description.en: Pairing-code remote access for DSH: a phone-first PWA with Web Push, plus a client role that operates the host's shared sessions in the native DSH interface, behind your own reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel.
description.zh: 配对码远程访问 DSH：手机端可安装 PWA、带 Web Push 推送；另一台设备作为客户端，在原生 DSH 界面里直接操作主机共享的会话，经自建反代或 Cloudflare Tunnel 接入。

description.en: All-in-one combo patch for STARDUSTLC's 18 DSH plugins: one command injects shared default configs across office, media, DevOps and notification presets; each component installs directly via a one-line add command (flat design, no git subdependencies).
description.zh: STARDUSTLC 插件全家桶·组合补丁：与 18 个组件插件配套，一条命令统一注入默认配置（办公流/媒体工坊/DevOps/通知/预设）；组件经一行 add 命令直装（扁平化设计，无 git 子依赖）。

description.en: Official-grade GitHub CI integration: a composite action.yml, a polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.
description.zh: 官方级 GitHub CI 集成：composite action.yml、轮询 PR 评审机器人（幂等行内评论 + status-check 门禁）以及 PR/issue 工具，所有写入走人工审批门。

description.en: Multi-provider usage dashboard with provider/model token breakdowns, calendar drill-downs, account balances, and OpenCode Go / Z.ai subscription quota tracking.
description.zh: 多供应商用量看板：按供应商/模型统计 Token 与日期下钻，统一展示账户余额，并追踪 OpenCode Go / Z.ai 订阅额度。

description.en: Reads and writes a self-hosted Bitwarden/Vaultwarden vault from any session: eleven bitwarden_* tools, real-time WebSocket sync with a polling fallback, a settings panel with readonly, ask and auto write modes, and optional local masking — with masking on, passwords surface as stable placeholders unless revealed one field at a time, and on-disk session logs are swept for bitwarden secrets. Masking and log sweeping are separate switches.
description.zh: 让任意会话直接读写自建的 Bitwarden/Vaultwarden 保险库：十一个 bitwarden_* 工具、WebSocket 实时同步（不可用时降级轮询）、readonly/ask/auto 三档写权限设置面板，以及可开启的本地脱敏——开启后密码默认以稳定占位符出现，需要时按条目+字段单次取回，落盘会话日志中的 bitwarden 明文也会被定期擦除；面板展示的密码与动态码会打码。脱敏与日志擦除是两个独立开关。

description.en: Five palettes for DeepSeek Harness — mono, warm sand, indigo, moss and a custom three-colour palette — each rebuilt in OKLCH for light and dark, with text and surface contrast solved per palette. Includes config export/import codes and a high-contrast mode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的五套配色（黑白、暖砂、靛蓝、苔绿、自定义三色），明暗两模式各自用 OKLCH 重算整条色阶，并按配色求解文字与承载面的对比度；附配置导入导出短码与高对比档。

description.en: In-conversation generative UI: the model renders interactive HTML cards into the chat stream, with streaming preview and sandboxed rendering.
description.zh: 对话内生成式 UI：模型把交互式 HTML 卡片直接画进会话流，带流式预览与沙箱渲染。

description.en: Authenticated mobile gateway for DeepSeek Harness: connects the companion native iOS client over WebSocket for sessions, live events, tasks, goals, approvals, commands, and file transfers, with QR pairing and device revocation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的设备鉴权移动网关：通过 WebSocket 连接配套原生 iOS 客户端，支持会话、实时事件、任务、Goal、审批、命令和文件传输，并提供二维码配对与设备撤销。

description.en: Signs in to a ChatGPT account over OAuth and serves that plan's models as a DeepSeek Harness provider route, calling api.openai.com/v1/responses with the account's plan scope rather than the Codex backend.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 登录 ChatGPT 账号，把该套餐的模型作为 DeepSeek Harness 的 provider 路由提供；调用 api.openai.com/v1/responses 并使用账号的套餐授权范围，而非 Codex 后端。

description.en: Your AI learning companion: helping you plan your studies, understand concepts, and build projects to master a subject.
description.zh: 你的AI学习搭档：定计划、讲知识、做项目，学透一门科目。

description.en: Shows a Live2D character in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI: blinking, breathing, lip-sync while talking, seven moods, and a speech bubble with its own chat, memory, corpus and stickers. Models are never bundled; every user drops in their own folder.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页右下角放一个 Live2D 角色：会眨眼、会呼吸、说话时嘴动、心情变了眉毛跟着动，用自己的对话气泡聊天，记得住之前说过的，能喂语料，也会配表情包。模型不用内置，谁装谁放自己的文件夹。

description.en: Render Mermaid code fences as SVG diagrams with streaming support, diagram/code switching, fullscreen zoom and pan, SVG export, and a bundled same-origin runtime.
description.zh: 将 Mermaid 代码围栏渲染为 SVG 图表，支持流式输出、图形/代码切换、全屏缩放与拖拽、SVG 导出，以及内置的同源运行时。

description.en: Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with native sidebar entry and admin drawer, self-healing bearer-token gateway over LAN/Tailscale, Android app (sessions/approvals/questions/goals), /fs/* file transfer (Range resume, 2GB upload), latency-based multi-server auto-switch, offline chat cache.
description.zh: 移动远程控制套件：原生侧边栏入口 + 管理抽屉的 bundle 插件，自带 Bearer 令牌网关自愈（局域网/Tailscale）；Android App 覆盖会话/审批/提问/goal；/fs/* 文件端点（Range 断点续传、2GB 上传）；多服务器测速自动切换；聊天记录离线缓存。

description.en: Pending-change review for DeepSeek Harness: every `edit`, `write` and `str_replace_editor` change is collected automatically into the file list, where a single change block, the blocks within a selection, or the whole file can be kept or reverted, and undo/redo is supported. It imports the workspace's version-control changes, shows the diff in a single-column or side-by-side view, and provides a Markdown preview in which changes can also be kept or reverted, in-file search, block jumping and copyable line references; the diff data is stored persistently, so the review continues after a restart.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的待处理改动审查：每次 edit/write/str_replace_editor 改动都会自动汇总到文件列表，可对单个差异块、选区内的多块或整个文件执行保留/回退，支持撤销重做。还能导入工作区的版本控制改动，以单栏或左右对照视图展示差异，并提供亦能保留/回退差异的 Markdown 预览、文件内搜索、差异块跳转与可复制的行号引用；差异数据持久化存储，重启后可继续审查。

description.en: Adds personality injection, a decaying memory card, a mood state and a daily diary so the agent keeps identity and history across sessions.
description.zh: 给 agent 加人格注入、会衰减的记忆卡、心情状态和每日日记，让它跨会话保留身份和历史。

description.en: LSP action surface for DSH: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints and rename, all backed by real language servers.
description.zh: DSH 的 LSP 动作面：诊断、格式化、补全、代码动作、符号、签名提示、inlay 提示与重命名，全部由真实语言服务器驱动。

description.en: MUV engine for DeepSeek Harness: runs the regex_scripts from a character card against model output, tracks variables, renders a status bar, expands macros and LaTeX, and styles tagged code blocks such as letter, terminal, newspaper and phone. Needs dsh-muv-table installed as well, which is its companion plugin.
description.zh: MUV 引擎：执行角色卡的 regex_scripts 实时替换模型输出，追踪变量、渲染状态栏、展开宏与 LaTeX、为标签代码块（信纸／终端／报纸／手机）套样式。需同时安装伴生插件 dsh-muv-table。

description.en: Undo/redo & rollback system for DSH: every config change is auto-snapshotted; undo/redo/restore to any version from the WebUI or the offline CLI/GUI tools (works even when DSH fails to boot).
description.zh: DSH 撤销/回退系统：配置变更自动存档，一键撤销/恢复/回退到任意版本，支持 WebUI 与离线 CLI/GUI 工具（DSH 启动失败也能救）。

description.en: Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 原生图片查看体验，支持指针中心缩放、拖动、画廊、下载、键盘操作和图片区域备注。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness kept as plain markdown, one fact per file. Every step the `MEMORY.md` index (the project store if there is one, plus a global store under `$DSH_HOME`) goes into the runtime context, so recall does not wait for a file read. The index has a hard cap, 200 lines / 25 KB by default, enforced by `ctx.tools.guard()`: a write that grows an over-cap index is denied, a rewrite that shrinks it passes. A read-only sidebar Memory page lists the notes by type. The plugin never writes memories on its own. An experimental companion mode adds note types for a persona's own life. The same store also works with Claude Code, Codex, Kiro and OpenClaw.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆，以纯 markdown 保存，一条事实一个文件。每一步都把索引 `MEMORY.md`（有项目库时含项目库，另加 `$DSH_HOME` 下的全局库）放进运行时上下文，召回不用等模型去读文件。索引有硬上限，默认 200 行 / 25KB，由 `ctx.tools.guard()` 强制执行：让已超限的索引变大的写入被拒绝，缩小它的重写一律放行。左侧栏有只读的「记忆」页，按类型列出笔记。插件不会自行写入记忆。实验性的大肥鱼模式为人设角色加了记录它自己人生的笔记类型。同一个记忆库也可供 Claude Code、Codex、Kiro、OpenClaw 使用。

description.en: Connects Qoder (China and Global) subscriptions to DSH through personal access tokens, keeping each variant on its own credentials and catalog, with saved-token switching, sidebar quota cards, per-model toggles, a context-window preference and a daily check-in.
description.zh: 通过个人访问令牌将 Qoder（国内版与国际版）接入 DSH，两版各自独立的凭证与模型目录，支持多令牌切换、侧栏额度卡、按模型开关、上下文窗口偏好与每日自动签到。

description.en: Views and builds CAD models (STL, OBJ, STEP, IGES, DXF, SVG) via cad_view/cad_info and OCCT parametric modeling tools, with an interactive viewer card and a resident CAD panel in the Web UI.
description.zh: 通过 cad_view/cad_info 与 OCCT 参数化建模工具查看和构建 CAD 模型（STL、OBJ、STEP、IGES、DXF、SVG），并在 Web UI 中提供交互式查看卡片与常驻 CAD 面板。

description.en: Deep PTC mode is an open-source agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that keeps the built-in PTC tool surface and replaces the persona with a working contract: a DeepSeek identity and unlimited-token-budget instruction so the model does not skip reads, commands or checks to save tokens; planning by estimated size (internal up to 5 minutes, shown without approval up to 20, approval required beyond); and asking about unclear intent instead of guessing. Waiting is limited in code by wrapping the official shell, job and question tools: foreground commands move to background jobs after 30 s (configurable), a steered user message ends the current wait so the model reads it, foreground pauses over 5 s and long timers in run_code are refused, and questions run in timed mode. The mode derives its preset from the official PTC declaration shipped by the installed Harness and inherits upstream composition changes, so an official PTC update — including removed or renamed modules — does not break existing sessions. A settings card selects the preset executor — Automatic, WSL Bash, Windows PowerShell, native Zsh or native Bash.
description.zh: 深度PTC模式是 DeepSeek Harness 的开源 Agent preset：保留内置 PTC 的工具面，把人设换成一份工作契约——写明 DeepSeek 身份与无限 token 预算，要求不为省 token 跳过读取、命令和验证；按预计耗时分档计划（5 分钟内直接做，5–20 分钟告知计划但不等审批，超过 20 分钟需批准）；意图不清时先提问而不是猜测。等待由代码限制：包装官方的命令、job 与提问工具，前台命令超过 30 秒（可配置）自动转为后台 job，用户插入消息时立即结束当前等待让模型读到消息，前台超过 5 秒的暂停和 run_code 中的长定时器被拒绝，提问采用限时模式。该模式在加载时从已安装 Harness 声明的官方 PTC 预设派生组成并继承上游变更，官方对 PTC 的增删改（包括移除或改名的模块）不会破坏已有会话。设置卡片可选择该预设的执行器——自动、WSL Bash、Windows PowerShell、原生 Zsh 或原生 Bash。

description.en: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 补丁风格文件编辑：单个 apply_patch 工具，接受 git/unified diff（默认）与 Codex apply_patch 语法（可选开启），在完整只读校验后全量原子应用；删除与移动走沙箱感知路径，并提供 dry-run 模式。

description.en: GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing your existing GLM quota or Coding Plan instead of the DeepSeek platform. Includes a translation layer for Zhipu's non-standard tool_result response layout.
description.zh: GLM(智谱)网页搜索 provider——把 web_search 后端切到智谱 Anthropic 兼容端点的服务端搜索工具,直接复用你现有的 GLM 额度或 Coding Plan,替代 DeepSeek 官方搜索通道,并内置智谱私有响应格式的翻译层。

description.en: Whale Girl light theme for the DSH Web UI, ported from a DreamSkin skin package: a full native --dsw-* token remap, the artwork as an ambient wallpaper behind a single light paper layer, and live controls for glass strength, conversation-only paper, wallpaper veil/focus/zoom and the composer focus glow, with a bilingual settings form on the installed-package page. Visual identity: 溟月 by 上善无形 → DeepSeek maid ver. by ZipZipPipe; artwork CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, code MIT.
description.zh: 移植自 DreamSkin 皮肤包的 DSH Web UI 鲸鱼娘亮色主题：完整重映射原生 --dsw-* 令牌，插画作为环境壁纸衬在单层轻纸面之后，玻璃强度、对话区独立纸面、壁纸遮罩/焦点/缩放与输入框聚焦光晕均可实时调节，设置表单以中英双语呈现在已安装插件详情页。视觉定型：溟月（上善无形）→ DeepSeek 女仆装（ZipZipPipe）；插画 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，代码 MIT。

description.en: Whale girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: browser floating mascot plus Windows desktop pet sharing one data backend, with real-time balance board, task notices, head-pat interaction, 19 pre-synthesized voiced lines with per-line emotion, and presence-aware idle speech.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌宠：浏览器悬浮桌宠与 Windows 桌面桌宠共享一套数据，实时余额木牌、任务通知、摸头互动、19 句预合成带情感的台词朗读，空闲节奏随是否在场自适应。

description.en: VSCode Remote-SSH-style development for DSH — connect to HPC and servers over SSH, read and edit remote files in the built-in Files tab, auto-SSH terminal, remote workspaces with single-roundtrip reads and result caching, and 12 session-aware remote_ssh_* model tools.
description.zh: 类 VSCode Remote-SSH 的 DSH 插件：SSH 连接超算/服务器，内置文件页签直读远程文件、终端页签自动 SSH，远程工作区配单往返合并读与结果缓存，含 12 个会话感知的 remote_ssh_* 模型工具。

description.en: Native Windows desktop control for DSH, 21 tools: UIA control tree plus offline OCR to see the screen, click a control by its name, type CJK without touching your clipboard, and drive WeChat / Office / browsers / online-class pages. It never steals your mouse or keyboard (it waits for you to stop), never resizes your windows, lets you type corrections mid-task from a sidebar panel, and after every action it reads the screen back and tells you honestly when it could not confirm. Persistent built-in browser channel. No driver, no extra runtime.
description.zh: 原生 Windows 桌面控制，共 21 个工具：UIA 控件树 + 离线 OCR 看屏幕、按控件名字点击、不占剪贴板地打中文，微信 / Office / 浏览器 / 网课都能操作。不抢你的鼠标键盘（你在用它会等）、从不改你的窗口大小，侧边栏「指挥台」可随时打字纠正，每步操作后都会回头核对屏幕并如实说明结果。内置持久登录的网页通道，无需驱动、无额外运行时。

description.en: Side chats and selection annotations for DeepSeek Harness, preserving full conversation history and bringing findings back to the main thread.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边追问与划选注释，保留完整对话历史，将结论带回主线。

description.en: Desktop pet (QQ-pet style): floats in the corner, draggable, feedable, playable.
description.zh: 桌面宠物（QQ 宠物形态）：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍。

description.en: Connects Huawei Cloud CodeArts to DeepSeek Harness with built-in OAuth2 sign-in (PKCE + DPoP) or a pasted token, after which CodeArts models are available in the DSH conversation window. Reads per-account credit balance, expiring credits and daily check-in from the CodeArts credit API, counts requests and tokens locally, and shows a per-account credits popover under the chat input box; the credits line and the upstream queue hint can each be turned off in settings.
description.zh: 把华为云 CodeArts 接入 DeepSeek Harness：内置华为云 OAuth2 登录（PKCE + DPoP），也支持粘贴 token；登录后即可在 DSH 对话窗口使用 CodeArts 提供的模型。积分余额、即将过期额度与每日签到读 CodeArts 自己的积分接口，请求数与 token 用量按账号在本机统计；对话输入框下方那行积分可点开看逐号明细，积分与上游排队位置都能在设置里单独关掉。

description.en: CalDAV calendar tools (list/create/update/delete/search/health) for Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/custom endpoints, with RRULE expansion, a month/week/agenda panel inside the settings page, in-panel connection setup that is tested before saving, and drag-to-reschedule in the week view (15-minute snapping, undo). A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: CalDAV 日历插件：查/建/改/删/搜日程与健康自检，Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/自定义端点，RRULE 重复事件展开；设置页内置月/周/议程面板，连接可在面板内填写并先测后存，周视图支持拖拽改期（15 分钟吸附、5 秒撤销）。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Thinking levels, image input and image generation for third-party models in the official Models page; multiple keys per provider routed by model, automatic failover between keys on failure, per-route custom request headers, and balance display.
description.zh: 在官方「模型」页为第三方模型补上思考等级、图片输入与生图；一个供应商可配多把密钥，按模型分流、失败自动换密钥重试，并可配置按路由的请求头、查看余额。

description.en: ChatGPT-style rich answers inside DeepSeek Harness: entity panels, KPI cards, series charts, sortable tables, nested layers, flow diagrams and local controls.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中呈现 ChatGPT 风格的富文本回答：实体面板、指标卡、多序列图表、可排序表格、嵌套分层图、流程图与本地控件。

description.en: End-to-end PowerPoint assistant preset for DeepSeek Harness with editable deck generation, template-preserving edits, rendering and structural quality checks. Needs Python 3.10+ with requirements.txt installed; rendering also needs LibreOffice and pdftoppm, and OCR of scanned documents needs Tesseract.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的一条龙 PowerPoint 助手预设，支持可编辑演示文稿生成、保留模板的修改、渲染和结构质量检查。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装 requirements.txt；渲染另需 LibreOffice 与 pdftoppm，扫描件 OCR 需 Tesseract。

description.en: Scopes system-prompt personas by workspace path or session id (exact, prefix, contains, regex), with an optional default persona for sessions nothing claimed, a 人设 tab on the conversation showing the prompt actually sent, import and export of the list, and a switch that refuses tool writes to the persona store.
description.zh: 按工作区路径或会话 ID 分发 system prompt 人设（完全一致 / 前缀 / 包含 / 正则），可指定一条默认人设兜底；会话页有「人设」页签，能看到实际发出去的提示词；人设列表可导入导出；另有一个开关拒绝工具写入人设存储。

description.en: Structural long-term memory for DSH: supersede, decay and entity-state tracking across 15 MCP tools, automatic recall and capture hooks, and a bounded pointer index published per request instead of filling the window. Requires Python 3.10+ with torch and sentence-transformers; the first run downloads a ~470 MB embedding model.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的结构化长期记忆：15 个 MCP 工具支持取代、衰减与实体状态跟踪，带自动召回与捕获钩子，并按请求发布有界指针索引，而不是等上下文塞满再压缩。需要带 torch 与 sentence-transformers 的 Python 3.10+；首次运行会下载约 470 MB 的嵌入模型。

description.en: Adds a switch between DeepSeek web chat and the Harness workspace in DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版中提供 DeepSeek 网页聊天与 Harness 工作区之间的切换。

description.en: Declarative DAG runtime for DSH tool plans with bounded parallel execution, read-only retries, per-step checkpoints, cancellation, and conservative crash recovery.
description.zh: DSH 工具计划的声明式 DAG 运行时，支持有界并行、只读重试、逐步落盘、取消及保守的崩溃恢复。

description.en: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed `ctx.memory` seam with a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a `memory` tool, and frozen snapshot injection, plus the dsh-memory-protocol v1 rehearsal with an adapter registry and a distributable conformance suite.
description.zh: 有界、分层、带审批门、可审计的跨会话记忆：`ctx.memory` 服务 + 零依赖 SQLite 存储 + `memory` 工具与冻结快照注入，并预演 dsh-memory-protocol v1——适配器注册表与可分发的一致性套件。

description.en: Second-model auto-review on the approval answerer chain: a read-only reviewer subagent returns structured allow/deny verdicts with reasons, fail-closed by default.
description.zh: 审批链上的第二模型自动审查：只读审查子代理返回带理由的 allow/deny 结构化裁决，默认 fail-closed。

description.en: Standalone wallpaper background for the DSH Web UI and desktop app: built-in wallpapers, local image/video uploads stored in IndexedDB, and a read-only local Wallpaper Engine library served by the bundled wallpaper-engine-api service in the repository; renders images, video and scene workshop previews, with light-fog/dark-overlay, blur, brightness and safe-zoom controls plus a read-only follow-desktop-wallpaper mode.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面与桌面端的独立壁纸背景：内置壁纸、本地图片/视频上传（存 IndexedDB）、只读接入本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库（需仓库自带的 wallpaper-engine-api 服务）；支持图片、视频与场景工坊预览渲染，可调浅色雾层/深色遮罩、模糊、亮度与安全放大，并可只读跟随桌面壁纸。

description.en: Replaces the default web search and fetch channel with eight free search engines including Tavily, Exa and Brave, tried in a configurable fallback order. Keys are entered in a settings card that also toggles the web_fetch tool.
description.zh: 把默认的 Web 搜索与抓取通道替换为 Tavily、Exa、Brave 等八个免费搜索引擎，按可配置的顺序依次 fallback。在设置卡片中填写各引擎 Key，并可开关 web_fetch 工具。

description.en: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompts, memory, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories, with review gates and hot-reloaded skills.
description.zh: 持续自进化：从会话轨迹沉淀版本化、可审计、可回滚的 harness 状态（提示词/记忆/技能/子代理规格），带审查门禁与技能热加载。

description.en: Keeps the NapCat QQ backend alive next to DSH: probes the OneBot 11 HTTP port at startup, launches NapCat when the port does not answer, then rechecks every 45 seconds, kills duplicate process chains, hides the console window, can create a logon scheduled task when a task name is set, and adds a settings page plus napcat_status, napcat_restart and napcat_dedupe tools. Optionally remembers the QQ password, behind a risk confirmation, so an expired fast-login token can be renewed without scanning a QR code. Windows only; without that scheduled task the launched QQ exits together with DSH.
description.zh: 让 NapCat 这个 QQ 后端跟着 DSH 一起活着：启动时探测 OneBot 11 的 HTTP 端口，连不上就拉起 NapCat，之后每 45 秒复查、清掉重复的进程链、隐藏控制台窗口、可在填写任务名后创建登录计划任务，并提供设置页以及 napcat_status、napcat_restart、napcat_dedupe 三个工具。可选记住 QQ 密码（默认关闭，开启前需确认风险），让失效的快速登录令牌不用扫码也能自己续上。仅 Windows；不建计划任务时，拉起的 QQ 会随 DSH 一起退出。

description.en: Shell tool with four Windows backends (PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2) plus an interactive PTY terminal; the MSYS2 backend starts bash.exe with -lc so /etc/profile puts /usr/bin and /mingw64/bin on PATH, and injects MSYSTEM=MINGW64 into the PTY environment. Written in TypeScript, targets DSH 0.1.2+.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上支持 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2 四种后端，外加交互式 PTY 终端；MSYS2 后端以 bash.exe -lc 启动，让 /etc/profile 把 /usr/bin 与 /mingw64/bin 带进 PATH，并为 PTY 环境注入 MSYSTEM=MINGW64。TypeScript 编写，面向 DSH 0.1.2+。

description.en: Desktop BigFish companion for DSH: real-time balance, out-of-browser desktop Q&A, 7 custom animations, 53 meme lines.
description.zh: 桌面大肥鱼增强版桌宠：点击实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，浏览器外桌面问答，7 套专属动作，53 条玩梗。

description.en: Approve tool calls, watch streaming output and answer questions from a phone over a zero-knowledge relay, with payload-level end-to-end encryption.
description.zh: 在手机上审批工具调用、看流式输出、回答问题；载荷级端到端加密，中继可自托管。

description.en: Message-level rollback, single-message deletion, and replay-based restore for DSH sessions; operations are append-only surface replacements, with confirmation prompts and a running-session guard. Requires Node.js 23.5+.
description.zh: DSH 会话消息级回滚、单条删除与重放式恢复；操作以 append-only surface replace 实现，带确认提示和运行中会话保护。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: Per-model appearance for the DSH Web UI: an ordered rule list matched against the current session model name, each rule carrying its own wallpaper, theme colour, layout mode, framing and wallpaper opacity and blur, plus per-surface opacity and frosted-glass blur for the main background, left panel, right panel, cards and panels, input and controls, settings panel, conversation text frame and trajectory view.
description.zh: 按模型切换 DSH Web 界面外观：有序规则列表按当前会话的模型名匹配，每条规则自带壁纸、主题色、布局模式、取景与背景透明度、模糊；另有主背景、左侧栏、右侧栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页的分区透明度与毛玻璃模糊。

description.en: Windows only: the agent edits documents inside the Word, Excel and PowerPoint (Microsoft Office or WPS Office) windows you have open, through the applications' automation interface, so changes appear live and you can edit alongside; it reads structure, applies batches of edits, renders pages to images to check layout, and saves or exports PDF.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：Agent 通过办公软件的自动化接口，直接在你打开的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint（微软 Office 或 WPS Office）窗口里改文档，改动实时出现，你可以同时编辑；可读取结构、批量修改、把页面渲染成图片核对排版、保存或导出 PDF。

description.en: A character who lives on her own phone: the plugin installs and runs her Android phone, and any app notification can wake her; she installs apps herself and browses, likes and comments in apps such as Xiaoheihe or Bilibili; she has her own QQ (NapCat / SnowLuma, multi-part replies, stickers); memory with people cards, a daily diary at 23:30 and automatic recall before each wake (local embeddings by default, SiliconFlow / DashScope optional); a life between conversations (after HDS-Interlude); and an optional microVM computer with approval gates. Sidebar tabs show her phone, her computer and a dot panel; personal settings live in ~/.dsh/dsh-dot.json, and each of the six components can be turned off. Only the QQ number set with /qq owner counts as you; other people's messages are treated as untrusted notifications.
description.zh: 住在自己手机上的角色：插件自动安装并运行她的 Android 手机，任何 App 的新通知都能叫醒她；她自己装 App，逛小黑盒、B 站等并点赞评论；有自己的 QQ（NapCat / SnowLuma，分条回复、发表情包）；记忆含人物卡、每天 23:30 的日记和叫醒前的自动召回（默认本机 embedding，可切 SiliconFlow / DashScope）；两次对话之间的生活（幕间，按 HDS-Interlude）；可选 microVM 电脑带审批闸门。右侧栏有手机画面、虚拟机画面和 dot 面板；个人设置集中在 ~/.dsh/dsh-dot.json，六个组件都能单独关闭。只有 `/qq owner` 指定的 QQ 号算你本人，别人的消息按不可信通知处理。

description.en: MUV variable table editor for DeepSeek Harness: a tree view of the variables being tracked, a macro test panel for random, pick and roll, a dice shortcut bar and pick-cache management. Companion plugin for dsh-muv-engine.
description.zh: MUV 变量表格编辑器：树形变量面板、宏测试浮窗（random／pick／roll）、骰子快捷栏与 pick 缓存管理。dsh-muv-engine 的伴生插件。

description.en: Sidebar overhaul for the dsh web UI: long-press drag to reorder the panel icon rail, one arrow to fold it away, whole-row height caps on both the panel list and the pinned section (30% of the rail, rounded down to whole rows), a pinned-session section that mirrors the shipped row's live status (spinner, waiting-for-reply, relative time), drag-to-reorder conversation view tabs, archived Sessions sunk to the bottom of each group newest-first, forked child Sessions following their parent into the pinned section, and a generic lift that moves any plugin's sidebar-footer entry up into the rail. Each subsystem starts behind its own guard, so one that fails returns null and the rest of the plugin still mounts.
description.zh: dsh 网页端侧边栏整体增强：长按拖拽重排面板图标栏，一个箭头即可整栏折叠；面板列表与置顶区都按整行限制高度（占侧栏 30%，向下取整行）；置顶会话区镜像原生行的实时状态（转圈、待回复、相对时间）；顶部会话视图标签可拖拽换位；归档会话按时间新到旧沉到每组末尾；分叉出的子会话自动跟进父会话所在的置顶区；并把任意插件注册在侧栏底部的入口提升到同一栏内。每个子系统各自带启动守卫，单个失败只返回 null，不影响整个插件挂载。

description.en: Cross-platform Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: virtual-mouse human-like operation (screen_observe + computer_click + type + key + scroll + drag, 11 tools), AX-tree zero-vision-cost mode with free GLM-4V-Flash vision fallback, safety guards (snapshot TTL / app whitelist / dangerous-action approval / password-box protection).
description.zh: 跨平台 Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作（screen_observe / computer_click / type / key / scroll / drag 共 11 个工具），AX 语义树零视觉成本 + GLM-4V-Flash 免费视觉兜底，安全护栏（快照 TTL / 应用白名单 / 危险操作审批 / 密码框保护）。

description.en: White-box causal guardrail for dsh: every tool call is adjudicated before execution along a deterministic causal logic chain — blocks destructive and credential-file operations, escalates repeated boundary violations, cuts faulting links until verified-fixed, and gives risk verdicts on un-auditable execution; runs fully local with zero API cost, plus 6 white-box self-check tools.
description.zh: 唯稳律白箱因果闸门：每个工具调用执行前沿确定性因果逻辑链裁决——拦截破坏性与凭据文件操作、对反复越界升级止损、故障环节切断至修复验证、不可审计执行给出风险判定；纯本地运行、零 API 成本，附带 6 个白箱自查工具。

description.en: Bridges a DSH session and QQ over NapCat HTTP, forwarding agent replies to QQ and feeding messages you send in QQ back into the session.
description.zh: 通过 NapCat HTTP 把 DSH 会话和 QQ 双向打通：AI 说完自动发到 QQ，你在 QQ 里说的话自动转进会话。

description.en: Blender 3D production plugin with 30 modeling/reconstruction skills, 13 runtime tools, and 26 deterministic helpers for reference fitting, rendering, validation, animation, and portable export; installable as `dsh-blender`.
description.zh: Blender 3D 生产插件：提供 30 个建模/重建 Skill、13 个运行时工具和 26 个确定性 Helper，覆盖参考图拟合、渲染、验证、动画与可移植格式导出；npm 包名 `dsh-blender`。

description.en: A Versions tab on the Plugins page: one-click upgrades that replace the plugin in place where they can (no uninstall, enabled state preserved, falling back to remove + reinstall with the reason logged when the profile writer lock is busy), live pnpm output with per-step timing and cancel, the full published version history with one-click rollback, every version checked against the running DSH so incompatible ones are marked and blocked, a rollback that installs the old version but cannot activate it reported separately from a lost package, profile manifest writes taken under the harness writer lock with one recoverable journal record per package after a failed upgrade, mirror-gap warnings, and a selectable npm registry saved in the profile.
description.zh: 在「插件」页新增「版本」标签：一键升级，能就地替换时就地替换（不卸载、启用状态保留；拿不到 profile 写入锁时退回卸载再装，并在日志写明走了哪条路），实时显示 pnpm 输出、每步耗时并可取消，列出全部已发布版本并一键回滚，每个版本先与当前运行的 DSH 核对，装不了的标出并禁用按钮，回滚时装回却无法激活的情况与包丢失分开说明，profile manifest 读写走 harness 自己的写入锁，升级失败后按包各留一条可恢复的 journal 记录，标出镜像落后上游的缺口，安装源可选并写进 profile。

description.en: Connects 36 model sources (free and pay-as-you-go APIs, Codex and Kimi subscriptions, local Ollama and LM Studio) to dsh and gives other tools one authenticated OpenAI-compatible address and key. The free pool model free/auto combines free API quotas such as ModelScope, Zhipu Flash, Gemini and Cloudflare Workers AI, moves to the next provider when one is used up, and by default only uses quotas that do not charge. Models appear in dsh grouped by source; Cherry Studio, Cline and scripts can use the same address (HTTPS is set up automatically next to dsh-vps). Daily check-in for 10 services (Trae, Qoder, WorkBuddy, Doubao, MiniMax Code, WPS Lingxi, DuMate, AStudio, Huawei CodeArts, OfficeAce) with several accounts each, pasted credentials for checking in on a server, and custom check-in services described as JSON. Installed from the plugin market it sets itself up, and the engine ships as an npm package, so no GitHub access is needed.
description.zh: 把 36 个模型来源（免费和按量付费的 API、Codex 和 Kimi 订阅、本机 Ollama 和 LM Studio）接进 dsh，并给其他软件一个带鉴权的 OpenAI 兼容地址和 key。免费池模型 free/auto 把魔搭、智谱 Flash、Gemini、Cloudflare Workers AI 等免费 API 额度合在一起，一家用完换下一家，默认只用不会扣费的额度。模型在 dsh 里按来源分组出现；Cherry Studio、Cline 和脚本可以用同一个地址（和 dsh-vps 同机时自动开 https）。每天自动签到 10 家（Trae、Qoder、WorkBuddy、豆包、MiniMax Code、WPS 灵犀、DuMate、AStudio、华为 CodeArts、OfficeAce），每家可加多个账号，可手动填凭据在服务器上签，也能用 JSON 描述添加自定义签到服务。从插件市场安装后自动完成设置；引擎随 npm 包一起安装，不需要访问 GitHub。

description.en: Runs your logged-in Claude Code CLI as a dsh model provider: live model list, session resume, approval relay, rewind, memory panel and remote SSH workspaces.
description.zh: 把已登录的 Claude Code CLI 作为 dsh 的模型提供方：实时模型列表、按会话恢复、审批中转、回退、记忆面板，以及远程 SSH 主机上的工作区。

description.en: Appearance customization for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI: theme palette, wallpaper and video backgrounds, translucency and glassmorphism.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观自定义:主题调色、壁纸与视频背景、半透明与毛玻璃。

description.en: Persistent SQLite session state, story memory and recall, repositories, and model-facing record tools for DSH roleplay plugins.
description.zh: 为 DSH 角色扮演插件提供持久化 SQLite 会话状态、故事记忆与回忆、数据仓库以及面向模型的记录工具。

description.en: Experience memory and reflection for DSH agents: automatically extracts candidate lessons after tasks and recalls user-reviewed lessons in relevant later tasks. Supports source provenance, project-scoped retrieval, conflict handling, usage feedback and expiry review; capture and recall have separate controls, and writing lessons to AGENTS.md requires preview and explicit application. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: DSH 智能体经验记忆与反思插件：任务后自动整理候选经验，经用户审阅采纳后在相关任务中自动召回。支持来源追溯、按项目检索、冲突处理、使用反馈和到期复核；整理与召回可分别开关，写入 AGENTS.md 需预览并手动应用。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Real-time local TTS for DeepSeek Harness: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, a read-aloud button, and a settings panel for the GSV-TTS-Lite engine.
description.zh: 将本地高性能 TTS 引擎 GSV-TTS-Lite 实时接入 DeepSeek Harness：语音预设、自动朗读、引擎配置助手、朗读按钮与设置面板。

description.en: Select text in the DSH Web GUI and ask about it in place (floating button, or the Alt+Q shortcut): an independent subagent that inherits no parent context answers, streaming into a side card hosted by the native right sidebar, dsh-better-sidebar, or a built-in overlay — and the question can be routed to the main conversation instead.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面划词就地追问（浮出按钮，或 Alt+Q 快捷键）：答案由不继承父上下文的独立子代理流式产出到侧边卡片，承载面为原生右侧栏 / dsh-better-sidebar / 内置浮层，也可把问题改为落回主对话。

description.en: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.
description.zh: 对话回退：基于持久 Change Ledger 回滚会话与工作区状态。

description.en: Delete a DSH conversation from its sidebar menu or the conversation header, optionally cascading into that conversation's associated memory nodes when you tick the box (the confirmation dialog shows the hit count before you commit); deletes land in a plugin recycle bin with restore, every action is appended to an audit log, and batch deletes are rate-limited with per-conversation rollback.
description.zh: 在会话列表菜单或会话页头部删除对话，可勾选一并删除该对话关联的记忆节点（确认框先显示命中条数）；删除进入插件回收站可恢复，每次操作写入审计日志，批量删除有限流与逐会话回滚。

description.en: Personalization for the agent: a Web UI panel (about-you, reply style & tone, traits for headings/lists and emoji, output language, custom instructions) and `/soul` commands, with nickname/occupation/bio/style/traits/language compiled into a system prompt and re-injected into active sessions. Exposes `soulConfig` for other plugins and a `set_persona` tool the agent can call.
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供个性化设置：Web 设置栏目（关于你、回复风格和语调、标题与列表 / 表情符号特质、输出语言、自定义指令）与 `/soul` 命令；昵称 / 职业 / 介绍 / 风格 / 特质 / 语言编译进提示词并推送给所有活动会话。向其他插件暴露 `soulConfig` 服务，并注册 Agent 可调用的 `set_persona` 工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: restart without losing work. It waits until every conversation is idle, restarts the host, and picks the interrupted work back up instead of dying with it; where a supervisor already manages the host it asks that supervisor, and it never starts a second host next to a running one. It also fixes a common one: stale login cookies pile up on every launch until the request header overflows and the host will not start; the plugin clears them before each restart. Every restart is preceded by a snapshot of the configuration and the installed plugins - 2 are kept by default, up to 10 are allowed, and old or incomplete ones are pruned. That snapshot is never applied automatically: the plugin does not watch the host and does not restore anything on its own; it is only there for you to look at, or to roll back by hand. When the work is done it counts down and powers the machine off, so nobody has to stay up at night. It works on the Windows desktop client, and on a hosted dsh web instance - verified on WSL with systemd; Windows-hosted web, WSL without systemd, and native Linux are untested.
description.zh: 重启不丢工作：等所有对话空闲后自动重启，重启后接着干、不中断；已有守护的机器交给守护重启，绝不双开。 还顺手治一个常见毛病：反复启动攒下的过期登录 cookie 会把请求头撑爆、让 DSH 起不来，插件在每次重启前先清掉它们。 每次重启前自动备份配置和已装插件，默认留 2 份、最多 10 份，旧的和不完整的自动清理。 这份备份不会被自动使用：插件不监视宿主、不自动还原，它只是给你留一份可以手工翻回去的存档。 所有工作完成后倒数关机，晚上无需人值守。 桌面客户端可用；dsh web 托管端已在 WSL（有 systemd）上验证；Windows 上的 web、无 systemd 的 WSL、原生 Linux 尚未验证。

description.en: Install suites from any Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi or agent-plugins.org git marketplace repo — skills, MCP servers, hooks and slash commands are injected into DSH sessions at runtime, with a market page in the Web GUI.
description.zh: 把任意 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Kimi / agent-plugins.org 的 git 市场仓库加为源，套件的技能、MCP 服务器、hooks 与斜杠命令在运行时注入 DSH 会话，并自带 Web 市场页。

description.en: SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the right.
description.zh: DSH SSH 运维终端：在主对话中直接指挥已连接的服务器（ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect），右侧保留可交互的 xterm.js 终端。

description.en: Compare Git/SVN versions across repositories and export Chinese Markdown release reports with optional approved model analysis.
description.zh: 比较多个 Git/SVN 项目的版本差异，导出中文 Markdown 发布报告，并可明确授权模型分析。

description.en: Adds a trash for DSH sessions: nothing expires automatically. Delete or batch delete moves sessions there, where you can read, restore, or permanently delete them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话加上回收站。增加删除会话、多选批量删除会话功能，删除的会话会被移至回收站。回收站内的会话可恢复，也可彻底删除；彻底删除就是永久删除，之后不可恢复，也不会自动过期。回收站内可以查看会话正文，方便区分会话。

description.en: Adds a Geek level to the Performance & usage setting: a live reading of the newest request in the composer status row (first-token latency, generation speed, output tokens, total time, amortised speed), and a drawer listing the last ten requests with an average row. Output tokens come from the provider usage; a calibrated character estimate is used only when usage is absent.
description.zh: 在「性能与用量」设置里增加极客档：输入区状态行实时显示最新一次请求的首字延迟、生成速度、输出 Token、总用时与折算速度，并可展开抽屉查看最近 10 次请求及一行平均值。输出 Token 取自上游返回的 usage，仅当 usage 缺失时才使用按内容类型标定的字符估算。

description.en: Human-readable Markdown memory for DeepSeek Harness: user-level (~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md) + workspace-level memory injected every turn, auto daily-log writing with distillation, bridges existing WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy memory dirs, memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read tools with built-in dedup, and a bilingual settings page. Plain-text storage, no database.
description.zh: 人类可读的 Markdown 记忆插件：用户级（~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md）+ 工作区级双层记忆，每轮自动注入提示词，回合结束自动写日志并按期蒸馏沉淀；可桥接已有 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 记忆目录；内置 memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read 三个工具（自动去重）与中英双语设置页。纯文件存储、无数据库，记事本即可编辑。

description.en: Engineering intelligence for coding agents — persistent, evidence-aware, project-isolated engineering memory with unified hybrid search (memory + RAG documentation) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向编程代理的工程智能——为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、证据感知、项目隔离的工程记忆，以及统一的混合搜索（记忆 + RAG 文档）。

description.en: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate, and global + project-scoped JSON stores that follow your git repo.
description.zh: 跨会话明文记忆：确定性 BM25 关键词召回（无向量嵌入），memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget 五个工具 + 人工确认闸门，global/project 两层 JSON 存储（project 随 git 分享）。

description.en: Write, check, and publish a Chinese Quarto Book: nine-step chapter writing, structure/link/figure checks, a consistent theme, and render acceptance. Loads only in type: book repositories; requires Quarto CLI and Python 3.
description.zh: 把一份 Quarto Book 写成可读、可查、可发布的中文技术书：九步章节写作、结构/链接/图表检查、统一主题与渲染验收。仅在 type: book 仓库加载；需 Quarto CLI 与 Python 3。

description.en: An agent preset for evidence-checked research: every step advances only through system-verified observations, L3+ claims go to an independent evaluator, and the session folds into a replayable ledger that grows into a browsable domain ontology. Requires DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1.
description.zh: 以证据为准的研究用智能体预设：每一步只能靠系统核验过的观测推进，L3 以上的结论交给独立评估者，整场会话折成一份可重放的账本，并长成可浏览的领域本体。需要 DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: one chief orchestrator that never implements itself — it triages every request, has a PM expert plan the work, and delegates implementation to domain experts via a merged expert roster (list and summon tools), scheduling parallel work through a dependency-DAG taskboard and a file-based message bus, with delivery gated by an independent review. Ships 11 core experts; more expert teams (Agency agents EN/ZH, classic collections) are one-click downloads from the settings page over dual GitHub/CDN channels with sha256 verification. Published on npm as dsh-expert-orchestrator (requires DSH >= 0.1.7-alpha.2).
description.zh: 多智能体编排 agent preset：首席编排者不亲自实施——先分诊、请 PM 专家规划、经合并专家花名册（召唤工具）把实施委派给领域专家，依赖 DAG 任务板与落盘消息总线调度并行协作，交付前经独立评审门禁。出厂内置 11 位核心专家；更多专家团（Agency agents 中英文、classic 集合）可在设置页一键下载，走 GitHub/CDN 双通道并经 sha256 验签。npm 包名 dsh-expert-orchestrator（要求 DSH >= 0.1.7-alpha.2）。

description.en: Adds Tako chat models to the official llm-pi-ai provider list from Tako's public catalog, with live refresh, context windows from size tags, and browser one-click sign-in writing a cr_ key into DSH credentials.
description.zh: 从 Tako 公开模型目录把聊天模型接入官方 llm-pi-ai，实时刷新并按尺寸标签写入上下文窗口，支持浏览器一键登录，把 cr_ 密钥存入 DSH 凭据。

description.en: Skill-driven harness/loop engineering workflow agent plugin.
description.zh: 技能驱动的 harness/loop 工程化工作流插件。

description.en: Novel generator: builds a world snapshot along a story timeline and, from the latest snapshot and the most recent chapters, deduces the next chapter. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 小说生成器：按时间线生成世界快照，通过世界快照和最近章节自动推演新章节。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Windows desktop computer-use tools (click, type, key, screenshot) with freshness checks, approval gating, process-identity verification around every action, and a sanitized audit trail.
description.zh: Windows 桌面电脑操作工具（点击、输入、按键、截屏）：每次动作都带新鲜度校验、审批门、进程身份核验与脱敏审计。

description.en: Agentic roleplay for DSH with structured worlds, autonomous characters, persistent sessions, world authoring, speech, and image generation. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay#state to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供具有结构化世界、自主角色、持久会话、世界创作、语音与图像生成功能的智能体角色扮演系统。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay#state。

description.en: Project-level icon library: a right-sidebar Icons panel plus four agent tools (icon_list, icon_get, icon_save, icon_annotate) that turn SVG shapes into named, rule-described assets. Artwork can be pasted, imported from Iconify or IconMCP, adopted from a workspace scan, or generated; editing one drawing rewrites every code reference to it.
description.zh: 项目级图标库：右栏「Icons」面板 + 四个 agent 工具（icon_list、icon_get、icon_save、icon_annotate），把 SVG 变成有名称、有应用规则、可被指代的资产；图形可粘贴、从 Iconify / IconMCP 导入、从工作区扫描收编或用 AI 生成，改一次图形，代码里的所有引用一起更新。

description.en: SSH host manager for DeepSeek Harness: browse ~/.ssh/config, store AES-256-GCM encrypted passwords, run batch commands and SFTP, and open interactive PTY terminals in persistent sidebar tabs.
description.zh: DSH 的 SSH 主机管理插件：浏览 ~/.ssh/config，保存 AES-256-GCM 加密密码，执行批量命令与 SFTP，并在可保持的侧边栏标签页中打开交互式 PTY 终端。

description.en: Claude Code-style declarative permission rules: ordered allow/deny/ask YAML rules matching tool names, arguments, workspace paths, and agent identity on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, with full session-log audit, dry-run mode, and hot reload.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格的声明式权限规则：按序 allow/deny/ask 的 YAML 规则，在 tools/pre-execute 瀑布上匹配工具名、参数、工作区路径与 agent 身份，带完整会话日志审计、干跑模式与热重载。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop-style theme for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with compact sidebar and chat layouts, light and dark themes, model and reasoning-effort controls, and an interactive pixel whale with spout, hop and tail-wag reactions on new sessions.
description.zh: 面向 macOS 与 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 的 Claude Code Desktop 风格主题，提供紧凑侧栏与会话布局、浅色与深色主题、模型与推理强度控件，以及支持随机喷水、轻弹和摆尾互动的新会话页像素小鲸鱼。

description.en: Diagnoses and repairs DeepSeek Harness on native Windows around the official persistent PowerShell and Workspace Write stack, creates the desktop shortcut, and keeps earlier Git Bash and BusyBox presets behind an explicit legacy setup. No WSL.
description.zh: 围绕官方持久 PowerShell 与 Workspace Write 方案检查和修复原生 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness，创建桌面快捷方式，并仅通过明确的 legacy 安装保留早期 Git Bash 与 BusyBox 预设，无需 WSL。

description.en: Let the Blue Big Fat Fish browse Bilibili for you: it comments on your behalf, DMs you interesting finds, writes a diary, and keeps a memory for long-term summaries. It filters videos to your taste, creates Markdown digests, and can watch comments and reply for you. In Circle Mode, it replies only inside threads explicitly invited by the video uploader in a top-level comment — ordinary viewer requests do not count, and it never starts a new top-level comment. Commenting, DMs, auto-run, and comment watch are off by default. Needs Node 22, DSH 0.1.7-rc.1+, a signed-in Bilibili account, a model route and Python.
description.zh: 让蓝色大肥鱼替你刷 B 站：帮你评论，把发现的有趣内容私信给你，还会写下日记；它也有记忆，能长期总结。视频按你的口味筛选并生成 Markdown 日报，也能守着评论区替你回话。开启「圈地自萌」后，它只回视频 UP 主本人主动邀请的楼中楼，普通观众喊话不算，绝不自己起新楼；评论、私信、自动运行和守护默认关闭。需 Node 22、DSH 0.1.7-rc.1+、已登录的 B 站账号、模型线路与 Python。

description.en: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness with a content-addressed evidence ledger, versioned sealed reports where every claim carries a verification verdict and the manifest hash seals the directory, and retrieval orchestration that reuses the ctx.web and ctx.jobs seams.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可核查研究报告引擎：通过内容寻址的证据台账和版本化封存报告使每条结论携带核查结论，由 manifest 哈希封存目录，检索编排复用 ctx.web 与 ctx.jobs 接口。

description.en: IM Companion for dsh-im: groups Feishu/WeChat/QQ bots by Agent in DSH workspaces and enhances DSH native session states (blue/orange/red rail markers for running, needs-review and error), with left badges, one-click filter, fleet overview and drag-to-move. Clean uninstall.
description.zh: dsh-im辅助插件：创造助理/家的概念，把飞书/微信/QQ等机器人收进DSH工作区，并提供更多强大的扩展功能。增强DSH原生会话状态:哪些在执行任务、哪些在等你回复、哪些有异常。感谢使用🌹。

description.en: A pet fish you raise in DSH. No personality settings — she grows up through the event stream, and your interactions decide who she becomes. She browses Bilibili on her own, writes a diary, and brings what she finds back to ask you. Four stages and three bottlenecks advance only by what happens; only after all four does she begin to have a stance list. Her diary is hers by default; one switch in settings and you can read it. Records in the event stream can never be deleted, so it remains the only trustworthy source. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在DSH里养一只大肥鱼宠物，你可以陪伴她长大。养成系体验，没有人格设置，通过你和她的互动学习成长。她可以自己刷B站，写日记，提取信息去问你，你的反馈决定了她成为什么样的人。通过事件流突破四个阶段、三道瓶颈，去积累「立场清单」，四个阶段完成后才会开始有立场。她的日记默认只给自己看，你在设置里打开就能读。事件流不能删除记录，是唯一可信源。没有任何运行时依赖。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: bidirectional sessions, conversation steering, home-channel routing, and TTS voice notes sent as Telegram audio messages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥接：双向会话、对话引导、主频道路由，以及以 Telegram 语音消息发送的 TTS 语音笔记。

description.en: Agent persona: gives DSH one global persona (name, language, persona prompt) that every new session carries at the front of its system prompt, plus a long-term memory you grow from any chat in one click; three built-in presets ship with it, and a Big fat fish persona is active right after install; chat sessions can also be deleted from the sidebar row menu.
description.zh: Agent人格：给 DSH 一份全局人格（名称、语言、人格提示词），每个新会话的系统提示都带着它，外加一份长期记忆，聊天里点一下就能把选中的对话提炼进去；自带三个内置预设，装好默认启用大肥鱼人格；侧栏会话行还能直接删除会话。

description.en: RSS/Atom subscription tools (list/add/remove/fetch/check/search/opml_import/opml_export/health) with cross-feed keyword search, cursor-based incremental fetch and OPML import/export, persisted to settings. A step-by-step first-run guide (3 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: RSS/Atom 订阅九工具（管理/校验/抓取解析/跨订阅搜索/增量抓取/OPML 导入导出/健康自检），游标增量抓取，订阅持久化到 settings。面板内置 3 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: System-1 decision guard for DeepSeek Harness, 4 questions asked before tool calling (risk reversible, relevance, injection suspension) and allow/ask/reject action. Needs an API key for a system-one compatible provider; decision requests are sent there.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 System-1 决策守卫：在每次工具调用前问模型四个问题 （风险、可逆性、任务相关性、注入嫌疑），据此放行、询问或拦截。

description.en: Local long-term memory for DSH sessions: archives older turns under context pressure, with a turn-summary index for faster turn lists, statistics, window probing and archive planning (rebuilt automatically when unavailable, with a manual full verification), four tiered hot-memory boards, project documents with enabled/disabled/archived filters and optional owner-controlled family sharing, project hot memory, dual user/assistant turn previews, memory families with editable names and root transfer, root-abdication recovery, orphan-family takeover, summary keyword locator with segment-level candidates and paging, manual injection, 20K segmented reads, and tag-related retrieval. Includes staged recall cues, automatic compatibility with older memory layouts, and post-install version verification. Off in each new session until you turn it on with `/palace on` or the Memory Palace tab. All data stays in the workspace.
description.zh: DSH 会话的本地长期记忆：上下文压力升高时归档较早轮次，提供轮次摘要索引（列表、统计、窗口与归档规划更快；索引不可用时自动重建，并支持手动全量校验）、四板块分级热记忆、项目档案（支持启用/停用/归档筛选与可由拥有者控制的家族共用）与项目热记忆、轮次用户与助手双摘要、记忆家族与根转移（家族名可独立修改，转移保留项目热记忆）、让位恢复与空根接管、摘要关键词定位与段级候选翻页、手动注入、20K 分段读取和 tag 关联检索；包含分级回忆 cue、旧版记忆布局自动兼容与安装后版本校验。新会话默认关闭，用 /palace on 或「记忆回廊」页签开启。数据都保存在工作区。

description.en: Accessibility-first macOS computer use: fresh observations, stale-state rejection, scoped permissions, and safe input.
description.zh: macOS 电脑控制：Accessibility 观测、过期状态拒绝、作用域权限与安全输入。

description.en: Memory the assistant writes and maintains itself — diary, index, self-description, the live emotion value — put back in front of it at the start of every session. It reads only the sections you name, never summarises, fills in missing starter files, and stamps a start date into an undated anchor in place — apart from that one additive edit it never changes an existing file. The writing side ships as skills.
description.zh: 让 AI 自己写、自己维护的一份记忆——日记、索引、自我描述、此刻的情绪；插件每个会话把她写的那几段摆回她眼前。只读你点名的几段，不自动总结、不替她写正文，只补缺的起始文件、给没有日期的锚点补上起算日；除此之外不改动已有文件。怎么写做成 skill 随包发。

description.en: Generates game art from reference images via Seedream image generation and MiniMax image-to-video, assembling eight-direction sprites, sequence frames, and skeleton animations with local green-screen keying.
description.zh: 基于 Seedream 生图与 MiniMax 图生视频，从参考图生成游戏素材，本地绿幕抠像后合成八方向精灵图、序列帧与骨骼动画。

description.en: AIGC creation inside DeepSeek Harness: generate images, video, audio and 3D with open and closed-source models — parameter schemas, cost estimates, approval gates and a task panel.
description.zh: 把 AIGC 创作直接放进 DeepSeek Harness：用开源与闭源模型生成图像、视频、音频与 3D，含参数 schema、费用预估、审批与任务面板。

description.en: Persistent enhanced web search: multi-engine routing (DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/Bilibili/YouTube/V2EX/Xiaohongshu/Twitter/Reddit/RSS), SQLite+LRU cache, userscript-style extraction, Playwright rendering.
description.zh: 增强型、可持久化的网页搜索：多引擎路由（DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/B站/YouTube/V2EX/小红书/Twitter/Reddit/RSS）、SQLite+LRU 缓存、userscript 风格抽取、Playwright 渲染。

description.en: Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace and Left/Right switch workspaces, reading session identity from the client controllers rather than the DOM, and yielding the keys back to the composer while a draft is being edited.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的方向键导航：上/下在当前工作区内切换会话，左/右切换工作区；会话身份来自客户端控制器而非 DOM；输入框存在草稿时把方向键交还给光标。

description.en: Honcho memory plugin by Plastic Labs: injects the user profile, session summary and relevant conclusions at session start, uploads each turn to Honcho in the background with secrets redacted, and adds honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember tools plus a /honcho status command; configured through the ~/.honcho/config.json shared with the other Honcho integrations, against hosted honcho.dev or a self-hosted instance.
description.zh: 由 Plastic Labs 维护的 Honcho 记忆插件：会话启动时注入用户画像、会话摘要与相关结论，后台脱敏后逐轮上传对话到 Honcho，提供 honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember 工具及 /honcho 状态命令；通过与其他 Honcho 集成共用的 ~/.honcho/config.json 配置，支持托管的 honcho.dev 或自建实例。

description.en: Shows the current provider's account balance or coding-plan quota above the composer, with usage percentages and reset countdowns.
description.zh: 在输入框上方查看当前模型供应商的账户余额或套餐额度，显示已用比例和重置倒计时。

description.en: Update management for DeepSeek Harness and its plugins: semver-aware dual-source (npm/GitHub) checks for the main program and every installed plugin, a locale-aware banner (zh/en) listing updatable items, one-click updates (the main program is backed up, integrity-checked and rolled back on failure; plugins install via a temp directory without touching other packages), and a watchdog-guarded restart after updating. The settings page adds per-plugin version lamps, live update progress, and banner/notification toggles.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主程序与插件更新管理：对主程序与每个已装插件做 npm/GitHub Release 双源 semver 比对，GUI 横幅按系统语言（中/英）列出可更新项；一键更新——主程序自动备份、完整性校验、失败回滚，插件经临时目录安装不碰其它包；更新后看门狗自动重启服务。「检查更新」设置页提供逐插件版本状态灯、实时更新进度与横幅/通知开关。

description.en: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that adds Cabinet Mode: a research-team Lead and four bureau members. A right-sidebar Cabinet panel shows the roster and task assignment, and Settings → Cabinet members edits each office's name, portrait, prompt and model.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加内阁模式的研究团队预设：首辅与四阁臣。右侧栏「内阁」面板显示成员与派活状态，设置页「内阁成员」可编辑各成员的名称、画像、提示词与模型。

description.en: Session management for DSH: archive/restore, batch & conditional delete, AI auto-rename, interrupted-session auto-resume, workspace grouping, undo last message, repair damaged session logs (seq-gap/EIO/dual-format), value analysis and full-text search — plus plan/closing template injection (system prompt + context).
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强：归档/恢复、批量与条件删除、AI 自动重命名、中断自动续跑、按工作区分组、撤回最后一条消息、三类损坏日志修复（seq-gap/EIO/双格式）、价值分析与全文搜索——另含方案/收尾模板注入（系统提示词 + 上下文）。

description.en: Extends the working range of DSH into WSL. Files in the distribution can be read, written, edited and searched by DSH directly. Depending on the task, the AI chooses for itself: run a one-off command, or open its own terminal and run several commands there to finish the job. Typing `dsh` in a WSL terminal calls DSH (type `dsh help` there for details), fusing WSL and DSH deeply. Every terminal you open can collaborate visually with the AI.
description.zh: 将 DSH 的工作范围扩展到 WSL。插件支持了发行版中的文件直接被 DSH 读取、写入、编辑与搜索。面对不同任务需求，AI可根据任务需求自行选择执行一次性命令/自建终端执行多条命令以完成任务。支持在 WSL 终端中键入 dsh 命令调用 DSH(详情在 WSL 终端键入dsh help)，深度融合了 WSL 与 DSH。用户新建的所有终端支持与AI可视化协作。

description.en: Paste a link; the agent reads it. Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, WeChat, articles, PDFs and audio become citable Markdown for a wiki or knowledge base. On 60 turns with vs without: finishes reading 22% -> 92% (+70 points), times out 68% -> 0%, answer quotes a real source fact 23% -> 82% (the A/B is exploratory: different time caps, no human correctness review). On 123 live links 80% came back usable (93% of the pages that answered); an unreachable link reports in 26 s. Codex, Claude Code, DSH.
description.zh: 贴一条链接，Agent 直接把内容读给你：小红书笔记、抖音与 B 站视频、微信公众号文章，连同文章、PDF、音频，都变成可引用的 Markdown，直接进你的知识库或 wiki。同一批题 60 轮对照：读完并作答 22% → 92%（+70 个百分点），跑到超时 68% → 0%，答案说中原文事实 23% → 82%（这组 A/B 是探索性的：两臂时限不同、未做人工正确性复核）。123 条真实链接里 80% 能直接当素材（能连上的页面里 93%），打不开的链接 26 秒就报。Codex / Claude Code / DSH 通用。

description.en: YuShe, a Dafeiyu (big fat fish) virtual pet for DSH: a guided visual setup hatches an AI fish girl with her own personality (15 species, 16 poses each, 200 stat points you allocate), who chats with you, answers in the workspace you bind her to, browses Bilibili on her own account and grows from what she sees, and reports back with a daily plan, diary, letters and, once you configure an image-generation API, photos; everything she posts goes through a local content gate.
description.zh: 鱼社 · 大肥鱼虚拟养成系统：可视化引导一键领养一条有性格的 AI 鱼（15 种鱼、每位 16 个姿势、200 点五维由你分配），她陪你聊天、在绑定的工作区里替你干活，用自己的 B站号刷视频、学东西、按经历成长，每天写打算和日记、写信、配好生图 API 后拍照片回来；她对外发的每句话都先过本地闸门。

description.en: Drive a local DeepSeek Harness agent from QQ and other IM channels through AstrBot: send tasks with /dsh, continue by quoting or @-mentioning the bot, answer approvals and ask_user_question prompts from chat (in parallel with the DSH web UI), and get results, inline images and file cards back. Ships session / workspace / model / permission commands, /compact and /last recovery, three progress-display modes, and group-shared or per-user session scoping.
description.zh: 把本机 DeepSeek Harness agent 接到 AstrBot，从 QQ 等 IM 渠道驱动它：用 /dsh 派活、引用或 @ 机器人续聊、在聊天里回答审批与 ask_user_question（与 DSH 网页并行），结果、内联图片与文件卡片发回。含会话 / 工作区 / 模型 / 权限命令、/compact 与 /last 找回、三档过程显示、整群共用或按人隔离的会话范围。

description.en: Transforms the local Wallpaper Engine library into a live background for DSH, with video and web wallpapers playing for real. An adaptive veil adjusts with picture brightness to keep text readable, while floating surfaces render as liquid glass. Includes a bilingual settings panel featuring framing adjustments, playlist rotation, library search, and real-time resource monitoring. Scene and application wallpapers are not supported.
description.zh: 将本地 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库化为 DSH 界面的动态背景,视频与网页壁纸真实播放。自适应遮罩根据画面亮度智能调节,保持文字清晰可读;壁纸生效时,悬浮组件呈现液态玻璃。内置中英双语设置面板,提供画面取景、轮播管理、搜索与实时资源监控。不支持场景与应用类壁纸。

description.en: Recursive delegation for dsh agent trees: a preset plus Host limits bound what each subagent may do, subagents work in separate _agents/ workspaces, and the parent decides which results to integrate.
description.zh: dsh agent 树的递归委派：用预设与 Host 限制划定每个子 agent 的能力边界，子 agent 在各自 _agents/ 工作区独立工作，成果由父 agent 决定是否合并、如何合并。

description.en: Xray-core supervisor and router for DSH with VLESS import, global/China-direct/whitelist routing, a three-card live panel, and self-update.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Xray 受管内核与分流：VLESS 导入、全局/国内直连/白名单路由、三卡片实时面板与自更新。

description.en: Adds selection annotations, in-place translation, sidebar subagent questions and default-browser link opening to DSH. The selected text rides along with your next message, the source keeps its highlight and ordinal mark for jumping back, the menu opens on selection or from the right-click menu, and the translation model can be picked separately.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加划词批注、引用、划词翻译、侧边子代理提问，链接用默认浏览器打开。选中的原文连同评论随下一条消息交给模型，正文保留高亮与序号角标、可跳回原文；菜单可划词浮出或从右键打开，翻译可单独指定模型。

description.en: Permanently delete DSH conversations with optional recursive deletion of forked and subagent sessions.
description.zh: 从 DSH 中永久删除会话，并可选择递归删除派生对话和子智能体会话。

description.en: Self-contained browser runtime: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and 9 interactive browser tools.
description.zh: 自包含浏览器运行时：Playwright（chromium）+ OpenCLI 作为插件本地依赖（全局复用回退），提供 `browser` 服务与 9 个交互式浏览器工具。

description.en: AI provider runtime and configuration UI for shared credentials and embedding, reranking, speech, and image generation services in DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供共享凭据以及嵌入、重排序、语音和图像生成服务的 AI 提供商运行时与配置界面。

description.en: Native-style notification sounds for DeepSeek Harness: a chime when the agent needs your decision or finishes a task, clickable system notifications that jump back to the window, repeat reminders, quiet hours, and goal-mode alerts that wait for the final round.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生风格提示音插件：智能体需要你决策或任务完成时播放提示音，点击系统通知可跳回窗口；支持重复提醒、静音时段，以及目标模式下只在最终轮提醒。

description.en: Deterministic code security review: 40+ rules, secret entropy detection, staged-diff review, SARIF export, baseline acceptance, SBOM-lite dependency inventory and health self-check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 确定性代码安全审查：40+ 规则、密钥熵检测、staged diff 审查、SARIF 导出、基线接受、SBOM-lite 依赖清单与健康自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI) concurrently, URL-dedupes and merges the results. Ships a settings card for toggling backends, storing API keys in the credential store, and tuning concurrency and timeouts.
description.zh: 聚合网络搜索插件：一次查询并发分发到 11 个引擎（Exa、Parallel、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Serper、Mojeek、DeepSeek、Anthropic、OpenAI），URL 去重后合并结果。设置面板卡片可开关后端、将 API Key 存入凭证库，并调整并发与超时。

description.en: Cross-session persona and diary for DeepSeek Harness: each turn can leave a first-person diary entry with a short retrieval index, and the next conversation injects the persona, a hand-note file you write yourself, and a dated batch of past entries retrieved by searching the diary text itself; anything older is found through feiyu_recall using that index.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话人格与日记：每轮可以留下一条第一人称日记并配一句检索索引，下一场对话注入人格、你手写的手记文件和一批带日期的旧事——按日记正文挑出来的，更早的用 feiyu_recall 按索引自己查。

description.en: Map your Zotero library into DSH: let AI operate Zotero for you and help you read papers. Browse collections and tags in the sidebar, read PDFs with highlights in place, and cite excerpts, annotations, notes or whole items into the chat. The model works from the source text for reviews, comparisons and data extraction, and can also search and organize the library, import papers and attach translations back to items; first use needs the Zotero MCP plugin and the local API enabled.
description.zh: 把 Zotero 文献库映射进 DSH：用AI管理操作Zotero，读文献时让AI辅助你。右侧栏按分类与标签浏览，双击即在 DSH 内精读 PDF，划词摘录、标注、笔记或整篇文献一键引用进对话；从综述、方法对比、数据提取到检索整理、导入论文、回挂译文，都可由模型代劳。首次使用需在 Zotero 装集成 MCP 插件并开启本地 API。

description.en: Tieba (Baidu forum) reader and companion for DSH: reads threads, writes daily digests, signs in, and builds a per-forum style library from high-liked replies. Optional replies to threads or to sub-replies under your own comments are off by default and limited per round and per day. Also ships a read-only MCP stdio server that MCP-capable clients can launch; not tested against specific clients.
description.zh: DSH 刷贴吧插件：读帖、写日报、签到，并从高赞回复里按吧建立风格库；回帖与楼中楼默认关闭，受每轮/每日限额。另带只读 MCP stdio server，支持 MCP 的客户端可尝试拉起；未逐客户端实测。

description.en: SSH profiles, browser terminals, SFTP browsing, port forwarding, proxies, and session-scoped AI access for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 配置、浏览器终端、SFTP 浏览、端口转发、代理与会话级 AI 访问。

description.en: AST-based context compression, test log filtering, and token budget guard for DeepSeek Harness: strips redundant syntax, prunes noisy log lines, and enforces a token ceiling so the context window never overflows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AST 上下文压缩、测试日志过滤与 Token 预算守卫：剔除冗余语法、精简日志噪声，并强制执行 Token 上限以防止上下文窗口溢出。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that statically parses Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` files into structured pages in the DSH right sidebar (the source is never executed: no eval, no bundler, no sandbox iframe), with a file-viewer takeover for `.tsx` and a bundled Skill for authoring the format.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把 Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` 静态解析为结构化页面渲染在右侧栏（不执行源码，无 eval / bundler / 沙箱 iframe），并附带 `.tsx` 文件查看器接管与一个教 LLM 写该格式的 Skill。

description.en: Windows-only computer use for DeepSeek Harness: captures the virtual screen and drives mouse & keyboard through 9 tools built on PowerShell and Win32 SendInput; pairs with picturereader so text-only models can complete the screenshot-analyze-act-verify loop fully locally.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 的 DSH 电脑操作插件：以 PowerShell + Win32 SendInput 实现 9 个工具，截取虚拟屏幕并驱动鼠标键盘；配合 picturereader 让纯文本模型在本地完成「截图-分析-操作-验证」闭环。

description.en: Chat-operated multi-database admin plugin for DeepSeek Harness: query and manage MySQL, PostgreSQL, GaussDB, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle, DM and SQLite from the conversation with project-scoped ro/rw grants, a sidebar management panel, schema browsing and data preview, and confirmation-gated dangerous operations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件：在对话中直接管理多数据库（MySQL、PostgreSQL、GaussDB、MongoDB、Redis、Oracle、达梦、SQLite），支持项目级 ro/rw 授权、侧边栏管理面板、结构浏览与数据预览，危险操作需确认后执行。

description.en: Lets text-only models handle pasted chat images, with a native vision experience, batch image viewing, and a built-in OpenAI-compatible analyze_image tool; vision-capable models are unaffected.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能处理聊天贴图，提供原生视觉体验，支持批量看图，走内置 OpenAI 兼容识图工具 analyze_image；具备视觉能力的模型不受影响。

description.en: Translates DSH's private remote protocol into a versioned REST API (chat, sessions, files, devices) for trusted clients such as the Android app dsh-companion, plus a Phone-settings panel inside the DSH WebUI settings: five cards in the main list (remote access, public tunnel, devices, trash, app download) and an Advanced settings group holding authorized roots, image reading and plugins.
description.zh: 把 DSH 内核的私有 remote 协议翻译成版本化 REST 接口（聊天、会话、文件、设备），供 Android 客户端 dsh-companion 等受信任客户端使用；桌面端在 DSH 设置里提供「手机设置」面板：主列表五张卡（远程访问 / 外网隧道 / 设备 / 回收站 / App 下载），另有「高级设置」组收纳授权根目录、识图与插件三项。

description.en: Phone access to a local DeepSeek Harness through a relay you run: QR pairing, request payloads sealed end to end, and a host machine that opens no inbound port.
description.zh: 通过自建中继从手机访问本机的 DeepSeek Harness：扫码配对、请求载荷端到端加密、本机无需开放入站端口。

description.en: Controls your real Chrome from DSH over a local WebSocket bridge: tab management, navigation, DOM snapshots, page JS evaluation, clicks, typing, screenshots, waits and dialog handling behind a Settings toggle.
description.zh: 通过本地 WebSocket 桥接让 DSH 操控你的真实 Chrome：标签页管理、导航、DOM 快照、页面 JS 求值、点击输入、截图、等待与弹窗处理，默认关闭需在设置中开启。

description.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.
description.zh: 为 DSH 自定义模型配置思考档位和子 agent 默认思考强度。

description.en: HuanJing Stock Board - a pure "slacking-off" stock watcher: read-only delayed quotes for A-shares, HK and US, a flat dot-matrix LED exchange hall, watchlists, candlestick charts, news, financials and price alerts. For market analysis and trading use professional software - professionals do professional things; this is just a simple way for retail investors to glance at their own stocks.
description.zh: 寰镜股票看板：纯粹的摸鱼看股票插件——A股/港股/美股只读延迟行情、平面 LED 灯阵证券大厅、自选、K 线、股市资讯、财报与价格提醒。行情分析和交易请用专业软件，专业的人做专业的事；它就是给散户方便看看自己股票情况的插件，极致简单。

description.en: Talk to Excel in DeepSeek Harness: create, edit, repair, and verify spreadsheets by conversation, with automatic formula health checks after every edit.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里对话完成 Excel 工作：建表、编辑、修复公式、图表校验，每次编辑后自动体检公式。

description.en: Smart checkpoints, workspace safety guards and instant rollback for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能检查点、工作区安全防护和即时回滚。

description.en: Terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar "Terminal" entry opens a multi-tab xterm.js interactive terminal over a real PTY (node-pty), with SSH remote tabs (ssh2, agent / key / password auth), a cwd following the current session, and tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send agent tools.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的终端面板：侧边栏「终端」打开多标签页 xterm.js 全交互终端（node-pty 真实 PTY），支持 ssh2 原生 SSH 远程标签页（agent/key/password 三种认证），cwd 跟随当前会话，并提供 tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send 三个 agent 工具。

description.en: Database tools for agents: list/query/exec/schema/stats/health across SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL, with lexer-grade read-only protection, row caps, CSV/JSON query output and an approval-gated write path.
description.zh: 数据库工具：sql_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health，SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL 三引擎，词法级只读保护、行数钳制、CSV/JSON 查询输出与写审批门。

description.en: Persona mode + structured output for DSH: identity header, three cards and signature rendered by the plugin while the model only submits a persona JSON envelope; per-session structured toggle, default-on persona.
description.zh: DSH 人格模式 + 结构化输出：身份头 / 三卡 / 收尾由插件渲染，模型只交 persona 内容块；人格默认开启、可显式关闭，结构化按会话开关。

description.en: Engineering-discipline guard: requirements grill before the first edit, red/green test-evidence gates, forked adversary review, and a delivery report with a per-dimension verification workflow.
description.zh: 工程纪律守门：动笔前审讯需求，红绿测试证据门，交付后对抗评审，并汇总交付报告与逐维度核对。

description.en: Discovers other DSH instances on the local network by UDP multicast or port scan, lists them in a sidebar panel together with the capabilities each one reports, and dispatches tasks between machines in both directions over the LAN or over an automatically downloaded userspace Tailscale node.
description.zh: 通过 UDP 组播或端口扫描发现局域网内的其他 DSH 实例，在侧栏面板中列出它们以及各自上报的能力，并可经局域网或自动下载的用户态 Tailscale 节点在两台机器之间双向派发任务。

description.en: Predicts the user's next prompt after each assistant reply and shows it as gray ghost text inside the composer; Tab accepts it, ↓ generates the next suggestion, ↑ returns to the previous one, and Esc dismisses it. Each assistant reply triggers an extra call to the session's model, carrying the most recent user and assistant text.
description.zh: 助手回复结束后预测用户的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 浮在输入框里；Tab 采纳、↓ 生成下一条、↑ 回到上一条、Esc 忽略。每次助手回复后会额外调用一次会话所用的模型，带上最近的用户与助手文本。

description.en: Renders Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers in real time in the browser (three.js player plus a Rust/WASM CPU particle simulation) and plays video and web wallpapers, falling back to the preview image, with no Wallpaper Engine runtime required. Scans the local Steam workshop library (431960) by auto-detection or a manual path, and offers a settings panel for wallpaper selection, library and engine directories, glow, pause and quality.
description.zh: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸放到 dsh Web 界面背后：scene 壁纸在浏览器内实时渲染（three.js 播放器 + Rust/WASM CPU 粒子模拟），视频与 web 壁纸原样播放，其余回退 preview 图，不需要安装 Wallpaper Engine 运行时。壁纸库从 Steam 创意工坊目录（431960）自动探测或手动指定，设置面板可选壁纸、配壁纸库与引擎目录、调光晕与暂停/画质。

description.en: Reference logged-in Chrome/Edge tabs, authorized local HTML and running Windows apps through a searchable native sidebar or @. Open browser candidates and the webpage sidebar refresh when the extension connects, disconnects or changes tabs, including an unchanged search query. Windows application lists skip protected processes with unreadable identity metadata and preserve other running apps. Read scoped snapshots, batch actions, capture screenshots and use available WebMCP tools; supports authorized uploads, drag/drop and opt-in network metadata. Browser actions preserve failure evidence, accept an explicit post-action observation scope and can check one final visible/text/value/URL condition without replaying effects. Expandable context preserves model content; dockable annotations support a session-bound staging queue with edit/delete/restore, and append to chat drafts without sending. App control prefers a matching installed MCP or approved installation, then Cua Driver with text, hotkeys and paged controls; desktop reads present the window once per connection or when recovery is needed. Background input depends on the app. Requires Chrome or Edge 125+ with the companion MV3 extension manually loaded and paired; installing the plugin does not install the extension.
description.zh: 通过可搜索的原生侧栏或 @ 引用已登录的 Chrome / Edge 标签页、已授权的本地 HTML 和运行中的 Windows 应用。扩展连接、断开或标签页变化时，已打开的浏览器候选与网页侧栏自动更新，无需修改搜索词。Windows 应用列表跳过身份信息无法读取的受保护进程，保留其他运行中的应用。读取局部快照、批量操作、截图及调用可用的 WebMCP 工具；支持授权上传、拖放和按需网络元数据。浏览器动作失败后保留执行证据，可显式指定后置观察范围，并在末尾检查一次可见性、文本、输入值或 URL 条件，不自动重放副作用。可展开引用保留模型内容；可收纳批注支持绑定会话的暂存队列与编辑、删除、恢复，加入聊天草稿而不自动发送。应用控制优先匹配的本地 MCP，未安装先询问，无匹配时使用 Cua Driver，支持打字、快捷键及控件分页；桌面读取在连接首次或需要恢复窗口时展示。后台输入取决于应用。需要 Chrome / Edge 125+，手动加载配套 MV3 扩展并配对；插件不会自动安装扩展。

description.en: Custom modes / assistant manager: give each mode its own system prompt in the settings page — a custom prompt that is a plain file the agent loop re-reads before every model step, so an edit applies to the running session on its next step — and start it from the official standard / PTC / minimal / Cordis composition, toggling the plugin rows it mounts one by one (a custom plugin composition per mode), renaming it as you like. Several assistants coexist with their own prompts, so one machine can keep a coding assistant, a chat companion and a roleplay (RP) persona side by side — a multi-agent setup you pick from per new session. Rows left untouched stay byte-identical to the shipped ones, platform conditions included.
description.zh: 自定义模式管理器 / 多助手管理器：在设置页里给每个模式写一份自己的系统提示词——自定义提示词就是普通文件，agent loop 每次模型调用前重新读取，改完对正在运行的会话下一步即生效；模式以官方 standard / PTC / 极简 / Cordis 的组成为底子，可逐行开关它挂载哪些插件，等于每个模式一份自定义插件组合，也能改模式名。多个助手可并存、各有各的提示词，所以一台机器上可以同时留一个编码助手、一个聊天搭子、一个角色扮演（RP）人格，新建会话时挑一个。没碰过的行与出厂行逐字节相同（含平台条件）。

description.en: GitHub Copilot LLM adapter: OAuth device-flow sign-in, live model discovery from the Copilot API, vision support for image-capable models (gpt-4.1, gpt-4o), and two wire protocols (Chat Completions and Responses API) with automatic endpoint routing per model.
description.zh: GitHub Copilot LLM 适配器：OAuth 设备码登录、从 Copilot API 动态发现模型、视觉模型图片输入支持（gpt-4.1、gpt-4o），以及 Chat Completions 与 Responses 双协议，按模型自动路由。

description.en: Visual review for the harness browser: pick any element to comment on it, adjust styles live with rollback, sketch on a free-form annotation canvas, and send everything as structured context attached to the next message, with a cropped screenshot per pin or the whole visible viewport composited with the drawings.
description.zh: 在 harness 浏览器里做可视化评审：选中任意元素添加评论、实时调整样式并可回滚、在自由画布上批注草图，然后作为结构化上下文随下一条消息发送；每个标注附局部截图，画布批注则合成进整个可视区域的截图（不含滚动区域外的页面）。

description.en: Offline-first UI/UX design intelligence library for DeepSeek Harness: design_recommend, design_review and design_search tools with a built-in database of 84 design styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 99 UX guidelines, 25 chart types and 22 tech stacks, Chinese-first with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供离线可用的 UI/UX 设计智能库：内置 84 种设计风格、192 个配色、74 组字体、99 条 UX 规范、25 种图表与 22 个技术栈，提供 design_recommend / design_review / design_search 三个工具，中文优先、零运行依赖。

description.en: Per-message delete for DSH: remove a user message, one reply step, or a whole assistant reply from the derived model context through the official surface-replace contract, and hide it from the visible transcript without rewriting the append-only log.
description.zh: DSH 消息删除插件：按条删除用户消息、按步骤删除思考与工具调用、按整条回复删除助手回答，经官方 surface-replace 契约从模型上下文移除并从可见转录隐藏，原始 append-only 日志不改写。

description.en: Session cost estimate in a status bar at the bottom of the conversation (per-model token pricing, CNY) plus the live DeepSeek account balance via the official balance API.
description.zh: 对话底部的会话费用状态栏：按模型逐条计价估算 Token 费用（CNY），并实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（官方余额接口）。

description.en: Personal assistant for projects, conversations, memory, reviews and news. Bundled WeChat pins the QR-confirmed account; first messages cannot claim ownership. An optional allowlist further restricts access. Missing or conflicting identity requires desktop recovery. API acceptance is not phone receipt.
description.zh: 个人助理：在授权范围内整理项目，衔接原生对话、记忆、回顾与资讯。单包内置微信，扫码确认账号为唯一操作者，陌生人先发消息不能认领；白名单可进一步限制，身份缺失或冲突会暂停并提示在电脑恢复。接口接受不代表手机实收。

description.en: Adds one button beside the composer that rewrites the draft into a more complete prompt in place, with no preview step, plus undo, a stop action, and optional conversation context.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一个按钮，把草稿直接原地改写成更完整的提示词（无预览步骤），支持撤销、随时停止、可选参考本会话上下文。

description.en: Adds an editable conversation canvas to DeepSeek Harness, where graph connections select context for canvas requests, with branching, merging, and local agent session imports.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中嵌入可编辑对话画布，通过连线选择画布请求的上下文，支持分支、合并与本地 Agent 会话导入。

description.en: Remote & mobile security gateway: zero-modification Tailscale/LAN access with QR pairing, RSA encryption, brute-force defense and mobile style snippets; auto-yields the shared pairing service to other remote plugins so coexistence never crashes startup.
description.zh: 远程与移动端安全网关：零改动 DSH 底层代码开放 Tailscale/局域网访问，支持扫码配对、RSA 加密、防暴力破解与移动端样式片段；与其他远程插件共存时自动让出共享配对服务，避免启动崩溃。

description.en: An always-on-top desktop pet (a washing machine) that renders session state as washing actions: four switchable skins, multi-session counters, and proactive done / stuck / approval alerts on macOS and Windows, plus a detail panel with recent turns and timings.
description.zh: 常驻桌面的桌宠（桌面宠物）：一台滚筒洗衣机，把会话状态渲染成洗衣动作，四套皮肤（精密家电 / 复古奶油 / 工笔重彩 / 太空舱）可切换，多会话计数、洗完 / 卡住 / 等你确认主动提醒；macOS 与 Windows 均可运行，详情面板可看最近几轮与耗时。

description.en: Review agent file changes in a Diff panel, add comments for follow-up edits, and undo edited or newly created files.
description.zh: 在 Diff 面板中审查 Agent 的文件改动、添加评论以继续修改，并撤销已编辑或新建的文件。

description.en: Provider-independent DSH document parsing powered by MinerU, with native background jobs, immutable results, and safe request coalescing.
description.zh: 基于 MinerU 的统一文档解析，支持自托管与官方云双 Provider、DSH 原生后台任务、不可变产物缓存与请求合并。

description.en: Raises the local Host's HTTP header budget to 64 KiB and retires stale dsh-auth-* launch cookies on each response, so a fixed profile cannot lock itself out of the desktop welcome handshake after roughly 72 restarts.
description.zh: 把本地 Host 的 HTTP 头部预算提升到 64 KiB，并在每次响应里清掉过期的 dsh-auth-* 启动 cookie，避免固定 profile 在约 72 次重启后卡在桌面端欢迎握手。

description.en: One-command backup, restore & migration for all DSH user data (~/.dsh) with a visual Settings panel: scheduled auto-backup with tiered retention, sha256 verification, hardened restore with auto-rollback and a result receipt, typed sub-backups (--types), credential redaction into a local vault, private-repo GitHub sync for moving to a new machine, and an out-of-process rescue console (zero-dependency rescue web UI in the backup dir) that works even when the host won't boot. /backup doctor checks and repairs corrupt session logs from a known-good backup and quarantines them before rotation; migrate-check statically predicts which sessions a host upgrade would break (frozen event-list rules, filename/generation mismatch, hardlink support, legacy credentials); the credential sentinel preserves pre-migration copies before the host rewrites them; smart backup snapshots before host upgrades; /backup check-update and /backup update report and install new releases (snapshotting first). Restore handles attachment hard links and arbitrarily large archives (streamed listing). Current npm version 0.13.4; spans DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 through 0.2.0-rc.1, including 0.2.0's install-time peer gate. macOS/Linux/Windows.
description.zh: 一条命令备份、恢复与迁移 DSH 全部用户数据（~/.dsh），附可视化设置面板：定时自动备份与每日/每周分级保留、sha256 校验、失败自动回滚并回执的加固恢复、分类型子集备份（--types）、凭据脱敏进本机 vault、GitHub 私有仓库同步跨机迁移、宿主起不来也能用的进程外救援通道（备份目录内置零依赖救援网页）。/backup doctor 从已知良好备份体检并定点修复损坏会话日志、轮换前先隔离；migrate-check 迁移预检在升级前静态扫描，预测哪些会话会被新宿主拒绝（冻结清单、文件名代际不匹配、硬链接、旧版凭据布局等）；凭据哨兵在宿主改写前自动存底；智能备份在宿主升级前快照；/backup check-update 与 /backup update 感知并一键更新（先留快照）。恢复链路支持含附件硬链接的归档与超大归档（清单走原始流逐行校验）。当前 npm 版本 0.13.4；覆盖 DSH 0.1.1-rc.2–0.2.0-rc.1，含 0.2.0 起的安装期 peer 闸门。macOS/Linux/Windows。

description.en: Configurable send and newline keys, a composer context menu with three sources (leave it to DSH and other plugins / browser menu / plugin-styled custom menu), a quick-command panel with categorized prompt lists where each prompt can append on every send or only on the first message of a session, a create-and-move row at the bottom of each category, a prompt optimizer that rewrites the draft with a separate model call, settings-panel size memory, and automatic x-opencode-session header injection for OpenCode routes. Prompt lists live in a global ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json that is independent of the session and the project.
description.zh: 可配置发送/换行键位、输入框右键菜单三种来源（插件不介入 / 浏览器菜单 / 自定义样式菜单）、带分类的快捷指令面板（每条可设「每次发送都附加」或「仅在本会话第一条消息附加」，并有跨分类移动与新建）、用另一次模型调用把草稿整理成清晰指令的提示词优化、设置面板尺寸记忆，并为 OpenCode 路由自动注入 x-opencode-session 请求头。快捷指令存在全局文件 ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json 里，与会话、项目无关。

description.en: Turns local markdown and text documents into a queryable knowledge base with hybrid semantic and keyword search, citation verification, and source injection.
description.zh: 将本地 Markdown 与文本文档转为可检索的知识库，支持语义与关键词混合搜索、引用校验与来源注入。

description.en: Local Markdown long-term memory for DSH: an Obsidian-compatible vault, a sidebar management page, four memory tools, and budgeted per-turn recall.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供本地 Markdown 长期记忆：Obsidian 兼容仓库、侧边栏管理页、四个记忆工具，以及按预算的每回合召回。

description.en: Notes and folder reader in the main panel: a file tree with pinned files, closeable tabs, Markdown split edit/preview with synced scrolling, plain-text editing, manual save, and drag-to-move. Deleting a file moves it to the system trash where one exists (macOS, Linux), falling back to an in-folder dsh-notes-trash directory; Windows has no delete entry.
description.zh: 主面板内的笔记与目录阅读器：文件树与置顶、可关闭的标签页、Markdown 左编右渲与同步滚动、纯文本编辑、手动保存、拖拽移动文件。删除时移入系统回收站（macOS、Linux），系统回收站不可用时移入目录内的 dsh-notes-trash 目录；Windows 不提供删除入口。

description.en: Adds custom ordering and tucking away to seven strips of buttons and cards in DSH (the left sidebar, sidebar footer, conversation tabs, composer dock, session header icon strip, right sidebar and settings navigation), plus per-area drag switches and JSON layout import/export. Tucked rows land in the built-in More menu of that region and can be dragged back out.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的七处按钮与卡片区域（左侧边栏、侧栏底部、对话标签、输入框工具条、会话头部图标条、右侧栏、设置导航）提供自定义排序与收纳，并支持分区拖动开关和布局 JSON 导入/导出；收纳项会进入该区域内置的「更多」菜单，可随时拖回。

description.en: Pi Host ABI compatibility engine: after one install, unmodified Pi extensions from npm mount as native DSH plugins with `dsh plugin add <pi-package>`.
