Verified end to end on stock DSH with pi-mcp-adapter (full MCP manager: OAuth, resources, prompts, MCP Apps, elicitation, sampling), @tintinweb/pi-subagents, pi-code, pi-hermes-memory and pi-background-tasks; `pi2dsh inspect` reports a package's compatibility before installing.
description.zh: Pi Host ABI 兼容引擎：装一次之后，npm 上的 Pi 扩展原包经 `dsh plugin add <pi-package>` 直接作为 DSH 原生插件挂载。已在官方 DSH 上端到端验证 pi-mcp-adapter（完整 MCP 管理面：OAuth、resources、prompts、MCP Apps、elicitation、sampling）、@tintinweb/pi-subagents、pi-code、pi-hermes-memory、pi-background-tasks；`pi2dsh inspect` 在安装前报告一个包的兼容情况。

description.en: Right-sidebar Reference Links tab that collects every http(s) URL from a conversation, with pins, per-link turn counts and a click-through list of the turns that mentioned it, search, manual renaming, single-link or whole-host hiding, and a Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+L shortcut. Titles come only from the conversation (markdown labels, web search results, fetched page titles) — no remote title scraping and no model calls.
description.zh: 右栏「参考链接」标签页：汇总对话里出现的全部 http(s) URL，支持置顶、每条链接的轮次统计（可点开查看具体轮次并跳转）、搜索、手动改名、隐藏单条或整个主机，以及 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+L 快捷键。标题只来自对话本身（Markdown 标签、联网搜索结果的标题、抓取到的页面标题），不做远程标题抓取，也不调用模型。

description.en: Keeps bulk output out of the conversation: ctk_execute, ctk_execute_file and ctk_batch_execute run code in a child process and return only the conclusion, ctk_index and ctk_search file long material into a local FTS5 knowledge base built on node:sqlite, and a routing gate refuses curl and wget before they execute. Ships ctk_stats and ctk_doctor plus a settings page with a live context-occupancy panel. No third-party runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 让大块输出不进对话：ctk_execute、ctk_execute_file 与 ctk_batch_execute 在子进程里跑代码只回结论，ctk_index 与 ctk_search 把长材料存进基于 node:sqlite 的本地 FTS5 知识库，路由门禁在执行前拦下 curl 与 wget。附 ctk_stats、ctk_doctor 与带实时上下文占用面板的设置页，零第三方运行时依赖。

description.en: Gated multi-agent pipeline for OpenSpec changes — six opx_* tools drive the phase state machine, two agent presets (developer and reviewer) carry implementation and review, and 23 bundled skills define the quality standards they are checked against; full mode runs analyze, implement, then tool, task and dimension-based quality review, while simple mode runs implement and one merged quality review.
description.zh: 面向 OpenSpec 变更的按阶段门禁多 Agent 编排：6 个 opx_* 工具驱动阶段状态机，开发者与审核人两个 agent preset 分工实施与审查，23 份内置 skill 定义审查基准；完整流程为 analyze、实施、工具/任务/维度质量三层审查，精简流程为实施加一次合并质量审查。

description.en: OpenAI provider for language models, embeddings, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and image generation in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入、文本转语音、语音转文本和图像生成能力的 OpenAI 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Pair a second model that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.
description.zh: 搭配一个副模型，每轮被动审查并注入见解。

description.en: Low-cost video understanding tool: a video_understand tool turns a Bilibili link / BV / local video into an AVIS info layer (ASR + scene structure + object tracks + YOLO labels) and returns summary + Q&A. Question-driven dynamic routing across layers (L0 ASR / L1 object tracks / L2 key-frame VLM), semantic-layer reuse for repeat questions, per-question budget cap. Python engine: core layer needs faster-whisper / opencv / yt-dlp (~200-300MB); the optional semantic layer adds ~2GB of torch / transformers / ultralytics. A bundled doctor --fix sets up the venv and installs both.
description.zh: 低成本视频理解工具：video_understand 把 B站链接/BV号/本地视频转成 AVIS 信息层（ASR+场景结构+对象轨迹+YOLO 标签）并输出摘要+问答。问题驱动动态路由分层（L0 ASR / L1 对象轨迹 / L2 关键帧 VLM）、语义层复用（重复提问直接查层）、单次问题预算上限。Python 引擎：核心层需 faster-whisper / opencv / yt-dlp（约 200-300MB）；可选语义层另需约 2GB 的 torch / transformers / ultralytics。内置 doctor --fix 一键建 venv 并装齐两者。

description.en: Windows Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness with 21 tools and verified targeting: controls are addressed through their UI Automation identity and patterns, and numbered marks are checked against the live window before input, so a stale target is refused instead of clicked. A known sequence runs in one computer_batch call, one model round trip; incremental observations, compact receipts (normally no more than about 6 KiB extra), bounded handoff waits (HANDOFF_WAIT_TIMEOUT/HANDOFF_HELD_TIMEOUT as continuations), the desktop-block cycle boundary and a deterministic 100 s owner-scoped leave backstop keep context small and prevent a stuck handoff from waiting out the tool deadline. Approval modes settle an unanswerable ask honestly: in a danger-full-access session with no approval card the action runs under that grant, every other sandbox — and every delegated subagent session — refuses and names the unavailable channel instead of reporting a user rejection, and gate diagnostics land in policy.jsonl. Human handoff, a model-visible stop brake and prebuilt native workers.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面操控，21 个工具，定位可验证：控件按 UI Automation 的真实身份与控件模式寻址，编号标记在派发前对照实时窗口校验，过期目标拒绝而不是点错。已知流程用一次 computer_batch 跑完，只花一轮模型往返；增量观察、默认精简回执（通常最多再加约 6 KiB）、有界的交接等待（HANDOFF_WAIT_TIMEOUT/HANDOFF_HELD_TIMEOUT，均作为可继续检查点）、“离开桌面块就 release”的边界与 100 秒 owner-scoped 自动释放兜底，让上下文保持轻量，也避免卡住的交接等到工具超时。审批模式会诚实地裁决无人可答的 ask：完全权限且无审批卡时按该授权执行，其它沙箱与被委派的子会话一律拒绝并点名“审批通道不可用”，不再把自动拒绝写成人的拒绝；门禁诊断落在 policy.jsonl。含人工接管、能传进模型的停止刹车，原生组件随包提供。

description.en: A browsable daily catalog of DeepSeek Harness plugins harvested from npm and GitHub: one-click install, enable/disable, update and uninstall, the reason dsh would refuse an install shown before you press it, prepurchase facts (engines.dsh, dependency count, bin names, install scripts), rollback and favorites.
description.zh: 从 npm 与 GitHub 每日采集的 DSH 插件目录：一键安装、启停、更新与卸载；装前就给出 dsh 会拒绝的原因与豁免命令；安装前的事实（engines.dsh、依赖数、bin 名、安装脚本）、回滚与收藏。

description.en: Russian for the dsh web GUI: the whole interface plus the menus of 520 third-party plugins — 584 sections, 67,666 strings.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面提供俄语：整个界面，加上 520 个第三方插件的菜单——584 个分区、67 666 条文案。

description.en: Browser bridge for DeepSeek Harness: captures page markup (DOM with boxes and computed styles, selector candidates checked for uniqueness) and the site's own xhr/fetch calls with headers and bodies, redacting credential-shaped values on ingest, into workspace files — then drives the page with trusted CDP input to verify what was captured. Ships 11 tools and an MV3 extension that works in the browser's own session. Requires Chrome or Edge 125+; the extension is loaded manually and paired with a local token.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浏览器桥接：把页面结构（带盒子与计算样式的 DOM、经过唯一性校验的选择器候选）与站点自身的 xhr/fetch（含请求头与请求体，凭据形态的值在写入时脱敏）抓取为工作区文件，再用可信 CDP 输入驱动页面验证抓取结果。包含 11 个工具与使用浏览器自身会话的 MV3 扩展。需 Chrome/Edge 125+，扩展需手动加载并用本机 token 配对。

description.en: UI enhancement suite for the DSH web client: Chinese locale completion, one-row stats, auto-expanded thinking, chat width, session archiving and delete, plus an optional prompt-injection switch (off by default).
description.zh: DSH 网页 UI 综合增强：中文补全、统计单行显示、思考自动展开、对话宽度、会话归档与删除，并可选的提示词注入（默认关闭）。

description.en: Send dsh turn traces, LLM generations, tool spans, and subagent activity to Langfuse.
description.zh: 将 dsh 的会话轮次、LLM 调用、工具调用及子 agent 活动记录到 Langfuse。

description.en: Runs TiddlyWiki 5 as the DSH persistent knowledge base: ten tiddlywiki_* agent tools (filtered search, read/write/batch/rename/delete, recent, tags, git sync with conflict resolve), a full TiddlyWiki editor embedded in the GUI center column over a same-origin proxy, a right-side wiki tab, a per-session tab summarizing the notes a session read or wrote, a quick-note card with draft auto-save, and an optional clip bookmarklet with image attachment — all backed by an auto-committing git repository.
description.zh: 把 TiddlyWiki 5 变成 DSH 的持久知识库：十个 tiddlywiki_* 智能体工具（带过滤的检索、读写/批量/改名/删除、最近、标签，以及 git 同步与冲突解决），GUI 中央栏经同源代理内嵌完整 TiddlyWiki 编辑器，右侧栏知识库 Tab，会话级汇总本会话读写过的笔记，快速笔记卡片支持草稿自动保存，另可选剪藏书签（选中图片一并存为二进制附件）——全部由自动提交的 git 仓库支撑。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to ReMe's local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base: automatically captures completed main-agent conversations as user-owned Markdown memory, searches conversations and source material through reme_search with BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion, and schedules daily memory consolidation.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ReMe 本地优先、自进化的个人知识库：自动把已完成的主 Agent 对话沉淀为用户掌控的 Markdown 记忆，通过 reme_search 结合 BM25、可选向量检索和 wikilink 展开搜索对话与资料，并按日整理长期记忆。

description.en: Preset doctor for agent presets: scans home/profile `cordis.patch.yml` declarations and legacy `.agent-presets/` dirs across host lines 0.1.0→0.2.0, shows every detected preset as an official-style card (source/era badges, broken red border, per-finding details, current DSH version + era catalog), and syncs a preset to the current syntax per-card behind an explicit confirm dialog (.bak backup + atomic write; report-level findings are never written — startup scans are report-only). npm: `dsh-preset-doctor`.
description.zh: Agent 预设医生：跨宿主线（0.1.0→0.2.0）扫描 home/profile `cordis.patch.yml` 声明与遗留 `.agent-presets/` 目录，把检测到的每个预设以官方同款卡片展示（来源/代际徽章、失效红边、逐条修复项明细、当前 DSH 版本与代际目录）；卡内「同步到当前版本」走显式确认框（.bak 备份 + 原子写，需人工裁决项永不写盘，启动扫描恒只报告）。npm 包名：`dsh-preset-doctor`。

description.en: A2A protocol server for dsh agents, with JSON-RPC tasks, SSE streaming, cancellation, and an agent card.
description.zh: 为 dsh agent 提供 A2A 协议服务，支持 JSON-RPC 任务、SSE 流式输出、取消任务和 agent card。

description.en: Right-sidebar SSH terminal for DSH where you and your agent share one PTY: 16 agent tools, configurable transfer limit, session-isolated audit trail, one-click in-place updates.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 SSH 远程终端：你和 agent 共用一个 PTY，16 个 agent 工具，传输上限可调，终端按会话隔离，配置页支持一键热更新。

description.en: Register locally-defined custom agents as callable subagents in dsh: the main conversation invokes any agent by name via use_agent, each running as a real dsh subagent with its own persona. Supports breakpoint resume for interrupted runs.
description.zh: 把本地定义的自定义 agent 注册成 dsh 可调用的 subagent：主模型通过 use_agent 工具按名字派活，每个 agent 以独立人格运行，支持断点续跑。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to QQ over OneBot 11/12, Satori, Milky or the official QQ bot API, with a separate session per group or private chat and nine built-in tools: group management, chat history with image understanding, web search, page fetching, reverse image search and image generation. Optional proactive chatter reads recent messages on an interval and decides whether to join in, with the judging and speaking stages able to use different models. Models, proxy and allowlists are configured in the DSH settings page. First run requires an owner (auth.owners): with it empty the plugin drives no sessions at all (deny by default, so installing it does not expose the bot); once set, private chats and groups work immediately, guests only reach the guest tool allowlist while qqbot and qqconfig stay owner-only.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 QQ。支持 OneBot 11/12、Satori、Milky 与 QQ 官方机器人接口，群聊和私聊各有一条独立会话；内置九个工具：群管理、聊天记录与图片理解、联网搜索、网页抓取、图片反搜、生图等，另有按间隔自主接话的主动发言（判断与发言可分用两个模型）。模型、代理、白名单等全部在 DSH 设置页里配置，不需要改代码。首次使用必须先填拥有者 auth.owners：留空时插件不驱动任何会话（默认拒绝，避免装机即对外开放）；填好后私聊与群聊立即可用，访客只能使用访客工具白名单，qqbot 与 qqconfig 仅限拥有者。

description.en: Reads animated GIF and WebP as animations: a pasted one keeps playing in the UI while the model gets a labelled sheet of frames sampled across it, and the read_animation tool samples a file on demand.
description.zh: 把 gif 和动图 webp 当作动画来读：贴进聊天框的照常播放，模型收到的是横跨整段采样、带帧号与时长的胶片条；工作区里的文件由 read_animation 按需采样。

description.en: Remotely control DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspaces from QQ (official Bot API v2, direct chat only): list and switch workspaces, create sessions, compact history, switch models, with streaming, markdown and approval forwarding. Access is not gated per user — anyone who can message the bot controls these sessions, using your model quota and file permissions.
description.zh: 通过 QQ（官方 Bot API v2，仅单聊）远程控制 DeepSeek Harness 会话与工作区：列出/切换工作区、新建会话、压缩历史、切换模型，支持流式输出、Markdown 与审批转发。未做按用户门禁——任何能给该机器人发消息的人都能控制这些会话，消耗你的模型额度与文件权限。

description.en: Syncs DSH model providers and models across computers through any WebDAV server: the backup is sealed with a passphrase before it leaves this machine, so a new machine opens with the same model list.
description.zh: 通过任意 WebDAV 服务在多台电脑之间同步 DSH 的模型供应商与模型：备份离开本机之前先用口令封好，新机器打开就是同一份模型清单。

description.en: Compresses DSH time-context from ~280 chars to 46 chars by injecting a compact date line into the runtime-context snapshot; zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 将 DSH 时间上下文从约 280 字符压缩到 46 字符，向运行期快照注入紧凑日期行，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Live token stats under the DSH Web composer: streamed tokens/s, output token and first-byte latency, plus per-step estimate-vs-actual reconciliation using the official BPE tokenizer, to tell a slow stream from a stalled one.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时渲染 token 状态带：基于 DeepSeek 官方 BPE 分词表显示流式 token/s、输出 token 与首字延迟，并对比每次 step 的估算与实际偏差，用于判断生成是慢还是卡住。

description.en: Browser automation for DSH: the agent fills in forms, scrapes lists and works across tabs in real pages, using the logins you already have. It drives its own visible window on your desktop — minimise it and it keeps working without stealing focus — and a sign-in, CAPTCHA or native dialog stops the run and hands the page back to you: it never confirms on your behalf. Login state persists (own profile plus session-cookie re-injection). 23 Playwright tools (20 always on, 3 gated and off by default), with a URL allowlist, dialog suspension and a CDP method allowlist that are mechanism-level and pinned by tests.
description.zh: 浏览器自动化：让 AI 用你已经登录的账号，在真实网页上填表、抓取列表、多标签查后台。它跑在你桌面上的一个可见窗口里 —— 最小化它就不抢焦点、安静干活；遇到登录、验证码和原生弹窗会停下来等你，绝不替你点「确定」。登录一次一直记得（独立 profile + session cookie 回注）。23 个 Playwright 工具（20 个常驻、3 个默认关闭的强力工具），URL 白名单、弹窗挂起、CDP 方法白名单都是机制级且有测试钉住。

description.en: Red-team engagement mode: send one target organization name; a planner session runs five execution roles (recon, asset triage, vulnerability discovery, exploitation, internal pivot) with configurable concurrency; preflight checks skills/resources; scoring uses four stages (recon, internet, boundary, internal) with server-side caps and privilege-wins dedup; findings stay in a local SQLite fact base. The persistent right-side console has nine pages and includes asset mapping, agents, sessions/tunnels, findings, score targets, reports, POC knowledge base and skill library. v0.15.2 adds automatic HTTP evidence/action records, batch ingest, scope check, tunnel pivot probe, data proof, cleanup ledger and T0-T3 asset admission to prevent scope drift. 59 redteam_* tools; 38 bundled skills.
description.zh: 红队作战模式：只发一个靶标单位名称，主会话指挥五个执行角色（信息收集/资产梳理/漏洞发现/漏洞利用/内网渗透），并发可配置；开工前做技能与资源预检；得分按四阶段（信息收集/互联网/边界/内网），上限、权限取高、同服务去重由服务端判定；发现落本机 SQLite 事实库。右侧常驻控制台 9 个页面，含资产测绘、智能体、会话隧道、漏洞战果、得分目标、报告、POC 知识库与技能库。v0.15.2 增加 HTTP 证据/动作记录自动留痕、批量落库、范围校验、隧道内网探测、数据证明、清理台账与 T0–T3 资产准入，防止打偏靶标。59 个 redteam_* 工具，随 npm 包 38 个随包技能。

description.en: Converts session, agent-loop, LLM, and tool lifecycle events into OpenTelemetry GenAI traces and metrics, exported over standard OTLP/HTTP to any compatible backend, with content capture off by default.
description.zh: 将会话、Agent 循环、LLM 与工具生命周期事件转换为 OpenTelemetry GenAI 调用链与指标，通过标准 OTLP/HTTP 导出到任意兼容后端，正文采集默认关闭。

description.en: Claude Code /rewind for DeepSeek Harness: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutating tool execution, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot /rewind command that restores files and forks the session back to a checkpoint.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code /rewind 等价能力：每次变更型工具执行前捕获 git 优先的工作区文件快照，轮次边界 fork 会话，一条 /rewind 命令恢复文件并把会话回退到检查点。

description.en: Image generation and image reading for DSH: an Images page in the sidebar, labelled 图像 in Chinese (one row per model, 10 ratios, 1K–4K sizes, a contact sheet with detail cards, zoom, reuse and delete), three preset providers plus custom endpoints — one needs no key at all — and a vision-review skill. A pasted key is written to ~/.dsh/secrets/media-tools.env (mode 600) and only sent to the provider you picked. The page follows the harness language (Chinese or English). Requires Python 3.9+ (generation runs through scripts/generate.py); the page needs desktop DSH 0.2.1+.
description.zh: DSH 的生图与读图：侧边栏「图像」页面（英文界面显示 Images；按模型分行、10 种比例、1K–4K 尺寸、联系表 + 详情卡 + 放大 + 复用 + 删除），三个预设提供方外加自定义端点（其中一个完全免 Key），另有 vision-review 读图技能。粘进去的 Key 只写进本机 ~/.dsh/secrets/media-tools.env（权限 600），只发给你选的那家服务商。页面文案跟随 DSH 界面语言（中文 / 英文）。需要 Python 3.9+（生图由 scripts/generate.py 执行）；该页面需桌面版 DSH 0.2.1+。

description.en: Workflow and automation (`workflow`): task dispatch, optional Agent Teams, and tiered verification; usage and billing (`usage`): session token tracking and automatic context folding (no bill calculation); sessions and messages (`session`): persistent fold state, protected recent messages, and watermark-triggered handoff; models and account access (`model`): six dispatch pools and optional intent-based routing (no account integration); skills (`skill`): read-only MySQL/Redis checks, commit-message generation, and requirements/design docs; development and runtime (`dev`): Host/Client settings UI and tool-call safeguards. Together, these features are designed to balance output quality with token efficiency and model-use costs.
description.zh: 工作流与自动化（workflow）：任务派发、可选 Agent Teams 协作及分级验证；用量与计费（usage）：会话 token 用量统计和自动上下文折叠（不计算账单）；会话与消息（session）：折叠状态持久化、近期消息保护及水位触发交接；模型与账号接入（model）：六个模型派发池与可选意图路由（不提供账号接入）；技能包（skill）：MySQL/Redis 只读核验、提交信息生成及需求/设计文档；开发与运行时（dev）：Host/Client 设置界面及工具调用保护。这些能力协同运作，旨在兼顾结果质量与 token 使用效率，并控制不必要的模型调用成本。

description.en: OpenDesign Go provider: 12 subscription models over Chat Completions, the real 5-hour and 7-day quota read from the local OpenDesign app, per-model parameters and switches, and multi-account failover.
description.zh: OpenDesign Go 模型提供方：以 Chat Completions 协议接入 12 个订阅模型，从本机 OpenDesign 客户端读取真实的 5 小时 / 7 天额度，支持每模型参数与开关、多账号失败切换。

description.en: Long-lived AI companions with isolated memory, WeChat channels, Skills, schedules, heartbeat concerns, and a dependency-aware task board.
description.zh: 提供隔离记忆、微信渠道、Skill、定时任务、伙伴挂念与依赖任务看板的长期 AI 伙伴。

description.en: Right-click menus for DSH sidebar rows: on DSH 0.2.2+ both rows use the host menus — workspace rows follow the session grouping (new session, copy path and reveal, pinned open-with apps, an open-with submenu, bulk delete) and session rows extend the menu that opens at the pointer with pinned open-with apps, an open-with submenu and permanent deletion of archived sessions; entries stay in the right-click menu by default and can be opted one by one into the shared "…" menu. On 0.2.1 the workspace menu is drawn by the plugin. Adapted from miao-ge/dsh-sidebar-context-menu and 0imzero/dsh-workspace-menu; do not install it alongside either - all of them attach right-click menus to the same sidebar rows.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏行右键菜单：在 DSH 0.2.2 及以上，两类行用的都是宿主菜单——工作区行按会话菜单的分组排入新建会话、复制路径与在文件夹显示、置顶打开方式、打开方式子菜单与批量删除；会话行在指针处展开菜单，并追加置顶打开方式、打开方式子菜单以及已归档会话的永久删除。条目默认只出现在右键菜单，可在设置里逐项开启「同时放进「…」菜单」；0.2.1 上工作区菜单由插件自绘。 改编自 miao-ge/dsh-sidebar-context-menu 与 0imzero/dsh-workspace-menu，请勿与它们同时安装——三者都会给同一批侧边栏行挂右键菜单。

description.en: Multi-platform API balance and usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI: balances for DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Kimi, StepFun, SiliconFlow, MiniMax, OpenRouter, Novita and xAI under the composer, estimated per-session and per-subagent cost with DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, automatic discovery of relays configured in DSH settings, and an optional draggable whale widget.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的多平台 API 余额与用量看板：在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek、智谱 GLM、Kimi、阶跃星辰、硅基流动、MiniMax、OpenRouter、Novita、xAI 的余额，估算本会话与子代理消耗并按 DeepSeek 峰谷计价，自动发现 DSH 设置里已配置的中转站，另有一个可拖拽的大肥鱼挂件。

description.en: Token usage dashboard and per-session tree statistics: provides time-range filtering, 6 summary metric cards, GitHub-style activity heatmap, model stacked-bar charts with cache hit rate curves, and Top-5 model/provider rankings; enhances the native session status bar to display aggregated token usage across main agents and all subagents with detailed breakdowns.
description.zh: Token 用量统计看板与会话树用量统计：提供快捷时间范围筛选、6 个汇总指标卡片、GitHub 风格活跃热力图、分模型堆叠柱状图与缓存命中率平滑曲线，以及按模型和供应商的 Top5 排行；接管并增强会话底部状态栏，汇总主智能体与全部子智能体的完整用量及分项明细。

description.en: Claude-style drag-and-drop/paperclip file upload with content sniffing, document-to-Markdown via Microsoft MarkItDown (built-in JS fallback), text inlining, and a read_document tool for agents.
description.zh: Claude 风格拖拽/回形针文件上传：内容嗅探、文档转 Markdown（微软 MarkItDown，内置 JS 兜底）、文本直插输入框、read_document 工具。

description.en: Test-stability tools: repeatedly run vitest/jest/pytest/node:test suites, classify flaky cases, keep history, maintain a quarantine manifest and health self-check.
description.zh: 测试稳定性工具：重复运行 vitest/jest/pytest/node:test，识别 flaky 用例，历史留档、隔离清单与健康自检。

description.en: Browser plugin for DSH (浏览器): Codex-style native browser control in your signed-in Chrome, with smooth virtual-cursor feedback, semantic page reads, form filling, screenshots and handoff; setup from the Browser sidebar. Requires macOS + Google Chrome (Chrome 125+) and a one-time unpacked load of the bundled MV3 extension; Edge, Windows and complete Linux installation are experimental.
description.zh: DSH 浏览器插件（Browser）：以 Codex 浏览器操作为体验参考，直接使用已登录的 Chrome 浏览器，平滑虚拟鼠标，支持页面读取、填表、截图与控制交还；安装后从侧栏「浏览器」完成配置。需要 macOS + Google Chrome（125+），并一次性以解压加载方式安装随包的 MV3 扩展；Edge、Windows 与完整的 Linux 安装仍属实验。

description.en: Cuigengji, your fiction-writing assistant and editor: organize settings, develop plots, draft chapters, and revise prose with AI. Share plot canvases, character cards, and worldbooks while you choose the direction, style, and what stays in the story.
description.zh: 催更姬｜你的小说助手与编辑。AI 帮你：理设定、推剧情、起草正文、润色改稿。共用剧情画布、角色卡与世界书，边讨论边创作。你定方向、文风和内容取舍，AI 协助把故事写下去。

description.en: Connect a self-hosted Magpie gateway with one provider route per upstream owner, so the stock model picker shows Magpie (Claude), Magpie (Codex) and other groups, plus automatic multi-line failover, read-only usage cards, per-model default effort, a per-session fast switch for priority-tier models, and optional Cloudflare Access.
description.zh: 把自托管 Magpie 网关按上游归属接入为多个 provider route，原版模型选择器即显示 Magpie (Claude)、Magpie (Codex) 等分组；支持多线路自动切换、只读用量卡片、逐模型默认 effort、priority 档模型的会话级快速切换和可选 Cloudflare Access。

description.en: Makes the agent narrate its process: every turn opens with how it reads the message and what it will do first, then short interim notes between tool-call batches, with in-app settings for style, sentence cap and toggles.
description.zh: 让 agent 边做边说：每轮先用一两句说明怎么理解消息、准备怎么做、第一步是什么，并在工具调用批次之间写过程叙述；插件页可直接调整详略、句数上限与开关。

description.en: PPT workbench: eleven ppt_* tools create, edit, reverse-engineer, QA-check and export slides from a plain-text PPTD project; five design-system families, themes, animations, posters and infographics.
description.zh: PPT 制作插件：十一个 ppt_* 工具创建、编辑、逆向、质检与导出演示文稿，内置五族设计系统与主题模板，支持幻灯片动画、海报与信息图。

description.en: Send local images or HTTP(S) image URLs to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint with the inspect_image tool and return its text response to the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 inspect_image 工具将本地图片或 HTTP(S) 图片链接发送至配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点，并将文字结果带回对话。

description.en: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that layers the self-referential Cordis toolset (dynamic plugins, runtime inspection) and preset-authoring skills onto the PTC Code-Mode preset; materialized files carry per-file sha256 markers, so user-edited presets are never overwritten on upgrade or uninstall.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 Agent 预设：在 PTC 编码模式之上叠加自引用 Cordis 工具集（动态插件、运行时检视）与预设编写技能；物化文件带逐文件 sha256 标记，用户改过的预设升级与卸载时都不会被覆盖。

description.en: Arknights: Endfield industrial-editorial theme for the DSH Web UI: cream paper, ink text, zero border radius, two switchable accent palettes (signal yellow / teal-cyan), plus optional marching-squares contour background, ENDFIELD watermark and boot progress plate.
description.zh: 《明日方舟：终末地》工业编辑风主题：奶油纸底、墨黑文字、全局直角，两套强调色配色（谷地黄信号黄 / 武陵青青碧色）可在设置切换，另有可选的等高线地形背景、ENDFIELD 水印与启动加载屏。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills with bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools, zero-cache-miss.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：DietrichGebert/ponytail 懒人 senior 模式与七阶梯子完美移植，6 个技能描述双语自由切换，各个技能自由开关，零 tool 注册，全场景零缓存破坏。

description.en: Whole-disk file-name search for DSH with a self-built cross-platform index, agent tools and a Web panel; no Everything required. It indexes your home directory by default; the first content search also builds a local full-text index (SQLite in the platform cache directory) of text and source files there (by extension, up to 1 MB each, 200,000 files) and of your recent DSH session messages; locator_export writes a SQLite copy of the index to any absolute path it is given, replacing an existing file when overwrite is true. The engine is a prebuilt Go binary shipped for six platforms (source in engine/), and the plugin makes no network requests.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供自建跨平台索引的全盘文件名搜索，带 agent 工具和 Web 面板，不依赖 Everything。默认索引你的主目录；第一次内容搜索时还会在本机建全文索引（SQLite，放在系统缓存目录），范围是主目录下按扩展名认定的文本和源码文件（每个最大 1 MB、最多 20 万个）以及你最近的 DSH 会话消息；locator_export 会把索引的 SQLite 副本写到给定的任意绝对路径，overwrite 为 true 时会替换已有文件。引擎是随包提供的预编译 Go 程序（六个平台，源码在 engine/ 里），插件不发任何网络请求。

description.en: Playwright/CDP web-fetch provider for the built-in web_fetch tool: renders pages in a real browser, denoises them (Readability + DOMPurify) and returns markdown.
description.zh: 为内置 web_fetch 工具提供 Playwright/CDP 后端：用真实浏览器渲染网页，经 Readability + DOMPurify 降噪后返回 Markdown。

description.en: Drive the Chrome browser you already use: open new tabs or reuse logged-in ones to read pages, click, fill, drag, scroll, screenshot, upload files, export PDFs, inspect console and network logs, and group tabs by task — 38 tools in all. Several harnesses can connect to the same Chrome at once, each working on its own tabs; a tab belongs to one harness at a time, so they never fight over it, and they can message each other. With foreground mode off, operations never bring the window to the front. Requires Chrome 120+; install the extension from the store and pair with an 8-digit code.
description.zh: 操纵你正在用的 Chrome 浏览器：新建标签页或复用已登录的标签页，读取页面、点击、填写、拖拽、滚动、截图、上传文件、导出 PDF、查看控制台与网络日志、按任务分组标签页，共 38 个工具。多个 Harness 可以同时连同一个 Chrome，各自操作不同标签页；同一个标签页只归一个 Harness，不会互相抢，彼此还能留言传话。关闭前台模式后，操作不会把窗口切到前台。需要 Chrome 120 或更新版本；从扩展商店装好扩展，用 8 位配对码连接。

description.en: Inline-edit and recall your own user messages in dsh web — lazily and seamlessly, with a version pager and per-session draft persistence.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 中内联编辑与撤回自己的消息——惰性、无痕，带版本翻页器与会话级草稿持久化。

description.en: Minimal prompt x Web PTC capabilities: one-line persona, run_code SDK, subagents, Ralph, web search/fetch, and Windows Git Bash; the general-purpose workflow tool stays hidden.
description.zh: 极简提示词 × Web PTC 能力：一句人格、run_code SDK、子代理、Ralph、网页搜索/抓取与 Windows Git Bash；通用 workflow 工具保持隐藏。

description.en: Academic tools in TypeScript, no Python or MCP server: the Zotero library through its local API or zotero.org (search, annotations, full text, citation export; add by DOI / arXiv id, notes and tags when writing is turned on), starting Zotero when it is closed; paper search across arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, PubMed and Europe PMC, plus CNKI and Google Scholar through a browser window; open-access full text, citations from the DOI registry, reference checking; 11 bundled skills.
description.zh: 学术工具，TypeScript 实现，不需要 Python 或 MCP 服务：通过本地 API 或 zotero.org 访问 Zotero 文库（检索、批注、全文、导出引文；开启写入后可按 DOI / arXiv 编号入库、写笔记、改标签），Zotero 没开时自动启动；同时检索 arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref、Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Europe PMC，并通过浏览器窗口检索知网和 Google Scholar；阅读开放获取全文、从 DOI 注册机构取引文、核验参考文献；内置 11 个学术技能。

description.en: Mirror dsh session events to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, or SQL Server while retaining local session files.
description.zh: 将 dsh 会话事件镜像到 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite 或 SQL Server，同时保留本地会话文件。

description.en: Floating panel for the DSH web UI managing MCP servers and skills: per-server deferred tool loading (ToolSearch, off by default) keeps a server's tools out of every turn's context — the prompt lists tool names only, and a tool's full schema enters the list once the model finds it with the built-in tool_search, so a turn stops paying for schemas it never calls. MCP servers live in a global scope or a project's own .dsh/mcp.json, with per-server enable/disable, a 47-service market and import from ten other clients; skills are auto-discovered across their real scopes with shadowing, and model auto-invocation versus manual-only is a switch per skill.
description.zh: DSH 网页的悬浮面板，管 MCP 也管技能：逐服务器开启工具延迟加载（ToolSearch，默认关闭）——该服务器的工具不再每轮常驻上下文，提示词里只列工具名，模型用内置 tool_search 搜到哪个，哪个的完整参数 schema 才进工具列表，每一轮不再为没调用的 schema 付上下文。MCP 分全局与项目两级（项目写在它自己的 .dsh/mcp.json，只该项目会话可见），逐台启停，另有 47 个服务的市场与从 10 种其他客户端导入配置；技能由宿主自动发现，面板按真实作用域与同名遮蔽逐条列出，每个技能「模型自动调用 / 仅你手动调用」就地可拨。

description.en: Voice I/O for DeepSeek Harness — speech-to-text and text-to-speech over the microphone and audio output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入输出：麦克风语音转文字与文字转语音。

description.en: Worktree Space: puts a workspace task that spans one or more Git repositories in its own task space directory - each repository in it gets its own worktree on one shared task branch; the space is registered as a DSH Workspace so sessions start right there, and multiple tasks run side by side without interfering. Finishing a task can merge the work back into each repository's target branch, remove the worktrees, and file whatever Git does not track in an archive directory you choose.
description.zh: Worktree Space：将一个可包含多个 Git 仓库的工作区任务放进独立的任务空间目录——参与的每个仓库使用同一个任务分支各开一个 worktree；空间自动注册为 DSH 工作区，会话直接在其中开工，多个任务并行推进、互不干扰。收尾时可合并回各仓库目标分支、移除 worktree，并把 Git 未跟踪的文件归档到指定目录；结束任务时可选把未提交的变更和合并冲突交给 agent 处理。

description.en: Standing instructions edited in the DSH settings UI and injected into the system prompt of every subsequent turn.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置界面维护常驻指令，自动注入此后每一轮对话的系统提示词。

description.en: Memory for long-form RP and companion chats: three fading layers, per-turn recall, source labels, character and world boundaries, a relationship graph, image attachments and a WebUI.
description.zh: 面向长篇 RP 与陪伴对话的记忆插件：三层记忆、逐轮召回、来源标注、角色与世界线边界、关系图、图片附件与独立 WebUI。

description.en: A font plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the conversation gets its own font, size, line height, weight, tracking, word gap, paragraph gap and first-line indent, the interface font follows it, code keeps its own axis with ligature control; light and dark can each hold their own set, whole setups save as presets, and a floating panel puts every axis a dot away.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的字体插件：对话有自己的字体、字号、行高、字重、字距、词距、段距与首行缩进，界面字体跟随对话，代码独立成轴并支持连字；亮色与暗色可各调一套，整套配置存为预设，另有一个悬浮调参面板。

description.en: Gacha banner and event schedule lookup for anime games: sidebar button with current banners, events and countdowns for 28 gacha games, with auto-refresh, search, Windows expiry reminders and .ics export.
description.zh: 二游卡池/活动排期速查：侧边栏按钮展示 28 款二游的当期卡池与活动起止，支持自动刷新、搜索、Windows 到期提醒与 .ics 导出。

description.en: Reuses the CodeBuddy CLI sign-in to bring its models into DeepSeek Harness, with a settings card showing account, token expiry, and remaining credit.
description.zh: 复用 CodeBuddy CLI 的登录态，把 CodeBuddy 包含的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，设置卡片可查看账号、令牌有效期与剩余积分。

description.en: Local media toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: converts files between 27 video, audio and image formats, trims clips, extracts audio or video tracks without re-encoding, exports embedded subtitles to .srt, compresses images with a before/after preview, reads and rewrites metadata, and encodes or decodes Base64 — all through the ffmpeg already installed on the machine, so files never leave it. The same engine is registered as a media_toolbox tool agents can call.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地多媒体工具箱：27 种视频/音频/图片格式互转、裁剪、不重编码地剥离音轨或画面、导出内嵌字幕为 .srt、带前后对比预览的图片压缩、元数据查看与改写、Base64 编解码——全部走本机已装的 ffmpeg，文件不出本机；同一引擎也注册为 agent 可调用的 media_toolbox 工具。

description.en: Apply configurable allow, deny, and approval rules to dsh tool calls, including shell command patterns.
description.zh: 根据可配置的允许、拒绝和审批规则控制 dsh 工具调用，包括对 shell 命令的匹配。

description.en: Kanban task board for DeepSeek Harness sessions: the main agent dispatches tasks to one-shot worker/verifier subagents, with dependency scheduling, file-level exclusion locks, arbitration hold/freeze, milestone progress reporting, and per-task token usage stats.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话任务看板：主窗口把任务派发给一次性 Worker/Verifier 子代理执行与验收，支持依赖调度、文件级排他锁、裁决挂起冻结、里程碑进展上报与任务级 Token 消耗统计。

description.en: Connects the MiniMax Code models to DSH - reusing the desktop app's sign-in or signing in on its own - with Anthropic-compatible model access, a live model catalog, the daily check-in that grants the free credits, and a credit balance that follows the model you selected.
description.zh: 将 MiniMax Code 的模型接入 DSH：复用桌面 App 登录态或用设备码自行登录，提供 Anthropic 兼容接入、动态模型目录、每日签到领取免费额度，以及跟随所选模型显示的积分余额与到期提示。

description.en: Turns the DeepSeek Harness agent into any character: a global cosplay switch, SillyTavern v2 role cards with JSON import/export, a neutral/role thinking-style toggle, and natural-language card authoring via a built-in skill.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 扮演任何角色：全局扮演开关、酒馆 v2 角色卡（JSON 导入导出）、中立/角色化思考切换，内置 skill 支持一句话生成角色卡。

description.en: Connect dsh to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes through `obsidian_*` tools.
description.zh: 把 dsh 连接到本地 Obsidian vault：通过 `obsidian_*` 工具搜索、读取、写入、移动与回收笔记。

description.en: Batch-port official Codex plugins into DSH skills (codex_list/port/status/health; measured: 186 plugins / 583 skills, 577 ported, 0 failures).
description.zh: Codex 官方插件一键移植为 DSH 技能（codex_list/port/status/health，实测 186 插件/583 技能，移植 577 个 0 失败）。

description.en: Skill that types the request before it searches: it splits a question into premises, definitions and analysis units, decides which report skeleton fits (verdict, explainer, causal mechanism, comparison, survey map, metric card), confirms the direction and runs a feasibility check, then emits that skeleton instead of forcing every question into a true-false verdict — in Chinese or English. Evidence gathering never trusts model memory: it searches domestic and international ecosystems in parallel, routes each point to the primary-source ladder for its domain (policy, academic, medical, financial, disaster, food safety, science, education, sports, entertainment, judicial, and more), fetches primary pages, grades sources by type, re-searches with debunking keywords, and keeps every statement bound to a full URL and citation position. Three factual judgements can be routed to a TypeSafe Jev (System One) decision model when a key is configured, falling back to the skill's deterministic rules when it is not; a model verdict can only lower a confidence tier.
description.zh: 先定型再取证的核查与调研技能：把提问拆成前提、定义、分析三类作业单元，判定要出哪种产物（裁决、释义、因果机制、对照、地图、指标卡），与用户确认方向并做可行性分析，再按型输出对应骨架——而不是把所有问题都压成真假判定，中英双语。取证不依赖模型记忆：国内外信息生态并行搜索，按事实范畴（政策、学术、医疗、金融、灾害事故、食品安全、科学常识、教育考试、体育、娱乐名人、司法案件等）选定一手来源阶梯，抓取一手页面并按来源类型分级，再用质疑关键词反查一轮，每条论断都带完整 URL 与引用位置。三类事实判断在配置了密钥时可交给 TypeSafe Jev（System One）决策模型，未配置则回退到内置的确定性规则；模型的判断只能降档、不能升档。

description.en: Ollama provider for DeepSeek Harness with model management, health checks, rule-based local routing, and cloud fallback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ollama 接入：模型管理、健康检查、基于规则的本地路由与云端回退。

description.en: Cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness — syncs sessions and settings between machines through git.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨设备会话同步：经 git 在多机之间同步会话与设置。

description.en: Union web search for DSH (consolidated successor of DDDMUC/dsh-free-search, which it credits): 28 engines across three tiers — keyless free (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG multi-instance union, plus Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel keyless modes), paid-with-key (Zhihu/Perplexity/Serply/DeepSeek official/You.com/Baidu/Kimi/Aliyun/Doubao/Zhipu/Bocha/Metaso), and model built-in search (OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Grok, explicit opt-in only) — with auto smart routing, per-engine enable/disable & fallback priority, parallel top-3 merge, multi_search, failure-aware fallback, a toggle to block the system built-in search, time filtering, platform search, web_fetch and a web settings UI. Experimental free advance_fetch: whole-page GFM-Markdown or CSS-selector/fields structured extraction with no API key and no per-call billing; fetch identity configurable (custom User-Agent, Referer, per-domain cookies attached only on domain match, never leaked across cross-domain redirects). Hosts 0.1.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1-rc.2 (17-tag exact engines.dsh enum; the rc.2 search-provider takeover goes through volatile config pinning after capability probing, never version branches). Paid engines need your own API keys (optional; free engines work keyless). npm: @drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search and bare dsh-union-search.
description.zh: DSH 的联合联网搜索（DDDMUC/dsh-free-search 的整合后继，README 有致谢）：28 个引擎分三档——免 key 免费（Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG 多实例联合，Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel 免 key 模式）、凭 key 付费（知乎/Perplexity/Serply/DeepSeek 官方/You.com/百度/Kimi/阿里云/豆包/智谱/博查/Metaso）、模型内置搜索（OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Grok，仅显式勾选）——配自动智能路由、逐引擎开关与回退优先级、并行 top-3 融合、multi_search 跨源工具、失败感知回退、屏蔽系统内置搜索开关、时间过滤、平台搜索、web_fetch 与网页设置界面。实验性·免费 advance_fetch：整页 GFM-Markdown 或 CSS 选择器/字段结构化抽取，零 key 零按次计费；抓取身份可配（自定义 UA、Referer、按域 cookie——仅在域名匹配时附带、跨域重定向绝不外流）。宿主 0.1.0-rc.2→0.2.1-rc.2 共 17 个 rc 精确枚举（rc.2 的搜索接管经能力探测后走 volatile 配置钉选，禁版本号分支）。付费引擎需自备 API key（可选，免费引擎开箱即用）。npm：@drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search 与裸名 dsh-union-search 双发。

description.en: Phone-portrait layout shell for the DSH Web UI: the sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer opened by swiping from the left, a persistent 56px action bar sits under the composer, and the settings panel plus the model and permission pickers are reflowed for touch. Ships native, merged and floating layout presets, all scoped to html\[data-dshm-mode="mobile"], so desktop, tablet and landscape keep the stock layout.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的手机竖屏布局壳：侧边栏变成左侧右滑打开的抽屉，输入区下方常驻一条 56px 操作栏，设置页与模型 / 权限选择器按触控重排；提供原生、融合、悬浮三套布局预设，全部样式受 html\[data-dshm-mode="mobile"] 作用域保护，桌面、平板与横屏保持官方原样。

description.en: Full-screen boot animation covering the loading page until the app UI is ready. The same library doubles as an appearance theme behind the interface, and desktop pets float over it on their own. Ships multiple built-in videos, wallpapers, voices and pets; upload your own files to customize.
description.zh: 全屏开机动画，盖住加载页直到应用就绪再淡出。同一套素材还能当外观主题铺在界面后面，另有桌面宠物浮在屏幕上自己活动。插件内置多套视频、壁纸、语音与宠物，也支持上传自己的文件进行自定义。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN change review inside DeepSeek Harness, with repository browsing and side-by-side diffs.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内只读审阅 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持仓库浏览和并排差异对比。

description.en: Use Jev to adjust main-chat reasoning effort without switching its model, independently select and apply fresh sub-agent capability and effort, and inspect decisions with per-reply allocation feedback.
description.zh: 通过 Jev 调整主会话推理投入而不换模型，为 fresh 子任务独立选择并应用能力与投入，展示决策分布并收集逐回复资源分配反馈。

description.en: Docker tools for agents: ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health with JSON output, env-configurable CLI path, approval-gated exec and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: Docker 工具：ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health 七工具，JSON 输出、DSH_DOCKER_PATH 环境变量、exec 审批门、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Suggested next-step prompts under every finished agent turn in the DeepSeek Harness chat: the model proposes a few followup prompts at the end of each turn, they render as clickable cards under that turn, and clicking one sends it verbatim as your next message. Each card stays attached to the turn that produced it across reloads and restarts, the generation language can be chosen from 15 languages or follow the conversation, and a settings page in the dsh settings covers the language, how many suggestions per turn, the header and the in-app update check. Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (web profile) and Node.js 20+.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天的每个已完成的智能体回合下方，都会给出可一键继续的下一步建议：模型在回合结尾提出若干后续提示，它们以可点击的卡片渲染在该回合下，点击即原样作为你的下一条消息发送。每张卡片始终归属于产生它的回合，重载与重启后依然对应；生成语言可在 15 种语言中选择或跟随对话；dsh 设置内还有设置页（语言、每个回合的建议数量、标题显示与内置更新检查）。需要 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x（web profile）与 Node.js 20+。

description.en: A separate narrow-screen web surface for DeepSeek Harness rather than the desktop GUI scaled down: it serves its own session list and chat stream behind a random access token over LAN, a tunnel (cloudflared, localtunnel or localhost.run) or an SSH reverse forward through a server you own. On the phone it streams assistant text, thinking, tool calls and results, sends prompts, stops the running turn, answers blocking questions and tool approvals (including ones waiting in other sessions), switches model, thinking level and permission preset, sends up to four photos compressed on the device, and keeps the computer awake.
description.zh: 为 DSH 单独做的窄屏移动端 Web 服务，不是把桌面 GUI 缩放塞进手机：自带会话列表与聊天流，随机访问令牌保护，可走局域网、cloudflared / localtunnel / localhost.run 隧道或自有服务器 SSH 反向转发。手机上流式看助手文本、思考、工具调用与结果，能发提示词、停止当前回合、回答阻塞提问与工具审批（含其它会话里等待的），切换模型 / 思考等级 / 权限预置，发送最多 4 张手机上压缩过的照片，并可一键让电脑常亮。

description.en: Six-layer local memory for dsh: captures turns, stages them through an L2 buffer into DL3 summaries via a staging model, injects a stable memory block each turn and replaces chat history with placeholders. Ships five memory tools and a config page.
description.zh: dsh 的六层本地记忆插件：捕获对话轮次，经 L2 巩固、由分流模型沉淀为 DL3 摘要，每轮注入稳定记忆块并以占位符替代聊天历史。附五个记忆工具与配置页。

description.en: Reports which PowerShell the DSH pwsh executor actually runs (enabled rows only; version-numbered Store paths are never recommended as pins), and installs a Store-managed PowerShell 7 through a scripted Store-page click or the manual Store path. Allows the pwsh tool only when the live executor resolves PowerShell 7+, and when dsh-ops is installed keeps the native pwsh beside ops_bash by enabling Compatibility and hiding duplicate official tools. Native status card and configuration switch in the Web UI; Windows only, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 报告 DSH 的 pwsh 执行器实际运行的 PowerShell（只认启用中的行，带版本号的商店路径不会被推荐为 pin），并通过脚本点击商店页面或手动商店路径安装由商店管理的 PowerShell 7。只有实际执行器解析到 PowerShell 7+ 时才放行 pwsh 工具；检测到 dsh-ops 时启用其 Compatibility 模式，保留原生 pwsh 与 ops_bash 并存，并隐藏重复的官方工具。Web 界面提供原生状态卡片和配置开关；仅 Windows，零运行时依赖。

description.en: A sidebar panel that moves, rebuilds, merges, renames and deletes whole workspaces: a move re-publishes each session log with the new directory in its header, repairs the workspace record, refreshes the cached title, and every card shows whether its sessions are running or only open.
description.zh: 侧栏里的工作区面板：迁移、重建、合并、重命名、删除整个工作区——迁移会用新目录的 header 重新发布会话日志，修复工作区归属并刷新标题缓存，每张卡片标明会话是在运行还是仅被打开。

description.en: A study tab with course-map, tutor and blackboard columns that turns markdown files, local folders or GitHub repos into guided courses, with lesson unlocking, mastery tracking, spaced repetition and a tutor-designed course import.
description.zh: 学习页签（课程｜导师｜黑板三栏）：把 markdown 文件、本地文件夹或 GitHub 仓库变成导学课程，提供课时解锁、掌握度追踪、间隔重复和导师设计式课程导入。

description.en: Plugin advisor for DeepSeek Harness: describe what you need and it ranks the npm packages carrying the dsh-plugin keyword by denoised metrics (daily baseline, week-over-week growth, release cadence, freshness) into a first pick, alternates and plugins to avoid; ships a sidebar panel, four AI tools and one-click install.
description.zh: DSH 插件选购顾问：说需求，从带 dsh-plugin 关键字的 npm 包里按去噪指标（日常基线、周环比、版本节奏、新鲜度）排出首选、备选和不推荐；提供右侧栏面板、4 个 AI 工具和一键安装。

description.en: DBLP and arXiv literature search, BibTeX retrieval and full-text acquisition with session-owned background jobs; an EduWork-maintained fork of SihanLv/dsh-literature.
description.zh: 检索 DBLP 与 arXiv 文献、获取 BibTeX 和全文，支持归属当前会话的后台任务；由 EduWork 接续维护的 SihanLv/dsh-literature 分支。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition backends, optional polish through dsh own LLM routes, and a native settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的语音输入插件：输入框的麦克风按钮把语音转成草稿文本，支持多种语音识别后端，可选经 dsh 自有 LLM 路由润色，并带原生设置页。

description.en: Knowledge base as a canvas in the right sidebar: notes are nodes, and nine tools let the model read, write, link and remove them. A node can carry pictures and documents, and reading one returns their text — Office files extracted in place — while pictures can be handed over as images.
description.zh: 右侧栏的卡片画布知识库：笔记就是节点，模型通过九个工具读写、连线、移除。节点可以挂图片和文档，读节点时连同内容一起返回（Office 文件就地抽取文本），图片还能作为图像直接交给模型。

description.en: Deterministic industry research reports for DeepSeek Harness — company and industry research flows produce structured, verifiable reports from staged evidence.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性行业研究报告：公司与行业研究流程基于分阶段证据产出结构化、可核验的报告。

description.en: Configurable default model for subagent delegations via settings.yaml, with single-model and multi-model round-robin or random strategies.
description.zh: 通过 settings.yaml 为子代理派发配置默认模型，支持单模型与多模型轮换/随机分配策略。

description.en: Floating pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows OpenCode Go usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as three rings, works out the remaining model quota automatically and can show the DeepSeek account balance alongside; a minimal mode nests the rings and lets you choose which of the 5-hour / weekly / monthly figures each outer / middle / inner ring shows, with a live preview.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮窗：三环显示 OpenCode Go 的 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月用量，支持自动计算模型配额剩余，可选同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额；极简模式把三环嵌套显示并支持自定义外 / 中 / 内环数据与实时预览。

description.en: Anthropic provider using the native Messages API for language models in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 使用原生 Messages API 为 DSH 提供语言模型能力的 Anthropic 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Reference verification for DeepSeek Harness (参考文献真实性检查器): the reference_checker model tool checks a paper's bibliography (.pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt or pasted text) against Crossref, OpenAlex and arXiv, reports found / partial / not_found / error per entry, and emits corrected citations in the input's style (APA, GB/T 7714, IEEE, Vancouver, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, ACS, BibTeX).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供参考文献真实性检查：reference_checker 工具将论文（PDF/BibTeX/tex/文本/粘贴列表）的每条文献对照 Crossref / OpenAlex / arXiv 核对，逐条判定 found / partial / not_found / error，并按输入样式生成可直接替换回论文的更正版引用（APA、GB/T 7714、IEEE、Vancouver、MLA、Chicago、Harvard、ACS、BibTeX）。

description.en: Voice input for the DSH web UI: tap or hold Alt to dictate into the composer. Local SenseVoice ASR by default — offline, zero config, zero key; auto-fallback to browser Web Speech, optional OpenAI-compatible ASR chain, polish through DSH-configured models, settings UI.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的语音输入插件：点按或按住 Alt 听写，结果落进输入框草稿。默认本地离线 SenseVoice（离线、零配置、零 key），自动回退浏览器 Web Speech，可选 OpenAI 兼容云端 ASR 服务链，可经 DSH 已配置模型润色，带设置页。

description.en: Two-way sync of DSH sessions, workspace mappings, settings and patches between machines through your own private GitHub repo (API keys stay machine-local).
description.zh: 通过你自己的 GitHub 私有仓库,在多台电脑间双向同步 DSH 会话、工作区对应关系、设置与托管补丁(API 密钥留在本机)。

description.en: Minecraft development for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), covering Minecraft 1.7.10 through 26.3: 9 skills for Paper/Spigot plugins, Fabric, Forge and NeoForge mods, addon development against major mods, and Gradle/JDK setup per era; the mc_scaffold generator and mc_gradle runner; 18 offline API signature indexes generated from the pinned artefacts with provenance headers; and mc_arbitrate, a deterministic sharded pipeline (contract freeze, per-shard briefs, 21 high-confidence audit rules including 5 cross-shard checks, manifest merge, compile-error routing) that calls no model inside the engine. Apache-2.0 with NOTICE.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 Minecraft 开发插件，覆盖 Minecraft 1.7.10 至 26.3：9 个技能（Paper/Spigot 插件、Fabric/Forge/NeoForge 模组、大型模组附属、分时代 Gradle/JDK 构建）、mc_scaffold 项目生成器与 mc_gradle 构建执行器、18 份由钉选工件生成且带 provenance 头的离线 API 签名索引，以及确定性分片流水线 mc_arbitrate（契约冻结、分片任务书、21 条高置信审计规则含 5 条跨分片检查、清单合并、编译错误定点路由），引擎内部不调用模型。Apache-2.0 + NOTICE。

description.en: Integrates coding agent CLIs, persistent terminals and remote workspaces into the native DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh: 将十几种编程助手 CLI、持久终端与远程工作区接入 DSH 原生界面。

description.en: Code-graph integration for the DSH Web GUI: a "Codegraph" card in Settings → Plugins with index status, symbol search, callers / callees / impact views, and one-click sync / index; hosts the codegraph MCP server and injects a CodeGraph usage guideline into the system prompt. Requires the codegraph CLI.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Codegraph 集成：设置 → 插件 中的「Codegraph」卡片提供索引状态、符号搜索、callers/callees/impact 查看与一键 sync/index；托管 codegraph MCP 服务器，并向 system prompt 注入 Codegraph 使用指引。需安装 codegraph CLI。

description.en: Effort slider in the model menu, a live tokens-per-second and turn-total readout beside the running status, a per-answer input/output/cached report, and a completion notification when a turn finishes, for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 模型菜单里的思考强度滑块、运行状态旁的实时速度与本轮用量、每条回答的输入/输出/缓存成绩单，以及每轮结束的完成通知；各自独立开关，只作用于界面。

description.en: Preset engineering workflows for DeepSeek Harness: a dev_task tool that gates stage transitions, artifacts, verification, review and commit scope, plus a web workbench for installing project or user skills and rules.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预设工程流程：dev_task 工具把阶段流转、产物、验证、审核与提交范围做成硬门禁，并带一个安装项目级与个人级技能和规则的工作台。

description.en: RSS/news reader in the dsh sidebar: built-in source library + custom feeds (real-fetch validated on save) + OPML import; the fetch pipeline auto-translates foreign items and LLM-scores new items, generating a daily digest and hourly briefs to cut through information overload; with data backup/restore and preference customization.
description.zh: 方便等待 AI 回复时看一眼新闻的 RSS/新闻阅读器。内置订阅源库，可自定义源；抓取管线自动翻译外文新闻、LLM 逐条评分，自动生成每日「日报」和每小时「快报」，解决信息过载；具有数据备份恢复，偏好自定义等功能。

description.en: Workspace-based archive management with scoped content search, conversation previews, tags and notes, ZIP backups, lineage graphs, confirmed permanent deletion and retries, and official Host updates.
description.zh: 按工作区管理已归档与未归档会话，支持独立范围正文搜索、上下文预览、标签备注、ZIP 备份导入导出、会话谱系、永久删除确认与失败重试，以及官方宿主更新。

description.en: One-tap connect Agnes language, image and video models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. After signing in to the Agnes console (re-login uses AGNES_PASSWORD), you can see the quota windows (5-hour requests, weekly requests, daily images, video), account-wide cumulative usage, and a usage pill beside the input box. AgnesCode desktop models can be connected too (Windows only), re-reading the desktop app login when the token expires, with rate-limit hits backing off on their own.
description.zh: 一键接入 Agnes 的语言、生图、视频模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与思考强度；登录 Agnes 控制台后（重登需 AGNES_PASSWORD），可看额度窗口（5 小时请求、每周请求、每日图片、视频）、账号累计用量，以及输入框旁的用量胶囊；也支持接入 AgnesCode 桌面端模型（仅 Windows），令牌到期时重新读取桌面端登录态，撞限额自动退避重试。

description.en: A polished floating whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with 95 categorized transparent animations, state-aware event reactions, customizable actions and triggers, click interactions, dragging and screen wandering.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的精致悬浮鲸鱼桌宠，拥有 95 个分类透明动画、状态感知事件回应、可自定义动作与触发规则，并支持点击互动、拖拽和屏幕漫游。

description.en: DeepSeek balance and token usage panel for DSH, with official platform billing, a daily usage calendar, and local session-log estimates for all providers using editable per-model pricing.
description.zh: DSH 里的 DeepSeek 用量面板：官方账户余额与账单、每日用量日历，以及按可编辑的逐模型费率估算全部 Provider 的本地会话日志用量。

description.en: A faster, more efficient, and more accurate coding Agent preset. On 100 hard SWE-bench Pro tasks selected using multidimensional difficulty criteria, average elapsed time decreased by 36%, average input tokens per task decreased by 17%, and accuracy increased by 5 percentage points.
description.zh: 提供一个更快、更节省、更准确的编码 Agent 预设。在按多维难度规则筛选的 SWE-bench Pro 高难度 100 题评测中，平均耗时减少 36%，平均每题输入 token 减少 17%，正确率提高 5 个百分点。

description.en: Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏全局搜索框全文搜索历史会话（走 sessionQuery 全文索引，未启用时降级为逐会话扫描）与设置面板，关键词高亮，点击直达会话或对应设置卡片。

description.en: Runs Midscene on the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness instead of separate third-party API keys: hosts an OpenAI-compatible bridge on 127.0.0.1 (default port 8787, automatically skipping occupied ports) that proxies chat completions, streaming and non-streaming, to the DSH host model layer, so DeepSeek official routing, CodeBuddy, Codex and custom OpenAI/Anthropic endpoints all become available to Midscene agents while credentials stay inside the provider plugins and the bridge never touches them. A `/v1/midscene-env` endpoint generates the four MIDSCENE_MODEL_* environment lines with the model family inferred, and seven built-in skills — browser, desktop, Android, iOS and HarmonyOS automation plus a Vitest E2E skill and a Midscene knowledge reference — appear in the session skill catalog without `npx skills add`. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-midscene`.
description.zh: 让 Midscene 直接用 DeepSeek Harness 里已配置的模型，不再需要第三方模型 API Key：在 127.0.0.1 托管一个 OpenAI 兼容桥接服务（默认端口 8787，被占用时自动跳号），把流式与非流式的对话补全代理到 DSH 宿主模型层，DeepSeek 官方路由、CodeBuddy、Codex 与自定义 OpenAI/Anthropic 端点对 Midscene 全部可用；凭据留在各提供方插件内，桥不接触。`/v1/midscene-env` 端点直接生成四行 MIDSCENE_MODEL_* 环境变量并自动推断模型家族；浏览器、桌面、Android、iOS、鸿蒙自动化加 Vitest E2E 与 Midscene 知识参考共 7 个内置技能随装随用，无需 `npx skills add`。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-midscene`。

description.en: Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM condensing (long replies summarized into short spoken lines, following the current conversation model), TTS-friendly text cleaning, selectable Edge TTS voices, adjustable silence auto-stop, and settings embedded in DSH settings dialog.
description.zh: 豆包式语音对话插件：聊天框麦克风按钮（按住说话）语音转文字并自动发送，AI 回复自动朗读。可选 LLM 转述精简（长回复压缩成口语再播，跟随当前对话模型）、朗读前清洗 markdown/emoji/特殊符号、Edge TTS 多种音色、静音自动结束时长可调，设置嵌入 DSH 自带设置弹窗（voice chat 类目）。

description.en: Lets Foxy browse Bilibili with daily windows and video limits, filter by interests, comment or remember through an editable prompt, reply to mentions and comment threads, and deduplicate per video. Requires dsh-foxy.
description.zh: 让 Foxy 按每日时段和视频上限浏览 B 站，按兴趣筛选，用可编辑提示词评论或记忆，并回复 @ 与评论楼中楼，按视频去重。需先安装 dsh-foxy。

description.en: Detects prompt-injection, jailbreak, and secret-leak patterns on the agent/pre-step, tools/pre-execute, and tools/post-execute seams with allow/ask/block tiers, sanitized defend/detection audit events, a defend_report tool, and a destructive-delete command guard.
description.zh: 在 agent/pre-step、tools/pre-execute、tools/post-execute 三个接缝检测提示词注入、越狱与密钥泄露，按 allow/ask/block 分层拦截，附脱敏 defend/detection 审计事件、defend_report 工具与危险删除命令门禁。

description.en: A model-driven desktop pet, derived from PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT): an always-on-top companion that follows your agent sessions, races the Web UI to answer approvals and questions, keeps a per-pet affection ledger, speaks through pet_say/pet_do tools or an autonomous inner voice, and can read those lines aloud through BreezeBlue TTS with your own BreezeBlue API key. It uses its own /whale598 route and ~/.dsh/whale598 data directory, so it is a separate pet from dsh-pet rather than a replacement for it.
description.zh: 模型驱动的桌面宠物，派生自 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT）：独立置顶小窗跟随会话状态，与 Web 界面竞速应答审批与提问，维护每宠独立的好感账本，经 pet_say/pet_do 工具或自主内心戏说话，并可用自备的 BreezeBlue API Key 通过 BreezeBlue 把台词读出来。它使用独立的 /whale598 路由与 ~/.dsh/whale598 数据目录，是独立于 dsh-pet 的另一只桌宠，不替代上游。

description.en: Yijing-based decision review plugin for DSH: six-layer weighted aggregation engine (384 yao to taiji) with strong-association veto rules, pure JS with zero solver dependencies. Free tier is capped at 9 runs per day and activation codes raise it; the stock-trend scenario pulls live quotes from Tencent for the stock codes in the request.
description.zh: 道一-易经推演：通用决策评审 DSH 插件（决策辅助，非迷信）。六层加权聚合引擎（384爻→64卦→8宫→四象→三才→两仪→太极），强关联一票否决，内置电机设计/股票趋势/商业成功率剧本，纯 JS 零求解器依赖。免费档每日限 9 次推演，激活码可提升；stock-trend 剧本会按请求里的股票代码向腾讯行情接口拉取实时行情。

description.en: Generative, interactive UI for DeepSeek Harness: the agent picks per reply between 26 validated native components and sandboxed streaming HTML widgets, patches a rendered UI in place by component ID, restores tabs, sorts, filters and form values after a reload, and computes slider and filter changes in the browser without another model call.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供生成式交互界面：模型每次回答自行在 26 个校验过的原生组件与沙箱流式 HTML widget 之间选择，可按组件 ID 就地修补已渲染的界面，标签页、排序、筛选与表单值在刷新后恢复，滑块与筛选的重算在浏览器本地完成，不回调模型。

description.en: Agent Teams for DeepSeek Harness: hand work to a team of agents that carries it end to end while you set the direction and hold the gates. Agents claim Tasks, hand work to each other, and have someone other than the builder verify it.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 团队：把工作交给一支 Agent 团队，它们把事做到底，你定方向、把关键的关。Agent 自己认领 Task、互相交接，由做的人以外的成员验收。

description.en: Stops a streaming model call when the same string repeats ten times in a row (threshold configurable), keeps the partial answer as a normal assistant message, and shows a stop notice with the workspace, session name and the repeated string. Repeat counts can vary by unit length through a piecewise table or a JavaScript module, and code regions (fenced, inline, indented) use a relaxed threshold.
description.zh: 同一字符串连续重复达到阈值（默认 10 次）时截停本次生成，已生成内容照常提交；截停后弹出通知，显示所属工作区、会话名称与重复的字符串。重复次数可按单元长度用分段表或 JS 模块决定，代码区域（围栏 / 行内 / 缩进）使用放宽的阈值。

description.en: Knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: assembles ContextWindow evidence at query time within heading boundaries and token budgets, with follow-up reading around each search anchor; combines BM25/vector search via weighted RRF, MMR and optional local/remote reranking; provides automatic evidence injection, a browser panel for local embedding/rerank/OCR model downloads and health checks, keyword search without model downloads, and in-place rescans of imported directories.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 知识库：查询时按标题边界与 Token 预算动态组织 ContextWindow 证据，支持围绕命中锚点续读原文；通过加权 RRF 融合 BM25 与向量召回，支持 MMR 去冗余和本地／远程重排；提供回答前自动证据注入、本地 embedding／rerank／OCR 模型下载与健康检查面板、无需下载模型的关键词检索，以及导入目录原地重扫。

description.en: Zero-LLM auto-capture and a symbolic \[ENGRAM\] index with progressive disclosure, an ESR-lite task/evidence protocol (esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link), and per-workspace usage telemetry with an offline recall benchmark (npm run eval).
description.zh: 零 LLM 自动捕获 + 符号化 \[ENGRAM\] 索引渐进披露，配 ESR-lite 任务/证据闭环（esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link）、按工作区的真实使用遥测与离线召回基准（npm run eval）。

description.en: LAN and reverse-proxy access to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: returns the settings service on pages that are not localhost, fills in the web APIs a browser withholds over plain HTTP, and can open a listener of its own.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 提供局域网与反向代理访问：在非 localhost 页面返回设置服务，补齐浏览器在纯 HTTP 下限制的 Web API，并可自行开启监听端口。

description.en: Two-way Slack messaging (notify/channels/inbox/reply/health) over Socket Mode, no public callback needed.
description.zh: Slack 双向通信（notify/channels/inbox/reply/health 五工具），Socket Mode 免公网回调。

description.en: One-tap connect SenseNova Token Plan language and image models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. On a rate limit it backs off and retries on its own instead of misreading it as an exhausted quota. After signing in to the SenseNova console you can see the usage pill, credit pools and per-model consumption. Xiaohuanxiong can also be signed in by QR code, bringing in its models and their consumption multipliers, and taking over DSH web search.
description.zh: 一键接入商汤 Token Plan的语言、生图模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与思考强度；限频时自动退避重试，不会误判为额度耗尽；登录商汤控制台后，可查看用量胶囊、积分池、每模型消耗。也支持扫码登录小浣熊，接入其模型，查看模型消耗倍率，使用联网搜索。

description.en: Desktop pet drawn from the official whale outline, for both the desktop app and the web UI: SVG animations and facial expressions follow agent state (thinking, working, done, error, waiting for confirmation), and it can follow other running sessions with a count badge; poke it, drag it, shake it dizzy, squash it against a screen edge, or rub the cursor over its head for a headpat; 7 palettes, 4 sizes, synthesized sounds, light/dark theme sync, and a playable web preview.
description.zh: 官方鲸鱼轮廓的桌宠，桌面端和网页端都能用：SVG 动画和表情随 agent 状态切换（思考／工作／完成／报错／等待确认），还能跟随其他在跑的会话并用角标显示个数；可戳可拖、能甩晕、按在屏幕边上会压扁，鼠标在头顶来回蹭就是摸头；7 套色板、4 档大小、合成音效，跟随亮暗主题，附网页预览可直接试玩。

description.en: Windows only (needs the Edge WebView2 Runtime): pop the current session into an always-on-top WebView2 mini window with a self-drawn title bar, free resizing and a jump back to the main window; adds full-screen and region screenshots that paste straight into the composer, a "ask about selection" pill for text selected in any application, global hotkeys and a settings section.
description.zh: 仅 Windows（需要 Edge WebView2 运行时）：把当前会话一键弹出为常驻置顶的 WebView2 小窗（自绘标题栏、可自由缩放、可跳回主窗），并附整屏与框选截图直插输入框、任意程序划词后的「问大肥鱼」快捷按钮、全局快捷键与设置页。

description.en: Select text → annotate → send with your message; replies map back to each annotation.
description.zh: 选中文字→批注→随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照。

description.en: Context indicator for the DeepSeek Harness composer: segmented occupancy, compression points, and the native auto-compaction line (flashes red when crossed). Supports preview-then-confirm compaction (/bc), seamless handoff (the old session becomes "History N" while the new one keeps the name; a relay bar above the composer shows the full handoff chain with two-way jumps), and message pinning with stale-pin labels. Thresholds, colors, and auto-archive after handoff are configurable in Settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框上下文指示器：分段显示会话占用、压缩判断点与 DSH 原生自动压缩线（越线红闪）。支持预览后确认压缩（/bc）、无痕交接（旧会话归档为「历史 N」、新会话继承原名，输入框上方接力条可回看完整交接链并双向跳转）、锁定消息防压缩与失效标注。设置里可配阈值、配色与交接后自动归档开关。

description.en: Deterministic context compression for dsh — zero LLM calls, rule-based pruning that preserves paths, commands, error traces, and open todos verbatim. Compresses ~80k tokens to a few hundred.
description.zh: dsh 的确定性上下文压缩后端：零 LLM 摘要调用，基于规则剪枝，逐字保留路径/命令/报错原文/未完成 todo，约 8 万 token 压到几百。

description.en: Login gate for the dsh web surface: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI (dsh.bundle manifest since 0.4.1, one-command `dsh plugin add` mounting).
description.zh: DSH 网页端登录门插件：账号口令或共享令牌认证、会话 cookie、登录限速，附用户管理 CLI（0.4.1 起声明 dsh.bundle manifest，`dsh plugin add` 一键挂载）。

description.en: Turns course files (PPTX, PDF, DOCX, Markdown) into an outline, per-chapter key points with quoted evidence, Bilibili video picks, syllabus coverage, and Anki/JSON exports.
description.zh: 把课程文件（PPTX、PDF、DOCX、Markdown）解析成目录、带原文引证的分章要点、B 站网课推荐与考纲覆盖检查，并可导出 Anki 卡片和 JSON。

description.en: Built-in Obsidian-style knowledge base for DSH: agents distill conversations, documents and web sources into a structured .wiki graph, with retrieval, graph export, note editing, incremental builds and multi-vault management.
description.zh: DSH 内置版 Obsidian 知识库：agent 把对话、文档与网页蒸馏为结构化 .wiki 知识图，支持检索、图谱导出、笔记编辑、增量构建与多库管理。

description.en: Desktop pet for DSH with voice chat, personas, memory, Bilibili and QQ context, and command-gated computer control; enable DSH built-in voice input first to use voice chat. A fork of dsh-pet (MIT), not installable alongside the original.
description.zh: DSH 桌面宠物：语音聊天、多人设、聊天记忆、B 站视频与 QQ 群记忆（只读本地文件）；「电脑操作」需在面板里显式打开总开关后才响应语音指令，语音聊天需先在 DSH 中启用内置语音输入。dsh-pet（MIT）的 fork，不能与原版同时安装。

description.en: Code-generated math and science animation for DSH: six tools cover environment checks and dependency self-repair, Manim/manimgx scene rendering to storyboard frames or MP4, contact-sheet probing of finished clips for black or overexposed frames, and formula identity checks with SymPy, together with three skills (topic routing, design spec, QA rubric), a project scaffold with timeline and narration, requirement approvals before rendering, and five animation styles.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的代码生成数学/科普动画：六个工具覆盖环境预检与依赖自愈、把 Manim/manimgx 场景渲染为 storyboard 帧或 MP4、对成片抽帧拼图检查黑帧与过曝、用 SymPy 判断公式恒等；另带三个技能（题材路由、设计规范、交付自检）、含时间轴与旁白的项目脚手架、渲染前的需求确认，以及五套动画风格。

description.en: Full-duplex Chinese voice interaction for DSH Web: dictate and edit tasks, submit requests, manage sessions, answer DSH questions, and hear concise task-completion announcements.
description.zh: 基于全双工语音模型的 DSH 网页端中文语音交互：边听边说、随时插话，用语音输入和修改任务、提交请求、管理会话、回答 DSH 的问题，并简短播报任务完成结果。

description.en: A balance and cost widget for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar footer card shows the account balance, a remaining-ratio bar and today costs; clicking opens a four-tier cost breakdown (last prompt / this session / today-this-project / today-all) with term explanations and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies, works on Node 24.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的余额与成本小部件：侧边栏底部卡片显示账户余额、剩余比例条与今日花费；点击展开四层级成本明细（最近提问 / 本会话 / 今日·本项目 / 今日·全部），带名词解释与一键充值入口。零依赖，兼容 Node 24。

description.en: Desktop side of a native Android DSH phone app: scan a QR code to pair, then chat, approve tool calls, answer questions, drive subagents and follow background jobs from the phone over an end-to-end-encrypted channel; one device at a time.
description.zh: 原生安卓手机 App 的电脑侧：扫码配对后，就能在手机上对话、审批工具调用、回答提问、驱动子智能体、跟进后台任务，通道端到端加密；同一时刻只服务一台设备。

description.en: Markdown-as-database project knowledge base for DSH agents: ten kb_* tools (including kb_register for registering existing notes), stable TIDs, `[[node]]` links that never copy text, `[[tscl]]` definitions expanded in place, bounded reads, structural lint covering tscl, workspace-first library discovery, inline git snapshots, a node-graph panel, and a bundled prompt section plus skill that make the agent reach for kb_* instead of hand-written docs/.
description.zh: 给 DSH Agent 用的「md 即数据库」项目知识库：10 个 kb_* 工具（含登记已有笔记的 kb_register）、稳定 TID、`[[node]]` 只出链接不复制正文、`[[tscl]]` 定义就地展开、有界读取、覆盖 tscl 的结构 lint、工作区优先的库发现、内嵌 git 快照、节点图面板，另带系统提示词段落与随包技能，让 Agent 优先用 kb_* 而不是手写 docs/。

description.en: DingTalk group-robot notifications (notify/text/health; webhook + HMAC signing, zero runtime dependencies).
description.zh: 钉钉群机器人通知：dingtalk_notify/text/health 三工具，webhook + HMAC 加签，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Switches the running session's persona and speaking style in place, via the composer's persona button or `/role`; each persona can bind its own on-screen mascot, the persona is appended as its own prompt section after the deployment persona without touching tools or skills, and each switch is announced in the transcript.
description.zh: 用输入框的「人设」按钮或 `/role` 指令就地切换当前会话的人设与说话风格，每个人设可单独绑定屏幕吉祥物立绘；人设作为独立的 prompt section 追加在部署人设之后，不动工具与技能，切换人设后会在会话里声明一次。

description.en: Embedded C/C++ firmware development toolbox: agents and skills covering FreeRTOS, interrupts, NVM storage, Keil MDK, ARMCLANG, HardFault triage, state machines, architecture, and LVGL patterns.
description.zh: 嵌入式 C/C++ 固件开发工具箱：代理与技能覆盖 FreeRTOS、中断、NVM 存储、Keil MDK、ARMCLANG、HardFault 分析、状态机、架构原则与 LVGL 陷阱。

description.en: Replaces the DSH Web connection provider to skip BrowserAuth entirely so the Web UI opens directly without pasting the random startup token, gated to nine verified DSH version pairs with strict host/client matching that sleeps automatically on unknown or mixed versions, and reverts fully on uninstall; web profiles only.
description.zh: 替换 DSH Web 的连接提供方以整体跳过 BrowserAuth，打开 Web 地址即可直接使用、无需抄写启动 URL 中的随机 token；按九个已验证的 DSH 版本对严格成对门控，遇到未知或混用版本自动休眠，卸载即完全恢复官方行为，仅限 Web profile。

description.en: Persona engine for DeepSeek Harness: one config.json drives the AI's self-name (per model, per tier), how it addresses you, relationship stance, character text, per-item work contracts with individual toggles, thinking-chain language, appearance and reply tone (both opt-in and per-model overridable), and long-term memory gated by human confirmation - the AI can only append proposed candidates, a human confirm line flips them into effect, and the log is physically append-only and replayable. Confirmed entries are injected as a quoted data-not-instructions block; entries tagged with a kind can instead be routed to arbitrary files on confirmation and never reach the prompt. Three prompt sections re-evaluate from disk on every assembly, so edits apply on the next step with no restart. Persona presets are shareable JSON snapshots (imports and exports SillyTavern character cards, v2/v3 read, v2 written) and deliberately never carry memory. Zero runtime dependencies, no network, no shell; any error degrades to an empty section rather than a broken session. Ships blank - installing changes nothing until you write something.
description.zh: 人设引擎（DeepSeek Harness）：一份 config.json 管住 AI 的自称（可按具体模型指定，未命中回落 flash / pro 两档）、对你的称呼、关系立场、性格正文、逐条可勾选的工作契约、思维链语言、形象与回复语气（两段均 opt-in、均可按模型覆盖），以及由人工确认闸门把关的长期记忆——AI 只能追加 status:"proposed" 候选，人执行一行 confirm 才转正，日志物理只追加、按行序重放。已确认条目以「数据而非指令」的引号块注入；带 kind 的条目改为在确认那一刻按路由追加进指定文件、永不进提示词。三段提示词每次装配都从磁盘重新求值，改配置下一步生效、不用重启。人设预设是可分享的 JSON 快照（导入导出酒馆角色卡：v2/v3 可读、v2 可写），且刻意不携带记忆。零运行时依赖、不联网、不执行命令；任何异常降级为空段，最坏是「没有人设」而不是会话起不来。出厂空白——不写配置就什么都不改变。

description.en: Turn another computer into a remote Agent teammate: the worker runs its own DSH and a full Agent loop locally, so dispatched tasks keep running when the link drops and its model credentials never leave that machine. The hub dispatches through 8 remote_* tools, receives only a handoff summary plus an artifact manifest, and pulls finished products on demand — intermediate artifacts stay on the worker. Pairing-code onboarding, direct or relay transport for NAT, Web panel on both sides.
description.zh: 把另一台电脑变成你的远程 Agent 同事：副机本地跑自己的 DSH 与完整 Agent 循环，所以链路断开时任务照常继续、模型凭证也永不离开那台机器。主机用 8 个 remote_* 工具派活，只收回 handoff 摘要与产物清单，成品按需拉取——中间产物留在副机。配对码接入，direct 或 relay 两种传输穿 NAT，两侧都有 Web 面板。

description.en: A shared kanban board that lets people and DSH agents manage workspace tasks through a Board tab and kanban tools.
description.zh: 一个由用户与 DSH Agent 共同维护的工作区看板，通过看板标签页和 kanban 工具管理任务。

description.en: Registers the DeepSeek Harness web server (dsh web) as an auto-start, self-healing background service — LaunchAgent / systemd / cron plus a 30s health-check watchdog — with seven dsh_daemon_* tools (install/uninstall/reinstall/status/start/stop/update).
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 服务（dsh web）注册为自启动、自愈的后台服务：LaunchAgent / systemd / cron 加 30 秒健康检查 watchdog，并提供 7 个 dsh_daemon_* 工具（安装/卸载/重装/状态/启动/停止/更新）。

description.en: Selection quoting and anchored annotations across DSH chats and document previews: numbered quote blocks stay visible in the composer and in sent messages and click back to the source, notes from docx / PDF / Markdown / code / Excel-range previews collect into one batched send, and each note can be dictated by voice.
description.zh: DSH 会话与文档预览里的划词批注：带编号的引用块在输入框和已发送消息里始终可见、点一下跳回原文；docx / PDF / Markdown / 代码与 Excel 选区批注可攒起来一次性发送；批注框支持语音输入。

description.en: Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start, context-window guards, pure files.
description.zh: 分层 Claude Code 式记忆：用户级+项目级双作用域（项目记忆随 git 团队共享），MEMORY.md 索引会话启动自动注入，上下文护栏，纯文件零依赖。

description.en: Connect Google Antigravity OAuth accounts to DeepSeek Harness with smart multi-account quota rotation, multi-model LLM routing, and Nano Banana 2 image generation.
description.zh: 接入 Google Antigravity OAuth 账号，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能多账号池额度自愈轮换、全系多模型流式路由及 Nano Banana 2 图像生成。

description.en: ShaderToy backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness: a WebGL2 player with a background library and five bundled presets, adjustable opacity, brightness, resolution and frame rate, playback options, and an in-app editor for the running shader.
description.zh: 把 ShaderToy 作品作为 DeepSeek Harness 背景：WebGL2 播放器 + 背景库（含 5 个预设），可调界面不透明度、亮度、分辨率与帧率，支持画面循环与音乐播放设置，并能在设置页直接编辑当前着色器代码。

description.en: Detailed model usage and cost analysis, with per-session usage stats and usage queries for GLM, MiniMax, OpenCode Go, DeepSeek and more.
description.zh: 详细的模型用量、费用分析，支持会话级用量统计，支持GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、DS等用量查询。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: six tools to ingest Markdown, plain text and PDF files, search them with BM25 or hybrid BM25 plus optional local embeddings, and answer with cited source passages. Runs offline with no database server. Requires Node.js 18+ and Python 3.9+; PDF ingest needs pymupdf.
description.zh: 本地知识库：六个工具，导入 Markdown、文本与 PDF，用 BM25 或 BM25 + 本地向量的混合检索查找，回答时带原文引用。离线运行，不需要数据库服务。需 Node.js 18+ 与 Python 3.9+；导入 PDF 需 pymupdf。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud DashScope provider for Qwen language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation through native APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 通过阿里云 DashScope 原生 API 为 DSH 提供通义千问语言模型、嵌入、重排、语音和图像生成能力。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Lets one session read, write and run bash across several folders, not just the primary root — additional roots are registered from a sidebar Folders panel or the /workspace-folders command (inherit/read-only/read-write) and share the primary root's file-fence + OS-sandbox authorization; adds no new tools.
description.zh: 让单个会话在多个文件夹中读写并运行 bash，而不限于主目录——附加根经侧栏 Folders 面板或 /workspace-folders 命令登记（inherit/read-only/read-write），与主根共享同一套文件围栏 + 内核沙箱授权；不新增工具。

description.en: Union IM bridge for DSH — an independent implementation uniting the capability sets of community peer plugins (xmanrui/dsh-im, MichengAI/dsh-im-connect). Drive your agent session from 15 channel adapters across 12 platforms (including email; WeCom/DingTalk/QQ each contribute two: bot + self-built app or notify tier) — WeChat (official iLink QR bind), Feishu/Lark (long-connection + streaming cards; the voice tier requires system ffmpeg), Telegram, Discord, WeCom intelligent bot & self-built app (signed callback), DingTalk (stream + AI Card and custom-robot notify), QQ official bot (plus notify tier), Slack (Socket Mode), WhatsApp (Baileys QR pairing; the dependency ships as an optionalDependency of the plugin package), Matrix, iMessage (macOS only), Email (IMAP/SMTP thread routing). The cross-version narrow waist auto-adapts settings gen1/gen2/gen3 across hosts 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 (12-tag enum; rc.2 verified by a real desktop-profile install with double read-back) using capability probing only, never version branches. In chat: a 25-command panel, tool-approval and question loops answered in the originating chat (deny-by-default, initiator-only, 5-min expiry), image/file input gated on host model metadata, deliverable file return, a delivery log with bounded retry (uncertain is never re-sent), proactive delivery and fragment composition. It also splits the native sidebar into self-owned Tasks / Channels tabs (standing down entirely when another plugin already owns the slot), registers an `im-concise` agent preset plus reply sanitisation that keeps GenUI fences and raw HTML out of text-only chats, renders `svg` fences to PNG images, guards model choice with an allowlist, and mirrors each turn's final answer to notify channels via `/relay` (addressed by account ID or alias, never guessed on ambiguity). Secrets are one-way into the vault and never echoed back. npm: `dsh-im-union`.
description.zh: DSH 的 IM 联合桥：整合社区同类插件（xmanrui/dsh-im、MichengAI/dsh-im-connect）能力合集的独立实现——用 12 个平台的 15 个渠道适配器（含邮件；企微/钉钉/QQ 各含机器人与自建应用或推送两档）驱动宿主会话——微信（官方 iLink 扫码绑定）、飞书（长连接+流式卡片，语音档需系统 ffmpeg）、Telegram、Discord、企微智能机器人与自建应用（回调验签）、钉钉（stream+AI Card 与自定义机器人推送）、QQ 官方机器人（另含推送档）、Slack（Socket Mode）、WhatsApp（Baileys 扫码，依赖以插件包 optionalDependencies 随包分发）、Matrix、iMessage（仅 macOS）、邮件（IMAP/SMTP 线程路由）。跨版本窄腰在 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 宿主间（12 tag 枚举，rc.2 已按桌面 profile 装机双回读实证）以能力探测自适配设置面 gen1/gen2/gen3（禁版本号分支）；IM 内 25 命令面板、工具审批与交互提问原聊天闭环（默认拒绝、发起者限定、5 分钟超时）、图片/文件输入（宿主元数据判视觉）、产物文件回传、投递日志限额补发（结果不明绝不重发）、主动投递与碎片续写；原生侧栏「任务/频道」两页签自持分离（检测到该槽位已被其它插件接管则完全不插手）、im-concise 智能体预设配合出站净化把 GenUI 围栏与裸 HTML 等富结构挡在纯文字聊天之外、svg 围栏自动渲染为 PNG 图片发送、模型白名单护栏、/relay 把每回合最终回答镜像到通知渠道（按账号 ID 或别名绑定，歧义不猜）。secret 单向入凭据库，永不回显。npm 包名：`dsh-im-union`。

description.en: Reflex arc for DS Bot: runs as a sibling DSH plugin with no change to ds-bot, collects facts in cheap layers, scores them with a local decision model, and wakes a Bot only when something crosses a threshold.
description.zh: 给 DS Bot 的反射弧：作为兄弟插件运行、不改 ds-bot，用低成本层持续采集事实并在本地决策模型上打分，只有越过阈值时才唤醒 Bot 的推理层。

description.en: H.D.D skin for the DSH Web UI: a voiced full-screen boot animation, an animated eye core (idle / thinking / done) you can drag or hide, a brand swap on the new-chat hero, a time-of-day greeting, a usage bubble with balance, today spend and the peak/off-peak countdown, the Fairy-mode agent preset, and optional local GPT-SoVITS voice.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的 H.D.D 皮肤：带音效的整屏开机动画、可拖动或隐藏的动态眼徽（待机/思考/完成）、新建对话页换标、按时段问候、显示余额与今日花费并带峰谷倒计时的用量气泡、Fairy 模式预设，以及可选的本地 GPT-SoVITS 朗读。

description.en: Multi-engine text-to-image generation (OpenAI Images and Zhipu CogView presets) with per-session quota tracking, engine failover, credential-safe config, and a result card with regenerate.
description.zh: 多引擎文生图（OpenAI Images 与智谱 CogView 预设）：按会话配额、引擎故障切换、凭证安全配置，结果卡片支持重新生成。

description.en: Create editable Blender product scenes in DSH. Start from speaker, cup and lamp recipes or imported models; view saved results on the Lighttable, compare revisions, and adjust dimensions, materials, cameras and lights. Place static models on actual mesh surfaces in one saved operation, then save a complete static view while preserving existing cameras and animation. Repair repeating texture coordinates on planar custom mesh faces while preserving geometry. Preview both recesses of a timber half lap before saving. Arrays and mirrors remain editable. Render images or saved-shot videos and export an editable revision with its assets. English guides cover creation, modeling, photography, recovery and agent tools. Native geometry inspections, immutable revisions and an approval gate help preserve existing work. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 and the legacy host, with 20 tools for modeling, review and delivery.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中创建可编辑的 Blender 产品场景。从音箱、杯与灯具配方或导入模型开始，在光台查看保存结果、比较版本，调整尺寸、材质、相机与灯光。一次操作将静态模型放到实际网格表面并保存，再另存完整静态取景，保留原相机和动画。逐面修复自定义网格上的重复纹理坐标并保持几何不变。保存半搭接前可预览上下槽口，阵列和镜像参数仍可编辑。渲染图片或分镜影片，也可将一个版本连同素材导出为可编辑副本。提供创建、建模、摄影、恢复与工具契约的英文指南。原生几何检查、不可变历史和审批闸门帮助保留已有作品。适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 并保留旧宿主入口，提供 20 个建模、评审与交付工具。

description.en: Pre-boot health checks and repair for dsh plugin trees — ten static scan rules that follow the launcher runtime resolution, fault attribution after a failed boot, whitelisted reversible fixes verified in an isolated instance first, an upgrade preview naming the plugins a target release would skip, and a panel with plugin-row management plus a RAG knowledge base of past failures.
description.zh: dsh 插件树的启动前体检与修复——十条跟随启动器运行时解析的静态规则、启动失败后的故障归因、先在隔离实例复验再落地的白名单可逆修复、点名目标版本会跳过哪些插件的升级预演，以及带插件行管理面板与历次故障 RAG 知识库的设置界面。
