description.en: Synchronizes the model catalog of API-key providers from the provider itself instead of maintaining the model list by hand.
description.zh: 自动从服务商同步 API Key 提供方的模型列表，无需手动维护。

description.en: Edit a sent message to rewind and branch the conversation from that turn, switch versions with a counter under the bubble, and browse every branch in a turn-level version tree.
description.zh: 编辑已发送的消息即可从该轮次回溯并分叉对话，用气泡下方的计数器切换版本，并在轮次级版本树中浏览所有分支。

description.en: Browse, search and install skills from the public SkillHub catalogue, then enable, disable, update or remove them without leaving Harness. Category chips carry the upstream total for each category; the details drawer has tabs for the file tree, version history, permissions, third-party security-scan results and upstream metrics. An installed skill is written into the harness skill root as an ordinary local skill, and disabling one moves its directory out of that root rather than flagging it.
description.zh: 浏览、搜索并安装公开的 SkillHub 技能库,启用、停用、更新或卸载都不必离开 Harness。分类按钮带该分类的上游总数;详情抽屉提供文件树、版本历史、权限、第三方安全扫描结论与上游指标等页签。装好的技能会作为一个普通本地技能写入 harness 的技能根目录,而「停用」是把它的目录移出该根目录,不是打标记。

description.en: Deletes any DSH session from its sidebar row, in bulk, or through a settings panel — into a recoverable trash, with ghost entries pruned automatically.
description.zh: 会话删除：任意会话行上直接删、多选批量清空、从回收站还原，删和还原都立刻生效不用重启；僵尸条目自动清理.

description.en: Telegram remote for DeepSeek Harness — attach a live web session from your phone and answer its questions there, with a Russian UI. Russian fork of hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel (MIT).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 遥控器：在手机上接续正在运行的 Web 会话并回答问题，界面为俄语。hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel 的俄语分支（MIT）。

description.en: Runtime diagnostics for DSH plugins: live, restart, or hot reload.
description.zh: DSH 插件运行时诊断：区分实时生效、重启和热重载。

description.en: Chinese government document processing toolkit: GB/T 9704 format check, auto-fix, content revision (red annotation + strikethrough), template generation, Markdown-to-docx, and document header/footer/page-number injection for 24 official document types.
description.zh: 中文公文全流程处理工具：GB/T 9704 格式检查、自动修复、内容修订（红色标注+删除线）、模板生成、Markdown 转公文、版头/版记/页码注入，覆盖通知/请示/报告/函/会议纪要等 24 类公文。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.
description.zh: 更安静的 DeepSeek Harness 阅读视图：原生过程细节、实时推理，以及干净的最终回答。

description.en: Not another memory plugin: ODR is an evolving-worlds self-improvement loop (Dream-RSI) — attempts are recorded into a Discovery Tree, and between runs thousands of strategy variants are replayed against that recorded world; a strategy, recipe or lesson is promoted only after surviving counterfactual replay, never on the model's word alone, and Sentinel gates tool calls before the budget burns; the LLM stays frozen, installable from npm as dsh-open-dream-rsi.
description.zh: 不是又一个记忆插件：ODR 是“演化世界”式（Dream-RSI）自我改进回路——每次尝试都记入发现树（Discovery Tree），任务间歇将数千个策略变体在这棵记录下来的世界上回放；策略、配方或经验只有通过反事实回放的考验才会晋升，绝不因模型自己说好就获得信任，Sentinel 还会在预算耗尽前拦截工具调用；LLM 保持冻结，可从 npm 安装 dsh-open-dream-rsi。

description.en: Control your DSH from your phone: opens a port on the mesh/VPN interface from inside the running process, so a phone browser gets the very same instance and session list — no SSH, no second dsh. Also works from another PC, a GUI NAS, or a TV box.
description.zh: 用手机远程控制电脑上的 DSH：在服务进程内部把端口开到组网网卡上，手机浏览器打开就是你在电脑上用的那个界面，同一实例、同一份会话，不用 SSH、不用第二个 dsh。顺带笔记本、NAS、电视盒子也能开。

description.en: Host-side plugin that links the Cindy mobile app to DSH: phone channels for sessions, messages, approvals, todos and goals, plus a settings card.
description.zh: Host 侧插件：将 Cindy 手机客户端接入 DSH，提供会话、消息、审批、todo、goal 的手机通道，以及配套的设置卡片。

description.en: Exposes any local service on a LAN address and a public cloudflared quick-tunnel domain behind one password login, with per-route open/block gates managed from the plugin settings page. Requires Python 3 and cloudflared on the machine, and reports either of them being missing or misconfigured in the settings page before you start; LAN and local access are passwordless by default, while the public tunnel requires the passcode.
description.zh: 把一个口令登录的内网地址与公网 cloudflared 快速隧道域名提供给本机任意服务，每条路由的开放/屏蔽闸门在插件设置页里管理。需本机有 Python 3 与 cloudflared，缺失或路径填错会在启动前的设置页里提示；内网与本机访问默认免密，公网隧道需要口令。

description.en: TinyFish-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: each search is one GET to the TinyFish Search API, no model call.
description.zh: 基于 TinyFish 的网页搜索提供方：把内置 web_search 接到 TinyFish Search API，每次搜索一次 GET，不消耗模型调用。

description.en: Self-hosted DSH Web operations panel for safe restart and upgrade, health diagnostics, model-usage statistics and provider quota lookup, backup and session management, task notifications, skill controls, subagent model routing, and Linux permission maintenance.
description.zh: 面向自托管 DSH Web 的运维面板：安全重启与升级、健康诊断、模型用量统计与供应商额度查询、备份和会话管理、任务通知、技能控制、子代理模型路由与 Linux 权限维护。

description.en: An Everforest colour theme for DeepSeek Harness, for both web and desktop. Forest tones, with six dark and light palettes. Chat content (headings, code, links, tables and more) is restyled with independent colours, and every tone and saturation level is tuned individually for a warm, gentle, easy-on-the-eyes experience.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Everforest 配色主题，同时支持网页和桌面端。以森林为色调，深色与浅色共 6 档配色。对聊天内容（标题、代码、链接、表格等）样式优化，独立着色，所有色调及饱和度都已逐一调校，提供温暖柔和的护眼体验。

description.en: Automatically add emojis to AI replies.
description.zh: 为 AI 回复自动添加表情。

description.en: Use the dsh web UI on your dev machine from an Android or iOS phone, connected peer-to-peer across networks via iroh; no server to set up, with a relay fallback that only carries ciphertext.
description.zh: 用 Android/iOS 手机远程使用电脑上的 dsh 完整网页界面,经 iroh 跨网点对点打洞直连,不用架任何服务器;打不通才退回 relay,relay 只见密文。

description.en: AI image and video studio as a floating DSH panel, so creation runs alongside the conversation instead of replacing it: text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition at 1K-4K across eight aspect ratios; text-to-video and image-to-video with first-frame control at 4-12 seconds; short-drama mode that imports a script (.txt/.md/.json), breaks it into storyboard shots for preview and batch generation; and a prompt-expert workspace. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 一站式 AI 影视创作工作站，作为 DSH 全局浮层面板运行，不占用对话框：生图（文生图 / 图生图 / 多图合成，1K–4K、8 种宽高比）、生视频（文生视频 / 图生视频，4–12 秒、支持首帧控制）、短剧（导入 .txt/.md/.json 剧本自动拆解分镜，故事板预览与批量生成）与提示词专家工作区。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Local video understanding for agents: extracts keyframes adaptively based on motion and pauses, inspects any timestamp at full resolution, and aligns visuals with dialogue from embedded subtitles or configured ASR. Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe; clips without subtitles also need a transcription engine for dialogue (a ~190 MB local whisper model, a cloud API key, or the official voice-input model).
description.zh: 让智能体看懂本地视频：根据画面运动与停顿自适应抽取关键帧，支持任意时间点全分辨率定点检视；自动从内嵌字幕或配置的语音转写（ASR）中提取台词并与画面时间轴对齐。需预装 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe；无字幕视频要台词另需转写引擎（约 190 MB 本地 whisper 模型、云端 API Key 或官方语音输入模型）。

description.en: A session auto-compaction plugin that is friendly to local models: the trigger point is configurable, compaction does not make the local engine re-read the whole history, and the model writes a structured handoff summary from the prefix that is already cached. Trigger ratio, summary template, display style and per-preset scope are configurable. Installing and restarting DSH takes over; uninstalling restores native DSH compaction.
description.zh: 对本地模型友好的会话自动压缩插件：可自定义压缩触发点，不会使本地引擎重读全部历史，并让模型基于已缓存的前缀撰写结构化交接摘要，触发比例、摘要模板、显示样式与逐预设生效范围均可配置。安装重启 DSH 后接管；卸载即恢复DSH原生压缩。

description.en: Archive, restore, permanently delete, and move DeepSeek Harness sessions across workspaces from one unified settings panel.
description.zh: 在统一设置面板中归档、恢复、彻底删除并跨工作区移动 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

description.en: Set the DSH Harness conversation flow's font, font size and line spacing, plus the padding between the conversation text and the window edges.
description.zh: 设置DSH Harness对话流字体、字号行间距，以及对话文字到窗口边缘的留白。

description.en: Local-only project memory with zero bundled runtime dependencies or external services: JSON as the source of truth plus generated PROJECT_MEMORY.md, token-bounded session-frozen Hot Memory for prompt-prefix cache stability, cached cross-project BM25 recall, trusted session/turn provenance, explainable pre-write duplicate/conflict governance, editable importance/pin/tags/supersede/archive lifecycle, configurable top-level turn-end distillation, and a bilingual Web GUI for search, inspection, diagnostics, and live settings.
description.zh: 仅本地运行、零捆绑运行时依赖（仅使用 DSH 宿主 peer）且不调用外部服务的项目记忆：以 JSON 为单一事实源并自动生成 PROJECT_MEMORY.md、按 token 有界且按会话冻结的 Hot Memory 以保持 prompt-prefix cache 稳定、带查询缓存的跨项目 BM25 召回、可信 session/turn 溯源、可解释的写前重复/冲突治理、可编辑的重要度/置顶/标签/supersede/归档生命周期、可配置的顶层回合自动蒸馏，以及支持搜索、检查、诊断和实时设置的中英双语 Web GUI。

description.en: Keeps a pool of models and routes every agent step to one of them with its reasoning effort set — configured by clicking in the composer, no JSON needed. The router takes over the composer's model cell, so one control shows the session's model and reasoning effort alongside the router's own settings. Three authorization scopes (model / effort / full) where a manual pick only counts in the scope that owns it, and in effort scope the router is bound to the one model you choose. Task presets with per-model weights, vision routing for image steps, session signals (active todo, context pressure, token budget, subagent depth), and an optional semantic task classifier. Thinking stays on, because DeepSeek rejects a thinking-enabled request whose history contains a tool call made with thinking off.
description.zh: 维护一个模型池，把每个 agent 步骤路由到池内模型并设置其思考等级——全部在输入栏点选配置，不需要写 JSON。路由面板接管输入栏的模型位置，同一个控件里既有本会话的模型与思考等级，也有路由自身的设置。三种授权范围（模型 / 思考 / 全部）：手动选择只在所属范围内生效；「思考」范围下路由只作用于你选定的那一个模型。另有按任务类型给模型加权的预设、带图任务的视觉分流、会话信号（当前 todo / 上下文压力 / token 预算 / 子 agent 深度），以及可选的语义任务分类。思考等级保持常开，因为 DeepSeek 会拒绝思考关闭时产生的工具调用。

description.en: Point-and-shoot screenshot capture: a system floating window turns a new screenshot (or copied image) into an Obsidian note with comments and key-point marking, instant OCR through the host DSH multimodal model (no extra API key needed, Tongyi Qianwen as fallback), a duplicate-screen guard, per-day merging, and an optional evening AI organization pass.
description.zh: 指哪拍哪截图入库：系统级悬浮窗把新截图（或复制图片）一键存入 Obsidian 笔记，支持注释与「重点」标记、用宿主 DSH 多模态模型即时识别文字（零配置、无需另配 key，可回落通义千问）、同屏去重、按天合并，并可在晚间用 AI 整理归类、打双链并生成当日总结。

description.en: Adds the official Google Antigravity ACP agent as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, with tool execution and approval kept in DSH, Node 22.19+ and a signed-in Antigravity account required, a per-model quota pill and a settings page.
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity ACP agent 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供商，工具执行与审批仍由 DSH 负责，附按模型切换的额度药丸和设置页；需 Node 22.19+ 并登录 Antigravity 账号。

description.en: Downloads a Bilibili video with yt-dlp, samples key frames, and transcribes it — from the site subtitles, or from a local faster-whisper install when there are none. Registers the skill the agent uses to write the summary; activates when a user message contains only a video link. Requires yt-dlp and ffmpeg on PATH; transcription needs faster-whisper.
description.zh: 用 yt-dlp 下载 B 站视频、抽帧并转写：优先用站方字幕，没有字幕时调用本机 faster-whisper。注册写总结所需的技能，当用户消息只有一条视频链接时自动启用。需 PATH 上有 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg，转写另需 faster-whisper。

description.en: Open a Mac or Windows DeepSeek Harness Web instance from iPhone or iPad Safari: 8-digit pairing, a LAN gateway for loopback-only hosts, optional Tailscale Serve, and iOS-only Safari input and touch fixes. Installs with dsh plugin add.
description.zh: 用 iPhone 或 iPad 的 Safari 打开 Mac 或 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness Web：8 位配对码、回环监听的局域网网关、可选 Tailscale Serve，以及仅 iOS 生效的 Safari 输入与触摸补丁。可用 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: Codex-style dark interface for DSH on Windows, with navigation, project and conversation sidebars, and model and reasoning controls.
description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供 Codex 风格深色界面，包含导航、项目与会话侧栏、模型和思考强度控件。

description.en: Snapshot-bound multi-agent Git review with independent verification, majority voting, resolution tracking and an AI review gate.
description.zh: 绑定代码快照的多智能体 Git 审阅，支持独立复核、多数投票、问题处置追踪和 AI 审阅门禁。

description.en: Code graph from tree-sitter: codegraph finds declarations, callers, callees, impact and call paths; codegraph_index builds the index, 18 languages.
description.zh: tree-sitter 代码图谱：codegraph 查声明、调用者、被调用关系、变更影响与调用路径，codegraph_index 建索引，覆盖 18 种语言。

description.en: Branch and worktree management for DeepSeek Harness: the workspace toolbar shows the current branch with in-place switching, plus an IDEA-style branch selector, remote branch checkout, context menus (create, rename, delete, copy), push and update, and branch isolation into standalone worktrees with managed creation and deletion.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 git 分支与 worktree 管理：工作区工具栏显示当前分支并可原地切换；支持 IDEA 风格分支选择器、远程分支检出、右键操作菜单（新建/重命名/删除/复制）、推送与更新当前分支，以及把分支隔离到独立 worktree 工作区并管理其创建与删除。

description.en: Chat-driven image-deck workbench for DSH: intent to storyboard script, per-page prompts and AI image generation with page-level revisions, nine design-style presets, and PDF/PPTX export (one full-page image per slide).
description.zh: DSH 的 image deck 工作台：从意图到故事线脚本、逐页 prompt 与 AI 出图、按页版本留存、9 套预设设计风格，导出 PDF/PPTX（每页一张整页图）。

description.en: Turns the iterate skill into an autonomous closed-loop harness — plan, parallel review, atomic fixes, validate, loop, auto-stop — plus a dry-run review-only mode and a meta-review that audits the report and emits a final review report.
description.zh: 把 iterate 技能跑成自主闭环：规划、并行审查、原子修复、验证、循环、自动停止，并支持纯评审的 dry-run 模式与元评审最终报告。

description.en: Output gallery in the DSH sidebar, built to fix DSH reporting produced files only after a task ends: it watches your on-disk output folders and shows files as they appear, so you can verify and intervene mid-task instead of after. Auto-refreshing image thumbnails with zoom and pan, documents, code, data, archives and links that open in DSH native preview, per-conversation filtering, and multi-folder support for sessions whose cwd is outside the default output folder. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 把 DSH 右侧栏变成产出目录的实时画廊，专门解决 DSH「只在任务结束时才列出产出文件、过程不可见」的问题：直接盯磁盘产出目录，文件一生成就能看到，方便在任务进行中校验与纠正。图片缩略图自动刷新、支持缩放拖动；文档、代码、数据、压缩包与链接点击即调用 DSH 原生侧栏预览；支持按「本对话产出」筛选；支持多扫描目录，兼容工作目录不在默认产出目录下的会话。零依赖。

description.en: Per-model reasoning-effort and input-modality configuration for third-party providers: suggestions fused from a model knowledge base and raw /models endpoint evidence with confidence labels, edited inside the official Models page card.
description.zh: 为第三方供应商模型按模型配置思考强度与输入模态：知识库与原始 /models 端点取证融合建议并标注置信度，在官方「模型」页卡片内直接编辑。

description.en: Docker container panel for the DSH Web GUI: containers (optionally including stopped), docker inspect details, logs, stats snapshots, image list and one-shot exec on the local machine or SSH hosts — read-only by default (mutations and exec are permission-gated), with a per-container terminal drawer embedded via the tty plugin.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Docker 容器面板：本机或 SSH 主机上的容器列表（可选含已停止）、docker inspect 详情、日志、stats 快照、镜像列表与一次性 exec——默认只读（启停删与 exec 均需显式开启权限），可经 tty 插件在面板底部就地打开容器终端。

description.en: Local-first, file-native long-term memory for DSH with per-turn preflight, compact context injection, citations, human-approved writes, manual consolidation, nightly report-only maintenance, and a Web panel that is read-only for knowledge while allowing workspace-config edits.
description.zh: 本地优先、文件原生的 DSH 长期记忆，提供每回合预检、紧凑上下文注入、引用、人工批准写入、手动汇总、夜间只读维护，以及一个知识视图只读、可编辑工作区配置的 Web 面板。

description.en: Windows desktop control through UI Automation, window screenshots and mouse/keyboard input, with per-session app consent and action approvals.
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation、窗口截图和鼠标键盘操作 Windows 桌面软件，支持会话独立应用授权和操作审批。

description.en: Moves an existing DSH session to another agent preset through a previewable five-section handoff, preserving the source session and either pausing the target for confirmation or continuing immediately.
description.zh: 通过可预览的五段式交接，将已有 DSH 会话迁移到另一个 Agent Preset；保留源会话，并可让目标会话暂停等待确认或立即继续。

description.en: Replaces the Windows pwsh executor row so the model-facing pwsh tool runs PowerShell 7, with a shell_router tool for status, diagnosis, and per-user portable installation.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上替换 pwsh 执行器行，让模型侧 pwsh 工具运行 PowerShell 7，并提供 shell_router 工具做状态、诊断与用户级便携安装。

description.en: Risk-gated approval automation for DeepSeek Harness: flash pre-classifies whether a write/command is irreversible — safe operations are auto-approved, dangerous ones are escalated to human approval (fail-safe). File-diff review with one-click revert and session-scoped snapshots (v0.5.1: precise snapshots via tool-call parameter tracing, incl. human-approval cases).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 预判写入/命令是否不可回补，安全操作自动批准、危险操作转人工（fail-safe）。另含文件改动对比（unified diff）与一键撤销、按会话隔离的快照管理（v0.5.1：通过工具调用参数回溯精确保存快照，覆盖人工审批场景）。

description.en: Conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness: the Markdown headings of the whole session, grouped by turn, in a side panel or a full-width curtain; hover previews can be pinned for comparison, bookmarks keep the places you come back to, and a right-click jumps to a section or copies a heading and the levels below it. Six theme colours and a translucent material, title/prompt/full-text/cross-session search, reading-position follow and a Chinese/English interface.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话大纲：按回合整理整段会话的 Markdown 标题，侧边面板与全屏「幕布」两种视图；悬停预览可钉住对照，书签留住常回看的几处，右键即可跳转到某一节或复制标题及其下面所有层级。支持六种主题色与半透明材质、标题/提问/全文/跨会话搜索、阅读位置跟随与中英双语界面。

description.en: Connects a Doubao account to DeepSeek Harness as a model provider after a single browser QR sign-in — live model discovery from Doubao web and desktop menus with inline composer billing multipliers and per-model thinking ladders, 「工作任务」 task-mode models spending paid quota, chain-of-thought reasoning streaming, Seedream image generation preferring original uncropped assets over watermarked variants, native DSH token usage and session stats tracking, and a live remaining-quota panel. Windows x64 only, since the session is sealed with DPAPI. Windows x64 only, since the session is sealed with DPAPI.
description.zh: 浏览器扫码登录一次即可把豆包账号接入 DeepSeek Harness：实时读取豆包菜单与在线清单、在对话框模型选择器直接显示计费倍率并可对比、支持思考链（CoT）推理透传与逐模型思考档位、「工作任务」模型（走会员付费额度）、Seedream 生图（优先取无水印原图）、完整接入 DSH 原生 Token 用量与会话统计（含 TTFT、速率与上下文缓存），外加实时剩余额度看板。仅 Windows x64：会话用 DPAPI 密封在本机。仅限 Windows x64，因为会话用 DPAPI 封存。

description.en: Adds an animated DeepSeek Chan reasoning-effort slider to DSH's native model selector, following model-declared levels with a running animation that speeds up while dragging.
description.zh: 为 DSH 原生模型选择器加入大肥鱼思考强度滑块，按模型声明的档位调节推理强度，拖动时奔跑动画随之加速。

description.en: Local-first memory nebula for DeepSeek Harness with graph views, evidence chains, hygiene checks, and offline snapshots. Reads the memory stores of every workspace and of other memory plugins (read-only, for example meow-memory's SQLite) and writes only under $DSH_HOME/memory-nebula. Registers 9 agent tools and a system-prompt section (usage rules every turn, plus not-yet-read neighbouring memories after a few reads); its /export and /share endpoints return the full memory text without authentication on the local server, and an optional standalone engine listens on 127.0.0.1:7890.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先记忆星图，提供图形视图、证据链、记忆体检与离线快照。只读地读取各工作区以及其他记忆插件（如 meow-memory 的 SQLite）的记忆库，只写入 $DSH_HOME/memory-nebula。会注册 9 个 agent 工具和一段系统提示（每轮带用法规则，读过几条记忆后再补充尚未读过的邻近记忆）；/export 与 /share 接口在本地服务上无需认证即返回完整记忆原文；可选的独立引擎监听 127.0.0.1:7890。

description.en: Skill Center panel for the current session: lists the visible skills with their provider and source root, renders each SKILL.md, toggles model and user invocation, and creates or soft-deletes skills; ships a skill-authoring skill and the skill_create tool.
description.zh: 当前会话的技能中心面板：列出可见技能及其提供方与来源根目录，阅读 SKILL.md，开关模型/用户调用，并可创建、软删除技能；随包附带 skill-authoring 技能与 skill_create 工具。

description.en: Manage Codex subscription (ChatGPT OAuth) authorization from the DSH settings panel, so Codex GPT models work without an API key.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中管理 Codex 订阅（ChatGPT OAuth）授权，无需 API key 即可使用 Codex 内的 GPT 模型。

description.en: Computer Use for every DSH session: screen capture, mouse and keyboard, app launch, plan and skill replay, an audit log, guards for dangerous actions, a background code agent, and an OCR workflow (text and coordinates) for apps whose accessibility tree is empty. Verified on macOS only: Windows has a basic GUI backend that is unverified, Linux has no desktop backend (calls fail with unsupported_platform), and the window/AX/browser/clipboard tools register on macOS only.
description.zh: 装一次、所有 DSH 会话可用的 Computer Use 插件：截屏、鼠标键盘、启动应用、计划与技能回放、审计日志、危险动作守卫、后台代码代理，以及面向无障碍树缺失应用的 OCR 工作流（文字与坐标）。仅 macOS 已验证：Windows 只有未验证的基础 GUI 后端，Linux 没有桌面后端（调用报 unsupported_platform），窗口/AX/浏览器/剪贴板工具只在 macOS 注册。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle: eleven specialist roles usable as one-shot consults or as team members, a team plane with a plan, a shared board and a dependency graph, a durable workmate library, a memory engine, and a verification plane that refuses a PASS unless a different agent records the verdict against gate evidence. Installs as one package with a dsh.bundle patch; also ships a native dshGo panel interface and a conformance gate pinned to a dsh-Go protocol v1 spec commit (d5ad25c).
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件包：十一个专家角色，可作单次咨询或团队成员；团队平面带计划、共享看板与依赖图；另有可长期积累的 Workmate 库、记忆引擎，以及一个验证平面——除非由另一个 agent 带上 gate 证据记录裁决，否则拒绝 PASS。以单个包加 dsh.bundle 补丁安装，同时提供原生 dshGo 面板接口与钉在 dsh-Go 协议 v1 规范提交 d5ad25c 的一致性检查。

description.en: Distill over-long model reasoning into its useful core, replay the compressed version on every later request, and report each session's cost and savings. Disabled by default: select one rewrite backend first. derive needs no install and works on packaged DSH; in-place needs 14 source patches and a rebuild (recommended for source checkouts); message-edit needs a third-party plugin and is experimental only.
description.zh: 把过长的模型思考压缩成有用核心，之后每次请求重放压缩版，并给出每个会话的开销与节省报告。默认关闭：必须先选择一个改写后端。derive 无需安装、打包版也能用；in-place 需给 DSH 源码打 14 处补丁并重建（源码构建首选）；message-edit 需装第三方插件，仅实验性，不推荐。

description.en: Per-plugin usage budgets and cost caps on the llm/stream waterfall: per-model usage accounting, session and monthly budgets with warn/block transitions, latency windows, and a carbon-footprint estimate.
description.zh: 在 llm/stream 瀑布上做按插件粒度的用量预算与费用上限：按模型用量记账、会话与月度预算的预警/阻断、延迟窗口与碳足迹估算。

description.en: Native agent control for the DSH right-sidebar browser: semantic snapshot with stable refs, clicks/typing/key presses, shadow DOM and same-origin iframes, recorded JS dialogs, full-page screenshots, back/forward, viewport resizing, and native large-file download/upload through the Electron webview. Page control needs DSH Desktop (Electron webview); in the Web build only tab management works.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏原生浏览器的 Agent 控制：语义快照与稳定 ref、点击/输入/按键、Shadow DOM 与同源 iframe、JS 对话框记录、整页截图、前进/后退、视口尺寸调整，以及基于 Electron webview 的原生大文件下载/上传。页面内容操作需 DSH Desktop（Electron 原生 webview）；Web 版只能管理标签页。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration layer for DeepSeek Harness — autopilot/ralph/team execution modes, 19 role cards, 40 bilingual skills, and a bundled MCP state server, ported from oh-my-claudecode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体编排层——autopilot/ralph/team 三种执行模式、19 张角色卡、40 个双语技能与内置 MCP 状态服务，移植自 oh-my-claudecode。

description.en: LocalAI provider for language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation with LocalAI-specific controls in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入、重排序、语音和图像生成能力及 LocalAI 专用控制项的 LocalAI 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Registers the RainSkills bootstrap skill in DeepSeek Harness for deploying, troubleshooting, and verifying applications on Rainbond.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 RainSkills 引导技能，用于通过 Rainbond 部署、排障和验证应用。

description.en: Native SSH remote development for DSH: remote workspaces, mirrored sessions, terminal and file access, approvals, and a DSH UI. Requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 and a remote host running Linux or macOS.
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机上的工作区接入 DSH：远程工作区、镜像会话、终端与文件访问、审批和原生 DSH 界面。需 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2，远端主机为 Linux 或 macOS。

description.en: Ships a set of /logi commands for project housekeeping: dispatches security, logic-correctness, maintainability, reliability and performance experts to inspect the whole project, then produces one consolidated improvement report.
description.zh: 提供一组 /logi 命令来做项目收尾工作，为你的项目派发「安全/逻辑正确/可维护/健壮/性能」5 位专家深入检查你的项目，并出一份优化总报告。

description.en: Local SQLite long-term memory with CJK-aware search, BM25 and character n-gram cosine reranking, deduplication, and lifecycle management.
description.zh: 基于本地 SQLite 的长期记忆，支持 CJK 分词检索、BM25 与字符 n-gram 余弦重排、去重和生命周期管理。

description.en: An AI routing gateway that runs as a DSH plugin. Adds a Routing System sidebar panel for suppliers, account pool, fallback combos and API keys, and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at http://localhost:3080/v1.
description.zh: 以 DSH 插件形式运行的 AI 路由网关。侧边栏新增「路由系统」面板管理供应商、账号池、回退组合与 API 密钥，并在 http://localhost:3080/v1 提供 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: DeepSeek App-style mobile shell for the DSH Web UI with drawer navigation, app-like composer and settings; best paired with the dsh-android app, which supplies the native Android back key (standalone use works but is not recommended).
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供接近 DeepSeek App 的移动端壳层：抽屉导航、App 风格输入与设置；Android 返回键需搭配 dsh-android App（单独安装也能用，但作者不建议且可能有 bug）。

description.en: Tag-based skill filtering: attach tags to DSH skills, then hand each workspace or conversation only the subset its boolean tag expression selects (for example `pdf + docx` or `aegis * plugin`). Excluded skills are deny-shadowed out of the model catalog rather than merely hidden in the settings UI; skills outside the expression can still be added by hand or force-disabled, and the bundled `tagging-skills` teaches the agent to derive a tag set from the machine it is running on.
description.zh: 按标签筛选技能：给 DSH 技能打标签，再用布尔表达式为每个工作区或对话选出下发给模型的子集（例如 `pdf + docx` 或 `aegis * plugin`）。命中以外的技能会被 deny-shadow 真正从模型目录里移走，而不只是在设置页隐藏；表达式之外的技能可手动添加或强制禁用，另附带 `tagging-skills` 教 agent 从本机技能清单自建标签体系。

description.en: Deterministic research reports for Chinese public mutual funds built from public-source data (Tiantian Fund and Eastmoney), pure-function metrics (performance decomposition, holdings penetration, style attribution, manager profile), and versioned reports with a per-number snapshot traceability appendix.
description.zh: 中国公募基金确定性研究报告：采集天天基金/东方财富公开数据，纯函数计算业绩拆解、持仓穿透、风格归因与经理画像，输出带逐数字可溯源快照附录的版本化报告。

description.en: Cross-session TODO board as a draggable floating panel: tasks are grouped by working directory and reorderable by drag, each one carries a run mode (remind only, continue in the current session, or open a new session in the same directory), up to four attached images sent to the model as real image attachments, and an optional local time it may run at; two checkboxes track AI-done and user-verified, and the agent picks up the next unfinished task in that directory when it finishes one.
description.zh: 跨会话 TODO 板：可拖动浮窗按工作目录分组、拖拽排序，每条待办带一个执行模式（仅提醒 / 在当前会话续跑 / 在同目录新开会话）、可附最多 4 张图片（派发时作为真正的图片附件发给模型）、以及一个可选的定时执行时间；两个勾选框分别记录 AI 已完成与用户已验收，AI 完成一项后自动接续该目录下一条未完成待办。

description.en: AI animated themes, computer control, standalone windows, attachment previews, Git management, session pop-outs and annotations, cross-app file drag-and-drop, and AI prompt suggestions. Computer control is enabled from the settings; on macOS it needs Screen Recording, Accessibility and Input Monitoring permission, Windows standalone windows need the Edge WebView2 runtime, and prompt suggestions and AI themes consume extra model usage.
description.zh: AI 智能动效主题、电脑操控、独立窗口、附件预览、Git 管理、会话分窗与批注、跨应用文件拖拽、AI 提示词。电脑操控需在设置里开启；macOS 上需授予屏幕录制、辅助功能与输入监控权限，Windows 独立窗口需 Edge WebView2 运行时；提示词建议与 AI 主题会额外消耗模型用量。

description.en: Component checklist for the shared Semi Design package used by tnnevol DSH plugins, opened from a `Semi UI` button in a conversation header: 35 components plus a multi-account case page, organised into seven sidebar groups from inputs, forms, selectors and trees to tables, cards, overlays and feedback, each rendered live with a one-line description and a page outline, with light, dark and follow-system preview. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-semi-ui-showcase`.
description.zh: tnnevol 系列 DSH 插件共用的 Semi Design 组件检查页，从会话头部的 `Semi UI` 按钮进入：35 个组件加一个多账号案例页，按七个侧边分组组织，涵盖输入、表单、选择器、树、表格、卡片、浮层与反馈，逐个实渲并配一句话说明与页内目录，可切换浅色、深色与跟随系统预览。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-semi-ui-showcase`。

description.en: Browse the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog from a dedicated page opened through the DSH left sidebar. Search, filter by category or installed state, and sort by stars, downloads, name or date added. Three tabs show all, installed and updatable plugins, with a separate count when update status cannot be determined. Install into the active Web or Desktop profile using the package manager supplied by DSH, while preserving disabled bundles. Reload the profile through HMR when available, with restart guidance otherwise. Installed state is isolated per profile, installation and reload requests are mutually exclusive, and pagination keeps the submitted search. Expired catalog and installed-state snapshots are served immediately while refreshing in the background. Unversioned npm installs resolve the official registry latest tag to an exact version, and confirm the installed version before reporting success. Registry updates install the exact catalog version; Git updates force source resolution. The catalog is cached locally for one hour, with mirror, CDN and npm fallbacks.
description.zh: 从 DSH 左侧栏打开独立的插件市场页面，浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin 目录。支持按分类或安装状态筛选、按名称或简介搜索，以及按 Star、下载量、名称或收录时间排序；三个标签分别显示全部插件、已安装插件和可更新插件，并单独提示无法判断更新状态的数量。自动识别当前 Web 或桌面 profile，使用 DSH 提供的包管理器一键安装和更新，保留其他插件的停用状态。支持通过 HMR 重载 profile，不可用时提示重启。各 profile 的安装状态独立，安装与重载互斥，分页保持已提交的搜索条件。目录与安装状态快照过期时先显示本地内容并在后台刷新。未指定版本的 npm 安装先解析官方 registry 的 latest，再按确切版本安装并核验落盘版本。npm 插件按目录目标版本精确更新，Git 插件强制重新解析来源。目录在本地缓存一小时，官方源不可达时依次回退到镜像、CDN 与 npm。

description.en: In-page task notifications with collapsible status toasts, sound, and session navigation.
description.zh: 带可折叠状态通知、提示音与会话跳转的页内任务通知插件。

description.en: Session-bound persistent TypeScript REPL for DSH PTC mode: bindings and imports stay live across run_code calls, edit_run_code replaces one line without resending the block, module import/export syntax is adapted via AST rewriting, and durable bindings are restored from the session journal after a cold restart.
description.zh: 把 DSH PTC 模式的顶层 run_code 变成会话绑定的持久 TypeScript REPL：变量与导入在多次 run_code 调用间保持可用，edit_run_code 只替换一行而无需重发整段，import/export 模块语法经 AST 改写适配，持久绑定在冷重启后由会话日志恢复。

description.en: Adds a resident system-prompt rule asking the assistant to report every file it produces as a full absolute path (a soft rule, not enforced), and replaces the official context menu on a file link with eight actions: open in the sidebar, open in a floating window, open with the default app, reveal in Explorer, save a copy elsewhere, copy the file, copy its path, and add it to the chat box, so a result reaches a friend in one click (copy-file and save-as are Windows only). Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 常驻系统提示词规则，要求助手为每个产物给出完整绝对路径（软约束，不保证），并把文件链接上的官方右键菜单替换成八项：在侧边栏打开、在悬浮窗打开、用默认程序打开、在资源管理器中定位、另存为到指定位置、复制文件、复制文件路径、添加到对话框，产物一键分享给好友（复制文件与另存为仅 Windows）。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Daily RSS/Atom news digest for DSH: built-in channels plus a curated awesome-rsshub-routes catalog and custom feeds (validated on save), aggregated into one "今日值得读" Markdown digest each day and injected into the system prompt; Web GUI settings card and sidebar reader.
description.zh: DSH 的 RSS/新闻聚合插件：内置渠道库 + awesome-rsshub-routes 精选订阅源目录 + 自定义源（保存时真实抓取校验），每天自动汇总成「今日值得读」Markdown 并注入 systemPrompt；带 Web 设置卡片与侧边栏阅读弹窗。

description.en: Data quality checking for DeepSeek Harness — profiling, cleaning, and verification pipelines with structured reports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据质量检查：数据画像、清洗与验证流水线，产出结构化报告。

description.en: Goal mode and autonomous execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a sticky top banner keeps the current goal visible across turns while the agent works toward it autonomously.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的目标模式与自主执行插件：顶部吸附横幅在每轮对话中保持当前目标可见，同时 Agent 自主推进完成目标。

description.en: Registers Qoder CN and international language models into DSH, fetching each model's rate automatically as it shifts with off-peak hours. It also provides a daily check-in, a usage pill and a credit lookup. Needs the Qoder login state on this machine, or one browser login.
description.zh: 注册 Qoder 中国版与国际版的语言模型到 DSH，自动获取每个模型的费率，随错峰时段变化。并提供每天签到、用量胶囊与积分查询功能。需要本机Qoder的登录态，或浏览器登录一次。

description.en: Turns large text pastes into pastes/*.txt attachments with a dock above the composer and a minimal, recognisable badge in the draft.
description.zh: 大段文本粘贴自动存为 pastes/*.txt 附件,输入框上方 dock 卡片管理,草稿内只留可辨识的最小徽标。

description.en: Motor-design AI assistant plugin: requirement parsing → parameter identification → candidate matrix → Top10 verification. L0 is a millisecond-level broad filter (pure JS, zero solver dependency) that ranks candidates and emits the handoff payload for the L1/L2 precision tools; usable as a local agent preset and Cordis plugin. L1 (RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) are reserved in this version — the level gate fails fast above l0.
description.zh: 电机 AI 辅助设计插件：需求解析 → 参数识别 → 候选矩阵 → Top10 校验。L0 纯 JS、零求解器依赖，毫秒级广筛候选并给出交给 L1/L2 精算工具的载荷；可作为本地 agent 预设与 Cordis 插件使用。L1（RMxprt）与 L2（Motor-CAD）在本版本中仅预留接口，层级总闸设为 l0 以上会立即报错。

description.en: MCP server configuration card for the DSH Web GUI: add / edit / enable / disable MCP servers over stdio (local subprocess) or streamable-http (remote), with js: prefixed expressions for env / header values, status badges, and hot-reload on save.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器配置卡片：增删改查与启用/停用 MCP 服务器（stdio 本地子进程 / streamable-http 远程两种传输），env / headers 值支持 js: 前缀表达式，带状态徽标，保存即热生效。

description.en: Route OpenRouter requests through a configured provider list and quantization cap, injected as provider.only/order with allow_fallbacks, plus provider.quantizations.
description.zh: 配置 OpenRouter 请求使用的提供商列表与量化位数上限，注入 provider.only/order（allow_fallbacks）与 provider.quantizations 路由参数。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 15 obra/superpowers engineering skills, bilingual descriptions, per-skill toggles.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：15 个 obra/superpowers 工程纪律技能，技能描述中英双语自由切换，每一个技能本身自由开关。

description.en: Fast-execution runtime for dsh: context governance with 4 KB tool-result caps and field projection, zero-LLM fast-path templates with idempotency keys, PTC container scripts that keep intermediate results out of context, a three-tier sandbox with file/command/network rules, injection detection, secret redaction, snapshots with a recycle bin, and append-only audit logs; 10 runtime_kit_* slash commands, no business dependencies.
description.zh: 面向 dsh 的快速执行运行时：上下文治理（4 KB 工具返回截断与字段投影）、零 LLM 快路径模板（幂等键）、PTC 容器脚本（中间结果不进上下文）、三级沙箱（文件/命令/网络规则、注入检测、敏感信息脱敏、快照与回收站）与追加式审计日志；10 个 runtime_kit_* 斜杠命令，零业务依赖。

description.en: Cost tracking priced from an online catalogue (models.dev + OpenRouter, 8000+ models, each call priced at its own instant): a per-turn cost line, a Cost tab attributing spend to tool output / model output / system prompt / commands, budget, monthly forecast, ~166 live-rate currencies, and a bill_stats agent tool.
description.zh: 按在线价格目录计价的费用统计（models.dev + OpenRouter，8000+ 模型，每次调用按自身时刻定价）：每轮成本行、把花费归因到工具输出 / 模型输出 / 系统提示词 / 终端命令的「费用」标签页、预算、月度预测、约 166 种实时汇率货币，以及 bill_stats agent 工具。

description.en: Session Manager for DSH (formerly Session Steward): one console over active and archived sessions — grouped by workspace, domain and title filters, favorites, and batch archive / unarchive / purge archived files (destructive steps ask twice) — plus a four-gate health checkup (log integrity, projection cache, lossless JSON, cold read) that ends in a reversible, backup-first prescription. Search and indexing live in dsh-search-index; this plugin builds no index and never rewrites session logs.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理台（原名会话管家）：一屏管理活跃与归档会话——按工作区分组、检索域与标题筛选、收藏，批量归档 / 取消归档 / 清理归档文件（不可逆需二次确认），外加四门会话体检（日志完整性 / 投影缓存 / 无损 JSON / 冷读），给出可逆、先备份的处方。搜索与索引在 dsh-search-index；本插件不自建索引，也不改写会话日志。

description.en: VS Code-style local workbench for DSH with a file explorer, Monaco editor, full-text search and a Git panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 VS Code 风格的本地工作台，含文件资源管理器、Monaco 编辑器、全文搜索与 Git 面板。

description.en: Add one session-header button to copy the session deep link, the full conversation as Markdown, only the messages you tick (QQ/WeChat-style multi-select), or the working directory.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏添加一个复制按钮，可复制会话深度链接、整段对话 Markdown、勾选的部分消息（QQ/微信式多选）或工作目录。

description.en: Local BM25 auto-recall, a fail-closed write guard, a static doctor and a memory panel for an Engramory markdown store. No network, no daemon and no model calls unless you opt in; recall quality is measured by a reproducible benchmark in the repository.
description.zh: 给 Engramory 记忆库加本地 BM25 自动召回、写入闸门、静态体检与记忆面板。不联网、不起进程，默认不调模型；召回质量由仓库里的可复算基准量化。

description.en: Turns what a design, plan or document claims into a model and decides it: UML diagrams rendered, read and reviewed; state machines, protocols and data models checked as models; migrations tested for coverage and rollback symmetry; concurrency claims mined and routed to the checker that can decide them; dependency graphs audited; reports diffed.
description.zh: 把设计、计划或文档里的声称抽成模型再判定：UML 图渲染、读取与审查；状态机、协议与数据模型按模型判定；迁移检查覆盖与回滚对称；并发声称挖掘后分派给能判定它的工具；依赖图审查；报告对比。

description.en: Modifies DSH plugin code at runtime, with ordered patches, inspection, and hot reload.
description.zh: 在运行时修改 DSH 插件代码，并提供 Patch 排序、检查和热重载。

description.en: A live Android device inside the conversation — emulator or USB phone, driven entirely through adb: 20 agent tools for streaming, Gradle build and run, UI-tree or OCR interaction, logcat, processes and memory, plus a three-button navigation panel.
description.zh: 在对话里直接操作 Android 设备——模拟器或 USB 手机，完全通过 adb 驱动：20 个 Agent 工具用于流式投屏、Gradle 构建运行、UI 树或 OCR 交互、logcat、进程与内存检查，并附带三键导航面板。

description.en: Converts tables in .docx, .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv and .tsv files into the table JSON consumed by the rule checkers, and reports when it could not rather than guessing.
description.zh: 把 .docx、.xlsx、.xlsm、.csv、.tsv 中的表格转换成规则核查器可读的 table JSON；识别不了时明确报告，不做猜测。

description.en: Read-only IMAP search and attachments, plus SMTP sending under DSH permissions, with separate reading and sending switches and a credential-backed settings page.
description.zh: 通过只读 IMAP 检索邮件与获取附件，按 DSH 权限发送 SMTP 邮件，提供独立收发开关和接入凭据存储的设置页。

description.en: Two gates for outbound AI text. (1) Guard: before any text goes out it blocks the shapes anyone could write — padding verbs plus abstract nouns ("optimised the code structure"), hollow adjectives, universal filler, template openers, git commit/PR/review boilerplate, comments that narrate the code. Covers chat, comments, email, commit messages, PR descriptions, reviews, issues, docs and code comments. Passes with OK, blocks with one line naming what to change. (2) Catch memes: when someone drops a slang term the model does not guess or look it up — it already knows. A built-in 6792-entry meme wiki is queried before the model starts thinking, and the entry usage field ("how to answer this") goes straight into context. Matches only exact title/slug/alias hits, never fuzzy, so ordinary chat never triggers it. Bundled SQLite by node:sqlite, zero dependencies, 1.6ms per query. Settings page: guard on/off, strict mode, prompt section toggle, meme wiki toggle, per-turn auto-lookup, a four-step tone slider (reserved / measured / follow the room / unrestrained) that is behavioural rather than a label, AI-completion switch (off by default, uses the session own model so no API key needed), a paste-and-test box, and three thresholds. No model call for any check.
description.zh: 管 AI 对外说话的两道门。一、守门：发出去之前拦掉「谁都能说」的形状——空转（动词配宏观名词，如「优化了代码结构」）、空形容词、万能话、模板开场白、git commit/PR/review 的套话、把代码念一遍的注释。聊天、评论、邮件、commit message、PR 描述、review、issue、文档、代码注释都覆盖。过了回 OK，没过回一行说明怎么改。二、接梗：对方抛出网络梗时不猜、不联网搜——内置 6792 条梗词库，在模型开始思考之前就查好，把词条的「用法」字段（这个梗该怎么接）直接塞进上下文。只认标题/slug/别名的精确命中，不做模糊匹配，所以日常闲聊不会误触发。词库用 Node 自带 node:sqlite，零依赖，单次查询 1.6ms。设置页：守门开关、严格模式、提示节开关、梗库开关、每轮自动查、四档玩梗尺度滑杆（很收着/有点度/跟着玩/放得开，写行为不写标签）、AI 接话开关（默认关，走会话自己的模型不用填 key）、粘一段当场试、三个阈值。所有判断都在本地跑，不调模型。

description.en: Replacement web interface for the unmodified official DSH release: collapsible reasoning groups, a turn timeline with adjustable reading width, cards for tool calls, a model and reasoning-effort picker, an Agents view that shows subagents as a tree, optional chart and diagram widgets in answers, light and dark themes, and a phone layout. Installs from npm; uninstalling restores the official interface. An optional jev_presentation_advice tool, enabled only once you save a TypeSafe key, sends up to four recent user messages and a short outline of the planned answer to api.typesafe.ai.
description.zh: 给未改动的官方 DSH 换一套网页界面：思考过程分组折叠、对话轮次时间轴与可调阅读宽度、工具调用卡片、模型与思考强度选择面板、子智能体编队视图、回答里可选的图表与流程图组件、明暗主题和手机布局。从 npm 安装，卸载即恢复官方界面。可选的 jev_presentation_advice 工具只有在你保存 TypeSafe 密钥后才会启用，它会把最近最多四条用户消息和一份简短的回答提纲发送到 api.typesafe.ai。

description.en: Adds a fish-ear microphone to DSH that transcribes speech locally, estimates tone and emotion, and lets BigFish reply with an emotion-aware prompt.
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加一个鱼耳麦克风，本地转写语音、估计语气与情绪，并让大肥鱼按情绪自然回复。

description.en: Adds a Worktree view to DSH Web UI that groups Sessions by Git worktree while keeping DSH as the source of truth.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 增加按 Git Worktree 组织 Session 的视角，同时继续由 DSH 管理原始 Project 和 Session 数据。

description.en: A whale-maid with a jar, sitting in the corner of your DSH window. She goes exploring on Bilibili for whatever you are into, ranks by like, coin and favourite rate rather than view count, and brings back pickled snacks that suit your taste. When a term runs dry she takes another route. Five picks go into the jar, and she tells you what each video is about. News-type axes keep only the last two weeks; game guides and music have no limit, and each axis decides for itself.
description.zh: 鲸鱼娘带着一个罐子，守在右下角。按照你的兴趣，她会去 B 站探险，按赞币藏率排，给你找一些符合口味的电子榨菜。哪个词搜得少，她换条路再找。回来把五条装进罐子里，然后和你说说这些视频讲了什么。时政这类她只留最近两周，游戏攻略和音乐不限时间，每根轴她自己定。

description.en: Tab autocomplete for the DeepSeek Harness desktop and web composer: next-message ghost text, inline draft completion, and Alt+Up/Alt+Down candidate cycling.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端与 Web 界面的输入框提供 Tab 自动补全：下一条消息的灰色幽灵文本、草稿行内续写，以及 Alt+Up/Alt+Down 切换候选。

description.en: Curated research plugin market: adds a Research plugins page to Settings with hand-reviewed plugins for literature search, reference management, writing and workbenches — one-click install, update and remove pinned to the reviewed version, restart from the panel, and exactly one network request (its own catalog).
description.zh: 精选科研插件市场：在设置里加一页「科研插件」，收录逐个读过代码的文献检索、文献管理、写作与科研工作台插件——一键安装、更新、卸载并钉住审读过的版本，面板内重启，只发一个网络请求（拉取自家目录）。

description.en: OpenAI-completions-compatible adapter for custom gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted proxies): always role:"system", thinking driven by the model config, Qwen-style response split, and vision-model image input (single / multiple).
description.zh: 面向自定义网关（vLLM / LM Studio / 自托管代理）的 OpenAI-completions 兼容适配器：始终 role:"system"、按模型配置驱动思考、Qwen 式 response 切分，并支持视觉模型图片输入（单图 / 多图）。

description.en: MCP management page in DSH Settings: list, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers, edit them in form or JSON mode, expand a server to see the tools it registers, paste-import MCP configs from 14 tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and more) in one go, and bind a server to project directories so only sessions working inside them can see or call its tools.
description.zh: DSH 设置中的 MCP 管理页：列出、启停、重启、删除 MCP 服务器，表单与 JSON 双模式编辑，展开可查看各服务器注册的工具，支持一次粘贴导入 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、VS Code 等 14 种工具的 MCP 配置，并可把某个服务器绑定到指定项目目录——只有工作目录在其中的会话能看到并调用它的工具。

description.en: Registers the models of a local workbuddy2api-hub gateway into DSH as one OpenAI-compatible provider per gateway API key, each key keeping its own model selection, and shows the main key's credit balance plus today's and this week's tokens, credits and API-equivalent cost in a sidebar badge. Requires workbuddy2api-hub running locally.
description.zh: 把本地 workbuddy2api-hub 网关的模型接进 DSH：网关里有几条 API Key 就同步成几条 provider，每条 key 的模型勾选各自独立；侧边栏徽标显示主 key 的积分余额和今日、本周的 tokens、积分与 API 等价花费。需本机运行 workbuddy2api-hub。

description.en: A Honkai: Star Rail "Firefly" theme with wallpaper/video backgrounds, firefly-green neon palette, transformation boot animation, ambient particles, BGM, typewriter SFX, and context-aware emote easter eggs.
description.zh: 崩坏：星穹铁道「流萤」主题：立绘/动态壁纸、萤火绿霓虹配色、开屏变身动画、萤火氛围粒子、背景音乐、打字音效与按对话触发的表情包彩蛋。

description.en: Sidebar weather panel: current conditions, 5-day and 24-hour forecasts, an hourly rain chart, temperature history, CMA alerts with graded reminders and county-level matching, a radar mosaic, FY-4B satellite imagery, typhoon tracks, and ECMWF / NW Pacific sea surface temperature charts.
description.zh: 侧边栏天气面板：当前天气、5 天与 24 小时预报、逐小时降水、历史气温、中央气象台预警（分级提醒、区县级匹配）、雷达拼图、风云四号 B 星卫星云图、台风路径，以及 ECMWF 与西北太平洋海表温度专业图。

description.en: Runs the local Cursor CLI as a child coding agent from DSH - a `cursor_code` tool plus the native one-shot `cursor_subagent` tool, one mirrored DSH sub-session per run, per-task model choice, resumable conversations, a step timeline with real file diffs, and a usage, model and session panel.
description.zh: 把本机 Cursor CLI 当作子编码智能体：提供 `cursor_code` 工具与原生一次性 `cursor_subagent` 工具，每次运行镜像为一个真实的 DSH 子会话，可按任务选模型、会话可续聊，返回逐步工具时间线与真实文件 diff，并提供额度、模型和会话面板。

description.en: Conversational Markdown mindmap workspace: edit complete documents step by step, keep a live right-side visualization synchronized, and open, manage, and export mindmaps from the working directory.
description.zh: 对话式 Markdown 思维脑图工作台：逐步编辑完整文档，实时同步右侧可视化，并在工作目录中打开、管理和导出脑图。

description.en: Connects QQ private chats and groups to DSH over OneBot 11, adding qq_send and other tools so the agent can reply, send stickers and wait for follow-ups.
description.zh: 经 OneBot 11 把 QQ 私聊和群聊接进 DSH，提供 qq_send 等工具，让 agent 能回消息、发表情、等待对方接话。

description.en: A workspace-based Studio for source-grounded reports, slides, tables, mind maps, quizzes, flashcards, audio and video, using DSH models and shared artifact services. Office generation requires Python 3.12+ with its dependencies and DSH_OFFICE_PYTHON configured; media rendering requires Chromium, and local ASR additionally requires whisper.cpp and a model.
description.zh: 基于工作区资料的 Studio，复用 DSH 模型与共享成果服务，制作报告、演示文稿、表格、思维导图、测验、闪卡及音视频。Office 生成需 Python 3.12+ 及相关依赖，并配置 DSH_OFFICE_PYTHON；媒体渲染需 Chromium；本地语音转写另需 whisper.cpp 和模型。

description.en: Plays local video and audio inside the conversation. Media files the model writes during a turn - screen recordings, transcodes, voiceovers - get a player under its final reply automatically when their paths appear in its commands, the command output or the reply; the play_video tool plays any other file. Video shows as compact cards with a hover preview, audio as a slim seek bar, streamed over HTTP Range so long files seek instead of loading into memory. Also registers a sidebar media preview renderer, since the built-in previewer treats mp4 as unviewable. The look_video tool lets the model see a video itself: a hidden local Chrome or Edge grabs frames into a time-labelled contact sheet (or big frames at given times, or a short range frame by frame), checks the audio (silence, too quiet, clipping, one channel only) and the picture (black or frozen frames), and reads MP4 / MOV headers for phone compatibility (codec, HDR, faststart and more), with ffmpeg fixes.
description.zh: 在对话流里直接播放本地视频和音频。模型这一轮写出的媒体文件（录屏、转码、配音），只要路径出现在它跑的命令、命令输出或回复里，回合收尾时播放器就自动出现在回复正下方，不用调工具；别的文件用 play_video 工具播放。视频是带悬停预览的小卡片，音频是可拖进度的细条，走 HTTP Range 流式传输，长视频能拖进度条、不会整个读进内存。同时注册了侧边栏媒体预览渲染器——内置预览器把 mp4 当作不可预览。look_video 工具让模型自己看视频：在本机一个看不见的 Chrome / Edge 里按时间截帧，拼成一张每格标时间的图交给模型（也能看某几刻的大图、逐帧看一小段），顺便量声音（没声、太小、爆音、只有一边声道）、找黑屏和卡住的画面，并读 mp4 / mov 文件头查手机上能不能放（编码、HDR、文件头位置等），附 ffmpeg 改法。

description.en: Curated DeepSeek Harness plugin market with a daily heat leaderboard, bilingual descriptions, 2-3 plugin comparison, compatibility checks and README summaries.
description.zh: 精选 DeepSeek Harness 插件市场，提供每日热度榜、双语说明、2–3 款并排对比、兼容性检查与 README 摘要。

description.en: Fluid streaming rendering and smooth scrolling for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供流畅流式渲染和丝滑滚动。

description.en: Moves an existing DeepSeek Harness conversation into another workspace from the sidebar menu: the transcript and title carry over, a new workspace folder can be registered in the same dialog, and the original session is archived and restorable.
description.zh: 从侧边栏菜单把已有的 DeepSeek Harness 会话移动到其他工作区：会话记录与标题一并带过去，可在同一对话框里登记新的工作区文件夹，原会话归档且可恢复。

description.en: WorkBuddy-style skill picker: a button beside the composer opens a searchable list of installed skills; picking one inserts the official /skill-name gesture, so the skill loads with your message.
description.zh: WorkBuddy 同款技能选择器：输入框旁 ⚡ 按钮弹出全部技能列表，支持搜索与最近/常用排序，点选即插入官方 `/技能名` 手势，随消息发出自动加载执行。

description.en: Renders HTML, React (JSX/TSX), Vue, SVG, Mermaid and Markdown written by the agent in an isolated iframe sandbox with SSE hot-reload, and adds a DOM click inspector, side-by-side visual diff, a responsive device matrix and one-click Vite ZIP export.
description.zh: 在隔离的 iframe 沙箱中实时渲染 Agent 生成的 HTML、React (JSX/TSX)、Vue、SVG、Mermaid 和 Markdown，支持 SSE 热重载，并提供 DOM 点击检查器、并排视觉对比、响应式设备矩阵和一键 Vite ZIP 导出。

description.en: A desktop companion for DSH: she lives on your real desktop, in the wallpaper or in dsh's own page, talks by voice, speaks first and remembers you. Several characters, each with her own look and scene rules.
description.zh: DSH 桌面女友：住在桌面上、壁纸里或 dsh 网页里，语音聊天，会先开口，记得你；可以设好几个人物，形象和编排都能自己定。

description.en: Android real-device debugging workbench for the DSH Web GUI: auto-attached logcat with severity/keyword filters and crash snapshots, live on-device screen casting with remote tap/swipe/text control, memory/proc/frida reverse-engineering toolset, 30 agent tools.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 安卓实机调试工作台：自动附加 logcat 流（级别/关键词过滤、崩溃自动快照），真机屏幕实时投屏与远程点击/滑动/文字操控，内存/进程/frida 逆向工具链，30 个 agent 工具。

description.en: Fork of Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth adding a deny-by-default allowlist route gate over resources, plugin bundles, /api and WebSocket upgrades; password and OIDC/SSO login with an SSO-only mode; server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies plus a per-browser session list and selective revocation; an OAuth 2.1 device authorization flow (RFC 8628) for app and CLI access, with independent device sessions that expire only on explicit revocation; and a core session bridge that exchanges the launch cookie on the server without exposing the launch token. It is a fork of Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth and cannot be installed alongside it — remove the original from the profile's bundle list first.
description.zh: Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth 的分支，新增默认拒绝的白名单路由闸门（资源、插件 bundle、/api、WebSocket 升级）；密码与 OIDC/SSO 登录及「仅允许 SSO」模式；服务端会话 + HttpOnly Cookie，浏览器会话列表与单条吊销；面向 App/CLI 的 OAuth 2.1 设备授权（RFC 8628），设备会话独立、仅主动吊销失效；核心会话桥在服务端换取 launch Cookie，不向客户端暴露 launch token。 本插件是 Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth 的分支，不能与原版同装——安装前请先从 profile 的 bundle 列表移除原版。

description.en: Skills and MCP browser behind one floating ball with five tabs: Skills (native folder picker, two-level categories plus custom groups, tree or flat view, manual, keyword and AI grouping on metadata only, search, and per-card or whole-library enable/disable with timestamped backups), Call Ledger (counts, success rate, trend, ranking), MCP (live loader config, real Fiber states, per-server tools and call stats, enable, disable, reconnect, export to mcpServers JSON, plus scan-and-AI-fix for unconfigured servers), Market (MCP marketplace: the official MCP Registry plus 29 curated free servers, 19 flat categories with per-category counts, grid and list views with 3-6 cards per row, one-click install into cordis.patch.yml with automatic backup, one-click uninstall, every server shown with its own real icon, two-way instant sync with the MCP tab, and the last scroll position is recalled) and Quick Start. 130 skins sync across the three balls. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 技能与 MCP 浏览器：一个悬浮球五个页面。技能浏览（系统目录选库、两级分类加自定义分组、树状/平铺、手动/关键词/AI 分组且只发元数据、搜索、单卡或全库启停并自动备份）、调用台账（次数/成功率/趋势/排行）、MCP（真实 loader 配置与 Fiber 状态、工具与调用统计、启停/重连/导出）、市场（MCP 市场：官方 MCP Registry 与 29 条精选免费服务器，19 大类平铺并带每类数量，网格/列表双视图且每行 3~6 列，一键安装写入 cordis.patch.yml 并自动备份、一键卸载，每条服务器用其自身真实图标，与 MCP 页双向即时同步，并记忆上次滚动位置）与快速上手。130 款皮肤在三颗悬浮球间同步。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Project-level memory built around a ledger whose structure the AI designs per project; the plugin only handles detection, injection, write-back, archiving and git. Memories are split by meaning: the active ledger holds current state, the turn journal is append-only, and decisions, the goal tree and lessons are one-card-per-file (with a multi-dimension index over the card folders); the fundamental principles file can be changed only by the user. There is a single compaction mode: before compacting, the AI sorts the work into three buckets - what must stay in context and is re-injected verbatim, what is written to the project's _stash/ for later lookup, and what is dropped. When a conversation is opened in a container workspace holding several projects, it can be locked to one sub-project (the lock lives in the plugin's own home and survives restarts; it leaves no marker in your project). Also an activity log with five levels, where L4 stores the user's own words verbatim (never injected, queryable on demand). Before each compaction a verbatim capsule (user quotes, raw errors, changed files) is written to disk, and both the capsule and its source material survive a restart; a handoff document lets a new conversation resume the previous one. 21 tools, 12 subcommands, 39 settings (one of them switches whether the settings panel or each project's manifest wins). Runs locally, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 项目级记忆，核心是台账：台账的结构由 AI 按项目类型自行决定，插件只负责检测、注入、回写、归档与 Git 配合。记忆按语义分开放 —— 活跃台账是当前状态、回合流水只追加、关键决策/目标树/经验教训各是一卡一文件（另有卡片目录的多维索引表），根本原则只有用户本人能改。压缩方式只有一种（分流后压缩）：压缩前先让 AI 把这一段分成三个桶 —— 留上下文的压缩后逐字注回、以后要查的落进项目 _stash/、已被取代的丢掉。对话建在装着多个项目的总工作区上时，可以把它锁定到某个子项目（锁记在插件自己的家，跨重启保持；不在你的项目里留任何标记）。另有活动日志 L0–L4，其中 L4 逐字存档用户原话（不注入上下文，可按需查）。每次压缩前把用户原话、报错原文、改过哪些文件落盘成一份逐字胶囊，重启后仍能取到（素材与胶囊分别落盘、跨重启保留）；再用交接单让新会话接上上一次的工作。21 个工具、12 个子命令、39 项设置（其中一项可切换「以设置面板为准 / 以项目清单为准」）；纯本地运行，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Free OpenCode Zen models in DeepSeek Harness, anonymous by default with an optional Zen key. The catalogue is read from Zen's official model list at runtime, and anonymous requests are adapted to the free tier's request checks, documented with dated measurements.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用免费的 OpenCode Zen 模型：默认匿名，可选填 Zen key；模型表在运行时从 Zen 官方列表读取，匿名请求会按免费档校验做适配，并有带日期的实测记录。

description.en: Full edition of the motor-design AI plugin for DeepSeek Harness: adds the L1 (Ansys RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) precision layers on top of the L0 millisecond-level broad filter, completing an end-to-end chain from requirement parsing to parameter identification, candidate matrix, L0 pre-screening and L1/L2 verification. Mutually exclusive with dsh-motor-ai-l0 (uninstall l0 first); the shared core @wangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-core installs automatically. L1 needs Ansys AEDT (RMxprt) and L2 needs Motor-CAD installed locally. Distributed under the PolyForm Noncommercial licence; L1/L2 require an activation code. Telemetry is on by default: per-tool usage counts and design-experience samples that the author describes as desensitized are sent to the author's server at wangxuewangxue98.deno.net, and fault assistance can upload fault reports; switch them off with telemetryEnabled, designExperienceUpload and faultAssistEnabled in the plugin config.
description.zh: 电机电磁设计 AI 插件完整版：在 L0 毫秒级广筛之上补齐 L1（Ansys RMxprt）与 L2（Motor-CAD）精算层，形成 需求解析 → 参数识别 → 候选矩阵 → L0 预筛 → L1/L2 精算校核 的端到端设计链；与 dsh-motor-ai-l0 互斥，安装前请先卸载 l0，共享核心 @wangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-core 随包自动安装；L1 另需本机安装 Ansys AEDT（RMxprt），L2 另需本机安装 Motor-CAD。完整版采用 PolyForm Noncommercial 许可，L1/L2 需激活码。默认开启遥测：按工具聚合的使用次数和作者称已脱敏的设计经验样本会回传到作者在 wangxuewangxue98.deno.net 的服务器，故障协助还可上传故障报告；可在插件配置里用 telemetryEnabled、designExperienceUpload、faultAssistEnabled 关闭。

description.en: Pink-and-white frosted-glass skin for the DSH Web GUI, themed after Cyrene from Honkai Star Rail. Also rewrites the agent persona (editable from the sidebar), adds Cyrene reaction stickers, replaces the new-session hero with her, and adds a full-page background picker with enable / pick / rotate / fade. Unofficial non-commercial fan project; Cyrene and related art are (c) miHoYo / HoYoverse, not affiliated or endorsed.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 换成昔涟（《崩坏：星穹铁道》）的粉白渐变毛玻璃主题，附带侧边栏可编辑的人格设定、昔涟表情包、新会话欢迎页形象，以及可开关 / 选图 / 轮换 / 调淡的整页背景图。非官方非商业同人作品；昔涟及相关美术素材版权归米哈游（miHoYo / HoYoverse）所有，与官方无隶属或背书关系。

description.en: Ranks the models a DeepSeek Harness install already discovered by measured connectivity and speed, and switches to the next candidate inside the same turn when the one in use fails without producing any output. Ships a settings page with a grouped model list, per-model and per-channel switches, and a quota-aware cooldown that rests an exhausted model until the next day.
description.zh: 把本机已发现的 DSH 模型按实测连通性与速度排序，当前模型无输出失败时在同一回合内切到下一个候选。附带设置页：按渠道分组的模型列表、逐模型与逐渠道开关，以及额度耗尽后休息到次日的冷却策略。

description.en: Zero-dependency, event-driven voice announcement plugin: no extra model, no token cost. Speaks with the system's built-in natural voice, supporting both Windows and macOS; final-reply announcements, approval & question alerts, optional event announcements (turn end, command done, goal change, tool errors, todo updates), replayable final replies, and a bilingual visual settings page.
description.zh: 零外部依赖、事件驱动、无需额外模型、不消耗任何 token的语音播报插件。使用系统自带自然语音进行播报，支持win/mac双平台；最终回复、审批与提问提醒、可选事件播报（回合结束/命令完成/目标变更/工具出错/待办更新）、最终回复可重播、双语言可视化设置。

description.en: LAN access for the official DSH Web UI through a gated reverse proxy: DSH keeps its own loopback binding, and a second port adds a password gate, self-signed HTTPS and per-device pairing that can be revoked individually, with a QR code to open it from a phone.
description.zh: 把官方 DSH Web UI 安全地开放到局域网：不改动 DSH 自身的回环绑定，另开一个带密码门禁、自签 HTTPS 与可逐个吊销的设备配对的反向代理端口，并提供手机扫码入口。

description.en: Multi-character Galgame conversation view with separate character and reply-model selection, per-character affection, memory, dialogue history, and CG galleries, plus responses informed by task events across Harness sessions.
description.zh: 多角色 Galgame 对话界面：角色与回复模型可独立切换，分角色保存好感度、记忆、对话历史与 CG 图鉴，并根据 Harness 跨会话任务事件做出角色回应。

description.en: Native right-sidebar Markdown preview with Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, GFM tables and syntax highlighting — rendering engine bundled, fully offline.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生右侧文件预览中渲染 Mermaid 图表、KaTeX 公式、GFM 表格与代码高亮，渲染引擎随包内置，完全离线。

description.en: Remote development launcher for DeepSeek Harness: provisions dsh on a remote host via SSH (or a local WSL distro) and connects from the local client, with LLM credentials proxied through a reverse tunnel so they never leave the local machine. Ships as both a standalone CLI and a dsh plugin with a session panel, /remote-explorer slash command and remote_* agent tools.
description.zh: 远程开发启动器：通过 SSH（或本机 WSL 发行版）在远端引导安装 dsh，从本地客户端连接，LLM 凭据经反向隧道代理、不离开本机。同时提供独立 CLI 与 dsh 插件双形态，插件含远程会话面板、/remote-explorer 命令及 remote_* agent 工具。

description.en: Calendar and hierarchical task workbench: AI-assisted intake clarification, consultation, decomposition, execution with user acceptance, and review, plus reminders and per-task AI session workspaces.
description.zh: 日历 + 层级任务个人工作台：AI 辅助澄清、咨询、拆解、执行（用户验收）与复盘，支持到期提醒与按任务组织的 AI 会话工作区。

description.en: High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: QR one-click auth, card-based commands and intent-confirmation cards, at-least-once zero-loss outbox, media in/out, /doctor session-log ZIP, and a reusable DSH Web GUI that lands sessions in the right workspace.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的高可靠飞书/Lark 桥接：扫码一键认证、卡片化命令与意图确认、at-least-once 零丢失出站队列、多媒体出入站、/doctor 会话日志 ZIP，并复用 DSH Web GUI 把会话归入正确工作区。

description.en: Windows PDF translator for DeepSeek Harness: a vision model locates and translates text, tables, figures and formulas; output is a Chinese PDF and a LaTeX source zip. Requires a vision-capable OpenAI-compatible API.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows PDF 翻译插件：由视觉模型识别并翻译正文、表格、图表和公式，输出中文 PDF 与 LaTeX 源码压缩包。需要自备支持图片输入的 OpenAI 兼容 API。

description.en: Arknights: Endfield theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: charcoal and hazard-yellow industrial HUD, a boot splash injected ahead of the shell, a conversation backdrop, and a re-cut Windows title bar. Restyles the sidebar brand to 终末地工业 / ENDFIELD INDUSTRIES, which a URL flag reverts.
description.zh: 《明日方舟：终末地》主题：炭黑与警戒黄的工业 HUD、在外壳渲染前注入的开屏动画、对话区背景，以及重新配色的 Windows 标题栏。侧栏品牌会改为「终末地工业 / ENDFIELD INDUSTRIES」，可用 URL 参数还原。

description.en: TencentDB Agent Memory integration with conversation capture, structured memory extraction, automatic recall, and memory and conversation search tools.
description.zh: 集成 TencentDB Agent Memory，支持对话捕获、结构化记忆提取、自动召回，以及记忆和对话搜索工具。

description.en: Multi-user login gateway for the DSH web UI: the first visit creates the admin account, admins add and manage users in the GUI settings panel, ordinary users see only their own conversations, and unauthenticated visitors are redirected to /login.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供多用户登录网关：首次访问创建管理员账户，管理员在 GUI 设置面板中添加和管理用户，普通用户只能看到自己的会话，未登录访问重定向到 /login。

description.en: Agent Teams management for the DSH Web GUI: inspect the teammates of any session, delete a role together with its session (the session folder moves to a recoverable trash), reclaim the freed member slot on pre-0.2.2-rc.1 teams, keep deleted members out of the subagent picker and the team roster, and restore a read-only members panel in the session header on 0.2.2-rc.1+ — works with both the old and the new Agent Teams implementations without patching DSH.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的智能体团队管理：查看任意会话的成员，删除角色及其持久会话（目录移入回收站，可恢复），在 0.2.2-rc.1 之前的旧版团队上回收释放的成员名额，让已删除成员不再出现在子智能体选择器与团队面板，并在 0.2.2-rc.1+ 恢复会话页头的只读成员面板；新旧两版智能体团队实现都能用，不需要改 DSH 源码。

description.en: Streaming fold for the DSH web transcript: the newest thinking window opens itself, older process rows fold into one summary, and a finished turn glides back to your prompt, which stays pinned while you read.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话流式折叠：运行中只展开最新的思考小窗、其余过程行折成一条摘要，一轮结束滑回你提的那句话；读到哪一轮那轮提问就钉在顶部。

description.en: Long sessions get expensive, and the platform compacts the context on its own. This plugin adds an occupancy badge (hover to see how it is computed), writes a handover draft into HANDOVER.md from 45% — files changed, money spent, what recent turns were about — and reminds you once at 60% to wrap up. On compaction it records the reading from just before, so you can check it later. No model calls, nothing added to the conversation; it does not prevent compaction.
description.zh: 长会话越跑越贵，平台到点还会把上下文压掉。这个插件做三件事：在会话标题旁显示当前上下文占了多少，鼠标停上去能看到这个数是怎么来的；过 45% 时往工作目录的 HANDOVER.md 写一份交接草稿，记下改过哪些文件、花了多少钱、最近几轮在聊什么；到 60% 提醒你一次该收尾了。平台压缩发生时，它把压缩前的数字记一行，事后还查得到。不调用模型，也不改动对话内容。它不阻止压缩，拿不回已经被压掉的部分。

description.en: Sidebar IM stand-in for DeepSeek Harness. Reuses your logged-in Feishu/Lark, WeCom and DingTalk CLIs (DingTalk is enabled from the panel) to poll only the chats you watch; an @-mention or a new message wakes the bound DSH session, which reads context, researches and drafts a reply in your voice. Each watch has its own draft-approval / auto-send mode and a three-state attention level, and new groups are triaged by the agent. Blocked chats are never fetched, message bodies stay on this machine, and the plugin opens no port of its own.
description.zh: 把「替你值守 IM」做成 DSH 侧边栏的常驻席位：复用本机已登录的飞书/Lark、企业微信、钉钉（需在面板启用）CLI，只拉取加入值守的会话；命中 @我 或新消息才唤醒绑定的 DSH 会话，由它读上下文、调研并按本人语气起草。每个值班可单独切换草稿审批 / 全自动发送与关注程度三态，新群由 agent 自动分诊；屏蔽的会话永不拉取，消息正文只留本机，插件不开任何端口。

description.en: Wraps the local GitHub CLI (gh) in agent tools for pull requests, issues, Actions runs, repository search and raw API calls, plus /gh status and /gh help slash commands and two web panels (a global repository cockpit and a per-session workspace panel).
description.zh: 把本机 GitHub CLI (gh) 包装成 Agent 工具集（PR、Issue、Actions 运行、仓库检索与原始 API 调用），另提供 /gh status 与 /gh help 两个斜杠命令，以及全局仓库驾驶舱和会话工作区两个 Web 面板。

description.en: Modular execution discipline and autonomous steward for DSH: evidence-first routing across 44 canonical skills, durable state planning, verification gates, fail-streak recovery, and interactive web dashboard.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的模块化执行纪律与自主管家：覆盖 44 项规范技能的循证路由、持久化状态规划、验证门禁、失败恢复与交互式 Web 看板。

description.en: Noname (Sanguosha-like game) extension workshop. AI writes skill and card extensions behind confirmation gates, static validation and block-based safe writes.
description.zh: 无名杀扩展开发工坊。AI 在确认协议、校验门禁与区块化写入的保护下编写武将技能与卡牌扩展。

description.en: Guarded context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the LLM proposes, deterministic guards dispose — eager per-atom shrink (extract/summary/false under verbatim guards) + lazy reference-graph eviction (0-LLM) + byte-exact recall from an append-only log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 守卫式上下文压缩——LLM 提议、确定性守卫裁决：逐原子缩放（verbatim 守卫下 extract/summary/false）+ 引用图延迟剪枝（0-LLM）+ append-only 日志逐字节精确召回。

description.en: Scheduled reminders and delayed send for DSH: /later delivers what you type as yourself at the time you pick, while the timer panel (or /schedule) posts a reminder row — even with the page closed. (scheduled send / reminders / delayed send)
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上定时提醒与延迟发送：一句话到点送达——/later 以你的身份发出，定时面板或 /schedule 发提醒行；关掉网页也准时触发。（定时发送 / 定时提醒 / 延迟发送 / 提醒）

description.en: Cohere provider for language models, embeddings, and reranking through Cohere's native APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 通过 Cohere 原生 API 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入和重排序能力的 Cohere 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: A fork of y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web that bridges the DeepSeek web client into DSH, so short-context conversations, workflows and skill packs run without an API key, and a picture pasted in DSH gets read for free. Ships a floating ball plus sidebar, one-click login that stays logged in, and a right-click action that sends any selected text into the web input after clearing it. It keeps the upstream provider id deepseek-web, so it cannot be installed next to another plugin that owns the same provider. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1. Reuses your own signed-in chat.deepseek.com session (needs Chrome/Edge/Brave/Chromium or a managed browser download); this may violate DeepSeek's terms and risks rate limiting or a ban. Cannot be installed alongside y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web.
description.zh: y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web 的 fork：把 DeepSeek 网页版桥接进 DSH，不花 API 额度就能跑短上下文对话、工作流与技能包，直接发图片也能免费识图。带悬浮球与侧边栏，一键登录后长期保持登录；正文任意文字右键即可投送到网页端输入框，投送前自动清空原输入框。沿用上游 provider id deepseek-web，不能与占用同一 provider 的其他插件同时安装。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。复用你自己已登录的 chat.deepseek.com 会话（需 Chrome/Edge/Brave/Chromium 或由插件下载托管浏览器），可能违反 DeepSeek 服务条款，有限流/封禁风险；不能与 y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web 同装。

description.en: HarmonyOS development suite for DSH: a right-sidebar HiLog inspector (live stream with level/logger/text filters) and an ArkUI Inspector (screenshot pick, collapsible component tree, node properties with search, box model), two tree sources — the DevEco debug channel (declared padding/margin/border and custom component names) and the uitest accessibility tree — an .ets viewer with ArkTS syntax highlighting, DevEco Studio/CLT toolchain and device management, plus the harmony_ui_tree agent tool. 21 remote methods, 82 unit tests.
description.zh: HarmonyOS 全栈开发套件：右侧边栏提供 HiLog 检查器（实时流与级别/包名/关键词过滤）与 ArkUI Inspector（截图点选高亮、可折叠组件树、节点属性搜索、盒子模型），两种树源——DevEco 调试源（ark 调试链路，提供 padding/margin/border 声明值与自定义组件名）与 uitest 无障碍树；.ets 查看器提供 ArkTS 语法高亮；注册 harmony_ui_tree agent 工具供对话内取组件树；设置页管理 DevEco Studio/CLT 工具链与 USB/网络设备。21 个 Remote 方法，82 个单元测试。

description.en: View and manage an agent’s tools and skills in a visual menu. Set each capability to Resident, On-demand, or Disabled; agents can find and use on-demand capabilities while reducing context usage.
description.zh: 以可视化菜单查看和管理 Agent 的工具与技能，按常驻、按需、禁用三档控制能力暴露；支持按需检索和使用，减少上下文占用。

description.en: Configurable OIDC login and token-authorized model access, including LiteLLM and opt-in oidc-llm integration, with a standalone DSH Web backend.
description.zh: 可配置的 OIDC 登录与令牌授权模型接入，支持 LiteLLM 和显式启用的 oidc-llm 集成，提供独立 DSH Web 后端。

description.en: Bridge Claude Code's .claude/ directories into DSH with zero migration: project and user-level skills, commands, rules (one system-reminder envelope), agent files, hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/ SessionStart/SessionEnd) and .mcp.json servers, plus Claude Code plugin marketplaces. Ships /cc-plugin for full plugin/marketplace management (claude CLI first, self-implemented fallback), /cc-resume to list and import Claude Code sessions into DSH as native event-sourced logs, and /cc-export to write DSH skills back as Claude Code skills. Two-way Claude Code <-> DSH bridge, versioned and released as dsh-claude-compat.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的 .claude/ 目录零迁移桥接进 DSH：项目与用户级 skills、 斜杠命令、rules（单条 system-reminder 信封注入）、agent 文件、hooks （PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/SessionStart/SessionEnd）、 .mcp.json 服务器，并支持 Claude Code 插件 marketplace。自带 /cc-plugin 插件与市场全管理（claude CLI 优先、自实现兜底）、/cc-resume 列出并把 Claude Code 会话导入为 DSH 原生事件日志、/cc-export 把 DSH skill 导出为 Claude Code skill。Claude Code 与 DSH 的双向桥。

description.en: Provider-reported quota snapshots for GLM Coding Plan and GitHub Copilot in DSH: a draggable floating capsule with detail panels for quota windows, reset times, per-model usage and Copilot credits, plus an optional sidebar card hidden by default; credentials are resolved by the DSH host and no quota history is stored.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中查看 GLM Coding Plan 与 GitHub Copilot 的服务商额度快照：可拖动悬浮胶囊与详情面板展示额度窗口、重置时间、分模型用量与 Copilot 额度，附默认隐藏的可选侧边栏卡片；凭据由 DSH 宿主解析，不保存额度历史。

description.en: Read web novels inside the DSH web GUI: import legado book sources, search across them, keep a bookshelf with reading progress, read in one continuous scroll, import local TXT and EPUB books, and let agent tools reach the same sources, shelf and text.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 里读网络小说：导入 legado 书源、跨源搜索、带进度的书架、连续滚动阅读、导入本地 TXT 与 EPUB，并让 AI 助手工具接到同一套书源、书架与正文上。

description.en: Make development more fun. A subtle layer of motion for DeepSeek Harness, with customizable effects and reduced-motion support.
description.zh: 让开发，有趣一点。为 DeepSeek Harness 添一层恰到好处的动效，支持效果调整并跟随系统「减少动态效果」。

description.en: Rearranges the panel entries at the top of the DSH sidebar: drag to reorder or sort alphabetically, hide an entry without unloading its plugin, and split entries into named groups that render as titled separators; group headers collapse on click. A layout guard caps the entry list height and makes it scroll, so a growing list no longer squeezes the session and workspace panes out of view. An optional switch lets the profile's default model propose groups, and the host whitelists the returned ids and labels before they are stored locally.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 侧栏顶部的全局面板入口：拖动排序或按名称排序、逐项隐藏（不卸载插件）、分成命名分组并渲染为带标题的分隔线，分组标题可点击折叠。布局兜底会给入口列表限高并允许滚动，入口变多时不再把会话/工作区列表挤到看不见。可选开关让当前 profile 的默认模型提议分组，模型返回的 id 与组名先经宿主白名单清洗再写入本地。

description.en: Adds three DeepSeek Harness agent modes modelled on pi: Pi (lean baseline), Pi+ (adds the official apply_patch tool for editing several places in one file or several files), and Pi-IM (delivery adjusted for IM bots). One install registers all three; DSH's built-in modes are untouched. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer; each mode replaces the standard system prompt with its own short Chinese one.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 新增三个以 pi 为蓝本的模式：Pi（精简基线）、Pi+（额外启用官方 apply_patch，便于批量改同一文件多处或多个文件）、Pi-IM（面向 IM 机器人调整交付方式）。一次安装注册三个模式，DSH 自带模式不受影响。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或更新版本；每个模式都用自带的简短中文系统提示取代标准系统提示。

description.en: Starts your dsh web and other servers at boot, sets up and manages services like Gitea and Jellyfin just by asking, and puts them all under one home-hosted panel.
description.zh: 让 dsh web 与其他服务器随开机自动启动；只需一句提示就能搭建和管理 Gitea、Jellyfin 等服务，并统一收纳到一个 home-hosted 面板中。

description.en: Classifies pending tool calls with Jev (TypeSafe AI's non-generative decision model) on tools/pre-execute — confident high-risk calls are denied, ambiguous ones escalated to approval — and auto-approves clearly-granted reversible calls on approval/request behind argument-evidence gating. Also subclasses the session-reference resolver so snapshots keep Jev-scored messages instead of dropping oldest-first. Degrades to stock behavior on any provider failure; shadow mode with a /jev-stats command; TypeSafe or OpenRouter endpoints; 64 tests.
description.zh: 在 tools/pre-execute 上用 Jev（TypeSafe AI 的非生成式决策模型）对待执行的工具调用分类——高置信高危拒绝、存疑转审批——并在 approval/request 上对明确授权且可逆的调用做带参数证据门控的自动批准。另子类化 session-reference resolver，让引用快照按 Jev 打分保留消息而非最旧优先丢弃。任何 provider 故障均回退原生行为；提供 shadow 模式与 /jev-stats 统计命令；支持 TypeSafe 或 OpenRouter 入口；64 个测试。

description.en: Read any page as clean main content: charset auto-detect (GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5), noise stripping, compact text/Markdown, offset continuation, optional SPA rendering, batch reads and site crawling.
description.zh: 读取网页返回干净正文：中文编码自动识别（GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5）、噪音过滤、紧凑文本/Markdown、offset 续读、可选 SPA 渲染、批量读取与整站爬取。

description.en: Ollama provider for language models and embeddings, with model discovery, loading, and unloading in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入以及模型发现、加载和卸载功能的 Ollama 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Trellis-style workflow for DeepSeek Harness: per-turn phase breadcrumbs via agent/pre-step, bundled skill provider, and DSH-native task/phase state with git-cleanliness guardrails.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Trellis 风格工作流：基于 agent/pre-step 的每轮速记注入、内置技能提供方，以及带 git 清洁度护栏的 DSH 原生任务与相位状态管理。

description.en: Install tab in Settings → Plugins: install, update and remove any plugin by npm spec, `github:user/repo` or local path through the same `dsh plugin add` CLI path; update checks against npm latest or GitHub HEAD with a downgrade guard and resolved-version verification, a pnpm 11 release-cooldown bypass on every add/remove, and service restart via the DSH Desktop shell or a relay process under standalone `dsh web`.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的「安装」标签页：按 npm spec、`github:user/repo` 或本地路径安装、更新、卸载任意插件，走的都是 `dsh plugin add` 这条 CLI 路径；更新检查对照 npm latest 或 GitHub HEAD，带降级保护与装后版本核对，每次 add/remove 均附带 pnpm 11 发布冷静期豁免；服务重启在 DSH Desktop 由壳层执行，独立 `dsh web` 下由中转进程接力并交接回原终端。

description.en: Visual Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness with Gitea-backed tasks, workflow columns and a dedicated agent session per task.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化看板，支持 Gitea 任务、工作流列和每任务独立 Agent 会话。

description.en: Tool-output repair layer for DeepSeek Harness — JSON schema enforcement, parameter mapping, and JSON repair for tool calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的工具输出修复层：JSON Schema 校验、参数映射与 JSON 修复。

description.en: Live skill provider that adds skills from 60+ other agents' directories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot), Claude Code plugin marketplaces, and any git repository of skills to the dsh catalog without copying or symlinking; deduplicates, repairs frontmatter, renames name collisions, and ships a CLI (list, add, sync, doctor).
description.zh: 实时技能提供器：把 60+ 个其他 Agent（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Copilot）的技能目录、Claude Code 插件市场以及任意 git 技能仓库中的技能接入 dsh 目录，零拷贝零软链接；自动去重、修复 frontmatter、处理同名冲突，并附带 CLI（list、add、sync、doctor）。

description.en: Runs the agent's shell and file tools in disposable Podman containers, so its access is constrained to the workspace project by default, and adds container, image, volume and secret management with approval-gated control.
description.zh: 让 agent 的 shell 与文件工具在一次性 Podman 容器中运行，默认只能访问工作区项目；同时提供容器、镜像、卷与机密管理，部分操作需审批。

description.en: One shared Obsidian vault for every agent: dependency-free Python core (search/promote/adjudicate/forget), vault template, dsh plugin (memory_search/show/submit/status).
description.zh: 多 Agent 共享一个 Obsidian vault：零依赖 Python core（检索/晋升/裁决/遗忘）+ vault 模板 + dsh 插件（memory_search/show/submit/status）。

description.en: Turns your AI agent application into an interactive workspace for ideation and design, with editable panels, structured knowledge and guided iteration.
description.zh: 将你的 AI 智能体应用升级为交互式构思设计工作台，通过可编辑面板、结构化知识与有目的的循环推荐，协作完成复杂任务。

description.en: Provides six code quality skills for code review, architecture audits, technical debt, test quality, health dashboards, and remediation.
description.zh: 提供六个代码质量技能，涵盖代码审查、架构审计、技术债、测试质量、健康看板与修复。

description.en: Recycle bin for DSH sessions: sidebar delete icons, multi-select restore and permanent delete, live-session protection.
description.zh: DSH 会话回收站：侧边栏删除图标、多选还原与彻底删除、活跃会话保护。

description.en: Controls the Chrome you are already logged into: the model clicks, types, fills in forms, reads pages, takes screenshots and downloads files in your real tabs, including inside same-origin iframes. Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux; needs Chrome 116+ and Node 18+. Works over native messaging and chrome.debugger instead of a listening port. Ships 12 browser_* tools and a cb CLI, dispatches real CDP input events, draws an on-page cursor that also appears in screenshots, and adds a toolbar panel with live status, the controlled tabs and a pause switch. browser_download saves a link, an element's target or a URL with the site's login cookies (following redirects, keeping the server's file name) to the Downloads folder or the session's working directory; cross-origin iframes are named in the snapshot but not entered. The native host and the MV3 extension travel inside this tarball: on first load the plugin copies them into place and writes the native-messaging registration itself, so there is no clone, no install.sh and no python3 - the one step left is adding the extension to Chrome: install DSH Bridge from the Chrome Web Store (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo, no Developer mode), or load the bundled unpacked copy at chrome://extensions (the plugin opens that page and puts the folder on the clipboard for you). Until then the tools fail loudly with those steps. On Windows the registration goes into the registry (for Chrome and Edge) and the host talks over a named pipe. A daily CI run on GitHub's macOS, Windows and Linux machines installs the plugin, loads the extension into a real Chrome and reads a page through the browser_* tools.
