description.zh: 操作你已经登录的 Chrome：模型在你真实的标签页里点击、打字、填表、读网页、截图、下载文件，同源 iframe 里的内容也能读能点。支持 macOS、Windows、Linux；需要 Chrome 116+ 与 Node 18+。走 native messaging 与 chrome.debugger，不开监听端口。提供 12 个 browser_* 原生工具和一个 cb 命令行，发送真实 CDP 输入事件，绘制会出现在截图里的页内光标，并带一个工具栏面板（连接状态、正在控制的标签页、暂停开关）。browser_download 带着这个网站的登录 Cookie 下载链接、元素指向的文件或网址（跟随跳转、用服务器给的文件名），存进「下载」文件夹或会话的工作目录；跨站 iframe 只在快照里标出来，不进去读。宿主（原生宿主 + MV3 扩展）随本 tarball 一起发：插件首次加载时自己把它们落盘并写好 native messaging 注册，不用 clone 仓库、不用 install.sh、不用 python3——只剩把扩展装进 Chrome：从 Chrome 应用商店装 DSH Bridge（https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo，不用开发者模式），或者到 chrome://extensions 加载自带的已解压扩展（插件会替你打开那个页面并把文件夹放进剪贴板）。没装好之前，工具会带着这几步明确报错。Windows 上注册写进注册表（Chrome 和 Edge 都写），宿主走命名管道。每天在 GitHub 的 macOS / Windows / Linux 机器上自动跑一遍：装插件、把扩展加载进真 Chrome、用 browser_* 工具读一个网页。

description.en: SSH/SFTP remote workspaces with conflict-aware mirror sync, port forwarding, and a native Web UI.
description.zh: 支持冲突感知镜像同步、端口转发和原生 Web UI 的 SSH/SFTP 远程工作区。

description.en: OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin.
description.zh: OpenPencil 设计预览与编辑插件。

description.en: Brings the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop logins on this machine into DeepSeek Harness as OpenAI-compatible local endpoints, with an account pool, automatic account switching when WorkBuddy is rate limited, and a settings panel.
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 的桌面登录接进 DeepSeek Harness，每家一个 OpenAI 兼容的本地端点，带账号池、限流自动换号与设置面板。

description.en: Provider quota and balance status widget for the DSH web UI, showing remaining quota, usage and rate-limit windows in a dock at the bottom of the composer. Local fork of wenzetan/dsh-quota-panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 端的供应商额度与余额状态小组件，在输入框底部的停靠区展示剩余额度、用量与限流窗口。wenzetan/dsh-quota-panel 的本地分叉。

description.en: QQ tools for DSH with group and private messaging, chat history, favorite stickers, pokes, friend management, and Qzone integration. Requires SnowLuma.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 QQ 群聊与私聊收发、聊天记录、收藏表情、戳一戳、好友管理和 QQ 空间功能，仅支持 SnowLuma。

description.en: Multi-threaded downloader plugin for DeepSeek Harness with bundled aria2: probes the target for Range support, then picks aria2 (4 or 8 connections by file size) or falls back to curl.
description.zh: DSH 多线程下载插件，内置 aria2：先探测目标是否支持 Range，再按文件大小选择 aria2（4 或 8 连接）或回退 curl 单线程下载。

description.en: Live2D desk pet overlay for the DSH web GUI: mirrors agent state (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval) with motions and speech bubbles, per-part touch reactions, drag-to-dock, switchable personas, and custom models via URL or local path.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠悬浮层：镜像 agent 思考/空闲/出错/完成/待审批状态，配动画与气泡，支持分部位触摸反应、拖动停靠、切换人设，以及通过 URL 或本地路径加载自定义模型。

description.en: Pairs a phone console with the current DSH Desktop conversation. Running /phone shows a one-time QR code; after pairing the phone can send messages, approve tool calls, switch models and stop the task, while the desktop stays the only execution host. Requires AgentBridge running locally.
description.zh: 把手机控制台接到当前这条 DSH Desktop 会话：执行 /phone 出现一次性二维码，扫码后可从手机发消息、审批工具调用、切换模型和停止任务，电脑仍是唯一执行端。需本机运行 AgentBridge。

description.en: Backup and restore for dsh-mnemon: pick any of its three memory components (memory spaces, project documents, runtime memory) and archive them to S3-compatible storage or WebDAV, then browse the archives and restore a chosen subset. Live SQLite databases are copied through node:sqlite backup() so a concurrent writer cannot tear the copy; every file carries a SHA-256 checked before upload and again before restore; a restore previews by default and deletes the stale -wal/-shm sidecars before writing a database back. Archives are named mnemon-sync-<device>-<timestamp>.zip so backups from several machines stay tellable apart. Runs a single timer with intervals from hourly to weekly, stores credentials in a 0600 file outside the DSH profile, and depends on nothing outside Node.
description.zh: 给 dsh-mnemon 做备份与恢复：它的三类记忆组件（记忆空间、项目档案、运行时记忆）可任选，打包到 S3 兼容存储或 WebDAV，之后可浏览备份列表并只恢复选中的部分。SQLite 库经 node:sqlite 的 backup() 在线复制，写入方同时写也不会撕开副本；每个文件带 SHA-256，上传前校验一次、恢复前再校验一次；恢复默认只做预览，写回数据库前会先删掉残留的 -wal/-shm。备份文件名是 mnemon-sync-<设备名>-<时间戳>.zip，多台机器备份到同一目录也能分辨来源。定时器只有一个，间隔从每小时到每周；凭据存在 DSH profile 之外的 0600 文件里；除 Node 外没有其他依赖。

description.en: Local code intelligence for DSH: Impact X-Ray visualizes potential change impact with inspectable source evidence and uncertainty; also provides symbol navigation, bounded Context Packs and ArkTS support.
description.zh: DSH 本地代码智能插件：Impact X-Ray 可视化展示潜在变更影响、源码证据与不确定性，并提供符号导航、有界 Context Pack 和 ArkTS 支持。

description.en: Use plugins from ecosystems such as Claude Code and Codex in DSH: add Git plugin sources and marketplaces, upload plugins and skills, add MCP servers, automatically discover and toggle local skills, and manage plugins, skills and MCP in one place, including plugin-provided subagents, Hooks and LSP.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 Claude Code、Codex 等软件生态的插件，一站式管理插件、Skills 与 MCP。支持添加 Git 插件源和 marketplace、上传插件和 Skills、添加 MCP 服务器，自动扫描并开关本地 Skills，接入插件提供的子代理、MCP、Hooks 与 LSP。

description.en: Per-Session OpenRouter routing: a loopback relay writes `service_tier`, `provider.sort` and the `:floor` variant into each request from one of nine presets picked on the composer chip, with a pinned base URL per preset for route-level defaults.
description.zh: 按会话切换 OpenRouter 路由：本地回环中继把 `service_tier`、`provider.sort` 与 `:floor` 变体写进每个请求，九个预设从输入框的按钮里选，每个预设另有固定的基址供整条路由使用。

description.en: Drive your local DSH from WeChat: a self-hosted iLink bridge over a persistent ACP session (context lives in DSH and is resumable), phone conversations grouped into the desktop workspace, with image recognition, file messages (Excel/Word/PDF, parsed by the agent itself) and voice transcripts. Tool approvals are answered inside WeChat itself (numbered card; ask/allow/reject policy; 120s timeout means reject), and any process can push a message to your phone through the outbox helper. Access defaults to strict (only registered devices are served); the phone channel's permission preset is configurable - see the README security section before sharing the bot.
description.zh: 手机微信驱动本机 DSH：自建 iLink 桥 + 常驻 ACP 原生会话（上下文归 DSH、可 resume），手机会话自动登记进桌面工作区；支持图片识别、直接发文件（Excel/Word/PDF，由会话里的 agent 自行解析）与语音转写。审批可在微信里应答（编号卡片，ask/allow/reject 策略，超时按拒绝），任何进程也能通过 outbox 推送把消息发到手机。准入默认 strict（只服务已登记设备）；手机通道权限预设可配置，详见 README 安全基线。

description.en: Deep-read books and articles in five modes (quick, deep, knowledge map, Feynman, full book) with claim-evidence-data reports, Mermaid/XMind mindmaps, batch comparison, budget preflight, transparent background-job progress, and MD/HTML exports from URLs, files, or pasted text.
description.zh: 五种模式精读图书与文章（快速/深度/知识地图/费曼/全书），输出观点—证据—数据报告、四档置信度、Mermaid/XMind 思维导图，支持批量对比、预算预检与后台任务进度透明，可导出 MD/MM/HTML。

description.en: Gitea and Forgejo integration for DeepSeek Harness with issue, pull-request and worktree tools plus a Git status chip.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成 Gitea 与 Forgejo，提供 issue、拉取请求和 worktree 工具及 Git 状态芯片。

description.en: Autonomic heartbeat for each root agent: silent pulses diff the session's todos, Agent Team board and goal against what the last pulse saw, and speak only on a signal — L1 report, L2 ask (ask_user_question), L4 escalate — never starting work. Each message carries a why-now line, an optional one-line physiology signature (time since your last message and how many times it has reached out today) and a compact task snapshot (800-char cap); a dedupe window, quiet hours, a daily budget, refractory/restart cooldowns and persisted vitals keep it quiet, while busy-safe followup injection never stacks. It shares one advisory speech floor with dsh-plugin-memory (~/.dsh/proactive-cooldown.json, 180 s) so the two never talk over each other, stays silent while a child subagent or teammate is still working, and surfaces a "subagents working · N" pill in the conversation header (polling pauses while the tab is hidden). v0.8 adds a diagnostics panel that explains recent quiet pulses and names the current speech-floor holder, plus panel controls for the arbitration window, presence suppression and the physiology line; its settings section carries a stroked heart mark (16×16, stroke 1.3, same spec as dsh-plugin-memory). v0.8.1 makes the plugin compatible with DSH 0.2.2-rc.2: the agent registry is read with agents.roots() when available and falls back to agents.list() on rc.2, and every agent/created listener is exception-guarded — on rc.2 an unguarded throw there rejects agent registration and no session can be created, so rc.2 users must upgrade to 0.8.1 or newer.
description.zh: 给每个根 agent 装一套自主神经心跳：静默拍会 diff 会话的待办 / 团队任务板 / 目标，只有出现信号才开口（L1 汇报 / L2 提问 / L4 升级），只问不做。每条消息带 why-now 行、可选的一行生理签名（距你上次说话多久、今天第几次找你）与紧凑任务快照（800 字符上限）；去重窗口、静默时段、每日预算、不应期 / 重启冷却与持久化生命体征共同限流，忙碌时 followup 注入排队不打断。它与 dsh-plugin-memory 共享一个建议性发言权（~/.dsh/proactive-cooldown.json，默认 180 秒）互不抢话，子 agent / teammate 仍在运行时保持静默，并在会话头部显示「子智能体执行中 · N」胶囊（标签页隐藏时暂停轮询）。v0.8 新增诊断面板（解释最近几次为何没开口并显示当前发言权持有者）与面板内可调的仲裁窗口 / 在场抑制 / 生理签名开关；设置区块带专属描边爱心标记（16×16 / stroke 1.3，与 dsh-plugin-memory 规格一致）。v0.8.1 兼容 DSH 0.2.2-rc.2：agent 注册表优先 agents.roots()、缺失时回退 agents.list()，所有 agent/created 监听器都做了异常保护——rc.2 下未保护的抛错会让 agent 注册被拒、无法新建会话，因此 rc.2 用户必须升级到 0.8.1 或更新版本。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy.
description.zh: 朗读助手回复（仅支持 Fish Audio API，需自备 Key）：逐条朗读、自动朗读开关，设置页可配模型、音色 reference_id、加密 API Key 与代理。

description.en: Reworks the DSH shell into a compact layout: a denser session sidebar, a status card at the bottom of the sidebar, and a project and task-line view that groups sessions by what they are working on.
description.zh: 把 DSH 外壳改成紧凑形态：更密的会话侧栏、侧栏底部状态卡，以及按「在做什么」给会话分组的项目与任务线视图。

description.en: DeepTutor tutoring bridge: deep explanations, self-test questions, learning-path planning, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and note archiving via deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note tools.
description.zh: DeepTutor 学习辅导桥接插件：通过 deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note 工具为 agent 接入深度讲解、自测题、学习路径规划、个人知识库检索（RAG）与笔记归档。

description.en: Discord adapter that installs into a dsh web or desktop profile: @mentions and threads bind to sessions with streaming replies and live tool-activity rows, nine slash commands cover workspace binding, permission presets and model selection, and tool approvals and user questions are claimed by whichever of Discord or the web UI answers first, behind a deny-first guild allowlist.
description.zh: 装进 dsh web / desktop profile 的 Discord 适配器：@提及与线程绑定会话，回复流式渲染并带实时工具活动行；九条斜杠命令覆盖工作区绑定、权限预设和模型选择；工具审批与提问在 Discord 与 web 端谁先答谁生效；guild 白名单默认拒绝。

description.en: Jina provider for embeddings and reranking in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供嵌入和重排序能力的 Jina 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: A vertical preview market for DeepSeek Harness: discover preview plugins, inspect the installed inventory, and install, enable/disable or configure them through dsh-market or the dsh CLI. One-click install and enable/disable need dsh-market; without it each card only shows a copyable install command.
description.zh: DSH 垂直预览市场：发现预览插件、查看已安装清单，并通过 dsh-market 或 dsh CLI 安装、启用/停用与配置。一键安装与启用/停用依赖 dsh-market；没有它时卡片只显示可复制的安装命令。

description.en: Connects free and check-in account channels to DeepSeek: Huawei Cloud CodeArts, Tencent CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy, Qoder, TRAE, Raccoon, LobsterAI, MiniMax, ZCode and iFlytek Loomy. Sign in to each channel in settings, claim the daily check-in where the channel offers one, sync the available model pool, and use those models as ordinary providers in the model picker, with a local usage dashboard that counts requests and tokens per account and model. Credentials stay in ~/.dsh/get-it-for-free/ on this machine; no telemetry and no requests to upstream repositories. Its optional LAN relay is off by default and listens on 0.0.0.0 when you enable it.
description.zh: 把免费、签到型的模型账号渠道接进 DeepSeek：华为云 CodeArts、腾讯 CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy、Qoder、TRAE、Raccoon、LobsterAI、MiniMax、ZCode、讯飞 Loomy。在设置里逐渠道登录，能签到的渠道每日签到（也可开自动），同步可用模型池，模型以普通 provider 的形式出现在模型选择器里，并带本机用量看板按账号与模型统计请求数与 Token。凭据只写在本机 ~/.dsh/get-it-for-free/，无遥测，不向上游仓库发请求。可选的局域网中继默认关闭，开启后监听 0.0.0.0。

description.en: Manage Claude Code, Codex and Grok CLIs inside dsh and dispatch tasks to them as headless subagents, with dsh models, skills and tools bridged into each task, resumable CLI subsessions, and a hierarchical task board in the right sidebar (the board tab requires the separate DSH-better-sidebar plugin; without it the tab is not registered).
description.zh: 在 dsh 中管理 Claude Code / Codex / Grok CLI，并把任务派发给它们作为子智能体执行：dsh 的模型、技能与工具随任务桥接，CLI 子会话可回放续聊，右侧栏提供分层任务看板（看板 tab 需另装 DSH-better-sidebar 插件，未安装时不会注册）。

description.en: Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates.
description.zh: 子代理 LLM 供应商/模型选择，支持角色模板。

description.en: Drives a locally installed Moli headless browser from DeepSeek Harness: rendered fetch, JavaScript evaluation, Markdown, semantic trees, screenshots and PDFs. A CSS selector returns one container rather than the whole page (measured 40-80x fewer tokens on listing pages) and scroll triggers lazy loading. Installs Moli when it is missing; verified with a real engine on Windows, Linux and macOS.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动本机安装的 Moli 无头浏览器：渲染抓取、JavaScript 求值、Markdown、语义树、截图与 PDF。用 CSS 选择器只取某个容器而不是整页（列表页实测省 40–80 倍 token），并支持滚动触发懒加载。Moli 缺失时自动安装；已在 Windows、Linux 与 macOS 上用真实引擎验证。

description.en: Hides other memory plugins' context sections and tools inside a chosen DSH preset, so that session gets a clean context. Off by default; ships a read-only diagnostic tool.
description.zh: 在指定 DSH preset 里挡掉其他记忆插件的上下文段与工具，让该会话拿到干净上下文。bundle 形态、默认关闭，带只读诊断工具。

description.en: Reads a GitNexus index in the DSH sidebar, reports skipped files, index freshness and language coverage, searches symbols, and reviews recent Git activity.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏读取 GitNexus 索引，报告被跳过的文件、索引新鲜度与语言覆盖，支持符号搜索和最近的 Git 活动审查。

description.en: Model-facing `vision` tool for DeepSeek Harness: describe and OCR image files by calling the free Zhipu GLM vision API directly (glm-4v-flash fallback chain), no external CLI required.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型补上免费识图：`vision` 工具直连智谱 GLM 视觉 API 描述/OCR 图片文件（glm-4v-flash 降级链），无需任何外部 CLI。

description.en: Hash-anchored read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit tools: every line gets a unique 3-character content hash, edits target hashes instead of line numbers, and served-state verification rejects stale ranges with fresh anchors.
description.zh: 基于哈希锚定的 read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit 工具：每行分配唯一的 3 字符内容哈希，编辑按哈希而非行号定位；对已提供状态逐行校验，过期范围会被拒绝并回传新锚点。

description.en: Manage DSH sessions the way Windows Explorer manages files: move, delete, search, archive, favorite and flag sessions as to-dos, and organize them with tags, notes and folders across workspaces. An AI pass can summarize a session and write its notes and tags in one go.
description.zh: 像 Windows 资源管理器那样管理 DSH 的会话：进行会话转移、删除、搜索、归档、收藏、待办等操作，对您的会话进行标签、备注，使用文件夹分组，方便地管理您的会话和工作区。同时也可以调用 AI 对您的会话进行一键总结、备注、修改标签。

description.en: A web theme recreating the DeepSeek Harness homepage with a fluid background, an elastic pointer grid, animated fish, and adjustable effects.
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Harness 首页视觉的 Web 主题，提供流体背景、鼠标弹性网格、动态小鱼与可调节效果。

description.en: Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) theme: cinematic wallpaper, comet-blue glassmorphism, movie logo swap and unified scrollbars for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 《你的名字。》主题：电影壁纸、彗星蓝玻璃拟态、电影 Logo 替换与统一滚动条。

description.en: Fronts stdio MCP servers with three router tools (list_capabilities, describe_tool, call_tool) so schemas load on demand instead of riding every request; shapes every tool result through a deterministic output ladder that archives the original first (retrieve_spill reads it back); prices tool groups in tokens and can hide built-in groups per agent. Bridges to a standard-library Python router, so Python 3.9+ is required.
description.zh: 用三个路由工具（list_capabilities、describe_tool、call_tool）代理 stdio MCP 服务器，schema 按需加载，不再随每次请求发送；所有工具结果经过确定性输出阶梯压缩，有损处理前先归档原文（retrieve_spill 可读回）；按 token 为工具分组标价，并可按 agent 隐藏内置分组。桥接到纯标准库的 Python 路由器，需要 Python 3.9+。

description.en: Performance profiling and LLM cache diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness — context engineering, latency profiling, and cache behavior reports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的性能剖析与 LLM 缓存诊断：上下文工程、延迟剖析与缓存行为报告。

description.en: Unofficial Grok integration for eligible X Subscription, SuperGrok, or X Premium accounts: shared Grok CLI OAuth, chat with optional main-loop web/X search, and experimental image generation, image editing, and video generation (all media features disabled by default).
description.zh: 面向符合资格的 X Subscription、SuperGrok 或 X Premium 账号的非官方 Grok 集成：共用 Grok CLI OAuth 登录，支持对话及可选的主循环网页/X 搜索；实验性的图片生成、图生图编辑和视频生成均默认关闭，需主动开启。

description.en: Open source links from DeepSeek Harness conversations at the referenced line, review Git diffs beside the chat, inspect paused variables, and turn explanations into searchable Markdown memory cards. The workbench also shows Python class relationships (beta). Go and Java navigation require language servers, and breakpoint debugging requires a debug adapter.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 对话点击源码链接，直接跳到指定行。在右侧工作台查看 Git 差异和断点变量，也可以把讲解保存为可搜索的 Markdown 记忆卡片。支持 Python 类关系图（Beta）。Go 和 Java 跳转需要语言服务器，断点调试需要调试适配器。

description.en: Windows native toast notifications for DSH desktop sessions: turn ends, approvals, questions and a reminder for an unanswered wait — each with its own sound and popup text (up to three named templates per situation), three delivery modes, previews, and imported custom sounds. Clicking a toast raises the DSH window.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端会话的 Windows 原生 Toast 通知：回合结束、审批、提问与未应答催办，每个情况可单独选择音效与弹窗文本（每个情况最多 3 套命名模板），支持三种通知形式、预览效果与导入自定义音效；点击通知把 DSH 窗口拉回前台。

description.en: Read-only tools for cadpop.com: parametric template list, help-center pages and drawing-tools page, plus links to the DFM check and the online editor, across 5 tools. Network-only.
description.zh: cadpop.com 只读工具：参数化模板清单、帮助中心页面与图纸工具页，另提供 DFM 检查与在线编辑器的入口链接，共 5 个工具。仅网络访问。

description.en: Provider-aware account balance chip for the DSH sidebar, showing the active model provider balance for DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM, and MiniMax, plus DeepSeek peak/off-peak status.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的账户余额胶囊，跟随当前模型的服务商显示余额，支持 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Moonshot/Kimi、Zhipu/GLM 与 MiniMax，并显示 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段。

description.en: A Multitask agent preset where the main conversation only plans, briefs subagents and summarizes results, while file reads, commands, search and builds run inside subagent contexts; four worker kinds, an approval gate for dangerous operations, and zero changes to DSH source.
description.zh: Multitask 减震器模式（Agent preset）：主对话只做需求理解、任务下发与结果汇总，读文件、跑命令、搜索与构建全部下放子代理；含四类 worker、危险操作审批闸门，且零 DSH 源码改动。

description.en: A lightweight, DSH-native code editor with intelligent coding assistance, minimizing reliance on external IDEs.
description.zh: 轻量化 DSH 原生代码编辑器，集成智能编程辅助能力，减少对外部 IDE 的依赖。

description.en: Desktop and webhook alerts on macOS, Linux and Windows when an agent finishes a turn, errors, or waits for approval — zero-dependency native notifications (osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast) plus a Slack-compatible webhook, with a configurable minimum turn duration.
description.zh: 桌面与 webhook 通知：任务完成、出错或等待审批时提醒；零依赖，走系统自带的 osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast，并支持 Slack 兼容的 webhook，可配置最短回合时长。

description.en: Bank statement reconciliation: ingest CAMT.053 and MT940, match them against ledger entries and export the workpaper — 6 `bankrec.*` tools.
description.zh: 银行对账单核对：导入 CAMT.053 与 MT940，与账簿条目匹配并导出工作底稿——6 个 `bankrec.*` 工具。

description.en: One-tap connect ModelScope language and image-generation models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and context window filled in automatically. You can also see the free Magicube balance, jump to a model's info page, and record local call counts, trends and rate-limit events, with a usage pill beside the input box showing the balance and today's local count. All of it needs only an API key, with no account sign-in.
description.zh: 一键接入魔搭社区的语言、生图模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与上下文窗口；还可查看免费魔粒余额、跳转到模型信息页，记录本地调用计数、趋势、限流事件，输入框旁另有用量胶囊显示余额与今日本地调用次数。上述功能仅需填入 API key，不需要登录账号。

description.en: Forge quality gates for DeepSeek Harness: task gates, read-before-edit, bash hazard interception and quality scoring, enforced by the local forge CLI through DSH's typed interception points. Requires the forge CLI on PATH; without it the plugin fails open and says so with a best-effort notice at session start, and task gates also need forge init in the project.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Forge 质量门禁：任务门禁、改前必读、危险命令拦截与质量评分，经 DSH 类型化拦截点由本地 forge CLI 执行。需本机安装 forge CLI，缺失时插件 fail-open 并在会话开始时尽力提示；任务门禁还要求项目已执行 forge init。

description.en: Vendor marks in the model picker plus a model list kept in step with the provider: mirrors the public catalog and logos to loopback, and regenerates the pi-ai route's models from that route's own endpoint, showing the drift before anything is written.
description.zh: 在模型选择器中显示厂商标志，并让模型列表与提供方保持同步：把公开目录与标志镜像到本地回环地址，再依据路由自身的接口重新生成 pi-ai 路由的模型列表，写入之前先显示差异。

description.en: Ocean-blue theme for the DSH web interface: swimming fish, rising bubbles, a daily-quote ticker above the input box, and a replacement brand area; Settings → Marine Theme exposes 7 groups and 32 options (brand text and size, badge, primary color, watermark, fish, quotes, overall scale) that apply instantly without a reload, plus a two-step reset to defaults.
description.zh: 海洋蓝主题：游动鱼群、上升气泡、输入框上方的「每日鱼语」，以及左上角品牌区替换；「设置 → 海洋主题」提供 7 组 32 项可调（品牌文字与字号、徽章、主色、水印、鱼群、语录、整体缩放），改动即时生效无需刷新，并带二次确认的一键恢复默认。

description.en: Wraps the Scrapling Python library in up to nineteen model tools, registered by probed capability: real-browser rendering for JavaScript-only pages, CSS/XPath extraction that returns data instead of Markdown, self-healing selectors, reusable login-state sessions, XHR capture, page screenshots, gated browser actions and a domain-scoped crawler with content/sitemap/feed/Shopify modes on the official job backend. It can also replace the built-in web_fetch / web_search, and serve the same tool table over MCP. Requires Python 3.14+ with Scrapling installed; the browser tools also need a Chromium engine for patchright, which an optional CLI installs on macOS arm64 only.
description.zh: 把 Scrapling Python 库包成最多十九个模型工具，按探测到的能力注册：为纯 JavaScript 页面上真实浏览器渲染、用 CSS/XPath 取出结构化数据而不是 Markdown、选择器自愈、可复用的登录态会话、XHR 抓取、页面截图、受部署门禁的浏览器动作，以及在官方作业后端上跑的限定域爬虫（content/sitemap/feed/Shopify 四种模式）。它还能顶替内置的 web_fetch / web_search，并把同一份工具表通过 MCP 端出。需要 Python 3.14+ 且装好 Scrapling；浏览器工具还需要 patchright 的 Chromium 引擎，可选的 CLI 只在 macOS arm64 上装得起来。

description.en: Owner workbench for independently connected family WeChat assistants, per-member project and tool permissions, scheduled services and delivery status; API acceptance does not confirm receipt.
description.zh: 通过 Owner 工作台管理家人各自连接的微信助手、按人授予项目和工具权限、安排服务并查看投递状态；接口接受不代表手机实收。

description.en: Browser provider for DeepSeek Harness: hand it a web task — open a page, click, type, fill a form, read what is on it — and it drives a real browser step by step, seeing an indexed table of what can be done on the current page instead of raw HTML or screenshots. Each step is one bundled-Jev decision rather than a full model turn (1.1 s median per step versus 2.8–3.6 s for chat-model turns in the repo benchmark), and the main conversation receives only the conclusion, so its context does not grow with the page. Targets come from the page it just read and a changed page is re-read rather than clicked blind, and it runs in the browser that Session owns, leaving your everyday Chrome untouched unless you switch to attach mode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 浏览器插件：把网页任务交给它——打开页面、点击、输入、填表、读取页面内容——它会驱动真实浏览器一步步完成，每步只看到“当前页面能做什么”的索引表，而不是原始 HTML 或截图。每步由内置 Jev 引擎决策一次，而非大模型整轮推理（仓库基准中每步决策中位 1.1 秒，大模型整轮 2.8–3.6 秒）；主对话只收到结论，上下文不随页面变长。目标取自它刚读到的页面，页面变化就重新读取而非盲点；每个会话用自己的浏览器，不碰你日常的 Chrome（除非切到 attach 模式）。

description.en: Conversation management for DSH: bulk-archive idle conversations (archiving only marks them; by default it also sends their snapshot ledgers to the Windows Recycle Bin), permanently delete conversations after confirmation, star the ones worth keeping, undo the last reply with a per-turn snapshot, and clean up snapshots and archived files from one panel. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: DSH 对话管理工具箱：按闲置批量归档（归档只做标记，默认顺带把快照账本送进 Windows 回收站），确认后可永久删除对话；收藏常看会话；按轮次撤销回复并保留轮次快照；一键清理快照与归档档案。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Card-style plugin manager in Settings: enable/disable each plugin through the profile patch layer, install-source details, npm update check with one-click update, uninstall, search, and load-error badges.
description.zh: 设置页卡片式插件管理：经 profile 补丁层启停插件（跨重启保留）、安装来源详情、npm 更新检查与一键更新、卸载、搜索与加载失败标识。

description.en: Runtime-switchable model output styles with Claude Code outputStyles parity, plus the output.render.* presentation protocol: a /style command, per-session persistence, systemPrompt injection, six built-in styles, a web picker, and a renderer registry with per-session/per-tool rules and /export.
description.zh: 运行时切换模型输出风格（对标 Claude Code outputStyles），另加 output.render.* 呈现协议：/style 命令、按会话持久化、systemPrompt 注入、六个内置风格、Web 选择器，以及带按会话/按工具规则与 /export 的渲染器注册表。

description.en: Checks installed DSH plugins for version-declaration and API risks against the current host, with source locations when available, certainty, impact basis and coverage limits. Adds a compatibility settings panel, plugin-detail findings/badges, a compat_check agent tool and a skill provider.
description.zh: 检查已装 DSH 插件相对当前宿主的版本声明与 API 风险，报告可用源码位置、确定度、影响依据和覆盖限制。提供兼容性设置面板、插件详情发现与角标、compat_check 对话工具及 skill provider。

description.en: Terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness on jump hosts and high-latency links: plain ANSI, incremental repaint, and a session that survives a dropped SSH connection (resume it from the log).
description.zh: 跳板机与高延迟 SSH 上的 DeepSeek Harness 终端：纯 ANSI、增量重绘；SSH 掉线后会话不丢，可用 --resume 接回。

description.en: Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic, semantic, procedural and emotional memory with reinforcement-learning signals, a goal stack with time triggers, curiosity-driven autonomous web research and proactive initiatives.
description.zh: 受大脑启发的认知插件:情景、语义、程序与情绪记忆,带强化学习信号;目标栈支持时间触发器,好奇心驱动的自主网络研究与主动提议。

description.en: Learning-mode agent preset for DSH with a topic knowledge base: answers retrieve from your own stored cards and cite the card they came from, mark anything not found as unverified, and only go online when verification is required. The sidebar panel browses topics, searches and edits cards, and every card can be AI-reviewed, verified, rolled back and versioned. Cards can reference each other with `[[title]]` links; the panel shows both outgoing links and which cards reference the one you are reading. New cards arrive as a preview you confirm before they enter the library; topic and card names are editable in the UI. The knowledge base is plain local files, not an automatic scraper.
description.zh: 学习模式 agent 预设 + 主题知识库：回答先从你自己存的卡片里检索，命中就标出处，查不到标「未验证」，必须查证才联网；侧边栏面板按主题浏览、搜索、编辑卡片，每张卡可 AI 校验补充、核实、回退和看版本；卡片之间可以用 `[[标题]]` 互链，面板里能看到「它连着谁」和「谁引用了它」；新卡片先出预览，确认后才入库；主题名和卡片名都能在界面里改。知识库是本地普通文件，不做后台自动抓取。

description.en: Drive OriginLab Origin scientific plotting from AI chat via MCP: 62 tools. Modal-dialog watchdog, LabTalk safety gate, release/reconnect, fit with initial/fixed/weighted params, fine-grained plot and sheet edits, matrix tools, FigureSpec declarative YAML (diff-able and replayable), MCP Resources read-only snapshot, matplotlib-figure bridge, PowerPoint assembly with panel labels, Graph Gallery template search, EPS export, file-access whitelist, visual regression baseline, and editable OPJU delivery with deterministic readback verification.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 在 AI 对话里驱动 OriginLab Origin 科学绘图与分析：62 个工具。模态对话框看门狗、LabTalk 破坏命令门禁、释放/重连、拟合初值/固定参数/加权、细粒度图与工作表编辑、矩阵工具、FigureSpec 声明式 YAML（可 diff 可重放）、MCP Resources 只读会话快照、matplotlib 图桥接、PowerPoint 组图、Graph Gallery 模板搜索、EPS 导出、文件访问白名单、视觉基准回归，以及带确定性反读验证的可编辑 OPJU 交付。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance at the bottom of the sidebar, with a configuration card on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在插件页提供配置卡。

description.en: Media and vision workspace for DeepSeek Harness: image, video and speech generation, image Q&A and element locating, long-image OCR, pixel diff, HTML-screenshot verification and video summarization, with DashScope and OpenAI-compatible providers, model pools and a workbench client.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的媒体与视觉工作台：文生图、图/文生视频、语音合成与转写、图像问答与元素定位、长图 OCR、像素比对、HTML 截图验证、视频摘要；支持 DashScope 与 OpenAI 兼容供应商，含模型池与工作台客户端。

description.en: Adds an animated ASCII whale ocean behind empty chats, with neutral frosted-glass input, visual color selection, light/dark support, and configurable whales, fish, grid and wakes.
description.zh: 在空白聊天背景中呈现 ASCII 鲸群与游鱼，提供中性毛玻璃输入框、可视化选色器、深浅色适配，以及鲸鱼、鱼群、栅格和尾迹参数设置。

description.en: Drag-and-drop / paste / upload files and images; on non-multimodal models images are auto-described by a configured VLM.
description.zh: 拖拽/粘贴/上传文件和图片，非多模态模型下图片自动调用已配置 VLM 识别。

description.en: Samples a video the way a person does instead of downloading it: metadata and chapters first, then timestamped frames as images, subtitle-first transcripts (local ASR only when the platform carries no subtitles), AudioSet 527-class sound tags and top comments — 21 tools sharing one on-disk cache behind a cross-process lock. Needs Python 3.10+, ffmpeg and the vidlens package (pip install vidlens-mcp); a missing install comes back with the two ways to fix it instead of a bare ImportError.
description.zh: 按人看片的顺序取样，而不是下载整片：先元数据与章节，再按时间码抽帧看画面、字幕优先转录（平台没有字幕才走本地 ASR）、AudioSet 527 类声音事件标签与高赞评论——21 个工具共用一个磁盘缓存，并带跨进程锁。需要 Python 3.10+、ffmpeg 与 vidlens 包（pip install vidlens-mcp）；缺依赖时回给你的是两种修法，而不是一句 ImportError。

description.en: Schedule a message into a dsh chat for later: a Schedule button in the message box with a date and time picker, a sidebar panel of pending messages across chats, delivery as a normal user message even with the browser closed, and schedule_message, list_scheduled_messages and cancel_scheduled_message tools so the model can come back to a chat on its own.
description.zh: 把消息排进 dsh 会话稍后再发：消息框里带日期与时间选择器的「定时」按钮、跨会话列出待发消息的侧栏面板、浏览器关着也由宿主按时投递成一条普通用户消息，以及 schedule_message / list_scheduled_messages / cancel_scheduled_message 三个工具，模型因而能自己回到某个会话。

description.en: All-media (video/audio/image) sibling of liustack/modlens: turns local media into structured evidence (timeline / transcript / layout regions) injected into the conversation so text-only models can cite concrete frames, seconds and speakers — Evidence, not imagination. One failover chain per media, recorded hop-by-hop in meta.attempts (a fallback is never silent): host-registered multimodal models first, then a configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint (comma-separated multi-key rotation), then local ffmpeg frame-sampling / a local ASR CLI, degrading to metadata-only as a last resort. Absorbs modlens battle-tested rules — cooldown keyed only on auth/quota failures and softened to chain-tail (never dropped), redact-before-clip error text, magic-byte sniff that never trusts file extensions. Optional vision-bridge registers a media-lens wrapper into the host model selector so a pure-text model gains image/audio/video sight. Registering / authenticating multimodal models and true inline audio-video upload lean on two companion plugins, declared as optional peers (absence auto-degrades, never errors): dsh-thinking-levels fronts the model config / registration surface, dsh-llm-openai-completions takes over the OpenAI-compatible transport that serializes file blocks into video_url / input_audio. Privacy: media goes to remote providers by default; strictLocalOnly keeps content on-machine. Prerequisites not shipped with the package: ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH (frame sampling / reencode / duration probe; degrades to metadata when missing) and a user-configured local ASR CLI for the audio fallback. Hosts 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 (6 rc, exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-media-lens.
description.zh: liustack/modlens 的全媒体（视频/音频/图像）延伸：把本地媒体转成结构化证据（时间线/转写/版面区域）注入对话，让纯文本模型能引用具体帧、秒、说话人——Evidence, not imagination。每个媒体一条 failover 链，逐跳记录在 meta.attempts（降级绝不静默）：宿主已注册全模态模型优先，其次自配 OpenAI-compatible 端点（逗号分隔多 key 轮换），再落到本地 ffmpeg 抽帧 / 本地 ASR CLI，末位仅元数据降级。吸收 modlens 实战经验——仅 auth/quota 类失败触发冷却且软化垫队尾（不剔除）、错误文本先脱密后截断、magic-byte 校验绝不信任扩展名。可选 vision-bridge 把透镜包装成模型选择器可见的 media-lens 包装 provider，让纯文本主力获得图/音/视频视野。多模态模型的注册/认证与真正的音视频直传依赖两个姊妹插件配合（均声明为 optional peer，未装则能力自动降级、不报错）：dsh-thinking-levels 承接模型配置录入/登记面，dsh-llm-openai-completions 做 OpenAI-compatible 传输接管、把 file 块序列化成 video_url / input_audio 真正上送。隐私：媒体缺省会发往远端 provider，开启 strictLocalOnly 则不出本机。不随包分发的安装前提：PATH 上的 ffmpeg/ffprobe（抽帧/重编码/时长探测，缺失时降为仅元数据），以及音频兜底需用户自备本地 ASR CLI。支持宿主 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 共 6 个 rc（engines.dsh 精确枚举）。npm 包名：dsh-media-lens。

description.en: A DSH context-compaction plugin: when the route supports images, it renders the middle of a session history into locally generated 1-bit bitmap frames for the vision model, while the exact head and tail, a bounded exact-token index and a FILES index stay as text.
description.zh: DSH 上下文压缩插件：路由支持图片时，把会话历史的中段在本地渲染成单色位图帧交给视觉模型阅读；精确的首尾文本、有上限的精确 token 索引与 FILES 文件索引仍以文字保留。

description.en: Delete a session from the UI (session-header button or sidebar row menu) or with the session_delete tool: stops and releases a running agent and its live session first, then removes the log directory, projection cache and workspace accounting, and cascades into the subagent sessions it owns while leaving forked branches untouched.
description.zh: 从界面删除会话（会话头部按钮或侧栏行菜单），或由 agent 调用 session_delete 工具：先停止并释放运行中的 Agent 与会话，再清理日志目录、投影缓存与工作区记账，级联删除它拥有的子代理会话（分叉分支不受影响）。

description.en: File encoding guard: byte-exact read/write/edit for GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS, EUC-KR, Windows-125x, UTF-16 and UTF-32 files, so editing a legacy file leaves it in its original encoding instead of silently rewriting it as UTF-8; UTF-8 BOM preserved exactly as it was, line endings (CRLF/LF/CR) kept, characters the encoding cannot represent refused rather than written as "?", and non-UTF-8 files listed with candidate encodings so the model can re-read them explicitly.
description.zh: 文件编码守护：为 GBK、Big5、Shift-JIS、EUC-KR、Windows-125x、UTF-16、UTF-32 文件提供字节级无损读写与编辑，改完仍是原编码而不是被悄悄转成 UTF-8；UTF-8 BOM 原样保留，CRLF/LF/CR 换行符保持，编码表示不了的字符拒绝写入而不是写成「?」；非 UTF-8 文件会列出候选编码，模型可显式指定重读。

description.en: Visually configure an agent's prompt, tools, visible skills, subagents and fallback models, and assemble several of them into a team. It never writes or edits any host preset file.
description.zh: 可视化地自定义配置 Agent 的提示词、工具、可见技能、子代理与备用模型，把它们编成一支团队。不写宿主的任何预设文件。

description.en: Sidebar panel for Agnes image and video generation that also ships a node canvas and a short-drama mode. Canvas nodes are chained by extracting the previous shot's tail frame with ffmpeg and submitting it as the next shot's first frame; short-drama mode turns an imported script into storyboard shots. Generation and polling run in the Host process, so tasks survive a page reload or a closed panel, and results plus an 80-entry history are stored on disk.
description.zh: 侧边栏 AI 创作面板，除生图与生视频外还带画布节点图和短剧模式：画布上用 ffmpeg 抽取上一镜尾帧，作为下一镜首帧自动串联；短剧模式可导入剧本拆解为分镜。生成与轮询都在宿主进程后台执行，刷新页面或关闭面板都不中断，结果与最多 80 条历史保存在本机。

description.en: Read-only page lookups for mfgabc.com: standards pages, industrial city guides, process clusters and cross-border compliance across 5 tools; each returns the page status, title and link, not full text. Network-only.
description.zh: mfgabc.com 只读页面查询：标准页、产业带城市指南、工艺集群与跨境合规，共 5 个工具；每个只返回页面状态、标题与链接，不含正文。仅网络访问。

description.en: Git worktree Session Targets with isolated task sessions, Ready for Review, reversible Local Preview, human-confirmed delivery, environment retention and recovery, and same-session iteration.
description.zh: Git Worktree Session Target：任务在隔离 Session 中运行，支持 Ready for Review、可撤回的 Local Preview、人工确认交付、环境保留与恢复，以及同一 Session 连续迭代。

description.en: Detects Minecraft mod and plugin projects (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Architectury, Paper) and runs their Gradle client or server task from the session header, with launch logs in a sidebar tab. One-shot tasks such as data generation and GameTest report a pass or fail verdict when they finish.
description.zh: 识别工作区里的 Minecraft 模组与插件工程（Fabric、Forge、NeoForge、Architectury、Paper），在会话标题栏运行 Gradle 的客户端或服务端任务，日志显示在侧栏标签；数据生成与 GameTest 这类会跑完的任务在结束时给出通过或失败的结论。

description.en: Build PowerPoint decks from a brief: plan and storyboard gates, per-page authoring through pptwise and ppt-master, a design-profile pass, page-image snapshots with a render audit, and a tool that hands those pages to an image-capable model for review.
description.zh: 从需求生成 PPTX：规划与分镜门、pptwise + ppt-master 页级作者、设计档案 pass、渲染页图快照与渲染审计，以及把页图交给支持图片的模型自评的工具。

description.en: Connects Qoder subscriptions to DeepSeek Harness, supporting Global and China regions, multimodal input, and tool calls.
description.zh: 将 Qoder 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持国际版与中国区、多模态与工具调用。

description.en: Bundles 19 short-video production skills (1 entry point, 1 orchestration, 17 atomic) into the agent skill catalog: Chinese TTS pronunciation fixes, text-to-image and text-to-video, image panning, composition, covers, media verification, data review and four-platform publishing. Ships skills and scripts only, so a runnable pipeline still needs ffmpeg, Python 3 + Pillow, Node.js and playwright installed locally, your own Bilibili biliup credential and WeChat Channels / Douyin / Xiaohongshu login states, and the placeholder values under skills/*/scripts/ filled in with your own. An installer's own skill of the same name keeps precedence.
description.zh: 把一条短视频生产流水线的 19 个 skill（1 总入口 + 1 编排 + 17 原子）内置进 agent 技能目录：中文配音读音校正、文生图与文生视频、图片运镜、成片合成、封面、成片核验、数据复盘、四平台发布。本包只提供 skill 与脚本，不安装任何工具：要真跑通流水线，还得本机装好 ffmpeg、Python 3 + Pillow、Node.js 与 playwright，自备 B 站 biliup 凭据和视频号 / 抖音 / 小红书登录态，并把 skills/*/scripts/ 里的占位符改成自己的值。使用者自己的同名 skill 优先级更高。

description.en: Bundles Google Chrome's Modern Web Guidance offline: three tools that search, retrieve and list 208 Baseline-aware web-platform guides, plus the modern-web-guidance and chrome-extensions skills.
description.zh: 离线内置 Google Chrome 的 Modern Web Guidance：三个工具用于搜索、读取和列出 208 篇关注 Baseline 兼容性的 Web 平台指南，另附 modern-web-guidance 与 chrome-extensions 两个技能。

description.en: Git workbench in the DSH session header and overlay: view changes, commit, fetch, pull, push, and browse branches and history in existing local repositories.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题栏与浮层工作台中管理已有本地仓库，支持查看改动、提交、获取、拉取、推送以及浏览分支和历史。

description.en: Pauses peak-hour requests that target official or listed models and lets everything else run, with editable peak windows, a per-model interception list and per-session free-run in the badge panel.
description.zh: 高峰时段只暂停指向官方或拦截列表内模型的请求，其余照常放行；峰谷时段、按模型的拦截列表与会话「畅跑」都能在徽标面板里编辑。

description.en: OpenCode free models for DSH with dynamic model-list refresh, optional HTTP(S)/SOCKS proxy failover, a fail-closed tool bridge and offline agent-scoped compatibility auditing.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode 免费模型，支持模型列表动态刷新与可选的代理出口轮换，并提供默认拒绝不安全转换的工具桥与离线、按 Agent 作用域的兼容性审计。

description.en: Fills in what the official pi-ai adapter leaves out on the Models page: gateway reachability probing with latency, one-click pull of the gateway model catalog with checkbox write-back into settings, DeepSeek balance and provider quota shown in place, the protocol and endpoint each provider is actually wired to, and a model dropdown that lists only what works right now — a dead key, an empty balance or an exhausted quota is hidden until you fix it, and comes back on its own.
description.zh: 补上官方 pi-ai 适配器在模型页缺的那半：网关可达性与延迟探测、一键拉取网关模型目录并勾选写回配置、DeepSeek 余额与各家配额就地常驻、每个 provider 实际接入的协议与地址；模型下拉只列当前真能用的分组 —— key 失效、余额耗尽、配额用尽都会被摘掉，修好后自动恢复。

description.en: Codex Appshots for DSH: capture the frontmost active window via global shortcut and seamlessly mount it into the composer for agent queries.
description.zh: DSH 版 Codex Appshots：全局快捷键精准捕获当前工作窗口，零摩擦挂载至 Composer 作为上下文向 Agent 提问。

description.en: Recall, edit-and-resend and regenerate, plus in-conversation versioning: a timeline of every rewind, artifact rollback (git-first, snapshot fallback), a fork map of explored paths, session lineage, and a real-time watchdog that snapshots the log at the first sign of concurrent writes. Edits auto-stop the running agent (official cancel/whenIdle) so rewinds never corrupt the durable log or break /compact.
description.zh: 撤回/编辑重发/重新生成，加上单会话版本化：每次回退的时间线、产物回退（git 优先、快照兜底）、分叉图、会话谱系，以及实时看门狗（并发写入第一时间快照日志）。编辑前自动停止运行中的 agent（官方 cancel/whenIdle），回退不会损坏持久化日志、也不会破坏 /compact。

description.en: Read-only Automations tab in the conversation view. It aggregates what other plugins are scheduled to run: last run time, next run time and a rough token-cost estimate, plus today's total spend and remaining balance. It owns no tasks and starts nothing.
description.zh: 会话视图里的只读「自动化」标签页。把其他插件排的自动化汇总成一张表：上次运行、下次运行时间、大致 token 花费，另附今日总花费与余额。它不拥有任何任务，也不会启动任何东西。

description.en: AI-agent-driven automated testing platform for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): drives the harness agent through long-lived multi-round sessions to write and run Markdown test cases, file bug reports, fix the code and re-verify the fix, with a per-project serial queue, a development board and built-in load testing.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 AI 智能体驱动自动化测试平台：以长期多轮会话驱动 agent 编写并执行 Markdown 用例、产出 bug 报告、修复代码并复验，配套按项目串行的统一队列、开发看板与内置压测。

description.en: Requires the ZCode CLI installed and signed in. Relays the ZCode CLI agent into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider. A resident app-server session streams each turn, and the model catalogue is read from the CLI at runtime, so context windows, image support and provider routes follow the installed CLI and account. Stable 0.6.1 supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.1, improves CLI discovery and includes optional Retry. Tool permission requests are denied by default; unknown approval or permission methods are always denied, and full-auto requires an explicit opt-in. DSH approval UI does not mediate this separately spawned app-server process, and the policy is not an OS sandbox. Derived from kyle123740/dsh-zcode-cli-proxy (AGPL-3.0); it registers the same `zcode-cli` provider id, so it cannot be installed alongside the original.
description.zh: 需已安装并登录 ZCode CLI。把 ZCode CLI agent 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供方。常驻 app-server 会话逐回合流式转发，模型清单从 CLI 实时读取，因此上下文窗口、图片支持与 provider 路由都跟随已安装的 CLI 和账号。稳定版 0.6.1 支持 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1，改进 CLI 自动发现并提供可选 Retry。工具权限请求默认拒绝；未知的 approval/permission 方法始终拒绝，全自动需显式启用。DSH 自带的审批界面不会介入这个独立 spawn 的 app-server 进程，该策略也不构成操作系统沙箱。派生自 kyle123740/dsh-zcode-cli-proxy（AGPL-3.0），注册相同的 `zcode-cli` provider id，不能与原版同装。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness to shared AgentsChat rooms over MCP and WebSocket wake bridge for cross-agent messaging, peer code review, proposals, voting, and OKRs.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 与 WebSocket 唤醒桥接将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 AgentsChat 共享房间，支持跨宿主多 Agent 通信、代码互审、提案投票与 OKR 协同。

description.en: The cyber-elixir of youth for the desktop client: fixes the `desktop welcome: Web authentication failed` (HTTP 431) launch failure — an Electron random-port launch lets `dsh-auth-*` login cookies pile up per port (70+ of them, ~229 B each), the startup request headers blow past Node's default 16 KB cap, and the client can no longer launch. Two fixes in one: a scriptable cleaner that removes leftover login cookies from the cookie database (Chromium SQLite) — explicit, offline, keeps a `.bak` copy, `--expired-only` narrows the scope — and a `patch` feature on the settings panel that fixes the launch port through the profile `cordis.patch.yml`, so the client always starts from a single port and cookies stop accumulating across different ones (rewrite `port` as a `!!js` expression to keep the `--port` flag in charge; a per-profile snapshot makes one click revert it). Read the README for usage. Interface, CLI output and market metadata in 9 languages. The purge runs from the bundled CLI (`dsh-cookie-cleaner --clean`) only while the client is fully closed; the in-app half is read-only. npm: `dsh-cookie-cleaner`.
description.zh: 桌面客户端的赛博端粒不老药：解决启动报 `desktop welcome: Web authentication failed`（HTTP 431）的现象——Electron 随机端口启动，`dsh-auth-*` 登录 cookie 随端口越积越多（70 余条、单条约 229 B），启动请求头撑爆 Node 默认 16 KB 上限，客户端直接起不来。两味药：脚本化清理器——报告并清理 cookie 库（Chromium SQLite）里残留的登录凭据，显式、离线、保留 `.bak` 副本，`--expired-only` 可收窄范围；设置面 patch 功能——经由 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 把启动端口固定化，保证客户端始终从单一端口启动，cookie 不再随不同端口累计（`port` 改写成 `!!js` 表达式可让 `--port` 旗标继续优先，按 profile 留快照、点一次即可回滚）。用法详见 README。界面、CLI 输出与市场元数据覆盖 9 语。清理需在客户端完全退出后运行包内 CLI（`dsh-cookie-cleaner --clean`），插件本体只读。npm 包名：`dsh-cookie-cleaner`。

description.en: Saves a whole DSH session as one .dsproj project file and opens it back. The session header gains an open button, a save button, a save-as button and an autosave switch, and the blank-session page gains its own open button. The first save asks where to put the file and later saves overwrite it; opening a .dsproj re-imports the session, switches to it, and can write the bundled workspace memory back on request.
description.zh: 把整个 DSH 会话存成单个 .dsproj 工程文件，并能再打开回来。会话标题栏上多了打开、保存、另存为三个按钮和自动保存开关，空会话页面另有自己的打开入口。第一次保存会问存到哪里，之后一键覆盖；打开 .dsproj 会导入该会话并切过去，按需可以把包里的工作区记忆合并回本机。

description.en: Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg files as the DSH web background: embedded video, time-of-day switching, unified frosted blur, local wallpaper library & rotation.
description.zh: 在浏览器里直接加载 Wallpaper Engine 的 .mpkg 作为 DSH 网页背景：内嵌视频、多时段切换、统一磨砂虚化、本地壁纸库与轮换。

description.en: Personal QQ channel for dsh: managed NapCat with QR login, private/group AI replies with batching and image understanding, local archive with polling backfill, in-group @ and self-recall, QQ Zone guestbook tools, and a sidebar panel. By default any QQ user who DMs the account (or @s it in a group) gets an AI reply; set access.privateMode / groupMode to allowlist to restrict. Owner-only commands stay owner-only.
description.zh: 把 dsh 接到个人 QQ：NapCat 托管与扫码登录、私聊/群聊 AI 回复（含图片理解）与批量节流、本地归档与轮询补漏、群内 @ 与撤回自己刚发的消息、QQ 空间留言，并带左侧栏管理面板。默认任何 QQ 用户私聊该账号（或在群里 @ 它）都会得到 AI 回复；把 access.privateMode / groupMode 设为 allowlist 才限制。主人专属命令仍只对主人生效。

description.en: Background security auditor for DeepSeek Harness: scans agent outputs for secret leakage, checks command safety before execution, and surfaces findings in a persistent audit log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的后台安全审计器：扫描 Agent 输出中的秘密泄漏，在执行前检查命令安全性，并将发现记录到持久化审计日志中。

description.en: Publishes the running DSH host as a Model Context Protocol endpoint, so other harnesses such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or another DSH can start and continue sessions, read transcripts, wait on or cancel turns, and answer pending approvals; every call is attributed to its caller, and owner-scoped sessions keep callers apart.
description.zh: 把正在运行的 DSH 宿主发布成 MCP 端点，让 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、另一个 DSH 等 harness 可以创建与延续会话、读取对话记录、等待或取消回合、代答待决审批；每次调用都归因到发起方，会话按所有者隔离。

description.en: Runs isolated install-and-smoke test drives for DSH plugins in throwaway profiles, returning structured pass/fail records and batch matrices without touching your real profile.
description.zh: 在一次性隔离配置中为 DSH 插件执行安装与冒烟测试，返回结构化的通过/失败记录与批量矩阵，不触碰真实配置。

description.en: Runs Claude Code as a DSH conversation while preserving its native agent loop, tools, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 作为 DSH 会话运行，同时保留其原生智能体循环、工具、技能、钩子和 MCP 集成。

description.en: Hermes-style tool search & slimming: progressive disclosure, semantic search, describe, and call long-tail tools on demand while core tools stay eager.
description.zh: Hermes 风格工具搜索与瘦身：渐进式披露，语义搜索/查看/调用长尾工具，核心工具保持直通。

description.en: Rewinds a finished turn in place — a button next to your own message withdraws that message and everything after it from the model context, puts its text back in the composer for editing, and optionally restores the files the turn changed through the DSH filesystem service.
description.zh: 就地回退已完成的回合：点你自己消息旁的按钮即可把这条消息及之后的内容从模型上下文中撤回，原文回到输入框可直接改完重发，并可一并恢复该回合经 DSH 文件系统服务改动过的文件。

description.en: Configure multiple image providers in Settings and call image_generate with the one selected model; images save under generate/image and show inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 在设置中配置多个生图供应商，对话通过 image_generate 调用当前选中的模型；图片保存到工作区 generate/image，并在对话中内联显示。

description.en: OMC-style multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: 29 omd-* skills and 12 /omd-* slash commands over the plan-execute-review-verify pipeline and team/autopilot/ralph modes.
description.zh: OMC 风格的多智能体编排层：29 个 omd-* skill + 12 条 /omd-* 命令，覆盖 plan-execute-review-verify 流水线与 team/autopilot/ralph 等模式。

description.en: Local offline prosody analysis for DeepSeek Harness: reports how something was said — speed, pitch, pauses, energy — alongside the transcript.
description.zh: 本地离线语气分析：在转写之外，给出语速、音高、停顿与力度的听感描述，让模型听懂「怎么说的」。

description.en: A Remielle(ZZZ) desktop pet for the dsh web GUI that switches animated sticker moods with the harness work state.
description.zh: 蕾米埃尔(绝区零)桌宠：随 DSH 工作状态切换动画表情。

description.en: Agentic answer reviewer for DeepSeek Harness: each final assistant turn is re-reviewed by a separate LLM graded 1-100; below-threshold scores steer the agent back with concrete feedback. The score is shown as a chip on the answer's action row (green pass / red needs-work, with retry count and reason on hover). Live gate config from the Reviewer 配置 tab in the conversation view ring above the composer (对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置), from a 127.0.0.1 HTTP server, or from an optional right-sidebar tab via dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 智能体回答审查器：每一轮 agent 的最终输出由独立 LLM 重新打分（1-100），低于阈值时携带具体反馈引导 agent 自我修正；评分以角标形式展示在该回答的操作行上（通过=绿、未达标=红，悬停可见重试次数与原因）。闸值配置可从输入框上方视图栏的「Reviewer 配置」标签页（对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置）、本机 127.0.0.1 HTTP 服务或 dsh-better-sidebar 侧栏标签页实时修改。

description.en: AI quota and usage monitor for DSH: per-window balances, reset countdowns and burn rate for Codex, Cursor, Google Antigravity (including the Gemini 4 Argon pool) and OpenCode-Go.
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 额度与用量监控：按额度窗口展示 Codex、Cursor、Google Antigravity（含 Gemini 4 Argon 独立额度池）与 OpenCode-Go 的剩余额度、重置倒计时与消耗速率。

description.en: Travel expense reconciliation: ingest orders, invoices and card lines, deduplicate, run the three-way match and a read-only policy check, then export — 5 `travel.*` tools.
description.zh: 差旅费用核对：导入订单、发票与卡流水，去重、三单匹配与只读政策校验后导出——5 个 `travel.*` 工具。

description.en: Profile management card for the DSH Web GUI: view, create (base / web / headless templates), copy, rename and delete DSH profiles under ~/.dsh/profiles, with per-profile port configuration and a copyable launch command.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Profile 管理卡片：可视化查看、创建（base / web / headless 三种模板）、复制、重命名与删除 ~/.dsh/profiles 下的 profile，支持逐 profile 端口配置并复制带 --port 的启动命令。

description.en: Fold completed turns into their final conclusions, split thinking from prose with a divider, and jump between turns from a rail dockable left or right with line or dot marks, an optional ring and hover summaries; it can hide the host right-edge TurnNavigator, load earlier history, and open a pre-filled diagnostics issue.
description.zh: 已完成轮次折叠成最终结论、思考与正文之间插入分隔线、可贴左缘或右缘的定位条（横线 / 圆点标记、可选外圈、悬停摘要 + 点击跳转）；还可隐藏宿主原生右缘 TurnNavigator、加载更早历史、一键打开预填好的诊断报告 issue。

description.en: Exposes the local DSH web GUI to one chosen CIDR range only (Tailscale by default) instead of binding 0.0.0.0: the proxy listens on addresses inside that range, rejects peers outside it, and admits clients by either a tokenised URL or a 4-12 character alphanumeric access code. Remote pages can be forced into a phone layout without changing the local UI, and the official appearance, font size, transcript view, code view and performance settings can be stored in the plugin config and re-applied on every remote page load.
description.zh: 只把本机 DSH 网页界面开放给指定的一个网段（默认 Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10），不绑 0.0.0.0：网段外的对端一律拒绝，进入方式可选带票网址或 4–12 位数字/字母访问密码；远程页面可强制手机布局而不动本机界面，官方「通用设置」里的外观 / 字号大小 / 工作步骤展示 / 显示代码工作视图 / 性能与用量可存进本插件配置，并在每次打开远程页面时重新套用。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness sessions to Feishu/Lark, Telegram and DingTalk: each chat is bound to a resumable DSH session, replies stream back as cards, and a task-end card reports the model, token usage, step count and duration. Question and permission-approval cards are answerable from the chat, and a web settings pane configures the per-channel credentials.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话接入飞书/Lark、Telegram 与钉钉：每个聊天绑定一个可续接的 DSH 会话，回复以卡片流式回传，任务结束时用一张结果卡汇报模型、token 用量、步数与耗时。提问与权限审批可直接在聊天里作答，各渠道凭据在 Web 设置面板中配置。

description.en: Lead-mode agent preset plus two runtime skills for the official Agent Teams runtime: a delegate-wait-verify working method, and a wrap-up digest that merges several members' output into one file. Ships no team runtime of its own.
description.zh: 给官方 Agent Teams 运行时配的 Lead 模式预设与两个 runtime skill：一套拆活、派活、验收的工作法，以及收尾时把多个成员产出合并成一份文件的团队汇总。本身不带 Team 运行时。

description.en: Move sessions across workspaces by drag-and-drop with true in-place migration; recover orphaned or unregistered sessions; re-point stale workspaces after folder renames. IDs and history stay intact, with per-step backup and rollback.
description.zh: 拖拽跨工作区真迁移会话，找回失联与未记账会话，文件夹改名后一键原地重定向工作区；ID 与历史原样保留，步步备份回滚。

description.en: Office workspace & session dashboard: a floating 6-column sprite panel visualizing workspaces, sessions, token usage and subagents, plus Agent Mail and an office log tab. Feishu/Lark views (message feed, meeting schedules, transcripts) additionally require the `@larksuite/cli` tool installed and authenticated separately.
description.zh: 办公室工作区/会话仪表盘：悬浮 6 列精灵面板，可视化工作区、会话、token 用量与子代理，并提供 Agent Mail 与办公日志页签。飞书相关视图（消息流、会议日程、妙记逐字稿）另需自行安装并授权 `@larksuite/cli`。

description.en: Diagnoses why a skill is not picked up — truncated description, broken frontmatter, missing resource files — and checks installed plugins for conflicting loader entries. Keeps a per-profile record so every checkup is diffed against the previous one, groups repeated findings into one root cause, produces rewrite worksheets for oversized descriptions, and lists the plugin patches that touch the skill directory configuration.
description.zh: 诊断技能为什么没被模型选中——简介被截断、文件头损坏、引用文件缺失——并检查已安装插件之间是否存在 loader 条目冲突；按 profile 自动保存体检病历、每次复诊对比上次差值，把重复出现的问题归并为同一根因，为超长简介生成改写工单，并列出改动了技能目录配置的插件 patch。

description.en: Bring your own wallpaper: import a local picture and its glass and ink are solved on the spot; plus twelve built-in full-screen wallpapers whose edge blur, feathering and glass opacity are computed per image; ink solved in OKLCH to hold WCAG AA; Rhodes Island iconography; approval and question cards signed with operator autographs.
description.zh: 自选壁纸：可导入本地图片，导入即按同一套算法解算玻璃浓度与文字色；另含 12 张整屏壁纸，边缘虚化、羽化与玻璃浓度按每张图分别计算；文字色以 OKLCH 求解并守住 WCAG AA 下限；界面图标换成罗德岛素材；授权卡与选项卡带干员签名。

description.en: Turns real DSH crash logs into a short hard-constraint list: static preflight before a plugin installs, conflict check afterwards, controlled self-heal when the harness will not start — plus handing a huge session over to a fresh one, the brief written by a model that reads the original transcript.
description.zh: 把 DSH 真实崩溃日志沉淀成精简硬约束：装插件前静态预检拦崩，装完体检冲突，起不来时受控自愈；大会话还能转世成新会话，交接单由模型读懂原会话后写。

description.en: Lark/Feishu bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: each chat drives its own agent, and tool approvals, model questions, and plan reviews return as cards answered by a button or a reply. Switch workspace and model from the chat (`/cd`, `/model`, `/new`), and run several bots that keep separate sessions and can hand turns to each other in one group.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 机器人渠道：每个会话驱动独立 agent，工具审批、模型提问与计划审阅都以卡片回到聊天，点按钮或直接回复即可作答；聊天里用 `/cd`、`/model`、`/new` 切工作区、换模型、重开会话，多个机器人各自独立并可在同群交接回合。

description.en: Local OCR fallback for text-only routes: when the session model declares it cannot accept images, the attached image is cached locally and its path injected so the model can call ocr_image — PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime on CPU, no API key, images never leave the machine. Silent when the model can see images.
description.zh: 纯文本路由的本地 OCR 兜底：会话模型明确声明不接受图片时，把附件的图片存入本地缓存并注入路径，模型调 ocr_image 用 PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime 在纯 CPU 上离线识别，无需 API key，图片不出本机；模型能看图时静默。

description.en: Web GUI enhancement bundle: a standalone password gateway (optional HTTPS via your own certificate or a self-signed local CA) for LAN and remote access without `?token=`, PWA install with icon and app name, desktop and mobile Web Push notifications for task/approval events, and optional session-id request-header injection for third-party OpenAI-compatible routes, all configured from a settings page.
description.zh: DSH 增强套件：为 Web GUI 提供独立的密码访问网关（可选 HTTPS，支持上传证书或由插件自签发本地 CA），无需 `?token=` 即可在局域网 / 远程登录；整合 PWA 安装与应用名 / 图标、桌面通知与手机 Web Push（任务完成、等待审批等事件），并可选地把当前会话的 session id 注入第三方 OpenAI 兼容路由的请求头，均在设置页统一配置。

description.en: Persistent Bots and group rooms inside DSH. Each Bot keeps its own model, permission preset, workspace and session across restarts; a Bot can also be backed by an installed local agent CLI (Codex CLI, Claude Code, ACP agents) using that CLI's own login and models. Unaddressed messages can be triaged by the room leader, the room accumulates a shared experience card, and every answer is a run in a durable ledger the sidebar panel replays. New Bots default to the full-access permission (any command, any file; the form asks you to confirm the risk), so choose read-only or workspace-write to confine one; Codex CLI and Claude Code Bots at full access run without their own sandbox or permission prompts.
description.zh: DSH 里的常驻 Bot 与群聊房间。每个 Bot 有自己的模型、权限预设、工作区与重启后仍在的会话；Bot 也可以直接接管本机已安装的 agent CLI（Codex CLI、Claude Code、ACP agent），沿用该 CLI 自己的登录与模型。未点名消息可由群主判断，群内经验会自动积累，每次回答都是持久运行记录里的一条 run，侧栏面板据此回放。新建 Bot 的权限默认是完全权限（可执行任意命令、修改任意文件，表单会要求勾选风险确认），需要约束时请选「仅查看」或「工作区内」；完全权限的 Codex CLI / Claude Code Bot 会在没有各自沙箱和权限询问的情况下运行。

description.en: Drag-and-drop reordering, official/third-party dividers and a stash panel for the buttons DSH renders in the sidebar, the sidebar footer, the conversation tabs, the composer dock and Settings. Only display position changes; the plugin registry is untouched.
description.zh: 对 DSH 投放到侧边栏顶部、侧边栏底部、对话标签、输入框停靠行与设置页导航的插件按钮做拖拽排序、官方/第三方分隔线与按钮收纳。只改变显示位置，不改动插件注册表。

description.en: WYSIWYG Markdown editor in the DSH right sidebar, built on MarkText's muya engine: open a .md file, edit it as a rendered document, and save back through ctx.fs with a version guard.
description.zh: 基于 MarkText 内核 muya 的右侧栏所见即所得 Markdown 编辑器：打开 .md 按渲染结果编辑，保存走 ctx.fs 并带版本守卫。

description.en: Authorized pentest mode for DeepSeek Harness — exploration chain, assets and findings with a Web view.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的授权渗透模式：以探索链路记录目标、线索、资产与漏洞，并在 Web 中可视化展示。

description.en: Free conversational ChatGPT Web (GPT 5.6 Luna) model provider for DeepSeek Harness with streaming Markdown.
description.zh: 基于免费 ChatGPT 网页端（GPT 5.6 Luna）的 DeepSeek Harness 零成本对话模型提供者，支持流式 Markdown。

description.en: Talk about everything in one chat (the main chat): each message is routed automatically to the topic it belongs to, each topic runs in its own background session with its own context, and existing DSH chat history is organized into topics.
description.zh: 所有事在一个对话框（主聊天）里聊：每条消息自动分到所属话题，每个话题在后台有独立的会话和上下文；已有的 DSH 旧会话也会自动整理、分类成话题。

description.en: QQ channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness over OneBot v11/SnowLuma, with pairing-based access approval, long-term memory, a knowledge base, proactive events and an admin panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 渠道插件（OneBot v11 / SnowLuma）：默认配对审批（陌生人先待主人批准）、长期记忆、知识库、主动行为与管理后台。

description.en: Bottom-right quota pill and panel aggregating membership quotas across AI platforms (Kimi Code, DeepSeek, Zhipu Coding Plan, BigModel, Qwen, Scnet, TokenRouter, SupaWriter), auto-syncing API keys from the DSH credentials domain with colored usage bars.
description.zh: 右下角「会员额度」悬浮球与面板，聚合各 AI 平台套餐额度（Kimi Code、DeepSeek、智谱 Coding Plan、BigModel、通义千问、超算、TokenRouter、SupaWriter），API key 自动同步自 DSH 凭证域，彩色进度条展示用量。

description.en: PTES-based penetration testing plugin with Root-Orchestrator architecture for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 PTES 的渗透测试插件，采用 Root-Orchestrator 架构，用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Four-source migration wizard: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH (/move wizard with approval gate and idempotent move.json, resumable sessions).
description.zh: 四合一迁移向导：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Hermes 的会话、记忆、技能、指令与斜杠命令迁入 DSH（/move 向导，审批门 + 幂等 move.json，会话可续聊）。

description.en: CodeBuddy supplier plugin for dsh-router. Handles one account at a time with polling OAuth login and token refresh, leaving account selection, cooldown and check-in to dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 CodeBuddy 供应商插件。单账号负责轮询式 OAuth 登录与令牌刷新，选号、冷却与签到交由 dsh-router 核心处理。

description.en: Configures forward proxies per enabled provider in Settings (HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5), keeping unconfigured providers and other traffic direct.
description.zh: 在设置里为每个已启用的 provider 单独配置正向代理（HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5），未配置的 provider 与其它流量保持直连。

description.en: Drive local Adobe Photoshop for game screenshots and photos: layered HDR, multi-zone colour/person masks, SUPIR/Real-ESRGAN super-resolution, native 1:1 vision inspection. Requires Windows 10/11 and Adobe Photoshop 2025; the grading tools do not run on macOS or on earlier Photoshop versions.
description.zh: 驱动本机 Adobe Photoshop 处理游戏截图与照片：分层 HDR、多区域颜色/人物蒙版、SUPIR/Real-ESRGAN 超分与原生 1:1 视觉检查。需要 Windows 10/11 与 Adobe Photoshop 2025；macOS 与更早的 Photoshop 版本无法运行调色工具。

description.en: Orchestration-mode preset generator for DSH: a lead agent delegates to four built-in role helpers that carry only their own tools, and the web panel adds or removes custom helpers with their own tools, skills, and models, per workspace — zero changes to the harness source.
description.zh: DSH 编排模式预设生成器：主 agent 指挥，四个内置帮手各只带本行工具；Web 面板按工作区增删帮手，可给自定角色配专属工具、技能与模型——零 DSH 源码改动。

description.en: Match your models and token budgets to each role, then let DSH delegate specialized subagents by task type. Covers architecture analysis, UI/UX, code implementation, codebase exploration, and documentation research, with automatic setup plus per-role reasoning effort and tool permissions.
description.zh: 合理搭配你的模型及 Token 额度，让 DSH 按任务类型自动委派专业子代理，覆盖架构分析、UI/UX、代码实现、代码库探索与文档调研。安装后自动配置，并支持按角色设置思考强度和工具权限。

description.en: Agent-initiated voice calls: `offer_call` rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后再说); accepted calls synthesize and play locally via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 speakers, 2 Chinese dialects), rejected calls return the decision to the agent.
description.zh: agent 主动打来的语音电话：`offer_call` 向人类振铃（接听/拒接/稍后再说），接听后由本地 CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS 合成并播放（9 个音色，含 2 个中文方言）；拒接则把决定返回给 agent。

description.en: Mobile-first UX polish for the DSH Web UI: composer auto-fold, enter-as-newline on phones, compact sidebar/header/settings, zoom and overscroll lock, plus approval/question/completion notifications via in-page cards, Web Push, and webhook — zero dsh changes.
description.zh: 手机优先的 DSH 前端体验优化：输入框自动折叠、手机回车换行、侧边栏/顶部栏/设置页压缩、禁缩放回弹，以及审批/提问/任务完成通知（页面卡片、Web Push、webhook）；零 dsh 本体改动。

description.en: Third-party TUI mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh --profile pi-tui), built on a vendored pi-tui fork: covers the main session loop plus approvals, commands, session switching and full-text search, as well as presets, skills, model/settings menus and slash commands.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 TUI 模式（dsh --profile pi-tui），基于内置 pi-tui fork 构建：覆盖主会话循环（审批、命令、会话切换与全文搜索），以及预设、技能、模型/设置菜单与斜杠命令。

description.en: Turns a repository and a running system into acceptance material - database design, design specs, a user manual with screenshots, and test / go-live / acceptance reports. Sections follow GB/T 8567-88; anything it cannot verify is left blank instead of invented. Requires Python 3 with python-docx for .docx output, and Google Chrome for automatic screenshots.
description.zh: 把代码仓库与运行中的系统变成验收材料：数据库设计、概要设计、详细设计、带截图的使用说明书，以及测试报告、上线报告、验收报告。章节按 GB/T 8567-88 组织，无法核实的字段与结论一律留空，不编造。需 Python 3 与 python-docx 生成 .docx，自动截图需 Google Chrome。

description.en: Right-click any file reference in the chat to open it, open it with an associated application, reveal it in the file manager, copy its path or contents, and save it.
description.zh: 右键聊天里的任意文件引用，即可打开、用系统关联应用打开、在文件管理器中定位、复制路径或文件内容、另存为。

description.en: Recall a message you already sent: the session log stays append-only and nothing is deleted, while the recalled turns leave the model context and the transcript, the text returns to the composer, and the files those turns changed wait in a quarantine you can review and clear from its own settings page.
description.zh: 撤回已发送的消息：会话日志只追加、不删除任何东西，被撤回的回合退出模型上下文并从对话界面消失、原文回到输入框，被这些回合改动的文件留在隔离区里——设置里独立一页，可查看可清理。

description.en: Notifications for four session states, with browser alerts and prompts.
description.zh: 会话完成等四种状态的通知响应，支持浏览器提示。

description.en: Live-tune the DSH Web conversation UI from Settings: message font size, Claude Desktop-style markdown tables, dialog width, an optional timeline rail, and a GitBar with branch management, per-file diff, and commit & push.
description.zh: 从设置面板实时调教 DSH 网页对话界面：消息字体大小、Claude Desktop 风格 Markdown 表格、对话框宽度、可选时间线侧栏，以及带分支管理、逐文件 Diff 和提交推送功能的 GitBar。

description.en: Multi-CLI worker sidebar for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with task dispatch, live conversation views, stop and follow-up controls, and custom role presets.
description.zh: 适用于 macOS / Windows 和 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的多 CLI 智能体侧栏插件，提供任务派遣、实时对话查看、停止与续聊及自定义角色预设。

description.en: HarmonyOS delivery orchestration for DSH: freezes a four-dimension acceptance pack whose measurable criteria carry machine-checkable assertions, runs an adversarial pre-review before dispatch, hands the work to DevEco Code in Goal mode, then audits the delivery with independently gathered evidence (screenshots, UI tree, logs, hashed evidence bundle), recomputing assertion verdicts against measured values and filing rework orders; includes a cited rule catalog, a user-confirmation state and a gate calibration ledger.
description.zh: DSH 侧鸿蒙交付编排插件：冻结四维验收任务包（可量化判据带机器可校验断言）、派发前对抗预审、以 Goal 模式交给 DevEco Code，再用独立取证（截图 / 布局树 / 日志 / 带 SHA-256 的证据包）做外部审计，按实测值重算断言判定并生成返工单；含带官方引用的规则目录、用户确认状态与闸门校准账本。

description.en: Skill and MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness: browse and toggle user/project skills, add/edit/remove MCP servers hot without restart, with live per-session status in the sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能与 MCP 管理中心：浏览并启停用户/项目技能，热增删改 MCP 服务器（免重启），侧边栏实时展示各服务器状态。

description.en: Proxies the loopback-only dsh web onto a LAN port so phones and other machines can reach it, with an optional access password that browsers type in and the bundled Android client unlocks with biometrics. Adds a LAN-access settings page with QR codes, inlines dsh-web-mobile (MIT, attribution kept) for the mobile layout, and the Android client in the same repository adds finish/approval notifications, voice input and a home-screen widget.
description.zh: 把只监听 127.0.0.1 的 dsh web 转发到局域网端口，供手机等设备访问；可选访问密码——浏览器输入，同仓库的 Android 客户端用指纹或面部解锁。新增带二维码的「局域网访问」设置页，内联 dsh-web-mobile（MIT，保留署名）提供移动端布局；Android 客户端另加完成/审批通知、语音输入与主屏小组件。

description.en: Local dev panel for the DSH web GUI: follow service logs, start/stop workspace programs, debug Java over JDWP, browse and edit workspace files, and search file names. Needs DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or later; starting or debugging Java programs needs a local JDK and Maven, and starting front-end programs needs Node.
description.zh: DSH 网页版的本机开发面板：跟随服务日志、启停工作区程序、JDWP 调试 Java、浏览编辑工作区文件与文件名搜索。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高版本；启动或调试 Java 程序需要本机 JDK 与 Maven，启动前端程序需要 Node。

description.en: Converts Office and PDF files in the DSH workspace to Markdown locally — no network, no API quota — before the model reads them. Writes each .md next to its source so only a file path enters the context, and returns byte size, line count, token estimate and a heading outline, for a single file or a whole directory.
description.zh: 在模型读取之前，把工作区里的 Office / PDF 文件在本机转成 Markdown（不联网、不消耗 API 额度），.md 写在源文件旁边，因此进入上下文的只是一个文件路径，并返回字节数、行数、token 估算与标题结构索引，支持单个文件或整个目录。

description.en: Turns a Minecraft Java save into a Blender cover or animation: scans the .mca region files for flat open ground, exports the terrain to OBJ, and drives Blender headless with MCprep materials, the BPS character rig and three-point lighting. After each render it reviews the frame with OpenCV for facing, ground contact, exposure, lighting and composition, then re-renders with adjusted parameters when a check fails. Requires Blender 4.2 LTS or newer and Python 3.10+ with opencv-python and numpy; the first run assembles the Minecraft assets with the bundled setup command.
description.zh: 把 Minecraft Java 存档变成 Blender 封面或动画：在 .mca 区域文件里找大片平地，导出地形为 OBJ，无头驱动 Blender（MCprep 材质、BPS 角色骨架、三点布光）。每次渲染后用 OpenCV 检查朝向、接地、曝光、布光和构图，不合格就调整参数重渲。需 Blender 4.2 LTS 以上、Python 3.10+（opencv-python、numpy），首次使用运行 setup 装配 Minecraft 素材。

description.en: Partitioned long-term memory for agents, with folders as memory zones, a one-line index first, and a forgetting curve.
description.zh: 分区式长期记忆：用文件夹收纳记忆，先看一行索引再翻对应分区，带遗忘曲线。

description.en: A namespace management tool for toolsets that supports automatic discovery and integration, designed to help reduce token consumption. Also runs TypeScript and JavaScript in a restricted Node runtime for on-demand namespace calls.
description.zh: 一个用于管理工具集的命名空间管理工具，支持自动发现与集成，用于节省token的消耗还会在受限 Node 运行时执行 TypeScript 与 JavaScript，按需通过命名空间调用工具。

description.en: Drive local Origin/OriginPro from chat via 27 MCP tools: import .dat/.csv/.txt and CHI workstation .bin files, plot, style, fit, and deliver PNG/TIF/SVG/PDF plus an editable .opju project, with read-back verification on plots, styles and exports. Requires Windows, Origin/OriginPro 2021+ and Python 3.10+, plus `pip install originpro numpy` into the interpreter dsh launches: without the package every tool answers `missing_originpro`, and without an interpreter on PATH no tools register at all.
description.zh: 通过 27 个 MCP 工具在对话里驱动本机 Origin/OriginPro：导入 .dat/.csv/.txt 与 CHI 工作站 .bin，绘图、改样式、拟合，交付 PNG/TIF/SVG/PDF 图片和可继续编辑的 .opju 工程；绘图、样式、导出都带读回验证。需要 Windows、Origin/OriginPro 2021+ 与 Python 3.10+，并把 `pip install originpro numpy` 装进 dsh 启动的那个解释器：缺包时每个工具都会返回 `missing_originpro`，PATH 上没有解释器时工具完全不注册。

description.en: One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP: on-demand MCP loading, in-session hot reload, SKILL & MCP descriptions viewable in the plugin.
description.zh: 一站式可视化管理 DSH 的 SKILL 与 MCP：MCP按需加载、会话内热重载、SKILL与MCP描述可在插件内直接查看

description.en: A read-only overview tab beside the conversation: what this round asked, what was observed, what still needs checking, and a bounded history you can step through round by round.
description.zh: 对话旁的只读概览页：本轮问了什么、观察到什么、还在验证什么；已结束的轮次可以一条条往回看。

description.en: Token dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: per-provider monthly budgets, subscription quotas (GLM / Kimi Coding), account balances, and time-range cost and real-Token breakdowns — plus local JSON export and import for backup.
description.zh: DSH Token 看板：按供应商的月度预算、订阅配额（GLM / Kimi Coding）、账户余额，支持当天 / 7 天 / 30 天 / 全部范围查看费用与真实 Tokens，并可本地导出 / 导入备份。

description.en: Relay that bridges DSH and the browser: tasks started from a browser extension run in DSH sessions, while page operations are driven back through browser_* tools, with an in-page assistant panel and a local wizard for one-click setup.
description.zh: DSH 与浏览器之间的通信桥：浏览器扩展发起的任务经 relay 在 DSH 创建会话执行，页面操作通过 browser_* 工具桥接回扩展，提供页面助手面板与免配置接入向导。

description.en: Database workbench inside DSH: import the connections DBeaver already stores (data-sources.json, decrypting saved passwords locally) or register SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle sources by hand, then hand them to the agent through eight mcp__db__ tools — list_datasources, list_tables, describe_table, sample_rows, execute_sql, explain_query, get_ddl and test_connection. Sources start read-only; one global switch enables INSERT/UPDATE/DDL, every call is row-capped and appended to a JSONL audit log. Also covers groups, bulk actions, a read-only schema browser and a bundled Python MCP server whose dependencies install from the panel. No DSH files to edit.
description.zh: DSH 里的数据库工作台：可以直接导入 DBeaver 已有的连接（读 data-sources.json，本地解密已保存的口令），也可以手工登记 SQLite、PostgreSQL、MySQL、Oracle 数据源，然后交给智能体通过 8 个 mcp__db__ 工具使用——list_datasources、list_tables、describe_table、sample_rows、execute_sql、explain_query、get_ddl、test_connection。数据源默认只读，一个全局开关才放开 INSERT/UPDATE/DDL；每次调用都限制行数并写入 JSONL 审计日志。另有分组、批量操作、只读结构浏览，以及依赖可在面板一键安装的内置 Python MCP 服务。不需要改 DSH 的任何文件。

description.en: Role-based AI swarms for DeepSeek Harness: an architect plans, parallel builders execute, reviewers gate quality, and an integrator ships. Per-role model pinning with fallback chains, review loops, evidence contracts, human-gated reviews, quota-aware pause/resume, and a live kanban + flow chart in the web GUI. 40 tests; installs from GitHub or npm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的角色化 AI 蜂群：架构师规划、多个建造者并行执行、评审代理把关、集成代理收尾。按角色钉选模型（含回退链），支持评审循环、证据合约、人工评审门、配额耗尽自动暂停与恢复，Web GUI 内置实时看板与任务流程图。40 个测试用例；支持 GitHub 或 npm 安装。

description.en: Usage statistics: a usage and reference-cost panel for DeepSeek Harness with today, 7-day, 30-day, all-time and custom ranges aggregated by hour or day; a model filter and a per-model breakdown of requests, input and output tokens, cache, reference cost and share; a model-share card showing the top four models by total tokens with the rest grouped as others; a reference price list generated from opencode Zen and DeepSeek's published rates, with DeepSeek models billed by Beijing weekday peak/off-peak windows and Chinese public holidays; a pricing-match dialog to point an unmatched model at a reference model or type per-million rates by hand; reference cost switchable between ¥ and $ at a fixed 1 USD = 7 CNY; and a yearly heatmap drawn only with theme variables, with no third-party chart library.
description.zh: 用量统计：DeepSeek Harness 的用量与参考成本面板，含今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 全部 / 自定义范围并按小时或天聚合；模型筛选与按模型明细（请求数、输入/输出 Token、缓存、参考成本、占比）；按总 Token 显示前 4 个模型、其余归入「其它」的模型占比卡；参考价目由 opencode Zen 与 DeepSeek 官方定价生成，DeepSeek 型号按北京时间工作日高峰/空闲与法定节假日分档计价；未匹配的模型可在「定价匹配」里指定参考模型或手填单价；参考成本可在 ¥ / $ 间按固定汇率 1 USD = 7 CNY 切换；年度热力图只用主题变量绘制，不引第三方图表库。

description.en: Skill marketplace with unified search across SkillHub and ClawHub, in-app README preview, one-click install and uninstall, an installed-skill list, and a chat-input skill picker.
description.zh: 技能市场插件，聚合 SkillHub 与 ClawHub 双源搜索，支持站内 README 预览、一键安装与卸载、已装技能列表，以及聊天栏技能选择器。

description.en: Contract clause work: build the clause tree, map it against a 12-key playbook, register the playbook and export the unresolved report — 5 `legal.*` tools.
description.zh: 合同条款处理：构建条款树、按 12 项 playbook 映射、登记 playbook 并导出未决清单——5 个 `legal.*` 工具。

description.en: Four-palette pixel-art skin for DSH Web (wood, parchment, warm, terminal green) with a bundled CJK pixel font served by the plugin's own host route, and a flat, shadow-free look.
description.zh: 四套配色的像素风 DSH Web 皮肤（木屋/羊皮纸/暖阳/终端绿）；中文像素字体由插件自身的 host 路由发货；完全平面、无阴影。

description.en: Installs four multi-agent math-research presets for DSH: v2 (probability-driven pipeline with multi-verifier debate), v3 (paper-style Markdown knowledge base with a planner agent and a reusable method library), v4 (persistent self-organizing residents that message and meet), and v5 (a research institute with an academician who decomposes and assigns work, voting researchers, temp workers, group chat and a compare-and-set task board); all four support checkpoint resume, human intervention, and an optional Lean formal-verification switch (off/encourage/require) whose passing proof turns the vote into a fidelity check of the Lean statements.
description.zh: 为 DSH 安装四个多代理数学研究预设：v2（概率驱动流水线 + 多验证器辩论）、v3（论文式 Markdown 知识库 + 规划代理 + 可复用方法库）、v4（常驻自组织成员，靠留言与开会决定一切）、v5（研究所：院士拆解并分派任务、有表决权的研究员、临时工、群聊与 CAS 任务板）；四套均支持断点续跑、人工干预，以及可调档的 Lean 形式化验证（off/encourage/require，一旦跑通，表决转为对 Lean 陈述的忠实性核对）。

description.en: Full-text search of all local sessions: sessiongraph finds conversations in any workspace, Chinese two-character terms included; sessiongraph_index builds it.
description.zh: 本机全部会话的全文检索：sessiongraph 跨工作区查找对话，中文两字词也能命中，sessiongraph_index 负责建索引。

description.en: Read-only tools for mj7.cn: search standards, products and materials, plus HS-code lookup, Incoterms, trade documents and CNY rates across 6 tools. Network-only, no local writes.
description.zh: mj7.cn 只读工具：检索标准、产品与材料，另有 HS 编码联想、Incoterms、贸易单证与人民币汇率，共 6 个工具。仅网络访问，不写本地。

description.en: Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.
description.zh: 按无障碍 ref 操控浏览器：导航、把页面快照成 ref 树、操作元素、等待条件；域名策略跟随会话审批状态，并由请求拦截层强制执行。

description.en: Terminal-style input history for the web composer: edge-first arrow-key recall with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, and sliding-context awareness; 0.5.0 adds a smart input layer — cross-session snippets (/save, /load), prompt templates with variables, reuse insights, and compaction-summary highlighting.
description.zh: Web 作曲器终端风格输入历史：边缘优先的方向键召回并精确还原草稿与光标、浏览器本地持久化历史、Ctrl+R 反向搜索，以及滑动上下文感知；0.5.0 再加智能输入层——跨会话片段库（/save、/load）、带变量的提示词模板、复用洞察与压缩摘要高亮。

description.en: Free vision bridge for text-only models: image understanding, OCR, UI and debug analysis via free-tier providers (Qwen3-VL-Flash, Doubao, DeepSeek-OCR) with a settings GUI.
description.zh: 免费视觉插件：纯文本模型看图 / OCR / UI / 报错分析，优先免费模型（千问 Qwen3-VL-Flash、豆包、DeepSeek-OCR），设置界面可配置。

description.en: Export a session as a ZIP archive with its attachments, and import such an archive as a new standalone session in the current workspace.
description.zh: 把会话连同附件导出为压缩包，或把这样的压缩包导入为当前工作区里的新会话。

description.en: Reference workspace files, DSH sessions, and historical ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, and Kimi conversations from the unified DSH @ menu.
description.zh: 从 DSH 统一的 @ 菜单中引用工作区文件、DSH 会话，以及 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Grok 和 Kimi 的历史对话。

description.en: Full-screen terminal client for DeepSeek Harness built on pi-tui: session replay/resume, streaming responses, collapsible tool cards, in-terminal approvals and questions, model/preset/permission/plan/goal management, shell mode, and a trajectory ledger.
description.zh: 基于 pi-tui 的 DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端客户端：会话回放/续接、流式响应、可折叠工具卡片、终端内审批与提问、模型/预设/权限/计划/目标管理、Shell 模式，以及轨迹（trajectory）事件台账。

description.en: Right-sidebar basket that collects the files a session produced or changed without the agent having to register them, with preview, zip packaging, and one-click archiving.
description.zh: 右侧栏「鱼篓」不用 agent 登记，自动汇总本场会话产出或改动的文件，支持预览、一键打包 zip 与归档。

description.en: Registers two MCP servers that drive the installed AutoCAD and SolidWorks desktop apps over COM, plus two on-demand skills. Windows only, Python 3.11+; the pinned upstream servers install themselves on first load, and only the sides whose CAD application is registered get a row.
