Each server advertises two meta-tools instead of its full catalog (a discovery shim here for SolidWorks, upstream DISCOVERY_MODE=search for AutoCAD), taking the schemas loaded before the first request from 23,404 to 256 tokens and from 83,732 to 365 respectively.
description.zh: 注册两个 MCP 服务器，在 Windows 上通过 COM 驱动本机安装的 AutoCAD 与 SolidWorks，另附两个按需技能。仅 Windows，需要 Python 3.11+；首次加载时自动安装钉死版本的上游服务器，并且只给真正装了的 CAD 应用注册对应的那一行。两者都只广告两个元工具而非完整工具表（SolidWorks 用本仓库的 discovery 垫片，AutoCAD 用上游 DISCOVERY_MODE=search），首次请求前加载的工具定义分别从 23,404 降到 256 token、从 83,732 降到 365 token。

description.en: Chat panel for the MuChe companion with per-user backend settings, plus an outbound bridge that runs tasks on the user's local dsh.
description.zh: 连接小沐的 dsh 插件：和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务。

description.en: Git plugin — adds a Git panel to the session tab bar: changes, commits, history, branches, remote sync, and merge-conflict resolution in one place, with AI-written commit messages.
description.zh: Git 插件 —— 会话 Tab 栏中添加 Git 管理面板，变更、提交、历史、分支、远端同步、合并冲突一站完成，Message 可 AI 生成。

description.en: Read-only security and compliance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: prompt-injection detection, Chinese-PII redaction, and a local configuration audit with redacted, reproducible reports.
description.zh: DSH 只读安全合规插件：提示注入检测、中文 PII 脱敏、本机配置安全审计，输出脱敏且可复现的报告。

description.en: Pauses the agent right before it sends the next model request of a tool round while keeping the composer usable: a bare Enter or the resume button lets it continue, and text typed meanwhile is sent along as a steering message; the pause never interrupts an in-flight API call and the model does not notice it.
description.zh: 在模型完成一轮工具交互、正要发出下一次请求之前暂停，输入框保持可用：裸回车或点按钮放行，草稿有字则随本次请求一并发出作为插话；不打断任何在途 API 调用，模型上下文完整、察觉不到暂停。

description.en: Keeps DSH agents from forgetting your requirements during long tasks. It saves important conditions and completion evidence locally, brings them back after context compaction or session resume, and stops partial work from being reported as the whole task done.
description.zh: 避免 DSH Agent 在长任务中忘记你的要求：它会把重要条件和完成依据保存在本机，在上下文压缩或恢复会话后重新带回，防止漏掉关键限制，或只做完一部分就说整个任务已经完成。

description.en: Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 10 tools (kb_ingest, kb_search, kb_rag, kb_zotero, kb_dedup, kb_clear, kb_fetch, kb_scope, kb_stats, kb_status), hybrid BM25+vector+reranker search, cited QA with clickable DOI links, all-local bge embeddings over a single-file SQLite index. Needs Python 3.9+ with pymupdf, faiss-cpu and sentence-transformers; the `npx dsh-kb-rag-install` installer sets those up and pre-downloads the model.
description.zh: 本地文献知识库 RAG：10 个工具（kb_ingest、kb_search、kb_rag、kb_zotero、kb_dedup、kb_clear、kb_fetch、kb_scope、kb_stats、kb_status），BM25+向量+重排混合检索、DOI 可点击溯源问答，全本地 bge 嵌入 + 单文件 SQLite 索引。需要 Python 3.9+ 及 pymupdf、faiss-cpu、sentence-transformers（`npx dsh-kb-rag-install` 安装器会自动装好并预下载模型）。

description.en: Reads and writes WPS 365 cloud documents (smart documents and .docx/.xlsx/.pptx) through the locally installed wps365-cli, with conflict checks before writing; requires a WPS 365 enterprise account.
description.zh: 通过本机安装的 wps365-cli 读写 WPS 365 云文档（智能文档与 .docx/.xlsx/.pptx），写入前先做并发冲突比对；需要 WPS 365 企业版账号。

description.en: Merge requests, review threads and pipeline job logs for GitLab over its REST API with a personal access token, in a side panel, with comment, reply, resolve and approve actions that wait for confirmation. Reads need the read_api scope, writes need api.
description.zh: 在侧栏面板里通过 GitLab REST API 与个人访问令牌查看合并请求、评审讨论串与流水线作业日志，并可评论、回复、解决讨论与批准；写操作均需二次确认（读需 read_api，写需 api）。

description.en: Role-play conversations with character cards, in-chat character-card authoring and editing, and image generation through configurable backends.
description.zh: 角色扮演插件：支持角色卡对话、在对话中创作与编辑角色卡，可接入生图后端生成插图。

description.en: DeepSeek usage dashboard for DSH Web: days-left estimate from recent average spend, daily/monthly/cumulative costs with period-over-period comparison, per-model cost ranking, cache savings, peak/off-peak pricing impact, and a draggable floating balance widget.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 DeepSeek 用量仪表盘：按近期日均消耗估算可用天数，今日/本月/累计花费环比对照，分模型成本排行、缓存节省、峰谷定价影响，以及可拖动的悬浮余额窗。

description.en: Adds Regenerate and Edit and resend to each message you already sent: Regenerate re-answers the same text in one click without going through the composer; Edit and resend retracts that message and everything after it in place — out of the transcript and out of the model context, in the same session with no new branch — then puts its text and images back into the composer, so the edited send rewrites the conversation from that point. Messages carrying files rather than images stay disabled.
description.zh: 给你发出的每条消息加上「重新生成」和「编辑重发」：重新生成一键用同样的文字重新回答，不经过输入框；编辑重发就地撤回这条消息及其之后的内容——从时间线和模型上下文里一起消失，不新建会话也不开新分支——再把文字和图片放回输入框，改完发送就从那一条重写对话。带文件（非图片）的消息两个操作置灰。

description.en: Imports chats captured from chat.deepseek.com by the repo's companion Edge extension (loaded unpacked in Edge) into DeepSeek Harness as new sessions; thinking is saved as a sidecar thinking.md, and trimmed, branched or very long chats also get the full transcript.md.
description.zh: 把配套 Edge 扩展（需在 Edge 里“加载已解压的扩展”）从 chat.deepseek.com 抓取并导出的对话重建为 DeepSeek Harness 新会话；思考存为旁挂 thinking.md，被截断、分叉或超长的对话另存完整原文 transcript.md。

description.en: Adds an /if slash command to DSH: the first line is a condition and the remaining lines are an instruction. A fork subagent that inherits the session tools, system prompt and message history judges the condition and answers YES or NO, and only on YES is the instruction sent to the main agent as an ordinary user message, while a NO sends nothing. The condition, judge prompt and verdict never enter the main transcript. While the agent is busy the command queues with ordinary messages, editable, removable and steerable from the queue panel, and a setting switches to the 0.2.x background mode. The judge runs read-only, and falls back to a one-shot model call over a plain transcript when the host has no context-inheriting fork provider. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 and later (verified on 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1) and Node.js 20.3 or later.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加 /if 斜杠命令：第一行是条件，其余行是指令。由继承当前会话工具、system prompt 与消息历史的 fork 子代理判断条件并回答 YES 或 NO，只有 YES 才把指令作为一条普通用户消息发给主 agent，NO 则什么都不发送；条件、判断用的 prompt 与判断结果都不会写进主会话。模型工作时命令与普通消息一起排队，可在队列面板里编辑、删除、插话，设置里可切回 0.2.x 的后台模式。判断以只读方式运行，宿主没有可继承上下文的 fork provider 时回退为一次性模型调用加纯文本记录。适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 及以上（已在 0.2.1-rc.5 与 0.2.2-rc.1 验证），需 Node.js 20.3 或更新版本。

description.en: Floating one-line widget showing how much Alibaba Cloud credit is left (voucher balance + account balance), with voucher face value, used amount and earliest expiry on hover. Read-only BSS queries, no spend tracking.
description.zh: 界面悬浮一行显示「还能花的钱」= 阿里云代金券余额 + 账户余额；悬停看券面值、已用与最早失效时间。只读 BSS 存量，不做消费统计。

description.en: Community-maintained WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy AI model provider using local desktop sign-in, with model discovery and credit display. Version 0.1.17 supports per-model context-window selection and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, rc.3, rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1; its CN compatibility layer differs from the functy23 fork. Derived from corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect (MIT), it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be enabled together with the original or other WorkBuddy bridges. Version 0.1.12 requires authenticated Host owner access for status and control routes.
description.zh: 复用本机桌面登录的 WorkBuddy 与 WorkBuddy AI 模型提供器社区分叉，提供模型发现和额度显示。正式版 0.1.17 支持按模型选择上下文窗口及 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2、rc.3、rc.5 和 0.2.2-rc.1，CN 兼容层与 functy23 的分叉不同。派生自 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect（MIT），注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与原版或其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。0.1.12 为状态与控制接口增加宿主 owner 身份认证。

description.en: Use a directory on an SSH host as a DSH workspace — hosts management, directory browser, five agent tools.
description.zh: 通过SSH方式，将远程主机的文件夹当成DSH的工作区，可以在本地DSH控制远程主机工作目录，不需要手动同步、不需要挂载驱动、不需要装任何第三方文件系统

description.en: Legal request intake: read requests out of EML, deduplicate threads and export the intake ledger — 2 `legal.*` tools.
description.zh: 法务需求收件：从 EML 读取需求、按线程去重并导出收件台账——2 个 `legal.*` 工具。

description.en: Ask the executing AI — and the auto-review AI when DSH's auto-review plugin is installed and enabled — about a pending tool approval before you allow or reject it; the executing AI's answers are saved into the session.
description.zh: 审批等待期间，向执行 AI 提问，装了并启用 DSH 的自动审查插件时也可问自动审查 AI，问清风险与后果再决定；执行 AI 的回答会留在会话里。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: agents save, search and update user preferences, facts and project decisions; important entries are injected into later sessions, and a Settings section lists, edits, archives or deletes them.
description.zh: dsh 跨会话记忆：agent 保存、检索并更新用户偏好、事实与项目决策，重要条目自动注入后续会话，设置面板可浏览、编辑、归档与删除。

description.en: Profile-wide DSH governance and routing with a Web Control Center for responsibility and evidence inspection, plus compaction, scoped semantic memory, safety continuity, and verified delivery; compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1.
description.zh: 面向整个 DSH profile 的治理与路由 bundle，提供用于职责与证据检查的 Web Control Center，以及压缩、本地作用域语义记忆、安全连续性与真实验收；兼容 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。

description.en: Replaces the stats line under the message input in the DSH desktop app with a configurable status bar of ten optional fields, with live cost estimates at DeepSeek's official peak and off-peak rates, custom per-model prices, a CNY or USD switch and account balance.
description.zh: 把 DSH 桌面端对话区底部的统计行换成可配置状态栏：10 个字段可选可排序，按 DeepSeek 官方峰谷口径实时估算费用，支持自定义模型单价、CNY / USD 计价切换与账户余额显示。

description.en: Turn event notifications: six event classes (completed, error, interrupted, approval requested, AI question, limit reached) delivered via sound, system notification, in-page banner, webhook, IM and host desktop-notification channels; when several browser windows are open, only one rings.
description.zh: 回合事件通知：完成/出错/被中断/等待审批/AI 提问/达到上限六类事件，经声音、系统弹窗、页内提示、webhook、IM、宿主桌面通知通道推送，多窗口只响一次。

description.en: Manageable one-tap text chips above the session composer; idle sessions queue the message and running sessions steer at the next safe boundary without rewriting the draft.
description.zh: 在会话输入区上方提供可管理的一点即发文本 chip；空闲时 queue、运行中 steer，不改写草稿。

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech that reads DeepSeek Harness assistant replies aloud, with a draggable mascot toggle and a one-click installer. Requires Python 3.10–3.12 preinstalled (the installer only locates it, it does not install Python); about 5 GB of disk and a GPU are recommended.
description.zh: 用本地 GPT-SoVITS 把 DeepSeek Harness 的助手回复读出来，带可拖动的挂件开关与一键部署。需预装 Python 3.10–3.12（安装器只负责定位，不负责安装）；建议约 5 GB 磁盘与 GPU。

description.en: Agent enhancements for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: prompt history, one-click optimize with undo, next-prompt prediction, conversation and tracked-file restore, model bill, context details with compact, Auto routing, and per-provider DeepSeek balance.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 智能体增强：提示词历史、一键优化与撤销、下一条预测、对话与已跟踪文件恢复、模型账单、上下文明细与压缩、Auto 路由，以及分账号 DeepSeek 余额显示。

description.en: See how you have been using AI: `/session-insights` reviews your DSH sessions over time, shows what worked, which problems kept coming back, and what results were actually produced, then creates a retrospective report on your machine.
description.zh: 回头看看你是怎么使用 AI 的：`/session-insights` 会整理一段时间内的 DSH 会话，找出哪些做法有效、哪些问题总在重复、最终真正留下了哪些成果，并生成一份保存在本机的复盘报告。

description.en: Browse and install DSH plugins without leaving the harness: a /store command, a Settings → Plugins tab, two agent-callable tools and a bundled skill, with an approval gate that lists the detected risk flags before anything installs.
description.zh: 不离开 harness 就能找插件、装插件：/store 命令、设置页的插件标签页、两个可供 agent 调用的工具和一个随包技能，安装前先确认并列出检测到的风险项。

description.en: Branch switching and isolated git worktrees as real workspaces, from the Web UI composer.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框切换分支、以真实工作区方式创建隔离的 git worktree。

description.en: Exports the session event stream to OpenTelemetry OTLP and Langfuse as sanitized, buffered traces and metrics, off by default.
description.zh: 将会话事件流导出为 OpenTelemetry OTLP 与 Langfuse 的脱敏、缓冲 traces 与指标，默认关闭。

description.en: Global font DIY: change size, weight, colour and family at any place in the DSH interface, per element or for the whole window, then hide the floating ball when you are done. No CSS writing and no restart. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 全局字体 DIY：界面任意位置的字体大小、字重、颜色与字体族都能改，可逐个元素也可整体生效，调完把悬浮球隐藏即可。不用写 CSS、不用重启。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Type Markdown, see it rendered live — Open-WebUI-style composer for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web, with syntax-highlighted code blocks, task lists, format toolbars and smart paste.
description.zh: 打 Markdown，边打边渲染——给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 输入框带来 Open WebUI 风格的实时编辑体验，代码块语法高亮、任务列表、格式工具栏、智能粘贴。

description.en: PII masking for DeepSeek Harness — anonymizes names, phones, emails, ids, and keys before requests and restores them at the display layer, keeping plaintext out of session logs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 PII 脱敏：请求前匿名化姓名、电话、邮箱、证件与密钥，展示层还原，明文不进入会话日志。

description.en: Mobile UI adaptation plugin for DeepSeek Harness - overlay drawer navigation, glassmorphism design, safe-area coverage, PWA support.
description.zh: DSH 移动端 UI 适配插件 - Overlay 抽屉导航、玻璃卡片设计、Safe Area 全覆盖、PWA 支持。

description.en: Reformats dsh session titles as "date | type | topic" (type and topic are summarized by a model from the full conversation), and hides unused sessions from the sidebar without deleting them.
description.zh: 把 dsh 会话标题统一成「日期｜类型｜主题」（类型与主题由模型对整段对话总结），并支持可逆的会话隐藏：暂时不用的会话从侧边栏收起，不删除、随时一键显示回来。

description.en: Hash-anchored file tools for DeepSeek Harness: the read, edit, write and grep tools are replaced by versions where every line is addressed by a variable-length content anchor instead of a line number, and the plugin also registers delete, rename, undo_last_edit, ast_grep, ast_edit, lsp and format. Edits answer with a unified diff; a stale or ambiguous anchor is rejected and a fresh one served back; undo survives restarts; structural search and rewrite run on tree-sitter and semantic work through a language server; a bundled web card plugin renders read, diff, grep and LSP cards from the tools' own structured metadata.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的文件工具换成哈希锚定版本：read、edit、write、grep 被替换为按变长内容锚点定位每一行（而不是行号）的实现，插件同时注册 delete、rename、undo_last_edit、ast_grep、ast_edit、lsp 与 format 七个工具。编辑以统一 diff 返回；失效或歧义的锚点被拒绝并重新下发新鲜锚点；undo 跨重启保留；结构化查找与改写走 tree-sitter，语义能力走语言服务器；随包的 web 卡片插件按各工具自带的结构化元数据渲染 read、diff、grep 与 LSP 卡片。

description.en: Chinese e-invoice (OFD/XML) inbox: ingest, parse, deduplicate, queue for review, record receipts and archive locally — 10 `invoice.*` tools, nothing uploaded.
description.zh: 中文电子发票（OFD/XML）收件箱：导入、解析、去重、进入复核队列、登记回执并本地归档——10 个 `invoice.*` 工具，数据不出本机。

description.en: The real ComfyUI editor as a sidebar tab in DeepSeek Harness, with per-session tools that read and edit the graph on screen and a panel that can start, stop and restart ComfyUI without installing anything into it.
description.zh: 把真正的 ComfyUI 编辑器作为侧栏标签嵌进 DeepSeek Harness，每会话的工具直接读写屏幕上那张工作流，面板可启停 ComfyUI，且不向 ComfyUI 安装任何东西。

description.en: Music, audiobook, radio and news player for DeepSeek Harness: streams your local music folder over HTTP, reads local .txt/.epub novels aloud with AI voices, plays online QQ/Kugou/Netease music and internet radio (HLS supported), and broadcasts daily news digests — all driven from the UI or by telling the agent through the music_play model tool.
description.zh: DSH 音乐/小说播放器：在网页里听本地音乐（HTTP 流式）、用 AI 声音朗读本地小说（.txt/.epub）、播放在线 QQ/酷狗/网易云音乐与网络电台（支持 HLS 直播流）、定时播报每日新闻；可在面板操作，也可让 agent 通过 music_play 工具直接点播。

description.en: Windows computer-use plugin for AI agents with reusable window targets, UI Automation, window-bound screenshots, background-first verified input, isolated Chromium automation, MCP, CLI, and installable skills.
description.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的 Windows 电脑操控与 computer use 插件，支持可复用窗口目标、UIA 无障碍定位、窗口绑定截图、后台优先的验证输入、隔离 Chromium 自动化、MCP、CLI 和可安装 Skill。

description.en: Role-based expert subagents for DeepSeek Harness with a task sidebar: explorer, librarian, oracle, designer and fixer delegate in parallel, each with its own model and reasoning depth.
description.zh: 基于角色的专家子代理并行协作，各角色可配置模型与思考深度，并提供 Expert Group 任务侧栏。

description.en: Auto-saves large pasted text as an attachment file in the DeepSeek Harness web input box; with dsh-better-sidebar installed, the paste pill opens the file in the sidebar editor and saves it back.
description.zh: 在输入框粘贴大段文本时自动保存为附件文件；装了 dsh-better-sidebar 时，药丸上的「查看」可在侧栏编辑器打开并保存回原文件。

description.en: Agent-team orchestration sidecar for DSH: teams with a configurable member cap, real sub-agent members with per-member model routing, task DAGs that dispatch automatically when their dependencies finish, a broker that enforces fs/exec/net/env permissions, and a live web panel over SSE.
description.zh: DSH 的 Agent 团队编排 sidecar：成员上限可配，成员是真实的 sub-agent 且可单独指定模型；任务按 DAG 依赖自动派发；fs/exec/net/env 四域权限由 broker 强制；运行过程通过 SSE 在 Web 面板实时查看。

description.en: Lighten the load on your agent: one-click toggles for skills and MCP, so the context holds only what this turn actually needs. Skills and MCP servers you switch off are no longer injected into the model context — cleaner, and lighter on tokens.
description.zh: 给你的 Agent 减负：Skill 与 MCP 一键启停，让上下文只装这一轮真正要用的能力。关掉的 skill / MCP 不再进入模型上下文，更干净，更省 token。

description.en: Android development toolchain inside DeepSeek Harness: 23 android_* tools that find the SDK, create and manage AVDs, start and stop emulators, scaffold a Kotlin/Compose project, build and run it with Gradle, then install, launch, screenshot, tail logcat and drive the UI. A settings page holds the SDK, emulator, API-level, build and output parameters.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里驱动 Android 开发工具链：23 个 android_* 工具负责探测 SDK、创建与管理 AVD、启停模拟器、生成 Kotlin/Compose 工程、用 Gradle 构建运行，并完成安装、启动、截图、logcat 与 UI 操作。设置页集中管理 SDK、模拟器、API 级别、构建与输出参数。

description.en: In DSH Desktop, see the tokens, cost and speed of every request, compare spending by model and provider, merge different names for the same model, check balances and compare real model performance.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端看清每一次请求的 Token、费用与速度，按模型和供应商汇总花费，统一同一模型的不同名称，核对余额并比较模型实际表现。

description.en: Black-box GUI testing for DeepSeek Harness: an AI tester drives a real Windows virtual machine using only screenshots and mouse/keyboard, so its verdicts rest on pixels instead of logs or source code. Ships the dsh-vm-tester plugin with twelve vm_* tools (status, UI tree, screenshot, click, type, type-secret, key, basic key, wait, snapshot, upload, download), a reverse-tunnel guest agent for Windows, and run verification scripts. Needs Windows, VirtualBox 7 and a Windows guest VM with the bundled agent before any vm tool works.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的黑盒 GUI 测试：AI 测试员只靠截图与键鼠操作真实 Windows 虚拟机，判定必须由像素支撑，而不是读日志或源码。包含 dsh-vm-tester 插件的十二个 vm_* 工具（状态、UI 元素树、截图、点击、输入、凭据注入、按键、普通键、等待、快照、上传、下载）、Windows 虚拟机内的反向隧道代理，以及运行体检与围观脚本。需要 Windows、VirtualBox 7 和装有内置代理的 Windows 虚拟机，vm 工具才可用。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DSH Web: workspace-grouped list, FTS5 full-text search over session content with per-session snippets, restore-and-open, and hard delete.
description.zh: 归档会话管理插件：按工作区分组浏览，FTS5 全文检索会话内容并展示多条命中摘要，支持恢复并打开与彻底删除。

description.en: Visual reference moodboard for DeepSeek Harness: drag-and-drop images with tags and notes, and pinned style guides the agent reads before it generates or restyles UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可视化参考情绪板：拖入图片并打标签、写备注，固定风格指南，智能体在生成或改版界面之前先读取这些参考。

description.en: Qwen Token Plan CN Responses provider for DeepSeek Harness via the OpenAI Responses API, with Qwen server-side tools, DSH local function tools, text/reasoning/tool-call multi-turn history, persisted image attachments, and a per-release official model catalog snapshot.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的千问 Token Plan 个人版 Responses API 提供方，保留 Qwen 服务端内置工具与 DSH 本地函数工具，多轮文本/推理/工具调用历史与图片附件均被支持，官方模型目录按 npm 版本冻结快照发布。

description.en: A bundle of molbio tools for molecular biology work:sequence analysis, primer and probe design (qPCR, TaqMan), in-silico PCR,cloning simulation,plasmid maps,sequencing validation,protein and CRISPR analysis,qPCR statistics,literature and lab records;installed as a preset-scoped bundle.
description.zh: 一组molbio分子生物学工具，包含序列分析、引物和探针设计、电子 PCR、克隆模拟、质粒图谱，测序验证，蛋白与CRISPR分析，qPCR统计，文献与实验记录；随 bundle 以预设模式安装。

description.en: A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端 UI（TUI）。

description.en: A Windows disk cleaner for DeepSeek Harness that scans known-safe cache locations, shows their sizes, reclaims the space from a Web panel, and offers a read-only audit of what it cannot clean automatically.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 磁盘清理插件，扫描已知的安全缓存目录、显示占用大小，在 Web 面板中回收空间，并对无法自动清理的部分提供只读审计。

description.en: PDF parsing tools for DSH: pdf_info, pdf_extract_text, and pdf_render_page with dual pdfjs and built-in rendering engines, including system-font rendering for PDFs with non-embedded CJK fonts.
description.zh: DSH 的 PDF 解析工具：pdf_info、pdf_extract_text、pdf_render_page 三件套，pdfjs 与自研渲染器双引擎，未内嵌 CJK 字体的 PDF 也能用系统字体渲染出图。

description.en: QQ protocol backend for DeepSeek Harness on Linux: boots LinuxQQ and NapCat with the engine (first run installs them, about 250 MB) and exposes a standard OneBot 11 endpoint.
description.zh: 给 DSH 提供 QQ 协议端（仅 Linux）：随引擎启动 LinuxQQ 与 NapCat（首次运行自动安装，约 250 MB），对外提供标准 OneBot 11 接口。

description.en: Manages a Magpie model list and writes the checked models into a Magpie provider group: full sync from /v1/models, manual entries, per-model context, output limit, image input and reasoning efforts, sorting and drag reordering. On Windows x64/ARM64 it also downloads and upgrades Magpie from yetone/magpie-releases with SHA-256 verification and rollback, auto-upgrades once a release is 30 minutes old and all conversations are idle, starts Magpie in the tray with DSH, and toggles its lite mode and sleep prevention.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理 Magpie 模型清单并写入 Magpie 模型分组：从 /v1/models 全量同步、手动添加，逐模型编辑上下文、输出限额、图片输入与思考档位，支持排序与拖动调整顺序。Windows x64/ARM64 上还可从 yetone/magpie-releases 下载、升级 Magpie（SHA-256 校验、失败回滚），新版发布满 30 分钟且对话全部空闲时自动升级，随 DSH 启动以托盘模式拉起 Magpie，并可切换其轻量模式与防止休眠。

description.en: Song-dynasty-inspired theme for the DSH web UI: a light "rice paper" and a dark "night ink" variant, Ru celadon carrying interactive states while kiln copper is reserved for blockquotes, plus a 4pt spacing scale and a 46-glyph mask icon set.
description.zh: 宋律 Songgrid —— 宋代美学主题，宣纸（浅）与夜墨（深）双变体；汝窑天青承担交互态、窑铜只用于引用块；另附 4pt 间距阶与 46 个 mask 图标。

description.en: A minimal phone remote control for DeepSeek Harness: the phone page carries only the instruction you send and the AI's final conclusion, while tool calls, file access, sub-agent dispatch, and reasoning traces stay on the computer, reachable over LAN, Tailscale, or a Cloudflare tunnel with a QR code, link, and password for each route.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的极简手机遥控器：手机页面上只有你发出的指令和 AI 最后的结论，工具调用、文件读写、子 Agent 调度与思考过程全部留在电脑上；可通过内网、Tailscale 或 Cloudflare 隧道连接，每条路径各配二维码、链接和密码。

description.en: Caps the lifetime of DSH desktop's dsh-auth-* session cookies at 7 days, so they stop piling up in the Cookie header until startup fails with HTTP 431.
description.zh: 把 DSH 桌面端 dsh-auth-* 会话 cookie 的寿命压到 7 天，避免它们越积越多撑爆请求头、导致启动时报 HTTP 431。

description.en: Hearts of Iron IV modding bundle for DeepSeek Harness: registers 15 skills covering focus trees, events, decisions, ideas, characters, technologies, localisation, GUI and error.log triage, and mounts 20 local MCP tools (a Python stdio server) to scaffold content, statically validate mods, build a SQLite FTS5 knowledge base from the vanilla game, and preview focus trees offline. Ships a 163-document reference library; requires DSH >=0.2.0 <0.3.0 and Python 3.9+ on PATH (standard library only, no game assets).
description.zh: 面向《钢铁雄心4》Mod 开发的 DeepSeek Harness 组合包：注册 15 个技能（国策树、事件、决议、理念、角色、科技、本地化、GUI 与 error.log 分诊），并在本地挂载 20 个 MCP 工具（Python stdio 服务器），用于生成内容、静态校验 Mod、以原版游戏建 SQLite FTS5 知识库、离线预览国策树。附 163 篇参考库；要求 DSH >=0.2.0 <0.3.0 与 PATH 上有 Python 3.9+（仅标准库，不含游戏素材）。

description.en: Web GUI convenience suite with appearance controls, timeline navigation, project folders, prompts, conversation export, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, and DeepSeek balance and daily token usage.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 便利套件，提供外观控制、时间线导航、项目文件夹、提示词、会话导出、Mermaid 渲染、引用回复，以及 DeepSeek 余额和每日 token 用量。

description.en: Injects a fixed system-reminder at the first step of every turn asking the model to reason and answer in Simplified Chinese, while code, commands, file paths, and identifiers stay in English.
description.zh: 每轮第一步注入固定的 system-reminder，要求模型用简体中文思考与回答，代码、命令、文件路径与标识符保持原文。

description.en: Three Zhihu tools for DSH — in-site search, Zhihu's global web index with domain and date filters, and Zhida answers — with a native settings card and source-cited results.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加三个知乎工具——站内问答与文章检索、知乎全网索引检索（可按域名与时间过滤）、直答——自带原生设置卡片，结果附来源可引用。

description.en: Accounts-payable three-way match: import invoices, purchase orders and goods receipts, apply the tolerance policy and export the exception workpaper — 4 `ap.*` tools.
description.zh: 应付三单匹配：导入发票、采购订单与收货单，按容差策略匹配并导出异常底稿——4 个 `ap.*` 工具。

description.en: Shows which graft index a dsh session is serving and whether it still matches the code, and gives the model graft_ask, graft_grep, graft_callers, graft_skeleton and graft_map as native tools.
description.zh: 显示当前 dsh 会话所用的 graft 索引、以及它是否仍与代码一致，并把 graft_ask、graft_grep、graft_callers、graft_skeleton、graft_map 作为原生工具交给模型。

description.en: A philosopher's way of thinking made executable: dialectics and practice-testing to govern hallucination and long-session drift, so done is a verifiable fact rather than a claim.
description.zh: 把哲学家的思考方式变成可执行的东西：用辩证法和实践检验治理幻觉与长会话漂移，让「做完了」是可核事实而不是一句自述。

description.en: Automate Huawei eNSP labs: generate .topo files, start and stop devices, and push configuration one command at a time with per-command error reporting. On Windows it drives the eNSP window with simulated mouse clicks and window screenshots used to locate buttons (administrator rights needed), sends commands to the device consoles over local TCP, and may force-kill running eNSP clients when it has to relaunch.
description.zh: 面向华为 eNSP 的自动化工具：生成 .topo 拓扑、启停设备、逐条下发配置并在每条命令后核对结果。在 Windows 上用模拟鼠标点击和用来定位按钮的 eNSP 窗口截图来驱动 eNSP 窗口（需要管理员权限），通过本机 TCP 向设备控制台下发命令，重新启动时可能强制结束正在运行的 eNSP 客户端。

description.en: Reusable Agent Team presets for DeepSeek Harness: a Settings page stores named Teams — a captain with its own prompt and tool allow-list, plus members carrying their own provider/model route, reasoning effort, prompt and tools — and a composer control applies one Team to the current Session, installing the captain prompt and registering the spawn_team_member, get_team_preset and update_team_preset tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可复用智能体团队预设：设置页保存具名团队——队长带自己的提示词与工具白名单，成员各自带 provider/模型路由、推理强度、提示词与工具——编辑器栏的团队控件把选中的团队应用到当前会话，安装队长提示词，并注册 spawn_team_member、get_team_preset、update_team_preset 三个工具。

description.en: Plugin development toolset: mark files read by shell commands, sync code into a profile, mock a plugin backend, preview a plugin frontend, verify plugin loading, spin up an isolated test instance, run named shell shortcuts, and list the plugin's tools.
description.zh: 插件开发工具箱：命令读过的文件自动算已读、代码同步到 profile、后端模拟与前端预览、插件装载验证、隔离测试实例、自定义快捷命令、工具清单。

description.en: Tidy the model list of DeepSeek Harness: hide any model from the selector, rename models and channels while keeping the provider billing rate, and arrange both with arrows. Search, per-provider batch toggles, back to top, one-click restore. Display only — no provider configuration is rewritten.
description.zh: DSH 模型整理：整理并精简模型列表——隐藏任意模型、给模型和渠道改备注名（保留厂商计费倍率）、用箭头调整模型与渠道排序；支持搜索、渠道级批量开关、返回顶部与一键恢复。只改显示，不重写任何渠道配置。

description.en: A long-form Chinese novel workbench inside DeepSeek Harness: read, edit and annotate the manuscript in place; AI reports problems with ready-to-adopt revision drafts, and the text changes only when you accept. A ledger for characters, facts and foreshadowing plus a world map keep a long novel consistent, and AI can continue, expand or rewrite chapters.
description.zh: 装在 DeepSeek Harness 里的长篇中文小说工作台：正文页直接阅读、编辑和批注；AI 找问题并写好修改稿，你采纳后正文才会变。人物、事实、伏笔的账本加世界地图，让长篇不前后打架；还能让 AI 续写、扩写或改写整章。

description.en: Refractive liquid-glass skin: custom wallpapers, several tunable refracting glass surfaces, wallpapers that rotate by time of day, four theme colours, a water-drop highlight lens on the selected item, and per-control parameters tuned from the bottom-right panel.
description.zh: 可折射的液态玻璃皮肤 UI：可自定义壁纸、多个可调折射液态玻璃面、随时段轮换的壁纸、四档主题色、选中项带水滴状高亮飞镜、右下可自定义每个控件参数。

description.en: Balance dashboard, allowing the addition of multiple pay-as-you-go/Token plans, while simultaneously checking balances.
description.zh: 余额看板，可以添加多个按量计费/Token plan，同时查询余额。

description.en: Exposes a running DeepSeek Harness as an MCP server over Streamable HTTP or a bundled stdio bridge, so an external agent can create workspaces and sessions, prompt, fork, rename and switch the model on them, read and write files, run foreground and background shell commands, call the instance's own agent tools by name, and read per-turn and cumulative token usage with a cost receipt when a price plugin is installed.
description.zh: 把正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 暴露为 MCP server（Streamable HTTP，或附带的 stdio 桥），外部 agent 可创建 workspace 与会话，发起 prompt、fork、重命名、切换模型，读写文件，运行前台与后台 shell 命令，按名调用该实例自身的 agent 工具，并读取单轮与累计 token 用量；装了计价插件时还给出费用回执。

description.en: IFC model quantity take-off with CSV export for quantity checking.
description.zh: IFC 模型工程量提取与 CSV 导出核对。

description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness work across configured model APIs and supported vendor CLIs with dependency-aware packages and cost previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 规划有依赖的工作包，将其分配给已配置的模型 API 或支持的厂商 CLI，并提供费用预览。

description.en: Scheduled task dispatcher: a dsh host plugin that drives recurring agent tasks from a single task table, dispatching each run as an independent dsh session; scheduling is pure logic and uses zero model calls.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：一张任务表驱动周期性运行的 agent 任务，每次调度为一个独立的 dsh 会话；调度本身纯逻辑实现，不消耗任何模型调用。

description.en: Turn a one-line requirement into verified delivery. TeamFlow runs a multi-stage pipeline — triage, PRD, design, technical plan, parallel development, QA with defect rework, acceptance — and gives the model 12 `teamflow_*` tools plus a workbench with a live pipeline graph and a backlog kanban. Each requirement gets its own folder holding the PRD, design, technical plan, QA report and acceptance record.
description.zh: 把一句话需求变成可验收的交付。TeamFlow 跑一条多阶段流水线——分诊、PRD、设计、技术方案、并行开发、带打回重修的 QA、验收——并给模型 12 个 `teamflow_*` 工具，以及带实时流水线图与 backlog 看板的工作台。每个需求一个专属目录，收着 PRD、设计、技术方案、QA 报告与验收记录。

description.en: Drive CADCraft from the agent: draw lines, arcs and splines, manage layers, add dimensions, hatches and blocks, then export DXF, DWG, SVG, PNG or PDF. Exposes both CADCraft's command ids and its own MCP server, so a drawing can be created and read back. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 CADCraft：绘制直线、圆弧与样条，管理图层，添加标注、填充与图块，并导出 DXF、DWG、SVG、PNG 或 PDF。同时暴露 CADCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server，可创建并读回图纸。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Compaction fallback for compaction-basic: when its LLM summary throws, comes back empty or cannot fit the window, the span is compiled deterministically with a seq pointer on every line (vendored dsh-compaction-instant compiler). Adds recall and search tools, /recall and /context commands, an idle trigger at 45% of the window and an on-disk span archive. The engine mounts as one row in the agent preset (docs/dsh-integration.md).
description.zh: 为 compaction-basic 提供压缩兜底：当 LLM 摘要抛错、返回空内容或放不进上下文窗口时，改为确定性编译该区段，每行带 seq 指针（内置 dsh-compaction-instant 编译器）。提供 recall、search 工具与 /recall、/context 命令，占用超过窗口 45% 时空闲自动压缩，并将被压缩区段归档到磁盘。引擎以一行配置挂载到 agent preset（见 docs/dsh-integration.md）。

description.en: Re-speaks each assistant report in a chosen persona outside the working prompt, with four built-in presets, per-session switches, and the original available on demand.
description.zh: 在系统提示词之外，用选定人格转述每条助手汇报；内置四个预设，支持会话级开关，原文随时可查。

description.en: Context fullness bands, the per-session compaction threshold derived from the model window, per-step cost computed from cache read and cache write rates, cache-hit, DeepSeek balance with the peak/off-peak tariff, and a one-click handoff. It never calls a model and spends no tokens.
description.zh: 上下文占用档位、按模型窗口推算的每会话压缩阈值、按缓存读取/写入费率计算的单步费用、缓存命中率、DeepSeek 余额与高峰/低谷费率，以及一键交接。它从不调用模型，也不消耗 token。

description.en: DeepSeek wallet balance at the sidebar foot: a credit-card icon with the amount tinted by remaining balance (green over ¥2, amber ¥0–2, red below), refreshed on mount, per turn-end, and on click; a signed delta floats up and fades on each balance change.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的 DeepSeek 钱包余额：信用卡图标配余额数字，按剩余额度着色（≥ ¥2 绿色、¥0–2 黄色、≤ ¥0 红色），挂载时、每轮对话结束和点击时刷新；余额变动时带符号差额上飘淡出。

description.en: Read-only MCP server over the DSH plugin-certification registry, exposing a plugin certification grade, its snapshot and the five-dimension evidence behind it.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 插件认证登记的只读 MCP 服务，对外提供插件的认证等级、其快照以及支撑它的五维证据。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web theme: ten OKLCH Chinese-traditional-colour palettes that adapt to light and dark, plus an optional wallpaper behind frosted glass panels; tailored for the DS Bot (bot team) interface; the palette and wallpaper persist locally.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 主题：十套 OKLCH 中国传统色配色、明暗自适应；可选一张壁纸铺满窗口、界面以磨砂玻璃叠上去；已适配 DS Bot（Bot 团队）界面；配色与壁纸都本地持久化。

description.en: Reader-first long-form fiction pipeline: setting and character cards first, 21 gate scripts, a 1000-trope library and 700 theme seeds, at most two tropes per chapter, a self-test for every script; the scripts run on the host's Python 3.
description.zh: 读者优先的长篇小说工序：人物卡与设定卡先行、21 个门禁脚本、1000 条桥段与 700 条主题种子、每章最多两个桥段，每个脚本自带自检；脚本依赖宿主上的 Python 3 运行。

description.en: Token optimization for DeepSeek Harness with searchable MCP tool discovery and lazy loading, configurable compaction controls and status reporting, tool-output reduction, long-text vision summarization, and opt-in conversation archiving with paginated retrieval.
description.zh: Token 优化：支持可搜索的 MCP 工具发现与懒加载、可配置的压缩控制与状态查看、工具输出精简、长文本视觉摘要，以及可选的对话原文归档与分页回查。

description.en: Automatic model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: one user instruction enters, one tier decision comes out — complex intent is planned on the strong tier and implemented on the cheap tier, simple intent stays cheap throughout, with a deterministic guard and a TTL escalation fallback.
description.zh: 自动模型档位路由：一条用户指令进入、一个档位决策出来——复杂意图由强档规划、廉价档执行，简单意图全程廉价档，确定性护栏 + TTL 升级回退。

description.en: Scratchpad panel for DeepSeek Harness: tagged notes, image/file attachments, Markdown task lists, send-to-chat, a wake-up shortcut, JSON export/import, and Agent tools.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的左栏便签插件：带标签的随手记、图片/文件附件、Markdown 待办、发到对话、唤起快捷键、JSON 导入导出，以及 Agent 工具。

description.en: Context compression for small-context models: visually configure the compressed context budget, default to an 8k handoff + 16k recent context, and keep full history searchable.
description.zh: 面向小上下文模型的 DSH 上下文压缩插件：压缩大小可视化配置，默认 8k 交接摘要 + 16k 最近上下文，完整历史仍可查询。

description.en: Read-only DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar version chip that shows the running DSH version, npm latest/next/alpha channels, compatibility labels, and a copy-only upgrade command.
description.zh: 只读的 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧栏版本芯片，显示当前运行版本、npm latest/next/alpha 通道、兼容性标识，以及仅复制的升级命令。

description.en: Step-by-step workflow map for DeepSeek Harness: folds a session into one step list, labels where each percentage came from rather than reporting a bare number, and queues a prompt for the next step with revoke before it is claimed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分步工作流地图：把会话折叠成一条分步列表，给每个进度百分比标注来源而不是只报一个数，并支持把提示词排入下一步队列、被取用前可撤回。

description.en: Per-turn checkpoints of the whole workspace: every turn ends with a snapshot, the files it changed are listed under that turn in the chat, and any turn can be restored — files, the conversation, or both. Capture is a whole-tree scan rather than a hook on write/edit tools, so edits made by shell commands, external editors or git leave a record too. Restoring the conversation forks it from that turn instead of cutting the original, and a restore can itself be undone. History sits in a shadow git repository under DSH_HOME and never touches your project .git. Requires Git >= 2.20 and Node.js >= 20.
description.zh: 按轮次给整个工作区留检查点：每轮结束存一份快照，本轮改了哪些文件直接列在聊天里那一条下方，任意一轮都能还原——只还原文件、只还原对话，或者全部还原。捕获靠扫描整棵树，而不是挂钩 write/edit 工具，所以 shell 命令、外部编辑器、git 操作改出来的东西同样留痕。还原对话是从那一轮分叉出新会话，不切断原来的会话；还原本身也能撤销。历史存放在 DSH_HOME 里的影子 git 仓库中，不碰项目的 .git。需 Git >= 2.20 与 Node.js >= 20。

description.en: Windows system-drive (C:) cleanup for DSH: rule-based scan, five-tier safety grading, a staging area with a rollback ledger, UAC elevation, and migration to another drive — a model tool plus a Web GUI panel.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 系统盘（C 盘）清理能力：按规则库扫描、五级安全分级、带台账可回滚的暂存区、UAC 提权与迁移到其他盘 —— 既有模型工具，也有 Web 面板。

description.en: OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.
description.zh: 把本地 OpenViking 记忆服务接进 DSH 界面：左侧边栏的 Studio 面板、输入框下方的会话提交状态胶囊与提交时间线，以及右侧边栏查看当前会话检索到哪些记忆的面板。

description.en: Image "reading" for text-only models: downscale + reduce color depth + structure/color fingerprints into text grids fed back to the conversation, letting the model zoom, sample and OCR autonomously like a multimodal model; fully local with zero external model dependency, ships an image-reading methodology skill and optional PaddleOCR.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的"读图"能力：图片降分辨率+降色深+结构/色彩指纹渲染成文本网格喂回对话，模型像多模态一样自主缩放、取样、OCR 读图；纯本地零外部模型依赖，附读图方法论 skill 与可选 PaddleOCR。

description.en: An always-on working style for DSH agents, packaged as an agent preset: restate the task, read before editing, verify each change with a real command, keep context lean. Ships 29 skills (plan loops, review loops, TDD, unsticking, PR watching) plus a turn guard that pushes back when a turn edits files without a successful check afterwards, and pushes back harder on a second miss.
description.zh: 以 agent preset 形式提供的 DSH 常驻工作方式：复述任务、改前先读、每步用真实命令验证、控制上下文体积。内含 29 个技能（计划循环、评审循环、TDD、卡住换思路、PR 跟踪），以及一个回合守卫：当本轮改了文件却没有在之后跑成任何检查时出言打回，第二次再犯时措辞更硬。

description.en: Agent tool that returns the running DSH Web GUI URL including its per-process launch token, so browser automation can open the GUI instead of getting a 401.
description.zh: 把当前 DSH Web GUI 的合法带 token 地址作为 agent 工具返回，浏览器自动化可直接打开 GUI，不再遇到 401。

description.en: Fetches AOSP source snapshots from codeload and searches them on the device with ripgrep through nine tools covering mirror listing, preset bundles, fetch, incremental update, cross-module regex search, a heuristic call-chain trace and line reads, with no git, no root and no build.
description.zh: 从 codeload 拉 AOSP 源码快照，在本机用 ripgrep 检索，九个工具覆盖镜像列表、预设包、拉取、增量更新、跨模块正则搜索、启发式调用链追踪与按行读取，不需要 git、root 或编译。

description.en: Named subagent presets bound to model-route allowlists, where an out-of-list child model is refused before a delegation starts and each child conversation shows the model its last request actually used.
description.zh: 为官方子智能体工具提供具名预设与模型路由白名单：越界的子模型在派发前被拒绝，子会话标题栏显示最近一次请求实际使用的模型。

description.en: Add missing reasoning-effort declarations to custom pi-ai models through DSH settings, enabling the native effort picker and handling models added later.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 设置为自定义 pi-ai 模型补充缺失的推理强度声明，启用原生强度选择器，并自动处理后续添加的模型。

description.en: Per-conversation behavioral rule fence for DeepSeek Harness: rules live in one JSON file, are edited from a Settings page or the conversation panel, and every rule carries its own on/off switch so a single rule can be muted without deleting it (muted rules are skipped at injection and the remaining numbering stays contiguous); any number of conversations can also be excluded as a whole so they receive no fence at all, and picking conversations never touches the rules themselves; the enabled rules are injected as one runtime-context section at a fixed order so the system prompt prefix stays stable.
description.zh: 给每个对话加一道行为围栏：规则存在一个 JSON 文件里，可在设置页或对话面板里编辑，每条规则右侧都有独立开关，可以随时单独停用某一条而不用删掉它（停用项不参与注入、剩余条目编号仍然连续）；也可以多选若干对话整体排除在外，让它们完全不受围栏约束，勾选对话本身不会改动任何规则；启用中的规则作为一段固定顺序的运行时上下文注入，不重写系统提示词前缀。

description.en: Analyzes usage and cost across models, providers and workspaces over any date range: hourly single-day and daily cross-day trends, a 53-week heatmap, cache-hit and model/workspace shares, plus request logs, CSV export and a ledger that survives session and workspace deletion. Highlights: multi-dimensional usage analysis, model and workspace insight, configurable cost and balance, full history with incremental sync, and auditable day-to-day operations.
description.zh: 统一分析多模型、多供应商、多工作区的用量与成本：任意起止日期、单日小时与跨日趋势、53 周热力图、缓存命中与模型/工作区占比，另有请求日志、CSV 导出与可跨会话恢复的持久账本。特点：多维用量分析，模型与工作区洞察，可配置成本与余额，完整历史与增量同步，可审计的日常操作。

description.en: Bridge DeepSeek Harness sessions to Cherry Studio desktops over the LAN - QR pairing, 15 cherry_* tools for agents, sessions, history and interactions (including uploading local files as attachments and reading desktop-uploaded images back as image blocks), a settings page for devices and per-workspace tool scope, and an experimental subagent that delegates the way DSH's own subagent does (Claude Code / Codex style) with the child running on a Cherry Studio agent.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话桥接到局域网内的 Cherry Studio 桌面端——二维码配对、15 个 cherry_* 工具（agent/会话/历史/交互，含把本地文件作为附件上传、把桌面端已上传的图片读成 image block）、设置页（设备管理、按工作区的工具启用范围），以及实验性子智能体（仿 DSH 官方 subagent / Claude Code · Codex 的委派方式，执行端换成 Cherry Studio 的 agent）。

description.en: Drive DeckCraft from the agent: create slides, apply layouts and themes, add shapes, pictures, tables and charts, then save a .pptx or export a PDF. Exposes DeckCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 DeckCraft：新建幻灯片、套用版式与主题、添加形状、图片、表格与图表，并保存为 .pptx 或导出 PDF。暴露 DeckCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Routes images to a vision model of your choice - auto-rewrite, explicit tools, or hybrid - so a text-only chat model does not fail a turn that contains a picture.
description.zh: 将图片交给所选的视觉模型处理（自动改写、显式工具或混合模式），使纯文本聊天模型也能处理包含图片的对话。

description.en: Secure remote access for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a login gate, MFA/TOTP, signed session cookies, optional admin/user/guest roles, in-browser workspace selection, and allowlisted remote file previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供安全远程访问：登录门禁、MFA/TOTP、签名会话 Cookie、可选的 admin/user/guest 角色、浏览器内工作区选择和按允许目录限制的远程文件预览。

description.en: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness: per-model daily and range charts plus a yearly contributions heatmap.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量统计：近 7 天/30 天按模型的柱状图、饼图，外加近一年每日活跃热力图。

description.en: Drive GridCraft from the agent: build workbooks, write and evaluate formulas, format ranges, insert charts and tables, and read cells back. Exposes both GridCraft's command ids and its own MCP server, so a workbook can be created and inspected end to end. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 GridCraft：构建工作簿、写入并计算公式、设置区域格式、插入图表与表格，并读回单元格。同时暴露 GridCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server，可端到端地创建并检查工作簿。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Configurable web search for DeepSeek Harness using SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, or Gemini, with per-client engine selection and bounded retries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置联网搜索，支持 SearXNG、Wikipedia、Tavily、Brave 与 Gemini，并支持客户端引擎选择和受控重试。

description.en: Drive PdfCraft from the agent: read and extract text, render pages to images, rotate, delete, reorder, combine or split pages, and audit faux redactions. Exposes PdfCraft's tool set as both commands and an MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 PdfCraft：读取并提取文本、把页面渲染成图片、旋转/删除/重排/合并/拆分页面，并检查伪脱敏。以命令与 MCP server 两种形式暴露 PdfCraft 的工具集。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Localizes known DSH system instructions and runtime reminders into Simplified Chinese, trims tool-related guidance to visible tools, and provides editable translations and component toggles while preserving tool names and parameter schemas.
description.zh: 将 DSH 已知系统指引与运行时提醒中文化，按可见工具裁剪相关指导，提供逐条译文编辑和组件开关，保留工具名与参数结构。

description.en: Select reply text, edit numbered annotations, and send several with a question using native DSH composer references, draft persistence, and submission; requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later within the 0.2.x series.
description.zh: 选取回复文字、编辑编号批注并随问题一起发送，复用 DSH 原生输入框引用、草稿保存和发送流程；需 DSH 0.2.x 系列中的 0.2.1-rc.2 或更新版本。

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-vision` provider route: the Web GUI accepts pasted images and transcribes them to text via the free Zhipu GLM vision API before delegating to the DeepSeek adapter.
description.zh: 注册 `deepseek-vision` 路由：Web GUI 直接粘贴图片，由免费智谱 GLM 视觉模型转译为文字后，再交给 DeepSeek 适配器作答。

description.en: Drive WordCraft from the agent: create documents, insert and style text, build tables and headers, track changes and comments, then save as DOCX or convert to PDF, ODT, RTF, Markdown and more. Exposes WordCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 WordCraft：新建文档、插入并排版文字、构建表格与页眉、跟踪修订与批注，并保存为 DOCX 或转换为 PDF、ODT、RTF、Markdown 等。暴露 WordCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Renders inline code in DSH chat as pills with syntax colours and optional file badges, styles chat file paths, and offers optional folded-row tinting and thinking-text ink, with a settings page for six presets, colours and fonts.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话中的行内代码渲染为带语法色和可选文件标记的胶囊，并处理聊天中的文件路径；可选折叠动作行着色与思考文字彩虹刷入，设置页提供六套预设、颜色与字体选项。

description.en: Right-click files, folders, web links, and workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness chat and sidebars to reference, copy, preview, open in a chosen app or browser, reveal, or save.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话区和侧边栏右键文件、文件夹、网页链接和工作区：引用、复制、预览、用默认或选择的应用/浏览器打开、定位或另存为。

description.en: Aquaculture input register completeness and withdrawal-period date check: deterministic findings with rule IDs.
description.zh: 水产养殖投入品记录完整性与休药期日期核对：按规则 ID 输出确定性发现。

description.en: Injects one fixed system-prompt section so the agent thinks and replies in Chinese, regardless of the user's language.
description.zh: 注入一条固定 system-prompt 段落，让 Agent 无论用户使用什么语言都始终用中文思考和回复。

description.en: Manage native archives by workspace, with search, unarchive, and permanent deletion of individual sessions or fixed batches.
description.zh: 按工作区管理原生归档，支持搜索、取消归档、单项和固定范围批量永久删除。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Busabase: search workspace knowledge, work with structured records and apps, submit writes as reviewable ChangeRequests, and inspect results in live cards.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Busabase：检索工作区知识、操作结构化记录与应用、将写入提交为可审阅的 ChangeRequest，并在实时卡片中查看结果。

description.en: Connect OpenCode Zen free-tier models to DeepSeek Harness through the local OpenCode client. Real-time model discovery, per-model toggle in settings, one-click provider write. No API key required.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，实时模型发现、设置页逐个启停、一键写入 provider，免 key；请求由本机 OpenCode 客户端代发。

description.en: Edit and regenerate: adds an edit action to user message bubbles, regenerating from that message with images and files carried over and the original model inherited.
description.zh: 编辑重发：在用户消息气泡上多一个「编辑」，改完从那条消息重新生成，图片与文件随行重传，模型继承原会话。

description.en: Drive VectorCraft from the agent: create and edit paths and artboards, set text and effects, then export SVG, PDF, AI or EPS. Exposes VectorCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 VectorCraft：创建与编辑路径和画板、设置文字与效果，并导出 SVG、PDF、AI 或 EPS。暴露 VectorCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Estimate session and turn costs with model prices in USD or CNY and price sync from models.dev, OpenRouter, or DeepInfra.
description.zh: 估算会话和每轮费用，按模型设置 USD 或 CNY 单价，并从 models.dev、OpenRouter 或 DeepInfra 同步价格。

description.en: Floating DSH desktop pet with 12 authored state animations for requests, tools, compaction, archive and prompt enhancement; live context occupancy; a persistent cross-session Lifetime Ledger; per-provider/model totals, hourly trends and 7/30-day views; dark/light theme switching; optional cost estimates (off by default) with a visual price editor and monthly budget alert; client-side skin ZIP import; JSON/CSV usage export; snapshot-only panel reads with background incremental indexing; and opt-in prompt enhancement with editable preview and DSH composer submission.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮桌面用量小宠物：用 12 个正式状态动作反馈请求、工具、上下文压缩、归档和提示词增强，展示实时上下文占用、跨会话终身用量账本、服务商/模型统计、小时趋势与近 7/30 日视图；支持深色/浅色主题切换；可选成本估算（默认关闭）与可视化价格表、月预算告警；客户端皮肤 ZIP 导入；JSON/CSV 用量导出；通过纯快照面板读取和后台增量索引避免打开面板时扫描历史，并提供用户主动触发、可编辑预览和直接发送的提示词增强。

description.en: Drive PhotoCraft from the agent: open and create documents, work with layers and selections, apply adjustments and filters, run batch actions, then save or export PSD, PNG, JPG, TIFF or WebP. Exposes PhotoCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 PhotoCraft：打开与新建文档、操作图层与选区、应用调整与滤镜、执行批处理动作，并保存或导出 PSD、PNG、JPG、TIFF 或 WebP。暴露 PhotoCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive FilmCraft from the agent: build a project and sequences, import media, run edits as a script, then export with a preset or format. Exposes FilmCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 FilmCraft：创建工程与序列、导入素材、以脚本方式执行剪辑，并按预设或格式导出。暴露 FilmCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Pushes DSH approval and question cards to IM channels (WeChat first) and answers them from chat, with a session console, per-channel security, and an open push service.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的审批卡与提问卡推送到 IM 渠道（先支持微信），可在聊天里直接作答，带会话控制台、逐渠道安全与开放推送服务。

description.en: One-click optimization of a raw instruction into a professional prompt: three output styles, situation-aware role/task/goal profiling, multi-sample selection scored by a model judge, self-iterating learning (session memory + smart defaults + user overrides), /template for 22 sub-scenes with zero model calls, input-box ✨ one-click optimize/undo, prompt_optimize tool, auto-optimize hook, a runtime status page, a settings panel (dsh 0.2.0) and auto-detected zh/en documents.
description.zh: 把原始指令一键优化为专业提示词——支持三种输出形态、情境感知画像、多采样择优（模型判官评分）、自迭代学习，以及 /template 等命令与一键工具/钩子/状态页/设置面板/自动语言。

description.en: Drive LightCraft from the agent: import photos, apply develop settings, and export JPEG or other formats from a photo library. Exposes LightCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 LightCraft：导入照片、应用冲图设置，并从照片库导出 JPEG 等格式。暴露 LightCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Magpie gateway provider for DSH: syncs gateway models into the picker with visibility control, image input and thinking levels.
description.zh: 把 Magpie 网关的模型接入 DSH 选择器，支持模型显隐管理、图片输入与思考档位。

description.en: Let a pet whale girl browse Bilibili on her own: she picks videos, reads subtitles, posts comments and moments once you allow it, and writes daily digests with optional local video production. Maintained fork of c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll (MIT) with per-action permissions, memories, stickers and local video production added; it registers the same bili_* tool names as the upstream, so the two cannot be installed together. Video production needs Python 3.11-3.13 (or uv); the media dependencies are installed on first use.
description.zh: 让桌宠鲸鱼娘自主刷 B站：自己搜片、读字幕原文，经你允许后发评论、发动态，并写日报、做视频。c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll（MIT）的维护分支，新增逐项授权、记忆、表情与本地视频制作；与上游注册同名的 bili_* 工具，不能与 dsh-bili-scroll 同装。视频制作需要 Python 3.11–3.13（或 uv），首次使用时自动安装媒体依赖。

description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness settings: add streamable-http or stdio servers, paste Postman-style headers, test connectivity, and toggle each tool so disabled ones never reach the model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 工具管理器：在设置里添加 streamable-http/stdio 服务器、Postman 式请求头、连通性测试，并按工具开关——停用的工具不会进入模型。

description.en: Drive EffectCraft from the agent: build compositions, add layers, set properties and keyframes, evaluate expressions, then render frames or movies. Exposes EffectCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 EffectCraft：搭建合成、添加图层、设置属性与关键帧、计算表达式，并渲染单帧或视频。暴露 EffectCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Self-tending living memory in one local SQLite file — a nightly patrol dedupes, merges, decays and cross-links entries on its own, with seven-signal RRF hybrid recall (FTS5 + jieba Chinese-first tokenization, optional vector KNN, graph PPR), a typed knowledge graph, conflict detection instead of silent overwrites, and web telemetry panels.
description.zh: 单文件本地 SQLite 的自整理活记忆——夜巡引擎自动去重、合并、衰减、建链，七信号 RRF 混合检索（FTS5+jieba 中文优先分词、可选向量 KNN、图谱 PPR），带类型知识图谱，冲突检测标记矛盾而非静默覆写，Web 遥测面板。

description.en: Semantic code search for DeepSeek Harness: registers two native tools, semble_search (find code by describing its behaviour, returning ranked file:line hits) and semble_find_related (neighbours of a known location), which run the Semble CLI via uvx, plus one bundled routing skill. Requires uv on PATH; the first query on a repository builds its index.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的语义代码搜索：注册 semble_search（按行为描述检索代码，返回按相关度排序的 file:line 命中）与 semble_find_related（查找已知位置的相邻代码）两个原生工具，检索由 uvx 启动的 Semble CLI 完成，并附一个随包分发的路由技能。需要 PATH 中有 uv；对某个仓库的首次查询会建立索引。

description.en: Vision-first Mac computer use, for when the accessibility tree is unavailable. Ships 11 desktop_* tools - window list, screenshots, OCR text targeting, numbered elements, coordinate clicks, typing, scrolling, drag - plus a Codex-style cursor overlay with spring animation. Clicks are delivered to the target process, so the real pointer never moves and nothing steals focus. In DSH it shows up as Mac Desktop Control with a settings page that checks the engine and the Screen Recording / Accessibility permissions, with a button that opens the matching System Settings pane. Works out of the box: the tarball bundles the dsh-cu engine and the overlay as prebuilt universal binaries (Apple silicon + Intel, macOS 11+, ad-hoc signed), compiled from the repo's Swift sources by the release workflow - no clone, no Xcode, no install.sh. The only setup is granting DeepSeek Harness Screen Recording and Accessibility once. macOS only; on Windows and Linux the plugin loads without registering the desktop tools.
description.zh: Mac 的视觉优先 computer use：无障碍树不可用时照样能干活。11 个 desktop_* 工具——窗口枚举、截图、OCR 找文字、元素编号、坐标点击、输入、滚动、拖拽，外加 Codex 风格的浮层光标（带弹簧动效）。点击投递给目标进程，不移动真实鼠标、不抢前台。DSH 插件页里显示为「Mac 桌面操作」，设置页会逐项检查命令行引擎和屏幕录制 / 辅助功能权限，缺哪个直接给按钮。装上就能用：安装包自带 dsh-cu 引擎和浮层的通用二进制（Apple 芯片 + Intel，macOS 11 起，本地签名），由发版工作流从仓库里的 Swift 源码编译——不用 clone、不用 Xcode、不用 install.sh。唯一的设置是给 DeepSeek Harness 开一次屏幕录制和辅助功能权限。仅支持 macOS；在 Windows / Linux 上插件照常加载，只是不注册桌面工具。

description.en: Jira and Confluence for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Atlassian remote MCP server, a result card for issues and pages, and an issue panel.
description.zh: 把 Jira 与 Confluence 接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 Atlassian 远程 MCP 服务器的工具、问题与页面的结果卡片，以及问题面板。

description.en: Tavily backend for the built-in web search: an in-process endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 turns its requests into Tavily searches; up to 10 API keys stay in the DSH credential store, rotate per request and switch on auth, rate-limit or quota errors; a settings card manages keys, runs a test search and points web search at the endpoint.
description.zh: 为内置网页搜索提供 Tavily 后端：在 DSH 进程内提供 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 接口，把搜索请求转成 Tavily 检索；最多 10 个 API Key 存在 DSH 凭据库，按请求轮换，遇鉴权、限流或额度错误自动换下一个；设置卡片可管理密钥、测试搜索并一键接入网页搜索。

description.en: Academic writing guard (EN/ZH bilingual): removes AI-style defensive writing, protects scientific evidence (numbers, citations, claim strength, null findings, scope) during polishing, and calibrates writing toward a target journal (Journal Profile + Journal Fit). Deterministic local regex/statistics, zero network/LLM; writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile with auto-audit on paper writes.
description.zh: 论文写作守卫（中英双语）：去掉 AI 式防御性写作，润色时守住科学证据（数字/引用/主张强度/零结果/scope），并按目标期刊校准写作风格（Journal Profile + Journal Fit）。纯本地正则/统计，零网络零 LLM；提供 writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile，论文写入后自动审计。

description.en: Full-interface whale skin pack for the DSH Web UI — layered wallpaper, metallic trim, lace and bows, a corner mascot that reacts to agent state, ambient particles, plus an installable third-party skin-pack format.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面全屏鲸鱼皮肤包：多层壁纸、金/银描边、蕾丝蝴蝶结、随 Agent 状态反应的角落立绘与环境粒子，并支持可安装的第三方皮肤包格式。

description.en: One collapsible sidebar widget stacking OpenCode GO, Command Code and GLM Code Plan quota windows, with reset countdowns, top-up balances, a settings page and a /provider-usage command.
description.zh: 一个可折叠的侧边栏组件，纵向堆叠 OpenCode GO、Command Code 与 GLM Code Plan 的套餐窗口，含重置倒计时、充值余额、插件设置页和 /provider-usage 命令。

description.en: Routes outbound model traffic per provider host or per model ID through chosen proxies, loopback or direct, configured from a Plugins settings page.
description.zh: 按提供商主机或模型 ID 将模型出站流量分流到指定代理、直连或继承进程策略，可在 Plugins 设置页配置。

description.en: Multi-host SSH workbench: keep remote servers in a host library, grant them per project, and open an interactive terminal or dual-pane SFTP in the right sidebar, while the SSHManager tool runs remote commands and transfers files without exposing keys to the model.
description.zh: 多机 SSH 工作台：把远程服务器收进主机库、按项目授权，在右侧栏里开交互式终端或双栏 SFTP；模型用 SSHManager 工具远程执行命令、上传下载文件，密钥不进模型上下文。

description.en: Agent mode picker for DSH: pick an external Agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI, Aider, Goose, Hermes…) as the session's default executor from a control next to the input box, instead of editing configuration files. The agent roster is data-driven, and installed CLIs are discovered automatically from PATH, the managed CLI directory and a drop-in convention directory. Agents that are installed but still missing credentials or a required background service are shown as "needs setup" rather than silently hidden.
description.zh: DSH 的 Agent 模式选择器：在输入框旁边直接选定一个外部 Agent CLI（Claude Code、Codex、 Qwen Code、Gemini CLI、Aider、Goose、Hermes…）作为当前会话的默认执行体，不必去改配置文件。 Agent 名册是数据驱动的，已安装的 CLI 会从 PATH、托管 CLI 目录和约定目录自动发现；装了但还缺 凭据或需要常驻服务的，会显示为「待配置」而不是被悄悄藏起来。

description.en: Token, cost, and balance dashboard under the composer: live indicator plus zero-dependency SVG charts for per-turn usage, estimated cost, and DeepSeek account balance.
description.zh: 输入框下方的用量/成本/余额仪表盘：实时指标指示器 + 零依赖 SVG 用量图表，按轮次统计用量、估算成本并实时查询 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: Header quota badge plus a usage-monitoring tab: live balance/quota remaining and reset countdown per provider, with requests, tokens (input/output/cache-read/cache-write), cache hit rate, estimated cost and average TPS tracked per session, provider, model and client, stored locally in SQLite with cross-device import/export.
description.zh: 会话头部余量徽标 + 用量监控页签：实时展示各供应商余额/余量与重置倒计时，按会话/供应商/模型/客户端统计请求量、Token（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写）、缓存命中率、预估费用与平均 TPS，本地 SQLite 留存历史，支持跨设备导入导出。

description.en: Browse and search a SkillHub registry and manage local skill installation, updates, and removal inside DeepSeek Harness. Targets DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2; not yet compatible with 0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、搜索 SkillHub 技能，并管理本地技能的安装、更新和卸载。适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2，暂不兼容 0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: VSCode-style Source Control page in the DSH Web right sidebar: a paged commit lane graph with ref markers and per-commit diffs, grouped working-tree changes with stage/discard/unstage, a commit box with amend and AI-generated messages, a side-by-side and unified diff page, GitHub repository and pull request creation through the gh CLI, and bidirectional HTTPS/SSH remote switching.
description.zh: DSH Web 右侧 Sidebar 中的类 VSCode 源代码管理页：带引用标记与分页的泳道提交图与逐提交差异、分组的工作区变更与暂存/丢弃/取消暂存，支持修补上一次提交与 AI 生成信息的提交框、并排与统一差异视图、通过 gh CLI 新建仓库与创建 Pull Request，以及 HTTPS 与 SSH 远程地址双向切换。

description.en: Replaces LLM summarization with deterministic text compilation, so compaction makes no model calls and keeps original tokens; elided content stays retrievable through seq pointers. Based on TsFreddie/dsh-compaction-instant.
description.zh: 用确定性文本编译取代 LLM 摘要，压缩过程不调模型、只搬运原文，被省略的内容可凭 seq 指针取回。基于 TsFreddie/dsh-compaction-instant。

description.en: Exposes a stdio MCP server as native DeepSeek Harness tools. Ships with the official Microsoft Playwright MCP preset, so the agent browses through the Edge or Chrome you already have open, with your logins intact; any other stdio MCP command can be configured instead. Host-only, no client bundle, no npm dependencies. To drive your own browser, start Edge/Chrome with remote debugging and allow npx to fetch @playwright/mcp.
description.zh: 把 stdio MCP 服务器变成 DeepSeek Harness 原生工具。默认接微软官方 Playwright MCP，agent 直接操作你已打开、已登录的 Edge 或 Chrome；也可换成任意 stdio MCP 命令。宿主侧插件，不带客户端包，无 npm 依赖。要接管你自己的浏览器，需以远程调试模式启动 Edge/Chrome，并允许 npx 拉取 @playwright/mcp。

description.en: Drives the open-source ArtCraft studio suite (17 apps including PhotoCraft, FilmCraft and PdfCraft) from DeepSeek Harness: agent tools, a same-origin HTTP API, a bundled craft skill pack, and plugins-page status with self-update. The ArtCraft apps are not bundled: install them separately so the plugin can find their CLIs (auto-discovery, artcraft.config.json or PATH).
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动开源创作套件 ArtCraft（含 PhotoCraft、FilmCraft、PdfCraft 等 17 个应用）：提供代理工具、同源 HTTP API、内置 craft 技能包，以及插件页状态与自更新。不含 ArtCraft 应用本体：需另行安装各应用，插件通过自动探测、artcraft.config.json 或 PATH 找到它们的 CLI。

description.en: Free model provider plugin for DSH with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.
description.zh: DSH free model provider plugin with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.

description.en: Records session snapshots and supports rollback to previous states.
description.zh: 记录会话快照并支持回滚到之前的状态。

description.en: Shows OpenCode GO plan quota (rolling 5-hour, weekly, monthly) on a DSH Settings page, reading the official usage API through a same-origin proxy; registers no sidebar widget. A rework of Astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage (itself a fork of yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage) — remove that plugin first; both register their own OpenCode GO Settings section, so they cannot be installed together.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页显示 OpenCode GO 套餐额度（5 小时滚动、每周、每月），通过同源代理读取官方用量接口；不注册侧栏组件。本插件是 Astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage（上游为 yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage 的 fork）的改造分支，安装前请先卸载上游插件——两者会各自注册一份 OpenCode GO 设置页，不能同装。

description.en: Reads the files that AGENTS.md references with @path imports and injects their content into model context, with byte budgets, compaction re-seeding and a six-language settings card. v0.5.x expands the imports of every instruction file the harness loaded (including a project AGENTS.md picked up mid-session, needs DSH 0.2.0+) and offers an opt-in live mode (off by default) that watches injected files and re-injects them on change, with settings-page controls; use 0.2.x on DSH 0.1.7.
description.zh: 把 AGENTS.md 里 @路径 引用的文件读出来，在会话启动时注入模型上下文；带字节预算、压缩后重新注入和六语言设置卡片。v0.5.x 会展开 DSH 已加载的所有指令文件里的引用（包括会话中途自动带进来的项目 AGENTS.md，需 DSH 0.2.0+），并提供可选的实时模式（默认关闭）：监听已注入文件、变更后自动重注入，设置页可调；DSH 0.1.7 请用 0.2.x。

description.en: Select text in the DSH web UI to stream a translation and an explanation of what it means in that specific context, read against the conversation it came from; the panel keeps a replayable history and can be promoted into a full session.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面划词，小窗流式给出翻译，并结合这段文字所在的会话上下文解释它在这里的具体含义；面板带可回放的历史记录，也能一键升格为正式会话。

description.en: Provisions the kimi-webbridge bridge daemon (auto-install with SHA-256 verification, auto-start) and registers a 25-action skill that drives the user's real browser through the local bridge.
description.zh: 自动安装并启动 kimi-webbridge 桥接守护进程（含 SHA-256 校验），注册一套 25 个动作的技能，通过本地桥接驱动用户的真实浏览器。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek Harness LLM token usage and cost (CNY, peak/off-peak pricing) with a settings dashboard, agent tools, HTTP API and persistent storage.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM Token 用量与花费（人民币、峰谷计价），提供设置面板、Agent 工具、HTTP 接口与持久化存储。

description.en: Distills session work into background observations and reflections to preserve context across compaction.
description.zh: 在后台将会话工作提炼为观察和反思，以便在上下文压缩后保留会话上下文。

description.en: Read-only session work-path observer: fold turns into stage, run, duration and tok/s summaries, then expand parallel branches, tool results and vendor-visible reasoning.
description.zh: 只读会话工作路径观察器：收起轮次看阶段数、执行数、耗时与 tok/s，展开看并行分支、工具结果与供应商可见推理。

description.en: Composer history that restores the whole input state: composer contents, image and file attachments, @ references and slash commands, plus the model, thinking effort, permission and agent preset used.
description.zh: 记录并还原整个输入框状态：文字、图片/文件附件、@ 引用和 / 指令，以及当时的模型、思考程度、权限预设和使用模式；还原后与记录时一致。

description.en: One-click restart for the DSH desktop client, from five entries you can toggle individually: a sidebar panel, the sidebar footer, the conversation header, a Settings → General row, or the /restart slash command. The app is closed gracefully (only the main process is signalled, so the host can flush session logs) and relaunched by a detached helper that survives the shutdown; optional guards wait for running tasks or an in-progress plugin install, results land in a receipt, requests are fenced to loopback same-origin, and every switch is persisted in the profile config file. Only the four UI entries can be switched off; the slash command is always available.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版一键重启，五个入口可逐项开关：侧栏面板、侧栏底部、会话标题栏、设置 → 通用行、斜杠命令 /restart。只给主进程发关闭信号让宿主优雅退出（会话日志得以下盘），再由脱离进程树的助手自动拉起；可选守卫会等待进行中的任务或插件安装结束，重启结果写成回执，动作请求仅限本机同源，所有开关落 profile 配置文件。四个界面入口可单独关闭，斜杠命令始终可用。

description.en: Drive SoundCraft from the agent: load a session, set track and mixer levels, insert plugins, edit MIDI, and bounce audio without opening a window. Exposes the DAW's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 SoundCraft：加载工程、设置轨道与混音电平、插入插件、编辑 MIDI，并在不打开窗口的情况下 bounce 音频。暴露这个 DAW 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Anime whale-boy in a maid outfit as a desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: four expressions follow the turn (thinking / success / failure), free dragging with remembered position, click-to-cycle, a bottom-right standee that reports each turn's token usage and think latency with its own balance bubble, a chat wallpaper, a liquid-glass composer, a cute persona that calls you 主人 with 喵~ style particles, and a single switch in Settings to turn the whole look off.
description.zh: 鲸鱼正太 × 女仆装 × 二次元的桌面桌宠：四种表情跟随对话状态，可拖拽、点击切换；右下角立牌每轮显示 token 消耗与思考时间，点击有 q 弹与独立余额气泡；另附聊天壁纸、液态玻璃输入框；人格自称小D，称呼你为主人并带喵~ 等语气词；设置里可一键开关，还能自定义称呼。

description.en: Injects conclusions already established in the previous reasoning block after each tool result, so the model continues from them instead of re-deriving the same conclusions.
description.zh: 在每次工具结果后注入上一段思考中已确立的结论，使模型直接沿用而非重复推导。

description.en: Adds two buttons to the sidebar footer: one reloads the interface and client plugins only, the other restarts the desktop app together with its Host. A restart is refused while a plugin install is running. Restart is Windows only and returns 409 elsewhere; reload works on all platforms.
description.zh: 在侧栏底部添加两个按钮：一个只重新加载界面与客户端插件，另一个连同 Host 重启整个桌面应用；插件安装期间拒绝重启。重启仅支持 Windows，其他平台返回 409；刷新全平台可用。

description.en: LLM-assisted auto approval with countdown fallback for the Auto permission preset: static rules, risk tiers, breaker and file audit.
description.zh: 为 DSH Auto 权限档提供 LLM 辅助自动审批：静态规则、LLM 复审、风险分档、人工倒计时兜底、熔断与文件级审计。

description.en: A permanent DSH plugin that bundles a developer workbench, an in-session conversation tree, and a plugin manager: build and run an LVAL project, browse its code, and keep per-program version snapshots with rollback; edit, retry, or branch any message in place, with message micro-versions; a feature manager plus a global-plugin library whose entries each carry an enable tier; cross-dialogue memory, one-shot temporary chats, and model collaboration; five network-permission tiers, mixed-model routing, a security audit, and browser control through a companion extension.
description.zh: DSH 永久插件工作台：LVAL 工程工具的编译/运行、代码查看与程序版本快照回退；会话内对话树（就地编辑 / 重新生成 / 分支）与消息小版本；DET 管理器，以及每条记录各带一档启停权限的全局插件库；跨对话记忆、一次性临时对话与模型合作；五档网络权限、混合模型路由、安全审计，以及经配套浏览器扩展的浏览器控制。

description.en: Read official DSH docs in the Plugins page; Creator mode searches docs and checks plugin npm metadata with native tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页阅读官方文档；创造模式用原生工具检索文档、查询插件 npm 元数据。

description.en: An agent-kept daily journal: one sentence injected into the system prompt makes recording one of the agent's duties, so what you have done and what you intend to do is written as dated todos and memories, one JSON file per day under the DSH home, and drawn on the right sidebar's month calendar — a hollow ring while a todo is still open, a green dot once every todo is done, a blue dot when the day holds only memories; that injected sentence is rewritten from the calendar itself, which is how you set how eagerly and how the agent records; every entry carries one of five tags (work, study, life, health, other) drawn as a colour-coded chip, todos can be checked off from the card, titles and tags are searchable across every day, and clicking a memory opens the conversation that recorded it and stops at that turn; the ? beside the month heading opens the project on GitHub.
description.zh: 助手主动维护的每日日志：它往系统提示词里注入一句话，把「记录用户做过的事和打算做的事」列为助手的职责，于是这些事被写成带日期的待办与记事，存放在 DSH home 下一天一个的 JSON 文件里，并画在右侧栏的月历上——有待办没做完的那天是空心圈，待办都做完是绿点，只记了记事的那天是蓝点；这句话可以直接在日历上改写，用它调整助手记忆的主动性与策略；每条记录带五个标签之一（工作 / 学习 / 生活 / 健康 / 其他）并显示为同色 chip，待办可以在卡片上勾选，全部日期的标题与标签都能搜索，点击一条记在对话里的记录会打开那次会话并停在对应轮次；月份标题旁的 ? 打开 GitHub 上的项目仓库。

description.en: TypeSafe AI Jev decision provider for typed probabilistic choices and scores in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 TypeSafe AI Jev 决策能力，用于带类型的概率选择和评分。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Three independent language channels for model output — tool-call descriptions (every tool-call card title, including run_code in PTC-style presets), thinking, and replies — each set to follow the web GUI language, force a specific language, or turn off (default: only descriptions, following the GUI). One global runtime-context prompt directive on the host; the client half reports the GUI language; a Settings plugin card switches the modes.
description.zh: 模型产出文本的三个语言通道——工具调用描述（所有工具调用卡片标题，含 PTC 类预设的 run_code）、思考与回复——各自可跟随网页界面语言、强制指定语言或关闭（默认仅描述通道跟随界面语言）。host 侧注入一条全局 runtime-context 提示指示，client 半上报界面语言，设置里的插件卡片负责切换。

description.en: Connect a DSH Agent to Minecraft Java servers with Mineflayer, a live game view alongside native reasoning and tools, configurable personas, server-scoped notebooks, and optional local survival knowledge retrieval. Reuses the host model; installation does not connect to a game or start inference.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Mineflayer 进入 Minecraft Java 服务器，在实时游戏画面旁查看原生推理与工具，配置人格、按服务器隔离的笔记及可选本地生存知识检索；复用宿主模型，安装本身不连接游戏或启动推理。

description.en: Composer cost chip: prices the current session DeepSeek API spend message-by-message with the official pricing table (incl. the 2026-08-17 peak/off-peak policy); hover for the breakdown, today (DSH) total and account balance. DeepSeek models only.
description.zh: 输入框右侧会话成本芯片：按官方价表（含 2026-08-17 峰谷价）逐消息计价当前会话的 DeepSeek API 花费，悬停查看计价明细、今日(DSH) 消耗与账户余额；仅 DeepSeek 模型计价，其他模型不计价不显示。

description.en: Offline mirror of the official DeepSeek Harness documentation as a dsh skill: 168 site pages (EN/zh) plus 52 repository-only reference docs, with topic navigation and a full-text search index for plugin development.
description.zh: 以 dsh-plugin-dev-kb 技能内置 DeepSeek Harness 官方文档离线镜像：站点中英 168 页 + 仓库补充文档 52 篇，带主题导航与全文检索，编写插件时随时查阅。

description.en: Drive FigCraft from the agent: create frames, components and auto layout, set fills, strokes and effects, build prototypes, and export PNG, SVG, PDF or code. Exposes both FigCraft's command ids and its own MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 FigCraft：创建画框、组件与自动布局，设置填充、描边与效果，搭建原型，并导出 PNG、SVG、PDF 或代码。同时暴露 FigCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Local semantic memory and prior-chat retrieval with source references, editable memories, retention, forget controls, undo, and JSON import/export.
description.zh: 本地语义记忆与过往对话检索，保留来源引用，支持编辑、保留、遗忘、撤销及 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Lets the model trigger compaction itself at a safe point via a compact_now tool (works mid-turn), plus a context_status tool reporting real token usage against the session's actual context window.
description.zh: 让模型自己挑安全时机触发压缩：提供 compact_now 工具（回合进行中也能用），另有 context_status 工具，按会话真实的上下文窗口报告 token 占用。

description.en: Render OpenUI Lang answers as interactive cards or reading articles in DSH chat, with maps, charts, forms, PNG export and standalone interactive HTML export.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中把 OpenUI Lang 答案渲染成交互卡片或阅读式文章，支持地图、图表、表单、PNG 图片导出和独立交互 HTML 导出。

description.en: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description.zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

description.en: File search palette for the DSH workspace: find files by name or content, open results in DSH's native right-sidebar preview, and edit text files inline with version-conflict checks.
description.zh: 工作区文件查找面板：按文件名或内容搜索，用 DSH 原生右侧栏预览打开结果，需要时在内置编辑器里修改文本，并在保存前检查版本冲突。

description.en: Always-on-top notch for Windows that shows which sessions are working, which need you, and which are done or failed: one bot per session, never takes focus, hides under full-screen apps, with its own settings page.
description.zh: Windows 屏幕顶部始终置顶的刘海：每个会话一个小机器人，显示哪些在工作、哪些在等你、哪些已完成或失败；不抢焦点，全屏应用下自动隐藏，带独立设置页。

description.en: SSH-backed remote directories and linked local⇄remote workspaces: read-only remote browsing, an editable linked workbench, bidirectional SFTP transfer, mirroring and a linked_workspace tool. Sidebar pages require the dsh-better-sidebar plugin (v0.24+); without it only the Settings pages load.
description.zh: 把 SSH 连接变成 DSH 远程目录与本地⇄远端联动工作区：远程目录只读浏览，联动工作区可编辑、双向传输、镜像同步，并提供 linked_workspace 工具。侧栏页面需配合 dsh-better-sidebar（v0.24+）；没有它只有设置页可用。

description.en: Package and install code-server (the web version of VSCode) as a plugin within dsh to quickly achieve professional file editing.
description.zh: 将code-server（VSCode网页版）打包安装到dsh内的插件，快速实现专业的文件编辑。

description.en: ACP adapter that drives DeepSeek Harness from Obsidian Agent Client (and other ACP clients): list, resume, fork and delete sessions, switch the model per session, preview a one-line summary, import external ACP sessions, and pull Obsidian Agent Client conversations into dsh native session storage. Requires DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3.
description.zh: 在 Obsidian Agent Client（及其他 ACP 客户端）里驱动 DeepSeek Harness 的 ACP 适配器：会话 list / resume / fork / delete、按会话切换模型、一句话摘要预览、导入外部 ACP 会话，并可把 Obsidian 侧会话拉进 dsh 原生会话库。需 DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3。

description.en: Fine-grained permission gateway: per-category tool-call review (outside-workspace directories, commands, file read/write, subagents, repeated actions) with global & per-project allow/deny exceptions, quick-tool defaults, custom rules, a bilingual approval modal with inline diff details, custom rejection reasons and a sandbox-upgrade flow.
description.zh: 细粒度权限网关：按分类（工作区外目录/命令/读写文件/子代理/重复操作）逐项审查工具调用，全局/项目双级白黑名单、快捷工具默认值、自定义规则，中英文审批弹窗（内联 diff 详情、自定义拒绝意见）与底层沙箱升级流程。

description.en: Drive DesignCraft from the agent: create pages, place and flow text, arrange frames and master pages, then export PDF. Exposes DesignCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 DesignCraft：创建页面、置入与排布文字、组织图文框与主页，并导出 PDF。暴露 DesignCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Requirements interview before work starts: judges whether a request is clear, asks focused questions when it is not, in strict mode denies editing tools until the user confirms a four-part summary in chat, and keeps confirmed preferences in two-layer memory.
description.zh: 开工前先做需求访谈：判定任务是否说清楚，没说清就分轮追问；strict 档位下用户未在对话中确认四段需求清单前，拦截编辑类工具；确认过的偏好写入两层记忆。

description.en: Simulated life context for DeepSeek Harness: every turn injects the past 24h of simulated life events from the workspace .life/ directory (sliding-window filter, session-level deduplication with delta updates, world summary) as a collapsed context notice, and the life_react tool lets the agent record feelings, thoughts and actions back into its life log for the next round of world evolution — turning a DSH agent into a roleplay character with a persistent daily life.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 提供拟真生活上下文：每轮对话自动注入工作区 .life/ 目录近 24 小时的生活事件（滑动窗口过滤、会话内智能去重与增量更新、世界近况），并提供 life_react 工具让 Agent 把感受、思考与行动回填到自己的生活日志，反哺下一轮世界演化——把 DSH Agent 变成有日常生活的角色扮演人设（适合酒馆式 RP、AI 陪伴）；配合每日世界演算工作流可获得持续的模拟人生式生活轨迹。

description.en: Eager, tail-heavy, line-aware tool result trimmer plugin: hooks into post-execution pipeline to trim oversized command outputs with smart semantic reducers and ANSI stripping.
description.zh: 即时、尾部加权、行吸附的工具输出修剪插件：挂载于执行流水线即时截断超大命令输出，内置语义提纯器与 ANSI 剥离。

description.en: Take a local video all the way to a Douyin creator post: open the upload page, trigger the picker, hand the file over with verification, fill the title, set visibility - then stop before publishing unless explicitly told to publish.
description.zh: 把本地视频送到抖音投稿页的「待发布」状态：打开投稿页、真实点上传、递文件（回读校验）、填标题、设可见性，然后默认停手——可见性默认仅自己可见、不点发布。

description.en: Drives a Chromium browser you are already running — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc or Thorium — over one long-lived CDP connection, so the remote-debugging approval is asked once instead of per command. Commands for tabs, navigation, JS evaluation, DOM snapshots, clicks, typing, screenshots and CSS/DOM/pixel assertions go over a loopback HTTP route that the agent calls with the shell tool it already has, so no new tools are registered, and the plugin registers its own usage skill with no runtime dependencies.
