description.zh: 通过一条常驻 CDP 连接驱动本机已在运行的 Chromium 内核浏览器——Chrome、Edge、Brave、Vivaldi、Opera、Chromium、Arc、Thorium，远程调试授权只需点一次，而不是每条命令都点。标签页、导航、执行 JS、DOM 快照、点击、输入、截图以及 CSS/DOM/像素断言都走本机回环 HTTP 路由，agent 用已有的 shell 工具发命令，因此不注册新工具；插件自带使用说明 skill，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Collects and redacts DSH runtime diagnostics before filing structured issues in GitHub or Gitea.
description.zh: 收集并脱敏 DSH 运行诊断信息，然后向 GitHub 或 Gitea 提交结构化问题报告。

description.en: Adds a web device-code sign-in and sign-out entry for the built-in GitHub Copilot provider in DSH, presets an out-of-the-box Copilot provider route, keeps credentials in the built-in credential store, and manages the model catalog as a first-login fallback that never overwrites customized model entries.
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置的 GitHub Copilot 通道补充网页设备码登录与注销入口，预置开箱即用的 Copilot 提供方路由，凭据存入内置凭据库，模型目录仅在首次登录兜底填充一次、永不覆盖已定制的模型条目。

description.en: Remote-control DeepSeek Harness from a HarmonyOS phone: list, switch and create sessions; send prompts (the phone follows the host's busy-enter behaviour, queue or steer); stream assistant text, reasoning and tool steps; answer approval requests and questions; view session images as inline thumbnails with on-demand full-size fetch; switch model and reasoning effort; cancel running tasks; receive push notifications. Traffic is end-to-end encrypted (AES-256-GCM with HKDF-SHA256 key derivation) and travels through a dumb-pipe relay that only sees ciphertext; v1.1.3 adds a session-epoch anti-replay handshake and optional native TLS for the relay. The relay can be hosted on the local machine (managed by the plugin) or on a VPS; the phone app and the plugin ship in one repository. 5 Remote methods.
description.zh: 用 HarmonyOS 手机遥控 DeepSeek Harness：浏览/切换/新建会话；发送提示词（手机跟随宿主的繁忙行为，排队或插话）；流式接收正文、思考与工具步骤；应答审批请求与提问；查看会话图片（缩略图内联 + 大图按需拉取）；切换模型与思考强度；取消运行中的任务；接收推送通知。流量端到端加密（HKDF-SHA256 派生密钥 + AES-256-GCM），经只转发密文的哑管道中继；v1.1.3 增加会话纪元抗重放握手与中继原生 TLS。中继可跑在本机（由插件托管）或 VPS 上；手机 App 与插件同仓库发布。5 个 Remote 方法。

description.en: DSH secretary: triages your unread GitHub notifications by their real state every 15 minutes (closing what is already resolved), remembers dated things you tell it (bills, renewals, document expiries, birthdays) and reminds you when due, and watches your inbox read-only; secrets live in the system keychain only.
description.zh: DSH 小秘书：每 15 分钟按当前状态分诊 GitHub 未读通知（已解决的替你关掉），记住你交代的到期事项（账单、续费、证件、生日）到时提醒，只读盯着邮箱收件箱；密码只进系统钥匙串。

description.en: Drive TextureCraft from the agent: build texture sets and layers over a mesh, paint, bake maps, and export PBR textures. Exposes both TextureCraft's command ids and its own MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 TextureCraft：在网格上构建贴图集与图层、绘制、烘焙贴图，并导出 PBR 纹理。同时暴露 TextureCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: QMS NCR, CAPA and 8D tracking with batch and impact assessment.
description.zh: QMS 不合格品、CAPA 与 8D 闭环跟踪。

description.en: Puts the Markdown documents, source files, images and video that already exist anywhere in the session workspace into the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation. The default lexical mode matches your recent messages against title, summary and body locally with IDF weighting (BM25) — no model calls, no network, nothing leaves the machine. The list comes from scanning the workspace rather than from a recent-files list, so restarting DSH or opening a new session does not empty it. Results are organised into a three-tier reading order (primary / supporting / related) with a verifiable reason on every row — which field matched, which document cites this one — and one click opens an in-place preview: Markdown as rendered text, relative-path images actually drawn, source code with the host's own syntax highlighting, video streamed over HTTP Range. The same Context Pack is exposed to the agent as a knit_docs tool. Later versions added read evidence and lifecycle tracking (attribution is frozen at the moment of reading), pin / exclude (exclusion applies before retrieval, and is undoable), relation evidence (references / imports / tests, with line numbers) and an incremental index reused across restarts. Since v0.23 there is also an optional hybrid mode: it is off by default and only runs once you configure an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embedding provider yourself. When it runs, what leaves the machine is your query text plus each candidate file's title and summary — a Markdown summary is an excerpt of the body's first paragraph (at most 60 characters), a code file's summary is its workspace-relative directory, and an image or video contributes its file name; full bodies and absolute paths are not sent, and a loopback provider keeps everything on this machine. Since v0.24 it also associates uncommitted changes: a read-only git status (fixed argv, no shell, whitelisted child-process environment) combined with the same reference / import / test / mention evidence shows which files a change is likely to drag along, and it is off by default. The benefit of semantic retrieval still awaits a real-provider run, so no recall improvement is claimed.
description.zh: 把会话工作区里已有的 Markdown 文档、源码、图片与视频列进 DSH 侧边栏，按与当前对话的相关性排序。默认的词法模式用最近几条消息在本地与标题、摘要、正文做带 IDF 加权的匹配（BM25）—— 不调用模型、没有网络出口，内容不出本机。列表来自工作区扫描，而不是「最近打开记录」，所以重启 DSH 或新开会话都不会变空。排序结果组织成主要 / 辅助 / 相关三层的阅读顺序，每一条都写明可核验的理由（命中了哪个字段、被哪一篇引用），点一行即可就地预览：Markdown 按渲染后的样子显示、相对路径图片真实渲染、源码走宿主自带的语法高亮、视频走 HTTP Range 流式播放。同一份 Context Pack 也作为 knit_docs 工具交给 agent。后续版本陆续补上读取证据与生命周期（归因在读那一刻冻结）、固定 / 排除（排除先于检索生效，且可恢复）、关系证据（引用 / 导入 / 测试，带行号）与增量索引（重启后复用）。v0.23 起还多一条可选的混合检索：默认关闭，只有你自己配好 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的 embedding 服务才会生效。它生效时，发出去的是你这句查询原话加上每篇候选文件的标题与摘要 —— Markdown 的摘要取自正文首段（不超过 60 字），代码的摘要是它所在的工作区相对目录，图片 / 视频贡献的是文件名；完整正文与绝对路径都不发送，指向本机服务（loopback）时内容不出这台机器。v0.24 起还能做变更关联：用一条只读的 git status（固定 argv、不走 shell、子进程环境白名单），配合同一套引用 / 导入 / 测试 / 提及证据，指出这次改动大概率该一起看哪些文件 —— 默认关闭。语义检索的收益仍待真 provider 实测，因此不承诺召回提升。

description.en: Evidence-grade reports beyond a plain export: /transcript writes styled HTML/Markdown/JSON with Mermaid lineage, editor diffs and a turn timeline; /stats prints a cost-aware card; /archive packs the raw JSONL with a metadata manifest, while /transcript --manifest and /bundle add the SHA-256 evidence manifest — full history, any backend.
description.zh: 不止导出，而是证据级报告：/transcript 生成带 Mermaid 血统图、编辑器 diff、回合时间线的 HTML/Markdown/JSON；/stats 输出成本感知统计卡；/archive 打包原始 JSONL 并附元数据清单，SHA-256 证据清单由 /transcript --manifest 与 /bundle 提供——全历史、任意后端。

description.en: Replaces the chat composer with an editor-style input panel on CodeMirror 6: line numbers, edit + markdown-preview split, a floating window mode and a full-height sidebar tab — one input surface at a time. Drafts ride the official input machine; the official voice-input button is rendered when the host provides one, and the stats row and context meter read the same data as the official dock.
description.zh: 把聊天输入框换成 CodeMirror 6 的编辑器式输入面板：行号、编辑 + Markdown 预览分屏、悬浮窗与全高侧栏标签，同一时刻只有一个输入入口。草稿走官方输入机；宿主有语音输入按钮时原样渲染官方语音组件，数据行与上下文小圈与官方 dock 同源。

description.en: Workbench with an AI assistant, pause/stop controls, separate background-model settings, tasks/replies, Linky, scoped knowledge capture, local and Yunzhijia search, news reading and developer tools. Optional embeddings download a model. Yunzhijia needs its CLI/account; web chats need the desktop app.
description.zh: 智能工作台，集成可停止的AI助手、后台模型独立配置、待办与回复跟进、Linky研发、知识收藏与检索、云之家搜索、资讯原文及开发工具；可选本地向量需下载模型，云之家需账号及CLI，多AI对话需桌面端。

description.en: Parody ads in 2005-Chinese-web style: sidebar banners, in-chat feeds, corner popups, and a close button whose hit area is smaller than it looks. All fictional.
description.zh: 2005 年中文站点风格的整活广告插件：侧栏广告/信息流/角落弹窗 + 假关闭叉，素材全虚构。

description.en: "Single-Core Writing" plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Thoroughly tool-streamlined and output-hardened for quantized small models, suitable for running long-novel pipelines locally with on-device models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「单核写作」插件：面向量化小模型做了充分的工具瘦身与输出加固，适合在本机用本地模型跑长篇小说流水线。

description.en: DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription: attach images in the GUI and each one is transcribed via the official deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp by default (a pure-text V4-Pro brain can see images), with any OpenAI-compatible VLM or local Ollama as alternatives.
description.zh: DeepSeek 大脑 + 自动识图：GUI 附加的每张图片自动经官方 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 原生识图转译，再交给纯文本的 DeepSeek 作答（纯文本 V4-Pro 也能看图）；支持任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM 与本地 Ollama 作为备选。

description.en: Git view for DeepSeek Harness: status, commit graph, branches and tags in one picker, diff, staging/commit, push/pull and blame.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 视图：状态、提交图、分支与标签（合并为同一个下拉框，可切换分支或检出标签）、差异、暂存提交、推送拉取与逐行溯源。

description.en: TeleAgent (China Telecom TeleAI "Stellar" agent) model provider for DeepSeek Harness with the working v1 gateway signing: two-round HMAC-SHA256 keyed by the login JWT signature segment, which fixes the 40104 rejections the older local-v1 signing produced. Signs in through a dedicated browser window over the DevTools protocol — the plugin intercepts the login callback the same way the official desktop app does, so nothing has to be copied by hand — and also accepts a pasted token. Ships points balance, daily check-in, an in-composer account chip, and a configurable context window (100K by default, 16K–2M, since the gateway declares no catalogue and the official client ships one shared 100K preset for all three tiers). Cannot be installed alongside anye-99/dsh-codearts-auth: both register the same teleagent provider, and this plugin reuses its credentials and derives its SSE/tool-call parsing from it. It also registers the same teleagent provider as anbulang/dsh-connect-teleagent, so install only one of the two.
description.zh: 中国电信天翼 AI「星辰超级智能体」(TeleAgent) 模型 provider，使用可用的 v1 云网关签名：以登录 JWT 签名段为密钥的两轮 HMAC-SHA256，修复旧版 local-v1 签名导致的 40104 拒绝。登录走独立浏览器窗口 + DevTools 协议——插件按官方桌面端同样的方式截获登录回调，无需手工复制任何内容，也可改用手动粘贴 token。提供积分余额、每日签到、输入框内账号条，以及可配置的上下文窗口（默认 100K，可设 16K–2M；网关无模型目录，官方客户端三档共享一份 100K 预置）。与 anye-99/dsh-codearts-auth 不能同装——两者注册同一个 teleagent provider；本插件复用其凭据，通用 SSE/工具调用解析亦取自该插件。与 anbulang/dsh-connect-teleagent 注册同一个 teleagent provider，两者只能装其一。

description.en: Joins two spreadsheets on a declared key and compares declared fields within declared tolerances, producing a Markdown report, a JSON result and a diff workbook. It reports differences; it does not adjudicate them.
description.zh: 按声明的主键连接两张表，按声明字段与容差比对，输出 Markdown 报告、JSON 结果与差异工作簿。只报告差异，不裁决对错。

description.en: Read-only knowledge gateway over a local Markdown vault, in four tools: `wiki_recall` returns the matching section in full with page-level citations plus vault health checks and a page skeleton for writing a good answer back; `wiki_context` returns one evidence pack with per-page excerpts, a support verdict and an explicit list of gaps; `wiki_verify` re-checks a drafted answer against that pack and reports claims the evidence cannot back, including unsupported numbers; `wiki_observe` reports how often answers needed correcting. The settings page and sidebar panel share the same query path as the model, so a search you run by hand cannot disagree with what the model was given. The three knowledge-gateway tools (`wiki_context`, `wiki_verify`, `wiki_observe`) need a local Python 3 bridge — `bridge.python` plus `bridge.toolsRoot` containing `wiki_bridge.py`; without it they return `E_PYTHON_UNAVAILABLE`.
description.zh: 在本地 Markdown 笔记库上做只读的知识网关，四个工具：`wiki_recall` 一次调用返回命中小节正文与页级出处，另带库健康检查与「把好答案回写成新页」的骨架；`wiki_context` 返回一份带逐页摘录的证据包，附「知识够不够」的判定和明确的缺口清单；`wiki_verify` 拿这份证据回头核验草稿，报出证据撑不住的说法，包括没有依据的数字；`wiki_observe` 统计回答需要被修正的比例。设置页与侧栏面板和模型走同一条查询路径，手动搜一次不会跟它拿到的结论对不上。其中 `wiki_context` / `wiki_verify` / `wiki_observe` 三个知识网关工具需要本机 Python 3 通路（`bridge.python` 与包含 `wiki_bridge.py` 的 `bridge.toolsRoot`）；未配置时返回 `E_PYTHON_UNAVAILABLE`。

description.en: SSH and JumpServer terminal plugin: real-machine read tools, human-initiated read-write operations, and session management from inside DSH.
description.zh: SSH 与 JumpServer 终端插件：真实机器读工具、人工发起的读写操作，以及 DSH 内的会话管理。

description.en: Configuration UI for the official OpenViking memory plugin: connection and user-key setup, local connection diagnostics, a per-session memory toggle in the composer, memory isolation that keeps recall inside the current topic, and recall tuning for score threshold, injected item count, query expansion and excluded URIs.
description.zh: 官方 OpenViking 记忆插件的配置管理界面：连接与用户 Key 配置、本机连接诊断、输入栏会话级记忆开关、按主题隔离的召回范围，以及分数阈值、注入条数、查询扩写与排除 URI 的召回调优。

description.en: Turns a repository and a software name into Chinese software copyright registration material - the 60-page source code excerpt (50 lines per page, auto-paginated), the software manual with screenshots, and the derived application-form fields (line count, language, completion date, function summary). Requires Python 3 with python-docx, and Google Chrome for screenshots.
description.zh: 把代码仓库和软件名变成软件著作权登记材料：60 页源程序鉴别材料（每页 50 行自动分页）、带截图的软件说明书、以及申请表信息推导（源程序量、语言、完成日期、功能简介）。需 Python 3 与 python-docx，截图需 Google Chrome。

description.en: Markdown display enhancements for the DSH Web chat, applied on top of the host renderer rather than replacing it: code blocks become cards with a language label and icon-only wrap and copy buttons, long code blocks, tables and Mermaid diagrams fold behind an expand control, Mermaid fences render as SVG with a diagram and code toggle, a fullscreen viewer with wheel zoom, drag and double-click to fit, and SVG or PNG export, tables get a sticky header and CSV or Markdown copy buttons, and a settings panel adjusts the diagram palette, code font size, the default diagram view and the three fold thresholds.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话的 Markdown 显示增强，在宿主渲染之上加样式与按钮而不替换渲染器：代码块变成带语言名和图标按钮（换行、复制）的卡片；超长的代码块、表格与 Mermaid 图会折叠，底部可展开收起；Mermaid 围栏渲染成 SVG，可在图形与代码间切换，支持全屏查看（滚轮缩放、拖拽、双击适应）以及导出 SVG 或 PNG；表格表头吸顶，并提供 CSV 或 Markdown 复制；设置面板可调图表配色、代码字号、图表默认视图和三类折叠阈值。

description.en: Desktop notifications and an app-icon unread badge for DeepSeek Harness. A banner fires when a turn finishes, when an approval, question or plan confirmation is waiting, and when a turn fails; the badge shows how many sessions need you and clears once viewed, and clicking a banner switches to that session. Follows the DSH interface language, subagent sessions stay quiet by default, titles and body length are configurable, and a loopback HTTP interface lets scripts and other tools post notifications.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加桌面通知与应用图标未读角标：一轮结束、等待审批／回答／计划确认、以及这一轮出错时各弹一条横幅；角标显示有几个会话需要你，看过之后清零，点横幅切到对应会话。文案跟随 DSH 界面语言，子智能体会话默认不提醒，标题与正文长度可配置；宿主还在回环地址上开了一个 HTTP 接口，供脚本和其它工具发通知。

description.en: Windows commit-charge watchdog for DSH Desktop: samples committed memory every 5 seconds, attributes it to the DSH process tree and the largest consumers, blocks automatic restart when DSH is not the main committer, and adds read-only pagefile advice, a 7-day crash timeline and an event export; automatic restart and crash resume are both off by default.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的 Windows 提交内存看门狗：每 5 秒采样提交内存，把它归因到 DSH 进程树与占用最高的进程，在 DSH 不是主要占用者时阻止自动重启，并给出只读的分页文件建议、7 天崩溃时间线与事件导出；自动重启与崩溃后自动续接默认都是关闭的。

description.en: Always-on AI teammate: hand it a recurring task in one sentence; dry-run rehearsal by default, snapshot before every real run, one-click rollback, CNY budget circuit-breaker, per-run cost transparency.
description.zh: 常驻 AI 队友：一句自然语言交给它长期值守；默认演习、执行前后双快照、一键整单回滚、人民币预算熔断、逐轮费用透明。

description.en: Suggests the next user reply in an empty composer after the assistant finishes, using the session model and rolling context summaries, with Tab to accept.
description.zh: 助手完成后，沿用会话模型与滚动上下文摘要，在空输入框中建议下一条用户回复，按 Tab 接受。

description.en: A Claude Code-style reasoning-effort slider for the DSH Web UI: stepless drag, snap-on-release, a WebGL fire trail, and real, working thinking-effort control for any custom third-party model or provider.
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的推理等级滑块：无极拖动、松手吸附、WebGL 火焰跟随，任何自定义第三方模型/提供商都能获得真实生效的思考强度调节。

description.en: Multi-dimensional quality scoring for DeepSeek Harness plugins that scores a repo or npm package across install success, maintenance activity, documentation completeness, security scan, and protocol compliance using real CLI evidence, and produces a JSON or Markdown leaderboard report.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供多指标质量评分：基于真实的 CLI 证据对某个仓库或 npm 包在安装成功率、维护活跃度、文档完整度、安全扫描和协议合规五个维度打分，并生成 JSON 或 Markdown 排行榜报告。

description.en: A Mimi desktop companion for DSH that follows work-session states with animated reactions and bubbles, provides a separate chat mode, and bundles Windows Computer Use for observing and controlling desktop windows.
description.zh: DSH 的 Mimi 桌面伴侣，跟随工作会话状态显示动画反应和气泡，提供独立聊天模式，并内置 Windows Computer Use 以观察和操作桌面窗口。

description.en: Extracts deadlines, deposit, validity, ceiling, bid composition and copy counts from a tender document, and reports the items it did not find rather than omitting them.
description.zh: 从招标文件提取截止时间、保证金、有效期、最高限价、投标文件组成与正副本份数；未找到的项也逐条报告，不省略。

description.en: Adds a Hindsight configuration and status dashboard to the DSH sidebar for connection, model, embedding and bank settings, with health checks and ownership-checked local service controls; memory tools are provided by the separate official integration. Hindsight itself is a separate service and is not installed by this plugin.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏提供 Hindsight 配置与状态面板，管理连接、模型、向量和记忆库设置，支持健康检查及经归属核验的本机服务控制；记忆工具由独立的官方集成提供。Hindsight 服务需另行安装，本插件不负责部署。

description.en: A companion playlist panel for the dsh-boot-animation intro-video plugin: add clips without leaving the app, order them, and switch between sequential, random and single-clip playback. Sequential order is made deterministic by parking every clip except the one due to play in a disabled/ subdirectory of the same asset folder and rotating it back in on each boot, leaving the upstream plugin unpatched. Also supports recycling instead of deleting, pinning one clip for every launch, per-clip opt-out, and .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov files including non-ASCII names.
description.zh: 给开屏动画插件 dsh-boot-animation 配的播放入口面板：不用离开 app 就能加入视频、排好先后，并在「顺序播放 / 随机播放 / 单次播放」之间切换。顺序播放不修改上游插件也能做到确定性——除该播的那支外，参与播放的素材都停在同一个素材目录下的 disabled/ 里排队，每次启动自动轮换。还支持回收而不是删除、固定每次播同一支、逐条取消参与，以及 .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov（含非 ASCII 文件名）。

description.en: Task-event notification center: 6 event kinds (ask / approval / completion / subagent completion / error / turn end), dual channels (browser Notification + host system toast) plus Bark/Webhook push channels (ntfy, Gotify, self-hosted gateways); quiet hours with urgent exceptions, approval-timeout re-reminders, completion-storm aggregation, and notification text redaction.
description.zh: 任务事件通知中心：6 类事件（提问 / 审批 / 完成 / 子代理完成 / 错误 / 轮次完成），双通道（浏览器通知 + 宿主系统 toast）外加 Bark/Webhook 推送频道（ntfy、Gotify、自建网关）；支持免打扰时段与紧急例外、审批超时二次提醒、完成风暴聚合、通知文本脱敏。

description.en: Draws draw.io diagrams in DeepSeek Harness through the next-ai-drawio MCP server: the link in the reply opens a live preview in the right sidebar, you can edit the diagram by hand, and each AI change is a version you can restore. Node.js 18+; npx downloads the MCP server on first use.
description.zh: dsh 的 draw.io 绘图插件：通过 next-ai-drawio MCP 服务器作图，点回复里的链接在右侧栏打开实时预览，可以手动修改图，AI 的每次修改都是可以恢复的版本。需 Node.js 18+，首次使用由 npx 下载 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Lets the agent see the compiled page: renders any page to an image, resolves a PDF point or a text anchor to the exact source line through SyncTeX (and says when a rule is drawn by a package rather than by the body, which is where naive locating is wrong), diffs a page against the previous build so an edit is visible, audits every page for holes the edit introduced, and checks that numbered labels still read in order.
description.zh: 让 Agent 真正看见编译后的页面：把任意一页渲染成图片，用 SyncTeX 把页面坐标或文字锚点解析成源码 file:line（并指出某条横线是宏包画的而不是正文画的——这正是朴素定位最容易出错的地方），把这一页与上一次构建做像素对比，逐页审计本次修改新引入的空洞，并检查图表编号是否仍然顺序正确。

description.en: Browses and plays the 6,454 videos Hacker News has recommended since 2007 inside a DSH panel, with a player, the HN discussion behind each pick, AI questions answered from subtitles, and 6,454 Chinese titles shipped with the package.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里浏览并播放 Hacker News 二十年推荐的 6454 个技术视频，带播放器、每个视频背后的 HN 讨论、基于字幕的 AI 问答，以及随包发布的 6454 条中文标题。

description.en: Account-based access to the ToTonAI gateway inside DeepSeek Harness: sign in or register in the settings panel, use 65 mainstream models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Doubao, Grok, GLM), and pick a plan then pay by QR code in the same panel. Upstream API keys stay on the server.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用账号接入 ToTonAI 中转站:设置面板里登录或注册,使用 65 个主流模型(GPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、豆包、Grok、GLM),并可在同一面板选档位、显示收款码、付款后申报开通。上游 API Key 只留在服务器上。

description.en: Manage VPS servers over SSH key login: 23 zero-token /vps- commands (status queries, recipe installs with a plan and /vps-yes confirmation, reboot that waits for the machine to come back), an in-conversation terminal (xterm.js over ssh -tt) for interactive programs, 5 agent tools with risk-tiered confirmation, file backup with automatic restore and a firewall/SSH safety net, 29 built-in recipes, and a settings page for adding machines.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 密钥登录管理 VPS：23 条不走模型的 /vps- 命令（查看状态、按菜谱安装并先出计划再用 /vps-yes 确认、重启并等机器回来），对话里的终端（xterm.js + ssh -tt，可运行菜单脚本等交互程序），5 个按风险分级确认的 agent 工具，改文件自动备份与还原、改防火墙和 SSH 前设自动恢复，29 条内置菜谱，以及添加机器的设置页。

description.en: Launches the local compound-memory MCP server through uvx and injects a short usage reminder once per session.
description.zh: 通过 uvx 启动本地 compound-memory MCP server，并在每个会话注入一次简短的使用提醒。

description.en: Command DeepSeek Harness from Telegram and Feishu (Lark): one live progress message per turn, approvals and questions as buttons, files and voice, delivery that survives outages and restarts, QR setup for Feishu, and per-person roles.
description.zh: 在 Telegram 和飞书中指挥 DeepSeek Harness：每轮一条实时进度消息，按钮审批与提问，收发文件和语音，断线和重启不丢消息，飞书扫码接入，按人设置权限。

description.en: Settings page for agent modes (presets): switch up to 15 capabilities per mode (commands, files or read-only files, web, subagents, and more) or individual plugin rows; edit each mode's system prompt with variable checks, a full preview, version history, optional live updates for running sessions, and an approval-gated mode_prompt chat tool; create modes from four starter templates or copies; merge built-in updates after a dsh upgrade while keeping your changes, and turn off rows that fail to load.
description.zh: Agent 模式（预设）设置页：按模式开关最多 15 项能力（运行命令、读写或只读文件、网页、子代理等），也能逐个开关插件；编辑每个模式的系统提示词，带变量校验、完整预览和历史版本，可选让正在运行的会话即时生效，并提供每次保存都需审批的对话内修改工具 mode_prompt；用四个起步模板或复制现有模式新建模式；dsh 升级后合并内置更新并保留你的修改，一键关闭加载失败的插件。

description.en: A clearer DeepSeek Harness sidebar with separate navigation and conversation regions and built-in widgets.
description.zh: 分区更清晰的 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏，内置时钟、余额等小组件。

description.en: RunningHub cloud ComfyUI workflows as a background task pool: submit a batch, and a watcher dispatches it within a concurrency budget, polls each job, downloads every output to disk, and wakes the session when the pool drains. A shared ledger records batches, costs, instance tiers, submit and finish times, and per-file save paths, with a live board in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 把 RunningHub 云端 ComfyUI 工作流当作后台任务池来跑：提交一批任务后，watcher 按并发上限自动派发、逐轮询每个任务、把产物全部下载到本地，池子排空时唤醒会话。共享台账记录批次、费用、实例规格、发起与完成时间以及每个文件的保存位置，右侧边栏有实时看板。

description.en: Give any Session a colour mark, shown as a chip in the sidebar and picked from the conversation header; marks are stored on the Host, so a colour chosen on one device is visible on every other one.
description.zh: 给任意会话加上颜色标记：在侧栏显示色条、从会话头部选择颜色；标记保存在宿主上，一台设备选的颜色在其他设备上同样可见。

description.en: Peak-hour reminder: while DeepSeek charges peak rates it shows a banner at the top of the DSH Web UI every N minutes (default 5, range 1-120), adds one at each peak/valley switch, stays silent during valley hours, and keeps a sidebar row with the current state and a countdown to the next switch. Peak rules (Beijing time Mon-Fri 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00; weekends, Chinese public holidays and 调休 weekends are valley all day) are evaluated in the host and served over two no-auth routes, /plugins/dsh-peak-reminder/state and /config; settings live in settings.section and are stored in ~/.dsh/peak-reminder.json.
description.zh: 峰时提醒：DeepSeek 走高峰计价时，每隔 N 分钟（默认 5，可设 1–120）在 DSH Web 界面顶部提醒一次「现在是峰时」，峰↔谷切换各提醒一条，谷时完全不打扰；侧边栏底部常驻一行显示当前峰/谷状态与下次切换倒计时。峰谷规则（北京时间工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00；周末、法定节假日与调休周末全天谷价）由宿主判定，经 /plugins/dsh-peak-reminder/state 与 /config 两个免鉴权路由供界面读取；开关与间隔在设置页一节里改，存到 ~/.dsh/peak-reminder.json。

description.en: Brings the models available in the logged-in WorkBuddy desktop app into the model picker, reusing the app login and credits; the domestic and international builds appear as two separate provider groups. Continuation of the now-deleted corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect; it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 里可用的模型接进模型选择器，复用 App 的登录与积分；国内版与国际版各成一组。corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect（仓库已删除）的续作；注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。

description.en: Checks an official document's type and reference number against the published party and government document format standard - including the bracket form the year is written in and the numbering pattern. Reports what does not match the format; it does not judge the document's content.
description.zh: 依据公开的党政机关公文格式标准，核对公文的文种与发文字号——包括年份所用的括号形式与编号格式。只报告与格式不符之处，不评价公文内容。

description.en: Meshy 3D generation and 3D printing skills driving meshy-cli through the shell: text-to-3D and image-to-3D, texturing, remeshing, rigging and animation, format conversion, and print-ready 3MF/STL with printability repair and slicer handoff. Bundles the CLI and keeps the sign-in on the host side, with a Meshy sidebar page, a Settings → Meshy page and an interactive GLB preview in Web and Desktop; installable as `meshy-dsh`. Needs a Meshy account; generation spends Meshy credits after you confirm the cost.
description.zh: 通过 shell 驱动 meshy-cli 的 Meshy 3D 生成与 3D 打印 Skill：文生 3D、图生 3D、贴图、重拓扑、绑骨与动画、格式转换，以及带可打印检查与修复的 3MF/STL 打印文件和切片软件交接。插件自带 CLI 并在宿主侧保持登录，在 Web 和 Desktop 中提供 Meshy 侧边栏页面、设置 → Meshy 页面和可交互的 GLB 预览；npm 包名 `meshy-dsh`。需要 Meshy 账号；生成会消耗 Meshy 点数，花费前先让你确认。

description.en: OpenCode Go control panel: an account pool that rotates A-to-B when a key runs out or stops authenticating, per-account 5-hour/weekly/monthly allowance, per-model spend with remaining quota, capability tags (image, video, text-only, tools, reasoning), a live OpenCode-vs-official cost comparison, and quota routing that falls back to a DeepSeek official subscription on an upstream limit or degradation, then returns after 10 stable minutes - shown as a current-route banner, a status card and desktop switch notices, in 10 UI languages.
description.zh: OpenCode Go 控制台：账户池在密钥额度耗尽或鉴权失败时自动 A→B 轮替，按账户显示 5 小时/本周/本月额度，按模型显示用量与剩余额度并标出能力（图像、视频、纯文本、工具调用、推理），实时换算走 OpenCode 还是官方直连更划算；额度路由在上游限流或降级时自动切到 DeepSeek 官方订阅、恢复并稳定 10 分钟后切回，页面顶部有当前路由横幅、状态卡与切换通知，支持 10 种界面语言。

description.en: Roll back to before any of your questions or edit the last one and resubmit, with the workspace files of the discarded turns restored.
description.zh: 回退到任意一条提问之前，或编辑上一条问题重新提交；被丢弃轮次产生的工作区文件会一并还原。

description.en: An independent approval subagent judges every sandbox escalation, with a configurable model and an audit log.
description.zh: 由独立审批子代理裁决每次沙箱提权，可配置审批模型并带审计记录。

description.en: Brings the third-party deepseekbase.com index into DSH: eight tools and five DSHIO standard skills (from the @liangjiehappy/dsh-dshio dependency). Search 8,400 plugins with real sandbox install verdicts and risk levels (including red-line warnings where credential access meets network), submit a plugin for a four-stage sandbox test from the conversation, read the verdict, check the remaining free quota, and run a clause-by-clause DSHIO/T 10 conformance check. The skill text is fetched from dshio.org at startup and replaces the bundled copy, so updates need no reinstall. Network: HTTPS to deepseekbase.com and dshio.org, plus an npm registry lookup before a test is submitted; no file reads or writes, no credential access, no shell.
description.zh: 把第三方 deepseekbase.com 的数据接进 DSH，八个工具加五个 DSHIO 标准技能（来自依赖包 @liangjiehappy/dsh-dshio）。能搜 8,400 个插件并附沙箱安装判定与风险等级（含红线警告：读凭证＋网络＝可能泄露 API Key）、在对话里提交插件做四阶段沙箱测试、查判定、查剩余免费额度，以及按 DSHIO/T 10 标准逐条检查插件是否合规。技能正文在启动时从 dshio.org 拉取并替换内置副本，更新不需重装。网络请求只发往 deepseekbase.com 与 dshio.org（提交测试前另查一次 npm registry）；不读写文件、不读凭证、不执行 shell。

description.en: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.
description.zh: 基于分支的消息编辑、reroll、重试与版本时间线。

description.en: Connects the hosted Knowra MCP server: search arXiv papers by topic, author or exact UTC dates without an account, and sign in with OAuth from the plugin page to read Scout reports on methods, evidence and limitations.
description.zh: 接入 Knowra 托管 MCP：无需账号即可按主题、作者或精确 UTC 日期检索 arXiv 论文；在插件页用 OAuth 登录后可读取 Scout 报告（方法、证据与局限）。

description.en: Usage statistics settings panel: 26-week activity heatmap, daily token trend with a cache hit-rate curve, per-model donut and breakdown, time-range filters, summary cards, one-time historical backfill and lossless rebuild.
description.zh: 用量统计设置面板：26 周活跃热力图、按日 Token 趋势与缓存命中率曲线、模型用量环形图与明细、时间范围筛选、汇总卡片，支持历史会话回扫与无损重建。

description.en: Teaching-first CTF solving skill: narrates each step's pattern, tool choice and underlying mechanism, then writes a reproducible writeup under solves/<challenge>/ gated by a nine-section check.
description.zh: 教学式 CTF 解题技能：每步讲清套路、工具选型与底层原理，收尾在 solves/<题目名>/ 生成可复现 Writeup，并用九章质量门校验。

description.en: Goal lifecycle management for dsh with an interactive kanban board: goals, criteria, attempts and reviews live in the workspace, driven by graph_* tools, with a two-lane board rendered in the conversation view.
description.zh: dsh 目标生命周期管理与可视化看板：目标、判据、执行、评审都在项目内跟踪，由 graph_* 工具驱动，会话视图内渲染二维泳道看板。

description.en: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback.
description.zh: 两级模型熔断与回退：模型或平台连续失败后自动熔断，并把下一个请求路由到配置好的备用模型。

description.en: Read-only judgment layer for DSH profiles: explains row by row why a plugin was refused admission or silently disappeared, pre-flights a runtime upgrade against the installed set in four buckets (would-be-denied, cannot-tell, improved, likely-fine), and can measure a candidate in an isolated DSH_HOME. Defaults to read-only; the two --apply verbs only write compatibility.json or dsh.profile.bundles, each after a backup, with a journal and a byte-exact --undo.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 插件判断层：逐行说明某个插件为什么被准入拒绝或静默失效，升级前对着已装集合预演四类结果（会被拒、判不了、会变好、像没事），并可把候选插件装进隔离的 DSH_HOME 实测。默认只读；两个 --apply 动词只写 compatibility.json 或 dsh.profile.bundles，各自先备份、写 journal、可逐字节 --undo。

description.en: DSH QQ bot bridge plugin, connect DeepSeek Harness with QQ bot.
description.zh: DSH QQ机器人桥接插件，将DeepSeek Harness对接QQ机器人。

description.en: Claim-verification skill that checks design documents and plans against codebase facts, escalating behavioral claims to executable logic-primitive verification for state machines and data models, with before/after regression, domain constraints, and concurrency risk mining.
description.zh: 声称核查技能：将设计文档与计划中的每条声称对照代码库事实核验，行为类声称升级为状态机/数据模型逻辑原语验证，支持前后回归、领域约束与并发风险挖掘。

description.en: Locks the model's reasoning, replies and tool-call descriptions to a chosen target language (Simplified Chinese by default) with system-prompt sections at the head, middle and tail of the prompt, offering three strength levels, an auto mode that follows the DSH interface language, a settings panel that shows the language currently in effect, and a sidebar quick switch.
description.zh: 把模型的思考过程、回复与工具调用描述锁定为指定语言（默认简体中文）：在 system prompt 首、中、尾注入约束段落，提供基础、强化、周期三档强度，可跟随 DSH 界面语言自动选择，设置页显示当前生效语言，并带侧栏快速切换。

description.en: Select text in a conversation to attach a numbered highlight with a colour stored per note, keep every mark in an outline panel that jumps back to its quote, and let a corner self-check badge report style, selector and saved-key problems without opening dev tools.
description.zh: 在对话里划词加批注：编号高亮、每条各记自己的颜色，大纲面板列出全部标记并点一条跳回原文；右下角自检角标不开开发者工具就报出样式、越界选择器与本地存档键的问题。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy free/paid models (domestic + international) into DSH without the desktop app, published as @bushizhanghan/dsh-workmate. This package is a maintained fork of Faide-cyber/dsh-workbuddy (whose upstream entry is already listed in this catalogue); do NOT co-install both, as they register the same provider id "workbuddy-ai" and will collide. v1.2.7 relocates over-long system prompts past the domestic gateway channel-risk classifier, rewrites the DSH brand string, and adds a debug dump; supports dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1 (incl. prereleases).
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 国内版和国际版的免费/付费模型接进 DSH，无需桌面端；以 @bushizhanghan/dsh-workmate 发布。本包是 Faide-cyber/dsh-workbuddy 的维护分支（上游条目已在目录内）；请勿与上游同装，二者共用 provider id「workbuddy-ai」会冲突。v1.2.7：跨国内网关风控——长系统提示自动搬迁、出站体改写 DSH 字样、调试落盘；支持 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 至 0.2.1（含预发布）。

description.en: Multi-workspace manager: bind a docs anchor plus ordered code-project repositories into one session, injecting their absolute paths, a recursive file index, a server/client endpoint index and optional coding standards, and syncing writable directories into the sandbox.
description.zh: 多工作区管理器：把文档锚点目录与若干代码项目仓库组合进同一会话，注入绝对路径、递归文件索引、前后端端点落点索引与可选的开发规范，并把可写目录同步进沙盒。

description.en: Read PLC projects inside DSH — decode CoDeSys .project and Delta .dvp (both need Python 3.9+ on PATH) and Siemens S7-200 SMART .smart/.smartlib into readable reports and structured data, plus project diff, address audits, element-level read/write analysis and ladder-logic reconstruction.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里读 PLC 工程——把 CoDeSys `.project`、台达 `.dvp`（两者需本机 PATH 里有 Python 3.9+）与西门子 S7-200 SMART `.smart/.smartlib` 解码成可读报告与结构化数据，另带新旧对比、地址体检、元素级读写判定与连线还原。

description.en: Encrypted local credentials vault for the Harness: a web settings page and vault_* tools to store, search and copy passwords, API keys, TOTP secrets and card data, with health audits, expiry rotation, imports/exports and read-only/ask access modes.
description.zh: Harness 的本地加密凭据保险库：Web 设置页与 vault_* 工具，可存取与复制密码、API 密钥、TOTP 与银行卡信息，支持健康审计、到期轮换、导入导出以及只读/询问访问模式。

description.en: Generate images and videos, edit images, remove backgrounds, upscale images, upload reference media, and check Fotor credits.
description.zh: 通过 Fotor 生成图片和视频、编辑图片、移除背景、放大图片、上传参考素材及查询积分。

description.en: Reads and edits STEP models through FreeCAD, measures geometry (distance, angle, diameter), and generates first-angle 2D machining drawings with a hole table as SVG, DXF, PDF or PNG.
description.zh: 通过 FreeCAD 读写 STEP 模型、量取几何尺寸（距离、角度、直径），并生成带孔表的第一角法二维加工图，可导出 SVG、DXF、PDF、PNG。

description.en: A drawer panel for the DSH web UI with a paginated list of free LLMs; one-click or batch writes each as a custom model provider into Settings, plus a local multi-key rotation proxy.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧的免费模型抽屉面板，分页浏览免费模型，可一键或整页批量把模型写入自定义提供方，并附带本地多 Key 轮换代理。

description.en: DSH plugin to read AutoCAD DWG/DXF, PDF and images without installing AutoCAD or Tesseract; DXF requires Python 3 and ezdxf on the machine.
description.zh: DSH 插件：直接读取 DWG/DXF 图纸、PDF 与图片，无需安装 AutoCAD 或 Tesseract；DXF 需本机安装 Python 3 与 ezdxf。

description.en: Turns a live session into a layered instrument: seven toggleable rings (session, steps, skills, tools, jobs, approvals, file changes), a per-turn timeline, hover and click on every ring node, and per-step ladders drawn beneath the rings. It reads the session log directly and updates as the conversation runs, in Chinese and English.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话画成分层仪表的插件：七层可开关的环（会话、步骤、技能、工具、任务、审批、文件变更）、逐轮时间线、环上任意节点可悬停看名称并点击看详情、连线画在环的下层；直接读会话日志，随对话实时演进，界面中英双语。

description.en: Turns a user goal into a plugin plan using community catalogs and author documentation, then continues through installation and task execution in one workbench with saved history and feedback.
description.zh: 从用户目标匹配社区插件并阅读作者资料，形成插件方案，在同一工作台衔接安装和任务执行，保存历史与反馈。

description.en: Adds Activity and Favorites views to the DSH sidebar for running, waiting, unread, recent, and natively pinned sessions across workspaces, while preserving the native workspace tree. Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏添加 Activity 和 Favorites 视图，跨工作区查看运行中、等待回复、未读、最近及原生置顶会话，并保留原生工作区树。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Voice or sound cue when a turn finishes and a failure cue when a tool call or turn errors; user aborts stay silent and subagent sessions are skipped by default. Three modes: voice (Volcengine TTS with cloned or preset voices, fingerprint reuse so unchanged text is not re-synthesised), effects (20 built-in sounds assignable to done, fail and approval, with per-row preview and no API key; the approval slot has no automatic trigger, so it plays only manually) and off. Plays through winmm without touching system volume. Windows only. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 每个 turn 结束播报完成、出错时播失败提示，用户中断默认不播，子代理默认跳过。三种方式：语音（火山 TTS，支持克隆与预设音色，指纹复用不重复合成）、音效（内置 20 个，可分配给完成/失败/审批并单独试听，零配置；审批槽没有自动触发源，只能手动播放）、关闭。走 winmm 播放，不改系统音量。仅 Windows。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: A memory plugin that forgets on purpose: short-term memories expire after 48h, long-term ones are rescheduled by Ebbinghaus/SM-2 curves and rarely-used ones fall asleep instead of bloating your context. Long-term writes stop in an approval center, so the agent cannot rewrite your persona on its own.
description.zh: 会遗忘的记忆插件：短期记忆 48 小时自动过期，长期记忆按艾宾浩斯/SM-2 曲线复习，久不用的沉进沉睡区（可唤醒）而不是无限撑爆上下文。长期写入停在审核中心，模型不能自行改写人格设定。

description.en: Manages a relay station's many groups and rates for DSH, switching the station's billing group in place and refreshing the model list and rate on stations that expose /v1/token/group; stations without it fall back to read-only and keep serving models.
description.zh: 解决中转站多分组多倍率不方便管理的问题：在提供 /v1/token/group 的站点上就地切换分组并同步刷新模型列表与计费倍率；缺少该接口的站点自动降级为只读，模型仍可正常拉取与调用。

description.en: Input prediction for the DSH composer: your next prompt suggested as ghost text after each turn, accepted with Tab. (autocomplete / input prediction / prompt suggestion)
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加上输入预测：回合结束后自动建议你的下一句话，Tab 一键采纳；输入时按会话历史做前缀补全。（输入预测 / 自动补全 / 提示词建议 / 补全）

description.en: Session header badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, per-model token prices on hover, and real session/turn costs from actual usage.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标：显示 DeepSeek 高峰/闲时状态、当前模型 token 单价，并按真实用量统计会话与每轮费用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness UI polish: one Markdown style across every renderer, select-text annotations with numbered pins, a sidebar that drags down to 214px and remembers its width, a first launch that fills the screen, sidebar panel and plugin icons collected into one top row of five, and a colour-cycling marker for running sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面增强：统一各处 Markdown 排版、划词批注（带编号的段落标记）、可拖到 214px 并记住宽度的侧栏、首次启动铺满屏幕、侧栏面板与插件图标合并为顶部一行（每行 5 个），以及运行中会话的彩色状态环。

description.en: Finds wasted GitHub Actions runner time and proposes small, reviewable workflow patches, with explicit approval before any edit and a DSH settings page for analysis rules, history limits, storage, and cost estimation.
description.zh: 找出被浪费的 GitHub Actions 运行时间，并提出小而可审查的工作流补丁；任何修改都需要明确批准，并提供用于分析规则、历史上限、存储和成本估算的 DSH 设置页面。

description.en: Forked from j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager (MIT) at its 0.5.6 baseline and substantially reworked since; it registers the same plugin id, so it cannot be installed alongside the original. Adds lossless cordis.patch.yml writes (JS expression values preserved), save-gated per-tool filters, skills governance over the DSH roots plus 10 external agent directories with per-skill/per-source switches enforced through the agent-scope skills provider (disabling actually hides a skill from the model), categories and a restorable trash, GitHub-repository install/update/rollback, zip and SKILL.md import, skills.sh/ClawHub market, workspace view, sidebar panel, dark/light contrast fixes, and update checks against the published npm package (same source as market installs; npm publication carries OIDC provenance).
description.zh: 本插件在 j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager（MIT）的 0.5.6 基线之上分叉并做了大幅重构；两者注册同一个插件 id，不能同时安装。相对基线新增：cordis.patch.yml 的无损写回（保留 JS 表达式值）、保存闸门式逐工具过滤、覆盖 DSH 原生根与 10 个外部 Agent 目录的技能治理与逐技能/逐来源启停（通过 agent-scope skills provider 真正让模型看不到被停用的技能）、分类与可恢复回收站、GitHub 仓库安装/更新/回滚、zip 与 SKILL.md 导入、skills.sh/ClawHub 市场、工作区视图、侧栏面板、亮/暗主题对比度修复，以及读取 npm 发布版本的更新检查（与市场安装源一致；npm 发布带 OIDC provenance）。

description.en: Forces context compression when running low-context llama.cpp models such as Qwen3.8-27B, improving model efficiency and usage smoothness, together with well-refined compaction prompts.
description.zh: llama-cpp qwen3.8-27b 低上下文时，强制上下文压缩插件，提示模型使用效率和使用流畅度，外加完善的压缩提示。

description.en: Mobile layout fixes for the Web UI on narrow screens: full-screen settings panel, one-row plugin nav, full-screen sidebar, centered popups, icon-only session-log button.
description.zh: Web UI 移动端布局修复：窄屏下设置面板全屏化、插件导航单行排满、侧边栏全屏、弹层居中、会话日志按钮图标化。

description.en: Redacts secrets, cookies and personal data in every model request at the host process undici dispatcher and restores the placeholders in the reply, so one interception covers every provider, adapters that plugins add included; per-kind actions mask / warn / block, an optional same-shape fake key, records written to disk by the day and a statistics card.
description.zh: 在宿主进程的 undici dispatcher 上拦截所有发往模型的请求：密钥、Cookie 与个人信息换成占位符，回复里再还原，一处拦截覆盖所有 provider（含插件自带的 adapter）；按 kind 可选 mask / warn / block、可换成同形的假 key，记录按天落盘并带统计卡。

description.en: Session bridge for DeepSeek Harness: drive other real DSH sessions straight from your prompt — create top-level sessions in any workspace, message or steer any session, wait for replies and stream them segment-by-segment (chain-of-thought included), resume offline sessions, find sessions across workspaces, run a background watchdog that monitors and schedules a main task (nudge when stalled, correct drift, cancel when stuck), and archive sessions with one command.
description.zh: 会话桥：让当前 agent 直接用提示词驱动其它真实的 DSH 会话——跨工作区创建主会话、向任意会话发消息或注入 steering、等待并逐段读取回复（含思维链）、恢复离线会话、按名称或 id 跨工作区查找会话；还能用后台看门狗监控并调度主任务（卡住催办、偏离纠偏、卡死终止），一键归档会话。

description.en: Token-efficient web reading for DeepSeek Harness: one call fetches several pages through a real Chrome/Edge over CDP, gates them by relevance and returns a single digest, cutting context tokens by 80-98%. Real search URLs, login flow, screenshots, three proxy modes.
description.zh: 省 token 的网页阅读：底层是真 Chrome/Edge（CDP），一次调用读完多个页面、按相关性筛掉不相关的，只回一段带账本的摘要（实测省 80–98% 上下文）。真实搜索链接、登录态、截图、三档代理。

description.en: Dependency graph inspector for DeepSeek Harness: snapshots the live Cordis plugin/service topology into a zoomable browser panel with graph-theory metrics, plus a graph.render tool for the model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件依赖图检查器：把运行中的 Cordis 插件/服务拓扑快照为可缩放的浏览器面板图，附带图论指标，以及面向模型的 graph.render 工具。

description.en: Ships a minimal lesson ledger: brief.ps1 to look up past pitfalls, add-lesson.ps1 to record new ones, deployed into the skills directory and wired into AGENTS.md by the installer. The model checks it before working and turns what it hits into rules, so the same mistake is not made twice. This plugin watches whether that actually happens and shows the result in a tab and under the composer.
description.zh: 自带一套最小账本工具：brief.ps1 查过往踩过的坑，add-lesson.ps1 记新的，安装时自动部署到技能目录并接好 AGENTS.md。模型动手前查一遍、踩坑后记成规则，同一个坑不必踩第二次。本插件负责盯着它有没有真的这么做，并把「查了几次、记了哪几条」摆在面板和输入框下方。

description.en: Normalizes every tool schema before it reaches the model, rewriting it into the strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset that Gemini function declarations accept — a type on every node, items on every array, no empty enum entry, $ref inlined — so a single offending MCP or built-in tool no longer fails the whole request with HTTP 400.
description.zh: 把发给模型的工具 schema 统一归一化成 Gemini function declaration 能接受的 OpenAPI 3.0 子集：每个节点补 type、数组补 items、剔除空 enum 项、内联 $ref，让"任何一个 MCP 或内置工具不合规"不再把整包请求打成 HTTP 400。

description.en: Adds configurable HTTP header profiles that can be selected per model.
description.zh: 添加可配置的 HTTP 请求头配置档，并支持按模型选择。

description.en: Week-keyed personal memo service: stores entries in ISO-week tables, resolves week/month/quarter/year navigation from one period calendar, archives quarters, runs AI analysis and Markdown report export, summarizes archived DSH sessions into the week as one entry per session in the language and at the length the reader picks, requires an explicit force flag to edit a past week, turns one suite-wide telemetry failure analysis into a GitHub issue report, and checks the npm registry for a newer release, returning the exact upgrade command instead of installing anything.
description.zh: 按 ISO 周组织的个人备忘服务：条目按周存储，周/月/季/年四种视图由同一份周期日历解析，支持按季度归档，提供 AI 分析与 Markdown 报告导出，并能按读者所选语言与长度把 DSH 已归档会话总结进对应周、每个会话一条，修改非当前周需要显式确认，也能把整条插件套件的遥测失败分析整理成一份 GitHub issue 报告，另外会向 npm registry 查询自身是否有新版本，只返回准确的升级命令而不自行安装。

description.en: Native generation-time Mixture-of-Agents: every turn, reference models run the same session context in parallel as pre-run drafts and one aggregator executes with full tooling; config-as-model recipes, F mirror / R trimmed views, enforced subagent gating (dual-shape session indexing), derived per-recipe vision (vision refs relay image reads to text-only aggregators), tiered cadence with separate steering and patrol rosters plus frozen reuse between beats, degeneration guard dropping degenerate reference output, anonymized model face (failure notices carry no provider identity), and cache-friendly guidance placement (the rehearsal record is pinned where it was produced instead of appended to every request, so the cached prefix covers it and each step pays only for what was added since - on by default across every cadence).
description.zh: 原生生成时 MoA：每轮参考模型并行预演同一会话上下文产出草稿，单一聚合模型带完整工具循环执行；配置即模型配方、F 镜像 / R 裁剪双视野、子会话门控（双形态会话目录索引，修复后实效）、按成分派生的配方级视觉（视觉参考路可为纯文本聚合转述图像）、节拍节奏（定调与巡检两套阵容、拍间冻结复用）、退化守卫（剔除退化的参考输出）、模型面匿名（失败提示零供应商身份）、缓存友好化注入（预演记录钉在产出它的那一步而非每步追加到请求末尾，缓存前缀覆盖它、每步只付新增量，缺省开启、全 cadence 档生效）。

description.en: Checks supervision logs for cross-day continuity and for on-site supervision coverage, against GB/T 50319-2013 and other published documents. Reports gaps and coverage differences for a human to review.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 50319-2013 等公开文件，核对监理日志的跨日连续性，以及旁站监理的覆盖情况。列出缺漏与覆盖差异供人复核。

description.en: Wraps work in named tasks and, once a task closes, folds its whole span of messages into one summary at the next step boundary; the original content can be restored on demand.
description.zh: 用命名任务包住工作过程；任务结束后，在下一个步骤边界把整段消息折叠成一段摘要，原文可随时还原。

description.en: Stops DeepSeek Harness from compacting (summarizing) your conversation far too early. Without it, compaction fires around half-full on smaller context windows; with it, compaction waits until the window is as full as you want (80% by default), settable per provider/model. It only changes when compaction happens — what a summary keeps is still DSH’s decision.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 不再过早压缩对话（把早期内容总结掉）。默认行为下，上下文窗口不大的模型（十几万 token 那种）常常在半满出头就开始压缩；装上它之后，压缩会等你设定的比例（默认 80%）到了才发生，并且可以按 provider/model 分别设置。它只改“什么时候压缩”，一次压缩保留哪些内容仍由 DSH 决定。

description.en: Multi-machine sync: keeps multiple dsh replicas consistent through one private GitCode repository — skills, sessions, settings and plugin manifests each with an independent switch; changes go through branch, PR and merge, remote-only additions are pulled back before every push so nothing is deleted, and an AI smart-align step semantically merges files both sides changed (plus one-click conflict resolution); private repos enforced, pull never overwrites local edits.
description.zh: 多机同步：让多台机器上的 dsh 通过一个私有 GitCode 仓库保持一致——技能、会话、设置、插件清单四类内容各有独立开关；变更走分支 → PR → 合并，推送前自动回填远端新增防误删，支持 AI 智能对齐（语义合并双方改动）与一键解决冲突；强制私有仓库，pull 不覆盖本地改动。

description.en: Authentication gateway for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the login gate covers pages, /api, /plugins and WebSocket upgrades; PBKDF2 password hashing with per-user salts, HttpOnly SameSite session cookies named per DSH_HOME and IP-based login lockout; invite-code registration; two-factor login with TOTP or passkeys (WebAuthn: several keys per account, phone enrolment by QR, username-less sign-in, and a step-up before any login factor is added or removed); a user-management settings panel (users edit their own profile and manage their own TOTP and passkeys, admins add or remove users, reset passwords, manage invites and clear the passkeys of a lost device); per-user model and API-key configuration whose private entries are encrypted with a key derived from the login password and stay unreadable by any admin, with admin sharing to selected users (usable, balance visible, key never shown, revocation immediate) and unconfigured users blocked rather than falling back to the deployment configuration; per-user isolation on the REST and list APIs and per-frame ownership filtering on the WebSocket mux; session persistence across restarts; a JSONL audit log; and a fail-closed gateway. Requires the DSH 0.2.0 line (the 0.1.1-rc.2 transport line was removed in 0.7.0); passkey login needs a localhost or HTTPS origin because browsers require a secure context.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 认证网关：登录门禁覆盖页面、/api、/plugins 与 WebSocket 升级；PBKDF2 口令哈希（每用户独立盐）、HttpOnly SameSite 会话 Cookie（名字按 DSH_HOME 唯一）、按源 IP 登录锁定；邀请码注册；两步验证可用 TOTP 动态码或通行密钥（WebAuthn：一个账号可绑定多个密钥，手机可扫码添加，支持免用户名登录，改动登录因子前必须二次验证）；设置面板内置用户管理（普通用户可修改本人资料与密码并管理自己的 TOTP 与通行密钥，管理员可新增/删除用户、重置密码、管理邀请码、清除丢失设备的通行密钥）；模型与 API Key 按用户隔离管理，私有配置用登录口令派生的密钥加密、任何管理员都无法读取，管理员可把自己的模型分享给指定用户（可用、可看余额、看不到 Key、撤销立即生效），未配置的用户被阻断而不是回退到部署级配置；REST/列表接口按用户隔离，WebSocket 主通道逐帧按归属过滤；会话重启后免登录恢复；JSONL 审计日志；存储故障时保持 fail-closed。仅支持 DSH 0.2.0 线（0.1.1-rc.2 传输线已在 0.7.0 移除）；因浏览器要求安全上下文，通行密钥需通过 localhost 或 HTTPS 访问。

description.en: Keep a multi-PR effort on one board you can trust at a glance: the hub agent keeps a tree of steps, each linked to its issue, PR, branch and worktree, through four board tools, and you see what is done, what is blocked and what needs you in a right-sidebar Board tab and a progress strip above the composer. Each board is one plain JSON file your scripts can read, and an optional drift command you configure flags steps whose status no longer matches their work.
description.zh: 把跨多个 PR 的工作放进一块一眼就能看清的看板：中枢 Agent 通过四个看板工具维护一棵步骤树，每步关联 issue、PR、分支与 worktree；右侧栏 Board 标签页和输入框上方的进度条告诉你哪些已完成、哪些被阻塞、哪些在等你处理。每个看板就是一个你的脚本也能读的 JSON 文件；可选的、由你配置的漂移检查命令会标出状态与实际进展不再一致的步骤。

description.en: Back up, restore and two-way sync DSH plugins and configuration through your own Git repository, with conflict handling, snapshots and six agent tools.
description.zh: 用你自己的 Git 仓库备份、恢复并双向同步 DSH 插件与配置，支持冲突处理、快照与 6 个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Port of ponytail: an always-on lazy-senior-developer coding persona with intensity levels, persistence of the default level, and review, audit, debt, gain and help skills for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ponytail 移植：常驻的「懒惰资深开发者」编码人设，带强度档位与 review、audit、debt、gain、help 技能，适用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Custom background image for the DSH Web UI: upload a picture or paste an image URL behind the whole app surface, with opacity, theme-aware scrim, panel transparency, frosted-glass and wallpaper blur, live preview and persisted settings, plus an optional DeepSeek-style timeline rail with per-question bookmarks for long conversations.
description.zh: DSH Web 自定义背景插件：上传本地图片或粘贴图片链接作为全界面背景，可调不透明度、明暗自适应遮罩、面板透明度、毛玻璃与壁纸模糊，实时预览、设置持久化；另附可选的 DeepSeek 官网风格会话时间线导航轨，支持重点书签与快速跳转。

description.en: Collapses the DSH sidebar panel list into a single group row, and its gear opens an edit mode to show, hide and drag-reorder two groups: sidebar extension entries and conversation view tabs.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧的面板列表折叠成一行分组头；点齿轮进入编辑态，对两组内容分别勾选显示/隐藏、拖动排序——侧栏扩展入口与会话顶部视图标签。

description.en: Run several DeepSeek Harness sessions side by side, hand work from one to another, and watch the whole collaboration on one read-only canvas.
description.zh: 并排运行多个 DeepSeek Harness 会话，让它们互相交接任务，并在同一张只读看板上看清整场协作。

description.en: A pinned group above the workspace browser: pinned sessions from every workspace in one collapsible, searchable list, plus pinned Workspaces that unfold their own sessions in place, with a pin entry in the workspace row menu.
description.zh: 侧栏「工作区」上方的一个置顶分组：跨工作区汇总置顶会话，可折叠、可就地搜索；置顶的工作区行点一下就地展开它自己的会话，工作区行右键菜单里也能置顶。

description.en: Composer toggle that shapes replies: conclusion first, inline quotes, no cross-turn references.
description.zh: 输入框「说人话」开关：结论先行、引用原文、去掉需要翻前文的表述。

description.en: Automatic session retrospective: after a conversation wraps up, distills useful experience into reusable skills stored in the skill library for the model to call, with signal-accelerated triggers, manual runs, an approval mode, and skill-library governance (archive/restore, never deletes directly).
description.zh: 自动复盘：对话收尾后自动把有价值的经验蒸馏成可复用的技能（skill）存入技能库，支持信号加速触发、手动立即复盘、审批模式与技能库治理（归档/恢复，永不直接删除）。

description.en: Coding-subscription OAuth for SuperGrok/Grok Build, ChatGPT Plus Codex, Kimi Code and Claude Code, plus an opt-in loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway: local login without pasting tokens, AUTH refresh-and-retry, grok-4.6 xhigh, and API-key route coexistence.
description.zh: 编码订阅 OAuth，支持 SuperGrok / Grok Build、ChatGPT Plus Codex、Kimi Code、Claude Code，并提供可选 loopback OpenAI/Anthropic 网关：本地登录无需粘贴 token，支持 AUTH 刷新重试、grok-4.6 xhigh，并可与 API-key 路由共存。

description.en: Two-step session deletion: the session menu moves a chat into a recycle bin without deleting anything, the bin panel restores an entry, deletes one for good right away, or empties the whole bin, and the next start wipes its log, projection cache, spill files and workspace membership.
description.zh: 两步删除会话：会话菜单先把会话移入回收站（不删任何内容、可随时恢复），面板可恢复、可逐条立刻删除、也可整体清空，下次启动 DSH 时才真正清掉日志、投影缓存、spill 文件与工作区登记。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness control of the Tabbit Browser: auto-loads the tabbit-browser skill on install, detects official Tabbit and Tabbit Browser releases (>= 1.9.0), checks the tabbit-cli persistent runtime, diagnoses the per-platform DSH sandbox mode needed to call the CLI, and downloads the region-matched official installer via a background job when no qualifying version is present.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能够控制 Tabbit 浏览器：安装即自动加载 tabbit-browser skill，检测国际版 Tabbit 与国内版 Tabbit Browser 正式版（>= 1.9.0），检查 tabbit-cli 常驻运行时，按平台诊断调用 CLI 所需的 DSH sandbox 模式，并在没有合格版本时通过后台任务下载与系统地区匹配的正式版安装包。

description.en: Session lifecycle: auto-archives sessions older than a configurable threshold (the check interval is configurable too), and an archive panel lists archived sessions for unarchive or deletion; deletion moves the session artifacts to the OS recycle bin, falls back to a plugin-managed quarantine directory where no recycle bin is available, and a ledger re-attaches a session whose artifacts were restored.
description.zh: 会话生命周期:按可配置阈值与检查周期自动归档超期会话,归档面板支持取消归档与删除;删除把会话产物移入系统回收站,无回收站的环境降级到插件回收区,台账可把已还原的会话重新挂载。

description.en: Version and maintenance suite for DSH itself: detects new host releases from npm dist-tags, upgrades with one click, restarts safely, and the web page auto-recovers once the host is back.
description.zh: DSH 版本与运维一体化：自动发现新版本、一键升级、安全重启，重启后页面自动恢复。

description.en: A DSH-first Rust/ratatui agent TUI with streamed tool calls, subagents, durable sessions, and a Cordis-extensible client UI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Rust/ratatui Agent TUI，支持流式工具调用、子代理、持久会话和可扩展的 Cordis 客户端界面。

description.en: Parse PDFs and documents into structured Markdown with MinerU. Uploads files to the MinerU cloud; no offline mode.
description.zh: 用 MinerU 把 PDF 与文档解析为结构化 Markdown。文件会上传到 MinerU 云端，无离线模式。

description.en: Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes by failure type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) to automatic backoff retry, model switch, resume after context compaction, or a stop-loss notification, with a visual rule editor and a full activity log.
description.zh: 自动续跑：agent 会话中断后自动续上，规则表按失败类型（限流/额度/鉴权/上下文超限/崩溃孤儿）路由——自动退避重试、换模型继续、压缩上下文后继续或止损通知，规则可视化编辑，全程活动日志。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app — it asks before restarting while work is running, and afterwards reports how long the app was down. Entries can live in the sidebar, the conversation header, the account menu or the settings page, and each one can be turned off. Extras include checking how much sign-in data is stored (a cause of startup failures) and previewing leftover temp files, counted but never deleted. Desktop app only.
description.zh: 在桌面版加一个「重启」按钮：有任务在跑时先问过你，重启后告诉你停机了多久。入口可放在侧栏、会话标题栏、账号菜单或设置页，不想要的能逐个关掉。附带功能：检查登录数据占用（避免应用启动失败）、预览遗留临时文件（只统计不删除）、隐藏账号菜单里的「意见反馈」。仅适用于桌面版。

description.en: Adds a Community Bench tab that reads the public task-conditioned registry and shows the same score everyone sees; it does not compute a local score.
description.zh: 增加社区基准标签页，读取公开的、按任务条件计算的 registry，展示所有人看到的同一分数；不在本地计算分数。

description.en: Adds Meta's Muse Code subscription as a DSH model provider: the bundle declares the shipped Meta route under Settings > Models, syncs the account chat catalog (Muse Wonder included) into the model picker, and adds a Sign in card plus the /muse-login command that run DSH's built-in Meta device-code flow, keep the minted key renewed, and show a red or green credential dot. Needs an active Muse Code subscription and no Meta CLI.
description.zh: 把 Meta 的 Muse Code 订阅接入为 DSH 模型提供方，在设置中声明 Meta 路由、同步账号聊天模型目录到模型选择器，并提供登录卡片与 /muse-login 设备码登录、凭据自动续期与红绿点。需有效 Muse Code 订阅，无需 Meta CLI。

description.en: Syncs the groups, keys and models of one sub2api instance into dsh-llm-pi-ai provider routes, with panel-driven login (password / OAuth) and one provider route per relay key.
description.zh: 将一个 sub2api 实例的分组、密钥与模型同步为 dsh-llm-pi-ai 的 provider 路由，支持面板登录（密码 / OAuth），一条中转密钥对应一条 provider 路由。

description.en: Design-artifact skill adapted from Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder: turns a design brief into a self-contained HTML/SVG artifact (posters, infographics, landing pages, charts, component mockups) with a pre-delivery quality checklist and an anti-AI-look pattern list.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的设计稿生成 skill（改编自 Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder）：把设计需求做成可直接打开的自包含 HTML/SVG 设计稿（海报、信息图、落地页、图表、组件稿），内置交付前质量清单与「去 AI 味」反模式清单。

description.en: Let the AI connect to databases and write SQL for you.
description.zh: 让 AI 帮你连数据库、写 SQL。

description.en: Use the free AtomGit quota already signed in on this machine to have AtomCode run an independent code review: the model calls the atomcode_ask tool on its own, and you can also use the /atomcode-review command to review uncommitted changes, a branch or a PR in one click. The plugin reads no API key; a usage pill below the input box shows the CodingPlan quota.
description.zh: 用你本机已登录的 AtomGit 免费额度，请 AtomCode 给代码做一次独立代码审查：模型通过`atomcode_ask` 工具自主调用审查；你也可以使用`/atomcode-review`命令，一键评审未提交改动 / 分支 / PR。本插件不读取 API key；输入框下方有用量胶囊显示 CodingPlan 额度。

description.en: Session usage dashboard: day/hour/minute token and request statistics, a 26-week activity heatmap, cache-hit-rate curve, per-model donut and list, and a settings page; it appends its cost item after the official session bottom bar (per-turn cost chips included, no separate detail button), renders the official cache-hit-rate number with two decimals, and estimates costs from multi-condition, time-segmented pricing rules. Re-implemented from HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel with extensions.
description.zh: 会话用量统计面板:天/小时/分钟三粒度 token 与请求统计、26 周活跃热力图、缓存命中率曲线、模型 donut 与列表、设置页;在官方会话底栏胶囊之后追加费用项(含回合费用芯片,不另建明细按钮),把官方缓存命中率数字渲染为两位小数,并按多条件分时段定价规则估算费用。复刻自 HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel 并扩展。

description.en: Keeps DSH session titles in DATE | CATEGORY | NAME with turn-aware auto-retitle, title-language control, a settings page, and hover duration/cost/token stats.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话标题固定为「日期 | 分类 | 名称」，支持自动重算、标题语言、设置页，以及悬停查看耗时/估算成本/token。

description.en: Cache-hit metrics, request-prefix risk confirmation, and per-step cache-miss diagnostics for DSH.
description.zh: 展示缓存命中、发送前确认请求前缀风险，并按调用步骤定位缓存失效。

description.en: Browse, enable, disable, and manage Agent Skills from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, and custom directories in the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中浏览、启用、停用和管理来自 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Gemini 及自定义目录的 Agent Skills。

description.en: Displays account quotas, Git state, context usage, public API reference costs, Subagent activity, and streaming speed in DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 显示账户额度、Git 状态、上下文、公开 API 参考费用、Subagents 活动和生成速度。

description.en: Agent-facing plugin installer that resolves DSH-compatible versions, handles ambiguous names, and verifies the loader entry after install.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的插件安装器：解析 DSH 兼容版本、处理同名歧义，并在安装后校验 loader 入口。

description.en: Always-on-top capybara task reporter for DSH Web — a transparent floating pet that narrates each trajectory step in a speech bubble, names the project it reports for, and alerts you when a task completes while you work elsewhere.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 打造的永远置顶的水豚任务播报宠物——透明悬浮气泡逐条播报运行轨迹、标明所属项目，任务完成时提醒正在别处忙碌的你。

description.en: 🌌 Mebular · shared memory and task collaboration for agents. Through a DSH-native plugin, it provides cross-device, cross-agent memory sharing and task-graph capabilities — so physical devices are no longer the boundary of your agents. Secure, controllable, and decentralized! The plugin attaches to an existing Mebular app or CLI runtime; when none exists, the panel installs the shared runtime on demand, and it never starts or downloads Mebular silently.
description.zh: 🌌 Mebular 忆云 · 智能体共享记忆与任务协作。通过 DSH 原生插件接入，提供跨设备、跨 Agent 记忆共享与任务图功能，让物理设备不再是你智能体的边界，安全、可控、去中心化！插件连接已有的 Mebular App/CLI 运行时；没有时可在面板里按提示安装共享运行时，不会静默启动或下载 Mebular。

description.en: A liquid glass UI plugin for the DSH desktop app. Works alongside most wallpaper plugins. Currently supports dark mode only.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 桌面端的液态玻璃 UI 美化插件，可与大部分壁纸插件联动使用，目前仅适配深色模式。

description.en: Per-conversation tool kits for DeepSeek Harness: pick one kit and only its tools reach the model, with three bases (All, built-in only, or a saved kit), add-ons for one-off combinations, and a token ledger estimating what the kit saves.
description.zh: 给每个对话选一套工具（套装），只把用得上的工具投给模型：三档底座（全部 / 仅内置 / 我的套装）、一次性加挂、token 账本估算省下的开销，并可在设置里指定新对话的默认套装。

description.en: dsh-lint-loop v0.7.0 adds bounded, read-only evidence checks for observable shell/bash/pwsh and file-tool changes; uncertain evidence remains incomplete. [Release](https://github.com/lemonxiny55/dsh-lint-loop/releases/tag/v0.7.0).
description.zh: dsh-lint-loop v0.7.0 通过有界、只读检查点追踪 shell/bash/pwsh 与文件工具产生的可观察变更；证据归因不确定或不足时保留为 incomplete。[正式 Release](https://github.com/lemonxiny55/dsh-lint-loop/releases/tag/v0.7.0)。

description.en: Pinned-version REA for DeepSeek Harness: installs rea-agents locally, starts its MCP server from that pinned copy, and upgrades only when you press Update.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 固定版本的 REA：把 rea-agents 安装到当前配置档的一个确切版本，从该副本启动其 MCP 服务，只有按下「更新」才升级。

description.en: Model-driven tool-result archiving for DeepSeek Harness. Results above a configurable size carry a short inline id (\[#a1b2c3d4]); the model archives the ones it no longer needs into the session's own archives/ folder and the context keeps a small recoverable stub with the file path. Originals stay in the append-only session log, so nothing is lost. Ships a settings panel with per-size-bucket recovery stats, thresholds that apply without restart, and a conditional reminder when results are waiting to be archived. Requires dsh-better-sidebar for the statistics panel.
description.zh: 模型驱动的工具结果归档插件。超过阈值的结果会带一个短内联编号（\[#a1b2c3d4]），模型把不再需要的 结果归档进会话自己的 archives/ 目录，上下文里只留一个可回捞的小存根（含文件路径）。原文同时保留在 只增的会话日志中，不会丢失。附带设置面板：按大小分桶的回收统计、改完立即生效的阈值、以及有待归档 结果时的条件提醒。统计面板需 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Automatic approval and audit frame for DSH tool calls: a four-outcome rule table (deny, ask, AI review, allow) over commands, file access, network and tool scope, with security rules, rule-based auto-approve/auto-deny, AI fast/deep review, human approval, permission tiers, workspace boundaries, secret redaction and placeholder restore, a hash-chained audit trail and a simulator. Target files are inspected by metadata only.
description.zh: DSH 工具调用的自动审批（自动审核）与审计框架：四档规则表（拒绝／问人／AI 评审／放行）对命令审批、文件读写、网络访问与工具调用逐条拦截，能按规则自动放行或自动拒绝，疑难项交给 AI 审查或人工审批／授权；带权限档、工作区边界、敏感信息脱敏、秘密占位符回填、哈希链审计日志与台账、模拟审批设置页。目标文件只查元数据。

description.en: One settings page for every MCP server on your machine. It reads the real config file of 17 other AI tools (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, OpenCode, Trae, Trae CN, Qoder, Gemini CLI, Qwen, Zed, Roo Code, Copilot CLI, Kiro, CodeBuddy, Continue) plus DeepSeek Harness itself, groups servers by the file that declares them, probes each one over JSON-RPC to see whether it starts and which tools it exposes, and gives every server a switch that mounts or unmounts it in DeepSeek Harness without editing the other tools' own files.
description.zh: 一个设置页管理本机所有 MCP 服务器。它读取另外 17 种 AI 工具的真实配置文件（Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code、Windsurf、OpenCode、Trae、Trae CN、Qoder、Gemini CLI、Qwen、Zed、Roo Code、Copilot CLI、Kiro、CodeBuddy、Continue）以及 DeepSeek Harness 自身，按声明它的文件分组展示，对每个服务器做一次真连 JSON-RPC 探活，看它能否启动、暴露了哪些工具，并给每个服务器一个开关，把它挂载进或卸载出 DeepSeek Harness —— 全程不改动其他工具自己的配置文件。

description.en: Sidebar Git panel for the DSH web GUI: Local Changes and All Commits views, branch, tag and stash management with fetch, pull and push dialogs, merge with conflict handling, and a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar.
description.zh: DSH 网页端的侧栏 Git 面板：Local Changes 与 All Commits 视图，分支、标签与 Stash 管理，fetch、pull、push 弹窗，带冲突处理的合并，以及输入框上的 zsh 风格分支标记。

description.en: QQ Official Bot adapter for C2C single chat, interactive action boards, workspace session management, and real-time Web UI sync.
description.zh: QQ 官方单聊机器人适配器：支持交互操作板、工作区会话管理与 Web UI 实时双向同屏。

description.en: Fortune-telling toolkit: bazi, ziwei doushu, meihua yijing, liuyao (six-line coin oracle with najia), almanac, chenggu bone-weight, zodiac, date selection, qimen dunjia, fengshui, name scoring, compatibility, numerology, a life K-line chart, tarot and xiaoliuren — 16 tools whose ganzhi, stars, hexagrams and bone weights are all computed by deterministic local engines, with the model only interpreting results. Supports solar and lunar dates with leap months, China DST and true solar time correction, plus a ten-page read-only side panel.
description.zh: 玄学算命插件：八字、紫微斗数、梅花易数、六爻纳甲、黄历、称骨、星座、择日、奇门遁甲、风水、起名、合婚、生命数字、人生K线、塔罗、小六壬共 16 个工具，干支、星曜、卦象、骨重全部由本地确定性引擎计算，模型只负责解读；支持公历/农历（含闰月）输入，自动校正中国夏令时与真太阳时，附带十页只读侧栏面板。

description.en: Adds a model route where a Lead plans and reviews while a Sidekick performs code changes.
description.zh: 提供由 Lead 规划与审查、Sidekick 执行代码修改的组合模型线路。

description.en: Checks a bid evaluation scoring matrix for internal arithmetic consistency: that each factor's maximum, the scores recorded and the total agree with each other. Reports the differences it finds; it does not judge whether the evaluation itself was correct or fair.
description.zh: 核对评标因素评分矩阵的内部算术自洽性：各因素分值上限、所记分值与合计之间是否互相一致。只报告发现的差异，不评价评标本身是否正确或公正。

description.en: Forces a todo list at the start of every turn and rewrites it in full each time, so finished items stay listed instead of being replaced. The floating ball shows the complete history, including plans that were lost when you cut in mid-turn, so what got done and what got dropped is always clear. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 强制每个 turn 先写 todo 清单并整表覆盖式重写，已完成项保留不删。悬浮球可看完整历史，含被插话打断后丢失的安排，干了什么、什么没干一目了然。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Plugin center for DeepSeek Harness: installed-plugin metadata, a community market with stars and versions, one-click install and update, and a What's New dialog.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件中心：已安装插件信息、带星标与版本号的社区市场、一键安装与更新，以及启动时的更新日志弹窗。

description.en: Git service plus right-sidebar UI — a Changes tab (stage/unstage, per-file diffs, commit/amend, push and rebase-then-push sync, confirmed discard), a paged canvas commit-graph tab, a Worktrees tab to list, enter and create checkouts, a composer branch selector, and opt-in LLM commit-message generation.
description.zh: Git 服务 + 右侧边栏 UI：Changes 页（暂存/取消暂存、逐文件 diff、提交/修补、推送与 rebase 同步、二次确认的丢弃）、分页 canvas 提交图谱页、Worktrees 页（列出/进入/新建工作树）、输入框旁分支选择器，以及可选的 LLM 提交信息生成。

description.en: GitHub project search and analysis: describe your idea in one sentence and the agent searches GitHub for related projects, ranks them by relevance weighted with stars, and returns a structured card — last updated, relevance, stars, weighted score, language and a one-line description for each project. Pick a few repositories and it reads their README, dependency manifest, directory tree and key files to lay out their architecture — so you stand on the shoulders of giants before you start building.
description.zh: GitHub 项目检索与解析工具：一句话输入开发想法，agent 在 GitHub 搜索相关项目，按相关性与 star 加权排序后返回一张结构化的卡片（包括各项目的更新时间、相关性分数、star数、加权后得分、使用的开发语言、一句话简介）。选择几个仓库后，它还能直接读取这些项目的 README、依赖清单、目录树和关键文件等，梳理它们的架构。让你在动手开发前，先“站在巨人的肩膀上”。

description.en: Publishes the DSH Web GUI to LAN or internet with dsh kept on loopback. Every source must sign in for an HMAC session cookie unless passwordless LAN is opted into. Adds self-signed or custom TLS, a secureCookies override for plaintext-HTTP proxies, and a UUID shim for plain-HTTP origins.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 发布到局域网/公网，dsh 仍只绑定回环。除显式开启局域网免密外，所有来源均须登录换取 HMAC 会话 Cookie。提供自签名或自定义 TLS、用于明文 HTTP 代理的 secureCookies 覆盖项，以及让局域网纯 HTTP 来源正常打开工作区的 UUID shim。

description.en: MCP server manager (stdio / streamable-http): per-working-directory project and global config tiers; project-level MCP collapsed into 4 atomic tools through a middleware layer by default (`middleware: all` folds in global servers too, hot-switchable in the settings page); workspace isolation prevents cross-project interference; configs keep `${ENV}` references only, with no plaintext secrets on disk; runtime registration API for other plugins to inject MCP servers.
description.zh: MCP 服务器管理器（stdio / streamable-http）：按工作目录分项目级/全局两级配置；项目级 MCP 默认经中间层收敛为 4 个原子工具（`middleware: all` 连同全局服务器一并收敛，设置页热切换）；工作空间隔离防串台；配置只存 `${ENV}` 引用、不落盘明文密钥；提供运行时注册接口供其他插件注入 MCP。

description.en: A VRM 3D desktop pet with task-state animations, a floating desktop window, body-part interactions, and optional AI chatter.
description.zh: 支持任务状态联动动画、独立悬浮窗、部位互动和可选 AI 碎碎念的 VRM 3D 桌宠。

description.en: Ctrl+wheel page zoom (60–180%, remembered) for the whole DSH UI, plus a bottom-right Settings entry that opens the host settings panel, with Ctrl+0 to reset.
description.zh: Ctrl+滚轮整页缩放（60%–180%，记住比例），右下角常驻「设置」入口可打开宿主设置面板，Ctrl+0 复位。

description.en: Beyond the built-in @: line ranges (@src/a.ts:12-40), skills, plugins and any git repo — with the token cost of each reference shown before you send.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内置 @ 引用之上扩展：精确到行的行区间（@src/a.ts:12-40）、Skill、插件与任意 git 仓库，并在发送前显示每条引用的 token 成本。

description.en: Local library panel for DSH: indexes files and artifacts into a searchable card tree with PDF, Office and image preview, plus paper search across arXiv/OpenAlex/Crossref and others, web-page archiving to markdown snapshots, a plugin-market tab, and one-click switching for resources found in installed plugins (personas, meme packs, whale widget assets). Ships 18 tools and 22 host routes.
description.zh: DSH 的本地资料馆：把本机文件与产物索引成可搜索的卡片树，支持 PDF / Office / 图片预览，另带论文检索（arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref 等）、把网页存成 markdown 快照、插件市场标签页，以及已装插件资源的同步与一键切换（人设、表情包图集、鲸鱼挂件素材）。包含 18 个工具与 22 条宿主路由。

description.en: Settings card for the DSH LLM auto-retry engine: tune retry count, backoff and jitter live from Settings -> General, with configurable retryableCodes chips - defaults add INVALID_REQUEST so OpenAI-style HTTP 400 reasoning_text errors in thinking mode get retried automatically.
description.zh: LLM 自动重试设置卡片：在设置页实时调整重试次数、退避与抖动，并可勾选额外可重试错误码（retryableCodes）—— 默认补入 INVALID_REQUEST，OpenAI thinking 模式 HTTP 400 reasoning_text 报错开箱即自动重试。

description.en: Edit the global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md rules from the web settings panel, live on save.
description.zh: 在设置面板中编辑 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 全局规则，保存后实时生效。

description.en: Read-only panel reporting an instance's plugin bundles, patch inserts, skills, upgrade health and decoupling health.
description.zh: 只读生态面板：汇总实例的插件束、补丁插入、技能、升级健康与解耦健康。

description.en: Conversation navigation with full-history turns, collapsible process steps, final-result and structured question-and-answer keys, and pointer-following piano interaction.
description.zh: 提供完整历史轮次导航、过程步骤折叠、最终结果与结构化问答琴键，以及鼠标连续跟随交互。

description.en: Connects the Google Stitch MCP endpoint as 16 native `mcp__stitch__*` tools for projects, screens and design systems, plus an in-panel card for an API key or OAuth access token.
description.zh: 把 Google Stitch 的 MCP 端点接成 16 个原生 `mcp__stitch__*` 工具，覆盖项目、界面与设计系统，并附一张面板内的 API Key / OAuth 令牌凭据卡片。

description.en: A document generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: JSON is the core output, structurally managing document content; unifies parameter definition and inheritance, material extraction, validation checking, and scoring across document generation, keeping output on-target, fast, and token-efficient; ships a built-in COSMIC scenario pack as a worked example plus a built-in guide for authoring new scenario packs.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的文档生成插件：以 JSON 为核心输出物，结构化管理文档内容输出；统一规范文档生成过程中的参数定义与继承、素材提取、校验结果检查及评分机制，使文档生成紧扣要求，快速且节约 Token；内置 COSMIC 文档生成场景包作为范例，并内置编写场景包的指南。

description.en: Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and a browser shield status light. Alarm-only, never an enforcer.
description.zh: DSH 插件信任流水线：确定性静态扫描判定、可选运行时守卫与蜜罐诱饵、agent 审查协议技能与浏览器盾牌状态灯，只报警不执法。

description.en: CRT idle screensaver for DSH pages: when no session is running and the page has seen no mouse or keyboard input for ten minutes (configurable), a retro CRT plate covers the window with scanlines and a looping inversion sweep. An in-window click or key press dismisses it, the wheel only locks scrolling, and the whole frame drifts slightly after the cursor; rendering is fully GPU-composited frame by frame. An adaptation of justawebsite/dsh-splash-crt (MIT), turned from a boot splash into an idle screensaver.
description.zh: DSH 待机显像管屏保：没有会话在运行、且页面上十分钟（可调）没有鼠标键盘输入时，盖上一块带扫描线与循环反色扫掠的 CRT 板；窗口内点一下或按个键即消失，滚轮只锁滚动，画面随指针轻微视差偏移，逐帧全 GPU 合成。改自 justawebsite/dsh-splash-crt（MIT），把开屏动画改成待机屏保。

description.en: Search the documents and pictures in your Quberi knowledge base, browse its spaces and documents, save notes to it, and upload files into it with your approval for each one, from DeepSeek Harness over OAuth.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内通过 OAuth 检索你的 Quberi 知识库中的文档和图片，浏览空间和文档，保存笔记，并上传文件（每个文件都需你确认）。

description.en: Dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code or Codex: native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge for vision and image generation.
description.zh: 从 Claude Code / Codex 派发任务给 DSH Agent：原生子代理进度、按能力分层预设的宿主内工作会话，以及为纯文本 Harness 提供视觉与图像生成的多模态桥。

description.en: Adds cross-workspace pinned and recent session sections to the DSH sidebar, with status indicators and display settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏跨工作区汇总置顶与最近会话，提供状态标记和显示设置。

description.en: Claude Code-style prompt history, double-Esc picker, selection quote/copy & right-click paste.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格上下键历史回溯、双击 Esc 历史搜索、选中文本引用/自动复制与鼠标右键直接粘贴。

description.en: Sentry for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Sentry MCP server, a result card, and an issue panel with resolve, ignore and assign.
description.zh: 把 Sentry 接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 Sentry MCP 服务器的工具、结果卡片，以及可解决、忽略与指派的问题面板。

description.en: Permission guard for DSH: four scopes with read/write/execute bits in the native permission menu, plus an optional Jev semantic classifier for bash commands.
description.zh: DSH 权限守卫：原生权限菜单里的四范围读写执行权限位，bash 命令可选 Jev 语义分类层。

description.en: Export a whole working DSH home — profile, installed plugins with their node_modules, skills, hooks and task boards — into one .dshpkg tar and import it on another machine without network or pnpm; also streams over HTTP or a one-shot LAN link.
description.zh: 把整套可用的 DSH 主目录——profile、带 node_modules 的已装插件、技能、hooks 与任务板——打包成单个 .dshpkg，在另一台机器上免联网、免 pnpm 还原；也支持 HTTP 上传与一次性局域网链接。

description.en: Turns explicit DSH session experience into reviewable native Skill drafts that are saved only after user approval.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话中明确表达的经验整理为可审核的原生 Skill 草稿，并仅在用户确认后保存。

description.en: Shows API-key and subscription quota limits in the DSH provider interface and settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面与设置中显示 API Key 和订阅账户的额度限制。

description.en: Select text in a committed DSH response to open an independent, persistent, read-only multi-turn Topic bound to source-session evidence and project files while the source Agent keeps running.
description.zh: 选中 DSH 已提交回复中的文字，开启独立、持久、只读的多轮 Topic；Topic 绑定来源会话证据与项目文件，来源 Agent 可继续运行。

description.en: Aggregated status badges on collapsed sidebar groups in DSH: a folded folder row shows in-progress / awaiting-approval / done / scheduled / review-pending counts, with numbers and hover detail. (sidebar badge / group status / aggregate)
description.zh: DSH 侧栏折叠分组聚合徽标：收起的文件夹行显示进行中/待审批/已完成/定时任务/等待评审的聚合状态，带数字与悬停明细。（侧栏徽标 / 分组状态 / 聚合）

description.en: Strips the harness-injected prefix and suffix system prompts so the agent runs on the preset's native prompt alone, for soft-jailbreak catgirl persona simulation: ships a bundled plugin that idempotently deploys the 猫娘 Yuike preset to ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/yuike/ and never overwrites an edited preset.
description.zh: 通过自带插件去除 harness 前置与后置注入提示词，仅使用预设原生提示词运行，实现软破限与猫娘人格模拟：将猫娘 Yuike 预设幂等部署到 ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/yuike/，不覆盖已编辑的预设。

description.en: Editable prompt shortcuts beside the DSH composer: save the prompts and phrases you retype as buttons, then send the preset text or insert it into the draft, and reorder, move, or resize them. Text-only: runs no host commands and never overwrites an existing draft; a button can also read the previous message, the draft, or the selection when clicked, and ask you to fill in {{name}} slots before it runs.
description.zh: DSH 输入框旁的可编辑提示词快捷按钮：把反复重打的提示词、常用语存成按钮，点一下发送预设文字或只填入草稿；可排序、换位置、调大小。纯文字动作，不执行宿主命令；有草稿时不覆盖；按钮还能在点击时现读上一条消息、当前草稿或选区，带 {{名字}} 的会先让你填再执行。

description.en: Translates user prompts before sending and translates model reasoning and replies back into the user's language via translation APIs or configured DSH models, with independent content toggles and a composer menu.
description.zh: 通过翻译 API 或 DSH 已配置的模型，在发送前翻译用户提示词，并将模型思考文本和回答译回用户语言，提供独立内容开关和输入框快捷菜单。

description.en: Qingxiao (Wuthering Waves) themed skin for the DSH web GUI, with ice-blue/jade/moon-white palette, sword-light motes and user-swappable backgrounds.
description.zh: 以《鸣潮》清宵为主题的 DSH Web 界面皮肤，冰蓝·青碧·月白配色，含剑气流光与可更换背景。

description.en: Auto thinking-effort routing for dsh: a locally fine-tuned 7-question classifier (ModernBERT, 842MB, <1s CPU inference) picks low/high/max for no-intent messages; in-session retries escalate the tier (low to high to max) under exclusion constraints; the judge service fails safe to low if unreachable. A tier chip in the input bar shows the live tier and the last 20 judgments. All inference is local - task text never leaves the machine.
