description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动思考档位路由：本地微调的 7 题分类模型（ModernBERT，842MB，CPU 推理 <1s）对无档位指令的消息自动选择 low/high/max；会话内检测到重试自动沿阶梯升档，受「别用 max」类排除约束压制；判定服务不可达时熔断降级，会话不断。前端档位芯片实时显示当前档位与最近 20 轮判断原因。判定全程本地推理，任务文本不出本机。

description.en: Topic grouping layered over the native workspace list: emoji folder groups, filtering and search, batch archive, and safe permanent deletion.
description.zh: 在原生工作区列表之上叠加主题分组：emoji 分组文件夹、筛选与搜索、批量归档，以及带安全边界的永久删除。

description.en: Aggregates all local Trae accounts into one auto-failover model provider, with manual and automated daily check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, and a model selection settings card.
description.zh: 把本机多个 Trae 账号聚合成一个自动容错换号的模型供应商，附带手动与自动签到、积分与到期监控，以及模型配置设置卡片。

description.en: Configures provider and model reasoning-effort mappings for DeepSeek Harness, with a grouped model picker and composer slider.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 配置 Provider 与模型的推理强度映射，并提供按 Provider 分组的模型选择器和输入框滑块。

description.en: Lets the model turn an answer into a web page that lives right inside the chat. The show_page tool either fills one of 8 built-in templates (report, compare, checklist, dashboard, timeline, flashcards, quiz, flow), where the model writes only the content and the plugin does layout, interaction and saving, or saves a full page the model wrote itself (calculators, games, custom layouts). Hand-written pages get the same design as base styles inside a CSS @layer, so the page's own CSS still wins. The page appears under the reply at its content height, interactive and following DSH's light/dark theme. The page's localStorage is stored in DSH per page, so what users tick or type survives reopening and new versions, and the same page open in the chat and the right sidebar stays in sync. Each edit is saved as a new version you can flip back to. After saving, the page is checked in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (script errors, horizontal overflow, dark mode not applied) and problems go back to the model. The right sidebar shows the page full-size with versions, a gallery of all pages and export to PNG, PDF or HTML. Pages run in a sandboxed, separate-origin frame with a strict CSP: no access to DSH data and no fetch, XHR or WebSocket. Works on phones with dsh-mobile.
description.zh: 让模型把回答做成一页网页，直接放在对话里。show_page 工具可以套 8 种内置模板（报告、对比、清单、数据看板、时间线、学习卡片、测验、流程图），模型只写内容，排版、交互和保存由插件做；也可以存模型自己写的整页（计算器、小游戏、特别的版式）。自己写的页面也套上同一套设计，放在 CSS @layer 里，页面自己的样式照样盖得过它。页面按内容高度嵌在回复下面，能点能用，深浅色跟着 DSH 走。页面里的 localStorage 按页面存在 DSH 里，勾过、填过的东西重开、改出新版本都还在；同一页同时开在对话里和右侧栏，两边实时同步。改一次存一版，旧版能翻。存好后在本机一个看不见的 Chrome / Edge 里体检（脚本报错、横向溢出、深色没跟上），问题交回模型改。右侧栏看整页、翻版本、看所有做过的页面，导出 PNG / PDF / HTML。页面跑在不同源的沙箱框里，CSP 很严：读不到 DSH 的数据，也不能联网取数据。配合 dsh-mobile 手机上也能用。

description.en: Predicts your next message after each completed turn and shows it as ghost text in the composer: press → to accept, or keep typing and finish it word by word with Ctrl+→, Esc to dismiss. The prediction model follows the session by default or can be picked in the settings card, which also has an on/off switch and a speed test.
description.zh: 每轮对话结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色幽灵文字显示在输入框里：按 → 接受，也可以直接开始打字、用 Ctrl+→ 逐词补齐，Esc 关闭。预测模型默认跟随当前会话，也能在设置卡片里指定；卡片里还有总开关和测速。

description.en: Sends a VS Code selection or file path into the open DSH conversation as an @path reference with its line range, inserted at the composer without sending it. Requires the companion VS Code extension shipped as a .vsix inside the bundle (one-click install from the composer, or install it by hand).
description.zh: 把 VS Code 的选区或文件路径以 @路径（含行号范围）插入当前 DSH 对话的输入框，不自动发送；需安装随包附带的 VS Code 扩展（.vsix，可在输入框一键安装或手动安装）。

description.en: WEB ONLY: designed specifically for the Web profile, NOT Electron Desktop. Windows support means Web on Windows, not the Desktop application; installing into Desktop can break startup or restart. Refresh immediately after installation or open /login; HTTP 401 on an old page means sign-in is required, not installation failure. Only an uninitialized data directory displays the temporary password; existing passwords survive reinstalling. Initialize in a trusted network and change the publicly displayed initial password immediately; passwords are never printed in terminal logs. Web lock screen, password/OTP/Passkey, persistent sessions and wallpapers; Windows Web power services can be enabled from the page. Linux/macOS need the bundled controller; npm updates require a dedicated managed install. Stopping interrupts active tasks. Auth kernel adapted from xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway (MIT); do not co-install.
description.zh: 【仅支持 Web，不支持 Electron Desktop】专为 Web profile 设计；Windows 支持仅指 Windows 上的 Web 版，不是桌面应用。请勿安装到 Desktop profile，误装可能导致启动或重启失败。安装后立即刷新页面或打开 /login，旧页 401 不代表安装失败。仅未初始化的数据目录展示临时初始密码；已有密码不会因重装而清空或再次展示。首次密码在页面公开展示，终端不打印，请在受控网络立即改密。提供 Web 锁屏、密码／OTP／Passkey、持久登录和壁纸，Windows Web 支持页面一键配置电源服务。Linux/macOS 需部署独立控制服务；npm 更新限独立托管安装，停止会中断运行任务。认证内核改编自 xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway（MIT），不能与其同装。

description.en: Manages the MCP servers of a DeepSeek Harness profile: lists each server with its connection state and the tools it registers, preflights a configuration before saving it (a missing executable, an npm package name used as a command, an unexpanded variable that would reach the child literally, a URL with no path), and adds servers by pasting a dsh patch fragment or a Claude Code mcpServers block, converted to the dsh shape.
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness profile 的 MCP 服务：列出每个服务的连接状态与它注册的工具；保存前预检配置（可执行文件缺失、把包名当命令、变量未展开、URL 缺少路径）；粘贴 dsh 配置片段或 Claude Code 的 mcpServers 块即可新增，并自动转换为 dsh 格式。

description.en: Drive DSH from anything that speaks HTTP: 47 routes (REST + SSE) for workspaces, sessions (create/prompt, live SSE generation, history, stats, todos, cancel, ask-user Q&A), models and the global default model, providers, agent presets, settings namespaces, skills, and workspace files including resumable chunked upload — plus an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions, a built-in OpenAPI 3.0 spec and an interactive request page. It only injects the host webServer and tools, so it rides on the DSH webserver (default prefix /api/v1) or its own port with optional API-key auth, and it ships a skill that teaches the DSH agent to call the API.
description.zh: 让任何会说 HTTP 的东西驱动 DSH：47 条路由（REST + SSE），覆盖工作区、会话（创建/提示、SSE 实时生成、历史、统计、任务清单、中止、问答）、模型与全局默认模型、提供方、Agent Preset、设置命名空间、技能与工作区文件（含分片续传上传），另有 OpenAI 兼容的 /chat/completions、内置 OpenAPI 3.0 规范与在线调试页。它只 inject 宿主的 webServer 与 tools，挂在宿主 webserver（默认前缀 /api/v1）或独立端口，可选 API Key 鉴权，并自带一份教会 DSH 里 Agent 调用本 API 的 SKILL。

description.en: One Settings page for every DeepSeek Harness session: browse active and archived sessions by workspace, generate a title from the whole conversation for live or archived sessions, archive or restore, move a cold session to another workspace, and permanently delete an archived session (with its subagent descendants after confirmation).
description.zh: 在设置里管理全部 DeepSeek Harness 会话：按工作区分组浏览活跃与已归档会话，为活跃或已归档会话按整段对话生成标题，归档/恢复，把冷会话移动到其他工作区，并在确认后彻底删除已归档会话（含其子代理会话）。

description.en: A plugin for dsh: monitor the resource utilization of dsh system processes, and report the results to the user in the form of charts.
description.zh: 监控dsh进程及其派生子进程的资源占用,并以面板图表报告整机与各会话的CPU与内存占用

description.en: Bounded local memory with CBDC authority gating: SQLite + FTS5 claims, scoped recall with explainable use/verify/ignore decisions and a full audit trail, /memory commands, ≤3-claim/1200-char injection per call, no extra model call.
description.zh: 有界本地记忆 + CBDC 权威门控：SQLite + FTS5 claims，作用域召回并给出可解释的采用/核验/忽略决策与完整审计轨迹，/memory 命令，每次注入 ≤3 条/1200 字符，不增加额外模型调用。

description.en: Named subagent roster: manage role entries (model, persona, tool filter, depth, background mode) from a hot-reloaded settings page; the model picks one with list_subagents and dispatches by id with delegate — foreground, background, or continuable.
description.zh: 具名子代理名册：设置页可视化维护角色条目（模型、persona、工具过滤、深度、后台模式），热生效；模型用 list_subagents 选人、delegate 按 id 派活，支持前台、后台与可续聊。

description.en: Local Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: branch search and switching, hunk-level staging, commit graph, file history and blame, stash and worktree management, conflict resolution, and eight git tools for the agent.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地 Git 工作台：分支搜索与切换、hunk 级暂存、提交图谱、文件历史与 blame、储藏与工作树管理、冲突处理，以及 8 个供 agent 使用的 Git 工具。

description.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with native identities based on the open Agent Network Protocol (ANP), plus identity-based direct, group, mail, and Agent-to-Agent communication.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供基于开放协议ANP的原生身份，以及基于该身份的私聊、群聊、邮件和智能体间通信能力。

description.en: Pins passages selected in a conversation into a per-conversation right-sidebar panel, marks them in the transcript, jumps back to the source passage on click, and quotes a pinned passage into the composer from the selection toolbar or by typing @; the panel tags, searches, filters and exports the pins as a Markdown outline.
description.zh: 把对话中划选的段落固定到按对话隔离的右侧栏面板，在正文里留下持久标记并可点击跳回原文；可从划选浮条或输入框 @ 把已固定的段落引用进消息，片段支持标签，面板可搜索、筛选并导出 Markdown 提纲。

description.en: Shared interactive terminal: the AI terminal tool and the official sidebar xterm drive the same session shell, so you can type and watch the live screen.
description.zh: 共享交互式终端：AI terminal 单工具与官方侧栏 xterm 共用 Session shell，用户可输入并查看当前屏幕。

description.en: Personal cross-session memory in local SQLite, with automatic conversation learning, companion states, and optional semantic retrieval. Currently intended for single-user local use on Windows.
description.zh: 大肥鱼饲养手册：基于本地 SQLite 的个人跨会话记忆，支持对话自动学习、伙伴状态与可选语义检索，目前面向 Windows 单人本地使用。

description.en: Pre-execution safety valve for DSH that judges with TypeSafe Jev: it hooks tools/pre-execute and decides every bash/pwsh call by first applying offline static rules, then by asking the Jev model — the System One model from TypeSafe, which returns a structured decision instead of prose — one yes-no question ("will this command irreversibly delete or overwrite real data?"), turning the answer into allow, revise, block or escalate; revise hands the model a safer rewrite, escalate offers a one-shot human token; exhausted credit or a missing API key degrades loudly instead of failing silent, and a missing key is requested in the conversation itself (`guard key set`, read from stdin); every verdict is appended to a shared audit log and the text people read is bilingual zh-CN/en.
description.zh: DSH 执行前安全阀门，用 TypeSafe Jev 模型做判定：挂载 tools/pre-execute，对每条 bash/pwsh 调用先过离线静态规则，再向 Jev 模型（TypeSafe 的 System One 模型，返回结构化判定而非散文）提一个是非问句——「这条命令会不可逆地删除或覆盖真实数据吗？」——把答案切成允许／修正／拦截／上报人工四态；修正给模型更安全的写法，上报提供一次性人工令牌；额度耗尽或没有可用密钥时大声降级而非静默失效，缺密钥时会直接在对话里要求录入（录入用 `guard key set`，只从标准输入读）；每条判定写入共享审计日志，面向人的文案中英双语。

description.en: Rice on a Stick: Expose control over DeepSeek Harness (dsh) through MCP (Streamable HTTP) and dsh's native tools, with a configurable list of allowed models. Long-tail host endpoints can be invoked via a generic, audited bridge. By default, it listens only on 127.0.0.1, with an optional access token.
description.zh: 白饭钓竿：把控制 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的能力通过 MCP（Streamable HTTP）与 dsh 原生工具暴露出去， 可配置允许使用的模型清单。可通过带审计的通用桥调用宿主长尾端点。默认只监听 127.0.0.1，可选访问令牌。

description.en: Expert roster for DeepSeek Harness: 636 experts across 22 divisions with full Chinese names and bios, summoned as subagents from the @ menu or by the model through list_t_experts / summon_t_expert / summon_t_experts, plus custom experts and a skill on/off switch.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的专家名册：22 个分类、636 位专家，中文名与简介全量覆盖；从 @ 菜单或由模型经 list_t_experts / summon_t_expert / summon_t_experts 三个工具召唤为子代理，另可自建专家，并带一个技能开关。

description.en: Adds two enhancements to DSH ask_user_question choice cards: right-clicking an option expands a per-option note that is merged into the submitted custom answer, and a footer field asks a side question answered by a fork subagent from the session context, read-only, with no write-back. Keeps left-click, skip, paging and the countdown working as before, and only claims generic choice cards, not plan review or approval cards. Supports DSH 0.2.x from 0.2.0-rc.1 (verified on 0.2.2-rc.1) and Node.js 20+. Derived from buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note (MIT) and inspired by MichengAI/dsh-btw (Apache-2.0); do not install it together with dsh-question-note — both take over the same ask_user_question card.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的 ask_user_question 选择题卡片增加两项能力：右键选项展开补充说明，并合并进提交的 custom 答案；卡片底部可以先问一句，由 fork 子代理带着当前会话上下文只读作答，不改写会话。左键选择、跳过、分页与倒计时照旧，且只接管普通选择题卡片，不接管计划确认与审批卡片。适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上的 0.2.x（已在 0.2.2-rc.1 验证），需 Node.js 20+。由 buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note（MIT）派生、并受 MichengAI/dsh-btw（Apache-2.0）启发；不要与 dsh-question-note 同装——两者会接管同一张 ask_user_question 卡片。

description.en: Session board in the left sidebar: every chat session's current work, todos and progress, with a searchable overview heatmap and one-click navigation back to the session.
description.zh: 在左侧栏提供会话看板：集中展示每个会话的当前工作、待办与进度，附带可搜索的概览热力图，点击卡片即可跳回会话。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a server-grade multi-tenant platform: remote access + auto HTTPS, subuser permissions & token/daily quotas, sandbox enforcement, encrypted auth & audit log.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 变成服务器级多租户平台：远程访问 + 自动 HTTPS、子用户权限与配额、沙盒强制、加密认证与审计日志。

description.en: Adds an optimize button beside the composer that analyzes and rewrites the prompt draft with SSE streaming, conversation-context awareness (template vs intent-polish strategies), an edit-continuity memory chain, undo, and model routing with fallback and a connectivity test.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加「优化」按钮：流式分析并改写提示词草稿，支持会话上下文感知（模板/润色双策略）、跨编辑记忆链与撤回，模型路由带 fallback 与连通性测试。

description.en: Loop guard for DeepSeek Harness: detects and stops repeated output mid-stream, prunes and compacts context, then automatically resumes the task without a restart.
description.zh: 模型死循环防护：自动检测并拦截重复输出，停止循环后恢复任务继续执行，无需重启或手动拉起；支持配置故障中断策略与救援参数。

description.en: Adds edit mode to the DSH settings nav for drag-reordering, per-section show/hide and named collapsible drawer grouping saved in the plugin's own settings namespace, plus pinning up to five sections to the main sidebar for one-click access.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置页导航加编辑模式：拖拽排序、逐个显隐、用命名可折叠抽屉分组，排版存在插件自己的设置命名空间；还能把最多 5 个分区钉到主界面侧栏，一键直达。

description.en: Complementary web-search provider: every web_search merges the DeepSeek Search API (primary) with serper.dev Google results (secondary) at a fixed 2:1 ratio. Both sides are direct HTTP retrievals with no auxiliary model turn: URL-deduped sources, long DeepSeek summaries clipped into snippets, per-backend timeouts and graceful degradation to whichever backend answers.
description.zh: 互补式网页搜索 provider：每次 web_search 由 DeepSeek 官方 Search API（主）与 serper.dev 的 Google 结果（补）按固定 2:1 交错合并。两路均为直连检索、无辅助模型调用；来源按 URL 去重，官方长摘要截断注入，单路超时自动降级到另一路。

description.en: Xueqiu (Snowball) market panel docked above the composer: A-share/HK/US quotes and indices, watchlist, candlestick K-line with volume, MAs and crosshair tooltip, hot list, search, 7x24 news, plus a draggable mini index badge — no login needed.
description.zh: 雪球行情面板：嵌入输入框上方，免登录查看 A股/港美股行情、指数与自选股，K线蜡烛图（成交量/均线/十字光标）、热榜、搜索、7×24 快讯，另有可拖动迷你指数徽章。

description.en: Keeps prompt caches warm for OpenCode Go DeepSeek conversations by predicting each request's cache hit before it is sent, rotating the x-opencode-session routing id when that request would be cold and recent requests are slow, and pooling idle warm ids for reuse by new conversations.
description.zh: 为 OpenCode Go 的 DeepSeek 会话保持提示缓存命中：在请求发出前预测其缓存命中率，当该请求预计变冷且近期请求偏慢时轮换 x-opencode-session 路由 id，并把空闲的暖 id 放入池中供新会话复用。

description.en: A plugin that adds a desktop pet to your DeepSeek Harness, supporting the Codex pet format, you can use hatch-pet or Petdex to add your pets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物：完全支持 Codex 桌宠格式，可使用 hatch-pet Skill 创建宠物，或通过 Petdex 导入宠物。

description.en: Icon, Chinese display name and a one-line note for every DSH plugin, organized with folders, favorites, drag or pinyin ordering, list and grid views. Icons are auto-assigned to all installed plugins and can be overridden; import and export cover icons, names, notes, folders and order. Display-only: plugin files and cordis config are never modified; enable switches call the official plugin manager.
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件换自定义图标、中文显示名和一句话说明；用文件夹与收藏整理，支持拖拽排序、按备注名拼音排序、列表与铺陈两种视图。所有已安装插件自动分配图标（可手动覆盖）；导入导出覆盖图标、备注名、说明、文件夹与排序。只改显示，不修改插件文件与 cordis 配置；启用开关转调官方插件管理器。

description.en: Adds a Delete action to archived Session rows that permanently removes the Session log directory, the log directories of its subagent Sessions, its Workspace membership and archive mark, its projection-cache record and its spill directory; a Session the Host still holds is staged and finished at the next start or from a cleanup dialog. It also sweeps abandoned blank placeholders, leftover subagent Sessions and orphaned projection-cache records, and keeps blank placeholders out of the @ reference list.
description.zh: 在已归档会话的行菜单里加入「删除会话」：永久移除会话日志目录、它启动的子代理会话日志、工作区归属、归档标记、投影缓存记录与 spill 溢出目录；宿主仍持有的会话先登记，下次启动或点「完成待删除清理」时完成。另外会清扫被放弃的空白占位、遗留的孤儿子代理与失效的投影缓存记录，并让空白占位不再出现在 @ 引用列表里。

description.en: Code-first React and TypeScript task apps rendered inline, in Canvas, full screen, or on localhost, with interaction state available to later agent turns and approval-gated MCP and API access.
description.zh: Code-first React + TypeScript 任务应用，支持 Inline、Canvas、全屏与 localhost；交互状态可供 Agent 后续轮次读取，MCP 和 API 访问在用户授权后执行。

description.en: Use DSH from a phone browser. Turn on phone access from the phone button in the session header (or the plugin card) and scan the QR code; the phone opens the official DSH web UI served by the desktop process, with the same sessions updating live, so you can follow a running task, reply and approve away from the computer. A gateway inside DSH (port 18765) proxies the web UI and handles the desktop login itself. One QR code works on Wi-Fi and on mobile data: turning access on also starts a free Cloudflare quick tunnel (cloudflared is downloaded from Cloudflare's GitHub releases if missing), and its address survives DSH restarts, so phones do not need to rescan. Pairing codes are one-time and expire in 10 minutes, each phone gets its own revocable credential, the header button shows when a phone is connected, and idle connections get keepalive pings. Optional push notifications go to Bark, ntfy, ServerChan, Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk group bots, Telegram or any webhook when a task finishes (after 30 seconds or more), stops with an error, or waits for an approval or an answer; they carry only the session title and status, and approval still happens in DSH. On a phone the web UI's side panels slide over the page, and it can be added to the home screen with its own icon.
description.zh: 在手机浏览器里用 DSH。点会话顶栏的手机按钮（或插件设置卡）打开手机访问、扫二维码，手机就打开电脑上 DSH 进程提供的官方网页界面，会话相同、实时同步，人不在电脑前也能跟进正在跑的任务、回消息、点批准。DSH 里内置一个网关（端口 18765）转发网页界面，并替手机处理桌面端登录。一个二维码在 Wi-Fi 和流量下都能扫：打开手机访问时顺带开 Cloudflare 免费快速隧道（没有 cloudflared 会从 Cloudflare 官方 GitHub 发布页下载），DSH 重启后地址不变，手机不用重扫。配对码一次性、10 分钟过期，每台手机一张凭证、可随时移除，顶栏按钮显示手机是否已连接，空闲连接自动保活。可选推送到手机：任务跑完（30 秒以上）、出错停下、等批准或等回答时，发到 Bark、ntfy、Server酱、飞书 / 企业微信 / 钉钉群机器人、Telegram 或任意 Webhook；通知只带会话标题和状态，批准仍在 DSH 里点。手机上网页界面的左右两栏改成盖在页面上，可以带图标添加到主屏幕。

description.en: Prompt-box screenshot shortcut button. Drag a box, shot taken immediately. DSH hides automatically; multi-monitor supported. Ctrl+Alt+1--hides the window then shoots; shift+click--does not hide. Hold Ctrl+Alt and click 1 to shoot repeatedly. ! One copy is saved by default, named by content hash, in the DSH attachment library; each session writes an index recording which shots belong to it (can be changed to keep an extra copy in the session folder). Images are part of the context, so deleting them breaks the session — use the "Delete Conversation" plugin to remove images together with the conversation. Windows only.
description.zh: 方便大家直接截屏的提示词框快捷按钮。拉完范围框后直接截屏。自动隐藏dsh，支持多屏幕。Ctrl+Alt+1--隐藏窗口截屏；shift+点击按钮--不隐藏窗口；按住Ctrl+Alt后点击1，反复截屏。！默认以哈希值名称保存1份在DSH附件库，各会话生成索引记录图片归属（可修改为多备份一份至会话文件夹）。图片属于上下文，删除会导致会话错误，须用“删除会话”插件让图片与会话一并删除。仅 Windows。

description.en: Dedicated model routes, tools, and system guidance for vision, compaction, reviews, subagents, titles, and image generation.
description.zh: 为视觉理解、上下文压缩、审批审查、子代理、会话标题与图片生成提供独立的模型路由、工具与系统提示。

description.en: Reorder configured models in the composer model picker, set cache-hit, cache-miss and output prices per million tokens, and estimate per-turn and session costs with built-in DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在输入框右下角的模型选择器中自定义模型顺序，按每百万 tokens 设置缓存命中、缓存未命中与输出三档价格，并结合内置的 DeepSeek 峰谷价估算逐轮和本会话费用。

description.en: Checks an invoice ledger for duplicates keyed on code + number, arithmetic consistency, payer mismatch, date anomalies and template placeholders, and emits an anomaly list plus a workbook.
description.zh: 核对发票台账：按代码与号码识别重复、核对算式一致性、付款方不一致、日期异常与模板占位符，输出异常清单与工作簿。

description.en: Shows Provider/Model in the DSH Web composer model selector trigger; the dropdown list and its search are unchanged.
description.zh: DSH Web 对话框模型选择器的触发器显示「供应商/模型」；下拉列表与其搜索均不变。

description.en: Turn raw data (CSV / pasted table / SQL results / DuckDB) into a structured Markdown report with business conclusions, metrics and charts.
description.zh: 把原始数据（CSV / 粘贴表格 / SQL 结果 / DuckDB）转成带业务结论、指标与图表的结构化 Markdown 报告。

description.en: Security-audit facts AI coding agents cannot compute, plus a verdict gate: euthyna history attributes deleted lines to commits and flags those from security fixes (--origins finds the first introducer), euthyna coverage reports which changed symbols no test ever invoked, and euthyna gate checks each finding against six gates, downgrading any without evidence to an observation.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的确定性安全审计事实与结论门禁：euthyna history 把每行被删代码归因到提交并标记安全修复类删除（--origins 追到最初引入者），euthyna coverage 报告哪些改动符号从未被测试调用，euthyna gate 用六道门禁逐条校验结论，拿不出证据的一律降级为观察。

description.en: Long-term memory scoped to the DSH workspace. A session opens with a one-line-per-memory index - bodies are fetched on demand by the `memory` tool, so the same character budget holds about three times as many entries - and when a turn ends a purely local search over the last user message pulls the matching memories into the next briefing at no model cost. Optional auto-capture distils a stretch of conversation into structured memories; in draft mode they wait in an approval queue instead of landing directly. A portrait layer keeps a workspace and a global picture, rewritten from the journal and the records, with the same draft-or-direct choice. Settings → Memory holds the archive, list and timeline views, a health check (duplicate clusters, stale entries, broken links), the supersede version chain with rollback, and a read-only scan that imports existing WorkBuddy / Qoder memory files.
description.zh: DSH 的工作区长期记忆。会话开始只注入「一行一条」的记忆索引，正文由 memory 工具按需取——同样字数预算约装三倍条目；一轮结束时用当轮最后一条用户消息做纯本地检索，命中的记忆下一轮随简报召回，不花模型 token。可选自动提炼把一段对话归纳成结构化记忆，captureMode=draft 时先进审批队列、你批准了才生效。另有画像层：工作区与全局各一份全貌，由日志与条目重写生成，同样可走草稿。设置 → 记忆 里有档案 / 列表 / 时间线、体检（重复簇、过期未用、断链）、版本链 supersede 与一键回滚，以及「扫描本机」把已有的 WorkBuddy / Qoder 记忆文件导入（只读，不动来源）。

description.en: Study workbench for exam prep and research: three-column task board with tags and filters, a spaced-repetition queue (simplified SM-2) that keeps finished cards coming back, a heatmap lit by actual focused minutes, weekly reports, per-day review notes, a pomodoro timer that survives panel switches, and Markdown export/import for Obsidian. Installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-study-desk on npm).
description.zh: 备考与科研学习工作台：三列待办墙（标签与过滤）、间隔重复复习队列（简化 SM-2，已完成的卡照样会到期）、按实际专注分钟点亮的热力图、周报、每日复盘、跨面板存活的番茄钟，支持 Markdown 导出与读回（Obsidian 友好）。可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-study-desk）。

description.en: Codebase Memory MCP bridge for DeepSeek Harness: six knowledge-graph code tools, auto-started background daemon with visualization Web UI, and bundled agent skill.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Codebase Memory MCP 桥接插件：提供六个原生代码知识图谱工具、自动启动后台守护进程及可视化 Web 界面，并内置专属代理技能。

description.en: Prompt optimizer for the DSH composer. One click runs rewrite then self-review rounds over the draft with per-round diff preview, and a rejected result rides into the next round as a prior attempt. Five fixed re-run directions (more concise / more detailed / more technical / restructure / stronger acceptance); a 164-role library ships in the package, roles recommended by draft or picked explicitly; matched installed skills fold into the meta-prompt under exact-name constraints; results save to a prompt library (browse, insert, re-optimize, two-step delete); mechanical acceptance criteria carry an executable check-command template; output language follows the agent UI language.
description.zh: DSH 输入框提示词优化器。一键对草稿执行「改写 → 自审」多轮优化，逐轮差异预览，被拒绝的结果作为上一次尝试进入下一轮；五个固定重跑方向（更精简／更详尽／更技术／结构化／强化验收）；包内自带 164 个角色的角色库，可按草稿推荐或显式指定；命中的已安装技能以精确名称约束并入元提示词；结果可存入提示词库（浏览、插入、再优化、两步删除）；机械验收准则附带可执行的检查命令模板；输出语言跟随 Agent 界面语言。

description.en: Academic literature search and citation tools for DeepSeek Harness: paper search via Crossref and OpenAlex with no API key, related-works discovery, and citation formatting in GB/T 7714, APA and BibTeX.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的学术文献检索与引用工具：基于 Crossref 与 OpenAlex 检索论文（无需 API key），支持相关工作发现，并可按 GB/T 7714、APA 与 BibTeX 格式生成引用。

description.en: Floating glass status bar for DSH on Windows 11 x64: an always-on-top capsule that mirrors session progress, the current step and pending approvals from a local DSH web profile, with peek and detail views; approval cards stay read-only until DSH returns its own decision receipt, and connecting to the official Desktop app is experimental and unverified.
description.zh: Windows 11 x64 上的 DSH 悬浮玻璃状态栏：常驻胶囊显示本地 DSH web profile 的会话进度、当前步骤与待处理审批，可展开速览与详情；审批卡在 DSH 返回正式回执前保持只读，连接官方 Desktop 应用属实验性、未验收。

description.en: ICVO coding-standards kit for DeepSeek Harness (formerly dsh-coding-kit): a bundle plugin that registers tools on load and injects the standards only when apply_coding_standards is called, plus a P0 gate CLI (npx spec-wave) with G1-G7 process commands, skills install, host apply, and IDE-block refresh.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ICVO 编码规范套件（原 dsh-coding-kit）：bundle 插件加载时仅注册工具，须调用 apply_coding_standards 才注入规范；另附 P0 门禁 CLI（npx spec-wave），含 G1–G7 过程命令、skills install、host apply 与 IDE 块刷新。

description.en: Cron job board: schedules local scripts or dsh session tasks (fresh or pinned sessions) by cron expression, with inline timezone suffixes (T±N), per-task model and agent-preset selection for session tasks, centralized environment-variable management, run logs, per-task concurrency limits and a per-task timeout for script runs.
description.zh: 定时任务看板:cron 调度本地脚本或 dsh 会话任务(每次新建/固定会话),表达式支持内联时区后缀 T±N,会话任务可选模型与 Agent Preset,环境变量集中管理,执行日志、任务级并发上限与脚本任务超时控制。

description.en: Browser notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness - system toasts when a task finishes, a run errors, or your input is needed (question / approval / plan review), click to open the session, per-type toggles, and no false 'done' while the main session waits on its subagents.
description.zh: DSH 浏览器通知插件 - 任务完成 / 运行出错 / 需要你回答、批准、审阅计划时弹系统级通知，点击气泡直达会话，三类通知独立开关，主会话等子代理期间不误报完成。

description.en: Role-based multi-agent team for DeepSeek Harness — your digital workforce. One goal assembles a team of product, architect, frontend, backend, reviewer and QA roles that deliver through a nine-phase gated pipeline, plus a persistent team you can keep directing across sessions. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.
description.zh: 角色化多智能体专家团 = 你的数字员工。一句目标即自动组建最多 12 个角色（产品、架构、前端、后端、审查、测试等），按九阶段门控流水线协作交付，并支持常驻团队反复指挥。零运行时依赖、无构建步骤。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, skills, and tools for your agent — true in-context state (loaded/truncated/evicted) and per-session switches.
description.zh: 一站式管理 MCP 服务器、技能与工具——真实的在上下文状态(已加载/已截断/已挤出),并按会话开关。

description.en: Fail-closed runtime tool-call loop guard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供故障关闭式运行时工具调用循环防护。

description.en: Zero-dependency screen capture for DSH: Lightweight — zero deps, zero binaries; Stage & shoot — one-click full screen, window layout, hover-snap capture of occluded windows; Agent self-service — path-only delivery; paths are universal, pair with modlens (optional) for one-call structured evidence.
description.zh: DSH 轻量截图插件：轻——零依赖零二进制；摆——一键全屏、窗口排版、悬停吸附截取被遮挡窗口；自助——Agent 可自助截屏，传路径不传图，路径通用，接上 modlens（选装）一步读出结构化内容。

description.en: Universal skill adapter that registers any GitHub repo containing a SKILL.md as a DSH skill by cloning and symlinking into the official skills root.
description.zh: 通用 skill 适配器，将含 SKILL.md 的 GitHub 仓库克隆并 symlink 到官方 skills 根目录，注册为 DSH skill。

description.en: Log query card for the DSH Web GUI over Elasticsearch / OpenSearch: one query surface with per-dialect query strings and clickable examples, field-name completion, filter chips, a time histogram whose bars zoom into that window, field facets that turn a bucket into a filter, and a result list with level colors, stack-continuation rows, columns and paging; Docker container logs are a collection source that reuses the docker plugin. Ships five read-only loglens_* tools (sources / search / fields / facets / context) sharing the same execution layer as the panel. Outbound requests only reach configured sources, judged on the resolved IP, without following redirects and with size and timeout caps.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的日志查询卡片（Elasticsearch / OpenSearch）：一个查询面——按来源方言给查询串与可点例子、字段名补全、筛选芯片、可点柱缩放时间窗的时间分布、把分组的桶点成筛选、带级别染色与堆栈续行标记的结果列表（可选列、可翻页）；Docker 容器日志作为采集来源复用 docker 插件。agent 侧五个只读 loglens_* 工具（sources / search / fields / facets / context）与面板共用同一执行层。出站只打到已配置的来源，按解析后的 IP 判定，不跟随重定向，并有体积与超时上限。

description.en: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

description.en: UI harmonizer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between installed plugins, and unifies the visual language via official design tokens — with live-customizable chat width, markdown font size, workspace scale, UI font stack and a rounded center-column card from Settings → General; client-only dsh bundle, zero model cost, no host side, removable without residue.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness UI 协调器：规范化官方未完善、自相矛盾的界面，协调已装插件间的样式冲突并统一视觉语言（全部遵循官方设计令牌）——支持实时自定义对话宽度、markdown 字号、工作区缩放、UI 字体栈，并在设置页提供圆角中栏卡片；纯客户端 dsh bundle，零模型开销，无 host 端，可无残留移除。

description.en: Conversation enhancements: a history-input overlay (Alt+Up, with workspace/session/global/favorite-prompt scopes), recall of interjected messages that were not applied, rewrite-style forking (fork a child session from before a turn and backfill that turn input for editing, including turns whose reply is still running), optional auto-resend after forking (off by default), and a copy-session-id action in the title bar.
description.zh: 对话增强:历史输入浮层(Alt+↑,workspace/session/global/常用提示词四范围)、未应用插话撤回、重写式分叉(在该轮之前分出新会话并回填该轮输入供编辑重发,回复进行中的轮也可分叉)、分叉后自动重发(默认关),以及标题栏复制 sessionId。

description.en: Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1. Mobile UI fixes for the dsh web profile: narrow-screen drawer and settings tabs, a full-width model menu, a stuck-request network chip, and a narrow-header collector that folds the lineage, subagent and background-job chips into one tappable sheet.
description.zh: 需要 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。dsh web profile 的手机端体验修复：窄屏抽屉与设置标签、全宽模型菜单、卡住请求的网络状态芯片，以及把会话层级、subagent 与后台任务芯片收进一张可点开面板的窄屏头部收纳器。

description.en: Usage and cost view for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates real token usage from existing session logs, locks each cost at the price of its event time, and shows month and today spend against a budget from a sidebar card or an input-bar pill.
description.zh: dsh 用量与费用视图：从既有会话日志聚合真实 token 用量，按事件发生时刻的价格写时锁定费用；侧栏卡片或输入框胶囊展示本月/今日花费与预算进度，设置页另有概览、趋势、明细三页。

description.en: Adds a writing-plans skill that generates a structured implementation plan document before coding, then executes simple tasks inline or offers an execution choice for complex work.
description.zh: 添加 writing-plans 技能，在写代码前生成结构化实现计划文档，简单任务直接执行，复杂任务提供执行方式选择。

description.en: UGREEN NAS connector for UGOS Pro: 59 agent tools covering all 70 access-token permissions over OpenCLI — files, storage, task metrics, Docker, downloads, app management, control panel and global search, auto-gated per category by what the token grants.
description.zh: 绿联 NAS（UGOS Pro）连接器：通过访问令牌调用 OpenCLI，59 个工具覆盖全部 70 项令牌权限——文件、存储、任务指标、Docker、下载、应用管理、控制面板与全局搜索，按令牌实际授予自动增减。

description.en: JetBrains-style Git workbench for DSH: hunk and line-level staging, side-by-side diff with word-level highlighting, commit graph and branch operations, three-way conflict merge, and commit messages drafted with the host model.
description.zh: DSH 的 JetBrains 风格 Git 工作台：按块与按行暂存、带词级高亮的并排 diff、提交图与分支操作、三方冲突合并，还能用宿主模型起草提交信息。

description.en: Input-box floating translation widget for DSH: translate drafts via session model, Zhipu GLM, or custom endpoints, with preview/replace/append, connectivity testing, and recent history.
description.zh: DSH 输入框悬浮快捷翻译挂件：支持当前会话模型、智谱 GLM 与自定义端点，提供预览/替换/追加、连通性测试及最近历史找回。

description.en: Adaptation packs for third-party DSH plugin panels on phones — 44px touch floor, width reclaim, shell hit targets and floating-widget clearance — loaded by the dsh-mobile plugin from its extensions directory (dsh-mobile must be installed for them to take effect), with a settings page that installs them and a per-plugin compatibility list.
description.zh: 第三方 DSH 插件面板的手机适配包：44px 触控地板、宽度回收、外壳命中区与浮动控件让位；由 dsh-mobile 插件从其 extensions 目录加载（须先装 dsh-mobile 才会生效），附设置页一键装/卸与插件兼容清单。

description.en: Opening animation, three bundled wallpapers, up to nine uploaded wallpapers with random rotation, and live panel and sidebar opacity.
description.zh: 开场动画、三张内置壁纸、最多九张上传壁纸与随机轮换，以及实时生效的面板与侧边栏透明度。

description.en: Checks nursing records for entry timing, signatures and assessment-form completeness, against 《病历书写基本规范》 and other published documents. Reports what is missing or out of sequence for a human to review.
description.zh: 依据《病历书写基本规范》等公开文件，核对护理记录的书写时限、签名，以及评估表的完整性。列出缺失或次序不符之处供人复核。

description.en: DSH plugin (fork of sj244/dsh-qq-bridge, MIT) that connects DSH sessions to QQ through OneBot/NapCat. Whitelist stays closed until filled in; @-mentions, nicknames and pokes always wake the model; other messages wake at a configurable probability. Cordis id remains qq-bridge. It keeps the upstream Cordis id (qq-bridge): uninstall sj244/dsh-qq-bridge before installing, the two cannot be installed together — and with an empty whitelist nothing wakes.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话接到 QQ（OneBot/NapCat）的插件（fork 自 sj244/dsh-qq-bridge，MIT）。白名单默认全关；被 @、叫到昵称或被戳一定叫醒，其余消息按可调概率抽样。Cordis 插件 id 仍是 qq-bridge。它沿用上游的 Cordis id（qq-bridge）：安装前须先卸载 sj244/dsh-qq-bridge，两者不能同装；白名单为空时谁都不会被叫醒。

description.en: Mobile-first Web UI quality-of-life pack for the DeepSeek Harness: a Chrome-style active-session tab bar, full-screen sidebar swipe open/close, overlay sidebar, collapsed-sidebar recents, keyboard-suppressing session switching, viewport/IME keyboard adaptation, touch feedback, code/table inner scrolling, hidden permission dropdown, a full-screen settings rewrite with tab memory, and a compositor-driven status pulse, no-touch-drag long-press protection — 14 features, each independently toggleable from the Settings QoL section with instant effect, persisted per browser in localStorage; pure client-side CSS/JS, mobile rules locked to viewports of 768px and below so desktop stays untouched.
description.zh: 面向 dsh Web GUI 的移动优先体验优化包：Chrome 式活跃会话标签页（Tab Bar）、全屏侧栏滑动开合、侧栏浮层与折叠态最近会话、切换会话不拉起输入法、viewport/键盘安全区适配、按钮触摸反馈、代码块表格内滚、隐藏权限下拉、设置页全屏重写与页签记忆、合成器线程状态动画、长按拖拽卡死修复——14 项功能均可在设置页 QoL 分区独立开关、即时生效，并按浏览器持久保存在 localStorage；纯客户端 CSS/JS，移动规则锁定 ≤768px 视口，桌面端零影响。

description.en: File-based environment registry for DSH: manage environments, services, deployments and operation-to-Skill bindings through a panel and model-facing tools.
description.zh: 基于文件的 DSH 环境注册表：通过面板和模型工具管理环境、服务、部署以及操作到 Skill 的绑定。

description.en: TongFlow film-crew studio for image, voice, music and video production: the agent writes per-asset TongFlow workflow files (.tongflow.json) that run through TongFlow plugins, with an embedded workflow canvas, a shot/character/take project layout and a manga-drama template; sessions starting with @tongflow open the Studio view.
description.zh: 基于 TongFlow 的“片场”插件，用于图片、配音、音乐与视频制作：agent 为每个资产生成 TongFlow 工作流文件（.tongflow.json）并通过 TongFlow 插件执行，内嵌工作流画布，按镜头/角色/take 组织项目，附漫剧模板；以 @tongflow 开头的会话进入 Studio 界面。

description.en: Folds the sidebar's add-on panel rows (schedules, agent teams, plugin market, context pages, …) under the shipped "More" row: a 28x28 chevron toggle on that row collapses them into a single header line and expands them back, the fold state persists per window, the rows kept visible are chosen with per-row switches read from the live sidebar, and each managed row's icon + label can be aligned left, centre or right. Client-only plugin: adds DOM, patches no host bundle, and uninstalls back to the shipped sidebar. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 exactly; other versions install but stay inert.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的加项面板行（自动化任务、agent 团队、插件市场、上下文页等）收进宿主「更多」行：在该行挂一个 28x28 箭头按钮，点一下把它们收成一行、再点复原；折叠状态按窗口持久化，保持可见的行用逐行开关从当前侧边栏实时枚举后选择，被管理行的图标与文字还能切换左/中/右对齐。纯 client 插件：只新增 DOM，不打宿主补丁，卸载后恢复原样。仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3，其它版本装上也不会生效。

description.en: Zhipu GLM web search provider: registers as `glm` on the ctx.web seam and runs the native web_search server tool through GLM's Anthropic-compatible API (Coding Plan billing).
description.zh: 智谱 GLM 联网搜索 provider：以 glm 注册到 ctx.web 缝，经 GLM 的 Anthropic 兼容 API 执行原生 web_search 服务端工具（走 Coding Plan 计费）。

description.en: A personal home page for DSH that gathers feature entry points and readings into a card wall: one-click DSH core updates, security review of a plugin before install, local Skill management, session status and more. The page is customizable, and any other plugin can add its own cards through the interface.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供一个集成功能入口与信息浏览的个人主页：以卡片墙的形式内置一键更新 DSH 核心版本、审核外部插件安全性、管理本地 Skill、浏览会话状态等功能与信息展示。页面支持高度自定义，并可自由通过接口增加新的卡片。

description.en: A self-evolving plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it observes how the agent runs, proposes improvements to its own assets via the LLM, validates each proposal inside a sandboxed trial agent, and applies only verified mutations — with a versioned ledger and automatic rollback on regression.
description.zh: 一个自我进化的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：观察代理的运行方式，通过 LLM 对其自身资产提出改进方案，在沙箱试运行代理中验证每个方案，只应用通过验证的变更——带版本化账本，出现性能回退时自动回滚。

description.en: Todoist-style todo management in the sidebar with projects, labels and priorities, CJK-aware natural-language quick-add, repeat rules, a stats dashboard, import and export, seven agent tools and due-time reminders.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的类 Todoist 待办管理：项目/标签/优先级、中英双语自然语言快速添加、重复规则、统计仪表盘、导入导出、七个 Agent 工具与到期提醒。

description.en: Wraps the external `ocr` (open-code-review) CLI in five model tools — one-shot review, whole-tree scan, deterministic scope/rule scaffolding and session lookup — and reports what OCR found separately from whether the run actually covered the selected files.
description.zh: 把外部 `ocr`（open-code-review）CLI 包成五个模型工具——单次评审、全树扫描、确定性的范围与规则脚手架、会话查询——并把「OCR 发现了什么」与「这次跑有没有覆盖完选中的文件」分成两套口径回报。

description.en: Holds the OS wake lock while any agent, subagent, or background job runs, releases it after a configurable grace period, and provides a bilingual web settings page with live status, manual hold, and display-on options.
description.zh: 任意 agent、subagent 或后台任务运行时持有系统唤醒锁，全部结束后按可配置宽限期释放；提供中英双语 Web 设置页，实时显示活动与唤醒锁状态，支持手动保持与阻止屏幕关闭。

description.en: Adds a Theme row to Settings → General between Appearance and Font size — 8 builtin palettes plus Default, hover previews without writing, click applies and is persisted by the host; imports/exports custom dsh-theme.json files, with an optional Theme Creator skill behind /dsh-theme-creator.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」的官方「外观」与「字号」之间注入「主题」行：8 套内置配色 + 默认项，悬停预览不写盘、点击应用并由 Host 持久化；支持导入/导出自定义 dsh-theme.json 主题文件，另有可选的 Theme Creator skill（/dsh-theme-creator）。

description.en: Fusion 360 for DSH: bridges the MCP server Fusion ships (read, execute, update, electronics) with every upstream schema kept byte-for-byte while the always-on tool surface drops 70 percent, adds an editable endpoint under Settings, and wraps a local hf.py modelling loop as nine hf_* tools (needs Python 3.10+ and a fusion-harness workspace).
description.zh: 把 Fusion 360 接进 DSH：桥接 Fusion 自带的 MCP 服务（读取、执行、更新、电子设计），上游 schema 逐字节保留而常驻工具面减少 70%，设置页可改端点，并把本地 hf.py 建模闭环包成九个 hf_* 工具（需要 Python 3.10+ 与 fusion-harness 工作区）。

description.en: A desktop pet for DSH: a blue whale girl with 104 animations and built-in voice. It is standalone, but its pet runtime is a rework of dsh-dafeiyu — disable the upstream dsh-dafeiyu before installing, or both will run and fight over the control port. Windows x64 only, and the first launch downloads about 580 MB of assets.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠：蓝色鲸鱼娘，自带 104 个动作与内置语音。插件独立，但桌宠运行时基于 dsh-dafeiyu 改造——安装前需先禁用上游 dsh-dafeiyu，否则两只同开会抢控制口；仅支持 Windows x64，首次启动需下载约 580MB 素材。

description.en: Deterministic project actions shared by people and agents: one actions.json, a right-sidebar run panel, and agent tools.
description.zh: 人与 Agent 共用的确定性项目任务：一份 actions.json，右侧栏运行面板与 Agent 工具双入口。

description.en: Local-first character archive in the DSH sidebar: it interviews you about someone and writes the answers into Markdown cards, imports SillyTavern character cards, writes a novel chapter by chapter, and roleplays with a card plus its world book; anything written into a card has to be quotable from material you wrote.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的本地优先人物档案：访谈你身边的人并写成 Markdown 卡，能导入酒馆角色卡，也能逐章写小说、拿角色卡和世界书演一段；写进卡的每一条都要能在你写过的材料里找到原句。

description.en: A live iOS Simulator or USB-connected iPhone inside the conversation: 22 agent tools for booting, building, driving the UI by accessibility identity or OCR text, list-row actions and SwiftUI preview hot reload, plus a streaming sidebar panel you can tap and drag on.
description.zh: 在对话里直接操作 iOS 模拟器或 USB 连接的 iPhone：22 个 Agent 工具用于启动、构建、按无障碍标识或 OCR 文本驱动 UI、列表行操作与 SwiftUI 预览热重载，并附带可点击拖拽的流式侧边栏面板。

description.en: Personal center for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session usage statistics with per-provider and per-model breakdown (auto-discovers configured models), per-model cost estimation, global custom instructions, a data-driven desktop pet with bitmap & vector skins, and a conversation status overview, all local and offline.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 个人中心：跨会话用量统计（按供应商/模型分别统计，自动读取已配置模型）、按模型成本估算、全局自定义指令、数据驱动的桌面宠物（位图/矢量皮肤）与会话状态概览，纯本地离线运行。

description.en: Study companion for your materials with guided practice, evidence-grounded feedback, Leitner spaced review, 18 teacher tools, and a Chinese/English student panel using the current DSH session model; requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, Python 3.11+, and Python runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 面向自选资料的学习陪练，使用当前 DSH 会话模型，提供引导练习、证据反馈、Leitner 间隔复习、18 个教师工具与中英双语学生面板；要求 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0、Python 3.11+ 及 Python 运行时依赖。

description.en: Installs Herta as a DeepSeek Harness agent: a preset carrying her persona and memory prompt sections, six memory and voice tools, a narrative layer that separates her thinking from what she says, 80 bundled voice clips, offline and MiniMax speech synthesis, and two conversation views that render the session with her own components.
description.zh: 把 Herta（黑塔）作为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体装入：携带人格与记忆提示词段的 preset、六个记忆与语音工具、区分内心与发言的叙述层、80 条随包语音、本地与 MiniMax 两条语音合成链路，以及两个用她自己的组件渲染会话的对话视图。

description.en: Set an earlier automatic-compaction threshold per model on DeepSeek Harness: /autocompact writes a session-only override keyed by exact provider/model (off falls back to the backend defaults, default clears it), a Settings → Autocompact page manages the persisted per-model thresholds every session inherits, and a composer status entry shows the current reading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 按模型设置更早的自动压缩阈值：/autocompact 以精确 provider/model 为键写入仅本会话生效的覆盖值（off 回退后端默认、default 清除覆盖），设置页「自动压缩」管理所有会话继承的持久化逐模型阈值，输入框状态条目显示当前读数。

description.en: Bridges the agent to a persistent OKF memory vault over MCP stdio: a Python server (SQLite FTS5 + Markdown) with 10 tools for searching and storing decisions, facts, learnings, conventions, profiles and sources.
description.zh: 经 MCP stdio 把 Agent 接入持久化 OKF 记忆库：Python 服务端（SQLite FTS5 + Markdown），10 个工具用于检索与写入决策、事实和偏好。

description.en: A memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: set its name, personality and character; it forgets only trivial things, keeps what matters, and marks and remembers what is special to you.
description.zh: 记忆类插件。可设置名字、性格与人格；只淡忘琐事，重要的会保留，特殊的会被记住。

description.en: Adds DSH 0.2.x kernel support to the SenseTime XiaoHuanXiong desktop-app models, reusing that app's stored sign-in so no API key is needed.
description.zh: 为商汤小浣熊桌面 App 的模型补上 DSH 0.2.x 内核支持，复用该 App 的登录态，无需填写 API Key。

description.en: CLIProxyAPI quota for DeepSeek Harness: a ring beside the model picker plus a settings panel listing every account quota windows with plans and reset times.
description.zh: 模型选择器旁的 CLIProxyAPI 额度圆环，设置面板仿 CPA 管理页列出全部账号的额度窗口、套餐与刷新时间。

description.en: Image generation and editing for GPT Image, Gemini (Nano Banana) and Grok, with official, OpenAI-compatible, api.toolify-ai.com and custom HTTP providers. Text-to-image, reference-image editing, canvas annotation, mask editing and Agent multi-turn chat, with images and history kept on your machine. The workbench UI is the MIT-licensed GPT Image Playground v0.9.0 build by CookSleep, bundled unchanged; that upstream is a standalone web app, not a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 支持 GPT Image、Gemini（Nano Banana）和 Grok 的图片生成与编辑工具，支持官方接口、OpenAI 兼容接口、api.toolify-ai.com 与自定义 HTTP 供应商。支持文本生图、参考图编辑、画板标注、遮罩编辑与 Agent 多轮对话，图片和历史记录保存在本地。界面为上游 CookSleep/gpt_image_playground 的 MIT 构建 v0.9.0，原样打包；上游是独立网页应用而非 DSH 插件。

description.en: Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete (with child sessions) to the DSH sidebar session menu, plus error and unread status dots, hover-card details, one-click delete for archived rows, and a settings panel that switches each menu item on or off; the interface is available in English and Chinese.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的会话右键菜单补上标记未读、复制会话信息、在访达中显示或换 IDE 打开、永久删除（连子会话一起删），并给会话行加上报错与未读状态点、悬浮卡信息、归档行的一键删除，以及一个可逐项开关菜单的设置面板；界面提供中英文两套文案。

description.en: Compacts a long session after a configurable idle time when its context exceeds a configurable token threshold, before the provider KV cache expires; both values are set on the plugin's page in the Plugins manager.
description.zh: 会话上下文超过可配置的 token 阈值、且用户空闲达到可配置时长后，在模型 KV 缓存过期前自动压缩会话；两项设置都在插件管理器的插件页面中修改。

description.en: CC-style auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic deny/allow rules plus a two-stage allow/reject classifier with a circuit breaker and denial guidance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 式自动审批：确定性 deny/allow 规则 + 两阶段 allow/reject 分类器，内置熔断器与拒绝引导。

description.en: Search, monitor, interrupt, and batch-archive workspace subagents, featuring real-time activity streaming and an active-agent floating panel.
description.zh: 搜索、监控、打断与批量归档工作区子代理，支持实时活动/思考流式展示与活跃浮窗。

description.en: Aqua glass theme for DeepSeek Harness: adjustable blur and frost, a fluid or image/video wallpaper, unified corners and motion, and font family, size and colour controls — switching it off restores the stock UI. Continues the Aqua theme by WYH66666666 (DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin v1.3.0); do not install alongside the upstream.
description.zh: Aqua 玻璃主题：可调模糊与磨砂、流体或图片/视频壁纸、统一圆角与动效、字体字号与文字配色，关掉即还原原生界面。承接 WYH66666666 的 Aqua 主题（DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin v1.3.0），请勿与上游同装。

description.en: Feishu IM bridge for dsh: create a dedicated Feishu bot by scanning a QR code, get one Card JSON 2.0 notice per finished turn, answer tool approvals and structured questions from the chat, and drive a session from it — listing and switching the bound session with /sessions and /resume, steering a running turn, and choosing per-chat permission modes (read-only, workspace, Auto Review, full). Long output paginates instead of being cut. Owner binding: the QR scan binds the scanner; with manually entered credentials the first sender claims ownership and everyone else is refused.
description.zh: 飞书 IM 通道：扫码创建专属飞书机器人；每轮结束推一张卡片，在飞书里授权工具调用、回答结构化提问，并直接用聊天驱动会话（/sessions 列会话、/resume 切换绑定会话、任务进行中可插话引导），还能按对话设置权限模式（只读 / 工作区读写 / Auto Review / 完全权限）。消息以卡片 JSON 2.0 发送，超长内容分页而不是截断。归属绑定：扫码创建时绑定扫码人；手填凭据时由首个发消息的人认领，其余人一律拒绝。

description.en: A sticky-notes panel for DSH with a draggable floating window, a full sidebar page, Markdown preview, pasted images and configurable settings.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 便签面板，支持可拖动悬浮窗、侧栏整页、Markdown 预览、粘贴图片与设置项，数据仅存于浏览器本地。

description.en: Select a term in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and press the Search button beside it to read the explanation in place: basic meaning, purpose and usage, with the token cost of that answer. The call is auxiliary — it writes nothing to the session log.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里选中一个术语、点旁边的「搜索」按钮，就地解释基本含义、用途与用法，并显示这次回答消耗的 token；该调用是旁路调用，不写入会话日志。

description.en: DSH plugin: matches a model you declared on a custom gateway to the capability metadata it should have — context window, output cap, reasoning levels and image support — by looking the bare model name up at runtime; the plugin never writes your settings document.
description.zh: DSH 插件：按模型名在运行时查一次目录，把你在自定义网关上声明的模型该有的能力元数据补上——上下文长度、输出上限、推理等级、能否看图；插件自己不写你的设置文档。

description.en: Expert center: browse and import WorkBuddy experts, create experts with AI, edit role.md and skills, and switch experts per session.
description.zh: 专家中心：浏览并导入 WorkBuddy 专家，用 AI 创建专家、编辑 role.md 与技能，并按会话切换专家。

description.en: Turns a one-line DSH draft into a complete task brief (role / goal / constraints / output format). The engine is a byte-verified port of linshenkx/prompt-optimizer (three modes, 10 templates identical to upstream); history is consent-gated with version chains and structural comparison; every run reports its token usage. Nothing is written back or sent without a click.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里的一句话补成完整任务书（角色/目标/约束/输出格式）。引擎是 linshenkx/prompt-optimizer 的逐字节移植：三种优化模式、10 个模板与上游一致；历史为授权制、带版本链与结构对比；每次润色的 token 消耗可见。未经点击不写回、不发送。

description.en: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on cron schedules, each run opens a new agent session to do the work, with workspace binding, manual run, session auto-naming, and a fullscreen task management page.
description.zh: 定时任务：用 cron 表达式定时执行提示词，到点自动开一个新 agent 会话替你干活，支持绑定工作区、手动立即执行与会话自动命名。

description.en: Delete sessions, optionally with the files each session wrote; deletions go to a trash that lists them by time and restores one or many; a session with a running turn is refused and nothing outside that session folder is touched.
description.zh: 删会话，可选择是否带上它写过的文件；删掉的进回收站，按时间列出，可单条或批量还原；正在跑的会话会被拒绝，会话目录以外的文件不动。

description.en: Adds a markitdown tool that converts PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, CSV, EPUB and URLs to Markdown, using a real Microsoft MarkItDown installation when one is reachable and a bundled dependency-free converter otherwise.
description.zh: 提供 markitdown 工具，把 PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、HTML、CSV、EPUB 与网址转成 Markdown：能找到真实的 Microsoft MarkItDown 时驱动它，否则使用内置的零依赖转换器。

description.en: General-purpose knowledge base for DSH: import md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf, folder management, FTS5 full-text search (BM25), and a Web management UI.
description.zh: DSH 通用知识库插件：导入 md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf、目录化管理、FTS5 全文检索（BM25）、Web 管理界面。

description.en: Shows a focus-free notice card in the corner when a turn ends or DSH is waiting on an approval or a question.
description.zh: 任务跑完、等你审批或等你回答时，在屏幕角落弹出一张不抢焦点的通知卡。

description.en: Visualizes all DSH session memories as an interactive 3D nebula, with a neuron-signal skin, memory-scaled clusters, zoom-driven detail levels and a live write/read activity stream over SSE.
description.zh: 把 DSH 全部会话记忆可视化为可交互的 3D 星云，提供神经元信号皮肤、按记忆量缩放的星云团、缩放分级细节，以及基于 SSE 的实时存取活动流。

description.en: Digests the images in a prompt with a vision model before admission, so any model — a text-only one included — can read them without the session ever switching models, and adds a describe_image tool for image paths.
description.zh: 在准入前把提示词里的图片换成视觉模型的文字分析，因此任何模型（包括纯文本模型）都能读图且会话不切换模型；另提供 describe_image 工具处理图片路径。

description.en: SillyTavern-compatible roleplay with character cards, presets, world books, and swipe branches that restore their continuations alongside native DSH conversations.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供兼容 SillyTavern 的角色扮演，支持角色卡、预设、世界书及保留后续对话的 swipe 分支，并可切回原生会话视图。

description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers from Settings → MCP 管理, with JSON export/import, four mcp_manager_* model tools and an HTTP API; install via npx, npm or cross-platform scripts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务管理器：在「设置 → MCP 管理」中新增/编辑/启停/重启/删除 MCP 服务，支持 JSON 导入导出、4 个 mcp_manager_* 模型工具与 HTTP API，可通过 npx、npm 或跨平台脚本安装。

description.en: Rust-based POSIX bash executor for the Windows platform — gives DSH a native bash with no WSL or MSYS compatibility layer, honors DSH's three-tier permission policy, and provides persistent-terminal tools.
description.zh: Rust 实现的 Windows 平台 POSIX bash 执行器：为 DSH 提供原生 bash（不依赖 WSL 或 MSYS兼容层），服从 DSH 的三档权限策略、提供持久化终端工具。

description.en: Model-based permission approval: an approval-request answerer backed by a separate reviewer model.
description.zh: 基于模型的权限审批：由独立审查模型自动应答 approval 权限请求。

description.en: DSH notification & remote-control plane: one `notify()` API across 28 outbound channels, six inbound control channels, phone approvals/questions/task control, a Native DSH Notify & Control UI, live outbound hot-apply, multi-agent routing, and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 通知与远程操作控制面：一个 `notify()` API 接入 28 个出站渠道，六条入站控制通道承载手机审批、提问与任务控制；提供 DSH 原生「通知与控制」UI、出站热生效、多 agent 路由，并保持零运行时依赖。

description.en: QA project workbench for dsh: manage test projects, requirements, test cases, defects, milestones, reports and approval gates through a browser UI and 18 QA-domain tools.
description.zh: dsh 质量项目工作台：通过浏览器界面和 18 个 QA 领域工具管理测试项目、需求、用例、缺陷、里程碑、报告与审批门禁。

description.en: Self-narrative memory in five budgeted segments (800 chars, not a full context): a first-person note the model writes to itself, a profile of you aggregated from approved facts, environment facts kept separate from who you are, heat-ranked conclusions, and habits. Every injected fact is traceable to a fact id and can be retired; the profile can be edited by hand, and self-notes stay plain lines you can clear. Facts fade by use and time without ever changing their credibility. Preference-like lines you say are auto-detected as candidates (never auto-approved), with conflicts kept side by side. Recall over past conversations with citations, an incremental index that only decodes newly appended frames, a pointer-required warm layer, a doctor that says which part is broken, a heartbeat proving injection is alive, and export/import so the whole thing moves to another machine.
description.zh: 五段预算制的自我叙述记忆（共 800 字，不是整段上下文）：模型写给自己看的第一人称自述、从已采纳记忆聚合的「关于你」画像、与本机环境事实分开的画像、按热度排序的结论、以及习惯。每条注入的事实都能回溯到具体事实 id，可一键退役；画像可手改覆盖，自述则是可清空的纯文本行。事实按使用与时间衰减，但可信度不随时间变。你说过的长期要求会被自动识别成候选（永不自动采纳），互相冲突的两条并排留着。另外带出处的历史检索、只解新增帧的增量索引、必须有指针的温层摘要、能说清哪里坏了的体检，证明注入还活着的心跳，以及能整体搬到另一台机器的导出/导入。

description.en: Checks a medical-record front sheet for field completeness and for internal logical contradictions between its fields, against 国卫办医发〔2016〕24号 and other published documents. Lists what is missing or inconsistent for a human to review; it does not assess clinical correctness.
description.zh: 依据国卫办医发〔2016〕24号等公开文件，核对病案首页各字段的齐备性与字段间的逻辑矛盾。列出缺失或不一致之处供人复核，不评价临床正确性。

description.en: Bundles five TIA Portal skills (Siemens PLC docs lookup, ladder-logic generation, SimaticML-to-PNG rendering, scan-cycle simulation with PASS/FAIL scenarios, and a TiaLink gateway skill for driving a real TIA Portal project) and wires five MCP endpoints. Requires TiaLink (paid; Windows + TIA Portal V19/V20 + Openness) for real-project work, API keys for the four cloud services (100 free calls each, then paid; rendering is billed per call even on failure), Node 22+, and network access; program snippets are uploaded to tia.hubwiz.com.
description.zh: 一次装齐西门子博途（TIA Portal）的五项技能（官方文档检索、梯形图生成、SimaticML 转 PNG 渲染、逐扫描仿真与 PASS/FAIL 验收、操作真实工程的本机网关）并接好五个 MCP 端点。操作真实工程需另装付费的 TiaLink（Windows + 博途 V19/V20 + Openness 用户组）；四个云端服务需 API Key（各 100 次免费，之后付费；渲染每次计费且失败也扣），且需 Node 22+ 与联网；程序片段会上传到 tia.hubwiz.com。

description.en: Manage MCP servers and skills from a panel in the DSH sidebar: edit rows in the profile or global cordis.patch.yml, toggle them, check whether an HTTP server answers, scan Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini configs and import the servers they declare, and browse, create, edit, enable or delete skills by rewriting the user-invocable policy in SKILL.md.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏的面板里管理 MCP 服务器与技能：编辑 profile 或全局 cordis.patch.yml 中的行、启用停用、探测 HTTP 服务器是否响应、扫描 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini 的配置并导入其中声明的服务器，以及浏览、新建、编辑、启停与删除技能（直接重写 SKILL.md 的 user-invocable 策略位）。

description.en: Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per Tavily account, plus a key and usage card on the Plugins page. The built-in web_search is never replaced.
description.zh: Tavily 搜索、提取、站点地图与爬取工具：多 Key 轮换，HTTP 401/429/432/433 故障转移，并提供按账号限制并发请求的负载均衡模式；插件配置页含密钥与用量卡片。内置 web_search 永不替换。

description.en: Checks a hazardous-chemical register for internal consistency: that each substance names its hazard class, that stored quantities parse, that a threshold is recorded, that the major-hazard-source verdict agrees with how the stored quantity compares to the threshold the register states, that safety data sheet numbers are present and CAS numbers are not duplicated. Reports differences for a human to review; it does not decide whether a unit constitutes a major hazard source.
description.zh: 核对危险化学品台账的内部自洽性：每种物质是否载明危险性类别、储存量能否解析、是否记录临界量、重大危险源判定与该储存量相对台账自述临界量的关系是否一致、是否载明安全技术说明书编号、CAS 号是否重复。只列出差异供人复核，不判定某单元是否构成重大危险源。

description.en: Runs commands as background jobs that keep executing when DSH exits, with an optional sandbox to constrain file effects, plus a live web panel and offline CLI/GUI management. Windows only for now.
description.zh: 将命令提交为独立于 DSH 进程的后台任务（可选沙箱），关闭 DSH 也不影响运行，并提供实时网页面板与离线 CLI/GUI 管理。当前仅支持Windows系统。

description.en: Standalone mobile surface for dsh: scan-to-pair device trust, realtime SSE sync, three-channel completion notifications (in-app / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram), offline outbox, approval & question panels, per-provider usage meters, PWA; a native narrow-screen phone UI.
description.zh: dsh 的独立手机端界面：扫码配对设备信任、实时 SSE 同步、三通道完成通知（应用内 / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram）、离线发件箱、审批与提问面板、多提供方用量卡、PWA；从零为窄屏设计的原生手机 UI。

description.en: Checks an FMEA worksheet for element completeness and for the arithmetic that follows from it - severity, occurrence and detection against the resulting risk priority number - following published FMEA method standards. Reports inconsistencies; it does not judge whether the ratings themselves are appropriate.
description.zh: 参照公开的 FMEA 方法标准，核对 FMEA 分析表的要素齐备性，以及严重度、发生度、探测度与风险顺序数之间的算术一致性。只报告不一致之处，不评价各项评分数值是否恰当。

description.en: Recoverable file and Git operations for coding agents, with shared recovery and redaction tools, a DSH shell adapter and audit records; optional native text-read protection is off by default.
description.zh: 为编码 Agent 提供可恢复的文件和 Git 操作、共享恢复与脱敏工具及 DSH Shell 适配器；保留审计记录，可选原生文本读取保护默认关闭。

description.en: Cross-session archive: overview workbench, folded timeline, subagent lineage, full-text search, rule+LLM summaries, ZIP export, live tracking. Native session-page embeds: turn rail, docked right panel (live mode, pinned to original session on switch), rename (official-synced), conclusion digest, health monitoring + persistent header chip (idle / active / tool-wait / stalled). dsh v0.1.2+: fuses with the official TurnNavigatorRail — vector-icon info chips (duration, tool calls, errors, thinking) plus lazy tool distribution inside the official preview card, right-click opens the workbench; the classic piano-key strip is on by default and delegates unloaded-turn jumps to the official auto-load engine; the official rail can be hidden entirely. Settings dialog section with 10 tunable behavior params.
description.zh: 跨会话档案柜：总览工作台、折叠时间线、子代理血缘、全文检索、双模式摘要、ZIP 导出、实时跟踪。会话流标签页嵌入原生会话页：轮次悬浮条、详情并入右栏（实时模式，切换会话可钉住原会话直播）、会话重命名（对齐官方即时同步）、结论摘要行、健康监控与常驻头部胶囊（空闲 / 活跃 / 工具执行 / 疑似卡死四态）。dsh v0.1.2+ 与官方轮次导航融合：官方预览卡内嵌矢量图标信息段（耗时 / 工具调用 / 错误 / 思考 + 工具分布懒加载），右键唤起会话流工作台；经典钢琴键悬浮条默认开启并存，点击未载入轮次委托官方引擎自动加载跳转；可设置隐藏官方导航只留钢琴键。设置弹窗独立分节，10 项行为参数可调。

description.en: Visual round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness — expert nodes on a ring with directed edges, an aggregation gateway, proxy thinking for black-box worker models, and adversarial review (red-team) of settled plans with per-viewpoint endorse/reject.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话变成可视化圆桌会议：环形专家拓扑、连线协作、汇聚网关、代理思考，以及「针锋相对」红队评审（观点支持/驳回）。

description.en: A full-screen novel-writing workbench: chapter board, draft candidates reviewed and merged paragraph by paragraph, plot summaries carrying an index header, and a writing pack assembled from the outline, character cards and earlier chapters. It also reads a shelf of finished books you import, extracts their writing habits in one run, merges them into a single style standard, and puts that standard in the prompt for every later generation.
description.zh: 一页式小说创作工作台：章节看板、候选稿逐段评审与合稿、带索引头的剧情总结，以及由大纲、人物卡与前文拼成的写作包。还能导入几本成品书，一次跑完粗扫、精读、汇总并融合成一套写法标准，写进偏好档案，之后每次生成都照着它来。

description.en: Account balance and cost statistics pill for DeepSeek Harness. It adds a pill at the right-hand end of the official stats row below the session composer, combining the billing period (peak/off-peak, colour-coded), the account balance and the current session cost; clicking it expands a per-session breakdown with cache-hit input, cache-miss input and output amounts, plus cost per model. The rate table is refreshed with plugin releases to follow official pricing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的账户余额及费用统计胶囊。它在会话输入框下方的官方统计行右侧新增一枚胶囊，集成计费时段（高峰/低谷，用颜色区分）、账户余额与会话费用；点击展开可查看本次会话的详细费用统计，包括缓存命中输入、缓存未命中输入、输出三项金额，以及按模型拆分的花费。费率表随插件版本更新，以跟随官方调价。

description.en: Project-level MCP servers loaded automatically: a project declares them in `.agents/mcp.json` (path and root markers configurable), and every session working inside that project mounts them in its own scope — stdio and Streamable HTTP, tools named `mcp__<server>__<tool>` — with the connections closed when the session ends. A Web UI panel lists the session's servers and their tools, and can enable or disable a project entry after confirmation, backing up and atomically rewriting the manifest.
description.zh: 自动加载项目级 MCP 服务器：项目在 `.agents/mcp.json` 中声明服务器（路径与根目录标记可配置），在项目内工作的每个会话各自的作用域里挂载——支持 stdio 与 Streamable HTTP，工具名为 `mcp__<server>__<tool>`——会话结束时断开连接。Web UI 面板列出本会话的服务器及其工具，并可在确认后启用或禁用项目条目，写入前备份并原子替换清单文件。

description.en: Renders image, video, and audio paths and URLs from DSH conversations inline, with workspace-confined local reads and an optional ComfyUI proxy.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中内联显示图像、视频和音频路径及 URL，并提供工作区受限的本地读取与可选的 ComfyUI 代理。

description.en: Drive the Unity Editor from DSH through the official unity CLI: live-Editor scene commands, in-Editor C# eval and runtime command discovery over a warm unity shell session, plus a raw CLI escape hatch for project creation, tests and builds. Mounts Unity's official skill collection alongside its own Unity workflow and Asset Store skills.
description.zh: 通过官方 unity CLI 在 DSH 中操作 Unity 编辑器：实时场景命令、编辑器内 C# 求值、运行时命令发现，均复用常驻的 unity shell 会话；另有原始 CLI 通道用于建工程、跑测试与构建。同时挂载 Unity 官方技能集，以及插件自带的 Unity 工作流与 Asset Store 技能。

description.en: Sticky-notes board for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry opens a Markdown note panel with auto-save, colors, image paste and task-list rendering.
description.zh: dsh 便签插件：侧栏入口打开 Markdown 便签面板，支持自动保存、颜色标签、粘贴图片与任务清单。

description.en: A customizable widget rail for the right side of DeepSeek Harness: 61 cards covering session stats, tokens and cache, context, background jobs, subagents, machine metrics, OpenCode Go and Command Code quota, session cost, peak pricing and the GitHub review queue. Cards install from an in-rail market into 1-4 column grids and 2x2 or 2x4 tiles, with per-instance settings, a magnification wave under the pointer and a one-click hide. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x, web UI and desktop app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧的可自定义部件栏：61 个部件覆盖会话统计、token 与缓存、上下文、后台任务、子代理、机器指标、OpenCode Go 与 Command Code 额度、会话成本、峰谷定价与 GitHub 待审队列；部件可在栏内市场安装，支持 1-4 列网格与 2x2 / 2x4 尺寸、逐实例配置、指针划过放大波峰与一键整栏收起。支持 DSH 0.1.x / 0.2.x，网页版与桌面端通用。

description.en: Answers @file completion from the Everything index through es.exe instead of walking the workspace, keeping the workspace root as the ranking scope. Windows only; needs Everything and es.exe on PATH.
description.zh: 用 es.exe 从 Everything 索引回答 @file 补全，而不是遍历工作区，并以工作区根目录作为排序范围。仅限 Windows；需先安装 Everything 与 es.exe 并加入 PATH。

description.en: Floating usage window for DSH Web showing Claude and Codex subscription windows with reset countdowns, plus DeepSeek API spend and balance; display-only companion to dsh-cost-meter.
description.zh: DSH Web 悬浮用量小窗，显示 Claude、Codex 订阅用量窗口与重置倒计时，以及 DeepSeek API 今日花费与余额；只展示，是 dsh-cost-meter 的伴侣。

description.en: Match context windows for configured DSH models in one click, show capacity sources, and support selective bulk configuration, manual editing, and continuous synchronization.
description.zh: 一键匹配 DSH 已配置模型的上下文窗口，展示容量来源，支持勾选批量配置、手动编辑和持续同步。

description.en: Host page for kit plugin configuration in the DSH Web GUI: registers a "Plugin configuration" section in Settings — peer to the built-in General section — through the official settings.section slot and declares a settings.kit.item child slot, which dsh-plugin-kit plugins render their own config cards into. Installing it alone shows an empty page; cards appear as slot-registering kit plugins are installed.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中 kit 插件配置的宿主页：经官方 settings.section 扩展点在「设置」里注册一行与「通用设置」平级的「插件配置」页，并声明子 slot「settings.kit.item」，供 dsh-plugin-kit 各插件把自己的配置卡片渲染到该页。只装本包时该页显示「暂无可用配置项」，卡片随注册该 slot 的 kit 插件出现。

description.en: A ZCode-styled skin for DSH Web: Zai light/dark themes, sidebar workspace session tree, global search, turn navigation with hover wave, and approval-card / message-keycap styling aligned to ZCode — every visual value guarded by contract assertions. A fork of MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui; do not install it alongside the upstream plugin — both repaint the same sidebar and conversation surfaces.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成 ZCode 视觉语言的皮肤：Zai 明暗主题、侧栏工作区会话树、全局搜索、带悬停波的轮次导航、对齐 ZCode 的审批卡与消息键帽样式，每个视觉值都有契约断言守护。本项目是 MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui 的分支，请勿与上游同装——两者都会重绘同一套侧栏与会话界面。

description.en: Todo plugin that records when each task is created and completed, with table, kanban, gantt and calendar views over the same data, categories, priority and type, @workspace-file links, JSON/CSV import and export, and a todo_time_log agent tool with /todo commands.
description.zh: 待办插件：自动记录每条待办的创建与完成时间，表格 / 看板 / 甘特图 / 日历四视图共用同一份数据与筛选，支持分类、优先级、类型、@工作区文件、JSON/CSV 导入导出，以及 todo_time_log 智能体工具与 /todo 命令。

description.en: Evidence-list completeness check: maps facts to evidence and reports gaps with rule IDs.
description.zh: 证据清单齐备性核对：把待证事实映射到证据并输出缺口与规则 ID。

description.en: Switchable backends behind the native web_search and web_fetch, chosen per session from a composer menu or /setup-search and /setup-fetch: DeepSeek, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily, Tinyfish, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and server-side model search for search; local HTTP with a private-network allowlist, the DeepSeek Fetch API, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily and Tinyfish for fetch.
description.zh: 为原生 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供可切换的后端，每个会话可在输入框菜单或 /setup-search、/setup-fetch 中选择：搜索支持 DeepSeek、Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily、Tinyfish、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar 与模型服务端搜索；抓取支持带内网白名单的本机 HTTP、DeepSeek Fetch API 以及 Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily、Tinyfish。

description.en: Mineradio glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: champagne-gold glass panes, a fluid or wallpaper backdrop, and a one-switch toggle that restores the stock look exactly.
description.zh: Mineradio 玻璃拟态 DSH 网页主题：香槟金玻璃面板、流体或壁纸背景，一键开关即可还原原生界面。

description.en: Visual multi-agent DAG workflows for DeepSeek Harness with live execution, restart recovery, and Feishu integration.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的可视化多智能体 DAG 工作流，支持实时执行、重启恢复和飞书集成。

description.en: Unreal Engine 4/5 (UE4, UE5) asset browser and exporter for Windows x64: browse, preview and export cooked assets from local PAK archives via CUE4Parse, with 3D mesh preview, animation playback and a searchable asset index. Oodle-compressed archives need Epic's oo2core DLL, which is not bundled but can be downloaded from the settings page.
description.zh: 虚幻引擎（Unreal Engine 4/5，UE4/UE5）资产浏览器与导出器，仅 Windows x64：通过 CUE4Parse 浏览、预览并导出本地 PAK 归档中的烘焙资产，支持模型 3D 预览、动画播放与可搜索的资产索引。Oodle 压缩的归档需要 Epic 的 oo2core DLL，包内不含，可在设置页一键下载。

description.en: HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline bundled docs), and a DevEco CLI build/sign/lint lane.
description.zh: 鸿蒙设备桥：hdc 截图/装包/日志/崩溃/UI 自动化闭环（配 read_image 看图），官方优先版本化 API 知识层（SDK .d.ts + 离线随包文档），以及 DevEco CLI 构建/签名/lint 通道。

description.en: Packaging pipeline for uni-app x projects: reads the local HBuilderX version, recommends and one-click installs the matching iOS / Android / HarmonyOS offline SDK (panel card with official download links), then drives the HBuilderX CLI to build, sign and upload apps from per-project config files; the engine also ships as list / doctor / check / build tools for the agent.
description.zh: uni-app x 项目打包流水线：读取本机 HBuilderX 版本，按版本推荐并一键配置对应的 iOS / Android / HarmonyOS 离线 SDK（面板卡片附官方下载入口），再按项目配置调用 HBuilderX CLI 打出、签名并上传；引擎同时以 list / doctor / check / build 四个工具暴露给 agent。

description.en: Complete reverse-skill pack (85 SKILL.md) as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: reverse engineering, authorized pentesting and security-research skill router.
description.zh: 完整 reverse-skill（85 个 SKILL.md）的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的技能路由包。

description.en: Checks a bid requirement by requirement against a tender requirements pack and reports which requirements appear answered, weakly matched or not located. It reports differences; it does not judge substantive compliance.
description.zh: 按招标要求逐条检查投标文件的响应位置，报告哪些要求看起来有应答、哪些匹配较弱、哪些未能定位。只报告差异，不判断是否实质满足。

description.en: Agent audio studio for DeepSeek Harness: compose from note-level scores, narrate, add sound effects and mix, then fine-tune every track on an editable timeline where each generated sound arrives as its own clip. Speech uses Edge TTS (Microsoft's public endpoint, needs ffmpeg) by default, or MiMo-V2.5-TTS with your own API key; needs Node.js 22.19+.
description.zh: 给 agent 用的音频工作室（DeepSeek Harness 插件）：写谱编曲、配音、音效与混音，生成的每个声音都以独立片段落到同一条可视化时间轴上，可逐轨试听、单独调节与微调。配音默认走 Edge TTS（微软公共接口，需要 ffmpeg），也可选用 MiMo-V2.5-TTS（需自备 API Key）；需要 Node.js 22.19+。

description.en: Promo studio panel for DSH plugins: type a plugin name, match it to a case file, and render a 28-second real-UI film plus a poster locally. The V0.1 film pipeline renders on the local Chrome with its own frame renderer (shutter-interval sampling for motion blur, hard-cut handling) and ships the composition assets, so an npm install can render without an Onetake runtime. Needs Node.js 22+, Chrome or Chromium and ffmpeg; python3 for the sound mix.
description.zh: DSH 插件宣传台面板：输入插件名称，匹配案例文件，在本机渲染 28 秒真机界面宣传片与封面。V0.1 真机片用自带的逐帧渲染器在本机 Chrome 上出帧（快门区间多采样得到运动模糊，并对硬切做保护），渲染所需的 comp 素材随包分发，因此 npm 安装后即可出片，不需要 Onetake 运行时。需要 Node.js 22+、Chrome 或 Chromium 与 ffmpeg，音效混音需要 python3。

description.en: One-click prompt refinement for the DSH composer: the ✦ button next to Send rewrites the draft into an agent-ready prompt in Standard or Light mode, with Revert and Retry; asks follow-up questions through the question card when the draft is missing information; checks that paths, identifiers, numbers, URLs, inline code and @mentions survive the rewrite and adds back any that were dropped; runs on the conversation model or a dedicated model chosen on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框一键改写提示词：点「发送」旁的 ✦，按「标准」或「轻」档把草稿改写成 Agent 可直接执行的提示词，可撤回或重试；草稿缺少信息时通过提问卡片追问；校验路径、标识符、数字、URL、行内代码与 @ 提及在改写后逐字保留，丢失的会补回；可使用会话模型，或在插件页面指定专用模型。

description.en: Automatic recovery when a turn ends badly: resume after a transient failure, continue after output truncation, re-run after an unfinished todo list, plus a request-level 429 backstop and a client dock with edit-resend, manual retry and stop-and-re-ask.
description.zh: 回合异常收尾时的自动补救：瞬时失败后续跑、输出截断后继续、待办未完成时重跑，另有一层请求级 429 兜底，以及带「改后重发 / 手动重试 / 停止并重问」的客户端停靠栏。

description.en: Windows bash tool for DeepSeek Harness: replaces the preset pwsh with Git for Windows or MSYS2 (UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64/...) bash while keeping the official terminal contract — workdir, background jobs and timeout promotion, result markers, terminal cards — and adds a settings row that discovers and validates Git/MSYS2 installations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows bash 工具：用 Git for Windows 或 MSYS2（UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64…）的 bash 替换预设里的 pwsh，保留官方终端契约（workdir、后台任务与超时转后台、结果标记、终端卡片），并提供一个可自动发现、校验 Git/MSYS2 安装的设置行。

description.en: Two-way voice for the DSH web app: dictate with the unified composer, hear replies with speaker buttons and auto-read, on any device. Needs DSH 0.1.7+, Node 22+, Python 3 with numpy and requests, a TTS model, and a microphone.
description.zh: DSH Web 的双向语音：用统一输入框听写、用朗读按钮与自动朗读听回复，任意设备可用。需 DSH 0.1.7+、Node 22+、Python 3（含 numpy 与 requests）、TTS 模型与麦克风。

description.en: Project file explorer in the details column (multi-select, drag-move, upload, download, rename, trash, system-open) with an in-session read-only preview tab for Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/notebook/PDF + code highlighting, a live model throughput badge, and a multiline GoalBar.
description.zh: DSH 右侧 details 列项目资源管理器（多选、拖拽移动、上传、下载、重命名、废纸篓、系统打开），会话内只读预览 Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/Notebook/PDF 与代码高亮，附带模型实时吞吐徽标与多行 GoalBar。

description.en: Paper trading in DSH: A-shares and commodity futures, local ledger, built-in FTShare data and K-line, and daily-close practice without buying an API key.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中进行模拟交易，支持 A 股和商品期货，本地账本，内置 FTShare 数据源与 K 线，无需购买 API Key 也可使用日K收盘价练习

description.en: Business knowledge-network context for DeepSeek Harness: bind a session to an OpenBKN knowledge network, query its objects and metrics through managed MCP tools, and open trace-backed provenance (execution facts and a business graph) for each answer. Ships with the OpenBKN Runtime; the provenance views need an OpenBKN enterprise license.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供业务知识网络上下文：将会话绑定到 OpenBKN 知识网络，通过受管 MCP 工具查询对象与指标，并为每轮回答打开可溯源的执行事实与业务上下文图。随 OpenBKN Runtime 发布；溯源视图需企业版 License。

description.en: Cross-session full-text search over persisted DSH session logs: builds an incremental message-level index and returns sessionId, seq, and a short excerpt; exposes an agent tool and a standalone panel. Requires Node.js 23.5+.
description.zh: 跨会话全文搜索：对持久化 DSH 会话日志建立增量消息级索引，返回 sessionId、seq 与摘录；提供 agent 工具和独立面板。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: Two chibi Genshin Impact desktop pets (Columbina and Nahida), 22 transparent animations each, with desktop wandering, drag-and-throw physics, click reactions, idle chatter and chat through DSH models. A fan pack derived from PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT) — it reuses upstream's /dsh-pet-7340 route and ~/.dsh/dsh-pet data directory, so install it instead of dsh-pet, not alongside it; the character art is not MIT-licensed.
description.zh: 两只原神 Q 版桌宠（哥伦比娅、纳西妲），每只 22 段透明动画；可桌面漫步、拖拽抛掷、点击反应，会碎碎念，并用 DSH 模型陪聊。本包派生自 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT），沿用上游的 /dsh-pet-7340 路由与 ~/.dsh/dsh-pet 数据目录，请替代 dsh-pet 安装、不要与它同装；角色素材不在 MIT 授权范围内。

description.en: Input experience enhancement: voice input, AI polish, anti-overwrite, prompt optimization with diff preview, and auto locale switching following DSH UI language.
description.zh: 输入体验增强插件，目前已实现语音输入、AI提示词润色（反覆盖保护、带差异预览的提示词优化）、跟随 DSH 界面语言自动切换中英文界面。

description.en: Markdown live rendering for the DSH Web UI composer: typed Markdown (bold, lists, code fences) renders as you type in a CodeMirror-based takeover composer; sent user messages render as Markdown; pasted rich text becomes clean Markdown.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 输入区 Markdown 实时渲染：输入中的粗体/列表/代码块即时成型（CodeMirror 接管卡）；已发送的用户消息按 Markdown 呈现；粘贴富文本转为干净 Markdown。

description.en: Turns the 13 δ-me13 (Amphoreus) role skill cards into seat workspaces: per-seat theme and wallpaper, first-turn skill injection, chat stickers, per-seat memory notes and presets, Alt+digit seat switching, and an overview canvas for dispatch and handoff; the skill suite itself is read from a configurable local directory and is not bundled.
description.zh: 把 δ-me13（翁法罗斯）的 13 张黄金裔角色技能卡变成席位工作区：逐席配色与壁纸、首轮自动注入技能卡、对话表情、每席记忆便签与预设、Alt+数字切席，以及用于派发与移交的总览画布；技能套件本身从可配置的本地目录读取，不随插件打包。

description.en: Multi-platform LLM balance and quota panel: configure DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, MiniMax, NewApi or custom endpoints, poll on a schedule, draw balance and quota trend charts, and push threshold and window-reset notices through multiple channels.
description.zh: 多平台 LLM 账号余额与额度面板：配置 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Kimi、智谱、MiniMax、NewApi 或自定义端点，定时自动查询并绘制趋势图，余额/额度阈值与窗口重置经多通道推送通知。

description.en: Adds an unofficial Antigravity OAuth-backed LLM route, web search, image generation and editing, video understanding, quota status, and DSH Web settings controls.
description.zh: 通过非官方 Antigravity OAuth 通道提供 LLM 路由、网页搜索、图片生成与编辑、视频理解、配额状态和 DSH Web 设置控件。

description.en: Brings SenseNova (日日新) models into dsh with a per-key rotation pool: paste any number of API keys and requests rotate across them, a 429 rate-limit immediately retries on the next key with per-key exponential-backoff cooldown, local RPM pre-throttling avoids the limit instead of reacting to it, and an exhausted pool answers 503 with Retry-After so a 429 never reaches the caller. Ships a built-in model catalogue that works offline and refreshes from /v1/models, plus a settings card with masked keys, per-key probing and removal.
description.zh: 把商汤日日新（SenseNova）模型接入 dsh，并提供按 Key 轮换的 Key 池：粘贴任意多把 API Key，请求在多把 Key 之间轮转；遇 429 限流立即换下一把 Key 重试，每把 Key 独立指数退避冷却；本地 RPM 预限流从源头避开限流，池子耗尽时回报 503 与 Retry-After，使 429 不会传到调用方。内置可离线使用的模型目录并从 /v1/models 刷新，设置卡片提供脱敏 Key 列表、单把探活与删除。

description.en: Connects CLIProxyAPI (CPA) to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with multiple accounts, model filtering, native protocols, quota lookup and image / video generation; once configured, the selected models appear in the model picker automatically.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）中接入 CLIProxyAPI（CPA），支持多账户、模型筛选、原生协议直连、额度查询、生图生视频，选好配置后自动出现在模型选择器中。

description.en: Syncs DSH skills, profile settings and AGENTS.md with a private git repository: status chip, six-section health check, pull, secret redaction, and a snapshot-then-push flow. Dry-run by default, never rebases or force-pushes.
description.zh: 把 DSH 技能、profile 设置与 AGENTS.md 与私有 git 仓库对齐：状态灯、六节体检、拉取、密钥脱敏、快照后推送。默认演练，永不 rebase 或强推。

description.en: MCP server installer and verifier for DeepSeek Harness: interactive init writes real patch entries into a profile, list and validate inspect them, and a CI-enforced verifier connects to every curated server.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器安装与验证工具：交互式 init 会把真实 patch 条目写进 profile，list 与 validate 检查配置，CI 强制的验证器逐个连接精选服务器。
