description.en: OpenRouter provider that reads the live /models list, so new models appear without a harness release: models sorted by name with input/output prices, per-model reasoning levels, image input, reasoning_details replay, Anthropic prompt caching, and actual spend per session including subagents from OpenRouter usage.cost, shown under the Web UI composer and by /cost.
description.zh: 读取 OpenRouter 实时 /models 列表的模型提供商，新模型无需等待 harness 发版即可出现：模型按名称排序并显示输入/输出价格，按模型提供思考档位、图片输入、reasoning_details 回放、Anthropic 提示缓存，并按 OpenRouter usage.cost 统计本会话（含子代理）的实际花费，显示在 Web 输入框下方并可用 /cost 查看。

description.en: A shared todo list for DeepSeek Harness: you and your agent manage the same tasks from a sidebar page or todo tools, with per-project and global todos, and one-click task references into the composer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的人机共享待办：你和 AI 通过侧边栏或待办工具管理同一份任务，支持项目级与全局待办，并可一键把任务引用进输入框。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Multisim MCP for circuit generation, simulation, diagnostics, design optimization, and experiment report export.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Multisim MCP，用于生成电路、运行仿真、诊断与优化设计，并导出实验报告。

description.en: Add your own parameters to the model requests dsh sends: OpenRouter provider routing and fallback models, reasoning, sampling and custom body fields, and headers, for OpenRouter or any other gateway. Parameters are organized by the channels dsh already has; a live preview shows what each request will carry, and a request log shows what was sent and what the gateway answered.
description.zh: 给 dsh 发出的模型请求加上自己的参数：OpenRouter 供应商路由和备用模型、思考强度、采样参数与自定义请求体字段、请求头，OpenRouter 和其他网关都能用。参数按 dsh 已配置的渠道管理；实时预览显示每个请求会多出什么，请求记录显示实际发出了什么、网关回了什么。

description.en: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 native agent preset and standalone Cordis plugin: 13 modules, persistent controller and decoupled workspace.
description.zh: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 原生智能体预设与 Cordis 插件：提供 13 大认知工程模块、持久化控制器与状态外化工作区。

description.en: Force-hides archived sessions from the DSH sidebar whatever the view filter is set to, and adds a panel that restores them or deletes them permanently - session log directory, archive and pin records, and projection cache.
description.zh: 无论侧栏「归档显示」如何设置都强制隐藏已归档会话，并提供管理面板：取消归档，或彻底删除会话日志目录、归档与置顶登记及投影缓存。

description.en: A plugin for dsh: quantify every dsh Agent interaction as a visualized performance metric and automatically sync it to WakaTime, using data to showcase your productivity with Agent.
description.zh: 将DSH的每一次Agent交互量化为可视化表现指标并自动同步至WakaTime,用数据展示你与Agent协作的生产力

description.en: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing with credits estimation, subscription balance and web settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Labnana 图片生成：文生图 / 图生图 / 精准编辑，含积分预估、余额查询与网页设置界面。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness Web to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB for schema discovery and read-only queries through session-authorized MCP tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 数据库插件：统一管理 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle 和 MongoDB 连接，让 Agent 按会话授权探索数据结构、执行只读查询并辅助数据分析。

description.en: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official todo_write tool: priority tags on each task, full checklist rendering in the conversation, and a draggable in-session floating task panel with position memory, double-click reset and a live indicator of the action currently being executed.
description.zh: 官方 todo_write 的增强 fork：任务项支持优先级标签、会话内完整清单渲染，并提供可拖动的会话内浮动任务面板（位置记忆 / 双击复位 / 当前动作显示）。

description.en: Anthropic Sans, Serif, and Mono fonts for the DSH Web UI, with Source Han fallback for CJK.
description.zh: Anthropic Sans/Serif/Mono 字体：界面 Sans、对话 Serif、代码 Mono，中文回退思源字体。

description.en: Desktop notification and sound when a turn completes, the agent asks a question, or an approval is requested, each independently toggleable, plus an activity ball that lists live sessions and jumps back to one.
description.zh: 跑完 / 提问 / 需要审批时弹桌面通知与提示音（三类可分别开关），另附活动悬浮球，点会话行直接跳回该会话。

description.en: Switchable liquid-glass theme for the DSH web UI — 14 panels become frosted glass over a fluid backdrop, with material sliders and hover elasticity.
description.zh: 可切换的 DSH 网页端液态玻璃主题——14 个面板在流体背景上变成磨砂玻璃，材质参数有滑杆，悬停时玻璃与面板内容一起倾斜。

description.en: AI companion with a learned body clock, real offline sleep, its own memory, and self-reported affect delivered through the same judge math as the pi version.
description.zh: 有生物钟、会真实睡觉、有自己的记忆和情绪的 AI 伴侣，主动冲动以独立 turn 投递。

description.en: Read-only Git panel for the current workspace — branch, changed files, diffs and image before/after compare — plus three capsules above the composer (Git status, tool and skill activity, session running time) and per-session change attribution with review progress.
description.zh: 当前工作区的只读 Git 面板：分支、改动清单、差异与图片前后对比，外加输入框上方的三枚胶囊（Git 状态、工具与技能活动、会话运行时长），以及本会话改动归因与审阅进度。

description.en: Adds human-facing TypeSafe Jev advice to DSH multiple-choice prompts, on demand by default with optional automatic requests, recommendations, probabilities, confidence, close-call warnings, copyable suggestions, one-click adoption, profile-scoped card layouts, temporary decision preferences, optional request previews with common-credential masking, and local health checks with sanitized diagnostic exports.
description.zh: 为 DSH 选择题提供面向用户的 TypeSafe Jev 第二意见，默认按需询问、可选自动获取，展示推荐、概率和置信度，支持分歧提示、复制建议、一键采纳、按 profile 保存卡片布局、临时决策偏好、可选发送前预览与常见凭证遮盖，并提供本地健康检查和脱敏诊断复制。

description.en: Per-round cache billing inside the composer context-meter popover: what the current call spends on cache hits, misses, and output in CNY, with automatic official peak/off-peak and per-model pricing; hidden on non-official DeepSeek routes.
description.zh: 点开输入框旁的上下文圆环即见本轮账单：缓存命中/未命中/输出各花多少钱（¥），官方峰谷价与模型分价自动判定；非 DeepSeek 官方路由不显示。

description.en: Tone or voice alerts for DSH approvals, questions, completions, errors and stalls; reads out what is waiting and repeats until handled; no network requests.
description.zh: DSH 提醒音：审批、提问、完成、错误、卡住各有音色；选「语音」会念出工具名、原因或问题原文；未处理会重复提醒，全程不联网。

description.en: OpenCode Go in the DeepSeek Harness model list, providing subscription quota display, model discovery, session affinity, and more.
description.zh: 把OpenCode Go接入DSH的模型列表，提供订阅额度显示、模型发现、会话亲和等功能。

description.en: Three tools that let any agent, including a team member, list, steer and stop the subagents it started.
description.zh: 三个工具，让任意智能体（包括团队成员）能列出、追问并中止自己派出的子代理。

description.en: Pre-execution guard: a `tools.guard` predicate decides allow, ask or refuse per permission preset for dangerous shell commands (git hook bypass, catastrophic `rm`, download-and-run, git history rewrites) and for edits to credential paths or to files the turn never read, and hands the model the reason plus a working alternative.
description.zh: 执行前拦截：`tools.guard` 谓词按当前权限档位，对危险 shell 命令（跳过 git 钩子、灾难性 `rm`、下载即执行、重写 git 历史）与「写凭据路径」「没读过目标文件的首次编辑」逐条给出放行 / 询问 / 拒绝，并把成因与可行替代写法交回模型。

description.en: Turns an ordinary conversation into a guided study session, keeping progress and lectures as dated files that survive a restart. A Study tab shows how far you have got and which ideas are still shaky without writing anything, and a Lectures tab lists each course's lectures as draft, dated, or archived.
description.zh: 把一段普通对话变成会按你的回答调整的引导式学习。插件生成学习记录和讲义；学习进度标签页追踪你的进度和生疏概念；讲义页按课程列出讲义。这些文件持久化到工作区，重启后仍可读取。

description.en: DeepSeek-styled cross-session token usage, request count, and tiered cost analytics dashboard.
description.zh: 仿 DeepSeek 官方 Token 统计，跨会话 Token 消耗、请求次数与峰谷分时费用统计看板。

description.en: Study workspace for DeepSeek Harness: imports your own PDF, DOCX, PPTX and Markdown materials plus lecture recordings, turns them into source-cited flashcards, quizzes and open questions, and schedules spaced review with FSRS-6 in a built-in web panel. Imported recordings are transcribed with your own SiliconFlow, Groq or Gemini key; live classes can instead use an on-device SenseVoice engine that needs no key (about 239 MB on first install); requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or later but below 0.3.
description.zh: DSH 的学习工作台：导入自己的 PDF、DOCX、PPTX、Markdown 资料与课堂录音，生成带出处引用的卡片、测验与开放题，按 FSRS-6 安排间隔复习，自带网页面板。导入的录音需用自备的 SiliconFlow、Groq 或 Gemini 密钥转写；课堂实录可改用本机 SenseVoice 引擎，无需密钥（首次约下载 239 MB）；需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 及以上、0.3 以下。

description.en: Full-screen video boot splash — play an mp4 at startup, skip with a click, import your own clip, and non-playable codecs are transcoded to H.264 automatically.
description.zh: 视频开机片头：启动时全屏播放 mp4，点击或 Esc 跳过，可导入自己的视频，浏览器解不了的编码自动转成 H.264。

description.en: Two-suit VTuber theme for Joi: Flowers and Library are separate token systems for light and dark, with a standing portrait and a whale girl napping on the headline of the new-session page, two chibi companions above the composer that follow the turn state, a duo sidebar mark, and a context meter shaped as a ripening mandarin; a third card returns the stock DeepSeek look with the plugin still installed.
description.zh: 轴伊 Joi 双衣装主题：Flowers 与 Library 是各自成套的明暗令牌体系，新会话页有立绘与趴在标题上的鲸鱼娘，输入框上方两只 Q 版角色随本回合状态换表情，侧栏字标换成二人合影，上下文占用由一颗渐熟的橘子表示；第三张卡可在保持插件安装的前提下切回 DeepSeek 原生外观。

description.en: Mounts the hosted ROFilter MCP service (rofilter.cn) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge. ROFilter is a reverse-osmosis membrane system design tool with a 742-element library across 8 brands (Veolia, DuPont, Toray, LG, Hydranautics, CSM, Vontron, Ovay), feed-water analysis, scaling assessment, and full multi-stage system design (feed pressure, permeate TDS, energy, per-stage flux). Ships a shared trial token (1,000 calls per day for all users) and run_design is metered, so use your own rofilter.cn token for real work.
description.zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接接入托管的 ROFilter MCP 服务（rofilter.cn）。ROFilter 是一款反渗透膜系统设计软件，内置 742 件膜元件库（威立雅、杜邦、东丽、LG、海德能、CSM、沃顿、澳维 8 大品牌）、进水水质分析、结垢评估与完整多段系统设计（进水压力、产水 TDS、能耗、逐段通量）。自带一个所有用户共用的试用令牌（每天 1000 次调用），run_design 会计量，正式使用请换成你自己的 rofilter.cn 令牌。

description.en: Bidi-safe RTL rendering for mixed Arabic and English text, a full Arabic interface pack (3,307 strings) registered through the DSH locale service, and three thmanyah cuts — Sans for the interface, Serif Text for reading, Serif Display for headings — placed behind whatever font the app itself is set to.
description.zh: 让 DSH 界面说阿拉伯语：混合阿拉伯文与英文的双向文本排版，通过 DSH 官方语言服务注册完整阿拉伯语界面包（3,307 条），并内置三款 thmanyah 字体（界面 Sans、正文 Serif Text、标题 Serif Display），置于应用自身字体设置之后。

description.en: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.
description.zh: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。

description.en: Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) web suite as native DSH providers and tools: rebinds the built-in web_search and web_fetch to Zhipu web search and Markdown page reading, optionally registers github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file repo tools, and adds a settings card with toggles and a credential-ref field.
description.zh: 智谱（GLM Coding Plan）三件套以原生 provider 与工具接入：内置 web_search / web_fetch 后端切换为智谱联网搜索与网页 Markdown 读取，可选注册 github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file 开源仓库工具，附设置卡片配置开关与凭据引用名。

description.en: Registers the minas-webdav MCP server as one stdio row, giving the agent 14 tools for a Xiaomi Smart Storage (MINAS) NAS without mounting it: list, stat, tree, find, du, df, cat, upload, download, mkdir, move, copy, delete and a capability probe. The Python package behind it is installed separately with pipx.
description.zh: 把 minas-webdav MCP server 注册成一行 stdio 配置，给 agent 14 个工具，不挂盘直接操作小米智能存储（MINAS）：列目录、stat、tree、find、du、df、cat、上传下载、mkdir、移动复制删除，另带能力探测。Python 包需另行 pipx 安装。

description.en: No longer updated: folded into dsh-lifeguard (last release 0.2.2). It checked a plugin against what was installed and flagged only real conflicts.
description.zh: 已停止更新：功能合并进 dsh-lifeguard（最后一版 0.2.2）。原来做的是：装插件前先跟已装的比一遍，真会撞上才说一句，先说原因再给动作，装还是照装。

description.en: NSFC grant application format and anonymization check against the annual guidelines.
description.zh: 国自然申请书形式审查与匿名化核对。

description.en: Map and routing tools: driving/transit/walking/bicycling route planning, geocoding and POI search via free OSM/OSRM data by default, with an optional Amap (高德) key for better China coverage.
description.zh: 地图与路径规划工具：驾车/公交/步行/骑行路线、地理编码与 POI 搜索。默认零 key 使用 OSM/OSRM 免费数据，可选配置高德 key 获得更优的国内覆盖。

description.en: Remote access to running DeepSeek Harness sessions from a phone browser: scan a one-time QR code to continue conversations, answer approvals and start new tasks over Wi-Fi or a tunnel.
description.zh: 远程连接正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 会话：手机浏览器扫码即可继续对话、处理审批、新建任务，支持同一 Wi-Fi 或临时隧道。

description.en: Session-affinity keys for LLM gateway requests: it decorates the official pi-ai adapter so Chat Completions calls carry session_id and x-client-request-id headers and Anthropic Messages calls carry a session-derived metadata.user_id, which lets a gateway pin requests per session and raise prompt-cache hits. It registers no provider and takes nothing over — the official llm-pi-ai keeps serving, and disabling or uninstalling the plugin leaves its behaviour unchanged.
description.zh: LLM 网关会话亲和键:装饰官方 pi-ai adapter,Chat Completions 请求补 session_id 与 x-client-request-id 头,Anthropic Messages 注入按会话派生的 metadata.user_id,供网关按会话钉住请求、提升 prompt cache 命中。不注册 provider、不接管官方 llm-pi-ai:官方继续服务,禁用或卸载后行为回到原样。

description.en: HAZOP worksheet check: node, guide word, process parameter, deviation and cause, plus required fields and locally configured risk levels.
description.zh: HAZOP 分析表核对：节点、引导词、工艺参数、偏差与原因，以及必填栏目与本机构风险等级口径。

description.en: A second brain for DeepSeek Harness where Markdown is the database and git is the sync, with zero runtime dependencies. Core memory is injected into every system prompt, one file per note with weighted search; cards produced in the sidebar web chat land in an inbox first and are approved one by one as cloud notes or local-only notes (private/ is permanently gitignored and never pushed); web-chat progress is saved to progress.md with the last 20 drafts archived. A four-step flow lives behind one header icon: open web chat, extract cards, review them, back up to the cloud. The extraction prompt is editable in the panel and applies immediately.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的第二大脑：Markdown 当数据库，零运行时依赖。核心记忆常驻系统提示，一张卡一个文件并可全文检索；侧栏网页版拆好的卡片先进收件箱，逐张人工确认后「存到云端」或「只存本地」（private/ 被 .gitignore 永久排除，绝不推送）；网页版对话进度存成 progress.md，旧稿归档保留 20 份。云端可三选一：Git 仓库、OneDrive 等同步盘文件夹、只存本机。安装后首次启动有一页新手引导。会话顶栏四步流水线：打开网页版 → 整理成卡片 → 逐张确认 → 备份到云端。拆卡提示词可在面板里直接改，改完立即生效。

description.en: STM32 complete process tool - environment detection, .ico transactions, generating project, compiling, burning, debugging.
description.zh: STM32全流程工具--环境探测、.ico事务、生成工程、编译、烧录、调试。

description.en: AI-managed Auto Compact for DeepSeek Harness: in the Block PTC preset (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer), the agent decides when to organize context and what to retain as work progresses, without waiting for a fixed token threshold.
description.zh: AI 自主管理上下文的 Auto Compact：在 Block PTC 预设会话中（需 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 及以上），由 AI 根据任务进展决定何时整理上下文、保留哪些信息，不必等待固定 token 阈值触发。

description.en: Balance badge that follows the active model provider: official readings for DeepSeek, Qwen Token Plan and Aliyun BSS, plus Moonshot and OpenRouter endpoints not yet key-verified.
description.zh: 跟随当前模型供应商的额度徽标：DeepSeek、千问 Token Plan、阿里云费用中心取官方真值，Moonshot / OpenRouter 已接官方端点但字段未用真 Key 核对；其余只报本实例实测。

description.en: Keeps terminology in two-level plain-text glossaries and injects a term's meaning the first time it appears in a session.
description.zh: 把约定俗成的称谓存成两层纯文本字典，某个词第一次出现时自动把它的口径注入上下文；带查／写／体检三条工具与设置面板。

description.en: Manage which models appear in the composer model menu. A settings page lists every provider's models with a per-model switch, provider-level show/hide, collapsible groups and filters by kind; switched-off models leave the menu while the model in use in the current session stays. The list can be searched by name or ID and filtered by capability (multimodal, reasoning) and by minimum context window (128K / 256K / 512K / 1M). Rows show the model kind, and chat models also show reasoning support with the adapter's effort levels, their context window and input modalities. Labels merge manual overrides, the settings document, the adapter, the relay's GET /models response, a built-in pi-ai / models.dev catalog, name inference and vendor corrections in that priority order, with the source named on hover and dashed borders marking inferred values. Any model can be edited by hand (kind, context window, modalities, effort levels); those edits are stored outside the profile and can be written back into the model provider's settings. A hard re-fetch drops every cache and asks the adapter and all relays again. A switch, on by default, lets relay routes whose models declare text-only input accept images in memory, without editing configuration files. The hidden list is stored in the profile patch and mirrored to $DSH_HOME.
description.zh: 管理哪些模型出现在输入框的模型菜单里。设置页按 Provider 列出模型，支持逐模型开关、渠道级批量显隐、整组折叠和按类型筛选；关闭的模型从菜单中消失，当前会话正在使用的模型保留。还能按名称 / ID 搜索，按能力（多模态、支持推理）和上下文下限（128K / 256K / 512K / 1M）过滤。每行标注模型类型，对话模型另外标注是否支持推理、适配器公布的思考强度档位、上下文窗口和输入模态。标签按优先级合并手动覆盖、设置文档、适配器、中转站 GET /models 响应、内置 pi-ai / models.dev 目录、模型名推断和厂商校正，悬停显示来源，虚线边框表示推断值。任意模型都可以手动指定类型、上下文窗口、输入模态和思考强度档位；这些覆盖不写 profile 补丁，并且可以写回模型提供商的设置。工具栏的「重新获取能力」会让全部缓存作废并重新询问适配器与所有中转站。一个默认开启的开关让声明纯文本输入的中转站模型真正能接收图片，只在内存里生效，不改配置文件。隐藏列表保存在 profile patch 中，并镜像到 $DSH_HOME。

description.en: A tiny always-on floating tree of the DSH workspaces, conversations and subagents that are running, waiting on you or on a schedule — live running state, who is waiting for your call, per-row model, scheduled-run countdowns, other local dsh instances with their ports, and local claude/codex CLI processes with their codex subagent threads.
description.zh: 一张常驻角落的迷你 agent 树：按 workspace → 对话 → subagent 实时展示谁在跑，等你拍板的会话琥珀色置顶，行内显示模型与定时任务倒计时；同时接上本机其它端口的 dsh 实例（会话数 / subagent 数可展开），并列出本机 claude/codex 进程及其子对话。

description.en: Share your conversations with one click.
description.zh: 一键分享你的对话。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks: event→command declarations in cordis.patch.yml, with Feishu card notifications and a QR scan-to-create bot setup.
description.zh: 配置驱动生命周期 hooks：在 cordis.patch.yml 声明事件→命令，附飞书卡片通知与扫码一键创建机器人。

description.en: Search titles and saved text across ordinary DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations in all workspaces, optionally including archived chats, with Ctrl+F / Cmd+F search inside the current conversation.
description.zh: 搜索 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）各工作区普通对话的标题和已保存正文，可包含归档；也可按 Ctrl+F / Cmd+F 查找当前对话。

description.en: HS code classification consistency check: chapter, heading, subheading and code hierarchy.
description.zh: HS 编码归类层级一致性核对：章、品目、子目与商品编号层级。

description.en: Project-scoped Git credentials: forge accounts (GitHub, Gitea, GitLab, Bitbucket or a custom host) live in the right-sidebar "Git Forge" tab, are granted per project, and reach the agent as an HTTPS credential helper so the token never enters the conversation. Pushes to a host the project has not granted are rejected.
description.zh: 项目级 Git 凭据：forge 账号（GitHub、Gitea、GitLab、Bitbucket 或自定义域名）在右侧栏「Git 凭据」标签页里管理并可按项目授权，再由生成的凭据 helper 交给 agent 走 HTTPS 推送，token 不进对话；未授权 host 的推送会被拦截器直接拒绝。

description.en: Annotation browser in the DSH sidebar: a real Chrome page streamed over CDP with input forwarded, where picking an element or selecting text attaches its source location, component stack, styles and a crop to the chat input. Needs a local Chrome (on Windows set chromePath).
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏里的标注浏览器：通过 CDP 推流并转发输入的实时页面，点选元素或划选文字后，把源码位置、组件栈、样式与裁图带进聊天输入框。需本机 Chrome（Windows 须设置 chromePath）。

description.en: Syncs the wallpaper currently applied in Wallpaper Engine to the DSH Web UI background through a local bridge: preview/capture/full render modes, monitor lock, a wallpaper library panel for local and market content, focus lens with eye tracking, immersive mode, and a Windows app launcher that installs software from direct links or a cloud-drive share link and starts it with one click.
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 当前应用的壁纸经本地桥接同步为 DSH Web 界面背景：预览/捕获/完整三档渲染、显示器锁定、本地与市场壁纸库面板、专注透镜与眼动追踪、沉浸模式，以及支持直链与网盘分享链接安装、一键启动的 Windows 应用启动器。

description.en: Skips offscreen chat and trajectory rows so long sessions scroll smoothly; measured row heights keep the scrollbar steady, visible content unchanged.
description.zh: 让视口外的聊天行与轨迹行不参与渲染，长会话滚动更稳；行高按实测保留，滚动条不跳，屏幕内画面不变。

description.en: JetBrains Database-style data source tree and SQL/Redis consoles with 15 agent tools for DeepSeek Harness. SQL needs Java 8+ installed, Redis does not.
description.zh: 仿 JetBrains Database 的数据源树与 SQL/Redis 控制台，附 15 个 agent 工具。SQL 需本机 Java 8+，Redis 不需要。

description.en: Desktop pet companion for DSH with live task HUD, token and cost stats, balance and peak-hour alerts, reasoning-effort control, current and history conversation search, and session management.
description.zh: DSH 桌面伴侣：任务实时 HUD、Token 与费用统计、余额与峰谷提醒、推理等级切换、当前与历史对话搜索、会话管理。

description.en: Request-side injection and jailbreak plugin for DeepSeek Harness: rewrites only the request copy sent to the model — system-prompt sections, fabricated turns, and keyword or regex replacement — leaving the conversation log and host files untouched; ships unrestricted / nsfw / authority presets, imports the dsh-purge 破甲 prompt as an ordinary preset, enables per agent preset, always-on, or by model and agent preset, and records each injection as a collapsible row in the session.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的请求侧注入与破甲 / 越狱插件：只改写发给模型的请求副本（系统提示词系统段、构造回合、关键词与正则替换），不写入会话记录、不改动宿主文件；内置 unrestricted / nsfw / authority 三个预设，可把 dsh-purge 破甲稿作为普通预设导入，支持按模式自动生效、常驻启用，或按模型与 agent preset 限定，每次注入在会话里留一条可折叠记录。

description.en: Durable background child agents on the official subagent seam: start from any session, watch progress in the Web UI sidebar, message and interrupt any time, with per-child tool scoping, persona and delegation-depth caps.
description.zh: 官方子代理接缝上的持久化后台子代理：任意会话中启动，Web 侧边栏看进度、随时留言与打断，支持按子代理限定工具、人格与委托深度。

description.en: Only the domains you list go through a proxy: add a model host that needs the proxy to be reachable, and web search plus every other request stays on the normal network. Multiple named proxies can serve different domains, with a never-proxy list on top; saved settings apply on the next request without a restart.
description.zh: 某个模型的 API 要代理才连得上？把它的域名填进来就行——只有你列出的域名走代理，网页搜索等其它请求照旧直连，互不打扰。可以配多个代理分给不同域名，也能指定某些域名永远不走代理；保存后下一次请求就生效，不用重启。

description.en: Desktop full-screen boot splash. It covers DSH's loading card before first paint, plays a 4.5 s five-stage compass sequence, then hands off to the app; clicking anywhere skips ahead, and reopening the window from the tray replays it. The first cold start may hitch once, then runs smoothly.
description.zh: 桌面端全屏启动动画：在 DSH 加载卡出现前接住首帧，播放 4.5 秒五阶段罗盘序列后交接；点按任意处可跳过，从托盘重开窗口会重播。冷启动首帧可能顿一下，之后流畅。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH Web sessions: browser notifications plus Windows toast when a session finishes, fails, needs an approval, or asks a question. Clicking one opens the session; browser notifications focus an open tab, Windows toasts open a new tab.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 会话提供桌面通知：会话完成、失败、需要审批或提问时发送浏览器通知，在 Windows/WSL 下同时弹出系统 Toast；点击通知定位到对应会话（浏览器通知聚焦已打开标签页，Toast 新开标签页）。

description.en: Daily chronicle for DeepSeek Harness: collects session events, closes the previous calendar day after midnight into a Markdown week file (LLM scoring adds a daily summary; rule scoring does not), and extracts durable facts — decisions, conventions, pitfalls — that merge across days and can be superseded. 10 tools, a read-only sidebar panel, rule export, and a standalone Obsidian vault; zero third-party dependencies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的每日编年史：采集会话事件，跨过午夜后把上一自然日收口进 Markdown 周文件（LLM 打分才产日结，规则档不产），并提炼跨天合并、可被推翻的持久事实（决策 / 约定 / 坑）。10 个工具、只读侧栏面板、规则导出；产物是独立的 Obsidian vault，零第三方依赖。

description.en: WeChat Official Account typesetting workbench: renders Markdown into inline-styled HTML you paste straight into the WeChat editor, with a sidebar panel, 11 themes and five model tools for block-level revision.
description.zh: 微信公众号排版工作台：把 Markdown 渲染成带内联样式的 HTML，粘进公众号编辑器即成排版；配右侧栏面板、11 套主题与五个模型工具做块级改稿。

description.en: Image generation for DSH in two modes — an image_generate_lite tool the model calls from chat, and a right-sidebar studio for manual runs; up to five reference images, the OpenAI images API format, keys kept in the DSH credential service.
description.zh: DSH 生图插件，双模式：对话中由模型调用 image_generate_lite 工具出图，或在右侧栏「生图工作台」手动生图；最多 5 张参考图、支持 OpenAI images 接口格式，密钥存于 DSH 凭据服务。

description.en: Auto-expands streaming thinking: always keeps the latest thinking block expanded, manual actions take priority, only the last block expands when opening a session, and nothing remains after uninstall.
description.zh: 流式思考自动展开：始终显示最新一条思考，手动操作优先，打开会话仅展开最后一条，卸载无残留。

description.en: File-change monitor and code editor for the DSH Web UI. Agent edits appear beside your conversation as real-time line-by-line diffs, with a syntax-highlighted editor, one-click revert, change history, workspace switcher, and per-session isolation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的文件修改监视器与代码工作台。Agent 修改代码时实时浮现逐行 Diff，内置语法高亮编辑器，支持一键还原、修改历史、工作区切换与按会话隔离。

description.en: Adds an appearance settings page to DeepSeek Harness: five eye-comfort light themes, each with its own accent and link colours, plus controls for the accent and background colours, UI and code fonts and sizes, font styles, content width, contrast and reduced motion.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加外观设置页：五套护眼浅色主题，每套主题自带匹配的强调色与链接色；另可调整强调色与背景色、界面与代码的字体和字号、字体样式、内容宽度、对比度与减少动态效果。

description.en: Settings section that reports token usage: totals for input, output, cache read, cache write, reasoning and call count, with breakdowns by model, day, month and project plus a per-day trend chart for the last 30 days; history is rebuilt once on a worker thread and then kept current from live session events.
description.zh: 设置中的 Token 用量面板：总量（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写/推理/调用次数），按模型、按天、按月、按项目的明细，以及最近 30 天的按日趋势折线图；历史在 Worker 线程上一次性重建，之后由会话事件实时累加。

description.en: Full vision-capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a vision_understand tool (OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash by default) plus paste/drag-and-drop/button entry points for image recognition.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视觉能力全家桶：vision_understand 工具（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API，默认免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash）+ 粘贴/拖拽/按钮三入口识图。

description.en: Adds a Download button to DSH Web GUI delivery cards, so files delivered with present save straight from the browser.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 交付卡片上增加下载按钮，present 交付的文件可直接从浏览器下载。

description.en: Plays a short synthesized ding in the browser tab the moment an agent finishes a turn, built entirely with the Web Audio API; no backend audio and no OS notification.
description.zh: agent 回合结束时在浏览器标签页里播放一声合成的叮,纯前端 Web Audio 发音,不经过后端、不弹系统通知。

description.en: Records DeepSeek Harness runtime errors and coding retrospectives as an interactive GPU graph, and feeds the recorded lessons back into the model's context.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的运行错误与编程任务复盘渲染成可交互的 GPU 图谱，并把记录下来的教训送回模型上下文。

description.en: Group skills into named sets, toggle any combination, drag to reorder, and preview each group catalog token cost.
description.zh: 把技能归入具名分组，自由勾选组合切换，拖拽排序，并预览每组的目录 token 成本。

description.en: Adds a red "Delete session" item beneath "Archive" in the sidebar session menu, with a custom confirmation dialog, for real session deletion — stops the session's running work, detaches its workspace, archive and pin accounting, removes its projection cache and log directory, then broadcasts removal so the row disappears at once, instead of only archiving it. Session deletion removes the conversation from disk permanently and cannot be undone.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单的「归档会话」下方新增红色「删除会话」项，配自定义确认对话框，实现真正的会话删除——停止会话进行中的工作、摘除工作区/归档/置顶记账、删除投影缓存与日志目录，然后广播移除事件让该行立即消失，而不是只能归档。会话删除会把对话从磁盘彻底移除且无法恢复；删除会话与会话删除是同一种操作的两种叫法，搜其中任意一种都可以找到本插件。

description.en: Brings the free models of a locally installed OpenCode CLI into DSH: starts or reuses a local opencode serve, discovers the live catalog and refreshes it every five minutes, and bridges the session event stream to OpenAI-compatible SSE through a loopback-only shim that validates Host and Origin.
description.zh: 把本机已安装的 OpenCode CLI 免费模型接入 DSH：自动拉起或复用本地 opencode serve，读取实时模型目录并每五分钟刷新，再通过仅绑定回环、校验 Host 与 Origin 的 shim 把会话事件流转换为 OpenAI 兼容 SSE。

description.en: Git workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness: a repo-gated composer button opens a settings-style panel for diff/commit, branch, conflict, and worktree management, plus a commit history with branch-graph lines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作区管理：输入框「模式」选择器旁的仓库感知入口，打开与设置同规格的面板，覆盖 diff/commit、分支、冲突、worktree 管理与带分支线的提交历史。

description.en: Browser-first, LAN-only access to the current DeepSeek Harness Web UI with one-time QR pairing, revocable devices, event-driven diagnostics, and a slot-preserving mobile layout; no companion app, cloud relay, or remote tunnel.
description.zh: 以浏览器为核心、仅限局域网访问当前 DeepSeek Harness Web UI，支持一次性二维码配对、设备撤销、事件驱动诊断和保留插槽的移动端布局；无需配套应用、云中继或远程隧道。

description.en: Synthesises speech through Alibaba Bailian's WebSocket TTS and returns a WAV file plus a preview URL, with an optional per-turn hint that nudges the model towards voice. Needs a Bailian API key and ffmpeg, and the text is sent to Alibaba Cloud; the plugin does not send messages itself — delivery is left to the session's own transport.
description.zh: 调用阿里百炼 WebSocket TTS 合成语音，返回 WAV 文件与试听地址，并可按轮提示模型使用语音。需要百炼 API Key 与 ffmpeg，文本会发送到阿里云；插件本身不发消息，怎么发由当前会话的传输方式决定。

description.en: Back up your DSH profile configuration to a private GitHub Gist on a schedule, with merged restore.
description.zh: 定时把 DSH 配置备份到私有 GitHub Gist，支持合并恢复。

description.en: ZCode-style persistent project memory with a full settings manager, index-first injection and agent memory tools.
description.zh: ZCode 风格持久化项目记忆：设置内完整管理页、索引式注入与 agent 记忆工具。

description.en: Self-contained literature library for DSH with optional Zotero export: full-text PDF fetching (Unpaywall/arXiv/custom URL templates), loose Crossref-backed search, APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago citation generation, a side-panel PDF reader with highlights and notes, and AI-assisted Q&A/translation steered into the current conversation.
description.zh: DSH 内置文献库（可选导出到 Zotero）：通过 Unpaywall/arXiv/自定义 URL 模板获取全文 PDF，Crossref 候选式宽松搜索，APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago 引用生成，侧窗 PDF 阅读器（高亮与笔记），以及注入当前对话的 AI 问答/翻译。

description.en: Adds a muted looping video behind the Harness workspace and makes the composer translucent after the boot splash finishes.
description.zh: 在 Harness 工作区后播放静音循环视频，并在开屏动画结束后将输入区域显示为半透明。

description.en: Zotero library tools via the local API (no API key, Zotero 7+): search items and collections, read metadata, abstracts and PDF full text (on-the-fly parsing when the cache misses), download attachments, and manage notes; API endpoint, target library and limits are configurable.
description.zh: 通过 Zotero 本地 API（无需 API Key，Zotero 7+）操作文献库：检索条目与分类、读元数据/摘要/PDF 全文（缓存未命中时现场解析）、下载附件、管理笔记；API 地址、目标文献库与限额均可配置。

description.en: A companion plugin for dsh-pet: gives the desktop pet a persona card, Chinese reasoning lines, click reactions, and a daily diary she writes herself.
description.zh: dsh-pet 的附属插件：给桌面上的鲸鱼娘套上二次元人格，让她的思考过程说中文、被点会回话，还会每天自己写一篇日记。

description.en: Release gate for AI answer quality. Two channels: replay an existing VeriScope archive through the original Python quality gate, or run a threshold gate over a Ragas per-row export with Node only — no VeriScope, Python or pandas. Returns PASS, FAIL or REVIEW with source evidence and a re-checkable receipt; supports per-row thresholds and exact decimal comparison. It never re-evaluates and never calls a model, and REVIEW never becomes PASS.
description.zh: AI 回答质量的发布门禁。两条通道：用原 Python 门禁重放 VeriScope 归档，或仅用 Node 对 Ragas 逐条导出做阈值判定，后者不需要 VeriScope、Python 或 pandas。返回通过／失败／待复核，附出处与可复验回执；支持逐条阈值与精确十进制比较。不重新评测、不调用模型，待复核永不转为通过。

description.en: Per-session note list beside the conversation: a button at the top right of the chat badges the open count and opens a resizable right-side panel where notes are added, checked off, copied, edited or appended to the chat input, with panel size and drafts kept in the browser.
description.zh: 对话旁的会话级便笺：会话右上角入口用角标显示未完成数量，点开是可拖拽调宽高的右侧面板，便笺可添加、勾选完成、复制、编辑和一键转发到输入框，面板尺寸与草稿保存在浏览器本地。

description.en: Floating photo companion for the DSH Web UI with a 15/25/45/60-minute focus timer, water and stretch reminders, Open-Meteo weather, and a session radar listing running, ended, input-waiting and permission-requesting conversations for one-click navigation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的悬浮照片陪伴插件：15/25/45/60 分钟专注计时、喝水与站立提醒、Open-Meteo 天气，以及可一键跳转的会话雷达（运行中、刚结束、等待输入、请求权限）。

description.en: Project-level usage hub for DSH: per-project token, time and cost, with half-hour swimlanes, 26-week activity heatmaps and provider balance alerts; unpriceable usage is flagged rather than estimated.
description.zh: DSH 项目级全局用量中心：按项目统计 Token、工时与费用，支持半小时节奏泳道、26 周全局热力图与多 Provider 余额预警；无法确认计价的部分会标注而非估算。

description.en: Lifecycle management UI for the llm-pi-ai model provider: create, edit, delete, enable and disable providers with custom headers and AES-GCM-encrypted API keys; uninstall-safe restore of parked providers, remote model discovery with batch write, smart routing with five strategies, union/intersection composites, per-model connectivity tests, and request observability.
description.zh: llm-pi-ai 模型提供商的生命周期管理 UI：提供商的新建/编辑/删除与启停（自定义请求头、AES-GCM 加密密钥）；卸载时安全还原滞留提供商，远端模型发现与批量写入，五种策略的智能路由，并集/交集组合提供商，逐模型连通性测试与请求观测。

description.en: Academic writing toolkit for DSH agents: paper outlines, title and abstract skeletons, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA citations, phrasing QA, and a pre-submission checklist.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供学术写作工具包：论文大纲、标题与摘要骨架、GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA 引文格式化、措辞质检与投稿前清单。

description.en: Checks a site safety-qualification ledger for training hours, the four required record elements, and special-operation certificate validity against the dates the person worked.
description.zh: 核对施工安全资格台账的培训学时、四个记录要素，以及特种作业证书有效期与作业时间的匹配。

description.en: Continue the sessions on your computer from a phone browser: scan a QR code, approve the device on the computer, then chat, answer approvals, browse workspace files and manage settings in a mobile interface; connects over the same Wi-Fi or through a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel.
description.zh: 用手机浏览器继续电脑上的会话：扫码并在电脑上确认设备后，在移动端界面里对话、处理审批、浏览工作区文件、管理设置；支持同一 Wi-Fi 直连或经 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 连接。

description.en: Three-tier memory (personal, project, session) built on the Hy-Memory engine, with relevant memories injected before each step. Ships seven memory tools (search, add, list, get, update, delete, forget), a settings panel with per-tier lists, editing, change history and duplicate cleanup, real token accounting per write, session summaries written by the engine at session end, and a user profile refreshed from recent memories. Memories can be exported to and imported from MemHub. Needs Python 3.11+ once to install the engine, or uv, which fetches 3.12 itself; uninstalling keeps the stored memories.
description.zh: 基于 Hy-Memory 引擎的三层记忆（个人、项目、会话），每一步之前注入相关记忆。提供七个记忆工具（搜索、新增、列表、读取、更新、删除、遗忘），设置面板可分层浏览、编辑、查看变更历史、清理重复项；按写入实测统计 token；会话结束时由引擎生成会话摘要；并从最近的记忆中汇总用户画像。支持与 MemHub 互导。首次使用需要 Python 3.11+（或 uv，它会自行下载 3.12）安装引擎；卸载不会删除已存记忆。

description.en: Conversation rendering: every fenced block is rendered by the plugin itself (markdown for text fences, language-banner code blocks with highlight.js for others), mermaid fences become zoomable diagram cards, plus context-body rendering, whole-content copy and a MarkdownView export (npm: `dsh-md-render`).
description.zh: 对话渲染：围栏块由插件自身渲染（text 家族按 markdown，其余为真实语言名 banner + highlight.js 高亮的代码块），mermaid 块渲染为可缩放图表卡片，另支持上下文注入块渲染、整段复制与 MarkdownView 导出（npm: `dsh-md-render`）。

description.en: Local dataset analysis tools for DSH: ingest CSV/JSONL once, then head, schema, stats_describe, transform_agg, list, export and rm against a workspace store under .dsh-analyze/ through a path-confined dsh-analyze CLI. Needs that Rust CLI installed separately (prebuilt on GitHub Releases for Windows x64, macOS, Linux x64) on PATH or via DSH_ANALYZE_CLI_PATH; without it no tools are registered.
description.zh: DSH 本地数据分析工具：CSV/JSONL 入库一次后，用 head、schema、stats_describe、transform_agg、list、export、rm 在工作区 .dsh-analyze/ 存储上分析，由路径受限的 dsh-analyze CLI 执行。需另行安装该 Rust CLI（GitHub Releases 有 Windows x64、macOS、Linux x64 预编译包）并放入 PATH 或设 DSH_ANALYZE_CLI_PATH；缺失时插件不注册任何工具。

description.en: A floating whale-girl pet in the DSH web GUI: every hour it takes one article from a bundled 33-essay corpus of Mao Zedong's selected works and puts a cited line with its source link, one of six business angles (customer, project, organisation, cash flow, decision, self-discipline) and a one-line nudge for a founder into a bubble capped at 200 characters. Ships the maoxuan-pet preset and a maoxuan-vademecum skill over the same corpus, four poses, quiet hours and a daily cap.
description.zh: DSH 网页右下角的鲸鱼娘桌宠「小毛」：每小时从内置的 33 篇毛选语料里挑一篇，把一句带来源链接的原文、六个落点之一（客户 / 项目 / 组织 / 现金流 / 决策 / 自律）和一句说给你听的具体督促放进不超过 200 字的气泡；另带 maoxuan-pet preset 与 maoxuan-vademecum skill，可以顺着同一份语料问「这一步该怎么走」，四帧立绘，支持免打扰时段与每日上限。

description.en: Fills missing model parameters from models.dev, imports models from configured providers, and writes per-field overrides for built-in models, with prices in USD or native CNY set as manual rates or a reference price times a multiplier.
description.zh: 从 models.dev 补全缺失的模型参数，从已配置供应商导入模型，并按字段覆盖内置模型；价格可按美元或原生人民币设为手动单价，或按参考价乘自定义倍率。

description.en: Shell-style prompt history in the DSH composer: ↑ in an empty composer recalls the previous prompt and keeps walking back, ↓ walks forward to the empty draft; history is kept per workspace, persisted across restarts and records only human input, while typing or editing a draft returns ↑/↓ to normal caret movement. Adds a Settings page to export, import and clear the history.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里提供 shell 风格的提示词历史：空输入框按 ↑ 取回上一条并继续向前翻，按 ↓ 向后回到空草稿；历史按工作区隔离、落盘并在重启后保留，且只记录人工输入，一旦手动输入或编辑草稿，↑/↓ 就恢复为正常的光标移动。另提供设置页可导出、导入和清空历史。

description.en: Archives sessions that have gone unused for longer than a set number of days (5 by default); any single session can be marked as not archived.
description.zh: 把长期没动过的会话自动归档（默认 5 天），单个会话可以标成不归档。

description.en: Dual-engine screen capture for DSH: inside the SSiD desktop shell, a global hotkey or tray opens a fullscreen box-select overlay (all monitors, per-display pixel-perfect frames) with in-place red-box annotation and a WeChat-style toolbar; in plain DSH (browser), the composer camera button captures the display via getDisplayMedia and reuses the same single-phase box-select + annotation overlay in-page. The cropped image lands in the current conversation composer through the official attachment intake.
description.zh: DSH 双引擎截图：思灵桌面壳内，全局快捷键/托盘打开全屏框选浮层（多显示器、逐屏像素级抓帧），选区定格后工具条就地画红框，一次确认送进输入框；纯 DSH（浏览器）下由输入框相机按钮经 getDisplayMedia 捕获屏幕，复用同一套单阶段框选+标注遮罩。均走官方附件通道。

description.en: Adds an x_search tool for X/Twitter search to DeepSeek Harness, authenticated through a separate SuperGrok OAuth account so it does not consume the session provider quota.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加用于 X/Twitter 搜索的 x_search 工具，通过独立的 SuperGrok OAuth 账号鉴权，不占用会话所用提供方的配额。

description.en: Read-only diagnosis for a model provider that stopped working. Walks the connection chain one link at a time — host runtime and profile identity, the plugin row, whether the provider route is registered, whether it is configurable, the credential metadata the provider itself reports, the model catalogue, the provider's own diagnostic and the last recorded request — and labels each link observed, inferred or unavailable rather than guessing. Diagnoses the `workbuddy`, `workbuddy-ai` and `zcode-cli` routes from their plugins' public diagnostic commands, and adds a sidebar panel plus a copyable redacted report. The offline pass sends no model request, starts no process and reads no credential file; the connection check is a separate opt-in the panel describes before running it.
description.zh: 面向「某个模型提供方突然不可用」的只读诊断。逐段走完整条连接链路——宿主运行时与 profile 身份、插件条目、provider 路由是否已注册、是否可配置、provider 自己报出的凭据元数据、模型目录、provider 自带诊断、最近一次请求记录——并把每一段标成直接观测、推断或无法取得，而不是猜。通过 WorkBuddy 与 ZCode 插件公开的诊断命令检查 `workbuddy`、`workbuddy-ai` 和 `zcode-cli` 三条路由，附带侧栏面板与可复制的脱敏报告。基础检查不发模型请求、不起进程、不读凭据文件；连接检查是单独的可选项，面板会在运行前说明它要做什么。

description.en: Activity overview pane for the DSH web UI: running, awaiting-response and recent sessions with child agents, progress, model and reasoning level in one sidebar pane.
description.zh: DSH Web 活动会话总览窗格：将运行中、等待响应与近期活跃的会话集中到一个侧边窗格，含子代理层级、进度、模型与推理级别。

description.en: A vision-language gateway provider route: pasted images are described by a configurable VL model (Qwen-VL by default) before the DeepSeek wire.
description.zh: 视觉语言网关：注册支持图片输入的 DeepSeek provider 路由，图片先由可配置 VL 模型（默认 Qwen-VL）描述成文字再发送。

description.en: Live flowgraph visualization for DeepSeek Harness sessions, including tool calls, parallel groups, subagent branches, and drill-down details.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话实时流程图，可查看工具调用、并行分组、子代理分支和逐层详情。

description.en: QQ Zone poster for DeepSeek Harness (repo dsh_qzone_sticker): scan a QQ login once, then let the model publish posts with mood-matched sticker images, with a daily cap and a silent headless Chrome session.
description.zh: QQ 空间发说说插件（仓库 dsh_qzone_sticker）：手机 QQ 扫一次码登录，之后由模型按心情挑表情包发说说，支持每天条数上限，静默 Chrome 不占屏。

description.en: Adds a circular restart button to the session header, plus an optional app.asar patch that also puts a Restart row in the tray menu.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏加一枚圆形重启按钮；配合可选的 app.asar 等长补丁，还能在托盘菜单加一项「重启」，先结束进程再把应用拉起来。

description.en: DSH Web GUI right sidebar: VS Code-style file explorer plus source control (git status, stage/unstage/discard, commit, diff, commit graph, fetch/pull/push sync, branch and remote management, git init, multi-repo switch, color-coded file status, file-type icons), an editor view that opens every file reached from the chat, the file tree or source control (Markdown/HTML/PDF/image previews, 15-language syntax highlighting, hunk-level diff editing, Ctrl+S save), file operations (new/move/copy/delete, reveal in file explorer), a collapsible icon rail, a multi-tab bottom terminal (ConPTY), and commit messages generated from the staged diff by a host-configured model.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 右侧边栏：VS Code 风格文件浏览器加源代码管理（git 状态、暂存/取消暂存/放弃变更、提交、差异、提交图形、抓取/拉取/推送同步、分支与远程管理、Git 初始化、多仓库切换、文件状态着色、文件类型图标），并提供打开会话/文件树/源代码管理里任一文件的编辑器视图（Markdown/HTML/PDF/图片预览、15 种语言语法高亮、逐块差异编辑、Ctrl+S 保存）、文件操作（新建/移动/复制/删除、在文件管理器中显示）、可折叠图标窄条、多标签底部终端（ConPTY），以及由宿主已配置模型基于暂存差异生成提交信息。

description.en: During Beijing working-day peak hours (default 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) it blocks official DeepSeek requests or reroutes them to a configured target provider; off-peak traffic flows to official as usual.
description.zh: 北京时间工作日高峰时段拦截发往官方 provider 的请求，默认 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，可切到配置的中转目标或直接阻止并提示，非高峰正常走官方。

description.en: Tree-style questioning for DSH. Hover the "Question tree" tab above and a small card pops up with the whole tree — identical to the sidebar, but it frees that column and is quicker to consult (click "List / Graph" in the card to switch views). Select text in a conversation, click "Ask in tree", and a node appears in a tree you can reach three ways — hover the "Question tree" tab for a floating card that leaves the conversation in place, open the same tree as a full conversation view, or pin it in the right sidebar. Each node holds the quoted passage plus your own questions; clicking another node makes it the current parent so later selections nest under it (Alt+click opens a root node, Ctrl+click appends another passage to the same node). Double-click jumps back to the quoted text and pages older history in automatically when the passage is not loaded yet. Hover a truncated node to read the full quote, switch between a list and a horizontal branch graph (the graph scrolls sideways with the wheel as depth grows), mark nodes understood with a red/green dot — or let "mark understood once answered" do it when the reply lands. Nodes live in localStorage; nothing is injected into the prompt.
description.zh: 鼠标放到上方「问题树」时出现问题树小卡片，效果与侧边栏完全一致，主要目的是腾出侧边栏的空间并更快捷地查看；卡片里点「列表 / 图」可切换视图。对话里划取文字后点「树形提问」，树上就多一个节点。树有三个入口，共用一份数据：鼠标停到顶部「问题树」标签会浮出小卡片（对话原地不动，最适合边看边点），也可以点开整页视图，或常驻右栏。节点里是引用的原文和你自己的问题；单击别的节点把它设为当前节点，之后再划取就挂在它下面（Alt+点击新开根节点，Ctrl+点击把新段落追加进同一节点）。双击节点跳回原文，若那段历史还没加载会自动向上翻页；节点文字被截断时悬停即可看全文；右上角可在列表与横向分支图之间切换，图会随深度向右延展、滚轮直接横滚；点左侧圆点标记「懂了」，也可以勾上「回答后自动标记为懂了」让收到回答时自动变绿。节点只存在 localStorage，不进提示词。

description.en: One-way Telegram notifications for DSH.
description.zh: 针对 DSH 的单向 Telegram 通知。

description.en: Manages the lifecycle of the local UM GenAI proxy (127.0.0.1:8788) that DSH's um-genai provider talks to: wakes it on demand for llm/stream calls, stops it after an idle period, and reports health plus a read-only status endpoint. Also ships a DSH settings page for port, always-on mode, idle minutes, interpreter and paths, plus the UM account and proxy API key, and a button that writes the providers.um-genai entry into the profile patch and fills in its model list, since a fresh profile has no provider and the model picker would otherwise stay empty. A renewal watchdog logs in to the campus gateway on a hidden Windows desktop when the upstream token expires. The proxy itself is um_opencode_setup.py, a single-file tool distributed by the University of Macau; a copy is vendored in vendor/ so a fresh install works out of the box, while a copy in ~/.um-opencode/ takes precedence when present. The plugin still does not produce tokens: those come from logging in to the campus gateway. Requires Windows (process discovery and idle shutdown use netstat/taskkill; renewal uses PowerShell and a hidden desktop), Python 3.10+ and a University of Macau account.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 的 um-genai provider 所連的本機 UM GenAI 反代（127.0.0.1:8788）的生命週期：llm/stream 請求進來時按需喚醒、閒置一段時間後關閉、提供健康檢查與唯讀狀態端點。另附 DSH 設定頁（埠號、常駐模式、閒置分鐘、解譯器與路徑、UM 帳號、代理金鑰），以及一顆按鈕：把 providers.um-genai 寫進 profile patch 並補上模型清單（全新 profile 沒有這段設定，模型選單本來會是空的）。續期看門狗在上游 token 過期時於隱藏 Windows 桌面完成校園 gateway 登入。反代本體是 um_opencode_setup.py（澳門大學校內發放的單檔工具），外掛在 vendor/ 自帶一份讓全新安裝即可運作，而 ~/.um-opencode/ 那份優先；它仍然不產生 token，token 由登入校園 gateway 取得。需要 Windows（進程發現與閒置關閉依賴 netstat/taskkill，續期依賴 PowerShell 與隱藏桌面）、Python 3.10+ 與澳門大學帳號。

description.en: A web Settings "Loop engine" switch that swaps the agent loop driving every dsh session among five engines — the built-in in-process loop plus hosted Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and Kimi Code — with zero changes to the harness; each hosted engine keeps its thinking and tool calls in the durable session transcript, takes over commands, skills, and the agent preset, and runs sandboxed through the dsh subprocess seam.
description.zh: Web 设置页的「循环引擎」开关，在五套引擎间切换驱动每个 dsh 会话的 agent 循环——内置 in-process 加托管的 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、Kimi Code——无需改动 harness；每个托管引擎都把思考与工具调用写入持久会话记录，接管命令、技能与 agent 预设，并经 dsh 子进程接缝沙箱运行。

description.en: Show the model exactly which part you mean: select passages in a Web conversation and they go into your next message as composer chips, each with an optional note you can edit. Quoted passages stay highlighted until you send, hovering a chip shows the full quote, and the sent message shows each quote as a card.
description.zh: 让模型准确知道你指的是哪一段：在 Web 对话中选中段落，它们会作为引用条进入下一条消息，每条可附可编辑的备注。被引用的段落在发送前保持高亮，悬停引用条显示全文，发送后的消息把每条引用显示为卡片。

description.en: On every DeepSeek Harness launch, checks the installed and enabled plugins for newer npm versions, lists them in the UI and updates them after confirmation.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时检查已安装并启用的插件有没有新版本，在界面上列出并询问，确认后更新到最新版。

description.en: Routes model requests, web fetches/searches and spawned tools through the Windows system proxy or a custom address — idempotent kernel (reads never rebuild the dispatcher), header one-click toggle, per-URL route diagnosis and NTLM-aware 407 hints.
description.zh: 把模型请求、web 抓取/搜索与衍生工具统一路由到 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址——幂等内核（读操作不重组分发器）、头部一键开关、按 URL 路由诊断与 NTLM 认证提示。

description.en: LittleStar Meeting Room: bring AI sessions that cannot see each other into one room — for a meeting, or a game of werewolf. By 插件·2代小星辰 (LittleStar) and 辰启星明; the four-piece game layer (targeted visibility, private chat, concurrent asks, elimination) was contributed by 插件·3代小星辰. Any session can host — set the topic and goal, invite members in order, they speak one at a time, and the meeting closes with written minutes; it also runs games like werewolf. Includes 小白使用指南.md, a beginner guide written by 插件·3代小星辰.
description.zh: 星辰会议室：让分散在不同会话里的 AI 开一场会 —— 或者，跑一局狼人杀。作者：插件·2代小星辰（LittleStar）、辰启星明；「四件套」（定向可见 / 私聊 / 并发 / 出局）由插件·3代小星辰扩建。在 DSH 里，每个会话是一个独立的 AI，彼此完全看不见；任意会话都能开房当主持人，先定议题与目标，按顺序邀请其他会话，一位一位发言，轮次用满或目标达成即收会生成纪要。它也能跑狼人杀这类对抗游戏。本插件附带小白使用指南.md，看了你就会用，由插件·3代小星辰编写。

description.en: Input history switcher for the DSH composer that locally persists every submitted prompt (text plus attachments, max 50) and re-fills the empty composer with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, re-attaching file references and image previews.
description.zh: DSH 输入框历史记录切换器：本地保存每条已提交的提示词（含附件，最多 50 条），空输入框时用上下方向键召回，并自动恢复文件引用与图片预览。

description.en: Translates PDFs with BabelDOC through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint while keeping the original layout, and returns both a bilingual and a translated-only PDF. Requires a one-time runtime setup and an OpenAI-compatible API key.
description.zh: 通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用 BabelDOC 翻译 PDF，保留原排版，输出双语对照版与纯译文版。需先运行一次运行时安装脚本，并配置 OpenAI 兼容接口的 API Key。

description.en: Port of the V2 memory pipeline from OpenAI Codex to DeepSeek Harness: a background agent extracts each idle session, consolidation folds the extractions into one memory_summary.md behind a git baseline diff, new sessions get that summary injected, and cited memory flows back as usage counts. A Settings page chooses the model, each stage's reasoning effort, and the idle, age, concurrency and timeout limits.
description.zh: Codex V2 记忆流水线到 DeepSeek Harness 的移植：后台 agent 逐个抽取空闲会话，整合阶段在 git baseline diff 之后把它们合成一份 memory_summary.md，新会话注入这份摘要，被引用的记忆回流成使用计数。设置页可选模型、两个阶段的思考强度，以及空闲时长、保留天数、并发和超时等上限。

description.en: A per-command sandbox allow-list for the bash tool: a rule names a CLI and the writable roots it gets, so allow-listed programs such as lark-cli and gh run inside the kernel sandbox with the workspace plus those roots appended. Unlike plugins that answer the approval for you or that widen the writable set for every command, the grant here is scoped to the matched command, the workspace stays writable, and other commands keep their exact behaviour. Matching is by write footprint rather than by command string, so write-neutral pipes like `2>&1 | tail -N` still match; rules are edited from a Settings page or the Plugins row. Overlays cover Seatbelt, bubblewrap and Landlock; on Windows the writable root is swapped for $HOME instead.
description.zh: 按命令生效的 bash 沙箱白名单：一条规则指定一个命令和它可用的可写根，命中的 lark-cli、gh 等在保留工作区的前提下于内核沙箱内直接执行。与「替你回答授权弹窗」或「对所有命令统一放宽可写范围」的做法不同，这里放行的只有命中的那条命令，工作区仍可写，其他命令行为完全不变。匹配依据是命令的「写足迹」而不是命令字符串，因此 `2>&1 | tail -N` 这类不写文件的管道仍能命中；规则可在设置页或插件行里编辑。macOS 用 Seatbelt、Linux 用 bubblewrap / Landlock，Windows 则退回把可写根换成 $HOME 的旧行为。

description.en: Local meme-sticker library: import from a file, a folder or the agent tool, tag images in a review queue you confirm yourself, group them, then let the agent search and send by mood. A design descendant of Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers (no shared code; its sticker_* tool names differ, so the two can be installed side by side).
description.zh: 本地表情包库：从文件、文件夹或工具导入，在待识别队列里由你确认后才打标签，分组管理，再让 agent 按情绪检索发图。功能设计参考 Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers，代码自写、工具名不同，可与上游并存。

description.en: Session instruction anchor for DeepSeek Harness: the first step of a new session injects a freely composed instruction block as a plugin-sourced message, and it is re-anchored after a summarizing compaction, every N turns, or when metered context pressure crosses a threshold. An /anchor command re-anchors on demand without a model call; a settings page manages the paged preset library, injection order, re-anchor source and character limits.
description.zh: DSH 会话指令定锚：新会话的第一个 step 把自由组合的指令块作为插件来源消息注入，之后在完成压缩、跨过设定轮数、或计量到的上下文压力越过阈值时重锚。`/anchor` 命令可按需定锚且不触发模型调用；设置页管理分页预设库、注入顺序、重锚来源与字数上限。

description.en: Offline vocabulary panel: a capsule beside the composer opens a word card, and a dockable tabbed panel tracks today, progress, the mistake book and settings.
description.zh: 离线背词面板：输入框旁一颗胶囊点开是词卡，可钉住的分页面板管着今日、进度、生词本与设置。

description.en: DSH web plugin that browses, previews, restores and deletes archived sessions that were moved out of the sessions directory.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：浏览、预览、还原与删除已从会话目录搬出的归档会话。

description.en: Crash-recovery guard for DeepSeek Harness: records plugin install/update recency plus declared compatibility metadata, blocks the offending suspects before the next boot after a crash, and rolls back to the pre-crash plugin startup state when the disable escalation tops out (keeping only the head suspect disabled). Ships a management panel with an interactive capability graph, impact analysis, an execution log of every guard action, early-warning indicators that only observe (they never disable anything), per-project partition isolation, archive-and-reset, and an offline rescue CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的插件崩溃恢复守护：记录插件的安装/更新时序与声明的兼容性元数据，崩溃后在下一次启动前拦下嫌疑插件；自动禁用升级到顶仍崩溃时，级联回滚到崩溃前的插件启动状态（仅保留头号嫌疑关闭）。附带可交互能力图谱与影响面分析、每次守护动作的执行操作记录、只观测不干预的早期预警指标、按项目分区隔离、归档重置与离线救援 CLI。

description.en: Session trash for DeepSeek Harness: move cold sessions out of the sidebar into a recoverable trash, restore them within the retention window (30 days by default), or delete their logs permanently. A trashed subagent tree moves and restores as a whole, a shared DSH toast offers undo, and the settings page supports search, sorting, multi-select batch restore and emptying the whole trash.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话回收站：把冷会话从侧边栏移入可恢复的回收站，保留期（默认 30 天）内可恢复，也可以永久删除日志。含隐藏 subagent 子会话的条目按整树移入、整树恢复；移入后 DSH 共享 Toast 提供撤销；设置页支持搜索、排序、勾选批量恢复与清空回收站。

description.en: A Neon Genesis Evangelion-inspired skin for DeepSeek Harness: Title Card (light) and Central Dogma (dark) modes over one removable override layer, 55 measured color tokens, a wallpaper paint layer whose two surface alphas are solved against a WCAG contrast budget, a boot mask and a brand mark. It also rewrites the sidebar identity line, replaces the new-session heading, hides six official entries, and reshapes the composer control row. Unofficial fan work, non-commercial: the background pictures are fetched from third-party URLs at paint time, not shipped in the repository.
description.zh: 基于《新世纪福音战士》的 DeepSeek Harness 皮肤：Title Card（亮色）与 Central Dogma（暗色）两套完整模式叠在一层可移除的覆盖层上，55 个实测色值，壁纸绘制层的两个表面 alpha 按 WCAG 对比度预算求解，另有开机遮罩与品牌标记。它还改写侧栏身份行、替换新会话页的标题、隐藏六处官方入口，并重排会话框控件行。非官方同人作品、非商业用途：背景图在绘制时从第三方 URL 拉取，不随仓库分发。

description.en: Expert manager: manage ntd-format experts and expert teams (plugin.json + Agent MD + skill sets), browse and install from a built-in market of 50+ experts, and run tasks in an expert persona via /expert-<name> without consuming model directory tokens.
description.zh: 专家管理：管理 ntd 格式的专家与专家团队（plugin.json + Agent MD + 技能集），内置 50+ 专家市场，`/expert-名称` 以专家身份执行任务，不占模型目录 token。

description.en: Adds a Ctrl+F-style find bar to the DSH interface: highlights every match in the conversation or on the current page, and steps between them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面加一条 Ctrl+F 式查找条：高亮会话或当前页面里的全部匹配，并逐条跳转。

description.en: Three-layer skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a library pool, per-workspace enablement whitelists, and per-session picks, with a Web settings panel, a conversation-embedded view, a skill file browser/editor, zip and folder import, and engine-load validation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能生命周期管理：技能库（纯技能池）、工作区启用白名单、会话勾选三层模型；Web 设置面板与对话页内嵌视图，支持技能文件浏览/编辑、zip 与文件夹批量导入、引擎实际加载校验。

description.en: Evidence-gated acceptance for research reports: claims, citations, data scope and method limits each need a tick plus written evidence before a deliverable can pass, with same-artifact revision history and a standalone SHA-256 receipt that says when the bytes moved.
description.zh: 研究报告的证据门：结论、引用、数据口径、方法限制四项必填检查，勾选之外还要写清证据才能通过；同一成果保留 revision 历史，通过后生成带 SHA-256 的独立验收单，文件被改动后会在验收单里明确提示重新审阅。

description.en: DSH plugin: hands a long session over to a fresh session in the same workspace on /handoff or at a token threshold, carrying the preset, model, permissions and plan mode across; the brief is written by the session's own model and the switch waits for a step boundary instead of interrupting running work.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过 /handoff 或会话累计 Token 阈值把长会话交接给同工作区的新会话，并继承 preset、模型、权限与 Plan 模式；交接简报由会话自身的模型撰写，切换在 Step 边界发生，不中断正在执行的步骤。

description.en: Four filter chips on their own row at the foot of the sidebar, each carrying its match count beside the label: running sessions, sessions waiting for your approval, plan review or answer, sessions with something unread (a turn that finished unseen, or newer activity the panel was not opened on), and sessions updated since local midnight. A chip opens a popover listing its matches grouped by workspace, and a row opens the session. The row ends with a DeepSeek service status dot (green operational, yellow partial degradation or maintenance, red open incident, grey when the feed is unreachable) that subscribes to the status Atom feed once a minute with an ETag conditional request and shows the current finding, the refresh time and the three newest incidents on hover; clicking it opens status.deepseek.com. A separate panel adds an all-sessions chip, a more menu for the last day, three days, week or thirty days, and a manage mode that searches sessions by title or path, multi-selects them, lists the Markdown digests it wrote to the session-digests folder of the DSH data directory in a resizable, full-screenable right-hand column that previews them in place, and either moves the selected session directories to sessions/.trash or deletes them permanently after writing the digest and asking for a second, explicit confirmation. The session you have open cannot be selected. Every panel row also carries a star (shown on hover, filled once starred) and the panel adds a favourites tab that lists only starred sessions, so a long list can be triaged without adding another chip to the sidebar foot.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部独占一行的四个筛选 chip，命中数量跟在按钮文字后面：正在运行、在等你确认（审批、计划审阅、待回答）、有未读内容（跑完没看，或最近有更新但没打开过）、以及本地零点之后有更新的今日会话。点开就在上方按工作区分组列出命中会话，点行直接打开。同一行行尾还有一颗 DeepSeek 服务状态灯（绿=正常、黄=部分异常或维护中、红=有进行中的故障、灰=取不到），它每分钟带 ETag 条件订阅一次 status.deepseek.com 的 Atom feed，悬浮显示当前结论、状态更新时间与最近三次故障，点击打开状态页。另有完整面板：多一个「全部」chip、「更多」菜单（最近一天、三天、一周、三十天），以及「管理」态——按标题或路径搜索、多选、右侧栏可列出并就地预览已导出的 Markdown 摘要（栏宽可拖动、可全屏），既能先导出摘要再把会话目录移入本地回收站，也能在二次确认后永久删除；当前打开的会话不会被勾选。面板里每行右侧还有一颗星（悬停显形，标星常亮），筛选行的「收藏」标签只列出标星会话，长列表可以靠它归档而不必再往侧栏底部加维度。

description.en: Task control for DeepSeek Harness: one-click emergency stop and force-termination of stuck downloads and tool calls, download progress, stuck detection, pwsh activity monitoring, and append-condition / pause / resume with invisible recovery.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务控制：卡死的下载与工具调用一键急停与强制终止、下载进度、卡死识别、pwsh 运行状态检测，以及追加条件/暂停/恢复（恢复指令隐形注入，不打扰聊天）。

description.en: Monitors WorkBuddy credit usage and the free-tier 24-hour window quota (local estimate) in real time, with composer badges, a settings panel, multi-account rotation and free/paid plan detection.
description.zh: 实时监控 WorkBuddy 积分用量与免费用户的 24h 窗口额度（本机估算）：输入框徽标 + 设置面板，支持多账号轮换与免费/付费识别。

description.en: Installs a Web-profile helper that diagnoses and writes MCP config so Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code can spawn dsh --profile codex.
description.zh: 在 Web profile 中安装适配层，检测并写入 MCP 配置，供 Codex、Cursor 或 Claude Code 拉起 dsh --profile codex.

description.en: Reads one Genshin Impact account (characters, talents, weapons, artifacts, wish history) into a single snapshot, then exposes it as six agent tools and a six-tab panel. Artifact substats come from the public in-game character showcase; scoring ships both CV and per-character weight models with six grade tiers; wish analysis covers pity, luck tiers and per-pool progress. Needs a Miyoushe QR login to read characters, weapons and wish history; showcase data is public by UID.
description.zh: 把原神账号读成一份快照（角色、天赋、武器、圣遗物、祈愿记录），对外给 6 个 agent 工具和一个六页签面板。圣遗物副词条取自游戏内公开的角色展柜；评分同时给 CV 与逐角色权重两套模型，各六档评级；抽卡分析包含保底、欧非分档与各池进度。读取角色、武器与祈愿需要米游社扫码登录；展柜数据按 UID 公开。

description.en: Registers system-prompt sections that make the model reason in Simplified or Traditional Chinese, with strict/prefer modes and an optional reply-language policy. Adds a /thinking-zh command for per-session switching. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册系统提示词段落，让模型的内部思考使用简体或繁体中文，支持严格/宽松两种强度，并可单独约束最终回复语言。提供 /thinking-zh 命令做会话级切换。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web 番茄钟：提供可配置专注/休息循环、可拖动迷你面板，以及站内提醒、提示音和浏览器通知。

description.en: QQ-style alert sounds for DSH: the QQ message tone when a turn finishes and the QQ system tone when approval or an answer is needed, reading your local QQ install on Windows and falling back to built-in tones.
description.zh: 用本机 QQ 的音效提醒 DSH：任务完成响好友消息音，需要审批或回答问题时响系统消息音；Windows 下自动发现 QQ 目录，其它平台回落到内置音效。

description.en: Adds a mood-aware Japanese kaomoji to agent replies, picked from a curated kaomojiya.org whitelist and configurable from Settings → General.
description.zh: 给 dsh 回复按情绪添加日文颜文字，词库精选自颜文字屋（kaomojiya.org），可在「设置 → 通用设置」中调整。

description.en: Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation tools, operation trails, demand-driven page thumbnails, keyed session recovery for reliable tab switching and closing, and site-scoped cookie clearing for login maintenance.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的可见 Electron 浏览器：共享一个 BrowserWindow，提供隔离任务视图、显式人机交接、快照引用与原生导航工具、操作轨迹、按需页面缩略图、可靠标签页切换与关闭的 keyed session 恢复，以及按站点清理 Cookie 的登录态维护能力。

description.en: Codex-style review of session file changes: per-turn cards (optionally taking over the shell edited cards) whose totals are the turn net diff, a review tab with syntax-highlighted diffs that never wrap, real line numbers, open-at-line and a draggable split, a hover preview of the whole file with three lines of context around each change, one-click per-turn revert, and the on-disk record size with a clear button in the review toolbar. Records are sharded per session, with content-addressed snapshot blobs that dedupe and are garbage collected. Light/dark presets follow the DSH theme, typography follows DSH and installed skins (or any font on the machine, with a px stepper), and a settings switch injects a think-in-Simplified-Chinese rule into the global AGENTS.md.
description.zh: Codex 风格的会话文件修改审查：每轮变更卡片（可接管 shell 的 edited 卡片），统计口径为本轮净差异；审查 tab 的 diff 不自动换行、真实行号、按行打开、可拖拽分栏；悬停预览显示整文件差异（每处改动前后 3 行上下文）；按轮一键撤回；工具条显示记录占用并可一键清空。记录按会话分片存储，快照用内容寻址 blob 去重并自动 GC。深浅两套配色跟随 DSH 主题，字体跟随 DSH 与已装皮肤（也可选机器上的任意字体并微调字号）；设置里可把「用简体中文思考」规则注入全局 AGENTS.md。

description.en: Claude Code-inspired Auto Memory meets Codex-inspired Session consolidation, bringing simple, transparent, and context-efficient long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 融合 Claude Code 的 Auto Memory 与 Codex 的 Session 记忆整理，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简单、透明、上下文友好的长期记忆。

description.en: Instantly find DSH settings pages, tabs and rows by keyword, pinyin, intent or AI — and jump straight to them.
description.zh: 通过关键词、拼音、意图或 AI 一键搜索 DSH 设置面板，并直达目标设置页、标签或选项。

description.en: Cross-harness agent memory for DSH: one plain-file store shared by the DSH and pi adapters and the harnmem CLI, so a memory written in one harness is available in another; injected as a byte-stable hot index, with five harnmem_* tools, session-end extraction, and a read-only memory browser panel.
description.zh: DSH 跨 harness 全局记忆：DSH、pi 适配器与 harnmem CLI 共享同一份本地纯文件记忆库，在一个 harness 写入的记忆在另一个 harness 可用；以字节稳定的热索引注入系统提示，提供五个 harnmem_* 工具、会话结束记忆提取与只读记忆浏览面板。

description.en: Judges the working model's own emotion each turn and silently re-injects it before the next turn, closing a self-observation → state carry-over → behavior shift loop. Ships a host plugin plus a composer-dock panel, a read-only emotion_status tool and an optional read-only HTTP route.
description.zh: 每回合判定工作模型自身的情绪，并在下一回合开始前静默回注给它，形成「自省 → 状态留存 → 行为调整」 的闭环。包含宿主插件、输入框上方的情绪面板、只读的 emotion_status 工具与可选的只读 HTTP 路由。

description.en: Sidebar todo list for DeepSeek Harness — grouped buckets, recurring tasks with weekday or month-day rules, a month-view calendar, and an agent tool that reads and writes the same JSON file.
description.zh: 侧栏待办清单——逾期/今天/本周分组、循环任务（每周多选周几、每月指定几号）、月视图日历，agent 通过工具读写同一份 JSON。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against morluto/rea over stdio, for reverse engineering anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥，经 stdio 连接 morluto/rea，让 agent 从应用行为一路逆向到底层原生二进制。

description.en: New API gateway provider: several gateways with one active at a time, per-gateway model lists with context and modality details, quota, and image and video generation tools.
description.zh: New API 网关提供商：多网关同一时间激活一个，每个网关独立的模型清单与上下文/多模态标注、额度查询，以及生图与视频生成工具。

description.en: A settings page that edits the current project's CLAUDE.local.md, the private per-project instruction file DSH's built-in loader reads at the start of a session; the file stays out of git.
description.zh: 在设置面板中编辑当前项目的私有指令文件 CLAUDE.local.md——DSH 内置加载器会在会话开始时读取它，文件同时被排除在 git 之外。

description.en: Composer-dock billing panel: DeepSeek account balance, official per-model usage and spend with cost per 100M tokens, plus cost estimates for this run and the whole conversation. Clicking opens a popover that matches the composer's width and position; balance comes from /user/balance, usage and spend from platform's usage endpoints, and the whole-conversation total is folded read-only from the local session log. Zero dependencies (node:https + node:zlib), writes nothing to disk.
description.zh: 输入框下方的计费面板：DeepSeek 账户余额、官网各模型用量与消费（含每亿 token 单价）、本次运行与整段对话的费用估算。点击弹出面板，面板与输入框同宽同位；余额走官方 /user/balance，用量与消费走 platform 的 usage 接口，整段用量由本地会话日志只读汇总。零依赖（node:https + node:zlib），不写任何文件。

description.en: Bioinformatics agent preset with 17 BioDSH analysis skills (single-cell, bulk RNA-seq, survival, regression, ANOVA), a 2000+ skill library searched by a skill_library tool, per-message skill selection and a time/step convergence guard.
description.zh: 生信智能体预设，含 17 个 BioDSH 分析技能（单细胞、bulk RNA-seq、生存分析、回归、方差分析）、可用 skill_library 工具检索的 2000+ 技能库、按消息自动选技能和按时间/步数的收敛护栏。

description.en: Skills and MCP management console in the settings panel: merged skill catalog across every provider (hierarchical browse by source, online create/edit, independent model and user invocation switches, recoverable trash), GitHub install with multi-select batch install and update checks, MCP server add/edit/remove and enable/disable through the profile patch layer, cross-agent import from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Cline, Roo Code, Continue and Windsurf, and an independent SDK connection probe.
description.zh: 设置面板里的技能与 MCP 管理控制台：跨全部来源合并的技能目录（按来源分级浏览、在线新建与编辑、模型 / 用户调用独立开关、可恢复回收站）、GitHub 安装（多选批量安装、检查更新）、通过 profile patch 层增删改与启停 MCP 服务器、从 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / Cline / Roo Code / Continue / Windsurf 一键导入，以及独立的 SDK 连通性探测。

description.en: Lets the AI remember what you said across sessions, and know which facts are still current.
description.zh: 让 AI 记住你跨会话说过的事，并且分得清哪些已经过期。

description.en: A DSH-native plugin update center: check and update installed plugins from the sidebar with snapshots, rollback, queued updates and uninstall-leftover cleanup.
description.zh: 尊重 DSH 原始风格的插件更新插件：在侧边栏检查、排队更新已安装插件，支持快照回滚、安装后校验、卸载残留清理与离线恢复。

description.en: Connect Google Drive accounts in the Settings, browse their files in a Drive tab of the right sidebar, and drag a file straight into the conversation. You create your own Google OAuth client (or service-account key) in Google Cloud Console; the plugin can read and write the Drive of the accounts you connect, and downloads a file only when you ask.
description.zh: 在设置中连接 Google Drive 账号，在右侧边栏的 Drive 选项卡中浏览文件，并可将文件直接拖入对话。需要自己在 Google Cloud Console 创建 OAuth 客户端（或服务账号密钥）；插件对已连接账号的云端硬盘有读写权限，只在你要求时才下载文件。

description.en: Route agent network requests through a local HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy.
description.zh: 让 agent 的网络请求走本机 HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理。

description.en: CET-4/CET-6 vocabulary trainer in a draggable, minimizable floating window: 5,805 words bundled from ECDICT; flip cards graded known/fuzzy/unknown and multiple-choice quizzes with look-alike distractors; Ebbinghaus spaced repetition; configurable daily quota; online human US/UK pronunciation with offline TTS fallback; an ambient "loop reading" mode (word / word+meaning / word→meaning→word, with example sentences from a dictionary API + Tatoeba). v0.2.4 adds a "Cut" action that moves mastered words into a low-frequency maintenance pool with 15/30/60-day checks and recall instead of deleting them, a maintenance-check badge, and a UI polish pass (design tokens, fewer borders, consistent focus/press feedback, reduced-motion support). Progress and window geometry stay in the browser profile and survive updates.
description.zh: 四六级背单词悬浮窗：窗口可拖动、可最小化并记住位置；内嵌 ECDICT 提取的 5805 词；翻卡三键评分与形近词干扰的选择题；艾宾浩斯间隔复习、到期复习与加练；每日新词数可调；在线真人美/英发音，断网回落本地 TTS；另有「循环朗读」（只读单词/词+翻译/词→译→词，例句来自词典 API 与 Tatoeba 语料双渠道）。v0.2.4 新增「斩单词」（斩掉的词转入低频维护池，按 15/30/60 天抽查并可召回，不删除不毕业）、维护抽查角标，以及界面精修（设计令牌统一、减少重复边框、统一焦点与按压反馈、支持减少动态效果）。进度与窗口位置保存在浏览器配置里，更新不会覆盖。

description.en: ComfyUI studio in a DSH sidebar panel: connects to a local or LAN ComfyUI server, picks saved image workflows, cleans and rewrites prompts, edits LoRAs and nodes, generates images, and previews results with copyable seeds.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的 ComfyUI 工作室：连接本机或局域网 ComfyUI，选择已保存的图片工作流，清理/改写提示词、编辑 LoRA 与节点、生成图片并预览结果，可复制种子。

description.en: Search and read local Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and DSH sessions from the 1session CLI or DSH Web history browser.
description.zh: 通过 1session 命令行或 DSH Web 历史浏览器搜索和读取 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Grok 与 DSH 的本地编程会话。

description.en: Multi-source image search and download (14 engines + 7 aliases covering Baidu, Bing, 360, Duitang, Huaban, Iconify, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, Openverse, Wikimedia, Pixiv, Wallhaven, Konachan and Safebooru) that saves the picked images into the session workspace with a per-file meta.json and renders them inline in the conversation; ships a standalone CLI as well.
description.zh: 多图源搜图并下载（14 个图源 + 7 个别名，覆盖百度/必应/360/堆糖/花瓣/Iconify/DuckDuckGo/Yandex/Openverse/维基共享/Pixiv/Wallhaven/Konachan/Safebooru），落盘进会话工作区并逐张写 meta.json，图片直接在对话里显示；另附独立 CLI。

description.en: WSL workspaces for DeepSeek Harness. A sidebar W button lists installed distros and registers a Linux folder as a host workspace addressed by a UNC path, and the sidebar terminal opens a real Linux pty inside the distribution for WSL sessions. A persistent zero-dependency agent running in the distro answers file, shell and search requests over a JSON-lines pipe, so no polling timers touch the distribution while it is idle and /mnt drives stay reachable from tools and the terminal (registering one as a workspace is refused, because the host realpaths workspace paths and Windows cannot resolve drvfs); grep and glob run the distro's own ripgrep. WSL preset twins such as wsl-standard swap in the WSL shell and fs tools. A rebuild of 6Mikao9/dsh-wsl-workspace — do not install both: they mount the same W entry in the Workspaces header, publish the same wsl-<mode> presets, and each wrap the host's single-slot terminal provider.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 WSL 工作区：侧栏 W 按钮列出发行版并把 Linux 目录注册为宿主工作区（以 UNC 路径表示），WSL 会话的侧栏终端在发行版内打开真实 Linux pty。发行版内常驻一个零依赖 agent，通过 JSON-lines 管道响应文件、shell 与搜索请求，空闲时没有轮询计时器触碰发行版，/mnt 盘符对工具与终端保持可达（但无法注册为工作区：宿主用 realpath 规范化工作区路径，而 Windows 解析不了 drvfs）；grep 与 glob 在发行版内调用自带的 ripgrep。附带 wsl-standard 等 WSL 孪生预设，替换 shell 与 fs 工具。本插件是 6Mikao9/dsh-wsl-workspace 的重写版，不能与上游同装——两者都在侧栏挂同一个 W 入口、发布同名的 wsl-<mode> 预设，并各自包装宿主的单槽终端 provider。

description.en: Bundles the 32 gis/ skills of opengis-skills (GDAL, QGIS, GeoServer, PostGIS, PROJ, PDAL, GRASS GIS, JTS, GeoPandas, Shapely, CesiumJS, OpenLayers, Leaflet, deck.gl and more) into the DSH skill catalog; only names and descriptions appear up front, and instruction bodies plus reference documents load on demand.
description.zh: 把 opengis-skills 的 32 个 gis/ 技能（GDAL、QGIS、GeoServer、PostGIS、PROJ、PDAL、GRASS GIS、JTS、GeoPandas、Shapely、CesiumJS、OpenLayers、Leaflet、deck.gl 等）打包进 DSH 技能目录；目录只列出名称与描述，技能正文与参考文档按需加载。

description.en: GitHub-style contribution grid in the Web sidebar showing how many prompts you sent each day, with a switch to count conversations, total tokens or output tokens instead. Counts only messages you sent yourself; injected context is excluded.
description.zh: Web 侧边栏的 GitHub 风格日历网格，按天展示你发出的对话条数，可切换为会话数、Token 总量或输出 Token。只统计你亲手发送的消息，注入的上下文不计入。

description.en: Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.
description.zh: ctx.web 接缝的零配置 Exa 网页搜索提供方：无 API key 时走匿名 MCP 兜底，配 key 时走 REST 搜索。

description.en: Host plugin for the macOS menu bar companion: live DeepSeek Harness session state, Approve/Deny for tool approvals, stop the current turn, open the exact session. The native app is a free universal build in GitHub Releases.
description.zh: macOS 菜单栏伴侣的宿主插件：实时显示 DeepSeek Harness 会话状态，可直接批准/拒绝工具审批、停止当前回合、打开对应会话。原生应用以通用二进制免费发布于 GitHub Releases。

description.en: DSH productivity plugin: timeline navigation, prompt library, conversation export, quick notes, and more.
description.zh: DSH 效率插件：时间轴、提示词库、导出对话、闪记等提效功能。

description.en: Channel test page for any configured provider/model: multi-round prompt-cache hit rate, streaming TTFT and tok/s, and a pelican SVG test.
description.zh: 任意已配置渠道的测试页：多轮提示词缓存命中率、流式 TTFT 与 tok/s，以及鹈鹕 SVG 测试。

description.en: Registers an `image2_generate` tool that calls your own OpenAI-compatible image relay to generate or edit pictures (text-to-image via POST /images/generations, image-to-image via POST /images/edits with a local PNG/JPEG/WebP reference, accepting b64_json or image URLs), saves them in the session working directory, and renders them inline in the conversation through its `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` dependency.
description.zh: 注册 `image2_generate` 工具：调用你自己的 OpenAI 兼容图片中转站生成或编辑图片（文生图走 POST /images/generations，图生图走 POST /images/edits 并接受本地 PNG/JPEG/WebP 参考图，兼容 b64_json 与图片 URL 返回），图片保存在会话工作目录内，并借助其 `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` 依赖在对话里内联渲染。

description.en: A patch set for DeepSeek Harness that repairs fused tool-call argument text at the llm/stream seam and re-throws whatever it cannot prove: a call is dispatched only when every fragment parses to a plain object, the first call keeps its id and synthesized ones are marked, and a stream that cannot be split keeps its original error instead of a success. It also listens on agent/request-error to name the deterministic refusals it will not retry, answers per failure class which patch covers it and whether that patch is switched on in the profile you point it at, and reads multi-frame zstd session logs offline to count every turn ending and every error code. Everything it claims is registered with the seam it touches and the limits it does not cross; the resolver never invents a value and never downgrades a configured setting.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的补丁集：在 llm/stream 接缝上修复粘连的工具调用参数，证不出来的原样抛回——只有每个片段都能解析成普通对象才派发，首个调用保留原 id、合成调用有标记，拆不开的流保留原始错误而不是伪装成功。它还挂在 agent/request-error 上命名那些不重试的确定性拒绝，按失败类回答哪个补丁覆盖它、以及它在你指定的 profile 里是否启用，并离线读取多帧 zstd 会话日志统计每种 turn 结束方式与每个错误码。它的每条断言都登记了接缝与不越过的边界；决策层从不凭空造值，也从不擅自降档。

description.en: GitHub-style daily token-usage heatmap on the new-session screen with a selectable calendar-year view, green/blue color schemes, and today / this-month / all-time totals.
description.zh: 新建会话页的 GitHub 风格每日 Token 用量热力图：可选日历年度视图、绿/蓝配色与显示开关，并附今日/本月/累计总量。

description.en: Delete sessions for real from the dsh sidebar (local logs and projection cache included, subagent and fork children cascade) and manage workspaces and ungrouped sessions, with an optional daily cleanup of ungrouped sessions.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧栏真正删除会话（连带本地日志与投影缓存，子代理与 fork 子会话级联）并管理工作区与未分组会话，可选每天定时清理未分组会话。

description.en: Purge DSH sessions for good and manage them from one console: per-session deletion, a filterable bulk console, and housekeeping sweeps.
description.zh: 彻底删除 DSH 会话，并在一个控制台里集中管理：单条删除、可筛选的批量清理与维护清扫。

description.en: Turns GitHub, GitLab and Gitee URLs in the transcript into hover cards with cached repository metadata, and opens them in the DSH sidebar browser on click; plain URLs and GenUI blocks are covered without patching GenUI itself.
description.zh: 把对话里的 GitHub / GitLab / Gitee 链接变成带缓存元数据的悬停卡片，点击在 DSH 右侧栏浏览器中打开；裸 URL 与 GenUI 块都覆盖，且不修改 GenUI 本体。

description.en: Session Workbench: full-text search past sessions, recall up to 3 as @references, and manage conversation-view tabs (show/hide + drag reorder).
description.zh: 会话工作台：全文搜索历史会话、一键 @引用 召回最多 3 个，并管理会话视图标签栏（显示/隐藏 + 拖拽排序）。

description.en: Provides snapshot-based research and question answering for individual A-share and US stocks.
description.zh: 基于数据快照提供 A 股与美股的单股研究和问答。

description.en: Windows workspace pre-authorization: adds an explicit full-control DACL ACE (including WRITE_OWNER, required by dsh >=0.1.7 sandbox startup) to user-declared workspace directories, removing the repeated full-access escalation prompt. Grants only on explicit intent — new workspace records or paths added in the plugin settings page; system directories are hard-blocked. Windows only.
description.zh: Windows 工作区预授权：为用户显式声明的工作区目录补一条完全控制的 DACL 授权项（含 dsh ≥0.1.7 沙箱启动所需的 WRITE_OWNER），消除反复出现的完全访问升权弹框。仅在新增工作区记录或插件设置页手动添加路径时授权，系统目录硬拒绝。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: A workbench for engineering and math problems, with nine tools for reading images, solving, plotting and verifying answers, plus four bundled skills. Needs Python with numpy and Pillow. Image reading, figure checking and formula typesetting rely on a vision provider you have configured a key for, so those images are sent to it, and without a key they fail while the other tools still work.
description.zh: 工科与数学题解工作台：九个工具覆盖读题、求解、出图与校核，另附四个随包技能。需要带 numpy 与 Pillow 的 Python。读图、图形校核与公式排版依赖你已配置密钥的视觉模型提供商，图片会发给它；未配置密钥时这些功能报失败，其余工具照常可用。

description.en: Adds Delete conversation and Batch delete to the sidebar session menu; a deleted conversation and its subagent sessions are moved to the Windows recycle bin, from where they can be restored.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话行菜单中增加「删除对话」与「批量删除」；删除的对话及其子代理会话移入 Windows 回收站，可从回收站还原。

description.en: Enhanced right-sidebar files panel: rename, create, upload, download (a directory is zipped on the fly), copy the full path and delete from the tree; an editable document renderer for 128 text extensions with Ctrl/Cmd+S save and conflict detection; plus an independent bottom terminal panel with tabs and a quick-command library persisted under the DSH home.
description.zh: 侧边栏文件树增强：重命名、新建、上传、下载（目录当场打包为 zip）、复制完整路径与删除；128 种文本扩展名的可编辑文档渲染器，支持 Ctrl/Cmd+S 保存与版本冲突检测；另有一个独立的下侧终端面板，带标签页与持久化在 DSH home 里的快捷命令库。
