description.en: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.
description.zh: 输入框右下角 GitHub 图标打开当前仓库的 issue/PR 搜索弹窗，数据来自本机 gh CLI，点选即以 URL 或 @owner/repo#number 形式插入引用。

description.en: Multi-session overview: list every session grouped by workspace with live status, and pin up to three side by side to read their conversation text. Each card says whether a session finished since you last looked, is waiting on your answer, or has stalled mid-turn, and which files it changed. Send a message or interrupt any session without switching away, with a receipt showing whether it was queued, delivered or being processed. Search across all sessions, forward a turn to another, and switch a session's model from its card.
description.zh: 多会话一体：在一个会话内按工作区总览全部会话的实时状态，钉住最多三个并排看对话正文。每张卡片标出它自你上次查看后是否跑完、是否卡在等你回话、是否停滞不动，并列出它改过哪些文件。可直接发消息或打断，不用来回切换，消息会显示排队中／已送达／处理中。可以跨全部会话搜索、把一轮对话转发给另一个会话，也能直接在卡片上换模型。

description.en: Focus-aware notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approvals, questions, plan reviews and finished replies appear as one alert only when the conversation window loses focus; background conversations alert at any time and subagent sessions never do.
description.zh: 焦点感知的 DeepSeek Harness 通知插件：审批、提问、方案确认与回复完成统一为一种提醒，当前对话在窗口失焦后才弹出，后台对话随时提醒，子代理会话不提醒。

description.en: Host-side DSH evaluation control plugin: injects one evaluation trial's variables, budget limits, session root and fork lineage into the agent process, routes its model calls through a host broker under a gateway lease, and writes a schema-versioned bundle descriptor for evidence attribution.
description.zh: 宿主侧 DSH 评测控制插件：把单次评测试次的变量、预算上限、会话根目录与 fork 血统一次性注入 agent 进程，模型调用经宿主 broker 走网关租约，并写出 schema 版本化的 bundle descriptor 做证据归属。

description.en: Adds an `auto` permission preset between workspace-write and danger-full-access: a classifier grants routine sandbox escalations once, while dangerous or uncertain requests still go to a human.
description.zh: 在 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access 之间增加 `auto` 权限档：分类器一次性放行例行沙箱升级，危险或不确定的操作仍转人工审批。

description.en: Evidence-driven company and job due-diligence for DSH: logs sources with evidence levels, adds evidence-bounded claims, verifies the legal entity against official registries, and renders a PROCEED/VERIFY/STOP report with a verification checklist and interview questions.
description.zh: 证据驱动的公司与岗位尽调插件：登记带证据等级的来源、添加受证据边界约束的结论、用官方登记信息核验公司主体，并生成推进/核验/停止三态报告，附核验清单与面试问题。

description.en: Auto-expands newly arrived tool-call cards in the DSH Web UI, with a sidebar toggle cycling no-op/expand/collapse and the state persisted to localStorage.
description.zh: 自动展开 DSH 界面里新到达的工具调用卡片，侧栏开关在不干预/展开/折叠三态间循环，档位持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: Group installed skills and manage MCP servers from a left-panel UI: filter the model skill catalog by enabled groups (union-deduped) and toggle MCP servers independently.
description.zh: 将已安装的技能分组管理、独立开关 MCP 服务器：按启用分组过滤模型可见的技能目录（并集去重），全部操作集中在左侧面板。

description.en: Visual development studio for DSH WebUI plugins with isolated Git worktrees, live official-WebUI previews, source editing, patch inspection, builds, and validation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH WebUI 插件的可视化开发工作室，提供隔离的 Git worktree、真实官方 WebUI 预览、源码编辑、Patch 检查、构建与验证。

description.en: Composer prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: a button beside the model selector rewrites the draft through one auxiliary LLM call and writes the result back in place, with composer undo left intact; a /prompt-enhance slash command returns the rewritten prompt as a command result line without touching the draft; the enhancement call can be pinned to its own fast provider and model in the profile patch; the rewrite policy is faithful - original intent, language and information are kept, code, commands and paths are preserved verbatim, and nothing is invented or padded with placeholder text.
description.zh: 输入框提示词一键增强：模型选择器旁的按钮把草稿经一次辅助模型调用改写后直接写回输入框，输入框撤销不受影响；/prompt-enhance 命令把改写结果以命令结果行显示、不改动草稿；可在 profile 补丁里为增强调用单独固定 provider 和模型；改写忠实原文，保留意图、语言与信息量，代码、命令与路径原样保留，不编造事实、不输出占位文字。

description.en: Builds, tests, archives and runs an Xcode project or workspace on iOS or macOS through xcodebuild — a live filterable build log, scheme and destination pickers read from the project, and log streaming for simulators and USB devices, including iOS 16 and earlier over libimobiledevice, whose app logs stay readable while the device is locked. macOS only.
description.zh: 在 harness 中通过 xcodebuild 编译、测试、归档并运行 iOS 或 macOS 工程——实时可过滤的构建日志、从工程自身读取的 scheme 与目标设备选择，以及模拟器与 USB 真机的日志流，包含经 libimobiledevice 支持的 iOS 16 及更早设备，其 app 日志在设备锁屏时依然可读。仅限 macOS。

description.en: Two buttons in the top-left of the DSH header — reload the UI and restart the app.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面左上角放两个按钮：刷新界面、重启应用。

description.en: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack), installable as `dsh-sgme`.
description.zh: 拾光记忆引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。

description.en: Inject a personal rules file into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt, with silent-step and repeated-action loop guards editable from the settings dialog.
description.zh: 把个性化规则文件注入 DeepSeek Harness 系统提示，并提供静默提醒与重复操作循环检测，可在设置弹窗中编辑。

description.en: Legal citation check: statute name, article number, text and validity status.
description.zh: 法条引用名称、条号、原文与效力状态核对。

description.en: A novel-writing workbench for DeepSeek Harness: you tap thumbs-up or thumbs-down on candidate passages, and the model distils them into a short preference profile that carries into later drafting calls while the manuscript stays out of the drafting context. Adds a chapter board, per-chapter writing packs, annotation-scoped revision that rewrites only the annotated paragraph and verifies the rest byte-for-byte, a project ledger, and local pacing checks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的小说写作工作台：你在候选段落上点赞或点踩，模型把这批点选蒸馏成一份简短的「作者偏好档案」带进后续写稿，正文本身不进写稿上下文。另有章节看板、每章写作包、只改被批注段落并逐字核对其余段落的批注式微调、项目台账，以及不把正文送进模型的本地情节体检。

description.en: Native UI cards instead of Markdown: the assistant calls render_ui and the answer renders as a card in the conversation — 29 block types (metrics, tables, charts, timelines, kanban, flow charts, clickable actions), a content auto-layout mode, four placements (inline, process, dock board above the composer, turn-tail next-step card), a schema-backed settings form, and an optional automatic next-step card. Cards are rebuilt from the recorded tool arguments, so they survive replay and fork; 253 offline tests, no build step.
description.zh: 用原生 UI 卡片代替 Markdown 回答：模型调用 render_ui，答案直接渲染成对话里的卡片——29 种区块（指标、表格、图表、时间线、看板、流程图、可点击按钮）、content 自动排版模式、四种落位（正文内联、过程折叠区、输入框上方看板、回合尾卡）、原生设置表单，以及可选的自动「下一步」卡片。卡片按会话日志里的调用参数重建，回放与 fork 后仍在；253 个离线测试，无构建步骤。

description.en: One-off btw side questions that inherit the current DSH session, with selectable context ranges and an optional compressed summary you review before sending it into the main session.
description.zh: 在当前 DSH 会话里发起一次性 btw 旁问，可选上下文范围；旁问默认不写入会话，可把压缩摘要预览确认后送入主会话。

description.en: DSH bundle that registers 13 native codegraph_* tools wrapping the codegraph CLI, so agents bootstrap, maintain, and query a pre-indexed code knowledge graph (symbol query, explore, node trail, callers/callees, impact, affected tests) instead of grepping files.
description.zh: DSH 插件，注册 13 个原生 codegraph_* 工具包装 codegraph CLI，让代理初始化、维护并查询预索引的代码知识图谱（符号查询、区域探索、节点轨迹、callers/callees、影响分析、受影响测试），无需 grep 文件。

description.en: Matt Pocock full promoted skill set (25 SKILL.md: grilling, writing-for-agents, wait-what, TDD, code review, wayfinder, ask-matt router) ported to DSH.
description.zh: Matt Pocock 完整发布技能集（25 个 SKILL.md）的 DSH 移植。

description.en: Four-tier prompt enhancer for the composer — the system tier always emits a LangGPT-structured system prompt (# Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows / Initialization), upgrading task drafts into the system prompt of the agent that runs them, while the other tiers rewrite as a light tidy-up, a single paragraph, or a five-section brief; the iterate workbench refines an editable base under an optional requirement, with fill-back and undo. Never changes intent, never invents requirements.
description.zh: 输入框四档提示词增强——系统档无条件输出 # Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows / Initialization 的 LangGPT 结构化系统提示词（任务型草稿升格为对应智能体），其余三档改写为轻度整理、单段或五段任务书；迭代工作台以可编辑基准加可选要求继续改写，支持回填与撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。

description.en: Lightweight crash-recovery for dsh: after a restart, it detects sessions whose last turn was killed mid-flight and re-injects a continuation prompt that first demands the agent verify real-world state before acting, so side-effecting operations are not blindly repeated. It only reacts to the genuine crash marker (turn/end reason 'interrupted', synthesized on cold read by session repair), so it never misfires on user cancels, rate limits or model errors - which is why it needs no error classification, backoff or configuration UI. Unlike general-purpose auto-continue plugins, it also covers the case where a subagent was interrupted mid-run: the parent turn has already ended normally while it waits, so a naive check sees nothing to resume and the whole subagent tree dies silently; this plugin detects the interrupted child and wakes the parent instead. Single host file, zero external dependencies, seven config constants.
description.zh: 轻量级的 dsh 崩溃恢复：重启后识别上一轮被强杀中断的会话，注入一条「先核实现状再动手」的续跑指令，避免盲目重做已有副作用的操作。只认真正的崩溃信号（turn/end 的 reason 为 interrupted，由 session repair 冷读时合成），因此不会把用户主动取消、限流或模型报错误判为可续，也就不需要错误分类、退避策略或配置界面。与通用自动续跑插件相比，它还覆盖「子代理执行中被中断」的盲区：此时父代理的轮次已正常结束（正在等待子代理），常规判定看不到任何可续对象，整棵子代理树会静默死掉；本插件会识别出被中断的子代理并唤醒父代理。单个宿主文件、零外部依赖、七个配置常量。

description.en: Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management, custom SearXNG instances, failover/rotate strategy switching and live SerpApi quota.
description.zh: 原生 web_search 的搜索池：8 个免费/付费后端自动故障转移与额度感知熔断，设置页管理 API Key、自定义 SearXNG 实例、failover/rotate 策略切换与 SerpApi 实时额度查询。

description.en: Cloudflare Workers AI media tools for dsh - text-to-image, text-to-speech and speech-to-text. Per-model price badges, a native settings card, reuse of an existing Cloudflare account, and output files named after the model that made them.
description.zh: 把 Cloudflare Workers AI 的多媒体模型接进 dsh：生图、TTS、语音转写都有；每个模型标注价格档位，带原生设置页，复用已有的 Cloudflare 账号，输出文件带模型名。

description.en: Cross-session task delegation for DeepSeek Harness: spawn durable top-level sessions and send them tasks, read or steer them by base62 session alias, and approve their sandbox escalation requests through an approval bridge that refuses destructive deletes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话派活与协同：新建顶层任务会话并投递任务，用 base62 会话别名读取或干预，并通过审批桥批准子会话的沙箱提权——命中破坏性删除一律强制拒绝。

description.en: Free LaTeX formula editor in the DSH sidebar with offline MathJax/PDF.js rendering: ten symbol tiles with hover palettes, ten template groups, live preview, colour/font/size/environment controls, favourites with titles and search, and nine export formats (SVG/PNG/JPG, LaTeX/AsciiMath/Typst/HTML/MathML/OMML) with escaping and share links. Image and PDF OCR need a vision-capable model in DSH or your own OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint; everything else runs offline.
description.zh: 免费的 DSH 侧栏 LaTeX 公式编辑器，MathJax/PDF.js 渲染全部离线：10 个符号磁贴悬停展开分类面板、10 组公式模板、实时预览、颜色/字体/字号/环境控制、带标题与搜索的收藏夹，以及九种导出格式（SVG/PNG/JPG、LaTeX/AsciiMath/Typst/HTML/MathML/OMML）与转义和分享链接。图片与 PDF 识别需要 DSH 中可用的视觉模型，或你自己配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点；其余功能全部离线运行。

description.en: Visibility layer for DSH's built-in Cua Driver computer-control channel: a top banner names the controlling session and its goal, Esc truly stops the agent, and four precision tools click more accurately - they check that the point is not covered by another window, verify what the click changed, find a control by its name, click up to five controls in a row, and wait for a control to show up; a control can also be addressed by element id and run in the background when the application supports it. When the official channel is missing it asks whether to install it and can install it in one click. Windows only.
description.zh: 给 DSH 官方内置的 Cua Driver 电脑控制通道加一层可见提示与精度工具：顶部横幅显示是哪个会话、基于什么目标在控制电脑，按 Esc 真正停止；四件精度工具点得更准 —— 点前查落点有没有被别的窗口挡住、点后校验界面变了没有、按控件名字定位、最多连点 5 个控件、等某个控件出现；控件还可以按元素 ID 精确定位，应用支持时能在后台运行。官方通道没装时还会弹窗询问是否安装，并支持一键安装。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Always-on ADHD-friendly output shaping: one system-prompt section makes replies action-first with numbered steps and concrete time estimates; adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status tools persist the mode across restarts.
description.zh: 常驻的 ADHD 友好输出塑形：一个系统提示词区段让回复行动先行、步骤编号、时间估算具体；adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status 三个工具让模式跨重启保持。

description.en: Sidebar file explorer and file previewer for DeepSeek Harness: a lazy workspace tree with in-panel preview for text, Markdown (tables included) and images, an action that opens the file in the conversation's right-hand document pane, and one that hands it to the system default app. Read-only, confined to configured roots.
description.zh: 侧栏文件浏览器与文件预览器：懒加载文件树，面板内预览文本 / Markdown（含表格）/ 图片，可把当前文件送进会话右侧文档预览，或交给系统默认程序打开；只读，路径限定在可浏览根内。

description.en: Ship a project to Cloudflare and publish your plugin to npm — the first deploy needs no cloud account, and credentials never reach the model.
description.zh: 一句话把项目部署到 Cloudflare、把做好的插件发布到 npm：首次部署零账号，凭据模型看不到。

description.en: Connects WeChat, QQ, DingTalk, Lark, and Telegram to DeepSeek Harness with unified configuration, private-chat and group access controls, and channel-side Agent chat and session commands.
description.zh: 将微信、QQ、钉钉、飞书和 Telegram 接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供统一配置、私聊与群聊访问范围管理，以及渠道内 Agent 对话和会话指令。

description.en: Injects a small continuity pointer at the start of a new session, naming the previous session and any handoff file, and reuses DSH's own compaction summary when there is no handoff file.
description.zh: 新会话开始时注入一条很小的接续指针，说明上一个会话是谁、工作区有没有交接文档；没有交接文档时复用 DSH 已有的压缩摘要。

description.en: Notes-backed context compression for DeepSeek Harness: replaces LLM-summarized compaction with a model-written persistent notebook plus recoverable raw history, so the rollover boundary itself costs zero model calls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供笔记式上下文压缩：用模型维护的持久笔记本取代 LLM 摘要式压缩，并保留可恢复的原始历史，窗口边界本身不产生模型调用。

description.en: Model switching and reasoning-effort control for DeepSeek Harness: set_model and list_models agent tools let the agent autonomously change its provider, model or thinking depth (reasoning effort) mid-task with a mandatory reason, a provider whitelist and a context-window token-pressure guard, the active model is injected into the runtime context, and Plan Mode auto-transition switches to a configured planning model on entering plan mode and restores the previous execution model on exit.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供动态模型切换与思考深度调节：set_model / list_models 两个 Agent 工具让模型按任务难度自主切换 provider、model 与 reasoningEffort（思考深度），强制附带切换理由，带 Provider 白名单与上下文窗口 Token 水位护栏，活跃模型注入运行时上下文；进入 Plan 规划模式自动切换到配置的规划模型，退出自动恢复日常执行模型。

description.en: Persistent memory for dsh in the style of Hermes Agent: a memory tool that keeps a user profile and the model's own notes, delivered to every chat as a logged context message — at the start, after a change and after compaction — and a session_search tool that reads earlier chats only after the user approves, with a Memory panel to see and edit what is kept.
description.zh: Hermes Agent 风格的 dsh 持久记忆：一个 memory 工具维护用户档案与模型自己的笔记，并在每段对话的开头、记忆变更后、压缩之后各投递一条带记录的消息；session_search 工具只在用户同意后才会读取更早的会话；另有 Memory 面板可查看和编辑已保存的内容。

description.en: A QQ NT messenger skin for DeepSeek Harness: light and dark share one QQ NT language — clean restrained light mode (brand blue #12B7F5, light-blue bubbles) and a calm blue-gray dark mode (#101822) — applied as reversible token and layout layers that never touch your Light/Dark preference.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 QQ NT 皮肤：浅色与深色共用一套 QQ NT 语言——浅色干净克制（品牌蓝 #12B7F5、浅蓝气泡），深色为沉稳蓝灰（#101822）——以可逆的 token 与布局两层实现，不改变你的浅色/深色偏好。

description.en: Installs and verifies the reverse-engineering engines REA needs on Windows (Ghidra, JADX, apktool, adb, WABT, frida and more), pins the rea-agents MCP server version, and reports capability gaps in a settings card.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上安装并校验 REA 所需的逆向引擎（Ghidra、JADX、apktool、adb、WABT、frida 等），固定 rea-agents 的 MCP 服务版本，并在设置卡片里体检能力缺口。

description.en: TRAE-style conversation rollback — per-turn checkpoints (10-turn sliding window) roll back touched files and truncate model context in place, keeping the same session id. Human-initiated only: a /rollback command or a per-turn Web button (works on interrupted turns too), with a preview listing each affected file and its action — restore, recover, delete, or skip.
description.zh: TRAE 式「回退到本轮对话发起前」插件：按轮次建立检查点（10 轮滑动窗口），同时回滚工作区文件与原位截断模型上下文，保持同一 session id。回退只能由人发起：/rollback 命令或每轮的 Web 回退按钮（被中断的轮次也可用），弹窗逐条列出受影响文件及其动作（恢复/找回/删除/跳过）。

description.en: Shows what each assistant turn cost under every reply, priced from the token usage of that turn at the official peak and off-peak CNY rates, together with the account and bonus balances; when a turn cannot be priced it states the reason instead of guessing.
description.zh: 在每条助手回复下面显示本次问答的花费、账户余额与礼金余额，按该轮 token 用量乘官方峰谷单价计算；算不出价时写明原因，不猜测。

description.en: Registers Ark Agent Plan, Coding Plan and postpaid model routes in the native DSH model picker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生模型选择器中注册方舟 Agent Plan、Coding Plan 与后付费模型路由。

description.en: One-line clock context for DeepSeek Harness: a Current time timestamp reading (weekday, date, time, UTC offset, IANA timezone) opens every conversation turn and a Turn ended reading closes it, so the model always knows the time, date and idle gap across turns without asking.
description.zh: 每轮对话开始向模型上下文注入单行时间戳读数（星期 / 日期 / 时间 / UTC 偏移 / IANA 时区），收尾再注入 Turn ended 关闭读数——模型始终知道现在几点、今天星期几、上一轮何时结束，日期运算与跨轮间隔不再靠猜；轻量时钟感知，每条约 30 token。

description.en: Token usage statistics by model, session and date in a sidebar panel, plus OpenCode Go quota, DeepSeek balance and Z.ai quota monitoring.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按模型、会话与日期统计 token 用量，并监控 OpenCode Go 额度、DeepSeek 余额与 Z.ai 额度。

description.en: Directed fuzzing driven by an LLM agent: from a target repository and a bug (CVE description, patch, crash trace, or file:line), it runs a PLAN, IMPLEMENT, EXECUTE, REFLECT loop in which the model writes Python input generators, until an input triggers the campaign's stderr-pattern oracle or the campaign stops.
description.zh: 由 LLM 智能体驱动的定向模糊测试：给定目标仓库和一个缺陷（CVE 描述、补丁、崩溃调用栈或 file:line），它运行 PLAN、IMPLEMENT、EXECUTE、REFLECT 循环，由模型编写 Python 输入生成器，直到某个输入触发该 campaign 基于 stderr 模式匹配的 oracle，或 campaign 停止。

description.en: Detects which conversation model an account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how its paragraphs open, and cancels probes that read as the older model within seconds. Includes an offline self-check that replays 13 hand-labelled chains-of-thought through the same classifier.
description.zh: 检测账号当前被分配到哪个对话模型：并发发起一次性探测会话，按段落开头的写法为流式思维链打分，读起来像旧模型的在数秒内中止。附带离线自检，用同一分类器回放 13 条人工标注的思维链。

description.en: Save reusable prompt snippets with categories and {{placeholders}}; manage them with /snippet commands (add, list, rm, optimize) and insert into the composer from a draggable dock panel, with one-click AI refinement through the default model.
description.zh: 保存带分类与 {{占位符}} 的可复用提示词片段：用 /snippet 命令（add/list/rm/optimize）管理，从输入框下方可拖拽面板一键插入草稿，并支持用默认模型一键 AI 优化。

description.en: Keeps a repository's task ledger as a resident prompt section with eleven native tools, plus a sidebar panel and a floating window for browsing the queue and signing off review tasks.
description.zh: 把仓库里的任务账本做成常驻提示段与十一个原生工具，另有侧栏面板与浮动窗，可浏览队列并签收待复核任务。

description.en: Unofficial host-side ServerChan notifications for DeepSeek Harness: sends mobile alerts through WeChat (ServerChan Turbo) or the ServerChan³ app when approvals, plan reviews, or questions go unanswered beyond a configurable threshold, even with the browser closed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 Server酱通知插件：在主机端监控审批、计划评审和问答，超过设定时间仍未处理时通过微信（Server酱 Turbo）或 Server酱³ App 发送手机提醒，无需保持浏览器打开。

description.en: Live security beacon for DSH that follows tool activity. Click to view call statistics, risk provenance chains and blocked actions, with read-only task restrictions and tool metadata change detection.
description.zh: DSH 实时安全浮标，随工具调用更新防护状态，点击查看调用统计、风险来源链和拦截结果，支持只读任务约束及工具元数据变化检测。

description.en: Adds Codex-like projectless drafts with per-project draft switching and date-and-topic directories created on first send; supports Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 without an archive patch or external installer.
description.zh: 提供类似 Codex 的无项目草稿、各项目草稿切换及首次发送时按日期和主题创建目录的功能；支持 Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2，无需归档补丁或外部安装器。

description.en: Four Chinese agent presets in one plugin, Standard, PTC, Minimal and Creation (standard-zh, ptc-zh, minimal-zh, cordis-zh), each keeping the matching built-in tool set; Standard, PTC and Creation translate known host instructions into Chinese while tool IDs, schemas and SDK declarations stay unchanged; a settings page enables each mode and edits its name, description and system prompt.
description.zh: 一个插件提供四种中文 Agent 预设：中文标准、中文 PTC、中文极简、中文创造（standard-zh / ptc-zh / minimal-zh / cordis-zh），沿用对应内置模式的工具组合；标准、PTC 与创造模式将已知宿主说明汉化，工具 ID、schema 与 SDK 声明保持原样；设置页可逐个启停模式并编辑显示名称、描述与系统提示词。

description.en: Local file manager served by the DSH web server itself: whole-disk browsing, previews for images, PDF, video and audio, text, Markdown, JSON, CSV, sandboxed HTML, docx and xlsx, Range downloads, folder ZIP, drag-and-drop upload, copy/paste, conflict-checked text editing, create/rename/delete-to-trash, and xlsx cell editing saved as a copy.
description.zh: 由 DSH web server 直接提供的本地文件管理页：整盘浏览，图片/PDF/音视频/文本/Markdown/JSON/CSV/沙箱 HTML/docx/xlsx 预览，Range 下载与目录 ZIP，拖拽上传、复制粘贴、带冲突检测的文本编辑、新建/重命名/删除（进回收目录），以及 xlsx 单元格编辑另存为副本。

description.en: A DSH companion with a macOS native pet and a Windows/Linux Electron companion. Shows the DSH account balance on the pet even when idle, plus color-coded task cards, progress and notices.
description.zh: 带 macOS 原生桌宠与 Windows/Linux Electron 桌宠的 DSH 伴侣。桌宠肚子上始终显示 DSH 账户余额，并支持任务配色、进度与通知。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness control center for official balance monitoring, per-session costs and tokens, third-party token totals, completion alerts, official recharge, flexible layouts, and agent-assisted session controls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 监控、提醒、充值与会话控制中心：查看官方余额、本会话花费与 token、第三方 token 合计，提供完成提醒、官方充值、灵活布局及 Agent 辅助的会话控制。

description.en: Hold Ctrl and roll the mouse wheel to zoom the whole Harness Web UI around the pointer, 50-200% in 10% steps; Ctrl +/- and Ctrl 0 from the keyboard; a bottom-right chip and a Page zoom row in Settings → General show and reset the level.
description.zh: 按住 Ctrl 滚动鼠标滚轮即可缩放整个 Harness 网页界面，以指针位置为锚点、50%–200% 每档 10%；另支持 Ctrl 加减号与 Ctrl+0 快捷键；右下角缩放胶囊与「设置 → 通用」里的页面缩放行显示当前档位并可一键复位；档位保存在 localStorage。

description.en: Engine-enforced guardrails for DeepSeek Harness agent swarms: quality gates reject half-done work, crash-safe checkpoints resume in place — keeps AI teams from breaking, not just running.
description.zh: dsh 单机多子 Agent 集群治理：引擎级质量门禁拒收半成品、崩溃断点续跑不重来——给 AI 团队装上"跑不坏"的工程护栏。

description.en: Programming Mode agent preset bundle: the standard coding agent with its persona mandating the Superpowers discipline (skills first, brainstorming before building, plans before code, TDD, systematic debugging, verification before completion) plus an always-on Ponytail code-volume discipline (7-rung minimal-code ladder, default full); ships all twenty skills bundled (14 superpowers + 6 ponytail) and mechanically injects the full using-superpowers skill into every new session's first request.
description.zh: 编程模式 agent preset 组合包：标准编码 Agent 强制执行 Superpowers 工程纪律（技能优先、先头脑风暴、先计划后编码、TDD、系统化调试、完成前验证），并常驻 Ponytail 代码量纪律（7 级最小化阶梯，默认 full）；内置全部 20 个技能（14 superpowers + 6 ponytail），并在每个新会话的第一条请求前自动注入 using-superpowers 技能全文。

description.en: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls you back, volume boost, settings panel.
description.zh: 通知出口：agent 主动通过桌面通知 / 中文语音 / 音效（炸裂、胜利、警报）联系你，60 秒确认窗口后语音呼叫，音量增强，设置面板。

description.en: An Aether Gazer Verdandi-inspired DSH Web UI skin with light and dark backgrounds, wedding-themed chrome, responsive character art, and themed conversation and sidebar surfaces.
description.zh: 一款以《深空之眼》薇儿丹蒂为主题的 DSH Web UI 皮肤，包含昼夜背景、誓约婚礼装饰、响应式角色立绘，以及主题化的会话区与侧边栏。

description.en: Shows where every session's tokens go: lifetime totals, cache hit rate, peak/off-peak cost, a calendar heatmap, a trend chart, per-model and per-workspace breakdowns, and a session tree revealing subagent sessions, with CSV/JSON export. Also ships context clear/compact actions and a prompt optimization button.
description.zh: 看清每个会话的 token 去向：累计总量、缓存命中率、峰谷分时成本、日历热力图、趋势曲线、模型与工作区分布，以及展开展示子代理的会话树，支持 CSV / JSON 导出。另带上下文清理 / 压缩按钮与提示词优化按钮。

description.en: Adds a refresh button and a power menu (restart / close DeepSeek Harness) to the conversation header. Client-only, zero tokens, no dependencies. The power menu is Windows-only.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部加一个刷新按钮和一个电源菜单（重启 / 关闭 DeepSeek Harness）。纯客户端、零 token、零依赖。电源菜单目前仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Polishes the draft in the composer into a clearer, better-structured prompt from the ✨ button or Alt+O; streams the result live over SSE with reasoning shown first, and follows the session's default model with zero configuration or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: 在输入框按 ✨ 或 Alt+O 一键把草稿润色成更清晰、更结构化的 prompt；默认零配置复用当前会话模型（SSE 真流式、推理过程先出），也可自配任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: Single-owner cloud tasks for DeepSeek Harness (大肥鱼 bot): submit from local chat or either IM bot, run continuously in a native cloud worker, and follow overall progress and artifacts in one workbench. Task permissions are independent of IM; includes agreed delivery and session archive recovery.
description.zh: DSH 单用户云端任务（大肥鱼 bot）：从本地对话或双端 IM 机器人交办，云端原生持续执行，在工作台查看整体进展与成果并继续跟进。任务权限独立于 IM，支持约定交付及会话归档恢复。

description.en: Control Proxmox VE virtual machines from the conversation: 16 tools for the VM console over VNC (screenshots, mouse, keyboard, batched actions, Unicode text and clipboard) and for running commands and reading or writing files through the QEMU guest agent, all over one ssh connection to the node, so the host needs no X11 or Wayland.
description.zh: 在对话里控制 Proxmox VE 虚拟机：16 个工具，既能通过 VNC 操作 VM 控制台（截图、鼠标、键盘、批量动作、Unicode 文本与剪贴板），也能经 QEMU guest agent 执行命令、读写文件；全部走一条到节点的 ssh 连接，宿主无需 X11 或 Wayland。

description.en: Draggable bubble graph of DeepSeek Harness workspaces and sessions in the Web UI: workspaces are large bubbles, sessions are small ones, and lines show real membership. The canvas supports pan, zoom and fit; filters cover workspace, status, type and archive state; search covers workspace names, paths and session titles; native actions open or create sessions, rename workspaces, and archive or restore sessions. Layouts are saved in the browser.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面中的工作区与会话可拖动气泡图谱：大泡为工作区、小泡为会话，连线表示真实所属关系。画布支持平移、缩放与适应；筛选覆盖工作区、状态、类型和归档情况；搜索覆盖工作区名称、路径与会话标题；原生操作可打开或新建会话、重命名工作区、归档或恢复会话。布局保存在浏览器本地。

description.en: Rotates configured LLM API keys after quota, rate-limit, or authentication failures.
description.zh: 在配额、速率限制或身份验证失败后轮换已配置的 LLM API 密钥。

description.en: Multi-provider usage stats framework (v2 adapter contract): persistent capsule plus detail panel; DeepSeek official (interval-bookkeeping daily usage derivation with a peak/valley countdown badge, working even without an official usage endpoint) and OpenCode Go built in; any other data source joins by dropping in a single mjs adapter file, hot-swappable from the settings page, with API keys kept on the host.
description.zh: 多 provider 用量统计框架（v2 适配器契约）：常驻胶囊 + 详情面板；内置 DeepSeek 官方（区间记账法推算每日用量 + 峰谷倒计时徽标，官方无用量接口也能算）与 OpenCode Go；其他数据源只需放入一个 mjs 适配器文件即可接入，设置页热插拔，密钥只留在宿主端。

description.en: Memory in global and per-project scopes: memories are injected into the system prompt at session start, a settings panel edits them with confirmation on write, and the agent gets a read-only memory_query tool (npm: `dsh-my-memory`).
description.zh: 全局 / 项目两级记忆：会话开始时把记忆注入系统提示词，设置页面板支持新增 / 修改 / 删除（写操作需确认），并为 agent 提供只读查询工具 memory_query（npm: `dsh-my-memory`）。

description.en: Adds a Keyboard Shortcuts page to the DSH Settings panel with six rebindable commands — permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, a status-page and a task-list shortcut — plus PgUp/PgDn input navigation and an optional composer Enter remap.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置面板增加「快捷键」页面：六个可改键命令（权限模式切换、思考强度调节、状态页、任务清单），并展示翻页键跳转与可选的输入框 Enter 重映射。

description.en: Starts a BaseMind MCP server for each session's workspace and registers the code-intelligence tools it advertises, with no MCP row to configure. Requires BaseMind installed and on PATH (basemind serve); without it no tools are registered.
description.zh: 按会话工作区启动 BaseMind MCP server，并注册其对外提供的代码智能工具，无需配置 MCP 行。需先安装 BaseMind 并在 PATH 上（basemind serve）；否则不会注册任何工具。

description.en: Work reports for DeepSeek Harness: gathers Git commits and local agent conversations (DeepSeek/Claude/Codex) and renders daily, weekly or monthly reports from your own templates; the agent tool is injected on demand.
description.zh: dsh 工作报告：汇总 Git 提交与本地 agent 对话（DeepSeek/Claude/Codex），按自定义模板生成日报/周报/月报，agent 工具按需注入。

description.en: Adds an Optimize prompt control next to the composer send button that rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (plain, sections, or role-task-goal) streamed from the session model, with Use, Undo, Copy and Close.
description.zh: 在输入框发送按钮旁加上「优化提示词」控件，用当前会话模型把草稿流式改写为结构化提示词（plain、sections、role-task-goal 三种风格），并提供使用、撤销、复制与关闭。

description.en: Semantic context watcher for DSH agents: maintains a journey ledger with flash summarization and MinHash novelty detection, folds milestones, and can inject long-term context with a three-level stall response; injection and the stall-2/3 responses are off by default.
description.zh: DSH 语义上下文观察器，维护旅程台账并做闪存摘要与 MinHash 新颖度检测，支持里程碑折叠、长期上下文注入与三级停滞响应；注入与 stall-2/3 响应默认关闭。

description.en: Adds an Artifact Space entry to the DSH sidebar that lists the final effective artifacts of each session, grouped by workspace and session, with an editor-style preview, image previews, search across workspaces and sessions, favorites, and provenance for every file.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏新增「产物空间」入口，按工作区与会话分组列出每个会话的最终有效产物，支持编辑器风格预览、图片预览、跨工作区与会话搜索、收藏夹与每个文件的来源追溯。

description.en: Renders a dsh-view fence in an assistant reply as cards — text, tables, charts, Mermaid diagrams and sandboxed HTML widgets — with an editable model prompt, a render_view tool and a bundled skill.
description.zh: 把回答里的 dsh-view 围栏渲染成卡片——文本、表格、图表、Mermaid 图与沙箱 HTML 组件——并提供可编辑的模型提示、render_view 工具和内置技能。

description.en: Models+ settings page for the DSH web UI: per-model reasoning-effort tables, input modalities and compat flags saved through the official settings pipeline, with models.dev metadata prefill and API key management.
description.zh: 模型+ 设置页:按模型声明推理挡位、输入模态与兼容参数(走官方 settings 管线保存),支持 models.dev 元数据预填与 API 密钥管理。

description.en: Chain-of-thought panel for the DSH Web right sidebar: folds the live reasoning stream of each session into turn → step groups carrying the reasoning text and the tool calls made in that step. Only the newest turn is expanded by default and earlier turns collapse to one line; steps are grouped into activity phases by a local rule, the step waiting on a tool is marked, tool failures show their reason, full reasoning text is fetched per step on demand, an all-turn directory searches turn titles, user text and turn numbers locally, and a whole turn can be summarised into a Chinese title with one model call.
description.zh: DSH Web 右侧栏的思维链面板：把每个会话的实时思考折成 turn → step 分组，每一步带该步的思考原文与工具调用。默认只展开最新一轮，更早的轮次收成一行；步骤按本地规则合并成阶段块，正在等工具的那一步单独标出，工具失败显示原因，思考原文按步按需取回，全轮目录在本地搜索轮次标题、用户原话与轮号，整轮可用一次模型调用生成中文标题。

description.en: A status rail in the DSH title bar that lists the sessions needing you, ordered red (failed) > yellow (waiting for your answer) > green (unread) > blue (running) > gray (not started, meaning an unsent draft sits in that session's composer); one click jumps to the session. State changes raise Windows toasts that clear themselves once you open the session or answer the question, and the DSH taskbar button carries a red/yellow/green dot through ITaskbarList3.SetOverlayIcon, so the state stays visible when the window is minimized or buried.
description.zh: DSH 标题栏里的一条状态栏，按「红（失败）> 黄（等你回答）> 绿（未读）> 蓝（运行中）> 灰（未开始，即该会话输入框里有未发送草稿）」列出需要处理的会话，点一下直达；状态变化时弹 Windows 通知，打开该会话或回答提问后通知自动消失；任务栏按钮再用红黄绿状态点（ITaskbarList3.SetOverlayIcon）标出状态，窗口最小化或被遮住时也看得见。

description.en: A two-minute whale-fishing mini game for the DSH web GUI. Catch fish whose numbers add to your score, avoid fish larger than you, eat rice bowls to heal, and grab coupons to ignore size on the next hook. Standalone HTML, no network, no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的两分钟小游戏：抓到的数字累加到身上，比自身大的鱼会掉一颗心，白饭回血，鲸元券让下一钩无视大小。单文件 HTML，不联网，无数据上报。

description.en: Embedded MCP server letting external agents (Hermes, Claude Code, etc.) drive DeepSeek Harness over StreamableHTTP: sync/async task execution, a three-tier file sandbox, a Web-backed approval bridge, session management and search, and path-jailed file tools.
description.zh: 内嵌 MCP server，让外部 Agent（Hermes、Claude Code 等）通过 StreamableHTTP 驱动 DeepSeek Harness：同步/异步任务执行、三档文件沙箱、Web 审批桥、会话管理与搜索、路径隔离的文件工具。

description.en: Shows the selected provider's balance below the Harness composer and estimates spend from observed balance drops.
description.zh: 跟随所选模型供应商显示余额，并根据观察到的余额下降估算消耗。

description.en: Engineering checklists distilled from Gillespie's Fundamentals of Vehicle Dynamics: 164 cards over the book's ten chapters, one skill entry with two-level routing. Each card gives the inputs a computation needs, the procedure, the boundary conditions where the method stops being valid, and a page reference — the explanation itself stays in the book. No passage of the book's prose is reproduced; 44 defects in the source (misprints, OCR damage, internal contradictions) are documented in the cards, each carrying a review-list ID. A study aid, not a substitute for the book.
description.zh: 把 Gillespie《车辆动力学基础》整本书做成工程检查单：十章 164 张卡，单一入口两级路由。每张卡给出所需输入、执行步骤、方法失效的边界条件，以及回查用的页码——原理讲解仍在原书里。不复制原书任何连续段落；卡内记录了 44 条原文缺陷（错印、OCR 损坏、前后矛盾），每条带审查清单编号。本包是学习辅助，不能替代原书。

description.en: NiuLai meme desktop pet — shouts "Ma～ma～" with a synced mouth when your agent finishes; 6 skins, signature actions, action-event binding, WebAudio-synthesized animal calls, hand-drawn SVG skins bundled.
description.zh: 牛来桌宠——agent 任务完成就蹦出来喊「妈～～妈～～」（嘴型同步）；6 个皮肤、签名动作、事件绑定、WebAudio 合成叫声，内置手绘 SVG 皮肤素材。

description.en: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar context menu behind a confirmation modal reporting log size and live activity, cleanly unlinking log files, projection checkpoints, and host memory registrations.
description.zh: 在侧栏上下文菜单中添加删除会话操作，删除前通过模态框实时展示日志大小与活跃状态，并完整清理日志文件、投影缓存与内存注册表杜绝复活。

description.en: In-chat read-aloud for DeepSeek Harness: tap to read, pause and resume AI replies with natural Doubao TTS voices (BYOK), reading only the final answer with code, tables and diagrams filtered; local engine, plugin keeps no API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话内朗读：点一下即可朗读、暂停、继续 AI 回复，豆包 TTS 自然音色（BYOK），只读最终回答并过滤代码、表格与图形，本地引擎，插件零 Key。

description.en: Config-driven development-task orchestration for DSH: graph workflows (task/gateway/human nodes) with per-stage persistence, plus an in-editor AI assistant that configures workflows through conversation with live validation. Hand documents to nodes as generic attachments (no declaration needed): files land in the task workspace and ${inputs.附件} gives the newline-joined absolute paths, so a node parses them with its own prompt.
description.zh: 配置驱动的工作流与开发任务编排：图式工作流（任务/网关/人工审批节点）+ 阶段级断点持久化，内置 AI 助手在图编辑器中通过对话配置工作流，逐条校验实时应用到画布。把文档作为「通用附件」交给节点（无需声明）：文件启动前落到工作区，节点用 ${inputs.附件} 拿到换行拼接的绝对路径自行解析。

description.en: Host-side connector for the DSH Mobile iOS app: dials a self-hostable WSS relay so the phone can reach the DSH sessions on this computer over 4G/5G, without a public IP or a VPN; the relay only authenticates and forwards.
description.zh: DSH Mobile 的电脑侧连接器：连上可自建的公网 WSS 中转，手机在 4G/5G 下即可访问这台电脑上的 DSH 会话，电脑不需要公网 IP 也不用组网；中转只做鉴权与转发。

description.en: In-chat image viewer for the web UI: takes over content image clicks (Markdown images, message attachments rendered as blob: URLs, and read_image results) and opens a dialog with pointer-centered wheel zoom and an editable percentage, drag pan, 90° rotation, download with progress, copy as PNG, open with the default app, and ←/→ gallery browsing across the conversation.
description.zh: Web UI 的聊天图片查看器：接管内容图片点击（Markdown 图、以 blob: URL 渲染的消息附件图、read_image 结果），打开弹层后支持以指针为中心的滚轮缩放与可编辑百分比、拖动平移、90° 旋转、带进度下载、复制为 PNG、用默认应用打开，以及会话内 ←/→ 图集浏览。

description.en: Switches DSH's package download source between the npmmirror China mirror and the official npm registry on timeout or failure, with a Web UI to inspect and switch manually.
description.zh: 在下载超时或失败时，于 npmmirror 国内镜像与官方 npm 源之间自动切换下载源，并附带 Web UI 可手动查看与切换。

description.en: OTA guest-review reply ledger check: content and score, reply deadlines, responder, issue category and duplicate review ids.
description.zh: OTA 点评回复台账核对：点评内容与评分、回复时限、回复人、问题分类与编号重复。

description.en: Closes ai-memory's consolidation loop for DSH: when a DSH session ends it calls ai-memory finalize-session, so the observations DSH captured become wiki pages the other harnesses ai-memory serves can read. Skips subagents, queues concurrent session ends, and sweeps sessions abandoned by a forced restart.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上 ai-memory 的收敛闭环：DSH 会话结束时调用 ai-memory finalize-session，把本次捕获的观察整理成 wiki 页面，供 ai-memory 服务的其他 harness 读取；跳过子代理、串行化并发结束的会话，并补扫被强制重启遗留的会话。

description.en: A lightweight plugin that adds model thinking token statistics to the bottom Dock.
description.zh: 在底部 Dock 添加模型思考 token 统计信息的轻量化插件。

description.en: Honor of Kings inspired theme for DeepSeek Harness. Each launch starts with an about 5 second mirror-break opening: the key art appears as a glass pane, cracks outward from the impact point, bursts into 56 shards with gold edges, depth and spin, hangs still, then rotates back together before a golden flash reveals the picture, the sun halo and the light beams. The key art is also inlined as the window backdrop and the texture of both main panels over an ink night sky with a molten sun, frosted mirror shards and drifting embers; the mirror emblem at the bottom left switches motion between full, calm and off, and colours come from overridden design tokens so panels, bubbles, menus and code blocks follow the theme.
description.zh: 王者荣耀「镜 · 炽阳神光」主题。每次启动先播一段约 5 秒的镜面破碎开场：原图先作为一面玻璃浮出，从撞击点向外裂开，炸成 56 片带金边、各有景深与自转的碎片，短暂悬停后逆向旋转重组，金色闪光推开镜面，日轮光环与光束随之展开。主视觉同时内联为整窗底图与两个主面板的肌理，底子是墨色夜空、熔金日轮与光冕、磨砂镜片与漂浮金烬；左下角「镜」徽记可在 神光 / 静谧 / 关闭 三档动效间切换，配色通过覆写设计令牌实现，面板、气泡、菜单与代码块一并跟随。

description.en: Two-level theme manager for the DSH Web UI: pick a culture / scene, a national flag, a developer palette, or a high-contrast pairing first, then a concrete style (58 built-in palettes, light and dark).
description.zh: DSH Web 两级主题管理器：先选文化 / 场景、国旗、开发者配色或强烈对比配色，再选具体风格，内置 58 套浅色 / 深色配色。

description.en: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export standalone HTML replays.
description.zh: 在可播放的时间线上回放会话并显示逐步 token 用量，审计敏感操作，估算成本，查看 fork 血缘，对比会话，并可导出独立 HTML 回放。

description.en: Aggregates every WorkBuddy account already signed in on this machine into one model pool, with manual and scheduled check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, per-model credit multipliers, and account switching with remaining credits right below the composer.
description.zh: 把本机所有登录过的 WorkBuddy 账号聚合成一个模型池，带手动与自动签到、积分与到期监控、模型倍率，并可在输入框下方切换账号、查看剩余总积分。

description.en: Process management: brings ntd-style processes (multi-stage, multi-step agent workflow templates) into the dsh web UI — browse, edit, validate, import/export and AI-generate processes; the built-in library is read-only while the personal library is writable with live file sync, and agents read the library through process_* tools and advance work stage by stage.
description.zh: 工艺管理：把 ntd 的「工艺」（多阶段·多环节 agent 工作流模板）接进 dsh web——浏览/编辑/校验/导入导出/AI 生成工艺，内置库只读、我的库可写，文件改动实时同步；agent 可通过 process_* 工具读工艺库、按工艺分阶段推进。

description.en: Turns the sidebar into a project view and gives each project a room with a shared board, task-line columns filled from message routing, and per-project member avatars.
description.zh: 把侧栏变成项目视图，并给每个项目一个房间：公共看板、按消息归线填充的任务线分列，以及项目内的成员头像。

description.en: Automatic second-opinion review: a restricted child session re-reads the agent's recent work with read-only tools and delivers at most one evidence-backed note, or stays silent. Requires a model route in the config; the plugin stays disabled until one is set.
description.zh: 自动二审：受限子会话用只读工具复核 agent 最近的工作，最多投递一条有证据支撑的提醒，没有问题则保持沉默。

description.en: Windows PowerShell 5.1 skill for downloading large GitHub release assets: it first read-only probes the host (listening local proxy ports, system proxy and env vars, an installed Clash Verge core and its config, curl version), measures KB/s of four routes in parallel (existing proxy, headless-spawned core, public mirrors, direct), runs a short time-boxed concurrency ladder on the winner, then downloads the asset in parallel curl byte ranges and verifies the byte count plus SHA256 against the release digest. Skips the ladder when the asset is under 100 MB or a single connection already reaches 3 MB/s, because concurrency only pays off when a single connection is throttled: measured 6.3x on a throttled node (1,234 to 7,759 KB/s) but 0.72x on a fast one (5,829 vs 4,175 KB/s). Needs no aria2 or 7z, never changes the system proxy, never asks the user for ports or concurrency, reports ASSET_NOT_FOUND with the real candidate names instead of silently picking a different file, and degrades to a size-only check with DOWNLOAD_SIZE_OK_NO_DIGEST when a release predates digests.
description.zh: 在 Windows PowerShell 5.1 上下载 GitHub Release 大资产的技能：先只读自检宿主环境（在监听的本地代理端口、系统代理与环境变量、已安装的 Clash Verge 内核及其配置、curl 版本），四条路线（现有代理 / 无头拉起内核 / 公共镜像 / 直连）并行实测 KB/s，在胜出路线上做限时并发阶梯，再用 curl 多段 range 并发下载，并按 release 的 digest 校验字节数与 SHA256。资产小于 100 MB 或单连接已到 3 MB/s 时直接跳过阶梯——并发只在「单连接被限速」时才有收益：实测限速节点 6.3×（1,234 → 7,759 KB/s），节点不限速时反而是 0.72×（单流 5,829 vs 16 段 4,175 KB/s）。不要求预装 aria2/7z，不改系统代理，不向用户索要端口或并发数；资产名对不上会报 ASSET_NOT_FOUND 并列出真实候选，绝不静默换文件；老 release 没有 digest 时降级为 DOWNLOAD_SIZE_OK_NO_DIGEST。

description.en: Whale-girl desktop pet for the DSH Web UI, drawn with hand-written SVG + CSS (no image or audio assets, zero runtime dependencies): swims while a turn runs, blows labeled bubbles on tool calls, taps the glass with an amber pulse when an approval is waiting, jumps with a turn duration/tool-count report on success and droops on failure, naps after dark or when idle. Click to poke, double-click to pet (affinity hearts), drag with remembered position, right-click menu (feed / mute / reset / hide), hover card with level, title, XP bar and per-turn stats. A `whale_say` tool lets the agent make her speak or act as a lightweight visible notification. Read-only over sessions and workspace; only ~/.dsh/whale-girl/state.json is written.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的鲸鱼女孩桌宠，手写 SVG + CSS 动画（无图片/音频素材，零运行时依赖）：任务运行中游泳，调工具时吐带标签的泡泡，等待审批时贴屏幕敲玻璃并伴随琥珀色脉冲，完成时跳一下并汇报本轮耗时与工具数，失败时下沉，闲置或深夜戴睡帽打盹。单击戳一戳，双击摸头涨好感，拖拽后记住位置，右键菜单可喂食/静音/回默认位置/隐藏，悬停显示等级、称号、经验条与本轮统计。`whale_say` 工具让 Agent 借她说话或做动作，作为轻量可见通知。只读会话与工作区，仅写入 ~/.dsh/whale-girl/state.json。

description.en: Local IMAP invoice download, OCR, archive, and Excel reimbursement summaries for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 IMAP 发票下载、OCR 识别、归档与 Excel 报销汇总。

description.en: Makes the dsh-pet desktop pet read model replies aloud in its own configured voice. Newer dsh-pet gets the whole text in one request (up to its 500-char cap); older versions automatically fall back to 60-char chunks. Each piece is verified against the pet log to confirm it actually played.
description.zh: 让 dsh-pet 桌宠用设置页里选定的音色朗读模型输出。新版桌宠整段一次下发（受其单次 500 字上限约束），旧版自动按 60 字切段兜底；每一段都回读桌宠日志，确认真的念了出来。

description.en: Section icons for the settings navigation: replaces the uniform gear icons with per-section glyphs and fills the plugin-market card avatar slot with a semantic icon chosen per plugin name; a page reload after uninstall restores the official icons.
description.zh: 设置导航分区图标:把千篇一律的齿轮换成各分区专属图形,并为插件市场卡片头像槽按插件名提供语义图标,卸载后重载页面即恢复官方图标。

description.en: Remote access gateway for DSH: a browser, or the optional 4 MB Android app, scans a QR code and joins the session already running on the desktop. One-time QR tickets (10 minutes, single use), a 6-digit pairing code matched on both screens, four network entries (SakuraFrp / Cloudflare quick tunnel / LAN / Tailscale), and per-device admission: an online-device limit, online devices pinned first with a green dot, and remove = disconnect plus revoke trust. The gateway listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
description.zh: DSH 的远程访问网关：用浏览器或可选的 Android App 扫一个码，接入电脑上正在运行的同一个会话。一次性二维码票据（10 分钟、扫一次失效）、6 位配对码两端核对、四条网络入口（SakuraFrp / Cloudflare 快速隧道 / 局域网 / Tailscale）、逐台设备准入（在线上限、在线设备绿灯置顶、离线灰灯、移除即断开并撤销信任）。网关只监听 127.0.0.1。

description.en: Third-party menu manager for the DSH Web UI: collects new menu entries added by other plugins into one place, with fold/collapse and pinned menu items.
description.zh: 第三方菜单管理器：统一收纳第三方插件的新增菜单入口，提供常规折叠与固定菜单项。

description.en: AGENTS & Skills Studio: edit AGENTS.md, create spec-compliant SKILL.md files with structured frontmatter, manage and rename skill folders, and install from Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, and Matt Pocock catalogs.
description.zh: AGENTS & Skills 工作台：编辑 AGENTS.md，按 Agent Skills 规范创建 SKILL.md，管理和重命名技能文件夹，并从 Anthropic、OpenAI、Cursor、Matt Pocock 四源技能目录安装技能。

description.en: Live session-title provider for dsh that regenerates the title after every user message, summarizing the most recent messages within a byte budget.
description.zh: DSH 会话标题实时生成器：每条用户消息后重新生成标题，在字节预算内概括最近几条消息。

description.en: Conversation navigator panel: turn-folded outline of the current session with per-step kind badges (assistant, tool, command, compaction, error), a hover bubble showing the full user question, a minimal mode that hides turn numbers for an all-badge view, keyword filter over user questions and assistant replies, click-to-jump with reading-position tracking, and load-earlier/load-all history paging. Host >= 0.1.2-rc.1; legacy hosts install @legacy/0.2.5.
description.zh: 会话导航面板：按轮折叠的当前会话大纲与步次类型徽标（助手/工具/命令/压缩/出错），悬停气泡显示用户提问全文，可隐藏轮次号的极简徽标视图，仅检索提问与助手回复的关键词过滤，点击跳转与阅读位置跟踪，支持加载更早/加载全部历史分页。宿主 ≥ 0.1.2-rc.1，旧宿主装 @legacy/0.2.5。

description.en: Floating Token Burn Dock for DSH that aggregates provider usage across every session: the collapsed capsule shows the live tokens/sec rate with an inline 60-second sparkline and today's total, while the expanded panel adds a large live-rate hero, per-model and per-hour breakdowns on a real left axis, and a 30-day commit-style heatmap. The sequence-frame flame burns only while tokens are actually flowing and goes out at rate 0; day and hour buckets follow the browser's UTC offset instead of the host process timezone, and the 31-day record store is written atomically after history load so a restart no longer wipes the numbers.
description.zh: DSH 的悬浮 Token 燃烧指数 Dock：汇总全部 session 的 provider usage。收起时是一枚胶囊，显示实时燃烧速率（含 token/s 单位）、内嵌近 60 秒速率曲线和今日总 Token；展开后是完整面板，含大号实时速率 Hero、按模型 / 按小时两种粒度、带真实左侧纵轴的柱状图，以及按真实星期对齐的近 30 天热力图。火焰是 16 帧程序生成的序列帧动画，只在真的有 Token 在烧时播放、速率为 0 时熄灭；日 / 小时分桶按浏览器时区（客户端把 UTC 偏移传给 Host），31 天记录先加载再原子落盘，重启不会再把历史覆盖清空。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DeepSeek Harness: grouped archive panel with restore and delete.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话归档管理：分组归档面板，支持恢复与删除。

description.en: Five skills for a reviewable engineering incident journal: record an event only when a counterfactual can be written, quiz yourself from the existing entries, audit the journal for decay, ingest outside material together with its provenance, and rename a layout directory while rewriting every reference to it.
description.zh: 五个技能维护一本可复习的工程事故日志：写不出反事实就不记，从已有条目出题自测，体检条目腐化，按出处收外部资料，并能在改目录名的同时改掉全库引用。

description.en: Session-scoped checklists the agent maintains, with a tree per session, a token-budgeted prompt digest and a right-sidebar tab where item titles can be edited.
description.zh: 会话级清单：每个会话一棵任务树、按预算注入提示词的摘要，以及可改条目标题的右侧栏面板。

description.en: Indexes each chat of a workspace into a small topic graph every 4 turns (one model call, verbatim source kept under .context-graph/), appends up to 5 matching topics from the other chats to each message, searching a named day such as "yesterday" first, and adds a recall tool that returns the original text by topic, chat, day or turn. On and shared by default; /context-graph off and unshare opt a chat out, and stats, build, map and find inspect it.
description.zh: 每 4 轮把工作区里的每个对话索引成小型主题图谱（一次模型调用，原文保存在 .context-graph/），在每条消息末尾附上其他对话中最多 5 个匹配主题，提到“昨天”等时间时先搜那一天，并提供 recall 工具按主题、对话、日期或轮次取回原文。默认开启并共享；/context-graph off 与 unshare 可让某个对话退出，stats、build、map、find 用于查看。

description.en: Opens the official DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) inside DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar entry renders the real page in the center column through the desktop shell's native browser guest, and keeps you signed in across restarts. The official client keeps its model picker, deep think, smart search, history and attachments. Falls back to opening a window where no guest bridge exists.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内打开 chat.deepseek.com 官方网页版：点侧边栏入口，真实页面通过桌面端的原生浏览器访客渲染在中栏，并且重启后保持登录。模型选择、深度思考、智能搜索、历史记录、附件上传仍是官方那一套；宿主没有该访客桥接时降级为打开窗口。

description.en: PPAP submission level and element completeness check.
description.zh: PPAP 提交等级与资料要素核对。

description.en: DSH right-sidebar plugin that compares two git commits, builds a manual-test checklist from the impact scope, and supports fail notes, screenshots, task attachments, and defect submission to Yunxiao, GitHub, GitLab, or a webhook.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏插件：对比两个 git 提交，根据影响面生成手测清单，支持失败备注、截图、任务附件，以及向云效 / GitHub / GitLab / Webhook 提交缺陷。

description.en: Adds a manual, confirm-first title generator: a header button and a session-row menu entry ask a model to summarize the whole conversation, show the proposal in an editable dialog, and rename the session only after you confirm — without registering a title provider or changing automatic titling.
description.zh: 手动触发的「先确认再改名」标题生成器：顶栏按钮与会话行菜单各一个入口，让模型总结整段会话给出标题，在可编辑弹窗里确认后才重命名会话；不注册标题 provider，不影响自带的自动标题。

description.en: Ponytail lazy senior dev mode: 6 skills adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail.
description.zh: Ponytail 最懒资深工程师模式：6 个技能，改编自 DietrichGebert/ponytail。

description.en: One-click temporary tasks for DeepSeek Harness — each task is a disposable timestamped workspace plus its own session, shown as a native sidebar workspace node.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的临时任务模式：一键创建一次性的时间戳工作区并开会话，直接成为侧边栏原生工作区节点。

description.en: Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供工作区隔离的持久化记忆，让每个工作区拥有可检索、可审计、可纠错和可删除的独立记忆，并支持受控的全局记忆。

description.en: Adds a strip above the composer that lists sent-but-unread (steering) text messages and recalls them before the model reads them, one by one or all at once.
description.zh: 在输入框上方列出已发送但模型尚未读取的插话消息，可在模型读取前逐条或一次性撤回。

description.en: Turns Zhejiang University classroom replays (classroom.zju.edu.cn) into Markdown study notes plus a matching PDF typeset locally with Typst. Transcripts are public; slide capture is opt-in and needs a ZJU login. Scraping core: nzw806/zju-lecture-summerizer-. Optional fill-in notes use the MIT-licensed scholia Typst template.
description.zh: 把浙大智云课堂（classroom.zju.edu.cn）回放整理成 Markdown 复习讲义，并在本地用 Typst 排成同名 PDF。字幕公开免登录；投影截图需在插件设置中开启，且需浙大登录态。抓取内核来自 nzw806/zju-lecture-summerizer-；可选填空笔记用 MIT 授权的 scholia 模板。

description.en: Control DeepSeek Harness Desktop sessions from WeCom on your phone, with session and model switching, tool approvals, task results and generated files, and QR setup in Desktop settings. Needs a dedicated WeCom smart bot; the first person to send it a direct message within 10 minutes of the QR scan (or the 6-digit code from the settings page) becomes the owner, and only the owner's direct messages are accepted afterwards.
description.zh: 在手机企业微信里遥控 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 会话，支持切换会话与模型、工具审批、结果与生成文件推送，并可在 Desktop 设置页扫码配置。需要一个专用的企业微信智能机器人；扫码后 10 分钟内第一个给它发单聊的人（或在设置页给出的 6 位绑定码）成为主人，此后只接受主人的单聊。

description.en: Keeps plugin inventories in sync across machines through a secret GitHub Gist, and updates installed plugins to their newest npm or GitHub release. Push shows a diff first: version conflicts default to the newer side, entries only the Gist has stay by default, and entries only the local machine has are pushed. Each update can pick the npm or the GitHub channel, and every install goes through the plugin manager with a live log.
description.zh: 通过私有 GitHub Gist 在多台机器间同步插件清单，并把已装插件更新到 npm 或 GitHub 上的最新发布版。推送前先展示差异：版本冲突默认取较新一方，仅线上有的条目默认保留，仅本机有的直接推送。每次更新可逐项选择 npm 或 GitHub 通道，安装全程走插件管理器并输出实时日志。

description.en: Applies personal prompts and system-prompt edits at the global level or on a single session, so each session can work with its own prompt setup without touching the others.
description.zh: 可以自行选择在全局范围或单独会话中增加个人提示词、修改系统提示词来工作，各会话互不影响。

description.en: Context7 MCP bridge: gives the model up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples through the Context7 MCP server, keyless by default.
description.zh: 接入 Context7 托管 MCP 服务，为 agent 提供随版本更新的库文档查询；默认免密钥可用。

description.en: Multi-channel notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness: dispatches in-page toasts in the foreground and PWA system notifications (Service Worker) or browser notifications in the background, with per-event toggles for task complete, approval request, question, plan review and errors, persistent notifications, and Web Audio synthesized alert sounds without audio files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多通道通知插件：前台弹页面内 toast，后台按可用性切换 PWA 系统通知（Service Worker）或浏览器通知兜底；任务完成、审批请求、提问、计划评审、出错等事件可逐项开关，重要通知驻留不消失，并用 Web Audio 实时合成提示音效、零音频文件零网络上报。

description.en: Replaces the DSH sidebar with a fixed 2×4 board of eight standing agent seats; each seat shows its own status, latest tool call, reasoning and result, and a settings switch restores the stock sidebar at any time.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏换成固定的 2×4 八席看板，每席显示自己的状态、最近一次工具调用、思考与结果；设置里的开关可随时切回原生侧栏。

description.en: Doubao video workshop: a gated pipeline from storyboard to finished cut. Locked art direction, shot validation, character-card vs reference-image separation, first/last-frame continuity and clip dedup; model-aware duration caps (Mini/Fast 10s, 2.0 15s, 2.5 40s). Uses ffmpeg for frame extraction, concatenation and subtitles; speech synthesis calls a separately installed local TTS plugin, and ASR subtitles need Python with faster-whisper.
description.zh: 豆包视频工坊：把分镜脚本做成成片的全流程闸门。风格锁定、分镜机检、角色卡与参考图分离、首尾帧衔接、片段去重；支持多模型时长上限（Mini/Fast ≤10s、2.0 ≤15s、2.5 ≤40s）。用 ffmpeg 做取帧、拼接与字幕；语音合成调用另装的本机 TTS 插件，原声字幕识别另需 Python 与 faster-whisper。

description.en: OpenFOAM case doctor for DeepSeek-Harness. Six agent tools: audit a case for 25 classes of silent failure (steadyState paired with timeStep writes, limiters set to 1 that let k/epsilon go negative, unbounded advection of transport scalars, nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 0 on a skewed mesh, loose solver tolerances, blockMesh vertex/block mismatch, stray time directories, purgeWrite 0); read any dictionary as JSON; survey a sweep of cases; run checkMesh/blockMesh/snappyHexMesh/foamRun inside WSL with log parsing; parse logs into the metrics that matter (aspect ratio, non-orthogonality, skewness, residual floor, fatal errors). Deterministic text analysis — no LLM — validated against a real 82k-cell street-canyon snappy case.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Harness 的 OpenFOAM 算例医生。六个 agent 工具：体检算例的 25 类静默错误（steadyState 配 timeStep 写出海量时间目录、限幅器设 1 导致 k/epsilon 变负、输运标量无界对流、斜网格上非正交修正为 0、求解容差过松、blockMesh 顶点/块不匹配、残留时间目录、purgeWrite 0）；把任意字典读成 JSON；扫描参数化扫描目录；在 WSL 里跑 checkMesh/blockMesh/snappyHexMesh/foamRun 并解析日志；把日志解成关键指标（长宽比、非正交度、扭曲度、残差地板、致命错误）。纯确定性文本分析，不调 LLM，已在一台真机的 8.2 万单元格街道峡谷 snappy 算例上验证。

description.en: Read-only DSH profile doctor: the seven config-tree checks (config-clobber, dead-patch, tool-collision, plugin-not-mounted, plugin-stale, entry diff, explain) plus eight ecosystem checks learned from real failures — pnpm store version conflicts that break `dsh plugin add`, patch insert names node_modules cannot resolve, broken junctions, duplicate-capability plugins, orphan backup dirs, GitHub-source deps, npm publish-scope hints, and the minimumReleaseAgeExclude gap. Four agent tools; every finding carries its fix.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH profile 医生：配置树七检（patch 丢字段、死 patch、工具重名、装了没挂载、停更、树 diff、组成解释）加八项生态检查——pnpm store 版本冲突（`dsh plugin add` 报 ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE 的根因）、patch insert 指向不存在的包、断裂的 junction、重复能力插件、孤儿 backup 目录、GitHub 源依赖、npm 发布权限提示、minimumReleaseAgeExclude 缺口。四个 agent 工具，每条 finding 都带修复文案。

description.en: Session management for the DSH sidebar: pin conversations, search their contents, read archived transcripts and hide noise.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏会话管理：固定对话、搜索内容、读取归档记录并隐藏噪音。

description.en: Dot-matrix backdrop for the DSH Web UI: the dots form the DeepSeek whale or a transparent PNG you import (alpha-masked), each dot carries its own low-frequency force and follows the cursor in manual mode, while an auto screensaver mode sweeps 360-degree waves and full-screen breathing across the artwork; sliders and toggles live under Settings > Plugins.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 加一层点阵背景:点阵可组成鲸鱼剪影,或导入透明 PNG 按 alpha 取主体;每颗粒子各自持有低频外力,手动模式下跟随光标扰动,自动屏保模式则用 360° 任意方向的扫波与全屏呼吸带动整幅图案;鼠标/自动与鲸鱼/照片在参数面板里切换,入口在 设置 → 插件。

description.en: Edit global AGENTS.md and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md custom instructions in DeepSeek Harness settings, with project-chain discovery, byte-budget display, and save-conflict handling.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页编辑全局 AGENTS.md 和项目 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 个性化指令，提供项目指令链浏览、字节预算显示与保存冲突处理。

description.en: Lets DSH drive the Chrome tab you are already browsing, no vision needed: the page reaches the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing, key presses, scrolling, tab handling and navigation wait for your confirmation in the extension side panel while password and payment-card fields stay masked. Fifteen browser_* tools cover snapshot, text, tab list, open, follow, click, type, press, scroll, wait, navigate, back, close, forward and reload. A repack of the bridge plugin from omdsh-dev/dsh-browser, published to npm so it installs with `dsh plugin add`: the peer ranges the host checks are widened so the install is not refused as incompatible, the bundled extension also probes the DSH Desktop host port 19387 so no bridge address has to be typed, and a script copies the extension to a fixed directory so a profile switch or reinstall cannot break it. The prebuilt release tarball carries the plugin and the built MV3 extension. Upstream: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser.
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接操控你当前正在浏览的 Chrome 标签页，无需视觉能力：页面以带编号元素清单的结构化文本交给模型；点击、输入、按键、滚动、标签页操作与导航都会在扩展侧边栏等你确认，密码与支付卡字段保持掩码。15 个 browser_* 工具覆盖 snapshot、文本读取、标签页列举/打开/跟随、点击、输入、按键、滚动、等待、导航、后退、关闭、前进与刷新。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 桥接插件的再打包版，发布到 npm，可直接 `dsh plugin add` 安装：放宽了宿主安装时校验的 peer 范围，避免被判为版本不兼容；随包的扩展额外探测 DSH 桌面端宿主端口 19387，因此无需手填桥接地址；并附带脚本把扩展复制到固定目录，避免切换 profile 或重装后扩展失效。预构建 Release tarball 内含插件本体与已构建的 MV3 扩展。上游：https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser。

description.en: Execution maze for DSH sessions: the agent's real path — main advance, failed or dead-end detours, backtracks, request retries and subagent branches — drawn on one wall-clock timeline, with three tracks under each lane sharing that axis (tool-call density, token pulse, context pressure) and a deterministic analysis panel below it (tool result matrix, failure-recovery chains, duration distribution); watch it grow live in a session tab, or upload up to 5 session logs for a same-axis compare.
description.zh: 执行迷宫：把智能体真实的执行过程——主干推进、失败或扑空的支路、折返、请求重试与子代理分支——画在同一根墙钟时间轴上；泳道下方是与它共用时间轴的三条数据轨道（工具调用密度、Token 脉冲、上下文压力），再下方是确定性的执行分析面板（工具结果矩阵、失败恢复链、耗时分布）；可在会话页签里实时生长，也可上传最多 5 个 session log 做同轴对比。

description.en: Vision for text-only DeepSeek via Doubao Web by default (zero-cost, no API key — drives your logged-in Chrome through a Windows CDP bridge), with Antigravity IDE quota (flash/pro) or Gemini fallback; auto detail escalation, vision evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图插件：默认走豆包 Web（零成本、免 API key，经 Windows CDP 桥接驱动已登录 Chrome），另有反重力额度（flash/pro）与 Gemini 降级通道；档位自动升级、视觉证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: A floating board over the chat for DS Bot's team: who is running and on which tool, who is waiting for another Bot to hand work back, who needs your approval or answer, and who failed, with a hand-off table grouped by sender, a per-Bot drawer showing the pending command or question, and a collapsed one-line pill. Read-only — it never writes to DS Bot's data. Needs the DS Bot plugin installed (built against 0.1.7 and 0.2.0); the panel stays hidden without it.
description.zh: DS Bot 团队的一块浮动看板：谁在跑、在跑什么工具，谁在等别的 Bot 交活，谁在等你批或等你答，谁报错了；带按发送方分组的交接表、显示待批命令或待答问题的单个 Bot 抽屉，收起后是一条状态胶囊。只读，不写 DS Bot 的数据。需要先装 DS Bot（按 0.1.7 与 0.2.0 开发）；没有 DS Bot 时面板不显示。

description.en: Node.js fork of andyfan1094/dsh-winrm: the same WinRM host panel and seven agent tools, with the backend ported from Python/pywinrm to a native Node WinRM client so the machine running dsh needs no Python.
description.zh: andyfan1094/dsh-winrm 的 Node.js 分支：同样的 WinRM 主机面板与七个 agent 工具，后端从 Python/pywinrm 移植到原生 Node WinRM 客户端，运行 dsh 的机器不再需要 Python。

description.en: Turns an article in the DSH conversation into an Excalidraw canvas in a session tab: the Agent drafts the structure with diagram_create, you edit labels, nodes and layout with autosave, export PNG, SVG or .excalidraw, and the Agent reads your edited canvas back with diagram_read. 0.6 adds an editable classification overview plus a complete detail index for large three-level trees.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话中的文章整理成会话内的 Excalidraw 画布：Agent 用 diagram_create 起草结构，你在画布中修改文字、节点和布局并自动保存，可导出 PNG、SVG 或 .excalidraw，Agent 再用 diagram_read 读回你改过的画布。0.6 新增大型三层分类树的可编辑总览与完整明细索引。

description.en: Telegram duty gateway: phone-message task loop on a dedicated duty session, global approval forwarding with inline approve/reject buttons, telegram_ask choice questions, duty/local toggle with a web duty banner, zh/en messages, zero idle tokens.
description.zh: Telegram 值班网关：手机消息任务闭环（专属值班会话）、值守模式全局审批转发（内联同意/拒绝按钮）、telegram_ask 选项提问、值守/本地切换与网页横幅、中英双语消息、空闲零 token。

description.en: Puts a domain bar under the session header — a domain groups skills and tools and toggles as one block, so one click loads or unloads every member. Hovering a chip lists its members (skills, then tools) in a height-capped panel that scrolls. The right end of the bar is a compaction-threshold counter (− 5 +, 100k tokens per step) that rewrites the live compaction engine policies, so the compaction trigger line changes on the next turn without restarting dsh; a degraded fallback turns the number amber and is reported in the snapshot. Settings maintains domains and members with search, skill/tool tabs, all/selected/unselected filters and a copyable AI grouping prompt. Tool removal uses tools.restrict plus a guard; hiding a skill re-registers it with modelInvocable false, so it leaves the model catalog while /name still works. Sessions of another preset are left untouched.
description.zh: 在会话头下方放一条领域横条：领域是用户自定义的 skill 与 tool 分组，点一下整块加载或卸载，不必逐条开关。悬停芯片在限高面板里列出成员（技能在前、工具在后，超出就在面板内滚动）。最右端是压缩阈值计数器（− 5 +，每格 10 万 token）：它给运行中的压缩引擎重写 modelPolicies，所以压缩触发线改完下一轮就生效，不用重启 dsh；降级时数字转琥珀色并写进 snapshot 的 degraded。设置页维护领域与成员，带搜索、技能与工具页签、全部与已选与未选筛选、可一键复制的 AI 归类 prompt。工具移除走 tools.restrict 加 guard；skill 隐藏是在会话作用域重投同名 skill 并标记不可被模型调用，于是它从模型目录消失而 /名字 仍可用。属于别的 preset 的会话一律不动。

description.en: A fork of Microsoft's official .NET/C# skills for AI coding agents, additionally packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin — covering development, testing, diagnostics, migration, and AI integration.
description.zh: 微软官方 .NET/C# AI 编码智能体技能的 fork，额外打包为 DeepSeek Harness 插件——覆盖开发、测试、诊断、迁移与 AI 集成。

description.en: Deterministic step governance for DSH agents: rejects over-budget agent steps and denies risky tool executions before they run, with shadow mode by default and fail-open on errors.
description.zh: 为 DSH 代理提供确定性步数治理，在超预算的 agent 步执行前拒绝、在风险工具调用执行前阻断，默认影子模式，出错时放行不阻断业务。

description.en: Built-in browser: gives the agent a real headed Chromium it can open, click, type and scroll in, keeping page state across calls.
description.zh: 内置浏览器：给 Agent 一个真实的有头 Chromium，可打开网页并点击、输入、滚动，页面状态在多次调用之间保持。

description.en: Sidebar row with today's tokens and estimated spend for DeepSeek Harness; the dialog adds 24h, 7-day, 30-day, 12-month and per-year charts, a contributions heatmap, per-request peak/off-peak pricing from the official DeepSeek price list and the Chinese statutory holiday calendar, and optional WebDAV sync that merges usage across machines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏用量徽标：显示当天 token 总量与估算费用；弹窗里有 24 小时 / 近 7 日 / 近 30 日 / 近 12 个月与按年图表、活跃度热力图，按 DeepSeek 官方定价与中国法定节假日逐请求计算峰谷价，并可选 WebDAV 云同步合并多台机器的用量。

description.en: Computer-aided translation, inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中完成计算机辅助翻译。

description.en: Composer prompt refinement: rewrite the draft through the harness LLM, preview the result, then apply or send it, with style presets, model-aware reasoning effort, cost estimate and a settings page.
description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强：通过宿主模型改写草稿，预览后再替换或发送；支持风格预设、按模型自适应思考档位、费用估算与设置页。

description.en: Always-on-top status pill for DSH on Windows: shows each session's turn state (thinking with a running timer, waiting for approval, done, failed) above every window, and while DSH is in the background it draws a bubble under the pill to approve a tool request (allow once / reject) or answer the agent's questions without switching back to the app; it declines to intercept whenever DSH is in front or the overlay is hidden, so the official cards still handle those. Sessions can be listed one per row (row count configurable) or folded into a +N badge by priority, the pill collapses to a small dot after a state settles and hides itself while a fullscreen app is in front, clicking brings DSH to the foreground and dragging moves it, and it reuses the Electron build already shipped with DSH Desktop so nothing extra is downloaded. A settings card on the plugin page adjusts scale, mini size, position, layout, row count, hold times, effects, bubble toggles and per-state visibility.
description.zh: Windows 上的 DSH 置顶状态胶囊：把每个会话的回合状态（思考并计时、等待审批、完成、失败）浮在所有窗口之上；DSH 在后台时胶囊下方会浮出气泡，可直接批准工具请求（允许一次 / 拒绝）或回答 Agent 的提问，不用切回应用；DSH 在前台或浮层被隐藏时不拦截，仍由官方卡片处理。会话可每行一个纵向排列（行数可调），或按优先级折成 +N 角标；状态结束后缩成小圆点，前台是全屏应用时自动隐藏；点击可把 DSH 拉到前台，拖动可改位置；复用 DSH Desktop 自带的 Electron，不额外下载。插件页里的设置卡片可调缩放、迷你尺寸、位置、布局、行数、收起时间、动效、气泡开关和各状态开关。

description.en: Standalone workspace file-tree panel for the DSH web UI: a session-header icon opens an animated popup of the current workspace tree; click or drag a file to insert its reference into the composer, with search, inline preview, live settings, and zh/en i18n; single-purpose, zero-config, one-command install.
description.zh: 独立单功能的工作区文件树面板：会话头部图标打开当前工作区目录树的动画弹窗；点击或拖拽文件即可把引用插入输入框；自带搜索、行内预览、实时设置与中英双语；零配置，一条命令即装即用。

description.en: LAN/remote access for the Web UI: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill on plain-HTTP origins so the frontend survives LAN or Tailscale IP direct links.
description.zh: Web UI 局域网/远程访问：为纯 HTTP 非安全上下文注入 crypto.randomUUID polyfill，局域网/Tailscale IP 直连时前端不再崩溃。

description.en: Dockable side panel that keeps an XEChat chat session connected over a single WebSocket: markdown messages with images and emoji, server switching through #showServer and #login, an online member list, a full-screen panic overlay, and dock side, width and visibility persisted to localStorage.
description.zh: 可停靠的侧边面板，用一条 WebSocket 保持 XEChat 聊天在线：支持图片与表情的 Markdown 消息、通过 #showServer 与 #login 切换服务器、在线成员列表、全屏伪装覆盖层，停靠位置、宽度与可视状态持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: Leafy green skin for the DSH Web GUI that overrides the --dsw-* palette in light and dark themes, plus a CSS layer for corners, shadows and motion that can be switched off.
description.zh: 叶绿色皮肤：把 DSH Web GUI 的 --dsw-* 调色板覆盖成浅色 / 深色两套叶绿配色，另有一层可关闭的样式层处理圆角、阴影与动效。

description.en: Burned DSH tokens become incense; spend one stick to raise or lower today's case. The case updates daily, Liangwei decides today's Liangzi, and the result is archived at day end.
description.zh: 用 DSH 烧掉的 Token 凝成香火，花一炷给今日梁案投夯或拉；梁案每日更新，梁位决定今日梁子，日终收入梁祠。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approve or reject from the notification while DSH is in the background, with an in-app fallback; foreground only skips the current conversation, while other conversations still notify. Also reports turn completion and errors; subagent sessions stay silent.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 授权通知：后台时可直接在通知上点「允许一次 / 拒绝」，前台时当前对话走应用内审批框、其他对话照常提醒；另含完成 / 出错通知，子代理会话保持静默。

description.en: Run Claude Code, Kimi CLI, Codex CLI, PI CLI, OMP CLI, OpenCode and CodeBuddy CLI (off by default, unverified) inside DeepSeek Harness sessions over ACP, with a CLI and model menu, a git changes panel and worktrees in the Web and Desktop UI. Needs each CLI installed and signed in (OMP, OpenCode and CodeBuddy must be installed first). The CLI runs outside the DSH sandbox and decides what to ask: only Claude Code in manual mode and OpenCode with ask permissions raise DSH approval cards, Codex, PI and OMP run commands without asking.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话里通过 ACP 使用 Claude Code、Kimi CLI、Codex CLI、PI CLI、OMP CLI、OpenCode 和 CodeBuddy CLI（CodeBuddy 默认关闭、未验证），Web/Desktop 界面提供 CLI 与模型菜单、git 变更面板和 Worktree。需要各 CLI 已安装并登录（OMP、OpenCode、CodeBuddy 须先自行安装）。CLI 在 DSH 沙箱之外运行、自己决定何时询问：只有 Claude Code 手动模式和配置为询问的 OpenCode 会弹 DSH 审批卡片，Codex、PI、OMP 直接执行。

description.en: Windows serial-port monitor for DeepSeek Harness — port parameters, live text/hex receive and data sending.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 串口调试面板：串口参数设置、文本/十六进制实时接收显示与数据发送。

description.en: Adds a sidebar card to DeepSeek Harness that runs a chosen action once every task finishes and the card is armed — shut down, restart, sleep, hibernate, lock, sign out, or a script you uploaded to its shared library; it holds back with a stated reason while background jobs, errored sessions or a manual interruption are still in play. Verified on Windows, macOS and Linux.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加一张卡片：武装后等所有任务结束执行你选的动作——关机、重启、睡眠、休眠、锁屏、注销，或运行你上传到共享脚本库里的脚本；后台任务在跑、本批次有会话报错、或你手动中断过，都会按条件暂缓并说明原因。Windows、macOS、Linux 三平台均已真机验证。

description.en: Bottom-right quota capsule that auto-discovers every configured provider (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, GLM, one-api/new-api, coding plans) and shows balance or rolling 5-hour and weekly usage, with per-provider visibility, alert thresholds and proxy support; also queries Volcengine Ark Agent Plan / Coding Plan usage via AK/SK-signed OpenAPI, and ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription usage via in-plugin device-code login or the Codex CLI auth file.
description.zh: 右下角额度胶囊：自动发现所有已配置 Key 的供应商（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、GLM、one-api/new-api、各类 Coding 套餐），显示余额或 5 小时/周滚动用量，支持按供应商设置可见性、告警阈值与代理；另支持火山方舟 Agent Plan / Coding Plan 用量查询（AK/SK 签名 OpenAPI）与 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 订阅用量（插件内设备码登录，或读取 Codex CLI 登录态）。

description.en: Codex-style drag-to-reference for DeepSeek Harness: drag a conversation row from the sidebar onto the chat area and it becomes a native session-reference chip in the composer draft, so you can keep typing around it before sending. Drag a workspace (folder) row instead and the draft gets that folder's path, so a whole directory can be handed to the model. The target session is matched by session id rather than by title, so duplicate or blank titles cannot insert the wrong conversation. The reference cap comes from the host (3 by default) and is read at runtime instead of being hard-coded, so a host-side raise is followed without changing the plugin. If the chip cannot be inserted, the plugin falls back to sending a reference-only message instead of failing silently.
description.zh: Codex 同款拖拽引用对话：把侧栏的会话行拖到对话区，它就变成输入框里一枚原生会话引用 chip，可以继续打字再发送。拖侧栏的工作区（文件夹）行，则把那个文件夹的路径插进草稿，整个目录一起交给模型。候选按 session id 匹配而不是按标题，标题重名或为空都不会插错对话。引用条数由宿主决定（原版 3 条），插件在运行时从宿主读取该上限而不写死，宿主侧调大后自动跟随、不用改插件。chip 插不进时降级为直接发一条只含引用的消息，不会静默失败。

description.en: Continual self-refinement loop: persistent memory, periodic review-and-refine, cross-session shared knowledge, and automatic rollback through a model-callable harness_refine tool.
description.zh: 持续自我优化闭环：持久记忆、周期评审与自动优化、跨会话共享知识、失败自动回滚，由模型可调用的 harness_refine 工具驱动。

description.en: Folds each 4-50 KB paste in the DSH composer into its own chip (expand or delete it individually), and turns a paste of 50 KB or more into a real file attachment. Declares DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, so it stays visible on the 0.2 release line.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里每次 4–50 KB 的粘贴折叠成独立的一枚 chip（可单独展开或删除），50 KB 及以上的粘贴转成真附件。声明 DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0，因此在 0.2 版本线上保持可见。

description.en: Native Harness workbench and local gateway for Dot to read saved projects and conversations, dispatch native tasks, inspect progress, continue or cancel tasks, and manage connection authorization.
description.zh: 通过原生 Harness 工作台和本机网关，让 Dot 读取已保存项目与会话、派发原生任务、查看进度、继续或取消任务，并管理连接授权。

description.en: Local knowledge base and document search for DeepSeek Harness with full-text search, PDF/Word/PowerPoint/Excel/Markdown import, OCR, ACL, and a Web panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识库与文档检索插件：全文搜索、PDF/Word/PPT/Excel/Markdown 导入与按行读取、扫描件 OCR、ACL 和 Web 面板。

description.en: Sidebar usage panel that attributes tokens to the relay site that served each request, read from your existing provider config: today/month/all-time totals, per-site and per-model breakdowns, a year activity heatmap, and New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek balances.
description.zh: 侧边栏用量面板：把 Token 归属到实际服务该请求的中转站，站点从已有的 provider 配置中读出，无需额外配置；含今日/本月/累计三窗口、按站点与模型下钻、一年活跃度热力图，以及 New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek 余额。

description.en: Expose every free model from a local opencode serve catalog — all providers, including your own custom ones — to DeepSeek Harness's model picker, with OpenCode's native tools denied so execution stays in DSH.
description.zh: 把本机 opencode serve 目录里的全部免费模型（覆盖所有 provider，含你自定义的 provider）接入 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器，并禁用 OpenCode 原生工具，执行权留在 DSH。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns Jev judgments into three automatic actions — pruning oversized tool output to the segments relevant to the request, screening fetched pages for instructions aimed at the model, and picking which skill fits the next step — plus the jev_ask and jev_gate tools, a judgment ledger that survives restarts, and a /jev-status report. Needs a TypeSafe API key; without one it is inert and sends nothing.
description.zh: 把 Jev 判定变成三件自动动作的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：精简超长工具输出、筛查抓取页面里针对模型的指令、挑选下一步该用的 skill；另有 jev_ask 与 jev_gate 两个工具、可跨重启的判定账本，以及 /jev-status 报告。需要 TypeSafe API key，没有时完全惰性，不发任何请求。

description.en: Image and video wallpapers for the DSH web workspace: auto-detected GIF/APNG/animated WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM backgrounds with blur, brightness and dimming, tint-following UI, per-component transparency, and one-click preset wallpapers.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供图片/视频壁纸背景：GIF/APNG/动图 WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM 魔数自动识别，压暗/亮度/高斯模糊，界面色调与字体颜色自动跟随背景，各组件独立透明度，预置壁纸一键应用。

description.en: A VS Code-like workspace panel with a JetBrains-inspired editor: lazy file tree, TypeScript code viewer with syntax highlighting, soft-wrap, find & replace, Quick Open, multi-tab drafts, bracket matching/auto-pair, workspace-wide text search, git status/history with coloured diffs, six VS Code palettes plus follow-DSH, Markdown and image/SVG previews. Nine authenticated host routes serve the filesystem, images, git reads and a quick-open file index.
description.zh: 类 VS Code 的工作区面板，编辑器对照 JetBrains 打磨：懒加载文件树、带语法高亮的 TypeScript 代码视图与软换行、文件内查找替换、Quick Open、多标签草稿、括号匹配/自动配对，全工作区文本搜索、Git 状态/历史与彩色 diff、六套 VS Code 配色并支持跟随 DSH 主题、Markdown 与图片/SVG 预览；Host 端九条鉴权路由提供文件系统、图片、Git 读取与 Quick Open 文件索引。

description.en: Five-layer persona (L1–L5), event memory with FTS5 plus Dice retrieval, cognitive filter, skill cards with auto-frozen asset packs, millisecond reflex rules, three-tier safety degradation, a read-only brain star map, and an optional VPet-Simulator MOD bridge.
description.zh: 五层人格（L1–L5）、事件记忆（FTS5 与 Dice 混合检索）、认知滤网、技能卡与自固化资产包、毫秒级条件反射、三档安全降级、只读脑星图，另附可选的 VPet-Simulator 桌宠 MOD 桥。

description.en: Quote selected conversation text into the Web composer as native reference chips for focused follow-up turns.
description.zh: 在网页会话中划选文本，以原生引用 chip 插入输入框，进行针对性追问。

description.en: EIA technical guideline applicability and execution-standard check.
description.zh: 环评导则适用性与执行标准核对。

description.en: Windows disk browsing, file operations and persistent preview in DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 的 Windows 磁盘浏览、文件操作与持久预览。

description.en: Registers the domestic-China trip-planning skill: hour-level daily timelines, 12306 and Trip.com booking deep links, offline KML, and seven HTML themes. Requires Python 3.9+ on PATH (the bundled scripts are standard-library only).
description.zh: 把境内旅行规划技能注册进 DSH 技能目录：逐小时每日时间线、12306 与携程/去哪儿预订深链、离线 KML 与七套 HTML 主题。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.9+（内置脚本仅依赖标准库）。

description.en: Letter of credit document check against UCP600: documents, periods and discrepancies.
description.zh: 信用证单据与 UCP600 不符点核对。

description.en: A better fold bar: automatically folds tool calls and Think segments into step fold bars, and collapses each finished turn into a single turn header with live metrics (duration, TTFT, token, tok/s, cache hit) — only the final summary stays visible; customizable leading icons with animated poker cards built in (suit-cycling card animation while running, a deck when collapsed, a fan when expanded), a settings row for the official fold mode, compatible with both new and old DSH versions. Zero intrusion into DSH source.
description.zh: 更好的折叠栏：将工具调用与 Think 段自动折叠为步骤折叠栏，回合结束后整回合收拢为带实时指标（耗时/首字/token/tok/s/缓存命中）的回合折叠栏，只保留最终总结正文；前导图标可自定义，内置动态扑克牌（运行中花色循环卡牌动画、收起牌堆、展开扇形），提供官方折叠方式设置行，适配 DSH 新旧版本。零侵入 DSH 源码。

description.en: Trimmed fork of ItQianChen/dsh-github-flow: a floating panel plus a right-column review pane for the pull requests raised in a session, showing CI state, review comments and merge status. It also registers the github_* agent tools (PR merge and review, secrets, raw API), so do not install both.
description.zh: fork 自 ItQianChen/dsh-github-flow 并裁剪：本会话 PR 的浮窗与右列审阅面板，显示 CI 状态、评审意见与合并状态；同时注册 github_* 工具（含合并/评审 PR、密钥、原始 API），勿与原版同装。
