description.en: Cross-session message forwarding between DSH sessions: extract one model reply, a user message, or a multi-selected batch of messages and images from one session and deliver it into another, with silent send, draft fill, or send-and-jump delivery, plus prompt templates.
description.zh: DSH 会话间消息转发：把单条模型回复、用户消息或多选合并的消息与图片从上游会话提取出来投递到另一个会话，支持静默发送、填入草稿、发送并跳转三种投递方式，并可套用提示词模板。

description.en: COM-driven real Microsoft Office automation for DeepSeek Harness: drives a running Excel/Word instance through OfficeMCP — VBA macros, pivot tables, live formula recalculation, and deep document layout; plus an accounting suite (double-entry journal posting with debit/credit balance check, and SUMIF general ledger).
description.zh: COM 驱动真实 Microsoft Office 实例的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：经 OfficeMCP 操作运行中的 Excel/Word——VBA 宏、透视表、活公式重算、文档深度排版；含会计场景（复式记账分录 + 借贷平衡校验、SUMIF 科目总账）。

description.en: Replaces the composer's model and reasoning-effort selector with a two-level menu and six slider skins.
description.zh: 把输入框右下角的模型 / 推理等级选择器换成两级菜单，并提供六种滑杆视觉。

description.en: Builds a Markdown knowledge base from your course materials, then drills you until every knowledge point reaches your target accuracy; each answer must include your reasoning.
description.zh: 从课程材料建一份 Markdown 知识库，然后出题刷到每个知识点都达到目标正确率；每题都必须写出思维链。

description.en: Terminal-native TUI frontend for DeepSeek Harness that presents sessions, models, plugins, jobs, subagents, todos, and provider configuration through Harness capabilities while preserving real terminal scrollback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端原生 TUI 前端，通过 Harness 能力提供会话、模型、插件、任务、子代理、待办事项和 Provider 配置，并保留真实的终端滚动历史。

description.en: Instance manager for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that lists every local dsh web instance the machine can see (port, PID, uptime, live session count, resident memory, version), starts a new instance on an automatically picked free port in 3080-3129 or on a port you name, opens a row in a new tab, and stops one or all of them through that instance’s own graceful shutdown (appExit). Rows also show what each instance is serving, and read-only instance logs and session summaries are one click away. Where a peer is configured, the same panel lists and queries instances on other machines over a bearer-authenticated link. Every route is loopback-guarded, and a browser-facing action must additionally pass the host’s own browser authentication.
description.zh: DSH Web 实例管理器：Mini Utility Dock 面板列出本机可见的全部 dsh web 实例（端口、PID、运行时长、会话数、常驻内存、版本），可在 3080–3129 自动选一个空闲端口或按指定端口启动新实例、把某一行在新标签页打开，并通过目标实例自身的优雅退出停掉单个或全部实例。行内还显示每个实例在跑什么，只读的实例日志与会话概要一点即达。配置了 peer 时，同一个面板会通过带 bearer 鉴权的链路列出并查询其他机器上的实例。所有路由都做回环校验，面向浏览器的操作还要额外通过宿主自身的鉴权。

description.en: An always-last, collapsible Recent tasks workspace group in the DSH sidebar: a sidebar entry and the Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N shortcut start a chat in a dedicated folder, so it lands in that group instead of 未分组. The group is a genuine workspace record rather than a plugin-drawn look-alike, so collapse, rename, search and drag order behave normally, and its folder, group name, pin-last and auto-repair are live settings.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里常驻末位、可折叠的「最近任务」工作区分组：侧边栏入口与 Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N 快捷键在专用目录里开新对话，对话因此归入这个分组，而不是「未分组」。该分组是真正的工作区记录，而非插件画出来的仿制品，折叠、改名、搜索与拖拽排序都正常可用；目录、分组名、常驻末尾与自动重建都是实时设置。

description.en: Session workspace file manager: adds a "Files" tab to the conversation area to browse the current session workspace directory tree and manage it in place (upload, download, mkdir, rename, delete, search), with files mentionable into the composer for the agent to process.
description.zh: 会话工作区文件管理：在对话区加「文件」tab，浏览当前会话工作区的目录树并就地管理（上传/下载/新建文件夹/改名/删除/搜索），文件可 @ 进对话框给 agent 处理。

description.en: Load Claude Code assets into DSH at runtime — skills, slash commands, rules, permission rules (deny/ask/allow), subagents and hooks from .claude/, plus Claude Code plugins (plugin.json / marketplace / skills / agents / MCP), via an in-memory IR that keeps .claude as the source of truth and writes back only when you opt in. Also surfaces Claude Code auto-memory in the system prompt, read-only by default, with a write-back switch in the /cc-memory panel. Eight packages: one bundle that installs the whole set, plus the loader and six adapters (skills, permissions, agents, hooks, mcp, memory).
description.zh: 运行时把 Claude Code 全家桶原样加载进 DSH：.claude/ 的技能、斜杠命令、规则、权限（deny/ask/allow）、子代理与 hooks，以及 Claude Code 插件（plugin.json / marketplace / 技能 / 代理 / MCP）——内存 IR 解析层，.claude 始终是唯一事实来源，只有主动开启才会写回。同时把 Claude Code 的 auto-memory 接入系统提示，默认只读，可在 /cc-memory 面板打开写回。八个包：一个可一键装齐的全家桶包、loader，以及 skills、permissions、agents、hooks、mcp、memory 六个适配包。

description.en: Graph-based code context, impact analysis, review workflows, interactive graphs, and permission-controlled refactoring for DSH using the code-review-graph engine.
description.zh: 基于 code-review-graph 引擎，为 DSH 提供代码图谱上下文、影响分析、审查工作流、交互式图谱和权限控制的重构。

description.en: Fetches any http/https page and returns title, description, main text, heading outline and links, with stats (char/word counts, reading time, language) and top keywords; can download content images to the session workspace for vision analysis and dispatch them to registered analyzers via the scrape.imageAnalyzer service.
description.zh: 抓取任意 http/https 网页，提取标题、描述、正文、标题结构与链接，输出字符/词数、阅读时长、语言等统计与高频关键词；支持下载内容图片到会话工作区供视觉分析，并通过 scrape.imageAnalyzer 服务分发给已注册的识图分析器。

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills covering planning, TDD, debugging, and code review.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能，覆盖规划、TDD、调试与代码评审。

description.en: EVA Unit-02 theme with an entry-plug boot cinematic, a context-based sync meter, and configurable dark interface styling.
description.zh: EVA 弐号机主题，提供插入栓启动演出、基于上下文余量的同步率表和可配置的深色界面样式。

description.en: Literature search for DeepSeek Harness: pubmed_search, pubmed_paper and pubmed_related over the official NCBI E-utilities (including elink related-article ranking), plus scholar_search and scholar_cite (MLA/APA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/BibTeX via SerpApi). Both backends return one paper shape, and a settings card configures the API keys, the Scholar backend and the rate/result limits.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的文献检索：pubmed_search、pubmed_paper、pubmed_related 走官方 NCBI E-utilities（含 elink 相关文献排序），scholar_search、scholar_cite 走 Google Scholar（MLA/APA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/BibTeX，需 SerpApi 后端）。两个后端统一为同一种 paper 结构，设置卡片可配置 API key、Scholar 后端与速率/条数上限。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to OOMOL-managed apps and services, with progressive Connector Action discovery and execution plus an in-app panel for managing Provider connections.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入由 OOMOL 管理的应用与服务，支持渐进式发现并执行 Connector Actions，并提供用于管理 Provider 连接的应用内面板。

description.en: Skill center for DSH: browse skills by region, install them from a zip archive, and manage them afterwards with enable/disable, uninstall, trash restore and search.
description.zh: 技能中心：按区域浏览技能、从 zip 安装，并支持启用停用、卸载、回收站恢复与搜索。

description.en: Adds a manim_card tool that renders Manim Python into a playable animation card in the chat stream; the code runs in the browser on a bundled runtime, so no local Python is needed, and video export goes through the local Manim CLI when installed or frame by frame in the browser otherwise.
description.zh: 新增 manim_card 工具，把 Manim Python 渲染为聊天流中可播放的动画卡片；代码经随包分发的运行时在浏览器内执行，本机无需安装 Python；导出视频时，本机装了 Manim 就走 CLI 渲染，否则在浏览器内逐帧导出。

description.en: A Gemini kitten widget for the DSH Web UI: live Google Gemini API free-tier quota per model, a model switcher, color-coded warnings, drag-to-snap, and click-to-change lines.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的 Gemini 猫娘额度挂件：每个模型的 Gemini API 免费层配额实时显示、按型号切换、按额度变色预警、拖拽吸附、点击换台词。

description.en: Turn English audiobooks (MP3) and documents into listening lessons: transcribe every sentence locally with the speech model DSH voice input already downloaded (about 241 MB, fetched on first use if missing; ffmpeg required), proofread and explain each sentence with your DSH model, then drill with blind listening, intensive listening and spaced repetition, with Chinese-dubbing export and offline Kokoro voices; ships a sidebar panel and four AI tools.
description.zh: 把英文有声读物（MP3）和英文文档（PDF / Word / EPUB / 网页 / TXT）变成听力课：用 DSH 语音输入已下载的模型在本机识别每一句（缺失时首次使用自动下载约 241 MB；需 ffmpeg）、用你选的大模型逐句校对翻译讲解，再以精听、间隔复习、磨耳朵练到一听就懂；支持中文配音导出与离线 Kokoro 语音，提供右侧栏面板和 4 个 AI 工具。

description.en: Blocks edit/write writes that contain characters matching configurable regex rules, executed before the tool runs, with configurable messages and same-turn pwsh propagation; default rule matches full-width parentheses.
description.zh: 在工具执行前拦截 edit/write 写入内容里匹配配置正则的字符，默认匹配全角圆括号，同一回合命中后连带拦截后续 pwsh，报错文案与正则均可配置。

description.en: Better Session Topbar: replaces the session topbar title with a workspace and session breadcrumb, switching workspaces, sessions and subagents from topbar dropdowns; adding a workspace hands off to the host's own directory picker, which is the OS folder dialog on desktop.
description.zh: 更好的会话顶栏：把会话顶栏标题换成工作区与会话面包屑，可在顶栏下拉里切换工作区、会话与子智能体；添加工作区直接交给宿主的目录选择，桌面版就是系统文件夹对话框。

description.en: Live tokens-per-second readout for the current session, docked to the sidebar or draggable as a floating card, with the placement chosen at the card's top-right corner.
description.zh: 当前会话的实时 tokens/s 读数卡片，可停靠左侧栏或作为悬浮卡片拖动，形态在卡片右上角切换。

description.en: Session and message surgery in one plugin: recall or edit prompts and replies (reasoning included), regenerate from the original prompt, delete any turn at the model-context level, and archive, delete, move or migrate sessions across workspaces. Targets DSH 0.1.5 and 0.2.x, verified on 0.2.1-rc.3. A combined fork of three MIT plugins (dsh-message-recall from Jipcon/DSH-plugins, dsh-session-manager from hkkz9522, dsh-delete-turn from DDDMUC) with added reply editing, regeneration and workspace migration. Do not enable it together with those plugins or other session movers or message deleters.
description.zh: 一个插件做会话与消息手术：撤回或编辑指令/回复（连思考过程一起改）、用原提问重新生成、按模型上下文级删除任意一条，以及会话归档、删除、跨工作区移动与工作区迁移。面向 DSH 0.1.5 / 0.2.x，已在 0.2.1-rc.3 实测。由三个 MIT 插件分叉合并而成（Jipcon/DSH-plugins 的 dsh-message-recall、hkkz9522 的 dsh-session-manager、DDDMUC 的 dsh-delete-turn），新增编辑回复、重新生成与工作区迁移。不要与这些插件或其它会话移动、消息删除类插件同时启用。

description.en: Unify third-party plugin settings in DeepSeek Harness. Auto-discover, group, and reorder plugin settings under one collapsible nav entry with drag-and-drop support.
description.zh: 统一收纳 DeepSeek Harness 里的第三方插件设置：自动发现、分组，并在一个可折叠的导航入口下拖拽排序。

description.en: Colored status marks on DeepSeek Harness sidebar workspace rows — waiting for you, running, or recently finished — aggregated per workspace, plus a pinned-conversations section above the list and pinned-only notifications, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的工作区行上显示彩色状态标记（等待你处理、运行中、刚刚完成，按工作区聚合），并在列表上方提供已置顶会话区与仅针对置顶会话的通知，持久保存。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages local inference engines.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于管理本地推理引擎。

description.en: Database connections and SQL for DeepSeek Harness: register data sources, browse and comment schemas, run AST-checked SQL with a per-source read-only toggle, and render bar, line and pie charts, from chat or the Settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库连接与 SQL 插件：注册数据源，浏览并注释表结构，通过 AST 校验执行 SQL（每个数据源可单独切换只读），并渲染柱状图、折线图和饼图，可在对话或设置页中使用。

description.en: Control a paired Android phone from DeepSeek Harness: read the accessibility node tree, tap by text, type into fields, take screenshots, launch apps, and read or write files over an encrypted WebSocket. Needs the companion Android app (Android 11+; the APK is attached to every release since v0.0.45, so no local build is needed — the source is in the repo if you would rather compile it with JDK 21 and Android SDK 36) and a network route from the phone to the computer (same Wi-Fi or a tunnel; the bridge listens on all interfaces by default). Pairing is a DSH settings section (8-digit code or QR code, listening port); the permission switches live in the phone app, and by default the agent cannot drive the bridge app itself.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 控制已配对的 Android 手机：读取无障碍节点树、按文字点击、输入文字、截图、启动应用，还能读写手机上的文件；连接走加密 WebSocket。需要配套的 Android App（Android 11+；自 v0.0.45 起每个 Release 都附了安装包，直接下载即可、不必自己编译；想自己编也可以，源码在仓库里，需 JDK 21 与 Android SDK 36），且手机要能连到电脑（同一 Wi-Fi 或隧道；桥默认监听所有网卡）。配对在 DSH 的设置页完成（8 位配对码或二维码、监听端口）；权限开关在手机 App 里，且默认不允许智能体操作桥接 App 自身。

description.en: Push DSH task results to the Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today screen as service cards. After installing, enter the auth code on the plugin settings page: DSH top-left Plugins - dsh-harmonyos-hiboard.
description.zh: 把DSH的任务结果，以服务卡片形式推送到华为鸿蒙负一屏。安装后请在插件设置页输入授权码，位置：主页面左上角「插件」→ 「dsh-harmonyos-hiboard」。

description.en: Adds a docked-first vertical shorts wall to the DSH Web UI with YouTube Shorts and Bilibili sources, keyword rotation, four-corner resizing, and Alt+S/Alt+M shortcuts.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入默认贴边的竖屏短视频墙：YouTube Shorts 与 B站双源、关键词轮换、四角缩放及 Alt+S/Alt+M 快捷键。

description.en: Read local EPUB, TXT and Markdown novels below selected native DSH chat regions on explicit expansion, preserving real reasoning and tool output without sending novel text to the model. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0.
description.zh: 小说摸鱼：主动展开选中的原生聊天区域时，在保留真实思考和工具输出的下方阅读本地 EPUB、TXT、Markdown 小说，小说不发送给模型。兼容 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, load them on demand, and filter tools to reduce context usage.
description.zh: 管理 MCP 服务器，按需加载并筛选工具以减少上下文占用。

description.en: Adversarial review for DeepSeek Harness: put one settled plan on the stand, send read-only red-team experts at it by dimension, then split their findings into single defects you endorse or reject one by one. It never rewrites the plan and never fixes code.
description.zh: 对抗式评审：把一个已定稿的方案摆上台，让只读红队专家按维度分头攻击，再把发言拆成逐条可裁决的缺陷由你逐一认定或驳回。它不产出方案、不改代码、不自动修复。

description.en: Beads issue browser in the right sidebar: filter and search the tracker with live ready and waiting counts, read issue Markdown with clickable project-file and issue links, and copy or insert the issue id. Requires the bd CLI on PATH and a project with a Beads workspace.
description.zh: 右侧栏的 Beads 议题浏览器：按可开工、受阻与各状态筛选并搜索 tracker，阅读渲染后的议题正文，其中的项目文件与议题 id 可直接点击，并可一键复制或插入 id。需要 PATH 上的 bd CLI，以及已初始化 Beads 工作区的项目。

description.en: One-click 💪 prompt enhancement (prompt): thin draft? continue 🔜, unhappy? regenerate 🔄; auto-archive history 🕐 with rollback ↩️; result syncs back to the composer with a line-by-line diff; 🗺️show the panel 🎨 customise the 🪄 prompt-button icon 📍 and button position yourself.
description.zh: 一键增强💪提示词(prompt)——嫌短就继续生成🔜，不满意就重新生成🔄；自动存档历史记录🕐，支持回退 ↩️；结果同步回输入框，差异逐行对比；🗺️显示界面🎨 提示词🪄按钮图标📍按键位置自己定制

description.en: Adds a comet-like light band that flows along the window edge of DeepSeek Harness — up to four in parallel, colored by each session's model, reversing direction while waiting for your reply, and returning to the composer or the workspace once the conversation ends.
description.zh: 为你的 DeepSeek Harness 添加沿窗口边缘流动的流星式光带 —— 最多四条并行、按会话模型配色、等待回复时反向流动，在对话结束后自行返回对话框或工作区。

description.en: DSH plugin: bring your ChatGPT subscription into DeepSeek Harness — Codex models, GPT Image, quota and recovery checks, plus a per-plugin scoped HTTP(S) proxy. Community alpha fork of dsh-codex-connect, published on the alpha dist-tag; it registers the same openai-codex provider, so it cannot be installed alongside the upstream plugin; the image, quota and proxy features are opt-in and off by default.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把你的 ChatGPT 订阅接进 DeepSeek Harness——Codex 模型、GPT Image、额度与恢复检查，以及按插件隔离的 HTTP(S) 代理。dsh-codex-connect 的社区 alpha 分支，npm 走 alpha 通道；它注册同一个 openai-codex provider，不能与上游插件同装；图像、额度与代理功能默认关闭，需在设置里开启。

description.en: Local development service console for DSH: lists every listening service on the machine and lets users inspect, safely stop, or restart services that were started during development.
description.zh: DSH 本地开发服务控制台：列出本机所有监听服务，并让用户查看、以安全方式停止或重启开发过程中启动的服务。

description.en: Started from AssassinVIX/fairy-zzz-plugin. The eye badge artwork and motion geometry come from Chengzhibense/Fairy-DSH. This plugin builds on that base with further changes and development, and delivers major performance optimizations. It repaints the DSH Web UI, adds an always-on fee dock, and supports one-click self-update after npm installation. It retains the H.D.D boot animation and voiced greeting, the dockable eye badge and usage bubble, optional local GPT-SoVITS narration, and titles using the bundled Anton font, among other features.
description.zh: 起点是 AssassinVIX/fairy-zzz-plugin。眼徽的美术与动效几何来自 Chengzhibense/Fairy-DSH。本插件在此基础上进行改动和开发。对性能方面做出了极大的优化。重绘DSH Web 界面，新增常驻电费坞，npm 安装后可一键自更新，保留 H.D.D 开机动画与语音问候、可停靠眼徽与用量气泡、可选本地 GPT-SoVITS 朗读，标题使用随包内置的 Anton 字体等等

description.en: LLM auto-approval for sandbox escalation requests, with presets and a fail-closed fallback.
description.zh: 沙箱升权申请的 LLM 自动审批：内置预设，fail-closed 兜底。

description.en: Pixel-art whale desktop companion with 29 frame-audited states — taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, speaks a completion report when a turn ends, and adds a slash-command palette to the web client.
description.zh: 像素鲸鱼桌宠,29 个逐帧验收状态:等批准时贴屏敲玻璃并让标签页标题闪烁,任务完成开口汇报,并为 web 端提供斜杠命令面板。

description.en: VSCode/IDEA-style Git source control in the DSH right sidebar, with a colour-coded commit graph, branch switching, staging, hunk actions, stash and history filters.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏提供类 VSCode/IDEA 的 Git 源码管理，含彩色提交图、分支切换、暂存与逐块操作、stash 与历史过滤。

description.en: 🐱 Catppuccin theme plugin: the lively, relaxing official 26-color pastel palette — 🌻 Latte / 🪴 Frappé / 🌺 Macchiato / 🌿 Mocha — with one-click switching; the whole UI is tinted from the palette and hover interactions glow in the theme accent.
description.zh: 🐱 Catppuccin 主题插件：充满活力、令人放松的柔和彩色主题。遵循官方 26 色粉彩盘，🌻 Latte / 🪴 Frappé / 🌺 Macchiato / 🌿 Mocha 四档一键切换，全界面按色盘上色，鼠标滑过交互变主题色。

description.en: Notifies you with a browser notification and toast whenever a session turn ends, with 5-language templates and custom presets.
description.zh: 会话轮次结束时推送浏览器系统通知与页内提示，内置 5 种语言模板与自定义预设。

description.en: Adds a reforge control to the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a sharper prompt in place, as one undoable edit, with one-click revert and cancellation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框工具栏加一个「重铸」按钮，把当前草稿就地改写成更精准的提示词——整段替换只占一步撤销，可一键恢复原文，也可中途取消。

description.en: Shows oversized images to the model at readable resolution instead of one downscaled copy: before admission, a large upload is split into as many tiles as the attachment store allows (an 8000x8000 screenshot becomes 20 tiles of 2000x1600), so small text survives. Replaces the local attachment store; adds no settings of its own.
description.zh: 让超大图片以可读分辨率进入模型视野，而不是被压成一张缩图：准入前按附件存储允许的上限把大图切成多张切片（8000x8000 的截图会变成 20 张 2000x1600），小字得以保留。以替换本地附件存储的方式实现，不新增任何配置项。

description.en: ZenTao work panel in the DSH left sidebar: lists tasks, bugs and stories assigned to you (web-login protocol, so instances where the RESTful v2 API is unavailable are supported — verified on ZenTao 18.13 open-source) with search, smart sort, overdue / due-today filters and a flow-board view (cards and details also show the owning project, execution, product and module, effort estimated / consumed / left, and the parent requirement or source bug); opens a new chat pre-filled with the card's description, recent comments and screenshots (or a blank one), or dispatches it to a new background session with workspace, model, reasoning-effort and optional-instruction selection (single or multi-select batch), turns screenshots inside ticket descriptions into real image attachments, reads back the linked session's latest reply once a card is done and lets you answer the agent from the panel while it waits on you, and tracks each card with live running / needs-decision / done status plus manual overrides and a manually-marked finished state, with a deep link to ZenTao's finish / resolve page, and caches list and detail data locally so reopening the panel or a card paints instantly with a silent refresh. Multi-account; read-only, no writes back to ZenTao.
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏禅道工作面板：列出指派给你的任务、Bug 与需求（走网页登录协议，RESTful v2 API 不可用的实例也能用，已在禅道 18.13 开源版实测），支持搜索、智能排序、逾期/今天到期筛选与流程看板（卡片与详情还显示所属项目、执行、产品、模块、工时口径「预计/已耗/剩余」与所属需求/来源 Bug）；可新建对话并自动带入任务背景（描述、最近动态与截图，也可只建空白会话），或下发到新后台会话（可选工作区、模型、思考强度与附加指令，支持多选批量），工单里的截图会转成真实图片附件，已完成的卡片可回读关联会话的最新回复，等你决策时能在面板里直接答复 agent，卡片实时显示 处理中/等你决策/已完成 状态并支持手动修正与「已结束」终态，完成后可跳转禅道的完成/解决页收尾；列表与详情缓存在本机，重开面板或复看同一张卡即时出内容并静默刷新。支持多账号；只读，不回写禅道。

description.en: Omni-modal workstation for DSH: analyze_image over an ordered multi-card VLM failover chain, a six-tool vision toolkit (zoom, colour sampling, pixel diff, OCR, element detection, inline display) sharing the same image resolver, generate_image over OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI protocols, multi-card async generate_video with a /build-video-tool builder, and speak/clone_voice TTS over seven providers, all driven by one auto-saving settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的全模态工作站：analyze_image 走有序多卡片 VLM 故障转移链；六个视觉工具箱工具（局部放大、色调采样、像素比对、OCR、元素检测、内联展示）共用同一套图片来源解析；generate_image 支持 OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI 协议；多卡片异步 generate_video 配 /build-video-tool 构建器；speak/clone_voice 语音合成覆盖七家供应商；全部由一个自动保存的设置页驱动。

description.en: Import the copied connection information from the new API site with a single click.
description.zh: 一键从new api站点导入复制的连接信息。

description.en: Ports poteto's pstack engineering playbooks to DSH, covering planning, review, verification and release workflows.
description.zh: 将 poteto 的 pstack 工程工作流移植到 DSH，涵盖规划、审查、验证与发布。

description.en: LLVM static-analysis plugin that builds whole-program bitcode for C/C++ projects and runs kernel-analyzer (KAMain) reachability analysis on it, providing kanalyzer_* tools to the agent and a ctx.kanalyzer service to other plugins.
description.zh: LLVM 静态分析插件，可为 C/C++ 项目构建整程序 LLVM bitcode，并在其上运行 kernel-analyzer（KAMain）可达性分析，向智能体提供 kanalyzer_* 工具，并向其他插件提供 ctx.kanalyzer 服务。

description.en: Obsidian-style notes panel in the DSH right sidebar: a tree over a local folder, Markdown preview with line numbers, edit and save, Obsidian callouts, tables and wikilinks, screenshot paste into the vault, one-click insert of a note path into the chat input, and batch archive or delete for sessions and workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 Obsidian 风格笔记面板：本地文件夹目录树、带行号的 Markdown 预览与编辑保存、Obsidian callout 与表格和双链渲染、粘贴截图存入 vault、一键把笔记路径插入对话输入框，以及会话/工作区的批量归档与删除。

description.en: Monitor the account balance for 3rd-party services those AI agents often use, such as Tavily, SerpAPI, Firecrawl, Bocha, Tinyfish, etc. Optionally you can select to inject the account balance into the system prompt, so the agent can use the services accordingly.
description.zh: 监控 AI Agents 常用的第三方服务余额，如 Tavily、SerpAPI、Firecrawl、博查、Tinyfish 等。可选支持将服务的余额注入 System Prompt，以便 Agent 合理使用相关服务。

description.en: VSCode-style workbench shell for the DSH Web UI: activity bar, side bar, editor area, panel and status bar, with a registry service (ctx.workbench) for mounting panels, views and commands.
description.zh: DSH Web 工作台基座插件：提供 VSCode 风格布局外壳（活动栏/侧边栏/编辑器区/面板/状态栏）和 ctx.workbench 开放注册表，供功能插件挂载面板、视图与命令。

description.en: Sidebar panel for the announcement file and the ticket status table. It lists the announcements together with how many sessions have seen each one, shows the delivery status, and lets the user post, edit and delete entries. Requires the third-party dsh-better-sidebar plugin.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板：把公告和投递状态表放进 DSH 界面 —— 列出公告以及每条有几个会话见过，并让用户发布、编辑、删除条目。需要第三方插件 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a DSH Desktop main panel through an Electron webview guest, with a back/forward/reload toolbar and a local snapshot of login-related localStorage restored on the next open.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版主面板里通过 Electron webview 嵌入 DeepSeek 网页版聊天（chat.deepseek.com），带后退/前进/刷新工具栏，并把登录相关的 localStorage 快照存在本地、下次打开时回填。

description.en: Mobile pairing remote for DeepSeek Harness: E2EE companion over dual-plane allowlisted RPC (LAN, Tailscale, optional Cloudflare Quick Tunnel or self-hosted rendezvous).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动配对远程插件：双平面白名单 RPC 上的端到端加密 Companion（局域网、Tailscale，可选 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 或自建 rendezvous）。

description.en: Model-facing display_file tool that renders 36 file extensions inline in the web UI: images with a click-to-zoom lightbox, seekable video, audio, PDF, Office and OpenDocument files converted to PDF on the host via LibreOffice, and local HTML in a sandboxed frame; bytes stream from a signed HTTP route with range support, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF also enter model context on image-capable routes.
description.zh: 面向模型的 display_file 工具，在网页 UI 内联渲染 36 种扩展名：图片（点击开灯箱）、可拖进度条的视频、音频、PDF、经 LibreOffice 在 Host 转为 PDF 的 Office 与 OpenDocument 文件，以及沙箱 iframe 中的本地 HTML；字节由带 Range 支持的签名 HTTP 路由流式传输，PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 在支持图像输入的路由上同时进入模型上下文。

description.en: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) MCP services in DeepSeek Harness: dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
description.zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查 MCP 服务：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖全部企查查数据服务。

description.en: MCP server management panel in Settings: add, edit, enable/disable and delete servers across user and workspace scopes with form or JSON editing, and auto-register discovered MCP tools as native conversation tools.
description.zh: 在设置中提供 MCP Servers 管理面板：新增、编辑、启停、删除服务器，支持用户/项目作用域与表单/JSON 双模式编辑，并自动把发现的 MCP 工具注册为对话原生工具。

description.en: SCNet models for DSH. Free SCNet-Max, no client login needed; tokenizer, template and deterministic-output fingerprints match DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (README). It reads the SCNet desktop client's stored login when one exists, and otherwise logs in with a phone SMS code from the settings page.
description.zh: 把 SCNet 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。可免客户端登录，使用免费模型（SCNet-Max，基座为 DeepSeek Flash 系列 —— 经分词器、对话模板与确定性输出的模型指纹比对，与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 一致，证据见 README 的「基座认定」）。它会读取 SCNet 桌面客户端落盘的登录态；没有客户端时在设置页用手机短信验证码登录。

description.en: Reports which skills each turn invoked (loaded by the model, typed as /name, or none) and manages the local skill directory: install from a pasted repository, folder, SKILL.md or zip address, set a Chinese display name in the skill meta.yaml, and remove a skill while keeping a backup.
description.zh: 每轮对话报告本轮调用了哪些 skill（模型自动加载、用户输入 /name，或一个都没用），并管理本机 skill 目录：粘贴仓库、文件夹、SKILL.md 或 zip 地址即可安装，中文显示名写入该 skill 的 meta.yaml，删除时保留备份。

description.en: Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供持续语音对话，支持免提监听、按住说话、语音识别、TTS 语音回复和后台 Agent 任务委派。

description.en: Global and project text memory with original-message citations, revision history and managed source withdrawal. Public beta.
description.zh: 保留原话引用、修改历史并支持受管来源撤回的全局与项目文字记忆。公开测试版。

description.en: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure (LAN HTTP) contexts.
description.zh: 局域网访问：Web GUI 绑定 0.0.0.0 + crypto.randomUUID polyfill（修复非安全上下文下 RPC 崩溃）。

description.en: AOCI cognition panel for DSH: multi-workspace AOCI overview, per-repo index and governance view, MCP binding diagnosis, and guided or batch initialization. Governance, verification and guided/batch initialization require the external aoci CLI on the host; index browsing works without it.
description.zh: DSH 的 AOCI 认知面板：多工作区总览、单仓库索引与治理视图、MCP 绑定诊断，以及引导式/批量初始化。治理、校验与引导式/批量初始化需宿主机装有 aoci CLI；仅浏览索引不需要。

description.en: General-purpose chat agent on a parent agent + worker sub-agent split, for DSH Desktop only: a sidebar row opens each assistant's long-running conversation, where the parent chats, records schedule, lists, memos, logs, profile, persona and projects as plain files in that assistant's workspace folder, and hands other work to background workers through the bundled complete-subagent, picking each worker's model from the ones you enable and approving their write access. A heartbeat wakes it for reminders, a daily brief and wake-ups it sets itself, and holds back during quiet hours. Through the bundled im-robot it chats over WeChat: the model decides per reply with im_route whether the reply also goes to WeChat, and images and files sent from WeChat appear in the conversation and stay in the workspace's IM/WeChat folder for a set number of days. Its tools never appear in normal sessions.
description.zh: 基于母 agent + worker 子代理架构的通用对话 agent，仅支持 DSH Desktop：侧栏入口直达每个助理的长期对话，母 agent 负责聊天，把日程、清单、备忘、流水、画像、人设和项目以纯文本文件记在该助理的工作区文件夹里，其余工作通过内置的 complete-subagent 交给后台 worker，从你勾选的模型里为每个 worker 选模型，并审批它们的写权限。心跳按时叫醒它处理提醒、每日早报和它自己设的唤醒，勿扰时段内不打扰。通过内置的 im-robot 接入微信：每条回复由模型用 im_route 决定是否同时发到微信，微信发来的图片和文件显示在对话里，并在工作区的 IM/WeChat 文件夹里保留可设置的天数。它的工具不会出现在普通会话里。

description.en: Mirror an iOS Simulator or Android emulator into DSH as floating overlay windows, several at once, and tap, drag or type on the mirrored screen with the input forwarded back to the device.
description.zh: 把 iOS 模拟器或安卓模拟机投进 DSH 的浮窗，可同时开多个，并在投屏画面上点、拖、打字，输入回传到设备。

description.en: Reads a running workbuddy2api-panel over its HTTP API and syncs its models into the DSH model picker with credit multipliers, CN/international realm labels and per-model reasoning-effort levels; also shows remaining credits and usage in a settings page and a sidebar badge.
description.zh: 读取运行中的 workbuddy2api-panel 的 HTTP 接口，把面板模型连同倍率、国内/国际分区与逐模型思考档位同步进 DSH 的模型选择器，并在设置页与侧边栏徽标中显示剩余额度与用量。

description.en: Mounts the tsm-core-dlr semantic service (LanceDB vectors + graph) as MCP tools and ships the scenario-independent DLR/TSM modeling skill, a service-status overlay and the agent rules; the service is a hard dependency and must be running before the bundle activates.
description.zh: 把 tsm-core-dlr 语义服务（LanceDB 向量 + 图）挂为 MCP 工具，并携带与场景无关的 DLR/TSM 建模技能、服务状态浮层与 agent 规则；该服务是硬依赖，须先运行、bundle 才能激活。

description.en: Desk-to-desk tickets between sessions on one machine. A session says which desk it belongs to by putting a number prefix in its title; a ticket names one desk and is taken by the first session of that desk to start working, so the desk is the address and a ticket is not delivered to a session that is just passing by.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上会话之间的「单子」：会话用标题里的编号前缀表明自己属于哪张桌；单子投给某张桌，由那张桌最先开始干活的那个会话取走 —— 桌是地址，路过的会话不会收到它。

description.en: Agent2Agent protocol v1.0 for DSH: run a standard A2A server to let other agents call this instance, connect to remote A2A agents as clients, and manage both from a visual settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 实现 Agent2Agent 协议 v1.0：以标准 A2A server 接收其他 Agent 的调用，以 A2A client 连接远程 Agent，并在可视化设置页统一管理连接。

description.en: Optimize prompts in the DeepSeek Harness composer: identify missing requirements, insert a sentence from 90 method cards, or compare and edit a full rewrite before you send.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里优化提示词：发现草稿中没说清的要求，从 90 张方法卡中选一句补进去，或对照原稿编辑整段改写。由你决定采用和发送。

description.en: Claude-style projects and threads: a project's main conversation opens threads (real sessions you can open and talk to) for self-contained tasks, runs up to 3 at once by default, optionally each in its own git worktree, and gets each thread's report back.
description.zh: Claude 式的项目与讨论串：项目主对话为能独立完成的任务开讨论串（可以点开直接对话的真实会话），默认最多 3 个同时运行，可各自在独立的 git worktree 里工作，做完把回报发回主对话。

description.en: Adds a pin button to the DSH Desktop title bar that toggles always-on-top for the main window. Windows 10/11 only.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 标题栏加一枚图钉，一键切换主窗口置顶。仅 Windows 10/11。

description.en: Deliverables registry for DeepSeek Harness: agents register the final artifacts of a task (reports, pages, documents, sheets, images, datasets) into one settings section and manager page that store paths only, never copies, and remove recoverably; a standalone CLI (add, list, stats, check, remove, restore) reads and audits the same registry outside the app.
description.zh: DSH 成果登记：agent 把一次任务的最终成果（报告、网页、文档、表格、图片、数据表）登记进设置页与管理页的同一份清单，只记路径、不搬文件，删除可撤销；独立 CLI（add/list/stats/check/remove/restore）在应用外也能查同一份清单，并核对登记的文件是否还在。

description.en: Theme pack for the DSH Web UI: 30 drop-in CSS themes with light and dark variants, integrated into Settings → General with a programmatic API.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 主题包：30 款即插即用的 CSS 主题，每款含浅色与深色变体，集成于「设置 → 通用」，并提供程序化 API。

description.en: Run your RunningHub ComfyUI workflows from DSH to generate images, video and audio, with a workflow setup panel, background tasks and multi-key management.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中调用你的 RunningHub ComfyUI 工作流生成图片、视频和音频，提供工作流配置面板、后台任务和多 Key 管理。

description.en: Open plugin marketplace: live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search with per-repo package.json verification (dsh.bundle/dsh.client manifest badges and a verified-only filter), npm-first installs with same-source anti-squatting checks, update detection, and five agent tools for headless use.
description.zh: 开放式插件市场：GitHub dsh-plugin 话题实时搜索，逐仓库 package.json 验证（dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明徽章与只看已验证过滤），npm 优先安装带同源防抢注校验，更新检测，并附五个可在无界面环境使用的 agent 工具。

description.en: DSH Web Usage Center with local SQLite history, HUD and dashboard, Hub account/quota snapshots, custom pricing and fee ledger, and CSV/JSON export, plus coding-plan OAuth and an optional loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量中心：本地 SQLite 历史、HUD 与仪表盘、Hub 账户与额度快照、自定义定价与订阅费用账本、CSV/JSON 导出，并含 coding 计划 OAuth 与可选回环 OpenAI/Anthropic 网关。

description.en: Community fork of l246804/dsh-pstack (cannot be installed alongside it: same plugin ids and tool names) that ports the pstack workflow system to dsh: 58 skills, five presets, a bundled script runner that works without node on PATH, a doctor for script prerequisites, and a translation layer for the remaining Cursor vocabulary.
description.zh: l246804/dsh-pstack 的社区 fork（与上游不能同装：插件 id 与工具名相同），把 pstack 工作流体系移植到 dsh 并补齐可用性：58 个技能、5 个 preset、不依赖 PATH 里 node 的脚本运行器、脚本前置检查，以及 Cursor 词汇的翻译层。

description.en: Runs local security audits of AI API relays and LLM proxies from DeepSeek Harness, producing Markdown reports for prompt injection, model substitution signals, tool-call rewriting, error leakage, stream integrity, and profile-gated Web3 risks.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 对 AI API 中转站和 LLM 代理运行本地安全审计，生成 Markdown 报告，覆盖提示词注入、模型替换信号、工具调用改写、错误泄漏、流完整性和按 profile 启用的 Web3 风险。

description.en: One-click standalone two-column code review page for Git diffs in the conversation: line numbers, add/delete coloring, character-level highlight, hunk-aware per-file sections, a file nav sidebar and a stats bar; line comments submit back to the DSH composer, and the UI follows the DSH locale.
description.zh: 把对话里的 git diff 一键打开为独立标签页的双列代码评审页：行号、增删配色、字符级高亮、hunk 感知的多文件分段、文件导航侧栏与统计条，行内评论可提交回 DSH 对话框，界面跟随 DSH 语言（中英）。

description.en: Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.
description.zh: 提供 Grok-compatible 网页搜索、保留来源分页、Context7 与 Exa 文档检索、有界网页提取、站点映射、离线研究计划和只读诊断。

description.en: A skills button at the bottom-right of the input box: one click opens every installed skill with search, categories and favourites, and the skill you pick is inserted into the box. Each answer also lists the skills that turn actually used.
description.zh: 输入框右下方有一个「技能」按钮，点开就能搜技能、按分类浏览、收藏常用的，选中后直接插进输入框；回答下方还会列出这一轮真正调用过的技能。

description.en: Local-first usage and cost meter for the DSH web UI: composer button with live session cost and balance; panel with a stacked per-model daily/7-day chart priced per effective list-price interval (official pricing page synced daily), monthly usage tiers with a canvas share card, 30/50/85% context-pressure warnings with one-click /compact, budget alerts, and an in-panel npm update check with one-click update.
description.zh: 本地优先的用量与费用仪表：输入框下方按钮显示实时费用与余额，面板含按模型堆叠的当日/近 7 天柱状图（按刊例价生效区间计价、官方定价页每日同步）、本月消耗段位与画布分享卡片、30/50/85% 上下文压力三档预警与一键 /compact、预算提醒，以及面板内 npm 检查更新与一键更新。

description.en: Manage DSH skills and commands from Settings: list, enable/disable, edit, delete and add skills across global and project scopes, and save reusable prompts as slash commands.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理技能与命令：跨全局与项目作用域查看、启用/停用、编辑、删除与添加技能，并把常用提示词保存为斜杠命令。

description.en: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one you register) as head words in the virtual terminal.
description.zh: 把文件系统与 bash 提供者换成 mirage 虚拟工作区：文件工具与 shell 命令作用于挂载的资源（RAM、S3、Redis、Slack、Gmail、Notion、Postgres）而非宿主磁盘，支持按挂载点设置读/写/执行模式、按命令选择沙箱（进程内 monty、pyodide、quickjs；远程 docker、e2b、daytona），并可在虚拟终端中安装 CLI（git、gh、slack、linear、ntn、gws，或自行注册的程序树）作为命令头词。

description.en: Plugin index inside DSH that lists over 10,000 third-party plugins checked against the dsh.bundle manifest in their package.json rather than by star count, with one-click install and a companion website.
description.zh: DSH 内的插件索引，收录 1 万余个按 package.json 里的 dsh.bundle 声明校验过的第三方插件（不按星数判定），支持一键安装，另有配套网站。

description.en: Sidebar footer badge that shows whether DeepSeek is inside a peak-pricing window right now: a state dot, the current multiplier (x2 during peak, 5 zhe / half price off-peak), a countdown to the next switch, and a 24-hour schedule bar whose white line marks the current time. Peak windows are 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time; weekends and Chinese public holidays count as off-peak. The holiday table currently covers 2026 only. Client-only, no network requests.
description.zh: 侧栏底部角标，标注当前是否处于 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段：状态圆点、当前倍率（高峰 ×2、空闲 5 折）、距下次切换的倒计时，以及一条用白色竖线标出当前时刻的 24 小时日程条。高峰为北京时间 9:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00，周末与中国法定节假日按空闲计费。节假日表目前只覆盖 2026 年。纯客户端插件，不发任何网络请求。

description.en: Rewrites every prompt into a Mechanicus prayer before the model sees it, then lets you pick prayer or original to send.
description.zh: 发送前把提示词改写成机械神教祷文，再让你选择发送祷文还是原文。

description.en: Prompt scene picker for DSH: choose a scene from a dropdown and it opens a new session with the prompt already filled in (with {variable} placeholders), so you only tweak and send.
description.zh: 提示词场景选择器：下拉选场景即自动开新会话并填充提示词（支持 {变量}），微调即可发送。

description.en: Plugin inventory manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: table view of installed plugins with status filters, enable/disable switches applied via HMR, config viewer/copy, uninstall and npm update reminders.
description.zh: DSH 插件总览（逃咪）：以表格视图管理已安装插件，支持状态过滤、HMR 热生效的启停开关、配置查看/复制、卸载与 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Turns session context into a deep-sea moyu (slack-off) game in a floating window — your hand sinks as context grows, touch a fish and server-rolled dice decide the mint of a holographic collectible card across five oceans, with a fish pond and a GitHub-linked leaderboard.
description.zh: 把会话 context 变成浮窗深海摸鱼：context 越长手沉得越深，摸到鱼后服务端掷骰定胜负，中卡铸造镭射收藏卡，五大洋摸鱼、鱼池养成、GitHub 绑定全球排行榜。

description.en: A session manager for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: per-workspace category trees with drag-and-drop ordering, pinned sessions hoisted above the categories (or kept inside them, switchable from the view options), an archive partition, and a delete bin where removed sessions keep their logs and can be restored or purged in batches. The host half owns the category and recycle data, the web half renders it; both ship as one plugin. Maintained fork of ht719/dsh-session-categories ported to current DSH, with pinning, archive partition and delete bin added; it cannot be installed together with the original.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的会话管理插件：按工作区划分的分类树，支持拖拽排序；置顶会话可抬到分类上方，也可按开关留在所属分类内；另有归档分区，以及删除回收站——删掉的会话日志留存，可恢复或批量彻底清除。宿主半边掌管分类与回收站数据，网页半边负责渲染，两者作为一个插件一起发布。本插件是 ht719/dsh-session-categories 的维护分叉，已移植到当前 DSH 并新增置顶、归档分区与删除回收站；不能与原版同时安装。

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless Chromium over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 headless Chromium（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。

description.en: Connect the DSHM iPhone/iPad companion to DeepSeek Harness over your local network or Tailscale, with device pairing, session control and file transfers; public TestFlight access to the companion app is pending Apple review.
description.zh: 通过本地网络或 Tailscale，将 DSHM iPhone/iPad 配套应用连接到 DeepSeek Harness，支持设备配对、会话控制和文件传输；配套应用的公开 TestFlight 仍在等待 Apple 审核。

description.en: Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.
description.zh: Tavily 网页搜索：设置页开关，关闭时回落到 DeepSeek 内置搜索；免密钥可用搜索与内容提取，配置 API Key 后解锁爬取与站点地图等 MCP 工具。

description.en: Repair order settlement check: item amounts, labour/parts totals and grand total.
description.zh: 维修工单项目金额、工时配件与结算总额核对。

description.en: File explorer for the dock workbench: tree browsing of the session workspace with create/rename/copy-paste/delete, drag-and-drop import and paste of local files and clipboard images.
description.zh: dock 系列文件浏览插件：侧边栏目录树浏览会话工作区，支持新建/重命名/复制粘贴/删除、拖放导入、粘贴本地文件与剪贴板图片。

description.en: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) legal-data MCP services — regulation search and case search — with dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
description.zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查法律产品——法律数据 MCP 服务（法规检索、案例检索）：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖法规与案例服务。

description.en: Attaches a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider requests, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors and keeping session affinity and prompt-cache routing intact.
description.zh: 为 OpenCode / OpenCode Go 提供商请求自动附加每个会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 请求头，修复 400 MissingSessionID 错误，同时保持会话亲和与提示缓存路由。

description.en: Standalone QQ-bot extension pack for DeepSeek Harness — fully independent, no other plugin required. Two-layer SQLite memory with hippocampal recall, a persona that keeps learning from daily chats, group tiers, local-model quick replies with a single-brain arbiter, TTS outbox, sticker library, an approval-gated video studio, and a four-form desktop pet (three custom characters plus the stock fish) playable over a public invite link with access-code login, single seat and brute-force protection. Chat bridging is deny-by-default: c2c/group access defaults to a care mode that only responds to the special-cared people and groups of the owner (shared with the persona system, zero extra config); allowlist, open and disabled modes remain available. First-run defaults (persistent inbound dedupe, configurable outbound-hook budget, optional default permission preset, extension seeding) are written only where nothing was configured and never overwrite user changes. Interview and quiz practice run inside chat with local scoring and configurable transcript retention. Requires QQBOT_APPID and QQBOT_SECRET, and Node.js 22.5 or newer.
description.zh: 独立的 QQ 机器人扩展包（DeepSeek Harness 桌面端插件，无需安装其他本体）。提供两层 SQLite 记忆（类海马体召回）、会从日常聊天里成长的人格、群分级、本地小模型代答与单脑仲裁、TTS 发件箱、表情包库、主人审核制的视频流水线，以及四形态桌宠（三套自绘形象 + 原生大肥鱼）——可通过带访问码、单席位、防爆破的公网邀请链接远程陪玩，网页端能切形态、发动作、拎起逗她。聊天桥接默认拒绝：私聊/群聊默认 care 模式——只回应主人的「特别关心」名单（与人格体系同源，零额外配置），陌生人无法触发 AI。首次运行只往没配过的位置补默认值（落盘去重、出站扩展预算、可选默认权限档、扩展自动播种），已改过的配置一律不覆盖；聊天里可直接用 /面试 与 /答题 练习，评分全在本地，会话与录音保留策略可配。需设置 QQBOT_APPID 与 QQBOT_SECRET，并要求 Node.js 22.5 或更新版本。

description.en: Send DSH event notifications to Gotify, a generic webhook, or ntfy when a task finishes, is interrupted, needs approval, or needs an answer. The message carries only the session title, workspace name and event reason, never the conversation body, and a failed send is logged without interrupting the session.
description.zh: 在任务完成、任务中断、需要审批、需要回答问题时，把 DSH 事件通知发到 Gotify、通用 Webhook 或 ntfy：通知只包含会话标题、工作区名称与事件原因，不包含会话正文；发送失败只写日志，不会打断会话。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek account balance badge in the sidebar footer with odometer roll animation, multi-currency support, balance trend chart, per-key usage statistics with historical backfill, and GitHub version auto-check.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额徽章：数字滚轮动画、多币种支持、余额趋势图、按 Key 用量统计（含安装前历史回填），并支持 GitHub 版本自动检查。

description.en: DSH web-GUI pet runtime that renders any Codex spritesheet-atlas pet (v1/v2) as a draggable overlay: drag/wave/jump, v2 mouse-tracking eyes that follow the active mouse, live agent-status poses, progress bubbles, and an in-GUI atlas importer; ships one original CC BY-NC demo pet (nastya), and user pets live in ~/.dsh/pets.
description.zh: DSH 网页 GUI 实时桌宠：可把任何 Codex 桌宠图集（webp/png/gif，v1/v2 自动识别）转换为 DSH 中可拖拽的悬浮桌宠。支持拖拽/挥手/跳跃，v2 桌宠的眼睛实时追踪活动鼠标，随 agent 状态切换姿势；进度气泡反映工作状态；「设置 → 桌宠」图形界面可导入、切换与调整桌宠；内置一只原创示例桌宠（娜斯佳），用户桌宠存放在 ~/.dsh/pets。

description.en: A multi-tab AI chat panel for the desktop app: seven services (DeepSeek, 豆包, ChatGPT, MiniMax, Kimi, Gemini, Grok) each run in their own webview and login partition, and the chat can live in the left navigation panel or in a right sidebar tab — whichever one you open owns it. Desktop app only; logins last until the app restarts unless you apply the optional shell patch (tools/shell-patch) to the desktop app's resources/app.asar, which the panel can check and whose exact command it prints.
description.zh: 桌面版的多标签 AI 聊天面板：七个服务（DeepSeek、豆包、ChatGPT、MiniMax、Kimi、Gemini、Grok）各自在独立 webview 与独立登录分区中运行，聊天页可放在左栏主面板或右栏标签里——哪边点开就由哪边承载。仅限桌面版；登录态只在本次运行内有效，要跨重启保持需给桌面版的 resources/app.asar 打可选补丁（tools/shell-patch），面板可以自检补丁状态并给出确切命令。

description.en: This project aims to bridge the Blender MCP Add-on, so that models on DSH can conveniently connect to the current user's working Blender to assist creation, while meeting basic security requirements.
description.zh: 此项目旨在桥接 Blender MCP Add-on，使 DSH 上的模型可便捷对接接入当前用户工作的 Blender 以辅助创作，且满足基础安全需要。

description.en: Delivery workflow preset for DeepSeek Harness: an agent protocol plus seven tools that keep user requests verbatim, record feedback decisions, plan tasks with acceptance criteria, log real verification commands and exit codes, and write completion summaries as per-project JSONL files.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的研发交付工作流 preset：一段工作协议加七个工具，保留用户原话与验收条件、记录反馈决策、拆解带验收的任务、记录真实验证命令与退出码，并以项目隔离的 JSONL 记录完成总结。

description.en: Model-autonomous context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: a mind_map tool surveys the agent context surface (stable seq ids, roles, token weights, clear-boundary markers, the clear-mind playbook), a clear_mind tool replaces a chosen conversation-history span with a model-written checkpoint through the native compaction transaction, call and result pairs self-collapse into one-line tombstones, and a proactive reminder nudges the model when the context grows long or a turn runs too many steps.
description.zh: 让模型自主压缩自身上下文的 dsh 插件：mind_map 工具俯瞰模型自己的上下文表面（稳定 seq、角色、token 重量、清理边界标记，返回内附清理手册），clear_mind 工具把选定的对话历史区间替换成模型自写的检查点（走平台原生 compaction 事务，GUI 渲染可展开的压缩行），调用对自动折叠成单行墓碑，上下文过长或单轮步数过多时主动提醒模型清理；人类侧会话记录保持原样、可审计可回退。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes QBoson Kaiwu Ising solving as an agent-callable solve_ising tool.
description.zh: 将 QBoson Kaiwu 的 Ising 矩阵求解能力作为 solve_ising Agent Tool 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Context lens: visualizes token usage of every request (context composition, KV cache hit rate) and enforces per-turn / per-session budgets with warning and blocking (npm: `dsh-my-context`).
description.zh: 上下文透镜：可视化每次请求的 token 用量（上下文构成、KV 缓存命中率），并提供每轮 / 每会话预算控制（超限提醒与拦截）（npm: `dsh-my-context`）。

description.en: Enhanced model selector for the DSH composer with searchable provider groups, keyboard and accessibility support, and an inline reasoning-effort slider.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 输入区的模型选择器：可搜索供应商分组、键盘与无障碍支持，以及内联推理强度滑杆。

description.en: Cone crusher selection and crushing-plant design for MACKORN NH/NS single-cylinder hydraulic cone crushers: requirement-form intake, equipment selection, plant configuration, proposal generation, product-size simulation and field-data calibration. 21 tools, 6 skills, an MCP server, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: MACKORN NH/NS 单缸液压圆锥破碎机的选型与破碎筛分生产线设计：需求表录入、设备选型、整线配置、方案书生成、产品粒度仿真与实测标定。21 个工具、6 个技能、一个 MCP 服务器，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Adds a full-screen dialog for writing long messages: Markdown on the left rendered live by marked on the right, with a draggable splitter that remembers its ratio. Confirming writes the text back to the composer draft, keeping command tokens and @-reference chips as a fixed prefix; Esc asks whether to discard or write back before closing.
description.zh: 为输入框加一个写长内容的全屏弹窗：左侧写 Markdown、右侧 marked 实时渲染，中间分栏可拖动并记住比例。确认后写回输入框草稿，指令 token 与 @ 引用 chip 作为固定前缀保留；Esc 关闭前询问「不写回」还是「写回」。

description.en: Keeps frequently used prompts in the DSH composer, with insert, replace, variables and a trash.
description.zh: 把常用提示词存进 DSH 输入框工具行：可插入、可整框替换，带变量与回收站。

description.en: Read PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and text documents as agent tools, and OCR scanned PDFs or images locally with tesseract.js. Exposes doc_read, pdf_read, xlsx_read, doc_meta and doc_ocr.
description.zh: 把 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 和文本文件读取为智能体工具，并用 tesseract.js 在本地对扫描版 PDF 或图片做 OCR。提供 doc_read、pdf_read、xlsx_read、doc_meta、doc_ocr 五个工具。

description.en: Token usage dashboard in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: daily totals from session logs with a 12-month heatmap, per-provider breakdown over today/7d/30d/all (hourly for today) including each route's average output speed, and a per-session ranking that includes archived and deleted sessions and folds subagent usage into its parent.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的 Token 用量看板：从本机会话日志统计每日消耗并给出近 12 个月热力图；按供应商渠道查看今天/近 7 天/近 30 天/全部的用量（今天按小时展开）及各渠道平均输出速度；按会话排行，包含已归档与已删除会话，子代理消耗并入父会话。

description.en: Matrix digital rain: drapes the chat window in the classic green character rain — cascading columns with incandescent white heads and green tails, streaming the tokens the agent is generating into the rain in real time; opacity, speed, density, font size and colors are all adjustable, and rain intensity follows agent activity.
description.zh: 黑客帝国数字雨：对话窗口铺上经典的绿色字符雨背景——雨柱倾泻而下、白炽雨头绿身拖尾，agent 正在生成的 token 原文实时掺进雨里；透明度/速度/密度/字号/配色全部可调，雨势跟随 agent 活跃度起伏。

description.en: Observability and git tooling: a persistent cross-session event audit log with a query API, a resource watchdog sidebar panel, structured Conventional Commits and pre-commit incremental diff review (npm: `dsh-my-observability`).
description.zh: 可观测性与 Git 工程工具：跨会话持久化的事件审计日志与查询 API、资源看门狗侧边栏面板、结构化 Conventional Commits 提交、提交前增量 diff 审查（npm: `dsh-my-observability`）。

description.en: IDE-style run configurations for DSH: save LLM prompts and shell commands as reusable run configs (global or per-workspace), run them from the session header or the new-session page, and manage them via the task_run_config tool with approval-gated writes.
description.zh: DSH 的 IDE 风格运行配置：把常用 LLM 提示词和 Shell 命令保存为可复用的运行配置（全局或按工作区），在会话头部或新会话页一键运行，大模型可通过 task_run_config 工具管理（写操作走审批）。

description.en: Ghost-text completion for the composer: FIM suggestions stream in inline after a typing pause (SSE, first token rendered immediately), Tab accepts one word at a time and Shift+Tab takes all, in-flight requests are truly cancelled on retyping or Esc. Plus two-layer typo checking: a browser-local dictionary scan (Chinese wrong phrases, English misspellings and proper-noun capitalization, user-defined per-browser entries) with a debounced LLM context pass, underlined in red in the text with per-item navigation and click-to-fix.
description.zh: 输入框 ghost 补全：停笔后 FIM 建议内联流式渐显（SSE，首 token 即上屏），Tab 逐词采纳、Shift+Tab 全量，重新输入或 Esc 会真正取消在途请求；错别字双层检查：浏览器本地词典扫描（中文错词、英文错拼与专名大小写、本浏览器自定义词条）叠加防抖 LLM 上下文校对，文中红波浪线标注、逐条导航、点击修正。

description.en: Native desktop notifications for DSH — approvals, questions, turn completion, session end and errors — with click-to-session, per-event toggles, quiet hours, a privacy switch that keeps message text off the banner, and a Web Audio tone per event type.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知：审批、提问、轮次完成、会话结束与出错时弹系统原生通知，点击直达对应会话；六类事件分别开关，支持免打扰时段与隐藏正文的隐私开关，并按事件类型合成提示音。

description.en: Runs /single-turn and /multi-turn answers in isolated sub-agents so results stay in the current chat and never enter the main model context.
description.zh: 用 /single-turn 与 /multi-turn 在独立子代理中作答，结果只留在当前对话，不进入主模型上下文。

description.en: Fills in a Chinese description for every installed DSH plugin that ships only an English one, at startup and again after each plugin change, and never rewrites a plugin name. Plugins that already export a locale folder show the new text on refresh; the rest are patched too — the in-memory layer shows Chinese immediately, and the on-disk locale pack it writes needs one restart.
description.zh: 给只提供英文简介的已安装 DSH 插件自动补上中文简介，启动时以及每次插件变动后各跑一次，插件名称一律不改。原本已导出语言包的插件刷新页面即生效，原本没有语言包导出的也会自动补上：内存注入层即时生效，写入磁盘的语言包需重启一次。

description.en: Unit conversion as a `convert` tool: 10 categories (length, area, volume, time, angle, speed, temperature, pressure, energy/heat, power) and 82 units with English and Chinese aliases, plus a locale-aware Unit Converter tab in the DSH web view with one module per category and a temperature-difference (Δ) switch.
description.zh: 单位换算：提供 convert 工具，覆盖长度/面积/体积/时间/角度/速度/温度/压力/热量/功率十大类共 82 个单位，支持中英文单位名与温差（Δ）换算，并在 DSH Web 会话视图中提供按类别分模块、跟随中英文界面语言的「单位换算」标签页。

description.en: Multi-platform message gateway and WeCom AI bot bridge with session context compression and smartsheet creation.
description.zh: 多平台消息网关与企微智能机器人桥接：会话自动压缩持久化与智能表格一键创建。

description.en: Work on any machine in your ssh config as if it were local: persistent connections, native file editing, search, exec and terminals, with nothing installed on the remote host.
description.zh: 像操作本地一样使用 ssh config 中的任意远程机器：持久连接、原生文件编辑、搜索、命令执行与终端，远端无需安装任何东西。

description.en: Reuses the Codex CLI ChatGPT login as an `openai-codex` LLM route and adds GPT Auth controls to DSH Web settings.
description.zh: 复用 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 登录态注册 `openai-codex` LLM 路由，并在 DSH Web 设置中提供 GPT Auth 控件。

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the model selector.
description.zh: Codex 风格推理等级滑块，内嵌于模型选择器，拖动切换推理档位。

description.en: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): realtime quotes and indices, full-market search, intraday and forward-adjusted candlestick K-line with F10 fundamentals, stock/ETF/convertible-bond/LOF boards, watchlist with position P/L and price alerts, 13-signal screener with 7 preset strategies, limit-up sentiment thermometer, dragon-tiger list, three-source 7x24 news, and AI stock analysis.
description.zh: 韭菜盒子：A股看盘助手——实时行情与大盘指数、全市场搜索、同花顺式 K 线详情弹窗（日/周/月/5分/30分，含 F10 财务摘要）、股票/ETF/可转债/LOF 榜单、带持仓盈亏与价格预警的自选股、13 项技术信号选股与 7 个预设策略交叉、涨停情绪温度计、龙虎榜、三源 7×24 聚合快讯、AI 个股分析。

description.en: A Cyrene-themed agent for DSH, with a customizable look (palette, wallpaper, particle effects, background music, typing sound) and a code security scan. It carries a worldbook, long-term memory and a speech-style correction layer (every reader gets their own Cyrene), plus retrieval over the script to back up its answers.
description.zh: 给 DSH 用的昔涟主题 agent，包括可自定义美化主题（配色、壁纸、粒子效果、背景音乐、打字音效）与代码安全扫描。拥有世界书、长期记忆与说话方式修正（一千个人心中有一千个昔涟），剧情检索增强回答。

description.en: Pressure-aware session handoff for DeepSeek Harness: writes a handoff doc before a long session degrades, then continues in a fresh session in the same workspace. Subagents are snapshotted, still-running ones are interrupted, and unfinished tasks are handed to fresh subagents; a session without subagents simply gets the normal handoff. The handoff request itself is editable from the panel. A status pip and its label shade from green to blue to amber to red as pressure rises.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话交接：长会话降智前自动写交接文档，并在同一工作目录开新会话继续；子智能体随交接迁移——仍在运行的先打断，未完成的任务写进续接提示交给新子智能体接手；没有子智能体时就是一次普通交接；「现在交接」的提示词可以在面板里直接改。输入框下方常驻压力提示，状态点与文字颜色随压力从绿 → 蓝 → 琥珀 → 红逐级变化。

description.en: Daily auto check-in for MiniMax Code, WPS Lingxi, Baidu DuMate, AStudio, Qoder, Trae, Doubao, Huawei CodeArts and Tencent WorkBuddy: reads each app's own local credentials so nothing has to be pasted, supports multiple accounts per service, and lets you add any other site yourself by importing a JSON definition the agent wrote for it. Streak tracking, per-service schedules, collapsible sidebar cards. The Doubao service can also read its login cookies from the local Chrome, Edge, Brave or Doubao app cookie store (Doubao hosts only), and a custom service sends requests to whatever http(s) URL its JSON names.
description.zh: 每天自动给 MiniMax Code、WPS 灵犀、百度 DuMate、AStudio、Qoder、Trae、豆包、华为 CodeArts、腾讯 WorkBuddy 签到领积分：凭据取自本机 App 自己的登录态，不用手抠，每个服务支持多账号，列表之外的站点也能自己加——让 agent 查好接口、导入一份 JSON 就多一张卡片。带连续天数记账、按服务设时间、可折叠的侧边栏卡片。豆包服务还可以从本机 Chrome、Edge、Brave 或豆包 App 的 Cookie 库读取登录 Cookie（只取豆包的域名）；自定义服务会向其 JSON 里写的任意 http(s) 地址发请求。

description.en: Blue-team defense mode for CTF and incident response: 37 defensive tools, MITRE ATT&CK coverage mapping, six worker roles, SQLite findings and tasks, an optional decoy server, deception/honeypot workflows, and a standalone console with full view.
description.zh: CTF 网络攻防蓝队防御模式：37 个防御工具、MITRE ATT&CK 覆盖映射、六个执行角色、SQLite 事实库与任务队列，可选诱饵程序、欺骗防御与蜜罐闭环，以及带全面浏览的独立控制台。

description.en: Runs your kanban backlog during DeepSeek off-peak hours while the machine is idle: per-card git worktrees, evidence-gated completion, merge-back, and budget and idle gates. Linux or WSL only (needs bash, python3, git, jq, flock); initialise a git repo once with `npx dsh-offhours init`.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 低谷时段、电脑空闲时自动跑看板待办：每卡独立 git worktree、证据门禁、合并回收、预算/空闲闸门。仅支持 Linux/WSL（需 bash、python3、git、jq、flock），首次需在 git 仓库执行 `npx dsh-offhours init`。

description.en: Operate n8n from DeepSeek Harness with a multi-instance registry, alias-addressed agent tools and a settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 n8n 工作流运维插件：多实例注册表、Agent 工具与设置页界面。

description.en: Counts the subagent sessions a conversation spawned and shows their token usage and CNY cost in the composer dock, grouped by parent turn.
description.zh: 在输入框工具条上统计本会话派出的子智能体 token 用量与人民币花费，按 turn 分组。

description.en: White kitten accountant on the window sill: shows the tokens and money for each answer and for the whole session, the money the prompt cache saved, the context size against the model window, the next peak/off-peak price change and the live DeepSeek balance; it purrs when stroked, reacts while the agent works and synthesizes all of its sounds.
description.zh: 窗台上的白猫记账助手：显示每条回答与会话的 token 和花费、提示缓存省下的钱、上下文占模型窗口的比例、下一次峰谷换价时间与实时 DeepSeek 余额；可摸头打呼噜，随 agent 工作状态做出反应，所有音效均为合成。

description.en: Local images and videos as the DSH desktop window background: timed rotation with 0.7s cross-fades, first-frame-ready before fading in, automatic light/dark ink for readability, adjustable blur and panel/sidebar opacity, video thumbnails, and a probe endpoint reporting load, layer and selector health. Reads only the local files you point it at.
description.zh: 把本机图片/视频（含 Dynamic Wallpaper.app 素材）用作 DSH 桌面客户端背景：定时轮换与 0.7 秒交叉淡化、等首帧就绪再淡入、按壁纸明暗自动切换深/浅字色、模糊与面板/侧栏透明度可调、视频缩略图，探针接口上报加载、图层与界面选择器的健康状态。只读取本机文件，不联网。

description.en: Model Health panel in Settings: lists every model configured in settings.yaml and batch-tests availability and latency for each.
description.zh: 设置页「模型健康」面板：列出 settings.yaml 配置的全部模型，一键批量测试可用性与延迟。

description.en: Replaces detected secrets (OpenAI, AWS, GitHub, PEM, Bearer) with deterministic, structurally valid honey tokens before they reach the model or the session file; adds manual marking for values the detectors miss, explicit user-visible restore, a cross-session canary alarm, and an opt-in JSONL log of substitution counts that never records the underlying values.
description.zh: 在密钥离开本机前，将其确定性地替换为结构合法的蜜罐假值（OpenAI、AWS、GitHub、PEM、Bearer 模式）；支持手动标记检测器认不出的值、用户可见的显式还原、蜜罐跨会话出现时的金丝雀告警，以及可选的 JSONL 替换计数日志（只记来源与类别计数，绝不记录真实值）。

description.en: Offline diagnostic for DSH: 19 checks across env, profile, and session state, with a settings "Doctor" panel and a read-only JSON API.
description.zh: 离线诊断工具：环境/Profile/会话共 19 项检查，带设置「诊断」面板与只读 JSON API。

description.en: Connects a ComfyUI server to the agent through five draw_* tools (status, workflows, models, generate, reverse) and a sidebar panel. It ships no workflows and assumes nothing about your models: every API-format JSON you drop into the workflow directory is inspected to find where prompt, negative, width, height, steps, cfg, seed and LoRA live, and a sidecar file can override what was detected. LoRA injection splices into any graph. All paths are configuration, editable from the panel and saved to a settings file, so it works against a remote or already-running ComfyUI. Headless auto-start and idle shutdown are opt-in and off by default.
description.zh: 把 ComfyUI 接给 agent：五个 draw_* 工具（状态、工作流、模型、生图、反推）与侧栏面板。插件本身不带任何工作流、也不假设你用什么模型：放进工作流目录的每个 API 格式 JSON 都会被自动检查，找出 prompt / 负向提示词 / 宽高 / steps / cfg / 种子 / LoRA 落位，可用同名 sidecar 文件覆盖检测结果；LoRA 能插进任意连线图。所有路径都可配置、可在面板里改并保存到设置文件，因此对着远程或已经开着的 ComfyUI 也能用。无头自动启动与空闲关闭默认关闭，需自行开启。

description.en: 0.8.6 fixes a startup crash: the host runtime package is an optional peer, never an installed dependency. TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) wired end to end into DeepSeek Harness (0.8.6). Seven tools: jev_decision (1-25 parallel atomic verdicts in one call; noul/choice/score; typed answers with calibrated confidence; measured median 266-484 ms; verdicts only, never prose), jev_choose (rank 2-10 candidate approaches - fit 0-3 and risk - into an explicit composite with a recommended pick), jev_batch (NEW in 0.8.6: one set of 1-5 judgments over 1-20 texts, one real call per text at bounded concurrency, returning a paste-ready markdown table sortable by a judged dimension; built-in sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam presets; a failed row is reported as failed with the raw error, never guessed), jev_usage (locally measured usage: calls, tokens, estimated cost, latency median and p95, per-tool mix, rolling windows, projected burn rate, optional local hard budgets, and a declared-balance remainder), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (guard counters plus a registrations block that surfaces per-surface registration failures) and jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark at concurrency 6: 96.3%, 26/27). WHAT IS NEW IN 0.8.6 - the ledger survives a restart, the remainder is derived instead of invented, and the plugin can now do batch paperwork. (1) The local ledger persists to $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json BY DEFAULT, so the cumulative total no longer resets when the host restarts. Two real bugs behind the old silent zero were found and fixed: the ledger path only honoured DSH_HOME (absent inside the host process, so persistence was silently disabled and the file name was null), and save() wrote the still-empty in-memory ring over the history file because it ran before the first load while the debounce window swallowed the follow-up write. (2) Remaining is derived, never invented: TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint - /v1/usage, /v1/quota, /v1/account, /v1/account/balance, /v1/balance, /v1/credits, /v1/billing, /v1/me, /v1/limits and a dozen more all return 404, and only /v1/models answers, with no balance headers - so the panel shows the remainder as your declared balance (quota.declaredBalanceUsd) minus locally measured spend since quota.balanceSince, and says plainly that it cannot be fetched instead of printing a number. (3) The composer pill re-reads every 20 s instead of every 60 s, so a call you just made shows up while you are still looking at it. (4) The collapsed pill leads with the remainder once you declare a balance, and the cumulative row is renamed when the ledger is on disk. Every tool has an in-conversation structured view; the Settings > Plugins card covers credentials, tool switches, the auto-guard, the dashboard, the prompt section, usage/quota and auto-triage. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one surface. Tests 38/38 (npm test, ~2.5 s). Client half applies on refresh; server half needs a host restart.
description.zh: 0.8.6 修复了一个会让宿主起不来的依赖问题（宿主运行时包改为 optional peer，永不被安装）。为 DeepSeek Harness 端到端接入 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）0.8.6。共七个工具：jev_decision（一次并行完成 1-25 个原子判定；noul/choice/score；返回类型化答案与校准置信度；实测中位 266-484 ms；只出判定不写文本）、jev_choose（对 2-10 个候选并行打分——契合度 0-3 与风险——合成综合分并给推荐，只给分不解释）、jev_batch（0.8.6 新增：一次调用对 1-20 条文本跑同一组 1-5 个判定，每条文本一次真实调用、并发有上限，返回可直接粘贴的 markdown 表格并可按某个判定维度排序；内置 sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam 预设；失败的行如实标为失败并附原文错误，绝不猜测）、jev_usage（本机实测用量：调用、tokens、估算成本、延迟中位与 p95、按工具分布、滚动窗口、全天用量预测、可选的本地硬预算，以及自报余额推算出的剩余）、jev_overview（会话账本）、jev_guard_status（护栏计数，并用 registrations 暴露分面注册失败）与 jev_verify（对线上 API 6 路并发运行冻结的 27 题基准：96.3%，26/27）。0.8.6 的三件事：账本扛得住重启、剩余是算出来的而不是编出来的、插件开始干批量整理的活。 （1）本地账本默认写入 $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json，宿主重启后累计不再清零。此前「明明有调用、面板却是 0」背后是两个真 bug：账本路径只认 DSH_HOME（宿主进程里没有这个变量，于是持久化被静默关闭、file 为 null），以及 save() 在首次 load 之前执行，把尚未载入的空内存环覆盖写到了历史文件上，而紧随其后的那次保存又被节流窗口吞掉。 （2）剩余只推算、不编造：TypeSafe 没有任何余额接口——/v1/usage、/v1/quota、/v1/account、/v1/account/balance、/v1/balance、/v1/credits、/v1/billing、/v1/me、/v1/limits 等十几个路径全部 404，只有 /v1/models 有响应且响应头没有任何余额字段——因此面板把「剩余」显示为你在 quota.declaredBalanceUsd 自报的余额减去 quota.balanceSince 起的本机实测花费，没自报时明确写「剩余无法显示」，绝不印一个数字。 （3）输入框胶囊的刷新周期从 60 秒改为 20 秒，刚跑完的调用不用等就能看到。 （4）自报余额后，折叠胶囊以「剩余」为首，账本落盘后累计行改名。每个工具都有对话内结构化视图；「设置 → 插件」卡片覆盖凭据、工具开关、自动护栏、看板、引导段、使用额度与 autoTriage。 诚实设计：未配置 Key 时给出明确报错、绝不伪造结果；任何分面注册失败都被隔离，只降级一个功能。 测试 38/38（npm test，约 2.5 s）。客户端部分刷新页面即生效；服务端部分需重启宿主。

description.en: Provides an OAuth account page for DSH Web, currently supporting OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic, Kimi For Coding, OpenRouter, and xAI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 OAuth 账号页面，目前支持 OpenAI Codex、GitHub Copilot、Anthropic、Kimi For Coding、OpenRouter 与 xAI。

description.en: A memory subsystem for DeepSeek Harness: full ontological memory (event/fact/rule three-ontology) plus a goal system (goal.js) — belief values written via Bridge trigger words, goal activation scored at read time (0.25 domain + 0.35 bridge + 0.40 sim) to recover goal/value long-range associations, journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay, memory_append/read/consolidate plus linghun_goal_update/get/state closed loop. Independent of the original dsh-linghun line. 16/16 on LoCoMo-Plus.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的记忆子系统：记忆完全本体化（event/fact/rule 三本体）+ 目标系统（goal.js）——belief 价值观写侧收录 + Bridge 触发词，读侧重匹配公式（0.25 域命中 + 0.35 触发词 + 0.40 相似度）补上 goal/value 语义远距联想；序时账留痕、情景归档、低置信降权遗忘；memory_append/read/consolidate + linghun_goal_update/get/state 读写沉淀闭环。独立于原 dsh-linghun 演进。LoCoMo-Plus 16/16 满分。

description.en: Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the unsent draft into a clearer, more specific prompt, with one-click restore, a settings page and an optional per-request model override.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，把未发送的草稿改写为更清晰、更具体的提示词；支持一键还原、独立设置页，以及单次调用的模型覆盖。

description.en: Text-to-image and image-to-image for a model that cannot draw, through any OpenAI-compatible image API, with multiple providers and an automatic fallback model.
description.zh: 让没有生图/修图能力的模型接入任意 OpenAI 兼容生图接口：支持文生图与图生图，可添加多个服务商，并为生图与修图各选主用与备用模型，主模型连不上时自动切换到备用。

description.en: MCP server and skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel and a plugin-page config section with search, status lights, per-row switches, expandable details, and an add-server form following Codex mcp_servers fields.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器与技能管理面板：侧栏面板加插件页配置区，支持搜索、状态灯、逐行开关、详情，以及按 Codex mcp_servers 字段设计的添加服务器表单。

description.en: Right-click menu for DeepSeek Harness conversation content: copy the selection or the whole message, copy message images and the preview lightbox to the clipboard as PNG (or save them), open file paths (absolute, relative to the session working directory, or ~/), reveal them in the file manager, open them with another registered application, and copy paths or links. Every candidate path is verified by the Host filesystem before an open action appears.
description.zh: 给 DSH 对话区加右键菜单：复制选中内容或整条消息；把消息图片和点击预览后的大图复制为 PNG 到剪贴板或另存为文件；识别绝对路径、相对会话工作区的路径、~/ 以及代码内联路径，一键打开、 在文件管理器中显示、用其他应用打开、复制绝对/相对路径；链接可打开或复制。所有候选路径都会 先由 Host 文件系统校验存在性，再显示打开项。

description.en: After each reply, shows a gray next-prompt suggestion in the empty composer that Tab or → accepts; in an empty composer, ↑ / ↓ browse the messages you sent in the session. Settings can be changed on the Plugins page; nothing is sent automatically.
description.zh: 回答结束后在空输入框里显示一条灰色的下一句建议，按 Tab 或 → 采纳；空输入框按 ↑ / ↓ 翻看本会话发送过的内容；可在插件页直接修改设置；不会自动发送。

description.en: Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branch/tag actions, and one-click fetch from all remotes.
description.zh: 专精于 Git 分支与状态处理：Web 右缘 Git 状态浮窗，commit DAG 泳道图、未提交改动与 stash、行内 diff，右键分支/tag 切换、合并、重命名、删除、新建，一键拉取全部远程。

description.en: Smart session titles for DSH: after each conversation turn an independent auxiliary LLM call summarizes the full user+assistant transcript into a title that follows the session's real topic instead of echoing the first message; the first message is titled instantly, failed built-in titles auto-retry on later turns, manual renames are never overwritten, and subagent/fork sessions are skipped.
description.zh: 会话智能标题：每轮对话结束后用一次独立的辅助 LLM 调用对「用户消息+助手回答」的完整转写做总结，标题跟随会话真实主题而不是复述第一句话；首条消息即时出题、内置标题失败在后续轮次自动重试、用户手动改名绝不被覆盖、自动跳过子代理与 fork 会话。

description.en: Session management for DSH: archive, restore and delete persisted sessions, cap how many sessions each workspace keeps, and review disk usage in a size governance panel.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理：归档、恢复、删除持久化会话，按工作区限制会话数量上限，并提供体积治理面板。

description.en: Agent-team task workbench for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar board and requirement view track tasks across backlog, execution, review and done, dispatch work to coding agents, and run multi-role team orchestration on a local SQLite store.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体团队任务工作台：侧栏看板与需求视图跟踪任务从待办、执行、评审到完成，把工作派发给编码智能体，并用本地 SQLite 承载多角色团队编排。

description.en: Vision understanding + image generation/editing for DeepSeek Harness (read images with Qwen/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini, generate and edit with Qwen-Image). A rework of liustack/modlens (MIT). Remove @liustack/modlens first — both register the same vision providers and image interception hooks, so co-installation breaks image reading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供读图与生图/编辑能力（Qwen/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini 读图，Qwen-Image 生图与编辑）。基于 liustack/modlens（MIT）改造；请先卸载 @liustack/modlens——两者会注册同一批 vision provider 与图片拦截钩子，并存会导致读图失灵。

description.en: One settings page that lists every subscription sign-in the harness can offer and walks you through it — ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter, Kimi and xAI — reading the list from the authorization seam instead of hardcoding providers, and showing credential records no registered flow claims any more.
description.zh: 把所有订阅登录收进一个设置页：列表直接读授权 seam 上注册的流程，引导你走完 ChatGPT (Codex)、Claude、GitHub Copilot、OpenRouter、Kimi 与 xAI，并列出已无人认领的旧凭据记录。

description.en: KuroWhale is an unofficial dark-themed whale-girl desktop companion for Windows x64, inspired by the DeepSeek Harness icon, with nine animations that react to DSH Agent activity. Requires WebView2; the first launch downloads the official Neutralino 6.9.0 runtime and artwork over the network and verifies them by SHA-256.
description.zh: KuroWhale 黑色系鲸鱼娘桌宠，参考 DeepSeek Harness 官方图标设计的非官方 Windows x64 桌宠，九种动画会随 DSH Agent 的工作状态作出反应；需要 WebView2，首次启动会联网下载官方 Neutralino 6.9.0 运行时与素材并做 SHA-256 校验。

description.en: Unified IM channel for DeepSeek Harness: Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, Slack, Discord — persistent conversations, true streaming replies, 40 MCP Feishu tools, slash commands, and an IM-bot status tab in the plugin settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一 IM 渠道：飞书、Telegram、钉钉、Slack、Discord —— 持久会话、真流式回复、40 个飞书 MCP 工具、斜杠命令，以及插件设置页中的 IM 机器人状态页。

description.en: Official DeepSeek platform monitoring inside the provider card: a live balance chip left of the composer model name plus an expandable account-details panel with per-model monthly usage and a daily stacked chart.
description.zh: 在官方供应商卡片内实时监控 DeepSeek 余额与开放平台用量——输入框工具行模型名称左侧的余额 chip，可展开的账户明细面板含按模型用量与每日堆叠图表。

description.en: Reads local PDFs in the DSH sidebar — jump to any page and page through the whole document.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏里看本地 PDF：跳到任意一页，整本连着看。

description.en: Windows desktop integration, a one-click launcher and tray controller for DSH, plus a sidebar button that puts DSH and a chat.deepseek.com window side by side with one shared taskbar button. Installing it writes a desktop shortcut and registers a dshsplit: protocol, both removed by lib/desktop.ps1 -Mode remove.
description.zh: Windows 桌面集成：一键启动器 + 托盘控制器，另加侧边栏按钮把 DSH 和 chat.deepseek.com 并排放置并共用一个任务栏按钮。安装会写入桌面快捷方式并注册 dshsplit: 协议，两者都可用 lib/desktop.ps1 -Mode remove 清除。

description.en: Reason tree: breaks a conclusion into a bottom-up argument tree, marks each branch as holds, fails or open, and jumps to the source file in Hippocampus.
description.zh: 根源追溯：把结论拆成从下往上的论证树，每一支可标成立、不成立或待拆，并能跳到海马体看原文。

description.en: IDE tab in the dsh web client: a Monaco editor with the Dark Modern theme plus a file tree, git source control (stage/commit/push), an integrated xterm terminal and ripgrep workspace search, opened as a conversation view tab.
description.zh: dsh Web 客户端里的 IDE 标签页：Dark Modern 主题的 Monaco 编辑器，配文件树、Git 源代码管理（暂存/提交/推送）、xterm 集成终端与 ripgrep 全工作区搜索，作为会话视图标签打开。

description.en: Remote DSH access that needs no hosting of your own — the Feishu DM chat is the interface over the bot's outbound long connection, with cards for workspace, session (switch and rename), model, reasoning effort, permission preset and balance, and tool approvals and agent questions answered in that same chat.
description.zh: 免运维的远程 DSH——拿飞书私聊当界面，机器人出站长连接、不需要公网入口，工作区、会话（切换与改名）、模型、推理深度、权限预设、余额都用卡片操作，工具审批与 agent 反问也在同一个聊天里回。

description.en: DSH plugin: images dropped or pasted into the composer become @path reference chips at the caret, with a hover preview.
description.zh: 把拖入/粘贴进输入框的图片当文件处理：光标处插 @路径 胶囊、不占附件栏，输入框与已发送消息里都能悬停看原图。

description.en: Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE — official Notion MCP, no integration token.
description.zh: 在图形界面中以 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 连接 Notion —— 官方 Notion MCP，无需集成令牌。

description.en: Per-model system prompt injector for DeepSeek Harness: append custom prompt text to the END of the system prompt for locally configured models, matched by exact provider/model route or a provider-wide provider/* rule (both stack in order). A Settings page lists every configured provider and its models for per-route editing with instant effect, and rules persist to DSH_HOME so they survive restarts. Applies to main sessions, subagents, and workflow children alike.
description.zh: DSH 按模型注入系统提示词：为本地已配置的模型把自定义提示词追加到系统提示词末尾，支持 provider/model 精确匹配与 provider/* 服务商级通配（两者按序叠加）。设置页自动列出每个已配置服务商及其模型，逐行编辑、即时生效；规则持久化保存、重启不丢；对主会话、subagent 与 workflow 子代理同样生效。

description.en: Retrospective agent-session evaluation — grades the sessions that already happened: deterministic grade cards, regression diffs, /eval-history trends, and /eval --report straight from exported artifacts; no benchmark runs, no LLM judges.
description.zh: 回溯式会话评测——给已经发生的会话打分：确定性评分卡、回归对比、/eval-history 趋势，/eval --report 直接从导出产物评分；不跑基准、不用 LLM 裁判。

description.en: Token usage and cost dashboard: requests, tokens, RPM/TPM over the last 60 minutes, cache hit rate, per-model and per-provider breakdown, a 12-month activity heatmap, and cost estimated from OpenRouter prices. Data stays in a local ledger; no telemetry.
description.zh: Token 用量与成本看板：请求数、Token、最近 60 分钟 RPM/TPM、缓存命中率、按模型与供应商拆分、12 个月活动热力图，成本按 OpenRouter 公开价目估算。数据只落在本地账本，无遥测。

description.en: Read-only Windows AppData analyzer: click the sidebar icon to drill down explorer-style through directories, each row showing recursive size, file count and last-modified time, plus the software that created it and a delete-worthiness verdict built from a knowledge base, mixed-directory splitting, then heuristics, with unmatched guesses marked as such. Scans directories only and never reads file contents; it ships no delete action, and unknown directories can be looked up online with a model summary and cited sources. The online lookup needs a DeepSeek API key (or an equivalent credential); without one the query is only copied to the clipboard.
description.zh: 只读的 Windows AppData 分析插件：点侧边栏图标后以资源管理器式逐层下钻，每行显示目录的递归体积、文件数与最后修改时间，并说明由哪个软件生成、作何用途，按「知识库 → 混合目录拆分 → 启发式 → 标注为推测」的顺序给出可删建议；只统计目录、不读取文件内容，也不提供任何删除操作，未知目录可按需联网检索并给出带摘要的来源。联网查询需配置 DeepSeek API key（或等价凭据）；没有凭据时只会把查询串复制到剪贴板，不会报错。

description.en: The menu bar app itself is a separate AppKit build from the repo's app/ directory (swift build -c release on macOS); the plugin only provides the host bridge.
description.zh: 菜单栏应用不在插件里：需在 macOS 上用仓库 app/ 目录自行执行 swift build -c release 构建，插件只提供宿主桥。

description.en: One stylesheet that retypesets the DSH conversation to measured Codex metrics: 14/22 px body, tighter headings, lists and blocks, a rounded quote bar, and Tidy Tables with a themed header, row/column rules, full-width short tables and contained scrolling for wide tables; no settings or DOM rewriting, with real before/after captures.
description.zh: 一张样式表，按实测的 Codex 版式重排 DSH 对话页：14/22 px 正文，收紧标题、列表与块级节奏，使用圆角引用条，并把表格补成带主题化表头、行列分隔、短表铺满和宽表容器内滚动的 Tidy Tables；无设置项、不改写 DOM，仓库内附真实前后对比图。

description.en: Quote books in the conversation header: one markdown file per chat, with search, a random pick, line and favourite counts, a keep button under every reply, and a trash with restore. The agent gets four tools (append, list, remove, merge) and a system-prompt guide, so by default it may save up to a line or two per chat on its own; capture rules can be set per chat or globally. Local-only. Needs DSH 0.2.1+ (below 0.3).
description.zh: 会话头部的「鲸语」：每个对话一本 markdown 语录，带搜索、翻一句、句数与收藏计数、每条回复旁的一键收入，以及能恢复的回收站。agent 有增、查、删、合并四个工具，系统提示里也带一段记录指引，所以默认每个对话它最多自己记一两句；记什么可按对话或全局设置。全部只存本地。需要 DSH 0.2.1+（0.3 以下）。

description.en: Web search, page fetch and one-call research through DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch API; needs a DeepSeek API key.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek 官方 Search/Fetch 接口做网页搜索、单页抓取与一键调研；需要一个 DeepSeek API key。
