description.en: Linear tools for DeepSeek Harness: 26 model-facing tools over the Linear GraphQL API (issues, comments, relations, teams, states, labels, projects, cycles, users) plus a linear_graphql escape hatch. Requires a Linear personal API token.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Linear 工具：26 个基于 Linear GraphQL API 的模型工具（议题、评论、关联、团队、状态、标签、项目、周期、用户），外加 linear_graphql 逃生口。需自备 Linear 个人 API token。

description.en: Learns a user's coding conventions from instructions and corrections, stores them as confidence-scored rules in editable Markdown, and injects them as reference data into every session. Rules that decay out of range or contradict a newer rule stay visible for review instead of being applied.
description.zh: 从指令和纠正里学习编码习惯，存成带置信度、可手工编辑的 Markdown 规则，并在每个会话中作为参考数据注入。衰减出注入窗口或与更新规则冲突的条目会留在待审列表里，而不是继续生效。

description.en: Adds a Restart dsh button above Settings that restarts dsh in place: through systemd when dsh runs as a systemd unit, otherwise via process.execve with the same PID (a thin wrapper parent on Windows or Node < 22.15), so whatever started dsh needs no supervisor config (verified on Linux; Docker, macOS and Windows not yet run for real); the page reloads once the new boot id answers.
description.zh: 在「设置」上方添加「重启 dsh」按钮，原地重启：以 systemd 单元运行时由 systemd 重启，否则通过 process.execve 保持同一 PID（Windows 或 Node < 22.15 时保留一个轻量父进程），启动 dsh 的守护进程或终端无需额外配置（已在 Linux 实测，Docker、macOS、Windows 尚未实机测试）；新 boot id 响应后页面自动刷新。

description.en: Tripo 3D generation skills driving the tripo-cli through the shell: text-to-3D, image-to-3D, rigging with locomotion clips, decimation and LOD chains, and export to GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF, with headless device login for both China-mainland and international accounts; installable as `tripo-dsh`.
description.zh: 通过 shell 驱动 tripo-cli 的 Tripo 3D 生成 Skill：文生 3D、图生 3D、绑骨与走跑动画、减面与 LOD 链，导出 GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF，支持国内站与海外站账号的无头设备码登录；npm 包名 `tripo-dsh`。

description.en: Routes eligible bash commands through rtk (Rust Token Killer) so tool output is compressed before it reaches the model, by asking the installed rtk to rewrite each command and adopting what it prints; when rtk is absent the executor behaves exactly like the stock one.
description.zh: 把符合条件的 bash 命令交给 rtk（Rust Token Killer）执行，让工具输出在进入模型之前就被压缩：插件调用本机 rtk 重写命令并采纳其结果；rtk 未安装时，执行器行为与原生完全一致。

description.en: Registers FreeLLMAPI as a dsh model provider, with the router itself bundled in the plugin. It launches the vendored server with the host binary and exposes the freellmapi route; the sidebar panel starts and stops that process, lists the router catalogue, probes which claimed models actually answer, and ranks them by the stability, speed and intelligence scores the router computes for itself. Provider keys, routing strategy and usage remain in the router console, which the panel links to.
description.zh: 把 FreeLLMAPI 注册为 dsh 的模型 provider，路由本体随插件打包。插件用宿主二进制启动内置服务并暴露 freellmapi 路由；侧栏面板负责启停该进程、列出路由的模型目录、实测哪些自称可用的模型真能回答，并按路由自身计算的稳定、速度、智能评分排序。provider key、路由策略与用量仍在路由自带控制台，面板里给了入口。

description.en: Pinned prompt shortcuts in a single row above the composer — one click replaces the draft with the saved text — plus a searchable panel for pinning, editing and deleting prompts, overflow collapsed into a "More" menu, storage in a Host-side JSON file, and a prompt_shortcuts agent tool that reads and writes the same file.
description.zh: 输入框上方的一行置顶提示词按钮，点击即替换草稿内容；另有可搜索的维护面板用于置顶、编辑、删除，放不下的按钮收进「更多」菜单，数据存于 Host 侧 JSON 文件，并注册 prompt_shortcuts 工具读写同一份数据。

description.en: Configuration vault for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot, diff and safely roll back profile patches, plugin manifests, skills and workspace lists, with credentials excluded by default.
description.zh: 配置保险箱：为 DSH 配置创建快照、对比差异并安全回滚设置补丁、插件清单、技能与规则、工作区列表，凭据默认排除。

description.en: Lets a phone reach the DeepSeek Harness desktop over a LAN address or a Cloudflare quick tunnel, with QR pairing, a live session feed, approval prompts and a floating desktop widget. Both entry points (LAN and the Cloudflare quick tunnel) start enabled by default; each phone pairs with its own token.
description.zh: 让手机连上本机的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版：局域网或 Cloudflare 隧道二维码配对，实时消息列表与授权提醒，桌面悬浮球。局域网与 Cloudflare 隧道两个入口默认都开启；每台手机用自己的配对令牌。

description.en: In-session "Files" tab (conversation.view, order 20) for dsh Web that browses the active session's workspace directory with breadcrumbs and previews files inline — sanitized Markdown (marked + DOMPurify), images, line-numbered text and PDF — served by read-only /dsh-files host routes registered on ctx.webServer; no write endpoints. Bilingual zh/en.
description.zh: dsh Web 会话内「文件」页签（conversation.view，order 20）：以当前会话工作区为根的面包屑目录浏览，内联预览消毒渲染的 Markdown（marked + DOMPurify）、图片、带行号文本与 PDF；目录与读取全部经 ctx.webServer 注册的只读 /dsh-files 宿主路由，无任何写端点（中英双语）。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to FitMeet through per-user OAuth with 17 tools for people search, gatherings, notifications, personal items, connection feedback, Hall publishing, and direct messages, with preview-and-confirm guards for write actions.
description.zh: 通过每位用户独立的 OAuth 授权将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 FitMeet，提供找人、组局查询、提醒、个人事项、连接反馈、大厅发布与私聊的 17 个工具，写入操作保留预览与确认步骤。

description.en: Persistent, cross-session multi-agent team rooms for DeepSeek Harness — members, a message bus, a shared task board, and a shared timeline that survive restarts.
description.zh: 持久化、跨会话的多 Agent 团队房间：成员、消息总线、共享任务板与共享时间线，重启后仍然保留。

description.en: Four palettes for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — solid, glass, volume and neon — each with light and dark halves. Neon adds a scene light field with a 46px circuit grid, a laser scan that sweeps the conversation column only while a turn is running, HUD-style workspace labels in the sidebar, embedded MiSans Latin chrome type, and a 125% sidebar type scale that stays fixed while the conversation area zooms.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的四套配色：实心 / 玻璃 / 体积 / 霓虹，各含明暗两半。霓虹版在整窗场景光场上叠 46px 电路网格，并在模型运行时让一条激光扫描线扫过对话列（停止即消失）；侧栏工作区名为青色 HUD 标牌，界面拉丁字体内置 MiSans，侧栏字号固定 125% 且不随对话区缩放。

description.en: Composer-side helpers for the DSH Web UI: next-message prediction shown as grey ghost text that Tab fills in, a one-line per-turn recap above the input (placeable below instead) that never enters the model context, a right-sidebar panel for follow-ups from past sessions, recap history and side questions with their own model picker, and config-driven reply length, style and actionable framing.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的一组顺手小件：输入框下方灰字预测下一句、Tab 填入；输入框上方逐轮一行摘要（也可以放到下方）、不进入模型上下文；右侧栏面板管待跟进、会话回顾与旁问，旁问可单独选模型；回复长度、风格与「便于行动」也在插件配置里调。

description.en: DSH plugin that enforces per-task budget caps by CNY amount or token count, with automatic interception to prevent runaway agent costs.
description.zh: 为 DSH 每次任务设置预算线，支持按金额或 Token 限制消耗，并在达到阈值时自动拦截，防止 Agent 过度消费。

description.en: Cross-session usage and cost observatory for DSH — token trends from hourly lines to 90-day and 1-year heatmaps, per-model DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing reconciled against the official balance, GLM/Kimi/MiniMax subscription-quota windows with burn-rate forecasts, cache-hit ring, project rankings, CSV export, and a dsh-tui terminal face.
description.zh: 跨会话用量与费用观测台——分时走势与 90 天/1 年热力图、逐模型峰谷计价并与官方余额对账、GLM/Kimi/MiniMax 订阅额度与燃速预估、缓存命中环、项目排行、CSV 导出，另有 dsh-tui 终端面。

description.en: Connects DSH Foxy to Foxy Memory for cross-platform recall, with local JSONL fallback, platform filters, and a memory browser. Requires dsh-foxy.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 Foxy 接入 Foxy Memory，支持跨平台召回、本地 JSONL 回退、平台筛选与记忆浏览。需先安装 dsh-foxy。

description.en: Keenable web search and page fetch for the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools, working with any model and no API key.
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 与 web_fetch 工具提供 Keenable 网页搜索与网页读取，适用于任意模型，无需 API Key。

description.en: Blocks AI coding agents from editing files without evidence and from running unapproved high-risk commands, and tells quoted dangerous strings apart from commands actually being executed.
description.zh: 拦截 AI 编码智能体未取证就改文件、未获授权执行高危命令，并区分「被引用的危险字符串」与「真要执行的命令」。

description.en: Sidebar schedule assistant for dsh-better-sidebar (required: the tab registers through it; DSH 0.2.2+): a today view with city weather refreshed at 8:30 / 12:00 / 17:30, an almanac and a collapsible horoscope block; a lunar month calendar whose cells let the wallpaper show through; events and to-dos; daily and weekly reports and a daily check-in; per-person rest-day schemes with an off-work countdown. A multi-account mail client for QQ Mail and Foxmail (@qq.com / @foxmail.com, both using imap.qq.com / smtp.qq.com and an app password): IMAP receive + SMTP send, seven tabs, search, star / spam / trash with restore, read-unread state, drafts, group send with a per-mail interval, and attachments in both directions — clickable links in message bodies open in the system browser. Reminders (sitting / water / eye-care / music) appear as in-app capsules floating above the whole DSH client with adjustable dwell time (3-60 s) and position, optional Windows notifications and a manual preview button. A rotating wallpaper appearance (sequential or shuffled), adjustable opacity and frosted glass, and adjustable text colour. Data stays local and is never uploaded. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 给 dsh-better-sidebar 用的侧边栏日程助手（必须先装该插件；需 DSH 0.2.2+）：今日一屏（天气每天 8:30 / 12:00 / 17:30 定点刷新、黄历、可折叠星座运势）；农历月历（格子可透出壁纸）；日程与待办；日报周报与每日签到；按人设置班制与上下班倒计时。多账号邮箱客户端，支持 QQ 邮箱与 Foxmail 邮箱（@qq.com / @foxmail.com，同一套 imap.qq.com / smtp.qq.com，授权码登录）：IMAP 收信 + SMTP 发信、七个页签、搜索、星标 / 垃圾 / 垃圾箱（可还原）/ 已读未读、草稿箱、可按间隔群发、附件双向收发，正文网址可直接用系统浏览器打开。久坐 / 喝水 / 护眼 / 听音乐提醒以界面内「胶囊」浮在整个 DSH 界面之上，停留秒数（3~60 秒）与位置可调，可选同时推 Windows 通知，并支持手动预览。壁纸轮播（顺序或随机洗牌）、透明度与磨砂、界面文字颜色均可调。数据全部本地保存，不上传云端。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Webpage watch agent: keep a watchlist of URLs, snapshot each page on every sweep, detect changes by bigram-Dice ratio and keywords, log important ones and push to a WeChat webhook; agent tools page_watch_add/list/check/history/remove. Renders JS anti-bot WAF pages via the optional lexmount extractor.
description.zh: 网页监控哨兵：把一批网页加入监视清单，每次巡检抓快照、用 bigram-Dice 变化率与关键词判断变化是否重要，重要变化写日志并推送企业微信 webhook；提供 page_watch_add/list/check/history/remove 工具，可选 lexmount 通道穿透 JS 反爬 WAF 页面。

description.en: After each completed agent turn, a bounded auxiliary LLM call writes one suggested next prompt into the session log; the web composer renders it as ghost placeholder text, adopted via Tab.
description.zh: 每次完成的 agent 回合后，一次有界的辅助 LLM 调用把一条建议的下一句 prompt 写入会话日志；Web 输入框将其渲染为幽灵占位文字，按 Tab 采纳。

description.en: Windows toast and a chime whenever a conversation task stops: completed, waiting on your approval or answer, or failed. Clicking the toast reopens that session at your last question, and in DSH Desktop it also raises the window.
description.zh: 对话任务停止时弹一条 Windows 通知并响一声提示音：完成、等你审批或回答、出错都会提醒。点通知回到那个会话，落在你上次提问的位置；桌面端还会把窗口拉到前台。

description.en: Chrome side panel that embeds the dsh web UI and lets the agent read the current page, capture HTTP traffic, and drive the browser.
description.zh: Chrome 侧边栏内嵌 dsh 网页界面，让 agent 读取当前页面、捕获 HTTP 流量并操作浏览器。

description.en: Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 对话结束语音播报（会话名、轮数、结果），回复生成时实时逐句朗读；内置 edge-tts，零第三方依赖。

description.en: Faithful port of the hermes-agent MEMORY.md / USER.md mechanism for DSH: bounded dual-bank memory (2200/1375 chars), a single `memory` tool (add/replace/remove/batch), frozen-snapshot injection per session, nudge reminders, DSH-native JSON storage — zero external dependencies, zero LLM cost.
description.zh: DSH 上 hermes-agent 记忆机制的忠实移植（MEMORY.md / USER.md）：有界双记忆库（2200/1375 字符）、单个 memory 工具（add/replace/remove/batch 全有或全无）、每会话冻结快照注入与 nudge 提醒、DSH 原生 JSON 存储——零外部依赖、零 LLM 成本。

description.en: Keeps long DSH sessions alive when a model channel starts failing: daruma takes over after the in-box retry gives up, trips a self-healing circuit breaker on repeated 429/5xx or a terminal error, and moves the next request to another channel in your chain. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x hosts, including 0.2.1-rc.2 with verified failover and backup-management RPC. The backup can be picked in Settings or from a panel beside the composer — both stay in sync — with a durable JSONL audit log for every switch. Channel switches are recorded in that audit log instead of as in-conversation notice rows, because a plugin session event of a type the host does not know makes it refuse to load the whole session.
description.zh: 渠道开始失败时不让长任务中断：内置重试放弃后 daruma 接管，对连续 429/5xx 或终止性错误跳闸自愈断路器，把下一个请求切到链上的其他渠道。支持 DSH 0.1.x 与 0.2.x 宿主，含已实测故障转移与备用管理 RPC 的 0.2.1-rc.2。备用渠道可在设置页或输入框旁的面板挑选，两处即时同步；每次切换落盘成可审计的 JSONL 日志。切换只记入这份审计日志，不再写入会话内的提示行——宿主不认识的插件事件类型会让整段会话加载失败。

description.en: Sound + popup when a task completes: a Web Audio chime, an in-page toast, and a system notification while the page is in the background (browser-only, cross-platform).
description.zh: 任务完成时播放提示音并弹出小通知：Web Audio 合成音效、页面内 toast、页面在后台时系统通知，纯浏览器方案、零系统依赖、跨平台。

description.en: Per-provider (account) proxy routing for DSH. SOCKS5/HTTP proxy pool with account-level routing based on API keys. Supports forced direct connections and hot-swapping built-in web tools proxies. Managed via a graphical settings page in DSH.
description.zh: 按提供商（账号）分流的 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理池。基于 API 密钥识别账号实现精准分流，支持绝对直连（无视 DSH 全局代理）与内置联网工具代理热装。配置在 DSH 设置页图形化管理，保存即热生效。

description.en: A WYSIWYG Typst editor for papers, reports, exams, resumes, charts, posters, sheet music, and slides exported as PPTX.
description.zh: Typst 文档编辑工具：WYSIWYG 编辑排版论文、报告、试卷、简历、图表、海报、乐谱和可导出为 PPTX 的 Slides。

description.en: File-defined subagent roles for DeepSeek Harness: roles live in project and global .dsh/roles files, a delegating agent sees one catalog line per role, and each role's tool policy decides which tools its child can see.
description.zh: 用文件定义子代理角色：角色放在项目级与全局级 .dsh/roles 目录，委派方每个角色只看到一行目录，子代理可见的工具由角色自己的工具策略决定。

description.en: Lowtide (as in low tide) runs task batches automatically in off-peak hours — a highly customizable task framework with four execution strategies, L1–L3 semi/full-auto adjudication, in-place task editing and preflight checks, built on the Cordis microkernel, one build for both desktop and web.
description.zh: lowtide（退潮）插件能够实现闲时自动批量跑任务——任务框架高度自定义，四种执行策略，L1–L3 半自动/全自动裁决，支持任务编辑与预检，Cordis 微内核集成，桌面网页端通用。

description.en: Prompt optimizer inside the DSH composer. One click rewrites the current draft with the model you already selected: it classifies the scenario (paper / agent task / daily question / English writing), returns a compact three-check diagnosis panel (is acceptance testable? missing information or capability? raising depth or widening scope?), and lets you pin a scenario manually. The draft is replaced in place, with no extra chat turn.
description.zh: DSH 输入框内的提示词优化器。点一下就用当前选中的模型就地改写草稿：自动识别场景（论文 / 派活 / 日常 / 英文），弹出三自检诊断面板（验收能否机器判定？缺信息还是缺能力？在抬深度还是扩范围？）， 并可手动钉住场景。改写结果直接替换输入框草稿，不新增对话轮次。

description.en: Resident multi-connection download engine for DeepSeek Harness: seven rdm_* agent tools plus a sidebar download panel, with resumable, SHA-256-verified and bandwidth-limited transfers that survive a kernel or DSH restart.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的常驻多连接下载引擎：七个 rdm_* 智能体工具加侧边栏下载面板，支持断点续传、SHA-256 校验与限速，内核或 DSH 重启后仍可续传。

description.en: Restart initiated by the agent itself, not by a button. The agent calls one tool, then the plugin takes over: it waits until every agent and background job on the host is idle, runs a visible ten-second countdown that a click, a scroll, or a key press cancels, then restarts DSH and wakes the original session so the agent carries on from its last sentence. No button, no manual entry: the tool is the only way in. Works on the official desktop app and the official web client; third-party shells are not supported out of the box. Windows only. One thing to know: every launch of the DSH desktop app writes a fresh identity cookie into its own profile and never prunes the old ones, so after enough launches the cookie header outgrows the request limit and the next start dies with HTTP 431 and `Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed`, with no window at all. Restarting by hand runs into this too; this plugin simply restarts far more often, so it brings that day closer.
description.zh: 由 agent 自己发起的重启，不是按钮。agent 调一个工具，之后由插件接管：等这台机器上所有 agent 与后台任务都空闲，走完十秒可见倒计时（点一下鼠标、滚一下滚轮、按任意键都会取消），再重启 DSH，并唤醒原会话让 agent 接着说下去。没有按钮、没有手动入口——工具是唯一入口。官方桌面端与官方网页端均已适配，第三方壳不在默认支持范围内。仅限 Windows。一点须知：DSH 桌面端每次启动都会往自己的 profile 里写一份新的身份 cookie，旧的不清理；攒多了会让下一次启动报 HTTP 431 与 Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed，窗口出不来。手动重启同样会遇到，这是 DSH 自身的行为；本插件重启更频繁，只是让这一天来得更早。

description.en: Fireworks celebration engine: floats fireworks above the chat window while the agent codes — welcome show, per-turn salutes, tool sparks, milestone celebrations, a finish finale and a dud on failure; each event type has its own fireworks card group with random variants, and token usage decides firework size, height and splendour.
description.zh: 烟花庆祝引擎：agent 编程时漂浮在对话窗口上空放烟花——开场迎宾、回合礼花、工具星花、里程碑大礼、收工终场、失败哑炮，每类事件一张烟花属性卡组，组内多变种随机抽取，token 用量决定烟花的大小、高度与绚烂程度。

description.en: Warm light and dark theme for DSH Web with responsive layout, bilingual settings, safe Markdown preview, per-block copy controls, and no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH Web 暖中性色明暗主题，支持响应式布局、双语设置、安全 Markdown 预览、内容块复制与无遥测运行。

description.en: Dabaifan Arrival Voice Announcements speaks the estimated spend per turn with the bundled Dabaifan voice by default; Alipay is optional. Amounts come from dsh-cost-meter or model-price estimates, not payment records. No runtime TTS service. Code is MIT; the bundled Alipay clips come from Reathin/XVoice (no licence), the Dabaifan voice is a MiMo clone and the icon is a fan-made meme, all for personal, non-commercial use with this plugin only.
description.zh: 大白饭到账语音播报：每轮结束默认用内置大白饭语音提醒本轮估算花费，也可切换支付宝；优先读取 dsh-cost-meter，否则按模型单价估算，不是支付通知，无需联网语音服务。代码 MIT；随包支付宝片段来自无许可证的 Reathin/XVoice、大白饭音色为 MiMo 克隆、图标为网友二创梗图，这些素材仅限随本插件个人非商用。

description.en: Literature research toolset registering 26 model tools over PubMed, Europe PMC, OpenAlex, PubTator3 and Semantic Scholar: field-syntax search, ID conversion, bibliographic lookup, citation formatting, MeSH and related-article walking, PubTator bioconcept resolution and relation queries, Europe PMC and Semantic Scholar paging, full-text retrieval, and open-access PDF discovery with optional download. A unified search deduplicates hits across sources and orders results by cross-source hits, then relevance, then citation count; a session knowledge graph with PubTator concept enrichment commits to a persistent user graph and renders as Mermaid. Most sources need no key.
description.zh: 文献研究工具集，注册 26 个模型工具，覆盖 PubMed、Europe PMC、OpenAlex、PubTator3 与 Semantic Scholar：字段语法检索、ID 互换、残缺引文定位、引文格式化、MeSH 与相关文献追溯、PubTator 生物概念归一与关系查询、Europe PMC 与 Semantic Scholar 翻页检索、全文获取，以及开放获取 PDF 发现（可选下载）。统一检索会跨源去重，排序依次按跨源命中、相关度、被引数；会话知识图谱带 PubTator 概念富集，可提交为持久用户图谱并渲染为 Mermaid。多数数据源无需密钥。

description.en: Add a theme-adjustment panel under Appearance to customize accent, background, foreground, contrast and gradient, applied live through theme token overrides.
description.zh: 在「外观」下增加一个主题调节面板，可自定义强调色/背景色/前景色/对比度/渐变度，并实时生效。

description.en: Markdown conversation theme plugin — 4 built-in themes with light and dark variants, user-editable CSS themes, system-aware auto-switching, an in-browser editor with syntax highlighting and save-time validation, and a theme selection that persists across reloads and tabs. Also ships a version-history panel. Windows and DSH Desktop supported.
description.zh: 对话 Markdown 主题插件——4 套内置主题（浅/深双档）、可自行编辑的 CSS 用户主题、跟随系统自动切换、内置编辑器（语法高亮 + 保存校验）、选中主题在刷新与新标签页后保持，并附带版本台账面板；支持 Windows 与 DSH Desktop。

description.en: Connects the Solmirror open platform to DeepSeek Harness as MCP tools covering image and video generation, a model catalog, cost estimates, reference uploads, result queries and media URLs. Generation jobs submit as native dsh background tasks that notify on completion and run in parallel within one message, with in-chat video playback and an image wall. A settings page takes the platform API key, server URL, per-group model visibility and a test-connection check; the key is stored in the local dsh credential store. Reference uploads (image, video, audio) return reusable ids kept one day unused or three days after last use — 50 MB per file, video up to 30 s, audio up to 60 s. Usage bills platform points at in-site prices, with quotes before a run and automatic refunds on failure. Files passed to upload_reference (jpg/png/webp/gif, mp4/mov/webm, mp3/wav, up to 50 MB) leave your machine: images and videos go straight to Volcengine ImageX/VOD storage with temporary credentials issued by Solmirror, audio through the Solmirror server; its HTTP routes (/plugins/solmirror/...) have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 把瞬镜开放平台的图片、视频生成能力接入 DeepSeek Harness：MCP 工具覆盖模型目录、估价、参考素材上传、文生图/图生图、文生视频/图生视频、结果查询与媒体地址。生成提交为 dsh 原生后台任务，完成自动通知，同一消息内并行执行；对话内视频播放、图片出图墙。设置页配置平台 API 密钥、服务器地址、可见模型组与测试连接，密钥只存本机凭据存储。参考素材（图片/视频/音频）上传一次可复用，未用保留 1 天、用过自最后使用保留 3 天（单文件 ≤50MB，视频 ≤30 秒，音频 ≤60 秒）；按平台价格计积分，生成前可询价，失败自动退款。传给 upload_reference 的文件（jpg/png/webp/gif、mp4/mov/webm、mp3/wav，≤50 MB）会离开本机：图片和视频用瞬镜签发的临时凭证直传火山引擎 ImageX/VOD 存储，音频经瞬镜服务器中转；插件的 HTTP 路由（/plugins/solmirror/…）没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: extracts durable facts from sessions in the background, recalls relevant memories on demand, and keeps a layered summary, a persona snapshot and a commitment ledger; data stays local unless you point it at your own private Git repository.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话记忆：后台从会话中抽取耐久事实，按需召回相关记忆，维护分层摘要、persona 快照与承诺台账；数据默认留在本机，可选同步到自己的私有 Git 仓库。

description.en: Cursor and GitHub PR Review style selection toolbar: quote selected text to chat (Cmd+L), write inline comments (Shift+Cmd+L), and batch-insert from a composer dock.
description.zh: Cursor 与 GitHub PR Review 风格划词引用与批注插件：支持划词一键引用到对话（⌘L）、行内展开写批注（⇧⌘L）及输入框上方批注汇总栏一键插入。

description.en: Bridge DeepSeek Harness agent sessions into Feishu (Lark) chats over the official SDK long connection, with a streaming reply card, many bots per instance, and mention-gated group replies.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 会话接进飞书（Lark）：官方 SDK 长连接收发、流式回复卡片、单实例多 bot、群里 @ 才回复。

description.en: Adds Kimi models to native DSH sessions with per-model selection of the embedded Kimi core or DSH native execution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生会话中接入 Kimi 模型，并按模型选择嵌入式 Kimi 核心或 DSH 原生执行方式。

description.en: Plugin center for VibeDev: describes the official VibeDev plugins and installs them in one click through the plugin manager (inspect, install disabled, then enable, with prerequisites). Also offers a suite install, migration of a renamed package, and a one-click install of the dshmarket plugin market.
description.zh: VibeDev 插件中心：介绍 VibeDev 官方插件，并通过官方插件管理器一键安装（先检查、先不启用地安装、再启用，并带上前置依赖）。另提供套装安装、旧包名迁移，以及一键安装插件市场 dshmarket。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app experts into DSH: a settings-page market scans the local WorkBuddy expert directory (experts land there after you summon them in WorkBuddy) read-only for browsing, search and category filtering, with one-click install (exported to ~/.dsh/experts/ as role prompt + skills + avatar), update and uninstall; a picker capsule next to the input box switches the current session's expert — swapping role prompt, skills and an optional tool whitelist wholesale while keeping full session history, applied at the next model-request boundary.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面端召唤落盘的本地专家带进 DSH：设置页市场只读扫描本地专家目录，卡片浏览/搜索/分类，一键安装（导出到 ~/.dsh/experts/，含角色描述、skills 与头像）、更新与卸载；输入框旁的专家胶囊为当前会话切换专家——整组替换角色描述与 skills（可选工具白名单），保留全部会话历史，在下一个模型请求边界生效。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness - a merge of AirPineApplea/feiyu-memory 4.0.2, dsh-soul-md and dsh-shallow-memory (do not install it alongside those plugins): a diary distilled from finished turns, a hand-written feelings diary, a persona card with version history, a hand-note injected in full every turn, and a short-TTL note layer, each capped separately so per-turn injection stays small; ships agent tools and a sidebar panel for recall, editing, compaction, and backup or restore from a local file, WebDAV or a gzip archive.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的分层长期记忆，合并自 AirPineApplea/feiyu-memory 4.0.2、dsh-soul-md 与 dsh-shallow-memory（请勿与这几个插件同时安装）：从结束的对话自动蒸馏的共度时光日记、手写的情感日记、带版本历史的人设卡、每轮全量注入的人格手记，以及带 TTL 的浅层记忆，各自独立限量以控制每轮注入开销；附带一组智能体工具与侧栏面板，可召回、编辑、压缩，并支持本地文件、WebDAV 与 gzip 整包备份还原。

description.en: Exposes DSH as an MCP server so another agent can watch its thinking, tool calls and file writes in real time, share intent, take a floor lock that denies DSH's write/edit/git tools, inject mid-turn alerts, and delegate reviews.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成一个 MCP server：让另一个 agent 实时看见它的思维、工具调用和文件改动，共享意图，持地板锁期间拒绝 DSH 的 write/edit/git 工具，插入中途提醒，并委托审查。

description.en: Skill-creation console for the Web UI: fetches the official creator skills, hands the requirements to the Huawei Cloud, generic, or REST API creator, then scores the generated skill against a 10-point rubric and returns the itemised deductions to the creator until it reaches 8.5/10.
description.zh: Web 界面上的技能创建面板：拉取官方 creator 技能，把需求交给华为云 / 通用 / REST API 三个 creator 之一执行创建，随后按 10 分制评测产物，未达 8.5 分就把逐项扣分交回 creator 修改直到通过。

description.en: Visualize the DSH process network path on Windows or WSL with layered DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP probes, detect stale proxy configuration, and apply snapshot-guarded repairs.
description.zh: 可视化 DSH 进程在 Windows 或 WSL 上的网络链路（DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP 分层探测），检测失效的代理配置，并提供带快照回滚的安全修复。

description.en: Tencent Yuanbao Search provider for the ctx.web seam: one direct Search API request per query returns portable title, URL, snippet and ISO-8601 date, with credentials resolved per search and no auxiliary model turn. Requires a Tencent Cloud WSA API key.
description.zh: 为 ctx.web 接入腾讯元宝搜索：每次查询只发一次直接检索请求，返回标题、URL、摘要与 ISO-8601 日期，凭证按每次搜索解析，不产生辅助模型轮次；需腾讯云 WSA API Key。

description.en: Git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness — isolate parallel work in its own directory and branch. Ships Fast mode (快速模式).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理 git worktree —— 让并行工作各自隔离在自己的目录与分支里。自带快速模式（Fast mode）。

description.en: Progressive tool discovery through tool_list, tool_search and tool_load, exposing tool schemas on demand while preserving host execution permissions.
description.zh: 通过 tool_list、tool_search 和 tool_load 渐进式发现工具，按需披露工具 schema，保留宿主执行权限约束。

description.en: Drives Windows apps through accessibility controls instead of pixels, with a takeover overlay that frames the window being driven, marks each action with a ghost cursor, and stops on Esc; a browser lane adds sign-in profiles, saved state, and attach-to-my-Chrome. Windows only, and DSH must be run as Administrator for the desktop lane.
description.zh: 用辅助功能接口而不是像素来驱动 Windows 应用：接管浮层只框住被操作的窗口、用虚拟光标标出每一步动作，按 Esc 立即停止；另有一条浏览器通道，支持登录配置、保存状态和接到你自己的 Chrome。仅限 Windows，桌面通道要求 DSH 以管理员身份运行。

description.en: A self-contained second brain for DeepSeek Harness — auto-captures durable dialogue knowledge into a local Markdown vault (custom dedup, CJK search, git-friendly), with a graphical knowledge base and an interactive knowledge graph (legend filter, time-dimension coloring, box-select, merge, delete, PNG export/import).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上自研「第二大脑」：对话结束自动把值得复用的内容沉淀成本地 Markdown 知识卡（自研去重、CJK 检索、可 git 管理），设置页提供图形化知识库 + 交互式知识图谱（图例过滤、时间维、框选、合并、导入导出）。

description.en: English word bank for one or more children, built for DSH 0.2 and newer (0.2.0-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2 verified, including the desktop shell; 0.1.7 through 0.2.x all work). 1.10 added pronunciation: in the memory cards and in the online quiz every word and every example sentence has a speaker button that reads it aloud with the built-in Windows voice - offline, with no network call and no model call - and the whole batch of audio is pre-rendered in the background whenever cards or an exam are generated, so a click starts instantly. 1.11 adds: pick words in bulk straight from the library (10 at a time, top-down, up to 50 selected, with a live counter); turn the words a child got wrong in a quiz into a one-click review set - an online card page that speaks plus a printable PDF; and every card example sentence now carries its Chinese translation underneath. Words marked on textbook or workbook photos (highlighter, red pen) are found by their marks, then translated and stored in a local SQLite bank with an occurrence count; the clipboard picker, the photo route and dictation all land in the same bank. High-frequency words surface by count, three correct answers in a row flag a word as learned, and any selection prints as a memory card set (a word split into chunks, real IPA per chunk, a grade-7 example sentence, a mnemonic hook, an A4 sheet of eight) in HTML, PDF or Word, with a print-and-answer exam page whose four options are set against each other for meaning. On 0.1.5 the settings panel does not appear - install dsh-word-vault@1.0.2 instead.
description.zh: 一个或多个孩子的英语生词库，面向 DSH 0.2 及以上（0.2.0-rc.1 / 0.2.0-rc.2 实测通过，含桌面版 GUI；0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x 均可使用）。1.10 新增语音发音：记忆卡与在线答题页里，每个单词、每句例句旁都有一个 🔊，点了用 Windows 自带语音朗读——离线、不联网、不调模型；出卡/出卷时还会在后台把整批音频预先合成好，点击即秒开。1.11 新增：词库页一键批量选词（每次 +10 个、从上往下、最多同时 50 个，带实时计数）；考试做错的词可一键出成「能发音的在线复习卡」（在线点读页 + 可打印 PDF）；卡面英文例句下方带中文对照。课本/作业照片上被荧光笔或红笔标出的词按标记找出来，翻译后进本机 SQLite，并累计出现次数；剪贴板点选、拍照、对话三种录入进的是同一本库。高频词按次数浮现，连对三次自动标记「已学会」；勾选任意若干词可出记忆卡（拆解块 + 每块真实 IPA 音标 + 7 年级英文例句 + 荒诞梗，A4 每页 8 张），输出 HTML/PDF/Word，并可出一份四选项按词义互斥的打印试卷作答。在 0.1.5 上设置面板不会出现，可改装 dsh-word-vault@1.0.2。

description.en: Turns guard denials, gate failures and human thumb-downs into project lessons, and injects only the rules a human has armed into each new session of that project; it registers no model tools and is reviewed through its settings card.
description.zh: 把拦截拒绝、门禁失败与人工差评沉淀为项目教训，只把人工确认过的规则注入该项目之后的新会话；它不注册模型工具，通过设置卡评审规则。

description.en: AI-native iteration cycle: 24 anic_* tools and 77 HTTP routes that run evaluation, convergence gates, and auto-fix loops across projects, with a live white-box panel (interactive workflow graph, invocation feed, autonomy gauge, gate ledger, HITL queue) and an inline installable SKILL.md workflow kit.
description.zh: AI 原生迭代循环：24 个 anic_* 工具与 77 个 HTTP 路由驱动跨项目评估、收敛门禁与自动修复循环，附带实时白盒面板（可交互工作流图、调用流、自主级仪表带、门禁账本、HITL 队列）与可内联安装的 SKILL.md 工作流套件。

description.en: A judgment core for DeepSeek Harness: a cognition loop that gives every decision a source and attribution and drives planning to a close, hippocampus memory that condenses running experience into knowledge (journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay), judgment identity responsibilities in the architecture (consistent rubric, judgment bound to its source), and an A2A memory-management team via dsh-linghun-assembler. Requires DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7 (rc.2 supported).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的判断内核：认知循环让判断有来处、反馈有归因、规划收口；海马体把运行经历沉淀为可复用知识（序时账留痕、情景归档、低置信降权遗忘）；判分身份职责入架构（口径一致、判据绑定来源）；联动 dsh-linghun-assembler 的 A2A 记忆管理团队。需要 DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7（支持 rc.2）。

description.en: Adds a "Terms" action to finished assistant answers that explains the computer-science terms it detects with Chinese definitions, occurrence counts, highlighted context snippets, and clickable nested explanations from a built-in offline dictionary, with no model calls.
description.zh: 在每条已完成回答的操作条增加「术语」入口，用内置离线词典给出回答中计算机术语的中文释义、提及次数、高亮上下文，并支持点击释义中的术语展开次级解释，不调用模型。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness workbench with model metrics, cost estimates, prompt presets, optional auditing, and context-aware reply suggestions; automatic suggestions default on and may incur API fees.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供指标、费用估算、提示词与可选审计，支持上下文回复候选；自动建议默认开启，可能产生 API 费用。

description.en: A chip at the left end of the composer tool row showing whether DeepSeek bills at peak or off-peak right now. Clicking it opens a card with the current state and rate, the next switch with a countdown, and why this instant is in that state: a weekend, a named statutory holiday, a 调休 make-up workday, or simply outside the peak windows. Times are resolved in Beijing time with an explicit UTC offset, so the verdict does not depend on the machine clock; a hard-coded 2026 Chinese holiday table carries the 33 holiday days and the six 调休 workdays, and a year beyond the table says so instead of guessing.
description.zh: 输入框工具行左端的小胶囊：点一下就知道此刻 DeepSeek 按高峰价还是空闲价计费。点开是当前状态与计费方式、下次切换时间与倒计时，以及此刻为什么是这个状态：周末、具名的法定节假日、调休上班日，或者只是不在高峰时段内。判定用北京时间并显式写死 UTC 偏移，不看本机时钟；内置 2026 年中国法定节假日表（33 天节假日、6 个调休上班日），表外的年份直接说不知道，不猜。

description.en: Renders LaTeX in the chat — formulas inside your own message bubble, plus a live preview of the composer draft while you type.
description.zh: 在聊天里渲染 LaTeX：你自己的消息气泡内联渲染公式，输入时还会实时预览草稿里的公式。

description.en: Hot-switches in-process DSH fetch traffic among direct, manual HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 proxy, and ambient system-proxy modes, with no-proxy rules and optional proxy-environment export for newly spawned child processes.
description.zh: 在直连、手动 HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 代理和环境/系统代理模式间热切换 DSH 进程内 fetch 流量，支持免代理规则，并可为之后启动的子进程导出代理环境变量。

description.en: Early-stage plugin connecting DeepSeek Harness to a separately deployed, self-hosted OwnDsh server for team identity, model access control, quotas, and usage auditing.
description.zh: 早期开发中的团队管理插件，将 DeepSeek Harness 接入独立部署的自托管 OwnDsh 服务端，提供团队身份、模型授权、配额与用量审计。

description.en: Bilibili live-room danmaku for DSH: read live chat, send messages only after explicit confirm, hang out in a room in the background, optionally let the model decide whether to reply, and optionally transcribe stream audio to text; no video understanding. Setup needs a Python 3 venv with the bundled requirements plus Bilibili cookies; transcription additionally needs ffmpeg and a Whisper engine.
description.zh: DSH 的 B 站直播弹幕插件：看弹幕、确认后才发弹幕、挂机听、可选 AI 自动接话与可选语音转写；不抽帧、不做视觉理解。使用前需自建 Python 3 虚拟环境并装好仓库里的 requirements，发弹幕需 B 站凭证；语音转写另需 ffmpeg 与 Whisper 引擎。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language — by default an offline, kinematics-level simulated arm, with a real-robot channel that stays off until it is explicitly enabled. Needs a Python install with numpy and paramiko (pip install -r requirements.txt). Developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）协作机械臂的插件——默认是一台离线、运动学级的仿真机械臂，真机通道在显式开启前始终关闭。需本机 Python 并 pip install -r requirements.txt（numpy、paramiko）。由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研 nUR MCP Server 的同源逻辑开发。（Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.）

description.en: Adds a Matrix-inspired digital-rain startup animation for DeepSeek Harness, a rectangular light portal that opens to both sides, optional replay when the desktop window reopens, and a green UI theme with adjustable hue.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加黑客帝国风格的数字雨开屏动画、向两侧展开的矩形光门、可选的窗口恢复重播，以及可调色相的绿色界面主题。

description.en: Extract CSS themes from URLs, DOCX or PDF; generate, validate and export ColaMD contract themes, and export Markdown to standalone HTML or PDF.
description.zh: 从 URL、DOCX 或 PDF 提取 CSS 主题，生成并校验 ColaMD 契约主题，以及将 Markdown 导出为独立 HTML 或 PDF。

description.en: Per-turn tool-call step budget for Agent Teams teammates, shipped together with the team-dev and team-boot skills.
description.zh: 为 Agent Teams 的 teammate 提供按回合的工具调用步数预算，并随包提供 team-dev 与 team-boot 技能。

description.en: Local Git plus the four GitHub remote tabs in the official DSH right sidebar: Changes (per-file staging, line diffs, and commit messages written by the model already configured in DSH), History, then Code, Issues, Pull requests and Actions proxied by the host half. The token stays in the host half through ctx.credentials and /dsh-git/* accepts loopback requests only.
description.zh: DSH 官方右侧栏里的本地 Git 与四个 GitHub 远端页签：Changes（按文件暂存、逐行 diff、提交信息由 DSH 里已配好的模型生成）、History，以及由 host 半代理的 Code / Issues / Pull requests / Actions。令牌只存在 host 半（ctx.credentials），/dsh-git/* 只接受 loopback 请求。

description.en: Session-level autonomy gears for DSH: a rail on the edge of the conversation area switches P/R/NT/NC/NE/M-/M+/D/A and injects the active gear's behavioral prompt into every request; the model's set_gear tool can only downshift, and handbrake H blocks all tool calls. The set_gear tool can downshift on its own; upshifts need user approval.
description.zh: 会话级行动档位：对话区左缘的滑轨切换 P/R/NT/NC/NE/M-/M+/D/A，并向每条请求注入当前档位的行为提示词；模型的 set_gear 只能降档，手刹 H 拦截全部工具调用。模型的 set_gear 只能自行降档，升档需用户在卡片上批准。

description.en: Provider-first model picker for the composer. Every provider is listed in the left rail and its models in the right pane. Providers, models within a provider, and pins reorder by drag or Alt+Arrow; providers take a local display alias; one provider can be the panel default; a model's reasoning levels expand inline; search matches model names, provider names and aliases. Switching goes through the shipped model directory service, so the /model popup and this panel always agree.
description.zh: 输入框里的供应商优先模型选择器：左栏列出全部供应商，右栏列出选中供应商的模型。供应商、组内模型与收藏都可用拖拽或 Alt+方向键排序；可给供应商起本地显示别名、可指定面板默认供应商；推理档位内联展开；搜索同时匹配模型名、供应商名与别名。切换走官方模型目录服务，/model 弹窗与面板始终一致。

description.en: Aggregated web-search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one prioritized queue over nine providers (AnySearch, TinyFish, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Firecrawl, Jina, SerpApi, Serper), with multi-key rotation per provider, ordered fallback on failed attempts, and a live settings card.
description.zh: 聚合式网页搜索提供方：为内置 web_search 工具提供一条按优先级排序的搜索队列，覆盖 AnySearch、TinyFish、Tavily、Brave、Exa、Firecrawl、Jina、SerpApi、Serper 九家服务，每家支持多把 API Key 轮换，失败时逐级回退，并附带实时生效的设置卡片。

description.en: A Herta theme for DeepSeek Harness: an ASCII boot opening ported from the upstream Herta project, a violet palette of design tokens, swappable wallpapers (four bundled, plus image URL, local import, solid colour or off) and a "Herta Appearance" page in DSH settings. Doubles as the theme that dsh-herta ships with.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的黑塔主题：移植自上游 Herta 项目的开机 ASCII 开场、一整套紫罗兰设计令牌、可替换的壁纸（自带四张，也支持图片网址 / 本机导入 / 纯色 / 关掉），以及 DSH 设置里的「黑塔外观」页。它同时就是 dsh-herta 自带的那套主题。

description.en: Turns a local Obsidian vault into a dedicated RAG chat panel: a sidebar page with the note browser, the retrieval-augmented chat and the cited source side by side, answering from fully local BM25 plus CJK-bigram retrieval over your notes and streaming through the DSH model channel, with clickable \[n] citations and mtime-based incremental indexing.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 仓库变成专属 RAG 对话面板：侧栏一个完整页面，左侧笔记浏览、中间检索增强对话、右侧引用原文；检索用完全本地的 BM25 加中文 bigram，回答走 DSH 模型通道，\[n] 引用可点击，索引按 mtime 增量更新。

description.en: Personal finance plugin for DSH with structured Beancount ledger tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的个人记账插件，基于结构化的beancount账本工具。

description.en: MCP hub for 1C development: keeps 1C:EDT connected through EDT-MCP, starts BSL Language Server with workspace roots on demand, and adds per-project settings, a read-only documentation wiki, model rules and SonarQube/GitLab skills. Requires 1C:EDT 2026.1/2026.2 with EDT-MCP running (default 127.0.0.1:8765).
description.zh: 面向 1C 开发的 MCP 枢纽：通过 EDT-MCP 保持 1C:EDT 连接，按需以工作区根目录启动 BSL Language Server，并提供逐项目设置、只读文档 wiki、模型规则以及 SonarQube/GitLab 技能。需安装 1C:EDT 2026.1/2026.2 并运行 EDT-MCP（默认 127.0.0.1:8765）。

description.en: A desktop dynamic island window for DSH (tested on Windows) that shows whether the agent is thinking, replying, running tools or waiting for approval; expanded, it shows plan progress, context and token usage, and lets you stop the task, approve permission requests and answer the agent's questions, with a separate usage window that estimates cost from DeepSeek's official prices. The island window needs an existing Electron runtime — reused from the dsh-orb plugin's downloaded runtime or pointed to by DSH_ISLAND_ELECTRON — and DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 on Windows; the package neither bundles nor downloads Electron.
description.zh: DSH 桌面灵动岛悬浮窗（Windows 验证）：实时显示 Agent 正在思考、回答、执行工具或等待确认；展开后可查看计划进度、上下文与用量，停止任务、批准权限请求、回答 Agent 的提问；另有用量统计窗口，按 DeepSeek 官方价格估算费用。灵动岛窗口需复用本机已有的 Electron 运行时（沿用悬浮球插件 dsh-orb 下载的运行时，或用 DSH_ISLAND_ELECTRON 指定路径），并要求 Windows 版 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5；安装包不含、也不会自动下载 Electron。

description.en: User Message Timeline - floating pill rail with hover preview, click/drag jump and pagination, switchable left/right.
description.zh: 对话内悬浮药丸导轨：等距药丸、悬停预览、点击/拖拽跳转、分页自动加载，开关在设置-插件-插件配置。

description.en: Multi-market watchlist and portfolio tracker for DSH: a draggable floating capsule with live price and change percent, grouped watchlists for A-share, HK, US and crypto markets with drag-and-drop reordering, position P&L with per-currency totals, target-price alerts with triggered B/S markers, intraday and daily/weekly/monthly candlestick charts, and an optional merged capsule segment for quota-watch; data lives in the DSH instance and is shared across browsers. Quotes come from public Eastmoney, Tencent Finance and OKX endpoints, which receive the symbols you watch; the watchlist and holdings are saved as plain JSON under ~/.dsh, and the /stock-kanban routes have no login check (write routes only require a same-origin request).
description.zh: DSH 多市场盯盘与持仓查看：可拖拽悬浮胶囊显示现价与涨跌幅，A股/港股/美股/加密货币分组自选与拖拽排序，持仓盈亏按币种汇总，目标价触达显示 B/S 标记，分时与日/周/月 K 线；可选与 quota-watch 合并为单枚两段胶囊。数据存 DSH 实例，跨浏览器共享。行情取自东方财富、腾讯财经和 OKX 的公开接口，这些服务会收到你关注的代码；自选与持仓以明文 JSON 存在 ~/.dsh 下，/stock-kanban 路由没有登录校验（写入路由只要求同源请求）。

description.en: Adds an Insight tab next to the conversation and trajectory tabs in DSH: calls a model to interpret tool calls turn by turn, and supports a custom prompt.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话轨迹栏边新增「解读」标签：调用模型分轮次解读工具调用情况；允许自定义提示词。

description.en: Rider-Waite-Smith tarot for DSH with a right-dock table for the Celtic Cross, Waite's alternative and thirty-five-card methods, plain draws, and three- or nine-card layouts; the plugin handles drawing and placement, then turns each card into the conversation for model interpretation from Waite's Pictorial Key.
description.zh: DSH 的莱德-韦特-史密斯塔罗牌插件，在右侧栏提供凯尔特十字、韦特的替代与三十五张牌方法、普通抽牌以及三张牌和九张牌布局；插件负责抽牌与摆放，再将每张翻开的牌逐轮送入对话，由模型依据韦特《塔罗图解》进行解读。

description.en: Tauri 2 desktop application for Windows that detects (or installs) the global @deepseek-ai/dsh package, launches the DSH Web server and embeds it in its own window, with system tray management, login autostart, a global hotkey and desktop shortcuts.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 Tauri 2 桌面应用：检测或自动安装全局 @deepseek-ai/dsh 包，启动 DSH Web 并嵌入自身窗口，支持系统托盘管理、登录自启、全局快捷键与桌面快捷方式。

description.en: Xiao character theme for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop with light and dark palettes, selectable illustrations, a draggable companion, session-state feedback, and optional official DeepSeek balance display.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 与 Desktop 的魈角色主题，提供明暗配色、可切换立绘、可拖动伙伴、会话状态反馈及可选的官方 DeepSeek 余额展示。

description.en: Turn-end quality gate: when the turn edited code or config it walks each file up to its project root, runs that root one check from a fixed whitelist (`pnpm check`, `cargo check`, `ruff check .`, `tsc --noEmit`) and, only if that check really ran and failed, opens a new turn carrying the failure output instead of letting the turn close.
description.zh: 回合收口质量门禁：本回合改过代码或配置时，把改过的文件逐个上溯到项目根，从固定白名单里为该根跑一条检查（`pnpm check` / `cargo check` / `ruff check .` / `tsc --noEmit`）；只有真跑过且失败才带着输出开新轮修复，而不是让回合直接收尾。

description.en: Isolated-environment browser verification skill for DSH plugin development: a throwaway DSH_HOME, its own `verify_<random>` profile, its own port and its own browser instance in one command, cleaned up on exit, so the profile you are actually using is never touched; ships a zero-dependency raw-CDP driver (snapshot / click / screenshot / eval) and an optional isolation audit.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发的隔离环境浏览器验证 skill：一条命令拉起临时 DSH_HOME、独立 `verify_<随机>` profile、独立端口与独立浏览器实例，退出自动清理，不污染正在使用的 profile；自带零依赖 raw-CDP 浏览器驱动（快照 / 点击 / 截图 / 求值）与可选隔离审计。

description.en: Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.
description.zh: 接入 Firecrawl 托管 MCP 服务：免密钥即可使用搜索、抓取与解析（有每日额度），配置 API Key 后解锁完整工具集，含爬取与站点地图。

description.en: Panel hotkeys for the web UI: Enter presses the confirm action and Esc presses the cancel action on every interaction panel (approval, question, plan review).
description.zh: Web UI 面板快捷键：在审批、提问、计划审查等交互面板上，Enter 触发确认操作、Esc 触发取消操作。

description.en: macOS Desktop only: one-click restart of the DeepSeek Harness Electron app. Confirms before interrupting running turns, blocks during plugin install/update, and records restart phases/logs.
description.zh: 仅 macOS 桌面版：一键重启 DeepSeek Harness Electron 应用；重启前确认运行中的任务，插件安装/更新时拒绝，并记录重启阶段与日志。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a provider + model icon in the sidebar for every session, updated live from the composer model selector with a last-request fallback for history sessions; aggregator routes render the provider logo with a 10px model logo in the corner.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏为每个会话显示 provider 与 model 图标，跟随输入框选择器即时更新，历史会话回退到最近一次请求；聚合路由（如 opencode-go、traex）显示 provider 主图并叠加 10px model 小图标。

description.en: Archive manager for DSH Web: list archived sessions in the Settings page and delete them for real, including their log, archive marker, and projection cache.
description.zh: 归档管理：在设置页列出已归档会话，并可真正删除，连同会话日志、归档标记与投影缓存一并清理。

description.en: Official agent skill for the open-source Mole CLI (mo), a disk cleanup tool for macOS and Windows: read disk usage, preview and run cleanup, inspect installed apps, and read system health and cleanup history from Mole's JSON output. It previews with --dry-run and asks before removing anything, and leaves app uninstalls and privileged steps to the user's own terminal. The plugin ships only the skill; the CLI is installed separately.
description.zh: 开源磁盘清理工具 Mole CLI（mo，支持 macOS 和 Windows）的官方 skill：按 Mole 的 JSON 输出查看磁盘占用、预览并执行清理、查看已安装应用、读取系统健康状态和清理记录。清理前先用 --dry-run 预览并征得同意，卸载应用和需要管理员权限的步骤留给用户在自己的终端里执行。插件只带 skill，CLI 需另外安装。

description.en: Adds an auto-hiding icon rail to the collapsed macOS Desktop sidebar, with workspace pinning and flyouts for recent sessions, scheduled tasks, user-installed plugins and account information.
description.zh: 为 macOS Desktop 折叠侧栏添加自动隐藏的图标轨，支持工作区置顶，以及最近会话、定时任务、用户安装插件和账号信息浮层。

description.en: DSH bundle that vendors the full mattpocock/skills tree, preserves upstream invocation policies, and applies an exact-match DSH semantic overlay checked during automatic upstream synchronization.
description.zh: 将完整 mattpocock/skills 技能树打包为 DSH 插件，保留上游调用策略，并在自动同步上游时校验和应用精确匹配的 DSH 语义适配层。

description.en: Plays a voice alert and a browser notification when a turn finishes, asks for input, or fails, and can push the same summary to a Feishu bot webhook as a card.
description.zh: 回合完成、需要你输入或执行失败时播放语音提醒并发送浏览器通知，还可把同样的摘要以卡片推送到飞书机器人 webhook。

description.en: Free literature fetching: give it a DOI, a title or a keyword and it locates the paper, then walks 8 Sci-Hub mirrors first and falls back to Unpaywall open access only when every mirror fails. PDFs are checked for the %PDF- magic bytes and a minimum size, and a clickable manifest is generated for the ones that cannot be fetched. No paid subscription, no API key. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 免费文献下载：给 DOI、标题或关键词就能定位论文，先依次遍历 8 个 Sci-Hub 镜像，全部失败才用 Unpaywall 开放获取兜底。PDF 要过 %PDF- 魔数与最小体积校验，抓不到的论文生成可点击的批量获取清单。不需要付费订阅，也不需要 API Key。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: An offline novel reader: imports .txt and .epub into the right sidebar, shows the chapter being read in a resizable peek window above the composer, and resumes each book at the paragraph and in-paragraph position it was closed at.
description.zh: 离线小说阅读器：把 .txt 与 .epub 导入右侧栏，在输入框上方用一个可缩放大小的速览窗显示正在读的章节，每本书都从关闭时的段落与段内位置继续。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud with Microsoft Edge neural voices and highlights the sentence being spoken, so you can follow along while listening. The highlight is yours to style: background colour, text colour and opacity are each adjustable in settings. Also adds a sound-wave play button to every reply, pause plus previous and next sentence, adjustable speed, and an auto-read toggle.
description.zh: 用微软 Edge 神经音色朗读助手回复，并高亮当前正在朗读的那一句，可以边听边看。高亮样式完全自定义：底色、文字颜色、浓淡三样都能在设置里调。另外每条回复下方有音浪播放键、暂停与上句/下句跳转、语速调节和自动朗读开关。

description.en: Sends Windows system notifications when DSH session turns end, with session titles, elapsed time when observed, optional foreground suppression and subagent filtering. Click a notification to focus the DSH window. DSH must remain running to deliver notifications.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话本轮运行结束时发送 Windows 系统通知，显示会话标题及可观测的运行耗时，支持前台免打扰与子代理过滤。点击通知可将 DSH 窗口拉回前台。接收通知需要 DSH 保持运行。

description.en: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的上下文感知下一句建议：重复 Trigger 可持续换一条，发送前始终由用户确认。

description.en: Whole-disk file search tool backed by the local Everything (voidtools) index: millisecond path queries for the agent over a loopback-only HTTP fast channel with es.exe fallback, plus verified auto-install of the latest stable Everything + ES CLI backend (signature-checked, proxy-aware). Windows only.
description.zh: 基于本机 Everything（voidtools）索引的全盘文件搜索工具：通过仅回环监听的 HTTP 快速通道（es.exe 兜底）为 Agent 提供毫秒级路径查询；后端缺失时自动下载并校验安装最新稳定版 Everything 与 ES CLI（验签名、支持代理）。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Registers the video-studio skill in the DSH skill catalog. It builds a Chinese-narrated video from a script: edge-tts synthesizes the narration, the timeline is derived from each line's measured audio duration rather than estimated from text length, Pillow renders every frame deterministically and pipes the raw frames to ffmpeg as rawvideo, burned-in subtitles and SRT/ASS export come from that same timeline, physical-model sound effects and a generated score are mixed sample by sample with numpy, and QA runs in four layers: container, signal, temporal and page level (the page layer only when the browser engine is used). An optional Playwright-driven browser engine renders the whole film as Canvas2D instead, sending PNG frames through image2pipe. Needs network access for the narration, ffmpeg on PATH and Python with numpy, Pillow and edge-tts; the browser engine also needs Playwright with a local Edge/Chromium.
description.zh: 把 video-studio 技能注册进 DSH 技能目录。它按剧本生成中文旁白视频：edge-tts 合成旁白，时间轴由每条音频的实测时长反推而非按字数估算，Pillow 逐帧确定性渲染并把原始帧以 rawvideo 管道交给 ffmpeg，烧录字幕与 SRT/ASS 外挂字幕由同一条时间轴生成，物理建模音效与程序化配乐用 numpy 采样级混音，质检分容器、信号、时间、页面四层（页面层只在走浏览器引擎时才有）。整片可改用可选的 Playwright 无头浏览器引擎渲染 Canvas2D 画面，帧以 PNG 经 image2pipe 送入编码器。需要联网合成旁白，PATH 上有 ffmpeg，以及装了 numpy、Pillow、edge-tts 的 Python；浏览器引擎还需要 Playwright 与本机 Edge/Chromium。

description.en: WeChat Mini Program dev loop for DeepSeek-Harness: check IDE status, launch the DevTools project, trigger preview and get the QR code straight into the conversation, parse compile errors into file/line/column, and watch it all from a sidebar panel. Six agent tools over the official DevTools CLI — honest about needing a one-time scan-login, never fakes a preview. Requires the Windows WeChat DevTools CLI and a one-time QR login.
description.zh: 小程序开发闭环：查 IDE 状态、启动开发者工具并打开项目、触发预览把二维码直接贴进对话、把编译报错解析成文件/行/列，右栏面板常驻显示状态、二维码与错误清单。六个 agent 工具走官方 DevTools CLI，首次扫码登录的需求如实告知，绝不假装预览成功。需要 Windows 上的微信开发者工具 CLI，并完成一次扫码登录。

description.en: Peak and off-peak billing season in the composer statistics row, right after the cache-hit reading, with a coloured dot, a countdown to the next switch, and a panel that shows the account balance split into total, granted and topped up in the currency the API reports.
description.zh: 在输入框统计行里、缓存命中读数之后显示高峰/非高峰计费时段：状态圆点与切换倒计时，点击展开面板显示按接口返回货币表示的余额，并拆分为总额、赠送与充值。

description.en: Unified plugin marketplace built for the DSH Desktop (EAC) shell, aggregating the curated catalog, the GitHub dsh-plugin ecosystem and the npm registry into one storefront, with source whitelisting, conflict pre-checks, trial-boot install verification, manual/batch/auto updates and .dshpack feature-pack management.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop（EAC）桌面壳的统一插件市场：聚合精选目录、GitHub dsh-plugin 生态与 npm registry 三源，提供来源白名单、冲突预检、试装安装验证、手动/批量/自动三档更新与功能包（.dshpack）管理。

description.en: Compact interface with borderless messages, a light queue, composer controls, and adjustable corners. Built for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only; while enabled it replaces the stock sidebar module, and removing it restores the original.
description.zh: 紧凑界面：无边框消息、轻量队列、输入区控制，以及可调圆角。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2；启用期间会替换官方侧栏模块，移除后恢复原样。

description.en: Split the DSH conversation area into unlimited native panes — side by side, stacked, 2×2 and an automatic grid — each a real session with its own composer, streaming and approvals.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话区拆成任意数量的原生窗格：左右、上下、田字 2×2 与自动网格，每个窗格都是独立会话。

description.en: Collapses the global panel entries above the workspace in the DSH Web sidebar into a single toggle in the sidebar footer.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 侧栏里工作区上方的全局面板入口收成侧栏底部的一个开关。

description.en: Sorts every loaded skill into one or more user-owned workspaces in a right-sidebar tab: each workspace is its own category list plus where every skill sits, categories are created, renamed, reordered and deleted in place, and skills are dragged or picked between them. A first run can let the profile model build the first classification, or place skills into categories the user built first; clicking a row copies its /skill-name and hovering unfolds the description the skill ships.
description.zh: 在右侧栏用一个或多个「工作区」给已加载的 skill 分类：每个工作区有自己的分类表和每个 skill 的归属，分类可就地新建、改名、排序、删除，skill 可拖动或用选择器改归位；首次使用可以让这个 profile 的模型从零分一版，也可以先自己建分类再让模型按分类分配。点击行复制 /skill-name，悬停展开 skill 自带的描述。

description.en: Sessivra: drag sessions into resizable split views, insert native @ references into drafts, exchange linked replies and review delegated work before queued follow-ups. npm package dsh-plugin-sessivra.
description.zh: Sessivra：拖拽会话自由分屏、调宽，拖入草稿插入原生 @ 引用；支持关联回复、共享裁决、验收后继续排队任务及会话树。npm 包名 dsh-plugin-sessivra。

description.en: Self-maintained DSH web task board with a human acceptance gate, card kinds and editable notes on executed cards.
description.zh: 自维护的 DSH 网页任务看板：带人工验收闸门、卡片类型与已执行卡片的可编辑备注。

description.en: Analyzes conversation images through mode-specific prompts (caption, UI, document, grounding, topology, etc.) and injects structured evidence with coordinate primitives (boxes, points, refs) as text, with session-level caching for reuse across replay and compaction.
description.zh: 通过模式化提示分析对话图片（描述、UI、文档、定位、拓扑等），将含坐标原语（框、点、引用）的结构化证据以文本注入上下文，会话级缓存跨回放与压缩复用。

description.en: Composer prompt refinement for DSH: rewrites a rough draft into a structured, unambiguous prompt with one-click undo, reference-chip protection, three model sources (composer / account / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and disconnect-aware cancellation.
description.zh: DSH 输入框提示词优化：把粗糙草稿改写成结构清晰、无歧义的提示词，支持一键撤回、引用芯片保护、三种模型来源与断连即停。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness automatically opens browser plugins and includes a built-in WebView2 program to achieve a lightweight desktop experience.
description.zh: deepseek harness自动打开浏览器插件，内置WebView2程序实现轻量级桌面化。

description.en: DeepSeek balance and usage monitor for DSH: a corner widget showing topped-up balance, per-model period consumption, token breakdown, and a Beijing-time peak/off-peak price reminder. Add a DeepSeek API key in the settings first.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的余额与用量监控：右下角悬浮组件，显示充值余额、按模型的周期消耗、Token 明细，以及北京时间高峰/低谷价格提醒；需先在设置里填入 DeepSeek API key。

description.en: Persona, mood, long-term memory and per-person ledgers for a DSH agent, with a portable soul pack for moving between machines.
description.zh: 给 DSH 里的 AI 装上人设、心情、长期记忆和按人账本，并支持把整套灵魂打包迁移到另一台机器。

description.en: Plugin that turns a XiaoAI (Xiaomi) smart speaker into a voice assistant: hosts the local bridge process, listens for the wake word, runs speech recognition (ASR / STT) on what you say, keeps the conversation in the host session, and speaks the answer back through the speaker with text-to-speech (TTS) playback.
description.zh: 把小爱音箱（小爱同学 / 小米智能音箱）接成语音助手的插件：托管本地桥接器进程，听到唤醒词就收音、做语音识别（ASR / STT），把对话交给 DSH 会话，再用语音合成（TTS）把答案念回音箱播报。

description.en: Read-only GitHub pull request and release workspace for DSH with diffs, comments, CI checks and local review drafts. Reads GitHub through the GitHub CLI, which must be installed and signed in with gh auth login.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中只读查看 GitHub 拉取请求与发布状态，浏览差异、评论和 CI 检查，并保存本地评审草稿。所有 GitHub 读取都经由 GitHub CLI，需先安装并执行 gh auth login 登录。

description.en: Windows shell takeover: replace the default pwsh tool with a configurable multi-client shell tool (git bash, WSL, cmd, pwsh, custom paths), with a deny blacklist and automatic fallback.
description.zh: Windows shell 接管：把默认 pwsh 工具替换为可配置多客户端 shell 工具（git bash/WSL/cmd/pwsh、自定义路径），deny 黑名单与失败自动回退官方链。

description.en: Read-only GitHub access for agents, wrapping several tools. Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally, and tries network proxies on its own. That cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitHub, and the overhead of it repeatedly trying different approaches.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的只读 GitHub 访问，封装多个工具。在工具内部自动探测与选择本地可用的 GitHub 访问设施，并自动尝试网络代理。减少 Agent 在访问 GitHub 时可能遇到的网络问题或解析问题，减少 Agent 频繁尝试不同方案的开销。

description.en: Captures and compares single-token behavioral fingerprints of configured DSH model routes using the One Token Is Enough protocol.
description.zh: 使用《One Token Is Enough》论文协议，对 DSH 已配置的模型路由采集并比较单 token 行为指纹。

description.en: A real Chrome or Edge for the agent to work in, mirrored in the sidebar so you can watch and take over: every conversation gets its own browser process, with its own profile and its own CDP port, so sign-ins never leak between conversations. It drives the Chrome or Edge already on the machine, downloads no browser, needs no companion app or extension, and another Playwright or DevTools can attach to the same CDP port while the sidebar is live.
description.zh: 让 agent 在一台真实 Chrome 或 Edge 里干活，侧栏同步镜像，你能看着，也能随时接手：每个对话一台独立的浏览器进程，各自的 profile 与 CDP 端口，登录态不会在对话之间串。它驱动机器上已有的 Chrome 或 Edge，不下载浏览器，不需要配套应用或扩展；侧栏镜像开着时，另一个 Playwright 或 DevTools 也能附加到同一个 CDP 端口。

description.en: Layered memory for AI agents: five verbs (wake/work/pit/tomb/close), core layer read every time, archive on demand. Plain markdown, four pages created on first run; survives restarts, model swaps and plugin removal.
description.zh: 守链：给 AI agent 的分层记忆——五个动词（醒来/干活/遇坑/立碑/收工），核心层每次读、档案层按需查；首次运行自动建四页，纯 markdown、无数据库；重启、换模型、拔插件后记忆还在、判断还接得上。

description.en: Daily game automation on Windows for Genshin Impact, Honkai Impact 3, Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero: a scheduled task per game drives BetterGI, the game-daily skill family, March7thAssistant or ZenlessZoneZero-OneDragon, with per-game switches, a foreground guard, in-run supervision that only steps in on trouble, and one report session per game that later results are appended to. Requires the DSH desktop app and the matching external engine installed.
description.zh: Windows 上的原神 / 崩坏3 / 崩坏：星穹铁道 / 绝区零日常自动化：每个游戏一个计划任务，分别驱动 BetterGI、game-daily 技能族、三月七助手或绝区零「一条龙」；带逐游戏开关、前台守护、只在出问题时介入的运行期值守，以及每游戏固定一个汇报会话、后续结果追加进去。需要 DSH 桌面端，并预先安装对应外部引擎。

description.en: Keyboard-driven quick switching for DSH — model palette with colored provider tags, suffix tags and pins, a two-column session palette with per-question prompt preview and archived-session restore, recency-ordered session cycling, find-next-answered jump, composer focus, and configurable permission cycling, managed from a sidebar control panel.
description.zh: 键盘驱动的快速切换：模型面板（彩色提供方标签、后缀与推理标签、置顶）、两栏会话面板（提问预览、归档会话恢复）、按活动时间顺序的会话循环、查找下一个已回答的会话、聚焦输入框、可配置的权限循环，侧栏控制面板统一管理开关与改键。

description.en: Cross-session and cross-project long-term memory: a non-blocking silent sedimentation dispatch on turn/end writes into a local SQLite store (FTS5 trigram full-text index with insert/update/delete sync triggers) that later turns recall from; entries are scoped per project alongside a global tree, and the plugin ships its own embedded web dashboard (it starts the HTTP server itself, no separate process) for browsing, graphing and controlled deletion.
description.zh: 跨会话、跨工程的长期记忆：turn/end 时非阻塞派发无感静默沉淀，写入本机 SQLite（FTS5 trigram 全文索引，含增删改同步触发器）供后续回合召回；记忆按项目作用域与全局树分层存储，并自带内嵌 Web 看板（插件自身起 HTTP 服务，非独立进程）用于浏览、图谱与受控删除。

description.en: Cherry Studio-style paste: multi-line/indented/fenced text or code pasted into the DSH Web composer collapses into a bordered, collapsible, language-tagged card and is restored as a fenced code block on send.
description.zh: Cherry Studio 式粘贴：把多行/缩进/围栏文本或代码粘进 DSH Web 输入框时收成带边框、可折叠、带语言标签的卡片，发送时还原为围栏代码块。

description.en: Codex-shaped coding tools and agent presets for GPT models on DeepSeek Harness: exec_command, write_stdin, apply_patch and view_image, plus OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses API routes, bridged to DSH-native plan, ask, approval and compaction. Long-running commands become DSH background jobs with bounded head/tail output readable through job_output, and each subagent type can be pinned to its own preset, provider, model and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 上 GPT 模型的 Codex 风格编码工具与 agent 预设：exec_command、write_stdin、apply_patch、view_image，以及 OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Responses API 两条路由，并桥接 DSH 原生的计划、提问、审批与压缩。长命令注册为 DSH 后台作业，输出首尾有界，可用 job_output 读取；每种子代理类型可独立指定 Preset、Provider、Model 与 Reasoning effort。

description.en: Scales the whole DeepSeek Harness interface from 50% to 200%, menus and pop-ups included, set from Settings - General with a slider, a percent field or presets. Works in dsh web and the desktop app, which has no zoom of its own.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 整个界面（包括菜单和弹窗）缩放到 50% 至 200%，在「设置 - 通用设置」中用滑块、百分比输入或预设调整。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用，桌面应用本身没有缩放功能。

description.en: Local media library management and playback powered by dsh Web: responsive on PC and mobile with touch swipe reels, instant seeking and on-the-fly transcoding.
description.zh: 基于 dsh 内置 Web 服务管理、浏览与播放本地媒体库，完美适配 PC 与移动端，支持手势上下滑动刷视频、即时拖拽秒播与实时转码。

description.en: Below 1024px the sidebar collapses to a 44px floating square and expands into a 280px overlay drawer; picking a session collapses it again and the focus grab that would raise the soft keyboard after a session switch is suppressed.
description.zh: 窄屏下侧栏收起为左上角 44 像素悬浮方块、展开为 280 像素覆盖式抽屉，点会话自动收起，并压掉切会话时自动抢焦点导致的软键盘顶起。

description.en: Registers Mol* file viewers with dsh-better-sidebar for PDB, mmCIF, MRC maps, small molecules and Chimera .cmm markers, including .gz, with a BioViewer workspace tab and bio_open / bio_add tools.
description.zh: 向 dsh-better-sidebar 注册 Mol* 文件预览器，支持 PDB、mmCIF、MRC 密度图、小分子和 Chimera .cmm 标记（含 .gz），并提供 BioViewer 工作区标签以及 bio_open / bio_add 工具。

description.en: Select text in any Windows app and read the translation in an always-on-top card next to the cursor: streaming text follows the newest line, up to 15000 characters per request. Windows only.
description.zh: 在任意 Windows 应用里划词，鼠标旁弹出只含译文的置顶卡片；译文流式出现并跟随最新一行，单次上限 15000 字。仅 Windows。

description.en: Delegates self-contained coding subtasks to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Agent SDK and returns the result to the host session. Nineteen per-call parameters control model, thinking effort, permission mode, allowed tools, turn count and budget cap; background jobs return a jobId immediately and stream incremental output; the result carries a session handle that can be passed back as resume to continue the same conversation; commands expected to run past ~20 seconds go through the built-in mcp__dsh__shell channel, which streams output line by line without consuming model context; a Claude Code monitor panel in the session lists jobs, renders the structured process, shows live output blocks and cancels a run; the delegation procedure ships as a runtime-registered skill, so installing the plugin installs the skill.
description.zh: 把自包含的编码子任务委派给本机 Claude Code（官方 Agent SDK 驱动），结果回传主会话：19 个参数可按次控制模型、思考强度、权限模式、允许工具、轮次与预算上限；后台作业立即返回 jobId 并支持增量读取；结果附会话句柄，传回 resume 即可在同一会话续跑；预计超过 20 秒的命令经内置 mcp__dsh__shell 通道逐行实时输出，不占用模型上下文；会话内附 Claude Code 监控面板（任务列表、结构化过程视图、实时输出块、一键取消）；委派规程以运行时技能注册，安装插件即安装技能。

description.en: Shows per-turn and session costs, provider/model breakdowns, subscription usage and the signed-in DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar.
description.zh: 展示每轮及会话费用、渠道/模型明细和套餐用量，并在侧栏显示已登录的 DeepSeek 账号余额。

description.en: Audio tools for DSH: inspect audio/video files, transcode or extract the audio track from a video, trim and normalize, and transcribe speech with local whisper.cpp or an OpenAI-compatible API. Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH (not bundled); local transcription also needs a whisper-cli binary and a ggml model.
description.zh: DSH 音频工具：查看音频/视频信息、转码、从视频提取音轨、裁剪与响度归一化，并用本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口把语音转成文字和字幕。需要本机已装 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe（插件不自带）；本地转写还需 whisper-cli 与 ggml 模型。

description.en: Multi-channel push notification plugin supporting Bark (iOS) and ntfy (Android/iOS/Web/Desktop) for turn completion, approvals, questions, and quota halts.
description.zh: 多渠道推送通知插件，支持 Bark (iOS) 与 ntfy (全平台)，覆盖回合结束、操作授权、交互提问及额度耗尽异常停机。

description.en: Running pace calculator: converts distance and time to min/km pace and km/h speed.
description.zh: 跑步配速计算：根据距离与时间换算配速（分/公里）与速度（公里/小时）。

description.en: Archive, unarchive, and delete sessions from a settings page.
description.zh: 在设置页中归档、恢复并删除会话。

description.en: Search Nyaa anime releases with quality and Chinese subtitle checks, manage scheduled tracking and qBittorrent delivery, and browse Bangumi lists with manual progress sync (dsh-find-anime). Needs Python 3.11 or newer on PATH.
description.zh: dsh-find-anime：按画质与中文字幕要求搜索 Nyaa 动漫资源，管理定时追番与 qBittorrent 下载，浏览 Bangumi 番单并手动同步进度。需要 PATH 里有 Python 3.11 及以上版本。

description.en: DSH project scaffold preset: strict 5-phase init runbook, engineering standards and six runnable starter templates (node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo).
description.zh: DSH 项目初始化脚手架预设：严格 5 阶段初始化流程 + 工程规范 + 六套可运行模板（node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo）。

description.en: Design-fidelity QA for text-only models: a `deepseek_vision` tool borrows an eye from any OpenAI-compatible vision route, so the model can judge whether an implementation matches its mock — shipped with the benchmark behind that judgement (four fixtures, 23 injected defects, raw transcripts) and the questioning discipline it depends on.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的设计稿保真判定：`deepseek_vision` 工具从任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉路由借来一只眼，让模型判断实现与设计稿是否一致——并附上支撑该判定的基准（4 组夹具、23 处注入缺陷、逐格原始输出）与其依赖的提问纪律。

description.en: Task reliability: auto-retry on model timeouts/failures, auto-continue unfinished tasks, completion verification, thinking-repeat interruption, resume after sleep or restart, autopilot mode and a remote trigger endpoint (npm: `dsh-task-reliability`).
description.zh: 任务可靠性：模型超时/请求失败自动重试、任务未完成自动继续、独立完成度校验、思考重复检测打断、休眠/重启后任务自动恢复、自主决策模式、远程触发接口（npm: `dsh-task-reliability`）。

description.en: Agent skill and tool for querying multi-platform model account balances: DeepSeek, Doubao / Volcengine, Qwen / Alibaba Cloud, Hunyuan / Tencent Cloud, and custom HTTP endpoints. Read-only, with 60s cache.
description.zh: 多平台余额 Agent 技能与工具：查询 DeepSeek、豆包 / 火山引擎、千问 / 阿里云百炼、混元 / 腾讯云以及自定义 HTTP 接口的账户余额；只读，内置 60 秒缓存。

description.en: Two-way WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness via the iLink protocol: bind your personal WeChat with a QR scan and chat with a local DSH agent from the chat box (text, images, voice-to-text, files); a web settings panel handles binding/start/stop/status, project-session binding continues the conversation on desktop, proactive wechat_notify pushes include throttling, and the pure-Node daemon runs on Windows/macOS/Linux.
description.zh: 基于 iLink 协议的 DSH 微信双向桥：扫码绑定个人微信后在聊天框直接与本机 DSH Agent 对话（文字/图片/语音转文字/文件），Web 设置面板管理扫码绑定/启停/状态，支持绑定项目会话跨端续聊，agent 可主动 wechat_notify 推送（内置节流），纯 Node 守护进程，Windows/macOS/Linux 三端通用。

description.en: Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversations into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, from a settings-page UI.
description.zh: 从设置页把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端对话导入为 DeepSeek Harness 会话，导入后可在其中继续对话。

description.en: Billing-period and balance pill under the DSH composer: it shows the account balance and the current conversation cost alongside the peak/off-peak state and a countdown to the next switch. The peak/off-peak rules cover China statutory holidays and weekends, and the conversation cost is measured as the decrease in account balance between the plugin's 60-second idle balance refreshes.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的计费时段与余额药丸：常显账户余额与本次对话花费，并显示峰价/谷价档位与距下次切换的倒计时。峰谷判定含中国法定节假日与周末；本次对话花费按余额差值记账，采样点是插件自带的「对话停止满一分钟后刷新余额」。

description.en: Windows 2000 desktop skin for the DSH Web GUI: metric-accurate grey chrome, two-tone gradient title bars, 1px bevels, square corners, 16px scrollbars, and the pixel font it renders with served by its own host route.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 换上 Windows 2000 桌面外观：按度量表还原的灰色控件、双色渐变标题栏、1px 立体边框、直角、16px 滚动条，以及由插件自身路由提供的点阵字体。

description.en: One chip in the composer dock: the account balance plus what the current chat has cost, priced per turn at the tariff in force when each turn ran. Clicking it opens a 264px card in the panel style of the host, with refresh and settings buttons.
description.zh: 输入框下方一枚芯片：显示账户余额与当前对话花费，花费按每轮发生时刻的峰谷档位逐段计价。点击展开 264px 卡片，沿用宿主自带面板的样式，带刷新与设置两个按钮。

description.en: AI-for-Science research workflow skill for DeepSeek Harness, aimed at researchers and grad students using agentic AI: multi-angle literature review with per-angle files, experiment design with a caveat list, figures and paper reading; each job returns files plus a cross-verification brief for a second model. Zero deps, MIT.
description.zh: AI4S 科研工作流技能包，面向 AI for Science 与研究生/科研 Agent 用户：多角度文献调研（每角度落盘）、实验方案（含漏洞清单）、作图与精读；每单交付文件，附交叉验证任务书。零依赖，MIT。

description.en: Whole-disk file search on Windows: ask for files or folders by name, path, extension, size or modified date and get matches from the local voidtools Everything index in milliseconds, with full paths, sizes and modified times. A second card reports whether Everything is reachable and how many items it indexes. Ships the official Everything SDK, so no es.exe or HTTP server is needed; Everything 1.4+ must be installed and running (the plugin can start it).
description.zh: Windows 全盘文件搜索：按文件名、路径、扩展名、大小或修改时间检索，毫秒级从本机 voidtools Everything 索引返回匹配的文件与文件夹（完整路径、大小、修改时间）；另一张卡片显示 Everything 是否可达与索引条目数。内置官方 Everything SDK，不需要 es.exe 或 HTTP 服务；需安装并运行 Everything 1.4 以上（插件可自动拉起）。

description.en: Access the dsh web UI over LAN: HTTP/HTTPS/WS forwarding plus TLS (self-signed or custom certificates); adaptive Brotli/gzip compression for HTTP and permessage-deflate for WebSocket; half-open WebSocket probing keeps mobile clients from going stale after backgrounding; launch-token auto-injection lets LAN devices connect without copying the token; DNS-rebinding protection + loopback-only upstream allowlist. Retired by the author: published npm versions stay installable but receive no further DSH adaptations (migration guide: docs/migrations/dsh-lan-proxy.md in the repository).
description.zh: 局域网访问 dsh web UI：HTTP/HTTPS/WS 转发 + TLS（自签名/自定义证书）；HTTP 自适应 Brotli/gzip 与 WebSocket permessage-deflate 双压缩；WS 半开探活，移动端切后台不僵死；启动令牌自动注入，LAN 设备免手工拿 token；DNS 重绑定防护 + 回环-only 上游白名单。作者已退役：已发布的 npm 版本仍可安装，但不再适配新版 DSH（迁移说明见仓库 docs/migrations/dsh-lan-proxy.md）。

description.en: A persistent translate button lives in every page the browser opens: click it and every visible text node is replaced in place, click again to restore. Hold to drag, drop it near an edge and it tucks into a small handle; it is re-injected automatically after navigation. The host LLM service does the translation — the plugin holds no API key.
description.zh: 给内置浏览器的每一张页面常驻一个「🈯 译」按钮：点一下，页面上每个可见文本节点原地换成译文；再点一下回到原文。长按可拖动，拖到左右边缘自动吸成贴边小把手；页面导航后自动重装。翻译走宿主模型服务 —— 插件不持有任何 API key。

description.en: Views, creates and edits AGENTS.md and other AI rule files from the DSH settings page: the project directory chain from project root to cwd, both DSH global roots (~/.dsh and ~/.agents), and user-level rule files of 25 third-party AI tools. Markdown preview is rendered with .mdc frontmatter stripped, edits save in place with conflict detection, files whose content is identical across tools are flagged, and tools outside the built-in list are discovered heuristically. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页查看、创建与编辑 AGENTS.md 等 AI 规则文件：项目级跟随工作区从项目根到 cwd 的目录链，全局级覆盖 ~/.dsh 与 ~/.agents，另含 25 个第三方 AI 工具的用户级规则文件。预览以渲染态展示并自动剥离 .mdc 的 frontmatter，就地编辑并带冲突检测，内容完全相同的跨工具文件会互相标注，内置清单之外的工具按目录特征自动发现。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Keep SSH, WSL and Docker projects in the native DSH sidebar. Group directories by environment while choosing full remote DSH or lightweight local Agent mode per project. Manage shared full-backend connections together, keep lightweight connections independent, and selectively sync local Skills with difference previews. Aimed at the Windows desktop client with Linux, WSL or Linux-container remotes that have Python 3 and Bash (macOS and Linux hosts untested); lightweight SSH needs an existing SSHFS mount, and Docker has not yet been run against a live daemon.
description.zh: 在当前 DSH 窗口的原生侧栏中管理 SSH / WSL / Docker 项目。目录按环境归组，每个项目独立选择全量远程后端或本机 Agent 轻量模式；共享全量连接统一管理，轻量连接独立控制，并可比较、选择性同步本机 Skill。主要面向 Windows 桌面客户端与装有 Python 3、Bash 的 Linux / WSL / Linux 容器远端（macOS / Linux 本机未实机验证）；轻量 SSH 需已有 SSHFS 挂载，Docker 尚未在真实守护进程上验收。

description.en: Modellix integration for DSH: schema-driven image, video and audio generation in a split Design workspace, a live LLM model catalog, and native web search and fetch providers through one API key.
description.zh: 将 Modellix 接入 DSH：使用一个 API Key 在分栏 Design 工作区中提供基于 Schema 的图片、视频与音频生成、实时 LLM 模型目录，以及原生网页搜索与抓取 Provider。

description.en: OpenSpec spec-driven workflows for DeepSeek Harness, generated from OpenSpec 1.14.3: twelve /opsx-* slash commands that carry the workflow prompt plus the arguments you type, and twelve openspec-* skills the model loads on its own.
description.zh: 把 OpenSpec 的规格驱动工作流接入 DeepSeek Harness，内容由 OpenSpec 1.14.3 生成：12 个 /opsx-* 斜杠命令会把工作流提示词与你输入的参数一起注入会话，另有 12 个由模型自行加载的 openspec-* 技能。

description.en: Remote host tunnel manager: runs dsh web on a remote Linux server (systemd supervision, no root needed) behind an auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel; allocates and registers remote ports on the server, multi-user safe, with an audit view.
description.zh: 远程主机隧道管理器：把 dsh web 跑在远程 Linux 服务器上（systemd 守护、免 root），本地经自动重连的 SSH 隧道访问；远程端口自动分配并在服务器登记留档，支持多人共用与 audit 审查。

description.en: A conversation-view tab for DeepSeek Harness Web showing solar/lunar dates, ganzhi year/month/day, Chinese zodiac, 24 solar terms, festivals, China public holidays including make-up workdays, multi-city weather, an epoch↔date timestamp converter with a time-zone picker, and bundled offline "on this day" history from free sources without an API key.
description.zh: 会话页头的「熊猫日历」标签页：公历/农历、干支、生肖、24 节气、传统与外国节日、中国法定节假日（含调休）、多城市天气、时间戳转换（秒/毫秒 ↔ 年月日时分秒，可选时区）与内置离线的「历史上的今天」，数据免费、无需 API Key。

description.en: Consult multiple expert advisor models in a retro CRT chat-group card: one ask_advisors call runs an auto-deepen pipeline (driver deep-question, advisor relay, synthesis conclusion) with SSE streaming, 26 provider presets, a configurable daily quota, stop/resume, and optional advisor tool calling.
description.zh: 主模型在专业/长尾/高风险或不确定问题上召集多个专家顾问模型，以复古 CRT 聊天组卡片展示：一次 ask_advisors 自动跑满自动深挖流水线（驱动模型追问、顾问接力、综合结论），真流式 SSE、26 个供应商预设、可配置每日配额、停止/继续，以及可选的顾问工具调用。

description.en: Session-local scheduled tasks: inject a prompt into the current session after a delay, at a fixed time, or on a repeating interval, so the model wakes up and runs it on time. Manage them from a panel above the composer, the /schedule command, or seven model-facing tools. Timers freeze while DSH is closed and never auto-resume; pause keeps the remaining time, so resuming continues from where it stopped.
description.zh: 会话内定时任务：按延迟、固定时刻或重复间隔向当前会话注入一段提示词，到点唤醒模型执行。可用输入框上方面板、/schedule 命令、或 7 个面向模型的工具管理。DSH 关闭期间计时冻结、绝不自动恢复；暂停保留剩余时间，恢复后从原处继续。

description.en: Adds a Batch Uninstall page to the DSH settings dialog: a checklist of every installed bundle with multi-select, select-all, a confirmation dialog and per-plugin progress, where official bundles stay locked and each removal goes through the host pluginManager service.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增「批量卸载」页面：勾选多个已安装插件批量移除，支持全选、二次确认与逐条进度，官方 bundle 自动锁定，删除统一走宿主 pluginManager 服务。

description.en: Terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness with local VS Code JSON/JSONC theme import, inherited terminal background effects, mouse text selection, structured tool and diff views, Session/Profile/plugin management, and Skill/MCP browsers.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的终端工作区，支持导入本地 VS Code JSON／JSONC 主题、继承终端背景效果、鼠标文本选择、结构化工具与 Diff 视图、Session／Profile／插件管理，以及 Skill／MCP 浏览。

description.en: Adds a Forget action to every session row menu, confirmed by a second click in the menu, that removes the session from the sidebar and from disk: running work is stopped, workspace, archive and pin records are detached through official channels, the log directory and projection-cache entries are deleted, and a revive guard re-deletes anything a late write or a lingering handle recreates; memories, attachments and other sessions are left alone.
description.zh: 在会话行菜单加入「遗忘会话」（菜单内二次点击确认），把会话从侧栏与磁盘彻底移除：先停掉正在运行的工作，经官方通道解除工作区、归档与置顶记录，删除日志目录与投影缓存条目，并由复活守卫在一个窗口内补删迟到写入或句柄残留重建的文件；灵枢记忆、附件与其他会话不受影响。

description.en: Manage agent-team roles in the dsh Web GUI: each role becomes its own selectable agent preset with per-role tool, skill and MCP switches.
description.zh: 在 dsh 的 Web GUI 里管理 agent team 角色：每个角色是一枚独立可选的 agent preset，按角色开关工具、技能与 MCP。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reader for CSV/TSV/PSV files and xlsx/xlsm workbooks: a sortable, filterable table with sheet tabs. Ceilings on rows, columns and cells, plus two zip-container gates, keep an input from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的表格读取视图：读取 CSV/TSV/PSV 与 xlsx/xlsm 工作簿，表头可点击排序、可按子串筛选，多工作表以标签切换。行数、列数与单元格数均有上限，另有两道 zip 容器闸门，任何输入都不会卡死标签页。

description.en: Dockable DSH Web UI layout that organizes conversations as tabs across draggable split groups.
description.zh: 可停靠的 DSH Web UI 布局插件，将对话组织为标签页，并支持拖拽拆分对话分组。

description.en: Host-side orchestrator for DSH agent teams. Every turn it injects an 11-section orchestration methodology into the system prompt and backs it with a counting tool-layer gate, so parallel dispatch, task-board tracking, cross-session handoff, employee-pool reuse and preset routing become the default in any preset and any session instead of something you have to ask for. The gate counts real dispatches (subagent / subagent_fork / spawn_teammate) rather than words: a todo listing N unmarked items only needs the base threshold, items explicitly marked as parallel must be launched in one batch up to a configurable cap, and a genuine single-step task is exempt by writing one marker. Read-only tools (read, glob, grep, context-management tools) are never gated. Team members are woken up and reused before new ones are hired, and subagents are reserved for work that must run under a specific preset. Local-only settings (preset routes, domain keywords, profile name, active tier) live in <DSH_HOME>/team-orchestrator.local.json and never ship inside the package. Status is exposed on a loopback-only HTTP route. Zero telemetry, no hosted service, no account. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
