description.zh: DSH 智能体团队的宿主端编排器。每轮把 11 节编排方法论注入系统提示，并配一层按真实派活次数计数的工具层硬门，让并行派活、任务板追踪、跨会话交接、员工池复用与预设路由在任何预设、任何会话里都是默认行为，而不是每次都要你特意要求。硬门只数真的派出去了几次（subagent / subagent_fork / spawn_teammate），不看你嘴上怎么说：todo 里列 N 条但没有并行标记时只要求基础门槛，明确标了并行的条目必须在同一批里一次派满（上限可配），真·单步任务写一个标记即可免派。只读工具（read、glob、grep 及上下文管理类工具）永不被拦。先唤醒并复用已有团队成员，不够才新增，subagent 只留给必须在某个专用预设下执行的任务。本机专属配置（预设路由表、业务域关键词、profile 名、当前挡位）外置在 <DSH_HOME>/team-orchestrator.local.json，从不随包发布。状态只在本机回环 HTTP 路由上暴露。零遥测、无托管服务、无需账号。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Hand-drawn mountain-lake pastoral theme with continuous local-time day/night scenes and a farmer who works while the displayed conversation is running. Architecture reference: xikan0/dsh-outerwilds-theme.
description.zh: 手绘山湖田园主题：按本地时间连续呈现晨昏昼夜，并让农人随当前展示对话的任务运行状态进出田间。插件架构参考 xikan0/dsh-outerwilds-theme。

description.en: Database access for DeepSeek Harness through the DBHub MCP server: configure MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite and SQL Server connections per workspace and environment, then let the agent configure, list, query and search SQLite objects through four fixed tools. Passwords and full connection strings are entered in the settings UI and never accepted as tool arguments, so the model only sees metadata such as mysql://host:3306/db; each environment can be read-only (the model may enable it but not clear it) or reached through a manual SSH tunnel. Every call runs its own short-lived dbhub process and dbhub installs itself when missing.
description.zh: 把 DBHub MCP 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness 的数据库插件：按工作区 × 环境配置 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQLite 与 SQL Server 连接，让 Agent 通过固定 4 个工具配置连接、列出数据源、执行 SQL、搜索 SQLite 对象。密码与完整连接串由用户在设置界面输入、不作为工具参数接收，模型只看到 mysql://host:3306/db 这类元数据；每个环境可设为只读（模型只能开启、不能关闭）或经手动 SSH 隧道访问。每次调用独立启动一条用完即退的 dbhub 进程，未安装 dbhub 时自动安装。

description.en: Installs a dedicated AI novel-writing preset and workbench: revisioned local project assets, a compact side drawer, and native approval-gated single-file changes.
description.zh: 安装专用 AI 小说创作预设与工作台：提供带修订号的本地项目资产、紧凑侧边工作台，以及需要原生审批的逐文件变更。

description.en: Git server: embeds ts-gogs (a TypeScript reimplementation of Gogs) and serves a full Git service on its own port — HTTP clone/push, web UI, issues/PRs/wiki — reusing user-management credentials, start/stop from the settings page.
description.zh: Git 服务器：内嵌 ts-gogs（Gogs 的 TypeScript 平替），独立端口跑完整 Git 服务（HTTP clone/push、网页端、issue/PR/wiki），可复用 user-management 的用户名密码，设置页一键启停。

description.en: Right-sidebar Git review panel for DSH: staged and unstaged change tree, inline and side-by-side diffs, stage/unstage/discard, commit and push, AI-generated commit messages, and line blame. A fork of sadgsk/dsh-review-panel 0.3.1; install either this or the upstream panel, not both.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Git 审查面板：暂存 / 未暂存改动树、内联与左右并排 diff、暂存 / 取消暂存 / 放弃更改、提交与推送、AI 生成提交信息、行级 Blame。本条目是 sadgsk/dsh-review-panel 0.3.1 的 fork，与上游面板不能同时安装。

description.en: Persistent Endeavour and Challenger peer sessions for DeepSeek Harness that plan, execute sequential tasks, and verify reported results.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻的 Endeavour 与 Challenger 对等会话：负责规划、按序执行任务，并核验汇报的结果。

description.en: Installation safety gate for DSH plugins: antivirus-style scan of install scripts, permissions, secrets and network callbacks on local directories or npm tarballs, returning a BLOCK/WARN/PASS verdict before "dsh plugin add".
description.zh: DSH 插件的安装安全闸门：在 "dsh plugin add" 前对本地目录或 npm 包做"杀毒"式扫描（安装脚本、权限、密钥、网络回连），给出 BLOCK/WARN/PASS 判定。

description.en: Native DSH tools for playing Stronghold Protocol solo games over the game site's WebSocket connection, with compact state views, explicit actions and public card lookups.
description.zh: 通过游戏站原生 WebSocket 连接进行 Stronghold Protocol 单人对局的 DSH 工具，支持紧凑局面查看、明确动作执行和公开卡牌查询。

description.en: Three switchable low-glare themes (Warm Paper, Sage Green, Warm Grey) for the DeepSeek Harness GUI, each a full alias-token layer with a light and a dark face.
description.zh: 三套可切换的低刺激护眼配色（暖纸、豆绿、暖灰），每套都是完整的别名 token 层，含浅色与深色两副面貌。

description.en: Runs the standalone opencode2api backend (jasonxu114514/opencode2api, Windows x64/ARM64, no Docker or OpenCode CLI) with DSH and on exit stops only the process it launched; its settings card installs, updates or rolls back the backend from checksum-verified GitHub releases, copies the initial admin password and syncs /v1/models into an opencode2api provider with context, vision and reasoning efforts, re-syncing every 10 minutes. Frozen archive: 26.10.31 is the last version, and the author points to dsh-magpie as the replacement.
description.zh: 随 DSH 启动独立的 opencode2api 后端（jasonxu114514/opencode2api，Windows x64/ARM64，无需 Docker 或 OpenCode CLI），退出时只停自己拉起的进程；设置卡片可从经校验和验证的 GitHub Release 安装、更新或回滚后端，复制初始管理密码，并把 /v1/models 连同上下文、视觉与思考档位同步到 opencode2api 模型提供方，运行中每 10 分钟重同步。已归档并冻结：26.10.31 是最后一个版本，作者建议改用 dsh-magpie。

description.en: Adds a human-editable notes workspace with folders, full-text search, rich text, checklists, resizable tables, attachments, exports, and opt-in agent collaboration.
description.zh: 提供可直接编辑的笔记空间，支持文件夹、全文搜索、富文本、核对清单、可调整列宽的表格、附件、导出和可选的 Agent 协作。

description.en: Adds per-member model and reasoning-effort routing to DeepSeek Desktop Agent Teams, plus leader-initiated release of a teammate subagent run instance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Desktop 的 Agent Teams 提供成员级模型与思考强度路由，并允许主理人释放（删除）团队成员的子智能体运行实例。

description.en: Agent presets whose leader does no work itself: every non-management tool call is denied at the harness boundary so the task has to go to a subagent, after a one-time lookup of the available subagent models and a per-task model choice; a second preset deliberately picks the model least suited to the task.
description.zh: 让领导不亲自干活的 agent preset：非管理类工具调用在 harness 边界一律被拒，任务只能外包给子智能体，选人前先一次性摸清可选子智能体模型、再按任务逐个选型；另一个 preset 故意挑最不适合该任务的模型。

description.en: Native image attachments for text-only DeepSeek in the Web GUI: pasted or dropped images appear as thumbnails in the session, and before dispatch the host reads them with the free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash vision API (glm-4v-flash fallback chain) and substitutes the description, so DeepSeek answers about the image while the original is kept in history.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 提供原生图片上传体验：在 Web GUI 粘贴/拖入图片即以缩略图附件进入会话，发送前由 host 用免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash 视觉 API（glm-4v-flash 降级链）读取并替换为文字描述，DeepSeek 据此回答，原图保留在聊天历史中。

description.en: DSH sidebar file-activity tab: records file reads/creates/modifies by the agent and the sidebar (including file ops hidden inside bash commands), per-session isolation, survives restarts, click a file for a floating preview (npm: `dsh-file-activity`).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏文件活动页签：记录 agent 与侧边栏的文件读取/新增/修改事件（含 bash 命令中隐含的文件操作），按会话隔离、重启后恢复，点击文件浮窗预览（npm: `dsh-file-activity`）。

description.en: FormatForge: forge 30+ file formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, EML, EPUB, TOML, archives) into AI-readable text via a drag-and-drop inbox, ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result tools and a CLI; scanned PDFs fall back to local OCR or an enhance hint for the session model.
description.zh: FormatForge：把 30+ 种文件格式（PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、EML、EPUB、TOML、压缩包）锻造成 AI 可读文本——网页拖拽入箱自动转换，提供 ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result 工具与 CLI；扫描件回退本地 OCR 或交给会话模型增强。

description.en: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.
description.zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

description.en: Usage dashboard: offline-scans session logs to chart daily/weekly/monthly tokens, estimated costs, model/tool/skill/command leaderboards, output speed, working hours and quality metrics; gridstack+ECharts cards are drag-and-drop composable, with custom formulas and AI arrangement (prompt round-trip import).
description.zh: 使用量仪表盘：离线扫描会话日志，统计每日/每周/每月 token、估算费用、模型/工具/技能/命令榜、输出速度、工作时段与质量指标；gridstack+ECharts 卡片可拖拽编排，支持自定义公式与 AI 编排（提示词往返导入）。

description.en: Layered context compression for DeepSeek Harness: folds old turns into model-written L1–L3 summary blocks, maps what each layer holds, and wakes the model when the context crosses a size line or keeps growing. By default it requires DSH's experimental Session Search plugin (session_event_read / session_event_search); without it the tools stay disabled unless requireSessionQuery is turned off.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的分层上下文压缩插件：把旧轮次折成由模型撰写摘要的 L1–L3 块，在地图里显示每层占用与可压位置，并在占用越过提醒线或持续增长时叫醒模型决定是否压缩。默认需要启用 DSH 实验性插件「会话搜索」（session_event_read / session_event_search），否则 compress 与 context_map 会停用（可关闭 requireSessionQuery）。

description.en: Collects the papers a DeepSeek Harness conversation cited, checks each one against Crossref, OpenAlex, arXiv and DataCite, and exports the confirmed entries as BibTeX or RIS.
description.zh: 收集对话里引用过的文献，逐条到 Crossref、OpenAlex、arXiv、DataCite 核对，通过核对的导出为 BibTeX 或 RIS。

description.en: Names a session from its first prompt, and streams AI title suggestions into the rename dialog.
description.zh: 用首条消息为会话命名，并在重命名弹窗里流式给出 AI 标题建议。

description.en: One-click Concise output style for DeepSeek Harness: results first, no filler, same work depth. Every final reply opens with a plain-language digest card (select text to copy); file paths inside the card are highlighted and click-to-open with the OS default app, and a deliverables zone lists the files the turn actually produced from real tool outputs. Scoped per session, works in headless/CLI too, with /concise command, style.md overrides and a local API.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键 Concise 输出风格开关：结果先行、少废话，工作深浅不变。每轮最终回答开头自动附「摘要」精华卡（划选即复制），卡内文件路径高亮可点（系统默认应用打开），卡底按本回合真实工具产出汇总交付物；按会话独立生效，headless/CLI 同样生效，支持 /concise 命令、style.md 自定义风格与本地 API。

description.en: A configurable 17-segment session status bar for the dsh composer dock with live TPS, per-model cost estimation, and a usage & cost dialog.
description.zh: 输入栏下可配置的 17 段会话状态栏，提供实时 TPS、按模型分别计价的费用估算，以及用量与费用弹窗。

description.en: Adds a /context slash command to DeepSeek Harness: shows how much of the session context window is used, how much is free, and a per-category breakdown (system prompt, memory files, skills, messages, tool results). Read-only, local, no model calls.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个 /context 命令：显示当前会话上下文窗口的占用、剩余空间，以及提示词各部分的占比（系统提示 / 记忆文件 / 技能 / 消息 / 工具结果）。只读、纯本地、不触发模型调用。

description.en: Training Lens opens a local TensorBoard scalar dashboard with selectable metrics, explicit improvement direction, optional EMA smoothing and Chinese/English UI; requires an existing Python environment with TensorBoard.
description.zh: Training Lens · 训练视窗通过 DSH 工具打开本地 TensorBoard 标量监控页面，支持指标选择、改善方向、EMA 平滑和中英文界面；需要已有的 Python 与 TensorBoard 环境。

description.en: Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid drift, palette size, tap targets, and the tells of generated UI such as violet gradients caught by hue angle; ships a design-system skill.
description.zh: 在渲染后的页面上测量设计规则，而非解析 CSS——字号种类、与真实合成背景比对的 WCAG AA 对比度、间距栅格偏移、配色规模、点击区尺寸，以及「机器味指纹」（如按色相角度判定的紫色渐变）；内置 design-system 技能。

description.en: Project document chain integrity check: stage order, completeness and amount parseability.
description.zh: 项目全流程文件链条核对：环节顺序、文件齐备与金额可解析。

description.en: DocsMint workspace panel and agent tools for document search, reading, creation and updates through Cloud OAuth or self-hosted API keys.
description.zh: DocsMint 工作区面板与智能体工具，支持文档搜索、读取、创建和更新，可连接 Cloud OAuth 或自托管 API 密钥。

description.en: Backup, restore and machine-migration for DSH: packs skills (which live outside ~/.dsh, in ~/.agents/skills), plugin manifests, core config, memories, todos and optionally sessions into a tar.gz with a sha256 sidecar, then imports it on another machine as a three-way merge against a baseline, listing per-file differences instead of overwriting changes made there. Credentials never enter an archive (filename deny-list of 27 names plus 7 private-key suffixes plus a content gate, enforced again on the import side), every import writes a pre-restore snapshot first, and an archive can be uploaded to any WebDAV server and pulled back on the new machine. Also includes scheduled backups, a read-only viewer for individual files, and an in-panel cloud card; no npm runtime dependencies (packing uses the system tar).
description.zh: DSH 的备份 / 恢复 / 换机迁移：把技能（技能目录在 ~/.dsh 之外的 ~/.agents/skills）、插件清单、核心配置、记忆、待办、以及可选的会话打成一个带 sha256 边车的 tar.gz，再在另一台机器上以「带基线的三方合并」导入 —— 逐文件列出差异，而不是直接覆盖对方改过的东西。凭据永不进包（27 个文件名 + 7 个私钥后缀的黑名单，外加内容特征闸，导入侧再过一遍），每次导入前先写一份可原样还原的快照；归档可以推到任意 WebDAV 服务（绿联 NAS / 群晖 / 坚果云 / Nextcloud）并在新机器上下载回来。另含定时备份、单文件只读查看、面板内的云端卡片；零 npm 运行时依赖（打包用系统 tar）。

description.en: Hierarchical model selection and collapsible multi-key configuration in the DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 web UI (native app menus unchanged); host patches are explicitly enabled, updated or restored from settings with verified backups and require an engine restart. Ordinary uninstall does not restore patches.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 网页界面的分层模型选择与可折叠多密钥配置（不改 App 原生菜单）；在设置页手动启用、更新或还原宿主补丁，校验备份后需重启引擎。普通卸载不会还原补丁。

description.en: Prompt enhancement: click the star button in the composer to have the current model rewrite the draft more clearly, with one click back to the original; the template is editable.
description.zh: 增强提示词：点击发送框的星形按钮，用当前模型把草稿改写得更清晰，可一键切回原文；模板可编辑。

description.en: An OpenCode Go model source for DSH: it reads the opencode-go catalog from Models.dev and serves it on a separate opencode-go-live route, leaving the built-in opencode-go route in place. The catalog snapshot is cached under the DSH home and a failed refresh keeps the last successful one; its own Models settings card edits the route key and can render OpenCode Go subscription usage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 OpenCode Go 模型来源：从 Models.dev 读取 opencode-go 目录，在独立的 opencode-go-live 路由上提供，内置 opencode-go 路由保持原样。目录快照缓存在 DSH home 下，刷新失败时沿用上一次成功的目录；插件自带 Models 设置卡片用于填写该路由密钥，并可显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量。

description.en: Turns PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files into Markdown or plain text with heading levels preserved where the source allows it, and refuses scanned PDFs that have no text layer instead of writing an empty file, naming the OCR alternative instead. Requires Python 3.10+ and pip install -r requirements.
description.zh: 把 PDF、Word、PPT、Excel 转成保留标题层级的 Markdown 或纯文本；遇到没有文字层的扫描件会主动拒绝（退出码 2），不会写一个空文件骗过下游，并指明可改用 OCR（dsh-scan2md）。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements。

description.en: Manages multiple Jenkins servers and triggers jobs from a Settings page, model tools, or a per-workspace "Run Jenkins Job" entry, with a bilingual host + browser UI.
description.zh: 管理多台 Jenkins 服务器，支持从设置页、模型工具或工作区级「执行 Jenkins Job」入口触发构建，宿主 + 浏览器双端、界面中英双语。

description.en: A web-novel writing engine for DeepSeek Harness: parallel drafting, outlining and brainstorming with a separate DeepSeek key, lore and foreshadowing management, semantic vector retrieval, a corpus library, usage ledger, mechanical proofreading, and a local serialization plan.
description.zh: 写文引擎：用独立 DeepSeek key 分流并发生成草稿/细纲/点子，设定与伏笔管理、语义向量检索、书库（饲料区）、用量总账、机械校对与本地连载计划。

description.en: A fully customizable theming framework for DSH UI, with Xiao from Genshin Impact as the default theme.
description.zh: 为 DSH UI 提供完全自定义的主题框架，默认主题为原神魈。

description.en: Workspace-first enhanced sidebar for dsh Web that shadows the built-in workspace browser at low priority (one-click toggle back to the official one) and adds soft workspace archive/restore, per-workspace SVG icons and accent colors, drag reorder and title/path/session-content search, plus a ⌘K Spotlight palette fuzzy-searching workspaces and sessions; the host half ships read-only workspace_find/workspace_list model tools and /workspace-find /workspace-list slash commands. Bilingual zh/en.
description.zh: 面向 dsh Web 的工作区优先增强侧栏：以低优先级 shadow 内置工作区浏览器（可一键切回官方版），提供软归档/恢复、每工作区 SVG 图标与强调色、拖拽排序与标题/路径/会话内容搜索；另提供 ⌘K Spotlight 面板模糊搜索工作区/会话；宿主侧附带只读 workspace_find/workspace_list 工具与 /workspace-find /workspace-list 斜杠命令（中英双语）。

description.en: A floating stock ticker for DeepSeek Harness: real-time quotes for Nikkei 225 and TOPIX ETF out of the box, plus worldwide markets via Yahoo Finance — Japan (.T), US, Hong Kong (.HK), China (.SS/.SZ) and any other symbol — with a customizable watchlist, display aliases and 16 UI languages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全球股市行情悬浮窗：默认显示日经225 与 TOPIX ETF，另支持通过 Yahoo Finance 实时报价全球市场——日本 .T、美国、香港 .HK、中国 .SS/.SZ 及任意代码，带自选列表、显示别名与 16 种界面语言。

description.en: Draggable companion widget by Tokyo with Codex quota monitoring, manual executable discovery, and editable replies. Requires the Codex CLI (codex app-server) and a ChatGPT login; API-key logins expose no subscription quota.
description.zh: Tokyo 的可拖动陪伴挂件，支持 Codex 额度监控、手动程序定位和可编辑回复。需安装 Codex CLI（codex app-server）并使用 ChatGPT 登录；API-key 登录不显示订阅额度。

description.en: Token-free Chinese classical poetry tab in the DSH conversation view with search, filters, 飞花令, daily poem, favorites, festival topics and a share-card image; AI explanation reuses your own DSH session.
description.zh: 免 token 诗词查询插件，在会话页头新增「诗词」标签页，支持搜索、筛选、飞花令、每日一首、收藏、简繁、节日专题与分享卡片图；AI 解读复用 DSH 会话。

description.en: Independent per-pane zoom for the DSH web shell: Ctrl+wheel over a pane, Ctrl+± / Ctrl+0 for the focused pane. Works with the official look and every skin.
description.zh: 支持 DSH Web 上的每个面板独立缩放：鼠标悬浮在面板上 Ctrl+滚轮，或对选中的面板 Ctrl+±，Ctrl+0恢复。兼容官方界面风格及皮肤。

description.en: Personal assistant for DeepSeek Harness that turns conversational commitments into cross-session plans, reminders, and an auditable dashboard.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的个人助手：从对话中整理跨会话事项与计划，通过提醒和可审计的助手看板持续跟进。

description.en: Four GitHub workflow skills for PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing, reusing existing DSH capabilities with gh/git fallbacks.
description.zh: 四个面向 GitHub 工程工作流的 DSH Skill：PR 分诊、review 反馈、GitHub Actions 诊断和安全的 draft PR 发布；优先复用现有 DSH 能力，必要时回退到 gh/git。

description.en: SPC control-chart and Cpk check against the current GB/T 17989.2—2020 control-chart constants.
description.zh: 按现行 GB/T 17989.2—2020 控制图常数表核对 SPC 控制图控制限与 CPK。

description.en: SSH workspace and operations for DeepSeek Harness: bind a server directory as a workspace whose fs/subprocess calls route to the remote host via cordis seam replacement, plus web terminal, file transfers, tunnels, cluster runs and host management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 工作区与运维：把服务器目录绑定为工作区，fs/命令经 cordis seam 替换透明路由到远端主机，并带 Web 终端、文件传输、隧道、集群执行与主机管理。

description.en: See the quota of every AI account connected to your local Magpie gateway at a glance, with usage breakdowns by day/week/month.
description.zh: 一键查看本机 Magpie 网关下全部 AI 账号的额度，并支持按天/周/月查看用量明细。

description.en: LaTeX and BibTeX guardrails for DeepSeek Harness: compile checks with automatic xelatex/lualatex detection, BibTeX entry deduplication and field filling from Crossref, and \cite key audits against the .bib file.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 LaTeX 与 BibTeX 检查工具：编译检查（自动识别 xelatex/lualatex），基于 Crossref 的 BibTeX 条目去重与字段补全，以及 \cite 键与 .bib 文件的一致性审计。

description.en: Configurable image recognition for text-only DSH models: attached images are preserved through the DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 adapter pipeline, transcribed by an OpenAI-compatible vision model, and passed to the main model as text. Supports selectable OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Azure auth headers and reports a missing API key before sending a request.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DSH 模型增加可配置识图能力：在 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 中，上传图片会完整通过适配链路，由 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型转写为文字后交给主模型；支持 OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Azure 风格密钥鉴权，缺少 API Key 时会在发起请求前明确提示。

description.en: AgentTeams for DeepSeek Harness — an independent design branch of NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams; do not install both, since both register the same `agent-teams` row. Multi-agent team collaboration with a captain and members, tasks that carry dependencies, and messaging, all driven by natural language, plus a tree monitor in the web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AgentTeams 多智能体团队协作插件，NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams 的独立设计分支；不要与上游同装：两者注册同一个 `agent-teams` 行。提供队长与成员、带依赖的任务与消息传递，全部由自然语言驱动，Web 界面提供树状实时监视。

description.en: Stops the agent after N consecutive failures on the same tool. Instead of another retry it pushes a four-part stop instruction: what was tried, the exact error text, the likely cause, and what the user must do. Detection reads real tool results (isError or a non-zero shell exit code) and mirrors them through agent.steer, so the agent sees it as an inbound message rather than a log line.
description.zh: 同一工具连续失败达阈值时叫停。不是再试一次，而是推送一条四部分停手指令：试过什么、完整错误原文、初判原因、需要用户做什么。判定读真实工具结果（isError 或 shell 退出码非零），通过 agent.steer 回灌，让 agent 把它当成收到的消息而不是日志。

description.en: Right-sidebar novel studio that treats a chapter as a pipeline with checkable artefacts instead of one long prompt: scaffold a project, inspect the exact context pack a chapter gets, generate 2-6 parallel candidates and keep the one you pick, then run chapters in sequence with per-chapter progress on disk so it survives an engine restart. Length band, cross-chapter Jaccard and drift ratio are enforced in code rather than by model self-grading; rejections come back as repair evidence for up to two rewrites. AI-fingerprint metrics are reported against a 3956-chapter human baseline but never block, because the distributions overlap. Ships 7 agent tools. The writing engine is a separate Python package that the plugin installs on first use. Needs Python 3.10+ on PATH (or a path set in the plugin settings).
description.zh: 右栏小说工作台，把「写一章」当成有可核对产物的流水线而不是一段长 prompt：生成骨架，先看清这一章会拿到什么上下文包，同一章一次生成 2–6 版候选挑中才落盘，再按章连写且进度写进磁盘，引擎重启不丢。字数区间、跨章 Jaccard、漂移比写在代码里而不靠模型自评，打回内容回灌为修复证据，最多重写两次；AI 指纹只对照 3956 章人类基线报数、故意不拦，因为两个分布本身重叠。带 7 个 agent 工具。写作引擎是独立 Python 包，首次使用时由插件自己装上。需要 PATH 里有 Python 3.10+（或在插件设置里填解释器路径）。

description.en: Fifteen curated theme families and nine complete dsh-web-ui skin replicas in one plugin behind a single settings entry, with CSS-only custom theme JSON, controlled custom skin-pack import via folder picker, preview, apply, delete and restore-default. Ships on npm as `dsh-appearance-gallery`.
description.zh: 15 个精选主题家族 + 9 个完整 dsh-web-ui 皮肤复刻合并为单一插件、设置页单一入口，支持 CSS-only 自定义主题 JSON、受控自定义皮肤包导入（可直接选文件夹）、试穿、应用、删除与恢复默认。npm 包名 `dsh-appearance-gallery`。

description.en: Deferred tool loading gate, applied at the global layer and at every per-agent scope layer: allowlisted tools are injected in full, the rest carry a defer_loading mark so the host search chain (tool_search) can activate them on demand; on routes without native deferred loading the marked tools are folded into placeholders that keep tool names and argument shapes visible. A settings card configures the allowlist.
description.zh: 工具白名单延迟加载,全局层与全部 per-agent scope 层同时生效:白名单内工具全量注入,其余打 defer_loading 标,由宿主 tool_search 检索链按需激活;无原生延迟加载能力的三方路由折叠为保留名字与参数骨架的占位。设置卡可视配置白名单。

description.en: OpenCode Zen free-tier models for DeepSeek Harness with anonymous no-key access, a loopback OpenAI-compatible shim, and real bash/read gate tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Zen 免费模型：默认免 key 走公共额度，内置回环 OpenAI 兼容 shim，并把网关要求的 bash/read 注册为真实可执行工具。

description.en: Registers a /code-review slash command with five parallel review lenses and per-finding confidence scoring, for both pull requests and local code.
description.zh: 注册 /code-review 斜杠命令，五个并行审查视角、逐发现置信度打分，同时支持拉取请求与本地代码审查。

description.en: Routes web search and fetch, records estimated costs, and provides local budgets, circuit breakers, and diagnostics. Requires Node.js >=22.19 and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: 路由网页搜索和抓取，记录估算费用，并提供本地预算、渠道熔断和诊断功能。需 Node.js >=22.19 与 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 或 0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: OpenCode usage dashboard: a sidebar panel for quota and usage in DeepSeek Harness, with Go subscription windows, Console spend, trends, forecasts and model breakdown, multiple accounts, service-account filtering and English/Chinese UI.
description.zh: OpenCode 用量看板：在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏查看额度与用量，支持 Go 订阅窗口、Console 花费、趋势、预测和模型拆分，以及多账户、服务账号筛选和中英界面。

description.en: Git inside your DSH session: a right-sidebar panel for the current workspace and a global page listing every workspace, one sync button that becomes Fetch, Pull, Push, Publish branch or Sync, a commit tab that opens first with every change checked, AI-written commit messages from the staged diff, plus history, branches, stash and in-panel conflict resolution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话里用 Git：右栏面板管当前工作区仓库，左侧栏全局页列出所有工作区；一个同步按钮按状态变成 Fetch / Pull / Push / Publish branch / Sync；打开面板先看到提交页、改动默认全选；提交信息由 AI 读本次会提交的 diff 生成；另含历史、分支、stash 与面板内冲突解决。

description.en: Digital Study: a private WeRead study in the DSH sidebar, in a calm light-green paper palette. The shelf folds into ten categories and carries a slightly deeper paper tint of its own; highlights and thoughts page through, copy per item, and export as front-matter Markdown (one file per book or a cross-book batch) into a folder you choose; the whole study backs up and restores as a single JSON bundle. Thoughts read like handwritten notes: looser line height, the source book shown in full, long entries folding behind a show-all control, and a same-chapter highlight block for context. A five-shade reading heatmap draws only the days up to today, keeps its numbers on one line underneath, and a year-scoped KPI dashboard sits above it. Sync is incremental: a local ledger plus per-book counts mean an unchanged library refreshes in 2-3 seconds instead of a full pull, and a banner reports progress and dismisses itself after eight seconds. Search covers shelf, books, highlights and thoughts with type filters. Reads WeRead through the official agent gateway using your own API key, keeps everything in local JSON and never writes back. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 数字书房：把微信读书搬进 DSH 侧栏的私人书房，清爽的浅绿纸感配色。书架折叠成 10 大类并自带一层略深的纸色；划线与想法可分页、可单条复制，也能勾选导出成带 front-matter 的 Markdown（一本书一个文件，或跨书批量），存到你指定的目录；整间书房还能一键备份与恢复成一份 JSON。想法页按手记排版：行距更松、来源书名完整展示、长内容可一键展开，并能在卡片里展开同章的划线作参考。五档阅读热力图只画到今天，数据收在网格下方一行；上方是可切换年份的统计表盘。同步是增量的：靠本地账本与每本书的计数比对，数据没变化时 2~3 秒就完成，不用整库重拉；进度提示条会在完成后 8 秒自动消失。书架、书籍、划线、想法都能搜索并支持类型筛选。通过官方 agent 网关用你自己的 API Key 读取，全部落在本机 JSON，绝不写回。要求 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Connects DSH Web and qq-bridge to OFM, defaulting to the DeepSeek public pool while preserving reasoning effort and manual model selection; loads the official OFM dependency when absent and reports account-rotation receipts.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web / qq-bridge 接入 OFM，默认先选 DeepSeek 免费池并保留思考档位；缺少 OFM 时装载官方依赖，支持自有账号与轮换回执，不限制手动选模。

description.en: Workspace-scoped DSH migration: package a project's conversations, files and attachments, restore them on another machine into a chosen root with historical absolute paths rewritten, and re-sync only what changed afterwards.
description.zh: 按工作区迁移 DSH：把一个项目的会话、文件与附件打包，在新机器上还原到指定根目录并重写历史绝对路径，之后只增量同步改动的文件。

description.en: Search public-domain libraries (Project Gutenberg, Wikisource, Internet Archive, Standard Ebooks) by title, author, character or half-remembered plot, or import EPUB / PDF / TXT / DOCX / Markdown, and listen in the sidebar with Microsoft Edge neural voices, offline Kokoro or the device voices; keeps your position, takes voice notes anchored to what you just heard, and discusses the book with your DSH model.
description.zh: 搜书听：按书名、作者、角色名或大概情节搜公版书（古腾堡、中英文维基文库、Internet Archive、Standard Ebooks），或导入 EPUB / PDF / TXT / DOCX / Markdown，在右侧栏用微软 Edge 神经网络语音、离线 Kokoro 或设备自带语音读给你听；自动记住听到哪，能语音记读书心得、和 AI 聊刚听到的内容。

description.en: Discourages unnecessary sequential tool calls by guiding the model to batch ready, independent calls, potentially reducing wait time, model round trips, and token use when the runtime supports parallel execution; no scheduler changes.
description.zh: 引导模型将已就绪且互不依赖的工具调用合批，减少不必要的串行调用；在运行时支持并行执行时，有望缩短等待时间、减少模型交互轮次及 token 消耗，不修改调度器。

description.en: Sidebar panel management for DeepSeek Harness: a grouped Panels launcher collects global panel rows and third-party plugin entry rows into one searchable menu — the full panel inventory (pinned and unpinned, unpinned open via temporary-pin peek), collapsible group memory, in-menu search with hit highlighting and keyboard navigation, Alt+1..9 direct activation of the Nth visible item, and hover pin/top quick-actions. A Ctrl+K command palette mirrors the inventory with quick commands, a Recent group of last-used panels (MRU, persisted), and named layout presets — save your whole arrangement (pins, top pins, folds, whitelist, icon-only, compact footer) and re-apply it in one click. v1.0.0 adds custom panel groups: define your own groups (inline rename, member picker in Settings) and they render as first-class groups with accurate counts in the menu and palette. Plus a keyboard-reachable right-click context menu, icon-only panel rows, top-pinning with drag-to-reorder, a compact footer with granular sub-toggles, and a Settings page with height sliders, a locale-safe whitelist, pin management, and settings export/import.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏面板收纳：把全局面板行（含未钉住的，未钉面板临时打开后还原）与第三方插件入口收进一个可搜索的分组「面板」菜单——分组折叠记忆、菜单内搜索带命中高亮与全键盘导航、Alt+1..9 直达第 N 个可见项、悬停钉住/置顶快捷操作。Ctrl+K 命令面板镜像同一清单，附带快捷命令、「最近使用」组（MRU 持久化）与具名布局预设——把整套排布（钉住、置顶、折叠、白名单、仅图标、紧凑底部区）存成预设一键套用。v1.0.0 新增自定义分组：在设置页建组、行内改名、挑选成员，菜单与命令面板中作为一等分组渲染且计数准确。右键上下文菜单（键盘可达）、面板行仅图标、置顶拖拽排序、紧凑底部区细分开关，设置页提供高度滑块、语言切换安全的白名单、钉住管理与配置导出/导入。

description.en: Adds a Continue button left of the model selector: after a turn ends aborted by the user, interrupted by a crash or errored, one click sends notices asking the model to pick that turn back up, and the button collapses while you type or attach a file.
description.zh: 在模型选择器左侧加一个「继续」按钮：上一轮被用户中止、崩溃中断或报错结束后，点一下让模型接着把那一轮做完；开始输入或添加附件时按钮收窄隐藏。

description.en: Bookmark assistant replies with notes and tags; browse every bookmark in one cross-session center and export to Markdown.
description.zh: 收藏 AI 回复（备注/标签），跨会话收藏中心（搜索/筛选/跳回会话），一键导出 Markdown。

description.en: Sidebar panel that embeds chat.deepseek.com full-width in the DSH main area (desktop shell only), restores the last conversation, and keeps a crashed embedded page inside the panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏加入 DeepSeek 聊天入口，主内容区全宽内嵌 chat.deepseek.com（仅桌面版），恢复上次会话，并把内嵌页崩溃限制在面板内。

description.en: Low-contrast graphite dark theme with a frosted-glass sidebar, composer and panels for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 低对比度石墨灰深色主题，侧边栏、输入区与弹层使用可调强度的毛玻璃。

description.en: Ships BMAD-Method inside the plugin: the seven modules are laid down on first open, no installer run and no download, the method's 90 agent and workflow skills come in the package, and each module can be turned off by writing the disabled flag into the profile patch.
description.zh: 把 BMAD-Method 塞进插件里：首次打开即铺好七个模块（不跑安装器、不下载），随包提供 90 个 agent 与工作流 skill，每个模块可通过写 profile 补丁里的 disabled 标记单独停用。

description.en: Shows the remaining quota of the current Our Free Model (OFM) channel beside the DSH composer, with a panel listing every signed-in channel; exhausted channels are flagged and switching models switches the channel shown. Requires dsh-our-free-model with at least one channel signed in.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁显示 Our Free Model（OFM）当前渠道的剩余额度，点开可看全部已登录渠道；余额用尽时红底标注，切换模型会跟着切渠道。需先安装 dsh-our-free-model 并登录至少一个渠道。

description.en: Unofficial Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth integration with isolated account storage; carries account-ban risk.
description.zh: 提供独立账户存储的非官方 Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth 接入，存在封号风险。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust backend.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与知识中台：在兼容插件之间路由 update、retrieve 和 subscribe 调用，并提供可选的事务化 Rust 后端。

description.en: Explain a selected word or sentence from a DSH conversation in a floating window: a channel of its own that leaves the session untouched, and the answer can be pinned to a session of its own.
description.zh: 在浮窗里解释 DSH 对话中选中的词或句子：走独立通道、不污染当前会话，解答可以固定成独立会话。

description.en: Skill usage scoreboard for DSH: counts both per-session deduplicated and per-load usage, scores `skill` tool calls and direct `read` of skill files, and shows the tally in a three-tab settings page (skill ranking, session board, management) with paging and JSON import/export.
description.zh: DSH 的 Skill 使用记分板：同时记录按会话去重与每次加载两种次数，统计 skill 工具调用与直接 read skill 文件两种记分来源，设置页三选项卡（Skill 排行 / 会话榜 / 管理）展示，支持分页与记分 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Merges AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper and zszz3/dsh-model-provider-prefix — two composer model-seat plugins that cannot be installed together — into one control: a Provider / Model trigger opening a two-column card where hovering the provider column swaps the models without moving the card, a separate reasoning-effort trigger with a particle slider, and a search that spans every provider while the card keeps its size.
description.zh: 把 AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper 与 zszz3/dsh-model-provider-prefix 这两个无法同时安装的输入框模型控件合并成一个控件：「供应商/模型」钮点开是两栏卡片，鼠标所指供应商的模型就地切换、卡片不移动；推理强度是旁边的独立钮，带粒子滑杆；搜索跨全部供应商，且卡片尺寸保持不变。

description.en: In the DSH desktop file preview, click an HTML element (with its source line and column) or lasso part of an image for the vision model to identify, then send your change request to the current session; local HTML edits keep a history with before/after previews, line diffs and rollback.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端文件预览中点选 HTML 元素（附源码行列），或自由圈选图片区域由视觉模型识别目标，写下修改要求后发送到当前会话；本地 HTML 修改保留记录，支持前后预览、逐行对比与回滚。

description.en: Embedded closed-loop development cockpit for DeepSeek Harness: the agent builds, flashes, debug-verifies and monitors STM32 boards from one panel, while the user watches every step live - progress ladder, streaming logs, RAM/FLASH usage and decoded serial waveforms. Requires a host Python 3.10+ on PATH (the plugin cannot install it); the ARM toolchain is auto-downloaded on first use (~400 MB, Windows x64 only), and you need an STM32 board with a debug probe.
description.zh: 嵌入式闭环开发驾驶舱（DSH 插件）：agent 在面板里闭环开发 STM32——发现、编译、烧录、调试校验、串口监视，开发过程对用户全程可视化（阶梯进度、实时日志、RAM/FLASH 占用、串口波形解码）。需主机自带 PATH 上的 Python 3.10+（插件不能代装）；ARM 工具链首次使用时自动下载（约 400 MB，仅 Windows x64），并需自备 STM32 板与调试探针。

description.en: Two buttons beside the chat input: one rewrites the draft with the current directory in view, the other inserts a role template from 85 curated entries generated from the bundled `agents/` role library, which the settings card can extend with your own `.md` role files.
description.zh: 对话输入框旁的两个按钮：一个结合当前目录改写草稿，另一个插入角色模板——默认 85 条精选模板由随包携带的 `agents/` 角色库生成，设置卡可用自己的 `.md` 角色文件扩充。

description.en: Wallpaper Engine integration for the dsh web GUI: scan the local WE library (Steam workshop 431960 + local projects) and use its wallpapers as the page background — image/video/web rendered natively, scene wallpapers as softened static previews — with a 壁纸设计 panel (opacity, scope, fill, blur, vignette, fps, parallax, carousel, theme linkage) and agent tools wallpaper_scan/list/set/config.
description.zh: Wallpaper Engine 壁纸联动：把本机下载的 WE 壁纸（创意工坊 431960 + 本地 projects）设为 DSH Web GUI 页面背景（图片/视频/网页原样渲染，场景壁纸柔化为静态预览），侧边栏「壁纸设计」面板可调不透明度、作用范围、填充、模糊、暗角、帧率、视差、轮播与主题联动，附 wallpaper_scan/list/set/config 四个 agent 工具。

description.en: PR evaluation and improvement consultant: assesses PR success probability based on historical anti-patterns and success patterns, with one-click scoring and actionable suggestions.
description.zh: PR 评估和改进顾问：基于历史反模式和成功模式评估 PR 成功率，一键评分并提供可操作的改进建议。

description.en: Redraw the left-hand workspace sidebar to add color highlighting, sorting, status indicators, and system notifications. You can also switch back to the original sidebar, which likewise implements some of these features.
description.zh: 通过重绘左侧工作区侧栏，为工作区侧栏添加颜色高亮、排序、收藏、状态指示以及系统通知等功能。同时可切换回原版侧栏，也具有部分功能实现。

description.en: DeepSeek-site-inspired skin for DSH Web and Desktop with a dark aurora, particle whale and constellation backdrop, a light blue glass theme, a single host-synced theme toggle, and theme-aware titlebar colors.
description.zh: 灵感来源于 DeepSeek 官网的 DSH Web 与 Desktop 皮肤：深色模式提供流体极光、粒子鲸鱼与星座背景，浅色模式采用蓝色玻璃质感，通过单一主题按钮切换并同步宿主外观设置，标题栏配色适配深浅色主题。

description.en: Stardew Valley theme (component-override edition): an official-mechanism client theme that stacks a cream-paper alias-token layer, stitched pixel font and valley wallpaper over the intact official React UI. npm: dsh-theme-stardew-valley.
description.zh: 星露谷物语主题·组件替换版：走 dsh 官方客户端主题机制，在完整保留的官方 React UI 上叠加奶油纸面 alias token 层、缝合像素字体与山谷壁纸。npm 包名 dsh-theme-stardew-valley。

description.en: Review tab for DeepSeek Harness sessions: workspace changes versus HEAD or any two refs as a filterable file tree with side-by-side diffs, a lane commit graph with blame and file history, three-scope search, line comments back to the composer, and guarded stage/commit/branch/tag/stash/conflict operations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话审查标签页：工作区相对 HEAD 或任意两 ref 的变更，以可过滤文件树加双列差异呈现；泳道提交图带逐行追溯与单文件历史；三范围搜索；行内评论回写对话输入框；暂存、提交、分支、标签、贮藏与冲突操作全部设防。

description.en: Restarts the DSH desktop app on Windows and wakes the sessions listed for it afterwards. The agent-facing restart tool is off by default and refuses while the host is busy.
description.zh: 重启 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端，并在重启后唤醒清单里指定的会话。面向 agent 的重启工具默认关闭，宿主繁忙时拒绝重启。

description.en: MCP bridge that lets ChatGPT Web create, view, continue, and supervise DeepSeek Harness agent sessions and goals while preserving DSH's native approval, sandbox, and workspace security model.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 让 ChatGPT Web 创建、查看、继续和监督 DeepSeek Harness Agent 会话与 Goal，同时保留 DSH 原生的审批、沙箱与工作区安全模型。

description.en: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.
description.zh: 专注模式：全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题与输入区，把 AI 工具调用折叠成摘要。

description.en: One click beside the composer turns a half-formed draft into a structured prompt the AI can act on: goal, constraints, output format and acceptance criteria filled in, placeholders only where a real decision is missing. Rewritten in place and never sent — undo with one click or Ctrl+Z. Four editable presets (general / code / writing / translation), optional conversation context to resolve references, and a model that either follows the session or is pinned to a chosen provider and reasoning effort. Requests survive session switches and typing while a rewrite is in flight; a result that no longer matches the draft is kept for retry instead of overwriting it. Pure JS, no build, no bundled dependencies.
description.zh: 输入框旁一键，把想到一半的草稿变成 AI 真能照着干的结构化提示词：补齐目标、约束、输出格式与验收标准，只在缺关键决策时留占位符。原地改写、绝不替你发送，一键或 Ctrl+Z 还原。四套可编辑预设（通用/编程/写作/翻译），可选读取会话上下文消解指代，模型可跟随会话或固定到指定 provider 与思考强度。改写期间切会话、继续打字都不会中断；结果与当前草稿不匹配时保留待重试而不是覆盖。纯 JS、无构建、无自带依赖。

description.en: MATLAB in the sidebar: a VS Code-like .m editor backed by a persistent MATLAB session (first boot ~6–9 s, then 12–84 ms per run in the default session mode, where figures really open on the desktop), live workspace variables you can edit, .mlx preview, extra folder mounts, and an agent-facing matlab_run tool. Requires a local MATLAB installation.
description.zh: 侧栏里的 MATLAB IDE：类 VS Code 的 .m 编辑器，背后是常驻 MATLAB 会话（首次启动约 6–9 秒，默认 session 模式下单次运行 12–84 毫秒，figure 真的会弹窗），可查看并编辑的实时工作区变量、.mlx 预览、多文件夹挂载，以及给 agent 用的 matlab_run 工具。需要本机安装 MATLAB。

description.en: Password gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that also removes the 403 a reverse proxy causes, with revocable sessions, an admin page and zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web UI 加密码登录，同时修掉反向代理导致的 403，带可吊销会话、管理页和零依赖。

description.en: Desktop only. DeepSeek Web in the Harness right Sidebar with synchronized theme, automatic launch, one-time web sign-in, and one-click question transfer.
description.zh: 仅 Desktop。把 DeepSeek 网页版放进 Harness 右侧栏：同步主题、自动打开、网页登录一次即可保持，并一键把提问带入当前对话。

description.en: Installs a multi-agent novel-writing preset for DeepSeek Harness: one conductor agent dispatches five specialized subagents — world-building, plotting, character management, prose writing, and QA review.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 安装一个多智能体小说创作预设：一个统筹队长派单五个专职子代理——架构世界、策划剧情、管理人物、执笔写文、质检复核。

description.en: Multi-model layered pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: a strong model plans, a fast one drafts, a third reviews, and a failed review is reworked automatically — endpoints, protocols, models and gates all configured from the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: DSH 多模型分层协同插件：强模型规划、快模型执行、第三方模型审查，审查 FAIL 自动带问题清单返工；端点、协议、模型、层级全部在设置面板里配。

description.en: File-defined command hooks across the session, prompt, tool, permission, Stop and PostCompact seams, with an approval-only GUI: no unapproved command runs, and approval binds the exact definition, canonical working directory and pinned watchFiles. Commands run as the DSH OS user without a hook sandbox, so the trust ledger is explicit.
description.zh: 文件声明的命令钩子，覆盖会话、提问、工具、审批、Stop 与压缩后等事件，配套只读审批界面：未经批准的命令不执行，批准绑定精确定义、实际执行目录与 watchFiles 固定内容。命令以 DSH 系统用户身份运行且无独立沙箱，因此信任记录是显式的。

description.en: Holds every final answer before delivery, has one independent minimal-context model call re-derive and check it, and releases only the verified text; the draft is never shown. Reviewed answers cost one extra model request and appear a few seconds later.
description.zh: 在最终回答送达前先扣住，交给一次独立、最小上下文的模型调用重新推导并校验，只放出校验后的文本，用户看不到草稿。被复核的回答多一次模型请求，文字出现前会多几秒。

description.en: Browse Claude Code, DSH and Codex session logs by working directory, with per-turn context composition, token usage, compaction markers and cost estimates.
description.zh: 按工作目录浏览 Claude Code、DSH 和 Codex 会话日志，查看每轮上下文构成、token 用量、压缩点和费用估算。

description.en: Workspace/chat context menu for the DSH home page: pin, rename, open in file explorer, archive, fork, copy, and open in a new window.
description.zh: DSH 主页工作区/会话增强菜单：置顶、重命名、资源管理器打开、归档、分叉、复制、新窗口打开。

description.en: Workspace-wide sticky notes on an infinite canvas: notes are plain Markdown files, created manually, captured from conversations, or distilled by the AI, and can be handed back as context; ships 12 model tools and 5 bundled skills for creating, tagging, arranging, comparing and merging notes.
description.zh: 工作区级的无限画布便签：便签以 Markdown 文件保存，可手动创建、从对话中摘录或由 AI 提炼生成，并能作为上下文提供给 AI 使用；附带 12 个模型工具与 5 个内置技能，用于创建、打标签、整理、比较与合并便签。

description.en: Sticker library for DeepSeek Harness: a composer button opens two bundled packs (10 GPT-drawn plus 8 community fan-art), one click sends a 180px sticker, and a send_sticker tool lets the model understand and reply with stickers.
description.zh: DSH 表情包库：输入区按钮打开默认表情（10 张 GPT 绘制）与社区二创梗图（8 张）两个包，点一下发送 180px 贴纸，模型也能通过 send_sticker 理解并回发表情。

description.en: Preview 3D models and textures from the session workspace in DSH's right sidebar. Supported formats include FBX, OBJ, glTF, GLB, and STL models, plus TGA, EXR, and HDR textures.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏预览会话工作区中的 3D 模型和纹理。支持 FBX、OBJ、glTF、GLB、STL 模型，以及 TGA、EXR、HDR 纹理。

description.en: A developer toolkit for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web console: a real multi-tab PTY terminal docked under the composer plus an AI-output file browser sidebar with syntax highlighting, Markdown rendering and image preview.
description.zh: DSH 网页控制台的开发者工具包：一个真实的多标签 PTY 终端（停靠在输入框下方），外加 AI 输出文件浏览器侧栏，支持语法高亮、Markdown 渲染与图片预览。

description.en: Global proxy for DeepSeek Harness: route agent tools, model requests and web fetches through the Windows system proxy or a custom address with one persistent toggle, an editable settings card, and agent-visible proxy status.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全局代理插件：通过 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址统一代理模型请求与工具流量，主界面常驻开关，且 Agent 在对话中实时感知代理状态。

description.en: Always-visible account topped-up balance pill in the sidebar header, refreshed automatically and showing the same number as Settings → Account.
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部常驻显示账户充值余额，自动刷新，数字与「设置 → 账户」一致。

description.en: Sidebar account-balance quick view for DeepSeek Harness: balance, bonus credit, current model and the official peak/off-peak pricing period, with ruby/amber/jade/gold tiers and a low-balance warning.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏账户余额快捷查看：显示余额、赠送额度、当前模型和官方高峰 / 空闲计费时段，按余额分四档显示质感，余额过低时提醒。

description.en: Audit what context compaction actually lost. Reads the raw session event log and checks session-constraint survival (the standing instructions the user gave — do-not-X, must-Y, only-in-Z — and whether the summary still carries them; arXiv 2608.11242 measured ~17% survival across compactors), summary hallucination (paths, versions, ports and identifiers the summary invents that were never in the history it replaced), ghost references ("see above" pointing at removed text), token accounting (a summary nearly as large as what it claims to free), and unaccounted prunes. Four agent tools including a cross-session sweep that ranks conversations by how much compaction hurt them. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name.
description.zh: 压缩质量审计：审出上下文压缩到底丢了什么。读原始会话事件日志，检查会话约束幸存率（用户给的常驻指令—— 不要X、必须Y、只准Z——摘要是否还带着；arXiv 2608.11242 实测各压缩器平均只保留 17%）、摘要幻觉（摘要里 出现了历史中从不存在的路径/版本/端口/标识符）、幽灵引用（"如上所述"指向已不在上下文的内容）、token 记账（摘要几乎和它声称释放的一样大）、无据裁剪。四个 agent 工具，含跨会话扫描并按受损程度排序。纯 确定性，不调 LLM——答错就是规则有 bug，有名字可查。

description.en: Makes the agent answer as soon as it has one: injects a deliver-first rule into the system prompt and escalates reminders when tool calls pile up without an answer.
description.zh: 让 agent 一拿到结果就交付：把"先交付、少查询"写进系统提示，并在工具调用持续堆积时逐级提醒它收尾。

description.en: Self-evolving project-level Agent for DeepSeek Harness: 16 SDD workflow skills (clarification, PRD, issue, coding, locating, acceptance, review) plus project memory and knowledge that compound over time.
description.zh: 会进化的项目级 Agent：以 SDD 规格驱动掌舵全流程，内置 16 个技能覆盖澄清、PRD、issue、编码、定位、验收、审查；会记忆、会沉淀，越用越懂你的项目。

description.en: Call between DSH sessions in different working directories or projects: message any session (next-step delivery or a new turn), end a blocking tool call on request, and read transcripts and usage without waking the target.
description.zh: 在不同目录 / 项目的 DSH 会话之间通话：向任意会话发消息（下一步直达或开新轮），可按需结束对方阻塞中的工具调用，并在不唤醒对方的情况下读取记录与用量。

description.en: Manage skill experts in the sidebar and summon them from the composer or @ menu.
description.zh: 在侧栏管理技能专家，并通过输入栏或 @ 召唤他们协助完成任务。

description.en: Runs allowlisted Python hook scripts on session events and injects the text they return into the next turn, so standing rules live in editable .py files instead of the prompt. Needs Python on PATH; it only runs scripts whose names are on its built-in allowlist.
description.zh: 在会话事件上按白名单运行 Python hook 脚本，并把脚本返回的文本注入下一轮，让常驻规则写在可编辑的 .py 文件里而不是提示词里。需要 PATH 里有 Python；只运行名字在其内置白名单里的脚本。

description.en: A DSH conversation workspace: turn actions, provenance quotes, local notes and summaries, in-conversation find, focus lock, and per-workspace command buttons.
description.zh: DSH 会话工作台：轮次操作、引用出处、本地笔记与摘要、会话内查找、专注锁和多工作区命令按钮。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH: a system toast, a per-kind chime and a tab-title marker when the agent needs you (approval, plan review, question) or a reply finishes in the background; errors, interrupts, usage limits and multi-agent workflow progress alert too. A host half adds SSE delivery, webhook push (WeCom/Feishu/DingTalk/generic), per-turn token/cache/TPS stats, plus three message-format presets (concise, detailed, custom); settings changes auto-save.
description.zh: DSH 桌面消息提醒：模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或后台回复完成时，弹系统通知、提示音并标记标签页标题；出错、中断、用量上限与多 agent 工作流进展同样提醒。宿主半提供 SSE 投递、Webhook 推送（企业微信 / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 通用）与当轮统计（token / 缓存 / TPS），以及三档消息格式（简洁 / 详细 / 自定义）与自动保存。

description.en: Interactive chat table of contents with bookmarks, turn pinning, global shortcuts, and heading extraction.
description.zh: 对话大纲目录导航：支持书签标记、轮次置顶钉住、全局快捷键与智能标题提取。

description.en: Mouse gestures for files in the DSH Web GUI: Ctrl+click a file-tree row, a file mention in a chat message or a file link to open it with the desktop default application; right-click opens a menu with open, the operating system own Open With chooser, save a copy, copy the absolute path, copy the file contents and reveal in the file manager, while a right-click on an ordinary hyperlink offers Copy Link. A plain click is left to DSH own sidebar preview and directory rows are left to the page. Open and reveal go through DSH own sessionController, the Open With chooser is the operating system dialog (Windows Shell verb, open -a on macOS) rather than an application list kept by the plugin, and file reads stop at 8 MiB.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的文件手势：Ctrl+左键点击文件树行、对话中的文件提及或文件链接，用系统默认应用打开；右键弹出菜单，可打开文件、调用系统自带的「打开方式」选择框、另存为、复制绝对路径、复制文件内容、在文件管理器中定位，右键普通超链接则提供「复制链接」。普通左键仍交给 DSH 自带的侧边栏预览，目录行交给页面处理。打开与定位走 DSH 自己的 sessionController，「打开方式」直接交给操作系统对话框（Windows 的 Shell 动词、macOS 的 open -a），插件不维护自己的应用列表；读取文件内容上限 8 MiB。

description.en: A biomedical Research Graph grounded in literature and experiment results. Fork hypotheses, connect evidence, advance research.
description.zh: 基于文献和实验结果的生物医学研究图谱，拆分假设，连接证据，推进研究。

description.en: Adds drag-and-drop attachments for local files, folders, ZIP archives and Office documents.
description.zh: 支持拖放本地文件、文件夹、ZIP 压缩包和 Office 文档作为附件。

description.en: Whole-interface zoom for the DSH Web UI from 70% to 160%, driven by Ctrl+wheel, DSH's shortcut center or an inline pill, with content-width compensation so zooming out fits more text instead of narrowing the column.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面整体缩放（70%–160%），可用 Ctrl+滚轮、DSH 快捷键中心或输入框旁的胶囊操作，带正文栏宽度补偿，缩小后是一行更多字而不是一条更窄的栏。

description.en: Fantasy glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web UI: a moonlit nether-forest scene with drifting teal clouds, red spider lilies spreading from the lower-left and a sleeping cat in the corner, drawn over a WebGL2 fluid background with its own wallpaper and video backgrounds. Ships two switchable variants (pale / saturated blue), plus cat-paw, fish, bubble and starlight decorations. One switch restores the stock interface exactly.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面打造的奇幻玻璃拟态皮肤：月光冥界森林，青绿流云缓缓翻涌、绯红彼岸花自左下蔓延、角落里趴着一只睡猫，底层是 WebGL2 流体；另有自定义壁纸与视频背景。内置两套可一键切换的风格（淡雅 / 蓝色），并有猫爪、小鱼、泡泡、星光装饰。一个开关即可完全还原原生界面。

description.en: Connects DSH and VS Code for a Claude Code for VS Code style experience, continuing the same workspace and conversation right inside VS Code: install the DSH Coding Agent extension and the plugin discovers and connects automatically on the same Windows machine, or connect manually elsewhere by pasting the copied connection address.
description.zh: 把 DSH 和 VS Code 连接起来，提供类似 Claude Code for VS Code 的使用体验，直接在 VS Code 中接续同一工作区与同一会话：下载 VS Code 扩展 DSH Coding Agent，插件在 Windows 同机会自动发现并连接，其他平台可复制连接地址后手动连接。

description.en: Enter-plan-mode tool: gives the model a callable `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode` that switches the current session into plan mode for non-destructive exploration, pairing with the built-in `exit_plan_mode` to submit the plan for review. No settings.
description.zh: 进入计划模式工具：给模型一个可调用的 `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode`，把当前会话切进计划模式先做非破坏性探索，再配合内置的 `exit_plan_mode` 提交方案评审。无设置项。

description.en: One screen for every work you have shipped: local project facts, GitHub stars and last push, whether the plugin market has picked it up and how many downloads it has, plus pending pull-request wait times against the upstream median.
description.zh: 一屏看清每个作品的现状：本地版本与文件数、GitHub star 与最后推送、市场是否已收录及下载量、收录 PR 等待时长对比上游中位数；全部只读、数字都来自 API，不经模型生成。

description.en: DSH environment diagnosis, graded repair with one-click rollback, and a runtime self-healing service.
description.zh: DSH 环境诊断、分级修复与一键回滚，附带运行时自愈服务。

description.en: The mobile client for DeepSeek Harness: use the DSH running on your computer from your phone. The Android app signs in with the same account, picks this computer from the device list and opens its DeepSeek Harness UI on mobile. The desktop plugin handles registration and the connection, and nothing on the computer needs an inbound port. The UI adapts on its own: on a phone it becomes a touch-friendly layout, and returns to the desktop layout when a foldable opens or the window gets bigger. A PC-side panel shows login state, device quota, device list and the app download QR code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动端：用手机使用你电脑上的 DSH。安卓 App 用同一账号登录，在设备列表里选中这台电脑，就能在手机上打开并进入它的 DeepSeek Harness 界面。桌面端插件负责注册与连接，本机不用开公网端口；界面会自己适应屏幕——手机上变成适合手指操作的布局，折叠屏展开或窗口变大时回到桌面布局。PC 端面板可以看到登录态、设备配额、设备列表与 App 下载二维码。

description.en: Codex-style workflow auto-collapse: finished turns fold into a single "processed in Xs" row leaving only the final answer; tool calls and think blocks collapse into live-summary chips that follow streaming; expand level by level, fully reversible on uninstall.
description.zh: Codex 风格工作流自动折叠：回合完成收成一行「已处理 X秒」只留最终正文，工具/思考块折叠成实时摘要 chip（运行中跟随流式滚动），逐级点击展开；卸载完整还原。

description.en: Tree view of a DSH conversation: editing an old message forks the thread, every version lives in one tree while the sidebar keeps a single entry, branches can be renamed, and a branch can be promoted to a session of its own.
description.zh: DSH 会话的树形视图：编辑一条旧消息即从那一刻分叉，所有版本住进同一棵树、侧栏始终只有一条，分支可以改名，也可以把某个分支提升为独立会话。

description.en: Insurance product comparison & proposal expert — clause analysis, cost-effectiveness, coverage planning, generates verifiable client-facing PDF proposals.
description.zh: 保险产品对比与建议书专家（险析君），条款拆解、性价比测算、保障规划，生成可自核 PDF 建议书。

description.en: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds multi_search, platform_search, image_search with an in-chat image wall, page_images and save_images, plus a settings page for engines, keys and per-engine proxy.
description.zh: 可切换引擎的联网搜索 provider，其中多个引擎无需 API key（Bing、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG 等），可设置回退顺序；另提供 multi_search、platform_search、带对话内图片墙的 image_search、page_images 和 save_images，以及配置引擎、密钥和按引擎代理的设置页。

description.en: Restart button for the Harness desktop app: one sidebar entry that closes every Harness process and starts the application again, launched without a console window and without a close-confirmation dialog. Windows only.
description.zh: DSH 桌面应用重启按钮：侧栏一个入口，关闭全部 Harness 进程后重新启动应用；启动过程无控制台窗口、无关闭确认框。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Model-visible SSH file tools read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote: read a remote UTF-8 file with line-numbered paging, create a new remote file (an existing target is refused, there is no overwrite branch), and apply literal replacements with unique-match checking — all addressed through a single "alias:path" field whose alias comes from ~/.ssh/config.
description.zh: 模型可直接调用的 ssh 远程文件三件套：read_remote 按行号分页读远端 UTF-8 文本，write_remote 只新建文件、目标已存在即拒绝且没有覆写分支，edit_remote 做唯一匹配的字面替换，三者共用取自 ~/.ssh/config 的「别名:路径」一个 file_path 字段。

description.en: Opens the recent sessions in a sheet that floats over the sidebar workspace list, from one row above Settings: rows sorted by last activity with their run state, a draggable height, and a list that settles onto whole rows after stopping. The sheet paints no surface of its own, so it reads as part of the sidebar.
description.zh: 在侧栏「设置」上方加一行入口，展开后最近会话以浮层压在工作区列表上方：按最后活动时间排序、每行带运行状态、高度可拖、滚动停下后自动对齐到整行。浮层不画自己的底色，展开后仍像侧栏的一部分。

description.en: Standalone rescue for a broken DeepSeek Harness profile: a CLI that runs without DSH diagnoses the crash logs (six classified causes, from real incidents), pre-flights the profile for command-name collisions and files plugins read at construction time, arms a safe mode that loads only official bundles until a healthy boot restores them, and keeps manifest snapshots for rollback. A resident watcher watches the crash-log directories via OS file events — idle costs nothing, and when the loader dies the report is written within seconds, one file overwritten per crash. Windows only: crash logs are read from %APPDATA% and the watcher autostarts from the Windows Startup folder.
description.zh: 在 DSH 打不开时救回配置：不依赖 DSH 的命令行工具，把崩溃日志归类（六类原因，全部来自真实事故），启动前预检命令名冲突与插件构造期读取的文件，布防安全模式（只加载官方 bundle，启动正常后自动还原），并保留清单快照供回滚。另有一个常驻守护进程，用操作系统文件事件盯着崩溃日志目录——空闲零开销，加载器一死几秒内写出自检报告，每次崩溃只覆盖一份文件。仅限 Windows：崩溃日志读自 %APPDATA%，守护进程经 Windows「启动」文件夹自启。

description.en: Stardew Valley theme (full-skin edition) for the dsh web UI only: replaces the served web frontend with a self-contained pixel-farm interface — Junimo dialog, farm-select presets, quest journal HUD, session-as-day valley calendar, chiptune SFX and desktop pets. Not available in the desktop window and not compatible with other UI-changing plugins.
description.zh: 星露谷物语主题·整皮版，仅适用于 dsh Web 界面：把 Web 前端整体换成自包含的像素农场界面——祝尼魔对话、农场选预设、任务日志 HUD、会话即游戏日的山谷日历、8-bit 音效与桌宠。不支持桌面原生窗口，请勿与其他会改变 UI 的插件同时启用。

description.en: Connects an existing local CodeGraph CLI to each session's indexed project, shares one MCP process per project, and updates session-scoped tools when the working directory or index changes.
description.zh: 将本机已安装的 CodeGraph CLI 接入各会话的已索引项目，同项目共享一个 MCP 进程，并在工作目录或索引变化时更新会话级工具。

description.en: Document intake for agents: doc_route sniffs a file's real format by magic bytes and measures a PDF's text layer and page column layout before any conversion, and pdf_markdown converts PDFs to Markdown in column reading order with PyMuPDF. The PDF path needs a Python 3 interpreter with PyMuPDF.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的文档入口：doc_route 先按魔数嗅探真实格式，并测量 PDF 的文本层与分栏版面，再给出该走的提取管线；pdf_markdown 用 PyMuPDF 按分栏阅读顺序把 PDF 转成 Markdown。PDF 路径需要带 PyMuPDF 的 Python 3 解释器。

description.en: Pre-publish credential audit: walks a directory tree and flags API keys, tokens, private keys, database connection strings and hard-coded passwords before you commit, publish or ship. Zero dependencies, fully offline, findings are redacted to the first six characters.
description.zh: 发布前凭据审计：在你提交、发布或打包外发之前，遍历目录找出里面的 API key、令牌、私钥、数据库连接串和硬编码密码。零依赖、纯本地、不联网，发现结果脱敏到前 6 个字符。

description.en: Adds a celebratory fireworks overlay to the DSH Web UI through a happy_fireworks agent tool.
description.zh: 通过 `happy_fireworks` Agent 工具为 DSH Web UI 增加庆祝礼花覆盖层。

description.en: Live2D avatar stage and desktop companion for DSH: bundled Haru sample, custom Cubism 2/3+ model loading with scale and position controls, a draggable in-page pet, an optional transparent always-on-top desktop pet window, per-conversation expression prompt control, and opt-in voice with self-hosted ASR/TTS.
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 形象舞台与桌宠：内置 Haru 示例、自定义 Cubism 2/3+ 模型加载与缩放/位置控制、页面内可拖动桌宠、可选透明置顶桌面独立桌宠窗口、按对话授权的表情 control prompt，以及默认关闭、需自部署 ASR/TTS 的语音功能。

description.en: Adds a Session without workspace entry to the DSH Workspace picker, creates isolated date-organized directories, and keeps started sessions resumable under Ungrouped.
description.zh: 在 DSH 工作区选择器中添加无工作区会话入口，创建按日期整理的独立目录，并让已开始的会话在未分组区域保持可恢复。

description.en: Gitee Enterprise project management inside the conversation: issues, pull requests, kanban and the Gitee MCP toolchain.
description.zh: 在对话里管理 Gitee 企业版项目：issue、Pull Request、看板与 Gitee MCP 工具链。

description.en: Gives the agent four session tools: start a new session, send a message into another one, list sessions with their state, and wait for another session's turn to finish so its answer can be read back.
description.zh: 给 AI 四个会话工具：新建会话、给别的会话发消息、列出会话及其状态，以及等另一个会话这一轮跑完并把它的回答取回来。

description.en: Registers native doubao_generate_image and doubao_image_status Agent tools to automate Doubao Web (doubao.com) via Tabbit Browser, automatically extracting watermark-free 2.7K wm0 original images into local files and multimodal chat attachments.
description.zh: 豆包网页生图 Agent 原生工具插件：向 Agent 注册 doubao_generate_image 与 doubao_image_status 工具，通过 Tabbit 操控 doubao.com 提交生图提示词、选择比例与风格，自动优选 2.7K wm0 无水印超清原图落盘并注入对话附件。

description.en: A free-form grouping layer for the DSH sidebar: nest sessions from different workspaces into draggable groups without changing workspace membership or logs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏官方工作区管理之上增加一层独立自由分组：不同工作区的会话可归入同一多层分组，支持拖拽、搜索、恢复和可选 AI 控制，不改变原工作区归属与日志。

description.en: Keep branching from any completed answer at any depth while the main session stays untouched.
description.zh: 从任意层级的已完成回答持续创建隔离分支，主会话始终不受影响。

description.en: Per-conversation system prompt, turn-based context folding, sampling overrides and a low-token pure chat mode for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为单个对话设置系统提示词、按轮数折叠上下文、采样参数，并提供低 token 的纯聊天模式。

description.en: Adds four extra UI locales to DeepSeek Harness — Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), Japanese, Korean and French. All translation data is bundled, so it works fully offline.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加四种界面语言（繁體中文、日本語、한국어、Français），语料随包内置，完全离线。

description.en: Makes every Host header that actually reaches the server a trusted entry: all webServer routes are wrapped and the parsed host is registered in connection.trustedHosts (mirrored into webRuntime.trustedHosts on host generations that still have that service), so wildcard or otherwise unenumerable entry domains work without editing the start command; entries beyond a configurable capacity are evicted LRU-first. It does not change the listen binding — that stays with the deployment layer — and the authentication layer is untouched. Because any Host header is accepted, the host allowlist no longer protects against DNS rebinding; use it only on a network you trust.
description.zh: 把实际到达的 Host 动态登记为受信任入口:包装全部 webServer 路由,解析出的域名写入 connection.trustedHosts(仍有 webRuntime 的宿主世代同步镜像),泛域名等无法枚举的入口免改 --trusted-host 启动参数,超出可配容量的按 LRU 淘汰。不改监听绑定(监听地址始终由部署层 --host 或宿主缺省决定),认证层原样保留。由于任何 Host 头都会被接受，主机白名单不再能防 DNS 重绑定；只应在可信网络中使用。

description.en: Restart control for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows. A session header button or a tray icon stops the app and its host process, waits for both to exit, clears a stale profile lock, and relaunches, so a newly installed plugin loads without quitting the app by hand.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端重启开关。会话头部按钮与系统托盘图标都会结束应用及其 Host 进程、等待完全退出、清理残留的 profile 锁，然后重新拉起应用，装好新插件后不必手动退出再进。

description.en: SiYuan (思源笔记) notes integration: 17 siyuan_* host tools covering notebook and document listing, full-text search, SQL query, reading documents and blocks, creating and appending content, moving and renaming documents, daily notes and block attributes, plus a Web settings page for the SiYuan URL, API token and per-tool switches.
description.zh: 把思源笔记（SiYuan）接入 DeepSeek Harness：17 个 siyuan_* 宿主工具，覆盖笔记本与文档列表、全文检索、SQL 查询、读取文档与块、新建与追加内容、移动与重命名文档、日记与块属性，另提供一个 Web 设置页配置思源地址、API token 与逐工具开关。

description.en: Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DSH web GUI: a draggable floating ball in the session that owns the job, expanding into a panel with done/total, speed and ETA.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面中长时间后台任务的实时进度：有任务的会话里浮着一个小球，可拖动，点开是含已完成/总量、速度与剩余时间的面板。

description.en: Local memory for DeepSeek Harness: what you write is filed under a topic and linked to related entries, recall ranks results by embedding similarity (word matching when no model is installed), and the data stays in a local SQLite database.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地记忆插件：写下的内容按主题归档、与相关条目连边，召回按向量相似度排序（没装模型时退回词面匹配），数据存在本地 SQLite 库里。

description.en: Records real clicks, inputs, navigation and network traffic in a user-guided browser session for DSH, then generates a Markdown timeline report (report.md + events.jsonl) to build API-level skills.
description.zh: 网页操作录制器：录制用户引导会话中的真实点击、输入、导航与网络请求，生成 Markdown 操作时间线报告（report.md + events.jsonl），用于沉淀接口级 skill。

description.en: Open .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: cached Blender headless GLB export plus a dependency-free WebGL viewport and scene statistics. Requires Blender 3.6 or later installed locally.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB，零依赖 WebGL 视口与场景统计。需要本机安装 Blender 3.6 或更高版本。

description.en: One-click plugin updates and restart from the sidebar: see every plugin's current and new version with publish dates, update them through the profile's own launcher, and keep the Desktop window where you left it across restarts. Windows desktop only.
description.zh: 侧栏一键更新插件与重启：列出各插件的当前与新版本及发布时间，走 profile 自带安装器更新；完全重启后窗口回到上次的位置。仅限 Windows 桌面版。

description.en: Lists the attachments the current session actually received through the WeChat bridge and adopts one into the workspace on demand.
description.zh: 列出当前会话通过微信桥实际收到的附件，并按需将其中一个采纳到工作区。

description.en: Multi-agent workflow for math-modeling contests: the "UltraMath" preset runs a problem from reading through framework, derivation, coding, verification, paper and review, plus 4 single-stage role presets (mathematician, engineer, writer, reviewer) and 33 model-library skill docs.
description.zh: 数学建模竞赛多 Agent 求解工作流：「UltraMath」主控预设一个预设跑通 读题→框架→推导→编码→验算→论文→审稿 全流程，另有 数学家/工程师/作家/审稿人 4 个单阶段角色预设与 33 篇模型库技能文档。

description.en: Take a breath mid-task: the current step finishes, then it holds. Resume sends no new request and spends no tokens; the timer freezes. Current session only.
description.zh: 零成本“会话暂停”键：不会发出新请求，当前步骤做完后直接挂起，方便添加提示词；继续时不会花费token重发请求；只有点击继续或发新提示词才会继续，子代理结算与定时提醒唤不醒；侧栏加入暂停图标，计时器与动画共同冻结，不计暂停时段，恢复后从冻结前时间继续走；状态区分「暂停中」与「已暂停」；暂停只会作用于当前会话。

description.en: AI-driven drawio: four agent tools (validate, render to SVG/PNG, edit, template) plus a sidebar live board — zero-dependency mxfile-to-SVG preview, embedded diagrams.net editor with save bridge, and auto-open whenever the agent draws.
description.zh: AI 驱动 drawio：四个画图工具（校验 / 渲染 SVG/PNG / 编辑 / 模板）+ 侧栏实时画板——零依赖 mxfile→SVG 预览、内嵌 diagrams.net 官方编辑器、AI 画图时自动弹出跟随。

description.en: Local AI-agent request-log panel: aggregates local logs from atomcode, codebuddy, workbuddy, claude, codex, codearts, gemini, cursor, kimi and dsh, and shows per-round latency, tokens, cache, context and tool calls.
description.zh: 本地 AI agent 请求日志面板：聚合 atomcode、codebuddy、workbuddy、claude、codex、codearts、gemini、cursor、kimi、dsh 等本地日志，查看每轮耗时、token、缓存、上下文与工具调用。

description.en: Nine single-ink print palettes — sage linen, kraft paper, lead type, cyanotype, risograph, CRT tube, phosphor screen, punch card, floppy disk. Each palette carries its own paper grain, type pairing, corner shape, section rule and a whale mark redrawn in its ink, plus a letterpress pass (paper tooth, sheet mottle, ink bite) that can be switched off. Every palette ships separate light and dark tokens.
description.zh: 复古油墨主题：九套单色油墨配色——鼠尾草、牛皮纸、铅字、蓝晒纸、孔版、显像管、荧光屏、打孔卡、软盘。每套自带纸张质感、字体搭配、圆角与直角、章节线，以及按自身油墨重画的鲸鱼标记；另有一层可关掉的凸版压印（纸齿、纸不匀、墨的压痕）。每套都配浅色与深色两套 token。

description.en: Adds a sidebar tab that folds a session into user turns (input, tool steps, output) with one-click jump back into the conversation.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按用户轮次折叠会话（输入、工具步骤、输出），一键跳回对话原位。

description.en: Creates a throwaway workspace with its own folder and session, manages running ones from a sidebar panel, and moves finished folders to the system Trash.
description.zh: 一键创建一次性临时工作区（独立文件夹、独立工作区与会话），在侧边栏统一管理，用完把文件夹移入系统废纸篓。

description.en: Configurable deterministic session titles for DeepSeek Harness from semantic prompt fields and templates.
description.zh: 基于语义 prompt 字段与自定义模板的 DeepSeek Harness 确定性会话标题生成插件。

description.en: FDE toolbox bundle: installing this one plugin pulls in a curated set of common dsh plugins (git server, WebDAV mount, knowledge base, scheduled tasks, auto-resume, UI tweaks, auto-retrospection, file manager, smart titles, task board, plugin market, context trimmer, IM bridge, sidebar enhancements), with a panel showing install status and one-click gap-filling.
description.zh: FDE 工具箱全家桶：安装一个插件带上一批常用 dsh 插件（代码仓库 / 挂载盘 / 知识库 / 定时任务 / 自动续跑 / 界面微调 / 自动复盘 / 文件管理 / 智能标题 / 任务看板 / 插件市场 / 上下文 / IM 接入 / 侧栏增强），面板看状态、一键补装。

description.en: A floating credit/quota widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web: shows DeepSeek / OpenCode Go balances and usage, and tracks DSH session token usage and estimated cost by day, month, and model.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 LLM 额度/用量悬浮窗：显示 DeepSeek / OpenCode Go 余额与套餐用量，并按日、月、模型统计 DSH 会话 token 用量与费用估算。

description.en: Bridges DSH to a local MemVault store: core memory blocks injected into the system prompt, finished turns extracted through MemVault's own pipeline, and a panel to browse, trace, review and replay what was stored.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接到本机 MemVault 记忆库：核心记忆块注入系统提示词、结束的轮次经由 MemVault 自己的管线抽取，并提供浏览、追溯、复核与重抽的面板。

description.en: Connects DSH session status, approvals and questions to a native macOS notch app; requires the native app and Focus companion.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话状态、审批和问题同步到原生 macOS 刘海程序，需要原生程序及 Focus 同步助手。

description.en: Bing-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: prefers Bing's RSS feed with the public cn.bing.com HTML page as fallback, no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeps searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint, result count and result language configurable; targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.7+).
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源：优先解析 Bing 的 RSS 输出，以 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页作为兜底，无需 API Key，国内可直连，搜索不再消耗模型自带的搜索额度。端点、结果数量与结果语言可配置；适配 DSH 0.2.x（0.1.7+ 亦可用）。

description.en: One shelf for WeChat Reading, GitHub book repos and your own EPUB/PDF/Markdown, with an immersive reader and AI notes.
description.zh: 把微信读书、GitHub 书库和自己的 EPUB/PDF/Markdown 收进一个书架，沉浸阅读并让 AI 解释划词。

description.en: ExHentai.org-inspired UI for DeepSeek Harness. DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai. Charcoal background, light-gray text, gray borders. The session list reads like a gallery index; the composer reads like a search bar. Live Demo: https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/
description.zh: ExHentai 皮肤 for DeepSeek Harness。DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai，深炭底、浅灰文字、灰色边框；会话列表像画廊索引，发送框像搜索栏。预览Demo：https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/

description.en: Adds backup-then-delete and delete-only actions to the DSH session menu: a safe session-delete tool that copies the session directory, its projection cache and a metadata snapshot to a local archive folder and checks them file by file before deleting a session to free disk space; subagent sessions it spawned are handled in the same run, and each backup folder keeps a RESTORE.txt with recovery steps.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话「···」菜单加「备份删除」与「彻底删除」两个入口：这是一个安全的会话删除工具（session-delete），删除会话前先把会话目录、投影缓存和元数据快照复制到本地归档文件夹并逐文件校验，通过后再删除原件以释放磁盘空间；派生的子代理会话一并处理，每个备份文件夹都带 RESTORE.txt 恢复步骤。

description.en: Replaces the terminal tool on Windows with Git Bash.
description.zh: 可将 Windows 环境下的终端工具替换为 Git Bash

description.en: A draggable balance and usage card for the web UI. Clicking the character button slides the card out from the left side of the image and clicking it again retracts the card; it shows the official DeepSeek account balance split into granted credit and top-up, and token usage folded from local session logs for today, the last 7 days and the month, priced per call with the official peak/off-peak rates (cache hits, cache misses and output are priced separately).
description.zh: 可拖动的余额与用量浮层卡片：点一下角色图片，卡片从图片左侧滑出，再点一下缩回；显示官方 DeepSeek 余额（赠金 / 充值拆分），并按缓存命中、未命中、输出三段计价，汇总本地会话日志的今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月 token 用量与人民币估算花费（按官方峰谷时段逐次计价）。

description.en: View tab manager for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session header: enable, hide, reorder and rename the conversation view tabs (Chat / Trajectory), with locale-aware zh/en copy and npm update reminders.
description.zh: DSH 视图标签管理器（逃咪）：管理会话页头视图标签（对话/轨迹）——启停、隐藏、排序与重命名，文案随界面语言中英切换，并带 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: LAN phone drop: a QR code on the computer screen opens a page on the phone, and photos or scanned documents land in a computer folder over the local network, with no tunnel and no cloud in between. Document mode binarizes locally in the browser (adaptive threshold plus speckle removal and edge crop) so an ordinary phone photo comes out as a black-and-white scan. Adds a "phone drop" entry at the foot of the DSH sidebar that opens the QR page, plus a phone_drop tool for the assistant; the same CLI also runs standalone without DSH.
description.zh: 局域网手机直传：电脑屏幕上出一个二维码，手机扫开就能拍照或扫描，文件直接落进电脑文件夹，全程局域网直连，不经过隧道也不经过云端。文档模式在手机浏览器里本地做自适应二值化、去噪、裁边，把普通照片变成黑白扫描件。插件会在 DSH 侧边栏底部加一个「手机直传」入口，点开就是二维码页；另有 phone_drop 工具供助手调用，同一个 CLI 也能脱离 DSH 独立运行。

description.en: AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit agent code, start battles, watch replays, and use DSH conversations to keep improving agents based on battle results.
description.zh: AgentDuel 是一款代码对战游戏，通过这款插件，在 DSH 内部完成整个游戏过程，实现死斗角色与夺旗团队、提交 Agent 代码、发起战斗、观看回放，并通过 DSH 会话依据战果继续优化 Agent。

description.en: Web search for DeepSeek Harness through Z.ai or Zhipu, with Coding Plan MCP quota and REST API billing modes, a native bilingual settings card, and support for reusing an existing ZAI_API_KEY.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Z.ai / 智谱网页搜索插件，支持 Coding Plan MCP 套餐额度和 REST API 余额两种计费模式，提供原生中英文设置卡片，可复用现有 ZAI_API_KEY。

description.en: Windows x64 translator with a dedicated sidebar entry and Workbench / Chat interface, side-by-side text and document translation, screen-region translation, recent history, and host model selection, voice input and preview. CPU OCR without NVIDIA dependencies. Do not enable the CPU and CUDA packages at the same time.
description.zh: 翻译 CPU：Windows x64 专属翻译界面，侧栏独立入口，支持工作台／聊天切换、原文与译文双栏、尽量保留原格式的文档翻译、屏幕框选翻译及最近记录，复用宿主模型、语音输入与预览。使用 CPU OCR，无需 NVIDIA 运行库。不要同时启用 CPU 与 CUDA 两个版本。

description.en: Patent-writing gatekeeper for dsh - screens the idea against Chinese prior art first, then runs five-party alignment interviews, eight-chapter disclosure drafting, figures and simulation runs, seven-dimension review and docx/PDF export. Skills work out of the box; the search, export and experiment tools come from a bundled Python MCP service that ships disabled - one line in ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml enables it, and uvx fetches the wheel from PyPI.
description.zh: dsh 专利撰写把关人：动笔前先检索中国专利给出三档结论，再走五方对齐访谈、八章交底书、附图与仿真实验、七维审查与 docx/PDF 导出全流程。技能开箱即用；检索、导出与实验工具来自内置的 Python MCP 服务，默认关闭——在 ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml 里开一行即启用，uvx 会从 PyPI 自动拉取。

description.en: Registers Baidu, Doubao, Tavily, and Exa backends into ctx.web so official web_search can use them, and routes web_fetch through Tavily Extract or Exa Contents when that backend is active.
description.zh: 向 ctx.web 注册百度、豆包、Tavily、Exa 后端供官方 web_search 使用，并在 Tavily 或 Exa 生效时将 web_fetch 转到对应提取接口。

description.en: SSH terminal, SFTP file manager and port forwarding (-L/-R/-D) in the DSH right sidebar, with jump-host chains and remembered passwords kept in the operating system credential store.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏里提供 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件管理与端口转发（-L/-R/-D），支持跳板链，记住的密码交给操作系统密码箱保管。

description.en: Moves a workspace to another folder from its right-click menu: renames the folder, carries its nested workspaces and sessions along, rewrites their records, rolls back if anything fails, and can be undone in one click. Developed on Windows; macOS and Linux share the same code path and are exercised in CI against a real harness host.
description.zh: 在工作区右键菜单里把整个工作区搬到另一个目录，顺带重命名：嵌套工作区与会话一起迁移并改写记录，失败自动回滚，移动后可一键撤销。在 Windows 上完成开发；macOS 与 Linux 走同一套代码路径，并在 CI 里用真实 Harness 实例跑通移动与撤销。

description.en: Sidebar panel for Agnes image and video generation. Images: plain text-to-image, or image-to-image and multi-image composition from up to eight reference images chosen from local files or from results already in the panel, at 1K-4K across eight aspect ratios, with six one-click style presets. Video: agnes-video-2.5-flash at 720p, 4-12 seconds, in three modes that the panel picks for you - plain text, keyframe (first frame, last frame, or both) and reference (up to five images) - plus an optional seed; the task is submitted to the host process, so switching panels, reloading the page and restarting the app all resume it instead of losing the job. The prompt is written into each generated PNG or JPEG and shown again when you hover the result, where one click copies it. Browse the output directory (images and videos on separate tabs) with automatic refresh, copy a path, reveal a file in Finder, or download it; the last 24 generations persist across restarts. Images and videos can also be produced from the chat itself through the agnes_image, agnes_video and agnes_video_status tools. Both the image and the video model can be switched from the panel, with a connection test, and local reference or keyframe images are sent as base64 data URIs so no public image host is needed. Needs an Agnes AI API key saved in a local file (default ~/.agnes-key.txt).
description.zh: 侧边栏 Agnes 出图与出视频面板。出图：纯文生图，或用最多 8 张参考图做图生图 / 多图合成（参考图可从本地文件选，也可直接从面板里已生成的结果中挑），1K/2K/3K/4K、8 种宽高比，另有 6 个一键风格预设。出视频：agnes-video-2.5-flash，720p、4-12 秒，支持纯文本、首帧 / 尾帧关键帧、最多 5 张参考图三种模式（面板自动判断），可选 seed；任务提交给宿主进程推进，切面板、刷新页面、重启应用都能接回进度，不会丢任务。生成时把提示词写进图片本身（PNG iTXt / JPEG COM），鼠标移到结果上就能看到并一键复制。可浏览输出目录（图片与视频分页）并在生成后自动刷新，支持复制路径、在访达中显示、下载；最近 24 条历史重启不丢。图片与视频也能在对话里通过 agnes_image、agnes_video、agnes_video_status 三个工具直接生成。图片与视频模型都可在面板切换并一键测试连接；本地参考图与关键帧以 base64 data URI 直传，不需要公网图床。需要 Agnes AI 平台的 API Key，存放在本地文件中（默认 ~/.agnes-key.txt）。

description.en: A composer-dock wallet pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows the account balance behind DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and opens a panel with the peak/off-peak billing window, a live switch countdown, and per-model token prices.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的余额胶囊：在输入框下方显示 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 对应账户的余额，点开可查看峰谷计费时段、切换倒计时与各模型价目表。

description.en: Windows x64 translator with a dedicated sidebar entry and Workbench / Chat interface, side-by-side text and document translation, screen-region translation, recent history, and host model selection, voice input and preview. CUDA document OCR with CPU fallback; screen OCR uses CPU. Do not enable the CPU and CUDA packages at the same time.
description.zh: 翻译 CUDA：Windows x64 专属翻译界面，侧栏独立入口，支持工作台／聊天切换、原文与译文双栏、尽量保留原格式的文档翻译、屏幕框选翻译及最近记录，复用宿主模型、语音输入与预览。文档 OCR 支持 CUDA 加速，无兼容 GPU 时回退 CPU；屏幕 OCR 使用 CPU。不要同时启用 CPU 与 CUDA 两个版本。

description.en: Columbina mascot for DeepSeek Harness: a 2D live pet on the desktop and inside the web panel, with four sprite sets, 76 official voice lines in Chinese, Japanese and English, weather reports, sticker moments, idle whispers, and a right-click menu for the sprite switch interval, sprite set, language and scale. Also includes quiet hours, volume with one-click mute, a searchable idle-action picker, and a power-save mode. It is a 2D-only fork of PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT) with upstream's 3D skin switching removed; it uses its own plugin id and can be installed alongside dsh-pet.
description.zh: 哥伦比娅桌宠：桌面与网页面板上都有 2D live 形象，四套形象、76 句中日英原声台词、天气播报、表情包时刻、闲暇碎碎念，右键菜单可调动图切换间隔、形象、语言与大小。另有夜间勿扰、音量与一键静音、可搜索的待机动作勾选、省电模式。本插件是 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT）的 2D 专用分支，去掉了上游的 3D 形象切换；使用独立插件 ID，可与 dsh-pet 同时安装。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH: conversations auto-distilled into atomic facts, scene summaries and a persona profile, with relevant memories injected before every model step. Zero-config out of the box — hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, optional offline local embeddings, chat/work family separation.
description.zh: dsh 长期记忆：对话自动蒸馏为原子事实、场景摘要与用户画像，每步模型调用前自动注入相关记忆。开箱零配置——BM25 + 向量混合检索，可选本地离线嵌入，chat/work 双族隔离。

description.en: Category tree for the DSH sidebar workspace browser: workspaces and their sessions nest under user-made categories (collapsed state remembered), rows drag between categories, a new workspace can be created straight into one through the directory picker, categories rename and delete in place, sessions archive and unarchive from their own row (the built-in browser's stop-active-work confirmation included) alongside a hide / show / only-archived filter, row buttons carry the app's own hover tooltips, and a footer toggle switches the panel back to the built-in list.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏工作区浏览器的分类树：工作区与其会话挂到自建分类下（折叠状态记忆），行可在分类间拖拽，新建工作区可直接落进某个分类（走系统目录选择器），分类可原地重命名与删除，会话行可归档 / 取消归档（运行中的会话走官方同款「停止并归档」确认）并配隐藏 / 含归档 / 仅归档三态筛选，行内按钮悬停有应用自带样式的提示，底栏开关可把面板切回原生列表。

description.en: Execution flow chart: renders the current session's execution as a vertical node flow (turns, user, assistant, tools, approvals, retries, compaction), appended in real time over SSE with auto-follow scrolling — the chart draws wherever the session executes.
