description.zh: 执行流程图：把当前会话的执行过程画成一条纵向节点流（回合/用户/助手/工具/审批/重试/压缩），SSE 实时追加——会话执行到哪，图就画到哪，自动跟随滚动。

description.en: Prompt optimization, next-sentence prediction, inline completion, and per-session draft stashing for the DSH input box.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框提供提示词优化、下一句预测、输入续写与当前会话草稿暂存。

description.en: Multi-select system-prompt picker behind one bolt icon in the composer: check saved rows to inject in order, each scoped to main agent, sub-agents or both; every row (the built-in 「火力全开」, "Full Throttle", included) can be edited and deleted, and Clear all only unchecks every row without deleting anything.
description.zh: 输入框工具栏一枚闪电图标后的系统提示词多选器：勾选保存的行按序注入，每行可设作用域（仅主 agent／仅子 agent／全部）；所有行（含内置「火力全开」）均可编辑和删除，「全清」只取消全部勾选、不删除任何条目。

description.en: Read-only JSONL and NDJSON viewer with a byte index, record navigation, and streaming previews for large records. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 使用字节索引逐条浏览 JSONL 与 NDJSON，支持物理行跳转和超长记录流式预览的只读查看器。要求 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Shows a Spark Scope card at the bottom of the dsh sidebar: model server decode and prefill rates with sparklines, running and queued requests, KV cache, TTFT and TPOT p95, and GPU temperature, power, load and memory for each DGX Spark node. Read-only; needs a running Spark Scope server. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧边栏底部显示 Spark Scope 卡片：模型服务的 decode 与 prefill 速率及走势图、运行中与排队请求、KV 缓存、TTFT 与 TPOT p95，以及每个 DGX Spark 节点的 GPU 温度、功耗、负载和显存。只读，需要已运行的 Spark Scope 服务。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用。

description.en: Injects a Chinese-thinking reminder around the system prompt and the per-step runtime snapshot, so the agent reasons in Simplified Chinese instead of drifting back to English as the transcript grows.
description.zh: 把中文思考提醒注入系统提示与每一步重建的运行时快照，让模型的推理全程用简体中文，不会随着会话变长漂回英文。

description.en: A starter plugin to copy from: one right-sidebar tab with two languages, behaviour tests that mount the real bundle, and CI that runs the manifest preflight.
description.zh: 可直接照抄的入门插件：一个右侧栏标签页、中英两份文案、挂载真实 bundle 的行为测试，以及会跑清单预检的 CI。

description.en: Insurance actuary — runs real actuarial calculations (life & P&C reserve valuation under C-ROSS II BEL+RM, profit testing NBV/VNB/IRR, embedded value EV, pricing & loss-triangle reserving), not just explanations.
description.zh: 保险精算师（insurance-actuary）——真跑精算测算：寿险/财险准备金评估（偿二代二期 BEL+RM）、利润测试（NBV/VNB/IRR）、内含价值(EV)、产品定价与损失三角准备金，而非仅讲解。

description.en: Codex-style sidebar: a pinned band for projects and conversations, collapsible 置顶/项目/组件 sections, a bell activity view of recently used conversations, and per-project emoji icons.
description.zh: Codex 风格侧边栏：项目和对话共用的置顶区、置顶/项目/组件 三段可折叠分区、小铃铛活动视图（含最后一条回答的预览）、可为每个项目换 Emoji 图标。

description.en: Session favorites: bookmark any conversation into a browser-style favorites panel — one-click star from session rows, folders for organization, notes, custom display names, resume session, fork into a new session, basic session stats, plus a fork-relationship graph showing how conversations derive from one another.
description.zh: 会话收藏夹：把任意会话收藏进浏览器收藏夹式的管理面板——左侧会话行一键收藏/星标，主面板支持文件夹分门别类、备注、自定义显示名、一键继续会话、Fork 新会话、会话基本统计，外加一张清晰展示会话派生关系的 fork 关系图。

description.en: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness with a session drawer and today / last-3-day / last-7-day panels, plus configurable charts and metrics.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量：会话抽屉与今日 / 近 3 天 / 近 7 天面板，图表与指标可配置。

description.en: Project board, task schedule (gantt) and project memory: sessions opened from a card auto-load the latest project STATE; persisting progress without losing facts needs python3 and is unavailable on Windows.
description.zh: 项目看板 + 任务日程（甘特图）+ 项目记忆：从卡片打开的会话自动带上项目最新记忆；一句话落盘不丢事实需要 python3，Windows 上不可用。

description.en: Personal coding assistant that schedules, follows up on and verifies local Codex or Claude Code tasks from DSH, with WeChat, WeCom and Feishu remote channels.
description.zh: 个人编码助理：在 DSH 中安排、跟进与验收本机 Codex 或 Claude Code 任务，并提供微信、企业微信与飞书远程渠道。

description.en: Study coach for DeepSeek Harness: turns a course into a knowledge map of subject, module and unit, records mastery per unit in six stages, plans daily tasks against a materials index, keeps a wrong-answer book and spaced-repetition cards, and serves its own web panel.
description.zh: DSH 的学习教练：把一门课拆成知识地图（大类 / 模块 / 最小单元），逐单元记六档掌握度，按资料索引排每日任务，带错题本与记忆卡，并自带一个网页面板。

description.en: Adds an ETA widget to the DSH web and desktop UI that estimates when the current turn will finish from the todo list and step pace, and shows the remaining time, a progress bar and a confidence badge.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页端与桌面端加一个 ETA 挂件：按 todo 清单与步进节奏估算本轮何时完成，显示剩余时长、进度条与置信度徽章。

description.en: Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.
description.zh: 通过快速或命名 Cloudflare Tunnel 为 DSH Web GUI 提供密码保护的公网访问，并代理 HTTP/WebSocket 流量、改用应用内目录选择器。

description.en: Exposes the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, so other local projects can call them with any standard OpenAI client. Multiple provider candidates share one named group with ordered, balanced or random dispatch; upstream failures before any output switch to the next candidate transparently, and rate-limited requests are retried after the provider's backoff. Per-candidate call statistics (attempts, answers, failures, token/TTFT totals) appear as badges in the settings page, and daily aggregates persist to a local file with a 30-day heatmap and trend view. Until you create a key in the UI, the endpoint accepts calls from anyone who can reach it; keys (stored as SHA-256 hashes) then turn authentication on, and the endpoint stays locked even after the last key is revoked. Exposing the optional LAN listener without a key leaves the port open to the whole network. Runs on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 through 0.1.7-alpha.1 and later.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 里已配置好的模型通过 OpenAI 兼容网关中转出去，其他本地项目 用标准 OpenAI 客户端即可调用。多个供应商候选共享一个具名分组，支持顺序、均衡、 随机三种调度；上游在产出任何内容前失败时自动切换下一候选，客户端无感，被限流的 请求按供应商指示的退避时间自动重试。每条候选的调用统计（尝试、应答、失败、 token/TTFT 累计）以徽章形式显示在设置页，按天聚合的数据落盘为本地文件，附 30 天 热力图与趋势视图。在界面创建密钥之前，接口对任何能访问到它的人开放；创建密钥 （仅存 SHA-256 哈希）后开启校验，且删掉最后一个密钥仍保持锁定，需显式关闭鉴权 才会重新开放。若启用可选的局域网监听而未配密钥，该端口对整个局域网开放。支持 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 至 0.1.7-alpha.1 及以后。

description.en: Stock workspace for eight markets (Shanghai/Shenzhen A-share, Hong Kong, NYSE and NASDAQ, Tokyo, Korea, London): grouped watchlists with pinning, drag ordering, aliases and price marks, multi-market search, quotes, K-line charts with indicators, a floating ticker and a settings view for data-source and capability routing; the page keeps its state across session switches. No trading or portfolio management. The shared client library is a normal npm dependency of this package, loaded by its own patch line.
description.zh: 股票工作台:沪/深 A 股、港股、美股 NYSE/NASDAQ、日经、韩证、伦敦八市场的自选(分组/置顶/拖拽排序/别名/价格标记)、多市场搜索、行情、K 线与指标、悬浮盯盘,以及数据源与能力路由设置;切换会话不清空页面状态。不做交易与持仓管理。公共 client 依赖是本包的普通 npm 依赖,由本包自带装载行引入。

description.en: Upload local images and files to your image host through PicGo's existing configuration (PicGo Cloud, GitHub, S3, COS, Qiniu, or any installed uploader plugin), via a `picgo_upload` tool and a `/picgo` command.
description.zh: 通过 PicGo 已有配置（PicGo Cloud、GitHub、S3、腾讯云 COS、七牛，或任意已安装的上传插件）把本地图片和文件上传到图床，提供 `picgo_upload` 工具与 `/picgo` 命令。

description.en: Liuyao divination in one click — ask a question, cast the six-line hexagram, and let AI interpret it for you; every cast is saved locally.
description.zh: 六爻起卦 · AI 解卦：遇事不决，一键摇一卦；起过的卦自动存进本机卦例库。

description.en: Connect a local Obsidian vault to DeepSeek Harness: local Markdown indexing with keyword search by default and optional hybrid or semantic search through `obsidian_*` agent tools (hybrid and semantic need an OpenAI-compatible or Ollama embedding endpoint); agent access is off until you enable the conversation switch, and note writing is approval-gated, undoable and proposal-first; the index and vectors stay on your machine.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 知识库接入 DeepSeek Harness：本地 Markdown 索引，默认关键词检索，配置 OpenAI 兼容或 Ollama 的 Embedding 接口后可用混合与语义检索；obsidian_* 工具默认拒绝 agent 访问，需在首页打开会话开关；笔记写入为需人工批准、可撤销的「先提案后写入」；索引与向量均留在本机。

description.en: Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free anonymous access.
description.zh: 面向内置 web_search 工具的多后端搜索提供方（Exa + Firecrawl）：自动故障切换、按后端 429 冷却、无密钥匿名可用。

description.en: Turn-handoff reminders in the DSH Web UI with a modal or top banner, six browser-synthesized chimes, configurable auto-dismiss, and a sidebar speaker toggle with an unread session list.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的回合交接提醒：居中弹窗或顶部横幅、六种浏览器合成提示音、可配置自动消失，以及带未读会话列表的侧栏喇叭开关。

description.en: Ten full-canvas animated backgrounds for the DSH conversation pane — starfield, code rain, circuit, sword-fight, cat, girl, fighter jet, racer, snow and bubbles — one random theme per turn, with a text-column veil that keeps the chat readable.
description.zh: 给 DSH 对话区加十种整屏动效背景——星空、代码雨、电路、华山论剑、小猫、小女生、飞机大战、赛车、飘雪、肥皂泡；每回合随机一个，正文列有纱罩保证可读。

description.en: Sign in to an xAI Grok subscription with device-code OAuth, refresh the access token, and use it as the xai route credential without an API key.
description.zh: 用设备码 OAuth 登录 xAI Grok 订阅，自动刷新访问令牌，并作为 xai 路由凭据使用，无需 API key。

description.en: Three-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness — a small always-on core block plus on-demand topic files (profile, preferences, decisions, lessons), with source-annotated writes and supersede-not-overwrite history, so preferences and project constraints stop drifting between sessions. Local-first: no vector DB, no server, no outbound calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的三层记忆：常驻小索引加按需读取的主题文件（画像、偏好、决策、教训），写入带来源标注、冲突取代留痕，让偏好与项目约束跨会话不漂移。本地优先：无向量库、无服务端、零出站。

description.en: Adds subscription OAuth and provider Plan API-key logins through Pi adapters, using a DSH-owned credential store.
description.zh: 通过 Pi 适配器接入订阅 OAuth 和厂商 Plan API Key 登录，使用独立的 DSH 凭据存储。

description.en: Personal toolbox for the dsh web profile with per-feature toggles: task-done desktop notifications, one-click restart, session deletion, plugin enable/disable, update checks, and UI utilities.
description.zh: 面向 dsh web profile 的个人工具箱，各功能可单独开关：任务完成桌面通知、一键重启、会话删除、插件启停、更新检查，以及若干界面小工具。

description.en: Settings page for per-model capabilities: reasoning-effort levels with their wire spellings, input modalities, and token capacities, written as declarations or sparse catalog overrides.
description.zh: 在设置页按模型编辑能力：推理档位及其发往端点的取值写法、输入模态与 token 容量，以声明或官方目录稀疏覆盖的形式写入。

description.en: Tool-call discipline for DeepSeek Harness with behavior prompts, failure-driven concurrency reduction and retry guidance, post-write checks with backup rollback, high-risk command gates, change summaries and verification reminders, advisory project-memory checks, configurable project-discipline reminders after compaction or at intervals, and compliance statistics.
description.zh: 工具调用纪律：提供行为提示、失败后降低并行度与重试提醒、写后检查及备份回滚、高风险命令闸门、变更摘要与验证提醒、项目记忆建议性检查、可配置的项目纪律周期重述与压缩后补充，以及遵守度统计。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling, weekly and monthly used and remaining percentage with reset times) in a floating panel anchored to the bottom-left of the session window.
description.zh: 在会话窗口左下角的悬浮面板中显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（滚动/每周/每月的已用与剩余百分比及重置时间）。

description.en: Production pack for ComfyUI inside DeepSeek Harness: submit API-format workflows to a local or remote server, batch-generate and fetch outputs, and diagnose bad images with measured parameter ranges and a failure-mode decision tree (black frames, duplicated subjects, color fringes, OOM).
description.zh: ComfyUI 在 DeepSeek Harness 里的生产包：向本地或远程服务提交 API 格式工作流、批量出图并取回产物，附实测参数区间与崩图排查决策树（黑图、主体重复、彩边、显存不足）。

description.en: Two-way Codex↔DSH bridge: skills from ~/.codex/skills, session import with workspace attach, live MCP mirroring of mcp_servers, and a Codex-side reverse MCP installer.
description.zh: Codex 与 DSH 双向桥接：挂载 ~/.codex/skills、带工作区绑定的会话导入、mcp_servers 实时镜像，以及 Codex 端反向 MCP 安装器。

description.en: Kimi-Code-style swarm: batch-parallel subagent dispatch with adaptive scheduling, a /swarm command, and in-chat live progress rows.
description.zh: Kimi Code 风格 swarm：批量并行子 Agent 调度（自适应并发）、/swarm 命令与聊天内实时进度条。

description.en: What it does while she sleeps, in one card. Two things: (1) tidy the element memory — merge synonyms only when the model agrees, trim descriptions, prune weak links, propose analogies for the user to confirm, with a backup before every write and a 15%-of-library cap per pass; (2) dream — stitch her own past experiences (plus props from the element memory) into a short 3–6 sentence story, leave one line on her desk as a note labelled "this is a dream, not something that happened". The dream lives in its own file and never enters her memory or her personality prompt. Requires @ssamurias/dsh-fish for her event stream and dsh-memory-brain for the element library; model-approved merges and dreams need a local Ollama model (or a paid API key).
description.zh: 她睡着时的两件事，装在同一个设置页里。① 睡眠整理：模型点头才合并同义词，压短描述，剪掉弱边，把元素组合成猜想请用户确认；每次写入前先备份，单次改库不超过全库 15%。② 潜意识梦：拿她自己经历过的旧事（加上元素库里的"道具"）拼成 3–6 句的小故事，在桌上留一句并标明「是梦，不是发生过的事」。梦只存在自己的文件里，不进她的记忆，也不进她的人格提示词。需已装 @ssamurias/dsh-fish（提供经历）与 dsh-memory-brain（元素记忆库）；模型复判与做梦还需要本地 ollama（或付费 API）。

description.en: Skill management: lists skills in global and per-project scopes and toggles each one per project; a disabled skill is not injected into that session (npm: `dsh-my-skill-manager`).
description.zh: Skill 管理：按全局 / 项目两个范围查看 skill 列表，并按项目启用或禁用；被禁用的 skill 不会注入该会话（npm: `dsh-my-skill-manager`）。

description.en: Customizes the native settings window: preset or custom window sizes, fullscreen, background transparency, and theme, solid-color, or image backgrounds, with a floating ball for quick access; saved in the local browser.
description.zh: 设置界面自定义：调整原生设置窗口大小（全屏/预置大尺寸/自定义宽高）、背景透明度与背景（主题/自定义颜色/图片），悬浮球即开即调，存本机浏览器。

description.en: Strips DSML markers that leak into assistant prose and resumes a turn only when a "continue" genuinely helps — a no-output marker leak, local or upstream network blips, a single-reply output token cap (max-tokens), and empty or stream errors — with message-level classification for codes upstream miscategorises and a default cap of 3 consecutive failures that any normal reply resets; quota, rate-limit, auth and context-window errors, and user aborts, never resume. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3.0, and Node 20 or newer.
description.zh: 抹掉漏进助手正文的 DSML 标记；只在发「继续」确实有用时补一条——毫无产出的标记泄漏、本机或上游网络波动、单次回复输出 token 到顶（max-tokens）、空响应或流中断——并对被上游误分类的错误码按报文细分；默认连续 3 次失败后停下，任何正常回复都会清零。额度、限流、鉴权、上下文总体超限与人为取消一律不续。适用 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 起、0.3.0 以下，Node 20 起。

description.en: Insurance company operations analyst — runs real solvency, profitability, embedded value (EV), investment risk and regulatory compliance calculations, not just text explanations.
description.zh: 保险公司经营分析专家（盈安），真跑偿付能力、盈利能力、内含价值(EV)、投资风险与监管合规五维测算。

description.en: Local-only telemetry service for DSH plugins: records operation trails and error events into a storage-domain KV table, applies a configurable redaction rule set before the write and again when the analysis reads back a record stored before a rule existed, and groups one plugin's failures by feature-code anchor, reporting the window it read, the route each group ran on, and the attempts recorded after its last failure in write order.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件的本地遥测服务：把操作轨迹与错误事件写入 storage-domain KV 表，在写入前按可配置的规则集脱敏，并在分析读回早于规则存在的旧记录时再次按同一规则集脱敏，然后按功能码锚点聚合单个插件的失败事件，同时报告读取的时间窗口、每个失败组的模型路由，以及按写入顺序统计的最近一次失败之后的尝试次数。

description.en: Rolecard-engineering toolkit for SillyTavern: 23 bundled skills, a host front door, a selectable agent preset and a browser panel in one DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: 面向 SillyTavern 角色卡工程的工具包：23 个技能、Host Front Door、可选 agent 预设和浏览器面板，打包成一个 DSH 插件。

description.en: Wraps Python virtual environment management commands: reduces the network and permission problems agents hit when managing environments through terminal commands, works across operating systems, and routes installs automatically through mirrors and local proxies. The tools are strictly confined by the granted read/write permissions.
description.zh: 封装了Python虚拟环境管理指令，减少Agent使用终端指令管理环境时遇到的网络问题和权限问题，兼容不同操作系统，工具内部设置自动网络与镜像路由。工具严格受给定读写权限限制。

description.en: Turn-rail settings for the DSH conversation locator: tick thickness, rail on the left or right, a curved length gradient on the hovered tick, and a plain-text hover preview with adjustable line count, font size and width.
description.zh: DSH 对话定位条的轮次轨道设置：刻度粗细、轨道在左还是在右、锚在悬停那根的曲线长度渐变，以及行数、字号、宽度都可调的纯文本悬停预览。

description.en: Makes 1080x1920 vertical promo videos from a storyboard JSON with 7 tools (doctor, setup, catalog, guide, validate, render, verify), rendered locally with Remotion.
description.zh: 从分镜 JSON 生成 1080×1920 竖版宣传片，含 7 个工具（doctor、setup、catalog、guide、validate、render、verify），用 Remotion 本地渲染。

description.en: Local-first content production and operations workspace for DSH: manage ideas, scripts, media assets, schedules, goals, publishing status, and post-publication reviews.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地内容生产与运营工作台：管理灵感、脚本、媒体资产、档期、目标、发布状态和发布后复盘。

description.en: Choose which shell backs the Windows terminal tool: PowerShell, the local Git Bash, or cmd.exe.
description.zh: 选择 Windows 终端工具背后的 shell：PowerShell、本地 Git Bash 或 cmd.exe。

description.en: Turn codebase smells into an executable, priority-ordered refactoring plan: file-length / deep-nesting / function-length / god-object heuristics plus a staged runbook (read-only, no auto-rewrite).
description.zh: 重构入口诊断：把代码库坏味道（超长文件/深嵌套/超长函数/上帝对象）转成带定位、优先级与依赖顺序的重构计划（只读不自动改码）。

description.en: Adds COS storage browsing and transfers, workspace artifact uploads, temporary links, and conversation attachments that retain local copies with cloud object identity, plus Agent tools for Tencent Cloud COS, CI, and MetaInsight.
description.zh: 提供 COS 云存储浏览与传输、工作区产物上传、临时链接，以及同时保留本地副本和云端对象身份的会话附件，并提供腾讯云 COS、数据万象和 MetaInsight 的 Agent 工具。

description.en: Adds Korean (한국어) as a native option in Settings - General - Language and translates all 2,775 Web UI strings of dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.2, experimental features included. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置 - 通用设置 - 语言」加入韩语（한국어），翻译 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-alpha.2 Web UI 的全部 2,775 条文案，包括实验功能。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用。

description.en: A project-scoped memory plugin for DSH. Knowledge authoring and the plugin's own prompts are open to editing, so users can redesign the library structure and how the model is driven without changing a line of code. By default the library is built on one core idea: a project document you design yourself (a handoff by default) is the project entity; the plugin detects which project a session belongs to, binds captured knowledge to that project, and promotes what generalizes into theme and global layers. The most natural logic there is does the pre-filtering of knowledge, with controllable compression and archiving of context.
description.zh: 以项目为主线的 DSH 记忆插件。开放知识书写，以及插件提示词编辑，让用户不改一行代码就能重新设计记忆库结构与模型被驱动的方式。默认的记忆库核心设计在于，项目以一份你自己设计的项目文档（默认是一份交接文档）作为实体，插件自动识别会话所属项目、把沉淀的知识与项目绑定，并把可复用的部分升级进主题与全局层。用最自然的逻辑完成知识的初筛，上下文可控压缩和留档。

description.en: Animated whale background for the DSH Web UI: a particle field sampled from the whale silhouette plus a dot-grid layer, both full-screen click-through canvases mounted in the shell.overlay seat; the particles gather on load, breathe when idle and are pushed away from the pointer, the grid dots swell near it, and the palette follows the page light/dark theme.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面加的一层动态鲸鱼背景：由鲸鱼剪影采样出的粒子场，加上一层点阵网格，两者都是挂在 shell.overlay 上的全屏点击穿透 canvas；粒子加载时聚合、空闲时呼吸、指针靠近时被推开，网格点靠近指针会放大，配色跟随页面明暗主题。

description.en: Watches download commands (git clone, package-manager installs, curl) and, when one overruns its budget, aborts it and writes a switch-source advisory into the tool result, so the agent retries from another mirror instead of waiting on a dead one. Timeouts are set per kind of work, and acting versus only reporting is switched per scene. A supervisor indicator reacts while something is stalled.
description.zh: 盯着下载类命令（git clone、包管理器安装、curl），超出预算就中止，并把一句换源建议写进工具结果，让智能体换个镜像重试而不是对着死源干等。超时按工作类型分别设置，「动手换源」与「只提示」按场景独立开关；另有一个只在卡顿时反应的监督员指示器。

description.en: Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness: control which skills and MCP servers new sessions load, per project.
description.zh: 按工作区（工程）启停 Skill 与 MCP：每个项目单独控制新会话加载哪些技能与 MCP 工具。

description.en: An event-stream driven personality that grows over time, not a configurable character card or assistant. Registers the same tools as dsh-fish (her_recall, growth_commit and others), so do not install it alongside dsh-fish.
description.zh: 一个由事件流驱动、只能长大不能被设定的人格，而非可配置的角色卡或助手。注册同名工具（her_recall、growth_commit 等），因此不要与 dsh-fish 同装。

description.en: Speaks your agent's reports in a voice you choose, compressing long reports before speaking. Character voices need no training - a 3-10 second reference clip clones one, and community-trained models work too - and no 6.4 GB GPT-SoVITS install: the plugin installs its own runtime and voice. An existing GPT-SoVITS can be used instead, and it is the same voice model.
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 用你喜欢的声音开口说话、汇报内容，过长的汇报先压缩再念。角色声线不需要自己训练：一段 3-10 秒参考音就能克隆，也能直接用别人训练好的模型；不必为此装一整套 6.4 GB 的 GPT-SoVITS —— 运行时和声线都由插件自己装好。已有 GPT-SoVITS 的话也能直接接上，两者跑的是同一套声线。

description.en: Import Agent Skills from Git repositories, group them by repository, and enable or disable each one in DSH settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中从 Git 仓库导入 Agent Skills，按仓库分组管理，并逐项启用或停用。

description.en: DeepSeek API billing-period chip in the composer dock: shows whether the current time is peak or off-peak with a countdown to the next rate switch, opens the peak/off-peak window rules on click, and during peak hours intercepts sending to ask for confirmation first.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek API 当前计费时段（高峰/空闲）与距下次切换的倒计时，点击可展开高峰/空闲时段规则；高峰时段发送消息前会先拦截并弹出确认。

description.en: Refines the built-in cache-hit percentage to three decimals in place across the composer stats row and the token-usage dialog.
description.zh: 把内置缓存命中率在 composer 统计行与 Token 用量弹窗中原位精化为三位小数。

description.en: Normalizes every generated .docx to one Chinese official-document layout: XiaoBiaoSong title, FangSong body at a fixed 29pt leading with zero paragraph spacing, character-unit 2-character first-line indent, fully centered table cells with repeating header rows, and a centered footer page number. Long attachment entries are split into real paragraphs at the wrap point measured by Word, producing a 2 / 6 / 5 / 6 character indent ladder. It applies the layout only when the request mentions 公文 (official document) and writes no signature block unless asked.
description.zh: 把生成的 .docx 统一到一套中文公文版式：方正小标宋标题、仿宋正文 29 磅固定行距、段前段后 0、字符单位首行缩进 2 字符，表格每个单元格都水平居中并带重复表头，页脚居中「— 1 —」页码。附件长条目按 2 / 6 / 5 / 6 字符缩进阶梯自动分段，折行点由 Word 实测得到。只有请求里提到「公文」时才套用版式，用户没有明确要求时默认不写落款。

description.en: A defensive agentic coding workflow for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+ featuring deterministic machine testing, an independent reviewer and a human merge gate.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+ 的防御性智能体编程工作流：包含确定性机器测试、独立审查者与人类终审闸门。

description.en: Generative background music while the model streams, plus completion, approval and attention chimes: hear whether the agent is thinking, still working, or waiting for you without watching the screen.
description.zh: 模型输出时演奏生成式背景音乐，完成、审批与等待操作各有独立提示音：不盯屏幕也能听出 Agent 在思考、仍在工作还是在等你。

description.en: Single/multi-line composer toggle for the DSH Web GUI: an editable shortcut (registered through the harness shortcut service) — Cmd/Ctrl+E on desktop builds and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E in the browser, with Linux browsers unbound until you pick one — switches the composer between its native single-line shape and a four-line-plus draft area; a small tab on the composer shoulder always shows the current shortcut and target mode; while multi-line, Enter inserts a newline and Shift+Enter sends, and the mode is remembered per device.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框单行/多行切换：通过官方快捷键服务注册的可编辑快捷键（桌面版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+E，浏览器版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E，Linux 浏览器默认未绑定） 在原生单行输入框与至少四行的多行输入框之间切换；输入框上沿的小 tab 常驻显示当前快捷键与目标模式；多行时 Enter 换行、Shift+Enter 发送，模式按设备记忆。

description.en: Local themed achievements, badges and character collections for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在本地记录 DeepSeek Harness 主题成就、勋章与角色收藏。

description.en: Let a local DeepSeek Harness Agent use BailingHub to query data, update records, and run permitted actions in an online store, SaaS, or other admin system.
description.zh: 让本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 BailingHub，直接操作商城、SaaS 或其他业务系统后台，在现有账号权限内查询数据、修改资料并执行已开放的操作。

description.en: Model-driven context compaction for DeepSeek Harness. The agent decides when and what to compress, commits durable session-log replacements, and ships reversible tool-result compression with byte-exact hash retrieval.
description.zh: 由模型主导的 DeepSeek Harness 上下文压缩：由 agent 决定何时压缩、压缩什么，以持久化会话日志替换提交，并提供可逆的工具结果压缩与逐字节哈希取回。

description.en: Goal Map shows a read-only goal-to-plan progress route, session mindmap and step list using reported plan progress, without starting tasks or model calls. Beta.2 supports DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.2, with Node.js >=24.
description.zh: 目标进展图以只读流程图展示目标到计划的进展路线、会话思维导图与步骤列表，按已报告计划计算进度，不启动任务或模型调用。Beta.2 支持 DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2 或 0.2.1-rc.2、Node.js >=24。

description.en: GitHub issue service for DSH: turns a telemetry failure analysis into a uniform issue report, builds a pre-filled new-issue URL that is shortened when it would exceed a configured length budget, rewrites a plain description into a structured issue with the deployment's model, and closes the intake loop by listing the open issues that carry a claim label and handing each one to a fresh session as a one-shot automation task on the host's Schedule service, which delivers the rendered prompt into that session when the task comes due and shows up on the Web Automation tasks page (a host with no Schedule service admits the prompt directly instead), skipping issues an earlier pass already dispatched, leaving the local day uncommitted when every dispatch is refused so the next startup tries again, and repeating the pass on the first start of each local day when autopilot is enabled.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 GitHub issue 服务：把遥测失败分析整理成统一格式的 issue 报告，构造预填的新建 issue 链接并在超出配置长度时裁剪正文，用部署配置的模型把一段自然语言描述改写为结构化 issue，也打通接单闭环——按认领标签列出可接的 issue，为每个 issue 新建会话并登记成宿主 Schedule 服务上的一次性自动化任务（出现在 Web 自动化任务页，到点把渲染好的提示词送进该会话；宿主没有 Schedule 服务时直接排入提示词），跳过此前已经派发过的 issue，若一轮派发全部被拒则不记下当天以便下次启动重试，开启自动驾驶后在每个本地日的首次启动时自动跑一轮。

description.en: Manage MCP servers and skills in DeepSeek Harness, and control which tools enter the next prompt.
description.zh: 管理 MCP 服务器与 Skill，并控制下一轮 prompt 带入哪些工具。

description.en: Offline civil-service exam study panel integrating 16 upstream open-source question banks with SRS wrong-book, mock exams, essay grading, an interactive knowledge graph and whitebox observability, plus a HuaSheng-13 methodology view (25 documents) with BM25 search. The npm package ships no question-bank or corpus data: after install, the question-bank manager clones the required set (about 360 MB, needs git) from the upstream repos (all 16 are about 2.2 GB).
description.zh: 离线公务员备考学习面板，整合 16 个上游开源题库，提供 SRS 错题本、整卷模考、申论离线评改、可交互知识图谱与白盒可观测，另有花生十三体系方法论视图（25 篇）与 BM25 检索。npm 包不含题库与语料数据：安装后由题库管理用 git 从上游克隆必选包（约 360 MB，需要 git），16 个上游仓库全量约 2.2 GB。

description.en: Adds a row of category tabs on top of the @ reference menu so candidates can be filtered by kind.
description.zh: 在 @ 引用菜单顶部加一排类别标签，点标签只看该类候选。

description.en: Context-window attribution for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that ranks the user messages, assistant turns, reasoning blocks and tool results of a session by the tokens each one occupies, so it is clear which entries hold the window. It also shows the share by entry type, the heaviest entries across the live sessions of the host, and, where the host provides them, provider usage and the estimated system/tools/messages composition. The panel is read-only: it does not estimate cost, modify a session, or trigger compaction.
description.zh: DSH Web 的上下文窗口归因插件：Mini Utility Dock 面板按各自占用的 token 给会话内的用户消息、助手回复、推理块和工具结果排序，一眼看出窗口被哪些条目占住。面板还显示各条目类型的占比、本机各 live session 里最重的条目，并在宿主提供时显示 provider usage 与 system/tools/messages 的估算构成。面板只读：不估算费用、不修改会话、不触发 compaction。

description.en: Automatic context compaction: a background observer distills early history into summary blocks, and when usage crosses the trigger line the engine commits whole blocks until it is back under the target line, with no model call on the commit path. Blocks merge into higher tiers as material runs out, and decompress or search_context reads any block back at its original length. The background observer spends model tokens: it uses the session's provider and model unless you pick another, with up to 10 distillations at once by default.
description.zh: 自动压缩上下文：后台观察者提前把早期历史蒸成摘要块，占用越过触发线时逐块提交直到回到目标线以下，提交路径不调模型；材料用尽后块可合并成更高层，decompress 与 search_context 可按块读回原文。后台观察者会消耗模型 token：默认沿用会话的 provider 与 model（可另选），默认最多同时进行 10 个蒸馏。

description.en: Voice call assistant for the DSH desktop app and the Web GUI (the same plugin, only the profile name differs): a draggable floating call ball, browser-side VAD that sends each utterance after a pause, speech recognition through the local SenseVoice model already downloaded by the official voice-input plugin (no second model), FunASR HTTP or streaming, or a cloud-compatible API, MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS (director mode and voice clone) / OpenAI-compatible TTS replies, an optional wake-word mode with auto-sleep, and task dispatch to separate sessions with progress, stop, and spoken completion reports.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端与 Web GUI 通用（同一份插件，只是 profile 名不同）的个人语音通话助手：可拖拽悬浮球通话面板、浏览器端 VAD（停顿自动发送）、语音识别可选本地 SenseVoice（复用官方「语音输入」插件已下载的模型，免装第二份模型）/ FunASR HTTP 或流式 / 云端兼容 API、MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS（含导演模式与音色克隆）/ OpenAI 兼容 TTS 语音回复、可开关的唤醒词模式（沉默自动休眠），以及把任务分发给独立子会话并跟踪进度、停止与完成播报。

description.en: Network proxy settings page for DeepSeek Harness: set a global HTTP(S) proxy with bypass hosts, or give each LLM provider its own proxy or a direct connection; changes apply on save without a restart.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网络代理设置页：配置全局 HTTP(S) 代理及免代理主机，或为单个 LLM 提供商单独指定代理或直连；保存即生效，无需重启。

description.en: Ctrl+F find-in-session for the conversation, powered by the session store rather than the DOM - labels every hit by source (you / assistant / reasoning / tool call / tool result / system), groups results by turn, merges identical snippets, offers prose-vs-everything scope, regex / case / whole-word options, highlights all matches, and copies or exports the result set as Markdown.
description.zh: 会话内 Ctrl+F 全文查找（读会话 store 而非 DOM）：命中按来源分类（你/助手/思考/工具调用/工具输出/系统）、按轮次分组、同文合并，可切「只搜正文 / 搜全部内容」，支持正则/大小写/全词，全量高亮，并能把结果复制或导出为 Markdown。

description.en: In-session cd for DeepSeek Harness: re-base relative paths on the fly (the file tools and the bash/pwsh default workdir follow) or move the session to another workspace for real — a `cd {"workspace": true, "confirmed": true}` call the user has agreed to, or the user's own `/cd <directory>` command, relocates the session's stored log, sandbox root, AGENTS.md and skill discovery and sidebar grouping. Per-session, persisted across restarts, without moving the session for a plain re-base.
description.zh: 会话内 cd：即时切换相对路径基准（文件工具与 bash / pwsh 默认工作目录跟随），或把会话真正搬到另一个工作区——经用户同意的 `cd {"workspace": true, "confirmed": true}` 或用户自己的 `/cd <目录>` 命令，会迁移会话日志存储位置、沙箱根、AGENTS.md 与 skills 发现根以及侧边栏分组；按会话隔离、跨重启恢复，单纯换基准时不动会话身份。

description.en: Windows desktop control exposed as native DSH tools - whole-screen and single-window capture (the window one goes through PrintWindow, so a covered window still captures), click, drag, typing, keyboard shortcuts, scrolling, window management, pixel and window polling, and UIA queries that can invoke a control or read its value instead of clicking coordinates. 13 tools over a PowerShell 7 child process; no MCP server, no resident process, no API key.
description.zh: 以 DSH 原生工具形式提供的 Windows 桌面控制——整屏与单窗口截图（单窗口走 PrintWindow，窗口被遮住也能抓）、点击、拖动、打字、按键、滚动、窗口管理、像素与窗口轮询，以及可直接 invoke 控件或读取控件值的 UIA 查询（不必点坐标）。13 个工具，跑在 PowerShell 7 子进程上；不需要 MCP 服务器、无常驻进程、无 API key。

description.en: Claude Code-style sidebar for the macOS desktop app: hovering the collapsed sidebar toggle peeks the sidebar over the content, selecting a session collapses it, clicking the toggle pins it; plus back/forward session history arrows (⌘\[ / ⌘]).
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的侧栏（macOS 桌面版）：悬停在折叠的侧栏按钮上即可将侧栏浮层展开，选择会话后自动收起，点击按钮固定；另有会话历史前进/后退箭头（⌘\[ / ⌘]）。

description.en: Emotion, energy and per-user portrait engine for AI characters: a 303-word emotion library scored in two steps (pick one of 6 categories first, then choose within it), novelty reward and same-word cooldown for diversity, a spirit meter with easter-egg state transitions (excited / suppressed / angry), and per-user portraits. File mode works with any AI; the optional OneBot mode reads friend message history from a OneBot 11 endpoint such as NapCat. Requires your own OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint and API key (EMOTION_LLM_KEY or emotion/config.json).
description.zh: 给 AI 角色的情绪·状态·人物画像引擎：303 情绪词分两步打分（先定 6 大类再在类内选词），冷门探索奖励 + 同类冷却保证情绪多样性，精神值阶梯 + 彩蛋式状态跃迁（亢奋/压抑/生气），按人画像，file/onebot 双模式。需要自备 OpenAI 兼容的 LLM 地址与 API Key（环境变量 EMOTION_LLM_KEY，或 emotion/config.json 的 llm 配置）。

description.en: Adds the models available in a signed-in WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness as a model provider, with the CN and international apps as separate groups. It is a rebuilt derivative of the npm package dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9 (originally corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect); it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 中的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，国内版与国际版各自成组。它基于 npm 包 dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9（原 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect）的构建产物改出，注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。

description.en: Open the extension side panel and it takes over the page you are browsing right now. On top of upstream it adds: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched action chains, whole-page screenshots, local file upload, image listing, and switching between several connected browsers. Pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list; actions wait for your approval and sensitive fields stay masked. Ships as the bridge plugin, with the extension in the same release. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser
description.zh: 打开浏览器扩展侧边栏，就能原地接管你当前正在浏览的网页。在上游基础上补齐了：悬停、坐标点击、拖拽、批量动作链、整页截图、本地文件上传、图片地址列举，并可在多个已连接的浏览器之间切换。页面以带编号的结构化文本交给模型；动作默认需要你批准，敏感字段以掩码呈现。发布的是桥接插件，配套扩展在同一 Release 里。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 的 fork，原仓库：https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

description.en: Project and session board in the native right sidebar, a floating session list, a keyboard-first command palette over sessions, projects and settings, and task notifications.
description.zh: 在原生右侧栏提供项目与会话看板，另有悬浮会话列表、键盘优先的命令面板（可搜索会话、项目与设置），以及任务通知。

description.en: Remote control for DeepSeek Harness over an outbound Huawei Cloud DevBridge tunnel: a sidebar seat and a standalone control page start and stop the tunnel and show its public URL, QR code and logs. The plugin's own gateway stays on 127.0.0.1, checks a rotatable access token or HMAC session cookie, rate-limits failures and strips external identity headers before forwarding to DSH, so no inbound port is opened. The tunnel is off by default; tokens and state stay under ~/.dsh. Requires a Huawei Cloud account and devbridge CLI v0.2.x. The relay terminates TLS and can see plaintext HTTP — this is access control, not end-to-end encryption.
description.zh: 把本机 DSH 的 Web 界面经华为云 DevBridge 出站隧道交给远端设备远控：侧边栏席位与独立控制页负责开启、停止隧道，并显示公网链接、二维码与日志。插件自带的鉴权网关只监听 127.0.0.1，转发前校验可轮换的访问令牌或 HMAC 会话 Cookie、限制失败次数并剥离外部身份头，因此不开放任何入站端口。隧道默认关闭，令牌与状态只留在本机 ~/.dsh。需要华为云账号与 devbridge CLI v0.2.x。中继会终止公网 TLS，能看到到达网关的明文 HTTP——这是访问控制，不是端到端加密。

description.en: Turn your phone into a full-featured camera for dsh sessions (requires the open-source Android companion app — install the plugin and scan the QR code it shows to download the APK): 1. Live viewfinder over LAN or USB, injectable into the chat or savable to a folder. 2. Callable tools let the dsh model take photos, zoom, and switch lenses on demand mid-conversation, so in fully automated workflows the model can actively "see" the physical world. 3. Full zoom/flash, crop, and annotation. 4. Rich settings.
description.zh: 手机变 dsh 会话的全功能摄像头（需配合开源的 Android 手机 App——安装插件后扫插件提供的二维码即可下载 APK）：1. 局域网或 USB 直连实时取景，画面可直接注入对话框或保存到指定位置；2. 提供可调用工具，dsh 模型可在流式对话中按需主动拍照/变焦/切换镜头，便于全自动开发中模型主动"看见"物理世界；3. 提供完整的变焦/闪光灯、照片裁剪、标注等功能；4. 提供丰富的设置选项。

description.en: dsh port of the shared handoff kit: handoff and task-id-bootstrap skills plus host-side automation — baseline state injection, per-turn snapshots with an Auto Log trail, task=<id> routing, continuation re-injection, a compaction guard with clear-required alerts, and read-only subagent handling — all writing the same .agents/state/ as the Codex, Claude, and pi editions for one-repo multi-agent handoff.
description.zh: 共享交接套件的 dsh 版:handoff 与 task-id-bootstrap 技能 + host 侧自动化——基线状态注入、每轮快照与 Auto Log 轨迹、task=<id> 路由、续接关键词重注入、达阈值报警的压缩守护、子代理只读保护;与 Codex、Claude、pi 版写同一份 .agents/state/,一个仓库多代理共享交接。

description.en: Customize the username (phone number or email) and avatar shown at the bottom-left account row — for personalization, or to keep screenshots from exposing them. The editor opens from the menu you get by clicking that row.
description.zh: 自定义左下角账号处的用户名（手机号/邮箱）和头像，从而提升个性化或避免截图泄露隐私。编辑入口位于点击此处的菜单内。

description.en: Desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: a Win32 layered window that keeps a whale-girl above other applications, speaks through a bubble, comments on its own when you stay on one window for ten seconds, and answers a single question typed into a right-click input box.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面桌宠：一个 Win32 分层窗口，让鲸鱼娘待在别的应用窗口之上，气泡说话；你在同一个窗口停够十秒它会自己开口，右键弹出的输入框里可以问它一个问题。

description.en: Tavily-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, result count, and recency window.
description.zh: 基于 Tavily 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量与时间窗口的设置卡片。

description.en: Government data inspector covering completeness, accuracy and timeliness metrics.
description.zh: 政务数据巡检工具，覆盖数据完整率、准确率、时效率等核心指标。

description.en: Carry durable task state across DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex with machine-readable checkpoints and optimistic locking.
description.zh: 通过机器可读检查点与乐观锁，在 DeepSeek Harness、WorkBuddy、Claude Code 和 Codex 之间交接持久任务状态。

description.en: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit trail.
description.zh: 诊断并安全修复损坏的 DSH 会话历史：raw zstd/JSONL 校验、tool-call ID 修复、单槽 pre-repair 备份与恢复、审计记录。

description.en: Session operations for DeepSeek Harness: really delete persisted sessions (ungrouped, temp, archive and subagent filters; guards on running, live and workspace sessions) and move sessions between workspaces (log relocation, header.cwd rewrite, workspace registry follow). Ships the shared session-store library.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话运维：真正删除持久化会话（未分组、临时、归档、子代理四种筛选；运行中、仍在宿主加载中与属于工作区的会话默认拒绝删除），并在工作区之间搬迁会话（日志迁移、header.cwd 改写、workspace 注册表跟随）。内含共享的会话存储库。

description.en: Adds an avatar to the left of each turn's final AI reply and to the right of each user message; upload your own image and set its size and circle or square frame.
description.zh: 在每轮 AI 回复左侧与你的每条输入右侧各显示一个头像，可上传自己的图片并设置尺寸与圆形/方形头像框。

description.en: Vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text through a configurable model (15+ OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic vendors) while DeepSeek keeps answering.
description.zh: 视觉模型路由：把附加图片经可配置模型（15+ OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 供应商）转译为文字，对话仍由 DeepSeek 作答。

description.en: Codex conversation panel for DeepSeek Harness: lists local Codex threads, renders their history, and sends messages back to the original thread through the Codex CLI. Needs the Codex CLI and Python installed locally.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用 Codex CLI 重建 Codex 对话窗口：浏览本机线程、查看历史，并通过 CLI 把消息发回原线程。需要本机已安装 Codex CLI 与 Python。

description.en: Ships the Zhouli-mode agent preset, which runs a session in three phases (declaring roles on opening, citing authorities while working, a six-item self-audit at the close), plus one tool with seven actions over a bundled 49,384-character 《周礼》 corpus that returns every passage with a stable 篇序.职官序 coordinate, a per-office establishment index and collation between two Kanripo witnesses.
description.zh: 主打「周礼模式」agent 预设：会话分三段依六官法度而行——开工「设官分职」、事中「依典援据」、收尾「岁终之会」依六计考成。另附 zhouli 工具，七种检索动作，检索内置 49,384 字《周礼》语料，每条结果带稳定坐标（篇序.职官序），含职官员额索引与 Kanripo 两本互校勘记。

description.en: Bridges LobsterAI (Youdao Lobster) into DSH: its free daily check-in credits become usable inside DeepSeek Harness, so conversations, workflows and skill packs run on those credits. Requires the LobsterAI desktop app (Windows); new-account login and gateway sync need the separate LobsterDaddy console (not in this repo). Unmaintained since 2026-10-21.
description.zh: 把 LobsterAI（有道龙虾）桥接进 DSH：免费签到积分直接接进 DSH 对话，用这些额度跑对话、工作流与技能包。需 LobsterAI 桌面端（Windows）；登录新账号与同步网关需另装 LobsterDaddy 控制台（不在本仓库）。作者已于 2026-10-21 停止维护。

description.en: Git sidebar panel with commit graphs, ahead/behind tracking, branch operations, and one-click chat context injection.
description.zh: Git 侧边栏面板：提交图谱、超前/落后跟踪、分支操作及改动 Diff 一键带入对话。

description.en: Floating todo panel in the DSH Web UI — a draggable window that snaps to any screen edge, today/more grouping in the home tab, a separate all-items tab with uncompleted/completed filters and incremental loading, items that open read-only with an edit toggle in the corner, image attachments that zoom in place and other files that download, a pomodoro timer (15/30/45/60 or custom, with configurable rounds and break interval) that sends a Windows notification and waits for confirmation before the next phase, and five agent tools plus a /todo slash command for reading and editing the list.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的浮动待办面板——窗口可拖动并吸附屏幕四边，首页按「今天/更多」分组，另有全部事项标签页（未完成/已完成筛选、增量加载），条目默认只读查看、点右上角「编辑」才可修改，图片附件点击放大、其它附件点击下载，内置番茄钟（15/30/45/60 或自定义，可设轮数与休息间隔）到点推送 Windows 通知并在进入下一阶段前等待确认，另提供 5 个 agent 工具与 /todo 斜杠命令读写任务。

description.en: Saves tokens in DeepSeek Harness sessions by reading any file by line range or symbol mention instead of whole, and by bounding oversized tool results while keeping a recovery path. Pruning happens at the source, not after content reaches the context. Measured 43.9% fewer prompt tokens in a modelled 30-step session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话节省 token：按行号或符号定位读取文件而不是整份读，并对过大的工具结果设上限且保留取回路径。修剪发生在源头，而不是内容进入上下文之后。在建模的 30 步会话上实测 prompt tokens 减少 43.9%。

description.en: Two games inside DeepSeek Harness where the model supplies intent and a local engine owns the rules: a twin-brain snake that periodically draws a strategy card, and Chinese chess where the model only comments on a move picked from locally generated legal candidates. Both keep running when the model is slow, offline or out of quota.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里玩游戏，分工是模型负责「想」、本地引擎负责「动」：双脑贪吃蛇会周期性抽一张策略卡；中国象棋里模型只从本地生成的合法候选着法里挑一个并解说。模型变慢、断网或额度用尽时，两个游戏都照常运行。

description.en: Source-install updater for DeepSeek Harness: checks the official GitHub release and the npm record, builds the target tag in an isolated directory, smoke-starts it, then switches through a supervisor process with rollback, with scheduled checks and a daily idle-only install window. Source install only (macOS/Linux); requires Node.js 22.19+, pnpm and Git.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 源码安装的更新插件：核对官方 GitHub 发布与 npm 记录，在独立目录构建目标版本并试启动，再由监督进程切换、失败回滚，支持定时检查与每日空闲安装时段。仅支持源码安装（macOS/Linux）；需 Node.js 22.19+、pnpm 与 Git。

description.en: Digital Earth: opens a 3D globe beside the chat where you can load city models or drone-scanned scenes, measure distances, take screenshots, and run flood or sunlight analysis — or just ask the AI to do it (3D Tiles / 3DGS).
description.zh: 数字地球：在对话旁边打开三维地球，加载城市模型或实景三维数据就能浏览；量距离、截图、做淹没和日照分析，也可以一句话让 AI 代劳（支持 3D Tiles / 3DGS）。

description.en: Read-only side branch in the right sidebar: quote text to ask follow-ups without polluting the model context of the main session; every follow-up rebuilds the branch from the latest settled turns of the main session, and writes are refused at the tool-execution layer so the prompt prefix stays cacheable.
description.zh: 右侧栏的只读侧枝会话：划选文字即可追问，答案不进入主会话的模型上下文；每轮追问都用主会话最新的已结算内容重建，写操作在执行层被拒，以保住提示词前缀缓存。

description.en: Thinking-sorting plugin. A switch beside the composer puts the session into a three-stage mode — sort, critique, research — and each stage has a checklist of what it should produce before you press the advance button; finished ideas are filed by genre into Settings → Thoughts Center. A floating notebook holds half-formed sparks and opens a new session with the chosen one already written into the input box.
description.zh: 梳理思路插件。输入框旁的开关把会话切进「梳理 → 批判 → 调研」三段模式，每段列着这一段该产出的东西，够了再点「推进」按钮换段；成稿按体裁存进 设置 → Thoughts Center。另有悬浮随想记录本，碎灵感先存着，点「去研究」直接开一条新对话，那句话已经写进输入框。

description.en: Move, archive, restore, portable backup/export and import sessions across workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中跨工作区移动、归档、恢复、可携式备份/导出与导入会话。

description.en: Wraps colbymchenry/codegraph into agent tools - status, search, callers/callees, impact, explore, and more.
description.zh: 将 colbymchenry/codegraph 封装到代理工具中 - status、search、callers/callees、impact、explore 等等。

description.en: Notes taken from DeepSeek Harness conversations: quotes whole replies or selected passages, keeps highlights rendered at their original position in the session, attaches editable Markdown notes, tags them, filters by workspace or session, and exports Markdown or a full JSON backup stored as local JSON files.
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话里记笔记：可收藏整条回复或选中片段，划线会持久重绘回原文位置，可为其补写可编辑的 Markdown 笔记、打标签，按工作区或会话筛选，并导出 Markdown 或完整 JSON 备份；数据以本机 JSON 文件存储。

description.en: Adds standard Unicode emoji to dsh replies at the point that best matches the content, and keeps emoji out of any sentence that already carries a kaomoji.
description.zh: 给 dsh 回复在内容最匹配的位置添加标准 emoji，并避免与颜文字出现在同一句。

description.en: A GrokBot-style animated avatar with a synchronized typewriter status line — right in front of the "Deep diving..." indicator.
description.zh: 在「Deep diving...」状态提示前，放一只动态小伙伴——GrokBot 风格动画头像，状态文字还会同步打字机变换。

description.en: Send and receive QQ Agent Mail through an OAuth-authorized agently-cli account — six tools (send, list, read, search, reply, poll) that embed a session/thread marker in the subject, a background poller that routes inbound replies into the owning DSH Session and wakes it, and incoming HTML bodies rendered to clean markdown.
description.zh: 通过已授权的 agently-cli 账号收发 QQ Agent Mail 邮件：发送、列表、阅读、搜索、回复、轮询共六个工具，主题自动嵌入会话/线程标记，后台轮询把回信路由回所属 DSH 会话并唤醒它，HTML 正文渲染为简洁的 Markdown。

description.en: Model manager for the composer picker: probes a model on demand and keeps the timestamped reason it failed, counts usage from committed assistant messages to rank models by proficiency level, pins, favourites and hides rows, and switches along a failover chain when a turn fails, asking the new model to pick the work back up.
description.zh: 输入框里的模型管理：可按需深度探活模型并记录失败原因与发生时间，从已提交的助手消息统计用量并按熟练度档位排序，支持置顶、收藏与隐藏，某一轮失败时沿后备链换模型并请新模型接着做。

description.en: Infinite canvas workspace in the DSH sidebar — arrange text, image, video and audio nodes, generate media with AI, and let agents drive every canvas operation through MCP tools. Ships a local bridge service, ready to use offline after install.
description.zh: 无限画布右侧栏插件——在画布上编排文本、图片、视频、音频节点，用 AI 生成媒体内容，Agent 经 MCP 工具直接操作画布；自带本地桥服务，安装后离线可用。

description.en: Alibaba Open Code Review for DSH: host-model delegation with native preview/rule tools and a review skill, plus optional OCR-managed reviews.
description.zh: 将阿里 Open Code Review 接入 DSH：通过原生文件筛选、规则工具和审查技能复用当前会话模型，并提供可选的 OCR 独立审查模式。

description.en: Renders the open conversation's Mermaid diagrams as a right-sidebar page, one card per diagram, each clickable to open full screen with zoom and pan; the chat's own code block is left untouched, so copying or quoting the source still works.
description.zh: 把当前对话里的 Mermaid 图表渲染成右侧栏的一个页面，一图一卡片；点击卡片可全屏查看并缩放、拖动，对话里的原始代码块保持不动，因此复制或引用源码照常可用。

description.en: Local-only memory guard for the DeepSeek Harness: host heap and session-log monitoring, oversized tool-argument interception, and dry-run by default session vacuum.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地内存守护插件：监控 host 堆与会话日志体积、拦截超大工具参数，并提供默认 dry-run 的会话瘦身命令。

description.en: A wall of photographs hung behind the main panel - uneven sizes at their own angles with room to breathe, twenty real landscape photographs shipped to fill it on first run, up to twenty rotating images per frame, rectangles only, the three lowest frames playing a local video, and one shortcut that sends the video back into the rotation.
description.zh: 挂在主面板背后的一面照片墙：大小不一、各自倾斜、彼此留白。自带二十张真实风景照，首次启动就挂上墙；每个画框最多二十张图轮播，最下面三个框可以放本地视频，一个快捷键让视频退回照片轮播。

description.en: Umbrella Corporation theme for DeepSeek Harness with dark and light schemes, a spinning umbrella watermark and a HUD frame.
description.zh: 生化危机保护伞公司主题，提供明暗双外观、自转保护伞水印与 HUD 装饰。

description.en: Batch pseudonymization for medical text, CSV, JSON, and XLSX in DeepSeek Harness. Deterministic identifier rules run first; an optional OpenAI-compatible model pass adds discovery and verification. Exact-span replacement preserves file structure, tokens stay stable per value, and each batch produces an audit report plus a re-identification vault. DICOM images get header-only de-identification based on PS3.15 Annex E, with pixel data left byte-identical.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中批量匿名化病历文本、CSV、JSON 与 XLSX：先跑确定性标识符规则，可选 OpenAI 兼容模型做发现与复核；按精确区间替换以保持文件结构，同一值保持同一假名，并输出审计报告与映射库。DICOM 影像按 PS3.15 附录 E 只处理头部元数据，像素数据逐字节保留。

description.en: Reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness composer: drag through the thinking levels the current model declares and release to write the chosen level into the session. An auto band escalates one level after a tool error and another after two or more, and optional model routing picks a provider/model per task type.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框里的推理强度滑杆：按当前模型声明的思考档位拖动，松手把档位写入本会话；可选「自动区间」在工具报错后逐档上调，另有可选模型路由按任务类型挑 provider/model。

description.en: Host-side Feishu board for DeepSeek Harness: pushes a session's ask_user_question to Feishu DM as plain text and sends a quoted reply back to the exact session that asked, archiving unmatched replies instead of guessing. Its lark-cli wrapper also suppresses an identical notification resent within three minutes.
description.zh: 宿主侧飞书公告板：把会话的 ask_user_question 以纯文本推到飞书私聊，引用回复只投回提问的那个会话，匹配不上的回复存档不猜；lark-cli 发送包装会拦下三分钟内重复的同一通知。

description.en: Connect one or more Feishu bot apps to the local DeepSeek Harness (DSH): each bot app is a channel with its own model, workspace, permissions and private-chat allowlist, and every chat under it gets its own DSH session. Derived from MichengAI/dsh-im-connect (Apache-2.0) with the other IM channels removed and identifiers renamed so both can be installed side by side.
description.zh: 把一个或多个飞书机器人应用接入本机 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）：每个机器人应用是一条频道，各自独立的模型、工作区、权限与私聊准入；频道下的每个私聊/群聊各有一条独立的 DSH 会话。基于 MichengAI/dsh-im-connect（Apache-2.0）改造，删去其它 IM 通道并重命名标识，因此可与上游同装。

description.en: Two-stage session deletion for DSH on Windows: move a conversation to the recycle bin and restore it to its original sidebar slot; deletion confirmed in two steps to prevent deleting files by mistake, clearing the whole subagent tree, sidebar ledger, projection cache, log lines and exclusive attachments along the way. It also scans the files a conversation actually wrote, adds a file query that pastes the path information into the conversation so an agent can judge which files are safe to delete, highlights them in Explorer, and copies the paths grouped by type. Both this and iamwuzhanglin/dsh-session-recycler install under the package name dsh-session-recycler, so install only one of them.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 DSH 会话两段式删除：对话移入回收站、可恢复回侧栏原位置；两段确认式删除，防止误删文件，连带整条子代理树、侧栏账本、投影缓存、日志与专属附件。同时能扫出一条对话真正写过的文件，增加文件查询功能，点击后将路径信息粘贴到对话中，通过Agent来判断哪些文件可以删除；在资源管理器中多选高亮，并复制按类型分好的路径。本插件与 iamwuzhanglin/dsh-session-recycler 安装后的包名同为 dsh-session-recycler，请只装其中一个。

description.en: MiniMax multimodal bridge: one `mmx_bridge` tool covers image understanding/generation, video, TTS, music, cover, web search and quota; optional `web_search`/`read_image` takeover; inline players/image previews right in the Web GUI (npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`).
description.zh: MiniMax 多模态桥接：一个 `mmx_bridge` 工具覆盖图片理解/生成、视频、语音合成、音乐、翻唱、联网搜索与用量查询；可选接管 `web_search`/`read_image`；对话流直接内嵌播放器与图片预览（npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`）。

description.en: Floating ball showing the signed-in DeepSeek account balance (OAuth), with live pricing, today's price curve and a token-consumption estimate range.
description.zh: 悬浮球显示已登录 DeepSeek 账户余额（OAuth），附带实时价格、今日价格走势与 token 消耗估算区间。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .pptx decks: slides in deck order, bullet levels, speaker notes and inline pictures. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and slide count keep a deck from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的 .pptx 阅读视图：按演示顺序列出幻灯片，还原项目符号层级、演讲者备注与内嵌图片。归档体积、单部件解压字节与幻灯片数量均有上限，演示文稿不会卡死标签页。

description.en: Browser-local prompt library with a composer picker for injecting multiple session-scoped system prompts, branch inheritance, bilingual UI, favorites, and JSON backups.
description.zh: 浏览器本地提示词库：在输入框选择器中同时注入多条会话级系统提示词，支持分支继承、中英界面、收藏与 JSON 备份。

description.en: Flight recorder panel for DSH sessions: live monitoring, timeline replay with a tool waterfall and event inspector, per-agent cost attribution, and a cross-session cost overview.
description.zh: DSH 会话飞行记录仪面板：实时监视、时间轴回放（工具瀑布与事件检查器）、按 agent 归因成本，以及跨会话成本总览。

description.en: Opens .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: Blender headless exports a cached GLB with scene statistics, rendered by a dependency-free WebGL viewport. Requires Blender 3.6+ on PATH (or set blenderPath).
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB 与场景统计，由零依赖 WebGL 视口渲染。需本机装有 Blender 3.6+（或在设置里指定 blenderPath）。

description.en: Mirrors an Android phone or tablet into the DSH right sidebar over adb with mouse and keyboard control, keeping videos, clips and chats next to the desktop instead of in your hand; Opus audio needs Android 11+, Windows only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏通过 adb 投屏并反控安卓手机/平板，视频、短视频和聊天留在电脑上，在工位上不必再拿手机；声音转发需 Android 11+，仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Zero-friction quick ask for DSH: select text in chat, Markdown/code, rendered HTML reports, or the better-sidebar editor. The default answer starts automatically (English prose is translated, a term is explained, a question is answered); typing cancels it. Answers stream from a one-shot completion on the main window's model, inherit a read-only conversation snapshot, read the selected file as context (up to 20,000 characters by default), and never write to the main session. One-line install; host routes, client slots, document renderers and the iframe selection bridge are separable extension points.
description.zh: DSH 的零摩擦快问：对话、Markdown/代码、渲染后的 HTML 报告、better-sidebar 编辑器里都能划词。默认回答会自动开始（英文正文先翻译、术语解释概念、问句直接回答），输入即取消。答案由一次性 completion 流式产出，沿用主窗口模型，继承只读对话快照，把所选文件作为上下文读取（默认上限 2 万字符），且不写入主会话。一行命令安装；宿主路由、客户端插槽、文档 renderer、iframe 选区桥都是可分离的扩展点。

description.en: Adds a restart row to Settings → General that relaunches dsh web with the same invocation through a detached helper, refuses under a detected systemd supervisor unless allowRestart is true, and tests whether the listening port is free by connecting to it rather than binding it.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」增加一行重启按钮：用相同启动参数、经分离的 helper 重新拉起 dsh web；检测到 systemd 监管时默认拒绝（除非 allowRestart 为 true）；判断端口是否空闲用连接探测而非绑定。

description.en: Analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation: module responsibilities, dependencies, entry points and run methods.
description.zh: 分析代码库并生成架构文档：模块职责、依赖关系、入口点与运行方式。

description.en: Open STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: browser-side binary/ASCII parsing, a WebGL viewport, and size/volume/surface-area/watertightness statistics.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里打开 STL：浏览器解析二进制/ASCII，WebGL 视口 + 尺寸/体积/表面积/水密统计。

description.en: Solo murder-mystery (jubensha) in a session tab: the AI hosts the game and plays every other seat, each knowing only its own role book, while the player's seat stays yours — with a stage bar, a per-seat timeline, a clue page and a reveal that unseals the truth only at the end.
description.zh: 一个人的剧本杀：AI 当主持人，AI 填满其余的椅子（各自只知道自己的角色本），留一个位子给你 —— 带阶段条、按座位归集的时间线与搜证页，而真相到复盘才解封。

description.en: Session cost in rubles in the composer dock — the tariff in effect with its countdown, the API cost at that tariff, the CBR rate, the total including subagents, cache savings, and DeepSeek Platform balances.
description.zh: 在输入框坞区显示以卢布计的当前会话费用：当前时段与倒计时、该时段的 API 费用、央行汇率、含 subagent 的合计、缓存节省与 DeepSeek 平台余额。

description.en: Read-only writing-workspace panel for projects that contain a .writing-anything/ workspace: per-work overview cards, a unit tree, YAML artifact views as semantic cards or highlighted source, the source list and the decision/review queues, and in-panel unit review whose feedback is written back by wa-cli.
description.zh: writing-anything 工作区的只读写作面板：作品总览卡片、单元树、YAML 产物的语义卡片与源码高亮视图、素材清单与决策／复核清单，以及面板内单元审阅（反馈经 wa-cli 写回）。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness page companion with animated characters, a clock-out countdown, estimated earnings, hydration reminders, quiet time and salary masking, with separate cards opened from the context menu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 页面陪伴插件，提供动态角色、下班倒计时、收入估算、喝水提醒、免打扰和工资隐藏，各功能通过右键菜单打开独立卡片。

description.en: A frosted-glass status card that floats on the Windows desktop and shows what DSH is doing — running tasks with elapsed time and current activity, pending approvals, today's token usage and the countdown to the off-peak window — and collapses into a 14×120 bar that stays out of the way.
description.zh: 浮在 Windows 桌面上的磨砂玻璃状态卡片，显示 DSH 正在做什么——运行中的任务及已跑时长与当前动作、待审批项、今日 Token 用量与谷时倒计时——不用时可缩成一根 14×120 的细柱贴在屏幕边缘。

description.en: Usage tiers and shareable stats cards: 🐟→🐳 ranks by monthly token burn with a locally-computed estimated percentile, precise pricing for 46 models across 6 vendors (including size-tiered Chinese pricing), backfill of pre-install sessions, and old-vs-new comparison across the 2026-08-17 rate change. Local-only, no telemetry.
description.zh: 用量段位与战绩卡片：按本月 token 消耗评 🐟→🐳 五档段位，分位本地估算（零上报）；6 家厂商 46 个模型精准计价，支持国内厂商按输入长度分档；自动回填安装前的历史会话；8·17 调价前后同一份用量的新旧价对比。数据全在本机，无遥测。

description.en: Native Google Antigravity agents loader and subagent orchestration engine with model selection and Web UI settings integration. Loads agent definitions from ~/.agents/agents and the workspace's .agents/agents; the selected main agent's instructions go into the system prompt, and a matching agent's instructions are prepended to DSH's own subagent and spawn_teammate calls. Settings are written to .agents/agents/settings.json in the workspace.
description.zh: 原生 Google Antigravity Agent 规范加载与子代理编排引擎，支持模型选择与 Web 设置界面集成。从 ~/.agents/agents 和工作区的 .agents/agents 读取 agent 定义；选中的主 agent 的指令会写进系统提示，匹配到的 agent 指令还会加到 DSH 自带的 subagent / spawn_teammate 调用的提示词前面；设置写在工作区的 .agents/agents/settings.json。

description.en: Jenkins CI integration with a live build-progress panel in the right sidebar, a multi-instance settings page, five model-facing tools (list jobs, build status, console log, workspace, trigger build), and a failure wake that hands a failed followed build to the conversation that followed it.
description.zh: Jenkins CI 集成：右侧栏实时构建进度面板、多实例设置页、五个面向模型的工具（列 job、构建状态、控制台日志、工作区、触发构建），以及构建失败时唤醒当初关注该 job 的那个会话。

description.en: An RTS-style orchestration dashboard where commands replace chats: a resident commander agent decomposes each order into task briefs with acceptance criteria, typed subagent troops (recon/engineer/medic/scribe) execute them across isolated workspaces, and every session is indexed by the order that started it.
description.zh: RTS 风格编排看板：用命令取代会话——常驻大副 agent 把舰长命令拆成带验收标准的任务书，侦察/工程/医疗/书记四类小队在隔离工作区执行，所有会话按发起命令索引归队。

description.en: Adds recall, delete-to-end, multi-select share and export to conversation messages, with per-answer usage statistics and DeepSeek balance cost tracking.
description.zh: 为对话消息添加撤回、删除、删至末尾、多选分享与导出，并提供每条回答的用量统计与 DeepSeek 余额费用统计。

description.en: Generates editable PPTX decks in DSH with a bundled authoring Skill, deterministic PPTD scene checks, native PowerPoint objects, and local PPTD source-project delivery.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用包内编排 Skill、确定性 PPTD 场景检查和原生 PowerPoint 对象生成可编辑 PPTX，并在本地交付 PPTD 源项目。

description.en: SearXNG-backed web_search provider for the web seam: free, self-hosted, key-less metasearch through your own instance's JSON API, with a bundled loopback-only docker-compose example.
description.zh: 基于 SearXNG 的 web_search provider：通过自建实例的 JSON API 实现免费、免密钥的元搜索，附仅绑定回环地址的 docker-compose 示例。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language, developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）机械臂的插件，由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研的 nUR MCP Server 同源逻辑开发。（Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.）

description.en: Enable permessage-deflate on DSH's WebSocket transport without modifying the DSH install tree.
description.zh: 在不修改 DSH 安装目录的前提下，为 DSH 的 WebSocket 传输启用 permessage-deflate。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .docx files: headings from the style map, paragraphs, lists, real table cells, inline pictures and header notes. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and rendered blocks keep a document from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的 .docx 阅读视图：按样式表识别标题，还原段落、列表、真实表格单元格、内嵌图片与页眉注释。归档体积、单部件解压字节与渲染块数均有上限，文档不会卡死标签页。

description.en: Use Zed AI hosted models in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 Zed AI 托管模型。

description.en: Reference other conversations from the current one — type @ to attach a session's record, drag a sidebar conversation into the composer, or open any conversation, tick single messages and insert them into another one.
description.zh: 在当前对话里引用别的对话：输入 @ 附加某段对话的记录，从左侧栏把对话拖进输入框，或打开任意对话、勾选其中几条消息插入到另一个对话中。

description.en: Edits assistant replies and thinking chains in DSH sessions so the model sees the edited text, live via message projection or on disk.
description.zh: 编辑 DSH 会话中的助手回复与思维链，让模型采信改后的内容：在线经 message projection 立即生效，或落盘改写会话记录。

description.en: Chat turn accordion: every interaction folds into one row with a time pill and question summary, only the newest turn stays open, and switching sessions or starting a new turn resets the open state; the execution process opens only on its own click.
description.zh: 会话交互折叠：每次交互压成一行（时间胶囊 + 提问摘要），只保留最近一次展开；切换工作区/会话或产生新交互都会重置到最新一条；执行过程仅在单独点击时展开。

description.en: Global back/forward navigation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: remembers every session and whole-page panel you visit, shows a configurable 1-7 entry history strip you can click, and supports browser-style shortcuts plus mouse side buttons.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供全局后退/前进：记录访问过的会话与整页面板，底部历史条可配置显示 1-7 个位置并可直接点击跳转，支持浏览器式快捷键与鼠标侧键。

description.en: Two-tier image reading for text-only models: fast local OCR (RapidOCR, offline) first, vision-model fallback (modlens).
description.zh: 纯文本模型双层识图：优先本地快速 OCR（RapidOCR，离线），不足时回落视觉模型（modlens）。

description.en: Watches installed DSH bundles for load failures and dependency drift, brakes repeatedly failing tools, and attributes token cost per message source.
description.zh: 检查已装 DSH 插件的加载失败与依赖漂移，给反复失败的工具加冷却刹车，并按消息来源归因 token 成本。

description.en: Per-model proxy routing for LLM requests: selected models go through a proxy (Clash etc.) while the rest stay direct, with automatic retry on transport errors, 429 and 5xx, configured live from the settings page.
description.zh: 按模型给 LLM 请求分流代理：勾选的模型走代理（Clash 等），其余直连；传输错误、429、5xx 自动重试，设置页实时生效。

description.en: Build presets for DSH Agents: package personas, prompts, skills, tools and runtime contexts into reusable capability bundles. Each task loads only the components it requires.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Agent 做「预设」：把**人设、提示词、技能、工具、运行时上下文**打包成一套可复用的能力组合。一个任务，只装它需要的东西。

description.en: Connects the Tavily hosted MCP server and registers the tools it publishes. The API key is read from the TAVILY_API_KEY credential and is not stored in plugin config.
description.zh: 接入 Tavily 托管的 MCP 服务器并注册它公布的工具。API Key 从 TAVILY_API_KEY 凭据读取，不写入插件配置。

description.en: Adds the scihub_pdf and scihub_batch model tools that resolve a DOI or article URL through Sci-Hub mirrors, download the paper PDFs into the session workspace and report per-DOI status honestly; the mirror list is configurable at runtime without a restart.
description.zh: 为 DSH 注册 scihub_pdf 与 scihub_batch 两个模型工具：按 DOI 或文章 URL 经 Sci-Hub 镜像解析并下载论文 PDF 到会话工作区，逐条如实返回下载状态；镜像列表可在运行时配置，修改后无需重启。

description.en: Enforces a check-fix-recheck loop when a task is wrapping up: it auto-runs your tests/lint/audit, blocks any round that still has unfixed problems, and only calls the task done after three consecutive clean full checks, then notifies the user.
description.zh: 收尾自检哨兵：任务收尾时强制「全面检查 → 修复 → 再全面检查」循环，自动跑测试/lint/audit，有未修复的问题就打回，直到连续三轮零问题才判定完成并通知用户。

description.en: Tailscale remote-access operations panel for the dsh web GUI: health checks, HTTPS entry toggle via tailscale serve, macOS proxy bypass, relay server ops, and ACL snippet generation.
description.zh: Tailscale 远程访问运维面板：健康检查、HTTPS 入口（tailscale serve）开关、macOS 代理绕过、中继服务器运维与 ACL 片段生成。

description.en: Scores each assistant answer on five dimensions plus topic coverage, shows evidence, and turns the weakest dimension into copy-ready prompt advice. Observational only; local by default, with optional Jev review.
description.zh: 为每条回答给出五维质量分与话题覆盖度，附证据，并把最弱的一项转成可直接复制的提示词改写。只观测不改写；默认本地评分，可选 Jev 精评。

description.en: Claude Code rules.md-style rule prompts: activate rule markdown files by glob-matching the files an agent reads or edits, with prompt injection and ordering support.
description.zh: 类 Claude Code rules.md 的规则提示词：按智能体读取或编辑文件的 glob 匹配自动激活规则文档，支持提示词注入与排序。

description.en: Pop-out sidebar: lists artifacts and a file tree with multiple preview formats, pops out into a separate browser tab you can drag to another monitor, and coexists with other sidebar plugins simultaneously.
description.zh: 可弹出式侧边栏：侧边栏展示产物与文件树，支持多种文件预览形式；并可弹出为独立浏览器标签页（可拖至另一显示器）；兼容其他sidebar插件，可以同时显示。

description.en: A Web3D energy orb decoration for the DSH Web GUI: a particle core wrapped in three mechanical rings that shrinks and falls silent while the session is idle and pulses in a double-beat heartbeat while a turn runs. UnrealBloom glow, draggable with its corner, position and size remembered, and three.js served locally by the plugin instead of a CDN.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Web3D 能量球装饰：粒子核心外包三圈机械环，会话静息时收缩沉默、回合运行时以双拍心跳涨缩。UnrealBloom 辉光；可拖动，所在一角、位置与尺寸都会被记住；three.js 由插件本地提供，不走 CDN。

description.en: Adds an "approve for me" access mode whose approval requests are answered by an independent reviewer model instead of a person: the reviewer can read the workspace read-only, a reviewer that cannot run hands the request back to the human, and every decision is recorded with its rationale in an Approvals tab.
description.zh: 新增「替我审批」访问模式：审批请求由独立的复核模型裁决而非人工，复核者可只读工作区，复核跑不起来时把请求交回人工，每次裁决的理由记录在「审批」页签中。

description.en: QwenWork (千问办公) model provider for dsh: signs in through the desktop device flow and then calls the official OpenAI-compatible gateway, so tool calls, image input and usage pass through; adds the tiers of the plan as a qwenwork provider, keeps the credential in a local file that a refresh rewrites in place, and shows the remaining credits of the account.
description.zh: 把千问办公（QwenWork）接成 dsh 的模型提供方：用桌面端设备码登录，直连官方 OpenAI 兼容网关，工具调用、图片输入和 usage 都能透传；在 qwenwork 下提供套餐里的各档模型，凭据落在本地文件、到期自动刷新写回，并显示账号剩余积分。

description.en: Local Carl companion with 12 pre-generated AI sprite actions, pat reactions, a 25/45-minute focus timer, quick menu, edge wandering and local reminders; no runtime model calls or chat messages.
description.zh: 带 12 种预生成 AI 动作的刺猬卡尔桌宠，支持摸摸、25/45 分钟专注、快捷菜单、边缘闲逛和本地提醒；不发送聊天消息、不调用模型。

description.en: Keyless image generation with two tools: generate_image (no API key, one call at a time, bounded rate-limit retries) and list_image_models.
description.zh: 无需 API 密钥的图片生成，含两个工具：generate_image（无需密钥、串行调用、有限次限流重试）与 list_image_models。

description.en: Local tool guard that scores every DeepSeek Harness tool call with an Ollama decision model before it runs; risky calls come back as an approval prompt, and an unreachable model stops all calls. Requires DSH 0.2.x and a local Ollama 0.35.1+ with the default ~6 GB clef-flash model pulled first; without them every tool call is denied.
description.zh: 每次工具调用前由本机 Ollama 决策模型判定：可疑调用升级为确认提示，模型不可达时停止所有调用。需 DSH 0.2.x，并先装好本机 Ollama 0.35.1+、拉取默认约 6 GB 的 clef-flash 模型；否则所有工具调用都会被拒绝。

description.en: An announcement file shared by several agent sessions on one machine. It is a plain text file the agents only append to; before each step a session receives the entries it has not seen yet, a new session catches up on the ones still in effect, and a session whose context was compacted gets them re-sent.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上多个会话共用的公告文件：一个只许追加的纯文本文件。每个会话在下一步之前收到自己还没见过的条目；新会话补看仍在有效期内的；上下文被压缩过的会话会收到一次重发。

description.en: A plugin manager tab in Settings → Plugins: Chinese names and plain-language descriptions for every installed plugin, one-click enable/disable, in-UI notes editing, and search/filter over the installed catalog.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的插件管理页：已装插件中文名与白话描述、一键启停、界面内改备注，支持搜索与筛选。

description.en: Windows only. Autonomous news briefing on user absence or continuous schedule, illustration & anime gallery with tagging and QQ bot search, plus native OS desktop alerts for AI completions, delivered to DSH sessions or IM bots.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。离席或持续自主资讯全网检索与多端推送，精选二次元/色图插画画廊与点图搜图，以及会话状态全局系统原生桌面弹窗通知，支持投递至 DSH 会话与 IM 机器人。

description.en: Shortcut buttons in the composer row that send preset text into the current conversation in one click. Button label, size, opacity, shape and payload are editable in place, and the whole group moves left or right of the context meter by right-click dragging, persisted in localStorage. The group takes only the width it needs, so the context meter and the usage area stay clickable.
description.zh: 在输入框一行放一组快捷按钮，点一下把预设文字发进当前对话。每个按钮的名称、大小、透明度、形状与发送内容都可就地编辑；右键拖动整组可在上下文进度左右换位，选择保存在本地。按钮组只占自身宽度，不会挤压上下文进度与用量区域。

description.en: Reads images with a vision model on the same provider when the selected model cannot see them, and passes that description to the text model.
description.zh: 主模型不能识别图片时，自动改用同一 API 下可识别图片的模型读取图片，再把描述反馈给主模型。

description.en: Bot-to-bot messaging across machines on top of ds-harness-remote: five tools let a local Bot list the peer Host Bots, pin a target device and send it a message, without switching the local window.
description.zh: 基于 ds-harness-remote 的跨机器 Bot 传话：五个工具让本地 Bot 列出对端 Bot、固定目标设备并给它发消息，不用切换本地窗口。

description.en: Pauses running DeepSeek tasks when peak billing starts and automatically resumes them after the off-peak window begins, with model-aware guards, an off-peak planning queue, and a sidebar countdown clock.
description.zh: 峰时自动暂停正在运行的 DeepSeek 任务，谷价开始后自动恢复继续；识别时段与模型，并提供错峰规划队列与左栏倒计时。

description.en: Creates DSH workspaces under a configurable base directory, links several external folders into one workspace, and relocates a workspace without losing its conversations. Its managed_workspace tool lets the agent create, adopt, link, move and unregister workspaces (moving relocates the whole folder and leaves a link at the old path when it has conversations), and its HTTP routes (/dsh-managed-workspaces/api/...) have no DSH access check beyond a marker header.
description.zh: 在可配置的根目录下创建 DSH 工作区，把多个外部文件夹关联到同一个工作区，并能在不丢失对话的情况下迁移工作区。它的 managed_workspace 工具允许模型创建、接管、关联、迁移和注销工作区（迁移会移动整个文件夹，有会话时在原路径留一个链接），插件的 HTTP 路由（/dsh-managed-workspaces/api/…）除一个标记头外没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Windows only. Prompts to restart DSH after a plugin install, update or uninstall, restarts it in one click without any console window, and shows a per-file diff of what changed.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。DSH 插件变动后提示重启，一键静默重启（全程无命令提示符窗口），并可展开本次改动的逐行差异。

description.en: Manage a GitHub Pages blog from a DSH panel — browse the Markdown articles grouped by tag, edit them in a split editor with a front-matter form, and publish the changes as one commit over the GitHub REST API.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里管理 GitHub Pages 博客：按标签分组浏览 Markdown 文章，用表单填 front matter 并在分屏编辑器里修改，再通过 GitHub REST API 把改动作为一次 commit 发布。

description.en: Answers a hard question with a one-page visual HTML explainer: the model writes a short Markdown draft and the bundled dependency-free `am` CLI builds the layout, CSS and diagram coordinates. Vendors the upstream answer-me-with-html skill verbatim as a skill-only DSH bundle with no Host code.
description.zh: 把复杂问题回答成一页可视化 HTML：模型只写简短的 Markdown 草稿，随包附带的零依赖 `am` 命令行负责排版、配色与图表坐标。以上游 answer-me-with-html 技能原样内置，是纯技能的 DSH bundle，不含 Host 代码。

description.en: Claude Science-style research workbench: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), and 10 science skills for genomics/pathogens/bioinformatics.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Claude Science 式科研工作台：ReAct 研究循环引擎（research_* 工具）、带溯源的版本化工件（artifact_* 工具）与面向基因组/病原体/生物信息的 10 个科研技能。

description.en: Animated background themes for the DSH desktop — 10 scene renderers (milky way, glow horizon, layered mountains, cloud dome, aurora ionosphere, black hole, cloud train, particle image, pixel sculpt, blinking squares), a wallpaper and video library, per-zone UI surface transparency, and a replica of the Appearance settings panel.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面版换上动态背景——10 种场景渲染器（银河、辉光地平线、层峦、云穹、极光电离层、黑洞、云列车、粒子成像、像素雕塑、闪烁方块）、壁纸与视频素材库、UI 表面分区透明，外加逐像素复刻的 Appearance 设置面板。

description.en: Browser-style in-page find bar (Cmd/Ctrl+F) for the desktop app, with highlight-all, a match counter, and a scope picker for the conversation or the right panel.
description.zh: 桌面端浏览器式页内查找条（Cmd/Ctrl+F）：全文高亮、匹配计数，可在对话区与右侧面板间切换搜索范围。

description.en: Agent skills: browse, toggle and edit skills in the management page, and let the agent write new ones itself.
description.zh: Agent技能：在管理页里浏览、开关、编辑技能，也能让 Agent 自己写新技能。

description.en: IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.
description.zh: IM 渠道桥：微信（ilinkai）/ QQ / 飞书接入，支持主动推送——定时任务可唤醒渠道 bot 并把 AI 回复推送到手机。

description.en: Render interactive diagrams, charts and staged learning visuals alongside native prose in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中结合正文呈现交互图形、图表与分阶段学习演示。

description.en: Load, edit, manage, and hot-reload trusted JavaScript and TypeScript userscripts in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中加载、编辑、管理和热重载可信的 JavaScript / TypeScript 用户脚本。

description.en: Lists this session's runtime errors — turn errors, tool failures, command failures and subagent failures — as copyable cards in a conversation tab.
description.zh: 把本会话的运行时错误——回合错误、工具失败、命令失败、子智能体异常——汇总成可复制的卡片，显示在会话标签页里。

description.en: Purges billion-context snapshots left behind after a session is deleted in DeepSeek Harness, and can also clean up cost-meter ledger rows (off by default).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中删除会话后，清理 billion-context 快照；cost-meter 账本记录的清理默认关闭，可在设置里打开。

description.en: Command Code usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: plan credits, 5-hour and weekly windows, per-period request stats, plan tiers, and an in-app API key editor, delivered as a Settings tab plus a draggable floating capsule.
description.zh: DSH 里的 Command Code 用量面板：套餐额度、5 小时 / 每周窗口、本期请求统计、套餐档位与内置 API key 编辑，包含设置页与可拖动浮窗。

description.en: Scans the whole C drive and classifies every large folder into A/B/C/D/E/P (safe cache / relocatable / junction-movable / abandoned software / config-memory redline / personal files), then deletes, moves, or redirects on demand — with strong redline protection, dry-run preview and undo. Unknown software decided by LLM fallback + human confirmation. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 扫描整 C 盘,把每个大空间按 A/B/C/D/E/P 分类(无忧缓存/官方可改址/可junction搬/冷废弃软件/配置记忆红线/个人文件),再按需删缓存/junction搬走/引导改址,带强红线保护、dry-run 预览与 undo。未知软件由 LLM 兜底 + 人工确认,动手前先预览、做完可回滚。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: Queries PRTS Wiki for Arknights operators, items, stages, story pages and worldbook entries, and predicts unreleased characters, alters and banner schedules from story-cast statistics and banner history.
description.zh: 查询 PRTS Wiki 的《明日方舟》干员、物品、关卡、剧情与泰拉大典世界观条目，并基于剧情卡司统计与卡池历史预测未实装角色、异格与卡池排期。

description.en: Matt Pocock's 25 skills fully translated to Chinese (technical terms kept in English with glosses).
description.zh: Matt Pocock 25 个技能正文全译中文（技术术语保留英文并附注释）。

description.en: Windows system-tray launcher for dsh web: console-free background start (VBS/powershell chain), a tray menu with open UI / logs / icon presets / launch-at-login / restart Harness, one-click install and update of the bundled dsh-plugin-usage-meter, and a dsh plugin half that starts the tray together with the harness.
description.zh: Windows 系统托盘启动器：无窗口后台启动 dsh web（VBS/powershell 链），托盘菜单支持打开界面、日志、图标预设、开机自启与重启 Harness，一键安装与更新内置的 dsh-plugin-usage-meter，并可作为 dsh 插件安装使托盘随 Harness 一起启动。

description.en: Per-target scheduled wake-ups for a DSH workspace: interval, quiet hours, daily cap and a prompt per target; each wake-up waits for the turn it started and records the outcome, and a turn that never finished is not counted as done.
description.zh: 给 DSH 工作区按目标定时唤醒：每个目标可设间隔、安静时段、每日上限和提示词；每次唤醒会等它自己那一轮结束并记下结果，没跑完的那一轮不会算作完成。

description.en: Adds an Execution graph conversation-view tab that renders each turn's prompts, replies, and tool calls/results as a foldable timeline with a detail panel and PNG export.
description.zh: 在会话视图中新增「执行图」标签页，把每个轮次的提问、模型回复与工具调用/结果渲染为可折叠的时间轴，并带详情面板与 PNG 导出。

description.en: Compaction integrity: directive lines (never/must/必须 style markers) extracted from the compacted range are verified against the summary — verbatim or by content-word coverage — and every constraint the session silently forgot is reported and written to a JSONL ledger; pinned constraints from config are checked on every compaction.
description.zh: 压缩监护：从被压缩范围提取指令行（never/must/必须 类标记），对照摘要做逐字或内容词覆盖存续校验；会话悄悄遗忘的约束会被响亮上报并写入 JSONL 台账；配置中的 pinned 约束每次压缩必验。

description.en: Refines the DeepSeek Harness interface for reading by adjusting layouts and reducing persistent controls. Built for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (Web UI); other versions are untested.
description.zh: 调整 DeepSeek Harness 界面布局并减少常驻按钮，以突出阅读内容。针对 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 的 Web 界面制作，其他版本未验证。

description.en: Full workbench fork of dsh-better-sidebar: explorer, editor, terminal, Git, browser and split panes, plus a VSCode-like shell refactor with a full-width compact header and activity rail; publishes as @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23 on npm.
