description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 完整工作台 fork：资源管理器、编辑器、终端、Git、浏览器与分屏，外加仿 VSCode 外壳重构（全宽紧凑顶栏与活动栏）；npm 包名 @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23。

description.en: Extends the composer model selector menu with a third Context window row, preset capacities (64K–2M), custom input, provider-wide sync, and adaptive compaction guard.
description.zh: 在底部聊天输入框的模型选择弹窗中扩展第三行【上下文窗口】，支持 64K~2M 档位切换、自定义容量输入、提供商批量同步与自适应压缩防失败守卫。

description.en: Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for you - auto-maximize (keeps the window buttons) or true fullscreen on launch, then maximize / restore / minimize / always-on-top anytime. It quits only after a native confirmation dialog - Esc, double Esc, or Ctrl+Q; in fullscreen, Esc leaves fullscreen first. The window channel installs itself, so no script or Python is needed; the first install takes effect after two DSH restarts.
description.zh: 如果你嫌每次打开 Harness 都要手动全屏，这个插件可以帮你自动铺满：启动时自动最大化（保留右上角窗口按钮）或真全屏；随时可最大化／还原／最小化／窗口置顶；退出前弹原生确认框，快捷键可选 Esc、双击 Esc 或 Ctrl+Q，且全屏下 Esc 先退出全屏。窗口通道由插件自己安装，无需脚本或 Python，首次安装需重启两次 DSH 生效。

description.en: DSH onboarding plugin: recommends plugins across eight domains ranked by weighted GitHub stars and npm monthly downloads, installs the recommended set in one click behind a reviewable plan, and exports or imports an environment code recording a profile's plugin list, exact versions and enabled flags.
description.zh: DSH 新人引导插件：按八个领域推荐插件（GitHub Star 与 npm 近月下载加权排序），先出计划再一键安装，并可导出／导入记录 profile 插件清单、精确版本与启用状态的环境码。

description.en: Dispatches tasks from DSH to 11 external agent CLIs and provides a sidebar panel for CLI availability and dispatch status.
description.zh: 从 DSH 向 11 种外部 Agent CLI 派遣任务，并在侧栏面板显示 CLI 可用性和派遣状态。

description.en: Rewrites the reasoning row: instead of the raw chain of thought it shows first-person working notes, written segment by segment while the reasoning streams in, with a toggle back to the original. Notes are stored per session so history rows keep them after a reload, the note writer runs on a configured provider or a downloadable local llama.cpp model, and the model still reads the full reasoning.
description.zh: 改写思考行：不显示原始思维链，而是随流按段写成第一人称的工作笔记，可随时切回原文。笔记按会话落盘，刷新后历史行仍有；写笔记可以用已配置的供应商，也可以下载本地 llama.cpp 模型；模型下一轮读到的仍是完整推理。

description.en: Bridges Multica to DeepSeek Harness through a versioned JSONL process protocol.
description.zh: 通过版本化 JSONL 进程协议将 Multica 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Connects a DSH Host to Slack and Feishu using your own bot applications.
description.zh: 使用自建机器人应用，将一个 DSH Host 接入 Slack 和飞书。

description.en: Anime Garden for DSH: search anime torrent resources from 動漫花園, 蜜柑计划, 萌番组 and ANi inside DSH — via chat, a sidebar panel with fansub and type filters, a seasonal calendar, and an in-app floating player.
description.zh: Anime Garden 的 DSH 插件：在 DSH 内搜索来自動漫花園、蜜柑计划、萌番组和 ANi 的动画 BT 资源——支持对话搜索、按字幕组和类型筛选的侧边栏面板、新番周历，以及站内浮窗播放。

description.en: Host-neutral durable DAG workflows for Agents with CLI, MCP, on-demand Skills, triggers, replay, and a visual Canvas.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 Host-neutral 持久化 DAG 工作流，提供 CLI、MCP、按需 Skill、Trigger、重放和可视化 Canvas。

description.en: Adds permanent delete to the session menu: removes the session log files from disk, or deletes a whole workspace together with all of its sessions through the host registry. Also ships a /purge command. Unrelated to the prompt-patching dsh-purge plugins also listed here, but it uses the same dsh-purge row id and /purge command, so do not install both.
description.zh: 在会话菜单中加入彻底删除：把会话日志文件从磁盘移除，或经宿主注册表删除整个工作区及其全部会话；另提供 /purge 命令。与本列表中其他同名 dsh-purge（提示词补丁类）插件无关，但使用相同的 dsh-purge 行 id 和 /purge 命令，请勿同装。

description.en: Model visibility manager for DeepSeek Harness: hide or show any model in the conversation model selector from a dedicated settings page. Per-model switches, search, provider-level batch actions, reset-all. Zero intrusion - writes only its own hidden list, never the provider config; hiding a model in use never interrupts a running session.
description.zh: DSH 模型可见性管理：在独立的设置分区页里按渠道/模型隐藏或显示模型选择菜单中的条目。逐模型开关、实时搜索、渠道级批量隐藏/显示、一键恢复全部。零侵入——只写插件自己的隐藏列表，不改 Provider 配置，隐藏正在使用的模型不会中断会话。

description.en: Token usage dashboard in the DSH settings page: nine metric cards (total, today, yesterday, peak day, longest session, active-day streak, active days, sessions, subagent tokens), a GitHub-style daily/weekly/cumulative heatmap, and an activity insight list, aggregated locally from session logs and projection caches, keeping token history after a session is deleted.
description.zh: DSH 设置页的 Token 用量看板：九宫指标卡（累计/今日/昨日/峰值日/最长会话/连续活跃/活跃天数/会话/子代理 Token）、GitHub 风格每日/每周/累计热力图与活动洞察，全部从本地会话日志与投影缓存聚合，会话被删后历史 token 仍然保留。

description.en: MCP server marketplace for DSH: browse a curated, npm-verified catalog and install MCP servers into the current profile with one click, live without restart.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 服务器商场：浏览经过 npm 校验的精选目录，一键安装 MCP 服务器到当前 profile，免重启立即生效。

description.en: Ten interoceptive senses for a DSH agent: workspace pulse, time, affect, needs, expression, silence, residue, open loops, body and face — deterministic state that keeps moving on its own.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体的十种内感受：房子脉搏、时间、情绪、需求、表达、沉默、余味、未闭合的事、身体与表情——各自持续演进的确定性状态。

description.en: Plays Inception Mercury's diffusion (denoising) stream live in the dsh Web UI answer bubble: for routes that support it, the request is re-sent with `diffusing: true` and the real frames are replayed from noise to final text, while only the converged answer reaches the session log. Support is detected per provider/model with a probe that is rejected before any token is generated, a floating per-model toggle turns it on, and attachments, auxiliary calls or unsupported routes fall back to the original adapter. Replaces the assistant-message renderer for all models while enabled.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web UI 的回答气泡里实时播放 Inception Mercury 的扩散（去噪）过程：对支持的路由以 `diffusing: true` 重发请求，按真实帧从噪声播放到最终文本，会话日志只写入收敛后的答案。按 provider/model 用一个在生成前就被拒绝的探测请求判断是否支持，右侧浮动按钮按模型开关；带附件、辅助调用或不支持的路由一律回退原适配器。启用期间会接管所有模型的助手消息渲染。

description.en: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never forgets what you told it. One-command install via `dsh.bundle.patch`, semantic layer runs in a worker thread.
description.zh: 对话历史回忆：字面/模糊/语义三层检索全部历史会话的原始文本，完全本地离线——AI 再也不会忘记你说的话。一条命令安装（自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`），语义推理跑在 worker 线程。

description.en: Brings the providers you already configured in cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness: reads the cc-switch database, converts Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi entries into llm-pi-ai routes with their API keys, and adds a health check that measures time-to-first-byte and whether each stream completes.
description.zh: 把 cc-switch 里配好的模型供应商接进 DeepSeek Harness：读取 cc-switch 数据库，将 Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi 等条目转成 llm-pi-ai 路由并写入 API Key，还提供实测首字节耗时与流能否正常收尾的体检。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the dsh web sidebar footer with live config hot reload and an editable Settings → Plugins card.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部展示 DeepSeek 账户余额，支持配置热重载与可编辑的设置 → 插件卡片。

description.en: A lightweight appearance skin for DeepSeek Harness: custom wallpaper, glass-like panel transparency, and an accent color; server-side settings shared across devices, native light/dark mode left untouched.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 轻量级外观皮肤：自定义壁纸、玻璃质感面板与重点色；服务端持久化、多设备一致，不接管原生深浅色。

description.en: WebDAV server: turns a shared directory into a WebDAV service that Windows, macOS and Linux can mount as a local disk, with token authentication, optional read-only mode, configurable directory/port/token, and per-platform mounting guides built into the settings page.
description.zh: WebDAV 服务器：把一个共享目录变成 Windows/macOS/Linux 都能挂载成本地磁盘的 WebDAV 服务，令牌认证、可选只读、目录/端口/令牌全可配，设置页自带三平台挂载指南。

description.en: Replaces the reasoning-effort dropdown with a draggable snapping slider, and draws 13 canvas effects across five style families (thrust, fluid, fantasy, tech, texture) with three tiers that unlock as the effort level rises. Custom mode combines 10 particle forms with 8 flow trajectories; 9 accent presets and a hex picker recolor every effect, and optional key sounds cover two voice clips, a synthesized duck squeak, a mechanical click and a local audio file.
description.zh: 把推理强度下拉菜单换成可拖拽吸附的滑块，并提供 13 款 Canvas 动效，分属推进、流体、幻境、科技、质感五个家族；动效随推理档位分三阶递进解锁。客制动效可自由组合 10 种粒子形态与 8 种流动轨迹；9 款预设主题色与 Hex 拾色器让全部动效跟随变色，档位吸附音效支持两段语音、合成鸭子叫、机械微触感与本地音频文件。

description.en: Opens STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: binary/ASCII parsing in the browser, a WebGL viewport, and size, volume, surface-area and watertightness statistics.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 STL：浏览器解析二进制/ASCII 网格，用 WebGL 视口展示尺寸、体积、表面积与水密性。

description.en: Windows desktop control through UI Automation: nine tools that read a window control tree and drive elements by id through their own UI Automation patterns, with every write gated by an approval policy, an append-only action log and a settings panel.
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation 控制 Windows 桌面：九个工具读取窗口控件树、按 id 走控件自身的 UIA 模式操作，每次写入都受审批策略、动作日志与设置面板约束。

description.en: Cross-session agent messaging for DeepSeek Harness with session discovery, offline delivery, delivery receipts, and sender-session navigation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话 Agent 通信：支持会话发现、离线投递、投递回执与发送方会话导航。

description.en: Handwriting and diagram whiteboard: sketch on a floating or sidebar canvas and attach the cropped image to your message.
description.zh: 手写公式、画示意图的画板：浮动或侧栏画布，导出裁切后的图片作为消息附件。

description.en: Chinese tax and cross-border e-commerce workbench: a local BigInt statement parser for Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Stripe CSV/TSV/XLSX exports (fintax_parse_statement), a 7-scenario deterministic tax and reconciliation calculator (fintax_calc), 4 read-only Tencent IMA knowledge-base tools (ima_list_kbs, ima_browse, ima_search, ima_read), 4 bundled compliance skills, and an in-app settings section. Statement files are parsed locally; optional IMA credentials are read from environment variables or ~/.config/ima/ (write-only via authenticated /api/fintax routes, never echoed back) and sent only to ima.qq.com; zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 中国财税与跨境电商工作台：提供 Amazon、TikTok Shop、Stripe 原始结算账单本地 BigInt 离线解析与异常雷达工具（fintax_parse_statement）、7 场景确定性算税与四层口径差额桥接工具（fintax_calc）、4 个腾讯 IMA 知识库只读检索工具（ima_list_kbs、ima_browse、ima_search、ima_read）、4 项合规自查技能及内置设置面板。账单文件仅在本地离线解析；可选的 IMA 凭证从环境变量或 ~/.config/ima/ 读取（/api/fintax 路由逐请求经宿主 connection 准入校验，密钥只写不回传明文）并仅发送至官方 ima.qq.com；纯 ESM 零运行时依赖。

description.en: Reads only the Microsoft OneNote notebooks you allow, with device-code sign-in, a per-notebook allow-list in Settings, and four read-only tools for status, page listing, search and page content.
description.zh: 只读取你允许的 Microsoft OneNote 笔记本：设备码登录、设置页的笔记本白名单，以及状态、页面列表、搜索、页面内容四个只读工具。

description.en: Windows system and custom desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness events: task completed, failed, running, awaiting approval, and awaiting answer. Click-to-jump to the session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness事件的Windows系统和自定义桌面通知：任务已完成、失败、正在运行、等待批准和等待答复。单击以跳转到会话。

description.en: One image behind the whole DSH shell. The image layer sits at z-index -1 and the shell's two --dsw-* tokens are repointed at translucent tints, so the picture shows through the frame, sidebar and composer. Ships a bundled default picture so it works with zero configuration, plus a floating panel with five sliders, presets, upload, and an SSRF-guarded URL import; changes persist to a local settings.json and the client self-heals when the SPA replaces its stylesheet.
description.zh: 给整个 DSH 外壳铺一张背景图：图片层挂在 z-index -1，并把外壳的两个 --dsw-* 令牌改成半透明色，让背景透出侧栏、中栏和输入框。内置一张默认图，装完零配置就有；右下角浮动面板提供五个滑杆、预设档、上传与带 SSRF 防护的链接导入，改动写进本地 settings.json，样式表被 SPA 顶掉时会自动重画。

description.en: Turns the composer's model menu into a two-level list (provider first, then that provider's models), shows the current model together with its provider name, asks for a reasoning effort after a model is picked, and adds settings switches that hide whole providers or single models from the picker.
description.zh: 把输入框的模型菜单改成「先选厂商、再选模型」的两级列表，当前模型位同时显示厂商名，点模型后再选推理等级；设置里可按厂商或单个模型把条目从选择器中隐藏。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness sidebar for LiteLLM models, MCP servers, skills, and spend.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏面板，用于 LiteLLM 虚拟钥匙、动态模型注入、MCP 转发与花费统计。

description.en: Windows console and system-window watchdog for DSH. It scans every console window, marks the idle and finished ones, and lists them in a collapsible taskbar panel (collapsed by default, expand by clicking the title bar) in two views — a compact icon grid and per-app grouped cards — then closes selected windows the graceful way (WM_CLOSE, the same as Alt+F4, never a force-kill) after a dry-run preview and a confirm step. Close a single window, every window of one app, or a whole batch; the icon view adds a red × badge to single-close any non-whitelisted window, and a thin 2px progress bar counts each close as i/N. Empty console shells are hidden or truly closed, while the DSH host, Fluent/MPI/ANSYS solver processes, the foreground window and whitelisted programs (added one row at a time by process image name or window-title substring) are never touched, and elevated admin windows go through one UAC prompt. Resource-Manager folder windows can be closed on their own without ever touching the desktop or taskbar. It also lists the DSH sidebar panels of the current mounted session and closes one in one click, and flags MCP service consoles (red badge, no close button) as never-close. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: Windows 专属的 DSH 控制台与系统窗口哨兵：扫描所有控制台窗口并标出已空闲或已跑完的，在本插件抽屉面板里以紧凑图标网格或按软件分组的详情卡两种视图展示（面板默认折叠，点标题栏展开），先在干跑预览里确认，再用优雅关闭（WM_CLOSE，等同 Alt+F4，绝不强杀）关掉选中的窗口。可只关某个单个窗口、关掉某款软件的全部窗口或整批处理；图标视图每个可关窗口右上角带红色小 × 角标，点一下即单独关闭该窗口；批量关闭时顶部有一条 2px 细进度条并实时显示「正在关闭 i/N」。空的控制台壳窗口可被隐藏或真正关闭，但 DSH 宿主、Fluent/MPI/ANSYS 求解进程、当前前台窗口与白名单程序永不被关闭；管理员窗口只弹一次 UAC 提权即可关闭。资源管理器的文件夹窗口可单独关闭，绝不会误关桌面、任务栏等系统外壳。另有一张「DSH 侧边栏 · 当前面板」卡，可枚举当前挂载会话已在侧边栏打开的面板并一键关闭，MCP 服务控制台会打上红底「勿关」徽标、不渲染关闭按钮，确保永不误关。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: PCL-style modpack for DSH plugins: export a small .dshpack.zip manifest of the selected third-party plugins and their versions, then import it with a preview before reinstalling.
description.zh: PCL 式 DSH 整合包：勾选已安装插件导出小体积 .dshpack.zip 与安装命令串，导入时先预览、确认后再按版本重新安装。

description.en: Host-side progress checkpoints for long DSH tasks. After N minutes or M tool calls the model is nudged to post a one-line progress note and keep working, so you can correct it before it runs far off course.
description.zh: DSH 长任务进度检查点——到点由宿主侧提示模型一边干活一边补一行进度，跑偏能及时纠正；汇报间隔与步数兜底都能在设置页里调。

description.en: Bring a DSH plugin repository's build and release pipeline into the app: a sidebar panel listing each repository's latest workflow run, its releases, and how far the local checkout has drifted from the last release, with buttons to trigger a build, cut a release, publish a draft, re-run, cancel, or read the failed-step log. Drives the workflows through the machine's authenticated gh CLI, so the plugin stores no credential of its own, and which repositories are tracked lives in a config file rather than the package.
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件仓库的持续构建与发布搬进应用：侧边栏面板逐仓库显示最近一次工作流运行、已发布与草稿 Release，以及本地检出相对上次发布的领先与未提交情况，并提供触发构建、发布、公开草稿、重跑、取消、查失败日志等按钮。通过本机已登录的 gh CLI 驱动工作流，插件自身不保存任何凭据，被监视的仓库列表放在配置文件里、不打进包。

description.en: Tokenrhythm (基元律动) finance dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: account balance & expiring credits, category-filtered model price cards (with discounted prices), service status and platform key management; login via platform account or session cookie — credentials stay on the local host.
description.zh: 基元律动费用中心：账户余额与限时额度、按分类筛选的模型价格卡（含折扣价）、服务状态与平台密钥管理，支持平台账号或 Cookie 登录，凭据存本机 host。

description.en: Unity-MCP bridge for DSH: dormant from boot, /unity-mcp-tools connects the Unity editor MCP server (com.ivanmurzak.unity.mcp) and registers the tools currently enabled on the Unity side; ships a per-plugin-version command catalog plus /unity-mcp-install and /unity-mcp-check, and re-fetches tools/list itself after a tool-set change because DSH sessions never receive list_changed.
description.zh: Unity-MCP 桥接：开机即休眠，/unity-mcp-tools 才连接 Unity 编辑器的 MCP 服务端（com.ivanmurzak.unity.mcp）并注册 Unity 侧当前已开启的工具；随包发布按插件版本生成的命令目录与 /unity-mcp-install、/unity-mcp-check 两个技能，工具集变更后桥接自行重拉 tools/list。

description.en: Active wait for background subagents in DeepSeek Harness: registers a wait_subagent model tool that blocks until a named background continuable subagent settles, then returns its stop reason and closing message — optional timeout, membership gate rejects unknown ids, event-driven with zero polling. Closes the gap between run_in_background fire-and-return and the async settlement notice; wait for a background subagent without polling list_agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台子代理的主动等待：注册 wait_subagent 模型工具，阻塞等待指定的后台 continuable（可续会话）子代理收尾（settlement），返回停止原因与收尾消息——可选超时、成员资格门控拒绝未知 id、事件驱动零轮询。补齐 run_in_background 发后不管与异步收尾通知之间的缺口：等待后台子代理（subagent wait）不再轮询 list_agents、不再靠猜。

description.en: Shows a dimmed suggestion of the user's next message in the empty composer after a settled turn; Tab accepts it into the draft and Escape or typing dismisses it.
description.zh: 在一轮对话结束后，用灰字在空的输入框里给出下一句建议；Tab 填入草稿，Esc 或打字忽略。

description.en: Store SSH hosts in an AES-256-GCM vault and let the agent run commands on them by alias, with passwords handed to ssh through SSH_ASKPASS instead of the command line. Windows only.
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机存进 AES-256-GCM 加密保险库，智能体按别名执行命令，口令经 SSH_ASKPASS 交给 ssh 而不进入命令行。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Signed chain-of-custody for sessions: every watched tool result appends a hash-chained, ed25519-signed record, with commits bound into the chain — tampering with any line or truncating the tail fails deterministic replay verification.
description.zh: 会话签名监护链：被监视的工具结果逐条追加哈希链 ed25519 签名记录，commit 绑定进链——篡改任意行或截断尾部都会在确定性重放校验中失败。

description.en: Maintainer and developer PR board for the DSH sidebar: a five-state review queue (waiting on me / waiting on author / ready to merge / merged / inbox), a three-column issue board, and a global view of the PRs you authored (my move / waiting on others / merged), with CI rollup badges, an inactivity filter, and one click per card to open or start the matching review conversation.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的维护者 + 开发者 PR 看板：五状态评审队列（等我 / 等作者 / 可合并 / 已合并 / 待分诊）、三列 issue 看板、跨仓库跟踪自己 PR 的 mine 视图（我的回合 / 等别人 / 已合并），附 CI 汇总徽章与不活跃过滤，点卡片一键打开或新建对应的评审会话。

description.en: Zen Mode view tab and foreground time tracker for DeepSeek Harness: while the agent works, a calm conversation view shows running/done status, your latest user message, live activity hints and the final AI reply in markdown with one-line turn stats, plus screen-watching (focus) time tracking with daily/weekly Zen scores, a chat-hide toggle that hides tool calls and reasoning rows, auto enter/exit Zen on task start/complete, an Alt+Z shortcut and a Zen settings panel — pure client-side, stored in localStorage, no network.
description.zh: 禅模式视图 + 前台盯屏时间统计插件：智能体后台运行时提供极简 Zen 标签页（进行中/结束状态文案、用户消息、动态提示、Markdown 渲染最终回复、单行轮次统计），统计前台盯屏时长并给出每日/每周禅值，支持一键隐藏中间过程（工具调用/推理行）、任务开始完成时自动进出禅、Alt+Z 快捷键与 Zen 设置面板——纯前端实现，数据存 localStorage，无网络请求。

description.en: Native workbench to select project sources, distill and test capability candidates, configure scoped Slack access, and review approvals and persistent tasks.
description.zh: 原生分身工作台：选择项目资料、蒸馏并试跑能力候选、配置有范围的 Slack 访问，查看审批与持久任务。

description.en: Per-session status labels (built-in active/done/paused plus custom) shown in the sidebar, conversation header, and hover card, with editable colors.
description.zh: 为每个会话设置项目状态标签（内置进行中/已结项/搁置中+自定义标签，颜色可调），在侧栏、对话头部与悬停卡片中显示。

description.en: Switch DSH's built-in web_search between the DeepSeek Search API (/v1/tools/search) and the default account search, with automatic fallback, a settings page and a sidebar switch.
description.zh: 给 DSH 内置 web_search 加一个开关：在 DeepSeek Search API（/v1/tools/search）与默认账号搜索之间切换，失败自动回退，并带设置页与侧栏开关。

description.en: JIRA task panel under the DSH composer: per-workspace project key and optional JQL, listing the issues assigned to the current user with status, priority and issue-type chips, a total count, collapse and refresh, links to JIRA, plus a settings card for the base URL and token with a connection probe.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的 JIRA 任务面板：按工作区配置项目 Key 与可选 JQL，展示指派给当前用户的问题，带状态、优先级与类型标签、总数徽标、收起与刷新、跳转 JIRA，并在设置页卡片配置 JIRA 地址与令牌（含连接测试）。

description.en: Turn-finished music reminder: when an agent turn ends, play a ringtone or any local audio file (bundled synthesised telephone ring, custom absolute path, or an in-page upload), with a floating chip to pause, resume or dismiss it and loop-until-paused playback; configured in Settings, defaults overridable per deployment.
description.zh: 回合提醒音乐：对话（回合）结束时播放铃声或任意本地音频提醒你回来——内置合成的电话「叮铃铃」，也可填宿主机绝对路径或直接在设置页上传；右下角浮标可暂停/继续/关闭，默认循环响到你手动停；设置项在「设置 → 内置插件」里，部署级默认值可写进 cordis.patch.yml。

description.en: Windows process-tree reconciler for the DSH host: samples the host process tree and the job ledger, attributes each process to the job that created it, flags unattributed and orphaned processes with a confidence level, and offers guarded termination of a whole tree. Termination is refused unless the target belongs to the DSH host tree, is re-sampled and re-checked immediately before the kill (creation time included), and contains no protected descendant, so an allowlisted PID cannot widen the kill scope.
description.zh: DSH 宿主的 Windows 进程树对账插件：采样宿主进程树与任务账本，把每个进程归属到创建它的任务，并按置信度标出未归属与孤儿进程，同时提供受保护的整树终止。终止必须满足：目标归属于 DSH 宿主树、在动手前重新采样复核（含创建时间）、目标树内不含受保护后代，因此白名单 PID 不会扩大可杀范围。

description.en: 273 ECC skills (95.8% of the 227k-star operator system) ported to DSH in four batches.
description.zh: ECC（227k⭐ 操作员系统）273 个技能（95.8%）分四批移植到 DSH。

description.en: Free voice closed loop for the Web UI: browser SpeechRecognition mic input with live interim results plus read-aloud speaker buttons and auto-read for assistant replies, zero configuration and no API key.
description.zh: Web UI 免费语音闭环：浏览器语音识别输入（实时中间结果上屏）+ 助手回复朗读与自动朗读，零配置、免 API key。

description.en: Requires the ui-ux-pro-max design skill to be installed; this plugin only gates it. Adds a switch to the DSH sidebar footer that enables or disables the ui-ux-pro-max design skill at runtime; the choice is stored in the profile settings.
description.zh: 需先安装 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能，本插件只做门控。在 DSH 侧边栏底部加一个开关，一键启用/停用 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能，选择保存在 profile 设置里。

description.en: One-off two-person password chat in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: end-to-end encrypted (the server sees ciphertext only), with images and screenshots, fully cleared on end.
description.zh: 装进 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏的一次性双人密码聊天：端到端加密（服务器只见密文），支持图片与截屏，结束即彻底清理，关掉 DSH 即消失。

description.en: Session minimap in the scrollbar gutter: to-scale bands coloured by event kind, anchor dots for user messages and failures, auto-loading history at the top, a hover wall of every prompt in the session, and a three-step map scale switcher.
description.zh: 滚动条槽位里的会话缩略图：按事件类型着色的等比色块、用户与失败锚点、滚到顶自动补载历史、悬停线索墙铺开全部发言，附近/中/全三档地图尺度切换。

description.en: WeChat official account AI writing pipeline: six-step article runs (topic, outline, draft, gates, render, images) with a launch brief contract, a hot-topic board with per-item AI digests, RRULE scheduling to the draft box, a workbench UI plus chat tools and a /wewrite command, and fail-closed host approval before any draft-box push.
description.zh: 公众号 AI 写作管线：六步成文（选题、大纲、成稿、门禁、渲染、配图）+ 启动 brief 合同、热榜逐条 AI 速览、RRULE 定时推草稿箱、写作台与对话工具（/wewrite 命令与 @ 引用），推送草稿箱前经宿主审批 fail-closed 确认。

description.en: Dynamic backgrounds and interface skins for DeepSeek Harness. Native customizable animated skins, plus beautiful live wallpapers to download from the marketplace. Built on Open Sea Skin (d-dev0101/open-sea-skin) - do not install both.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 动态背景与界面皮肤。原生个性化动态背景皮肤，以及市场下载精美的动态壁纸。沿用 Open Sea Skin（d-dev0101/open-sea-skin）的上游实现，请勿与上游同时安装。

description.en: Adjust Agent Team's member count, task count, message size and teardown timeout.
description.zh: 调整 Agent Team 的人数、任务数、单条消息大小与清理超时。

description.en: China A-share stock research: ticker search, announcements over any date range, financial report cards, valuation profiles and signal-factor explanations (~5,000 stocks since 2011, public read-only data service), plus a link-out tool to an external trading-sandbox product.
description.zh: A股个股研究：搜股票、查任意区间公告、财报卡、估值画像与交易信号科普（约 5000 只、2011 年至今，公共只读数据服务），另有一个跳转外部交易推演产品的链接工具。

description.en: Task-tiered session notifications for DSH: marked main-line sessions alert as they finish, other sessions batch into one summary, plus balanced and silent modes; per-event sounds or uploaded audio, per-session mute, click-through notifications, and an option to wait for subagents.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的任务分级会话通知：标记的主线任务完成或失败时立即提醒，其余会话汇总为一声；另有逐条提醒的均衡模式与完全不响的静音模式（提问与权限请求仍提醒）。支持每类事件独立音效或自定义音频、按会话静音、点击通知直达会话，以及等待子代理结束再提醒。

description.en: Annotate on selection, persist through refresh; send the notes with your message and the model answers each one.
description.zh: 选中即批注，刷新亦留存；随消息发送，模型逐条回应。

description.en: Forensic analysis of past model-routing decisions. Replays each session, classifies every turn's task complexity from its request shape (deterministic, no LLM), and reports two kinds of waste: an expensive model on cheap work (the difference is measurable), and a cheap model on expensive work that failed on its own merits — where every retry re-sends the whole context, so the downgrade cost more than the upgrade. Distinguishes provider-capacity retries (RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT) from model failures so it does not cry wolf. Derives routing rules from the evidence, priced against a built-in per-million table.
description.zh: 模型路由浪费取证：回放每个会话，按请求形状确定性判定每轮任务复杂度（不调 LLM），报两类浪费——贵模型干 便宜活（差额可计算），以及便宜模型干贵活且因自身能力失败（每次重试重发整个上下文，比直接升级更贵）。会 区分服务商容量限制（RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT）与模型能力失败，所以不会天天喊狼来了。并从证据推导路由 规则，按内置每百万 token 价目表估算金额。

description.en: Memory that outlives the session, kept as plain daily log files: one markdown file per day plus a generated index the agent greps instead of re-reading. Registers the annals skill, injects the write-it-down rules into the system prompt, and exposes three tools — annals_init builds the log directory, the index generator and a separate Git repository in one call; annals_query full-text searches past entries and returns them with file and line anchors; annals_links resolves which entry cites which. Reminds the agent once per turn when it changed files but wrote no log that day, and once more when the log was updated but the index was not. Adds a settings page for the six switches.
description.zh: 活过本次会话的记忆，载体是普通的每日日志文件：一天一个 markdown，外加一份生成出来的索引，让助手先用索引检索而不是重读全文。注册 annals 技能，把「写下来」的规矩注入系统提示词，并提供三个工具——annals_init 一次建好日志目录、索引生成器与独立的 git 仓库；annals_query 全文检索历史条目并带回文件与行号锚点；annals_links 查条目之间的双向引用。改过文件但当天没写日志时每轮提醒一次，写了日志却没更新索引时再提醒一次。另有设置页可关这六个开关。

description.en: Play Gomoku against the AI, or let two AIs battle it out.
description.zh: 与 AI 下五子棋，也可让 AI 对局比棋力。

description.en: Adjusts the context-window percentage at which DSH triggers its native automatic compaction: a slider on the plugin page in the plugins manager sets it from 1% to 100% (default 80%, arrow keys adjust by 1%), and the retained-history budget shrinks with lower thresholds so early compaction is not defeated; the compaction run itself stays with the native engine.
description.zh: 调整 DSH 原生自动上下文压缩的触发阈值：在插件管理器的插件页面用滑块设置上下文占满模型窗口多少百分比时压缩（1%–100%，默认 80%，方向键可 1% 微调）；阈值调低时保留的最近历史预算会随之缩小，以免提前压缩被抵消，压缩本身仍由原生引擎执行。

description.en: Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents.
description.zh: 面向 AI 生成代码的死代码检测：graphlint 构建依赖图，定位从任何入口不可达的代码，以实现代码库清理和功能有效性理解，并为 DSH 智能体提供 graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config 工具与 graphlint 技能。

description.en: Conversation node appearance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: configurable per-category and per-tool colors (left accent bar + tinted background), plus a show-thinking toggle; pure frontend rendering, takes effect instantly and persists to the DSH user settings file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话节点外观插件：按节点类别/工具名可配置着色（左侧色条 + 淡色底），附带"显示思考过程"开关；纯前端渲染增强，改动即时生效并持久化到 DSH 用户设置文件。

description.en: Web search provider for the ctx.web seam that routes the DeepSeek web_search tool through a LiteLLM proxy using the OpenAI Responses API, reusing LITELLM_API_KEY.
description.zh: ctx.web 搜索提供方：通过 LiteLLM 代理走 OpenAI Responses API 调用 DeepSeek 原生服务端 web_search，复用 LITELLM_API_KEY，无需新密钥。

description.en: Real Windows OS toasts for DeepSeek Harness: task-finished, needs-input and needs-approval alerts that persist in Notification Center under DeepSeek branding. Windows-only, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 真正的 Windows 系统 Toast（通知中心持久、DeepSeek 品牌鲸鱼图标）：任务完成 / 需要输入 / 需要审批时提醒。仅支持 Windows，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Cite Lens for dsh: select text in a PDF in the Files tab to quote or ask about it in the current chat, and turn the model's \[main.pdf p.7 "exact words"] citations into links that open the PDF and highlight the passage; /cite-links makes a chat cite every claim.
description.zh: dsh 的 PDF 阅读：在文件选项卡里选中 PDF 中的文字，就能引用到当前对话或就它提问；把模型的引用变成链接，点开 PDF 并高亮被引用的那几句话；/cite-links 让一段对话为每条论断都附上引用。

description.en: Test-insight plugin that turns repository facts and change risk into evidence-backed test plans and isolated, reviewable test drafts.
description.zh: 测试洞察插件：把仓库事实与变更风险转化为有证据支撑的测试计划与隔离、可人工审查的测试草稿。

description.en: Embedded terminal for DeepSeek Harness: opens an in-app terminal panel in the right sidebar (DockKit) or bottom composer dock, with PSReadLine geometry protection and full theme sync.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内嵌终端插件：在右侧栏（DockKit Tab）或输入框下方以沉底抽屉形式提供界面内嵌的交互式终端，跟随官方主题与工作区目录，支持 PSReadLine 尺寸保护与位置热切换。

description.en: Opens academic sites through institutional proxy rules and optionally renames eligible new PDFs using matched article metadata, with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and US English settings.
description.zh: 按机构代理规则打开学术网站，可依据匹配的论文元数据重命名符合条件的新 PDF，并提供简体中文、繁体中文及美式英语设置界面。

description.en: Turns a ZSpace (极空间) NAS into native agent tools: list, stat, search, read, download, upload, write, create folders, rename, move, copy and delete files on the NAS. Works across networks through the desktop client relay — no LAN, no WebDAV, no SSH — and switches to the faster direct WebDAV transport automatically when the NAS is on the same network. Deletes require an explicit confirm: true; write, upload, create-folder, rename, move and copy run directly, and zspace_write overwrites a same-named file unless overwrite is false.
description.zh: 把极空间（ZSpace）NAS 变成 agent 的原生工具：列目录、查属性、按名检索、读取、下载、上传、写入、建目录、重命名、移动、复制、删除 NAS 文件。跨网络走桌面客户端中转——不需要同一局域网、不用 WebDAV、不用 SSH；同一网络时自动改走更快的 WebDAV 直连。删除需显式传 confirm: true；写入、上传、建目录、重命名、移动、复制默认直接执行，zspace_write 会覆盖同名文件（除非传 overwrite: false）。

description.en: Adds an Auto permission preset between Workspace Write and Full access: routine work stays in the official workspace-write sandbox while the current session model reviews escalation and destructive calls, granting one exact wider access once, asking when the intent is ambiguous, and denying critical paths.
description.zh: 在 Workspace Write 与 Full access 之间增加 Auto 权限档：日常操作留在官方 workspace-write 沙箱内，由当前会话模型复核升权与破坏性调用，精确的越界访问按次放行一次，意图不明时询问，命中关键路径则拒绝。

description.en: One-click prompt improvement for the DSH composer: press the sparkle button to rewrite the draft into an agent-ready prompt, replaced in place and undoable, with a deterministic fidelity check that keeps every path, identifier, number, URL and backticked token verbatim, plus a length ceiling that blocks inflation.
description.zh: DSH 输入框一键增强提示词：点 ✦ 把草稿改写成 Agent 可执行的提示词，直接替换并可一键撤回；保真闸机械校验硬事实（路径、标识符、数字与版本、URL、反引号代码）逐字存活，长度闸防止把一句话需求膨胀成规格书。

description.en: Model Capability Manager for DSH Web: thinking levels, context window, output caps, input modalities, gateway compat presets, EN/中文 UI.
description.zh: DSH 网页端模型能力管理插件：控制推理档位、上下文与输出上限、输入模态及网关兼容预设，双语界面。

description.en: Runs persistent bash and Linux-path file and search tools inside the current WSL distribution. A new conversation that selects WSL mode asks which of that distribution's folders to use as the workspace, and nothing is installed inside the distribution.
description.zh: 在当前 WSL 发行版里运行持久 bash 以及 Linux 路径的文件与搜索工具。新建对话选中 WSL 后，从该发行版的文件夹里指定工作区，且不会在发行版内安装任何东西。

description.en: Registers a keyless search provider for the built-in web_search tool so it works without an API key, failing over between the documented no-key tiers of Tavily and Firecrawl; a TAVILY_API_KEY or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is picked up automatically when present. Two Bing scrape backends are included but off by default.
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具注册免密钥搜索提供方：无需 API Key 即可使用，在 Tavily 与 Firecrawl 官方免密钥通道之间自动降级；若设置了 TAVILY_API_KEY 或 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY 会自动采用。另含两个 Bing 抓取后端，默认关闭。

description.en: Deterministic prompt-injection interception: tool results from file reads, repo searches and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context; high-severity findings quarantine-wrap or block, and credential-material files quarantine on the path alone.
description.zh: 确定性注入拦截：文件读取、仓库搜索与网络抓取的工具结果在进入模型上下文前被扫描；高危发现隔离包裹或阻断，凭证类文件按路径即隔离。

description.en: Runs one-time and RFC 5545 recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with visual schedule editing and session-linked history.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或 RFC 5545 周期 Agent 任务，支持可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。

description.en: Forwards an unattended DeepSeek Harness run's tool-call approvals and ask_user_question prompts to Feishu cards on your phone. The desktop GUI answers first — a card is only sent after `delaySeconds` (120 by default) with no answer there — and a phone approval grants `allowed-once`, so no authority accumulates on the phone. One outbound WebSocket long connection to Feishu: no public IP, domain, tunnel or relay.
description.zh: 把无人值守运行时 DeepSeek Harness 的工具调用审批与 ask_user_question 提问推送到手机飞书卡片。桌面 GUI 优先作答——只有在 `delaySeconds`（默认 120 秒）内无人应答时才发出卡片——手机上的批准等同于 `allowed-once`，因此不会在手机上累积任何权限。仅一条到飞书的出站 WebSocket 长连接：不需要公网 IP、域名、隧道或中继。

description.en: Meeting notes for dsh: one meeting per conversation, transcribed and speaker-separated on the machine itself, with points, assignments, handwritten notes, reviews and monthly scores in the same panel. Exports SRT/Markdown/Word and packs a meeting into a portable zip another dsh can import; confirmed assignments go to DingTalk/WeCom in one click, following your robot settings. Recognition models are swappable (a stronger local model can be imported from a file), and cloud recognition is off by default with no request made before consent. Word export needs Python and python-docx; the first run downloads a recognition model (28 or 77 MB).
description.zh: 会议记录插件：一个会话对应一场会议，本机离线转写与发言人分离；要点、工作安排、手写笔记、复盘与月度评分都在面板里完成。可导出 SRT／Markdown／Word，也能打成「会议工程包」（zip）在另一台 dsh 导入；已确认的工作安排按设置一键推送到钉钉／企业微信。识别模型可更换（支持从本地文件导入更强的模型），云端识别默认关闭、未同意即零请求。导出 Word 需 Python 与 python-docx；首次使用会下载识别模型（28 MB 或 77 MB）。

description.en: Restart the DSH host from inside a session without cutting the answer: dsh_restart waits for every agent to go idle, logs the causes, and wakes the asking sessions afterwards.
description.zh: 在会话内部重启 DSH 宿主而不打断回答：dsh_restart 等到所有代理空闲，记录原因，并在重启后唤醒请求通知的会话。

description.en: Composer key remap for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: bind Enter, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, Shift+Enter or any custom chord to the Send, Newline or Interrupt actions, with cross-action migration, durable persistence and native behavior preserved by default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框键位自定义：把 Enter、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter、Shift+Enter 或任意组合键分配给发送、换行、打断三个动作，支持跨动作互斥迁移与持久化保存，默认保持 DSH 原生行为。

description.en: Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.
description.zh: DSH 重启插件：可配置的重启方式（Node 原生/旧 PowerShell 适配）、重启后自动继续的提示词、可选看门狗自动拉起。

description.en: A talking whale desktop pet for the DSH web UI — persona-driven chat with persistent memory, plus scheduled autonomous web browsing that brings back a summarized message telling you what she found. Based on PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (its art and animations are reused under the upstream non-commercial terms); install it instead of dsh-pet, not alongside it.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面右下角的会说话的鲸鱼桌宠：可配置人设与持久对话记忆，还会按间隔自己随机上网，把见闻总结成消息带回来告诉你。基于 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet 的二次创作（沿用其形象与动画素材，素材不可商用），请替代 dsh-pet 安装，不要与上游同装。

description.en: Web Composer placement for long prompts: keep it at the bottom or dock it in a resizable right column beside a long answer.
description.zh: 面向长提示词的 Web Composer 布局：输入框可保留在底部，也可停靠到可调宽度的右栏，与长回答并排阅读和写作。

description.en: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里并排运行、监控多个对话实例：多窗口墙 + 自动发现 + 单窗控制，内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。

description.en: Audit how each turn's context budget is spent. Breaks down what a turn pays for AGENTS.md, the skill catalog, tool schemas and runtime context; flags repeated injection of unchanged content as pure waste; ranks skill-catalog bloat (with 60+ skills installed, how many tokens of descriptions does the model read every turn) and tool-schema inflation per plugin. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name. Four tools including a cross-session sweep.
description.zh: 每轮上下文预算审计：拆解一轮对话在 AGENTS.md、技能目录、工具 schema 与运行时上下文上各花了多少；把"内容 没变却每轮重发"标为纯浪费；排名技能目录膨胀（装 60+ 个技能时，模型每轮要读多少 token 的描述）与各插件的 工具 schema 占比。纯确定性，不调 LLM。四个工具，含跨会话扫描。

description.en: Recreates a workspace folder that was deleted while sessions were still bound to it, and summarizes a stranded session so its context can be reused.
description.zh: 有会话绑定的工作区目录被删时自动重建；并把失去归属的会话折叠成摘要，供新会话导入。

description.en: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename), keyboard model switching via Alt+M, alternate send, Esc focus hand-off, and Alt+W to close or restore a dsh-split-screen workspace — all rebindable with Windows/macOS presets. Verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
description.zh: Web 会话热键插件：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话——Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、Alt+M 键盘切换模型与备用发送、Esc 焦点交接，Alt+W 关闭/恢复 dsh-split-screen 工作区；键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

description.en: LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness providing diagnostics, formatting, rename, code actions, and symbols over real language servers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的通用 LSP 工具面，提供语言服务器诊断、格式化、重命名、代码动作与符号导航。

description.en: All-in-one DSH extension center in Settings: manage skills, MCP servers and plugins, a Plugin Market (curated + GitHub search, npm one-click install), and an Add-ons block to install, disable, uninstall and update companion features together.
description.zh: 设置页一体化扩展中心：管理技能/MCP/插件，内置插件市场（精选目录+GitHub 搜索、npm 一键安装），并提供附加功能区统一安装/停用/卸载、一起更新附属功能。

description.en: Registers the REA reverse-engineering toolset in DSH and manages its Node and REA runtime, with a global tool switch, a live composer status indicator and in-place runtime upgrades. On first start it downloads a pinned Node and REA runtime (from nodejs.org and npm) into a managed location and registers REA's full tool catalogue as mcp__rea__*; optional analyzers are set up only on request.
description.zh: 把 REA 逆向分析工具集接入 DSH，并托管其 Node 与 REA 运行时：提供全局工具开关、输入框状态指示点和就地运行时升级。首次启动会从 nodejs.org 和 npm 下载固定版本的 Node 与 REA 运行时到受管目录，并把 REA 的全部工具注册为 mcp__rea__*；可选的分析器只在你要求时才配置。

description.en: Read-only repository fact scanner kernel for DSH analysis plugins: deterministic probe / file index / modules / dependencies / entry points / symbols / graphs and git facts over a stable JSON schema (CLI + library + skill runbook).
description.zh: 只读仓库事实扫描内核：为分析型插件提供可复现的仓库探测、文件索引、模块、依赖、入口、符号与 Git 变更等硬事实（CLI + 库接口 + 技能 runbook）。

description.en: Mounts the pen.dev desktop app MCP server in a DSH session so the model can read and edit the .pen document open in Pen through the get_app_state, read_skill, execute, get_style and browser tools; finds the server binary by probing the usual install paths, and adds a pen-dev skill plus a listener that turns pen.dev plan-limit failures into a short bilingual notice. Unofficial, and ships no pen.dev binaries.
description.zh: 把 pen.dev 桌面应用的 MCP 服务器挂进 DSH 会话，模型即可通过 get_app_state、read_skill、execute、get_style、browser 读取并修改 Pen 中打开的 .pen 文档；服务器二进制按常见安装路径探测定位，另附一个 pen-dev 技能，以及一个把 pen.dev 额度用尽错误改写成简短中英提示的监听器。非官方项目，不含 pen.dev 任何二进制。

description.en: Speaker button left of the model selector in the composer tool row — one click scrolls to the start of your newest question, marks it with a blinking caret and reads from there through the newest agent reply (dsh-tts, browser voice as fallback); press-and-hold the icon and then click anywhere on the page to pick another reading start position; press-and-drag-up opens a vertical mixer for in-page media volume and system output volume.
description.zh: 输入框工具行里、模型选择框左边的扬声器按钮——单击翻到「你最新提问的开头」并闪烁光标，从那里读到最新回复结尾（走 dsh-tts，回退浏览器语音）；按住图标后在页面上单击即可挑选任意朗读起点；按住上滑调出竖式混音台，分别控制页内媒体音量与系统输出音量。

description.en: Combine text, vision, and image-generation APIs into one Mix model with automatic routing: text-only requests go to the chat model, user images and agent screenshots go to the vision model, follow-ups keep using the same session image, and agents can generate or edit images with session-scoped call history.
description.zh: 把文本、识图和生图 API 组合成一个 Mix 模型并按对话内容自动路由：纯文本走聊天模型，用户图片和 Agent 截图走识图模型，后续可继续追问同一张图；还支持图片生成与编辑及会话级调用记录。

description.en: Runs a userspace tailscaled for Harness so web fetch, shell, plugin and LLM traffic can each use a Tailscale exit node, leaving routes and DNS untouched. Needs Tailscale's tailscaled installed separately; it starts a second per-user daemon, routes the selected traffic through a loopback proxy and looks up the exit IP through ifconfig.me. An auth key, if you set one, is kept in the plugin config.
description.zh: 为 Harness 单独运行一个用户态 tailscaled：网页抓取、命令行、其他插件、大模型四类流量各自选择是否走 Tailscale 出口节点，系统路由与 DNS 不变。需要另行安装 Tailscale 的 tailscaled；它会再启动一个用户级守护进程，把所选流量经本机回环代理转发，并通过 ifconfig.me 查询出口 IP。若设置了 auth key，会保存在插件配置里。

description.en: Fetches up-to-date, version-pinned library documentation and code examples from context7.com for DSH agents via context7_search and context7_get_docs tools.
description.zh: 通过 context7_search 与 context7_get_docs 工具，为 DSH 智能体从 context7.com 获取最新、可锁定版本的库文档与代码示例。

description.en: Kimi Coding web search and web fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness — one coding-plan key fills both ctx.web seams (POST /v1/search and /v1/fetch), a settings card in the GUI stores it via the credentials service, and the fallback chain reads the Kimi CLI config for zero-setup installs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Kimi Coding 的网页搜索与网页抓取双提供方——一把 coding 计划密钥同时接入 ctx.web 的两条链路（/v1/search 与 /v1/fetch），设置卡片经凭据服务保存密钥，并回退读取 Kimi CLI 配置，安装即用。

description.en: Uses a dedicated model for context compaction rescue and adds manual compaction to the native context popup.
description.zh: 使用专用模型处理上下文压缩恢复，并在原生上下文弹窗提供手动压缩。

description.en: A versions tab on the plugin page: every installed bundle with its current version, the newest published version and a status (update available, up to date, follows the harness version, or not updatable from a registry). A row opens the official bundle page, where the update button lives; check results are cached and re-checked oldest first. The bundle page also gets a jump-to-bottom and a back-to-top button.
description.zh: 插件页新增「版本一览」标签页：列出每个已安装组合包的当前版本、最新发布版本与状态（可更新、已是最新、随 DSH 版本更新、来源不支持更新）。点一行跳到官方组合包页，更新仍在官方页面完成；检查结果会缓存，并按缓存时间从旧到新重新核对。组合包页另加「到底部」与「回到顶部」两个按钮。

description.en: Terminal coding agent for DeepSeek Harness with a full-screen alternate-screen UI, turn-aware session navigation, and a gated /ship workflow that takes one-line requirements through specification, TDD, and rerun acceptance checks.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的终端编码 Agent，提供全屏备用屏幕 UI、轮次感知的会话导航，以及将一句话需求经过规格、TDD 和验收复跑的分阶段 /ship 流程。

description.en: Add a WSL directory as a DSH workspace from the sidebar's Add workspace button: pick a distribution, browse the Linux tree, and the directory is registered as a \\wsl.localhost workspace whose sidebar terminals open inside the distribution and whose files the agent can write. Requires Windows 10/11 with WSL installed.
description.zh: 在侧栏的「添加工作区」按钮里把 WSL 目录加成 DSH 工作区：选发行版、浏览目录后以 \\wsl.localhost 路径注册；该工作区的侧栏终端开在发行版里，agent 也能正常写入其中的文件。需 Windows 10/11 并已安装 WSL。

description.en: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
description.zh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

description.en: Automatic Flash/Pro routing for DeepSeek Harness subagent calls: light tasks run on a cheap model (e.g. V4 Flash), heavy tasks stay on the strong model — with per-call overrides and /delegate session modes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理调用做 Flash/Pro 自动分派：轻任务自动用便宜模型、重任务留在强模型，支持手动覆盖与 /delegate 会话模式。

description.en: Adds a Delete Session row to every sidebar session '...' menu (the official harness has archive/pin/rename/fork only, no durable delete). One-click Force delete ejects the session from the host live catalog, stops its background work, then removes the durable log, projection cache and registry bookkeeping - no ghost rows on any connected desktop web UI. Workspace files the session created are kept; conversation logs are permanently deleted. Third-party cloud mirrors (e.g. phone apps via Agents Anywhere) hold their own copies. Bilingual zh/en UI, trust-fenced local route. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1.
description.zh: 给侧边栏每个会话的"…"菜单加上"删除会话"（官方只有归档/置顶/重命名/分叉，无持久 删除）。一键「强制删除」：逐出宿主内存态会话、停止后台工作后，彻底清除会话日志、 投影缓存与注册表记账，已连接的桌面 Web 端即时清行、不留幽灵。会话生成的工作区文件 保留，对话记录永久删除；第三方云端镜像（如经 Agents Anywhere 同步的手机 App）持有 各自副本、需在其 App 内管理。中英双语界面，本地回环路由带信任栅栏。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1。

description.en: Send local files to WeChat from any DSH session by reusing an installed IM plugin, plus cron-scheduled tasks that run in fresh sessions, a workspace activity glow, a header activity indicator, a completion chime, a macOS sidebar vibrancy toggle and a one-click host restart.
description.zh: 在任意 DSH 会话把本机文件主动投递到微信（复用已装的 IM 插件），另有按 cron 在全新会话里跑的定时任务、工作区活动呼吸灯、标题栏活跃指示、对话完成提示音、关闭 macOS 侧栏毛玻璃与一键重启宿主。

description.en: Claude-style skin with a warm-black canvas, clay accent, and serif UI that follows the native light and dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格皮肤：暖黑画布、陶橙点缀、衬线 UI，跟随原生亮/暗主题。

description.en: Keeps running, finished-but-unopened and currently open sessions pinned above the workspace groups in the DSH Web sidebar, and lets any session or workspace be pinned there from its own "..." menu.
description.zh: 把运行中、跑完未点开和当前打开的会话固定在 DSH Web 侧栏工作区分组上方，并可从任意会话/工作区的「...」菜单里全局置顶。

description.en: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: the standard tool stack plus four working rules written into the persona prompt — a project keeps at most four documents (intro, decisions, change log, current state and next steps), those documents describe only the current state with no AI edit history or superseded decisions, no git commit or push or pull request until the user explicitly asks, and a careful-coding workflow (restate the goal and done-criteria first, surgical diffs, evidence before claiming success) with plain-language reports.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Agent 预设：标准模式的工具栈，外加写进人格提示的四条工作纪律——每个项目最多四个文档（项目介绍、方案设定、改动记录、现状与下一步）；文档只写当前状态，不记 AI 修改历史、不留被推翻的旧方案；用户没有明确指令就不提交、不推送、不开 PR；动手前先复述目标与验收标准、只做手术式最小改动、没验证不说已修复，汇报用大白话。

description.en: Plugin marketplace in Settings that targets any local profile, not just the running one: install, update and remove across web, headless and other profiles, with install-script warnings, an installed view that also covers non-catalog profile dependencies, and an automatic DSH restart when the current profile changes.
description.zh: 设置页里的插件市场，可操作本机任意 profile 而不只是当前运行的那个：在 web、headless 及其他 profile 上安装、更新、卸载，带安装脚本风险提示，已装视图同时覆盖目录之外的 profile 依赖，改动当前 profile 时自动重启 DSH。

description.en: Adds two UI surfaces: a composer image editor (numbered marks with per-mark instructions, background removal, brush-mask erase, resize with crop/padding preview, keyboard-accessible markers; results return as attachments plus a version-1 manifest) and a Settings → vision/generation provider panel (explicit provider picker, providerId normalization, ChatGPT-web accounts synced into channels, per-channel test/try-run/copy-command, script readiness scan, save validation with .env preview, probing that only disables on explicit quota errors, Chinese/English UI) that writes providers back to the skills .env files.
description.zh: 为 img2img-studio 提供两个界面：① 输入框上方的图片编辑器（编号标记 + 每处改法、纯色背景移除、涂抹掩码擦除、比例与尺寸调整（含裁切/留白预览）、标记键盘微调，结果以附件 + version 1 manifest 回填输入框）；② 设置页「识图与生图」供应商面板（显式选择供应商、providerId 归一化、ChatGPT 网页账号库同步为通道、每通道测试/试跑/复制命令、脚本就绪扫描、保存校验与 .env 预览、只对明确欠费码自动关停、中英双语），保存后写回两个 skill 的 .env。

description.en: Qwen media tools: multimodal video and audio understanding, text-to-speech with preset voices, and scene audio generation, through Alibaba Cloud DashScope.
description.zh: Qwen 媒体工具：通过阿里云百炼提供多模态视频音频理解、带预置音色的语音合成，以及场景音频生成。

description.en: A panel plugin that keeps mini-games in one place and plays them in the same window. Ships with Tetris: a 10x20 board, seven pieces, a ghost piece and a next-piece preview, line and level scoring, three difficulty levels, and a best score kept in localStorage.
description.zh: 面板插件：把开发的小游戏集中到一处，并在同一窗口内直接游玩。首发俄罗斯方块：10×20 棋盘、七种方块、落点虚影与下一个方块预览、消行与等级计分、三档难度，最高分存在 localStorage。

description.en: QUASAR — a space-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness: an ink black hole in the sidebar and a live accretion disk rendered behind the app, with frosted-glass panels. Motion is canvas-driven and honors prefers-reduced-motion.
description.zh: QUASAR — DeepSeek Harness 的太空主题皮肤：侧栏里一颗墨色黑洞，应用背后实时渲染吸积盘，配合磨砂玻璃面板。动效由 canvas 驱动，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。

description.en: Per-workspace gate that hides the tool schemas and system prompt sections of selected plugins from the model in directories that do not need them.
description.zh: 按工作区门控插件：把选定插件的工具 schema 与系统提示词段，从不需要它们的目录的模型上下文中摘掉。

description.en: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for DSH Web: supports Question and Approval cards, Standard/Vim/Custom profiles, and capability-gated Session and Workspace navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供按 profile 管理的键盘快捷键：支持 Question 和 Approval 卡片、Standard/Vim/Custom 配置，并按能力提供 Session 与 Workspace 导航。

description.en: Generate images from chat by calling a fleet of local or LAN ComfyUI workers, with workflow templates, worker health checks and queue control.
description.zh: 在对话里直接调用本机或局域网的 ComfyUI 机队出图，支持工作流模板、机队健康检查与队列控制。

description.en: Skill center panel for the DSH web GUI - search online skill registries (SkillHub, skills.sh, GitHub), install skills to user or project roots, and manage local skills with enable, create, edit, delete and preview.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的技能中心面板——搜索网络技能市场（SkillHub、skills.sh、GitHub），一键安装技能到用户或项目根，并管理本地技能（启停、创建、编辑、删除、预览）。

description.en: Pins your DeepSeek Harness account balance to the bottom-right corner and refreshes it every 60 seconds, with a click for an immediate lookup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 主界面右下角常驻账户余额，60 秒自动刷新，点击即可立即查询。

description.en: Plugin store: npm authoritative catalog + awesome curated list (550+ plugins, 11 categories), dsh-field quality verification, official `dsh plugin add/remove` one-click install, sidebar + settings entry.
description.zh: dsh 插件商店：npm 权威目录 + awesome 精选（550+ 插件、11 分类）、dsh 字段质量验证、官方 `dsh plugin add/remove` 一键安装，侧边栏与设置页入口。

description.en: Shows what each completed turn cost in CNY on its own row under the turn, with a click-to-open breakdown naming the tokens per category, the unit rate, the matched price rule and the billing instant; per-model rates are edited on a settings page inside DSH — four token categories plus weekly recurring peak/valley rules with arbitrary multipliers and absolute time-window promo prices that override them. 0.2.3 adds account awareness: it reads the balance or remaining quota of 14 providers (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Zhipu GLM, Moonshot, MiniMax, Kimi Coding, OpenAI-compatible relays and more) and shows today / this month / this session spend next to it; spend is accumulated in a local ledger (atomic writes, one book per API key, 1-24 month retention, JSON export), and a monthly calendar lets any day be corrected by hand - including days with no balance observation - with an optional note. Usage and rates are computed locally from what the provider reported; balance is read straight from the provider API with your own key, and nothing is sent to a third party.
description.zh: 在每个已完成回合的下方单独一行显示这一轮的花费金额（人民币），点击展开明细，列出各 token 类别的数量、单价、命中的价格规则与计费时刻；单价可在 DSH 设置页里按模型维护，含四类 token 单价、每周循环的峰谷规则（系数自定）与绝对时间区间的限时优惠价。0.2.3 起还能看账户：读取 14 家 provider 的余额或剩余额度（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、智谱 GLM、月之暗面、MiniMax、Kimi Coding、OpenAI 兼容中转站等），在旁边显示今日 / 本月 / 本会话花费；花费记在本机日账里（原子写、按 API key 分本、保留 1-24 个月、可导出 JSON），另有一张按月日历，任何一天都能手动更正（包括没有余额观测的日子）并可加备注。用量与单价都在本机计算，余额用你自己的密钥直接向 provider 接口查询，不经过第三方。

description.en: Quick-open palette for the Web GUI: Ctrl+P fuzzy-searches an in-memory index of the session workspace (about 51k entries, median query 5 ms) with per-segment path anchoring, dir: and file: prefixes, Tab directory drilling and :line jumps, opens the picked file in the native right sidebar, and drops a file reference into the conversation draft with Ctrl+Enter. Also adds in-file find (Ctrl+F) and a selection-to-reference action to the built-in file preview.
description.zh: Web GUI 的快速打开面板：Ctrl+P 在会话工作区的内存索引上做模糊检索（约 5.1 万条目，查询中位数 5 ms），支持逐段路径锚定、dir: 与 file: 前缀、Tab 目录下钻与 :行号 跳转；选中文件走 DSH 原生右栏打开，Ctrl+Enter 把文件引用放进会话草稿。另为内置文件预览补上文件内查找（Ctrl+F）与选中加入会话。

description.en: Slides out a Monaco editor plus a lazy-loaded file-tree panel in the DSH Web conversation, so you can edit the local workspace inline without switching to an external editor.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话界面右侧滑出 Monaco 编辑器与文件树面板，直接在对话里编辑本地工作区代码，无需切到外部编辑器。

description.en: Runs the locally installed ZCode CLI as a `zcode` model route in DSH: all traffic is signed by the official binary, the plugin never sends its own request, forges client requests or sends credentials off the machine (the plan token is decrypted in memory only to hand back to the official CLI), no API key is needed, and both a paid one-shot and a free app-server channel are supported. Since v0.3.0 it ships an HTTP MCP bridge so tool calls run through the DSH approval surface. Backed by a contract document and a node --test gate.
description.zh: 把本机已安装的 ZCode CLI 接成 DSH 的 `zcode` 模型路由：流量全部由官方二进制签名，插件自身不发请求、不伪造客户端请求、不把凭据传出本机（plan token 只在内存中解密并交还官方 CLI），不需要 API Key，付费一次性与免费 app-server 两条通道并存；v0.3.0 起内建 HTTP MCP 工具桥，工具调用走 DSH 的审批面；有契约文档与 node --test 测试门禁背书。

description.en: Per-workspace closet for temporary scripts and their run logs, kept in a .dsh-fix directory inside each project. Registers a script with its language and purpose, scans a project for leftover scratch scripts, backups and log files, runs registered scripts with a timeout and writes each run to a timestamped log, and sweeps chosen files into a reversible trash with per-batch restore. Scanning only lists and never deletes; cleanup moves files instead of deleting them; files already tracked by git are refused unless forced. Ships 7 agent tools and a settings panel.
description.zh: 按工作区管理临时脚本与其运行日志的收纳间，数据放在每个项目内的 .dsh-fix 目录。可登记脚本（语言与用途）、扫描项目中遗留的临时脚本/备份/日志、带超时执行已登记脚本并把每次运行写进带时间戳的日志、把选中的文件清运进可整批还原的回收站。扫描只列清单永不删除；清运只做移动不做删除；已被 git 跟踪的文件默认拒收，确需处理要显式加 force。含 7 个 Agent 工具与一个设置面板。

description.en: Requires macOS and AirPods with head tracking. Answer DSH permission prompts and questions with AirPods head gestures — nod to allow or confirm, shake to reject or shift the selected option — and install the companion macOS menu-bar app from a card inside the session.
description.zh: 需 macOS 与支持头部追踪的 AirPods。戴着 AirPods 用点头/摇头回答 DSH 的权限许可与提问——点头＝允许或确认，摇头＝拒绝或切换选项；会话里一张卡片就能装好配套的 macOS 菜单栏 App。

description.en: A live preview panel for the ArtCraft applications inside the DSH Web GUI: the agent step list, the current render, a filmstrip of earlier steps and a timeline for time-based crafts, fed by the craft plugins' renders.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 内的 ArtCraft 实时预览面板：智能体步骤流、当前渲染、历史步骤胶片条，以及时间轴类应用的时间轴，数据来自各 craft 插件生成的渲染图。

description.en: AST-based structural code search and syntax outline tool powered by ast-grep.
description.zh: 基于 ast-grep 的语法级 AST 代码结构检索与大纲提取工具。

description.en: Choose API hostnames from configured providers or add them manually to route matching DSH backend Fetch/Undici requests through an existing local HTTP(S) proxy, leaving other routes unchanged; optional in-memory records show actual dispatch paths, first-content wait, token throughput and usage without storing prompts, responses or API keys.
description.zh: 从已配置的 Provider 选择 API 域名或手动添加，让命中的 DSH 后端 Fetch/Undici 请求通过已有本机 HTTP(S) 代理，其他请求沿用原有路线；可选开启内存调用记录，查看实际分发路线、首内容等待、token 速度与用量，不保存提示词、回答或 API Key。

description.en: Database explorer panel for DeepSeek Harness: connect SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Elasticsearch and Qdrant from a third Conversation tab — browse schemas, page through data, edit cells, insert rows, design and drop tables, run SQL, import/export CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown, and draw editable E-R diagrams. Read-only connections enforce statement-level allowlists, agent tools ship read-only by default with an opt-in write flag, and every write (including refused attempts) lands in an auditable log. Ships an MCP stdio server exposing the same connections to external AI clients.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库浏览器：在对话区第三个页签连接 SQLite、MySQL/MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、MongoDB、ClickHouse、Redis、Elasticsearch 与 Qdrant——浏览结构树、分页查看数据、编辑单元格、插入行、建表/改表/删表、执行 SQL、CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown 导入导出，以及可编辑的 E-R 关系图。只读连接按语句白名单硬拒绝写路径，agent 工具默认只读、写工具需显式授权，所有写操作（含被拒尝试）进入可查可删的审计日志；附带 MCP stdio 服务器，把同一份连接暴露给任意外部 AI 客户端。

description.en: Auto-discovery vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: automatically finds an image-capable model from your configured providers and returns picture descriptions as plain text via a vision tool.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 主模型搭视觉桥：自动从已配置模型中挑选多模态模型，通过 vision 工具把图片描述以纯文本返回。

description.en: Vision toolkit for text-only DeepSeek: model-invokable `vision` tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go (v4 flash/pro), Antigravity IDE quota (default, flash/pro) / any OpenAI-compatible VLM / Gemini / local Ollama channels, evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图工具包：模型可主动调用的 `vision` 工具、deepseek/opencode-go 包装适配器（v4 flash/pro）、反重力额度（默认，flash/pro）/ 任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM / Gemini / 本地 Ollama 通道、证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: Per-turn and per-session estimated cost in the DSH Web UI, computed from provider-reported token usage in four buckets with the built-in official DeepSeek CNY peak/off-peak card — peak hours are Monday-Friday 9:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time, weekends and Chinese statutory holidays are off-peak all day. An optional local JSON rate table overlays prices for other or self-hosted models, and models without a price show tokens only.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面显示每轮与整个会话的预估费用：按 provider 上报的 token 用量（四桶）与内置官方 DeepSeek 人民币峰谷价目计价，高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，周末与中国法定节假日全天按空闲价；可用本机费率表叠加其它或自部署模型的单价，没有单价的模型只显示 token。

description.en: Shows GLM Coding Plan quota windows (5-hour, weekly, monthly tools) as an always-visible pill in the composer stats row with a 5h reset countdown, opening a card-grid detail panel with limits, reset times, 24h per-model token usage and one-click plugin self-update.
description.zh: 在输入框统计行常驻 GLM Coding Plan 额度 pill(含 5 小时窗口重置倒计时),点击展开双列卡片式详情面板:各窗口限额、重置时间、近 24 小时按模型 Token 用量与小时级 sparkline,支持插件一键自更新。

description.en: Adds one 28x28 icon button per dsh-im channel that holds an account to the official Workspaces header row. Pressing one puts the sidebar into that channel's view, drawing only its conversations and hiding every other row; pressing it again drops back to the official list. Buttons appear only for channels with a connected account.
description.zh: 在官方「工作区」标题行上，为每个已接入账号的 dsh-im 通道添加一个 28x28 图标按钮。点击后侧栏切到该通道视图，只显示它的会话、隐藏其余所有行；再次点击回到官方列表。只有已接入账号的通道才会出现按钮。

description.en: Theme studio for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: eight switchable preset styles, accent and panel-translucency fine-tuning, host-side wallpapers painted on the first frame, and a one-click fix when the wallpaper-engine glass tint greys out light styles.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 主题工坊：可切换预设风格、强调色与面板透明度微调、宿主壁纸首帧绘制；wallpaper-engine 玻璃色把浅色主题洗灰时一键改为白色玻璃。

description.en: E-commerce product image generation for DSH: 24 prompt modules covering main, detail and ad images, style transfer from a reference shot, batch runs, and a project gallery with live preview.
description.zh: DSH 电商商品图生成：24 个提示词模块覆盖主图、详情图与广告图，支持参考图风格复刻、批量生成，以及作品库实时预览。

description.en: Manage, discover, install, update, and uninstall DSH skills as plugins.
description.zh: 类 Codex 插件市场的 DSH 技能管理器。

description.en: Feishu/Lark gateway for DeepSeek Harness with topic-persistent conversations, live execution cards, image and file inputs, in-chat approvals and questions, source allowlists, and durable one-time or recurring agent tasks created in natural language.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 网关：按话题持久化会话、实时执行卡片、图片与文件输入、聊天内审批和提问、来源白名单，以及用自然语言创建可持久化的一次性或周期 Agent 任务。

description.en: Test work framework for DSH that scaffolds a product, module and version directory tree, registers seven test_framework_* tools and four runtime skills, and adds a prompt-level gate that reports which requirement-document splits, versions, related documents and environment credentials are still unrecorded before testing starts. Requires the playwright MCP server (no fallback).
description.zh: DSH 测试工作框架：把空文件夹初始化为产品、模块、版本、报告与归档目录树，注册 7 个 test_framework_* 工具与 4 个运行时技能，并提供提示词级闸门——开测前报告需求文档拆分、版本、跨文档关联与环境账密中尚未登记的部分。需先配置 playwright MCP（无替代路径）。

description.en: Glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: frosted translucent surfaces with adjustable opacity, blur radius and saturation, ambient lighting and accent palettes, plus a custom background image with cover, contain, stretch, tile or center fit and crop, all persisted from a settings page.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的毛玻璃主题：磨砂半透明表面，可调不透明度、模糊半径与饱和度，支持氛围光与配色方案，并可设置自定义背景图片（填充、适应、拉伸、平铺、居中与裁剪），全部参数保存在设置页中。

description.en: Hierarchical workspace tree plus browser-style session tabs for the DSH sidebar: a "/" in a workspace or session title creates a virtual folder, with sections, pinning, time buckets, drag ordering, unified 6px status dots, per-row appearance customization (colour, glow, weight, icon) and a floating full-text search over session titles and message bodies. Several settings switches restore any behaviour to the host default, and a host-side route deletes sessions permanently (DSH ships archive only). Fork of KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的工作区层级树与浏览器式会话标签页：工作区或会话标题中的 / 自动成为虚拟分组，另含分区、置顶、时间分桶、拖拽排序、统一 6px 状态点、按行定制外观（颜色 / 发光 / 字重 / 图标），以及覆盖会话标题与消息正文的浮层全文检索。配置页多个开关可把任一行为还原为宿主默认；宿主侧另有永久删除会话的路由（DSH 只有归档）。fork 自 KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace。

description.en: Split the DSH sidebar workspace list into Active, Session tasks and Inactive sections with manual pins and an activity threshold, keeping the official search, archive filters, row menus and drag and drop, with a one-click switch back to the shipped list. The Session tasks section uses a fixed Windows workspace at D:\files\history-tasks; other platforms must create that directory manually.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏工作区列表分为「活跃 / 会话任务 / 不活跃」三段，支持手动钉住与活跃阈值，保留官方搜索、归档筛选、行菜单与拖拽，并可一键切回官方列表。「会话任务」段固定用 Windows 路径 D:\files\history-tasks，其他平台需自行预建该目录。

description.en: Session-memory autopilot: watches DSH sessions and extracts OKF entries in-process through the harness LLM (ctx.llm, deepseek-official by default) at idle, commit, compaction and end checkpoints, storing them via the vault MCP server.
description.zh: 会话记忆自动驾驶：监听 DSH 会话，在会话结束与压缩前通过宿主 LLM（ctx.llm，默认 deepseek-official）就地抽取 OKF 条目，无需外部 API Key。

description.en: Insurance company financial & operating analyst — solvency, financials, investment, distribution channels and peer comparison with real calculations.
description.zh: 保险公司财务经营分析专家，真跑偿付能力、财务报表、投资、渠道与同业对标测算。

description.en: Preview local HTML in the right sidebar, annotate elements or regions, and send the selections with current and target styles into the current session.
description.zh: 在右侧栏预览本地 HTML，点选元素或框选区域写批注，把选中项、当前样式与目标样式一起发进当前会话。

description.en: Browse, search, install, and apply VS Code color themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: bundles 14 curated themes with live color-swatch previews, searches the official VS Code Marketplace for more, and one-click installs map any theme's palette onto the DSW design tokens with live switching and persisted selection.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中浏览、搜索、安装并应用 VS Code 配色主题：内置 14 款精选主题并带实时色卡预览，可搜索官方 VS Code 插件市场安装更多主题，一键安装会把任意主题的调色板映射到 DSW 设计令牌，支持实时切换与选择持久化。

description.en: Local cross-session messaging for DSH agents, with discovery, cold-session wake-up delivery, and auditable message history.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的本地跨会话消息桥：支持会话发现、冷会话唤醒投递与可审计消息记录。

description.en: Registers a SpecWorkflow skill pack for requirement clarification, implementation specs, execution, delivery review, repair planning, bug diagnosis, and source-backed research.
description.zh: 注册 SpecWorkflow 技能包，覆盖需求澄清、实施规格、代码执行、交付检查、修复规划、bug 诊断和带来源调研。

description.en: RTK (Rust Token Killer) extension for dsh-router: rewrites each bash tool call through `rtk rewrite` so the agent reads compressed command output, and falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 RTK(Rust Token Killer)扩展插件：把每次 bash 工具调用经 `rtk rewrite` 改写，让 agent 读到压缩后的命令输出；rtk 缺失或无等价改写时原样执行。

description.en: Runs one-time and recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with natural-language schedules, visual schedule editing and session-linked history. Supports custom models, skills, pause on failure, and permission settings.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或周期 Agent 任务，支持自然语言计划、可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。支持自定义模型、技能、失败时暂停以及权限设置。

description.en: Publishes an ordered system prompt section that names wsl as the command executor to reach for first, so the agent prefers WSL over PowerShell on Windows. Registers no tools, and only advertises executors the agent can actually call.
description.zh: 发布一段带顺序的系统提示词段，指定 wsl 为执行命令时优先选用的执行器，让模型在 Windows 上优先走 WSL 而不是 PowerShell。不注册任何工具，且只宣传模型真实可调用的执行器。

description.en: An AI-native multimodal canvas for DSH: preview images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs, documents, and code; connect ideas and collaborate with agents in a persistent local workspace.
description.zh: AI 原生多模态画布，支持图片、视频、音频、3D 模型、PDF、文档与代码等文件展示与预览；通过节点连线组织素材，与 Agent 共享上下文、协作编辑，内容持久保存在本机。

description.en: Market-gap radar for DSH plugin developers. Splits the catalog into categories and topics, tags every topic empty, thin, contested or crowded, and ranks the emptiest directions first, so you know what to build before writing it; it also browses the whole market with copy-ready install commands.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发者的市场空白雷达。把目录拆到大类与方向，每档标出空位、稀少、有竞争或红海，空位最多的方向排在前面，动手前先知道该做什么；同时可浏览整个市场并一键复制安装命令。

description.en: DSH-SOLO desktop plugin for its companion app. Pair by QR code to view sessions, send tasks, switch models, transfer attachments and approve operations with end-to-end encryption; official cloud relay preconfigured, no server setup required. Download the App APK at https://github.com/wudidiandian/dsh-solo/releases/latest/download/dsh-solo.apk (GitHub Releases).
description.zh: DSH-SOLO 手机远程协作的电脑端插件，搭配 App 扫码连接，查看会话、发送任务、切换模型、传递附件并确认操作审批；支持端到端加密，已配置官方云转发服务，无需自行部署服务器。App 安装包下载：https://github.com/wudidiandian/dsh-solo/releases/latest/download/dsh-solo.apk （GitHub Releases）。

description.en: Cross-session error lessons for DSH agents: search past mistakes before handling errors and reuse their verified fixes.
description.zh: DSH 代理的跨会话错误教训库：处理报错前先检索过去踩过的坑，直接复用已验证的解法。

description.en: Browser notifications and a beep when a session turn ends, the agent asks a question or approval is pending; clicking the notification jumps to the session; remote trigger endpoint and SSE channel (npm: `dsh-my-notify`).
description.zh: 会话（本轮）结束 / agent 询问 / 等待审批时弹浏览器通知 + 滴声，点击通知跳转会话；预留远程触发接口与 SSE 实时通道（npm: `dsh-my-notify`）。

description.en: CGSS idol theme with multi-character Web colors and card artwork, immersive reading, and an optional Windows desktop companion.
description.zh: CGSS 偶像主题，提供多角色 Web 配色与卡面、沉浸阅读和可选的 Windows 桌宠。

description.en: Manage environment variables, .env files, and credentials in DeepSeek Harness, including Windows user and system environment variables.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理环境变量、.env 文件和凭据，支持 Windows 用户级与系统级环境变量。

description.en: DSH hardware sandbox plugin: assemble a 3D scene of ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED components with protocol- and voltage-checked port wiring, run real Python project code in the loop against simulated I2C/GPIO hardware with fault injection, let networked device simulators report over HTTP to a real backend (validated end-to-end against a live seat-reservation system), observe a real device read-only and map its state onto the scene, and add support for new boards through data-driven pin definitions. Ships 16 hw_* agent tools plus a bundled SKILL.md.
description.zh: DSH 嵌入式硬件沙盒插件：在 3D 面包板场景里摆放 ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED 等器件、按协议与电压校验接线；让真实 Python 项目代码在环运行、经 Python shim 读虚拟 I2C/GPIO 的寄存器级读数，支持故障注入（断线 / NACK / busy / 强制读数）；联网设备模拟器可向真实 HTTP 后端周期上报（已在真实"智能选座"系统全链路验证）；还可只读观察真机状态，并用数据驱动的型号定义支持新硬件。随插件带 16 个 hw_* 工具与一份 SKILL.md。

description.en: Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source, nested flag, model/user invocation), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, toggle model/user invocation, and mine DSH session logs to extract reusable personal skills that the agent auto-loads — from the web settings panel and via skillmgr_* / skillmgr_extract_* tools.
description.zh: DSH skill 可视化与管理插件：在设置面板列出全部 skill（含来源、嵌套标记与模型/用户调用状态），查看并编辑 SKILL.md 正文，一键启用/禁用模型与用户调用；并可从会话日志提取可复用内容，沉淀为 agent 可自动加载的个人 skill。提供 skillmgr_list/get/save/policy 及 skillmgr_extract_* 工具。

description.en: Read-only bridge that surfaces Claude Code's existing project memory in DSH — git-root-aware resolution, credential redaction before injection, and an on-demand recall tool. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 只读桥接 Claude Code 已有项目记忆到 DSH：按 git 仓库根解析、注入前脱敏、按需检索工具，零依赖。

description.en: Live token cost for every chat in the DSH Web UI: the chat, its subagents and the whole session tree, priced from a bundled models.dev snapshot of seven providers and 139 priced models, with cache read and write rates wherever the provider publishes them and DeepSeek from its own peak and off-peak table. Every finished answer carries its own price in the transcript, and a chat that is not currently open is priced from the log instead of disappearing. Spend is costed per interval from an append-only JSONL ledger in the project folder, so logged work keeps the tariff it was billed at. On top of it: budget-aware work plans packed against a money limit, routing scenarios that show which models are worth connecting, a generated plan document in English, Chinese or Russian, and a warning when spend belongs to no plan unit.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 的每个对话实时计算 token 费用：本对话、其子代理与整棵会话树，价格来自内置的 models.dev 快照：七家供应商、139 个有价模型，缓存读写费率按供应商实际公布的取值，DeepSeek 则使用其官方峰谷价格表。每个完成的回答都会在对话中显示自身费用，未打开的对话则按日志计价而不是整行消失。费用按区间计价，依据写入项目目录的只追加 JSONL 账本，因此已记录的工作保留当时的费率。此外还提供：按金额预算排布的工作计划、展示值得接入哪些模型的路由方案比较、以英语/中文/俄语生成的计划文档，以及当费用未归入任何计划单元时的提醒。

description.en: Governed literature library: import papers, extract text, keep one index row per entry, and verify quotes verbatim.
description.zh: 可治理的文献库：导入论文、抽取全文，每条文献只保留一行索引，并逐字核验摘录能在原文中查到。

description.en: Diverts operation-script writes out of the workspace into a per-session scratch root and collects each one into an inspectable vault outside the workspace, so the workspace holds only real deliverables.
description.zh: 把操作腳本的寫入導出工作區、改放各 session 的暫存根，並把每一支收進工作區外的可檢視收納庫，讓工作區只留下真正的交付物。

description.en: 3D director desk sidebar plugin for DSH: stage characters, set camera moves and record timeline previews; AI agents drive the scene in real time via MCP tools.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 3D 导演台插件：摆角色、运镜、时间轴预演与导出，AI Agent 经 MCP 工具实时编排场景。

description.en: Sayaka Miki desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: twelve hand-drawn sprites follow the live session state and swap instantly, with a tired slump after a turn, a furious second stage after ten pokes, and idle sword-polishing; repeated states change her line and a voice line plays every five to eight encounters.
description.zh: 美树沙耶香桌宠：把会话状态映射成十二张立绘并啪地直接切换——一轮对话跑完会累倒、连点十下会气炸、闲着会擦剑吹口哨；同类状态连着来她会换话变脸，每种状态每碰 5~8 次播一次语音，台词还配了专属录音。

description.en: Official DSH plugin for nuphus-mcp (by the nuphus-mcp maintainers): desktop and browser automation (38 tools) with PaddleOCR element perception and Chrome CDP browsing, via a persistent stdio MCP child process.
description.zh: nuphus-mcp 官方 DSH 插件（由 nuphus-mcp 维护者发布）：桌面 + 浏览器自动化（38 个工具），配 PaddleOCR 元素感知与 Chrome CDP 浏览，经常驻 stdio MCP 子进程接入。

description.en: Read-only DSH Web plugin for inspecting and searching Milvus or Zilliz Cloud collections from chat, including scalar, BM25, dense, and hybrid queries.
description.zh: 只读 DSH Web 插件，可在对话中检查和搜索 Milvus 或 Zilliz Cloud Collection，支持标量、BM25、稠密向量与混合查询。

description.en: Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing comet trail replaces the native blinking caret and glides across the input as you type, with configurable accent color, thickness, and trail, IME-aware for CJK input.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供流畅的彗星光标：以发光的彗星拖尾取代原生闪烁光标，随输入平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细与拖尾，并适配中文等 IME 输入。

description.en: Shows JeV-selected task plans, progress updates and stage summaries in DSH chat, with native translation or lightweight summaries. Requires a JeV key; the Jev service is called externally and may bill. and hierarchical serial/parallel task flows.
description.zh: 通过 JeV 筛选并外显思考中的任务规划、进展和阶段小结，支持轻量摘要、DSH 原生翻译（需 JeV Key，会外部调用 Jev 服务并可能计费）及父子任务、串并行流程图。

description.en: Query and manage JumpServer through conversation: assets, users, accounts, permissions, sessions, command audit logs, command filters, and RBAC roles, authenticated with an AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret pair (HTTP Signature).
description.zh: 通过对话查询与管理 JumpServer：资产、用户、账号、授权、会话、命令审计、命令过滤与 RBAC 角色，使用 AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret（HTTP 签名）鉴权。

description.en: Turn the tab icon into a green/amber status light and send browser notifications when a session finishes or awaits your input, with 47 selectable notification sounds.
description.zh: 把标签页图标变成绿/琥珀状态灯，并在会话跑完或有交互待处理时发送浏览器通知，含 47 个可选音效。

description.en: Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.
description.zh: 定时循环：`/loop` 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条。

description.en: Flyout sidebar with a file tree, uncommitted-changes list and multi-tab file/diff previews; pops out into a standalone browser tab.
description.zh: 可弹出侧边栏：文件树、Git 未提交变更列表与多标签文件/diff 预览，一键弹出为独立浏览器标签页。

description.en: A draggable pet in a blue-whale onesie: sticks to window edges, squashes flat, blinks, sleeps, and shows agent status in a thought cloud.
description.zh: 一个穿着蓝色鲸鱼连体衣、可拖动的宠物：会贴住窗口边缘、被压扁，会眨眼、睡觉，并用气泡显示智能体状态。

description.en: Below 1024px the sidebar leaves the shell frame entirely and is opened as an overlay drawer from a header button, so the conversation gets the full viewport width; wider layouts are untouched.
description.zh: 視窗闊度細過 1024px 時，側欄完全移出 shell frame，改由頁首按鈕以浮動抽屜方式打開，令對話可以用盡整個螢幕闊度；闊螢幕版面唔受影響。

description.en: Embed a local web server in the DSH GUI through a remote-browser-safe same-origin proxy: any localhost port works, plus a Console/Network/Errors toolbox that captures what the iframe actually does.
description.zh: 把本地网页服务安全地嵌进 DSH 界面：同源代理绕开远程浏览器的 localhost/混合内容限制，任意 localhost 端口可用，并附控制台/网络/错误工具箱，实时捕获 iframe 内真实行为。

description.en: Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes with half-life memory decay: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking, n-gram/embedding hybrid search, and an explicit weight-feedback loop — a native Cordis plugin, npm-installable as @eqman00003/knowlp-rag.
description.zh: Markdown 笔记的双知识图谱 RAG，带半衰期记忆衰减：前置依赖 + 相似关联双图（P/S-Agent 遍历）、段落级匹配、ngram/embedding 混合检索、显式权重反馈闭环——原生 Cordis 插件，npm 包 @eqman00003/knowlp-rag。

description.en: Read, edit, export and verify Excel VBA projects through a real Excel COM instance: modules, UserForm code, procedure lists and .frm/.frx exports. Windows only, with desktop Excel installed, Python 3.10+ with pywin32, and AccessVBOM=1.
description.zh: 通过真实 Excel COM 读写、导出并校验 Excel VBA 工程：模块、窗体代码、过程清单与 .frm/.frx 导出。仅 Windows：需安装桌面版 Excel、Python 3.10+（含 pywin32），并设置 AccessVBOM=1。

description.en: Think tank: a built-in library of 161 classic mental models (decision/strategy/cognition/psychology/communication/learning/system/innovation/execution) — enter one question and several selected models analyze it in parallel via AI, producing a synthesized report with consensus, disagreements, blind spots and an action checklist; supports both automatic analysis and prompt round-trip import.
description.zh: 智囊团：内置 161 个经典思维模型库（决策/战略/认知/心理/沟通/学习/系统/创新/执行九大分类），输入一个问题即可用选中的多个模型并行 AI 分析，产出含共识/分歧/盲区/行动清单的综合报告页；支持自动分析与提示词往返导入两种模式。

description.en: Reference search for DeepSeek Harness: refkit_search looks up image, video, audio and text references across 24 open sources and tags each result with its normalized license and a use verdict for the intended use; refkit_rights re-checks one license against another use. Source keys and search tuning live on a settings page. 11 of the 24 sources need API keys; the use verdict is returned only when an intended use is passed. Runs on DSH ^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2 (tested on 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的参考素材检索插件：refkit_search 在 24 个开放来源中检索图片、视频、音频和文本参考素材，为每条结果标注规范化的许可证和针对用途的可用性判定；refkit_rights 针对另一种用途复核单条许可证。来源 key 与检索参数在设置页配置。24 个来源中 11 个需要 API key；仅在传入用途时返回可用性判定。支持 DSH ^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2（实测 0.1.7-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2）。

description.en: Connects GitHub's official remote MCP server as a DSH plugin: stores the PAT in DSH's credential center (.credentials.yaml) via github_set_token, and exposes GitHub tools as mcp__github__*.
description.zh: 把 GitHub 官方远程 MCP server 封装为 DSH 插件：PAT 存入 DSH 凭据中心（.credentials.yaml），提供 github_set_token / github_token_status 模型工具，GitHub 工具以 mcp__github__* 形式可用。

description.en: Beta 0.2.0-beta.2 for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only, for Host-owner use. Search original user and assistant text in the current session or same-directory workspace, with source coordinates and context. Non-owner session authorization is not supported.
description.zh: 0.2.0-beta.2 仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，面向宿主所有者使用。在当前会话或同目录工作区搜索用户与助手原文，查看来源坐标和上下文；不支持非所有者身份的会话级授权。

description.en: Neumorphic DSH Web theme with light and dark palettes, ambient lighting, material shadows, grain texture, frosted-glass surfaces, and micro-interactions.
description.zh: DSH Web 轻拟物主题：提供浅色与深色配色、环境光影、材质阴影、纹理、磨砂玻璃表面与微交互。
