description.en: Standalone Network Engineer Assistant agent preset plus a bundled 32-doc command knowledge base skill for DPtech, H3C, Huawei and Ruijie switches and routers: KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI-output screenshot reading, online manual lookup with cited sources, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only.
description.zh: 网络工程师助手预设 + 四厂商（迪普/新华三/华为/锐捷）交换机路由器命令知识库：32 篇文档随插件以技能形式分发（含来源链接与 verified 分级），KB 优先检索、跨厂商语法对照、拓扑与回显截图识别、联网查官方手册并注明出处、高危命令强制 ⚠️ 风险标注；只回答网络工程主题。

description.en: Adds a red delete row to the sidebar session menu, plus a multi-select delete that confirms before running, and permanently removes the stored data behind a conversation — session directory and log, projection-cache record, workspace membership and pin.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单加入红色「删除对话」，并支持多选批量删除（二次确认），永久清除对话的磁盘数据——会话目录与日志、投影缓存记录、工作区归属与置顶。

description.en: Model attribution panel for the dsh web chat — local, zero-network structural fingerprinting (template token leaks, glitch canaries, tokenizer usage-vector matching) that scores which of 29 AI vendors a session's responses most resemble, with a per-claim evidence ledger and a 12-probe active battery.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页端挂载模型归属面板，用纯本地、零联网的结构指纹匹配（模板特殊 token 泄漏、glitch 金丝雀、tokenizer usage 向量比对）判断当前会话的回答最像 29 家 AI 厂商中的哪一家，每个结论附带可展开的证据账本，另附 12 探针主动取证电池。

description.en: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider with quota management and model selector.
description.zh: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist 模型提供商插件，支持配额查看与模型选择管理。

description.en: A right-sidebar workbench for legal practice backed by a folder of Markdown notes: SOP lookup, recordings with live transcription and line-level annotations, an inline glossary, and full-text search. Optional email rules library, Pkulaw points and usage badges. Notes, recordings and annotations stay on the local machine; live transcription needs your own Volcengine key and sends audio to Volcengine.
description.zh: 以 Markdown 笔记文件夹为事实源的法律实务工作台：SOP 速查、录音实时转写与逐句批注、可编辑术语表、全文搜索；可选邮件规则库、法宝积分与用量角标。笔记、录音与批注只存本机；实时转写需自备火山引擎密钥，音频会发往火山引擎。

description.en: Proactive per-provider token-bucket rate limiting that queues over-limit requests before they are sent, preventing upstream 429 errors.
description.zh: 按 provider 令牌桶主动限速，超限请求在发出前延迟排队而非失败，避免触发上游 429。

description.en: Self-learning loop for dsh: record lessons, draft and promote skills, periodic curator review that corrects, consolidates, and retires skills.
description.zh: dsh 自我学习闭环：记录经验、生成并发布技能，定期审查修正、合并与退役技能。

description.en: Power management plugin for DeepSeek Harness - sidebar power button with restart/shutdown menu, self-contained restart engine without external dependencies, graceful session flush.
description.zh: DSH 电源管理插件 - 侧边栏电源按钮、重启/关机菜单、自包含重启引擎（无需外部依赖）、优雅会话刷新。

description.en: Control a local Linux desktop from DeepSeek Harness with 19 tools: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, scroll, window, application, display and state-verification control over a native X11 session with XTEST, plus optional AT-SPI accessibility-tree reads and widget value setting. Not for Wayland. Requires xdotool on the host (XTEST input); screenshots and window control also want scrot, ffmpeg, wmctrl, xrandr and xprop, and the AT-SPI tools need python3-gi, at-spi2-core and libatk-adaptor. Missing packages can be installed from the plugin's dependency panel with sudo.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek Harness 直接操控本机 Linux 桌面，提供 19 个工具：截图、鼠标、键盘、滚动、窗口、应用、显示器与状态校验，基于原生 X11 + XTEST 会话，并可选读取 AT-SPI 无障碍树与直接给控件赋值，不适用于 Wayland。需要宿主安装 xdotool（XTEST 注入）；截图与窗口控制还需 scrot、ffmpeg、wmctrl、xrandr、xprop，AT-SPI 工具另需 python3-gi、at-spi2-core、libatk-adaptor。缺失的软件包可在插件详情页的依赖面板用 sudo 一键补装。

description.en: Local-first fiction workspace that links outlines, chapters, characters, timelines, writing rules, and continuity checks to the conversation.
description.zh: 本地优先的小说创作工作台，将大纲、章节、人物、时间线、写作规则与一致性检查联动到对话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web panel for creating, evaluating, repairing, and installing skills, delegating generation to the official generic and Huawei Cloud skill creators. Needs git, bash and python3, and network access to gitcode.com (the creators and reference data are pulled from there); the creator runs shell commands with danger-full-access by default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能创建面板：调用官方通用/华为云技能创建器生成技能，并提供评测、修复、安装与创建记录。需要 git、bash 与 python3，并能访问 gitcode.com（创建器与参考数据从那里拉取）；创建器默认以 danger-full-access 权限执行 shell 命令。

description.en: Better Right-Click: right-click menu on file references in the DSH transcript. Copies the absolute path, reveals the file selected in Explorer by reusing and focusing an existing window, and lists every app registered for that file type so you can open it with the one you want. Menu labels follow the DSH display language (Chinese and English). Windows only (Explorer reveal and the registered-apps list use PowerShell).
description.zh: 给正文里的文件引用加右键菜单：复制绝对路径、在资源管理器中定位并选中文件（复用已打开的窗口并置前）、以及列出本机所有能打开该类型文件的程序让你自己选。菜单文案跟随 DSH 界面语言（中文/英文自动切换）。仅 Windows（资源管理器定位与程序列表依赖 PowerShell）。

description.en: Auto-log failed tool calls across native tools, PTC run_code, and inline invocations: dedup and count root causes into a skill so repeated mistakes fade.
description.zh: 全模式调用工具失败自动实录：把原生工具 / PTC run_code / 代码内嵌工具调用的失败错因去重计数后写入 skill，越用越少错。

description.en: Session-scoped research evidence ledger with sources, linked claims, open questions, and explicit user review; provides a tool, slash command, and conversation panel, with selected-claim Markdown export that omits excerpts, review notes, and local paths by default; does not fetch sources or verify their truth.
description.zh: 会话级研究证据账本，整理来源、关联论点、待解问题与用户明确复核；提供工具、斜杠命令和会话面板，可按论点选择导出 Markdown，默认省略摘录、复核备注与本地路径；不抓取来源或判断内容真伪。

description.en: Explain supported DSH plugin failures with composition source paths and manual next steps: duplicate insertions, missing bundle patches and peer mismatches; standalone CLI and report viewer, read-only diagnosis offline by default, with unobserved runtime left unknown.
description.zh: 通过组合来源路径和人工下一步解释受支持的 DSH 插件故障：重复引入、bundle patch 缺失和 peer 不匹配；提供独立 CLI 与报告查看器，默认只读离线诊断，未观察的 runtime 保留 unknown。

description.en: English, Chinese and Cantonese typing practice with Pinyin and Jyutping hints, timed or passage modes, local conversation excerpts and local records.
description.zh: 英文、中文和粤语打字练习，提供拼音与粤拼提示、限时或按篇练习、本地对话语料和本机记录。

description.en: Search, inspect, and use selected third-party skills and MCP tools through one on-demand gateway. Catalog trimming depends on the host and tool mode. A local journal records usage metadata.
description.zh: 通过一个按需网关搜索、查看和使用选定的第三方技能与 MCP 工具。目录精简取决于宿主和工具模式。本地日志记录使用元数据。

description.en: A governed swarm of six specialist DSH agents — orchestrator, planner, knowledge-base bridge, developer and two reviewers — turns a requirement into a strict phase pipeline where every delivery must prove itself with structured evidence before the next phase may start; reviewers are read-only, code merges only after a review pass, and an append-only event log gives full replay and audit on a live kanban board. Its design draws inspiration from the Hermes Agent kanban.
description.zh: 一个受管的智能体蜂群（swarm）：六种专职 DSH 智能体——编排、规划、知识库桥接、开发，以及方案评审与代码评审——把需求转化为严格阶段流水线；每阶段交付必须先以结构化证据自证，下一阶段才放行；评审只读、代码仅评审通过后合并，追加式事件日志支持全程回放与审计，实时看板同步展示。其设计灵感源自 Hermes Agent kanban。

description.en: Per-provider API key pool for DeepSeek Harness with manual switching, background reachability probing and plan-usage adapters for DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax, Zhipu, OpenRouter and other providers.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的分提供商 API 密钥池，支持手动切换、后台可达性探测与 DeepSeek、Kimi、MiniMax、智谱、OpenRouter 等多家服务商的套餐用量适配器。

description.en: OpenDesign subscription quota: a sidebar page for the 5-hour and 7-day allowance, with an adaptive quota meter in the session header.
description.zh: OpenDesign 订阅额度：左栏额度页看 5 小时 / 7 天剩余额度，顶栏自适应额度条一眼可见。

description.en: Irreversible secret-scrubbing guard: rewrites access keys, bearer tokens, and private key blocks into `[REDACTED:<category>]` placeholders before they reach the session log and the model.
description.zh: 不可逆密钥脱敏守护：在访问密钥、Bearer 令牌、私钥块进入会话日志和模型请求之前，将其改写为 `[REDACTED:<category>]` 占位符。

description.en: Turns course, lecture, tutorial, meeting, and talk videos into structured study notes: it extracts the audio track with ffmpeg, transcribes it with Whisper, then writes notes with a chapter outline, emphasis markers, and a quick-reference card.
description.zh: 把课程、讲座、教程、会议、演讲等视频整理成结构化学习笔记：用 ffmpeg 提取音轨、Whisper 语音转文字，再生成带分段大纲、重点标记和速查卡的笔记。

description.en: DeepSeek API wallet balance in the composer dock with a popover showing topped-up and granted credit, the refresh time, and usage and top-up links, plus a /balance command and an api_balance tool; the Host reads a signed-in account wallet or the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential, so the browser only receives amounts.
description.zh: 输入框下方常驻 DeepSeek API 余额胶囊，点开显示充值额度、赠送额度、更新时间与用量/充值链接，另有 /balance 命令与 api_balance 工具；凭据只留在 Host（已登录账户钱包或 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY），浏览器只拿到金额。

description.en: Ask-before-act approval for every edit and every bash command: a red/green line diff before a file is touched, a description+command panel before a command runs — approve once or reject, each gate with its own master switch in Settings → General.
description.zh: 每次 edit 与 bash 调用前都会询问：编辑前展示红绿行级 diff，命令前展示描述与命令面板——同意一次或拒绝，两个 gate 各带独立总开关（Settings → General）。

description.en: Pre-visit due diligence and company research in DeepSeek Harness for customer background checks and risk briefs, with Qichacha MCP tool-call budget approval and entity confirmation.
description.zh: 访前尽调智能体：面向拜访前调查，提供企业尽调、客户尽调、客户背景调查、工商核验与风险信息整理；使用企查查 MCP，设有调用预算授权和主体确认。

description.en: Runs the official Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent over print-mode stream-json, exposed as the subagent_antigravity delegation tool. Includes Gemini 4 Argon on Antigravity subscriptions. Requires the Antigravity CLI (agy 1.4+) installed and signed in.
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity CLI（agy）作为一次性编码子智能体接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 subagent_antigravity 委派工具，可直接使用 Gemini 4 Argon 等 Antigravity 订阅模型。需安装并登录 Antigravity CLI（agy 1.4+）。

description.en: Adds an Inherit row to the session menu: mechanically extracts concrete anchors (task, recent instructions, files edited, recent failures, commands, todos) from a long session into a handoff and continues in a clean session, with the same preset, no history copied and no model call.
description.zh: 会话菜单新增「继承」：把长会话里的具体锚点（任务原文、最近的用户指令、改过的文件、最近的失败、命令、待办）机械提取成交接单，在干净的新会话里接着干——预设默认一并继承，不复制历史，也不调用模型。

description.en: Pools every WorkBuddy account signed in on this machine into one auto-failing-over provider, serving OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages from the same pool, with model aliases, usage statistics and scheduled credit automation.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 账号汇成一个自动故障转移的模型池，同一池子对外提供 OpenAI Chat、OpenAI Responses 与 Anthropic Messages 三种协议，并支持模型别名、用量统计与积分自动化。

description.en: Renders edit and write tool calls as always-expanded side-by-side diffs styled like git diff, with optional syntax coloring and word-level highlighting.
description.zh: 将编辑与写入工具调用渲染为常开的双栏 diff，样式类似 git diff，可选语法配色与词级高亮。

description.en: Host performance monitor in the right Sidebar: CPU, memory and swap gauges, a GPU clock and VRAM bar, CPU / GPU / motherboard / drive temperatures, and a process table sortable by CPU, memory or name.
description.zh: 右侧栏主机性能监控：CPU、内存、交换内存仪表盘，显卡频率与显存条，CPU / 显卡 / 主板 / 硬盘温度，以及可按 CPU、内存、进程名排序的进程列表。

description.en: Maintained fork of godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing adapted to DSH 0.1.5-rc.1: Bing-backed provider for the built-in web_search tool, scraping the public cn.bing.com HTML results page with no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeping searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint and result count configurable.
description.zh: godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing 的维护 fork，适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1：为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源，直接解析 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页，无需 API Key，国内可直连，不消耗模型自带搜索额度。端点与结果数量可配置。

description.en: Neutral warm Chobits Chii picture-book skin for the DSH web UI, with light and dark token sets, a polaroid photo wall, and a built-in Live2D Chii mascot with gaze following.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的小叽绘本风皮肤：明暗双 token、拍立得照片墙，以及内置 Live2D 小叽桌宠（视线跟随）。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek API peak/off-peak status, a countdown to the next switch and a mini timeline next to the DSH desktop avatar, with a 24-hour Beijing-time timeline on click; holiday calendars update automatically from holiday-cn, and an optional reminder fires 5 minutes before each peak period.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端头像旁显示 DeepSeek API 峰谷时段、切换倒计时与迷你时间轴，点击查看北京时间 24 小时时间轴；节假日日历从 holiday-cn 自动更新，可选在峰时段开始前 5 分钟提醒。

description.en: Artifacts-like documents in the sidebar: the agent writes a self-contained HTML document, you comment on any part, send the comments back for the next version, or edit text and formatting yourself. Every change is a new version; local only. A local-only fork of tdoc (https://github.com/tornado-doc/tdoc), rewritten as a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Artifacts 式文档：AI 生成独立的 HTML 文档，你可以对任意位置批注、一键交给 AI 改出新版本，也可以自己直接修改文字和格式。每次修改都是新版本，内容只存在本地。基于 tdoc（https://github.com/tornado-doc/tdoc）改造的本地化 DSH 插件。

description.en: Keep your automation tasks in files you can version and review: write each task's schedule, prompt, model, permission and working folder in YAML, JSON or JS, and DSH's own Schedule is kept exactly in line, creating, updating, disabling and deleting tasks within a second of a save. Each task runs in its own conversation, persistent or fresh per run; /automations syncs on demand and names any file mistake; and a sync that finds no tasks never wipes the Schedule.
description.zh: 把自动化任务放进可以版本管理、可以审阅的文件里：用 YAML、JSON 或 JS 写下每个任务的计划、提示词、模型、权限和工作目录，DSH 自带的 Schedule 会与文件保持完全一致，保存后一秒内完成创建、更新、停用和删除。每个任务在自己的会话中运行，可持续复用或每次新开；/automations 可随时同步并指出出错的文件；若同步时一个任务也没找到，绝不会清空 Schedule。

description.en: Token usage dashboard for the whole harness: billed tokens from every session are rolled up per session and turn (uncached input, cache read, cache write and output) with a peak/off-peak CNY cost estimate, and a "Token 用量" entry above Settings in the sidebar opens the dashboard at /token-stats, in a new tab on the web and in an in-app popup on the Desktop. The page recollects and repaints every 60 seconds while the tab is visible. Usage is read from the same session event stream dsh-token-meter consumes, accepting 0.1.x assistant/chunk and 0.2.x assistant/message and assistant/attempt, and counting an attempt repeated after an llm retry as its own billed call; cold history is seeded once from a persisted rollup file and afterwards only logs whose mtime or size changed are re-parsed. Host half and client half ship in the one package.
description.zh: 整个 Harness 的 Token 用量看板：把全部会话的计费 token（未缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入、输出）按会话与轮次汇总，并给出高峰/低谷的人民币预估费用；侧边栏「Token 用量」入口（在设置上方）打开 /token-stats 看板，Web 端新标签页、桌面端应用内弹窗。标签页可见时每 60 秒自动重新采集并重绘。用量读取的是 dsh-token-meter 消费的同一条会话事件流，兼容 0.1.x 的 assistant/chunk 与 0.2.x 的 assistant/message、assistant/attempt；llm 重试后的再次采样按一次新的计费计入；冷历史只从持久化 rollup 文件播种一次，之后仅对 mtime/size 变化的日志做增量重解析。宿主半与客户端半在同一个包里。

description.en: Plugin compatibility vet for dsh that compares installed plugins peerDependencies against the running dsh version to flag which ones the startup preflight will refuse to load, prints copy-pasteable fix commands, and offers a top-of-page banner in dsh web to isolate, uninstall or upgrade them, with an automatic backup before the change and rollback if the re-check fails.
description.zh: dsh 插件兼容性体检：把已装插件的 peerDependencies 与当前 dsh 运行时比对，提前指出哪些会在下次启动被预检拒绝加载，并给出可直接执行的中文修复命令；dsh web 顶部横幅可按键隔离、卸载或升级，改动前自动备份、复检不过自动回滚。

description.en: A self-healing layer for tool calls: missing params, wrong fields and out-of-range paths are fixed before they reach the model. Measured visible error rate fell from 7.95% to 2.20%.
description.zh: 给工具调用加一层自愈：缺参数、错字段、路径越界在到达模型前自动修好，实测可见错误率从 7.95% 降到 2.20%。

description.en: Sensitive-character replacement for DeepSeek Harness: matches messages and tool results against a YAML blocklist you maintain (global, per provider id, or per model) before the model reads them, and scrubs the outgoing request again before dispatch, so blocked characters cannot trip the official API Content Exists Risk 400.
description.zh: 在模型读取内容之前，按用户维护的 YAML 屏蔽表（全局 / 按 Provider ID / 按模型）替换消息与工具结果中的敏感字符，出网前再清洗一次请求，避免 DeepSeek 官方 API 的 Content Exists Risk 400。

description.en: Moves and resizes the DeepSeek Harness settings panel; its position and size are remembered per browser.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的设置面板可以自由拖动与缩放，位置与尺寸按浏览器记忆。

description.en: PowerPoint deck builder for DeepSeek Harness: pastel palettes, ten slide templates, web images, Python-drawn charts, highlighted code cards, LaTeX formulas typeset without a TeX installation (matrices, integrals, sums with limits) and a Presentations agent mode.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 PowerPoint 演示文稿生成器：柔和色板、十种幻灯片模板、网络图片、Python 绘制的图表、高亮代码卡片、无需安装 TeX 的 LaTeX 公式（矩阵、积分、带上下限的求和）以及 Presentations 智能体模式。

description.en: 1:1 port of DeepSeek's official web right-side chat navigation rail (ScrollNav): hover-expandable rail, reading-position highlight, click-to-jump.
description.zh: 1:1 复刻 DeepSeek 官网右侧对话导航栏（ScrollNav）：悬停展开面板、阅读位置高亮、点击跳转。

description.en: A token-based DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with ten presets, custom colors, and system font pickers.
description.zh: 基于原生令牌的 DeepSeek Harness 主题插件，提供十套预设、自定义配色与系统字体选择。

description.en: Native Anki workspace backed by one real headless Anki collection: browse, edit, add and review notes, suspend cards, import and export APKG, and sync with AnkiWeb, with the same collection exposed to the anki AI tool. No Anki desktop app, AnkiConnect or Qt is started. Supports Windows x64 and macOS 12 or later (Apple Silicon and Intel). The matching headless Anki core, CPython and all Python runtime dependencies are bundled, so no separate Anki or Python installation is required.
description.zh: 原生 Anki 工作区，由真实的独立无界面 Anki 牌库驱动：浏览、编辑、添加与复习笔记，暂停卡片，导入导出 APKG，并与 AnkiWeb 同步；同一牌库同时提供给 anki AI 工具。不启动 Anki 桌面程序，也不依赖 AnkiConnect 或 Qt。支持 Windows x64 和 macOS 12 及以上版本（Apple Silicon 与 Intel）。已内置匹配的无界面 Anki 核心、CPython 与全部 Python 运行依赖，无需另外安装 Anki 或 Python。

description.en: Peak / off-peak rate badges for the model selector (every row) and the composer tool row, judged per provider by its own time zone and schedule; the live catalog is served from the host over a fenced route.
description.zh: 为模型选择器（每一行）与 composer 工具行显示峰谷倍率，按每个 provider 自己的时区与时段规则判定；实时目录由 host 经带信任围栏的路由下发。

description.en: Sidebar workspace panel that switches between running tasks and all conversations, shown as one freely sortable card list with per-card pin, rename, copy ID, fork, stop, and archive actions.
description.zh: 侧栏工作区面板，在运行中任务与全部对话之间切换，统一为一张可自由排序的卡片列表，每张卡片可置顶、重命名、复制 ID、分叉、停止与归档。

description.en: Encrypted file handoffs and cross-device agent collaboration with background message reception and managed task execution in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中进行加密文件交接与跨设备 Agent 协作，支持后台收件和受管任务执行。

description.en: Peer channels between conversations at the same level: user-granted, symmetric, with durable grants that survive a restart and burst messages merged into one ordered delivery.
description.zh: 平级对话之间的通道：经用户授权、对称，授权跨重启保留；忙时多条消息合并成一批按发送时间排序投递。

description.en: Plays MP4, M4V and MOV videos in the DSH right sidebar using the native video player, replacing the "this file type cannot be previewed" placeholder.
description.zh: 用原生播放器在 DSH 右栏播放 MP4 / M4V / MOV，替掉「此文件类型不支持预览」的占位提示。

description.en: Local-first persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: bounded pre-step hot-memory injection, exact and Chinese-bigram BM25 cold recall, six agent tools, approval-gated lease-lock writes with recovery receipts, and read-only governance and trajectory-review candidates.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先持久记忆：在 pre-step 注入有预算上限的热记忆，使用精确匹配与中文二元 BM25 召回冷层，提供六个 Agent 工具，并以审批门禁、租约锁、恢复回执和只读治理与轨迹复盘候选保护写入。

description.en: A persistent download server for DSH — jobs outlive the session, survive a restart, and resume from the last byte.
description.zh: DSH 的全自动轻量常驻下载服务器 —— 任务活过会话、扛过重启，断点按字节续传。

description.en: Desktop tweaks: F11 fullscreen toggle; enables Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste in the terminal, both switchable in the General settings.
description.zh: 桌面修改：F11 全屏切换；使终端使用 Ctrl+C/V 复制粘贴，从通用设置内开启/关闭。

description.en: Counts keywords inside thinking rows and highlights them once a row is expanded, with a count chip per keyword on the title line that doubles as an on/off switch for that word, per-keyword tint, text colour and text size (10-22px, the same range the host body-text setting uses), typeface, bold / italic / underline and whole-word matching, plus a dedicated settings section.
description.zh: 统计思考行里的关键词并在展开后按词标红；标题行上每个词一个计数徽章，点徽章即单独开关这个词；每个词可设底色、文字颜色、字号（10-22px，与宿主正文尺寸同一区间）、字体、加粗/斜体/下划线与「完整词」匹配；插件有独立的设置分区。

description.en: Adds the Foxy agent preset, sidebar entry, settings page, editable prompt suffix, and a small capability registry to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Foxy 人设预设、侧栏入口、设置页、可编辑附加提示词和可扩展能力注册。

description.en: Progressive-disclosure MCP gateway that searches large remote catalogs through `mcp_search`, then invokes exact schemas through `mcp_call` with lazy connections and bounded caches.
description.zh: 渐进披露 MCP 网关：用 `mcp_search` 检索大型远程工具目录，再由 `mcp_call` 按精确 schema 调用，并采用惰性连接与有界缓存。

description.en: Markdown visual enhancement and session workbench for DSH Web Composer: live syntax presentation with caret-row source reveal (inactive-line markers can be hidden or faded), deterministic local completions, and list/quote continuation on line break with ordered-list renumbering; long pastes fold into persistent chips with inline context or file-mode delivery (@path across 50+ extensions) plus sidebar LLM rewrites (stop, preview diff, undo/redo); real-time context map with token gauge, composition breakdown, per-turn growth chart with anchor lines, in-place /compact, turn forking, and a Context Doctor workspace (overview, diagnostics, analysis, feedback).
description.zh: DSH Web Composer 视觉增强与会话工作台：实时 Markdown 呈现与光标行源码还原（非焦点行语法标记可完全隐藏或淡化显示）、确定性本地补全、列表与引用的换行自动续行及有序列表重编号；超长粘贴自动收纳为持久化引用 chip，支持直接内联或文件送达（支持 50+ 种扩展名），并在右栏抽屉提供大模型智能改写（支持中止、预览对比、应用与撤销重做）；集成实时上下文地图，包含 Token 仪表盘、构成穿透钻取、逐轮增长图与锚定刻线、一键 /compact 及会话分叉，并内置 Context Doctor 工作区（概览、诊断、分析、反馈）。

description.en: Right-click any session row in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar to color-tag it with a default red, ten palette colors or a custom picker, persisted locally.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话行加右键标色：默认红色、十色色板与自定义取色，颜色本地持久化。

description.en: Edit a sent message in place and resend it as a forked chat, keeping the original: change the text, remove, reorder or add images and files, with session image limits checked before sending (the first message opens a new chat in the same workspace). Also @-references pending images by file name, drag-reorders composer attachments, copies messages together with their images, and adds copy, download and drag-to-composer for images in the conversation.
description.zh: 在消息位置编辑已发消息并以 fork 出的新聊天重发，原聊天保留：改文字、删图、调整图片顺序、补图片或文件，发送前按会话图片限制校验（第一条消息在同一工作区新开聊天）。另外支持输入 @ 按文件名引用待发送图片、拖动调整输入框附件顺序、复制消息时连图片一起复制，以及对话图片的复制、下载和拖进输入框。

description.en: OpenCode GO quota widget pinned to the sidebar, with rolling/weekly/monthly usage bars, an elapsed-versus-remaining time bar under each, a same-origin usage proxy, an /opencode-go command, and the runtime x-opencode-session fix for GO gateway chat requests. Fork of yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage.
description.zh: 常驻侧边栏的 OpenCode GO 套餐额度组件：滚动/周/月三条用量条、每条下方一条已流逝与剩余时间条、同源用量代理、/opencode-go 命令，以及针对 GO 网关聊天请求的运行时 x-opencode-session 修复。fork 自 yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage。

description.en: Draggable recent-deliverables panel for DSH Web that merges declared deliverables with recently modified workspace files, with filename search, type filters, inline PDF/HTML/image/text previews, and desktop open or reveal actions.
description.zh: DSH Web 的可拖动最近成品面板，合并已声明交付的文件与工作区最近修改的文件，支持文件名搜索、类型筛选、PDF/HTML/图片/文本内嵌预览，以及用桌面应用打开或在文件管理器中定位。

description.en: Run RunningHub cloud ComfyUI workflows from chat — settings card, sha256 media upload cache, concurrency gate, and background task ledger.
description.zh: 在对话中运行 RunningHub 云端 ComfyUI 工作流：设置卡片、sha256 媒体上传缓存、并发闸门与后台任务台账。

description.en: Session budget gate for DeepSeek Harness: prices every turn against the official price table, warns at 80%, stops the task at 100%, and writes a handoff snapshot so the next session can continue the work.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的会话设预算上限：按官方价目表实时算账，80% 预警、100% 拦停任务，并落盘一份交接快照，让下一个会话接着干。

description.en: Native iOS and Android apps for remote control of DeepSeek Harness, with end-to-end encryption, workspace browsing, and real-time session updates.
description.zh: 提供 DeepSeek Harness 远程控制功能的原生 iOS/Android 应用，支持端到端加密、工作区浏览和会话实时更新等。

description.en: Adds OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness as one provider, backed by a managed, isolated OpenCode runtime, with a Settings page that lists each model and tests it.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型作为一组 provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness，底层是受管、隔离的 OpenCode 运行时，并在设置页列出每个模型并可逐个检测。

description.en: Read-only preview of SQLite files and MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL / SQL Server connections in the right sidebar, with tables, paged rows, columns, indexes and draggable column widths, never writing to the database.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏只读预览 SQLite 文件与 MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL / SQL Server 连接：表、分页数据、列、索引，列宽可拖动，从不写库。

description.en: Message and attachment editing with save-only updates, forked regeneration, and a version timeline for DSH desktop.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 桌面端的消息与附件编辑，支持原地保存、分支重生成和版本时间线。

description.en: Turn code flows into source-linked Mermaid diagrams and interactive CodeWalkthrough explainers.
description.zh: 把代码流程变成可跳转源码的 Mermaid 图和交互式 CodeWalkthrough 讲解页。

description.en: Scans MCP configurations from 13 local AI clients and from project workspaces, imports selected servers into the active DSH profile, and adds connection testing, in-place reconnect, JSON import and visual add, edit and removal controls.
description.zh: 扫描 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、VS Code 等 13 种客户端和项目工作区的 MCP 配置，把选中服务接入当前 DSH profile，并提供连接测试、原地重连、JSON 导入和图形化新增、编辑和移除。

description.en: Embeds chat.deepseek.com in a DSH desktop panel and moves text both ways round by round: pick any round of the web conversation and copy it, or send it as a user message into a session of a chosen workspace; and fill any answer of the current agent session back into the web input box without sending it. The embed reuses the web session, so it spends no API quota, and asks for a web login once per app start.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 嵌进 DSH 桌面端面板，并在两个方向上按「轮」搬运：可选网页对话里的任意一轮，复制它，或把它作为一条用户消息发进指定工作区的指定会话；也可把当前 agent 会话里任意一轮回答填回网页输入框而不自动发送。内嵌页面复用网页会话，不消耗 API 额度，每次启动应用需登录一次网页。

description.en: Hands-free voice for DSH on Windows: local wake word, local Chinese speech-to-text inserted and sent into the composer, and spoken replies that can be interrupted and resumed. Requires a one-time run of the bundled install.ps1 (Python speech dependencies plus microphone pick) and a SenseVoice model already downloaded by the DSH voice input (or placed under models/sensevoice-onnx).
description.zh: Windows 上的免手语音：本地唤醒词、本地中文识别自动填入并发送、回答语音朗读，可打断与续播。需先运行仓库自带的 install.ps1（安装 Python 语音依赖并选定麦克风），并准备 SenseVoice 识别模型（跑一次 DSH 语音输入让它自动下载，或放到 models/sensevoice-onnx）。

description.en: Switchable web-search provider for DSH: native DeepSeek web search or an OpenAI-compatible custom backend. Installation automatically routes DSH web searches to the plugin; only provider, API key and model are required. Published on npm as @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3.
description.zh: 安装后自动将 DSH 网页搜索路由到本插件；只需配置服务商、API Key 和模型即可使用。支持 DeepSeek 原生搜索与 OpenAI 兼容自定义后端，已发布为 npm 包 @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3。

description.en: Sorts the DSH sidebar workspace list: the workspace you last sent a prompt in rises above the first non-running one, with pin, drag-to-reorder, name filtering and one-click tidy; also removes empty workspaces and relocates a workspace folder to a new path while carrying its conversations over.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏工作区排序：刚发过消息的工作区升到「第一个非运行工作区」之上，另有置顶、拖拽排序、按名称筛选与一键整理；并可清理空工作区、把工作区文件夹连对话一起迁到新路径。

description.en: Cross-session messaging: sends text into another session in the same workspace, and creates new top-level sessions.
description.zh: 跨会话投递：往同工作区的另一个会话发消息，并可新建顶层会话。

description.en: Adds a permanent Delete session action to the sidebar session menu, behind a confirmation dialog that reports the log size, running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders bound to the session; the id is then released from the live, archive and workspace registries, so the row stays gone on refresh instead of folding back in.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中增加「永久删除会话」的操作，并附带确认对话框：对话框会说明会话日志大小，以及与该会话绑定的进行中轮次、子代理、后台任务和提醒；删除后 id 会从 live、归档与工作区登记中一并释放，因此刷新列表时该行不会复活。

description.en: Sidebar panel menu layout: switch between a button row and a list, cap the button row at one to three rows, drag any entry to reorder it, hide the entries past the cap and list them in the shell More menu, and absorb Settings, Feedback and Sign in from the bottom-left launcher. Based on ruanimal/dsh-sidebar-panel-buttons; the two cannot be enabled at the same time.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板菜单布局：在按钮行与列表之间切换，按钮行可限一到三行，任意项可拖动排序，超出上限的项收进宿主「更多」菜单，并把左下角「更多」里的设置、意见反馈、登录并入面板菜单。基于 ruanimal/dsh-sidebar-panel-buttons；两者不能同时启用。

description.en: Converts Mermaid flowcharts into GB/T 1526-1989 (ISO 5807) compliant SVG through one model-facing tool, with optional A4/A3 pagination.
description.zh: 把 Mermaid 流程图转成符合 GB/T 1526-1989（等同 ISO 5807）图形符号的 SVG，可选用 A4/A3 幅面自动分页。

description.en: Signature escook theme ported from VS Code: 4 classic aesthetic color schemes (Dark, Dark Soft, Light, Light Soft) with high-contrast syntax highlighting for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 移植自 VS Code 经典的彬哥主题：包含 4 款经典美学配色（经典暗黑、柔和暗黑、紫韵浅色、柔和浅色）与高对比度语法高亮。

description.en: C++ audit skill: detects the target project's actual C++ standard before making any recommendation, then reports findings across RAII and ownership, move semantics, exception safety, performance and memory, containers and algorithms, concurrency, templates and compile-time, standard boundary, and type safety, ABI and interface design, each with a checkpoint, a reason, a bad-to-good example and the minimum standard.
description.zh: C++ 审查技能：先探测目标工程真实的 C++ 标准再给建议，随后按 RAII 与所有权、移动语义、异常安全、性能与内存、容器与算法、并发、模板与编译期、标准边界、类型安全、ABI 与接口设计逐条给出结论，每条含检查点、原因、反例→正例与适用标准。

description.en: A floating always-on-top overlay for Windows that shows which of your terminals is waiting: it aggregates DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, OpenCode and Antigravity session states (working, waiting for approval, failed, finished) over a named pipe, rings only on real events, and a click jumps to that terminal or copies its project path. Harness sessions appear on install; the other three need their own reporter from the repository, and approvals still happen in DSH.
description.zh: Windows 上的置顶浮窗，汇总 DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code、OpenCode 和 Antigravity 的会话状态（进行中、等待确认、出错、完成）到一条命名管道，只在真事件上响铃，点一下跳到对应终端或复制项目路径。装上即接上 Harness 的会话；另外三个终端要先各自装好仓库里的上报端，授权仍在 DSH 里完成。

description.en: Shows the API balance of the provider behind the current model as a dsh Web sidebar card, with per-package progress bars, currency/credit-aware units, a settings tab, and subscription and credit quota monitoring.
description.zh: 在当前会话所用模型的厂商 API 余额，以 dsh Web 侧边栏卡片常驻展示，含每套餐进度条、货币/积分单位区分、设置页，以及订阅与积分额度监测。

description.en: Read-only Raindrop.io dashboard in the sidebar with collection and tag distribution, top source domains, content types, a 12-month trend and a cleanup backlog, plus two read-only agent tools for analyzing saved bookmarks. Requires a Raindrop.io API token (create an app and paste the token).
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Raindrop.io 只读仪表盘：分类与标签分布、域名来源 Top、内容类型、近 12 个月趋势与待清理项，并提供两个只读 Agent 工具分析收藏。需 Raindrop.io API token（创建应用后粘贴）。

description.en: Replaces keys, tokens and passwords with <SG_> placeholders before they enter model context; plaintext stays in a local AES-256-GCM vault, revealed by a click-to-reveal lock in Settings and in user messages.
description.zh: 把密钥、令牌与密码在进入模型上下文前替换为 <SG_> 占位符，明文以 AES-256-GCM 加密保存在本地保管库；设置页与用户消息里可点小锁临时查看。

description.en: Plain-language trust dashboard for the dsh trust family: aggregates the nine channels (injection interception, write denials, egress blocks, custody-chain verification, tool-surface and prompt drift, leftover scans, forgotten compaction constraints, profile composition) into one right-sidebar panel with a single status light and event cards that translate engine jargon into sentences a non-security user can act on; the read and egress engines run from the package's own npm dependencies so those channels work even without the sibling plugins, and absent plugins simply show as not installed.
description.zh: 信任面板：把 dsh 信任插件族九个通道（注入拦截、写拒绝、出网拦截、custody 链校验、工具面/系统提示词漂移、残留扫描、压缩遗忘约束、profile 组成）聚合成右侧栏一块仪表盘——一个状态灯 + 事件卡片，把引擎术语翻译成非安全背景用户能看懂并知道要不要处理的句子；read/egress 引擎随包自带 npm 依赖，未装兄弟插件也能工作，缺失的通道仅显示未安装。

description.en: Read-only dashboard for token usage, cost, request speed, and first-token latency across local DSH sessions.
description.zh: 只读看板，汇总本机 DSH 会话的 Token 用量、费用、请求速度与首字耗时。

description.en: Opens the official chat.deepseek.com page in the DSH main panel through the desktop app's native browser view, so the login survives restarts, without an iframe or request proxying. A fork of JaMoLpE88/dsh-desktop-chat with the changes listed in its NOTICE. The login token is kept in plaintext in session.json.
description.zh: 在 DSH 主面板里用桌面端原生浏览器打开 chat.deepseek.com 官方网页，登录可跨重启恢复，不用 iframe、不代理请求；基于 JaMoLpE88/dsh-desktop-chat 的 fork，改动见 NOTICE。登录令牌以明文保存在 session.json 中。

description.en: Session-scoped delivery receipts for local artifacts: compare current file hashes with a recorded baseline, keep agent claims separate from explicit user acceptance, flag changed or unavailable files, and export a Markdown receipt through a tool, slash command, and conversation panel.
description.zh: 为本地成果生成会话级交付回执：对比当前文件哈希与记录基线，将 Agent 自述与用户明确验收分开，标记已变化或无法核验的文件，并通过工具、斜杠命令和会话面板导出 Markdown 回执。

description.en: Traces how something became what it is, what it currently rests on, and what it will become next.
description.zh: 回望一件事怎么变成现在这样，说清它现在靠什么成立，判断它下一步会变成什么。

description.en: Report generator that follows your own style: pick DSH sessions by time window and slice each one to the turns inside it, optionally merge Git commits from several repositories filtered by author, then a new session reads the evidence with read-only collector scripts and writes a daily, weekly or monthly Markdown report matching a pasted sample; finished reports stay in a local library.
description.zh: 按你给定的样例风格生成日报/周报/月报：按时间窗口挑选 DSH 会话并只取窗口内的回合，可选合并多个仓库中按作者过滤的 git 提交，再由新会话用只读采集脚本读取证据写出 Markdown 报告；成品进入本地报告库。

description.en: Quantify what switching projects costs. Measures each workspace's cold-start overhead (AGENTS.md + skill catalog + tool schemas + runtime context), its steady state, and how many turns it takes to reach it — then compares workspaces and attributes the difference. Attribution requires at least three workspaces and says so instead of inventing a correlation from two points; a factor with no spread across workspaces is reported as a property of the profile, not of the project. Recommends which workspaces to keep warm, which to archive, by entry cost times visit frequency. Deterministic.
description.zh: 工作区切换成本量化：量每个工作区的冷启动开销（AGENTS.md + 技能目录 + 工具 schema + 运行时上下文）、稳态值、 几轮到达稳态，然后横向对比并归因。归因需要至少三个工作区，不到就明说数据不够而不是拿两个点编一个相关性； 在所有工作区之间没有差异的因素被标注为 profile 的属性而非项目的属性。按"进入成本 × 访问频率"给出常驻/ 归档建议。纯确定性。

description.en: A one-line caption above the composer that tells you what the AI is doing right now: the step number, the action (e.g. running npm test), and whether it is still going, done, or failed with a short plain-language reason. Inferred locally from tool calls and the thinking text; no model calls, no network requests, no writes to DSH data.
description.zh: 在输入框上方加一行小字，告诉你 AI 现在第几步、在做什么、成没成，比如「第 3 步 · 正在执行命令 npm test · 琢磨中」。全部靠本机规则推断，不调模型、不联网、不改 DSH 的任何数据。

description.en: Cron scheduler for agent tasks: create jobs by natural language or a sidebar UI, inject a user message into a new or fixed session on schedule to trigger a full agent turn, with run history, manual trigger, and live SSE sync. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:cron.
description.zh: Agent 任务定时调度器：自然语言或侧栏 UI 创建任务，到点向新建/固定会话注入 user 消息触发完整 agent turn，带执行历史、手动触发与 SSE 实时同步。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:cron。

description.en: AX-first macOS computer use for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility snapshots with stable refs, background input, Unicode typing, menus and apps, set-of-mark screenshots, on-device OCR and verified actions — 11 tools bridged to the macos-cu CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS computer use：基于无障碍树的稳定 ref 定位、后台输入、Unicode 输入、菜单与应用、set-of-mark 截图、本地 OCR 与动作校验——11 个工具桥接 macos-cu CLI。

description.en: Press a chord, then type a letter label to click or focus any visible target.
description.zh: 按下组合键后，用字母标签选中并点击或聚焦任意可见目标。

description.en: Skill manager page in the DSH Web Settings panel, at the same level as Plugins: lists every skill the installation serves with its own summary, source and disk footprint, and removes any of them into a recoverable trash.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置里的 skill 管理器页面，与「插件」同级：列出当前安装提供的全部 skill 及其自己的简介、来源与占用，并可逐个移除（移除是移入可恢复的回收站）。

description.en: Installs and runs Android native command-line tools from inside DSH: fetches aarch64 bionic packages from the Termux repository, unpacks them in pure JS and runs them through /system/bin/linker64, with no root, no Shizuku and no external package manager.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内部安装并运行 Android 原生命令行工具：从 Termux 仓库取 aarch64 bionic 包、纯 JS 解包，再经 /system/bin/linker64 执行，无需 root、Shizuku 或外部包管理器。

description.en: Shows selectable DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, and TeamoRouter balances in the DSH Web sidebar, with per-provider details, usage data, and refresh controls.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏展示可选的 DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱 GLM 和 TeamoRouter 余额，并提供渠道详情、用量数据与刷新控制。

description.en: Lists RouterAI prompt, completion and cache-read prices per million tokens for the models configured in this profile, highlighting the active one. Requires a model provider whose config key is `routerai`; without it the table shows no data.
description.zh: 列出 profile 里各模型的 RouterAI 提示、补全和缓存读取价格（每百万 token），并高亮当前在用的那个。需要配置键为 routerai 的模型 provider；缺了表格不显示数据。

description.en: Appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included, and plays a short synthesized sound for each one.
description.zh: 在模型写出的每句话结尾（含思维链）补一个小冰块标记，并为每次补冰播放一声短促的合成音效。

description.en: Interactive Side-Assistant Dock to ask quick side questions via /btw with real-time thinking status and history pagination without interrupting the active agent loop.
description.zh: 交互式侧边助手坞：用 /btw 快速提问，实时显示思考状态，历史记录分页浏览。

description.en: Persistent wallpaper skin for the dsh web profile: static image or muted looping video as the app background, with translucent panels and a floating picker panel.
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的持久化壁纸皮肤：静态图片或静音循环视频作为应用背景，面板半透明化，右下角悬浮面板一键换壁纸。

description.en: Agent persona management, agent memory, edit-and-regenerate for past messages: create and manage agents, each with its own identity, long-term memory, global memory and chat history.
description.zh: Agent人格管理，Agent记忆，历史消息编辑并重新生成：创建和管理 Agent，每个 Agent 有独立身份、长期记忆、全局记忆与聊天记录，历史消息可编辑后重新生成。

description.en: Mobile web UI for DeepSeek Harness: a token-protected LAN server that lists all sessions, streams replies over SSE, and lets a phone continue any conversation; the desktop GUI shows a QR entry and, with dsh-whale-girl 0.3.0+, a phone held by the pet opens the same panel.
description.zh: DSH 手机端 Web UI：带令牌认证的局域网服务，手机可浏览全部会话、通过 SSE 实时查看回复并继续对话；桌面 GUI 提供二维码入口，配合 dsh-whale-girl 0.3.0+ 现在还可以点桌宠鳍里的小手机打开面板。

description.en: Auditable token ledger for DeepSeek Harness: folds the durable session log into restart-safe totals, recomputes the same numbers from the raw logs and diffs them, and turns usage into a bill by workspace, session, model or vendor, exportable as CSV or JSON.
description.zh: 可审计的 DSH token 账本：把持久化会话日志折算成重启安全的总量，可从原始日志重算并比对差异，并按工作区、会话、模型或厂商生成账单，可导出 CSV 或 JSON。

description.en: Agent governance kingdom for DeepSeek Harness: territories, role bindings (bind/unbind/session with model/agent identity), and a plan→assign→execute→review task loop where Worker claims never auto-complete (Claim ≠ Fact), with a local GUI operations console.
description.zh: DSH 里的 Agent 王国：领地、角色绑定/换届/会话归属（含模型/Agent 身份），plan→派发→执行→验收治理闭环（Worker 自述≠完成事实），附本地 GUI 操作台。

description.en: Read-only XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV viewer for dock-files with worksheet tabs, sorting, filters, search and cell links.
description.zh: dock-files 的只读表格查看器，支持 XLSX、XLS、ODS、CSV、TSV 格式以及工作表切换、排序、筛选、搜索和单元格链接。

description.en: Export complete Web Sessions to local Markdown or self-contained HTML, with stable rendered previews, default redaction, and opt-in bounded tool-call details.
description.zh: 把完整 Web Session 导出为本地 Markdown 或自包含 HTML，提供稳定的 Markdown 渲染预览、默认脱敏和可选的有界工具调用详情。

description.en: In-app plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, one-click install, compat badges.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 内置插件商店：浏览、搜索、一键安装、兼容性徽章。

description.en: Native discovery and per-agent loading of built-in, plugin and MCP tools, with BM25 and optional Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embeddings.
description.zh: 内置工具、插件工具与 MCP 工具的原生发现与按 agent 加载，支持 BM25 检索，可选 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的向量检索。

description.en: Imports Claude Code setup into DeepSeek Harness from a native settings screen or CLI, with dry-run previews for skills, commands, agents, hooks, permission rules, and MCP config. Codex and OpenCode remain supported as secondary origins, with collision-safe apply and post-move checks.
description.zh: 通过原生设置页或 CLI 将 Claude Code 配置迁入 DeepSeek Harness，可先预览技能、命令、代理、hooks、权限规则与 MCP 配置；Codex 和 OpenCode 作为次要来源继续支持，并提供目标冲突保护和迁移后检查。

description.en: Continues numbered and bulleted lists in the DSH composer, so Shift+Enter after "1. item" starts a new line with the next marker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里写列表时，Shift+Enter 换行后自动补上下一个编号（1. → 2.）或项目符号。

description.en: Keeps the shared default model pinned, so switching the model inside a chat no longer rewrites the global default and no longer lowers that default's reasoning effort.
description.zh: 锁定共享的默认模型：在聊天里切换模型不再改写全局默认值，也不会再被那次切换连带降档推理强度。

description.en: Sidebar skill hub: scan Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini skill directories for one-click import, manage global/project skills (toggle, trash), and install from dropped folders, zip archives, or local paths of any size.
description.zh: 侧边栏技能站：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录一键导入，管理全局与项目技能（启停、回收站），支持拖拽文件夹、zip 包与本地路径（不限大小）安装。

description.en: Hermes in the DSH sidebar: start and stop the gateway and dashboard, watch the dashboard beside the chat, and bridge DSH to Hermes. Windows only; requires an existing Hermes install.
description.zh: 把 Hermes 放进 DSH 右侧栏：启停网关和 dashboard，聊天旁边就能看 dashboard，再把 DSH 和 Hermes 接起来。仅 Windows；需已安装 Hermes。

description.en: DSH Usage Monitor: auto-query provider credit balances and time-window limits from configured API keys, with input capsule and custom provider support.
description.zh: DSH 用量监控：自动查询已配置 API Key 的供应商余额和时间窗口限制，支持输入框余量胶囊和自定义供应商。

description.en: Keeps plugins you have edited (third-party or built-in) as local git repos: deploys an exact commit only after it builds and passes checks, reverts a change that crashes dsh right after it is applied, merges origin updates (npm or git) into your edits, and can open an agent session that squashes your edits into one commit on top of the original release (backup branch first).
description.zh: 把你改过的插件（第三方或内置）保存为本地 git 仓库：只部署已构建并通过检查的指定提交，应用后导致 dsh 崩溃时自动回滚，把 npm 或 git 源的更新合并进你的修改，并可打开智能体会话，把你的修改压缩为原始发布版本之上的一个提交（先建备份分支）。

description.en: Two-level model picker for the DeepSeek Harness composer: browse providers, then models, search across all providers or within one provider, select supported reasoning-effort levels, and navigate with arrow keys, Enter and Esc.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框的两级模型选择器：先选供应商再选模型，支持全局与供应商内搜索、可用思考强度设置，以及方向键、Enter 和 Esc 操作。

description.en: Send "Memory unlocked" to let the AI recall conversations it has forgotten.
description.zh: 发送“大记忆恢复术”来让 AI 回想起忘记的对话。

description.en: Injects a per-conversation x-opencode-session header for OpenCode Go routes that were registered under a custom provider name, through the host official llm-pi-ai/request-headers waterfall. Zero dependencies, no fetch patching, and it never overwrites a header someone else already set.
description.zh: 为以自定义供应商名接入的 OpenCode Go 路由，按会话注入 x-opencode-session 请求头：走宿主官方 llm-pi-ai/request-headers 瀑布；零依赖、不替换 fetch，且不覆盖他人已写入的同名头。

description.en: Pre-install compatibility gate for DSH plugins: locks the resolved version, checks peer/engines declarations, dry-installs into an isolated DSH_HOME and boots it with a timeout, blocks on any failure, and restores the profile if the real install fails. Optionally intercepts dsh-market install/update clicks. Compatible with DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x.
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前兼容性门控：锁定解析版本、校验 peer/engines 声明、在隔离 DSH_HOME 中试装并限时试启动，任一失败即阻止；正式安装失败自动还原 profile。可选拦截 dsh-market 的安装/更新点击，兼容 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x。

description.en: Turns the DSH turn-navigation rail into a music visualiser: each thin bar grows and thickens with its own frequency band, from system audio captured with WASAPI loopback. Geometry only, no colour or glow, and the rail keeps its native hover preview, click-to-jump and wheel scrolling.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的轮次导航条变成音乐可视化：每根细横条按自己的频段变长变粗（系统声音用 WASAPI loopback 采集）。只改几何、不加颜色或发光，导航条原有的悬停预览、点击跳转与滚轮滚动都保留。

description.en: Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools with a settings-page leaderboard.
description.zh: DSH 插件透明排行与推荐：每日自动抓取 `dsh-plugin` 话题生态，公开评分模型，提供 rank/search/recommend 工具与设置页榜单。

description.en: Theme skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness — built-in themes / static image / dynamic 360°-follow video, one-click from the sidebar & Settings; imports persist, default skins protected.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题皮肤插件：内置主题 / 静态图片 / 动态视频（鼠标环绕跟随帧），侧边栏一键切换，设置页完整管理；导入持久化、默认皮肤不可删。

description.en: LLM adapter plugin for locally deployed Qwen models behind a vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with per-model multimodal switch, fully configurable reasoning efforts, and a web settings page for editing the deployment from the frontend.
description.zh: 面向 vLLM OpenAI 兼容端点上本地部署的 Qwen 模型的 LLM 适配器插件,支持按模型多模态开关、完全可配置的推理档位,以及可在前端编辑部署配置的 Web 设置页。

description.en: Bridges campfire group chats into DeepSeek Harness, delivering messages addressed to your member into a DSH session and posting the reply back to the group. Needs a self-hosted campfire server plus a member handle and channel token; anyone who @-mentions that member in the configured chat can start a turn.
description.zh: 把围炉群聊接进 DeepSeek Harness：发给成员的群消息投进 DSH 会话，模型回复自动发回群里。需自托管的围炉服务及成员 handle 与渠道令牌；配置群里任何人 @ 该成员都会触发一轮对话。

description.en: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

description.en: Learn an ERP through the browser into private local knowledge, with a desktop Adapt ERP workspace (multi-site sessions, chat in the middle and the official Browser on the right, approvals before writes).
description.zh: 通过浏览器学习 ERP 并沉淀为私有本地知识；桌面端提供「ERP 助手」工作区（多站点会话、中对话+右浏览器、写入前审批）。

description.en: Discord bridge loaded into the same Host as the desktop app or dsh web, with no separate process or profile — chat with sessions in any workspace from DMs or threads, attach to sessions open on the desktop, and answer tool approvals and model questions from whichever side responds first.
description.zh: 与桌面端或 dsh web 运行在同一个 Host 里的 Discord 桥接，无需单独进程或 profile：在私信或线程里与任意工作区的会话对话，接入桌面端正在用的会话，工具审批和模型提问在 Discord 与桌面端谁先答谁生效。

description.en: Paints a mouse-following WebGL particle field behind the DSH Web UI. The palette follows the light/dark theme; Settings → General has an on/off switch and a selectable frame-rate cap (30/60, plus 120 when the display supports it). It inserts nothing into the composer or transcript scroll tree.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面背后铺一层跟随鼠标的 WebGL 粒子场。配色跟随浅色/深色主题；设置 → 常规里有开关和可选帧率上限（30/60，显示器支持时增加 120）。不会向输入框或会话滚动树插入任何元素。

description.en: Session map: a fork-tree canvas over DSH sessions, and a Settings page that clones a Git repository into a new workspace. The canvas is reachable from a session-header toggle and two right-side tabs, and from a conversation tab that is off by default; it starts on the current session's own tree, growing downward, with wheel pan, Ctrl/⌘-wheel zoom, a subagent-session filter and a per-session overview of turns, steps, model time, tool time, output tokens and running state. The clone page takes a repository address and a remembered parent directory with a native folder picker, offers a per-clone shallow switch (off by default), runs git clone on the host, and registers the cloned directory as a workspace.
description.zh: 会话图谱：把 DSH 会话画成一张 fork 树画布，另在设置里加了一个「从 Git 克隆」页——填仓库地址、选存放目录（会记住上次选择、带原生目录选择器），按需打开浅克隆，克隆完自动添加为工作区。画布可从会话头部开关和右侧栏两个标签页打开，对话标签页默认关闭；默认只铺开当前会话所在的那棵树、自上而下生长，支持滚轮平移与 Ctrl/⌘ 滚轮缩放、隐藏子代理会话，另有一个会话概览页列出轮次、步骤、模型耗时、工具耗时、输出 token 与运行状态。

description.en: Writes engineering decisions down the way DSH documents its own — every non-trivial change leaves a Markdown note under .agents/notes/<lifecycle>/<class>/ holding the problem, the decision, the rejected alternatives and the consequences, committed to git and reviewable like code. It supplies the workflow for that: five tools (note_search, note_read, note_write, note_verify, note_skip), an end-of-turn hook that asks a code-changing turn to either write a note or record an explicit skip, the tree/format/archived checks, and the write-notes-like-deepseek skill bundled in the package and mounted by the plugin. A sidebar board that renders the notes into four views (architecture baseline, timeline, rejected proposals, decision list) comes with it; the notes themselves stay plain Markdown.
description.zh: 像 DSH 记录自己的决定那样记录工程决策：每次非平凡改动在 .agents/notes/<lifecycle>/<class>/ 下留一篇 Markdown，写清问题、决定、被否决的备选与后果，进 git、可以像代码一样 review。插件提供这套流程：note_search、note_read、note_write、note_verify、note_skip 五个工具，回合末钩子（改过代码的轮次要写笔记或记录一次显式跳过），树、格式、归档三项校验，以及随包分发、由插件挂载的 write-notes-like-deepseek 技能。另附把这些笔记渲染成四个视图（架构基线、演进时间线、避坑智库、决策清单）的侧边栏看板；笔记本体仍是普通 Markdown。

description.en: Automatic and user-customizable Fluent-style icons for DSH Settings and sidebar actions, with offline SVG packs and original-icon preservation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置和侧边栏自动分配并支持自定义的 Fluent 风格图标，离线内置 SVG，默认保留插件原图标。

description.en: Draft polish for the DSH composer: one-click AI polish of the input draft (sparkles button next to send), with optional conversation context and a configurable model channel.
description.zh: DSH 输入框草稿润色：发送键左侧一键调用 LLM 润色草稿，可携带会话上下文，模型渠道可配置。

description.en: LLM debug console for DeepSeek Harness: captures the full content of every model call at the llm/stream waterfall (options, stream chunks, usage, wire protocol) and shows it in a DevTools-style docked panel, with shared-prefix context diffing, wire-JSON reconstruction, JSON export and a runtime-tunable capture policy.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的 LLM 调试台：在 llm/stream 层完整捕获每次模型调用（请求参数、流式块、用量、真实 wire 协议），以 DevTools 风格停靠面板展示，支持上下文共享前缀折叠对比、wire JSON 重建、JSON 导出与运行时可调的抓取策略。

description.en: Per-answer timing breakdown: splits each reply into model, tool and other time, with first-token, decode and per-tool totals, and keeps a local JSONL ledger. Needs Node 24 or newer in the DSH runtime.
description.zh: 逐次回答耗时拆解：把每次回复分成模型、工具与其它三段，给出首字、生成与各工具耗时，并在本地落一份 JSONL 账本。需要 DSH 运行时为 Node 24 或更新版本。

description.en: LAN access for the harness process: writes the authenticated links for the harness port, one per local IPv4 address, to a token file and registers DSH_LAN_LINK in the shell environment, and can run a gateway on a fixed LAN port that holds the browser session on this machine, so devices need no token; forwarded requests get Host and Origin rewritten for the same-origin guard, and a host-claim marker is injected so the page renders as the full desktop UI instead of remote-visitor mode. Devices are admitted by CIDR, with optional Basic auth.
description.zh: 把当前 harness 进程的局域网访问交给其他设备：把 harness 端口的已认证链接按本机 IPv4 地址写进一个 token 文件，并在 shell 环境注册 DSH_LAN_LINK；可选的网关在固定局域网端口上对外服务，会话凭据留在本机、设备不需要 token，转发时重写 Host 与 Origin 以通过宿主的同源校验，并注入主机声明让页面按完整桌面界面渲染而不是远程访客模式。设备按 CIDR 放行，可选 Basic 认证。

description.en: Notion connector for DeepSeek Harness: search, read, query, create, update, and append Notion pages and databases via six agent tools, with a Web settings page — configured once with an Integration Token.
description.zh: 配置一次 Notion Integration Token，Agent 即可搜索、读取、查询、创建、更新、追加 Notion 页面与数据库内容，并提供 Web 设置页。

description.en: Construction cost workbench for DeepSeek Harness projects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 项目的工程造价工作台。

description.en: Switch OpenAI models between Codex-style Responses WebSocket transport and SSE from the composer, inheriting DSH provider settings with an optional priority-tier toggle.
description.zh: 继承 DSH 渠道配置，在输入框旁切换 OpenAI 模型的 Codex 风格 Responses WebSocket 与 SSE 传输，并可开启优先处理模式。

description.en: Freezes a six-step repair chain into callable tools — freeze the facts, measure the real shape, minimal repro, single-variable A/B, a judge that must say OK, delivery gate — plus a zero-dependency boot self-check (path drift, missing files, version sync, crash-log freshness), per-item tunables and a rollback ledger that backs up every action.
description.zh: 把排障六步固化成可调用的链：冻结事实→量真形状→最小复现→单变量对照→判定器（没说 OK 不许说修好）→交活闸；另带零依赖开机自检（安装路径漂移、配方缺件、版本三处一致、崩溃日志新鲜度）、逐项说明的微调设置，以及每个动作都留备份的退回账本。

description.en: Display read_image results in DSH Web and Desktop: complete previews, grouped multi-image galleries, transparency checkerboards, keyboard and touch zoom, and session-authorized loading. Verified with DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 和桌面版展示 read_image 结果：完整预览、多图画廊、透明棋盘格、键盘与触控缩放，使用会话授权加载。已验证 DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Manually zoom the Harness Web UI from 75% to 200% via a Settings row, Ctrl+wheel, or a Session-header control, keeping text crisp and readable on high-DPI displays.
description.zh: 在高 DPI 显示器上手动缩放 Harness Web UI（75%–200%）：设置行、Ctrl+滚轮与会话标题栏控件三种入口，让文字更清晰易读。

description.en: Claude Code-compatible persistent memory: the host injects the MEMORY.md index at session start, the model maintains memory files with plain read/write/edit tools, and a Settings page lists saved memories. Same on-disk format as Claude Code; claude mode shares the exact memory directory.
description.zh: Claude Code 兼容的持久记忆：每个会话开始时自动注入 MEMORY.md 索引，模型用普通 read/write/edit 文件工具维护记忆，Settings 内置记忆列表页。落盘格式与 Claude Code 完全一致，claude 模式直接共享同一记忆目录。

description.en: Visual theme customizer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — backgrounds, text colors, borders and details, all adjustable visually, with presets you can import and export, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面自定义主题插件：背景/文字/框线/细节全可视化调整，可导入导出预设，持久化保存。

description.en: Inspect plugins and Skills in the running DSH profile, preview updates, record verifiable snapshots and offer recovery only when replay evidence is available. Requires Node 22+ and DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or a later declared-compatible host. Restoring a plugin version does not restore configuration, its complete dependency tree or agent presets.
description.zh: 在运行中的 DSH profile 中查看插件与 Skill，预览更新、记录可核验快照，并仅在具备回放证据时提供恢复。需 Node 22+ 与 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或声明兼容的后续宿主；恢复插件版本不等于恢复配置、完整依赖树或 agent 预设。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness panel for local CLIProxyAPIPlus with Qoder and Codex authentication, quota views, automatic provider and model catalog sync, YAML editing, service control, request trends, and runtime logs.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理本地 CLIProxyAPIPlus，支持 Qoder、Codex 认证与额度查询，自动同步模型供应商及模型列表，并提供 YAML 编辑、服务启停、请求趋势和运行日志。

description.en: Composer expand/collapse toggle for the Web UI: a ⬆/⬇ button in the composer tool row grows the input to a tall 70vh writing view for long drafts.
description.zh: Web UI 输入框展开/收起：composer 工具行新增 ⬆/⬇ 按钮，一键把输入框扩大到 70vh 高度，方便写长 prompt。

description.en: Human-governed cross-session memory spaces with independent source and consumer relationships, provenance, versioning, and pre-send injection review.
description.zh: 用户治理的跨会话记忆空间，提供独立的来源与使用关系、来源追踪、版本管理和发送前注入检查。

description.en: Temporary workspace for DSH web — one click creates a throwaway workspace whose conversations are deleted at the next restart (immediately or after a delay, optionally behind a confirm dialog). Pin a temp workspace to keep it: its files move into the folder you pick, its title becomes that folder's name, its conversations migrate, and a real host-level restart re-indexes them.
description.zh: DSH web 临时工作区：一键创建一次性工作区，下次重启自动清空其全部对话（可立即/延迟删除，也可先弹确认框）。点击图钉可永久保留——文件移入所选文件夹、以文件夹名为标题、对话一并迁移，并触发真实的宿主级重启重新索引。

description.en: Source Control panel in the DSH Web left rail: search, switch and create branches with ahead/behind counts, a topo-order commit graph, and a click-to-expand preview of any commit showing its files (A/M/D), insertions and deletions, message, author and timestamp. An always-on footer dock above Settings carries the branch dropdown and recent commits and follows the open session; fetch and fast-forward pull are one button, and a git_worktree agent tool creates, lists and removes worktrees.
description.zh: DSH Web 左侧栏的源代码管理面板：搜索、切换与创建分支并显示领先/落后提交数，拓扑序提交图，点击任意提交可展开查看其文件（A/M/D）、增删行数、提交信息、作者与时间。设置上方常驻一个底部停靠区，包含分支下拉与最近提交并跟随当前会话；fetch 与快进 pull 合并为一个按钮；另有 git_worktree 工具供智能体创建、列出与移除 worktree。

description.en: Scheduled tasks panel for managing DSH agent and system crontabs with natural language input and execution logs.
description.zh: 定时任务面板：分区管理 DSH 与系统 crontab、自然语言生成表达式、执行日志与完成后消息推送。

description.en: Ranks models in a ten-slot ladder, routes each subagent by a 1-10 difficulty, and falls back a tier when one fails. Windows only; applies to sessions that opt in. Subagents can also launch local agent CLIs (Codex verified, nine others experimental), and a subagent granted full authority runs its CLI with --dangerously-skip-permissions, --yolo or --force. Run records go to .dsh-supa/ in the workspace.
description.zh: 把模型排成十档阶梯，按 1–10 的难度给子代理选档，失败自动降一档。仅支持 Windows，按会话选择启用。子代理还可以启动本机的 agent CLI（Codex 已验证，另有 9 个为实验性），被授予完全权限的子代理会给其 CLI 加 --dangerously-skip-permissions、--yolo 或 --force。运行记录写在工作区的 .dsh-supa/ 里。

description.en: Copies a session log path (or a paste-ready handoff block) and turns the multi-frame zstd log into a readable file another session can continue from.
description.zh: 复制会话日志路径（或可直接粘贴的接续块），并把多帧 zstd 会话日志转成可读文件，供另一个会话读取接续。

description.en: Panellist manager: reorder the entries on the left rail, rename them, replace their icons, hide them, and fold several into a Group with a flyout menu, from a Settings tab.
description.zh: 面板列表管理器：在设置页里调整左侧轨道上的页签顺序、改名、换图标、隐藏，并把若干页签收进带飞出菜单的分组。

description.en: Keeps the images you pasted or attached in the composer, per session: they are mirrored locally in the browser and handed back through the official draft channel when you return to the conversation or the composer remounts, and dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.
description.zh: 按会话保住输入框里的图片草稿：在浏览器本地留一份镜像，切回该对话或输入框重新挂载时经官方草稿通道放回去；消息一旦发出或你手动移除，就不再见它回来。

description.en: Click a delivered-file card to open the file with the system default application instead of DSH's built-in sidebar preview; hold Shift to keep the original preview.
description.zh: 点击交付文件卡片时用系统默认程序打开文件，而不是在 DSH 侧边栏里预览；按住 Shift 保留原来的预览行为。

description.en: Rewrites your composer draft in the voice of a chosen character card before it is sent, using the model the current session is already on, with an optional review panel and a local check that reports any identifier or path the rewrite dropped.
description.zh: 发送前把输入框草稿按所选角色卡的口吻改写，用当前会话正在使用的模型；可先审查再发送，并有一项本地检查会点名改写过程中丢掉的技术记号。

description.en: Read-only lazy session viewer: lists sessions with stat only, then decompresses just the tail Zstandard frames to inspect recent events; includes search, stats, and export in a standalone /lazyview panel. Requires Node.js 24+.
description.zh: 只读会话惰性查看器：仅 stat 列出会话，再只解压尾部 Zstandard 帧查看最近事件；独立 /lazyview 面板支持搜索、统计和导出。需 Node.js 24+。

description.en: Adds a Firecrawl search provider with multi-account API-key settings.
description.zh: 提供 Firecrawl 搜索服务及多账户 API Key 设置。

description.en: Takes over the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers with Tavily, each behind its own toggle: a key pool with balance-aware scheduling that reads real credit balances from /usage, failover with hard exclusion of cooling or exhausted keys, and call history with a 14-day credit chart.
description.zh: 用 Tavily 接管内置的 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供方，两者各有一个开关：密钥池按余额调度（从 /usage 读取真实余额），失败自动切换，冷却中与额度耗尽的密钥硬排除，并记录调用历史与 14 天额度图表。

description.en: Turns markdown into a WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) draft: inlines every CSS rule onto its element because the editor discards `<style>` blocks and class names, uploads each local image through WeChat's own endpoint so it is not filtered out, and creates the draft; it never broadcasts.
description.zh: 把 markdown 变成排好版的微信公众号草稿：样式逐条内联到元素上（编辑器会丢弃 `<style>` 块和 class 名），每张本地图片走微信自己的上传接口以免被过滤，然后创建草稿；不做群发。

description.en: Windows desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-tree snapshots, click by control name, delivery verdicts, and repeatable task files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面操控：读无障碍树、按控件名点击、动作投递判定，以及可重复执行的任务文件。

description.en: Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate: baselines the full visible tool registry (name/description/parameters, MCP tools included) into a committable JSON file and warns loudly when an upgrade adds, removes or reshapes a tool.
description.zh: 工具面快照与漂移门：全量可见工具注册表（含 MCP 工具）基线化为可提交的 JSON，升级新增、移除或改动工具时响亮告警。

description.en: SQLX database tools: list saved datasources, show or test a connection, execute SQL and open a local result page, with the sqlx CLI installed on first use.
description.zh: OtterMind SQLX 数据库工具：列出已保存的数据源、查看或测试连接、执行 SQL、打开本地结果页，缺少 sqlx CLI 时首次调用自动安装。

description.en: GLM Mode agent preset for zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash: PTC/Code Mode tool presentation, a reasoning loop guard and a tool spin guard (live-incident driven), and GLM-specific auto-compaction at 75%/22%.
description.zh: 为 zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash 调优的「GLM 模式」Agent 预设：PTC 程序化工具调用、思考死循环守卫与工具空转守卫双层防护（源自活体事故复盘）、GLM 专属自动压缩（75%/22%）。

description.en: One hub over every coding IDE you run — dsh, Claude Code, Codex, ZCode, Qoder, CatPaw, Trae, OpenCode. Zero-API: it reads each tool's own on-disk state and gives a session inventory, per-IDE usage with cache-hit rates, one-line resume commands, and a single .hub/ rule body wired into all eight via marker-delimited pointer files. The domestic-IDE adapters (Trae/Qoder/CatPaw) were verified against the installed binaries — a gap no overseas tool covers.
description.zh: 一个入口管住所有编码 IDE（dsh/Claude Code/Codex/ZCode/Qoder/CatPaw/Trae/OpenCode）：零 API 读各自磁盘状态，出会话盘点、按 IDE 用量与缓存命中率、一键恢复命令，并用指针文件把一份规则本体接入全部 8 个工具。国产 IDE 适配位从本机安装的二进制里逐一逆向核实，补齐海外工具的空缺。

description.en: Animal Island theme with boarding-pass masthead, cream notebook paper, 118 ThemeRuntime tokens, in-app appearance presets, and starry night mode.
description.zh: 动森风手账主题：渡岛船票品牌区、奶油手账纸、覆盖 118 项 ThemeRuntime token、应用内外观设置与夜岛星空。

description.en: Safe detached DSH restart: /restart and /dsh-restart slash commands with native candidate styling plus a dsh_restart agent tool; a detached worker restarts DSH after 3 seconds without freezing the session, and Windows/macOS use a native Node helper built on the official appExit service.
description.zh: 安全的分离式 DSH 重启：/restart 与 /dsh-restart 斜杠命令（原生候选样式）加 dsh_restart Agent 工具；分离的 worker 在 3 秒后重启 DSH 且会话不冻结，Windows/macOS 走基于官方 appExit 服务的原生 Node helper。

description.en: Usage statistics panel for the Web GUI and the Desktop app: silent per-model token collection, activity heatmap, trend charts, cost estimation and a daily-limit guard.
description.zh: Web GUI 与桌面端的用量统计面板：静默按模型采集 token、活跃热力图、趋势图、费用估算与每日超限守卫。

description.en: Keeps the DSH host awake during active tasks using native power assertions and releases them when tasks finish.
description.zh: 在任务运行期间通过原生电源断言保持 DSH 主机亮屏与唤醒，并在任务结束后释放。

description.en: Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session messaging.
description.zh: 整合工具包：会话身份、全局/工作区提示词（含引用文件）、会话自动上线、免 UAC 网页重启、会话间消息。

description.en: Architecture map workbench: register local repos, let a restricted agent (run as a hidden subagent session) read the code with the archify skill, keep branch-level structure and domain diagrams with concepts, temporary/permanent custom diagrams, read-only Q&A, and pick the analysis model from the models DSH already has configured.
description.zh: 代码库架构图册：登记本地仓库，由受限 agent（跑在子代理会话里，不占会话列表）用 archify skill 读代码，按分支维护结构图与领域图，支持概念提取、临时/永久自定义图、只读追问，并可在设置里挑选 DSH 已配好的模型来跑分析。

description.en: Deletes a DSH session from the session menu, and lists the workspace files that session touched so you choose which ones to remove with it. Deletion is permanent (no undo), and files written through shell commands are not tracked.
description.zh: 在会话菜单里删除 DSH 会话，并列出该会话碰过的工作区文件，由你勾选哪些一起删掉。删除是永久的、无法撤销；通过 shell 命令写出的文件不在追踪范围内。

description.en: AI dataset quality inspector for annotation consistency, class distribution bias and data leakage detection.
description.zh: AI数据集质量巡检工具，自动检测数据集中的标注一致性、类别分布偏差与数据泄露风险。

description.en: A CodeGraph tool scoped to the session's own indexed project, resolved from its workspace directory. One MCP server is launched through npx per project root and shared by every session working there; a project indexed mid-session is enabled without a restart, and the managed child process is reaped when the harness exits.
description.zh: 按会话自身的已索引项目提供 CodeGraph 工具，项目由 workspace 目录解析得出。每个项目根经 npx 启动一个 MCP 服务并被该项目下所有会话共享；会话中途建好索引即自动启用，无需重启；harness 退出时受管子进程被回收。

description.en: 🎲 Dice Battle — six classic dice games (Liar's Dice, Guess Red Dots, Red/Blue, Big/Small, Odd/Even, Straight) for the DSH web GUI. Single vs AI plus PeerJS WebRTC online play, fully bilingual zh/en, sidebar entry opens the game in the center column.
description.zh: 🎲 骰子大作战 — 六种经典骰子玩法（吹牛、猜红点、猜红蓝、猜大小、猜单双、猜顺子），单人 vs AI + PeerJS 联机，全量中英双语，侧边栏入口打开游戏面板。

description.en: Scheduled DSH tasks: each topic keeps its own folder and task-detail file, runs by cron or manually, and renders a timestamped PNG or PDF report that can be pushed to Lark.
description.zh: DSH 定时任务：每个选题一个目录与任务细节文件，按 cron 或手动执行，渲染带时间戳的 PNG / PDF 报告，并可推送到飞书。

description.en: Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots the result; ships a frontend-verify skill.
description.zh: 无头浏览器验证工具：让 agent 打开自己刚写的页面，读取渲染后的 DOM 与计算样式、检查控制台、截图留档；内置 frontend-verify 技能。

description.en: Skirk, Rose Queen and Hatsune Miku themes for DSH with built-in management, phone layouts, entrance animation and custom startup videos.
description.zh: 丝柯克、玫瑰女王与初音未来三主题套装，内置主题管理、手机布局、首页入场动画及自定义启动视频。

description.en: Runs a fixed set of agent benchmark cases in isolated sandboxes, scores each case with deterministic assertions, and diffs two runs to show which cases regressed after a model, prompt or DSH upgrade.
description.zh: 在隔离沙箱里跑一组固定的 Agent 用例，用确定性断言判分，并对比两次运行，指出换模型、改提示词或升级 DSH 之后哪条用例退化了。

description.en: Conflict diagnosis and repair for DeepSeek Harness plugins. Builds a capability graph of the running Loader profile and of the on-disk cordis.patch.yml layers, comparing imports, peer ranges and config against the host that is ACTUALLY running rather than the profile's possibly-stale copies, and reports the conflicts that fail silently: a fiber stuck PENDING on a service no plugin provides, a browser half injecting a client module nothing provides, a tool id two plugins both register, duplicate Loader entry ids, a row disabled by one layer and re-inserted by another, an import of a host subpath the running host does not export, and a cycle among inject declarations. Every finding carries its evidence, a confidence grade for who owns a name, and a repair with a risk grade — verify it with a dry-run difference table, or take the individual .patch.yml files that --fix-out writes (never auto-loaded, so picking wrong breaks nothing).
description.zh: DSH 插件冲突诊断与修复建议。把运行期能力图谱与磁盘上的 cordis.patch.yml 层对齐，并与真正在运行的宿主（而不是 profile 里可能过期的副本）比对导入、peer 范围与配置，检出那些不会自己报错的静默故障：卡在 PENDING 等待无人提供的服务、浏览器半区注入了无人提供的客户端模块、两个插件注册同一个 tool id、Loader entry id 重复、某层停用又被后一层重新插入的行、导入了运行宿主未通过 exports 暴露的子路径、以及 inject 声明之间成环。每条结论都带证据、归属置信度与带风险分级的修复：用 --dry-run 在内存里试修并看修改前后差异，或用 --fix-out 拿到独立的 .patch.yml 文件自己挑（这些文件不会被 DSH 加载，挑错也不影响运行）。

description.en: Moves the composer to the top of an active conversation and renders the transcript plus the turn navigator newest-first, so replies appear right under the composer.
description.zh: 把活跃会话的输入框固定在视口顶部，转写列表与右侧回合导航按最新在上渲染，新回复紧贴输入框出现。

description.en: Turns a learning request and local materials into a structured, locally stored AI course with outline, lessons, diagrams and learning progress.
description.zh: 把学习诉求和手头资料变成结构化、纯本地的 AI 课程，含大纲、知识点内容、图表与学习进度。

description.en: Unread count on the browser tab icon and the Windows taskbar button, with a chime when a turn finishes.
description.zh: 回合结束时在浏览器标签页图标和 Windows 任务栏图标上显示未读数，并播放提示音。

description.en: Conversation and workspace undo: use the /undo timeline, session-header action, or message icon to roll back before any sent prompt; private Shadow Git snapshots restore files, the reverted turns stay out of model context, and Undo Rollback can recover mistakes. Includes archived-session management and per-tool colored cards.
description.zh: 对话与工作区撤销：通过 /undo 节点轴、会话头部按钮或消息下方图标回滚到任意已发送 prompt 之前；插件私有 Shadow Git 快照恢复文件，被回滚回合不会进入模型上下文，误操作还能“撤回回滚”。附带归档会话管理与工具卡片分类配色。

description.en: Captain-led multi-agent teams that split a goal into tasks and dispatch them along an execution chain to members running in their own sub-sessions, each with its own model.
description.zh: 领队主导的多智能体团队：把目标拆成任务，按执行链派发给运行在各自子会话里的成员，每个成员可配不同模型。

description.en: Per-model reasoning effort (off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh) for GPT, Codex, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible models. Installs a helper, not a runtime adapter: run enable-capabilities.ps1 once per profile (Windows) and restart — it declares the levels in ~/.dsh/settings.yaml, with a disable script and a backup to revert.
description.zh: 为 GPT、Codex、Gemini 与 OpenAI-compatible 模型提供按模型的推理等级（off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh）。装的是 helper 而不是运行时适配器：需按 profile 手动跑一次 enable-capabilities.ps1（Windows）并重启——它把等级声明写进 ~/.dsh/settings.yaml，附带还原脚本与备份。

description.en: Make the AI remember how you think, not what you said: actively captures your principles, redlines, and working habits across sessions — with memory capacity, graceful decay, and human-readable reasoning for every entry. 0.7.0 brings an intuitive persona portrait with evidence tracing.
description.zh: 让模型主动记下你的判断依据（原则/红线/工作方式），跨会话复用 —— 有容量上限、会遗忘、每条都说得出为什么记。0.7.0 重构为画像式速写，带证据追溯与红线硬约束，告别冷冰冰的数据库列表。

description.en: Composer model selector grouped by provider: pick a provider card, then drill into that provider to choose a model, with cross-provider search and Reasoning Effort kept.
description.zh: 按来源分块的输入框模型选择器：先选来源渠道卡片，再下钻进该渠道选择模型，保留跨来源搜索与推理强度调节。

description.en: Four adjustable terse levels plus independent switches for reasoning effort, web search and subagents, on the conversation header and in the Settings page. No output ceiling.
description.zh: 四档「简洁模式」常驻对话页顶部，思考强度、联网搜索、子代理三个开关独立可调，设置页里也有一份；四个档位都不设输出上限。

description.en: Connects QQ Bot private and group chats to DeepSeek Harness Desktop, with per-chat personas, interactive questions, and optional image understanding.
description.zh: 将 QQ 私聊和群聊接入 DeepSeek Harness Desktop，支持按会话切换人格、交互式提问和可选图片理解。

description.en: Registers the TypeSafe/Jev (System One) skill into DeepSeek Harness's global skill layer, so every session can classify, route, score, extract and gate on confidence using typed judgments instead of prompt-and-parse. Ships no API key; the user supplies OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
description.zh: 把 TypeSafe / Jev（System One 判断模型）的构建技能注册进 DeepSeek Harness 的全局技能层，让每个会话都能用带类型的判断做分类、路由、打分、抽取和置信度门控，取代「调大模型再解析回复」。不含任何密钥，API key 由使用者通过 OPENROUTER_API_KEY 提供。

description.en: Alpha Agent Teams plugin for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and newer that lets same-session user Steer end the Lead’s current wait_agent call while teammates continue, with native message delivery and Node PTC continuation.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 起版本的 Agent Teams 预览插件，让同会话用户 Steer 结束主代理当前的 wait_agent 等待，队友继续工作，并保留原生消息领取与 Node PTC 后续执行。

description.en: Image understanding for DSH: describe an image and read the text in it through Zhipu GLM-4V (needs a Zhipu API key, free tier), with optional person identification through Volcengine Ark and anime-only reverse image search through SauceNAO or trace.moe (each needs its own key); ffmpeg must be installed for GIF/WebP input. Keys and the ffmpeg path are set on the plugin's own settings page.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加识图：用智谱 GLM-4V 描述图片、读图中文字（需智谱 API Key，有免费额度），可选火山方舟认人、SauceNAO / trace.moe 反查动漫原图（各需自己的 Key）；GIF/WebP 图需要装 ffmpeg。Key 与 ffmpeg 路径在插件自带的设置页里配。

description.en: GitHub MCP helper panel: shows copyable example prompts at Settings → Plugins → GitHub MCP (random 4 from a 30-example pool), visualizes a public user's repo star/fork/language, and adds the gh_repo_stats and gh_current_user model tools.
description.zh: GitHub MCP 辅助面板：在「设置 → 插件 → GitHub MCP」展示可复制的示例提示（30 条示例池随机 4 条）、可视化公开仓库的星/fork/语言，并提供 gh_repo_stats / gh_current_user 模型工具。

description.en: Adds a city-local sky theme with a moving sun, day and night colors, drifting clouds, time previews, and an immersive sky view to the DSH web workspace.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页工作区添加按城市当地时间变化的天空主题，支持太阳移动、日夜配色、浮云、时间预览与沉浸天空。

description.en: Configurable context compaction with three independently switchable sections — whole-context checkpoint, reasoning compression and tool-output pruning — each with its own pressure threshold and method. Mechanical modes make no model calls; model modes summarize fragments in batches with a configurable provider and prompt. A left-sidebar panel exposes switches, method cards and editable parameters that save without a restart, and every rewrite is archived with its original text.
description.zh: 可配置的上下文压缩，三个板块各自独立开关：总压缩（整段检查点）、思考压缩、工具输出压缩，每个板块有自己的触发阈值与方式。机械方式不调用模型，模型方式按批摘要且提供方与提示词可配。左栏面板提供开关、方式卡片与可编辑参数，保存后无需重启即生效；每次改写都会连同原文一起归档。

description.en: A status bar for the DSH sidebar. While a session runs, its row becomes a green card with a progress bar driven by an estimate of how long the turn will take (drifting dotted track), plus a live percentage on the leading edge that switches to elapsed mm:ss once the estimate is exceeded. When the turn finishes the row turns orange and stays lit until you actually open that conversation. Pure client-side, no extra services, a few localStorage keys.
description.zh: 侧栏会话状态条：会话跑起来时整行变成绿色卡片，底部一条带流动小点的进度条按估算时长推进，行首直接显示完成百分比，超时后改显示精确到秒的已用时长；跑完后整行转橙并一直亮着，直到你点开那条对话才熄灭。不用切过去看，瞄一眼侧栏就知道每条会话在干嘛。

description.en: Sync a git-backed memory folder with a peer machine every time DeepSeek Harness starts — no daemon, no cron, no manual pull.
description.zh: 每次打开 DeepSeek Harness，自动把本机的 git 记忆目录和另一台机器双向同步一次——开机就有最新记忆，不用常驻后台。

description.en: Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working animations under prefers-reduced-motion, zh-CN/en localized. Works in the stock composer and inside dsh-split-screen panes; verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
description.zh: Web 对话「只看结果」开关：隐藏思考与工具调用过程，运行中仅保留一条实时状态行，reduced-motion 环境下恢复活动光影，中英双语。原生输入框与 dsh-split-screen 分屏面板内均可用；已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

description.en: Immersive weather theme for DeepSeek Harness: physical rain with splashes and ripples, snow in two crystal habits, a hearth, lightning with distance-coded thunder, a night mode, and a compact control panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供沉浸式天气主题：按物理模拟的雨滴（含溅射与水花）、两种晶型的雪花、炉火，以及带分叉的闪电与按距离延迟的雷声，并提供夜间模式和紧凑控制面板。

description.en: Prune low-value exchanges or single messages from a session: select them inline in the chat, drop them from the model-visible surface and the transcript, undo in one step.
description.zh: 把会话里低价值的问答或单条消息筛除：在对话内原位选中，从模型可见内容与对话界面中移除，可一步撤销。

description.en: From chat to canvas to artwork — drive ComfyUI as a visual workflow IDE inside DSH. Embed ComfyUI (local or cloud) as a split-screen canvas in DeepSeek Harness Web: the agent sparks ideas, writes prompts and scripts right in the chat, applies them live to the canvas in front of you, and produces images, music, video, and 3D. From idea to finished output without ever leaving the conversation or switching front-ends: Canvas ops — compose and arrange pipelines, read/write workflows, edit nodes, wire links, run, tune parameters, and debug errors, all live and WYSIWYG on the exact canvas you are looking at; Production tasks — batch parameter sweeps (batch_run) and automatic output-image retrieval back into the chat (get_outputs), powering multi-modal creative and batch generation across images, music, video, and 3D; Environment upkeep — one-click launch of ComfyUI and one-click upgrade of the core plus every custom node (upgrade), keeping the stack healthy without interruption. This package is the DSH-side plugin, and it ships the ComfyUI-side bridge node too.
description.zh: 从对话到画布再到作品——DSH 里驾驭 ComfyUI 的可视化工作流 IDE。把 ComfyUI（本地或云端）以画布分屏嵌入 DeepSeek Harness Web，agent 在对话里激发创意、书写提示词与脚本，实时落到你眼前的画布上，产出图像、音乐、视频、3D。从灵感到成品，全程不离开对话，不用切换任何前端工具：画布操作——搭建编排、读写工作流、修改节点、连线、运行、调整参数、工作流查错，所见即所得，实时落在你眼前的画布上；生产任务——批量扫参（batch_run）、自动取回出图（get_outputs）带回对话，实现图像、音乐、视频、3D 等多任务智能创作与批量生产；环境维护——一键启动 ComfyUI、一键升级核心与全部自定义节点（upgrade），省心维护不间断。本仓库集成了 DSH 侧插件（画布副驾）+ ComfyUI 侧桥接节点，无人值守/规模化执行时可配合官方 ComfyUI MCP 服务器使用。

description.en: Media-scape theme for the DSH web UI: standing/character-art and video wallpapers (mp4/webm, local + online) with boot animation, base color schemes (single-source JSON + presets + picker), capsule host-element styling, ambient particles, background music player (covers/playlists/random), typing sound effects, and a draggable dock toolbar with a unified upload entry — wallpapers and music uploaded together (suffix-classified), mid-upload no-disk buffering, pause→.part snapshots with offset resume, filename+size dedup with "skipped" notices, and true-delete removal with list refreshes.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 媒体景观主题：立绘/视频壁纸（mp4/webm，本地+在线）+ 开屏动画 + 基底配色（单真源 JSON + 预设包 + 取色器 + 胶囊宿主元素样式）+ 氛围粒子 + 背景音乐播放器（封面/歌单/随机）+ 打字音效 + 可拖动 dock 工具条；dock「传」统一上传壁纸与音乐（按文件后缀识别）——上传中途不落盘、暂停落 .part 快照可续传、文件名+大小去重预检「已跳过」、移除真实删除并前后刷新列表。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: pinned rules injected every turn, the rest recalled by IDF-weighted keyword evidence, fact-key dedup, plain JSON storage, and a settings page to edit or delete entries.
