description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话长期记忆：规则和坑每轮注入，其余按 IDF 加权关键词召回；事实键去重、明文 JSON、设置页可增删改。

description.en: A YAPI documentation panel for DeepSeek Harness with search, multi-tab, field tree, and copy features. Needs your own YAPI server and account.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 YAPI 接口文档面板，支持搜索、多标签、字段树与勾选复制。需自备 YAPI 服务与账号。

description.en: Delegates independent tasks from DeepSeek Harness to the local OpenAI Codex CLI and returns the result to the current conversation. Provides four tools (task execution, status check, danger-mode toggle, enable/disable switch), enforces a real-path working-directory whitelist with symlink-escape protection, defaults to Codex workspace-write sandbox mode, passes the task body as a single argv argument to avoid shell injection, kills the whole Codex process group on timeout or cancel, and caps output length. Requires Node.js >= 20 and a Codex CLI build supporting codex exec.
description.zh: 把独立任务从 DeepSeek Harness 委派给本机 OpenAI Codex CLI 执行，并把结果返回当前会话。提供四个工具（任务执行、状态检查、危险模式开关、启停开关），强制真实路径白名单并做软链逃逸防护，默认使用 Codex workspace-write 沙箱模式，任务正文以单个 argv 参数传递避免 shell 注入，超时或取消时终止完整 Codex 进程组，并限制输出长度。需要 Node.js >= 20 和支持 codex exec 的 Codex CLI。

description.en: Plays a character entrance card beside the composer when you switch model: identity name, six scored axes (intelligence, coding, speed, stability, cost, context), quota hint and a dialogue line. 23 curated cards across 15 providers; models without a curated card fall back to a data card derived from public benchmarks, or a generic card when no benchmark data exists. A web client plugin with no dependencies and no hooks.
description.zh: 切换模型时在会话输入框旁播一张角色登场卡：身份名、六轴分数（智力／编码／速度／稳定／性价比／上下文）、额度提示与台词；23 张精选卡覆盖 15 个 provider，库里没有精选卡的模型按公开基准派生数据卡；基准集里也没有分数的则回退为通用卡。web 客户端插件，无依赖、无 hooks。

description.en: Tracks token usage and estimated costs for every model call, with daily charts, session and workspace names, provider balances, budgets, and secret-free CSV/JSON exports.
description.zh: 统计本机每次模型调用的 token 用量与预估费用，提供每日图表、会话/工作区名称、账户余额、预算与无凭据 CSV/JSON 导出。

description.en: Decision split view for DSH web UI: a decision summary card in the main window plus the full plan in an independently scrollable side panel, so you can review the whole plan while writing decisions and send them back to the agent with one click.
description.zh: 决策分屏视图：主窗口显示决策摘要卡片，右侧详情栏独立滚动展示完整方案，边看全文边写决策，一键回传 agent。

description.en: Session management enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness - workspace session count display, archived sessions panel with restore/delete, drag-and-drop session move across workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强插件 - 工作区会话数展示、归档会话面板（支持恢复/删除）、拖拽移动会话到其他工作区。

description.en: WeChat Official Account pipeline: validate a draft against a publish gate, then push it into the draft box.
description.zh: 公众号发布管线：先按发布闸门校验草稿，再推送到草稿箱。

description.en: Version-control workbench for the DSH Web sidebar: local changes grouped by type, per-file and multi-file staging, preview-confirmed commit / update / push, and a failure dialog that shows the raw Git output instead of a four-second toast.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏的版本控制工作台：改动按类型分组，支持单文件与多文件暂存，提交/拉取/推送均先预览再确认，失败时弹窗展示 Git 原始输出。

description.en: Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated at every assembly, with RPE reinforcement, decay and sleep consolidation; shares one data repo with its Claude Code (MCP) and OpenClaw hosts; verified against DSH 0.1.0-rc.6.
description.zh: 自进化团队记忆，以纯 Markdown 存于 Git：原生 Cordis 插件注册 38 个裸名记忆工具，并按每次组装动态注入 prompt-signals 段；含 RPE 强化、衰减与睡眠巩固；与 Claude Code（MCP）、OpenClaw 宿主共享同一数据仓；已对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 实测。

description.en: Reverse-engineering agent preset. Mounts REA (rea-agents) as MCP tools for native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, managed assemblies, archives and installers — the full 170-tool catalog by default — but only inside sessions that select the preset; other presets load nothing. Ships an install-time check that reports which native analysis engine (Hopper, Ghidra, IDA) is present and prints the env snippet to wire one in. A fork of dsh-rea (JeremyWangCY, MIT) retargeted as an agent preset; do not install it together with dsh-rea.
description.zh: 逆向工程 agent 预设。把 REA（rea-agents）的原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron、托管程序集、归档与安装包分析能力作为 MCP 工具挂载——默认全量 170 个——但只在选择该预设的会话里生效，其它预设零加载。附带安装后环境自检：报告本机已装哪个原生分析引擎（Hopper / Ghidra / IDA），并给出接入所需的 env 片段。本插件是 dsh-rea（JeremyWangCY，MIT）的二次开发分支，改为 agent 预设，请勿与上游 dsh-rea 同时安装。

description.en: Recalls prompts sent earlier in the current session with the up and down keys in an empty composer, and shows a position badge while browsing.
description.zh: 在空输入框里用 ↑/↓ 翻出本会话之前发过的提示词，翻动时显示位置角标。

description.en: Circuit breaker for idle agent turns: watches agent/assistant-stream and cancels a turn that produces only reasoning — no text and no tool call — after 45s, after 80000 reasoning characters, or on a degenerate repetition pattern (exact repeat unit, sentence-template repeat, sparse repeat, or 6-gram density). On trip it injects a continue instruction that requires the next action to be a tool call, and ships 11 regression cases plus per-gate tuning.
description.zh: 空转回合熔断器：监听 agent/assistant-stream，对只产出 reasoning、零文本零工具调用的回合实施三重熔断——45 秒无进展、单次思考超 80000 字符、或命中退化重复模式（精确重复单元/句模重复/稀疏复读/6-gram 密度）。熔断后注入继续指令，要求下一个动作必须是工具调用；附 11 个回归用例与逐档调参。

description.en: English edition of Weiwen's Law (KISS's Law): the first and only domain-agnostic white-box causal adjudication middleware for AI agents. Unlike domain-specific causal-inference tooling (statistics/economics/ML) or evidence-gated agent firewalls, it adjudicates *every* tool call along a deterministic structural causal chain (R->S->D->H->M) before execution - across any domain, with no training or per-domain tuning. It blocks destructive and credential-file operations, escalates repeated boundary violations, cuts faulting links until verified-fixed, and gives risk verdicts on un-auditable execution; runs fully local with zero API cost.
description.zh: 唯稳律（KISS's Law）英文版：业界首个且唯一的领域无关白箱因果裁决中间件。与领域特定的因果推断工具（统计/经济/机器学习）或「需提供因果证据」的代理防火墙不同，它在执行前对*每个*工具调用沿确定性结构因果链（R->S->D->H->M）裁决——适用任意领域，无需训练或按领域调参。拦截破坏性与凭据文件操作、对反复越界升级止损、故障环节切断至修复验证、不可审计执行给出风险判定；纯本地运行、零 API 成本。

description.en: Sets up QuickTUI from a dsh plugin page: installs QuickTUI server on macOS and Linux, pairs the phone app by QR code, and connects dsh sessions so the app can follow them, answer approvals and questions, send prompts, and interrupt turns.
description.zh: 在 dsh 插件页配置 QuickTUI：在 macOS 与 Linux 上安装 QuickTUI server，扫码配对手机 App，并接入 dsh 会话，让 App 能查看会话、回应审批与提问、发送提示词、中断回合。

description.en: Compose two skill contracts into a traceable, unverified draft with declared gaps and preserved constraints; the composition engine runs locally with no model call.
description.zh: 把两个技能契约本地组合成可追溯的未验证草案，列出缺口并保留双方约束；组合引擎在本机运行，不调用模型。

description.en: Chat with your Galatea assistant from QQ (official bot) and WeChat: the same conversation, persona and memory as on the desktop, only the paired owner's private chat is accepted, replies go back where you wrote, and more chat apps can be added. Requires the Galatea framework.
description.zh: 在 QQ（官方机器人）、微信上和 Galatea 助手聊天：和桌面是同一段对话、同一个人格和记忆，只接收配对本人的私聊，回复发回你说话的地方，可扩展更多聊天软件。需要先装 Galatea 框架。

description.en: Monitor workspace sessions, subagents, todo progress and token usage in a floating panel.
description.zh: 在浮动面板中查看工作区会话、子代理状态、待办进度与 Token 用量。

description.en: Adds a /grill-me slash command that switches the session to plan mode and prompts the agent to ask 3 to 20 structured questions about your goal, each with a recommended option and alternatives, through ask_user_question before it plans.
description.zh: 添加 /grill-me 斜杠命令：把会话切到计划模式，并提示 agent 在规划前通过 ask_user_question 就你的目标提出 3 到 20 个结构化问题，每个问题带推荐选项和备选项。

description.en: Requires at least one search API key (Grok, or any one of the supplementary sources). A grok-search-rs-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness with configurable source fallback, visual settings, search log replay, and account quota queries.
description.zh: 需至少配置一个搜索 API Key（Grok 或任一补充来源）。基于 grok-search-rs 的 DeepSeek Harness 搜索插件，提供可配置的来源回退、可视化设置、搜索日志回放和账户额度查询。

description.en: Live dot-matrix whale wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: ~1,750 breathing WebGL2 particles with pointer liquid vortices, light/dark themes, and a Canvas2D fallback.
description.zh: DSH Web 动态点阵鲸鱼壁纸：约 1,750 个呼吸的 WebGL2 粒子，指针液态涡流交互，明暗双主题，带 Canvas2D 回退。

description.en: Daily news digest from 46 curated RSS sources, edited by the model already configured in dsh, delivered to your IM via webhook, and broadcast in the chat like a regular model reply with zero context cost.
description.zh: 每日要闻日报：46 个精选 RSS 源，用 dsh 里已配好的模型做主编式编辑，经 webhook 送到微信/Telegram，并以模型回答的样式插播在对话里，零上下文消耗。

description.en: Update copilot for DeepSeek Harness: one scan covers the DeepSeek Harness core and every profile plugin; explains what changed and how risky each update is, then updates only what you confirm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的更新助手：一次扫描覆盖 DeepSeek Harness 本体和每个 profile 的插件，说清改了什么、风险多大，只更新你确认过的那些。

description.en: Adds an extensible Functions menu to the DSH top bar, where plugins register one-click actions with staged confirmations and submenus. Since 0.4.0 it bundles a built-in "Restart DSH" action, so no separate restart plugin is needed.
description.zh: 给 DSH 顶端加一个可扩展的「功能」栏：插件注册的一键动作都在这里，支持分级确认与二级菜单。0.4.0 起自带了「重启 DSH」功能，不再需要单独安装重启插件。

description.en: Owner-facing AI studio for DeepSeek Harness: project roles, task acceptance, worktree-based agent runs, host verification, independent review, decision records, and human-triggered merges.
description.zh: 面向项目所有者的 DeepSeek Harness AI 工作室：角色、任务验收、worktree 代理执行、Host 验证、独立评审、决策记录和人工触发合并。

description.en: Plan-and-execute orchestration over ReactLoopAgent — turns a goal into reviewable steps with a web UI plan card.
description.zh: 基于 ReactLoopAgent 的 Plan-and-Execute 编排插件，将目标拆解为可审阅的步骤并以 Web UI 卡片呈现。

description.en: A gold switch beside the composer that raises every model request to the strongest reasoning effort the current model declares and to its default max output tokens, and adds a system-prompt section asking for exhaustive, self-checked work.
description.zh: 输入框旁一枚金色开关：把每次模型请求的推理强度提到当前模型声明的最高档、输出上限提到其 defaultMaxTokens，并在系统提示里追加一段要求穷尽检索、逐条自检的工作纪律。

description.en: A three-scope TODO board for DeepSeek Harness (user, workspace and session) with nested folders that can reference one item from several places, T0–T9 priorities, drag reordering, batch actions, a floating panel that also opens as a right-sidebar tab, Markdown preview windows that can stay open with autosaving title and body editing, and agent read/write tools, with every write gated by DSH approval.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的三区 TODO 便签（用户 / 工作区 / 会话）：支持嵌套文件夹与同一条目多处引用、T0~T9 优先级、拖动排序、批量操作、可浮动也可作为右侧栏页签打开的面板、可保留且自动保存标题与正文的 Markdown 预览，以及智能体读工具与每次写入都经 DSH 审批的写工具。

description.en: A file editor in the DSH web GUI right sidebar: open any text file, edit it, and save in place, with a version gate on every save — if the file changed on disk during the edit it stops and asks instead of overwriting. The document preview gains an edit button and a two-step delete button, and a separate File editor sidebar tool brings its own file tree for create, rename or move, copy, cut and paste (including a file taken from the system clipboard), delete and drag to reorganize. Two renderer bands cover 107 plain-text, config and source extensions; the second is offered only as an open-with choice, leaving the shipped Markdown and highlighted-code views as the default. All mutations run through the plugin's own trusted host routes, behind the connection trust fence, the workspace containment check and the sandbox policy.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 右侧栏的文件编辑器：打开任意文本文件即可编辑并原地保存，每次保存都带版本闸——编辑期间磁盘上的文件被改过就停下来问，不静默覆盖。文档预览多出「编辑」按钮和两步确认的「删除」按钮；另有一个「文件编辑」侧栏工具，自带文件树：新建、改名 / 移动、复制、剪切 / 粘贴（含把系统剪贴板里的文件粘进工作区）、删除、拖拽整理。两档文档渲染器共覆盖 107 个纯文本、配置与源码扩展名，其中第二档只作为「打开方式」出现，官方 Markdown 排版与代码高亮仍是默认视图。所有变更都走插件自己的 Host 路由，过连接信任围栏、工作区包含性检查与沙箱策略三道闸。

description.en: macOS computer-use tools backed by a plugin-owned Cua Driver runtime.
description.zh: 通过插件独立管理的 Cua Driver 运行时提供 macOS 电脑操作工具。

description.en: Version management for dsh: inspect the installed version against every npm channel or version line, install or downgrade in one click, stream the install log live (rollback-snapshot copy progress, npm extraction progress, elapsed time), roll back instantly from local snapshots, and automate the cycle with a policy engine (silent auto-update, execution windows, daily checks). Never stops npm mid-install — a wedged run is only stopped after an hour, and a half-committed global tree is detected and repaired from the pre-install snapshot automatically. Confirms before installing a found update, auto-restarts the host after install, and falls back to a mirror when the primary registry is unreachable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 版本管理：对照各 npm 通道或版本线查看已装版本，一键安装或降级，安装日志实时流出（回滚快照复制进度、npm 提取进度、已运行时长），从本地快照秒级回滚，用策略引擎（静默自动更新、执行时间窗、每日检查）托管整个流程。绝不在安装中途终止 npm——卡死的任务要等一小时才会停止，半提交的全局安装树会被自动检测并从安装前快照修复。检查到新版本时弹窗确认是否立即更新，安装后自动重启宿主，遇到 registry 不可达时自动回退到镜像。

description.en: Registers a QwenWork (千问办公) model provider that reuses the desktop client's local sign-in, runs a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge on 127.0.0.1, and translates DSH model requests into the ACP-style control-envelope conversation protocol the upstream actually speaks.
description.zh: 注册千问办公（QwenWork）模型提供器，复用桌面客户端的本机登录态，在 127.0.0.1 起一个 OpenAI 兼容回环桥，把 DSH 的模型请求翻译成上游真正使用的 ACP 控制信封对话协议。

description.en: DSH balance and quota card showing up to 3 recently used providers. Supports DeepSeek, Moonshot, Kimi For Coding, OpenAI Codex, and OpenCode Go, with auto-discovery, quota windows, reset times, color-coded status, dragging, and automatic refresh.
description.zh: DSH 余额与配额悬浮卡片：常驻显示最近使用的最多 3 个 provider，支持 DeepSeek、Moonshot、Kimi For Coding、OpenAI Codex 和 OpenCode Go；自动发现配置，展示配额窗口与重置时间，并支持分档着色、拖动和自动刷新。

description.en: A pannable conversation tree for DeepSeek Harness: inspect any turn in a side panel, return to its branch, and fork a new branch from any turn; continuous turns fold into a single node.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可平移会话树：在侧栏查看任意一轮、回到该分支，并从任意一轮分叉；连续轮次会折叠成一个节点。

description.en: Bridges the Cua Driver MCP server into DSH: installs the cua-driver executable when it is missing, starts it over stdio through the in-box MCP client, and registers its 60 accessibility-first window, input, menu, and browser tools with a bundled workflow skill and one-time macOS permission guidance.
description.zh: 把 Cua Driver 的 MCP 服务器接入 DSH：缺失时自动安装 cua-driver，经内置 MCP 客户端以 stdio 启动，注册其 60 个无障碍优先的窗口、输入、菜单与浏览器工具，并附带工作流技能与一次性的 macOS 权限引导。

description.en: Connects the Tabby serial MCP bridge and registers a tabby-serial skill: the agent can list, open, read and write the serial ports already open in Tabby, and the same terminal keeps accepting your keystrokes while it works. Requires the tabby-serial-mcp plugin inside Tabby.
description.zh: 接入 Tabby 串口 MCP 桥接服务并注册 tabby-serial 技能：agent 可以列出、新建、读写 Tabby 里已经打开的串口，同时你还能在同一个终端里继续敲键盘。需要在 Tabby 里安装 tabby-serial-mcp 插件。

description.en: Star-ranked radar for DSH plugins. A plugin is listed once it has 3,000+ GitHub stars or 100k+ npm downloads in 30 days; after its rank drops it stays listed for 180 days by default, so a plugin is still findable for months after a hot streak.
description.zh: 按 GitHub 收藏数排名的 DSH 插件热度榜：收藏 ≥ 3,000 或近 30 天下载 ≥ 10 万即收录， 排名下滑后仍保留 180 天（默认），热度过去几个月依然找得到。

description.en: GitHub Device Flow connect plus an in-conversation PR workflow: a status bar above the composer for create / AI-review / merge, and github_* tools for search, issue and PR read and write.
description.zh: GitHub Device Flow 授权与对话内 PR 工作流：输入框上方的状态条支持创建 / AI 审查 / 合并 PR，另有 github_* 工具用于搜索、Issue 与 PR 读写。

description.en: Laya typed decisions (`noul` yes/no, `choice`, `score`) as a first-class Cordis service (`ctx.laya`) plus the model-visible `laya_ask` and `laya_plan` tools. The plugin itself installs and downloads nothing: it is a client of a `laya-mcp serve` sidecar you start yourself, and it reports that the sidecar is not running instead of failing obscurely at the first tool call.
description.zh: 把 Laya 的有类型决策（`noul` 是/否、`choice`、`score`）接成一等 Cordis 服务（`ctx.laya`）与两个模型可见工具 `laya_ask`、`laya_plan`。插件自身不安装也不下载任何东西：它是你自己启动的 `laya-mcp serve` 边车的客户端，边车未运行时会明确报出，而不是在首次工具调用时隐晦失败。

description.en: Windows system-level notifications when the agent finishes a task or needs your input: task-done, question, approval and plan-review alerts via the browser Notification API, click-to-open the session, background-only mode, and a first-level settings page (Settings → 任务提示).
description.zh: 任务完成或需要你输入/批准时弹出 Windows 系统通知（浏览器 Notification API）：完成/提问/审批/计划审阅提醒，点击气泡直达会话，支持后台模式，设置页在官方设置 → 任务提示。

description.en: Ranks OpenRouter providers for the current DSH model by quantization, speed, cache-heavy price, context, and uptime, with one-click switching to help reduce token costs.
description.zh: 按量化、速度、缓存重度价格、上下文和可用率为当前 DSH 模型推荐 OpenRouter 供应商，并支持一键切换以帮助降低 token 成本。

description.en: Pushes DSH session events to phone IM and lets you reply straight under that message, injecting the text back into the right session. Covers nine event kinds: task completion, execution error, execution blocked, manual abort, token limit reached, abnormal interruption, waiting for your answer, permission request, and waiting for plan confirmation. Channels are QQ single-chat bots and Feishu custom apps, both over WebSocket long connections — no public IP, domain or tunneling needed. Several bots can be configured at once, each subscribing to the sessions it cares about. Approvals and questions arrive with tappable buttons, and replies route home through three layers (button, quoted reply, explicit short-id prefix), falling back to the most recent intervention-needed notification and echoing which session it went to.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话事件推到手机 IM，并允许在那条消息下直接回复回注到正确会话。覆盖九类事件：任务完成、执行错误、执行被阻塞、手动中止、Token 达到上限、异常中断、等待我回答、权限请求、等待计划确认；通道支持 QQ 单聊机器人与飞书自建应用，两者均走 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 IP、域名或内网穿透。可同时配置多台机器人，各自订阅自己关心的会话。审批与提问以可点按钮下发，回复按「按钮 → 引用回复 → 显式短 id 前缀」三层路由归位，兜底发给最近一条需人介入的通知并回显投递目标。

description.en: Data cleaning and data enrichment for CSV/XLSX/JSON enterprise lists in DeepSeek Harness, including spreadsheet cleaning, deduplication, profiling, optional Qichacha MCP and exports.
description.zh: 数据清洗补全智能体：面向 Excel/CSV/JSON 企业名单，提供数据清洗、表格清洗、清洗补全、去重、企业数据补全与字段补全，支持企查查 MCP 和结果导出。

description.en: UI design knowledge base: 99 filterable design cards with live demos, implementation prompts and per-design usage notes, plus an agent tool that finds and applies them.
description.zh: UI 设计知识库：99 项可筛选设计，带可交互 demo、实现提示词和适用/不适用场景，配套 agent 工具按场景检索并应用。

description.en: Meta's Muse Code CLI inside DSH: a composer switch starts muse serve, a right-sidebar panel and five chat tools (muse_open, muse_prompt, muse_read, muse_status, muse_interrupt) share one Muse session, approvals are decided only in the panel, and a local spend guard hard-stops at $10 by default. Windows only; needs the Muse Code CLI installed and signed in. The $10 cap is a local estimate for the muse serve this plugin starts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里使用 Meta 的 Muse Code CLI：输入框开关启动 muse serve，右侧边栏面板与五个聊天工具（muse_open、muse_prompt、muse_read、muse_status、muse_interrupt）共享同一个 Muse 会话，审批只能在面板里决定，本地花费护栏默认到 $10 硬停止。仅限 Windows；需已装好并登录 Muse Code CLI。$10 上限为本机估算，只管本插件启动的 muse serve。

description.en: Suiji (随记) is a local-first notebook plugin for DeepSeek Harness: quick capture, AI filing, diary, todos, sticky notes, and MCP access for AI sessions.
description.zh: 随记：DSH 本地笔记插件，随手记录、AI 自动归档、日记、待办、便笺，并支持 MCP 让 AI 会话直接读写。

description.en: Switches the tone of DSH replies from Settings → 人格模式 or the /persona command (/persona catgirl, /persona off), effective from the next turn. Only the active persona is injected, as runtime context, so the system prompt keeps a single stable short strategy; with the mode off the injected persona text is 0 characters. Facts, code and engineering discipline are unchanged.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 人格模式」或 /persona 命令（/persona catgirl、/persona off）里切换回复语气，下一轮对话生效。同一时刻只注入当前这一条（放在运行时上下文里，系统提示词只保留一条约 50 字的稳定策略），关闭时注入 0 字；只改语气，不改事实、代码与工程纪律。

description.en: A floating balance widget for the Web UI: live DeepSeek account balance with manual refresh and a Y/N-confirmed graceful exit.
description.zh: Web UI 右上角悬浮窗：实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，支持手动刷新与一键优雅退出（Y/N 快捷键确认）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness native SSH terminal and SFTP workspace with direct agent tools and security sandboxing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生 SSH 终端与 SFTP 远程工作区，支持 Agent 直连运维与三级安全沙盒。

description.en: Model usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: automatic per-call accounting from session logs with real timestamps, full history and live increments, showing tokens, cost, requests, trend and model composition with per-model, per-project and per-session views and editable tiered pricing.
description.zh: MIMO Quota Panel —— DeepSeek Harness 的模型额度面板。装上即用，零配置：从会话事件日志逐调用自动记账（真实时间戳、全历史、实时增量），一屏展示 Token 用量、消费金额、请求次数、趋势波形、模型构成，支持按模型 / 粒度 / 时间范围 / 项目·对话 统计切换。内置可编辑定价，DeepSeek 峰谷价按记录时间自动套算，小米全系牌价开箱即用。

description.en: A pill in the corner of every DSH page that walks a shift with you: it asks you to clock in when the shift starts, counts down quietly afterwards, tints the card with your reminder colour as the end approaches, then fills it, breathes and shakes when it is time to clock out, and stays on screen outside a shift naming when you are next on.
description.zh: 常驻 DSH 页面角落的班次胶囊：上班时间显示「打卡」提醒你打卡，打卡后安静倒计时，快下班时卡片染上你设的提醒色，到点整块填满并呼吸抖动提醒下班；班次之外也不消失，显示下一次上班时间。

description.en: Multi-platform research and deep search pipeline: harvest_scout for parallel discovery across GitHub, Web, Twitter, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, and YouTube, harvest_deep_research for automated comprehensive research reports, plus extract, cross-source verification, and credibility auditing.
description.zh: 多平台调研与深度搜索流水线：harvest_scout 并行发现（覆盖 GitHub、Web、推特、Reddit、小红书、B站、YouTube 等通道），harvest_deep_research 自动化长篇综合研报生成，外加穿透抓取、跨源交叉验证与五维来源可信度审计。

description.en: Layered cross-session memory for DSH that pushes only what changed - the first round injects every active entry, later rounds push only added / updated / removed ones, and nothing at all is injected when nothing changed, with keys that merely repeat an entry id left out of the text so the baseline is about 26% smaller. Facts and decisions carry semantic keys (one active truth per key), the model may only write to an inbox that a human promotes, an entry can carry a review date that raises a one-time reminder when due, and search is relevance-ranked with journal lines down-weighted and Chinese matched by bigram. A sidebar tab tells the lifecycle story instead of listing files - entries are grouped by stage (awaiting confirmation / in use / archived) along four axes (topic - one level, human-assigned, type, tag, date), each group can be ticked for batch promote / withdraw / archive / restore / delete / assign topic, and topics can be renamed store-wide or searched on their own. The archived stage reads in three levels - the category says why an entry left (distilled into the docs / useless for good / not needed right now, the first two being defaults you can add to), below it the entry topic stays collapsed until you click it, and entries with no topic sit right under the category. The tab also shows the global and workspace instruction files plus the current injection size. A zero-dependency CLI ships with it, so the store is usable without DSH.
description.zh: 分层跨会话记忆，只推变化的部分：首轮注入全部有效条目，之后只推新增 / 已更新 / 已失效，没有任何变化时一个字都不注入；与条目 id 重复的 key 不再写进正文，基线体积因此小约 26%。事实与决策带语义键（一个 key 只有一个有效结论），模型只能写收件箱、由人确认后才成为常驻事实；条目可以带复核时间，到期后提醒一次；检索按相关度排序、流水行被降权，中文按 bigram 匹配。侧边栏页签不再只是列文件，而是讲清流程：条目按「待你确认 / 已在用 / 已归档」分组，每个阶段都能按四个维度（主题——一级、由人归类，类型，标签，日期）查看；可逐条勾选做批量提升 / 撤回 / 归档 / 取回 / 删除 / 归类，主题可全库改名、也可只在该主题内搜索。「已归档」分三层：分类说明它为什么退场（已蒸馏 / 已废弃 / 暂时不用，前两个是默认分类，也能自己新建一个），分类下面是主题行、点开才列出条目，没写主题的条目直接列在分类下。页签同时显示全局与工作区规范文件以及当前注入体积。附带零依赖 CLI，不装 DSH 也能用这套记忆库。

description.en: Let the agent restart its own DSH host: schedule a self-restart, finish the turn first, then a detached helper stops and relaunches the app and reports what happened. Dry-run, a status check, and an optional "when can I blink" confirmation are built in.
description.zh: 让 agent 自己安排宿主重启：工具立刻返回，等这一轮回复送达、会话日志落盘安静后再停+拉，并留下报告；自带 dry-run、体检与「什么时候可以眨一下眼」的确认。

description.en: Shrinks the first history page of long DSH sessions to at most 100 messages, targeting the latest two turns, and fills the viewport in the background with the built-in load-earlier control when the trimmed transcript is shorter than the window.
description.zh: 把长会话首次打开时的历史页缩小到默认最多 100 条消息、尽量保留最新 2 个 turn；缩小的记录短于视口时，Web 端在后台调用内置「加载更早」把视口补齐。

description.en: Material library for dsh: collect a folder, file or note from a conversation, keep it in real folders with tags, browse it Finder-style, reopen the source chat's output in one click. Ships a materials_archive tool plus auto-filing rules: file a task's deliverable once, and every later scheduled run files the new documents by itself.
description.zh: dsh 材料库：把对话里产出的目录、文件或笔记收进真实文件夹并打标签，按 Finder 方式浏览，点一下跳回原始会话。内置 materials_archive 工具与自动归档规则：手动收过一次某任务的成品，之后每次定时任务跑完都会自动把新成品收进同一个文件夹。

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills — brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, subagent-driven development, test-driven development, systematic debugging, parallel agent dispatch, git worktrees, code review, verification before completion and skill authoring — served through the DSH skills registry with their scripts, references and cross-links intact (frontmatter folded into a manifest, prefixes realigned to DSH skill names). Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): the /superpowers slash command declares the producer-owned source kind plugin:dsh-plugin-superpowers.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能——头脑风暴、写计划、计划执行、subagent 驱动开发、TDD、系统化调试、并行派发、git worktree、代码评审、完成前验证、技能编写——经 DSH 技能注册表提供，脚本、参考资料与交叉引用原样保留（frontmatter 收进 manifest、前缀对齐 DSH 技能名）。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：/superpowers 斜杠命令使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:dsh-plugin-superpowers。

description.en: Sets token, cost and wall-clock caps on a DSH goal and blocks that goal when a cap is reached, instead of only reporting the spend. The figures come from the usage events DSH records for the session, priced per model, with a pill beside the composer that opens a per-model breakdown. The official DeepSeek tariff is built in, with peak/off-peak pricing toggleable because it depends on the route; other models are priced from configured rates, and a model with no rate has its tokens counted and its name listed rather than being guessed at.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 goal 设 token、费用与计算时长上限，达到上限即阻断该 goal，而不只是报告花费。数字取自 DSH 为该会话记录的用量事件并按模型计价；输入框旁的 pill 点开是按模型分列的明细。内置 DeepSeek 官方价目，峰谷计价可关闭（它取决于线路）；其他模型用配置的单价，没有单价的模型只计 token 并列出名字，不猜价格。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 启动成功后运行用户自定义命令的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。

description.en: Adds handoff, context-decision and context-diagnose skills, self-contained context_pressure/context_history tools (peak tokens, compaction stats), per-route realWindows with windowSource evidence, routeKey, handoffAt forced-handoff line, and slash commands.
description.zh: 新增交接、上下文决策、上下文诊断三个技能，自带 context_pressure/context_history 工具（峰值 token、压缩复盘），支持按线路实测窗口 realWindows（含 windowSource 证据）、routeKey 直出与 handoffAt 强制交接线，附斜杠命令。

description.en: Manages game automation scripts from dsh on Windows. Installs and updates scripts such as MAA, runs them in scheduled pipelines, watches their logs and hands failures and stalls to an agent, and tracks game events.
description.zh: 在 dsh 里管理游戏自动化脚本（仅 Windows）：安装和更新 MAA 等脚本，按定时流水线运行，监看日志并把出错和卡住交给 agent 处理，还会记录游戏活动。

description.en: One credential store for many API platforms: keeps keys for GitHub, Cloudflare, Vercel, npm, Docker Hub, Hugging Face and custom platforms in the DSH credential store rather than in configuration or the session log, and gives the model three tools. apikey_call takes a path rather than a URL, so a key only reaches the host its platform fixes; apikey_platforms lists platforms and accounts without values; apikey_key gets, sets or clears one. Supports five auth shapes (bearer, custom header, x-api-key, basic, query string), verifies a key against the identity the platform returns, and reports transport failures as readable results instead of ending the turn. By default (exposeKeys on) the apikey_key tool can return a stored key's value to the model, which puts it in the session log; turn exposeKeys off to keep keys inside the Host.
description.zh: 统一管理多个平台 API Key 的凭据库：把 GitHub、Cloudflare、Vercel、npm、Docker Hub、Hugging Face 与自定义平台的 Key 存进 DSH 凭据库（而非配置文件或会话日志），并向模型提供三个工具。apikey_call 的参数是路径而非 URL，Key 只可能发往该平台固定的主机；apikey_platforms 列出平台与账号但不返回值；apikey_key 读取、写入或清除单个 Key。支持五种认证方式（Bearer、自定义头、x-api-key、Basic、查询串），会用平台返回的身份校验 Key，网络故障返回可读结果而不是中断对话。默认（exposeKeys 开启）时 apikey_key 工具可以把已存的密钥值返回给模型，从而进入会话日志；把 exposeKeys 关掉才能让密钥只留在宿主内。

description.en: Persistent local token-usage accounting for DSH Web with automatic history discovery and compact provider/model details.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供自动发现历史记录的本地持久化 Token 用量统计与紧凑的供应商/模型明细。

description.en: Describe the persona you want and the agent writes it: nickname, bio, taglines and links come from the host model, the avatar comes from your local asset library (or a path you give), then it fills your profile page and hands the picture to the site's own uploader. Dry-run by default - it only touches profile fields, never passwords or security settings.
description.zh: 你说想要什么样的人设，它把文案写出来并把资料页填好：昵称/简介/标语/链接由宿主模型生成，头像取本地素材库（或你给的路径），再由站点自己的上传控件完成头像入库。**默认 dry-run**，只写资料字段 —— 不碰密码、邮箱、安全设置。

description.en: Development tooling for Minecraft 26.3 mods: starts a real dedicated server and a real client from JSON instance registrations, drives both through an authenticated HTTP probe, and asserts on world, UI and log state across Fabric, Forge and NeoForge, writing per-run evidence and shipping no game or loader files. Requires JDK 25 and a Minecraft 26.3 instance.
description.zh: Minecraft 26.3 mod 开发工具：按 JSON 实例登记启动真实的专用服与客户端，通过带鉴权的 HTTP 探针驱动两端，并对世界、UI 与日志状态做断言，覆盖 Fabric / Forge / NeoForge；每轮运行留下取证目录，且不随包分发任何游戏或加载器文件。需 JDK 25 与 Minecraft 26.3 实例。

description.en: Draws every branch of a conversation as a clickable tree beside the chat, with favorites, custom icons and colors, branch merge and split, rewind-aware layout, and Claude Code branches that keep their memory.
description.zh: 把一个对话的所有分支画成聊天区旁边的一棵可点击的树，支持收藏、自定义图标与颜色、分支合并与拆分、撤回感知的布局，以及带记忆的 Claude Code 分支。

description.en: MemWeave (dsh-mem-weave) weaves memory into persona: layered memory and a persona editor in one DeepSeek Harness plugin, with a bounded per-turn injection budget, decay and consolidation, a candidate and conflict review queue, 24-hour undo, and calendar reminders, all stored in a local SQLite file.
description.zh: 忆织 MemWeave（dsh-mem-weave）—— 把记忆编织进人格（记忆 × 人格一体 DSH 插件）：分层记忆与人格编辑，每轮注入有固定上限，记忆按层遗忘与整理，候选与冲突需人工确认，写入可在 24 小时内撤销，另有约定与纪念日提醒，全部数据存在本机 SQLite 文件里。

description.en: Host-side guard that lets the write tool only create new files: when the target already exists it denies the call before execution and tells the model to use edit instead, applied to all sessions.
description.zh: 纯 host 端守卫，让 write 工具只允许创建新文件：目标已存在时在执行前直接拒绝并提示改用 edit，全局所有会话生效。

description.en: Cites one specific message from another conversation: the @ menu inserts a chip, and at send time the quoted text is injected as untrusted background; a conversation_history tool also lets the model search and read other sessions of the same workspace. The @ menu searches the indexed sessions of every workspace (only the model tool is limited to the current one), and its HTTP routes (/dsh-message-cite/api/…) are guarded only by a marker header, not by a DSH access check.
description.zh: 引用另一段对话里的某一条具体消息：在输入框 @ 菜单里选中后插入 chip，发送时把原文作为不可信背景注入本轮；另有一个 conversation_history 工具，让模型自己搜索并读取本工作区内的其他对话。@ 菜单会搜索所有工作区里已建索引的会话（只有给模型用的工具限定在当前工作区）；插件的 HTTP 路由（/dsh-message-cite/api/…）只靠一个标记头把关，没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Render any Markdown report or DSH session excerpt into shareable PNG images with no npm dependencies, driving the Chromium-family browser already on the machine and falling back to PDF, then HTML. Reports come out as a summary card plus a full verbatim long image; a report written for dsh-fact-check also gets the tier badge, the two rails and the per-claim tiering, all taken from the report itself, and a report following one of the other report skeletons it defines gets the section that skeleton designates as its conclusion lifted onto the summary card. Conversations come out as a message flow, exportable by turn range, event range or the most recent N turns.
description.zh: 把任意 Markdown 报告或 DSH 会话片段渲染成可分享的 PNG 图片，零 npm 依赖：复用本机已有的 Chromium 系浏览器，不可用时退回 PDF、再退回 HTML。报告输出短图（结论）加长图（完整原文）；dsh-fact-check 的报告额外带档位徽标、甲乙双轨与逐条断言分档（都取自报告本身），其余几种报告骨架则把该骨架自己指定的结论段抬到短图上。对话输出消息流长图，可按轮次、事件序号或最近 N 轮选定范围。

description.en: Local Markdown user and project memory for DSH: pinned preferences, keyword search, soft invalidation, history and archive, and JSON migration with preview, backup and rollback.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地 Markdown 用户与项目记忆：置顶偏好、关键词检索、软失效、历史归档，以及带预览、备份与回滚的 JSON 迁移。

description.en: Cross-device workspace backup, restore, and ecosystem update via the uagent-sync CLI.
description.zh: 工作区跨设备备份、恢复与扩展更新，经 uagent-sync CLI 桥接执行。

description.en: Fail-fast tool batches for DeepSeek Harness: inside a step, concurrency-safe calls still overlap, but after the first failed call every remaining unstarted call is denied before dispatch and returned to the model as a synthesized `is_error` "not executed" result.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的工具批次增加“失败即停”（fail-fast）机制：同一并行组内的只读调用仍可并发，一旦有调用失败，所有尚未开始的调用都会在派发前被拦截，并以合成的 is_error「未执行」结果返回给模型。

description.en: Audible feedback for the DSH web interface: button presses are classified by semantics (normal, primary, toggle, send, close, danger, link) and the current session's task transitions (started, finished, failed) plus any pending interaction play a cue, each scenario with its own cue picker and switch on a settings page. All 78 cues and 12 sound packs are synthesised in the browser with the Web Audio API, so the package ships no audio files and makes no network request. A community port of dsh-plugin-uisfx to DSH 0.2.0, with the ported changes recorded in PROVENANCE.md.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面补上可听的语义反馈：按钮按下按语义分类发声（普通、主要、开关、发送、关闭、危险、链接），当前会话的任务开始、成功结束、失败结束以及出现待处理交互也各有一声，每个情景都能在设置页单独挑音效、单独开关。78 个 cue 与 12 个音色包全部由浏览器用 Web Audio API 实时合成，因此包里不含音频文件、也不发起网络请求。这是 dsh-plugin-uisfx 向 DSH 0.2.0 的社区移植版，改动逐条记录在 PROVENANCE.md。

description.en: Model pricing for the DSH settings page: ~7,250 models / 213 providers with the harness catalog overlaid, honest lowest-listed comparison, session costs priced by the actual route, cache-leak attribution, and a verified promotion feed.
description.zh: DSH 设置页中的模型价格表：约 7,250 个模型 / 213 个提供商（叠加本地路由目录），诚实的最低标价比较、按实际路由计价的会话成本、缓存泄漏归因，以及经验证的促销信息源。

description.en: Content-degradation detection (thinking loops, output repetition) for DeepSeek Harness, with a continue-vs-handoff cost verdict and zero-model handoff documents.
description.zh: 内容退化检测（思考打转、输出复读）+ 继续/交接成本裁决 + 零模型交接文档。

description.en: System-prompt surface drift gate: every section any plugin or preset contributes to the assembled system prompt is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of what the model is told fails loud.
description.zh: 系统提示词面漂移门：任何插件或预设注入组装提示词的段落均哈希基线化，对模型被告知内容的静默改写将响亮报错。

description.en: Appearance suite for DeepSeek Harness: deep-space starfield background, Cyberpunk 2077 HUD theme, startup authentication sequence, and a sidebar toggle for borderless windows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观套件：深空动态天体背景、赛博朋克 2077 HUD 主题、开机认证序列，以及无边框窗口下的侧栏折叠按钮。

description.en: System guard for DeepSeek Harness (Windows-first, protected actions via UAC/sudo): classifies core system files and runtime junk, keeps a hidden SHA-256 backup of core files on the largest free disk, patrols integrity and restores damaged files, and asks for administrator rights only to protect the system. On macOS/Linux it only classifies and hashes (no junk deletion; repair prints manual steps), and that path has not been tested on real hardware.
description.zh: 系统守护（以 Windows 为主，保护类操作走 UAC/sudo）：分析并分类系统核心文件与运行时垃圾，把核心文件隐藏备份到剩余空间最大的硬盘、定期巡查完整性并从备份修复损坏文件；守护权限只用于保护系统。macOS/Linux 上只做分类与哈希（不删垃圾，修复仅给出人工步骤），且该路径未在真机验证。

description.en: Antigravity provider for DeepSeek Harness: resolves the OAuth client from the locally installed official desktop app and supports multiple accounts with quota-based automatic switching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Antigravity 模型供應商：從本機安裝的官方桌面應用程式解析 OAuth client，支援多帳號管理與額度自動切換。

description.en: Conversation Canvas tab: live-preview workspace HTML artifacts and export PNG/JPG/SVG locally (`npx dsh-canvas-preview`).
description.zh: Conversation Canvas 标签页：实时预览工作区内的 HTML artifact，并支持本地导出 PNG/JPG/SVG（`npx dsh-canvas-preview`）。

description.en: File-based CSS overrides for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — edit ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css and reload to restyle any plugin's elements, for example making the quote bar fully opaque.
description.zh: 基于本地 CSS 文件的界面覆盖——编辑 ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css 并刷新，即可改任意插件元素的外观，例如让引用浮层完全不透明。

description.en: PDF outline navigation and local reading bookmarks in the existing right-sidebar file preview; supports adding, renaming, deleting and revisiting page positions, with version and integrity guards. Verified on macOS Apple Silicon with dsh Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: 在现有右侧文件预览中提供 PDF 内嵌目录导航与本地阅读书签，可添加、改名、删除和跳回页内位置，并有版本与完整性保护。已验证 macOS Apple Silicon 上的 dsh Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: One leader, many sessions: tell the leader the goal and it splits the work into cards, runs persistent worker sessions in the background, collects their reports, and keeps the facts on a per-project board in the right sidebar, so several features move in parallel instead of one at a time. Project-level LEADER.md and SLOTS.md prompts shape every request, and `read_worker_session` replays a worker transcript read-only without waking it.
description.zh: 一个 leader 管多个 session：把目标告诉 leader，它拆成卡片、在后台跑常驻 worker 会话、收齐各自回报，任务事实落在右侧栏的按项目看板——几个 feature 并行推进，而不是逐个陪跑。项目级 LEADER.md 与 SLOTS.md 塑造每次请求的行为，`read_worker_session` 只读回放 worker 的会话过程、不唤醒它。

description.en: Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with `(sessionId, seq)` citations, deterministic recall plus session-query FTS over past sessions — no external server, no custom SQLite.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 原生接缝的按工作区记忆：事实与有界常驻档案落在 storage-domain 的 JSON 单元上，写入经人工审批并带 `(sessionId, seq)` 引证，确定性召回 + session-query 全文检索历史会话——无外部服务器、无自建 SQLite。

description.en: Renders a conversation's context as a layered architecture map of goals, decisions, actions, artifacts, risks and open questions, exported as SVG, interactive HTML and Mermaid Markdown.
description.zh: 把对话上下文分层渲染成信息架构图：目标、决策、动作、产物、风险与待确认一次成图，可导出 SVG、交互式 HTML 与 Mermaid Markdown。

description.en: Manage skins, themes, backgrounds, and widgets in separate layers and save appearance presets for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 分层管理皮肤、主题、背景与装饰件，并保存和应用整套外观方案。

description.en: Deterministic network egress gate: web fetches and searches are checked against a destination allowlist in tools/pre-execute and denied before they run; shell fetch-verbs are observed (enforcement opt-in).
description.zh: 确定性网络出口门：网页抓取与搜索在 tools/pre-execute 按目的地白名单校验，越权即拒；shell 抓取动词默认观察，可选拦截。

description.en: Monitors IEEE Xplore journal Early Access through Crossref, has an LLM screen every new paper against your keywords, and emails a Markdown weekly digest.
description.zh: 按关键词盯 IEEE 期刊 Early Access：Crossref 抓新收录，逐篇交给大模型研判，生成 Markdown 周报并发到邮箱。

description.en: Use a ChatGPT/Codex subscription in DeepSeek Harness with GPT models, image generation, web search, subscription quota reporting, model and feature controls, and browser or device-code OAuth sign-in.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入 GPT 模型、图像生成与 Web 搜索，并支持订阅额度显示、模型与功能控制，以及浏览器或设备码 OAuth 登录。

description.en: Trip planning workspace for DeepSeek Harness: a map page with day-by-day stops, roam_* tools that draft, review and adopt an itinerary, and optional MCP sidecars for rail tickets and Xiaohongshu notes.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的行程工作台：地图页按天展示站点，roam_* 工具负责起草、审阅与采用行程，可选接入火车票和小红书笔记的 MCP 数据源。

description.en: Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume, configurable in the Web UI (built-in synth, mute, or local audio file).
description.zh: 六类事件独立提示音：回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败各有独立声音与音量，可在 Web 设置面板配置（内置合成音 / 静音 / 本地音频文件）。

description.en: Qoder supplier plugin for dsh-router, covering both the CN and international regions. Uses a personal access token for authentication, signs requests to the Qoder cosy gateway and converts upstream SSE to OpenAI SSE; the model list reports the upstream display name alongside the key, while account selection and cooldown stay in dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 Qoder 供应商插件，同时覆盖国内版与国际版。以个人访问令牌认证、对 Qoder 的 cosy 网关签名请求，并把上游 SSE 转成 OpenAI SSE；模型列表同时上报上游显示名与 key，选号与冷却仍由 dsh-router 核心处理。

description.en: Local-first task workbench for DeepSeek Harness with today, week and all-task views, single-day and multi-day tasks with optional times, a four-state idea pool, and daily/weekly/monthly reviews that only a human can write.
description.zh: 本地优先的任务工作台：今日/本周/任务总表、当天与跨周期任务（可选时间）、四态想法池，以及日/周/月复盘；复盘正文只能人写，AI 只读。

description.en: Kite-flying engine: while the agent codes, an animated kite drifts and sways in the wind on screen, tethered to the bottom edge of the window — the busier the agent, the denser the events and the higher it flies; ships a Weifang-style framework card deck (sand-swallow, goldfish, butterfly, bagua, dragon-head and more, hard-wing / soft-wing / flat / dimensional frames), with shape x pattern x colors all swappable data configs, and supports pasting user images onto the kite face with real-time affine transforms as the kite banks.
description.zh: 放风筝引擎：agent 编程时屏幕上放一只动画风筝——token 越多事件越密风筝飞得越高，随风漂移摆动，一根线牵在窗口底边；潍坊系框架卡组（沙燕/金鱼/蝴蝶/八卦/龙头等，硬翅软翅板式立体），形状×图案×配色全是可替换数据配置，支持把用户上传的图片糊上风筝面，贴图随风筝侧正斜的姿态实时仿射变换。

description.en: Two-way bridge between GNU Emacs and a running DeepSeek Harness session over loopback HTTP + SSE: submit prompts, stream replies, manage sessions and workspaces, and answer ask-user/approval prompts from Emacs, with a Plugins-page card that installs the Emacs package.
description.zh: GNU Emacs 与正在运行的 DSH 会话之间的双向桥：走本机回环 HTTP + SSE，可在 Emacs 里提交提示、流式收回复、管理会话与工作区、回答 ask-user / 审批提示；插件页还有一张卡片用来安装 Emacs 那边的包。

description.en: Browse, preview and install public Agent Skills from inside the DSH web GUI, aggregating five sources (claudeskills.info, skillsmp.com, the awesome-claude-skills repository list, the official anthropics/skills repo, and skill packs shipped by installed DSH plugins). Skills install pinned to a commit rather than a branch name, so what you previewed is what lands; the panel reports provenance, whole-tree update checks and a trash instead of deleting. Before writing anything it validates the skill name and frontmatter against the rules the harness silently enforces, lists files that SKILL.md references but the fetch did not bring, flags partial fetches, and offers overwrite, rename or skip when a name is taken.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 里浏览、预览并安装公开的 Agent Skills，聚合五个来源（claudeskills.info、skillsmp.com、awesome-claude-skills 仓库坐标表、Anthropic 官方仓库、已装 DSH 插件自带的技能包）。安装按 commit 而不是分支名钉住，预览到的就是落地的；面板给出每个技能的来路、按整棵树比对的更新检查，删除是移进回收站而不是抹掉。落地之前先按 harness 实际执行的规则体检技能名与 frontmatter（名字不合法会被 harness 静默跳过），列出 SKILL.md 引用但没取回的文件，标出只取到一部分的情况，同名时给出覆盖、改名、跳过三个选项。

description.en: Pasted screenshots become numbered references: each Ctrl+V image is stored in the attachment library under a stable number, listed in a composer-dock thumbnail panel with an image source in the @ menu, and inserted as a reference chip at the caret — automatically after paste when the auto-insert switch is on.
description.zh: 粘贴即编号引用：Ctrl+V 的截图入库后拿到固定编号「图片N」，在输入框旁面板里以缩略图列出，可经 @图片 菜单插入引用；开着「自动插入」时粘贴后直接落到光标处。

description.en: Service farm for DSH: register, start, stop and restart long-running project services, with agent tools (farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register), farm.yaml declarations and an overview drawer UI with live log follow, search and export.
description.zh: DSH 服务农场：注册、启动、停止、重启长驻项目服务，提供 agent 工具（farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register）与 farm.yaml 声明式服务，总览抽屉支持按工作区分组、实时日志 follow、搜索与导出。

description.en: Rich Markdown notebook for the composer region: a tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing, submitted through the conversation service.
description.zh: 为输入区提供富 Markdown 笔记本：工具行开关加 CodeMirror 编辑卡片，支持 Codex 风格列表编辑，经会话服务提交。

description.en: Scoped persistent memory for DSH: memory_save/search/replace/remove/list across global, user, project and failure scopes, DSH storage-domain persistence with secret and prompt-injection scanning, session-scope search, retention cleanup, and optional session-start injection; standing context via memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin.
description.zh: DSH 有界持久记忆：memory_save/search/replace/remove/list 覆盖全局、用户、项目、失败四类范围，基于 DSH storage-domain 持久化，写入前做密钥与提示注入扫描，支持会话范围检索、保留期清理与可选的会话开始注入；常驻上下文用 memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin 管理。

description.en: Security scanner for DSH plugins: static and semantic passes over plugin source, DSH-specific attack-surface rules, npm audit, batch scanning, and an HTML report with per-finding severity and evidence.
description.zh: DSH 插件安全扫描器：对插件源码做静态与语义双通道检查，内置 DSH 特有攻击面规则，集成 npm audit，支持批量扫描，输出带严重等级与证据的 HTML 报告。

description.en: Context window auto-management for DeepSeek Harness: when the window fills up it rolls over to a fresh one with zero summarization model calls, archiving the old window verbatim for line-by-line recall; handoff anchors carry task orientation, working notes survive compaction, and a stale-notes gate warns instead of vouching for outdated notes. The trigger follows the provider budget equation (window - max_tokens) and the real routed model even after a mid-session switch. One-click composer button plus /smart-compact, three-band automatic rollover, mandatory anchor sanitization; works out of the box.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的上下文窗口自动管理：窗口快满时零模型调用换窗，旧对话整窗无损归档、可逐字回查；交接锚点带任务定向，工作笔记跨压缩存活，笔记滞后自动 STALE 警示；触发线按（窗口 − max_tokens）预算方程计算，中途切模型也按真实路由测量；一键换窗按钮与 /smart-compact 命令，三带自动换窗，锚点强制脱敏，开箱即用零配置。

description.en: Selectable SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Gemini Search Grounding, or Wikipedia backend for the native web_search tool, with Web settings and no implicit fallback.
description.zh: 为原生 web_search 工具提供可选的 SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Gemini 搜索溯源或 Wikipedia 后端，支持 Web 设置且不进行隐式回退。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the DeepSeek API account balance and OpenCode Go plan usage (consumption ring, hover details) in the sidebar footer, with adaptive polling and zh/en locale support.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件:在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek API 余额与 OpenCode Go 套餐用量(消耗圆环、悬浮详情),自适应轮询,支持中英文。

description.en: Client theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: a fluid background, frosted glass panels and quantised shader effects, with 100 adjustable parameters persisted to a JSON file.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 客户端主题插件：流体背景、毛玻璃面板与量子化着色器效果，100 项参数可调并持久化到 JSON 文件。

description.en: Local-first resume warehouse for DeepSeek Harness: package your work into reusable bullets, import an existing resume into a template, analyse a job description (including the school-tier preference it implies), assemble a tailored Chinese or English resume and export a PDF named position-name-school. The whole app ships inside the npm package — server/, web/, skills/, scripts/, requirements.txt, no git clone needed — and one tool starts, stops and health-checks it; the first start installs the dependencies into app/.venv. Needs Python 3.10+ and macOS or Linux (bash). Nothing leaves the machine except the LLM calls you confirm.
description.zh: 本地优先的简历仓库：把经历打包成可复用的表述、把现有简历拆成模板、分析岗位 JD（含其隐含的院校层次偏好）、组装中英双语定制简历并导出「岗位-姓名-学校」命名的 PDF。应用本体随 npm 包发布（server/、web/、skills/、scripts/、requirements.txt，无需 clone 仓库），自带工具负责启动/停止并读取健康状态，首次启动会把依赖装进 app/.venv；需要 Python 3.10+ 与 macOS / Linux（bash）。除你确认过的 LLM 调用外数据不出本机。

description.en: Add an optional rejection reason to approval prompts: the text is steered into the running turn before the rejection is answered, and the panel only follows the session you are currently viewing.
description.zh: 在审批卡上增加可选的拒绝理由：理由会先作为 steering 消息进入当前轮，再把审批答成拒绝；浮层只跟随你正在查看的会话。

description.en: A fifth DeepSeek Harness work mode that requires a falsification design (at least two pieces of evidence that could disprove the plan) in every plan and tags each factual claim with its source (\[文件]/\[检索]/\[记忆]) or \[未知]; evidence grading follows the project's AGENTS.md.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 增加第五个工作模式：每个计划必须含「证伪设计」（至少两条能推翻方案的证据），每条事实须标来源（\[文件]/\[检索]/\[记忆]）或 \[未知]；取证分级按项目 AGENTS.md 执行。

description.en: Draggable transparent balance card with a blood-bar of remaining balance vs month-opening, today/month spend (official when the platform token is configured), and session cost.
description.zh: 可拖动透明余额卡片：余额/月初额度血条、今日/本月用量（配置平台 token 后为官方精确数据）、当前对话费用。

description.en: Coding-learn floating panel: edits and runs Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell with exit code and timing, grades JSON course lessons with progress export, keeps Markdown notes and snippet library, and sends code plus a question into the current conversation for the main model to answer.
description.zh: 编程学习悬浮面板：编辑并运行 Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell（含退出码与耗时），JSON 课程包关卡自动评判并可导出进度，提供 Markdown 笔记与代码片段库；代码分析以用户消息直投当前对话，由对话主模型直接输出。

description.en: Import local Codex CLI/Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Desktop conversations into DSH with project grouping, semantic history, and tool activity; bind an existing or replacement workspace and continue with the DSH Agent.
description.zh: 将本地 Codex CLI/Desktop、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop 会话导入 DSH：按项目分组，保留语义历史和工具活动，可绑定原工作区或新工作区，并由 DSH Agent 继续对话。

description.en: Scroll-painting message rail for DeepSeek Harness: a slim right-edge rail with one indicator per user message, scroll-spy follows the reading position, hover unfolds a canvas with full message previews, and clicking jumps to any history message; animates in sync with better-sidebar panels.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 画卷式消息导航栏：会话面板右侧一条竖排导轨，每条用户消息一个指示点，scroll-spy 跟随阅读位置，hover 展开画卷查看完整消息预览，点击跳转任意历史消息；与 better-sidebar 面板动画同步避让。

description.en: MCP manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: a Settings page beside Plugins that lists the MCP servers the running loader tree actually holds, each with its config summary, endpoint and live state, and disables or restores any of them through a paired-marker block in the profile's cordis.patch.yml. Env values, header values and `!!js` sources reach the page only as key names or dot-paths.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 极简管理：与「插件」同级的一页设置，列出运行中 Loader 树里真实存在的 MCP 服务器及其配置摘要、端点与实时状态，并通过 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 成对标记块停用或恢复任一服务器；环境变量值、请求头值与 `!!js` 表达式只以键名或点路径的形式到达页面。

description.en: Drag folders into the DeepSeek Harness web composer instead of hitting 'only the desktop app supports folders'. Adds a host folder dialog, /folder, and drag/paste into @path mentions. Plain browser, no desktop app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页版直接拖文件夹进输入框，不再提示「只有桌面端支持添加文件夹」。新增主机文件夹选择框、/folder 命令，拖入/粘贴自动解析为 @路径 引用。纯浏览器可用，无需桌面端。

description.en: Evidence-based research workspaces with archived sources, knowledge graphs, exact citations and exportable reports. Experimental alpha. Needs Node 24.9 or later, uv and Python 3.13, plus a one-time setup step (setup-engine.mjs) that copies the engine and runs a locked uv sync; pnpm must also be allowed to run the build scripts of onnxruntime-node and protobufjs.
description.zh: 提供原始资料归档、知识图谱、精确引文和可导出报告的循证研究工作区。处于 alpha 阶段。需要 Node 24.9 及以上、uv 和 Python 3.13，另有一步必须执行的安装脚本（setup-engine.mjs，复制引擎并按锁文件执行 uv sync）；pnpm 还需允许 onnxruntime-node 与 protobufjs 运行构建脚本。

description.en: One-handed, keyboard-free input for the composer: press and hold the mouse on the input box, speak, release — the text lands in the draft, and sliding up cancels without leaving a half sentence behind. No mic button to aim at and no shortcut to remember; the hand never has to leave the input area, which is the point when the other hand is busy. Recognition runs fully offline (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx, no API key, audio never leaves the machine).
description.zh: 输入框上的单手、免键盘输入：鼠标在输入框按住、说话、松手，文字直接进草稿；上滑取消，不留半句。不用去瞄麦克风按钮，也不用记快捷键，手始终不用离开输入区——另一只手正忙的时候，这一点才是关键。识别完全在本机完成（SenseVoice + sherpa-onnx），无需 API key，音频不出本机。

description.en: Adds a Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) language to the web GUI, registered through the locale service with one dictionary per namespace and selectable in Settings, General, Language.
description.zh: 為網頁介面加入繁體中文（zh-Hant）語言，經語言服務註冊，每個 namespace 各有一份字典，並可在「設定 → 一般 → 語言」揀選。

description.en: Project-based learning coach: a subject-agnostic teaching engine plus swappable domain packs (Unity/C# included), shipped both as a DSH skill and as an installable bundle. The skill protocol enforces attempt-first teaching and graded hints; a zero-dependency validator rejects ability claims their evidence does not support and blocks stage acceptance while blockers are open.
description.zh: 项目制教学教练：学科无关的教学引擎 + 可替换领域包（随包提供 Unity/C#），同时以 DSH 技能与可安装组合包分发。技能协议强制"先做后教"与分级提示；零依赖校验器会拒绝证据不支撑的能力结论，并在存在未解决阻塞项时阻止阶段通过。

description.en: Read-only Skill inspector for DeepSeek Harness. It shows which Skills a conversation actually loaded — from observed loading evidence only — and which Skills the current environment can discover, and gives each Skill a detail page whose left column switches between the framework, the evidence, validation, evaluation, step evidence, run logic, the before/after of a modification when there is one, the definition facts and the raw SKILL.md. Declaration and run stay apart: the body is split into structure, declared workflow and progressive disclosure, the run logic is read from local receipts, and every declared step carries its own evidence — no observed evidence is reported as exactly that, not as executed or not executed, and the run's instruction hash sits beside the current definition as match, mismatch or unavailable. The evidence view gives each subject one of three states (declared, observed, unavailable), walks definition → load → use → outcome, names what each stage cannot reach, declines to attribute an outcome to the Skill, and can copy the snapshot out as byte-stable JSON. Validation checks the Agent Skills open standard and the platform profiles separately, each finding on a rule id and labelled standard compliance or platform compatibility. Evaluation keeps repeatable cases with the conditions each run was recorded under and the four stages of runtime evidence, comparing two runs of one case item by item without scoring them. The trigger boundary keeps should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts, has you run them in a real new session, then records what was observed — whether a load record appeared and whether it was model-invoked or user-explicit; a typed /name is not a natural trigger, and an absent load record is reported as not observed, not as not triggered. The same projections are exposed to the agent as a read-only skill_review tool, which returns a structured review packet and says what it omitted when the packet will not fit whole. The inspector, the evidence chain and these reviews are computed on this machine from the definition and the session receipts; the Chinese reading version sends the body through the host's model when you ask for it, keeping code fences, paths and frontmatter verbatim and storing the result on this machine. A Skill can also be cloned into a local copy. It does not write back to the source Skill and does not run its scripts.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的只读 Skill 检视器。它显示一次对话实际加载过哪些 Skill（只凭观测到的加载证据）、当前环境又能发现哪些 Skill，并为每个 Skill 提供一页详情：左列在框架、证据、验收、评测、步骤证据、本次运行逻辑、有修改事务时的本次修改前后对比、定义事实与 `SKILL.md` 原文之间切换。声明与运行始终分开：正文按结构、声明流程与渐进披露拆开，运行逻辑只从本机收据读，每个声明步骤都带自己的证据——没有观测到证据就照实这么写，而不是「已执行」或「未执行」；本次运行收到的指令哈希与当前定义并列给出 match、mismatch 或 unavailable。证据视图给每一类对象三态之一（声明 / 已观察 / 无法取得），沿定义 → 加载 → 使用 → 结果走一遍，逐段写明它够不着什么，不把结果归因给这个 Skill，并能把快照按逐字节稳定的 JSON 复制出去。验收把 Agent Skills 开放标准与各平台 Profile 分开判，每条发现落在规则 id 上并标注「标准合规」或「平台兼容」。评测用可重复的用例记录每次运行的条件与四段运行时证据，只在同一个用例内逐项对照两次运行，不给分。触发边界维护「应触发 / 不应触发」的提示词，由你在真实新会话里跑一遍再记录观察到的结果——加载记录出现过没有、`model-invoked` 还是 `user-explicit`；手打 `/name` 不算自然触发，没有加载记录只写成「未观察到」，不写成「没有触发」。同一批投影也作为只读工具 `skill_review` 交给 Agent，它返回结构化审查包，包太大时会说明省略了什么。检视器、证据链与上面这些审查都在本机按定义与会话收据算；中文阅读版在你需要时把正文交给宿主模型翻译，代码围栏、路径与 frontmatter 逐字保留，译文只存本机。另外可以把一份 Skill 复刻成本机副本。它不改写源 Skill，也不执行源里的脚本。

description.en: Doxygen comment workflow for C/C++ (including Qt) sources: file headers, functions, module groups, trailing and short comments, plus a scan that flags comments whose signature fingerprint went stale. Requires Python 3.10+ with `pip install tree-sitter tree-sitter-cpp`.
description.zh: 为 C/C++（含 Qt）源码生成与维护 Doxygen 注释的工作流：文件头、函数、模块分组、行尾与简短注释，并扫描出签名指纹已过期、需要更新的注释。运行时需要 Python 3.10+ 并 `pip install tree-sitter tree-sitter-cpp`。

description.en: Portable Workspace: (1) 100% off the host disk, with sessions, plugins, projects and logs all on a removable drive or USB stick; work portably, no fear of switching computers or reinstalling the OS. (2) Independent portable web instances, multiple at once, each with its own plugin configuration. (3) Drive-letter-independent detection plus offline use. (4) A password for privacy and against accidental deletion, without encrypting the data (security). (5) One-click reinstall of missing plugins from a list you can prune. (6) Two-way session migration across drives and the local machine, .zip backup/restore, rename. (7) Upgrade-friendly, zero dependencies, works offline. (8) Optional local-login sync. (9) Automatic cleanup of expired stale cookies. Needs DSH and this plugin on each computer; verified on Windows only. The workspace password gates actions inside the plugin and does not encrypt the files, and the optional "sync local login" copies your DeepSeek account credentials onto the drive as plain-text YAML.
description.zh: 移动工作区：① 100% 不落本地， 会话、插件、工程与日志 全放在 移动盘/U盘。便携工作，不惧换电脑、不惧重装系统；②独立便携 web 实例，可多开、独立插件配置环境；③盘符无关识别 + 脱机；④密码防隐私、防误删， 不加密数据（安全）；⑤缺插件一键按清单重装，可剔除的清单；⑥跨盘·本机会话双向迁移 + .zip 备份恢复 + 改名；⑦升级友好、零依赖、离线可用。⑧可选的「同步本机登录」⑨自清理过期失效的cookie。每台电脑都需安装 DSH 和本插件；仅在 Windows 上验证过。工作区密码只限制插件内的操作、并不加密盘上文件；可选的「同步本机登录」会把 DeepSeek 账号凭据以明文 YAML 复制到盘上。

description.en: Closes right-sidebar tabs with a middle click or a left double click, reusing the built-in close button so the native rules (such as the last docked guide card being unclosable) still apply.
description.zh: 右侧栏标签页支持鼠标中键关闭与左键双击关闭，关闭动作复用原生 × 按钮，原生规则（例如唯一停靠的 guide 卡片关不掉）保持不变。

description.en: Read-only viewer for archived DSH sessions: browse the archive with workspace filtering and title/ID search, and read the transcript folded from the durable log — including messages from before a context compaction — without unarchiving.
description.zh: 已归档 DSH 会话的只读查看器：按工作区筛选、按标题/ID 搜索，不取消归档即可阅读从完整日志折出的对话——包括上下文压缩前的原文与工具调用。

description.en: Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups, a fold toggle, and auto classification (market tags → name rules → your AI model).
description.zh: 设置面板导航整理：第三方插件入口折叠为可展开的分组行，支持书签式自定义分组、折叠开关与自动分类（市场标签 → 名称规则 → AI 模型三级兜底）。

description.en: Push a Gotify notification when each conversation turn ends, with configurable templates, priority and per-cause titles.
description.zh: 每轮会话结束时向 Gotify 服务器推送通知，支持模板、优先级与按结束原因区分标题。

description.en: Plugin manager with a rescue center: grouped enable/disable by necessity, multi update sources (npm / dshfind market / GitHub), browser-first downloads with an auto-install folder, P2P fallback, pre-boot self-check and broken-bundle quarantine.
description.zh: 插件管理器与救砖中心：按必要程度分组启停、多更新源（npm / 插件超市 / GitHub）、浏览器下载优先与目录自动安装、P2P 兜底、启动前自检与坏包隔离。

description.en: Keeps the PTC run_code deadline from firing while DSH waits for your answer, plan review or approval, so a question can stay open longer than the shipped 120 s budget.
description.zh: 把 PTC 模式 run_code 的执行预算在人机等待期间暂停，提问、计划审议或审批可以超过出厂的 120 秒而不被中断。

description.en: Personal paste inbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): /inbox in the composer or the sidebar panel files links, images, text and credentials into a local vault, classifies them by local rules and then by a rate-capped model pass, and browses, searches and edits them from the panel; the assistant retrieves records on request in conversation, credential bodies stay encrypted at rest, and an optional WebDAV or S3 remote syncs records and attachment bytes. Windows only so far.
description.zh: dsh 的个人收件箱：输入框的 /inbox 或侧栏面板把链接、图片、文本与账密收进本地仓库，先按本地规则、再由有每日上限的模型分类，可在面板里筛选、搜索与编辑；对话里让助手按需检索取回，账密正文加密落盘，可选 WebDAV 或 S3 远端同步记录与附件字节。目前只在 Windows 实测。

description.en: Model rotation for DeepSeek Harness: groups each provider's models by source, orders them by hand or by measured success rate and latency, stores model plus reasoning-effort presets, falls over to the next entry when a model hits its quota or is unavailable, resends the same step on the next model, and shows which model actually answered. Uses the models of whatever provider plugins are already installed (Antigravity accounts, Codex subscription, DeepSeek API keys); it does not provide model access itself.
description.zh: 按来源分组的模型轮询：把每个 provider 的模型按来源分组，可手动排序，也可按成功率和延迟自动排序；支持「模型 + 思考强度」预设；某一档额度用尽或不可用时自动切到下一档，并用下一档把同一步重新发一次；会话头显示本次回答由哪个模型产出。使用已安装的 provider 插件（agy 账号池、Codex 订阅、DeepSeek API Key）提供的模型，插件本身不提供模型接入。

description.en: Clean desktop shell for DSH: launch by double-clicking a desktop shortcut like any normal desktop app, live backend monitoring with one-click tray start/restart/stop (progress dialogs), offline auto-reconnect, single instance. Reuses your existing web profile, no restyling of the web UI. Windows + macOS.
description.zh: DSH 纯净桌面壳：双击桌面快捷方式即可像普通桌面软件一样启动；后端活性实时监测 + 托盘一键启停/重启（带进度弹窗）、离线自动重连、单实例。复用现有 web profile，不改动 web 界面。Windows + macOS 双平台。

description.en: Annotate elements in the built-in browser — click one, write a comment, then send the whole batch to the session in one message so the model can find and edit the matching source.
description.zh: 在内置浏览器里点选页面元素写批注，攒够后一次性发给会话，让模型直接定位并修改对应源码。

description.en: MQTT client and embedded broker for DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar panel with saved connections, a live message log and a local broker, plus nine mqtt_* agent tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MQTT 面板：客户端连接池、实时消息日志与内嵌 Broker，并提供九个 mqtt_* 智能体工具。

description.en: Gives the agent its own clock: per-session time readings whose precision the agent can change at runtime, elapsed-time counters, and one-shot countdowns that survive a host restart.
description.zh: 为 agent 提供它自己的时钟：按会话注入时间读数且精度可由 agent 运行时调整，并附带累计计时器与跨宿主重启可靠的一次性倒计时。

description.en: Let agents read and control the web page open in the right Sidebar Browser tab — read text, run JS, click (HTML and SVG), type, scroll, screenshot, with a per-command token bridge behind the Harness connection fence. Full control and screenshots need the DSH Desktop app; in a regular browser (Web) only same-origin pages can be read or scripted.
description.zh: 让 agent 读取并控制右侧 Sidebar 浏览器标签页里打开的网页——读文字、执行 JS、点击（HTML/SVG）、输入、滚动、截图，命令桥接带逐命令令牌并置于 Harness connection 防护栏之后。完整控制与截图需 DSH 桌面端；在普通浏览器（Web）中仅能读取或操控同源页面。

description.en: Smart calendar and checklist assistant with lunar dates, macOS/Windows native notifications, and WeCom push.
description.zh: 智能日程与待办助手：农历节气、macOS/Windows 原生桌面弹窗、企微多平台推送与拖拽改期。

description.en: Electrical and electronics calculation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: every computation runs through dedicated tools on self-describing complex value objects in SI base units, with an isolated calculation agent preset and a records panel that archives every solve on disk.
description.zh: DSH 电气电子计算插件：所有计算都通过专用工具完成，基于 SI 基本单位的自描述复数值对象；附带隔离的计算智能体预设与记录面板，每次求解落盘存档。

description.en: Research workflow suite that registers 10 domain skills and 15 tools, curates 450 bundled research skills into 103 capability cards with an auditable per-skill ledger, and takes over research requests automatically through a system-prompt section. Tools cover real R/Python execution (off by default, two-phase preview then confirm), data gates, figure and docx auditing, .docx generation in Chinese-journal style, live PubMed search, field-level DOI verification, and cross-session project memory.
description.zh: 科研全流程插件：注册 10 个领域技能与 15 个工具，把随包 450 条科研技能整理成 103 张能力卡并附 444 条可审计的判定账本，并通过系统提示段自动接管科研任务。工具覆盖真跑 R/Python（默认关闭，先预览再确认）、数据闸门、图片与 docx 核验、按中文期刊体例生成 .docx、PubMed 真检索、DOI 逐字段核对、跨会话项目记忆。

description.en: Writes one short line into the system prompt only when a stress, energy or reward value crosses a threshold; the values rise on real session events and decay over time.
description.zh: 压力、精力、爽度三个状态随真实会话事件涨落、随时间衰减，越界时才往系统提示里写一句话。

description.en: Connects DSH to local Beav for Xiaohongshu (RED/RedNote) and social-media AI operations: topic research, knowledge, copywriting, image, audio, and short-video workflows with approval and artifact tracking.
description.zh: 将 DSH 连接到本机 Beav，面向小红书（RED/RedNote）、社交媒体运营和自媒体 AI 创作，覆盖选题研究、知识库、文案、图片、音频与短视频工作流，并保留审批和产物追踪。

description.en: Adds a "Hot restart" row under "Sign out" in the DSH account menu; it reconciles the profile plugin tree in place and reloads the page, without restarting the DSH process or dropping the current conversation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 账号菜单「退出登录」下面加一行「热重启」：原地对账 profile 插件树并刷新页面，不重启 DSH 进程，当前对话不丢。

description.en: Manage agent skills and MCP servers across DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other tools from one DSH sidebar page: CRUD, cross-tool sharing, import/export, backups and MCP health checks.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏统一管理 DSH、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等工具的 skill 与 MCP 服务器：增删改查、跨工具共享、导入导出、备份恢复与 MCP 连接体检。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness lifecycle status, errors, and approval requests to a locally running OpenPets desktop companion.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的生命周期状态、错误与审批请求，桥接到本地运行的 OpenPets 桌面伙伴。

description.en: Adds a browserless deepseek-web provider that drives chat.deepseek.com, with an account pool (rotation, cooldown, auto-failover), in-panel login (browser, or email + password with MFA) and token usage stats.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 网页版接成 deepseek-web provider：纯 HTTP 无浏览器，多账号轮换/冷却/自动切换，插件内登录（浏览器，或邮箱+密码+验证码），带 token 用量统计。

description.en: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision tools, with on-demand server lifecycle management.
description.zh: 给在线模型装上本地双手：koboldcpp_run 与 koboldcpp_vision 工具把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地 KoboldCpp（llama.cpp）服务器，并按需拉起与管理服务器生命周期。

description.en: Windows tray desktop shell: auto-installs and auto-updates the exe from GitHub Releases, creates desktop shortcuts for both the app and the web UI, and exposes a desktop_launch tool to start it from the conversation.
description.zh: Windows 托盘桌面壳：自动从 GitHub Releases 安装并升级 exe、创建应用与网页端两个桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

description.en: Adds a "Check updates" tab to the Built-in plugins settings: one row per installed bundle, with its latest npm version and an update button. Each row also reports DSH-runtime compatibility. The registry is read through the .npmrc chain (environment, then profile, then user, first hit wins); with nothing configured it races a mirror against the public registry, and a private registry is never raced against a public one. A version is installed from the registry it was read from.
description.zh: 在内置插件设置里新增「检查更新」标签页：每个已安装插件一行，显示 npm 最新版本并提供更新按钮。每行还会报告 DSH 运行时兼容性。注册表按 .npmrc 逐级读取（环境变量 → profile → 用户级，取第一个命中），未配置时并发探测镜像与公共源，内部源不会与公共源竞速。版本从哪个注册表读到，就由它安装。

description.en: Hermetic composition lock: fingerprints the profile's dependencies, bundle order, lockfile and patch layer; booting a drifted composition warns, or fails under strict mode (the --frozen posture for CI).
description.zh: 密闭组合锁：对 profile 的依赖、组合顺序、锁文件与补丁层取指纹；组合漂移时启动告警，strict 模式直接失败（CI 的 --frozen 姿态）。

description.en: Watches DSH and plugin releases, retests exact published artifacts in disposable runners, publishes machine-readable compatibility evidence, and reconciles managed issues after fixes.
description.zh: 持续监控 DSH 与插件发布，在一次性隔离环境中复测精确发布物，发布机器可读的兼容性证据，并在修复后自动核对和关闭受管理的问题。

description.en: Interactive HTML or flowchart cards inside the conversation: the tool blocks until the user submits, then returns the clicked action, fields, comments and card state.
description.zh: 在对话里发可交互的 HTML 或流程图卡片；工具阻塞到用户提交，再把点击、字段、评论和卡片状态作为结果交还。

description.en: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
description.zh: 在对话中 Ctrl+点击文件路径与链接：路径在文件管理器中定位所在文件夹，链接在新标签页打开。

description.en: Type normally; about two seconds after you pause, it rewrites your draft into a clearer, first-person version more likely to get a good answer, leaving pasted code, links and long text untouched, marking missing details as placeholders instead of guessing, and keeping multi-part questions numbered.
description.zh: 你只管正常打字，停下约两秒，它就把你刚写的话改写成更清晰、以第一人称表达的版本，更容易得到好答案；贴进来的代码、网址、长文原样不动，缺的信息用占位符标出而不乱猜，一次问几件事也一件不漏、排好顺序。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for IsingQ: guided QUBO modeling and validation on-device, then user-confirmed remote solving.
description.zh: IsingQ 原生插件：引导式 QUBO 建模与本地校验，用户确认后提交远端求解。

description.en: Forced collaboration: a composer picker sets 0–6 sub-agents, and while it is on every hands-on task must be split across exactly that many child agents through a collab_fanout tool that has no count parameter, then merged by the main agent.
description.zh: 强制协作：在输入框左侧选 0–6 个子 Agent，开启后每个动手的任务都必须通过没有数量参数的 collab_fanout 工具拆给正好这么多个子 Agent 并行，再由主 Agent 汇总。

description.en: Annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on: a badge line in each parent-catalog row and a readout in a child session's own header.
description.zh: 给每个子代理标注它实际运行使用的模型路由：父会话目录行增加「mode · 活动状态 · 模型」徽标行，子代理会话页头显示同一读数。

description.en: Per-step model router: named presets with ordered image/keyword-group rules route each agent step across every mounted provider and model, adding collaboration flows for image transcription, an image guard, a multi-plan quota panel, and per-step decision observability.
description.zh: 逐步模型路由器：以命名预设与带图/关键词组有序规则为每一步在全部已挂载模型间选路，附图像转述协作流、图像护栏、多 plan 配额面板与逐步决策可观测。

description.en: Learns what you leave unsaid in your prompts from messy turns and your own corrections, and injects the learned directives into the system prompt of every new conversation; the directives are editable in Settings and a composer button rewrites the current draft with them.
description.zh: 从不顺的轮次和你自己的纠正中学习你在提示词里没说出口的东西，并把学到的指令注入每个新对话的系统提示；指令可在设置中编辑，输入框按钮可用它们改写当前草稿。

description.en: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: realtime market indices, stock screener with 13 technical signals and multi-strategy intersection, 7×24 multi-source news aggregation, watchlist with group management, market sentiment thermometer (limit-up ladder, breadth), K-line charts with MA/EXPMA/BOLL overlays, and sector/limit-up/longhu rankings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness A 股行情面板：实时大盘指数、技术选股（13 项信号 + 多策略交叉）、7×24 多源快讯聚合、自选股分组管理、市场情绪温度计（连板梯队/涨跌家数）、K 线图（MA/EXPMA/BOLL 叠加）、板块榜/涨停池/龙虎榜。

description.en: Adds the fs_remove and fs_move tools, executed in the DSH host process so they can delete paths the sandboxed shell cannot, gated by a session allow list and a path allow/deny list that denies by default.
description.zh: 在 DSH 宿主进程里执行 fs_remove 与 fs_move，因此能删除沙箱 shell 删不掉的路径；带会话白名单与路径白/黑名单，默认拒绝。

description.en: Codex Pets-style floating pixel pet with 10 built-in Petdex-compatible pets, a 9-state agent-status engine (idle/running/waiting/review/failed plus client-side waving/jumping/directions), draggable overlay, pet picker/zoom settings, notification bubbles, and a `pet_say` tool for the agent to speak through the pet.
description.zh: Codex Pets 风格浮动像素桌宠：内置 10 只 Petdex 兼容宝可梦伙伴，9 状态 agent 状态机（空闲/思考/等待/审查/出错 + 客户端挥手/跳跃/方向动画），可拖拽悬浮、宠物切换与缩放设置、通知气泡，以及 agent 可用的 `pet_say` 工具。

description.en: Cut LLM costs: a Jev (System One) classifier vets each turn against a declarative policy and recommends the subagent model route, so routine work runs at flash rates while the main model keeps the hard parts; explicit /route trigger, runtime delegation-capability gate, credential redaction, and offline policy replay over the verdict log.
description.zh: 降低 LLM 成本：Jev（System One）分类器按声明式策略审查每一轮任务并推荐 subagent 模型路由，让常规工作以 flash 价格运行、主模型专注难点；显式 /route 触发、运行时代理能力门控、凭据脱敏，以及基于判定日志的离线策略回放。

description.en: White noise player: lays a layer of background sound (rain, streams, campfire, café) while AI codes, for flow and focus. Supports multiple playback modes (sequential / shuffle / single-loop / intermittent) and AI automatic background music download from Wikimedia Commons (CC0/PD/CC-BY).
description.zh: 白噪音播放器：AI 编程时铺一层背景音（雨声、溪流、篝火、咖啡馆……），帮助进入心流状态、集中精力、高效思考。支持顺序/随机/单曲循环/间歇等多种播放模式。支持 AI 自动从 Wikimedia Commons 下载 CC0/PD/CC BY 背景音乐到对应场景文件夹。

description.en: A full-screen terminal workbench for DeepSeek Harness with a durable assistant, workspace-grouped project sessions, transcript-only scrolling, and structured thinking, tool, diff, plan, and subagent views.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端工作台，提供独立持久助手、按工作区分组的项目会话、仅聊天区滚动，以及结构化思考、工具、diff、计划和子代理视图。

description.en: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will" mode into scattered "let me" mode.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的鞭子：实时监听每个思维块的指纹，当模型从专注的 We will / I will 模式滑向发散的 let me 模式时把它拉回来。

description.en: Prompt enhancer for the DSH web UI with basic/standard/expert modes: standard/expert modes rewrite drafts with project context and recent session history, retry gracefully when gateways reject reasoning-effort settings, and show a before/after review with undo.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面提示词增强插件：基础/标准/专家三档模式，标准/专家模式结合项目上下文与最近会话历史重写草稿；网关拒绝推理档位参数时自动去参重试；增强结果支持对比确认与撤回。

description.en: Adds a logon autostart switch for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows. It manages a single shortcut in the user Startup folder: no registry writes, no admin rights, no extra background process.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版加一个登录自启开关：只管理用户启动文件夹里的一个快捷方式，不写注册表、不需要管理员权限、不额外常驻进程。

description.en: Three things for DSH plugin development: reload the plugins whose files changed, restart the client when a reload cannot apply a change, and let the model trigger a reload itself. Reload uses DSH's own path, so untouched plugins keep running. Restart starts outside the client, so it completes even when the client is what gets replaced, and refuses while a session or job runs. Lightweight: no parameters, no added context, buttons off by default.
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件开发准备三件事：重载文件有改动的插件、重载办不到的改动就重启客户端、模型能自己触发热重载。重载走 DSH 自带的路径，没碰过的插件继续运行。重启从客户端外部发起，所以被替换的正是客户端也能完成，有会话或后台任务在跑时拒绝。轻量：不带参数、不添加上下文、按钮默认不出现。

description.en: Sidebar sticky-note wall with colour-coded notes, checklists, folding, a trash drawer that restores deleted notes, drag and resize, and five sticky_wall_* model tools for writing and restoring notes from chat.
description.zh: 侧栏便签墙：彩色便签、待办勾选、折叠、可恢复的回收站抽屉、拖拽与改尺寸，并给模型 5 个 sticky_wall_* 工具从对话里记事和恢复。

description.en: Adds a Managed Agents settings tab and MCP tools to dispatch long-running agent tasks to Ark cloud Managed Agents.
description.zh: 新增 Managed Agents 设置页，并通过 MCP 工具向方舟云端 Managed Agents 派发长任务、取回轨迹与产物。

description.en: Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session-row menu; the confirmation mode is configurable (click again, confirm in a dialog, or delete immediately) and a session that is running a task is refused.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话行菜单中加入「删除会话」项，确认方式可配置（再次点击、对话框确认或直接删除），正在执行任务的会话会被拒绝删除。

description.en: Generates a session title from the conversation with the session's own model, either from the /ai-title command or from a button in the rename dialog. Four title shapes (subject, action, subject + outcome, custom prompt) and an optional MM-DD prefix, all editable on the plugin's settings page.
description.zh: 用会话自己的模型从对话内容生成会话标题，可走 /ai-title 命令，也可点重命名弹窗里的按钮。提供四种标题结构（主题、动作、主题 + 结论、自定义提示词）和可选的「月-日」前缀，均可在插件设置页调整。

description.en: Small-window mode for DSH NEXT on Windows: a 425px-wide always-on-top sticky window with a drawer sidebar and animated transitions. Requires DSH NEXT; the other desktop client (dsh desktop) is not supported.
description.zh: DSH NEXT（Windows）的小窗模式：把主窗口切成 425px 宽、置顶的便签式小窗，侧栏变抽屉、进出带过渡动效。只支持 DSH NEXT，另一个桌面端 dsh desktop 不支持。

description.en: Remote control: pushes ask / approval / session-end events to an external channel webhook and lets you answer, approve, query status or continue a session from your phone with token auth (npm: `dsh-my-remote`).
description.zh: 远程控制：把 ask / 审批 / 会话结束事件推送到外部通道 webhook，可用 token 鉴权在手机上回答问题、批准请求、查询状态或继续会话（npm: `dsh-my-remote`）。

description.en: Makes a connection between two DSH sessions a first-class object: drag from the composer anchor or a session row to open one, set a permission in each direction, and mount cards on it. Each end gets five host tools for messaging at a chosen urgency, reading the peer work state, and sharing a convention box; awareness is pull-based, so an idle connection costs no context.
description.zh: 把两个 DSH 会话之间的「连接」做成一等对象：从输入框锚点或会话行拖拽建连，两个方向各自设权限，并可在连接上装载卡片。两端各获得五个宿主工具，用于按指定紧急度传话、读取对端工作状态、共用公约盒；感知为拉取式，空闲连接不占上下文。

description.en: Two DeepSeek Harness tools for the local tempguard watchdog: read temperatures and alertd health, and send alerts through alertd; it does not start or stop the watchdog. Needs the separate tempguard Python watchdog and its alertd service running locally, with projectDir and alertdToken set in the profile patch; there is no npm package, so install from a local clone of the repository subfolder.
description.zh: 为本地 tempguard 温度守护提供两个 DSH 工具：读取温度与 alertd 健康状态，以及通过 alertd 发送告警。需另行在本机运行 tempguard Python 看门狗及其 alertd 服务，并在 profile patch 里配置 projectDir 与 alertdToken；暂无 npm 包，需克隆仓库后从子目录本地安装。

description.en: Makes Enter insert a newline in the DSH 0.1.5 Web composer while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter keeps submitting messages.
description.zh: 让 DSH 0.1.5 Web 输入框使用 Enter 换行，同时保留 Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 提交消息。

description.en: Union workspaces: merge multiple directories into one session, manage unions from a settings panel, and read/write member files via uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move tools.
description.zh: 联合工作区：将多个目录合并到一个会话中，通过设置面板管理联合工作区，使用 uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move 工具读写成员目录文件。

description.en: Keep declared workspace subpaths (e.g. .git) read-only, honor a read-only rules file at the workspace root, grant extra writable roots under workspace-write, and let the model request session-scoped write access; enforced for sandboxed CLI commands and the write/edit tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH 沙箱增加工作区子路径只读保护 (例如 .git), 支持工作区根下的只读规则文件, 可在 workspace-write 下声明额外可写根, 并允许模型申请本会话的可写授权; 命令沙箱与 write/edit 工具都生效.
