description.en: Export the current session as a readable Markdown file with dialogue only: user messages, assistant text, and ask_user_question answers, from a session-header button or the /md command.
description.zh: 把当前会话导出为可读的 Markdown 文件，只保留对话正文：用户消息、助手文本与 ask_user_question 问答，通过会话标题栏按钮或 /md 命令触发。

description.en: Adds a composer button that rewrites the current draft into a precise prompt in place, in one click, with a revert action.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，点一下就把草稿原地改写成精确提示词，可一键恢复原文。

description.en: Opens the DSH settings dialog as a full-page screen and moves the close control to a back row at the top left.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的设置弹窗以整页全屏打开，并把退出入口移到左上角的返回行。

description.en: Frontend GUI debugging and testing for DeepSeekHarness agents: 36 browser_* tools for structured GUI automation, visual comparison, dynamic frame analysis and network debugging on Web/Chromium.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeekHarness 的前端 GUI 调试与测试：36 个 browser_* 工具，覆盖结构化 GUI 操作、视觉比对、动态帧分析与网络调试（Web/Chromium）。

description.en: Previews plugin-market entries inside DSH instead of opening an external browser: clicking a card shows the README in a panel docked beside the market, or the repository in DSH's built-in right-sidebar browser, and restores the layout when you leave. Works with dshmarket and DSH's built-in experimental market.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件市场点击插件卡片时把插件留在 DSH 里预览：README 显示在市场旁的停靠面板，或在内置右侧栏浏览器打开仓库页，离开市场时恢复原布局。支持 dshmarket 与 DSH 内置实验性市场。

description.en: Per-session status chips in the GNOME top bar for DeepSeek Harness — gray for running, green for done, yellow for waiting — configurable from the sidebar, with a self-installed GNOME extension.
description.zh: 在 GNOME 顶栏显示 DSH 各会话状态色块（灰=运行中，绿=已完成未确认，黄=等待回复/审批），可在侧边栏配置，自动安装 GNOME 扩展。

description.en: A balance and usage card at the bottom of the sidebar: DeepSeek account balance, today token count with input, cache and output breakdown, this session tokens, and the last error when a fetch fails.
description.zh: 侧栏底部的余额与用量卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额、今日 token（含输入、缓存、输出明细）、本会话 token，以及抓取失败时的最近错误。

description.en: A floating VS Code-like workbench for DeepSeek Harness, with a Monaco editor, file explorer, Git panel, content search and an SSH terminal.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的浮动式 VS Code 风格工作台，包含 Monaco 编辑器、资源管理器、Git 面板、内容搜索与 SSH 终端。

description.en: Open dsh web from your phone or another computer through a UUMit account, without running your own server or installing another program: a built-in tunnel client connects to UUMit's hosted tunnel, and a panel in the sidebar handles pairing and who can use it (only you, people you invite by link or phone number, or everyone), with revocation. Requires dsh web on DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 用 UUMit 账号在手机或其他电脑上打开这台电脑的 dsh web，不用自建服务器、不装其他程序：插件内置通道客户端连接 UUMit 托管的通道，侧栏里的面板负责配对和选择谁能用（仅自己、通过邀请链接或手机号授权的人、所有人），可随时撤销。需 dsh web 且 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Codex-style left-gutter tick rail for each user turn, with hover preview and click-to-scroll.
description.zh: 对话区左侧 Codex 风格短横线锚点，悬停预览，点击跳转到对应轮次。

description.en: A deterministic calculation engine for DeepSeek Harness, including a preset that guides the LLM to calculate through the engine rather than by text generation.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性计算引擎，附带一个预设：引导 LLM 通过引擎而非文本生成来完成计算。

description.en: Restores the DSH right sidebar divider drag after whole-interface zoom shifts the host handle off it, and widens the hit area to 12px with a hover affordance.
description.zh: 修复整页缩放后右侧栏拖拽手柄偏移、分割线拖不动的问题，把命中区加宽到 12px 并显示悬停提示线。

description.en: Collects every DSH plugin sidebar entry into one collapsible floating dock at the corner of the Web GUI, with a switch that hides the original icon column and a deep-linked list of installed plugins.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧栏里所有插件的入口收进一张可折叠的浮动小卡片：顶部开关决定是否收起原侧栏图标列，点一行直达对应面板，另有全部已安装插件的深链列表。

description.en: WSL console for the harness — manage distributions, edit .wslconfig and wsl.conf in a typed form, and run commands, file edits and long-running processes inside any distribution with its own wslx-* tools.
description.zh: 用于 Harness 的 WSL 控制台：管理发行版、以表单编辑 .wslconfig 与 wsl.conf，并用自带的 wslx-* 工具在任意发行版内执行命令、读写文件、运行长驻进程。

description.en: Rates how hard the current message is and shows the cheapest model and reasoning effort that still fits, above the composer, before you send.
description.zh: 发送前判断问题难度，在输入框上方提示够用的模型与推理等级，避免用错档位多花钱。

description.en: Git integration for DSH modelled on IDEA's VCS: a git icon beside the permission mode in the composer shows the current branch and the pending-change count, opens a branch switcher on hover and an IDEA-style VCS panel on click (branch tree, commit graph, changes and staging, commit detail, file diff), plus a settings page for commit identity, the git binary and the network flags. Registers no model tools with DSH.
description.zh: 照着 IDEA 的 VCS 做的 Git 集成，装进 DSH 会话：输入框「权限模式」旁边的 Git 图标显示当前分支与未提交改动数，悬停可切分支，点击弹出 IDEA 风格的面板（分支树、提交图、变更与暂存、提交详情、文件差异），另有一个设置页管提交身份、git 位置和网络参数。不向 DSH 注册任何模型工具。

description.en: Data asset attestation plugin that generates certification-level data quality reports with evidence chains.
description.zh: 数据资产认证报告插件 — 生成带证据链的认证级数据质量报告

description.en: Vets third-party plugins before you trust them: static scan for malicious patterns (exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence) and over-privileged path use, transitive-dependency coverage, official-package hash baseline for supply-chain tamper detection, and an optional plugin-tool call gate.
description.zh: 为了您的电脑安全，装插件前先体检：静态扫描恶意模式（外传/凭据/混淆/持久化）与高权限误用，覆盖传递依赖与官方包哈希基线（防供应链篡改），可选插件工具调用闸。

description.en: Inspect and simulate DSH context consumption with trajectory and inventory views, and create, inject, import, or safely repair session messages through the integrated Message Forge.
description.zh: 上下文控制台：通过轨迹墙与库存视图检查并模拟 DSH 上下文消费，并由内置消息锻造台创建、注入、导入或安全修复会话消息。

description.en: Merged commit timeline for the Git repositories in a DSH workspace, with per-repository dirty and ahead/behind state, fetch, and right-sidebar file diffs.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区内各 Git 仓库的提交合并在一条时间线中查看，并显示各仓库改动与领先／落后状态、支持拉取和右侧文件差异。

description.en: Adds a search-engine picker, a bookmarks panel with multi-level folders (add/edit/delete/import Netscape bookmark HTML) and keyword-then-Enter search in the address bar of the sidebar Browser tab. Requires dsh-better-sidebar >=0.20.0 (the client injects its betterSidebar service and will not load without it). Bookmarks are stored in a local JSON file; no external browser required.
description.zh: 给侧边栏「浏览器」Tab 增加搜索引擎选择、书签面板（多级文件夹、增删改、导入书签 HTML），以及地址栏输入关键词回车直接搜索。需先装 dsh-better-sidebar >=0.20.0（客户端 inject 其 betterSidebar 服务，缺了不会加载）。书签存本地 JSON，不依赖外部浏览器。

description.en: Adds a 12-hour peak/off-peak billing strip and the account balance above the composer, with today, 7-day and 30-day spend per model.
description.zh: 在输入框上方显示以当前为中心的 12 小时峰谷条形与账户余额，可切换今日、近 7 日、近 30 日查看各模型花费。

description.en: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
description.zh: 在已配置遥测后端接收前，对 `session-telemetry/record` 导出副本中的已支持秘密模式进行脱敏。

description.en: Prompt market beside the composer: browse and search three built-in online prompt sources, bookmark or write your own, and insert into the input box.
description.zh: 对话框旁的提示词市场：浏览并搜索三个内置在线提示词源，可收藏或自建，选中即插入输入框。

description.en: Appends local hash-chained JSONL receipts for tool results and session events without storing prompts, tool arguments, result text, or raw session IDs.
description.zh: 把工具结果与会话事件的 receipt 写入本地哈希链 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数、结果正文或原始会话 ID。

description.en: Smart naming for sessions and workspaces: one click asks the profile model for short name candidates from the item's own content, then renames in place.
description.zh: 会话与工作区的智能命名：点一下让模型基于条目自身内容给出短名候选，选中即改名。

description.en: Turns a dsh session into a redacted idea and delivers it end-to-end encrypted to friends on DeepHub; received ideas land as new sessions.
description.zh: 将一条 dsh 会话提炼为脱敏后的思路，端到端加密投递给 DeepHub 上的朋友；收到的思路落为一条新会话。

description.en: A local overview of installed DSH plugins. It does not install packages — pair it with a plugin market. Fold third-party settings, organize notes/groups with AI, check health and toggle plugins, so nothing gets lost in clutter.
description.zh: 本地已装插件总览：不下载插件，和插件市场搭配；一键收纳第三方插件设置，AI 整理备注与分组，配合健康诊断和启停，让插件不再乱而不知。

description.en: Persistent AI memory backed by a local Obsidian/Codex vault: five obsidian_memory_* read/write/search tools plus a sidebar vault browser.
description.zh: 基于本地 Obsidian/Codex 知识库的持久 AI 记忆：5 个 obsidian_memory_* 读写搜索工具，外加侧边栏知识库浏览器。

description.en: Five task-state reminders for DeepSeek Harness (completion, approval, question, block, error) with four synthesized browser sound presets, optional question text in the notification, an optional native Windows and WSL toast channel that bypasses Focus Assist, and a terminal-BEL fallback when no browser is ready.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供五类任务状态提醒（完成、审批、提问、受阻、出错）：四种浏览器合成音方案、可在通知中显示提问正文、可选的原生 Windows/WSL 通知通道（可越过专注助手），没有就绪浏览器时降级为终端 BEL。

description.en: Adds a right-sidebar panel that lists the skills available to the current session, searches and tags them, combines them with your own saved prompts, appends the selection to the composer in one click, and can pin skills and prompts as always-on context injected through the system prompt.
description.zh: 在右侧栏列出当前会话可用的 Skill，支持搜索与标签，可与自存提示词组合后一键追加到输入框；还能把 Skill 与提示词设为常驻，经系统提示注入每个新对话。

description.en: Inline +N −M badges on edit/write tool rows and a collapsible per-turn file-change summary card with aligned diffs, review and undo — covers native edit/write, str_replace_editor and Code Dispatch sub-calls, no git required.
description.zh: 在编辑/写入工具行内联 +N −M 徽标，每轮末尾给出可折叠的文件变更汇总卡：对齐差异、逐文件审查与撤销；覆盖原生 edit/write、str_replace_editor 与 Code Dispatch 子调用，不依赖 git。

description.en: Cursor-style New Session: every click creates a fresh blank draft session (persisted before the first message) instead of reusing the workspace's single one, plus a sidebar Drafts switcher to keep several empty chats open at once.
description.zh: Cursor 风格的新会话：每次点击都新建一个空白草稿会话（首条消息前即持久化），不再复用工作区唯一的空会话；侧栏新增草稿切换器，可同时保留多个空会话。

description.en: Reads a local Hermes Agent session store read-only and imports sessions into the current conversation as bounded, untrusted background context: a composer button opens a searchable list across every profile, plus the hermes_sessions_list and hermes_session_import tools.
description.zh: 只读读取本机 Hermes Agent 的会话库，把会话导入当前会话作为有界、不可信的背景上下文：输入框按钮可搜索全部 profile 的会话，另有 hermes_sessions_list 与 hermes_session_import 两个工具。

description.en: The session page has an extra "Git" page; on the left is a preview of the non-staged/staged changes, and on the right is a diff preview with a row-level action bar (staged/discarded).
description.zh: 会话页里多出一个 Git 页；左侧是未暂存 / 已暂存的改动，右侧是带行级操作条（暂存 / 丢弃）的 diff 预览。

description.en: Deterministic write gate: scope policy denies out-of-scope write/edit calls before they touch the disk, residue rules scan the written text, and every decision lands in a content-hashed JSONL ledger; can reuse the repo's agent-pr-gate.yaml so CI and session enforce one policy.
description.zh: 确定性写入门禁：范围策略在落盘前拒绝越权写入，残留规则扫描所写文本，每个决定落入带内容哈希的 JSONL 台账；可复用仓库的 agent-pr-gate.yaml 让 CI 与会话共用同一策略。

description.en: Rules, commands & skills manager for dsh: /rules slash command, settings panel with visual rule editing (add/edit/disable/delete, free-zone support), user-defined custom commands with {input} arguments, skill management, and automatic backup & one-click restore of AGENTS.md.
description.zh: dsh 规则、命令与技能管理：/rules 斜杠命令、设置面板可视化编辑规则（增改禁用删除、自由区域支持）、带参数的自定义命令、技能管理、AGENTS.md 自动备份与一键恢复。

description.en: Mirrors DeepSeek Harness task state (failed, waiting for your answer, finished) into the macOS Atoll Dynamic Island as one status light with three counts.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的任务状态（失败、等待你处理、已完成）镜像到 macOS Atoll 灵动岛上的同一枚状态灯，并显示三种状态的计数。

description.en: Acceptance gate for DSH: freeze the acceptance criteria into an oracle ledger before work starts, then honor only real execution receipts — files changed after freezing are refused outright, and a failing hard gate overrides any human pass.
description.zh: DSH 验收闸门：动手前把验收判据冻结成 oracle 账本，之后只认真实执行回执——冻结后被改过的文件直接拒绝执行，硬门失败时人工放行也无效。

description.en: Expose every model already configured in your local DeepSeek Harness to the LAN over OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, with API keys, per-key rate limits, a circuit breaker, model filters and usage reports.
description.zh: 把本机 DeepSeek Harness 已配置的全部模型，以 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容接口开放给同一局域网；自带 API Key、按 Key 限流、熔断、模型过滤与用量报告。

description.en: Adds an "edit question" action to every user message: editing re-sends the prompt from that turn, re-attaches the original images (extra ones can be pasted in), and optionally archives the original session.
description.zh: 在每条用户提问旁加「编辑提问」入口：改完从该提问重新开始，原图一并重发（还可粘贴补充图），原会话可选保留或归档。

description.en: Unofficial port of Ponytail 5.3.3 (upstream: DietrichGebert/ponytail, MIT; not affiliated) for DeepSeek Harness: minimal-code rules, session modes, native settings, a composer status band, and a reported-usage dashboard. It cannot be installed alongside another DSH Ponytail adapter — remove @mengyuly/dsh-ponytail first.
description.zh: Ponytail 5.3.3（上游 DietrichGebert/ponytail，MIT，与上游无关联）的 DSH 非官方移植：最小代码规则、会话模式、原生设置、输入框状态条与用量面板。不能与其他 DSH Ponytail 适配器同装，需先卸载 @mengyuly/dsh-ponytail。

description.en: Workspace artifact manager that sorts files into artifact, process, memory and material roles, with extra workspace roots, 12 file types, a year/month/day timeline, preview, rename, trash, zip archive and optional COS sync.
description.zh: 工作区产物管理器：按「产物 / 过程 / 记忆 / 素材」分层，可添加多个工作区、12 类文件类型、按年/月/日分组的时间轴，预览、重命名、回收站、zip 归档与可选的 COS 同步。

description.en: Converts formula-bearing Word documents into Markdown with LaTeX, handling OLE equation objects, native Word OMML equations and image-based formulas; keeps equation numbers and structure. Needs Python 3.9+ (or uv); OLE and image formulas are transcribed by a vision-capable model from rendered images, and rendering needs Windows or LibreOffice.
description.zh: 把含公式的 Word 文档转成带 LaTeX 的 Markdown：OLE、Word 原生 OMML、图片公式三种载体都处理，保留公式编号与结构。需要 Python 3.9+（或 uv）；OLE 与图片公式由具备视觉能力的模型读渲染图转写，渲染需 Windows 或 LibreOffice。

description.en: Logged-in browser automation with 170+ site adapters as deterministic one-shot commands (requires the OpenCLI CLI, npm i -g @jackwener/opencli, and its BrowserBridge browser extension) — action-evidence verification (no silent failures), site knowledge & health cards, watch monitoring, trace replay, provenance reports, and a write-approval gate.
description.zh: 登录态真实浏览器自动化:170+ 站点结构化命令一步到位（需安装 OpenCLI CLI：npm i -g @jackwener/opencli，及其 BrowserBridge 浏览器扩展）;执行真实性判定(失败说真话)、站点知识卡+健康度、watch 监控、轨迹回放、带出处报告导出;写命令带审批门。

description.en: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.
description.zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness：用一个 base URL 统一管理 OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini 等多供应商路由，支持按 key 发现模型、用量查询与全局视觉/图像生成工具。

description.en: Independent workspace and conversation personas with adaptive styles, approved communication preferences and role-based routing to registered DSH models, including models supplied by Codex and Claude Code provider plugins.
description.zh: 为工作区与对话配置独立人格，支持自适应风格、经确认的通用交流偏好和子代理模型路由；可配合其他 provider 插件使用 Codex、Claude Code 等已注册模型。

description.en: Qingyun Jianxian (青云剑仙, Azure Cloud Sword Immortal) — a resident bottom-right widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a sword-cultivator character that reads your account balance and token spend, keeps a local ledger broken down by model, and has 10 switchable sound effects. Reminders cover low balance, a model waiting on your answer, a pending approval, and staying up too late. Ships 23 idle poses plus a 24-frame sword dance, 22 menu-icon skins, six panel tabs, a line-by-line speech-bubble editor, and black or white robes that follow the light or dark theme. Runs entirely locally and registers no agent tools.
description.zh: 青云剑仙：DSH 网页界面右下角的常驻剑修挂件，读取账户余额与 token 消耗，本地记一本按模型拆占比的账，10 路音效各带开关。余额告急、模型在等你回答、等你批准、深夜该睡了，都会开口提醒。23 个常驻姿态加 24 帧剑舞、22 件法宝（菜单图标皮肤）、6 个面板页签、可逐行编辑的气泡编辑器，黑衣白衣跟着明暗主题换。全本地运行，不向 agent 注册工具。

description.en: Recalls messages you already sent in the DSH composer with ArrowUp; ArrowDown walks forward, restores the draft you were writing, and one more press discards it and clears the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框用 ↑ 调回本会话已发送的消息；↓ 前翻并恢复你正在写的草稿，再按一次 ↓ 丢弃草稿、清空输入框。

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort card for the composer: takes over the model selector and shows the current level, the model row and a segmented slider over the model's own adapter-provided levels, with a model list, a reset, and a purple aurora with twinkling particles at the maximum level.
description.zh: 输入框里的 Codex 风格推理强度卡片：接管模型选择器，显示当前档位、模型行，以及覆盖模型适配器所报全部档位的分段滑块；另带模型列表、重置，以及最高档时的紫色极光与闪烁粒子。

description.en: Annotate pages inside the existing Harness Browser: click or drag to select, comment or ask, then send marked screenshots or DOM location details to the current session. While enabled it replaces the official Browser, Chat and Layout providers; targets Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2.
description.zh: 在 Harness 原有 Browser 内批注网页：点选或框选后就地评论、提问，可把标记截图或 DOM 定位资料发给当前会话；启用期间替换官方 Browser、Chat 与 Layout 提供方，精确支持 Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2。

description.en: Data asset valuation plugin with cost-based (replacement cost) and income-based valuation.
description.zh: 数据资产估值插件 — 成本法（重置成本）+收益法两轨估值

description.en: Local-first token usage heatmap inside DSH settings: GitHub-style week/month/quarter/year grids, hourly usage per day, per-model and per-provider Top 5, and persisted history that survives session deletion. Zero network, zero billing.
description.zh: DSH 设置内的本地 Token 用量热图：GitHub 风格周/月/季度/年视图、每日小时级展开、模型与供应商 Top 5，历史持久化，删除会话不丢数据。零联网、零计费。

description.en: Run one deterministic skill-routing pass on every user instruction, so the skill catalog is consulted before the model answers instead of after it remembers. On the host it scores the live catalog from the instruction's keywords and the catalog metadata, with no LLM or embedding call, and appends a single producer-tagged message to the step: a ranked shortlist by default, the winning SKILL.md body once the score clears a threshold, or an instruction to call a named router skill exactly once. Unrelated instructions stay silent.
description.zh: 对每条用户指令自动做一次确定性的技能路由，让技能目录在模型作答之前就被查阅，而不是等它自己想起来。宿主侧只依据指令关键词与目录元数据打分，不调用 LLM 也不做向量检索，然后向该步追加恰好一条带生产者标签的消息：默认是候选排名简报，分数过线时改注入冠军技能的 SKILL.md 正文，也可以只注入一句「立刻调用某个路由技能」。无关指令保持沉默。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory: captures durable facts from each turn, auto-associates them by shared entity and tag, and recalls with BM25 plus spreading activation over the link graph.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆：从每轮对话抽取持久事实、按共享标签与实体自动建立联想关联，并以 BM25 加关联图激活传播进行召回；提供六个模型可调用工具与一张设置卡片。

description.en: A secret store for DSH Desktop that keeps API keys in one place and injects them into the assistant's shell as $DSH_* variables.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供密钥库，集中保管 API 密钥并以 $DSH_* 变量注入助手的 shell 中。

description.en: Highlight or quote any passage of an answer, attach a note to it, then send the excerpt back to the composer as a quoted instruction.
description.zh: 在回答里标出任意一段文字、写上备注，再把引用放回输入框当作带上下文的指令发出。

description.en: Replaces the host-side folder chooser in the Add workspace flow with a name dialog, so a remote browser can create and open a workspace instead of an OS dialog appearing on the Host screen.
description.zh: 將「新增工作區」流程中喺主機彈出嘅資料夾選擇器，改成輸入名稱嘅對話框，令遠端瀏覽器可以直接建立並開啟工作區。

description.en: Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, blocked ⏸️, review 👀, done ✅, plan 💡, bug 🐛). Features seamless lifecycle recovery, optional Jev inference (needs a Jev API key), model tool maintenance, and a visual settings panel.
description.zh: 基于 Jev 决策模型或 Agent 工具为会话自动分类，并将任务阶段直观展示为标题前缀 Emoji（进行中 🚧、阻塞 ⏸️、待验收 👀、已完成 ✅、规划 💡、排障 🐛）。支持生命周期状态自愈、可选 Jev 决策推断（需配置 Jev API Key）、Agent 自主标记与可视化设置面板。

description.en: Channel-grouped session view injected into the sidebar — Workspace/Channels tabs with live-running dots, archived grouping, orphan tagging, built purely on official extension surfaces and serving as the RFC-0001 reference implementation.
description.zh: 侧边栏注入的按渠道分组会话视图——工作区/Channels 双标签、运行中绿点、归档折叠与孤儿工作区标注，完全基于官方扩展面实现，兼作 RFC-0001（discussion #3897）的参考实现。

description.en: Phone-first web client for DeepSeek Harness whose /m/ page serves a compact mobile UI instead of proxying the full desktop UI, with approvals staying on the phone when the phone started the turn and Mermaid rendered on the device.
description.zh: 手机优先的 DeepSeek Harness 客户端，/m/ 页面提供紧凑的手机界面而不是代理完整桌面 UI；手机发起的 turn 审批留在手机，Mermaid 在设备上渲染。

description.en: Rewrites a composer draft into a clearer, structured prompt (5 modes, model fallback chain, optional multi-round memory) and adds stop-on-silence, hotkey and filler-word cleanup to DSH voice input; transcription stays with the official speechToText, the plugin ships no engine.
description.zh: 把输入框草稿改写为更清晰、结构化的提示词（5 模式·模型回退链·可选多轮记忆），并为 DSH 语音输入加上说完自动停、热键与口水词清理；识别仍由官方 speechToText 提供，插件不自带引擎。

description.en: Compliantly use your own Antigravity quota in dsh: bridges your local logged-in official Antigravity CLI (agy) session as the chat and subagent model provider.
description.zh: 合规地在 dsh 中使用你自己的 Antigravity 额度：将本机已登录的官方 Antigravity CLI（agy）会话桥接为主对话与子代理模型提供方。

description.en: Plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the DeepSeek Harness web UI when it loads, then fades out on its own.
description.zh: 网页加载时在 DeepSeek Harness 界面上播放一段水墨鲸跃动画，随后自行淡出。

description.en: In-harness plugin market for the dsh web GUI: browse the awesome-dsh-plugin.com catalog and install/uninstall plugins into a profile from Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market.
description.zh: dsh Web GUI 内的社区插件市场：浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 目录，从 设置 → 插件 → 插件市场 安装/卸载插件到 profile。

description.en: Desktop-bundle fork of the DeepSeek Harness team's dsh-superagent research prototype: turns requests from allowed people on GitHub issues or Feishu into tickets worked by isolated DSH sessions, with a panel for sources, setup, prompts and run history. By default only people on a source's allowed list can start work. Needs git 2.32+ and the gh CLI for one GitHub repository; Feishu is optional and needs lark-cli.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 团队 dsh-superagent 研究原型的桌面 bundle 分支：把名单内的人在 GitHub issue 或飞书里提出的请求变成工单，交给相互隔离的 DSH 会话处理，面板里管理来源、部署、提示词与运行记录。默认只有来源名单里的人能发起工作。GitHub 来源需要 git 2.32+ 与 gh CLI；飞书可选，需要 lark-cli。

description.en: Drop-in replacement for the Node.js subprocess runner with a NativeAOT binary, cutting per-spawn overhead by 59-67% (p50 156ms to 63ms) while staying byte-identical on 28 A/B cases; Windows x64 only, requires a one-line upstream patch, and ships disabled until you set enabled: true.
description.zh: 子进程 runner 的 NativeAOT 替代实现：每次调用开销降低 59~67%（p50 156ms → 63ms），28 个用例与 Node 版字节级一致；仅限 Windows x64，当前需要一个上游补丁，且装上后默认关闭，需在 profile 里设 enabled: true 才生效。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the model is busy; per-session merit is stored locally, and the sprite can be swapped for custom art.
description.zh: 右下角电子木鱼，默认是鲸鱼娘图包：敲头记功德，模型忙碌时自动敲；功德按会话存本机，可换自定义图源。

description.en: Windows computer use forked from computer-user: 13 computer_* tools that read the screen and drive the mouse and keyboard. Image-capable routes get the screenshot as a real image with an exact image-to-screen mapping, so no external OCR; elements return as UI Automation refs so a click lands on the exact control rectangle; Ctrl+Alt+Esc stops every call.
description.zh: computer-user 分叉的 Windows 电脑操作插件：13 个 computer_* 工具，读取屏幕并驱动鼠标键盘。模型支持图像输入时截图直接作为图片返回，附精确的图像→屏幕映射，无需外接 OCR；控件以 UI Automation 引用返回，点击落在精确矩形上；Ctrl+Alt+Esc 可阻断所有调用。

description.en: Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to independent verifiers tasked with refuting it, and one refutation drops it.
description.zh: 对抗式代码审查：多个 finder 并行地从不同视角（正确性、生命周期、契约、安全）审查改动，随后每条发现都交给独立验证者去推翻它，只要有一票推翻就丢弃。

description.en: Adds AMD Radeon Cloud as a model provider in DeepSeek Harness, with reasoning-effort levels declared per model. The provider definition ships in the plugin's own patch layer rather than in your profile.
description.zh: 把 AMD Radeon Cloud 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器，思考档位按模型逐个声明。provider 定义随插件自带的补丁层交付，而不是写进 profile。

description.en: Windows GUI automation reliability layer: probes whether a window is minimized, foreground or DPI-scaled, then clicks and types with the coordinate space and activation order handled for you. Zero dependencies, local only.
description.zh: Windows 窗口操作的可靠性层：先体检目标窗口是否最小化、是否在前台、有没有 DPI 缩放，再点击与输入——坐标口径和激活顺序由它处理。零依赖、纯本地、不联网。

description.en: Phone-side command center rather than a web-UI mirror: dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from a PWA, tool-approval push notifications with phone/desktop first-answer-wins racing (never auto-approved), a multi-machine session board, and an end-to-end encrypted zero-knowledge relay you can self-host.
description.zh: 面向手机的指挥台而非 Web UI 镜像：从 PWA 把任务派发进隔离的 git worktree，工具审批推送通知支持手机/桌面「谁先答谁算」（绝不自动批准），多机会话看板，以及可自建的端到端加密零知识中继。

description.en: Global cross-session todo inbox for DSH web: any session's agent records human-action todos (merge MRs, approve work orders, reviews) via inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list; a sidebar entry shows a count badge and an expandable list to open and complete them, persisted to ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json.
description.zh: DSH Web 全局跨会话待办收件箱：任意会话的 agent 通过 inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list 登记等待人类处理的事项（合并 MR、审批工单、评审等）；侧边栏入口显示未完成数角标与可展开的待办列表，支持打开与完成，数据持久化到 ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json。

description.en: Browser tab favicon mirrors the DSH session state (idle / running / asking / done), recolored and animated from one base SVG entirely in the browser, with colors and effects configurable from the Settings page.
description.zh: 浏览器标签页 favicon 实时反映 DSH 会话状态（待机 / 运行中 / 提问 / 完成）：单个 base.svg 在浏览器端上色与动画，颜色与特效均可在设置页配置。

description.en: Adds up to 3 clickable next-action chips under a reply; clicking one fills the input draft and never sends.
description.zh: 在回复下方给出至多 3 条可点击的下一步建议；点击只填入输入框，不会自动发送。

description.en: Right-click menus on artifact cards and file links: copy the full or short path, show the file in its folder, or open it in its default app.
description.zh: 给会话里的产物卡片和文件链接加上右键菜单：复制完整或短路径、打开所在文件夹、用默认程序打开。

description.en: Shows a six-character session id badge next to the conversation title in the DSH web UI; clicking it copies the full session id and shows a short confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面的对话标题旁显示 6 位 session id 徽标，点击即复制完整 session id 并给出短暂提示。

description.en: A Phone tab in dsh-better-sidebar: SMS and calls over Twilio and SIP lines bridged through Asterisk, call audio through your server, Live, Voicemail and Do not disturb modes with live voicemail transcripts, a Telegram account with chats, voice messages and calls, and phone_* and telegram_* agent tools. Requires dsh-better-sidebar, Node 22.5+, a Twilio account with a voice and SMS number, a public HTTPS host for provider webhooks, and the bundled Go daemons built from a checkout (Telegram also needs your own api_id/api_hash).
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 里的 Phone 标签页：通过 Twilio 与经 Asterisk 桥接的 SIP 线路收发短信和通话，通话音频走你的服务器，提供 Live、Voicemail、勿扰模式与实时语音信箱转写，并可挂一个 Telegram 账号（聊天、语音消息、通话），以及 phone_* / telegram_* agent 工具。需要 dsh-better-sidebar、Node 22.5+、带语音与短信号码的 Twilio 账号、可供服务商 webhook 访问的公网 HTTPS 地址，以及从 checkout 构建的 Go daemon（Telegram 还需自备 api_id/api_hash）。

description.en: Grouped on/off switches for the skills a DSH profile exposes: the effective set is the union of the groups that are switched on, with a catalog-derived group for the skills shipped with the harness, a panel over the composer, and skill_toggles_* tools for agents.
description.zh: 按分组开关 DSH 暴露的技能：生效集合是所有启用中分组的并集；含成员由当前目录判定的自带技能分组、输入框上的面板，以及给智能体的 skill_toggles_* 工具。

description.en: Five warm, low blue-light color themes that retint the whole DSH interface, including the sidebar, popups and shadows, without touching layout. Palettes are switched under Settings → General.
description.zh: 五套低蓝光暖色配色，整体重着色 DSH 界面（含侧栏、浮层与阴影），零布局改动，卸载即还原。在「设置 → 通用」中切换配色。

description.en: Windows x64 only, 0.5.4 preview: two scoped tools (dragon_browser and dragon_desktop) that drive a visible browser through the DOM or CDP and Windows apps through UI Automation, with per-origin and per-executable read/control scopes, batch steps, a physical-Esc emergency stop and a redacted action log. 0.5.4 only widens the DSH compatibility range to 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1.x, because 0.5.3 pinned it to an exact DSH version and was silently skipped on DSH Desktop 0.2.1. Two long-lived native processes remove the per-action process spawn, so a single key step takes about 0.7 s on the same machine; when another window steals the foreground the step is aborted instead of typing into the wrong place. The browser side ships its own Edge/Chrome launcher and CDP client, so it no longer needs another browser plugin or the Electron runtime. It is not an OS sandbox; logins, admin windows and secure desktops stay with the user.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows x64，0.5.4 预览版：两个受控工具（dragon_browser 与 dragon_desktop），网页走 DOM/CDP、桌面走 Windows UI Automation，按网站来源和可执行文件分 read/control 权限，支持多步 batch、物理 Esc 急停与脱敏动作日志。0.5.4 只是把 DSH 兼容范围放宽到 0.2.0-rc.2 至 0.2.1.x——0.5.3 把版本钉死，在 DSH Desktop 0.2.1 上会被宿主静默跳过。原生命令改成两个常驻进程，省掉每次动作重新起进程，同机单步按键约 0.7 秒；前台被别的窗口抢走时直接中止这一步，不会把字打到别处。网页侧自带 Edge/Chrome 启动器与 CDP 客户端，不再依赖其他浏览器插件或 Electron 运行时。它不是系统沙箱，登录、管理员窗口和安全桌面仍由用户处理。

description.en: Per-conversation system prompt studio for DeepSeek Harness. Append text, shadow-replace one named first-party prompt section, or replace the whole system prompt; changes apply on the next model request without a restart. Overrides persist per session and are inherited by forked conversations along the parent chain, with a Pin action to freeze the inherited result locally. The panel lists the real assembled sections and guards unsaved edits.
description.zh: 按对话管理 DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词：追加文本、按名替换某一第一方段落，或整段替换，保存后下一次模型请求即生效，无需重启。覆盖按会话持久化，fork 出的对话会沿父链继承上游规则，并可用「在此固定」把继承结果固化成本地规则。面板会列出真实的装配段清单，并对未保存的修改做保护。

description.en: Adds a Share to chat action under each reply: converts the answer to WeChat or WeCom text, ordered segments or a long image, editable-table email HTML, or a downloadable Word document.
description.zh: 在每条回复下加「分享到聊天」：把回答转成微信/企微可直接粘贴的文本、分段或长图、可编辑表格的邮件 HTML，或直接下载 Word 文档。

description.en: A mode dropdown in the composer that switches models through the host's own session.selectModel — Plan, Act and any number of user-defined modes, each with its own provider, model, reasoning effort and optional instruction that joins the system prompt while that mode is active — plus a soft switch into Plan mode and a forced switch to Act when a plan is approved, with per-workspace overrides for Plan and Act.
description.zh: 在对话框里加一个模式下拉框，通过宿主自己的 session.selectModel 换模型：Plan、Act 与任意个自定义模式各自绑定 provider、模型、思考复杂度，并可各带一段在该模式生效时隐式加入系统提示词的指令；进入 plan 时软切换到 Plan，批准计划时强制切到 Act，Plan 与 Act 支持按工作区覆盖。

description.en: Draws the sidebar navigation as a compact two-column grid at every viewport; on narrow, short or coarse-pointer screens it additionally caps the navigation at 34vh with scrolling so the workspace and session history keep a 38vh floor. Also repairs dsh-resource:// records whose protocol the browser URL parser reports as empty.
description.zh: 把侧栏导航在所有视口下都重画成紧凑双列网格；窄屏、矮窗口或粗指针设备上再加一层限制——导航最高 34vh 并允许滚动，给工作区与会话历史留出 38vh 下限。同时修复浏览器把 dsh-resource:// 记录协议判空导致的资源不可用。

description.en: Stripe Style theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a 40px purple grid, layered soft shadows, 12px cards, an 8px control scale, and an in-settings theme row with Daylight Violet and Midnight Navy palettes plus one-click factory restore.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Stripe 风格主题：40px 紫色网格、多级柔和阴影、12px 卡片与 8px 控件圆角，设置页内可直接切换「白昼紫 / 午夜蓝」双版本，并可一键恢复出厂外观。

description.en: Generate and edit images, generate video, and cut video locally through a GenBox server, with a zero-key test bench.
description.zh: 通过本地 GenBox 服务生图、改图、生视频，并用 ffmpeg 本地剪辑；自带零成本测试台。

description.en: On-screen test-progress HUD for DSH — a click-through panel drawn over the app under test, showing each step's expectation vs actual and whether the waiting human may take back the mouse and keyboard. Ships a universal prebuilt binary (arm64 + x86_64), so no Xcode Command Line Tools are needed; the panel itself requires macOS 14+.
description.zh: 把自动测试的进展画在被测界面之上的浮层：每步的期待与实际，以及等待的人现在能不能动鼠标键盘。包内附带通用预编译二进制（arm64 + x86_64），无需 Xcode 命令行工具；浮层面板自身要求 macOS 14 及以上。

description.en: Runs shell commands on machines you have paired with eXe, over its relay, and reads images back from them as image blocks for the model: three model tools (device list, shell, image — take a screenshot with the shell tool, then read the file), plus a sidebar page that shows the caller address of this machine, edits the device and trusted-caller lists with labels, and times a real call to each device on demand. Needs the eXe client running on those machines and a caller key from `exe mcp init` on this machine.
description.zh: 在你已与 eXe 配对的机器上跑 shell，并把设备上的图片作为图片内容块交给模型，往返经 eXe 中继：三个模型工具（设备列表、shell、图片——截图需先用 shell 工具生成再读回），外加一页侧边栏——本机调用方地址、可改名的设备与受信调用方清单，以及按设备一键测量一次真实调用的往返耗时。那些机器上需运行 eXe 客户端，本机需有 `exe mcp init` 生成的调用方键。

description.en: Learning Mode agent preset: a coding agent that teaches while coding — concrete scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and TODO(你) practice blanks, modeled on Claude Code's Learning output style; installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-learning-mode on npm).
description.zh: 学习模式（Learning Mode）Agent 预设：边做边教的编码 Agent——具体的情景化阐释、苏格拉底式引导、TODO(你) 留白练习，模拟 Claude Code 的 Learning 输出风格；可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-learning-mode）。

description.en: Adds a sidebar panel to the DeepSeek Harness web UI that reports token usage and cost straight from DeepSeek's own usage API (today's spend, 7/30-day trends, today's hourly split, a history table, cost breakdown, peak/off-peak tier pricing), plus per-session detail from local logs. Zero-config: it reads the browser sign-in for the official figures, and falls back to local session logs with the source labelled.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏加入 Token 用量与花费面板：直接采用 DeepSeek 官方用量接口（今日消费、7/30 天趋势、今日分时、历史表、成本构成、峰谷分档计价），并用本机会话日志给出按会话明细。凭据零配置——自动读取浏览器登录态取官方数据，取不到时退回本地日志并标明来源。

description.en: Normalizes malformed token-usage samples so broken session histories remain loadable.
description.zh: 规范化异常的 Token 用量样本，使损坏的会话历史仍可加载。

description.en: Shares one set of Markdown memory files between DSH and WorkBuddy: project memory, user memory and the user profile are injected into the session context, while daily notes stay out of the prompt and are read, appended and archived through the tools. Six tools (status, read, search, append, edit, prune) write back through a cross-process lock, revision check, backup and atomic write, and a panel in the left rail and the right sidebar edits entries, sections and whole files.
description.zh: 让 DSH 与 WorkBuddy 共用一套 Markdown 记忆文件：项目记忆、用户记忆与用户画像会注入会话上下文，当日笔记不进提示词，只通过工具读取、追加与归档。六个工具（status、read、search、append、edit、prune）写回时统一经过跨进程锁、修订号校验、备份与原子写；左侧栏与右侧边栏的面板可编辑条目、整节与整份文件。

description.en: Brings McDonald's China official MCP (mcp.mcd.cn) into DSH. Paste a token you generated yourself and the plugin handshakes, calls tools/list, and registers every remote tool as a native DSH tool (mcd_ prefix) — upstream additions and removals need no code change, just a restart. Ships four always-on tools (mcd_status, mcd_test, mcd_tools, mcd_call) for self-checks and direct fallback calls, plus a settings page with a one-click connection test. The token is stored only on this machine in ~/.dsh/dsh-mcd-mcp.json (mode 600); it never enters the repository or the conversation context.
description.zh: 把麦当劳中国官方 MCP(mcp.mcd.cn)接入 DSH。粘贴自己在官网生成的 Token 后，插件会握手并调用 tools/list，把远端全部工具自动注册成 DSH 原生工具(mcd_ 前缀)，官方增删工具无需改代码，重启即同步。另附 mcd_status、mcd_test、mcd_tools、mcd_call 四个常驻工具用于自检与兜底直调，设置页可一键测试连通性。Token 只存本机 ~/.dsh/dsh-mcd-mcp.json(权限 600)，不进仓库、不进对话上下文。

description.en: Runs git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work inside the agent sandbox; exposes 8 agent tools (status, diff, log, stage, commit, push, fetch, pull) and 11 slash commands including /git-status, /git-commit, /git-tag and /git-name-set.
description.zh: 在宿主进程中执行 git，使 push、pull、fetch 在 agent 沙箱内可用；提供 8 个 agent 工具（status、diff、log、stage、commit、push、fetch、pull）与 11 个斜杠命令，包括 /git-status、/git-commit、/git-tag 与 /git-name-set。

description.en: Agent-native API client for DeepSeek Harness: Postman-like debugging UI (request tree with context menus and full keyboard navigation, resizable sidebar, layered auto-generated header preview with per-item suppression and constant secret masking), six api_client_* agent tools sharing the same request core, redaction and audit chain with the human UI, Postman Collection v2.1 import with a migration report, environment variables with SecretRef indirection, and a fail-closed SSRF network policy.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 原生 API Client：Postman 级调试 UI（右键菜单与完整键盘导航的请求树、可调宽侧栏、自动生成 Header 分层预览——逐项可停用、敏感值恒脱敏），六个 api_client_* Agent 工具与 Human UI 共用同一请求核心、脱敏与审计链，Postman Collection v2.1 导入附迁移报告，环境变量经 SecretRef 间接引用，SSRF 网络策略默认 fail-closed。

description.en: Ren'Py galgame production workbench: a host-side project service (write gateway plus git snapshots, a dialogue/scene dialect parser, derived progress, human-only review stamps, pinned-SDK validation and playtest, local publish) behind one seam, driven by an embedded web panel and agent tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里制作 Ren'Py galgame 的工作台：宿主侧项目服务（写网关 + git 快照、方言子集解析器、推导进度、只由人盖的审读戳、钉版 SDK 校验与试玩、本地发布）收在一条接缝后面，由内置 Web 工作台面板与 agent 工具驱动。

description.en: Live CNY cost of the current session under the composer, priced per assistant message by the model that produced it and the peak or off-peak window of its own timestamp, with a Settings page that edits the six prices of every model and marks a model with no rate card with a leading tilde because it is costed from the Flash rates.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示当前会话的人民币费用，每条消息按其自身时间戳与该条所用模型的峰谷单价计价；设置页可编辑每个模型的六项单价，未定价的模型按 Flash 单价估算并以 ~ 标注。

description.en: Per-workspace session defaults for DeepSeek Harness: save the Agent preset, permission preset, model, reasoning effort, Chat work-details level and collapse timing per workspace; new or reused blank sessions in that workspace start from them.
description.zh: 按工作区保存 DeepSeek Harness 的会话默认值：模式、权限预设、模型、推理强度、Chat 工作步骤展示与收起时机；在该工作区新建或复用的空白会话自动应用这些值。

description.en: Registers a configurable prompt variable so an agent preset whose persona uses complete: true can still receive an injected text block; the plugin ships no content of its own and reads the text from its config.
description.zh: 注册一个可配置的 prompt 变量，让使用 complete: true 人格的 agent 预设也能收到一段注入文本；插件本身不含内容，文本由配置提供。

description.en: Adds a Plan/Build mode toggle to the composer, switched with the Tab key or a toolbar button, and remembers a separate model for each mode from the native model selector.
description.zh: 在输入框中提供 Plan/Build 模式切换：按 Tab 键或点击工具栏按钮即可切换，并按模式分别记住右侧原生模型选择器中所选的模型。

description.en: Floating ZenTao work center: a right-edge sidebar listing tasks, bugs and stories assigned to you, with drag-to-chat, original links and auto-refresh.
description.zh: 悬浮禅道工作台：右侧边栏展示指派给你的任务、Bug 与需求，支持拖拽到聊天、原始链接与自动刷新。

description.en: Adds a checkbox-style switch at the right end of the Installed group header on the DSH Plugins page: it opens a checklist of the unofficial plugins, all checked by default, and toggles only the ones you keep checked. Once everything is off the button flips to enabling them again. Disable/enable only — it never uninstalls a plugin or deletes plugin files and configuration, and its UI copy follows the app language.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页的「已安装」分组标题右端加一个勾选式开关：点开是当前方向下非官方插件的清单，默认全选，只切换你保留勾选的那些；全部停用后按钮翻转成启用侧。只做启用/停用，从不卸载插件、也不删除插件文件与配置，界面文案跟随应用语言。

description.en: DSH Skill Manager: browse, enable/disable, import from Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork, auto-discover skills with symlink support.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器：浏览、启用/禁用、从 Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork 导入，自动发现技能并支持软链接。

description.en: Web access for DSH agents: fetch JS-rendered or protected pages as clean markdown, aggregated search across 14 engines, and stateful interactive sessions (click, type, scroll, eval, screenshot) against a hosted or self-hosted Rust browser engine. Every session returns a live view URL so a human can watch the agent browse and take over with the mouse.
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的网页访问层：把 JS 渲染或受保护的页面抓成干净 markdown，聚合搜索 14 个引擎，并提供有状态交互会话（点击、输入、滚动、eval、截图），引擎可托管可自部署（Rust 单二进制）。每个会话带直播页 URL，人能实时围观 agent 浏览并用鼠标接管。

description.en: Tracks API token usage and estimated costs with per-route model pricing, optional billing groups, synchronized CNY/USD display, session reports, composer totals and a clickable daily sidebar total.
description.zh: 按 API 路由与模型配置单价，统计 Token 用量与估算费用，支持可选账单分组、同步切换 CNY/USD，以及会话报告、输入框费用和可点击的侧边栏今日金额。

description.en: Auto-switches the agent to ultra-compressed caveman-style output during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, price x2) and shows a status badge plus transition toasts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，价格 ×2）自动切换 caveman 超精简输出省 token，标题栏常驻状态徽章，档位切换时弹提醒。

description.en: Code preview for dsh-better-sidebar with per-language syntax highlighting, symbol outline, in-file search, and selection-to-conversation.
description.zh: 为 dsh-better-sidebar 提供代码预览：按文件类型语法高亮、符号大纲、文件内查找，选中代码可直接加入对话。

description.en: Local OCR using Apple Vision on macOS: text from screenshots, photos, and scans, with no install, no network and no API key.
description.zh: 在 macOS 上使用 Apple Vision 的本地 OCR：从截图、照片和扫描件中读取文字，无需安装、无需联网、无需 API 密钥。

description.en: Login gate for the dsh web UI: unauthenticated visitors get a login/register page and the first registrant becomes admin; includes user and role management plus login and access audit logs.
description.zh: 用户管理：给 dsh web 加登录门禁，未登录访问弹登录/注册页，首个注册者自动成为管理员；管理员可管理用户/角色，带登录与访问审计。

description.en: Replaces the composer's model selector with a starfield popup that sets the model and its reasoning effort in one control, and remaps the current effort to the nearest level the new model declares instead of failing the switch.
description.zh: 把输入框的模型选择器换成星光滑轨弹层，模型与思考强度由一个控件设置；切换模型时若目标模型没有当前档位，自动落到最接近的一档，不再报错。

description.en: Turns the DSH web UI into the H.D.D Hollow Deep Dive terminal from Zenless Zone Zero: the sidebar and composer are reskinned. Ships a small read-only host half plus the web skin; switch it off and DSH returns to its native light UI.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成《绝区零》H.D.D 空洞深潜系统的深蓝终端：侧栏与输入框整体换装。插件含一个只读的宿主半边与前端皮肤；关掉即回 DSH 原生白底。

description.en: Token-efficient persona runtime for DeepSeek Harness with local catgirl rendering and progressive tool-schema disclosure.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的省 token 人格运行时：本地渲染猫娘风味，并支持渐进式工具 schema 披露。

description.en: Caddy forward_auth administrator login for DeepSeek Harness Web, with Argon2id passwords, revocable sessions, bilingual UI, and a native sidebar sign-out action.
description.zh: 通过 Caddy forward_auth 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供管理员登录，含 Argon2id 口令、可撤销会话、中英界面和侧栏原生退出。

description.en: Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex and Grok web search and deep research.
description.zh: 将 codex-web-search-mcp 注册为 DSH 原生 MCP 工具（codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch），提供与模型无关的 Codex / Grok 联网搜索与深度研究。

description.en: Tracks DSH's file reads, image views, and code edits in WakaTime, including exact counts of lines added and deleted by AI. Keeps activity tracking running while DSH responds, batches updates across files, and coordinates per-project reporting limits across parallel DSH processes. Automatically installs and updates wakatime-cli.
description.zh: 在 WakaTime 中记录 DSH 读取文件、查看图片和编辑代码的活动，并准确统计 AI 新增和删除的代码行数。DSH 回复期间持续记录活动，多个文件的记录批量上报，并在并行运行的 DSH 进程间统一控制各项目的上报频率。自动安装和更新 wakatime-cli。

description.en: Estimates what each conversation costs, with built-in official prices from 16 vendors (DeepSeek peak/off-peak hours and long-context tiers included), a breakdown panel with a currency picker under the composer, and each conversation's cost in the sidebar.
description.zh: 估算每个对话的费用：内置 16 家厂商的官方价格（含 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段和长上下文阶梯价），输入框下方可展开明细并切换币种，侧边栏显示每个对话的费用。

description.en: Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search at organization or project scope, single issue detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed stacktrace. Local variables, request headers and bodies, query strings, packages and secret-looking tags are removed before the event reaches the model, and oversized events degrade through source context, breadcrumbs and frames rather than failing.
description.zh: 面向 Sentry 的只读工具：项目列表、组织或项目范围的议题搜索、单个议题详情，以及最新或指定 event 的裁剪后堆栈。局部变量、请求头与请求体、查询字符串、依赖清单以及疑似机密的 tag 会在 event 交给模型前移除；超大 event 会依次降级源码上下文、面包屑与栈帧，而不是直接失败。

description.en: Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools over the REST API both projects share: instance info, repository listing, issue and pull request search and read, PR diffs and changed files, and Actions runs, jobs and job logs. Tool metadata is available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.
description.zh: 面向自建 Gitea / Forgejo 的只读工具，走两者共用的 REST API：实例信息、仓库列表、议题与 PR 搜索和读取、PR diff 与变更文件，以及 Actions 运行、任务与任务日志。工具元数据支持英文、繁体中文、简体中文与日文。

description.en: Cross-session memory and a per-workspace knowledge base in one plugin. Memories are plain JSONL under ~/.dsh/memory by default; each session starts with the relevant ones already in the system prompt and writes one back when it ends. A read-only kb/ folder per workspace plus one global folder is searched with results cited down to file lines. Eleven tools under a scribe_ prefix (seven scribe_memory_*, four scribe_kb_*), a /scribe slash command, and a settings page with overview, memory, knowledge base and migration tabs. Cloud backends (Bailian memory library, ChromaDB, cloud-primary with local mirror) are opt-in; moving data between them requires an explicit approval and is logged so it can be rolled back.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆与工作区知识库合一。记忆默认是 ~/.dsh/memory 下的纯 JSONL，会话开始把相关记忆放进系统提示，会话结束回写一条；每个工作区的 kb/ 目录加一份全局目录构成只读知识库，检索结果能引用到文件行号。十一个工具统一带 scribe_ 前缀（七个 scribe_memory_*、四个 scribe_kb_*），一个 /scribe 斜杠命令，以及概览 / 记忆 / 知识库 / 迁移四页的设置页。云端后端（百炼记忆库、ChromaDB、云端主 + 本地镜像）按需启用；迁移数据必须经显式审批，并留有可回滚的日志。

description.en: One-click update for the local DeepSeek Harness checkout — compare versions, pull and rebuild, then restart, and roll back to any past release, all from a sidebar panel with live progress.
description.zh: 一键更新本地 DeepSeek Harness：侧边栏按钮对比版本、拉取重建并自动重启，还可选择回退到任一历史版本，全程实时进度。

description.en: Browser system notification, sounded by the OS notification itself, when a session needs a reply or a run goes idle; no page-focus check, at most one notification per session with a newer one replacing the old, and an idle notice reports how many background tasks are still running.
description.zh: 会话出现待回复交互或一轮跑完落到空闲时弹出浏览器系统通知，提示音由系统通知自带；不判断页面是否聚焦，每个会话最多保留一条通知、新通知顶掉旧的，空闲时若还有后台任务会在正文里说明数量。

description.en: Six independently togglable modules in one DSH plugin: per-turn CNY cost, DeepSeek account balance, PDF/Word/Excel/CSV read-write tools with right-sidebar preview, a compiler/runtime environment registry, and run/build tools that execute a program or an MSBuild project by environment id. Toolchain paths are resolved at run time (Visual Studio install-root scan, %ProgramFiles%, PATH) and can be overridden per environment through plugin config, so nothing is pinned to the author's machine.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件里的六个可独立开关的模块：每轮对话的人民币成本、DeepSeek 账户余额、PDF/Word/Excel/CSV 直接读写工具与右栏预览、编译/运行环境表，以及按环境名执行程序或编译 MSBuild 工程的 run/build 工具。工具链路径在运行时解析（扫描 Visual Studio 安装根、%ProgramFiles%、PATH），并可在插件配置里逐个环境覆盖，没有写死在作者机器上的路径。

description.en: Shows MiniMax Token Plan usage beside the DSH Web UI model selector with compact 5h/7d bars, click-to-refresh, automatic idle and heartbeat refreshes, and endpoint fallback. Reuses subscription keys configured under Settings → Model and appears only for MiniMax Token Plan providers.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 模型选择器旁显示 MiniMax Token Plan 用量，以紧凑的 5h/7d 进度条展示，支持点击刷新、空闲与心跳自动刷新及接口回退；复用「设置 → 模型」中的订阅 Key，且仅在 MiniMax Token Plan provider 下显示。

description.en: Portrait layout for desktop windows: when the browser window is portrait, navigation takes the full left column and the file/terminal panel moves to the upper right above the conversation, with a draggable splitter setting its height (initial height configurable). Phones and tablets are untouched.
description.zh: 竖屏布局（仅电脑窗口）：浏览器窗口为竖屏时，左侧导航占整列，文件 / 终端面板移到对话区上方（右上），中间分隔线可拖拽调整高度（初始高度可配）。手机 / 平板不受影响。

description.en: Cost panel for DeepSeek Harness: meters every request from session events, prices it against a built-in catalog of 136 models across 16 providers, and shows the current model, account balance, session, today and month spend plus a monthly budget bar next to the composer. Bilingual zh/en.
description.zh: DSH 费用统计面板：从 session 事件采集每次请求用量，按内置 16 家厂商 136 个模型的价格目录实时计费，在输入框旁展示当前模型、账户余额、本会话/今日/本月消费与月度预算横条。中英双语。

description.en: Take over context compaction on both the manual and the automatic path, each runnable by a compaction model (falling back to a second model, or used directly) or by a mechanical fold that builds the summary card locally with no model call; the fold goes through the same official compaction transaction, so the replaced events stay in the append-only session log under their sequence numbers. It adapts code from dsh-compact-saviour and takes the mechanical fold from dsh-ledger-compact (both MIT) — install it instead of dsh-compact-saviour, not alongside it.
description.zh: 接管上下文压缩：手动与自动压缩都可选用模型压缩（支持备用模型兜底或直接使用备用模型），或选用机械折页——在本地把旧历史整理成摘要卡，不调用模型、不消耗 token；折页走官方压缩事务，被替换的原始事件仍以原序号留在只追加的会话日志里。代码改编自 dsh-compact-saviour、折页算法取自 dsh-ledger-compact（均为 MIT），请替代 dsh-compact-saviour 安装，不要两者同装。

description.en: Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine, and hover it for a speed and voice panel. Text is sent to an unofficial Edge TTS endpoint.
description.zh: 在每条已定稿的助手回复里、紧挨点赞按钮右侧加一个小喇叭：点击用浏览器语音引擎朗读这条回复，鼠标悬停可调倍速与音色；文本会发送到非官方的 Edge TTS 端点。

description.en: A research library panel and skill set for DSH: project folders, figures with registered provenance, drafts, references, data tables, journal profiles and submissions, plus writing, citation and Origin-plotting discipline for research agents.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的科研库面板与技能组：课题目录、带溯源的图表登记、草稿、文献、数据表、期刊档案、投稿台账，以及面向科研智能体的写作、引用与 Origin 出图纪律（出图需另装 dsh-origin-plugin）。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a ~600-character hot layer that evicts its own overflow, month-archived cold entries recalled by keyword and ranked by usage, and extractive day/week/month summaries.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的分层长期记忆：热层约 600 字、超限自动腾挪，冷层按月归档、可按关键词跨月召回并按使用度排序，日/周/月三级抽取式摘要控制注入体量。

description.en: Read-only Odoo tools over JSON-RPC: server info, model field introspection, and a restricted search_read limited to an allow list of models whose domain field names may not contain dots, so related-record traversal is not possible. A draft-create tool is registered only when allowWrite is enabled, and is limited to sale.order and project.task with the draft state enforced by the plugin.
description.zh: 经 JSON-RPC 的 Odoo 只读工具：服务器信息、模型字段自省，以及受限的 search_read——仅限白名单模型，且 domain 字段名不允许包含点号，因此无法沿关联关系穿透。草稿创建工具需显式开启 allowWrite 才会注册，且仅限 sale.order 与 project.task，草稿状态由插件强制。

description.en: Skin author workbench: official token browser (169 --dsw-* variables with Chinese descriptions and module-usage tags), live try-on, durable skin save, theme freeze, seven spectrum presets with SVG backdrops and custom backdrop upload.
description.zh: 皮肤作者工作台：官方 token 浏览器（169 个 --dsw-* 变量，带中文描述与模块标签）、实时试穿、皮肤持久保存、主题固化、7 套光谱预设与 SVG 背景图，以及自定义背景上传。

description.en: About section for the DeepSeek Harness settings: version info, npm latest/next update check with one-click install and auto-restart, and GitHub release history.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中心增加「关于」分区：版本信息、npm 检查更新与一键安装（自动重启）、GitHub 版本更新记录。

description.en: Read-only SonarQube Community Build tools: instance status, project Quality Gate for a branch or pull request, issue and Security Hotspot search, single hotspot detail, and coverage, duplication or caller-selected measures. Issue and hotspot results carry a normalized location with component key, file path, line and text range.
description.zh: 面向 SonarQube Community Build 的只读工具：实例状态、分支或 PR 的项目质量阈、议题与安全热点搜索、单个热点详情，以及覆盖率、重复率或调用方指定的度量项。议题与热点结果附带标准化的位置信息，包含组件 key、文件路径、行号与文本范围。

description.en: Adds a button to the composer that restates your draft, then asks a few questions with clickable options — every question offers an "I don't know, you decide" escape — and only then rewrites the draft into a request an agent can start on. The whole flow can be finished without typing, and it never sends for you.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮：先复述你的草稿，再用可点的选项问几个问题——每题都带一个「我不知道，你替我定」的逃生项——最后把草稿改写成 AI 能直接开工的需求。全程可以一个字都不打，而且它不会替你发送。

description.en: Two switchable design languages for the DSH GUI — liquid glass with inner-lit surfaces and pointer specular, and Soviet constructivism with cream/ink/red poster geometry — plus a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs, and a seven-expression whale-girl pet.
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面的两套可切换设计语言：内部发光的液态玻璃，与米色/血红/墨黑的苏联构成主义海报；附带个性化面板、投放式 CSS 皮肤包与 7 种表情的鲸鱼娘桌宠。

description.en: macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click menu with quiet mode and a session list, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin on your own image tool and credentials; system Python and ctypes, no Electron and no dependencies.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 页面之外的 macOS 桌宠：一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住；六种状态跟着本地 DSH 走，原生右键菜单里有免打扰与会话清单；自带的 skill 用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片变成整套十八个姿势的皮肤。跑系统自带的 Python 与 ctypes，不用 Electron，零依赖。

description.en: Todo sidecar for DeepSeek Harness: turn selected text into a todo, capture todos from a conversation, review them in a left sidebar panel, get due reminders as an in-app popup or an IM bot message, and export everything to HTML, Markdown, Excel, CSV or JSON.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供待办清单：把划选的文字存成待办、从对话里捕获待办、在左侧栏面板里查看与处理、到期用应用内弹窗或机器人推送提醒，还能把全部记录导出成 HTML、Markdown、Excel、CSV 或 JSON。

description.en: Renders GitHub admonition syntax in messages as alert cards, matching the Hermes desktop look.
description.zh: 把消息里的 GitHub admonition 语法渲染成 alert 卡片，视觉对齐 Hermes 桌面端。

description.en: Replaces the composer model menu with a recent-models list, a searchable all-providers flyout and a draggable reasoning-effort slider; a Manage models row at the bottom of the flyout opens the Models settings directly. It takes over the composer model slot, so install only one model-menu plugin.
description.zh: 把输入框的模型菜单换成最近模型列表、可搜索的全部模型飞出面板和一条可拖动的思考强度滑杆；全部模型面板底部的「管理模型」可直接打开设置的模型页。它接管输入框的模型位，请只装一个模型菜单类插件。

description.en: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板中查看、添加、编辑、删除、启用或停用 MCP 服务器，保存后热重载。

description.en: All-in-one UI plugin for DSH Desktop (Windows): conversation-width slider with fullscreen preview and follow-window mode, thinking-block enhancements (forced Chinese, expand/collapse, Markdown rendering), an Open With header button, UI label localization, a resizable settings dialog, session delete, and workspace tabs.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版多功能 UI 插件：对话宽度滑块（按下全屏预览、跟随窗口宽度）、思考块增强（思考/回复强制中文、展开收起、Markdown 渲染）、Open With 头部打开按钮、界面英文标签中文化、设置弹窗窗口化、会话删除与工作区分页。

description.en: OCR for scanned, image-only PDFs into Markdown, built around the fact that a book takes about an hour: every page is checkpointed so an interrupted run resumes, a progress log reports live status, and a quality report names empty pages and low-confidence lines. Requires Python 3.10+ and pip install -r requirements; the first run downloads the OCR model.
description.zh: 把扫描版 PDF（影印书、拍照件）OCR 成 Markdown，并按“一本书要跑约一小时”来设计：逐页写检查点，中断可续跑；进度日志随时可查；质量报告点名空白页和低置信行。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements；首次运行会下载 OCR 模型。

description.en: Token usage and estimated spend for the dsh web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session stats.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量与费用统计插件：右下角悬浮窗，按模型/按天/按会话多维聚合与预计花费。

description.en: Glass weather pill in the session header with 23 weather states, each with its own tint, SVG icon and canvas particle layer, per-field visibility switches, and a get_weather tool backed by keyless Open-Meteo data.
description.zh: 会话顶栏的玻璃天气胶囊：23 种天气状态各自配色、SVG 图标与 canvas 粒子层，可按字段开关显示内容，并注册 get_weather 工具（Open-Meteo 免密钥数据）。

description.en: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the catalog synced automatically, each model routed to the endpoint the official docs assign, and free *-free models hidden by default because they only run inside the OpenCode client.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console (Zen) 模型：在「设置 → 插件」填入 Console API Key 后即可选用 Console 的对话模型，模型目录自动同步，每个模型按官方文档路由到对应端点，免费 *-free 模型默认不列出（它们只能在 OpenCode 客户端内运行）。

description.en: Trip-planning agent preset for mainland China that answers in Chinese: queries 12306 train availability, Fliggy and Tuniu flight and hotel prices, and real Amap transit routes, checks closures and weather, and delivers a single offline HTML roadbook with draggable maps, three hotel price tiers and an itemized budget. Ships 9 skills, an environment doctor that walks users through missing API keys, and a patch for the 12306 MCP server; it plans and queries but never books or pays.
description.zh: 中文旅行规划 agent 预设「旅行规划助手」（面向国内行程）：实时查 12306 余票、飞猪 / 途牛机票与酒店价格、高德真实路线，核实闭馆与天气，交付一份可离线打开的单文件 HTML 路书（可拖动地图、三档酒店、分项预算）；附 9 个技能、引导用户补齐 Key 的环境自检，以及 12306 MCP 的预售期补丁；只规划查询，不代订代付。

description.en: AI-assisted reading workspace for DSH with a local TXT/Markdown/EPUB/PDF library, annotations, prompt presets, long notes, memory, export and companion tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 AI 辅助阅读工作区：本地 TXT/Markdown/EPUB/PDF 书库、批注、提示词预设、长笔记、记忆、导出与伴读工具。

description.en: Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace references, and the resizable file/preview right panel.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 客户端的桌面化 UI 增强：自适应对比度壁纸、带活动流与投喂玩法的桌面宠物、@file 工作区文件引用，以及可缩放的文件/预览右侧面板。

description.en: Shows local glossary definitions when hovering over terms in chat messages.
description.zh: 悬停聊天消息中的术语时显示本地词库释义。

description.en: Open delivered files, changed-file rows and inline file mentions in the system default app with a left click; right-click takeover is configurable: all menus, only where DSH has none, or never. Desktop app only: the Web client has no system-open capability, so clicks stay with DSH.
description.zh: 左键以系统默认程序打开交付文件、改动文件行和对话中的文件提及；右键接管方式可选：全部接管、只接管原生没有菜单的、或完全不接管。仅桌面端可用：Web 端没有系统打开能力，点击仍交给 DSH 原生行为。

description.en: Offline Wikipedia and ZIM lookups through your own kiwix-serve: the wiki_search, wiki_read and wiki_books tools run full-text search with snippets, read an article by exact title, and list the local ZIM library.
description.zh: 通过你自己运行的 kiwix-serve 离线查询维基百科等 ZIM 数据包：wiki_search / wiki_read / wiki_books 三个工具分别做带摘要片段的全文搜索、按精确标题读取全文、列出本地 ZIM 书库。

description.en: Chrome and Edge browser control that drives the real logged-in profile, tabs and cookies through an MV3 extension and a loopback Bridge, exposing browser_* tools, a Skill and /chrome commands.
description.zh: 通过 MV3 扩展和本地 loopback Bridge 驱动用户已登录的真实 Chrome/Edge Profile、标签页与 Cookie，为 DSH 提供 browser_* 工具、Skill 和 /chrome 命令。

description.en: Loader-independent startup recovery for DSH Web that detects likely broken plugins, temporarily skips them, and restores only Boot Guard-managed changes.
description.zh: 独立于常规客户端插件加载链的 DSH Web 启动救援工具，可定位疑似故障插件、临时跳过，并且只恢复 Boot Guard 写入的配置。

description.en: DSH Session Fork Tree Arrangement: forked sessions sit under their parent with an indent and a rounded connector, sessions that own forks carry a green "+" that collapses by default and expands level by level, and hovering a child highlights its ancestor chain.
description.zh: DSH 会话分叉树排列功能：分叉会话缩进排在父会话下方并绘制圆角连接线，有分叉的会话名字右侧带绿色“+”，默认收起、逐层展开，悬停子会话时祖先链高亮。

description.en: Neo-brutalist theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with paper and ink palettes, 4px hard rules, 8px offset shadows, zero radius, hazard stripes, and an in-settings theme row that restores the factory appearance.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的新粗野主义主题：白纸 / 黑板双配色，4px 硬边、8px 偏移硬阴影、零圆角、警示斜纹，设置页内置主题行，可一键切回出厂外观。

description.en: Model channel manager: several provider/model candidates share one virtual route (roundrobin/<group>) with failover, retry, timeout and cooldown; a settings tab edits providers and groups, runs per-model speed tests and real single-model request tests, and a seven-day health panel aggregates latency, failures and upstream token usage (input, output, cache and reasoning).
description.zh: 模型渠道管理：多个供应商/模型候选共享一条虚拟路由（roundrobin/组），带失败转移、重试、超时与冷却；设置页签可编辑供应商与轮询组、跑测速与单模型真实请求测试，健康面板聚合七天延迟、失败与上游 token 用量（输入、输出、缓存、推理）。

description.en: Home Assistant control for DSH: entity states, history, service calls, notifications, weather, and a live home dashboard card.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里控制 Home Assistant：实体状态、历史、服务调用、通知、天气与实时家庭仪表盘卡片。

description.en: Connects a GitHub account to DSH from the composer button (OAuth device flow or a personal access token) and exposes one github_api tool for REST calls — create repositories, write files, read pull requests and workflow runs — with a read-only switch and an in-panel call log. A rewritten fork of Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect (MIT): device-flow Client IDs are no longer rejected, paths may carry query strings and non-ASCII characters, undici is no longer a hard dependency, and the panel has four tabs. Registers the same github_api tool name and the same credential namespace, so it cannot be installed alongside that plugin.
description.zh: 在对话框左下角连接你的 GitHub 账号（设备流或 Personal Access Token），提供一个 github_api 工具直接调 REST 接口——建仓库、写文件、读 PR 与 Actions，带只读开关和调用记录。改自 Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect（MIT）：不再拒收设备流 Client ID，路径可带查询串与非 ASCII 字符，不再硬依赖 undici，面板改成四页签。工具名 github_api 与凭据命名空间都与原插件相同，两者不能同时安装。

description.en: Automatically retries model failures (drops, timeouts, rate limits, 5xx) in-turn. Retry count, delays, backoff, fallback and more are configurable. Rate-limit backoff is capped and jittered, server retry hints are honored, and optional retry-until-success keeps going within a time ceiling. Every option is editable from the plugin config or the sidebar panel: retry count, initial and max delay, backoff factor and jitter, rate-limit delay window, retry-until-success ceiling, fallback trigger and switch cap, dead-route blacklist TTL, log file. When a route keeps failing it can switch to a pinned, allowlist-filtered, or catalog-picked alternate model route, with a 30-minute dead-route blacklist (auth failure, subscription expired, billing) and a stale-assembly guard that keeps retried requests on the switched route. Ships a right-sidebar panel with live retry state, route labels and incident counters, Chinese and English locale, and memory-only logging by default.
description.zh: 自动重试断连类模型失败（传输中断、超时、限流、5xx、流中断），在同一次智能体回合内接管重试而不是让任务直接断掉。所有选项都能在插件配置或右侧栏面板里调整：重试次数、初始与最大延迟、退避系数与抖动、限流延迟窗口、一直重试的时间上限、换路线的触发条件与次数上限、死路黑名单时长、日志文件。限流按指数退避等待并尊重服务端重试提示，开启后可在时间上限内一直重试直到成功。路线持续失败时可自动切换到备选模型路线（可手工固定、白名单过滤或从模型目录挑选），死路（鉴权失败、订阅过期、欠费）拉黑 30 分钟，并有旧装配守卫保证重试请求确实走在新路线上。附右侧栏状态面板（重试状态、路线标签、事故计数），中英双语，默认仅内存日志、可选设置文件。

description.en: One standing system prompt for every workspace: a Custom instructions page in DSH's own Settings panel whose text is added to the system prompt of every session, subagents included, and stored in the profile instead of any project.
description.zh: 所有工作区共用的长期系统提示词：在 DSH 自己的设置面板里新增「自定义指令」页，文本会加入每个会话（含子代理）的系统提示词，并保存在 profile 而不是任何项目里。

description.en: Session management for DeepSeek Harness — an archived-chat list in Settings, permanent deletion from the session menu, and agent tools to list, inspect, create and fork sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话管家：设置里给已归档会话一个列表，会话菜单里给一个真正的删除，并提供列出、查看、新建、分叉会话的模型工具。

description.en: A session-header 3-dots menu: download the session log, switch each chat's transcript between Normal and Verbose, and define what Verbose expands (thinking blocks, tool calls, terminal output).
description.zh: 会话标题栏的三点菜单：可下载会话日志，把每个会话的转录在普通与详细视图间切换，并自定义详细视图展开哪些内容（思考块、工具调用、终端输出）。

description.en: AI research toolkit for DSH: a model release radar, a per-model benchmark and community report from 13 structured leaderboards plus Chinese and English community discussion, and an AI news radar over 46 feeds and 22 official X accounts; registers four tools and three skills and renders every report to Markdown with a generated table of contents.
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 研究工具箱：模型发布雷达、单模型跑分与口碑体检（13 路结构化榜单 + 中英文社区讨论）、覆盖 46 个 Feed 与 22 个官方 X 账号的 AI 新闻雷达；注册 4 个工具 + 3 个技能，报告统一渲染为带目录的 Markdown。

description.en: Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.
description.zh: 电商可视化工作区：在无限画布上完成产品图、虚拟试穿、背景处理与视频生成，并与 Harness 对话实时同步。

description.en: Resumes turns interrupted by a DSH host restart: hooks agent activation (once a session is live), reads the crash-repair turn/end, and sends a continuation that requires verifying real-world state first rather than assuming a side effect succeeded or failed. Permanent failures (AUTH, QUOTA, context overflow) are skipped, with a cross-restart budget, adaptive backoff and a minimal-context payload.
description.zh: DSH 重启后自动续跑被中断的回合：在会话激活后读取崩溃修复写入的 turn/end，投出要求先核对真实状态（不假定外部操作成功或失败）的续跑消息；永久性失败（认证、配额、上下文超限）直接跳过，并有跨重启次数预算、自适应退避与最小上下文注入。

description.en: Annotates pages inside the built-in browser: click an element, write a comment, and send the batch to the conversation as one message, with a cropped screenshot per note where the element can be located.
description.zh: 在内置浏览器里给网页元素写批注，整批发进对话；每条批注附一张能定位到元素的裁剪截图。

description.en: Agent-driven kanban board: one board per workspace, per-task agent sessions, and a guarded human/agent workflow (Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done).
description.zh: agent 驱动的看板：每个工作区一块看板、每个任务一个 agent 会话，以及带护栏的人机协作流程（Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done）。

description.en: Adds a full-screen panel to the DSH composer for writing multi-line text, movable and resizable, sharing one draft with the composer; Enter inserts a newline and only Ctrl+Enter sends, so an IME cannot turn Shift+Enter into a send.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的输入框加一个全屏输入面板，用于书写多行文本，可移动、可调整大小，与主输入框共用同一份草稿；Enter 只换行、仅 Ctrl+Enter 发送，因此中文输入法不会把 Shift+Enter 变成发送。

description.en: A file-view enhancement plugin that extends the official DSH sidebar, providing source view, in-place editing, line number display, search, and font zoom.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 官方侧边栏的文件视图增强插件，提供源码视图、原位编辑、行号显示、搜索和字体缩放功能。

description.en: DSH Desktop workbench for official MATLAB MCP experiments, verified PNG figures, MATLAB-computed metrics, and PID parameter sweep comparisons. Requires Windows, a MATLAB license and the separately installed official MATLAB MCP Server.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 中通过官方 MATLAB MCP 执行实验，校验 PNG 图像及 MATLAB 计算指标，并比较 PID 参数扫描结果。需要 Windows、MATLAB 授权，以及另行安装的官方 MATLAB MCP Server。

description.en: Code workbench in the right sidebar: a workspace file tree and a multi-tab Monaco editor with syntax highlighting and version-guarded saving, Tab completion from DeepSeek fill-in-the-middle, per-save checkpoints with rollback, codebase search (plus a codebase_search tool for the agent), and reference chips that insert a selection into the chat as an @path mention.
description.zh: 右栏的代码工作台：工作区文件树 + 多标签 Monaco 编辑器（语法高亮、版本守卫保存），基于 DeepSeek FIM 的 Tab 补全，按次保存的检查点与回滚，代码库检索（另提供 codebase_search 工具给 Agent），以及把选中代码以 @路径 mention 插入对话的引用胶囊。

description.en: Color presets and a custom paper-color picker for the built-in DSH sidebar PDF, converted Office, and spreadsheet previews, with dark-mode brightness control and locally saved preferences; changes only the display, not the files.
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置侧边栏的 PDF、转为 PDF 的 Office 文档及表格预览提供配色预设与自定义纸张底色，支持深色模式亮度调节和本地保存偏好；只改变显示，不修改文件。

description.en: Detect DSH plugin conflicts and loading failures, quarantine affected bundles and recover them, with offline startup rescue.
description.zh: 检查 DSH 插件冲突与加载故障，隔离和恢复受影响的插件，并在宿主无法启动时提供离线修复。

description.en: Colors DSH sidebar Session rows by their official status, in an Evangelion-flavored palette: a blue left rail for a row awaiting interaction, red for the session open in the main view, purple for finished-but-unviewed, and a static rainbow title for pinned rows. Every colour is mode-scoped — dark keeps the vivid stop, light takes a darker variant solved to clear 4.5:1 against the light wall — and the split reads DSH's own dark marker. Reads official Client services only: it owns no state, never polls, and ships no host-side half.
description.zh: 按官方状态给 DSH 侧栏会话行染色，配色取自福音战士：等你处理的会话为蓝色左轨，主视图打开的那条为红色左轨，已结束但未查看为紫色左轨，置顶行的标题为静态彩虹。左侧轨道按模式分档——暗档保留原色，亮档换成对浅底 ≥4.5:1 的压暗变体——分档读的是 DSH 自己的暗色标记；未读的紫色轨道两种模式共用。只读取官方 Client 服务，自身不持有状态、不轮询，也没有宿主侧代码。

description.en: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official workflow tool: a verbatim fork of the stock tool plus a persisted saved-workflow library (workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved) backed by ctx.storageDomain, so scripts can be stored, retrieved and re-run with new arguments.
description.zh: 官方 workflow 工具的 drop-in 增强版：在逐字 fork 的官方工具之上，用 ctx.storageDomain 提供持久化的 saved workflow 库（workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved），可把编排脚本存库、检索并带新参数重跑。

description.en: ChatGPT-style side chat for the DSH Web GUI: ask small questions about the current topic in a floating side panel, answered by an independent lightweight session over the official /api RPC — the main conversation is never touched. Streaming text, collapsible reasoning, tool chips, stop button, agent-preset selector, and an automatic context snapshot from the visible main chat.
description.zh: ChatGPT 式侧边快速提问：在 DSH Web 聊天界面右侧悬浮面板中就当前话题提小问题，由独立轻量会话通过官方 /api RPC 回答，绝不写入、不影响主对话。流式正文、可折叠思考、工具 chips、停止按钮、agent 预设选择，自动抓取主对话最近内容作为背景。

description.en: Daily and weekly task manager: startup popup reminder, a marquee strip above the composer, one-click circle completion, editable task cards, and a Sunday AI weekly summary, plus a sidebar DeepSeek API usage widget with balance card, today/cumulative tokens and cost, per-model breakdown and a 7-day chart. Persists as JSON under $DSH_HOME.
description.zh: 每日/每周任务管理：启动弹窗提醒、输入框上方滚动条、圆圈一键完成、任务卡片编辑、周日 AI 周总结；另附侧边栏 DeepSeek API 用量小部件（余额卡片、今日与累计 tokens 及费用、按模型明细、近 7 日柱状图）。数据以 JSON 存于 $DSH_HOME。

description.en: One-click launcher for the Web UI: a double-click Start-DSH-Web.cmd on the Windows desktop that boots dsh web and auto-opens the browser (polling until ready), plus a web_launcher model tool (install / open / status).
description.zh: Web 界面一键启动器：在 Windows 桌面创建双击即用的 Start-DSH-Web.cmd（自动启动 dsh web，轮询就绪后自动打开浏览器），并提供 web_launcher 模型工具（install / open / status）。

description.en: Configure official and third-party DSH plugins, MCP servers and skills per client, workspace and session, with separate settings, inheritance and child defaults. Save plugin settings while disabled; update core and Web components independently in Harness.
description.zh: 按客户端、工作区和会话分层配置官方及第三方 DSH 插件、MCP 与 Skill，支持独立配置、逐级继承及下级默认；插件关闭时可保存配置，核心与 Web 界面在 Harness 中分别升级。

description.en: Chat wallpaper for the DSH desktop UI: paint one image from a local folder across the app, tune the left sidebar, main window and right sidebar scrims separately, rotate through a group with fade effects, and add a bar under the composer, a task progress bar and an all-session token total.
description.zh: 聊天背景：把本地图片文件夹里的一张图铺满 DSH 桌面界面；左侧栏、主窗口、右侧栏遮罩可分别调节，支持背景轮换与分组、淡入淡出特效，并提供输入栏背景条、任务进度条与全会话 Token 总用量。

description.en: Refuses agent-generated SQL that reads tables or columns outside a configured blacklist or whitelist, returning a structured permission reason instead of rewriting the query.
description.zh: 拒绝智能体生成的越权 SQL：读取的表或字段不在黑白名单策略内时直接拒绝，返回结构化权限原因，不改写查询。

description.en: Browse and manage the community plugin catalog from a first-level DeepSeek Harness Settings page, with verified installs and updates, removal, pause and resume, installed-package state, and sanitized README previews.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置一级页面中浏览和管理社区插件目录，支持验证后安装与更新、删除、暂停与恢复、已安装状态查看及安全 README 预览。

description.en: Looks up English words in chat replies by click or selection, showing part of speech, Chinese meaning and exam tags; selecting a pure-English sentence translates it. Ships an offline dictionary: 20,499 entries, 8,960 with bilingual examples, 6,374 with root analysis.
description.zh: 点选或划选聊天回复里的英文单词，显示词性、中文释义与考纲标签；划选纯英文句子翻译成中文。词库离线内置：20,499 词条，8,960 个带双语例句，6,374 个带词根分析。

description.en: Read-only Grafana tools that query metrics through the data source proxy: instance health, data source listing, instant and range PromQL queries, current alert state, and provisioned alert rules. Range queries downsample to a point budget; an explicitly supplied step that would exceed it is rejected rather than silently changed, so the model never receives data at a resolution it did not ask for.
description.zh: 面向 Grafana 的只读工具，经数据源代理查询指标：实例健康、数据源列表、instant 与 range PromQL 查询、当前告警状态与已配置的告警规则。range 查询会按点数预算降采样；调用方显式指定的 step 若会超量则直接拒绝，而不是静默改写，避免模型拿到与预期不同分辨率的数据。

description.en: Voice conversation mode for the DSH Web GUI: tap the mic to start a full-screen call, talk hands-free, and hear each reply read aloud as it streams. Bilingual (Chinese/English) UI, light and dark themes, adjustable speech rate, and switchable voices.
description.zh: DSH Web 的语音对话模式：点一下麦克风进入全屏通话，边说边听，AI 回复边生成边朗读。界面中英双语，适配明暗主题，支持语速调节与音色切换。

description.en: Registers a janitor_scan tool that returns a deterministic, reviewable cleanup plan for session debris (plan docs, scratch scripts) with per-file verdicts and evidence; scan-only, never deletes.
description.zh: 注册 janitor_scan 工具：对会话遗留物（计划文档、临时脚本）给出确定性、可审阅的清理计划，逐文件裁决附证据；只扫描，永不删除。

description.en: Per-session fast-delivery mode from the composer. New conversations start enabled; switching is refused while that conversation is running, and a read-only session-header badge shows on/off during a run. One switch drives three subsystems: a circuit breaker that short-circuits test and build commands instead of running them, an apply_patch tool that writes SEARCH/REPLACE hunks atomically (all anchors must match or nothing is written), and a dehydrator that trims terminal output to a pass line or the last 15 error lines.
description.zh: 按会话独立的极速交付模式，从输入框切换。新对话默认开启；对话运行期间拒绝切换，并在会话头部显示只读开/关徽标。一个开关驱动三个子系统：测试与构建命令断路器（不真正执行，直接返回成功回执）、按 SEARCH/REPLACE 冲突块原子写入的 apply_patch 工具（任一锚点未命中则整次回滚）、以及把终端输出脱水成一句通过或最后 15 行错误的脱水器。

description.en: Data asset orchestration engine that chains suite tools into preset pipelines (masking, cleaning, inventory, packaging, attestation, AI dataset health check, government inspection, circulation assessment), with incremental and scheduled processing.
description.zh: 数据资产编排引擎，把套件内工具串成预置流水线（脱敏→清洗→盘点→封装、鉴证、AI数据集体检、政务巡检、可流通性评估），支持增量与定时处理

description.en: Tints the strip above the composer green or red to match DeepSeek's off-peak and peak billing windows, shows the remaining time of the current window as a progress bar, and ships six themes plus a custom-CSS hook.
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 峰谷计费时段给输入卡上方那条染色（谷绿峰红），以进度条显示当前时段剩余时长，带六套主题与自定义 CSS。

description.en: ModelScope connector: OpenAI-compatible chat models, a Models-page provider entry, and a composer magicube balance while a ModelScope model is selected.
description.zh: 魔搭社区连接器：接入 OpenAI 兼容对话模型，「模型」设置页出现 ModelScope 条目，选中魔搭模型时在对话栏显示魔粒余额。

description.en: Public chat rooms with quoted replies and opt-in encrypted private text chat inside DeepSeek Harness, using a shared Nostr relay and locally protected identities (macOS Keychain or Windows DPAPI; Linux has no identity store, so posting is unsupported).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内进入公共聊天室交流，支持引用回复、私聊申请和加密文字聊天，通过共同 Nostr 中继互通，身份保存在本机受保护存储中（macOS 钥匙串 / Windows DPAPI；Linux 无身份保存适配，暂不能发言）。

description.en: Summarizes the current DeepSeek Harness session with /recap or after inactivity, with configurable models, Chinese and English output, and expandable summaries in the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 /recap 或闲置触发回顾当前 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持配置模型、中英文输出，并在对话内展示可展开的摘要。

description.en: Change impact analysis plugin that lifts a code change into an evidence-backed impact and verification plan (CHANGE-IMPACT.md + change-impact.json): affected modules, entry points and public exports, risk levels with factors and confidence, and recommended verification commands (read-only, never runs repository commands). Only read-only git queries (rev-parse, diff, status) are run; suggested verification commands are never executed.
description.zh: 变更影响分析插件：把一次代码变更升级为有证据支撑的影响与验证计划（CHANGE-IMPACT.md + change-impact.json）：受影响模块、入口与公开导出、带因子与置信度的风险分级、建议验证命令（只读，不执行仓库命令）。只会执行 rev-parse、diff、status 等只读 git 查询，建议的验证命令不会被执行。

description.en: DSH plugin bridging agents to Cheat Engine for dynamic memory debugging: scanning, pointer analysis, breakpoints, and game memory hacking.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Cheat Engine 进行动态内存调试：扫描、指针分析、断点与游戏内存修改。

description.en: Creates local, content-addressed workspace checkpoints with diff previews and two-phase restore confirmation.
description.zh: 创建本地内容寻址工作区存档，提供差异预览和两阶段确认恢复。

description.en: Complete wuyun-liuqi (five-evolutions-six-qi / 五运六气) Traditional Chinese Medicine skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: annual and guest-qi calculation, clinical pattern differentiation, and pathogenesis reasoning.
description.zh: 完整 wuyun-liuqi（五运六气）中医运气学技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness 插件：年度与客气推算、临床辨证、病机推演。

description.en: A DSH Web plugin that adds a browser to the right sidebar: open any page beside the chat, pick an element, and send the agent its selector, HTML, styles and a pinned screenshot so it can find and fix that component. Local/dev pages stay interactive through a same-origin proxy; public pages render in a host Chromium. Fork of zengxiaolou/dsh-annotate-browser (MIT), install one or the other — both add their own right-sidebar browser tab and drive a separate Chromium. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 to 0.2.x, Node.js 22.19+ and a Chromium-based browser on the host (auto-detected, or set chromePath).
description.zh: 一个 DSH Web 插件，在右侧边栏添加浏览器：在对话旁边打开任意页面，选中元素，把它的 selector、HTML、样式和一张带标记的截图发给 agent，让它能定位并修改组件。本地/开发页面经同源代理保持可交互；公共页面由宿主机上的 Chromium 渲染。fork 自 zengxiaolou/dsh-annotate-browser（MIT），两者二选一安装——都会新增自己的右侧栏浏览器标签页并驱动各自独立的 Chromium。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 至 0.2.x、Node.js 22.19+，以及宿主机上的 Chromium 系浏览器（自动检测，或设置 chromePath）。
