description.en: Long-form novel writing plugin: each book is a git repository of frontmatter files, with 39 DSH domain tools and a web writing UI. Deep import drafts candidates, AI adoption into canonical assets requires DSH approval, and deterministic continuity checks ship with a report-only benchmark. Independent open source (MIT), not an official DeepSeek product; requires Node >= 24.11.0 and currently targets DSH 0.1.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 长篇小说写作插件：每本书一个 git 仓库，当前 39 个 DSH 领域工具 + Web 写作台；深度导入产候选草稿、AI 采用类写入正式资产前必过审批、确定性连续性检查（报告型）。独立开源（MIT），非 DeepSeek 官方产品；需 Node ≥ 24.11.0，当前适配 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1。

description.en: Quick sticky notes with colored labels, pin, timed reminders, and password protection for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 泡泡猫的即时便签 — 支持彩色标签、置顶、定时提醒与密码保护。

description.en: Local hardware monitor for DSH: a sidebar dashboard, a composer-dock CPU/memory/GPU widget, and a hardware_monitor_status tool backed by a local Python service installed separately from the repository root with install-dsh.ps1 (Windows, Python 3.10); installing only the DSH plugin leaves the panel and tool offline.
description.zh: DSH 本机硬件监控插件：侧边栏完整面板、输入框下方的 CPU/内存/GPU 挂件，以及 hardware_monitor_status 工具。数据来自另装的本地 Python 服务：需在仓库根用 install-dsh.ps1 安装（Windows、Python 3.10）；只装 DSH 插件时面板与工具均不可用。

description.en: Adds one system-prompt section that keeps private words out of formal deliverables and, every few of them, leaves a short note at the end.
description.zh: 在系统提示词里加一段：正式交付物不写私话，私人笔记里隔几次留一小段。

description.en: Windows computer-use capability for DSH: screenshot → vision model → simulated mouse/keyboard with self-evolving knowledge base. Dual-mode plugin tools + skill-only pwsh fallback.
description.zh: Windows 桌面识图+模拟操作能力：截图→vision模型→模拟鼠标键盘，内置自进化应用技巧库。支持插件工具模式和纯skill模式双形态。

description.en: Treats the session as a mainland-China user (zh-Hans-CN, Asia/Shanghai, ISO dates, CNY currency) and generates a self-consistent test persona: five tools, six cross-checks, GB 11643 check digit, phone prefix matched to carrier ASN.
description.zh: 把会话当作中国大陆用户（简体中文、Asia/Shanghai、ISO 日期、人民币），并生成彼此自洽的测试人设：五个工具、六项交叉校验，身份证校验位、号段与运营商 ASN、区划码与地址互相对得上。

description.en: Runs one-night werewolf games inside DSH: deterministic dealing, night order, card swaps, voting and settlement, with a room UI and private night prompts. It vendors modified copies of baixianger/dsh-chat and baixianger/dsh-bridge; uninstall those two first, because enabling both registers the same dshChat/dshBridge services.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里组织《新版一夜狼人杀》：确定性发牌、夜序、换卡、投票与结算，自带房间界面与夜间私聊提示。包内是 baixianger/dsh-chat 与 baixianger/dsh-bridge 的修改版快照；请先卸载这两个上游插件，同时启用会重复注册 dshChat / dshBridge 服务。

description.en: Session replay view for DSH conversations: replays a session turn by turn at reading pace for prompts and answers while reasoning and tool output stream past, and every prompt is followed by a one-second pause. It can also re-run the original prompts in a new session, and record the replay — screen recording the conversation itself — to a WebM video through a 1280x720 canvas, with no OS screen-recording permission.
description.zh: DSH 会话回放视图：按轮重放一次会话，用户输入与助手正文保持阅读速度，思考与工具输出高速掠过且每段最多 3.5 秒，每条输入后停顿一秒；可一键把原始请求复刻到一个新会话，也可边回放边录制，把回放录屏导出成 WebM 视频（画布 1280×720，无需系统录屏权限）。

description.en: Host-side session alerts for DSH Web on Linux: tones played through the server's audio device when a turn ends, fails, or waits for approval or an answer — no browser needed.
description.zh: Linux 上 DSH Web 的宿主侧会话提醒：回合结束、出错或等待审批/回答时，服务器音频设备直接发声，无需打开浏览器。

description.en: Tracks the agent's state as Yogācāra mental factors over a durable seed store, and feeds it back into the prompt as first-person inclination.
description.zh: 以唯识心所与种子藏记录 agent 的状态，并以第一人称倾向写回提示词。

description.en: A lightweight font and theme plugin for the DSH client: Latin/Chinese/code font pickers that list only installed families, and five official palettes (One Dark Pro, Dracula, Nord, GitHub, Catppuccin) applied through the official theme tokens, including code-block syntax colors. No bundled fonts, no dependencies, no build step. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.
description.zh: 轻量的 DSH 字体与主题插件：中英文与代码字体选择器（只列本机已安装的字体），以及 One Dark Pro、Dracula、Nord、GitHub、Catppuccin 五套官方色板预设，全部走官方主题 token（含代码块语法高亮），不打包字体、零依赖、零构建。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更新。

description.en: Select a model and its reasoning effort in one drag with a two-dimensional grid.
description.zh: 使用二维网格，一次拖动同时选定模型与推理强度。

description.en: A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.
description.zh: 极简 worktree 管理方案，只有一个按钮和一个弹窗。

description.en: In-place HTML document preview annotation: pick elements, leave notes saved per file, send batches to the conversation, and let the agent apply changes directly.
description.zh: HTML 文档预览就地批注插件：点选元素写批注，按文件保存批注，可整批发送到当前对话，由 Agent 直接修改源文件。

description.en: Drag files and folders from the sidebar Files pane into the message composer. A dropped file becomes an inline chip inside the sentence, an uploaded attachment card, or a plain @ path, switchable in Settings.
description.zh: 把右侧文件区的文件和文件夹拖进输入框：落下的文件变成句中内嵌的小卡片、附件卡片或 @ 路径，可在设置里切换。

description.en: Four EVA-themed skins for DeepSeek Harness — Units 02, 00, 01 and 08. Each one restyles the sidebar, composer and window frame from the theme token layer, and ships a 20-second canvas boot sequence with a confirm step, a skip button and a replay hotkey. Switch skins from a popup on the composer chip.
description.zh: 四套 EVA 主题皮肤（二号机／零号机／初号机／八号机）。每套通过主题样式层重绘侧栏、输入框与窗口边框，并带一段 20 秒的开机动画（Canvas 绘制，含身份确认、可跳过、可重播）。输入框旁的胶囊可弹出列表切换皮肤。

description.en: Global and in-session search for DeepSeek Harness: search chat history across all sessions or just the current one, and retrieve both paragraph text and file names — find it even when you only remember the file name. Filter by date range and each session recent turns; results expand as session → question → paragraph, and a jump lands on the match with the words highlighted. Defaults to the last 14 days and the latest 30 turns per session; leave either empty to search everything.
description.zh: DSH 全局搜索与会话搜索插件：在所有会话或当前会话中搜索聊天记录，同时检索正文段落与文件名——忘了内容、只记得文件名也能找到。支持按日期范围与每个会话的最近轮次筛选、过滤，结果按“会话 → 问题 → 段落”展开，跳转后自动定位并高亮命中词。默认只搜最近 14 天、每会话最近 30 轮，清空任一项即可不限范围。

description.en: Read-only CAD tools that inspect, extract and export DWG/DXF drawings, including SVG and PNG previews and DXF conversion.
description.zh: 只读 CAD 工具：查看、提取 DWG/DXF 图纸，导出 SVG/PNG 预览或转换 DXF。

description.en: Hand a local file to any program's file picker: wait for the native Open dialog, paste the path through the clipboard, read it back to verify character by character, then confirm. The target is always explicit and every step leaves evidence. Windows only (EnumWindows / UI Automation).
description.zh: 把本地文件交给任何程序的「打开文件」对话框：等对话框出现、走剪贴板填路径、读回来逐字核对、再点确认。目标必须显式给，每一步都留证据——文件上传、微信发文件、PS 打开都能用它代劳。仅 Windows（依赖 EnumWindows / UI Automation）。

description.en: Live subagent run monitor for the Web UI: a sidebar footer trigger plus a fixed top-right card panel showing each subagent of the current session in real time (running/elapsed, terminal outcomes, tree indent), with one-click jump into the child conversation and a return button, refresh-surviving and mobile-hidden by default.
description.zh: Web UI 子代理实时监视面板：侧边栏底部入口 + 右上角常驻卡片面板，实时展示当前会话每个子代理的运行状态（运行中/耗时/终态）、树形缩进，一键跳转子代理会话并支持返回主会话，刷新自恢复、移动端默认隐藏。

description.en: Evidence-driven goal verification plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Locks goals via /ultragoal and verifies completion against command exit codes and generated artifacts, preventing the model from falsely reporting task completion.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据驱动目标校验插件。通过 /ultragoal 锁定目标，并依据命令退出码与生成产物验证完成状态，防止模型虚报任务完成。

description.en: WeChat Reading (WeRead) multi-target export for DeepSeek Harness via the official Skills API gateway: browse your bookshelf, export highlights & thoughts to flomo, a local Markdown file, or Notion, optionally reworked by a configurable LLM prompt.
description.zh: 微信读书多目标导出：通过官方 Skills API Key 查看书架、导出划线/想法到 flomo、本地 Markdown 或 Notion，可选按自定义 LLM prompt 整理后再导出。

description.en: Pins the first prompt of the current session in a scroll-proof bar above the conversation: one-click copy, a panel listing every prompt you sent (click a row to jump straight to that message, paging back through history when needed), and ten switchable looks (four of them light) you pick from inside the panel.
description.zh: 把当前会话的第一条提问常驻在对话区上方，滚动也不消失：一键复制，面板列出本会话发过的全部提问（点某一行直接跳到那条消息，够不着会自动往前翻页），另有十套外观可在面板里即选即换（含四套亮色）。

description.en: Runs local CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Pi by default, auto-detected) as panels inside DSH, reusing the official subprocess.spawnTerminal with an embedded xterm.js. Names, commands, colours and order are configurable. Requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer. The CLI agents must already be installed and run with your own user permissions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 主面板里运行本机 CLI Agents（默认 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Pi，自动识别已安装入口），进程复用官方 subprocess.spawnTerminal、画面使用内嵌 xterm.js；名称、指令、颜色与顺序可自定义。需 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或更新版本。各 CLI Agent 需事先装好，并以你本人的用户权限运行。

description.en: US stock quotes, price history, financial statements, analyst consensus and news via yahoo-finance2.
description.zh: 美股行情、历史 K 线、财务报表、分析师共识与新闻，数据来自 yahoo-finance2。

description.en: Windows-only desktop floating ball with a bilingual WebView2 quick-chat window, including in-window question and approval cards.
description.zh: Windows 桌面悬浮球，内置中英文 WebView2 快捷聊天窗口，支持在窗口内回答提问和审批操作。

description.en: Asks before archiving a DeepSeek Harness session, then backs the archived copy up to a directory you choose — one folder per session with the session log, its attachments and the metadata, plus a manifest, a restore note and a Markdown ledger. Adds a right-sidebar browser for archived sessions and a double-click restart button (Windows only; disabled while a session is running).
description.zh: 归档 DeepSeek Harness 会话前先确认，归档后把副本自动备份到你指定目录：每个会话一个文件夹（会话日志、附件、元数据），另附清单、还原说明与 Markdown 台账。并提供右侧栏的已归档会话浏览器与双击重启按钮（仅 Windows；会话运行中时按钮禁用）。

description.en: Distills long sessions into background observations and reflections, injects them as a system-prompt section, and renders compaction summaries from prepared memory; includes a Settings page and source-backed recall.
description.zh: 在后台把长会话提炼为观察与反思并注入系统提示，压缩时直接用预备记忆渲染摘要；提供设置页与可回溯原文的 memory_recall。

description.en: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away: fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones via a bundled zero-dependency Node SMTP sender.
description.zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：goal 完成、阻塞、向你提问决策前、长任务节点时触发，自带零依赖 Node SMTP 发送器。

description.en: Live session status on the browser tab favicon with sound notifications for pending input and completed tasks.
description.zh: 浏览器标签页 Favicon 实时回显会话状态，并支持需介入/已完成时的音效提示。

description.en: Maintained fork of feibi-mochi/deepseek-harness-control-center, which has not been updated since 2026-09-09. Pricing follows the official model pool instead of a hardcoded model prefix, so DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (`deepseek-flash`) is billed and shows its peak/off-peak clock, and the official price page is parsed structurally so a renamed or retired model no longer stops price sync. Adds an English interface beside the original Chinese. Otherwise the same plugin: balance, per-session cost and token breakdown, a 24-hour peak/off-peak clock, Z.ai plan quota, and a local usage ledger, following the host light/dark theme.
description.zh: feibi-mochi/deepseek-harness-control-center 的维护分支，上游自 2026-09-09 起未再更新。计价改为跟随官方模型池、而非硬编码模型前缀，因此 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（`deepseek-flash`）能正常计价并显示峰谷时钟；官方价格页改为结构化解析，模型改名或下架不再中断价格同步。界面在原有中文之外增加英文。其余与原插件一致：余额、本会话花费与 token 拆分、24 小时峰谷时钟、Z.ai 套餐额度与本机用量账本，并跟随宿主明暗主题。

description.en: Pairs the running executor with a stronger reviewer model through zero-parameter advisor() calls and step-based patrol checks, returning plan, correction, or stop guidance.
description.zh: 通过零参数 advisor() 咨询和按步巡逻检查，为执行模型接入更强的审查模型，返回计划、纠偏或停止信号。

description.en: A floating-island UI skin for DeepSeek Harness with a persistent left rail, an aggregate pinned-session section, and a configurable accent color.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设计的浮岛式界面皮肤，包含常驻左侧栏、置顶聚合与可调强调色。

description.en: Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).
description.zh: 浏览器 Web Speech API 语音输入：零服务端、零密钥、零模型下载（Edge=Azure 语音、Chrome=Google 语音）。

description.en: Renders workspace Markdown files in a standalone full-screen reader with GFM, KaTeX, Mermaid, outline navigation, live file reload, and browser printing/PDF export.
description.zh: 在独立全屏阅读器中渲染工作区 Markdown 文件，支持 GFM、KaTeX、Mermaid、目录导航、文件更新同步以及浏览器打印和 PDF 导出。

description.en: Team Skill Hub: browse shared public or private team skills from a Skill Base server and install them in DSH Web.
description.zh: 团队 Skill 中心：连接 Skill Base，浏览团队共享的公开或私有技能，并一键安装到 DSH Web。

description.en: Wraps the upstream ppt-master presentation skill set as an installable DeepSeek Harness plugin: byte-for-byte vendored skills, three lifecycle tools (ppt_master_info, ppt_master_check_env, ppt_master_setup_deps), optional venv interpreter isolation, and a Plugins-page configuration card. Requires python3 ≥ 3.10 plus the pip dependencies installed via `ppt_master_setup_deps`.
description.zh: 把上游 ppt-master 演示文稿技能集封装为可安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：逐字节 vendor 技能树，提供 ppt_master_info / ppt_master_check_env / ppt_master_setup_deps 三个生命周期工具、可选的 venv 解释器隔离与插件页配置卡片，需 python3 ≥ 3.10 + `ppt_master_setup_deps` 安装的 pip 依赖。

description.en: Reads each third-party endpoint's own model listing and keeps llm-pi-ai's per-model reasoningEfforts in sync, so the composer offers the thinking levels a model actually has.
description.zh: 读取每个第三方端点自己的模型列表，同步 llm-pi-ai 的逐模型 reasoningEfforts，让输入框提供模型真实支持的思考等级。

description.en: Sends a desktop notification and chime when a DeepSeek Harness run completes, errors, or waits for approval, with a configurable duration threshold.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知插件：运行完成、出错或等待审批时发送桌面通知并播放提示音，支持可配置的时长阈值。

description.en: Windows-only. Trust a newly added workspace folder once, then grants the NTFS rights the workspace-write sandbox needs and pushes the grant plus the Low integrity label through folders that already exist; repairs show live progress.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：新增工作区时授权一次，补齐 workspace-write 沙箱所需的 NTFS 权限，并把授权与 Low 完整性标签铺进已有子目录；修复过程带实时进度与日志。

description.en: Left-edge user-Turn navigation rail with reading-position highlighting, hover previews of per-turn metrics and model-answer excerpts, keyboard and click-to-jump controls, and local conversation search.
description.zh: 左侧用户轮次导航轨道：随阅读位置高亮，悬停预览单轮指标与模型回答摘要，支持键盘和点击跳转及本地会话搜索。

description.en: Free web search with 10 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch free + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), automatic fallback chain, time-filtered advanced search, platform search (GitHub/Reddit), web page fetching, LRU caching, and a settings UI. No API keys required for basic use.
description.zh: 免费网页搜索，支持 10 个引擎（Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch 免费，Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek 付费）、自动回退、按时间筛选的高级搜索、平台搜索（GitHub/Reddit）、网页内容抓取、LRU 缓存和设置界面。基本使用无需 API 密钥。

description.en: DSH Web GUI paperclip button: a 📎 button in the composer opens a file picker (drag & drop supported) and inserts file contents into the textarea.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框添加回形针按钮：点击选择文件（支持拖拽），文件内容自动插入输入框。

description.en: Shows the RouterAI credit balance in rubles and the spend since the session started in the sidebar footer (Web and Desktop, Russian-language labels). Requires a RouterAI API key stored in the harness credentials as ROUTERAI_API_KEY; without it the footer shows a "key not set" message instead of the balance.
description.zh: 在侧栏底部显示 RouterAI 的额度余额（卢布）和本次会话开始以来的花费（仅 Web / Desktop，界面文字为俄语）。需要把 RouterAI API key 以 ROUTERAI_API_KEY 存入 harness 凭据；缺了底部显示「未设置密钥」提示而不是余额。

description.en: Plays a distinct chime when a turn finishes, is interrupted, fails, or asks a question, and can show a Windows toast for questions.
description.zh: 回合完成、中断、出错或 Agent 提问时播放可区分的提示音，提问时可弹 Windows 系统通知。

description.en: Get back what you typed and walked away from: a new Web conversation you leave before sending never appears in the sidebar, so its draft is out of reach. This plugin lists those drafts above the composer of the next new conversation, newest first, with their workspace and time; Open takes you back with the text and chips in place, and Discard drops one, with Undo.
description.zh: 找回打了字却没发送就离开的内容：未发送就离开的新 Web 对话不会出现在侧栏，里面的草稿也就找不到了。本插件在下一个新对话的输入框上方按时间倒序列出这些草稿，并显示所属工作区与时间；「打开」带你回到原对话，文字和引用条原样还在；「丢弃」可撤销地删除草稿。

description.en: Multi-platform IM gateway for DSH: Feishu (Lark) WebSocket long connection (no public URL), WeCom AES-encrypted callbacks, and Telegram long polling — per-chat agent sessions, whitelist access, and a visual settings card in the web GUI.
description.zh: 多平台 IM 网关：飞书（Lark）WebSocket 长连接（无需公网）、企业微信 AES 加密回调、Telegram 长轮询；每会话独立 agent、白名单访问、Web GUI 可视化设置卡片。

description.en: Permanently deletes a session from the sidebar, waiting for a running turn to stop and cascading to its subagent sessions.
description.zh: 从侧边栏永久删除会话：等待正在运行的回合停下，并级联删除其子代理会话。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek API balance in the DSH sidebar and every Turn's cost in CNY, billed Search requests included. Requires the official DeepSeek (deepseek-official) provider and its API key (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY) in a Web-UI profile.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏显示 DeepSeek 余额，并在每轮对话底部显示该轮花费（人民币，含搜索请求费用）。需要官方 DeepSeek（deepseek-official）渠道及其 API Key（DEEPSEEK_API_KEY），且只在带 Web 界面的 profile 中生效。

description.en: Vendor-based usage dashboard: per-provider token/cache/output KPI, a 53-week heatmap, trend chart with hourly "today" view, model drilldown, cost estimation, CSV export, and health cards (TTFT, generation speed, peak context, error rate).
description.zh: 按厂商（订阅/官方API）统计用量看板：按供应商/模型拆分 Token、缓存、输出等 KPI，53 周热力图，趋势折线图（今天按小时），模型钻取，费用估算，CSV 导出，以及健康度卡片（TTFT、生成速度、峰值 Context、错误率）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for querying LLM service provider usage: reads DeepSeek and Moonshot balances plus Kimi For Coding and OpenCode Go quota windows on the host and shows them in an always-visible card with three view modes, edge docking and a collapsed letter bubble.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 服务提供商用量查询插件：在宿主侧读取 DeepSeek、Moonshot 余额与 Kimi For Coding、OpenCode Go 的配额窗口，在常驻卡片中展示，支持三种视图、边缘磁吸与收起为字母气泡。

description.en: Finder-style session labels: a hover button next to archive and pin, plus the native context menu, assign coloured labels; titles can take the first label's colour or a label symbol; view options gain a filter by label applied before grouping. Labels are stored by the Host and shared across workspaces. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer and Node.js 24.9+ (node:sqlite); the interface is available in Chinese and English only.
description.zh: Finder 风格的会话标签：悬浮按钮（位于原生归档、固定之后）与右键菜单都能给会话打彩色标签，标题可按第一个标签着色或显示标签符号，「视图选项」增加按标签筛选且在分组前生效；标签由 Host 保存，在同一 Host 的各工作区之间共享。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或更新版本与 Node.js 24.9+（node:sqlite）；界面仅提供中英文。

description.en: Re-decodes collected subprocess bytes with strict UTF-8 then GB18030 before they reach the agent, so GBK/CP936 output from Windows cmd and PowerShell tools stops arriving as U+FFFD mojibake.
description.zh: 在字节被解码前接管子进程输出采集，按严格 UTF-8、必要时 GB18030 重新解码，Windows 下 cmd 与 PowerShell 的 GBK/CP936 输出不再变成 U+FFFD 乱码。

description.en: Adds a button beside the composer and a global hotkey palette (default mod+shift+k) that hand one-off questions to a web chat instead of into the harness context: the draft is lifted out of the composer, copied to the clipboard and opened in the templated URL. Ships target-site presets (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, 豆包, 腾讯元宝, GLM, Gemini), a local question history that can be re-opened, copied, or inserted back into the composer, and a settings tab for site, URL template, hotkey, clipboard and history.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一个按钮，并提供全局快捷键（默认 mod+shift+k）浮层，把一次性的小问题交给网页版对话而不是送进 harness 上下文：草稿会从输入框取出、复制到剪贴板并打开模板 URL。内置目标站点预设（DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen、豆包、腾讯元宝、GLM、Gemini），带本地问题历史（可重新打开、复制或回填到输入框），以及设置页（站点、URL 模板、快捷键、剪贴板、历史）。

description.en: Adds a handoff button to every assistant message that writes an LLM-summarized handoff document of the current conversation into the workspace handoff/ directory.
description.zh: 为每条 AI 回复添加 Handoff 按钮，点击后由 LLM 将当前会话总结为交接文档，写入该会话工作区的 handoff/ 目录。

description.en: Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a capacity cap, projection-cache cleanup, and a hot-reload settings panel.
description.zh: 全类型会话生命周期管理：一次性子 agent 完成后归档，闲置的可续聊子 agent 与主会话归档（可恢复），容量上限、投影缓存清理，以及热重载设置面板。

description.en: Renders Excalidraw architecture scenes inside DSH — import a local .excalidraw/.json file or an inline document with no account, or refresh from Excalidraw+ over MCP (refresh needs an Excalidraw+ MCP bearer token in mcpToken or EXCALIDRAW_MCP_TOKEN); pan, zoom, select and export SVG/PNG.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里渲染 Excalidraw 架构图：可无账号导入本地 .excalidraw/.json 或内联文档，也可通过 MCP 从 Excalidraw+ 刷新（刷新需在 mcpToken 或 EXCALIDRAW_MCP_TOKEN 里配置 Excalidraw+ 的 MCP 令牌）；支持平移、缩放、选中与 SVG/PNG 导出。

description.en: Four slash commands for session branches: list the branch tree, fork at a completed turn, pin a session together with its whole family, and merge a child branch back into its parent.
description.zh: 会话分支的四个斜杠命令：列出分支树、在已完成的轮次处 fork、把会话连同整个家族置顶、把子分支合并回父会话。

description.en: Deterministic ticket triage: a rule prefilter classifies clear cases and returns everything else as needs_review instead of guessing.
description.zh: 确定性工单分诊：规则先处理明确案例，放不下的统一返回 needs_review，而不是猜。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Postiz over MCP: list connected social media channels, fetch per-platform posting rules, and schedule, draft, or publish posts to X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord, Slack, Telegram and more; adds a postiz workflow skill.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Postiz：列出已连接的社交媒体渠道、获取各平台发帖规则，并向 X、LinkedIn、Instagram、Facebook、Threads、TikTok、YouTube、Reddit、Bluesky、Mastodon、Discord、Slack、Telegram 等平台排期、存草稿或发布帖子；附带 postiz 工作流技能。

description.en: Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.
description.zh: 基于官方 OAuth Open API 双向同步滴答清单（TickTick/Dida365）任务：拉取各清单任务、创建/更新/完成/删除、按标题去重的一键同步，带 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Manage frequently used file bookmarks in DeepSeek Harness, supporting bookmark saving, listing and navigation. It also allows creation of frequently used projects, including management projects, code projects and more.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理常用的文件书签，支持保存、列出与跳转，并且可以创建常用的项目，包括管理类项目、代码类项目等。

description.en: Durable multi-agent collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with channels, threads, tasks, and resumable agent sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的持久化多 Agent 协作插件，提供频道、话题、任务与可恢复的 Agent 会话。

description.en: Comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing trail glides to the text position, with configurable accent color, thickness, trail, and a 500 ms idle blink. Extends the surface to ask-question card inputs, and fixes the caret vanishing on an empty composer or first focus, forward drag-selection not following the pointer, soft line breaks measuring against the previous line, and the caret painting outside the composer when long input scrolls. Maintained fork of Lacquervii/smooth-cursor.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的彗星光标：发光拖尾随文字位置平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细、拖尾，并在静止 500ms 后呼吸。覆盖 ask-question 交互卡片的输入框，并修复空输入框或首次聚焦时光标消失、正向拖选不跟随鼠标、软换行按上一行测量、长内容滚动时光标绘制到输入框之外等问题。Lacquervii/smooth-cursor 的维护分支。

description.en: A markdown notes manager for DSH: full **MD notes manager** and **MD notes editor**, quickly capture conversations into notes, maintain notes by **syncing to Git repositories**, and **bring notes into the conversation context**.
description.zh: DSH 的 MD 笔记管理插件：提供完整的 **MD 笔记管理器** 和 **MD 笔记编辑器**，对话内容可快速记入笔记。笔记可 **同步 Git 仓库** 维护。对话时可将笔记 **加入上下文**。

description.en: In-session question navigator for the DSH Web UI: a dot minimap on the conversation edge (left or right, configurable in settings), one dot per user question — hover shows the full question text, click jumps to it.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话内提问导航：对话栏左/右缘（可在设置中切换）的圆点迷你地图，一个圆点对应一个用户提问——悬停显示全文，点击跳转到该提问。

description.en: Text viewer and editor for the dock workbench: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation and binary detection, registered as the default file viewer.
description.zh: dock 系列文本查看与编辑器：支持撤销重做、Ctrl+S 保存、未保存确认和二进制检测，作为 dock-files 的默认文本查看器。

description.en: In-chat preview for produced files: click a produced-file chip to render Markdown (server-side markdown-it + highlight.js), images, or plain text right in the conversation; system-app open and reveal-in-folder stay one click away.
description.zh: 产物文件聊天内预览：点击产物 chip 直接在对话中渲染 Markdown（宿主侧 markdown-it + highlight.js 代码高亮）、图片或纯文本，系统应用打开与在文件夹中显示仍一键可达。

description.en: Animated AI companion for DSH with image and file chat, shared memory, reminders and background work; reads Bilibili videos through an installed dsh-bili-watch or dsh-bili-scroll plugin.
description.zh: 住进 DSH 的会动 AI 搭子：图片文件随聊随发，共享记忆、自然提醒和后台办事；B 站内容需另装 dsh-bili-watch 或 dsh-bili-scroll 插件后读取。

description.en: Permission mode between workspace-write and full access: shell commands are checked by deterministic rules and a subagent review; irreversible or system-level actions require explicit approval.
description.zh: 介于 workspace-write 与 Full access 之间的权限模式：命令先经规则与子代理审查，不可逆或系统级操作需人工批准。

description.en: Teaching board view: agent-generated self-contained HTML is projected into a sandboxed iframe as a board, annotated by hand (brush, four colours, eraser, undo), extended in place across several tool calls, and screenshotted back into the conversation as a real user message.
description.zh: 教学平面视图：agent 生成的自包含 HTML 投影进沙箱 iframe 当板书，可用画笔手写勾画（四色、橡皮、撤销）、在同一块板上增量续写，并把画面截图作为真实用户消息发回对话。

description.en: Realtime ocean skin for DeepSeek Harness, rebuilt from d-dev0101/open-sea-skin 1.2.7 under MIT. Wave height follows the live session load, the sky comes from a local NOAA ephemeris, the star field is a real 2851-star HYG subset with 88 constellations, one boat per running subagent, plus a searchable 11-group settings panel and three quality tiers. Published to npm as "open-sea-skin-dsh"; it keeps the upstream bundle id, so uninstall d-dev0101/open-sea-skin first — the two cannot be installed side by side.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的实时海洋皮肤，基于 d-dev0101/open-sea-skin 1.2.7（MIT）重新构建。浪高跟随会话负载，天色来自本地 NOAA 星历，星空是 2851 颗真实恒星的 HYG 子集与 88 个星座，每个运行中的子智能体一艘船，另有可搜索的 11 组设置面板与三档画质。已以 open-sea-skin-dsh 发布到 npm；bundle id 仍与上游相同，安装前须先卸载 d-dev0101/open-sea-skin，两者不能同时安装。

description.en: Merges, appends, and repairs DSH session logs: eleven modes for copying events between sessions, computing compaction cut points, clearing a broken parent link, and validating the result against DSH's own loader.
description.zh: 合并、追加与修复 DSH 会话：十一个模式，覆盖会话之间复制事件、计算压缩切点、断开损坏的父子链，并按 DSH 加载器校验结果。

description.en: Docks the dsh-whale-widget desktop pet flush against the right sidebar edge, following sidebar width changes and collapse/expand, with a toggle in the widget menu.
description.zh: 让 dsh-whale-widget 桌宠紧贴右侧栏边缘：展开时贴其左缘、折叠时贴窗口右缘，右栏改宽时实时跟随，开关在挂件菜单里。

description.en: Loads Google Antigravity rules from ~/.agents/rules and the workspace's .agents/rules into the system prompt: always-on rules in full, the rest as a catalog the model can load with the antigravity_rule tool, or that activates when a touched file matches a rule's globs. The rules are prompt guidance rather than hard enforcement, and the model can toggle them off with the same tool. Settings are written to .agents/rules/settings.json in the workspace.
description.zh: 把 ~/.agents/rules 和工作区 .agents/rules 里的 Google Antigravity 规则加进系统提示：always_on 规则全文注入，其余以目录形式列出，模型可用 antigravity_rule 工具加载，或在触及的文件匹配规则 glob 时自动激活。规则只是提示词层面的指引，不是强制执行，模型也能用同一个工具把它们关掉。设置写在工作区的 .agents/rules/settings.json。

description.en: Session board orb: live thinking and tool progress per session, task duration, context usage and 12h/30d usage stats; click through to any session.
description.zh: 会话看板：悬浮球一览所有工作区会话，实时显示思考与工具进展、任务耗时、上下文用量，支持近 12h/30 天用量统计，点击直达会话。

description.en: AlertManager panel in the DSH sidebar: reads multiple AlertManager HTTP API v2 instances in parallel, aggregates their alerts into severity-colored cards filterable by search, state, severity and instance, and dispatches any selection into a new session in a chosen workspace; the instance-grouped alerts become the first message to the agent, which then starts handling them immediately. Supports per-instance auth and TLS, auto-refresh, and a configurable dispatch prompt.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的 AlertManager 告警面板：并行读取多个 AlertManager HTTP API v2 实例，把告警聚合为可按搜索 / 状态 / 级别 / 实例筛选的严重度卡片；勾选任意告警并选择工作区后一键新建会话，把按实例分组的告警作为首条消息发给 agent 立即处理。支持每实例独立鉴权与 TLS、自动刷新，以及可配置的派发提示词。

description.en: Multi-agent frugality defense plugin: read-ledger dedup metrics, compaction-immune rules, completion gate, cheap-model review lane.
description.zh: 多智能体防内耗防御插件：读取台账去重度量、免疫压缩规则区、完成机械门禁、低成本审查 lane。

description.en: A transparent always-on-top desktop pet of Firefly (流萤) that chats through the host model, plays animations on click, whispers on a timer, narrates task progress, and shows account balance. Runs in the DSH Desktop app using its bundled Electron runtime (~/.dsh/electron); the pet does not appear if that runtime is missing. Windows only.
description.zh: 流萤桌宠：透明置顶的桌面伴侣，走宿主模型聊天、点击切换动画、定时碎碎念、按会话播报任务进度，并可查询账户余额。依赖 DSH Desktop 自带的 Electron 运行时（~/.dsh/electron），缺失时桌宠不会出现；仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Generates UI wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in DeepSeek Harness with selectable DashScope and Volcengine image providers.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用可切换的阿里云百炼与火山方舟图像服务生成 UI 线框图和高保真设计稿。

description.en: Download queue with aria2 and optional Xunlei engines, magnet links, and a per-session history; aria2 is not bundled and must be installed separately, and the Xunlei engine needs its own SDK and API key. Built mainly for Windows. Its POST routes (add, pause, remove downloads, with a caller-chosen target directory) are mounted with webServer.register and only check that the connection is from loopback, so a web page open in your browser can queue downloads on your behalf.
description.zh: 下载队列：aria2 与可选迅雷双引擎、磁力链接、按会话记录下载历史；aria2 不随包附带，需自行安装，迅雷引擎需自装 SDK 并提供 API Key；主要面向 Windows。它的 POST 路由（添加、暂停、删除下载，可指定保存目录）通过 webServer.register 挂载，只检查连接来自本机回环，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能替你加下载任务。

description.en: Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard: injects persistent system-prompt rules and post-execute notices when tool calls omit visible progress text, with a Web settings form.
description.zh: 阶段性结论软强制守卫：常驻注入系统提示词规范，并在模型调用工具漏发可见结论时自动附加软强制纠偏提醒，支持 Web 设置表单。

description.en: Blocks risky tool-call shapes before execution: inline multi-line Python, forwarded content without a source, missing source labels, and memory writes past the character cap. It also asks for confirmation before shell commands, and one rule is specific to the author's WeChat sending workflow.
description.zh: 在执行前拦下高风险的调用形态：内联多行 Python、没有出处的转发内容、缺失来源标签，以及超出字数上限的 memory 写入。它还会在执行 shell 命令前要求确认，其中一条规则是针对作者自己的微信发送流程的。

description.en: Adds a prompt-refine button to the DSH composer and, when auto mode is on, refines the prompt before the agent starts by rewriting the text with recent session context through a side-channel model call, asks on the native question card when the rewrite cannot be decided, reports each stage as a command card in the chat, and keeps the original text when analysis fails.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框添加「提示词优化」按钮；开启自动模式后，在助手开始执行前先用旁路模型结合最近会话上下文改写提示词，无法确定改写方式时先用原生提问卡片确认，各阶段以命令卡片在主对话中播报，分析失败时按原文继续。

description.en: HeroUI v3 theme builder for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop: live Accent hue, Base tint, font family, radius, form radius and light/dark controls, applied as one token-override layer with HeroUI Slider, Tabs and Select.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 与桌面端提供 HeroUI v3 主题构建器：实时调节 Accent 色相、Base 彩度、字体、圆角、表单圆角与明暗模式，通过单层令牌覆盖生效，设置控件使用 HeroUI Slider、Tabs 与 Select。

description.en: Sign in with a ChatGPT account and view Codex subscription usage directly in DSH Web's model settings, with browser or device-code OAuth.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的模型设置中使用浏览器或设备码登录 ChatGPT 账号，并直接查看 Codex 订阅用量。

description.en: Local Git-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with hybrid CJK/English retrieval, cited context, transactional sync, previews, and rollback.
description.zh: 基于本地 Git 的 DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆，提供中英文混合检索、带引用的上下文、事务式同步、预览与回滚。

description.en: Tencent CloudQ integration: AIOps chat mode with usage, inspiration, artifact and architecture panels.
description.zh: 腾讯云智能顾问集成：CloudQ 对话模式，附用量、灵感、制品与架构图面板。

description.en: Adds hover Recall / Delete / Delete-onward actions to every message row: removes content from the model context and the transcript together via durable append-only tombstones, with an empty-content guard so old deletions can never break strict providers. Tested on the DSH 2.0 desktop.
description.zh: 给会话里的每条消息加上「撤回 / 删除 / 删除此处及之后」悬浮按钮：以 append-only 墓碑让内容同时从模型上下文与对话界面消失，带空内容兜底，旧删除不会打回严格校验的 provider。已实测支持 DSH 2.0 桌面版。

description.en: Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: each base is a folder of UTF-8 text, text PDFs and OCR-read images; the plugin retrieves from the session's selected bases before every turn with Chinese n-gram and BM25, answers carry citations that open in a right-sidebar reader, and the agent gets five kb_* tools (list, search, read, stats, propose text) plus /kb commands for create, use, files, search and rescan.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识库：每个库对应一个本地文件夹，支持 UTF-8 文本、文本型 PDF 与图片 OCR 资料；每轮对话前用中文 n-gram 与 BM25 从本会话所选库中检索，回答带可在右侧阅读器打开原文的引用；并提供 kb_list、kb_search、kb_read、kb_stats、kb_propose_text 五个工具与 /kb 系列命令（新建、选用、文件、检索、重扫）。

description.en: Local ComfyUI cosplay photo sets for Windows with an NVIDIA GPU (8 GB+ VRAM): deploys the ComfyUI Windows portable build and Z-Image-Turbo (8-10 GB of models) with a self-test, then turns a character name, a reference image, or a hot-character pick into a live-action cosplay photo set with base-image and shot-script approval gates.
description.zh: 面向 Windows + NVIDIA 显卡（显存 ≥8 GB）的本机 ComfyUI cosplay 套图：自动部署 ComfyUI 便携版与 Z-Image-Turbo（模型约 8-10 GB）并自检，再把角色名、参考图或热门角色推荐变成真人 cosplay 套图，基准图与镜头脚本各设人工确认闸门。

description.en: Adds a Phone page to dsh web that shows a QR code; scan it, sign in to OpenTandem on the phone and tap Allow, then send tasks to this computer's dsh from OpenTandem. Installs the OpenTandem command line and a background Runner on first use.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 中新增「手机连接」页并显示二维码，用手机扫码、登录 OpenTandem 并点「允许」后，即可在 OpenTandem 里把任务发给这台电脑上的 dsh。首次使用会安装 OpenTandem 命令行和后台 Runner。

description.en: Model high-availability failover (quarantine, circuit breaking, probe recovery) and subagent orchestration (fanout/pipeline/supervisor) with bilingual settings UI.
description.zh: 模型高可用故障回退（隔离/熔断/探测恢复）与子智能体编排（fanout/pipeline/supervisor），附带双语设置界面。

description.en: Desktop-grade companion: browser native notifications for user questions and approval interactions, screen capture model tool, multi-agent tiling grid view, and lightweight Tauri desktop shell.
description.zh: 桌面级增强套件：原生提问/审批交互通知、屏幕截图工具、多智能体平铺网格视图与轻量级 Tauri 桌面外壳。

description.en: Claude-style warm-editorial skin for the DSH web GUI — ivory/warm-black canvas, a clay ember accent, serif display + sans UI + mono labels, hairline borders and pill CTAs, light/dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格暖调编辑 DSH Web 皮肤：象牙白/暖黑双画布、陶烬橙点睛、衬线标题+无衬线界面+等宽标签、发丝线与胶囊 CTA，亮暗双主题跟随系统。

description.en: One-click native conversations with independent workspaces for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键原生对话入口，每次创建独立工作区和会话。

description.en: Provides a structured, per-session resume editor for DeepSeek Harness with shared chat and sidebar edits, A4 preview, and PDF export.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的结构化简历编辑器；每个会话独立保存草稿，对话与侧栏共用内容，并提供 A4 预览和 PDF 导出。

description.en: Previews a workspace OpenWiki in the DSH Web right Sidebar: detects the wiki directory, serves it with the official `openwiki visualize` reader on a loopback port, and embeds it in its own tab, reporting the installed openwiki and DSH versions against configurable floors and checking the registry for its own updates.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右侧边栏预览工作区的 OpenWiki：识别 wiki 目录，用官方 `openwiki visualize` 阅读器在本地回环端口提供服务并嵌入自有标签页，同时对照可配置的版本下限报告 openwiki 与 DSH 版本，并向 registry 检查自身更新。

description.en: Copy selections from assistant messages as Markdown, preserving links, LaTeX sources, and code-fence language info.
description.zh: 将助手消息中选中的内容复制为 Markdown，保留链接、LaTeX 源码与代码块语言信息。

description.en: Local, per-session LIFO prompt stash for temporarily setting aside unfinished composer text and safely restoring it later.
description.zh: 本地、按会话隔离的 LIFO 输入暂存：临时收起未完成的输入，之后安全恢复并继续编辑。

description.en: Remote DeepSeek Harness with full server-side API access (`settings.*` / `credentials.*` / `host.listDirectory`). Token-gated reverse proxy, per-device sessions, phone invite QR, fence self-check, optional approval / CIDR / idle timeout / local TLS, WebSocket/SSE.
description.zh: 远程访问 DeepSeek Harness 且服务端 API 完整：转发时改写 Host/Origin，恢复其他方案必定 403 的 settings.* / credentials.* / host.listDirectory。令牌门、按设备会话、可选首访审批。

description.en: Windows-only local encrypted credential vault (DPAPI-wrapped AES-256-GCM) plus a headless-Chrome login keeper: 31 agent tools log a site in once, keep the session on disk, and fetch login-walled pages (Tieba, NGA, Pixiv, one book site) with per-floor post extraction. The live page mirrors into a draggable, collapsible right-edge dock where clicks, typing and scrolling replay over CDP, so a captcha can be solved without a separate browser window. Edge/Chrome saved passwords can be migrated: the plugin reads the browser's Login Data store, decrypts v10/v11 entries in-process, and copies the store and its key blobs into its own controlled profile so the browser can autofill them (v20 app-bound entries can only be autofilled, not decrypted offline). Ships a one-command installer that repairs the DSH profile registration and a built-in self-test.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：本地加密凭据库（DPAPI 包裹的 AES-256-GCM）配无头 Chrome 登录态保管：31 个 agent 工具登录一次即可把会话存到本机，之后抓登录墙内的页面（贴吧、NGA、Pixiv、书屋）并逐楼层提取正文。页面实时镜像到可拖动、可收起的右边缘抽屉，点击、打字、滚动经 CDP 回放，验证码不必再开独立浏览器窗口。可迁移 Edge/Chrome 已存密码：插件会读取浏览器的 Login Data 密码库，在进程内解密 v10/v11 条目，并把密码库及其密钥复制进自己的受控 profile 让浏览器自动填充（v20 App-Bound 条目只能自动填充、无法离线解密）。另附一条命令修复 DSH profile 登记的安装器，以及内置自检。

description.en: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
description.zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

description.en: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files.
description.zh: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出插件、MCP 与卫生文件的安装建议。

description.en: Browser-side preset visibility and ordering controls for the new-session page.
description.zh: 在新会话页控制 Agent 预设的显示与排序。

description.en: DSH plugin: three MCP tool servers for DingTalk (via the dws CLI), Feishu (via lark-cli) and Feishu Project (via the official @lark-project/mcp), reusing the accounts dws and lark-cli are already logged in with, plus a Feishu Project MCP user token you paste in the panel; once the three connectors are connected, the default set is 140 tools (47 DingTalk, 45 Feishu, 48 Feishu Project) under the mcp__dingtalk__ / mcp__feishu__ / mcp__meego__ prefixes. A sidebar panel adds a connector wall with one-click connect (installs the CLI and walks through device-code login, or takes the Feishu Project token), custom MCP connections pasted as mcpServers JSON, enable/disable per connection, the write-tool switch, and a searchable catalog of the 1098 dws and 246 lark-cli commands.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把钉钉（走 dws CLI）、飞书（走 lark-cli）和飞书项目（走官方 @lark-project/mcp）做成三个 MCP 工具服务器，钉钉与飞书复用这两个 CLI 已登录的账号，飞书项目需在面板里填入 MCP 用户令牌；三个连接器都连好后默认注册 140 个工具（钉钉 47、飞书 45、飞书项目 48），前缀分别是 mcp__dingtalk__ / mcp__feishu__ / mcp__meego__。侧边栏面板提供连接器墙（一键连接：装 CLI 并走设备码登录，或填飞书项目令牌）、粘贴 mcpServers JSON 添加自定义 MCP、逐条启停、写工具开关，以及可搜索的 1098 条 dws 与 246 条 lark-cli 命令目录。

description.en: A fake-ip-aware ctx.web fetch provider that takes over the stock http provider id: a hostname is accepted when every DNS answer is a placeholder inside the proxy's fake-ip block (198.18.0.0/15 by default), so web_fetch works under mihomo/Clash TUN mode without disabling fake-ip or setting proxy environment variables. IP literals and private, loopback and reserved destinations stay blocked.
description.zh: ctx.web 的 fake-ip 感知抓取后端，接管官方 http provider id：当某主机名的每一条 DNS 应答都是代理 fake-ip 段（默认 198.18.0.0/15）内的占位地址时予以接受，从而在 mihomo/Clash TUN 模式下无需关闭 fake-ip、也无需设置代理环境变量即可使用 web_fetch；IP 字面量与私有、回环、保留地址仍被拒绝。

description.en: A floating cyber wooden fish widget — tap it to strike and accumulate merit, drag it anywhere on the page.
description.zh: 一个赛博木鱼：可拖拽、点击敲击、累积功德的 Web 悬浮小摆件。

description.en: Adds a resizable workspace file tree beside the native preview, with directory expansion, filtering of loaded files, and refresh.
description.zh: 在原生预览旁添加可调整宽度的工作区文件树，支持目录展开、已加载文件筛选和刷新。

description.en: Displays CodexRadar model capability benchmarks in a Settings page and shows the selected session model's DeepSWE score beside the composer.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 CodexRadar 模型能力评测，并在输入框旁显示当前会话所选模型的 DeepSWE 分数。

description.en: QQ (OneBot 11 / NapCat) channel for DeepSeek Harness: bridges QQ private chats and group chats into their own dsh sessions. Ships group guardrails (mention-only, quiet hours, cooldowns, daily quota, peak-hour mute), a tool gate with write-action audit, an outbound filter that stops the model from echoing input tags, voice transcription, media and forwarded-card support, dryRun and usage stats. Forked from dsh-onebot-qq 0.9.4. Cannot be installed alongside the upstream dsh-onebot-qq (two QQ channels on one NapCat crash-loop DSH). Private chats answer admins only (an empty admin list means nobody); group chats default to all groups and answer any @-mention, so set groupPolicy to allowlist to restrict who can drive the agent.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 QQ（OneBot 11 / NapCat）通道：把 QQ 私聊和群聊各自接成一个独立的 dsh 会话。内置群聊闸（只认点名、静默时段、冷却、每日配额、工作高峰闭麦）、工具闸与写操作审计、出站过滤器（挡住模型把输入标签当自己的话复读出来）、语音转写、图片与合并转发、dryRun 试运行与用量统计。由 dsh-onebot-qq 0.9.4 分叉而来。不能与上游 dsh-onebot-qq 同装（两个 QQ 通道共用一个 NapCat 会互相抢消息并让 DSH 崩溃循环）。私聊默认只回管理员（管理员名单为空=谁都不回）；群聊默认所有群、被 @ 即应答，任何群成员都能驱动 agent，需要限制请把 groupPolicy 设为 allowlist。

description.en: Git history visualization for the dock workbench: swimlane commit graph, branch and tag management, stage/commit/push and remote operations.
description.zh: dock 系列 Git 历史可视化插件：泳道式提交图、分支/标签管理、暂存/提交/推送与远端操作。

description.en: Dual-ledger cross-session memory: auto-extracts lasting facts from conversations into MEMORY.md and maintains a PROGRESS.md project ledger, recalling both into every new session.
description.zh: 双账本跨会话记忆：自动把对话中的长期事实提取进 MEMORY.md，并维护项目进度账本 PROGRESS.md，每个新会话自动召回两本账。

description.en: Doubao Search (Volcengine 豆包搜索) web search provider for the DeepSeek Harness — swaps the active web_search backend to the standalone Doubao Search API with its own key and billing (500 free searches per month), and ships a dedicated settings card that stores the key via the credentials service.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供豆包搜索（火山引擎）网络搜索提供方——把 web_search 的后端切换为独立的豆包搜索 API，密钥与计费独立（每月 500 次免费），并内置专用设置卡片，经凭据服务保存密钥。

description.en: Standalone prompt assembly with a source registry, custom text, strategy editing and previews, and per-session strategy snapshots through DSH public hooks.
description.zh: 独立提示词装配插件，提供来源注册、自定义文本、策略编辑与预览，通过 DSH 公开钩子按会话应用策略快照。

description.en: Multi-agent Chinese debate simulator with eight debaters, live two-column discussion and draft notes, judges and scoreboard, single-side clocks, per-round ZIP archives, a training side with a configurable end condition (win-rate threshold or fixed rounds), and a Word prep package.
description.zh: 多智能体中文辩论模拟：8 名辩手、实时双栏讨论与草稿纸、评委计分、单边计时、每轮 ZIP 归档、训练方可选胜率阈值或固定轮次收官，并生成 Word 备赛包。

description.en: Per-model token usage and cost estimation with DeepSeek account balance, shown in a Settings panel tab.
description.zh: 按模型统计 token 消耗并估算费用，同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，展示于设置面板「模型消耗」页签。

description.en: Plays a chime and speaks a Chinese voice alert when an approval, question, or plan-review popup appears in the DSH web GUI, so you never miss a request.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中出现审批、提问或计划审批弹窗时，播放提示音并中文语音播报，避免漏看待处理请求。

description.en: One-click TokenDance gateway access for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth sign-in stores the API key, a live model catalog with per-model visibility, and agent tools for chat, image generation, video generation and typed decisions.
description.zh: 一键接入 TokenDance 模型网关：OAuth 登录保存 API Key，实时模型目录可逐模型控制显隐，并提供对话、生图、生视频与类型化判断的 agent 工具。

description.en: Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.
description.zh: 配置一次 flomo API URL / API Key，Agent 即可用 flomo_send 把笔记、摘要、待办写进 flomo（浮墨笔记）。

description.en: NovelAI image generation for DSH: `nai_image` (style presets, artist strings, per-model weight rewriting, token budget warnings, results rendered inline), `nai_status`, and `nai_prompt` (build / check / guide), plus a studio page with live draft previews, a standalone studio server, and a prompt guide distilled from four tutorials. Bring your own `pst-` token.
description.zh: 把 NovelAI 生图接进 DSH：`nai_image`（画风预设、画师串、按模型自动转权重、token 预算提醒，出图直接内联显示）、`nai_status`、`nai_prompt`（build / check / guide 三个动作），外加带逐帧草稿预览的画室页面、独立 studio 和一个从四份教程里提炼的提示词手册。用自己的 `pst-` token。

description.en: Seven agent-preset modes for DeepSeek Harness, each with a fixed tool boundary, per-mode model routing and fast/deep omd_task delegation tiers, plus a plan-to-execute loop (/mode, /start-work, goal-backed /ulw) and a settings page that remaps models per mode and per tier.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 7 个 Agent 预设模式：每个模式固定工具边界、按模式路由模型，并以 fast/deep 档位委派 omd_task 子代理；含规划到执行闭环（/mode、/start-work、基于 goal 的 /ulw）与逐模式、逐档位重配模型的设置页。

description.en: Live hotel and flight prices from Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com, Traveloka and other booking sites, through the remote PriceWin MCP server (no account or API key), plus a travel-search skill. In the Web UI the results show as cards: hotel photo, rating, stay total and one linked price per site; flights with times, stops and each site's fare. Search details are sent to mcp.price.win.
description.zh: 通过远程 PriceWin MCP 服务器（无需账号或 API key）实时比较 Booking.com、Agoda、Trip.com、Traveloka 等预订网站的酒店与机票价格，并附带旅行搜索 skill。在 Web 界面中结果以卡片呈现：酒店照片、评分、整段住宿总价及各网站带链接的价格；航班显示起降时间、经停与各网站票价。搜索条件会发送到 mcp.price.win。

description.en: A small bead-art game in the DSH Web right sidebar for the wait while the model replies: 12 built-in templates with guide beads, free drawing in 16 colors on 12/16/24 boards, a pattern drawn by the model from one sentence, on-device picture-to-pattern conversion (pictures are never uploaded), ironing finished pieces onto a wall of up to 60 works, and PNG export.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右侧边栏拼小拼豆的轻量小游戏，等模型回复的空档拼一张：12 个带引导豆的内置图案、16 色在 12/16/24 格板上自由拼、一句话让模型生成图纸、照片在本机转成图纸（不上传）、拼完熨烫存入最多 60 件的作品墙，并可导出 PNG。

description.en: Pause and resume tasks automatically during user-defined time windows to avoid peak-hour API costs; includes account balance display and 10-minute granularity spend bar chart.
description.zh: 自定义时间窗口自动暂停/恢复任务，高峰时段节省 API 费用；含账户余额显示和 10 分钟粒度的消费柱状图。

description.en: Highlights sidebar session rows by state (pending approval, running, just finished) with color, animation and a matching status dot.
description.zh: 按待审批、运行中、刚完成三种状态给侧边栏会话行上色并加呼吸动效，行尾配同色状态点。

description.en: Chinese localization for DeepSeek Harness: translates all system prompts, tool descriptions, and runtime contexts into Chinese at runtime via the system-prompt/assemble waterfall (1788 entries, zero source modification, uninstall restores English).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中文汉化插件：通过 system-prompt/assemble 瀑布钩子在运行时把全部系统提示词、工具描述与运行时上下文翻译成中文（1788 条译文，零源码修改，卸载即还原英文）。

description.en: Pomodoro timer, tasks and study planning in DSH, with a chat assistant that can read and update the same local records as the UI. Needs the separate tomato-runtime service (Linux release bundle from the project) running on 127.0.0.1:43987.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理番茄钟、任务与学习计划；对话中的学习助手可读写与界面相同的本地记录。需另行安装并运行项目发行包里的 tomato-runtime 本地服务（Linux 发行包，监听 127.0.0.1:43987）。

description.en: Drive your dsh agent from WeChat over the iLink gateway: two-way encrypted media transfer (auto-decrypt inbox + /send), proactive weixin_send tool, completion notifications, multi-session switching, and a health panel with file logging.
description.zh: 微信遥控 DeepSeek Harness：iLink 双向加密文件收发（入站自动解密落盘 + /send 出站）、weixin_send 主动通知、完成通知、多会话切换、健康面板与文件日志。

description.en: Multi-agent meeting negotiation over the LAN: each person runs their own assistant, and assistants find each other via mDNS and negotiate meetings, weekend outings and bubble tea votes through A2A messages. They share only availability (never the reasons) and ask the owner before giving up protected time. Ships a phone-style page in the DSH sidebar and a 13-person sample company. No authentication; trusted LANs only.
description.zh: 局域网多智能体会议协商：每人一个助理，助理通过 mDNS 互相发现，用 A2A 报文协商排会、周末团建和奶茶投票。对外只给忙闲不说原因，占用本人保护的时段前先问本人。DSH 侧栏自带手机样式页面和 13 人示例公司。无鉴权，仅限可信局域网。

description.en: Every few turns asks the model whether anything is worth keeping, then sorts the answer into memory, skill or hook.
description.zh: 每几轮让模型判断是否有值得沉淀的经验，并把结论归入 memory、skill 或 hook 三类之一。

description.en: GitHub search, discovery and audit scripts wrapped as a SKILL.md pack around the gh CLI: repo search, multi-axis explore, trending, repo summaries, similar projects, code search, issue/PR search and org audits; ships as a dsh bundle (and on npm).
description.zh: 基于 gh CLI 的 GitHub 搜索/发现/审计技能包（SKILL.md 打包）：仓库搜索、多轴探索、趋势、仓库概览、相似项目、代码搜索、issue/PR 搜索与组织审计；以 dsh bundle 形式安装（并已发布 npm）。

description.en: Connects ChatGPT accounts through OAuth, switches among them manually or automatically, and adds Codex models with usage limits to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 连接 ChatGPT 账号，支持手动或自动切换，并为 DeepSeek Harness 添加带用量限额信息的 Codex 模型。

description.en: Auto-hide a sidebar workspace the moment its last unarchived session is archived, and add a "隐藏工作区" entry to each workspace row's own "..." menu. The restore entry sits at the bottom of the sidebar. It only toggles display and never archives, deletes or rewrites a workspace.
description.zh: 某个工作区的未归档会话从 1+ 掉到 0 的那一刻自动隐藏它的侧栏行，并在工作区行自带的「…」菜单里追加「隐藏工作区」，另配侧栏底部恢复入口。只切 display，不归档、不删除、不改写任何工作区。

description.en: LAN reverse proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness - enables mobile/tablet access with full features, fixes settings panel inaccessible via reverse proxy.
description.zh: DSH 局域网反向代理插件 - 让手机/平板访问 DSH 获得完整功能，修复反代访问时设置面板无法打开的问题。

description.en: Quantitative data quality scoring based on GB/T 36344-2018, providing auditable quality reports for data asset capitalization.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 36344-2018 国家标准，从规范性、完整性等六个维度对数据质量进行量化评分，为企业数据资产入表提供可审计的底稿。

description.en: Static security scanner for DSH plugins: read-only audit (exec, credentials, exfiltration, obfuscation, install scripts, bundle manifest) with a 0-100 risk score.
description.zh: DSH 插件安全扫描器：只读静态审计（执行、凭据、外传、混淆、安装脚本、bundle 清单），输出 0-100 风险分。

description.en: Markdown viewer for the dock workbench: GFM rendering with DOMPurify sanitization, document outline and relative-path image/link resolution, with one-click switch to editing.
description.zh: dock 系列 Markdown 查看器：GFM 渲染 + DOMPurify 消毒、文档大纲、相对路径图片/链接解析，可一键切换编辑。

description.en: Agent preset bundle for wish and task management: create wishes or tasks from conversation, opportunity-day check-ins, micro-actions, plus a memory store and progress charts in the web UI.
description.zh: 愿望与任务管理的 Agent Preset 组合包：在对话中创建愿望/任务、机会日打卡、微行动，并附带记忆存储与 Web 端进度图表。

description.en: Resume screening plugin for HR in DeepSeek Harness: ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library with skills / coarse categories / ingest time, auto-ingest & de-dupe new resumes, then screen by plain-language criteria — rule pre-filter in the database plus LLM fine-judge on the shortlisted few, CSV export. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 面向 HR 的简历筛选插件:把 Word/PDF/Excel 简历统一收进简历库建档(技能/粗分类/入库时间),新简历自动入库、重复自动去重;用大白话下指令即可筛选,硬性条件靠库内规则精准过滤,入围的少数人再由 LLM 精判适配度,结果可导出、可追溯。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: Give the agent a talking face: seven tools that drive a self-hosted Mynah realtime digital human — speak (queued or interrupting), play a gesture clip, interrupt, list live sessions and channels, check health, add text to its knowledge base.
description.zh: 给 Agent 一张会说话的脸：七个工具驱动自托管的 Mynah 实时数字人——开口说话（排队或打断）、播放动作片段、打断、查看在线会话与频道、健康检查、往知识库加文本。

description.en: Adds a session_rename tool so an AI can retitle the DeepSeek Harness session it is running in.
description.zh: 新增 session_rename 工具，让 AI 能重命名自己所在的 DSH 会话。

description.en: Object memory for DSH: each object is broken into fourteen kinds of smallest elements (shape, material, state, part, function...), observed links are stored apart from inferred ones, and analogies stay as questions until the user answers.
description.zh: DSH 元素记忆库：把物体拆成十四类最简元素（形状、材质、状态、部位、功能等），观察到的边与推断出的边分开存放，猜想只作为问题等待用户回答。

description.en: An Astra Yao desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that renders the Codex v2 8x11 sprite atlas, follows session state through thinking, running, waiting and failed, shows a status bubble with the running tool and a DeepSeek balance readout (on by default, can be switched off), and quotes her own voice lines while idle.
description.zh: 把 Astra Yao（耀嘉音）的 Codex 桌宠图集搬进 DSH Web 界面：随会话状态切换到构思、执行、候场、破音等动作，头顶气泡显示正在跑的工具和余额（默认开启，可关），空闲时轮播她的官方台词。

description.en: Ecommerce operator workbench: CSV batch preview with marketplace column adapters, reproducible profit/six-dimension scoring, public product-page snapshots, Chinese skills, and a replaceable store-policy KB.
description.zh: 电商店主工作台：CSV 批量预览（多平台列适配）、可复算利润与六维评分、公开商品页快照、中文 skills、可替换售后政策知识库。

description.en: Image-to-text input for the Web UI: paste or drag an image and it is transcribed into structured text and sent, giving text-only LLMs image-input takeover (OpenAI-compatible vision API).
description.zh: 图片转文字输入插件：粘贴/拖拽图片自动转为结构化文字描述发送，给纯文本 LLM 提供图片输入接管（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API）。

description.en: Shared multi-agent task board (create/claim/transition/query) over a Cordis service key.
description.zh: 多 agent 共享任务板：经 Cordis service key 创建/认领/流转/查询任务。

description.en: Per-turn session cost chip in the composer stats row: each turn's spend with the model it used, the conversation total split into cache-hit and cache-miss (CNY), priced from an official price table that refreshes on demand.
description.zh: 输入框下方统计栏里的会话费用胶囊：逐轮列出每轮花费与所用模型，并把总额拆成缓存命中与未命中两笔（CNY）；价目表按需从官方定价页刷新。

description.en: Pokémon-style skin for DSH Web with GBA frames, HP-bar status, effort level panel, and customizable color palettes.
description.zh: 宝可梦风格 DSH Web 皮肤，含 GBA 双边框、HP 条状态、推理等级面板与可自定义配色。

description.en: Binds a Feishu/Lark bot to DeepSeek Harness over a WebSocket long connection: incoming messages run through an agent session and stream back to the chat, chat commands such as /attach manage the live session, and feishu_* tools let the model push messages.
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket 长连接把飞书机器人绑到 DeepSeek Harness：收到的消息跑在 agent 会话里并流式回传，/attach 等聊天命令管理活动会话，模型可调用 feishu_* 工具推送消息。

description.en: An upgrade assistant for DSH plugins. Checks which installed plugins have newer versions, then upgrades them in one click or on a schedule — taking a snapshot before every upgrade and rolling back automatically if the install fails, so a bad upgrade never breaks your environment. Also runs a health check: conflicts, undeclared compatibility, missing dependencies, ranked by review priority. Auto-update scope is configurable (patch / minor / major) with a per-package exclude list. Any operation can be reverted to a historical snapshot.
description.zh: DSH 插件的升级助手。自动检查已装插件哪些有新版本，可一键全部升级或定时自动升级；每次升级前自动打快照，装失败自动回滚到升级前，不会把环境弄坏。也能体检：列出插件冲突、兼容性未声明、依赖缺失，并给出检查优先级。支持按补丁/次版本/主版本三档控制自动升级范围，可排除不想动的插件。所有操作都能回退到任意历史快照。

description.en: Attaches the current Chrome tab to a DSH draft: one pick screenshots the page (falling back to a macOS window shot) and writes its title and URL into the composer as one line.
description.zh: 把当前 Chrome 标签页附到 DSH 草稿：一次点击截图（失败时降级为 macOS 窗口截图），同时把页面标题与地址写成一行放进输入框。

description.en: A settings-panel skin manager that auto-discovers installed Web UI skins, switches between them in one click, and maintains the profile patch automatically.
description.zh: 设置面板皮肤管理器：自动扫描已安装的 Web UI 皮肤并一键切换，profile 补丁自动维护。

description.en: Engineering work-tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers two model-facing Host Tools — a scoped `git` runner, and a package-manager runner (`dev`) that detects npm/pnpm/yarn/bun from the workspace lockfile and picks the right verb per manager. Both run through dsh's sandboxed shell and return structured stdout/stderr/exitCode, so the agent gets focused, reviewable results instead of raw bash, and adding another tool is a copy-paste of one register block.
description.zh: 面向软件工程师的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：注册两个模型可直接调用的 Host Tool——受工作区约束的 `git` 运行器，以及按 lockfile 自动识别 npm/pnpm/yarn/bun 并选择正确动词的包管理器运行器（`dev`）。两者都经 dsh 沙箱 shell 执行，返回规整的 stdout/stderr/exitCode，让 agent 拿到聚焦、可复核的结果而不是裸 bash；再加一个工具只需复制一个 register 块。

description.en: Correct-encoding command runner and mojibake recovery: encoding_run spawns a child process and decodes its raw output bytes (UTF-8/UTF-16LE/GBK auto-detected or forced), and encoding_decode recovers garbled text back to correct Unicode.
description.zh: 编码正确的命令执行与乱码还原：encoding_run 自动识别 UTF-8/UTF-16LE/GBK 并正确解码子进程输出，encoding_decode 把乱码文本还原为正确 Unicode。

description.en: Tavily search and page fetch: tavily_search queries with a rotating pool of up to eight API keys that backs off per key on 401/403/429 so one exhausted account does not take the tool down, and web_fetch retrieves a single page through curl, returning its HTTP status with de-tagged text.
description.zh: Tavily 检索与网页抓取：tavily_search 带最多八把 API key 的轮询池，按 key 对 401/403/429 退避，单个账号额度耗尽不再等于工具失效；web_fetch 经 curl 抓取单页，返回 HTTP 状态与去标签正文。

description.en: A Live2D waifu plugin for DSH.
description.zh: dsh 的 Live2D 看板娘插件。

description.en: Gitee/GitHub AI employee: @ the bot on an issue (Gitee or GitHub), it clones the repo, implements the fix on the branch you name, opens a PR to that branch, and can auto-merge and auto-close the issue. v1.2 adds security scanning: configure scan repos, audit with built-in/custom prompts, deduplicate, and file new findings as issues.
description.zh: Gitee/GitHub AI 员工：在 issue 里 @ 机器人并指定目标分支（如"需要修改 release-v1.2 分支"），它自动克隆仓库开发、向指定分支提交 PR，可自动合并并自动关闭 issue。v1.2 新增代码安全扫描：配置扫描仓库后按内置/自定义提示词审计代码，去重后把新发现提交 issue。

description.en: Fills in the vision capability that DSH's "fetch models" step drops, so image-capable models stop being declared text-only, and marks them in the model name.
description.zh: 补上 DSH「获取可用模型」漏记的视觉能力，让能看图的模型不再被当成纯文本，并在模型名后标出「可看图」。

description.en: Token usage statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness - today's token consumption by model, cache hit rate, 7-day trend chart, optional header badge, persistent storage with auto cleanup.
description.zh: DSH Token 用量统计插件 - 今日 Token 用量按模型分桶、缓存命中率、7 日趋势图、可选顶栏徽标、持久化存储自动清理。

description.en: Cooking recipes in DSH: a full panel in the Web GUI plus four recipe_* tools for the agent. 373 home-cooking recipes — mostly Chinese, with Western, Japanese and Korean dishes mixed in — bundled with 347 dish photos and three kitchen-tip illustrations; the dataset is derived from the open-source HowToCook project (Unlicense) and was cleaned, unit-repaired and re-typeset for this plugin. Browse by dish, category or the ingredients you already have, get a daily pick, keep favourites and cooked marks, and read kitchen tips. Everything ships inside the plugin: offline, no hotlinking, no telemetry.
description.zh: 菜谱面板 + 4 个 recipe_* 工具：373 道家常菜谱（以中式为主，兼收西式与日韩菜式），随包附带 347 张菜品图与 3 张厨房技巧插图，数据取自开源项目 HowToCook（Unlicense）并经清洗、单位修正与重排。按菜名、分类或手头食材找菜，每日推荐、收藏与「做过」标记、厨房技巧；数据随插件分发，离线可用，不热链、无遥测。

description.en: Pull invoice number, date, parties, tax IDs and the amount/tax/total triplet out of text, then verify that amount plus tax really equals the total and flag documents that do not reconcile.
description.zh: 从文本中提取发票号码、日期、购销方、税号与金额/税额/合计，并验算「金额 + 税额 = 价税合计」是否成立，对不上就报出来。

description.en: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，一键启动/停止/监测服务，双击唤起 GUI。

description.en: Answers real-life decisions from a 765-entry Chinese life guide: looks up entries first, ranks by cost and benefit, and cites section and item.
description.zh: 按《高性价比人生指南》765 条正文回答人生决策：先查条目，按成本与收益排序，每条注明第几节第几条。

description.en: Plug-in vision for text-only models on DSH, with native interaction for image understanding and generation, GUI automation, through layered evidence memory and cache.
description.zh: 为 DSH 上的纯文本模型提供视觉插件：通过分层证据记忆与缓存，实现图片理解与生成的原生交互及 GUI 自动化。

description.en: Marks a Session as focus or parked in one click from its sidebar row, its hover card, or the conversation header, and keeps a count visible at the foot of the sidebar and next to workspace folder names when those groups are collapsed. A panel lists every marked Session alongside the states the sidebar already tracks (waiting for a reply, running, finished-unread), and the sidebar foot opens whichever one needs a reply first.
description.zh: 从会话行、悬浮卡或会话头一点即可标记「进行中／挂起」；侧边栏底部和折叠的工作区名旁始终显示还有几条。面板把标记过的会话与侧边栏本就跟踪的状态（等待回复、在跑、已完成未查看）列在一起，底部读数则直接跳到最该处理的那一条。

description.en: Sends desktop notifications and custom HTTP pushes when tasks finish or need your attention.
description.zh: 在任务结束或需要处理时发送桌面通知和自定义 HTTP 推送。

description.en: Manual model probe for DeepSeek Harness: a session-view tab where you pick provider, API type, model and route, then send one real raw HTTP request over openai-completions, openai-responses or anthropic-messages — streaming or not — and read latency, TTFT, HTTP status, token usage and a three-layer diagnosis chain (API request / model response / strict check) on one screen, with errors in plain language.
description.zh: DSH 模型健康检查：会话视图页签内按「供应商 → API 类型 → 模型 → 路由」选定目标，手动发一条真实裸 HTTP 请求（支持 openai-completions / openai-responses / anthropic-messages 三协议，流式可切），一屏看清耗时、TTFT、HTTP 状态、token 用量与三层诊断链（API 请求 / 模型响应 / 严格校验），错误全部人话化。

description.en: Full-screen workspace panel for DSH: a project sidebar with per-project tabs for session, files, explorer, project search, terminal, browser, source control and a Markdown notes vault.
description.zh: DSH 全屏工作台面板：项目侧栏加按项目隔离的 tab，覆盖会话、文件、资源管理器、全项目搜索、终端、浏览器、源代码管理与 Markdown 笔记库。

description.en: Runs a local command, an HTTP request or a log entry on DSH lifecycle events (startup, session start/idle/end, user messages, tool results) or on a daily or interval schedule; a left-rail panel and five agent tools manage the same rule set.
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动、会话开始/空闲/结束、收到消息、工具执行后，或按每天/固定间隔，自动执行本机命令、发 HTTP 请求或写一条日志；左侧栏面板与五个 agent 工具管理同一批规则。

description.en: Daily briefing plugin for DeepSeek Harness that collects watched X accounts, RSS/Atom/JSON/ICS feeds and arbitrary pages, YouTube and Bilibili updates, Steam news, Minecraft server and status pages, mailboxes (IMAP) and calendars into persona-styled rows. YouTube and Bilibili videos are read past the title: the plugin fetches each video's real comment count, picks the most-discussed one and puts it on top as a hot-takes card with its highest-liked comments. Built for Windows 10/11: it registers a daily Windows scheduled task (enabled by default, 07:30) that opens the briefing in an Edge/Chrome app window, stores mailbox and cookie credentials with Windows DPAPI, and by default sends item titles (including mail subjects) to the DSH model to polish the wording (set ai.polish to off in config.json to disable).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供每日简报：汇总关注的 X 账号、RSS/Atom/JSON/ICS 订阅与网页、YouTube 与 Bilibili 更新、Steam 动态、Minecraft 服务器与状态页、邮箱（IMAP）与日历，按人设排版。YouTube 与 Bilibili 不只看标题：会读取每条视频的真实评论数，挑出评论最多的那条放在简报顶部做成「今日热议」卡片，附上点赞最高的几条热评。面向 Windows 10/11：默认注册每日 Windows 计划任务（07:30），到点用 Edge/Chrome 应用窗口弹出简报；邮箱与 Cookie 凭据用 Windows DPAPI 加密保存；默认会把条目标题（含邮件主题）交给 DSH 模型润色文案（在 config.json 里把 ai.polish 设为 off 可关闭）。

description.en: \!WARNING\! this removes the authentication step !WARNING! Exchanges the process launch token for the browser-session cookie, so a first visit needs no ?token=... in the URL.
description.zh: ！警告！这会移除认证步骤！警告！注册一个登录入口路由（默认 GET /__dsh_login），把进程里的登录 token 换成浏览器会话 cookie，让首次访问不用带 ?token=…。

description.en: Image viewer for the dock workbench: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO and AVIF, with SVG rendered as image data only.
description.zh: dock 系列图片查看器：支持 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/SVG/ICO/AVIF 格式，SVG 仅以安全方式渲染。

description.en: Header chip for the DSH web GUI that shows whether the current Beijing time is inside DeepSeek's API peak window, with a live clock and countdown to the next transition.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 会话头部高峰指示灯，实时显示当前北京时间是否处于 DeepSeek API 高峰时段，附实时时钟与下一转折倒计时。

description.en: Export the current DSH conversation, or selected turns, as clean readable Markdown.
description.zh: 将当前 DSH 对话或选定轮次导出为干净、易读的 Markdown。

description.en: Routes chat images to a fixed OpenAI-compatible vision model, returns factual observations to the selected main model, and reuses session-scoped observations across replay, compaction, and restarts.
description.zh: 将聊天图片交给固定的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，把事实性观察交给当前主模型，并在事件回放、上下文压缩和重启时复用会话内观察。

description.en: Legacy compatibility entry for the bundled Skirk, Rose Queen and Hatsune Miku themes; new users only need dsh-plugin-miku-theme.
description.zh: 丝柯克、玫瑰女王与初音未来主题套装的旧版管理器兼容入口；新用户只需安装 dsh-plugin-miku-theme。

description.en: Idle-time context truncation for a single DeepSeek Harness session. After a configurable number of idle hours the older conversation is dropped without a summary, so one long-lived session cannot leak one task into the next; it ships a per-session toggle, a tab next to the chat, and a /truncate command that IM bridges can drive.
description.zh: 单个会话的空闲定时上下文截断：可配置空闲多少小时后整段丢弃较早的对话（不生成摘要），避免长期存活的会话把上一个任务带进下一个；带每会话开关、会话上方的「上下文截断」选项卡，以及 IM 桥接可直接驱动的 /truncate 命令。

description.en: A /agentinit command that builds, repairs or audits a repository's AGENTS.md inside a subagent: the child reads the method file itself and checks every command and path it writes with the bundled read-only checker, so no instruction body enters the main conversation. The bundled checker is a Python script, so Python 3 must be on PATH.
description.zh: /agentinit 命令：在子代理里生成、修订或审计仓库的 AGENTS.md。方法文档由子代理自己读取，写下的每条命令与路径都用随包的只读检查器核验，主对话不进入任何指令正文。随包的检查器是 Python 脚本，需要 Python 3 在 PATH 中。

description.en: Gaokao countdown blackboard: counts down the days to the gaokao on a desktop blackboard widget that collapses into a slim bar on double-click, and quizzes random knowledge cards while the agent works; open Markdown knowledge-card framework — drop .md files under subject/category folders and they load automatically, with cross-links, favorites, priority subjects and importing your own knowledge base.
description.zh: 梦回高三：桌面小黑板高考倒计时（双击收成竖条），AI 干活时随机抽背知识点卡；Markdown 开放知识卡框架——按学科/分类放 md 即自动加载，支持关联跳转/收藏/重点学科/导入自己的知识库。

description.en: Unofficial FreeCodeGo for DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek, Codex and Claude engines over one session and toolchain, with a 0-token free access channel for deepseek-v4.1-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash-free, glm-5.3-flash, grok-4.6, kimi-k3, nemotron-3-ultra-free, muse-spark-1.3, Qwen 3.8 Flash and mimo-v2.6-flash-free, plus a keyless private-key gateway.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 FreeCodeGo：DeepSeek、Codex、Claude 三套引擎共用同一条会话与工具链，并为以下模型提供 0 token 免费使用渠道：deepseek-v4.1-flash、deepseek-v4-pro、deepseek-v4-flash-free、glm-5.3-flash、grok-4.6、kimi-k3、nemotron-3-ultra-free、muse-spark-1.3、Qwen 3.8 Flash、mimo-v2.6-flash-free，另有零注册的私钥网关。

description.en: Bayesian stock prediction plugin that fuses MACD, RSI, moving-average, volume and other technical signals into an up-move posterior probability with multi-horizon comparison, trend-state classification and position risk metrics for A-share and US stocks.
description.zh: 贝叶斯个股预测插件：多指标信号融合的上涨概率估计、趋势状态识别与持仓风险度量（A 股 + 美股）。

description.en: Cache-first context compaction with an optional adaptive economic policy, observation-only by default, without cache-hit or cost-saving guarantees.
description.zh: 缓存优先的上下文压缩，提供可选的自适应经济策略，默认仅观察，不保证缓存命中或费用节省。

description.en: Model selector for the DSH composer that keeps the native button and menu and takes over only when the small dropdown would open: search across providers, probe any model with a real streaming request to measure TTFT and TPS, and browse a leaderboard of up to 100 rows built from OpenRouter's catalogue, where clicking a row searches local channels of that name.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的模型选择器：保留原生按钮与菜单，只在小下拉列表即将弹出时接管；跨渠道搜索、对任意模型发起真实流式请求测出 TTFT 与 TPS，并可浏览由 OpenRouter 目录构建的最多 100 行榜单，点一行即搜索本机同名渠道。

description.en: Registers the justSkill design skill in DSH, adds a workbench that lists design files across workspaces, and opens a file's live canvas in the session's right sidebar. The agent edits a validated HTML file one operation at a time while the user reviews and adjusts on the canvas.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中注册 justSkill 设计技能，提供跨工作区的设计文件工作台，并在会话右侧栏打开实时画布：Agent 逐条修改受校验的 HTML 文件，用户在画布上审阅调整。

description.en: Floating approval window for DeepSeek Harness that appears when you leave the app and hands the request back to the native card when you return. Windows-only (WPF via PowerShell). Independent fork of zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta (MIT); do not run alongside the upstream.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的独立审批浮窗：离开应用时弹出，切回时把请求交还原生卡片。仅 Windows（WPF/PowerShell）；独立分支自 zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta（MIT），不能与上游同时运行。

description.en: Ten live-data tools over eight keyless public APIs: FX rates, weather, npm/PyPI versions, GitHub repo stats, Bilibili video stats, A-share/index/gold quotes, and IP geolocation. Tool defaults are configurable in settings.
description.zh: 10 个实时数据工具，覆盖 8 个免密钥公开接口：汇率、天气、npm/PyPI 包版本、GitHub 仓库信息、B站视频数据、A股/大盘/金价行情、IP 归属地；默认参数可在设置面板配置。

description.en: Chain-of-thought leakage linter: zero-dependency CLI that finds AI-session residue in docs and comments (dead design citations, PR vantage, change narration, review choreography), shipping the cot-trim fixing skill as the installable bundle.
description.zh: 思维链泄漏检测：零依赖 CLI 扫描 AI 留在文档与注释里的会话残留（死设计引用、PR 视角、变更叙述、评审编排），内置 cot-trim 语义修复技能包。

description.en: A bookshelf panel for reading .txt novels beside the conversation: import a local file, decode UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, UTF-16 or GB18030, split it into chapters, then read with a table of contents, chapter navigation, adjustable font size, line height and column width. Each book resumes at the chapter and scroll position you left it at.
description.zh: 在对话旁边加一个书架面板，用来读本地 .txt 小说：导入文件后识别 UTF-8、带 BOM 的 UTF-8、UTF-16 或 GB18030 编码并自动分章，提供目录、上下章、字号、行距与版心宽度，每本书从上次读到的章节与位置继续。

description.en: Local-first DSH Web work checklist with rich-text notes, categories, folding, drag reordering, search, JSON import/export, and a restorable trash.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH Web 工作清单，支持富文本笔记、分类、折叠、拖拽排序、搜索、JSON 导入导出和可还原回收站。

description.en: Replies to DingTalk direct messages as your own account — reads the bound DSH workspace, writes the answer, and sends it back through the dws CLI.
description.zh: 以你本人钉钉身份自动回复私聊：在绑定的 DSH 工作区里查资料生成回答，通过 dws CLI 以本人身份发出。

description.en: Ship a local DSH plugin project to GitHub and the plugin market in one call: preflight, per-file upload with byte verification, the market registry PR, then pull every published file back and compare bytes.
description.zh: 一条命令把本地 DSH 插件工程发到 GitHub 并开市场收录 PR：逐文件上传带字节校验、市场条目 PR，最后把线上文件逐个拉回来比 sha256。

description.en: HTTPS + login gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: access your DSH Web UI securely from another machine on your LAN, or from the internet via port forwarding. Fail-closed defaults (loopback-only, no accounts until configured); setup and security notes in the README.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 HTTPS + 登录保护的远程访问网关：局域网内其它设备可安全访问，配置端口映射后可从互联网访问。默认 fail-closed（仅本机监听、无内置账号，配置后才能登录），配置与安全说明见 README。

description.en: Data visualization plugin that generates self-contained HTML reports with five chart types (bar/comparison/pie/radar/flowchart) and two-column layout.
description.zh: 数据可视化插件 — 生成自包含HTML报告，支持五种图表(bar/comparison/pie/radar/flowchart)与两列布局

description.en: An Obsidian-style knowledge base: ingest sources, let the LLM build and maintain an interlinked wiki, and ask questions grounded in it.
description.zh: 一个 Obsidian 风格的知识库：摄取资料，让 LLM 构建并维护互联 wiki，并基于它提问。

description.en: Makes the AI default to Mermaid diagrams in development conversations — system prompt guidance, a mermaid_validate syntax-check tool with real-parser validation, and an output gate that auto-fixes or removes broken diagrams. Rendering via dsh-mermaid.
description.zh: 让 AI 在开发交流中默认用 Mermaid 图表达——系统提示引导、mermaid_validate 真解析语法校验工具，以及自动修复或摘除坏图的输出闸。渲染交给 dsh-mermaid。

description.en: Keeps an agent working continuously over long stretches: set a deadline, and if it finishes the task early, Dont-Stop automatically nudges it to keep iterating and take on the next step on its own.
description.zh: 保证智能体长时间持续工作：设定一个截止时间，若提前完成任务，Dont-Stop 会自动督促它继续迭代、自主推进下一步任务。

description.en: Exa-backed web search provider for the ctx.web seam, with Exa Dynamic Highlights on by default and the Exa-Beta header that setting requires; exposes all eight Exa retrieval types, adds an /exa command to change highlights, search type and result count at runtime, and registers an exa_search tool that takes its own result count.
description.zh: 基于 Exa 的网页搜索提供方：默认开启 Exa Dynamic Highlights（并带上该设置必需的 Exa-Beta 请求头），开放全部 8 种 Exa 检索类型，提供 /exa 命令在运行时改高亮、检索类型与返回条数，并注册一个可自行指定条数的 exa_search 工具。

description.en: Decentralized multi-device fleet: mDNS LAN discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct execution across networks.
description.zh: 去中心化多设备舰队：mDNS 同网发现、密钥配对、SSH 跨网直连指挥。

description.en: Peer communication between conversations in one DeepSeek Harness process: list the conversations the workspace shows, link one under a nickname, message it without waiting for its turn to end, read its progress without waking it, and declare rules for your own tool calls.
description.zh: 同一 DeepSeek Harness 进程内对话之间的对等通信：列出工作区里的对话、用昵称连接、发消息而不必等对方当前一轮结束、不唤醒对方地查看进度，并给自己声明工具调用规则。

description.en: Peak-Valley Meter (峰谷电表) — a tiny DeepSeek usage companion: a minimal two-part balance chip above the composer (currency symbol + number, nothing else), official balance refreshed every 5s; click the symbol to open the official top-up page in a new tab; hovering the chip fades in a circular backdrop under the symbol, its left arc flush with the chip's own left edge, and expands a 24h peak/valley timeline (orange=peak, blue=valley, glowing marker at the current local time) so off-peak hours are obvious; independent today-spend metering; a settings panel with 10 muted color presets plus custom valley/peak colors, detailed/minimal styles and readout toggles; all-Chinese UI.
description.zh: 峰谷电表——DeepSeek 用量小助手：输入框上方一枚极简余额徽章，框内只有「货币符号 + 余额数字」两组，官方余额每 5 秒实时刷新；点击符号即在新页签打开官方充值页；光标移入徽章时，符号身下浮现一枚圆形底色（左弧与徽章左端圆角完全重合），并展开 24 小时峰谷时间轴（橙=峰时、蓝=谷时、白色发光指针标当前本地时刻），谷时省钱时段一目了然；今日消耗独立计费；设置面板提供 10 套沉稳配色预置与谷/峰色自定义、详细/极简样式与各项读数开关；全中文界面。

description.en: Signs in to ChatGPT by driving DSH's bundled pi-ai Codex OAuth flow from a settings page, revokes the session at OpenAI on sign-out, shows the signed-in account's five-hour and weekly quota, and limits the Codex route to seven GPT models with low, medium, high and xhigh reasoning (default low).
description.zh: 在设置页驱动 DSH 自带 pi-ai 的 Codex OAuth 登录 ChatGPT，退出时在 OpenAI 撤销会话，显示所登录账号的 5 小时与每周额度，并把 Codex 路由限定为 7 个 GPT 模型，统一 low、medium、high、xhigh 四档推理（默认 low）。

description.en: Typing effects, companions and sounds for DSH: theme presets with pets or whale, combos, fullscreen glow and optional key sounds.
description.zh: 为 DSH 打字过程添加主题特效、萌宠或蓝鲸陪伴、连击动画、全屏光晕与可选打字音效。

description.en: Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a Markdown or GEML document instead of the whole file. Ships the GEML authoring skill and a code-graph skill that builds and navigates a project call graph as GEML codemaps.
description.zh: 按块寻址的文档读写：MCP server 提供 geml_get / geml_set / geml_check 等工具，Agent 只取回或改写 Markdown、GEML 文档中的某一个块，而不是整篇文件。另带 GEML 写作技能，以及把项目调用图构建为 GEML codemap 并浏览的代码图谱技能。

description.en: Adds a take screenshot tool plus two optional automatic capture points, putting the screen into the conversation as an image block; requires an image-capable model.
description.zh: 一个截图工具，外加两个默认关闭的自动截图时机。需要模型支持图片输入。

description.en: Real-time generation-speed gauge for DSH: a half-circle dial and a flowing trend curve, sampling tok/s 50 times a second for finer, more accurate measurement.
description.zh: DSH 生成速度仪表盘：半圆表盘与流动曲线趋势图，一秒 50 次获取 tok/s，测量更细更精准。

description.en: A memory panel for DeepSeek Harness with one store per workspace: persona traits, notes about you, dated events, and a first-person diary the model writes and cannot edit. Every entry keeps the quote it came from and can be retracted; workspaces can share one memory and be split apart again; optional per-person profiles for group chats; a capped event list with ★ marks. Local only, no network, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 按工作区分开的记忆面板：人设卡、用户画像、事件与模型自述日记各存一份，每条都带原话与改动史、可以撤回；工作区之间能共用同一份记忆并随时切断；可选按人记录的他人画像；事件有上限、可标 ★。纯本地、不联网、零依赖。

description.en: Named model routes for subagent delegations, configured from a settings page: each alias binds a subagent provider, model and optional reasoning effort, token cap, agent preset, tags, plus a "when to use" line the model reads to pick it, so a delegation names only the alias. Adds five tools (delegate, list routes, edit config, wait, release), shows the route a child actually ran on in its session header, lets each UI element be switched off, and keeps all configuration in one local JSON file instead of YAML.
description.zh: 给子智能体配命名模型路由：每个别名绑定子智能体代理、模型与可选的思考档位、令牌上限、Agent 预设、标签，并写清「何时使用」供模型选路，委派时只写别名。插件提供委派、查目录、改配置、等后台、释放五个工具，在设置页完成全部配置（两级下拉、逐项校验），在子代理会话头部显示其实际运行的路由，界面元素均可单独停用；配置存于本地 JSON，不需要改任何 YAML。

description.en: Records every session as one readable Markdown timeline inside the session workspace - the full request sent to the model (system prompt and plugin injections included), user input, replies, reasoning, tool calls and results, file reads and writes, web searches, skill loads, command runs and token usage - with a review page, a per-session tab and configurable capture scope.
description.zh: 把每次会话记录成会话工作区内一份可读的 Markdown 时间线——发往模型的完整请求（含系统提示词与插件注入）、用户输入、模型回复、推理过程、工具调用与结果、文件读写、联网搜索、技能加载、命令执行与 token 用量，并带审阅页、会话内标签页与可配置的采集范围。

description.en: Automatically groups installed plugins in dsh-market on startup.
description.zh: 启动时自动把已安装插件归入 dsh-market 分组。

description.en: Registers the commercial-ui-ux skill for DSH: task-aware commercial UI/UX/GUI design, review, repair, and implementation (SaaS, dashboards, admin panels, forms, tables, design systems) with a reference-doc system and quality gates.
