description.zh: 注册 commercial-ui-ux 技能：以任务为中心的商业界面 UI/UX/GUI 设计、审查、修复与实现（SaaS、仪表盘、后台、表单、表格、设计系统），带参考文档体系与质量门禁。

description.en: Configurable statistics row below the composer via a ${variable} display template — which segments appear and how they are labelled is fully user-defined.
description.zh: 用 ${变量} 显示模板自定义输入框下方的会话统计行——显示哪些统计段、单位文案怎么写，全部由模板决定。

description.en: Per-session prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness: reusable system-prompt sections, grouped into named profiles, sealed into the session prompt.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按会话提示词配置：可复用的系统提示词片段组成命名配置，并在会话启动时固化进该会话的提示词。

description.en: Zhihu (知乎) for DeepSeek Harness: wraps the local pyzhihu-cli as 18 zhihu_* tools — 14 read-only (search, hot list, question, answer, user, feed, topic, notifications, collections) plus 4 publishing tools that are not registered until readOnly is turned off — with a web panel in the sidebar for login, config and lookups.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供知乎能力：包装本机 pyzhihu-cli 为 18 个 zhihu_* 工具——14 个只读（搜索/热榜/问题/回答/用户/推荐流/话题/通知/收藏夹）与 4 个发布类工具（readOnly 关闭前不注册）——并在侧栏提供 Web 面板做登录、配置与查询。

description.en: Push-to-talk dictation for the Web composer: hold a hotkey to record and the transcript is written into the draft through DSH's own speech Remote (local SenseVoice), with an optional auto-send.
description.zh: 输入框按住说话：按住快捷键录音，经 DSH 自带语音 Remote（本地 SenseVoice）识别后写入草稿，可选自动发送。

description.en: Delete DSH sessions into a restorable recycle bin — subagent sessions follow their parent as one tree, batch archive, restore and purge are supported, and only purge destroys bytes.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话删入可恢复的回收站——子会话随其父会话作为一棵树处理，支持批量归档、恢复与彻底删除，只有彻底清除才会真正销毁数据。

description.en: DSH plugin that installs, supervises and auto-upgrades the local miloco-mcp-server background service, bridges its MCP tools into DSH and adds service, account and license settings panels.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中安装、守护并自动升级本机 miloco-mcp-server 后台服务，把它的 MCP 工具接入 DSH，并提供服务、账号与授权设置界面。

description.en: Mobile UI shell for the DSH Web GUI: turns the desktop three-column layout into a touch-friendly phone layout (overlay drawers, draggable FAB, full-screen dialogs, infinite-scroll history) under a 1024px viewport, with zero desktop impact. - Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的移动端适配：窄屏下把桌面三栏布局改造成触屏友好的手机布局（覆盖式抽屉、可拖拽悬浮按钮、全屏弹窗、上滑加载历史），1024px 断点内生效，桌面端零影响。 — 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

description.en: Compact Codex coding mode for DSH: light prompt guardrails against GPT over-explaining, with an editable prompt and native Codex-style tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供精简的 Codex 编码模式：使用精简的 codex 提示词与原生 Codex 风格工具，并用少量提示词约束抑制 GPT 的过度解释；提示词可自行编辑调整。

description.en: Side chat for the right dock: branches the current conversation into its own Session so follow-ups never derail the main thread. Reuses the product Conversation surface, so streaming, tool calls, Stop and the composer behave exactly like the main chat.
description.zh: 右侧栏辅助对话：把当前会话分支成独立 Session，追问不打断主线。直接复用产品自带的对话界面，流式输出、工具调用、Stop 与 composer 与主对话完全一致。

description.en: Markdown editing aids for the DSH web composer: ordered and unordered list continuation with continuous renumbering, Tab-nested list levels, inline-code styling, and code-fence auto-closing, with the sent draft kept as literal Markdown.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的 Markdown 编辑增强：有序与无序列表续行且组内序号恒连续、Tab 层级缩进、行内代码样式、代码块围栏自动闭合；发送的草稿保持字面 Markdown。

description.en: Adds a General settings row choosing where the Add-workspace directory picker opens: a fixed custom path (typed, pasted, or picked visually) or the last directory you confirmed. Quoted and CJK paths are accepted, and a This PC level reaches other Windows drives.
description.zh: 在通用设置中新增一行，控制点击"添加工作区"时目录选择框从哪里打开：固定自定义路径（可输入、粘贴或可视化选取），或上次确认的目录。容忍带引号与中文路径，并提供「此电脑」层以跨盘选择。

description.en: Configure automation Hooks for user and project scopes to run commands on session, tool, permission, and context-compaction events. Manage Hook authorization manually in Hooks setting.
description.zh: 为用户和项目配置自动化 Hook，在会话、工具调用、权限请求和上下文压缩等事件发生时运行命令。Hook 授权需在“Hooks 设置”中手动管理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness integration for OpenContext with durable cross-session memory, automatic prompt capture and recall, session summaries, structured insights, and document retrieval.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenContext，提供跨会话持久记忆、提示词自动捕获与召回、会话摘要、结构化洞察和文档检索。

description.en: AI interview practice for DeepSeek Harness Web: generates questions across four modes (concept review, mock interview, scenario, LeetCode Hot 100), scores answers, and provides explanations.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 AI 面试陪练：支持背八股、模拟面试、场景题与力扣热题 100 四种模式，自动评分、点评并讲解知识点。

description.en: Open the current registered Workspace from the Session Header or Workspace menu in a detected or configured editor, with hot re-detection and a remembered browser preference.
description.zh: 从 Session 页头或 Workspace 菜单用检测到或配置的编辑器打开当前已登记 Workspace，支持热重新检测和浏览器首选项记忆。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and current-session spend estimate in a top-bar chip and settings card, with pause-aware auto-refresh, an editable official price table, a `deepseek_balance` model tool, and a bilingual UI.
description.zh: 顶栏徽章与设置卡片展示 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前会话预估花费：暂停感知的自动刷新、可编辑官方价格表、`deepseek_balance` 模型工具与中英文界面。

description.en: Loopback-first multi-agent message relay: HMAC-authenticated broker plus dsh plugin (relay_send/recv/peers/history), zero-dependency CLI and Python clients, wire protocol v1.0.
description.zh: 本地优先的多 Agent 协作中继：HMAC 认证 broker + dsh 插件（relay_send/recv/peers/history）+ 零依赖 CLI 与 Python 客户端，wire protocol v1.0。

description.en: Expand button for the DSH Web UI composer — appears at 3+ lines, stretches to near-fullscreen height, auto-collapses on send, and inserts a newline on Enter or Shift+Enter in expanded mode while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends.
description.zh: 输入框全屏扩展按钮——内容达 3 行以上时出现，点击扩展至全屏高度，发送后自动折叠；扩展模式下 Enter 与 Shift+Enter 换行，Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 发送。

description.en: DSH sidebar footer ordering: forces the sidebar.footer.action slot into a vertical stack and lets users configure the top-to-bottom order of its entries.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏页脚排序：将 sidebar.footer.action 槽位改为上下堆叠，并允许用户配置各条目自上而下的排列顺序。

description.en: Adds one tool, echo_judge, that scores 1-4 draft replies to an emotionally loaded message on three steps (perception, mental-state inference, response strategy), combines the steps with a cascade gate and step-level credit assignment, and names the weakest step to redo; scoring runs through ctx.llm of the running engine, so no API key is needed.
description.zh: 加一个工具 echo_judge：对 1–4 条回复候选按「感知／心智状态推理／支持策略」三步打分，用级联门控与步骤级信用分配合成总分，并指出最弱、该重做的那一步；打分走引擎自带的 ctx.llm，不需要 API key。

description.en: DSH-side remote session driver for the dsh-overdrive chat gateway: exposes sessions, trajectory replay and tap-to-approve to Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom bridges. Requires running @dsh-overdrive/gateway alongside.
description.zh: dsh-overdrive 聊天网关的 DSH 侧远程会话驱动：把 Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 企业微信 的会话、轨迹回放与一键审批接入 Harness。需配套运行 @dsh-overdrive/gateway。

description.en: Adds a capsule split-button to the conversation header: launch VS Code, terminal, or File Explorer at the current workspace directory in one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话头部添加胶囊拆分按钮，一键在当前工作区打开 VS Code、终端和文件资源管理器。

description.en: Outer Wilds theme with a static starfield, campfire effects, appearance settings, and bundled Jost and Source Han Sans fonts.
description.zh: 以《星际拓荒》为主题，提供静态星空、篝火动效、外观设置和内置 Jost 与思源黑体。

description.en: Writing bridge to the open-source QingAgent client: the agent drafts and revises documents through qing_ prefixed host tools, typeset on a rice-paper panel with mermaid, drawio, tables and KaTeX; edits stage as reviewable diffs and land only on commit, and it requires the QingAgent desktop app on the same machine.
description.zh: 青简写作桥：agent 通过 qing_ 前缀工具起草改稿，右侧宣纸面板排版呈现（mermaid、drawio、表格、公式）；每处修改先摆在纸上供审阅，提交才落稿。需本机运行开源的青简桌面客户端。

description.en: English-only fork of dsh-model-router. Routes each agent step across a configurable model pool and adjusts reasoning effort based on task complexity, tool failures, and cost.
description.zh: dsh-model-router 的纯英文分支。把每个 agent 步骤路由到可配置的模型池，并按任务复杂度、工具失败与成本调整推理强度。

description.en: Data sensitivity classification plugin that auto-identifies sensitive fields and classifies them into high/medium/low/public levels.
description.zh: 数据敏感度分类插件 — 自动识别敏感字段+分级（高/中/低/公开）

description.en: Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt password CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的传输层认证门禁，提供服务端会话、HttpOnly Cookie、基于 IP 的登录限流及 scrypt 口令 CLI。

description.en: DeepTrace — deterministic agent reports from session logs (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly/custom): cost & token breakdown, 8 insight rules, collaboration review, live provider balance, PDF/PNG/HTML export; read-only, never rewrites history.
description.zh: 深迹 DeepTrace — 从会话日志生成日报/周报/月报/年报/自定义区间报告：成本与 Token 拆解、8 条确定性洞察、协作复盘、实时模型余额、PDF/PNG/HTML 导出；只读，绝不改写历史。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, exponential backoff, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning, a settings card and a per-session stop/restore button in the composer toolbar; it never switches models or providers.
description.zh: 回合中断自动续跑：turn/end 因 error / interrupted / max-tokens 结束时自动发送「继续」，支持宽限期、冷却、指数退避、连续次数上限、启动扫描、设置卡片，以及输入框工具行的会话级停止/恢复按钮；不切换模型/provider。

description.en: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice (TTS), and custom audio.
description.zh: 按工作区定制的任务完成铃声，以及审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败等需要人介入事件的注意提示音，支持内置合成音、语音播报与自定义音频。

description.en: Live architecture map of DeepSeek Harness: renders plugins, services, tools, sessions, models and MCP as a five-layer diagram of 14 component domains, and animates the real tool/model/session call flow as moving dots along the connecting curves.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 运行时架构透视：把插件、服务、工具、会话、模型与 MCP 画成 5 层、14 个组件域的实时架构图，并用沿连线移动的圆点动画展示真实的工具 / 模型 / 会话调用流。

description.en: Conversation minimap docked on the right edge of the dsh Web chat: colour-block and to-scale thumbnail modes, drag-to-resize (10–320px), hover loupe preview, click-to-jump and drag-to-scroll with a live viewport indicator, and collapse to a 4px strip.
description.zh: 停靠在 dsh Web 对话区右缘的会话代码地图：色块/缩略图双模式、拖动调宽（10–320px）、悬停放大镜预览、点击跳转与拖动滚动（带实时视口指示条）、可收起为 4px 细条。

description.en: Inline visualizer for DSH: the model loads a design contract first, then renders an SVG or a sandboxed HTML card in place inside the conversation, with light/dark tokens and a source/download toggle.
description.zh: 对话内联可视化：模型先按需加载设计契约，再把 SVG 或沙箱 HTML 卡片就地渲染在对话里，支持深浅色令牌与源码/下载切换。

description.en: Gives one conversation a pinned as-of point and a dated evidence window on both sides — \[as_of − before, as_of + after], past, future or BC. In restricted mode the agent is told the active window once per change, web_search results are filtered to dated sources inside the window and undated sources are rejected, and the first reply must echo the window (a missing echo gets one nudge). It also narrates long silent background jobs with deterministic \[TIME FACT] facts and exposes a read-only time_pin_status tool; default mode injects nothing and filters nothing.
description.zh: 为单个对话钉住 as_of 时间点与前后两侧的带日期证据窗口——\[as_of − before, as_of + after]，支持过去、未来与公元前。在受限模式下，窗口变化时只告知一次当前窗口，web_search 结果按发布日期过滤到窗口内、无日期来源一律排除，首条回复必须确认窗口（缺失时纠正一次）。另对长时间静默的后台任务给出确定性 \[TIME FACT] 播报，并提供只读的 time_pin_status 工具；默认模式不注入、不过滤。

description.en: Ranks workspaces holding a session that wants attention to the top of the sidebar session list - waiting on you first, then running, then finished-but-unopened, then just read - and draws those rows with a state bar, tinted surface and coloured title, plus a one-shot settle pulse when a run stops. Every colour is taken from the active theme's own tokens, and the three windows that decide how long a finished session stays promoted are settings.
description.zh: 把含“需要注意的会话”的工作区按紧急度排到侧栏会话列表最前——待你处理优先，其次运行中，再次完成未读，最后刚读过的——并为这些行画状态竖条、着色底与着色标题，一次运行结束时播放一次收敛动效。所有颜色都取自当前主题自身的变量；决定完成会话置顶时长的三个窗口都是可配置项。

description.en: Counts the assistant rounds that call tools without writing anything to the user, then inserts a short progress reminder as a visible user message at the next model-request boundary, so a long silent tool loop reports what it has done before continuing. A Settings page adjusts the silence threshold (default 10), the reminder wording, the language (en / zh-CN / zh-TW), whether the reminder repeats every further threshold of silent rounds, whether subagent sessions are counted, and whether Agent Teams nudges the lead only or every member.
description.zh: 统计「只调用工具、没有向用户输出文字」的助手轮数，在下一次模型请求的边界把一条简短的过程汇报提醒作为可见的用户消息插入，让长时间沉默的工具循环先汇报已完成的工作再继续。设置页可调整沉默阈值（默认 10）、提醒文案、文案语言（en / zh-CN / zh-TW）、是否每再积累一个阈值就再次提醒、是否统计子代理会话，以及启用智能体团队时只提醒 Lead 还是所有成员。

description.en: Ops request channel for a team over Feishu DMs — a colleague's message waits in a serial queue behind an approval card that the paired admin must accept, then runs in one shared DSH session with a persona attached, and the answer is posted back to the requester.
description.zh: 给同事的运维请求通道——同事在飞书私聊里提的事先排进串行队列，由已配对的管理员在审批卡上放行后才进入那条共享的 DSH 会话（带注入的人设执行），回答回到提交人。

description.en: Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat.
description.zh: 实时追踪 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话中模型流式推理轨迹关键词统计的 UI 面板。

description.en: TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) as the jev_decide tool for DeepSeek Harness: noul, choice and score questions return calibrated probabilities; credentials reuse the DSH credential seam; 429/529 backoff retry built in.
description.zh: 把 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）接入 DSH 的 jev_decide 工具：noul/choice/score 三种问题形状返回校准概率，凭证复用 DSH 凭证缝，内建 429/529 退避重试。

description.en: A draggable tarot card back in the corner of the DeepSeek Harness UI. Click to draw, right-click for the four spreads, full 78-card deck with bilingual meanings. Readings use only the cards actually drawn.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面角落里可拖动的塔罗牌背。点一下抽牌，右击选四种牌阵，完整 78 张牌库，正逆位含义中英双语。解读只用真正抽到的牌。

description.en: Shows per-turn, per-session and per-workspace conversation costs in CNY, priced by DeepSeek's official tiers with peak/off-peak hours and per-request Search/Fetch billing.
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 官方价目显示每轮、每会话与每工作区的对话费用人民币金额，支持峰谷分时与 Search/Fetch 按次计费。

description.en: Prompt-driven code audit tasks for DeepSeek Harness with vulnerability tracking, live progress, and exportable reports that include PoC request examples.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 代码审计插件：按所选提示词执行审计任务，跟踪漏洞与实时进度，导出包含 PoC 请求包的专业报告。

description.en: DeepSeek account wallet balance and the current peak or off-peak billing period, in a fixed status region at the sidebar foot, with a manual refresh and an official top-up link.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部固定状态区：DeepSeek 账号钱包余额、当前计费时段（高峰/空闲）、手动刷新与官方充值入口。

description.en: Creates, activates, checks and removes external DSH plugins from a conversation through fixed tools; requires the external DSHX devkit.
description.zh: 通过对话中的固定工具创建、激活、检查和移除外部 DSH 插件，需要外部 DSHX 开发工具。

description.en: Astrophotography planner: 18 target types across 173 Chinese sites, ranked by light pollution, altitude, moon phase, ephemeris events and 7-day weather, with framing and exposure advice plus a Stellarium-style 3D sky preview. The 7-day weather comes from Open-Meteo, which needs network access; everything else runs offline.
description.zh: 星野摄影计划：按 18 类天象与深空目标、全国 173 站检索，结合光污染、方位、月相、星历事件与 7 天天气给出推荐排序、焦段与曝光，并附 Stellarium 风格 3D 天球画面模拟。7 天天气来自 Open-Meteo，需要联网；其余功能离线运行。

description.en: Thesis and empirical-analysis workbench that drives IBM SPSS from the conversation: spss_check (environment self-check), spss_variables (list .sav variables with labels, types, measurement levels, case counts), spss_data (sample case rows to inspect missing and outlying values), spss_run / spss_run_file (execute SPSS syntax or an .sps file, relative CD and GET FILE paths auto-rebased), and spss_analyze (one-shot frequencies, descriptives, crosstabs with chi-square, t-tests, one-way ANOVA, correlation, linear regression). Results come back as structured tables extracted through OMS. SPSS 25-31 is auto-detected; the bundled MCP server is zero-dependency stdio.
description.zh: 论文/实证分析工作台：在对话里直接驱动 IBM SPSS。spss_check（环境自检）、spss_variables（列出 .sav 变量：名称/标签/类型/测度水平/案例数）、spss_data（抽查案例数据，检查缺失与异常值）、spss_run 与 spss_run_file（执行 SPSS 语法或 .sps 文件，自动修正 CD / GET FILE 相对路径）、spss_analyze（一键跑频数、描述统计、交叉表卡方、t 检验、单因素方差、相关、线性回归）。结果经 OMS 导出为结构化表格。自动探测 SPSS 25-31；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 服务。

description.en: Browse, sort, group, toggle and batch-update every DSH plugin you already installed — with groups, filters and resumable updates.
description.zh: 已安装 DSH 插件的书架：按名称/安装时间/大小排序，自由分组与一键启停，批量检查并可断点续装的自动更新。

description.en: Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and jump to a message (auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded).
description.zh: 会话历史消息查看：列出当前会话全部你发送的消息，支持排序、搜索、一键复制与点击跳转定位（目标未加载时自动加载更早历史）。

description.en: Search stored DSH conversation text across all or selected workspaces and sessions, with exact, regular-expression, typo-tolerant or word-internal subsequence matching.
description.zh: 在所有或指定工作区、会话中搜索已存储的 DSH 对话文本，支持精确、正则表达式、拼写容错及词内子序列匹配。

description.en: Compiles a repository into a source-grounded code map: structured pages where every claim carries a verifiable path:line citation, an interactive dependency graph, knowledge cards, four model tools and the /codemap command. Deterministic, no model calls, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 把代码仓库编译成带 path:line 源码引用的代码地图：结构化页面、可拖拽依赖图谱、知识卡片、四个模型工具与 /codemap 命令。确定性生成、不调用模型、零第三方依赖。

description.en: A right-sidebar Git panel in the IDEA style — local changes with per-file checkbox commits, a commit tree with per-commit details, branch, remote and stash management, push with a credential fallback, all driven by the plain git CLI.
description.zh: 右侧栏的 IDEA 风格 Git 面板：本地变更与按文件勾选提交、提交树与提交详情、分支 / 远程 / 贮藏管理、带凭据兜底的推送，以及 git 命令流水，全部通过原生 git CLI 执行。

description.en: Publishes HTML pages and Markdown documents written by the agent to GitHub Pages as shareable links, with tools to update them in place, list, read back, and delete them; adds an Artifacts sidebar panel and a bundled page-design skill.
description.zh: 把 Agent 生成的 HTML 页面和 Markdown 文档发布到 GitHub Pages 并返回可分享链接，提供原地更新、列出、读回和删除的工具；附带侧边栏 Artifacts 面板和内置的页面设计技能。

description.en: Plays a random chime when a reply finishes, a one-shot reminder chime if the conversation stays quiet for a configurable number of seconds afterwards, and a chime the moment DSH needs you to step in: an approval request, a question, or a plan confirmation. Three independent switches and sound pools, persisted on disk.
description.zh: 每轮回复结束随机播一声完成音效；之后若静默到设定秒数，再补响一次提醒；DSH 需要你出面（审批、提问、确认计划）时立刻响一声。三个独立开关：A/C 为可批量导入的音效池，B 为单个提醒音；设置全部落盘持久化。

description.en: A GitHub-connected visual git manager for DeepSeek Harness: guided GitHub-Flow steps, commit graph with PR/CI badges, one-click GitHub login, PR and issue management, and structured git tools for the agent. Renamed from gitcompass in 2.0.0.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub 联动的可视化 Git 管理：引导式 GitHub Flow 步骤、带 PR/CI 徽章的提交图谱、一键 GitHub 登录、PR 与 issue 管理，以及面向 Agent 的结构化 Git 工具。2.0.0 起由 gitcompass 改名而来。

description.en: An agent preset that adds a working mode to DeepSeek Harness: the mode text has the model analyze requirements and plan before acting, open a gate document, and reply in a fixed three-block shape. The task tree and session-start profile injection are separate companion packages in the same repository, installed from a clone with scripts/install.mjs; only the term dictionary (dsh-term-dict) comes with this package, and without the task tree the model writes its own alignment bar. Needs DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 or later.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 增加一个工作模式的 agent preset：模式正文要求模型动手前做需求分析与计划、建关卡文档，回复固定三块。任务树与开场画像注入是同仓库的独立配套包，需克隆仓库后用 scripts/install.mjs 装；装本包只会自动带上术语字典（dsh-term-dict），没有任务树时由模型自己写对齐栏。需要 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 及以上。

description.en: Mobile web shell for the DSH Web GUI: overlay drawers, draggable FAB, mobile composer fixes, and a floating image-upload button pinned above the composer (native gallery/camera, integrated with the validated add-images pipeline), zero desktop regression. Published on npm as dsh-webui-mobile.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的移动端外壳：抽屉式侧栏、可拖拽悬浮按钮、移动端输入框修复，以及悬浮在输入框上方的图片上传按钮（原生相册/拍照，走加图校验管线），桌面端零影响。已发布到 npm（dsh-webui-mobile）。

description.en: Dracula (VS Code) dark theme for the DSH Web GUI: the vampire palette mapped onto the product colour tokens, plus a denser type scale, a 1080px reading column and code blocks that scroll instead of re-wrapping. Dark mode only.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Dracula（VS Code 吸血鬼）深色主题：把产品自身的配色令牌映射到德古拉调色板，并附更紧的字号阶梯、1080px 正文列宽与不折行的代码块。仅深色模式。

description.en: A goal mode for DeepSeek Harness with no round cap: a goal stays active until it is completed, paused, blocked, or cleared; the minimum interval between automatic rounds is configurable, and quiet windows suppress automatic rounds.
description.zh: DSH 的无轮次上限目标模式：目标保持 active 直到被完成、暂停、阻塞或清除；自动轮次之间的最小间隔可配置，静默时段内不触发自动轮次。

description.en: Message hub for DeepSeek Harness. Collectors for system health, weather, IMAP mail and market events feed configurable severity rules (critical wakes you, warn batches, info is only logged), and the surviving events are handed to the agent. Collectors run in-process, so nothing dies silently in a stray daemon. The weather collector is on by default and sends your IP to ip-api.com over plain HTTP unless a city is configured.
description.zh: 消息中枢：采集系统健康、天气、邮件与行情事件，按可配置的轻重规则过滤（critical 立刻叫、warn 攒批、info 只留档），再把事件交给 agent。采集器跑在插件进程里，不会死在一个没人看的守护进程里。天气采集器默认开启，未配置城市时会把你的 IP 经明文 HTTP 发给 ip-api.com 定位。

description.en: Radial right-click menu on conversation turns in the DSH web GUI for forking a session from a chosen turn, interrupting generation, copying the working directory path or session ID, opening the working directory, and exporting session logs.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话轮次上点击右键弹出的圆盘菜单：从此轮分叉出新会话、打断生成、复制工作目录路径与会话 ID、打开工作目录、导出会话日志。

description.en: Declares per-model reasoning-effort ladders for third-party providers in the llm-pi-ai settings section, so DSH's stock thinking-intensity selector works on models the pi-ai catalog does not describe.
description.zh: 在 llm-pi-ai 设置节为第三方模型提供商补齐推理档位（reasoning effort）声明，让 DSH 自带的思考强度选择器对 pi-ai 目录之外的模型真正可用。

description.en: Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or blocks repeat attempts until the evidence changes.
description.zh: 证据约束的负面知识账本：记录被证伪的路径（command_failed / file_missing）及其结果与前置条件证据，重复尝试时警告或拦截，证据变化后自动解除。

description.en: PWA icon: replaces the icon and app name used when the Web GUI is installed or added to the desktop, covering desktop browsers and the iOS home screen. Ships a ready-to-use bundled icon set and accepts your own image plus manifest overrides.
description.zh: PWA 图标：把 Web GUI 安装 / 添加到桌面时使用的图标与应用名换成自定义内容，覆盖桌面浏览器与 iOS 主屏幕。包内自带开箱即用的图标集，也支持换成自己的图片并覆盖 manifest 字段。

description.en: A tiled sticky-notes board for the DSH sidebar (a notes plugin): per-row density, colours, pins, search and colour filters, a trash with restore, Markdown export, and note_* tools that read and write the same notes.
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏的彩色便签墙（便签插件 / 记事贴）：每行 2–5 个或自适应、置顶、搜索与颜色筛选、带恢复的回收站、Markdown 导出；四个 note_* 工具读写同一批便签。

description.en: Use Kimi Code as the DSH agent loop over ACP, with approvals, slash commands, and local/remote (ssh+tmux) session attach.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 agent loop 换成 Kimi Code（ACP 直连）：审批、斜杠命令、本地与远程（ssh+tmux）会话接入。

description.en: GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or cancel CI; mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right panel.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏 GitHub 工作台：远端目录树加 Issues / Pull requests / Actions 页签，支持建 Issue/PR、评论、编辑、关闭、merge/squash/rebase 与重跑或取消 CI；挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧面板。

description.en: DSH knowledge-graph memory with a better-sidebar tab and a standalone /graph-memory/app dashboard: extracts TASK/SKILL/EVENT nodes, recalls across sessions, and ships as the npm package dsh-graphmemory.
description.zh: DSH 知识图谱记忆：better-sidebar「记忆图谱」页签与独立看板 /graph-memory/app；抽取任务/技能/事件节点并跨会话召回，npm 包名为 dsh-graphmemory。

description.en: Lists the Docker Compose projects of your DSH workspaces in the right sidebar, one group per project directory, with container status, project- and service-level up/stop/restart, and streamed per-service logs.
description.zh: 在右侧栏列出各 DSH 工作区中的 Docker Compose 项目，按项目目录分组，显示容器状态，支持项目级与服务级 up/stop/restart 以及单服务日志流。

description.en: Import local Claude, Codex, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode, and CC Switch config into DeepSeek Harness with OAuth login for supported providers.
description.zh: 把本机的 Claude、Codex、Grok、Gemini、Copilot、OpenCode 与 CC Switch 配置导入 DeepSeek Harness，支持的提供方可直接 OAuth 登录。

description.en: Suiji Word Book: a word book panel that shows one word per page with picture, phonetics, pronunciation, five phrases and an example sentence, plus fill-in-the-letters spelling practice and a 12-type word-recognition quiz. Word data is kept as plain files in a local directory, and an included skill lets an AI add cards from a word list. The “+Word” button (hidden until enabled in Settings) starts an AI session and by default switches it to danger-full-access; turn that off in Settings.
description.zh: 随记单词本：一个词一页，插图、音标、发音、五条词组和例句，外加挖字母拼写练习与 12 种题型的单词辨析；词库以普通文件保存在本地目录，附带技能可让 AI 按词表批量建卡。「+单词」按钮（默认隐藏，需在设置里开启）会新建 AI 会话并默认把它切到 danger-full-access，可在设置里关闭。

description.en: Windows desktop floating assistant for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top chat panel with streaming answers, model switching, and region-screenshot questions.
description.zh: Windows 桌面悬浮助手：常驻置顶的对话面板，框选屏幕区域直接提问，支持流式回答、模型切换与历史记录。

description.en: Finance data toolkit for DSH agents: number and currency formatting (incl. Chinese wan/yi units), return and CAGR math, valuation and profitability ratios, PV/FV, risk metrics, and a data-quality checklist.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供金融数据工具包：数字与货币格式化（含中文万/亿单位）、收益与年化计算、估值与盈利比率、现值/终值、风险指标与数据质量清单。

description.en: Companion for DSH Notch that synchronizes session navigation and read state with DSH Desktop and Web.
description.zh: DSH Notch 的配套助手，同步 Desktop、Web 与 Notch 之间的会话跳转和已读状态。

description.en: Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or wandering off when idle, with click-to-view work monitors and in-place approval cards.
description.zh: 把多 agent 会话的实时活动渲染成 Web UI 侧边栏里的像素风办公室--每个会话是一名牛/马员工，忙时伏案敲键盘、闲时起身摸鱼，支持点击查看工位监控、就地处理审批。

description.en: Long-term memory kept as plain Markdown plus git: each session opens with a generated memory-context block assembled from a global store and per-project books (role card, user profile, current focus, routing table, recent logs), the plugin records which memory files the agent read and reminds it to extract conclusions while the day's log is unextracted, personas live in roles/<role>/SOUL.md role cards, and it ships a seven-tab settings page in the sidebar plus four skills. Requires Python 3.10+.
description.zh: 以纯 Markdown 加 git 存放长期记忆：每次会话开始按全局总册与各项目册渲染一段 memory-context（人格卡、用户档案、当前焦点、路由表、最近日志），记录代理读过哪些记忆文件，并在当天日志还没提炼时提醒收口；人格放在 roles/<role>/SOUL.md 角色卡里，附侧边栏七页签设置页与四个 skill。依赖 Python 3.10+。

description.en: Provides a specification-driven engineering workbench with versioned requirements and documents, isolated Git workspaces, independent review, verification, and explicit human acceptance. Requires Node.js 24+ and Git.
description.zh: 提供规格驱动的工程工作台，支持需求和文档版本、隔离 Git 工作区、独立复核、验证与人工接纳。需 Node.js 24+ 与 Git。

description.en: Adds a knowledge-base picker and a native-attachment paperclip to the DSH composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框中加入知识库选择器与原生附件回形针。

description.en: Toasts from DeepSeek Harness when a turn finishes, and when it stops for approval, a question or a plan exit. Native on Windows, text and timing configurable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：任务完成时、或停下来等你审批/回答/确认计划时弹出系统通知。文案与触发时机可配置。

description.en: A port of the T3 Code model picker into the composer: a provider rail, search results grouped under provider headings, favorites kept in the browser, unavailable-provider badges, and Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 jump shortcuts for the first nine rows of the visible list.
description.zh: 把 T3 Code 的模型选择器移植到 DSH 输入框：提供方侧栏、按提供方分组的搜索结果、浏览器本地收藏、不可用提供方标记，以及用 Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 直接选中可见列表的前九行。

description.en: Hides the built-in DSH Desktop update badge (the download-arrow "新版本" pill beside the account button): a CSS rule for the current build plus accessible-label matching with a throttled MutationObserver, so it keeps working after a DSH upgrade. Update checking, the manual "Check for updates" menu item and the connection indicator are untouched.
description.zh: 隐藏 DSH 桌面版自带的更新角标（账号按钮右边那颗「下载箭头 + 新版本」胶囊）：当前构建用一条 CSS 规则压掉，再叠一层按无障碍标签识别 + 节流 MutationObserver 的兜底，宿主升级后仍大概率有效；更新检查、菜单里的「检查更新」和连接指示器都不受影响。

description.en: Recall previously sent messages in the input box with Up/Down, and archive a workspace session from its right-click menu.
description.zh: 在输入框内按 ↑/↓ 回填历史消息，并支持右键归档（隐藏）工作区会话。

description.en: Escaped, theme-aware HTML code-block rendering service for DSH Web plugins, built on structured syntax-highlight tokens with source line-ending preservation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 插件的转义与主题响应 HTML 代码块渲染服务，基于结构化语法高亮 token，并保留源码换行符。

description.en: Read, build and take apart EPUB 3 books with no external dependency — the ZIP reader/writer and the XML scanner are both built in. Inspect metadata, reading order and TOC for structural problems, assemble a book from chapters, or split one back into per-chapter HTML.
description.zh: 读、造、拆 EPUB 3 电子书，零外部依赖 —— ZIP 读写器与 XML 扫描器均为自建。可体检元数据/阅读顺序/目录并点出结构问题，从章节拼出一本合规的书，或把已有的书拆回逐章 HTML。

description.en: Adds an edit action to finalized assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness, letting you rewrite the reply text or reasoning chain; the edit is saved as a surface replacement.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 已完成的助手回复增加编辑入口，可改写正文或思维链，改动以 surface replacement 形式保存。

description.en: Registers DeepSeek Search and Fetch API providers for the ctx.web seam, replacing both the web_search and web_fetch backends with DeepSeek's Search and Fetch JSON APIs, with configurable retries and backoff, settings that apply to the next call, and a configuration page on the bundle page. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5+ and a DeepSeek API key with access to /v1/tools/search and /v1/tools/fetch (calls are billed by DeepSeek; account sign-in is not supported).
description.zh: 在 ctx.web 接缝上注册 DeepSeek Search / Fetch API 的搜索与抓取 provider，用 DeepSeek 的 Search / Fetch JSON API 替换 web_search 与 web_fetch 两个后端；支持可配置的重试与退避、下次调用即生效的实时设置，以及 bundle 详情页里的配置页。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 及以上，以及一个可访问 /v1/tools/search 与 /v1/tools/fetch 的 DeepSeek API key（调用由 DeepSeek 计费；不支持账号登录）。

description.en: Sidebar badge showing the current DeepSeek peak/off-peak billing phase, the countdown to the next switch, the account balance and a 7-day CNY spend chart — with a voice alarm when off-peak starts.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示当前峰谷计费档位、切换倒计时、账户余额和近 7 天人民币花费柱状图；谷时开始时用语音提醒你开工。

description.en: Read-only Web client file-preview panel with image, PDF, CSV/TSV, text, source-code, Markdown, JSON and YAML renderers, large-file range loading, and a provider API for non-local content.
description.zh: Web 客户端只读文件预览面板，支持图片、PDF、CSV/TSV、文本、源代码、Markdown、JSON 与 YAML 渲染、大文件分段读取，以及面向非本地内容的 provider API。

description.en: Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.
description.zh: 多模型主脑编排器：主模型将复杂任务拆解，按各模型优劣分派给 GLM / Kimi / Qwen 子代理执行，并按模型统计 token 用量。

description.en: Merges other sessions' context into the current turn: evidence-weighted conflict resolution, retraction of claims whose premises were retracted, trust labelling that resists cross-session prompt injection, and budget-bounded packing. Ships a benchmark.
description.zh: 把其他会话的上下文合并进当前回合：按证据裁决冲突、前提被撤回时同步撤回结论、用信任格抵抗跨会话提示注入，并在 token 预算内打包。附带评测基准。

description.en: Edits workspace text files in place inside the DSH file preview, with Monaco highlighting and project-typed completion.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的文件预览面板内直接编辑工作区文本文件，基于 Monaco 提供语法高亮与工程类型补全。

description.en: Extract text from an image or PDF, reading a born-digital text layer directly and falling through to a configured OCR engine for scans.
description.zh: 从图片或 PDF 中抽取文字，电子版直接读文字层，扫描件自动转交已配置的 OCR 引擎。

description.en: Installs the browser4-cli runtime and registers the Browser4 skills (browser4-cli, browser4-experience, browser4-plugin, scent-miner) into the DSH skill registry, providing an AI-native browser engine for autonomous agents, intelligent extraction, and large-scale web automation.
description.zh: 安装 browser4-cli 运行时，并将 Browser4 技能集（browser4-cli、browser4-experience、browser4-plugin、scent-miner）注册到 DSH 技能库，提供面向自主 Agent、智能提取与大规模网页自动化的 AI 原生浏览器引擎。

description.en: TickTick (滴答清单) daily task dispatcher: an interval timer pulls due tasks from a chosen list into a Markdown task file and notifies only when the task set changes (WeChat via ClawBot / flomo / macOS); it can also auto-execute each task in its own headless DSH session under a configurable timeout, optionally gated to DeepSeek's off-peak hours so peak-time work queues to the next off-peak window instead of starting, plus a settings panel for the deferred write-back queue and dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report tools.
description.zh: 滴答清单任务派发器：按间隔从指定清单拉取到期任务写入今日任务文件，仅在任务集变化时通知（微信 ClawBot / flomo / macOS）；可为每个任务单独开一个 headless DSH 会话自动执行（worker 超时可配），并可选只在 DeepSeek 空闲（优惠）时段开跑——高峰期把任务排到下个空闲窗口而不是立刻执行；带 Web 设置面板（延迟回写队列、省钱模式时段与状态）与 dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report 工具。

description.en: Copper-to-oil ratio dashboard for the Shanghai Composite: lag-weighted forecast band and drill-down charts.
description.zh: 铜油比与上证指数看板：滞后加权预测区间与可缩放的联动图表。

description.en: Per-conversation backup for DSH: incremental session mirroring, fuzzy restore (preview then confirm), and rule-based cleanup with a 7-day recycle bin.
description.zh: 按会话逐个备份 DSH 对话：增量镜像、模糊匹配恢复（先预览再确认）、按规则清理并先进回收站留 7 天。

description.en: Toolbar picture button in the DSH Web composer: click to pick multiple images through the native file dialog — they join the same draft-image rail as drag-and-drop and paste, with the host image-format, per-message-count and per-image-size limits enforced inline.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框工具栏图片按钮：点击调用系统文件选择器直接多选取图，进入与拖拽/粘贴相同的草稿图片栏，并内联校验宿主的图片格式、单条张数与单张大小限制。

description.en: Registers any set of HTTP APIs as paired doc-query and request tools for the agent.
description.zh: 把任意一套 HTTP 接口注册成 agent 可用的文档查询与请求双工具。

description.en: Lazy-loading router for MCP servers: auto-discovers compatible MCPs and keeps only a shared router in the tool catalog, revealing a server's schemas when a turn needs them and hiding them again at turn end, so many installed MCPs stop costing context on every request. Falls open to normal visibility on any uncertainty, and the original MCP keeps ownership of execution, permissions and process lifecycle. Also supports explicit lazy connections with warm reuse, bounded reconnection, stdio and Streamable HTTP.
description.zh: MCP 懒加载路由：自动发现可接管的 MCP，冷态只在工具目录里留一个共享路由，某轮需要哪个服务器才展开它的工具 Schema、轮次结束再收起，让装了很多 MCP 不再每次请求都吃上下文。命名异常、重名或状态不确定的 MCP 不接管；出现任何不确定即恢复原工具可见性，执行、权限与进程生命周期仍归原 MCP。也支持显式的连接层懒加载，含连接保温、有限重连、stdio 与 Streamable HTTP。

description.en: Feishu/Lark IM channel for DeepSeek Harness agents with native thinking-process messages, approval cards, live goal and todo cards, workflow fan-out lines, session text search, and background job and subagent settlement notices. Access is bounded by the Feishu app's own visibility scope by design — anyone the app admits can drive the agent and answer its approvals unless the optional sender, group and approver allowlists are filled in.
description.zh: 飞书/Lark 深度通道：原生思考过程消息、审批卡片、goal/todo 实时卡片、workflow 展开行、会话全文检索、后台任务与子代理结算通知。其设计以飞书应用自身的可见性范围为访问边界——凡是应用允许触达的人都能驱动 agent 并回答它的审批请求，除非填写可选的发送者/群组/审批人白名单收窄。

description.en: Share an existing OpenClaw Markdown workspace with DeepSeek Harness as bounded persona and memory context, with Sidebar browsing and editing.
description.zh: 把现有 OpenClaw Markdown workspace 作为有界的人格与记忆上下文共享给 DeepSeek Harness，并提供 Sidebar 浏览与编辑。

description.en: Select English text in the conversation or the sidebar file preview to translate it in place — single words get a dictionary entry with IPA, part-of-speech senses, web meanings and pronunciation, while sentences use machine translation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的对话或侧栏文件预览里选中英文就地翻译——单词出词典条目（英/美音标、按词性分组的释义、网络释义、真人发音），句子走机器翻译。

description.en: Rewrites the New Session hero headline with a short greeting written by the model the session already uses, from the local time, the current city and the live weather; falls back to a local time-based greeting when no model is reachable.
description.zh: 用新会话已选定的模型，按当地时间、城市与实时天气写一句简短问候，替换首屏标题；没有可用模型时退回本地按小时计算的问候。

description.en: Bing daily wallpaper as the app background: auto-refresh every day, pin any of the last 30 days.
description.zh: 必应每日壁纸作为界面背景：每天自动更换，可在最近 30 天中任选一天固定。

description.en: Control a DeepSeek Harness agent from Feishu/Lark: send a task by DM, an agent runs it with your configured model and replies in the chat, and a feishu_send tool lets the agent push results. Uses lark-cli's WebSocket connection, so no public webhook is needed, and ships a resident launcher. Note: the plugin does not check who sent a message, so anyone who can DM the bot — by default, members of the Feishu tenant the app belongs to — can drive an agent running with the host's own model credentials and file permissions. Setup is not one `dsh plugin add`: `lark-cli` must be installed and authenticated once, and a Feishu self-built app with the permissions the README lists is required.
description.zh: 从飞书/Lark 操作 DeepSeek Harness：私聊发送任务，agent 用你配置的模型执行并把结果回到会话；feishu_send 工具可让 agent 主动推送结果。基于 lark-cli 的 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 webhook，并附常驻启动器。注意：插件不校验发送者身份，因此任何能私聊到该机器人的人（默认即该飞书应用所属企业内的成员）都能驱动一个使用宿主机自身模型凭据与文件权限运行的 agent。安装不是一条 `dsh plugin add` 就完事：需要先全局安装并登录一次 `lark-cli`，并在飞书开放平台建一个带 README 所列权限的自建应用。

description.en: Aggregated MCP market for DeepSeek Harness: 26 curated presets plus the official MCP Registry and user-added JSON sources, with search, source filters, connectivity tests and one-click install into the profile.
description.zh: 聚合式 MCP 市场：26 个精选预设、MCP 官方注册表与用户自定义 JSON 源，支持搜索、来源筛选、连通性检测与一键安装到 profile。

description.en: Per-project scheduled prompts run as fresh headless agent sessions, with one-time, interval, and cron schedules plus durable run history.
description.zh: 按项目调度提示词，在全新的无头 Agent 会话中执行，支持单次、固定间隔和 cron 计划，并持久化运行历史。

description.en: Data lineage tracking tool, mapping the full lifecycle of data to meet source legality requirements.
description.zh: 数据血缘追踪工具，梳理数据从产生到流转的全链路，满足数据产权登记中的来源合法性审查要求。

description.en: Notched reasoning-effort slider grouped with the model picker in the composer, with theme variables and English, French and Chinese labels.
description.zh: 与模型选择器连为一体的带刻度推理强度滑杆，位于输入框内，支持主题变量与中英法三语。

description.en: Pulls GitHub repo content into DSH conversations at start and writes extracted long-term memory back with SHA-locked multi-file commits at conversation end; per-file read/write permissions, native settings page, turn indicators and global change notices.
description.zh: 对话开始时自动拉取 GitHub 仓库内容注入上下文，对话结束时提取长期记忆按文件写回并提交；文件权限中心、原生设置页、回合写回指示与全局变动提示。

description.en: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness: provider-scoped PDF and image input, with Responses API streaming support.
description.zh: 火山方舟 Coding Plan 的 DeepSeek Harness LLM provider：provider 级 PDF 与图片输入，支持 Responses API 流式。

description.en: Conversational bookkeeping bundle for dsh: record expenses/income by chat with strict amount validation and natural-language dates, then query, report, export CSV/HTML, and track monthly budgets against a local SQLite ledger.
description.zh: dsh 的对话式记账插件:聊天即可记账(严格金额校验、自然语言日期、自动分类),并支持查询、报表、CSV/HTML 导出和月度预算,数据存于本地 SQLite 账本。

description.en: The dock-base Workbench adapter for the DSH Quick Control panel. The panel core ships separately as `dsh-flash`; this package is what mounts it into dock-base — sidebar/floating panel, activity-bar ⚡, editor view and the dock-flash:openQuickControl command. Requires dock-base; a broken install fails loudly instead of silently doing nothing.
description.zh: DSH 快捷控制面板的 dock-base 工作台适配器。面板本体（开关注册表、皮肤系统、i18n、告警面、host 路由）由 `dsh-flash` 核心单独提供；本包只负责把它挂进 dock-base：侧栏/浮动面板、活动栏 ⚡、编辑器视图与 dock-flash:openQuickControl 命令。需安装 dock-base；装错时会明确报错而不是静默失效。

description.en: Agent preset that hands every task to a Claude Code subagent, so the session only writes the task brief, delegates and reports the result. Requires a locally installed, logged-in Claude Code.
description.zh: 一个 Agent 预设：把每个任务都交给 Claude Code 子代理执行，会话只负责写任务说明、委派与汇报结果。需本机已安装并登录 Claude Code。

description.en: Adds ChatGPT/Codex OAuth-backed Codex models and gpt-image-2 generation/editing to DSH without requiring an OpenAI Platform API key.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加基于 ChatGPT/Codex OAuth 的 Codex 模型及 gpt-image-2 文生图和编辑能力，无需 OpenAI Platform API Key。

description.en: HTTP/API debugging toolset: full-control HTTP requests (method/headers/body/auth), curl command parsing and one-step execution, in-session request history with side-by-side response comparison, pagination-aware Link headers, and DeepSeek-branded UI cards (optional dsh-http-tools-ui).
description.zh: HTTP/API 调试工具集：全参数 HTTP 请求（method/headers/body/auth）、curl 命令解析与一步执行、会话内请求历史与响应并排对比、分页 Link 头透出；配合可选 dsh-http-tools-ui 提供 DeepSeek 风格工具卡片。

description.en: Session model selector with search: two-stage loose matching (normalised substring first, subsequence as fallback, so glm53 finds GLM-5.3 and ds finds DeepSeek), providers with recent successful calls pinned first, and a reasoning-effort pane that remembers each model's last explicitly chosen effort.
description.zh: 搜索增强的会话模型选择器：两段式宽松匹配（先归一化子串，未命中再退子序列，glm53 命中 GLM-5.3、ds 命中 DeepSeek）、近七天成功调用过的供应商置顶，推理档位面板记住每个模型上次显式选择的档位。

description.en: A Codex-style conversation navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Codex 式对话导航与预览。

description.en: A simple, information-dense DeepSeek status display for the DSH sidebar: balance, usage, and peak/off-peak countdown. Requires the DSH Web GUI with a signed-in DeepSeek account.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏集中显示 DeepSeek 余额、用量和峰谷倒计时，简约直观。需要 DSH Web 界面并已登录 DeepSeek 账户。

description.en: Long-form fiction workflow for DSH: seven queryable bibles, edit-impact tracking, living relationship and plot maps, and a first-chapter tryout that picks your writer. Its /novel-panel routes, including save, archive and reconcile, are mounted with webServer.register and carry no DSH Host/Origin admission check, so a web page open in your browser can write to the novel project through them.
description.zh: 长篇小说创作工作流：七份可查账的设定库、改稿影响追踪、活的图谱，以及用试笔稿选写手的机制。它的 /novel-panel 路由（含保存、归档、对账）通过 webServer.register 挂载，没有 DSH 的 Host/Origin 准入检查，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能经由它们写入小说项目。

description.en: Runtime requirement drift guard that keeps long-running DSH agents aligned with the user's approved goal, constraints, and decisions.
description.zh: 运行时需求漂移防护，在长任务执行过程中保持 DSH Agent 与用户确认的目标、约束和决策一致。

description.en: A dsh web plugin that wraps the running Harness in a native Windows desktop window: it bundles a Wails v3 desktop client (so installing the plugin is enough), probes the web port and writes the ~/.dsh/dsh-web-port.json protocol file for the client, registers a system tray, desktop/Start Menu shortcuts and a startup autostart toggle, and the client can start dsh itself if it is not running.
description.zh: 把 dsh web 界面封装成原生 Windows 桌面窗口，内置桌面客户端，带系统托盘、开机自启与协议文件分发。

description.en: ClinePass provider for DeepSeek Harness: 15 bundled subscription and free models, a settings page with per-model capacity overrides, subscription usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, and multi-account failover to a backup account.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClinePass 模型提供方：内置 15 个订阅与免费模型，提供设置页与按模型容量覆盖、5 小时／每周／每月订阅用量，以及多账号与备用账号自动切换。

description.en: Delegates a self-contained coding task to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, and adds a session tab with live output, cost and remaining quota.
description.zh: 把自包含的编码任务委派给本机 Claude Code 订阅执行（走官方 Claude Agent SDK），并在会话里新增一个标签页，实时显示输出、费用与剩余额度。

description.en: Native Search1API (s1) web research tools: search, news, page crawling, sitemap discovery, and trending topics as first-class `s1_*` tools, with a bundled s1 skill.
description.zh: Search1API（s1）原生联网检索工具：网页搜索、新闻、页面抓取、站点地图与趋势榜，以 `s1_*` 一等工具形式提供，并附带 s1 技能。

description.en: Web Audio agent-heartbeat cues for the DSH web GUI: a low working hum while an agent is busy, ticks on streaming output, and a chime when a session awaits input or work finishes, with per-voice volume, mute toggle, and optional local audio files.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供 Web Audio 智能体心跳提示：Agent 忙碌时低频心跳、流式输出时滴答声、会话等待输入或工作完成时提示音；支持分音色音量、静音开关与本地音频文件替换。

description.en: Connect multiple Overleaf projects to DSH through OverleafMCP for browsing, analysis, and Git-based file updates.
description.zh: 通过 OverleafMCP 将多个 Overleaf 项目接入 DSH，支持浏览、分析和通过 Git 写回 LaTeX 文件。

description.en: Lists every entry that can appear in the left sidebar and gives each panel entry its own hide/show switch from a section in Settings.
description.zh: 列出所有可以出现在左侧菜单里的功能，并在设置中逐个隐藏或显示面板入口。

description.en: Slumber Pavilion physically moves archived DSH sessions out of the load path into ~/DSH-Archive, and ships archive, read, restore and delete tools for them.
description.zh: 沉眠阁把 DSH 里已归档会话的日志与投影记录真正搬出加载路径，并提供归档、读取、还原、删除会话的工具。

description.en: Adds Claude, Gemini, and a local Ollama model to DSH's native model picker, using your existing Claude Code / Antigravity CLI logins instead of a metered API key, with a working reasoning-effort selector for Claude.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生模型选择器里加入 Claude、Gemini 与本地 Ollama 模型，复用你已有的 Claude Code / Antigravity CLI 登录态而不是按量计费的 API Key，并为 Claude 提供可用的推理强度选择。

description.en: Per-region UI zoom for DeepSeek Harness — Ctrl + wheel sets independent zoom levels for the conversation header, the left sidebar, the conversation body and the right sidebar (sidebars 25%-300%), and dragging the header bottom edge makes that header shorter or taller, growing by height only so label size stays unchanged.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分区域缩放：Ctrl + 滚轮分别为会话顶栏、左侧栏、会话正文和右侧面板设置独立比例（侧栏 25%–300%）；拖动顶栏整条下边界可以把它调矮或调高，调高只增加高度、字大小不变。

description.en: Adds a UI effects page to Settings that switches off DSH Web animations and transitions, loading and progress animations, backdrop blur, smooth scrolling, hover title scroll, shadows, gradients and JS motion one category at a time, to cut browser rendering cost.
description.zh: 在设置里新增 "前端特效" 页, 按分类关掉 DSH Web 的动画与过渡, 加载与进度动画, 毛玻璃, 平滑滚动, 标题 hover 滚动, 阴影, 渐变与 JS 动效, 降低浏览器渲染负担.

description.en: Cache-stable progressive tool discovery: a fixed tool_search and tool_dispatch surface on every request, in-memory catalog search, nested dispatch through the Harness pipeline, and a byte-stable native tool list across discovery.
description.zh: 缓存稳定的渐进式工具发现：每次请求使用固定的 tool_search 与 tool_dispatch 工具面，从内存目录搜索后经 Harness 管线分发，发现过程中原生工具列表保持字节稳定。

description.en: Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time. Ships on npm as `dsh-pet-bridge`.
description.zh: dsh ↔ cc-pet 桌面宠物状态桥：把会话状态（思考中 / 读取文件 / 运行命令 / 完成）实时推送到桌面宠物气泡。npm 包名 `dsh-pet-bridge`。

description.en: Controls the Browser panel DSH renders in the right Sidebar: numbered refs from a snapshot, click/type/press/select/scroll, query-scoped reads and change diffs, up to 12 steps in one call, and multi-tab focus/close.
description.zh: 控制 DSH 右栏内置 Browser 的 Agent 插件：快照返回编号控件，支持点击/输入/按键/选择/滚动，按问题检索阅读与变化对比，一次调用最多 12 步，并可切换和关闭多个标签。

description.en: Timed send for the chat composer: pick a moment and the host delivers the message then. Inside an existing conversation tasks join that conversation; from the new-session screen each task gets its own pre-created session.
description.zh: 聊天输入框的定时发送：选好时刻到点由 Host 真正发出。已有对话内任务排进当前对话；新会话界面每条任务各建一个独立会话。

description.en: Blinks the Windows notification-area icon the way QQ and WeChat do for an unread message — the app's own icon alternating with a fully transparent frame — and flashes the taskbar button, when a turn finishes or a session waits for an approval or an answer.
description.zh: 任务完成、或有会话在等你审批/回答时，让 Windows 通知区域的图标像 QQ、微信收到消息那样一闪一闪（原图标与全透明帧交替），同时闪任务栏按钮。

description.en: Evidence-first self-evolution controller: bounded Cordis candidate generation, one-shot real-Loader admission, Harbor evaluation, and a crash-resumable journaled lineage.
description.zh: 证据优先的自进化控制器：有界生成 Cordis 候选插件，一次性真实 Loader 准入，Harbor 评测，可崩溃恢复的日志化谱系。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness covering approval requests, questions, run completion, errors and sign-in prompts, with the conversation name as the first line of every notification.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：申请权限、提问、任务完成、出错与登录提醒，每条通知第一行都是会话名称。

description.en: Pre-install supply-chain checks for DeepSeek Harness plugins: verify the tarball you are about to install matches the source you read, before any code runs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件做安装前供应链校验：在代码运行前核对即将安装的包是否与你读到的源码一致。

description.en: Connects Harness to the published BeatBrowser runtime with namespaced MCP tools and a TaskSpace Skill; requires the Chrome extension and preserves manual takeover.
description.zh: 通过带命名空间的 MCP 工具和任务空间 Skill 接入已发布的 BeatBrowser；需要 Chrome 扩展，保留人工接管规则。

description.en: Local YonBIP/YMS development runtime: resolves project settings, issues platform API tokens, pulls and adapts middleware endpoints, provides internal DB/Redis/service access via a SOCKS forwarder or direct mode, builds and starts the local YMS runtime, and prepares IDE launch/debug configuration. Works without dsh-ris-ide. Needs JDK 21 and Maven on PATH (the first build downloads dependencies).
description.zh: YonBIP/YMS 本地开发运行时：解析项目配置、签发平台 API 凭据、拉取并适配中间件端点、通过 SOCKS 转发或直连访问内网数据库/缓存/服务、构建并启停本地 YMS 运行时、生成 IDE 启动/调试配置。不依赖 dsh-ris-ide。需要 JDK 21 与 PATH 中的 Maven（首次构建会下载依赖）。

description.en: Configurable startup splash screen for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows only — a real main-process splash with live preview and light/dark themes. Deploys by rewriting the app's app.asar (a backup is kept) and takes effect on the next launch after you quit DSH; redeploy after each DSH upgrade.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows 桌面版 DeepSeek Harness 的可配置启动动画（splash）：主进程真实启动画面、设置页实时预览、深浅色跟随。通过改写 app.asar 部署（会保留备份），退出 DSH 后下次启动生效；DSH 升级后需重新部署。

description.en: Enhances the DSH Web GUI file tree with inline sizes and modification dates, plus a right-click menu for download, upload, and copy-path actions.
description.zh: 增强 DSH Web GUI 的文件树：行内显示大小与修改时间，右键菜单支持下载、上传、复制路径。

description.en: Imports the MCP servers Codex and Claude Code already declare as dsh mcp-client tools, links the skills of 22 known agent skill directories into ~/.dsh/skills as symlinks instead of copying them, and adds a Settings page that lists what was mounted, toggles each skill, and changes the source on a name conflict.
description.zh: 把 Codex 与 Claude Code 已声明的 MCP 服务器接入 dsh 的 mcp-client，把 22 个已知 Agent 技能目录的技能以符号链接（不复制文件）导入 ~/.dsh/skills，并提供设置页：列出本次实际挂载的服务器与技能、逐项启停技能、重名时改选来源。

description.en: Configurable web search hub for the built-in web_search tool: switch the active entry between DeepSeek official native search and Zhipu GLM web_search, with entry and credential management on a Settings page tab.
description.zh: 可配置的原生 web_search 后端：在 DeepSeek 官方原生搜索与智谱 GLM web_search 之间切换当前生效入口，并在设置页管理搜索入口与凭证引用。

description.en: Starts a whole dev stack from one place: it scans a directory for projects, matches each one's start command, starts them in dependency order once their ports answer, and shows their colourised logs in the sidebar.
description.zh: 一个地方管起整套开发环境：扫描目录发现项目并匹配各自的启动命令，按依赖顺序启动、以端口探测确认就绪，日志带彩色显示在侧栏。

description.en: Adds interactive agent-switch CLI terminals with tab and grid layouts, Codex delegation cards, and live or saved task output in the right sidebar. Requires agent-switch on PATH, at least one target coding CLI, and a node-pty build allowlist; implemented and tested on Windows.
description.zh: 提供支持页签和网格布局的 agent-switch CLI 交互终端、Codex 委派任务卡片，以及右侧面板中的实时与历史任务输出。需 PATH 上有 agent-switch、至少一个目标编码 CLI，并在插件页放行 node-pty 原生构建；目前只在 Windows 验证过。

description.en: Shows the current DeepSeek API peak or off-peak pricing period and a countdown to the next transition.
description.zh: 显示当前 DeepSeek API 高峰或非高峰计费时段，以及距离下一次切换的倒计时。

description.en: Detect and contain runaway symbol streams at the model boundary in DeepSeek Harness, with tooling to repair polluted artifacts and sessions.
description.zh: 在模型输出边界检测并拦截退化符号流，并提供修复被污染工件与会话的工具。

description.en: Adds a global document-routing prompt so PDFs, images, and Office files are read with the right tool.
description.zh: 加入全局文档路由提示，让 PDF、图片和 Office 文件自动走正确的读取工具。

description.en: Evidence-backed Skill self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: redacted trajectory learning, quarantined proposals, arena validation, canary monitoring, automatic rollback.
description.zh: 带证据的 Skill 自进化：脱敏轨迹学习、隔离提案、竞技场验证、金丝雀监控与自动回滚。

description.en: Mirrors an Android phone screen to a Windows PC over USB or Wi-Fi with scrcpy, and exposes start, stop, status, connect (reconnect after a phone reboot) and screenshot as an agent tool and a /mirror command. Requires scrcpy and adb installed on the host (winget install Genymobile.scrcpy); the plugin does not bundle them.
description.zh: 用 scrcpy 把安卓手机画面投到 Windows 电脑（USB 或无线），并把启动、停止、状态、connect（手机重启后重连）、截图暴露为智能体工具与 /mirror 命令。需在本机装好 scrcpy 与 adb（winget install Genymobile.scrcpy），插件不打包这两个可执行文件。

description.en: Session-level verdict on whether compaction would lose unlanded state; structurally refuses per-block screening.
description.zh: 会话级判定：compaction 是否会丢失未落地状态；结构上拒绝逐块筛选。

description.en: Intercepts startup crashes, isolates broken frontend plugins, and recovers GUI cleanly with revision-bound quarantine.
description.zh: 拦截插件启动崩溃与前端白屏，按指纹静默隔离故障版本并在修复后自动恢复。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar workspace region with a two-tab browser: several workspace roots stay registered side by side while conversations are filed under the real working directory of each session, with a read-only resource tree that previews files in the right sidebar. Hiding is per tab, display-only and fully reversible; a resource folder or file can be copied as a path or dragged into the composer as a native reference, and @ completion covers every registered root rather than the working directory alone.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的工作区区域换成双选项卡浏览器：多个工作区根并列登记、各自固定不变，对话按每个会话真实的工作目录归入目录树，资源是只读文件树、点击即用右侧栏预览。两个选项卡各自独立隐藏、只影响显示且完全可逆；资源文件夹或文件可复制路径，也可拖进输入框成为原生引用块；@ 补全覆盖全部已登记工作区，而不只是当前工作目录。

description.en: Adds F5 / Ctrl+R page reload to the DeepSeek Harness desktop web UI, which production builds lack by default (the "Reload Page" menu item and bare-F5 accelerator are development-gated). Binds soft reload (F5, Ctrl+R) and cache-busted hard reload (F5 with a modifier, Ctrl+Shift+R, appending a _dsh_refresh timestamp) through a capture-phase client key listener.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面 Web UI 补上 F5 / Ctrl+R 页面刷新功能（生产版默认没有刷新菜单项与裸 F5 快捷键）。通过客户端捕获阶段按键监听绑定软刷新（F5、Ctrl+R）与防缓存硬刷新（F5 加修饰键、Ctrl+Shift+R，附加 _dsh_refresh 时间戳）。

description.en: SSH remote workspace — run bash, file tools, glob and grep on a remote machine over plain sshd (exec + SFTP), zero remote install, purely additive.
description.zh: SSH 远端工作区——在远端机器上执行 bash、文件读写、glob 与 grep（基于 sshd 的 exec + SFTP），远端零安装，纯附加。

description.en: Real-time usage, cost and balance meter for DeepSeek Harness: official-API balance, cost accuracy within ¥0.02, per-turn / per-session / per-model cost ledger, live color-tiered token speed and a docked one-click popup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 实时用量、费用与余额计量：官方 API 实时查询余额、计费误差 0.02 元内，分本轮/本次会话/整个模型三级费用台账，实时分色档位 Token 速度，输入框旁弹窗即点即看。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud coupon balance, used amount and expiry in the sidebar footer, read through the read-only BSS OpenAPI.
description.zh: 在侧栏页脚显示阿里云代金券的剩余余额、已用额度与到期时间，数据来自只读 BSS OpenAPI。

description.en: Manual approval mode ("Manual Mode" / "Ask Mode").
description.zh: 手动审批模式（Manual/Ask Mode）。

description.en: Pre-claim gate: a commit, push or tag claim like "tests pass" is checked against the session evidence ledger before it is written.
description.zh: 提交前声明门：把“测试通过”等 commit/push/tag 声明与本次会话的真实执行证据核对后再写入。

description.en: Import Codex-style sprite-sheet pets and render them as a floating shell.overlay with a pet library, interactions, and agent-state linkage.
description.zh: 导入/上传 Codex 风格精灵图序列帧宠物，在 DSH Web GUI 以悬浮浮层渲染，含图库管理、交互与 Agent 状态联动。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API peak and off-peak hours, the current model's output price and the account balance in the Web UI.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中显示 DeepSeek API 高峰/空闲时段、当前模型的输出价格与账户余额。

description.en: Agent tools for a local Gopeed downloader: create, inspect, pause, resume and remove downloads, diagnose or launch the Gopeed process, and receive download-complete events through a DSH background job that wakes an idle agent. Process diagnostics and launching are Windows-only; the download tools work wherever Gopeed runs.
description.zh: 把本机 Gopeed 下载器接进 DSH 的 agent 工具：新建、查看、暂停、继续、删除下载任务，诊断或启动 Gopeed 进程，并通过 DSH 后台任务接收下载完成事件（空闲的 agent 会被唤醒）。进程诊断与启动仅支持 Windows，下载相关工具跨平台可用。

description.en: Cubox sync for DeepSeek Harness: scheduled sync of your bookmarks, an AI daily brief generated from your own prompt template straight into Obsidian, and per-card markdown export.
description.zh: Cubox 收藏同步：定时同步收藏，按你的 prompt 用 LLM 生成今日收藏简报直接写入 Obsidian，可导出每张收藏为 Markdown。

description.en: Shows the current session's equivalent cost in the stats bar below the input, priced from a bundled table of published token prices. Uncached input, cache reads and writes, and output including reasoning are priced separately; model changes add up as separate per-currency segments; subagent costs are included. Clicking the cost opens a per-session and per-subagent breakdown.
description.zh: 在输入框下方的统计条显示当前会话按刊例 token 价折算的等值费用：未缓存输入、缓存读取与写入、输出（含推理）分别计价；换模型分段相加、各币种不换算；子代理费用计入总数。点击费用项可展开主会话与各子代理的明细。

description.en: DogCatTrace attribution parody as a right-sidebar tab: draw three integer challenges, paste each model reply into one box at a time, read the 24-breed dog and cat ranking.
description.zh: 猫狗品种归因的侧栏插件：出三道整数挑战，逐段贴回模型回复，看 24 个品种的降序榜。

description.en: Sidebar tidy: when plugins pile up, the rows under 'New session' get crowded with panel and plugin entries. This plugin folds them all — global panel rows, plugin-injected entry rows (own and third-party alike), and bottom entries — into a single menu button whose secondary menu triggers each entry exactly as before; keep any entry permanently visible with a name whitelist, and the button turns into an icon when the sidebar collapses to a narrow rail.
description.zh: 侧栏收纳：把「新会话」下方被各插件塞满的入口行——全局面板行、插件入口行（自家/第三方一律识别）、底部入口——统统收进一个菜单按钮，点开二级菜单原样触发各入口；想常驻的加名称白名单即可，侧栏折叠成窄轨时按钮自动变纯图标。

description.en: Bundled Pixiv skill backed by a Python CLI: search illustrations, manga and novels, browse daily/weekly/monthly/rookie/original/AI/R-18 rankings, look up works, novel series and artists, and download originals, with multi-page works merged into PDF, ugoira converted to GIF and novel series merged into TXT; requires Python 3.9+ with requests, img2pdf and Pillow installed (pip install -r requirements.txt), and R-18 content needs your own Pixiv cookie.
description.zh: 内置 Pixiv 技能，由 Python 命令行脚本实现：搜索插画、漫画、小说，查看日榜/周榜/月榜/新人榜/原创榜/AI 榜/R-18 榜，查询作品、小说系列和画师详情，下载原图，多页作品合成 PDF、动图转 GIF、小说系列合并成 TXT；需要 Python 3.9 以上并装好 requests / img2pdf / Pillow（pip install -r requirements.txt），R-18 内容需要自己的 Pixiv Cookie。

description.en: Per-request DeepSeek billing with peak/off-peak and holiday pricing, a cost bar, sidebar card, usage dashboard (trends, calendar, yearly view) and a three-step hot restart (Windows DSH Desktop only).
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 官方人民币价目（峰谷时段、节假日）逐请求精确计费，提供费用条、侧栏卡片、用量看板（趋势/日历/年视图）与三段式热重启（热重启仅限 Windows 版 DSH 桌面端）。

description.en: GitHub authorization, repository browsing, AI-written project intros and confirmed Release publishing inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内完成 GitHub 授权、仓库浏览、AI 生成项目介绍与 Release 发布，所有写操作先预览再确认。

description.en: Delete sessions with a 5-second undo and a recycle bin, plus an archive view to browse and unarchive, for the DSH Web GUI. Ships on npm as `@wsxwj123/dsh-session-manager`.
description.zh: 会话删除（5 秒可撤销 + 回收站）与归档视图（查看、取消归档）。npm 包名 `@wsxwj123/dsh-session-manager`。

description.en: Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.
description.zh: 将非图片文件或文件夹以原生 @path 引用粘贴进聊天输入框，或拖放插入绝对路径，替代仅支持图片的报错。

description.en: Sidebar activity bell: a red badge counts sessions that finished, and clicking it swaps the sidebar list from workspace grouping to a day-grouped recent-activity list with a green dot on completions that have not been opened.
description.zh: 侧边栏活动铃铛：会话跑完后铃铛显示红色角标，点一下把工作区列表换成按天分组的最近活动列表，尚未打开过的完成项带绿点。

description.en: TRAE-style conversation rollback rebuilt for DSH 0.1.7-rc.2: per-turn file checkpoints restore touched files and truncate the model context in place under the same session id. Adds a /rollback doctor framework-contract self-check, an affected-file diff preview computed against the current on-disk state so it stays correct after a restart, a one-click undo-last action with a Ctrl+Shift+Z shortcut, a setting for whether rolled-back messages stay hidden, and English UI text.
description.zh: TRAE 式「回退到本轮对话发起前」：按轮次建立文件检查点，回滚工作区文件并在同一 session id 下原位截断模型上下文，已适配 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2。新增 /rollback doctor 契约自检、按当前磁盘状态实时计算的受影响文件 diff 预览（重启后依然准确）、一键「回退最近一轮」（快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+Z）、「回退后隐藏已回退消息」开关，以及英文界面文案。

description.en: A run_tests tool that turns a failing test run into precise context instead of a raw dump. It detects the runner (pytest, jest, vitest, cargo, go, npm), extracts the file, line and assertion of each failure, and stops the loop when failures with an identical signature repeat. Output is decoded so Windows-encoded and non-Latin assertion text stays readable.
description.zh: 提供一个 run_tests 工具，把失败的测试运行变成精确上下文，而不是原始大段输出。自动识别测试框架（pytest、jest、vitest、cargo、go、npm），提取每个失败的 file、line 与断言；同一失败签名反复出现时停止循环。输出经过解码，Windows 编码与非拉丁断言文字都能正常显示。

description.en: One panel for MCP servers, skills and Claude Code plugins across global/profile/project scopes: live status, import/export, trash & backups, and the official claude-plugins-official market (install/update/uninstall).
description.zh: 一个面板统一管理全局 / Profile / 项目三个作用域的 MCP 服务与技能：实时状态与工具数、导入导出、回收站与备份，并可安装/更新/卸载 Anthropic 官方 claude-plugins-official 市场的 Claude Code 插件。

description.en: Mounts external skill directories (Claude Code, Codex, ZCode) into DSH as read-only skill providers: frontmatter field mapping, name slug normalization and hot reload.
description.zh: 技能兼容层：把 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 的技能目录挂载为 dsh 的只读技能提供方——支持 frontmatter 字段映射、名称 slug 规范化与热重载。

description.en: Bridge DSH to OpenCode-compatible models via the local OpenCode CLI: native LlmAdapter passthrough, persistent OC sessions with cross-turn tool results, tool mirroring, and a CLI environment check panel. Requires the OpenCode CLI installed locally.
description.zh: 经本机 OpenCode CLI 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode 兼容模型：原生 LlmAdapter 透传、OC 会话持久续接（工具结果跨轮可见）、工具镜像回传、CLI 环境检测面板。需本机已安装 OpenCode CLI。

description.en: Posts a follow-up prompt into opted-in chats that fall silent, and offers a secret-protected HTTP API that posts a message into any chat. Requires Node.js 22.5+.
description.zh: 在久无动静且主动开启的会话里投递跟进提示，并提供一个带密钥保护的 HTTP API，可向任意会话发消息。需 Node.js 22.5+。

description.en: Dispatch subagents with named profiles (model, reasoning effort, and tool scope per task), safety checks, cost estimation with savings comparison, and a full dispatch decision ledger.
description.zh: 子 Agent 派发插件：按任务选模型、推理强度与工具范围，存成命名方案随时复用；内置安全检查、成本估算与节省分析、完整派发决策台账。

description.en: DSH settings section for managing a local Sirchmunk knowledge backend: graph inspection, cluster management, audit history, runtime metrics, and privacy controls.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理本地 Sirchmunk 知识库：图谱导出、聚类管理、审计历史、运行指标与隐私控制。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for rulemux: asks the local rulemux CLI for the rules rendered for this workspace (rulemux inject --agent dsh) and injects the output into the session at the first user turn, once per session. Nothing is written into the workspace for rules; skills are the only part that lands on disk.
description.zh: rulemux 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：通过 rulemux inject --agent dsh 取当前工作区渲染出的规则，在每次会话的首条用户消息时把输出注入一次。规则不往工作区写任何文件；只有技能会落盘。

description.en: Zhinao (second brain) for DeepSeek Harness: Markdown-authoritative layered memory (L1 long-term model gated by user confirmation / L2 knowledge with mandatory sources / L3 recent status under daily quotas), a local recall ledger explaining every injection, lifecycle engine with weekly review and a Web panel. First-run wizard initializes a blank brain, adopts an existing Zhinao directory read-only, or fills in only missing skeleton files; existing files are never touched.
description.zh: 智脑（第二大脑）—— DeepSeek Harness 的 Markdown 权威记忆插件：分层记忆（L1 长期模型经用户确认 / L2 知识必须留源 / L3 近况每日配额），本地召回账本可解释每次注入，生命周期引擎带周回顾与 Web 面板。首次运行向导支持空白脑新建、只读接管现有智脑目录、或仅补齐缺失骨架文件，均不改动已有文件。

description.en: Turns a local Markdown vault into two folders the user picks in Settings: a knowledge folder DSH writes notes into, and a memory folder used as the agent's long-term memory with per-turn recall and end-of-turn capture. Pure Markdown with frontmatter, BM25 search, reversible archive, and path isolation that rejects traversal, absolute paths and symlink escapes.
description.zh: 把本地 Markdown 库拆成两个由用户在设置页选择的文件夹：知识库由 DSH 在对话中写入笔记，记忆库作为 agent 的长期记忆，按回合召回、回合结束沉淀候选。纯 Markdown 加 frontmatter、BM25 检索、可逆归档，并用路径隔离拒绝穿越、绝对路径与符号链接逃逸。

description.en: Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 皮肤管理器：自动发现已安装皮肤，在独立设置页一键互斥切换，热载入无需重启。

description.en: Track the origin of local development ports on Windows and safely manage verified DSH services.
description.zh: Windows 本地开发端口来源追踪与安全处理工具。

description.en: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。

description.en: PDF document editing plugin for precise text editing in PDF files.
description.zh: 面向 PDF 文档的编辑插件,精确编辑PDF文字

description.en: Declarative task-DAG orchestration for DSH: validates dependency graphs, runs topological task layers in parallel through workflow-backed subagents, and propagates failures deterministically.
description.zh: DSH 声明式任务 DAG 编排：校验依赖图，通过工作流子智能体并行执行拓扑任务层，并确定性传播失败。

description.en: Track DeepSeek Harness's own releases and update in one click: reads the npm dist-tags and the GitHub changelog, shows every change between the running build and the target, grades the risk, then hands the install to a detached helper that backs the current install up with an atomic rename, runs npm, verifies what landed, relaunches, and rolls back when the new build does not come up.
description.zh: 跟踪 DSH 官方版本并一键更新：读取 npm dist-tags 与 GitHub 更新说明，列出当前版本到目标版本之间每一个版本的更新点，给出分级风险清单（预发布、破坏性变更措辞、本机多份安装与 PATH 不一致、插件 dsh.engines.dsh 兼容性、备份与回滚可用性），再把安装交给分离助手——用 rename 原子备份当前安装、执行 npm、校验落地结果、用原命令重启，新版本起不来就自动回滚。

description.en: Resumes an agent turn that ended after narrating its next action without calling a tool: the guard replays the turn log on agent/turn-stopping, asks a judge model one true/false question, and steers the same turn to run one more step.
description.zh: 续跑「叙述了下一步动作却没调用工具」就结束的 agent 轮次：插件在 agent/turn-stopping 回放该轮日志，让裁判模型回答一次 true/false，命中的话把同一轮再推进一步。

description.en: Adds a Drawing Mode agent preset whose 19 comfyui_* tools drive a local ComfyUI: Anima and Krea2 generation, LoRA search and download, Danbooru character tags, PNG metadata, an upstream repro check, and xiaofanqie de-obfuscation.
description.zh: 新增「绘图模式」Agent 预设，含 19 个 comfyui_* 工具：Anima/Krea2 出图、LoRA 检索与下载、Danbooru 角色 tag、PNG 元数据、上游复刻自检、小番茄解混淆。

description.en: Static and runtime security guard for dsh: rule-based scans for malicious code, prompt injection and token waste, runtime interception of dangerous tool calls, /scan command, plugin_scan tool, web panel, and allowlist.
description.zh: dsh 安全守卫插件：基于规则的静态扫描覆盖恶意代码、提示词注入与令牌浪费，运行时拦截危险工具调用，提供 /scan 命令、plugin_scan 工具、Web 面板与白名单。

description.en: Annotate replies and documents for the next message, edit past user messages and rerun from that point, and use keyboard shortcuts to navigate user messages or recall previous inputs in the composer.
description.zh: 为回复和文档添加随下一条消息发送的注释，编辑历史用户消息并从该处重新执行，使用快捷键浏览用户消息或在输入框调出历史输入。

description.en: Creates and inspects RecoWork local-agent-project workspaces through two bounded DSH tools and a web workspace card.
description.zh: 通过两个受限的 DSH 工具和网页工作区卡片，创建并检查 RecoWork local-agent-project 工作区。

description.en: Persistent provider-reported token usage totals with per-session, per-model, and daily activity statistics.
description.zh: 持久化 provider 上报的 Token 用量统计，支持按会话、按模型和按日活跃度查看。

description.en: Flat list of recent sessions across every workspace, with last-question previews, time buckets, full-text search, and notes that resurface when you reopen a conversation. Fork of huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions with a native-style UI rewrite; both register the same recent-sessions panel id, so do not install both.
description.zh: 跨所有工作目录的扁平会话列表：显示最后一句提问、按时间分组、全文搜索，并让随手记下的想法在重开会话时提醒。是 huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions 的重写分支，界面按原生样式重做；两者注册同一个 recent-sessions 面板 id，不要与原版同装。

description.en: Preview and edit attached PowerPoint presentations in the DSH sidebar through conversation or manual controls, with shared undo/redo and PPTX download.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏预览附件中的 PowerPoint 演示文稿，通过对话或手动操作编辑，共享撤销与重做历史，并下载编辑后的 PPTX。

description.en: Password gate and reverse proxy for the DeepSeek Harness web interface.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的密码门与反向代理：默认只监听本机回环，没设置密码时首次启动会生成一个密码并只显示一次；需要远程访问时再把 listenHost 设为 0.0.0.0。

description.en: Safe, audited SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL access for dsh agents: schema introspection, enforced read-only queries, a write approval gate, and a durable JSONL SQL audit trail.
description.zh: 为 dsh agent 提供安全且可审计的 SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL 访问：schema 内省、强制只读查询、写审批门与持久化 JSONL SQL 审计追踪。

description.en: Persistent C/C++, Python, and TypeScript definition navigation with a standalone workspace UI for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化的 C/C++、Python 和 TypeScript 定义跳转及独立工作区界面。

description.en: macOS desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: agent operates non-browser apps (CapCut, Photoshop, WPS, native clients) like a human — 14 tools for mouse, keyboard, scrolling, app activation, windows and screenshots, plus a vision closed-loop (desktop_see for image understanding + desktop_locate for UI element coordinates) that reuses dsh existing vision credentials. GUI-session service starts on demand, no login autostart.
description.zh: macOS 桌面控制插件：agent 像人一样操作非浏览器应用（剪映/PS/WPS/原生客户端）——14 个工具覆盖鼠标/键盘/滚动/应用/窗口/截图，并整合视觉闭环（desktop_see 识图 + desktop_locate UI 定位坐标，复用 dsh 既有视觉凭据）。服务 GUI 会话按需拉起，非登录自启。

description.en: Four native tools for image/video model discovery, contract inspection, pricing previews, approved generation and resumable task status through BeatAPI.
description.zh: 提供图片视频模型发现、接口检查、价格预览、确认后生成及原任务续查，通过 BeatAPI 执行。

description.en: Remember the DeepSeek Harness desktop window position, size and maximized state, restoring it on next launch. The window logic lives in a standalone PowerShell script that does not depend on the client version; the plugin shell only installs it, keeps it autostarted and exposes a toggle.
description.zh: 记住 DSH 桌面窗口的位置、大小与最大化状态，下次启动回到上次离开的地方。窗口逻辑放在独立的 PowerShell 脚本里，不依赖客户端版本；插件外壳只负责安装、自启和开关。

description.en: Git-based multi-device sync for DSH configuration — captures settings, plugin manifests, lockfiles and skills into a private repository, with one-click capture, apply, pull and restore, and plugin rebuilds from pnpm-lock.
description.zh: 基于私有 Git 仓库的 DSH 多端配置同步——把设置、插件清单、锁文件与技能纳管到私有仓库，设置页一键捕获、应用、拉取与回滚，并按 pnpm-lock 确定性重建插件依赖。

description.en: LAN pets for DeepSeek Harness. Neighbors' pets visit your desktop, and yours can visit theirs with a note or file along. Desktop pets need DSH Desktop (Electron) on macOS or Windows; on Linux or the web profile, discovery and visits still work but the desktop layer is unavailable.
description.zh: 让同一局域网里的 DSH 宠物互相看见、互相串门，还能捎一张字条或一个文件。桌面宠物需要 macOS 或 Windows 上的 DSH Desktop（Electron）；在 Linux 或 web profile 上，发现和串门仍可用，但没有桌面层。

description.en: Settings panel for global and per-workspace AGENTS.md, with identity and persona injection, runtime-context toggle, and result notifications.
description.zh: 设置面板管理全局与各工作区 AGENTS.md，支持身份与人设注入、运行时上下文开关和结果通知。

description.en: Runs the agent through GEML workflows: work items move through flow steps, practices are recorded at the step they belong to, and a board tab in the right sidebar shows where each item stands. Also mounts the GEML MCP server and skills; when the project has a fixed workflow, a supervisor gates tool calls by its current state. Needs Node.js 22+; the GEML MCP server is fetched with npx (@geml/geml) when a session starts.
description.zh: 用 GEML 流程带 agent 干活：工作项按流程一步步走，做法记在它所属的那一步，右侧栏的看板页签显示每件事走到哪了。同时挂上 GEML 的 MCP 服务和技能；项目里有固化流程时，监督器按流程当前状态把关工具调用。需要 Node.js 22+；GEML MCP 服务器在会话启动时经 npx（@geml/geml）获取。

description.en: Before you say yes to an agent, ask how the code works: answers come with an interactive UML diagram (8 types) linked to the text, so pointing at a paragraph highlights it in the diagram and clicking a step jumps to its paragraph. Code quotes are checked against the files.
description.zh: 点 yes 之前先问清代码怎么运作：回答带一张和文字联动的交互式 UML 图（8 种），指向段落图上跟着高亮，点图里的一步文字跳到对应段落；代码引文回到文件里核对。

description.en: Adds one button to the sidebar foot that opens the desktop DSH Web GUI — in the system browser on a phone, in a new tab on a desktop. The target address is read from plugin config, DSH_DESKTOP_URL, or ~/.dsh/desktop-url.txt, and falls back to the relay origin published by dsh-remote-web-ui; the button renders inert with a hint when nothing is configured. It also adds a small gear button that saves the address into ~/.dsh/desktop-url.txt; on a phone with no separate launch address set, a click asks the local pairing service (/api/pair/issue) for a one-time pairing link and opens it; its HTTP routes (/api/desktop-link/…) have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 在侧栏底部加一个按钮，点一下打开桌面版 DSH 的 Web GUI——手机上交给系统浏览器，电脑上开新标签页。目标地址取自插件配置、DSH_DESKTOP_URL 或 ~/.dsh/desktop-url.txt，取不到时回退到 dsh-remote-web-ui 发布的固定中继地址；什么都没配时按钮置灰并给出提示。另有一个齿轮按钮，可在界面里把地址存进 ~/.dsh/desktop-url.txt；手机上如果没单独配置点击地址，点按钮时会向本机配对服务（/api/pair/issue）申请一次性配对链接再打开；插件的 HTTP 路由（/api/desktop-link/…）没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Local-first long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: text packages, on-demand recall, raw event citation, multiple brains and workspace boundaries.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 长期记忆插件：文本包、按需检索、可回原始事件、多大脑与工作区边界。

description.en: Reverse-engineering workbench: bridges a local IDA Pro into DeepSeek Harness through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, exposing the ida-pro-mcp toolset (decompile, xref, rename, comment) as mcp__ida__* tools. Auto-selects idalib headless mode (analyses a binary in-process, no IDA GUI) or GUI mode (connects to the IDA plugin RPC on port 13337). Adds re_check, re_open and re_status; the bundled MCP server is a zero-dependency stdio proxy usable from any MCP client.
description.zh: 逆向分析工作台：通过 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 把本机 IDA Pro 桥接进 DSH，将 ida-pro-mcp 工具集（反编译、xref、重命名、注释）以 mcp__ida__* 注册给模型。自动选择 idalib 无头模式（进程内分析二进制，无需打开 IDA GUI）或 GUI 模式（连接 IDA 插件 RPC，默认 13337 端口）。附带 re_check、re_open、re_status 三个工具；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 代理，任意 MCP 客户端可直接挂载。

description.en: Draggable 3D liquid-glass floating card for the DSH web GUI: DeepSeek API balance, cumulative spend/token stats (today/yesterday/7d/30d/all), adjustable glass/3D/color controls, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: DSH 网页右上角可拖动 3D 液态玻璃余额卡片：显示 DeepSeek API 余额、累计消费与 Token 统计（今天/昨天/近7天/近30天/全部），玻璃参数/3D 厚度/颜色均可调，内置官方充值入口。

description.en: Heads-up Texas Hold'em training with an independent AI opponent, persistent public-action memory, and decision reviews.
description.zh: 德州扑克 AI 陪练：双人对局、持久公开行为记忆与可追溯决策复盘。

description.en: Explicit, project-scoped memory handoff: when you open a new conversation, one model call that you confirm curates the project's earlier conversations into a bounded brief and injects it into the conversation's first step. No silent background calls; a Memory panel shows the brief and lets you edit notes.
description.zh: 显式、按项目隔离的记忆交接：新开会话时，经你确认后只调用一次模型，把同一项目里之前的对话整理成有长度上限的摘要，注入到新会话的第一步；不会在后台偷偷调用模型。“记忆”面板可以查看摘要、编辑笔记。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek balance and estimated daily spend, merges external vision-call JSONL records, and adds a per-session dashboard with model statistics, TTFT, cache rate, call logs, cost estimates, filters, and CSV export.
description.zh: 显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日花费估算，合并外部视觉调用 JSONL 记录，并提供含模型统计、TTFT、缓存率、调用日志、费用估算、筛选与 CSV 导出的会话看板。

description.en: One toggle makes the whole DeepSeek Harness shell translucent, with an opacity slider and a custom full-page background.
description.zh: 一键让整个 DeepSeek Harness 界面通透起来：透明度滑块随心调，背景图自由换。

description.en: Per-turn and per-step cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness: a Turns tab beside Chat and Trajectory with tokens, estimated cost, cache savings, and an inspector for tool arguments, raw results, and source. Client-only; prices are estimated from recorded model usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的逐轮、逐步成本账本：在 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁新增 Turns 页签，显示 token、估算费用、缓存节省，以及工具参数、原始返回与来源检查器。纯客户端，价格按已记录的模型用量估算。

description.en: Neutralize tool calls with invalid JSON arguments on the wire so one malformed model generation cannot brick a session against strict OpenAI-compatible servers.
description.zh: 在 wire 层中性化 arguments 为非法 JSON 的 tool call，避免一次模型畸形输出让 session 在严格 OpenAI 兼容服务端上永久 400。
