description.en: SDD task progress (todos) and progress ledger (sdd/progress.md) as a right-sidebar tab bound to the current session, rendered with the official MarkdownText, auto-refresh every 5s.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏以当前会话为维度展示 SDD 任务进度（todos）与进度台账（sdd/progress.md），采用官方 MarkdownText 渲染，每 5 秒自动刷新。

description.en: macOS desk pet forked from anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet, in a real always-on-top window that covers fullscreen Spaces: the pose follows whatever the local DSH is doing across six states, the right-click menu is a real AppKit one carrying quiet mode and a session list, and seven skins ship with it. Two of the seven are drawn from geometry by a script in the repo rather than generated, so making a skin needs no image model and no API credits; the bundled skill still expands one photo into all eighteen poses on your own image tool and credentials. There is no Electron and nothing to install alongside it: the window is driven through ctypes on the Python that ships with macOS.
description.zh: 分叉自 anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet 的 macOS 桌宠，一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住：姿势跟着本地 DSH 在六种状态之间走，右键菜单是真的 AppKit 菜单，里面有免打扰和会话清单，随包带七套皮肤。七套里有两套是仓库中的脚本用几何画出来的，不是生成的，所以做一套皮肤不需要图像模型、也不烧 API 额度；自带的 skill 仍用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片扩写成十八个姿势。没有 Electron，也不用另装任何东西：窗口是用 macOS 自带的那个 Python 经 ctypes 驱动的。

description.en: Five native tools for Social Data discovery, pricing previews, approved reads, stored-result retrieval and source tables; requires a BeatAPI key for paid reads.
description.zh: 提供社媒能力发现、价格预览、确认后读取、历史结果取回及来源表格；付费读取需要 BeatAPI key。

description.en: Local file recall: indexes the folders you choose into one local SQLite database, so 'where did I put that file?' is one query instead of a disk walk. Caches, VCS and program folders are pruned per directory; each folder keeps its own incremental anchor, so a folder added later is backfilled in full. Read-only: it never modifies, moves or deletes your files. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 本地文件记忆索引：把指定的文件夹记进本机一个 SQLite 库，忘了东西放哪问一句就能找回，不必翻硬盘；缓存、版本库与程序目录整棵跳过。每个目录各有独立增量锚点，后加入的目录首扫回填全部历史。只读，绝不修改、移动或删除你的文件。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek models: transcribes attached images with deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp before they reach deepseek-v4-pro, with no third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 视觉桥：贴图先经 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 转写为文字，再交给纯文本的 deepseek-v4-pro 回答，零第三方依赖。

description.en: An ikun (basketball meme) pet that fills the dock under the "Deep diving..." status row during replies: a sprite-sheet pet walks a 0→100% progress bar, switching animation and text every 20%, and plays a system-level "nǐ gàn ma~" voice cue at completion.
description.zh: ikun 桌宠填满「Deep diving...」状态行下方整行区块：坤宠动图沿 0%→100% 进度条行走，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时系统级播放「你干嘛~哎哟」提示音。

description.en: Provider logos and model IDs in the DSH model picker, registered as a label decorator on the official conversation.input.model.label slot; providers match by token, display name, model ID and explicit override, falling back to a letter monogram when unknown.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型选择器中显示各提供商的 logo 与模型 ID：通过官方 conversation.input.model.label 插槽注册标签装饰器；按 token、显示名、模型 ID 与显式覆盖四级匹配，未知提供商回退为字母 monogram。

description.en: Checks each step of a plan before you approve it, using command rules plus Jev or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with logprobs, and marks steps that can't be undone, affect things outside the workspace, weren't asked for or are too vague on the plan review card.
description.zh: 在你同意执行计划前逐步检查每一步，用命令规则加上 Jev 或支持 logprobs 的 OpenAI 兼容端点，在计划审阅卡片上标出无法恢复、影响工作区以外、需求没提到或描述太模糊的步骤。

description.en: Forwards a local dsh web UI to the public internet under a *.ds.hn subdomain (or your own self-hosted relay), gated by a login, with optional end-to-end encryption (PBKDF2 to AES-256-GCM).
description.zh: 把本地 dsh 网页通过带登录门禁的中继转发到公网 *.ds.hn 子域名(也可自托管到自己的域名),支持可选的端到端加密(PBKDF2 到 AES-256-GCM)。

description.en: Looks up CCF conference paper deadlines with the ccf_deadlines, ccf_venue and ccf_update tools, the /ccf command and a desktop panel that exports the list as a calendar. Dates come from a live sync (CCFDDL as the main source, a second source cross-checked; a gap of 36 hours or more is flagged as a source conflict), so nothing is bundled and the next 30 days stay in the system prompt.
description.zh: 用 ccf_deadlines、ccf_venue、ccf_update 三个工具、/ccf 命令和可导出日历的桌面面板查 CCF 会议截稿：日期靠实时同步（CCFDDL 为主、另一个源交叉比对，差 36 小时以上标「来源冲突」），插件本身不内置任何日期，首次使用需先同步一次；未来 30 天的截稿会常驻系统提示。

description.en: A helmeted pixel chicken rides a bicycle along a Minecraft-style pixel strip docked at the bottom of the app frame, with an 80-second day/night cycle, bell with note particles, jumps, a headlight, and ride stats. Creepers roam by day and zombies by night. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-alpha.
description.zh: 一只戴头盔的像素小鸡骑行在 GUI 底部的我的世界像素风骑行带里，带 80 秒昼夜循环、按铃音符、跳跃、车头灯与骑行统计。白天苦力怕出没，夜晚僵尸被撞飞。需要 DSH >=0.2.1-alpha。

description.en: Folder explorer for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: open any local folder, browse a tree with file-type icons, rename/create/delete/copy files and folders, and add files to the chat as @ references.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏的文件夹资源管理器：打开任意本地文件夹、按类型显示彩色图标、重命名/新建/删除/复制文件与文件夹，并可把文件作为 @ 引用添加到对话。

description.en: Vertical icon rail under the right-sidebar toggle: collapsed it shows three icons, hovering expands every right-sidebar tab, and clicking one opens that tab.
description.zh: 右侧栏快捷导航：在「打开右侧边栏」图标下方常驻一条竖排图标轨，悬停展开全部标签，点击一步直达。

description.en: Pools several OpenCode Go API keys and hot-switches each request to the least-used one, with official usage and balance lookup plus a graphical settings page.
description.zh: 聚合多个 OpenCode Go API key，把每次请求热切换到用量最低的一个，并提供官方用量/余额查询与设置页图形化管理。

description.en: Streams DeepSeek Harness sessions, messages, tool activity, and turn outcomes to a JARVIS Mission Control board with task status and human review.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话、消息、工具活动与每轮结果实时推送到 JARVIS Mission Control 看板，附任务状态与人工复核。

description.en: Registers 25 software engineering workflow skills covering spec, planning, build, test, review and ship. Mirrored from addyosmani/agent-skills (MIT).
description.zh: 注册 25 个软件工程工作流技能，覆盖规格、规划、构建、测试、评审与发布。镜像自 addyosmani/agent-skills（MIT）。

description.en: WhaleHarbor desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top transparent float window hosts a chibi whale-maid built from 13 AI-generated parts and animated as a CSS paper-doll (breathing, blinking, ahoge sway, sweat, hops, tremors), mirroring work state in eight moods — idle, busy, approval, question, error, celebration, nap, and subagent clones — with poke, drag, three sizes, tray toggle, and live stats in the speech bubble. Requires the WhaleHarbor desktop shell (Windows build).
description.zh: 鲸港 WhaleHarbor 大白鲸娘桌面窗宠：13 个 AI 生成零件以 CSS 纸片人方式驱动（呼吸、眨眼、呆毛摇摆、汗滴、蹦跳与抖动），八种状态实时反映 DSH 工作情况——空闲、忙碌、审批、提问、出错、庆祝、打盹、子代理分身——支持戳一戳、拖动、三档尺寸、托盘开关与气泡实时统计。需 WhaleHarbor 桌面壳（当前提供 Windows 构建）。

description.en: Global Quick Actions beside every session-backed composer in DSH. One press sends a preset or your own saved text, with per-action send confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 每个由会话支持的消息编辑器旁提供全局快捷动作。一键发送预置或你自己保存的文本，每个动作可单独设置发送确认。

description.en: Finds potential UX issues in your project: automatically reviews React/TypeScript code, pinpoints each problem, and gives concrete suggestions.
description.zh: 帮你发现项目中可能存在的用户体验问题：自动走查 React/TypeScript 源码，定位问题并给出具体优化建议。

description.en: Galatea: shape an AI assistant of your own. One assistant with its own persona and long-term memory (git-versioned plain files); long chats hand off to a fresh conversation without forgetting, and it tidies its memory in the background while you are away. It runs on whatever model DSH is set to and keeps its memory when you switch; every module can be turned off, and other plugins can extend it. Phone chat (QQ, WeChat) and Claude Code sessions come from the separate Galatea channels and agent-sdk plugins. Preview; needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or a later 0.2.x.
description.zh: 加拉忒亚——塑造专属于你的 AI 助手。一个有自己人格和长期记忆（git 版本化的普通文件）的助手；聊得再久也会自己换到新对话、不失忆，你不在时它在后台整理记忆。会话跑在 DSH 里设的模型上，换模型记忆不丢；各模块都能单独关闭，也能用别的插件扩展。QQ/微信聊天与 Claude Code 会话由另外两个 Galatea 插件提供。预览版，需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或之后的 0.2.x。

description.en: Windows toast notifications when a DeepSeek Harness task finishes: the session title, the outcome, and a summary of the final reply, sent once when the agent really stops rather than once per round of a running goal.
description.zh: DSH 任务完成时，在 Windows 通知栏弹出原生通知，带上会话标题、结果状态与最后一条回复的摘要；在 agent 真正停下来时才发一条，而不是每跑一个回合就响一次。

description.en: Fixes web_fetch failing with "non-public IP address" while Clash, Surge or v2rayN runs in TUN/fake-IP mode: finds your local HTTP proxy by itself, sends web_fetch through it while the proxy is on and directly when it is off, and adds an Auto/Proxy/Direct switch to the sidebar. Model calls are left alone by default.
description.zh: 修复开着 Clash / Surge / v2rayN（TUN、fake-IP）时 web_fetch 报 non-public IP address 的问题：自动找到本机 HTTP 代理，代理开着走代理、关了直连；侧栏可一键切换「自动 / 走代理 / 直连」。默认只接管 web_fetch，不影响模型调用。

description.en: Search-first capability workflow for DSH agents (v1.0.0): reuse local tools or review exact-source plugins before installation, adapt or create capabilities in managed source work, and use receipts that distinguish installed, loaded, activated, and verified states; version tools cover rollback, adoption, and upstream updates.
description.zh: AutoEvo v1.0.0 为 DSH Agent 提供 Search-first 能力工作流：优先复用本地工具或审查精确来源插件后再安装；可在受管源码中改造或新建能力；回执区分 installed、loaded、activated、verified，版本工具支持回滚、领养与上游更新。

description.en: Diagnoses how discoverable a DSH plugin is (npm keywords, README install format, GitHub topics, market listing) and drafts fix suggestions; registers diagnose_visibility and boost_exposure tools. Scoring rules are tuned to the author's own @liuhange packages; needs network access (npm, GitHub API, dsh-plugin.org).
description.zh: 诊断 DSH 插件的可发现性（npm 关键词、README 安装写法、GitHub topics、市场收录）并生成改进建议；注册 diagnose_visibility 与 boost_exposure 两个工具。评分规则按作者自家 @liuhange 系列包调校，需联网访问 npm、GitHub API 与 dsh-plugin.org。

description.en: DevLead mode for DeepSeek Harness: a human-only switch turns one ordinary session into a lead with eight devlead_* tools to register workspaces and create, read, continue and watch other ordinary sessions; it dispatches work to those sessions, reviews the delivery and reports, is woken through a durable notification digest when a watched session's turn settles, and can give a dispatched writing session its own Git worktree when the host provides the experimental worktree service.
description.zh: DSH 的 DevLead 模式：人类专属开关把一个普通会话升级为 DevLead，获得 8 个 devlead_* 工具，用于注册工作区、创建/读取/继续/监督其他普通会话；它向这些会话派发任务、审阅交付并汇报，被监督会话的轮次结束时通过持久通知摘要将其唤醒，宿主提供实验性 worktree 服务时还可让被派发的写入会话使用独立 git worktree。

description.en: Data asset inventory scan plugin — deep metadata scan + triple-condition check, outputs asset catalog.
description.zh: 数据资产盘点扫描插件 — 深度元数据扫描 + 资产三条件初筛（权属线索标注），输出资产清单

description.en: Native tools for an Obsidian wiki vault: wiki_query, wiki_write, wiki_rename, wiki_scaffold, wiki_archive, and wiki_lint cover BM25 search with link-graph context, bookkeeping writes with sha256 source tracking, vault-wide renames, mode scaffolds, source archiving, and health checks — with cross-process locks and optional git auto-commit.
description.zh: Obsidian wiki vault 原生工具：wiki_query、wiki_write、wiki_rename、wiki_scaffold、wiki_archive、wiki_lint 覆盖 BM25 链接图检索、带 sha256 源追踪的簿记式写入、全库改名、模式化脚手架、源归档与健康检查，并内置跨进程锁与可选 git 自动提交。

description.en: Model brand marks in the composer model selector; vendor and model marks across Settings → Models (provider rows, model rows, the add-provider dropdown); and a per provider/model icon picker that stores overrides in the DSH user settings document.
description.zh: 在输入框的模型选择器中显示模型品牌图标，在「设置 → 模型」页的提供商行、模型行和添加提供商下拉框中显示厂商与模型图标，并提供按提供商/模型覆盖图标的图标选择器，覆盖项保存在 DSH 用户设置文档中。

description.en: Let DSH speak: every reply is rewritten into natural spoken language before being read aloud, with code, tables, and Markdown handled gracefully. Works out of the box with system TTS; Doubao (third-party API) adds dialects and expressive voices; the local Kokoro engine runs offline to keep content on your device. Supports both DSH desktop and dsh web. Optional session sounds tell you when the agent is working, finished, or waiting for your answer — with swappable built-in tones and support for your own audio.
description.zh: 让 DSH 开口说话：每轮回答先改写成自然口语再朗读，代码、表格与 Markdown 自动处理；系统 TTS 开箱即用，豆包（第三方 API）提供方言与情感演绎，本地 Kokoro 引擎离线运行、内容不出本机；支持 DSH 桌面版与 dsh web。另附工作／完成／提问三种会话状态提示音——会话在跑、跑完了、等你回答各有提示，音色可换、也能上传自己的音频。

description.en: Injects your existing markdown documents (notes, rules, knowledge-base files) into every dsh session's system prompt as read-only memory — list file or directory paths in `files`; no database, no service, no write path; UTF-8 byte-budgeted truncation with line-boundary fallback, total budget, YAML front-matter stripping, and freshness timestamps.
description.zh: 把本地已有的 markdown 文档（笔记、规则、知识库）按路径清单注入 dsh 每个会话的系统提示词，当只读记忆——无数据库、无服务、无写入通道；支持目录收集、UTF-8 字节预算截断、front-matter 剥离与新鲜度时间戳。

description.en: Customer-machine access plugin for deepseek-harness-gateway: opens a single outbound WebSocket to the gateway and relays the machine local dsh web UI over that tunnel using pairing-code + HMAC auth, so no inbound port, port mapping, or public IP is needed.
description.zh: 客户机接入插件：以单条出站 WebSocket 连接网关，把本机 dsh web 界面经隧道转发给门户，配对接入码 + HMAC 认证；无需入站端口、端口映射或公网 IP。

description.en: Adds mind maps and an Excalidraw canvas to the DSH sidebar, with local blueprint-file editing, Excalidraw file previews and standalone CLIs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏提供思维导图和 Excalidraw 自由画布，支持本地思维导图文件编辑、Excalidraw 文件预览与独立 CLI。

description.en: Find and compose DSH plugins from a task description, then open an independent chat environment or install the plan into the current profile.
description.zh: 根据任务查找并组合 DSH 插件，打开可继续对话的独立环境，或将方案中的插件安装到当前配置。

description.en: Removes the Preview badge on DSH.
description.zh: 去除在DSH上的预览版标签。

description.en: Sit-and-water reminder for DeepSeek Harness, with a cat that sits in the corner of the Web GUI. A focus cycle of 30-90 minutes ends in a centered overlay plus a triple chime that gets you up to walk and drink; the later button answers with one real sourced case about prolonged sitting and one about dehydration (built-in library of 17 entries, each with publisher, date and a link to the original); stopping produces a session report with worked time, completed rounds, successful interruptions, snoozes, suggested drinks and a good/mid/bad grade. The cat can be dragged anywhere with its position remembered and loops one animation per state. The timer and the ledger live in the host half, so a page refresh never loses a cycle; it only reminds while a DSH page is open. Cycle lengths, chime volume, cat opacity and grade thresholds are configurable on the plugin settings page.
description.zh: DSH 的久坐与喝水提醒：一只猫待在 Web GUI 角落帮你盯时间。专注周期 30-90 分钟结束后居中弹窗并连响三声，喊你起来走两步、喝口水；点「再等会」给出 1 条久坐的真实案例 + 1 条缺水的真实案例（内置 17 条，均带来源媒体、发布日期和原文链接）；点「结束」输出本次工作评价：工作时长、完成轮数、成功中断次数、推迟次数、建议喝水次数与好/中/差评分。猫可以拖到任意位置并记住位置，四个状态各一段循环动画。计时与账本在宿主侧，刷新页面不丢；只在 DSH 页面开着时提醒。周期时长、提示音音量、猫的不透明度、评价阈值都能在设置页调整。

description.en: Adds a Restart button to the Windows titlebar of the desktop app: a click opens a confirmation dialog that says how many sessions a restart would interrupt, and confirming quits and reopens the app.
description.zh: 给桌面端 Windows 标题栏加一个「重启」按钮：点一下先弹出确认框（并说明有几个会话会被中断），确认后退出并重新打开应用。

description.en: Bidirectional Hermes ↔ DSH bridge: import Hermes sessions into DSH, consult Hermes, and receive Hermes-dispatched tasks as a single Cordis plugin.
description.zh: Hermes 与 DSH 的双向桥接插件：将 Hermes 会话导入 DSH、咨询 Hermes，并以单一 Cordis 插件接收 Hermes 下发的任务。

description.en: Skill manager for DSH with a pack system. Installs skills as versioned packs and never overwrites files you have edited - upgrades skip your changes and report them. Also ships 6 built-in skills, a problem-grouped settings panel, and tools that let the agent read and write the skill library in conversation.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器，带技能包机制。技能以带版本的包安装，升级时绝不覆盖你改过的文件，只跳过并如实报告。另自带 6 个基础技能、按「你遇到的问题」分组的面板，以及让模型在对话里直接读写技能库的工具。

description.en: Inserts the full path as text when a folder is pasted into the input box, instead of trying to upload it (Windows and macOS).
description.zh: 粘贴复制来的文件夹时插入完整路径文本，而不是尝试上传（支持 Windows 与 macOS）。

description.en: Type /私 and complete 私家大厨 — Chinese skill names, zero renaming. Patches DSH skill discovery, the / gesture and the skill tool so any Unicode SKILL.md name (私家大厨, 卡路里, 作息管家…) works: slash completion, direct /私家大厨 invocation, model skill({name}) loading. Zero config; runtime changes revert on uninstall, but the regex patch written into three DSH packages on disk stays until the next DSH upgrade replaces those files.
description.zh: 中文技能名零改造直用：输入 /私 自动补全 私家大厨。为 DSH 打上技能发现、斜杠手势与 skill 工具补丁，Unicode 技能名（私家大厨/卡路里/作息管家…）补全、直达、加载全可用；不改 SKILL.md、零配置；运行时改动随卸载恢复，但写进 DSH 三个依赖包磁盘文件里的正则补丁会保留到下次 DSH 升级覆盖为止。

description.en: Reasoning-effort tier manager for custom API models plus cross-session preference memory: inline low/medium/high/max toggles inside Settings → Models, with atomic settings writes.
description.zh: 为自定义 API 模型提供推理强度分级管理与跨会话偏好记忆：在「设置 → 模型」中内联切换 low/medium/high/max，配置写入为原子操作。

description.en: DSH plugin: a four-entry learning flow in the session input bar — scaffold a preset, collect candidates, merge reviewed changes, and run a read-only workspace audit.
description.zh: DSH 插件：会话输入区的四入口学习流程——初始预设、收集提炼、关联升级、沉淀复用。

description.en: Generate QR codes from a from-scratch ISO/IEC 18004 encoder with no external tools, plan symbol version and error-correction headroom before producing anything, and decode an existing symbol back to text.
description.zh: 内置从零实现的 ISO/IEC 18004 编码器，无需任何外部程序即可出码；出图前先算清楚版本与纠错余量，也能把已有二维码读回文本。

description.en: Per-workspace project kanban board: nine kanban_* model tools for agent-driven planning plus a browser board UI, with disk persistence, undo, templates, and archiving.
description.zh: 按工作区（项目）隔离的项目看板：9 个 kanban_* 模型工具供 Agent 规划时写卡，另带浏览器看板 UI，支持磁盘持久化、撤销、模板与归档。

description.en: Data asset compliance check plugin — checks source compliance, processing compliance, usage compliance.
description.zh: 数据资产合规检查插件 — 检查来源合规性、处理合规性、使用合规性

description.en: Watchlist panel for A-share, Hong Kong and US quotes plus Eastmoney boards, with intraday sparklines and an agent stock_quote tool.
description.zh: A 股 / 港股 / 美股与板块自选面板，带分时迷你走势图，并向 agent 提供 stock_quote 工具。

description.en: Adds next-message prediction, inline draft completion, and prompt optimization to the DSH composer, with a call budget, request stats, and glossary protection in Settings. A fork of Somnus678/dsh-input-assistant; both put their controls on the same composer, so do not install the two together.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框中提供下一句预测、输入续写和提示词优化，并在设置页提供调用额度、请求统计和术语保护。基于 Somnus678/dsh-input-assistant 改造的分支，两者都在同一个输入框上加控件，不能与上游同装。

description.en: CRT terminal skin with a phosphor-green palette, scanlines and monospace type for DeepSeek Harness. Also adds a sidebar dashboard with output speed, CPU/memory and DeepSeek balance; the key stays in the host process.
description.zh: 深色磷光绿 CRT 终端皮肤，带扫描线和等宽字体，用于 DeepSeek Harness。另在侧栏加仪表盘：输出速度、CPU/内存与 DeepSeek 余额；密钥只留在宿主进程。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer plus spend per session, today, this month and all time, priced by a configurable time-of-day price table per currency (DeepSeek CNY/USD defaults included). Two read-only remote methods, no host routes, key read through the host credentials seam on every call, egress only to the configured provider origin.
description.zh: 侧栏脚注显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并按会话/今日/本月/累计统计花费，按可配置的分时价格表（按币种分表，内置 DeepSeek 人民币/美元默认表）计价。两个只读远程方法，无宿主路由，密钥每次经宿主凭据缝读取，只向配置的供应商域名出网。

description.en: Folds REA's 207 reverse-engineering tools (Ghidra / Hopper / IDA backends) into 3 commands plus 6 read-only domain entries: about 5 KB of resident tool text instead of 757 KB. Ships no engines; rea-agents, Ghidra 12.1.x and JDK 21 are installed separately.
description.zh: 把 REA 的 207 个逆向工具（Ghidra / Hopper / IDA 后端）折叠成 3 条命令加 6 个只读域入口，常驻约 5 KB。不代装引擎，需自行安装 rea-agents、Ghidra 12.1.x 与 JDK 21。

description.en: Concurrency guard and monitor for DeepSeek Harness: FIFO queue when concurrent model requests reach the limit, per-day persisted stats with error-kind classification, and interruption detection for abandoned streams.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 并发监控与门闩：模型请求达上限时 FIFO 排队防锁号，按天持久化统计并做异常分类，检测流被弃用的回合中断。

description.en: Makes plain Enter insert a newline in the composer and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter submit, toggleable in settings.
description.zh: 让对话框中普通 Enter 换行、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 提交，可在设置中开关。

description.en: Review DeepSeek Harness responses with inline annotations, document reading, comment threads, and text revisions, then bring a reading summary back to the main conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型回复添加多处批注、文档阅读、评论线程和正文修订，并将阅读摘要带回主对话。

description.en: A newspaper-style front page for a session you left running, as a Conversation View tab beside Chat and Trajectory: a per-turn timeline (duration, steps, tools, tokens, outcome), file churn counted per file, where the wall clock went and how much of it was the model rather than tools, which single turn ate the spend, failures nobody retried quoted with their failing command, and a context-pressure gauge measured against the routed model's own declared capacity. The briefing is folded from the durable session log and never generated by a model, so it costs no tokens, cannot hallucinate, and is byte-identical for the same log and clock; it appends nothing to the session and reaches no model, and it reports a pending approval without ever answering it. Pages are offered only when they have content, and the tab refreshes itself on turn settle and on a two-speed poll backed by a metadata-only tail probe.
description.zh: 把跑着的会话排成一张报纸式头版，作为 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁的 Conversation View 标签页：逐轮时间线（耗时、步数、工具、token、结果）、按文件统计的改动热度、墙钟时间去向以及其中多少是模型而非工具、哪一轮吃掉了花费、无人重试的失败（附失败命令），以及对照该路由模型自报容量的上下文压力仪表。简报由持久会话日志折算而成、从不调用模型：零 token、不会编造、同一份日志与时钟下字节一致；不向会话追加任何内容、也不触达模型，只报告待批准项而绝不代为应答。仅在某一页有内容时才提供该页；标签页在轮次结束时自刷新，并用只读日志尾部的探针做两档轮询。

description.en: Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an interactive 88-key keyboard.
description.zh: 让 Agent 弹一曲真钢琴：Salamander Grand 真实采样音色，Canvas2D 三角钢琴与沉浸式舞台渲染，88 键可弹。

description.en: Offline CET-4 study panel: a built-in original starter set (426 words and one mock paper, listening read by the system voice) plus locally built practice from the user's own materials; answers are shown without explanations.
description.zh: 离线四级学习面板：内置原创示例题库（426 个自编词 + 1 套原创模拟卷，听力用系统语音朗读），也可用自备资料在本地构建真题练习；客观题只给答案不给解析。

description.en: Read-only Molio knowledge base tools: list vaults, browse the file tree, full-text search and read documents, served over the local Molio daemon HTTP API, which must be running. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-molio.
description.zh: Molio 本地知识库只读工具集：列知识库、浏览文件树、全文搜索、读取原文，经本机 Molio daemon HTTP API 取数（需 daemon 常驻运行）。npm 包名 dsh-plugin-molio，dsh plugin add 即装。

description.en: Routes agent requests to configurable default, planner, and subagent models, automatically using the planner role in plan mode, with per-role reasoning effort and Web UI configuration.
description.zh: 按 default、planner 和 subagent 角色将代理请求路由到可配置模型，在计划模式下自动使用 planner，并提供逐角色推理强度与 Web UI 配置。

description.en: /compact and auto-compaction summarize with the model selected in the session, not the model that finished the last turn.
description.zh: /compact 与自动压缩使用会话中当前选中的模型来生成摘要，而不是用跑完上一轮的那个模型。

description.en: Super input suite — model and effort picker, prompt enhancer, follow-up suggestion chips, a full cost engine with daily heatmap and Coding Plan quotas, voice-input light effects and transcript cleanup (needs the built-in voice-input bundle enabled), prompt templates, selection reference chips with comments, a compaction ring and a settings hub. Bundles the author's standalone dsh-cost, dsh-power-picker, dsh-prompt-enhancer, dsh-followup, dsh-siri-voice and dsh-compaction-control; uninstall those before installing.
description.zh: 超级输入框套件——模型与推理强度选择器、提示词增强、跟进建议 chips、带每日热力图与 Coding Plan 配额的完整费用引擎、语音输入光效与转写清理（需先启用官方语音输入包）、Prompt 模板库、划选引用与评论 chip、压缩圆环和设置总览。已并入作者原独立插件 dsh-cost、dsh-power-picker、dsh-prompt-enhancer、dsh-followup、dsh-siri-voice、dsh-compaction-control，安装前请先卸载它们。

description.en: Workspace file tree and code editor in the DSH right sidebar: browse the workspace of the session it belongs to, create, rename and delete files and folders (to a trash folder by default), edit in place with line numbers and syntax highlighting (Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+D duplicates the current line), preview images and play audio or video, list and unpack archives or pack a folder into a .zip through the system tar, search by file name or jump by a pasted path, and draw file rows with the icons Windows itself uses (SHGetFileInfo, Windows only).
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏里的工作区文件树与代码编辑器：跟随所在会话的工作区，新建 / 重命名 / 删除文件与文件夹（默认进回收站），带行号与语法高亮地编辑、Ctrl+S 保存、Ctrl+D 复制当前行，可预览图片、播放音频视频、查看并解压压缩包或用系统 tar 打包成 zip，能按文件名搜索或粘贴路径跳转，Windows 下图标用系统自己那套（SHGetFileInfo）。

description.en: Convert Notion blocks and Markdown in both directions, with no API client and no external dependency. A Notion paragraph is an array of rich-text runs while Markdown says one string, so the two directions are a split and a merge rather than a pair of inverses — rich-text runs are cut at every annotation boundary one way and re-merged the other, with fences widened when the content already contains backticks. Reports every lossy step instead of swallowing it.
description.zh: Notion 区块与 Markdown 双向转换，不带 API 客户端、无外部依赖。Notion 的段落是一组富文本 run，而 Markdown 只有一个字符串 —— 所以两个方向分别是「切分」与「合并」，并不是一对互逆操作：一个方向在每个注解边界切开 run，另一个方向把相邻同注解的 run 重新合并，内容本身含反引号时自动加宽围栏。每一步有损转换都会报出来，而不是默默吞掉。

description.en: Adversarial review gate for tool calls. It hooks `tools/pre-execute`: a local regex pass over destructive commands (`rm -rf`, `git push --force`, `git reset --hard`, `DROP TABLE`, `format`, disk writes) and sensitive paths (`.env`, `id_rsa`, `.ssh`, `.git/`, `$DSH_HOME`) runs first with no latency, and only a hit is escalated to one review-model call that returns allow or deny. Plain reads and ordinary writes never enter that path, so everyday work pays no added delay. Every verdict is shown live in the Web GUI.
description.zh: 工具调用的对抗式审查门。它挂在 `tools/pre-execute` 上：先用本地正则零延迟筛破坏性命令（`rm -rf`、`git push --force`、`git reset --hard`、`DROP TABLE`、`format`、写盘）和敏感路径（`.env`、`id_rsa`、`.ssh`、`.git/`、`$DSH_HOME`），只有命中才升级给一次审查模型调用，返回 allow / deny。普通读取与普通写入完全不进这条路径，日常工作没有额外延迟；每次判定都在 Web GUI 里实时显示。

description.en: Groups the sessions of every workspace in the DSH sidebar by day, with explicit date labels, a live running indicator and date-based search.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏的每个工作区内把会话按日期分组、标注具体日期，并保留运行中状态灯与按日期搜索。

description.en: Live decode speed (tok/s) pill in the composer status bar that tracks the currently streaming response.
description.zh: 在输入栏状态栏中实时显示当前流式响应解码速度（tok/s）的插件。

description.en: Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.
description.zh: dsh web 输入栏模型选择面板：左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索。

description.en: DSH updater + official docs sync in Settings: one-click npm update of @deepseek-ai/dsh with live progress (npm output stream, elapsed timer, monotonic bar), multi-copy protection that only touches the running instance, source-tree mode via git pull, one-click PowerShell 7 install on Windows, incremental sync of the official docs/ with progress, and the dsh_docs_search / dsh_docs_read model tools.
description.zh: 设置页内的 DSH 更新器 + 官方文档同步器：一键以 npm 全局更新 @deepseek-ai/dsh 并带实时进度（npm 输出流、已运行计时、单调进度条），多副本保护只更新当前运行实例，源码树模式走 git pull；Windows 缺 PowerShell 7 时可一键安装；官方 docs/ 增量同步（按 blob sha 跳过未变文件）带进度条，并提供 dsh_docs_search / dsh_docs_read 模型工具。

description.en: Find keywords in the current conversation or across every session, with highlight and jump.
description.zh: 在当前对话或所有会话里按关键词查找，命中可高亮、可跳转。

description.en: Event sounds for DSH: plays a chosen sound on session end, options popup, permission request and stop, with AI-generated character voice lines and a manageable sound library.
description.zh: DSH 声音工坊：在会话结束、弹出选项、请求许可与停止时播放指定音效，支持 AI 角色语音生成与音效库管理。

description.en: Injects your own text into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt as real system sections from a sidebar editor: each section lands after the persona, after the tool docs, or at the very end of the prompt, can be switched on or off, and can resolve {{variables}}; a preview runs the host's own assemble and render pass so you see the exact prompt the next request will send, with empty, duplicate, unknown-variable and oversize sections flagged.
description.zh: 把你的文字作为真正的 system 段落注入 DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词：侧栏编辑器里为每段选择落点（人格之后、工具说明之后，或提示词最末尾），逐段启停，可解析 {{变量}}；预览调用宿主真实的 assemble 与 render，看清下一个请求实际发出的提示词，并标出空段、重复行、未知变量与超长段落。

description.en: Persistent tmux control-mode cockpit for DSH Web that mirrors native panes in a dock.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供持久的 tmux 控制模式驾驶舱，在停靠栏中镜像原生窗格。

description.en: Toolbox plugin for the Web UI: session/trash/subdirectory/search/preset/config management, tag grouping, long-message collapse, and a scheduled heartbeat with optional IM channel push.
description.zh: Web 界面工具箱：会话/回收站/子目录/搜索/预设/配置管理、标签分组、长消息折叠，以及支持 IM 渠道推送的定时心跳。

description.en: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.en: LaTeX snippet expansion in the composer, built from Obsidian LaTeX Suite's own defaults — 138 triggers expand as they are typed, Tab walks the tabstops, and the table of 142 is editable in one JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框里的 LaTeX 片段展开，触发词表直接取自 Obsidian Latex Suite 的默认片段——138 条打完即出，Tab 依次跳 tabstop，142 条全在一份可编辑的 JSON 里。

description.en: Git workflow studio for DeepSeek Harness: pick a branch model, enforce Conventional Commits, review PRs by defect density, rewrite history safely, rescue lost commits with reflog, and version releases by actual behavior change.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作流工作室：定分支模型、统一提交规范、按缺陷密度评 PR、安全改写历史、用 reflog 救援丢失的提交，并按真实行为变化定版本号。

description.en: DSH host bundle for the ShyPie privacy-first workflow: extracts attached images and PDF/Office files locally before they enter the session log (requires poppler pdftotext/pdftoppm on PATH and a local OCR engine — Windows OCR on Windows, optionally tesseract; without them attachments are rejected, not forwarded); default filter mode keeps text local (optional local masking); blocks unmaskable media/BLOB; provides local privacy_extract, privacy_ocr, privacy_scan and privacy_rehydrate tools; denies read_image and binary/document reads outside allowPaths; and enforces a fail-closed llm/stream egress guard before DSH dispatches a model request (the default provider allowlist is the local Magpie gateway).
description.zh: 面向 ShyPie 隐私优先工作流的 DSH 主机插件：在写入会话日志前本地提取附件图片及 PDF/Office 文件（需 PATH 中有 poppler 的 pdftotext/pdftoppm 和本地 OCR 引擎，Windows 用系统 OCR、可选 tesseract；缺少时附件会被拒绝而不是转发）；默认 filter 模式保留本地文本（可选用本地掩码）；阻断无法掩码的媒体/BLOB；提供本地 privacy_extract、privacy_ocr、privacy_scan、privacy_rehydrate 工具；拒绝 read_image 及 allowPaths 之外的二进制/文档读取；并在 DSH 发出模型请求前执行失败关闭的 llm/stream 出口检查（默认只放行本地 Magpie 网关）。

description.en: An animated pixel cat that lives over the DSH web interface and follows what the agent is doing — sitting while the session is calm, lying down and falling asleep while a run is in progress, and waking when the turn returns or typing starts. It can be dragged anywhere, remembers its position, sleeps after a minute of inactivity, and offers an enable switch, four sizes and a status-reaction toggle in Settings.
description.zh: 一只住在 DSH 网页界面上的动画像素猫，会跟随 agent 的状态变化——会话平静时坐着，运行中躺下并入睡，回合结束或开始打字时醒来。可以拖到任意位置并记住坐标，闲置一分钟后入睡，设置里有开关、四档尺寸和状态联动选项。

description.en: Picks a random installed skin on every DeepSeek Harness launch and enables exactly that skin, with an on/off switch and a shuffle action inside the Skins settings page. Skins the running host would refuse to load are excluded, and a manual switch still applies until the next launch.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时随机启用一个已安装皮肤，并在「设置 → 皮肤」页内提供开关与「立即随机换一个」按钮。宿主会拒绝加载的皮肤自动排除；手动切换的皮肤一直有效到下次启动。

description.en: Adds a model picker to teammate (continuable subagent) sessions: switch a quota-exhausted teammate to a model that still has quota and let it continue, without rebuilding it or touching the Lead session.
description.zh: 给队友（continuable subagent）会话加一个模型选择器：队友额度用完时直接换个还有额度的模型让它继续跑，不用重建队友，也不影响主线会话与全局默认模型。

description.en: Mounts the hosted Exa search MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa tools, anonymous on the free tier or with your own EXA_API_KEY.
description.zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接接入托管的 Exa 搜索 MCP 端点（mcp.exa.ai）：web_search_exa 与 web_fetch_exa 工具，免费额度匿名可用，设置 EXA_API_KEY 可解锁更高限额。

description.en: An MC-Fabric-style hook processor.
description.zh: 类似 MC Fabric 的 hook 处理器。

description.en: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
description.zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

description.en: Runs OmicVerse/OmicOS bioinformatics analyses in a persistent Python kernel, with capability-catalog search, kernel inspection and an account tab.
description.zh: 在持久 Python 内核里跑 OmicVerse/OmicOS 生信分析，附能力目录检索、内核变量查看与账号订阅页签。

description.en: Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol bridge: serves an A2A endpoint with agent card, message/send, message/stream SSE, task lifecycle (get/cancel/resubscribe) and input-required continuation; a2a_discover/a2a_send/a2a_task_status/a2a_cancel tools for calling remote agents; plus a web ops panel with live task board, one-click cancel and a remote agent directory.
description.zh: Agent2Agent（A2A）协议桥：内置 A2A 服务端（agent card、message/send、message/stream SSE、任务 get/cancel/resubscribe、input-required 续答）；a2a_discover/a2a_send 等 4 个工具呼叫远端 agent；附 Web 运维面板：实时任务板、一键取消、远端 agent 目录。

description.en: MarkPilot — an IDE-style Markdown × AI workspace inside DSH. Files, editor and chat sit side by side with draggable panes; send a selection's Markdown source and its file path into the chat with one click or Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Enter, or reference the open note with @mp. Resume the last note per project, start a blank draft that saves into its own folder, and keep your place as conversations change. Typora-style live rendering with click-to-source formulas, cell-level tables, offline Mermaid and KaTeX, ten themes and transparency; a 150k-character document is parsed in a worker so typing stays smooth. Saves are version-guarded and atomic — conflicts raise a banner instead of overwriting; external disk edits are adopted within 1–2 s, drafts are recoverable, and file:// links or absolute .md path chips open in the workspace. 2.0 adds durable document state, missing/renamed/read-only lifecycle banners, a recovery center and Save As. Fully offline assets, MIT, 544 automated tests.
description.zh: MarkPilot · IDE 式 Markdown × AI 工作台：文件树、编辑器与对话并排，分栏可拖；选中文段一键把 Markdown 源码和文件路径送进对话，@mp 引用当前文档。按工作目录记住最近笔记，切项目不丢文档；空白稿首次保存落在原目录。Typora 式即时渲染，公式点哪改哪、表格格内编辑、离线 Mermaid 与 KaTeX、十套主题与透明外观；15 万字长文交给 Worker，输入不卡。保存走版本守卫与原子落盘，冲突给横幅而不覆盖；外部改写 1–2 秒自动采纳，有草稿时给可操作提示，草稿可恢复；消息里的 file:// 链接与 .md 路径芯片直接进工作台。2.0 增加持久文档状态、缺失/改名/只读生命周期横幅、恢复中心与另存为。全部资源离线、MIT、544 自动化测试。

description.en: Hosts the agent as a persona on a self-hosted web page, with owner and guest accounts: a mood value that drifts back toward baseline over time, memory you can read and edit, a sticker library, diary posts that guests can comment on, idle small talk, voice notes, speech recognition and text to speech. The built-in web server listens on 0.0.0.0:2332 by default; create the owner account before exposing the port, and only the owner can add guest accounts.
description.zh: 让 agent 以人设住进自建网页，分主人和客人两种账号：会随着时间回落到平常值的心情、可查看可修改的记忆、表情库、客人能评论的空间动态、闲置搭话、语音条、语音识别与朗读。内置网页服务默认监听 0.0.0.0:2332；对外暴露端口前请先创建主人账号，客人账号只能由主人创建。

description.en: Cross-version session migration for DSH: sweeps legacy session stores (v0 plaintext, .zstd and .zip exports), re-pins the header cwd to the target workspace and drops sessions in so the persistence layer upgrades them on open; settings sidebar with env/import/list/convert tabs plus a CLI (check / fix / import).
description.zh: DSH 会话跨版本迁移：扫描旧版会话目录（v0 明文、.zstd 与 .zip 导出包），改写 header cwd 绑定目标工作区并落盘，打开会话时由持久化层自动完成版本升级；设置侧边栏（环境 / 导入 / 列表 / 转换）加 CLI（check / fix / import）。

description.en: Resident-index grep for DeepSeek Harness that shadows the built-in grep/glob tools under the same names: repeated content searches hit an in-memory index ranked by access/modification frecency, and glob serves the built-in ripgrep semantics when available, falling back to the index otherwise.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻索引 grep，以同名遮蔽内置 grep/glob 工具：重复内容检索命中按访问/修改 frecency 排序的内存索引，glob 在可用时对齐内置 ripgrep 语义、不可用时回退索引。

description.en: Construction data asset inventory plugin — inventories BIM/IFC classification, asset encoding, outputs asset catalog.
description.zh: 建筑工程数据资产盘点插件 — 盘点BIM/IFC分类、资产编码，输出资产清单

description.en: Model-facing `generate_image` tool for text-only models: the model asks for a picture in natural language, Gemini draws it via the Antigravity CLI, the image is saved to a configurable output directory, and the tool returns the file paths for the model to use in its work.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的 `generate_image` 工具：模型用自然语言要一张图，经 Antigravity CLI 让 Gemini 画出，保存到可配置输出目录并返回文件路径，供模型在任务中使用。

description.en: Re-validates Cloudflare Access JWTs at the DSH origin so Settings, Credentials, Agent Preset management, and model discovery work from a remote hostname.
description.zh: 在 DSH Origin 校验 Cloudflare Access JWT，使 Settings、凭据、Agent Preset 管理与模型发现可在远程主机名下使用。

description.en: Archives the sessions of a workspace when its folder is deleted or moved away, or when its registration is removed, and restores them when it returns: unarchives only the sessions it archived itself, re-attaches every member its ledger recorded (including sessions you archived manually, whose archived state is left unchanged), and adopts ungrouped sessions whose working directory is that workspace path.
description.zh: 工作区文件夹被删除或移走、或工作区登记被移除时，自动归档其会话；目录或登记回归时恢复：只取消归档本插件归档过的会话，把台账记过的全部成员挂回分组（含你手动归档的会话，且不改其归档状态），并把「无项目」里工作目录正是该工作区路径的会话归位。

description.en: Dormant-by-default MCP for dsh: one mcp_summon tool; summoning a server registers its tools as real native mcp__<server>__<tool> tools for the rest of the session, and release unregisters them and stops the process.
description.zh: 休眠式 MCP：只注册一个 mcp_summon 工具，召唤后该服务器的工具在本次会话内以原生 mcp__<server>__<tool> 名称注册，释放即注销并停止进程。

description.en: Education toolkit for DSH agents: lesson-plan skeletons by grade band, quiz scaffolding and answer-key validation, analytic rubrics, Anki/markdown flashcards, and readability levels.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供教育工具包：按学段的教案骨架、测验题与答案校验、分析式评分量规、Anki/markdown 闪卡与可读性分级。

description.en: Web chat entry for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar button opening chat.deepseek.com in a dedicated desktop window under dsh-desktop, with in-webview fallback for plain web environments.
description.zh: 网页对话入口插件：侧边栏一键打开 chat.deepseek.com 独立窗口（dsh-desktop 桥接），纯网页环境自动回退内嵌打开。

description.en: Restarts the DSH desktop host on macOS when a change needs it, then hands the conversation back to the same session with a note the model writes about why it restarted and what comes next.
description.zh: 改动需要重启时自动重启 DSH 桌面宿主（仅 macOS），重启后把模型写的交接话（为什么重启、下一步做什么）投回原会话继续。

description.en: Delegate DSH tasks to independent Pi, Qoder and MiniMax Code workers through session-scoped MCP, with persistent sessions and a shared WebUI for results, events, approvals and cancellation. By default the Qoder and MiniMax Code workers run with every tool approval bypassed (change it with HARNESS_SUPERVISOR_QODER_PERMISSION_MODE and HARNESS_SUPERVISOR_MCODE_PERMISSION_MODE); DSH workers default to workspace-write with approval.
description.zh: 通过按会话限定的 MCP，将 DSH 任务委派给独立的 Pi、Qoder 和 MiniMax Code Worker，支持持续会话，并提供查看结果、轨迹、审批和取消任务的共用 WebUI。默认情况下 Qoder 和 MiniMax Code 的 Worker 会绕过所有工具审批（用 HARNESS_SUPERVISOR_QODER_PERMISSION_MODE 和 HARNESS_SUPERVISOR_MCODE_PERMISSION_MODE 修改）；DSH Worker 默认是 workspace-write 加审批。

description.en: Multiple named launch targets in the DSH composer: left-click starts the default target, right-click opens the list.
description.zh: 对话输入框的多启动项按钮：左键启动默认项，右键弹出列表，每项可绑定一个程序或目录。

description.en: Decodo Web Data API as the fetch provider behind the built-in web_fetch tool: returns Markdown by default, pins fetchProvider to decodo, and enforces a configurable per-process fetch cap. Requires a Decodo API key; web_search is unchanged.
description.zh: 把内置 web_fetch 工具的抓取后端换成 Decodo Web Data API：默认返回 Markdown，并把 fetchProvider 固定为 decodo，可配置单进程抓取上限；需要 Decodo API Key，web_search 不受影响。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness tools and a Skill for md-report/1: validate and render Markdown plus declared SQLite/CSV datasets into one offline interactive HTML report or dashboard, with AntV G2 charts (ECharts fallback) and chart/table data and source-SQL views.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 md-report/1 报告的校验与渲染工具：把 Markdown 与声明的 SQLite/CSV 数据集生成单个离线可交互 HTML 报告或仪表盘，图表默认用 AntV G2、复杂图表回退 ECharts，并提供图表/数据/SQL 与数据表/数据/SQL 视图。

description.en: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the app, and inline app rendering in ordinary chats.
description.zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

description.en: Agent-managed procedural memory: a skill_manage tool that creates, patches, disables and deletes the agent's own skills in user or project scope, with delete guards (agent-created marker, pin, path confinement) and a trigger-discipline prompt.
description.zh: 代理自管的程序性记忆：skill_manage 工具可创建、修补、禁用、删除 agent 自己的技能（用户级/项目级双作用域），带删除守卫（agent 创建标记、pin、路径限制）与触发纪律提示。

description.en: Opens a folder in DeepSeek Harness from the OS: a Windows Explorer context-menu verb, a macOS Finder Quick Action and QSpace service, and the dsh-open launcher that starts or hands off to the desktop app. The OS menu entries need a one-time registration script (install-menu.ps1 on Windows, install-macos.sh on macOS) after installing the plugin.
description.zh: 从系统里用 DeepSeek Harness 打开文件夹：Windows 资源管理器右键动词、macOS Finder 快速操作与 QSpace 服务，以及负责启动或交接桌面端的 dsh-open 启动器。系统菜单需在安装插件后运行一次注册脚本（Windows 用 install-menu.ps1，macOS 用 install-macos.sh）才会出现。

description.en: Sidebar unread / waiting / status hub for DSH Web: a bell jumps to the next unread session, a shortcut walks sessions waiting for input, and ⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. step back and forward through the conversations you have visited; one overlay lists unread and pending sessions side by side; a six-metric readout at the sidebar foot makes every icon a button that jumps to the next session of that kind; a host-side ledger keeps the account across restarts, so an unread session keeps its green row dot after a restart, and a startup dialog offers to re-send a continue message to sessions whose turn was cut off.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏的未读、待办与状态读数中枢：铃铛按顺序定位未读会话，快捷键依次走到正在等你输入的会话，⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. 在访问过的对话之间前后切换；另有总览把未读与待决策会话分两区铺开；底部一行六项会话状态读数，每个图标都能点，点了跳到下一个同类会话；账本落在 host 半边，重启也不丢——未读会话重启后仍然显示行内绿色小标，启动时还会把上次被切断的会话列成清单，一键重发续跑消息。

description.en: Splits a session into turns and incrementally clusters them into named topics and stages, with per-topic token / tool / time stats, a workflow view, a turn timeline, a relation graph and per-turn AI analysis.
description.zh: 把会话按轮次聚合成话题与阶段，按话题统计 token / 工具 / 耗时，提供工作流、时间线、关系图谱三种视图和单轮 AI 分析。

description.en: Turn a raw recording into a published podcast with a local ffmpeg — detect chapter boundaries from silence, cut at those boundaries, normalise loudness to a broadcast target in two passes, and write an iTunes-compatible RSS feed whose enclosure byte lengths are measured from disk.
description.zh: 用本机 ffmpeg 把一期录音做成可发布的播客 —— 从静音里检出章节断点、按断点切段、两遍算法把响度归一化到广播目标，并写出 iTunes 兼容的 RSS（enclosure 字节长度实测自磁盘，避免客户端静默丢弃）。

description.en: Import Claude Code sessions, skills and plugin assets into DSH as native resumable sessions, and export or sync DSH sessions back to Claude Code JSONL.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 会话、技能与插件资产导入为 DSH 原生可续聊会话，并支持将 DSH 会话导出或同步回 Claude Code JSONL。

description.en: Layered file memory for DeepSeek Harness with workspace-scoped USER/MEMORY notes, background consolidation, and hybrid session recall.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分层文件记忆，提供工作区隔离的 USER/MEMORY 笔记、后台沉淀与混合会话召回。

description.en: A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。

description.en: Adds a per-session notebook with autosave, a draggable key-information panel with collapsible items and queue injection, notebook and key-information inheritance for native and /fork forks, workspace-scoped session groups, session highlighting, running-workspace prioritization with a blue spinner, and close-current/left/right/all actions on every right-sidebar tab.
description.zh: 为每个会话增加自动保存的笔记本和可拖动关键信息面板，面板支持条目折叠与队列注入；原生分叉和 /fork 会继承笔记本与关键信息；另提供工作区会话组、会话高亮、运行工作区置顶与蓝色转圈指示，以及右侧边栏任意标签的关闭当前/左侧/右侧/全部操作。

description.en: Deterministic AST code graph and architecture intelligence tool for call hierarchies, blast radius, circular dependencies, domain slices, and full-stack API contracts.
description.zh: 确定性 AST 代码图谱与架构治理分析工具：调用链消歧、重构爆炸半径、循环依赖审计、领域切片与全栈 API 契约追踪。

description.en: Runtime workarounds for host defects while upstream fixes land: coalesce repeated session/follow rebuilds, reconnect a terminal view whose output stalled, keep the session stream alive when a proxy idles it out, cap job/list subscriptions, recover a session stuck on load, trim the session-list projection on the host and shrink the first-screen history window. Each feature has its own switch; when the host structure does not match, that feature is skipped, logging the reason or degrading silently.
description.zh: 官方修复落地前的宿主缺陷兜底:合并 session/follow 重复重建、终端输出停滞自愈、会话流空闲保活、任务状态流条数上限、会话加载停滞自愈、宿主侧会话列表投影瘦身、首屏历史窗口收敛。每项独立开关,宿主结构不匹配时该项跳过,记录原因或静默降级,不影响页面与其它补丁。

description.en: Discovers rule files from every convention OMP supports and injects them into the system prompt as an always-apply layer plus a rulebook index, then enforces them with time-traveling stream rules that abort violating output mid-turn, deny a matching tool call, fold a reminder into that call's result, or ask a judge model about the finished reply. The same tool lets the model write new rules, and an audit panel on the Plugins page says why each rule is in force.
description.zh: 从 OMP 支持的每一种约定中发现规则文件,以 always-apply 层加规则索引注入系统提示词,并用时间旅行流规则强制执行——在模型输出中途打断违规内容、拦下会违规的工具调用、把提醒折进该调用的结果,或在回复完成后交由裁判模型判断。同一个工具也让模型能写入新规则;Plugins 页的审计面板会说明每条规则为何生效。

description.en: Recovers a DeepSeek Harness turn that ended with reasoning only, with no text and no tool call, by steering the same turn one more step. Structure-only detection, so it costs no extra model call.
description.zh: 识别「整轮只有思考、既无正文也无工具调用」的空回合，让同一轮再走一步；纯结构判定，不额外调用模型。

description.en: Title-bar balance badge for DeepSeek Harness: account balance, today's cost, session tokens, and peak/off-peak pricing awareness (Beijing-time weekday windows) with flat-rate support for custom providers like TokenBom.
description.zh: 标题栏余额徽章：余额、今日花费、本会话 tokens 一目了然，官方按峰谷时段计价展示，TokenBom 等自定义服务商按平价展示。

description.en: Plugin updater for DeepSeek Harness that delegates every version decision to the dsh CLI, so the pnpm release-age policy still decides what is eligible; it snapshots before applying, can roll back, keeps a lock list, and can check or auto-apply on a schedule the user turns on.
description.zh: DSH 插件更新器：把版本决策交给 dsh CLI，继续受 pnpm 发布年龄策略约束；应用前先快照、可回滚、带锁定清单，用户打开开关后可定时检查或自动应用。

description.en: Runtime policy guards that block repeated failing tool calls, oversized shell commands and network commands chained with local ones, composite batch tools (read_batch/edit_batch), a SYSTEM.md mode that replaces the official system-prompt sections with your own file, soft convergence notices, and turn telemetry for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的运行时策略防护（拦截重复失败的工具调用、超长 shell 命令、与本地命令串联的网络命令）、复合批处理工具（read_batch/edit_batch）、用你自己的 SYSTEM.md 替换官方系统提示词各段的模式、软收敛提醒和回合遥测。

description.en: Turns stock names and codes in DSH output text into clickable buttons for quotes and company news.
description.zh: 将 DSH 输出文本中的股票名称和代码转换为可点击按钮，并在侧边栏展示行情与资讯。

description.en: Adds custom icons to the DSH Settings sidebar and exposes a keyed `settings.section.icon` slot for third-party settings sections.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置侧边栏添加自定义图标，并开放 keyed `settings.section.icon` 槽位供第三方设置分区注册图标。

description.en: Select foreign text in a DSH conversation and a Simplified Chinese translation card appears right below the selection.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用鼠标选中外文，选区正下方就地浮出简体中文译文卡片。

description.en: Web composer enhancement: recalls sent prompts across sessions with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, searches them with Ctrl+R, restores rich drafts, and opens a docked /btw or /side conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框增强：跨会话召回已发送提示词、用 Ctrl+R 搜索并还原富草稿，以及提供停靠式 /btw 或 /side 旁路会话。

description.en: API contract studio for DeepSeek Harness: decide the seven things that must be locked before coding, author and review OpenAPI, classify breaking changes by how they actually break clients, and settle error shapes, versioning and deprecation — six playbooks plus a router.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 API 契约工作室：开工前先定七件事、写/审 OpenAPI、按「客户端具体坏在哪」分类破坏性变更，再定错误结构、版本与弃用——六本手册加一个路由。

description.en: Displays generated images in a conversation gallery with a lightbox viewer.
description.zh: 以对话内画廊和灯箱展示生成的图片。

description.en: Wraps globalThis.fetch to route DeepSeek Harness model-API requests through an HTTP/SOCKS proxy by target domain, leaving all other requests on the direct connection, without modifying Harness source.
description.zh: 把 globalThis.fetch 包一层，按目标域名让 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 API 请求走 HTTP/SOCKS 代理、其它请求保持直连，全程不改 Harness 源码。

description.en: Measures what your assembled system prompt is actually made of - rules, identity, workspace policy, tool descriptions - in bytes and percentages, then moves the operating protocol ahead of the rule block so the model reads who it works for before it reads the prohibitions. Config-driven via ~/.dsh/prompt-balance.json; two hooks, no build step, no dependencies.
description.zh: 先按字节与占比量出组装后的系统提示词到底由什么构成——规则、身份、工作区策略、工具描述各占多少，再把操作规程提到规则块之前，让模型先读到「在为难干活」再读到一堆禁令。通过 ~/.dsh/prompt-balance.json 配置；两个钩子、无需构建、无依赖。

description.en: A Settings page for the memo plugin suite in DSH Web: edits the memo Host's AI route, archived-session summary language, length, transcript budget, template and prompt, and repository URL, adds a GitHub intake section for the claim label, per-run issue cap, autopilot switch and its working directory, preset, time zone and dispatch prompt, with per-field reset and saves that reach the running services without a restart, and carries an update entry that checks the npm registry and can install a newer release through the deployment's plugin manager.
description.zh: DSH Web 里的备忘插件套件设置页：修改备忘宿主的 AI 路由、归档会话总结的语言、长度、正文预算、模板与提示词以及仓库地址，另有一栏 GitHub 接单设置——认领标签、每轮 issue 上限、自动驾驶开关及其工作目录、preset、时区与派发提示词——支持逐字段恢复默认，保存后无需重启即作用于运行中的服务，并带一个检查更新入口：查询 npm registry，并可经部署的插件管理器安装新版本。

description.en: Generates DSH host-side plugin skeletons — tool registration, an approval hook, a dsh.bundle manifest and three test layers — and registers a plugin_kit_new tool so the agent can scaffold a plugin from inside DSH without a shell.
description.zh: 一条命令生成 DSH host 侧插件骨架（工具注册 + 审批钩子 + dsh.bundle 清单 + 三层测试），并注册 plugin_kit_new 工具，让 agent 不开 shell 也能在 DSH 里搭骨架。

description.en: City data AI classification plugin — auto-recommends data classification based on GB/T 47949, supports structured/semi-structured/unstructured data.
description.zh: 城市数据AI分类插件 — 基于GB/T 47949自动推荐数据分类，支持结构化/半结构化/非结构化

description.en: Clinical documentation and reference bundle for healthcare professionals: SOAP/APSO progress notes, admission H&P, SBAR/I-PASS handover, discharge summaries, Safe Harbor de-identification, patient-instruction readability, completeness checks, and cited lookups against FDA labels, MedlinePlus, PubMed, and ClinicalTrials.gov. Draft-only with a PHI egress guard; not a medical device.
description.zh: 面向临床人员的文档与参考工具包：SOAP/APSO 病程录、入院 H&P、SBAR/I-PASS 交接班、 出院小结、Safe Harbor 脱敏、患者须知可读性评分、完整性检查，以及来自 FDA 说明书、 MedlinePlus、PubMed 和 ClinicalTrials.gov 的带出处检索。仅起草不决定， 内置 PHI 外发守卫；非医疗器械。

description.en: Let the DSH assistant send local, web, and AI-generated images directly to users in chat, with external vision support for text-only models. On Windows it runs through PowerShell.
description.zh: 让 DSH 助手把本地、网页和 AI 生成的图片直接发到聊天里给用户看，并为文本模型提供识图能力；Windows 下经 PowerShell 运行。

description.en: Registers Kimi, Grok, Codex, and MiniMax as DeepSeek Harness model routes, vendor subagent recipes, and kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch tools.
description.zh: 把 Kimi、Grok、Codex、MiniMax 注册成 DeepSeek Harness 的模型路由、各家子代理配方，以及 kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch 工具。

description.en: Two-way Feishu (Lark) chat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over the official WebSocket long connection: messages route to the bound workspace's latest session and replies return automatically; bot credentials and workspace routing are configurable from the settings page.
description.zh: 基于飞书官方 WebSocket 长连接的 DSH 双向聊天桥：消息路由到所选工作区的最新会话并自动回复，可在设置页切换机器人凭证与工作区。

description.en: Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and guided setup/diagnostic skills, sharing one ~/.memorylake identity and memory set with the Claude Code and Codex plugins.
description.zh: 将 Memory Lake 作为 dsh 的持久记忆层：基于 memorylake CLI 的 memory_search、memory_remember、memory_forget 三个工具，会话状态行，以及引导安装/诊断 skills，与 Claude Code、Codex 插件共享同一 ~/.memorylake 身份与记忆。

description.en: Live CPU, memory and GPU readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a clickable badge with a details panel, per-metric toggles, and three refresh speeds.
description.zh: 在输入框下方的状态栏里实时显示 CPU、内存与 GPU 读数：可点击的徽章、详情面板、逐项开关与三档刷新速度。

description.en: Windows XP (Luna) skin for the DSH web GUI: beige Luna panels, gradient buttons, #7F9DB9 input fields, rounded blue scrollbars and a CSS-drawn Bliss-style desktop, plus a chime when a turn finishes and a different cue when the agent stops for approval.
description.zh: 把 DSH 换成 Windows XP：Luna 蓝皮肤（米色面板、渐变按钮、#7F9DB9 输入框、圆角蓝色滚动条、纯 CSS 绘制的 Bliss 风格桌面），外加一轮跑完时的提示音，以及智能体停下来等你批准时的另一种提示音。

description.en: Sync cc-switch provider balances and track token usage & cost by day/month/total with relay-aware currency settings.
description.zh: 同步 cc-switch 各 provider 余额，按日/月/总量统计 token 用量与花费，支持中转站币种与汇率设置。

description.en: Git Changes tab for the DSH web GUI: staging, diffing, AI-drafted commit messages, branch/merge/stash/worktree operations and sync, with live updates via fs.watch plus a changeToken poll.
description.zh: Git 更改标签页：暂存、对比、AI 起草提交信息、分支/合并/储藏/工作树操作与同步，通过 fs.watch 加 changeToken 轮询实现实时更新。

description.en: Two-way iMessage channel for DeepSeek Harness over Photon: sender allowlisting, session commands, in-chat approvals and questions, and a Settings page for device authorization and hosted-line setup.
description.zh: 通过 Photon 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的双向 iMessage 通道：按发件人白名单路由，支持会话命令、聊天内审批与提问，并提供用于设备授权和托管号码设置的 Settings 页面。

description.en: Game market and runtime for DSH. While the agent runs a long task, a game fills the main workspace and a small whale in the corner shows the agent state (working, waiting for you, done, error); progress is saved and continues next time. Ships five built-in games, a game SDK and CLI, and a community catalog installable from the market.
description.zh: DSH 的游戏市场与运行时。Agent 跑长任务时，游戏铺满主工作区，右下角的小鲸鱼显示 Agent 状态（运行中、等你、完成、出错）；进度自动保存，下次接着玩。内置五款游戏，提供游戏 SDK 与 CLI，并可从市场安装社区游戏。

description.en: Reasoning-effort slider in the model menu for DeepSeek Harness that also appears for providers and models with no declared effort metadata. Based on Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider — uninstall that upstream plugin before installing this one.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型菜单里提供推理等级滑条，未声明推理档位的 provider 与模型同样出现。基于 Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider 改造，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Local long-term memory core for DeepSeek Harness with plain-text notes, a bounded index, five tools, optional host-model consolidation and auditable evidence. It appends every user and assistant message under 32,000 characters to ~/.companion/cold/<date>.jsonl in plain text, with no built-in cleanup, and adds a short index of its notes to every system prompt; the optional model-based consolidation is off by default and, once on, sends those messages to the session's model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地长期记忆内核：明文笔记、限长索引、五个工具、可选的宿主模型整理，并保留可追溯原话。它会把每条不超过 32,000 字符的用户和助手消息以明文追加到 ~/.companion/cold/<日期>.jsonl，没有内置清理，并在每次的系统提示词里加一份笔记索引；基于模型的整理默认关闭，打开后会把这些消息发给当前会话的模型。

description.en: Manages Git worktrees in DeepSeek Harness with branch deletion controls and scoped workspace management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理 Git Worktree，提供分支删除控制和指定工作区管理。

description.en: Automated data masking tool based on national standards, automatically identifying sensitive fields like ID cards and phone numbers.
description.zh: 基于国家标准的自动化数据脱敏工具，自动识别身份证、手机号等敏感字段，支持完全匿名化与假名化分级策略，生成合规审计日志。

description.en: Underground pipeline data quality inspection plugin — checks coverage, edge matching, flow direction, outputs quality score. Default rules follow Chinese standards and a Guangdong guideline (accepted SRIDs: CGCS2000 and 3° zones 38–40; gross-error threshold 5%); override via config JSON.
description.zh: 地下管线数据质量检查插件 — 检测覆盖率、接边精度、流向合理性，输出质量评分。默认规则取自国标与广东省导则（坐标系仅认 CGCS2000 及三度带 38–40 带，粗差率阈值 5%），可用配置 JSON 覆盖。

description.en: Windows one-click launcher with a borderless WPF startup animation (stroke-by-stroke HARNESS lettering) that starts dsh web in the background and fades into the GUI once ready, plus a desktop_launch tool.
description.zh: Windows 一键启动器：无边框 WPF 启动动画（HARNESS 逐笔描边），后台拉起 dsh web 并在 GUI 就绪后淡入，附 desktop_launch 工具。

description.en: Translation toolkit for DSH agents: sentence segmentation, term and glossary extraction, source-target QA (numbers, units, brackets), tone guides, and a durable workspace translation memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供翻译工具包：句子分块、术语与术语表提取、译文质检（数字、单位、括号）、语气指南与工作区持久化翻译记忆。

description.en: Applies structured unified diffs (git format) to the real filesystem: multi-file/hunk parsing, fuzzy hunk location with line-offset correction, all-or-nothing application with typed conflict reports, reverse-patch undo journal and dry-run - four patch_* dsh tools plus a CLI.
description.zh: 将结构化 unified diff（git 格式）应用到真实文件系统：多文件/多 hunk 解析、带行号偏移修正的模糊定位、全有或全无的应用与类型化冲突报告、反向补丁撤销日记及 dry-run——4 个 patch_* dsh 工具外加一个 CLI。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against CursorTouch/Windows-MCP, excluding PowerShell, FileSystem, Registry, Process and Scrape by default (16 of the 21 tools upstream 0.8.8 publishes). Requires uv on PATH.
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥接 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP，默认排除 PowerShell、FileSystem、Registry、Process、Scrape（上游 0.8.8 共 21 个工具，保留 16 个）。需要 uv 在 PATH 上。

description.en: Data quality scoring plugin — multi-dimensional scoring (completeness/accuracy/consistency/timeliness).
description.zh: 数据质量打分插件 — 多维度评分（完整性/准确性/一致性/时效性）

description.en: Counts completed compactions per session in a floating window and warns only after repeated compactions plus extra token spend or high context occupancy, with all three thresholds adjustable in Settings.
description.zh: 统计每段对话成功完成的压缩次数并常驻悬浮窗，只有反复压缩过、且此后又烧掉大量 token 或上下文占用过高时才提醒；三个阈值都可在设置页调整。

description.en: Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API. Channels are entirely user-configured - no bundled endpoint, you bring your own baseURL, key and model name (manual input supported). Agent-initiated generations are approval-gated by default: requests queue in the floating panel and nothing bills until you approve; approval is non-blocking (the agent replies "awaiting your approval" immediately, and results, denials or timeouts are injected back so the agent reports them in the next turn). Floating glass workbench with five tabs (Generate / Approvals / Prompts / History / About), aspect-ratio grid with quality-budget + 16px-alignment sizing, transparent background, batch up to 10 images as aggregated sub-tasks, prompt library with custom JSON sources fetched through a host proxy, persistent generation logs with one-click retry, multi-channel aggregation with per-channel model fetching, bilingual UI (zh/en), stroke-SVG icon set, config import/export. Registers as a Better Sidebar tab when dsh-better-sidebar is installed; stacks above the dsh-cua FAB when both are present.
description.zh: DSH 生图工作台与 Agent 生图工具：一个工具（ark9_generate_image）走任意 OpenAI 兼容图片 API 文生图/图生图。渠道完全由用户自行添加——默认零预置，自带 baseURL、Key 与模型名即可（支持手动输入任意模型名）。Agent 发起的生图默认需用户审批：请求进入浮窗审批页，批准才开始生成并计费；审批非阻塞——Agent 立即回复"等你审批"，结果、拒绝或超时以通知注入后续轮次并自动汇报。玻璃拟态浮窗五页签（生成/审批/提示词/记录/说明）、比例网格（质量预算+16px 对齐）、透明背景、批量最多 10 张（子任务聚合，部分成功也返回）、提示词库（自定义 JSON 来源经宿主代理拉取）、生成记录持久化与一键重试、多渠道聚合与逐渠道拉模型、中英双语界面、线性 SVG 图标、配置导入导出。安装 dsh-better-sidebar 自动注册侧栏页签；与 dsh-cua 共存时自动堆叠其悬浮按钮上方。

description.en: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a top-right card that jumps straight to the replying conversation.
description.zh: 多对话并行的声音提醒 + 对话直达：当前对话当/当当（crisp 清脆档），其他对话叮/叮叮（soft 柔和档）+ 右上角小卡片，点一下直达对应对话。

description.en: Writes the session's estimated cost into the composer token-usage pill, and adds a per-bucket amount plus an estimated total to the usage dialogs, using DeepSeek's official peak and off-peak rates in yuan.
description.zh: 把本次会话的估算费用直接写进输入框上方的 Token 用量胶囊，并在用量弹窗里为每个分项补上金额与预估合计，按 DeepSeek 官方高峰与空闲时段价（人民币）计算。

description.en: Prefixes every session title with the name of its workspace or project, so a flat session list shows which project each conversation belongs to; titles you renamed yourself are left unchanged.
description.zh: 给每条会话标题加上所属项目名前缀，会话列表平铺展示时不必点开就能看出它属于哪个项目；你自己手动改过的标题保持原样。

description.en: Search AIGC Radar's curated GitHub AI project library (500-star admission, bilingual zh/en tags, star-growth snapshots) over its MCP endpoint with native result cards; an agent/pre-step listener proactively suggests a reuse check before the agent writes code.
description.zh: 检索 AIGC Radar 精选 GitHub AI 项目库（500 Stars 准入、中英双语标签、星标增长快照），经其 MCP 端点调用并以原生结果卡片展示；agent/pre-step 监听器在 agent 动手写代码前主动建议复用检查。

description.en: Run DSH sessions on the local Claude Code (Opus, Sonnet), with Galatea's memory and tools. Pick an auth mode in the profile (Anthropic API key recommended, or your existing Claude Code login). Requires the Galatea framework.
description.zh: 让 DSH 会话跑在本机 Claude Code 上（Opus、Sonnet），带着 Galatea 的记忆和工具；需在 profile 里选登录方式（推荐 Anthropic API key，或沿用本机 Claude Code 已有登录）。需要先装 Galatea 框架。

description.en: Drag-reorders the dsh sidebar panel entries and the conversation view tabs, and moves an entry between the sidebar and the tab strip as a real tab; order and moves are saved locally and survive restarts.
description.zh: 拖拽重排 dsh 左侧栏的插件面板条目与会话顶部标签，并能把条目在侧栏与标签区之间搬移（搬过去是真实标签）；顺序与搬移状态存本机，重启后保留。

description.en: Turn your recurring one-liners into capsules above the composer. They reorder themselves by how often you use them, and ask you to fill in {{placeholder}} values before the snippet lands in the draft. Clicking appends rather than replaces, so a half-written draft survives. A drawer adds search, grouping and editing, and everything lives in a Host-side JSON file you can edit by hand.
description.zh: 把每次都得重打的那几句话做成输入框上方的胶囊。它们按使用次数自动重排，带 {{占位符}} 的会先弹框让你填，填完才插入草稿。点击是追加而不是替换，写到一半的草稿不会被冲掉。抽屉里可以搜索、分组、编辑，数据存在 Host 侧 JSON 文件里，可以直接手改。

description.en: Windows XP Luna desktop for the DSH Web UI: a floating window manager with taskbar and desktop icons, plus the era-accurate Luna skin.
description.zh: Windows XP Luna 桌面化主题：浮动窗口管理器（任务栏、桌面图标）加上还原度很高的 Luna 皮肤。

description.en: Six-player no-limit Texas Hold'em for the dsh Web GUI. One human plays against five LLM agents that each see only their own hole cards. Adds a dedicated tab plus a draggable mini-window over the conversation area, per-browser sessions with CSRF protection, pot-relative raise sizing, three rebuys before elimination, and showdown reveals with board-card deal animations.
description.zh: 六人无限注德州扑克：1 名玩家对 5 位只能看到自己底牌的 LLM 智能体。在 Web GUI 中提供独立 Tab 与会话区可拖拽悬浮小窗，支持按浏览器隔离的牌局与 CSRF 防护、按底池倍数给出的加注尺度、每人 3 次买入后出局，以及摊牌亮牌与公共牌翻牌动效。

description.en: A slim port of Headroom: compresses tool output, cuts up to 20% of context, without affecting the model's context cache or agent performance.
description.zh: Headroom 的精简移植，在不影响模型上下文缓存以及 Agent 性能的情况下，压缩工具的输出，至多减少 20% 的上下文。

description.en: Syncs the DSH home directory and Mnemon memory data through a git remote: pull, push, sync on an interval, cross-device migration, initialization backups, and conflict detection that stops before pushing and keeps local commits. A panel lists up to 100 recent operations with their backup paths.
description.zh: 通过一个 git 远端同步 DSH 主目录与 Mnemon 记忆数据：拉取、推送、按间隔自动同步、跨设备迁移、初始化备份，遇冲突在推送前停下并保留本地提交；面板记录最近 100 次操作各自的备份路径。

description.en: Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks blocked-versus-converted metrics.
description.zh: 实证门——按会话将第一手结论与持久工具活动索引交叉核验、拦截未验证猜测并以台账统计拦截与转化，中英双语界面。

description.en: Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.
description.zh: 给 dsh web 铺上 DeepSeek Harness 首页同款背景：WebGL 流体光效、点线网格与数字点云鲸鱼，深色/亮色两套配色。

description.en: Drag a session onto another workspace in the DSH sidebar and it really moves: the session-log header cwd is rewritten and the log directory is re-homed under the target project, with a progress bar while it runs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏把会话拖到别的工作区，归属真的会变：改写会话日志 header 的 cwd 并把日志目录迁到目标项目下，迁移过程中显示进度条。

description.en: Permanently deletes a conversation, optionally together with the documents and attachments it created.
description.zh: 彻底删除对话，可选择同时删除该对话创建的文档与附件。

description.en: A /remember command that writes facts into the AGENTS.md instruction hierarchy dsh already loads, plus a Memory tab showing which instructions the loader kept within its byte budget.
description.zh: /remember 命令将事实写入 dsh 已加载的 AGENTS.md 指令层级，并配有 Memory 标签页，显示加载器在字节预算内实际保留了哪些指令。

description.en: macOS only: holds a PreventUserIdleSystemSleep assertion (caffeinate -i -w <host pid>) while any DSH session runs, and releases it when the last one stops, so a long turn is not cut off by idle sleep. The display may still turn off. It keeps holding through the maintenance phase, where Agent.status reports idle and a long manual /compact runs, via the compaction/start and compaction/end events. It reconciles against ctx.agents.list() every 60s, so a session already running when the plugin is hot-reloaded is picked up at once instead of at the next turn boundary. A failed hold retries with exponential backoff capped at 60s and never gives up; release escalates from SIGTERM to SIGKILL after 2s, and -w lets caffeinate exit by itself if the host dies. No browser half — configured through the profile patch. 51 tests, including two that read pmset -g assertions on real hardware.
description.zh: 仅 macOS：任意 DSH 会话运行期间持有 PreventUserIdleSystemSleep 断言（caffeinate -i -w <宿主 pid>），最后一个会话结束后释放，长时间回合不会因空闲休眠被切断；屏幕仍可正常息屏。它会一直持有跨过 maintenance 阶段——该阶段 Agent.status 报 idle 而手动 /compact 正在跑，靠 compaction/start 与 compaction/end 事件兜住。每 60 秒与 ctx.agents.list() 对账，插件热重载时已在运行的会话立即被接管，不必等到下一个回合边界。持有失败按指数退避重试、上限 60 秒且永不放弃；释放时先 SIGTERM，2 秒未退出升级 SIGKILL；带 -w，宿主崩溃时 caffeinate 自行退出。无前端半身，通过 profile patch 配置。共 51 个测试，其中 2 个在真机上直接读 pmset -g assertions。

description.en: Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL connection layer.
description.zh: 自然语言查询 + 商业智能报表：Text2SQL、图表、报表收藏、Schema/数据面板与侧栏工作台，基于 DSH 的 MySQL 连接层。

description.en: Let Codex dispatch tasks to DeepSeek Harness workspaces, follow execution, read results, and continue collaboration through a local bridge and companion Codex skill.
description.zh: 通过本机桥接插件与配套 Codex 技能，让 Codex 向 DeepSeek Harness 工作区派发任务、跟踪执行、回读结果并继续协作。

description.en: One-click upgrade to Deepseek Harness, with version number displayed in the sidebar.
description.zh: 一键升级Deepseek Harness, 支持侧边栏显示版本号.

description.en: Removes the DeepSeek Harness logo, brand name, version string, and the conversation hero fish from the sidebar.
description.zh: 移除侧边栏里的 DeepSeek Harness 标志、品牌名、版本号，以及对话页的主视觉小鱼。

description.en: Auto-adjust model reasoning effort per task (off/low/high/max): task classification, \[effort=...] markers, in-turn error escalation, DeepSeek peak-pricing-period capping with countdown notices, and manual-selection priority.
description.zh: 根据任务自动调整模型推理档位（off/low/high/max）：任务分类判定、\[effort=...] 显式标记、轮内出错升级、DeepSeek 高峰计价时段自动限档省钱并显示切换倒计时、GUI 手动选择优先。

description.en: During long agent thinking, posts a hot-news or reminder message directly into the conversation stream.
description.zh: agent 思考超时时，直接在对话流中推出一条今日头条热点或提醒消息。

description.en: Migrate Codex (OpenAI Codex CLI / Desktop) MCP servers, skills, instructions, memory and session history into DeepSeek Harness with a visual panel or CLI, with dry-run previews and secrets migrated as-is.
description.zh: 把 Codex（OpenAI Codex CLI / Desktop）的 MCP 服务器、技能、全局指令、记忆与会话历史迁移进 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），支持可视化面板与命令行，带 dry-run 预览。

description.en: A plugin for dsh: once ask_user_question times out, the content you entered will remain in the UI or model context.
description.zh: dsh提问超时保护插件: 一旦模型提问超时,将你的回答草稿保留在UI或上下文中,而不是直接丢弃。

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription usage beside the composer: the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows each as a small ring with the used percentage (amber at 70%, red at 90%). Clicking the meter opens a detail card with per-window progress bars, reset countdowns and a refresh button, and when it is not clicked nothing floats over the conversation. The API key stays in the Host process and never reaches the browser.
description.zh: 在输入框旁边常驻显示 OpenCode Go 套餐用量：5 小时滚动、每周、每月三个窗口各一个圆环与已用百分比（70% 变黄、90% 变红）；点击整条弹出详情卡，含每个窗口的额度进度条、重置倒计时与刷新按钮，不点击时不会在对话上悬浮任何东西。API Key 只留在 Host 进程里，不进入浏览器。

description.en: (UI enhancement) Frosted-glass background for the whole app: one slider blends from a genuinely blurred, milky frost to a fully transparent page, and every region, control and expanded page moves as a single sheet painted on body::before; the settings page has its own independent slider, and an optional whale particle overlay reacts to the pointer. In a browser the plugin paints its own dark backdrop behind the frost. On the desktop the effect is painted on the app window itself: the dsh Windows window has never been transparent (only macOS gets a vibrancy window), so on Windows the page shows the window background instead of your wallpaper, while macOS keeps the native transparent window. Works on every dsh version (checked up to 0.2.2-alpha.3).
description.zh: （UI 增强）整页磨砂背景：一条滑杆从真实模糊的磨砂过渡到完全透明，所有区域、组件与展开面板作为画在 body::before 上的同一张纸一起变化；设置页有独立滑杆，另有可选的鲸鱼粒子图层，随鼠标推开与拖动。浏览器里插件会自绘一层深色背景垫在磨砂之下。桌面端的效果直接画在应用窗口上：dsh 的 Windows 主窗口历来不透明（只有 macOS 才有 vibrancy 透明窗口），所以 Windows 上看到的是窗口自身的底色而不是你的壁纸，macOS 则仍是原生透明窗口。适用于所有 dsh 版本（已核对到 0.2.2-alpha.3）。

description.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness agent preset that hands implementation work to Codex subagents (auto-approved, workspace-write sandbox); the session agent only splits tasks, dispatches them and reports results. Requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+, the @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex bundle and a locally installed, logged-in Codex CLI.
description.zh: 新增一个 DeepSeek Harness Agent 预设：把实际工作交给 Codex 子代理执行（自动审批、工作区可写），会话主代理只负责拆分任务、委派与汇总结果。需 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+、已装 @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex，且本机已安装并登录 Codex CLI。

description.en: Wakes the main agent after any DSH restart so interrupted work resumes automatically — adds a restart tool and an optional canary that validates the boot and aborts with an alert before a broken restart.
description.zh: DSH 重启后唤醒主 agent，让被打断的工作自动接着做；提供一个重启工具，以及可选的探针在启动异常时提前中止并告警。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness activity as a GitHub-style contribution graph: an account-menu row opens a centred dialog with your avatar and name, a year of daily activity in five shades, a year picker and a tooltip on every day.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的日常活动画成 GitHub 风格的贡献热力图：账号菜单里的入口打开居中弹窗，含头像与用户名、按五档配色的一年活动、年份选择器与逐格 tooltip。

description.en: Sidebar conversation actions: open the row menu on right-click, rename by double-click, copy the session id, and delete a conversation together with its storage after a confirmation.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话操作：右键打开行菜单、双击重命名、复制会话 ID，以及二次确认后连同存储一起删除会话。

description.en: Moves conversation views into the Windows caption row and header utilities into a compact right rail on DSH Desktop with Codex UI, reclaiming a full row of vertical space while preserving the session title, fullscreen control, dynamic status counts and menus.
description.zh: 将会话视图移入 Windows 标题栏、其余顶栏工具压缩进紧凑右轨，在 DSH Desktop 与 Codex UI 中保留会话标题、全屏、动态状态计数与菜单功能，同时省下一整行垂直空间。

description.en: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a locally running Unsloth Desktop (Unsloth Studio) server through unsloth_run and unsloth_vision tools; pure HTTP client, never spawns or owns processes.
description.zh: 把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地运行的 Unsloth Desktop（Unsloth Studio）服务器：unsloth_run 与 unsloth_vision 两个工具，纯 HTTP 客户端，不拉起也不持有任何进程。

description.en: Adds a compact mid-turn steering box above the composer for text, images, and files, with read and pending status, cancel, and unfinished-draft rescue.
description.zh: 在输入框上方增加独立插话栏，支持文字、图片和普通文件，显示读取状态并可在未读取时取消，任务结束时救援未发送草稿。

description.en: Balance and live session usage for the DSH web UI: header balance button (left of the Session log), dropdown with account balance, real-time token breakdown (cache miss/hit, cache write, output), cache hit rate, and official-rate cost estimates with peak/off-peak auto-switch.
description.zh: DSH Web 余额与会话用量插件：头部余额按钮（Session log 左侧），下拉展示账户余额、实时 token 明细（缓存未命中/命中、缓存写入、输出）、缓存命中率，以及按官方峰谷价自动切换的费用估算。

description.en: Adds paragraph-by-paragraph translation and a bilingual view to assistant replies in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: each Chinese paragraph gets an English translation underneath and each English paragraph gets a Chinese one underneath, behind a session-header toggle; code blocks and formulas stay untranslated, and tables get a translated copy underneath. Translations come from the DeepSeek API (the plugin reuses DSH's saved DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, or a key you paste in its settings), so it needs network access and each uncached paragraph is a billable request.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的助手回复加逐段翻译与中英双语对照：中文段落下补英文、英文段落下补中文，会话头部有开关；代码块、公式不翻译，表格会生成一张完整的译文表附在下方。译文由 DeepSeek API 生成（插件复用 DSH 已保存的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，也可在设置里粘贴 Key），需要联网，每段未命中缓存的文本都会产生一次计费请求。

description.en: Sends QQ mail through an OAuth-authorized agently-cli account. Registers the send_qq_email tool with a user-approval step and exposes a ctx.qqEmail service for other DSH plugins.
description.zh: 用已授权的 agently-cli 账号发送 QQ 邮件：注册 send_qq_email 工具（发送前需用户确认），并对外提供 ctx.qqEmail 服务供其他 DSH 插件调用。

description.en: External wake bridge for DSH sessions: an out-of-host watcher posts an event to a loopback endpoint, and a failed delivery records nothing so the caller can retry with the same event_id.
description.zh: DSH 会话的外部唤醒桥：宿主外的 watcher 向本地端点投递事件；投递失败不记账，调用方可用同一个 event_id 重试。

description.en: Docker-isolated real-host lifecycle tests for DSH plugins across install, boot, tool registration, update, uninstall, reinstall, and recovery, with structured evidence.
description.zh: 在 Docker 隔离的真实宿主中测试 DSH 插件的安装、启动、工具注册、更新、卸载、重装与恢复生命周期，并输出结构化证据。

description.en: What's up - a zero-maintenance status board for your sessions. Scans every conversation on the host, extracts a goal + one-line status per session (multi-provider LLM, fingerprint-cached), surfaces half-done, unanswered and recent work in a sidebar panel, and jumps you back into any session with one click.
description.zh: What's up · 在忙啥——零维护的会话动态看板:host 端扫描全部会话,为每个会话提取「目标 + 一句话现状」(多 provider LLM、按指纹缓存),自动发现做到一半、问了没回、近期在推进的事,点卡片一键跳回会话。

description.en: Browser tab status indicator for dsh web: paints the document favicon from the session list (blue spinning while work runs, amber while waiting on the user, green when finished).
description.zh: 为 dsh web 绘制浏览器页签状态指示：根据会话列表把 favicon 画成状态圆环（执行中蓝色旋转、等待用户琥珀色、完成绿色）。

description.en: A Discourse forum management and AI Agent plugin designed for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness 而设计的 Discourse 论坛管理和 AI Agent 插件。

description.en: Indexes workspace symbols with Tree-sitter and provides lexical or optional embedding-assisted code search.
description.zh: 用 Tree-sitter 建立工作区符号索引，提供词法或可选 embedding 辅助的代码检索。

description.en: Turn a GitHub repository's raw counts into a defensible judgement — contributor concentration and bus factor with single-author files, merge time reported as a median beside the mean so an outlier is visible rather than hidden, and an issue backlog with pull requests and drafts filtered out. Reads the public REST API with no SDK, and never claims a truncated page is the whole answer.
description.zh: 把 GitHub 仓库的原始计数变成一句能站住的判断 —— 贡献者集中度与 bus factor（附单作者文件）、合并时长中位数与均值并列（让离群值可见而不是被隐藏）、以及排掉 PR 与 draft 之后的 issue backlog。只用公开 REST API、不装 SDK，分页被截断时明确说明而非伪装完整。

description.en: Phone and remote access to the DSH Web UI: scan a LAN QR code, or reach your PC from anywhere through a self-hosted relay server you run yourself instead of a cloudflared tunnel. Per-device credentials that pair, list, and revoke individually, and several PCs sharing one relay with automatic failover.
description.zh: 手机与远程访问 DSH Web 界面：局域网扫码即用，或用自建 relay 中继服务端（替代 cloudflared 隧道）随时随地连回电脑；每台设备独立凭据，可配对、查看与单独撤销；多台电脑共用一个中继并自动热备。

description.en: Restores the blue shimmering Deep diving turn status row that DSH 0.1.6 and earlier showed at the end of the transcript.
description.zh: 恢复 DSH 0.1.6 及以前在对话流末尾显示的蓝色流光深度求索中回合状态行.

description.en: Redundant branch cleaner: finds branches whose work already landed in the mainline — merged, squash-merged, patch-equivalent after rebase or cherry-pick, upstream-gone, or PR-merged — and deletes them when asked. It only reports by default, never switches branches or rebases, and backs every deleted local branch up under refs/backup/branch-cleaner/ (deleting remote branches has no backup).
