description.zh: 冗余分支清理：找出已经落地到主线的分支（普通合并 / squash 合并 / rebase 或 cherry-pick 落地 / 上游已删除 / PR 已合并），确认后再删除。默认只报告，不切换分支、不 rebase，删除前把每个本地分支备份到 refs/backup/branch-cleaner/（删除远端分支不备份）。

description.en: A row of quick-phrase buttons in the DSH composer: one click sends "please continue" or any saved phrase, so a stalled agent keeps working without touching your draft.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框底栏放一排可自定义的快捷语按钮：点一下发送「请继续」等快捷语，把卡住的 agent 一键叫醒，且不覆盖你写了一半的草稿。

description.en: Logic-risk review before rewriting: audit the source, decide each fix, generate several drafts in parallel, and export with a per-draft audit report. Bring your own OpenAI-compatible API endpoint and key - the plugin ships no model and returns 403 until one is configured.
description.zh: 改写前先做逻辑体检：审原文风险、逐条裁决，再并行出多稿，每稿附六维审核报告。需要自备 OpenAI 兼容的接口地址与 API Key——插件不内置模型，未配置时生成类接口返回 403。

description.en: The complete #dsh-plugin mall inside DeepSeek Harness: browse, search and score the full GitHub dsh-plugin topic catalog refreshed every 2 hours, AI pre-install review with install/caution/avoid verdicts, five-dimension scores with radar charts, nine-language UI, editor picks and personalized recommendations, one-click install/update/rollback with a global task panel, and an in-agent /dsh-mall skill.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内完整的插件商场：每 2 小时刷新 GitHub #dsh-plugin 全量目录，支持浏览、搜索与评分；AI 装前审查给出装/谨慎/别装结论，五维评分雷达图，九语言界面，编辑精选与个性化推荐，一键安装/更新/回退及全局任务面板，并内置 /dsh-mall skill 在会话中发现插件。

description.en: Shell-style Up/Down arrow key message history navigation for DSH Web UI with cross-session persistence and draft restoration. It keeps up to 100 of your past messages as plain text in ~/.dsh/message-history.json, filling it at startup from the session records already under ~/.dsh/sessions, and makes no network requests.
description.zh: 类似于 Shell 的上下方向键历史消息导航，支持草稿暂存恢复与跨会话历史持久化。它把你发过的最近 100 条消息以明文存在 ~/.dsh/message-history.json，启动时从 ~/.dsh/sessions 下已有的会话记录补全，不发任何网络请求。

description.en: Overlay reader for agent output files: Markdown rendering, in-panel PDF, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX text preview and reply-end file chips, with search, outline and position memory.
description.zh: agent 产出文件的浮层阅读器：Markdown 渲染、PDF 面板预览、DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 文本提取与回复末尾文件 chips，支持搜索、大纲与位置记忆。

description.en: Pins a selected passage of a finished user or assistant message as source text and keeps it in the model input across context compaction: each pin is recall-on-demand by default, or can be moved to a neutral resident system-prompt section or an emphasised highlighted one. Selections are aligned back to the source text with source-exact, source-normalized or rendered fidelity, and each of the three levels has its own character budget.
description.zh: 把已定稿的用户或助手消息里划选的一段原文钉住，让它在上下文压缩后仍留在模型输入中：每枚钉子默认按需补回，也可改为 resident（中性常驻系统提示词）或 highlight（强调常驻）。选区会以 source-exact、source-normalized 或 rendered 三级保真对回源文本，三个级别各有独立的字符预算。

description.en: Restart DSH with one /rst command: an external launcher shuts down the current process and starts a new one, then a receipt is written back to the session that issued the restart. Windows 10/11 only (relies on tasklist/taskkill).
description.zh: 用 /rst 一条命令重启 DSH：由进程外启动器关掉当前进程并拉起新的，重启完成后把回执写回你发起重启的那条会话。仅支持 Windows 10/11（依赖 tasklist/taskkill）。

description.en: Kill AI Slop for DSH — score a received document on three weighted axes (expression, execution, decision), audit work-slop with a delivery-obligation ledger, and machine-verify every quote against the source. Reads docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf, txt, md, csv, json and html. Zero runtime dependencies, zero network, fully local.
description.zh: AI垃圾过滤（Kill AI Slop）：给收到的文件打一个可回溯的体检得分（表达／执行／决策三维加权），用交付承接台账审查工作空转，每条引文回原文机器复核；支持 docx/pptx/xlsx/pdf/txt/md/csv/json/html。零运行依赖、零联网、纯本地计算。

description.en: Park whole tool packs out of the session's tool surface and mount them back with one command. Cuts the tool table from 99,789 to 48,144 characters (51.8%) without uninstalling plugins or restarting. Reversible per group, per agent.
description.zh: 把整包工具从会话的工具面上摘掉，要用时一条命令挂回来。工具表从 99,789 字符降到 48,144（51.8%），不用卸载插件、不用重启，按组可逆、按 agent 独立。

description.en: Unofficial upstream bundle for DeepSeek Harness. CodeBuddy gateway with a runtime-synced model catalogue, per-model reasoning efforts, web search/fetch, image generation and a streaming credential bridge, plus TraeWork CN and Qoder CN subscription channels via local translation gateways and a key-type OpenAI-compatible provider registry, all managed from an accordion settings card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的非官方上游插件包：CodeBuddy 网关（模型目录动态同步、逐模型思考强度、联网搜索/抓取、生图、流式凭据桥），TraeWork CN 与 Qoder CN 两条订阅额度通道（本地 OpenAI 翻译网关），以及 key 型 OpenAI 兼容上游注册表，全部收在四区块手风琴设置卡里。

description.en: Surfaces important facts and trade-offs from the current task, with on-demand explanations and optional discussion in the main session.
description.zh: 根据当前任务上下文提醒重要事实和方案取舍，支持展开解释并带入主会话讨论。

description.en: Acceptance-criteria-driven goal completion: locks verifiable criteria, tracks task dependencies, and gates completion behind formal reviewer validation (18 MCP tools).
description.zh: 验收标准驱动的目标完成：锁定可验证的验收标准、跟踪任务依赖，以 reviewer 正式验收作为完成门禁（18 个 MCP 工具）。

description.en: Mem0-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with managed Platform, self-hosted server and local OSS backends; visual settings, automatic recall (from the first turn) and capture, editable memory summary, token budgets and weekly memory hygiene that only deletes memories this plugin wrote. Captured text is redacted; the memory summary is a stable system-prompt section (plugin:dsh-mem0:profile) and recall a separate mem0:recall block appended last, so the cached prompt prefix stays stable; recall and capture have timeouts (recallTimeoutMs, addTimeoutMs). With dsh-strata installed, recall size follows its strataBudget allowance, and the optional captureStrataFolds setting (off by default) also saves its fold summaries as memories.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Mem0 的长期记忆，支持 Platform、自建 Server 和本地 OSS 后端，带可视化设置、自动召回（从第一轮起）与保存、可编辑记忆摘要、Token 预算和每周记忆巡检（只删除本插件写入的记忆）。保存的文本会先脱敏；记忆摘要是稳定的系统提示段（plugin:dsh-mem0:profile），召回是最后追加的独立 mem0:recall 块，不破坏已缓存的提示前缀；召回与保存都有超时（recallTimeoutMs、addTimeoutMs）。安装 dsh-strata 时，召回大小遵循它的 strataBudget 额度；可选设置 captureStrataFolds（默认关闭）还会把它的折叠摘要存为记忆。

description.en: Adds customizable switch shortcut buttons to the left of the DSH Web GUI chat input for one-click slash-command insertion.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 聊天输入框左侧添加可自定义的 switch 快捷按钮，一键插入斜杠命令。

description.en: Session utilities: Markdown export and dependency-free batch ZIP export, a timeline overlay for jumping between turns, safe session duplication that rewrites internal identity fields, and sidebar right-click menu extension points.
description.zh: 会话工具箱：导出 Markdown 与零依赖批量 ZIP、时间线浮层快速跳轮、安全复制会话（自动重写内部身份字段）、侧栏右键菜单扩展。

description.en: Plugin-tree terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown transcript, tool cards, fuzzy slash commands, and live theming, with every component a hot-swappable Cordis plugin.
description.zh: 插件树式终端界面：流式 markdown 会话流、工具卡片、模糊命令补全与主题热切换，每个界面组件都是可热替换的 Cordis 插件。

description.en: Browses checkpoints produced by dsh-checkpoint-rewind as a timeline of time nodes and shows per-file line diffs between any two of them, with trace replay from session logs (no snapshot producer needed) and preview-first workspace rollback with single-shot undo, via /diff and /rollback commands, a JSON HTTP API, and a GUI panel.
description.zh: 把 dsh-checkpoint-rewind 产生的检查点变成时间线时间节点，任意两节点之间逐文件行级 diff；可从会话日志重放 trace 区间差异（无需快照生产者）；支持预览式工作区回滚与一次性撤销。提供 /diff、/rollback 命令、JSON HTTP API 与 GUI 面板。

description.en: File-backed post office between DeepSeek Harness sessions: every letter is sealed with an HMAC and a body digest, recipients are resolved through a roster interface, and delivery is offline-first, so an undeliverable letter waits in the mailbox instead of being lost.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话之间的文件信箱：每封信都用 HMAC 与正文摘要封好，收件人通过名单接口解析，默认离线投递——投不出去的信留在信箱里等人来收，不会丢。

description.en: Per-person affinity for DSH personas on a QQ channel (a QQ bridge such as dsh-onebot-qq is required — the person is identified by the QQ number in each message; on the plain web UI nothing is injected): per-user scores with daily decay, reasons history, sulking and forgiveness, plus a global mood that colors replies.
description.zh: 在 QQ 通道上给 DSH 人设按人记好感度（需先装 QQ 通道插件，如 dsh-onebot-qq；身份取自消息里的 QQ 号，纯 Web 界面下不会注入）：分数、每日衰减、理由回看、生闷气与哄好，外加影响整体语气的综合情绪。

description.en: Renders every file mutation in the web chat as one collapsed diff card with per-line highlighting — MCP filesystem edit_file/write_file and the built-in edit/write.
description.zh: 把网页对话里的每次文件改动渲染成一张折叠的 diff 卡片并逐行高亮，涵盖 MCP filesystem 的 edit_file/write_file 与内置的 edit/write。

description.en: Adds a produced-files card row to the chat and a resizable split-screen preview panel for workspace artifacts (Markdown, source code, CSV, JSON, images, HTML), plus a localhost port preview.
description.zh: 在对话中新增产出文件卡片行，并提供可拖拽分屏的产物预览面板，支持 Markdown、源码、CSV、JSON、图片、HTML，以及本地端口预览。

description.en: Colors each DSH sidebar session title by state: unread (blue while the model is running, green once it has finished) and pinned (yellow, read from DSH's own pinned set), composed into one left-to-right gradient. Pinning, archiving and ordering stay with DSH itself — the plugin reimplements no pinning and rewrites no official bundle — and a settings section lists every unread session.
description.zh: 按状态给 DSH 侧栏会话标题上色：未读（模型运行中＝蓝、已跑完＝绿）与置顶（黄，读取 DSH 官方置顶集合），两者合成一条从左到右的渐变。置顶、归档与排序由 DSH 官方提供，本插件不重复实现置顶、也不改写官方 bundle；另含列出全部未读会话的设置分节。

description.en: Group chat rooms for DSH sessions with explicit @mentions, cold-session wake-up delivery, and optional cross-host transport through dsh-weave.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 会话的群聊室：支持明确 @ 提及、冷会话唤醒投递，并可通过 dsh-weave 跨主机通信。

description.en: Adds a strip of saved prompts above the composer: click a chip to insert its text at the draft caret, and manage the list — add, edit, reorder, delete — in an inline panel that opens in place. Prompts persist per profile and are also exposed to the agent as a quick_prompts tool; a fresh install starts with no entries.
description.zh: 在会话输入框上方维护常用 prompt：点胶囊把内容插入草稿光标处，并可展开内联面板新增、编辑、排序、删除；条目按 profile 持久化，同时以 quick_prompts 工具提供给 agent，初始不预置任何条目。

description.en: AI team with a pixel-art office showing each teammate's status and daily trail. A lead runs project sessions; daily caps per teammate. DSH Desktop, macOS only.
description.zh: 带像素办公室的 AI 团队：显示每位队友当前的状态和当天做过的事。项目会话由负责人安排分工，队友互相 @；队友每天自己开工的次数和 token 有上限。仅支持 macOS 上的 DSH 桌面版。

description.en: Vision for any DSH route: paste images in the Web composer with intent-aware auto-analysis, delegate workspace image reads to a Kimi/MiniMax vision subagent, and materialize pasted originals for editing.
description.zh: 为任意 DSH 路由装上眼睛：Web 输入框贴图按意图自动聚焦分析，视觉子代理代读工作区图片，原图可随时物化编辑。

description.en: Shows per-turn changes in cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, and maximum nesting depth for TypeScript, Python, and Go in the Web UI, with expandable file and function summaries for code review.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中展示每轮任务前后的圈复杂度、认知复杂度和最大嵌套深度变化，支持 TypeScript、Python 和 Go，可展开文件和函数查看详情，帮助确定代码审查重点。

description.en: Chrome-style spell check for the dsh composer: the misspelled word under the caret gets a suggestion strip, and Tab accepts it. Local only — no network, no LLM, no telemetry.
description.zh: 给 dsh 输入框做像 Chrome 那样的拼写检查：光标所在的错词上方出现建议条，按 Tab 直接接受；错词下画蓝色波浪线，右键可看完整候选。完全本机运行，不联网、不调用模型。

description.en: Pixel-art reasoning-effort slider for DSH Web with continuous 0–100 dragging, 16ms throttled writes, snap-to-level commits, and a WebGL ember fire that ignites as the slider moves.
description.zh: 炭灰余烬风格的 DSH Web 像素推理强度滑块：以近黑木炭、暗红裂纹和橙红高温核心呈现 4px 像素化 WebGL 火焰，拖动时逐档点燃；支持 0–100 无极拖动、16ms 节流写入与松手吸附。

description.en: Moves DSH sessions between workspaces with validation of live/subagent/offline states and automatic backups of every move under ~/.dsh/session-move-backups/.
description.zh: 在工作区之间安全移动会话：移动前校验运行中/子代理/离线状态，每次移动自动备份到 ~/.dsh/session-move-backups/。

description.en: Transparent image guard for text-only routes: paste images without the 400 session deadlock, plus a vision_analyze tool for OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/video.
description.zh: 纯文本路由的透明图片护栏：贴图不再 400 卡死会话，附带 vision_analyze 工具（OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/视频）。

description.en: Serves the live opencode Go model catalog from the harness's built-in opencode-go provider route.
description.zh: 让 DSH 自带的 opencode-go 供应商跟随 opencode Go 套餐的实时模型列表，opencode 上架新模型后无需改配置即可使用。

description.en: Provides shared plan, context pickup, and progress update Skills through StateDock Remote MCP without executing tasks or scheduling agents; targets Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 通过 StateDock Remote MCP 提供共享计划、上下文恢复与进度更新 Skills，不执行任务或调度 Agent；适配 Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Review agent file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab or chat turn-tail row — line-level diffs and undo.
description.zh: 把 agent 的文件改动审查放进 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏 Tab 或对话尾部行，支持行级 diff 与撤销。

description.en: Local decision-layer plugin for DSH: a fail-closed command approval gate and ask/gate tools backed by a 144.3M on-device model. Needs a separate local decision service: `pip install phocinae-server`, then download the ~330 MB weights and keep the service running; without it the tool returns `PHOCINAE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.
description.zh: DSH 本地决策层插件：失败关闭的命令审批门，以及由 144.3M 端侧模型支撑的 ask/gate 工具。需另装本地决策服务：`pip install phocinae-server` 后下载约 330MB 权重并常驻运行；服务不在时工具会返回 `PHOCINAE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`。

description.en: A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.
description.zh: Web UI 局域网密码门禁：同网手机/平板输共享密钥登录，会话与电脑实时同步，内置 randomUUID polyfill。

description.en: Run Stata through DeepSeek Harness: the native Stata AI Skill service auto-starts with DSH (macOS/Windows binaries bundled), so you can run regressions, do-files and econometrics workflows with no manual setup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中运行 Stata：Stata AI Skill 原生服务随 DSH 自动启动（内置 macOS/Windows 多平台二进制），无需手动配置即可跑回归、do 文件与计量工作流。

description.en: Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).
description.zh: dsh 规则执行引擎：解析 AGENTS.md、硬拦违反规则的工具调用、文本纠察与审计、/guard 命令、版本化文件守卫、自由区域支持（引擎跳过自由区内容）。

description.en: Closes the gap in batch-searching CNKI (知网) literature with an agent: the academic research preset reads CNKI Space metadata, maps each link to the openable kns.cnki.net record page server-side (no login state and no browser redirect script; full text depends on institutional access), and adds arXiv, PubMed / Europe PMC and Semantic Scholar for English literature; the download-paper skill turns the results into one topic directory with an offline HTML index, XLSX table, BibTeX, RIS and an arXiv batch-download script. Requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+, uv and Node.js. Requires DSH 0.2.x, uv (the CNKI, arXiv and Semantic Scholar MCP servers start through it) and Node.js (PubMed starts via npx).
description.zh: 补齐「用 Agent 批量检索知网文献」这一环：学术研究 preset 从知网空间取题录，在服务端把每条链接换算成可打开的 kns.cnki.net 主站文献页（不需要登录态与浏览器跳转脚本，全文能否打开取决于机构权限），并用 arXiv、PubMed / Europe PMC、Semantic Scholar 覆盖英文文献；download-paper 技能把结果整理成同一专题目录下的离线 HTML 索引、XLSX 总表、BibTeX、RIS 与 arXiv 批量下载脚本。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+、uv 与 Node.js。需要 DSH 0.2.x、uv（CNKI、arXiv、Semantic Scholar 的 MCP 服务通过它启动）和 Node.js（PubMed 通过 npx 启动）。

description.en: Image generation through the Volcano Ark / Doubao Seedream API: ark_generate_image for text-to-image, image-to-image and fixed-seed batches, ark_image_gen_status for checking the key, model and output directory. Requires a Volcano Ark API key (ARK_API_KEY).
description.zh: 火山方舟 / 豆包 Seedream 生图：ark_generate_image 支持文生图、图生图和固定 seed 批量出图，ark_image_gen_status 检查密钥、模型与输出目录。需配置火山方舟 API Key（ARK_API_KEY）。

description.en: Arknights-inspired fan skin for the DSH Web UI featuring Pramanix and Eyjafjalla in a day/night celestial garden.
description.zh: DSH Web 明日方舟同人皮肤“初雪和小羊”，包含昼夜星海庭园背景与双角色布局。

description.en: Beautified archive-manager settings section listing archived sessions grouped by workspace, with a hover unarchive action and relative timestamps.
description.zh: 美化版归档管理设置页：按工作区分组展示归档会话，悬停即可取消归档，附相对时间显示。

description.en: Turn timer for DSH: reports how long the current turn has been running, injects wrap-up prompts on a /set-time schedule so the agent starts finishing instead of running on, and shows run-time cards above the composer.
description.zh: DSH 本轮计时看门狗：读取本轮已运行时长，按 /set-time 排程向模型注入收尾提示词，并在输入框上方显示运行时长卡片。

description.en: Exports the agent loop to GreptimeDB as OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, with seven Grafana dashboards covering token usage, cost, session outcomes and per-turn latency.
description.zh: 把 agent loop 以 OpenTelemetry traces、metrics、logs 导出到 GreptimeDB，附七个 Grafana dashboard，覆盖 token 用量、成本、会话结果和每轮耗时。

description.en: Adds Windows desktop notifications, optional sounds, and DSH-styled in-page notifications for task events.
description.zh: 为任务事件提供 Windows 桌面通知、可选提示音和 DSH 风格的页面通知。

description.en: Keep this session working until a wall-clock deadline: one button in the composer picks 22:30, +90m, or tomorrow 07:00, and after every finished turn the plugin posts one continuation message so the session keeps working; nothing is posted once the deadline passes. Stops early on a round cap (400), three consecutive failed turns, or four consecutive rounds that called no tool; a manual stop button is always there. The last part of the watch switches to wrap-up wording, sized to at most half the remaining time so a short watch is not entirely wrap-up. Armings persist to $DSH_HOME/nightwatch.json via an atomic write and are re-adopted after a restart. No slash command is registered by default (enableCommand turns one on); the continuation message carries source.kind cordis-host-runner, not user.
description.zh: 把这个会话一直续跑到指定钟点：输入框里一颗按钮选 22:30、+90m 或明天 07:00，之后每轮答完插件补一句继续，让你去睡觉时它接着干；到点之后不再发任何消息。另有三道提前收手的闸——轮次上限 400、连续 3 轮出错、连续 4 轮一个工具都没调；随时可以手动停。快到点时切成收尾语气，窗口最多为剩余时间的一半，免得短守夜整段都在收尾。守夜记录以原子写落到 $DSH_HOME/nightwatch.json，重启后自动认领。默认不注册任何 slash 指令（enableCommand 可开）；补的那句话 source.kind 是 cordis-host-runner 而不是 user。

description.en: Reimplements the shut-down BSide: Olivia Lin letter API on loopback so the game client keeps sending and receiving letters: every incoming letter is delivered to one persistent DSH agent session, and the reply is written back to the local letter store.
description.zh: 在回环地址上复现已关停的《BSide: Olivia Lin》信件 API，让游戏客户端照常收发信件：每封来信投进同一个持久 DSH agent 会话，回信写回本地信件库。

description.en: Runs AItelier pipelines from DSH over MCP: 39 tools (22 read, 17 write) to generate, run, inspect, edit, export and import multi-step SkillFlow pipelines. The steps execute in AItelier rather than in the DSH session and are polled by run_id, pause at engine-enforced checkpoints answered with answer_checkpoint, and leave per-step traces and step outputs to read afterwards; add_provider / map_model / edit_role point an individual role at a local or cheaper endpoint. Bundles an aitelier-pipelines skill.
description.zh: 从 DSH 经 MCP 运行 AItelier 流水线：39 个工具（22 读、17 写），用于生成、运行、查看、编辑、导出与导入多步 SkillFlow 流水线。步骤在 AItelier 中执行而不占用 DSH 会话，按 run_id 轮询，在引擎强制的检查点暂停并由 answer_checkpoint 应答，事后可读取逐步 trace 与各步输出；add_provider / map_model / edit_role 可把单个角色指向本地或更便宜的端点。随包附带 aitelier-pipelines skill。

description.en: Sidebar token gauge for DeepSeek Harness: live output-speed dial, current-session and today token totals, estimated spend from DeepSeek list prices with half price off-peak, and a 70-100% cache-hit dial, with single- and dual-gauge layouts and four skins.
description.zh: 侧边栏 Token 仪表盘：实时输出速度表、当前会话与今日 Token 用量、按 DeepSeek 列表价（峰谷半价）估算的费用，以及 70–100% 缓存命中率表盘，支持单表/双表两种布局与四种皮肤。

description.en: Lists every DSH workspace and its conversations on a settings page with checkboxes, and deletes the checked conversations or whole workspaces together with their session logs, projection caches and workspace registrations.
description.zh: 在设置页列出所有工作区及其对话，勾选后按勾选内容删除对话或整个工作区，并一并清理对应的会话日志、投影缓存与工作区注册。

description.en: Delivery panel in the DSH sidebar: indexes every image and file sent to the harness (content-addressed attachments plus @-mentioned local paths), rebuilds Taildrop send history per target device from tailscale file cp calls in the session logs, lists incoming files (the Tailscale inbox plus unmarked files in ~/Downloads), and sends new files to a device from the panel with online status and upload progress.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的投送面板：索引所有发给 Harness 的图片与文件（内容寻址附件 + @ 引用过的本机路径），从会话日志里的 tailscale file cp 调用按目标设备还原 Taildrop 投送历史，列出收到的文件（Tailscale 收件箱 + ~/Downloads 里没有下载标记的文件），并能在面板里直接选设备发文件（显示在线状态与上传进度）。

description.en: Usage statistics settings page computed locally from session logs: 30-day daily list, per-model and per-session tables with provider-aware pricing (DeepSeek peak/off-peak, bundled TokenBom flat rates); skips inherited events of forked subagent sessions to avoid double-counting.
description.zh: 用量统计设置页：全部基于本地会话日志计算（近 30 天条形图 / 模型表 / 会话表），按服务商感知计价（官方峰谷、内置 TokenBom 平价表），并跳过子代理会话继承的历史事件避免重复计费。

description.en: Resident search index living in the host process: hot_find (fuzzy filename and path match, with frecency and git status), hot_fuzzy (content search that tolerates typos, including in Chinese), hot_grep (literal and regex content search), hot_plan (groups hits per file so a batch of files can be read in order) and hot_stats. One in-memory line index is built once and rebuilt on demand, so a query does not spawn a process.
description.zh: 活在宿主进程里的常驻检索索引：hot_find（文件名与路径模糊匹配，带 frecency 与 git 状态）、hot_fuzzy（内容检索，中文错字也能命中）、hot_grep（字面与正则内容检索）、hot_plan（按文件聚合命中，便于排批量阅读顺序）与 hot_stats。一份内存行索引只建一次、按需重建，单次查询不启动进程。

description.en: While vibe coding, save an answer you may need later, use Side Chat for a question that suddenly comes up, or open a related conversation for deeper work without losing focus on the current task.
description.zh: Vibe Coding 时，如果突然想到另一个问题，或者看到一段以后还会用到的回答，可以先保存下来、在 Side Chat 里快速问清楚，或另开一个相关会话继续研究，不打断当前任务的开发思路和注意力。

description.en: 11 shareable workflow skills (handoff, triage, to-spec, to-tickets, wayfinder, teach, wait-what, dsh-mode-routing, ask-matt, overnight-execution, full-throttle) as an installable skill pack.
description.zh: 11 个可分享的工作流 skills（handoff、triage、to-spec、to-tickets、wayfinder、teach、wait-what、dsh-mode-routing、ask-matt、overnight-execution、full-throttle），打包为可安装 bundle。

description.en: Adds a diagram button under every finished reply in the DSH Web UI: the configured model writes a single-file HTML page with inline SVG and the right sidebar renders it in a sandboxed iframe, with diagram, source and original-text views, a per-session replay history that is served from a disk cache instead of calling the model again, redraw, and save to a .html file.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面每条定稿回复下加一个「图解」按钮：模型产出单文件 HTML（内联 SVG），右侧栏以沙箱 iframe 渲染；带图解／源码／原文三个视图、命中磁盘缓存即回放（不再调用模型）的会话内历史列表、重画与另存 .html。

description.en: Windows XP Luna skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a blue taskbar sidebar, Luna title bars, translucent conversation and plugin windows with adjustable opacity and blur, and a settings page for importing a wallpaper. Light mode only: the skin removes itself when the host switches to dark.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Windows XP Luna 皮肤：蓝色任务栏侧栏、Luna 标题栏、可调节不透明度与模糊的半透明对话及插件窗口，以及可导入壁纸的设置页。仅浅色模式：宿主切到深色时皮肤自动移除。

description.en: Story Mode preset for DeepSeek Harness: role-play GM persona, three-way choices, .md character cards and world book, context distillation and prompt wrapping.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的故事模式预设：叙事 GM 人格、三条走向、.md 角色卡与世界书记忆、上下文提纯与前后置提示词。

description.en: Provider balance and quota status bar for DSH Web, with model capability settings, external JSON health monitoring, visual field binding, and per-model status details.
description.zh: DSH Web 的供应商余额与额度状态栏，支持模型能力设置、外部 JSON 健康监测、可视化字段绑定和逐模型状态详情。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Skill built on the official command-line tool maa-cli for MaaAssistantArknights (MAA), enabling direct control of MaaCore to automate daily tasks in Arknights.
description.zh: 基于 MaaAssistantArknights (MAA) 官方命令行工具 maa-cli 构建的 DeepSeek Harness Skill：让 DeepSeek Harness 直接驱动 MaaCore，自动化完成《明日方舟》日常任务。

description.en: Drive Jiey Browser from DeepSeek Harness over MCP: navigate, snapshot, act, read, screenshot, and manage tabs in a real Chromium profile.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 Jiey 浏览器：导航、快照、操作、读取、截图与标签页管理，使用真实 Chromium 环境。

description.en: Authenticated LAN, Tailnet, and public HTTPS access for a DSH Host, with persistent host identity, pairing, and QR setup.
description.zh: 为 DSH Host 提供经认证的局域网、Tailnet 与公网 HTTPS 接入，支持持久主机身份、配对和二维码配置。

description.en: Routes DSH web search through the current session's model and a self-hosted retrieval backend.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页搜索改走当前会话模型加自建检索后端。

description.en: Composer input toolkit: arrow-key session history (first/last-line gated, IME and command-menu safe), an instructions viewer/editor for global and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and a prompt library of 780 Chinese prompts (Cherry Studio agents-zh corpus, AGPL-3.0) inserted into the composer in one click. Ships on npm as `dsh-composer-tools`.
description.zh: 输入框工具集：方向键调取历史消息（限首/末行触发，兼容输入法与命令菜单）、指令查看/编辑器（全局与项目级 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md）、提示词库（780 条中文提示词，源自 Cherry Studio agents-zh 语料，AGPL-3.0，一键插入输入框）。npm 包名 `dsh-composer-tools`。

description.en: Data asset registration helper: runs a disallowed-scenario and ownership-dispute pre-check, matches a registration agency by data type and region, and returns a registration checklist with the triple-audit standard and seven-step flow.
description.zh: 数据资产登记助手：做禁用场景与权属纠纷预检，按数据类型和地区匹配登记机构，并给出含三审标准与七步流程的登记清单。

description.en: Native-feel DSH attachments: official PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF thumbs plus 64px cards for other files via drag, paste, or paperclip; non-images land in .dsh-uploads and sent cards sit on the user bubble.
description.zh: 接近原生的 DSH 附件：PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 走官方缩略图，其它文件经拖入、粘贴或回形针变成 64px 卡片；非图片落到 .dsh-uploads，发送后贴在用户气泡旁。

description.en: Floating toolbar on text selection in conversations: add the quote to the composer, start a new discussion from it, or copy it; quotes collapse into a card aligned to the composer and double-clicking jumps back to the quoted turn.
description.zh: 会话内选中文字即弹出工具条：添加到对话、新开讨论或复制；引用折叠为输入框旁的引用卡片，双击跳回被引用轮次。

description.en: Daily and weekly AI journals generated from your local DSH session logs, grouped by goal with deliverables and unfinished todos.
description.zh: 按天/按周汇总本机 DSH 会话：按目标分块的行动/结果/交付物与未完成待办，左侧栏图形化面板。

description.en: Reports DSH session token usage from the local session logs as a host-side tool: totals, input, output and cache-read split, a per-day timeline, usage grouped by day or session and optional cost estimates.
description.zh: 以 host 侧工具统计 DSH 会话 token 用量，数据取自本地会话日志：总量、输入、输出与缓存读取拆分、按天时间线、按天或按会话分组的用量，以及可选成本估算。

description.en: Adds a collapsible, draggable minesweeper board to the conversation area, with adjustable rows, columns and mine count, and a first click that never lands on a mine.
description.zh: 在会话区左侧叠一块可折叠、可拖动的扫雷盘，行列与雷数都可调，第一次点击保证不踩雷。

description.en: Local image, voice, music and SFX generation plus transcription, with pinned identity: characters, animals, objects and actor voices are defined once and reused on every later call, degenerate output (a near-flat image, silent audio) is rejected instead of returned as success, and a generated line can be read back as text so a clone that swallowed its ending becomes visible. The engines unload when idle, and image generation and transcription can each be pointed at an OpenAI-shaped API instead of the local Vulkan backend.
description.zh: 本地生成图像/配音/音乐/音效并听写，同一性锁定：角色、动物、道具与配音角色定妆定声一次，之后每次调用复用同一份参考；退化产物（接近纯色的图、静音的音频）被拒绝而不是当成成功返回；生成的台词可以听写回文字，好让吞掉结尾的克隆暴露出来。空闲时引擎卸载显存，生图与听写也可改指向任意 OpenAI 形状的 API 而不用本地 Vulkan 后端。

description.en: Read-only DeepSeek web archive tools for DSH: list/download/search sessions, share-list, and a digest tool that compresses the 100-session history into one high-density page with activity bars and topic clusters. Write operations are intentionally not exposed (the web client rate-limits them). Requires the separately installed deepseek-ops Python client (github.com/Panniantong/deepseek-ops, by another author) with QR-code login; set scriptDir to its path.
description.zh: DSH 内只读访问 DeepSeek 网页版会话归档：列会话/下载全文/搜索索引/分享列表，以及把 100 段会话压缩成一页高密度摘要（含活跃度直方图与主题聚类）的 digest 工具。刻意不暴露写操作（网页版有限流）。需另外安装第三方 deepseek-ops Python 客户端（github.com/Panniantong/deepseek-ops，另一位作者）并扫码登录，在插件配置里把 scriptDir 指向它。

description.en: Input prediction: the likely continuation of your draft appears as grey ghost text after the caret and Tab accepts it, and after each assistant turn 1-3 clickable follow-up suggestions appear above the input box and send on click. Ghost completion, suggestions and the suggestion count can be toggled in Settings, Built-in plugins.
description.zh: 输入预测：在输入框里用灰字续写你草稿最可能的后续，按 Tab 接受后落进输入框、可继续编辑；每轮回答结束后在输入框上方给出 1–3 条你可能会发的下一条，点一下就发送。灰字补全、回复后推荐与推荐条数都能在「设置 → 内置插件 → 输入预测」里开关。

description.en: Dota 2 ranked no-ban 2-2-1 draft assistant with bracket and pro data sources, flexible player pools, in-game player selection, and a post-draft win probability estimate.
description.zh: Dota 2 天梯无 Ban 2-2-1 征召助手，支持分段与职业数据口径、灵活分路成员池、参战勾选和 BP 后预测胜率。

description.en: DSH Feishu Client. 1) Users (humans) access remote agents through the UI provided by this plugin; 2) The local DSH accesses remote agents by calling the tools provided by this plugin. Supported remote agents include but are not limited to DSH, OpenClaw, WorkBuddy, Weknora, etc.
description.zh: DSH飞书客户端：1）用户（人）通过本插件提供UI访问远端智能体；2）本地DSH通过调用本插件提供工具访问远端智能体。支持的远端智能体包括且不限于：DSH、OpenClaw、WorkBuddy、Weknora等等。

description.en: Watchdog for quota exhaustion: on a 429 or quota error it creates a recurring schedule that re-sends a continue-the-task prompt until a turn closes normally, so a long task resumes without manual restarts; /keep-running list and /keep-running cancel <id> manage those schedules. Requires @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule to be mounted first (it registers the schedules).
description.zh: 配额看门狗：遇到 429 或配额错误时建立循环调度，持续重发「继续任务」提示直到某一轮正常结束，长任务不必手动重开；/keep-running list 与 /keep-running cancel <id> 用于查看和取消。需先挂载 @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule（调度由它注册）。

description.en: Removes sandbox_permissions / justification arguments that cannot widen the call's current sandbox mode, so calls no longer fail with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode'. GPT models tend to fill these optional fields on every call and pick workspace-write, which is narrower than danger-full-access. Runs in tools/pre-execute: compares the requested mode with the mode the session's sandbox policy resolves, and drops the fields when the request is the same or narrower (also drops a lone justification). Also understands the values GPT carries over from Codex's own shell tool: null, empty and use_default are treated as no request, and in a danger-full-access session any value (including require_escalated) is dropped because nothing is wider. Real widening requests, unknown modes and tools that do not advertise DSH's escalation schema are left to DSH core. Never widens permissions. Configurable tool list (default bash, pwsh, write, edit, run_code). Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 去掉那些不会让当前沙箱模式变宽的 sandbox_permissions / justification 参数，避免调用报错「sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode」。GPT 系列模型往往每次调用都会填这两个可选参数，并选 workspace-write，而它比 danger-full-access 更窄。插件在 tools/pre-execute 阶段把请求的模式和会话沙箱策略给出的当前模式做比较：相同或更窄时去掉这两个字段（只有 justification 时也会去掉）。同时兼容 GPT 从 Codex shell 工具带过来的取值：null、空值和 use_default 视为没有请求；会话已经是 danger-full-access 时，任何取值（包括 require_escalated）都会去掉，因为不存在更宽的模式。真正的升权请求、无法识别的模式值，以及没有声明 DSH 升权参数的工具，都原样交给 DSH 处理。不会放宽任何权限。监控的工具列表可配置（默认 bash、pwsh、write、edit、run_code）。零依赖。

description.en: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
description.zh: 把每轮工具计数与粗粒度验证信号写入本地 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数或结果正文。

description.en: Agent skills for the Lark/Feishu CLI: exports the 27 skills embedded in the lark-cli binary (docs, sheets, base, calendar, drive, task, wiki, approval, mail, slides, vc, minutes and more) and registers them with the DeepSeek Harness skill registry so the agent can read them on demand. Excludes lark-im so it complements an IM bridge plugin rather than duplicating one. Requires lark-cli to be installed.
description.zh: 飞书/Lark CLI 的 agent 技能包：把 lark-cli 二进制内嵌的 27 个技能（文档、表格、多维表格、日历、云空间、任务、知识库、审批、邮箱、幻灯片、视频会议、妙记等）导出并注册到 DeepSeek Harness 技能库，供 agent 按需读取。刻意排除 lark-im，与 IM 桥接插件互补而非重复。需先安装 lark-cli。

description.en: Fan-made wallpaper plugin themed on the streamer Zhang Shunfei: full-screen high-definition rotating colorful pegasus GIF wallpaper with theme blending and prominence control, plus a Bilibili music player (add songs by pasting a link, delete, volume, seek, single/list/shuffle loop, and a sidebar mini player).
description.zh: 以网络主播张顺飞为主题的粉丝同人二创壁纸插件：彩色飞马高清旋转动图全屏壁纸，支持主题融合与突出度调节；附带 B站音乐播放器，可粘贴链接添加歌曲、删除、调音量、拖进度条、切换单曲/列表/随机循环，并有侧栏迷你播放器。

description.en: Tavily web search for DSH with a settings toggle, keyless by default, and a connection test.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Tavily 网页搜索：设置开关、默认无 Key，以及连通测试。

description.en: Everything (voidtools) file-name search: everything_find queries the local Everything index to locate files and folders on any indexed drive in milliseconds, and adds a configuration card to the Plugins page.
description.zh: 基于 Everything 索引的全盘文件名搜索：everything_find 工具毫秒级定位任意盘上的文件与文件夹，并在插件页提供配置卡片。

description.en: Registers the Zemingxingxiao five-element brand-diagnosis skill with five companion reference skills (theory, diagnosis playbook, 240-case library, visual templates, glossary), a system-prompt router, and the mandatory HTML report template with 13 theory diagrams.
description.zh: 注册择命行效五行品牌诊断技能及五个伴随参考技能（理论、诊断手册、二百四十案案例库、可视化模板、术语表），带提示词路由与强制 HTML 报告模板、13 张理论配图。

description.en: Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.
description.zh: Overleaf 式 LaTeX 论文工作台：在渲染后的 PDF 上选中任意文字批注，由 dsh agent 改写源文件、编译验证并提交 git 修订。

description.en: One-button prompt optimizer: rewrites the composer draft via a configurable strategy, with an editable template, few-shot examples, pinned models and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 一键提示词优化：按可配置策略改写输入框草稿，提供可编辑模板、Few-shot 示例、指定模型与推理强度。

description.en: ZCode-style enhancement of dsh plan mode: a model-initiated enter_plan_mode tool, hard interception of write-class tools at dispatch time (ctx.tools.guard) while planning, and a four-phase planning prompt section (explore, design, review, exit), reusing the official plan/mode state machine and exit review flow.
description.zh: dsh 计划模式的 ZCode 式增强：模型可主动调用 enter_plan_mode 进入计划模式，计划期间写类工具在分发前被硬拦截，并注入「探索 → 设计 → 评审 → 退出」四阶段工作流提示词；复用官方 plan/mode 状态机与退出评审流，只做增量。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) bot for DSH remote control — messages become session turns, results return to the chat, and ask-mode approval requests can be approved or denied in Feishu.
description.zh: 飞书机器人远程控制 DSH 会话——消息进入会话，回合结果回到飞书，ask 档的审批可以在飞书里批准或拒绝。

description.en: Switch sessions between Standard and Fast tiers via the model selector or `/fast` command, attaching the `priority` tier to eligible Responses requests and forwarding them to the target endpoint when Fast is enabled. Interactive sessions can toggle tiers on the fly while team roles lock in their tier at launch; once Fast is active alongside required configuration and upstream support, requests are routed with `priority`, with actual speed and billing governed by your provider. It needs provider, source and target URLs filled in; it then runs a loopback proxy that sends matching requests, with their authorization header, to the target URL.
description.zh: 通过模型选择器或 `/fast` 命令在会话中按需切换 Standard 与 Fast 档位，在开启 Fast 时为符合配置的 Responses 请求附带 `priority` 档位并转发至目标端点。交互会话支持随时切换，团队角色则在启动时锁定所用档位；启用 Fast 且完成前置配置与上游接口支持时请求即按 `priority` 档位发送，实际响应速度与计费规则由上游服务商决定。需要先填齐 provider、源地址和目标地址；之后由本地回环代理把匹配的请求连同授权头一起转发到目标地址。

description.en: Interactive canvas for visualizing Agent, Subagent, Workflow, Phase, and tool relationships in DSH Web.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可交互画布，用于展示 Agent、Subagent、Workflow、Phase 与工具调用之间的关系。

description.en: Grok Build provider using the official CLI browser login, with dynamic account-visible models, streaming reasoning and tools, plus quota and model-capability settings.
description.zh: Grok Build 模型接入插件：使用官方 CLI 浏览器登录，动态发现账号可见模型，支持流式推理、工具调用、额度与模型能力设置页。

description.en: Zero-credential Outlook automation: 13 tools that drive the local desktop Outlook client via COM — search/read mail, drafts, reply/forward, calendar, address book, rooms, free/busy — plus a sidebar new-mail badge. No Graph API registration, no SMTP passwords; anything that leaves the machine passes a three-layer human approval gate.
description.zh: 零凭据 Outlook 自动化：13 个工具通过 COM 直接驱动本地桌面 Outlook 客户端——搜信/读信/草稿/回复转发/日历/通讯录/会议室/忙闲查询——外加侧边栏新邮件角标。无需 Graph API 注册、无需 SMTP 密码；任何外发动作都过三层人工审批门。

description.en: Tracks this turn cost under the input box, today tokens and spend in the sidebar with peak and idle pricing, and pins the latest question to the top of the conversation.
description.zh: 输入框下方显示本轮花费；侧栏显示今日 token、消费与高峰/空闲时段；对话区顶部钉住最新提问，点击可跳回。

description.en: Give DSH AI timestamped video frames, audio and lyric analysis for Bilibili, YouTube and local files, with encrypted browser-session import, continued viewing, saved site resolvers and native cache management. Requires FFmpeg and ffprobe on PATH or configured in the plugin settings.
description.zh: 让 DSH 中的 AI 结合时间戳画面、音频与歌词理解 B 站、YouTube 和本地视频，支持浏览器登录态导入与加密保存、接续观看、站点解析扩展和原生缓存管理。需要把 FFmpeg 与 ffprobe 放进 PATH，或在插件设置中填写程序路径。

description.en: DSH Cordis computer-use provider for the ZTE Nde desktop. npm install auto-fetches the musl binary built by computer-use-linux-zte-nde (v0.7.7-nde.3) into the package's own bin/ via postinstall; resolveCommand() resolves the cordis command path against import.meta.url so the mount works regardless of dsh web's cwd. Reserves the shared computer-use slot via ctx.computerUse.register and exposes MCP tools under mcp__computer-use-linux-nde-mcp__* (screenshot, list_windows, click, type_text, doctor, etc.). Two notable Nde fixes upstream of this provider: KWin caption+coords fallback for window targeting, and SnapshotCache that keeps AT-SPI single-wake per (app, pid) so Chrome is not repeatedly disturbed.
description.zh: 为中兴 Nde 桌面定制的 DSH Cordis computer-use provider。npm install 完成后由 postinstall 钩子从 computer-use-linux-zte-nde v0.7.7-nde.3 release 自动下载 musl 静态二进制到包内 bin/，SHA 校验后 chmod +x；cordis patch 里的 command 用相对路径，由 provider 内部 resolveCommand() 依据 import.meta.url 解析为绝对路径，不依赖 dsh web 的 cwd。占用 DSH 一等公民 ctx.computerUse slot，工具命名空间为 mcp__computer-use-linux-nde-mcp__*（screenshot、list_windows、click、type_text、doctor 等）。binary 本身携带两个 Nde 适配修复：KWin 窗口寻址的 caption+coords 兜底，以及 SnapshotCache——同一 (app, pid) 5 秒内的 AT-SPI 树结果复用、避免 Chrome 反复被唤醒。

description.en: Wire-level LLM inspector: captures the raw HTTP request and response bodies of model provider calls and attributes each capture to the session that caused it through the llm/stream waterfall. The request pane renders the body as a collapsible tree with per-node sizes — one measured request was 98.6% a single 973-entry array — and the response pane reassembles the OpenAI-style SSE chunk stream into reasoning, content, tool calls and usage. Shown in a Conversation View tab and a loopback viewer page.
description.zh: 线路层 LLM 检查器：抓取模型调用的原始 HTTP 请求与响应报文，经 llm/stream 瀑布把每次抓取归属到发起它的会话。请求面板把报文渲染成带每节点大小的可折叠树——实测一次请求有 98.6% 是单个 973 项的数组——响应面板则把 OpenAI 风格的 SSE chunk 流重新组装成推理、正文、工具调用与用量。在对话栏标签页与本地查看页展示。

description.en: Composer stats strip for the DSH Web UI: official CNY pricing with auto-synced peak/off-peak tiers, per-model accounting, live timers, subagent-tree merging, DeepSeek account balance, budget alerts, and streaming cost estimation.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框下方的增强统计条：官方人民币计价（峰谷分时、价目自动同步）、多模型分账、实时计时、子代理树合并、余额直连、预算预警与流式成本估算。

description.en: Daily todo board in the main panel with one list per calendar day split into Work and Life; local midnight archives the day and carries unfinished tasks into the new day.
description.zh: 主面板里的每日待办：一天一份清单，分「工作 / 生活」两段，打勾即划掉；本机零点自动归档当天清单，未完成项带进新的一天。

description.en: Adds a "Work Roles" tab and a pixel-art office overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 508 built-in role cards (The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253) with search, EN/ZH toggle and department filter; draggable Canvas 2D pixel characters that stand, type and pace, with idle chat that can plug into AI. One-command npm install, no dsh source changes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 主窗口添加「工作角色」页签 + 像素办公室浮层：内置 508 张角色卡（The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253），支持搜索 / 中英切换 / 分部分类；Canvas 2D 像素小人可站立、打字、踱步，闲聊台词可接 AI。一条命令安装，不改 dsh 源码。

description.en: Automatic approval and review for tool calls that need approval: keyword buckets match red lines without context, then a judge model classifies what was requested and sends it to allow, reject or a human according to the matching row and risk level; a judgment that never ran always goes to a human, and rejections tell the model why.
description.zh: 自动审批 / 自动审核需要审批的工具调用：先用关键词分桶做零上下文红线匹配，再交由审核模型判类别与风险等级， 按命中行与等级那一格决定自动允许、自动拒绝或转人工；判定没跑成固定转人工，自动拒绝会把原因回传给模型。

description.en: Prompt-cache diagnostics dashboard showing provider-reported token usage, adjacent logical-input changes, and Call TTFT.
description.zh: 提示词缓存诊断页，展示 Provider 回传的 Token 用量、相邻逻辑输入变化与 Call TTFT。

description.en: Dracula theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: the classic dark palette and the Soft variant registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的德古拉主题插件：经典暗色配色与 Soft 变体接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择。

description.en: Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。

description.en: Capture selected DSH, local MCP, or native WebMCP calls as reviewed, parameterized routines, expose typed tools, and replay with fresh approval.
description.zh: 把选定的 DSH、本地 MCP 或原生 WebMCP 调用捕获为经过评审的参数化例程，暴露为带类型的工具，重放时重新请求批准。

description.en: Adds a collectible blind-box layer to a composer-dock pomodoro timer: each finished focus session opens one of 15 items across four rarity tiers, tracked in a 5x3 gallery.
description.zh: 在输入框下方的番茄钟上加一层藏品盲盒：每走完一个专注段开一个盲盒，15 件藏品分四档稀有度，进度记在 5x3 图鉴里。

description.en: Evidence-backed inspector for DSH Web built-in capabilities: runtime/config provenance, compatibility and drift diagnostics, plus fail-closed controls for nine reviewed UI leaves.
description.zh: DSH Web 内置 capability 的 evidence-backed 检查器：展示运行/配置溯源、兼容性与漂移诊断，并仅为 9 个经过审阅的 UI leaf 提供 fail-closed 控制。

description.en: Installs the coaligne-workflow skill for CoAligne team collaboration; requires CoAligne Desktop (signed in) to provide the MCP connection - not usable without Desktop.
description.zh: 安装 CoAligne 团队协作的 coaligne-workflow skill；MCP 连接由登录后的 CoAligne Desktop 提供，不安装 Desktop 则无法使用。

description.en: Does AI sometimes take over your story and decide the plot for you? DSH Novel Beat pauses at key turning points while the AI writes, offers 2-4 distinct directions with their consequences, and waits for your call before continuing. Picks go into a book-wide ledger, and a post-chapter check flags drifted or missing changes.
description.zh: AI 写着写着就替你决定了剧情？「拍板」会在 AI 写作途中遇到关键岔路时暂停，把 2–4 个走向及其代价交给你选；拍板写进全书账本，下一章接着用，写完再做结构核对。

description.en: Browser tools for DSH that POST to the local OpenCLI daemon instead of spawning the opencli CLI per command, avoiding its cold start: oc_status, oc_exec, oc_navigate, oc_snapshot and oc_tabs, with one persistent automation tab per session.
description.zh: 把本机 OpenCLI daemon 当常驻服务直连的 DSH 浏览器工具，替代「每条命令起一次 opencli CLI」的冷启动：oc_status、oc_exec、oc_navigate、oc_snapshot、oc_tabs 五个工具，每个 session 一个常驻自动化标签页。需要本机运行 OpenCLI daemon，并让浏览器里的 OpenCLI 扩展保持连接。

description.en: Captures every plan the agent presents through exit_plan_mode as markdown under <workspace>/.dsh/plans, opens a review window, and keeps a Plans history tab recording the outcome of each plan.
description.zh: 将智能体通过 exit_plan_mode 呈现的每个计划捕获为 <workspace>/.dsh/plans 下的 markdown，打开审阅窗口，并以 Plans 历史标签页记录每个计划的结果。

description.en: A NieR:Automata / YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with sand-and-charcoal palettes, square geometry, and interface-wide styling.
description.zh: 一款面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 NieR:Automata / YoRHa 风格工业终端主题，提供沙色与炭黑配色、直角几何和全界面样式。

description.en: Zhejiang provincial government data inspection config pack with runtime config loading and validation.
description.zh: 浙江省政务数据巡检配置包 — 含浙政办/浙委改等浙江省地方政策依据与标准词表，提供配置加载与校验运行时

description.en: Adds a draggable restart button and a plugin panel to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: it prompts when the profile plugin list changes, records additions and removals per profile, tracks trials, reports host startup state, and offers rollback, minimal boot and recoverable cleanup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端添加可拖动重启按钮与插件面板：插件清单变化时提醒重启，按 profile 记录新增与移除、跟踪试用、显示宿主启动状态，并提供回滚、最小启动与可恢复的残留清理。

description.en: Sync DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspace files to a private GitHub repository for cross-device handoff, with sync badges, search and bulk upload, independent local/remote delete, conflict "pick a side", and multi-device-safe index merging.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话与工作区文件同步到私有 GitHub 仓库，实现跨设备接力；支持同步徽标、搜索与批量上传、本地/远端独立删除、冲突选边，以及多设备安全的索引合并。

description.en: Native RSS monitor for DeepSeek Harness: multi-source subscription, keyword filtering, scheduled polling with smart dedup, and email notifications for new items (HTML template with thumbnail cards), with SMTP passwords stored only in the credential store.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生 RSS 订阅监控插件：多源订阅、关键词过滤、定时检查去重、新条目邮件通知（缩略图 HTML 模板），SMTP 密码走凭据库永不落盘，原生设置页四页签体验。

description.en: Detects repetitive loops in an agent's reasoning output and records, nudges, or cuts them, with a history report. Defaults to a nudge (a reminder injected into the next request); cutting and auto-resuming is opt-in, and should not be combined with another plugin's cutting such as dsh-loop-rescue. Needs DSH 0.2.1+ and Node.js 22.15+.
description.zh: 检测 Agent 推理输出中的重复循环，命中时记录、提醒或截断，并生成历史报告。默认只是提醒（向下一次请求注入一条提示）；截断并自动续跑需手动开启，且不要和 dsh-loop-rescue 之类的截断同时开。需要 DSH 0.2.1+ 与 Node.js 22.15+。

description.en: Sales workflow for individual insurance agents: P1-P5 product class matched against the client risk rating, a policy ledger that counts grace periods from the receipt date, and five-section dual-recording checks. 10 tools and 5 skills.
description.zh: 个险代理人的展业工作流：P1-P5 产品分级与客户风险等级匹配、按回执签收日推算犹豫期的保单台账、双录五环节校验，含 10 个工具与 5 个技能。

description.en: Automatically sends "continue" to recover from RATE_LIMIT (429) and QUOTA (insufficient_quota) errors. Per-session consecutive-failure counter (default 20, configurable 1-100), a toolbar on/off switch, and a settings-page card.
description.zh: 遇到 RATE_LIMIT（429）或配额耗尽（insufficient_quota）错误时自动发送 continue 恢复对话。每会话独立计数连续失败次数（默认 20，可设 1-100），带工具栏开关条与设置页配置卡片。

description.en: Windows desktop shortcut for dsh web: launches the server, auto-opens the browser when ready, and stops the service when the Harness window closes.
description.zh: Windows 桌面快捷方式：一键启动 dsh web，就绪后自动打开浏览器，关闭 Harness 窗口即停服务。

description.en: Classic Macintosh (System 7) pixel theme: desktop pattern canvas, Finder sidebar, monochrome buttons and dialogs, light/dark support.
description.zh: 经典麦金塔 System 7 像素风主题：桌面网点画布、Finder 侧栏、黑白按钮与弹窗，深浅色随官方外观切换。

description.en: Per-turn cost meter and tool-loop guard for the DSH web GUI. It records model, tool and idle time for every turn, blocks runaway tool calls with a dynamic step gate, a retry breaker and a slow-command block, and renders the breakdown as a card under each reply plus a ledger view.
description.zh: DSH 网页版的每轮成本计与工具循环护栏。记录每轮模型、工具与空转耗时，用动态步数闸门、重试熔断和慢命令拦截限制失控的工具调用，并把拆分显示为每条回复下的卡片与账本视图。

description.en: MCP & Skill manager: enable/disable MCP servers and skills from a Settings panel to free context in real time; optional AI middle layer (mcp_search/mcp_call) calls disabled servers on demand, with state-based visibility filtering that keeps user-enabled servers visible.
description.zh: MCP 与技能管理面板：设置页面板实时启停 MCP 服务器与 Skill 释放上下文占用；可选 AI 中间层（mcp_search/mcp_call）按需调用停用服务器，按 server 状态过滤模型可见性（用户打开的保持可见）。

description.en: Data cleaning plugin for deduplication, format standardization and anomaly detection.
description.zh: 数据清洗插件 — 去重+格式标准化+异常值检测

description.en: Persistent search bar in the conversation header: keyword-search the message bodies of past sessions, then open the session at the matched text.
description.zh: 对话页顶部常驻搜索栏：按关键词搜索历史会话的消息正文，点击结果直接打开会话并定位到命中的那段文字。

description.en: Offline voice input for the DSH Web UI: mic to local FunASR (SenseVoiceSmall), one-click install, no cloud.
description.zh: DSH Web 本地离线语音输入：麦克风经本地 FunASR（SenseVoiceSmall）识别后填入输入框，支持一键安装，全程离线。

description.en: Shows an aggregated session-status dot in front of every folder in DSH Web's sidebar workspace tree — waiting for input, just finished, or running — and bubbles the sessions of nested workspaces up to their parent folder.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏工作区树的每个目录名前显示聚合状态点（等你输入 / 刚完成 / 运行中），父目录自动汇总嵌套工作区的会话状态。

description.en: Read-only monitor for local DSH sessions: live task board, per-session tails, blocking reply wait, Markdown export, and optional IM push via dsh-im. Requires Python 3 with the zstandard package; IM push additionally needs the dsh-im plugin.
description.zh: 只读的本机 DSH 会话监视器：实时任务看板、会话事件尾随、阻塞等待回复、Markdown 导出，可选配合 dsh-im 推送 IM。需要 Python 3 与 zstandard 库；IM 推送需另装 dsh-im。

description.en: Raises one desktop notification when a turn stops, a question waits, or an approval waits. Each event has its own switch; subagent Sessions stay quiet; a click opens the Session. Uses the page's own Notification API, so there is no helper app or install-time registration.
description.zh: 回合结束、有提问等待回答或有审批等待决定时各发一条桌面通知。每类事件可单独开关；子代理会话不发通知；点击通知打开对应会话。走页面自带的 Notification API，不需要辅助程序或安装时注册。

description.en: Finishes 头歌 (EduCoder) homework over the platform JSON API, with no browser automation. educoder_sweep scans every course for homeworks that still have unfinished challenges — complete homeworks are skipped without reading a single challenge, so a full-account scan costs no model tokens — and can finish them; multiple-choice challenges also cost no model tokens, because the platform returns the answer key in any submission response, while code challenges are generated by the model, uploaded with evaluate:0 and graded once per challenge, then retried using the error report the platform returns. Three tools: educoder_sweep, educoder_homework, educoder_account.
description.zh: 走头歌（EduCoder）平台 JSON API 完成作业，无浏览器自动化。educoder_sweep 扫描所有课程中仍有未通过关卡的作业——已完成的作业直接跳过、一个关卡都不读，因此全量扫描不消耗模型 token——并可一次做完；选择题同样零 token，因为平台会在任意一次提交的响应里回吐标准答案；代码题由模型生成，以 evaluate:0 上传后每关只触发一次评测，再按平台返回的报错重试。三个工具：educoder_sweep、educoder_homework、educoder_account。

description.en: Watches the context budget of a DeepSeek Harness session: a colour dot in every turn footer (green <50%, yellow 50-65%, orange 65-80%, red >=80%) read from the official contextPressure projection, a reminder panel with a one-click new-session handoff at orange/red, the /context-watch and /handoff commands, and a static reasoning-rule prompt section. Budget and handoff read local session files only; the badge and reminder spend no tokens until the button is clicked.
description.zh: 看护 DeepSeek Harness 会话的上下文预算：每轮回复底部一个颜色点（绿<50%、黄50-65%、橙65-80%、红≥80%，读官方 contextPressure 投影），橙/红档在输入框下方出现提醒与「一键开新会话」交接按钮，另有 /context-watch 与 /handoff 命令和一个静态思考规则提示段。预算与交接只读本地会话文件，徽章和提醒不点按钮不花 token。

description.en: Hot-swap the outbound proxy in dsh between direct, system, and saved proxies without restarting.
description.zh: 在 dsh 运行过程中热切换出站代理（直连/系统/自定义），无需重启即可生效

description.en: When a dsh turn gets interrupted — by a web restart or an upstream hiccup (rate limit, 5xx, quota error) — this plugin auto-injects a "continue" so your session picks up where it left off, with a dead-loop guard that hands back control if the retry produces nothing.
description.zh: dsh 会话因 web 重启或上游瞬时故障（限流、5xx、余额/配额错误）中断时，自动注入「继续」让本轮接着跑，不需要手动点、不会丢上下文；带死循环守卫，重试没反应就把会话交回给你。

description.en: Trusted Iroh mesh networking for DSH hosts, with encrypted peer discovery, remote session delivery, and reachability status.
description.zh: 基于 Iroh 的可信 DSH 主机网状网络：提供加密的节点发现、远程会话投递与连通状态。

description.en: Adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider with native and animated modes, light and dark palettes, and shared or per-model colors.
description.zh: 为模型添加推理强度滑块，支持原生与动画模式、明暗配色，以及全局或按模型配色。

description.en: Semantic-layer analytics tool that uses curated table, column and metric metadata with Qdrant and Elasticsearch recall to generate, validate and execute MySQL analytical queries through the Xiwen service.
description.zh: 基于人工维护的表、字段和指标语义元数据，结合 Qdrant 与 Elasticsearch 召回，通过析问服务生成、校验并执行 MySQL 分析查询。

description.en: Injects a persona into the system prompt and a past conversation into context, with a settings page and a conversation picker.
description.zh: 把人设正文注入系统提示词、把历史对话注入上下文，带设置页与对话选择器。

description.en: Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.
description.zh: 零 token 在线状态指示器：会话头部常驻显示 ● 在线 / ● 离线 状态点，每 15 秒自动检测一次，不调用任何 LLM。

description.en: Split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - chat with several agents side by side in panes that look and behave exactly like the stock conversation: drag-to-split, live sessions with queued messages and in-pane ask_user/approval cards, per-pane view tabs (Chat/Trajectory/plugin views), a compact TUI composer mode (Alt+T) and pane-focus shortcuts. Requires DSH 0.1.5+.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端分屏工作区 - 多个会话并排聊天，面板观感与原生对话完全一致：拖拽分屏、实时会话（排队消息、面板内 ask_user/审批卡片）、面板内视图标签（Chat/Trajectory/插件视图）、Alt+T 紧凑 TUI 输入模式与面板焦点快捷键。需要 DSH 0.1.5+。

description.en: Pull a 3D lever next to the send button and turn the model's reasoning signals into a pixel-art gacha reveal.
description.zh: 在发送按钮旁拉动 3D 拉杆，把模型思维链的文本信号变成一场像素风抽卡演出。

description.en: Automatic provider failover on rate limits or quota exhaustion: switch between providers with configurable per-provider models, a cooldown, and a permanent last-entry fallback.
description.zh: 限流或配额耗尽时自动切换模型提供方：可按提供方配置模型，带冷却机制与永久最终兜底。

description.en: API regression and acceptance workbench: snapshot the responses of the endpoints you register before the agent edits the backend, rerun them all after the edit, and review a structured field-level diff (status codes, added and removed fields, numeric old → new values with the delta) beside the captured source diff, accepting each endpoint one by one before exporting a Markdown or single-file HTML report.
description.zh: 接口回归验收台：登记端点后先快照响应基线，模型改完后端一键重跑，把结构化字段级差异（状态码、字段增删、数值新旧值与差值）与源码 diff 并排展示，逐项验收后再导出 Markdown / 单文件 HTML 报告。

description.en: Let Agents directly control independent local DSH instances with zero intrusion—no plugins or components required on the target. Isolated environments enable autonomous configuration and testing, while Agents with different models and personalities can chat, role-play, or form nested control chains. Supports conversational setup, user-like operations, incremental reading, saved references, and remote session/workspace search.
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供直接操控本机完整 DSH 实例的能力：目标 DSH 无需安装任何插件或额外组件，零侵入，环境隔离便于用户直接让agent为另一环境进行修改配置到自主测试,也能让不同模型、不同人格的 Agent 互相聊天、角色扮演或层层套娃，探索趣味玩法，可通过对话由 Agent 自主配置连接，并支持接近用户的操作语义、增量读取、引用保存以及远端会话与工作区搜索。

description.en: Five-layer intent recognition pipeline (rules, pgvector retrieval, Jev scoring, fine-tuned arbitration, LLM fallback) with scenario management UI, PostgreSQL storage and distributable API services.
description.zh: 五层意图识别流水线（规则、pgvector 向量检索、Jev 概率精判、微调仲裁、LLM 兜底），带场景管理界面、PostgreSQL 存储与可分发 API 服务。

description.en: Right-sidebar prompt shelf for DSH: store prompts as cards, click one to append it to the next message, keep selected cards injected into every turn of the current session, and save any sent user message back into the shelf with one click. Per-session switches, JSON storage under ~/.dsh with atomic writes.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏快捷指令库：把常用提示词存成卡片，点一下追加到下一条消息；打开「每轮注入」后按会话在每一轮自动附带；已发出的用户消息也能一键存回。开关按会话保存，数据以原子写入存在 ~/.dsh 下的 JSON 文件中。

description.en: Policy-driven Git sync for DSH settings and profile configuration, with secret-aware projections, conflict review, and per-line apply controls.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 设置与 Profile 配置的策略化 Git 同步，支持敏感信息隔离、冲突审阅与按行选择应用。

description.en: Vision MCP and DSH bundle for text-only DeepSeek: analyze_image, analyze_clipboard, compare_images and vision_status tools, a visual settings page, free GLM-4.6V-Flash by default, result caching and rate-limit tolerance; keys stay out of logs.
description.zh: 面向纯文本 DeepSeek 的视觉 MCP + DSH 插件：analyze_image / analyze_clipboard / compare_images / vision_status 四个工具、可视化配置页、默认免费 GLM-4.6V-Flash、结果缓存与限流容错，Key 不入日志。

description.en: Highlights answered ask blocks (the “question n/n answered” tool rows) in the conversation with a soft brand-tinted card that follows the light/dark theme; pending asks and other tool blocks keep their native look. Settings can toggle highlighting and expand-by-default.
description.zh: 提问块高亮：把对话里已答复的「提问 n/n 已回答」工具块用柔和品牌色卡片凸显，明暗主题自适应；等待中的提问块与其它工具块保持原样。设置页可开关「高亮已答复提问块」与「默认展开」。

description.en: Self-evolution actuator: consumes problem tickets mined from session logs, synthesizes skill candidates (zero-code tiers by default) behind an eval gate with hold-out canaries, then promotes to project .dsh/skills with human confirm and deterministic rollback.
description.zh: 自进化执行器：消费会话日志挖掘出的问题工单，在评测门（hold-out canary 防作弊）下合成技能候选，人工确认晋级到项目 .dsh/skills 并支持确定性回滚。

description.en: Autonomous permission classifier for the auto preset: tool-scoped allow/deny rules, an LLM semantic judge, and git checkpointing for unattended sessions.
description.zh: auto（自主模式）权限分类器：工具作用域的放行/拒绝规则、LLM 语义裁判与 git 快照，面向无人值守会话。

description.en: A Markdown-based draft-board plugin for dsh: live-preview editing and local persistence.
description.zh: 基于 Markdown 的 dsh 草稿板插件，支持实时预览编辑，本地持久化。

description.en: LibTV canvas and media tools for DeepSeek Harness, with three director skills bundled and one-time WeChat QR authorization.
description.zh: 把 LibTV 的画布与媒体生成能力接进 DeepSeek Harness，随包附带三个导演技能，首次使用微信扫码授权一次即可。

description.en: Bundles the remote-shell skill for secure SSH, SFTP, Telnet, and WinRM remote operations, with an encrypted credential vault whose login and execution scripts never accept plaintext passwords.
description.zh: 打包 remote-shell 技能，提供安全的 SSH、SFTP、Telnet、WinRM 远程操作，内置加密凭证库，登录与执行脚本不接受明文密码。

description.en: Bottom multi-tab terminal panel (node-pty + xterm.js) pinned to the viewport bottom, always below the input box.
description.zh: 底部多标签终端面板（node-pty + xterm.js）：贴底全宽，输入框始终在终端上方。

description.en: Hands standalone jobs to the Cursor CLI signed in on the same machine, with CLI readiness and proxy diagnostics, child-model settings, and a read-only connectivity test.
description.zh: 将独立任务交给同机已登录的 Cursor 命令行，并提供命令行就绪/代理诊断、子模型设置和只读连通性测试。

description.en: Verifies letters signed by other agents: a canonical field order, digest and HMAC checks, and fail-closed handling of missing or unregistered fields. Off by default; when enabled, a letter that fails any check is refused rather than delivered.
description.zh: 校验其他 agent 写来的信：规范字段顺序、摘要与 HMAC 校验。默认关闭；开启后，缺字段或未登记字段不放行，任何一项不过就拒收。

description.en: Per-turn, per-file checkpoints for files written by DSH tools: keep, undo, redo, and revert to here from a dock above the composer, with inline before/after diffs, pinning, and per-session storage cleanup.
description.zh: 按轮次记录 DSH 文件工具改过的文件，在输入框上方的 dock 里保留、撤销、重做、回退到某一轮，支持行内前后 diff、钉住与按会话清理存储。

description.en: Reloads an upgraded plugin inside the running dsh process instead of restarting it, and rolls back to the old version when a reload fails.
description.zh: 插件升级后在运行中的 dsh 内直接重载，无需重启；重载失败时回滚到旧版本并提示手动重启。

description.en: Read, audit and diff Protocol Buffer definitions without installing protoc: a zero-dependency .proto parser exposing six tools (status, outline, describe, diff, audit, next_number). diff classifies every change as breaking, risky or additive and names the wire-format consequence; audit catches what protoc accepts but a reviewer should not — duplicated or illegal field numbers, reserved-range collisions, unresolved types, and unreserved gaps below the high-water mark.
description.zh: 无需安装 protoc 即可阅读、审查和对比 Protocol Buffer 定义：零依赖 .proto 解析器，提供六个工具（status / outline / describe / diff / audit / next_number）。diff 会把每处改动分级为 breaking、risky、additive 并说明其线上格式后果；audit 能发现 protoc 接受但审查者不该放过的隐患——重复或非法字段编号、与 reserved 区间冲突、类型无法解析，以及高水位线以下未声明的空洞。

description.en: Adds Alt+Enter as a newline to the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web composer.
description.zh: 给 dsh 的网页输入框加上 Alt+Enter 换行。

description.en: Web search insights for the agent: it keeps a local log of what was looked up and which pages came back, and counts searches, returned pages, citations and pages opened per turn and across the session, with the numbers shown in a small entry under the answer and a right-sidebar panel.
description.zh: 联网搜索的「搜索洞察」：记下 Agent 查了什么、搜回哪些网页，并统计每轮与整个会话的搜索次数、返回网页数、被引用数与被打开读过的页数；这些数字在回答下方的引用入口和右侧栏面板里随时能回看。

description.en: Windows-native tools for DSH agents: clipboard read and write, system notifications, hosts file inspection and network diagnostics, each returning structured data with UI cards from injection-safe PowerShell.
description.zh: 面向 DSH agent 的 Windows 原生工具：剪贴板读写、系统通知、hosts 文件查看与网络诊断，均返回结构化数据（带 UI 卡片），底层为防注入的 PowerShell。

description.en: DSH workspace hub: organize workspaces into color-coded folders in the sidebar (three-level drag reorder for folders/workspaces/sessions, inline edit, one-click expand/collapse, dual-channel search) with per-workspace and per-session token usage and cost stats from real session logs (official DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing for any deepseek model, three spend calibers, hover detail cards, overview panel) plus OpenCode Go plan usage; data persists to host disk and refreshes live every 30 s.
description.zh: DSH 工作区中枢：侧边栏将工作区按彩色分组管理（分组/工作区/会话三级拖拽排序、内联编辑、一键展开折叠、标题+消息双通道搜索），基于真实会话日志统计每工作区与每会话的 Token 与花费（任意 deepseek 模型自动按官方峰谷价计费、三种时段口径、悬停明细卡、总览面板），另含 OpenCode Go 额度；分组与结果持久化到本机磁盘，30 秒实时刷新。

description.en: A Cursor-like sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with file browsing, code editing, Git diffs, terminal, side chat, and Ctrl+L references.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 Cursor 侧边栏，支持文件浏览、代码编辑、Git 差异、终端、侧边对话及 Ctrl+L 文件引用。

description.en: Session health-check: mechanically mines session logs into structured problem tickets (retry loops, tool-error clusters, interrupted turns, token waste) over the official session-query seam; works standalone.
description.zh: 会话体检：基于官方 session-query 接缝，机械挖掘会话日志为结构化问题工单（重试环/工具错误簇/中断回合/Token 浪费）；可独立安装使用。

description.en: Brings your existing Claude / ChatGPT history into DSH: instant zero-token import of the memories.json inside a Claude export, local Claude Code transcripts with no export needed, and conversations distilled through the model you already configured in DSH. Every memory carries verbatim evidence checked against the source by code — a paraphrase is dropped and counted, and evidence found only in the assistant turns is always routed to review rather than stored.
description.zh: 把你在 Claude / ChatGPT 里已有的历史搬进 DSH：Claude 导出包里的 memories.json 零 token 瞬时入库，本机 Claude Code 记录免导出直读，历史对话用你在 DSH 里已配好的模型提纯。每条记忆都带由代码回原文核对的逐字证据——转述会被丢弃并计数，只在 AI 回复里找到的证据一律转人工确认而非直接入库。

description.en: Community Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with ChatGPT OAuth, Codex models, image input, quota display, per-session Fast and transport controls, and safe stream recovery.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区 Codex 模型接入：支持 ChatGPT OAuth、Codex 模型、图片输入、额度展示、单会话 Fast 与传输控制，以及安全的流式恢复。

description.en: Keeps the most recently used sessions resident in the browser so switching back reuses the already loaded history instead of re-reading it; the number of resident sessions is configurable and the plugin can be switched off.
description.zh: 让浏览器最近用过的会话保持常驻：切走再切回来直接复用已加载的历史、不再重新读取；常驻数量可配置，并可整体关闭。

description.en: Notify-only update checker for the plugins in a DSH profile: classifies each dependency by its specifier and offers only releases the running DSH core can load, in a plugin_updates tool and an Updates sidebar tab (the tab needs dsh-better-sidebar; the tool and settings work without it).
description.zh: 面向 DSH profile 内插件的只提醒更新检查器：按依赖写法（specifier）分类，只列出当前 DSH 内核能加载的版本；提供 plugin_updates 工具和 Updates 侧栏页（侧栏页需装 dsh-better-sidebar，不装时工具与设置仍可用）。

description.en: Replaces the official Models settings page with provider lifecycle management, per-model reasoning effort tiers, retry overrides, drag reorder and upstream model sync.
description.zh: 替代官方「模型」设置页：提供方生命周期管理、每模型思考档位、重试覆盖、拖动排序与上游模型同步。

description.en: Reads the API balance or subscription quota behind the current DSH route — including OpenDesign (AMR) wallet and Design Plan windows via the control plane — and never guesses a figure: a miss reports its cause (the raw response is echoed only when parsing fails). OpenDesign needs `vela login` or a desktop `controlKey` in `~/.amr/config.json`.
description.zh: 读取当前 DSH 路由背后的 API 余额或订阅余量——包括经控制面读取 OpenDesign（AMR）的钱包与 Design Plan 窗口——绝不猜数字：查不到时如实说明原因（仅解析失败时附原始响应）；OpenDesign 需先 `vela login` 或在桌面端写入 `~/.amr/config.json` 的 controlKey。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only event log, rebuildable tag index, day diaries, semantic layer, trend quarantine, and an offline knowledge-graph panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的分层长期记忆：追加式事件日志、可重建标签索引、按天日记、语义层、趋势隔离，以及离线知识图谱面板。

description.en: Johari cognition-quadrant dialog prompt composer — adds a button above the composer that opens a 2×2 quadrant panel (known/unknown × AI-known/AI-unknown) to groom conversation context into a structured prompt written back into the draft.
description.zh: 乔哈里认知四象限对话梳理工具——在输入框上方添加按钮，弹出 2×2 象限面板（我知道/不知道 × AI知道/不知道），将对话上下文梳理为结构化 Prompt 并写回输入框。

description.en: Adds a persistent restart button to the top-right corner of the DeepSeek Harness desktop client. It gracefully shuts down and relaunches the Electron shell and host, and asks for confirmation only when a task is running. Windows + DSH Desktop only.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端右上角添加常驻重启按钮，优雅关停并重新拉起 Electron 外壳与宿主；有任务在跑时才弹出确认。仅支持 Windows + DSH Desktop 桌面端。

description.en: Syntax-highlighted code for reports via one highlight_code tool: 68 languages, 15 themes, 11 output formats (inline HTML, Word-ready SVG/PNG, LaTeX), incl. the classic SyntaxHighlighter themes. PNG output needs Python 3 with Pillow; other formats need no external runtime.
description.zh: 报告代码高亮：一个 highlight_code 工具，68 种语言、15 套主题、11 种输出（内联 HTML、Word 可插 SVG/PNG、LaTeX 等），含 codeinword.com 同款 SyntaxHighlighter 经典主题。PNG 输出需 Python 3 与 Pillow，其他格式无额外依赖。

description.en: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
description.zh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮起：角标、标签页标题计数、按状态换色的鲸鱼 favicon。

description.en: Multi-agent agent team of employee AI subagents for DeepSeek Harness — dsh-company: employee management, CEO bidding, n8n workflow orchestration, drag and drop canvas. DeepSeek Harness plugin with seven built-in roles (project director, product manager, tech lead, engineer, data analyst, QA, reviewer), each with its own persona, model and tool whitelist. Broadcast a mission and the employees bid for it themselves — the first line of their answer must be 【accept】 or 【decline】 — so accepted work runs in parallel instead of down a pipeline. The workflow canvas wires employee nodes with the start node, references each upstream result with {{input}}, and runs the graph in topological layers: parallel across employees, serial per employee, downstream skipped when upstream fails. Ships a web panel for the employee management tab, the mission board and each employee's transcript, the /dsh-company slash command, a live mirror into the built-in agent-team panel, deletable missions, and a private memory directory per employee.
description.zh: dsh-company：多智能体 AI 团队、子智能体公司。员工管理、CEO 认单派活、n8n 式工作流编排：拖拽员工节点到画布、连线、并行执行。DeepSeek Harness 插件，七个内置角色（项目总监、产品经理、技术总监、工程师、数据分析师、测试工程师、审核员），每人各有人设、模型与工具白名单。任务广播下去，员工自己决定接不接——回复第一行必须是【接单】或【不接】——接单的人并行开工，而不是走流水线。工作流画布用开始节点串起员工节点，用 {{input}} 引用上游产出，图按拓扑分层执行：跨员工并行、同员工串行、上游失败下游自动跳过。附员工管理、任务板与员工对话详情的网页面板，/dsh-company 斜杠命令，与内置 agent-team 面板的实时联动，可删除的任务，以及每员工独立的记忆目录。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for DSH with a whale-girl icon, background server startup, and a Chromium app-mode window without browser chrome.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 桌面启动器，提供鲸鱼娘图标、后台服务启动和无浏览器工具栏的 Chromium 应用窗口。

description.en: Set the startup window size of DeepSeek Harness Desktop from a settings page, with 4:3, 16:9 and 16:10 presets and up to 12 custom presets.
description.zh: 在设置页设置 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版启动时的窗口大小，内置 4:3、16:9、16:10 比例预设，支持保存最多 12 个自定义预设。

description.en: Turns file and directory paths in DSH chat into clickable buttons: click one to preview the file in the right sidebar, or open it with the system default application.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话中的文件与目录路径变成可点击按钮：点击即在右侧侧边栏预览，或用系统默认程序打开。

description.en: Switch providers from the left column and choose a model from the right; hover, focus or click a provider to update the model list.
description.zh: 左侧切换供应商，右侧直接选择模型；悬停、聚焦或点击供应商即可切换右侧模型列表。

description.en: A draggable floating window with three tabs — meals, water, standing. It picks breakfast, lunch and dinner at random (three tries a day, no repeats, editable food lists), counts water cups and standing breaks, and reminds you with a distinct 3-second chime per tab. Collapses to a 32px ball.
description.zh: 可拖动的悬浮小窗，分吃饭、喝水、站立三个 tab：随机决定三餐（每天各 3 次机会、不重复、可增删菜品），记录喝水与站立，每类提醒各用一种音色响约 3 秒；可收成 32px 悬浮球。

description.en: Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring with a pure-function engine — the work itself is the game.
description.zh: 把开发变成 RPG：回合/工具/todo 积累 XP、27+ 成就徽章、等级与赛季。事件流驱动、纯函数计分——你的工作就是游戏。

description.en: Renders local audio/video paths as inline, playable previews in DSH chat: replaces paths with <audio>/<video> players backed by same-origin /api/media-preview/* route, with explicit error statuses.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天记录中自动将本地音视频路径渲染为可播放预览：将路径替换为同源 /api/media-preview/* 路由支持的 <audio>/<video> 播放器，并返回明确的错误状态码。

description.en: Web interface enhancements for DeepSeek Harness with session rename/fork shortcuts, a searchable model picker with provider filters, mobile layouts, global font scaling, context usage alerts, DeepSeek balance and tariff rates, sent-message navigation, and conversation summaries.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页交互增强，提供会话重命名与分叉快捷操作、带搜索和供应商筛选的模型选择器、移动端布局、全局字体缩放、上下文用量提醒、DeepSeek 余额与峰谷价格、已发消息导航和对话情况总结。

description.en: Fork of @michengai/dsh-pua that removes the upstream global kill-switch so the composer entry is always visible while the feature stays off by default and can be toggled per session; the entry is a dropdown (Turn on / Turn off / Options) with a more compact options panel.
description.zh: 基于 @michengai/dsh-pua 的修订版：解除上游「全局总闸」，让入口恒常显示、功能默认关闭并可按会话开关；入口改为下拉菜单（打开 / 关闭 / 选项），选项面板更紧凑。

description.en: Gives the agent its own context usage through a context_usage tool plus one reading line per turn, with an editable template.
description.zh: 通过 context_usage 工具与每轮一行读数让 Agent 读懂自己的上下文占用，注入模板可编辑。

description.en: Automatically disables a failing plugin so the rest of DSH keeps booting — by patching DSH’s own installed kernel (mount-time quarantine + self-healing), not preflight smoke-tests. Includes status tools and a one-click restore panel.
description.zh: 自动隔离损坏插件、让 DSH 其余插件照常启动——通过补丁 DSH 自身已安装的内核实现（挂载期隔离 + 补丁自愈），而非 preflight 冒烟测试。附带状态工具与一键恢复面板。

description.en: Superself's self CLI as model-facing tools (project context, work units, reports, decisions) plus a /self command — cross-session, cross-project project state kept outside the code repo.
description.zh: 把 Superself 的 self CLI 暴露为模型工具（项目上下文、工作单元、报告、决策）并提供 /self 命令——跨会话、跨项目的项目状态，保存在代码仓库之外。

description.en: Persistent image or MP4 wallpaper for the DSH Web profile: a wallpaper card under Settings -> General selects a local image or MP4 (up to 300 MB), tunes surface opacity and blur, compresses video locally to H.264 when ffmpeg/ffprobe are on PATH, stores media under ~/.dsh/wallpapers, and pins the Web server to port 9191 so the saved wallpaper survives restarts.
description.zh: DSH Web 持久化背景图/视频插件：在 设置 -> 通用 中提供壁纸卡片，可选本地图片或 MP4（最大 300 MB），调节表层透明度与模糊；检测到 ffmpeg/ffprobe 时在本机把视频压缩为 H.264；媒体保存到 ~/.dsh/wallpapers；并将 Web 服务固定到 9191 端口以便重启后恢复壁纸。

description.en: Slacking-off companion: a floating mini player that streams Bilibili videos (native player, danmaku, comments, search) and pauses when your agent needs you, resuming exactly where you left off.
description.zh: 摸鱼伴侣：右下角小窗播放 B站视频（原生播放器/弹幕/评论/搜索），agent 需要你时自动暂停提醒，处理完从原位置精确续播。

description.en: Turns a DSH conversation into a floating window that stays usable over plugin and automation pages — on screen, minimised to a left-sidebar taskbar row, or docked into the right sidebar.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话变成悬浮窗，在插件页与自动化页之上仍旧可用——浮在页面上、缩到左侧边栏任务栏行，或停靠进右侧边栏。

description.en: Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop.
description.zh: 输入框麦克风：点击持续监控、按住对话；浏览器语音识别逐字上屏，回复由 host Edge TTS 边生成边朗读，朗读时暂停识别防回声，点击可停止。

description.en: DSH port of TokenEconomizer with cross-session project knowledge, opt-in tool pruning, failure-loop redirection, and token usage records.
description.zh: TokenEconomizer 的 DSH 移植版，提供跨会话项目知识、需主动应用的工具裁剪、失败循环引导与 token 用量记录。

description.en: Lists archived sessions, previews their content, restores them to the original workspace, and adds an optional archive confirmation.
description.zh: 列出已归档会话、预览内容、恢复到原工作区，并提供可选的归档二次确认。

description.en: Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache tool for stats and clearing.
description.zh: 为 DSH read 工具提供版本令牌校验的进程内结果缓存：未变更文件的重复读取跳过文件 I/O 与行渲染，附带 readcache 工具查看统计与清空。

description.en: Shows the balance or Coding Plan quota of the active model provider in the dsh status line, model menu and Current Model label, with background-collected history and trend charts.
description.zh: 在 dsh 状态行、模型菜单与「当前模型」标签显示当前模型供应商的余额或 Coding Plan 额度，后台采集历史数据并以趋势图展示变化。

description.en: Groups the sidebar's panel rows: two stay pinned, the rest fold under a collapsible Tools row, and rows can be dragged between the two groups.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板分组：两行常驻，其余收进可折叠的「工具」组，支持拖动互相搬运。

description.en: Running panel for dsh for skill management and visualizing skill calls: live skill and tool calls, the skill-catalog token budget against a line that follows the model's context window, a skill loadout window that enables and disables skills in bulk with dry run and undo, goals and ideas, and saved conversation excerpts. Applying a loadout moves skill folders between ~/.agents/skills and ~/.agents/skills-parked, which other apps share (dry run first, undo available); automatic translation, goal inference and idea collection call your default model only after you opt in on first open.
description.zh: dsh 运行面板，用于技能管理与 Skill 调用可视化：实时显示技能调用和工具调用；技能目录占用的 token 预算，预算线随模型上下文窗口变化；技能装配窗口可批量启用、停用技能，带预演和撤销；另有目标与灵感、对话收藏。应用技能装配会在共享的 ~/.agents/skills 与 ~/.agents/skills-parked 之间移动技能目录（先预演、可撤销），其他应用也会受影响；自动翻译、目标推断和灵感收集只有在首次打开时选择开启后，才会调用你的默认模型。

description.en: Extensible AI-driven group-reaction narrative game framework for DeepSeek Harness: type one action and multiple NPCs each respond in their own chatroom message with avatar illustrations; worlds, locations, NPCs and feature extensions (e.g. a third-party drawing API for dynamic NPC expressions) are added and modified through the harness chat dialog without code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：可扩展的 AI 群像聊天游戏框架。输入一个行动，多个 NPC 各自回应，每条反应独立成带头像插图的聊天室消息；世界、地点、NPC 与功能扩展（如接入第三方绘图 API 实现 NPC 动态表情动作）都可以在对话框里让 agent 直接添加修改，无需写代码。

description.en: Diagnoses current and saved DeepSeek Harness trajectories with AgentDebugX and opens structured reports in its dashboard.
description.zh: 使用 AgentDebugX 诊断当前及已保存的 DeepSeek Harness 轨迹，并在其仪表盘中打开结构化报告。

description.en: Adds a 3D model library in its own conversation tab, where agents store models built from CadQuery scripts or supplied as tessellated meshes; the library previews them with three-cad-viewer, organises them into folders and exports them to 10 formats including STEP, BREP, STL and DXF.
description.zh: 在对话界面新增「3D模型」标签页作为模型库：agent 把 CadQuery 脚本或已剖分的网格存入服务端，标签页用 three-cad-viewer 预览、按文件夹整理，并可导出 STEP、BREP、STL、DXF 等 10 种格式。

description.en: Right-sidebar session timeline: fishbone layout of every workspace session with native fork/handoff lineage, manual drag links, branch fan-outs, archived-session display and per-turn detail browsing.
description.zh: 右侧栏会话时间线：以鱼骨布局展示工作区全部会话，含原生 fork/handoff 血缘、手工拖拽衔接、分支扇出、归档会话显示与逐轮详情浏览。

description.en: Adds a sentient floating eye to DeepSeek Harness — injects a taming kernel that makes the AI truly understand you, with 11 dynamic eye skins, ghost mode, and zero token cost when AI mode is off.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上会开智的智子：注入驯兽内核让 AI 真正懂你，11 款动态皮肤、幽灵模式，关闭 AI 模式即零 token 消耗。

description.en: Replaces the composer model picker with a model + thinking-effort picker: arrow keys left/right cycle the effort level and arrow keys up/down switch model; an Auto level scores each turn by how far the conversation has drifted from the main objective and by repeated failures (one extra small judge call per turn), picks the effort from that score, and labels every finished turn with the effort it sent.
description.zh: 用「模型 + 思考强度」选择器替换输入框的模型选择器：← → 切换思考档位，↑ ↓ 切换模型；Auto 档依照对话偏离主要目的的程度和重复失败次数给每轮打分（每轮多一次小模型判分调用），据此选择思考强度，并在每轮结束后标出该轮发送的档位。

description.en: Grabs a live frame from the local webcam and hands it to the agent as an image, so the model can actually look through the camera without opening any app or keeping a window in front. A dim room no longer comes back black — brightness, gamma, contrast, sharpen and an auto-level pass run inside the capture itself. ffmpeg is fetched automatically on first use, and the same plugin lists the available capture devices.
description.zh: 从本机摄像头抓一帧实时画面，以图片形式交给 agent，让它真正从摄像头看见画面——不用打开相机应用，也不要求窗口在前台。暗光房间不会再拍成一片黑，亮度、伽马、对比度、锐化和自动拉伸都在抓帧时一次做完。首次使用时自动下载 ffmpeg，配套还有一个工具用于列出可用采集设备。

description.en: Turns a streaming assistant reply into short blips, one per character at a configurable minimum spacing, for the reply text only, and keeps sounding when the window is minimized, covered, or in a background tab. Two built-in voices, or a custom one shaped by waveform, or loaded from an audio file.
