description.zh: 把流式输出的助手回复变成短促音效：按可调的最小间隔逐字发声，只对回复正文发声，窗口最小化、被遮挡或切到后台标签页时照常发声。内置两种音色，也可自调波形，或载入音频文件当音色。

description.en: Expires stale dsh-auth sign-in cookies once the Cookie request header passes 4 KiB, so per-port cookie accumulation can never reach Node's 16 KiB header limit (HTTP 431).
description.zh: 当 Cookie 请求头超过 4 KiB 时，自动过期失效的 dsh-auth 登录 Cookie，避免按端口累积的 Cookie 撑到 Node 的 16 KiB 请求头上限（HTTP 431）。

description.en: Connects the Qixin Insight MCP server over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE as a single plugin entry, mounting its tools as mcp__qixin_insight__* with automatic token refresh and revocation on disconnect.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE 授权接入启信慧眼 MCP 服务，以单条插件条目把它的工具挂载为 mcp__qixin_insight__*，token 到期前自动刷新，断开时吊销。

description.en: Floating FC/NES game hall for DSH Web with fceumm, local ROM upload, and GitHub online library.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右下角挂悬浮球打开 FC/NES 游戏厅（fceumm），支持本地上传与自填 GitHub 在线库。

description.en: Replaces the DSH sidebar list with a workspace rail: pinned chats and folders, projects that are folders with their own AGENTS.md and files, a virtualized Recents list ordered by the last finished turn, a project_search tool, unread markers, a collapsed icon column with an unread count and a live browser tab title.
description.zh: 用工作区栏替代 DSH 侧栏列表：置顶会话与文件夹；项目即带自有 AGENTS.md 和文件的文件夹；Recents 为按最后一次完成 turn 排序的虚拟列表；提供 project_search 工具、未读标记、带未读数的折叠图标栏，以及随会话实时更新的浏览器标签标题。

description.en: Data-circulation assessor: scores how readily a dataset can circulate, covering trusted-data-space access readiness and transaction-compliance pre-checks, with improvement recommendations.
description.zh: 数据流通评估插件：给数据集的可流通性打分，覆盖可信数据空间接入就绪度与交易合规预判，并给出改进建议。

description.en: Runs PowerShell scripts through base64 encoding, so quotes, $, backslashes and CJK survive as written. Same sandbox channel as the built-in pwsh tool.
description.zh: 把 PowerShell 脚本 base64 编码后执行，引号、$、反斜杠、中文全部原样传递，免去转义地狱。走与内置 pwsh 工具相同的沙箱通道。

description.en: Routes the DSH web_search tool through Ollama's web search API, reusing OLLAMA_API_KEY. No DeepSeek official key needed.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 web_search 工具走 Ollama 联网搜索 API，复用 OLLAMA_API_KEY，无需 DeepSeek 官方 Key。

description.en: Classic 25/5/15 pomodoro timer for DSH that ties each run to the current session task or a manual project name, with a stats panel, a 365-day heatmap, a draggable floating timer and a corner pill, local JSON storage, and CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 番茄钟：经典 25/5/15 计时，可将每次专注关联当前会话任务或手动输入项目名，内置统计面板与全年热力图，配可拖动悬浮计时卡与角落迷你药丸，数据本地持久化并支持导出 CSV。

description.en: Forgetting-curve in-place dialogue compression for DeepSeek Harness: recent turns stay verbatim, middle turns are structurally dehydrated (zero-LLM), ancient turns fold into a bounded summary pair — unbounded conversations on a bounded memory budget.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于自然遗忘曲线的就地对话压缩：近期对话逐字保留、中期结构化脱水（零 LLM 成本）、久远对话折叠为有界摘要对——有限记忆预算上的无限对话。

description.en: One-click health check for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 score, plain-language issue list, and safe reversible fixes via the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
description.zh: 一键体检你的 DeepSeek Harness：0-100 健康评分、问题清单，以及写入 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 的安全可逆一键修复。

description.en: Embeds a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in the local DSH window over an SSH tunnel, lists the remote sessions, and switches between the local instance and any remote host.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 隧道把远端 DSH 的 GUI 嵌进本地 DSH 界面，列出远端会话，并在本地实例与任意远端主机之间切换。

description.en: Quote selected text from a DSH message into the composer as a blue chip, hover to read the full quote, and remove it with X or Backspace; sent quotes reach the model as a blockquote.
description.zh: 划选 DSH 消息中的文字，右键引用为输入框里的蓝色小块；悬停查看全文，点 ✕ 或按 Backspace 删除；发送后引用以 blockquote 原文交给模型。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the official Vercel MCP server over OAuth, with per-Agent on-demand tool loading, slimmed tool schemas, paged long results and 34 bundled Vercel skills.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 把 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Vercel 官方 MCP 服务，支持按 Agent 按需加载工具、精简工具 schema、长结果分页，并附带 34 个 Vercel 技能。

description.en: Mail for DSH: IMAP, POP3, SMTP and OAuth2 accounts with a reading tab, API senders, scheduled and CSV bulk sends with unsubscribe handling, and mail_* agent tools. The Mail tab appears inside dsh-better-sidebar; the agent tools work without it.
description.zh: DSH 的邮件客户端：接入 IMAP、POP3、SMTP 与 OAuth2 账号，提供侧栏阅读标签页、API 发信、定时与 CSV 批量发信（含退订处理），以及 mail_* agent 工具。阅读标签页需配合 dsh-better-sidebar，未装时 agent 工具仍可用。

description.en: Codex-backed `web_search`, `image_gen`, and `image_vision` tools for DeepSeek Harness, reusing ChatGPT OAuth login state.
description.zh: 基于 Codex 的 `web_search`、`image_gen` 与 `image_vision` 工具，复用 ChatGPT OAuth 登录态为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索、生图与识图能力。

description.en: Ships a skill about writing DSH skills - SKILL.md frontmatter and root precedence, how to phrase a description so it actually triggers, length and splitting rules, and an A/B check that the finished skill changes agent behaviour. The package also carries the checker the skill uses to validate a skill directory.
description.zh: 携带一份讲怎么写 DSH 技能的技能——SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 与技能根优先级、description 怎么写才会被触发、篇幅与拆分标准，以及「写完后怎么证明它真管用」的 A/B 验证。包里还带着供这份技能校验技能目录的检查脚本。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu to selected text in the Harness Web UI that replaces it with a Simplified Chinese translation in place, and restores the original on a second right-click.
description.zh: 在 Harness Web UI 中为选中文字添加右键翻译菜单，可就地替换为简体中文译文，再次右键还原原文。

description.en: Cross-workspace DSH messaging and sender navigation, with bounded same-workspace context and opt-in local Claude Code messaging.
description.zh: 支持 DSH 跨工作区消息与发送方导航、同工作区受限上下文，以及可选的本机 Claude Code 双向通信。

description.en: Novel writing panel for the DSH sidebar that binds a local manuscript folder, imports Agent Skills as analysis lenses, and scans platform rankings into story-structure outlines.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的小说创作面板：绑定本地书稿目录，把导入的 Agent 技能当作分析视角，并扫描平台榜单归纳故事架构。

description.en: Liquid Glass refraction input card for the DSH web GUI, with coupled-spring press animation. Published on npm: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 输入卡加上液态玻璃折射效果与弹簧按压动画。已发布 npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input。

description.en: Theme presets, a DIY palette editor with per-mode accents, bold borders, fonts, and interface text size for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供主题预设、DIY 调色与各模式强调色、加粗边框、字体与界面字号。

description.en: Opens a dedicated question chat in the right sidebar for text selected in a DSH conversation, so follow-up questions do not push the main conversation away and never appear in the session list.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中一段文字，右侧栏即开出独立的提问对话，与主对话分屏并排，追问不会顶走正在学的内容，也不会出现在左侧会话列表里。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu on file references in chat output, listing registered applications with icons for open-with, revealing files in the file manager, and copying absolute or relative paths resolved against the session workspace, while code blocks, plain text and external links keep the native menu.
description.zh: 为聊天输出中的文件引用添加右键菜单，列出系统关联应用（带图标）供选择打开，在文件管理器中定位文件，并复制基于会话工作区解析的绝对或相对路径；代码块、普通文本与外部链接保持原生菜单。

description.en: A time module in the DSH session header: current time, time since your last message, reminders, and countdowns. Pure browser-side - data lives in localStorage and the host half registers nothing. Alerts are a border glow plus an in-app toast; no system notifications.
description.zh: DSH 会话头部的时间模块：现在时间、距你上次发言、提醒与倒计时。纯前端插件——数据存浏览器 localStorage，host 半不注册任何东西；到点提示是边框呼吸灯加界面浮条，不发系统通知。

description.en: A 3×3 pad of saved phrases sitting to the left of the composer and tracking the input box's height: clicking a cell inserts its text at the caret as one undoable edit. Presets are editable in place, 9 cells per page up to 12 pages, and the UI follows the DSH language setting. Falls back to a panel above the composer when the window leaves no room.
description.zh: 输入框左侧的九宫格快捷短语面板，高度跟随输入框：点一格就把该条短语以一次可撤销的编辑插入光标处；面板内可就地编辑，每页 9 格、最多 12 页，界面跟随 DSH 语言设置。窗口放不下时退回输入框上方浮层。

description.en: Self-organizing multi-agent clusters with no orchestrator. Real DSH subagents coordinate through a shared append-only log that each agent reads and writes on its own schedule, with no topology and one dispatch per agent; a snapshot mode is also included where the harness freezes each neighbour view into the prompt and drives a ring/mesh/swarm cluster to convergence.
description.zh: 无编排者的自组织多智能体集群。真实 DSH 子智能体通过共享的只追加日志协调，由各智能体自行决定读写时机，无拓扑、每个智能体只派发一次；另附快照模式，由调度层把邻居视图冻结进提示词并驱动环形/网状/群集收敛。

description.en: Codex-style tool call folding, collapsing multiple tool calls into a single line.
description.zh: Codex 风格的工具调用折叠，将多个工具调用折叠到一行内。

description.en: Semantic UI sound effects powered by uisfx: task start/success/failure and per-button cues, settings UI with instant preview, 12 sound packs, Host-persisted preferences, and `ctx.uisfx` service for other plugins.
description.zh: 基于 uisfx 的语义化 UI 音效：任务开始/成功/失败、不同按钮情景 cue，设置页即时试听，12 种音色包，Host 持久化，并提供 `ctx.uisfx` 服务给其他插件。

description.en: Provides the see_image tool for DSH: send an image file to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision model and relay its description back to a text-only model.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 see_image 工具：将图片文件发送到可配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，并把其描述回传给纯文本模型。

description.en: Sidebar panel for account balances and local token usage, with provider/model breakdowns and a 27-week daily heatmap.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板展示账户余额与本地 Token 用量，包含供应商/模型明细和 27 周每日热力图。

description.en: Adds approval-gated Git status, diff, log, commit, branch, and optional checkpoint tools.
description.zh: 增加需要审批的 Git 状态、diff、日志、提交、分支和可选检查点工具。

description.en: Two round buttons at the foot of the DSH desktop sidebar on Windows: restart the app without a console window ever flashing on screen, and open the DeepSeek top-up page in your browser. The restart path launches the helper through WMI and wscript so the new process never inherits a console; it verifies the executable path before killing anything and preserves the original command line. Windows 10/11 only (the package declares os: win32).
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 桌面端侧边栏底部加两个圆形按钮：重启应用（全程不闪黑窗）和打开 DeepSeek 充值页。重启走 WMI + wscript 拉起 helper，新进程不继承控制台；动手前会先核对可执行文件路径，并保留原始命令行。仅支持 Windows 10/11（包声明 os: win32）。

description.en: Session-context surfaces ported from T3 Code: a session-row hover card showing machine, git branch, model, agent preset, approval policy and token usage, a status pill covering pending approval, awaiting input, working, error and subagent work, a provider and model chip, a per-session header strip, a lineage breadcrumb, row-menu actions that copy the context or run DSH compaction, and a preference row in DSH Settings for choosing which facts appear. Nothing is added to the composer.
description.zh: 移植 T3 Code 的会话上下文界面：会话行悬浮卡显示机器、Git 分支、模型、代理预设、审批策略与 token 用量，状态标签覆盖待审批、等待输入、运行中、错误与子代理工作，另有提供方与模型标记、会话头部信息条、血缘面包屑、可复制上下文或执行 DSH 压缩的行菜单操作，以及位于 DSH 设置中用于选择显示哪些事实的偏好行。输入框区域不新增任何元素。

description.en: Fold the DSH left sidebar's plugin entries into a single 「插件列表」 row with grouping and custom ordering, giving vertical space back to the workspace and session list; expanding restores the full entry list.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧那排插件入口折成一行「插件列表」，支持按组归类与自定义顺序，把纵向空间还给工作区与会话列表；展开即恢复完整入口。

description.en: Personal-experience memory for DSH: turns solved tasks into sourced problem cases with condition-scoped claims, recalls them into new tasks via hidden pre-step injection, and makes corrections/deletes cascade to future recall.
description.zh: 个人经验记忆：把真实解决过的问题存为带来源、可纠正、有适用条件的案例，新任务中自动召回复用，纠正与删除会级联影响后续召回。

description.en: Resolve a shared URL into title, author, body text, cover and direct video links: Bilibili, Douyin, Xiaoheihe and GitHub are parsed structurally, while WeChat, Zhihu and other pages fall back to an OpenGraph summary (title, description, cover). Includes an optional download step for sending the media back through chat.
description.zh: 把聊天里的分享链接解析成标题、作者、正文、封面与视频直链：B站、抖音、小黑盒、GitHub 走结构化解析，微信、知乎等其它页面退回 OpenGraph 摘要（标题、简介、封面）；可把媒体下载到本地后发回聊天。

description.en: Replaces the built-in compaction provider: at a configurable fraction of the context threshold (85% by default) a detached task summarizes everything up to the previous turn, and the next step boundary commits that held summary as a checkpoint with zero model calls, so the swap itself takes milliseconds. /bcompact \[message] starts the same generation on demand and then sends the message. A settings page sets the trigger ratio, the summarization model, and how many consecutive failures stop background generation until a half-open probe gets through. Subagent sessions, a changed prefix or an expired summary fall back to the built-in synchronous path.
description.zh: 接管内置压缩 provider：默认在上下文达到阈值的 85%（比例可配）时，起一个游离任务把截至上一轮的历史总结成摘要；摘要就绪后的下一个回合边界直接把它提交为 checkpoint，这一步 0 次模型调用、耗时毫秒级。/bcompact \[消息] 按需发起同样的生成，随后照常发送你的消息。设置页可改自动触发比例、摘要模型，以及连续失败多少次后停止后台生成（熔断打开后按冷却放行一次探针以自愈）。子代理会话、前缀已变动或摘要过期时，回退到内置的同步压缩路径。

description.en: Drives the GME Test Agent from inside Harness: three tools list interface catalogs, start and repair autonomous test generation in a local Python backend, poll the task until review, and keep PR, skip and cleanup actions behind explicit user consent.
description.zh: 在 Harness 内驱动 GME Test Agent：三个工具负责列出接口目录、在本地 Python 后端启动并修复自主测试生成、轮询任务直到待评审，并把创建 PR、跳过与清理等动作挡在用户显式同意之后。

description.en: AI form filling and spreadsheet autofill for XLSX in DeepSeek Harness, using authorized Qichacha MCP facts with cell previews, user confirmation and export to a new copy.
description.zh: AI填表智能体：支持自动填表、表格填充、表格补全、Excel填表与 Excel回填；使用企查查 MCP 填写 XLSX 空白字段，预览确认后导出新副本。

description.en: Daily sending quotas and quiet hours for agent mailboxes: letters are counted in named buckets that each carry a per-day limit, the day boundary is configurable, and a quiet window tells the core to hold online letters rather than deliver them.
description.zh: 智能体信箱的每日配额与免打扰时段：信件按命名桶计数、每桶有每日上限，日界可配置，并给出一个免打扰窗口，让核心把在线件留着而不投递。

description.en: Composer readouts for the DeepSeek Harness: CJK-weighted draft token count, session spend at official peak/idle rates, context occupancy, and what the same usage would have cost on the costliest other model; client-only, with no host half and no credential access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方的实时草稿 token 数、按官方高峰/空闲费率计算的会话花费、上下文占用，以及同样的用量在最贵的另一个模型上会花多少；纯客户端，没有 host 半，不接触凭据。

description.en: Jujutsu (jj) version-control panel in the DSH web GUI: a Jujutsu tab renders the jj log change graph with change details, changed files and file diffs, a revset input, and jj-native history edits (drag-to-rebase, split by file, describe, squash, abandon, undo, push); it reads jj directly rather than through git, and every command runs as an argv array through a whitelisted host service with confirmations, timeouts and output caps.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 里的 Jujutsu（jj）版本控制面板：「Jujutsu」标签页把 jj log 渲染成 change 图，含 change 详情、改动文件与文件差异、revset 输入框，以及 jj 原生历史改写（拖拽 rebase、按文件拆分、修改描述、压缩、放弃、撤销、推送）；直接读 jj 而不经过 git 转译，所有命令以 argv 数组经白名单化的宿主服务执行，带确认、超时与输出上限。

description.en: Sidebar token and cost curve for the current conversation plus a local ledger across all sessions: monthly/weekly rollups, per-turn detail, Excel export with print-ready A4 layout, and a live account balance. Reads session logs only, prices every message by its own peak/off-peak timestamp, and drops fork-inherited history so it is never billed twice. Desktop app only, verified on Windows; the live balance needs a signed-in DSH account.
description.zh: 右栏 Token 曲线 + 账本：当前对话逐轮 token 与费用，本机全部会话按月/周汇总，逐轮明细可导出 Excel，顶部实时显示账户余额。只读会话日志，逐条按峰谷计价，分叉会话抄来的历史不重复计费。仅桌面端，仅在 Windows 上验证；实时余额需登录 DSH 账号。

description.en: Cloudflare D1 tools for agents: d1_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health over the D1 HTTP API, read-only by default with a SQLite-accurate lexical guard, LIMIT row cap, CSV/JSON query output and an approval-gated write path.
description.zh: Cloudflare D1 数据库工具：d1_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health，通过 D1 HTTP API 访问，默认只读（SQLite 语义的词法级只读保护）、LIMIT 行数上限、CSV/JSON 查询输出与写审批门。

description.en: A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous results reported by voice.
description.zh: dsh 的对话式语音前端 Agent：通过 ByteDance Duplex 自然对话，把语音请求委派给后台任务，并用语音回报异步结果。

description.en: Edit Markdown in place in the right sidebar and send inline comments to the agent, which resolves each one it handles.
description.zh: 在右侧栏直接编辑 Markdown，把行内评论发给 Agent，处理完自动标记解决。

description.en: Cross-workspace worker fleets: one orchestrating session spawns named worker sessions in other project workspaces, queues or steers tasks into them, watches them in the background via a real host job, and collects their reports. Worker completions deliver themselves to the orchestrator's session rather than needing to be polled, so an idle orchestrator still reacts. Escalations and failed workers deliver by steer when the orchestrator is mid-turn and by queue when it is idle; a turn that ends without a report counts as a failure and the worker is replaced after a configurable limit. The roster persists to disk and each worker session carries a durable title, so a restart neither loses the fleet nor spawns duplicate sessions. Ships five agent presets at full plugin parity with the standard preset.
description.zh: 跨工作区的多智能体工舰队：一个编排会话在其他项目工作区中创建具名的 worker 会话，向其排队或插队下发任务，以后台任务的方式监视其进度，并收集其报告。worker 完成后主动把消息投递到编排会话，无需轮询，空闲的编排器同样能及时反应。当编排器正在执行任务时，升级提问与失败通知以 steer 方式送达，空闲时以 queue 方式送达；一个回合结束时若未提交报告即判定为失败，达到阈值后自动替换该 worker。名册持久化到磁盘，且每个 worker 会话带有持久标题，重启既不会丢失工舰队，也不会产生重复会话。附带五个智能体预设，插件清单与 standard 预设完全一致。

description.en: Task-list staleness guard for DeepSeek Harness: watches the session event stream and counts tool calls since the last todo_write; past a configurable threshold it appends one short notice before the next step, quoting the current list, so the model writes it back to the real progress instead of leaving a stale snapshot on screen. Pure prompt injection, no blocking and no data mutation.
description.zh: 任务清单陈旧度守卫：监听会话事件流，统计上一次 todo_write 之后又发生了多少次工具调用；超过可配置阈值时在下一步之前追加一条简短提醒，并附上当前清单内容，让模型把清单写回真实进度，而不是在界面上留一份过期的快照。纯提示注入，不阻断流程，也不改动任何数据。

description.en: A right-side floating panel and /context command for DeepSeek Harness — a live donut chart of context token usage, allocation, and estimated cost.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供右侧悬浮栏以及 /context 命令，用环形图实时展示当前上下文 token 用量与分配及消费估算。

description.en: Kaze Tachinu (The Wind Rises) skin for the DSH Web GUI: a full-screen film wallpaper behind glassmorphism surfaces, sky-blue interaction tokens, redrawn vector logos for the sidebar and home hero, a restyled composer card with themed placeholder text, and a bottom fade on the message list.
description.zh: 宫崎骏《起风了》主题皮肤：全屏电影壁纸配毛玻璃界面，交互色统一为天蓝，侧边栏与首页改用自绘矢量徽标，输入卡重绘为主题化占位文案的云海蓝胶囊，并为消息列加 40px 底部渐隐。

description.en: Persistent conversation outline: per-turn questions and final replies, keyword filter, one-click jump, light/full history modes, and Ctrl/Shift+click to open the same position in the Trajectory view.
description.zh: 对话栏左侧常驻大纲：按轮次列出提问与最后回复，关键词过滤与一键跳转，轻便/全面两种历史模式，按住 Ctrl/Shift 单击可跳到轨迹视图同一位置。

description.en: Tender search and bid intelligence in DeepSeek Harness with proposed project search, rule screening, human review and Excel/PDF exports using user-authorized Qichacha MCP.
description.zh: 招投标智能体：支持招投标搜索、招标查询、投标查询、标讯查询、拟建项目与项目筛选，辅助商机发现、人工复核及 Excel/PDF 导出，使用客户自备授权的企查查 MCP。

description.en: Adds a Graph tab that renders one session's execution as an interactive DAG of turns, LLM steps, tools, skills, subagents, code changes and tests, with live status, retry aggregation, critical path and trajectory linkage.
description.zh: 在会话区新增「图谱」Tab，把单个会话的执行过程渲染为可交互 DAG：轮次、LLM 步骤、工具、技能、子代理、代码改动与测试，支持实时状态、重试聚合、关键路径与轨迹双向联动。

description.en: Yuque knowledge base as external memory for dsh — auto-injects matching document fragments into conversation, with catalogue search, cloud full-text search and online reading.
description.zh: 把语雀文档作为 dsh 的外部记忆：对话中自动检索并注入相关文档片段，支持目录快照检索、云端全文搜索与在线阅读。

description.en: Task-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness, playing the original opencode sounds for done, question, plan-review and error events with zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 复刻 opencode 的任务完成提示音，完成、提问、计划待审、出错四种场景播放原始音效，零外部依赖。

description.en: Save whole turns — the question plus the full answer — as plain Markdown inside the session workspace, promote the good ones into a cross-project personal knowledge base, and let the model search it on demand. No database and no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把整轮问答（问题 + 完整回答）存成工作区里的纯 Markdown；把值得留的提升进跨项目个人知识库，模型可按需检索。无数据库、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Adds a custom right-click context menu to the sidebar workspace files tree, with new folder, rename, reveal in file manager, open in browser, open in VS Code, copy path, streaming ZIP download, and delete.
description.zh: 为侧边栏「工作区文件」树添加自定义右键菜单：新建文件夹、重命名、在文件管理器中显示、浏览器打开、VS Code 打开、复制路径、流式 ZIP 下载、删除。

description.en: A per-turn token usage strip in each reply's icon row: a grey/yellow/green segmented bar plus a legend giving that turn's uncached-input, cache-read and output split and each one's share.
description.zh: 在每条回复的图标行里画一条单轮用量条：灰/黄/绿分段条配百分比图例，显示该轮未缓存输入、缓存读取与输出的拆分与各自占比。

description.en: Native DSH support for context-mode (mksglu/context-mode), intercepting large tool outputs with SQLite FTS5 indexing, BM25+RRF search, and session continuity. On by default: tool outputs over 4 KB are replaced with a short preview while the full text is indexed into ~/.context-mode/context.db, and a section is added to the system prompt. Its ctx_execute and ctx_batch tools run shell, Node, Python, PowerShell or cmd commands with DSH's own permissions and environment (not sandboxed), and ctx_index reads any local file path or fetches any http(s) URL it is given.
description.zh: 原生支持 context-mode (mksglu/context-mode)，通过 SQLite FTS5 拦截工具大输出并提供 BM25+RRF 搜索与会话连续性恢复。默认开启：超过 4 KB 的工具输出会被替换成简短预览，全文索引进 ~/.context-mode/context.db，并在系统提示里加一段说明。其 ctx_execute、ctx_batch 工具以 DSH 自身的权限和环境变量运行 shell / Node / Python / PowerShell / cmd 命令（没有沙箱），ctx_index 可读取任意本地文件路径或抓取任意 http(s) 地址。

description.en: Reads local AI session history from 16 AI tools plus Windows recent-file activity, and generates daily or weekly work reports on your machine. Currently Windows x64 only: the plugin ships a bundled Windows sidecar (no Python needed); macOS/Linux are not supported yet.
description.zh: 读取 16 个 AI 工具的本地会话记录，外加 Windows 最近文件活动，在本机生成日报或周报。目前仅支持 Windows x64：插件自带 Windows sidecar，无需安装 Python；macOS / Linux 暂不支持。

description.en: Adds a button left of the built-in Open In... in the session header that opens the current workspace directory in VS Code, fixing the desktop ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE environment leak that makes the built-in open-in-app fail with HTTP 502. Windows only: it locates Code.exe, so macOS and Linux are not supported yet.
description.zh: 在会话头部「打开方式」左侧新增按钮，一键在 VS Code 中打开当前工作区目录，修复桌面宿主 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 环境变量泄漏导致内置 open-in-app 启动 VS Code 失败（HTTP 502）的问题。仅支持 Windows：按 Code.exe 路径定位，macOS / Linux 尚未适配。

description.en: Web Audio lifecycle cues for DeepSeek Harness: ten configurable events, three low-noise defaults, per-event custom sounds, and no shipped audio assets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 生命周期提示音：10 个可配置事件，默认只开启三项低打扰提示，可为每个事件更换自定义声音，内置音效不带音频资源。

description.en: Ponytail lazy-senior-dev ruleset for DeepSeek Harness: a 7-rung minimal-code ladder (YAGNI, reuse, stdlib, native, installed deps, one line, minimum), six skills (main rules, over-engineering review, repo audit, debt ledger, gain scoreboard, help), a /ponytail session command for lite/full/ultra/off levels, and optional always-on ruleset injection via config. Vendored verbatim from upstream ponytail (MIT), zero tools registered, clean uninstall.
description.zh: 把「最懒资深工程师」规则集 ponytail 装进 DeepSeek Harness：7 级最小代码阶梯（YAGNI、复用、标准库、平台原生、已装依赖、一行、最小实现），六个技能（主规则、过度工程 review、全仓 audit、debt 欠账台账、gain 计分板、help 速查），/ponytail 会话级调档命令（lite/full/ultra/off），以及可选的每轮常驻规则注入。上游内容 MIT 原样打包，零工具注册，卸载零残留。

description.en: Two DSH delegation presets — a fixed 8-seat crew, or up to 3 day-rate temps by convention — with call-time guards that refuse the other shape's delegation tools. The 8-seat preset additionally needs @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile in the profile's dsh.profile.bundles; without it that preset has no team tools and degrades to solo work.
description.zh: 给 DSH 装两条干活形态——8 个固定工位的终身奴，或按约定一次最多点 3 个的日结奴；跨形态调用会在调用时被 guard 拒绝。8 工位形态还需在 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles 里挂 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile，否则该形态没有 Team 工具、会降级为单人作业。

description.en: Codex-style window capture for DSH Desktop on macOS and Windows: press both Command keys (macOS) or both Ctrl keys (Windows), or the camera button, to grab the frontmost window, attach it to the current chat, and inject a VoiceOver-style accessibility tree as hidden context.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的窗口截图，支持 macOS 和 Windows：macOS 按两边 Command、Windows 按两边 Ctrl（或点输入框旁相机）捕获当前前台窗口并附加到会话，同时把 VoiceOver 风格的辅助功能树注入为隐藏上下文。

description.en: An F1 Race Control theme for DSH Web with four switchable team skins, broadcast-photo backgrounds, light and dark modes, and native appearance controls.
description.zh: 一款适用于 DSH Web 的 F1 赛事控制中心主题，提供四支车队皮肤、赛事摄影背景、浅色与深色模式及原生外观设置。

description.en: A no-limit Texas holdem table where you are the only human. Eight seats: you plus seven LLM agents written on AI-founder personas (Altman, Dario Amodei, Musk, Liang Wenfeng, Jensen Huang, Lei Jun, Zhang Yiming). Each agent bets through the currently selected host model and falls back to its own heuristic style when no model is available; every agent only ever sees its own hole cards, because the prompt is built from that seat alone. A hand ends by revealing the winner hole cards, with a flip animation replayed on every community card, and a rail keeps a live action-and-table-talk timeline. LAN mode (off by default, single-machine play is unaffected) lets another install on the same network join this very table: the host shows a six-digit room code, UDP broadcast discovers nearby tables, and a joiner randomly takes over one bot seat, with the seat handed back to its character on leave or after twenty seconds of silence. The room code is never put on the wire and every snapshot is generated for one viewer seat, so nobody, not even the host, can read another player hole cards. Fork of BubblePtr/dsh-holdem (MIT), credited in the README and in the UI.
description.zh: 一张只有你一个人类的无限注德州扑克桌。八个座位：你，加上七位以 AI 创始人设写成的 LLM 智能体（Altman、达里奥、马斯克、梁文峰、黄仁勋、雷军、张一鸣）。每个智能体都通过宿主当前选中的模型下注，模型不可用时回落到自己的启发式风格；每个智能体只看得见自己的底牌，因为提示词只由它自己那个座位拼出来。一手结束时亮出赢家底牌，每张公共牌落地都会重播翻牌动画，侧栏保留实时的行动与桌边闲话时间线。局域网模式默认关闭、不影响单机玩法：同一网络里的另一份安装可以加入这张桌，主机屏幕显示 6 位房间号，UDP 广播负责发现附近的牌桌，加入者随机顶替一名人机座位，离开或静默二十秒后座位交还该角色。房间号从不上广播，且每份快照都按观看者座位生成，所以没有人（连主机也不行）能读到别人的底牌。本仓库是 BubblePtr/dsh-holdem（MIT）的 fork，README 与界面都保留了上游署名。

description.en: Snipping tool for the composer: freeze the screen, drag a region, annotate it, and drop the result into the message box. Windows only; the selector is a bundled WinForms binary (rebuilt from the included C# source if missing) and uses the built-in .NET Framework 4.x.
description.zh: 输入框旁的截图标注工具：冻结屏幕、拖框选区、就地标注，完成后直接插入输入框。仅 Windows；选区器为内置 WinForms 程序（缺失时用随包的 C# 源码重建），依赖系统自带 .NET Framework 4.x。

description.en: Knowledge-base-driven agent preset: wiki long-term memory, a web KB UI, a management page and optional UI polish.
description.zh: 知识库驱动的 Agent 预设：wiki 长期记忆、网页知识库、管理页、可选界面润色。

description.en: Real DeepSeek account balance and official spend tracker in the session header, with peak/off-peak badge, monetary alert with auto-stop, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: 会话头部的真实 DeepSeek 余额与官方消费统计：高峰/空闲标签、按金额提醒与自动停止、一键充值。

description.en: Prompt library stored in the plugin config, with a Settings page and a composer picker: the ticked prompts are injected into every model step of that session, and a subagent inherits the selection of its nearest ancestor session.
description.zh: 提示词库存放在插件配置中，含 Settings 页面与输入框选择器：勾中的提示词注入该会话的每一步模型调用，subagent 继承其最近祖先会话的选择。

description.en: Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path input.
description.zh: Web UI 增强版工作区目录选择器：WSL 下 /mnt Windows 盘符一键直达、完整面包屑层级与常显路径输入框。

description.en: Scans recent sessions locally for real token usage, scores context health on a floating dashboard and plays a token-ledger animation with made-up figures; its one action opens a new empty session, the same as /new, and nothing is deleted. A parody plugin that makes no model calls.
description.zh: 在本地扫描近期会话的真实 token 用量，在悬浮仪表盘上给出上下文健康度评分，并播放数字是编的 token 账本动画；唯一的动作是开一个新的空会话，等同 /new，不会删除任何内容。恶搞性质的插件，不调用模型。

description.en: Adds chunked uploads with progress and resume, and native downloads of workspace files and the session log ZIP, to the DSH Web GUI, including sessions reached through a paired remote link.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 增加带进度与续传的分块上传，以及工作区文件与会话日志 ZIP 的原生下载；通过配对远程链接访问的会话同样可用。

description.en: One-line sidebar badge for OpenCode Go quota (5-hour, weekly and monthly windows), switching to the DeepSeek official balance when that model source is selected. Read-only, no telemetry. The OpenCode Go quota needs OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY configured in DSH, or an OpenCode Console login (its local credential file is read as a fallback), and the DeepSeek balance needs DEEPSEEK_API_KEY configured in DSH.
description.zh: 侧栏底部的一行小徽标：显示 OpenCode Go 额度（5 小时 / 本周 / 本月窗口），切到 DeepSeek 官方模型时显示余额。只读，无遥测。OpenCode Go 额度需要在 DSH 中配置 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY，或登录 OpenCode Console（会兜底读取其本地凭据文件）；DeepSeek 余额需要在 DSH 中配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。

description.en: Rearranges DSH Web into a three-column workbench with file editing, Git views, Markdown preview, and workspace terminals.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 重排为三栏工作台，提供文件编辑、Git 视图、Markdown 预览和工作区终端。

description.en: Voice assistant for dsh web: say the wake phrase (e.g. "小鲸") to activate hands-free dictation — what you say is transcribed and typed into the chat box automatically. Supports spoken edit commands (send, clear, new line, stop reading) and reads assistant replies aloud in Chinese. Speech recognition runs locally in-browser via sherpa-onnx WASM, so it works offline without an API key.
description.zh: dsh web 语音助手：说出唤醒词（如「小鲸」）即可免手听写，说话内容自动转成文字填入输入框；支持口述编辑指令（发送、清空、换行、停止朗读），并可用中文朗读 AI 回复。语音识别基于 sherpa-onnx WASM 在浏览器本地运行，离线可用、无需 API Key。

description.en: Adds two-level tabs (provider and model family) to the composer model picker for large catalogs, with configurable family rules.
description.zh: 给 composer 模型选择器加两级 Tab（提供商 + 模型系列），大目录时减少滚动翻找；族规则可在设置页配置。

description.en: Boot-time watchdog for DSH web: detects broken plugins, disables them persistently so the UI opens, with quarantine audit, automatic probe recovery, and one-click restore.
description.zh: dsh web 启动看门狗：检测并持久化禁用问题插件，让界面正常打开，并提供隔离账本、探针自动恢复与一键恢复。

description.en: Daoist Canon (DaoZang) retrieval skill: keyword or semantic search over 285,117 scripture chunks with exact original-text extraction (line numbers, hit markers), and one-command workspace setup from the Godners/DaoZang dataset.
description.zh: 道藏知识库离线检索与原文提取：对 28.5 万段经文进行关键词或语义检索，精确提取原文（带行号与命中标记），可从 Godners/DaoZang 数据集一键搭建工作区。

description.en: Real-time hot topics panel for the DSH web GUI: AI news and engineering news, each item with a distilled summary and the source link, shown from a sidebar entry with three views, keyword/source filters, read-state marking and hotkeys.
description.zh: DSH Web 时事热点面板：AI 大事与工科热点实时聚合，每条含要点提炼与来源链接；侧边栏入口、三视图、关键词与来源筛选、已读标记与快捷键。

description.en: Floating, browser-local whale arcade with three score games and ocean-themed Gomoku for breaks while waiting on the agent.
description.zh: 浏览器本地运行的悬浮鲸鱼游戏中心，包含三款积分游戏和海洋主题五子棋，适合等待 Agent 时随手游玩。

description.en: Single-model disable gate: hides denied models from DSH catalogs, blocks direct dispatch with an in-protocol error chunk, and exposes a settings UI for the denylist.
description.zh: 提供模型粒度的启用禁用机制：从 DSH 模型目录隐藏被禁用的模型，以协议内错误块拦截直接分发请求，并提供UI设置界面。

description.en: Wallpaper-aware readability repair for the DSH Web GUI: it lifts the three low-contrast secondary text tokens with color-mix plus an adjustable text halo, adds content rules (bold, permanently underlined or recoloured links, tinted headings and body text) scoped to conversation Markdown only, offers adjustable rainbow-edge and gradient-fill heading effects, loads custom fonts from the plugin folder or the DSH home, and ships a draggable WYSIWYG preview with a WCAG contrast badge.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的「壁纸感知」可读性修复：用 color-mix 把三个低对比次级文字 token 向主文字靠拢，并叠加可调强度的文字光晕；提供仅作用于会话 Markdown 的内容规则（链接加粗 / 常驻下划线 / 变色、标题与正文变色）、可调的彩虹描边与渐变填充标题特效、从插件目录或 DSH_HOME 加载的自定义字体，以及带 WCAG 对比度徽标的可拖动 WYSIWYG 预览窗。

description.en: Keeps the Auto permission preset across DSH restarts: the auto-review unload migration no longer rewrites a live Auto Session to Full access during application shutdown, and a stored Auto Session no longer fails to open when its integration is absent.
description.zh: 让「自动审批」熬过重启：应用退出时，自动审查的卸载迁移不再把在用的自动审批会话改写成「完全权限」；集成缺席时，存留的自动审批会话也不会打不开。

description.en: Skills & MCP manager in the DSH web settings: browse/enable/import/delete skills across project and user roots, and manage stdio/streamable-http MCP servers with a real connection (tools registered as mcp__<server>__<tool>, config in ~/.dsh/mcp.json).
description.zh: DSH Web 设置内的技能与 MCP 管理器：在项目级与用户级技能目录间浏览/启用/导入/删除技能，并管理 stdio/streamable-http 的 MCP 服务器（真实连接，工具注册为 mcp__<server>__<tool>，配置存 ~/.dsh/mcp.json）。

description.en: Sidebar category groups for DSH workspaces: the flat project list becomes collapsible named sections, workspaces re-file by dragging a row onto a group or picking one from a dropdown, one toolbar button collapses every group at once, an appearance panel sets font size, text color and background tint for each of the three levels, and Ctrl+Tab cycles recently opened sessions.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的工作区加自定义分类：平铺的项目列表变成可折叠的分组，工作区可拖到别的分组或在下拉框里改归类，工具栏一键收起全部分组，外观面板能分别调三层字号、文字颜色与底色，Ctrl+Tab 在最近打开的会话之间切换。

description.en: Firecrawl-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key and result limits.
description.zh: 基于 Firecrawl 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量等字段的设置卡片。

description.en: DIT.ai provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness: installs 29 OpenAI Chat Completions models and 10 Anthropic Messages models from one DIT_API_KEY, with protocol-specific thinking configuration.
description.zh: DIT.ai 的 DeepSeek Harness 模型接入 bundle：使用一个 DIT_API_KEY 安装 29 个 OpenAI Chat Completions 模型和 10 个 Anthropic Messages 模型，并按协议配置 thinking。

description.en: Injects the contents of a .keep-reminder file from the session working directory as a system-reminder, with three modes: once per session, first step of every turn, or every request.
description.zh: 把会话工作目录下 .keep-reminder 文件的内容作为 system-reminder 注入，支持三种模式：每会话一次、每轮第一步、每次请求。

description.en: Diagnose duplicate DSH loader entry IDs before startup, report version-locked repair status in a read-only settings card, and apply or revert audited loader repairs through an external CLI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动前诊断重复的 loader entry ID，通过只读设置卡片报告版本锁定的修复状态，并使用外部 CLI 应用或撤销经过审计的 loader 修复。

description.en: A bilingual overlay layer for DSH: it overlays Chinese names and functional descriptions for plugins, commands and skills, supports three display modes and manually-triggered AI translation, and does not modify a single line of DSH source code.
description.zh: DSH的双语覆盖层：为插件、命令与技能叠加中文名和功能说明，支持三种显示模式与纯手动触发的AI翻译，且不修改一行DSH源码。

description.en: Manage global AGENTS.md in DSH Web with Markdown preview, reusable templates, version history, import/export, failed-import rollback, and revision-conflict protection.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中管理全局 AGENTS.md，支持 Markdown 预览、可复用模板、版本历史、导入导出、失败导入回滚与修订冲突保护。

description.en: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

description.en: Usage statistics dashboard for the DSH Web UI: info cards, a 280-day GitHub-style activity heatmap, daily token trend, and model-usage donut chart.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 用量统计面板：信息卡、280 天活跃热力图、按天 Token 趋势与模型用量双环饼图。

description.en: Power Mode typing effects for the DSH web composer: caret particles and glowing character echoes, a heat ramp from amber to red with rising embers as the combo grows, a combo counter over visible glyphs, and a synthesized key tick with a heavier Enter impact.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的 Power Mode 打字特效：光标粒子与发光残影，连击越高当前输入行越热（暖黄到红）并升起余烬，按可视字符累计的连击计数，以及合成的按键音与更重的回车冲击音。

description.en: A temp note in the DSH right sidebar with session, workspace, and global scopes, browser-local autosave, one-click copy, and one-click LLM polish through the default model.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏的临时笔记，支持会话级、工作区级与全局三种范围、自动保存、一键复制，以及用默认模型一键优化为 Markdown。

description.en: Video-style turn navigation for the Web UI: full-map progress bar with hover preview cards (tools/files/tokens), drag scrub, ⌘K in-conversation search, ⌘↑/⌘↓ stepping, Esc-return. Event-log powered — works beyond the loaded window. Dual-half plugin on the official composer.dock slot.
description.zh: 会话内轮次导航视频进度条：全图分段、悬停富元信息卡（工具/文件/token）、拖动 scrub、⌘K 全会话搜索、⌘↑/⌘↓ 逐轮跳转、Esc 返回原位——基于会话事件日志，超出已加载窗口仍可用。

description.en: Scene-awareness probe for DSH on macOS: a privacy-first, pull-model `look` tool that reads the frontmost non-self window (app info, AX title/selection, gated local OCR), plus a summon-hotkey snapshot captured the instant you press.
description.zh: macOS 场景感知探针：拉模型零轮询的 look 工具，读取最前非自身窗口（应用信息、AX 标题/选中文本、按需本地 OCR），支持召唤热键按下瞬间抓取快照注入对话。

description.en: Declares a spec-driven development agent preset with a Chinese persona and four static Claude Code/Codex delegation tools for planning, implementation, review and knowledge distillation; roles are prompt-guided, not an automatic state machine.
description.zh: 声明规范驱动研发预设，包含中文人格与四个 Claude Code/Codex 静态委派工具，用于规划、实现、审查与知识提炼；角色由提示词引导，并非自动状态机。

description.en: Presents DSH Web as a playable, full-screen first-person Minecraft-style voxel interface—not a color-only skin: users walk through a persistent Three.js block world and access native workspaces, sessions, conversations, tools, model selection, permissions, context information, and the composer through in-world facilities and a workbench.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 直接呈现为可游玩的全屏第一人称 Minecraft 风格体素界面，而非只更换颜色的皮肤：用户可以在可持久化的 Three.js 方块世界中移动，并通过游戏内设施和工作台使用原生工作区、会话、对话、工具、模型选择、权限、上下文信息与输入框。

description.en: Floating NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH Web: draggable collapsible window with mini mode, playlist discovery with search and hot lists, synced lyrics with translations, persistent playback queue, QR-code or Cookie login, colors following the DSH skin theme.
description.zh: 网易云音乐浮窗播放器：可拖拽/折叠浮窗与迷你条，歌单发现（搜索/热门歌单），逐行同步歌词与翻译，播放队列持久化，扫码或 Cookie 登录，颜色跟随 DSH 皮肤主题。

description.en: A Chrome-dino-style runner for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: play while the agent replies, score from 梁子 to 梁圣 on a persistent progress strip.
description.zh: 等待 Agent 回复时的恐龙快跑小游戏：常驻进度条从「梁子」冲向「梁圣」，折叠即暂停、任意键恢复。

description.en: Installed-plugin catalog for DSH: group plugins by origin (official vs self-installed) in a searchable panel with enable/disable, uninstall, and one-click update. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-diraud.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 里的插件目录：按来源（官方/自装）分组展示已安装插件，可搜索，支持启用/停用、卸载和一键更新。已发布 npm 包 dsh-plugin-diraud。

description.en: Local token usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: four-segment token breakdown (miss/cache-hit/cache-write/output), cache savings estimate against the miss/hit price gap, per-session drill-down with context-growth curves and anomaly flags, global filters with shareable URLs, monthly budget progress with month-end projection, and day/month aggregate fast-path queries (O(days)) with incremental rescan.
description.zh: DSH 本地 Token 用量与成本统计仪表盘：四段 Token 构成（未命中/缓存命中/缓存写入/输出）、按未命中与命中的价差估算缓存省钱、会话下钻（上下文增长曲线与异常激增标记）、全局筛选可分享 URL、月度预算环形进度与月底外推、日/月聚合快路径查询（O(天数)）+ 增量扫描。

description.en: Pack a directory into a deterministic tar, read an archive's contents without extracting it, unpack while refusing every member that could reach outside the destination, and verify what came out against what went in by SHA-256. No external dependency — the tar format is written and read in this plugin. Extraction is deliberately more permissive on reading than on writing, because a reader's job is to report what an archive says, while a writer must never emit what it cannot read back. A tar has no central index, so the walk tracks whether it reached the end-of-archive marker: without that, a half-file checksums fine and reads as complete.
description.zh: 把目录打成确定性 tar、不解包就列出内容、解包时逐个成员拒绝任何能写到目标目录之外的名字、并用 SHA-256 核对「解出来的东西 == 打进去的东西」。零外部依赖 —— tar 格式在这个插件里自己写、自己读。读比写更宽容是刻意的：读方的职责是如实报告归档说了什么，写方则绝不能写出自己读不回来的东西。tar 没有中央索引，所以遍历必须跟踪「有没有走到归档结束标记」—— 少了这一步，一个被截断的文件校验和照样正确、照样被读成完整。

description.en: Metadata-first runtime profiler for DSH agents: turn/step traces, model and tool wall-time timelines, provider usage, retries, errors, and live or historical sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的运行时分析器：查看 Turn/Step 轨迹、模型与工具耗时、Provider 用量、重试与错误，实时与历史会话都能看。

description.en: Registers the project-cross-migration skill for DSH: five-layer agent project migration (conversations, memory, persona, tools, environment) with entry validation, JSONL integrity checks and readable restore. 1,418-message real migration verified across three platforms; pure Python stdlib, MIT.
description.zh: 为 DSH 注册 project-cross-migration 技能：对话/记忆/人格/工具/环境五层迁移，含入口校验、JSONL 完整性检查与可读还原。三平台 1418 条消息真实迁移实测；纯 Python 标准库，MIT。

description.en: A small dock in the DSH Web UI: restart the host or reload the page in one click. Restart asks first (now / 30s / 60s / 2min / cancel); the dock drags to any edge only after a 320ms hold, and stays anchored when the window resizes. Refresh refuses to run unless the plugin bundle is verifiably loadable (timestamp baseline + real bundle fetch + syntax compile), so a reload can never brick the app. Restart is Windows-only (PowerShell 5.1); the UI and page refresh work on all platforms.
description.zh: DSH 界面上一小框：一键重启宿主、一键刷新页面。重启会先问「立即 / 30 秒 / 60 秒 / 2 分钟 / 取消」，倒计时可撤回；小框需长按 320ms 才能拖动（避免手一抖就粘住），拖到边缘自动吸附，窗口缩放时跟着走。刷新前会真正确认插件包能加载（文件时间戳 + 取回 bundle + 语法编译三重检查），任何一项拿不到就不刷——宁可多点一次，也不把应用刷成起不来的样子。重启仅 Windows（PowerShell 5.1）；界面与刷新功能全平台可用。

description.en: Desktop pet "Zhaozhao" (照照) that floats above all apps in a transparent always-on-top window and mirrors DeepSeek Harness state — idle, cooking, serving and waiting-for-you animations, click reactions, drag, right-click resize, plus an auto-downloading Electron helper.
description.zh: 桌面宠物「照照」：透明置顶窗悬浮于所有应用之上，镜像 DeepSeek Harness 状态——待机、颠锅、上菜、托腮等你回话，支持点击回应、拖拽、右键调大小，Electron 运行时自动下载。

description.en: Shows the linked COROS watch model and cumulative activity days in the Web UI, expanding to a one-line review and suggestion when clicked.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中常驻显示已绑定的高驰手表型号与累计运动天数，点击展开一句话点评与建议。

description.en: Ports CSDN blog article typography into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — heading hierarchy, quote blocks, solid-grid tables, inline code and Atom One syntax highlighting, in matching light and dark palettes.
description.zh: 把 CSDN 博文的配色与正文排版搬进 DeepSeek Harness 网页端：标题层级、引用块、实线网格表格、行内代码与 Atom One 语法高亮，浅色深色各一套。

description.en: Codex-style model selector for the composer listing every provider/model in the profile, with four reasoning-effort levels and per-session persistence; disabling of the native selector ships inside the package.
description.zh: 输入框内的 Codex 风格模型选择器：列出 profile 全部 provider/model，四档推理力度，选择按会话记忆；原生选择器的禁用补丁随包内置。

description.en: Strict workflow document viewer and lifecycle driver for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看和驱动严格规范与工作流文档的插件。

description.en: Adds a one-click Worktree switch beside the composer that moves an empty session into a new git worktree, and removes worktrees idle for three days.
description.zh: 在输入框分支标记旁提供一键 Worktree 开关，让空会话进入新的 git worktree；三天无活动的 worktree 自动清理。

description.en: Brings active DSH sessions into a 3D 'Overcooked' kitchen: AI agents work, whale-girls wander the kitchen, and you watch from the side; status bubbles show who's cooking, waiting, or done with one-click navigation — originally built to check progress, now you just can't stop watching the whales.
description.zh: 把活跃会话放进 3D 胡闹厨房：AI 在跑任务，鲸鱼娘在厨房溜达，你在旁边看鱼；常驻气泡一眼看清谁在干活、谁在等回应、谁已交作业，点击直达会话继续干活——本来是为了看进度，现在只想再看一眼鱼。

description.en: Visualize the plugin and model call flow as a 3D office with six fixed workstations, thought bubbles and a delivery sheet.
description.zh: 把插件与模型的调用过程可视化成 3D 办公室：六个固定工位、思维流气泡与交付纸。

description.en: Animated and video live wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — GIF, animated WebP/APNG and static PNG/JPEG images, plus MP4/WebM video backgrounds, with auto format detection, a dim slider, and UI chrome tone matching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面动态壁纸插件：支持 GIF / 动图 WebP / APNG 与静态 PNG/JPG 图片，以及 MP4 / WebM 视频背景，格式自动识别，自带压暗与亮度调节，可让界面色调跟随背景。

description.en: Make F5, Ctrl+F5, and Ctrl+Shift+R reload the DeepSeek Harness page.
description.zh: 让 F5、Ctrl+F5 和 Ctrl+Shift+R 都能刷新 DeepSeek Harness 页面。

description.en: Focus board for DeepSeek Harness agents: durable, model-maintained notes in the session workspace that pin the objective, constraints, and decisions across compaction and sessions, with automatic context injection, archive on clear, and an optional web panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供持久化专注板：在会话工作区维护目标、约束与决策笔记，跨压缩与会话存活，支持自动注入上下文、清空归档与可选 Web 面板。

description.en: Moves selected messages from one conversation into another, and manages a workspace's conversations with archive, restore, delete and move between workspaces.
description.zh: 把选中的消息从一个对话迁移到另一个对话，并管理工作区的对话——支持归档、还原、删除和跨工作区迁移。

description.en: Wakes a DSH conversation on demand and hands work to it: pick one or more sessions to auto-wake when DSH starts, give each session its own provider, model and reasoning effort, and let the agent call another conversation with the session_task tool — it wakes that session, delivers the content, waits for it to finish and brings the answer back. Also ships list_sessions and wake_session tools plus a settings page titled 会话唤醒; no QQ or bridge dependency. The three tools are available to every agent and can reach any session in the profile; the auto-wake list is empty by default, a session's boot prompt is delivered at every DSH start, and session_task waits up to 300 seconds by default.
description.zh: 按需唤醒 DSH 里的对话并给它派活：可以挑一个或几个会话在 DSH 启动时自动唤醒，为每间会话单独指定 provider、模型与思考强度，还能用 session_task 工具叫醒另一个对话——把内容递过去、等它干完、再把答复原文带回来；另外提供 list_sessions、wake_session 两个工具和一个「会话唤醒」设置页，不依赖 QQ 或任何桥接。三个工具对所有 agent 开放，能触达 profile 里的任意会话；自动唤醒列表默认为空，每次 DSH 启动都会向对应会话投递其开机提示词；session_task 默认最多等待 300 秒。

description.en: Loopback HTTP bridge that lets a peer machine ping this PC and run shell commands, with an optional ssh reverse-tunnel supervisor.
description.zh: 本机回环 HTTP 桥：让对端机器 ping 并执行 shell 命令，可选 ssh 反向隧道看守。

description.en: DSH remote-access authorization page that shows the current process browser-session URL as a clickable link or QR code, behind an optional authority/subnet allow-list and PIN.
description.zh: DSH 远程授权页：以可点击链接或二维码呈现当前进程的浏览器会话 URL，可选主机/网段白名单与 PIN 门禁。

description.en: Shows a Kobe iced-tea side popup and reports per-turn costs or token counts with bundled offline audio. Uses dsh-cost-meter first, or estimates each request from native usage and public prices. Includes twenty cost phrases, four token phrases, CNY/USD, three-decimal rounding and custom previews; no runtime TTS service or API key. The bundled voice clips are pre-synthesized offline and the portrait is a fan-made image; the package declares UNLICENSED. When it has to estimate a cost itself it fetches a public price table from raw.githubusercontent.com (Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter) and the USD/CNY rate from open.er-api.com, at most once a day, and sends no session data.
description.zh: 每轮结束弹出科比冰红茶人物，离线播报本轮费用或 Token 用量；费用优先使用 dsh-cost-meter，不可用时按各请求原生用量与公开单价估算并标明来源。含二十句金额台词、四句 Token 台词，支持人民币/美元、三位小数四舍五入及自定义试听；无需在线语音服务或 API Key。内置的语音片段是预先合成的离线音频，人物图是网络二创图；包的许可证声明为 UNLICENSED。需要自己估算费用时，它最多每天一次从 raw.githubusercontent.com（Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter）取公开价格表、从 open.er-api.com 取美元兑人民币汇率，不发送会话数据。

description.en: Live estimated session spend in the composer dock, pricing each assistant step at DeepSeek's peak or off-peak rate for its own timestamp.
description.zh: 在输入框底栏显示当前会话的预估花费，每一步都按其自身时间戳采用 DeepSeek 的峰时或非峰时单价计价。

description.en: Research data provenance auditor: audits lineage integrity, reproducibility and FAIR principles compliance, outputs provenance audit reports for research integrity and open science.
description.zh: 科研数据溯源审计插件，审计血缘完整性、可复现性与FAIR原则合规性，输出溯源审计报告，支撑科研诚信与开放科学。

description.en: UI enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-click workspace open (copy path, reveal in Finder, open in an auto-discovered editor), DeepSeek-web-style user-message nav rail, session to-do marks, flat-list polish, and a hard-restart button.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面增强插件：工作区一键打开（复制路径、访达显示、自动发现编辑器打开）、用户消息导航条、会话待办标记、单列表增强与硬性重启按钮。

description.en: After official llm-retry (n/5) gives up, keep retrying transient API failures (timeout, transport, rate-limit, 5xx, dropped SSE) on the same open step until success, cancel, or pause; AUTH, QUOTA, and user Stop are never retried.
description.zh: 官方 llm-retry（n/5）耗尽后，对超时/传输/限流/5xx/SSE 断流等瞬时失败在同一打开 step 上继续重试直到成功、取消或暂停；认证失败、额度耗尽和用户停止不会重试。

description.en: Copy-on-write permission preset: shell commands run inside a per-workspace Sandboxie box, so writes outside the workspace land in the box copy while the real disk stays untouched (Windows only, requires Sandboxie-Plus).
description.zh: 写时复制权限预设：shell 命令在工作区专属的 Sandboxie 沙盒内运行，工作区外的写入落进沙盒副本、真实磁盘不受影响（仅 Windows，需先安装 Sandboxie-Plus）。

description.en: Quote earlier content of the current session into the composer: select text in any message for a Quote pill, or type @ to pick a whole message; the quote travels as a native reference chip and is serialized into the prompt as a blockquote. Client-only, no host routes, no custom session events.
description.zh: 把本会话里更早的内容引用进输入框：在任意消息里划选文字出现"引用"按钮，或输入 @ 选择整条消息；引用以原生 chip 形式存在，发送时序列化为引用块进入 prompt。纯客户端，无宿主路由，无自定义会话事件。

description.en: Defines named roles that each pair a persona with a bound model and fallback chain, and exposes one delegation tool per role, so subagents are dispatched by role name instead of a provider/model string.
description.zh: 把角色定义成 persona、绑定模型与备用链三部分，每个角色暴露一个委派工具；派发子代理时用角色名即可，不必每次手写 provider/model。

description.en: Play different configurable sounds for five conversation events in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: normal completion, interrupt, error, approval wait, and auto-retry success; each event has its own audio setting and bundled default, with auto-retry after errors using a configurable wait (10-300s), plus a community sound library. Compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的不同触发情况可分别设置音频提醒：支持正常完成、中断、出错、等待确认、自动重连成功五种场景，每种场景都有独立音频配置和默认音效；出错后自动重连，等待时长可自定义（10-300 秒）；附带社区音色库下载；已适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。

description.en: Codex-style keyboard answers for the pending command-approval panel — 1 allows once, 2 rejects, Enter confirms the highlighted choice, arrow keys move it, and Esc rejects, with the buttons still usable by mouse.
description.zh: 审批面板的 Codex 风格键盘应答：按 1 允许一次、2 拒绝、回车确认高亮项、方向键切换高亮、Esc 拒绝，鼠标点按依旧可用。

description.en: Drive a local ffmpeg as six structured tools: probe a file's streams, transcode or trim it, pull evenly-spaced frames or the audio track, and compress video to a byte budget with two-pass encoding.
description.zh: 把本机 ffmpeg 包成六个结构化工具：探流、转码裁剪、均匀抽帧、扒音轨，以及按目标体积做两遍编码压缩。

description.en: Desktop notifications when a DeepSeek Harness session finishes a turn or needs your approval.
description.zh: 会话完成一轮任务或需要你审批时，弹出系统桌面通知。

description.en: 15 skills and three mutually exclusive optional MCP rows (ru-marketplace-compare, ru-marketplace-decision, ru-marketplace-full) for twelve marketplaces: price comparison across Wildberries, Detsky Mir and Yandex Market, plus per-source search, product cards and reviews, including Ozon, Avito, AliExpress, Taobao, Megamarket, Lamoda, DNS, Citilink and Cian. The 15 skills load on install; the MCP rows stay disabled until RU_MARKETPLACE_MCP_DIR points at a local clone, which needs Python 3.12+ and uv.
description.zh: 面向十二家电商与分类信息平台的 15 个技能与三行互斥可选 MCP（ru-marketplace-compare、ru-marketplace-decision、ru-marketplace-full）：跨 Wildberries、Detsky Mir、Yandex Market 比价，以及各平台（含 Ozon、Avito、AliExpress、Taobao、Megamarket、Lamoda、DNS、Citilink 与 Cian 房产）的搜索、商品卡与评论。安装后 15 个技能立即可用；三行 MCP 默认关闭，需将 RU_MARKETPLACE_MCP_DIR 指向本地克隆，该克隆需要 Python 3.12+ 与 uv。

description.en: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never overwrites), persisted in a host-side JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框上方的提示词库：📚 按钮展开可搜索面板，点条目一键填入草稿（追加不覆盖）；数据以 JSON 文件保存在 Host 侧。

description.en: An Artifacts tab in the DSH sidebar that lists the files an agent produced and previews them in place with live reload, plus artifact template tools for agents.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的 Artifacts 标签页：列出 agent 产出的文件并就地预览、支持实时刷新，另提供 artifact 模板工具。

description.en: Sticky notes on a wall, with five paper stocks, five inks, seven typefaces, four text sizes and your choice of pin, tape or clip.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的便签墙：五种纸面、五种墨色、七种字体、四档字号，图钉或胶带或回形针固定，随手记下自动保存。

description.en: 3D office view for DeepSeek Harness: the sidebar panel turns the real main session, its sub-agents, tool activity and reports into animated desks, with per-desk screen details and a notification centre for collaboration events; sessions are picked per working directory. Read-only: it starts no tasks, calls no model, needs no API key, and ships its own scene and models (no CDN). Requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (or a later 0.2.x) and Node ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 3D 多 Agent 办公室：侧栏面板把真实主会话、子 Agent、工具活动和汇报呈现为动画工位，点开工位屏幕可查看该 Agent 的详情，通知中心记录协作动态，会话按工作目录分组选择。只读：不启动任务、不调用模型、不需要 API Key，场景与模型随包提供，不使用 CDN。要求 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1（或之后的 0.2.x）与 Node ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0。

description.en: A little cat that wanders the DeepSeek Harness UI, walking along text edges, napping, teleporting, falling off ledges, and leaving poops you can clean up.
description.zh: 一只在 DeepSeek Harness 界面里游荡的小猫，沿文字边缘行走、打盹、瞬移、摔下台阶，还会拉粑粑等你清理。

description.en: Route eligible shell commands through rtk to compress tool output and save tokens.
description.zh: 将符合条件的 shell 命令路由给 rtk，压缩工具输出并节省 token。

description.en: Brings the codebase knowledge-base capability of langchain-ai/openwiki into DSH — one-click generate/read/update of the repository Wiki, Grounded Claims (source-traced knowledge cards) and a project knowledge base built from uploaded local files, reusing the model DSH already has configured, with no second API key.
description.zh: 把 langchain-ai/openwiki 的代码库知识库能力搬进 dsh —— 一键生成 / 阅读 / 更新仓库 Wiki 与 Grounded Claims（溯源知识卡片）与项目知识库（上传本地文件），直接复用 DSH 已配置的模型，无需二次填 Key。

description.en: Message timeline rail for DeepSeek Harness web chat: evenly spaced ticks for each user message on the right edge, click to jump, hover to preview.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页会话消息时间轴导航条：消息区右侧等间距刻度，点击跳转，悬浮预览。

description.en: A market card pinned to the DSH sidebar: live price and 24-hour change for crypto pairs, A-share / Hong Kong / US stocks and world indices, FX majors and London spot gold and silver. An optional long or short cost basis plus a position size turn the change column into a P&L percentage and a cash amount; symbols, order and refresh interval are chosen in DSH settings. No login and no API key. Quotes come from public endpoints of Gate.io, Eastmoney and Sina, and the symbols you choose are sent to them on every refresh.
description.zh: 钉在 DSH 侧栏的行情卡片：加密货币、A股 / 港股 / 美股与世界主要指数、外汇直盘、伦敦金银的实时价格与 24 小时涨跌幅。填上买入或做空成本价与持仓数量后，涨跌列会切换成盈亏百分比与浮动金额；标的、顺序、刷新间隔都在 DSH 设置页里决定。免登录、免密钥。行情取自 Gate.io、东方财富和新浪的公开接口，每次刷新都会把你选的标的发给它们。

description.en: Recent-first session sidebar with user groups, workspace tree, archive bucket, status dots and drag reorder.
description.zh: 最近优先的会话侧边栏：自定义分组、工作区树、归档、状态点与拖动排序。

description.en: Permanently deletes one session from its sidebar context menu after a confirmation dialog: the log directory under the DSH home, the projection-cache thumbnail, its id in every workspace.json, and its archived and pinned entries. Sessions resumed since launch are detached from both the sessions and the agents stores first, so the deleted row does not return to the sidebar as an orphan. Refuses while the session is running a turn, and never touches the workspace folder itself.
description.zh: 在会话右键菜单里永久删除一个会话（先弹确认框）：DSH home 下的日志目录、投影缓存缩略图、每个 workspace.json 里的会话 id、以及归档与置顶列表里的条目。本次启动后 resume 进内存的会话会先从 sessions 与 agents 两个 store 里摘除，删掉的会话不会以幽灵条目的形式回到侧边栏。会话正在跑一轮对话时拒绝删除；工作区目录本身不受影响。

description.en: AI-native SDLC as a DeepSeek Harness bundle: task state machine and artifact chain, independent verification with structured verdicts, per-issue rework and re-verification, test freezing, RSI retrospectives, and a read-only dashboard.
description.zh: 把 AI 原生 SDLC 落成 DeepSeek Harness bundle：任务状态机与制品链、带结构化裁决的独立验证、按问题编号的返工与复验、测试冻结、RSI 复盘与只读看板。

description.en: Word alternatives and underscore-gated fill-ins in the composer. End a line with _ and it is filled; misspellings are flagged as you type. Routes through the model dsh is already configured with, so it needs no API key.
description.zh: 在输入框内提供同义词替换与以下划线触发的补全：一行以 _ 结尾即自动补全，拼写错误在输入时即时标出。它走 dsh 已配置好的模型，因此无需额外的 API key。

description.en: Boot-time guard that repairs corrupt session logs, preflights plugin composition, vm-checks client artifacts, smoke-tests host apply() and quarantines crash-causing bundles, so a broken plugin can never brick startup.
description.zh: 启动守卫：修复会话日志、预检插件组合、校验客户端工件、冒烟宿主 apply() 并隔离崩溃源，让坏插件再也无法砖掉启动。

description.en: SSH terminals, SFTP file transfer and text editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with server troubleshooting through host models.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内使用 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件传输与文本编辑，并通过宿主模型排查服务器问题。

description.en: Queues composer messages sent during DeepSeek peak billing hours and delivers them 3 s after the next off-peak window starts. A dock above the composer shows the countdown with send-now / edit / cancel, the queue survives closing the browser or restarting DSH, and attachments are staged on the host.
description.zh: 高峰时段按发送自动排队，到谷时（半价）开始后 3 秒投递；输入框上方 dock 显示倒计时并提供立即发送/修改/取消，关掉浏览器或重启 DSH 队列不丢，支持附件。

description.en: Adds Token Market as an OpenAI-compatible model provider with DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3.
description.zh: 将 Token Market 添加为 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商，并提供 DeepSeek V4 Pro、Kimi K3 和 GLM-5.3。

description.en: TAPD + ZenTao task hub for DSH: list assigned work in the sidebar and dispatch an agent on a branch you name.
description.zh: DSH 的 TAPD 与禅道任务中心：在侧边栏查看分配给自己的需求或任务，并在手动指定的分支上派发 Agent。

description.en: Inline annotations for DSH plan review: select plan text, comment on any passage, and send one structured review back to the agent.
description.zh: 给 DSH 计划评审加选区批注：选中计划原文、逐条写意见，一次性把结构化反馈发回给 agent。

description.en: Deterministic review of synthetic AI-agent claims in DeepSeek Harness, reporting bounded verdicts, reasons, and evidence references.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的合成智能体主张证据审阅插件，通过确定性规则输出有限判定、理由与证据引用。

description.en: Real Madrid dual-mode skin: Bernabeu night stadium for dark, white-kit pinstripes with crest and 1902 layers for light. Unofficial fan work.
description.zh: 皇家马德里双模式皮肤：暗色为夜场伯纳乌全景，亮色为纯白主场暗纹，队徽与 1902 背号作为背景层（非官方球迷作品）。

description.en: Adds a "Handoff session" item to the session context menu: pick an older session, choose how the new one should read it, and a fresh session is created with the handoff instruction pre-filled in its composer while the old session stays untouched. Three read modes — the AI decides what to read, a six-part summary written into a .md file, or just the last 20 turns. The second tab turns those .md files into a cleanup list grouped by workspace, deletable once the receiving session has run 3 turns or the handoff is 7 days old. All file, record and turn-count operations run in the host process; the browser half only renders and requests. Requires Windows and the DSH desktop app (it uses Electron shell.openPath and explorer.exe/cmd.exe).
description.zh: 在会话右键菜单加「移交会话」：选一个老会话、挑新会话用哪种模式怎么读，新开一个上下文干净的会话，交接指令已预填进输入框；老会话全程不动。三种读取方式——AI 自行判断读多少、让 AI 先写成六段摘要落到 .md、或只读最近 20 轮。第二个标签把那批 .md 变成按工作区分组的清理清单，接手会话跑满 3 轮或移交满 7 天即可逐条删除。删文件、写记录、数轮数全部在主进程完成，界面只负责画和发请求。需要 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面版（依赖 Electron shell.openPath 与 explorer.exe / cmd.exe）。

description.en: Select response text or code to ask contextual follow-ups with streaming replies in a native sidebar.
description.zh: 选中回答里的文字或代码，在原生侧边栏中结合上下文实时追问。

description.en: Declutters the DSH chat: hides agent execution-log rows, tightens spacing and fonts, wraps messages in bubbles, and injects an editable reply-concisely system instruction.
description.zh: 简化 DSH 聊天界面：隐藏执行日志、收紧间距与字号、把消息做成气泡，并注入可编辑的“简洁回复”系统指令。

description.en: Schedules workspace Agent runs in fresh Result Sessions with persistent audit history, using a stock DSH Conversation tab or a global Shell page when its slots are available.
description.zh: 面向 Workspace 调度 Agent 任务，每次运行创建全新 Result Session 并持久保留审计历史；原版 DSH 使用会话标签，存在对应 Slot 时使用全局 Shell 页面。

description.en: Persistent background watchers that wake the agent on new messages (file inbox or command-output delta) — the harness analog of Claude Code's Monitor tool.
description.zh: 常驻后台监视器：文件收件箱（NDJSON）或命令输出增量一到就唤醒 agent，相当于 Claude Code Monitor 工具的 Harness 实现。

description.en: Rewrites the draft in the DSH composer into a clearer, more executable prompt through the harness's own LLM routes, showing an original/optimized comparison before you adopt it.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里的草稿通过 harness 自身的 LLM 路由改写成更清晰、更可执行的提示词，采纳前先显示原文与优化后的对比。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH web UI: a draggable pixel-art cat with a pomodoro timer, XP levels, and 30 unlockable facts.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的桌宠插件：可拖拽的像素猫，带番茄闹钟、经验等级与 30 条可解锁的托托事实。

description.en: Interactive physics lab in the DSH sidebar — 24 parameter-driven animations (mechanics, electromagnetism, optics, thermodynamics) grouped by grade, each with a knowledge-point lesson whose steps follow the animation, a quiz with answer checking, and a draggable 3D view for four field models. Pure client side: analytic solutions computed locally, no LLM calls, no network, no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的高中物理动态仿真实验室：24 个可调参数的互动模型（力学 / 电磁 / 光学 / 热学），按高一高二高三分组；每个模型配知识点讲解与跟随动画的分步解说、出题判分，其中 4 个电磁学模型支持拖动旋转的 3D 视角。纯客户端，解析式本地计算，不调模型、不联网、不上报数据。

description.en: Archives DSH conversation output into SiYuan notes: a single siyuan_archive call files content under `<archive path>/<year-month>/<type>/<date>_<time>_<topic>_<content>` with a metadata table and auto-maintains an index document at the notebook root; 6 siyuan_* host tools (list notebooks, full-text search, read document, archive, delete block, remove document) and a Web settings page for base URL with connection test, API token in the host credential store, archive target and title template, plus notebook/document-level read/write/delete permissions with default deny and child levels able to only tighten.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话产出归档到思源笔记：一次 siyuan_archive 调用按「<归档路径>/<年-月>/<类型>/<日期>_<时间>_<主题>_<内容>」写入并附元数据表，自动维护笔记本根的「索引与规范」索引文档；6 个 siyuan_* 宿主工具（列笔记本、全文检索、读文档、归档、删块、删文档）与 Web 设置页配置地址（含测试连接）、存宿主凭据库的 API token、归档目标与标题模板，以及按笔记本/文档的读写删权限（默认全拒、子级只能收紧）。

description.en: Paints a colored counter badge (green = unread completed sessions, orange = pending question or approval) on the DeepSeek Harness taskbar icon on Windows, and plays a chime when a session finishes. Fork of dthcle/dsh-badge-notify (MIT) with a completion chime and green/orange state colors; both draw the same taskbar badge, so the two cannot be enabled together.
description.zh: 在 Windows 任务栏的 DeepSeek Harness 图标上叠画彩色计数角标（绿=未读的已完成会话，橙=待回答提问或待批准权限），会话结束时播放提示音。基于 dthcle/dsh-badge-notify（MIT）二次开发，新增提示音与绿/橙状态色；两者都在同一个任务栏图标上叠画角标，不能同时启用。

description.en: Read-only diagnostics for a DSH install — boot-crash logs and the cause named in them, config drift against a recorded fingerprint, backup freshness, workspace growth, plugin updates, host-version compatibility, duplicate client ids, and model availability — plus an action layer that always shows a plan first and needs a single-use fingerprint and explicit confirmation before anything is written. A checkup also runs 45 seconds after every host start; when the 3-hour probe cache is stale it sends a one-line test prompt to the default model and a few models of each configured provider (model.probeOnReport can switch this off). Registers the agent tools dsh_steward_report and dsh_steward_act (clean caches via dsh-disk-cleaner, backup via dsh-config-manager, disable or enable a bundle, set the default model; execute takes the plan's hash plus confirm: true) and a system-prompt section telling the agent to run the report first when something crashed.
description.zh: 对 DSH 安装做只读诊断——启动崩溃日志及日志里点名的病因、配置相对基线指纹的漂移、备份新鲜度、工作区增长、插件更新、宿主版本兼容、客户端 id 重复、模型可用性——另有一层动作：每次先给计划，写入前要单次指纹加显式确认。每次宿主启动 45 秒后会自动体检一次；3 小时的探测缓存过期时，会向默认模型和每个已配置服务商的少数几个模型各发一条测试提示（model.probeOnReport 可关掉）。还会注册 agent 工具 dsh_steward_report 与 dsh_steward_act（经 dsh-disk-cleaner 清缓存、经 dsh-config-manager 备份、停用或启用 bundle、改默认模型；执行时需带上计划的指纹和 confirm: true），并加一段系统提示，让 agent 在出现崩溃时先跑体检报告。

description.en: Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.
description.zh: 在输入框右侧提供「定时发送」按钮与配置面板，支持智能时段、自定义日期时间、多个定时任务并行，任务经 localStorage 持久化，刷新页面后自动恢复。

description.en: Injects durable user-set must-do and must-not requirements into the model at conversation start.
description.zh: 在会话开始时向模型注入用户设定的“必须做 / 不能做”持久要求。

description.en: Sidebar session-title icons: an auxiliary model call on the same route as title generation draws a 24x24 monochrome SVG metaphor shown before each session row title, with disk caching.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话标题图标：标题生成时用同一路由的辅助模型调用画一枚 24×24 单色 SVG 隐喻图标，显示在每行标题左侧，带磁盘缓存。

description.en: GLM Coding Plan usage quota ring in the composer dock - 5-hour and weekly credit windows with level, auto-refresh and one-click retry. Requires a GLM Coding Plan subscription and key, plus your BigModel organization and project IDs (the team quota API returns empty without them).
description.zh: 输入框下方实时显示 GLM Coding Plan 额度环 - 5 小时与每周额度窗口、等级、自动刷新与一键重试。需 GLM Coding Plan 订阅与 key，并配置 BigModel 的 organization 与 project ID（团队额度接口缺了它们会返回空）。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the AdWhispr remote MCP server through mcp-remote with browser OAuth sign-in, adding tools for competitor ad research, ad creative cloning, and launching and managing Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns. Requires an AdWhispr account.
description.zh: 通过 mcp-remote 加浏览器 OAuth 登录，把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 AdWhispr 的远程 MCP 服务：竞品广告调研、广告创意克隆，以及 Meta／Google／TikTok 广告的投放与管理。需要 AdWhispr 账号。

description.en: Verification toolkit for DSH agents: evidence-based claim checking against workspace files with line citations, config validation (JSON/YAML), and read-only URL/npm/GitHub submission-readiness probes.
description.zh: DSH 核验工具箱：在工作区文件中核查声明并返回带行号引用的证据，校验配置文件（JSON/YAML），以及只读的 URL / npm / GitHub 提交就绪度探测。

description.en: Financial AML compliance checker: detects large/suspicious transaction thresholds, exemptions and timeliness, outputs auditable AML compliance reports across banking, insurance and securities.
description.zh: 金融反洗钱合规检查插件，自动检测大额与可疑交易阈值、豁免规则与时效性，输出可审计的反洗钱合规报告，覆盖银行、保险、证券多业态。

description.en: Host plugin that adds the /dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct command and the dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct tool to any session for a full book walkthrough plus one deep insight.
description.zh: Host 插件：任意会话可用 /dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct 命令与 dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct 工具，输入书名与作者后讲透全书并给出一段深度思想。

description.en: Real PTY terminal panel for the DSH Web UI: host half spawns shells with node-pty (cmd.exe default on Windows), rendered in the browser with xterm.js; multi-tab sessions, dock/floating window, clipboard support.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 终端面板：宿主端 node-pty 真实 PTY（Windows 默认 cmd.exe）+ 浏览器 xterm.js 渲染；多标签会话、停靠/浮动窗口、复制粘贴。

description.en: Keep conclusions alive across context compaction: the model writes a task checkpoint and the plugin re-injects it into the system prompt's first node — the span compaction never touches, so it survives any number of compactions. Four-tier injection (0/95/175/≤12000 chars) scales with session relatedness; checkpoints live in the plugin's own folder, never in your workspace.
description.zh: 让结论活过上下文压缩：模型把任务状态写成检查点，插件把它注入到 DSH 系统提示词首节点——那里永不参与压缩，所以压缩 100 次结论也不丢。四档注入（0/95/175/≤12000 字符）按会话关系收放；检查点写在插件自有目录，工作区一个文件都不多。

description.en: Open a page, wait for it the way it actually needs, extract the readable article, and take a screenshot. Playwright is optional: when it is absent the tools fall back to a static fetch and say so in the result, because a page whose JavaScript never ran means something different from one that rendered. Content is chosen by scoring candidate subtrees on prose density rather than on tag names, so a container loses to the article inside it instead of winning by containing more of the document.
description.zh: 打开页面、按页面真正需要的方式等待、抽出可读正文、截图。Playwright 是可选依赖：没装时退回静态抓取并在结果里明确说明，因为「JavaScript 从未执行」的页面意味着的东西和渲染过的不同。正文靠给候选子树打正文密度分来选，而不是相信标签名，所以容器不会因为「包含的文档更多」而赢过它里面的正文。

description.en: Registers a Tavily search provider for the ctx.web seam and switches web_search to it, with a comma-separated apiKey list that rotates on 401/403/429/5xx and transport errors.
description.zh: 为 ctx.web 接缝注册 Tavily 搜索 provider 并把 web_search 切到它；apiKey 支持逗号分隔多 key，遇到 401/403/429/5xx 与网络错误自动轮换。

description.en: Runs local Codex CLI tasks from DSH on Windows with background execution, progress queries, follow-up instructions, completed chat records, and optional supervision; requires Node 22.23.4+, DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0, and an installed, authenticated Codex CLI.
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 中运行本机 Codex CLI 任务，支持后台执行、进度查询、追加指令、已完成聊天记录展示及可选监督；需要 Node 22.23.4+、DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0，以及已安装并登录的 Codex CLI。

description.en: Geospatial data quality inspector: checks elevation accuracy, topology consistency and coordinate system compliance, outputs weighted quality scoring reports per GB/T 24356-2023.
description.zh: 地理空间数据质量检查插件，检测高程精度、拓扑一致性与坐标系统合规性，输出加权质量评分报告，满足GB/T 24356-2023国家标准。

description.en: Codex App Server model provider using a local Codex login, with session reuse, Harness tool bridging, native action traces, and durable generated-image projection.
description.zh: 使用本地 Codex 登录的 Codex App Server 模型提供方，支持会话复用、Harness 工具桥接、原生动作轨迹和生成图片持久化。

description.en: The dsh security mode plugin achieves a zero third-party plugin startup by constructing a blank profile.
description.zh: dsh安全模式插件，通过构建空白profile实现零第三方插件启动。

description.en: Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse toolkit for DSH: 15 tools for querying metadata and solution layers across environments, snapshots and diffs, field impact analysis, migration risk assessment, GitLab merge-request checks, contract drift, environment health, and review-gated metadata writes.
description.zh: 面向 Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse 的 DSH 工具箱：15 个工具，支持跨环境查询元数据与解决方案层、快照与差异、字段影响面反查、迁移风险评估、GitLab MR 检查、契约漂移、环境健康，以及需人工确认的元数据写入。

description.en: Native Windows completion and approval notifications for DeepSeek Harness, with session titles, optional AI summaries, quick reply, and an opt-in taskbar completion badge. Toasts carry the original session route, subject to Windows activation. The badge requires PowerShell 7.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带会话标题的 Windows 原生完成与审批通知，支持可选 AI 总结、通知内回复和可独立开启的任务栏完成角标。通知携带原会话路由，跳转取决于 Windows 激活。角标需要 PowerShell 7。

description.en: Shows which provider the composer's currently selected model belongs to, and stays silent for providers another plugin already presents.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框展示当前所选模型所属的供应商；已被其他插件接管的供应商自动让位，不重复显示。

description.en: Real-time cost tracking for the current DSH conversation: a composer-dock line showing the running token usage and DeepSeek official price estimate (base and peak/valley pricing).
description.zh: 当前对话实时费用统计：输入框下方一行显示运行中的 token 用量与 DeepSeek 官方价格估算（基础价与峰谷价）。

description.en: Blocks a tool call whose arguments lost their boundary, keeps a closing turn open when a step silently never ran so the model can re-issue it, and replaces damaged output on the model-visible surface after a fork. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 拦截参数边界损坏的工具调用；某一步静默失败、turn 即将关闭时保持其打开，让模型重新发起调用；fork 之后把模型可见面上损坏的输出替换为说明。零依赖。

description.en: Project .pack.json/.pack.zip into .agent-pack/modpacks/ and expose skills via a workspace allow-list.
description.zh: 把 .pack.json/.pack.zip 投影到 .agent-pack/modpacks/，按工作区白名单暴露 skill。

description.en: Tracks online, active and task time in DSH, with a day/week/month dashboard, per-workspace and per-session breakdowns, and a read-only `timespan_stats` tool for agents.
description.zh: 记录 DSH 的在线、活跃与任务三种时长，提供日/周/月仪表盘、按工作区与会话的明细，以及供 Agent 查询的只读 `timespan_stats` 工具。

description.en: Per-turn USD cost badge in the Web UI: session total in the header and per-turn cost in each message footer, with a hover breakdown.
description.zh: Web UI 美元成本徽标：头部显示会话总成本、每条回复结尾显示该轮成本，悬停看分项。

description.en: Adds two switchable themes, built-in and local-folder background slideshows, and per-session token usage details to DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 与桌面端提供两套可切换主题、内置及本地文件夹背景轮播和逐会话 Token 用量明细。

description.en: Sidebar tab that lists a session's file changes by turn, expands line-level diffs and undoes them, with a matching review card at the end of each chat turn. Needs dsh-better-sidebar installed separately. DSH 0.2.x port of Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab; do not install both.
description.zh: 侧边栏「文件审查」标签页：按轮次列出本会话改动文件、展开行级 diff 并支持撤销，对话尾部同步显示同款审查卡片。需另装 dsh-better-sidebar。是 Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab 的 DSH 0.2.x 移植版，不要与原版同装。

description.en: Rclone backup tooling with four tools: target inventory, local/remote status, rclone check verification, and approved copy/sync transfers with dry-run previews and an audit line. Requires rclone installed and a remote configured with `rclone config`; the plugin never reads the rclone config or credentials.
description.zh: 基于 rclone 的备份工具，含四个工具：目标清单、本地/远端状态、rclone check 校验，以及带预演与审计行的审批式 copy/sync 传输。需已安装 rclone 并用 `rclone config` 配好远端；插件不读取 rclone 配置或凭据。

description.en: Prompt optimizer in the composer: rewrites the draft into an eleven-section analytical prompt using the conversation, workspace files and the session's selected model, with one-click undo.
description.zh: 输入框内的提示词优化器：结合对话历史、工作区文件与会话选定模型，把草稿改写为十一节分析式提示词，支持一键撤销。

description.en: Solarized theme plugin: the classic low-contrast, eye-friendly dual palette system — Ethan Schoonover's Solarized plus Selenized (its refined take), dark and light each, built for long sessions with canonical syntax colors.
description.zh: Solarized 主题插件：经典低对比护眼配色双体系——Ethan Schoonover 的 Solarized 与 Selenized（改良版）深浅各一套，专为长时间使用设计，遵循经典语法色。

description.en: Adds per-Workspace category trees to the Web sidebar, with nested categories, drag-and-drop session assignment, category-scoped session creation, and category deletion that archives contained sessions.
description.zh: 为 Web 侧边栏添加按 Workspace 隔离的分类树，支持嵌套分类、拖拽归类会话、在分类中新建会话，以及删除分类时归档其中的会话。

description.en: Searches the whole conversation — not just the loaded window — from a button in the conversation header, opens the results in the right sidebar, paints every keyword yellow in both your messages and the replies, and jumps the conversation to the hit. History search runs on the host log, so it still works when the full-text index is disabled.
description.zh: 在对话头部加一个搜索按钮，结果显示在右侧栏；整段历史都能搜（不只是已加载的那部分），命中关键词在用户消息和 AI 回复里都标黄，点结果可跳转到对话中的位置。历史检索走宿主日志，所以全文索引被关闭时也能用。

description.en: Agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness with eleven selectable presets, planning, delegation, review gates and durable project state.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体编排插件：11 个可选 preset、规划、委派、评审门与 .omd 持久状态。

description.en: macOS notifications with the standard Glass alert when a reply finishes or DSH needs your input.
description.zh: 回复完成或需要用户介入时，用 macOS 系统通知 + Glass 提示音提醒，点通知回到对应会话。

description.en: Select text in a reply and quote it into the composer as an atomic reference chip: delete the whole chip in one keystroke, click it to scroll back and highlight the quoted turn, and expand it into a bounded reference block at send time so the model can tell the quote apart from what the user typed. Also opens the snippet in a side chat, or copies it to the clipboard.
description.zh: 在回复里选中文字，把引用作为原子 chip 写进输入框：一次按键整体删除、点击回跳并高亮被引用的轮次、发送时展开成带边界的引用块，让模型能分清引用与用户输入。另可把片段送进侧边对话，或复制到剪贴板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness streaming MCP bridge: live session events as MCP progress, plus ACP adapter for cc-connect/Feishu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 流式 MCP 桥接：将实时会话事件作为 MCP 进度输出，并提供 cc-connect/飞书 ACP 适配器。

description.en: Scan a QR code in Settings to open the DeepSeek Harness web UI on your phone inside the active session via a cloudflared quick tunnel.
description.zh: 在设置中扫描二维码，通过 cloudflared 快速隧道在手机上于当前会话中打开 DeepSeek Harness 网页端。

description.en: Session install radar for DeepSeek Harness: lists what each conversation installed (pip, npm, git clones, winget-like installers) with size, path, creation time, purpose, why it was installed, and what removing it costs. Ships a sidebar panel, 10 agent tools, a timestamp sweep of temp directories, a process-command-line audit, and a two-step confirmed cleanup limited to temp directories. An optional scheduled cleanup of old temp directories is off by default.
description.zh: 会话安装雷达：按会话列出装了什么（pip、npm、git clone、winget 等），给出体积、安装位置、创建时间、用途、为什么装、卸载后果。含侧栏面板、10 个 agent 工具、临时目录时间戳扫描、进程命令行审计，以及仅限临时目录的两段式确认清理。另有可选的定时清理旧临时目录功能，默认关闭。

description.en: Subagent model control: a Jev classifier labels each turn, and the subagent request itself is rewritten to the provider, model and reasoning effort that the label maps to, at the agent/request hook; a per-session inherit/auto/manual selector, one prompt per role injected ahead of the task, and offline replay of past verdicts.
description.zh: 子代理模型管控：由 Jev 判定本轮任务类别，再把子代理自身的请求改写为该类别对应的 provider、model 与推理强度（在 agent/request 钩子上执行）；会话内可用继承/自动/手动三种方式指定模型，每个角色可带一条先于任务注入的前置提示词，并可离线回放历史判定。

description.en: Read-first VPS operations tools: systemd status and actions, disk usage, Docker status, log tails, configured backups, and quiet-hours schedules.
description.zh: 先读后写的 VPS 运维工具：systemd 状态与操作、磁盘占用、Docker 状态、日志尾部、可配置备份与静默时段计划。

description.en: Token usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: a bar above the composer opens billing token totals, trend charts, per-model and per-project breakdowns and a custom date range, read from local session logs of DSH, Codex, Claude Code, Trae and WorkBuddy. With a self-hosted portal URL and an app key it also reports usage events to that portal; with neither configured it collects nothing. It exposes token_usage tools plus a ctx.tokenReport service, and never collects conversation content.
