description.zh: DSH 的 token 用量面板：输入框上方一条用量条，点开是计费总量、趋势图、按模型/项目/来源的分组明细与自定义日期范围，数据来自本机 DSH / Codex / Claude Code / Trae / WorkBuddy 的会话日志；填了自建服务端地址与 appKey 后，用量事件会实时上报到那个服务端，两者都没配时一个字节都不采集；另提供 token_usage 工具与 ctx.tokenReport 服务。不采集对话内容。

description.en: Fine-grained LLM verification for DSH agents: pairwise rewards over score-token logprobs, Probabilistic Pivot Tournament best-of-N selection, and per-step progress tracking.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 智能体的细粒度 LLM 验证：基于评分 token logprob 期望的成对打分、概率枢纽锦标赛 N 选一与逐步进度追踪。

description.en: Network and proxy doctor for DSH: checks system proxy settings, probes local proxy ports, detects TUN adapters, tests GitHub, TCP and HTTP reachability, scans hosts conflicts and prints concrete suggestions for what to change.
description.zh: DSH 的网络与代理诊断工具：检查系统代理设置、探测本地代理端口、识别 TUN 适配器、测试 GitHub/TCP/HTTP 连通性、扫描 hosts 冲突，并给出具体的修改建议。

description.en: Expose a second-opinion tool: when the main agent is stuck it hands the problem to an independent session, receives a plan back, and continues — without waking or impersonating the user.
description.zh: 跨会话「第二意见」：一个会话卡住时，把问题交给另一个独立会话单独思考，把方案拿回来继续。不冒充用户发言，也不唤醒闲置会话。

description.en: Adds a live status badge to the session header and delivers guidance added mid-task without interrupting the turn.
description.zh: 在会话头显示实时状态徽标，并在不打断当前回合的前提下投递运行中新增的指导。

description.en: Mobile-viewport fixes for the dsh web GUI: overlay drawer sidebar with swipe gestures, icon-only composer with a mode · model · effort status line, centered popovers, and horizontal-overflow/scrollbar centering fixes.
description.zh: 修复 dsh web GUI 的手机视口体验：抽屉式侧栏与滑动手势、纯图标 composer 与「权限·模型·思考深度」状态行、浮窗居中、横向溢出与滚动条挤压居中修复。

description.en: Manage archived conversations in the Settings UI: unarchive them back to the sidebar, or permanently delete them with confirmation.
description.zh: 在设置界面管理已归档对话：一键取消归档，或经确认后永久删除。

description.en: File-browser web app for DSH: React frontend and REST API served by the host webserver, a /dsh-agfs command that opens at the current session workspace, and a browse_files model tool.
description.zh: 文件浏览器 Web 应用：React 前端与 REST API 由宿主 webserver 托管，/dsh-agfs 命令自动定位当前工作区，附 browse_files 模型工具。

description.en: Disable plugins per workspace: a disabled plugin stops contributing tools to the model tool list and prompt sections to the system prompt, cutting the per-turn schema cost. A plugin is switched as a whole, with packs evaluated by workspace binding, then default.
description.zh: 按工作区停用插件：停用后该插件不再向模型工具表提供工具、也不再向 system prompt 注入提示词段，减少每轮固定开销。插件按整包开关，pack 按工作区绑定值、再按 default 求值。

description.en: Adds a Spawnd.gg games cabinet to the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar with search, sorting, hover previews, embedded play, and a minimized player.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏中添加 Spawnd.gg 游戏柜，支持搜索、排序、悬停预览、嵌入式游玩和最小化播放器。

description.en: Task Runner mode for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent decomposes large tasks into independent subtasks, dispatches them to subagents (default local model) in fresh short contexts, and synthesizes results; concurrency and worker/orchestrator models are configurable in the settings panel.
description.zh: 任务拆解模式：主代理把大任务拆成独立子任务，派给子代理（默认本地模型）在全新短上下文中执行并综合结果；并发数与模型可在设置面板图形化配置。

description.en: Adds a session-scoped context window selector next to the reasoning-effort row in the DeepSeek Harness model popup: a pill showing the effective window opens a dropdown of presets below the model default, the choice applies to the next request of that session only, and a new session falls back to the profile default. It writes no config file and appends nothing to the session log.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型弹窗的「推理等级」旁增加会话级上下文窗口选择器：显示当前生效窗口的胶囊按钮可展开默认窗口以下的档位下拉，选择只作用于该会话的下一次请求，新建会话自动回到 Profile 默认值。不改任何配置文件，也不向会话日志写入内容。

description.en: Archived-session management, task-stop notifications, an update checker, model routing (keyword rules + allowlist-gated model_route), multi-task scheduled triggers (heartbeats and fixed-time tasks), and a DeepSeek-style message scroll nav for the dsh web GUI.
description.zh: 归档会话管理、任务完成桌面通知、更新检查、模型路由（关键词规则 + 白名单门控 model_route）、多任务定时触发（心跳与定点任务），以及 DeepSeek 风格的消息滚动导航。

description.en: Bridges the harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP server into DSH: HarmonyOS device discovery, build/install/run/uninstall, UI automation (click/input/keys/swipe/screenshot), E2E UI-tree inspection, and log/crash analysis as 18 mcp__harmonyos__* tools.
description.zh: 把 harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP 服务桥接进 DSH：鸿蒙设备发现、构建/安装/运行/卸载、UI 自动化（点击/输入/按键/滑动/截图）、E2E 界面树检查、日志与崩溃分析，共 18 个 mcp__harmonyos__* 工具。

description.en: Recalls lessons recorded in earlier projects: when the running work matches one, the local model decides whether to inject a short note before the next step. Requires a local Ollama model (default qwen3.5:9b) and the dsh-mnemon store with its mnemon CLI; without them it only observes and logs, never injects.
description.zh: 把在别的项目里记下的经验在当前工作命中时找出来，由本机小模型判断是否在下一步之前插入一条简短提示。需要本机 Ollama（默认 qwen3.5:9b）以及 dsh-mnemon 记忆库与 mnemon CLI；缺了只会观察记录、不会注入。

description.en: Back up and restore a whole DSH environment (installed plugins, DSH and plugin settings, skills, sessions and explicitly registered workspace files) into one private GitHub repository. Multiple machines share a single repo through per-device namespaces that never overwrite each other, and a pull can restore from this device, the latest backup or a chosen device. Push previews a read-only plan before writing, pull backs up local data first, secret-looking settings are redacted and key files are never uploaded. It calls api.github.com with the GitHub token you save in the panel (kept host-side only); its HTTP routes (/one-pack/api/...) require DSH browser auth.
description.zh: 把整套 DSH 环境（已装插件、DSH 与插件设置、技能、会话、显式登记的工作区文件） 打包同步到一个私有 GitHub 仓库。多台设备共用同一仓库时各写自己的设备命名空间、 互不覆盖，拉取可选本设备、最新备份或指定设备；推送前先只读预览计划，拉取前自动 备份本地数据；疑似密钥字段写成掩码、密钥文件硬排除，GitHub token 只保存在 Host 本地。它会用面板里保存的 token 访问 api.github.com；HTTP 路由 （/one-pack/api/…）要求 DSH 浏览器鉴权。

description.en: Path to Nowhere MBCC dossier theme for DSH, with dark and light palettes, a boot splash, a balance capsule and a settings panel.
description.zh: 无期迷途 MBCC 档案风 DSH 主题：深浅两套色板、开屏动画、余额胶囊与设置面板。

description.en: Review-first batch automation for DeepSeek Harness: three reviewed samples, a full preview, one approval, then a safe apply across many files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的审核优先批量自动化：先审核三个样本，预览全部结果，一次批准，再安全地应用到多个文件。

description.en: Plugin insight center: one answer to "哪些值得装" — plugin_guide matches needs to plugins, recipe installs whole environments, plugin_rank scores health (0-100), plugin_audit static-scans a local checkout for security, and plugin_verdict outputs install / caution / research / avoid.
description.zh: 插件评测中心：一个答案回答"哪些值得装"——plugin_guide 按需求推荐插件、recipe 安装整套环境、plugin_rank 健康评分（0-100）、plugin_audit 静态安全扫描本地目录、plugin_verdict 给出 install / caution / research / avoid 结论。

description.en: Prompt enhancement for the DSH composer, with a model picker that lists the models the host actually offers: a Boost button beside the composer sends the current draft to a model on the Host, shows the rewrite in a before/after overlay, and replaces the draft only when you confirm. While boosting, the button glyph becomes a spinning arc; once a rewrite is applied the same button becomes an in-place Undo that restores the original draft and then returns to its idle state. Settings hold the enable switch, a provider/model choice rendered as a grouped dropdown built from the live provider list (including configurable providers that are not set up yet) rather than free-text fields, temperature, output limit, timeout and optional custom instructions. Empty or reasoning-only model answers are reported with their real cause instead of a generic failure, and the Host endpoint only answers loopback requests from the same origin.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的提示词增强，并带一个列出宿主实际可用模型的下拉选择器：输入框旁的「增强」按钮把当前草稿交给宿主侧的模型改写，以原文/改写对照的浮层预览，只有确认后才替换草稿。增强过程中按钮图标变为旋转的圆弧；替换草稿后同一个按钮就地变为「撤销」，点击即恢复原始草稿并回到初始状态。设置页含启用开关、以分组下拉框呈现的提供商/模型选择（选项来自实时提供商列表，含尚未配置但可激活的提供商，而非自由文本输入）、温度、输出上限、超时与可选的自定义指令。模型返回空内容或只返回推理时给出真实原因而非笼统失败；宿主接口只响应本机同源请求。

description.en: Replacement session-title provider that compresses oversized or code-heavy first prompts before calling the model (in the tested DSH version the built-in provider rejects inputs above 4096 bytes without a model call) and waits for a real task instead of titling a greeting. Titles use the session’s own provider and model by default and manual titles are protected; title rules cover a character cap, an optional date affix, style, language and exclusion words, plus a per-session lock. Also re-titles stored sessions in bulk, with a progress overlay that keeps running after Settings is closed.
description.zh: 会话标题 provider 替换插件：先把过长或代码密集的首条 Prompt 压缩再调用模型（实测 DSH 版本的内建 provider 在超过 4096 bytes 时直接拒绝、不调用模型），遇到纯问候则等待真正的任务。默认使用该会话自身的 provider 与 model，保护人工标题；标题规则支持字数上限、可选日期前后缀、风格、语言与排除词，并可按会话锁定标题。还可批量重优化历史会话标题，进度浮层在关闭设置页后继续运行。

description.en: Zero-interruption audit and fuse blocking for DeepSeek Harness: silently records every tool call with deterministic risk scoring, cumulative-risk bonuses, risk-level breakdowns and retention-based cleanup; blocks irreversible catastrophes (protected-path deletion, disk wipe, force-push to protected branches/refs, credential exfiltration), and renders a redacted /risk-guard operation bill with --since filtering.
description.zh: 零打扰审计与保险丝拦截：静默记录每次工具调用并做纯规则风险评分（含累积加分、风险等级分布、归档保留期清理），只拦不可逆灾难（受保护路径删除、磁盘擦除、force push 到受保护分支/引用、凭据外发），/risk-guard 输出脱敏操作账单并支持 --since 时间过滤。

description.en: Code security defense review judge for DeepSeek Harness: detects sessions that are writing code, reviews them against the Code Security Defense Architecture Rules, recommends which security architectures the program needs (one or several), checks conflicts between them, teaches the session AI after repeated failures, and teaches the session AI after repeated failures; once you grant it review authority in its panel, it gates task completion until the review passes (without that authorization it only observes).
description.zh: 代码安全防御规则评审判官：自动识别正在做代码的会话，按《代码安全防御架构规则》强制评审其安全防御措施与所采用的代码安全防御架构，推荐程序需要的架构（一种或多种）并检查架构之间是否冲突；连续不合格会进入教学模式要求重做；在面板授予评审权限后，未通过评审的代码任务不能算完成（未授权时只读观察）。

description.en: TapTap Maker integration for DeepSeek Harness: bundled MCP tools, Maker workflow and feature skills, plus a packaged CLI path for project initialization and diagnostics.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 TapTap Maker 集成：提供内置 MCP 工具、Maker 工作流与功能技能，以及用于项目初始化和诊断的随包 CLI 路径。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go quota usage in the web sidebar's bottom-left corner — rolling/weekly/monthly progress with a hover card, plus a Beijing-time DeepSeek peak-hour timeline.
description.zh: 在 Web 侧边栏左下角显示 OpenCode Go 用量——滚动/本周/本月配额进度与悬停明细卡片，并附按北京时间标记的 DeepSeek 高峰时段进度条。

description.en: Local development facts for Harness: environment and runtime-health probes, git status/diff/log/commit, write-time snapshots with version-by-version restore, and project checks for Node, Python and Go.
description.zh: 本地开发事实层：环境探测与运行时健康检查、git 状态/差异/历史/提交、写入前快照与逐版回退，以及 Node / Python / Go 项目检查。

description.en: A T3 Code-style New Session screen for the composer: a "What should we build in <project>?" headline whose project name opens a workspace menu, a reasoning-effort picker in the composer tool row, and a git branch strip under the card that searches local and remote refs and switches with git checkout.
description.zh: 把 T3 Code 的新会话界面移植到 DSH 输入框：标题「What should we build in <project>?」里的项目名可点开工作区菜单，工具栏里新增推理强度选择器，卡片下方新增 git 分支条，可搜索本地与远程引用并用 git checkout 切换。

description.en: Adds a /new slash command that opens a blank session in the current workspace (reusing an existing blank one when there is one) and carries the old session's permission preset and agent preset into it, so starting fresh never changes what the agent may do.
description.zh: /new 指令：在当前工作区打开空白会话（已有空会话可直接复用），并把原会话的权限预设与 Agent 预设带入新会话，开新会话不会悄悄改变代理的可用权限。

description.en: When a live session's context passes a threshold, append older messages to a per-conversation folder on disk, then release the oldest finished turns from the model-visible context; the chat transcript and the session log stay untouched.
description.zh: 会话上下文超过阈值时，先把较早的消息追加到按会话归档的文件夹，再把最早的已完成轮次移出模型可见上下文；聊天记录与会话日志保持原样。

description.en: Memory triage for DeepSeek Harness: at the end of each turn it decides which entries to keep and which to archive, routes project-specific ones into a project bucket while global ones stay in the main store, merges near-duplicate entries, and falls back to an LLM when the rules are unsure — automatic actions are recoverable archives only, never deletions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 记忆分诊插件：每轮对话结束自动判断条目保留或归档，把项目条目迁入 project 桶、全局条目留在总体记忆，合并近义重复条目，规则拿不准时用 LLM 兜底；自动动作只做可恢复的归档，永不直接删除。

description.en: Checks enabled plugins for newer versions at startup, lists them in a corner card and upgrades them all with one click, reporting per-plugin success or failure; resolves the bundled dsh CLI on macOS, Windows and Linux instead of assuming a Windows executable.
description.zh: 启动后检查已启用插件的新版本，在右下角列出并一键逐个升级，逐条给出成功或失败结果；通过解析应用自带的 dsh CLI 在 macOS、Windows、Linux 上执行更新，不假定 Windows 可执行文件。

description.en: A row of model preset buttons above the composer: left-click switches the session to that preset's provider, model and reasoning effort, right-click opens an editor for it, and each preset can carry a custom name instead of the model id. The editor reads the session's live model catalog, and presets are stored locally.
description.zh: 输入框上方的一排模型预设按钮：左键点击把当前会话切换到该预设的提供方、模型与思考强度，右键点击打开该预设的编辑弹窗，每个预设还可以自定义备注名称而不必使用模型名。编辑弹窗读取当前会话真实的模型目录，预设保存在本地。

description.en: Loads Claude-style plugins into DeepSeek Harness (dsh): discovers skills, commands and optional SessionStart hooks from Claude plugin directories, with hot command reload and uninstall cleanup.
description.zh: 把 Claude 风格的插件加载进 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）：扫描 Claude 插件目录，接入 skills、commands 与可选的 SessionStart hooks，支持命令热更新与卸载清理。

description.en: AI UI automation via Midscene — android_ui and web_ui tools that tap, type, query, and assert on a real Android device or an already-running Chrome through the ctx.midscene seam.
description.zh: 基于 Midscene 的 AI UI 自动化——android_ui 与 web_ui 工具，通过 ctx.midscene seam 在真实 Android 设备或已运行的 Chrome 上完成点击、输入、查询与断言。

description.en: Adds one row to Settings → General with a switch that writes or removes a Windows logon startup entry for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, and registers a dsh_autostart tool exposing the same status, enable and disable operations. Defaults to a single HKCU Run value, no admin rights; the startup-folder launcher mode adds an optional delay and launch arguments.
description.zh: 在 设置 → 通用 里加一行「开机自启」开关，用于设置 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的开机自启：写入或删除它的 Windows 登录启动项，并注册 dsh_autostart 工具暴露同一组状态查询、开启与关闭操作。默认只写一条 HKCU Run 值，不需要管理员权限；启动文件夹模式额外支持延迟秒数与启动参数。

description.en: Connect Huawei CodeArts and OfficeAce models to DeepSeek Harness: it reuses existing logins (a logged-in CodeArts desktop client or dsh-codearts; the OfficeAce desktop app running and logged in on Windows), shows each account's remaining credits, toggles models per platform, and shapes requests like the official clients.
description.zh: 把华为「码道 CodeArts」与「果办 OfficeAce」两个平台的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：复用已有登录态（码道桌面端或 dsh-codearts 已登录；果办桌面端需在 Windows 上运行并登录），显示各账号积分余量、按平台勾选模型，并按官方客户端形态构造请求。

description.en: Reload a plugin's source the moment a file changes, without restarting the harness. Covers the third-party plugin case the built-in watcher misses because it skips node_modules.
description.zh: 改完插件源码即刻生效，无需重启 DSH。补上宿主内置热重载因排除 node_modules 而覆盖不到的第三方插件场景。

description.en: Hangs a clothesline of polaroid photos under the DeepSeek Harness message composer, on the session page and the new-session home screen; photos from a local folder refresh within seconds and clicking one opens a lightbox preview.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 消息输入框下方挂一条拍立得照片晾衣绳（会话页与新会话首页都会出现）；可换成自己文件夹里的照片，几秒内自动刷新，点击照片打开灯箱预览。

description.en: Adds a clarify mode: the agent loses its file-writing tools and can only ask questions until the required dimensions are covered, then writes a spec with acceptance criteria before implementing.
description.zh: 加一个需求澄清模式：模式内移除写文件工具，Agent 只能提问，覆盖完必需维度后产出带验收标准的 spec，再开始实现。

description.en: First-class Git tools for the model: status / diff / log / commit / branch with validated messages and paths - no bare-shell git calls.
description.zh: 一等公民的 Git 工具：status / diff / log / commit / branch，参数与路径校验、零 shell 调用，杜绝注入。

description.en: Opens the official Plannotator app (plannotator.ai) so you can review the agent's plan — annotate, approve, or send it back.
description.zh: 打开官方 Plannotator 应用（plannotator.ai）审代理写好的计划：批注、批准，或打回重写。

description.en: Unified model routing for DeepSeek Harness: one logical ModelID over multiple providers with first-token failover and cooldown, health-aware candidate ranking, three tiers (tier1/tier2/tier3) auto-selected by purpose, per-candidate reasoning effort, and a settings-page management panel.
description.zh: 统一模型路由：一个逻辑 ModelID 汇聚多家供应商，首 token 前失败自动切换并冷却、健康度择优、按 purpose 三档分级（tier1/2/3）、每候选思考级别，设置面板自动保存即时生效。

description.en: Knowledge base with a corrective acquisition loop for DeepSeek Harness: when the agent keeps hitting the same failure, a background worker fetches the web under a rate limit, distills the result into a staging area, and only a two-stage commit makes it recallable — pages without sources are refused.
description.zh: DSH 的纠错式补料知识库：agent 反复撞同一堵墙时，后台 worker 在限流下联网抓取、蒸馏结果先落暂存区，只有两段式 commit 才能进入召回——无来源的页面一律拒绝。

description.en: Layered syntax highlighting for bash/pwsh command and read code output in the DSH web GUI (VS Code Dark+ palette: keywords/strings/numbers/functions/comments each get a color); colors only what it recognizes, keeps tables/logs plain; pure frontend, zero token overhead.
description.zh: DSH web 插件：给 bash/pwsh 命令与 read 的代码输出做分层语法染色（VS Code Dark+ 配色：关键字/字符串/数字/函数名/注释各一色）；认得出来才染，表格/日志保持原样；纯前端渲染，零 token 开销。

description.en: Full-screen ice-and-fire boot intro for DSH: a frost-to-ember boot sequence with typed bilingual logs and a hairline progress line, then Ygritte's five-step identity authorization. Esc skips, Enter or click fast-forwards, and a settings page switches it off/quick/full or replays it; the host half paints the opening frame while the document parses, so the built-in loading card never shows.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段「冰与火」全屏开机片头：冰霜→余烬的启动动画、双语打字机日志与发丝进度线，随后是 Ygritte 的五步身份授权。Esc 跳过，Enter/点击快进，设置页可切换关闭/简易/完整或随时重播；首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段就注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸。

description.en: Settings-page usage dashboard: per-provider/model token summary across all sessions, with today/7-day/30-day CSS-bar trends and a cache-hit rate.
description.zh: 设置页用量仪表盘：按服务商/模型汇总全部会话 token 用量，含今日/近 7 天/近 30 天趋势柱状图与缓存命中率。

description.en: Feishu OAuth login reduces the need to distribute the DSH owner token while retaining token login; authorized users receive native owner session cookies with shared owner privileges, without per-user isolation.
description.zh: 通过飞书 OAuth 登录减少分发 DSH owner token 的需要，同时保留 token 登录；获准用户使用原生 owner 会话 Cookie，共享 owner 权限，不提供逐用户隔离。

description.en: Local-life toolkit for DSH agents: budget planning, bill splitting, unit-price and discount math, common unit conversions (jin/li/chi, C/F, L/gallon), and trip checklists.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供本地生活工具包：预算规划、账单分摊、单价与折扣计算、常用单位换算（斤/里/尺、摄氏/华氏、升/加仑）与出行清单。

description.en: Skill management panel inside DeepSeek Harness settings: lists global and per-project skills, marks whether the running DSH actually loads each one, offers one switch that controls both model and slash-command invocation, previews and edits SKILL.md with the chat UI markdown renderer, and creates, imports (folder or zip) or deletes skills into a recovery folder. It only reads and writes the local skill roots (~/.dsh/skills and <project>/.dsh/skills) through its own Host routes behind the DSH Connection trust fence; no telemetry, no outbound requests, no credentials.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的技能管理面板（设置 → 技能）：按全局 / 本项目两组列出技能，标注 DSH 是否真的加载了它；一个启用开关同时控制模型与 /命令 调用；用聊天界面同款 Markdown 渲染器预览并编辑 SKILL.md；支持新建、从文件夹或 zip 导入、删除到回收目录。只读写本机技能目录（~/.dsh/skills 与 <项目>/.dsh/skills），宿主路由走 DSH 的 Connection 信任围栏；不上报数据、无外发请求、不碰凭据。

description.en: Multi-tab side chat for DeepSeek Harness. Quote a whole message or text selected from a still-streaming reply into a side chat without waiting for the reply to finish, and dock the panel over the better-sidebar workbench or yield to the conversation depending on the sidebar state.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多标签侧聊增强：可引用整条消息，也可在回复生成中选中文本追问（无需等待回复完成）；右侧停靠面板随 better-sidebar 开关在覆盖与让位间自动切换。

description.en: Ecosystem-wide plugin health audit: syncs the dsh-plugin topic into a local scored catalog (maintenance / docs / npm + weekly downloads / ecosystem, 0-100, A-D), static security scan with high-finding grade veto, star history snapshots, web leaderboard and agent tools.
description.zh: 插件生态体检：将 dsh-plugin 话题同步为本地评分目录（维护/文档/npm+周下载/生态四维，0-100 分 A-D 级），静态安全扫描高危一票否决，支持 star 历史快照、Web 榜单与 Agent 工具。

description.en: A split-flap salary board for the DSH Web UI. Enter monthly salary, hours per day, working days per month and a start time, and the board settles today's earnings every 2 seconds on eight flip cells (currency symbol, four integer digits, decimal point, two decimals). Shows 0.00 before the shift, caps at the daily wage after it, and handles shifts that cross midnight. Six color schemes, drag anywhere (the position is kept on this machine), and a close button that collapses the board into a pill in the session header. Pure client-side bundle: no network calls and no dependencies.
description.zh: 挂在 DSH 网页界面上的翻牌工资看板。填好月薪、每天工时、每月工作天数、上班时间，板子每 2 秒结算一次今天赚了多少，用八格翻牌显示（人民币符号、四位整数、小数点、两位小数）。上班前显示 0.00，下班后封顶日薪，跨午夜的班次同样处理。六套配色，可拖到任意位置（位置存在本机），点关闭按钮收进会话顶栏的胶囊。纯前端 bundle，不联网、无依赖。

description.en: Appends the current turn's estimated token cost in CNY to the assistant action row, right after the usage/time indicator. Prices come from a built-in DeepSeek peak/off-peak CNY table (Beijing time, Monday-Friday 9:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) and can be overridden from the profile's cordis.patch.yml; a model without a configured price shows a dash instead of a made-up amount. Follows the shipped Performance & usage - Compact setting and hides together with the usage pill. Token cost only, per turn only.
description.zh: 在本轮对话的操作行「用量 / 时间」右侧追加该轮 token 费用估算（人民币）。单价来自内置的 DeepSeek 峰谷价目（北京时间，周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00），可在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里整表覆盖；没有配置单价的模型显示「¥—」，不套用其它价格。跟随官方「性能与用量 = 简洁」设置一起隐藏。只算 token 费用、只显示本轮。

description.en: Hides or disables specific tools for a customized list of agent presets, such as tools another plugin adds to every preset. Hidden tools are removed from the tool list and use no tokens, denied tools have calls refused. Can also blank system prompts added by other plugins. Configured in YAML. Does nothing until you add a config row.
description.zh: 为自定义的一组智能体预设隐藏或禁用特定工具，例如其他插件添加到所有预设的工具。隐藏的工具会从工具列表中移除，不占用 token；拒绝的工具调用会被拒绝。还可以清空其他插件添加的系统提示词。通过 YAML 配置。安装后需在 YAML 里加一行配置才会生效。

description.en: Codex-style left-side message navigation rail for the Web UI: one tick per user message, hover previews, and click-to-jump across the whole history.
description.zh: Codex 风格左侧消息导航轨道：每条用户消息一个刻度，悬停预览、点击跳转，全历史一次索引。

description.en: Shows the selected model provider's account balance next to the composer's model seat once a model and reasoning effort are selected.
description.zh: 在选择模型与推理强度后，于输入框模型选择器旁显示当前模型提供方的账户余额。

description.en: Registers the Inspiration Deck Workshop skill for DSH: local static HTML presentation decks (6 deck templates, 25+ layouts, 23 themes & motion showroom) with a validate + PNG/PDF export CLI and smoke tests, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册灵感演示工坊技能：本地静态 HTML 演示文稿（6 套 deck 模板、25+ 布局、23 套主题与动效展示馆），带 validate 校验与 PNG/PDF 导出 CLI 和 smoke 测试，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Artifact center: search, preview and open files produced by DSH conversations.
description.zh: 产物中心：跨工作区检索、预览并打开对话产出的文件。

description.en: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格生命周期 hooks：工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令（stdin 收 JSON payload），pre-tool 非零退出即阻断调用。

description.en: Context profiles for new sessions: pick which tools and which system prompt each new conversation receives. Deferred tools stay as name+summary placeholders, keeping the tool list and the prompt prefix cache stable.
description.zh: 为新会话选择注入的工具集合与系统提示词：档位表逐组切换工具、system 段逐项开关，被延迟的工具保留名字与功能摘要占位，工具表和前缀缓存保持稳定。

description.en: Bundles the PrismSearch MCP server and its agent skill. Web search over Bing and Baidu with no account or API key, plus Google and Brave when API keys are set and DuckDuckGo, Sogou, 360 and Yandex when enabled in config; automatic engine fallback and an aggregate mode. Also image search, WeChat Official Account article search, and fetch_page, which returns web pages and PDFs as Markdown in segments.
description.zh: 打包 PrismSearch MCP 服务与配套 Agent Skill。网页搜索默认使用 Bing 和百度，无需账号或 API Key；设置 API Key 后可用 Google、Brave，在配置中启用后可用 DuckDuckGo、搜狗、360、Yandex；支持引擎自动回退与聚合模式。另提供图片搜索、微信公众号文章搜索，以及把网页和 PDF 转成 Markdown 并分段读取的 fetch_page。

description.en: Trims historical images in outgoing chat requests down to a recent-image count, learns the provider per-prompt image cap from HTTP 400 responses, and retries with fewer images so image-heavy sessions keep working.
description.zh: 发送前把请求中的历史图片裁剪至保留张数，并从上游 400 错误解析单次图片上限、按更少张数降级重试，保证含图会话不被图片数量限制打断。

description.en: Voice control for the DSH web composer: push-to-talk speech-to-text into the input box (with optional auto-send), spoken playback of assistant replies via the Web Speech API, right-click settings popover, and a global Ctrl+M hotkey.
description.zh: DSH 网页端语音控制：按住说话将语音转文字输入发送框（可自动发送），用浏览器语音合成朗读助手回复；右键麦克风打开设置面板，支持 Ctrl+M 全局快捷键。

description.en: OpenCode Go balance pill at the right end of the composer tool row: rolling/weekly/monthly quota remaining straight from the Zen usage endpoint, with hover detail and warn/danger coloring.
description.zh: 输入框工具行右侧的 OpenCode Go 余额胶囊：滚动/每周/每月配额剩余百分比（数据直接来自 Zen 用量接口），悬停查看明细，低余额自动变黄/变红。

description.en: Lands the chat viewport on your most recent own message when you open a finished session, instead of the bottom of the conversation; running sessions still follow the bottom. Client-only: it reads the viewport and never touches files, credentials, subprocesses, or the network.
description.zh: 打开已结束的会话时，聊天视口落在你最近一条本人发言处而不是页面底部；正在运行的会话仍跟到底。纯客户端：不碰文件、凭据、子进程与网络。

description.en: Claude Code style /init command and tool that writes a minimal CLAUDE.md and symlinks AGENTS.md to it.
description.zh: 提供 Claude Code 风格的 /init 命令与工具，生成极简 CLAUDE.md，并将 AGENTS.md 以相对软链指向它。

description.en: Separate slash-command group in the Web UI composer: /steer injects text on the agent's next step without interrupting the turn, /new starts a blank session, /skill and /docs wrap /steer with post-turn skill or docs tasks, and custom /steer aliases are configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 输入框的斜杠菜单里单独一组插件命令：/steer 在模型下一步注入内容且不打断当前回合，/new 开启空白会话，/skill 与 /docs 在 /steer 基础上附加完成后写入 skill 或 docs，并可在设置里为常用 /steer 内容配置自定义快捷命令。

description.en: RSS/Atom digest bundle for dsh: subscribe to feeds, fetch on a schedule, dedupe exact and near-duplicate stories, and get LLM-summarized daily Markdown briefings delivered into conversations and/or files (with a standalone CLI).
description.zh: dsh 的 RSS/Atom 摘要插件:订阅源管理、定时抓取、精确与近似去重,并由 LLM 生成每日 Markdown 简报投递到会话和/或文件(同时提供独立 CLI)。

description.en: A cross-session project board for managing projects, plans, tasks, and external document references in the DSH web UI and agent tools. Verified on Windows 11 x64 only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面和 agent 工具中跨会话管理项目、计划、任务和外置文档引用。仅在 Windows 11 x64 上验证过。

description.en: Network optimization for the DSH web UI: reduces transfer size with caching and compression to greatly speed up page loading, plus a connection-drop indicator and automatic reconnection. Ideal for users pursuing peak performance or using unstable networks.
description.zh: dsh网页端网络优化：通过缓存与压缩技术降低传输，从而大幅提升网页加载速度；同时提供网络断连指示与自动断网重连功能。非常适合追求极致性能或网络不稳定用户使用。

description.en: Update checker for plugin bundles installed in a DSH profile: a Version section on the detail page of a plugin installed from a GitHub repository or release tarball compares the installed commit or version with the exact target, and the /plugin-updater commands list bundles, check npm, Git-repository and GitHub-release sources, and prepare an update that runs only after confirmation; a read-only plugin_updates tool lets an agent check without installing, npm registry packages keep DSH native update controls, a fixed version or commit stays pinned unless explicitly allowed, and the plugin never approves build scripts.
description.zh: 检查 DSH profile 内已装插件包更新的工具：从 GitHub 仓库或 release tarball 安装的插件，其详情页会出现 Version 分区，把已装 commit 或版本与确切目标版本对照；/plugin-updater 命令可列出插件包、检查 npm、Git 仓库与 GitHub release 三种来源并生成待确认的更新，确认后才执行；只读的 plugin_updates 工具让 Agent 只检查而不安装，npm registry 包继续使用 DSH 原生更新方式，固定版本或 commit 需显式允许才会升级，且本插件从不代为批准构建脚本。

description.en: Auto-expand reasoning and tool cards, tune code-block font size and line spacing, and choose the model output language (auto, Chinese or English).
description.zh: 自动展开思考与工具卡片，调整代码块字号与行距，并可选择模型输出语言（自动、中文或 English）。

description.en: Global experience archive for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: probes local tools (with versions and PATH-first hits), convenient paths, network latency and disk speed; folds per-session stats from session/event; LLM-extracts durable facts; env_profile tool with remember; byte-stable summary injected every turn to speed up sessions and cut token use.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全局经验档案（Windows）：探测本地工具（含版本与 PATH 首个命中）、便捷路径、网络延迟与磁盘速度；从 session/event 折叠每会话统计；由 LLM 抽取持久知识条目；提供带 remember 的 env_profile 工具；每轮注入字节稳定的摘要，加快会话并降低 token 消耗。

description.en: Connector hub for DeepSeek Harness: browse 13 curated remote MCP connectors in a Connectors tab, authorize them with OAuth or an API key, and keep credentials in the macOS Keychain. MCP tools mount at the profile root and credentials pass through a loopback-only gateway.
description.zh: DSH 的连接器市场：在「连接器」tab 里浏览 13 个精选远程 MCP 连接器，用 OAuth 或 API Key 授权，凭据保存在 macOS 钥匙串。MCP 工具挂在 profile 根目录，凭据只经 loopback 网关转发。

description.en: Automatically generates and displays images in the DSH chat via API channels or local CLIs (mmx / codex / agy), and can also recognize images using the corresponding CLI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天窗口自动调用生图工具（API 渠道，或本机 CLI：已支持 mmx / codex / agy）并展示图片，也支持利用对应 CLI 识别图片。

description.en: Android client implementation for DeepSeek Harness: bridges local dsh web to the OneBox app with QR scan-to-pair and an end-to-end encrypted cloud relay tunnel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端实现:扫码配对 + 端到端加密云端中继,把本机 dsh web 桥接到万宝盒 App。

description.en: Adds touch-friendly navigation, layout refinements, and standalone PWA styling to the existing DeepSeek Harness web interface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 现有 Web 界面加上触屏友好的导航、布局微调与独立 PWA 样式。

description.en: Proxy provider that reshapes each outbound payload through a per-category op chain before forwarding upstream, keeping the prompt prefix monotonic between turns so unchanged history is not re-paid at full price; op names are transports (exec / http / inline) and accept user-defined algorithms.
description.zh: 代理 provider：每次出网前按类别跑 op 链重塑 payload 再转交上游，使 prompt 前缀在回合之间保持单调、未变的历史不必按全价重付；op 名只表示传输方式（exec / http / inline），可接入用户自定义算法。

description.en: Five Brave Search tools — web/news/image/video results, token-budgeted page context, cited AI answers, local places, and autocomplete/spellcheck — plus a brave search provider for the built-in web_search tool. Needs a Brave Search API key (BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY; some endpoints need a higher plan). Based on Brave's official Search API skills; it uses the same plugin id as BuffMcBigHuge/dsh-brave-search, so install only one of the two.
description.zh: 五个 Brave 搜索工具：网页/新闻/图片/视频结果、按 token 预算裁剪的正文、带引用的 AI 回答、本地地点、联想与拼写纠错；另提供一个 brave 搜索 provider，供内置 web_search 使用。需要 Brave Search API 密钥（BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY，部分接口要更高档的套餐）。基于 Brave 官方的 Search API skills；与 BuffMcBigHuge/dsh-brave-search 使用同一个插件 id，二者只装其一。

description.en: GitHub Trending masonry feed in the DSH sidebar: daily, weekly and monthly boards with category chips, concise project intros, and one-click starring that syncs to your GitHub account or saves to a local collection. It reads github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com, sends README excerpts to your current model and text to Google Translate when a translation is needed, and stars with the GitHub token you connect (or GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN); its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 带侧边栏的 GitHub Trending 瀑布流：日/周/月三榜加分类标签，简明扼要的项目简介，一键加星可同步到 GitHub 账号或存入本地收藏。它会读取 github.com 与 raw.githubusercontent.com，把 README 摘录发给当前模型、需要翻译时把文本发给 Google Translate，并用你连接的 GitHub 令牌（或 GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN）加星；它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Ships a skill that documents how to build, debug and publish DSH plugins - host and client package skeleton, developing a forked plugin inside a throwaway profile, publishing to GitHub and npm, and the pitfalls found while shipping them. Installing the plugin registers the skill.
description.zh: 携带一份技能，讲怎么开发、调试、发布 DSH 插件——host/client 双半包骨架、把 fork 挂进丢弃式 profile 开发、发布到 GitHub 与 npm，以及发布过程中实际踩到的坑。安装插件即注册该技能。

description.en: Service control panel in DSH Web settings: live host info (PID, versions, uptime, memory/CPU trends, active sessions), npm update banner, and a confirm-guarded graceful stop that warns when tasks are running and can wait for them to finish.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置页的服务控制面板：实时宿主信息（PID、版本、运行时长、内存/CPU 趋势、活跃会话）、npm 更新提醒，以及带确认的优雅停止——任务运行时发出警告，也可等待任务结束后自动停止。

description.en: A cozy offline vocabulary trainer for the whole family: 1094 curated words, spaced repetition, 6 quiz types, spelling games and a lazy large-screen mode; opens as a sidebar panel and also runs standalone as one HTML file.
description.zh: 舒服的离线背单词全家桶：1094 个精选单词、间隔重复、6 种题型、拼写游戏和躺着背大字模式；侧边栏面板打开，也可作为单个 HTML 文件独立运行。

description.en: Plays video and audio files in the right Sidebar preview pane, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek a large file without launching a native player on the Host.
description.zh: 在右側欄預覽區直接播放影片同音訊，經帶認證的 HTTP Range 路由串流，令遠端瀏覽器可以播放同跳轉大型檔案，唔使喺主機開原生播放器。

description.en: Manage DSH rules from the web settings panel — edit global/project AGENTS.md, or auto-split pasted rules into layered AGENTS.md and skills via LLM.
description.zh: 在设置面板统一管理 DSH 规则：编辑全局/项目 AGENTS.md，或由 LLM 自动拆分粘贴的规则为分层 AGENTS.md 与技能。

description.en: SillyTavern-style prompt rules for DSH: layered system-prompt anchors, constant/keyword entries, reproducible probability gates and regex rewriting.
description.zh: 类世界书的 DSH 提示词规则：分层系统提示锚点、蓝绿灯条目、可复现概率门与正则替换。

description.en: Survival mode: all sessions share one satiety/health pool — each model step burns satiety, starvation freezes tool calls until fed, with an MC mini-game for gathering food.
description.zh: 生存模式：全局共享一条饱食度与生命，模型每步思考消耗饱食度，饿死后全局工具被冻结，通过 MC 采集小游戏获取食物喂食复活。

description.en: A machine-checked reasoning ledger: every fact must resolve to a real file:line and be quoted verbatim from it, every assumption must state what would falsify it, and a conclusion may not rest on an assumption that never comes back for review. The ledger can carry a review date, a confidence and a kill condition. Ships the checker tool, an /fp command family, an optional gate that asks before irreversible shell commands, and a web panel listing the error codes each round fixed.
description.zh: 可机械核对的第一性原理台账：事实必须落回真实的 文件:行 并逐字引用那里的话，假设必须写明什么情况下它错了，结论不得依赖一个永不回来复查的假设；台账可带复查日期、置信度与止损条件。附带校验工具、/fp 命令族、不可逆命令前的可选闸门，以及列出每轮修掉哪些错误码的面板。

description.en: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes — title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt, with subagent filtering and fire-and-forget delivery.
description.zh: 回合结束时向 Server酱3 推送微信通知——标题、模型、项目目录、Git 分支、状态与回复摘要，支持子代理过滤，fire-and-forget 不阻塞主流程。

description.en: Sidebar archive directory for DSH Web: restore a session to its original workspace slot, delete the session log, or edit-and-branch a user message into a new conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏归档目录：将会话恢复到原工作区槽位、删除会话日志，或从用户消息修改并分支为新会话。

description.en: Right-click menus for the DSH Web UI — copy, cut, paste and select all on text and input areas, plus copy path, reveal in the file manager and open with the default app on file references and links.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面补上右键菜单：文字与输入框可复制/剪切/粘贴/全选，文件引用与链接可复制路径、在文件管理器中定位、用默认应用打开。

description.en: DSH environment management: auto-installs a Rust/Tauri desktop host (downloaded per-OS from dsh-desktop-host releases, source build as fallback), one-click runtime updates, Windows platform compatibility, official DeepSeek billing, and a built-in code editor for the workspace.
description.zh: dsh 环境管理插件：自动获取 Rust/Tauri 桌面宿主（按系统从 dsh-desktop-host 下载，无 Release 时源码构建），运行时一键更新、Windows 平台兼容自动适配、DeepSeek 官方计费，并内置工作区代码编辑器。

description.en: macOS system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: aborted, max-tokens, blocked, interrupted and error events, pending questions and approvals, and completion or subagent-end via terminal-notifier; clicking a banner opens a configured app and returning to the page auto-dismisses them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 系统通知插件：任务中止、超限、阻塞、中断、出错、等待提问或批准、完成或子代理结束等事件通过 terminal-notifier 弹系统横幅；点击横幅打开指定应用，回到页面自动清空。

description.en: A Wang Lin cultivation companion for dsh: watches your session state and acts it out with rich animations, and levels up as you cultivate.
description.zh: 渡劫飞升：仙逆王林修炼伙伴。实时监控会话状态，用打坐、掐诀、御剑、雷龙等丰富交互动画演绎大模型的每一个动作，随使用修炼升境。

description.en: AI-generated curiosity & trivia plugin for the dsh web GUI (Curio in the English UI): 「开始探奇」 generates a fresh batch of unexpected knowledge (excluding everything already seen), each item unfolds into two deeper layers plus similar knowledge points, and 「探奇清单」 keeps the full history (batch, items, layers, similar points) in browser storage. Reuses the host LLM channel with zero config; when no model is available, a DeepSeek API key can be pasted into the panel. Output language follows the DSH UI language (zh/en).
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面生成冷知识与奇妙事实的插件（英文界面下名为 Curio）：「开始探奇」每次生成一批不重复主题（排除已见），每条可深入两层并展开类似知识点，「探奇清单」将全部历史（批次、条目、层级、类似点）保存在浏览器；优先复用宿主 LLM 通道，无需配置，无可用模型时可在面板填写 DeepSeek API Key；输出语言跟随 DSH 界面语言（中/英）。

description.en: Listen to Ximalaya podcasts and audiobooks inside the DSH web UI: search albums, browse paginated tracks, and play through a now-playing bar (prev/play/next, seek, volume, rate). After QR login the "Mine" page lists your liked tracks (click to play), subscribed albums with latest-episode hints, and followed anchors with their public albums; the host relays audio streams with Range support and registers an `ximalaya_play` tool so the agent can search and play on request.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面收听喜马拉雅播客/有声书：搜索专辑、分页浏览曲目，播放条支持上下集/进度/音量/倍速；扫码登录后「我的」页可看收藏的声音（点击即播）、我的订阅（带最新一集提示）与关注的主播（含其公开专辑）；Host 端音频流代理支持 Range 拖动，并注册 `ximalaya_play` 模型工具让 agent 按需搜索播放。

description.en: DingTalk IM channel via Stream-mode WebSocket: each chat drives its own tooled agent; replies stream back as messages, no public callback URL needed.
description.zh: 钉钉 IM 双向 channel（Stream 模式）：每条单聊/群聊驱动一个 agent，思考与回复通过 WebSocket 长连接回流消息，免公网回调。

description.en: Action Hub for DSH: a standard Agent Skill library whose SKILL.md files can run as model-visible Skills or user-only Commands, with groups, project scopes, import/export and a native Alt+A palette.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的标准 Agent Skill 库：同一份 SKILL.md 可作为模型可见的 Skill 或仅由用户调用的 Command，支持分组、项目范围、导入导出和原生 Alt+A 面板。

description.en: Round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows desktop, reusing existing Agent sessions with discussion, editable task cards, sequential and parallel steps, shared meeting files, and secretary minutes.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 桌面版 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的圆桌会议，复用已有 Agent 会话，提供讨论、可编辑任务卡、顺序与并行步骤、会议文件归档及秘书纪要。

description.en: Connects the agent to JuzPost, a social media scheduler, over MCP: lists connected accounts, checks per-platform limits, uploads media, and drafts, schedules or publishes posts to YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, Tumblr and WordPress. Registers the JuzPost tools as mcp__juzpost__* plus a workflow skill that confirms with the user before anything is published. Needs a JuzPost API key in JUZPOST_API_KEY; JuzPost issues API keys on paid plans.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 将智能体连接到 JuzPost（社交媒体排程工具）：列出已连接账号、检查各平台限制、上传媒体，并向 YouTube、Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、X、LinkedIn、Pinterest、Bluesky、Threads、Tumblr 和 WordPress 起草、排程或发布帖子。注册 mcp__juzpost__* 工具及一个发布前先向用户确认的工作流技能。需要在 JUZPOST_API_KEY 中提供 JuzPost API 密钥；JuzPost 的 API 密钥需付费方案才能创建。

description.en: Low-token web search that returns only {title, url, snippet} per hit — vendor extras such as answer, score and raw_content never enter the context. Five interchangeable backends (Tavily, Brave, SearXNG, Google CSE, Exa) with automatic failover to the next usable one in fallback / chain order when the primary fails, deduplicating repeated providers. Returned URLs and snippets are sanitized of tracking parameters.
description.zh: 低 Token 联网搜索：只把结果裁成 {title, url, snippet} 三个字段返回，厂商附带的 answer / score / raw_content 等一律不进上下文。后端可在 Tavily、Brave、SearXNG、Google CSE、Exa 五种之间配置，主后端失败时按 fallback / chain 顺序自动切换到下一个可用后端（同一后端去重）。返回的 URL 与摘要经清洗，除去跟踪参数。

description.en: Fork of SheepofSheep/dsh-doyourweb that puts the browser on another machine: the MV3 extension dials out to this plugin over TLS, so DSH reads and acts on a remote Chrome or Edge rather than a local one. It also generates ready-paired extension packages for the current configuration, adds tab open and close tools, writes annotation detail to a file instead of pasting it into the chat, and shows a checklist naming which part of a remote setup is misconfigured. Interfaces with no DOM at all are reachable too: canvas games, canvas maps and hand-drawn widgets take coordinate clicks, drags and wheel input that glide, pause and hold like a person's, and the viewport is checked before every action so a stale coordinate is refused rather than clicked blindly. It reuses the same browser-tabs plugin id as the upstream, so do not install both in the same profile. Requires Chrome or Edge 125+ and an unpacked MV3 extension loaded manually on the browser machine; the plugin does not install the extension. With tls: true, trust the generated ca.crt as a root certificate there. The extension gives the model access to the tabs and signed-in sessions of the browser it is paired with. The bridge listens on 127.0.0.1 by default; a non-loopback bind needs remote: true, and the extension pairs with a token confirmed by the user.
description.zh: SheepofSheep/dsh-doyourweb 的 fork，把浏览器放到另一台机器：MV3 扩展主动经 TLS 出站连接插件，DSH 因此能读取并操作远程的 Chrome/Edge，而不限于本机浏览器。此外按当前配置生成已配对的扩展包、新增开/关标签页工具、把批注明细落盘而不是塞进聊天，并提供远程接入自检表指出配置哪一环不对。完全没有 DOM 的界面也能操作：canvas 游戏、canvas 地图与自绘控件可用坐标点击、拖拽与滚轮驱动，事件像人一样滑行—停顿—按下—保持，且每次动作前校验视口尺寸，坐标过期时直接拒绝而不是点偏。 它与上游共用同一个 browser-tabs 插件 id，不能与 SheepofSheep/dsh-doyourweb 同装。需要 Chrome/Edge 125+，并在浏览器所在机器手动加载解包的 MV3 扩展（插件不会自动安装）；走 TLS 时还要把生成的 ca.crt 装进受信任的根证书颁发机构。扩展让模型能访问所配对浏览器里的标签页与已登录会话。桥接默认只监听 127.0.0.1，非回环地址需要 remote: true，扩展用经用户确认的令牌配对。

description.en: Hide chosen workspaces from the DSH sidebar and archive their sessions along with them, so those sessions never spill into the ungrouped list. Fully local and reversible; with dsh-archive-manager installed the archiving is real and undoable, otherwise it stays a display-only layer. Restore any hidden workspace from Settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏隐藏指定工作区，并把它的会话一并归档，避免这些会话溢出到「未分组」列表。纯本地、完全可逆；装了 dsh-archive-manager 时执行真归档且可撤销，未装时退化为纯显示层。随时可在设置页恢复。

description.en: Hosted tool server over MCP: invoice and bank-statement extraction with in-code arithmetic checks, ledger reconciliation in integer cents, PDF and table conversion, SQL dialect transpiling, and mainland-China reachability probes run from a China Mobile network vantage point.
description.zh: 托管工具服务器（MCP）：发票与银行流水提取并做代码内算术校验、按整数分对账、PDF 与表格转换、SQL 方言转写，以及从中国移动骨干网实测大陆可达性。

description.en: Strinova theme: light/dark modes, a Cielle character illustration on the new-session screen, a corner character randomly picked on each page load with a matching composer placeholder line, and floating particles.
description.zh: 卡拉彼丘主题：日夜双模式；新会话页展示汐的角色立绘，右下角角色与输入栏台词按页面加载随机轮换，并点缀漂浮粒子。

description.en: Keyboard navigation for the DSH Web GUI: hold Control for 1-9 conversation numbers in the sidebar, Control+Tab to cycle, Control+J to jump to any conversation from a panel that also lists collapsed and not-yet-rendered ones, double-tap Option for clickable hints, and Option+Enter to focus the composer.
description.zh: 键盘流 DSH 会话导航：按住 Control 在侧边栏显示 1-9 编号、Control+Tab 轮转、Control+J 从覆盖全部会话（含折叠分组与未渲染行）的面板跳转；双击 Option 为可点击控件显示字母提示，Option+Enter 聚焦输入框。

description.en: Web theme and file workspace plugin with global typography controls, @file mentions, a project file tree, Markdown preview, and a resizable side panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 主题与文件工作台：全局字体设置、@ 文件引用、项目文件树、Markdown 预览和可拖拽侧边面板。

description.en: Per-turn file-change card for DSH Desktop: +N −M badges, aligned diffs, and Mac/Windows file open (system app, Finder/Explorer, VS Code).
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的轮末改动卡：编辑/写入行显示 +N −M，点开审 diff；macOS 和 Windows 可用系统应用、文件夹或 VS Code 打开文件。

description.en: Scheduled send: fire a drafted message into the bound conversation as a normal user bubble at a set time. Runs host-side, so the browser can stay closed; per-session isolation and restart-safe redelivery.
description.zh: 定时发送：到点将拟好的消息以正常用户气泡发送到绑定的会话。调度在服务端执行，关闭浏览器不影响发送；会话隔离、重启自动补发。

description.en: Windows-only: per-session auto-shutdown switch in the session header — once every armed session has no turn, job or subagent still running (by default every other live session must be idle too), a two-minute countdown starts and the machine powers off; clicking the countdown cancels it, and sessions without the switch never start one.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：会话标题栏上的「任务完成后自动关机」开关——所有开启它的会话都不再有进行中的回合、任务或子代理（默认还要求其他在线会话也空闲）时，开始两分钟倒计时，结束后关机；点倒计时即取消，没开这个开关的会话不会触发任何动作。

description.en: Ships a skill plus six Node scripts for a DSH install that will not come up - walking the boot stages before readiness, the plugin dependency bridges and junctions under a profile, dead or duplicated plugin rows, and the upgrade path. The scripts are diagnostics first; the rebuild helper only writes when it is given --fix.
description.zh: 携带一份技能加 6 个 Node 脚本，用来处理装完起不来的 DSH——沿 readiness 之前的引导阶段、profile 下的插件依赖桥与 junction、失效或重复的插件行、以及升级路径逐段排查。脚本默认只诊断，重建脚本只有显式加 --fix 才写盘。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek's official service status in the DSH session header, including overall and per-component status, uptime percentages, and active or recent incidents. A maintained fork of KekuKase/dsh-deepseek-status (published as @mengls1620/dsh-deepseek-status since 0.1.6); do not install it alongside the original dsh-deepseek-status — both register the same /deepseek-status route and plugin row id.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话头部显示 DeepSeek 官方服务状态，包括总体状态、各组件状态、可用率，以及进行中或最近的事件。这是 KekuKase/dsh-deepseek-status 的维护分支（0.1.6 起以 @mengls1620/dsh-deepseek-status 发布）；不要与原版 dsh-deepseek-status 同时安装——两者会注册同一个 /deepseek-status 路由与同一条插件行 id。

description.en: Hides the sidebar's global panel navigation (Plugins / Market / Schedules / More) and gives the vertical space back to the session list; three modes, switchable in Settings → Sidebar.
description.zh: 隐藏侧栏顶部的全局导航（插件 / 插件市场 / 自动化任务 / 更多），把垂直空间还给会话列表；三档模式，在 设置 → 侧栏 里切换。

description.en: Drive a browser from one natural-language goal: a decision service picks the next operation and target from an indexed element table, so a DSH session spends one tool call instead of one turn per click.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 一句话目标：决策服务从带编号的元素表里挑出下一步操作与目标元素，驱动真实浏览器把事办完，一趟多步任务只花一次工具调用。

description.en: Inject deployment-configured system-prompt sections and reference exchanges into every conversation request via stream interception, with a web settings panel.
description.zh: 通过流拦截将部署级系统提示词段落与参考对话注入每次对话请求，附带 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Cleanup Mode agent preset for DSH: read-only scans of leftovers (including duplicate detection), a manifest before anything is deleted, trash-first removal only after confirmation, and a per-session audit log. Cleaning outside the workspace requires a danger-full-access session; under workspace-write it can only inspect and will ask you to raise the permission.
description.zh: DSH 清理模式 agent 预设：只读扫描残留（含重复文件检测），删除前先出清单，确认后优先移入回收站，并按会话写审计记录。清理工作区之外的位置需要 danger-full-access 会话；workspace-write 下只能检查并会提示你提升权限。

description.en: Per-workspace skill visibility: each workspace binds one named switch table, so which skills the model may call on its own follows the project instead of every installed skill being listed every turn. Cannot be installed together with dsh-skill-scope.
description.zh: 按工作区控制 skill 可见性：工作区绑定一张具名开关表，模型每轮能自动调用的 skill 随项目而定，不再每轮列出全部已安装 skill。不能与 dsh-skill-scope 同装。

description.en: Toggles installed plugins from a sidebar panel, groups them by origin (official, marketplace, local), flags changes that need a Host restart, and installs curated plugins from a Discover tab.
description.zh: 在侧边栏面板里一键启停已安装插件，按来源分组（官方自带、市场安装、本地导入），标出需要重启 Host 才生效的改动，并在「发现」页一键安装精选插件。

description.en: Draw.io in chat: describe it, get an interactive diagram in the transcript; 12 Chinese scenario templates; keep editing or undo the same .drawio file; right-sidebar preview. No account, no MCP server, no editor.
description.zh: 聊天里画 draw.io：说一句需求，对话里直接出可交互图表；内置 12 个中文场景模板；可继续改图、撤销同一个 .drawio 文件；右侧栏预览不再是 XML。不登录 draw.io、不需要 MCP server、不用装编辑器。

description.en: Git development workbench for DeepSeek Harness: captures branch, status, worktrees, stashes and recent commits, with commands, tools and a settings UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Git 开发工作台：采集分支、状态、worktree、stash 和最近提交，并通过命令、工具与设置界面管理 Git 工作区。

description.en: Local-first Agent Experience Network for DeepSeek Harness, distilling task-level experiences from traces and live manifests, grading by H0-H4 evidence, discovering by compatibility, and promoting only after explicit review.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先 Agent 经验网络：从 trace 与实时 Manifest 蒸馏任务级经验，按 H0-H4 证据分级、按兼容性发现，经显式审阅后才晋升。

description.en: Makes the built-in web_fetch tool work when Clash / mihomo runs in TUN mode with fake-ip: it lets the fake-ip address ranges (198.18.0.0/15, fdfe:dcba:9876::/64, 2001:2::/48) past the public-address check that otherwise rejects them, while loopback, private and link-local addresses stay blocked as before. Works with no proxy environment variables and no Clash changes.
description.zh: 让内置 web_fetch 在 Clash / mihomo 以 TUN + fake-ip 模式运行时正常工作：只放行 fake-ip 地址段（198.18.0.0/15、fdfe:dcba:9876::/64、2001:2::/48）通过公网地址校验，回环、内网与链路本地地址仍照旧拦截。无需设置代理环境变量，也无需改动 Clash。

description.en: Custom brand icon and name for the DSH Web sidebar and conversation hero, editable live from a settings card on the plugin detail page.
description.zh: 自定义 DSH Web 侧边栏与会话页的品牌图标和名称，插件详情页内置设置卡片，保存即生效。

description.en: Character skins with an editable decoration board — Yukino warm daily and occult editorial themes, each with dual character sprites + sticker sheets, drag/resize/rotate coordinate editor, custom asset upload, and shareable diorama packs (assets + layout bundled).
description.zh: 角色皮肤舞台：雪乃·暖阳日常与隐秘年代志双主题，各带双角色立绘与表情贴纸；可视化装饰看板支持拖动/缩放/旋转/坐标精调/锚定切换/上传素材，装饰包（素材+布局）可导出分享、导入后自动打开看板继续调整。

description.en: Gives dsh the ability to generate images and videos through the grok2api API.
description.zh: 让 dsh 通过 grok2api 的 API 获得生成图片与视频能力。

description.en: War Thunder user-skin studio: 4-point UV quad picker, quad-clipped art layers, and PNG/DDS/.blk export.
description.zh: 战争雷霆自定义涂装插件：四点 UV 取点器、按四边形裁切的艺术图层，导出 PNG/DDS/.blk。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin adding an OKX perpetual-futures price dashboard: BTC/ETH candlesticks at 1m/3m/15m/1h/4h/1D, EMA overlays, line/Fibonacci/ruler drawing tools, close-line alerts through desktop notification, sound or email (email delivery additionally needs the dsh-qq-email plugin), and an in-panel backtester. Market data comes from OKX public endpoints and no API key is required.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 OKX 永续合约看板插件：BTC/ETH 的 1m/3m/15m/1h/4h/1D K 线、EMA 均线叠加、直线/斐波那契/尺子画线、收线预警（桌面通知/提示音/邮件；邮件通道需另装 dsh-qq-email 插件）与面板内回测。行情来自 OKX 公开接口，不需要 API key。

description.en: COROS Sport panel for DeepSeek Harness: sign in to COROS inside the panel, read the account, bound devices, recovery, fitness, recent workouts, daily health and the training schedule in one dashboard, and get a plan from the model with /coros-plan. The plan page writes a fixed four-week, 16-session plan to the account only after a two-step confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内登录高驰（COROS）账号，用一个面板查看账号、绑定设备、恢复、体能、近期运动、每日健康与训练安排，并可用 /coros-plan 让模型按账号数据给出训练计划；计划页只在二次确认后才把固定的四周 16 节课写入账号。

description.en: Requirement-driven dsh plugin discovery and environment recipes: plugin_guide matches natural-language needs to a curated plugin directory with reasons and install commands; recipe installs whole setups (通知全家桶, 安全审计套装...) from bundled community bundles with ordered plans.
description.zh: 需求型插件导购与环境配方：plugin_guide 按自然语言需求语义匹配精选插件并给出理由与安装命令；recipe 一键安装整套社区配方（通知全家桶、安全审计套装等），带有序安装计划。

description.en: Composer UI for DeepSeek Harness that does two things. The reasoning-effort row in the model menu becomes a continuous slider drawn on the row itself, with the rungs read live from the model adapter so any ladder length works; each rung paints its own ember plume into a canvas behind the knob. Separately, the permission trigger renders in the theme error colour whenever full access is the active preset, including its row in the permission menu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的输入框增强，做两件事。模型菜单里的推理等级行变成直接画在该行上的连续滑块，档位实时读取模型适配器，因此档位数不限；每档会在旋钮背后的 canvas 上喷出各自的余烬尾焰。另外，只要当前是完全权限，权限触发器就用主题的错误色渲染，权限菜单里对应那一行同样变红。

description.en: Per-session clock injection with durable idle-gap tracking: tells the agent how long it has been since this particular conversation last spoke, which the host's time context (last message only) cannot.
description.zh: 给指定会话授时，并给出「距上次对话过去多久」。补上宿主时间上下文只算「距上一条消息」、无法按会话开关的缺口。

description.en: Session Console: a sidebar dashboard over every conversation that shows run state, token spend, cache hit rate, context pressure and a heat score, resolves a plain-language sentence such as "how is the example project going" to the matching session, and dispatches that sentence as a queued task into it. Ships five agent tools (overview, find, tail, dispatch, cancel) over the same data.
description.zh: 会话总控：给侧栏加一个覆盖全部对话的仪表盘，显示运行状态、token 消耗、缓存命中率、上下文压力与热度分数；说一句“示例项目怎么样了”即可定位到对应会话，并把这句话作为任务派发进去。同时提供 5 个 agent 工具（overview / find / tail / dispatch / cancel），与界面共用同一套数据。

description.en: Asks the few key questions that decide the approach before work starts — one shot, about 200 tokens per session, no tool registration and no extra model call.
description.zh: 开工前用一次提问把关键选择问清（静态还是动态、Hexo 还是 Hugo），约 200 token/会话，不注册工具、不额外调模型；可在精简/标准/深入三档间切换。

description.en: Mobile adapter for the DSH web shell: overlay sidebar/details drawers, responsive composer and settings below 768px, zero desktop regression.
description.zh: DSH Web 移动端适配插件：侧边栏/详情抽屉浮层化、输入栏与设置页响应式适配，桌面零回归。

description.en: One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.
description.zh: macOS 上 DSH Web 的一键启停启动器：前台/后台启动、停止、状态、防重复启动、自动打开浏览器，并可用脚本构建程序坞版 DSH.app。

description.en: Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API first, falling back to a local Qwen3-VL worker.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 聊天界面内联渲染粘贴/上传的图片，并让纯文本模型“看见”图片：visual_review 工具优先调用任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API，未配置时回退本机 Qwen3-VL。

description.en: Fetches Tsinghua MadModel API tokens and renews them from the saved SSO session on a 20-minute timer in a windowless browser, writes the token into the DSH credential MADMODEL_API_KEY and creates or reuses the madmodel model provider; one manual Get captures that session through the campus login window.
description.zh: 获取清华 MadModel 的 API token，按每 20 分钟在无窗口浏览器里用已保存的 SSO 会话续期，写入 DSH 凭据 MADMODEL_API_KEY 并创建或复用 madmodel 模型 Provider；手动点一次 Get 就通过校内登录窗口捕获该会话。

description.en: Minimal ↑/↓ input history for the DSH web composer: press ↑/↓ to walk back through sent messages. Nothing else.
description.zh: DSH 会话输入框的极简输入历史：按 ↑/↓ 翻阅发过的消息。只有方向键，别无其他。

description.en: Update checker (npm edition): a settings page comparing local and latest versions of @deepseek-ai/dsh and every installed plugin, with a red-dot nav reminder and ready-made update commands.
description.zh: 更新检查器（npm 版）：设置页对比 @deepseek-ai/dsh 与已装插件的本地/最新版本，有更新时导航红点提醒，并直接给出更新命令。

description.en: Enhances the native right-sidebar Files tab rather than replacing it: each row gets an @ reference button that inserts the canonical path mention into the composer, plus a size column, a sortable modification-time column, and a status dot for untracked, unstaged and staged files. Below the tree a git bar shows the branch with ahead/behind counts and expands upward into the 20 most recent commits, with a repository selector when a workspace has independent repositories in subdirectories. A header search box walks the workspace recursively and can open a result or expand the tree at it, preview tabs offer reveal-in-tree and one-click @, the tree is keyboard navigable with ARIA tree semantics, and a right-click entry on the Files tab switches back to the native tree at runtime.
description.zh: 增强右侧栏原生的「文件」标签页而非替换它：每行带一个 @ 引用按钮，把规范路径提及插入输入框；另有大小列、可排序的修改时间列，以及按未跟踪/未暂存/已暂存着色的状态点。文件树下方有 git 栏，显示分支与领先/落后数量，并可向上展开最近 20 条提交；当工作区的子目录是独立仓库时提供仓库选择器。页头搜索框递归遍历工作区，可打开结果或在文件树中展开定位；预览页签提供「在文件树中定位」与一键 @；文件树支持键盘导航与 ARIA tree 语义；右键「文件」标签页可在运行时切回原生树。

description.en: Yugan Huafang (语感花房) is a personal voice workshop for DeepSeek Harness: your own writing and corrections become explainable local style rules, optionally distilled by the current model, then compiled into a preset you pick per session; edits apply on the next message in that session.
description.zh: 语感花房是 DSH 的个人语气工作台：把你自己写的语料和纠正变成可解释的本地风格规则，可选当前模型深读，编译成按会话选用的 preset；改完在该会话的下一句话生效。

description.en: Layered context management: at each turn end older tool output becomes a deterministic card, the model can fold older ranges into its own summaries in up to three tiers (compress), and every original is archived locally for decompress and search_context. Works alongside DSH-Mem0: superseded runtime-context snapshots (such as recalled memories) are never archived, carded or folded, and are replaced by a one-line placeholder at turn end when the prompt cache is already broken, when the saving outweighs the cache miss, or above 75% of the window; a strataBudget service (pressure, allowance, countTokens) and a strata/fold-landed event are provided for other context plugins; strata_status warns when DSH's automatic compaction is off or its official summary keeps failing. Its L1 layer, archive rotation, prune guard and preset takeover are forked from dsh-live-compact 1.0.6 (MIT); uninstall dsh-live-compact or billion-context first — they replace the same compaction rows and Strata will not take over while either is installed.
description.zh: 分层上下文管理：每轮结束时把较早的工具输出替换成确定性卡片；模型可以用 compress 把较早的范围折叠成自己写的摘要，最多三级；所有原文都存在本地，可用 decompress 和 search_context 取回。可与 DSH-Mem0 同时使用：过期的运行时上下文快照（比如召回的记忆）不存档、不切卡、不折叠；在前缀缓存已经失效、清理的收益超过缓存损失，或上下文超过窗口 75% 时，于轮末换成一行占位；为其他上下文插件提供 strataBudget 服务（pressure、allowance、countTokens）和 strata/fold-landed 事件；DSH 自动压缩没有启用、或官方摘要连续失败时，strata_status 会给出警告。其 L1 层、存档轮换、裁剪保护与预设接管分叉自 dsh-live-compact 1.0.6（MIT）；请先卸载 dsh-live-compact 或 billion-context——它们替换同一行压缩配置，装着任一者时 Strata 不会接管。

description.en: Read-only Linux port, service and Caddy route map: listening sockets with their owning unit or container, a reverse service view, and reverse_proxy liveness checks. Requires iproute2 (ss); docker and a Caddyfile are optional.
description.zh: 只读的 Linux 端口、服务与 Caddy 路由地图：监听套接字及其所属 unit 或容器、反向服务视图，以及 reverse_proxy 存活检查。需要 iproute2（ss），docker 与 Caddyfile 可选。

description.en: Device channel between the agent and your own phone: it sends files it just produced, and you @-reference what your phone sent back. End-to-end encrypted P2P through the SwarmDrop CLI, with no account and no public IP; node status, paired devices and QR pairing sit in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在 agent 和你自己的手机之间开一条设备通道：agent 把刚产出的文件发过去，手机传回来的东西可以在输入框里 @ 引用。底层经 SwarmDrop CLI 走端到端加密的 P2P，不需要账号，也不需要公网 IP；节点状态、已配对设备与扫码配对都在侧边栏面板里。

description.en: Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.
description.zh: 把各提供方线上模型列表写进 DSH 设置，输入框圆环显示当前会话模型的 5 小时/7 天窗口或按量剩余余额。

description.en: Floating GPU monitor for the DSH Web UI: a compact, draggable strip with one row per discrete GPU (exact name, utilization, VRAM, temperature, power draw) from nvidia-smi, stays visible over side panels and side cards, with a top-VRAM-process list when the driver reports it; degrades to an n/a pill on machines without an NVIDIA driver.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面内置的悬浮 GPU 监控：紧凑可拖动的条带，每张独立 GPU 一行（精确名称、利用率、显存、温度、功耗），数据来自 nvidia-smi；侧边面板或侧边卡片打开时保持在最上层；驱动支持时还列出显存占用最高的进程；无 NVIDIA 驱动的机器会退化为 n/a 胶囊。

description.en: Bilibili course notes for DSH: turns the videos and subject knowledge maps recorded by dsh-video-coursemap into same-name Markdown + Word notes with the video link on top, and delivers them in a new session through dsh-memory-evolve. Requires both plugins (with memory-evolve session orchestration turned on), Python with python-docx for the Word file (the DSH bundled runtime works), and Windows.
description.zh: B站课程知识笔记：把 dsh-video-coursemap 记录的视频与学科知识地图整理成视频链接置顶的同名 Markdown + Word 笔记，并通过 dsh-memory-evolve 在新会话交付。需先装这两个插件（并开启 memory-evolve 的「会话编排」），Word 需要带 python-docx 的 Python（DSH 捆绑运行时可用），仅 Windows。

description.en: Configurable serial agent-team workflows with a Manager, role Actors, an independent Judge, and a visual workflow editor.
description.zh: 可配置的串行 Agent 团队工作流，提供 Manager、角色 Actor、独立 Judge 和可视化工作流编辑器。

description.en: Checks npm hourly for newer versions of the installed plugins and asks which ones to upgrade.
description.zh: 每小时检查 npm 上已安装插件的新版本，并询问升级其中哪些。

description.en: Token cost monitoring, call-efficiency analysis and reversible tool-output caching for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 成本监控、调用效率分析与可逆工具输出缓存。

description.en: `describe_image` tool: a vision bridge that sends images to mimo-v2.5 through the opencode Zen API (credential `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, free route first with paid fallback) and returns text descriptions for text-only models, with native passthrough and ImageMagick transcoding of SVG/TIFF/HEIC formats.
description.zh: `describe_image` 视觉桥：经 opencode Zen API（凭据 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`，免费线路优先、付费兜底）把图片发给 mimo-v2.5、返回文字描述给纯文本模型，原生格式直发，SVG/TIFF/HEIC 等格式经 ImageMagick 自动转码。

description.en: Per-execution HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy routing for Agent fetches, LLM providers, and shell commands, with settings-backed hot reload, approval-gated controls, and credential-safe status.
description.zh: 按每次执行为 Agent fetch、LLM provider 与 shell 命令路由 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理；支持 settings 热更新、审批门禁和凭据安全状态。

description.en: Shrinks oversized bash and job_output text by piping it through the external rtk binary, keeps the original in a spill file and lets the model fetch it back on demand; keeps the original text when rtk is missing or fails.
description.zh: 把超大 bash / job_output 文本交给外部 rtk 二进制压缩，原文写入 spill 文件供模型按需取回；rtk 缺失或失败时保留原文。

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed; single-engine moli serve with auto LD_LIBRARY_PATH/FONTCONFIG_FILE injection and a persistent profile dir for logins), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 moli 无头浏览器（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron；单发动机 moli serve 直连，自动注入 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 与 FONTCONFIG_FILE，profile 目录持久化登录态）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。

description.en: Opens a native side conversation forked from the active conversation, with live parent context, Inline & Spill chain recall, relay to the main conversation, and usage stats.
description.zh: 把当前对话分叉成独立的原生侧边会话，注入父对话实时上下文，支持 Inline & Spill 链式召回、把请求或结论 relay 回主对话，并显示用量统计。

description.en: Provider-folded model selector for the DSH Web composer with catalog-driven reasoning effort choices.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入栏提供按 provider 折叠的模型选择器，并使用模型目录中的真实推理档位。

description.en: Browse and continue DeepSeek web conversations in DSH, or import them with attachments into a workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内浏览和继续 DeepSeek 网页会话，或将历史与附件导入工作区。

description.en: A handwritten-journal salary timer on the DSH composer dock: set your monthly salary and work hours, then it shows how much you have earned today and this month in real time, plus daily, hourly and per-second rates, progress toward quitting time, hours worked past quitting time, weekday attendance dots and a status badge (working, lunch, off work, unpaid overtime, day off). Settings are kept in localStorage only; no network requests.
description.zh: 挂在 DSH 输入框下方的「牛马费用计时器」手帐小卡——填好到手月薪与上下班时间，实时显示今天已挣多少、本月累计多少，附带日薪/时薪/秒薪、下班进度条、下班后的无偿加班时长、工作日打卡点阵与状态章（打工中、午休中、已下班、无偿加班、休息日）。配置只存在页面 localStorage，不发网络请求。

description.en: Real-time token estimates for the DSH conversation composer, combining the current context baseline with the draft and showing exact or heuristic counts.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话输入框实时估算 token 数，将当前上下文基线与草稿合并计算，并区分精确计数与启发式估算。

description.en: Session-level root privilege bridge for DeepSeek Harness: ask mode with per-request web approval, full root mode (polkit password entry in the web UI) and fakeroot mode, with sudo or run0 --empower escalation and a configurable subagent sudo policy. It escalates real commands with sudo or run0: in ask mode each request waits for your approval; in full root mode every bash command of the session runs elevated after one password entry in the web UI. Delegated subagents need per-request approval by default (subagentPolicy: request).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话级 root 权限桥：申请制（逐次网页审批）、完整 root（网页内 polkit 密码输入）与 fakeroot 三种模式，支持 sudo 或 run0 --empower 提权，子代理 sudo 策略可配置。它用 sudo 或 run0 提升真实命令的权限：申请制下每次请求都等你批准；完全 root 模式下，在网页里输一次密码后整个会话的每条 bash 命令都以提权方式运行。委托的子代理默认逐次审批（subagentPolicy: request）。

description.en: Verifiable issue-to-PR delivery chain: an 11-stage pipeline (analysis, search, code understanding, hypothesis, planning, implementation, patch ledger, tests, review, failure classification, PR build) with 4 human review gates, GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts credential connections, a 5-page workbench and a draggable AI assistant panel.
description.zh: Issue-to-PR 可验证交付链：11 阶段流水线（分析→检索→理解→假设→规划→实现→补丁→测试→评审→归因→PR 构建），4 道人工复核闸门，GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts 凭据连接，5 页工作台与可拖拽智能助手浮窗。

description.en: Weak-network adaptor: transparent long-backoff model-stream retries (10-min cap), local response replay cache, heartbeat auto-reconnect, and degraded-mode token economy, with a bilingual (zh/en) settings page.
description.zh: 弱网适配器：模型流式请求的长退避透明重试（上限 10 分钟）、本地响应重放缓存、心跳自动重连、降级模式 token 节流，并提供中英双语设置页。

description.en: Adds a sidebar Restart button to DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows that stops the whole application process tree and reopens the app.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版侧边栏添加「重启」按钮：结束整个应用进程树并重新打开应用。

description.en: Adds the owning workspace and current Git branch under each session row in the flat session list.
description.zh: 在单列表的每个会话行标题下方显示所属工作区与当前 Git 分支。

description.en: Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue bank, then re-injects remembered context on topic-switch detection (keyword or vector matching).
description.zh: 跨会话「触点记忆库」插件：自动从每轮对话提取任务/会话级触点与用户惯用词，存入全局持久记忆库；检测到话题切换时重新注入相关历史记忆（关键词或向量匹配）。

description.en: MiniMax voice studio for DeepSeek Harness: clone a voice from an audio sample, preview it from the audio returned by the clone request itself (no extra synthesis call, so the per-voice fee stays uncharged), synthesize text to local mp3 files, transcribe audio to text with asr-1.0, and manage the voice library, API key and these actions from a settings panel; four agent tools and a local HTTP API.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MiniMax 音色工作台：用音频样本复刻音色，复刻后用接口返回的试听音频直接试听（不额外合成，因此不触发按音色计费），把文本合成为本地 mp3，用 asr-1.0 转写音频，并在设置面板里管理音色库、API Key 与这些操作；提供 4 个 agent 工具与本地 HTTP 接口。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks for DSH: block or observe tool calls, and react to completed turns, messages, and title changes with shell commands.
description.zh: 配置驱动的 DSH 生命周期 hooks：拦截或观察工具调用，并对回合完成、用户消息和标题变化执行 shell 命令。

description.en: Shows the current workspace's Git commit graph in the DSH desktop right sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端右侧栏显示当前工作区的 Git 提交图。

description.en: Runs a parallel code review squad of read-only reviewer subagents (security, correctness, tests, style), each optionally on its own model, and aggregates one severity-grouped report from /review or a code_review tool call.
description.zh: 通过 /review 命令或 code_review 工具并行派出只读评审员子代理小队（安全、正确性、测试、风格，各自可指定不同模型），并汇总为按严重度分组的结构化评审报告。

description.en: Twenty-one fruit themes with original palettes and pixel fruit sprites for the DeepSeek Harness web client, including a settings gallery and an in-session style switcher.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端提供 21 套水果主题（原创配色与像素水果），含设置页画廊与会话内换肤入口。

description.en: Scan, view, and safely clean local AI terminal session histories (Claude Code, Codex CLI, WorkBuddy, DSH) from a settings card — quarantine-first with SHA-256 manifests, one-click restore, audit log, and phrase-confirmed hard delete.
description.zh: 会话清道夫：在 DSH 设置中扫描、查看并安全清理本机 AI 终端会话历史（Claude Code、Codex CLI、WorkBuddy、DSH），隔离优先、带 SHA-256 清单与一键整批恢复，彻底删除需输入确认短语。

description.en: ClickHouse query tools for DSH, targeting ClickHouse alone: seven tools that list databases, tables and columns, sample rows, search columns by name, show EXPLAIN plans, and run single read-only SQL statements behind a client-side guard that rejects writes, multi-statement SQL, cross-table queries and external table functions. Single-table by default: the query parameter is used as given, with no built-in multi-step business flow. Zero runtime dependencies; it tells the model to backtick non-ASCII aliases instead of failing with a bare syntax error on older servers. With no configuration it connects to http://10.0.0.34:8123 as user default (database default); set url or host/port to point it at your own server.
description.zh: DSH 的 ClickHouse 数据问答工具：七个工具负责列库表字段、抽样、按字段名反查、看 EXPLAIN 计划，以及执行带客户端只读护栏的单条 SQL（拒绝写操作、多语句、跨表查询与外部表函数）。默认单表查询：用户给什么参数就用什么参数，不内置任何多步业务流程。零运行时依赖；遇到老版本服务器会提示中文别名要加反引号，而不是只报一个语法错误。不做任何配置时，它默认连接 http://10.0.0.34:8123（用户 default、库 default）；用 url 或 host/port 指向你自己的服务器。

description.en: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Swedish) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with hand-polished translations, runtime fallbacks, and automatic translation of market and third-party text.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面新增 20 种语言（繁体中文香港/台湾、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、俄语、乌克兰语、波兰语、荷兰语、土耳其语、阿拉伯语、印地语、印尼语、越南语、泰语、瑞典语），逐条精译并带运行时兜底，另加自动翻译，把市场与第三方文本翻译成你的语言。

description.en: One-level session folders for the web sidebar - group sessions per workspace, move them by drag-and-drop or context menu, archive and restore, server-side persistence.
description.zh: 为网页侧边栏提供单层会话文件夹——按工作区分组会话，支持拖拽或右键菜单移动、归档与恢复，数据在服务端持久化。

description.en: Illustrated desk theme with an adjustable desk lamp (warm, white or rainbow light, beam size), plants, and pets, including a cat that tucks away beside the composer and a sleeping Westie on the new-session screen.
description.zh: 插画风桌面主题：可调节的台灯（暖光、白光、彩虹光，光束大小）、绿植与宠物，含可收进输入框旁的猫和新会话页上睡着的西高地。

description.en: Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.
description.zh: 用一句自然语言切换当前 DSH 会话模型，可在 Web、TUI 及 IM 桥接的微信、飞书等对话框中使用，无需操作面板。

description.en: Automatically highlights key points, definitions, warnings, and questions in completed assistant answers using one separate model call.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的助手回答完成后，额外调用一次模型，自动高亮其中的关键点、定义、警告和问题。

description.en: Automatically continues a native continuable DSH subagent once when it ends with explicit max-tokens termination, then stops.
description.zh: 当原生可续接 DSH 子代理因明确的 max-tokens 终止时自动续接一次，然后停止介入。

description.en: Project workspaces for multi-session collaboration, conversation handoffs, searchable chat records, and editable shared memory; automatic memory curation and handoff judgment require two background models (memoryModel and sessionManagerModel) configured in the plugin config.
description.zh: 为跨会话协作提供项目空间、会话接力、可查询的聊天记录与可编辑的共享记忆；自动记忆整理与接力判断需在插件配置里分别指定 memoryModel 与 sessionManagerModel 两个后台模型。

description.en: DSH-native integration layer for the Minta memory engine: composes the official dsh-mcp-client row, registers the minta-memory-governance skill plus a session-start memory prewarm, and ships a Minta agent preset; requires the separately deployed Minta engine (Python/Docker) to provide the 19 MCP tools - not usable without it.
description.zh: Minta 记忆引擎的 DSH 原生接入层:合成官方 dsh-mcp-client 行、注册 minta-memory-governance 技能与 session-start 记忆预热,并提供 Minta agent 预设;19 个 MCP 工具由需单独部署的 Minta 引擎(Python/Docker)提供,未部署引擎则无法使用。

description.en: Client-side writing panel for the Web UI: project volumes and stats, corpus library, full-text search, evolution version-chain diffs, and an SVG thread graph, shown only in writing-preset sessions.
description.zh: Web 客户端「写作」面板：项目分卷与统计、书库与全文检索、设定演化版本链 diff、线索 SVG 图谱，仅在写作预设会话显示。

description.en: Reusable subagent definitions managed from a Settings page and dispatched through a single delegate_agent tool; ships with a built-in read-only Explorer preset and a nested-delegation policy toggle.
description.zh: 用设置页维护可复用的子代理定义，通过统一的 delegate_agent 工具委派；内置只读的 Explorer 预置与嵌套委派开关。

description.en: Realtime Avatar (realtimeavatar.ai) for agents: the developer API key held by the harness credentials store, the public docs as five on-demand skills, rta_* tools over the public REST API (balance, avatars, clips, sessions, usage) with approval-gated credit spending, and a /rta command that walks a developer from no key to a live avatar call.
description.zh: Realtime Avatar（realtimeavatar.ai）实时数字人工具：开发者 API key 由 harness 凭据存储保管，公开文档打包为五个按需加载的技能，rta_* 工具封装公开 REST API（余额、数字人、动作片段、会话、用量），消耗额度的操作需审批，/rta 命令引导开发者从零到一次真实的数字人通话。

description.en: Write, illustrate and hand off WeChat and short-video content from one workbench, with per-image versions and draft push.
description.zh: 在一个工作台里写稿配图、留存每版出图，并把草稿推进公众号。

description.en: Adds a sidebar entry that opens DeepSeek web chat in an in-app window for quick questions while working. Fork of zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat (already listed); it uses its own settings namespace, so both can coexist. Needs the desktop bridge (window.dsh.desktop.openWindow).
description.zh: 在侧边栏增加网页对话入口，将 DeepSeek 网页对话打开在应用内窗口中，方便工作时临时提问。基于 zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat（已在目录内）的分支；使用独立设置命名空间，可与上游共存。需要桌面端桥（window.dsh.desktop.openWindow）。

description.en: A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent per-line ledger (drift-proof by content hash), DSH-* commit trailers, or the live session log.
description.zh: /backstory 命令与工具：为每一行标注最后改动它的 git 提交，以及写下它的 agent 轮次与提示词；数据取自按行持久化的账本（以内容哈希防漂移）、DSH-* 提交尾注或实时会话日志。

description.en: Manages the default DSH model, provider and model visibility, and optional OpenAI Responses web search.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 默认模型、Provider 与模型可见性，并支持可选的 OpenAI Responses 联网搜索。

description.en: Publish TXT, Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files as ShareOne links with passwords, watermarks, text-page updates, and TXT/Markdown/HTML comments.
description.zh: 将 TXT、Markdown、HTML、PDF、Word 和 PowerPoint 文件发布为 ShareOne 分享链接，支持访问密码、水印、文本页面更新和 TXT/Markdown/HTML 评论。

description.en: DeepSeek-Harness plugin for multi-model orchestration with recursive task decomposition, dynamic routing, quality gates, failure recovery, and KPI reporting.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Harness 多模型编排插件，支持递归任务拆解、动态路由、质量门控、失败恢复与 KPI 报表。

description.en: Smooth think-row experience for the DSH Web UI: think rows expand as a capped 24-line preview that glides to the bottom while reasoning streams, collapse with a short height animation on settle, and the main conversation view follows with a reader-safe smooth chase (no snaps, no yanks).
description.zh: DSH Web 端的丝滑思考盒体验：think 行展开为 24 行限高预览并随流式推理平滑追底，settle 时以短动画收起，主对话视图以读者友好的平滑追逐跟随（无跳变、无拉扯）。

description.en: Lists resumable Codex chats under the DSH composer, grouped by the concrete project each one belongs to, and inserts a mechanically extracted recovery context into the draft without sending it. Project ownership is resolved from the Codex project registry with path-boundary matching and labelled by how reliable it is: recorded session ownership, registered directory, unreadable metadata, or a directory registered under several projects (left unknown rather than guessed). Also reports when the stored autosave is behind the log tail, which usually means the turn ended without a stop. The chat list requires python3 >=3.8 on PATH; Windows is not supported yet, and without python3 the list stays silently empty.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方列出可接续的 Codex 聊天，按每个聊天所属的具体项目分组，把机械提取的恢复上下文插入草稿、不自动发送。项目归属取自 Codex 的项目注册表并做路径边界匹配，同时标注这个判断有多可靠：有记录的会话归属、登记目录、元数据不可读、或同一目录登记给多个项目（后者标为未知而不是猜一个）。存档落后于日志末尾时也会提示——那通常说明该轮没有正常结束。聊天列表需要 PATH 上有 python3 ≥3.8；Windows 暂未适配，缺少 python3 时列表会静默为空。

description.en: CET-6 training panel with word drills (core and syllabus lists, three modes), 25-question listening in three sections, cloze, long reading, careful reading, partial and full translation, timed writing, a vocabulary notebook and a wrong-answer notebook.
