Ships only an original sample bank (345 words, one mock paper); the full ~2,500-word core list, ~6,000-word syllabus list, papers, transcripts and audio come from your own files, built locally from a data-pack folder and never uploaded.
description.zh: 大学英语六级训练台：核心词与大纲词背记（三种模式）、听力三段 25 题、选词填空 / 长篇阅读 / 仔细阅读、片段与全篇翻译、作文计时、生词本与错题本。包内只带原创示例题库（345 词 + 1 套模拟卷）；约 2500 核心词、约 6000 大纲词、真题、听力原文与录音需自备，按分类放进本机 data-pack 目录后本地构建，不上传、不分发。

description.en: Translate installed plugins' documentation into Simplified Chinese: README sections are translated with a persistent section-level cache, and an opt-in metaSidecars mode (off by default) writes a locale/zh.json sidecar for each Plugins list row so the list can render Chinese natively.
description.zh: 把已安装插件的文档翻译成简体中文：README 按章节翻译并持久缓存；另有默认关闭的可选 metaSidecars 模式，会为每条插件列表行写入 locale/zh.json 侧文件，让列表原生渲染中文。

description.en: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.
description.zh: DSH 本機工具調用防護外掛：攔截高風險 Shell 指令模式與敏感憑證讀取，具備持久化哈希鏈 JSONL 審計記錄，可選配外部 Gateway 集中治理。

description.en: Session code collector for DeepSeek Harness: a composer-side panel gathering every code block the model produced in the current session, with by-language / by-file views, per-file version history, live search, per-entry copy, copy-all, download-all as Markdown, and click-to-jump back to the exact turn (Alt+Shift+C).
description.zh: 会话代码收集器：输入框右侧按钮一键汇总当前会话中模型产出的全部代码块，支持按语言/按文件双视图、同一文件的版本历史、实时搜索过滤、单条/全部复制、下载合并 Markdown，点击直接跳转到产出该代码的回合（Alt+Shift+C 快捷开关）。

description.en: PostgreSQL-backed durable memory for DSH agents: MCP memory tools plus a Web panel for reviewing memories and candidates.
description.zh: PostgreSQL 持久个人记忆：MCP 记忆工具 + 可查看记忆与候选的 Web 面板。

description.en: Adds a line-based copy tool for replacing or inserting file sections, with indentation control and diff previews.
description.zh: 提供按行复制工具，可替换或插入文件片段，并支持缩进控制和 diff 预览。

description.en: Piano-key in-conversation navigation for the Web UI: one key per user message with hover ladder, message-preview tooltip, and active-message highlight; click to smooth-scroll.
description.zh: 钢琴键风格会话内导航条：一根键锚定一条用户消息，悬停显示消息预览气泡与阶梯展开，点击平滑跳转。

description.en: Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.
description.zh: 工具调度崩溃后自动修复 messages 数组（孤儿 tool_calls / tool 消息），防止 400 INVALID_REQUEST 会话卡死。

description.en: CapMap docs visualization with Obsidian-style semantic graph and capability panel.
description.zh: CapMap 文档体系可视化：Obsidian 风格语义图谱与能力面板。

description.en: Reskin the whole DSH interface with colour themes, illustration wallpapers, custom cursors and a desktop pet.
description.zh: 给整个 DSH 界面换肤：配色主题、插画壁纸、自定义光标与桌面桌宠。

description.en: Deterministic engineering orchestration runtime for DeepSeek Harness: the orbit_controller tool and OrbitService run Commander, Executor and Smart Watchdog children through PLAN, EXECUTE, EVALUATE, bounded correction and runtime recovery, with durable state in <project>/.cx/state.json.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的确定性工程编排运行时：orbit_controller 工具与 OrbitService 以 Commander / Executor / Smart Watchdog 子代理执行 PLAN、EXECUTE、EVALUATE、有界修正与运行时恢复，持久状态保存在 <project>/.cx/state.json。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness agent preset where a Codex subagent analyses and decomposes the task, Claude Code subagents execute each work item, and the session only dispatches, checks and reports. Requires Codex installed and signed in locally, and Claude Code signed in locally.
description.zh: 一个 Agent 预设：先让 Codex 子代理分析任务并拆出工作项，再交给 Claude Code 子代理逐项执行，会话只负责调度、核对与汇报。需要本机已安装并登录 Codex、已登录 Claude Code。

description.en: A settings-tab workshop plus the cordis-plugin-development skill it hands to the agent, for writing DSH plugins against the running host API.
description.zh: 设置页里的插件工坊，附带交给 Agent 的 cordis-plugin-development 技能，基于当前运行的主机 API 编写 DSH 插件。

description.en: Plugin recommender for DSH: search and rank plugins from an embedded 1100+ entry marketplace catalog by need description, category and tags, with match reasons and a live catalog refresh from the awesome-dsh-plugin README.
description.zh: DSH 插件推荐器：按需求描述、分类与标签在 1100+ 条内嵌市场目录中搜索并排序插件，返回匹配理由，支持从 awesome-dsh-plugin README 在线刷新目录。

description.en: Adds the Miaoshou (Meituan CatPaw) desktop client as a DeepSeek Harness model provider. The 12 models mirror the ones the Miaoshou app picker shows, each carrying its credit-cost multiplier; thinking levels are translated into the upstream modelParams; a read-only panel reports available credits and the current plan. Sign-in is a QR link, so the desktop client does not have to be running.
description.zh: 把妙手（美团 CatPaw）桌面客户端接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型 provider：12 个模型与 App 内模型选择器逐条对齐，含每个模型的积分消耗倍率；思考等级会翻译成上游的 modelParams；另附一块只读看板，显示可用积分与当前套餐。登录走扫码链接，妙手客户端不必常驻运行。

description.en: Adds a Chat/Work switch in the DSH Desktop titlebar: Chat embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a native webview with no DSH API calls from the plugin and is the default on first launch, Work keeps the native agent UI, the page stays mounted across switches, and a confirm-first dialog can copy chat text into a work-mode draft without sending it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版标题栏加入聊天/工作切换：聊天模式用原生 webview 内嵌 DeepSeek 网页版（chat.deepseek.com），插件自身不调用 DSH API，首次启动默认进入聊天；工作模式保留原生 Agent 界面，切换时网页保持挂载；「带入工作」对话框需先确认，只会填入工作模式草稿、不自动发送。

description.en: Unified provider pools for DeepSeek Harness with session-sticky balancing, capability-aware model mapping, and automatic failover.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一模型池：会话粘性、能力感知映射与自动故障切换。

description.en: Native LLM-provider vision bridge: images pasted in the chat are described by a vision model (Qwen3-VL via pi-ai/llama.cpp) and the text description is fed to text-only DeepSeek for the reply — image admission, routing and compaction all run through harness-native mechanisms, with an LRU description cache and 503 retry.
description.zh: DeepSeek 视觉桥接：注册原生 LLM provider，聊天内粘贴的图片自动由视觉模型（pi-ai/llama.cpp 上的 Qwen3-VL）转成文字描述后交给纯文本 DeepSeek 作答——图片准入、路由与会话压缩全部走 harness 原生机制，带 LRU 描述缓存与 503 重试。

description.en: Per-session question index for the DSH Web UI: a time-proportional dot rail on the right edge and an expandable chain panel showing every user question with its time, including branch/subagent sessions; clicking a node jumps to that message and highlights it.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话提问索引：右缘时间比例圆点窄条与可展开链面板，展示每次用户提问的问题与时间，含分支/子会话；点击节点跳转并高亮对应消息。

description.en: Inline image chips for the DeepSeek Harness composer — paste an image and it lands in the text as a numbered chip (image-1.png) with hover preview. Images still ship through the official attachment pipeline, names restart per message, the dock and sent-message thumbnails carry a sequence badge, and a pre-send self-check warns when the names in the text no longer match the images in that message.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里粘贴图片，即在文字中插入 image-1.png 编号胶囊；图片仍走官方附件管线随消息发出。鼠标悬浮名字弹出缩略图预览卡，dock 与已发送气泡的缩略图带序号角标，发送前还会自检「文字里的名字」与「本条消息的图片」是否对得上。

description.en: Archived conversations list in the sidebar footer with read-only previews of the most recent messages, for sessions the product deliberately keeps hidden and unreopenable.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的已归档对话列表，可只读预览最近消息；针对产品刻意隐藏且无法重新打开的归档会话。

description.en: Highlights parts of speech (nouns green, verbs red, adjectives/adverbs purple) in rendered DSH Web Markdown, with light/dark palettes, toggles, and stream-aware updates.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 已渲染的 Markdown 中做词性高亮：名词绿、动词红、形容/副词紫，支持深/浅色板、词性开关与流式防抖。

description.en: Replaces the stock bash/pwsh terminal rows in the DSH web UI with shell command cards: long commands soft-wrap with line numbers instead of truncating, plus separate copy-command and copy-output buttons.
description.zh: 用自定义 Shell 命令卡片替换 DSH Web 原版 bash/pwsh 工具行：长命令自动换行带行号不再截断，并提供独立的复制命令/复制输出按钮。

description.en: Split view for the Web UI: tiles 1-3 columns x 1-3 rows of live sessions from several workspaces in one grid, with draggable dividers, sidebar-follow routing, an in-pane file preview and an in-pane changes review.
description.zh: Web 界面里的多工作区分屏视图：用 1–3 列 × 1–3 行的网格同时显示多个工作区的实时会话，支持拖动分栏、侧边栏会话进入格子、格内文件预览与改动评审。

description.en: Connects dsh to the BulkPublish MCP server (32 tools) to draft, schedule, publish and analyse social media posts, manage media, and handle inbox conversations and comments across 15 platforms, authenticated with a BulkPublish API key sent as a bearer token.
description.zh: 把 dsh 连接到 BulkPublish MCP 服务器（32 个工具），用于草拟、定时、发布与分析社交媒体帖子，管理媒体，并处理 15 个平台上的收件箱对话与评论；以 BulkPublish API Key 作为 Bearer token 认证。

description.en: Turn-level workspace undo for Git worktrees: every agent turn gets a private snapshot, /undo previews a red/green diff card that is confirmed in place, files changed after the turn are refused with a conflict diff unless --force or --skip-conflicts is passed, and HEAD, index, stash and commit history of the user repository are never written.
description.zh: Git worktree 的 turn 级工作区撤销：每个 turn 建私有快照，/undo 先出红绿 diff 预览卡、卡内确认；turn 之后被改过的文件拒绝用冲突 diff 覆盖，只有显式 --force 或 --skip-conflicts 才继续；不写用户仓库的 HEAD、index、stash 与提交历史。

description.en: Bridges the official IAR C-SPY MCP server into DeepSeek Harness: build .ewp projects, start simulator or hardware debug sessions, and read variables, registers, memory, the call stack and target output from the conversation. Windows only, and it needs an IAR Embedded Workbench installation. Setup needs Python 3.10+, Git and network access to GitHub and PyPI.
description.zh: 把官方 IAR C-SPY MCP Server 接入 DeepSeek Harness：在对话里编译 .ewp 工程、在模拟器或硬件上启动调试会话，并查看变量、寄存器、内存、调用栈与目标输出。仅支持 Windows，需要本机安装 IAR Embedded Workbench。安装配置需要 Python 3.10+、Git，并能访问 GitHub 与 PyPI。

description.en: Adds a Web composer switch between the native DSH agent and Grok Build, proxying Grok Build sessions and slash commands through ACP.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框中切换原生 DSH Agent 与 Grok Build，并通过 ACP 代理 Grok Build 会话及斜杠命令。

description.en: Shut down Windows automatically after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — a floating arm button plus a cancellable countdown banner (shutdown /a), zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 任务完成后自动关机：右下角按钮开启模式，任务成功完成后进入可取消的倒计时（取消走 shutdown /a），零运行时依赖。

description.en: Manage skills and MCP servers from one DSH settings panel. Skills are read from disk: browse, search, preview the body, create, rename and delete, with a backup written before every removal. Global MCP servers are the real cordis.patch.yml loader rows; per-project entries mount only for sessions in that project. Each expanded card lists the tools that server actually registered, and a per-server allow/deny rule keeps only the ones you need — a blocked tool never enters the tool registry, so it costs no context on every turn. Every MCP card carries a connection status tag (connected with a tool count, retrying, gave up, activation failed) plus a one-click reconnect, so a server that fails at startup is visible instead of silently missing its tools. Imports existing configs from 26 other MCP clients.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板里一站式管理技能与 MCP 服务器。技能以磁盘为准：浏览、搜索、预览正文、新建、重命名、删除，删除前自动写一份备份。全局 MCP 就是 cordis.patch.yml 里的真实 Loader 行，项目级条目只挂到对应项目的会话。展开卡片会列出该服务器实际注册的工具，并可只保留需要的那些——被挡下的工具不进工具注册表，因此不占用每一轮的上下文。每张卡片带连接状态标签（已连接并显示工具数 / 重试中 / 已放弃重试 / 激活失败）与一键重连，让启动时连不上、工具悄悄消失的服务器看得见。另可从 26 个 MCP 客户端导入既有配置。

description.en: Turns DSH conversations into reviewable community feedback and, after confirmation, submits it to the official DeepSeek Harness Discussions.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话整理为可审阅的社区反馈，并在确认后提交到 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Discussions。

description.en: Adds a row at the top of the sidebar that switches the whole Web GUI to another DSH host reached over a loopback port, and shows that host's session state on the row (running, unread activity, or waiting for your answer).
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部加一行，点击后整页切换成另一台 DSH 主机的 Web GUI（通过回环端口访问），并在该行显示那台主机的会话状态（运行中、有新活动、正等你回答）。

description.en: Volumes and handoffs for DeepSeek Harness: group sessions per project and hand state to a fresh session through a generated handoff document instead of replaying context.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期项目分卷：会话按项目归档，用一份约 1500 token 的交接文档把状态交给新会话，而不是重放上下文。

description.en: Draggable floating cat-or-dog companion for the dsh web GUI that changes expression with the session and is configured on a Companion settings page.
description.zh: 可拖拽的猫狗悬浮伴侣，表情随当前会话变化，在 Companion 设置页里换皮肤。

description.en: Disk review canvas: agent-written semantics, human decisions, previewed cleanup with undo.
description.zh: 磁盘审查盘面：Agent 写语义、你做决定，清理前预览、执行后可撤销。

description.en: Adds the KnyazevAI API provider and its DeepSeek, GLM, and MiniMax model catalog to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 KnyazevAI API 提供方及 DeepSeek、GLM 和 MiniMax 模型目录。

description.en: Local three-band memory for DeepSeek Harness: a 24h protection band, query recall and scene replay, injected into sessions without embedding or model calls.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的本地三段式记忆带：24 小时保护带、按话题召回、场景回放，自动注入会话，不调用 embedding 或模型。

description.en: Runs a Claude Code project's .claude/ slash commands and permissions.deny rules inside DeepSeek Harness. Command bodies expand $ARGUMENTS, positional arguments and @file references into the agent's next turn; matching tool calls are denied before they run. Every host service is probed, so a host without a command registry, working-directory service or TUI status line degrades one feature instead of failing the boot.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里运行 Claude Code 项目的 .claude/ 斜杠命令与 permissions.deny 规则。命令正文会把 $ARGUMENTS、位置参数与 @文件引用展开进模型的下一轮；命中的工具调用在执行前被拒绝。所有宿主服务都做探测：缺命令注册表、工作目录服务或 TUI 状态行时只降级一个功能，不会让宿主启动失败。

description.en: Save English learning cards while interacting with DeepSeek Harness. It adds a line to the system prompt on every step telling the model to check your English and call english_cards_capture first; cards stay on this machine unless you turn on the sync switch (off by default), which after an OAuth login in your browser sends your original and corrected sentences with their cards to aoilang.com.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness里使用英文时，自动保存英语学习卡片，利用和Agent的日常交互提高英语。它会在每一步的系统提示词里加一句，让模型先检查你的英文并调用 english_cards_capture；卡片默认只存在本机，打开同步开关（默认关闭）并在浏览器里完成 OAuth 登录后，会把你的原句、更正后的句子和卡片发到 aoilang.com。

description.en: Registers an apiCost session projection that estimates DeepSeek spend from reported token usage at published peak / off-peak rates, in CNY and USD, over self, delegation-tree or verified-team scopes: a composer-dock pill and its detail panel, the /cost command, a session_cost tool, and GET routes for the view and the current rate card. A panel switch parks model requests at the llm/stream waterfall while peak rates apply and dispatches them unchanged once the off-peak window opens, so the call is billed at the off-peak rate with no failure reported to the session.
description.zh: 注册 apiCost 会话投影，按官方公布的峰谷价目表把上报的 token 用量折算成 ¥/$ 花费，覆盖本会话、委派树与经校验的团队三种范围：输入框下方的胶囊与其详情面板、/cost 命令、session_cost 工具，以及读取视图与当前价目表的 GET 路由。面板上的开关可在高峰时段把模型请求停在 llm/stream 上，待谷时窗口开启后原样派发，于是按谷时价计费，且会话中不会出现任何失败。

description.en: Adds a ✦ button below the DSH composer — and on the new-conversation screen — that rewrites the current draft into a more complete prompt with a single call to the configured default model, keeping the original intent and language, and replaces the draft in place without sending it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方（以及新建对话窗口）加一个 ✦ 按钮，用当前配置的默认模型把草稿改写成更完整的提示词（保持原意与语言），原地替换草稿、不发送。

description.en: Adds a tier bar to the DSH composer with three thinking tiers (normal, strict, max), an exclusive loop mode whose three levels run 3, 5 or 8 self-review rounds, and a counter-review toggle that stacks on either; the model reads the current tier through the clarify_tier and forge_level tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里加一条档位条：思考三档（常规 / 严格 / 极致）、互斥的循环模式三档（3 / 5 / 8 轮）、可叠加的对抗审查开关；模型通过 clarify_tier 与 forge_level 两个工具读取当前档位。

description.en: Replaces the signed-in sidebar account name and avatar on this device only, without changing the account or uploading anything.
description.zh: 只在本机替换已登录侧栏账号行的名称和头像，不修改账号，也不上传。

description.en: Headless Claude Code consultations with advisor, reviewer, and designer roles, returned as reference answers.
description.zh: 以 advisor / reviewer / designer 角色无头调用 Claude Code，回复作为参考答案。

description.en: Per-request cost ledger covering retries and subagents, holiday-aware peak/off-peak pricing, shared pricing/usage/balance/budget services, and DeepSeek bill reconciliation.
description.zh: 按请求记录费用，涵盖重试与子代理，支持节假日峰谷计价、共享计价/用量/余额/预算服务和 DeepSeek 账单对账。

description.en: Consistency guard for long-form writing: scans conversation prose for character, timeline and numeric setting conflicts across chapters, then jumps straight to the conflicting message.
description.zh: 长文创作一致性守卫：扫描会话正文，发现人物年龄、等级、境界、年份等设定跨章节矛盾，点击直接跳转到冲突原文位置。

description.en: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sidebar view.
description.zh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

description.en: Adds a "Task Planning" agent preset that asks requirements in versioned rounds, then writes step-by-step plans and prompts without implementing them itself.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加「任务规划」模式：按版本迭代逐轮提问把需求问清楚，再产出可逐条执行的规划与提示词，自身不实现代码。

description.en: Minimal-compatible first turn for Web root sessions: starts with persistent bash and str_replace_editor, removes automatic workspace and skill context, then restores the selected preset after the first tool call or reply; includes a persistent composer toggle.
description.zh: Web 根会话的首轮精简：先使用持久 bash 与 str_replace_editor，移除自动工作区和技能上下文；首次工具调用或回复后恢复所选预设，带持久 composer 开关。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel for TeamAI skills, MCP, and prompts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏面板，用于团队技能、MCP 和提示词管理与同步。

description.en: Policy plugin that gates kubectl by kubeconfig context: hard-deny irreversible verbs outside local clusters, ask for the rest.
description.zh: 按 kubeconfig context 管控 kubectl 调用的策略插件：本地集群外硬拒绝不可逆操作，其余写操作请求人工确认。

description.en: A lightweight, general-purpose attachment Dock for DSH: paste, drop, or choose images, PDFs, documents, archives, code, and other files, review and manage them before sending, then pass them to the Agent as local paths. It gives non-image files a consistent attachment entry point.
description.zh: 一个轻量、通用的 DSH 附件 Dock：支持粘贴、拖入或选择图片、PDF、文档、压缩包、代码等文件，发送前统一查看和管理，再以本地路径交给 Agent；解决非图片文件缺少统一附件入口的问题。

description.en: Conversation rewind for DSH: rewind in place to any earlier user message with one click or the /rewind and /undo commands, without a new branch or window, and optionally restore workspace files edited by write tools. A Settings page lists recent rewinds per workspace and can undo the file changes from the latest one. Derived from SiriLee/dsh-rewind and maintained separately; do not install both (they share the /rewind and /undo commands and the rewind-snapshots directory).
description.zh: DSH 对话回退：一键就地回退到任意更早的用户消息（也可用 /rewind、/undo 命令），无需新建分支或切换窗口，并可一并还原被写类工具修改过的工作区文件；设置页按工作区列出最近的回退记录，可撤销最新一次回退的文件改动。基于 SiriLee/dsh-rewind 派生并独立维护，不能与上游同装（共用 /rewind、/undo 命令和 rewind-snapshots 备份目录）。

description.en: Workspace-scoped MCP server loading for DeepSeek Harness: servers default to dynamic mode, so they are not mounted at boot and the model loads them on demand with mcp_load (set a row to eager to keep boot-time mounting); tools can be filtered with ! globs, and a pack lets one project hide a server without affecting another. Registers the same mcp_load/mcp_unload/mcp_call tools as @guowenzhang/dsh-mcp-manager, so install only one of them.
description.zh: 按工作区控制 MCP 服务器的可见性与加载方式：行默认为 dynamic，启动时不挂载，模型按需用 mcp_load 加载（设为 eager 才保持启动即挂载）；工具可用 ! 通配规则过滤；pack 可让一个工程隐藏某台 server 而不影响别的工程。与 @guowenzhang/dsh-mcp-manager 注册同名的 mcp_load/mcp_unload/mcp_call，二者只装一个。

description.en: Per-session document ledger in the DSH sidebar (Windows only, Chinese-language UI): which documents a session read, created or modified, with time ordering, type grouping, search, two preview modes and a cross-session view.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏按会话查看文档台账（仅 Windows，界面仅中文）：用过哪些文档、创建/修改了哪些，带时间排序、类型分组、搜索与两种预览。

description.en: Lets a text-only DeepSeek agent read images in the same session by delegating to a vision-capable subagent, with send-time image-to-path conversion.
description.zh: 让纯文本 DeepSeek 代理在同一会话内读图：委派给视觉子代理，发送时自动把图片转为文件路径。

description.en: Real-time LSP diagnostics loop: lsp_diagnostics / lsp_workspace_errors / lsp_hover tools over headless stdio language servers (TypeScript/JavaScript + Python), plus an auto-injected post-edit diagnostics delta wired to the harness fs/observed event — Cursor-style edit → diagnostics → fix for dsh agents.
description.zh: 实时 LSP 诊断闭环：通过无头 stdio 语言服务器（TypeScript/JavaScript + Python）提供 lsp_diagnostics / lsp_workspace_errors / lsp_hover 工具，并订阅 harness 的 fs/observed 事件自动注入「本次编辑引入的诊断增量」——为 dsh Agent 带来 Cursor 式的编辑→诊断→修复体验。

description.en: Exposes the DSH workspace as an HTTP API: browse, search and read files, and run natural-language agent tasks that answer with cited sources.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区暴露为 HTTP API：浏览/搜索/读取文件，并支持自然语言任务（agent 查阅文档后带出处回答）。

description.en: Big Fat Fish clean — unofficial graphical panel for the local Mole CLI on macOS: live system health, cleanup previews with explicit confirmation, disk analysis, app inventory, maintenance, cleanup history, and a guided Mole CLI install.
description.zh: 大肥鱼 clean —— 非官方 Mole CLI 图形面板（macOS）：实时系统状态、清理预览与二次确认、磁盘分析、应用清单、系统维护、清理历史，并内置 Mole CLI 安装引导。

description.en: An Eisenhower-matrix to-do panel for the DSH sidebar: importance × urgency quadrants that fill the panel, inline quick-add with a hand-drawn due-date calendar, drag to reorder or move between quadrants, a draggable center handle for quadrant proportions, one-click switch to the completed view, and random encouragement toasts that tell praised on-time finishes apart from overdue ones. Minimal styling uses only DSH theme tokens; bilingual UI.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的艾森豪威尔矩阵待办面板：重要 × 紧急四象限自动撑满面板，象限内 就地新增并自带自绘截止日期日历，拖动可在象限内排序或跨象限移动，拖动中心 圆点调整四象限比例，一键切换到「已完成」，完成时按按期/逾期给出不同的随机 鼓励浮窗。极简风，只用 DSH 主题 token，界面中英双语。

description.en: Pre-execute hook that denies writes under a read-only result zone of protected roots; every other path passes through.
description.zh: pre-execute 钩子：拒绝写入受保护根下只读的成果区，其余路径放行。

description.en: Draggable splitter between the sidebar panel list and the workspace region, so the session list can grow. Double-click restores the default layout.
description.zh: 侧边栏「工作区」与导航之间的可拖动分隔条，上拖把高度让给会话列表，双击恢复默认。

description.en: Adds a manual "mark as unread" action to workspace session rows, and retires itself once the harness exposes the same capability.
description.zh: 给工作区会话行补一个手动「标记为未读」；官方支持同能力后自动退休。

description.en: Sends a macOS native notification when a root DSH session turn completes normally: the title is the session title and the body a sanitized, truncated preview of the reply. Subagents, cancellations and errors are skipped by default and no conversation text is stored.
description.zh: 主会话每轮回复正常完成后发送 macOS 系统通知：标题为会话标题，正文为脱敏截断的回复摘要。默认跳过子代理、取消与错误，不保存会话内容。

description.en: Listen to Xiaoyuzhou (小宇宙) podcasts in the DSH web UI: paste a share link to play anonymously (host proxies the audio with Range/seek), or log in via QR code to sync subscriptions, keyword-search shows/episodes, page full episode lists, and unlock purchased paywalled episodes; a `podcast_play` tool lets the agent play by link, podcast pid, or episode eid.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面收听小宇宙播客：粘贴分享链接即可免登录播放（host 代理音频流，支持 Range 拖动），扫码登录后同步账号订阅、关键词搜索节目与单集、加载完整单集分页、解锁已购付费单集；注册 `podcast_play` 工具让 agent 按链接、节目 pid 或单集 eid 直接播放。

description.en: Tri-channel task notifications: in-page toasts with chimes, browser OS banners, and host-direct OS toasts that keep working with the browser closed, plus a bell panel with persistent history.
description.zh: 三通道任务通知：页内浮层与提示音、浏览器系统横幅、宿主直发系统通知（浏览器关闭也送达），附铃铛面板与持久历史。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SiYuan (思源笔记) desktop app: registers its note tools as mcp__siyuan__<tool>, exposes the AI configured in SiYuan together with its agent loop as one more tool, ships a notes skill, and enforces a readonly/authoring/full profile on every call while keeping the tool list available when the app is closed.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到本机思源笔记桌面端：把笔记工具注册为 mcp__siyuan__<tool>，额外把思源里配置好的 AI 与其 agent 回路也做成一个工具（按档位门禁），附带笔记使用技能，并在每次调用上执行只读/创作/完整三级策略；思源关闭时工具列表依然可用。

description.en: Adds a Continue button to resume tasks interrupted by a process exit or restart.
description.zh: 为进程退出或重启导致中断的任务提供继续按钮。

description.en: Cross-agent monitoring board for local AI agent sessions (cursor-ide, claude, codex, copilot, kimi and dsh itself) with session timelines, and message injection behind a default-off two-phase confirmation gate.
description.zh: 跨 agent 看板监控本机 AI agent 会话（cursor-ide、claude、codex、copilot、kimi 及 dsh 自身），提供会话时间线，并可经默认关闭的两阶段确认门注入消息。

description.en: Records browser bugs, freezes expected results, and verifies fixes against a fresh original-code control.
description.zh: 录制浏览器问题、固定预期，并通过独立原代码对照复核修复。

description.en: Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management (CRUD/clone/attributes/revisions), full-text search, weekly-report workflow, attachments, calendar notes, backup/import, and a settings card.
description.zh: 通过 ETAPI 把 Trilium 笔记库接入 agent，提供 20 个工具：记忆读写（remember/recall + 自动注入索引）、笔记管理（CRUD/克隆/属性/修订）、全文搜索、周报工作流、附件、日历笔记、备份导入，独立设置卡片，配置 0600 落盘。

description.en: Replaces the composer's reasoning-effort dropdown with a card that shows one illustration per level (off / low / high / max); the four levels keep their original meanings, and swapping an illustration only means replacing a file in assets/.
description.zh: 把输入框的推理强度下拉换成一张卡片，每一档配一张插画（off / low / high / max）；四档取值与原来一致，换插画只需替换 assets/ 下的同名文件。

description.en: Serves the obra/superpowers skill catalog to the harness and injects its using-superpowers bootstrap as a persistent, compaction-safe system-prompt section.
description.zh: 向 dsh 提供 obra/superpowers 技能目录，并将其 using-superpowers 引导作为持久、压缩安全的系统提示区块注入。

description.en: Render GeoJSON or vector data into an interactive GeoLibre map in a sidebar tab, and let agents operate the live map through tools: layers, styles, view, feature identification, GeoLibre processing algorithms, and the Whitebox toolbox (WASM in the browser).
description.zh: 把 GeoJSON / 矢量数据渲染成侧边栏「地图」tab 里的交互地图，并让 Agent 通过工具实时操作地图：图层、样式、视图、要素识别、GeoLibre 处理算法与 Whitebox 工具箱（浏览器端 WASM 执行）。

description.en: Android Studio-style ADB logcat viewer with live filtering and level colors.
description.zh: Android Studio 风格 ADB logcat 查看器，支持实时过滤与等级配色。

description.en: Adds upload, download, new folder, delete, drag-to-move, drag-to-chat and in-place text editing with auto-save to the workspace Files tab and file previews.
description.zh: 为工作区「文件」标签页和文件预览添加上传、下载、新建文件夹、删除、拖拽移动、拖入对话，以及支持自动保存的原地文本编辑。

description.en: VS Code-style code editor: sidebar file tree over the workspace, Monaco editing, file read/write, Git status and diff, search, and Markdown preview.
description.zh: VS Code 风格代码编辑器：侧边栏文件树浏览工作区，Monaco 编辑，文件读写，Git 状态与差异，搜索与 Markdown 预览。

description.en: Gives an installed dsh web app a native-looking window caption through Window Controls Overlay - the manifest route is served with display_override, the app's own sidebar brand row and session header become the drag region, and the app's own trailing controls are inset clear of the browser's caption chrome.
description.zh: 通过 Window Controls Overlay 让已安装的 dsh Web 应用拥有原生观感的窗口标题栏——清单路由带 display_override 返回，应用自身的侧边栏品牌行与会话 header 成为拖拽区，应用自身右侧控件自动让开浏览器标题栏 chrome。

description.en: Persistent concurrent node-graph workflows for DeepSeek Harness with agent, command, HTTP, human, fan-out/join, gate, and subworkflow nodes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的持久化并发节点图工作流，支持 agent、命令、HTTP、人工、fan-out/join、gate 与子工作流节点。

description.en: When enabled, exchanges the running process's launch token for a browser-session cookie at a configurable public URI (default /trustme), so a first visit needs no ?token= in the URL.
description.zh: 开启后，在可配置的公开 URI（默认 /trustme）上把当前进程的 launch token 换成浏览器会话 cookie，首次访问无需在 URL 里带 ?token=。

description.en: Adds an input-modality selector to custom model settings in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的自定义模型设置添加输入模态选择器。

description.en: Ingestion-time tool-output curation: keeps error and warning lines plus head and tail, spills the full text to disk with a pointer the model can read back; covers every text tool, small results pass through untouched.
description.zh: 摄入时点的工具输出治理：保留 error/warning 行与头尾，全文落盘留指针供模型按需读回；覆盖所有返回文本的工具，小结果原样通过。

description.en: Exposes bounded Prometheus metrics for DSH sessions, agents, LLM calls, tools, approvals, subagents, and jobs, with a Grafana dashboard and a loopback-only endpoint by default.
description.zh: 导出有界的 DSH Session、Agent、LLM、Tool、Approval、Subagent 与 Job Prometheus 指标，附带 Grafana 仪表盘，Endpoint 默认仅监听回环地址。

description.en: Personal workbench panel with an overview dashboard, custom kanban boards, a note pad and a file library, persisted to local JSON by the host.
description.zh: 个人工作台面板：总览仪表盘、自定义看板、随手记与资料库，数据由 Host 持久化到本地 JSON。

description.en: Give agents access to files on the machine where the browser runs: user authorizes a local directory via File System Access, tool calls relay over the plugin's own WebSocket; read-only compat mode for mobile/insecure contexts.
description.zh: 让 agent 读写浏览器所在电脑上的文件：浏览器授权本地目录（File System Access），工具调用经插件自建 WebSocket 中继；移动端/非安全上下文自动降级只读兼容模式。

description.en: Database structure the agent already knows: dbgraph indexes a remote catalog into local SQLite, answering schema questions offline and fetching data in one query.
description.zh: 把数据库结构提前索引好：dbgraph 将远端库的 catalog 索引到本地 SQLite，结构问题离线回答、取数只发一次查询。

description.en: Multi-machine, multi-agent orchestration and control plane for DSH: discovers Agents and workspaces across devices, routes tasks by machine, repository, capability, and load to local or remote Agent runtimes, streams progress and results, forwards approvals, and recovers durable tasks after disconnections.
description.zh: DSH 的多机多 Agent 编排与控制平台：发现各设备上的 Agent 与工作区，按机器、仓库、能力和负载将任务路由到本地或远程 Agent Runtime，统一回传进度、审批与结果，并在断线后恢复持久任务。

description.en: Finder clipboard paste for macOS: Cmd+C files or folders in Finder, then Ctrl+V in the DSH composer inserts their absolute paths; ordinary text paste with Cmd+V is untouched.
description.zh: macOS Finder 剪贴板粘贴：在 Finder 里 Cmd+C 复制文件或文件夹，回到 DSH 按 Ctrl+V 把绝对路径插入输入框；普通文本粘贴的 Cmd+V 不受影响。

description.en: Text-to-speech service with Doubao TTS 2.0, Alibaba Bailian and OpenAI-compatible providers and a user-chosen voice; the agent speaks through tts_service_say, split into segments with an optional tone each, and other plugins can reuse ctx.ttsService.
description.zh: 多平台语音合成服务：豆包语音 2.0、阿里云百炼和 OpenAI 兼容接口，音色由用户选；助手用 tts_service_say 说话，可按语气分段、每段带一句语气描述，其他插件可复用 ctx.ttsService。

description.en: Custom text and image in the Windows desktop title bar, with multi-item rotation, per-item fonts, colors, alignment and shimmer, and a Settings page. Renders nothing outside the Windows desktop shell.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面端窗口标题栏显示自定义文字与图片，支持多条目轮播、每条独立字体/颜色/对齐/流光，并可在设置里编辑；非 Windows 桌面端不渲染。

description.en: Side-by-side native chat windows for DSH Web GUI — open several conversations beside the main chat, tile them with one click, minimize into a live status dock, or pop them out into their own browser window.
description.zh: 话分两头：把 AI 对话从「切来切去」变成「并排开火」——每个会话一枚原生小窗，贴着主对话随开随用；一键平铺所有窗口（顶对齐·同高·紧贴），最小化到带实时状态灯的底部停靠条（转圈=工作中·绿色=刚完成·黄色=待审批·灰色=空闲），真浏览器里还能把会话弹出成独立浏览器窗口。

description.en: Interior and exterior ballistics paper reproduction and code generation skill. Requires LibreOffice Kit for PDF rendering and a vision API key (e.g. Qwen-VL) for formula OCR.
description.zh: 内/外弹道学的论文复现与代码编写 skill。前置：LibreOffice Kit（PDF 渲染）+ 视觉 API key（如千问，公式 OCR）。

description.en: ChatGPT-style question nav rail with up/down arrow buttons — per-question tick marks on the chat edge, hover-triggered drawer listing every user question with real-time search filter, one-click smooth-scroll jump, and active-question highlight synced to scroll position.
description.zh: ChatGPT 风格问题导航胶囊，带 ⏫⏬ 上下箭头 — 对话区右侧逐条刻度尺，悬停展开抽屉列出全部用户问题，实时搜索过滤、一键平滑跳转、滚动同步高亮当前问题，会话切换自动重挂载。

description.en: Ships a skill about handing work to subagents instead of doing it inline - which tasks are worth fanning out, how many to run at once, how to send them in parallel, and how to check what they returned instead of trusting the summary.
description.zh: 携带一份讲「什么该交给子 agent 做、而不是自己顺手做」的技能——哪些任务值得扇出、一次派几个、并行怎么发，以及子 agent 回来后怎么核对它真的做了什么，而不是信它的总结。

description.en: Real-time quote bull/bear desk pet for DSH: a portfolio-average-driven pet that runs faster and jumps higher the closer gains reach 20%, with a watchlist panel for searching and adding stocks plus a live "race" of how each holding is moving.
description.zh: DSH 的实时行情牛熊桌宠：由自选组合平均涨跌驱动，收益越接近 20% 跑得越猛；带自选面板可搜索添加股票，还有展示每只标的涨跌的实时赛跑。

description.en: Overrides the order, names and icons of DeepSeek Harness settings navigation entries from a personal profile configuration, without patching other plugins. Shipped defaults contain no rules, so the interface is unchanged until configured. The rules are written by hand in the profile's cordis.patch.yml; needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer and Node.js 24.9+.
description.zh: 用个人配置覆盖 DeepSeek Harness 设置导航的顺序、名称与图标，不修改其他插件源码；公共默认不含任何规则，未配置时界面不变。规则需手写在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里；需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或更新版本与 Node.js 24.9+。

description.en: DSH plugin: read and write DingTalk AI Tables through the official dws CLI, adding ten DingTalk AI Table tools (nine `dingtalk_aitable_*` plus `dingtalk_sync_job`), a settings panel, and scheduled CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 插件：包装钉钉官方 dws CLI，读写钉钉 AI 表格，提供 10 个钉钉 AI 表格工具（9 个 `dingtalk_aitable_*` 加 1 个 `dingtalk_sync_job`）、设置面板与定时 CSV 导出。

description.en: Encrypted, chunked full backups of a DSH installation: config, sessions, plugins, workspaces and Hindsight memory packed into AES-256-GCM volumes that unlock by passphrase, recovery code or this machine's DPAPI slot, each package carrying a self-contained restorer, GFS rotation (last, daily, weekly, monthly, plus a total size cap and a recycle bin) and network or WebDAV targets. Zero external dependencies — node: builtins only, no 7z, openssl or rclone.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的配置、会话、插件、工作区与 Hindsight 记忆加密分卷打包：AES-256-GCM 卷可用口令、恢复码或本机 DPAPI 免密槽解开，包内自带自包含还原器；GFS 四档滚动保留（最近 / 每日 / 每周 / 每月，另有总体积上限与回收站），支持网络路径与 WebDAV 目标。零外部依赖，只用 node: 内置模块，不需要 7z、openssl 或 rclone。

description.en: Native OS notifications for approval and question/plan prompts: the toast names the workspace, click jumps to it, bilingual (zh-CN/zh-TW/en), with chime.
description.zh: 审批与选择方案的系统级桌面通知：通知显示所属工作区、点击跳转到对应工作区，多语言（简中/繁中/英文），附提示音。

description.en: Backs up DSH profiles and mints a desktop "revival coin" that restores the harness after a failed boot or install: a boot guard runs a two-phase health check (HTTP 200 plus client render), marks good boots, isolates or rolls back bad ones, and keeps 3 rotating snapshots. Cross-platform.
description.zh: 备份 DSH 环境，启动或安装失败时通过桌面"复活币"一键恢复：内置启动守卫做两阶段健康检查（HTTP 200 + 客户端渲染），标记正常启动、隔离或回滚异常启动，并轮换保留 3 份快照。跨平台。

description.en: Commitment write-gate: operator-authored rules enforced before a tool call runs — a deterministic guard tier plus an LLM-judge tier, fail-closed by default, every block written to a contradictions log.
description.zh: 承诺写入闸门：由运营者编写的规则在工具调用执行前生效——先是一层确定性守卫，再是一层 LLM 裁判，默认失败即拒绝，每一次拦截都写进矛盾日志。

description.en: Per-model wire protocol for DeepSeek Harness (desktop profile only): compiles model-level protocol intent into legal llm-pi-ai provider routes, probes Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages with a differential control probe, and lets you hide models no protocol can serve. Mutually exclusive with dsh-gearbox.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的每个模型单独选择请求协议（仅 desktop profile）：把模型级协议意图编译成合法的 llm-pi-ai 路由，用对照探针实测 Chat Completions、Responses、Anthropic Messages 三种协议，并可把任何协议都不可用的模型从选择器隐藏。与 dsh-gearbox 二选一。

description.en: Cross-session reference cards: drag a Q&A card out of any session into another one and it stays there; when you ask a question in the target session, the dragged cards' question, the answer it got at the time and its attachments are injected into the prompt as earlier conversation context, so the model can quote them directly.
description.zh: 跨会话引用卡片：把任意会话里的问答卡片拖到另一个会话并保留下来；在目标会话提问时，被拖入卡片的提问、当时的回答与附件会作为「本会话更早的对话记录」注入 Prompt，模型可直接引用。

description.en: Plugin diagnostics for the dsh web GUI: finds plugins that failed to load, bundle rows that never started and broken file links, then reports the findings. Read-only: it does not repair, journal or undo anything.
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的插件诊断：找出加载失败的插件、未启动的 bundle 行与失效的 file 链接，并报告扫描结果。只读：不修复、不写日志、不提供撤销。

description.en: Lab/project progress management for DeepSeek Harness: 16 progress_* agent tools (item CRUD, day-board pages, daily records, global search, overview, gantt, comments, import/export) plus a 「进度」sidebar tab in better-sidebar hosting the original web UI; data lives in the session project's .progress/progress.json.
description.zh: 「进度」实验/项目进度管理：16 个 progress_* agent 工具（安排增删改查、画板页、每日记录、全局搜索、概览、甘特、留言、导入导出），并在 better-sidebar 注册「进度」侧边栏 tab 托管原版界面；数据存会话项目 .progress/progress.json，随项目目录走。

description.en: Adds a reasoning-effort rail above the DSH composer: drag or use the keyboard to preview and submit the levels the current model exposes (Off through Max), while a procedurally rendered micro-universe contracts and collapses into a black hole as effort rises. Levels go through the DSH model-selection interface, so the rail shows the level DSH confirms, and the plugin writes only to $DSH_HOME/stellar-effort/.
description.zh: 在输入框上方加一条推理强度滑轨：拖动或用键盘预览并提交当前模型支持的档位（Off 到 Max），滑轨背后由程序实时渲染的微缩宇宙随档位收缩、坍缩成黑洞。档位通过 DSH 自身的模型选择接口提交，显示的是 DSH 确认后的等级；插件只写入 $DSH_HOME/stellar-effort/。

description.en: Local-first, file-backed memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Markdown memories, verified trust, per-turn recall, and optional SQLite FTS5.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的本地优先、基于文件的记忆插件：支持 Markdown 记忆存储、可验证的信任机制、逐轮次回忆，以及可选的 SQLite FTS5 全文检索。

description.en: Skill for packaging DeepSeek Harness into a Tauri 2 desktop app (macOS + Windows): dual-platform install playbook, China mirror bootstrap with a subagent timeout sentinel, admin-free Windows toolchain recipe (no VS Build Tools), and three-path acceptance checklists.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 封装成 Tauri 2 桌面应用（macOS + Windows）的技能包：双平台安装、国内镜像加速（含 subagent 超时哨兵）、无管理员 Windows 工具链方案、三路径验收清单。

description.en: Langfuse observability for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-turn trace trees aggregated by session id, with prompt versioning and evaluation.
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Langfuse 可观测性插件：会话轮次映射为 Langfuse trace 树（同会话经 session id 聚合），提供 Prompt 版本管理与评测能力。

description.en: Homework helper for the AI Passport device: turns homework screenshots into a checklist with per-task countdown timers and push-to-talk, plus a parent dashboard. It runs its own HTTP server on 0.0.0.0:8787 by default so the device on the same Wi-Fi can reach it: the parent dashboard only accepts connections from this computer, and a device needs a token issued after you approve its pairing code.
description.zh: AI Passport 作业助手：把作业截图整理成清单，设备上逐项倒计时、按住说话，并提供家长后台。默认会在 0.0.0.0:8787 上开自己的 HTTP 服务，让同一 Wi-Fi 下的设备能连：家长后台只接受本机连接，设备要在你批准配对码后拿到令牌才能访问。

description.en: Observes consecutive identical tool failures and optionally pauses before the next model step, preserving original results and successful repeats, with an in-chat report in DSH Web.
description.zh: 监视连续相同的工具失败，可在下一个模型步之前选择暂停；保留原始结果与成功的重复调用，并在 DSH Web 里出一份会话内报告。

description.en: Main-brain orchestration preset: delegation-first persona, root-session execution gate, and portable AI-LAW rule skill.
description.zh: 主脑编排 preset：委派优先的 persona、根会话执行门禁，以及可移植的 AI-LAW 规则技能。

description.en: Task-to-skill pairing meta-skill with a laziness ladder for minimal loading, a user-editable routing table, and a quarantine, SkillSpector scan, human-approval install flow.
description.zh: 任务到技能配对元技能：懒人阶梯最小化加载、可编辑路由表、隔离-SkillSpector 扫描-人工确认的安装流程。

description.en: Observational file-mutation rollback for the fs tools: write/edit pre-images are checkpointed as git blobs or snapshots and restored through a model-facing rollback_files tool or a /rollback command.
description.zh: 文件变更回滚：捕获 write/edit 工具调用的改前映像（git blob 或快照），通过面向模型的 rollback_files 工具或 /rollback 命令还原。

description.en: Control, organize, diagnose, design, personalize, and answer product knowledge questions for a Yeelight smart home, powered by the local yeelight-home runtime.
description.zh: 控制、组织、诊断、设计、个性化 Yeelight 智能家居，解答产品知识问题，由本地 yeelight-home 运行时驱动。

description.en: Reports the semantic blast radius of agent code edits: which symbols changed, who calls them, and which of those callers have no covering test.
description.zh: 报告 agent 代码修改的语义波及面：哪些符号变了、谁在调用它们、其中哪些调用方没有测试覆盖。

description.en: Local billing dashboard for DSH model calls: multi-platform provider/model breakdowns of calls, tokens and spend, peak/off-peak pricing, manual CSV price import with peak windows, official-bill reconciliation, and HTML/PDF/CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 本地计费面板：多平台、按平台/模型明细汇总调用次数、token 与花费，支持峰谷/阶梯计价、CSV 人工导入价格（含峰时窗口）、官方账单对齐，以及 HTML/PDF/CSV 导出。

description.en: Per-workspace model packs: bind a named provider, model and reasoning effort plus the four subagent tier routes to a directory. Applies to new sessions in that directory; a session that has not run a turn yet also follows a pack switch, while sessions that already ran a turn are never changed.
description.zh: 按工作区指定模型：把 provider、model、reasoningEffort 与子智能体四档路由组合成具名 pack 绑定到目录，作用于该目录新建的会话；尚未开过轮次的空白会话在切换 pack 时也会跟随，已开过轮次的会话不受影响。

description.en: Auto-supplement QMD semantic search when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory: zero-dependency DSH plugin, async injection via next-step, no manual invocation.
description.zh: 模型在知识库目录执行 grep/glob 搜索时自动补充 QMD 语义检索：零依赖 DSH 插件，异步注入下一步上下文，无需手动调用。

description.en: Host-side Typert remote for dsh-tool-writing: serves project volumes, chapter status, corpus library, full-text search, evolution entries, and thread-graph data to the client writing panel.
description.zh: 写文引擎的 host 侧数据通道：把项目分卷、章节状态、书库、全文检索、演化条目与线索图谱以 Typert remote 暴露给客户端写作面板。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that periodically detects added, modified, and deleted files in a workspace and reports the changes.
description.zh: 一个适配 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区监测插件，按周期检测并报告文件的新增、修改和删除。

description.en: Sidebar search across every past Session: literal substring matching that works for Chinese, results grouped per Session with highlighted snippets, and one click to reopen the conversation.
description.zh: 侧栏全局搜索历史对话：字面子串匹配（中文可用），结果按会话分组并高亮命中片段，点一下跳回那个会话。

description.en: Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool call and no model call on the read path; each recalled fact cites the turn it came from and carries validity dates, so superseded facts stop being retrieved.
description.zh: 基于 SodaMem 守护进程的双时间轴记忆：每轮组装提示词时注入检索结果，回合结束后自动写回，读路径不经工具调用也不额外调用模型；每条召回的事实都标注来源回合并带有效期，失效的事实不再被检索到。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to LRC's local structured memory: distills conclusions every 8 turns, drops near-duplicates by character-level Jaccard similarity (≥ 0.85), and writes them to a local LRC store. Five tools — lrc_recall, lrc_forget, lrc_remember_now, lrc_handoff and lrc_status — cover on-demand recall, retracting wrong entries, immediate writes, session handoff and a status line. On first run it downloads a per-platform LRC binary (win32-x64, darwin-arm64 or linux-x64, SHA256-verified) and starts an isolated instance, so the LRC desktop app is not required; data stays in $DSH_HOME/cache/lrc-plugin/data unless LRC_BASE points at an existing instance.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 LRC 的本地结构化记忆：每 8 轮提炼一次结论，按字符级 Jaccard 相似度（≥ 0.85）去重后写入本地 LRC 库。五个工具 lrc_recall / lrc_forget / lrc_remember_now / lrc_handoff / lrc_status 分别负责按需召回、撤回错误条目、立即写入、会话交接与状态行。首次运行会按平台下载 LRC 二进制（win32-x64、darwin-arm64、linux-x64，带 SHA256 校验）并启动隔离实例，因此无需先装 LRC 桌面端；数据默认写在 $DSH_HOME/cache/lrc-plugin/data，设置 LRC_BASE 可复用已有实例。

description.en: Use ChatGPT and Codex subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness with OAuth, quota runway forecast, safe resets, web search, image generation, and Fast mode.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接使用 ChatGPT / Codex 订阅：OAuth 免密、额度续航预测、安全重置、联网搜索、生图与高速模式。

description.en: Flip the DSH page over to a glass task board showing live jobs, subagents and session state, with an infinite canvas that unrolls a card into draggable controls, embedded web-app frames, and a conversation box that edits the canvas.
description.zh: 把 DSH 页面翻到背面变成玻璃任务台（会话 / 后台任务 / 子代理 / 工作区卡片），并提供无限画布：能把卡片拆成可拖动的控件、内嵌网页应用，还能用对话框直接改画布。

description.en: The missing backend for the dsh-artifacts sidebar tab — serves the /report artifact index and the artifact bytes it renders.
description.zh: 为 dsh-artifacts 侧边栏补上缺失的后端，提供 /report 产物索引与预览所需的文件内容。

description.en: A full-page console panel opened from the sidebar, with eight tabs: an overview; a session list read from the sessions service (title, directory, running state, updated time, with filters); installed bundles and Loader entries from pluginInventory and pluginManager, with per-bundle enable switches; a plugin market listing public topic:dsh-plugin repositories from the GitHub search API; a model and provider editor that writes the llm-pi-ai settings namespace through remote.settings.mutate (switch a session model, add or edit providers and their model lists, and store API keys via remote.credentials, merging over the stored profile so fields the form does not expose survive an edit); MCP and skills tabs; and a usage tab that reads the host's loopback /api/dsh-usage/overview document. Services are declared through ctx.inject, so a deployment that omits one mounts without the console rather than crashing.
description.zh: 从侧栏打开的整页控制台面板，含八个标签：总览；从 sessions 服务读取的会话列表（标题、目录、运行状态、更新时间，带筛选）；从 pluginInventory 与 pluginManager 读取的已装 bundle 与 Loader 条目，每个 bundle 带启用开关；列出 GitHub 搜索 API 中 topic:dsh-plugin 公开仓库的插件市场；一个模型与供应商编辑器，通过 remote.settings.mutate 写入 llm-pi-ai 配置命名空间（切换会话模型、新增或编辑供应商及其模型列表、经 remote.credentials 保存 API Key，并以合并方式写入以免表单未暴露的字段被覆盖）；MCP 与技能两个标签；以及一个读取宿主回环 /api/dsh-usage/overview 文档的用量标签。所需服务通过 ctx.inject 声明，缺少任一服务的部署只是不挂载该面板，不会崩溃。

description.en: Expose a local MCP server to remote agents through an outbound-only tunnel stack (mcp-proxy + cloudflared Quick Tunnel), then register the public URL into dsh-mcp-client streamable-http config.
description.zh: 把本机 MCP Server 通过出站-only 隧道栈（mcp-proxy + cloudflared Quick Tunnel）暴露给远程 Agent，并把公网 URL 注册进 dsh-mcp-client 的 streamable-http 配置。

description.en: A life-care layer for DSH: health log and cycle care in every session, saved coordinates so nearby-place questions do not need re-asking, Amap and Luckin MCP tools, plus a QQ companion layer that injects expression rules into replies.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一层生活关怀：每个会话都带健康日志与周期关怀，面板里存过的常用坐标省掉「你在哪」的反问，高德与瑞幸的 MCP 工具挂进所有会话；另附 QQ 伴生层，把表达规则注入回复。

description.en: Desktop half of the dsh browser extension: mounts a token-authenticated WebSocket bridge on the dsh webserver and exposes the browser_* tools that let the model read the tab you are on as text and act on it, with image recognition off until the user enables it.
description.zh: dsh 浏览器扩展的桌面端一半：在 dsh 自带的 webserver 上挂一个带令牌校验的 WebSocket 桥，向模型暴露 browser_* 工具，让它读取并操作用户当前标签页，图片识别默认关闭、需用户自行开启。

description.en: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness with curated facts, automatic turn retention, and graph- and vector-ranked recall.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供人工记忆、自动对话保留以及图谱和向量排序召回的持久记忆插件。

description.en: HarmonyOS development kit for DSH: five tools for spec search, code generation and rule checks over 366 curated entries.
description.zh: 面向鸿蒙原生开发的 DSH 插件：5 个工具，覆盖规范检索、代码生成与规则校验，内置 366 条内容。

description.en: Keeps the current chat in a movable, resizable floating window when the right file or browser panel enters full view, with a compact input bar, a whale restore button and a return to the original split layout.
description.zh: 右侧文件或浏览器面板进入完整视图时，将原会话保留为可移动、缩放的聊天小窗，支持紧凑输入条、鲸鱼球恢复入口和返回原来的分栏布局。

description.en: Shows a reminder card in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI whenever the agent is waiting for your answer, and adds a desktop notification plus a flashing tab title when you are on another tab or window.
description.zh: 当 agent 停下来等你作答时，在 DSH Web 界面右下角弹出提醒卡；若你切到了别的标签或窗口，再补一条系统通知并让标签标题闪烁。

description.en: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.
description.zh: 把最近一次已完成的 DSH 任务生成为可分享的竖屏战报视频：五幕可编辑故事板、Host 侧脱敏、可选 AI 润色与配音，导出 MP4/WebM 和 PNG 封面。

description.en: A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.
description.zh: 「设置」按钮上方的一键二维码，让手机通过带鉴权的反向代理连接 Web 界面。

description.en: Adds custom task groups and an activity bell to the sidebar: drag sessions into or out of a group, reorder them by hand, collapse groups, and see running, waiting and unread sessions in one place.
description.zh: 给侧边栏加上自定义任务分组和活动铃铛：把会话拖进拖出分组、手动排序、折叠分组，并在一处集中查看运行中、待确认和未读的会话。

description.en: DSH Desktop enhancement: one-click update checker, DeepSeek balance & API key viewer, and import other AI tools.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 桌面增强：一键检查更新、DeepSeek 余额与 API Key、导入其他 AI 工具。

description.en: Compare two or three answers in one session and drop chosen turns from every later model request.
description.zh: 在同一会话里对比两三次回答，并从之后每次模型请求中剔除指定的轮次。

description.en: Floats conversations that are currently running to the top of their workspace session list, and keeps them there after they finish.
description.zh: 把正在运行的对话浮到所在工作区会话列表的最上方，运行结束后仍保留在该位置。

description.en: DSH model provider for the locally authenticated AGY CLI: Gemini/Claude model discovery, independent reasoning effort, DSH-owned tools, bounded context and tool-result handling, and Windows-safe streaming. Report problems in GitHub Issues: https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider/issues.
description.zh: 将本机已登录的 AGY CLI 接入 DSH 作为模型 Provider：支持 Gemini/Claude 模型发现、独立推理强度、DSH-owned 工具、受限上下文与工具结果管理、Windows 安全流式传输；如遇问题，请在 GitHub 提交 Issue：https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider/issues。

description.en: Adds a Trade Desk panel to the DSH sidebar for foreign-trade documents and container loading: quotation, PI/CI/PL/contract/customs documents, carton loading plans and a step-by-step loading animation. The existing offline single-file workbench is served same-origin inside the panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏增加外贸工作台入口，用于外贸单证与装柜计算：报价单、PI/CI/PL/合同/报关资料、装柜方案与逐层装柜动画。现有离线单文件工作台通过同源页面嵌入面板。

description.en: A simple DSH queue panel for editing, removing, steering, reordering, and bulk removal.
description.zh: DSH 排队消息增强面板，支持编辑、删除、插话、排序和批量删除。

description.en: Manage the dsh service via `dsh --profile ctl`: systemd lifecycle (install, start, stop, restart, enable, disable, uninstall), persisted config, health probe and logs, plus shell completions and self-update.
description.zh: 通过 `dsh --profile ctl` 管理 DSH 服务：systemd 生命周期（安装、启停、重启、自启、卸载）、持久化配置、健康探测与日志，附带 shell 补全与自更新。

description.en: Show workflow stages and subagents on a timeline, configure model and concurrency for each stage, and reopen subagent conversations from the panel. Run names and stage settings persist under ~/.dsh.
description.zh: 在时间线中查看工作流阶段和子代理，为每个阶段配置模型与并发，并从面板打开子代理对话。运行名称与阶段设置保存在 ~/.dsh。

description.en: Composer code-quote collapse for the DSH Web UI: pasting a `path:line` header followed by code folds the input into one compact inline quote chip, and at send time the `agent/pre-step` hook injects the full pasted snapshot to the model as a separate context message. 0.5.x also folds sidebar file-selections that insert only a `path:lines` line (large selections), fetching the code from disk by session cwd, and preempts Ctrl+V paste interception.
description.zh: 输入框代码引用折叠：粘贴「路径:行号 + 代码」时自动折叠为「文件图标+文件名:行号」引用芯片（Ctrl+Z 可还原），发送时由 agent/pre-step 钩子将完整代码快照作为独立上下文消息注入给模型。0.5 起支持侧边栏「添加到对话框」大段选区（仅插路径行时按会话工作目录读磁盘取代码），并在捕获阶段抢权接管 Ctrl+V 粘贴。

description.en: Adds a Long text button to the composer tool row: write or paste the body in an editor overlay, and on save it is written to <workspace>/.dsh-longtext/<timestamp>_<title>.md and an @ path reference to that file is appended to the composer, leaving the conversation free of the long text itself.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏新增「长文本」按钮：在编辑器浮层里写或粘贴正文，保存后写入 <工作区>/.dsh-longtext/<时间戳>_<标题>.md，并把该文件的 @ 路径引用追加到输入框，让正文不进入对话。

description.en: Vertical message pointer rail on the left edge of the chat: one dash per user message, click to scroll to that message, hover for a preview bubble.
description.zh: 聊天区左侧的消息指针导轨：每条用户消息一个横条，点击滚动定位，悬停显示预览气泡。

description.en: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.
description.zh: 无痕会话：独立临时子 Agent（独立 preset 不继承父会话、全量工具集），浮窗可拖动，关闭即焚毁、磁盘零痕迹。

description.en: Metaso (秘塔AI搜索) search & reader providers for the web seam: web_search returns page summaries, web_fetch reads full-page markdown, multi-scope search (webpage/document/paper/image/video/podcast).
description.zh: 秘塔AI搜索 providers for ctx.web：web_search 返回网页摘要，web_fetch 读取网页全文 markdown，多范围搜索（网页/文库/论文/图片/视频/播客）。

description.en: Puts your own animated vector logo over the DSH brand mark in the sidebar and beside the start-page headline, taking over the three single slots sidebar.brand.mark, sidebar.brand.name and conversation.hero.brand.mark. The bundled patch only inserts the plugin into the loader — the official brand plugin (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official) holds those slots too, so you must disable it in the profile's cordis.patch.yml and restart. Ships a swimming whale that follows light and dark themes through currentColor and is tuned to stay legible at the sidebar's 24 px.
description.zh: 把自己做的矢量 Logo 换到 DSH 侧栏与首屏标题旁，接管 sidebar.brand.mark / sidebar.brand.name / conversation.hero.brand.mark 这三个 single 槽位。包里自带的补丁只把自己插进 loader——这三个槽位同时被官方品牌插件 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official 占着，所以要先在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里把它 disabled，再重启 DSH。默认那只鲸鱼会游动，用 currentColor 跟随明暗主题，动效按侧栏 24px 的可读性调过。

description.en: Zero-config per-turn git checkpoints: after every completed agent turn in a git workspace, stages all changes into one tagged \[turnsnap] commit (serialized queue, sandbox-policy aware), so any turn is a rollback point.
description.zh: 零配置的逐轮 git 检查点：在 git 工作区的每个 agent 轮结束后，把全部变更暂存为一条带 \[turnsnap] 标记的提交（串行队列、感知沙箱策略），每一轮都是回滚点。

description.en: Local toolbox for the DSH web GUI: 35 pure-client tools (text, encoding, hashing, extraction, conversion, reference tables) in a sidebar view, plus the /toolbox command and config-driven agent tool exposure.
description.zh: DSH 本地工具箱：侧边栏独立页面内置 35 个纯本地小工具（文本、编码、哈希、提取、转换、速查表），另有 /toolbox 命令与配置驱动的 agent 工具注册。

description.en: Adds subagent_route and subagent_fork_route delegation tools where the model itself picks the provider/model route for each child; the deployment only sets the spawn/fork backend, background policy and allowedProviders allowlist, while continuable children and background jobs reuse the official send_message / job_output tools.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_route 与 subagent_fork_route 委托工具：由模型自主为子代理挑选 provider/model 路由，部署方仅配置 spawn/fork 后端、调度策略与 allowedProviders 白名单；续聊子代理与后台任务复用官方 send_message / job_output 工具。

description.en: dshBrutalDelete permanently deletes DSH sessions from disk — single-row or cross-workspace bulk delete, with Ctrl+A select-all and Delete shortcut, wiping transcripts, projection cache, workspace slots, attachments and subagent data. Irreversible.
description.zh: dsh暴力删除：永久删除 DSH 会话的磁盘数据——单条删除或跨工作区批量删除，支持 Ctrl+A 全选与 Delete 快捷删除，彻底清理对话记录、投影缓存、工作区归属、附件与子会话，不可恢复。

description.en: Auto-renames DSH sessions with LLM-summarized titles: runs after the first prompt and on /handoff, or manually via a header button or /autotitle, with configurable title language and max title bytes.
description.zh: DSH 会话自动重命名（session rename）：基于全部会话消息的 LLM 总结标题，首条提示词与 /handoff 后自动命名，会话头按钮或 /autotitle 手动触发，标题语言与最大字节数可设置。

description.en: Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.
description.zh: 会话左侧的短横线时间轴：整个会话的用户消息一览、当前消息定位、悬停预览消息与回复、点击跳转，可收起展开。

description.en: Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight `coyote_*` tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, disconnect fail-safe); optional auto-stim layer maps agent events (tool calls, errors, turn end) to bounded pulses; official V3 socket protocol with QR pairing, programmable waveforms. Adults only.
description.zh: Agent 与网页 GUI 双面控制的 DG-LAB 郊狼（Coyote）电击/电刺激插件：八个 `coyote_*` 工具 + DSH 网页面板，共用同一安全边界（软上限、非对称升速限流、会话冷却、播放硬上限、断连即停）；v0.2 起可选自动电击层，把 agent 事件（工具调用/报错/回合结束）映射为有界脉冲；官方 V3 socket 协议 + 二维码配对、可编程波形。仅限成年人。

description.en: Normalize the DSH settings UI onto one design language: unified typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages contributed by other plugins.
description.zh: 将 DSH 设置界面归一为同一套设计语言：统一各设置页的排版、卡片、控件、焦点与动效，包括其他插件贡献的页面。

description.en: Per-turn cost in CNY, with 本轮 / 今日 / 会话 totals shown above the composer. Tokens are priced by model and by the moment they were spent (peak hours and holidays); native DeepSeek search spend can be folded in when the optional audit plugin is installed.
description.zh: 按轮显示本轮花费（人民币），输入框上方常驻「本轮 / 今日 / 会话」合计；按模型与花费时刻计价（含峰谷与节假日），装了可选的搜索审计插件后可并入原生 DeepSeek 搜索费用。

description.en: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).
description.zh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

description.en: Adds file and folder drag-and-drop attachments to the Web UI, with composer cards, persistent history, and workspace-backed paths.
description.zh: 为 Web UI 添加文件与文件夹拖放附件，提供输入栏卡片、持久化历史记录与工作区路径。

description.en: Reorder the messages queued while a DSH agent is busy, from inside the official queue dock: a drag handle and per-row ↑ / ↓ buttons on the dock's own rows, applied on the host as one concurrency-checked inbox splice. The dock is decorated rather than replaced, so previews, inline editing, steering, removal and attachments stay as shipped. A move is refused when the queue has changed since the caller last saw it, when the row is not a user prompt (a goal round prompt, for example), or when the queue belongs to a subagent session.
description.zh: 在官方队列 dock 内直接重排忙碌时排队的消息：每一行带拖拽手柄与上下移动按钮，移动在宿主端以一次带并发校验的 inbox splice 完成。只装饰官方 dock 而不替换它，因此预览、行内编辑、插话、删除与附件保持原样。队列已变化、该行不是用户消息（例如目标轮次提示）、或队列属于子代理会话时，移动会被拒绝。

description.en: Previews what DSH does not cover, including video and audio, 3D models, archives, SQLite and model weights, and searches large CSV, log and JSONL files.
description.zh: 预览 DSH 未覆盖的格式，包括音视频、3D 模型、压缩包、SQLite 与模型权重，并可在超大 CSV、日志与 JSONL 中搜索。

description.en: Codex-style /side side conversations for DeepSeek Harness: a temporary fork of the current chat in a floating panel, inheriting context without interrupting the main task.
description.zh: Codex 风格 /side 侧边对话插件：在当前对话旁开一个浮动分叉面板，继承上下文、不打断主任务。

description.en: Live Android device pane next to your DSH conversation: scrcpy H.264 streaming, agent taps verified by screenshots and a UI tree, and screenshots / recordings / debug evidence saved into one host directory. Debug sessions keep segmented video, full logcat and per-action frames. Emulators and USB phones, human+agent co-operation, loopback-only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话旁打开 Android 设备实时画面：scrcpy H.264 串流，agent 可点按操作并用截图与控件树自证，截图 / 录屏 / 调试证据统一存进你指定的电脑目录；调试会话自带分段视频、全量 logcat 与逐动作前后帧。模拟器与 USB 真机通吃，人机共屏，仅限本机回环。

description.en: Second-model gate on the assistant turn, installed with one command: the bundle installs the settings panel and mounts the engine out of the same package, so both halves come up together. A separate judge call scores the draft against the numbered criteria (0-10 each); any criterion under 6 fails the turn and sends it back for a rewrite, up to 3 rounds by default. Ships in dry-run mode, which only records verdicts to an audit log until you switch it off. The web panel edits the criteria, the thresholds and the judge prompt.
description.zh: 动手回合前先过第二个模型的质检，一条命令装完：bundle 同时装上设置面板和同一个包里的引擎，两半一起起来。一次独立判官调用按编号判据逐条打 0-10 分，任一条低于 6 分即判不合格并打回重写，默认最多回炉 3 轮。出厂是演习模式，只把判定写进审计日志、不打回，看过日志再在面板里关掉。Web 面板编辑判据、阈值与判官提示词。

description.en: Narrow 40px icon rail for the DSH sidebar: panel icons move into a single column so the session list gets the full width, session titles gain a three-level hierarchy, and the DeepSeek account balance sits just above the sidebar footer with today and cumulative spend accounted from balance deltas, plus value-based colours. Follows the DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 sidebar structure (the two-column grid now lives on the nested scrollArea), so icons and the workspace list stay side by side.
description.zh: 把面板图标收进 40px 窄栏、把宽度还给会话列表，会话标题分三级明暗；侧栏底部栏上方常显 DeepSeek 余额，并按余额差值记录今日与累计消费（按数值变色）。已适配 DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 的侧栏结构（两列网格挂在 scrollArea 上），图标列与工作区保持并排。

description.en: Session-header button that previews and downloads the exact request frame DeepSeek Harness sends to the model: the full system prompt, the declared tools array, and the wire message array (system/user/assistant/tool-result) rebuilt from the session log via the same folds the agent loop reads.
description.zh: 会话头部按钮：预览并下载 DeepSeek Harness 真正发给模型的请求帧——完整 system prompt、声明的工具数组 tools 与 wire 消息数组（system/user/assistant/tool-result），按 agent loop 读取所用的同一会话折叠重建。

description.en: Plugin value auditor: pre-install review (source scan + LLM judge) and post-install audit of installed bundles, with model-switch re-audit reminders.
description.zh: 插件价值裁判：装前审核（源码静态扫描 + LLM 裁判）与装后审计已装插件，模型切换时弹窗提醒复核；判断插件对当前模型是增强还是压制。

description.en: Agent config packer for DeepSeek Harness: pack local agent assets (skills/sessions/profiles/settings/memory) into a zip for migration or sharing, with privacy scanning, diff-based restore, pack management, and a settings UI; memory ships as a read-only Markdown mirror, not the live database.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Agent 配置打包器：把本地 Agent 资产（Skills/会话/Profile/全局设置/记忆）打包成 zip，用于迁移或分享；带隐私安全扫描、差异恢复、包管理与设置 UI；记忆以只读 Markdown 镜像入包，不含运行时数据库。

description.en: China hard-tech supply chain intelligence: 33-signal board, H1 earnings tracker, hit-rate track record and Q&A, via a remote MCP (mcp__cn_intel__*).
description.zh: 中国硬科技供应链情报：33 条信号看板、中报验证追踪、命中率记录与问答，通过远程 MCP 接入（mcp__cn_intel__*）。

description.en: System monitor for kids: a single card summary of CPU, memory and disk.
description.zh: 系统小监控：一张卡片看 CPU、内存、磁盘概况。

description.en: Imports sessions from pi, opencode, codex, claude-code and WorkBuddy into DSH, unifies AGENTS.md, skills, project and per-agent memory across harnesses with symlinks instead of copies, and migrates Codex and WorkBuddy automations into DSH scheduled tasks.
description.zh: 把 pi、opencode、codex、claude-code 与 WorkBuddy 的会话导入 DSH，用符号链接在各 Harness 间共享同一份 AGENTS.md、技能、项目与 Agent 记忆，并把 Codex / WorkBuddy 自动化迁移为 DSH 定时任务。

description.en: Behavior-drift reports for DSH sessions: compares two session logs and reports tool-sequence alignment, tool mix, reasoning volume, timing, retries and file targets, with an optional CI threshold gate. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 会话的行为漂移报告：对比两份 session log，输出工具序列对齐、工具构成、推理量、耗时、重试与文件目标的差异，并支持可选的 CI 阈值门禁。零依赖。

description.en: Delete a complete closed turn (question + answer + tool calls) from a DeepSeek Harness session, without deleting the session.
description.zh: 删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话中的一整轮对话（提问 + 回答 + 工具调用），不影响会话本身。

description.en: Distills daily AI conversations (Doubao, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Kimi) into structured Markdown notes in your Obsidian vault.
description.zh: 把每天和各种 AI 的对话提炼成结构化 Markdown 笔记，写入你的 Obsidian 库。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Postel over MCP: search a library of X posts that went viral by topic, write posts and X threads in the user's saved voice, and save, schedule or publish them to X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and Mastodon; adds a postel-writing skill. Research works without an API key.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 把 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Postel：按主题搜索走红的 X 帖子库，以用户保存的文风撰写帖子和 X 长串，并保存、定时或发布到 X、LinkedIn、Bluesky 和 Mastodon；附带 postel-writing 技能。调研功能无需 API Key。

description.en: Reports DeepSeek Harness session activity to a self-hosted cc-monitor server, which surfaces Claude Code and DSH sessions as color-coded state cards in one web dashboard and pings your browser and Android app when a session needs attention.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话活动上报到自托管的 cc-monitor 服务器：Claude Code 与 DSH 会话以彩色状态卡片出现在同一个 Web 仪表盘中，会话需要关注时通过浏览器与 Android 应用通知你。

description.en: Adds a "History" conversation view tab listing the session's user messages as a clickable directory, with auto-paging and click-to-jump back into the chat.
description.zh: 在会话头部新增「目录」tab：把当前会话的用户消息整理成可点击的目录，自动翻页加载全部历史，点击即跳回对话并定位。

description.en: Client-only right-edge chat input index rail: one bar per user message, two-stage hover preview (15 chars, expandable to 40), click-to-jump, and scroll-follow highlight; static npm bundle with no host half.
description.zh: 纯客户端对话输入目录条：每条用户消息一根横条，两级悬停预览（15 字，移入气泡展开 40 字）、点击跳转、滚动跟随高亮；静态 npm 包，无宿主半。

description.en: Tool-surface governance for DeepSeek Harness: six scope-separated deny lists cut each agent's tool visibility through the host tools.restrict() API, unseen tool names wait in a pending gate, and dispatch_composed assembles a minimal surface from capability tags — a tasks array runs subagents in parallel, and a continued subagent keeps its original surface. Every decision goes to an append-only ledger that rotates into dated archives without ever losing history.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的工具面治理：六张作用域分开的名单经宿主 tools.restrict() API 逐 agent 裁剪工具可见性，新见工具名进待裁决闸门，dispatch_composed 按能力标签组装最小面——传 tasks 数组可并行跑子代理，续派的子代理保持原有工具面。每次决策写入 append-only 台账，超限轮转为带日期的归档档，历史一条不丢。

description.en: Disk, CPU/memory/GPU, listening-port and token-usage cards with a full-page zoom; runs as a workbench module or standalone. The port card works on Windows only and the GPU card needs nvidia-smi.
description.zh: 磁盘、CPU/内存/GPU、监听端口与会话用量四张卡片，可放大到整页；既可作工作台模块，也能独立运行。端口卡片仅支持 Windows，GPU 卡片需要 nvidia-smi。

description.en: Ambient fullscreen status grid for DeepSeek Harness sessions with token/rate graphs, plus ntfy push and alarm notifications when a turn ends, errors, or waits for approval.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏状态看板：会话状态网格与 token/速率图表一览无余，回合结束、出错或等待审批时通过 ntfy 推送与铃声提醒。

description.en: Adds a Run button to shell code blocks in replies, executing the snippet through the host shell service and showing its output in a floating bottom-right dock, or in one bottom-panel tab per run.
description.zh: 为回答里的命令行代码框加「运行」按钮，通过宿主 shell 服务执行该命令，输出显示在右下角浮动面板，或每个运行一个底部面板标签页。

description.en: Explains computer memory as a workbench: current usage, memory pressure and top programs.
description.zh: 把内存讲成工作台：当前占用、内存压力、最占内存的程序。

description.en: Collapsible right-docked web terminal (xterm.js) bridged to a host PTY over WebSocket: bash/zsh switching, resizable panel, and fold/unfold that keeps the session alive.
description.zh: 右侧停靠的可折叠 Web 终端（xterm.js），经 WebSocket 桥接宿主 PTY：支持 bash/zsh 切换、拖拽调宽，折叠时保留会话。

description.en: Reads IDEA run configurations and launches Java, Spring Boot and Vue projects inside DeepSeek Harness, with colored logs and a fast java -cp startup path.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里读取 IDEA 运行配置，启动 Java / Spring Boot / Vue 项目并查看彩色日志，支持快速启动（java -cp 直启）。

description.en: Compaction fix for NInfer-hosted qwen3.8-27b gateways: disables thinking on dsh context-compaction and session-title calls so xhigh reasoning stops burning the whole output budget; the same idea applies to other launch methods, this package targets NInfer only.
description.zh: 针对 NInfer 托管的 qwen3.8-27b 网关的压缩修复：在 dsh 上下文压缩与会话标题调用中关闭思考，避免 xhigh 推理耗尽全部输出预算；同一思路适用于其他启动方式，本包仅面向 NInfer。

description.en: Diagnoses third-party LLM API endpoints from the sidebar: a four-layer check (DNS/TCP/TLS, key and model, a real streaming conversation, then timed repeat runs) reporting time-to-first-token, output speed and success rate, with every failure attributed to the step it stalled at and the byte count that actually left the machine. 37 provider presets, no model names hardcoded.
description.zh: 侧边栏体检第三方 LLM 接口：四层检查（DNS/TCP/TLS、Key 与模型、真实流式对话、连测多轮），报出首字延迟、输出速度与成功率；失败时标明卡在第几步、实际写出多少字节。内置 37 个服务商预设，不硬编码任何模型名。

description.en: Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness session per email thread, with an approval gate and recipient allowlist on everything outbound.
description.zh: 用 AgentMail 给 agent 配一个自己的收件箱：发信、读信、搜索与打标签共十一个工具；收到的邮件按邮件线程分派，每个线程对应一个独立会话；所有外发邮件都要过审批与收件人白名单。

description.en: Rotates images and videos from a media folder as the DSH UI background, with panel controls for the rotation interval and UI opacity.
description.zh: 把媒体目录中的图片与视频自动轮换为 DSH 界面背景，面板可调轮播间隔与界面透明度。

description.en: GitHub Trending radar inside the Harness Web UI: fetches the daily, weekly or monthly board (optionally filtered by a language), analyzes each repository into description, star gain, tech stack, highlights and risks, renders the result as a filterable card panel with paging, and registers the github_trending tool plus the /github-trending command.
description.zh: Harness Web UI 里的 GitHub 趋势雷达：抓取日榜/周榜/月榜（可按编程语言筛选），把每个仓库分析成简介、star 增量、技术栈、亮点与风险，渲染为可筛选、可分页的卡片面板，并注册 github_trending 工具与 /github-trending 命令。

description.en: A floating quick-ask panel that answers without touching the conversation: a 10-turn scratch window, question-and-answer favourites that do not take up a turn, the conclusion dropped into the composer on request, and an empty window on every restart.
description.zh: 快问小面板：不碰主对话，固定 10 轮便签窗口；问答成对收藏且不占轮次，结论可一键放进输入框，每次重启都是空的。

description.en: Predicts the next message you would send once an assistant turn finishes and shows it as a one-line suggestion above the composer; Tab or a click fills the draft without sending. The prediction follows the session model unless a provider and model are pinned, and the Settings page has an on/off switch.
description.zh: 助手回复结束后预测你下一句会发的消息，以一行建议显示在输入框上方；按 Tab 或点击填入草稿，不会自动发送。预测默认跟随当前会话的模型，也可以在配置里另选模型服务商与模型；设置页有总开关。

description.en: Sends deferred MCP tool definitions as an index of names, parameter signatures and one-line summaries grouped by server, with tool_details returning a full schema on request and call_tool running the real tool. Reading a schema or running a tool does not change the model-visible tool list, so the prompt cache is not invalidated.
description.zh: 把延迟加载的 MCP 工具定义以索引形式发送——按服务器分组的名称、参数签名和一行摘要；tool_details 按需返回完整 schema，call_tool 运行真正的工具。读取 schema 或运行工具不会改变模型可见的工具列表，因此不会使提示缓存失效。

description.en: One-person-company operations SOP for DeepSeek Harness: 8-field company profile, a daily cycle from morning brief through two execution shifts to an evening report, ledger and cash-snapshot conventions, quote/contract shapes, and six red lines with a human-approval outbox.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的一人公司运营 SOP：8 字段建公司档案，晨报→两档执行→晚报的日循环，台账与现金流快照口径，报价/合同/日报形状，以及六条红线与待发池人审。

description.en: Real-time speech-to-text inside the DeepSeek Harness composer: a live transcript while you speak, inserted at the caret when you stop, with a microphone picker. Local sherpa-onnx inference, so audio never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里做实时语音转文字：边说话边显示识别结果，说完点完成自动插入光标处，可切换麦克风，本地 sherpa-onnx 推理、音频不出本机。

description.en: Seaglass is a highly customizable glassmorphism theme.
description.zh: Seaglass是一个高自由度的玻璃质感主题。

description.en: Offline, deterministic public API catalog search for DeepSeek Harness, with Chinese and English queries plus exact filters for authentication, HTTPS, CORS, status, source tier, and category.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的离线确定性公共 API 目录检索，支持中英文查询，以及认证、HTTPS、CORS、状态、来源层级与分类的精确筛选。

description.en: Code RAG semantic index panel and settings card: live index bar with start/rebuild/cancel, plus one-click detection and configuration.
description.zh: Code RAG 语义索引面板与设置卡片：输入框上方的实时索引条（开始/全量重建/取消），以及一键检测与配置（Qdrant/Ollama/预设/ignore）。

description.en: Long-term memory backed by a local SQLite store: project-scoped memory auto-injection with junk filtering, rule-based or model-assisted memory extraction from recent turns, write-side dedup and feedback-weighted ranking. The Python bridge runs on $NEXUS_PYTHON or the DSH-bundled interpreter at <DSH home>/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/ (Python 3.8+).
description.zh: 基于本地 SQLite 的长期记忆：新会话自动注入项目相关记忆（噪声过滤），支持轻量规则或模型辅助提取，写入去重与反馈加权排序。Python 桥默认使用 $NEXUS_PYTHON 或 <DSH home>/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/ 下的解释器（需 3.8+）。

description.en: A Shenshen desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: transparent task-aware animations (idle, working, thinking, celebrate, failed), click-to-wave and drag-to-run interactions, plus the upstream API balance, local usage accounting, roles, bubbles and sound settings. A character branch of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (dsh-whale-widget 0.4.2); do not install it alongside the upstream, or two pets and duplicate requests appear.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠「深深」：跟随任务状态切换待机/敲键盘/思考/庆祝/失败，支持点击挥手、拖动左右奔跑，并保留 API 余额、本机用量记账、角色、气泡与音效设置。二创自 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget（dsh-whale-widget 0.4.2）；请勿与上游同时安装，否则会出现双角色与重复请求。

description.en: Multi-agent roundtable discussion: each member runs as a subagent on its own model and speaks in turn, a host summarizes each round, and termination writes meeting-minutes Markdown.
description.zh: 多智能体圆桌讨论：每个成员作为子代理在自己的模型上依次发言，主持人逐轮汇总，终止时生成会议纪要 Markdown。

description.en: Serves the OwlCoda RunKit skill in the DSH skill catalog: project-owned objectives, work items, candidate identity, verification receipts, handoffs and recovery stay in project artifacts. Installs instructions only; the project-local owlrunkit CLI is a separate setup step.
description.zh: 把 OwlCoda RunKit 技能加入 DSH 技能目录：目标、WorkItem、候选身份、验证回执、交接和恢复保存在项目工件中。只安装指令；项目本地的 owlrunkit CLI 仍需单独安装。

description.en: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.
description.zh: 打开页面时左侧边栏直接显示每个会话的主题，无需点进会话。启动时预热会话投影缓存，让冷会话也能显示真实标题。

description.en: Current-session message outline rail for the DSH web UI — your messages show as slim bars on the left edge; hover to expand the full outline (line number + text), click to jump instantly to that message. Pure frontend, zero external service dependencies, sessions-snapshot driven with zero polling.
description.zh: 当前会话消息大纲（左缘横杠）——你的消息在对话区左缘显示一列细横杠，hover 展开完整大纲（行号+文本），点击瞬间定位到对话里那条消息。纯前端、零外部服务依赖、sessions 快照驱动零轮询。

description.en: Arrow-key input history for DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1: press ↑ in an empty composer to recall this session's prompts, ↓ to go forward, Esc to restore the draft.
description.zh: DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1 输入框历史：空输入框按 ↑ 召回当前会话刚发过的话，↓ 前进，Esc 还原正在打的草稿。

description.en: Scans MCP servers configured in Claude Code, Codex and CodeBuddy and probes real connectivity via stdio and streamable-http initialize handshakes, with enable/disable toggles and a /mcp control panel.
description.zh: 扫描 Claude Code / Codex / CodeBuddy 配置中的 MCP，通过 stdio 与 streamable-http initialize 握手检测真实连通性，支持启停开关与 /mcp 控制面板。

description.en: On Windows, the available bash tool is limited to Git Bash and PowerShell is disabled.
description.zh: 让 Windows 上可用的 bash 工具限制为 Git Bash,并禁用 PowerShell。

description.en: Shows the running agent step above the web composer as a Chinese sentence: its step number, the tools it is running, and how long it has been going. A finished step keeps its duration on screen until the next one starts, so a slow step can be identified after the fact.
description.zh: 在网页版输入框上方用一句中文显示当前正在执行的智能体步骤：步号、正在执行的工具、以及已运行多久。步骤结束后会保留该步用时，直到下一步开始，因此慢步骤事后也能查证。

description.en: Sets the DSH web client conversation column to a percentage of its own width (40-100, default 100 = full width) instead of the built-in 680-920px reading measure, edited from a collapsible card under Settings > Plugins.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 客户端对话列宽度设为其自身宽度的百分比（40–100，默认 100 即铺满整列），取代内置的 680–920px 阅读宽度，并在「设置 > 插件」中提供可折叠的调整卡片。

description.en: Tiered cold storage for DSH sessions: idle sessions move out of the live root into an on-disk cold tier instead of being deleted, an FTS5 index over that tier keeps them searchable, and a restore path moves a session back into the live root. Dry-run by default: nothing moves until you turn it off in Settings.
description.zh: DSH 会话的分层冷存储：闲置会话移出实时根目录、转入磁盘冷层而不被删除；冷层上的 FTS5 索引让它们仍可检索，需要时可将会话恢复回实时根目录。默认为演练模式，在设置页关闭后才会真正移动会话。

description.en: Interactive code-reading coach for DeepSeek Harness: a five-phase guided walkthrough of the source behind a paper, starting by identifying its language and framework.
description.zh: 代码研读教练：交互式引导研读论文对应的开源代码。五段研读法（锚定论文主张、地形扫描、入口追踪、核心映射、闭环验证），自动识别并告知语言的框架与架构，适合研读 AI 论文源码。

description.en: Workspace-free chats that promote real files into their own project workspace - a maintained fork of dsh-scratchpad, kept working on current DSH.
description.zh: 免工作区自由对话，产物自动提升为独立项目工作区；dsh-scratchpad 的持续维护 fork，跟当前 DSH 保持可用。

description.en: Read-only observer of native DeepSeek search model calls: appends each call token usage to a JSONL file so accounting plugins can price it. Requests and responses are not modified.
description.zh: 只读观察原生 DeepSeek 搜索的模型调用，把每次调用的 token 用量追加到 JSONL 文件，供统计类插件计价；不修改请求与响应。

description.en: TOTP-only access control for personal DeepSeek Harness Web instances, with in-app QR enrollment, single-use recovery codes, live protection controls and lock-all revocation of page access.
description.zh: 面向个人 DeepSeek Harness Web 实例的纯 TOTP 访问验证，支持设置内扫码绑定、一次性恢复码、动态启停保护和撤销所有页面授权。

description.en: Local plugin installer in the DSH web Settings: a file picker for .tgz plugin packages (multi-select) or a full machine path, installing them into the auto-detected profile via the official `dsh plugin add` with live CLI output — no terminal needed.
description.zh: 本地插件安装器：DSH 网页设置页里的本地插件安装入口——文件选择器多选 .tgz 或输入本机完整路径，自动检测所在 profile 并执行官方 `dsh plugin add`，实时回显安装日志，无需终端。

description.en: Network explorer for kids: my identity, DNS lookup, a traceroute trip, speed test and who is home on the LAN.
description.zh: 网络小旅行：我的身份、DNS 查询、路由追踪、测速、谁在局域网。

description.en: Reorder the settings panel nav by long-pressing and dragging a section: the dragged row turns translucent and follows the pointer, the order is saved to the plugin's own folder, and uninstalling restores the official order.
description.zh: 长按拖动即可重排设置面板左侧大项：被拖项半透明并跟随指针，顺序保存在插件自己的目录而非 settings.yaml，卸载后自动恢复官方原序。
