description.en: Read Google Antigravity SQLite conversations in DeepSeek Harness and import them as native sidebar sessions with list, read and import tools plus slash commands.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里读取 Google Antigravity 的 SQLite 会话并导入为原生侧栏会话，提供 list／read／import 工具与斜杠命令。

description.en: Registers one agent tool, plugin_guard, that statically scans a DSH plugin package before it is installed and reports a verdict with the reasons: a missing or broken dsh.bundle.patch, a missing dsh.permissions block, install scripts, dangerous APIs and obfuscation, dependency risk, and source that is not indexed and therefore cannot be verified. Read-only: the scanned code is never imported, installed, evaluated or run.
description.zh: 注册一个 agent 工具 plugin_guard，在安装前对 DSH 插件包做静态扫描，给出判定与原因：缺少或损坏的 dsh.bundle.patch、未声明 dsh.permissions、安装脚本、危险 API 与代码混淆、依赖风险，以及未索引、无法核验的源码。只读：不导入、不安装、不求值、不运行被扫描的代码。

description.en: Share the current session over the LAN as a read-only, token-guarded HTML snapshot with session stats and Markdown rendering.
description.zh: 将当前会话以只读、token 保护的 HTML 快照分享到局域网，附带会话统计与 Markdown 渲染。

description.en: Stop a running background job from the session-header job list, with a confirmation dialog that restates the full command.
description.zh: 在会话头部的后台任务列表里停止正在运行的任务，确认弹窗会再次显示完整命令。

description.en: Version badge above the sidebar settings button: shows the current dsh version, expands to list every core package version, and checks npm for updates with one-click deploy.
description.zh: 侧边栏设置按钮上方的版本徽标：常驻显示当前 dsh 版本，展开可查看全部核心包版本，并支持检查 npm 更新与一键部署。

description.en: A ✨ button left of the send button: reads the draft and recent turns, asks the configured model for three suggestions each pairing an issue with a patch, lets you tick them individually with a live preview of the merged prompt, and writes the result back to the composer without sending.
description.zh: 发送按钮左侧的 ✨ 按钮：读取草稿与最近若干轮对话，向已配置的模型要三条建议（每条都是「问题 + 改法」），可逐条勾选并实时预览合并后的提示词，结果写回输入框但不发送。

description.en: Streaming video preview in the DSH sidebar — mp4, webm and mov play in place over an authenticated byte-range route, with 206 responses, instant seeking, no size cap and no build step.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里的流式视频预览：mp4、webm、mov 就地播放，走带鉴权的字节范围路由（206 响应），拖动秒开、没有大小上限、无构建步骤。

description.en: Runtime observability and plugin operations panel for DeepSeek Harness: shows the profile plugin tree, real Loader fiber state, capabilities/dependencies/compatibility, current-session plugin activity and upstream source/version checks, with one-click enable/disable/update/uninstall plus a standalone startup-failure diagnostics page that works while DSH is not running.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的运行可观测与插件运维面板：展示 Profile 插件树、Loader 真实 fiber 状态、能力/依赖/兼容性、本轮会话插件活动与上游来源/版本核验，支持一键关闭/启用/更新/卸载，并提供 DSH 未运行时也能打开的独立启动失败诊断页。

description.en: Export DSH conversations as Smartisan Notes-style PNGs, or create and update Markdown notes in a configured account-scoped workspace.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话导出为锤子便签风格 PNG，或在配置的账号工作区中新建和更新 Markdown 便签。

description.en: Multi-candidate mode for DeepSeek Harness (test-time scaling): floating panel config, the agent auto-runs parallel candidates plus verifier selection, scoped to the current session.
description.zh: 多候选模式插件（test-time scaling）：悬浮球面板配置，模型对任务自动执行并行候选加验证选优，仅当前会话生效。

description.en: One-click search-engine switcher beside the DeepSeek Harness model picker; changes the dsh-free-search provider, handy on overseas university networks that block the DeepSeek Official search endpoint.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁一键切换搜索服务商的下拉菜单；海外大学网络常拦截 DeepSeek 官方搜索，可借此切到其他引擎规避。

description.en: Read-only insight panel for one profile: five views over the same data — config layers, plugin tree, services, tool names and models — each entry showing which layer inserted or disabled it and whether it is running.
description.zh: 只读的 profile 洞察面板：同一份数据的五个视图——配置层、插件树、服务、工具名、模型，每一条都给出被哪一层插入或禁用、此刻在不在跑。

description.en: Processes as little workers: how many, the busiest, the family tree and badges.
description.zh: 进程小工人：数量、谁最卖力、家族树、工牌。

description.en: A self-hosted digital-life companion for DSH. Three slow-moving hormones (dopamine, cortisol, serotonin) set its mood and tone, a memory layer turns chats into events and facts with version chains and a forgetting curve, and it writes, hot-loads and unloads its own organs (tools) when a capability is missing. It handles text, images, stickers, voice notes with text to speech and speech recognition, and file uploads; the web space holds diary posts and guestbook comments, and it starts conversations on its own schedule. The built-in web server listens on 0.0.0.0:2332 by default, so create the owner account before exposing the port.
description.zh: AuraLife 把 DSH 变成一条自托管的数字生命：三种慢变量激素（多巴胺、皮质醇、血清素）决定它的状态和话风；记忆层把聊天变成事件和事实，带版本链与遗忘曲线；发现缺少能力时它会自己写「器官」（工具），写完即热加载，也能热卸载。支持文字、图片、表情、语音（TTS 与语音识别）和文件上传；网页空间里有日记和留言评论，它还会按自己的安排主动搭话。内置网页服务默认监听 0.0.0.0:2332，对外暴露端口前请先创建主人账号。

description.en: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.
description.zh: 跨会话引用插件：在任意会话（含其他工作区）粘贴 @[label](dsh-session:…) 引用，宿主注入被引用会话的快照供模型阅读，并提供一键复制引用按钮。

description.en: Matrix-style CLI chat page for the DSH web UI: the agent's thinking streams down the screen as green code rain while replies print normally in the terminal.
description.zh: 矩阵风格 CLI 对话页：Agent 思考过程化作绿色代码雨倾泻而下，回复照常流式显示。

description.en: A green pixel-Ork mascot for DSH Web that masks model thinking and output as Waaaaaaagh! until clicked to reveal, plus a random-length input mask.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 加一个会眨眼的像素绿皮兽人：把模型思考与输出掩码成 Waaaaaaagh!（点击显示原文），并支持随机长度的输入掩码。

description.en: Deep research as an agent mode: one reviewed loop that plans, researches in adaptive parallel rounds driven by the gaps the researchers themselves declare, synthesises a cited report and then reviews it adversarially, instead of a script the model rewrites per call. Questions the round budget never reached are named in the report rather than dropped.
description.zh: 把深度研究做成一种代理模式：一条经过审阅的固定循环——先规划，再按研究员自行声明的缺口进行自适应并行轮次，综合出带引用的报告，最后对其做对抗性审阅——而不是让模型每次现写脚本。轮次预算未能覆盖的问题会在报告中被逐一点名，而不是被悄悄丢弃。

description.en: Read GeoServer WMS services and render map images in the dsh web GUI, with a settings card for server, username, and password.
description.zh: 在 dsh web GUI 中读取 GeoServer WMS 服务并渲染地图图像，带服务器地址、用户名和密码设置卡片。

description.en: Computer safety shown as castle guards: firewall, disk encryption, lock screen, remote ports and login history.
description.zh: 电脑安全小城堡守卫：防火墙、磁盘加密、锁屏、远程端口、登录记录。

description.en: A page for writing notes inside DeepSeek Harness. · Minimal writing — one page that typesets as you type. · AI completion — a suggestion arrives when you pause, and TAB takes it. · Immersive writing — full screen, with only the page on it. · History — every note listed, searched and edited in place, and copied out as standard Markdown. · AI board — a data assistant that answers from your notes and pins the charts it builds.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的笔记页。 · 极简写 — 一页纸，边写边排版。 · AI 自动补全 — 停笔片刻给出建议，TAB 采纳。 · 沉浸式书写 — 全屏，只有这张纸。 · 历史记录 — 笔记可列、可搜、就地编辑，一键复制标准 Markdown。 · AI 看板 — 数据助手用你的笔记回答，并把图表钉在看板上。

description.en: Show local images and short videos in the DSH conversation card with one-click download of the original file, or offer any other local file for download; works over local and remote connections and keeps the media itself out of the model's vision context.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话卡片内显示本地图片与短视频并提供原文件一键下载，也可为任意其他本地文件提供下载；本机与远程连接均可用，媒体本身不进入模型的视觉上下文。

description.en: Plays a chime when the AI asks a clarifying question (a `?` / `？` in the message, or an `ask_user_question` tool call). Synthesized via Web Audio API, no audio file, works on every OS.
description.zh: 当 AI 询问澄清性问题时（带问号或调用 ask_user_question）播放提示音。Web Audio API 合成，零音频文件，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

description.en: A pelican riding a bicycle along a seashore in the bottom-right corner: an SVG animation that reflects the agent working state (thinking/done), with a chime and an optional system notification when a reply finishes.
description.zh: 右下角鹈鹕环海骑行 SVG 动画，随代理状态在思考/完成间切换，回复完成时播放提示音并可选发送系统通知。

description.en: Teaches Herdr about DSH panes: reports agent working/idle/blocked state — including the blocked state DSH itself lacks — enabling panel jump and --wait. (Herdr integration / agent state display / panel jump)
description.zh: 让 Herdr 认识 DSH 面板：把 agent 的 working/idle/blocked 状态报给 Herdr（含 DSH 本身没有的 blocked 等待态），支持面板跳转与 --wait。（状态上报 / 状态显示 / 终端集成 / 面板跳转）

description.en: Beads issue-graph panel in the left sidebar of the Web GUI: filter ready, in-progress, open, and all beads, read a bead's description, notes, dependencies, and comments, and create, claim, or close beads through the bd CLI. Requires the bd CLI on PATH and a workspace with a Beads database.
description.zh: Web 界面左侧栏的 Beads 任务图谱面板：按可领取、进行中、待处理、全部筛选，查看任务描述、备注、依赖与评论，并通过 bd CLI 新建、领取或关闭任务。需要 PATH 上的 bd CLI，以及已初始化 Beads 数据库的工作区。

description.en: Progressive tool disclosure: a deferred tool group costs one catalog line instead of its full schemas until the model loads it with tool_search, with one switch per group in Settings and each group measured against the live registry.
description.zh: 渐进式工具披露：被延后的工具组在每次请求中只占目录里的一行，模型用 tool_search 加载后才拿到完整 schema；设置页为每个组提供一个开关，各组开销按当前工具注册表实测。

description.en: VS Code-style local IDE for DeepSeek Harness: Monaco editor, explorer, search, Git, terminal, and language services. With pnpm, run `pnpm approve-builds --all` so the native build of node-pty is allowed.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供 VS Code 风格的本地 IDE：Monaco 编辑器、资源管理器、搜索、Git、终端与语言服务。用 pnpm 安装时需运行 `pnpm approve-builds --all`，允许 node-pty 的原生构建。

description.en: Draggable weather bar in the shell overlay with forecast and geocoding from Open-Meteo; the position persists across sessions.
description.zh: shell 浮层中的可拖动天气条，预报与地理编码来自 Open-Meteo；位置跨会话持久保存。

description.en: A plugin for managing MCP servers in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness内管理MCP服务的插件。

description.en: Read-aloud and dictation for the DSH web UI with 23 TTS and STT provider types configured side by side, per-language routing, in-text language markers, per-sentence language detection, word highlighting and a TTS Reader sidebar tab (the tab requires dsh-better-sidebar; everything else works without it).
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供朗读与听写：23 种 TTS 与 STT 提供商类型可并排配置，支持按语言路由、文内语言标记、逐句语言检测、逐词高亮，以及 TTS Reader 侧边栏标签页（该标签页需安装 dsh-better-sidebar，其余功能不装也可用）。

description.en: Windowed handoffs on top of DSH native compaction: each compaction appends a bounded window message (goal, todos, recent user instructions, notes), with session-private notes, paged history recall and a /ctx switch; notes and history tools appear after the first rotation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生压缩之上做换窗交接：每次压缩追加有长度上限的窗口消息（目标、待办、近期用户指令、笔记），配会话私有笔记、分页历史检索和 /ctx 开关；笔记与历史工具在首次换窗后出现。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness with auto-collapsing process, a minimap-style message navigation rail, in-page search, unified failure cards, and generative MCP Apps (SEP-1865) in sandboxed iframes.
description.zh: 阅读视图增强插件——执行过程自动收起、右缘消息导航导轨、页内查找、统一失败卡片，支持生成式 MCP Apps（SEP-1865）沙箱交互。

description.en: Cost readouts for the composer, turns and sessions, a usage dashboard, daily/monthly budgets and settings, with DeepSeek balance from dsh-tally-balance-deepseek.
description.zh: 提供输入框费用条、每轮与会话费用详情、用量看板、日/月预算和设置，并通过 dsh-tally-balance-deepseek 显示 DeepSeek 余额。

description.en: Pavement design methods as a judgement manual: 76 cards over 9 chapters on method selection, indicator assignment, parameter calibers, axle-load conversion and climate zoning, with the airport chapter recovered by re-OCR of the intact PDF.
description.zh: 路面设计方法判据手册：9 章 76 张卡，覆盖方法选型、指标指派、参数口径、轴载换算与气候分区；第九章机场道面曾整章丢失，已由原 PDF 重扫恢复。

description.en: Per-turn git checkpoints of a workspace: revert one turn’s changes (or go back to the end of an earlier turn), previewed file by file, and forget that part of the conversation from the model context.
description.zh: 按轮次为工作区拍 git 检查点：撤销某一轮的改动，或回到某一轮结束时的状态，并把这些对话从模型上下文中遗忘；执行前展示差异预览。

description.en: Generate AI-narrated DSH session reports (daily/weekly/monthly, any date range) and sync them to flomo (浮墨笔记) with one configurable tag (default #write/dsh) and automatic # stripping, via a web settings panel with daily reminder.
description.zh: 生成 AI 叙事的 DSH 会话报告（日报/周报/月报、任意区间）并同步到 flomo：单一可配置标签（默认

description.en: Backs up a DSH profile's text configuration to an unlisted secret GitHub Gist, and syncs it back on another machine: a settings page with three buttons (status / upload / sync), a config_backup agent tool, a reversible merge-style restore, and credential stores, binaries, lockfiles and local usage counters left out of every backup and named in the UI. Needs a GitHub token with the gist scope (DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN or a signed-in gh CLI). Files are uploaded as plain text without redaction, so keys written into cordis.patch.yml or .npmrc end up in a Gist that anyone with its link can read.
description.zh: 把本机 DSH profile 的文本配置备份到不公开列出的 secret GitHub Gist，并在另一台机器上同步回来：设置页只有三个按钮（状态／上传／同步），另有 config_backup 工具；恢复是合并式的、可撤销；凭据库、二进制文件、锁文件与本机用量计数不进入备份，并在界面上逐项列明。需要带 gist 权限的 GitHub 令牌（DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN、GITHUB_TOKEN 或已登录的 gh CLI）。文件按原文上传、不做脱敏，写进 cordis.patch.yml 或 .npmrc 的密钥会进入 Gist，任何拿到链接的人都能读。

description.en: Drag any sidebar panel to reorder it, or drop one onto More to fold it into the More submenu; the order and the folded set are remembered across restarts.
description.zh: 拖动左侧栏任意面板调整顺序，或把它拖到「更多」上收进二级菜单；顺序与收纳状态重启后保留。

description.en: Storage explorer: disk boxes, the home folder and the heaviest items.
description.zh: 存储小仓库：磁盘分区、主目录、最占空间的东西。

description.en: Work-data hub for DingTalk and Yunxiao: syncs todos, logs, meeting notes, attendance, schedules, projects, requirements, commits and worklogs into local SQLite, then renders dashboards, a work calendar, project analysis and reports, with workhub_* agent tools over the same data. Requires the DWS CLI installed and logged in (`dws auth login`); the Yunxiao PAT is stored in the macOS Keychain only.
description.zh: 钉钉与云效的个人工作数据中心：把待办、日志、AI 听记、考勤、日程、项目、需求、代码提交与报工同步到本地 SQLite，展示驾驶舱、工作日历、项目分析与智能报告，并向 Agent 提供 workhub_* 工具。需先安装并登录 DWS CLI（`dws auth login`）；云效 PAT 仅存 macOS 钥匙串。

description.en: Lets the DSH Web UI run behind an authenticating reverse proxy, with separate controls for trusted hosts, login bypass, cross-site navigation, local-page trust, and an optional network listener.
description.zh: 让 DSH Web UI 可在带身份验证的反向代理后运行，并分别控制受信任主机、跳过登录、跨站导航、本地页面信任和可选的网络监听器。

description.en: Local-first AI literature desk for DSH: import and parse PDFs (MinerU APIs or on-device pdf.js), read original/bilingual text with in-margin annotations, ask grounded questions whose citations jump to the page, and build per-paper or library knowledge graphs; eight agent tools expose the same library.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先 AI 文献阅读台：导入并解析论文（MinerU 或本机 pdf.js），原文/双语阅读与页边批注，带引用跳转的 grounded AI 问答，以及单篇/全库知识图谱；八个 agent 工具共享同一文献库。

description.en: Computer use through an external USB HID device: name a target in plain language, a vision model locates it in a cropped window screenshot, and a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 moves the real mouse and types on the real keyboard. 7 tools. Windows has window listing, per-window cropping and automatic window raising; macOS needs pyobjc and has neither; Linux is unsupported.
description.zh: 通过外接 USB HID 硬件做电脑控制：用一句话描述目标，视觉模型在裁剪后的窗口截图里定位，树莓派 Pico 2 驱动真实鼠标和键盘完成动作。7 个工具。Windows 支持窗口枚举、按窗口裁剪与自动抬窗；macOS 需 pyobjc 且不支持这两项；Linux 不支持。

description.en: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when engines fail so a thin result set is not read as a thin web.
description.zh: 把 web_search 指向自建的 SearXNG 实例而非原生搜索路由：自动翻页直到满足 maxResults，并在引擎失败时报告覆盖不全，避免把稀少的结果误读成网上本就没有内容。

description.en: Runs the local nanobot CLI agent as a DSH subagent through a nanobot_run tool: each call carries one self-contained task and returns only the agent's final answer, either as a fresh process or through a persistent OpenAI-compatible server.
description.zh: 通过 nanobot_run 工具把本机 nanobot CLI agent 当作 DSH 子代理运行：每次只交给它一个自包含任务并仅返回最终答案，可按次启动进程，也可走常驻的 OpenAI 兼容服务。

description.en: PPT stage — presentation generation (Beamer/Quarto) from the paper for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 报告阶段（PPT）——资产定价与机器学习研究的论文演讲幻灯片生成（Beamer/Quarto）。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Carries a DSH environment between machines through one private GitHub or Gitee repository: third-party plugins (reinstalled from a version, or carried as a tarball or source tree), the four profile configuration files, and folder snapshots. A restore resolves each folder through an absolute path, a registered root, or a confirmed new path, compares file by file, leaves locally edited files alone, backs up anything it replaces, and refuses writes that escape a root, cross a junction, or land on a directory the plugin does not own. Configuration files and folder contents are uploaded as they are (no secret scrubbing) and the plugin does not check that the repository is private; the access token stays in the credentials service, and on first start a GIT_SYNC_* token left by dsh-plugin-git-sync is copied over. Needs Node 22.12 or later.
description.zh: 通过一个私有 GitHub / Gitee 仓库在机器之间搬运 DSH 环境：第三方插件（按版本重装，或携带 tarball / 源码目录）、四个 profile 配置文件、以及文件夹快照。还原时逐文件比对，本机改过的文件不覆盖，被替换的文件先备份，并按绝对路径、已登记的根、或显式确认三级解析落点；逃出根、穿越 junction、覆盖非本插件目录的写入一律拒绝。配置文件和文件夹内容原样上传（不做密钥脱敏），插件也不检查仓库是否私有；访问令牌保存在凭据服务里，首次启动会把 dsh-plugin-git-sync 留下的 GIT_SYNC_* 令牌复制过来。需要 Node 22.12 及以上。

description.en: Open DSH workspace directories in installed file managers, terminals, and supported editors from the Web UI.
description.zh: 从 DSH Web UI 使用已安装的文件管理器、终端和受支持的编辑器打开工作区目录。

description.en: Configurable static launch token for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI across restarts and reverse proxies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 配置固定的静态启动令牌，方便跨服务重启和反向代理访问。

description.en: Fine grained per tool permission rules for DSH at the tools/pre-execute gate, deny and ask lists in Claude Code rule syntax (`Bash(rm -rf:*), Read(_secrets_), mcp__server__tool`), works standalone without migrating.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上按工具粒度的权限规则：在 tools/pre-execute 强制执行 deny/ask 清单，规则语法与 Claude Code 相同，不迁移也能单独用。

description.en: Parses DSH session logs to attribute AI-written files, overlays c8 coverage, and reports AI vs human code coverage with a trust score, plus a check/fix/verify tool loop for closing test gaps.
description.zh: 解析 DSH session 日志归因 AI 生成文件，叠加 c8 覆盖率，产出「AI vs 人工代码」覆盖率对比与信任分，并提供 check/fix/verify 三工具闭环补齐测试盲区。

description.en: Ctrl+Tab switcher over every visited screen — Sessions, Settings sections and plugin pages — shown while Ctrl is held; release to switch, Esc to stay. Browsers reserve Ctrl+Tab for their own tabs, so use it in the desktop app or in a browser that delivers the shortcut to the page.
description.zh: Ctrl+Tab 切换器：按住 Ctrl 时列出访问过的页面——会话、设置分区和插件页——松开即切换，Esc 取消。浏览器会把 Ctrl+Tab 留给自己的标签页，所以请在桌面端使用，或在能把该快捷键交给页面的浏览器里使用。

description.en: After an agent's own bash or shell command, re-observes the files that session had observed, so FS_STALE_VERSION no longer fires on self-inflicted writes but still fires on writes by others.
description.zh: 在 agent 自己的 bash/shell 命令结束后，重新观察该会话此前观察过的文件：自己改文件不再触发 FS_STALE_VERSION，但其他人写入仍会触发。

description.en: Connects all seven Qwen Token Plan Harness-entitlement MCP services (enhanced search, web fetch, code interpreter, vertical search, image, TTS, ASR) plus the decision-model-preview model (qwen_decide) as native tools, with a per-service on/off and live-status panel.
description.zh: 一步接全千问 Token Plan 的 7 个 Harness 权益 MCP 服务（联网搜索、网页解析、代码解释器、垂类搜索、图像生成、语音合成、语音识别）与决策模型（qwen_decide），附逐服务开关与实时状态面板。

description.en: Adds a confirmed Delete session action to the sidebar menu of archived Sessions; the Host permanently removes their local JSONL logs (including hidden subagent descendants), workspace accounting and archive/pin entries, then refreshes open Web clients.
description.zh: 在 Web 侧栏已归档会话的“...”菜单中新增带二次确认的「删除会话」；Host 永久删除本地 JSONL 日志（含隐藏的子代理后代）、工作区记账与归档/置顶集合，并刷新已打开的页面。

description.en: Turn the Edifier Halo PixelBar desktop pixel display into a DSH tool: push short text, switch scenes, set screen color, ambient light and volume over HID, and restore the clock on demand. USB-connected device only; tested on Windows only; needs Python 3.8+ with hidapi (pip install hidapi).
description.zh: 把花再 Halo PixelBar 桌面像素屏变成 DSH 工具：经 HID 推短文字、切场景、设屏色、调氛围灯与音量，并可按需切回时钟。需 USB 连接设备；仅在 Windows 上验证；需要 Python 3.8+ 与 hidapi（pip install hidapi）。

description.en: Kids' coding classroom: run Python and LOGO-turtle code, explain, practice, review and step through programs.
description.zh: 小朋友的编程小教室：跑 Python 与海龟画图代码、讲解、练习、点评、分步。

description.en: Copy a user message together with its images and files, then paste it into any session: the text lands in the composer and each attachment is rebuilt through the official createDrafts/addAttachments path, so it uploads and sends like a normal draft.
description.zh: 复制用户消息时连同图片与文件一起捕获，粘贴到任意会话：文字进入输入框，每个附件经官方 createDrafts/addAttachments 通道重建为真实草稿，可正常上传并发送。

description.en: Keeps the Mac awake for as long as the DSH host is running, whether or not an agent is working: starts ClamAwake's virtual display (mirroring the main screen) plus caffeinate -d, stops both when DSH exits and restarts the engine if it crashes. Self-contained (bundles the arm64 vd-engine, GPL-3.0). Requires macOS on Apple Silicon.
description.zh: 只要 DSH 宿主在运行就让 Mac 保持清醒，不论智能体是否在工作：启动 ClamAwake 的虚拟屏（镜像主屏）并挂 caffeinate -d，DSH 退出时一并停止，引擎崩溃自动重启。自包含（随包带 arm64 vd-engine，GPL-3.0）。需要 Apple Silicon 的 macOS。

description.en: Vision for text-only dsh models: paste an image and a configured multimodal model transcribes it to text automatically — transparent twin routing, an agent-callable read-image tool, no built-in keys or relay.
description.zh: 纯文本 dsh 模型的识图插件：粘贴图片自动由你配置的多模态模型转成文字——透明孪生路由、模型可自主调用识图工具、无内置密钥与中转。

description.en: Compiles a Windows .bat/.cmd launcher into a real .exe from inside DSH: renders an icon from a built-in bitmap font, emits a C# wrapper that runs the batch file next to it, compiles with csc.exe (or dotnet build), and can write Start Menu / Desktop shortcuts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内把 Windows .bat/.cmd 启动器编译成真正的 .exe：用内置位图字体生成图标，生成调用同目录批处理的 C# 薄壳，经 csc.exe（或 dotnet build）编译，并可选写入开始菜单/桌面快捷方式。

description.en: Navigation dots for DSH Web conversations — quickly jump between user messages.
description.zh: DSH 网页端对话导航点 — 快速跳转用户消息。

description.en: Agent lineage tree panel for DeepSeek Harness: renders the Lead-to-member-to-grandchild agent hierarchy as a live org-chart tree, with team focus, real-time status dots, and a model routing center (hot-reload default model config and actual per-session routes). The model routing center needs the optional dsh-plugin-subagent-director plugin; the rest of the panel works without it.
description.zh: 代际树面板：把 Lead→成员→孙代理 的多层代理关系画成实时组织树，含团队焦点、真状态点、模型路由中心。模型路由中心需另装可选的 dsh-plugin-subagent-director 插件，其余功能不装也能用。

description.en: Task-queue execution endpoint for DSH: requires a separately self-deployed Hermes Agent gateway plus your own WeChat inbound script; verified on a single environment — expect to adapt it.
description.zh: DSH 的任务队列执行端点：需要自行部署独立的 Hermes Agent 网关并编写自己的微信入站脚本；仅在单一环境验证过，需要按你的环境适配。

description.en: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
description.zh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

description.en: Compares existing DSH sessions or runs controlled A/B trials between agent presets, showing aligned timelines, paired metric deltas, explicit success checks, and exportable reports.
description.zh: 对比已有 DSH 会话，或在两套 Agent Preset 之间运行受控 A/B 试验，展示对齐时间线、配对指标差值、显式验收结果与可导出的报告。

description.en: Restores Cmd+, to open the existing Settings dialog in DeepSeek Harness on macOS.
description.zh: 为 macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 恢复 Cmd+, 设置快捷键。

description.en: GIS/CAD analysis toolkit for dsh: read DXF, convert DWG to DXF, query layers/entities, export styled analysis maps (SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF, plus PSD on Windows x64), and run GIS summary/buffer/overlay on SHP/GeoJSON/KML — pure-JS parsing, no GDAL.
description.zh: 面向规划/测绘的 GIS/CAD 分析工具：读 DXF、DWG 转 DXF、按图层/文字查实体、出带版式的分析图（SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF，PSD 仅 Windows x64），并对 SHP/GeoJSON/KML 做按类汇总、缓冲与叠加——解析用纯 JS，不依赖 GDAL。

description.en: Pool AI provider accounts per platform and route them through a local loopback proxy that bridges the OpenAI, OpenAI-Responses, Anthropic and Gemini protocols, then write the proxy into Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Grok, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes config files with snapshot-and-rollback safe writes; registers no agent tools.
description.zh: 按平台把 AI 供应商账号组成算力池，经本地回环代理路由并在 OpenAI、OpenAI-Responses、Anthropic、Gemini 四种协议间桥接，再用带快照回滚的安全直写把代理写进 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Grok、OpenCode、OpenClaw、Hermes 的配置文件；不注册任何 agent 工具。

description.en: Inline diff cards for every edit, write and str_replace_editor call: old/new line numbers, character-level highlighting, 57-language detection with a red/green-safe syntax palette, a side-by-side viewer, Read-row line ranges, and a settings page for display style and highlighting.
description.zh: 为 edit、write、str_replace_editor 调用就地渲染内联差异卡片：旧/新行号、字符级高亮、57 种语言检测与红绿安全的语法配色，另有左右对照、Read 行范围，以及可配置的显示风格与高亮设置。

description.en: Reading workbench for DSH: a cover-grid bookshelf and a paginated single/double-page reader for Markdown, TXT, HTML, EPUB, MOBI and PDF, with highlight notes anchored to text offsets and three agent tools for listing books, reading highlights and pulling text excerpts.
description.zh: DSH 阅读工作台：封面网格书架 + 单/双页分页阅读器，支持 Markdown、TXT、HTML、EPUB、MOBI、PDF，划线笔记以文本偏移锚定，并提供书目、划线、正文节选三个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Before closing a coding session or the DSH app itself, checks what would be lost — uncommitted work, unpushed commits, scratch files, missing handoff notes, pending restarts, broken profile bundles — and prints a three-level verdict; when a handoff is needed it writes the seven-section handoff file into the workspace ledger. Read-only by default.
description.zh: 关会话或关 DSH 之前先查会丢什么：未提交改动、未推提交、临时文件、缺交接件、待重启标记、profile 里重启后装不上的包；给出三档结论，该交接时把七节交接件写进工作区台账。默认只读。

description.en: Identity-gated Tailscale access to the Web GUI with dsh still bound to loopback: a 127.0.0.1 proxy published by `tailscale serve` admits a request only when the Tailscale login it stamps is allowed, with an optional per-device allowlist, so the privileged /api methods behind the loopback check — Settings, Models, Plugins — answer without dsh being told to trust a remote host.
description.zh: 在 dsh 仍绑定回环地址的前提下，为 Web 界面提供基于身份的 Tailscale 访问：由 `tailscale serve` 对外发布的 127.0.0.1 代理，仅当其标记的 Tailscale 登录账号在允许列表内时才放行请求，并可另按设备白名单限制；这样受回环检查保护的特权 /api 方法（设置、模型、插件）无需让 dsh 信任远程主机即可正常响应。

description.en: NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek nodes inside DSH: five read-only tools covering provenance (both upstream releases this build names), a data directory's restored state and ledger audit, the conformance vectors, exact decimal conversion, and node reachability. Driving the node -- starting or stopping a daemon, depositing funds, sending bus messages -- is deliberately not exposed, because those are audited privileged operations in this project.
description.zh: 把 NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek 节点接入 DSH：五个只读工具，覆盖版本与上游出处、数据目录恢复状态与账本审计、一致性向量、精确十进制换算，以及节点可达性探测。刻意不暴露启动/停止守护进程、存款、发总线消息这类在本项目里受审计的特权操作。

description.en: Drive the DSH Desktop right-sidebar browser on Windows through playwright-cli, with a stable per-session page ID. Needs DSH started with --remote-debugging-port=0 and @playwright/cli installed globally.
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 桌面端通过 playwright-cli 驱动右侧边栏浏览器，为每个会话提供稳定的 pageId。需要用 --remote-debugging-port=0 启动 DSH，并全局安装 @playwright/cli。

description.en: Codex-style auto-hiding right-edge turn rail: edge-peek show/hide, per-turn tooltip, in-rail search, and a scrolling 30-turn window for long sessions.
description.zh: Codex 风格自动隐藏右缘轮次导航：靠边浮现、单轮 tooltip、会话内搜索、长会话 30 轮滚动窗口。

description.en: Question index: an ordered, collapsible list of your asked questions floating on the right side of the conversation; click a question to jump the session to that point. Auto-indexes each session's full history on open, persists it locally, and jumps to older questions by growing the window on demand.
description.zh: 提问索引：在会话右侧按序展示你提过的问题列表，可收起；点击某条即可把会话滚动跳转到对应位置。打开会话自动索引全部历史提问并本地持久保存；点击更早的提问会按需翻页加载后跳转。

description.en: She keeps the questions your chats left unanswered, then goes and looks them up later. A line she asked you that ended in "?" and never got an answer is stored as a hanging question; on a schedule inside a daily window (08:00–23:00, five a day by default; an optional mouse/keyboard-idle gate is off by default) she picks the oldest one, searches the web and Bilibili, reads what is actually readable, distils it into two or three sentences and leaves a note on her desk. Questions about its own plugins are skipped and left for you. Read-only on her events: nothing is written to her memory, her growth is untouched, and dsh-fish needs no patching. Requires the @ssamurias/dsh-fish persona plugin for her event stream and a local Ollama model; a search API key is optional.
description.zh: 让她自己补上那些你没答、她也没懂的问题。聊天里她问出口、以问号结尾、又没等到回答的话，被记成一条「悬着的问」；到点（默认 08:00–23:00、每天最多 5 条，可选的键鼠空闲闸默认关闭）她挑最久的那条自己去查——搜网页与 B 站，只读真正读得进来的页面，提炼成两三句，在你桌上留一张纸条。问的是我们自家插件的事就跳过，留给你答。全程只读她的经历：不写她的记忆、不动她的成长，也不需要改 dsh-fish 一行代码。需已装大肥鱼人格插件 @ssamurias/dsh-fish 提供经历，并配本地 ollama 模型；搜索 API 可选。

description.en: Expose the DSH Web GUI over IPv6 or IPv4 from WSL2 through a reverse proxy (Lucky): /wan up sets up the socat relay, Windows portproxy, firewall, and trusted-host fence, with a Settings card plus commands to configure the domain and ports.
description.zh: 从 WSL2 走 IPv6/IPv4 经反向代理（Lucky）把 DSH Web GUI 暴露到公网：/wan up 一键建立 socat 中继、Windows portproxy、防火墙与 trusted-host 白名单；域名与端口可在设置卡片或命令中配置。

description.en: Drive locally installed Codex CLI and Claude Code from DeepSeek Harness through a settings page and agent tools, exposing their sessions, configuration and run state.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动本机安装的 Codex CLI 与 Claude Code，通过设置页与 agent 工具查看会话、配置和运行状态。

description.en: Rejects foreground waiting in DSH agents: waiting commands (sleep, wait, tail -f, watch, ping without -c, infinite loops), blocking wait tools (wait_agent, job_output with wait: true), progress polling (the same check command repeated within a window) and commands that need human input/confirmation (sudo without -n, ssh without BatchMode, login flows, interactive editors, docker -it) are refused with an actionable retry to run in the background or end the turn. Configurable budget and polling window, message language follows the system (zh/en), zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 禁止 Agent 前台等待：sleep / wait / tail -f / watch / ping 等等待型命令、wait_agent 与 job_output(wait) 等阻塞等待工具，用反复 check 代替等待的轮询（同一条命令在窗口内重复出现），以及需要人输入/确认的命令（sudo 不加 -n、ssh 不开 BatchMode、登录流程、交互式编辑器、docker -it）都会被拒绝，并给出改用后台作业或结束本轮等唤醒的可执行指令；等待预算与轮询窗口可配、文案跟随系统语言（中/英）、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Generates video through the user's own OpenAI-style asynchronous endpoint and plays the finished clip in the conversation, with live progress and cancel.
description.zh: 通过你自己的 OpenAI 风格异步接口生成视频，并在对话里播放成品，带实时进度和取消。

description.en: Pavement structural dynamics as a judgement manual: 59 cards over 8 chapters flagging which chapter name oversells its contents, which formulas break when copied, and which numbers cannot be cross-quoted.
description.zh: 路面结构动力学判据手册：8 章 59 张卡，指明哪章名不副实、哪些式子抄走就错、哪些数不能互引。

description.en: Configurable per-turn budgets for supported file mutations, limiting distinct files, mutation calls, and UTF-8 payload bytes before tool execution.
description.zh: 为受支持的文件修改设置可配置的逐回合额度，在工具执行前限制不同文件数、修改调用数与 UTF-8 载荷字节数。

description.en: A Kun-Like desktop pet living in the corner of the DSH web UI; switches animations with agent state and plays a voice line on task completion.
description.zh: 住在 DSH Web 界面右下角的坤坤桌宠：随 Agent 状态切换动作，任务完成时播放「你干嘛~哎哟」。

description.en: Session-first DSH sidebar: pinned, active and recent sections, workspace grouping, focus groups, search and a session trash bin.
description.zh: DSH 的会话优先左侧栏：置顶、活跃、最近分区，工作区分组，专注模式，搜索与会话回收站。

description.en: Injects a per-session x-opencode-session header into opencode.ai inference requests, fixing the OpenCode Go gateway 400 MissingSessionID error; server-only, no UI (npm: `dsh-my-opencode-session-header`).
description.zh: 为 opencode.ai 的推理请求注入按会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 头，修复 OpenCode Go 网关 400 MissingSessionID；纯 server 插件，无界面（npm: `dsh-my-opencode-session-header`）。

description.en: Makes the Axolotl Minecraft launcher's built-in MCP server usable from DSH: turns its 269 tools into nine domain tools plus status and raw, answers the launcher's 15-second session ping so the control session survives long turns, and returns screenshots as real images instead of files on disk. Needs Axolotl Launcher 1.11.0-beta.2 or later with its MCP server enabled.
description.zh: 把美西螈启动器（Axolotl Launcher）自带的 MCP 服务器接进 DSH：269 个工具收成 9 个领域工具加 status 和 raw；代持常驻客户端应答启动器的 15 秒心跳，让控制会话撑过长任务；截图直接变成图片，不用落盘再读。需要 Axolotl Launcher 1.11.0-beta.2 或更新版本，并启用其 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Read-only Git graph tab for the DSH right sidebar — colored branch/merge lanes, HEAD / branch / tag / remote badges, commit details with a changed-file tree and per-file diff, virtualized rows that page through large histories — plus a branch chip in the composer that searches local and remote branches and switches with guards against uncommitted changes, detached worktrees and in-progress merges or rebases.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的只读 Git 图谱标签页：彩色分支/合并泳道，HEAD / 分支 / 标签 / 远程徽标，提交详情含变更文件树与单文件 diff，行虚拟化、大量提交也翻页流畅；输入框里还有一枚分支胶囊，可搜索本地与远程分支并切换，切换前会检查未提交改动、已被其他 worktree 检出、进行中的 merge / rebase，会覆盖改动时直接拒绝。

description.en: A Storage settings page for DeepSeek Harness: a donut of what dsh occupies on this machine (install, sessions, attachments, runtimes, plugins, temp), a drill-down that lists archived sessions and can delete them, and a clean action that only touches rebuildable caches. Deleting to the system Recycle Bin and Open folder are Windows-only; scanning works everywhere. Host routes accept loopback connections only and are CSRF-guarded; nothing leaves the machine.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加「存储空间」设置页：环形图展示本机 dsh 占用（程序本体、会话、附件、运行时、插件、临时目录），可按工作区/类型下钻、列出已归档会话并删除，清理只动可再生缓存。系统回收站与打开目录仅 Windows，扫描与统计跨平台可用；宿主路由只接受本机回环连接并有 CSRF 防护，不联网。

description.en: Adds "Delete conversation" (zh/en) to the sidebar conversation menu. Confirming removes the durable session log under <DSH_HOME>/sessions, drops the id from the workspace registry (sessionIds, pin, archive), detaches a live session before its files go away, and emits api-session/removed so every connected client drops the row.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单里加中英双语的「删除会话」。确认后删除 <DSH_HOME>/sessions 下的会话日志、从 Workspace 注册表摘掉该 id（sessionIds、置顶、归档），先 detach 活会话再删文件，并广播 api-session/removed，让所有已连接客户端同步移除该行。

description.en: Asphalt pavement skid resistance: 76 cards over 12 chapters on friction calibers, water film and hydroplaning, texture parameters, tire-road contact and maintenance decisions, each capability carrying its own when-not-to-use bound.
description.zh: 沥青路面抗滑：12 章 76 张卡，覆盖摩擦口径、水膜与滑水、纹理参数、胎路接触与养护决策，每条能力都带「什么时候别用」。

description.en: Adds a "用量" section to the DSH Settings page that shows your MiniMax Token Plan usage (5h and weekly windows with reset countdowns), per-model breakdown, and video bonus credits; fetches `/v1/token_plan/remains` via a trusted plugin that holds the API key, auto-hides when no key is configured. MIT.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页「用量」section 展示 MiniMax Token Plan 的 5 小时 / 周窗口用量（带重置倒计时）、单模型明细与视频赠送额度；通过 trusted plugin 调 `/v1/token_plan/remains` 拿 key，未配置 key 时整段 section 自动隐藏。MIT。

description.en: Look up Chinese companies inside the conversation: name a company and get its business registration, shareholders, executives, outbound investments and registration changes, plus judicial and operating-risk records such as enforcement, dishonest judgment debtor, consumption restriction, abnormal operation, serious illegality and administrative penalties (11 dimension groups). Results render as conversation cards with fields and the raw payload on expand, and the API key is saved from the plugin page into the Harness credential store.
description.zh: 在对话里直接查中国企业：说出公司名就能拿到工商基本信息、股东、高管、对外投资、工商变更，以及被执行、失信、限制高消费、经营异常、严重违法、行政处罚等司法与经营风险（共 11 类维度）；结果以对话卡片呈现，展开可看字段与原始数据，API Key 在插件页保存到 Harness 凭据库。

description.en: Download watermark-free Douyin and Xiaohongshu videos, transcribe them with local or cloud speech recognition, proofread the text against a term list, and export Markdown, DOCX, SRT, VTT and other formats from a settings panel or agent tools. Needs Python 3.10+ with pip packages (playwright, python-docx, numpy, and sherpa-onnx for the default local SenseVoice engine, which also downloads a ~228 MB model on first use), ffmpeg on PATH, and Chrome or Edge.
description.zh: 下载抖音和小红书无水印视频，用本地或云端语音识别转成文字、按术语表校正，并从设置面板或 agent 工具导出 Markdown、DOCX、SRT、VTT 等格式。需自备 Python 3.10+（pip 安装 playwright、python-docx、numpy，默认的本地 SenseVoice 引擎另需 sherpa-onnx 并在首次使用时下载约 228 MB 模型）、PATH 中的 ffmpeg，以及 Chrome 或 Edge。

description.en: Bridges the shared ~/.agentloom store between DeepSeek Harness and Codex: injects the shared memories and the AGENTS.md entries the context budget truncates into the system prompt, and adds six loom_* tools for status, sync, memory search/list/add and skill listing. Requires the agentloom CLI installed and a one-time agentloom init; the seven-tool MCP bridge in the same repo is a separate package for MCP clients.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 与 Codex 接到共享的 ~/.agentloom：将共享记忆与被上下文预算截断的 AGENTS.md 条目注入系统提示，并提供 status、sync、记忆检索/列出/写入与技能列出的六个 loom_* 工具。需先安装 agentloom CLI 并执行一次 agentloom init；同仓库的七工具 MCP 桥是另一个包，供 MCP 客户端使用。

description.en: Bark push notifications to iPhone: turn completion, waiting-for-input, and approval events sent from the DSH Host.
description.zh: Bark 推送通知到 iPhone：回合完成、等待回答、等待授权等事件由 Host 端发送。

description.en: FOFA cyberspace mapping inside the conversation: check the account quota, run FOFA queries and export the full result set into CSV/JSON/TXT files in the session workspace by paging through a time cursor. A CSV or TXT export stopped by its time budget or by an upstream error continues into the same file from the saved cursor, so rows already fetched are kept. Results render as conversation cards (query, match count, file path), and the API key is saved from the plugin page into the Harness credential store.
description.zh: 在对话里做 FOFA 网络空间测绘：查看账号额度、执行查询语句，并把全量结果按时间游标深翻页导出为 CSV／JSON／TXT 落到会话工作区；被时间预算或上游报错中断的 CSV／TXT 导出可凭游标续写同一文件，已拉取的行不丢。结果以对话卡片展示（语句、命中数、文件路径），API Key 在插件页保存到 Harness 凭据库。

description.en: Shows the mode (agent preset) each Session runs under as a colored pill in the left sidebar, with a settings page for per-mode dot colors.
description.zh: 在左侧栏的会话行显示该会话运行的模式（agent preset）胶囊，并可在设置页按模式配置圆点颜色。

description.en: Reads a few lines of a txt or epub novel inside the sidebar bottom panel, styled to pass for scratch notes; pages with Ctrl+Alt+J/K and keeps progress locally. Requires dsh-better-sidebar 0.26+ - the reader exists only as a tab in its bottom panel.
description.zh: 把 txt / epub 小说藏进侧栏底部面板，一屏只显示几行、看着像随手记的草稿；Ctrl+Alt+J/K 翻页，进度存在本地。需要 dsh-better-sidebar 0.26 以上，阅读器只存在于它的底部面板里。

description.en: DSH plugin: a local egress proxy bridge. Hands a credential-free HTTP(S) proxy URL to consumers that reject credentials, and injects the upstream auth on the hop that needs it. Fail-closed by default: if the upstream fails, traffic is refused rather than falling back to a direct connection. Zero build, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 插件：本地出口代理（egress）桥——把只接受无凭据 HTTP(S) 代理地址的消费方，接到需要账号密码的上游代理上，凭据只在需要的那一跳注入；默认失败即断联，绝不降级为直连。零构建、零运行依赖。

description.en: Password-protected LAN gateway for DeepSeek Harness, letting a phone browser on the same Wi-Fi drive the desktop DSH; DSH's own files are untouched, but a small compatibility polyfill is injected into the pages served to the phone. Plain HTTP, trusted LAN only.
description.zh: 带密码的 DSH 局域网网关，手机连同一个 WiFi 就能用浏览器打开电脑上的 DSH；不改 DSH 自身文件，但会向发给手机的页面注入一小段兼容 polyfill。明文 HTTP，仅限可信局域网。

description.en: Adds a Resources tab to the right sidebar with live CPU, RAM, swap and disk usage on Linux, macOS and Windows, plus rankings of the top processes, folders and files; read-only, no dependencies, requires dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏新增“资源”页，在 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 上实时显示 CPU、内存、交换区和磁盘用量，并列出占用最多的进程、文件夹和文件；只读、无依赖，需要 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Start a local mihomo proxy core on demand and shut it down when idle — no always-on port, no leftover process, no change to the Windows system proxy. Routes through an existing proxy when one is already running. Needs a Clash/mihomo config (subscription, imported FlClash config, or pasted in); the first run downloads the ~61 MB mihomo core into the plugin folder.
description.zh: 按需拉起 mihomo 内核，空闲后自动关闭：不常占端口、不留后台进程、不改 Windows 系统代理设置。已有代理在跑时直接借道它的出口。需要自备 Clash/mihomo 配置（订阅、导入 FlClash 配置或手动粘贴）；首次运行会自动下载约 61 MB 的 mihomo 内核到插件目录。

description.en: Token-authenticated REST and SSE bridge with QR pairing, so a phone app can read sessions, send messages and approve tool calls.
description.zh: 带令牌鉴权的 REST 与 SSE 接口，扫码配对后可在手机 App 上看会话、发消息、批准工具调用。

description.en: Developer quick-reference toolbox for DSH: 12 themed categories (195 entries) plus zero-dependency tools — regex tester, JSON formatter, timestamp converter, Base64/URL codec, cron generator and line diff, in a searchable settings panel.
description.zh: 开发者速查工具箱：12 个主题 195 条速查 + 6 个零依赖工具（正则实时测试、JSON 格式化、时间戳转换、Base64/URL 编解码、Cron 生成、行 diff），设置页可搜索查阅。

description.en: Read, create and edit native Figma UI with DSH: screenshot comparison, design references, components and variables, motion, assets and scoped recovery. Local companion by default, with official MCP connections retained. Requires Figma Desktop and the generated companion.
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言读取、创建和编辑 Figma UI，支持参考图比对、设计参考、组件与变量、动效、素材和局部恢复。默认走本地配套插件，保留官方 MCP 接入；需 Figma 桌面版并导入 DSH 生成的配套插件。

description.en: Literal substring search across every conversation in the workspace, from a search box in the conversation header. The built-in index tokenizes with unicode61 and only matches whole tokens; this plugin scans the local session logs directly, so mid-token fragments and two-character Chinese words match too. Searches user and assistant message text (tool output is opt-in), rotates results across sessions so one long conversation cannot fill the list, and opens the matched conversation scrolled to the hit. Read-only over local session logs, no network access.
description.zh: 在对话页顶栏按字面文字搜索工作区内全部历史会话。内置索引按 unicode61 分词、只匹配整词，这个插件直接扫描本地会话日志，因此句中片段与两字中文词也能命中；默认只搜用户与助手正文（工具输出需手动开启），结果按会话轮转，避免单个长会话占满列表，点开后滚动定位并高亮命中。只读本地会话日志，零网络请求。

description.en: Multi-folder workspace: a durable global linked-folders list plus per-session on-the-fly linking (link_folder/unlink_folder), managed from the Web sidebar with a native folder picker.
description.zh: 多文件夹工作区：全局链接文件夹列表 + 会话内临时挂载（link_folder/unlink_folder），侧边栏管理并支持系统选目录。

description.en: Floating community panel for the Web UI: 24h hot topics and hot plugins TOP10 with a draggable, always-on-top button.
description.zh: Web UI 的社区热门悬浮面板：24 小时热门话题与热门插件 TOP10，悬浮按钮可拖动置顶、点击居中展开。

description.en: Right-side message navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness: per-message tick marks, hover-to-expand preview drawer, smooth jump to any historical message, star bookmarks, realtime slide animation with interrupt support, full session index with virtualization, dynamic panel avoidance, official --dsw-* token styling.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧消息导航轨道：逐条消息刻度、悬浮预览抽屉、平滑跳转、星标回看、实时平移动画（可打断）、完整会话索引与虚拟化、面板动态避让、官方 --dsw-* token 样式。

description.en: YiHe pkg-dev knowledge packs for DeepSeek Harness: 52 domain packs and 90 RFB experience files for coding cognition.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 YiHe pkg-dev 知识包：52 个领域包与 90 个 RFB 经验文件，用于编程认知。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks, including context injection: declare event, handler and outcome in YAML, where the handler is an in-harness tool (MCP included), a shell command or an HTTP endpoint, and the outcome is model-visible context, a denied tool call, or fire-and-forget.
description.zh: 以配置驱动的生命周期钩子，并支持上下文注入：在 YAML 中声明事件、处理器与结果——处理器可以是进程内工具（含 MCP）、shell 命令或 HTTP 端点，结果可以是模型可见的上下文、拒绝该次工具调用，或触发即忘。

description.en: Exits the dsh CLI process automatically when the Web UI closes, with a configurable grace period and dry-run mode.
description.zh: 关闭 DSH Web UI 后自动退出 CLI 进程（等效 Ctrl+C），支持可配置宽限期与试运行模式。

description.en: Two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second click archives; the archive entry is removed from the ⋮ menu.
description.zh: 工作区侧边栏行内两击归档：点一次变红确认，再点即归档，归档项不再出现在 ⋮ 菜单里。

description.en: PromptPolish is an icon-only prompt optimizer beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector: it rewrites the current draft with the active session model and DSH quota, with no API key, no auto-send, and draft-change protection.
description.zh: PromptPolish 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器左侧提供图标式提示词优化：用当前会话模型与 DSH 额度重写草稿，无需 API Key、不自动发送，并带草稿变化保护。

description.en: Multi-role parallel argumentation for DeepSeek Harness: runs the real Codex and Claude CLIs in parallel, has the DSH model (Judge) write a third-party verdict back into the conversation, plus Obsidian-style single-agent direct chat and per-role model config.
description.zh: 多角色并行论证：并行调用真实 Codex 与 Claude，由 DSH 主会话模型（Judge）生成第三方汇总并回对话；另含单 Agent 直接对话与各角色模型自由配置。

description.en: Cost pill at the right end of the composer stats row, showing the estimated cost of the current turn and the session total; clicking it opens a two-column panel with input, cache and output spend for the turn and the session, dialogue turns, today's and lifetime spend, and this session's cache-hit rate and cache saving. Rates follow the official DeepSeek price table including peak pricing (double on weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time, statutory holidays excluded), each message is priced at the time it settled, and prices.json reloads without a restart.
description.zh: 位于输入框统计行右端的成本胶囊，显示估算的本轮费用与会话总费用；点开后是双栏面板，列出本轮与本会话的输入、缓存、输出支出，对话轮数，今日与总计支出，以及本会话缓存命中率和缓存节省。价格取自 DeepSeek 官方价目表并含峰时计价（北京时间工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 加倍，法定节假日除外），每条消息按结算时刻取价，prices.json 改动后无需重启即可生效。

description.en: Display-layer text replacement for DSH chat messages: rewrite how any configured text appears on screen without touching the real conversation, with per-rule whole-word matching and code-block protection.
description.zh: 显示层文本替换：自定义消息中任意文本的界面显示而不改动真实对话，支持逐条整词匹配、长词优先与代码块保护。

description.en: Registers the hosted SpecStream MCP server with the harness MCP manager and keeps the API key in the credential store. The server returns live web data as structured rows, each value with its source URL, and a run starts only after the quote's maximum is approved.
description.zh: 把托管的 SpecStream MCP 服务器注册到 harness 的 MCP 管理器，并把 API Key 存入凭据库。该服务器以结构化行返回实时网页数据，每个值都附来源 URL；只有报价上限获批后才会开始运行。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file upload into the conversation composer, token usage pill with quota tracking, and session archive management — a three-in-one daily-driver addon.
description.zh: 会话输入区拖拽上传文件、Token 用量胶囊与额度跟踪、会话归档管理，三合一日常插件。

description.en: Collapses consecutive tool-use and thinking steps between messages into a single bracketed, expandable item.
description.zh: 把消息之间连续的工具调用与思考步骤折叠成单个可展开的括号条目。

description.en: Guides RTL design and verification in DeepSeek Harness, with project scaffolding, evidence checks, and OpenROAD/ORFS setup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 RTL 设计与验证指导、工程脚手架、证据核对和 OpenROAD/ORFS 环境准备。

description.en: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry, and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back), via a single Python script (pypdf + Pillow + numpy).
description.zh: 注册 remove-pdf-background-gray 技能：去除扫描 PDF 的灰色/米白底色，保持分辨率、页面几何与抗锯齿文字边缘（无损 Flate 写回），核心为单文件 Python 脚本（pypdf + Pillow + numpy）。

description.en: Self-contained DSH profile plugin that bridges the cua-driver 0.46.1 Windows kit into DSH as about 63 cua_* background desktop and browser automation tools (UIA observation, PostMessage input without focus stealing, CDP browser control, agent-cursor overlay, recording and diagnostics), with a bundled /cua-driver skill. Windows x64 only; bundles the prebuilt cua-driver.exe and starts it with --grant existing-profile, so the tools can attach to your already-running Edge or Chrome profile and act in its logged-in sessions.
description.zh: 自包含的 DSH profile 插件：把 cua-driver 0.46.1（Windows x86_64）驱动套件桥接进 DSH，提供约 63 个 cua_* 后台桌面与浏览器自动化工具（UIA 观察、不抢焦点的 PostMessage 输入、CDP 浏览器控制、代理光标叠加层、录制与诊断），并内置 /cua-driver skill。仅限 Windows x64；随包带预编译的 cua-driver.exe，并以 --grant existing-profile 启动它，所以这些工具可以接入你正在运行的 Edge 或 Chrome 配置并在其已登录的会话里操作。

description.en: An Orchestrate tab in dsh-better-sidebar and 14 orch_* tools to spawn, prompt, fork and cancel agent chats, run command, scrape, http and agent tasks on local, ssh or remote runners, show provider status cards, and serve a secret-protected machine API. Requires DSH >= 0.1.1-rc.1, Node >= 22.5, the web profile and dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 在 dsh-better-sidebar 中提供 Orchestrate 标签页，并有 14 个 orch_* 工具：创建、提示、分叉和取消 agent 会话，在本机、ssh 或远程 runner 上执行 command、scrape、http、agent 四类任务，展示各 provider 状态卡片，并提供受密钥保护的机器 API。需 DSH >= 0.1.1-rc.1、Node >= 22.5、web profile 与 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Literature review stage — search, synthesis, and citation-chain tracking for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 文献综述阶段——资产定价与机器学习研究的文献检索、合成与引用链追踪。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Preventive content policy for tool results: rewrites matched text, and drops or truncates whole fields by path before a result is normalised, rendered or persisted, so an unreviewed payload never enters it. Ships inert with no built-in category or domain blocklist.
description.zh: 工具结果的预防式内容策略：改写命中文本，并按字段路径整段丢弃或截断，让未经审查的载荷在结果被规范化/渲染/落盘之前就进不去。随包为真空操作，不含任何内置的类别或域名黑名单。

description.en: Infinite canvas for sessions, with regions bound to workspaces and agent presets, pinned session cards, sticky notes and alignment guides.
description.zh: 无限会话画布，区域绑定工作区与智能体预设，可钉住会话卡片、放置便签，带对齐参考线。

description.en: Feeds every dsh prompt into the local agent-feedback-loop feedback-memory pipeline — captures dissatisfaction, reviews it offline into reflections, and attaches the compiled recurrence-rule context back to the turn, never blocking a prompt. Lessons are compiled into a layered rules block (an index that names every family on every turn, plus on-demand instructions), same-class reflections are merged so one lesson is not re-read as many, and each index fact decays through current → possibly-stale → dormant instead of being trusted forever. Requires the agent-feedback-loop runtime; running agent-feedback-loop install afterwards wires existing dsh profiles automatically. On every prompt it runs ~/.agent/feedback-loop/hooks/core-hook.sh with the prompt on stdin.
description.zh: 把 dsh 的每一轮 prompt 送入本地 agent-feedback-loop 反馈记忆管线——捕获用户不满、离线评审沉淀为反思，并把编译好的复发规则上下文附着回当前轮次，从不阻塞 prompt。教训被编译成分层规则区块（每轮点名全部家族、按需展开指令），同类反思会合并，避免同一课教训被当作多份重复读取；索引事实按「现行 → 可能已过期 → 休眠」降级，而不是被永久信任。需要先安装 agent-feedback-loop 运行时；安装后执行 agent-feedback-loop install 会自动接线已有的 dsh profile。每条 prompt 都会运行 ~/.agent/feedback-loop/hooks/core-hook.sh，并把 prompt 写入它的标准输入。

description.en: Chat memory that archives messages by time and recalls by stated period, widening twice before admitting it forgot.
description.zh: 按时间归档聊天，用户提到某段时间就先检索，未命中扩大两次，仍没有就如实说「我忘记了」。

description.en: Fills in a cheaper sibling route for subagent calls that name no provider, model or effort (for example Opus to Sonnet 5.5 at medium, Qwen max to Qwen flash); explicit choices and subagent_fork are left alone. Requires the subagent-model-selection policy to be enabled with the target route in its allowedModels - without it the plugin does nothing.
description.zh: 为未指定 provider/model/effort 的 subagent 调用补上更便宜的同类路由（例如 Opus → Sonnet 5.5 @ medium、Qwen max → Qwen flash）；显式指定的选择与 subagent_fork 保持不动。需在设置里启用 subagent-model-selection 且目标路由在其 allowedModels 中，否则插件不产生任何效果。

description.en: Runs the model's bash commands in a local shell chosen in Settings (Niubash, Git Bash, MSYS2, Cygwin, or any bash.exe on PATH) instead of rewriting them for PowerShell, and hides the pwsh tool on Windows.
description.zh: 让 bash 工具在本机设置里选定的 shell（Niubash、Git Bash、MSYS2、Cygwin 或 PATH 上的 bash.exe）中执行命令，不再改写为 PowerShell，并在 Windows 下隐藏 pwsh 工具。

description.en: Local-first music player and playlist manager for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的本地音乐播放器与歌单管理插件。

description.en: Normalizes an omitted or undefined first argument to {} for TypeScript PTC run_code calls, so no-argument tools such as tools.job_list() stop failing with "binding arguments must be lossless JSON".
description.zh: 把 PTC run_code（TypeScript function-body）中省略或为 undefined 的工具首参归一化为 {}，tools.job_list() 这类无参调用不再报 binding arguments must be lossless JSON。

description.en: Report stage — academic paper writing for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 报告阶段（文稿）——资产定价与机器学习研究的学术论文写作。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Per-profile settings overlay for DeepSeek Harness: global settings.yaml stays the baseline while each profile overrides any namespace through its own profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml — object sections merge recursively, scalars and arrays replace wholesale, and !unset masks an inherited value. The overlay is transparent to existing plugins (they keep reading ctx.settings unchanged), writes land in the profile overlay only, and official schema validation, revision semantics, expectedRevision conflicts, watchers and events are untouched. Ships a settings command family (get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers) plus a Profile Settings section in the web Settings panel over a loopback RPC channel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按 profile 分层的设置覆盖：全局 settings.yaml 仍为基线，每个 profile 可用自己的 profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml 覆盖任意设置命名空间——对象段递归合并，数组与标量整体替换，!unset 显式屏蔽继承值。覆盖层对现有插件透明（照常读 ctx.settings），写入只落在 profile 覆盖层；官方 schema 语义、revision、expectedRevision 冲突检测、watcher 与事件均不改动。附带 settings 命令族（get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers），并在 Web 设置面板经 loopback RPC 通道提供 Profile Settings 区块。

description.en: Automatically split long DSH conversations into volumes (every 10 user messages by default), with todo handoff snapshots, source navigation, read-only archives and host compatibility checks.
description.zh: 长会话默认每 10 条用户消息自动分卷，支持待办快照续接、来源回溯、归档只读与宿主兼容检查。

description.en: Road building materials as a caliber manual: 60 cards over 12 chapters on aggregates, asphalt and the PG system, mix volumetrics, cement, concrete, stabilized mixtures, steel, polymers and 35 test procedures.
description.zh: 道路建筑材料口径手册：12 章 60 张卡，覆盖集料、沥青与 PG 体系、混合料体积参数、水泥、混凝土、无机结合料、钢材、聚合物与 35 个试验方法。

description.en: Adds a Delete conversation action to the conversation menu that permanently removes the session log, projection cache, and sidebar entry; refuses while a turn, subagent, job, or reminder is running.
description.zh: 在对话的 ⋯ 菜单里永久删除对话，清理会话日志、投影缓存与侧栏条目；有回合、子代理、后台任务或定时提醒在跑时会拒绝。

description.en: Model training stage — end-to-end analysis, model training, and estimation for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 模型训练与结论阶段——资产定价与机器学习研究的端到端分析、模型训练与估计。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Draggable floating restart button for the dsh Web GUI (Windows only, dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.1): confirm, then the app and its host close and come back on their own, with a cancel button, a watchdog and a clear failure message. Icon, background colour and position lock are edited in Settings.
description.zh: 给 dsh Web GUI 的悬浮重启按钮（仅 Windows，需 dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.1）：拖动改位置、点击确认后一键重启应用与 Host，可中途取消、超时会自动收手并说明原因；图标（4 个自带矢量图或上传图片）、底色、位置锁定都在设置里改。

description.en: DSH plugin (dsh-desktop-launcher) that launches the dsh-desktop Windows Electron shell from the conversation: double-click to run the DSH web in a standalone window, region screenshot with GPU-accelerated selection that auto-pastes into the chat (works with vision bridges), system tray, session manager, auto environment setup, configurable port, single-instance lock.
description.zh: dsh 插件（dsh-desktop-launcher）：在对话中一键启动 dsh-desktop Windows Electron 桌面壳——双击即用、无需终端；支持选区截图提问（GPU 实时框选、自动粘贴到聊天框、配合识图插件 AI 直接看图回答）、系统托盘、会话管理、环境自动引导、可换端口、单实例锁。

description.en: Right-click menu for the DSH workspace file tree: open a file, expand or collapse a folder, copy the absolute path, relative path or name, and reveal the item in the file manager.
description.zh: DSH 工作区文件树的右键菜单：打开文件、展开或折叠文件夹、复制绝对路径/相对路径/文件名，并在资源管理器中定位。

description.en: A local-first todo board for the DSH sidebar with Todo/Doing/Done columns organised by project, storing everything in one Markdown file inside a folder you pick on first run. Cards carry due dates down to the minute, a colour stripe, a private blur that hides the title until you reveal it, notes and per-project roles, and can be dragged between columns or onto another project. The agent also gets a kanban tool that reads and edits every card, masked ones included. On macOS it installs three launchd jobs that run /usr/bin/python3 and post system notifications (a 09:00 digest, a check every 30 minutes for cards due within 2 hours, a Monday weekly review), which you can retime or disable in the in-panel Automations tab.
description.zh: 本地优先的待办看板：左侧导航里的 Todo/Doing/Done 三列，按项目组织，所有数据都在你首次使用时自己选的文件夹里的一个 Markdown 文件中。卡片支持精确到分钟的截止时间、颜色标记、私密打码（默认遮罩，点击才显示）、备注与项目角色，可在列与项目之间拖拽；agent 另有 kanban 工具，可读写全部卡片（含已打码的）。macOS 上会安装三个 launchd 定时任务，由 /usr/bin/python3 运行并发系统通知（每天 09:00 摘要、每 30 分钟检查 2 小时内到期的卡片、每周一回顾），可在面板「自动化」标签里改时间或停用。

description.en: Adds a left-sidebar panel to the DSH Web GUI: one ranked board of the films and series released in the past 21 days or due within the next 31 days, taken from JustWatch for the US, five European countries, Japan and Korea and from Douban for China. Each row carries a poster (or a drawn placeholder when the poster CDN will not load), a synopsis of five sentences or fewer, Douban and Rotten Tomatoes ratings and popular Douban comments. A search box filters the board as you type and asks Douban, TVMaze and the iTunes storefront about a title, merging the three into one record and listing the matches already on the board separately. Synopses, comments and titles are translated through the host translator service, so the Chinese/English switch re-renders the board. No API key and no account.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页版的左侧栏加一块影视雷达：把近 21 天内上映与未来 31 天内定档的电影和剧集排成一张加权榜单，美国、欧洲五国、日本和韩国取自 JustWatch，中国取自豆瓣。每行带海报（图床不可达时用绘制的占位图）、五句以内简介、豆瓣与烂番茄评分和豆瓣热门短评。搜索框输入即筛，并向豆瓣、TVMaze 与 iTunes 查询片名，三路结果合并为一条，榜单内命中单独成组。简介、短评与缺失片名经宿主翻译服务转成面板语言，中英文切换后整块重绘。不需要 API Key，也不需要账号。

description.en: External one-shot subagent provider using the local CodeBuddy CLI over ACP, with background result delivery and steering of running children.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 调用本机 CodeBuddy CLI 的外部一次性子智能体提供者，支持后台结果回传及向运行中的子智能体追加指令。

description.en: A cost bar for DSH relay users: current-session and today totals under the composer (today includes already-closed sessions), a peak/off-peak dot, and no call to the official balance API. Click for a per-model breakdown; narrow windows keep the money line first. Derived from KIDLi1412/dsh-session-cost (MIT); it uses the same plugin id and /api/session-cost/summary route, so do not install it alongside the original.
description.zh: 给走中转站的 DSH 用户做的费用条：输入框下方常驻本次与今日花费（今日累计含已关闭的会话），峰谷时段一眼可辨，不查官方余额接口。点开看分模型明细，窄窗口优先保留费用读数。改自 KIDLi1412/dsh-session-cost（MIT），与原版使用相同的插件 id 和 /api/session-cost/summary 路由，不能与原版同装。

description.en: Twelve curated palettes, eight accent colours, a contrast slider and font/scale overrides for the DSH web UI, with an inlined first-paint script that prevents theme flash.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 12 套精选配色、8 种强调色、对比度滑块与字体/缩放覆盖，并内联首帧脚本防止主题闪烁。

description.en: After user setup, guides native subagents toward model preferences by task type, using native model-selection permissions with no extra routing-model calls.
description.zh: 配置模型偏好后，引导原生子 agent 按任务类型选择模型；沿用原生授权，不额外调用路由模型。

description.en: Role-based plugin recommender for DSH: asks the user's role (developer, designer, writer, researcher, ops, student...), recommends suitable plugins, and audits each with a local static security scan (dangerous code patterns + 0-100 risk score) and a reputation check (npm downloads / GitHub stars).
description.zh: 按职业/角色推荐 DSH 插件：询问用户是做什么的（程序员、设计师、写作、研究、运维、学生…），推荐适合的插件，并对每个插件做本地静态安全审计（危险代码模式 + 0-100 风险分）与口碑检查（npm 下载量 / GitHub 星数）。

description.en: Pins each message's action row — copy/like/dislike/branch controls, timestamp, and third-party additions — so it stays visible without hovering.
description.zh: 让每条消息的操作栏（复制、点赞、点踩、分支按钮，时间，以及其他插件添加的内容）无需悬停即可常显。

description.en: Local coding-activity timing per project with wall-clock interval unions, AI added/deleted lines from real diff metadata, per-file time shares, a settings dashboard and CSV export.
description.zh: 本地编码活动计时：按项目统计墙钟活跃区间并集、基于真实 diff 元数据的 AI 增删行、按文件时长占比、设置页仪表盘与 CSV 导出。

description.en: A floating sticky-note pad for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with a note directory, text editing, pasted images and local persistence.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的悬浮便签本，支持便签目录、文本编辑、粘贴图片和本地持久化。

description.en: Turns a session into a folder in the left sidebar: fork it into an independent branch — full copy, a compressed digest of its memory, or only the opening request — and browse the branches as a tree.
description.zh: 把会话变成左侧栏里的文件夹：可分叉出独立分支（完整复制 / 压缩记忆 / 只继承开头），并以树状浏览。

description.en: Push notifications for DeepSeek Harness: the reply text itself plus approval and question prompts, delivered in parallel to Bark and optional Gotify, ntfy, PushDeer, ServerChan, PushPlus, extra Bark servers or a custom webhook, with per-workspace and per-session mute.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的推送通知：直接推送回复正文，以及授权与提问提醒；Bark 之外可并行投递到 Gotify、ntfy、PushDeer、Server酱、PushPlus、额外 Bark 服务器或自定义 Webhook，并支持工作区级与会话级静音。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style message navigation rail for quickly locating earlier prompts in long DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 Codex 风格的消息导航轨道，方便在长会话中快速定位历史提问。

description.en: OpenDesign (AMR) quota readout: the Design Plan 5-hour and 7-day windows, wallet balance and days-to-exhaust in a composer pill, read over a local controlKey or a browser session. The local source reads the controlKey from ~/.amr/config.json; the browser source opens a temporary Chrome window, and after you log in collects the session cookie over CDP into DSH's credential store.
description.zh: OpenDesign（AMR）额度读数：输入框旁显示 Design Plan 的 5 小时与 7 天窗口、钱包余额与外推天数，走本机 controlKey 或浏览器会话两条通道。本机来源会读取 ~/.amr/config.json 里的 controlKey；浏览器来源会打开一个临时 Chrome 窗口，你登录后通过 CDP 收集会话 cookie 存进 DSH 的凭据库。

description.en: Obsidian-compatible Markdown notes in the DSH sidebar with search, tags, backlinks, graph, audio notes with transcription, a paint canvas, OCR (needs tesseract), client-side encryption and notes_* agent tools; the release tarball and the npm package carry a prebuilt Linux x64 daemon, other platforms build it from source with Go.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的 Obsidian 兼容 Markdown 笔记：搜索、标签、反向链接、图谱、带转写的语音笔记、画布、OCR（需 tesseract）、客户端加密与 notes_* agent 工具；release tarball 与 npm 包自带预构建的 Linux x64 daemon，其他平台需用 Go 从源码构建。

description.en: Starts the published local BeatDesign 0.2.5 workspace and connects 30 MCP tools for projects, Canvas, Assets and Timeline, with a shared-project Skill and remote-generation approval guidance. Requires Node.js 22.12+ and a free port 3020; frame extraction and timeline rendering also need ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH (browser export does not).
description.zh: 启动已发布的本地 BeatDesign 0.2.5 工作台，接入项目、画布、素材和时间线的 30 个 MCP 工具，附带共享项目与远程生成确认流程。需 Node.js 22.12+ 且 3020 端口空闲；抽帧与时间线渲染另需 PATH 上的 ffmpeg/ffprobe（浏览器导出不需要）。

description.en: Watches the official DeepSeek models for changes: every cycle it reads the model catalog and sends one minimal completion per watched model, then compares the system fingerprint, the served model name, the response envelope shape, the catalog metadata and the token count of a fixed prompt. When something moves, it pops a random meme with a table of exactly what changed and plays a blast. Needs a DeepSeek API key (kept in the credential store); by default it runs every 60 minutes and spends tokens on each watched model.
description.zh: 盯着官方 DeepSeek 模型有没有变：每轮读取模型目录，并对每个受关注的模型发一次最小补全请求，比对系统指纹、返回的模型名、响应信封结构、目录元数据和固定输入的 token 数。任一项变化就弹一张随机表情包，列出具体改了什么，并放一声轰鸣。需要 DeepSeek API key（存入凭据库）；默认每 60 分钟运行一次，对每个受关注的模型消耗 token。

description.en: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked against the non-routable ranges, with a streamed size cap and a content-type allowlist.
description.zh: ctx.web 接口的本地受控抓取提供方——dsh 自带完整的 web_fetch 工具，却没有随附后端。每一跳重定向都会重新解析并对照非公网地址段校验，另有流式大小上限与内容类型白名单。

description.en: Windows-only derivative of the official ego lite DSH plugin (@ego-lite/dsh-plugin, citrolabs/ego-lite) that cannot be installed alongside it: connects DeepSeek Harness to the installed Windows ego lite app through authenticated loopback HTTP for task spaces, navigation, page reading, clicks, form input and screenshots.
description.zh: ego lite 官方 DSH 插件（@ego-lite/dsh-plugin，citrolabs/ego-lite）的 Windows 衍生版，不能与官方插件同装：通过带认证的本机 HTTP 连接已安装的 Windows ego lite，提供任务空间、导航、页面读取、点击、表单输入和截图。

description.en: Task kanban where agents claim and hand off work through taskboard_* tools, which cannot move a task to done or canceled — acceptance stays with a human.
description.zh: 任务看板，agent 通过 taskboard_* 工具领活与交接；这些工具无法把任务移到 done 或 canceled，验收由人来做。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI themed as an XRY/B1 medical HUD: ECG heartbeat waveform and a rotating radar scan disc on the right bar, power-gen energy-cell meters on the left bar, a DATA TIMELINE scan-log table on the bottom, all in a cyan-on-near-black CRT skin around the original UI.
description.zh: 以 XRY/B1 医疗 HUD 为主题色的 eDEX-UI 风格 DSH 外壳：右侧 ECG 心电波形与旋转雷达扫描盘、左侧能量条仪表、底部 DATA TIMELINE 扫描日志表，青蓝近黑 CRT 皮肤包裹原始界面。

description.en: Layered global and workspace memory for DeepSeek Harness, with a web panel to browse entries and tune distillation and consolidation, an index kept in context with records loaded on demand, and a per-session choice of layer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层的全局与工作区记忆：Web 面板中查看、控制条目并调整记忆整理与整合设置；索引常驻上下文、详情按需加载，每个对话手动选择要加载的记忆层。

description.en: Open folders on remote hosts over SSH as Harness workspaces: file tools (read/write/edit/grep/glob) and shell commands run directly on the remote host over SFTP, ripgrep, and ssh2 exec, with no local mirroring, an encrypted multi-host registry, and the local sandbox policy still enforced.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 把远程主机目录作为 Harness 工作区打开：read/write/edit/grep/glob 与 shell 命令经 SFTP、ripgrep、ssh2 exec 直接在远程主机执行，不做本地镜像；多主机注册表加密存储，本地沙箱策略依然生效。

description.en: Model-linked characters and a shared world for DSH, with separate editable personas and memories, optional AI diaries and sleep consolidation, Chinese/English controls, task-aware desktop pets, themes and usage statistics; updates preserve user customizations. Supports Windows, Linux and macOS; see the guide for each system's installation requirements. Diaries and consolidation consume tokens. Before installing or updating, we recommend closing visible desktop pets and bubbles; open files may cause installation to fail. Codex and OpenAI API account queries have been user-validated; other sources await user validation and feedback.
description.zh: DSH 模型联动角色与共享世界，支持独立可编辑人设和记忆、可选 AI 日记与睡眠整理、中英文界面、任务联动桌宠、主题和用量统计，更新保留用户自定义。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，各系统安装要求见使用说明。日记和整理消耗 Token。安装或更新前，建议先关闭桌面上已显示的桌宠和提示气泡；未关闭时，文件占用有可能导致安装失败。Codex 与 OpenAI API 已获用户验证；其他来源待用户验证反馈。

description.en: Conversation timeline dock bar for DeepSeek Harness: a turn-level timeline above the composer with user-prompt hover tooltips and click-to-jump back to the exact chat position.
description.zh: 对话时间线横条：输入框上方按轮次聚合的时间线，悬停显示该轮用户提示词，点击直接跳转到对话中的对应位置。

description.en: Ultra-lean coding preset for DSH that eliminates orchestration overhead and pre-action chatter for surgical edits and fast tool execution.
description.zh: 专为日常编码打造的极简预设插件：消除编排开销与前置报幕废话，专注外科手术式精准修改与高效工具执行。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH where an LLM decides what to keep: turns pool while the session is idle, then the main chat model distills them into one-line entries in a single batched call; vector dedup runs before insert, so near-duplicates and saturated topics are dropped; recall uses hybrid vector plus FTS5 search over tiered hot, warm and cold storage; ships remember, recall, forget and prune tools. Zero dependencies, Node only.
description.zh: DSH 长期记忆插件，由 LLM 裁决什么值得记：会话空闲后把攒下的轮次一次性交给主对话模型提炼成一句话条目；入库前先做向量判重，近重复与同话题超量的条目不再进库；检索走向量 + FTS5 混合召回，热/温/冷分层存储；附记/回忆/忘/清理四个显式工具。零依赖，纯 Node。

description.en: Runs macOS caffeinate with -w bound to the DSH host process id, so the sleep-prevention process exits when the host exits, and exposes /keepawake to report status and switch sleep-prevention modes. macOS only and on by default: from startup it keeps the Mac from idle sleep (and from system sleep on AC power) until DSH exits, while the display may still sleep; /keepawake running or off narrows it.
description.zh: 以 -w 把 macOS caffeinate 绑定到 DSH 宿主进程 pid，宿主退出即随之退出；并提供 /keepawake 指令查看状态与切换防休眠模式。仅限 macOS，默认开启：DSH 启动后就阻止 Mac 空闲休眠（接交流电时也阻止整机休眠），直到 DSH 退出，屏幕仍可息屏；用 /keepawake running 或 off 可收窄。

description.en: Pick elements on a real Chrome, Edge or ego lite page inside DeepSeek Harness, comment and screenshot them, then insert the annotation as a chat reference chip — the agent receives the CSS selector, page position, comment and screenshot, and edits the front end you are looking at. It launches Chrome or Edge with its own profile and a random local debugging port and injects an overlay into the pages; for ego lite it attaches to the instance you already have open unless DSH_VISUAL_ANNOTATOR_ADOPT_RUNNING=0.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里拾取真实 Chrome / Edge / ego lite 页面上的元素，写评论、截元素图，再把标注插入对话输入框——agent 拿到 CSS 选择器、页面位置、评论与截图，照着你眼前的界面改前端。它用自己的用户目录和随机本地调试端口启动 Chrome 或 Edge，并在页面里注入一个悬浮层；选 ego lite 时会接入你已经开着的那个实例（把 DSH_VISUAL_ANNOTATOR_ADOPT_RUNNING 设为 0 可关闭）。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file attachments as Codex-style cards, with in-app PDF/text/video/audio previews and system-default opening for other formats.
description.zh: 拖拽文件以 Codex 风格附件卡片呈现，支持 PDF/文本/音视频应用内预览，其余格式调用系统默认应用打开。

description.en: Dual-model auto-routing plugin: low-cost direct / high-cost upgrade with an escape-learning closed loop (wrong direct answers auto-learn fingerprints, force-upgrading the same fingerprint next time), persisted and interoperable with the Python ModelRouter.
description.zh: 双模型 Auto 路由插件：低成本模型直返 / 高成本模型升级 + 逃逸学习闭环（直返答错自动学习指纹，同指纹下次强制升级），状态持久化并与 Python ModelRouter 互通。

description.en: Reviews each finished turn, distills reusable skills as drafts, runs code-level checks over them, and holds each draft until the user approves or rejects it with a directive; every write is recorded in a SHA-256 ledger that supports rolling back a single entry. On by default, it reviews finished turns with the current session model (or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint set through DSH_EVOLUTION_BASE_URL), sending a bounded excerpt of the conversation, and writes drafts to ~/.dsh/skills/.staging until you promote them. Its bundle patch lowers DSH's skill-catalog description limit from 500 to 80 characters for every skill, and it starts an unauthenticated HTTP server on 0.0.0.0:18890 (DSH_EVOLUTION_PORT) that can list and promote drafts, change settings and trigger reviews.
description.zh: 回合结束后复盘会话，把经验蒸馏成技能草稿，经代码级检查后等你批示采纳或驳回；每次落盘都记入 SHA-256 账本，支持按单条回滚。默认开启，回合结束后用当前会话模型（或 DSH_EVOLUTION_BASE_URL 指定的 OpenAI 兼容接口）复盘一段有上限的会话摘录，草稿写在 ~/.dsh/skills/.staging，等你采纳才进正式技能库。随包补丁会把 DSH 全局技能目录的描述上限从 500 收紧到 80 字符（影响所有技能）；另外它在 0.0.0.0:18890（可用 DSH_EVOLUTION_PORT 改）启动一个没有鉴权的 HTTP 服务，可列出和采纳草稿、改设置、触发复盘。

description.en: A Google Docs-style word processor inside DeepSeek Harness with rich text, page setup, tables, images, print, export, and agent editing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的 Google Docs 风格文字处理器：富文本、页面设置、表格、图片、打印、导出，并支持由 agent 直接编辑。

description.en: Data stage — data discovery and quality assessment for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 数据处理阶段——资产定价与机器学习研究的数据发现与质量评估。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent spawn, where a fan-out past the cap waits in a FIFO queue instead of failing.
description.zh: 按提供方/模型限制并发生成，并附带设置卡片：限定同时进行流式生成的会话数，在流式调用与子代理派生两处强制执行；超出上限的扇出会进入 FIFO 队列等待，而不是直接失败。

description.en: Data packaging plugin for product manual generation and compliance attachments.
description.zh: 数据封装插件 — 产品说明书生成+合规附件

description.en: Session tabs for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI whose open-session set is shared across every device attached to the same host, with workspace grouping, status dots, and a bottom bar that collapses into a drawer on narrow screens.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的会话标签栏：同一宿主下的所有设备共享一份「打开过的会话」集合，带 workspace 分组、状态点，窄屏时横条贴底并收进抽屉。

description.en: Fold the sidebar plugin-panel list to three entries, drag them to reorder, and keep every other panel one click away in a More menu — order and pins persist in localStorage.
description.zh: 侧栏插件面板入口压缩：默认只留三个，按住鼠标拖动排序，其余全部收进「更多」菜单（点名字直接打开，✓/＋ 决定去留），选择和顺序记在 localStorage。

description.en: Drives a plugin page in the running DeepSeek Harness UI — opens the panel, reads real DOM and computed styles, clicks, types, waits for async effects, collects console errors, then returns to the original conversation.
description.zh: 在运行中的 DeepSeek Harness 界面里驱动插件页面做验收：打开面板、读取真实 DOM 与计算样式、点击、输入、等待异步生效、抓取控制台报错，结束后自动回到原对话。

description.en: View XMind, FreeMind, OPML, KityMinder and VYM mind maps in the sidebar, edit and save all of them except read-only XMind (convert it to .mm first), export to .mm, and read or edit outlines through agent tools.
description.zh: 在侧栏查看 XMind、FreeMind、OPML、KityMinder 和 VYM 思维导图，除只读的 XMind（需先转成 .mm）外均可编辑保存，并可导出为 .mm，另提供供 agent 读写大纲的工具。

description.en: Sidebar calendar board for tracking a nanny or caregiver: onboarding and offboarding dates, leave days and salary payouts, with per-month and all-time totals and automatic payday markers on a 30-day cycle.
description.zh: 育儿嫂日历看板：记录上户、下户、休假与工资发放，按月汇总，并统计从首次上户到今天的累计在岗与休假天数，同时按 30 天周期在日历上自动标出发薪日。

description.en: Keyword-rule scan of a project directory for tax-industry compliance gaps ahead of regulatory audits: accounting voucher and ledger retention set under 30 years, invoice-title lines with no taxpayer ID, tax data leaving China with no security assessment or standard contract mentioned, and e-invoice lines with no verification or de-duplication mentioned, with rule sources kept in rules/.
description.zh: 稽查前对项目目录做财税行业专项体检（关键词规则扫描）：会计凭证与账簿保存期配置低于 30 年、开票信息缺纳税人识别号、税务数据出境未提及安全评估或标准合同、电子发票未提及验真或查重，规则出处保留在 rules/。

description.en: Drags a session in the sidebar onto another project group to change the project it belongs to. It rewrites the workspace membership ledger and projects the read side (file tree, open folder, working directory) onto the new project, while the session's JSONL log, header and attachments stay in the original project directory, so the change is reversible and never touches the archive.
description.zh: 把侧栏里的对话拖到另一个项目分组上，即可修改这段对话的所属项目：插件改 workspace 归属账本，并把读取侧（文件树、打开文件夹、工作目录）投影到新项目；会话的 JSONL 日志、header 与附件仍留在原项目目录，因此改动可逆、不碰档案。

description.en: Manage a domain portfolio in DeepSeek Harness: sync registrations from Namecheap and Cloudflare, track expiry dates, auto-renewal and yearly renewal costs, and check domain availability. Read-only towards registrars (never registers, transfers or renews). Syncing needs a Cloudflare API token, or a Namecheap API key with an allow-listed IP (or Namecheap's browser-login connector, which cannot read renewal prices).
description.zh: 管理域名组合：从 Namecheap 与 Cloudflare 同步注册信息，跟踪到期日、自动续费与年度续费成本，并检查域名可用性。对注册商只读（不注册、不转移、不续费）。同步需要 Cloudflare API 令牌，或带 IP 白名单的 Namecheap API 密钥（也可用 Namecheap 的浏览器登录连接器，但读不到续费价格）。

description.en: Model-agnostic visual-inspection pipeline for text-only agents: page-by-page HTML screenshots plus a ready-made vision-subagent briefing contract (gewu_prep), then source-code truth verification of every finding (gewu_locate); validated on mimo-v2.5 & qwen3.7-plus.
description.zh: 面向纯文本 DSH 主脑的模型无关视觉审阅流水线：HTML 逐页截图 + 视觉子代理简报契约（gewu_prep），再把每条审阅发现定位回源码核验真值（gewu_locate）；已在 mimo-v2.5 与 qwen3.7-plus 上实测。

description.en: Windows-only tray monitor for DeepSeek Harness: deploys and manages the standalone DshTaskWatcher tray app - four-state tray icon (gray=disconnected, green=idle, amber=running, red=attention), a per-task panel with live duration/tps/tokens, and completion & outcome notifications. Start/stop switch in Settings > Plugins; the watcher is an independent process that survives DSH restarts.
description.zh: Windows 托盘任务监视器：部署并管理独立监视程序——四态托盘图标（灰=未连接、绿=空闲、橙=运行中、红=有待处理）、逐任务实时面板（时长/速度/token）、完成与结局通知。设置→插件内启停开关；监视器独立进程运行，DSH 重启不影响。

description.en: A thinking level stored per provider and model, so reasoning effort outlives the session it was set in and also reaches subagents, which dsh never asks. The in-session picker still wins, and a model with no row keeps its provider default.
description.zh: 按提供方与模型保存思考等级：推理强度不再只属于设置它的那次会话，还会应用到 dsh 从不询问的子代理。会话内的手动选择依然优先，没有配置的模型保持提供方默认值。

description.en: Session takeover: read-only pull local sessions from nine external agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ZCode, Pi, WorkBuddy, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI) into distilled six-section handoff cards — one click on the Relay chip takes over. /handoff checks the current session into the handoff: 1 open-protocol inbox (~/.handoff, consume-once with machine-signature tamper detection); any agent picks up on start and continues. Memory files ride with cards; cross-machine relay is one env var away.
description.zh: 会话接管：只读拉取九家外部 agent（Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode / ZCode / Pi / WorkBuddy / Cursor / Grok / Gemini CLI）的本地会话，蒸馏成六段交接卡，输入框「接力」按钮一键接管；/handoff 把当前会话寄存进 handoff: 1 开放协议收件箱（~/.handoff，消费即弃 + 机器签名防篡改），任何 agent 开局取件接着干，记忆文件随卡交接，同步盘一句环境变量跨机器接力。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) group notifications for DeepSeek Harness: when a turn ends, pushes a compact digest — conclusion, artifacts and follow-ups — to a custom-bot webhook. Successful turns without follow-ups batch into one-line messages per project; failures and pending items get a detail card; the full text is archived locally; sends retry with exponential backoff and alert after repeated failures.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 每个回合的结果压缩成「结论 / 产物 / 待办」推送到飞书群自定义机器人：成功且无待办的回合按项目聚合成一行型消息，失败或含待办时发详情卡片，可选 LLM 压缩并带本地兜底，全文本地归档，发送失败指数退避重试、连续失败后告警。

description.en: Adds a full-screen sea overlay that appears on a schedule (3 minutes every 120 minutes by default) and fades out on its own.
