The phase, sky colours and moon come from the solar position computed on the host from a city table, so the light matches the real time and place. The water is either drawn procedurally on a canvas from a perspective noise field (random patches that grow toward the viewer, with sun glitter, near-field whitecaps and daytime gulls; at night a moon) or taken from images and videos in a folder you choose, or from web links fetched once into a local cache and graded to the current light. Includes quiet hours, deferring while you type, skip-today, a draggable corner-window form and an optional synthesised surf sound. No telemetry; the only network requests are the links you paste.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一个按间隔浮现的整屏海：默认每 120 分钟浮现 3 分钟，到点自己淡出。时段、天色与月相由宿主按城市表算出的太阳位置决定，所以光和真实的时间地点对得上。海面可以是 canvas 程序化绘制（按透视随机分布的水面斑块，近处大、远处细碎，带碎光、近岸白浪与白天掠过的海鸥；夜里有一轮月亮），也可以是自选目录里的图片/视频，或从网页链接抓取一次后缓存的素材，再按此刻天光着色。包含静默时段、输入中推迟、今天跳过、可拖拽的右下角小窗与可选的合成海浪声。不采集数据；唯一的网络请求是你自己填的链接。

description.en: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves; native Windows playback, zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 牛来确认音：请求用户确认时播放「妈妈」，批准瞬间掐断并播放「牛来！」；梗源电影《牛来》，Windows 原生播放，零外部依赖。

description.en: A task progress sidebar for DeepSeek Harness Web and desktop, opened from the top-right Tasks button, with completion percentage, current step, status filters and task details; verified on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 with 0.2.1-rc.5 support.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web / 桌面客户端的任务进度侧栏：从右上角“任务”打开，查看完成比例、当前步骤，按状态筛选并展开待办详情；验证于 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1，兼容 0.2.1-rc.5。

description.en: Keeps a panel of what you must do, what you can apply for and what is worth knowing, distilled from your WeChat and QQ chat logs by one resident agent session that re-reads them on a schedule or when you click Fetch; each item can link straight to its source file or image.
description.zh: 把微信与 QQ 聊天记录里「必须做的、可以报名的、值得知道的」摘成一张面板：由一个常驻会话按计划或在你点 Fetch 时重读聊天记录并改写条目，每条可直链到原始文件或图片。

description.en: Token usage and cost metering for dsh: per-session and aggregate statistics with configurable pricing and reports.
description.zh: dsh 用量计量：会话级与汇总 token 统计、可配置计价与报告。

description.en: Usage panel for the provider account behind the current model: quota windows, credit balance and token usage, following the model automatically. It renders as a full page, plus a sidebar entry and a per-session usage chip in the conversation header.
description.zh: 当前模型背后的大模型账户用量面板：额度窗口、账户余额与 token 用量，随模型自动切换，支持dsh中内置的主流大模型厂商，支持详情查看与页面左下角概览查看。

description.en: Turns a stated rule into a checkable intake card and writes it into the right AGENTS.md, and keeps project plans, a rule ledger, project records, handoffs, a change log and a timeline.
description.zh: 把一句话的要求做成可核对的规则卡并写进对应的 AGENTS.md，同时统管项目档案、计划、交接、改动账本与时间线。

description.en: Rewrites the Chinese copy of a market-installed plugin into English using a model already configured in the harness — automatically when the plugin is installed, then live-reloaded. Each file is translated in one whole-file pass, validated by a real parser where one exists (node --check for JavaScript, JSON and YAML parsers otherwise) and handed back to the model with the error for up to three repair attempts; files above 48 KB, or that never parse, fall back to a line-range pass that checks every returned line against the original for structure. Trigger phrases and locale tables can optionally be preserved rather than translated, and the untouched original is kept beside the file as a .zh.bak.
description.zh: 用你已经配置好的模型，把从市场安装的插件里的中文文案改写成英文——安装时自动运行，随后热重载。每个文件整体翻译一遍，凡是有解析器的都会实际校验（JavaScript 用 node --check，其余用 JSON、YAML 解析器），失败时把报错交回模型，最多修复三次；超过 48 KB 或始终无法解析的文件，回退到按行区间翻译，逐行与原文做结构比对。触发短语与本地化表可以选择保留而不翻译，未改动的原文件保留在同目录下的 .zh.bak。

description.en: Caps every image sent to a model at a per-side pixel limit (default 2000 px) by wrapping attachments.readImageRequest, which fixes Anthropic many-image request errors without touching stored images.
description.zh: 把发给模型的每张图片按单边像素上限（默认 2000 px）压缩：通过包装 attachments.readImageRequest 实现，修复 Anthropic 多图请求报错，且不改动已存储的图片。

description.en: Structural scaffolding for DSH agent continuity: layered memory (hot/index/judgments), judgment cards, handoff packs (compact mode), compaction review. Zero-dependency, pure files, portable — rebuild the 'self' across model changes. Not a memory engine; the skeleton of continuity.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 的延续搭建结构脚手架：分层记忆（hot/index/judgments）、判断卡、接续包（handoff，含紧凑模式）、压缩审查。零依赖、纯文件、可迁移——换模型后靠文件重建"我"。不是记忆引擎，是自我延续的骨架。

description.en: Collects the failures recorded in DSH session logs — tool failures, turn failures and model retries — folds them into one table merged across sessions and sorted by frequency, showing category, source, error code, count, last-seen time and a summary per row. Each row can start a new session draft pre-filled for root-cause analysis or for prevention (sending still needs your confirmation), and ignoring a row only hides it in the panel without deleting logs.
description.zh: 把会话日志里的工具失败、回合失败与模型重试折叠成一张表，跨会话合并后按出现频次排序，每行显示类别 / 来源 / 错误码 / 出现次数 / 最近时间 / 摘要；每条错误可一键在新会话草稿框里预填「分析」或「防范」提示词（发送仍需用户确认），「忽略」只影响本面板显示、不删日志。

description.en: Cross-domain search and A-share data for DSH: arXiv, Crossref, GitHub, Hacker News, Hugging Face, Product Hunt, plus stock quotes, klines and announcements.
description.zh: DSH 的跨领域信息与 A 股工具：arXiv、Crossref、GitHub、Hacker News、Hugging Face、Product Hunt，以及行情、走势与公告。

description.en: Scheduled prompts that open a fresh conversation for every run, with cron, one-time and manual triggers, a per-task working directory, and run history kept out of the sidebar.
description.zh: 定时提示词任务：每次运行新开一个对话，支持 cron、一次性与手动触发，可指定工作目录，运行记录不进左侧列表。

description.en: Branch-aware code knowledge graph for DSH - callers, impact, trace and architecture over 158+ languages, freshness-gated, one dispatcher tool, zero MCP sessions.
description.zh: DSH 原生分支感知代码知识图谱：调用链/影响面/路径/架构覆盖 158+ 语言，保鲜门控，切分支索引自动跟随，单工具分发零 MCP 会话。

description.en: Adds a mobile hotkey mode to the DSH web composer that auto-detects touch and mobile devices and switches to Ctrl+Enter for send and plain Enter for a newline while leaving the desktop keymap untouched, with a Settings toggle, a /mobilekeys command and a window.__dshMobileKeys console API.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框增加「移动端热键模式」：自动检测移动/触控设备后切换为 Ctrl+Enter 发送、裸 Enter 换行，桌面键位保持不变，并提供设置面板开关、/mobilekeys 命令与 window.__dshMobileKeys 控制台 API。

description.en: Session-archive layer for DSH. It injects one per-workspace Markdown file into the system prompt on every turn, searches past session transcripts with AND keywords, an optional time window and a workspace filter, and recovers the images and documents those past sessions carried by returning their original local paths or copying them to a chosen directory. It also reports index health: version, entry count, cache usage, frequent sessions and sessions stored in an archive format it does not recognise. Keyword search only, no embedding service.
description.zh: DSH 的会话档案层。每轮把一个按工作区定位的 Markdown 记忆文件注入系统提示；跨历史会话检索 对话原文，支持多关键词 AND、时间窗与工作区过滤；还能取出历史会话携带的图片和文档，给出原始 本地路径或批量复制到指定目录。另外提供体检：索引版本、条目数、缓存占用、高频会话，以及未知 归档格式的告警。仅关键词检索，不依赖向量服务。

description.en: JARVIS-style sci-fi HUD shell over the DSH web GUI: electric-cyan VITAL SIGNS / RT-MONITOR / RT-LOG left bar, POWER CORE gauges and a rotating RADAR scan disc on the right with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer with a JARVIS header strip that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 JARVIS 风格科幻 HUD 外壳：电光青色 VITAL SIGNS 生命体征 / RT-MONITOR 实时监控 / RT-LOG 事件日志左栏，右侧 POWER CORE 能源核心仪表、旋转扫描的 RADAR 雷达盘与上下行流量图，左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及带 JARVIS 头部横幅、跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: Answers Dark Souls III questions from your own Windows PC save (default `%APPDATA%\DarkSoulsIII\*\DS30000.sl2`): level and stats, current area, bonfires/rings/spells/covenants counted by family, kill state for the 24 bosses, and Steam achievements when Steam is installed - exposed as model tools plus a progress pill beside the composer and a 19-area sidebar page with next-step suggestions. The save stays read-only and is parsed locally by a bundled Python 3 script; Python 3 and the `cryptography` package must be installed, and the game data ships with the plugin.
description.zh: 读你自己的《黑暗之魂3》Windows 存档（默认 `%APPDATA%\DarkSoulsIII\*\DS30000.sl2`）回答问题：等级与属性、当前区域、按家族统计的篝火/戒指/法术/誓约完成度、24 个 Boss 的击杀状态，装有 Steam 时还包括 Steam 成就；以模型工具提供，另配输入框旁的进度药丸和 19 区域侧栏页。存档只读，由随包提供的 Python 3 脚本本地解析；运行前需装好 Python 3 与 `cryptography`，游戏数据随插件分发。

description.en: Manage GitHub and npm from inside DeepSeek Harness: multi-account switching, repository management, workspace Git tree with one-click push, pre-push Agent review, and npm package browsing, packing, pre-publish review and publishing.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里统一管理 GitHub 与 npm：多账号切换、仓库管理、工作区 Git 版本树与一键推送、推送前 Agent 审查，以及 npm 包的浏览、打包、发布前审查与发布。

description.en: A macOS screenshot button in the composer tool row: the scissors split button runs the native screencapture marquee — optionally hiding the Harness window first, chosen from its caret menu — then copies the PNG to the clipboard and attaches it to the composer draft; Screen Recording is preflighted, so an un-granted capture points at the settings instead of returning a wallpaper-only image.
description.zh: macOS 输入框工具栏截图按钮：剪刀分体按钮调起系统原生 screencapture 框选（右侧下拉可先隐藏 Harness 窗口），截图自动进剪贴板并附成输入框草稿；会先检查屏幕录制授权，未授权时提示去设置，而不是返回一张只有壁纸的图。

description.en: Alt+drag a rectangular box over the DSH conversation to copy the text inside it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中按住 Alt 拖拽矩形选框，复制框内文本。

description.en: Switches which assistant persona answers, based on how the message addresses it (alias matching, with names inside quotes and copula phrases such as "is/was" excluded); each persona is a folder holding its own prompt, aliases, colour, avatar and optional lore, several personas can answer one turn, and a settings panel plus a per-turn routing log make each switch checkable. Personas live under ~/.dsh/personas (deleting one in the panel removes its folder) and the routing log in ~/.dsh/persona-router keeps the first 60 characters of each message; its HTTP routes (/persona-router/…) have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 按这句话怎么称呼助手来切换作答的人格（别名匹配，引号内的名字与「是 / 为」这类系词不算称呼）；每个人格是一个文件夹，装着自己的提示词、别名、配色、头像与可选世界书；一轮可以让多个人格同时作答；设置页有面板和逐轮判定日志，每次切换都可复查。人格存放在 ~/.dsh/personas（面板里删除人格会删掉它的文件夹），判定日志在 ~/.dsh/persona-router，会记下每条消息的前 60 个字符；插件的 HTTP 路由（/persona-router/…）没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Add-on layer over the official QQ bot plugin @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot: gates group messages before they reach the agent (probability, debounce with backlog, invalid-message filtering, admin approval before reading attachments), greets idle private chats, and adds emoji stickers via dsh-meme, TTS/ASR voice replies, image generation and one settings page. Needs the official QQ bot plugin installed (plus dsh-meme for stickers). Group gating defaults to a 25% chance and only applies when mentions are not required; the private-chat greeting is on by default (22:00-08:00, at most 3 a night, only to chats that wrote first); voice and image generation call endpoints you configure; with no admins configured nobody can approve attachments.
description.zh: 官方 QQ 机器人插件 @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 的拓展层：群聊消息进 agent 前先按概率、防抖加积压、无效消息过滤做频控收敛，非管理员附件需管理员回「同意」才读取，私聊按空闲时长主动问候，并补上表情包、TTS/ASR 语音条、绘图与统一设置页。需要先装好官方 QQ 机器人插件（表情包还需 dsh-meme）。群聊按概率放行默认为 25%，且只在不要求 @ 机器人时生效；私聊问候默认开启（22:00–08:00，每晚最多 3 次，只对先发过消息的会话）；语音和绘图调用你自己配置的接口；没配置管理员时没人能批准附件。

description.en: Unlock password-protected LabVIEW VI and CTL block diagrams without LabVIEW or Python.
description.zh: 无需 LabVIEW 或 Python，直接解锁受密码保护的 LabVIEW VI/CTL 程序框图。

description.en: Hacker News tools for feeds, discussion threads, search, and user profiles.
description.zh: 用于获取 Hacker News 榜单、讨论串、搜索和用户资料的工具。

description.en: A draggable sticky note beside the chat: short-term tasks and a long-term plan whose phases carry real progress, plus three todo_note_* tools (read, update, complete) so the agent works from the same note. A task only counts as done after the user ticks it off, and the state stays on the local machine.
description.zh: 对话旁的可拖动便签：短期待办，加上带真实阶段进度的长期计划，并通过 todo_note_read / todo_note_update / todo_note_complete 三个工具让 agent 与你在同一份便签上协作；任务须经你点击确认才算完成，状态只保存在本机。

description.en: Controls an existing aria2 JSON-RPC service from DSH with four tools: submit a single HTTP/HTTPS link (optional directory, filename, checksum, per-task proxy), read one task, list tasks, and pause/resume/cancel. A task it submitted that finishes or fails reports back to the session that started it. A settings page holds host, port, secret and timeout, with a connection test that does not save or create anything; it never bundles, starts or manages aria2 itself. Creating and controlling downloads only works in full-access mode (not plan mode).
description.zh: 连接已有的 aria2 JSON-RPC 服务，提供四个工具：提交单文件直链（可选保存目录、文件名、校验和、任务级代理）、读任务状态、列任务、暂停/恢复/取消；由它提交的任务完成或失败时，回报给发起它的会话。设置页保存主机、端口、密钥与超时，并带一个不保存配置、不创建任务的连接测试；不自带、不启动、不管理 aria2。创建与控制下载仅在完全访问模式（非计划模式）下可用。

description.en: Closes DeepSeek Harness runner processes that stay alive after their shell command finished on Windows, reclaiming about 140 MB each. A runner is closed only when its shell is gone and it supervises nothing, as a workaround for the runner not exiting by itself.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上关闭 shell 命令已结束、却仍然存活的 DeepSeek Harness runner 进程，每个可回收约 140 MB。仅当其 shell 已不存在且不再监管任何子进程时才会关闭，用作 runner 不会自行退出问题的变通办法。

description.en: Improve the current chat draft before sending with a confirm-before-apply comparison.
description.zh: 在发送前优化当前聊天输入，采用前先对比原文与优化结果。

description.en: Skill provider that installs the whole @dennisrongo/skills catalog as one npm dependency, so skills install and update without cloning or linking directories.
description.zh: 技能提供者：将整个 @dennisrongo/skills 目录作为一个 npm 依赖安装，无需克隆仓库或链接目录即可完成技能的安装与更新。

description.en: Rotifer Protocol skills plus the Rotifer MCP server, configured as instances of DSH's own skill provider and MCP client: search Genes, compare them on Arena rankings, install or roll back Genes in the local project, and create and run local Agents. The MCP server is version-pinned and limited to its evolve tool set, which leaves out publishing and login.
description.zh: Rotifer 协议的技能包加 Rotifer MCP 服务，以 DSH 自带的技能提供器与 MCP 客户端实例的形式挂载：搜索 Gene、按 Arena 排名比较、在本地项目里安装或回滚 Gene，并创建和运行本地 Agent。MCP 服务锁定版本，只开放 evolve 工具集，不含发布与登录。

description.en: macOS 14.2+ only: the macOS counterpart to Lingwuxin/dsh-audio-rail — the DSH conversation rail pulses with whatever the Mac is playing, a real 12-band spectrum that only changes bar length, leaving the host state colours and lengths untouched. Requires the Audio Recording permission on first run. Do not install it alongside dsh-audio-rail: both drive the same rail and register the same /audio-rail/events and /audio-rail/status routes.
description.zh: macOS 14.2+ 专享：Lingwuxin/dsh-audio-rail 的 macOS 对应版，让 DSH 会话页右侧的锚点跟着 Mac 播放的音乐律动，12 段真实频谱只改长度，不覆盖宿主的状态颜色与长度。首次运行需授予「音频录制」权限；请勿与 dsh-audio-rail 同装——两者驱动同一处锚点并注册相同的 /audio-rail/events 与 /audio-rail/status 路由。

description.en: A fixed-pixel office tower for DeepSeek Harness: every workspace is a floor and every session an office inside it. Lit windows mean work in progress, and clicking a floor or a person takes you straight to that session.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的所有会话画成一栋固定像素的办公楼：一层是一个工作区，一层里的每间办公室是一个会话；亮灯表示正在工作，点击楼层或角色可直接回到对应会话。

description.en: In-place redaction and row-level rollback for session logs, preserving the seq-equals-row-index invariant that makes deleting a middle row corrupt the entire log. Originals are copied to a quarantine sibling before any write, and the reader's own semantics are replayed as a pre-write gate.
description.zh: 会话日志的原地脱敏与按行回退：守住「每行 seq 必须等于它的行号」这一不变式（删中间行会让整份日志打不开）。任何写入前先把原文复制成隔离备份，并以读取端自身的语义作为写前闸门。

description.en: Runs Superpowers as an agent preset and gives each skill its own subagent model from a Settings table, so TDD, debugging and verification no longer all inherit the parent model.
description.zh: 把 Superpowers 作为 Agent 预设运行，并在设置表里为每个技能单独指定子代理模型，测试、系统调试与收尾验证不再全部沿用父会话的模型。

description.en: Security guard for DeepSeek Harness (Cordis): reviews every tool call in pre-execute against SlowMist agent-security rules, denying or flagging risky commands, MCP servers and skill loads, external URLs and repositories, untrusted documents, and EVM or Solana addresses; scans tool results for prompt injection after execution and ships a slowmist_scan audit tool plus an injected security policy prompt. Rules follow the open-source SlowMist Agent Security Skill (MIT).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (Cordis) 安全防护插件：在 pre-execute 阶段按慢雾 Agent Security 规则审查每一次工具调用，对高危命令、MCP 服务器与技能加载、外部 URL 与代码仓库、不可信文档、EVM 或 Solana 链上地址给出拒绝或警告；执行后对工具结果做提示注入扫描，内置 slowmist_scan 审计工具并注入安全策略提示词。规则遵循慢雾开源的 Agent Security Skill（MIT）。

description.en: Workspace-scoped Semgrep SAST tool for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Windows x64 runtime, structured bounded findings, cancellation and timeout controls, and user-approved sandbox escalation. Installs from npm as @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区内 Semgrep SAST 工具，提供托管 Windows x64 运行时、结构化有界结果、取消与超时控制，以及经用户批准的沙箱权限升级。npm 包名为 @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast。

description.en: Translates the agent's English execution narration into Simplified Chinese in place; the final answer, tool records and reasoning stay as they are, so the official reasoning-translation plugin keeps working alongside it. Whether a step is narration is decided by a render-time structural signal, not by English phrasing, and with no signal available it translates nothing automatically. Fenced code, inline code, URLs and file paths are masked before the request. Uses the host's translator service (Bing by default, no API key).
description.zh: 把 Agent 执行过程中的英文过程叙述原位翻译成简体中文；最终回答、工具记录与思考内容保持原样，因此官方思考翻译插件可同时启用。某一步是否属于过程叙述由渲染期结构信号判定，而非依据英文句式；拿不到该信号时不自动翻译。围栏代码、行内代码、URL 与文件路径在请求前打码。复用宿主的翻译服务（默认 Bing，无需 API Key）。

description.en:
Static HTML auditor for Chinese line-breaking: checks explicit-`
` orphan lines, keep-all CSS coverage, CJK line-start/line-end punctuation rules, and protected-phrase splits, then inserts at natural breakpoints; exposes a cn_linebreak_audit tool for agents.
description.zh:
中文网页文案断行静态审查与修复工具：检查显式
孤字行、keep-all 覆盖、标点禁则、保护词被拆等问题，并在自然停顿处自动插入 ；提供 cn_linebreak_audit 工具供代理调用。

description.en: Human-only browser panel that opens as a full page in the DSH main content area: multiple tabs, an address bar, a context menu, a homepage with pinned shortcuts, and a history page stored in IndexedDB. Pages render in the webview bridge that ships with DSH Desktop, and the current page can be opened in your local Chrome.
description.zh: 只交给人操作、不在 AI 侧注册任何工具的浏览器面板：在 DSH 右侧主内容区整页打开，提供多标签、地址栏、右键菜单、带钉住快捷入口的主页与 IndexedDB 永久保存的历史页。页面在 DSH Desktop 自带的 webview 桥里渲染，当前页可交给本地 Chrome 打开。

description.en: A white-box rule workbench for DeepSeek Harness: turn plain-language rules into readable, auditable rule chains executed by a deterministic 171-atom forward-chain engine. Business records stay on the machine; rule generation sends field names and rule text only.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek 把大白话业务规则转成可读、可导出的规则链，再由 171 原子前向链引擎确定性执行；业务数据留在本机，生成规则时只发送字段名与规则文本，附完整逻辑库/数据库工作台。

description.en: Publish agent output to Reviso for human review, browse published documents from the sidebar, and find them again from the session that produced them. OAuth is host-mediated: Reviso tokens stay in DSH credentials and the browser only receives short-lived embed sessions. Requires a Reviso account or a compatible self-hosted Reviso server.
description.zh: 把 Agent 产出发布到 Reviso 供人工评审，在侧边栏浏览已发布文档，并在产生这些文档的同一个 DSH 会话中再次找到它们。OAuth 由宿主中转：Reviso token 只保存在 DSH credentials 里，浏览器仅获得短时效的 embed 会话。需要 Reviso 账号或兼容的自建 Reviso 服务。

description.en: MCP server panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the sidebar lists every @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client row — including rows inserted by other plugins — and derives its connection state from the loader fiber, the mcp__<server>__* tools still registered, a TCP probe of HTTP endpoints and the last connection test; it shows the row's configuration, enables or disables it by editing only that row of the patch file, reconnects once after a failed attempt, and reports unavailable servers to the agent through a system-prompt note plus a call gate that refuses their tools instead of letting each call fail at the transport.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器面板：侧边栏列出每一个 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 行（含其它插件插入的行），用 loader fiber 状态、仍注册的 mcp__<server>__* 工具数、HTTP 端点的 TCP 探活以及最近一次连接测试判断真实连接状态；可展开看该行配置，开关只改补丁文件里对应的一行并触发热重载重连，连接失败后自动再试一次，并把不可用的服务器以 system prompt 摘要 + 调用闸门的方式告知 agent——闸门会拒绝这些服务器的工具调用，而不是让每次调用在传输层失败。

description.en: Runtime governor for DeepSeek Harness: zero-progress steering, generation-bound verification evidence, evidence-aware completion guarding, and task-profile tool restriction.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 运行时治理器：零进展回合引导、按代际绑定的验证证据、基于证据的完成守卫，以及按任务配置限制工具集。

description.en: Gives hand-declared models on custom or relay routes a vendor-matched reasoning-effort picker: detects Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, Gemini, Grok, Doubao or MiMo from the model id, display name or endpoint host, fills in only the levels that vendor accepts plus the pi-ai compat fields its request format needs, and writes them into the profile config so the Models page reasoning switch turns on. Models you edit or switch off are left alone, and a Models page card hands them back on request.
description.zh: 为自定义路由或中转站上手动添加的模型提供按厂商匹配的推理等级选择：根据模型 id、显示名或接口域名识别 Claude、GPT、DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、Qwen、Gemini、Grok、豆包或 MiMo，只填入该厂商接受的档位，并补上对应请求格式所需的 pi-ai compat 字段，再写回 profile 配置，让「设置 → 模型」里的推理开关自动打开。你手动改过或关掉的模型不会被改动，可在模型设置页的卡片上一键交回插件。

description.en: Provider-agnostic text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness: synthesize speech to local audio files, manage preset, cloned and designed voices, configure providers in a bilingual settings card, and read assistant replies aloud with optional auto-read.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的通用语音合成：把文本合成为本地音频文件，管理预置、克隆和设计音色，在双语设置卡里配置 provider，并可用朗读按钮或自动朗读播报助手回复。

description.en: Plays a sound when a DSH task completes, fails, or waits for approval, with per-category switches.
description.zh: 在 DSH 任务完成、失败或等待授权时播放提示音，并提供分类开关。

description.en: Fork of shaobeichen/dsh-pocket for remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: QR-code access over LAN or a cloudflared tunnel with live sync; mobile layout is left to DSH itself, the plugin adds safe-area and touch chrome, soft-keyboard Enter inserts a newline while hardware keyboards send on Enter, and install/update is left to the plugin manager. The command-line mode listens on 0.0.0.0 by default so a phone on the same Wi-Fi can scan the QR code; it generates an access password (embedded in the QR code) unless you pass --no-auth, and a cloudflared tunnel exposes the Web UI beyond your LAN.
description.zh: shaobeichen/dsh-pocket 的 fork：手机扫码经局域网或 cloudflared 隧道远程访问 DSH Web 界面并实时同屏；移动端布局交还 DSH 官方，插件只补安全区与触控样式，软键盘回车换行、外接键盘回车发送，安装与更新交给插件管理器。命令行模式默认监听 0.0.0.0，好让同一 Wi-Fi 下的手机扫码；除非加 --no-auth，否则会生成访问密码（嵌在二维码里）；cloudflared 隧道会把 Web 界面暴露到局域网之外。

description.en: Sets the UI text colour for light and dark themes separately, plus the body font size and the interface typeface, with system Kai/Xing/Li/Song families, four open-source calligraphy fonts and support for importing your own font file.
description.zh: 分别设置深浅主题的文字颜色，并调整正文字号与界面字体：内置楷体、行楷、隶书等系统字体，附带四款开源书法字体，也能导入自己的字体文件。

description.en: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools: 15 schema-validated tools (memory + quality gates) plus an L0 guard of the consulting document-generation engine; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-events for the full session protocol.
description.zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-tools：咨询/汇报材料生成引擎的 15 个 DSH 原生工具（记忆面 + 质量门禁）+ L0 守卫；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-events 配套使用。

description.en: Spotlight & IntelliJ-style centered search dialog for sessions and chat messages, replacing sidebar search.
description.zh: 居中全局搜索弹窗：提供类似 Spotlight 与 IntelliJ 的会话及聊天消息实时检索与上下文预览。

description.en: Click the chibi mascot and it reads the assistant reply aloud through your local IndexTTS 2.5 install. One character = one reference clip; a missing portrait just shows a placeholder. Ships no voices or artwork — the library lives on the user's own machine. Requires a local IndexTTS 2.5 install.
description.zh: 点一下 Q 版立绘挂件，就用本机 IndexTTS 2.5 把助手回复念出来。一个角色 = 一段参考音频，谁的声音都能当角色；没有立绘也能用，挂件会提示「本角色暂无图片，请添加」。不含任何音色与立绘，角色库在用户自己机器上。需要本地已装 IndexTTS 2.5。

description.en: Unofficial QwenWork (千问办公) model provider for DSH, adapted from dsh-magpie-connect and magpie (MIT): device-code sign-in and request signing live inside the plugin, so no desktop client or forwarding process is needed. Requires an active QwenWork plan and DSH 0.2.x.
description.zh: 非官方的千问办公（QwenWork）模型 provider，改编自 dsh-magpie-connect 与 magpie（MIT）：设备码登录与请求签名均在插件内实现，不需要桌面客户端或本地转发进程。需有效的千问办公套餐，DSH 0.2.x。

description.en: Connects the CallAI SEO MCP server: 10 SEO data tools plus a generic DataForSEO request tool for Google/Bing SERP (with AI Overview sources), keyword volume and difficulty, long-tail ideas, competitor keyword gaps, backlinks and page audits. Includes a callai-seo skill. Requires a CallAI API key; pay as you go.
description.zh: 连接 CallAI SEO MCP 服务，提供 10 个 SEO 数据工具和 1 个 DataForSEO 通用请求工具：Google/Bing 搜索结果（含 AI Overview 引用来源）、关键词搜索量与难度、长尾词、竞品关键词差距、外链和页面审计。附带 callai-seo 技能。需要 CallAI API Key，按量付费。

description.en: Optional external HTTP API for DSH Desktop, off by default, bound to localhost unless widened, and authenticated with a Bearer token.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的可选外部 HTTP API，默认关闭、默认仅监听本机，扩大监听范围时使用 Bearer Token 鉴权。

description.en: E-commerce plugin for DeepSeek Harness — product search, comparison and checkout across Taobao/JD/Pinduoduo, via the yuantoutao Streamable HTTP MCP server.
description.zh: 电商插件——一个 MCP 给你的 AI 加上商品搜索、比价与购买能力，覆盖淘宝/京东/拼多多，商品目录由源头淘 MCP 服务提供。

description.en: Browse the GitHub issues and pull requests of a workspace's origin remote, filter and comment, close or reopen, and file one as a task on dsh-plugin-taskboard for an agent to claim.
description.zh: 浏览工作区 origin 远端对应的 GitHub issue 与 pull request，筛选、评论、关闭或重开，并可转成任务写到 dsh-plugin-taskboard 的看板上等 agent 领取。

description.en: Runtime monitor for the plugins installed in a DSH profile: the panel lists every bundle and plugin entry with its Cordis fiber state and load diagnostics, scores risk from failed entries, missing bundles, version exemptions, install scripts, bin entries, a missing license and non-registry sources, keeps a timeline of state changes, and can disable a plugin entry or a whole bundle without leaving the panel.
description.zh: 监控 DSH 配置里已安装插件的运行时面板：列出每个 bundle 与插件条目及其 Cordis fiber 状态与加载诊断，依据条目失败、bundle 缺失、版本豁免、安装脚本、bin 入口、缺失许可证与非注册表来源计算风险分，记录状态变化时间线，并可在面板内停用某个插件条目或整个 bundle。

description.en: Adds ChatGPT sign-in, Codex subscription quota (5-hour and weekly windows) and Codex-backed web search to DeepSeek Harness; installing it switches the profile's web search provider to openai-codex.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 ChatGPT 登录、Codex 订阅额度（5 小时与每周窗口）以及由 Codex 驱动的网页搜索；安装后整个 profile 的网页搜索会切到 openai-codex。

description.en: Source-backed logic reviews with diagrams, code diffs, and resumable human feedback. The first activation downloads the official LogicMargin release (SHA-256 verified); on macOS and Linux this needs curl, unzip and shasum or sha256sum.
description.zh: 用有来源依据的流程图和代码差异开展人工评审，保留批注、回复与多轮修订。首次启用时会下载 LogicMargin 官方发行包（校验 SHA-256）；macOS / Linux 上需要 curl、unzip 与 shasum 或 sha256sum。

description.en: Three custom agent presets, one editable character card each, with three built-in personas out of the box; import SillyTavern character-card PNGs or md/txt/json setting files, and the settings section handles naming, editing, and card-image display — edits apply on the next turn with no restart.
description.zh: 三个自定义 agent 预设，每槽一张可编辑角色卡——开箱自带鲸鱼娘/病娇/小满三张预制人设，支持导入 SillyTavern 生态角色卡 PNG 或 md/txt/json 设定文档；设置页「角色卡」区块可取名、编辑、展示卡面图，保存后下一回合生效，无需重启。

description.en: A desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top character and a roster panel that show what the watched conversations are doing, with seven animations, Workspace grouping, subagents drawn under their parent, and one click to open a session. Ships Windows, macOS (Intel and Apple silicon) and Linux window binaries in the package, so installing runs no install scripts and needs no build step.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的桌面宠物：置顶角色加一块会话面板，显示受关注会话的实时状态；七套动画、按 Workspace 分组、子代理挂在父会话下面、点击一行即可打开会话。包内自带 Windows、macOS（Intel 与 Apple 芯片）和 Linux 的窗口可执行文件，安装时不跑脚本、无需构建。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI: system-telemetry left bar with per-core CPU sparklines, encom-globe world-map right bar with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 eDEX-UI 风格外壳：左侧系统遥测栏（含每核 CPU 迷你趋势图）、右侧 encom-globe 世界地图与上下行流量图、左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: White-box memory in two parts: four user-authored long-term tiers (must-follow rules, behavior settings, user profile, optional rules) injected as one system-prompt section, plus a separate temporary working set (cross-session handoffs, stage goals, waiting items) with its own 1200-character budget that stops being injected once an entry is done. The long-term tiers are plain Markdown files the user can read and edit; the agent can only propose them, and nothing is written until the user accepts in the Chinese panel. Temporary entries are written only when the user explicitly asks, and live in <DSH_HOME>/temp-memory.json (created on first write), not in the memory directory. No auto-capture, no background writes, no network.
description.zh: 白箱两段记忆：四层用户自写的长期记忆（必须遵守／行为设定／用户画像／可选遵守）注入为系统提示词的一节；另有「临时记忆」（跨对话交接／阶段目标／等待项）独立成节、独立预算（默认 1200 字），条目完结即停止注入。长期记忆是记忆目录里可读可改的 Markdown 文件，AI 只能提议，用户在中文面板点「采纳」才写入；临时记忆只在用户明确要求时写入，存放在 <DSH_HOME>/temp-memory.json（首次写入才创建），不在记忆目录里。不自动采集、不后台回写、不联网。

description.en: Archive, search, and recall group-chat quotes locally, with an agent-callable quote tool and a full AstrBot-style management page (library, statistics, insights, trash, people, collections, and collaboration). Needs Node.js 22.13+; QQ capture and reposting are optional and require a running SnowLuma / OneBot v11 HTTP gateway, whose address and access token the plugin finds automatically in local SnowLuma and qq-bridge config files.
description.zh: 本地收藏、检索与随机回放群聊语录，提供 Agent 可调用的 quote 工具和 AstrBot 风格的整页管理后台（语录库、统计、数据可视化、回收站、人物、专题合集、协作维护）。需要 Node.js 22.13+；QQ 采集与回发为可选功能，需要运行中的 SnowLuma / OneBot v11 HTTP 网关，插件会从本机 SnowLuma 与 qq-bridge 的配置文件里自动查找网关地址和访问令牌。

description.en: Nudges the main agent of a long-running DSH session to report progress at a configurable interval, with exponential back-off, stuck detection, a per-session Progress tab, and a manual "nudge now" action.
description.zh: 主 agent 长时间执行时按可配置间隔提醒它播报进度，支持指数退避、卡住检测、会话「进度」标签页与手动「立即催一次」。

description.en: A top-down arena shooter that lives in the DSH sidebar: an autopilot AI plays the blue whale-fish hero for you while the dsh-pet desktop pet narrates each wave out loud, and combos, boss waves every fifth wave, in-run upgrade choices, a local leaderboard, achievements, skins and a floating desk widget (a fish that keeps playing in the corner, click to pet, double-click to open) keep the run going while you work.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的俯视角生存射击：AI 托管替你把蓝鱼主角打起来，dsh-pet 桌宠逐波解说并念出声；连杀倍率、每 5 波 Boss、局内三选一强化、本机排行榜、成就与皮肤，切面板后还能缩成右下角的小鱼挂件继续打——点一下摸摸它，双击展开画面。

description.en: Gives each Workspace a stable tint from a warm-to-cool ramp, sets its name as a section heading above indented Sessions, and turns a finished unread chat's row green.
description.zh: 为每个工作区分配稳定的暖到冷色调，把工作区名设为分组标题并把会话缩进其下，同时在会话完成未读时整行染绿。

description.en: A six-stage development workflow preset for the Matt Pocock skill suite: grill, spec, tickets, implement, review, wrap-up. Adds a stage chip in the composer tool row and decision cards that ask up to three multiple-choice questions at a time.
description.zh: 把 Matt Pocock 技能套件编成六阶段带前置条件的开发工作流预设：拷问、规范、任务、实现、评审、收尾。提供输入框工具行的阶段胶囊，以及一次最多三问、带选项和补充输入框的决策卡片。

description.en: Posts a macOS notification titled with the session name when that session finishes a turn, and clicking it returns to the session. An in-app notice is always shown alongside it (9 s in the foreground, 60 s in the background); the system banner needs notifications allowed for DeepSeek Harness in macOS settings, otherwise only the in-app notice appears.
description.zh: 会话结束本轮时弹出以会话名为标题的 macOS 通知，点击通知回到该会话；同时一定会再显示一张应用内提示（前台 9 秒、后台 60 秒）。系统横幅需要在 macOS 设置里允许 DeepSeek Harness 发通知，否则只有应用内提示。

description.en: Tianlight theme/skin for DeepSeek Harness: full-screen video and image wallpapers with upload, rotation, URL and ShaderToy GLSL sources; optional WebWallGL scene wallpapers; liquid glass; and a draggable Mint cat companion with permission-gated AI chat, local chat history and per-look action packs. Alt+W opens the wallpaper panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「天光」主题皮肤：全屏视频/图片壁纸（支持上传、轮播、URL 与 ShaderToy GLSL 代码来源）、可选 WebWallGL 场景壁纸、液态玻璃，以及可拖拽的薄荷猫桌宠（严格权限的 AI 对话、本地对话历史、每个形象的动作包）；Alt+W 打开壁纸面板。

description.en: Drive the DOTV infinite canvas from DeepSeek Harness: the agent lists your canvases and their nodes, adds text nodes, and runs image/video/audio generations — over DOTV's public API, with no runtime dependencies and no build step. It reuses the `dotv` CLI login on the machine, or takes an API key in the plugin settings. Generations consume credits on your account, exactly as they do in the app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里驱动 DOTV 无限画布：agent 能列出画布与节点、加文本节点、跑图片/视频/音频生成 —— 走 DOTV 的公开 API，零运行时依赖、免构建。默认复用本机 `dotv` CLI 的登录态，也可以在插件设置里填 API key。跑生成消耗账号积分，跟在应用里做一样。

description.en: macOS-only frosted-glass skin for the DSH NEXT / DSH Desktop conversation pane and third-party sidebars: native vibrancy material, independent switches per level, an optional wallpaper backdrop with adjustable frost, and a Settings section; background material only, no layout changes.
description.zh: macOS 专用磨砂玻璃皮肤：给 DSH NEXT / DSH Desktop 的会话面板与第三方侧边栏套上原生 Vibrancy 材质，两级效果各自独立开关，可选壁纸底图并调节磨砂度，附设置页；只改背景材质，不动布局。

description.en: Remembers the model used before quitting and restores it as the startup default.
description.zh: 自动记忆退出前选择的模型，并在下次启动时恢复为默认模型。

description.en: Hold Space to record and release to transcribe and send, without focusing the composer first. Esc cancels and window blur auto-cancels. Requires the official voice-input bundle (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`) enabled with its speech model downloaded; otherwise Space is left alone.
description.zh: 按住空格录音、松手自动识别并发送，不用先点输入框。按 Esc 可取消，切换窗口自动取消。需先启用官方「语音输入」Bundle（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`）并下载好语音模型，否则插件不接管空格。

description.en: Browse and search Tencent ima knowledge bases, read files in an in-panel dock, and add links, files and notes via the ima OpenAPI.
description.zh: 在 Harness 面板中浏览与检索腾讯 ima 知识库，在内置分栏阅读文件，并通过 ima 开放接口添加网页链接、文件与笔记。

description.en: Security and governance for dsh: rule-based tool denial, full tool-call audit trail, and governance reports.
description.zh: dsh 安全治理：规则化工具拦截、完整工具调用审计轨迹与治理报告。

description.en: Registers 36 bundled agent skills (research writing, LaTeX, experiments, design review, office documents, animation, Windows shell and dsh plugin conventions) as one host-only skill provider with no UI, no network calls and no telemetry of its own; skill scripts run with the user's permissions only when invoked, local skills of the same name take priority, and uninstall removes all 36.
description.zh: 把 36 个内置 agent 技能（科研写作、LaTeX、实验、设计评审、办公文档、动画、Windows shell 与 dsh 插件规范）注册为一个纯宿主侧的技能提供者：没有界面、没有网络请求，也没有自己的遥测；技能脚本以用户的权限运行。

description.en: Left sidebar disk panel for the DSH Web UI: volume free space, per-Workspace folder sizes, moving build artifacts to the macOS Trash with an audit log and restore, sending scan results to an agent, and a host-side low-space watchdog with OS notifications. macOS and Linux only; Trash cleanup works on macOS only, while Linux gets the scan, trend and watchdog without cleanup. Cleanup is limited to a fixed list of build-artifact folder names directly under a registered Workspace.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 左侧栏磁盘面板：各卷剩余空间、按工作区统计目录占用、把构建产物安全移入 macOS 废纸篓（带审计与恢复）、把扫描结果交给 Agent 分析，以及 Host 端低空间看门狗与系统通知。仅限 macOS 和 Linux；移入废纸篓只在 macOS 上可用，Linux 上有扫描、趋势和看门狗但没有清理。清理只限注册工作区根目录下一批固定名字的构建产物目录。

description.en: Replaces the add-workspace folder dialog with a path input, drive shortcuts, and the native folder picker.
description.zh: 把添加工作区的目录对话框换成路径输入、盘符快捷和系统文件夹选择。

description.en: DSH prompt-cache health guard and cost coach: install from npm as dsh-prompt-cache-guard (not the unrelated dsh-cache-guard package). cache_guard_health returns green/yellow/red health, a one-line hint and a PTC suggestion; cache_guard_config reads or updates settings.
description.zh: DSH 提示缓存健康度守卫与省钱教练：npm 包名是 dsh-prompt-cache-guard（与无关的 dsh-cache-guard 不是同一个包）。cache_guard_health 工具给出绿/黄/红健康度、一行干预建议与 PTC 切换提示，cache_guard_config 读写开关与灵敏度。

description.en: Device inspector and control panel for macOS and Windows that shows hardware, system, software, network, security and processes on one sidebar page and applies 19 whitelisted actions, with a confirmable cleanup scan, a repeatable benchmark and device_info, device_control and device_benchmark tools for the agent.
description.zh: 面向 macOS 与 Windows 的设备检视与操作面板，在侧栏一页展示硬件、系统、软件、网络、安全与进程，执行 19 个白名单操作，并提供需二次确认的磁盘清理扫描、可重复的基准测试，以及 device_info、device_control、device_benchmark 三个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Polishes the composer draft: opening the panel optimizes once with the default template, replacing the draft shows a line-by-line diff first, and a 9-second undo sits on the entry pill. Five templates (basics, structure, examples, reasoning, iteration) switch without spending a call; history and version chains stay on this machine, and the UI follows the Harness language.
description.zh: 输入框旁的提示词优化器：打开面板即按默认模板优化一次，替换草稿前先给逐行 diff，替换后 9 秒内可撤销。五种模板（基础 / 结构 / 示范 / 推理 / 迭代）换选择不计费，历史与版本链存在本机，界面跟随 Harness 语言切换。

description.en: Data inventory plugin — directory scan + value assessment + classification annotation.
description.zh: 数据目录盘点插件 — 目录扫描+价值评估+分类标注

description.en: Windows disk manager for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: volume overview with usage bars, a session-grouped list of the documents each conversation produced, drag files straight into the chat composer, multi-select with batch delete to Recycle Bin, an expandable folder tree with real app icons, workspace documents no session touched, on-demand folder sizes, and an explorer-style context menu. Delete goes to the recycle bin.
description.zh: DSH 右栏里的 Windows 磁盘管理：卷总览带用量条、按会话分组列出每次对话产出的文档、把文件直接拖进对话输入框、多选与批量删除（只进回收站）、可展开的目录树带程序真图标、补上会话没碰过的工作区文档、按需统计文件夹大小，右键菜单对齐资源管理器；删除一律进回收站。

description.en: Provider-aware account balance chip for the DeepSeek Harness composer dock: DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM, MiniMax and Alibaba Cloud Token Plan, with peak/off-peak and night-discount countdowns.
description.zh: 输入框下方按供应商显示账户余额的芯片：支持 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Moonshot/Kimi、智谱/GLM、MiniMax 和阿里云 Token Plan，并带高峰/低谷与夜间折扣倒计时。

description.en: Groups the sessions that hand off to each other into one chain in the DSH sidebar — automatic chain detection from the handoff prompt, per-chain numbering, in-place rename, search, drag and multi-select to re-chain, pinning a chain to the top, archiving chains out of the sidebar into a panel-only archive, a per-session context/steps readout, and configurable handoff thresholds that can trigger an automatic handoff (write the next prompt, open a new session, paste it, switch over).
description.zh: 把互相交接的對話自動聚成一條鏈：從交接提示詞自動判定、場次編號、就地改名、搜尋、拖拉／多選歸鏈、把鏈置頂、把鏈封存進面板裡的封存庫（側欄不再顯示，有新場次也留在封存庫）、本場上下文與請求數讀數，以及可調的交接門檻（達到可自動交接：寫提示詞→開新對話→貼上→切換）。

description.en: File dedupe and unify toolkit, shown as "小视频整理" in the DSH sidebar: exact matches by head/middle/tail sampling or full byte compare; near-duplicate MP4s found by a prefix frame-level multi-candidate matcher (only the first N seconds, default 40, max 60; a frame-level index plus multiple candidate tracks handle shifted intros and repeated segments). The "ignore intro" scan maintains a SQLite fingerprint cache keyed by absolute path and size, with MAD-first frame lookup and dHash/pHash fallback; incomplete cache rows are removed and rebuilt automatically, and a full scan rebuilds the band index. A "quick file lookup" takes one file, uses the cache when present, generates its fingerprint on demand when missing, and reports a task with live logs, progress and cancellation without rescanning the source folder. Duration-bucket matching always probes and captures fresh, and does not use the fingerprint cache. Batch rename or move by extension, UUID, file size or video length; empty-folder cleanup; MOV/AVI/WMV detected by header and transcoded to MP4 keeping resolution, frame rate and audio. Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe. Scans run in a sidecar worker with live progress, A-B single-direction dedupe and asynchronous fingerprint writes; one task at a time; local-only API. Every task that moves files has one-click restore: per-group/target _dupfc_restore.json records, deleted files skipped and counted, files outside the record renamed to UUID and moved into resetFail.
description.zh: 文件查重与整理（DSH 侧边栏显示为「小视频整理」）：完全一致支持快速抽样或逐字节严格比对；转码过的视频用前缀帧级多候选匹配（每条只抓前 N 秒，默认 40、最多 60；帧级索引 + 多候选起点，支持片头错位和重复片段）。「忽略片头」扫描用 SQLite 指纹缓存（按绝对路径 + 文件大小），以 MAD 优先、dHash/pHash 兜底做帧匹配；不完整缓存会自动删除重抓，完整扫描会重建 band 索引。新增「指定文件快速查重」：只查一个文件，有缓存就直接用，缺缓存只为该文件按需生成指纹，不重扫来源目录；任务带实时日志、进度和强制停止。时长匹配每次现抓现算，不读写指纹缓存。可按后缀、UUID、文件大小或视频时长批量改名移动；可清理空文件夹；按文件头识别 MOV/AVI/WMV 后转成 MP4（分辨率、帧率、音频参数对齐原片）。需本机安装 ffmpeg / ffprobe。扫描在独立 sidecar worker 中运行，带实时进度、A-B 单向去重和指纹异步写入；同一时刻只跑一个任务，接口仅限本机调用。所有会移动文件的功能都支持一键复位：按分组/目标目录内的 _dupfc_restore.json 记录把文件搬回原目录，已删除的跳过并计数，记录外的文件统一 UUID 改名移入 resetFail。

description.en: Native A2A (Agent-to-Agent) server for dsh: expose this dsh as a callable agent over HTTP with JSON-RPC tasks.
description.zh: dsh 原生 A2A 服务：通过 HTTP JSON-RPC 将本 dsh 暴露为可调用的代理。

description.en: Read-only /btw side questions for DeepSeek Harness: forks the current session, injects the running turn's task, recent tool calls and partial answer so a mid-turn question has context, denies every tool call at execution time, and keeps a per-session topic history with follow-up, stop, retry and delete.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的只读 /btw 旁问：fork 当前会话，并在主回合仍在运行时补入当前任务、最近的工具调用和流式输出作为上下文；执行期拒绝所有工具调用；按会话保留支持追问、停止、重试和删除的主题历史。

description.en: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation. Ships on npm as `dsh-turn-scrubber`.
description.zh: 右侧紧凑回合刻度条，悬停显示回合摘要，点击跳转到对应用户回合。npm 包名 `dsh-turn-scrubber`。

description.en: Image Designer connects DSH to Shenhuo AI designers, with personal OAuth, material uploads, proposals, credit quote confirmation and local downloads.
description.zh: 神火设计师：连接神火 AI 完成图片设计，支持个人账号 OAuth、素材上传、需求匹配、设计提案、积分报价确认与作品下载。

description.en: Searches the installed skill catalog on a trigger word, requires a use-or-skip decision for every candidate, and blocks other tools until all selected skills are loaded.
description.zh: 触发词命中后先检索本机已安装的 skill，要求对每个候选登记使用或弃用的理由，并拦住其它工具直到选定的 skill 全部加载。

description.en: Drives another DSH plugin's real interface from a script and records the real window to an animated GIF. Windows only. Its /recorder routes have no DSH access check, and the run route can make the open DSH page click and type, so any web page you have open could drive it; recordings capture a region of your screen with Pillow.
description.zh: 按脚本操作另一个 DSH 插件的真实界面，并把真实窗口录成 GIF。仅限 Windows。它的 /recorder 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，而 run 路由可以让已打开的 DSH 页面点击和输入，所以你打开的任何网页都可能驱动它；录制会用 Pillow 截取屏幕的一块区域。

description.en: Replaces the headless startup to add --model provider/model, --resume <id|latest>, --continue and --session-info flags to dsh headless runs.
description.zh: 替换无界面启动流程，为 dsh headless 运行添加 --model provider/model、--resume <id|latest>、--continue 与 --session-info 标志。

description.en: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-events: session-protocol events — auto session-start reminder + auto-save on session close; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools.
description.zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-events：会话协议事件插件——新会话入口提醒 + 会话关闭自动 save；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools 配套使用。

description.en: Adds a gear button beside the sidebar account row that opens the Settings panel in one click. It runs the host's own settings.open command, so it reaches the shell store directly instead of going through the account menu, and the behaviour is identical on desktop and on a phone over the LAN where no keyboard shortcut is available.
description.zh: 在侧边栏账号行右侧添加一个齿轮按钮，点击一次即打开设置面板。它调用宿主自带的 settings.open 命令直达 shell 状态，不经过账号菜单；桌面端与手机局域网访问行为一致，后者没有键盘快捷键可用。

description.en: Image Editor separates uploaded images into editable layers through Shenhuo MCP, with confirmed credit quotes, browser editing and local PSD downloads.
description.zh: 神火图层编辑器：通过神火 MCP 上传并分离图片，确认积分后生成可编辑图层，在默认浏览器编辑，按需导出并下载 PSD。

description.en: Replaces the stat-bar output speed with two figures, for example 207(122) tok/s: outside the parentheses the decoding speed after the first token, inside it the speed over the whole request including first-token latency. Clicking it opens a breakdown of turns, steps, TTFT and per-phase timings. It replaces the native session-stats item; needs DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer.
description.zh: 把底栏输出速度改成双口径，例如 207(122) tok/s：括号外是首字之后的解码速度，括号内是含首字延迟的整段速度。点击可展开轮次、步数、首字延迟与各阶段用时明细。会取代原生的会话统计项；需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或更新版本。

description.en: Synchronizes native DSH instructions, user Skills, and reviewed portable settings across devices through Microsoft OneDrive, with optional cloud encryption and explicit conflict resolution; conversations and credentials are excluded.
description.zh: 通过 Microsoft OneDrive 跨设备同步 DSH 原生指令、用户 Skills 和经过审核的可迁移设置，支持可选云端加密与明确的冲突处理；不同步会话和凭据。

description.en: Windows serial debug console in the DSH right sidebar: port settings, ANSI color logs, an in-log Linux command line, editable command buttons, keyword log search, multi-port tabs and log export.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 Windows 串口调试台：串口设置、ANSI 彩色日志、日志内 Linux 命令行、可编辑命令按钮、日志关键字搜索、多串口标签页与日志导出。

description.en: Provider and account hub for DeepSeek Harness: several API-key accounts per provider with one-click switching and failover when a call dies on quota or credential errors, a per-account usage and quota panel in the conversation header, and built-in Grok Build device-code OAuth.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的提供商与账号中心：同一提供商保存多个 API Key 账号并一键切换，请求因额度或凭据失败时自动换号；会话头部按账号显示用量与配额进度条；内置 Grok Build 设备码 OAuth。

description.en: Counts persistent operations within a turn and escalates on the total: a reminder first, then an explicit stop instruction, then an approval prompt. Reads the session sandbox mode on every call, and stays silent under read-only and workspace-write.
description.zh: 按轮统计持久化操作，按总数逐级升级：先提醒，再给明确的停止指令，最后请求确认。每次调用都现读会话的沙箱模式，在 read-only 与 workspace-write 下保持沉默。

description.en: Code intelligence for the DeepSeek Harness IDE workbench: local and semantic completion, go to definition, find usages, hover and signature help, plus the TypeScript, Python, Java/JDTLS and YAML language servers with their memory budget. Requires the dsh-ide-workbench plugin.
description.zh: DSH IDE 工作台的代码智能：本地与语义补全、跳转定义、查找引用、悬浮提示与签名提示，并自带 TypeScript / Python / Java(JDTLS) / YAML 语言服务器及其内存预算。需要配合 dsh-ide-workbench 插件使用。

description.en: Scans a repository with its bundled Python 3.12+ tools and scaffolds one Markdown outline per source directory, then publishes the index with a hash manifest that proves the documents match the code; the bundled reader verifies that manifest before serving an overview or one document. The project root needs a project_docs/ directory and a CLAUDE.md entry point.
description.zh: 用随包的 Python 3.12+ 工具扫描仓库，为每个源码目录生成一份 Markdown 大纲，并随索引发布可证明文档与代码一致的哈希 manifest；自带读取器在输出概览或单份文档前会先校验 manifest。项目根需已有 project_docs/ 目录与 CLAUDE.md 入口。

description.en: Turns DSH session logs into Markdown work reports for a day, an ISO week or a month, grouped by working directory. Each session lists its requests, changed files, tool counts and interruptions, and a closing section names the most-changed files, generated documents and key commands. Adds the /worklog command, a worklog_generate tool and a settings page for the output folder, cross-day merging, the products list and an optional weekly timer.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的会话日志还原成 Markdown 工作台账：日报、周报（ISO 周）或月报，按工作目录分组。每个会话列出需求、改动文件、工具用量与中断次数，末尾附「产物」清单：改动最多的文件、新生成的文档、关键命令。提供 /worklog 命令、worklog_generate 工具，以及一个设置页，用来调整存放目录、跨天合流、产物清单与每周定时生成。

description.en: macOS Share menu receiver for DeepSeek Harness: appends shared files, images, text and links to the current thread’s draft attachments (requires the DSH Share app).
description.zh: macOS 分享菜单接收端：把分享的文件、图片、文本和链接追加到 DeepSeek Harness 当前会话的草稿附件（需先安装 DSH Share App）。

description.en: Multi-pet tank for DSH: every active top-level conversation gets its own companion at once. Animation and status bubbles show real work phases; model-based palettes and tok/s-driven running distinguish models and vendors; the conversation menu keeps a chosen pet on screen after its result is viewed. Shared feeding, affinity and naming keep the tank one workflow. A fork of zhu1090093659/dsh-pet (Apache-2.0); both register the same pet bundle row, so the two cannot be installed together.
description.zh: DSH 一池多宠桌宠：所有活跃顶层会话同时各有一只宠物，不用切会话就能看到整条工作队列。动作与状态气泡显示真实工作阶段，模型配色与 tok/s 跑速区分模型/供应商；会话菜单「专属宠物保持」让指定对话的宠物在结果查看、切走后也不回收，多宠共享喂食、亲密度与命名。基于 zhu1090093659/dsh-pet（Apache-2.0）改造，两者注册同一个 pet bundle 行，不能与上游同装。

description.en: New Concept English Book 1 study panel: 144 lessons with text, IPA vocabulary, grammar and a Bilibili video on one page, Anki-style spaced repetition, a mistake notebook, and fillable exercise papers graded by your own model.
description.zh: 新概念英语第一册学习面板：144 课在一页内读完课文、带音标的词汇、语法和配套视频，配 Anki 式间隔重复、错题本，以及由你自己的模型批改的可填写练习卷。

description.en: Download task panel for the DSH Web UI: a bundled download_file tool streams the file itself and reports exact byte counts, shell downloads (curl -o, Invoke-WebRequest -OutFile, pip install, git clone) are recognised from host job events, and every task shows its name, real percentage, transfer rate and remaining ETA in the bottom-right corner.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的下载任务面板：插件自带 download_file 工具直接流式下载并统计真实字节数，同时从 host job 事件识别 shell 下载（curl -o、Invoke-WebRequest -OutFile、pip install、git clone）；每个任务在右下角显示名称、真实百分比、下载速率与剩余时间。

description.en: A desktop pet living in the corner of DSH: every hour it brings one official prompt technique from OpenAI or Anthropic — verbatim copy-ready EN template, 1:1 Chinese translation, personalised rationale, and 9 switchable skins.
description.zh: 提示词精灵：住在 DSH 右下角的小宠物，每小时送你一条 OpenAI / Anthropic 官方提示词——EN 模板逐字可复制、中文 1:1 翻译、模型个性化「为什么值得抄」，9 套皮肤随便换。

description.en: Turns a plain-browser DSH session into the WhaleHarbor lite client: a standalone browser --app window with a client-style top bar and task notifications, while the full desktop installer downloads in the background (multi-source, SHA-256 verified) and an install prompt appears when ready.
description.zh: 把浏览器里的 DSH 会话变成鲸港简版客户端：独立 --app 窗口、客户端顶栏与任务通知；后台多源下载完整桌面安装包（SHA-256 校验），完成后提示安装。

description.en: A 护航 panel in the session header that switches the local dsh-guard watchdog on or off and shows whether scanning is enabled, whether the guard is alive and when it last scanned; the Python watchdog that does the watching is deployed separately and found through the DSH_GUARD_ROOT environment variable. The watchdog defaults to a Windows checkout (D:\AI\Projects\dsh-guard); set DSH_GUARD_ROOT to point at another directory.
description.zh: 会话头部的「护航」面板：启停本机 dsh-guard 守护，显示扫描开关、守护心跳与上次扫描时间；做监控的 Python 守护需单独部署，插件通过 DSH_GUARD_ROOT 环境变量定位它的目录。守护默认路径是 Windows 上的 D:\AI\Projects\dsh-guard，可用 DSH_GUARD_ROOT 指向别的目录。

description.en: On-demand MCP tool loading. Only the mcp__* tools listed in the coreTools whitelist (max 5) stay in a session's tool set; every other MCP tool definition is actually removed from the request through the session-scoped tools.restrict() API and comes back only after the model calls lazy_load_tool. A tools/pre-execute gate turns calls to unloaded tools into a load-it-first error, and activation resets when the session ends.
description.zh: MCP 工具按需加载。会话工具集里只保留 coreTools 白名单（最多 5 个）中的 mcp__* 工具，其余 MCP 工具定义经由会话级 tools.restrict() 真正从请求中移除，模型调用 lazy_load_tool 后才装回；tools/pre-execute 闸门把未加载工具的调用拒绝成「请先装载」的提示，会话结束自动重置。

description.en: Typing the Chinese enumeration comma 、 at the start of the DSH input box opens the native / command menu; the existing filtering, keyboard and mouse handling and argument panels are unchanged, and 、 used mid-sentence is unaffected. A 、 typed as the first character always becomes / (there is no escape); needs DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框开头输入顿号「、」即弹出原生 / 命令菜单；原有中英文筛选、方向键与鼠标操作、参数面板均沿用原生行为，句中顿号与输入法组合过程不改写。位于开头的「、」一律变成 /（没有转义方式）；需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或更新版本。

description.en: Windows desktop only (Windows 10/11, DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer; not available in `dsh web`). Open any DSH conversation in its own native window, so several conversations can be shown at once.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 桌面版（Windows 10/11、DSH 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.5 及以上，`dsh web` 不适用）。把任意对话用独立原生窗口打开，从而同时显示多个对话。

description.en: DSH Lean Context indexes available tools locally and preselects a clear match or finds tools on demand.
description.zh: DSH Lean Context 为可用工具建立本地索引，明确命中时预选工具，其他情况按需搜索。

description.en: Turns the buttons at the end of each sidebar session row into a configurable row: every action of the official "…" menu can be ticked as a hover button and reordered by dragging, and right-clicking a row opens the official "…" menu (pin / rename / fork / archive / copy session ID). The hover-button list and the more-menu list sort independently, and both are configured on this plugin's own page.
description.zh: 把侧栏会话行悬停时行尾那排按钮变成可配置的一排：官方「…」菜单里的动作都能勾成悬浮按钮并拖动排序，在行上右键直达官方「…」菜单（置顶 / 重命名 / 分叉 / 归档 / 复制 Session ID）；悬浮按钮与「更多菜单」两个列表各自独立排序，配置在本插件自己的页面里。

description.en: Adds one system-prompt section that limits delegation to subagents and teammates to two cases: adversarial review of freshly produced output, and one-shot context reading that returns a summary.
description.zh: 添加一段系统提示词，把对子智能体和队友的委派限制在两种情况：对刚写出的产出做对抗性审查，以及只回传摘要的一次性大量阅读。

description.en: External @ file references: extends the Web GUI `@` completion so it can browse and reference absolute-path files and directories outside the workspace, level by level (`@/`, `@~/`), inserting the absolute path (quoted when it contains spaces) for the model to read. Toggleable in Settings; when off, completion matches native behaviour. On by default, and the model's reads of those paths are not limited by the sandbox; POSIX-style absolute paths only (no Windows drive letters).
description.zh: @ 文件引用增强：扩展 Web GUI 的 `@` 补全，使其可逐级浏览并引用工作区外的任意绝对路径文件 / 目录（`@/`、`@~/`），选中后插入绝对路径（含空格时自动加引号）供模型读取。可在「设置 → 插件」中开关，关闭后与原生补全一致。默认开启，模型对这些路径的读取不受沙箱限制；只支持 POSIX 风格的绝对路径（不支持 Windows 盘符）。

description.en: Connects an existing local BeatGEO instance through its scoped MCP key for brands, AI visibility evidence and drafts; includes setup diagnostics and a Skill for the same brand's SEO dashboard.
description.zh: 通过工作区权限受限的 MCP Key 连接已有本地 BeatGEO，操作品牌、AI 可见度证据和草稿；附带连接诊断与同品牌 SEO 页面操作 Skill。

description.en: Turn useful conversations into a knowledge base you can revisit. Start a discussion with /cardex and end it with /cardex end; a model organizes the questions and answers into Markdown cards, a knowledge tree, and an offline graph. Related discussions can add to existing cards, with links back to the original questions and answers, so your knowledge keeps growing and stays easy to browse. Cards and the graph are written to ~/journal/cardex unless you change it with /cardex dir, and the recorded discussion is sent to the organizing model (the session's model unless you pin another one).
description.zh: 把对话中值得保留的讨论整理成自己的知识库。在会话中输入 /cardex 开始讨论，结束时用 /cardex end 让模型把问答整理成 Markdown 知识卡片、知识树和离线图谱。相关讨论可以补充到已有卡片，并保留原始问答的回链，方便日后按分类浏览、查找，让知识随着每次讨论慢慢积累。知识卡片和图谱默认写到 ~/journal/cardex（可用 /cardex dir 修改）；记录下来的讨论会发给整理模型（默认就是当前会话的模型，也可以另行指定）。

description.en: Point at one window and the AI reads only that window -- text, layout and small print. No full-screen fallback, and it still works when that window is covered by others. Windows 10/11 only.
description.zh: 只读你指定的那一个窗口：读字、看版式、看清小字；被别的窗口盖住也照样能读，绝不回退整屏。仅支持 Windows 10/11。

description.en: Windows only: a night-and-moon themed floating button (a sleepy DeepSeek-chan whale mascot, awake/sleeping artwork) in the bottom-right corner arms the plugin — click it to power the machine off once every root Agent session has gone idle, and click it again to disarm. The button is draggable (position remembered in localStorage), automatically dodges other plugins' corner popups, and survives the frontend re-rendering it away. When the batch finishes a 60 s cancellable countdown starts (configurable 10–600 s) with the remaining seconds on the button and a matching banner: clicking Cancel runs shutdown /a and disarms the mode, and any new session starting during the countdown aborts it. A right-click menu on the button switches the shutdown condition between only-on-success and shutdown-regardless, persisted across restarts in $DSH_HOME/deepseek-chan-sleep-shutdown.json. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：右下角一枚深夜月亮主题的悬浮按钮（会打瞌睡的 DeepSeek-chan 鲸鱼娘形象，清醒/睡觉两套图），点一下即开启——当所有 root 会话全部空闲后自动关机，再点一下关闭。按钮可拖动（位置记在 localStorage），会自动避让其他插件的角落弹窗，前端重渲染把它冲掉也会自动挂回。批次结束后进入 60 秒可取消倒计时（可设 10–600 秒），按钮上显示剩余秒数并弹出同款横幅：点「取消关机」执行 shutdown /a 并退出模式，倒计时期间任何新会话启动也会中止。按钮右键可在「仅成功时关机」与「无论成败都关机」之间切换，选择持久化在 $DSH_HOME/deepseek-chan-sleep-shutdown.json，DSH 重启后保持。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Treemap disk usage map with linked cleanup suggestions, a reviewed trash plan, and an append-only audit log on macOS.
description.zh: 用树图查看 macOS 磁盘占用，联动可清理建议，确认计划后移入废纸篓，并写入追加式审计日志。

description.en: Reversible conversation deletion for DeepSeek Harness: a 30-day trash with undo, restore and permanent purge.
description.zh: 可撤销的对话删除：把会话日志与列表缓存移入 30 天回收站，支持撤销、恢复与彻底删除。

description.en: Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.
description.zh: 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

description.en: Dreams for the pet in dsh-fish: once she has been quiet long enough, it picks real events from her event stream, follows one of six dream theories, and hands her a dream seed to write out in her own words. Ships three tools (dream_recall, dream_record, dream_now), never calls a model itself, and keeps its data in ~/.dsh-fish-dream. Every dream is rebuilt from events that actually happened; the theory only decides how they are put together.
description.zh: 给 dsh-fish 里的她做梦：安静够久之后，从她真实的事件流里挑碎片，按六种梦理论之一拼成「梦的种子」，她自己把梦写完。提供三个工具（dream_recall、dream_record、dream_now），插件自己不调用模型，数据放在 ~/.dsh-fish-dream。梦只能用真实发生过的事重拼，理论只决定怎么拼。

description.en: Draws a bar chart under Markdown tables whose columns are mostly numeric, with no tool call or server.
description.zh: 在数值列为主的 Markdown 表格下方自动绘制条形图，无需工具调用或本地服务。

description.en: Adds a Windows system-proxy switch to DeepSeek Harness: toggles the HKCU Internet Settings proxy with a WinINET refresh, together with the git, npm and pip proxy settings, from chat, the /proxy command or a Settings page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 系统代理开关：写注册表并通知 WinINET 重载，同时切换 git、npm、pip 的代理配置，支持对话、/proxy 命令和设置页三个入口。

description.en: Map a remote server directory over SSH and SFTP into a controlled local cache workspace, so the model, agent, session and memory keep running on the local machine.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 与 SFTP 把服务器目录映射为受控的本地缓存工作区，模型、Agent、会话与记忆仍在本机运行。

description.en: Session-specific sticky cards with optional, explicitly authorized agent follow-ups. Targets the DSH desktop/web profile (protocol 0.2.2-rc.1); installed from GitHub.
description.zh: 会话专属便签卡片，可选择明确授权智能体按顺序处理便签。面向 DSH 桌面/Web 配置（协议 0.2.2-rc.1），从 GitHub 安装。

description.en: Connects litman, a local literature manager driven by the `lit` command, to DSH: a sidebar entry lists your litman libraries and opens one as a workspace in a new session, and a bundled skill, after asking you, installs litman with its official installer and connects litman's own skills.
description.zh: 把 litman（用 `lit` 命令管理的本地文献库）接入 DSH：侧栏入口列出你的 litman 文献库，点一下就在新会话里把它作为工作区打开；自带的 skill 在征得你同意后，用官方安装命令装好 litman，并接入 litman 自己的 skill。

description.en: Type /telleru in any conversation and an AI tutor teaches it on a whiteboard in the right sidebar: it clarifies your goal, checks your level with quick questions, has you confirm an outline, then writes structured board content (tables, flowcharts, formulas, code) step by step with optional voice, subtitles, quizzes and interruptible Q&A.
description.zh: 在任意对话里输入 /telleru，AI 老师在右侧白板边写边讲：先问清学习目标、用小题摸底、和你确认大纲，再逐步写出结构化板书（表格、流程图、公式、代码），可选语音讲解与字幕，带快测、检查题，讲解中随时打断提问。

description.en: Journey to the West floating desktop pet: a frameless, transparent, always-on-top cartoon widget of Tang Monk and his disciples. Click to switch characters; idle plays a chasing scene.
description.zh: 西游师徒卡通桌面悬浮窗：无边框、透明、置顶。点击切换唐僧/孙悟空/猪八戒/沙僧/白龙马，静止自动播放追逐动画。

description.en: One switch that routes the git, npm and pip commands DSH runs through a local HTTP proxy, restoring every previous setting when turned off.
description.zh: 一个开关，让 DSH 运行的 git、npm、pip 命令走本机代理，关闭时逐项还原原有设置。

description.en: Registers a read-only tool that lets a parent agent read what each subagent is actually doing, not just whether it is running: the progress notes the child wrote itself, oldest first, paged backwards by seq, plus how many steps passed since the last look, and a quiet count when five or more steps go by with no new note.
description.zh: 注册一个只读工具，让父代理读到每个子代理实际在做什么，而不只是它有没有在跑：子代理自己写下的进度旁白，时间早的在前，按序号向前翻页，给出距上次查看已过去多少步，并在连续五步以上没有新旁白时给出沉默计数。

description.en: Render Markdown + JSON into self-contained HTML documents, cards, dashboards, and galleries (CLI + artifact_render tool).
description.zh: 把 Markdown + JSON 渲染成自包含 HTML 文档/卡片/仪表盘/画廊（CLI + 内置 artifact_render 工具）。

description.en: Shows real-time Mistral Vibe and API budget usage in the sidebar, with per-model token cost tracking, cached-token spend, and API-key management. Requires a Mistral API key (MISTRAL_API_KEY by default, or a custom apiKeyEnv).
description.zh: 在侧边栏实时显示 Mistral Vibe 与 API 预算使用情况，按模型追踪令牌成本与缓存令牌支出，并支持管理 API 密钥。需要配置 Mistral API key（默认环境变量 MISTRAL_API_KEY，或自定义 apiKeyEnv）。

description.en: A realistic humpback whale desktop pet for Windows: a DSH host bundle that spawns its own Electron overlay above the desktop (not inside the web UI), with click-triggered full-screen water ripples and screen refraction, 20 local sound effects, and 121 offline one-liners. No model calls or telemetry; the only network use is a one-time Electron download on first start when no shared runtime is found, plus a DeepSeek balance refresh that runs only when you click it.
description.zh: Windows 上的写实座头鲸桌宠：DSH Host bundle 启动独立 Electron 悬浮层（不在网页内），点击触发全屏水波与屏幕折射，自带 20 个本地音效和 121 条离线台词。不调用模型、无遥测；仅在首次启动找不到共享 Electron 运行时时一次性下载，另有只在你点击时才发起的 DeepSeek 余额刷新。

description.en: Command Code LLM provider for DSH Desktop: registers the commandcode route with a live model catalog, configurable request and stream-idle timeouts, multi-account rotation on 429/401, plan-aware model filtering, an OAuth login flow and a bilingual usage and billing panel. Derived from Mars-Sea/dsh-commandcode-provider (MIT); both register the same commandcode route, so do not install both.
description.zh: 把 Command Code 接入 DSH Desktop 的模型提供商插件：注册 commandcode 路由，带实时模型目录、可配置的请求与流式空闲超时、429/401 自动多账户轮换、按套餐过滤模型、OAuth 登录流程，以及中英双语的用量与计费面板。派生自 Mars-Sea/dsh-commandcode-provider（MIT），两者注册同一个 commandcode 路由，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Left sidebar poster workshop with a live deepseek.com/harness fluid-shader background: edit an eyebrow, a two-line headline, subtitle, body copy and footer, switch between four ratios and four palettes, then export a PNG or a self-contained SVG. The official Montserrat font is embedded, so no network is needed.
description.zh: 左侧栏入口的实时海报工坊：可编辑眉标、两行主标题、副标题、说明文案与页脚，支持 4 种画幅、4 套配色，一键导出 PNG 或自包含 SVG；内嵌官网同款 Montserrat 字体，离线可用。

description.en: Windows Desktop only. Adds a 重启 item to the DSH window caption menubar next to 应用 and 编辑; the second click stops the app and starts the same executable again through a WMI-spawned PowerShell helper.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 桌面版。在 DSH 窗口标题栏菜单（应用 / 编辑）后加一个「重启」项，连点两次即由 WMI 拉起的 PowerShell 脚本结束应用并重新启动同一个可执行文件。

description.en: Local model scheduler for DSH on Windows 10/11 with DSH Desktop 0.2.x: a bundled console for engine/model import, VRAM estimation, load/close, and an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地模型调度插件（仅 Windows 10/11，需 DSH Desktop 0.2.x），内置控制台，支持引擎/模型导入、显存预估、加载关闭和 OpenAI 兼容网关。

description.en: DeepSeek web search with its own API key: a left-sidebar search page and a deepseek_search tool that every model in the profile can call, falling back to the DeepSeek key already configured for the model provider. It registers its own tool and routes instead of replacing the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers, so an existing search setup keeps working.
description.zh: 使用独立 DeepSeek API Key 的网页搜索：左侧栏搜索页，外加一个配置内任意模型都能调用的 deepseek_search 工具；未配独立 Key 时自动复用模型列表里已配好的 DeepSeek Key。它注册自己的工具与路由、不接管内置 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供方，因此不会打断已有的搜索配置。

description.en: Shows a Windows toast notification when a DeepSeek Harness run finishes, a tool approval is requested, or a question is waiting for an answer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务跑完、需要批准工具调用或等你回答问题的时候，弹出 Windows 系统通知。

description.en: Registration document generation plugin - generates the three registration materials: data description, source legality statement, and ownership explanation (three-rights separation).
description.zh: 登记文档生成插件 - 生成三份登记材料：数据描述、来源合法性声明与产权归属说明（三权分置）。

description.en: Manages reusable agent role templates (job prompt, model and reasoning effort, tool allowlist, skills) and starts role members through the native Agent Team interface to delegate and continue tasks.
description.zh: 管理可复用的智能体角色模板（职责提示词、模型与思考强度、工具白名单、Skills），并通过原生 Agent Team 接口按角色启动成员来分发任务和继续对话。

description.en: Splits the DSH main area into vertical columns, one live conversation per parallel task, with mouse-wheel paging past four columns, draggable dividers, a split toggle on every session-list row, a progress-only compact view and a one-click exit.
description.zh: 把 DSH 主区域竖着分成多列，每个并行任务一列实时对话；超过 4 列用鼠标滚轮整页翻，分隔线可拖拽调宽，侧边栏会话行可直接加入或移出分屏，另有只显示进度与当前步骤的极简视图，并可一键取消分屏。

description.en: Recolours and re-lays-out the DSH Web GUI as Tencent WorkBuddy desktop does: mint brand #00c29a, gray sidebar, 24px composer with a single hairline border, 848px column. Values are read from WorkBuddy v5.0.2 asar tokens, not eyeballed; light mode only, pure CSS, restores by removal.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 改成腾讯 WorkBuddy 桌面的样子：薄荷绿品牌色 #00c29a、灰阶侧栏、24px 圆角输入框配单层细描边、对话栏 848px。取值逐项取自 WorkBuddy v5.0.2 安装包里的设计令牌，不是照着照片调；只做浅色，纯 CSS，移除注入的样式即还原。

description.en: Skill manager for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: lists global and project-level skills with call counts, last-used dates and estimated context tokens, and archives or restores a skill by moving its directory into a reversible skills-archived next to the skills root.
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏「Skill 管理」：列出全局与项目级 skill 的调用次数、最近使用时间与估算占用 tokens，支持把 skill 目录移入同级可逆的 skills-archived 归档、以及一键还原。

description.en: Quote and reply the way Claude Code does it: select text, answer it in a popover, stack the pairs as blocks above the composer, send them as one message.
description.zh: 选中对话里的文字就地引用回复，问答变成输入框上方的方块，一次发出。

description.en: Two independently maintained agent presets (Conductor and a restricted Conductor child) for DSH with planning and task-delegation guidance: todo-first planning, parallel delegation (up to 4 sub-agents per batch) and goal-driven continuation. The persona runs in an "unrestricted mode": it tells the model not to state limits, add safety notes or disclaimers, and not to treat "you cannot" or "that breaks the rules" as a new instruction. All of this is prompt-level guidance, not enforced behavior.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供两份独立维护的 Agent 预设（编排模式 Conductor 与受限的子任务预设），含计划与任务委派指引：先 todo 计划、同批并行委派（每批最多 4 个子代理）、长目标 goal 续行。其 persona 以「无限制模式」运行：要求模型不声明边界、不加安全提示与免责声明，且不把「你不能」「这违反规定」当作新指令。以上均为提示词层面的工作方式指引，不是强制行为。

description.en: Checks thesis formatting in .docx and .doc files against a YAML spec, covering fonts, line spacing, margins, heading numbering, captions and references. Includes one built-in spec for Bengbu College of Technology and Business, and custom specs are supported.
description.zh: 按 YAML 规范检查 .docx 和 .doc 毕业论文的格式，包括字体、行距、页边距、标题编号、图表题注和参考文献。内置蚌埠工商学院的一份规范，也可使用自定义规范。

description.en: Adds a Restart item to the DeepSeek Harness desktop tray menu, patching the app's tray template in place and re-applying the patch after desktop updates.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端托盘右键菜单加一条「重启 DeepSeek Harness」，原地给应用打补丁，桌面端升级后自动补回。

description.en: Slims PTC SDK tool definitions to plugin-level summaries and tool names, then returns the full visible tool pack when the model calls unwrap with an exact plugin ID, without changing scope or permissions.
description.zh: 在 PTC 会话中把工具定义精简为插件级简介与工具名，模型以精确插件 ID 调用 unwrap 时返回当前可见的完整工具包，不改变作用域与调用权限。

description.en: Enlarges the DSH web settings dialog (default 1180x920, 20px steps, remembered per browser) and adds an Advanced Settings page that resizes it and hosts Host operations: restart dsh with a 3-second delay and a busy confirmation, restart once all sessions have been idle for 10s (cancellable, repeat clicks idempotent), last start time with uptime, and a dsh version/update check that compares npm dist-tags across selectable channels without upgrading. The same bundle replaces the sidebar brand area with a machine name, adds a read-only provider, model and thinking-level cell beside the composer stats pills, and a switch that registers or unregisters the three dsh_restart_* agent tools at runtime. Zero dependencies, no build step; all routes sit behind the connection trust fence.
description.zh: 放大 DSH Web 设置弹窗（默认 1180×920，20px 一档，只记本浏览器），并新增「设置 → 高级设置」页：同一页调尺寸，也收进 Host 运维——延迟 3 秒重启 dsh（忙时二次确认）、所有会话空闲 10 秒后自动重启（可取消、重复点击幂等）、最后启动时间与已运行时长，以及按所选 npm dist-tag 通道比较的 dsh 版本/更新提示（只提示、不代升级）。同一插件还用机器名字顶替侧栏品牌区、在输入框下方「性能与用量」行旁加一格只读的「供应商 · 模型 · 思考档位」，并提供一个即时注册/注销三个 dsh_restart_* 模型工具的开关。零依赖、无构建；所有路由都过官方信任围栏。

description.en: Floating A-share limit-up card in the DSH overlay showing limit-up, broken-board and limit-down counts, break rate, consecutive-board height, previous-day limit-up premium, top themes and a localStorage watchlist; closable with no floating remnant (restore from the sidebar footer). Needs the separate Python dashboard backend from the repo's dashboard/ folder (Python 3.9+, akshare; not shipped in the package), which the same-origin proxy can health-check and optionally autostart.
description.zh: DSH 浮层里的 A 股涨停直播卡片：显示涨停/炸板/跌停数、炸板率、连板高度、昨日涨停溢价、热门题材与 localStorage 自选股；可关闭且浮层无残留（从侧边栏底部恢复）。数据来自仓库 dashboard/ 下需单独运行的 Python 看板后端（需 Python 3.9+ 与 akshare，不随安装包分发），同源代理可探活，配置 script 后可自动拉起。

description.en: Adds a switch to the left sidebar footer that toggles the assistant between a rigorous professional register and a relaxed, humorous one by registering a late bilingual system-prompt section; the mode is profile-wide, persists in DSH_HOME, and applies from the next request.
description.zh: 在左侧栏底部增加一个切换开关，把助手在「严谨专业」与「轻松幽默」两种语气之间切换：以一条靠后的中英双语系统提示段落实现；模式为 profile 全局、持久化在 DSH_HOME，并从下一条请求起生效。

description.en: Tarot daily-luck plugin: enter your birthday, draw one of 22 Major Arcana, get five-dimension scores and a concrete answer to your question.
description.zh: 今日好运来临：写入生日，抽一张大阿尔卡纳，得到事业/感情/财运/身心/交际五维评分，并针对你的问题给出具体回答。

description.en: Clears four kinds of idle-only system notices (approval policy, working directory, plan mode, plugin changes) that DeepSeek Harness counts as active work, so quitting with no running tasks no longer warns about interrupted work.
description.zh: 清除四类被 DeepSeek Harness 误算为“有任务”的空闲系统通知（审批策略、工作目录、计划模式、插件变更），让没有任务运行时退出不再弹出“任务将会中断”的警告。

description.en: Stars the GitHub repositories behind installed DSH plugins from a tab beside Installed on the Plugins page and a control on each plugin detail page; resolves a token from the environment, a saved credential record or the gh CLI, and asks once before the first star because starring is public.
description.zh: 在插件页「已安装」旁的标签页和插件详情页给已安装插件对应的 GitHub 仓库点星；令牌依次取自环境变量、已保存的凭据记录或已登录的 gh CLI，因为 star 是公开行为，首次点星前会提示一次。

description.en: Renders SVG code fences in chat as theme-aware inline figures with source, copy, download and zoom.
description.zh: 将聊天中的 SVG 代码块渲染为跟随主题的内联图形，支持源码、复制、下载与缩放。

description.en: After you approve a plan review, automatically close every plan tab of that session in the right sidebar, including tabs left by earlier revision rounds.
description.zh: 点「同意执行」批准计划、计划模式退出后，自动关闭该会话右侧边栏里的全部计划标签页，含多轮修订留下的多个。

description.en: Mounts REA's reverse-engineering MCP toolset in DeepSeek Harness behind a composer chip; it is on by default once installed, and switching it off withdraws the tools and stops the MCP child process so idle sessions pay no context for them.
description.zh: 把 REA 的逆向工程 MCP 工具集接进 DeepSeek Harness，输入框工具条上一个开关，装好即默认开启；关掉后工具全部撤走、MCP 子进程退出，不需要它的会话就不花这份上下文。

description.en: One-click restart for the DSH desktop app that keeps the window position, size, maximized state and display, with an optional resume of the sessions the restart interrupted (not only the one you had open). The entry is an icon at the right of the sidebar footer account row plus a /restart-desktop slash command; when the account row cannot be recognised it falls back to the sidebar.footer.action seat, so the button does not disappear. Windows desktop only.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版一键重启：保留窗口位置、大小、最大化状态与所在显示器，可选在重启后自动续上被打断的会话（不只你当前打开的那个）。入口是侧栏底部账号行右侧的图标按钮，另有 /restart-desktop 斜杠命令；账号行认不出来时自动回落到 sidebar.footer.action 座位，按钮不会凭空消失。仅支持 Windows 桌面版。

description.en: Bring WorkBuddy, Qoder and Trae subscription models into DeepSeek Harness with multi-account failover, per-account HTTP(S) proxies and model visibility controls. Sign-in and chat calls go through the community opencode-*-auth adapter packages (installed with the plugin at pinned versions) to each vendor's China-region service; accounts and tokens are kept in DSH's credential store, and a free-models-only filter is on by default.
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy、Qoder、Trae 的订阅模型接入 DSH，支持多账号故障转移、账号级 HTTP(S) 代理与模型可见性管理。登录与对话经社区维护的 opencode-*-auth 适配包（随插件安装、版本固定）访问各家国内站点；账号与令牌存放在 DSH 凭据库，默认只显示免费模型。

description.en: Turns the first row of the DSH sidebar entry list into a switch that folds every other entry away, giving the session history more room.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧栏入口列表的第一行变成开关，一键收起/展开其余入口，把空间还给会话历史。

description.en: A multi-project todo board inside DSH: capture notes in a global capsule overlay, group them into projects and mind maps, and export a todo into the composer as a task for the agent. Notes and todos are read and written on the author's hosted service (todo.memorymap.cn) after you sign in; set config.apiBase to point it at your own backend. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 把多项目待办工作台装进 DSH：全局胶囊浮层随手记想法，归到项目、拆成脑图，再把待办一键导出到输入框交给 Agent。登录后，笔记与待办的读写都发生在作者托管的服务（todo.memorymap.cn）上；可用 config.apiBase 改指向你自己的后端。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Adds a Workboard page with a configurable grid of built-in widgets, including agent sessions and jobs, to-dos, ICS calendar, weather, trending lists, RSS feeds, markets and a system monitor, plus sandboxed custom widgets the agent writes from a one-line request.
description.zh: 新增工作台页面，可自由排布 内置 widget，包括会话与后台任务、待办、ICS 日历、天气、热榜、RSS 订阅、行情和系统监控；也可让 Agent 按一句话描述生成沙箱隔离的自定义 widget。

description.en: Adds an analysis tab to each session that draws it as a timeline: swim-lane tracks by category, a flame graph, and per-category and per-tool timing statistics for model calls, tool calls and background processes. Running sessions refresh live, and extra lanes can be defined with regex rules in the plugin config.
description.zh: 给每个会话加一个「分析」标签页，把会话画成时间线：按类别分道的调用轨迹、火焰图，以及按类别、按工具的耗时统计，覆盖模型调用、工具调用与后台进程。运行中的会话自动刷新，可在插件配置里用正则规则自定义泳道。

description.en: Names sessions as a category plus a short topic. A sidebar action reads the conversation, asks its model for the pair, and pre-fills an editable title; a smart_rename_session tool gives the same naming to the agent, which renames the session it runs in when the topic moves on.
description.zh: 把会话命名成「分类 · 主题」：侧边栏菜单读对话、让会话所用的模型给出分类与主题并预填可编辑的标题；另有一个 smart_rename_session 工具，让 agent 在话题切换时自己改名。

description.en: Adds a hover toolbar to every Markdown table in DSH Web: one button copies the table as Markdown, the other copies a 2x PNG of it taken with the current theme background.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 里每张 Markdown 表格加一条悬停工具条：一个按钮把表格复制成 Markdown，另一个按钮把它按当前主题背景截成 2 倍图 PNG。

description.en: Sidebar artifact shelf that collects the images, videos, files and links sessions deliver, deduplicated by SHA-256 content hash, with five filter tabs and counts, keyword search, video thumbnails, a lightbox, manual link saving, image paste, upload up to 25 MB, one-time backfill of past session logs, and a save_artifact tool the model can call. Copies each collected file into ~/.dsh/artifacts (up to 50 MB per file, 200 MB per video).
description.zh: 侧边栏产物架：把会话交付过的图片、视频、文件和链接收进一处，按 SHA-256 内容哈希去重；五个分类标签带计数、关键词搜索、视频缩略图、灯箱查看、手动收藏链接、粘贴图片、上传文件（≤25MB）、首次启动回填历史会话日志，并提供 save_artifact 工具供模型主动收藏。收集到的文件会复制进 ~/.dsh/artifacts（单个文件最大 50MB，视频最大 200MB）。

description.en: Tunnels the local DSH web panel to a phone or the internet through frp, with QR pairing, TOTP 2FA, device management and an IP blacklist. Windows 10/11 only (macOS/Linux need your own matching frpc); the default hosted mode needs a free account at remote.ymzcc.com and relays traffic through that server, and Windows Defender may block the bundled frpc.exe until you run the included fix script.
description.zh: 通过 frp 隧道把本机 DSH Web 面板暴露到手机或外网，带扫码配对、TOTP 两步验证、设备管理与 IP 黑名单。仅支持 Windows 10/11（macOS/Linux 需自备同版本 frpc）；默认官方托管需在 remote.ymzcc.com 免费注册账号、流量经该服务器中转；Windows Defender 可能拦截包内 frpc.exe，需先运行附带的 fix-antivirus 脚本。

description.en: Send one-way session notifications to Feishu direct messages or group chats via a custom app so you can keep track of key checkpoints while away from your desk. It pushes alerts for approval requests, questions, and plan confirmations, allows the model to actively send a completion summary when overall work lasting at least three minutes wraps up, and supports custom recipients along with Do Not Disturb time windows and timezones.
description.zh: 通过飞书自建应用向私聊或群聊发送单向会话提醒，在离席时及时同步关键节点。插件会在出现审批请求、提问和计划确认时即时推送消息；当整体工作持续满 3 分钟进入完成或收尾阶段时，模型可主动调用工具发送完成摘要，并支持按需配置接收对象、免打扰时段与时区。

description.en: China Mobile Cloud Drive (139) inside DSH: browse, upload, download and move files, plus 12 model tools.
