Its /api/dsh-mcloud routes (sign-in, list, download, move, delete) are mounted with webServer.register without DSH Host/Origin admission, so a web page open in your browser can act on the signed-in cloud drive through them.
description.zh: 中国移动云盘（139）接入 DSH：浏览、上传、下载、转移网盘文件，并提供 12 个模型工具。它的 /api/dsh-mcloud 路由（登录、列目录、下载、移动、删除）通过 webServer.register 挂载，没有 DSH 的 Host/Origin 准入检查，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能经由它们操作已登录的云盘。

description.en: Right-click selected text in a chat answer or a right-sidebar preview (Markdown, text, code, PDF, Office, Excel) to quote it to the model together with its source — file path, heading and line range, or page number (Excel: the current cell and sheet) — then send it at once or insert it into the composer for editing.
description.zh: 在会话回答或右侧栏文档预览（Markdown、文本、代码、PDF、Office、Excel）里选中文字后右键，带着来源（文件路径、标题与行号范围，或页码；Excel 为当前单元格与工作表）引用给模型，可直接发送，也可先插入输入框继续编辑。

description.en: Interactive code-graph visualization inside DSH: a sidebar entry (a tab inside dsh-better-sidebar when that plugin is installed) draws the graph produced by dsh-codegraph (its .codegraph/codegraph.db or the codegraph CLI) or by dsh-tool-lens, with call-chain tracing, cycle detection, dependency and impact analysis, directory/file/function clustering, four layouts, and PNG/SVG/JSON export. Requires dsh-codegraph or dsh-tool-lens as the data source; without one the graph is empty.
description.zh: DSH 的交互式代码图谱：以侧栏入口呈现（装了 dsh-better-sidebar 时则是它的一个标签页），渲染 dsh-codegraph（.codegraph/codegraph.db 或 codegraph CLI）或 dsh-tool-lens 提供的数据，支持调用链追踪、循环依赖检测、依赖与影响分析、目录/文件/函数聚类、四种布局与 PNG/SVG/JSON 导出。需要 dsh-codegraph 或 dsh-tool-lens 提供数据源，否则图谱为空。

description.en: Auto-titles conversations after the first user+assistant exchange, with a chat header button to update or manually edit titles.
description.zh: 在首轮完整对话（提问+回复）后自动生成会话标题，并在聊天顶部工具栏提供更新/编辑标题按钮。

description.en: Composer prompt library: reusable global and per-project prompts are stored as Markdown files and appended to the draft on click or @ mention; the global library works out of the box, while project groups appear only after "config.root" is set in the profile patch.
description.zh: 输入框常用提示词库：全局与项目两层的 Markdown 提示词，点一下或 @ 触发追加进草稿、不覆盖已写内容；全局库装好即用，项目库需在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里给该插件配 config.root 后才会出现。

description.en: Durable workspace Plan/Backlog todos for DeepSeek Harness, with a sidebar board, agent tools, and /todo commands.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的持久工作区待办面板：Plan/Backlog 两层、侧边栏看板、Agent 工具与 /todo 命令，跨会话不丢。

description.en: Voice dictation scratchpad: realtime speech-to-text into timestamped, per-session blocks, with one-click insert into the conversation composer. Requires the official DSH voice-input bundle (@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle); the speech model downloads on first use.
description.zh: 语音听写文本板：边说边出字，生成按会话隔离的时间戳文本块，一键加入会话输入框。 需先安装 DSH 官方语音输入插件 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle，语音模型在首次使用时下载。

description.en: Shows ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok Bot remaining usage with reset countdowns plus the DeepSeek balance in a compact card above the sidebar account row; thresholds, refresh interval and per-provider HTTP proxies are configurable. Needs existing sign-ins: Codex CLI login for ChatGPT, an Antigravity token for Gemini, a Cursor user API key (CURSOR_API_KEY) for Grok Bot, and a DeepSeek account signed in inside DSH; a row without its sign-in shows a login hint instead of numbers.
description.zh: 在侧栏登录名上方以紧凑卡片显示 ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok Bot 的剩余额度与重置倒计时，以及 DeepSeek 余额；可配置阈值、刷新间隔与每个 provider 的 HTTP 代理。需事先具备各家登录态：ChatGPT 需 Codex CLI 登录（codex login）、Gemini 需 Antigravity 登录令牌、Grok Bot 需 Cursor 用户 API Key（CURSOR_API_KEY）、DeepSeek 余额需在 DSH 内登录账号；缺哪项，对应行只显示登录提示而不是数字。

description.en: Bookmark manager for the sidebar browser: toolbar star button, dropdown list with one-click navigation, inline editing and reordering.
description.zh: 侧边栏浏览器的书签管理器：工具栏星标按钮，下拉列表一键打开书签，支持就地编辑与排序。

description.en: Live, bidirectional mind map for DSH Web built on Mind Elixir: the agent and the user edit the same tree in real time in a docked panel or fullscreen, with PNG export and open-in-desktop.
description.zh: DSH Web 实时双向思维导图：Agent 与用户共编同一棵树，改动即时互相同步，支持停靠分屏与全屏两种视图。

description.en: Keeps manually opened Think rows expanded by default, with a per-session switch to open or close every Think row; tool cards stay collapsed and state resets on page reload.
description.zh: 手动点开的 Think 默认保持展开，并提供每会话开关批量展开或收起全部思考；工具卡保持折叠，状态随页面刷新重置。

description.en: Installs and opens PM Workbench, a local Electron multi-role project workbench, from a DSH tool. Windows only: the first load bootstraps Node, Electron and the app through a PowerShell installer. It does not embed the workbench UI in DSH.
description.zh: 从 DSH 安装并打开 PM工作台（本地 Electron 多角色项目工作台）。仅支持 Windows——首次加载会通过 PowerShell 安装器准备 Node、Electron 和应用本体；不把工作台 UI 嵌入 DSH。

description.en: Let the model read the current session's sidebar: the active tab, open tabs, terminal screens and browser page text (page text is desktop only; the terminal channel needs DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.2).
description.zh: 让模型按需读取当前会话的侧边栏：当前选中标签、打开的标签、终端屏幕与浏览器网页正文（网页正文仅桌面端；终端通道需 DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.2）。

description.en: A dedicated background-job dashboard for the DSH Web UI: merges jobs from every session, shows producer-reported or parsed progress with an honest estimate fallback, groups by status, purpose, session or kind, streams live output, and keeps a local history ledger.
description.zh: 跨会话的后台任务面板：进度按「任务自报 / 输出解析 / 历史耗时估算」三档显示，可按状态、用途、会话或类型分组，支持实时输出、输出内搜索与本地历史台账。

description.en: Puts Grok Bot's own face in the DSH sidebar session list: each row's status dot becomes a living GrokBot avatar whose six motions read as idle, working, waiting, blocked, thinking and done — color marks the project, motion marks the state.
description.zh: 把 Grok Bot 本人那张脸装进 DSH 侧栏会话列表：每行的状态圆点变成会动的 GrokBot 头像，六种动作分别对应空闲、处理中、等待、已阻止、思考与完成——颜色标记项目，动作标记状态。

description.en: Shows a spinner on a sidebar workspace row while any of its sessions are running, and a short-lived finished mark after they stop.
description.zh: 侧边栏的工作区行会在其下会话运行时显示转圈，会话停止后短暂保留一个已完成标记。

description.en: Adds a session tab bar under the DSH conversation header: open sessions appear in order with workspace/title labels and status dots; click to switch, use the hover × or the right-click menu to close, rename, close others or close all; the tab list persists in localStorage. Plugin only; it does not change DSH core or stop background work.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话头部下方增加会话标签栏：打开过的会话按顺序显示为标签（工作区/标题与状态圆点），点击切换，可用悬停 × 或右键菜单关闭、重命名、关闭其他/全部关闭；标签列表持久化在 localStorage。纯插件实现，不改 DSH 核心，也不停止后台任务。

description.en: A learning chat tree for branching chat: fork selected text with inherited context, continue each native session, and return to your reading position.
description.zh: 学习树与学习分支：划词分叉并继承上下文，每个节点都是可持续聊天的原生会话，返回主线时恢复阅读位置。

description.en: Fold the left sidebar panel entries into a More menu, freeing height for the workspace and session list; entries can be opened from the menu, restored in one click, and the choice persists across reloads. First install folds Taskboard, QQ Bot, Context Insights and SSH, and newly installed plugins fold by default (switchable).
description.zh: 把左侧栏的面板入口收进「更多」菜单，给下方工作区与会话列表腾出高度；入口可从菜单打开、一键全部还原，选择跨刷新保留。首次安装默认收起任务看板、QQ 机器人、上下文洞察与 SSH，之后新装的插件也默认收进「更多」（可关）。

description.en: Replaces identity numbers, phone numbers, bank cards, emails, addresses, customer names and secrets with numbered placeholders before a model request leaves the machine, restores the response, and keeps an encrypted local mapping plus a hash-chained audit log exportable as CSV.
description.zh: 在模型请求离开本机前，把身份证、手机号、银行卡、邮箱、地址、客户名与密钥替换成编号占位符，响应回来自动回填；映射表加密存本机，每次替换写入带哈希链的审计日志，可导出 CSV。

description.en: Tencent Agent Mail client: a sidebar panel for inbox and sent browsing, HTML reading in a sandboxed frame with remote images blocked by default, compose/reply/forward with attachments, search and permanent delete, adjustable font and surface opacity, plus five agent tools (mail_health, mail_list, mail_read, mail_search, mail_send) sending through an OAuth-authorized agently-cli account. Needs a Tencent account (OAuth device-code login); the panel can install agently-cli for you. Tested on Windows only.
description.zh: 腾讯智能体邮箱（Agent Mail）客户端：侧边栏面板浏览收件箱与发件箱，HTML 正文在沙箱内渲染并默认拦截外链图片，支持写信、回复、转发、附件收发、搜索与永久删除，可调字体与界面透明度；另注册 5 个工具（mail_health、mail_list、mail_read、mail_search、mail_send），发信走已授权的 agently-cli 账号。需腾讯账号（设备码授权），面板可一键安装 agently-cli；仅在 Windows 上实测。

description.en: Git panel for the DSH right sidebar: staging, commits, branch switching, fetch/pull/push, worktrees, a Cursor-style commit graph and GitHub pull requests (the GitHub card needs a GitHub token). It drives the system git binary, so the panel and the terminal always agree.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Git 面板：暂存、提交、切换分支、fetch/pull/push、工作树、Cursor 风格提交图与 GitHub PR（GitHub 卡片需要 GitHub 令牌）。直接调用系统 git，面板与终端状态保持一致。

description.en: Beelli X UI brings searchable settings to DSH NEXT on Windows. Appearance groups themes, skins, fonts, pets, and effects, while Models has its own page. Use images or MP4 wallpaper, adjust frosted panels, and save skin presets. Switch between pets and upload default and extra animations for each one. Preview, time, or skip MP4 and GIF startup animations. Add model connections from provider presets or a custom endpoint, fetch and select models, or enter model IDs manually. You can also restore or bulk-delete archived chats by workspace and switch or add plugin catalogs on the same page. Replaces the built-in Settings page and sidebar (disables ui-settings-general and ui-sidebar); run only one plugin that takes them over.
description.zh: Beelli X UI 为 Windows 上的 DSH NEXT 提供一套可搜索的设置。左栏按用途导航，「外观」内分为主题、皮肤、字体、吉祥物和效果，「模型」单独管理服务连接。皮肤支持图片或 MP4 壁纸、磨砂面板与方案保存。桌宠可以添加多只、切换显示，并为每只上传默认和额外动作，右键播放。启动动画支持 MP4 或 GIF，可预览、设定时长和跳过。模型可用厂商预设或自定义接口，从服务获取型号后勾选，也能手动填写模型 ID。还支持按原工作区恢复或批量删除归档聊天，以及在插件页直接切换和添加市场。会替换内置设置页与侧栏（停用 ui-settings-general 与 ui-sidebar），请勿与其他接管设置页或侧栏的插件同装。

description.en: Agent skills for Obsidian, vendored verbatim from the official repository kepano/obsidian-skills (MIT, Steph Ango). Six skills covering Obsidian Flavored Markdown (wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties), Bases (.base), JSON Canvas (.canvas), the Obsidian CLI, Defuddle and Knap. Documentation only: no CLI binaries are bundled, so obsidian/defuddle/knap are installed separately by the user.
description.zh: 从官方库 kepano/obsidian-skills（MIT，Steph Ango）逐字收录的 Obsidian 技能包。六个技能覆盖 Obsidian 风格 Markdown（双向链接、嵌入、标注块、属性）、 Bases（.base）、JSON Canvas（.canvas）、Obsidian CLI、Defuddle 与 Knap。 只含文档，不含任何 CLI 本体；obsidian/defuddle/knap 需用户自行安装。

description.en: Registration agency matching plugin — recommends data exchange/registration agency based on data type.
description.zh: 登记机构匹配插件 — 基于数据类型推荐数据交易所/登记机构

description.en: A DSH workbench for picking photos from local folders on macOS and Windows: local dedupe, filtering and grouping, AI grid triage and scoring with an image-capable model you supply (the plugin bundles no model, credentials or quota), then human review, calibration and export.
description.zh: DSH 本机照片挑选工作台（macOS / Windows）：本地去重、过滤与分组，用你自备的图片输入模型做 AI 网格粗筛与评分（插件不内置模型、凭据或额度），并支持人工复核、校准与导出。

description.en: Aggregate pinned sessions that are currently rendered and visible across workspaces into a single sidebar view, saving you from digging through separate workspaces. The aggregated section can either stay above the workspace list with independent scrolling or scroll inline with the list, directly reusing native session rows, status indicators, and actions while respecting current folding and search filters without forcibly expanding hidden items.
description.zh: 将当前原生视图中已渲染可见的各工作区置顶会话汇总到侧栏同一处，省去跨工作区来回翻找。汇总区可固定在工作区列表上方独立滚动，也可并入列表内随整体一起滚动；条目直接复用原生会话行、状态标识与快捷操作，并严格遵循当前视图范围，被折叠或搜索过滤隐藏的会话保持原状不强制展开。

description.en: Adds a pixel-coordinate viewer to the sidebar image preview: hover coordinates, one adjustable dashed rectangle with start/end/size labels, edge snapping, and true-pixel measurements across zoom.
description.zh: 在侧栏图片预览中加入像素坐标查看器：悬浮读取坐标，用一个可移动/缩放的虚线选框标注起点、终点与宽高，越界自动吸附，缩放后仍按图片真实像素计算。

description.en: Campus-network auto-login for DeepSeek Harness: status, one-click login, a local settings page, and an optional autostart watchdog. Includes a Nanjing Audit University preset and a configurable JSON-portal mode.
description.zh: 校园网自动登录插件：查看状态、一键登录、本地设置页和可选的开机自启守护。内置南京审计大学预设，也支持自定义 JSON 门户。

description.en: Two columns for the dsh Plugins page, Minecraft resource-pack style: the left column holds the packs running together, the right holds packs that are installed but switched off, with arrow or drag moves between them, custom tags, search, scope filters, batch toggling and undo. Tags and display names live in a hand-editable packs.json under DSH_HOME instead of browser storage, so they survive a new browser or cleared site data.
description.zh: 在 dsh 插件页加「插件包」标签：左栏是正在一起用的包、右栏是装好但未启用的，支持箭头或拖拽在两栏间搬包、自定义标签、搜索、范围筛选、批量启停与撤销。标签与中文名存在 DSH_HOME 下的 packs.json 里而不是浏览器存储，换浏览器或清站点数据都不丢。

description.en: Sends an Edge/Windows desktop notification when a tool call waits for approval, the agent asks you to choose an option, or a session finishes a turn, and only while the DSH page is in the background or unfocused; an optional chime covers cases where the browser or Windows suppresses the notification.
description.zh: 工具调用等待审批、智能体提问等你选择、或会话跑完一轮时，弹出 Edge/Windows 桌面通知，且只在你不看 DSH 页面（后台或未聚焦）时提醒；浏览器或 Windows 抑制通知时可用可选提示音兜底。

description.en: Sidebar footer widget that shows DeepSeek service health: a status dot plus the live latency of four probes (API, chat, docs, status page) run from this machine, with a popover listing official component statuses read from status.deepseek.com. Refresh cadence 15s-2min.
description.zh: 左侧栏底部的一行状态挂件：绿点加本机四项探针（API、网页、文档、状态页）的实时延迟，点开弹出卡片看官方组件状态。刷新间隔 15 秒到 2 分钟可选。

description.en: Knowledge-planet (zsxq) knowledge base toolkit: sync posts and attachments, extract docx/PDF text and images, rebuild an index, search, and self-check — pure JS, no Python. Requires a Knowledge-planet subscription and its Cookie, pasted into config.json.
description.zh: 知识星球知识库工具集：同步帖子与附件、抽取 docx/PDF 正文与图片、重建索引、检索与自检，纯 JS 无需 Python。需要知识星球订阅账号，并把订阅 Cookie 写进 config.json。

description.en: Off-peak task queue: typing /闲时任务 in a conversation queues a task with no model call at queue time, and DSH runs it in that same conversation during the off-peak hours of the model that conversation uses (DeepSeek off-peak half price, GLM Coding Plan half credits).
description.zh: 闲时任务队列：在对话中输入 /闲时任务 即可入队，入队不产生模型调用；DSH 会在对话所用模型的闲时时段（DeepSeek 半价、GLM Coding Plan 半积分）自动在同一条对话中执行任务。

description.en: Transcribe session audio through V-yovoice and display a waveform player and transcript. Needs a reachable V-yovoice service (its root URL is set in the plugin's configuration); audio files are sent to that service.
description.zh: 使用 V-yovoice 转写会话音频，展示波形播放器和转写原文。需要一个可访问的 V-yovoice 服务（在插件配置里填它的根地址）；音频文件会发送到该服务。

description.en: Keeps a turn from closing on an unfinished reply: a stream guard turns silent truncation into an in-step retry, and a completion protocol asks the model to declare how each turn ended.
description.zh: 避免轮次停在「话没说完」或「只写了下一步计划」上关闭：把静默截断的流转成同一步内可重试的失败，并要求模型在每轮结束时声明收尾方式。

description.en: Read-only disk usage scan and interactive HTML cleanup report for Windows and macOS. Needs Python 3 on the machine; the bundled scan scripts run offline as child processes.
description.zh: 只读扫描 Windows 与 macOS 磁盘占用，生成带三级清理建议的交互式 HTML 报告。需要本机装有 Python 3；包内的扫描脚本以子进程方式离线运行。

description.en: Host-side TTS bridge for dsh that synthesizes speech over the Edge TTS protocol and serves MP3 on a same-origin route, for containers with no audio device.
description.zh: 宿主侧语音桥：用 Edge TTS 协议合成语音并以 MP3 同源提供，解决容器无声卡、WebView 念不出中文的问题。

description.en: Resizes any block in the DSH Web UI: pick a block, drag its eight handles to set width and height, then collapse it, scroll its content, move it or raise it above other layers. Sizes and positions are remembered and restored after a reload.
description.zh: 调整 DSH 界面里任意块的长宽：点选后拖八个手柄改尺寸，还能收起、滚动内容、平移、置前，尺寸与位置会被记住并在刷新后恢复。

description.en: Chinese titles, Chinese search, hover detail cards and drag-to-reorder for DSH skills and commands in the slash menu and plus panel.
description.zh: 技能与命令的中文增强：菜单中的技能显示中文标题、支持中文搜索与悬浮详情，命令与技能的顺序可自由拖拽。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a Task Instructions button beside the input box pins reusable task requirements to a session, and the instruction survives context compression.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：输入框旁的「任务指令」按钮，把可复用的任务要求固定到整场会话，压缩上下文也不变形。

description.en: Organizes task materials and supports session handoffs across workspaces.
description.zh: 整理任务资料，支持跨工作区的会话交接。

description.en: Per-Bot memory for Tobs Bots (requires DeepSeek Harness with @botharness/core; it ships off with no Bots listed, and after you list a Bot and set mode to on it works with no other service): a read-only local full-text index of that Bot's own past conversations (Chinese words found inside sentences), memory imported from other AI tools, a status tool, optional auto recall before a step in which a Human speaks, and a service for other plugins. Richer backends can be chosen at install, with a quote first and a daily token cap: a public fact store (memv2-lite), the official Graphiti graph, or both, fed from the Bot's own conversations.
description.zh: 给 Tobs Bot 的按 Bot 隔离的记忆（需带 @botharness/core 的 DeepSeek Harness；插件默认关闭、不列任何 Bot，在配置里列出 Bot 并把 mode 设为 on 后无需其它服务）：只读地把该 Bot 自己的历史对话建成本地全文索引（中文词在整句里也能搜到），可导入从别的 AI 工具继承来的记忆，带状态工具、可选的自动召回（只在真人发言时）和给其他插件用的接口。安装时还可以选更立体的后端（先报价、每天有上限）：公开的事实库（memv2 精简版）、Graphiti 官方图谱，或两个一起，都从 Bot 自己的对话里抽取。

description.en: Usage statistics inside Settings: a GitHub-style one-year conversation heatmap of your own daily messages, token usage totals by model and by day/week/month with stat cards, and a per-day list of files written or edited via write/edit tools. All computed locally from session history with incremental rescans; no data leaves the machine.
description.zh: 设置面板内的使用统计：GitHub 风格一年对话热力图（按每天本人消息数着色，自动排除子代理与注入上下文）、按模型与按天/周/月汇总的 Token 用量（统计卡片 + 表格）、以及每天通过 write/edit 工具产出或修改的文件清单（日期选择）。全部本地扫描会话历史完成、增量更新，数据不出本机。

description.en: A deliberately context-free chat panel in the right sidebar: it sends only a one-line system prompt plus what you type there, with no tools, no session history and no fork of the current conversation, and keeps the panel history in memory. Each reply reports its own token usage, plus the cache hit rate on routes that return cache stats.
description.zh: 在右侧栏加一个刻意「无上下文」的对话面板：只发一句系统提示和你在面板里输入的内容，不带工具、不复制当前会话、不派生分支，面板历史只存在内存里。每条回复下方显示本轮 token 用量；在返回缓存统计的路由上同时显示缓存命中率。

description.en: Download only a time range of a video (yt-dlp segments; long videos fall back to HLS when the DASH URL cannot be seeked), verify the cut with ffprobe and sampled frame contact sheets, and serve the clip over a temporary LAN HTTP link with byte-range support. Exposes video_clip_download, video_clip_verify and file_share tools plus a video-clip skill; requires ffmpeg/ffprobe. Installs yt-dlp with pip into $DSH_HOME/cache/video-clip when it is missing; file_share serves a file or directory over unauthenticated HTTP bound to 0.0.0.0 (visible on the LAN) for 30 minutes by default.
description.zh: 按时间区间下载视频片段（yt-dlp 分段；长视频的 DASH 直链无法定位时改用 HLS 分片），下载后用 ffprobe 与抽帧拼图核对起止边界，并把成片起成带 Range 的内网 HTTP 下载链接。提供 video_clip_download / video_clip_verify / file_share 三个工具和一个 video-clip skill；需要 ffmpeg/ffprobe。缺少 yt-dlp 时会用 pip 把它装到 $DSH_HOME/cache/video-clip；file_share 默认把文件或目录用无鉴权 HTTP 绑定在 0.0.0.0（局域网可见）上共享 30 分钟。

description.en: Review commits made in the current workspace, grouped by repository, each expandable to its per-file diff.
description.zh: 按仓库分组查看本工作区产生的提交，每个提交可展开查看文件级 diff。

description.en: Model quick picker for DeepSeek Harness: a button left of the model dropdown opens a full model-selection dialog with provider grouping, live search, provider filter, capability tags read from the user's own input config, reasoning badges, recent-model shortcuts and a reasoning-effort picker; the choice writes back to the native dropdown immediately.
description.zh: 模型速选器：在模型下拉框左侧添加按钮，弹出全量模型选择窗口（提供商分组、实时搜索、提供商筛选、读取用户配置的真实能力标签、推理徽章、最近使用与推理档位选择器），选中后立即回写原生下拉框并生效。

description.en: Connects Penpot to DSH across two independent channels with 9 tools: 5 MCP tools (execute_code, high_level_overview, api_info, export_shape, import_image), 2 browser-free REST tools (penpot_read and penpot_write to create files, pages and shapes or edit attributes without an open tab), plus penpot_status and penpot_control; supports official SaaS, local and self-hosted endpoints with auto-detection and config migration from DSH, Codex, Claude, Cursor, Gemini and .mcp.json, an isolated Chromium launcher, and a five-tab control panel.
description.zh: 把 Penpot 接进 DSH，提供两条独立通道与 9 个工具：5 个 MCP 工具（execute_code、high_level_overview、api_info、export_shape、import_image）、2 个免浏览器的 REST 读写工具（penpot_read 与 penpot_write，无需打开网页即可建文件、加页面、加图层与改属性），外加 penpot_status 与 penpot_control；支持官方托管、本地构建与自部署三档及从 DSH、Codex、Claude、Cursor、Gemini、.mcp.json 自动识别与迁移配置，附带独立 profile 的 Chromium 启动器与五标签页控制面板。

description.en: Version manager for the dsh host in a settings section of its own: shows the installed version against npm dist-tags, checks for updates, and installs, upgrades, downgrades or reinstalls any published version with a pre-upgrade local snapshot, failure rollback, snapshot-based rollback and an upgrade history. Before a cross-minor install it compares the @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings exports of the target release with the named imports of installed plugins to flag those that would stop loading, and it can apply or remove reversible compat shims that port removed legacy APIs back into framework files. Upgrade, restore and restart engines are Windows-only; version listing and checks work on every platform.
description.zh: dsh 主程序版本管理，位于独立设置分区：对照 npm dist-tags 显示已装版本、检查更新，可安装/升级/降级/重装任意已发布版本，升级前自动建本地快照，失败自动回滚，支持基于快照的回滚与升级历史。跨次版本安装前，会比对目标版本 @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings 的导出与已装插件的具名导入，标出升级后将无法加载的插件；并可启用/停用可逆兼容垫片，把被移除的旧 API 移植回框架文件。升级/恢复/重启引擎仅 Windows 可用，版本查看与更新检查各平台通用。

description.en: Drive an Edifier Halo PixelBar — a 256x32 1-bit dot-matrix screen in a desktop speaker — from DSH over raw USB HID: push custom bitmaps, play GIF animations, render pixel-art walk scenes from sprite sheets and push self-rendered text, with a color-calibration table, a hardware self-check and EQ / volume / lighting / face-scene control. A push can return the screen to the clock afterwards.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里驱动花再 Halo PixelBar（桌面音箱上的 256×32 单色点阵屏）：通过裸 USB HID 推自定义位图、播放 GIF 动画、用精灵图渲染像素角色行走场景、推自绘文字，并带颜色校准表、硬件自检，以及 EQ / 音量 / 氛围灯 / 表情与场景控制；推送后还能自动切回时钟。

description.en: DSH plugin: a settings panel to list, add, rewrite and toggle @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client MCP rows — no more hand-writing them into cordis.patch.yml. Zero build, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 插件：一块设置面板管理 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 的 MCP 行——列出、新增、改写、启停，不必再手写 cordis.patch.yml；零构建、零运行依赖。

description.en: Per-task cost dashboard and budget guard that prices each model call at peak or off-peak rates, turns the remaining budget into a per-turn work envelope in the system prompt, and stops the task at its cap until the user replies. The default cap is ¥0.5 per task.
description.zh: 按任务统计模型调用费用（峰/谷价），把剩余预算换算成每轮提示词里的调用/文件额度，并在超出上限时暂停任务等待用户确认。默认每个任务的上限为 ¥0.5。

description.en: Per-project long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a panel to browse, search and edit what each project knows, and a pointer injected after the first user message telling the agent to read the handoff pack. The memory store itself is a local MCP server (Python + SQLite) in the same repository; install the plugin from npm, then clone the repo, set up the MCP server per the README, and the plugin locates the checkout through DSH_RAG_ROOT or a common install path. Handoff packs are ordered for prompt-cache reuse: stable baseline first, facts appended at the end.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层按项目分类的长期记忆：面板可浏览、检索、编辑每个项目记得什么，并在会话第一句后注入一条「去读 handoff pack」的指针。记忆库本体是同仓库里的本地 MCP server（Python + SQLite）；插件从 npm 安装，之后按 README 克隆仓库并配置 MCP，插件会通过 DSH_RAG_ROOT 或常见安装位置找到仓库。上下文包按「稳定基线在前、事实追加在后」排序，用来复用 prompt 缓存。

description.en: Knowledge-planet (zsxq) knowledge base skill: sync posts and attachments, extract docx/PDF text, guide topic category, summary and quote enrichment, rebuild the index, and search. Requires Python ≥3.10 with the packages in requirements.txt plus your own zsxq account cookie.
description.zh: 知识星球知识库 skill：同步帖子与附件、抽取 docx/pdf 正文、指导分类/摘要/金句富化、重建索引与检索。需要本机 Python ≥3.10 与 requirements.txt 里的依赖，以及你自己的知识星球账号 Cookie。

description.en: Math-modeling contest workbench for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar P0–P7 progress board and traceable facts ledger, one-click render/check/layout/compile, PDF preview, and human sign-off; paired with the math-modeling-cumcm skill. Requires the math-modeling-cumcm skill's scripts (set skillDir), Python 3.10+ and XeLaTeX with ctex/xeCJK; fully verified only on Windows 11 + MiKTeX.
description.zh: 国赛论文工作台：侧栏展示 P0–P7 进度与可追溯的 facts 台账，一键执行 render/check/layout/编译，预览 PDF，并支持人工签字；配套 math-modeling-cumcm skill。需配置该技能的脚本（skillDir）、Python 3.10+ 与 XeLaTeX + ctex/xeCJK 环境，目前仅在 Windows 11 + MiKTeX 完整实测。

description.en: Adds an optional note field under each selected option in the DSH Web UI ask_user_question popup; submitted notes travel to the model in the answer's custom field.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页端 ask_user_question 弹窗中为每个选中选项增加可选的补充说明输入框，提交时补充内容随答案一并传给模型。

description.en: Previews GLB, glTF, FBX, OBJ, STL and PLY models in the right-sidebar document preview, and parses runtime-built three.js scenes from HTML pages or pasted code to export the full scene or per-object groups as model files.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里预览 GLB、glTF、FBX、OBJ、STL、PLY 模型；也能解析 HTML 页面或粘贴代码中运行时构建的 three.js 场景，支持完整场景导出和按个体分组导出为模型文件。

description.en: An agent-writable spreadsheet editor inside DeepSeek Harness with formulas, formatting, CSV/Excel import, and export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里可由 agent 直接写入的电子表格编辑器：支持公式、格式、CSV/Excel 导入与导出。

description.en: Session-completion reminders for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar bell with an unread dot, plus system notification, in-app toast and a two-tone chime, each switchable. The toast can be dragged anywhere, subagent sessions can be muted, and the last 24 completions stay one click away.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话完成提醒：侧栏铃铛带未读圆点，系统通知、应用内浮层与双音提示音可分别开关；浮层位置可拖动，可忽略子代理会话，最近 24 条完成记录可一键回到对应会话。

description.en: Splits over-long screenshots into DSH-acceptable slices before prompt admission instead of letting them be rejected: vertical slices overlap so a line of text is never cut in half, and pure-JS codecs avoid native binaries. It wraps the existing attachment store instead of replacing it.
description.zh: 超长截图在发送前自动切成 DSH 可接受的切片，而不是被直接拒收：纵向切片带重叠，不会把一行字劈成两半；纯 JS 编解码，无原生依赖，且只是包住现有附件服务、不顶替它。

description.en: Layout plugin for DSH: customize the structure, order, width and visibility of the left sidebar, right sidebar, conversation area and settings page. Drag-sort and resize the three columns, per-layer teardown of sidebar/conversation/right/settings, grid slot arrangement, draw-a-frame region relocation, entry consolidation into More menus, conditional linkage rules, multiple named layout schemes, and a fullscreen layout whiteboard with a four-layer structure tree. Config persists host-side; dangerous configs have multi-layer recovery entries.
description.zh: DSH 界面布局插件：自定义左栏、右栏、会话区与设置页的结构、顺序、宽度和显隐。三栏拖动排序与宽度调整，侧栏、会话区、右栏、设置页逐层拆解，槽位网格编排，画框式区域搬移，入口收纳进「更多」菜单，条件联动规则，多套命名布局方案，全屏布局白板四层结构树。配置持久化在宿主侧，危险配置有多层恢复入口。

description.en: Adds a show/hide toggle for each sidebar panel entry to the sidebar More menu, one row per panel with its current state; the choice is stored in localStorage and replayed when the plugin reloads. The Plugins entry stays fixed and cannot be hidden.
description.zh: 在侧边栏「更多」菜单里给每个面板入口加一行显隐开关，右侧标出当前状态；选择存 localStorage，插件重载后自动回放。插件面板本身固定显示，不可隐藏。

description.en: Registration precheck plugin — checks a data asset against the national data-property registration rules: national-security sensitivity, source legality, ownership disputes, and the material-authenticity commitment, then outputs a precheck report.
description.zh: 登记预检插件 — 按国家数据产权登记规则做四项检查（国家安全、来源合规、权属纠纷、材料真实性承诺），并输出《登记预检报告》。

description.en: Multi-user collaboration rooms for DeepSeek Harness: discuss work, coordinate tasks, propose changes, and review them from each participant's local DSH. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and a Git workspace.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多人协作房间：参与者在各自本地 DSH 中讨论、协调任务、提出并审阅变更。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 与一个 Git 工作区。

description.en: A zero-config composer model picker with one provider per tab, independent scrolling per provider, cross-provider search with provider badges and reasoning-effort chips; selections stay in sync with the built-in /model dialog.
description.zh: 零配置的输入框模型选择器：每个 provider 一个 tab、各自独立滚动，支持带渠道徽标的跨渠道搜索和推理强度 chips，并与内置 /model 弹窗共享同一份模型目录。

description.en: Tracks manufacturing quality issues and 8D improvement projects, analyzes process capability and SPC control charts, and exports reports from a local SQLite database.
description.zh: 管理制造质量问题和 8D 改进项目，分析过程能力与 SPC 控制图，并从本地 SQLite 数据库导出报表。

description.en: Archives scripts written in any DSH session into a per-category folder, writes a Markdown doc for each one, and starts or stops them with status verified against real processes and scheduled tasks.
description.zh: 把任意会话里写出的脚本归档到按类别分好的目录，逐个生成 Markdown 文档，并能启动/停止、按真实进程与计划任务核对状态。

description.en: One-shot OMP subagent provider for DeepSeek Harness — each delegation spawns the local `omp --print --mode json` CLI running with the user's own ~/.omp configuration and model bindings, and delegations are serialized so a single-session local engine is never oversubscribed. Requires the OMP (oh-my-pi) CLI installed locally and DSH 0.2.2-rc.2.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的一次性子代理提供器——每次委派都会启动本地 `omp --print --mode json` CLI，沿用用户自己的 ~/.omp 配置与模型绑定运行，且委派串行执行，单会话本地引擎不会被并发压垮。需本机已安装 OMP（oh-my-pi）CLI，并要求 DSH 0.2.2-rc.2。

description.en: Load skills to reveal bound tools on demand, with per-tool blocking and MCP support.
description.zh: 加载技能后按需解锁绑定工具，支持按工具拦截和 MCP 工具。

description.en: Project/task dual-mode workspaces for DSH: a task skips the workspace picker and gets a fresh scratch directory (D:\dsh_working\<name>-<timestamp>) per conversation, Codex-style; no-workspace sessions are grouped under a persistent Tasks section in the sidebar with empty states, and the new-session workspace picker gains a "no workspace (task)" option.
description.zh: DSH 项目/任务双模式工作区：任务不绑定工作区，每次新对话在 D:\dsh_working\<名称>-<时间戳> 自动创建独立临时目录（类 Codex）；侧边栏"任务"分组常驻显示所有无工作区会话并带空状态提示，新建会话的工作区选择器增加"无工作区（任务）"选项。

description.en: Peer sessions between DeepSeek Harness instances on a LAN: UDP discovery, an explicit one-way allow list with open or confirm approval, HMAC-signed HTTP with a ±60 s window and nonce replay protection, a `跨端 · <peer>` session for delivered prompts, two-phase file transfer up to 100 MiB with SHA-256 receipts, and seven agent tools that call the named tools listed in `exposedTools` on the receiving side. Its local /cross-agent panel routes are guarded only by a loopback check, without DSH's Host/Origin admission.
description.zh: 同一局域网内两台机器上的 DSH 建立跨端会话：UDP 发现、显式单向放行与 open/confirm 审核、带 ±60 秒时间窗和 nonce 防重放的 HMAC 签名 HTTP、把指令投进 `跨端 · <对端名>` 会话、两阶段传输 ≤100 MiB 的文件并校验 sha256，以及七个只能调用对方 `exposedTools` 白名单内具名工具的 agent 工具。本机的 /cross-agent 面板路由只用回环地址检查把关，没有 DSH 的 Host/Origin 准入。

description.en: Connects DSH to decision models (TypeSafe Jev, TokenRhythm NeoHorse-Jev, OpenAI Decisions, and local System One endpoints) with decide, gate, rerank, and judge tools plus a settings page. Needs an API key for at least one provider (kept in the DSH credential store); the text you ask it to judge is sent to the selected provider unless it is local. The command guard is off by default.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接入决策模型（TypeSafe Jev、基元律动 NeoHorse-Jev、OpenAI Decisions、本地 System One），提供 decide / 守门 / 重排 / 验收工具和设置页。至少需要一家提供方的 API 密钥（存放在 DSH 凭据库里）；要它判断的文字会发给所选提供方（本地提供方除外）。命令守门默认关闭。

description.en: A skill picker beside the composer that lists installed skills under Chinese categories, searches them by name or purpose, and suggests up to three skills matching the draft you are typing.
description.zh: 输入框旁的技能面板：把已安装的技能按中文分类列出，可按名字或用途搜索，并根据你正在写的草稿推荐最多三个相关技能。

description.en: Shows the balance or quota behind the current conversation's model for DeepSeek, Kimi Code and OpenAI, plus local usage and priced estimates for every provider configured in DSH.
description.zh: 按当前会话模型显示 DeepSeek、Kimi Code 与 OpenAI 的余额或配额，并为 DSH 中配置的每个提供商提供本地用量与价格估算。

description.en: Adds a system-prompt section that asks the model to drop stock AI writing habits: subheadings, bold and emoji overload, quoted aphorisms and grand-finale endings.
description.zh: 往系统提示词里加一段，要求模型去掉常见的 AI 写作习惯：小标题、加粗与 emoji 堆砌、引用名言和结尾升华。

description.en: Local-first RSS/Atom reader with full-text search, bulk read marking, on-demand AI summaries and native reading companion. Uses the native better-sqlite3 module, so approve its native build when the installer asks.
description.zh: 本地优先的 RSS/Atom 阅读器，支持全文搜索、批量标记已读、按需 AI 总结和原生伴读。依赖原生模块 better-sqlite3，安装器询问时需要批准它的原生构建。

description.en: Condenses DSH session titles from a full sentence into a short verb-free phrase, aiming for under five words.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话标题从一句话精简为不含动词的短语，目标五个词以内。

description.en: Blurs every image in the conversation body until you click the Show button in its corner, leaving side panels, plugin pages and icons untouched.
description.zh: 对话正文里的图片默认模糊，点图片右上角的「显示」才看清；侧栏、面板与图标不受影响。

description.en: Windows x64 DSH workbench for scheduled, unattended novel writing and Fanqie publishing, with configurable tasks and optional free-quota model channels. First start downloads a pinned Python and Chromium runtime (about 278 MB) into %LOCALAPPDATA%\ChapterWhale; publishing signs in to your Fanqie writer account, and the free-quota channels sign in with IDE vendor accounts (CodeArts, WorkBuddy, Qoder, TRAE).
description.zh: 码章鲸：Windows x64 无人值守小说写作与番茄发布工作台，可自定义日更任务，接入部分免费模型并支持部分厂商账号授权。首次启动会把固定版本的 Python 和 Chromium 运行时（约 278 MB）下载到 %LOCALAPPDATA%\ChapterWhale；发布需要登录你的番茄作家账号，免费额度渠道则用 IDE 厂商账号（CodeArts、WorkBuddy、Qoder、TRAE）登录。

description.en: Manually resets old AgentRouter Responses replay state for chats blocked by upstream resource-binding errors while preserving history; supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 手动重置 AgentRouter Responses 旧回放状态，处理旧会话续聊时的上游资源绑定报错，保留聊天历史；支持 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Prepares a workspace management protocol for an agent — three libraries (cognition, tools, external information), an optional preloaded session that has already read the workspace, and a re-read card when the workspace has changed enough.
description.zh: 为 agent 准备一套工作区管理协议——认知、工具、外部信息三库，一条可选的、已读过工作区的预加载会话，以及工作区变化达到阈值后弹出的重读卡片。

description.en: Lets the agent read the app, title, URL and text of the window in front through the macOS Accessibility API, with opt-in on-device screen memory it can search.
description.zh: 让 agent 通过 macOS 辅助功能 API 读取最前窗口的应用、标题、URL 和文字，并可选开启本机屏幕记忆供其检索。

description.en: Adds an Explain this action button under the permission approval card that asks the session model for a plain-language description of the pending operation — what it does, which files it touches, whether it modifies or deletes anything, and the privacy risk — plus a risk level and an allow or reject recommendation. Explanations are generated in Simplified Chinese.
description.zh: 在权限审批卡片下面加一个「解释这条操作」按钮：调用当前会话模型，把待批准的操作翻成大白话——做什么、碰哪些文件、会不会改动或删除、有没有隐私风险——再给出风险等级和允许或拒绝的建议。解释以简体中文生成。

description.en: Adds a “why does this need escalation?” button to every DSH approval card: it opens a panel with the permission requested, the risk, what refusing means, the exact tool arguments and whether the named paths fall outside the session workspace; the card also keeps a one-line risk and refusal consequence visible under it, and the model’s original reason is split into labelled paragraphs instead of a run-on block.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的审批卡上就地解释「为什么需要越权」：按钮展开所需权限、风险、不授权的后果、系统真正要执行的参数，以及每个路径是否落在会话工作区之外；卡片下方常驻一行风险与拒绝后果，模型给出的原始理由按「需要的权限 / 风险 / 不授权」分段显示，而不是挤成一坨。

description.en: Interactive K-line analysis for DeepSeek Harness with multi-market quotes, technical indicators, news, and fundamentals.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式 K 线分析，支持多市场行情、技术指标、新闻和基本面信息。

description.en: Per-session control of which skills and MCP tools/servers the model can see (built-in tools are untouched): default shows everything, auto asks the model each turn what to keep, smart picks from your saved groups, or tick groups by hand, with a switcher under the composer and fail-open to full visibility on any error. The default state is auto, which adds one model call per turn (the session model unless judgeModel is set).
description.zh: 按会话控制模型能看到哪些技能与 MCP 工具/服务器（不碰内置工具）：default 全部可见，auto 每轮由模型判定保留哪些，smart 从你建好的分组里选，也可手动勾选分组；输入框下方可随时切换，任何出错都回到全部可见。默认状态为 auto，每轮多一次模型调用（默认沿用当前会话模型，可用 judgeModel 指定）。

description.en: NanoGPT PRO subscription models for DeepSeek Harness: a curated model picker with ×1/×2 rate badges, reasoning levels and the remaining weekly quota, without spending the subscription allowance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 NanoGPT PRO 订阅模型：精选的模型选择器，带 ×1/×2 倍率标记、推理档位和本周剩余额度，且不消耗订阅额度。

description.en: Adds a live system dashboard with per-core CPU, memory, GPU, processes, disk usage and a STOP action for ending processes, plus per-process energy on macOS, exposed as a browser page, a GUI panel and a `systemInfo` service other plugins can inject. macOS is the main platform and Linux is best-effort. The dashboard page and its read-only JSON (process list with users, disks, logged-in users) are served with no login check; publicDashboard: false only refuses non-loopback peers. STOP accepts loopback requests only and sends SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after a grace period, to any process your account may signal except pid 1, the DSH host and its parent.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供 CPU（逐核）、内存、GPU、进程、磁盘占用与 STOP 结束进程的实时仪表盘，macOS 上另含逐进程能耗，并提供浏览器页面、侧栏面板与供其他插件注入的 systemInfo 服务。以 macOS 为主，Linux 尽力支持。仪表盘页面及其只读 JSON（含进程列表与所属用户、磁盘、已登录用户）不做登录校验，publicDashboard 设为 false 也只是拒绝非回环来源。STOP 只接受回环请求，会对你的账号有权发信号的任何进程先发 SIGTERM、宽限期后再发 SIGKILL，pid 1、DSH 宿主进程及其父进程除外。

description.en: Zero-config per-Session freshness for codebase-memory: on Session start and on every working-directory change it refreshes the index of the Session's own repository, so each project in each Session answers from its current graph while indexing stays in the shared daemon.
description.zh: 零配置的 codebase-memory 保鲜插件：会话开始时、以及每次切换工作目录时，自动刷新该会话自己那个仓库的索引，让每个会话里的每个项目都查得到与当前代码一致的图；索引重活仍在共享 daemon 里完成。

description.en: Runs sessions on your own Claude Code and Codex CLIs from the model picker, and lets a DSH agent hand background tasks to them and follow up. Permission prompts cannot be answered from DSH: Claude Code runs in acceptEdits mode by default, Codex in its workspace-write sandbox, and ACP permission requests are approved automatically by default.
description.zh: 在模型选择器里用你本机的 Claude Code 和 Codex CLI 跑会话，也让 DSH agent 把后台任务交给它们并继续追问。权限提示无法在 DSH 里回答：Claude Code 默认以 acceptEdits 模式运行，Codex 用 workspace-write 沙箱，ACP 的权限请求默认自动批准。

description.en: Search Wikimedia Commons and Openverse for real photos, download them, and verify provenance, magic bytes and dimensions before they reach your agent.
description.zh: 在 Wikimedia Commons 与 Openverse 搜索真实照片，下载后校验来源、魔数与尺寸，再交给 Agent 使用。

description.en: Five tools that build, test and run the Inimerse engine, and drive its Verse layers over the server's line protocol. Needs a local Inimerse checkout built with CMake; point the bundle's repoRoot at it (the shipped default is the author's path).
description.zh: 五个工具，用于构建、测试与运行 Inimerse 引擎，并通过服务端行协议驱动其 Verse 层。需要本机有 Inimerse 源码检出并用 CMake 构建；在 bundle 配置中把 repoRoot 指向它（默认值是作者本机路径）。

description.en: Browser Use cloud bridge for dsh: run real web tasks — open pages, click, type, fill forms, and extract data — through the Browser Use API.
description.zh: Browser Use 云端桥接：通过 Browser Use API 让 dsh agent 执行真实网页任务，包括打开页面、点击、输入、填表和提取数据。

description.en: Codex quota card at the sidebar foot, styled like the Command Code panel, plus a quota dashboard: a ring, one row per quota window with reset time and remaining percentage, and a dashboard with credits, spend-limit and reset-credit tiles. Reads the ChatGPT quota that dsh-codex-subscription reports over its bridge.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的 Codex 额度卡片（样式与 Command Code 面板一致），并附带额度仪表盘：环形进度、每个额度窗口一行（含重置时间与剩余百分比），仪表盘展示点数、消费上限与重置次数。数据来自 dsh-codex-subscription 通过其桥接上报的 ChatGPT 额度。

description.en: Sidebar GitHub panel plus github_* agent tools: list your repositories, inspect issues and pull requests, and create, update or comment on issues.
description.zh: 侧栏 GitHub 面板加 github_* 工具：列出仓库、查看 Issue 与 PR，新建、更新或评论 Issue。

description.en: Window close behaviour for DeepSeek Harness Desktop — ask, minimise to tray, or quit, with a remembered choice editable in Settings, plus per-session and per-workspace child windows. Windows only: requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5+ and a PowerShell installer that patches the app shell (resources/app); re-run it after every DSH upgrade, otherwise closing keeps DSH default behaviour.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的窗口关闭行为——可选询问、最小化到托盘或完全退出，记住选择并可在设置中修改，还能把会话或工作区开进独立窗口。仅限 Windows：需要 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5+，并用 PowerShell 脚本给应用壳（resources/app）打补丁；每次升级 DSH 后需重跑，未装壳扩展时关闭行为仍是 DSH 默认。

description.en: Neumorphism skin for the DSH web UI that re-keys 72 design tokens to a cool-grey palette with a steel-blue accent in both light and dark mode, and adds soft shadows to the composer, cards, floating surfaces and session rows.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的新拟态皮肤：把 72 个设计 token 重写成冷灰底、钢蓝强调色，浅色与深色同时生效，并给输入区、卡片、浮层与会话行加上柔和阴影。

description.en: Adds a Task Progress tab to the conversation view, next to the Context tab, with a progress bar for the session's todo list and completed items ordered by completion time.
description.zh: 在会话顶部“上下文”标签右侧增加“任务进度”标签页，用进度条显示已完成与未完成的任务，已完成项按完成顺序排列。

description.en: Translates Chinese text rendered by other DSH plugins into English as it appears - plugin cards, settings pages, dropdown menus, plugin view tabs and same-origin iframe panels - while leaving the chat transcript, tool output and anything you type untouched. Uses the shipped translator service (Bing or Google, no key needed) and falls back to the default model.
description.zh: 把其他 DSH 插件显示的中文实时翻译成英文——插件卡片、设置页、下拉菜单、插件视图标签与同源 iframe 面板，同时不改动对话记录、工具输出和你输入的内容。使用内置翻译服务（Bing 或 Google，无需密钥），不可用时回退到默认模型。

description.en: Agent browser for DeepSeek Harness built on playwright-core with two visibility modes, where hidden sessions for private research close themselves after 45 seconds of idling and visible sessions open in a real Edge or Chrome window on request, exposing eight browser_* tools (search, open, read, click, type, screenshot, close, status) and a left-sidebar panel with engine state, live sessions and an activity feed.
description.zh: 基于 playwright-core 的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体浏览器，两种可见性模式：隐藏会话用于私下检索并在闲置 45 秒后自动关闭，可见会话按需在真实的 Edge 或 Chrome 窗口中打开；提供八个 browser_* 工具（search、open、read、click、type、screenshot、close、status），左侧栏面板显示引擎状态、活动会话与操作流水。

description.en: Render PlantUML diagrams from plantuml, puml and wsd fenced code blocks in the DSH sidebar Markdown preview, using a bundled browser-side PlantUML engine; no Java or PlantUML server is required.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏的 Markdown 预览中，把 plantuml、puml、wsd 围栏代码块渲染为 SVG 图表，使用内置的浏览器端 PlantUML 引擎，无需 Java 或 PlantUML 服务器。

description.en: Independent DSH plugin: Settings → brand color with preset swatches and a custom color picker; recolors only the sidebar/hero logo mark and favicon, never text. Works with DSH 0.2.0 and 0.2.2.
description.zh: 独立 DSH 插件：设置页「品牌颜色」，预设色卡 + 自定义取色，只给侧栏/首页 logo 和 favicon 上色，不改文字；兼容 DSH 0.2.0 / 0.2.2。

description.en: An animated cat companion for the DSH chat UI. It reacts to session states, shows editable click-to-read lines and per-turn token counts, and supports dragging with a squish effect, left/right flipping and Ctrl+wheel resizing.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话界面显示呆猫桌宠：跟随会话状态切换动画，点击展示可编辑台词，每轮结束显示 token 用量；支持拖动压扁回弹、左右翻转及 Ctrl+滚轮缩放。

description.en: Adds 17 barotrauma_* tools to DeepSeek Harness for making Barotrauma mods: environment probing, mod skeleton, item and weapon XML, afflictions, creatures, random events, Lua and C# script scaffolding, localization, validation, icon generation, zip packaging and Steam Workshop publish notes. barotrauma_gen_icon sends your prompt to image.pollinations.ai and writes the returned image into the mod folder; on Windows the Steam install path is read with reg query.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 17 个 barotrauma_* 工具，用于制作潜渊症 mod：环境探测、内容包骨架、物品/武器/状态效果/角色/随机事件 XML、Lua 与 C# 脚本脚手架、本地化、校验、图标生成、打包与创意工坊发布文案。barotrauma_gen_icon 会把你的提示词发到 image.pollinations.ai，并把返回的图写进 mod 目录；在 Windows 上会用 reg query 读取 Steam 安装路径。

description.en: Native desktop notifications for DSH on Windows, macOS and Linux. While the DSH window is in the background, permission requests arrive as system notifications; where the platform supports notification actions, Reject and Allow-once buttons return the decision to the host approval waterfall, and returning focus or a timeout hands the request back to the in-app panel. Approvals and questions also play a separate input cue that is independent of window focus. Turn-end, question and error reminders, notification sounds and the cue are configured on a Notifications settings page.
description.zh: DSH 的原生桌面通知。窗口在后台时权限确认直接出现在系统通知里；平台支持通知按钮时，点「拒绝 / 允许一次」即把结果交回宿主审批流程，切回窗口或超时则退回应用内审批面板。权限确认与提问还会播放独立于窗口焦点的交互提示音；任务完成、提问、错误提醒、通知铃声与提示音都在「通知提醒」设置页配置。

description.en: Classifies each session from its first user message and prefixes the title with an emoji category (explore, research, fix, build, design, docs, config, qa, tidy), falling back to a local keyword rule when the model call fails.
description.zh: 根据会话首条消息判断任务类型，为标题加上「emoji + 分类」前缀（探索、研究、修复、研发、设计、文档、配置、问答、整理），模型调用失败时自动降级为本地规则。

description.en: A macOS global hotkey that opens a small prompt bar from any app and sends what you type, with an optional screenshot or window text, to a new or the last session.
description.zh: macOS 全局热键，在任意应用里唤出一个小输入条，把输入内容连同可选的截图或窗口文字发到新会话或最近的会话。

description.en: SMTP/IMAP email bridge with five tools: send, list, read, download attachments, and list folders. Needs Python; the send tool sends real email from your account, and the mailbox authorization code is kept in the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
description.zh: 基于 SMTP/IMAP 的邮件桥，提供发信、列表、读信、附件下载、文件夹列表五个工具。需要 Python；发信工具会用你的账号真实发出邮件，邮箱授权码保存在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里。

description.en: Use your ChatGPT account to bring Codex models into DSH: choose models and thinking effort, chat with images, use tools and skills, approve local tasks, answer interactive questions, continue and compact long conversations, check quota and Token history, and maintain a supported Windows screenshot helper.
description.zh: 使用 ChatGPT 账号在 DSH 中接入 Codex：选择模型与思考档位，进行图文对话、使用工具和技能，经审批执行本机任务，回答交互问题，压缩并续接长对话，查询额度和 Token 历史，并维护受支持的 Windows 截图辅助程序。

description.en: Replaces native DSH file-tree file and folder icons with locally bundled vscode-icons artwork and filename associations, preserving native tree interactions and expanded folder states.
description.zh: 使用本地打包的 vscode-icons 图标和文件名映射替换 DSH 原生文件树的文件与文件夹图标，保留原生交互及文件夹展开状态。

description.en: Sound cues played by the host operating system, not the browser: three bundled WAV files fire through the machine's own audio (SoundPlayer on Windows, afplay on macOS, paplay/aplay on Linux) when an agent's turn completes, when the context is compacted and when the agent is waiting for your answer; subagent turns can be included, cues fired closer than a configurable interval are skipped, and each bundled sound can be replaced with your own file via plugin config.
description.zh: 由宿主操作系统（而非浏览器）播放的提示音：智能体一轮结束、上下文被压缩、以及智能体在等你回答时，通过本机自己的音频播放随包的三个 WAV（Windows 用 SoundPlayer，macOS 用 afplay，Linux 用 paplay/aplay）；可包含子代理轮次，间隔小于可配置时长的提示会被跳过，每个随包音效都可在插件配置里换成你自己的文件。

description.en: Cross-computer Harness Agent messaging and task handoff; pairing, binding and the receiver's existing local authorization remain required. Not open source (UNLICENSED evaluation build, not for production); requires Node.js 24+, tested only on macOS arm64 and Windows 11 x64 build 22621+. Its last full install-and-run test was on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2; on 0.2.2-rc.1 only the version gate has been checked.
description.zh: 跨电脑 DSH Agent 消息与任务交接，须先配对、绑定，并遵守接收端本机既有授权。非开源（UNLICENSED 评估试用版，勿用于生产）；需要 Node.js 24+，仅在 macOS arm64 与 Windows 11 x64 build 22621+ 上测试。最近一次完整的安装和运行测试是在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 上做的，0.2.2-rc.1 上目前只检查过版本门控。

description.en: Adds a Temporary tasks section above the workspace list, where one click creates a timestamped folder, workspace and session; tasks support search, sort, pin, rename and archive, can be moved into a regular workspace, and tasks that never receive a message are cleaned up automatically.
description.zh: 在工作区列表上方增加独立的「临时任务」区：一键创建带时间戳的文件夹、工作区与会话；支持搜索、排序、置顶、重命名与归档，可把任务移入普通工作区，未发过消息的任务会自动回收。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH: rule gates capture durable facts from conversation turns into a single SQLite database with tiered hot, warm and cold storage; recall injects hybrid vector plus FTS5 hits into the prompt each turn; ships remember, recall, forget and cold-memory prune tools. Zero dependencies, Node only.
description.zh: DSH 长期记忆插件：规则闸门从对话轮次里捕获值得长期记住的事实，存进带热/温/冷分层的单一 SQLite 库；每轮用向量 + FTS5 混合召回注入提示词；附记/回忆/忘/清冷记忆四个显式工具。零依赖，纯 Node。

description.en: Edit and resend or regenerate a message you already sent, including while its answer is still streaming: the plugin stops the running turn through the official Session.cancel, waits for the session to go idle (8s cap), then rewinds that message in place the same way dsh-redo does. Command is /relive so it can coexist with dsh-redo.
description.zh: 生成中也能编辑已发送的消息：点「编辑重发」或「重新生成」时，如果这一轮还在跑，先通过官方 Session.cancel 停掉并等会话空闲（上限 8 秒），再按上游 dsh-redo 的方式原地撤回并重发。命令为 /relive，可与 dsh-redo 同时安装。

description.en: Douyin for DSH: bounded autonomous watching with storyboard frames and danmaku sampling, persona and interest memory, a daily watch report, plus direct-message auto-reply and one daily greeting for a whitelisted set of friends. This is a maintained fork of dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent 1.4.7 that fixes follow-list read timeouts, unclickable conversations, missed replies, and greetings that stopped scheduling after a single send. Windows only (a dedicated Edge window, Node.js 22.13+). Replies and greetings are sent as ordinary messages with no “automated reply” label, and once you have enabled them they restart by themselves each time DSH launches until you stop them by hand. It registers the same bundle id as dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent and LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent, so it replaces them rather than running next to them.
description.zh: DSH 里的抖音：限时自主观看（抽帧故事板 + 弹幕采样）、人格与兴趣记忆、观看日报，并给许可名单里的好友自动回私信、每天问候一次。本条目是基于 dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent 1.4.7 的维护分支，修掉了关注名单读取超时、会话点不开、漏回消息、问候发一条就停等问题。仅限 Windows（专用 Edge 窗口、Node.js 22.13+）。回复和问候以普通消息发出，不带“自动回复”标记；启用后每次 DSH 启动都会自动恢复，直到你手动停止。它和 dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent、LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent 注册同一个 bundle id，是替代而不是并装。

description.en: Pre-install security gate: quarantines each plugin, skill and subagent bundle with install scripts disabled, scans it with Cisco Skill Scanner, SkillScan, Cisco MCP Scanner, OSV-Scanner, Trivy, Gitleaks and optional SARIF tools or an LLM judge on a DSH model, then passes, asks for review or blocks it. Needs the install-gate hook proposed in deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#12999.
description.zh: 安装前安全闸门：在禁用安装脚本的隔离区中检查每个插件、技能和子代理组合包，使用 Cisco Skill Scanner、SkillScan、Cisco MCP Scanner、OSV-Scanner、Trivy、Gitleaks 以及可选的 SARIF 工具或基于 DSH 模型的 LLM 判定进行扫描，然后放行、要求审查或阻止。需要 deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#12999 中提议的 install-gate 钩子。

description.en: Confluence and Jira over Atlassian remote MCP as a configuration-only bundle: one MCP client row, OAuth handled by mcp-remote with the token cached in ~/.mcp-auth, no login command and no in-app UI. Exposes mcp__atlassian__* tools (CQL search, pages, comments, JQL issues, transitions).
description.zh: 以纯配置包的形式接入 Atlassian 远程 MCP，提供 Confluence 与 Jira：只加一行 MCP 客户端配置，OAuth 交给 mcp-remote、令牌缓存在 ~/.mcp-auth，没有登录命令也没有界面。工具名为 mcp__atlassian__*（CQL 搜索、页面、评论、JQL 问题、状态流转）。

description.en: Sends a Markdown file from the conversation into a self-hosted SiYuan notebook: a button on every delivered-file card and on the document-preview toolbar, or just ask the agent to send it, all through the SiYuan kernel HTTP API. Existing notes are never overwritten — a repeated title gets a timestamp suffix — and the API token stays in the host credential store rather than in settings files or the browser.
description.zh: 把对话里交付的 Markdown 文件一键送进自建的思源笔记：交付文件卡片和文档预览工具栏各有一个按钮，也可以直接让智能体发送，统一走思源内核 HTTP API。已有笔记绝不覆盖——重名自动加时间戳——API token 只存在宿主凭据库里，不落设置文件、也不发给浏览器。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness quota dashboard: current-model floating pill, DeepSeek balance and official usage charts, OpenCode Go monthly and per-model quota, and GLM / Xiaomi MiMo balances.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 额度面板：跟随当前会话模型的悬浮胶囊，展示 DeepSeek 余额与官网用量图、OpenCode Go 总额度与分模型额度，以及 GLM / 小米 MiMo 余额。

description.en: Adds a quick-select model list to the DSH composer model button: a settings icon on the Model row of the model menu opens a dialog to pick and reorder favourite models, dragging vertically on the model button switches between them on release, and dragging left or right steps the reasoning effort; the menu's reasoning-effort row also gets a draggable slider (based on Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider). Text follows the DSH language setting (English / Chinese).
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框的模型按钮加入快速选择列表：模型菜单 Model 行右端的设置图标打开弹窗，勾选并排序常用模型；在模型按钮上竖向拖动、松手即在这些模型间切换，左右拖动逐档调整推理等级；菜单的「推理等级」行同时变成可拖动的滑条（基于 Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider）。界面文字跟随 DSH 语言设置（中文 / English）。

description.en: Session archive with tags, notes and per-session metrics, plus a Plan-Do-Check-Act loop over the archived sessions that produces prompt and AGENTS.md rules and re-measures them on later sessions. Runs locally without calling a model.
description.zh: 会话归档：标签、备注与会话指标；对归档语料跑 Plan-Do-Check-Act，产出 prompt 与 AGENTS.md 规则，采纳后在后续会话上重新度量。纯本地运行，不调用模型。

description.en: Third-party DSH bundle carrying the original deterministic-pixel-art Skill for editable JSON/PNG pixel art, Python rendering and recoloring within declared regions. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (other DSH versions are not claimed compatible) and Python 3.10+ with Pillow.
description.zh: 第三方 DSH bundle，携带原 deterministic-pixel-art Skill，支持可编辑 JSON/PNG 像素画、Python 渲染及声明区域内的改色。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1（其他 DSH 版本未声明兼容）以及带 Pillow 的 Python 3.10+。

description.en: Calculator tool that evaluates arithmetic expressions with a hand-written recursive-descent parser. No eval or new Function; whitelisted identifiers, length and nesting limits, and structured error codes.
description.zh: 计算器工具：手写递归下降解析器求值算术表达式，不使用 eval 或 new Function，标识符白名单、长度与嵌套上限、结构化错误码。

description.en: A Chinese-thinking plugin built for Chinese users: registers a system prompt section at order -900 so the agent reasons in Simplified Chinese.
description.zh: 适合中国宝宝的中文思考插件：在系统提示词 order -900 注册段落，让 Agent 用简体中文思考。

description.en: Port of MiMo Code's infinite-context memory: as the window fills it asks the model in the background (the current provider route unless writerProvider/writerModel is set) to write a structured checkpoint and a project MEMORY.md, then, ahead of DSH's native compaction, replaces the visible window with a rebuilt dump of tasks, checkpoint, recent user messages, memory and notes, falling back to a MiMo-style compaction. Memory files live under $DSH_HOME/mimo-context (per session, per project, plus a read-only global one); it adds mimo_* memory, history, checkpoint and rebuild tools and /mimo-* commands, with dream/distill off by default. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or a later 0.2.x.
description.zh: 移植自 MiMo Code 的无限上下文记忆：窗口逐渐填满时，在后台让模型（默认沿用当前模型路由，可用 writerProvider/writerModel 指定）写出结构化 checkpoint 和项目 MEMORY.md，并在 DSH 原生 compaction 之前，用任务、checkpoint、最近用户消息、记忆与笔记重建的内容替换当前可见窗口，没有可用 checkpoint 时回退到 MiMo 式压缩。记忆文件存在 $DSH_HOME/mimo-context（按会话、按项目，另有只读的全局记忆）；提供 mimo_* 记忆、历史、checkpoint、重建工具和 /mimo-* 命令，dream/distill 默认关闭。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或之后的 0.2.x。

description.en: Drops text blocks that carry nothing but leaked DSML tool-call tags, then rewrites the resulting empty turn into a retryable error so the host's built-in retry re-issues the request; prose that merely contains tags passes through untouched.
description.zh: 丢弃只含泄漏 DSML 工具调用标签的整段文本；若整轮没有产生任何可见内容，把结尾改写成可重试错误，交给宿主内置重试重新请求；正文夹带标签的输出原样放行。

description.en: Browse and search provider models to choose an independent summary model for DSH Standard mode, or let Auto follow the conversation route; save extra automatic pressure-compaction passes, while manual compaction attempts one useful pass. Includes Chinese/English theme-aware settings; start a new Standard-mode conversation after installation to apply the configuration.
description.zh: 按供应商浏览、搜索并选择 DSH 标准模式的独立摘要模型，或用 Auto 跟随对话路由；保存自动压力压缩额外次数，手动压缩只尝试一次有用压缩。提供中英文主题适配设置，安装后新建标准模式会话以应用配置。

description.en: Configuration panel for an existing `oneapi` route of the pi-ai provider adapter (declare that route in the llm-pi-ai settings first, with api: openai-completions): edit display name, Base URL, API key and default model, test connectivity per model and sync the model list from the gateway, with six agent tools and an optional left-sidebar panel. Written for a Baidu-internal gateway: the Base URL placeholder and token link point there, so set your own OneAPI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: pi-ai 提供方适配器里已有的 `oneapi` 路由的配置面板（需先在 llm-pi-ai 设置里声明该路由，api 选 openai-completions）：编辑显示名、Base URL、API Key 与默认模型，逐模型测试连通性并从网关同步模型列表，附带 6 个 Agent 工具与可选左侧边栏面板。最初为百度内部网关编写，Base URL 占位符与获取 Token 链接均指向内网，请改填你自己的 OneAPI 兼容网关。

description.en: A session workspace for DeepSeek Harness modeled on the Claude app, with forked sessions nested in one tree, up to four sessions on one screen, and a right rail per pane.
description.zh: 参照 Claude 应用会话界面的 DSH 工作区：fork 会话收进一棵树，一屏最多四个会话并排，每屏带自己的右栏。

description.en: Native Windows notifications when an unawaited background job settles (completed, failed, or stopped), when a conversation turn ends, or when the agent waits for a question answer or tool approval.
description.zh: 无人等待的后台任务结算（完成、失败或停止）、对话轮次结束、或 agent 等待你回答问题/工具审批时，弹出 Windows 原生通知。

description.en: Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: workspace Markdown notes with provenance, review status, BM25 search, and four km_* tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识库：工作区 Markdown 笔记，带来源、审核状态、BM25 检索与 4 个 km_* 工具。

description.en: Find Android game packages and guide Google Play dependency analysis and modification. Needs Python 3 and the Android tools you pick (JADX/apktool/adb).
description.zh: 查找 Android 游戏安装包，提供 Google Play 依赖分析与修改工作流。需要 Python 3 和你自选的 Android 工具（JADX/apktool/adb）。

description.en: Literature reading workbench in the sidebar: import PDFs into a library that groups a paper with its supporting materials, read and annotate in a built-in viewer, and chat over your notes for summaries and insights.
description.zh: 侧栏里的文献阅读工作台：把 PDF 导入文献库，正文与支撑材料归到同一篇下；内置阅读器可阅读批注；还能基于笔记对话做总结与洞察。

description.en: Cross-session memory and compaction archives for dsh, plus a persona kernel. After each substantive turn a background model call extracts facts, preferences, open tasks and commitments; entries carry ids, fade when they stop being mentioned, are capped per kind and can be corrected. When the host compacts a conversation the compressed span is written to the note vault as an archive card whose catalog is injected into the session, so details can be read back by id. Ships an append-only ledger, a settings page, a /whale command group and nine tools.
description.zh: dsh 的跨会话记忆与压缩档案插件，另带人格内核。每轮有实质内容时由一次后台模型调用萃出事实、偏好、未完成的事与答应过的事；条目带编号，久不提会淡化，按类限额，也可以纠正。宿主动压缩时，被压掉的一段落成档案卡写进笔记库，目录注入会话，需要细节时按编号读回原文。另有只追加台账、设置页、/whale 命令组与九个工具。

description.en: Shared runtime for the Personal Workbench: local SQLite, domain registration, agent tool, HTTP/SSE and opt-in cloud sync for the Tasks, Tags, Sites and Storage plugins.
description.zh: 个人工作台共享宿主：本地 SQLite、业务域注册、agent 工具、HTTP/SSE，以及任务/标签/站点/物品插件的可选云端同步。

description.en: Per-step thinking-effort pilot for DeepSeek Harness: simple tool rounds stay cheap, failures and heavy work lift one declared step, and agents can change their own depth through a set_effort tool without switching models.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供逐步思考强度驾驶：简单工具轮保持低档、失败与重活自动升一档，Agent 还能通过 set_effort 工具在不切换模型的情况下调整自身思考深度。

description.en: Folder-style session panel: organize sidebar sessions into your own folders with drag-to-assign, per-session aliases and archived dimming. Display-only — it never touches DSH grouping.
description.zh: 文件夹式会话面板：把侧栏会话装进自建文件夹，支持拖拽归类、会话别名与归档变淡；只做显示，不改 DSH 自己的分组。

description.en: Health check for a DSH profile: scores skills and agent instruction files, subagent definitions and presets on one shared 18-bucket S–E grade scale, with a sidebar panel, four dsh360_* tools, and a backup with undo for every write.
description.zh: 体检 DSH 配置：技能与 agent 说明书、子代理定义、预设共用一套 18 档 S~E 等级评分，带侧栏面板、四个 dsh360_* 工具，每次写入都有备份可撤销。

description.en: Personal memory sidebar and agent tools for Mory, with search, editing and optional GitHub/Gitee synchronization. Requires a Mory service installed and running on the DSH host.
description.zh: Mory 个人记忆侧栏与智能体工具，支持记忆检索、编辑及可选的 GitHub/Gitee 同步。需在 DSH 宿主机上先安装并启动 Mory 服务。

description.en: Sidebar workspace tree: create nested sub-workspaces at any level, start a session on any level, and pin a session to the top of its nearest folder.
description.zh: 侧边栏工作区多级树：任意一级都能新建子工作区与会话，会话可置顶到所属的最近一级文件夹，刷新不丢。

description.en: A TRAE-宝-style personal assistant plugin for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session long-term memory, auto-extracted candidate memories, first-time onboarding, a dedicated assistant agent preset, scheduled daily digest, desktop notifications, and a live overview panel.
description.zh: DSH 宝 —— TRAE 宝式个人助理插件：跨会话长期记忆、自动候选记忆提取、首次启动引导、专属助理 Agent 预设、定时每日简报、桌面通知与实时工作状态面板。

description.en: Shows and loads Qwen (qianwen*) skills only when the session runs on the Qwen Token Plan CN provider, and hides and blocks them on any other provider.
description.zh: 仅当会话运行在 Qwen Token Plan CN 供应商上时才展示并加载千问（qianwen*）技能，其它供应商下隐藏并禁止加载。

description.en: Requirement-to-delivery workbench: paste or upload a requirement, and a plan-dispatch-verify loop delivers it with child agents and test evidence.
description.zh: 需求驱动交付工作台：粘贴或上传需求后，规划-派发-验证闭环驱动子 agent 交付，并以测试证据判定完成。

description.en: Validates every tool call against that tool's own parameters schema before it runs, and denies with the exact path and type. The host renders a tool's parameters into the prompt but never checks a call against them, so a wrong-typed value reaches the tool body: a number lands in path.join and the caller gets a raw TypeError instead of an answer. This plugin hooks tools/pre-execute, resolves the definition, and returns a deny whose reason reads "demo_tool.dir: expected string, got number (123)". Covers primitive types and unions, required, enum/const, nested properties, array items, additionalProperties:false, and oneOf/anyOf/allOf. Fails open on purpose: an internal error, an unknown tool, or a schema construct it cannot read allows the call. mode deny or warn, plus a skip list. Two read-only tools, arg_guard_status and arg_guard_check.
description.zh: 在工具真正执行前，用这个工具自己的 parameters 校验入参，被拒时给出精确的字段路径与类型。宿主只把 parameters 渲染进 prompt，从不按它校验调用，所以类型错误的值会一路走到工具体内：一个数字进了 path.join，调用方拿到的是一句原始 TypeError 而不是回答。本插件挂在 tools/pre-execute 上，取出工具定义， 返回 deny，reason 形如「demo_tool.dir: expected string, got number (123)」。覆盖原始类型与联合类型、 required、enum/const、嵌套 properties、数组 items、additionalProperties:false、oneOf/anyOf/allOf。 故意 fail-open：自身出错、工具未注册、或遇到读不懂的 schema 构造，一律放行。mode 可选 deny 或 warn， 另有 skip 名单。两个只读工具：arg_guard_status 与 arg_guard_check。

description.en: macOS only. Shows a live badge in DSH and an optional SwiftBar menu-bar item reporting what the Yunshu (Eagleyun SASE) endpoint agent is doing on this Mac right now — TCC permission requests, its own agent logs (screen capture, clipboard, browser URL reads, browser window counts), DLP scan paths and the process table. Read-only: it never blocks, disables or modifies the agent, keeps the last 60 events in memory only, writes three state files locally and makes no network calls. Requires the Yunshu agent to be installed; SwiftBar is optional.
description.zh: 仅 macOS。在 DSH 顶栏和可选的 SwiftBar 菜单栏显示云枢（Yunshu / 鹰云 SASE）终端 agent 此刻在本机做什么：TCC 权限申请、云枢自身日志（截屏、剪贴板读写、读取前台浏览器地址、各浏览器窗口数）、DLP 扫描的文件路径、进程表。纯只读——不拦截、不禁用、不修改云枢，只在内存保留最近 60 条动作，本地写三个状态文件，不联网。需要本机已安装云枢；SwiftBar 可选，不装也能用。

description.en: Remake a viral short video end to end in one workbench: source clip, character sheet behind a human approval gate before any paid render, AI face swap, frame-sample QA and the final cut, plus a media library, a three-track timeline, and any RunningHub workflow connected by its ID.
description.zh: 爆款短视频复刻工作台：原片、角色图（付费生成前必须人工过审）、换人、抽帧质检、成片五步；附素材库与三轨时间线，填 RunningHub 工作流 ID 即可接入任意工作流。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud while they stream: sentence-by-sentence speech with highlighted lines in a sidebar player, pause, mute and stop controls, and automatic quieting for code blocks. Speech uses the operating system's local voices; its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 边生成边把回复念出来：按句合成语音，侧栏播放器里当前句逐句滚动高亮，可暂停、静音、停止，遇到代码块自动静音。朗读用的是操作系统自带的本地语音；它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Inline annotations for DeepSeek Harness replies and sidebar documents, with a composer card and a right-sidebar list.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的回复和侧边栏文档加划词标注，聚合成输入框卡片并一键发给 AI，右侧边栏可查看列表。

description.en: Mobile viewport lock, overscroll containment, virtual keyboard resizing, and sidebar auto-retraction.
description.zh: 移动端视口锁定、滚动溢出阻断、虚拟键盘自适应及侧边栏自动收起。

description.en: Hide or show individual DeepSeek Harness sidebar entries from a settings page without disabling the plugin; includes in-plugin update.
description.zh: 在设置页逐个隐藏或显示 DSH 左侧边栏的插件入口，无需停用插件；带插件内更新。

description.en: Storage records for DSH: names, brands, locations, units, stock text and tags with local SQLite and optional metadata sync.
description.zh: DSH 储物：记录名称、品牌、位置、单位、库存文本与标签，本地 SQLite 保存，可选元数据同步。

description.en: Adds read-only Git status colors, file badges and directory change summaries to the native DSH file tree, with cached status reads and a manual refresh button.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生文件树中显示只读 Git 状态颜色、文件标记和目录变更汇总，提供状态缓存及手动刷新按钮。

description.en: Site bookmark manager for DSH: a folder tree, multiple links per site, tags and filtering, with per-folder views.
description.zh: DSH 站点收藏：目录树、每个站点多条链接、标签与筛选，支持按目录浏览。

description.en: Windows session-end reminder for DeepSeek Harness: an in-window unread badge that lists session names and jumps to the session when clicked, two Web Audio chimes, taskbar flashing, and a tray badge on the whale icon; only visible sessions are counted, and the settings page has seven options including a zh/en switch.
description.zh: Windows 会话结束提醒：窗口内未读浮层列出会话名、点击即跳转到该会话，两段 Web Audio 提示音，任务栏闪烁，并在托盘鲸鱼图标上叠加数字徽章；只统计可见会话，设置页含中英文切换等七项。

description.en: A long-form fiction writing desk inside DeepSeek Harness: a shelf of books, a three-column editor (chapter tree, prose, AI assistant), outlines, character/world/foreshadowing notes, story archives, and an AI assistant whose prose and note edits are reviewed before they are written. Interface and AI prompts are bilingual (Chinese and English), manuscripts stay local in SQLite, and the model uses the DeepSeek service already configured in Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的长篇小说写作台：书架、三栏编辑器（目录、正文、AI 助手）、大纲、角色 / 世界观 / 伏笔资料、故事档案，以及会先给出可审阅的正文与资料改动、确认后才写入的 AI 助手。界面与 AI 提示词支持中英双语，书稿保存在本地 SQLite，模型复用 Harness 中已配置的 DeepSeek 服务。

description.en: Shows Qwen Token Plan, Z.ai GLM Coding Plan and MiniMax Coding Plan quota usage in three cards under Settings → Models, reusing the configured provider API keys for Z.ai and MiniMax and a dedicated browser-window sign-in for Qwen.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 模型」底部用三张卡片集中显示 Qwen Token Plan、Z.ai GLM Coding Plan 和 MiniMax Coding Plan 的套餐用量，Z.ai 与 MiniMax 复用已配置的 provider API key，Qwen 通过独立浏览器窗口登录取数。

description.en: Task manager for DSH: a task tree, eight views, priorities, due dates, timeline/restart chains, batch merge and table moves.
description.zh: DSH 任务管理：任务树、八个视图、优先级、截止日、时间线/重启链、批量归并与迁表。

description.en: Tag manager for DSH: create, search and delete tags, with soft-delete and per-item mappings used by the workbench task, site and storage plugins.
description.zh: DSH 标签管理：创建、搜索、删除标签，支持软删除与条目映射，供任务、站点与储物插件使用。

description.en: Syncs the same DeepSeek account's terminals: plugin inventory and enablement, app settings, selected workspace files, session logs and skills / agent presets. Four transports (shared folder, git, WebDAV, LAN) and five independent content toggles, with a dry-run plan, conflict copies and additive-only session import. Its optional LAN transport listens on 0.0.0.0 (port 47810 by default) and is protected only by a pairing token over plain HTTP; synced app settings and workspace files are not encrypted by the plugin (secrets are stripped before publishing).
description.zh: 同步同一 DeepSeek 账号下的多台终端：插件清单与启用状态、应用设置、选定的工作区文件、会话记录、技能 / Agent 预设。四种传输方式（共享文件夹、Git、WebDAV、局域网）与五类独立内容开关，支持预演计划、冲突副本和会话只增不改。可选的 LAN 传输默认监听 0.0.0.0（端口 47810），只靠配对令牌保护且走明文 HTTP；同步的应用设置和工作区文件不由插件加密（发布前会剔除密钥）。

description.en: Keeps e-commerce merchant logins in one place: one isolated Chrome or ego lite browser profile per shop for Pinduoduo, Taobao/Tmall, Douyin, JD and 1688, so listing and data-collection scripts reuse a single sign-in; silent and scheduled login checks, automatic credential refill when signed out, scheduled collection jobs driven by a platform-to-metric catalog, and self-update that only deploys verified commits.
description.zh: 把拼多多、淘宝/天猫、抖音、京东、1688 的商家店铺登录态集中管起来：一店一份隔离的 Chrome / ego lite 浏览器档案，上架与采集脚本复用同一份登录态；支持静默与定时检测、掉线自动代填、按「平台→采集域→指标」目录执行定时采集作业，以及只部署经校验 commit 的自更新。

description.en: A full-viewport donkey-mill background for the DSH Web UI: an animated top-down donkey or a Chinese-character form circles the millstone, accelerating with the model's live token throughput and plodding slowly when idle; a bottom-right panel switches form, adjusts opacity and hides the scene, persisting in localStorage.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的全屏驴拉磨背景：俯视动画驴或汉字形态绕磨盘转动，转速随模型实时 token 吞吐加快、空闲时缓慢踱步；右下角面板可切换形态、调节透明度、隐藏背景，设置保存在 localStorage。

description.en: Android companion bridge: QR-code LAN pairing with revocable device tokens and TLS fingerprints, a phone-connection and device-management panel, and an HTTPS access proxy serving sessions, live events and approvals to the paired native app.
description.zh: Android 配套桥接：局域网扫码配对（可吊销的设备 Token 与 TLS 指纹）、手机连接与设备管理面板，以及向配对原生 App 提供会话、实时事件与审批的 HTTPS 接入代理。

description.en: Configurable session titles with custom prompts, refresh policies, local topic-drift detection, and single-session or historical title regeneration.
description.zh: 可配置的会话标题生成，支持自定义提示词、刷新策略、本地话题漂移检测，以及单条会话和历史标题重建。

description.en: Keep your git workflow inside DeepSeek Harness. A composer chip shows the current branch at a glance; the TRAE-style popup lets you switch or create branches, fetch remotes, commit & push a subset of changes, merge with a clear source -> target flow, and stash / restore partial changes — all without leaving the chat. Popovers dock above the composer so your draft stays visible; the change list is prefetched when the menu opens; and the plugin confirms before touching a dirty tree.
description.zh: 让 git 操作不离开 DSH 聊天窗口。输入框工具行的胶囊实时显示当前分支；TRAE 风格弹层一键切换/新建分支、同步远端、勾选改动提交推送、按来源 -> 目标流向合并分支、暂存与恢复部分改动。所有面板停靠在输入框上方，不遮挡草稿；菜单打开时预取改动列表；工作区不干净时先确认再操作。非 git 目录自动隐藏。

description.en: Adds a Plan/Build switch to the composer chip and to the Tab key, keeping a separate model and reasoning effort per mode and restoring them on every toggle, /plan, and plan approval.
description.zh: 在输入框的 chip 上用 Tab 键切换 Plan/Build，每个模式各自记住模型与 reasoning 强度，切换、/plan 与批准计划后自动恢复。

description.en: Watches Feishu/Lark Minutes, writes a full meeting note and a title for each recording into Feishu Docs, and keeps one index document that maps minutes to notes.
description.zh: 自动发现飞书妙记，为每条录音生成完整会议纪要与标题并写入飞书文档，并用一篇索引文档维护妙记与纪要的对应关系。

description.en: Windows 11 Mica, Acrylic and Tabbed backdrop materials for the DSH desktop window, with adjustable page opacity; a bundled app.asar patch makes the window transparent so the wallpaper shows through. Windows only. The transparency patch is a separate step you run yourself (node tools/window-bridge.mjs apply, with DSH closed): it edits the installed app.asar, keeps a backup next to it, and restore undoes it.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面窗口换上 Windows 11 的 Mica、Acrylic、Tabbed 系统材质，页面不透明度可调；随包附带的 app.asar 补丁让窗口透明，壁纸才会透出来。仅限 Windows。透明补丁是要你自己另外运行的一步（关闭 DSH 后执行 node tools/window-bridge.mjs apply）：它会修改已安装的 app.asar，并在旁边留一份备份，restore 可还原。

description.en: Dispatch a task to a real DSH session by workspace path or session id; results land in a persistent task ledger that can be queried without triggering the model. It serves HTTP on 127.0.0.1:7391 and requires a bearer token it generates on first run (kept in ~/.dsh/relay/token), rejects non-loopback Host and foreign Origin, and stores task results as JSON files under ~/.dsh/relay/tasks; an optional notifyUrl receives each finished result.
description.zh: 按工作空间或会话 id 给真实的 DSH 会话派发任务；结果写入持久任务台账，查询时不会触发模型。它在 127.0.0.1:7391 提供 HTTP 接口，首次运行自动生成令牌并要求 Bearer 认证（存放在 ~/.dsh/relay/token），拒绝非回环 Host 与外部 Origin；任务结果以 JSON 文件存在 ~/.dsh/relay/tasks，可选的 notifyUrl 会收到每个完成任务的结果。

description.en: Reversible context folding plus external memory for DeepSeek Harness: tool output collapses into expandable lines, session facts become auditable records.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的可逆上下文折叠 + 外部记忆：工具输出与模型回复折叠成一行可展开的摘要（12 个长会话实测 52×），会话事实沉淀成可像文件一样浏览的带证据记录（rcs:// 寻址、L0/L1/L2 分层、每条事实可回查来源）。

description.en: Off-peak scheduler for DeepSeek Harness: queue prompts to send automatically during DeepSeek off-peak hours, with peak/off-peak price fetching, low-balance alerts and a local usage ledger.
description.zh: DSH 谷价调度器：把写好的指令排在 DeepSeek Harness谷价时段自动发送，附带峰谷价格与时段抓取、余额提醒与本机用量记账。

description.en: Video analysis panel in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar. Paste a YouTube or Bilibili link to fetch its subtitles and generate a summary, chapters, a mind map and citation-backed Q&A over the transcript, with an embedded player whose timestamps jump to that moment and keep playing. Videos without subtitles fall back to local Whisper / SenseVoice transcription (audio stays on the machine); silent videos fall back to frame OCR with macOS Vision, or to vision-model frame descriptions. Per-video analysis caching, a 20-item history, and two agent tools: video_digest and video. A Bilibili SESSDATA cookie, if you enter one, is stored in ~/.dsh/video-credentials.json (mode 0600), transcripts are sent to your current model, and its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的视频解析面板。粘贴 YouTube / 哔哩哔哩链接即可抓取字幕，生成总结、章节、思维导图，以及带「依据」时间戳的转写稿问答；内置播放器，点时间戳会跳到对应位置并继续播放。没有字幕时用本机 Whisper / SenseVoice 转写兜底（音频不出本机），纯无声视频则用 macOS Vision 做画面文字识别，或让视觉模型描述画面。按视频缓存分析结果、保留最近 20 条历史，并注册 video_digest、video 两个 agent 工具。如果填了 B 站 SESSDATA Cookie，会保存在 ~/.dsh/video-credentials.json（权限 0600）；文字稿会发给当前模型；它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Corner card that watches Tibo (@thsottiaux) on X, shows new posts and replies with a Chinese translation, and marks reset-related posts; extra JSON sources can be added. Reads the third-party tiboreset.com text mirror rather than X itself (a few minutes behind, text only); translation goes through the host translation service, which may send post text to a public provider unless translate is set to false.
description.zh: 右上角卡片：盯 Tibo（@thsottiaux）在 X 上的新帖与回复，自动配中文译文，重置类消息加标；支持追加 JSON 数据源，Host 侧抓取与翻译，不消耗对话 token。数据来自第三方文字镜像 tiboreset.com 而非 X 本身（有数分钟延迟，仅文字）；翻译走宿主翻译服务，帖子文字可能经公共翻译服务商，把 translate 设为 false 可只留本地。

description.en: Hosts the ai-goofish-monitor scraper for the Xianyu second-hand marketplace: managed backend lifecycle, thirteen goofish_* agent tools, a sidebar panel, and AI listing analysis through the dsh-our-free-model gateway by default.
description.zh: 托管闲鱼二手市场监控后端 ai-goofish-monitor：管理其进程生命周期，提供十三个 goofish_* agent 工具与侧边栏面板，并把商品分析默认接到 dsh-our-free-model 的免费模型网关。

description.en: A Conductor tab and commands for a chat's context: /new replaces the context in place with a model-written handoff, /rewind restores the chat and the agent's file edits to an earlier prompt, plus /drop, pins, an automatic compaction level, recovery after failed turns, silent messages between chats and agent and task orchestration. Supersedes dsh-orchestrator, dsh-force-compact and dsh-continue, so do not install it alongside them. Requires DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.5, Node >= 22.5, the web profile and dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 聊天上下文的 Conductor 标签页与命令：/new 用模型写的交接单就地替换上下文，/rewind 把对话与智能体的文件改动回退到更早的提示，另有 /drop、置顶、自动压缩阈值、失败轮次后的自动恢复、聊天间静默消息，以及 agent 与任务编排。取代 dsh-orchestrator、dsh-force-compact 与 dsh-continue，不能与它们同装。需要 DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.5、Node >= 22.5、web profile 与 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Windows environment doctor: audits 30 developer tools, installs the missing ones, manages the user PATH, and exports or imports an environment share code so a team keeps identical setups.
description.zh: 环境体检：审计 30 种 Windows 开发工具，安装缺失的工具，管理用户 PATH，并支持导出/导入环境分享码，让团队配置保持一致。

description.en: Composer add-on for DSH: next-message prediction shown as ghost text, history prefix completion, a one-line recap after each turn, and ↑/↓ recall of earlier prompts.
description.zh: DSH 输入框增强：回合结束后预测下一句并以灰字显示，输入时按会话历史补全，每轮结束追加一行回顾，草稿为空时 ↑/↓ 翻看之前发过的提示词。

description.en: Ecommerce research for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth into the Nexscope MCP server, marketplace data across Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, Shopee, Temu and 1688, plus a bundled nexscope skill.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的电商研究插件：OAuth 接入 Nexscope MCP，覆盖亚马逊、TikTok Shop、沃尔玛、Shopee、Temu 与 1688 等市场数据，并捆绑 nexscope 技能。

description.en: Plug/unplug any DeepSeek Harness plugin cleanly — list every mounted layer (bundles + patch rows), remove with full cleanup, disable/enable without deleting, and audit for orphaned/dangling state. CLI + agent-callable unplug tool. Read-only by default; destructive operations require explicit confirmation.
description.zh: 让 DSH 插件的安装和卸载干净利落——列出所有加载层（Bundle + 补丁行）、完整卸载（清理 Bundle 列表+补丁行+依赖）、临时禁用以调试而不真正删除、以及审计残留的孤立行或悬空引用。CLI 与 agent 均可调用，默认只读，破坏性操作需二次确认。

description.en: Checkpoint-and-resume for interrupted runs: when a conversation reaches a key step — two consecutive successful file writes/edits, or one successful test command — it appends a lightweight record (timestamp, step type, tool, ≤200-char argument summary, result status) to a local JSONL file, keeping the newest 50 and pruning after 24 hours. After DSH restarts, the session_recovery tool lists unfinished sessions and resuming one creates a new session whose system prompt carries only the last three checkpoints (≤500 characters) instead of the full transcript.
description.zh: 中断续跑：对话走到关键节点时（连续两次成功的文件写入/编辑，或一次成功的测试命令），向本地 JSONL 追加一条轻量记录（时间、步骤类型、工具名、≤200 字参数摘要、结果状态），只保留最近 50 条并在 24 小时后过期。DSH 重启后，session_recovery 工具列出未完成的会话，恢复时新建会话，系统提示只携带最后三个检查点（≤500 字），而不是整段历史。
