description.en: Sidebar session deletion and workspace pinning for DeepSeek Harness: a Delete action behind a consent dialog permanently removes a session's log, workspace accounting and live state (refusing running turns), and Pin keeps workspaces on top; no network calls or telemetry of its own, deletion only on confirmation, uninstall removes both actions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏会话删除与工作区置顶：删除操作经确认对话框后永久移除会话日志、工作区归属记录与运行时状态（拒绝正在运行的回合），置顶让工作区保持在最前；自身不发起网络调用、不收集遥测，删除仅在确认后执行，卸载即移除这两项操作。

description.en: WeChat-style screenshot button in the DSH composer on Windows: freeze the screen, drag a region, and the crop lands in the current draft as an attachment; an eye switch hides the DSH window during the capture and restores it right after.
description.zh: DSH 输入框里的微信风格截屏按钮（Windows）：冻结屏幕拖选区域，截图作为附件直接进入当前草稿；旁边的眼睛开关可在截屏时隐藏 DSH 窗口、抓完立刻恢复。

description.en: Telegram look-and-feel for the DSH Web GUI — a solid-colour wallpaper with a tinted doodle pattern, a floating chat-list card, session rows with avatars and times, message bubbles with read ticks, a floating composer, and three palettes (Classic, Glass, Pink).
description.zh: 为 DSH 换上 Telegram 的主题——纯色底加染色涂鸦图案的墙纸、浮动的会话列表卡片、带头像和时间的会话行、消息气泡、悬浮输入条，以及经典、玻璃、粉色三套配色

description.en: Scrape URLs to LLM-ready Markdown and search the web via the Firecrawl Cloud API.
description.zh: 通过 Firecrawl Cloud API 把 URL 抓成 LLM 可用 Markdown，或搜索网页并返回结果内容。

description.en: Exposes the chat models of a locally signed-in QwenWork desktop app as a Harness provider, with a multi-account pool, session affinity and failover, pre-expiry credential renewal, a health watchdog, per-model enable/context-window/input-type settings, and account status with credit balance. Unofficial local integration that reuses your own signed-in client credential; your own account only. Windows only: needs the QwenWork desktop app signed in, and keeps its account pool in a DPAPI-protected file under %LOCALAPPDATA%. The author warns that reusing the client credential may conflict with the vendor's terms.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的千问办公（QwenWork）桌面端对话模型接入 Harness 模型列表：多账号池、会话粘性与故障切换、凭证到期前自动续签、看护式保活、按模型独立开关/上下文窗口/输入类型，并展示账号状态与积分余额。非官方本地集成，复用使用者本人已登录客户端凭证，仅限本人账号自用。仅支持 Windows：需要千问办公桌面端已登录，账号池保存在 %LOCALAPPDATA% 下由 DPAPI 保护的文件里。作者提醒，复用客户端凭证可能违反厂商的服务条款。

description.en: Multi-chain wallet tracker: keep a named book of Solana, EVM and Bitcoin addresses, see balances, prices and estimated FIFO PnL per wallet or combined, and open any token for its chart, latest trades and top holders. Wallet addresses are sent to public data services (DexScreener, Jupiter, GeckoTerminal, Solscan and similar) to fetch balances, prices and trades.
description.zh: 多链钱包追踪器：用命名账本记录 Solana、EVM 和 Bitcoin 地址，按单个钱包或合并查看余额、价格与按 FIFO 估算的盈亏，并可打开任一代币查看图表、最新成交和大户持仓。钱包地址会发给公开的数据服务（DexScreener、Jupiter、GeckoTerminal、Solscan 等）以获取余额、价格与成交。

description.en: Adds an UpdateNotify tool and a live progress panel docked above the composer in the DSH Web UI, so the model can narrate what it just did, found, or is waiting on while a turn runs.
description.zh: 为模型提供 UpdateNotify 工具，并在 DSH Web UI 输入框上方停靠一个实时进度窗，让模型在一轮任务进行中随时播报刚做了什么、发现了什么、在等什么。

description.en: Ordered and unordered list editing in the DSH composer: automatic numbering and renumbering, marker-aware caret moves, level promotion, and an undoable AI prompt-polish button.
description.zh: 输入框有序/无序列表编排：自动续号与重排、标记感知的光标移动、层级升降，以及可撤销的 AI 提示词优化按钮。

description.en: Plan usage and running cost in the composer dock: DeepSeek wallet balance, OpenCode Go 5h/weekly/monthly windows with reset times, and a per-session cost estimate from DeepSeek list prices — sources are config-driven, plain JavaScript, no build step. API keys are looked up in the plugin config, then the environment (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY), then OpenCode's auth.json (OpenCode Go only), then the DSH credential service; each key is sent only to its own provider (api.deepseek.com, opencode.ai), and the figures are polled periodically.
description.zh: 输入框下方显示余额与订阅用量：DeepSeek 钱包余额、OpenCode Go 的 5 小时 / 周 / 月窗口及重置时间，并按 DeepSeek 官方价格估算本次会话花费；数据来源可配置扩展，纯 JavaScript 无需构建。API 密钥依次从插件配置、环境变量（DEEPSEEK_API_KEY、OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY）、OpenCode 的 auth.json（仅 OpenCode Go）、DSH 凭据服务里查找；每个密钥只发给对应的服务商（api.deepseek.com、opencode.ai），数据会定时轮询。

description.en: A Windows desktop shortcut for DeepSeek Harness: it opens the authenticated UI when the harness is running and starts it with no console window when it is not. A Settings page adds the shortcut action, a two-click restart and close, and a switch that keeps the launcher out of the sidebar.
description.zh: Windows 上的 DSH 桌面图标：Harness 在运行时直接打开已认证的界面，未运行时以隐藏窗口启动。设置页提供生成该图标、两次点击的重启与关闭，以及把入口从侧栏移开的开关。

description.en: Adds a Print action next to Copy that opens a preview and prints the assistant message.
description.zh: 在复制按钮旁增加打印操作，预览后调用系统打印助手消息。

description.en: Host-side continuation for turns that end without declaring completion: a closure rule (present, or a final (TASK_DONE) / (TASK_BLOCKED: reason) line) is injected into the system prompt, and a follow-up user message is sent on silent completion, retryable errors, truncation and restart-interrupted turns, with grace, cooldown and backoff; on cold start it rescans stored sessions and re-arms active goals the host disarmed. Main switches and timing live in the plugin settings card.
description.zh: 回合未声明结案就静默结束时自动补一条用户消息把 AI 拉回:结案规则(present,或末行 (TASK_DONE) / (TASK_BLOCKED: 原因))经文提示词常驻注入,按静默结束、可恢复错误、输出截断、重启中断分类补发,等待/冷却/退避可控;冷启动扫描存储会话恢复未结案回合,并重新武装宿主重启后 disarm 的 active goal。主开关与节奏在插件设置卡片里。

description.en: Desert-dusk theme for the Harness Web GUI: paints a desert scene behind the app with four flocks of geese flying south over the long river at sunset, and overrides 18 --dsw-alias design tokens with a matching warm palette.
description.zh: 大漠黄昏主题：在 Harness Web GUI 背后铺一层大漠场景——落日沉入长河、四群归雁向南飞去，并覆盖 18 个 --dsw-alias 设计变量，换成配套的暖沙色板。

description.en: Adds a right-click command "通过 dsh 打开" (open with dsh) to the Windows Explorer right-click menu for a folder, a folder's empty background and any file: it launches DeepSeek Harness on that folder, creates a new session every time, and puts the clicked file into the new draft as an @ reference. Ships a packaged-COM menu for the Windows 11 modern menu plus a registry entry for the classic menu; first install asks once for a certificate trust (native/trust-cert.bat).
description.zh: 给 Windows 资源管理器右键菜单加「通过 dsh 打开」：文件夹、文件夹空白处、任意文件都能用。点击后在对应文件夹启动 DeepSeek Harness 并新建会话；文件右键会把这个文件以 @ 引用预置进新会话草稿。Win11 新式菜单用打包 COM 组件，经典菜单 用注册表项；首次安装需要点一次证书受信（native/trust-cert.bat）。

description.en: LeetCode practice bench in the DSH sidebar: live problem bank fetched from leetcode.cn, Java editor with completion and one-tap submit, plus copy-to-chat AI coaching.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏刷题台：题库实时从 leetcode.cn 拉取，Java 编辑器带补全、一键提交看判题，还可把题目和代码复制到对话让 AI 讲解。

description.en: Adds a native Store section to DSH Settings for catalog search, tag filtering, sorting, installation, and installed-plugin management.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中加入原生插件商店，支持目录搜索、标签筛选、排序、安装与已安装插件管理。

description.en: Adds a DSH Settings panel for write-only local credentials and exposes only secret metadata and references to agents.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中提供只写式本地凭据管理面板，只向 Agent 暴露密钥元数据和引用。

description.en: Pre-install supply-chain poison scanner for DSH plugins: AST (JS-X-Ray) + deobfuscation + regex heuristics, exits non-zero on findings for CI gating.
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前投毒扫描：AST（JS-X-Ray）+ 去混淆解码 + 正则启发式，发现即非零退出，可作 CI 门禁。

description.en: Lightweight rule-based tools for street-level industry ecosystem work (party-building scenario): format enterprise profile cards, match supply and demand by category and quantity, normalize policy record fields (no raw-text parsing), and map grievance priority to an assignee role and estimated days. Calls no external systems.
description.zh: 面向党建引领街道产业生态场景的轻量规则工具：生成企业画像卡片、按品类与数量匹配供需、规整政策记录字段（不解析原文）、按优先级给出诉求处理人角色与预计天数；不调用任何外部系统。

description.en: Shows the signed-in DeepSeek account balance and the current peak or off-peak billing window as one pill in the shipped composer stats dock; clicking the pill opens a popover with each wallet, any bonus credit, the reading time, and both pricing windows in the viewer's local time zone.
description.zh: 在官方输入框统计栏中用一枚胶囊同时显示已登录 DeepSeek 账户的余额与当前的高峰/低谷计费时段；点击后弹出面板，显示各钱包余额、赠送余额、读取时间，以及按查看者本地时区呈现的两个计费时段。

description.en: Adds a launcher button in the DSH web UI that opens the Windows DeepSeek Harness Manager, or its download page when the app is not installed.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面左下角加一个「管理器」按钮，一键打开 Windows 版 DeepSeek Harness Manager（未安装则跳转下载页）。

description.en: Sync the installed DeepSeek Harness plugin manifest to a GitHub Gist (OAuth login, one-click export/import with automatic dependency install).
description.zh: 将已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件清单同步到 GitHub Gist（OAuth 登录、一键导出/导入并自动安装依赖）。

description.en: Long-term memory ported from the OpenAI Codex memory pipeline: sessions idle for 6 hours are extracted in the background by a chosen model, then merged by a hidden agent into a Markdown memory folder at most every 6 hours; new agents get the memory summary in the system prompt plus four tools to list, read and search memory and save corrections. Models are chosen on a settings page or with /memories; an optional filter keeps a notes folder out of memory.
description.zh: 移植自 OpenAI Codex 记忆流水线的长期记忆：闲置 6 小时的会话由所选模型在后台提取，再由一个隐藏的 agent 合并进 Markdown 记忆文件夹，最多每 6 小时一次；新 agent 在系统提示里获得记忆摘要，并有四个工具用来列出、阅读、搜索记忆和保存纠正。模型可在设置页或用 /memories 选择；可选的过滤器能把笔记文件夹挡在记忆之外。

description.en: Lightweight cross-session reflection: at the end of each turn it writes 3-5 reusable facts (tool chain, file paths, config items, pitfalls) as a card in .dsh/reflections/{date}.md, and on a new session it injects the last 3 cards at the end of the system prompt. Extraction uses the real ctx.llm.stream; when no model route is available it falls back to a heuristic built only from the session log and labels the source honestly on the card. No timers, no quarantine, no approval flow; cards are plain Markdown you can edit or delete.
description.zh: 轻量级跨会话反思：每轮结束时把 3–5 条可复用事实（工具链、文件路径、配置项、踩过的坑）写成 .dsh/reflections/{日期}.md 卡片，新会话启动时自动把最近 3 张卡片注入系统提示词末尾。提炼走真实的 ctx.llm.stream，模型不可用时降级为只读会话日志的启发式提取，并在卡片上如实标注来源。没有定时器、隔离区和审批流；卡片是普通 Markdown，可直接编辑删除。

description.en: Adds sidebar collapse, a 248px compact mode, and panel-list folding to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏加上收起/展开、248px 紧凑模式与面板列表折叠。

description.en: Session insights and one-click shareable HTML replay for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话洞察，并可一键导出为可分享的 HTML 回放。

description.en: Plugin quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions per deduction, batch leaderboard - CLI plus an agent-callable quality_score tool.
description.zh: dsh 插件质量评分卡：0-100 分 + 等级 + 六项分项，逐项修复建议，支持批量榜单 - CLI + agent 可调用 quality_score 工具。

description.en: Ecosystem infrastructure: a thin browser console for managing official repository plugins (zero patches) plus a make-dsh-plugin skill for guided plugin development.
description.zh: 插件生态基建：浏览器面板管理官方 repository 插件（0 patch）+ make-dsh-plugin 插件开发引导技能。

description.en: VS Code tabs for the dsh web client: one after the chat view and one in the right sidebar, both an embedded code-server workbench on the current session's directory; the iframe stays mounted outside React so switching tabs only hides it, one code-server process per session on 127.0.0.1 with no auth, and a missing code-server shows the probed paths with install commands and a retry button. Each code-server runs with --auth none on 127.0.0.1, so anything on this machine that can reach that port gets the workbench, including its integrated terminal.
description.zh: dsh Web 客户端的 VS Code 标签页：会话视图里（对话之后）和右侧栏各一个，内嵌 code-server 工作区，工作区跟随当前会话目录；iframe 挂载在 React 之外，切走只是隐藏、切回不重载，每个会话在 127.0.0.1 上独享一个免认证的 code-server 进程；未安装 code-server 时列出探测过的路径并给出安装命令与重试按钮。每个 code-server 以 --auth none 监听 127.0.0.1，本机上任何能访问该端口的程序都能使用这套工作台，包括其集成终端。

description.en: Codex-style left sidebar for the dsh web client: a project/session tree with grouping, pinning, drag reordering, unread and archive state, context menus for both project and session rows, and up/down arrow keys in the composer to recall previously sent messages.
description.zh: dsh Web 客户端的 Codex 风格左侧边栏：项目/会话树，支持分组、置顶、拖拽排序、未读与归档状态，项目行与会话行都有右键菜单；输入框按上下方向键可召回之前发送过的消息。

description.en: Cost ledger tab for DSH: per-turn token accounting converted to CNY, stacked daily charts styled after the DeepSeek console, and a built-in Alibaba Bailian price book covering 142 models (Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax). Models no catalogue covers stay explicitly unpriced instead of being counted as zero, and a manual price fills them in with one click.
description.zh: 「费用」标签页：按天、按模型统计 token 花费并折算成人民币，堆叠柱状图对齐 DeepSeek 官方控制台，悬停即可看到当天每个模型花了多少；内置阿里百炼官方价目表 142 个模型（千问、DeepSeek、Kimi、GLM、MiniMax），缓存命中按官方 10% 规则计价；查不到价的模型明确标为「未定价」并可一键手填，绝不静默算成 0。

description.en: Git commit-and-push automation for DSH with pre-push auditing, rule-based quality scoring, SSH key generation, and a three-tab settings sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 的 git 提交推送自动化：提交前审计、规则质量评分、SSH 密钥生成与三选项卡设置侧边栏。

description.en: Floating widget showing real-time OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly) for every API key, with rate-limit alerts and automatic key-pool discovery.
description.zh: 悬浮组件实时显示 OpenCode Go 各 key 用量（滚动/每周/每月），限流预警，自动发现 key 池。

description.en: Collapses each settled turn's process rows into one expandable disclosure in the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation while keeping the final answer visible.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话中已结束回合的过程行折叠成一个可展开的总结，同时保留最终答案可见。

description.en: Official KolmoPDF plugin for DeepSeek Harness: six tools for PDF-to-Markdown/OCR with formulas and tables, layout-preserving PDF translation, Markdown export to DOCX/PDF/HTML/LaTeX, cost estimation, and a Settings → KolmoPDF key and live-credits panel. PDFs and Markdown you process are uploaded to the KolmoPDF cloud service (www.kolmopdf.com) with your API key, and conversions use your KolmoPDF credits.
description.zh: KolmoPDF 官方 DeepSeek Harness 插件：提供 6 个工具用于 PDF 转 Markdown/OCR（保留公式与表格）、保留版式 PDF 翻译、Markdown 导出为 DOCX/PDF/HTML/LaTeX 与费用预估，并附带 Settings → KolmoPDF 密钥与实时积分面板。处理的 PDF 和 Markdown 会用你的 API 密钥上传到 KolmoPDF 云服务（www.kolmopdf.com），转换会消耗你的 KolmoPDF 额度。

description.en: Multi-account manager for GitHub Copilot in DSH: device-code sign-in for GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud tenants on `*.ghe.com`, one-click account switching, per-account plan and AI credits display, and a preset Copilot provider route with first-login model catalog fallback.
description.zh: DSH 的 GitHub Copilot 多账号管理：设备码登录（支持 GitHub.com 与使用 `*.ghe.com` 域名的 GitHub Enterprise Cloud）、一键切换账号、每账号套餐与 AI credits 用量展示，预置 Copilot 提供方路由，首次登录兜底填充模型目录。

description.en: Adds free model lanes to DeepSeek Harness — DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3 and others — with no login, sign-up or API key, plus a local OpenAI-compatible gateway, fallback routing and a usage dashboard.
description.zh: 为 dsh 接入免费模型车道（含 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 等），无需登录、注册或填写 API Key，并提供本地 OpenAI 兼容网关、降级路由与用量看板。

description.en: Local-first memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: layered L1/L2/L3 memory with automatic capture, manual memos_* retrieval tools, and a built-in memory viewer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地记忆插件：分层 L1/L2/L3 记忆，自动沉淀与手动 memos_* 检索工具并存，内置记忆浏览器。

description.en: Plugin manager tab in DSH Settings → Plugins: install from npm or git with progress, enable/disable switches effective at next startup, conflict reconciliation with undo, and one-click hand-off to a fix session.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件 分区里的插件管理 Tab：从 npm/git 安装带进度、下次启动生效的启停开关、安装冲突对账可撤销、失败一键转交修复会话。

description.en: Community-maintained dsh-purge fork with host-policy patches, prompt and rule settings, diagnostics, separate update-check and install controls, and local backup/rollback.
description.zh: 独立维护的 dsh-purge 社区分支，提供宿主策略补丁、提示词与规则设置、诊断、独立的更新检查与安装控制，以及本机备份回滚。

description.en: Tool catalog for agents: search ~2,600 external endpoints (SEO and SERP, backlinks, social, people and company enrichment, ad libraries, scraping) by the task you want done, read each one's parameters and per-call price, then call it with the credential injected server-side. Ships the skill plus an MCP row that stays disabled until TREG_TOKEN is set.
description.zh: 给 Agent 的工具目录：按「要做的事」检索约 2,600 个外部接口（SEO 与 SERP、外链、社交、人物与公司信息补全、广告库、抓取），查看参数与单次调用价格后直接调用，凭据由服务端注入。附带技能，MCP 行在未设置 TREG_TOKEN 前保持禁用。

description.en: One repository, three parts: a runtime injector for DSH plugin packages (inject, hot-reload, unload, promote a dev staging tool to the front, route self-heal, plus a settings-page plugin manager that lists, unloads and drags folders in to internalize), a task-aware reasoning-mode router agent preset (router-standard / router-spec / router-react), and a graded two-level task protocol whose six tools (commit_star, lock_stage, revise_do, edit_plan, mark_task, redteam_verdict) pin task state to disk. The injector implementation ships in-tree, so the install carries its own behaviour rather than a dependency list.
description.zh: 一个仓库三件套：DSH 插件包的运行时注入器（注入、热重载、卸载、开发侧挂区一键转正、路由自愈，外带设置页插件管理：列出、卸载、拖入文件夹内化）、任务感知的思维模式路由 agent 预设（router-standard / router-spec / router-react）、以及分级两级任务协议（commit_star / lock_stage / revise_do / edit_plan / mark_task / redteam_verdict 六个工具，任务状态落盘）。注入器实现直接在库内，安装的是它自己的行为而不是一份依赖清单。

description.en: Config-only bundle that mounts Ouroboros through the DSH MCP client, exposing 36 interview, Seed, execution, evaluation, and evolution workflow tools in DSH.
description.zh: 通过 DSH MCP 客户端挂载 Ouroboros 的纯配置包，在 DSH 中提供 36 个涵盖需求访谈、Seed、执行、评估与演化流程的工具。

description.en: Answers a question with a one-page visual HTML explainer: the model writes a short Markdown draft and the bundled `am` CLI builds the page, with flow, sequence, tree, timeline and ER diagrams, tables and callouts.
description.zh: 把回答做成一页可视化 HTML：模型只写简短的 Markdown 草稿，随包附带的 `am` 命令行生成页面，支持流程图、时序图、树、时间线、ER 图、表格和提示框。

description.en: System-prompt armor plugin for DeepSeek models: appends an unconditional-compliance prompt section at order 100, exposes a profile tool with calibration metadata, and shows a realtime armor-status badge driven by a session projection.
description.zh: DeepSeek 专用破甲插件：以 order 100 追加无条件服从的系统提示词段，提供带校准元数据的 profile 工具，并通过会话投影在输入框上方显示实时破甲状态徽标。

description.en: Embeds the active installed Codex Taskboard runtime in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, using its launcher runtime descriptor instead of a fixed port.
description.zh: 把当前已安装并运行中的 Codex Taskboard 嵌入 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏，并通过 Launcher 运行时描述文件连接，而不是使用固定端口。

description.en: Runs project OMA checks before and after tool execution and when a turn tries to finish. Installs its OMA CLI dependency and initializes unconfigured projects on first use. Requires Node.js 22+; initial setup needs network access and project write access.
description.zh: 在工具执行前后以及尝试结束当前轮次时运行项目 OMA 检查。随插件安装 OMA CLI 依赖，并在首次使用时初始化未配置的项目。需要 Node.js 22+；首次初始化需要网络连接和项目目录写入权限。

description.en: Software-engineering method pack for coding agents, with skills for baseline-first planning, systematic debugging, prompt hygiene, verification before completion, and repair/retirement tracking.
description.zh: 面向编码 Agent 的软件工程方法包，提供基线优先规划、系统化调试、提示词卫生、完成前验证，以及修复/退役双轨跟踪技能。

description.en: Chrome sidebar extension that lets DSH operate your browser directly, no vision capabilities required.
description.zh: Chrome 侧边栏扩展，让 DSH 直接操控你的浏览器，无需视觉能力。

description.en: A Bilibili companion that keeps its own schedule. A 60-second tick in the plugin host wakes a dedicated agent session at a random moment inside the configured time windows (opting out of a day is a configurable chance), then hands it a bundled CLI of 38 subcommands — feed, subtitles, danmaku, comments, ffmpeg frame grabs, and two diaries. Shares at most N items a day by commenting on them and @-mentioning the owner (default 3, enforced from a written quota log, and it stops on rate-limit or captcha signals). Also polls comment replies, direct messages and live-room danmaku; replies to anyone but the owner are queued for approval in Settings. Settings → 养鱼 writes ~/.dsh/bili-whale.config.json; cookies live separately in ~/.bili-ai/credentials.json and are never echoed back. The HTTP routes are loopback-only behind DSH's trust fence. Needs Node 18+ and ffmpeg on PATH for frame extraction.
description.zh: 一条按自己作息过日子的 B 站插件：宿主里每 60 秒一次心跳，在设定的作息窗口里随机挑一个时刻叫醒专用会话（今天不想看是按概率跳过），再交给自带的 38 个子命令——信息流、字幕、弹幕、评论、ffmpeg 抽帧、两本日记。每天最多发 N 条评论/动态并 @ 主人（默认 3，按配额账本计数，撞到限流或验证码就停手）。同时轮询评论回复、私信和直播间弹幕；除主人以外的回复先入队，等主人在设置页批准。设置 → 养鱼 写 ~/.dsh/bili-whale.config.json；cookie 单独在 ~/.bili-ai/credentials.json，只写不回显。HTTP 路由只认回环地址并过 DSH 信任栅栏。抽帧需要 Node 18+ 与 ffmpeg。

description.en: Design skill for UI and marketing graphics on the Superdesign canvas: reads the repo for context, extracts its design system, then generates and iterates branchable design drafts, flow pages, and reusable components through the Superdesign CLI.
description.zh: 在 Superdesign 画布上做 UI 与营销图的设计技能：先读代码库拿上下文、抽取现有设计系统，再通过 Superdesign CLI 生成并迭代可分支的设计稿、流程页与可复用组件。

description.en: Authorized-security DSH collection: nine work modes (redteam coordinator, pentest, code audit, binary analysis, attack-defense, AV evasion, incident response, cloud security, CTF solving) and fifteen runtime plugins, managed from a settings page with one-click deploy, install, update and uninstall.
description.zh: 面向授权安全研究的 DSH 合集：九个工作模式（redteam 总控、渗透测试、代码审计、二进制分析、攻防评估、免杀对抗、应急溯源、云安全攻防、CTF 解题）与十五个运行时插件，设置页管理台支持一键部署、安装、更新与卸载。

description.en: Workbench plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: collects your own projects and mounted plugin entries with rename, icon, sort, show/hide, project-to-session binding and a per-project file cabinet, adds a split-pane workspace engine with draggable panes, tabbed windows and built-in Explorer, terminal, browser, animation and custom panes, and auto-mounts an agent output into the matching window when it writes widget-result.json.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的工作台插件：收集自建项目与挂载的插件条目，支持改名、图标、排序、显示隐藏、项目与会话绑定和项目文件柜；内置自研分栏工作区引擎，窗格可拖拽分割、标签页管理，带资源管理器、终端、浏览器、动画与自定义窗口；项目内 agent 写完 widget-result.json 后，产物会自动挂载进对应窗口。

description.en: Rhine Lab-style boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: six acts from a black title plate through irradiated white-out to a warm dossier panel, five access-authorization steps (the first two can wait for a click or Enter, and Esc skips), real-voice recordings for the first five lines, and a settings page that switches between warm-light and dark themes and live-edits 33 playback, identity, voice and visual options.
description.zh: 莱茵生命风格的 DeepSeek Harness 启动动画：黑幕标识 → 过曝洗白 → 暖白档案底板 → 五步访问授权（前两步可设为等点击/回车，Esc 可跳过）→ 色散揭幕，前五句为真声台词；设置页提供暖白/暗色两套主题，并可实时调整播放、身份、语音与视觉等 33 项参数。

description.en: A purely plugin-based implementation that brings "cross-session long-term memory + background self-evolution" capabilities to DeepSeek Harness: five-track memory · git branch awareness · in-turn self-review · skill self-evolution and skill manager · four-track to-do · COI scheduling · session broadcast · session search · prompt manager · temporary info notes—zero core modifications, zero runtime dependencies, ready to use upon installation and completely removable upon uninstallation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来「跨会话长期记忆 + 后台自我进化」能力的纯插件实现：五轨记忆 · git 分支感知 · 回合内自我审查 · 技能自我进化与技能管理器 · 四轨待办 · COI 调度 · 会话广播 · 会话搜索 · 提示词管理器 · 临时信息便签——零核心修改、零运行时依赖，随装随用、卸载即净。

description.en: Visual, non-linear conversation workspace for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, follow-ups and branches become a browsable conversation map.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可视化非线性对话工作区：把会话、追问与分支变成可浏览、可拖拽的对话地图。

description.en: Traceable, searchable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness — conversation knowledge as typed graph nodes (TASK/SKILL/EVENT) and typed edges.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可追溯、可检索跨会话记忆：把对话知识沉淀为带类型的图节点（任务/技能/事件）与关系边。

description.en: Connects dsh to a local SandBase Harness runtime over stdio MCP for managing agents and sessions, streaming turns, inspecting artifacts and cancelling work.
description.zh: 通过 stdio MCP 将 dsh 连接到本地 SandBase Harness 运行时，用于管理代理与会话、流式执行任务、检查产物和取消工作。

description.en: Puts the agent on QQ as a persona character through SnowLuma (OneBot v11): private and group chat, voice notes, stickers, Qzone diary, Bilibili browsing, song covers, image generation, long-term memory and mood. Every feature is a module you can switch off, replace or extend locally — hot-reloaded modules can also rewrite group-reply decisions, prompts, outgoing messages and per-chat model choice. Safe by default (master switch off, dry run on).
description.zh: 通过 SnowLuma（OneBot v11）让 agent 以人设角色住进 QQ：私聊与群聊、语音条、表情包、QQ 空间日记、刷 B 站、翻唱、生图、长期记忆与心情。每项本事都是模块，可关闭、替换或在本地扩展——热重载的扩展模块还能改写群聊回不回、提示词、最终发出的消息和每个聊天用的模型。默认安全（总开关关、试运行开）。

description.en: Codex-style `@file` mentions: search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to prompts.
description.zh: Codex 风格的 `@file` 文件引用，输入框里直接搜索并引用工作区文件。

description.en: Registers the local flowix-cli MCP server so the agent can search, read, create, and edit Flowix memos and mind-map artifacts.
description.zh: 将本地 flowix-cli 注册为 MCP 服务，让 agent 可以搜索、读取、创建和编辑 Flowix 备忘与思维导图产物。

description.en: Zero-key market data MCP server (dsh bundle): 5 MCP tools for A-share/HK/US quotes, sector rankings, futures, money flow and 7x24 news, with a three-tier upstream fallback.
description.zh: 零密钥行情数据 MCP server（dsh bundle）：5 个 MCP 工具覆盖 A股/港股/美股行情、板块排行、期货、资金流与 7×24 快讯，三层上游降级兜底。

description.en: Plays an intro full-frame on a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. Four clips ship inside the plugin itself — embedded in code, with no separate video files — and an in-app library switches between them, previews the choice, and accepts your own clip. The pin button sits beside Settings.
description.zh: 打开新对话、或每次打开你钉住的那个会话时，铺满窗口播放一段片头动画。插件自带四段片头，直接内嵌在代码里（不带独立的视频文件）；界面里的片库可切换、可预览，也能随时换成你自己的片子；设置旁一键钉住会话。

description.en: HarmonyOS NEXT skill bundle for DeepSeek Harness with offline API references and DevEco, HDC, and emulator automation guidance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 HarmonyOS NEXT 技能包、离线 API 参考及 DevEco、HDC 与模拟器自动化指南。

description.en: Enterprise login, colleague mentions, shared text and files, and authenticated business requests for WorkDSH Desktop 2.0.6-alpha.3+ with WorkDSH Admin; distributed as a release archive.
description.zh: 面向 WorkDSH Desktop 2.0.6-alpha.3 及以上版本的企业连接插件，配合 WorkDSH Admin 提供成员登录、@同事分享正文与文件、业务插件认证复用，通过发行包安装。

description.en: Local SQLite taskboard as a native overlay page: projects, tasks, comments, relations, attachments and workflow automation, with backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done statuses, `taskboard_*` Agent tools that can only submit work to in_review, a headless JSON CLI and a packaged skill.
description.zh: 本地 SQLite 任务板，以原生覆盖页呈现：项目、任务、评论、关联、附件与工作流自动化，状态流转 backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done；提供 `taskboard_*` Agent 工具（Agent 只能提交到 in_review，验收需人工）、无头 JSON CLI 与打包 skill。

description.en: Community distribution: TUI, desktop, and Web UI as one bundle with layered installation.
description.zh: 社区发行版：TUI、桌面端与 Web UI 统一体验，分层安装、一步到位。

description.en: Provides read-only tools for querying authorized WeLink conversations by date or keyword.
description.zh: 提供只读工具，按日期或关键词查询已授权的 WeLink 聊天记录。

description.en: Unified search with evidence verification for agents: 120+ engines with multilingual routing, vertical domains and structured modality cards, 10 MCP tools plus wide_research orchestration, and a fetch-verify loop that backfills evidence scores.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的统一搜索与证据核验：120+ 引擎多语言路由，垂直域与结构化模态卡，10 个 MCP 工具与 wide_research 编排，fetch 核验回填证据分的证据闭环。

description.en: Rewrites outgoing /chat/completions requests with an evolved chain-of-thought scaffold (nine-dimension genome, elitist selection with fragment crossover, one deterministic re-evaluation pass), scores answers against a fixed 20-objective baseline, and appends one line per rewrite to live-requests.jsonl in the plugin data root (default <cwd>/.aecot, overridable with AECOT_ROOT).
description.zh: 在请求边界重写出站的 /chat/completions 请求体，注入进化出的九维思维链支架（精英保留、片段交叉、一次确定性复评），用固定 20 目标基线打分，每次改写追加一行到插件数据根目录下的 live-requests.jsonl（默认 <cwd>/.aecot，可用 AECOT_ROOT 覆盖）。

description.en: Integrates TypeSafe Jev for skill and file selection, task supervision, shared-finding corrections, tool-output filtering, approval assistance, and recorded-stage navigation in DeepSeek Harness; all features are disabled by default.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中集成 TypeSafe Jev，用于技能与文件选择、任务监督、共享结论纠错、工具输出过滤、审批辅助和历史步骤阶段导航；所有功能默认禁用。

description.en: Mounts 88 packaged research, social-intelligence, marketing and business Agent Skills into dsh through the filesystem Skill provider.
description.zh: 通过文件系统 Skill provider 将 88 个研究、社交情报、营销与商业 Agent Skills 挂载到 dsh。

description.en: View FlowX workflow graphs and artifacts in DeepSeek Harness. Web only; needs Python 3.10 or newer with the FlowX SDK installed separately.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看 FlowX 工作流图和构建产物。仅限 Web 端；需要另外安装 Python 3.10 及以上版本和 FlowX SDK。

description.en: Full-screen Changzhengji-themed boot animation for DSH with a six-step authorization sequence, seven built-in real-voice packs, two switchable emblems, five switchable character portraits, and an optional access-password gate.
description.zh: DSH 全屏长征机主题开机动画，包含六步授权流程、七款内置真声音色、两款可切换图案、五款可切换人物立绘，并支持可选的访问密码校验。

description.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting / NeRF / computer-graphics research skills — 18 AI skills (paper reader, method compare, experiment planner, code reviewer, training debugger, visualizer, MCP renderer…) over a curated 1011-method catalog, plus a stdio MCP server for agent-driven 3DGS rendering.
description.zh: 3D 高斯泼溅 / NeRF / 图形学科研技能包——18 个 AI 技能（论文精读、方法对比、实验设计、代码审查、训练调试、可视化、MCP 渲染器…）覆盖 1011 个方法的精选目录，并带一个 stdio MCP 服务供 Agent 驱动 3DGS 渲染。

description.en: Model-driven context compression (Active Context Pruning) for DeepSeek Harness: the model decides when and what to compress.
description.zh: 模型驱动的上下文压缩（Active Context Pruning）：由模型决定何时压缩、压缩什么。

description.en: UltraCode-style multi-agent orchestration: a generatable, savable, governable, observable, resumable workflow layer.
description.zh: 把 UltraCode 式多 Agent 调度带给 DSH：可生成、可保存、可治理、可观察、可恢复的 Workflow 层。

description.en: Delegate bounded coding tasks to a headless CLI agent (WorkBuddy by default, or codex, claude, aider or a custom command) and collect a structured result plus the real diff, with a writable-path whitelist, a dispatch lock over overlapping paths, an isolated worktree and a structured needs_human flag. Requires Python 3.10+ (standard library only) and one installed CLI executor (WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy by default, or codex, claude, aider or a custom command).
description.zh: 把边界明确的编码任务派给无头 CLI 执行体（默认 WorkBuddy，也可选 codex、claude、aider 或自定义命令），回收结构化结论与真实 diff，并带可写路径白名单、重叠路径派发锁、独立 worktree 隔离与结构化 needs_human 标记。需本机安装 Python 3.10+（仅标准库）与其中一个 CLI 执行体（默认 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy，也可选 codex、claude、aider 或自定义）。

description.en: Signs in and manages accounts for 16 AI coding providers, plus a cross-provider rotation channel: multi-account pools, automatic credential refresh, credit claiming where the provider offers it, and a local OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 登录并管理 16 个 AI 编程服务商的账号，另含一个跨渠道轮换渠道：多账号池、凭据自动续期、服务商支持时的积分领取，以及本地 OpenAI 兼容网关。

description.en: Manage your own remote DSH host from the local GUI: SSH tunnels, mixed remote session list, one-click remote GUI, auto-healing tunnels.
description.zh: 本地 GUI 管理你自己服务器上的 DSH 分身：SSH 隧道、远程会话混排列表、一键远程 GUI、隧道掉线自动重连。

description.en: Pre-submit pull-request hygiene checks inside DeepSeek Harness: scans the current diff for TODO leftovers, hardcoded secrets, and non-conventional commit subjects.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内做提交前的 Pull Request 卫生检查：扫描当前改动中的 TODO 残留、硬编码密钥与非规范提交信息。

description.en: OpenMAIC: classrooms, slides, interactive widgets, and Socratic teaching.
description.zh: OpenMAIC 教学：课堂、幻灯片、交互组件与苏格拉底式教学。

description.en: Read RSS feeds, retrieve podcast transcripts, collect web links for rewrites, and discuss articles in native Harness conversations.
description.zh: 阅读 RSS、获取播客原文、收录网页并生成改写，在 Harness 原生对话中伴读。

description.en: Add a WSL workspace from the web GUI without needing to install dsh or related tools again inside WSL. Bash commands and file read/write operations run within the local WSL distribution on the host machine, while Windows files remain accessible.
description.zh: 从 Web GUI 添加 WSL 工作区，无需在 WSL 之中再次安装 dsh 以及相关工具，bash 命令与文件读写运行在本机 WSL 发行版内，Windows 文件仍可访问。

description.en: Causal memory for dsh: a zero-dependency MCP stdio bridge that mounts the 17 tools of the causal-memory server under clean names (no mcp__ prefix) — decision → outcome edges with typed relations (caused / enabled / prevented) in a local SQLite store that survives compaction — plus a pinned system-prompt section. Requires the causal-memory server binary on PATH (pip install causal-memory, or a prebuilt release).
description.zh: 因果记忆插件：零依赖的 MCP stdio 桥，把 causal-memory 服务的 17 个工具以干净名（无 mcp__ 前缀）挂载——本地 SQLite 记录「决策 → 结果」因果边（caused / enabled / prevented），压缩后记忆仍存活——另注入一段常驻系统提示词。需先将 causal-memory 服务端装到 PATH（pip install causal-memory，或下载预编译包）。

description.en: Asset governance console for self-hosted AI infrastructure. Registers MCP servers, skills, agents, AI apps, model channels, SaaS connectors and NAS storage in one ledger with a lifecycle state machine, per-tool RBAC permission points, department x agent x skill cost attribution, dependency topology and an append-only audit trail. Self-hosted, MIT, no hosted tier and no cloud contract.
description.zh: 自托管 AI 基础设施的资产治理控制台。把 MCP 服务 / Skill / Agent / AI 应用 / 模型渠道 / SaaS 连接器 / NAS 存储登记进同一台账，带生命周期状态机、逐工具 RBAC 权限点、部门 x Agent x Skill 三维成本归因、依赖拓扑与只追加审计日志。完全自托管，MIT，无托管版无云端合约。

description.en: Scheduled coding runs in fresh agent sessions with auditable history.
description.zh: 定时任务：让 Coding 任务按计划在全新 Agent Session 中运行，保留可审计历史。

description.en: All-in-one companion for the DSH web GUI: a balance whale widget with today's usage, per-turn cost and peak/off-peak pricing, an editable bubble queue and sound effects; a 106-clip transparent desktop pet with spring drag, throw, screen roaming and clones; a QQ message card bridged through SnowLuma for reading history and replying; Bilibili dynamics and comment interaction with a fish guard and a day/night schedule; and local, redacted two-way memory. One plugin; data stays on the machine. Runs on Windows 10/11 only.
description.zh: 一体化的 DSH 桌面伴侣：小鲸鱼余额挂件（今日已用、每轮消耗、峰谷价、可编辑泡泡队列与音效）、106 段透明动画桌宠（弹簧拖拽、甩抛、屏幕漫游、分身）、经 SnowLuma 桥接的 QQ 消息卡（查看历史与回复）、B站动态与评论互动（鱼群保护、昼夜作息），以及本机双向脱敏记忆。单个插件，数据只存本机。仅支持 Windows 10/11。

description.en: Renders agent HTML output as real UI in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with visual cards, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, built-in open-source fonts, and design-spec injection.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 把 agent 输出的 HTML 渲染成真实界面，支持视觉卡片、KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图表与内置开源字体，并向 agent 注入设计规范。

description.en: Qwen Image 2.1 workspace for DSH: Apple Silicon MLX or your own NVIDIA server, native reference editing, LoRA, ControlNet, inpainting, shared presets, gallery and live agent progress. Includes verified updates and an agent setup guide.
description.zh: DSH 的 Qwen Image 2.1 创作工作区：本机 MLX 或自己的 NVIDIA 服务器，支持原生参考编辑、LoRA、结构控制、蒙版、整套预设、图库与对话实时进度，提供校验更新和 Agent 安装指南。

description.en: A Live2D whale-girl companion for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the model stays on screen and reacts to what the agent is actually doing (thinking, tool calls, streaming text, errors, turn completion); click her to send the agent a message and watch the reply stream into a speech bubble; right-click for a menu of expressions, dress-up items, desk scenes and one-shot animations, every action mapped from the original model author hotkey sheet so nothing overlaps and everything expires on its own. Non-commercial model assets (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), MIT code, by Andersen216 (https://github.com/Andersen216).
description.zh: DSH 里的 Live2D 桌宠「鲸鱼娘」：模型常驻 Web 界面，跟着 agent 的真实状态换表情与动作（思考、调工具、逐字输出、报错、收工庆祝），点一下就能直接给 agent 发消息、回复逐字冒进气泡；右键菜单可换表情、戴眼镜贴纸、摆桌面场景、演一次性小动作，动作全部照模型作者自己的按键表设计，互不冲突、到点自动收回。模型素材非商业（CC BY-NC-SA 4.0），代码 MIT，作者 Andersen216。

description.en: Browser-local wallpaper and translucent-panel controls for DSH Web, with multiple images, fit and position choices, shading, blur, and panel opacity.
description.zh: DSH Web 的浏览器本地壁纸与半透明面板插件，支持多图切换、填充与位置选择、遮罩、模糊和面板透明度调节。

description.en: A-share watchlist real-time market monitoring plugin: a collapsible popup in the top-right corner of the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web interface for real-time quote monitoring, group switching, intraday and candlestick (K-line) charts, and buy/sell target price settings.
description.zh: A 股自选股实时行情盯盘插件：在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面的右上角显示一个可折叠弹窗，实时监控自选股行情、切换分组、查看分时与 K 线、设置买卖目标价。

description.en: Run the dsh runtime on Multica.
description.zh: 让 dsh 运行时跑在 Multica 上。

description.en: Native account-pool and provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness on macOS and Windows: official browser OAuth and provider-native transports for Codex, Antigravity, Grok, Claude, Cursor, WorkBuddy, Command Code, Hermes and OpenRouter Free, with per-account model catalogs, plan and quota windows, quota warnings, and manual, sticky-session, round-robin, failover or most-allowance-left account selection.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 与 Windows 原生账号池与 Provider 插件：为 Codex、Antigravity、Grok、Claude、Cursor、WorkBuddy、Command Code、Hermes 与 OpenRouter Free 提供官方浏览器 OAuth 与原生请求链路，读取按账号的模型目录、套餐与额度窗口并提供额度提醒，账号选择支持手动、sticky session、轮询、failover 与额度最充足优先。

description.en: Registers a local OpenAI-compatible bridge as a native dsh model provider: reuses the models already signed in on the desktop app on this machine, manages the bridge and its local dashboard process, and adds five tools, a /workbuddy command and a nine-tab settings panel. Requires the desktop app to be installed and signed in on the same machine; the bridge binds 127.0.0.1 only.
description.zh: 把本机的本地 OpenAI 兼容桥注册成 dsh 原生模型 provider：复用这台机器桌面端已登录的模型，管理桥与其本地控制台进程，并附带 5 个工具、/workbuddy 命令与 9 个标签页的设置面板。需同机已安装并登录该桌面端；桥只监听 127.0.0.1。

description.en: Offline meme and slang dictionary: 6,792 built-in entries are looked up before a turn and injected only when a message looks like a meme question. Ships a lookup tool, a settings page for adding/editing/deleting entries and aliases, an adjustable tone slider for how far it plays along, and a built-in version check.
description.zh: 离线梗/黑话词典：内置 6792 条词条，只在消息像在问梗时才提前查好注入上下文。带查询工具、可增删改词条与别名的设置页、可调的玩梗尺度滑杆，以及检查版本更新。

description.en: Search 65,600+ API docs from 20 Chinese open platforms through five read-only tools and a runtime skill.
description.zh: 通过五个只读工具和一个运行时 Skill，搜索 20 个中国开放平台的 65,600+ 篇 API 文档。

description.en: Cleans the harness prompt-authority layer into a reviewable patch set, writes prompt-inject.md and lets each model use a different default prompt, reports which patches took effect and whether the running host loads app.asar or an unpacked tree, and swaps a sealed install to the patched tree once the desktop process is idle. Includes a status page and the dsh-purge CLI.
description.zh: 把 dsh 提示词权威性清洗成可审查的补丁集并写入 prompt-inject.md，可为不同模型选用不同默认提示词，报告哪些补丁已生效、当前进程从 app.asar 还是解包目录加载，并在桌面进程空闲时把密封安装换成已打补丁的解包树。附状态页与 dsh-purge 命令行。

description.en: Compare multiple skills on the same task and pick the winner.
description.zh: 同一任务并行试跑多个技能，对比结果选出最优。

description.en: Applies OpenQuantum branding, browser metadata, and PWA assets to the native DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 原生 Web 界面应用 OpenQuantum 品牌、浏览器元数据与 PWA 资产。

description.en: Replaces the dsh web startup to allow binding 0.0.0.0, gated by username/password login: signed session cookies, /api route protection, an auth tab in the settings panel, and a reset CLI that rotates the signing key to invalidate all sessions.
description.zh: 替换 dsh web 启动器以允许绑定 0.0.0.0，并以账号密码登录为门槛：签名会话 cookie、/api 路由保护、设置面板认证标签页，以及轮换签名密钥使全部会话失效的重置 CLI。

description.en: Context injection audit: token costs of instruction chains / skill catalogs / tool schemas, duplicate and conflict detection.
description.zh: 上下文注入审计：统计指令链/技能目录/工具 schema 的 token 成本，检测重复与冲突。

description.en: Quantitative R&D toolkit for DeepSeek Harness — 59 tools across six domains covering market data, indicators, factor evaluation, walk-forward ML validation, risk (VaR/CVaR/drawdown/Beta with Kupiec POF), options, bonds, FICC and fund simulation, with an end-to-end PDAT→PET research pipeline.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的量化研发工具箱，59 个工具覆盖行情、指标、因子评价、滚动样本外机器学习验证、风险（VaR/CVaR/回撤/Beta 与 Kupiec POF）、期权、债券、FICC 和基金模拟，并提供端到端 PDAT→PET 研究管线。

description.en: Export the append-only session log as human-readable Markdown or HTML, grouped by trajectory source.
description.zh: 把 append-only 会话日志导出为按轨迹来源分组的可读 Markdown 或 HTML。

description.en: Local Obsidian vault as the agent knowledge store, with read-only DSH tools that route status, preference, correction, memory, project, search, and suggest to the matching page.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 库当作 Agent 知识库，并用只读 DSH 工具把状态、偏好、纠错、记忆、项目、搜索与建议路由到对应页面。

description.en: IM webhook and local notifications on turn completion, errors, or approval (Feishu/WeCom/DingTalk/Slack/Discord/custom).
description.zh: 回合完成、错误或待审批时推送 IM webhook（飞书/企微/钉钉/Slack/Discord/自定义）与本地通知。

description.en: One DSH plugin that aggregates the models of WorkBuddy (personal multi-account, enterprise and the WorkBuddy AI international edition), Qoder CN and Trae CN into a single model picker with a shared conversation history, live credit multipliers, per-model reasoning effort, the largest context window the international edition declares, and daily check-in where the channel offers one.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件把 WorkBuddy（个人多账号、企业版与国际版 WorkBuddy AI）、Qoder CN、Trae CN 的模型聚合进同一个模型选择器，共用一套对话历史，支持积分倍率、逐模型思考档位、国际版上游声明的最大上下文窗口，并在渠道有签到活动时自动领取。

description.en: Keeps a local TinyTitan model server reachable from the harness: refreshes the llm-pi-ai route from the installed models and mounts a compaction backend that does not think.
description.zh: 把本机 TinyTitan 模型服务接入 Harness：按已安装模型刷新 llm-pi-ai 路由，并挂载一个不做思考的压缩后端。

description.en: Memory center for sedimem, a local cross-client memory layer: one sidebar entry opens the read-only observer as a full page — today's changes, a hand-rotatable 3D memory graph, and 30-day hygiene trends, with a scope picker. The host reuses an already-running observer when observerUrl points at one (pure proxy, no extra process) and spawns an embedded copy as fallback, both reading the same ~/.memo; read-only, loopback-only, with an extra cross-site fence on the routes. The write path (MCP memory_* tools) shared by DSH/Codex/Claude Code is untouched. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: sedimem 记忆中心：把本地跨客户端记忆层 sedimem 的只读观察台装进 DSH——侧边栏一行进入中列整页（今日变化 / 可手转 3D 记忆图谱 / 卫生趋势三页，可切分库）。宿主优先复用已在运行的观察台（observerUrl 指向即纯代理、零新进程），探测不到才 spawn 内嵌副本兜底，数据始终是同一份 ~/.memo；只读、仅回环，路由再叠一层防跨站栅栏。记忆写入链路（MCP memory_* 工具）与 DSH/Codex/Claude Code 三端共用配置不受影响。零依赖。

description.en: Complete chinese-traditional-wisdom (玄枢 / XuanShu) skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: bazi, ziwei-doushu, liuyao, meihua, qimen, daliuren, taiyi, wuyun-liuqi, constitution and fengshui calculation, with a local deterministic engine and a visualization dashboard.
description.zh: 完整中华传统智慧（玄枢 / XuanShu）技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness Cordis 插件：八字、紫微斗数、六爻、梅花易数、奇门遁甲、大六壬、太乙、五运六气、中医体质与风水推算，内置本地确定性引擎与可视化 Dashboard。

description.en: DSH plugin half of Fish Buddy: relays a separately downloaded Windows desktop whale widget (the .exe from the project's Releases page) to the session you bind; the widget itself does the listening, speaking, live subtitles, sampled frames and in-game chat, and downloads one of its voice-recognition models (228 MB default) on first use.
description.zh: 《鱼搭子》的 DSH 插件半边：把另行下载的 Windows 桌面小鲸鱼挂件（Releases 里的 .exe）与你绑定的会话接起来； 听、说、陪看字幕、抽帧与游戏弹幕都在挂件里，首次使用还要在挂件中下载一档语音识别模型（默认 228MB）。

description.en: Aggregated IM gateway for DeepSeek Harness: drive agents from WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, QQ, WhatsApp and 20+ chat platforms with unified sessions, remote approvals and interactive questions. By default, anyone who can message a connected bot can drive the agent; configure allowedUserIds to restrict access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 聚合 IM 网关：通过微信、飞书、Telegram、Discord、QQ、WhatsApp 等 20+ 聊天平台驱动 agent，支持统一会话、远程审批和交互提问。默认放行所有能给机器人发消息的人，需要限制请配置 allowedUserIds。

description.en: A Claude-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, and custom character/audio. Ships animated roles that breathe and blink, plus a balance-alert variant that switches to a crying face when the balance falls below the alert line; 256/384 animation tiers and an optional 512 HD pack installed from the resource manager. 63 Claude-flavored lines. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).
description.zh: 右下角的 Claude 拟人桌宠「小克」：显示余额、今日已用、峰谷定价与每轮消耗，泡泡内容可编辑（文本、余额、今日、峰谷、图片、随机语句与并列加权选择），支持逐行样式与字体、悬浮快捷编辑、音效与自定义角色/音效；内置会呼吸、会眨眼的动态角色，余额低于预警线时切换成哭脸，动图分 256/384 两档，并可在资源管理里安装 512 高清包；台词 63 条。二创自 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget（MIT）。

description.en: Fanqie reader for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: search book and media metadata, browse covers and chapter lists, read website-visible chapters, and view your bookshelf and saved highlights after QR sign-in.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏番茄阅读：搜索小说及其他作品元数据，查看封面和目录、阅读官网可见章节，并在本人扫码登录后查看书架与收藏划线。

description.en: Academic assistant plugin.
description.zh: 学术助手插件。

description.en: Commit-time audit harness for AI coding agents: 28 git-diff rules (secrets, out-of-scope edits, prompt injection), HMAC-signed audit trail, snapshot rollback, and a full MCP toolset. Installable via dsh plugin add.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编程 agent 的提交时审计 harness——28 条 git diff 规则（密钥泄漏、越界改动、提示注入）、HMAC 签名审计链、快照回滚、完整 MCP 工具面的 MCP server；dsh plugin add 即装。

description.en: Delete DSH sessions from the web UI and desktop client: header danger button and session-row menu item with a risk-consent dialog; host endpoint and agent tool remove the session log, projection cache, and workspace accounting.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 与桌面客户端中删除 DSH 会话：头部危险按钮 + 会话行菜单项，风险确认弹窗，宿主端点与 agent 工具同步清理会话日志、投影缓存与工作区记账。

description.en: Voice AI girlfriend for the Web UI: FunASR mic input, Qwen3-TTS spoken replies, companion animation window, and two-way QQ chat (text/voice/image push) via NapCat.
description.zh: Web UI 语音 AI 女友：FunASR 麦克风语音输入、Qwen3-TTS 语音回复、数字人动画窗、QQ 双向聊天（文本/语音/图片推送，经 NapCat）。

description.en: Plays a video while DSH opens, then dissolves over 0.3 seconds once it has played out. Ships with a default video so it works on install, and the path can be changed or cleared from the plugin settings page.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段自定义开屏动画：自带默认视频，装好即可用；也能换成自己的视频，播完后 0.3 秒渐隐露出界面，并顶掉壳自己的加载画面。清空路径即彻底关闭。

description.en: DSH↔Godot engine runtime bridge: launch and drive a running Godot 4.x game through its in-game TCP interaction server — 16 tools (runtime control via ~130 game commands, scene/UI inspection, GDScript eval, input simulation, screenshots, headless static ops, project editing, export, script validation, engine-path setup), replaces godot-mcp.
description.zh: DSH↔Godot 引擎运行时控制桥：通过游戏内置 TCP 交互服务器启动并操控运行中的 Godot 4.x——16 个工具（约 130 条运行时命令、场景/UI 检查、GDScript eval、输入模拟、截图、headless 静态操作、项目编辑、导出、脚本编译检查、引擎路径设置），替代 godot-mcp。

description.en: Expose MineRU document parsing tools to the model.
description.zh: 向模型暴露 MineRU 文档解析工具。

description.en: Open DSH workspace directories in VS Code directly from the web GUI.
description.zh: 从 Web GUI 一键在 VS Code 中打开工作区目录。

description.en: Customize the "deep diving" thinking status label to anything you like.
description.zh: 把鲸鱼娘思考时的 "deep diving" 状态文案自定义成任意你想要的样子。

description.en: Pins the model's reasoning language to a tier picked in Settings - General - Thinking language (Simplified Chinese, or a default tier that only constrains replies and leaves reasoning to the model), by injecting a system-prompt section at order -1000000 and re-hoisting it to first place at the end of the assemble waterfall, plus an optional per-turn copy placed ahead of each user message for models that follow static sections weakly.
description.zh: 把模型思考语言锁定为「设置 → 通用设置 → 思考语言」里选定的档位（简体中文，或只约束回复、把思考交还模型的默认英文），实现方式是以 order -1000000 注入 system prompt section，并在 assemble 瀑布末端把它重排到首位兜底；另可开启每轮前置同一指令的用户消息通道，用于对静态 section 服从弱的模型。

description.en: Bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and chat with ChatGPT models inside DSH, using your Plus/Pro subscription quota.
description.zh: 通过官方 OAuth 绑定你的 ChatGPT 账号，在 DSH 内直接使用 ChatGPT 模型对话，消耗 Plus/Pro 订阅额度。

description.en: Whale-maid theme for DSH desktop and Web UI with light and dark palettes, ocean illustrations, hand-drawn frames, and a native Windows companion.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端与 Web UI 鲸鱼女仆主题，提供亮暗配色、海洋插画、手绘边框和 Windows 原生桌宠。

description.en: Quick sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas or TODOs, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the chat.
description.zh: 编辑框工具栏便签，随手记点子和 TODO，自动保存为 Markdown，一键发送到对话。

description.en: Real session deletion with trash and restore, archived cleanup, and batch delete from settings.
description.zh: 真正删除会话：回收站可还原、归档清理、设置页批量删除。

description.en: A Blue Glass ocean-fantasy skin for DeepSeek Harness Web: crisp ocean backdrop, glass bubbles, an ocean sidebar with a gold-gradient HARNESS wordmark and a bottom cartoon character, a whale settings button, and gradient model text.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的海洋幻想玻璃皮肤：清澈海洋背景、玻璃气泡、海洋侧边栏（金色渐变「HARNESS」字标 + 底部卡通角色）、鲸鱼设置按钮、渐变模型文字。

description.en: File upload with color-coded attachment cards (session-isolated storage, sha256 dedup, TTL sweep) plus a content-sniffing read_document tool for PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT.
description.zh: 文件上传（彩色附件卡片、会话隔离存储、sha256 去重、TTL 清扫）+ 内容嗅探的 read_document 文档读取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）。

description.en: Bridge plugin for the [Better DeepSeek](https://github.com/EdgeTypE/better-deepseek) Chrome extension: exposes HTTP handshake and session-filtered SSE event streams over the web server, enabling browser-extension UI integrations with DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: [Better DeepSeek](https://github.com/EdgeTypE/better-deepseek) Chrome 扩展桥接插件：在 webServer 上提供 HTTP 握手与会话过滤的 SSE 事件流，实现浏览器扩展 UI 与 DeepSeek Harness 的集成。

description.en: Cross-instance message and event handoff between DSH instances via an interconnect server.
description.zh: 跨实例互联：经 interconnect 服务在多个 DSH 实例间转发消息与事件。

description.en: Unified multi-provider web search and fetch: BYOK key pools, health monitoring, and deterministic fallback.
description.zh: 统一的多供应商网络搜索与抓取：多 Key 轮询容灾、用量与健康监控、原生设置面板及搜索模式。

description.en: Dual-brain Chrome automation: registers the browserpaw skill and browserpaw_session tool to connect with the local BrowserPaw host (127.0.0.1:12306 via bridge-token), driving Chrome without losing logins.
description.zh: Chrome 浏览器双脑自动化插件：注册 browserpaw 技能与 browserpaw_session 会话工具，直连本机 BrowserPaw 原生服务（127.0.0.1:12306 与 bridge-token），免登录丢失控制已有浏览器。

description.en: Reflective self-evolution plugin for local Qwen3.8 27B/3.8 Flash and online APIs: a coding-loop convergence steerer curbs Qwen3.8 27B/Flash repeated-verification deep-thinking to converge faster and cut thinking time; a five-state delivery guard detects and corrects stuck turns and infinite loops; model-agnostic host logic, mostly compatible with online APIs; per-use continual self-improvement with counter-reason self-checks, critic escalation, inverted-index memory retrieval, coding-loop convergence steering, and a five-state delivery guard.
description.zh: 面向本地 Qwen3.8 27B/3.8 Flash 及线上 API 的反思进化插件：编码循环收敛器针对 Qwen3.8 27B/Flash 的重复验证大思考加速收敛、减少思考时间；五态交付护栏检测并纠正卡住/死循环；model-agnostic 宿主逻辑，线上 API 多数可通用；每次使用持续自进化，带反问式自检、批评升级、倒排索引记忆检索、编码循环收敛提示与五态交付护栏。

description.en: A fixed-corner DeepSeek balance whale widget for the DSH web GUI: three switchable skins (default / bowl-on-head / bowl-in-hand), balance with today usage, per-turn cost popups, peak/off-peak price conversion, press sound effects and random talk lines. Modified from MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面右下角的 DeepSeek 余额鲸鱼挂件：三套形象切换（默认 / 顶碗 / 拿碗）、余额与今日已用、每轮对话消耗提示、峰谷价换算、按压音效与随机台词。基于 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget 修改。

description.en: Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme: NC yellow and neon cyan identity, CRT scanlines, Kiroshi hover lock-on, combat-state HUD, synthesized typewriter and message SFX, and hidden easter eggs (relic / johnny).
description.zh: Cyberpunk 2077 / 夜之城主题：NC 黄 × 霓虹青配色、CRT 扫描线、Kiroshi 悬停锁定、战斗状态 HUD、合成打字机与消息音效，以及隐藏彩蛋（relic / johnny）。

description.en: Douyin assistant plugin: picks a daily round of videos, reads comments, writes a dated report, can like and comment with an @ mention (both off by default), and publishes clips rendered by your own ComfyUI. Windows only; needs Python 3 and a system Chrome, and the first run needs the install-main-dependencies step plus a QR-code login.
description.zh: 抖音助手插件：每天刷一轮视频、读评论、写带日期的日报，可点赞、评论并 @ 你（默认均关闭），还能发布你自己 ComfyUI 出的片子。仅限 Windows；需 Python 3 与系统 Chrome，首次使用要先点「装主依赖」并扫码登录。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) UI for DeepSeek Harness — a panel-driven control console: every slash command is a button on the ⚙️ control-panel card, in-card approvals and questions, live streaming cards, and one-QR app setup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书 UI：面板驱动控制台——每个斜杠命令都是 ⚙️ 控制面板卡片上的按钮，卡内审批与提问，流式卡片，扫码一次完成配置。

description.en: A fork of dsh-livestream (MIT) - install it instead of that plugin, not alongside it. Lets DSH host a Bilibili livestream: chat and gift replies, queued viewer video requests on a skinnable stage, Doubao TTS voice, and automatic OBS/Bilibili streaming setup; needs OBS Studio 28+ and a Bilibili live room, and the voice stays silent until you add a Doubao TTS API key (Python + faster-whisper optional for transcribing subtitle-less videos).
description.zh: dsh-livestream（MIT）的分支，请替代原插件安装、不要与它同时安装。让 DSH 在 B 站当主播：回弹幕、谢礼物、观众点的视频排队上舞台、豆包 TTS 音色说话，并自动配置 OBS 与 B 站推流；前置需要 OBS Studio 28+ 和一个 B 站直播间，没填豆包 TTS API Key 时只有画面没有声音（无字幕视频转写可选装 Python + faster-whisper）。

description.en: Side-panel arcade: 18 offline mini-games to play while the model thinks.
description.zh: 右侧小游戏面板：18 款离线小游戏，等模型回复时的摸鱼神器。

description.en: Fills in the Web UI's missing IDE workbench: resizable chat / editor / files-and-Git columns in Conversation, multi-tab file editing with save and new-file, workspace Terminal, a file tree with name filter and open-in-external-editor, SCM (stage/commit/push/pull, branch switch, Git graph, inline diffs), a status bar, and git_* model tools.
description.zh: 为 Web UI 补齐缺失的 IDE 工作台：对话页可拖拽三栏（对话 / 编辑器 / 文件与 Git），多标签编辑（保存、新建、路径面包屑、行内 diff）、工作区 Terminal、文件树（按名筛选、用外部编辑器打开）、源代码管理（暂存/提交/推送/拉取、分支切换、提交图）、状态栏，以及 git_* 模型工具。

description.en: A chibi blue-haired maid desktop pet for the DSH Web UI with 106 hand-drawn transparent animations, desktop wandering, chat through local Ollama or the DSH online models, and optional screen watching.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的 Q 版蓝发小女仆桌宠：106 个手绘透明动画、桌面漫步、本地 Ollama 或 DSH 在线模型陪聊，可选看屏幕吐槽。

description.en: Personal agents with persistent memory, multi-Bot group collaboration and native background tasks for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 个人智能体插件，支持持久记忆、多 Bot 群聊协作和原生后台任务。

description.en: Desktop notification reminders.
description.zh: 桌面通知提醒。

description.en: Lets the primary model ask an independent reviewer model to review a decision it has already made, with off, shadow and advisory modes. Requires your own service implementing POST /v1/decision.
description.zh: 让主模型把已形成的决策交给独立评审模型复核，支持 off、shadow、advisory 三种模式；需自备实现 POST /v1/decision 的复核服务。

description.en: Zero-dependency toolkit: time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema — ten deterministic tools in one install.
description.zh: 零依赖工具包：time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema 十件套一键安装。

description.en: Adaptive deep-research orchestrator built on the official workflow engine.
description.zh: 自适应深度研究编排器（基于官方 workflow 引擎）。

description.en: GitHub-style usage heatmap dashboard: per-workspace turn counts and token spend (with cache-hit rate), DeepSeek account balance, and workspace aliases.
description.zh: GitHub 风格用量热力图看板：按工作区统计使用次数与 Token 花费（含缓存命中率）、DeepSeek 账户余额查询、工作区别名管理。

description.en: Right-panel system for the dsh web GUI: a pixel-faithful AionUi Explorer + Preview (file tree, diff view, preview).
description.zh: dsh web GUI 右侧面板系统：像素级还原 AionUi 的资源树 + 预览（文件树、差异视图、预览）。

description.en: LiangShen (梁神) agent preset for the dsh web GUI: a two-phase anchored-standard preset.
description.zh: dsh web GUI 的梁神 agent 预设：两阶段锚定标准预设。

description.en: Web UI plugin group card in the dsh settings page: enable switches and config for the dsh-web-ui family.
description.zh: dsh 设置页的 Web UI 插件组卡片：dsh-web-ui 全家插件的开关与配置。

description.en: Live token estimates and generation throughput for the dsh web GUI.
description.zh: dsh web GUI 实时 token 估算与生成吞吐。

description.en: Gives a text-only model image understanding via a vision-language model, exposed as a `describe_image` tool.
description.zh: describe_image 模型工具：让纯文本模型通过视觉语言模型获得图像理解能力。

description.en: Registers the fnOS CLI Skill and provides a matching CLI for fnOS device operations. For first sign-in, the user authorizes access in a browser and sends a one-time code back to the Agent; no interactive terminal is required.
description.zh: 注册 fnOS CLI Skill 并提供匹配版本的 CLI，用于管理 fnOS 设备；首次登录由用户在浏览器授权后，将一次性 code 回传 Agent，无需交互式终端。

description.en: Ported from the ARS Claude Code plugin (44k+ stars on GitHub): academic research skills for DeepSeek Harness — a deep-research agent team, a paper-writing pipeline, a multi-perspective peer-review panel, and an end-to-end orchestrator, plus sixteen /ars-* commands.
description.zh: 移植自 ARS Claude Code 插件（GitHub 44k+ stars）：面向 DeepSeek Harness 的学术研究技能套件——深度调研 agent 团队、论文写作流水线、多视角同行评审小组与端到端编排器，外加十六个 /ars-* 命令。

description.en: Zero-cost access to 6 free large models. No registration, no recharge, 6 free models built-in, multi-key rotation and rate-limit backoff.
description.zh: 0元接入6个免费大模型，免注册免充值，内置6个免费模型，多Key轮换与限流退避。

description.en: Evolving memory infrastructure for DSH — evidence, time, context, and correction for long-term continuity — backed by a local Python 3.11+ memory service (fastapi/uvicorn/pydantic, started automatically as a python3 subprocess).
description.zh: DSH 演化记忆基础设施：用证据、时间、情境与纠错支撑长期连续性；后台是本地 Python 3.11+ 记忆服务（fastapi/uvicorn/pydantic，插件以 python3 子进程自动启动）。

description.en: Turns a local audio file into a short plain-language verdict on tempo, key, dynamics, clipping and arrangement shape, and keeps the raw measurements in a separate block; audio never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 把本地音频拆成速度、调性、动态、削波与编曲形状，合成一段人话结论，原始测量值另列；音频不出本机。

description.en: Visual MCP manager for the DSH web UI: inspect, add, remove, enable/disable MCP servers and view their live connection status from Settings → MCP.
description.zh: DSH 网页 MCP 可视化管理插件：在「设置 → MCP」中查看/新增/删除/启停 MCP 服务器，实时显示连接状态与工具数。

description.en: Automatic conversation distillation: background subagent reflection + skill create/update.
description.zh: 自动对话蒸馏：后台 subagent 反省 + 技能 create/update。

description.en: A visual workbench for reference-image generation, cropping and component-wise Tripo 3D modeling, with per-task paid-operation approval and local asset previews.
description.zh: 用于参考图生成、裁剪、分件 Tripo 3D 建模与本地资产预览的可视化工作台，收费操作须逐次确认。

description.en: Two-phase agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Pro: the first request sees only bash+read (Minimal-aligned bootstrap), then the full Standard tool catalog after the first tool call or reply; ships as an installer bundle plus a manual preset directory.
description.zh: V4 Pro 两阶段 agent 预设：首轮仅 bash+read 完成极简开局，首个工具调用或回复后恢复 Standard 完整工具目录；以安装器 bundle 与手动预设目录双形态发布。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness port of Claude Code Game Studios (CCGS v1.1.2, MIT): 76 skills, 49 agents, hook bridge.
description.zh: Claude Code Game Studios（CCGS v1.1.2，MIT）的 DeepSeek Harness 移植：76 个技能、49 个代理与钩子桥。

description.en: Adds image_generate and image_library tools that pick reference images from four local libraries (characters, outfits, scenes, props), expand situation, expression, pose, shot and light keyword presets into the prompt, and call the 65535 async task API or any OpenAI-compatible images API, showing the result in the conversation; a settings page manages the libraries and turns an uploaded image or a text description into a three-view reference sheet. With dsh-daily-schedule installed, an image without a specified outfit uses what the character is wearing in the current schedule entry.
description.zh: 提供 image_generate 与 image_library 工具：从本地四个参考库（人物、服饰、场景、道具）挑选参考图，把情境、神态、动作、镜头、光线关键词展开进提示词，调用 65535 异步任务接口或任意 OpenAI 兼容图像接口生图并在对话中显示；设置页可管理参考库，并能把上传的图片或一段文字描述生成三视图设定图。装了每日日程（dsh-daily-schedule）时，没指定服饰的图沿用角色此刻日程里的穿着。

description.en: Design-aesthetics skill pack (10 styles: dark SaaS, minimal white, neumorphism, brutalism, glassmorphism, Japanese minimal, bento grid, cyberpunk, vaporwave, art deco) with runnable landing-page demos: tokens, component rules, forbidden lists, and acceptance checklists per style.
description.zh: 设计美学技能包：10 种风格（深色 SaaS、极简白、新拟态、粗野主义、毛玻璃、日式极简、便当盒、赛博朋克、蒸汽波、装饰艺术），每种含 token、组件规则、禁用清单与验收清单，附可运行落地页 demo。

description.en: Synchronizes DSH profiles and local plugin source archives through WebDAV and S3-compatible storage, with encrypted snapshots, conflict-aware recovery, and explicit self-updates.
description.zh: 通过 WebDAV 和兼容 S3 的存储同步 DSH profile 与本地插件源码归档，支持加密快照、冲突感知恢复和显式自更新。

description.en: QQ channel for DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11 / NapCat: keeps one fixed persona across sessions with long-term memory, answers in group and private chats, sends stickers and voice replies, and ships a local web console that shows what the bot is doing. Persona and memory files are yours to write — the repository only ships examples.
description.zh: 基于 OneBot 11 / NapCat 的 QQ 通道：跨会话保持同一人设并带长期记忆，在群聊和私聊里接话，会发表情包、会发语音，另附一个本地 Web 控制台，能看见她此刻在做什么。人设与记忆文件由你自己写，仓库只提供样例。

description.en: Plugin health checks: manifest protocol / patch format / build traps, zero-dependency and read-only.
description.zh: 插件健康检查：扫描清单协议/patch 格式/构建陷阱，零依赖只读。

description.en: Git-style dot timeline on the right edge of the DSH web UI: one dot per user message, hover for content and metadata (time, turn, duration, TTFT, tokens), click to jump. Also adds a full-session message list, in-session and cross-session search, bookmarks with #msg= deep links, and keyboard navigation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧的圆点时间轴：每条提问一个圆点，悬停查看内容与元信息（时间、轮次、耗时、TTFT、token），点击即跳转。附带全会话消息列表、站内与跨会话搜索、书签深链接（#msg=）和键盘导航。

description.en: Factory (Droid) subscription quota as native DSH model providers, with three protocol routes, your own API key through a loopback gateway, and a settings page for connection status, quota, per-model token statistics and key switching.
description.zh: 把 Factory (Droid) 订阅额度接入 DSH 的原生模型 provider：三条协议路由、用你自己的 API key 经本机回环网关认证，并提供设置页查看连接状态、订阅额度、按模型的 token 统计与切换 key。

description.en: Per-request thinking budgets, a compaction backend, and a settings tab for the local Qwen3.8 line (llama.cpp or NInfer).
description.zh: 本地 Qwen3.8 线（llama.cpp 或 NInfer）的逐请求 thinking 预算、压缩后端与设置 tab。

description.en: A long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Every turn is judged and stored into a local SQLite (utterance / event / version / stage / decision), with a browsable panel.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆插件。每轮聊完自动把话判一遍，存进本地 SQLite（话、事、版本、阶段、决定五层），带一块能翻能筛的面板。

description.en: ROS2 debugging toolset and robot-state vision analysis for DeepSeek Harness: node/topic/service/action/interface/TF enumeration, whole-graph topology JSON, rosdep checks, approval-gated builds and custom message scaffolding, GUI screenshots and multimodal vision observation, plus headless RViz2 offscreen rendering (low-poly meshes, direct pixel read, GPU passthrough - motion rendering at 30Hz) with parallel VLM realtime analysis.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 ROS2 调试工具集与机器人状态视觉分析：节点/话题/服务/动作/接口/TF 枚举、全图拓扑 JSON、依赖检查，审批门控的构建与自定义消息骨架生成，GUI 截图与多模态视觉观察，以及无头 RViz2 离屏渲染（低模 + 直读像素 + GPU 直通，动作渲染 30Hz）与并行 VLM 实时分析。

description.en: PiUI-style diff viewer replacing the stock DiffBlock for write/edit tool calls.
description.zh: PiUI 风格 diff 查看器，替换 write/edit 工具调用的默认 DiffBlock。

description.en: Steam Workshop-style in-app plugin browser: search, hot/newest/trending (7/30/90-day) sorting, Chinese keyword mapping, bilingual descriptions and README translation, plugin-signature filtering, and one-click install/update.
description.zh: 创意工坊式插件浏览器：侧栏常驻入口，搜索/最热/最新/近 7-90 天飙升榜、中文关键词映射、描述与 README 机翻、插件特征验证过滤、一键安装/更新。

description.en: Bidirectional sticker reactions between user and agent.
description.zh: 用户与 agent 双向表情贴纸互动。

description.en: Provides a better model experience, including but not limited to: filling model parameters in multiple ways, improving model compatibility, remembering reasoning efforts, subagents following the parent's model and reasoning effort in real time, and AI self-adjusting reasoning effort.
description.zh: 提供更好的模型使用体验，包括但不限于：多种方式填充模型参数、提升模型兼容性、记住推理级别、子智能体实时跟随模型和推理级别、AI 自主调节档位等。

description.en: Condition-driven wakeup: durable file/command/http/process/webhook watches that wake the agent.
description.zh: 条件驱动唤醒：file/command/http/process/webhook 持久监视，触发即唤醒 agent。

description.en: Keyboard-first command palette for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 键盘优先的命令面板（command palette）。

description.en: A UX enhancement pack for the DSH web chat: one plugin that collects small interface conveniences, each with its own switch under Settings → UX Plus applied immediately — chat-area font size and reading width under Settings → General → Chat area, a session-row menu that copies the session ID or inherits the conversation into a new session on a chosen model, workspace and session rows ordered by recent activity with 24-hour idle auto-collapse and age labels, and settled ask_user_question cards left expanded. The switch list is generated from its own feature registry, so the pack grows as conveniences are added instead of being fixed at a count.
description.zh: DSH Web 对话界面的 UX 增强包：一个插件持续收纳各种界面小改进，每项都有独立开关，位于 设置 → UX Plus，改动即时生效——对话字号与阅读宽度（设置 → 通用 → 对话区）、会话行菜单可复制会话 ID 或把当前对话继承到所选模型的新会话里继续、工作区与会话行按最近活跃排序（闲置超过 24 小时自动收起并显示上次更新时间）、已结束的提问卡片默认展开。开关列表由插件自身的功能注册表生成，功能会持续增加，不固定在某个数量。

description.en: Bridges the MemOS memory service over MCP: the agent gets add/search/update/delete memory, multi-cube sharing, and a memory scheduler as mcp__memos__* tools.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 桥接 MemOS 记忆服务：agent 获得 mcp__memos__* 记忆写入/检索/更新/删除、多 Cube 共享与记忆调度工具。

description.en: Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools with a Monaco editor and model-driven tool lifecycle.
description.zh: 用 Monaco 编辑器创建和管理沙箱化的自定义 JavaScript 工具。

description.en: Host-wide MCP server panel: imports the servers declared in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and Codex CLI configs, searches six upstream catalogs and installs from whichever of them declares an install plan, asks only for the fields a server actually declares, and checks each row for whether the mount, the handshake and its tool list really work.
description.zh: 全局 MCP 服务面板：导入 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、Codex CLI 配置里声明的服务，检索六个上游目录并只从声明了安装方案的条目安装，只询问服务器自己声明过的配置项，并对每一行检查挂载、握手与工具表是否真的可用。

description.en: Disciplined engineering workflow system for AI coding agents: planning, TDD, auto-fix loops, codebase knowledge graphs, and multi-agent wave execution. Needs codebase-memory-mcp (pip install "codebase-memory-mcp>=0.10.8,<0.11.0"); /scan stops without it.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编程智能体的工程工作流系统：规范计划、TDD 测试驱动、自动修复闭环、代码知识图谱与多智能体分波次执行。需先安装 codebase-memory-mcp（pip install "codebase-memory-mcp>=0.10.8,<0.11.0"），缺它 /scan 会直接停止。

description.en: Import SillyTavern/TavernAI character cards and world books, save them as local Markdown lore documents, and generate novel prose from your prompts with the world settings as reference.
description.zh: 导入酒馆（SillyTavern/TavernAI）角色卡与世界书，落地为本地 Markdown 设定文档，激活创作模式后根据用户输入、参考世界书创作小说。

description.en: Auto-compaction that writes a handoff note first: as a session approaches a token threshold it asks the model to save a project checkpoint into the workspace, then optionally starts a fresh session seeded with a continue instruction and parks the old one. The note must be written within the current compaction cycle and its conclusions section must actually change, so a stale or merely touched file cannot slip through.
description.zh: 压缩前先落档：会话接近 token 阈值时先要求模型把项目状态写进工作区的检查点文件，再按需开新会话接力、把旧会话停用。落档必须写于本次压缩周期内，且「这一轮定下的结论」那节正文确实变了——旧档、或用 cat 追加一行刷时间戳的档都过不了关。

description.en: Pi-style append-only multi-branch session trees: fork or jump to any historical node without deleting history, clone a branch into a new session, and browse the tree in a WebUI panel. Works on stock Harness via graceful degradation.
description.zh: Pi 风格的追加式多分支会话树:在任意历史节点开分支或跳转而不删除旧历史,可将分支克隆为新会话,并在 WebUI 树面板中浏览(明暗主题)。在原版 Harness 上优雅降级运行。

description.en: Gives text-only models vision: forwards user images to an OpenAI-compatible vision model and shows the descriptions in a Web UI right panel.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型装上眼睛：把用户图片转发给任意 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型生成描述，并在 Web UI 右侧面板展示结果。

description.en: Folds degenerate reasoning loops out of the model-visible history so they are not replayed upstream on the next turn. Detects two shapes — one sentence hammered repeatedly, and short-sentence rotation — and replaces the matched span in place; a companion escape valve aborts a turn that will not stop on its own.
description.zh: 把退化的思考复读从模型可见历史里折叠掉，下一轮不再回传上游。能识别两种形态——同一句反复死磕、以及短句轮换——并对命中的那段做等价替换；配套的急停阀则对停不下来的回合当场中止。

description.en: Security-audit methodology skill pack plus the plugin_vet supply-chain gate: eight agent skills (secret scan, dependency audit, supply-chain review, prompt-injection review, audit orchestration, threat modeling, vuln intel, incident response) in Chinese and English editions, with an npm provider bundle that mounts the skills and registers the automated plugin_vet pre-install scanner.
description.zh: 安全审计方法论技能包 + plugin_vet 供应链门禁：八个 agent 技能（密钥扫描、依赖审计、供应链评审、提示注入审查、审计总编排、威胁建模、漏洞情报、事件响应），中英双版本，附 npm provider 包一键挂载并注册自动化 plugin_vet 安装前扫描。

description.en: Cross-platform file drag-and-drop with raw path insertion, no file copying.
description.zh: 跨平台文件拖拽与原始路径插入，无需复制文件。

description.en: Hello Kitty-styled task-completion and question alerts for DSH Web, bundled with an optional light/dark pink Skin Center v2 theme and local install scripts.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 Hello Kitty 风格任务完成与待回答提醒插件，附带可选的粉色明暗双主题 Skin Center v2 皮肤及本地安装脚本。

description.en: Semantic retrieval, resource management, auto-recall (user + agent dual spaces) and session memory for DeepSeek Harness: memsearch/memfind/memread/membrowse/memgrep/memglob over viking:// URIs, memadd/memremove resource management, memqueue observer status, memcommit session capture, and memlearn skill playbook minting.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenViking 语义检索、资源管理、自动召回（user + agent 双空间）与会话记忆插件：基于 viking:// URI 的 memsearch/memfind/memread/membrowse/memgrep/memglob 检索工具、memadd/memremove 资源管理、memqueue 队列状态、memcommit 会话捕获，以及 memlearn 技能手册沉淀。

description.en: One-shot mcp-unity integration for DeepSeek Harness: bundled MCP server with zero manual config lets the agent drive the Unity editor through 34 tools - scenes, game objects, transforms, materials, prefabs, menu items, play mode, tests and console logs - with auto-reconnect.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键接入 mcp-unity：内置 MCP 服务端，零配置让 Agent 直接操控 Unity 编辑器——场景、GameObject、变换、材质、Prefab、菜单、播放模式、测试与控制台日志等 34 个工具，支持自动重连。完整中文文档。

description.en: Evidence-aware research writing skills for DeepSeek Harness: academic paper revision against supplied experiment records and references, rebuttal preparation, and presentation storyboarding, each with bundled Python tools that package the evidence and check the edits locally.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的科研写作技能包：依据提供的实验记录与文献修订论文、准备逐条 rebuttal、生成汇报 storyboard；每个技能内置 Python 工具，用于打包证据并在本地校验修改。

description.en: Access DSH from your phone or anywhere: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel public link, LAN HTTP/HTTPS direct access with an auto-generated self-signed certificate, token auth, gzip compression, a floating phone-icon panel with QR codes, configurable public URL and LAN port, and WeChat / Feishu / Telegram bot channels with per-channel health monitoring and session-completion push. Targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.2-rc.1+).
description.zh: 手机/外网远程访问 DSH：Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 公网链接、局域网 HTTP/HTTPS 直连（自动生成自签名证书）、token 鉴权、gzip 压缩、常驻手机图标面板（一键复制/二维码）、可配置公网链接与局域网端口，以及微信 / 飞书 / Telegram 机器人通道，支持分通道健康监测与会话完成推送。适配 DSH 0.2.x（0.1.2-rc.1+ 亦可用）。

description.en: Fixes the bug where your account can't lose money while you code.
description.zh: 有效解决了写代码的时候账户不能同时亏钱的 BUG。

description.en: DSH plugin for Blind Whale Farmer, a SMAPI mod in the same repo that turns Stardew Valley into a text game state so an AI can play it through MCP tools: farming, fishing, mining, gifts, festivals and marriage, plus LAN co-op on the same PC where you chat with her in Chinese (F6). A config card on the plugin page sets play limits (days and minutes), time freeze while thinking, the co-op mode, extra instructions and the guide, and pushes them to the running game; an optional session preset or a single stardew gateway tool (both off by default); and an automatic "keep playing" when a session stops on a tool call that came back as plain text. Needs the mod installed in the game.
description.zh: 大肥鱼种白饭（Blind Whale Farmer）的 DSH 插件。同仓库里的 SMAPI 模组把星露谷的游戏状态转成文字，让 AI 通过 MCP 工具来玩：种地、钓鱼、下矿、送礼、过节日、恋爱结婚，也能和你在同一台电脑上联机一起玩，按 F6 用中文聊天。插件在插件页的配置卡片里调整每次游玩的天数和时长、思考时冻结时间、联机模式、给 AI 的额外要求和攻略，自动推送到游戏；可选会话预设或单个 stardew 入口工具（默认都关闭），会话因工具调用中断时会自动发“接着玩”。需要先在游戏里装好模组。

description.en: Replaces the model button in the DSH composer with its own two-level panel (provider list, then a searchable model list) built around a continuous draggable reasoning-effort slider: blue-to-violet fill, nebula and star particles on higher levels, and a distinct color per level. Picking a model keeps the panel open and moves the slider to that model's middle level. The implementation started from Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider 1.0.0 (credited in the README); the panel, the seat takeover, the offline test suite and the docs are new here.
description.zh: 接管 DSH 输入框的模型按钮，点开是自建的两级面板（provider 列表 → 模型列表，带搜索），核心是一条连续可拖动的推理等级滑条：填充由蓝渐变到紫罗兰，高档位带星云与星尘粒子，一档一色。点模型不关面板，滑条落到该模型的中间档。实现起点是 Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider 1.0.0（README 中有致谢），面板、接管、离线测试与文档为新增。

description.en: A mid-run steer input for DeepSeek Harness Web: while the agent works, an input bar appears above the composer to inject modification requests into the next decision via agent.steer(), without stopping the conversation. Drafts persist per session, unread injected messages can be recalled from the bubble, and an optional guiding prefix is supported.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供运行中修改要求输入条：agent 工作时在 composer 上方弹出输入框，通过 agent.steer() 将修改要求注入下一步决策而无需停止对话；输入草稿按会话持久化，消息气泡旁可撤回未被读取的注入，支持可选注入引导前缀。

description.en: Particle-network background overlay for the DSH Web shell: full-screen, click-through, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供粒子网络动态背景：全屏覆盖、点击穿透、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Signs in to Huawei Cloud CodeArts and registers CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, LobsterAI, Qoder (global and China), TRAE, Cline, Loomy, Raccoon Work, MiniMax Code, TeleAgent, ZCode, Step Code and Antigravity as LLM providers, with per-provider account pools; several of them also show quota balance and daily check-in in the same panel.
description.zh: 华为云 CodeArts 浏览器登录，并把 CodeBuddy、WorkBuddy、LobsterAI、Qoder（国际版与中国版）、TRAE、Cline、Loomy、Raccoon Work、MiniMax Code、TeleAgent、ZCode、Step Code、Antigravity 注册为 LLM 提供商；各 provider 独立账号池，其中多家在同一面板内提供额度余额与每日签到。

description.en: Smart Charts skill: turns CSV/TSV/TXT/XLSX/XLS/JSON data files into standalone interactive ECharts HTML - 32 chart types including offline maps, 3 themes, no CDN. A --profile data profile (per-column dtype, cardinality, missingness, samples, statistics, entity grain, insight signals) lets the agent read the data and pick the chart itself; each chart embeds a fact sheet (plot_stats + data_preview) whose numbers are the only quotable values. LLM transform code runs in a restricted sandbox (blacklist + AST whitelist + safe builtins); --doctor self-checks the Python environment. Fully offline, ECharts bundled.
description.zh: 智能图表 skill：把 CSV/TSV/TXT/XLSX/XLS/JSON 数据文件转为独立交互式 ECharts HTML——32 种图表（含离线地图）、3 套主题、无需 CDN。--profile 数据画像（每列 dtype/基数/缺失/样本/统计、实体粒度、洞察信号）让 agent 自己读懂数据并决定选型；每张图内置事实卡（plot_stats + data_preview），其数值是解读时唯一可引用的数字。LLM 转换代码在受限沙箱（黑名单 + AST 白名单 + 安全 builtins）中执行；--doctor 自检 Python 环境。ECharts 离线打包，完全无需联网。

description.en: Generate complete AI songs and BGM from prompts or lyrics, with reference-audio creation and song extension.
description.zh: 根据提示词或歌词生成完整 AI 歌曲和 BGM，并支持参考音频创作与歌曲续写。

description.en: Galgame generator: give it a script document plus character/background/BGM/animation assets in the workspace (img_human/, img_bg/, audio/, img_cg/) and it builds a playable visual-novel web page with configurable save slots (`[存档 N]`, default 9), speaker-following sprites with multi-pose variant switching (`[表情]`), opening/ending/CG animations (`[op]`/`[ed]`/`[cg]`), BGM play/stop/volume control, and if-line branching.
description.zh: Galgame 生成器：提供剧本文档与立绘/背景/音乐/动画素材（工作区 img_human/、img_bg/、audio/、img_cg/）即可生成可玩视觉小说网页，支持可配置存档槽位（`[存档 N]`，默认 9）、立绘自动跟随说话人并切换多表情立绘（`[表情]`）、开局/结束/CG 动画（`[op]`/`[ed]`/`[cg]`）、BGM 播放/停止/音量控制与 if 条件线分支。

description.en: Pluggable design canvas inside DSH — standalone Excalidraw board, session image tools (edit, erase, background removal, OCR, vectorize, PSD/text rebuild), project asset library, and a Photoshop/Illustrator ⇄ canvas bridge.
description.zh: DSH 内的可插拔设计画布——独立 Excalidraw 画布、会话图片工具（修图、擦除、去背景、OCR、转矢量、PSD/文字重建）、项目素材库，以及 Photoshop/Illustrator ⇄ 画布桥接。

description.en: Analyze Windows disk usage, compare scans, and manage cache cleanup and developer environment migration in DSH Web.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中分析 Windows 磁盘占用、对比扫描结果，并管理缓存清理与开发环境迁移。

description.en: Research agent suite: long-horizon goal control with auditable evidence chains, cron scheduling, multi-agent expert teams, self-evolving research memory (FTS5 + RRF recall), project workspaces, and a custom workspace UI.
description.zh: 科研 agent 套件：长程目标控制（可审计证据链）、定时任务、多智能体专家团队、自进化科研记忆（FTS5 + RRF 召回）、科研项目工作区与自定义工作台界面。

description.en: Two-way WeChat bridge: reads incoming messages from the local WeChat database and sends replies through Windows UI automation, so you can talk to a local DSH session from your own WeChat. Outsiders who can message this WeChat account can chat with the local session by default (they cannot run commands or touch files); set an inbound allowlist to restrict who may talk to it.
description.zh: 微信双向桥：读微信本地数据库收消息、用 Windows 界面自动化发消息，用你自己的微信和本机 DSH 会话对话；默认允许任何能给这个微信号发消息的联系人与本机会话聊天（他们不能执行命令或读写文件）；可配置入站白名单限制谁能对话。

description.en: Anatomy panel for the Agent-Body organs: serves a live vitals dashboard at /anatomy inside the harness itself - organs, heartbeat, healing ledger, self-training counters and the real pulse stream - read straight from the runtime files rather than retyped. Host-only, no client bundle and no build step.
description.zh: Agent-Body 器官的解剖面板：在 harness 内部的 /anatomy 提供实时体征看板——器官、心跳、自愈账本、自训练计数与真实脉冲流，数据直接读自运行时文件而非誊写。仅 host 端，无客户端 bundle、无构建步骤。
