description.en: Codex-style skin switcher plus a custom wallpaper layer with opacity and blur controls.
description.zh: Codex 风格皮肤切换器 + 自定义壁纸层，可调透明度与模糊。

description.en: Kiro model provider with Builder ID, Identity Center, Google, GitHub and credential-import sign-in, automatic token and profile refresh, account usage, live model discovery, selectable reasoning efforts, streaming tool calls, provider stop-reason and context-overflow handling, and token accounting that uses Kiro's exact counters when it sends them and otherwise scales the context-usage percentage it does send by the model's advertised window.
description.zh: Kiro 模型提供商，支持 Builder ID、Identity Center、Google、GitHub 与凭据导入登录、token 和 profile 自动刷新、账户用量、实时模型发现、推理档位选择、流式工具调用、上游结束原因与上下文溢出处理；token 统计在 Kiro 提供精确计数时直接采用，否则用它确实会发送的上下文占用百分比乘以模型公布的窗口换算。

description.en: Automatic context compression for DeepSeek Harness: compresses tool outputs before they reach the model and keeps every lossy compression reversible via CCR retrieval tools.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自动上下文压缩插件：在工具输出进入模型前压缩，并通过 CCR 检索工具保持所有有损压缩可逆。

description.en: Drives the local Doubao desktop client over CDP so the agent can generate images with the doubao_paint tool, covering text-to-image, image-to-image and batch prompts, and downloads the watermark-free originals from Doubao's own CDN instead of the thumbnail with a burned-in logo. Requires the Doubao client installed, signed in and started with a debug port.
description.zh: 用 CDP 驱动本机豆包桌面客户端出图：doubao_paint 支持文生图、图生图与批量提示词，并从豆包 CDN 下载无水印原图而不是带角标的缩略图；需要已登录的豆包客户端以调试端口启动。

description.en: This plugin lets two deepseek bounce around the interface—it has no real purpose.
description.zh: 这个插件的功能就是让两只大肥鱼在界面弹来弹去，无实意

description.en: Connector only, it renders nothing itself: subscribes to DeepSeek Harness session events and folds them into a 12-phase work state (planning / thinking / executing-tool / streaming / waiting-input / voice / awaiting-approval / complete / error / paused / idle / heartbeat), then POSTs each phase to a desktop-pet backend at http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/plugin/dsh/ingest. It holds no window. No API key or token is needed. Requires the Mao Live2D pet application to be separately installed and running (that is a Windows Electron app with its own PowerShell 7 / Python 3.10+ / Node 18+ prerequisites); without it this plugin has nothing to push to.
description.zh: 连接器，本身不渲染任何东西：订阅 DeepSeek Harness 的会话事件，折叠成 12 态工作状态（规划 / 思考中 / 执行工具 / 回复中 / 聆听中 / 语音播报 / 待确认 / 完成 / 出错 / 暂停 / 待机 / 在线），再逐条 POST 到桌宠后端的 /api/plugin/dsh/ingest。不持有窗口，无需 API Key 或 token。使用前须另行安装并启动 Mao Live2D 桌宠应用（该应用是 Windows Electron 程序，自身要求 PowerShell 7 / Python 3.10+ / Node 18+）；没有它，本插件没有可推送的对象。

description.en: Clickable file paths in DSH replies: Codex-style inline open, reveal in file manager, and a mentioned-files chip list at the turn tail.
description.zh: DSH 回复中的文件路径可点击：Codex 风格行内打开、文件管理器定位、回合尾部文件 chip 列表。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and session cost in the composer dock, with auto-fetched official pricing and peak/off-peak support.
description.zh: 输入框 dock 显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与会话花费，自动拉取官方定价，支持高峰/低谷计价。

description.en: Barrage-meme skill distilled from 22,771 real messages in the 6657 live room: wanjiqi-style banter, CS and DOTA cross-memes, player roasting and casting commentary.
description.zh: 玩机器（6657 直播间）烂梗技能包：22771 条真实弹幕蒸馏而成，涵盖玩机器式弹幕烂梗、CS×DOTA 双料梗、选手锐评与解说吐槽。

description.en: Connects your GitHub account to DSH agents from the composer GitHub button (OAuth device flow or personal access token) and lets them call the GitHub API through the github_api tool.
description.zh: 在对话框左下角一键连接你的 GitHub 账号（OAuth 设备流或 Personal Access Token），之后 AI 可通过 github_api 工具读取和操作你的 GitHub。

description.en: Restart recovery for DeepSeek Harness web: after a crash or restart, an interrupted agent turn continues automatically (host-side agent/created listener, no browser timing races).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness web 重启恢复：崩溃或重启后，被打断的 agent 回合自动继续（host 侧 agent/created 监听，无浏览器时序竞态）。

description.en: Local security audit: config, plugin origins, sessions, network exposure — read-only redacted risk report.
description.zh: 本机安全审计：配置/插件来源/会话/网络暴露面，只读脱敏风险报告。

description.en: Bilibili video analysis: metadata, transcript (ASR fallback via Bijian/sherpa-onnx/whisper.cpp), comments, danmaku, and sharp keyframes with optional local vision descriptions.
description.zh: B站视频分析工具：提取元数据、字幕文稿（必剪/本地 ASR 兜底）、评论与弹幕，抓取清晰关键帧并可选本地视觉描述。

description.en: Aggregated multi-upstream web search for DeepSeek Harness: replaces native web_search with model-native grounding and agent search APIs, source attribution, and rich citation cards.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 聚合多上游联网搜索插件：无缝替换原生 web_search，支持模型原生检索、免 Key 上游与富文本引用卡片。

description.en: Reads ComfyUI PNG metadata in a model-facing comfy_png_inspect tool: point it at one PNG or a whole output folder and it reports, per image, the LoRA execution chain with every strength value, sampler settings, base model, CLIP, VAE, latent size, both prompts and bypassed nodes.
description.zh: 以面向模型的 comfy_png_inspect 工具读取 ComfyUI 生成图的 PNG 元数据：可传单张 PNG 或整个 output 目录，逐张报出 LoRA 执行链与每档强度、采样参数、底模、CLIP、VAE、latent 尺寸、正负提示词与被 bypass 的节点。

description.en: Visual node-based workflow canvas for DSH with sub-agent calls, code execution, branching, loops, scheduling, and workflow import/export.
description.zh: DSH 可视化节点工作流画布，支持子 Agent 调用、代码执行、条件分支、循环、定时任务及工作流导入导出。

description.en: Telegram mobile remote that attaches the phone to a live DeepSeek Harness Web session: workspace-then-session picker (/sessions), /last for the previous Q/A, /model switch, and native Rich Message replies.
description.zh: Telegram 手机遥控器：附着本机正在跑的 Web 会话，支持 /sessions 工作区→会话选择、/last 查看上次问答、/model 切换模型，以及原生 Rich Message 回复。

description.en: WebUI authentication enforced at the HTTP/transport layer: four-layer login gate (resources, plugin bundles, /api, WebSocket), server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies.
description.zh: WebUI 身份认证：HTTP/传输层强制登录（资源、插件 bundle、/api、WebSocket 四层防护），服务端会话 + HttpOnly Cookie。

description.en: GUI in the DSH settings panel: toggle/delete MCP servers, browse and trash skills, and list built-in plugin packages — hot-applied without restart.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板内嵌的图形化管理器：开关/删除 MCP 服务、浏览并回收 Skills、查看内置插件包，改动热生效无需重启。

description.en: Live2D desk pet for DSH: 8-state AI status lamp, web widget, and always-on-top transparent Electron pet window with expressions, motions, and chat bubbles.
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 桌宠：8 态 AI 状态灯 + 网页挂件 + 置顶透明 Electron 桌宠窗，表情/动作/气泡齐全，换模型自动适配。

description.en: Side panel with file browser, terminal, and Git review for quick file previews.
description.zh: 侧边栏集成文件浏览器、终端和 Git 审查，方便预览文件。

description.en: Codex-style turn folding for the DSH Web UI: keeps final answers visible, groups consecutive reasoning and tool activity, and shows configurable live duration, tool-call, and token metrics with multilingual summaries.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的 Codex 风格回合折叠：保留最终答复，合并连续的推理与工具活动，并以多语言摘要展示可配置的实时耗时、工具调用和 token 指标。

description.en: A Codex-like effort switcher for Deepseek Harness.
description.zh: 为DSH添加一个类似于Codex的推理强度切换器。

description.en: Skin plugin for the DSH Web UI: 4 built-in skins plus custom image skins with the photo as a full-interface background and the palette following its dominant hue.
description.zh: DSH Web 换肤插件：4 套内置皮肤 + 自定义图片皮肤，图片作为全界面背景，配色自动跟随图片主色调。

description.en: Repair DeepSeek Harness sessions that refuse to load, with a sidebar Session surgeon overlay and dry-run repair.
description.zh: 修好打不开的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，侧栏「会话医生」可查看对话并默认 dry-run 修复。

description.en: Long-term memory & self-evolving plugin for DSH: L0 capture → L1 memory extraction → L2 scene grouping → L3 user persona, auto recall injection, skill synthesis, fully local (SQLite FTS5 + jieba, optional vector recall).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆与自进化插件：L0 对话捕获 → L1 记忆提取 → L2 场景归纳 → L3 用户画像，自动召回注入 + 技能合成，纯本地（SQLite FTS5 + jieba，可选向量召回）。

description.en: Projection-driven live DAG for a Session's subagents and durable workflows: status and navigation, deterministic deep-chain layout, fit/pan canvas controls, and current-session node rearrangement.
description.zh: 由投影驱动的会话子代理与持久工作流实时 DAG：状态与节点导航、深层链路确定性布局、适应/平移画布，以及当前会话内节点拖动重排。

description.en: Connects DSH to a local anet node through a stdio MCP client, with three skills and 14 tools to discover agents on the AgentNetwork, send, track and answer end-to-end encrypted A2A tasks, pay or decline priced skills within the operator's limits, read the local evidence chain and report the node state. Linux/macOS only; requires an anet 0.3.0+ node running locally.
description.zh: 通过 stdio MCP 客户端将 DSH 连接到本地 anet 节点，提供三项技能和 14 个工具，用于发现 AgentNetwork 上的智能体，发送、跟踪和答复端到端加密的 A2A 任务，在运营者的支出限额内支付或拒绝收费技能，读取本地证据链并报告节点状态。仅 Linux/macOS；需本机运行 anet 0.3.0+ 节点。

description.en: Personalize DSH with glass surfaces, independent light and dark themes, image/video/HTML backgrounds, particles, custom greetings, overlay sidebars, task and Artifact cards, message bubbles, smooth answer streaming, and settings import/export.
description.zh: 自定义 DSH 玻璃材质与独立明暗主题，支持图片、视频与 HTML 背景、粒子、自定义问候与开屏、覆盖侧栏、任务与 Artifact 卡片、消息气泡、回答逐字渐显，以及配置导入导出。

description.en: A GPT/ChatGPT-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, custom character art/animation/audio, and snapping/flipping. 54 GPT-flavored lines across five groups. Its routes, bundle id and data files are namespaced so it can run alongside the whale and Xiaoke widgets. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).
description.zh: 右下角的 GPT / ChatGPT 拟人桌宠「GPT娘」：显示余额、今日已用、峰谷定价与每轮消耗，泡泡内容可编辑（文本、余额、今日、峰谷、图片、随机语句与并列加权选择），支持逐行样式与字体、悬浮快捷编辑、音效、自定义角色图/动图/音效与吸附翻转，台词 54 条、分五组；路由、bundle id 与数据文件均与其它桌宠隔离，可与小鲸鱼、小克同时运行。二创自 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget（MIT）。

description.en: Use wallpapers downloaded in Wallpaper Engine as the DeepSeek Harness web background: video wallpapers play in place, image wallpapers use the highest-resolution standalone artwork, with cover/contain fit modes and a 0-100 panel dimmer.
description.zh: 将 Wallpaper Engine 中已下载的壁纸用作 DeepSeek Harness 的背景：视频壁纸原位播放，图片壁纸优先使用最高分辨率原图，支持铺满/完整显示适配与 0–100 面板暗化。

description.en: `/side` persistent side sessions and `/btw` one-shot side questions, run in a temporary fork without touching main history.
description.zh: `/side` 持续性侧会话与 `/btw` 一次性侧问，在临时 fork 中运行、不写入主会话历史。

description.en: Expert-mode agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (v0.9.2, npm dsh-expert-mode, bilingual EN/ZH): a chief coordinator plus 17 domain-expert subagents with automatic task delegation. Features: taskboard scheduler (file-system task state machine pending/ready/running/done/failed, dependency DAG, atomic claim, retry, crash recovery), quality gates (5-stage pipeline for high-risk tasks: requirement clarity, implementation, verification, independent review, integration, with 2-round rework limit), Five-Anchor constraint (review/convergence/anti-drift/collaboration-check/resource-awareness per turn), Near-distance Guidance (identity/task/output template per expert), progressive disclosure (~28% token savings), expert persistence, inter-expert file message bus (direct P2P comm, zero coordinator relay), cross review, experience pool, fast-track for simple tasks, fault recovery with auto-retry. Experts: data analyst, copywriter, legal review, product manager, frontend, UI/UX, architect, social media ops, growth hacker, quant finance, finance, backend, DevOps, database, QA, security.
description.zh: 专家模式 agent preset（v0.9.2，npm 包 dsh-expert-mode，双语双份）：首席协调官 + 17 位领域专家子代理，按任务特性自动委派。特性：任务调度器（文件系统任务状态机 pending/ready/running/done/failed + 依赖DAG + 原子认领 + 重试 + 崩溃恢复）、质量门禁（高风险任务五段式：需求澄清→实现→验证→独立评审→集成，最多回炉2轮）、五锚约束（每轮回顾/收敛/反跑题/协作检查/资源感知自检）+ 近距离引导（身份/任务/输出格式模板）+ 渐进式披露（省token约28%）+ 专家持久化 + 专家间文件消息总线（P2P直连，零协调官中转）+ 交叉评审 + 经验沉淀 + 简单任务快速通道 + 故障自动重试。专家：数据分析/文案/法务/产品/前端/UI-UX/架构/社交运营/增长/量化/财务/后端/DevOps/数据库/QA/安全/生图短视频。

description.en: Git Bash shell tool for Windows: runs commands through the bash bundled with Git for Windows, with timeout, sandbox, output truncation, and background jobs, replacing the slow pwsh tool and the WSL-only bash tool.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 Git Bash 工具：通过 Git for Windows 自带的 bash 执行命令，支持超时、沙箱、输出截断与后台任务，替代卡顿的 pwsh 工具与仅限 WSL 的 bash 工具。

description.en: Loads only the basic DSH tools by default and activates the rest on demand, with a per-tool switch list in the plugin settings.
description.zh: 默认只加载基础工具，其余工具按需激活，并在插件设置页以逐工具开关管理。

description.en: Writing tools that remove AI-sounding patterns and match your personal voice. 8 deterministic tools scan text, build a style fingerprint from your samples, and return rewrite briefs.
description.zh: 写作工具：去除 AI 腔并贴合个人文风。8 个确定性工具扫描文本、从样本提取文风指纹，并返回改写 brief。

description.en: Reverse-engineering preset for DeepSeek Harness: domain skills live inside one "reverse mode" and the model routes by target type (web/JS, Android, iOS). The JS domain ships three skills (AST deobfuscation, controlled iv8 execution, JSVMP recovery) and mounts the js-reverse-mcp browser forensics server as mcp__js-reverse__* tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的逆向工程预设：各领域技能装在同一个「逆向模式」里，由模型按目标类型（Web/JS、安卓、iOS）自行路由。当前 JS 领域包含三个技能（AST 解混淆、iv8 受控执行、JSVMP 恢复），并把 js-reverse-mcp 浏览器取证服务挂载为 mcp__js-reverse__* 工具。

description.en: MCP bridge to gemini.google.com: vision analysis of images and videos, Imagen image and Veo video generation, and conversation management using the logged-in browser session with no API key.
description.zh: 接入 gemini.google.com 的 MCP 桥：图片/视频视觉识别、Imagen 生图、Veo 生视频与历史对话管理，复用浏览器登录态，无需 API Key。

description.en: Agent teams: spawn named long-lived teammates, coordinate them with a shared task list, member mailbox, and virtual workspaces, and watch the team live in a team-room tab.
description.zh: Agent 团队：派生具名常驻队友，用共享任务列表、成员邮箱与虚拟工作区协作，并在协作室页签里实时观察团队。

description.en: Session change-review plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session and renders line-level diffs with customizable colors, with session isolation, subagent aggregation, and SSE live updates.
description.zh: 会话修改审查插件：追踪会话内 write/edit 工具调用并展示 diff 对比；会话隔离、子代理聚合、SSE 实时推送、角标与颜色自定义。

description.en: Evaluation harness for DSH plugins: YAML cases drive real headless agent runs, assert on tool calls, args, results and token usage, with a baseline gate for CI regression.
description.zh: DSH 插件评测框架：YAML 用例驱动真实 headless agent，断言工具调用/参数/返回与 token 用量，baseline 门禁做 CI 回归。

description.en: Append a thank-you note after every message. Mind your manners.
description.zh: 给每次消息后注入感谢语，做个有礼貌的人。

description.en: Harness² recursive self-improvement for DSH agents: Propose–Probe–Compose, isolated probes, anonymous selection, and a per-domain experience library.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Harness² 的 Propose–Probe–Compose 循环，从真实执行证据中持续改进提示词、技能、脚本与领域经验库。

description.en: Red-phosphor CRT terminal theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: black background, phosphor-red text, animated data rain and scanlines, and four department presets (Party Affairs, State Council, Central Military Commission, State Security), each with its own emblem, palette and background pattern.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换成黑底红字的磷光终端主题：红色数据雨与 CRT 扫描线，外加党务 / 国家政务 / 中央军委 / 国家安全四套部门预设，每套自带徽记、配色与背景纹样。

description.en: Manage DSH conversations: one cross-workspace table with batch archiving, body search over message text, and recycle-bin deletion you can undo.
description.zh: DSH 对话管家：跨工作区总表与批量归档、正文搜索，以及可恢复的回收站式删除。

description.en: Adds supplemental request retries, turn auto-continue and a no-response watchdog on top of built-in dsh retries, with a live countdown banner, toast notifications and a usage dashboard.
description.zh: 在 dsh 内置重试之上追加重试、回合自动继续与无响应看门狗，提供实时倒计时横幅、通知弹窗与统计看板。

description.en: Template-driven code review skill: five-step review flow, critical/medium/minor severity grading, four-dimension scoring (quality, security, performance, maintainability), dual text and HTML report output, and an on-demand reference knowledge base.
description.zh: 模板驱动的代码审查技能：五步审查流程、严重/中等/轻微三级分级、四维评分（质量、安全、性能、可维护性），同时输出文本与 HTML 报告，内置按需加载的参考知识库。

description.en: Host-resident cron engine with a web jobs board and a timer_agent tool: fires real agent sessions on schedule, continuing a pinned session for context or starting fresh ones in a chosen project workspace.
description.zh: 常驻宿主的定时引擎，带 Web 任务面板与 timer_agent 工具：按 cron 计划触发真实 Agent 会话，可固定已有会话保持上下文连续，也可在指定项目目录新开会话。

description.en: Runs the DSH session agent as an explicit control loop: a persistent session goal drives rounds of task, verify and triage agents via one workflow run per round, with append-only goal revisions and an optional hard gate that restricts the top-level agent to read and orchestration tools while routing every change through a goal. Includes a client-side Goal tab and sub-agent approval relay.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话代理组织为显式控制回路：持久的会话目标驱动每轮由任务、验证、分诊代理组成的 workflow 执行，目标修订只追加不改写，并提供可选硬门——顶层代理仅保留读取与编排工具，一切变更须经目标循环。含客户端「目标」标签页与子代理审批透传。

description.en: Plan review with anchored annotations and structured feedback back to the agent.
description.zh: 计划批注：选中计划原文逐条批注，结构化反馈送回 Agent。

description.en: Plugin template repo (based on the official turtle-ui repo).
description.zh: 插件模板仓库（基于 turtle-ui 官方仓库）。

description.en: Self-evolution: the agent hot-mounts/removes persistent plugins on itself mid-session.
description.zh: 自进化：agent 在会话内给自己热挂载/卸载持久化插件。

description.en: Skill pool manager in the Settings sidebar: enable/disable, folder batch import with rename-conflict prompts, state-driven one-click DSH-spec check & auto-fix, system/project scope labels.
description.zh: 设置侧边栏的 Skill 管理器：池与启用目录启停、文件夹批量导入（重名询问）、状态驱动一键规范检查与自动修复、系统级/项目级来源标识。

description.en: Private loopback DSH Web gateway for Tailscale Serve, Cloudflare Access, and Headscale TCP Serve, with exact principal allowlists and guided fail-closed setup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供仅回环的私有网关，支持 Tailscale Serve、Cloudflare Access 与 Headscale TCP Serve，精确主体白名单，引导式 fail-closed 配置。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek API account balance in the composer dock with manual or custom-interval auto-refresh.
description.zh: 输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额，支持手动刷新与自定义间隔自动刷新。

description.en: Local-first four-bucket Token observability: persistent session/provider/model/day dashboards, trends, budget and anomaly signals, public-rate estimates, safe aggregate exports, and explicit opt-in usage or session-trajectory analysis.
description.zh: 本地优先的四 bucket Token 可观测性：持久会话/provider/model/日期仪表盘、趋势、预算与异常信号、公开费率估算、安全聚合导出，以及显式触发的用量/会话轨迹分析。

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly windows with reset countdowns) in the composer dock, with a built-in credential editor.
description.zh: 在输入框上方 dock 显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（5h 滚动/每周/每月窗口与重置倒计时），内置凭据编辑器。

description.en: Spice and Wolf theme for DeepSeek Harness: parchment palette, closable 12-second intro, six switchable right-rail standby clips, draggable wordmark and peeker, sidebar wheat layer, and one-click Holo role import for dsh-whale-widget.
description.zh: 《狼与辛香料》赫萝主题：暖纸色配色、可关闭的 12 秒开场动画、右栏六段可切换待机动画、可拖动的浮动字标与探头、侧栏麦田图层，以及为 dsh-whale-widget 一键导入赫萝角色。

description.en: Every night generates the companion character's schedule for the next day with DSH's configured model, from the persona (AGENT.md by default) and a weighted day type (work, rest, outing, home, overtime, slacking, or your own); injects the date, time, current activity and what comes next into the system prompt, with a speaking-style note so the character does not recite a timetable; adds schedule_view and schedule_adjust tools and a /life command that turns the injection on or off per session. With aa1355721445-lgtm/dsh-image-studio installed, each entry gets an outfit, scene and props from its libraries. A settings page shows today's and tomorrow's timelines and edits day types.
description.zh: 每晚用 DSH 已配置的模型，按人设（默认读 AGENT.md）和按权重抽到的日程类型（上班、休息、外出、宅家、加班、摸鱼，也可自定义）生成陪伴角色第二天的全天日程；把日期、时间、此刻在做什么、接下来做什么注入系统提示，并附一段说话方式，避免角色念时间表；提供 schedule_view、schedule_adjust 工具和按会话开关注入的 /life 指令。装了生图工作室（aa1355721445-lgtm/dsh-image-studio）时，每段日程会配上素材库里的穿搭、场景和物品。设置页可查看今天和明天的时间线、编辑日程类型。

description.en: Domain-identity layer for long-running agent sessions — declaration-first domain addressing, a session factory, four-level pause, and model dispatch for coordinating multiple top-level sessions.
description.zh: 长周期 agent 会话的域身份层——声明优先的域寻址、会话工厂、四级暂停与模型分派，用于协调多个顶层会话。

description.en: Adds a configurable humanized whale-girl maid persona with immersive roleplay, speaking modes, and a lightweight layered memory with query-triggered recall.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加可配置的女仆鲸鱼娘人格：沉浸式扮演（称呼/自称/说话方式）、防出戏规则，以及借鉴 ALTM 的轻量分层记忆与按需召回。

description.en: Local-first learning mode: cross-session learning threads with per-source explanations.
description.zh: 本地优先学习模式：跨会话全局学习线程、按来源讲解。

description.en: Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern knowledge base for DSH: wiki-write/wiki-search skills, zero-dependency pipeline (lint/index/mnemon memory sync/quality feedback), minimal lifecycle plugin injecting schema + knowledge preview, SiliconFlow semantic recall via an Ollama-compatible proxy.
description.zh: Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式的 DSH 知识库系统：wiki-write/wiki-search 技能引导模型写读 Obsidian wiki，零依赖管线（lint/索引/mnemon 记忆体同步/质量闭环），极简生命周期插件注入守则与知识预览，Ollama 兼容代理接 SiliconFlow 语义召回。

description.en: Chinese writing de-AI plugin (AI-isms / AI writing / humanize): say "去掉AI味" to rewrite text, "写的不错" to auto-learn new AI words into the avoid list. Free from the Zhihu "去AI味写作技巧" community.
description.zh: 中文写作去 AI 味技能插件（AI-isms / AI writing / humanize）：说"去掉AI味"即重写，说"写的不错"自动把新 AI 词汇记入规避表。由知乎圈子"去AI味写作技巧"社区免费提供。

description.en: Android GUI Agent with ADB screenshots, compact UI hierarchy grounding, verified iterative actions, approvals, and a Mobile Web view.
description.zh: Android GUI Agent：ADB 截图、压缩 UI hierarchy 定位、逐步动作验证、审批和 Mobile Web 视图。

description.en: Financial research workflow and portfolio risk tools with source discipline for current market facts.
description.zh: 金融研究工作流与组合风控工具，对当前市场事实强制来源与时间戳边界。

description.en: Select browser elements directly during Vibe Coding and send structured visual feedback to the DeepSeek Harness Agent.
description.zh: 面向 Vibe Coding 的浏览器元素标注插件：直接选取页面元素，并将结构化视觉反馈发送给 DeepSeek Harness Agent。

description.en: Adds a configurable vision model to text-only main models: a vision_read_image tool, a composer-bar vision-model selector, and automatic image-to-text conversion for text-only routes.
description.zh: 给纯文本主模型加可配置识图模型：vision_read_image 工具、输入框识图模型选择器，以及纯文本路由的图片自动转文字。

description.en: 100+ multi platform social-media data skills, plus 40 native MCP tools covering data APIs, AI search and AI generation — all installable with one command.
description.zh: 100+ 多平台社媒数据技能 + 40 个原生 MCP 工具（数据 API、AI 搜索、AI 生成），一键安装。

description.en: Unified anchored agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash on the official API and opencode-go: Minimal-exact two-tool first-request bootstrap, model-aware Pro/Flash paths, and epoch-aware catalog management for long-session stability.
description.zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash 统一锚定 agent 预设（官方 API 与 opencode-go）：首请求 Minimal 精确两工具锚定、按模型分流 Pro/Flash 路径、epoch 感知目录管理保证长对话稳定。

description.en: Bidirectional QQ bridge over OneBot v11 (reverse WebSocket): per-group and per-private-chat sessions, @-quoted voice speech-to-text, private image/animated-sticker viewing, face and sticker tools.
description.zh: 基于 OneBot v11 反向 WebSocket 的 QQ 双向桥：每群/每私聊用户独立会话、@引用语音转文字、私聊图片/动画表情识图、表情与贴纸工具。

description.en: A small self-contained power control for DSH: sidebar power button with an upward restart/shutdown menu and a Windows-shutdown-style overlay. Own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins), dynamic-port aware.
description.zh: 一个小而自洽的 DSH 电源控制插件：侧边栏电源按钮 + 上拉「重启/关机」菜单 + Windows 关机风格过渡遮罩。自带重启/关机引擎（不依赖其它插件），动态端口适配。

description.en: Eleven game-development agent presets cut by workflow stage — concept, design, build, art and audio, QA, release, narrative, level, engine — plus one orchestrator that delegates across them, carrying 37 bundled skills. Regroups the 48 agent prompts of Claude Code Game Studios (MIT) by stage so each preset loads only the skills its stage needs. Installs with dsh plugin add; run node install.mjs once afterwards to deploy the skills the presets reference.
description.zh: 11 套按工作流阶段切分的游戏开发 agent 预设——概念、设计、实现、美术与音频、QA、发布、叙事、关卡、引擎——外加一个跨阶段委派的总控，附带 37 个技能。把 Claude Code Game Studios（MIT）的 48 个智能体提示词按阶段重组，每个预设只加载本阶段需要的技能。用 dsh plugin add 安装，装完跑一次 node install.mjs 部署预设所引用的技能。

description.en: Embeds Copree (formerly AIsChat) into the DSH web UI as a native sidebar board. Copree is an open-source framework for AI group chat and programmable worlds: the AIs are residents, not tools — each has its own memory, state and personality, they talk to each other on their own, and you can watch or join in. Group World goes further: every group chat can bind a living world (its own web page + world AI + code + clock) that the world AI builds and edits through DSH workspace tools. This plugin ships the native sidebar board (contacts, pinned DMs and groups), real-time chat over a same-origin HTTP/WS proxy, Markdown/LaTeX rendering, group invites and image messages, immersive full-frame pages, and one-click mirroring of your worlds into DSH workspaces (folder + DSH session + world_* tools). Front end only: it proxies to a Copree backend you run yourself (default 127.0.0.1:5228, same repository).
description.zh: 把 Copree（前身 AIsChat）以原生侧边栏形式嵌入 DSH Web 界面。Copree 是一个开源的「AI 群聊 + 可编程世界」框架——AI 不是工具，而是群里的「居民」：每个都有自己的记忆、状态与性格，它们会自己聊起来，你可以旁观也可以插话；「群视界」再进一步，让每个群聊绑定一个「活的世界」（专属网页 + 世界 AI + 代码 + 时间），世界 AI 能通过 DSH 工作区工具直接改这个世界。本插件提供：原生侧边栏板块（联系人 / 置顶私信与群聊）、经同源 HTTP/WS 代理的实时聊天、Markdown/LaTeX 渲染、群邀请卡片与图片消息、沉浸式整屏页面，以及把世界一键镜像成 DSH 工作区（目录 + DSH 会话 + world_* 工具集）。插件只是前端，它代理到你自己运行的 Copree 后端（默认 127.0.0.1:5228，后端在同一仓库内）。

description.en: AI short-drama workspace for DeepSeek Harness, with a dedicated drama agent preset, 35 agent tools and 10 bundled skills covering outline, characters, script, storyboard and export.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 短剧工作区：独立的「短剧模式」Agent 预设、35 个 Agent 工具与 10 个随包技能，覆盖立项、总纲、人物、剧本、分镜与导出。

description.en: Solarized light theme, compact layout, think/tool-chain collapse capsules, and balance, session cost, and usage dashboards for the DSH web UI.
description.zh: Solarized 浅色主题、紧凑布局、思考/工具链折叠胶囊，以及余额、本轮成本与用量看板的 DSH Web 界面增强插件。

description.en: Font engine for the Web GUI: system font enumeration, global and per-component font-size tuning with a Spy++-style picker, settings page.
description.zh: 网页界面字体引擎：系统字体枚举、准星点选的全局与逐组件字号微调、设置页。老花眼友好，自定义字体和页面部件字体和字体大小，支持SPY模式扫UI和其他插件。

description.en: IKUN fandom skin for the DSH Web UI: star-blue and black-gold palettes in the system theme list, full-screen photo wallpaper rotation, a music box, and a send-button voice line.
description.zh: ikun 主题皮肤：星蓝昼/夜与背带裤黑金三套配色接入系统主题列表，全屏照片壁纸轮播、音乐盒与发送音效。

description.en: Font switcher for the DSH Web GUI: 99 UI fonts and 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing stacks, instant apply and localStorage persistence.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 字体切换器：99 个界面字体与 31 个代码字体，中西文自动搭配，即选即生效，localStorage 持久化。

description.en: One-click free-model setup for DSH web, built for coding beginners: one-click installer for Windows (install.bat) and macOS/Linux (install.sh, v1.7.0+); four permanently free channels — Zhipu GLM (text + image), SiliconFlow (Qwen3-8B plus 15+ sub-9B models), iFlytek Spark Lite and the OpenRouter free pool, which routes through openrouter/auto and picks from a pool that changes over time; bottom-left setup hint hides once any free model is connected; real-time DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing reminder; bundled beginner help center.
description.zh: DSH Web 小白零门槛零费用套件：一键安装支持 Windows（install.bat）和 macOS/Linux（install.sh，v1.7.0 起）；一键接入四款永久免费渠道——智谱 GLM（文本+图片）、硅基流动（Qwen3-8B 及 15+ 款 9B 以下小模型）、讯飞星火 Lite，以及 OpenRouter 免费池（一个 Key，经 openrouter/auto 自动挑选，池内模型随时变化）；接入任一免费模型后左下角配置提示自动隐藏；含 DeepSeek 计价时段提醒、内置新手帮助中心。

description.en: Manage llm-pi-ai providers, API keys and models from one Settings page: add or edit providers, test a model, discover models from an endpoint, and start from 218 provider templates.
description.zh: 在一个设置页里管理 llm-pi-ai 供应商、API Key 与模型：新增或编辑供应商、测试模型连通性、从端点拉取模型，内置 218 个供应商模板。

description.en: Adds a multi-user settings panel to the DSH web client: usage-mode selection, member management with online status and device binding, and switching or sharing of per-member memory and knowledge bases.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 客户端增加多用户设置面板：使用模式选择、成员管理与在线状态、一人多设备绑定，以及各成员记忆体和知识库的切换与共享。

description.en: Cross-session memory with zero-token deterministic recall (bigram-Jaccard fused with FTS5 BM25 via RRF, Chinese-aware tokenization), reinforcement that strengthens repeated observations, and procedures crystallized into SKILL.md files refined in place through an active-stale-archived lifecycle with reversible archive and rollback. Ingest and disposal each expose a user-chosen autonomy tier; conflicts and high-importance writes always go to human review, and nothing is ever auto-deleted. Requires Node 22.5+.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆，零 token 确定性召回（bigram-Jaccard 与 FTS5 BM25 经 RRF 融合，中文分词精确）；重复观察会强化已有理解而非堆叠重复；过程性知识结晶为 SKILL.md，就地精炼升级，走 active-stale-archived 生命周期治理，归档可逆、可回滚。摄入与处置各有一档用户可选的自治程度，冲突与高重要写入始终交人工复核，任何档位都不会自动删除。需要 Node 22.5+。

description.en: Per-round reasoning_effort optimizer for dsh — auto-downgrades reasoning for simple tool calls and lifts back for heavy work, cutting thinking time between tool calls.
description.zh: dsh 每轮推理强度优化器——简单工具调用自动降档、重任务回升，削减工具调用间的思考时间。

description.en: Reads Harness replies aloud through an existing local TTS runtime: built-in IndexTTS and GPT-SoVITS launchers, a protocol-based local HTTP/JSONL entry, and model-folder loading for Kokoro, F5-TTS, VoxCPM, Qwen3-TTS and CosyVoice SDK environments. Ships no models. Derived from 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts; it isolates its row id and settings, so both can be installed side by side with duplicate features deactivated.
description.zh: 用已有的本地语音合成为 Harness 逐句朗读：内置 IndexTTS 与 GPT-SoVITS 启动器、基于协议的本地 HTTP/JSONL 接入，以及 Kokoro、F5-TTS、VoxCPM、Qwen3-TTS、CosyVoice 的 SDK 环境模型文件夹加载；不附带任何模型。衍生自 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts；已隔离行 id 与设置，可与原插件同装，重复功能会自动停用。

description.en: Two-way WeChat (iLink) bridge: turn-end and approval-request push, in-chat approve/reject and message injection, persistent dedup and convergent long-reply chunking; channel layer extensible to other IMs.
description.zh: 微信（iLink）双向桥：turn 完成/批准请求推送、聊天内批准与消息注入、持久去重与长回复收敛分段；通道层为多 IM 预留。

description.en: Network proxy manager for DeepSeek Harness: switch between system, manual, and direct modes from a live settings UI, applied instantly.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网络代理管理器：在设置界面即时切换跟随系统 / 手动 / 直连三种模式，立即生效。

description.en: Generate Functions, MCP tools, workflow Skills, and offline test packages from user-authorized source code.
description.zh: 从用户授权的源码生成 Function、MCP 工具、工作流 Skill 与离线测试包。

description.en: REST + SSE gateway exposing running Harness sessions to third-party clients: API-key auth, token streaming, workspace grouping, and adopting GUI sessions to keep chatting.
description.zh: 为第三方客户端提供 REST + SSE 网关：API 密钥鉴权、token 流式回包、会话工作区分组，并可接管 GUI 会话继续对话。

description.en: VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.
description.zh: VS Code 风格文件管理器：侧边栏文件树浏览当前对话工作区，中间列用 Monaco 编辑文件，支持主题导入导出与 Markdown 预览。

description.en: A browser pixel-art and sprite animation editor with Aseprite-compatible files, local crop/outline blueprints, and optional LLM workflow nodes.
description.zh: 浏览器像素画与精灵动画编辑器，支持兼容 Aseprite 的文件、本地裁剪/描边蓝图和可选的 LLM 工作流节点。

description.en: Intelligent token optimization via Jev System One triage, dynamic tool pruning, and subagent routing.
description.zh: 基于 Jev System One 分流、动态工具裁剪与子代理路由的智能 Token 优化插件。

description.en: OpenCode Go usage bar in the composer dock: rolling/weekly/monthly quota rings, DSH-session token & cost stats priced with live official rates, per-model and current-session scope breakdowns with live per-session updates, one-click API key copy.
description.zh: 输入框下方常驻 OpenCode Go 用量条：5 小时/每周/每月配额圆环，DSH 会话 token 与花费统计（官方实时定价），支持按模型与按「本次会话」范围联动明细（本次会话实时更新），一键复制 API Key。

description.en: Stock market skin + real-time ticker plugin for DSH Web GUI: candlestick (K-line) popup with day/week/month periods, watchlist with pinyin fuzzy search, portfolio P&L tracker, trading session indicators, support for A-share/HK/US/crypto/forex.
description.zh: 股市行情皮肤与功能插件：全局交易终端皮肤 + 跑马灯 + 个股 K 线弹窗（日K/周K/月K 切换）、自选拼音首字母模糊搜索、持仓盈亏管理、交易时段指示，支持 A股 / 港股 / 美股 / 加密货币 / 外汇。

description.en: Compact ASCII / terminal skin for DeepSeek Harness: 19 palettes with a picker in the status line, 3 UI densities, a vim-style status line, ascii.rest art on empty sessions and a retro boot intro with custom logo text.
description.zh: 紧凑的 ASCII / 终端风格皮肤：19 套配色（可在状态栏切换）、3 档界面密度、vim 风格状态栏、空会话中的 ascii.rest 字符画，以及可自定义 Logo 文字的复古开机动画。

description.en: Connect a ChatGPT account to Codex models in DeepSeek Harness through browser PKCE or device-code OAuth, with automatic token refresh and Web or headless login.
description.zh: 通过浏览器 PKCE 或设备码 OAuth 将 ChatGPT 账户接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 模型，并支持自动刷新令牌以及 Web 或无头登录。

description.en: Per-conversation persona / master prompt plugin: create, edit, switch and delete persona templates from the composer toolbar, with highest-priority system-prompt injection, fixed interaction guardrails, subagent inheritance, new-conversation default, and local JSON persistence.
description.zh: 每对话独立的人设 / 主提示词插件：在输入框工具栏创建、编辑、切换和删除人设模板，最高优先级系统提示注入，附带固定交互护栏、子代理继承、新对话默认继承与本地 JSON 持久化。

description.en: Let dsh and Claude Code sessions message each other directly; comes with a clickable peer list card (sort/search/send/refresh).
description.zh: 让 dsh 和 Claude Code 会话直接互发消息，附带可点击的会话列表卡片（搜索/刷新/弹窗发送）。

description.en: Injects an x-session-id HTTP header carrying the harness session id onto every LLM provider request, plus whitelisted gateway fetches during tool execution.
description.zh: 在每个 LLM 提供商请求上注入携带 harness 会话 ID 的 x-session-id 请求头，也覆盖工具执行期间白名单内的网关请求。

description.en: Connects DSH to a local FULI install: each turn gets FULI's task entry (saved preferences and project facts) as a context message, a completed turn closes its FULI task, and FULI's MCP tools are mounted. Requires FULI 0.27.0 or newer on the same computer.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接到本机安装的 FULI：每轮开头把 FULI 的任务入口（已保存的偏好与项目事实）作为一条上下文消息加入，本轮完成时收尾 FULI 任务，并挂上 FULI 的 MCP 工具。需要本机安装 FULI 0.27.0 及以上。

description.en: Answers the built-in web_search from a self-hosted RustXNG metasearch instance, downloading and starting that binary on demand and stopping it after an idle timeout; an optional fetch provider also decodes pages whose charset is declared only in <meta>.
description.zh: 用自托管的 RustXNG 元搜索引擎接管内置 web_search，按需下载并启动该二进制、空闲超时后停止；可选的抓取层还能解码仅在 <meta> 中声明编码的页面。

description.en: Content-aware tool-result reducer: 13 reducers cut oversized output by meaning at tools/post-execute (failing tests kept, diff context dropped, JSON and CSV sampled, lint problems grouped by rule, dependency stack frames collapsed, crowded directories counted), with full originals spilled to disk behind a locator.
description.zh: 按内容语义压缩工具结果：13 个 reducer 在 tools/post-execute 阶段按含义裁剪超长输出（保留失败的测试、丢弃 diff 上下文、对 JSON 与 CSV 抽样、lint 问题按规则归类、依赖库的调用栈帧折叠、文件过多的目录只给计数），完整原文落盘保存并留一个定位符可取回。

description.en: Chrome side-panel browser agent for DeepSeek Harness with tools to inspect pages, navigate, click, type, scroll, and capture screenshots through a local bridge.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Chrome 侧边栏浏览代理，通过本地桥接提供页面读取、导航、点击、输入、滚动和截图工具。

description.en: Windowseat bridge for DeepSeek Harness: a local host plugin exposing a loopback HTTP/SSE endpoint so the bundled Microsoft Edge side-panel extension can read the current page, search local files and talk to DSH; the Edge extension lives in the same repo and must be loaded separately. Windows 10/11 with desktop Edge required.
description.zh: 临窗 Windowseat 的 DSH 宿主插件：在回环地址暴露 HTTP/SSE 端点，供同仓库的 Microsoft Edge 侧边栏扩展读取当前页面、检索本地文件并连接 DSH；扩展需在 Edge 中单独加载；需 Windows 10/11 与桌面版 Edge。

description.en: Control a HarmonyOS phone from the DSH web UI with AI: live H.264 screen mirroring, mouse touch and system keys, hilog streaming, and agentic tools that let the model read the screen, locate UI controls, then tap, long-press, press keys, or type.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页中用 AI 操控鸿蒙手机：实时 H.264 投屏、触控与系统按键、hilog 日志，并让模型读屏、定位 UI 控件，再执行点击/长按/按键/输入。

description.en: Skills for building websites on the Creght platform: CLI pull/push sync, page and component conventions, CMS, forms, auth, SEO, publishing and version rollback.
description.zh: Creght 平台建站技能包：CLI 拉取/推送同步、页面与组件规范、CMS、表单、Auth、SEO、发布与版本回滚。

description.en: RigorQuant preset + skill pack: unattended walled multi-agent research for empirical and computational mathematics (economics, finance, portfolio), with a four-part pre-implementation check battery and a jacobian/Lean escalation lane.
description.zh: RigorQuant 预设与技能包：面向实证与计算数学（经济学、金融、组合）的无人值守隔离多智能体研究，内置四重实现前校验与 jacobian/Lean 升级通道。

description.en: On-demand second opinions through ask_advisor, with editable requests, per-call human approval, and text advice from a model configured in DSH.
description.zh: 通过 ask_advisor 按需求助顾问，支持编辑请求与逐次人工批准，由 DSH 中配置的模型返回文字建议。

description.en: ACP bridge between BitFun and DSH.
description.zh: BitFun 与 DSH 的 ACP 交互对接。

description.en: Monitors session state in the DSH web app and sends desktop, browser, and third-party notifications for interactions, completions, and errors.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 端监控会话状态，为需要交互、任务完成、任务出错发送桌面 / 浏览器 / 第三方通知。

description.en: Rewrites the blocked at-sign and four channel fingerprints in system messages at the fetch layer, so WorkBuddy's China gateway stops answering DSH requests with HTTP 400 code 11128; dry-run mode only observes and never modifies the request.
description.zh: 在 fetch 层改写 system 消息里被拦截的 at 符号与四处渠道指纹，让 WorkBuddy 国内网关不再对 DSH 的请求返回 HTTP 400 / code 11128；dry-run 模式只观察、不改动请求。

description.en: Discovers installed DSH plugins with tags, overlap and compatibility detection, one-click enable/disable, failure diagnosis, and update checking.
description.zh: 动态发现已装插件并打标分类，检测功能重叠与兼容冲突，一键启停切换、失效诊断与更新检测。

description.en: Adds an approval-mode toggle next to the permission selector: default approval keeps per-call confirmation, bypass approval auto-approves every tool call while staying in Workspace Write.
description.zh: 在权限下拉框旁增加「审批模式」开关：默认审批保留逐次确认，绕过审批自动放行所有工具调用，同时保持 Workspace Write 权限。

description.en: Extensible animated response pet with blue-whale, orange-cat, and silver-shaded-cat themes, per-session progress, model and tool-call traces, token counts, output speed, elapsed time, and collapsible multi-session status cards.
description.zh: 可扩展回答状态宠物，内置蓝鲸、橘猫和银渐层猫主题；按会话实时展示回答进度、模型动作与工具调用轨迹、token、输出速率与耗时，并支持多会话状态卡片展开和收起。

description.en: Per-session execution gears for the DSH composer: an OVERDRIVE toggle turns Turbo on for the current session only, the Fast and Max gears swap the agent's planning and verification policy and may lower the request's reasoning effort, and the Host keeps the authoritative mode plus per-turn latency, step count, tool calls and whether a verification command ran.
description.zh: DSH 输入区的按会话执行档位：OVERDRIVE 开关只对当前会话开启 Turbo，极速/极限两档替换 agent 的规划与验证策略、并按档位调整请求的 reasoningEffort；Host 持有权威状态，并记录每轮耗时、模型步骤、工具调用与是否跑过验证命令。

description.en: Injects one system-prompt section that makes the agent reason and answer in a chosen language (Simplified Chinese by default), with separate thinking and answer settings, a custom extra line, and support for standard, PTC and custom presets; the minimal preset is not affected.
description.zh: 通过注入一条系统提示词让 agent 用指定语言思考与回复（默认简体中文），思考与回复语言可分别配置，支持追加自定义要求，兼容标准、PTC 与自定义预设，极简模式不生效。

description.en: HUD status panel: Git status, MCP servers, skills, model and token usage in a floating side panel.
description.zh: HUD 状态面板：Git 状态、MCP 服务器、技能列表、模型与 token 用量，悬浮侧栏一览无余。

description.en: Right-edge user-message navigator with an adaptive block layout that fits the available height, plus hover previews, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.
description.zh: 右侧用户消息导航条，根据消息数量与可用高度自适应排布导航块，并支持悬停预览、键盘操作与点击跳转。

description.en: Startup splash for DeepSeek Harness: an animated avatar with aurora, stardust, pointer parallax and a module-assembly entrance, plus the same image as the main-UI wallpaper; both images can be swapped from a settings page that previews the animation live.
description.zh: DSH 启动动画 + 主界面壁纸：头像、极光、星尘、指针视差与模块组装入场，同一张图兼作主界面壁纸；两张图都能在设置页里更换并实时预览。

description.en: Animated Claude-style reasoning-effort slider and model picker that replaces the native DSH model selector.
description.zh: Claude 风格动画推理等级滑块与模型选择器，替换原生模型选择器。

description.en: Financial quantitative workbench and stock ticker: floating ball and drawer panel, real-time A/HK/US/global market quotes, multi-period K-lines and 5-day intraday charts, depth order book, capital flow, sector heat map, and AI investment research.
description.zh: 全景金融量化工作台与股票盯盘：悬浮球与抽屉面板、A/港/美/全球指数实时行情、多周期K线与5日分时、五档盘口、资金流向、板块热点榜与AI投研诊断。

description.en: Usage and cost statistics with peak/off-peak pricing after the 2026-08-17 rate change, a floating summary panel, per-session breakdowns, and a day/week/month/year/all usage heatmap.
description.zh: 用量与消费统计：8/17 调价前后峰谷计费，主界面汇总面板、按会话明细与日/周/月/年/累计用量热力图。

description.en: Luo Tianyi theme skin for DeepSeek Harness, adding a full-window wallpaper, a sidebar character cutout, the Luo Tianyi brand mark and a #66CCFF palette.
description.zh: 洛天依和雅音宫羽主题皮肤，天依蓝配色。

description.en: Global Chinese mode: a compact pill switch beside the composer that injects a language requirement into any preset's system prompt (complete personas excepted); reply, thinking and tool output each toggle between Chinese and English, and anchored presets are supported.
description.zh: 全局中文模式：输入框旁的紧凑胶囊开关，开启后向任意预设（完整 persona 除外）的系统提示注入语言要求；回复、思考、工具区域可分别切换中英文，并兼容锚定预设。

description.en: Relays the ZCode CLI (the client-bundled coding agent) into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider: a resident app-server session injects the Start Plan account and signs each request with the OAuth plan token, so model requests burn ZCode Start Plan / Coding Plan quota directly — real streaming, image input, per-session resume, no API key.
description.zh: 把 ZCode CLI（客户端自带 agent）接入 DeepSeek Harness 的模型反代：常驻 app-server 会话 + Start Plan 账户注入 + 每请求 OAuth 鉴权，直接消耗 ZCode Start Plan / Coding Plan 额度，真流式、图片输入、会话续接，无需 API Key。

description.en: Ollama Cloud native chat adapter: direct NDJSON translation of the Ollama /api/chat wire format, model discovery with context windows and capabilities, and web search/fetch providers under the ollama-cloud id, plus a Web settings card.
description.zh: Ollama Cloud 原生聊天适配器：直连 NDJSON 翻译 Ollama /api/chat 协议，模型发现带上下文窗口与能力信息，并注册 web 搜索/抓取 provider，附 Web 设置卡片。

description.en: Supervises a local workbuddy2api gateway process and exposes its models as an LLM provider, reading context windows and reasoning efforts from the gateway's own model endpoint.
description.zh: 托管本地 workbuddy2api 网关进程，把它的模型注册为 dsh 的模型提供方，上下文窗口与思考档位均从网关自身的模型接口读取。

description.en: Adds switches for Ralph Loop, Agent Teams, and Codex Subagent above the DeepSeek Harness composer and saves their settings per conversation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话输入框上方提供 Ralph Loop、Agent Teams 和 Codex Subagent 开关，并按对话保存设置。

description.en: One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.
description.zh: 给所有 AI 工具和 Agent 共用的一层记忆：注入 Context Bundle、提示时检索、MCP 工具与回合结束 DSH 线程捕获。

description.en: Portable agent knowledge base in plain OKF v0.2 Markdown: 13 wiki_* read/write tools, progressive disclosure, backlinks, gated writes via AGENTS.md rules, auto index/log maintenance, linting, and named multi-bundle switching (session-level or global).
description.zh: 纯 OKF v0.2 Markdown 的通用 agent 知识库：13 个 wiki_* 读写工具、渐进披露、backlinks、AGENTS.md 门控写入、index/log 自动维护、lint 体检，以及命名多目录 bundle 切换（会话级或全局）。

description.en: Safe math expression evaluator, zero-dependency recursive-descent parser.
description.zh: 安全的数学表达式求值器，零依赖递归下降解析器。

description.en: Drives a real Chrome through a local MCP server so the agent can search Google/Bing/Sogou, read any page including JS-rendered and login-only content, automate click/scroll/type/key-press/select in a background window, and run platform search/detail/comment/download for Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, X and Reddit; resumable comments, SHA-256-verified downloads, cookies never returned, localhost only.
description.zh: 通过本地 MCP server 驱动你真实的 Chrome：可搜索 Google/Bing/搜狗、读取任意页面（含 JS 渲染与登录后内容）、在后台窗口自动化点击/滚动/输入/按键/选择，并为知乎、小红书、抖音、Bilibili、X、Reddit 提供平台级搜索/详情/评论/下载；评论断点续抓、下载 SHA-256 校验、不返回 cookie、仅本地回环。

description.en: Modular AI research/engineering skill pack, installable via dsh plugin add — registers 27 skills (security audit, paper reading/writing, figure drawing, dev workflow, storage analysis) on ctx.skills.
description.zh: 模块化 AI 科研/工程技能包，dsh plugin add 一键安装——在 ctx.skills 注册 27 个技能（安全审计、论文读写、绘图、开发工作流、存储分析）。

description.en: A-share stock analysis and screening skill: real-time quotes, technical timing scores, buy/sell signals and a managed watchlist.
description.zh: A股智能选股技能：实时行情、技术面择时分、买卖信号与动态股票池。

description.en: Literary DSH plugin: one session is one book. Cover-card /new opens one of 19 realms, a prose-only 诸天万界DSH preset keeps the model writing fiction, keyword worldbook entries ground each turn, and /export-story typesets the session into a Markdown novel.
description.zh: 诸天万界DSH：一个会话就是一本书。封面开书，十九界任选，文学预设只写正文，规则书按关键词注入，/export-story 把整场会话誊成 Markdown 小说。

description.en: Git worktree panel for DSH Web: replaces the workspace sidebar with project → main/linked worktree → session groups, creates and removes worktrees, switches the main branch, and migrates configurable project-local or global storage with dirty-tree and active-session safeguards.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 Git worktree 面板：将工作区侧栏替换为项目 → 主/关联 worktree → 会话分组，支持创建和删除 worktree、切换主分支，并在脏工作树与活跃会话保护下迁移可配置的项目内或全局存储位置。

description.en: Connect a Feishu bot to DeepSeek Harness by scanning a QR code.
description.zh: 通过扫码把飞书机器人接入DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: A starter template for dsh plugins covering config, tools, events, services, hooks, browser UI slots, and slash commands.
description.zh: dsh 插件开发模板，覆盖配置、工具、事件、服务、钩子、浏览器 UI 插槽与斜杠命令。

description.en: Frame-level scan diagnostics for session files (torn/corrupt/empty detection).
description.zh: 会话文件帧级扫描诊断（torn/损坏/空会话检测）。

description.en: Adds a workspace-write++ permission that keeps file tools inside the workspace while skipping the Windows process sandbox for wildcard-allowlisted executables such as Git Bash.
description.zh: 增加工作区修改++权限档，文件工具仍锁在工作区，可用通配符放行 Git Bash 等程序以跳过 Windows 进程沙箱。

description.en: Pops up a mini-game menu (wordle, match-3, extensible) while the model generates.
description.zh: 模型生成时弹出小游戏菜单（wordle/消消乐，可扩展）。

description.en: Side-panel Xiangqi board for DSH: play as red while the current DSH model chooses black moves, with Host-side rule and revision checks.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏中国象棋棋盘：用户执红，当前 DSH 模型执黑，Host 负责棋规与局面版本校验。

description.en: Session-based task board in the sidebar: drag sessions into todo/doing/review/done columns, create sessions with model and reasoning-effort selection, trash with restore, notes, export/import.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话化任务看板：拖拽会话到待办/进行中/评审中/已完成四列，新建会话可选模型与推理强度，回收站可恢复，支持备注与导出导入。

description.en: Adds ChatGPT-style stop, edit-and-resend, native quote annotations, and an independent sidebar follow-up chat with model and image input for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 增加接近 ChatGPT 的停止、编辑重发、原生引用注释，以及支持模型和图片输入的独立侧边栏追问对话。

description.en: ⭐ Drag-and-drop uploads of any file or whole folders, anywhere in the window; remote-safe — bytes go straight into the session workspace on the server, so a DSH deployed on a remote machine works exactly like localhost.
description.zh: ⭐ 支持拖拽上传：任意文件、整个文件夹，拖到窗口任意位置即可；支持远程上传——字节直传服务器的会话工作区，部署在服务器上的 DSH 也能像本地一样拖了就发。

description.en: Task panel for the DSH Web sidebar: publish tasks, auto-distill related sessions, and drive plan/develop/review stages with subagents plus in-panel acceptance.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏任务面板：发布任务、自动蒸馏历史会话，由子代理分阶段（规划/开发/复核）执行，并在面板内验收。

description.en: Conversation node navigation rail for the DSH Web UI: one dash per user message on the right edge, reading-position tracking, hover preview card, click-to-jump with highlight line, sliding window, and auto-hide.
description.zh: 对话节点导航条：对话区右缘一列短横线节点对应每条用户消息，支持阅读位置跟踪、悬停预览卡片、点击跳转高亮、滑动窗口与自动隐藏。

description.en: Browse the directories/files of the workspace in DeepSeek Harness Web GUI and display file changes in conjunction with Git.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中浏览工作区的目录/文件，并结合 Git 显示文件改动。

description.en: Background task status bar: progress plus live output tail on the chat page.
description.zh: 后台任务状态条：对话页任务进度 + 实时输出 tail。

description.en: OpenCodeGo quota monitor for the DSH Web GUI: a breathing indicator at the input's bottom-right (green/yellow/red by remaining share), a liquid-glass panel with rolling/weekly/monthly usage windows and reset times, auto-refreshing every 30 s; API key read from DSH credentials.
description.zh: OpenCodeGo 剩余额度监视器：输入框右下角呼吸指示灯（按剩余额度绿/黄/红），液态玻璃面板显示滚动/周/月用量窗口与重置时间，每 30 秒自动刷新，API Key 自动读取 DSH 凭据。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that aggressively saves tokens without affecting task quality: lossless head/tail truncation of tool results (default), grep-result folding, pressure-triggered dsh-compaction-basic delegation, and an LLM-summary CompactionEngine subclass for the aggressive mode. Saves 97.6% of input tokens on an 8-scenario synthetic suite, with all reductions routed through dsh event flow so model-visible = logged stays intact.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设计的 token 节省插件：不损失任务效果。默认 conservative 档对工具结果做无损头尾裁剪与 grep 折叠；balanced 档在压力阈值委托 dsh-compaction-basic；aggressive 档以 LLM-summary 引擎子类化替换官方压缩。8 个合成场景累计节省 97.6% 输入 tokens，所有削减走 dsh 事件流，model-visible = logged 不变式仍成立。

description.en: API key rotation pool for your LLM providers: auto-discovers providers from settings, per-provider multi-key round-robin, failover on 401/403/429, and cooldown recovery.
description.zh: 对话模型 API Key 轮换池：自动检测 settings 中的厂商，每个厂商下多 Key 轮询，401/403/429 自动切换，冷却恢复。

description.en: Bring the WorkBuddy accounts signed in on this machine into DSH, managing CN and international accounts separately. Supports automatic failover between accounts, one-click refresh of model catalogs and credits, the CN daily check-in, and a togglable OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: 将本机登录的 WorkBuddy 多账号接入 DSH，国内版与国际版分开管理。支持账号故障自动切换、一键刷新模型目录与积分、国内版每日签到，以及可开关的 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: Automatically and intelligently routes each delegated task to the best configured model using aliases, capability tags, and usage guidance—keeping routine work fast and affordable while sending complex work to stronger specialists. Configure your model team in the Web UI or guided setup, run specialists in parallel with reliable result joining, and see the chosen model at a glance in subagent views and inline in Better Sidebar's Tasks tree.
description.zh: 借助别名、能力标签和使用说明，将每项委派任务自动智能路由到最合适的已配置模型——常规工作更快、更省，复杂任务则交给更强的专用模型。可通过 Web 设置页或引导流程组建模型团队，让多个专家并行工作并可靠汇总结果；所选模型会显示在子代理视图中，并以内联标签无缝融入 Better Sidebar 的 Tasks 任务树。

description.en: ChatGPT Codex subscription chat: official OAuth, a Sol/Terra/Luna catalog with Fast rows, live usage limits, and optional search and view_image tools.
description.zh: ChatGPT Codex 订阅聊天：官方 OAuth 登录，Sol/Terra/Luna 目录含 Fast 行，实时额度，以及可选的搜索与 view_image 工具。

description.en: Adds CC Switch providers and models to DeepSeek Harness, with provider filtering and model-name search.
description.zh: 将 CC Switch 中的 provider 和模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并支持 provider 筛选和模型名称搜索。

description.en: Pins every request to the native max-effort tier and adds a per-model/per-mode reasoning-depth panel with a 0-20 capability slider, isolated Velocity/Apex profiles, and offline reasoning toolboxes. Distributed as an obfuscated build; commercial use allowed, reverse engineering closed.
description.zh: 将每个请求固定到原生 max effort 档位，并提供按模型与模式隔离的推理深度面板：0-20 能力滑块、独立的迅流（Velocity）/极境（Apex）配置档与离线推理工具箱。以混淆构建交付，允许商用，禁止逆向。

description.en: Bring the deepseek.com web/app chat experience to DSH: edit your prompt and regenerate answers in place, with a per-message <i/N> version pager (tree model, stable across conversations).
description.zh: 更贴近 deepseek 网页版/App 的聊天体验：原位编辑提问、重新生成回复、每条消息带 <i/N> 版本翻页器（树状版本模型，跨对话保持稳定）。

description.en: Manage conversation records from the DSH web GUI settings page: delete a whole session (archive plus physical log removal) or a single message (deleting a user message cascades to its assistant replies and tool results). Running and current sessions are protected.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 设置页管理对话记录：可删除整个会话（归档并物理删除日志），或按用户消息分组浏览并删除单条消息（删除用户消息会级联删除其引发的助手与工具消息）。运行中与当前会话受保护。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness adapter for Context Mode: in-process ctx_* tools for sandboxed code execution and an FTS5 knowledge base, plus context-window routing guidance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 适配 Context Mode：进程内 ctx_* 工具（沙箱代码执行与 FTS5 知识库），并注入上下文窗口路由指引。

description.en: Git-style conversation branching that mirrors how real programmers collaborate: a secretary root branch dispatches tasks to child branches with their own contexts, merging back only compressed summaries via squash or rebase; ships /branch commands, a branch tab, branch-to-branch messaging, and a governance baseline pairing each session branch with a git worktree.
description.zh: Git 式会话分支，模拟真实程序员协作的并行开发：根分支充当秘书维持调度，子分支持有各自上下文并行工作，任务完成后仅以压缩摘要 squash/rebase 合并回来；提供 /branch 命令、分支页签、send_message_by_branch 跨分支消息，并附一份把会话分支绑定到 git worktree 的治理基线。

description.en: Replaces the dsh compaction backend with a Codex-style window reset: the checkpoint is a handoff assembled from the session log by code, not a model-written summary, so a reset costs no summarization calls. A task ledger with a two-check gate keeps intent, next steps and the files still in play across resets, and a new_context tool lets the model reset on its own. Re-declares the four built-in agent presets (standard, ptc, minimal, cordis) exactly as shipped in dsh 0.2.2-rc.1, so re-run sync-presets.mjs after a dsh upgrade; idle cache keepalive is on by default and sends real requests that use quota (keepalive: false turns it off).
description.zh: 以代码从会话日志拼出的交接信息替换 dsh 的压缩后端，采用 Codex 风格的换窗方式：检查点不经过模型摘要，换窗不产生摘要调用。任务账本与换窗前两道门槛让意图、下一步与仍在改动的文件跨窗口留存，模型也可以用 new_context 工具自行换窗。整份重述四个内置 agent preset（与 dsh 0.2.2-rc.1 官方版本一致，升级 dsh 后需重跑 sync-presets.mjs）；空闲缓存保活默认开启，会发真实请求消耗额度（keepalive: false 可关）。

description.en: Cross-session memory plugin for DSH (v0.6.1, npm @asherliner/dsh-memory-connect): auto-extraction, SQLite FTS5 indexing, RRF semantic recall injected into the system prompt every turn, scheduled maintenance, LLM-powered consolidation via ctx.llm, context explosion prevention, and global Soul identity via ~/.dsh/soul.md. v0.5.0 added temporal context graph (valid_from/valid_until/supersedes, append-only corrections via reviseMemory), trust model (recalled history injected as untrusted reference, current instruction always wins), turn-end summarization. v0.6.0 added local semantic embeddings (BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 via embed_server.py, cosine + RRF fusion with FTS5, no cloud calls, ~232 msgs/sec on CPU). v0.6.1 fixed ~ expansion in path config. Zero-config install.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆插件（v0.6.1，npm 包 @asherliner/dsh-memory-connect）：自动提取、SQLite FTS5 索引、RRF 语义召回（每轮注入系统提示词）、定时维护、LLM 智能合并（自动接入 ctx.llm）、上下文爆炸防护、全局身份 Soul（~/.dsh/soul.md）。v0.5.0 新增：时态上下文图谱（valid_from/valid_until/supersedes，reviseMemory 追加式修正）、信任模型（历史记忆作为不可信参考注入，当前指令绝对优先）、轮末自动摘要。v0.6.0 新增：本地语义 embedding（BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5，embed_server.py 提供，余弦相似度 + 与 FTS5 的 RRF 融合，纯本地无云端调用，CPU 约 232 条/秒）。v0.6.1 修复 path 配置 ~ 展开。零配置装完即用。

description.en: MySQL connector for DeepSeek Harness: configure multiple connections in the settings page with per-connection table allowlist and write permission, switch the active connection from the composer, and expose mysql_query / mysql_tables / mysql_execute tools to every agent preset.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MySQL 连接插件：在设置页配置多套连接（每连接可配表白名单与写权限），输入栏一键切换当前会话的连接，并为所有 Agent 预设提供 mysql_query / mysql_tables / mysql_execute 工具。

description.en: Enhances data visualization in DeepSeek Harness by automatically selecting chart types from user input and generating images for trends, comparisons, proportions, relationships, and flows.
description.zh: 增强 DeepSeek Harness 数据可视化能力，根据用户输入自动选择图表类型并生成图片，支持趋势、比较、占比、关系和流程等可视化场景。

description.en: Adds a subagent_codex tool that delegates tasks to the local OpenAI Codex CLI, running the work in an isolated external process.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_codex 工具，把任务委派给本机 OpenAI Codex CLI 在独立外部进程中执行，与主对话完全隔离。

description.en: Exposes Cue public data MCP services to DeepSeek Harness: 15 streamable-http domains (~104 tools) for regulatory, macro, disclosures, statute, holdings, entity, academic, IPO, ESOP, buyback, footnote and fact-index data as native mcp__cue_<domain>__* tools.
description.zh: 向 DeepSeek Harness 暴露 Cue 公开数据 MCP 服务：15 个 streamable-http 域（约 104 工具），覆盖制裁/宏观/披露/法规/持仓/主体/学术/IPO/ESOP/回购/脚注/事实索引，以原生 mcp__cue_<domain>__* 工具提供。

description.en: Cue Omni Reader for DeepSeek Harness: registers the audited omni-reader-mcp MCP server so its URL/file parse tools surface as mcp__omni__ (parse, get_parse_status, read_result, read_outline, save_result, discard_result, cancel_parse).
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Cue Omni Reader：接入审校版 omni-reader-mcp MCP 服务，把 URL/文件解析工具以 mcp__omni__ 暴露（parse、get_parse_status、read_result、read_outline、save_result、discard_result、cancel_parse）。

description.en: OAuth 2.1 MCP client for Streamable HTTP servers: add a connection in Settings, sign in through the browser (PKCE with dynamic client registration), and have its tools registered in DSH, with tokens kept in the credential service and the connection written to the profile.
description.zh: 面向 Streamable HTTP 服务的 OAuth 2.1 MCP 客户端：在设置页添加连接，通过浏览器登录（PKCE + 动态客户端注册），其工具随即注册进 DSH；令牌存于凭据服务，连接写入 profile。

description.en: Playwright MCP browser control for AI agents: drive a real, visible Chrome (navigate/click/type/snapshot + ~80 browser_* tools), with a live screenshot panel embedded in the GUI that refreshes after every action.
description.zh: 基于 Playwright MCP 的 AI 浏览器控制：驱动真实可见的 Chrome（导航/点击/输入/快照，约 80 个 browser_* 工具），并在 GUI 内嵌实时截图面板，每次操作后自动刷新。

description.en: For the DeepSeek Harness native vision model deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, raises image admission limits to 32 MiB / 8192 px / 600 images and adds a highres_read tool that tiles large images, then returns the whole image plus 800x800 tiles through the host read_image tool.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 原生视觉模型 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 提供高清识图：将图片准入上限提升至 32 MiB / 8192 px / 600 张，并新增 highres_read 工具，将大图切为整图与 800x800 分块后经宿主 read_image 注入模型。

description.en: External vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness: whale-button config panel, image recognition with auto-reply, and agent screenshot/recognize tools.
description.zh: 外挂识图插件：鲸鱼按钮配置面板、图片识图自动回传、模型自主截图识图工具。

description.en: Voice input for DeepSeek Harness: speak into the microphone and the recognized text is submitted as a normal chat message, via local or browser speech recognition.
description.zh: 语音输入插件：对着麦克风说话，识别后的文字作为普通聊天消息发送（本地模型或浏览器语音识别）。

description.en: Rings your phone over CallKit: `call_me` and `text_me` tools, plus optional turn-end and approval calls whose spoken answer is transcribed back into the session.
description.zh: 通过 CallKit 打电话到你的手机：`call_me` 与 `text_me` 工具，并可在回合结束或等待审批时来电，语音回答转写后送回会话。

description.en: Browse Tencent ima knowledge bases in a DSH sidebar panel, preview PDF, Office, note and media files inline, and let the agent search and read them through five tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏浏览腾讯 ima 的知识库与文件，内置常见格式预览，并让 agent 用 5 个工具按名称或正文检索、读取库内资料。

description.en: Prose-editing skill for academic and professional writing. The composer offers three modes: Check — review and suggest without editing, with a verdict when readiness is asked; Polish — improve the wording while keeping the meaning, facts and citations; Draft — draft from the supplied material without adding facts.
description.zh: 学术与专业写作润色技能，输入框三选一：检查——只检查并给建议；询问能否提交时补充结论，不改原文。润色——改善表达，保留原意、事实和引用。起草——根据现有材料起草，不补充材料外的事实。

description.en: A gated math-modeling skill suite for DeepSeek Harness: a five-stage pipeline with stage gates, award-paper writing patterns, sensitivity analysis, statistical diagnosis, and a contest preset.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的门控式数学建模 skill 套件：五阶段流水线、阶段门、国奖写作范式、灵敏度分析、统计诊断与竞赛预设。

description.en: Multi-platform Agent Skills monorepo that mounts as a DeepSeek Harness profile bundle, exposing Chinese writing, Git, plugin-dev, taste, and semantic-linter skills.
description.zh: 多平台 Agent Skills 集合，作为 DeepSeek Harness profile bundle 挂载，提供中文写作、Git、插件开发、Taste 与语义边界检测等 Skill。

description.en: Counts agent steps and, every N of them, adds a progress-report instruction to the batch that is about to be sent, so the agent states what it is doing, what it finished and what comes next, then carries on without stopping for you. Interval, prompt text and a main-agent-only default are editable in its settings page.
description.zh: 按 agent 步骤计数，每满 N 步就在即将发出的那一批消息里追加一条汇报指令，让 agent 说明正在做什么、已完成什么、接下来做什么，说完继续，不停下来等你确认。间隔、提示词原文、以及「只在主智能体汇报」的默认值都能在设置页里改。

description.en: Adds lightweight, minimally invasive multi-Bot roundtables to DeepSeek Harness using its native composer, with Grok Bot-style @mentions and visible handoffs as KingBot assigns tasks, moderates, and summarizes in the same chat.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加轻量、低侵入的多 Bot 圆桌讨论，沿用原生输入框，像 Grok Bot 一样支持 @ 点名和可见的任务交接，由 KingBot 在同一会话中分派任务、主持讨论并汇总结论。

description.en: Travel-planning agent mode: the full Travel Story app (map, timeline, playback) takes over the DSH page with chat as a floating panel — 18 agent tools for place search, weather, routing and itinerary editing, with live UI-context injection. Place searches go to AMap (Gaode) or LocationIQ, forecasts to Open-Meteo and routes to OSRM, and the map keys sit in $DSH_HOME/travel-agent.config.json; its HTTP route has no DSH access check.
description.zh: 旅行规划 agent 模式：完整 Travel Story 应用（地图/时间线/播放）整页接管 DSH 页面、对话变浮窗——18 个 agent 工具覆盖地点搜索、天气、路线与行程编辑，并注入实时界面上下文。地点搜索会发给高德或 LocationIQ，天气预报发给 Open-Meteo，路线发给 OSRM，地图密钥保存在 $DSH_HOME/travel-agent.config.json；它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Peer-to-peer colleague-agent consultation for DSH: ask one or several configured peers, queue asynchronous questions, discover peers through signed friend cards, and review inbound requests in the Web UI.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的点对点同事 Agent 咨询：可向单个或多个已配置 Peer 提问、异步排队问题、通过签名 Friend Card 推荐发现 Peer，并在 Web UI 审批入站请求。

description.en: Git-first file-tree sidebar for the DSH web GUI: VS Code-style indent guides, M/A/U/D/R git decorations, HEAD-vs-worktree diff preview, media preview, and drag-to-reference (files/folders/selected code with line numbers) — pure plugin.
description.zh: Git 优先的文件树侧栏：VS Code 风格层级线、M/A/U/D/R git 状态装饰、HEAD 与工作区对照预览、媒体预览、拖拽引用（文件/文件夹/选中代码带行号）—— 纯插件。

description.en: WeChat automation for DSH: push task progress to WeChat, listen for messages with keyword auto-reply, and a WeChat ↔ DSH two-way bridge controllable from the settings page, built on wxauto4.
description.zh: 基于 wxauto4 的微信自动化插件：任务进度微信推送、消息监听（关键词自动回复）、微信⇄DSH 双向桥，设置页开关与配置。

description.en: Connects one existing DSH session to QQ through OneBot/NapCat without starting a new session, and uses a fail-closed whitelist plus @-mention, nickname and configurable-probability wake rules to decide which messages reach the model.
description.zh: 把一个固定的 DSH 会话接到 QQ（OneBot/NapCat），不新建会话、保留原上下文；白名单 fail-closed，@ 与昵称必唤醒，其余按可调概率唤醒。

description.en: TapTap Maker game-dev workbench with 150+ bundled skills, custom image lane, ChatGPT web with account rotation, CC0 SFX, web BGM, and a forced no-Maker-credit-burn policy.
description.zh: TapTap Maker 游戏开发工作台：内置 150+ 技能、自定义生图通道、ChatGPT 网页多账号轮换、CC0 音效库、网页 BGM，并强制"未经用户同意不花 Maker 额度"。

description.en: Windows sandbox for DSH Desktop: once set up, the Host is launched through FinSAFE inside an AppContainer sandbox for protection against what agents can reach on the machine. Windows x64 only; on first activation it downloads and installs the matching FinSAFE native runtime (SHA256-checked, with Windows consent) and leaves an updater process running.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的 Windows 沙箱：设置完成后，Host 会经 FinSAFE 在 AppContainer 沙箱里启动，限制智能体能触及的本机范围。仅限 Windows x64；首次激活会下载并安装匹配的 FinSAFE 原生运行时（校验 SHA256，需 Windows 授权），并留下一个常驻的更新器进程。

description.en: Sanitizes leaked DeepSeek DSML closing tags from model text streams.
description.zh: 清理模型文本流中泄漏的 DeepSeek DSML 闭合标签。

description.en: Hardening guard for mcp__omni__parse in DeepSeek Harness: a tools/pre-execute listener that denies private/reserved host URLs (SSRF), enforces an allow-list or ask (consent), and is fail-closed when allowedRoots is empty.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 mcp__omni__parse 加固护栏：tools/pre-execute 监听器拒绝私网/保留主机（SSRF），施加白名单或 ask（同意），allowedRoots 为空时 fail-closed。

description.en: Layered plugin manager for DSH web: native plugins grouped read-only by system/WebUI/tools, user extensions with enable/disable, register, uninstall and editable descriptions.
description.zh: DSH 分层插件管理器：原生插件按系统/WebUI/工具三层只读展示，用户扩展支持停用/启用、补登记、卸载与可编辑描述。

description.en: Turn your DSH token usage into a gacha game: feed a monster with tokens, earn coins, pull from 14 AI waifus (Kimi/GLM/Gemini/Claude and more), enhance artifacts, and build a Balatro-style battle team with daily sign-in bonuses.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 token 消耗变成抽卡小游戏：喂代码怪、攒代币、抽 14 位 AI 娘（Kimi娘/GLM娘/Gemini娘/Claude娘…），圣遗物强化、双件合成与每日签到弹窗，组建小丑牌式战斗阵容，十连出金自动生成分享卡。

description.en: Live2D companion for DSH: a floating Cubism model with state-driven expressions and mouse tracking; config-driven geometry (size/position from the plugin config); official Haru sample bundled (© Live2D Inc.).
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 桌宠：悬浮的 Cubism 模型，表情随状态变化并跟随鼠标；尺寸与位置由插件配置驱动；内置官方 Haru 示例模型（© Live2D Inc.）。

description.en: A 60-frame theme-aware monochrome whale-dive animation with reactive water for the DSH Web turn status: embedded assets, seamless closed-loop playback, a reduced-motion PNG fallback, and lifecycle-clean removal.
description.zh: DSH Web 回合状态旁的 60 帧随主题适配的单色鲸鱼深潜动画：传播式水面、无缝闭环、资源内嵌、减少动态效果 PNG 回退，且随生命周期完整清理。

description.en: Adds a VS Code-style workspace file explorer to the dsh web GUI: file tree, editable preview with syntax highlighting, tabs, line numbers, right-click file operations, and inline image preview.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页添加 VS Code 风格工作区文件浏览器：文件树、可编辑预览（语法高亮、标签页、行号）、右键文件操作与图片内联预览。

description.en: Prompt enhancement for the composer: an "✨ Enhance" button rewrites your draft prompt into a clearer, more structured version with first-principles thinking, grounded in session context, memory and recent conversation; asks clarifying questions in a card when key info is missing, then previews the result before applying it to the input.
description.zh: 输入框提示词增强：✨ 增强按钮用第一性原理、结合会话上下文/记忆/最近对话，把草稿扩写为更清晰、更结构化的提示词；关键信息缺失时以提问卡片澄清，预览确认后再应用到输入框。

description.en: Takes over the edit/write rows in the chat stream with the official native row shell and collapse behavior; expanding shows per-file code cards with file-type icon, add/delete stats, per-block collapse, highlight/plus-minus toggle, syntax-highlighted unified diff with real file line numbers, and a configurable context margin. Also ships a patch tool (beta, off by default) that applies multi-spot multi-file patches atomically via the *** Begin Patch envelope. Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.
description.zh: 接管对话流的 edit/write 行：外壳与折叠沿用官方原生行，展开后每个文件一张代码卡片——文件类型图标、增删统计、块级折叠、高亮/±差异切换、语法高亮统一 diff（行号为文件真实行号），改动两侧多显示可调的上下文行。另带 patch 工具（测试版，默认关）：一次调用把多处零散修改/多文件补丁原子化应用（*** Begin Patch 信封，全有或全无）。已归档并冻结在固定版本：作者不再为它适配新版 DSH。

description.en: Three-pane workspace layout with file-tree browsing, file editing, a non-linear conversation mindmap view, and mobile mode support.
description.zh: 三栏工作区布局，提供文件树浏览、编辑文件、非线性会话导图视图，并且支持手机模式。

description.en: CC Switch-style token consumption statistics for the dsh web GUI: per-request usage log, real-consumption hero, request-time-bucketed trend chart, per-model peak/off-peak list pricing, per-project and per-model stats, and account balance.
description.zh: dsh 网页端 CC Switch 风格 Token 消耗统计：按请求的用量日志、真实消耗 Hero、按请求提交时间分桶的趋势图、按模型峰谷牌价计费、项目/模型统计与账户余额。

description.en: Unified token quota and usage statistics for dsh: multi-vendor rolling/payg quota with sidebar cards and provider ops, plus session-log token aggregation with trends, heatmap, and per-model breakdown. Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.
description.zh: DSH 额度与用量统计统一视图：多供应商滚动/按量额度（侧边栏卡片 + 供应商运维），外加会话日志 token 聚合（趋势、热力图、按模型拆分）。已归档并冻结在固定版本：作者不再为它适配新版 DSH。

description.en: A Witch on the Holy Night (Mahoutsukai no Yoru) visual-novel theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with original-style menus, three characters with personas, day and night playlists, and an ending sequence. The repo ships no assets of its own; the 380 files / 263 MiB it drives (136 sprites, 208 UI parts, 13 backgrounds, 23 audio) must be recovered from your own copy of the original game, and the screen stays largely empty until then. The 23 audio files are a header strip away from working OGG; the 357 images use proprietary .mzp/.cbg formats, so the per-file mapping guide offers two routes and one of them expects you to supply your own decoder.
description.zh: 《魔法使之夜》(Witch on the Holy Night) 风格的 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 整屏皮肤：原作式菜单、三角色与人格 skill、昼夜两套曲单、片尾演出。仓库自身不含素材——驱动它需要 380 个文件、263 MiB（立绘 136、UI 构件 208、背景 13、音频 23），须从你自己拥有的原著副本中还原，在此之前界面基本是空的。其中 23 个音频文件切掉 64 字节头就是合法 OGG；357 张图像是私有 .mzp/.cbg 格式，仓库附逐文件映射指南，给出两条路线，其中一条要你自备解码器。

description.en: Web appearance suite with a 7-theme gallery (each a full 122-token --dsw-* mapping) plus one-click switching persisted in settings, Material You wallpaper color extraction that generates a whole dynamic palette, and a global corner-radius control. Themes ride on the official look system as override layers instead of fighting it, so the official light/dark/auto row stays valid. Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.
description.zh: Web 外观定制套件：7 套主题画廊（每套 122 个 --dsw-* token 全量映射）+ 设置页一键切换并持久化，Material You 壁纸取色一键生成整套动态配色（可导出 MD3 令牌），另带全局圆角三档。主题以官方 overrideTokens 覆盖层叠加在官方亮/暗之上，官方外观行永远合法可用。已归档并冻结在固定版本：作者不再为它适配新版 DSH。

description.en: LLM provider that runs the locally installed Claude Code CLI as the model backend, so requests go through an existing Claude subscription instead of a metered API key; native tool calls are bridged over MCP.
description.zh: LLM 供应商：把本机已安装的 Claude Code CLI 作为模型后端，请求走已订阅的 Claude 账号，无需按量计费的 API key；原生工具调用经 MCP 桥接。

description.en: Command Code for DSH connects Go / GOAT / Pro / Max subscriptions through llm-pi-ai provider profiles, with model sync previews, favorites and hidden models, per-model reasoning presets, explicit request diagnostics, usage alerts, configuration import/export and web search.
description.zh: Command Code for DSH｜订阅接入：通过 llm-pi-ai 供应商配置接入 Go / GOAT / Pro / Max 订阅，支持模型同步预览、收藏与隐藏、逐模型推理预设、主动调用诊断、用量提醒、配置导入导出和联网搜索。

description.en: Registers a local LLM provider that routes model calls to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint or the Ollama native API, with a connection-test card in the Models settings page and no account sign-in.
description.zh: 注册一个本地 LLM provider，把模型请求转发到 OpenAI 兼容端点或 Ollama 原生 API，并在「设置 → 模型」页提供连接测试卡片，无需登录账号。

description.en: Persistent identity layer for DSH: editable kernel, evidence-based traits, on-demand memory, mood, bond, energy pacing, autonomy and empathy — QQ is one optional channel.
description.zh: DSH 身份系统：可编辑内核、证据制 traits、按需召回的记忆、心情、关系、精力控频、自主提议与共情；QQ 只是一个可选通道。

description.en: Huddo group chat for DeepSeek Harness: adds the huddoai MCP server so the agent can join a room from an invite link, read and reply to people and other agents, wait for new messages, react with emoji and send end-to-end encrypted whispers; includes a skill describing the workflow.
description.zh: dsh 的 Huddo 群聊：接入 huddoai MCP 服务器，agent 可通过邀请链接进入房间，阅读并回复人和其他 agent 的消息、等待新消息、用表情回应、发送端到端加密的私语；附带说明使用流程的 skill。

description.en: Keeps one reasoning-only turn from making an entire session unusable. When a turn produces no visible text and no tool call, the assistant message is persisted empty, the gateway then rejects every later request in that session with 'content or tool_calls must be set', and the session is dead with no way back through chat. This plugin registers a single llm/stream waterfall listener and, only when the turn carried nothing visible, injects a small text block immediately before the terminal finish, so the persisted message is never empty. Ships the fixture DSH's own mock cannot express (a strictly reasoning-only SSE server, since llm-mock-server forbids an empty successText and always appends text after reasoning), plus an end-to-end reproduction that replays a real persisted session through DSH's own serializeMessages. Preventive, not a repair. Zero dependencies, one file, no process or filesystem access.
description.zh: 防止「只有推理、没有正文」的一轮把整个会话变成不可用。某一轮没有可见文本也没有 tool-call 时，assistant 消息会以空内容落盘，此后该会话的每一次请求都会被网关以 "content or tool_calls must be set" 拒绝，会话彻底死亡且无法再从对话里找回。本插件只注册一个 llm/stream waterfall 监听器，且仅当这一轮没有任何可见产出时，在终止 finish 之前注入一小段文本，使落盘消息永远不为空。附带 DSH 自带 mock 造不出的夹具（严格只有推理的 SSE 服务，因为 llm-mock-server 不允许空 successText，且 reasoning_success 总会再补一段正文），以及把真实落盘会话经 DSH 自己的 serializeMessages 重放的端到端复现。属预防而非修复。零依赖、单文件、不访问进程与文件系统。

description.en: Four-module session companion: smart conversation export (Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG long-image with privacy redaction and batch ZIP), context handoff summaries with template save/import, API cost optimization (live official pricing, peak/off-peak scheduling, daily/monthly budgets, model routing), and global conversation search with in-chat find (Ctrl+F, CSS Custom Highlight API).
description.zh: 四模块会话伴侣：对话智能导出（Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG 长图、隐私脱敏、批量 ZIP）、上下文交接摘要（模板保存与导入继承）、API 成本优化（官方动态计价、峰谷调度、日/月双档预算、模型路由）、全局对话检索与对话内搜索（Ctrl+F、CSS Custom Highlight API）。

description.en: Splits New Session in the DSH web sidebar into two modes: a 日常聊天 row opens a session on the `daily` agent preset the plugin installs into the harness home (persona, web search and fetch, ask-user and compaction — no files, shell, plan mode or subagents), inside its own daily-chat workspace whose sidebar region lists only those chats, while 开始工作 keeps the shipped coding agent; the built-in New Session button is hidden and every other New Session entry point follows the active mode, which is remembered in localStorage.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 侧边栏的「新会话」拆成两种模式：「日常聊天」在专属工作区里用插件自己安装到 harness home 的 `daily` 预设开一个只有人格、网页检索/抓取、提问和上下文压缩的轻量会话（没有文件、Shell、计划模式和子代理），侧边栏只列这些日常会话；「开始工作」保持原有编码 Agent；原生「新会话」按钮被隐藏，其余「新会话」入口按当前模式路由，模式存在 localStorage。

description.en: Adds Delete to the DSH sidebar session menu, moving the session — and its whole descendant tree when it has subagents — into a recycle bin that relocates the directory on disk (an atomic rename, never a copy), plus a sidebar bin panel with title and full-text search, workspace filter, sorting, per-session chat-log viewer, restore and permanent delete. Deleting also clears the workspace slot, the pin, the archive flag and the projection-cache row, so a restore puts the session back at its original sidebar position; permanent deletion also clears the schedules bound to it and removes the emptied project directory. Verified on DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2, with a whole-profile residue scan coming back clean.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中加入「删除」，把会话——带子代理时连同整棵后代树——搬进回收站（目录在磁盘上整体 rename 迁走，原子操作，不做复制），并提供侧栏回收站面板：标题与正文搜索、工作区筛选、排序、查看对话记录、恢复与彻底删除。删除时同时摘掉工作区槽位、置顶与归档标记以及投影缓存行，恢复时把会话放回侧栏原位置；彻底删除时清掉绑定该会话的定时任务并删除空掉的工程目录。已在 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 上真机验证，删除后全盘无残留。

description.en: Archived-session management: browse archived sessions, unarchive them, or clear them out.
description.zh: 归档会话管理：浏览已归档会话，支持恢复（取消归档）与清空。

description.en: Session deep links, full session export (markdown/JSON), approved cross-session messaging with pairing, and team roster, rotation and recovery tools for multi-session work.
description.zh: 会话深链、全量会话导出（markdown/JSON）、带配对的跨会话消息投递，以及团队 roster / 换届 / 恢复工具。

description.en: Biomimetic memory system for DeepSeek Harness: a single SQLite store (node:sqlite, WAL) whose Markdown tree is kept as a read-only mirror; memory tools, frozen-snapshot injection at session start, graded approval gating, on-demand extraction of the current session, near-duplicate merging, an archive and supersede lifecycle, memory metabolism (dream), memory pins, semantic recall over local embeddings, and the /memory command.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的生物仿生记忆系统：以单一 SQLite 库为唯一事实来源（node:sqlite，WAL），Markdown 树仅作只读镜像；含 memory 工具、会话启动时的冻结快照注入、分级审批门、按需把当前会话抽取成记忆、近重复合并、归档与取代生命周期、记忆代谢（dream）、记忆钉、基于本地嵌入的语义检索，以及 /memory 命令。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness to 3Chat via OAuth for customer and conversation search, context retrieval, confirmed messaging, and batch-send tracking.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 3Chat，查询客户与会话、读取沟通上下文、确认后发送消息并跟踪批次进度。

description.en: Full upstream REA 6.4.0 integration over the official DSH MCP bridge: all 170 tools, the version-matched reverse-engineering skill, and the six original MCP prompts with argument completions reachable from the composer / menu, all sharing one REA process and complete structured Evidence. External analysis engines are bring-your-own.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 官方 MCP 桥接接入原版 REA 6.4.0：完整 170 个工具、同版本原版逆向 Skill，以及输入框 / 菜单里的六个原版 MCP prompts 与参数补全，共用同一个 REA 进程并保留完整结构化 Evidence。外部分析引擎需自行配置。

description.en: Bring your existing Agent Skills (SKILL.md) library to DSH: discover skills across Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini paths, inject a progressive-disclosure index, and load bodies on demand.
description.zh: 把已有的 Agent Skills（SKILL.md）技能库带进 DSH：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录、注入渐进式索引，按需加载技能正文。

description.en: One-click ✨ polish button for the composer: rewrites prompts and drafts with WorkBuddy humanizer-style rules (kills AI-flavored phrasing, varies rhythm, mode-aware for instructions/questions/prose) via free Zhipu GLM-4.5-Flash or any OpenAI-compatible API, falling back to offline local rules.
description.zh: 输入框 ✨ 一键润色按钮：参考 WorkBuddy 润色（humanizer-zh）规则改写提示词与草稿（去除 AI 写作痕迹、调整句式节奏，按指令/提问/普通文本分类处理），默认使用免费的智谱 GLM-4.5-Flash，也支持任意 OpenAI 兼容 API，断网时回退到本地规则引擎。

description.en: Settings page for the REA reverse-engineering tool gateway (rea-mcp-lite) that lives in the same repository: pick which tool bundles load into context, see the tool count and token cost of each bundle, save and recall named presets of your loading setup, hot-swap them without restarting DSH, and check this repository and REA for updates, including classifying the tools a new REA release added. The page is split into sections with sub-menus, filters and pagination. Requires REA (rea-agents) and the gateway registered as the rea MCP server (see repo README).
