description.zh: 同一个仓库里的 REA 逆向工具网关（rea-mcp-lite）的设置页：勾选加载哪些功能族、看清每族的工具数与 token 成本、把当前加载组合存成命名预设随时切回、热切换无需重启，并可检查本仓库与 REA 的更新、归类 REA 新版新增的工具。页面按功能分区，带子菜单、筛选与分页。需已装 REA（rea-agents），并按仓库 README 把网关注册为名为 rea 的 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Query Chinese Minecraft Wiki (MediaWiki API) and convert raw wiki text into clean AI-readable output — search, page intro, full-page Markdown, and random entry; templates, references, images and cross-language links are stripped before reaching the model. Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.
description.zh: 查询中文 Minecraft Wiki（MediaWiki API），把搜索结果与页面全文完整转换为 AI 可直接阅读的干净文本——搜索、引言、全文 Markdown、随机条目；模板、引用、图片、跨语言链接等噪声在插件内部全部清洗完毕。已归档并冻结在固定版本：作者不再为它适配新版 DSH。

description.en: Real browser tools for DeepSeek Harness: browse and extract web content, fill forms, manage multiple tabs, and execute multi-step tasks, with incremental DOM, session isolation, screenshots, action-result checks, and archived evidence recall.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供真实浏览器操作能力：网页浏览与信息提取、表单填写、多标签页协作和多步骤任务执行；支持增量 DOM、会话隔离、截图、操作结果检查与证据归档回读。

description.en: A visible Chrome window per DSH session: 16 chrome_* tools (open/status/close/navigate/tabs/snapshot/screenshot/click/click_at/fill/type/press_key/hover/scroll/evaluate/wait), a Chrome tab in the Web GUI with a live screencast view (screenshot-heartbeat fallback for idle pages), tab management, window controls and a screenshot history.
description.zh: 每个 DSH 会话一个可见的 Chrome 窗口：16 个 chrome_* 工具（打开/状态/关闭/导航/标签/快照/截图/点击/坐标点击/填写/输入/按键/悬停/滚动/执行脚本/等待），Web GUI 的 Chrome 标签页提供实时画面流（静止页截图心跳兜底）、标签页管理、窗口控制与截图历史。

description.en: A content-aware PDF reading plugin for vision models: profiles each page for figures (vector and raster), tables, formula risk and double-column layout, then applies content-aware hybrid extraction, rendering figure/table/formula pages as high-DPI region crops. Provides a low-resolution preview to understand the page layout, and renders a specified region at high resolution. Packaged as multiple tools for agents.
description.zh: 面向视觉模型的内容感知 PDF 读取插件：逐页分析图（矢量与栅格）、表格、公式风险与双栏排版，基于内容识别进行混合提取，图表/公式页渲染成高 DPI 区域裁切。提供低清预览以理解页面概况并支持指定选区获取高清渲染。功能包装为多个工具供Agent使用。

description.en: Let text-only models see images: when a picture arrives with a placeholder like \[image omitted because this model accepts text only], the model calls the vision_describe tool and the plugin forwards the image reference plus the question to a multimodal model, retrying with a fallback model on failure. Configured in the settings page and persisted via the official settings API.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能看图：消息中出现图片占位符时模型调用 vision_describe 工具，插件把本轮图片引用与提问一起转交给多模态视觉模型识别，主模型失败时自动用备用模型重试。配置在设置页完成并通过官方 settings API 持久化到 settings.yaml，热重载不丢。

description.en: Perlica (Arknights: Endfield) themed tiered sound notifications: plan-ready, task-done, needs-your-input, and error tones; silent for plain chat, system-level playback (works in background), cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), custom TTS sounds.
description.zh: 明日方舟终末地佩丽卡主题分级提示音：计划出方案 / 任务完成 / 需要你回应 / 出错四档独立音效，普通问答保持安静；系统级播放（窗口在后台也响），跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），支持自定义 TTS 语音。

description.en: Create, read, and edit PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, and PDF via the local zagens-office CLI as office_schema / office_write / office_edit / office_read tools.
description.zh: 通过本机 zagens-office CLI 读写编辑 PPTX / DOCX / XLSX / PDF，注册为 office_schema / office_write / office_edit / office_read。

description.en: Technical documentation agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: template-driven writing with a self-learning template library, AI-flavor removal for tech docs, and a quality-assurance toolkit (document audit, cross-document consistency, numbering resequencing, version sync, PDF and Word export, screenshot automation).
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的技术文档撰写 Agent 模式：模板驱动写作与自学习模板库、技术文档去 AI 味，以及文档质量保障工具集（量化体检、多文档口径一致性校验、图/表编号重排、版本同步检查、Word/PDF 导出与界面截图自动化）。

description.en: ADHD behavioral coaching skill: task breakdown, overwhelm management, launch rituals, and failure recovery.
description.zh: ADHD 行为辅导技能：任务拆解、事项过载管理、启动仪式与失败重启。

description.en: Cron scheduler with a sidebar UI: run shell, Python or Node scripts, skills, or agent tasks on a schedule, with push notifications and session archiving.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：侧栏管理界面，按 cron 表达式或间隔执行脚本、技能与 Agent 任务，支持完成后推送通知与会话归档。

description.en: Engineering workflow agent preset for dsh: five gated phases (requirements clarification, plan approval, TDD, parallel subagents, verified finishing) with six workflow skills adapted from obra/superpowers.
description.zh: 工程化工作流 agent preset：五阶段硬门禁（需求澄清、计划审批、TDD、子 Agent 并行、验证收尾），附 6 个改编自 obra/superpowers 的工作流技能。

description.en: Question-Driven Discovery research workflow for DeepSeek Harness with a QDD Agent Preset, durable Human and Auto runs, and an auditable research panel.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Question-Driven Discovery 科研工作流，提供 QDD Agent Preset、持久化 Human 和 Auto 运行，以及可审计的研究面板。

description.en: AI can write resume text, but templates may still look wrong, pages may overflow, whitespace may remain, and small edits can destabilize the layout. dsh-resume provides an end-to-end DSH workflow for truthful content refinement, template selection, A4 layout tuning, visual review, and tailored resume versions for different job-search scenarios.
description.zh: AI 写简历容易，但写完常会遇到模板不合适、排版溢出、页面留白过多，以及改一处导致全局变形等问题。dsh-resume 专注解决手动修改简历繁琐、低效的问题，让 DSH 覆盖从内容撰写、模板选择到排版调优的完整简历工作流，并支持针对不同求职场景产出合适的简历版本。

description.en: Adversarial checkup → fix → review loop toolset.
description.zh: 发现问题→修复交付→质量复查的对抗式闭环工具集。

description.en: Host-side unattended job scheduler: runs one-shot agent tasks or shell commands on cron, interval, or one-time schedules, with persisted at-most-once dispatch state, overlap/misfire policies, and bounded run history.
description.zh: 宿主侧无人值守定时任务：按 cron 表达式、固定间隔或一次性时点运行一次性 agent 任务或 shell 命令，调度状态持久化（至多一次语义），支持重叠/错过策略与有界运行历史。

description.en: Project autopilot for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3, with scoped authorization, independent verification, editable memories and companion chat, including automatic installation of the compatible desktop pet fork. The bundled pet is a fork of takboo/dsh-coopanion (AGPL-3.0-or-later); do not install the upstream pet alongside it.
description.zh: 支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2、0.2.1-rc.3，提供范围授权、独立验收、可编辑记忆和伙伴聊天的项目自动推进插件，自动安装配套桌宠 fork。配套桌宠是 takboo/dsh-coopanion 的 fork（AGPL-3.0-or-later），不能与上游桌宠同装。

description.en: Visual GitHub login without a terminal: in-window device flow, token synced into the gh CLI, and host status/launch endpoints.
description.zh: 零终端的 GitHub 可视化登录插件：窗口内完成设备码授权，令牌同步进 gh CLI，附宿主端状态与唤起接口。

description.en: Multi-channel push for DeepSeek Harness: Server酱, PushPlus, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Feishu, ntfy, custom webhooks and more, configurable from the settings panel and callable by other plugins via the pushNotifier service.
description.zh: DSH 多渠道消息推送插件：支持 Server酱、PushPlus、Bark、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram、飞书、ntfy、自定义 Webhook 等，可在设置面板配置多个渠道，并通过 pushNotifier 服务供其他插件调用。

description.en: Chat with, monitor, and approve your DSH agents from WeChat via the iLink gateway: text both ways, session targeting, digest heartbeats, and numbered approval prompts.
description.zh: 通过 iLink 网关在微信里与 DSH agent 聊天、监控与审批：双向文本、会话切换、进度摘要与编号审批提示。

description.en: Bridge to the Telegram Bot API: long polling, per-chat sessions, HTML formatting.
description.zh: Telegram Bot API 桥接：长轮询、per-chat 会话、HTML 格式化。

description.en: Connect dsh to Notion via the official Notion MCP (OAuth + PKCE): search, read, and write pages, databases, and comments through `mcp__notion__*` tools.
description.zh: 通过官方 Notion MCP（OAuth + PKCE）把 dsh 连接到 Notion：通过 `mcp__notion__*` 工具搜索、读写页面、数据库与评论。

description.en: C/C++ LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using clangd.
description.zh: 基于 clangd 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 C/C++ 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: C# LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using OmniSharp.
description.zh: 基于 OmniSharp 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 C# 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Go LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using gopls.
description.zh: 基于 gopls 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Go 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Java LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using the Eclipse JDT language server.
description.zh: 基于 Eclipse JDT 语言服务器为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Java 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Kotlin LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using kotlin-language-server.
description.zh: 基于 kotlin-language-server 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Kotlin 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Lua LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using lua-language-server.
description.zh: 基于 lua-language-server 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Lua 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: PHP LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using Intelephense.
description.zh: 基于 Intelephense 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 PHP 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Python LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using Pyright.
description.zh: 基于 Pyright 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Python 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Ruby LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using ruby-lsp.
description.zh: 基于 ruby-lsp 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Ruby 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Rust LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using rust-analyzer.
description.zh: 基于 rust-analyzer 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Rust 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Swift LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using sourcekit-lsp.
description.zh: 基于 sourcekit-lsp 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Swift 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: TypeScript and JavaScript LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using typescript-language-server.
description.zh: 基于 typescript-language-server 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 TypeScript 和 JavaScript 代码导航及语言服务配置。

description.en: Scan and fix Low integrity labels, non-inherited S-1-4 sandbox ACEs, and related Everyone deny ACEs in DSH workspaces on Windows. Maps live DSH workspaces, defaults to read-only, repairs after confirmation, verifies the result, and keeps one replaceable ACL rollback record per workspace.
description.zh: 扫描并修复 Windows 上 DSH 工作区中的 Low 完整性标签、非继承 S-1-4-* 沙箱授权 ACE 及关联的 Everyone 拒绝项。按 DSH 实时工作区映射，默认只读，确认后修复并复扫校验；每个工作区保留一条可替换的 ACL 回滚记录。

description.en: Remote development over SSH: pick a directory on a registered machine as the session workspace and the file, shell, bash, and search tools run on the remote host — the agent works there with the same local tools, and no extra model-facing tools are added.
description.zh: 基于 SSH 的远程开发：把注册机器上的目录选为会话工作区后，文件、shell、bash 与搜索工具即改在远程主机上执行——agent 用与本地相同的工具在那里工作，不新增任何面向模型的工具。

description.en: Remote access for the DSH Web GUI: LAN QR access, cloudflared quick tunnels, and frp reverse proxying via your own server, with a built-in auth portal.
description.zh: Web GUI 远程访问：局域网二维码直连、cloudflared 快速隧道、frp 自有服务器反代，内置登录门户，并放行设置接口。

description.en: Self-healing Cloudflare quick-tunnel pool for the dsh web GUI: floating widget with QR phone access, generational rotation, chase service worker and prompt-free credential handoff.
description.zh: 为 dsh web GUI 提供自愈式 Cloudflare 快速隧道池：浮窗控件、扫码手机访问、代际轮换、追踪 Service Worker，免提示凭据交接。

description.en: Phone access to DSH over a self-hosted relay (WSS via your own TLS-terminating proxy): bundle plugin with bridge supervisor and QR login, a native Android app, and server-side device revocation.
description.zh: 通过自建中继从手机访问 DSH（WSS 由你自己的 TLS 终止代理提供）：含桥接守护与扫码登录的 bundle 插件、原生 Android 应用，并支持服务端设备吊销。

description.en: An orange-tabby desktop pet for dsh-pet — 32 transparent VP9-alpha actions, 512×512 at 8–12fps, with the matte and QA toolchain that produced them.
description.zh: 橘猫桌宠「耄耋」——32 个透明动作（512×512 / 8–12fps / VP9-alpha），附抠像与体检工具链。

description.en: Adds one draggable desktop pet to the DSH web GUI: a whale girl called Big Fat Fish (nickname Jingjing), with eight switchable colour skins and a personality. She eats rice, is clever but lazy, and is a tsundere: too many rapid clicks and she lies down and refuses to react for a while, calling her fat annoys her and she insists she is not, and the nickname Jingjing pleases her. She also remembers you between sessions: three fat-calls today and she greets you cold, three nickname-calls and she greets you warm, coming back after half an hour earns "I was not waiting for you", and the first few meetings she is shy - so the counters reset each local midnight and are stored in a state file the plugin owns. After ten quiet minutes she drifts to a corner, which is visual only and never moves the position you chose. The eight PNGs are bundled with the plugin and served by the plugin itself, so there are no third-party requests. NOTE - the artwork carries an OleapCrow mark and was supplied by the repository owner, the eight skins are recolourings of that one drawing, and the plugin has not been installed against a live DSH host.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面加一只可以拖动的桌宠：一只叫「大肥鱼」（昵称「鲸鲸」）的鲸鱼娘，八种配色皮肤可切换，并且有性格——只吃米饭、聪明但懒、嘴硬心软；连点几次会躺平不干了，被叫「大肥鱼」会生气并坚持自己不胖，叫「鲸鲸」才高兴。她还会记事：今天被叫胖三次就来时冷淡，被叫昵称三次就亲近，离开半小时再回来说「才不是等你」，头几次见面怕生；这些计数每天零点清零，存在插件自己的状态文件里。十分钟没人理会游到角落，那只改视觉、不会动你放她的位置。八张皮肤图随插件分发、由插件自己提供，因此没有任何第三方请求。注意：画面带有 OleapCrow 标记、由仓库所有者提供，八种皮肤是同一张画的重新配色；本插件尚未在真实的 DSH 宿主上安装验证过。

description.en: A whale companion with configurable roles, emotional speech through local TTS, persistent file-based memory, QQ messaging, and half-duplex voice calls. QQ requires a NapCatQQ-compatible OneBot v11 gateway, and the emotional voice requires a local VoiceStudio + audio.cpp + Breeze TTS 2 stack (or a compatible TTS API); FFmpeg is needed for non-1x speech speed.
description.zh: 提供角色配置、本地情绪语音、文件持久记忆、QQ 消息与半双工语音通话的鲸鱼娘陪伴插件。QQ 需搭配兼容 OneBot v11 的 NapCatQQ 网关；情绪语音需本地 VoiceStudio + audio.cpp + Breeze TTS 2 链路（或兼容 TTS API），非 1 倍语速时还需 FFmpeg。

description.en: Self-evolving agent framework on DeepSeek Harness (dsh): 40 Cordis plugins and 4 presets covering memory, reflection, gates, metrics and an auditable evolution loop. Not a one-command install. Clone the repo and run install/install.sh --profile=web (needs bash, Node 20+, python3, DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 or newer with an initialized profile), then restart.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的自进化智能体框架：40 个 Cordis 插件、4 套 preset，含记忆、反思、门禁、度量与可审计的进化闭环。不是一条命令装完。需克隆仓库并运行 install/install.sh --profile=web（依赖 bash、Node 20+、python3、DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 及以上且目标 profile 已初始化），装完重启。

description.en: One-click enter/exit Plan mode for the DSH web input bar, a quick-click shortcut for /plan.
description.zh: 输入框一键进/出 Plan 模式（/plan 的快捷点击），常驻小按钮。

description.en: Replaces the Web GUI trajectory tab with a new-user-friendly round-by-round storyline, plain-language tool labels, category filters and fuzzy search.
description.zh: 把 Web GUI 的轨迹页签替换为新手友好的回合故事线：工具名通俗中文化，支持类别筛选与模糊搜索。

description.en: PBR 3D model preview for game art: GLB/GLTF with textures, IBL environment lighting, orbit controls, and a material channel inspector (baseColor/normal/roughness/metallic/AO/emissive/wireframe); scalar channels shown as grayscale per PBR spec, via the pbr3d fence and pbr_render tool.
description.zh: 游戏美术 PBR 3D 模型预览：GLB/GLTF 带贴图纹理、IBL 环境光照、轨道控制，以及材质通道检查器（基础色/法线/粗糙度/金属度/AO/自发光/线框），标量通道按 PBR 规范以灰度显示，通过 pbr3d 围栏与 pbr_render 工具使用。

description.en: Select any text in a conversation and tap the Explain button to get a streaming Markdown explanation bubble, with recursive follow-up questions.
description.zh: 对话中框选任意文字后点击「解释」按钮，弹出 Markdown 实时流式解释气泡，支持递归追问。

description.en: A marquee mood-light ring around the DSH web UI edge that reacts to session state, turning green while the agent works, pink when done, and yellow when something needs attention, with colors, ring width, rotation speed, and flash frequency configurable from the settings panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面边缘的跑马灯氛围光环：随会话状态自动变色（运行中绿色流动、完成粉色、有待处理黄色警告），设置面板可调颜色、光圈宽度、转速与闪动频率。

description.en: Collapse noisy messages (Think, Bash, etc.) in conversations.
description.zh: 折叠对话中的 Think、Bash 等「无用消息」。

description.en: Developer tools panel for the DSH web UI: file browser with preview, edit, and path-only file mentions; multi-tab terminals with quick commands; Git panel with commit, push, pull, and branch switching; and background job management. UI ported from pi-web-ui.
description.zh: dsh Web UI 开发者工具面板：文件浏览/预览/编辑与路径式文件提及、多终端（快捷命令）、Git 面板（提交/推送/拉取/分支）与后台任务管理。UI 移植自 pi-web-ui。

description.en: All-in-one bundle for DSH: the native Windows desktop window (WebView2), DeepEye vision (GLM-4V-Flash), and voice input (mic button) in a single install.
description.zh: DSH 三件套全家桶：Windows 原生窗口（WebView2）+ DeepEye 视觉（GLM-4V-Flash）+ 语音输入（麦克风按钮），一条命令装齐。

description.en: Native Windows desktop window (WebView2) for DSH: one-command install, auto-fetches the app zip from GitHub Releases, creates a desktop shortcut, and adds a desktop_launch tool to start it from chat.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 原生窗口（WebView2）：一键安装，自动从 GitHub Releases 下载应用 zip、创建桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

description.en: Configurable DSH usage statistics: a sidebar text/card widget plus a detail dialog with per-provider and per-model breakdowns, cache-hit rates, token trends, and latency details (TTFT and duration).
description.zh: 高度可配置的 DSH 用量统计插件：侧边栏文字/卡片组件加统计弹窗，提供按提供方与按模型的请求/Token 统计、缓存命中率、趋势图与首字节/总耗时明细。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and session cost under the composer, with a live peak/off-peak pricing badge (Beijing time), a countdown to the next pricing switch, hover price tables, and usage advice.
description.zh: 输入框下方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本会话花费，余额前带峰/谷价格徽章（北京时间）与距切换倒计时，悬停看两档单价明细与使用建议。

description.en: Shows coding-plan usage and balance for 5 AI providers (MiniMax, DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenRouter, Zhipu) beside the composer input, switching with the selected model and reusing API keys configured in DSH model settings.
description.zh: 在 composer 输入框旁显示 5 家 AI 套餐用量与余额（MiniMax、DeepSeek、Kimi、OpenRouter、智谱），跟随当前模型自动切换，复用 DSH 模型设置里已配的 API Key。

description.en: Customizable brand area for the Web UI: replace the whale logo and DeepSeek wordmark with local images, and edit the HARNESS badge text (double-click to change, right-click to reset).
description.zh: Web UI 品牌区自定义：鲸鱼 logo 与 DeepSeek 文字可换成本地图片，HARNESS 徽章文字可双击编辑（双击修改，右键恢复）。

description.en: Genshin Impact Yoimiya theme: two hand-tuned palettes, a procedural fireworks particle layer, and a local music player that reads your own files — songs and covers are never uploaded. Warm syntax colors and a hand-drawn goldfish brand mark; apart from the wallpaper every pixel is CSS gradients and hand-written SVG.
description.zh: 《原神》宵宫主题：严格核算过对比度的明暗双色板、程序化生成的烟花粒子层，以及一个读取你自己本地文件的播放器——歌曲与封面不上传到任何地方。语法高亮为暖色，标识为自绘金鱼；除壁纸外所有画面都由 CSS 渐变与手写 SVG 生成。

description.en: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: mica and compatibility modes with adjustable blur and frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, background brightness, particle-whale accent, and a master switch that restores the stock UI.
description.zh: Aqua 玻璃质感主题：云母/兼容双模式、可调模糊与磨砂、流体/壁纸背景、背景亮度、粒子鲸鱼点缀，一键关闭即还原原生界面。

description.en: Rotates the DSH app background wallpaper from a folder on a timer with cross-fade transitions; falls back to four bundled SVG gradients when no folder is set, and adds background-opacity, wallpaper-dimming, blur and text-shadow controls so panels and text stay readable.
description.zh: 按设定间隔从指定文件夹轮换 DSH 应用背景壁纸（带交叉淡化）；未配置文件夹时使用随插件分发的 4 张 SVG 渐变壁纸，并提供背景不透明度、壁纸压暗、毛玻璃模糊与文字阴影四个可读性调节，让面板与文字在花哨的图上仍然看得清。

description.en: Two-tier model routing: a strong tier plans, advises and reviews while a cheap tier implements, with plan-mode-aware auto routing, a high-impact escalation guard, failure auto-escalation, and subagent tiering.
description.zh: 双档模型路由：强档负责规划/咨询/评审、弱档负责实现；含计划模式自动路由、高危操作守卫、失败自动升级与子代理分层。

description.en: Local model plugin for DeepSeek Harness: manage GGUF models in settings, auto-launch llama.cpp on first message, and auto-unload after 5 minutes of idle time to free VRAM.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地模型插件：在设置里管理 GGUF 模型，首条对话自动拉起 llama.cpp，空闲 5 分钟自动卸载释放显存。

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription models as a DeepSeek Harness provider: re-resolves the live gateway catalog every few minutes, auto-adapts models the built-in table has not seen, and covers streaming, tool calls, image input and subscription usage. A maintained fork of dsh-opencode-go: a clash with the upstream package over the llm-opencode-go settings namespace makes it withdraw quietly instead of failing the whole plugin tree, and an already-claimed opencode-go route makes it serve on opencode-go-plus.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Go 订阅模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：每隔几分钟重新解析网关实时目录，内置表里没有的模型按同族自动适配，支持流式输出、工具调用、图片输入与订阅额度显示。这是 dsh-opencode-go 的维护分支：与上游包争用 llm-opencode-go 设置命名空间时安静退场，而不是让整棵插件树加载失败；opencode-go 路由已被占用时改用 opencode-go-plus 路由继续服务。

description.en: Use third-party subscription accounts in DeepSeek Harness: chat, image understanding, image generation, and image editing with the models your subscription covers, with available models and reasoning levels synced from your account; currently supports OpenAI/ChatGPT subscriptions, more providers planned.
description.zh: 用第三方订阅账户在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用订阅覆盖的模型：文字对话、图片理解、图片生成与图片编辑，可用模型与推理等级随账户自动同步；当前支持 OpenAI / ChatGPT 订阅，更多订阅服务规划中。

description.en: NewAPI (OpenAI-compatible gateway) LLM provider: registers a `newapi` route with chat-only model discovery, auto-fills model parameters (context window, reasoning effort) from models.dev, and adds a Web settings section for the base URL and API key.
description.zh: NewAPI（OpenAI 兼容网关）模型接入：注册 `newapi` 路由，仅发现聊天类模型，自动从 models.dev 获取模型参数（上下文窗口、思考强度等）并填充，并在 Web 设置页配置 base URL 与 API Key。

description.en: Manages OpenCode Zen free-tier and Go-tier models in settings.yaml — fetches the live model listings from opencode.ai, reports configured-versus-live drift per route, and adds or removes entries through four agent tools and an OpenCode Models settings section.
description.zh: 在 settings.yaml 中管理 OpenCode Zen 免费档与 Go 档模型——实时拉取 opencode.ai 的最新模型列表，按路由对比已配置与线上差异，通过四个 agent 工具和设置页分区增删模型条目。

description.en: Unofficial provider that connects Tencent CodeBuddy open platform models to DeepSeek Harness, with automatic model discovery and a settings page for the API key.
description.zh: 非官方 provider 插件：把腾讯 CodeBuddy 开放平台的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持自动探测模型，并在设置页填写 API 密钥。

description.en: Reversible delivery contract: rewrites operator authority and execution rules when enabled, byte-identical to stock when off, with host and profile clean.
description.zh: 可逆的交付契约与破甲插件：开启时生效最高指令权威与交付规则，关闭时注册面与官方逐字节一致，支持宿主与 Profile 清洗。

description.en: Context Assembler plugin for DeepSeek Harness: topic-block context assembly, water-pressure topic splitting, tool trace/rewrite, reality recall injection and handoff planning.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 上下文汇编插件：话题块上下文汇编、水位压力话题切割、工具轮压缩/改写、reality 召回注入与 handoff 规划。

description.en: Off-peak message scheduler: turn on valley mode and the composer queues your messages until DeepSeek off-peak hours (half price), then auto-injects them into the session and gets replies. Native-look composer, hotkeys (Enter queue / ⌘+Enter send now / Esc exit), per-session toggle persisted across restarts.
description.zh: 谷时发送调度器：开启谷时模式后输入框消息排队至 DeepSeek 谷时窗口（半价）自动注入会话并得到回复。原生外观输入条、快捷键（Enter 入队 / ⌘+Enter 立即发送 / Esc 退出）、按会话记忆的开关，重启不丢。

description.en: An edited fork of dsh-chat-editor from WZZNNE/DSH-CyberWorkStation (MIT), with -plus ids so it can be installed alongside the original. Rewrite or delete messages the model reads — text, reasoning blocks and tool results — without replacing the message on the session surface, and branch a session from any turn.
description.zh: WZZNNE/DSH-CyberWorkStation 中 dsh-chat-editor（MIT）的二次开发版，包名/插件 id/slot 均带 -plus，可与原版并存安装。改写或删除模型读到的消息（正文、思考块、工具结果），消息本身仍留在会话表层、seq 不变；并可从任意一轮分叉会话。

description.en: Message-level full-text search across DSH sessions via an FTS5 trigram index (user / assistant / steering / tool with per-kind filters), deduplicated results across fork/continued sessions, read-only context preview with auto-scroll to the focused message, one-click jump to the real session, and incremental/full index rebuild with health check; zh/en i18n follows the Host locale service.
description.zh: DSH 会话消息级全文检索浏览器：FTS5 trigram 索引按消息检索（用户/助手/系统注入/工具四类，可按类型筛选），fork/续接会话结果自动去重，只读上下文预览自动滚动定位焦点消息，一键跳转真实会话；支持增量/全量重建索引与健康检查；界面中英双语跟随 Host locale 服务。

description.en: Read-only semantic retrieval for meow-memory: a local bge-m3 vector index over memory entries and conversation turns, a knowledge graph, and verbatim turn recall. Never writes back to the memory store; requires meow-memory.
description.zh: meow-memory 的只读语义检索增强层：为本机记忆条目与对话轮次建 bge-m3 向量索引，提供记忆图谱与逐字原文召回，绝不回写记忆库；需与 meow-memory 搭配使用。

description.en: Persistent five-layer memory system with relevance injection, LLM auto-extraction, profile rotation, and six agent tools.
description.zh: 五层持久记忆系统：相关性注入、LLM 自动提取、画像轮替与六个 agent 工具。

description.en: Long-term memory for dsh via a local Hindsight service: each turn is retained with local timestamps and relevant memories (time-aware, reranked) are recalled into context before replies; each workspace binds to one memory bank, several workspaces can share a bank, and banks can have Chinese names; what gets retained is configurable (default: user messages and AI replies); history is imported only when you choose to; includes a three-step setup page with one-click local deployment (uv + Python 3.12), a sidebar status card and a panel to browse and search memories. Needs a SiliconFlow API key for the default embedding and reranker models; only Linux is verified so far.
description.zh: dsh 长期记忆（基于本地 Hindsight 服务）：每轮对话带本地时间写入记忆库，回答前按问题与时间检索并经 reranker 排序后注入上下文；每个工作区绑定一个记忆库，多个工作区可共用同一个库，记忆库可起中文名；记住哪些内容可设置（默认只记用户消息与 AI 回复）；以前的对话不自动导入，由用户手动选择导入；提供三步设置页与一键本地部署（自动准备 uv 与 Python 3.12）、侧栏状态卡片及可浏览、搜索记忆的控制面板。默认的向量与排序模型需要一个硅基流动 API 密钥，目前只在 Linux 上实测。

description.en: Long-term memory written by the character itself. A sorting plugin watches the workspace and, once conversations have been quiet past a threshold, opens its own session to run the bundled extraction script and turn the recent exchanges into memory files; a heartbeat plugin later re-opens sessions on a probability curve that rises with the time since the last exchange, with quiet hours and a random delay. Ships the memory templates, the sorting guide and the extraction script. Needs Python 3.8+ with zstandard, plus manual setup after install (a preset with agent-instructions, templates copied into the workspace, defaultPreset/sortPreset set to real preset ids; a wrong id fails silently with one log line). Plugin-opened sessions run with full permissions by default. Tested on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 由角色自己写成的长期记忆。整理插件盯着工作区，会话静默超过阈值后自己开会话，跑包里的提取脚本，把最近的对话整理进记忆文件；心跳插件之后按概率曲线重新开会话，间隔越久概率越高，带静默时段和随机延迟。附记忆文件模板、整理流程和提取脚本。需要 Python 3.8+ 与 zstandard；装完还须手动配置（建带 agent-instructions 的模式、把模板/脚本复制进工作区、把 defaultPreset 与 sortPreset 改成真实模式 id，填错会静默失败、仅日志一行）；插件自开的会话默认全权限；仅在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 实测。

description.en: Adds local PDF reading, a durable paper library, traceable evidence records, and cross-paper comparison and synthesis tools.
description.zh: 提供本地 PDF 阅读、持久论文库、可追溯证据记录，以及跨论文比较与综合工具。

description.en: Registers the MathWorks MATLAB/Simulink MCP server into a dsh profile, so agent sessions get mcp__matlab__* tools for running MATLAB code and reading, editing and testing Simulink models.
description.zh: 把 MathWorks MATLAB/Simulink MCP 服务器注册进 dsh profile，让会话获得 mcp__matlab__* 工具，用于运行 MATLAB 代码以及读取、编辑与测试 Simulink 模型。

description.en: Redirects DSH downloads, artifacts, caches and temp files to user-specified drives (auto-picks the largest non-C drive), injects a path-discipline prompt into every session, and ships a disk_guard tool for status and cleanup — keeps the C: drive from filling up.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的下载、产物、缓存与临时文件重定向到用户指定目录（自动挑剩余空间最大的非 C 盘），向每个会话注入路径纪律提示词，并自带 disk_guard 工具做状态查看与清理——防止 C 盘被撑爆。

description.en: Scans 20+ AI agents on this machine (Codex, Claude Code, cc-switch, Hermes, opencode, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, CodeBuddy, Trae, OpenClaw, Qoder, WorkBuddy, Zcode, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, Qwen Code, ...) and one-click syncs, manages and adds their MCP servers and skills into DSH — global or per-workspace.
description.zh: 扫描本机 20+ 种 AI agent 的 MCP 服务器与 Skills（Codex、Claude Code、cc-switch、Hermes、opencode、Gemini、Grok、Kimi、CodeBuddy、Trae、OpenClaw、Qoder、WorkBuddy、Zcode、Cursor、Windsurf、Cline、Roo Code、Qwen Code 等），一键同步、管理并添加进 DSH（全局或按工作区）。

description.en: Law paper writing corpus for DeepSeek Harness: 850 bibliographic records from four CLSCI journals (2024-2026) with title, authors, abstract, keywords and outline, supporting BM25 search, framework cards, journal profiling, submission self-check and export.
description.zh: 法学论文框架语料库：内置 2024–2026 四本 CLSCI 期刊 850 篇题录（标题、作者、摘要、关键词、目录骨架），支持 BM25 检索、框架卡、期刊画像、投稿对标自查与导出。

description.en: Keep the built-in web_search tool without an official DeepSeek API key: disable web-search-deepseek and use Tavily keyless by default.
description.zh: 不用官方 DeepSeek API 也能用内置 web_search：关掉 web-search-deepseek，默认走 Tavily keyless。

description.en: Image previews for DSH sessions: read_image thumbnails plus user, assistant, Markdown and present images in a lightbox with zoom, rotate, pan, download, sidebar and native file actions.
description.zh: 统一接管 DSH 会话里的图片预览：read_image 缩略图，以及用户、助手、Markdown 和 present 图片，支持缩放、旋转、拖动、下载、侧栏和原生文件操作的 Lightbox。

description.en: Full-duplex voice mode for the Web UI: tap-to-toggle or hold-to-talk dictation (send key or `Ctrl`) with a live caption, host-side SenseVoice ASR via sherpa-onnx, sentence-by-sentence spoken replies, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). No API key.
description.zh: Web UI 全双工语音对话：点按切换或按住说话（发送键或 `Ctrl`）并显示实时字幕，宿主端 SenseVoice（sherpa-onnx）转写，回复按句流式朗读，开口说话即打断播放与正在运行的回合（真 barge-in），无需 API key。

description.en: Document reading mode for DSH.
description.zh: DSH 文档阅读模式。

description.en: Hook DeepSeek Harness into a Hermes pipeline: dispatch-spec template, model-tier routing, orchestrator-run quality gates, git single-writer rule, as a SKILL.md pack (bundle installable).
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接进 Hermes 管线：派单 spec 模板、模型档位路由、质量门、git 唯一写者约定，SKILL.md 技能包（bundle 可安装）。

description.en: Website cloning methodology skill: a real-source-first decision tree covering static sites, React/Vue/Next content sites and WebGL/Canvas-heavy fronts, mandatory verification of executable code quoted from second-hand AI analyses, and 13 zero-dependency Node scripts for CDP browser recon, asset/font harvesting, route crawling, sourcemap hunting and pixel-diff auditing.
description.zh: 网站复刻方法论 skill：以「真源码至上」决策树覆盖静态站、React/Vue/Next 内容站与 WebGL/Canvas 重前端站，强制核对二手 AI 分析里的可执行代码，内置 13 个零依赖 Node 脚本（CDP 浏览器侦察、素材/字体抓取、路由爬取、source map 挖掘、像素 diff 审计）。

description.en: AI companion skill for DeepSeek Harness: persona configuration (8 presets + custom), six-type long-term memory, emotion recognition and feedback, and multi-turn emotional conversation with tone post-processing. The skill body must be placed in the agent's skills directory (~/.dsh/skills/love-companion/SKILL.md), and the persona/memory pipeline runs on a local Python 3 (standard library only).
description.zh: AI 陪伴技能：人设配置（8 种预设 + 自定义）、六类长时记忆、情绪识别与反馈、多轮情感对话及语气后处理。技能本体需放进 Agent 技能目录（~/.dsh/skills/love-companion/SKILL.md）；人设/记忆管线依赖本机 Python 3（仅标准库）。

description.en: Registers six spec-driven + test-driven workflow skills for DeepSeek Harness: OpenSpec spec authoring fused with Superpowers TDD discipline into a Phase 0-4 pipeline with review gates. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 6 个 SDD+TDD 工作流技能：把 OpenSpec 规格编写与 Superpowers 测试驱动纪律衔接为带审查 Gate 的 Phase 0-4 流水线，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Multi-lens structural analysis skill: adversarial-first analysis across 16 lenses in 4 categories with 10 structural tools, confidence calibration, and fact-bound layered output.
description.zh: 多视角深层结构分析技能：16 透镜 4 类别、10 个结构工具，先攻击默认立场，产出置信度校准、事实绑定的分层结论。

description.en: Browse the public skillhub.cn catalog from Settings and install selected SKILL.md bundles into ~/.dsh/skills.
description.zh: 在设置页浏览 skillhub.cn 公开技能目录，并将选中的 SKILL.md 技能包安装到 ~/.dsh/skills。

description.en: Auto-injects user-chosen skills into DSH sessions, either every prompt or once at session start, with a settings page and a composer indicator.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中自动注入所选技能（如 caveman、ponytail）：每轮提示或仅在会话开始时，含设置页与输入区指示。

description.en: Deep-reading workflow for books: import EPUB/Markdown/TXT/PDF into chapters, read one chapter per subagent so the source text never enters the main session, keep \[n]-anchored chapter memories for cross-session continuation, and export notes or an EPUB.
description.zh: 读书工作流：导入 EPUB/Markdown/TXT/PDF 拆章，逐章由子任务精读（原文不进主会话），保存带 \[n] 定位的章节记忆、支持跨会话续读，可导出笔记或 EPUB。

description.en: Luna preset for DeepSeek Harness — a little-demon persona on the full standard tool set, composed by six deterministic rule layers (perception, understanding, state, style, regulation, memory) plus a derived vitals layer, with a gated, suppressible cross-session memory file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的露娜预设：小恶魔人设配完整的 standard 工具面，由感知、理解、状态、表达、调节、记忆六层确定性规则驱动，外加生理派生层；跨会话记忆写入经证据门控，遗忘用抑制而非删除。

description.en: Git panel for the DSH web GUI with a commit graph, branch filters, working-tree status, per-commit diffs, stash, merge-conflict handling, remote sync and repository settings.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Git 面板：提交图与分支筛选、工作区状态、单提交 diff、暂存、合并冲突处理、远程同步与仓库设置。

description.en: Pin Git commits to the environment's own author identity; env-var injection overrides all `git config` settings.
description.zh: git 提交固定使用环境自身作者身份，环境变量注入压过一切 `git config` 设置。

description.en: AtomGit plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness: six built-in AtomGit skills (plan issues, implement issues, review PRs, merge PRs, publish CLI releases, mirror to GitHub) plus ag CLI integration and platform-hosted MCP tools for repos, branches, issues, PRs, and search.
description.zh: AtomGit 插件包：内置六个 AtomGit 技能（Issue 规划、Issue 实现、PR 审查、PR 合并、CLI 版本发布、GitHub 镜像），并集成 ag CLI 与平台托管的 MCP 工具（仓库/分支/Issue/PR/搜索）。

description.en: SVN (Subversion) toolset for DeepSeek Harness: 33 agent tools (status, diff, log, blame, commit, merge, props, lock, changelist...) plus a sidebar panel with side-by-side BASE/working-copy diff, conflict resolution and AI commit logs.
description.zh: SVN（Subversion）工具集：33 个 agent 工具（status/diff/log/blame/commit/merge/props/lock/changelist 等），以及带 BASE/工作副本左右对比、冲突解决与 AI 提交日志的侧边栏面板。

description.en: Bidirectional Lark/Feishu controller for DeepSeek Harness with project and session routing, interactive cards, approvals, attachments, and task controls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 双向控制器，支持 Project 与 Session 路由、交互卡片、审批、附件和任务控制。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for the DSH Web UI: desktop shortcut, silent start, system tray with open/full-exit (stop service, close app window, quit tray), PWA app window with focus-instead-of-relaunch, install prompt, and task-completion notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面化启动器：桌面快捷方式、静默启动、系统托盘（打开 / 彻底退出＝停服务＋关应用窗口＋退托盘）、PWA 应用窗口（已运行则聚焦不重复弹窗）、安装引导、任务完成通知。

description.en: Humanized fork of @xmanrui/dsh-im (base 4.21.2): humanized message delivery with send-delay and typing two-phase, message_break + streaming coexistence, status reactions, reply quotes, per-bot humanize overrides, and a no_reply reclaim tool — across WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Telegram, Slack and WhatsApp channels.
description.zh: @xmanrui/dsh-im 的拟人化分支（基于上游 4.21.2）：人化消息发送（发送延迟 + 输入中两阶段）、message_break 与 streaming 共存、状态表情、回复引用、per-bot 全量拟人化覆盖、no_reply 回收工具，覆盖微信/飞书/钉钉/企业微信/QQ/Telegram/Slack/WhatsApp 全通道。

description.en: Per-event sound alerts and system notifications for DeepSeek Harness. Four events — turn complete, question, approval and error — each get a switch, a sound picker with instant preview and a system-notification master switch. Twelve built-in tones plus a silent option are synthesized at runtime with the Web Audio API, so no audio files ship with the package; the four per-event defaults differ in register, timbre and rhythm (a high sine strike, a rising triangle pair, a repeated square pulse and a low sawtooth descent) so they are distinguishable without comparing pitches. A mode dropdown in General settings offers on, off and a smart mode that defers to the whale widget so the two never double up; the same row has a preview button and a gear opening a full settings dialog with volume, a skip-while-focused option and upload of your own audio up to 2 MB. A speaker button in the composer mutes sound without touching notifications. Works in the web GUI and the Electron desktop app.
description.zh: DSH 逐事件提醒插件：任务完成 / 需要回答 / 需要授权 / 运行出错四类事件，各配一个开关、一个可即时试听的声音选择和一个系统通知总开关。内置 12 种音色与 1 项静音，全部用 Web Audio 实时合成，不随包分发任何音频文件；四个默认音在音区、音色与节奏上互不相同（高音正弦单响、三角波上行两音、方波同音三连、锯齿低音下坠），不必对比音高也能分辨。通用设置那一行提供模式下拉（开启提醒 / 关闭提醒 / 智能判断，智能模式让开鲸鱼挂件已提醒的事件，避免重复），旁边有试听按钮与打开完整设置弹窗的齿轮；弹窗内含音量、前台运行时不提醒，以及上传自定义音频（单个不超过 2MB）。对话输入框左下角的喇叭可临时静音声音而不影响系统通知。网页端与桌面端（Electron）均可用。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: forwards agent questions (with inline buttons), tool approval requests, turn summaries and subagent messages to a Telegram bot, and takes the answer from Telegram or the DSH Web UI, whichever comes first. Ships a loopback control panel; host-only, no client UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥：把代理提问（带内联按钮）、工具审批请求、回合摘要和子代理消息转发到 Telegram 机器人，答案可从 Telegram 或 DSH Web 界面给出，以先到者为准。自带本地控制面板，纯宿主插件，不含前端界面。

description.en: Native desktop and webhook notifications for turn completions, failures, and approval requests, with outcome filters, content rules, privacy controls, and retrying delivery.
description.zh: 回合完成、失败和待审批时发送跨平台本机通知与 Webhook，支持结果过滤、内容规则、隐私控制和失败重试。

description.en: Feishu meeting reminder: a dsh-plugin which has only side effect: reminding you, mid-flow with AI, that you "have to go meet carbon-based lifeforms".
description.zh: 飞书会议提醒：一个只有副作用的 dsh-plugin，在你跟 AI 聊得神魂颠倒时提醒你「不得不去跟碳基生命开会了」。

description.en: Environment housekeeper for the agent: toolchain inventory (node/pnpm/git/gh/ffmpeg/browsers), scratch/cache scan with whitelist-guarded one-click cleanup, and the machine rules file (AGENTS.md) editor - all in the Web GUI settings.
description.zh: agent 的环境管家：工具链台账（node/pnpm/git/gh/ffmpeg/浏览器）、缓存与临时目录扫描 + 白名单安全一键清理、机器规则（AGENTS.md）编辑，全在 Web GUI 设置面板。

description.en: Static codebase analysis for onboarding: scans a project, builds a dependency graph, and writes evidence-cited architecture, module, key-flow and getting-started docs, plus project-level Q&A over a local retrieval index (no network or LLM by default; LLM narrative is optional and off unless enabled).
description.zh: 项目罗盘 — 静态扫描代码库并构建依赖图，生成带 path:line 证据引用的架构、模块、调用链与上手指南，并基于本地检索索引提供项目级问答（默认不联网、不调用 LLM，LLM 叙事为可选项，需手动开启）。

description.en: Zero-dependency static and sandbox smoke detector for DSH plugins: package-structure gates, cordis contract scans, keyless headless smoke, and ecosystem-listing checks.
description.zh: 零依赖的 DSH 插件静态检查与沙箱冒烟检测器：包结构门禁、cordis 契约扫描、无密钥无头冒烟，以及生态收录校验。

description.en: Make your dsh ready for serious coding. (Tools x Schemas)^REPL. `skill://`, `ctx://`, `agent://`, `dvc://`, `dsh://`, IPython REPL, Context as Variables, cross compactions recallable, full context revive. `hash-edit`, `dvc://browser`, subagent as function, workflow as function.
description.zh: 能胜任严肃编程任务的 dsh。（Tools x Schemas）^REPL。`skill://`，`ctx://`，`agent://`，`dvc://`，`dsh://`，IPython REPL，Context as Variables，抗压缩可回溯、完整上下文重构。`hash-edit`、`dvc://browser`、subagent as function、workflow as function。

description.en: Browse, search, delete, undo-delete, and update user skills from the Web settings panel; checks GitHub/Gitee Releases for newer skill versions.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板中浏览、搜索、删除/撤回并更新用户技能，支持从 GitHub/Gitee Release 检查技能更新。

description.en: Adds an Auto Approve permission preset to the Web UI, using a fresh restricted Reviewer Agent to allow or deny each approval request.
description.zh: 为 WebUI 增加 Auto Approve 权限档位，由全新且受限的审查 Agent 逐次允许或拒绝审批请求。

description.en: LAN mobile gateway: isolated child-process reverse proxy with first-visit approval, per-device token binding, rate limiting, and mobile layout injection (compact composer pills, randomUUID polyfill).
description.zh: 局域网手机访问网关：独立子进程反向代理 + 首次访问审批 + 设备令牌绑定 + 限流 + 手机端紧凑排版注入（输入区权限/模型小胶囊、randomUUID polyfill）。

description.en: Secure remote access for the official Web UI: authenticated LAN/tunnel gateway with QR + HMAC one-time pairing, per-device sessions and revocation, mDNS discovery, and a fork_session tool.
description.zh: 官方 Web UI 的安全远程接入：带认证的局域网/隧道网关，QR + HMAC 一次性配对、按设备吊销，mDNS 发现，附 fork_session 会话分叉工具。

description.en: Requires the phone app, not just this plugin: the phone half is a separate APK and must be installed first — download it from https://github.com/Zoragyx/dsh-phone-pair/releases — otherwise the computer side has nothing to pair with. This package is the computer half: it enables the upstream remote-web-ui pairing plugin with a Cloudflare quick tunnel and a fixed relay subdomain, so one scan keeps the phone connected from anywhere.
description.zh: 需要先装手机端 App，光装这个插件没用：手机那一半是单独的 APK，必须先安装——下载地址 https://github.com/Zoragyx/dsh-phone-pair/releases ——否则电脑端装好了也没得配。本包是电脑那一半：开启上游远程访问插件、Cloudflare 快速隧道与固定中继域名，扫一次码之后在外面也能连回来。

description.en: Manage Git-backed DSH plugin markets, installed agent skills and optional Codex hooks from the web settings page.
description.zh: 在网页设置页管理基于 Git 的 DSH 插件市场、已安装的 agent 技能和可选 Codex hooks。

description.en: Browse Xiaoheihe posts on a schedule, with optional persona-based comments and replies, QR login, and browsing history.
description.zh: 定时浏览小黑盒帖子，支持可选的人格评论与回复、扫码登录和浏览历史。

description.en: Codex-style desktop pet: a floating animated sprite in the corner that mirrors the agent's running state (working, waiting, failed, done).
description.zh: Codex 风格桌面宠物：右下角悬浮动画精灵，随 agent 运行状态实时变化（工作、等待、报错、完成）。

description.en: Cristiano Ronaldo desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: a chibi Portugal number 7 mascot in a bottom-right overlay whose animation follows the agent state — dribbling while tools run, thinking during a turn, waiting at approvals, diving on errors — and jumping in a SIU celebration with a host-process sound when a turn completes; it can be dragged, looks at the cursor on hover, dives on a triple click, and a settings panel manages several pets and imports custom spritesheets. It also runs as a borderless, always-on-top native Windows window that keeps living after the browser is closed: hovering shows the current workspace and conversation title, double-clicking opens the Harness page in Edge, and dragging, mouse-wheel resizing and a right-click menu work there too, sharing position, size and behaviour with the web panel. Pet sheets may use any cell resolution and scale preserving aspect ratio (atlas.scaling: smooth | pixelated). v2.2 adds a video route — feed it a clip (green screen or ordinary footage) and its real motion becomes the pet animations, via automatic backdrop sampling, chroma keying with spill suppression, motion-based segment splitting and union-bbox alignment; already-extracted PNG frames work too, with no video decoder installed, and the clip audio can be cut into per-action sounds. Pets can also be published to the community gallery under the DPSL-1.0 sharing declaration, and installed from it in one click. v2.3 adapts it to DSH 0.2 desktop clients — the celebration sound now falls back to spawning PowerShell when the host no longer provides the shell service — and makes a single click play a short, configurable taunt animation (`interactions.clickAnim`).
description.zh: DSH 桌宠：Web 界面右下角的 C 罗精灵，动画随 Agent 状态切换——工具执行中颠球、回合中思考、等待审批、出错假摔——回合完成时跳起 SIU 庆祝并由宿主进程播放提示音；支持拖动、悬停注视光标、连点三次假摔，设置面板可管理多只宠物并导入自定义 spritesheet。同时提供一个无边框、始终置顶的原生 Windows 窗口，关掉浏览器也还在：悬停显示当前工作区与对话名，双击用 Edge 打开 Harness 页面，拖动、滚轮改大小、右键菜单都可用，位置/大小/行为与网页设置面板共用同一份状态。素材单格分辨率不限、等比缩放（atlas.scaling: smooth | pixelated）。v2.2 新增视频路线：喂一段视频（绿幕或普通素材都行），里面的真实动作直接变成宠物动作——自动取幕布色、色度抠像带溢色抑制、按运动量切分动作、并集包围盒对齐落格；也支持直接喂已经抽好的 PNG 帧（不需要装视频解码器），并能把视频原声按动作切成音效。宠物还可按 DPSL-1.0 分享协议发布到宠物社区，并从社区一键安装。 v2.3 适配 DSH 0.2 桌面版——宿主不再提供 shell 服务时，庆祝音效改为直接启动 PowerShell 播放——并让单击播放一段可配置的挑衅动作（`interactions.clickAnim`）。

description.en: Digimon-style raising game: hatch an egg that feeds on real work (turns, tool calls, errors) and evolves along four branching lines shaped by how you work; zero tokens, invisible to the model.
description.zh: 数码宝贝式养成：孵一颗吃真实工作长大的蛋（回合、工具调用、报错都是营养），按你的工作方式走四条进化分支；零 token，模型完全看不见。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration preset: a lead agent dispatches subagents from a built-in role roster over separate read and write lane pools with per-role model binding, and collects each subagent report on a shared board; adds go_work/continue/need_help/forward tools, a tree-view panel and a settings page.
description.zh: 多智能体编排预设：主编（Sisyphus）调度 + 内置工种名册 + 报告落板；读/写双泳道池化编排、按工种绑定模型，含 go_work/continue/need_help/forward 通信，以及 Web UI 树状图面板与设置页。

description.en: Edge breathing border showing DeepSeek peak/valley hours, with flowing light and scheduled push reminders.
description.zh: DeepSeek 峰谷提醒：贴屏呼吸边框（高峰橙/低峰蓝）、流光效果与消息推送提醒。

description.en: Vault button beside the DSH composer: save keys, servers, phone numbers, addresses and URLs, auto-collected from conversations, password-protected with WebDAV backup; click to insert, Ctrl+click to send.
description.zh: 输入栏旁的保险箱按钮：保存密钥、服务器、手机号、地址与网址，自动识别会话中的敏感信息提醒收录，密码保护并支持 WebDAV 备份；点击填入输入框，Ctrl+点击直接发送。

description.en: Adds searchable filtering to the model selector by provider, model name, and model ID; spaces act as wildcards.
description.zh: 为模型选择器增加按提供方、模型名称和模型 ID 搜索的筛选框，空格表示任意字符。

description.en: Coding workbench for DSH: docked workspace panels, a grouped project sidebar, split editor tab groups with hibernate/resume, file preview and diff views — built on parallel git worktree development with cross-session collaboration primitives.
description.zh: coding 工作台：停靠式工作区面板、项目分组侧栏、可休眠/恢复的分栏编辑器 TAB 组、文件预览与 DIFF 查看，以 git worktree 并行开发与跨会话协作为地基。

description.en: File-drag fork: drop documents as removable chips above the composer, send without typing.
description.zh: 拖放 fork：文档以可删除「文件芯片」挂在输入框上方，不打字也能发送。

description.en: Watches a turn for long silences and, once the threshold passes, injects a user message asking the model to state in prose what it is doing before carrying on, so the turn keeps going. The same text is mirrored in a lower-left overlay above the composer. The silence threshold and the minimum gap between reports are set in minutes, the prompt can be replaced wholesale, and it runs with no runtime dependencies. Requires DSH 0.2.1+ and Node.js 18+.
description.zh: 盯着回合里的长时间沉默：超过阈值就注入一条用户消息，让模型先用正文说清正在做什么、做到哪了再接着干，回合不中断。这段原文同步显示在输入框上方的左下角浮窗。静默阈值与两次汇报的最小间隔都在设置卡里按分钟调，提示词可整段替换，零运行时依赖。需 DSH 0.2.1+ 与 Node.js 18+。

description.en: Use DeepSeek's web chat inside DSH: real chat history in the leftmost sidebar, a Chat/Work switch beside the agent mode, plus streaming answers, thinking, web search and file uploads.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 DeepSeek 网页版对话：最左侧边栏显示真实聊天记录，Agent 模式旁提供 Chat/Work 切换，支持流式回答、深度思考、网页搜索和文件上传。

description.en: Turbo Vision-style character-cell window manager for dsh agents: overlapping framed windows with drop shadows, a Borland menu bar, a function-key strip, mouse drag and resize, approvals as modal dialogs, and five skins including the classic Borland blue.
description.zh: Turbo Vision 式字符窗口管理器：带投影的重叠窗口、Borland 菜单栏、功能键提示条、鼠标拖拽缩放、模态审批对话框，五套皮肤含经典 Borland 蓝。

description.en: Select text in a conversation to ask a context-free side question in a floating card, and browse every question as a network graph.
description.zh: 在对话里选中文字横向追问（空上下文的浮卡），所有追问连成一张可浏览的网状图，支持导出 PNG。

description.en: Mobile-first DeepSeek Harness UI with an installable PWA, responsive navigation, and Web Push notifications when an agent completes successfully.
description.zh: 面向手机的 DeepSeek Harness 界面，提供可安装 PWA、响应式导航，以及 Agent 成功完成时的 Web Push 通知。

description.en: Draggable grid-aligned workbench of 28 mini-cards in the margins of the conversation (API balance, token usage, cost, context pressure, todos, goal, usage heatmap, GitHub repo, image relay), with S/M/L/XL size tiers.
description.zh: 对话两侧空白区的可拖动卡片工作台，28 个小组件（余额、Token 用量、成本、上下文压力、待办、目标、用量热力图、GitHub 仓库、图片中转等），支持 S/M/L/XL 四档尺寸。

description.en: Restart button at the right end of the session header that restarts the whole client: the Windows desktop app (Electron shell and Host, through the Host's own graceful shutdown) or the dsh web server. It can wait until running turns and background jobs finish, reopens the open session afterwards with one-click continue for interrupted sessions, flags plugin updates that only take effect after a restart, and shows Host uptime and memory on hover.
description.zh: 会话标题栏右端的重启按钮，可重启整个客户端：Windows 桌面版（Electron 外壳与 Host，走 Host 自身的优雅关闭流程）或 dsh web 服务。可等正在运行的回合与后台作业结束后再重启；重启后回到原会话，被中断的会话可一键继续；提示需重启才生效的插件更新；悬停显示 Host 运行时长与内存。

description.en: Floating Bilibili video mini-player for DSH — always-on-top window with discover/search/follow-UP channels, auto-playlist, mini & focus modes, persisted watch history and window minimize-to-ball.
description.zh: DSH 里的 B站悬浮看片小窗：置顶窗口，含推荐/热门/排行/精选/关注/AI 频道与搜索，自动连播、迷你专注模式、历史持久化与最小化悬浮球。

description.en: Full-pipeline Chinese translation for the dsh web GUI: live translation of the model reasoning as it streams, in-place Chinese below each English reply, and one-line Chinese summaries for tool outputs and tool-call glosses — a standalone provider request that never enters the session transcript.
description.zh: dsh 网页端全链路中文翻译：思考过程实时翻译、英文回复就地中文、工具输出中文摘要与工具调用注释；翻译为独立提供方请求，不进入会话上下文。

description.en: Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts for the Web UI: 34 pre-registered features (sessions, views, clipboard, models, silent permission cycling, settings), one-click recording to bind your own, and a shortcut cheatsheet with built-in diagnostics.
description.zh: Web UI 可自定义键盘快捷键：34 个预置功能（会话、视图、剪贴板、模型、静默权限切换、设置），一键录制自定义组合键，内置快捷键速查表与诊断面板。

description.en: Model sampling sliders (temperature / maxTokens) in the composer: override every model request for all providers via the agent/request hook, with hot/persist modes.
description.zh: 对话输入区的模型采样滑杆（temperature / maxTokens）：通过 agent/request 钩子对所有供应商的每次请求生效，支持热调/持久化两种模式。

description.en: Adds a Compact context button and a New session button to the context meter panel; compact submits /compact through the same command channel, and new session starts a fresh session in the same workspace.
description.zh: 在上下文计量面板中添加「压缩上下文」与「新建会话」两个按钮：压缩按钮通过与手敲 /compact 相同的通道提交命令，新建会话按钮在同一 workspace 中开启新会话。

description.en: VS Code-style workspace keyword search tab for dsh-better-sidebar: matches file names and content, grouped by file with line numbers, opens in the sidebar editor.
description.zh: VS Code 式工作区关键词搜索 Tab（better-sidebar 扩展）：同时匹配文件名与文件内容，结果按文件分组带行号，点击在侧栏编辑器打开。

description.en: Adds a draggable, position-persisted chip bar of configurable quick phrases to DeepSeek Harness, plus a /-triggered phrase menu with per-phrase pin, slash-menu, bar-visibility, and click-to-send toggles.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加可拖拽、位置会记住的快捷短语条，以及 `/` 触发的短语菜单；每条短语可单独设置置顶、斜杠菜单、是否上条和点击即发送。

description.en: Activity heatmap in the DSH Web sidebar: GitHub-style grid of daily commits, token usage, and estimated spend, with a today stats line for all-session token totals, cache hit rate, and per-model auto-priced cost.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏活动热力图：GitHub 风格网格展示每日提交、Token 用量与估算花费，今日统计行显示全会话 Token 总量、缓存命中率与按模型自动计价的花费。

description.en: OpenCode Go quota ring: click-to-cycle progress ring (5h/weekly/monthly) left of the model selector, colored by urgency, with reset countdowns on hover.
description.zh: 模型选择器左侧的 OpenCode Go 额度圆环：点击循环切换 5 小时/每周/每月用量窗口，按紧急程度着色（绿/蓝/橙/红），悬停显示百分比与重置倒计时。

description.en: Cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates model input/output/cache tokens across all local sessions, prices them with a builtin table (including DeepSeek peak/off-peak), and shows daily trends plus per-model and per-session tables.
description.zh: 费用看板：汇总本机全部会话的模型输入/输出/缓存 token，按内置价格表计费（含 DeepSeek 峰谷），展示每日趋势与按模型/会话明细。

description.en: Per-turn TPS and TTFT statistics for DeepSeek Harness: model time, tool time, time-to-first-token, and output speed per turn.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供每轮 TPS/TTFT 统计：模型耗时、工具耗时、首 token 延迟、输出速度。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance and 24-hour usage dashboard in Settings, with estimated spend, token counts, request counts, and an hourly timeline.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 DeepSeek API 余额与最近 24 小时用量，包括估算消费、Token、请求次数和按小时时间线。

description.en: Plan-usage pet for the DSH web GUI: a floating skeletal-animated character reports quota in a speech bubble, auto-matching the configured provider (OpenCode Go, Command Code, DeepSeek) to show a plan percentage or an account balance, and falling back to local token stats when the provider API is unavailable; draggable, wheel-scalable (90-260px), synthesized click sounds, loopback-only routes.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的桌宠用量小窗：悬浮的骨骼动画角色用气泡报出套餐用量，按 DSH 里配置的 provider 自动匹配（OpenCode Go / Command Code / DeepSeek 官方），套餐制显示百分比、按量计费显示余额，取不到官方数字时降级为本地 token 统计；可拖动、滚轮缩放（90–260px），音效现场合成，HTTP 路由只开 loopback。

description.en: Neo-brutalism skin with two switchable schemes (Blue Command / Aged Newspaper), hard shadows, sharp corners, and light/dark theme support.
description.zh: 新粗野主义换肤皮肤：双方案（蓝统治 / 做旧报纸）随时切换，硬阴影 + 直角 + 2px 边框结构层，浅色/深色自适应。

description.en: Sword Art Online theme with two Link Start animations and Kirito/Asuna voices; full or startup-only mode with a true-alpha white-background transition into the loaded interface; independent light/dark accents and surface colours, local fonts, fully themed settings and clear control states; improved liquid-glass edge refraction and directional reflections with reduced white halos, or frosted glass; popovers sample the current page and only refract visible wallpaper; per-component transparency, continuous sidebar/context glass, compact tabs and single-line status readouts; nine wallpapers, local images or 4K/5K looping video with power-saving mode; model reasoning-intensity slider.
description.zh: 刀剑神域主题：双 Link Start 启动动画与桐人／亚丝娜语音，可选全部功能或仅限启动动画，启动白底以真实透明通道自然透出已加载界面；明暗主题色独立记忆、界面底色与本机字体、完整设置主题与清晰控件状态；液态玻璃边缘折射与方向反光，减轻整圈泛白，亦可选磨砂；浮层跟随当前页面取景，仅折射实际可见壁纸；分组件透明度、连续右栏与上下文玻璃、紧凑标签与单行读数；九张壁纸、本地图片或 4K／5K 循环视频及静态省电；模型思考强度滑条。

description.en: DSH Web background settings: upload a local image or pick a preset ambiance, with live preview and persistent settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 设置背景：上传本地图片或选择预设氛围，实时预览且设置持久化。

description.en: Fills missing context window, max tokens, thinking levels, and image input on custom DSH models from models.dev, and lists unmatched models for manual edits.
description.zh: 按模型名从 models.dev 补全自定义模型缺失的上下文、输出上限、思考档位和图片能力，并列出未匹配模型供手改。

description.en: Model failover and turn keep-alive for DeepSeek Harness: a request that fails with a model error before any visible output falls through the models of the configured provider groups (then the next provider) until one streams; transient failures retry with backoff under a liveness watchdog, a dead turn self-resumes with templated 「继续」 wake-ups, and an optional full-auto mode auto-answers permission, question and plan approvals with every decision appended to an AUTO-MODE.md audit log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 模型故障自动回退与轮次保活：请求在产出任何可见内容前因模型错误失败时，沿所选供应商分组的模型（再到下一个供应商）逐个切换直到流式成功；瞬态失败按指数退避自动重试并有活性看门狗防假死，整轮任务失败后自动发送模板化「继续」唤醒续跑；可选全自动模式自动应答权限审批、确认提问与方案评审，每次自动决策追加到 AUTO-MODE.md 审计日志。

description.en: Calls your own chat.deepseek.com account as a second model from DSH: ask a question, analyze a file's line range, and check login state, plus a runtime skill and a settings-page login panel.
description.zh: 把你自己的 chat.deepseek.com 账号当作第二个模型接入 DSH：提问、按文件行区间分析、查看登录状态，附带运行时技能与设置页登录面板。

description.en: Render local image paths from assistant replies inline in the message body (9 formats, click-to-zoom lightbox, adjustable size).
description.zh: 对话内联图片：LLM 回复中输出的本地图片路径在消息正文直接渲染为图片（9 种格式、点击放大灯箱、可调尺寸）。

description.en: Take over the system input shortcuts for the chat input box and configure behavior independently for each shortcut.
description.zh: 接管聊天输入框的回车等快捷键，每个快捷键的行为都能单独配置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages archived sessions and the trash from the settings panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 存档会话管理插件：在设置面板管理归档会话（恢复/删除）与回收站。

description.en: Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.
description.zh: 跨会话消息：本机任意会话都可像 Claude Code 一样列出并互发消息，基于本地心跳注册表与收件箱。

description.en: Piano-key style in-conversation navigation bar: one key per user message, hover preview tooltip, click-to-jump across full history. Official dual-face dsh plugin, no dsh source changes.
description.zh: 钢琴键风格的会话内导航条：每根键对应一条用户消息，悬停预览、点击跳转到完整历史的任意消息。官方双面 dsh 插件，不改 DSH 源码。

description.en: Search, list and read past and current sessions through the harness's own `sessionQuery` service: uses the SQLite FTS5 index where a deployment enables it, and falls back to a bounded newest-first scan where it does not.
description.zh: 通过 harness 自带的 `sessionQuery` 服务搜索、列出、读取历史与当前会话：部署启用了 SQLite FTS5 索引时走索引，未启用时回退到有上限的倒序扫描。

description.en: Shows a DSH session as a conversation canvas — every turn is a node, any turn forks a real child session, and a compacted context folds into one green node you can keep talking from; the left rail groups canvases by DSH workspace and renames them in step with the session titles.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话画成一张对话画布：每轮问答是一个节点，任意节点都能分叉出真实的子会话，压缩过的上下文收成一个绿色节点、可以从它继续对话；左侧栏按 DSH 工作区分组列出画布，重命名与 DSH 自己的会话标题同步。

description.en: Session handoff & context management: structured handoff documents (export/resume/status) so a fresh session can continue seamlessly, plus active context pruning (acp_* tools via the official compaction API with model-authored summaries).
description.zh: 会话交接与上下文管理：导出/恢复结构化交接文档，让新会话无缝续接；并集成了主动上下文裁剪（acp_* 工具，基于官方 compaction API 与模型自写摘要）。

description.en: WeChat Official Account source collector: QR-login credential profiles, rate-limit-safe crawling with cooldown, RSS second water source, and secret-safe handoff to ContentStudio.
description.zh: 公众号素材采集：扫码登录的多套凭证档案、带冷却保护的限流安全抓取、RSS 第二水源，以及凭证隔离的 ContentStudio 来源卡交接。

description.en: Claude Code-style shell integration: /! for single-command analysis and /terminal for interactive PTY sessions with on-demand history reference.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格的 shell 集成：/! 单命令分析 与 /terminal 交互式终端（带按需历史引用）。

description.en: Agnes AI image and video generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Agnes AI 生图生视频插件。

description.en: Descriptive statistics, percentiles, frequency distributions, and correlation.
description.zh: 描述统计/百分位数/频数分布/相关性。

description.en: TickTick (Dida365) task bridge: a session-header task panel and curated agent tools over the official TickTick MCP endpoint.
description.zh: TickTick（滴答清单）任务桥：会话页头部任务面板与精选代理工具，走官方 TickTick MCP 端点。

description.en: ADB device & bench operations for DSH: device discovery, structured logcat (background streaming), apk install, file pull/push, and dumpsys performance snapshots.
description.zh: ADB 设备·台架运维工具集：设备发现、结构化 logcat（后台采集）、apk 安装、文件 pull/push、性能快照。

description.en: Novel-writing console for DSH: five novel_* tools for the agent (list, read, context, save chapter, cast) plus a side panel with a book wizard, a cast/relation view and streaming chapter continuation.
description.zh: 小说创作台：5 个 novel_* 工具（列目录、读文件、取上下文、存章节、管角色），外加侧栏开书向导、人物关系图与流式续写。

description.en: Game asset production pipeline: generate images, video and audio, turn a video into a coherent sprite animation, derive recoloured variants, adapt assets to an engine schema, install them into the project and verify the code actually references them. Requires ffmpeg for the video-to-sprite path, and an image/video API key (Agnes AI / OpenAI / fal) for generation.
description.zh: 游戏素材生产流水线：出图、生视频与音频，把一段视频变成连贯的精灵动画，派生配色变体，适配引擎配置，装进项目并核对代码是否真的引用了。视频转精灵动画需 ffmpeg；出图/生视频需自备图像/视频 API Key（Agnes AI / OpenAI / fal）。

description.en: Exact-profile control of your real logged-in Chrome browser: an MCP server plus MV3 extension and authenticated localhost bridge for tabs, locators, file injection, media export, and durable scroll capture, with no debug profile or remote-debugging port.
description.zh: 按精确 Profile 名控制你真实已登录的 Chrome 浏览器：MCP 服务器 + MV3 扩展 + 认证本地桥接，提供标签页、定位器、文件注入、媒体导出与持久滚动采集，不使用调试 Profile 或远程调试端口。

description.en: Ultra-lightweight Moli (Rust headless browser) web-fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness: renders complex SPAs, micro-frontends, and dynamic pages with ~60MB memory.
description.zh: 基于超轻量 Rust 无头浏览器 Moli 的 web_fetch 提供方：专为微前端与复杂 SPA 渲染设计，内存占用仅约 60MB。

description.en: Detect and download media from Bilibili/YouTube/Douyin/Xiaohongshu with quality and format analysis.
description.zh: 检测并下载 B站/YouTube/抖音/小红书视频媒体，带清晰度与格式分析。

description.en: MiniMax-powered multimodal plugin: real-time voice call mode (streaming conversation, floating dock UI), voice mode and mic voice input, plus image/video/music/speech generation and vision inspection tools.
description.zh: 基于 MiniMax 的多模态插件：实时语音通话模式（流式对话、悬浮胶囊 UI）、语音模式与麦克风语音输入，并提供图像/视频/音乐/语音生成与视觉检查工具。

description.en: Mic button in the composer tool row: Web Speech API speech-to-text (Chrome/Edge), language switching, and optional auto-send, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 输入框麦克风语音输入：浏览器 Web Speech API 实时转写（Chrome/Edge），多语言切换与可选自动发送，零依赖零密钥。

description.en: OMX-style workflow skills for DeepSeek Harness: deep-interview, ralplan, ralph, autopilot, team, code-review, visual-ralph, canslim-trader and 17 more, with autopilot defaulting to agent-team collaboration (Agent Teams), rewritten on native DSH tools including vision-backed UI matching.
description.zh: OMX 风格工作流技能集：deep-interview、ralplan、ralph、autopilot、team、code-review、visual-ralph、canslim-trader 等 25 个技能，autopilot 默认组队（Agent Teams），基于 DSH 原生工具重写，含视觉支持（参考图/基线 UI 对齐）。

description.en: Injects a per-turn skill-selection preface chosen by the local JEV model of the jev-decision-kit workspace, so the agent loads exactly those skills instead of browsing. Requires a separately set-up jev-decision-kit workspace (Python .venv, host/preface_worker.py, models/jev/head.json); without it the plugin injects nothing.
description.zh: 每轮对话前用本机 JEV 模型选好技能，把一行选择结果作为前言注入，让智能体只加载该加载的技能。需另行准备好 jev-decision-kit 工作区（Python .venv、host/preface_worker.py、models/jev/head.json）；没有它插件不会注入任何内容。

description.en: AI fortune-telling skill for DeepSeek Harness: feng shui, face reading, BaZi, zodiac, daily divination and Chinese almanac.
description.zh: AI玄学助手技能：风水、面相、八字、星座、每日一卦与老黄历。

description.en: Registers Epic's Unreal Engine skills (unreal-mcp, create-toolset, unreal-skill), injects Unreal project context, and connects the editor's ModelContextProtocol server with a port form on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 注册 Epic 的 Unreal Engine 三个技能（unreal-mcp、create-toolset、unreal-skill），注入 UE 工程上下文，接通编辑器的 ModelContextProtocol 服务器，并支持在插件页修改端口。

description.en: SHOPLINE AI Toolkit: bridges the official SHOPLINE Developer MCP server and ships seven SHOPLINE agent skills (Admin REST, GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks, Sline) — the SHOPLINE counterpart of the Shopify AI Toolkit.
description.zh: SHOPLINE AI 工具包：接入 SHOPLINE 官方开发者 MCP 服务器，内置七个 SHOPLINE 平台技能（Admin REST、GraphQL、OAuth、Webhook、Sline），是 Shopify AI Toolkit 的 SHOPLINE 对应版。

description.en: Math Agent Framework for DeepSeek Harness: symbolic derivation engine (CES / quadratic forms / ODE / PDE), SymPy verification, Lean 4 compiler-verified formal proofs, and QED-style multi-agent adversarial verification, exposed as native DSH tools through a TS shell bridging a Python engine. Requires cloning the math-agent-framework repo and `pip install -r requirements.txt`, with MATH_AGENT_HOME pointing at the repo root. Every result carries provenance (engine versions, seed, tolerances) and is marked untrusted data.
description.zh: 数学 Agent 框架接入 DeepSeek Harness：符号推导引擎（CES/二次型/ODE/PDE）、SymPy 验证、Lean 4 真编译验证的形式化证明、QED 多 Agent 对抗验证，经 TS 壳桥接 Python 引擎暴露为 DSH 原生工具。需先克隆 math-agent-framework 仓库并 `pip install -r requirements.txt`，将 MATH_AGENT_HOME 指向仓库根目录。所有结果携带 provenance（引擎版本/seed/容差）并标记为不可信数据。

description.en: Watches agent execution traces and fires an LLM review at every successful turn end when signals trip, crystallizing reusable workflows into registered skills that improve progressively with later runs.
description.zh: 观察 agent 执行轨迹，在每个成功回合结束时按信号触发 LLM 评审，把值得复用的工作流结晶为已注册技能，并随后续运行持续改进。

description.en: Embedded task management engine: decision-point protocol, idea capture wall, Linear-style issue store.
description.zh: 嵌入式任务管理引擎：决策点协议、念头捕获墙、Linear 形 issue 存储。

description.en: Lifecycle orchestration engine for AI agent teams with task-scoped Git worktree isolation, state-gated delivery transitions, and off-context memory.
description.zh: 基于 Git 工作树任务隔离、状态门禁交付与外置记忆的 AI 智能体软件生命周期编排引擎。

description.en: Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a DSH product subagent: delegate tasks to a Gemini coding agent with your Antigravity login (no API key), with conversation follow-ups, background streaming progress, image analysis by path, and a pop-up login window.
description.zh: 把 Google Antigravity CLI（agy）接入 DSH 作为产品子代理：用 Antigravity 登录态（无需 API key）委托 Gemini 编程智能体干活，支持对话续聊、后台流式进度、按路径识图与自动弹出登录窗口。

description.en: Agent state machine plugin with a todo ledger, stall guard, phase trails and a process-isolated per-step Python worker with GUI automation lanes. Windows only; needs Python 3.10+ on PATH, and pyautogui, mss and pywinauto for the GUI lanes.
description.zh: 智能体状态机插件：任务台账、停滞熔断、相位轨迹与进程隔离的步级 Python 执行器，带 GUI 自动化车道。仅限 Windows；需 PATH 中有 Python 3.10+，GUI 车道另需 pyautogui、mss、pywinauto。

description.en: Git and source-control plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness: local git operations plus GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps and Gitea adapters, with self-evolving memory.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 与源码管理插件套件：本地 git 操作，外加 GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket、Azure DevOps 与 Gitea 适配器，并带自演进记忆。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: one-command install, streaming progress cards with a tool panel, ask/approval button cards, attachments, and proactive feishu_send pushes.
description.zh: 飞书入口插件：一条命令安装，流式进度卡片带工具面板、提问/审批按钮卡片、附件处理与 feishu_send 主动推送。

description.en: Desktop notifications for run completion, model questions, and approval requests with per-platform system sounds, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 系统桌面通知：运行结束、模型提问与审批请求即时提醒，三平台提示音，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Fail-closed Feishu (Lark) channel bridge: chat with a bot, get dsh agent turns back — with opt-in human-in-the-loop tool approval (Allow/Deny cards before every bash call, fail-closed timeout). Official-Python-SDK-only integration (exact-pinned); deny-by-default allowlist, webhook signature/timestamp/replay verification, per-chat sticky sessions; daily latest-SDK compatibility canary; bilingual docs.
description.zh: Fail-closed 的飞书（Lark）channel 桥：和机器人聊天即驱动 dsh agent turn，可选人在环工具审批（每次 bash 调用前飞书弹 Allow/Deny 卡，超时默认拒绝）。仅经官方 Python SDK 集成（精确锁版）；白名单默认全拒、webhook 验签/时间窗/防重放、按 chat 粘性会话；每日最新 SDK 兼容金丝雀；中英双语文档。

description.en: One-click restart button for the DSH Web UI: a sidebar footer button that restarts the dsh web process with a single click and persists across the restart it triggers.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面一键重启按钮：侧边栏底部按钮，单击即重启 dsh web 进程，且重启后按钮常驻。

description.en: A QA plugin for DeepSeek Harness that runs end-to-end checks on a project (build, typecheck, lint, tests, coverage, dependency audit, secret scan) and writes a tickable report with P0–P3 severities and quality gates; execution is limited to preset commands and probing to loopback addresses.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 QA 插件：对项目运行端到端检查（构建、类型检查、lint、测试、覆盖率、依赖审计、密钥扫描），输出可勾选的报告，按 P0–P3 分级并带质量门禁；执行范围限于预设命令，探测只到回环地址。

description.en: Moves a plugin set between DSH profiles (web to desktop by default): diff, pre-checks, an offline script for CLI-owned profiles, and a post-restart verification. It installs nothing itself.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的各 profile 之间迁移插件（默认 web → desktop）：算差异、预检、为 CLI 管的 profile 生成离线脚本、重启后核对。它自己不安装任何东西。

description.en: DSH self-updater in the settings page: one-click check/pull (`git pull --ff-only`), auto background checks, version diff and changelog preview with a red-dot reminder.
description.zh: 设置页中的 DSH 自助更新器：一键检查/拉取（git pull --ff-only）、自动后台检查、版本对比与更新说明预览，带红点提醒。

description.en: Agent security guardrail: intercepts and audits every tool call, requiring human confirmation on sensitive operations.
description.zh: Agent 安全护栏：拦截并审计所有工具调用，命中敏感操作就要求人工确认。

description.en: LAN / remote-access control, frpc NAT tunneling, a panel password gate, and mobile UI adaptation for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：局域网/远程访问控制、frpc 内网穿透、面板密码门禁与手机端 UI 适配。

description.en: Cheap enough to leave running in a QQ group all day. The lite reply mode bypasses the full agent loop and calls chat completions directly: about ¥0.0027 per turn, roughly ¥0.2 for 80 turns a day, around 75x cheaper than a full DSH session. Still includes switchable persona cards, image and video understanding, an auto-tagged image library built from group pictures, and keyword recall over archived chats. One-command SSH deploy with environment checks, credential-safe config generation, systemd units and a watchdog. Bundles a fork of Derpyu520/qq-bridge (MIT); do not deploy it to a host that is already running the upstream bridge.
description.zh: 便宜到能天天泡在群里：lite 模式绕过完整 agent 会话、直连 chat completions，一轮约 ¥0.0027，一天 80 轮也就 ¥0.2 出头，比走完整 DSH 会话便宜约 75 倍。同时带可切换人格卡、图片与视频理解、自动打标签的群图素材库、群聊冷存储检索；SSH 一键部署到远程主机，含环境体检、不落密钥的配置生成、systemd 单元与看门狗。内置引擎 fork 自 Derpyu520/qq-bridge（MIT）；请勿在已运行上游桥接的主机上重复部署。

description.en: Chat with local DeepSeek Harness agents from iPhone iMessage: switch workspaces/sessions, start new sessions, and get replies in the Messages app — no extra apps, no servers, no cloud.
description.zh: 在 iPhone 信息里直接和本机 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）对话：切换工作区/会话、开新会话、原生信息气泡回复，无需额外 App、服务器或云服务。

description.en: Runtime extension suite for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session mailbox with wake cold-start, agent teams (captain + members + dependency task board + team_wait), subagent spawn policy with escalation approval, task-aware routing preset, plugin market, skill manager and runtime injector.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 扩展套件：跨会话邮箱与 wake 冷启动、代理团队（队长 + 成员 + 依赖任务板 + team_wait）、子代理派发策略（提权自动审批）、任务感知路由 preset、插件市场、技能管理器与运行时注入器。

description.en: Steam Workshop-style plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, and one-click install community plugins with mirror acceleration, progress UI, security checks, and Chinese descriptions.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的 Steam 创意工坊式插件商店：浏览、搜索并一键安装社区插件，支持镜像加速、进度 UI、安全检测与中文描述。

description.en: Community search, similarity analysis, and install/dedupe/build-it-yourself decisions for the dsh-plugin ecosystem.
description.zh: DSH 插件生态的社区搜索、相似度分析与安装/去重/自建决策工具。

description.en: Short-video sidebar: native player, series navigation, precise history replay.
description.zh: 侧栏短视频：原生播放器、系列导航、精确历史回放。

description.en: A draggable character companion for the DeepSeek Harness web profile with six visual and expression levels, four task modes, current-session chat, public reasoning summaries and browser speech synthesis.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 人物交互插件，支持六档人物与表达风格、四种任务模式、当前会话交流、公开思考摘要和浏览器语音朗读。

description.en: Role-play plugin for DeepSeek Harness: imports SillyTavern character cards (JSON/PNG) and world books (lorebooks), binds DSH skills to a character, and registers the combination as a native agent preset.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 角色扮演插件：导入 SillyTavern 角色卡（JSON/PNG）与世界书（lorebook），为角色绑定 DSH 技能，并注册为原生 agent preset。

description.en: Adds a stamina-bar desktop pet to every DeepSeek Harness session — two bars in the session header for context and alertness, plus a draggable whale-girl who can be poked, petted and dressed up.
description.zh: 给 DSH 每个会话加一只体力条桌宠：会话头部显示上下文与清醒度两条，点一下就能把她放到桌面上，可以拖动、戳、摸头、换装。

description.en: Drag-to-resize the chat content width in the DeepSeek Harness web UI: a handle on the column right edge overrides the built-in 748px width (default 1040px, 520-2400 range, persisted per browser, double-click resets).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供可拖拽的聊天内容宽度：文字列右缘的把手覆盖内置的 748px 宽度（默认 1040px、范围 520~2400、按浏览器记忆，双击恢复默认）。

description.en: Turns each long dsh conversation into a three-level trail (topic to progress steps to milestone timeline) and shows it in a draggable overlay, where one click jumps back to the matching message in the transcript. Topics are distilled by the DeepSeek model with a zero-cost rule-based fallback, can be renamed, locked, merged by drag and drop, and support per-conversation notes plus a vector drawing board.
description.zh: 把 dsh 的每次长对话实时提炼成「线索 → 进度步骤 → 阶段历程」三级结构，以可拖动的悬浮窗呈现，点一下就能跳回对话里的对应消息。线索由 DeepSeek 模型总结，模型不可用时自动回退到零成本的规则模式；支持重命名、锁定、拖拽合并，附带每个对话独立的笔记与矢量画笔。

description.en: OLED burn-in care for the Web GUI with pure-black surfaces, gamma-aware text dimming on an idle/focus ladder, a true-black nap screensaver with live agent status, and slow accent-hue rotation.
description.zh: Web GUI 的 OLED 烧屏防护：纯黑底色、按空闲/聚焦档位做伽马感知的文字调暗、带实时 agent 状态的纯黑小憩屏保，以及缓慢轮转的强调色。

description.en: A floating, semi-transparent market ticker for DeepSeek Harness showing real-time level and change percentage for the Shanghai Composite, ChiNext, STAR 50 and Hang Seng Tech indices.
description.zh: 一个悬浮的半透明行情小窗，实时显示上证指数、创业板指、科创50 与恒生科技的当前点位与涨跌幅。

description.en: Tool-use visibility for dsh: an act wrapper and guard make every ordinary tool call carry a describe field (direct calls are rejected by default), the model narrates decisions in plain text, and live act cards with thinking, purpose, status and result show in a strip under the composer and, with the optional dsh-better-sidebar plugin, in a right-side digest panel. Also adds a background event tool for long tasks.
description.zh: 让 dsh 的工具调用可见、可纠偏：act 包装与护栏强制每次普通调用携带 describe（默认直接调用会被拒绝），模型以纯文本播报决策，act 卡片（思考结果、作用、状态、结果）实时显示在输入框下方的梳理条里，装了可选的 dsh-better-sidebar 后还会显示在右侧梳理页；另提供后台 event 工具处理长任务。

description.en: An Excalidraw prototyping tab for dsh-better-sidebar with structured product clarification, conflict-aware human and Agent board updates, and prototype-guided frontend generation.
description.zh: 运行在 dsh-better-sidebar 中的 Excalidraw 协作原型插件：结构化澄清产品需求、保护用户手工修改的人机画板更新，以及基于原型的前端生成。

description.en: Game-style floating HUD: balance HP bar, context MP bar, official peak/valley pricing with countdown, auto-compaction under 5% remaining, and memory-carrying new conversation.
description.zh: 游戏风格悬浮 HUD：余额血条、上下文蓝条、官方峰谷定价与切换倒计时、上下文不足5%自动压缩、携带记忆开启新对话。

description.en: Icon console for the DSH desktop app: import one icon and apply it to the desktop and Start Menu shortcuts (immediately), the application window image and the system tray image (after a restart), with automatic backup, one-click restore, a named icon library, and restart/exit controls.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端图标控制台：导入一个图标即可应用到桌面与开始菜单快捷方式（立即生效）、应用窗口图标与系统托盘图标（重启后生效），带官方图标自动备份、一键恢复、图标库管理，以及重启/退出控制。

description.en: UI butler for every plugin UI: official/plugin categories, per-widget toggles, drag move/resize, collision avoidance and one-click auto arrange.
description.zh: UI 管家：官方/插件 UI 分区折叠、逐条开关，拖拽移动/改大小，碰撞避让与一键自动排布。

description.en: Codex-style `@file` mentions for the web GUI: search and reference workspace files of every format (.java, .vue, PDF, images, extension-less, hidden) with no index truncation. Replaces dsh-at-file.
description.zh: Codex 风格的 `@file` 文件引用：输入框里搜索并引用工作区所有格式的文件（.java、.vue、PDF、图片、无扩展名、隐藏文件），无索引上限。dsh-at-file 的替代品。

description.en: Hebrew RTL rendering for the web GUI: any line with Hebrew reads right-to-left (messages, GenUI, question cards, the composer and input fields), and RTL-aware Cmd+Left/Right line navigation.
description.zh: 为 Web 界面提供希伯来语 RTL 渲染：任何包含希伯来文的行都从右向左显示（消息、GenUI、提问卡片、输入框与各类输入字段），以及在 RTL 行上方向正确的 Cmd+左/右 行内跳转。

description.en: Moves a session from one workspace to another by dragging it in the sidebar: a confirmation dialog first, subagent sessions travel with the parent, the list auto-scrolls at its edges, and an open idle session takes the move immediately through a registry refresh; moving into or out of the ungrouped group works both ways.
description.zh: 在侧栏把会话从一个工作区拖到另一个工作区，确认后移动会话日志与归属（含子代理、列表边缘自动滚动，已打开的空闲会话经注册表刷新即时生效），未分组双向拖动同样支持。

description.en: Workspace file tree for the Web UI: multi-tab preview (text/DOCX/PDF/Markdown/CSV/images), inline Markdown editing, a Git changes panel, and file operations (rename/delete/copy/move/create) via context menu.
description.zh: 工作区文件树插件：多标签预览（文本/DOCX/PDF/Markdown/CSV/图片）、Markdown 内联编辑、Git 变更面板与右键文件操作（重命名/删除/复制/移动/新建）。

description.en: Full-screen boot animation for the DSH web client: the boot HTML paints a cover-fit artwork on its first frame, adds a slow settle, a scanning light sweep and a progress HUD, then hands the viewport over when the app mounts. Click or press Esc / space / Enter to skip.
description.zh: 用图片做全屏开机动画：启动 HTML 首帧即铺满画面并缓慢推近，横向光带扫过，左下进度与阶段提示，应用挂载完成后淡出。点击任意处或按 Esc / 空格 / 回车可跳过。

description.en: Deep links: open a specific session or workspace via `?session=` / `?workspace=`.
description.zh: `?session=` / `?workspace=` 深链直达指定项目对话。

description.en: Shows download, install, fetch and search progress in a floating overlay or in a compact chip above the composer, and lists background jobs that have no progress to draw.
description.zh: 在浮层或输入框上方的胶囊里显示下载、安装、抓取、搜索的进度，并列出没有进度可画的后台任务。

description.en: Audio/video FileViewer for dsh-better-sidebar: native inline playback for mp4/webm/mkv/mov and mp3/flac/wav, served by a Range-capable streaming media route.
description.zh: better-sidebar 音视频预览器：原生播放器内联播放 mp4/webm/mkv/mov 等视频与 mp3/flac/wav 等音频，自带支持 HTTP Range 拖动的流式媒体路由。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a one-click whale icon plus a sidebar More menu with Settings / Restart-Refresh / graceful Full Exit, and a scrollable multi-DSH picker on the cold-start card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面启动器：一键鲸鱼图标 + 侧栏「更多」菜单（设置 / 重启/刷新 / 优雅完全退出），冷启动卡片支持可滚动的多 DSH 候选选择。

description.en: Session-header task capsule with color-coded run states, click-to-jump and a multi-task dropdown, plus task notification cards (done / error / waiting-for-confirmation) with synthesized sound and optional system notifications.
description.zh: 会话 header 常驻任务胶囊（圆点颜色分态、点击跳转、多任务下拉），任务完成、出错、等待确认时弹通知卡，支持合成提示音与可选系统通知。

description.en: Read-only goal-tree status strip above the composer: planners see the full node tree, workers see their claimed node, and worker reports call back to the planner session.
description.zh: 输入框上方的只读 goal-tree 状态条：规划者看全树，Worker 只看认领节点，Worker 回报可唤醒规划者会话。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI: sprite-sheet animation, agent state linkage, drag, alarm (daily/one-shot) and pomodoro widgets, skin picker with preview.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物：精灵图动画、agent 状态联动、拖拽、闹钟（每天/一次）与番茄钟，皮肤下拉选择 + 预览。

description.en: Real-time token billing for DSH web: official DeepSeek CNY pricing with automatic peak/off-peak switching, hourly price sync from the official site, visual custom model prices, and multi-currency fallback.
description.zh: DSH Web 实时 token 计费插件：官网人民币价直接计费、高峰/错峰自动切换、价格实时跟随官网、可视化自定义模型价格、多币种兜底。

description.en: DeepSeek API spend (current session and all sessions) and account balance in the aside panel, with official pricing and peak/off-peak support.
description.zh: 右侧面板展示 DeepSeek API 费用（当前会话 + 全部会话累计）与账户余额，内置官方计价与峰谷计价支持。

description.en: Permanent composer-dock balance card: real-time DeepSeek API account balance with 5-minute auto-refresh, a manual refresh button, and low-balance color warnings.
description.zh: 输入框下方常驻余额卡片：实时显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额，每 5 分钟自动刷新，支持手动刷新，余额过低自动变色提醒。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and per-session cost card in the sidebar foot.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部 DeepSeek 账户余额显示与会话费用估算卡片。
