description.en: GitHub-style activity heatmap in the sidebar, one cell per day over 30/90/365-day ranges, with token usage and estimated cost per model and editable per-model prices.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的活动热力图，一格一天，支持近 30、90、365 天，统计 token 用量与按模型估算的费用，单价可自行修改。

description.en: Theme studio for the DSH Web GUI: five built-in presets plus fully customizable light/dark palettes (accent, background, foreground, UI and code fonts, translucent sidebar, contrast), hot-swapped instantly and persisted in localStorage.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 主题工作室：5 套内置预设 + 完全可自定义的浅/深配色（强调色、背景、前景、UI 与代码字体、半透明侧栏、对比度），即时热切换并持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: QQ 2007-inspired DSH Web skin: 72 native theme tokens, scoped three-pane chrome, original offline art and pixel buddy, an optional synthesized send chime, responsive/accessibility fallbacks, and reversible Settings switches.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 QQ 2007 风格皮肤：72 个原生主题 token、作用域三栏窗框、原创离线素材与像素伙伴、可选合成发送提示音、响应式/无障碍回退和可恢复设置开关。

description.en: Sky: Children of the Light skin for the dsh web UI - light children on a glowing star map, candlelight gold and starry night.
description.zh: 光遇·遇境主题皮肤：星盘之上的光之子，烛火暖金与深蓝星空双主题，为 dsh WebUI 定制。

description.en: Codex-style appearance for the DSH Web interface: window edge hairlines and shadows, sidebar colours and row alignment, a model picker with a reasoning-effort power rail, composer and right-panel geometry, a full-page settings-modal pass, a Trajectory view exit, and a settings card for theme, accent, background, foreground, fonts, sidebar translucency and contrast.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面复刻 Codex 外观：窗口边缘发丝线与阴影、侧栏配色与行对齐、带推理强度功率轨的模型选择器、输入区与右栏几何、设置模态框全页改造、轨迹视图退出出口，以及可调主题、强调色、背景、前景、字体、侧栏半透明与对比度的设置卡。

description.en: Imports .vsix theme files made for Visual Studio Code and applies them to the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 导入为 Visual Studio Code 设计的 .vsix 主题文件并应用到 DSH Web UI。

description.en: Skin manager for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a draggable whale button that restores the default look on left-click and switches between installed skins on right-click.
description.zh: DSH 网页皮肤管理器：可拖动的鲸鱼按钮，左键恢复默认界面，右键列出并切换所有已安装皮肤。

description.en: Main UI skin that extends the dsh-startup-screen archive layout to the whole workspace, picking up from the boot animation when it hands off.
description.zh: 主界面皮肤：把 dsh-startup-screen 开机动画的技术档案版式延伸到整个工作台，揭幕时接住开机动画的常驻件。

description.en: Whale-girl wallpaper background with a frosted semi-transparent app surface; customize image, opacity, and contain/cover from the Web settings, with remote image preflight and no-referrer loading.
description.zh: Web UI 鲸鱼娘壁纸背景，应用表面半透明磨砂；支持在设置页自定义图片、透明度与 contain/cover 铺放方式，远程图片自动预检并 no-referrer 加载。

description.en: Tsinghua MadModel provider for DSH: renews the campus token automatically, switches between campus direct access and WebVPN, and serves model requests through a loopback transport with per-model queuing.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的清华 MadModel 接入：自动续期校园 token，按网络在校内直连与校外 WebVPN 之间切换，经本地回环转发模型请求并按模型排队。

description.en: Sign in to DeepSeek Harness with a Claude Pro/Max membership (no API key), downscale Anthropic request images to a 2000px long edge, slim /compact summarizer payloads, and show 5-hour/weekly plan usage plus DSH message counts.
description.zh: 用 Claude Pro/Max 会员登录 DeepSeek Harness（无需 API key），将 Anthropic 请求图片长边压到 2000px，精简 /compact 摘要请求，并显示 5 小时/每周套餐用量百分比与 DSH 消息数。

description.en: Ollama Cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness: adds the chat route on install, publishes each model's own thinking levels for the composer effort control, keeps the model list current from the endpoint (/api/tags and /api/show, cached for offline boots), reads the account allowance from /api/balance into the Models page and a sidebar row that hides itself when the endpoint reports none, and offers Ollama's web search and fetch as selectable DSH web providers.
description.zh: Ollama Cloud 供应商：安装即配好聊天路由，按 Ollama 模型自身元数据公布每个模型的思维链档位（供 composer 的推理强度选择），模型清单可由端点自动刷新（/api/tags 与 /api/show，并带离线缓存），账户额度改从 /api/balance 读取并显示在 Models 页与侧栏（端点不上报时侧栏那行自动隐藏），还把 Ollama 的 web_search / web_fetch 作为可选的 DSH 网页能力提供方。

description.en: Rate-limits LLM requests per provider and per model using a reservation-based token bucket, with queue or reject modes, plus gateway identity rules that rewrite user-agent and inject custom headers.
description.zh: 按供应商与模型粒度限速 LLM 请求，预约式令牌桶支持排队或拒绝两种模式，附带网关身份规则（改写 User-Agent、注入自定义请求头）。

description.en: Simulates a Codex environment for selected model routes to improve GPT-family model tool-call success.
description.zh: 为选定的模型路由模拟 Codex 环境，以提升 GPT 系列模型的工具调用成功率。

description.en: LLM provider adapter that routes model calls through any ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Devin and more — with a registry browser, per-server settings UI, lazy authentication, and dynamic model discovery.
description.zh: 通过 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）将任意外部 agent 作为 LLM 提供方接入——支持 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Devin 等，内置注册表浏览与服务管理界面，支持惰性认证、模型动态发现与热切换。

description.en: Deterministic keyword routing, allowlisted model switching, and an isolated image_gen channel for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 关键词路由与隔离生图插件：确定性关键词路由、白名单模型切换与隔离的 image_gen 生图通道。

description.en: Export any DeepSeek Harness session as a single self-contained HTML page that opens offline, with per-message picking, collapsed tool calls and default redaction of local paths and credentials.
description.zh: 把任意 DSH 会话导出为单文件、离线可打开的 HTML 分享页：可按单条消息挑选、工具调用折叠，并默认脱敏本机路径与密钥。

description.en: Provides Codex-style session message folding for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格的会话消息折叠。

description.en: Conversation history rail on the left edge of the chat: each tick is one real user request, hover to preview its text, click to jump to that turn.
description.zh: 会话历史迷你滑轨：对话区左侧垂直居中的短横线，每条横线代表一条真实用户请求，悬停预览请求内容，点击跳转到对应轮次。

description.en: Inline preview for \[图片: path] image bridge markers: after the marker renders, the image shows in chat automatically, keeping long instructions out of the conversation.
description.zh: 图片桥接内联预览:对话中 \[图片: 路径] 标记渲染后自动显示图片,长指令不留在对话里。

description.en: Folds oversized tool results into on-disk spill files with deterministic head and tail markers, indexes compaction summaries in a searchable ledger, and extracts cross-session memories with per-project scoping. Any folded content is restored byte-for-byte on demand through one tool call.
description.zh: 把超长工具结果折叠为落盘副本并保留 head/tail 标记，为 compaction 摘要建立可检索账本，并按项目作用域抽取跨会话记忆；被折叠的内容可通过一次工具调用原样取回。

description.en: Knowledge collection board for DeepSeek Harness: file chat answers, papers and notes into per-mode boards (study, academic, daily), browse them as a grouped kanban, timeline or calendar, link cards to each other, and roam a per-mode star map; ships an agent tool for adding and linking cards and scheduled collection tasks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的知识收录看板：把对话答案、论文与随手笔记收录进学习/学术/日常三种模式，用分组看板、时间轴或日历浏览，卡片之间可建立联系并在单星系星图里漫游；另提供 agent 工具与定时收录任务。

description.en: Governed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only evidence ledger with write guards, 7-tier authority claims, supersede chains, and budgeted pre-step injection with per-domain quotas.
description.zh: 带治理的长期记忆：只追加证据账本、写入闸门、7 级权威声明与取代链，pre-step 按领域配额预算注入。

description.en: Event-based memory for long-lived chat bots: emotion-weighted decay, three confidence levels on recall, superseding outdated facts, per-subject isolation, plus relationship, fact, chapter, skill and gap tables. Ships a CLI, an HTTP endpoint and a DSH plugin bundle.
description.zh: 给长期陪伴型机器人的记忆层：事件编码、情绪加权遗忘、召回分三档确定度、改口即失效、按人隔离，另有关系、事实、章节、技能、缺口五张表。包含命令行、HTTP 接口和 DSH 插件三件套。

description.en: A biomimetic memory plugin for DSH that folds context into token clues and reconstructs memories on-demand.
description.zh: 记忆插件：上下文放不下时把旧轮次蒸馏成 Token 线索并从历史中切除，需要时用线索重建记忆。

description.en: DSH ↔ agentmemory session-memory bridge: mirrors session lifecycle into a local agentmemory daemon (REST), exposes memory_recall / memory_remember tools, and injects a per-session memory context window via agent/pre-step.
description.zh: DSH ↔ agentmemory 会话记忆桥：把会话生命周期镜像到本地 agentmemory 守护进程（REST），提供 memory_recall / memory_remember 工具，并通过 agent/pre-step 按会话注入记忆上下文窗口。

description.en: Self-hosted crypto portfolio dashboard: BTC, EVM (73 chains via DeBank), Solana, Dogecoin, Cardano, Hyperliquid L1, five exchanges (Binance, Bybit, Backpack, OKX, Bitget) and tokenised equities in one view, with multi-provider failover, custom asset labels, a tunable asset-health report, a shareable PNG card, per-source connection tests, multi-profile configs, scheduled refresh and zero-dependency charts (Python stdlib + vanilla JS, no CDN).
description.zh: 自托管加密资产仪表盘：BTC、EVM（DeBank 73 条链）、Solana、狗狗币、艾达币、Hyperliquid L1、五家交易所（Binance / Bybit / Backpack / OKX / Bitget）与代币化股票统一视图；多数据源自动切换、自定义资产类别标签、可调阈值的资产健康度报告、可分享的 PNG 卡片、每个数据源独立连通性测试、多 Profile 配置、定时刷新、零依赖图表（Python 标准库 + 原生 JS，无 CDN）。

description.en: Browses Bilibili on your behalf and actually takes part: search videos, like, coin, send danmaku, post comments, reply to other people, and keep replying when someone answers back. Reads the video's Bilibili AI subtitle (or transcribes the audio locally when there is none) so its comments talk about what the video really says, and it reads that same content before choosing whom to reply to. Instead of copying other people's sentences, it distills rules about how to sound like a person and gets less AI-ish the more it runs. Skips videos it already browsed, de-duplicates replies per thread, and after too many rounds with the same person in one comment section it reviews whether the exchange has any substance -- if it looks like two bots complimenting each other, it says one last line and stops replying to that person there. Checks whether each comment is genuinely public or only visible to your own account, can scan any time window (last hour / day / 3 days / all) and lists the ones others cannot see, warning you on the overview when replies got folded. Six-tab settings panel where every change takes effect immediately with no restart, a manual run that queues behind the background listener instead of being refused, and an environment self-check that tells you exactly what to install. Requires Python 3 for the Bilibili actions; the built-in check lists any missing packages.
description.zh: 替你在 B 站上真的动手：搜视频、点赞、投币、发弹幕、发评论、回别人的评论，别人回了还能接着聊。会读视频的 B 站 AI 字幕（没有字幕时可本地转写），所以评论说的是视频里真正讲了什么；挑该回谁之前也会先看一遍视频内容。它不抄别人的句子，而是总结「怎么说话才像真人」的规律，跑得越多 AI 味越淡。会跳过刷过的视频、同一楼不重复回复；跟同一个人在同一个评论区来回聊太多轮时会先审查这段对话有没有营养 —— 如果像两个机器人在互相捧场，就说最后一句、之后不再回复他。还能查每条评论是真公开了还是只有你自己看得见，可以按任意时间范围（最近 1 小时 / 24 小时 / 3 天 / 全部）批量扫描并列出别人看不到的那些，总览上直接告警有多少条被折叠。六页签设置面板，改任何一项立刻生效、不用重启；手动「跑一轮」撞上后台监听会排队而不是被拒；自带环境自检，缺什么直接告诉你。B 站操作需要 Python 3，内置自检会列出缺少的依赖。

description.en: Use the Jev (System One) decision-model paradigm with any OpenAI-compatible LLM — no TypeSafe key required. Registers a jev_decide tool that returns probability-distributed answers to typed questions (choice/score/boolean) in one call.
description.zh: 用任意 OpenAI 兼容大模型跑 Jev 决策范式——无需 TypeSafe key。注册 jev_decide 工具，一次调用返回带概率分布的类型化答案（choice/score/boolean）。

description.en: Sidebar image workbench with separate Agnes / OpenAI GPT Image / Grok / OpenAI-compatible keys, text-to-image and up to five reference images, local history, an image_studio_generate tool for /image, and an in-panel GitHub update button.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏生图工作台：Agnes、OpenAI GPT Image、Grok、OpenAI 兼容接口各自独立 Key，支持文生图和最多 5 张参考图、本地历史、/image 工具，以及插件内 GitHub 更新按钮。

description.en: Adobe Lightroom Classic as native dsh tools through the lightroom-py MCP server: read the catalog, apply develop settings and presets, export JPEG/TIFF/PSD/DNG, and write ratings, labels, keywords and IPTC — 15 tools driving the Lightroom Classic installed on the local machine, no cloud round-trip; the Python package is on PyPI and the Lightroom plugin installs with one command.
description.zh: 通过 lightroom-py MCP 服务器把 Adobe Lightroom Classic 接入为 dsh 原生工具：读取目录、应用 develop 设置与预设、导出 JPEG/TIFF/PSD/DNG、写入星级/色标/关键词/IPTC——15 个工具，直接驱动本机安装的 Lightroom Classic，不经云端；Python 包在 PyPI 上，Lightroom 插件一条命令安装。

description.en: A-share and US stock trading toolkit for DSH agents: realtime quotes, OHLCV klines, ADX three-state regime signals and simple backtest previews via EastMoney. Read-only, never places orders.
description.zh: DSH agent 的 A股/美股交易工具箱：实时行情、OHLCV K线、ADX 三状态市场分类信号与简易回测预览，数据源东方财富。只读设计，永不下单。

description.en: On-demand tool groups for DeepSeek Harness, with optional role-scoped tool surfaces. Role masks are off by default; Settings can enable or disable review/build/research, and add custom roles with a group allow-list. The role key comes from the host's session label, subagent marker or preset, so an orchestrator's child agents each see only their own allow-list. Also auto-groups tool families by name prefix, lets the agent classify ungrouped tools once, restores a hidden tool when it is actually called, and reports per-session visibility health.
description.zh: 把重工具组从每一轮请求里收起来，并提供可选的角色工具面。角色工具面默认关闭；设置页可逐项开关 review/build/research，也能自定义角色和允许组。角色键来自宿主自己的会话 label、subagent 标记或 preset，编排器的子代理各看各的组白名单。另有按名前缀自动分组、让 AI 分一次没归组的工具、调用被收工具时自动放回，以及每个会话实际可见性的 health 快照。

description.en: Video editing toolset for DSH: probe, trim, concat, audio handling, subtitle burn-in, transform, transcode and frame grabbing, powered by ffmpeg downloaded on first use.
description.zh: DSH 视频剪辑工具集：探测、裁剪、拼接、音轨处理、字幕烧录、变速、转码与抽帧，引擎为首次使用时自动下载的 ffmpeg。

description.en: A read_graph tool backed by a codebase knowledge graph (CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL relations).
description.zh: 基于代码库知识图谱的 read_graph 工具（CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL 关系）。

description.en: Universal Model Context Protocol (MCP) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: connects agents to stdio/sse/websocket MCP servers with a 10k dormant scale engine, sub-millisecond BM25 tool search, dynamic token budgeting, and a real-time web UI dashboard.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通用 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 桥接插件：支持 stdio/sse/websocket 协议，具备 10k 休眠伸缩引擎、亚毫秒级 BM25 工具检索、动态 Token 预算管理及实时 Web UI 仪表盘。

description.en: Character consistency toolkit: personality profile cards, appearance-weight stats, and behavioral-drift detection for long-form fiction.
description.zh: 角色一致性工具包：性格侧写档案、出场权重统计与行为偏离检测。

description.en: Parse/query/aggregate/convert CSV (RFC 4180) with a zero-dependency state-machine parser.
description.zh: CSV 解析/查询/统计/转换（RFC 4180），零依赖状态机解析器。

description.en: base64/url/hex encoding, common hashes, and UUID generation.
description.zh: base64/url/hex 编解码、常用哈希、UUID 生成。

description.en: Commander mode for the dsh web GUI: a one-click session header button injects a protocol brief into the session, then parses and auto-executes task blocks in the model reply — separating the strategist loop from worker loops via a visible badge.
description.zh: dsh 网页端指挥官模式：会话标题栏一键注入协议简报，解析模型回复中的任务块并自动执行，让策略层与执行层分离；通过徽章按钮激活/停用。

description.en: Request-level one-time prompt injection without further context pollution. SillyTavern-style UI and data compatibility, keyword/regex/constant triggers, and a lore_lookup tool for on-demand searching.
description.zh: 酒馆风格的通用世界书，为最新用户消息附加一次性的提示词注入，无上下文污染。兼容酒馆世界书，关键词/正则/常驻触发，以及不污染上下文的 lore_lookup 单轮查询工具。

description.en: E-commerce customer-service desk that answers buyers only from the fields the shop itself wrote down (price, SKU table, shipping, after-sales), has the DSH model rephrase those facts under a check that rejects invented numbers and platform red lines, and moves the conversation to a human queue when a field is missing. Ships Taobao TOP and JD JOS gateway adapters, a local bridge and webhook channel, and a standalone 24/7 daemon.
description.zh: 电商客服台：只按商家自己写下的字段（价格、规格表、发货、售后）回答买家，由 DSH 模型改写措辞并校验不得编造数字或触碰平台红线，缺字段时转入人工队列。内置淘宝 TOP、京东 JOS 网关适配器，外加本地桥接与 webhook 通道，以及可独立常驻的守护进程。

description.en: SSH remote ops for DSH: pair servers over SSH or a one-time-code remote-hostd, then run commands, manage background jobs, and read or write remote files with reviewable changes (host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes).
description.zh: DSH SSH 远程运维：通过 SSH 或一次性配对码的 remote-hostd 连接服务器，执行命令、管理后台任务、读写远程文件并审阅变更（host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes）。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file upload for PDF, Word, Excel and images: dropped files are saved to a local directory and referenced by path, no base64 bloat in the chat.
description.zh: 拖拽上传 PDF/Word/Excel/图片等文件:落盘为本地路径引用,对话里不塞 base64 大文本。

description.en: Cache-first code exploration: the rdd_explore tool queries the project's .rdd/exploration index and, on a miss, dispatches a read-only worker subagent to explore and register findings; rdd_models serves the live model catalog for dispatch-time model selection.
description.zh: 缓存优先的代码探索：rdd_explore 工具查询项目 .rdd/exploration 索引，未命中时派遣只读 worker 子代理探索并注册产物；rdd_models 提供实时模型目录，用于派遣时选模型。

description.en: Go (weiqi) review coach: parses SGF records, backfills winrate and score analysis with a bundled KataGo engine, explains the costly moves in the chat, and writes the commentary back into an SGF copy; a web panel shows the board with problem moves, AI choices and variations.
description.zh: 围棋复盘教练：解析 SGF 棋谱，用自带 KataGo 引擎补算胜率与目差，在对话里逐手讲解问题手，并把讲解写回 SGF 副本；Web 面板用棋盘展示问题手、AI 首选与变化图。

description.en: CloakBrowser-powered native browser tools with per-agent isolated sessions, bounded snapshots, ref-based interaction, screenshots, and safe routing.
description.zh: 基于 CloakBrowser 的原生浏览器工具：按 Agent 隔离会话，提供有界快照、ref 交互、截图与安全路由。

description.en: Let your AI agent see and operate a real Android phone: phone_look (vision + UI-tree fusion), tap/swipe/type, screenshot — over adb, for any MCP client.
description.zh: 让 AI 助手看见并操作真实安卓手机：phone_look（视觉+UI 树融合判读）、点击/滑动/输入、截图——经 adb，适用于任何 MCP 客户端。

description.en: Bridges session images to configurable vision providers and returns text-only analysis to eligible DeepSeek Harness model routes.
description.zh: 将会话图片转交可配置视觉服务，并向符合条件的 DeepSeek Harness 模型路由返回纯文本分析。

description.en: Fully-local image understanding & OCR via macOS Vision Framework: `ocr_image` (text, table layout + coordinates) and `view_image` (scene, faces, QR) — paste multiple images into the web input box or pass path/URL/base64; images never leave your Mac.
description.zh: 基于 macOS Vision Framework 的全本地识图插件：`ocr_image`（文字提取，表格结构+坐标）与 `view_image`（场景/人脸/二维码）；web 输入框可直接粘贴多张图片，图片永不离开你的 Mac。

description.en: Unified image generation router for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): auto-discovers image models from any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, provides draw_image and draw_list_sources tools, supports SenseNova, StepFun, Agnes, Qwen, Flux, SD, Imagen and more.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 统一绘图路由器：自动识别任意 OpenAI 兼容接口的绘图模型，提供 draw_image 和 draw_list_sources 工具，支持商汤、阶跃、Agnes、千问、Flux、SD、Imagen 等。

description.en: Breeze TTS for DeepSeek Harness: read replies aloud in full or as a short summary, one-click Breeze CLI login with automatic key import, voice search and design, smart companionship, and lunch/dinner reminders.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Breeze 语音插件：可按全文或概要朗读回复，一键登录 Breeze CLI 并自动导入 Key，支持音色搜索与设计、智能陪伴，以及午饭/晚饭提醒。

description.en: Preview Mermaid diagrams as images via local rendering in DSH Web when the chat message contains a Mermaid fenced code block, and also allow integration with external rendering servers.
description.zh: 当 DSH Web 中的消息包含 Mermaid 语法时，通过本地渲染以图像形式预览 Mermaid Diagrams，并允许接入外部渲染服务器。

description.en: Bounded, cell-addressed `doc_read`/`doc_write` for xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb, plus an MCP server and CLI.
description.zh: doc_read/doc_write：以有界、单元格寻址的方式读写 xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb，另附 MCP 服务器与 CLI。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin — PDF text-layer and scanned-PDF OCR, Office docx/xlsx/pptx to Markdown, TIFF/epub and long-document index cards.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 插件——PDF 文字层与扫描件 OCR、Office 文档转 Markdown、TIFF/epub 与长文档索引卡。

description.en: HTML↔Markdown conversion, GFM table normalization, and TOC generation.
description.zh: HTML↔Markdown 转换、GFM 表格规范化、目录生成。

description.en: Browse, preview, edit, and save files under the current project's openspec/ directory from a Web UI header panel that follows the session workspace.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 会话标题栏打开当前项目的 openspec/ 目录，浏览、预览、编辑并保存其中的文件，自动跟随会话工作区。

description.en: Skill that deploys a folder to a public HTTPS address on Back4app with the Back4app CLI, on a temporary account with a claim link to keep the web app.
description.zh: 技能：用 Back4app CLI 把一个文件夹部署到 Back4app 上的公开 HTTPS 地址；使用临时账号，并附认领链接，认领后即可保留该网页应用。

description.en: WeChat Official Account content studio: anti-homogenization rotation writing, low-creativity remediation playbook, blessing-image visual baseline, gpt-image pipeline with OCR acceptance, and the measured xiaolvshu draft web API.
description.zh: 微信公众号内容生产工作台：防低创作度结构轮换写作法、低创作度整改实战、祝福图视觉基线、gpt-image 配图管线与 OCR 验收、小绿书草稿网页接口实测参数。

description.en: B2B lead generation skill: search target companies by industry/product/region, cross-validate and extract contacts.
description.zh: 精准客户线索挖掘技能：按行业/产品/地区搜索目标公司，多渠道验证并提取联系方式。

description.en: AI-driven presentation workflow packaged as a dsh skill: generates editable PPTX decks and SVG snapshots from PDF, DOCX, URLs or Markdown, fills native PPTX templates, and enhances finished presentations.
description.zh: AI 驱动的演示文稿工作流：从 PDF、DOCX、网址或 Markdown 生成可编辑 PPTX 与 SVG 快照，支持原生 PPTX 模板填充与成品演示文稿增强。

description.en: Douyin local-promotion OEM ad daily/weekly report automation (Author: Kirin): collects 3 data sources (laike leads, plan-level delivery, video analysis) via a one-time Edge login, computes metrics, builds A4-style docx reports, supports free-choice scheduled run times and email notifications.
description.zh: 抖音本地推 OEM 广告日报/周报自动生成（作者：Kirin）：一次 Edge 登录后自动采集三大数据源（来客客资、计划级投放明细、视频分析），计算指标并生成 A4 排版 docx 报告，支持自由选择定时运行时间和邮件通知。

description.en: Nightly self-improvement for your DeepSeek Harness agent: harvest past sessions offline, replay recurring tasks on your own API budget, and consolidate validated skills behind a held-out gate. Brings microsoft/SkillOpt's SkillOpt-Sleep engine to dsh as native tools plus a bundled skill - no weight training. Requires Python 3.10+ and the SkillOpt-Sleep engine (pip install skillopt).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供夜间自我进化：离线复盘过往会话，在你的 API 预算内重放高频任务，并把学到的技能凝练成经得起门禁验证的技能。把 microsoft/SkillOpt 的 SkillOpt-Sleep 引擎带进 dsh，作为原生工具加内置技能——无需模型训练。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装 SkillOpt-Sleep 引擎(pip install skillopt)。

description.en: Diagnoses and fixes "duplicate loader entry id" boot crashes - finds duplicate loader rows across profile bundles and converts them into id-targeted patches via a zero-dependency CLI (detect / preview / fix / verify).
description.zh: 检测并修复 dsh 启动的 "duplicate loader entry id" 崩溃：扫描 profile 各 bundle 的重复 loader row，转换为 id-targeted patch，附带零依赖 CLI（检测/预览/修复/复检）。

description.en: AI Look-Up: detects aimless grinding (repeated commands, failure loops, long runs with no output) and injects mid-run self-review nudges, plus a real local-clock anchor so the agent stops estimating elapsed time.
description.zh: AI 抬头：检测空跑（重复命令 / 连续失败 / 久跑零产出）并在运行中途注入自我审查提醒，同时定期注入真实本地时间，校准 AI 的时间感。

description.en: Six-stage WeChat Official Account content-publishing workflow with quality-gate tools and a bundled skill.
description.zh: 六阶段公众号内容发布工作流，带质检门工具与配套 skill。

description.en: Kanban board for DSH: task state machine with git branch isolation, agent auto-execution, and review-driven merge.
description.zh: DSH 任务看板：任务状态机 + git 分支隔离，agent 自动执行、审核后自动合并回基础分支。

description.en: Agent preset that turns multi-stage objectives into resumable flows: refereed stages, SHA-256 lock identity, an HMAC-signed terminal review gate and event-sourced run logs; ships 15 agent tools.
description.zh: 把多阶段目标编排为可恢复 Flow 的 agent 预设：阶段带裁判、SHA-256 流锁身份、HMAC 终局评审门禁、事件溯源运行日志；附 15 个工具。

description.en: Coordinate independent DSH Sessions and provider-backed members without merging their histories, using persistent native Rooms with identity-bound leading `@` mentions, direct delivery, broadcasts, and leader-scoped controls.
description.zh: 在不合并对话历史的前提下，将多个独立 DSH Session 与 provider-backed 成员组成持久原生 Room，支持绑定精确成员身份的行首 `@` 提及、定向投递、广播和 Leader 权限控制。

description.en: Delivery board for client-project teams: stage pipeline (default or governance template, or custom stages), cards with owner, due date, acceptance criteria and DoD, an automatic handoff audit log when a card changes stage, a progress/risk/blocker/decision log, a weekly Markdown client report, a loopback-only drag-and-drop board and a read-only HTML export; state lives in delivery.json in the workspace (11 delivery_* tools plus a /delivery command).
description.zh: 面向客户项目交付团队的交付看板：阶段流水线（default 或 governance 模板，也可自定义阶段），卡片含负责人、截止日、验收标准与 DoD，卡片跨阶段时自动记录交接审计日志，进展/风险/阻塞/决策日志，Markdown 客户周报，仅绑定 127.0.0.1 的可拖拽本地看板与只读 HTML 导出；状态保存在工作区的 delivery.json（11 个 delivery_* 工具与 /delivery 命令）。

description.en: Supervisor-style workflow orchestration over top-level sessions: confirmation-gated batch dispatch, team workstreams, steering running tasks, idle-wait collection and live model-route discovery across 11 task_* tools plus a /tasks slash command.
description.zh: 总控式工作流编排：确认闸门批量派发、团队编组、向运行中任务纠偏、等待收口与模型路线发现——11 个 task_* 工具加 /tasks 斜杠命令。

description.en: Six engineering skills for Claude Code and DSH: research, architecture scouting, implementation orchestration, three-axis diff review, complexity audit and mutation testing. Skills delegate through the host’s generic subagent tools when available.
description.zh: 可安装到 Claude Code 与 DSH 的六个工程技能：调研、架构侦察、实施编排、三轴评审、复杂度审计和突变测试。按需通过宿主通用子 agent 能力委派，无需注册自定义 agent。

description.en: Proactive scheduling: an adaptive heartbeat plus a value network (urgency, relevance, interruption cost) decides when the agent should speak unprompted.
description.zh: 主动调度：自适应心跳 + 价值网络（紧迫度、相关性、打断代价）决定 Agent 何时主动开口。

description.en: Visual drag-and-drop workflow builder for DSH — orchestrate tool calls, sub-agents, and conditional branches on a React Flow canvas.
description.zh: DSH 可视化工作流编排画布，基于 React Flow 拖拽编排工具调用、子智能体与条件分支。

description.en: Adds a "Compact and run" action to the DSH Web plan-review card, which compacts the history submitted before the plan into a checkpoint and then approves the plan.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的计划审批卡上增加「压缩后执行」：先把计划提交之前的历史压成检查点，再批准计划。

description.en: Adds a versioned DPIA workbench to DeepSeek Harness for source-linked facts, follow-up answers, reassessment, and reviewable reports. Needs Python 3.9+ with `python-docx`, `pypdf`, and (for PDF templates) `reportlab` + `pdftoppm`.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加带版本记录的 DPIA 工作台，关联材料来源、事实补正、补答、复评与待审阅报告。需 Python 3.9+ 及 `python-docx`、`pypdf`，PDF 模板还需 `reportlab` 与 `pdftoppm`。

description.en: An AI creation canvas for DeepSeek Harness. Organize project materials, reference cards and files, run local Skills, and manage versions of text, presentations, images, and video. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer; document handling needs Python 3, PPT page rendering needs LibreOffice, video preview needs ffprobe, and image/video generation uses your selected local Skills and their prerequisites. API provider extension points are available, but no provider models or API Key settings are bundled yet.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 创作画布。在同一个项目里整理资料、引用卡片与文件、调用本机 Skill，并管理文本、演示文稿、图片和视频的成果版本。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或更新版本；文档处理需要 Python 3，PPT 分页渲染需要 LibreOffice，视频预览需要 ffprobe，图片／视频通过用户自选的本机 Skill 生成，具体服务与账号按该 Skill 配置；API 提供商扩展接口已预留，尚未内置模型或 API Key 设置。

description.en: Chinese multi-agent workflow with per-role model fallback, versioned Mermaid task plans, independent Agent and Jev reviews, persistent expert collaboration, and pure-function calculation tools.
description.zh: 中文多智能体工作流，支持按角色配置模型回退、版本化 Mermaid 任务规划、独立 Agent 与 Jev 审核、专家持久化协作和纯函数计算工具。

description.en: Git status badge in the composer tool row: a 14px branch glyph left of the model selector, with branch name, changed-file count and +added/-deleted lines on hover. Counts staged, unstaged and untracked files; nothing renders outside a git work tree.
description.zh: 输入框工具行的 git 状态角标：模型选择器左侧一枚 14px 分支图标，悬停显示分支名、变更文件数与增删行数。统计含未跟踪文件；非 git 工作区不显示。

description.en: QQ hub for DeepSeek Harness: private and group chats over OneBot v11 (SnowLuma/NapCat), with per-chat scoped memory, per-chat persona routing, a vision helper that narrates images for text-only models, multi-platform link parsing (large videos sent as group files, image galleries sent inline or as merged-forward messages) and a web panel for models, personas and settings. Derived from aureth-labs/dsh-aurabot-qq; do not install both.
description.zh: 把 QQ 接入 DeepSeek Harness：经 OneBot v11（SnowLuma / NapCat）接私聊与群聊，按会话隔离记忆、按会话分流人格，文本模型收图时由辅助模型转述，多平台链接解析（大视频转群文件，图集以图片或合并转发发出），并提供网页管理面板。改自 aureth-labs/dsh-aurabot-qq，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Notifies you about 11 configurable DSH agent events (task completion, questions, denied approvals, background subagents/goals/jobs, team tasks, context compaction, triggered schedules, plugin startup and permission changes) as browser Web Notifications through a bundled service worker, falling back to Windows toast or Linux D-Bus, with three silence levels and click-to-open.
description.zh: 为 11 类可配置的 DSH agent 事件（任务完成、提问、审批被拒、后台子代理/目标/任务、团队任务、上下文压缩、定时任务触发、插件挂载、权限变更）发送桌面通知，优先走自带 Service Worker 的浏览器 Web Notification，降级到 Windows Toast 或 Linux D-Bus，支持三档静默与点击跳转。

description.en: Connects dsh to Weixin, with arbitrary file sending support.
description.zh: 通过微信远程控制 DeepSeek Harness，支持任意文件传输。

description.en: Unified LLM request/response inspector: reasoning-effort tuning, external-think export, traffic & bundle analysis.
description.zh: 统一 LLM 请求/响应检查器：调 reasoning effort、外部思考(think)导出、流量与包分析。

description.en: Settings -> Plugins switchboard: every loaded plugin card shows its package description and runtime phase, with fuzzy search and start/stop toggles that never rewrite config files.
description.zh: 设置→插件开关面板：每个已加载插件的卡片显示简述与运行阶段，支持模糊搜索与运行时启动/关闭（不改写配置文件）。

description.en: Unified Godot asset and project-goal management for DSH: godot_* model tools, a /gap REST surface, and a better-sidebar UI with asset manager, scene-tree viewer, and Git panel.
description.zh: Godot 资产与项目目标统一管理：godot_* 模型工具 + /gap REST 路由 + better-sidebar 界面（资产管理器 / 场景树查看器 / Git 版本控制）。

description.en: Pre-install static security review and runtime guard for dsh plugins: deobfuscation decoding, supply-chain checks, web one-click review/install/uninstall, and optional runtime tool-call guard.
description.zh: DSH 插件安全审查与运行时守卫：安装前静态审查（反混淆解码、供应链检测）、Web 一键审查/安装/卸载，以及可选的运行时工具调用拦截。

description.en: Support for the microsandbox backend.
description.zh: microsandbox 沙箱支持。

description.en: Bridges WeChat (ilink bot) private chats into DSH agent sessions and streams replies back, with hot-plug and a Settings tab.
description.zh: 把微信私聊桥接进 DSH agent 会话并流式回传回复，支持热插拔与设置页签。

description.en: Toggle switches for the plugin inventory: enable/disable any plugin live from Settings → Plugins → Plugin list without restarting, with groups/filters, bulk toggle, undo, and backup.
description.zh: 插件清单页滑块开关：在设置 → 插件 → 插件清单实时启用/停用任意插件，无需重启；支持分组/筛选、批量开关、撤销与自动备份。

description.en: Companion for the DSH plugin market: batch-updates every installed npm plugin after DSH quits and relaunches it, rolls back the plugins an update broke when the next boot fails, and checks updates plus keeps snapshots for local link plugins. Windows DSH Desktop only; it is a companion patch for the plugin market (dshmarket), not a replacement — install dshmarket for the market tab.
description.zh: DSH 插件市场的补丁层：一键批量更新所有已装 npm 插件（退出 DSH 后自动完成并重新打开），启动失败时自动回退肇事插件，并为本地 link 插件提供更新检测与快照回滚。仅支持 Windows 桌面版 DSH；它是对插件市场（dshmarket）的补丁层而非替代品，市场分组需先装 dshmarket。

description.en: Digital Employee，Integrates three catalogs — Experts, Skills, and Connectors — supporting browsing, favoriting, invoking, and publishing without modifying the host.
description.zh: 数字员工，整合专家、技能、连接器三大目录，支持浏览、收藏、召唤与发布，且无需改动宿主代码。

description.en: Extensible desktop-pet plugin for the DSH Web GUI, with feed / play / character-switch menus and Codex 8x9 spritesheet characters.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的可扩展桌面宠物插件，支持投喂、玩耍、切换角色，并使用 Codex 8x9 spritesheet 添加自定义角色。

description.en: Aseprite-style pixel art studio: the AI draws sprites stroke by stroke with selections, layers, animation frames, gradients, symmetry and reference layers, each step rendered live as ANSI terminal frames.
description.zh: Aseprite 风格像素画工作室：AI 像人类一样分步绘制精灵，支持选区、图层、动画帧、渐变、对称、参考层与 rgb16 4096 色，每一步实时渲染为 ANSI 终端帧。

description.en: Maps locally analyzed system audio to music-reactive conversation effects, rhythm-game judgements, score and combo feedback, and optional RGB spectrum bars in DSH Web.
description.zh: 将本地分析的系统音频映射为 DSH Web 的对话律动、音游判定、分数与连击反馈，以及可选的 RGB 频谱柱。

description.en: A collapsible/expandable draggable floating music player with NetEase Cloud Music playlist import and song/artist search — chat and listen at the same time.
description.zh: 可折叠/展开、自由拖动的悬浮音乐播放器，接入网易云音乐，支持歌单导入和按歌名或歌手搜索单曲导入，边对话边听歌。

description.en: Route each task to one model and its review to a different one, with qualification evidence, failover and a durable journal.
description.zh: 把任务派给一个模型、把评审交给另一个模型，并带有资格证据、故障转移与持久日志。

description.en: A collaboration front-office for AI agents and humans — department boards, tickets, approvals and industry calculations run inside the DSH conversation and panel, so agents do the work in chat while humans stay accountable in the panel. It calls the 01men/ybkkasi governance base over existing contracts (asset ledger, IAM, OIDC SSO, RBAC and scene-level authorization) instead of re-implementing governance. Ships as a Cordis bundle and mounts at /gate01; the selftest suite is green on every push. Do not install this and 01men/ybkkasi as dsh bundles in the same profile: both register the ops-platform-core / ops-iam / ops-authn rows. Requires DSH >=0.1.0-rc.7 <0.2.0.
description.zh: AI 代理与人类的协作前台——部门看板、工单、审批与行业计算都在 DSH 会话与面板里完成，代理在对话里干活，人在面板里负责。它通过既有契约调用 01men/ybkkasi 治理底座（资产台账、IAM、OIDC SSO、RBAC 与场景级授权），不重复实现治理。以 Cordis bundle 形式安装，挂载在 /gate01；自测套件每次推送全绿。请勿在同一 profile 同时安装本插件与 01men/ybkkasi 的 dsh bundle：两者都会注册 ops-platform-core / ops-iam / ops-authn 行。要求 DSH >=0.1.0-rc.7 <0.2.0。

description.en: Adds an "About" settings page to the DeepSeek Harness web interface, showing the running DSH version and recent release notes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置面板添加“关于”页，展示运行中的 DSH 版本与最近更新日志。

description.en: Turns an uploaded picture into a floating desk pet by cutting out its background in the page, with idle animation and a live account-balance bubble.
description.zh: 上传一张图片，在页面内抠掉背景做成浮在 Harness 上的桌宠，带呼吸摇摆动画和实时账户余额气泡。

description.en: Enhances the DSH web session view — one-click collapse of reasoning and tool chains, numbered history quick-jump, Markdown export, AI avatars.
description.zh: 增强 DSH Web 会话视图：一键折叠思考链与工具链、历史快速定位、Markdown 导出、AI 头像。

description.en: A pixel companion living in the chat area: hatches from an egg into one of three sprites or an LLM-drawn custom one from a text description, platform-jumps over message bubbles on its own, WASD controllable, chats in character through the models you already configured, and carries a nurture system (mood/power/health, levels, shop) driven by real token usage.
description.zh: 聊天区里的像素小宠物：从蛋孵化三选一，也可用一句话描述让 LLM 画出自定义形象，自动在消息气泡间平台跳跃，支持 WASD 操控与拖拽，用已配置的模型角色扮演陪聊，养成系统（心情/电量/健康、等级、商店）由真实 token 消耗驱动。

description.en: Adds host file management and an interactive Bash terminal to the DSH WebUI.
description.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 添加好用的独立文件管理与终端页面，及附属实用功能。

description.en: Arknights-flavoured startup animation for the DSH Web GUI: a PRTS terminal boot, sonar scan, hologram lock-on and an operator-file splash that end in a deep-sea lockup, about 4.6 seconds, with four selectable original score presets (or sound off), skippable with a click or Esc and switchable, re-timed or replayed from Settings.
description.zh: 明日方舟风格的 DSH 启动动画：PRTS 终端自检、声呐扫描、全息锁定、干员档案，最后定格在「深海回响」，约 4.6 秒，自带 4 套可切换的原创合成配乐（也可关闭音效）；点击或 Esc 跳过，并可在设置中改时长与重播。

description.en: Your real Obsidian vault in the DSH right Sidebar: vault tree, full-vault search, read-view typography, wikilinks and heading anchors, properties, backlinks, highlights, in-place editing, an outline, and a right-click menu for handoff, rename and .trash.
description.zh: 把你真实的 Obsidian 知识库放进 DSH 右侧栏：目录树、全库搜索、阅读视图排版、双向链接与标题锚点、属性区、关系图谱、高亮、就地编辑、大纲，以及右键菜单（引入对话、重命名、移到 .trash）。

description.en: Chat column width and alignment control, numbered question history with keyboard navigation and auto-load of older questions, and markdown outline rails for both the conversation and the file preview.
description.zh: 对话列宽度与位置调节、带序号与快捷键跳转的提问历史（支持自动加载更早提问），以及对话区和文件预览区的 Markdown 大纲目录。

description.en: A sidebar assistant plugin for the Web interface, allows users to select any text, displays the model’s reasoning process and final answer in a floating panel.
description.zh: Web 界面的侧边栏助手插件,在 Web 聊天界面里选中任意文本，在浮层面板里流式显示思考过程与最终答案。

description.en: Generative UI: the model calls render_ui with a React snippet and the answer renders as an interactive card in the conversation. The snippet runs in a sandboxed iframe with an opaque origin, so it cannot read the host page, its storage or its cookies, and the frame CSP blocks the network; a message from a card is only sent after the user confirms it, and a failing card shows its error with the source behind a toggle.
description.zh: 生成式 UI：模型调用 render_ui 写一段 React，回答就地渲染成可交互卡片。代码跑在 opaque origin 的沙箱 iframe 里，读不到宿主页面、存储与 cookie，帧内 CSP 挡掉网络；卡片要发消息必须由用户确认，卡片出错时显示原因、源码放在开关后面。

description.en: Next-prompt suggestions: after each answer it predicts your next message as grey ghost text in the composer. Tab fills it without sending, and the prediction model is selectable.
description.zh: 下一句：每轮回答后预测你的下一条输入，以浅灰 ghost 文本显示在输入框。按 Tab 填入但不发送，预测模型可选。

description.en: Separate font slots for content, code and terminal text, plus an interface font, an interface-size stepper and an inline-code size stepper, with line-height and letter-spacing controls. Typography only — it never touches colour.
description.zh: 内容、代码与终端文字各一个字体槽，另加界面字体、界面字号步进器与行内代码字号步进器，附行距与字距。只改排印，不动配色。

description.en: DSH prompt library and reusable snippets plugin: save, edit, delete, and append prompt templates, workflow instructions, and reusable text from a button beside the composer without sending.
description.zh: DSH 常用内容、提示词收藏与 Prompt 管理插件：在 composer 输入框旁保存、编辑、删除和一键回填常用提示词、Prompt 模板、工作流指令与可复用文本，不自动发送。

description.en: Upload arbitrary local files from the Web composer, show pending cards, and manage stored files in Settings.
description.zh: 从 Web 输入框上传任意本地文件，以待发送卡片展示，并在设置中管理已存文件。

description.en: A long conversation that renders many LaTeX formulas at once can become laggy, because the browser keeps styling, laying out and painting content that is off screen. This plugin applies content-visibility: auto to the off-screen message bodies, so that work is skipped and the lag is reduced.
description.zh: 一段渲染了大量 LaTeX 公式的长会话容易卡顿：屏幕外的消息和公式仍会被浏览器反复计算样式、布局和绘制。本插件给屏幕外的消息体加上 content-visibility: auto，让这部分工作被跳过，卡顿随之减少。

description.en: DSH Web right-side output dock: session-scoped tabs for reports, images, data, video, and audio, with inline previews, output quality checks, and a searchable per-turn history.
description.zh: DSH Web 原生右侧产物栏：按会话管理报告、图片、数据、视频与音频，提供内联预览、产物质检和可按轮次检索的历史目录。

description.en: Local long-term schedule panel: top-bar "日程" text button, today/week/history month-calendar views with stats, completion checkmarks with per-day history, schedule↔conversation links with click-to-jump, recurring tasks (daily/weekly), optional auto carry-over for unfinished one-time tasks, and dailytask_* agent tools.
description.zh: 本地长期日程面板:顶栏「日程」文字按钮、今天/本周/历史月历统计视图、完成打勾(按天记录历史)、日程↔会话链接点击跳转、重复日程(每天/每周)、一次性日程可选未完成自动顺延,以及 dailytask_* agent 工具。

description.en: Manage the left global panel list from Settings → General: show or hide entries, reorder them by dragging in the sidebar or in the dialog, and keep entries that have their own sidebar switch in step with it.
description.zh: 在 设置 → 通用 里集中管理左侧全局面板图标：显示或隐藏、拖动排序；自带侧栏开关的插件，其开关与本插件保持同步。

description.en: Conversation Flow observability for DeepSeek Harness swarms, with topology, routed-message inspection, HITL pauses, Live follow, and child-session navigation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness swarm 的 Conversation Flow 可观测性，支持查看拓扑、检查路由消息、HITL 暂停、Live 跟随和子会话导航。

description.en: A Workspaces-native Recent sessions section for the DSH left sidebar: favorites, running, waiting-for-you and unread sessions at a glance, with a one-click ☆ on every session row, one-line collapse and in-section search. It takes over the sidebar shell (the shipped sidebar package is disabled) and renders the official workspace/session browser inside it; its recent-sessions panel id conflicts with huangxp12/whybebabo, so do not install them together.
description.zh: 像官方「工作区」一样融入左侧栏的「最近会话」分区：收藏、运行中、等待你的回应、完成未读、最近活跃一屏直达；每个会话行 ☆ 一键收藏，可收起到一行、支持就地搜索。它会接管侧栏外壳（禁用官方侧栏包）并在其中原样渲染官方工作区/会话浏览区；其 recent-sessions 面板 id 与 huangxp12/whybebabo 冲突，不要同装。

description.en: Word auto-completion in the Web composer: prefix-matched suggestions sorted by closeness, arrow-key selection and Enter to confirm.
description.zh: 输入框词自动补全：按前缀匹配与接近程度排序弹出当前会话词建议，↑/↓ 选择、回车确认。

description.en: Mobile UI for the Web GUI on narrow screens: full-width responsive layout, overlay session drawer, 44px touch targets, safe-area support, and reading enhancements with zero desktop impact.
description.zh: Web GUI 移动端适配：窄屏全宽响应式布局、会话抽屉、44px 触摸目标、安全区适配与阅读增强，桌面端零影响。

description.en: Adds a non-uniform conversation density map(chat history markers) to the right of the DSH chat area: one tick per turn, with tick length and spacing reflecting message size, clickable to jump to a turn and expanding on hover when crowded.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天区右侧添加非等长非等距对话密度地图（历史聊天标签），一轮对话一个刻度，刻度长度与纵向距离反映消息大小，点击刻度可跳转至对应对话，标签繁杂时鼠标悬停会自动拉伸便于点击。

description.en: Search and insert workspace file and directory paths with `@`, plus a `/h` menu for reusing prompts from the current session.
description.zh: 在组合框中使用 `@` 搜索并插入工作区文件和目录路径，并通过 `/h` 菜单复用当前会话的问题。

description.en: **DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) same-style attachments**: paperclip upload button, 240×64 DS-style file cards with official colored doc icons (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPT/IMG extracted from the DS frontend bundle), drag-and-drop, text extraction (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT) injected into the message, and real attachment cards rendered in the transcript (custom user renderer) with the model reading full content.
description.zh: **DeepSeek Chat（chat.deepseek.com）同款附件**：回形针上传按钮、240×64 DS 风格文件卡片（官方彩色文档图标，从 DS 前端 bundle 提取）、拖拽上传、文本提取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）注入消息、对话流中渲染真实附件卡片（自定义 user 渲染器）且模型读取完整内容。

description.en: Keeps DSH reasoning in Simplified Chinese and auto-expands every Think row in the Web UI.
description.zh: 让 DSH 用简体中文思考，并自动展开 Web 界面里的所有 Think 行，展开的思考块与回复有视觉区分。

description.en: Learning Mode toggle in the input toolbar: injects a teaching prompt into the current session so the assistant introduces a topic, teaches it, tests it, and corrects mistakes, rendering graded quizzes through GenUI. Requires the GenUI plugin (@changfenhuang/dsh-genui); without it the teaching text still works but quizzes, sliders and charts degrade to plain text.
description.zh: 输入框工具栏的学习模式开关：为当前会话注入教学提示词，按「引入知识点—学习—测试—反馈纠错」引导，并用 GenUI 生成可判分的互动测验。需先安装 GenUI 插件（@changfenhuang/dsh-genui）；未安装时教学文字仍生效，但测验、滑块与图表会退化为纯文本。

description.en: Draws circles, arrows, boxes and text on the DSH image preview, keeps every mark selectable so it can be dragged, scaled or re-edited later, and attaches the flattened PNG to the composer at the original image resolution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的图片预览上圈选、画箭头、方框与文字，每一笔都能再选中拖动、缩放或改字，并把原分辨率的标注图作为附件放进输入框。

description.en: Session usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: price, tokens, per-turn curves, and per-answer cost badges.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话用量面板：价格、token、每轮累计曲线，以及每个回答末尾的价格标记。

description.en: Checks in Trae and WorkBuddy daily from local login files, with a sidebar status and credits panel.
description.zh: 从本机登录文件完成 Trae 与 WorkBuddy 每日签到，侧边栏展示状态与积分。

description.en: Usage panel on the blank-session hero: sessions, messages, total tokens, active days, peak hour, favourite model and a contribution heatmap, over all time, 30 days or 7 days.
description.zh: 空白会话首页的用量面板：会话数、消息数、总 token、活跃天数、高峰时段、常用模型与热力图，范围可选全部、30 天或 7 天。

description.en: Settings usage dashboard: tokens, requests, output tokens, and cache-hit rate from session logs, with a stacked chart and a breakdown table by provider, model, or workspace.
description.zh: 设置页用量仪表盘：从会话日志汇总 token、请求、输出 token 与缓存命中率，含堆叠图，并按供应商、模型或工作区分组列表。

description.en: Optional read-only bridge plugin that publishes live dsh session and token statistics as one JSON snapshot for the standalone dsh-minato toolkit to read.
description.zh: 可选的只读桥接插件：把 dsh 的会话与 token 实时统计写成一份 JSON 快照，供独立的 dsh-minato 工具箱读取.

description.en: Displays token usage statistics, daily and weekly heatmaps, activity insights, and model rankings from DSH session logs, with locally persisted aggregates.
description.zh: 根据 DSH 会话日志展示 Token 用量统计、每日与每周热力图、活跃情况和模型排名，并在本地持久保存汇总数据。

description.en: OpenCode Go plan usage display for the DSH web GUI: a persistent badge under the composer shows rolling/weekly/monthly usage percents with reset countdowns; click to expand a card; agents can query the balance via the `opencode_go_usage` tool.
description.zh: OpenCode Go 套餐用量显示：输入框下方常驻徽章显示滚动 / 每周 / 每月用量百分比与重置倒计时，点击展开进度卡片；Agent 可经 `opencode_go_usage` 工具随时查询余额。

description.en: CPA account-pool status panel: sidebar health light, quota bars, success-rate ticks, and gateway key endings.
description.zh: CPA 账号池状态面板：侧栏健康灯、配额进度、成功率刻度与网关密钥末四位一览。

description.en: Agent-structured prompt optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: rewrites composer drafts into role/task/context/constraint/format with normal, slim, and expand modes, a confirm modal with score, continue-optimize, and local, hybrid, DSH, or cloud-API engines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 结构化提示词优化：将输入栏草稿改写为角色/任务/上下文/约束/格式，支持普通/精简/扩写，弹窗含评分与继续优化，引擎可选本地、hybrid、DSH 或云端 API。

description.en: Unofficial fork of dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage (baseline v0.16.0): sidebar balance and quota card for the active model provider, covering DeepSeek, Moonshot, Z.ai, OpenRouter, Kimi, MiniMax and OpenCode, plus Alibaba Cloud voucher balance for qwen-token-plan (BSS OpenAPI with AccessKey) and Xiaomi MiMo console balance with token-plan usage (console cookie). Ships a provider query-status page and per-token unit prices. Do not install it alongside upstream dsh-deepseek-usage: both render the same sidebar card.
description.zh: dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage 的非官方分支（基线 v0.16.0）：侧边栏余额与配额卡片，显示当前模型提供商的账户读数：DeepSeek、Moonshot、Z.ai、OpenRouter、Kimi、MiniMax、OpenCode；并为 qwen-token-plan 读取阿里云代金券余额（BSS OpenAPI + AccessKey），为小米 MiMo 读取控制台余额与套餐用量（控制台 Cookie）。另提供各提供商查询状态页与每 token 单价。不要与上游 dsh-deepseek-usage 同装：两者会渲染同一张侧边栏卡片。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek API account balance and Volcengine Ark Coding/Agent Plan quota windows (5h/weekly/monthly with reset countdowns) in the settings panel, composer dock, and a draggable floating refresh button.
description.zh: 在设置页、输入框下方读数条与可拖动悬浮按钮三处显示 DeepSeek 官方 API 余额与火山方舟 Coding/Agent Plan 套餐额度（5小时/周/月窗口及重置倒计时）。

description.en: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, forked from upstream and repaired to load on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1: mica and compatibility modes with adjustable blur and frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, background brightness, and a master switch that restores the stock UI.
description.zh: Aqua 玻璃质感主题（上游分支，修复以适配 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1）：云母/兼容双模式、可调模糊与磨砂、流体/壁纸背景、背景亮度，以及一键还原原生界面的总开关。

description.en: Paper-and-ink theme with warm surfaces, hairline strokes, near-square corners and a living ASCII koi pond behind the shell; the theme sets no font family, so the shell's own stacks (or your Settings choice) apply.
description.zh: 纸墨主题，提供暖色纸面、细描边和近方形圆角，并在整个界面后方绘制动态 ASCII 锦鲤池；主题不指定字体，沿用 DSH 自带字体栈（或设置中选择的字体）。

description.en: 30 classic open-source theme palettes (Catppuccin, Nord, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox, Solarized, etc.) mapped to official ThemeService tokens for DeepSeek Harness, with a Style Settings panel for live color/font/radius tweaks and JSON export/import for sharing config packs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 30 套经典开源主题配色（Catppuccin、Nord、Tokyo Night、Gruvbox、Solarized 等），映射官方 ThemeService token；带 Style Settings 面板，可实时调整颜色/字体/圆角，并支持 JSON 导出/导入分享配置。

description.en: Claude Design System theme for DeepSeek Harness: warm-grey surfaces and a clay accent, refined composer, sidebar, code blocks and Markdown, localized edit/write cards with workspace-relative paths, and an ASCII ocean on the blank-session page with three whale colour modes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude 设计系统主题：暖灰表面与陶土强调色，细化输入框、侧栏、代码块和 Markdown，编辑与写入卡片显示本地化状态及工作区相对路径，空白会话首页带三种鲸鱼配色的 ASCII 海洋。

description.en: ASCII sharks and schooling fish swim behind the DSH Web interface, with a settings page for veil opacity, shark count, size, fish density, swim speed and grid strength.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面背景中游动的 ASCII 鲨鱼与鱼群，设置页可调遮罩浓度、鲨鱼数量与体型、鱼群密度、游速和网格浓度。

description.en: DSH Background adds custom photo/GIF backgrounds to the DSH Web interface, with adjustable glass, typography, accent colors, aurora, six presets, and portable themes. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or later.
description.zh: DSH Background 可为 DSH Web 界面上传自定义图片或 GIF 背景，并调节毛玻璃、字体、强调色、极光、六套预设与可迁移主题。需 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 及以上。

description.en: Deep-sea skin for the DSH Web UI: an 80-token light/dark theme layer, a two-layer background, a gradient sidebar with a whale sticker, a wordmark that doubles as the skin switch, and a rotating turn-status line.
description.zh: DSH Web 深海皮肤：80 条明暗双值令牌、背景两层、渐变侧栏与鲸鱼娘贴纸；左上角大字标就是皮肤开关，运行中的状态文案每 6 秒轮播。

description.en: Registers local Qoder, QoderCN, OpenCode, Pi and CodeBuddy CLIs as DSH subagent backends, with ordered model fallback, live progress, per-run credit display, a settings page, and slash commands. Requires the corresponding CLI installed and logged in.
description.zh: 把本机 Qoder、QoderCN、OpenCode、Pi、CodeBuddy 等 CLI 注册为 DSH 子代理后端，支持模型故障转移链、实时进度、单次额度显示、设置页与斜杠指令。需先安装并登录对应 CLI。

description.en: Adds models.dev reasoning levels to unconfigured third-party DeepSeek Harness models.
description.zh: 为未配置的第三方 DeepSeek Harness 模型添加 models.dev 推理级别支持。

description.en: Drop-in successor to the now-deleted corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect, keeping its package name, config row id and provider ids so an existing install upgrades in place. Also fixes the 400/11128 channel check by neutralising the DSH identity sentences and scrubbing the product name from system messages, and reads the real Windows client and bundled CLI versions instead of a compiled constant, unlike the functy and community forks. Verified 2026-10-21 on Windows, WorkBuddy 5.8.3, DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 已 404 的 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect 的原地接管版，沿用原来的包名、配置行 id 与 provider id，已装用户可直接升级。同时修复 400/11128 渠道校验（归一化 DSH 身份句并清除 system 消息中的产品名），并改为读取真实的 Windows 客户端与内置 CLI 版本，不再使用编译常量，这一点与 functy、community 两个分叉不同。验证环境（2026-10-21）：Windows、WorkBuddy 5.8.3、DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Unofficial Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider: registers an `ark-coding` route with 12 models (capacity facts measured per model), multi-account with automatic rotation, a bundled pinned arkcli for the official model catalog and live plan quota, plus a settings wizard and a sidebar usage card.
description.zh: 非官方火山方舟 Coding Plan 模型接入插件：注册 `ark-coding` 路由，12 个模型的容量事实逐项实测，多账户自动轮换，内置钉版 arkcli 拉官方模型目录与真实套餐额度，含设置向导与侧边栏用量卡片。

description.en: Assigns a model and reasoning effort to each Agent Teams teammate, from the chat toolbar or a settings page.
description.zh: 为每个 Agent Teams 队友单独指定模型与推理强度，可在聊天工具行或设置页切换。

description.en: LongCat-2.0 LLM adapter: 1M context, binary thinking mode, tool calling, and streaming over the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: LongCat-2.0 模型适配器：100 万上下文、二元思考模式、工具调用，基于 OpenAI 兼容接口的流式输出。

description.en: Hand a DSH web session to the locally installed Claude Code CLI: a per-session engine selector (DSH | Claude Code), Claude models and reasoning effort in the model seat, Claude permission modes in place of the access-mode selector, and permission requests, AskUserQuestion and ExitPlanMode routed to the native DSH approval, question and plan-review cards. The stream is written as native DSH session events, so the built-in transcript, tool cards and nested subagents render it; Claude slash commands merge into the command palette; the CLI is held by a detached broker, so plugin updates and DSH restarts do not interrupt a running turn.
description.zh: 把一个 dsh web 会话交给本机 Claude Code CLI 驱动：输入框内的引擎选择器（DSH | Claude Code）按会话切换，模型座换成 Claude 的模型与 reasoning effort，访问模式换成 Claude 权限档；权限请求、AskUserQuestion、ExitPlanMode 分别接到 dsh 原生的审批卡、提问卡与计划审核卡。Claude 的流写成 dsh 原生会话事件，由内建转录、工具卡片与嵌套子 agent 渲染；斜杠命令并入命令面板；CLI 由独立 broker 持有，插件更新与 dsh 重启都不中断进行中的轮次。

description.en: Reuses stored Responses IDs for continuation, with retry and branch isolation and verified history replay.
description.zh: 复用 Responses 存储 ID 续传，隔离重试与分支，并核对历史回放。

description.en: Discovers OpenRouter's free models, measures their real speed and context size, and writes them into the DeepSeek Harness model list fastest-first, with speed and context in each display name, plus a Settings section to configure and run it.
description.zh: 自动筛选 OpenRouter 免费模型，实测真实速度与上下文大小，并按速度从快到慢写入 DeepSeek Harness 模型列表，模型名中带上速度与上下文，同时在设置中新增「免费模型」配置页。

description.en: The model switch for DSH: point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with curated free/cheap DeepSeek provider presets and automatic fallback when a free tier rate-limits you.
description.zh: DSH 的模型切换器：指向任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，内置精选免费/低价 DeepSeek 服务商预设，免费额度限流时自动回退。

description.en: Import local Codex, Grok, Claude, OpenCode, and CC Switch logins into DSH; pick sources and enable models in Settings.
description.zh: 把本机 Codex / Grok / Claude / OpenCode / CC Switch 登录态导入 DSH，在设置里自选来源并启用模型。

description.en: LLM request retry plugin for DeepSeek Harness: when a model request fails with a configured HTTP status code, machine code, or provider field=value match, it sleeps for the per-rule delay and re-issues the request automatically, so subscription quota and rate-limit errors (429 / insufficient_quota) do not interrupt a run.
description.zh: 大模型请求重试插件：命中配置的 HTTP 状态码、机器码或 provider 返回字段=值时，按该条规则独立配置的时长休眠后自动重新请求，让订阅套餐的限额、限流报错（429 / insufficient_quota）不打断运行。

description.en: Model picker dialog with routing groups: a model that keeps failing hands the turn to the next usable model in its group, and the dialog also carries a metrics dashboard and a free-channel tab. That tab installs six channel plugins — Our Free Model (the only one that needs no login or API key), CodeArts, WorkBuddy, Trae, Qoder and Providers Hub — whose providers cover 23 platforms: Huawei Cloud CodeArts, Tencent CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, Youdao LobsterAI, Qoder, TRAE, Cline, iFlytek Loomy, SenseTime Raccoon, MiniMax, Zhipu ZCode, Gemini Code Assist, Alibaba Accio, iFlytek AStudio, OpenCode, OfficeAce, AutoClaw, ModelScope, Qiniu, Codely, MonkeyCode, Baizhi Cloud and MagiCrew.
description.zh: 模型选择弹窗＋路由分组：模型失败后自动换到组内下一个可用模型并继续本轮；另含数据看板与免费渠道页签。页签一键安装六个渠道插件 —— Our Free Model（唯一不登录、不填 API Key 也能用的）、CodeArts、WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder、Providers Hub，覆盖 23 个平台：华为云 CodeArts、腾讯 CodeBuddy、WorkBuddy、有道 LobsterAI、Qoder、TRAE、Cline、讯飞 Loomy、商汤 Raccoon、MiniMax、智谱 ZCode、Gemini Code Assist、阿里 Accio、讯飞 AStudio、OpenCode、OfficeAce、AutoClaw、魔搭 ModelScope、七牛云 Qiniu、Codely、MonkeyCode、百智云、超级麦吉 MagiCrew 等平台。

description.en: Command Code Provider API chat for DSH with a Host-held API key, discovered model catalog, effort defaults, an optional zero-data-retention header, quota meters, and per-model OpenAI or Anthropic protocol selection.
description.zh: DSH 的 Command Code Provider API 聊天：Host 持有 API key，支持模型发现、effort 默认值、可选零数据保留请求头、额度仪表，以及按模型选择 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 协议。

description.en: Explicit model routing for Main, Subagents, web_search, and image generation, plus a catalog-driven Composer and Plan Review picker with Model, Effort, Context, Fast, and Thinking variants.
description.zh: 显式路由 Main、Subagent、web_search 与图像生成，并提供由模型目录驱动的 Composer/Plan Review Picker，支持 Model、Effort、Context、Fast 与 Thinking 变体。

description.en: Sub-agent matrix swarm that routes heterogeneous tasks to the most suitable model from an OpenRouter-like gateway plus cfgpu.com/llm/square, dispatches each via in-process subagents or direct LLM calls, and tracks per-model token consumption with a feedback-driven ranking.
description.zh: 子智能体矩阵蜂群：把异质任务路由到最合适的模型（OpenRouter 类网关 + cfgpu.com/llm/square），通过进程内子智能体或直接 LLM 调用下放，并按模型统计 token 消耗、用真实反馈驱动排名。

description.en: Settings-UI editor that assigns per-teammate model and reasoning-effort rules for DSH native agent teams, resolved at spawn time by wrapping SubagentRuntime.startContinuable. No official files are modified.
description.zh: 为 DSH 原生 Team 编队队员可视化配置专属模型与推理档位，运行时包装注入，不改官方任何文件。

description.en: Run the main session model on a local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, taking over the llm/stream route for the claude-code provider, with token-level streaming, session resume, and DSH tools bridged in over MCP so they keep DSH sandbox and approval.
description.zh: 让会话主模型跑在本机 Claude Code 订阅上：经官方 Claude Agent SDK 接管 claude-code provider 的 llm/stream 路由，支持 token 级流式、会话 resume 续接，并把 DSH 工具经 MCP 桥接进去以保留 DSH 的沙箱与审批。

description.en: Windows QQ character integration kit for DSH with NapCatQQ/SnowLuma, Bilibili, local GPT-SoVITS voice, revisable memory and a dashboard; development preview requiring companion-service setup.
description.zh: Windows DSH QQ 角色集成包，连接 NapCatQQ / SnowLuma、B站、本地 GPT-SoVITS 语音、可塑记忆与控制台；开发预览，配套服务需另行配置。

description.en: Panel to edit dsh's native AGENTS.md from the web settings page: every layer in the instruction chain is clickable, three activation scopes, and a visual budget meter.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web 设置页里编辑原生 AGENTS.md 的面板：指令链上每层可点选编辑，三种生效范围，并可视化官方指令预算。

description.en: Full-featured record & replay for DSH (works on Windows) from the huahua plugin series: replay every auto-recorded session as a readable timeline, export/import shareable replay packs, re-run conversations in a fresh session, and record screen operations to auto-generate installable SKILL.md skills. Includes a 4-file Windows adaptation of kangshifu1/dsh-record-replay for DSH rc.5 (see README derivative notice).
description.zh: 功能完整的 DSH 录制回放插件（huahua 出品，Windows 实测可用）：会话时间线回放、回放包导出/导入、复刻会话重新执行、录屏自动生成可安装技能。基于 kangshifu1/dsh-record-replay 做 4 处 Windows/rc.5 适配（见 README 衍生声明）。

description.en: Conversation rewind for dsh web: /undo rolls back one turn, /rewind cuts to a past message, and hovering a user bubble offers a visual undo.
description.zh: 对话回退：/undo 回退一轮，/rewind 回退到历史消息，悬浮用户气泡可可视化撤回。

description.en: Continues work across coding agents inside DeepSeek Harness: six sessionflow_* tools query a local session index built by sessionFlow to find past work, show where the current project left off, and hand the goal, files and open items to the next agent. Requires the separate sessionFlow core, installed from its GitHub repo. Everything stays local — no cloud, no telemetry.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里跨编码 Agent 继续工作：六个 sessionflow_* 工具查询 sessionFlow 构建的本地会话索引，找回过去的工作、看清当前项目做到哪了，并把目标、涉及文件与未完成事项交给下一个 Agent。需要另行安装独立的 sessionFlow 核心（见其 GitHub 仓库）。全程本地运行——无云端、无遥测。

description.en: Context curation for DeepSeek Harness: content-aware tool-output slimming, dead-log sweep, pinned user requirements and in-flight work, archive-then-compact with an audit trail.
description.zh: 自动上下文策展：tool 输出内容感知瘦身、无效日志清理、用户要求与进行中工作钉扎保护、先归档后压缩，全程审计留痕。

description.en: Diagnose, unstick, and read DSH sessions: list sessions with agent status, read conversations, diagnose stuck agents, recover them with cancel+keepInbox, and send messages to other sessions.
description.zh: 会话医生：列出会话（含 agent 运行状态）、读取会话记录、诊断卡死的 agent、解卡（cancel + keepInbox 保留排队消息）、向其他会话发送消息。

description.en: Edit user and built-in system-prompt sections with live preview.
description.zh: 带实时预览的用户/内置 system prompt 分节编辑器。

description.en: Session progress tracking for DeepSeek Harness, without digging through the logs: the agent keeps a live nested checklist of the work — from a whole phase down to a single step — and every item carries a weight, so the ring and the % pill in the composer dock row always match reality. Hover it for the current activity, or open the Session Progress tab in the native right sidebar for the goal, the weighted checklist with per-item shares, the next steps and the working notes; when the session ends, the same checklist stands as a clean record of what got done.
description.zh: 不用再翻日志，也能随时知道 DeepSeek Harness 的会话做到哪一步了：agent 维护一份实时嵌套清单——从整个阶段到单个步骤——每一项都带权重，所以输入框下方 dock 行的进度环与百分比胶囊始终反映真实进度。悬停可看当前活动，或打开原生右侧边栏的 Session Progress 标签页，查看目标、带单项占比的加权清单、后续步骤与工作备注；会话结束时，它就是一份清晰的工作记录。

description.en: Configurable template-based session titles with a type vocabulary, AGENTS naming guidance, historical backfill, and explicit rename and refresh tools.
description.zh: 按模板生成会话标题：支持类型词表、AGENTS 命名指导、历史回填，以及显式改名与刷新工具。

description.en: Preview conversation context and selectively keep, summarize, or omit exchange groups before applying persistent compaction through Harness session services.
description.zh: 预览会话上下文，按对话分组选择保留、摘要或省略，确认后通过 Harness 会话服务持久化压缩结果。

description.en: Task-scoped Workspace to Task to Session control center for DSH Web, with Session boards, archived conversation viewing, and bounded long-term memory shared across linked Sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的任务级 Workspace 到 Task 到 Session 协作控制台，提供 Session 看板、归档对话查看，以及在关联 Session 之间共享的有界长期记忆。

description.en: A searchable, workspace-grouped multi-select panel over DSH conversations for batch delete, archive and pin, with Shift-range and Ctrl-add selection.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话加入可搜索、按工作区分组的多选面板，支持 Shift 范围选择与 Ctrl/Cmd 追加选择，然后批量删除、归档或置顶。

description.en: Reading archive for dsh: after reading open-source code, capture quick notes or write full deep notes that group into one card per repo / file / symbol, stored as an append-only log of Markdown notes you can open in Obsidian; query your history, browse recent reads, or search your own Obsidian vault and link related notes to a reading record. Nine tools, a /codevault command, and a code-reading skill.
description.zh: 读开源代码后记一笔的档案：快记或深读笔记按 仓库/文件/符号 归并成一张卡，追加式落盘为可放进 Obsidian 的 Markdown 笔记；可检索历史、回看最近阅读，也能搜你自己 Obsidian 里的笔记、把相关笔记挂到阅读记录上。共 9 个工具、/codevault 命令与 code-reading 技能。

description.en: Fully local long-term memory for dsh: cross-conversation and cross-project, stored as a single JSON file on your machine with no network calls, no model calls and no API key. Ships memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_forget and memory_review tools, keyword-and-tag recall injected before each turn with adjustable ranking weights, Markdown import (including Kun and Hermes Agent formats) and export (native and Hermes Agent formats), and a settings page to browse and edit memories.
description.zh: 纯本地长期记忆：跨对话、跨项目，数据只存本机一个 JSON 文件，不联网、不调大模型、不需要 API key。提供 memory_save / memory_search / memory_list / memory_forget / memory_review 五个工具；每轮按关键词与标签检索并注入相关记忆，检索权重可调；支持 Markdown 导入（含 Kun 与 Hermes Agent 格式）与导出（原生与 Hermes Agent 格式）；设置页可直接浏览与编辑记忆。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH stored as plain Markdown. Real user/assistant exchanges are captured into daily session files without a model call; an LLM pass then distils them into memories that are injected into the system prompt each turn. Retrieval is local (CJK bigram + BM25) in three levels — index, summary, full text — so the model only pays for the detail it asks for. Memories carry priorities; P0 and user-written entries are never changed automatically, and forgetting marks an entry stale instead of deleting it, so the whole chain stays auditable in status.md. Six tools cover recall, write, status, extract, feedback and the skill library; when a cluster of memories is ready to become a skill, a card appears at the end of the turn, writes the SKILL.md on click, and installs it only after you approve. Learning is on by default and follows the conversation model; turning the master switch off stops the LLM entirely while capture keeps working. Failures are surfaced in the prompt and in status.md instead of being swallowed. Pure JavaScript, no third-party runtime dependencies beyond the harness packages.
description.zh: DSH 的长期记忆，全部存成纯文本 Markdown。真实的用户/助手对话会零模型调用地落进按天切分的会话文件，再由一轮 LLM 抽取沉淀成记忆，每轮注入系统提示。检索在本地完成（中文二元组 + BM25），分索引、摘要、全文三级，模型只为它真正要看的细节付费。记忆带优先级；P0 与用户手写的条目永不被自动改动，遗忘是把条目标记为 stale 而不是删除，整条链路都能在 status.md 里审计。六个工具覆盖检索、写入、状态、抽取、反馈与技能库；当一组记忆够格变成技能时，回合尾部会出现一张卡片，点一下当场写出 SKILL.md，经你确认后才装进技能库。学习默认开启并跟随对话模型；关掉总开关即完全不用 LLM，而原始问答照样落盘。失败会写进提示与 status.md，不会被吞掉。纯 JavaScript，除 harness 自带包外无第三方运行时依赖。

description.en: Three-layer local memory for DeepSeek Harness: L1 snapshot memory (MEMORY.md/USER.md) read on demand through the memory_* tools + L2 searchable knowledge base (facts + SQLite FTS5, Chinese search via sliding-window tokenization) + L3 import from Hermes/Claude Code/Codex/WorkBuddy and from approved Agent Hub documents (memory/global, memory/projects, accepted decisions) with content-hash dedup. v0.2.0 removed every automatic injection: memory enters the context only when the model calls one of the 12 memory_* tools, and data stays on the local drive.
description.zh: DSH 本地混合记忆插件：L1 快照（MEMORY.md/USER.md，由 memory_* 工具按需读取）+ L2 可检索知识库（facts + SQLite FTS5，滑窗分词支持中文检索）+ L3 从 Hermes/Claude Code/Codex/WorkBuddy 以及 Agent Hub 已批准文档（memory/global、memory/projects、accepted decisions）导入，内容哈希去重。v0.2.0 已移除全部自动注入：记忆只在模型调用 12 个 memory_* 工具之一时才进入上下文，数据全部留在本地。

description.en: An accumulated design-taste corpus for DSH agents: feed good and bad examples, distill principles, and review new designs against learned judgment rather than a fixed ruleset.
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的积累型设计品味语料库：喂好坏例子、提炼原则，用学到的判断评审新设计，而不是套固定规则。

description.en: Local-memory lifecycle for the official Hindsight plugin on DSH desktop: one-click start/stop of the hindsight-embed daemon, auto-start on boot, stop on exit, hides the uv.exe console window, and installs the vault/models to another drive.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端官方 Hindsight 插件补齐本地记忆生命周期：一键启停 hindsight-embed 守护进程、开机自启、退出随停、隐藏 uv.exe 黑框，并支持把档案柜与模型装到其它盘。

description.en: Vector + graph memory backend: observe/remember/search/recall tools against a local memoria server, fusing HNSW semantic recall, FTS5 keyword search, and knowledge-graph signals via RRF ranking, with automatic turn-end persistence and per-agent namespace isolation.
description.zh: 向量+图记忆后端：observe/remember/search/recall 四个工具对接本地 memoria 服务，HNSW 语义召回 + FTS5 关键词 + 知识图谱信号经 RRF 融合排序，回合结束自动写入，按 Agent 命名空间隔离。

description.en: Fully local vector memory for DSH: local embeddings, SQLite storage, automatic recall injection, dedup with conflict detection, soft-delete recycle bin, online backup, and optional LLM extraction.
description.zh: DSH 全本地向量记忆:本地 embedding、SQLite 存储、自动召回注入、去重与冲突检测、软删除回收站、在线备份,可选 LLM 提取。

description.en: Three-tier agent memory harness: L1 always-on CLAUDE.md, L2 index, L3 detail skeleton with templates, a gate that blocks writes to protected files without a one-time approval token, zero-judgement event logging, weekly distillation, and a TDD execution-loop skill.
description.zh: 三级记忆 agent 底座：L1 常驻层、L2 索引、L3 详情骨架与模板，受保护文件门禁（一次性审批令牌），零判断事件日志，周审提炼与 TDD 执行流技能。

description.en: Local-first experience library for DeepSeek Harness: error-signature retrieval, pre-step recall hints, failure-to-fix drafts, gap-to-entry closure, and a full-page library view. Ships a sanitized starter library. No model calls, no network.
description.zh: 本地优先的经验库：给 DeepSeek Harness 的索引化 markdown 知识，支持错误签名检索、开口前召回、失败→修复起草、缺口→条目闭环与整页浏览视图；自带脱敏起步库，不调模型、不联网。

description.en: Cross-session memory kept as a short Markdown living document that is rewritten in full at the end of every turn, written to by model tools, the page, and automatic rewriting alike.
description.zh: 把跨会话记忆写成一份简短可读的 Markdown 活文档，每轮对话结束后整个重写；模型工具、页面手写与自动改写都写进同一批文件。

description.en: Siemens NX integration for dsh on Windows (requires a local Siemens NX install; tested only with NX 2512, and the FE tools need Simulation/Nastran licences): 71 tools that build and edit solids, surfaces, sketches, holes and tubes, run NX Nastran statics and modal studies, roll up assembly BOMs with pairwise clearance checks, and print A3 sheets with a real GB frame to PDF, all in a background NX session driven by JSON commands.
description.zh: 把 Siemens NX 接进 dsh（仅 Windows，需本机已装 Siemens NX，且只在 NX 2512 上验证；有限元工具另需 Simulation / Nastran 许可）：71 个工具覆盖实体建模、曲面闭环、同步建模、孔型与管路、Nastran 静力与模态、装配 BOM 与逐对间隙检查、A3 图纸与 GB 图框出 PDF，全部通过 JSON 命令驱动后台 NX 会话执行。

description.en: Mounts the mcptoon MCP gateway as one stdio server, so the agent discovers the tools of every MCP server you have configured through mcptoon's compressed view instead of full JSON schemas on each turn. Ships a doctor CLI that checks the mcptoon executable resolves and prints the exact command/args override when it does not.
description.zh: 把 mcptoon 作为一条 stdio MCP 服务接入，让 agent 通过 mcptoon 的压缩视图发现已配置 MCP server 的工具，而非每轮支付完整 JSON schema。附带 doctor CLI：校验 mcptoon 可执行文件能否解析，不能时打印精确的 command/args 覆盖配置。

description.en: Query local log files with Chinese natural-language time expressions (e.g. "yesterday afternoon", "3 hours ago") — precise time range, matched lines, ERROR/WARN/INFO level stats, fully offline.
description.zh: 用中文自然语言时间描述查询本地日志（如「昨天下午」「3小时前」）——精确时间范围、匹配行、级别统计，完全离线。

description.en: Session execution analytics: steps, tool calls, failures, repeated actions, token usage and verification signals, rendered as text/Markdown/JSON reports.
description.zh: 会话执行分析：步骤、工具调用、失败、重复动作、token 用量与验证信号，输出 text/Markdown/JSON 报告。

description.en: Evidence-first vulnerability research workbench for DeepSeek Harness: native audit views, 29 OMV tools, Evidence.v1 findings, reproducible runs, Campaign workflows, and isolated PoC evidence.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据优先漏洞研究工作台：原生审计视图、29 个 OMV 工具、Evidence.v1 Finding、可复现 Run、Campaign 工作流和隔离 PoC 证据。

description.en: Zero-dependency MCP client bridge that connects stdio and HTTP MCP servers and registers their tools as mcp_<server>_<tool> for the agent.
description.zh: 零依赖 MCP 客户端桥接，连接 stdio 与 HTTP MCP server，把其工具注册为 mcp_<server>_<tool> 供 agent 调用。

description.en: Make DSH follow your system network settings: route through the OS proxy and trust its certificate store, so TLS-intercepting accelerators work without environment variables or a restart.
description.zh: 让 DSH 跟随系统网络设置：走系统代理并信任系统证书库，无需环境变量、无需重启。

description.en: Agent trajectory governance and anomaly diagnosis: rebuilds flat session logs into multi-branch trajectory trees, detects loop deadlock, invalid retry, and goal drift, alerts with cost attribution, one-click interrupt and breakpoint fork via official APIs, independent GUI tab.
description.zh: Agent 轨迹治理与异常诊断：把平铺会话日志重建为多分支轨迹树，识别循环死锁/无效重试/目标漂移，带成本归因的告警与一键中断/断点分支（官方 API），独立 GUI Tab。

description.en: Polymarket toolkit for DeepSeek Harness and Claude Code: market-data tools for Gamma/CLOB/Data-API (31 model tools in DSH; read-only subset exposed over MCP), opt-in authenticated trading tools, WebSocket stream service, and an embedded Polymarket knowhow skill.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 与 Claude Code 的 Polymarket 工具包：Gamma/CLOB/Data-API 行情工具（DSH 内 31 个模型工具，MCP 只暴露只读子集）、需显式开启的带鉴权交易工具、WebSocket 推流服务，以及内置的 Polymarket 知识技能。

description.en: Runs DSH's stock bash tool on Git Bash for Windows, so commands go straight to bash -c instead of being re-parsed by the pwsh tool.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上把 DSH 原版 bash 工具挂到 Git Bash 上运行，命令直达 bash -c，不再经 pwsh 工具二次解析。

description.en: Nine consolidated tools that give agents full access to the stool ops CLI: server management, database query/redis, log search/tail, CI/CD deploy and history, MFA codes, git operations, notes, todos, and misc utilities (accounting, weekly reports, audit, project listing, nginx presets).
description.zh: 将 stool 运维 CLI 的全部能力整合为 9 个合并工具，Agent 可直接调用：服务器管理、数据库查询与 Redis、日志搜索与尾部查看、CI/CD 部署与历史、MFA 动态码、Git 仓库操作、笔记管理、待办任务，以及记账、周报、审计、项目列表、Nginx 预设等杂项工具。

description.en: Content workshop tools for DSH — topic, title, post and content-calendar generation through the built-in LLM.
description.zh: 内容工坊——选题、标题、文案与排期生成工具，直接调用内置 LLM。

description.en: Git Bash as the default shell on Windows. Resolves bash.exe from git --exec-path (never the WSL stub), exposes a run_shell tool, and degrades visibly instead of disappearing when Git Bash is missing.
description.zh: Windows 上的 Git Bash 默认 shell。从 git --exec-path 定位 bash.exe（不用 WSL 的 bash），提供 run_shell 工具；找不到 Git Bash 时明确降级，而不是让插件消失。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness rate-limiting plugin that prevents API 429 errors during long-running tasks, with task retrospectives.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 限流插件：长程任务自动控速避免 429，支持任务复盘。

description.en: Lets sandboxed agents reach the web through your local proxy: net_fetch fetches pages, net_proxy_status reports proxy status.
description.zh: 让沙箱里的 agent 通过你的本地代理联网：net_fetch 抓取网页，net_proxy_status 查看代理状态。

description.en: Xcode AI integration for DSH: 26 Xcode MCP tools (mcpbridge) + Apple platform skills + Xcode Intelligence-style persona (agent preset or global bundle).
description.zh: DSH 的 Xcode AI 集成：26 个 Xcode MCP 工具（mcpbridge）+ Apple 平台技能 + Xcode Intelligence 风格 persona（agent preset 或全局 bundle）。

description.en: Local code knowledge graph for agents: parse a codebase (Python/JS/TS/Go/Java/Rust) into a SQLite index and answer callers, callees, deps, dependents, impact and full-text questions over it.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的本地代码知识图谱：把代码库（Python/JS/TS/Go/Java/Rust）解析进 SQLite 索引，回答调用者、被调用者、依赖、反向依赖、影响面与全文检索问题。

description.en: Windows desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: update checker, server start/stop, system tray, graphical console, and one-click installer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面伴侣：更新检查、服务器启停、系统托盘、图形控制台与一键安装。

description.en: Adds session, project, and global controls in the DSH WebUI for skills, MCP servers, tools, prompt injections, approval escalation, and safety guards; enforcement is scoped to the current agent.
description.zh: 在 DSH WebUI 中为技能、MCP 服务器、工具、提示词注入、审批升权和安全守卫提供会话、项目与全局三级控制，并在当前 agent 作用域内强制执行。

description.en: Read-only audit of the local CLI toolchain as a sidebar panel in the DSH web GUI: lists installed versions across Homebrew, npm global, pip, Rust/Bun/uv and self-updating CLIs, flags which ones have a newer release available, and shows the dependency impact for installed packages. It reports only and never runs an upgrade, so no tool on the machine is modified. The DSH plugin ships on npm as `dsh-cli-doctor`.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的只读 CLI 工具链体检面板：按生态列出 Homebrew、npm 全局、pip、 Rust/Bun/uv 与自更新类 CLI 的本机版本，标出哪些有可用更新，并展示已安装包 的依赖影响。只报不升，不会改动本机任何工具。DSH 插件在 npm 上以 `dsh-cli-doctor` 发布。

description.en: Sticker/emoji expression for assistants: emotion-driven auto-matching, library management, AI image tagging, dialects, style mimicry, and chat-based tag refinement.
description.zh: 表情包表达插件：让助手用表情包表达情绪，按情绪自动配图，含图库管理、AI 识图打标、方言口音、学我说话，还能点「和助手聊聊」直接调教标签。

description.en: Structured comparison and unified diffs for text/JSON/CSV/Markdown.
description.zh: 文本/JSON/CSV/Markdown 结构化比较与 unified diff。

description.en: JSON queries with a JMESPath subset.
description.zh: JMESPath 子集 JSON 查询。

description.en: Test/extract/safe-replace/statically explain regexes without executing code.
description.zh: 正则测试/提取/安全替换/静态解释（不执行代码）。

description.en: JSON Schema validation: validate/paths/explain/normalize.
description.zh: JSON Schema 验证：validate/paths/explain/normalize。

description.en: Strict ISO 8601 parsing, IANA timezone conversion, and UTC calendar arithmetic.
description.zh: 严格 ISO 8601 解析、IANA 时区转换、UTC 日历运算。

description.en: MuApi media-generation tool: a muapi_generate tool that submits and polls jobs against any of MuApi's 100+ image, video, audio, and 3D models through one x-api-key.
description.zh: MuApi 媒体生成工具：muapi_generate 工具通过一个 x-api-key 提交并轮询 MuApi 100 多个图片、视频、音频与 3D 模型的生成任务。

description.en: Batch recursive extraction: magic-byte format detection (disguised extensions), nested archive auto-unroll, multi-password pool with per-layer dynamic discovery, SFX/split-volume pairing.
description.zh: 批量递归解压：魔数识别真实格式（伪装后缀/无后缀/乱序后缀）、嵌套压缩包自动解到底、多密码池+层内动态发现（"第二层密码:xxx"）、SFX/分卷自动配对、工具运行库目录防误递归。

description.en: EPLAN Electric P8 automation for DeepSeek Harness (Windows): a bundled eplan-mcp server drives the running P8 2025 instance through the EPLAN Remote Client interface, a settings page sets the EPLAN install root, and five skills cover connection and safety, C# scripting, documentation lookup, EEC Pro development and setup. Five offline SQLite documentation indexes (P8 2025 API reference, P8 2025 platform help, P8 2026, P8 2027, EEC Pro 2026) answer questions without network access, but they are not shipped in the repository: download the release zip or build them with the included scripts; the P8 2026 and P8 2027 rows ship disabled. Requires EPLAN P8 2025 with Remote Client access enabled and Python 3.12+ with mcp and pythonnet (run scripts\setup.ps1 once). A version panel records releases and applies a newer one from the repository.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 EPLAN Electric P8 自动化插件（仅 Windows）：内置 eplan-mcp 通过 EPLAN Remote Client 接口驱动正在运行的 P8 2025，设置页配置 EPLAN 安装根目录，五个技能覆盖连接与安全、C# 脚本、文档查阅、EEC Pro 开发与安装排错。五套离线 SQLite 文档索引（P8 2025 API 参考、P8 2025 平台帮助、P8 2026、P8 2027、EEC Pro 2026）可在断网状态下检索，但索引不随仓库提供：需下载 Release 里的索引压缩包，或用自带脚本自行构建；2026 与 2027 两行默认关闭。需已安装 EPLAN P8 2025 并开启 Remote Client 远程访问，以及带 mcp 与 pythonnet 的 Python 3.12+（先运行一次 scripts\setup.ps1）。版本面板记录发布历史，并可从仓库直接更新到较新版本。

description.en: Run a read-only Dameng DM8 database inspection with 85 checks and produce an HTML report.
description.zh: 只读巡检达梦 DM8 数据库：85 项检查项，生成 HTML 报告。

description.en: Fork of fourzkw/dsh-drawai that keeps the editable .drawio canvas and its two agent tools, and adds a second vectorization engine beside the original tracer: hierarchical color clustering with Bezier spline fitting and per-channel color precision, selectable per drawing task in three fidelity levels (measured about 18, 38 and 46 dB PSNR on the same 1920x1080 frame (the upstream engine scores about 26 dB on that frame)), with worker parallelism raised to half the logical cores instead of a cap of four. The original tracer stays the default and remains the right choice for whole videos, where the new engine produces files hundreds of times larger.
description.zh: fork 自 fourzkw/dsh-drawai，保留 .drawio 可编辑画布与两个模型工具，并在原版描边之外新增第二套矢量化引擎：分层颜色聚类 + 贝塞尔样条拟合 + 每通道色彩精度，绘制任务可选三档保真度（同一 1920×1080 帧实测约 18 / 38 / 46 dB PSNR（上游引擎同帧约 26 dB）），并行度提升为逻辑核心数的一半（不再封顶 4）。原版描边仍是默认引擎，也是整段视频的正确选择——新引擎在视频上产物会大出数百倍。

description.en: SketchUp Pro 2023 bridge for DeepSeek Harness that lets the agent inspect a live model, run Ruby task scripts, save .skp files and capture viewport PNGs.
description.zh: SketchUp Pro 2023 桥接插件：让 Agent 检查实时模型、执行 Ruby 任务脚本、保存 .skp 并截取视口 PNG。

description.en: Unit conversion toolbox covering 20 categories — length, mass, temperature, area, volume (incl. US cooking units), speed, time, data sizes (decimal MB vs binary MiB), data transfer rates (Mbps vs MB/s), acceleration incl. g-force, illumination (lux / foot-candle), pressure, energy, angle, frequency, power incl. three horsepower definitions, force, torque, typography (px/pt/em/rem), and fuel economy (mpg ↔ L/100km). Two tools — convert_unit and list_units — zero runtime dependencies, pure arithmetic; each result includes the formula applied.
