description.zh: 单位换算工具箱：覆盖 20 个类别——长度、质量、温度、面积、体积（含美制烹饪单位）、速度、时长、数据大小（十进制 MB 与二进制 MiB）、数据传输速率（Mbps 与 MB/s）、加速度（含 g-force）、照度（lux 与英尺烛光）、压强、能量、角度、频率、功率（含三种马力定义）、力、扭矩、排版（px/pt/em/rem）与油耗（mpg ↔ L/100km）。提供 convert_unit 与 list_units 两个工具；零运行时依赖，纯算术实现，结果附带所用公式。

description.en: Web reading tools for text-only agents. Five read-only tools: web_fetch (any URL rendered as clean Markdown or plain text), web_links (inventory of a page's links), web_feed (RSS 2.0 / Atom entries), web_headers (HTTP status, response headers and redirect chain without downloading the body, HEAD with automatic GET fallback), and web_table (HTML tables extracted as structured rows with header detection and colspan/rowspan grid expansion). Transport is Node fetch plus a zero-dependency HTTP proxy implementation (CONNECT tunnelling, absolute-URI requests, NO_PROXY with suffix/wildcard/IPv4-CIDR matching, Proxy-Authorization). Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 纯文本 agent 的网页阅读工具。五个只读工具：web_fetch（把任意 URL 渲染成干净的 Markdown 或纯文本）、web_links（清单页内链接）、web_feed（RSS 2.0 / Atom 条目解析）、web_headers（不下正文即取 HTTP 状态、响应头与重定向链，HEAD 失败自动回退 GET）、web_table（把 HTML 表格抽成结构化行，含表头识别与 colspan/rowspan 网格展开）。传输层为 Node fetch 加一套零依赖 HTTP 代理实现（CONNECT 隧道、绝对 URI 请求、NO_PROXY 的后缀/通配/IPv4 CIDR 匹配、Proxy-Authorization）。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Fetches random cat facts and images from public APIs for AI agents.
description.zh: 为 AI 代理从公开 API 获取随机猫咪冷知识与猫图。

description.en: 3D printing & additive manufacturing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: parametric STL generation, calibration G-code, STL/G-code analysis, toolpath rendering and PrusaSlicer bridge, plus 5 skills and a concise persona optimized for local models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 3D 打印与增材制造插件：参数化 STL 生成、校准 G-code、STL/G-code 分析、刀路可视化、PrusaSlicer 桥接，含 5 个技能与面向本地小模型的精简 persona。

description.en: Astronomy research workbench for DSH and Codex: NADC terms, reference library, writing, scoring, author confirmation, recommended books, FITS/XML formats, and analysis guides.
description.zh: 面向天文的 DSH/Codex 研究工作台：NADC 术语、参考文献库、写作、评分、作者确认、推荐书籍、FITS/XML 格式与分析引导。

description.en: Connects seven Wind financial MCP domains and Wind Alice to DSH while resolving WIND_API_KEY only inside the host credential boundary.
description.zh: 将 Wind 七个金融 MCP 域和 Wind Alice 接入 DSH，并仅在宿主凭证边界内解析 WIND_API_KEY。

description.en: Local knowledge base manager for DSH agents: multi-format import, CJK-aware chunking, sqlite-vec vector + BM25 hybrid search with bge-reranker-base rerank, snapshots, kbpack export/import and cross-KB search — 22 agent tools plus a Web panel.
description.zh: 本地知识库管理：多格式导入、CJK 感知分块、sqlite-vec 向量 + BM25 混合检索与 bge-reranker-base 重排序、快照恢复、kbpack 导入导出与跨库检索，提供 22 个 agent 工具与 Web 面板。

description.en: Bridges a local MATLAB MCP server into DSH: evaluate MATLAB code, run .m scripts and tests, and inspect installed toolboxes via mcp__matlab__* tools. Requires MATLAB and the MathWorks MATLAB MCP Server binary, and a path edit after install — the plugin on its own registers no tools.
description.zh: 将本地 MATLAB MCP server 桥接进 DSH，提供 mcp__matlab__* 工具：执行 MATLAB 代码、运行 .m 脚本与测试、查看已安装工具箱。需要自备 MATLAB 与 MathWorks 官方 MATLAB MCP Server 可执行文件，且安装后需填一次路径——只装插件不会出现工具。

description.en: Query 64 Chinese exams (高考/考研/四六级/CPA/法考…) with rule-aware date math (2nd-Saturday, 1st-Sunday) and countdowns.
description.zh: 查询 64 场中国考试（高考/考研/四六级/CPA/法考…）的规则日期（第二个周六、第一个周日）与倒计时。

description.en: Compile SVG paths and keyframe specs into self-contained Lottie JSON animation files.
description.zh: 将 SVG 路径与关键帧参数编译成自包含的 Lottie JSON 动画文件。

description.en: Injects WSL distro, Linux path mapping, /mnt/c CRLF and git caveats, and NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY into the system prompt.
description.zh: 向 system prompt 注入 WSL 发行版、Linux 路径映射、/mnt/c 的 CRLF 与 git 注意点，以及 NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY。

description.en: Opens WSL Linux paths from DeepSeek Harness chat in the Windows default app or Explorer.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 聊天里的 WSL Linux 路径在 Windows 默认程序或资源管理器中打开。

description.en: Windows desktop shortcut and system-tray launcher for DSH running in WSL, with fully hidden startup, tray open/restart/exit menu, and a plugin-configuration card to manage the shortcut.
description.zh: 为运行在 WSL 的 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面快捷方式和系统托盘启动器：完全隐藏启动，托盘菜单支持打开/重启/退出，插件配置页可管理快捷方式。

description.en: Embeds external AI chat sites in a DSH side panel through the same-origin reverse proxy with per-site DOM adapters, and adds a composer button that either rewrites the draft with the host model or runs a two-round loop: compress the conversation, optimize, send to the embedded site, capture the reply, then finalize it into the composer.
description.zh: 通过同源反向代理把外部 AI 对话站点嵌进 DSH 右侧面板（DOM 适配器写在配置里，站点改版无需改代码），并在输入框旁加一个按钮：要么用宿主模型改写草稿，要么跑一轮闭环——压缩对话、优化、发送到嵌入站点、捕获回复、整理成终稿写回输入框。

description.en: Drive the user's real browser through the local Kimi WebBridge daemon: navigate, find-tab, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate, CDP, screenshot, network, upload, PDF export and tab-management tools that reuse existing login sessions.
description.zh: 通过本地 Kimi WebBridge 守护进程驱动用户的真实浏览器：navigate、find-tab、snapshot、click、fill、evaluate、CDP、screenshot、network、upload、PDF 导出与标签管理工具，复用浏览器已登录会话。

description.en: Mounts Microsoft's Playwright MCP through the official dsh-mcp-client so the agent gets its browser tools over stdio; the one-time CDP authorization is guided by a prompt note, a call guard and the /bw-setup command.
description.zh: 通过官方 dsh-mcp-client 挂载微软的 Playwright MCP，把浏览器工具以 stdio 接入智能体；一次性的 CDP 授权由提示注入、调用拦截与 /bw-setup 命令引导完成。

description.en: Registers a real-browser URL-to-text MCP server in a DSH profile: fetch_url and fetch_urls render JavaScript-heavy and anti-bot Chinese pages (Zhihu, CSDN, Juejin, cnblogs) and return clean article text as JSON with per-tier diagnostics, and crawler_status reports whether the browser is available. Needs a one-time Python dependency setup after install.
description.zh: 把真实浏览器抓取注册进 DSH profile：fetch_url 与 fetch_urls 渲染 JS 页面与中文反爬站点（知乎、CSDN、掘金、博客园），返回带分层诊断的干净正文 JSON，crawler_status 报告浏览器是否可用。装好后需要一次性安装 Python 依赖。

description.en: Per-route video input for DSH: native video on capable routes, a storyboard fallback for image-only routes, and explicit failures otherwise, without registering another provider.
description.zh: 按当前路由处理视频输入：原生支持则发送视频，仅支持图片则生成 storyboard，两者都不支持则明确失败；不注册额外 provider。

description.en: Advertise image paste on text-only DeepSeek routes, describe attachments with a vision sidecar, and leave native vision models untouched.
description.zh: 在纯文本 DeepSeek 线路上开放贴图准入，用视觉 sidecar 把附件转成文字，原生视觉模型不改写。

description.en: Integrated visual creation toolchain for DSH: prompt reverse-engineering and audit optimization plus multi-provider image generation with async background rendering.
description.zh: DSH 一体化视觉创作工具链：提示词反推与审计优化，多供应商生图，支持异步后台出图。

description.en: Agent-callable vision tool that describes local images via any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint you configure, with an optional multi-model cross-check and no built-in keys.
description.zh: Agent 可调用的视觉工具：通过你配置的任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点描述本地图片，支持多模型交叉核对，不内置任何密钥。

description.en: Image understanding for any DSH model: vision, OCR, grounding, and crop tools with domain presets for histopathology, cell biology, anatomy, clinical images and scientific figures.
description.zh: 让任意 DSH 模型都能识图：提供 vision/OCR/定位/裁剪四件套工具，内置病理、细胞、解剖、临床与科研统计图等专业预设。

description.en: Voice notes in, spoken answers out: dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), local-first under ~/.dsh/voice.
description.zh: 语音输入、语音输出：把口述音频转写为用户消息（transcribe），让 agent 朗读回复（speak），本地优先，音频存于 ~/.dsh/voice。

description.en: Voice input for the Web UI: a mic button that drives local VocoType offline speech recognition and auto-inserts recognized text into the composer (auto-deploy, dedupe, continuous dictation).
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：输入框麦克风按钮驱动本地 VocoType 离线识别，识别结果自动插入输入框（自动部署/防重复/持续输入）。

description.en: Microphone voice input for the composer: browser Web Speech API live transcription, dedupe/auto-continue, smart punctuation, language and auto-send settings.
description.zh: 输入框麦克风语音输入：浏览器 Web Speech API 实时转写，自动去重/续听、智能标点，支持语言与自动发送设置。

description.en: Free lip-sync video generation plugin for DSH with 3000+ voices and 500+ languages.
description.zh: DSH 免费对口型口语视频生成插件，支持 3000+ 声音和 500+ 语言。

description.en: Obsidian-style Markdown workbench for DSH: browse, edit, preview, create, move, and delete notes inside the selected local vault.
description.zh: DSH 内的 Obsidian 风格 Markdown 工作台：浏览、编辑、预览、创建、移动和删除所选本地仓库中的笔记。

description.en: LaTeX studio for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: a portable MiKTeX engine (xelatex / pdflatex) behind a conversation tab and a web editor with a formula panel, plus compile, PDF preview and download. The engine installs on first use; nothing is written to the registry or PATH.
description.zh: LaTeX 工作室（Windows）：便携 MiKTeX（xelatex / pdflatex）引擎，提供会话页签、带公式面板的网页编辑器，以及编译、PDF 预览与下载；首次使用时一键安装引擎，不写注册表、不改 PATH。

description.en: Builds presentations by driving the LibreOffice installed on the machine over UNO instead of writing OOXML in JavaScript: `lo_build` opens a real Impress document from structured slides and lets LibreOffice export editable PPTX/ODP plus PDF and per-slide PNG, `lo_render` re-renders an existing PPTX/PPT/ODP, `lo_convert` converts between Office formats, `lo_probe` reports the detected soffice path, version and UNO bridge, and `lo_config` edits the stored settings. Needs a local LibreOffice (verified on 26.8.1.1); it uses the bundled Python, so no system Python is needed, and it keeps one warm soffice process between calls. Fully verified on Windows only; on Linux it falls back to the system python3, which needs python3-uno.
description.zh: 通过 UNO 驱动本机安装的 LibreOffice 做 PPT，而不是用 JavaScript 写 OOXML：`lo_build` 用结构化幻灯片真开一份 Impress 文档，再由 LibreOffice 导出可编辑的 PPTX/ODP、PDF 与逐页 PNG；`lo_render` 重新渲染已有的 PPTX/PPT/ODP；`lo_convert` 做 Office 格式互转；`lo_probe` 报告探测到的 soffice 路径、版本与 UNO 桥状态；`lo_config` 修改已保存的配置。需要本机安装 LibreOffice（已在 26.8.1.1 验证），使用其自带 Python，无需系统 Python，并会在两次调用之间保留一个 soffice 热进程。仅在 Windows 上做过完整验证；Linux 上会退回系统 python3，需要 python3-uno。

description.en: Paper reading workbench: a paper library, the PDF beside Markdown notes and one dedicated AI session per paper. Highlights and region screenshots go straight into notes; select-to-ask sends the passage with its page; notes are editable in place with autosave; sessions can be combined into a Summary.
description.zh: 论文阅读工作台：论文库、PDF 与 Markdown 笔记并排、每篇论文一个专属 AI 会话。高亮与框选截图自动写入笔记；划词 Ask AI 附带页码与选段；笔记可原地编辑、自动保存；多个会话可汇总成 Summary。

description.en: Competition math (IMO/Putnam/USAMO/AIME) solved with a pure-reasoning pass, an adversarial verifier in a fresh subagent context, and calibrated confidence output (high / medium / honest "no confident solution"); optional LaTeX-to-PDF rendering.
description.zh: 竞赛数学解题（IMO/Putnam/USAMO/AIME）：纯推理求解 + 新鲜上下文 subagent 对抗验证 + 校准信心输出（high / medium / 诚实「无把握解」）；可选 LaTeX 编译 PDF。

description.en: Turns one journal paper PDF into three deliverables by default — a Chinese group-meeting literature report deck (.pptx) in the Nanyang Normal University physics template, a matching Word speaker script, and a two-colour defence-prediction Q&A HTML (ten-odd questions with short direct answers). Requires Python 3 with python-pptx, python-docx, Pillow and pymupdf (pypdf fallback); install them with pip install -r requirements.txt.
description.zh: 把一篇期刊论文默认做成三份产物 —— 中文组会文献汇报 PPT（南阳师范学院物理模板）、配套 Word 讲稿、双色答辩预测问答 HTML（十题左右，答案简短直接）。需本机 Python 3 及 python-pptx、python-docx、Pillow、pymupdf（pypdf 兜底）依赖，可用 pip install -r requirements.txt 安装。

description.en: Eight academic skills bundled for one-command install — publication-ready academic figures designed from real data with visual review, AI-text humanization, paper polishing and rewriting, PubMed citation verification (DOI/PMID reconciliation), Chinese citation and medical-book reference checks, and WeChat medical article structuring. Three skills run fully local, five call external services only when used (NCBI E-utilities, DOI resolvers, publishing platforms), declared per skill. Zero telemetry, no install-time scripts. Skills run local Python 3.8+; the academic-figures skill also needs its pip dependencies installed.
description.zh: 八个学术技能一次装齐——学术图表（按真实数据设计+视觉审核）、去 AI 味改写、论文润色与改写、PubMed 引文核验（DOI/PMID 逐条对账）、中文著作引用核验、公众号医学文章结构化。三项纯本地运行，五项按功能访问外部服务（NCBI、DOI 解析、发布平台）并逐技能如实声明；零遥测、无安装期脚本。技能经本机 Python 3.8+ 运行；academic-figures 另需安装其 pip 依赖。

description.en: Registers the fight-scene-director skill for designing AI-video fight scenes, ported from the Codex skill of the same name. Emits structured Chinese prompts for Seedance 2.0/2.5 and MiniMax H3, plus trajectory-map and initial-position image prompts.
description.zh: 把 fight-scene-director 打戏设计技能注册进 DSH，移植自同名 Codex 技能。输出适配 Seedance 2.0/2.5 与 MiniMax H3 的结构化中文提示词，并支持轨迹图与初始站位图生图提示词。

description.en: Deck-generation skill for the National College Student Career Planning Competition. It takes a contestant's profile, materials and photographs, drafts a page-by-page outline for confirmation, then renders a 15-20 page reading-type PPTX (under 15 pages is flagged as a page-count error) using 17 page types, three built-in themes or a user-supplied template; the build audits the estimated layout (text overflow, per-page word count, missing evaluation dimensions, material gaps) and the rendered PDF is checked again for out-of-bounds and overlapping text. Requires Python 3.9+ with python-pptx, python-docx and Pillow; LibreOffice (soffice) and pdftotext are optional for the PDF layout re-check.
description.zh: 职规赛（全国大学生职业规划大赛）展示 PPT 生成技能：给出选手信息、材料与照片后先出逐页大纲待确认，再渲染成 15–20 页的阅读型 PPTX（少于 15 页会被判为页数错误）（17 种页型、3 套主题，可套学校模板）；生成时审计估算版面（文字溢出、每页字数、评分维度覆盖、素材缺口），导出 PDF 后再复核一遍越界与压字。依赖 Python 3.9+ 及 python-pptx、python-docx、Pillow；PDF 版面复核可选依赖 LibreOffice（soffice）与 pdftotext。

description.en: Port of pstack to DeepSeek Harness: 58 agent-workflow skills plus a deterministic router that picks each subagent model from the models you checked for subagents.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 pstack：58 个 agent 工作流技能，外加确定性路由器，按任务意图从你勾选的子 agent 模型池里选型。

description.en: Project documentation scaffolding skill: question-driven setup of project standards, AI-collaboration workflows, and memory discipline across DSH, Reasonix, Claude Code, and Codex.
description.zh: 项目文档体系初始化 skill：提问驱动落实文档规范、固化 AI 协作工作流，跨 DSH / Reasonix / Claude Code / Codex 可用。

description.en: Generate and edit AI media (image, video, audio, 3D) with WaveSpeed models via the open-source wavespeed CLI: live catalog search, per-model input-schema introspection, local-file upload with @path markers, and price checks before running.
description.zh: 通过开源 wavespeed CLI 用 WaveSpeed 模型生成与编辑 AI 媒体（图像、视频、音频、3D）：实时目录搜索、逐模型输入 schema 自省、@path 标记本地文件上传、运行前价格查询。

description.en: A-share technical analysis (ladder dynamics) plugin: chanlun structure via struct_calc, hang-slope D+/D/D- and strong-start E+/E/E- signals, with an in-app settings page and work prompts.
description.zh: A股技术面研判（架梯动力学）插件：基于缠论结构给出挂坡 D⁺/D/D⁻ 与强势起步 E⁺/E/E⁻ 信号，附设置页与工作提示词。

description.en: Cut token cost in 4 layers without cutting model intelligence: handoff, rtk, headroom, caveman token-saving skills — each also available as a standalone installable plugin.
description.zh: 四层省 Token，不牺牲模型智能：handoff、rtk、headroom、caveman 四个省 token 的 skill，每个也是独立可装插件。

description.en: Sidebar skill picker: lists installed skills with Global and repo badges, session checks plus persistent auto-start, optional Guard, Codex/Grok/Hermes user skills, and /skill injection.
description.zh: 侧边栏技能选择器：列出已安装技能并标注 Global 与所属 repo，支持本会话勾选与常驻默认启动、可选 Guard、Codex/Grok/Hermes 用户技能，以及 /skill 注入。

description.en: Rigorous open mathematics research suite: four agent skills (rigorous-open-math-research, manage-math-research-program, math-research-workflow, lean-verify) for theorem solving with adversarial audit, research program management, pipeline orchestration, and Lean 4 formalization audit; CI-verified tests and mechanical upstream sync.
description.zh: 严谨开放数学研究套件：4 个 agent skill（rigorous-open-math-research、manage-math-research-program、math-research-workflow、lean-verify），覆盖对抗性审计的定理求解、研究项目管理、流水线编排与 Lean 4 形式化审计；CI 测试与机械式上游同步。

description.en: Image and video production toolkit for DeepSeek Harness - background removal with quality tiers, local inpainting retouch, headline and logo compositing, batch platform-size exports and image QA reports; for video, AI subject matting with background replacement (RVM ONNX, plus a chroma-key path), animated titles with fade/slide/typewriter/karaoke presets, 53 transitions with stylized variants, and light-effect and grading presets with LUT support, alongside footage inventory, accurate cutting, subtitle burn-in, music mixing and platform-spec exports; it provisions its own local Python runtime through a bundled bootstrap script.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的美工与视频剪辑工具包——可分档抠图、局部重绘改图、标题与 logo 合成、平台规格批量导出与图片体检；视频侧含 AI 抠像换背景（RVM ONNX，另有绿幕色键路径）、淡入/滑入/打字机/卡拉OK 动效文字、53 种转场与风格化变体、光效与调色预设（支持 LUT），以及素材通览、精确裁切、字幕烧入、配乐混音与平台规格导出；通过内置引导脚本自备本地 Python 运行时。

description.en: On-demand skill tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers skill_search / skill_load / skill_ref so the model searches a staged skill library first and loads a skill body only when it needs it, keeping the library out of the resident session catalog and out of every turn's context; adds a Skills tab to the conversation view ring that reads back the whole session and lists which skills were actually loaded, and in which turn. Zero dependencies, and the records render client-side only, never entering the model's context.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按需技能工具：注册 skill_search / skill_load / skill_ref 三个工具，让模型先从分层的技能库里检索、再按需加载正文，库里的技能因而不必进入常驻目录、不占每轮上下文；并在对话视图栏加一个「技能」标签页，回读整个会话、列出本次真正加载过哪些技能及其轮次。零依赖，所有技能调用记录只在客户端渲染，不进入模型上下文。

description.en: DSH port of TaskPlane: dependency-ordered waves run in parallel git-worktree lanes, with task packets, cross-model review, and crash recovery.
description.zh: TaskPlane 的 DSH 移植版：按依赖分波、多 lane 并行执行（git worktree 隔离），任务包 + 跨模型评审 + 崩溃可恢复。

description.en: LAN task delegation between DSH hosts on one network: the parent dispatches a task to a child host, the child works in its own session and workspace, results and files return to the parent's inbox, sensitive actions wait for the parent's approval, and a finished task can be continued with one follow-up inside the child's existing session. Since 0.4.0 a fresh host listens on loopback only and keeps its listener off until it is enabled, the six-digit pairing code is single-use and rotates with a lockout after repeated failures, tokens travel in an Authorization header and are stored hashed, and a dispatch with no grant or with a permission above the grant is refused before anything is sent. Transport is still plain HTTP with no TLS, so use it on a trusted LAN.
description.zh: 局域网内的 DSH 多机任务委派：上级把任务派给子级主机，子级在自己的会话与工作区里执行，结果与文件回到上级收件箱，敏感动作等待上级审批，完成的任务还能在子级原会话里接着追问一轮。0.4.0 起，新装默认只监听本机且监听开关关闭；六位配对码单次可用，失败会自动换码并锁定来源；令牌放在 Authorization 头里传输、本地只存哈希；没有授权或权限不足的任务会在派发前被直接拒绝、不消耗对方的 token。传输仍是明文 HTTP、没有 TLS，请在可信局域网使用。

description.en: GPT plans dependency DAGs, DeepSeek workers execute tasks with adaptive parallelism, and an optional GPT reviewer audits incremental Git diffs and drives repair rounds.
description.zh: GPT 规划依赖 DAG，DeepSeek Worker 自适应并行执行任务，可选 GPT Reviewer 审核增量 Git Diff 并驱动返工轮次。

description.en: Product Design workflow suite for DeepSeek Harness - a router plus nine pd-* skills carrying ideas from a minimum design brief through visual directions, evidence-grounded research and audits, URL cloning, frontend builds and a blocking design-QA gate.
description.zh: 产品设计工作流套件：一个路由加九个 pd-* 技能，把想法从最小设计简报推进到视觉方向、证据化调研与审计、URL 克隆、前端构建与阻断式设计 QA 闸门。

description.en: Hierarchical multi-agent team coordination with lead review gates, write-scope isolation, and floating workspace.
description.zh: 具备主控审查门禁、文件范围隔离与悬浮工作台的多模型主从协同插件。

description.en: Evidence-first operating kit: six read-only tools (capability catalog, staged workflow plans, packaged skill reader, bounded local memory search, repository release audit, release checklist) and five packaged skills - plans and audits, never remote writes.
description.zh: 证据优先的操作套件：六个只读工具（能力清单、分阶段编排计划、随包技能阅读、有上限的本地记忆检索、仓库发布审计、发布清单）加五个随包技能；只规划与审计，不做远程写入。

description.en: A structured multi-panelist review workflow for the DeepSeek Harness: N panelists score in isolated subagents, blind to each other; a chair reconciles disagreement by anchor match then Δ-level adjudication; an independent critic audits the process. Works for design, code, paper or project review.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的结构化多评审人评审工作流：N 个评审人在相互隔离、彼此不可见的 subagent 中独立打分；一名 chair 先按锚点匹配、再按 Δ 级别裁决来调和分歧；一名独立的 critic 负责审计整个评审过程。适用于设计、代码、论文或项目评审。

description.en: Orchestrates durable multi-agent teams from one DSH session: a captain spawns member subagents, drives a dependency-aware task DAG with quality gates, and coordinates through persistent mailboxes, with a live activity panel.
description.zh: 把单个 DSH 会话编排成持久化多智能体团队：captain 生成成员子代理、驱动带质量门的依赖感知任务 DAG、通过持久邮箱协调，附带实时活动面板。

description.en: Advisor reviews that converge over rounds, an engineering mode whose writes require a design token, escalation of a task to a stronger model, and parallel multi-model consultation; a settings page edits the model routes, timeouts and budgets.
description.zh: 导师评审逐轮收敛、工程模式写入需持设计令牌、把任务转交给更强的模型、并行多模型会诊；设置页可改各模型路由、超时与预算。

description.en: Publish articles to CSDN / Juejin / CNBlog directly from the session, no external server.
description.zh: 会话内直接发布文章到 CSDN / 掘金 / 博客园，无外部服务。

description.en: Bot Mode for DeepSeek Harness: a roster of named bots with avatars, personas and per-bot chats, each backed by one durable continuable subagent session that keeps memory across turns.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Bot 模式：把子 Agent 变成一群有头像、有人格的 Bot，每个 Bot 拥有独立对话，由一个持久的 continuable 子 Agent 会话支撑，跨轮次保留记忆。

description.en: Task planning with experience muscle-memory: condition-reflex recall of past solutions, LLM capability matching, and auto-persisted lessons.
description.zh: 带经验肌肉记忆的任务规划：条件反射检索历史方案 + LLM 能力匹配 + 经验自动沉淀。

description.en: VSCode-style uncommitted-changes sidebar docked to the right of the DSH web conversation page: staged / unstaged / untracked file groups, status badges, per-file +/− line counts, click-to-expand diff, rename as old → new, untracked content preview, and open with the system default application.
description.zh: 停靠在 DSH Web 对话页右侧的 VSCode 风格未提交改动侧边栏：已暂存/更改/未跟踪三组文件、状态徽标与每文件 +/− 行数，点击展开单文件 diff，支持重命名显示、未跟踪文件内容预览及调用系统默认应用打开文件。

description.en: Branch chip in the composer tool row that switches, creates, and refreshes workspace branches, commits a checked subset of changed files with a message the session's own model writes from the diff, and pushes the current branch.
description.zh: 位于 composer 工具栏的分支标记：切换、新建、刷新工作区分支；提交时可勾选部分改动文件，提交信息由当前 Session 的模型根据 diff 生成；并可推送当前分支。

description.en: A strip above the composer listing files modified in the current session (collapsed by default), with a Review button opening a per-session change panel showing before/after hunks from the session's own edit/write tool results, no git required.
description.zh: 输入框上方的条带列出当前会话修改过的文件（默认折叠），Review 按钮打开会话变更面板，基于会话自身的 edit/write 工具结果展示前后差异块，无需 git。

description.en: Runs 3 or 5 coding-agent candidates in detached Git worktrees, validates their patches with project commands, ranks only passing candidates, and requires separate approval before applying the winner.
description.zh: 在独立 Git worktree 中运行 3 或 5 个编码智能体候选，用项目命令验证补丁，只对通过者排序，并在应用获胜补丁前要求再次批准。

description.en: Unified messaging gateway for DeepSeek Harness: 27 IM platforms (Telegram, QQ, WeChat, Discord, WhatsApp, Feishu and more) in one plugin, with QR scan-to-authorize, per-platform workspaces, slash commands, and a web setup dialog.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一消息网关：一个插件接入 27 个 IM 平台（Telegram、QQ、微信、Discord、WhatsApp、飞书等），支持扫码授权、每平台独立工作区、斜杠命令与 Web 配置弹窗。

description.en: DSH meets Kimi WebBridge.
description.zh: DSH 结合 Kimi WebBridge。

description.en: macOS Dock badge and bubble chime: shows an unread badge on the Dock (dot while running, count when done) and plays a chime while the app is hidden; clears on return, built on the Badging API.
description.zh: macOS Dock 角标与提示音：最小化/切走时 Dock 显示未读角标（运行中=红点、跑完=数字）并播放水泡提示音，回到应用自动清除，基于 Badging API。

description.en: Multi-channel IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness: each QQ (SnowLuma / OneBot v11, official QQ Bot) or Discord group and private chat becomes its own agent session, bound to a role card whose domain carries knowledge bases with draft approval, shared memory, a read-only GitHub reader and group trigger rules; two built-in personas (customer support, group chat), unified push with broadcast, and human hand-off.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的多渠道 IM 桥：QQ（SnowLuma / OneBot v11、官方 QQ Bot）与 Discord 的每个群、每个私聊都对应一个独立的 agent 会话，会话绑定角色卡、角色卡背后的领域承载知识库（含草稿审批）、共享记忆、只读 GitHub 查询与群聊触发策略；内置客服与群聊两套人格，支持统一推送（含广播）与人工接管。

description.en: Installer and configuration base for a five-plugin DSH assistant suite: probes the Python, WPS and workspace environment, installs the sibling plugins shipped in the same repository, and generates the workspace baseline (instruction layer, memory seed, skills, settings); it also contributes its own settings section and its own host-side setup and check logic.
description.zh: DSH 工作秘书集成体的本体：做安装引导（Python / WPS / 工作区环境探针、安装同仓库分发的子插件）与配置底座（生成指令层、记忆种子、技能、设置），并在界面里提供独立的「工作秘书」设置分区，自带宿主侧安装与检查逻辑。

description.en: Relay agent approval requests and questions to iMessage / Email / WeChat channels and resolve them by replying with the request number (#N 批准 / 拒绝 / 回答).
description.zh: 把 agent 的审批与提问诉求推送到 iMessage / 邮件 / 微信通道，回复 `#编号 批准/拒绝/回答` 即可处理，无需打开网页。

description.en: Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today (负一屏) task-completion push for DeepSeek Harness: hiboard_push / hiboard_verify tools post Markdown task results to the phone card feed, wire-compatible with the OpenClaw today-task skill, with the authCode managed from the dsh settings panel.
description.zh: 华为鸿蒙负一屏（智慧助手·今天）任务完成推送：hiboard_push / hiboard_verify 工具把 Markdown 任务结果推送到手机卡片流，与 OpenClaw today-task 技能线级兼容，授权码可在 dsh 设置面板配置。

description.en: Discord-like communities in DSH with channels, roles and permissions, message search, and sharing or cloning of DSH sessions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板内建社区：文字、公告与话题频道，角色与频道级权限，消息搜索，并可分享和克隆 DSH 会话。

description.en: Personal WeChat and WeCom (企业微信) bridge: QR pairing, one DSH conversation per chat, two-way text/image/video/document/archive transfer, chat commands (/help, /status, /new, /stop, /friends) answered by the bridge itself without spending a model turn, a switch that restricts the bot to 1:1 chats (group messages are dropped silently and counted), remote approval by replying 1 or 2 in the chat, and a two-way WeCom intelligent robot over its long connection (no public URL needed) that also receives and sends images, files and videos.
description.zh: 个人微信 + 企业微信桥：扫码配对，每个会话各自一个独立 DSH 会话，文字/图片/视频/文档/压缩包双向传输，聊天里支持 /help、/status、/new、/stop、/friends 命令（由桥直接应答，不消耗模型回合），可切换「只处理好友私聊」（群消息静默忽略并计数），敏感操作可在聊天里回 1 或 2 远程审批，并支持双向的企业微信智能机器人长连接（无需公网地址），图片、文件、视频同样能收发。

description.en: Registers `list_profiles` and `export_profile`, so the agent can show what setups exist and hand back a whole profile — bundle order, plugin versions and patch — as one portable file to share. Read-only.
description.zh: 注册 `list_profiles` 与 `export_profile`：让 agent 列出本机有哪些配置，并把整套 profile（bundle 顺序、插件版本、patch）导出成一个可直接分享的文件。只读。

description.en: Automated unit-test generation: a /testgen command and generate_tests tool that scaffold, run, and fix tests until they pass (LLM + offline template generators; vitest/jest/mocha/node:test).
description.zh: 自动化单元测试生成：/testgen 命令与 generate_tests 工具，生成、运行并修复测试直至通过（LLM 与离线模板双生成器；支持 vitest/jest/mocha/node:test）。

description.en: Zero-touch runtime telemetry for DSH: every session auto-writes task, model tier, tools, failures, duration, status into a human-readable journal with a stats section (pure observer — no tools, no LLM calls, no injection).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 零侵入运行事实遥测：每个会话自动把任务/模型档位/工具/失败/时长/状态写入人机共读观测卡并附统计区（纯观察者——零工具、零 LLM、零注入）。

description.en: A dockable IDE workbench for the DSH web UI: a GPU-accelerated terminal (restty renderer over a Rust PTY), a CodeMirror editor, a file explorer, notes, a sandboxed browser, and ripgrep content search.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的可停靠 IDE 工作台：GPU 加速终端（restty 渲染器 + Rust PTY）、CodeMirror 编辑器、文件浏览器、笔记、沙箱浏览器，以及基于 ripgrep 的内容搜索。

description.en: Runs the agent's filesystem, bash and PTY terminals inside a Docker container by providing the `ctx.fs` and `ctx.subprocess` seams, so cwd, environment and background processes survive a harness restart.
description.zh: 通过提供 `ctx.fs` 与 `ctx.subprocess` 接缝，把 agent 的文件系统、bash 与 PTY 终端跑在 Docker 容器里；工作目录、环境变量与后台进程可在 harness 重启后存活。

description.en: Restart button in the window caption band: one click closes the whole desktop app and relaunches it (the original v0.1.0 restart helper). The repository also ships a tool that patches the installed desktop shell so its tray menu carries a Restart item.
description.zh: 窗口标题栏的重启按钮：点一下关闭整个桌面应用再重新拉起（沿用最初的 v0.1.0 重启逻辑）。仓库另附一个工具，可为已安装的桌面壳打补丁，使其托盘菜单里出现「重启」一项。

description.en: Model-driven /init command: the agent analyzes the current repo and generates/updates a high-signal AGENTS.md, with a persistent system-prompt reminder to keep it maintained.
description.zh: 模型驱动 /init 命令：让 agent 分析当前仓库并生成/更新高信号 AGENTS.md，并通过常驻 system prompt 提醒持续维护。

description.en: PWA plugin for DSH — adds offline support, service worker caching, and install-as-app capability.
description.zh: DSH 的 PWA 插件：离线支持、Service Worker 缓存，并可作为应用安装。

description.en: Manage the DSH web service from a settings panel: status, version, restart, stop, and one-click updates.
description.zh: 在设置面板中管理 DSH Web 服务:状态、版本、重启、停止与一键更新。

description.en: Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格权限规则引擎：hard/deny/ask/allow 四级规则（hard 高于全访问、不可豁免）、workspace 作用域、通配符路径保护、可视化草稿式编辑器，规则持久化于 settings.yaml。

description.en: Sanitizes fetched pages before the model reads them: strips hidden text, offsite images and inline data, wraps the rest in canary-tagged untrusted delimiters, and flags prompt injection.
description.zh: 在内容进入模型之前净化抓取的网页：剥离隐藏文本、站外图片与内联数据，其余内容用带金丝雀的不可信分隔符包裹，并标记提示注入。

description.en: Runtime plugin firewall for sessions started through its launcher (the DSH Desktop app cannot be injected and is not covered): filesystem, network and subprocess calls plugins make are attributed to the plugin that made them and judged against what that plugin declares, so a plugin doing its declared job stays silent and leaving it is recorded. Attribution is best-effort, not a guarantee - uncovered calls fall back to host, never to another plugin. Also adds a pre-install health card (capability surface, red-line combinations, PASS/WARN/BLOCK), boundary judging, opt-in pre-execution blocking with a credential-exfil rule, update diff with a trial install in an isolated child process, SARIF/CSV audit export, and multi-source aggregation. Local-only storage, no telemetry; the optional webhook is off by default.
description.zh: 运行时插件防火墙，仅覆盖经其启动器启动的会话（DSH Desktop 桌面应用注入不进去，不在覆盖范围）：插件发起的文件、网络、子进程调用会归属到发起它的插件，并用该插件自己声明的需求去衡量——本职范围内的行为零打扰，越出声明才被记录。归因是尽力而为，不是保证：覆盖不到的调用退回 host，不会被记到别的插件头上。附带装前体检卡（能力面、红线组合、PASS/WARN/BLOCK）、越界判定、可选的执行前拦截（含 credential-exfil 规则）、更新 diff 与隔离子进程试装、SARIF/CSV 审计导出与多源汇总。数据只存本机，无遥测；webhook 默认关闭。

description.en: One-time Full access switch for DeepSeek Harness: new sessions (workspaces and conversations) start with danger-full-access and skip the per-session Full access confirmation; installable as a dsh bundle or via patch scripts.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加 Full access 一次性开关：新工作区与新对话默认 danger-full-access 并跳过逐个确认；可作为 dsh bundle 安装，也可用脚本打补丁。

description.en: Blocks an agent from reading, searching, writing, or editing chosen files and directories, keeping their contents out of the conversation — including sensitive-word files whose text can make later provider requests fail with a 400. Rules are picked from a file/directory browser on the plugin page.
description.zh: 屏蔽 agent 对指定文件或目录的读取、搜索、写入与编辑，使其内容不进入对话——含敏感词的文件也在其中，避免它们的文字让之后的 provider 请求以 400 失败。规则在插件页面上点选。

description.en: Two-way Telegram remote cockpit for DeepSeek Harness: live progress tracking, screenshot vision, git diffs, shell execution, and tool approvals. Unconfigured chatId automatically claims the first sender as owner; voice-to-text requires local ffmpeg and BeeRouter services.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 双向 Telegram 远程控制台：实时进度卡片、截图识图、Git 差异对比、Shell 执行与工具审批。未配置 chatId 前首个发送者即被认领为主人；语音转文字需本地 ffmpeg 与 BeeRouter 服务前置支持。

description.en: Remote-SSH-style workspaces: turn an SSH host and a remote directory into a native DSH workspace; the agent operates the remote filesystem directly via 12 rw_* tools (SFTP/exec), with workspace-confined paths and known_hosts verification.
description.zh: Remote-SSH 风格工作区：把 SSH 主机上的远程目录变成原生 DSH 工作区，agent 通过 12 个 rw_* 工具（SFTP/exec）直接操作远程文件，路径限定在工作区内并校验 known_hosts。

description.en: Pairs two DeepSeek Harness machines with a one-time code - directly on a LAN, or across networks through an end-to-end-encrypted relay with a zero-config official default - so one agent can run tasks and exchange files on the other while each machine keeps its own files in place.
description.zh: 用一次性配对码把两台 DeepSeek Harness 机器连起来——局域网直连，或跨网络经端到端加密中继（默认自带官方中继，零配置）——让一边的 agent 在另一边执行任务、交换文件，各自文件都留在本机。

description.en: Complete LAN/remote access for the Web UI: 0.0.0.0 binding, crypto.randomUUID polyfill, token gate (401 login page + WebSocket interception, loopback exempt), privileged-fence and settings-persistence exemptions, and an idempotent installer with upgrade recovery.
description.zh: 完整的 Web GUI 局域网/远程访问方案：0.0.0.0 绑定、crypto.randomUUID polyfill、令牌门卫（401 登录页 + WebSocket 拦截，回环豁免）、特权围栏与设置持久化放行，附带幂等安装器与升级恢复。

description.en: Skill index browser with search, custom alias editing, and chat-input skill insertion.
description.zh: 技能索引浏览器，支持关键词检索、自定义中文别名与输入框多技能快捷插入。

description.en: Alternative plugin market for DSH: curated catalog plus live GitHub browsing, zh/en cross-language search, a fail-closed pre-install static security audit with an install-hook block, and per-plugin README viewing with garbled-encoding repair.
description.zh: 另一款 DSH 插件市场：精选目录 + GitHub 实时浏览、中英互通搜索、安装前 fail-closed 静态安全审计（拦截安装钩子），每个插件可直接查看 README 且乱码自动修复。

description.en: Local-first A-share portfolio and watchlist monitor for DSH: sidebar quotes, holdings P&L, browser add/edit/delete, and JSON persistence.
description.zh: DSH 本地优先的 A 股持仓与自选监控：侧栏行情、持仓盈亏，以及网页添加、修改、删除和 JSON 保存。

description.en: A pixel whale-girl desktop pet for DSH on Windows: live agent state from real session events, poke and tickle, Ctrl-drag, 72-480 px resize, and a transparent always-on-top Electron window with 22 bundled animations.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话状态变成 Windows 桌面上的像素鲸娘：按真实会话事件实时换动作，可戳脸、挠痒、按住 Ctrl 拖动，72–480 px 缩放，独立 Electron 透明置顶窗，随包附带 22 个动作。

description.en: Windows only. On every DSH start it checks, with no configuration, whether Genshin Impact is already installed — if it is, the game is launched (falling back to the miHoYo launcher when the game exits immediately, e.g. while an update is pending); if it is not, the launcher installer is downloaded to the desktop behind a size gate that rejects any link whose payload is more than 15 MiB away from the expected ~224 MiB, and a failed download falls back to opening the official download page.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。打开 DSH 先探测本机《原神》：装了直接启动本体（秒退改起米哈游启动器），没装才下载安装包到桌面；与预期 224MB 相差超 15MB 的链接会被拒绝，失败则打开官方下载页。

description.en: Interactive character for Harness Desktop with task expressions, rice feeding, an iron-basin hat, dragging, and time-based greetings.
description.zh: 为 Harness Desktop 添加任务表情、白饭喂食、铁盆帽、拖动和时间问候的互动角色。

description.en: TIC-80 fantasy console for DeepSeek Harness: 3-column embedded web player, 14 agent tools, live hot reload, and native CLI export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 TIC-80 虚拟游戏机插件：三栏嵌入式 Web 播放器、14 个 Agent 工具、实时热重载与原生 CLI 导出。

description.en: Turns the user into an RPG protagonist: after each finished user turn a random "adventure" may trigger, drawn from 700+ events across 7 themed pools (sci-fi, fantasy, ancient, anime, novels, wuxia, urban), growing six persistent attributes (strength, intelligence, agility, charisma, luck, vitality) with XP, levels and attribute-weighted story branches, configured via a settings-page UI.
description.zh: 把用户本人当作 RPG 主角：每轮对话结束后有几率触发随机「奇遇」，事件库 700+，覆盖科幻/玄幻/远古/动漫/小说/武侠/都市七大主题，增减力量/智力/敏捷/魅力/幸运/体魄六维属性，积累经验升级并随等级解锁更宏大的事件，含属性加权分支与设置页可视化配置。

description.en: Rewrites DSH model output as "Doubao-speak": a barrage of superlatives, a long list of negations, healing diagnoses, verbatim repeats and a service-style closing question. Five strength levels (off / light / standard / heavy / max) instead of a dial, two independent channels (system-prompt style bible and llm/stream post-processor), three transform modes, and every length knob adjustable live in a settings page with a preview.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的模型输出改造成「豆包语」：超长排比、密集否定清单、疗愈式诊断、原样复读、服务化收尾。总强度分五档（关闭/轻度/标准/重度/拉满），不是连续旋钮；两条独立通道（系统提示注入风格圣经 + llm/stream 输出流后处理），三种后处理模式，所有长度参数都能在设置页实时调节并预览。

description.en: A bottom-right pixel-art basketball-chick desktop pet for the DSH Web GUI: sprite animations, drag with edge snapping, click sounds, waiting reminders when a session needs you, per-turn cost bubbles, a usage ledger, and a DeepSeek balance badge.
description.zh: DSH 右下角的「鸡你太美」篮球小鸡桌面宠物：像素帧动画、拖拽吸附、点击音效、会话等待回答或授权时弹提醒、每轮消耗气泡、账单明细与 DeepSeek 余额角标。

description.en: A Taffy mood mascot for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the corner GIF reacts live to agent state — approval pending / approved / rejected / begging, thinking, tool runs, interrupts, ask_user_question waiting, compaction, long-task fatigue, idle-ignored approval, idle / sleeping — with SSE-pushed state, drag positioning, middle-click console, tool-card mirror console, per-mood locking, persisted appearance settings and per-day bucket statistics.
description.zh: Taffy 表情包状态机：右下角表情实时联动 agent 状态——待审批 / 已批准 / 被拒 / 求饶、思考、工具执行、插话、等你回答、压缩记忆、长任务疲惫、审批没人理、空闲 / 休眠；SSE 推流同步、拖拽定位、中键控制台、工具卡片镜像控制台、表情锁定、外观设置持久化与今日时长统计。

description.en: Achievement system for the DSH Web UI: gallery with category/rarity sorting, unlock toasts, sidebar trophy, composer dock, crossover achievements, and local persistence.
description.zh: DSH Web 成就系统：画廊支持按分类/难度双排序、解锁 toast、侧栏奖杯、输入坞进度读条、联动成就，并本地持久化进度。

description.en: Audit each finished assistant turn with an independent reviewer model and steer the agent to fix failed output, with at most 2 review rounds per turn and SOP-folder standards injected as an extra review dimension.
description.zh: 每轮回复结束时用独立审查模型审核输出，判定不合格则引导 agent 修复，每轮最多追问 2 次；可注入 SOP 文件夹标准作为额外审核维度。

description.en: Memory-assembly team for DeepSeek Harness: every message triggers a five-step cognition loop (judge, retrieve, assemble, feedback, calibrate) carried by role-playing subagents (judge, retriever, archivist, advocate, editor, scribe), using BM25 retrieval, time-ordered material, and LLM assembly to build useful material packs injected into linghun. Works with dsh-linghun.
description.zh: 灵魂的记忆提取侧·认知循环团队版：判断→捞取→组装→被判定→校准五步闭环，判官/捞手/史官/辩手/编辑/书记角色化子智能体承载，BM25 检索 + 时序素材 + LLM 组装「有用素材包」注入 linghun。与 dsh-linghun 组合使用。

description.en: Peer collaboration between a DeepSeek Harness agent and the local Codex CLI: split a goal into a shared work list, hand tasks over, review what comes back, and keep every prompt, event stream, and answer on disk.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness agent 与本机 Codex CLI 对等协作：把目标拆成共享工作清单、派活与交接、互相审查，并把每一步的提示词、事件流与回答留档在本地。

description.en: Claude Code-style workbench in DSH: workspace/session sidebar, streaming document-style transcript with unified tool cards and thinking, Markdown and Mermaid rendering, dark theme, and a draggable overlay panel backed by an in-host HTTP/WebSocket service.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内提供 Claude Code 风格工作台：工作区/会话侧栏、流式文档式对话与统一工具卡、思考过程、Markdown 与 Mermaid 渲染、暗色主题，以及由宿主内 HTTP/WebSocket 服务驱动的可拖动悬浮面板。

description.en: A 3D neural memory map panel for the meow-memory store inside DeepSeek Harness. Sidebar entry + desktop embed, with 8-region memory classification and retrieval. Requires the meow-memory plugin (it reads .dsh-meow/memory.db) and Node 22.5+ (node:sqlite).
description.zh: 记忆星脑：meow-memory 记忆库的 3D 神经脑图面板，左侧栏入口 + 桌面内嵌，支持八分区归类与记忆检索；需先安装 meow-memory 插件（读取其 .dsh-meow/memory.db），并要求 Node 22.5+（node:sqlite）。

description.en: Persists unsent composer attachments per session, so images and files pasted into the input box survive page switches, conversation switches and app restarts: the bytes are mirrored in IndexedDB and handed back through the official createDrafts/addAttachments channel, and are dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.
description.zh: 按会话持久化输入框中尚未发送的附件：切页、切换会话乃至重启应用后回到该会话，草稿图片与文件会经官方 createDrafts/addAttachments 通道自动恢复；消息发出或手动移除后不会再出现。

description.en: Composer-toolbar button that rewrites the draft prompt into a clearer, more complete version through the Harness LLM route, with a revert control that restores the pre-enhancement text; a settings page holds style keywords and an independent model choice.
description.zh: 输入框工具栏按钮：通过 Harness 的 LLM 路由把草稿提示词改写为更清晰、更完整的版本，并提供撤回控件恢复改写前的原文；设置页可填写风格关键词，并可单独指定优化所用的模型。

description.en: Right-side overlay panel for DSH sessions showing git status, background jobs, skills and MCP usage, artifacts and visited pages, with a commit/push dialog and one-click GitHub publish.
description.zh: DSH 会话右侧独立监控面板：git 状态、后台进程、技能与 MCP、产出与网页查阅，附提交/推送对话框与一键发布到 GitHub。

description.en: Live progress bar under the composer with a percentage and an estimated time left for the current DeepSeek Harness turn; the estimate re-anchors as the turn runs and never reads 100% until the turn ends, and the bar turns red when the turn fails or is interrupted.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示当前这一轮 DeepSeek Harness 任务的实时进度条、百分比与预计剩余时间；估计随轮次实时重锚，任务失败或中断时进度条变红。

description.en: Live Markdown rendering inside the DSH composer plus Markdown-rendered user messages; the submitted text stays literal Markdown.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框内实时渲染 Markdown，并让已发送的用户消息按 Markdown 显示；提交文本保持字面 Markdown 不变。

description.en: Adds a native sidebar menu item in DSH that opens chat.deepseek.com in a standalone browser window with persistent login, and supports bidirectional text selection transfer between DSH and the web page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧边栏添加原生菜单项，一键打开 chat.deepseek.com 独立窗口（登录态持久化），支持 DSH 与网页端双向划词互传。

description.en: One-click brand replacement for the DSH web GUI — logo, product name, version badge, hero headline, tab title and favicon.
description.zh: 一键替换 DSH Web GUI 品牌信息（商标、产品名、版本徽标、Hero、标签页标题与 favicon），方便二改分发。

description.en: System status floating widget: live CPU/memory/disk usage in the bottom-right corner of the DSH Web UI with threshold colour warnings.
description.zh: DSH Web 右下角系统状态悬浮窗：实时显示 CPU、内存、磁盘占用率，带阈值变色告警。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu to the DSH web UI for files and for links: a file-tree row, a file path or file mention in a chat message, or a hyperlink opens a menu that previews a file in DSH, opens it in the default application or a chosen associated one, reveals it in the file manager, copies the path, the workspace-relative path, the file name, the link address, the link text or the file contents, saves a copy elsewhere, and opens an HTTP(S) link in the sidebar browser or in the system browser, while a right-click that is not on a file or a link keeps the browser's own menu.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的右键菜单，覆盖文件与链接：在文件树一行、对话消息里的文件路径或文件提及、以及超链接上右键，可预览、用默认程序或指定关联程序打开、在资源管理器中定位、复制路径／相对路径／文件名／链接地址／链接文字／文件内容、另存为，并可把 http(s) 链接在侧边栏浏览器或系统浏览器中打开；在非文件非链接处右键仍保留浏览器原生菜单。

description.en: TikTok-style video feed in a floating sidebar window: swipe local or SMB-NAS folders, or paste online video URLs (yt-dlp, bilibili/YouTube, cookies.txt login state); the window auto-fits the video aspect ratio, with fullscreen, drag-resize, Range streaming and an agent video-queue endpoint.
description.zh: 侧栏浮动窗口里的抖音式刷视频：本地/SMB NAS 文件夹上下滑动，或粘贴在线视频地址（yt-dlp 解析，支持 bilibili/YouTube 与 cookies.txt 登录态）；窗口随视频宽高比自适应，支持全屏、拖动缩放、Range 流式播放，并提供 agent 视频推送队列端点。

description.en: ChatGPT-desktop-style model picker whose thinking-level slider carries a particle trail, plus a visual-only fast-mode toggle and a hold-to-lock for it.
description.zh: ChatGPT 桌面风格的模型选择控件：思考档位滑杆带粒子拖尾，另有纯视觉的快速模式开关与长按锁定。

description.en: NextLine suggests a personalized next message in the DSH composer and lets you accept it as an editable draft.
description.zh: NextLine 下一句在 DSH 输入框内显示个性化的下一条消息建议，按 Tab 或右方向键即可填入草稿。

description.en: Customizable startup animation for DeepSeek Harness with eight bundled clips, random rotation, tail fade and time-of-day greetings. Based on lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation, so do not install it with the upstream plugin; bundled clips and the welcome voice carry their own media terms.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 启动动画定制版，内置 8 段短片，随机轮播、片尾淡入，还有分时段问候。基于 lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation 定制，不可与上游插件同装；随包短片与欢迎音按各自媒体授权。

description.en: Composer-dock badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing on a Beijing-time calendar whose China holiday schedule is fetched online at runtime (off-peak costs half the peak rate); auto-hides for non-DeepSeek models and cycles seven readouts on click.
description.zh: 输入栏下方显示峰谷时段徽标：按北京时间与中国法定节假日日历计算峰谷（空闲时段价格为高峰一半），节假日安排在运行时联网自动同步，非 DeepSeek 模型自动隐藏，点击循环切换 7 种显示内容。

description.en: UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness with a persistent customizable left Dock, cross-workspace pinned chats, a draft-first home, global search, a completion inbox and right-panel video previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻可自定义的左侧 Dock、跨工作区置顶会话、先写草稿的首页、全局搜索、完成通知收件箱，以及右侧文件面板视频预览。

description.en: Travel wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness: pick one of three built-in characters (DeepSeek whale girl, GPT dragon girl, Claude young lady) or upload your own reference photo, or observe a world without any character; choose a world and one of 20 art styles, and the plugin assembles the image prompt, generates the wallpaper through your own image channel (ChatGPT or Google subscription, OpenAI-compatible API, Gemini, Volcengine Seedream, or local ComfyUI/MOSS) and applies it to the Windows desktop or lock screen. Character trips also return world events and a letter from the character, and replying to the letter shapes the next scene; observe-world trips return world events only. Every trip stays in a browsable archive with image and ZIP export. Ships daily wallpaper, instant blind-box trips and scheduled blind-box trips. Data lives in ~/.dsh/planet-news; provider credentials are read from DSH's credential store, and the plugin provides no image quota.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的旅行壁纸：三个内置角色（DS大肥鱼、GPT 龙娘、Claude 大小姐）任选其一，也可上传自己的参考图，或选择「观察世界」不启用角色；选一个世界和 20 种画风之一，插件整理画面提示词，经你自己配置的生图渠道（ChatGPT 或 Google 订阅、兼容 OpenAI 的 API、Gemini、火山 Seedream，或本地 ComfyUI/MOSS）生成壁纸，并设为 Windows 桌面或锁屏。角色旅行会得到世界见闻和角色来信，回信会影响下一幕；观察世界只写世界见闻，没有角色来信。旅行记录保留在可浏览的档案里，支持导出图片或 ZIP。另有每日壁纸、立即盲盒旅行和定时盲盒旅行。数据保存在 ~/.dsh/planet-news，渠道凭据由 DSH 凭据服务读取，插件不提供生图额度。

description.en: Chinese-first UI enhancement: translates slash-command names and plugin-inventory cards with three display modes (Chinese only / Chinese + English / off), switching instantly without losing English.
description.zh: 斜杠命令名与插件清单卡片中文化：三种显示模式（只显示中文 / 中英都显示 / 不翻译），中文为主、英文不丢，切换即时生效。

description.en: Real-time inspector of the files the agent reads and edits, with a file tree, in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: M/A/R badges, side-by-side diffs and live agent activity tracking.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏实时文件变更检查器与文件树：根据智能体的读/写/编辑调用显示 M/A/R 标记与并排 diff，实时追踪智能体活动。

description.en: Draws workspaces and conversations as a 3D star map in the stock panel slot: eight layouts (spiral, rings, armillary sphere, solar system, double helix, irregular web, cubic lattice, radial tree), eight colour themes, a memory-library map of instruction files, skills and skill calls, star-to-star fly-throughs, and a 中/EN switch. Links are drawn only where a workspace owns a conversation or one conversation descends from another.
description.zh: 把工作区与对话画成三维星空，占住原版面板槽位：八种布局（螺旋、星环、浑天仪球、太阳系、双螺旋、不规则星团、立体方阵、中心放射星树）、八套配色主题、一张把指令文件/技能/调用记录画成环的记忆库图、星体间飞行，以及中/EN 切换。连线只画真实的从属关系：工作区→对话，以及父→子。

description.en: Folds Think and tool-call rows into a floating summary pill with red failure counts, for a cleaner writer-friendly chat view.
description.zh: 把 Think / 工具调用等过程行折叠成右下角摘要浮条，失败步骤红色计数，面向文字工作者的干净对话视图。

description.en: Adds a Quick Chat entry to the Web UI sidebar that opens a floating chat window with its own model and reasoning-effort picker, optionally seeded with the current session's transcript, and keeps every side conversation in a resumable, renamable, deletable history.
description.zh: 在侧边栏加入「快速会话」入口，打开一个小窗对话，可切换模型与思考强度、可选携带当前主会话全文，历史可继续、重命名、删除。

description.en: Shows a Chinese translation under each English thinking block in the DSH web chat, without modifying the session transcript; per-chunk caching, a configurable translation model, and a settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页对话里把每段英文思考的中文译文显示在原文正下方，不改动会话记录；按译文块缓存、可指定翻译模型，并带设置面板。

description.en: Draggable ring gauge showing live model output speed (tok/s) with an expandable per-step detail panel (exact speed, TTFT, cache-hit rate, cache read/write, reasoning and input tokens, model, cumulative tokens).
description.zh: 可拖拽环形表盘，实时显示模型输出速度（tok/s），点击展开每步详情（精确速度、TTFT、缓存命中率、缓存读写、推理/输入 token、模型、累计 token）。

description.en: Composer-dock balance/usage readout for DeepSeek, Kimi Coding, OpenCode Go, Zhipu, MiniMax, OpenRouter and OpenAI Codex — provider-based, 2s polling, 5min cache.
description.zh: 输入框下方按 provider 展示 DeepSeek、Kimi Coding、OpenCode Go、智谱、MiniMax、OpenRouter、OpenAI Codex 的余额/用量，2 秒轮询、5 分钟缓存。

description.en: Select text in any Windows app to explain, summarize, translate, or read it aloud with DeepSeek Harness — answered in a streaming always-on-top overlay with a horizontal capsule menu.
description.zh: 在任意 Windows 应用里划词，弹出解释 / 总结 / 翻译 / 朗读，结果以流式输出落在原生置顶浮窗里，菜单为横向胶囊条。

description.en: Predicts your next message after each turn and shows it as gray ghost text in the composer: Tab takes the whole line, Alt+Right takes one word at a time, Enter takes it and sends, Esc dismisses, and Alt+R asks the model again without repeating the old one. Typing a few characters completes from prompts already sent in the session, Up in an empty composer recalls the last one, and a plugin-page form sets the provider, model, reasoning effort, per-key toggles and generation limits.
description.zh: 每轮结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 显示在输入框：Tab 整条采纳、Alt+→ 逐词采纳、Enter 采纳并发送、Esc 忽略、Alt+R 换一条且不重复旧的那条；输入几个字时用本会话发过的提示做前缀补全，空输入框按 ↑ 回填上一条；插件页可设置服务商、模型、思考强度、各按键开关与生成参数。

description.en: Right-sidebar GitHub panel with four rising-repository lists — created within 2 days, 7 days, 30 days, and 20k+ stars still pushed — where the first three are ranked by star velocity (stars per day) rather than total stars, so repositories that gained traction fast surface above older ones with more stars. Each row shows the repository name, its own description, language, the stars-per-day rate and up to two topics, and links to the repository. A keyword search box queries the GitHub Search API directly, debounced and IME-aware so a Chinese or Japanese composition costs one request instead of one per keystroke. Reads the public GitHub Search API anonymously: no token, no login, no account, nothing else contacted. Lists cache for 30 minutes and search results for 5; outbound requests go direct first and fall back to a listening local proxy port only if direct fails.
description.zh: 右侧栏 GitHub 面板，四个升起中的仓库榜：最近 2 天新建、最近 7 天、最近 30 天，以及两万星以上且近期仍在推送的老牌项目；前三个按星标增速（星/天）而非星标总数排序，让刚起量的项目排在攒了很久的项目前面。每行显示仓库名、仓库自带描述、语言、每日涨星速度与最多两个话题，整行链接到仓库页。另有搜索框直接查 GitHub Search API，带防抖并识别输入法组词——中文或日文拼音打字过程中只发一次请求，不是每敲一个字母发一次。数据取自公开的 GitHub Search API，匿名访问：不需要 token、不需要登录、不读账号，也不访问其它任何域名。四个榜缓存 30 分钟，搜索结果缓存 5 分钟；请求优先直连，直连失败才回退到确实在监听的本机代理端口。

description.en: Rewrites the composer draft into a tighter prompt in one click and restores the exact original in another, running on Harness's own models by default or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with an editable polishing prompt.
description.zh: 一键把输入框草稿改写为更紧凑的提示词，再点一次还原原文；默认用 Harness 自带模型，也可接任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，润色提示词与长度、超时限制均可自行设置。

description.en: Grouped workspace browser for the DSH sidebar: named groups over group > workspace > session, group-level archive and delete that show the affected count, a three-way archived-session filter, and a group document the Host half writes to $DSH_HOME/storages. Drawn with the shell's own --dsw-* tokens and official components, so rows, menus and theme switching match the native sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的分组工作区浏览器：自定义分组按 分组 → 工作区 → 会话 展开，组级归档与删除会显示影响数量，归档会话可三档筛选，分组文档由 Host 半边写入 $DSH_HOME/storages。行、菜单与折叠均用外壳自己的 --dsw-* 令牌和官方组件绘制，主题切换与原生侧栏一致。

description.en: A green interrupt button beside the send box: silently stops a running agent, which then summarizes its progress and asks for your new requirements, with a customizable interrupt prompt.
description.zh: 发送按钮旁的绿色打断按钮：运行时一键静默中断 AI，AI 停止后总结进展并向你征求新要求，支持自定义打断提示词。

description.en: One-click collapse of every expanded section (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.
description.zh: 一键收起会话中所有展开的区块（Think、工具卡等），常驻计数按钮 + 自定义快捷键。

description.en: Local music player: scans a folder for audio and video files, plays them in a Music tab with crossfade, a 10-band EQ and ReplayGain, and can write matched tags, covers and filenames back to the files with atomic replacement.
description.zh: 本地音乐播放器：扫描目录中的音频与视频文件，在「音乐」标签页播放，支持交叉淡化、10 段均衡器与响度归一化，并可按歌手-歌名重命名回写标签、封面与文件名（原子替换）。

description.en: Follow list above the sidebar conversation list: a status dot per conversation (unread, waiting for you, running, failed), newest reply first, running ones last, and a follow toggle beside the model selector. Marking a row unread lifts it to the top, opening one expands and scrolls to its row in the Workspace list below, a finished turn always counts as unread until the conversation is opened, and a conversation whose delegated subagents are still working keeps counting as running until the last child reports back.
description.zh: 在侧边栏对话列表上方增加关注区：每行一个状态圆点（未读、待回复、运行中、失败），有新回复的置顶、运行中的置底，模型选择器左侧还有关注按钮。点圆点标未读会把该行顶到最前，点开一行会自动展开并滚动到下方工作区列表里对应的那一行；每一轮结束都算未读，直到你打开这个对话；派出的子代理还在跑时父会话继续算运行中，等最后一个子代理结束才转成未读。

description.en: Conversation outline panel for the DSH web surface: user questions as root nodes (index, time, tool count and text volume per turn) with the Markdown headings of assistant replies hanging beneath them, plus level slider, search scope, bookmarks, copy and export as Markdown, section jump, keyboard navigation, a right-edge density rail and per-session reading-position memory. Read-only UI: it never touches prompts, tool results or provider traffic, and writes nothing outside its own localStorage keys.
description.zh: Web 端会话大纲面板：用户提问为根节点（序号、提问时间、该轮工具数与正文量），助手回复的 Markdown 标题按层级挂在其下；带层级滑块、搜索范围、收藏、复制与导出 Markdown、节级跳转、键盘导航、右侧密度刻度条与按会话记忆的阅读位置。纯只读 UI：不接触提示词与工具结果，不向提供方发起请求，只写自己的 localStorage 键。

description.en: Displays real-time CPU and memory usage for the machine running the DSH Web server.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面右上角实时显示运行 DSH 服务端机器的 CPU 与内存使用情况。

description.en: Composer-side prompt library: a button next to the input opens a picker with group chips and word-split AND search over saved snippets, inserting one into the draft or appending it, filling {{variables}} before insertion, with 13 built-in templates. Snippets live in one local JSON file behind a rev lock, a per-save backup, and whole-library JSON import/export; a settings page handles editing, grouping, pinning and a 6-second delete undo.
description.zh: 输入框旁的本地提示词库：按钮打开取用浮层，按分组 chips 与分词 AND 搜索筛选，插入或追加到草稿，插入前填充 {{变量}}，内置 13 套模板；数据存单个本地 JSON 文件，带 rev 乐观锁、每次保存前备份与整库 JSON 导入导出；设置页管理编辑、分组、置顶与 6 秒删除撤销。

description.en: Sidebar leaderboard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): LMArena blind-test ratings, Artificial Analysis intelligence index, LiveBench 2.0 capability, OpenRouter weekly/monthly usage and market share, price, speed and context — plus a local token-usage dashboard built from your own session logs (tokens, estimated cost, per-model ranking), model detail drawers and CSV export. Daily snapshot, instant open, no API key; locally configured models are highlighted.
description.zh: 侧栏大模型排行榜：LMArena 盲测评分、Artificial Analysis 智能指数、LiveBench 2.0 能力榜、OpenRouter 周榜/月榜与市场份额，附价格、速度与上下文；另有本机用量仪表盘（只读会话日志统计 tokens、估算花费与模型用量排行）、明细抽屉与 CSV 导出。数据由宿主每日快照，面板打开即显示，并高亮本机已接入的模型。

description.en: Month calendar panel in the DSH main column: add and edit a day's entries inline, overlay the Host's scheduled reminders for today and tomorrow coloured by run state, and merge iCalendar subscriptions with the calendars already synced into this Mac's Calendar.app; a calendar_board tool exposes the same entries to any agent session.
description.zh: DSH 主栏里的月视图日历面板：可直接在日期格里写/改当天事项，叠加定时任务（只显示今天和明天，按运行状态配色），并合并 iCalendar 订阅与本机「日历」里已同步的日历；同一个 calendar_board 工具把事项开放给任意 Agent 会话。

description.en: Local TXT novel reader in the DSH right sidebar: bookshelf with file, directory and path import, chapter table of contents with jump, click-to-turn or vertical-scroll paging, reading progress restored across restarts, and font, line-spacing, background and night themes.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏本地 TXT 小说阅读器：书架三种导入、章节目录跳转、点击翻页与上下滚动、重启后进度恢复、字体/行距/背景/夜间阅读主题。

description.en: Session-scoped Markdown writing pad docked beside the conversation, with edit/preview modes, selection-based AI rewrites, diff review, undo, and draft recovery.
description.zh: 停靠在对话旁的会话级 Markdown 写作板，支持编辑/预览、选区 AI 改写、Diff 审核、撤销与草稿恢复。

description.en: A native reasoning-effort control for the composer: a blue-to-violet tier bar with a starfield and a sheen sweep. It owns the model seat and drives the official model-directories service, so the ladder comes from each model's own reasoning declaration and no other plugin is required.
description.zh: 原生推理档位控件：蓝紫渐变档位条，带星点与流光。它自己占用模型座位并只对接官方 modelDirectories 服务，档位由每个模型自身的 reasoning 声明决定，不依赖任何其它插件。

description.en: Automatically loads the full conversation history when a session opens, so older messages are ready without clicking "Load earlier".
description.zh: 打开会话时自动加载全部历史消息，免去反复点击「加载更早」。

description.en: Session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px), widening the chat column, composer, and user bubbles together.
description.zh: 会话标题栏按钮循环切换对话宽度（748–1600px），消息区、输入框、用户气泡同步加宽。

description.en: Floating restart button for the DSH web GUI: restarts the dsh process in place with a full-screen overlay and auto-reloads the page; no launcher script required, works on Windows/macOS/Linux.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面右下角的一键重启按钮：全屏遮罩原地重启 dsh 进程并自动刷新页面；无需启动脚本，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

description.en: Re-sorts sidebar workspaces by last activity once per day; stable order within the day.
description.zh: 侧边栏工作区每日按最近活动排序一次，当天顺序稳定。

description.en: Universal on-screen translator for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: translates text, attributes, Shadow DOM, and iframes across 45+ languages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面即时屏幕翻译：支持菜单、设置、Shadow DOM 与嵌套 iframe，覆盖 45+ 种语言。

description.en: Shows a local image or short video in the current conversation card, with click-to-preview.
description.zh: 在当前对话卡片里展示本地图片或短视频，点击可预览。

description.en: Opens the NeoXider Agent Deck desktop widget (chat, the slime pet avatar or the hinge handle) from a Harness session, and reports its mode, installed version, running state and whether it follows the same Harness.
description.zh: 在 Harness 会话里打开 NeoXider Agent Deck 桌面挂件（对话、史莱姆宠物头像或铰链把手），并报告其模式、已安装版本、运行状态以及是否跟随同一个 Harness。

description.en: JupyterLab-style notebook for DSH: code and output side by side with a draggable divider, outputs that stick to the viewport while a long cell scrolls, Jupyter keyboard shortcuts (a/b/dd, m/y, Shift+Enter vs Ctrl+Enter), a scissors button to delete a cell and a chip to switch it between code and Markdown. Modified fork of @beihaizb/dsh-notebook: both register the same nb_* tools, so remove the original before installing; the Python kernel you pick needs ipykernel, jupyter_client and nbformat.
description.zh: DSH 的 JupyterLab 风格 notebook：代码与输出左右分栏并可拖动，长 cell 滚动时输出贴住视口，支持 Jupyter 快捷键（a/b/dd、m/y、Shift+Enter 与 Ctrl+Enter 区分）、左侧剪刀删除 cell、py/md 标签切换代码与 Markdown。基于 @beihaizb/dsh-notebook 的修改版：两者注册同一批 nb_* 工具，不能与上游同装，装前请先卸载原版；所选 Python 内核需安装 ipykernel、jupyter_client 与 nbformat。

description.en: Always-on quotes strip pinned to the top of the DSH window: watchlist, holdings with share counts and cost price, P&L, candlestick and intraday charts, 5-level order book, trade ledger, price alerts, and streamed AI review of the selected symbol.
description.zh: 钉在 DSH 窗口顶部的常驻行情条：自选股、带股数与成本价的持仓、盈亏、K 线与分时图、五档盘口、交易流水、价格预警，以及用 DSH 已配置模型流式生成的 AI 复盘。

description.en: macOS menu-bar status box for DSH: a whale status item shows running / waiting / completed counts and colours, its menu lists sessions grouped by workspace, a top-bar pill mirrors the counts inside the window, and the global hotkey ⌥⌘⇧D opens a single-field capture window that queues a task and sends it to the chosen workspace as a new session (queued while DSH is closed, delivered when it opens). A settings page adds an open-after-send switch. Needs macOS 11 or later, the Xcode command-line tools and the desktop app. The menu-bar part is a separate native helper that you build and install with menubar/install.sh from a copy of the repo: it compiles with clang, registers a login item (LaunchAgent) and listens on 127.0.0.1:59421, where the plugin posts session titles and status every few seconds.
description.zh: DSH 的 macOS 菜单栏状态盒：小鲸鱼状态项显示运行中/待处理/已完成数量并随状态变色，点开菜单按工作区分组列出会话，窗口顶部胶囊同步显示数量；全局热键 ⌥⌘⇧D 唤出单行输入窗，把任务排队并在指定工作区新建会话直接发送（DSH 关着时排队，打开后自动发出）；设置页含「发送后打开对话页」开关。需要 macOS 11 及以上、Xcode 命令行工具和桌面版。菜单栏部分是单独的原生小助手，要在仓库副本里运行 menubar/install.sh 来编译（clang）并安装：它会注册登录项（LaunchAgent），监听 127.0.0.1:59421，插件每隔几秒向它发送会话标题和状态。

description.en: A transparent always-on-top desktop fish that mirrors the current DSH session - turn, step, tool calls, todos, background jobs and team tasks - with optional login autostart, an option to stay after DSH exits, and a right-click hide.
description.zh: 常驻 Windows 桌面的透明置顶悬浮鱼，实时显示当前 DSH 会话的轮次、步骤、工具调用、todo、后台任务与团队任务；可选开机自启、DSH 退出后保留，右键可隐藏。

description.en: Top-centered weather bar for the DSH Web UI: geolocation, current conditions, 12h/7d forecasts and severe-weather notifications via Open-Meteo (free, no API key).
description.zh: DSH Web 顶部居中的天气栏：定位 + 当前天气 + 未来 12 小时/7 天预报与恶劣天气提醒，数据来自 Open-Meteo（免费、无需 API key）。

description.en: Screenshot button for the DSH composer on Windows: drag a region over the frozen screen and the picture lands in the draft as a normal image attachment, with a global hotkey and an editable shortcut.
description.zh: 给 DSH 打字框加一个截图键：点剪刀、拖框选中屏幕区域，图片作为普通附件直接进草稿；另带全局热键与可自定义的快捷键，仅 Windows。

description.en: Windows terminal dock inside the DSH web GUI. It is the occupant of the shipped shell.bottom slot: showing it splits the screen (the columns shrink instead of being covered), hiding it returns the space and keeps the PTY session alive. Each session is a local ConPTY child spawned through node-pty and rendered by xterm.js over a loopback-fenced WebSocket (backpressure, debounced resize). Other plugins can add terminal or DOM views through a host registerView API and a window CustomEvent channel.
description.zh: 嵌入 DSH Web GUI 的 Windows 终端 dock。它占用官方 shell.bottom 槽位：显示时真正分屏（三列高度自动让位而非被盖住），隐藏后空间归还且 PTY 会话不销毁。每个会话是 node-pty 起的本地 ConPTY 子进程，浏览器用 xterm.js 渲染，经 loopback 限定的 WebSocket 传输（带背压与 resize 去抖）。其他插件可通过宿主 registerView API 与 window CustomEvent 通道注册终端或 DOM 视图。

description.en: A Deepseek Harness plugin that gives its UI color themes.
description.zh: Deepseek Harness 的一款插件，可为其用户界面添加颜色主题。

description.en: Collapses the DSH Web sidebar panel menu (plugins, extensions, scheduled tasks, IM) from a vertical labelled list into a horizontal row of 36×36 icon buttons with hover tooltips; a Settings → General option switches back to the list and is remembered per browser.
description.zh: 把 dsh Web 侧边栏的全局面板菜单（插件、扩展管理、定时任务、IM）从竖排文字列表收起为一行 36×36 图标按钮，悬停显示名称；可在「设置 → 通用」里切回列表，选择按浏览器记忆。

description.en: Personalises the DSH running-turn status line: rotating bilingual quips, a configurable animated loading icon (5 styles x 3 sizes) and one-click matching to the active theme colour, all in a General-settings panel, plus a # Chinese / # English sectioned quips editor. Ships with no dependencies, no build step and no config file.
description.zh: 为 DSH 运行中状态行做轻量个性化：可轮换的中英俏皮话、可配置的动态加载图标（5 种样式 x 3 档尺寸）、一键匹配当前主题色，全部集中在「通用设置」里，外加一个用 # Chinese / # English 分段的俏皮话编辑框。零依赖、无构建、不写配置文件。

description.en: Adds an independent code font-size axis and per-plugin font-size sliders to the DSH font settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 字体设置面板增加代码字号独立轴，并为每个插件提供单独的字号滑杆。

description.en: Fridge-magnet quick-task stickers docked above the composer: one-click sends a preloaded prompt into the current session, grouped long-term/short-term.
description.zh: 输入框上方的冰箱贴纸栏：把常用任务（科技新闻、GitHub 推荐等）做成贴纸，点击即向当前会话发送预置 prompt 并执行，按长期/短期分组。

description.en: Adds an Agent docs tab to the conversation view: it lists the AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md instruction files DSH actually loads for the current session (the ~/.dsh and ~/.agents roots, plus every directory from the project root to the working directory), previews each as Markdown with per-file sizes and the 64 KiB instruction budget, edits and saves them in place after a sha256 version check, and opens the workspace folder from the path button; a saved file takes effect on the next message.
description.zh: 在对话页签栏新增「智能体文档」页签：列出当前会话实际加载的 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.local.md / CLAUDE.local.md 指令文件（~/.dsh 与 ~/.agents 两个全局根，以及项目根到工作区的每一级目录），以 Markdown 预览并显示各文件大小与 64 KiB 指令预算，点「编辑」可就地改写、保存前做 sha256 内容冲突校验，点击工作区路径会在文件管理器中打开；保存后从下一条消息生效。

description.en: Adds download actions to DSH delivery cards, changed-file review, and the document preview, and hides native open controls that cannot work when the Host is remote or headless. Needs DSH Web; the native open controls are hidden by default and can be restored per browser.
description.zh: 在交付卡片、变更审查和文档预览上增加下载按钮，并隐藏 Host 远程或无桌面时无法生效的原生打开控件。需 DSH Web；原生打开控件默认隐藏，可在浏览器里恢复。

description.en: Direct web search button and /search slash command plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的直接联网搜索按钮与 /search 斜杠命令插件。

description.en: Read-only heads-up display over a DeepSeek Harness conversation: one state word in the centre, fixed seats around the ring for terminal, code, search, documents, web and a catch-all, and a sub-agent ring when more than one agent runs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话上的只读状态浮层：中心一行状态词，外圈按固定位置显示终端、代码、检索、文档、网页与其它六类活动，多 Agent 时显示内圈子 Agent。

description.en: Session-scoped @file/@folder mentions in the composer with Git-aware indexing, drag-drop and paste managed uploads, and validated path markers.
description.zh: 输入框内 session 范围的 @文件/@文件夹提及：Git 感知索引、拖放与粘贴受管上传、经校验的路径标记。

description.en: One plugin for DeepSeek Harness with durable autonomous loops, sidebar GitHub discovery, AI-assisted installation, and workspace shortcuts.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：提供持久自主循环、侧边栏 GitHub 插件发现、AI 安装和工作区快捷入口。

description.en: Adds an "Open folder" item to the session-row ⋯ menu in the DSH workspace sidebar, opening the session's workspace folder with the host OS file manager.
description.zh: 在工作区侧边栏的会话行 ⋯ 菜单中增加「打开文件夹」项，用系统文件管理器打开该会话所属工作区的文件夹。

description.en: Provides an always-on-top window feature for the DSH window, preventing it from being hidden unexpectedly, Windows only; requires PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe) on PATH.
description.zh: 提供 DSH 软件窗口置顶功能，让其不会乱隐藏，仅 Windows；需 PATH 上有 PowerShell 7（pwsh.exe）。

description.en: Quick temporary conversation and workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 临时对话工作区自动化管理插件。

description.en: Presets message-injection content combos and auto-injects them into every message.
description.zh: 预设消息注入内容组合，每条消息自动注入输入框首行。

description.en: DSH sidebar fold: collapse plugin panel rows into one More row that expands inline on hover or click; right-click opens a settings page to choose which panels stay outside.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏收纳：把插件注册的面板行收成一行「更多」，悬停或点击在行内向下展开；右键进设置页，可勾选哪些面板留在外面。

description.en: iPhone-style agent phone: dual-panel calls & SMS, RCS group chat with trust gates, cross-device agent messaging via the registry inbox bridge, L0–L4 trust badges and evidence audit. Experimental: trust summaries are not a security guarantee, and SMS/signalling is relayed through the operator's inbox (visible to them); E2E encryption is planned.
description.zh: 苹果风格智能体手机：双面板电话/短信、RCS 群聊（信任门禁）、跨设备智能体消息（registry 收件箱桥）、L0–L4 信任徽章与证据审计。实验性：信任摘要非安全保证，短信/信令经运营方收件箱中继（运营方可见）；E2E 加密为演进方向。

description.en: Anchors an approve/answer bubble to each DSH Web sidebar session row — one-click handling of authorization, questions, plan reviews and blocked goals without opening the conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏锚定气泡：会话待授权、提问、计划确认、目标阻断时在会话行旁自动弹出并一键处理，无需点进会话。

description.en: Re-applies Chinese UI labels to the DSH client modules on every start, so translations survive upgrades.
description.zh: 每次启动自动将 DSH 界面英文工具与状态标签修补为中文，升级 DSH 后自动恢复，无需手动改文件。

description.en: Adds a capability panel to the DSH web GUI: browse, install (upload, zip, host path or URL), enable, edit and export skills, and add or edit Claude Code-compatible MCP servers, at global and per-project scope — with project copies, per-project shadow stubs, live mount status and a zero-side-effect connection probe. A session view toggles capabilities for the current conversation only, and a TypeSafe Jev tab scores skills and MCP servers for the session from the input draft. Requires the dsh web shell 0.2.0-rc.2 or later. Forked from chengdb/dsh-plugin-capability-panel; it shares a patch id with that plugin and with pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel, so do not install them together.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中加入能力面板：浏览、安装（上传 / zip / 宿主路径 / URL）、启停、编辑与导出技能，新增与编辑 Claude Code 兼容的 MCP 服务器，覆盖全局与项目双作用域（项目副本、屏蔽占位、默认关闭声明），显示实时挂载状态并提供零副作用连通性探测；会话视图只对当前对话开关能力；「Jev 模型」Tab 用 TypeSafe Jev 按输入草稿为本会话技能与 MCP 打分。需 dsh Web 外壳 0.2.0-rc.2 及以上。fork 自 chengdb/dsh-plugin-capability-panel；与其及 pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel 使用同一 patch id，勿同装。

description.en: Agent-team task Gantt chart for the DSH sidebar - one swimlane per teammate, real session-log time on the x-axis, and every shared task drawn with its title and summary. Requires dsh-better-sidebar 0.4.0 or later (the tab has nowhere to register without it).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的 agent team 任务甘特图：每个 teammate 一条泳道，横轴取自真实会话日志时间，条内显示共享任务的标题与简介。需先安装 dsh-better-sidebar >= 0.4.0（没有它，标签页无处注册）。

description.en: Edge-style tab groups for the DSH sidebar on Web and Desktop, with nested groups up to three levels, workspace tree, single-list view, recursive sorting, RGB colors, collapsed status summaries, subagent expansion with status, and an approval-gated agent tool for organizing groups.
description.zh: 仿 Edge 标签页分组的 DSH 侧栏会话分组插件，支持 DSH Web / Desktop；提供最多三层的组内分组、工作区树、单列表、递归排序、RGB 自定义颜色、折叠状态汇总、子代理展开与状态联动，以及需要用户审核的 AI 会话整理工具。

description.en: A six-stop reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness, with a pixel-texture Ultracode mode that sweeps in from right to left and adapts to light and dark themes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的六档推理强度滑条，第六档 Ultracode 会在轨道上铺开一层向左流动的像素纹理，浮层与纹理跟随界面明暗自动切换。

description.en: Lets the DSH web UI attach files of any type as pathless @-mentions: pick a workspace file from the @ menu or drop one into the composer, and the agent reads it directly.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页以无路径 @提及 附加任意类型文件：可从 @ 菜单挑选工作区文件，或拖入输入区，Agent 直接读取。

description.en: Extends the DSH web chat drag-and-drop to accept every file type: non-image files are saved into the active session workspace so the agent can read and use them.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页聊天支持拖拽任意类型文件：非图片文件保存到当前会话工作区，供 Agent 读取使用。

description.en: Enables or disables MCP servers from Settings → MCP Servers: stops or starts each @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client connection immediately and persists the change across restarts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置 → MCP 服务器中直接启用或停用 MCP：即时停止或启动每个 MCP 客户端连接，并持久化，重启后依旧生效。

description.en: Team cost captain: meters every model call (subagents included), attributes each call to a member by workspace rules, prices it with the built-in DeepSeek 2026-09 catalog (peak/off-peak, CNY/USD) or user overrides, and appends it to a local JSONL ledger. Adds hot-reloadable member budgets, 80%/100% webhook alerts, optional over-budget enforcement, a team_cost_report tool with CSV export, and a settings-page team dashboard served over a Typert RPC service.
description.zh: 团队成本管家：按成员/工作空间计量每次模型调用的 token 与费用（含子代理），内置 DeepSeek 2026-09 价目表与自定义价格覆盖，成员预算热更新、阈值 Webhook 告警、可选超支拦截，提供成本报表工具与 CSV 导出，并在设置页提供团队成本看板。

description.en: Per-model capability profiling for DSH: turns local session history into per-model dashboards of session counts, tool usage, error rates, and top error signatures, with time-range filters and multi-model comparison.
description.zh: DSH 按模型的能力画像:把本地会话历史变成逐模型的会话数、工具使用、错误率与 Top 错误签名看板,支持时间范围过滤与多模型对比。

description.en: Adds a Desktop card to the settings page that detects the DeepSeek Harness Desktop app and launches it with one click.
description.zh: 在设置页加入「桌面端」卡片，检测 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用并一键唤起。

description.en: Adds a Settings Usage dashboard for DeepSeek API balance, official token and cost analysis, trends, context warnings, and live API activity.
description.zh: 在设置中添加 DeepSeek API 用量仪表板，显示余额、官方 Token 与费用分析、趋势、上下文警告及实时 API 活动。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek account balance in the composer dock, auto-refreshing every 15 seconds with hover details.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，每 15 秒自动刷新，悬停查看总额、赠送与充值明细。

description.en: Trading-terminal style cost tracker for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar balance and today spend, per-step RMB cost table, auto-synced official pricing with peak/off-peak, cross-session and per-day summaries, tool-level attribution, and cost forecast.
description.zh: 交易终端风格的 DeepSeek Harness 计费插件：侧边栏余额与今日消费、按步骤人民币费用表、官方价自动同步（含峰谷）、跨会话与按天汇总、工具级费用归属与成本预测。

description.en: Per-turn first-token latency and output speed beside the built-in usage pill, folded on the host over the durable event log: first-token time is replayed from each message's compact stream, so historical turns stay exact after a reload rather than showing an estimate.
description.zh: 在自带用量胶囊旁显示每轮的首字延迟与输出速度，由宿主在持久事件日志上折叠得出：首字时刻从每条消息的压缩流中重放还原，所以刷新后历史轮次依然精确，而不是估算值。

description.en: Persistent bottom bar showing remaining Codex and Gemini quota (weekly and 5-hour windows with reset countdown) and the DeepSeek platform wallet balance. Codex and Gemini values come from accounts already signed in through the dsh-codex-subscription and dsh-gemini-pool plugins; each source can be switched off, and a switched-off source makes no requests.
description.zh: 在主界面底部常驻一条额度状态条：显示 Codex、Gemini 的周 / 5 小时剩余额度与重置倒计时，以及 DeepSeek 平台账号的钱包余额。Codex / Gemini 的数值来自 dsh-codex-subscription 与 dsh-gemini-pool 里已登录的账号；三个来源可分别关闭，关掉的来源不再发起任何请求。

description.en: DeepSeek API usage dashboard for DSH Web: daily cache-hit/miss and output token statistics from session logs, per-model cost estimates, account balance, 7-day trends, and a composer usage summary.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 DeepSeek API 用量仪表盘：基于会话日志统计每日缓存命中/未命中输入与输出 Token，并展示分模型费用估算、账户余额、7 日趋势和 composer 用量摘要。

description.en: Adds a /dshpp slash command that reports session and token usage, cache-hit rate, and estimated cost from harness session logs; the repo also ships a CLI and local web console for lifecycle, provider, session, and plugin-security management.
description.zh: 新增 /dshpp 斜杠命令，从 Harness 会话日志汇总会话数与 token 用量、缓存命中率与估算成本；同仓库还附带用于生命周期、Provider、会话与插件安全管理的 CLI 与本地 Web 控制台。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek balance and what the current session has cost in a corner overlay, with budget alerts, peak-hour warnings and opt-in official price sync.
description.zh: 在右下角浮层显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本会话花费，支持预算告警、峰时提醒，以及可选开启的官方价格同步。

description.en: Reports Codex reset probabilities and schedules in the DSH composer, with opt-in system notifications for completed resets and a read-only status and history tool.
description.zh: 在 DSH composer 中报道 Codex 重置概率与排期，支持已完成重置的可选系统通知，并提供只读状态与历史记录工具。

description.en: Daily cost card for your local LLM gateway: /usage reads gateway_usage.jsonl and itemizes spend per model and per hour, covering official direct, OpenRouter relay, and in-plan metered pools.
description.zh: 本地 LLM 网关当日花费价目卡：/usage 读取 gateway_usage.jsonl，按模型×分小时列出消费，覆盖官方直连、OpenRouter 中转与套餐内计费池。

description.en: MiniMax token-plan quota dock for the Web UI: a drop-shape 5h-usage % chip in the conversation input area, click for a detail panel listing every model's 5h & weekly usage and reset countdown, auto-hidden when the active default model is not a MiniMax model.
description.zh: DSH 网页 MiniMax 配额悬浮卡：会话输入区显示水滴形 5h 已用百分比，点击展开详情面板，列出每个模型的 5h/周用量与重置倒计时，当前默认模型非 MiniMax 时自动隐藏。

description.en: Global and per-session prompt templates in a right-side panel — insert into the draft or send now, edit, promote session templates to global, with SQLite persistence via the built-in node:sqlite.
description.zh: 右侧面板中的全局与会话级提示词模板——插入草稿或立即发送、编辑、会话模板提升为全局，SQLite 持久化走内置的 node:sqlite。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for SuperGrok and X Premium subscriptions: device-code sign-in, the xai provider, account-visible chat models with context and per-million-token prices, reasoning efforts read from model capabilities, and subscription usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SuperGrok / X Premium 订阅插件：设备码登录、xai 提供商、账号可见对话模型与上下文/百万 token 价格、按模型能力读取的推理强度，以及订阅用量。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness usage analytics dock on the composer: Beijing-time peak/valley pricing with all-day weekend valley rate, live balance, cross-session history, by-date drill-down and charts.
description.zh: DSH 用量分析坞：输入框峰谷计费坞（周末全天谷时）、实时余额、跨会话历史、按日期下钻与图表。

description.en: Persistent token-usage ledger and Web Usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 token 用量账本和 Web Usage 仪表盘。

description.en: Cuts session input tokens three ways, each with its own switch in a panel under the composer: lossless structure-aware compression of tool results on `tools/post-execute`, then a per-tool head/tail elision that always names a recovery path through the shared spill store; tool-catalogue visibility per agent on `agent/created`; and a per-workspace memory document that recall matches against each new message and injects through `agent.inject`, so the transcript is not re-read. Measured 41.76% fewer prompt tokens over 149 recorded requests, with a bundled script that re-measures any profile.
description.zh: 三条路径削减会话输入 tokens，每条都在输入框下方的面板里带独立开关：在 `tools/post-execute` 处对工具结果做无损结构化压缩，再对超预算结果做按工具的头尾裁剪，且每次都通过共享 spill store 给出恢复路径；在 `agent/created` 处按 agent 管理工具目录可见性；并为每个工作区维护会话记忆文档，recall 用每条新消息匹配它并通过 `agent.inject` 注入，避免重读上下文。在 149 次真实请求上实测 prompt tokens 减少 41.76%，并附带可复测任意 profile 的测量脚本。

description.en: Per-model token cost tracking with configurable cache-hit/miss, output and peak-window pricing, a live session cost bar, and unconfigured-model flags.
description.zh: 按模型追踪 token 成本：可配置缓存命中/未命中、输出与高峰时段单价，实时会话花费条，并标记未配置价格的模型。
