description.en: Token attention management panel for DeepSeek Harness: per-task/day/week/month token usage and cost tracking (input hit/miss, output, reasoning), DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, task-type recognition, and advice on when to switch sessions, write a hand-off, or compact context.
description.zh: Token 注意力管理面板：按任务/日/周/月记录 token 消耗与费用（命中/未命中/输出/推理四桶），支持 DeepSeek 峰谷计价与任务类型识别，并给出换对话、写 hand-off、压缩上下文的建议。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek API usage: account balance with low-balance alerts (browser notification on threshold crossing), token & request stats (total/today/last-60s windows, per-model and per-session), estimated cost — a composer dock plus a settings-page usage panel.
description.zh: 实时 DeepSeek API 用量：账户余额与低余额告警（跨阈值浏览器通知）、请求/token 统计（全部/今日/近 60s，按模型与会话下钻）、估算花费——输入框下方统计条 + 设置页用量面板。

description.en: Real-time session token usage and estimated cost in the composer stats row, with pricing fetched from DeepSeek official pricing page.
description.zh: 在输入框下方统计行实时显示当前会话累计 token 消耗与估算费用（人民币），价格从 DeepSeek 官方价格页动态获取。

description.en: Adds a colored status line under the DSH conversation stats showing live DeepSeek API cost, usage and account balance, with on/off-peak pricing indicators.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话统计行下方新增彩色状态行，实时显示 DeepSeek API 费用、用量与账户余额，并带高峰/错峰计费指示。

description.en: Shows real-time token and cost savings from the Headroom compression proxy in the DSH web UI: a Settings dashboard plus a persistent stats line under the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内实时展示 Headroom 压缩代理的 token 与费用节省：设置页仪表盘 + 输入区常驻统计行。

description.en: Live llmtrim savings dashboard in the DSH web UI: Settings page with paid, would-have-cost, saved-today and saved-this-week cards plus per-model breakdown, and a configurable rotating or static stats strip under the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内实时展示 llmtrim 节省统计：设置页金额卡片（已支付、未压缩应付、今日与本周节省）与按模型明细，输入区可配置轮播或静态统计条。

description.en: Plays a full-screen video while DeepSeek Harness starts and reveals the UI only after it ends. Esc skips it.
description.zh: 打开 DeepSeek Harness 时全屏播放一段开机视频，播完才露出界面，按 Esc 可跳过。

description.en: A configurable Liquid Glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with translucent surfaces, wallpaper, desktop transparency, window blur, custom cursors, click ripples, and per-side conversation contrast controls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的液态玻璃主题，包含半透明界面、壁纸、桌面透出、窗口模糊、自定义光标、点击涟漪和消息辨识选项。

description.en: Nai milk-frog mascot appearance layer for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: wears the bundled milk-frog artwork as the GUI background (surface-token fade with opacity, blur, scrim and position controls), seats the matching square avatar as the sidebar and conversation brand mark, and edits it all from a Settings section; the host serves the artwork and config locally under /api/nai, and the config lives at $DSH_HOME/nai.json.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端的奶蛙美化形象插件：把内置奶蛙素材铺成界面背景（表面令牌淡出，配合不透明度、模糊、遮罩与位置调节），将方形头像换到侧栏与会话标题的品牌标识位，并在设置页统一配置；素材与配置由宿主在 /api/nai 下本地提供，配置文件位于 $DSH_HOME/nai.json。

description.en: Wishing House theme skin with warm amber glow, live moon phases, meteors, typing sparks, procedural chime audio, and daily fortune slips.
description.zh: 许愿屋古风主题皮肤：暖灯琥珀色调、今日真实月相与轨迹、字落生辉打字萤火、纯原生风铃音效与每日许愿签。

description.en: DSH Web plugin that injects an SVG (feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap) refraction filter and applies it through backdrop-filter to panels, bubbles and the input card, and bundles the orca-scene skin with theme tokens plus light and dark backgrounds.
description.zh: DSH 网页端插件：注入 SVG（feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap）折射滤镜，并用 backdrop-filter 作用到面板、气泡与输入卡上；同时附带 orca-scene 皮肤（主题 token 与明暗两套背景）。

description.en: Local semantic-token theme editor with palette extraction, WCAG auditing, preview, and export.
description.zh: 本地语义令牌主题编辑器，支持色板提取、WCAG 审计、预览和导出。

description.en: Animated ASCII orca-ocean wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness that follows local time, with native plugin settings for brightness, saturation and composition.
description.zh: 随系统时间变化的 ASCII 虎鲸海洋动态壁纸，可在 DSH 原生插件设置中调节亮度、饱和度与构图。

description.en: iOS 26 liquid-glass skin: one white-grey-blue fog field behind the whole window, a single 40px frost on top of it, a floating glass sidebar and reply bubbles. Light and dark palettes, no photo wallpaper, no dependencies (33 KB).
description.zh: iOS 26 液态玻璃皮肤：整窗共用一层白→灰→淡蓝的静态雾场，雾上只磨一次（blur 40px），左侧栏是悬浮玻璃卡，回复是一条气泡；浅深两套配色，不用照片壁纸，零依赖（33 KB）。

description.en: A Genshin Impact Hu Tao (Wangsheng Funeral Parlor) skin for the dsh web GUI - a 14-token ink-black, crimson and amber palette, falling plum petals and spirit butterflies, a plum-blossom brand mark, and a floating petal toggle that tracks the sidebar.
description.zh: 原神胡桃（往生堂）主题皮肤：14 个主题令牌的墨黑、绯红与琥珀金配色，飘落梅花瓣与流光蝴蝶，梅花徽记，以及会跟随侧栏收放的浮动开关。

description.en: Arknights PRTS Originium Protocol theme featuring interactive 3D crystal, tactical HUD, memory fragments, and boot sequence.
description.zh: 明日方舟 PRTS 源石协议主题：可交互旋转 3D 源石晶簇、工业指令面板、普瑞赛斯记忆残片与启动序列。

description.en: Kami-inspired editorial skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with a warm parchment canvas, ink-blue accent, serif typography and hairline borders in light and dark palettes.
description.zh: 基于 Kami 视觉风格的 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 皮肤；暖羊皮纸画布、墨蓝强调色、衬线字形与发丝线边框，提供浅色与深色两套配色。

description.en: Upload an image as a full-window frosted-glass theme: sidebar/conversation/details share one frost layer, Save/Delete, official Light/Dark/System stay in charge.
description.zh: 上传图片作为整窗磨砂玻璃主题：侧栏/会话/详情同一层磨砂，保存/删除，官方浅色/深色/跟随系统仍有效。

description.en: Genshin Impact white-and-gold skin for the DSH web GUI: a random in-game landscape wallpaper on every page load, the Genshin UI font site-wide, a Paimon-style menu and a running-status element ring, and a switchable Paimon/Phanes assistant persona. The repository ships 262 wallpapers across eight regions at 1920x1080.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成原神白金风格：每次打开随机一张游戏内风景壁纸，全站使用原神界面字体，带派蒙风格菜单与运行状态元素环，可在派蒙/法涅斯两种人格间一键切换；仓库内置 262 张 1920x1080 壁纸，覆盖八个地区。

description.en: Customize the interface font, size, weight, color and layout from the settings page, Word-style and WYSIWYG, auto-saved. Ships two bundled open-source fonts (STIX2Text, Latin Modern Mono Light) plus an author-recommended typography, and stores settings under ~/.dsh.
description.zh: 在设置页里像 Word 一样改界面字体、字号、加粗、颜色与版式，所见即所得、自动保存。自带两套开源字体（STIX2Text、Latin Modern Mono Light）与一套作者推荐排版，设置存在 ~/.dsh（换桌面外壳不丢）。

description.en: Mistral subscription for DeepSeek Harness: model route, multi-account failover, and a composer usage panel.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 Mistral 订阅，提供模型路由、多账号故障切换和输入框额度面板。

description.en: Model channel auto-enricher for DeepSeek Harness: eliminates manually configuring contextWindow, maxTokens, \[text, image] multimodal input, and {low, high, max} reasoning effort tiers model by model after adding a provider channel, with live auto-enrichment on save, a Settings UI page, and timestamped backups.
description.zh: DSH 模型补齐助手：解决添加新渠道后还要把几十个模型一个个手动点开调百万上下文、调最大输出、勾多模态发图（\[text, image]）、配思考强度档位（{low, high, max}）的繁琐痛点，支持设置页添加模型保存后自动补齐与可视化一键补齐。

description.en: Picks each subagent model from the local catalog by task category, unless the caller already named one. Free and quota tiers are ranked together by per-model capability tags; a pricier model is used only when no cheap model is tagged as good at that kind of work. Only providers whose remaining balance is readable, or that are account-backed, enter the candidate pool; the rest stay listed but are not routed. A panel adds per-model manual priority above the automatic order plus allow/revoke controls.
description.zh: 未由调用方指定模型时，按任务类型从本机模型目录为每个子代理挑一个模型。免费与额度档合并后按逐模型能力标签排序；只有当便宜档里没有任何模型声明擅长这类工作时，才升到更贵的档。只有余额可读或账号接入的 provider 进候选池，其余仍列出但不参与路由。面板提供盖过自动顺序的逐模型手动优先级，以及放行/收回开关。

description.en: Fork of dsh-reasoning-effort with a two-level model picker in the composer: a provider list, a model pane that slides out beside it, search, and compact rows, alongside the reasoning-effort slider and its max-level effects.
description.zh: dsh-reasoning-effort 的分支：输入框里的两级模型选择器（Provider 列表 + 右侧滑出的模型栏）、搜索与紧凑行，并保留推理强度滑块与最高档特效。

description.en: Adds a Codex sign-in page to DSH settings, driving the built-in llm-pi-ai OAuth flow for browser or device-code login and showing masked account status without a separate provider or credential store.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页添加 Codex 登录入口，调用 llm-pi-ai 内置 OAuth 流程完成浏览器或设备码登录并展示脱敏账号状态，不另建模型适配器或凭证库。

description.en: Call a new-api (one-api style) relay station's video model from the conversation with @-referenced image/video materials, supporting Seedance 2.0 and Happyhorse text-to-video and image-to-video across four relay protocols.
description.zh: 在对话中用 @ 引用素材调用 new-api 中转站的视频大模型生成视频，支持 Seedance 2.0 与快乐马的文生视频和图生视频，覆盖四种中转协议。

description.en: Adaptive model routing: per-request complexity classification with automatic provider routing.
description.zh: 自适应模型路由：请求级复杂度分类，按配置链自动选择后端 provider。

description.en: Use your ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions in DSH, with image generation and web search support.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用你的 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅，并支持图像生成和 Web 搜索。

description.en: macOS Keychain credential provider that replaces the local-file provider and uses a signed, notarized universal helper.
description.zh: macOS Keychain 凭据提供器：替换本地文件提供器，并使用已签名、公证的通用二进制辅助程序。

description.en: Registers external ACP (Agent Client Protocol) agents such as Codex, Claude Code and Gemini CLI as DSH model providers: maps each agent's thought_level options to the reasoning-effort selector, forwards images when the agent advertises promptCapabilities.image, and routes permission requests to DSH's approval dialog; ships an ACP Agents settings page that imports Zed agent_servers JSON and discovers models.
description.zh: 把 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等外部 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）Agent 注册为 DSH 模型提供方：Agent 的 thought_level 选项映射为推理等级菜单，Agent 声明 promptCapabilities.image 时转发图片，权限请求走 DSH 原生审批框；附带 ACP Agents 设置页，可导入 Zed 的 agent_servers JSON 并发现模型。

description.en: Use TRAE account model quota in dsh, with multi-account management, daily check-in, rotation, usage statistics, reasoning levels and model visibility. Requires Python 3.10+; the first run downloads Python dependencies.
description.zh: 将 TRAE 账号的模型额度接入 dsh，支持多账号管理、自动签到、账号轮询、用量统计、思考强度选择和模型显示管理。 需要 Python 3.10+，首次使用需联网安装 Python 依赖。

description.en: Connects a locally-signed-in Cursor desktop app to dsh as a native LlmAdapter — reads the Cursor login token from state.vscdb or auth.json, drives the private agent.v1.AgentService/Run HTTP/2 bidi stream, and translates InteractionUpdate deltas into dsh StreamChunks. No loopback proxy. macOS, Windows and Linux.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 Cursor 桌面应用接入 dsh，原生 LlmAdapter 直连：从 state.vscdb 或 auth.json 读登录态，驱动 agent.v1.AgentService/Run 的 HTTP/2 双向流，把 InteractionUpdate 增量翻成 dsh StreamChunk，不走 loopback 代理。支持 macOS / Windows / Linux。

description.en: Unofficial Zhipu Qingyan (chatglm.cn) web provider — run DeepSeek Harness on web-app credits with a login token, streaming and prompt-bridged tool calls included.
description.zh: 非官方的智谱清言（chatglm.cn）网页版 provider——用网页版登录态与积分驱动 DSH，支持流式输出与提示词桥工具调用。

description.en: Native MiniMax provider for DeepSeek Harness: chat over the official MiniMax API, plus image, video, speech, music and transcription tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入原生 MiniMax：通过官方 MiniMax API 对话，并提供生图、视频、语音、音乐与语音转写工具。

description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness model API requests through a system, custom or SOCKS proxy; requests outside the configured domains stay direct.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 API 请求送进系统代理、自定义代理或 SOCKS 代理，清单之外的请求一律直连。

description.en: Adds OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT) as a selectable DSH provider via the local Codex App Server.
description.zh: 通过本机 Codex App Server，将 OpenAI Codex（ChatGPT）作为可选 DSH Provider。

description.en: Search-first model selector with favorites, recent models, collapsible provider groups and keyboard navigation.
description.zh: 模型再多也好找：搜索、收藏、最近使用、服务商分组折叠与键盘快速切换。

description.en: Registers a wrapper provider that gives delegated subagents their own LLM route — one-off spawns through provider.start, Agent Teams members through a hook on startActivation — while the main agent keeps its model. Ships a Settings section for picking that route, a per-expert override file, a capability flag reporting which seams the hook caught, and a readiness record written at mount.
description.zh: 注册一个包装 provider，让被委派的子代理走自己的 LLM 路由——单发子代理经 provider.start，Agent Teams 成员经 startActivation 上的钩子——主 agent 仍用自己的模型。附带设置页选择路由、按专家覆盖的配置文件、报告钩子挂在哪条缝上的能力标志，以及挂载时写下的就绪记录。

description.en: Turns the MiniMax Code (Mavis) subscription already signed in on this machine into a DSH model provider, renewing the OAuth token itself so the desktop client can stay closed, with points, check-in and subscription-quota panels.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 MiniMax Code（Mavis）订阅接入 DSH 作为模型 provider，自己完成 OAuth 续期所以桌面客户端可以一直关着，并提供积分、签到与订阅额度面板。

description.en: Agnes AI provider for llm-pi-ai: 4 multimodal chat models declared in the bundle patch, plus image and video generation tools.
description.zh: 为 llm-pi-ai 预声明 Agnes AI 供应商：4 个多模态对话模型，以及图像与视频生成工具。

description.en: Google Antigravity and Cloud Code Assist model provider with Gemini 3.8 Flash, sandbox failover, and multi-account quota management.
description.zh: Google Antigravity 与 Cloud Code Assist 模型提供方插件，支持 Gemini 3.8 Flash、沙箱端点容灾与多账号配额管理。

description.en: One-click/auto sync provider model lists against /v1/models endpoint.
description.zh: 一键同步 / 自动同步供应商模型列表，与 /v1/models 保持一致。

description.en: Adds a mood system to DeepSeek Harness — 33 named moods judged every 3-6 hours with small per-message adjustments, plus cross-session memory, an aesthetic taste library and an encrypted diary. The mood, memory, taste and diary tools are all callable by the model, and each of the five modules has its own switch. Flat by default: every mood starts at 0, so a quiet day reads as calm instead of an always-on mood. The diary is written only by the model; no summary template is generated. A trimmed fork of JMX-4869/dsh-mood; install either this or upstream dsh-mood, not both, because both register the same mood/diary/taste/memory tool names.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套心情系统：33 种心情，每 3~6 小时一次周期判定，并随消息小幅增减；另有跨会话记忆、审美品味库、加密日记。心情、记忆、品味、日记四个工具都可由模型调用，五个模块各有独立开关。心情底分全为 0，平静的日子就显示平静，不会永远挂着某个心情在跑。日记只由模型自己写，不生成系统总结模板。本插件是 JMX-4869/dsh-mood 的精简 fork：二者注册同名的心情 / 日记 / 品味 / 记忆工具，不能同时安装，只能二选一。

description.en: Switches a bot between qq-bridge role cards and dsh-persona-dafeiyu personas so only one is active, either globally or one persona per QQ conversation. Needs a running qq-bridge.
description.zh: 在 qq-bridge 角色卡与 dsh-persona-dafeiyu 人设之间切换，保证只生效一个；可全局生效，也可每个 QQ 会话各配一个。需 qq-bridge 已运行。

description.en: A simulated human-brain core for chat: global workspace, emotional appraisal, dual-system memory with nightly consolidation, and an experimental sensory interface; the QQ bridge needs a local snowluma client and is off by default.
description.zh: 一个按计算神经科学定律运行的拟人认知内核：全局工作空间、情感评估、双系统记忆与夜间归纳，可接管 QQ 群聊（需自备 snowluma 客户端，默认关闭）。

description.en: Manage DeepSeek Harness agent presets (personas) from a Settings page: create one on top of a shipped base preset, edit a persona in place, lay it out in a rendered preview, and export or import it as JSON or Markdown. Edits to a hand-written profile patch are applied as text, so comments, quoting and loader expressions survive. Desktop app is the tested environment; creating from a base preset needs the yaml package that ships with DSH.
description.zh: 在设置页里管理 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 预设（人设）：基于官方预设新建、就地编辑人设正文、用排版预览检查效果，并导出或导入 JSON 备份与 Markdown。改写 profile 里手写的预设时按文本替换，注释、引号和 loader 表达式都原样保留。实测环境为桌面版；基于基准预设新建需要随 DSH 发布的 yaml 包。

description.en: Puts the agent on the Muretai network: its own identity, invite-based introductions, signed end-to-end encrypted messaging with agents owned by other people, and an inbound-mail wake that lets it reply on its own.
description.zh: 让智能体加入 Muretai 网络：拥有自己的身份，通过邀请相识，与属于其他人的智能体进行签名、端到端加密的通信；来信唤醒后可自行回复。

description.en: Persona state and slow evolution for DSH: five state dimensions (valence, arousal, energy, intimacy, focus) move after each turn and decay toward baseline over time; four scene types (work, tech, support, chat) modulate reply length and warmth without changing the state itself; the Soul panel keeps a persona card plus weighted evolution entries and injects them into the system prompt persona-first under a 4000-character budget. Ships a browser panel with a persona card editor and a live state view (the five metrics plus the last six events), appends a JSONL trace to disk, and seeds a usable default persona on first install.
description.zh: 人格状态与缓慢演化：五个状态维度（效价、激活、精力、亲近、专注）每轮对话后更新、随时间向基线衰减；四种场景（工作、技术求助、情绪支持、闲聊）只调回复长度与温度，不改状态本身；Soul 面板保存人格卡与带权重的演化条目，按权重排序注入系统提示词，总预算 4000 字，人格在前、状态在后。带浏览器面板：人格卡编辑 + 实时人格状态（五个指标与最近六条事件），并把轨迹以 JSONL 落盘；首次安装会种入一份可用的默认人格。

description.en: Two-level sidebar organizer with workspace groups and nested per-workspace session folders, drag-and-drop, live session status dots, a pending-sessions overview, and manual unread marks.
description.zh: 两级侧边栏组织器：工作区分组 + 工作区内嵌套会话文件夹，支持拖拽、会话状态点、待处理会话概览与手动未处理标记。

description.en: DSH SMOOTH: config-only bundle for a lighter DSH UI - compact transcript and usage views, 16 px font and 200 ms job polling out of the box - plus a troubleshooting SKILL.md and opt-in recipes (appended by hand to your own cordis.patch.yml or the profile) to remove the Agents-Anywhere "Reconnect" button, slim the tool list, drop legacy sub-agent bundles and make compaction thresholds take effect. User patches still win; rollback = remove the bundle.
description.zh: DSH 顺滑包：纯配置 bundle，装上即把对话与用量视图精简为 compact、字号 16、任务轮询放缓到 200ms；另附排障 SKILL.md 和需手动启用的可选配方（追加到自己的 cordis.patch.yml 或手改 profile）：去掉 Agents-Anywhere 的「重新连接」按钮、精简工具表、移除不兼容的旧子代理、让压缩阈值真正生效。用户自己的 patch 优先，移除 bundle 即回滚。

description.en: Share any excerpt of a conversation.
description.zh: 分享任意段落的对话。

description.en: Organize DeepSeek Harness workspace sessions by renaming them as 类别｜主题 and reporting archive, rename, and review suggestions.
description.zh: 整理 DeepSeek Harness 工作区会话，按 类别｜主题 重命名并给出归档、改名与待判断建议。

description.en: Session recycle bin for DeepSeek Harness: deleting a session from its row menu (or in bulk from the sidebar header) moves it into a recycle bin kept for 15 days by default — 7, 15 or 30 in settings — and expired entries are purged automatically. The bin table shows the days left for each entry, restores it to its original workspace, and can delete an entry for good, one at a time or all at once.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话回收站：从会话行菜单删除（或从侧栏标题栏批量移入）后，会话进入回收站，默认保留 15 天（设置里可选 7 / 15 / 30 天），到期条目自动清除；回收站表格显示每条还剩几天，可还原回原工作区，也可单条彻底删除或清空。

description.en: Fork companion for DSH: on any official fork, copies every direct subagent child of the source session onto the forked conversation (recursively, whole subtrees) through the official agent API, leaving each copy as a cold session the official resume path can wake — so the new conversation keeps its subagent panel and can keep messaging those children, while the originals stay with the old branch.
description.zh: DSH 的 fork 伴随插件:官方 fork 发生后,把原会话的直接子 agent 复制到 fork 出的新对话下(递归复制整棵子树,副本经官方 agent API 创建),每个副本留在磁盘上成为可被官方恢复路径唤醒的冷会话——新对话保留子代理面板,并能继续给这些子代理发消息;原件仍留在旧分支。

description.en: Creates an isolated folder for each new default-workspace session and renames it to match the session title.
description.zh: 为默认工作区中的每个新会话创建独立文件夹，并根据会话标题重命名。

description.en: Inspects the model's streamed reply before it is committed and either discards it or holds it for review when it reads as a refusal, so that text does not stay in the session context. Detection combines built-in phrase rules (an opening refusal, a capability denial, policy wording, first-person intent, refusals quoted in reasoning) with a plain-text word list and optional regular expressions. Interception can sit at the llm/stream waterfall, at the HTTP fetch layer before encryption (not TLS decryption, and it cannot tell which session a call belongs to), at both, or in a preview mode that shows a transient preview while the original chunks stay in memory until the whole reply has been checked. The same plugin also guards tool calls on tools/pre-execute: a command that deletes a drive, filesystem or user-profile root, formats or repartitions a volume, empties the Recycle Bin, fetches and executes a remote script, or writes to a raw device is denied, and a recursive delete outside build directories is recorded by default. Each tier can be set to deny, ask, record, or off, and the disk guard has its own switch. Both halves are heuristics: they can miss phrasings, the disk guard sees the arguments of a call rather than what a running script does, and they fail open.
description.zh: 在模型的拒绝性回复提交进会话之前检查并处理：丢弃或暂存待你放行，避免这段文字留在会话上下文里。判定用内置短语规则（开头拒绝语、能力否认、政策措辞、第一人称拒绝意图、思考中引用的拒绝句）加自定义词库与可选正则。拦截位置可在 llm/stream、加密前的 HTTP fetch 层（不是 TLS 解密，也拿不到调用属于哪个会话）、两者同时，或「实时预览」模式——原始 chunk 先留在内存，整段输出检查通过后才提交。同一个插件还在 tools/pre-execute 上守工具调用：删除盘符根、文件系统根或用户目录，格式化或重新分区，清空回收站，下载即执行，写裸设备这类命令会被拒绝；构建目录之外的递归删除默认只记录。两档都可设为拒绝、先问我、记录或不处理，磁盘保护另有总开关。两部分都是启发式规则：可能漏掉某些说法；磁盘保护只看得到调用参数，看不到正在运行的脚本内部；出错时一律放行。

description.en: Archived-session manager: an "Archived Sessions" settings page that lists archived sessions and lets you restore or permanently delete each one (two-step confirmation).
description.zh: 归档会话管理：在设置页新增“归档会话”，列出所有已归档会话，支持恢复与二次确认后的永久删除。

description.en: Cross-session task queue with handoff notes: sessions and subagents push, claim, complete and cancel tasks on a shared file-backed queue, and leave a handoff summary for whoever picks up next.
description.zh: 跨会话任务队列与交接摘要：会话与子 agent 在共享的文件队列上投递、认领、完成、取消任务，并留下交接摘要供后续会话查看。

description.en: Session cleanup for the DSH sidebar: drag a conversation row onto the balance widget's whale and it eats the row — the session directory goes to a recycle bin, not to rm. Deletion asks one short question first (how many tokens it burned, and that prompt can be turned off in Settings). Undo from the persistent toast or the 12-entry log in Settings. Clicking the whale jumps straight to the plugin's Settings, where you can swap the avatar, drag the mouth into place and rewrite all 17 UI strings; blank, currently-open and running sessions are refused in place with a reason.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的会话清理：把会话行拖到余额挂件的小胖鱼嘴边，它张嘴吃掉 —— 会话目录移入回收站，不是 rm。删除前只问一句「消耗了多少 token，真的给我吃吗？」（可在设置里关掉）；撤销走常驻回执或设置里 12 条持久台账。点侧栏那条小鱼直达插件设置：换形象、拖拽校准嘴位、改写全部 17 段界面文案；空白会话 / 正在聊的 / 正在跑的会被就地拒绝并写明原因。

description.en: Switch the current session's agent preset (mode) at any time, including after the conversation has already started, from a session-header dropdown backed by a fenced POST /preset-switch/api route. The route also repairs sessions whose recorded preset was deleted. Fork of jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher updated for DSH 0.2.1.
description.zh: 随时切换当前会话的代理预设（模式），对话开始后也能切：会话头下拉菜单，由受限的 POST /preset-switch/api 路由支撑；该路由还会修复记录中预设已被删除的会话。jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher 的分支，已适配 DSH 0.2.1。

description.en: Windows minimal agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: fixed one-line persona, three tools, no runtime context.
description.zh: Windows 极简模式 preset：单句 persona、三工具、无运行时上下文。

description.en: Auto-continue for the dsh web GUI: when a local model hits its output-token cap and the max-tokens notice appears, the plugin automatically queues a short continue message so the reply keeps flowing — dual-source truncation detection, loop protection, and no UI.
description.zh: dsh 网页端输出上限自动继续：本地模型输出到上限出现提示时，自动发送「继续」让回复接上；双源截断检测、防死循环保护，完全无 UI。

description.en: Right-click session menu and sidebar session manager: pin, rename, archive, fork, export, copy cwd/id/deep link, and open in explorer or a new window.
description.zh: 会话行右键菜单与侧边栏会话管理：置顶、重命名、归档、分叉、导出、复制工作目录/会话 ID/深链，在资源管理器或新窗口打开。

description.en: Tag each session as a long-term or short-term task, record the agent mode it was created with, and auto-archive it once the archive window you set elapses.
description.zh: 为每个会话标记长期任务或短期任务、记录创建时的 Agent 模式，并在你设定的归档时间窗结束后自动归档。

description.en: Delete one finished turn from a DSH conversation without deleting the session — the trash button next to the last assistant reply removes the question, that reply and the tool records of the turn from the conversation surface and from the model context, while the session id, title, later turns and the append-only log stay; the removal is written as a persistent tombstone, so it survives a reload.
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话中删除一个已结束的轮次而不删除会话本身——最后一条助手回复旁的垃圾桶按钮会把该轮的提问、这条回复与工具记录从对话界面和模型上下文中移除，而 Session id、标题、之后的轮次与只追加日志保持不变；删除以持久 tombstone 记录，刷新后依然生效。

description.en: Adds a Windows Explorer right-click action to open a folder as a DSH workspace, launching DSH if needed.
description.zh: 给 Windows 文件管理器加右键项：把文件夹设为 DSH 工作区并切换到它，DSH 未运行会自动拉起。

description.en: Adds a permanent-delete row to the sidebar menu of archived sessions, removing the session log, its projection cache and its workspace registration.
description.zh: 在侧栏「已归档」会话的菜单里加一行彻底删除，一次清掉会话日志、投影缓存与工作区登记。

description.en: Adds a "Move to another workspace…" row to every conversation menu: copies the full event log into the target workspace under a new session id (header, title and model preset preserved, delivery markers retargeted), reads the copy back to verify it, attaches it, then archives the original unless you keep it.
description.zh: 在每个对话的「⋯」菜单里加一行「转移到其他工作区…」：把完整事件日志复制成目标工作区下的新会话（保留 header、标题与模型预设，并改写投递标记），读回校验后挂载，默认归档原会话（可勾选保留）。

description.en: Backs up DeepSeek Harness sessions, plugin config and workspace memory to Nutstore (Jianguoyun) over WebDAV, with incremental upload, connection test and one-click restore on a new machine.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话记录、插件配置与工作区记忆通过 WebDAV 增量备份到坚果云，支持连接测试与在新机器上一键恢复。

description.en: Injects a fixed system-prompt section so the agent always replies in Simplified Chinese — including the short narration between tool calls — unless you explicitly ask for another language. Applies to every session and preset without overriding the persona.
description.zh: 向系统提示注入固定语言指令，让 Agent 始终用简体中文回复（含工具调用之间的叙述文字），除非你明确要求其他语言；对所有会话与预设生效，且不覆盖 persona。

description.en: Turns this machine's DSH session logs into daily, weekly and monthly briefs with three reading layers, tool-call statistics, token and cost estimates, blockers and unfinished todos, a morning card above the welcome-page whale, and optional Windows idle-time health reminders. By default it writes summaries without calling any model.
description.zh: 把本机 DSH 会话日志整理成日报／周报／月报：三层阅读结构、工具调用统计、token 与花费估算、卡点与未完成待办，另有欢迎页鲸鱼上方的早晨卡片与可选的 Windows 键鼠空闲健康提醒。默认不调用模型即可生成摘要。

description.en: Turns DSH into a local OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible gateway endpoint that puts one persona and long-term memory in front of every client pointed at it; requires your own DeepSeek API key — the DSH login credential is rejected upstream.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成本机的 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容网关端点，给指向它的客户端统一套上同一套人格与长期记忆；需自备 DeepSeek API Key（DSH 的登录凭证在上游会被拒）。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness via the official storage domain: memories persist through ctx.storage (storageDomain table) and are injected into the system prompt through a registered section (memory:recall), with memory_save / memory_forget tools so the agent reads and writes its own memory (maxMemories configurable).
description.zh: 跨会话记忆插件：用官方 ctx.storage 存储域持久化记忆，注册 system-prompt section（memory:recall）把记忆注入模型上下文，提供 memory_save / memory_forget 工具让 agent 自行存取记忆（maxMemories 可配置）。

description.en: Memory protocol enforcement plugin: bridges the opencode-memory MCP server, forces memory_weave before tool calls, auto-ingests turns, and injects memory context into agent steps.
description.zh: 记忆强制协议插件：桥接 opencode-memory MCP 服务器，工具调用前强制 memory_weave、每轮自动存档、自动注入记忆上下文。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory backed by a local Go service (~50MB RAM, SQLite-vec + verify-augmented claims): zero-lag recall injection on every user message, session-end transcript ingest, and memory_search / memory_logs / memory_ingest tools. Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add @djasdh/interest-memory-dsh-bridge`. Protocol bridge only: the Go service is not installed by `dsh plugin add` — install and start it per the repository README first; until it runs, the tools silently return nothing.
description.zh: 由本地 Go 服务支撑的跨会话长期记忆（约 50MB 内存，SQLite-vec + 经验证增强的论断）：每条用户消息零延迟注入召回、会话结束时摄入对话记录，提供 memory_search / memory_logs / memory_ingest 工具。安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @djasdh/interest-memory-dsh-bridge`。仅为协议桥：Go 主服务不随 `dsh plugin add` 安装，需先按仓库 README 安装并启动；服务未运行时工具静默返回空。

description.en: Offline QR code (SVG/PNG/ASCII) and barcode (Code128/EAN-13) generator for DeepSeek Harness, no network and no shell.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 离线二维码（SVG/PNG/ASCII）与条码（Code128/EAN-13）生成器，无网络、无 shell。

description.en: Scans the skills visible to the current session and ranks them by relevance to the recent conversation.
description.zh: 扫描当前会话可见的技能，按与最近对话的相关性排序推荐。

description.en: BM25 keyword-based memory recall.
description.zh: 基于 BM25 关键词检索的记忆召回。

description.en: Project-scoped deterministic execution trace memory and zero-token session digest plugin for DSH, compiling session histories into guarded playbooks and behavior summaries with inline session_id lineage. Registers the /tmem slash command, recalls memories only on explicit file-path or error anchors in agent/pre-step (skipping unchanged repeated steps), and intercepts tools/post-execute errors and code edits with same-origin L2 fixes, failure-loop warnings, and statistical L1 co-change partner hints (skipping routine read calls when idle). Needs Python 3 on PATH (or TMEM_PYTHON) and spawns python3 -m tmem.cli with a 5-second timeout; stores all data inside each project's .tmem/ directory (no ~/.tmem/ global store) and makes no network requests. It needs Python 3 on PATH (or TMEM_PYTHON) and runs python3 -m tmem.cli synchronously, with a 5-second timeout, on every agent step and tool result; traces are stored in .tmem/ inside each project and in ~/.tmem/ shared across projects. It makes no network requests.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的项目级确定性执行轨迹记忆与零额外 token 历史会话摘要插件，将会话历史提炼为带守卫条件的执行剧本及内联 session_id 溯源的需求行为摘要。注册 /tmem 斜杠命令，在 agent/pre-step 仅基于显式文件路径或报错锚点召回记忆（跳过输入未变的重复步骤），并在 tools/post-execute 对报错和代码修改拦截提供同源 L2 修复、死循环熔断警告与统计 L1 共变文件提醒（空闲时跳过常规读取工具）。需要 PATH 中有 Python 3（或设置 TMEM_PYTHON），通过子进程调用 python3 -m tmem.cli（超时 5 秒）；所有数据仅存于各项目 .tmem/ 目录（无 ~/.tmem/ 全局存储），不发任何网络请求。需要 PATH 里有 Python 3（或设置 TMEM_PYTHON），并在每个 agent 步骤和每条工具结果上同步运行 python3 -m tmem.cli（5 秒超时）；轨迹存放在各项目内的 .tmem/ 和跨项目共用的 ~/.tmem/。不发任何网络请求。

description.en: Local-first memory and persona plugin for DeepSeek Harness: four file-backed memory layers (pinned, memory, facts, experience), editable SOUL/MOOD persona, zero-LLM session capture, BM25 recall and a themed mood card; no standalone web panel, Python service, vector database, or API key.
description.zh: 澜·轻量本地记忆与人格系统：四层文件记忆（pinned / memory / facts / experience）、可编辑 SOUL/MOOD 人格、零 LLM 捕获、BM25 检索与状态池卡片；无独立管理面板，不依赖 Python 服务、向量库或 API Key。

description.en: Context manager for DeepSeek Harness: auto-summarizes every turn into priority-sorted records, injects them plus pinned cross-session notes and custom text into each model request, and folds any-size real conversation ranges into summaries to save tokens. Persistent and restart-safe. NOTE: manual multi-step install — copy the three package folders into profiles/node_modules and add the provided cordis.patch.yml rows, then restart DSH; not a standard one-command install.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 上下文管理：每轮对话自动总结为记录并按优先级排序注入，⭐ 置顶记录跨会话继承，自定义文本每轮注入；真实对话任意范围折叠成摘要真省 token，全状态持久化重启不丢。注意：非标准一键安装——需手动将三个包目录复制到 profiles/node_modules、粘贴 cordis.patch.yml 接线并重启 DSH。

description.en: On-demand memory for DeepSeek Harness: session logs are distilled into layered markdown (a summary, an index and per-topic files), and a mem_query tool returns only the matched entries rather than the whole index. Nothing is injected per turn, there are no dependencies, and every entry keeps a source pointer back to the conversation it came from.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的按需记忆库：会话日志提炼成分层 markdown（总览、索引与分主题明细），mem_query 只回命中条目而非整份索引。不每轮注入、零依赖，每条记忆都保留指回原对话的溯源标记。

description.en: Cipher memory platform as a DSH bundle: four memory types (attention, experience, preference, cognitive) sedimented per turn by four memory agents, cross-session deterministic recall injected via systemPrompt.context, insight review kept out of user-facing output, per-session UNNI/LOOP modes with memory-driven auto-continuation, memory search/ingest tools, plus a settings page (SOUL editor) and an AgentPool panel.
description.zh: 把 cipher 记忆平台原生带进 DSH：四类记忆每轮沉淀、跨会话确定性检索经 systemPrompt.context 注入、洞察复核只进沉淀、会话级 UNNI/LOOP 模式（记忆驱动自动续轮）、记忆检索/写入两个工具，以及设置页（SOUL 编辑器）与 AgentPool 面板。

description.en: Build auditable KB packs (SQLite FTS5) from md/txt/docx/pdf with deterministic retrieval and original-text reading.
description.zh: 从 md/txt/docx/pdf 构建可审计知识库包（SQLite FTS5），确定性检索与原文阅读。

description.en: Project+global long-term memory for the dsh web GUI: split POST /items endpoints, tool-call context merged into memory items as compact summaries, with deduplication and session-scoped persistence.
description.zh: dsh 网页端项目级+全局长期记忆：分拆 POST /items 路由避免路径冲突，多轮工具调用上下文压缩后存入记忆项，去重与会话级持久化。

description.en: Per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness. Three Markdown files per workspace — PROJECT.md, DECISIONS.md and SESSIONS.md — are auto-created on the first step of any session in that workspace, re-read from disk and re-injected only when they change (and re-injected if compaction dropped them), and written back by classification through a memory_checkpoint tool, with a bounded end-of-turn nudge when a turn did work but recorded nothing. memory_read and memory_search read the live log and the archive, the latter over a zero-dependency BM25 index. The session log is capped at 200 entries with the overflow moved to SESSIONS-archive.md — never injected, but visible, readable and searchable, and restorable one entry at a time. Settings page: a workspace list with a path filter, read-only tabs for the three memory files plus the archive, reload, export/import of one workspace's memory as a JSON bundle, a two-step clear, a panel that rewrites or removes the AGENTS.md instruction block, and a PROJECT.md staleness reminder. A composer status chip shows that workspace's sync state and creates the files on click. Zero dependencies — no vector store, no embeddings, and no model calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的项目记忆插件。每个工作区三份 Markdown 文件（PROJECT.md / DECISIONS.md / SESSIONS.md）：会话首个步骤自动创建、内容变了才重新注入（被上下文压缩挤掉也会重注入），并按分类经 memory_checkpoint 工具写回，在「干了实事却没记录」时给一次收尾提醒。memory_read 与 memory_search 可读活日志与归档，后者走零依赖 BM25 索引。会话日志上限 200 条，溢出搬进 SESSIONS-archive.md —— 不自动注入，但可见、可读、可搜，并能逐条恢复。设置界面：带路径筛选的工作区列表 / 三份记忆文件与归档的只读页签 / 重新读取 / 单个工作区记忆包的导出导入（JSON）/ 两步确认的清除 / AGENTS.md 指令段的重写或移除面板 / PROJECT.md 陈旧提醒。输入框状态图标显示该工作区的同步状态，无记忆时可点击创建。零依赖——不含向量库、embedding 或模型调用。

description.en: A local-first personal state record and decision engine for dsh: keeps every input byte-for-byte with line-level provenance, argues against its own conclusions by generating defeaters first, ages each stored fact with its own TTL, and reports where a decision rests on nothing at all.
description.zh: 本地优先的个人状态档案与决策引擎：逐字保留你的原始输入并精确到行地溯源，给出结论前先生成"证伪项"反驳自己，为每个事实单独设置有效期，并指出这个决定正建立在哪些空白之上。

description.en: Decision-and-goal memory with lineage: explicit commands and a model tool record decisions deterministically, a status card re-anchors them across compaction, a lossless event stream with BM25+jieba retrieval backs it, and a scenario-level fidelity regression suite gates releases.
description.zh: 带血缘的决策与目标记忆：显式命令与模型工具确定性记录决策，状态卡跨压缩重锚定，无损事件流 + BM25 分词检索兜底，场景级保真回归集作发布门禁。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) integration for DeepSeek Harness: 25 tools for chat messages and history, cloud documents (including knowledge-base pages, generated charts and images), bitable records, spreadsheet ranges and drive permissions, using your own enterprise self-built Feishu app.
description.zh: 飞书（Lark）集成：25 个工具，覆盖群消息与聊天记录、云文档（含知识库页面、自动生成的图表与图片）、多维表格记录、电子表格区间读写与文档授权，基于企业自建应用。

description.en: Parse Chinese e-invoice PDFs (XML attachment first, text-layer regex fallback) into structured JSON with amount cross-check, and generate expense reports (Markdown / xlsx).
description.zh: 解析增值税电子发票 PDF（XML 附件优先、文本层正则兜底）为结构化 JSON + 金额勾稽校验，多张汇总生成报销单（Markdown / xlsx）。

description.en: One-click create, update or remove the DeepSeek Harness desktop shortcut with switchable custom icons and a draggable whale button.
description.zh: 一键创建、更新或删除 DeepSeek Harness 桌面快捷方式，图标可自定义上传切换，蓝白金鲸鱼悬浮按钮可拖动，点击旋转 90° 弹出面板。

description.en: Windows desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-first observe/act loop with 30 standard tools (element/coordinate targets, auto/a11y/event strategy routing), superseded-observations and no-replay safety semantics, persistent kill switch, RuntimeId/rect-drift stale protection, chat cards and a floating panel (live ops, frame wall, env auto-detect settings), tiled vision describe for low-res models, JSONL audit trail and a pid allowlist. Requires Windows 10+ and Python 3.9+ with uiautomation and pillow (installable from the settings page).
description.zh: Windows 桌面自动化插件：无障碍优先的观察-动作回路（30 个标准工具，元素/坐标双目标与 auto/a11y/event 策略路由），写后作废与禁重放安全语义，持久急停开关，RuntimeId/矩形漂移防错位，对话卡片与悬浮面板（实况/画面/环境自检设置），面向低分辨率模型的分块识图，JSONL 审计与 pid 白名单。需 Windows 10+ 与 Python 3.9+，并安装 uiautomation 与 pillow（设置页可一键安装）。

description.en: Disk Janitor for DeepSeek Harness — reports where DSH disk usage goes and reclaims only what is safe to rebuild, always keeping the resources currently in use.
description.zh: DSH 磁盘清理插件：看清磁盘占用都花在哪，只清理可以安全重建的部分，正在使用中的资源始终保留。

description.en: Safe, resumable automation and analysis tools for CST Studio Suite, with task planning, solve-budget control, persistent runs, result extraction, far-field analysis, and parameter sweeps.
description.zh: 面向 CST Studio Suite 的安全、可恢复自动化与分析插件，支持任务规划、求解预算控制、持久化运行、结果提取、远场分析和参数扫描。

description.en: Transactional uninstall engine: every destructive action runs validate/preview/execute/undo with Saga rollback, WAL crash recovery, hash-chain audit, hardlink dedup, and a Bayesian oracle that predicts success probability before you commit.
description.zh: 事务化卸载引擎：每个破坏性动作走 validate/preview/execute/undo 四段式并带 Saga 回滚，WAL 崩溃恢复、hash chain 审计、硬链接去重，提交前先知推演成功率。

description.en: Adds a subagent_routed tool that runs a one-shot subagent fully mounted on any agent preset from any session, with per-call model/provider override and a model-availability pre-check.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_routed 工具：从任意会话发起一次性子 Agent，并完整挂载到任意 agent preset 上运行，支持按次覆盖模型/提供方，并在调用前预检模型可用性。

description.en: Econometrics research assistant: 6 tools covering method selection, data preparation, model specification, empirical analysis with Python/R/Stata code templates, robustness checks, and result reporting.
description.zh: 计量经济学研究助手：6 个工具覆盖方法选择、数据预处理、模型设定、实证分析（含 Python/R/Stata 代码模板）、稳健性检验与结果报告。

description.en: A document preview / edit / management plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It provides a VSCode-style "Document Center" workbench inside the DSH Web GUI: a file tree on the left, click-to-preview, editable code & Markdown with Ctrl/Cmd+S save; and exposes three document tools (doc_read / doc_edit / doc_create) to agents, letting models read and write workspace documents through natural language.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的文档预览 / 编辑 / 管理插件。在 DSH Web GUI 中提供一个 VSCode 风格的「文档中心」工作台：左侧文件树，点击即预览，代码与 Markdown 支持编辑与 Ctrl/Cmd+S 保存；同时为 Agent 暴露 doc_read / doc_edit / doc_create 三个文档工具，让模型可以通过自然语言读写工作区文档。

description.en: Renders the built-in cache-hit percentage with three decimals and widens the composer stats line to prevent truncation.
description.zh: 把内置缓存命中率原位显示为 3 位小数，并加宽底部统计行避免内容被截断。

description.en: Drives the installed AutoCAD over COM and exposes it to the agent as 18 mcp__autocad__ tools: connect and status, cancel the current command, list registered ProgIDs, list or create documents, save, create and list layers, draw lines, circles, rectangles, polylines, arcs and text, list entities, zoom to extents, and pass any native command through. A sidebar panel owns the Python bridge process — start, stop, restart, dependency bootstrap, live logs and crash recovery — and resolves every path at runtime, so the same bundle serves both the web app and the desktop app. Windows only, Python 3.10-3.12, AutoCAD 2022-2024 documented (2024 is the default; other versions require setting CAD_PROG_ID to the matching ProgID).
description.zh: 通过 COM 驱动本机安装的 AutoCAD，把它暴露成 18 个 mcp__autocad__ 工具：连接与状态、取消当前命令、列出本机注册的 ProgID、列出或新建文档、保存、新建与列出图层、绘制直线/圆/矩形/多段线/圆弧/文字、列出图元、缩放到范围，以及透传任意 AutoCAD 原生命令。侧边栏面板托管驱动它的 Python 桥进程——启动、停止、重启、安装依赖、实时日志与崩溃自动重启——所有路径在运行时解析，同一个 bundle 在 Web 版与桌面版都能用。仅 Windows，Python 3.10-3.12，文档覆盖 AutoCAD 2022-2024（默认 2024；其他版本需把 CAD_PROG_ID 设为对应 ProgID）。

description.en: A local-first ledger for DSH. Record an expense or income from one sentence or a screenshot, with accounts, categories, refunds, installments, loans, debts and offline HTML charts. Data stays in local JSONL files.
description.zh: 说人话就能记的本地账本。一句话或一张截图记一笔收支，支持账户、类别、退款、分期、债权、债务和离线 HTML 图表；账本存在本地 JSONL 文件里。

description.en: Per-project runtime environments for DeepSeek Harness: auto-adopt or create a project-local Python venv (.venv_local/python) and wire in the toolchains and env vars for the runtimes each project uses (python venv / node / go) — python & pip always resolve to the project, never silently to system Python.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 工作区/项目提供独立的运行时环境：自动接管或创建项目本地 Python venv（.venv_local/python），并自动识别项目所用运行时（python venv / node / go）接入其工具链与环境变量——python / pip 永远走项目环境，绝不静默落到系统 Python。一个有则接管、无则自动建的零配置插件。

description.en: Windows desktop UI context picker for Codex, DeepSeek Harness, and MCP clients: select windows, UI elements, or screen regions with hover highlighting, UI Automation, screenshots, and local OCR, then review and approve Markdown/JSON context before output.
description.zh: 面向 Codex、DeepSeek Harness 和 MCP 客户端的 Windows 桌面 UI 上下文取景器：选择窗口、UI 元素或屏幕区域，使用悬停高亮、UI Automation、截图和本机 OCR，并在输出前确认 Markdown/JSON 上下文。

description.en: Mounts the hosted FIU Finance MCP service (Hong Kong, US, A-share, Japan, IPO and bond market data) through an MCP stdio bundle; needs your own FIU API key in FIU_API_KEY (apply at ai.szfiu.com) and Node.js with npx.
description.zh: 通过 MCP stdio Bundle 接入托管的 FIU Finance MCP 服务（港股、美股、A 股、日本、IPO 与债券行情数据）；需自备 FIU API Key（环境变量 FIU_API_KEY，到 ai.szfiu.com 申请）并安装 Node.js（npx）。

description.en: Read-only GitHub research tools for the agent - repository search, repo health check (stars, license, last push, size, archived), dependency manifests, and single-file reads over the raw channel - plus an oss-reuse skill that makes the agent search GitHub and check real dependencies before writing code, so features are assembled from existing open-source projects instead of rewritten; nothing is cloned and no disk space is used.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的只读 GitHub 调研工具——仓库检索、候选体检（star、许可证、最近推送、体积、是否归档）、依赖清单读取、经 raw 通道读单个文件——并附一个 oss-reuse 技能，让 agent 先检索 GitHub、核对真实依赖，再用现成开源项目拼装功能而不是从零重写；全程不克隆、不占磁盘。

description.en: NURBS BRep solid modeling studio with natural-language input, live 3D viewport (measure/wireframe/fit), STEP export, and agent tools driving NVIDIA usd-brep through a managed CPython venv. Needs CPython 3.12; usd-brep wheels cover 64-bit Windows and Linux only.
description.zh: NURBS BRep 实体建模工作台：自然语言输入、实时 3D 视口（测量/线框/适合）、STEP 导出，并通过托管 CPython venv 驱动 NVIDIA usd-brep 的 agent 工具。需要 CPython 3.12；usd-brep 仅有 64 位 Windows 与 Linux wheel。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible image generation in DSH Desktop chat: generate inline, edit reference images or chain-edit previous results directly (image-to-image) without re-uploading, with storage cleanup.
description.zh: 对话内联生图插件：模型在对话框直接出图，可基于参考图或上次生成结果连续图生图修改，附存储清理。

description.en: Adds generation_fork and generation_run to copy an agent preset and run a task on a new session.
description.zh: 提供 generation_fork 与 generation_run，用于拷贝 Agent preset 并在新会话上跑任务。

description.en: Shopping assistant for e-commerce: search, compare, pick and recommend products when buying things online, with price comparison, sales, service tags, product images and promotion links from the official Pinduoduo open-platform API, right inside the DSH conversation.
description.zh: 购物助手：在 DSH 对话里搜索、对比、挑选并推荐商品，支持比价与选购建议，覆盖电商购物场景，数据来自拼多多开放平台官方 API，含价格、销量、服务标签、商品图与推广链接。

description.en: Windows desktop observation and control: accessibility tree, screenshots, OCR fallback, mouse and keyboard, with session-scoped approvals and an ESC halt gate. Computer use and desktop automation for DSH, including GUI automation fallbacks.
description.zh: Windows 桌面观察与操作：无障碍树、截图、OCR 兜底、鼠标键盘，带会话级授权与 ESC 急停；适用于电脑操作、桌面自动化与 GUI 自动化场景。

description.en: A panel for editing DeepSeek Harness agent presets. It reads and writes the files inside a preset, switches its prompt injections, documents, skills and tool rows on and off, and installs or uninstalls the preset. Editing is line based, so YAML comments and layout survive. The same package also ships the injector and the doc_update write-back tool that a preset mounts.
description.zh: 编辑 DSH 预设的面板。它读写预设里的文件，开关预设的注入、文档、技能与工具行，并直接装卸预设；按行编辑，YAML 注释与排版都保留。同一个包还提供预设挂载用的投递器与 doc_update 写回工具。

description.en: Windows screenshot and annotation plugin with configurable global hotkeys, always-on-top pinned images, and capture delivery to the current DSH chat draft; requires a compatible Python runtime. Ships a prebuilt Windows executable (native/DualCtrlSnip.exe) and a Python helper that polls only the state of the selected hotkeys.
description.zh: Windows 截图与标注插件，支持自定义全局快捷键、置顶贴图和添加到当前 DSH 聊天附件草稿；需要兼容的 Python 运行环境。随包带有预编译的 Windows 可执行文件（native/DualCtrlSnip.exe）和一个只轮询所选快捷键状态的 Python 辅助程序。

description.en: Turns a Xiaohongshu, Douyin, TikTok, YouTube or X link into text: transcript with timecodes, on-screen text, a description and OCR of every image, caption and metadata. Mounts the hosted MCP server over streamable HTTP.
description.zh: 把小红书、抖音、TikTok、YouTube 或 X 链接转成文本：带时间戳的转写、屏幕文字、逐图描述与 OCR、正文与元数据。通过 streamable HTTP 挂载托管的 MCP 服务。

description.en: Real-compute verification gates: math simplification, logic proofs, regex validation, E-prover FOL, state-machine checks, and code repair, backed by Go-compiled binaries with prebuilt Windows executables.
description.zh: 真实计算验证门：数学化简、逻辑证明、正则校验、E-prover 一阶逻辑、状态机检查与代码修复，由 Go 编译的二进制支撑（附 Windows 预编译产物）。

description.en: Traditional Chinese Medicine toolkit: eight-axes diagnosis and herb-pair lookup.
description.zh: 中医工具集：八纲辨证与药对查询。

description.en: Gives a DSH agent a real adb shell on the phone itself over loopback, with no root and no PC. Needs DSH Go with android-tools-adb installed in its Ubuntu environment and a one-time Wireless debugging pairing; adb has to be switched to TCP port 5555, which then also accepts connections from the local network (still key-authenticated).
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体在手机内部通过回环拿到真实的 adb shell，无需 root，也不需要电脑。需要 DSH Go，并在其 Ubuntu 环境里装好 android-tools-adb，且先用「无线调试」配对一次；adb 需切到 TCP 5555 端口，该端口随后也接受局域网内的连接（仍需 adb 密钥认证）。

description.en: Desktop (native) control for dsh as a stdio JSON-RPC bridge over a Python core: capture the screen, inject pointer/keyboard input, drive accessibility-tree actions, and gate high-risk operations behind required confirmations.
description.zh: 桌面(native)控制:dsh 经 stdio JSON-RPC 桥接 Python 核心;支持截屏、指针/键盘注入、无障碍树语义操作,并以强制确认为高风险操作把关。

description.en: Local semantic code search for DeepSeek Harness: fragment-level symbol-aware indexing, offline lexical embeddings or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and hybrid vector + BM25 retrieval fused with RRF - three dsh tools plus a sema CLI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地语义代码搜索：片段级符号感知索引、离线词法 embedding（或 OpenAI 兼容端点）、向量+BM25 混合检索并以 RRF 融合——三个 dsh 工具外加 sema CLI。

description.en: Zhihu (知乎) dashboard: hot list with trend arrows, follow feed (favorites/creations/followees), post tracking (question/keyword/person) with auto-briefs, and five agent tools (zhihu_search/hot/answer/global_search/followees).
description.zh: 知乎面板：热榜（带趋势标记）、关注动态（收藏/创作/关注的人）、帖子追踪（问题/关键词/关注的人，支持自动创意简报），并提供 5 个对话工具（zhihu_search / hot / answer / global_search / followees）。

description.en: Pi-compatible tool suite recreated inside DeepSeek Harness: installs lower-case read/write/edit/bash/find/grep/ls core tools while retaining DSH-backed web, task, plan, todo, think, and slash extensions.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中复刻 Pi 工具组：安装小写 read/write/edit/bash/find/grep/ls 核心工具，并保留 DSH-backed 网页、任务、计划、todo、think 与 slash 扩展。

description.en: Bounded, privacy-safe local scanner for Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, and CodeBuddy metadata: atomically aggregates keyed evidence and deterministically advises built-in DSH presets and optional capabilities—without content retention, network access, or preset mutation.
description.zh: 有界、隐私安全的本地扫描器：汇总 Codex、Claude Code、WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy 元数据，原子保存密钥化聚合证据，并确定性推荐 DSH 内置 preset 与可选能力；不保留正文、不联网、不修改 preset。

description.en: File workbench library plugin for DSH, provide file processing capability.
description.zh: DSH 文件工作台库插件，提供文件处理相关能力。

description.en: Resolves a company name or ticker to a verified stock symbol via SEC EDGAR, then fetches a live quote with price, P/E, EPS, market cap, 52-week range, and dividend yield from yahoo-finance2.
description.zh: 通过 SEC EDGAR 将公司名称或股票代码解析为已验证的股票代号，再从 yahoo-finance2 获取实时行情，包括价格、市盈率、每股收益、市值、52周区间和股息率。

description.en: Automated daily content pipeline for Insta360 GO 3S: BLE/WiFi remote capture of aquarium footage, wireless import, ffmpeg quality evaluation with decision log, Auto editing (segment selection, TTS narration, music, subtitles), and Bilibili upload via biliup (dry-run by default).
description.zh: Insta360 GO 3S 自动每日内容管线：BLE/WiFi 遥控拍摄鱼缸素材、无线取回、ffmpeg 质量评估与决策记录、自动剪辑（选段/旁白/配乐/字幕）、biliup 投稿（默认 dry-run）。

description.en: Cooperative timeout guard for ask_user_question: lost or unanswered questions resolve as a structured ASK_TIMEOUT instead of hanging the turn forever.
description.zh: 为 ask_user_question 提供协作式超时守卫：提问卡片丢失或用户未答复时以结构化 ASK_TIMEOUT 结束调用，避免回合无限挂起。

description.en: Adds a calculate tool backed by a hand-written parser with no eval, batch evaluation and an exact-decimal mode for money math.
description.zh: 为 agent 提供 calculate 工具，内置零依赖表达式解析器（不用 eval），支持批量求值与金额精确小数模式。

description.en: Unreal Engine .uasset inspection (resolve/registry/load) and restricted Blueprint node editing through built-in UE Python.
description.zh: 通过 Unreal 内置 Python 提供 .uasset 检查与受限蓝图节点编辑。

description.en: Retrieval and planning toolkit for the BeiShan Besson Minecraft modding tutorials site: 7 tools to search 194 indexed tutorials, plan learning routes, compare version environments, and fetch article text.
description.zh: 北山 Besson Minecraft 模组开发教程检索与规划工具包：7 个工具检索 194 篇教程文章、规划学习路线、对比版本环境差异并抓取文章正文。

description.en: Encrypted, scheduled backup and restore of a DSH profile — plugins, settings, skills, UI preferences and optional MCP connector or API keys — to S3-compatible storage, WebDAV or a local folder.
description.zh: 把 DSH 配置档案（插件、设置、技能、界面偏好与可选的 MCP 连接器或 API Key）加密定时备份到 S3 兼容存储、WebDAV 或本地目录，恢复时自动重装缺失的插件。

description.en: Professional translation for DSH: 18 target languages, 4 styles (formal/casual/technical/literal), glossary-controlled terminology, and whole-file translation (README/docs/subtitles) with Markdown/code-block format preservation; powered by DeepSeek via SiliconFlow.
description.zh: 专业翻译：18 种目标语言、4 种风格（正式/口语/技术/直译）、术语表控制译名、整文件翻译（README/文档/字幕）并保留 Markdown 与代码块格式；经 SiliconFlow 调用 DeepSeek。

description.en: Answers hard questions by staging a formal debate: two adversarial subagents argue opposite sides with research, then the main agent rules on the transcript through the debate_open, debate_round, and debate_verdict tools.
description.zh: 通过一场正式辩论来回答难题：两个对抗性子代理各自调研并论证对立立场，最后由主代理依据辩论记录作出裁决，提供 debate_open、debate_round、debate_verdict 三个工具。

description.en: Economics-first journal/working-paper monitor for DeepSeek Harness: NBER RSS + arXiv econ (4 categories) + Chinese econ journals (Shi Jie Jing Ji via Magtech, Zhong Guo Nong Cun Guan Cha, Cai Mao Jing Ji, Zhong Guo Ren Kou Ke Xue, Jing Ji Guan Li via ajcass) fetch, keyword filter, dry-run/Webhook push, dedup persistence, and schedule_create-compatible briefing.
description.zh: 经济学优先的期刊/工作论文监控插件：NBER RSS + arXiv 经济学（4 类目）+ 中文经管期刊（世界经济-玛格泰克平台，中国农村观察/财贸经济/中国人口科学/经济管理-ajcass 平台）抓取、关键词过滤、dry-run/Webhook 推送、去重持久化、定时简报（schedule_create 兼容）。

description.en: macOS menu bar app for the DSH web server, plus the host plugin it reads: the plugin writes the running server's port, PID and tokenized URL to ~/.config/dsh-launcher/runtime.json and removes it on shutdown, so start, open, restart and stop work from the status bar even for a server started from a terminal.
description.zh: DSH Web 服务的 macOS 菜单栏应用，以及它所读取的 Host 插件：插件把运行中服务的端口、PID 与带 token 的 URL 写入 ~/.config/dsh-launcher/runtime.json，并在停止时删除，因此即使服务器是从终端启动的，也能在状态栏完成启动、打开、重启与停止。

description.en: Image generation through eight provider APIs (Labnana, OpenAI, Gemini, Seedream, DashScope, xAI, Zhipu, ComfyUI) with multiple saved profiles, a per-conversation gallery, and credit tracking on Labnana.
description.zh: 多 API 生图：Labnana、OpenAI、Gemini、Seedream、DashScope、xAI、智谱、ComfyUI 八种接口，支持多套配置、对话画廊与 Labnana 积分计量。

description.en: SSQ (China Welfare Lottery Double Color Ball) helper for DeepSeek Harness: 1000-draw trend tracking, six prediction models with ensemble voting, structure analysis and dan-tuo/random generation via the ssq tool.
description.zh: 双色球助手 DSH 插件：千期趋势追踪、6 种预测模型与集成投票、组合结构分析、胆拖/随机选号，对话中直接调用 ssq 工具。

description.en: The public-apis catalog wired into DeepSeek Harness: search 1716 free public APIs by keyword, category, auth, HTTPS or CORS and call any of them.
description.zh: 把 public-apis 目录接入 DeepSeek Harness：按关键词、分类、auth、https、cors 搜索 1716 个免费公共 API 并直接调用。

description.en: Runs a Douyin subagent that browses videos and reads comments in valley hours and reports back, with dy_* tools for publishing and replying (comments sent from the already-logged-in page with its own request signature, no IM ticket), a daily quota timer, and a settings panel under Settings → Douyin: master switch, auto mode, valley windows, rounds per day and report depth. Windows-oriented; needs the separate douyin-mcp binary (yunsur/douyin-mcp releases, path set via dy_config mcpExe) and an Edge/Chromium login; replying needs a logged-in browser on a CDP port; publishing needs extra credentials most accounts lack.
description.zh: 让子代理在谷时刷抖音、读评论并汇报；附带发作品/回评论的 dy_* 工具（评论从已登录页面带签名直发，不依赖 IM ticket）、每日配额定时，以及设置页「刷抖音」里的控制面板（总开关、自动模式、谷时窗口、每天轮数、报告详细度）。偏 Windows；搜索与评论依赖另装的 douyin-mcp 可执行文件（yunsur/douyin-mcp 的 Release，路径经 dy_config 的 mcpExe 设置）及 Edge/Chromium 登录；回评论需要开了 CDP 端口的已登录浏览器；发作品还需多数账号没有的额外凭据。

description.en: Registers the dsh-mol stdio MCP server, built on RDKit with no network access, into a DSH profile. It exposes 12 tools: three-level SMILES validation with human-readable diagnostics and character positions, molecular properties, drug-likeness and structural alerts, structure rendering to PNG/SVG, multi-molecule grids, format conversion (SMILES, InChI, InChIKey, MOL, SDF, formula), standardisation with a per-step change log, deduplication, SMARTS substructure matching, fingerprint similarity, and batch clean-up that reports every rejected row. The patch only registers the server; the tools live in this repository's Python package and must be installed first — the README gives a `pip install` route and a from-source route, and until the package is on PyPI the from-source one is what works.
description.zh: 把 dsh-mol 的 stdio MCP 服务（基于 RDKit，不联网）接进 DSH profile。它提供 12 个工具：三级 SMILES 校验（人话诊断 + 字符定位）、分子性质、类药性与结构警报、结构图渲染（PNG/SVG）、多分子拼图、格式互转（SMILES/InChI/InChIKey/MOL/SDF/分子式）、标准化（逐步记录改了什么）、去重、SMARTS 子结构匹配、指纹相似度，以及逐条报告失败行的批量清洗。本 patch 只负责注册服务；工具实现在本仓库的 Python 包中，需先安装——README 给了 pip 与源码两条路线，包上架 PyPI 之前，源码那条是可用的。

description.en: A chemistry workbench panel in the DSH web UI. Draw structures on a Ketcher canvas (a script downloads the build; it renders locally in the browser with no backend), then compute on the current molecule with RDKit without calling a model — formula, molecular weight, exact mass, logP, TPSA, hydrogen-bond donors and acceptors, ring counts, Fsp3, stereocentres, Lipinski and Veber rule-by-rule checks, QED, PAINS/BRENK structural alerts and the Murcko scaffold, plus SMARTS substructure matching, fingerprint similarity, format conversion, standardisation and batch clean-up. A retrosynthesis tab talks to a pluggable backend (Retro* by default) over a single JSON-in/JSON-out process, and states what is missing when the backend is not installed instead of inventing a route. The calculations run in this repository's Python package (rdkit), which is installed with pip separately.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的化学工作台面板。在 Ketcher 画板上画结构（构建由脚本下载，浏览器本地渲染、不经后端），然后对本机 RDKit 直接计算，不调用模型——分子式、分子量、精确质量、logP、TPSA、氢键供体与受体、环数、Fsp3、立体中心，Lipinski 与 Veber 逐条判定、QED、PAINS/BRENK 结构警报与 Murcko 骨架，另有 SMARTS 子结构匹配、指纹相似度、格式互转、标准化与批量清洗。逆合成页签通过「JSON 进 JSON 出」的单进程协议对接可插拔后端（默认 Retro*），后端没装好时如实说明缺什么，不编造路线。实际计算由本仓库的 Python 包（rdkit）完成，需另外 pip 安装。

description.en: Three literature-research skills packaged as one DSH plugin: academic-web-research (lightweight proxy fetch), academic-literature-research (Scholar/IEEE/CNKI/Wanfang/Sci-Hub pipeline), off-campus-literature (campus WebVPN/CARSI access). Installing drops the three SKILL.md folders into ~/.dsh/skills/, so the agent can invoke them by name after a restart. The bundled web-research skill assumes a local HTTP proxy at 127.0.0.1:7897; edit it if your setup differs.
description.zh: 三个文献调研技能打包成一个 DSH 插件：academic-web-research（轻量代理检索）、academic-literature-research（Scholar/IEEE/知网/万方/Sci-Hub 全流程）、off-campus-literature（校园 WebVPN/CARSI 校外访问）。安装即把三个 SKILL.md 落到 ~/.dsh/skills/，重启后 agent 可按名调用。内置的 academic-web-research 技能假定本机 127.0.0.1:7897 有 HTTP 代理，环境不同请自行修改。

description.en: Provides the bili_summary tool: Bilibili video metadata, subtitle timeline, and sharp-based frame capture with built-in error handling and graceful degradation.
description.zh: 提供 bili_summary 工具：B 站视频元数据、字幕时间轴与 sharp 切帧配图，内置错误处理与优雅降级。

description.en: Windows only. Bilibili video summarizer: downloads the audio track, transcribes it locally with faster-whisper (Python + faster-whisper, about 725 MB of models on first run), then writes the analysis markdown and renders a one-page infographic PNG.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。B 站视频一键总结：下载音轨并用 faster-whisper 本地转写（需 Python 与 faster-whisper，首次运行下载约 725 MB 模型），随后生成解析 md 与一页「一图读懂」PNG。

description.en: Allowlisted SSH into Unix/AIX/macOS from DeepSeek Harness (no shell; read-only by default), with remote_ssh_probe OS-aware suite.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 白名单 SSH 接入 Unix/AIX/macOS（不走 shell；默认只读），含 remote_ssh_probe 按系统探测套装。

description.en: Adds a net_doctor tool that reports proxy environment, NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY, and reachability of the DeepSeek API and the npm registry, and sets NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY on bash and npm child processes.
description.zh: 提供 net_doctor 工具，报告代理环境、NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY，以及 DeepSeek API 与 npm registry 的连通性，并为 bash 和 npm 子进程设置 NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY。

description.en: Read-only tmux list + capture-pane.
description.zh: 只读查看 tmux 会话与 pane 输出。

description.en: Writes a Windows shortcut and tray launcher to start dsh web in WSL, with Health/Restart and the :3081 launch-token URL.
description.zh: 生成 Windows 快捷方式与托盘启动器，在 WSL 中启动 dsh web，并提供 Health/Restart 与 :3081 launch token 地址。

description.en: Microsoft Web IQ search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, endpoint, language, region, passage length and SafeSearch.
description.zh: 基于 Microsoft Web IQ 的网页搜索提供方，接入内置 web_search 工具，并提供 API Key、端点、语言、地区、摘要长度与 SafeSearch 的设置卡片。

description.en: The built-in web_search bills a full model turn against DeepSeek's own endpoint; this runs it on an OpenRouter-compatible gateway instead, so search is billed where your chat already is, at the model and price you pick.
description.zh: 内置 web_search 每次搜索都要在 DeepSeek 自己的端点上消耗一整轮模型调用；本插件改为在 OpenRouter 兼容网关上执行搜索，与对话走同一个账户，模型和价格都由你决定。

description.en: Anti-bot HTTP fetch tools hardened by SXS's production scraping stack (millions of requests/day): UA-pool rotation, retry with exponential backoff, anti-bot wall detection (captcha / verification challenges) and adaptive rate limiting — tools: `sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`.
description.zh: 反爬 HTTP 工具：UA 池轮换、指数退避重试、反爬墙检测（验证码/安全验证）与自适应限流，提炼自 SXS 生产采集体系（每日数百万请求）——工具：`sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`。

description.en: CDP bridge to an already-running Chrome/Edge for DSH: screenshots, pixel assertions, DOM/CSS checks, and page JS evaluation over HTTP + WebSocket, with zero child processes, zero npm dependencies, and zero per-use approval.
description.zh: 通过 CDP 连接已运行的 Chrome/Edge：为 DSH 提供截图、像素断言、DOM/CSS 检查与页面 JS 执行，全程 HTTP + WebSocket、零子进程、零 npm 依赖、无需逐次授权。

description.en: Multi-engine reverse image search aggregator: Google Lens, Baidu, Yandex, TinEye, SauceNAO, IQDB, Ascii2d.
description.zh: 多引擎反向识图聚合：Google Lens、百度、Yandex、TinEye、SauceNAO、IQDB、Ascii2d。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek: send images (alone or mixed with text) and a fast tiny vision model describes them behind the scenes — the chat keeps the picture, DeepSeek sees only text. Pure plugin: uninstall restores everything.
description.zh: 视觉桥：纯文本 DeepSeek 也能收图（单独发、图文混发均可），快速小识图模型后台描述，对话框里图还在、模型只见文字；纯插件，卸载即复原。

description.en: Generate images through a logged-in web ChatGPT session and download them to a local directory.
description.zh: 控制已登录的网页版 ChatGPT 生成图片并下载到本地。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek routes that analyzes attached and local images through configurable OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions, or Anthropic Messages endpoints while leaving image-capable routes native.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 路由提供视觉桥接：通过可配置的 OpenAI Responses、Chat Completions 或 Anthropic Messages 端点分析附件与本地图片，同时保持支持图片的路由走原生路径。

description.en: Structured vision evidence (OCR/layout/semantics) plus a USB camera capture tool for a "shoot-look-adjust" debug loop; backends: Ollama, DeepSeek, Xiaomi.
description.zh: 结构化视觉证据（OCR/版面/语义）+ USB 摄像头拍摄工具，支持"拍-看-改"调试闭环；后端支持 Ollama、DeepSeek、小米。

description.en: Local art pipeline for DSH: drives the locally installed SD WebUI and ComfyUI backends through ten image_* tools and an Art Studio sidebar panel with an embedded ComfyUI canvas, post-processes with the Python shipped with those installs (rembg cutout, Real-ESRGAN upscale, seamless tiling), and writes Godot-ready assets with res:// paths once a project root is set.
description.zh: 本机美术流水线：把本机已装的 SD WebUI 与 ComfyUI 接进 DSH——10 个 image_* 工具 + 「美术工坊」侧边栏面板（内嵌 ComfyUI 画布），用整合包自带的 Python 做抠图 / 放大 / 无缝平铺后处理；填写 Godot 项目根目录后，产物直接落成带 res:// 路径的游戏资产。

description.en: DSH text-to-image/image-to-image plugin: compatible with OpenAI-style image generation APIs, with 多米API as the default; standard OpenAI endpoints may require protocol, image-to-image mode and size adjustments; text-to-image and URL reference images do not use COS, while local reference images can be compressed and stored in COS; custom prompt suffixes are supported.
description.zh: DSH文生图/图生图插件：兼容OpenAI风格生图接口，默认适配多米API；标准OpenAI需调整协议、图生图模式和尺寸；文生图和URL参考图无需COS，本地参考图可压缩后存COS；支持自定义提示词后缀。

description.en: Native vision capability extension, using either Zhipu (free) or Qwen-VL (local).
description.zh: 极简的原生视觉能力增强，支持免费的智谱模型或本地千问视觉模型。

description.en: Chat image-attachment bridge with a `view_image` tool for any OpenAI-compatible VLM (local Ollama or cloud): pasted/dropped images become `view_image` path markers before reaching text-only DeepSeek models.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的聊天识图插件：view_image 工具转发任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM（本地 Ollama 或云端），对话框粘贴/拖拽的图片自动改写为 view_image 路径标记供模型查看。

description.en: Sidebar radio that plays Bilibili audio with search, playlists, scrolling lyrics (looked up on music.163.com, kugeci.com and lrclib.net), and chat-driven song picks. Runs a local audio proxy on 127.0.0.1:13210 and, when the system resolver fails, DNS lookups in the whole DSH host process fall back to public DoH servers (1.12.12.12, 223.5.5.5).
description.zh: 左侧栏 B 站电台：播放音频、搜索、歌单、滚动歌词（从 music.163.com、kugeci.com、lrclib.net 检索），以及对话点歌。内置 127.0.0.1:13210 本地音频代理；系统解析失败时，整个 DSH 宿主进程的 DNS 查询会回退到公共 DoH（1.12.12.12、223.5.5.5）。

description.en: China-ready voice input for the composer. Requires a local Python bridge (pip install dashscope websockets, run bridge/voice-bridge.py) — the plugin alone does not work. Browser mic streams 16 kHz PCM to the bridge, which runs Alibaba Cloud DashScope ASR (paraformer-realtime-v2); interim text fills the draft at the cursor, silence auto-stop, optional auto-send.
description.zh: 国内可用的输入框语音输入。需要先启动本地 Python bridge（pip install dashscope websockets，运行 bridge/voice-bridge.py）——只装插件不可用。浏览器麦克风采集 16kHz PCM 流式转发给 bridge，由阿里云 DashScope ASR（paraformer-realtime-v2）识别；识别文字在光标处实时填入草稿，静音自动停止，可选识别后自动发送。

description.en: Connects the Xiaozhi voice assistant to DSH Web over MCP: DSH is the tool provider, weaving 35 DSH Web endpoints into 16 voice-friendly tools for workspaces, sessions, chat, models, settings and files — outbound WebSocket to the Xiaozhi MCP access point by default (no public IP or port forwarding needed), several devices bound at once, plus a DSH settings page with live status.
description.zh: 把小智语音助手接入 DSH Web：DSH 作为 MCP 工具提供方，把 35 个 DSH Web 接口封装成 16 个语音友好工具，覆盖工作区、会话、对话、模型、设置与文件；默认出站 WebSocket 连到小智 MCP 接入点（无需公网 IP 和端口转发），可同时绑定多台设备，并自带实时刷新状态的 DSH 设置页。

description.en: Per-reply read-aloud with a multi-provider settings page — MiniMax or any OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech endpoint, with voice, emotion, speed and model selection plus an auto-read toggle.
description.zh: 每条回复旁的朗读按钮与输入框自动朗读开关，设置页可选服务商与音色：MiniMax 或任意 OpenAI 兼容的 /audio/speech 端点，可调音色、情绪、语速与模型。

description.en: Subtitle-first video transcription with SRT export, cancellable job controls, and a faster-whisper large-v3 fallback when subtitles are unavailable.
description.zh: 字幕优先的视频转录，支持 SRT 导出与可取消任务控制；字幕不可用时回退到 faster-whisper `large-v3`。

description.en: Renders .ttl, .owl, .rdf, .jsonld, .nt, .n3, .nq and .trig ontology files as an interactive graph in the DSH sidebar preview, with local Turtle, N-Triples, RDF/XML and JSON-LD parsing and no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏预览中把 .ttl、.owl、.rdf、.jsonld、.nt、.n3 等本体/RDF 文件渲染为可交互图谱，本地解析 Turtle、N-Triples、RDF/XML 与 JSON-LD，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Turn DeepSeek Harness sessions into daily, weekly, handoff and article reports, with a verifiable HTML export and a receipt that re-checks the saved file.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话整理成日报、周报、交接与文章稿件，支持可核验的 HTML 导出与复核收据。

description.en: Design-first PowerPoint builder: six pptx_* tools turn a deck.json design draft into an editable .pptx with AI backgrounds, cutout illustrations and decoration pieces, run layout and contrast checks, render slide previews, and review pages with a configurable vision model; chat cards and a settings page in the Web UI. Requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2+ (pptx_render uses its bundled LibreOffice Kit) and an Agnes or ModelScope API key for image generation.
description.zh: 设计型 PPT 生成：六个 pptx_* 工具把逐页设计稿（deck.json）组装成可编辑 .pptx，配合 AI 背景、去底插画与装饰件，做版式与对比度检查、渲染页面预览，并可用可配置的视觉模型逐页评审；Web 端提供聊天卡片与设置页。需 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2+（pptx_render 使用其内置 LibreOffice Kit），AI 背景需 Agnes 或 ModelScope API Key。

description.en: Draw Mermaid diagrams in DSH conversations through the pele_draw tool, rendered inline as theme-aware SVG cards with zoom and pan plus SVG and PNG downloads.
description.zh: 通过 pele_draw 工具在 DSH 会话中绘制 Mermaid 图表，以内联 SVG 卡片渲染，支持缩放/拖动与 SVG/PNG 下载，跟随明暗主题。

description.en: Tools over the local jetformat CLI: convert DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX to PDF, extract text, validate files, and inspect, merge, extract pages from, or render PDFs. Requires the jetformat CLI.
description.zh: 基于本地 jetformat CLI 的工具：将 DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 转为 PDF，提取文本，校验文件，以及查看、合并、抽页或渲染 PDF。需要安装 jetformat CLI。

description.en: HTML deliverable workbench in the file preview: viewport presets (desktop, laptop, tablet, mobile, A4), click-to-annotate elements with a notes/QA panel that docks to any edge or floats and sends the notes to the agent as one message, delivery QA grouped by category (figure/table numbering, orphans, clipping, overflow, page whitespace, WCAG contrast, images, dead anchors, banned words), PDF export through a local Chromium-based browser, and export of a self-contained annotated HTML that reviewers open in a browser to reply; also provides the `deliver_qa` and `deliver_export_pdf` tools and a `/deliver` command.
description.zh: 文件预览里的 HTML 交付物工作台：桌面、笔记本、平板、手机、A4 视口预设；点选元素就地批注，批注与 QA 收在可停靠任一边或浮动的面板里，批注可整理成一条消息发给 Agent；交付 QA 按类别分组（图表编号与引用、孤字、截断、溢出、页面留白、WCAG 对比度、图片、页内死链、禁用字样）；用本机 Chromium 内核浏览器导出 PDF；可导出自包含的带批注 HTML，审阅者在浏览器里打开即可回答；另提供 `deliver_qa`、`deliver_export_pdf` 工具与 `/deliver` 命令。

description.en: Dockable Markdown preview for the DSH Web UI: side-by-side with the conversation, a per-session recently-read .md list, local relative-path images render in place, and clicking an in-chat .md reference previews it instead of launching the system editor; follows the shell light/dark theme.
description.zh: DSH Web 端可停靠的 Markdown 预览面板：与对话并排展示，会话级「最近打开 .md」列表，本地相对路径图片可直接渲染；点击对话中的 .md 引用改为并排预览而非唤起系统编辑器；跟随 shell 深浅色主题。

description.en: Edit xlsx/xls/csv/tsv/docx/pptx files in the DSH sidebar on Windows DSH Desktop through a locally installed ONLYOFFICE Document Server; saved edits are written back to the original file on disk.
description.zh: 在 Windows 版 DSH Desktop 的侧边栏用本机安装的 ONLYOFFICE Document Server 编辑 xlsx/xls/csv/tsv/docx/pptx，保存直接写回磁盘上的原文件。

description.en: Open and edit Visio (.vsdx) drawings in a DSH panel: live SVG preview, shape and connector editing, layout checks, and a visio tool so the agent can read and modify the drawing. The core engine is Python standard library and needs no Visio or Office; requires Python 3.9+ on PATH, and Pillow for PNG export, snapshots and stencil previews.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里打开和编辑 Visio（.vsdx）图纸：实时 SVG 预览、图形与连接线编辑、布局检查，另有一个让 Agent 直接读写图纸的 visio 工具。核心引擎为 Python 标准库，无需装 Visio 或 Office；需要 PATH 里有 Python 3.9+，PNG 导出、快照与模具预览另需 Pillow。

description.en: Breaks a STEM textbook into a four-level card map (book, chapter, section, knowledge point) in a sidebar panel, where each point names the defect of the previous approach it fixes and each chapter keeps its remaining gap as the motive for the next; marks key points with a star, shows theorems as cards with statement, conditions and symbol table, folds step-by-step derivations, and exports the same map as a self-contained offline HTML file, Word or PDF. Ships a textbook-parser skill and a textbook_archive tool (save_book / save_chapter / list_books / get_book / delete_book) plus a bundled 12-chapter Signals and Systems sample with 116 sections, 263 points and 601 worked examples. No runtime dependencies and no network access.
description.zh: 把理工科教材拆成「全书、章、节、知识点」四层卡片知识地图（侧边栏面板）：每个知识点写明它修复了前方案的什么缺陷，每章用「仍存短板」作为下一章的动机；重点知识点标 ★，定理以卡片呈现（结论／适用条件／符号说明），推导过程可折叠，并可将同一张地图导出为离线自包含 HTML、Word 或 PDF。内置 textbook-parser 技能与 textbook_archive 工具（save_book／save_chapter／list_books／get_book／delete_book），附带《信号与系统》12 章示例（116 节、263 个知识点、601 道例题）。零运行时依赖、不联网。

description.en: An add-only Markdown library for DeepSeek Harness with a workspace file picker, a fixed icon grid with pointer-first hysteresis drag targeting, marquee selection and bulk folder moves, drag-to-folder and dissolve/delete folder actions, persistent move and line highlights, full-screen tabs, immersive reading, GFM tables, bookmarks, and local Mermaid/chart rendering.
description.zh: 只收主动加入的 Markdown 文档，支持工作区挑选、带指针滞回的固定网格拖拽、右键框选与批量移入文件夹、文件夹解散/删除、移动与行高亮持久标记、全屏标签页与沉浸式阅读、GFM 表格、书签，以及 Mermaid/代码块图表本地渲染。

description.en: Paper-reading workspace for DeepSeek Harness — page-by-page bilingual PDF translation, select-to-translate, paper-aware chat with page citations, notes, diagrams and cloud sync.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的论文阅读工作台：中英整页对照翻译、划词即译、带页码引用的伴读对话，以及笔记、框架图与云同步。

description.en: Prepares a repository README before pushing: scans repo facts, renders banner and process-diagram images (needs Pillow and the Microsoft YaHei font), lints layout and section numbering, then commits and pushes with retry.
description.zh: 上传 GitHub 前优化仓库 README：扫描仓库事实、渲染首图与过程图（需 Pillow 与微软雅黑字体）、校验排版和编号，最后带重试提交推送。

description.en: Provides a skill for the LinShang LS125 UV irradiance meter and its UVALED-X3 probe: the reverse-engineered 9600 8N1 link (28-byte frames, CRC-16/MODBUS, poll and clear commands), a capture and decode toolchain, and a verified STM32F103 host firmware that reads the probe without the original meter. All code and documentation written by an AI agent (DeepSeek Harness).
description.zh: 为林上 LS125 紫外辐照计与 UVALED-X3 探头提供技能：逆向出的 9600 8N1 链路（28 字节帧、CRC-16/MODBUS、轮询与清零命令）、抓取解码工具链，以及已验证的 STM32F103 主机固件，可在脱离原装表的情况下读取探头。全部代码与文档均由 AI agent（DeepSeek Harness）编写。

description.en: Invoke user-accessible Skills with @name tokens and show matching Skill suggestions in the conversation composer.
description.zh: 通过 @名称 标记调用用户可用的 Skill，并在对话输入框中显示匹配的 Skill 候选项。

description.en: Turns an English paper PDF into a Chinese group-meeting .pptx whose figures and tables are the paper's own cropped pixels.
description.zh: 把英文论文 PDF 做成中文组会汇报 PPT，图表用原文真实像素。

description.en: Registers the eight official GSAP AI skills in DeepSeek Harness; the skill bodies ship inside the plugin, so it works after installing and restarting with no configuration, account or API key.
description.zh: 把 GSAP 官方的 8 个 AI 技能注册进 DeepSeek Harness；技能正文随包分发，装完重启即可使用，无需配置、账号或密钥。

description.en: One page for every skill on your machine: lists what DSH, WorkBuddy, Claude Code, Codex and Doubao have installed, imports any of them as a DSH skill, and discovers more on GitHub or the ClawHub directory (sorted by real downloads). Experts can be attached per session with a per-turn avatar header.
description.zh: 把机器上散落的技能收进一页：列出 DSH、WorkBuddy、Claude Code、Codex、豆包的已装技能，可一键导入为 DSH 技能；发现页支持 GitHub 与 ClawHub 目录（按真实下载量排序）。专家可按会话挂载，回复上方显示署名。

description.en: Manage skills, MCP servers, instruction files, custom commands and hooks. Hooks run commands with your own account outside DSH's sandbox and approval; the plugin asks you to confirm when you add one.
description.zh: 管理 Skill、MCP 服务器、指令文件、自定义命令和 Hooks。Hook 会以你自己的账户在 DSH 沙箱和审批之外运行命令；添加时插件会要求你确认。

description.en: Spec-driven development discipline for dsh: five keel skills (anchor/spec/probe/build/audit), three review tools and six spec templates enforce specs-before-code, assumption verification and scope control.
description.zh: 规格驱动开发纪律技能包（keel）：五个技能（锚定/立规/探针/建造/审计）、三个审查工具与六个规格模板，强制先规格后代码、假设先行验证并约束范围蔓延。

description.en: Life-story skill: capture moments and fragments, build a user profile and generate novels, scripts or autobiographies.
description.zh: 闪念记录与人生拼图技能：捕捉生活点滴，构建画像并生成小说、剧本或自传。

description.en: Smart form skill: structured record-keeping for bills, ledgers and logs with auto-categorization and periodic reports.
description.zh: 智能表单技能：支出账单、台账与日志的结构化记录，自动归类并生成周期报表。

description.en: Per-project skill roots for DeepSeek Harness, with multi-level category discovery.
description.zh: 按项目分配技能根目录，支持多级分类发现。

description.en: Plugin-author upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness: one package carrying a corridor index, which detects the caller peer band and routes to the closed corridor card that matches it (0.1.3-alpha.1 -> 0.1.5-rc.1 as legs A+B, 0.1.5-rc.2 -> 0.1.6-alpha.2 as leg C), plus a zero-dependency seam scanner shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 插件作者的升级技能：一个包只放一份走廊索引，自动识别调用方的 peer 区间并路由到对应已封版的升级卡片（0.1.3-alpha.1 至 0.1.5-rc.1 为 A+B 两条腿，0.1.5-rc.2 至 0.1.6-alpha.2 为 C 腿），并附带以 bundle 技能与 npx CLI 两种形态提供的零依赖接缝扫描器。

description.en: Adds file-backed Chinese web-fiction planning, chapter writing, consistency review, rollback, and style-profile skills.
description.zh: 为现有 Agent 添加基于文件记忆的中文网文策划、逐章写作、一致性审校、回滚与文风画像技能。

description.en: Reusable skill to browse, search and download Wallpaper Engine (Steam 431960) workshop wallpapers and wire them into the DSH skin center, including bypassing the Steam HTTP block and the region-mismatch sign-in block via a matching SOCKS proxy.
description.zh: 可复用技能：批量浏览、搜索、下载 Wallpaper Engine（小红车，Steam 431960）创意工坊壁纸并接入 DSH 皮肤中心；含绕过 Steam HTTP 封锁与异地登录拦截（经出口 IP 与账号一致的 SOCKS 代理）。

description.en: DSH plugin that registers the ai-eight-honors-eight-shames skill: eight checkable working rules for coding agents (verify before calling, confirm ambiguity, cite evidence, reuse before creating, test before claiming done, follow local conventions, separate fact from inference, keep changes reversible) plus a ninth rule that logs each user request and the change made in report files at the workspace root.
description.zh: 注册 ai-eight-honors-eight-shames skill 的 DSH 插件：面向编码代理的八条可核对工作准则（先查证再调用、有歧义先确认、业务规则给出处、先复用再新造、先测试再声称完成、按既有约定写、区分事实与推断、改动可回滚），外加第 9 条——用户每次提出需求或问题，都在工作区根的报告文件里成对记录诉求与改动。

description.en: Import, install and invoke Agent Skills in DeepSeek Harness from Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, GitHub or npm — composer-side ⚡ picker inserts /skill-name into the draft, and a Skill 管理 settings page offers per-source/per-skill import, expandable source paths with skill counts, uninstall and one-click restore from .trash.
description.zh: 从 Codex / Claude Code / OpenCode / GitHub / npm 导入并安装技能到 ~/.dsh/skills，模型自动读取、/技能名 立即可用；对话框旁 ⚡ 一键插入调用，设置页支持按来源/单技能导入、路径与数量展示、卸载与一键恢复。

description.en: Reads the session event stream, with no extra model calls, and turns corrections, failures and fixes into pending lesson candidates. Every candidate is judged against written criteria and carries the reason it passed or was refused; only confirmation writes a skill, and only through the single validated writer `learn_skill_manage`. An idle curator marks unused skills stale and archives them by moving rather than deleting, and spares any skill that is still being loaded. Five tools: `learn`, `learn_review`, `learn_curator`, `learn_skill_manage`, `learn_skills`. Registers a prompt section stating the criteria, and a tool guard that refuses direct edits to skill files so the writer cannot be bypassed.
description.zh: 读取会话自身的事件流（不额外发起模型调用），把纠正、失败与修法变成待确认的候选教训。每条候选按写死的标准逐项判定，并给出通过或被拒的理由；只有确认之后才写成技能，而且只能经过唯一的写入口 `learn_skill_manage`。闲置时由 curator 把长期不用的技能标为陈旧并归档（是移动，不是删除），仍在被加载的技能会被豁免。五个工具：`learn`、`learn_review`、`learn_curator`、`learn_skill_manage`、`learn_skills`。另外注册一段写明判定标准的提示词段落，并挂一个工具守卫，拒绝直接编辑技能文件，使写入口无法被绕过。

description.en: Agent preset: one session runs a three-phase auto-development pipeline — interactive design with parallel research subagents, goal-driven development with reviewer/developer subagents and per-package budget ledgers, then an acceptance fix loop.
description.zh: Agent 预设：单会话跑三阶段自动开发流水线——并行研究员子代理交互设计、goal 驱动审核/开发子代理开发（按包预算台账硬上限）、验收修复循环。

description.en: Verification gate for DSH agents: every acceptance criterion must be backed by server-stamped real tool evidence before the completion gate lets a goal through (advisory audit, enforce gate, durable permits).
description.zh: DSH agent 完成验证闸门：每条验收标准必须有服务端标记的真实工具证据才能完成（advisory 审计 / enforce 拦截 / 持久 permit）。

description.en: Turns each DSH workspace into a project: every new session auto-injects a project-workspace convention (read code before acting, empty folder means a brand-new project); a per-session Project toggle in the composer downgrades the session to a plain workspace with an explicit notice, with the state kept in the session log.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区文件夹变成项目：新会话自动注入精简的「项目工作区约定」上下文（先读代码、空目录即新建项目）；输入框旁每会话「项目」开关可将会话显式降级为普通工作区（状态渲染式注入，关时有提示，不整块消失），状态存于会话日志。
