description.en: Canvas task board ported from CodexFF: hierarchical parent/child tasks with boundaries, snap-aligned draggable panels in a conversation view tab, plus `board_*` / `task_*` agent tools and a sync skill.
description.zh: 移植自 CodexFF 的画布任务看板：父子层级任务树与任务边界，会话「任务看板」tab 内磁吸对齐的可拖拽面板，配套 `board_*` / `task_*` 模型工具与同步技能。

description.en: Runs a thesis-antithesis-seal debate whose verdict is computed from real command exit codes and case counts, never from agent prose.
description.zh: 运行「正题—反题—封印」三方辩论，其结论由真实命令的退出码与用例数计算得出，绝不采信智能体的文字陈述。

description.en: Council of High Intelligence: assemble an 18-member think tank of historical figures for multi-perspective structured debate, with a live DAG side panel, SQLite run history, and per-project defaults via .council.yaml.
description.zh: 高智议会：召集 18 位历史人物组成智囊团对复杂问题进行多视角结构化辩论，附带实时 DAG 右侧面板、SQLite 历史记录持久化，支持通过 .council.yaml 配置项目级默认面板与主席。

description.en: Whole-report verification for scientific reports: per-claim checks against Crossref, PubMed (retraction scan), ClinicalTrials.gov, UniProtKB, GEO/SRA and PatentsView, URL accessibility and title agreement, claim-vs-source meaning at temperature 0, and a durable restartable audit ledger with an annotated report.
description.zh: 面向科研报告的整篇校验工作流：逐条核对 Crossref、PubMed（含撤稿扫描）、ClinicalTrials.gov、UniProtKB、GEO/SRA 和 PatentsView，核验 URL 可访问性与标题一致性，以温度 0 判定声明与原文含义一致，输出可恢复的审计账本与标注版校验报告。

description.en: Native roundtable panel with a product manager, engineer and critical user, two discussion rounds, follow-up questions, votes, answer retries and summaries.
description.zh: 在原生面板中让产品经理、程序员和挑刺用户进行两轮讨论，支持追问、投票、重答和结论整理。

description.en: Reminds the agent to speak up when it runs several model steps without emitting any text, so long tool runs stop going silent.
description.zh: 别憋着：连着几步模型输出里一个 text 都没有（心里的盘算不算说话），就往会话里塞一句提醒，下一个 step 落进它眼里。

description.en: Explicit cross-session work state for DeepSeek Harness: goals, decisions and next steps captured automatically from host events or via a model-visible work_state tool, inspectable with /checkpoint.
description.zh: 跨会话工作状态显式持久化：目标、决策与下一步从宿主事件自动捕获，或由模型经 work_state 工具主动记录，/checkpoint 随时可查。

description.en: Extends dsh-subagent-tools with a per-call cwd for subagents, shipped with the two in-process provider patches it requires.
description.zh: 在 dsh-subagent-tools 基础上增加子代理按调用 cwd，附带所需的两个 in-process provider 补丁。

description.en: Per-call model, provider, persona, and toolFilter overrides for subagent delegation, with @preset: references and provider/model composite ids.
description.zh: 子代理委派的按调用覆盖：model/provider/persona/toolFilter、@preset: 引用与 provider/model 组合 id。

description.en: Desktop-pet lab assistant for DSH that keeps experiment records, accumulates per-software notes, and generates Word/Markdown lab reports from real step-by-step evidence. The desktop pet and lab panel require the Windows desktop build of DSH; other profiles get the conversational tools only.
description.zh: 面向高校实验课程的 DSH 桌宠式插件：保存实验档案、按软件累积经验、用真实步骤证据生成 Word/Markdown 实验报告，并提供黄色高框指引与「点一下自动判对错」的教学循环。桌宠与实验助手面板仅在 Windows 桌面端出现，其他环境只有对话工具可用。

description.en: Sync DSH user-level assets (skills, plugin manifest, config, memory) across machines with one-click restore, automatic plugin reinstall and secret scanning.
description.zh: DSH 用户级配置同步：技能、插件清单、配置与记忆跨机同步，换机一键恢复、缺插件自动装回、敏感文件硬拒绝。

description.en: More agent presets for DSH, derived from other coding agents such as Qwen Code and iFlow.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供更多智能体预设，衍生自其他编程智能体（例如 Qwen Code、iFlow）。

description.en: Long-task orchestration loop: Codex plans/scores/reviews, DeepSeek executes, Kimi supplements (vision acceptance, summarization, cross-check).
description.zh: 长任务编排闭环：Codex 规划/打分/审核，DeepSeek 执行，Kimi 补充（视觉验收/摘要/交叉验证）。

description.en: Settings-based scheduled tasks that run on time or during DeepSeek off-peak hours, with one-time and daily schedules backed by durable task state.
description.zh: 设置页定时任务：支持准点或 DeepSeek 谷时段执行、单次/每日重复，并持久化任务状态。

description.en: Scheduled DeepSeek Harness Agent tasks with mandatory end-to-end tests, run history, and bidirectional delivery through nine messaging channels.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Agent 定时任务：创建前强制完成端到端测试，提供运行历史，并通过九种通讯渠道双向收发消息。

description.en: Surveys local code and GitHub/npm for reusable implementations before development, evaluates reuse versus rewrite, and checks architecture coupling.
description.zh: 在开发前检索本地代码与 GitHub/npm 的可复用实现，评估复用与重写成本，并检查架构耦合。

description.en: Convert Office documents and PDFs (including scanned ones) to structurally formatted Markdown via a CPU-first routing OCR pipeline (RapidOCR/SLANet/FormulaNet).
description.zh: 将 Office 文档与 PDF（含扫描件）转换为保留结构的 Markdown，采用 CPU 优先的路由 OCR 流水线（RapidOCR/SLANet/FormulaNet）。

description.en: Four-quadrant todo manager in the DSH sidebar with month and week calendar views, per-period completion statistics, system notifications and Feishu notifications (the latter needs the DSH Feishu integration), and recurrence rules including Chinese statutory workdays and the Ebbinghaus curve. Derived from Natte/dsh-sidebar-todo 0.2.3 and largely rewritten; do not install both — they register the same /todo/api route and use the same todos.json data file.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的四象限待办管理器，带月/周日历视图、周期完成率统计、系统通知与飞书通知（飞书需已装 DSH 飞书集成），以及中国法定工作日和艾宾浩斯记忆曲线等重复规则。基于 Natte/dsh-sidebar-todo 0.2.3 大幅改写；不要与上游同装——两者注册同一个 /todo/api 路由并共用同一份 todos.json。

description.en: Right-sidebar page for DSH that draws the current session's repository as a VS Code-style commit graph - colored branch/merge lanes, ref chips and per-commit details - with a working-tree Changes area above it (staged/unstaged sections with inline diffs) for every working tree of the repository; read-only, works with or without dsh-better-sidebar, and follows the session's worktree label when dsh-session-worktree is installed.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏页：把当前会话的仓库画成 VS Code 风格的分支/合并提交图谱（彩色泳道、ref 徽章、提交详情），上方带工作区 Changes 区（staged/unstaged 分节、行内 diff），覆盖仓库的每个工作树；只读，装不装 dsh-better-sidebar 都能用，装了 dsh-session-worktree 时跟随会话的 worktree 标签。

description.en: Native interactive Git diff review for DeepSeek Harness with structured annotations sent back to the current Agent session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生交互式 Git diff 审查，支持结构化批注并回传当前 Agent 会话。

description.en: One-step GitHub uploader: initializes git, auto-creates or improves README, sets repository topics, and pushes a local project to GitHub.
description.zh: 一键上传项目到 GitHub：自动初始化 git、生成或完善 README、设置仓库 topics，并推送本地项目。

description.en: Per-task isolated git worktrees with a full create/sync/finish lifecycle: task names auto-derive branches, merge targets are double-checked, and batch cleanup is built in — zero manual git operations.
description.zh: 按任务隔离的 git worktree 工作区，覆盖创建/同步/收尾全生命周期：任务名自动派生分支、合并目标双重校验、内置批量清理——全程零手工 git 操作。

description.en: A Git Graph tab for DSH Web: a faithful port of vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 that registers a native tab in the dsh-better-sidebar right rail (prerequisite), auto-binds to the session workspace, runs the full git operations (checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash) directly on the host, and opens file diffs in the built-in DiffTab.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 忠实移植：入驻 dsh-better-sidebar 右侧栏的原生 Git Graph 提交图 tab（前置依赖），自动绑定会话工作区，host 直跑全套 git 操作（checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash），文件 diff 复用内置 DiffTab 打开。

description.en: Git hygiene checker: read-only scan of merged and stale branches, oversized tracked files, untracked files and uncommitted work, with cleanup suggestions (it never deletes anything).
description.zh: Git 卫生巡检：只读扫描已合并/过期分支、大文件、未跟踪文件与未提交修改，输出体检报告与清理建议，不自动删除任何东西。

description.en: QQ official bot (q.qq.com) integration for DeepSeek Harness: chat with the full agent from private chats, groups and channels — WS long connection (heartbeat / reconnect / RESUME), per-chat session isolation, standard agent preset, approval inline buttons with /revoke, slash commands, whitelist fail-closed, credentials via the credentials domain.
description.zh: 接入 QQ 官方机器人（q.qq.com）：私聊 / 群聊 / 频道 @ 与完整 agent 对话——WS 长连接（心跳 / 重连 / RESUME）、每会话隔离、标准 agent preset、审批内联按钮 + /revoke、斜杠命令、白名单 fail-closed、凭据走凭据域。

description.en: Multi-channel notifications for DeepSeek Harness: registers a send_notification tool and a settings page fanning out to NotifyX, WeCom app webhook, WeCom group robot, email (Resend), SMTP, DingTalk, Feishu robot; plus browser notifications and automatic notification on task completion and blocking events.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多渠道通知插件：注册 send_notification 工具与设置页，向 NotifyX、企业微信应用通知、企业微信机器人、邮件（Resend/SMTP）、钉钉机器人、飞书机器人发送通知；支持浏览器通知、运行结束/阻塞/目标完成事件自动推送。

description.en: Sounds and notifications when a task completes or waits for your approval or answer; notification sounds are configurable in the settings page (synth styles or your own audio file), with built-in cat hachimi sounds, just for fun. An optional Windows patch adds a taskbar digit, flashing and native toasts.
description.zh: 任务完成或等待批准、回答时播放提示音并发送通知；提示音可在设置页更换（合成音色或自选音频文件），内置猫咪 hachimi 音效，just for fun。可选的 Windows 补丁额外提供任务栏数字角标、闪烁与原生通知。

description.en: WeCom smart bot over the official long connection (Bot ID + Secret, no public callback): persona, sender identity tags, three-layer memory with a forgetting curve, reminders, opt-in proactive chat, owner-only work mode guarded by tools.guard, auto-steer, image input and a wecomSoulBot host service; group chats answer when @-mentioned.
description.zh: 企业微信智能机器人官方长连接接入（Bot ID + Secret，无需公网回调）：人设、发送者身份标记、带遗忘曲线的三层记忆、提醒、可选主动搭话、由 tools.guard 拦截的仅主人工作模式、运行中自动插话、图片输入和 wecomSoulBot 宿主服务；群聊 @ 时回复。

description.en: Automatically retrieves time-of-use pricing data (with Beijing Time) and notifies users during peak periods to reduce costs.
description.zh: 自动获取分时电价数据（按北京时间），在高峰时段提醒用户，以降低用电成本。

description.en: Top-right status plate for six session states (complete, error, approval, question, unopenable, subagent), plus an OS notification when you are away.
description.zh: 右上角状态提示板，覆盖六种会话状态（完成、出错、待授权、待回答、会话打不开、子 agent 在跑），不在看 DSH 时发系统通知。

description.en: Shows a system notification when a turn finishes, carrying the session title and a summary of the reply.
description.zh: 每轮对话正常结束时弹出系统通知，标题是会话名，正文是本轮回答的摘要。

description.en: Bottom-right DSH-styled Windows cards for approvals, questions, plan reviews and finished runs: click to jump back to the app that started the session (DSH by default), close with the × button, or let it close when you return.
description.zh: 工具请求审批、模型提问、计划待审阅或运行结束时，在右下角弹出 DSH 风格置顶卡片；点一下切回发起该会话的应用（默认 DSH），点 × 关闭，或切回时自动关闭。

description.en: Real-time disaster alerts for DeepSeek Harness: Japan earthquakes (P2PQuake) and JMA EEW, tsunami and weather telegrams, global earthquakes (EMSC/USGS) and NOAA tsunamis, mainland China earthquakes (CENC via Wolfx) plus nmc.cn rainstorm and geological-hazard warnings, and US/Canadian NWS and ECCC flood, rainfall and storm-surge warnings — matched against your watch regions and thresholds.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的实时灾害预警：日本地震（P2PQuake）与 JMA 紧急地震速报、海啸、气象电文，全球地震（EMSC/USGS）与 NOAA 海啸，中国大陆地震（CENC via Wolfx）及 nmc.cn 暴雨、地质灾害预警，美国 NWS 与加拿大 ECCC 的洪水、降雨、风暴潮预警——按你关注的地域与阈值匹配播报。

description.en: Discord-native remote controller for DeepSeek Harness: drive persisted coding-agent sessions from DMs, mention-gated guild channels, and threads, with slash commands, progress updates, approvals, structured questions, and image and text attachments.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Discord 原生远程控制器：通过私信、需提及机器人的服务器频道及 Thread 操作持久化的编程 Agent Session，并支持斜杠命令、进度更新、工具审批、结构化问题、图片和文本附件。

description.en: Plays a short chime when a conversation turn finishes, with three built-in tones or one custom upload, configured in Settings → Plugins.
description.zh: 会话回合结束时播放短提示音，内置三种音色或一条自定义上传，在设置 → 插件中配置。

description.en: Turns the MacBook keyboard Caps Lock light into an agent status light: on while the agent works, flashing when it waits for your approval or answer, off when idle.
description.zh: 把 MacBook 键盘的 Caps Lock 指示灯变成 agent 状态灯：干活时常亮，等你审批或回答时快闪，空闲时熄灭。

description.en: Pre-flight plugin-library index for DSH agents: injects per-step trigger-table hints into the runtime context so suitable installed plugins get used predictably instead of opportunistically.
description.zh: DSH agent 的插件库起飞检查：向运行时上下文注入按步骤触发的提示，让合适的已装插件从「碰巧想起」变成「可预期使用」。

description.en: Self-update for the harness launcher; checks npm for a newer @deepseek-ai/dsh, stages the tarball, and applies it on harness exit or via update-and-restart from the web panel.
description.zh: Harness 启动器自更新插件；检查 npm 上的 @deepseek-ai/dsh 新版本，暂存 tarball，并在退出或通过面板「更新并重启」时应用。

description.en: Capability transform & assembly engine (Qian Xuesen cybernetics/systems framework): static resident layer manages the skill/MCP/plugin registries, auto-absorbs skills and tool metrics, and drives a negative-feedback evolution loop (scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select promote/reject → 30s rollback); includes a Web UI panel and a GitHub dsh-plugin store bridge.
description.zh: 能力转化与组装引擎（钱学森工程控制论/系统论框架）：静态常驻层管理 skill/MCP/插件三库、自动吸收技能与工具度量，驱动负反馈进化闭环（scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select 晋升/淘汰 → 30s 回滚）；含 Web UI 面板与 GitHub dsh-plugin 商店桥。

description.en: Three-position toggle (off / this turn / always-on) for an "unlimited mode" that injects a "do not conserve tokens" instruction into the system prompt; the "this turn" mode reverts automatically on the kernel agent/status idle event.
description.zh: 三档切换的「无限大白饭模式」（关 / 本轮 / 常开），控制要不要给系统提示注入「别省 token」的指令；「本轮」靠内核 agent/status 的 idle 事件自动回落。

description.en: Plugin development toolkit for DeepSeek Harness with scaffolding, contract checks, plugin vetting, impact analysis, and upstream compatibility tracking.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件开发工具集，提供骨架生成、契约检查、插件体检、影响面分析与上游兼容性追踪。

description.en: Unifies every DSH extensibility seam behind one declarative DSL: a runtime `fabric` service, `fabric_extend`/`fabric_inspect` tools, and a capability-graph settings page.
description.zh: 用一套声明式 DSL 统一 DSH 的所有可扩展接缝：提供 `fabric` 运行时服务、`fabric_extend`/`fabric_inspect` 工具，以及能力图谱设置页。

description.en: Plugin compiler with a blueprint registry (scaffold → validate → deploy) exposed as a runtime service, three model tools, and a blueprint-gallery settings page.
description.zh: 插件编译器：以运行时服务提供蓝图注册表（脚手架 → 校验 → 部署），配三个模型工具和一个蓝图画廊设置页。

description.en: Read-only incremental AI code review with declared task dependencies, eligible result reuse, and selective reruns after input changes.
description.zh: 只读增量 AI 代码审查，声明任务依赖、复用符合条件的结果，并在输入变化后重跑受影响的任务。

description.en: Aborts a DSH reasoning stream that starts repeating itself instead of letting the turn stall: five rules over the streamed reasoning text (periodic unit, repeated block, repeated line above a share floor, 64-gram density, and a long trailing run of punctuation or whitespace), plus a JSONL fire journal, a Web GUI log panel, and opt-in recovery that retries with a corrective message.
description.zh: 在推理流开始自我重复时提前中断本轮，避免长时间卡死：对推理文本做五条判据（周期单元、重复块、带占比下限的重复行、64-gram 密度、末尾超长标点或空白段），并附带 JSONL 触发日志、Web GUI 日志面板，以及可选的重试恢复（带纠正消息）。

description.en: Evidence-first guard: warns the agent when it claims success without a matching tool-execution record in recent context.
description.zh: 证据铁律守卫：模型声称成功但上下文中没有对应工具执行记录时，自动注入警告。

description.en: Code review center for DSH, built on open-code-review: reviews current changes, commits, branch ranges, project architecture, code modules and business data flows, with live progress, a GitHub-style commit heatmap, fixed markers, automatic fix verification, light/dark themes and one-click fix sessions. Requires git and the open-code-review CLI 1.13 or later (npm i -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review); reviewed code is sent to the LLM configured for that CLI, or to the session model when the review is delegated to it, and reopening a report after a fix session re-runs the review to verify the fixes.
description.zh: DSH 代码评审中心：基于 open-code-review，支持当前改动、提交、分支对比、项目架构、代码模块与信息流业务工作流评审，提供实时进度、GitHub 风格提交热力图、已修复标识、自动修复校验、深浅色主题与一键修复会话。需要 git 和 open-code-review 命令行（1.13 及以上，npm i -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review）；被评审的代码会发给该命令行所配置的模型，委托给会话时则发给当前会话模型；开过修复会话的报告再次打开时会重跑一次评审来校验修复。

description.en: Reuses hooks declared in Claude Code, Codex and opencode configs on dsh, executing shell, webhook, oracle and proxy handlers with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code、Codex、opencode 配置里声明的 hooks 原样复用到 dsh，执行 shell、webhook、oracle、proxy 四类 handler，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Compares coding agents in isolated Git worktrees with deterministic validation, scoring, and explicit winner application.
description.zh: 在隔离的 Git 工作树中比较编码智能体，并提供确定性验证、评分和显式胜者应用。

description.en: Source-aware prompt injection guard for DSH: tracks untrusted turn context, detects injection signals, scores sensitive sinks, and blocks high-risk tool calls with explainable audit logs.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的来源感知提示词注入防护：跟踪 Turn 中的不可信上下文，检测注入信号，评估敏感 Sink，并通过可解释审计日志阻断高风险工具调用。

description.en: Weekly digest generator: aggregates git commits, DSH session activity and daily memory entries into a Markdown weekly report, read-only.
description.zh: 周报生成器：聚合最近 N 天的 git 提交、会话活动与每日记忆，自动生成 Markdown 周报，全程只读。

description.en: Floating power dock for the DSH web GUI: one-click restart or graceful shutdown of the dsh host, loopback-guarded and dependency-free.
description.zh: DSH Web 悬浮电源坞:一键重启或优雅关机,仅限环回访问,零依赖。

description.en: One-click health check for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar button runs the ops kit's check-health.ps1 through a plain HTTP route (independent of the tool registry) and renders a structured report card; colors follow the active theme, Windows/PowerShell.
description.zh: 一键健康检查：侧边栏按钮经纯 HTTP 路由（独立于工具注册表）调用 check-health.ps1 并渲染结构化报告卡片；配色跟随当前主题，Windows/PowerShell。

description.en: Multi-cluster Kubernetes management panel powered by local kubectl, with resource filtering, YAML editing, live Pod logs, interactive container terminals, workload restart/scaling, and DSH theme synchronization; accessible from the sidebar or session view. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 基于本地 kubectl 的 Kubernetes 多集群管理面板：资源筛选、YAML 编辑、Pod 实时日志、交互式容器终端、工作负载重启与扩缩容，并同步 DSH 主题；支持侧栏入口和会话视图。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Read-only work report rebuilt from local session logs: tools used and how often, commands run, files read and written, whether tests passed, failures and their causes, token usage, and whether the task finished.
description.zh: 从本机会话日志只读还原的工作报告：用了哪些工具、各调用多少次、执行了哪些命令、读写哪些文件、测试有没有通过、失败了几次及原因、消耗多少 Token，以及最后完成了没有。

description.en: Windows system-tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness Web: start, stop, restart, open the Web UI, tail logs, live status icon, and a launch-at-login toggle.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Windows 托盘启动器：托盘图标一键启动、停止、重启服务，打开 Web UI、查看日志，实时状态图标，并支持开机自启开关。

description.en: Shared toolkit for authoring DeepSeek Harness plugins, published as @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit: a pluggable provider registry seam, fail-closed approval and session-event gates, shared sanitize/pricing/judge modules and a new-plugin skeleton.
description.zh: 编写 DeepSeek Harness 插件的共享工具包，发布为 @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit：可插拔的 Provider 注册表接缝、失败即拒绝的审批与会话事件门、共享的脱敏/计价/裁决模块，以及新插件骨架。

description.en: Prunes the tool schema to a whitelist and injects a structural preamble on a session's first turn only, then passes every later turn through untouched.
description.zh: 只在会话首轮把工具清单裁剪到白名单并注入一段结构化前言，之后每一轮原样放行。

description.en: Adds a Quick Restart entry to the DSH Desktop account menu that quits and relaunches the app in one click. Windows desktop app only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端账号菜单中新增“快速重启”入口，一键退出并重新打开 DSH。仅 Windows 桌面端。

description.en: Adds a { } button under each assistant reply in the DSH Web GUI that opens the exact request sent to the model for that reply: model, call parameters, messages, tools, and provider-reported token usage.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 每条 assistant 回复下方加一个 { } 按钮，点开可查看产生这条回复的那次调用实际发给模型的完整请求：model、调用参数、messages、tools 与 provider 上报的 token 用量。

description.en: An IDE inside DeepSeek Harness with a file tree, multi-tab editor, AI assistant with model picker and API-key setup, Git panel, PTY terminal, and Python/TypeScript LSP.
description.zh: 内置在 DeepSeek Harness 里的 IDE：文件树、多标签编辑器、AI 助手（模型选择/API Key）、Git 面板、PTY 终端和 Python/TypeScript LSP。

description.en: OpenAI Codex CLI wrapper: one-shot exec, repo review and session resume with a default read-only sandbox.
description.zh: OpenAI Codex CLI 封装：一次性任务、仓库审查与会话续接，默认只读沙箱。

description.en: Kubernetes ops for the agent: get resources with structured JSON output, describe, logs, exec, apply/delete (user-confirmed) and port-forward.
description.zh: Kubernetes 运维：JSON 结构化查资源、describe、日志、exec、apply/delete（需确认）与端口转发。

description.en: Runs reproducible DSH profile and patch experiments with guided case authoring, assertions, Web comparison reports, recovery, and policy gates.
description.zh: 运行可复现的 DSH Profile 与 Patch 实验，并提供引导式用例构建、断言、Web 对比报告、恢复和策略门禁。

description.en: Java efficient development plugin for DeepSeek Harness providing deterministic auto-fix for .java files, token-saving template intents, and cross-platform JDK/Gradle/Android SDK/FFmpeg/LWJGL/IDEA discovery with persistent caching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Java 高效开发插件，提供 .java 文件的决定性自动修复、节省 token 的模板意图、以及跨平台的 JDK/Gradle/Android SDK/FFmpeg/LWJGL/IDEA 自动发现与持久化缓存。

description.en: Hard-stop consecutive identical tool calls after a configurable streak so the agent cannot spin in place.
description.zh: 在可配置次数后硬拦截连续相同的工具调用，避免 Agent 原地空转。

description.en: Filesystem permissions for shell calls, granted per path and capability rather than per command name. The command line is parsed for the read, write, create, delete and execute effects it needs, a capability it lacks raises the approval card instead of a flat refusal, and the same rules are compiled into the macOS Seatbelt profile the process, its children and the code its arguments never showed all run under. An Approvals tab in the conversation reads the audit log back and shows which rule, automatic reviewer or person answered each call.
description.zh: 按路径与能力（read / write / create / delete / execute）授予 shell 调用的文件权限，而不是按命令名判断。命令行的文件效果由解析得出，缺哪个能力就出审批卡片而不是一律拒绝，同一套规则还会编译成进程、它的子进程、以及命令行根本没露出来的代码共同运行其下的 macOS Seatbelt profile。会话里的「审批」标签页把审计日志读回来，显示每次判定是规则、自动复核还是人拍的板。

description.en: Vets local, npm, and GitHub plugin source before installation, blocks configured high-risk tool calls at runtime, audits output secret patterns, and writes HMAC-chained local audit logs.
description.zh: 在安装前体检本地、npm 与 GitHub 插件源码，运行时拦截命中配置阈值的高风险工具调用，审计输出中的密钥模式，并写入 HMAC 链式本地审计日志。

description.en: AI-driven source-code security scanning workbench: 5 model tools (start/finding/status/report/list) plus a /hawkeye web UI and JSON/Markdown/HTML vulnerability reports; zero-dependency Cordis plugin, installable as agent preset or npm package.
description.zh: AI 驱动的源代码安全扫描工作台：5 个模型工具（start/finding/status/report/list）、/hawkeye Web UI 和 JSON/Markdown/HTML 漏洞报告；零依赖 Cordis 插件，可作 agent preset 或 npm 包安装。

description.en: Adds an Explain button to the approval card: one model call returns exactly three lines reading the pending operation, covering what it does, which files or system state it reads, writes, modifies or executes, and a risky/attention/safe verdict with a one-sentence justification. It also renders the detail area for `write` and `edit` calls, which the shipped renderer leaves blank because it only reads a `command` field.
description.zh: 在审批卡片上加一个「解释」按钮：一次模型调用返回固定三行解读——做什么、读写改了什么、是否安全（风险等级加一句理由）。同时补上 `write`/`edit` 类调用详情区留白的问题——官方渲染器只读 `command` 字段，那两类调用没有该字段。

description.en: Microsoft cross-platform sandbox support.
description.zh: 微软跨平台沙盒支持。

description.en: Support for the nono sandbox backend.
description.zh: nono 沙盒支持。

description.en: Global prompt-injection / context-virus defense for DeepSeek Harness: scans tool arguments, tool results, pre-model messages and the outbound stream; quarantine/block/monitor modes, canary trap, and an evolvable on-disk signature library with learn/import/export.
description.zh: 全局提示注入 / 上下文病毒防御：扫描工具参数、工具结果、进模型前消息与出站流；隔离/阻断/监控三模式、金丝雀陷阱、可演进磁盘签名库（学习/导入/导出）。

description.en: Live CVE/supply-chain audit for your workspace's own project dependencies (npm/pip/go), backed by OSV.dev, with a `cve_audit` tool plus optional automatic re-scan on lockfile changes.
description.zh: 面向你自己项目依赖（npm/pip/go）的实时 CVE/供应链审计，基于 OSV.dev，提供 `cve_audit` 工具，并支持在 lockfile 变化时自动重新扫描。

description.en: Static-only plugin gate and clinic for DSH: audit before install, hash-and-capability lock after install, local fingerprint peer search over GitHub topic:dsh-plugin, and mechanical detox. Never executes the target plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件的静态安全闸门与诊所：安装前静态审计、安装后哈希与能力锁定、本机指纹库与 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题的同类搜索、机械式剥离清理；永不执行目标插件。

description.en: Cross-Workspace Memory: local-first, encrypted, per-session authorized memory for DSH.
description.zh: 跨工作区安全记忆：本地优先、加密的 DSH 跨工作区记忆插件，具备逐会话授权与提示词注入隔离功能。

description.en: Reviews side-effecting tool calls against the project rules and the current goal before they run, and denies anything out of scope with a fail-closed verdict and no bypass switch.
description.zh: 在写文件、跑非只读命令、联网、派子代理等有副作用的动作执行前，按项目规则与当前目标复核，超出范围即拒绝（失败即拒，无可配置豁免开关）。

description.en: Fourth permission preset for dsh: unconfined, GPU-capable sessions (danger-full-access) with per-operation user approval for writes outside the workspace or to protected paths (.git/**, .env*); implemented purely as a bundle over the official tools/pre-execute ask hook, no core edits.
description.zh: dsh 第四个权限预设：进程全权限（GPU 可用），同时工作区外与受保护文件（.git/**、.env*）的写入逐次向用户审批；纯插件实现，零核心改动。

description.en: SSH workspaces for Windows DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2: discover OpenSSH hosts, add or browse remote project directories, and route file, search and Bash operations by workspace while the DSH runtime stays local. A Desktop compatibility fork of Yan-Zero/dsh-remote-ssh that preserves local permission defaults.
description.zh: 为 Windows DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2 提供 SSH 工作区：发现 OpenSSH 主机、添加或浏览远端项目目录，按工作区路由文件、搜索与 Bash 操作，DSH 运行时仍在本地。基于 Yan-Zero/dsh-remote-ssh 的 Desktop 兼容分支，保留本地默认权限。

description.en: Control a DeepSeek Harness session from an Android phone: pair over Wi-Fi or Tailscale, follow the live transcript, send prompts, switch model, mode and permission, browse workspace files, run a terminal and change settings.
description.zh: 用安卓手机操控电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness：经 Wi-Fi 或 Tailscale 配对，实时跟随对话、发送指令、切换模型／模式／权限，浏览工作区文件、运行终端、修改设置。

description.en: Use SSH hosts and WSL distributions as remote DSH workspaces, with environment setup, model configuration porting, and the remote interface embedded locally.
description.zh: 将 SSH 主机与 WSL 发行版接入远程 DSH 工作区，支持环境安装、模型配置移植与本地内嵌远程界面。

description.en: On-demand proxy for DeepSeek Harness that leaves the system proxy, WinHTTP and TUN alone: its own Clash-style engine parses vmess, vless, ss, trojan, socks5 and http subscriptions and runs a rule engine (DOMAIN, DOMAIN-SUFFIX, DOMAIN-KEYWORD, IP-CIDR, IP-CIDR6, GEOIP with DIRECT/PROXY/REJECT) so only the requests that are slow when dialled directly take the proxy on the web, search, scripts and browser channels, with per-node latency and bandwidth tests, spoofing options and a loopback panel behind a per-instance token.
description.zh: 不接管系统代理、WinHTTP 与 TUN 的按需代理：自带 Clash 风格引擎解析 vmess、vless、ss、trojan、socks5、http 订阅，规则引擎支持 DOMAIN、DOMAIN-SUFFIX、DOMAIN-KEYWORD、IP-CIDR、IP-CIDR6、GEOIP 与 DIRECT/PROXY/REJECT，只有直连偏慢时才让网页抓取、搜索、脚本与浏览器四条通道的请求走代理，并提供节点延迟与带宽测速、伪装选项和带每实例令牌的本地 Web 面板。

description.en: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: compact typography, full-width composer with caret fix, drawer sidebar with overlay-close, two-page settings flow, responsive tables and stats, safe touch targets.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：紧凑排版、全宽输入卡（含光标修复）、抽屉式侧边栏（点击遮罩关闭）、两页式设置流程、响应式表格与统计、安全触控目标。

description.en: Fork of @linxin666/dsh-ssh (the two cannot be enabled at the same time): resolves an SSH host by its NIC MAC address before dialing, so DHCP address changes stop breaking saved hosts.
description.zh: 基于 @linxin666/dsh-ssh 的二次开发（两者不能同时启用）：建链前先按网卡 MAC 把主机解析成当前 IP，DHCP 换号不用改配置。

description.en: Use your phone as a DSH peripheral remote: send messages (typed or dictated with the phone keyboard), answer yes/no and choice prompts, browse messages and switch sessions on a Game Boy-style screen, paired over LAN QR or a built-in Cloudflare tunnel.
description.zh: 把手机变成 DSH 的外设遥控台：发送消息（打字或用手机输入法语音转文字）、应答 yes/no 审批与选择题、浏览消息与切换会话，Game Boy 风格屏幕；局域网扫码或内置 Cloudflare 隧道连接。

description.en: Browse, install, inspect, update, and remove MCP server connections inside DeepSeek Harness, with an online catalog and native Streamable HTTP/stdio support.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、安装、检查、更新和卸载 MCP 服务器连接，支持在线目录、Streamable HTTP 与 stdio。

description.en: Quality-aware in-agent plugin discovery: a find_dsh_plugins tool that ranks the whole dsh-plugin topic through a daily quality-scored index (installable manifest, curated listing, license, activity) merged with a live gh search — zero LLM API cost, risk flags and exact install commands in every result.
description.zh: 质量感知的会话内插件发现：find_dsh_plugins 工具基于每日更新的质量评分索引（可安装声明 / 精选收录 / 许可证 / 活跃度）对 dsh-plugin topic 全量排序，并叠加实时 gh 搜索——零 LLM API 成本，每条结果附风险徽章与精确安装命令。

description.en: Plugin center: discover, install, and manage DSH plugins from Settings.
description.zh: 插件中心：在设置页发现、安装与管理 DSH 插件。

description.en: Update manager for installed plugins: check for updates, back up, and roll back.
description.zh: 已装插件更新管理：检查更新、备份与回滚。

description.en: In-app DSH plugin marketplace panel with curated and full catalogs, keyword and semantic search, Chinese translation, favorites, installed-state tracking, and install/update/uninstall via the official CLI.
description.zh: DSH 内置插件市场面板：精选与全量目录、关键词与语义搜索、中文翻译、收藏、已安装状态，以及通过官方命令安装、更新和卸载。

description.en: Conversational DSH plugin finder: four-source unified index, BM25 pre-filter plus LLM semantic ranking, candidates carry evidence grades and local static security audit, safe install flow with post-install verification.
description.zh: 对话式查找 DSH 插件的增强版 skill：四源聚合统一索引，BM25 粗筛 + LLM 语义精排，候选表带证据分级与本地静态安全审计，安装走安全确认流程并自动验证。

description.en: Task-aware DSH plugin navigator: builds a local index from GitHub topics and community lists, retrieves across 28 bilingual capability classes, and provides commit-level static risk audit, consent-gated pinned installation, composition checks, and recovery.
description.zh: 任务感知的 DSH 插件导航：聚合 GitHub topic 与社区清单建立本地索引，按 28 类中英能力检索；提供 commit 级静态风险审计、用户确认后的锁定版本安装、组合验证与恢复流程。

description.en: Turns a stated need into a plugin choice: an agent skill that queries a catalog of the whole `dsh-plugin` topic (2600+ repos, recrawled every 6 hours, Chinese descriptions from Workers AI) through a ranked search API, then hands back the matching `dsh plugin add` command.
description.zh: 把「我想让 DSH 做什么」直接变成选好的插件：技能查询覆盖整个 `dsh-plugin` topic 的目录（2600+ 仓库，每 6 小时重抓，简介由 Workers AI 译成中文）的相关度检索接口，再给出对应的 `dsh plugin add` 命令。

description.en: Purple-white desktop pet that docks to the screen edge and shows real-time CPU, RAM, GPU and NVMe temperatures with hardware info.
description.zh: 紫白桌宠悬浮球，贴边停靠实时显示 CPU/内存/GPU/NVMe 温度与硬件信息。

description.en: A desk pet that floats over the DSH interface and opens into a daily check-in, focus timer and habit journal.
description.zh: 浮动在 DSH 界面上的桌宠，点开是打卡、专注计时与生活手帐。

description.en: Desktop pet with a chat panel: QQ-style history, favorites, and branch threads that merge back into the log as a forward card; the panel docks beside the pet and resizes from its edges and corners. Modified from PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT); do not install together with the original.
description.zh: 带聊天面板的桌宠：QQ 风格的历史记录、收藏，以及聊完会以合并转发卡片回到历史的支线对话；面板停靠在小女仆右侧，可从边缘与四角拖拽改大小。基于 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT）的二次修改版，请勿与原版同时安装。

description.en: Achievement and gamification plugin: unlock badges for turns, tool calls, sessions, daily streaks and coding behavior (edits/reads/tests), with a badge wall, unlock toasts and a ctx.achievements SDK.
description.zh: 成就与游戏化插件：按回合、工具调用、会话、连续天数与编码行为（编辑/读取/测试）解锁徽章，带徽章墙、解锁 toast 与 ctx.achievements SDK。

description.en: Sends excerpts from recent Chinese Markdown conversation exports to the DeepSeek API (API key required) to generate a dream, saved as a local Markdown file.
description.zh: 将近期中文 Markdown 对话导出文件中的片段发送给 DeepSeek API（需 API key），生成一场梦境并保存为本地 Markdown 文件。

description.en: DSH pet plugin that adds an Arknights operator library and custom image pets: pick one of 486 operators and the plugin downloads that operator Codex v2 atlas from the pinned upstream revision, verifies every Git blob hash and installs it locally, or import your own Codex atlas (1536x1872 or 1536x2288) or a plain PNG/WebP/GIF; the pet then follows session activity, shows a bubble while a decision is pending, and can be dragged and resized.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠插件：内置 486 位明日方舟干员素材目录，选定干员后从固定上游版本下载 Codex v2 图集并逐个校验 Git 哈希再本地安装；也可导入自己的 Codex 图集（1536×1872 或 1536×2288）或普通 PNG/WebP/GIF 图片；桌宠随会话状态切换动作，等待确认时显示气泡，可拖动并调整尺寸。

description.en: AI-native music player plugin for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and KuGou search with cross-provider playback fallback, renders word-by-word karaoke lyrics synced live over USB HID to HALO PIXELBAR speakers, and exposes search, playback, queue, alarm and speaker control as model tools.
description.zh: 运行于 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 原生音乐播放器（music player）：聚合网易云（NetEase）、QQ Music 与酷狗（KuGou）搜索并支持跨源播放回退，逐字卡拉OK歌词（karaoke lyrics）经 USB HID 实时同步至花再音箱（HALO PIXELBAR），搜索、播放、队列、闹钟与音箱控制均可由对话操控。

description.en: Auto chess: human vs AI, or AI vs AI.
description.zh: 自走棋：人机对战或双 AI 对弈。

description.en: Five casual mini-games (sliding-number puzzle, Sudoku, snake, Schulte grid, number memory) that pop up when a turn starts, with auto-saved progress across sessions.
description.zh: 任务开始时自动弹出的 5 个休闲小游戏（数字华容道、数独、贪吃蛇、舒尔特方格、数字记忆），支持跨会话自动保存进度。

description.en: Desktop companion pet in its own always-on-top window: imports Codex pet folders from ~/.codex/pets as-is, with affinity ranks, session-linked activity bubbles, snap-to-edge dragging, a right-click-reachable smart click-through mode and a daily token meter that mirrors the dsh-usage ledger when installed.
description.zh: 独立置顶窗口的桌面宠物：直接导入 ~/.codex/pets 的 Codex 宠物，含亲密度段位、会话活动气泡、贴边吸附拖拽、右键可达的智能鼠标穿透；已装 dsh-usage 时自动对齐其当日 token 台账。

description.en: Five animated K-ON! character pets for the DSH web interface, with dragging, voice playback, and a tea table.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加《轻音少女》五位角色桌宠，支持拖拽、语音播放和茶桌互动。

description.en: Brings Harness conversations and tasks into a Live2D character on the Windows desktop, with drawer-based memory. The desktop app includes the whale girl 哦鲸鲸 as its default character. The modular design supports optional voice components for voice conversations and custom character voices.
description.zh: 把 Harness 的对话和任务交互集成到 Windows 桌面上的 Live2D 角色中，采用抽屉式记忆设计。桌面程序默认搭载大肥鱼「哦鲸鲸」。角色功能采用模块化设计，语音组件按需安装，支持语音交流和自定义角色音色。

description.en: Pokemon-style catch-em-all: your real work is the tall grass — turns, tool calls and errors spawn wild encounters; throw balls, fill a 28-slot dex, walk a team of six. Zero tokens, invisible to the model.
description.zh: 宝可梦式捕捉收集：真实工作就是草丛 —— 回合、工具调用、报错刷出野外遭遇；投球捕捉、集 28 格图鉴、带 6 只队伍。零 token，模型完全看不见。

description.en: Opens a browser console to prepare Minecraft Java on Windows x64 and run DeepSeek-controlled survival through native-player MCP tools, with spatial observations and an optional livestream overlay from a separate extension. Requires an installed Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.x client and an official DeepSeek API key with at least ¥1 balance.
description.zh: 在 Windows x64 上打开浏览器控制台准备 Minecraft Java 环境，通过原生玩家 MCP 工具让 DeepSeek 自主生存，提供空间观察与（需另装扩展的）可选直播挂件。需已安装 Minecraft Java 1.21 系列正式版，并准备余额不少于 ¥1 的官方 DeepSeek API 密钥。

description.en: Local TXT reader in a right-sidebar tab plus a spoiler-safe AI reading companion: the model only sees what you have already read — the current chapter, the tail of the previous chapter, and a per-book background file it grows as you go. Excerpts, thoughts and the companion replies become structured Markdown notes exportable to Obsidian; raw text unlocks only for a book you mark as finished.
description.zh: 右侧栏本地 TXT 阅读器 + 不剧透的 AI 陪读：模型只能看到你已经读到的部分（本章全文、上一章结尾，以及随进度增量补齐的背景认识）；摘抄、感想与 AI 回应写成结构化 Markdown 笔记，可导出到 Obsidian。只有你标记「已读完」的那一本才向它放开原文。

description.en: A desktop pet in the DSH web GUI: floating, draggable sprite pet that animates with agent activity (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval), with a settings page for size, switching, gallery search and one-click pet install. Ships 4 bundled Hunter x Hunter starter pets.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的桌面宠物：右下角悬浮、可拖拽，随智能体活动切换精灵动画；设置页可管理大小、启停切换、图库搜索与一键安装宠物。内置 4 个全职猎人主角宠物包。

description.en: A restart button at the sidebar foot, just above the account entry, for the DSH desktop app on Windows: two clicks stop the app and bring it back, with no console window.
description.zh: DSH Windows 桌面端侧栏底部的重启按钮，就在账号入口上方：点两次即结束应用进程并自动重启，全程不弹命令窗口。

description.en: Restarts the DeepSeek Harness desktop app from three places: a Settings row, the account menu above Sign out, and a configurable keyboard shortcut. Asks before interrupting running tasks. If a newer update is already downloaded and waiting, restarting installs it first. Windows desktop app only.
description.zh: 从三处重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端：设置里的按钮、账号菜单「退出登录」上方的一项、以及可自定义的快捷键；有运行中的任务时会先确认；若新版本更新已下载并等待安装，重启时会先静默安装更新。仅支持 Windows 桌面版。

description.en: Translates the interfaces of installed DSH plugins into Chinese with an offline dictionary and a DOM translation layer, toggleable in settings.
description.zh: 用离线词典和 DOM 翻译层把已安装 DSH 插件的英文界面换成中文，可在设置里随时开关。

description.en: Clamps the session history page request to 120 messages and replaces request/header tool schemas larger than 200k characters with an empty array before React renders them, so long sessions open without freezing the transcript.
description.zh: 把打开会话时的历史取数收到 120 条消息，并在进入 React 之前把超过 20 万字符的工具 schema 换成空数组，让长会话打开时不再卡死界面。

description.en: Sidebar panel for a weekly, human-curated Chinese ranking of the DSH ecosystem: 31 tracked projects (17 installable plugins plus tools/skills) ranked by live GitHub stars with week-over-week deltas, and a real-call availability survey of the "free" models. Sponsor slots are labelled and sit outside the ranking.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板：每周更新的中文 DSH 生态榜单——收录 31 个项目（其中 17 个是可安装插件，其余为周边工具/Skill），按实时星数排行并给出较上期涨星；另有「免费」模型的真实调用可用性实测。赞助位明确标注，且不参与排序。

description.en: An embedded Douyin window docked in the DSH sidebar: a real Electron webview guest, so douyin.com's X-Frame-Options: DENY no longer applies.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏底部的内嵌抖音窗口：用 Electron webview 租约绕过 douyin.com 的 X-Frame-Options: DENY。仅桌面版。

description.en: Keyboard shortcuts for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+Q toggles the left sidebar, Ctrl+E toggles the right panel, and Ctrl+S opens Settings. Physical key codes can be overridden in the profile patch.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供快捷键：Ctrl+Q 切换左侧栏，Ctrl+E 切换右侧栏，Ctrl+S 打开设置。物理键码可在 profile 补丁中覆盖。

description.en: Folds the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's global panel list into a single row, with a popover to switch panels.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的全局面板列表收进一行，点击弹出浮层切换面板。

description.en: Right-to-left reading mode for the conversation answer area, with a button to switch back to left-to-right.
description.zh: 为对话回答区域提供从右到左的阅读模式，并提供按钮一键切回从左到右。

description.en: Enhanced desktop shell for DSH: auto-starts the local backend on launch (no browser tab), asks before closing the backend on quit, and starts the backend in parallel with Electron for faster cold start. Fork of dsh-clean-desktop-shell.
description.zh: DSH 桌面壳增强版：启动即自动拉起后端（不弹浏览器）、退出时询问是否关闭后端、后端与窗口并行启动加速冷启动。基于 dsh-clean-desktop-shell 的 fork。

description.en: Shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently billing at the off-peak or peak rate in the sidebar brand row, with the Chinese statutory-holiday calendar built in and zh/en copy.
description.zh: 在侧边栏品牌位显示 DeepSeek API 当前按空闲还是高峰时段计费，内置中国法定节假日与调休日历，中英双语。

description.en: A phone shell for the web GUI - the sidebar becomes an overlay drawer that closes when a session is tapped, the settings sheet goes full-screen single column, and the transcript is retuned for phone reading.
description.zh: 网页版界面的手机外壳：侧栏改为覆盖式抽屉、点会话自动收起，设置面板改全屏单列，正文排版按手机阅读距离重调。

description.en: Middle-click closes a session or a sidebar tab in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. A session closes through the row's own archive action, so the confirmation for running work and the undo notice stay exactly as the Harness renders them; a tab closes through its own close control, leaving the rule that a lone guide tab cannot be closed untouched. The gesture settles on press-and-release on the same element, so a middle drag never closes anything. Two switches on the plugin's own Settings tab turn each half off, remembered per browser.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面里，用鼠标中键关闭会话或侧边栏标签页。会话走这一行自带的归档操作，因此运行中任务的确认框和撤销通知仍由 Harness 原样渲染；标签页走自己的关闭按钮，「唯一的指南页不能关」这条规则不受影响。手势要求在同一元素上按下并松开，所以中键拖动不会误关。插件自带独立设置页，两个开关分别关闭这两项，并按浏览器记住。

description.en: Adds a DSH settings panel for QQ proactive-message dice rolls, showing per-conversation progress, hit statistics and quiet/guarantee countdowns, with editable parameters that apply immediately. Reads from an auto-detected local bridge, a custom HTTP status endpoint, or a built-in demo engine.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里显示 QQ 主动消息投骰进度：逐会话计数、命中统计、安静与保底倒计时，参数可改并立即生效；数据源支持自动探测本机桥接、自定义 HTTP 接口或内置演示引擎。

description.en: Persistent work-progress row in the band below the composer: task completion, a progress bar, and what the agent is doing right now (generating a reply or running a tool), expandable into the full task list with turns, steps, timings and context usage.
description.zh: 输入框下方常驻的工作进度行：任务完成度、进度条，以及此刻正在做什么（生成回复或执行工具）；展开可见完整任务清单与轮次、步骤、耗时、上下文占用。

description.en: Add six languages (繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI language options, with hand-polished per-language translations and automatic fallbacks (Simplified-to-Traditional conversion for zh-TW, English for the others) covering upstream updates and third-party plugins.
description.zh: 為 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 語言選單新增六種語言（繁體中文、日本語、한국어、Français、Deutsch、Español）：各語言逐條精譯，缺字串自動兜底（繁中即時簡轉繁、其他語言回退英文），官方更新與第三方插件都能覆蓋。

description.en: View and edit the AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md instruction chain in a native right-sidebar tab — global, shared, and every project directory down to the session working directory — with in-place save that creates missing files, a chat-header toggle, and an /agents command that works without the panel.
description.zh: 在右侧栏原生 tab 里查看并编辑 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 指令链：全局、共享，以及从项目根到会话工作目录的每一层；就地保存，文件不存在时直接创建；另有聊天头部按钮，以及界面不可用时也能用的 /agents 命令。

description.en: A grey ASCII ocean behind the whole window: whales swim continuously across the sidebar and the chat area, so a creature can drift from one column into the other. Once a conversation starts, every creature leaves through its own edge — up, down, right, or left — while the sea calms, and the sidebar keeps one frosted surface whose height follows its content, so a passing whale becomes a soft shadow behind the labels; an empty conversation brings them back in from the edges. Streaming replies reveal from blur to clear, and reduced motion falls back to a still frame and the native renderer. Neutral ink only, with day and night palettes.
description.zh: 整个窗口背后是一片灰色字符海洋：鲸群在侧栏与聊天区之间连续游动，能从一栏游进另一栏。开始对话后，生物各自向上、下、右或左侧边缘游走，海面缓缓平静，侧栏留一整片跟随内容高度的磨砂面，鲸鱼经过时只在文字背后留下模糊的影子；回到空白会话时，生物再从边缘游入。流式回复从模糊到清晰逐字浮现，开启减少动态效果时改用静态画面与原生渲染。只用中性墨色，日夜两套配色。

description.en: Folders for the DSH Plugins page: group installed plugins, toggle a whole group, batch move with undo, search across groups, long-press drag to reorder, reinstall removed plugins from their record, and restart Harness with one click.
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件页加文件夹：把已装插件分组、整组开关、批量移动并可撤销、跨分组搜索、长按拖动排序，卸载后按记录一键装回，还能一键重启 Harness。

description.en: Adds a drag handle above the chat composer so its height can be set by hand at any content length, with double-click to restore auto-grow capped at 168px.
description.zh: 给聊天输入框加一条拖动把手，任何内容长度下都能手动设定高度；双击恢复自动增高（上限 168px）。

description.en: Adds a Chinese-mode toggle beside the composer that opens a panel for switching reply, reasoning, and tool-narration language, persisted in the profile.
description.zh: 在输入框左侧加一个中文模式开关，点开可分别切换回复、思考与工具说明的语言，配置随 profile 持久化。

description.en: Adds Blue Archive style click and touch effects plus a cursor trail to the DSH Web GUI, with theme color, scale, opacity, glow, speed and on/off switches on a Click FX page in Settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加蔚蓝档案风格的点击/触摸特效与鼠标拖尾，并在设置的 Click FX 页提供主题色、大小、不透明度、辉光、速度与开关。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the DSH Web UI through a loopback-only endpoint that requests a relaunch using the current process executable, arguments and working directory.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加基于本机回环接口的重启按钮，按当前进程的可执行文件、参数和工作目录请求重新启动。

description.en: Embeds the original Magpie web UI in the DSH sidebar: downloads the Magpie binary from the yetone/magpie GitHub releases when missing, starts `magpie serve --web` in the background, and serves it through a local reverse proxy that injects the login cookie server-side.
description.zh: 把 Magpie 原版 Web UI 嵌进 DSH 侧边栏：缺 Magpie 二进制时自动从 yetone/magpie 的 GitHub Releases 下载，后台启动 `magpie serve --web`，并经由在服务端注入登录 Cookie 的本地反向代理提供页面。

description.en: Four-pointed star (FPS) adds long-task status, tool summaries, session outputs, persistent attachment drafts, native voice integration, provider usage, compatibility checks, and optional image generation to DSH.
description.zh: Four-pointed star（FPS）为 DSH 增加长任务状态、工具摘要、会话产物、附件持久化、原生语音接入、服务商用量、兼容性自检和可选生图。

description.en: Bottom terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI, providing multi-tab interactive terminals powered by node-pty (Windows ConPTY / POSIX openpty) with split panes, a side terminal list, and a dropdown new/split menu. Also compatible with DSH-better-sidebar — auto-detected at runtime, it switches to a bottom workbench tab so PTY sessions do not bind the DSH session write handle.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 底部终端面板插件，基于 node-pty 提供多标签交互式终端（Windows ConPTY / POSIX openpty），支持拆分面板、右侧终端列表与下拉新建/拆分菜单。同时兼容 DSH-better-sidebar——运行时自动检测并切换为底部工作台 tab，PTY 会话不绑定 DSH session 的 write handle。

description.en: Tick-rail conversation navigator: one tick per message you sent, a lit peak that follows the mouse with an even falloff, hover previews, click or keyboard to jump.
description.zh: 会话刻度线导航条：你发的每条消息一格刻度，点亮峰值随鼠标移动、两侧均匀衰减，悬停预览消息摘要，点击或键盘跳转到对应位置。

description.en: Page zoom for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+mouse wheel scales the entire interface in 5% steps (30%-200%), remembers the zoom level locally, and shows a magnifier with the percentage in the bottom-right corner.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 页面缩放：Ctrl+鼠标滚轮以 5% 步长缩放整个界面（30%-200%），在本地记住缩放比例，并在右下角显示放大镜与百分比。

description.en: Beginner panel for DeepSeek Harness: routes a plain-language request into ready-to-use plans (prompt variants, matching skills, advanced moves) with a local keyword engine and fills the chosen plan into a new session in one click.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 新手的说人话需求路由面板：用本地关键词引擎把一句大白话需求路由成可直接用的方案（提问话术变体、匹配技能、进阶玩法），选中的方案可一键填入新会话。

description.en: Change review for a turn's edited files: a pill above the composer counts this turn's files and lines and floats the file list up on hover, and a right-sidebar page shows each file's diff with syntax highlighting and a one-click revert.
description.zh: 本轮改动审查：输入框上方的气泡统计本回合改动文件数与行数，悬停时向上浮出文件清单；右侧边栏按标签页展示逐文件语法高亮 diff，并支持一键还原。

description.en: Adds lightweight selected-text references to DSH assistant replies: selections stay outside the editor as removable draft contexts, remain marked beside the source, and render as hoverable annotations after submission.
description.zh: 为 DSH 助手回复添加轻量选中文本引用：选区以可删除的草稿上下文独立于编辑器保存，在原文旁保留标记，并在发送后显示为可悬浮查看的注释。

description.en: Browse local image, video, and SVGA artifacts from conversation nodes in a Finder-style column view.
description.zh: 以访达式分栏浏览对话节点中的本地图片、视频与 SVGA 产物。

description.en: A WeCom WeDrive picker for the DeepSeek Harness composer: a draggable floating window with list, column and gallery views, search, sorting and multi-select inserts selected files, documents and folders as official `@` reference chips. Data comes from a local wecom-cli with the official doc.weixin.qq.com selector as fallback, and a bundled wecom-wedrive-ref skill routes the chips to the matching wecomcli-* document readers.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入条添加企业微信微盘选择器：可拖动的浮动窗口提供列表、分栏、画廊三种查看方式，支持搜索、排序与多选，把选中的文件 / 文档 / 文件夹写成官方 `@` 引用 chip。数据来自本机 wecom-cli，缺少 CLI 时回退到官方 doc.weixin.qq.com 选择器；附带 wecom-wedrive-ref 技能，按 id 前缀把 chip 路由到对应的 wecomcli-* 文档技能。

description.en: The row that is running expands itself and folds back when it settles. A running turn keeps its whole procedure in one height-capped window that scrolls itself; a finished turn merges into the built-in finished header, leaving only the final answer. It works by driving the official disclosure rows rather than drawing its own panel, leaves rows you opened by hand alone, and restores the official settings on uninstall.
description.zh: 正在跑的那一行自动展开、跑完自动收起；跑着的一轮把过程收进一个限高窗口，页面不再被越堆越长的步骤拽着走；一轮结束并进官方那条「已完成」表头，只留最终回复。做法是点官方自己的折叠行、给官方过程体加限高，不自绘面板；你手动开合过的行不动，卸载时把改过的官方设置还原。

description.en: Drag or paste files into the Web composer with one image-and-file preview rail; native PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF keep the image attachment path, while other files reuse a matching local path or stream to Host staging and become @ references only at send time. Includes browser media/PDF and bounded text previews; Office and archives show identity cards, and unsent file entries are page-local.
description.zh: 把文件拖入或粘贴进 Web 输入框，图片与文件共用预览栏；PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 保留出厂图片通道，其他文件优先引用匹配的本地路径，否则流式暂存到 Host，发送时才追加 @ 引用。提供浏览器媒体/PDF 和限长文本预览；Office 与压缩包显示身份卡，未发送文件清单仅保存在页面内。

description.en: Polish button in the composer that rewrites the draft with the model the current conversation already uses: four styles, a fidelity guard that keeps every concrete fact verbatim, one-click revert, and no API key of its own.
description.zh: 输入框润色按钮：用当前会话正在使用的模型改写草稿，四种风格，代码层保真校验确保数字、版本、路径、URL、引号内容与代码标识符逐字保留，支持一键还原，无需自备 API Key。

description.en: Puts a More row at the end of the sidebar main panel list and lets you decide, entry by entry, which panels stay visible and which move into it: a menu lists every entry with a one-click switch in either direction, a search box filters long lists, and a single Restore all clears both kinds of key. Also hides the footer action buttons, keeps the plugins entry un-collapsible, and writes each choice to the profile config so it survives a restart.
description.zh: 在侧边栏主导航列表末尾放一行「更多」，每个入口单独决定留在外面还是收进去：菜单列出全部入口，一行一个开关，两个方向的切换都只要点一下；入口多了能用搜索框筛，一个「全部恢复」把两类键一起清空。底部工具区的按钮也能收，插件入口锁死不可收；选择写进 profile 配置，DSH 重启后照样生效。

description.en: Adds a 24px capsule to the composer status row that plays seven preset internet radio stations, with a live spectrum, now-playing metadata for Nightride FM and Radio Paradise, and remembered volume and station.
description.zh: 在 composer 状态行加一条 24px 胶囊，播放 7 个预置网络电台；带实时频谱、Nightride FM 与 Radio Paradise 的当前曲目，并记住音量和上次电台。

description.en: Pops the DSH side chat into a frameless, always-on-top Windows desktop window that can sit over any other application, with its own settings page for appearance, pinning, remembered geometry, opacity, ephemeral threads and cache cleanup.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的侧边对话弹成一个无边框、可置顶的 Windows 独立浮窗，可覆盖在其他应用之上；自带设置页，可调外观、置顶、记忆窗口几何、不透明度、即用即焚与缓存清理。

description.en: User message jump bar for the DSH web GUI: a minimap-style dash strip on the right edge of the conversation, with hover preview, click-to-jump, drag-to-scrub and a viewport marker.
description.zh: DSH Web 用户消息跳转条：对话区右缘 minimap 式横杠条带，悬停预览消息内容、点击跳转置顶、拖拽快速浏览，并带当前视口标记。

description.en: Embeds a full calendar app as a sidebar panel and adds a draggable, resizable scheduled-task widget on the DSH page. Registers six agent tools (status, list, create, update, delete, summarize) that read and write the same SQLite database. The calendar's own AI is routed to the DeepSeek route already configured in DSH, and each reply shows token usage and cost, accumulated per day.
description.zh: 把完整的日历应用嵌成侧栏面板，并在 DSH 页面上挂一个可拖动、可缩放的定时任务浮窗。注册六个 Agent 工具（状态、查询、新增、修改、删除、总结），读写同一个 SQLite 数据库。日历内的 AI 改走 DSH 已配置的 DeepSeek 路由，每条回复下方显示 token 用量与费用，并按天累计。

description.en: Adds the dshmarket plugin market to the DSH sidebar as a panel of its own, ordered above the built-in Plugins entry. Clicking the entry renders the market through the client service dshmarket publishes for hosts, so the catalog, category filters, comments and install and update flows are the ones dshmarket ships rather than a copy of them. Nothing to learn or configure: the panel is the market, with its own sidebar entry, label in Chinese or English to match the interface language, and icon. If dshmarket is not loaded the panel says so instead of failing client composition, and its locale keys, slots and style tag are released when the plugin unloads.
description.zh: 把 dshmarket 插件市场作为独立面板放进 DSH 侧边栏，排在「插件」之上。点击即通过 dshmarket 对外发布的 host 端 client service 渲染市场本身，因此目录、分类筛选、评论与安装/更新流程都是 dshmarket 自己的，而不是一份副本。无需学习或配置：这个面板就是市场，有自己的侧边栏条目、跟随界面语言的中英文名与图标。dshmarket 未加载时面板会明说，而不是让客户端组装失败；插件卸载时其语言键、插槽与 style 标签一并释放。

description.en: Adds a Settings → General row that opens ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md in the system editor, so the instruction file can be opened without hunting for it. On Windows it launches Notepad and raises the window.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」里增加一行，用系统编辑器打开 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md，不必再去文件管理器里翻这个指令文件；Windows 上直接拉起记事本并把窗口提到前台。

description.en: Adds one action to the workspace menu that moves a workspace to the top once, without a favorites system or automatic reordering.
description.zh: 在工作区的「…」菜单里加一项「移到最上面」，只调整一次顺序，不做收藏、星标或自动重排。

description.en: Keeps the DSH desktop window the size you left it: records the last outer frame of the main window in physical pixels and restores it, centred on the work area, on the next start - and it acts before the window is ever shown, so the boot animation plays at the right size. The settings page offers 12 presets (1024x768 to 3840x2160), free-form custom width and height, a centre-on-restore switch and an apply-now action; a choice takes effect immediately and persists. Resizing goes through a small helper executable compiled on the user's own machine: the C# source ships inside the plugin, is built on first run with the in-box Windows csc.exe (measured ~110 ms once, cached next to the state file, ~90 ms to start), and falls back to a short-lived powershell.exe process when that is not possible. The package ships no binary, declares no npm dependencies and makes no outbound network request. Windows only.
description.zh: 让 DSH 桌面端窗口保持你离开时的大小：记录主窗口最后一次的外框尺寸（物理像素），下次启动恢复并居中到工作区，而且赶在窗口露面之前改完，启动动画不会播在错误的分辨率上。设置页有 12 个常用分辨率（1024×768 到 3840×2160）、任意自定义宽高、「恢复时居中」开关与「立即应用」，选中即生效并持久化。改尺寸走一个在使用者本机现编的小助手 exe：C# 源码随插件一起发布，首次运行用 Windows 自带的 csc.exe 编一次（实测约 110 毫秒），产物与同名 .cs 缓存到状态文件同目录，之后起进程约 90 毫秒；编不出来时退回临时 powershell.exe 进程。包里不含二进制、package.json 不声明任何依赖、不发任何外部网络请求。仅限 Windows。

description.en: Bring GrokBot into DeepSeek harness.
description.zh: 将GrokBot带入DSH。

description.en: Takes over the model button in the DSH composer and opens its own two-level panel (provider list, then model list with search) built around a continuous draggable reasoning-effort slider: the fill runs blue to violet, higher levels add nebula and dust particles, and every level has its own color. Drag moves one level at a time, and picking a model keeps the panel open and repositions the slider to that model's middle level.
description.zh: 接管 DSH 输入框的官方模型席按钮，点开是自建的两级面板（provider 列表 → 模型列表 + 搜索），核心是一条连续可拖动的推理等级滑条：填充由蓝渐变到紫罗兰，高档位带星云与星尘粒子，一档一色；拖动一档一格，点模型不关面板、滑条立刻落到该模型的中间档。

description.en: Adds quick installation and switching for workbench templates in DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供工作台模板的快捷安装与切换。

description.en: Replace the model picker with global search, favorites, recent selections, model-family navigation, and reasoning effort selection.
description.zh: 替换模型选择器，提供全局搜索、收藏、最近使用、模型家族导航与思维强度选择。

description.en: Replaces the DSH composer send/stop button with the DeepSeek blue whale and animates it while the agent runs.
description.zh: 将 DSH 输入框的发送 / 停止按钮换成 DeepSeek 品牌蓝色鲸鱼，运行时游动起来。

description.en: Line-range selection: browse workspace files, preview code with line numbers, visually select a line range, and write a `@path:start-end` reference into the composer; the agent receives the exact selected lines on send.
description.zh: 行选区：浏览工作区文件、带行号预览代码、可视化选中行范围，一键把 `@path:start-end` 引用写入输入框，agent 发送时自动收到所选行原文，精准修改指定行。

description.en: Download pets from petdex.dev and keep one on the desktop, following the DSH session status; the appearance is adjustable and an enterprise WeChat bot can push a notification when the agent needs confirmation or finishes a turn. Desktop mode needs macOS 12+ or Windows 10 1903+; the bundled companion is prebuilt.
description.zh: 从 petdex.dev 下载宠物并常驻桌面，跟随 DSH 会话状态显示；外观可调，Agent 需要确认或一轮结束时可通过企业微信机器人推送通知。桌面模式需要 macOS 12+ 或 Windows 10 1903+，桌面端已随安装包预编译。

description.en: Adds download buttons to the document preview toolbar and the Files tree, packs a folder download into a streamed ZIP, and adds a Files-tree upload button that streams to the Host one file at a time, capped at 1 GiB and renamed with an (n) suffix instead of overwriting.
description.zh: 在文档预览工具栏与 Files 文件树添加下载按钮（文件夹下载打包为流式 ZIP），并在文件树增加上传按钮：逐个文件流式写入 Host，单文件上限 1 GiB，重名自动改为 (n) 后缀而不覆盖。

description.en: Select text in any Windows app to explain or translate it with the Harness agent, answered in a native always-on-top overlay.
description.zh: 在任意 Windows 应用里划词，用 Harness 自己的 agent 解释或翻译（自动带上选区所在的上下文段落），结果落在可拖动、可缩放的原生置顶浮窗里。

description.en: Adds a Chats/Files switch to the left-sidebar Workspace header that swaps the session list for a lazily loaded tree of the current session's workspace. Files and folders can be dragged into the composer as @path references; clicking a file opens the built-in preview; the right-click menu reveals a file in the system file manager or copies its path; entries carry VS Code-style Git status (modified, untracked, added, deleted, conflict, ignored) relative to the last commit.
description.zh: 在左侧栏「工作区」标题旁加入「对话 | 文件」切换，把会话列表换成当前会话工作区的按需加载文件树。文件和文件夹可拖进输入框作为 @路径 引用；单击文件打开自带预览；右键可在系统文件管理器中打开所在文件夹或复制路径；条目按 VS Code 的方式显示相对最近一次提交的 Git 状态（修改、未跟踪、新增、删除、冲突、忽略）。

description.en: Conversation-map rail down the left edge of the transcript: one tick per user turn, read from the full session log on the host rather than from the rendered page, so long sessions are covered end to end. Hovering fans the neighbouring ticks open by pixel distance and floats a scrollable preview of that turn prompt and its last reply; clicking scrolls to the turn, paging older history in first when it has not been rendered yet; the tick for the visible turn stays highlighted while you scroll.
description.zh: 主对话区左缘的对话地图刻度列：每条刻度是一轮用户提问，刻度由宿主直读会话完整日志得来，不受客户端分页窗口限制，长会话也是全量覆盖。hover 时邻近刻度按像素距离连续展开，右侧浮出该轮提问与最后一次回复的预览卡（可进卡滚动看完）；点击跳转到该轮，老轮次尚未渲染时先自动分页加载再跳；滚动对话时当前轮次的刻度保持高亮。

description.en: Typography settings page: text, code and terminal font size and family, plus interface, conversation and code text colour, weight, italic, letter spacing and line height, with a live preview.
description.zh: 字体设置页：正文、代码与终端的字号和字体族，外加界面、会话与代码的文字颜色、字重、斜体、字间距与行高，带实时预览。

description.en: Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more specific prompt through a one-shot LLM call, with one-click revert and cancel.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，一键调用 LLM 把当前草稿改写成更清晰具体的提示词，支持一键恢复原文与取消。

description.en: Quote text selected in a DSH Web conversation, then either attach it to the current composer or dispatch it to a subagent session: the quote sits on a bar above the composer, or opens that subagent in a new pane on the right. When the target has no subagent yet, the quote is held and the composer is seeded with a spawn request, then picked up automatically once the new session appears. Client-only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页版会话里划词后，把选中内容引用到当前输入框，或分派到子智能体会话：引用落在输入框正上方的引用条上，或在右侧新开一格打开该子智能体会话。目标还没有子智能体时先挂起这条引用，并在输入框写入派生请求，新子会话一出现就自动接续。纯客户端。

description.en: A floating command deck that lists every slash command in DeepSeek Harness as runnable buttons, sorted by usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮命令甲板：把所有斜杠命令列成可执行按钮，悬停看介绍，按使用次数排序。

description.en: Searches wallhaven.cc from a settings page and sets any wallpaper as the DSH web GUI background, with opacity, blur and scrim controls, a sidebar shuffle button and one-click original download; all fetching runs in the host process, so the browser never needs to reach wallhaven.
description.zh: 在设置页搜索 wallhaven.cc,把任意壁纸铺成 DSH Web GUI 背景,支持透明度、模糊与遮罩调节,侧边栏一键换图,可下载原图;图片全部由宿主进程取回,浏览器无需能访问 wallhaven。

description.en: Web UI plugin that folds each staged response's think and tool calls into per-segment bounded, scrollable slide windows with a configurable height, keeping every intermediate response visible.
description.zh: Web UI 插件：以阶段性文字回复为界分段，把每段的 think 与工具调用收进限高可滚动、高度可配置的 slide 窗口，中间过程始终可见。

description.en: Sorts the entries of the DSH sidebar panel list into one or two levels of categories, draws a titled collapsible header for each group, and shows or hides each entry, all edited from a Plugin Sidebar page in Settings and mirrored to $DSH_HOME/plugins-sidebar-manager.json.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏的面板入口按一级或二级分类归位，为每个分类在侧栏画出可折叠的标题行，并能逐个显示或隐藏；都在设置的「插件侧栏管理」里调整，布局同时写入 $DSH_HOME/plugins-sidebar-manager.json。

description.en: UI polish layer for the DSH web client: frosted-glass menu surfaces, a draggable reasoning-effort slider that replaces the level radio list, and model-menu navigation that reaches the model list in one click and closes on a single Esc.
description.zh: DSH 网页端界面打磨层：补上浮层毛玻璃材质，用可拖动滑杆替换推理等级单选列表，模型菜单一次点击直达列表、Esc 一次关闭。

description.en: Switch providers and models, adjust reasoning effort; each model remembers its own level.
description.zh: 切换供应商、模型与思考强度，每个模型各自记住档位。

description.en: Tauri 2 desktop app for DeepSeek Harness (macOS + Windows; installers on the repository's Releases page) with a built-in dsh runtime: tray-resident launcher with per-profile ports and windows, a process guardian that auto-heals up to three times, local or remote dsh, task-completion notifications with a Dock badge, and a live startup console. This plugin is the app's in-page half — its desktop chrome and notification bridge only take effect when DSH runs inside the desktop app; added to a regular DSH with `dsh plugin add`, it provides the bundled skill for packaging a DSH Web GUI as a Tauri app.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 封装成 Tauri 2 桌面应用（macOS + Windows，安装包见仓库 Releases，内置 dsh 运行时）：托盘常驻启动器（按 profile 分端口与窗口）、最多自愈 3 次的进程守护、本地或远程 dsh、带 Dock 角标的任务完成通知、实时启动控制台。本插件是该应用的页面内半区——桌面 chrome 与通知桥只在 DSH 运行于桌面应用内时生效；在普通 DSH 里用 `dsh plugin add` 安装时，提供的是随附的「把 DSH Web GUI 打包成 Tauri 应用」技能。

description.en: Legal knowledge-base workbench: hybrid keyword/statistical/vector retrieval over local statute .doc/.docx corpora, faceted filtering, charge-name and civil-cause trees, a document editor, and four AI tools (citation check, contract review, AI analysis, AI drafting).
description.zh: 法律知识库工作台：直读本地法规 .doc/.docx 语料，关键词/统计语义/向量三路融合检索、双维度筛选、案名索引与民事案由树、文书编辑器，以及引用核验/合同审查/AI 分析/AI 文书生成四件套。

description.en: Shows a 0-100 conversation coherence badge and commentary by running parallel contradiction analysis on the live DSH session, with a manual trigger and interval-based auto-analysis (on by default, editable per session or globally).
description.zh: 对当前 DSH 会话做并行矛盾分析，在会话标题栏显示 0–100 连贯性徽章与评注，支持手动触发和按轮数的自动分析（默认开启，可按会话或全局调整）。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing status, a countdown to the next rate change, and the estimated session cost as inline text beside the model selector.
description.zh: 在模型选择器旁以行内文字显示 DeepSeek 峰谷定价状态、距下一次调价的倒计时，以及本次会话的预估费用。

description.en: A 44x44 always-on-top desktop ball for DSH that reflects what the agent is actually doing (thinking, searching, web fetch, error, waiting for input) and shows an exclamation or question-mark badge when a task finishes or needs an answer while you are away. Windows only; it downloads its own Electron runtime on first use.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的桌面情绪小球：44×44 置顶小挂件，实时反映 agent 正在做什么（思考、检索、联网、出错、等待输入）；任务在你不看时完成、或有问题等你回答时，右上角亮「!」「?」角标。仅 Windows；首次使用会自行下载 Electron 运行时。

description.en: A personal home workspace with tasks, a focus timer, a Flomo notes timeline, shortcuts and wallpapers.
description.zh: 一页个人工作台：待办、专注计时、Flomo 笔记时间流、快捷入口与壁纸。

description.en: Select any text in a DSH conversation and tap Ctrl to get an inline sub-topic card: streaming answer, follow-up tree, and drag-to-quote reference chips.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话里选中一段文字按 Ctrl，就地开出子话题卡片：流式解答、追问树，还能把树行拖成引用卡片。

description.en: Prompt enhancement for the DSH Web GUI composer: pick a style before generating (logic-only, structured, or concise), or supply or clear a custom system prompt in settings; a sparkle button or Shift+Tab rewrites the current draft through the harness model, streams the result into an inline preview (original vs enhanced) with a live thinking timer, fills it back with one click, keeps an undo bar, and offers settings for model route, temperature, length limits, context awareness, undo-bar behavior and shortcuts.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 输入框旁的提示词增强插件：生成前可选仅优化逻辑、结构化重写或精简压缩，也可在设置页自定义或清空系统提示词；点 ✨ 或在输入框内按 Shift+Tab，把当前草稿交给宿主模型重写，结果流式显示在原文/增强的对比预览里并显示思考计时，一键回填并保留撤销条，设置页可调模型路由、温度、长度上限、上下文感知、撤销条行为与快捷键。

description.en: Korean UI language pack that adds 한국어 to Settings → General → Language through the official language-pack API.
description.zh: 韩语界面语言包，通过官方语言包 API 在 设置 → 通用 → 语言 中添加韩语（한국어）。

description.en: No-setup mode for the DSH web UI: hides advanced surfaces, auto-applies best defaults (chat mode, full access, account balance), and one-click role-play personas (maid/butler).
description.zh: DSH 网页免设置模式：隐藏复杂界面、自动套用最佳设置（聊天模式、Full Access、账户余额），并提供一键人设角色扮演（女僕/管家）。

description.en: Composer meter for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a pill under the input shows draft character count, estimated tokens and this session's estimated cost from DeepSeek's published prices (peak/off-peak, Flash/Pro or custom rates), and opens a panel with the token breakdown, a six-snapshot per-session draft vault and a draft cleaner; every write goes through the host setDraft API instead of touching the editor DOM.
description.zh: dsh 输入框计量：输入框下方的 pill 显示草稿字数、预估 token 与本会话估算费用（内置 DeepSeek 官方价目，高峰/空闲与 Flash / Pro 自动换价，可自定义）；点开面板可看 token 明细、最近 6 份草稿快照（保险箱）与草稿清洗，写回只走宿主的 setDraft 接口。

description.en: A collapsible, draggable popup in the top-right corner of the DSH web interface for watching A-shares, ETFs, Hong Kong and US stocks and OKX spot crypto side by side: real-time quotes, intraday and daily/weekly/monthly candlestick charts with moving averages, buy/sell target prices, group switching with drag-to-reorder, rename and delete, cross-market search, and light/dark themes. A fork of Awu12277/dsh-stock-watch that adds US quotes via Eastmoney and crypto via OKX.
description.zh: A 股 / ETF / 港股 / 美股 / 加密货币行情盯盘插件：在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面右上角显示可折叠、可拖动的弹窗，同时盯多个市场——实时行情、分时与日/周/月 K 线（含均线）、买卖目标价、分组管理（切换、拖动排序、重命名、删除）、跨市场搜索、明暗主题。fork 自 Awu12277/dsh-stock-watch，新增东方财富美股行情与 OKX 现货加密货币行情。

description.en: Folds the built-in subagent dropdown into History / Today / Previous / Current groups by usage batch, keeping the current batch expanded; the original header is left untouched.
description.zh: 把原生子代理下拉按使用批次折叠为 历史 / 今日 / 上次 / 本次 四组，本次始终展开；不改动原版头部。

description.en: Compact card above the sidebar account avatar showing the signed-in DeepSeek account balance, the current peak or off-peak billing window with a countdown to the next switch, and the rate of both windows. The window is computed locally in Beijing time without a network request; the balance refreshes every 60 seconds and on window focus or visibility. zh/en copy, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 侧栏账户头像上方的紧凑卡片：显示已登录 DeepSeek 账户的余额、当前闲时/忙时计费时段及切换倒计时、以及两种时段的费率。时段按北京时间本地计算，无需网络请求；余额每 60 秒刷新，窗口重新可见或获得焦点时也会刷新。支持中英文，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Moves the sidebar account avatar out of the bottom strip with four placements, including a zero-height inline mode in the brand row, and three heights down to an avatar-only row, with adjustable spacing and a settings card on the Plugins page, while other plugins' footer widgets stay pinned at the bottom.
description.zh: 把侧栏底部的账号头像移出，支持四种位置（含零高度的品牌行内嵌）、三档高度（最小仅头像）、可调间距，并在插件页提供设置卡；其他插件的底栏小组件保持原位贴底。

description.en: A terminal workbench for dsh with streaming chat, tool execution, session management, provider management, and image input.
description.zh: 面向 dsh 的终端工作台，提供流式对话、工具执行、会话管理、Provider 管理与图片输入。

description.en: Interactive terminal chat app for dsh: streaming conversation, tool cards, jobs panel, full-text search, trajectory replay, multi-session tabs, and A2A dispatch (Ink-based).
description.zh: dsh 交互式终端聊天应用：流式对话、工具卡片、任务面板、全文搜索、轨迹回放、多会话标签与 A2A 派发（Ink 实现）。

description.en: Adds a Branch Chat tab to dsh-better-sidebar that opens independent archived sessions with a head/middle/tail context digest and the same tools as the main agent.
description.zh: 在 dsh-better-sidebar 新增分支对话页签：开出独立封存 session，注入头／中／尾脉络摘要，并使用与主对话相同的工具。

description.en: Predicts your next message after each completed turn and shows it as grey ghost text in the empty composer: Tab or → fills it in without sending, Esc hides it, and a rebindable shortcut (Alt+\ by default) predicts on demand or steps through several candidates. Off until enabled in its settings page, which has three one-click modes (balanced, saver, quality), an optional left-sidebar entry, daily request and token limits, masking of keys, tokens and e-mail addresses before sending, and a 7-day usage summary; short messages repeated in the session and a list of pinned phrases come after the model suggestion when stepping through candidates, without a model call, and the interface is available in nine languages.
description.zh: 每轮回答结束后预测你的下一条消息，以灰色文字显示在空输入框里：Tab 或 → 填入但不发送，Esc 隐藏，可改的快捷键（默认 Alt+\）立即预测或在多条候选间切换。默认关闭，在设置页启用；设置页提供均衡、省流、高质量三种一键模式，可选的左侧栏入口，每日请求与 token 上限，发送前遮蔽密钥、令牌和邮箱，以及近 7 天用量统计；会话中重复发过的短句和自己固定的短语排在模型建议之后，切换候选时出现，不调用模型；界面支持九种语言。

description.en: Codex-style Create Workspace dialog: name it and the folder is created for you, or pick one with a native chooser that remembers where you were (the native chooser is Windows-only; elsewhere use the name field).
description.zh: Codex 式的创建工作区对话框：填名称就自动建出目录，或者选文件夹——原生选择窗口会记得你上次在哪（原生选择窗口仅 Windows 可用，其它平台请直接填名称）。

description.en: Adds a configurable dsh-ui status card before each DSH agent reply, with bilingual templates and a live settings preview. Requires @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui from dsh-market; without it, the card markup is emitted unrendered.
description.zh: 为每次 DSH Agent 回复添加可配置的 dsh-ui 状态卡片，提供双语模板和实时设置预览。需要先从 dsh-market 安装 @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui，否则卡片标记会以未渲染的形式输出。

description.en: A plain-notebook calendar in the DSH sidebar: a 70-day, Monday-first grid whose cells print that day's note; one note per day is stored in a .xlsx you choose, in the DesktopCal two-column layout (Excel date serial plus free text, newest date first). Clicking a day opens the editor for it, and import/export move that same format in and out, with a preview step and a conflict policy (keep, overwrite, concat or skip).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里的纯记事本日历：周一起始的 70 天网格，格子里直接显示当天内容；每天一条，写进你自己指定的 .xlsx，沿用 DesktopCal 两列格式（Excel 日期序列号 + 自由文本，新日期在前）。点某天即打开该日编辑框；导入导出走同一格式，导入先预览，冲突可选保留、覆盖、拼接或跳过。

description.en: Turns the "deep diving" thinking status into a pixel font, with an animated pixel blue whale spouting and wagging its tail beside it.
description.zh: 把「深度求索中」变成像素字，旁边一只像素蓝鲸喷水摆尾。

description.en: Adds a Canvas drawer and eight model tools to create, patch, version, and export HTML, Markdown, Mermaid, SVG, and React artifacts.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 增加 Canvas 抽屉与八个模型工具，用于创建、局部补丁、版本管理和导出 HTML、Markdown、Mermaid、SVG 与 React 工件。

description.en: Auto-pairs brackets and quotes in the DSH chat composer, inserting the closing half with the caret in between; it also wraps selected text with the typed pair and handles brackets committed by an IME.
description.zh: DSH 聊天输入框的括号/引号自动配对：输入左半边自动补右半边并把光标停在中间；也支持用符号包裹选中文字，以及中文输入法提交的括号。

description.en: Plan review enhancement for DeepSeek Harness Web: reply to the plan-review card inline to have the model revise the plan, and browse, compare, edit and archive every plan version in a full-screen overlay.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的计划评审增强：在评审卡片内直接回复意见让模型修订计划，并在全屏浮层中回看、对比、编辑和留档每一版计划。

description.en: A draggable desktop pet for the DSH web interface with interactive actions and growth states.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 界面的可拖拽桌宠，支持互动动作与成长状态。

description.en: Lightweight sidebar UI for DeepSeek Harness: five fold switches, three density presets and three width presets, served from one footer row plus a settings section — no dependencies and no background service.
description.zh: 轻量级侧栏 UI：五个折叠开关、三档密度预设与三档宽度预设，入口收在底部一行与设置分区；无依赖、无后台服务。

description.en: Adds a refresh button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop title bar next to the Edit menu, reloading the interface without restarting the app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端顶部标题栏「编辑」右边加一个「刷新」按钮，只重载界面、不重启应用。

description.en: Replace tool-card leading icons with emoji while preserving the original cards.
description.zh: 把工具卡片前面的图标换成 emoji，同时保留原卡片全部内容。

description.en: Left-edge turn-marks strip in chat: one bar per user message, click to jump to that message, hover for a preview, active bar turns white.
description.zh: 会话左侧消息标记条：每发一条消息多一根条条，点击跳转到该消息、悬停预览内容，当前消息对应的条条变白。

description.en: Changes how DSH Web sends messages: Enter inserts a newline and sending takes Cmd on macOS or Ctrl elsewhere.
description.zh: 调整 DSH Web 的消息发送方式：Enter 只换行，发送用 Cmd（macOS）或 Ctrl。

description.en: Right-click a session in the left session list to choose one of eight gradient washes or three hand-drawn line patterns; the last blank row clears it.
description.zh: 右键左侧会话列表中的会话，选择八档渐变或三个手绘线条图案（星星、猫、狗）；最后一条空白条清除。

description.en: Plugin-button aggregator with carrier + on-site-LLM extensibility: gather any plugin's scattered buttons into one entry (SSiD title bar / web floating ball), LLM registers per environment, right-click deregisters — pure data, no plugin source touched.
description.zh: 插钮聚合器（载体+驻场 LLM 范式）：把任何插件的散落按钮聚合到统一入口（SSiD 标题栏 / web 悬浮球）——LLM 按环境注册、右键删除=注销，纯数据零代码，不动插件源码。

description.en: macOS desktop shell for the DSH web UI: a plugin plus a small Tauri/WKWebView window over the loopback web surface — real macOS fullscreen, single instance, external links delegated to the system browser, and browser-style zoom.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 装进原生 macOS 桌面窗口：插件 + 轻量 Tauri/WKWebView 外壳跑在同一个 loopback 地址上——真 macOS 全屏、单实例、外链交给系统浏览器、类浏览器页面缩放。

description.en: A DSH Desktop enhancement plugin offering Skills/MCP management, global instructions, task notifications, and other practical features, with options to streamline built-in functionality as needed.
description.zh: DSH 桌面增强插件，提供技能/MCP 管理、全局指令、任务通知等实用功能，支持按需精简内置功能。

description.en: Starts the DSH desktop New Workspace folder picker in a directory you configure (Windows only) and adds a settings page for it, falling back to the stock picker when the saved folder is missing.
description.zh: 让 DSH 桌面端「新建工作区」的文件夹选择框从你设定的目录开始（仅 Windows），并在设置里提供配置入口；目录不存在时静默回退到原生选择框。

description.en: A download-progress indicator for the DSH session header: it reads the background-job roster and parses what downloaders already print — curl --progress-bar, wget, aria2, or a JSON progress file — into a progress ring, animated bars, transfer speed and ETA. Jobs that report nothing show as unknown progress instead of being hidden. A finished file opens with one click, or reveals in the file manager. No third-party plugin required; the package ships zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 会话头里的下载进度指示器：读取后台任务名册，把下载器自己已经打印出来的进度（curl --progress-bar、wget、aria2，或 JSON 进度文件）解析成环形进度、动画进度条、传输速率与剩余时间；不上报进度的任务显示为未知进度而不是被隐藏。已完成文件单击即开，也可在文件管理器里定位。不依赖任何第三方插件，运行时零依赖。

description.en: Renders agent-authored HTML/CSS/JS inside the conversation as sandboxed iframes, with POST and SSE back to the model and reusable templates.
description.zh: 让模型写出 HTML/CSS/JS，在会话里以沙箱 iframe 渲染，并通过 POST 与 SSE 与模型互通，支持模板复用。

description.en: Adds three settings pages to DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable and remove MCP servers; write agent skills by hand or install them from a GitHub repository; and keep a library of global personas with one active.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 增加三页设置界面：增删改查与启停 MCP 服务；手写 Skill 技能或从 GitHub 仓库安装；维护多人设库并启用其中一份。

description.en: Expands every session in the DSH Desktop sidebar. Its control page (/dsh-sidebar-expand-all) applies four equal-length patches to the app.asar workspace client bundle, with backup and one-click restore; after that the "Expand remaining N sessions" row reveals all hidden sessions in one click, collapsing returns to exactly 5, and a workspace reopens fully expanded instead of resetting to five. Needs an app restart, and a DSH update reverts the patch.
description.zh: 让 DSH 桌面版侧栏的会话全部展开。它的控制页（/dsh-sidebar-expand-all）对 app.asar 内 workspace client bundle 打四处等长补丁，带备份与一键还原；之后「展开其余 N 个会话」点一次就展开该工作区全部剩余会话，「收起」严格回到 5 个，重开工作区也保持全展开而不是退回五个。需要重启应用，DSH 升级后补丁会被覆盖。

description.en: Turns completed DeepSeek Harness public-content work into a browser-local visual magazine with explicit updates and reviewed one-article sharing.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 中已完成的公开内容工作整理为浏览器本地的视觉杂志，支持显式更新和经审核的单篇文章分享。

description.en: Adds a Workspaces / Recent-sessions switcher above the sidebar list, with a pinned-sessions group, a per-row menu (pin/unpin, copy session id), title filtering, and browser-local pin storage with a one-shot migration from dsh-plugin-pin-session.
description.zh: 在侧栏列表上方加「工作区 / 最新会话」切换条，含固定会话分组、行级菜单（固定/取消固定、复制 Session ID）、标题过滤；pin 存于浏览器 localStorage，并对 dsh-plugin-pin-session 做一次性迁移与过渡双写。

description.en: Adds a management page for the official DeepSeek Harness ACP subagent provider, with one-click presets, a read-only connectivity check, live switches for all three entry points, and online preset updates.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 官方 ACP 子智能体 provider 提供目标管理页、一键预设、只读连通性检测、三个入口的实时开关与在线预设更新。

description.en: Settings extensions for DSH.
description.zh: DSH 的设置扩展。

description.en: Web Components support.
description.zh: Web Components 支持。

description.en: Replaces the left sidebar session list with a tree of every session and its nested subagent descendants, with click-through to each conversation's multi-turn history and a tree_send tool for messaging any continuable session anywhere in the tree.
description.zh: 把左侧栏的会话列表替换为完整会话树：展示全部会话及其多层子智能体，点击节点即可进入该会话的多轮对话；并附带 tree_send 工具，可向树中任意可续接的子会话投递消息。

description.en: Shows processing time and rotating Chinese tips above the DSH composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框上方显示处理中计时和轮换的中文趣味提示。

description.en: Session-header fishbone panel for sub-agent assignments, live status, available token and duration metrics, shared task-board entries, and native child-session navigation.
description.zh: 会话标题栏鱼骨图面板，展示子代理分工、实时状态、可用的 Token 与耗时指标及共享任务，并支持跳转子会话。

description.en: Provider-first three-level model selector for the DSH Web model seat: pick a provider, then a model from that provider, with inline search on both levels, failed-provider retry rows, and a Model · Provider trigger.
description.zh: Provider-first 三级模型选择器：先选供应商再选模型，两级均可行内搜索，失败供应商以可重试行展示，触发器显示 Model · Provider。

description.en: Sidebar system monitor for the DSH Web UI: live host overview (CPU/memory/network/disk), process list, and Docker container status, all read-only.
description.zh: 侧边栏系统监控：实时查看宿主机概览（CPU/内存/网络/磁盘）、进程列表与 Docker 容器状态，全程只读。
