description.en: Live per-turn progress capsule with an empirical ETA table and a click-to-open turn history, docked under the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框下方常驻显示当前对话的进度与预估剩余时间，点击可回看该会话的历史任务记录。

description.en: Creates a Windows desktop shortcut that starts DeepSeek Harness when needed and opens the Web UI in a Chrome or Edge app window.
description.zh: 创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式，必要时启动 DeepSeek Harness，并用 Chrome 或 Edge 应用窗口打开 Web UI。

description.en: Lets users quote selected conversation text with optional notes, then attaches the references to their next message.
description.zh: 引用选中的对话文本并添加可选备注，在发送下一条消息时自动附带引用内容。

description.en: Three-window workbench for dsh web: chat, construct, and a read-only review window side by side for each workspace, per-window hooks, and an anonymous multi-model review that asks before it runs, groups findings by issue, and reports in Markdown.
description.zh: dsh web 的三窗工作台：每个工作区并排显示聊天、施工和只读审核三个窗口，各窗口独立配置 hook；审核窗提供匿名多模型评审，先确认再运行，按同一件事归组，报告为 Markdown。

description.en: Seeyon workbench that mounts OA to-dos and meetings, the skill catalog, and one-click aTrust VPN in one panel. Its vendored modules replace the author's dsh-seeyon-todo, dsh-skillhub and dsh-vpn — install this bundle or those plugins, not both. Requires a Seeyon OA account; the VPN part is Windows-only and needs the Sangfor aTrust client.
description.zh: 致远工作台：把 OA 待办、会议、技能市场和 aTrust VPN 一键登录合成一个面板。内含模块替代作者的 dsh-seeyon-todo / dsh-skillhub / dsh-vpn，二选一，不可同装。需要致远 OA 账号；VPN 部分仅限 Windows，且需先安装深信服 aTrust 客户端。

description.en: Persona wardrobe for DeepSeek Harness: save multiple personas, apply them globally or per workspace, with a master switch, an adjustable API balance guard, and a lazy token-loving tired mode that speaks on the agent's behalf when quota runs out. Files-as-config, hot reload, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 agent 穿上主人钦定的人设：多套人格随心换，全局或按工作区生效，内置人设库、总开关、余额预警与没电模式（80 句随机话术）。文件即配置、保存即生效、零依赖。

description.en: Translates visible Chinese UI and content in DeepSeek Harness Web, using a browser-local OPUS-MT model for session titles, workspace names, messages, search results, and opted-in plugin prose while keeping remote translation limited to allowlisted UI labels.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中翻译可见的中文界面与内容：会话标题、工作区名称、消息、搜索结果和插件主动标记的正文使用浏览器本地 OPUS-MT，远程翻译仅限白名单界面标签。

description.en: Live preview tab for DSH — embed any dev server in an iframe with transparent SPA proxying.
description.zh: DSH 实时预览标签页：把任意 dev server 嵌入 iframe，透明代理 SPA 路由。

description.en: Replaces the DSH startup screen with an ~18 s anime-style Link Start dive whose check, language, log-in and confirmation scenes show your own DSH status (profile, plugins, default model, workspaces, sessions, UI language). Click or press any key to skip; plays a gentle ~10 s version under reduced motion and lowers effect quality on slow machines. Unofficial fan work.
description.zh: 把 DSH 启动画面换成约 18 秒、动画风格的 Link Start 连线动画，检测、语言、登录和工作区确认几步显示你这台 DSH 的实际状态（profile、插件、默认模型、工作区、会话、界面语言）。点击或按任意键跳过；系统开启减少动态效果时播约 10 秒的平缓版，慢机器上自动降画质。非官方同人作品。

description.en: Adds a sidebar entry that opens a card gallery of all Red Fox Community skills from the redfox-community-dsh plugin.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部加入「红狐 Skills」入口，点击后切换为卡片式技能画廊，集中展示 redfox-community-dsh 插件内的红狐社区技能。

description.en: Colorful sticky notes for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with add, edit, bulk delete, and daily, weekly, monthly or one-time reminders.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏多彩便签，支持增删改、批量删除，以及每天、每周、每月和单次提醒。

description.en: Mobile layer for DSH Web: swipe-gesture drawer sidebar with adjustable width, layered back key, bigger tap targets, Enter inserts a newline instead of sending, keyboard avoidance and a 15px font floor.
description.zh: 手机上的 DSH 界面优化：侧边栏变可滑动抽屉、手势开关侧栏、宽度可调、返回键逐层退出、按钮放大、回车换行而不是直接发送、键盘不挡输入框、字号不小于 15px。

description.en: Like Codex/Claude Code: drag any file or folder (no format limit) onto the DSH web page and its real absolute path is inserted into the composer instantly — no typing paths by hand. Workspace-first smart lookup, size checks, same-name picker, batch and clipboard paste support, Windows/macOS.
description.zh: 像 Codex/Claude 一样：拖入任意格式文件或文件夹，真实绝对路径立即插入输入框，不用一个个打字。工作区优先智能定位、大小校验、同名弹候选选择器，支持批量拖入与粘贴，兼容 Windows/macOS。

description.en: Desktop profile for dsh: native Tauri window over the harness web surface with tray, native notifications, a file-manager panel, and one-click updates.
description.zh: dsh 桌面配置：原生 Tauri 窗口承载 harness Web 界面，支持托盘、原生通知、文件管理器面板与一键更新。

description.en: Collects sidebar footer plugin entries into a collapsible row.
description.zh: 将侧边栏底部的插件入口收纳为可折叠的一行。

description.en: Custom Chinese nicknames for dsh plugins, displayed directly in the native plugin list.
description.zh: 给 dsh 插件列表里的插件自定义中文备注名，直接显示在原生设置页。

description.en: Turns rough notes or images into ready-to-paste English ComfyUI prompts with a Chinese translation and notes, in a workspace side panel. The bundled default system prompt tells the model to drop content restrictions and refusals (override it with config.systemPrompt); image input needs a vision-capable model.
description.zh: 在侧栏面板中把碎片文本或图片整理成可直接粘贴的 ComfyUI 英文提示词，附中文翻译与补充说明。内置默认系统提示词会要求模型取消内容限制与拒答（可用 config.systemPrompt 覆盖）；图片输入需选用支持视觉的模型。

description.en: In-place Markdown editing for the right-sidebar document preview: a file keeps the shipped renderer's look, clicking a paragraph, heading, list, fence, or table cell puts the caret exactly where you clicked, and only the edited range is written back through ctx.fs.writeText, optionally guarded by the version it read.
description.zh: 让右侧栏的 Markdown 预览就地可编辑：文档保持自带渲染器的排版，点段落、标题、列表、代码围栏或表格单元格时光标落在点击处，只有被编辑的那段经 ctx.fs.writeText 写回，并可带上读取时的版本作为护栏。

description.en: Adds a corner card that estimates how much a session spent repeating a failed or empty tool call with the same arguments.
description.zh: 在左下角显示这一场里，失败或空结果之后又用同一组参数重试花了多少钱。

description.en: A left-sidebar gallery of every file the assistant wrote, edited or delivered across all conversations, grouped by file type with preview thumbnails and one-click open. Document previews and the open / open-with / Trash actions require macOS; the gallery, text previews and filters work anywhere.
description.zh: 左侧栏画廊：汇总所有对话里助手写入、修改或交付的文件，按类型分组、显示预览缩略图，点击即可用默认应用打开。文档预览与「用默认应用打开 / 选择应用 / 移到废纸篓」需要 macOS；画廊本身、文本预览与筛选在任何平台可用。

description.en: Four-step WHOOP account connection (you create your own WHOOP developer app and paste its Client ID/Secret) with automatic sync on dashboard visits, plus recovery, strain, sleep and workout charts inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 四步连接 WHOOP 账号（需自行创建 WHOOP 开发者应用并填入 Client ID/Secret），打开看板即自动同步，在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看恢复、负荷、睡眠与训练图表。

description.en: Immersive read-only reading panel for DSH — the model delivers pre-formatted Markdown to a native right-sidebar tab via `reading_pad_send`, with three low-blue-light themes and 30em measure typography; also browse manuscript chapters read-only.
description.zh: DSH 沉浸式只读阅读板：模型用 `reading_pad_send` 把已排版 Markdown 推到原生右侧栏「📖 阅读板」tab，三套低蓝光主题、30em 限宽排版；也可只读浏览当前写作工程的章节。

description.en: Markdown notepad in the right sidebar, side by side with the chat, with a formatting toolbar and local autosave.
description.zh: 右侧栏 Markdown 记事本，与聊天并排，带格式工具栏与本地自动保存。

description.en: Publishes a project plan the agent writes: ordered steps in a panel docked to the right of the frame, and the framework graph as an auto-laid-out diagram in its own centre tab, downloadable as SVG or PNG. Charts are rebuilt from the session log, so they survive restart and resume.
description.zh: 把 agent 写出的项目规划显示出来：有序步骤在窗口右侧停靠的面板里，框架图在单独的中间标签页中自动排版，可下载为 SVG 或 PNG。图表由会话日志重建，重启与恢复后依然保留。

description.en: Select text in assistant replies, add optional comments, and send the annotations with the next message.
description.zh: 在助手回复中选中文字，添加可选评论，并将注释随下一条消息一起发送。

description.en: Live change review for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session, lists changed files above the composer and opens each file's line-level diff in a plugin-registered right-sidebar tab, with session-log / initial-version / Git comparison modes, per-change and per-file revert, subagent aggregation and SSE updates. A fork of cirelir/dsh-change-review rebuilt around the right sidebar.
description.zh: 实时审查插件：追踪会话内 write/edit 工具调用，改动列表常驻输入框上方，点开即在插件自注册的右侧栏标签页里查看行级 diff，支持「会话记录 / 初始版本 / Git 版本」三种对比、单项与整文件撤回、子代理聚合与 SSE 实时刷新，配色可自定义；fork 自 cirelir/dsh-change-review，审查界面整体重构到右侧栏。

description.en: Tick which models appear in the DSH model selector, and fold provider groups in the settings panel.
description.zh: 在设置里逐个勾选要显示的模型，未勾选的从模型选择器菜单中隐藏；provider 分组可在设置面板中折叠。

description.en: Sidebar panel for background local services: start, stop, restart, remove and inspect each task (status, port, PID, uptime, live log). Tasks are described in the plugin config, so any local service can be managed, and removing a task also drops it from that config. In the default attached mode the managed services are stopped when DSH quits, and a chat entry opens a new session with prefilled notes so an agent can add a service.
description.zh: 左侧栏「后台任务」面板：管理需要后台运行的本地服务，一键启动/停止/重启/删除，查看状态、端口、PID、运行时长与实时日志。任务在插件配置里描述，任何本地服务都能接管，删除任务同时把它从配置里移除。默认 attached 模式下 DSH 退出即停服务；另提供对话入口，新会话里预填插件维护说明，由 agent 接手新增服务。

description.en: Adds per-workspace icons and a default session icon to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar. The workspace icon is picked inside the existing rename-workspace dialog; sessions without an IM channel get a default icon drawn with the same title pseudo-element the IM plugin uses, so the two stay aligned, while IM sessions keep their channel logo. Session rows are indented one level under their workspace with a vertical guide line. Icons come from 73 built-in Lucide glyphs, uploaded SVGs, or linked Iconify collections browsed from the official catalog, and follow the theme colors instead of a custom palette.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏添加逐工作区图标与默认会话图标。工作区图标在原有的「重命名工作区」弹窗里选取；没有 IM 渠道的会话显示默认图标，画法与 IM 插件同源的标题伪元素一致、两者对齐，已有渠道 logo 的会话保持原样。会话行相对工作区多缩进一级并带一条竖直引导线。图标来自 73 个内置 Lucide 图标、上传的 SVG，或从官方目录关联的 Iconify 图标库；配色跟随主题，不提供自定义调色。

description.en: Un-clamps the composer stats footer: long turn and token stats lines span the full composer width instead of truncating with an ellipsis.
description.zh: 解除输入框统计行的宽度限制：较长的轮次与 token 统计行横跨输入框全宽居中显示，不再以省略号截断。

description.en: Switches every session's thinking and answers to Chinese — terse, a little wry, plain-spoken — while keeping proper nouns in English, and adds an "answer only what was asked" interaction rule. One global system-prompt section (order 10): no UI, no binaries, no network calls. Inactive under the minimal preset, which replaces the whole prompt with its own persona.
description.zh: 让所有会话的思考与回复都说中文：简洁、略沾文言、说人话，专有名词保留英文原形；并附一条「只答所问、不主动跑命令、动手前先提醒」的交互偏好。实现只是一条全局 system-prompt 段落（order 10）：没有界面、没有二进制、不联网。切到极简预设时不生效——那个预设会把整个 prompt 换成它自己的人设。

description.en: A right-sidebar assistant that knows the main session's finished turns, follows the main agent's running steps and background jobs, and answers in the panel; its model, context budget and answer style are configurable.
description.zh: 侧边栏助手：知道主会话已完成的回合，跟随主 Agent 正在跑的步骤与后台 job，在面板里回答问题；模型、上下文预算与回答风格可配置。

description.en: Folds each DSH Web turn's thinking, tool calls and context into bordered process boxes cut at every piece of model text; a collapsed box shows its latest two items, the stacked lines above its border open that one box, the border itself folds it back, and user dialogue, interactive questions and model text stay outside.
description.zh: 把每轮 DSH Web 会话中的思考、工具调用与上下文折叠进带边框的过程框，在每段模型文本处切开；折叠时每框只显示最新两项，点上边框的堆叠线展开这一个框、再点上边框收回，用户对话、交互式提问与模型文本始终留在框外。

description.en: Floating workspace file-preview window for the Web client: lazy file tree, CodeMirror preview and in-window edit with save, Markdown and image preview, Quick Open search, and opening paths clicked in the conversation.
description.zh: Web 客户端悬浮文件预览窗：懒加载文件树、CodeMirror 预览与窗内编辑保存、Markdown 与图片预览、Quick Open 搜索，以及点击会话中的路径直接打开。

description.en: Turn navigation for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 对话轮次导航。

description.en: CLI-style chat history recall for the DSH input box: press ArrowUp/ArrowDown to recall previously sent messages.
description.zh: 给 DSH 聊天输入框加 CLI 风格历史记忆：按上下方向键召回之前发送过的消息。

description.en: Official-style composer model trigger with a floating reasoning-effort slider popup.
description.zh: 官方风格输入框 + 浮动推理能力滑块弹窗，节点与滑块对齐，弹窗跟随 Harness 主题自适应。

description.en: Automatically opens the right sidebar for blank top-level chats on wide screens, skipping saved layouts containing tabs and leaving non-blank chats unchanged.
description.zh: 在宽屏上为顶层空白会话自动展开右侧栏，跳过包含标签页的已保存布局，不更改非空白会话。

description.en: Four right-Sidebar panels for the dsh web client: artifacts, long-term memory, terminal and notes. They pair two per tab with a draggable split, so two panes show all four at once. The host half ships nine memory_* tools, artifacts_list, the /memory command, and the /api/artifacts/* and /api/terminal-notes/* routes. The terminal runs one bash command per line, with a default 120-second deadline and a stop button. Requires dsh 0.1.5 or newer, and 0.2.
description.zh: 给 dsh web 客户端加四个右侧栏面板：产物浏览、长期记忆、终端、记事本。两两配成一个标签、中间可拖拽分栏，因此两个窗格就能同时看到四个。终端每行执行一条 bash 命令，默认 120 秒期限、可随时终止。宿主侧一并提供 9 个 memory_* 工具、artifacts_list、/memory 命令，以及 /api/artifacts/* 与 /api/terminal-notes/* 路由。需要 dsh 0.1.5 及以上，以及 0.2 系列。

description.en: A prompt optimizer in the composer input tool row: pick a category and a template, then ✨ rewrites the draft in place with one-click undo. Pick from the Basic, Context and Image categories; you can cancel a run, and it shows elapsed time and token usage. Ships 15 templates covering task-instruction rewriting, step planning, safety-research framing, system-prompt role cards, and text-to-image / image-to-image prompts; context templates read the recent turns of the session for coreference resolution. Calls go through the host model service, and a settings section exposes the model and the budgets. Output guards check that user-written constraints survive, warning rather than auto-retrying. Adapted for dsh 0.1.7 and 0.2.
description.zh: 给对话输入框工具行加一个提示词优化器：选类别（基础 / 上下文 / 图像）与模板，点 ✨ 即原地改写草稿，支持一键还原。可取消，并显示耗时与 token 用量。内置 15 个模板，覆盖任务指令改写、需求步骤化规划、逆向/安全研究语境与系统提示词角色卡，以及文生图与图生图提示词。上下文类模板会读取当前会话最近几轮用于消歧。调用走宿主模型服务，设置分区可调模型与各项预算；输出守卫会核对用户明写的约束是否保留，只告警不自动重试。适配 dsh 0.1.7 与 0.2 系列。

description.en: Rotates the model status line through a 53-phrase English/Chinese deep-theme pool: a random pick at turn start, event-driven switching on new thinking segments or tool calls (3s throttle), and a click on the status line toggles the language.
description.zh: 把内置 'Deep diving...' 思考状态行扩展为 53 条 deep 系英/中双语短语池：回合开场随机一条，随新思考段/工具调用事件轮换（最短间隔 3 秒），点击状态行切换中英文。

description.en: Google AI Studio-style floating preview for the Web UI: a draggable/resizable iframe preview with aspect-ratio and resolution presets, plus a VS Code-style code window with direct editing, confirmed writes, and session-log recording.
description.zh: Web UI 悬浮预览与代码窗口：Google AI Studio 风格的 iframe 预览（宽幅比/分辨率预设、一键放大），VS Code 风格代码窗支持直接编辑，保存需确认并写入会话日志。

description.en: Keyboard confirmation for approval cards: the card takes focus when it appears, so Enter allows once and Esc rejects, and those two keys are forwarded through the card handler when focus has moved elsewhere. It never auto-approves and never steals focus from a text field.
description.zh: 审批卡片的键盘确认：卡片出现时自动聚焦，按 Enter 允许一次、按 Esc 拒绝；焦点离开卡片后这两个键仍会转交给卡片处理。不会自动批准，也不会抢输入框的焦点。

description.en: Read-only GitHub profile page inside DSH — repo cards with language and stars, plus a one-year contribution heatmap.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏里看 GitHub 档案：仓库卡（语言与星标）与一年贡献热力图，只读公开信息。

description.en: Bottom-left floating panel that uploads and switches your own background images, with scrim and blur sliders and three bundled wallpapers.
description.zh: 左下角浮窗，上传并切换自定义背景图片，带遮罩与模糊滑块，内置三张壁纸。

description.en: Right-click menu for links and file references in DSH messages: open with the default app or a chosen app, reveal in the file manager, copy the path, name or text content, or save a copy.
description.zh: 在 DSH 消息里右键链接或文件引用，弹出类似 ChatGPT 的菜单：默认打开方式、打开方式…、在文件管理器中打开、复制文件地址、复制文件名、复制文件内容、另存为…

description.en: VS Code style 44px icon rails for the side panels DSH collapses: the left rail keeps the sidebar navigation and the bottom action rows, the right rail lists the sidebarRightTabs ledger so third-party tabs appear on their own, and the right panel is drag-resizable between 300px and 60% of the window. Two switches under Settings → Activity Bar, saved in this browser.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 收起后的两侧栏变成 VS Code 那样的 44px 图标条：左条接管侧边栏导航与底部动作行，右条按 sidebarRightTabs 清单自动列出第三方面板，右侧面板可拖动改宽（300px 至窗口 60%）。设置里的「活动栏」两个开关，按浏览器保存。

description.en: Adds a Chinese end-of-line comment to every line of code shown in a DSH tool card - grey for the call being made, blue arrows for code in the output - written instantly by a local rule set and, for lines the rules cannot judge, by the current session model; a header toggle returns the block to plain code, and credentials are masked before anything is sent or cached.
description.zh: 在 DSH 工具卡的代码块上给每一行加中文行尾注释：输入侧是灰色「//」，输出侧的代码用蓝色箭头，规则能判的行即时给出、判不出的行用当前会话的模型补一版；顶部「注释：开/关」可关回纯代码，内容在发给模型与落盘前先做凭据掩码。

description.en: Clean and simple TUI.
description.zh: 干净简单的终端交互式界面。

description.en: Scan a QR code with WeChat, upload a photo from the phone, and use it as the DSH Web UI background.
description.zh: 手机微信扫码，从相册传一张照片，换成 DSH 的全屏背景。

description.en: Collapses the sidebar global-panel rows to a few visible entries and adds a picker for choosing which ones stay, so a long panel list stops squeezing the workspace and session area; rows are hidden only, never unregistered.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的全局面板条目折叠成少量可见行，并提供勾选面板决定留哪几个，条目一多时不再挤压工作区与会话区；只隐藏显示，不注销条目。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop-style selection quoting: select text in a conversation to reply to that passage from a popover, or fork the session into a side chat in the right sidebar with the selection quoted. Quotes sit above the composer as removable cards, are sent as plain Markdown blockquotes in the same format as Claude Code Desktop, and render as clamped quote blocks in sent messages.
description.zh: Claude Code Desktop 风格的选区引用：在对话里选中文字，可在弹窗里针对这段话回复，或把当前会话 fork 成右侧栏的侧边对话并带上引用。引用以可移除的卡片放在输入框上方，按与 Claude Code Desktop 相同的格式作为纯 Markdown 引用块发送，已发送消息里显示为可折叠的引用块。

description.en: DSH审批汉化 — approval dialogs translated to Chinese before they render: DeepSeek-powered, host-side, nothing for React to revert.
description.zh: DSH审批汉化 — 审批弹窗在渲染前自动翻译成中文：DeepSeek 驱动、宿主侧完成，React 重渲染也无法还原。

description.en: Installer entry for the dsh-xswt-tauriapp desktop shell, a Tauri desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness: on the first dsh start after installation it downloads this platform's installer from the release, checks it against the release SHA256SUMS before writing it, and opens it with the system installer. It installs nothing itself and adds no UI to dsh.
description.zh: 桌面外壳 dsh-xswt-tauriapp（一个 Tauri 写的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面壳）的安装引导：安装后首次启动 dsh 时，从发布页下载本平台安装包，先比对 SHA256SUMS、校验通过才落盘，再交给系统安装器打开；插件自己不安装任何东西，也不给 dsh 加界面。

description.en: Reasoning-effort slider that replaces the composer model seat: one rail over the levels the current model declares (off/low/high/max on DeepSeek), with a 241-frame portrait that evolves frame by frame as you drag and a per-model choice that survives restarts. Uninstall restores the shipped picker.
description.zh: 替换输入框模型座位的推理档位滑杆：一根滑杆覆盖当前模型声明的档位（DeepSeek 为 off/low/high/max），拖动时 241 帧人像逐帧演变，按模型记忆所选档位且重启保留，卸载即恢复官方选择器。

description.en: Read-only terminal view tab in the conversation header: aggregates bash output, background jobs and persistent terminal sessions from the current session, subagents and Agent Team teammates into one filterable panel, with type and session-scope filters, command/output search, auto-collapse, follow-scroll and a maximize dialog; foreground bash shows final output only. Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 or later (0.2.x).
description.zh: 会话头部只读的「终端」视图标签页：把当前会话、子代理与 Agent Team 队友的 bash 输出、后台任务和持久终端会话聚合为一个可筛选面板，支持类型与会话范围筛选、命令与输出搜索、自动收起、跟随滚动与最大化只读弹窗；前台 bash 仅显示终态输出。需 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 及以上（0.2.x）。

description.en: Snipaste-style screenshot for DeepSeek Harness: press F1 (a real Windows global hotkey) to freeze and dim the whole screen, drag a region, then draw red boxes and click-to-type text annotations with wheel-resizable font; the annotated PNG drops into the composer at native resolution. Esc exits. Windows 10/11.
description.zh: Snipaste 式截图标注：F1 全局热键把整块屏幕定格压暗，鼠标框选后用红色方框与文字标注（点位置输入、滚轮调字号），确认后按原分辨率把标注图放进输入框；Esc 退出。仅 Windows 10/11。

description.en: A stock market panel for DeepSeek Harness, forked from dsh-xueqiu: A-share/HK/US quotes, K-line and intraday charts, hot lists, search and 7x24 news, plus local holdings with live-computed P&L, host-side price alerts, and a hide switch that unmounts the panel and stops market polling while alerts still fire. Replaces dsh-xueqiu; do not install both.
description.zh: 行情面板（dsh-xueqiu 的衍生版本）：免登录查看 A股/港美股行情、K线/分时、热榜、搜索与 7×24 快讯，并支持本地持仓与按行情现算的盈亏、宿主侧价格提醒，以及一键「行情隐身」——面板卸载、行情请求停发，提醒照常。替代 dsh-xueqiu，请勿与它同时安装。

description.en: Shows an elapsed/budget progress bar with a moving head picture under blocking tool calls in the DSH Web conversation flow, and adds a graphical settings page for its style and tool list.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话流的阻塞型工具调用下方显示「已等待/预算」进度条与随进度移动的图片（可换成动图），并提供图形化设置页调整样式与工具列表。

description.en: Image-to-LaTeX formula editor: point it at any OpenAI-compatible vision model and a dropped or pasted screenshot is read into LaTeX, a MathLive field edits the formula in place with a 272-symbol palette, and the result copies into Word as a native equation or exports to .docx. Needs baseURL, model and an API key set in its settings before it works: there is no default endpoint, so the screenshot and the key only go where you point them.
description.zh: 图片转 LaTeX 的公式编辑器：指向任意 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型，拖入或粘贴的截图就读成 LaTeX，MathLive 公式域可就地修改并提供 272 个符号的面板，结果可复制为 Word 原生公式或导出 .docx。需要先在设置里填好 baseURL、model 和 API Key 才能用：插件没有默认接口，截图和 Key 只发往你填的地址。

description.en: Windows-only stealth lyrics readout: reads the desktop Netease Cloud Music client through Windows SMTC (song, artist, play state), fetches its LRC and translation from the public Netease API, and renders the currently sung line directly beside the DSH activity line ("深度求索中，用时 X s") with font, size and color cloned from that line via computed style, so it reads as one longer sentence. The stopwatch-based progress freezes on pause and resets on track change; lyrics hide entirely when no activity line exists; an anchorText config retargets non-Chinese hosts; 1.0.5+ fails over between two Netease search endpoints when rate-limited. Needs the Netease "SMTC" toggle enabled.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 的摸鱼歌词插件：通过 Windows SMTC 读取桌面网易云音乐客户端的歌名、歌手与播放状态，从网易云公开接口拉取 LRC 与翻译，并把当前演唱的那句歌词直接渲染在 DSH 状态行（"深度求索中，用时 X 秒"）右侧，字体、字号、颜色经 computed style 从状态行实时克隆，看起来只是那句话变长了。进度由宿主秒表推算，暂停停表、切歌归零；状态行不在时歌词整体隐藏；anchorText 配置可适配非中文界面；1.0.5 起搜索被限流时自动切换备用端点。需在网易云设置中开启"开启SMTC"开关。

description.en: Expands the assistant reasoning block while it streams and folds it back when done, animated in both directions; the sidebar switch only controls whether that happens automatically.
description.zh: 思考时自动展开、结束时自动折叠，展开与收起都带高度与透明度过渡；侧边栏开关只控制是否自动，动画始终生效。

description.en: DSH design-delivery plugin with 10 tools for UI lint, design tokens, three-candidate shortlists, JND parameter probes, and PPTX deck check/export/render. Deck tools need ppt-master, Python with python-pptx and DSH's LibreOffice Kit; design_capture needs a real browser.
description.zh: DSH 设计交付插件：10 个工具覆盖界面审查、设计 tokens、三方向粗选、JND 参数精调，以及 PPTX 质检/导出/渲染。deck 工具依赖 ppt-master、带 python-pptx 的 Python 与 DSH 自带的 LibreOffice Kit；design_capture 需要真实浏览器。

description.en: Copying rendered math from the chat puts the formula's LaTeX source on the clipboard instead of KaTeX's visual glyph text.
description.zh: 在对话中复制渲染后的数学公式时，剪贴板里得到的是公式的 LaTeX 源码，而不是 KaTeX 的字形文本。

description.en: Select text in the chat to quote it into the composer as an annotation, or to ask about it in a throwaway side panel that leaves no record.
description.zh: 在对话里划词引用进输入框（显示为「N 条注释」小框），或在侧栏一次性小窗里就这段内容提问（不留任何记录）。

description.en: Adds buttons to open the current DSH workspace root in the host file manager.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题和工作区菜单中添加按钮，用系统文件管理器打开当前 Workspace 根目录。

description.en: Native desktop pet for DSH that follows agent activity, supports Codex pet packages, and imports approved pets directly from Petdex without its CLI.
description.zh: 跟随 agent 状态的 DSH 原生桌宠，兼容 Codex 桌宠包，并可在插件内直接从 Petdex 导入已审核桌宠，无需 Petdex CLI。

description.en: Turns the DSH Web UI into a macOS-style desktop with the chat parked behind it: Sonoma wallpaper, menu bar, magnifying Dock, F4 Launchpad, ⌘Space Spotlight, Control Centre, clock/calendar widgets, F3 Mission Control and a desktop orb that floats the native conversation back up. Finder, Terminal (a /bin/bash session) and Settings ship with the plugin; the Browser, Code, Office and Notes windows are unlocked by separate companion plugins (dsh-ego-browser, dsh-code-workbench, dsh-univer-office, dsh-obsidian-notes) and show a placeholder until installed, and the Browser window also launches a headless Chromium (found under /usr/bin, or set DSH_MACOS_CHROME). The agent can drive the desktop through /api/macos-desktop/* routes and window.__macos.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 Web 界面变成 macOS 风格桌面，并把对话藏到桌面后面：Sonoma 壁纸、菜单栏、可放大的程序坞、F4 启动台、⌘Space 聚焦搜索、控制中心、时钟/日历小组件、F3 调度中心，以及一颗能把原生对话浮出来的桌面悬浮球。访达、终端（/bin/bash 会话）、设置随插件自带；浏览器、代码、Office、笔记四个窗口由另装的配套插件解锁（dsh-ego-browser、dsh-code-workbench、dsh-univer-office、dsh-obsidian-notes），未安装时显示占位窗口；浏览器窗口另会以无头方式启动本机 Chromium（默认在 /usr/bin 下查找，或设置 DSH_MACOS_CHROME）。agent 可通过 /api/macos-desktop/* 路由与页面内 window.__macos 操作整个桌面。

description.en: Split-screen panel for the Web UI: draggable panes, each rendering one Session's real conversation, with unread dots and a layout saved per browser.
description.zh: 网页端分屏面板：可拖拽的窗格，每个窗格渲染一个会话的完整对话；窗格标题带未读点，布局按浏览器保存。

description.en: Turns each produced-file chip into a per-file menu: open the file, copy its path, reveal it in the native file browser, or open a terminal cd-ed into its directory.
description.zh: 把每个产物文件卡片变成按文件操作的下拉菜单：打开文件、拷贝路径、在系统文件浏览器中定位，或打开终端并进入其目录。

description.en: Adds a configurable bubble behind assistant replies, with an optional liquid-glass material and matching chrome for process, tool-call and reasoning rows.
description.zh: 给助手回复加一层可调节的气泡底，可选液态玻璃材质，并让过程、工具调用与思考等周边行同步。

description.en: Floating workspace file-tree browser for the Web GUI with line-numbered syntax highlighting and Markdown preview.
description.zh: 悬浮工作区文件树浏览器：带行号的代码语法高亮与 Markdown 富文本预览。

description.en: Renders mermaid code blocks in the chat as diagrams in place (flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, pie), with zoom, source toggle, copy PNG and SVG download.
description.zh: 将聊天中的 mermaid 代码块原位渲染为图表（流程图/时序图/类图/状态图/ER图/甘特图/饼图），支持放大、源码切换、复制 PNG 与下载 SVG。

description.en: Adds prompt optimization, cancellation, and undo controls to the DeepSeek Harness composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话输入框提供提示词优化：优化过程中可取消，完成后可一键撤回。

description.en: Codex-style session archiving: hovering a sidebar conversation row reveals an Archive icon at the far right; one click archives the session via the official workspace archive API.
description.zh: Codex 风格会话归档：鼠标悬浮侧边栏会话行时，最右侧浮现 Archive 图标，一键归档会话。

description.en: Whale tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a Windows system-tray app and a macOS menu-bar app that start/stop the dsh service, summon the Web UI, restart and top up — running independently of the dsh process, like a Steam launcher for dsh.
description.zh: 大肥鱼 —— DeepSeek Harness 的托盘 / 菜单栏启动器：Windows 右下角托盘 + macOS 右上角菜单栏，一键开关 dsh 服务、唤起 Web、重启、充值，独立于 dsh 进程运行，类似 Steam 之于游戏。

description.en: Right-sidebar file-preview enhancement built on `dsh-better-sidebar` (required — without it the plugin stays inert): a floating find bar for any text file (Ctrl+F, literal or regex, case-sensitive, match counter, next/previous) plus a collapsible Structure panel that lists classes, methods and file-level variables for Java, JavaScript, TypeScript and Python and an element outline for HTML (including .vue/.svelte), with click-to-line jumps. Read-only, no separate tab.
description.zh: 基于 `dsh-better-sidebar` 的右栏文件预览增强（必须先装它，否则插件静默不生效）：为任意文本文件提供漂浮查找条（Ctrl+F，字面量或正则、区分大小写、命中计数、上一个/下一个），并在代码右侧提供可折叠的「结构」面板——Java、JavaScript、TypeScript、Python 列出类/方法/文件级变量，HTML（含 .vue/.svelte）给元素大纲，点条目跳到对应行。只读，不注册独立页签。

description.en: Fork of dsh-effort-slider that splits the composer model seat into two buttons: the model name opens the model list, the effort label opens the Claude-style slider with WebGL fire.
description.zh: dsh-effort-slider 的修改版：把输入框的模型座位拆成两个按钮——点模型名打开模型列表，点推理等级打开带 WebGL 火焰的滑块面板。

description.en: Folds long composer drafts into a compact summary card once a character threshold is reached, without changing message submission.
description.zh: 输入草稿超过阈值后自动折叠为摘要卡，不改变消息提交路径。

description.en: Task details sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: a "View task details" button under every finished turn opens a resizable right-sidebar panel showing that task's input files, intermediate artifacts, output files, tools and skills used, inferred languages, a step-by-step flow timeline, and the model provider with token usage and cache hit rate.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务详情侧边栏：每个已结束任务的最下方显示「查看任务详情」，点开后从右侧边栏打开可拖拽调宽的面板，列出该任务的输入文件、中间产物、输出文件、所用工具与 skill、推断出的语言、按步骤组织的流程时间线，以及模型提供方与 Token 用量、缓存命中率。

description.en: Fudan · Desktop: DeepSeek quota and campus-weather status bar, six curated campus wallpapers, and a fully local 知行台 schedule/knowledge workspace with a Fudan editorial UI and week-by-week review.
description.zh: 复旦 · 桌面：DeepSeek 额度与校园天气状态栏、六张精选校园壁纸，以及带复旦编辑感界面、支持按周回顾的本地知行台日程 / 知识工作台。

description.en: Read-only clinic for DSH session logs: 22 named diagnostics (token waste, retry and failure loops, context bloat, cross-session amnesia, idle MCP servers and skills), each reported with a replayable evidence locator such as session.v4.jsonl.zstd#L101-L110, and each finding turned into an executable prescription — a profile-patch YAML snippet or a command with current to suggested values, risk, verification and source — plus a feedback command that retires a prescription you reject, after which the report states it was removed by your feedback. Zero dependencies, default zero egress, session files are never written.
description.zh: DSH 会话日志的只读体检诊所：22 项具名诊断（token 浪费、重试与失败循环、上下文膨胀、跨会话失忆、闲置的 MCP 服务器与 skill 等），每条都附可复核的证据定位符（如 session.v4.jsonl.zstd#L101-L110）；每个问题给一条可执行处方（profile patch 片段或命令，含当前值到建议值、风险与验证方式），并支持标记「已拒绝」让该处方不再出现（报告会写明是你撤掉的）。零依赖、默认零外发、会话文件只读。

description.en: Inline Command Code plan usage badge in the DSH composer toolbar beside the model selector: 5h and weekly window usage plus remaining credits, clicking the badge opens an upward detail popover with reset countdowns; reuses the commandcode/report remote from @mars-sea/dsh-commandcode-provider.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入栏（模型选择器旁）内联显示 Command Code 套餐用量：5 小时与周窗口已用百分比及剩余 credits，点击徽章弹出向上的详情浮层并含重置倒计时；复用 @mars-sea/dsh-commandcode-provider 的 commandcode/report 远端数据。

description.en: A right-side session stats panel showing average cache-hit rate, session cost, runtime, request count, cumulative tokens and account balance.
description.zh: 右侧会话统计面板，展示平均缓存命中率、会话成本、运行时长、请求数、累计 token 与账户余额。

description.en: Local-only, read-only DSH token dashboard: provider-reported usage across all backends, all-time totals, a 365-day heatmap, input+output and cache read/write details, turn/step counts, average tok/s, and durable history after sessions are archived.
description.zh: 仅本地、只读、不上传的 DSH Token 面板：按 provider 实际 usage 统计，所有后端统一汇总；含历史总量、365 天热力图、输入+输出与缓存读写明细、轮次/步骤、平均 tok/s，归档后仍保留历史。

description.en: Token usage statistics panel for DeepSeek Harness: usage trends, model breakdown and activity heatmap, hand-written SVG, zero chart libraries.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量统计面板：用量趋势、模型用量与活跃热力图，手写 SVG，零图表库依赖。

description.en: Floating HUD for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: live session token speed, input/output/total token counts and cache hit rate, DeepSeek account balance, and per-model cost estimates in a draggable, resizable panel.
description.zh: 浮在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面上的 HUD：实时显示会话 Token 速度、输入/输出/总量与缓存命中率、DeepSeek 账户余额，以及按模型估算的费用；面板可拖动、可缩放。

description.en: A Usage page in DSH settings that folds every model call into a local ledger and reports requests, tokens, and estimated cost by day, route, and model, with editable unit prices and CSV export.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里加一页「用量查询」：把每次模型调用记进本地账本，按天、接口、模型汇总请求数、Token 与费用估算，支持单价修改与 CSV 导出。

description.en: Token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness. A dedicated settings page shows cumulative input / output / cache-read / cache-write token totals, a green GitHub-style daily heatmap colored by usage, and a pie / bar chart toggle for per-model (provider/model) usage shares — all read from local session logs, no upstream API calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量看板。在设置页单开一页：累计输入 / 输出 / 缓存读 / 缓存写四大桶总量、按天绿色热力网格（颜色随用量加深），以及饼图 / 柱状图一键切换展示各模型（provider/model）的用量占比；数据全部来自本地会话日志，不调上游 API。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek API balance and local DSH Flash and Pro usage costs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中查看 DeepSeek API 余额及本机 Flash 和 Pro 消费统计。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and model cost tracking with official peak/off-peak pricing, three-tier token billing (cache miss, cache hit, output), per-model and per-session breakdowns, a composer summary bar with hover details, CSV export, and a settings panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek 账户余额与模型消耗：官方价格表分高峰/空闲时段计价，三档计费口径（缓存未命中/命中/输出），按模型与会话统计，主页摘要条悬停明细，支持导出 CSV 与重置记录。

description.en: Per-turn and session-wide LLM cost metering: a dollar cost line under each message, a session cumulative total with hover breakdown, and an LLM+web price auto-refresh tool.
description.zh: 按轮次与会话统计 LLM 成本：每条消息下方显示美元成本、会话累计总额（悬停看分项），以及 LLM+联网的价格自动刷新工具。

description.en: Monitors multi-provider balances, DeepSeek peak/off-peak usage costs, per-session analytics, and configurable spending limits in the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏监控多个平台的余额，统计 DeepSeek 峰谷用量成本与会话消耗，并支持配置消费上限。

description.en: Local usage ledger that reads this machine's session logs and reports per-day, per-model and per-workspace token consumption, cache hit rate, tool-vs-chat split and estimated cost, with an in-app editor for per-model prices.
description.zh: 本地用量账本：从本机会话日志统计每日、每模型、每工作区的 token 消耗、缓存命中率、工具请求占比与估算费用，并提供按模型编辑单价的设置面板。

description.en: Token usage and cost tracking with daily/session budget alerts and a usage_report tool.
description.zh: Token 用量与成本统计：日/会话预算告警 + usage_report 工具。

description.en: Tokenrhythm billing center for DeepSeek Harness: account balance and expiring quota, model price cards, a 30-day usage heat calendar, connectivity checks and platform API-key management, with credentials kept on the local host. A single-channel fork of 162568316/dsh-tokenrhythm-bill; the package name, Cordis id and route prefix all differ, so the two can be installed side by side.
description.zh: 基元律动费用中心：账户余额与限时额度、模型价格卡、近 30 天用量热力日历、连通检测与平台密钥管理，凭据只存本机 host。单渠道 fork 自 162568316/dsh-tokenrhythm-bill；包名、Cordis id 与路由前缀都与上游不同，可与上游同时安装。

description.en: 余额显示quota-balance — shows the DeepSeek account balance at the left of the composer status row; clicking it opens a panel with the normal and bonus wallet split, the refresh time and a top-up link. The chip and panel read the host surface tokens, so they follow the dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine glass settings, theme and wallpaper changes.
description.zh: 余额显示quota-balance：在输入框下方的用量行最左侧显示账户余额，点开可查看普通余额与赠送额度的分项、更新时间，并可跳转充值；徽标与浮层读取宿主表面 token，可跟随 dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine 的玻璃参数、明暗主题与壁纸切换。

description.en: Session cost chip in the DeepSeek Harness conversation header showing live token usage by bucket, peak/off-peak tariff pricing, and a countdown to the next tariff switch.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话标题栏显示会话费用芯片：实时分桶 Token 用量、高峰/非高峰费率，以及到下次费率切换的倒计时。

description.en: Floating API-balance badge for DeepSeek Harness: live balance for DeepSeek, Moonshot, OpenAI and custom endpoints; draggable, resizable, frosted-glass look, with text color adapting to the content beneath.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 悬浮 API 余额徽章：实时显示 DeepSeek / Moonshot / OpenAI / 自定义接口余额；可拖动缩放、亚克力质感、文字颜色随下方内容明暗自适应。

description.en: Sidebar badge and panel showing the balance, daily spend and remaining runway of a New API relay, with a top-up link.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏显示 New API 中转站的余额、日均消耗与剩余可用天数，并提供充值入口。

description.en: Counts token usage for one selected project per machine, syncs the totals to a self-hosted team server, and shows each member's project, spend and last active time in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 每台机器只统计选定的那一个项目的 Token 用量并汇总到自建团队服务器，在侧栏面板中逐人显示所选项目、花费与最后消耗时间。

description.en: A draggable Volcengine Coding Plan usage card for DeepSeek Harness Web using a local console session.
description.zh: 一个使用本地控制台登录态、可拖动的 DeepSeek Harness Web 火山引擎 Coding Plan 用量卡片。

description.en: Shows the live DeepSeek account balance in the composer toolbar and prices each completed turn in CNY beside its token usage, using the official peak/off-peak table: peak on Beijing-time weekday mornings and afternoons, valley on weekends and statutory holidays. The balance needs a DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential; accounts signed in through DeepSeek OAuth show no chip.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在每轮完成对话的 token 用量旁显示按官方峰谷价计费的人民币金额：北京时间工作日上下午为高峰价，周末与法定节假日为空闲价。余额需要 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 凭据，仅通过 DeepSeek OAuth 登录的账号不显示余额。

description.en: Keeps a pricing-period badge in the sidebar footer of the Web UI. It shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently in an off-peak or peak period, plus how long until the next switch. Click it to open the rules, the price table currently in force, and the balance of the signed-in DeepSeek account.
description.zh: 在 Web 界面侧栏底部常驻一个价格时段标记，显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于 空闲时段还是高峰时段、距下次切换还有多久；点开是规则说明、当前生效的价目表，以及已登录 DeepSeek 账户的余额。

description.en: Agent billing and usage observability for dsh web: session-log direct-scan recording (zstd, per-event timestamps, watermark + lastSeq double dedup), multi-account rate profiles per provider and model, per-window live badge reading the window session id via React fiber, full glassmorphism dashboard with 14-day sparkline, budget alerts, relay-station balance queries and a 332-model official price library.
description.zh: dsh web 的 Agent 计费与用量可观测：会话日志直扫记账（zstd 解压、逐事件时间戳入账、水位+lastSeq 双防双计）、多账号按 provider/模型费率档案、per-window 实时徽标（React fiber 读窗口会话 id，切会话即切账单）、玻璃拟态面板（14 天趋势/预算告警/中转站余额/332 模型官方价库）。

description.en: Auto-detect the current model vendor (7 built-in) and show its balance or quota in the composer input row, with custom endpoints for unsupported vendors.
description.zh: 自动识别当前模型厂商（内置 7 家），在输入框内显示余额或配额，未内置厂商可配置自定义接口。

description.en: Inventory of the MCP servers, skills and hooks a DSH profile has, plus a conversation tab reporting every tool, skill and MCP server a session actually called.
description.zh: 汇总本机已配置的 MCP 服务、SKILL 与 HOOK 清单，并在会话顶部新增一个页签，展示该会话实际调用过的每个工具、技能与 MCP 服务。

description.en: Per-step context ledger for dsh: measures what every step actually re-sends, then offers three opt-in gates — a schema-budgeted tool table, long-tail result externalization, and duplicate-read pointers. In the author's A/B test the tool-table gate cut 16,110 first-step prompt tokens (-49.7%), about -23% of per-step context on long sessions. v0.3.1 adds a read-only /budget-doctor self-check, spill index maintenance and a growth forecast.
description.zh: 每步上下文账本：量化每步重发量，并提供三个可单独开关的闸门——按 schema 体积裁工具表、长结果外置、重复读回指针。 作者 A/B 实测，工具表闸门省首步 16,110 token（-49.7%），长会话每步上下文约降 23%。 v0.3.1 新增只读 /budget-doctor 自检、spill 索引维护与增速预测。

description.en: Token usage heatmap for the Web UI: daily/weekly/cumulative views over a 12-month window with light/dark themes.
description.zh: Token 用量热力图：日/周/累计视图，12 个月窗口，支持深浅色主题。

description.en: Per-session token, cost and wall-clock budgets that stop the model session at the limit, plus a DeepSeek peak and off-peak schedule.
description.zh: 按会话限制 token、金额与时长并在到达上限时停止模型会话，另外带 DeepSeek 峰谷时段的暂停与自动恢复。

description.en: Enhanced derivative of ai-shushu/dsh-quota-meter; cannot be installed alongside it (both serve /quota). Per-session spend and quota meter for DSH: bills real token usage against an editable model price table (including peak/off-peak pricing), shows a live progress bar and, in the session header, a balance capsule (the balance needs a DeepSeek API key), and blocks new model calls when a session budget runs out. Subagent and helper-call spending rolls up into the parent session ledger.
description.zh: ai-shushu/dsh-quota-meter 的增强衍生版，不能与上游同装（都占用 /quota 路由）。DSH 的会话额度与花费监控：按可编辑的模型价目表（含峰谷价）对真实 token 用量记账，输入框上方显示消耗进度条、会话头部右侧显示余额胶囊（余额需 DeepSeek API Key），额度耗尽时拦截新的模型调用；子代理与辅助调用的消耗并入父会话账本。

description.en: Configurable VS Code style keyboard shortcuts for the DSH web GUI, with a settings-page keybinding editor, conflict detection and JSON import/export.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供可配置的 VS Code 风格键盘快捷键，内置设置页改键、冲突检测与 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Compact DSH wallet panel for any Sub2API-compatible third-party balance site. Uses /v1/usage with a long-lived API Key, auto-discovers configured providers, and shows balance plus daily usage.
description.zh: 通用 Sub2API 第三方余额面板：使用 /v1/usage 和长期 API Key，自动发现 DSH provider，显示余额及今日用量。

description.en: Live per-task token cost widget: peak/valley pricing windows, projected post-hike costs, sortable per-task cost table, multi-currency (COP/USD/CNY + ~40 more) with FX rates, and one-click streamed LLM explain of expensive tasks.
description.zh: 实时按任务追踪 token 成本的小部件：高峰/低谷定价时段、涨价后预测成本、可排序的每任务成本表、多币种（默认 COP/USD/CNY，另有 40 余种）与汇率，以及一键流式解释高成本任务。

description.en: Live remaining balance for the current API key from Sub2API, New API, or official DeepSeek, plus actual spend when the site publishes it, not a local token estimate.
description.zh: 读取当前 API key 在 Sub2API、New API 或 DeepSeek 官方账本上的剩余额度；站点公布实扣时才显示实扣，不是本地 token 估算。

description.en: Delegates mechanical text work (translate, summarize, extract, classify, rewrite) to an Ollama-native or OpenAI-compatible endpoint by file path, so the source text never enters the main model's context. Registers local_transform, local_batch and local_health; per-workspace local-AI levels (none/light/default/high/max) add a local_worker subagent and a plan-only mode; an opt-in SlaveAgentTeams switch discovers mounted model routes, runs parallel child agents with node-level failover, and registers the endpoint chain as llm-pi-ai routes. Configured from the Web GUI; requires a reachable endpoint.
description.zh: 把机械性文本工作（翻译、摘要、抽取、分类、改写）按文件路径交给 Ollama 原生或 OpenAI 兼容端点，正文不进入主模型上下文。注册 local_transform、local_batch、local_health；按项目工作区设置本地 AI 介入程度（无/轻度/默认/更高/最高），高等级下新增 local_worker 子 agent 与「只规划」模式；可选的 SlaveAgentTeams 开关会探测已挂载的模型路由、并行运行子 agent 并在节点失败时切换，同时把端点链注册为 llm-pi-ai 路由。配置在 Web GUI 内完成；需要可达的模型端点。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek account balance and today's token usage in the sidebar footer, and reconciles locally estimated spend against the balance the account actually lost over the days it has sampled.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与今日 token 用量，并把本地估算的花费与账户余额实际减少量按采样覆盖的时长对账。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API-key balance as one ambient stat in the Harness composer row, refreshed every 60 seconds. Click the balance to set a local low-balance threshold; the amount turns red below it. The API key stays in the host and is only sent to api.deepseek.com/user/balance.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方的统计行里显示 DeepSeek API 余额，每 60 秒自动刷新；点击余额可设置本地低余额阈值，低于阈值时金额变红。API Key 只留在本机 Host，仅用于请求 api.deepseek.com/user/balance。

description.en: Manage multiple API keys per provider in Settings → API 密钥: keep a pool of keys with notes, switch the active key with one click, and the switch really takes effect on the next model call.
description.zh: 在设置 → API 密钥中为每个提供商管理多个 API 密钥：密钥池加备注、一键切换当前使用密钥，切换后下一次模型调用立即生效。

description.en: Buckets every model call by local date, provider and model, then shows the totals in a sidebar card, a per-chat pill under the composer and a settings page, alongside each provider's account balance and subscription windows.
description.zh: 把每次模型调用按本地日期、供应商与模型记账，在侧栏卡片、输入框下方的单会话胶囊和设置页里展示用量合计，并同列展示各供应商的账户余额与套餐窗口。

description.en: Composer pill with the DeepSeek account balance, the live peak/off-peak pricing phase, and this session's spend priced request by request at the rate in effect when each request was sent. Subagent sessions' costs are aggregated into the parent session; Search and Fetch fees are charged only for DeepSeek's search engine, while third-party engines (Tavily, Bing, Exa, …) are counted but free. The balance refresh interval is configurable.
description.zh: 输入框下方的余额胶囊：显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、实时峰谷时段，以及本会话花费——每条请求都按发出时刻生效的峰谷单价计价，子智能体会话的花费汇总进父会话；Search 与 Fetch 只对 DeepSeek 搜索引擎计费，Tavily、Bing、Exa 等第三方引擎只计数不计费；余额刷新间隔可在插件设置页调整。

description.en: Per-channel credit balances for the Our Free Model gateway in the DSH sidebar: one always-on card covering the channels the gateway supports (unconfigured channels stay hidden), collapsed to the channel the current conversation uses, expanded to one row per channel with a bar and remaining amount, with per-channel visibility toggles on the plugin detail page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏显示 Our Free Model 网关各渠道的剩余额度：一张常驻卡片覆盖网关支持的渠道（未配置的默认隐藏），折叠时显示当前对话所用渠道及其剩余百分比，展开后每个渠道一行含进度条与余量，并可在插件详情页按渠道开关显示。

description.en: Account-level DeepSeek platform usage inside the DSH settings page — 52-week token heatmap, per-API-key and per-model breakdown, live balance.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页查看 DeepSeek 开放平台的账号级用量：52 周热力图、按 API Key 与模型的拆分、实时余额。

description.en: Scheduled daily credit check-in for Trae CN, WorkBuddy, Qoder and MiniMax Code with per-platform toggles and history. Currently verified on macOS with DSH Desktop 0.12.1.
description.zh: 每天定时为 Trae CN、WorkBuddy、Qoder、MiniMax Code 领取每日积分，支持平台开关与签到记录。目前在 macOS 的 DSH Desktop 0.12.1 上验证。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance + per-call cost tracker: durable per-call cost ledger from real usage chunks with official Beijing peak/off-peak (x2) pricing, 60 s balance polling, and a sidebar footer action showing balance and today's spend.
description.zh: DeepSeek 余额与逐次调用成本追踪：基于真实 usage 的持久化成本账本，支持官方高峰/低谷定价（北京时间 ×2），60 秒余额轮询，侧栏底部显示余额与今日消耗。

description.en: Lists every system-prompt section, context block and tool schema assembled for a session with per-item token estimates, and lets you rewrite sections or hide tools for that session.
description.zh: 逐条列出为某个会话装配的系统提示词分段、上下文块与工具 schema，并给出各自的 token 估算；可就地改写分段文本或隐藏工具，改动只对该会话之后生效。

description.en: Agent-tree token budget management.
description.zh: agent 树 token 预算管理。

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription, model allowance, usage meter, and per-million-token rate panel for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏中的 OpenCode Go 面板：订阅、模型额度、用量计量与按每百万 token 计的费率。

description.en: Peak/off-peak billing cost dial for the DSH Web GUI: session token usage billed at the official DeepSeek peak and off-peak rates, a rate dial with a model-colored needle and switch countdown, a balance ring with a low-balance alarm, drag-to-resize, and a minimized status-lamp mode.
description.zh: 峰谷计费表盘：DSH Web 浮动窗按 DeepSeek 官方峰谷（高峰/空闲）费率对会话花费（token 费用）实时计费，指针配费率切换倒计时，余额环带低余额报警，支持拖拽缩放与最小化状态灯。

description.en: Local Token usage dashboard in DSH Settings with hourly activity, daily heatmaps, custom date ranges, model breakdowns, local/API filters, and native cache-hit accounting, without cost estimates or composer overrides. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中统计本地 Token 用量，支持小时活动图、日历热力图、自定义日期、模型用量分布、本地/API 筛选和原生缓存命中口径，不估算费用，不替换输入框状态栏。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高兼容版本。

description.en: Per-session cost & usage report cards: tokens, cache hits, duration.
description.zh: 会话成本与耗时报表：tokens / 缓存命中 / 耗时。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud / Qwen balance card above the Settings row in the DSH web sidebar: account available and cash balance, coupon balances with expiry dates (student vouchers included) read through the BSS OpenAPI, and OpenAI-compatible relay quota. An official DashScope sk- key has no balance endpoint at all, so real money and coupons require an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey with bss:DescribeCoupons + bss:DescribeAcccount (AliyunBSSReadOnlyAccess is enough); secrets stay in the host process, the browser only sees a masked AccessKey ID, and /api/dsh-qwen-balance/* is loopback-only.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏「设置」行上方的阿里云 / Qwen 余额卡片：经 BSS OpenAPI 显示账户可用额度与现金余额、代金券余额与到期日（含学生 300 元券），以及 OpenAI 兼容中转站额度。官方百炼 / DashScope 的 sk- key 没有任何余额接口，想看真金白银与代金券必须用带 bss:DescribeCoupons + bss:DescribeAcccount（建议只挂 AliyunBSSReadOnlyAccess）的阿里云 AccessKey；密钥只留在宿主进程，浏览器只拿到掩码后的 AccessKey ID，/api/dsh-qwen-balance/* 仅允许环回访问。

description.en: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness. Per-channel usage with balances and plan quotas for mainstream providers, CNY cost estimates, and daily charts — a settings-sidebar section.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Token 用量统计。按渠道区分统计，官方渠道自动显示余额，套餐渠道显示 5 小时/7 天/30 天用量余量，人民币计费估算，含每日图表与模型分布，集成在设置页侧边菜单。

description.en: Cross-session usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on usage ring plus a draggable panel that aggregates token usage, cache-hit rate, cost and balance from local session logs, with per-tool cost attribution, iOS-style tile layout editing and an optional animated companion face.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话用量面板：常驻用量圆环 + 可拖动面板，从本地会话日志聚合 token 用量、缓存命中率、成本与余额，支持工具级成本归因、iOS 式磁贴布局编辑与可选表情伴侣；数据只在本机读取，不联网。

description.en: Extreme LLM-call compression for DeepSeek Harness: title short-circuit, in-flight dedup, 24h replay cache, and batch-merging N parallel requests into 1 upstream call via a `[[TASK n]]`/`[[ANSWER n]]` delimiter protocol - fewer API calls, less spend, same answers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的极端 LLM 调用压缩：标题生成短路、飞行中请求去重、24 小时回放缓存，并用 `[[TASK n]]`/`[[ANSWER n]]` 分隔协议把 N 个并行请求批量合并为 1 次上游调用——更少 API 调用、更低开销、相同答案。

description.en: Registers a battle-tested development delivery rulebook as a skill family - one core skill (clarification, delivery checklist, navigation) plus nine focused skills (layered architecture, evidence-driven debugging, minimal changes, impact-graded verification, migration feature parity, async UI feedback, sizing rules, CLI safety and cleanup, project notes). Only the skills matching the current task are loaded, trivial tasks (small reversible single-file edits) are exempted outright, so each session pays tokens just for the rules it actually uses.
description.zh: 把一套实战打磨的《开发交付规则》注册为技能家族：1 个核心技能（需求澄清、交付自检、规则导航）+ 9 个专项技能（分层架构、证据驱动调试、最小变更、验证分级、迁移对等、UI 异步反馈、样式尺寸、命令行安全与清理、项目记录）。按任务场景只加载命中的技能，琐碎小任务（单文件、≤10 行、可回滚）整体豁免不加载，每个会话只为真正用到的规则付 token。

description.en: CommandCode usage & balance panel for DeepSeek Harness: API usage, credit balance, 5-hour/weekly windows from the sidebar footer.
description.zh: DSH 的 CommandCode 用量与余额面板：在侧边栏底部显示 API 用量、信用额度、5小时/每周窗口。

description.en: Zenless Zone Zero inspired dark theme for the Harness Web UI, with a pointer-following hollow background.
description.zh: 《绝区零》风格的 Harness Web 深色主题，包含随鼠标移动的空洞背景。

description.en: Theme that pairs Windows XP-era scenery wallpapers with a modern frosted-glass interface: a fixed background layer behind the DeepSeek Harness web UI, panel styling applied through theme tokens, a wallpaper picker with custom image import, and a light/dark toggle. Works on desktop and mobile web surfaces.
description.zh: 让 XP 时代的风景壁纸与现代磨砂玻璃界面同框的主题：DeepSeek Harness Web 界面 之下的固定壁纸底板、经主题 token 应用的面板玻璃样式、支持导入自定义图片的 壁纸选择器与明暗切换按钮——桌面与移动端均可使用。

description.en: Full-screen dynamic wallpaper from local videos and images, with live effect controls, wallpaper switching and Wallpaper Engine workshop import; settings persist automatically.
description.zh: 把本地视频/图片变成全屏动态壁纸，支持实时效果调节、壁纸切换与 Wallpaper Engine 工坊导入，设置自动保存永久生效。

description.en: TangSan mascot appearance layer for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: wears a generated TangSan portrait as the GUI background (surface-token fade with opacity, blur, scrim and position controls), seats the matching square avatar as the sidebar and conversation brand mark, and edits it all from a Settings section; the host serves the artwork and config locally under /api/tangsan, and the config lives at $DSH_HOME/tangsan.json.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端的唐三美化形象插件：把生成的唐三插画铺成界面背景（表面令牌淡出，配合不透明度、模糊、遮罩与位置调节），将同系列方形头像换到侧栏与会话标题的品牌标识位，并在设置页统一配置；素材与配置由宿主在 /api/tangsan 下本地提供，配置文件位于 $DSH_HOME/tangsan.json。

description.en: Low-contrast dark theme that remaps DSH's alias tokens and adds its own chat bubble, code block banner and markdown heading colours.
description.zh: 低对比度深色主题，重映射 DSH 的 alias token，并自带聊天气泡、代码块语言条与 markdown 标题配色。

description.en: Cursor skins with a whale-girl white arrow and a maid-girl pointer, applied inside the Harness UI instantly or written into Windows system cursors with one-click restore. Its /state route is mounted with webServer.register without DSH Host/Origin admission, so a web page open in your browser can change the cursor settings.
description.zh: 鼠标指针皮肤：鲸鱼娘白羽箭头与蓝发女仆立绘指针，打开开关即在 Harness 界面内生效，也可一键写进 Windows 系统光标并随时还原。它的 /state 路由通过 webServer.register 挂载，没有 DSH 的 Host/Origin 准入检查，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能改动光标设置。

description.en: A port of DeepSeek-Refined for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), which injects "Obsidian Border"-style Markdown styling and multi-theme color schemes into the DSH frontend.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Refined 的 DSH 移植版：为 DSH 前端注入 Obsidian Border 等 5 个风格的 Markdown 美化与 5 套主题配色，并提供调色板按钮。

description.en: A Dracula dark theme for DeepSeek Harness covering the sidebar, chat, settings, and code highlighting, with first-paint styling and synchronized switches across windows.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Dracula 深色主题，覆盖侧栏、对话区、设置与代码高亮，支持启动时应用主题和跨窗口开关同步。

description.en: Prism Theme Studio adds 24 paired light/dark themes and a live theme studio to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: Prism 主题工作室为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 带来 24 套明暗双生主题和实时主题工作室。

description.en: 27 light color themes for the DSH Web GUI, ported from the Scaefy OpenCode light themes, with a Settings > General picker that shows a palette swatch per theme and restores the last choice after a restart.
description.zh: 27 款 DSH Web GUI 浅色主题，移植自 Scaefy OpenCode 浅色主题；在 设置 > 通用 中提供带配色色块的选取器，重启后自动恢复上次选择。

description.en: Region-by-region UI customizer for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: background, border and text styles for every interface area, element picker, highest-priority overrides.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端界面主题自定义：按界面区域配置背景、边框与文本样式，支持元素拾取器，优先级覆盖其他主题插件。

description.en: Interface theme and wallpaper plugin: preset skins, gradients, image wallpapers, and local video wallpapers with a playlist, prev/next buttons and fullscreen playback. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1; videos whose audio Chromium cannot decode need ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH, otherwise they play silently.
description.zh: 界面换肤与壁纸插件：预设皮肤、渐变、图片壁纸，以及本地视频壁纸（播放列表、上一个/下一个、双击全屏，自动为 Chromium 解不了的音轨生成 AAC 侧车）。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1；视频里 Chromium 解不了的音轨需要 PATH 里有 ffmpeg 和 ffprobe，没有时视频无声。

description.en: Turns an image folder into a frosted-glass global wallpaper for the DSH web UI, keeping the official palette.
description.zh: 把文件夹里的图片设为 DSH 网页端全局磨砂壁纸，配色沿用官方原版。

description.en: A deep-sea dive startup splash for DeepSeek Harness: a depth gauge with a submersible probe, a character reveal video that then loops, and a seafloor with coral, bubbles and slow drifting particles. The depth reached decides which sea creatures appear.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的深海下潜式启动开屏：深度尺与探测器、角色出场视频接无缝循环、海底珊瑚与气泡与缓慢漂浮的微光粒子；下潜到哪一层，就出现哪一层的海洋生物。

description.en: Anime theme for DeepSeek Harness: full-screen wallpaper, glassmorphism panels, six color themes, video wallpaper, particle effects, and a random corner sticker.
description.zh: 二次元主题：全屏动漫壁纸、玻璃拟态面板、六套全局配色主题、动态壁纸、粒子效果与右下角随机动图挂件。

description.en: Renders a Live2D Cubism 4 model as the DSH web UI background: a transparent click-through canvas that covers the window without blocking any control. Eyes, head and body follow the pointer; expressions track the agent state (thinking, running a tool, turn finished, error, waiting) and the conversation (message arrives, reply ends, question asked); after an idle delay the character shows speech bubbles and plays motions and expressions drawn at random from pools you tick. Settings list the models under ~/.dsh/live2d-stage/models, expose position, scale, opacity, gaze strength and every interval and probability, and open a resizable live preview of the same canvas. Expressions and motions a model3.json omits are detected from the model folder; one sample model is included.
description.zh: 把 Live2D Cubism 4 模型渲染成 DSH 网页界面的背景层：透明画布铺满窗口且不挡任何控件。眼、头、身体跟随鼠标；表情跟着智能体状态（思考、调用工具、回答结束、报错、等待确认）和对话（收到消息、回答结束、向你提问）变化；空闲到设定时间会冒台词气泡，并从你勾选的池子里随机播动作和表情。设置页列出 ~/.dsh/live2d-stage/models 里的模型，开放位置、缩放、透明度、视线强度与每一项间隔和概率，并可拖拽改大小的实时预览窗查看同一块画布。模型清单里没声明的 exp3/motion3 会被自动识别，另附示例模型。

description.en: Turns the DeepSeek Harness window into frosted acrylic glass so the desktop shows through, stacking on top of the active theme instead of replacing it. Desktop show-through on Windows 11 also needs the bundled installer (npx github:InkStain258/dsh-glass-skin), which makes a backed-up edit to the DSH Desktop app.asar.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 窗口换成磨砂亚克力玻璃，可透视桌面；叠加在当前主题之上而非替换主题。Windows 11 上透出桌面还需另跑仓库自带安装器（npx github:InkStain258/dsh-glass-skin，会带备份地修改 DSH Desktop 的 app.asar）。

description.en: Three neon palettes for DeepSeek Harness — cyan, pink and yellow — picked from a Theme colors row of three swatches under Appearance in Settings → General, each palette carrying its own light and dark token set; the built-in Appearance switch still owns dark and light.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的三套霓虹配色——青、粉、黄，在「设置 → 通用设置」的「外观」下面一行三个色块里点选切换，每套配色各自带明暗两套 token；深浅仍由内置的「外观」开关决定。

description.en: A black hole theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Web UI 的黑洞主题插件。

description.en: Ink-and-paper Apple-inspired theme for the DSH web client with a handwritten jimmy sidebar brand.
description.zh: 墨水纸质感的苹果风 DSH 网页主题，侧栏使用手写 jimmy 字标与小狗头像。

description.en: Warm pixel theme for the DSH Web UI: cream-paper and arcade-phosphor palettes, hard-edged pixel chrome with bundled pixel fonts, CRT motion on streaming and state changes, three intensity tiers, and a pixel loading bar while a turn runs.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的暖调像素主题：亮色暖米白纸面、暗色街机磷光；方角硬描边与偏移投影的像素控件、随包发布的像素字体，流式输出与状态变化带方块光标、扫描线与硬切闪帧；强度（轻/标准/浓）、动效、扫描线、像素字体四组档位在「设置 → 通用」里切换，输出时输入框上沿有一条像素加载条。

description.en: Acid-graphics theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: six complete palettes (acid, neon orange, electric cyan, violet, rose, warm orange-light) registered as switchable themes, plus an optional WebGL wireframe crystal backdrop driven by pointer and scroll, local wallpapers with a dimming mask and background lettering, a crystal startup animation with optional local video, and a Settings section that holds every control.
description.zh: dsh 酸性科技风主题：六套完整配色（酸性 / 霓虹橙 / 电弧青 / 紫罗兰 / 玫红 / 暖橙白）注册为可选主题；另附可选的 WebGL 线框晶体背景（随鼠标与滚动形变）、本地壁纸与遮罩、背景大字、晶体开机动画（可选本地视频），控制项集中在「设置 → Acid Core」。

description.en: DSH Web skin manager for mainstream DSH skin packages: import local paths or GitHub collections, scan installed skins from the web profile, preview/use/disable/refresh/delete, with host-side persistence.
description.zh: DSH Web 皮肤管理器：支持主流 DSH 皮肤包本地/GitHub 导入、扫描已安装皮肤、预览/使用/禁用/刷新/删除，宿主持久化。

description.en: Minecraft-styled theme for the DSH web GUI: blocky pixel components, a photo wallpaper library with auto-rotation and local uploads, Minecraft UI sound samples, and a BGM player with a local track library.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 界面用的 Minecraft 风格主题：方块化像素组件、可自动轮换与本地导入的照片壁纸库、Minecraft 界面音效，以及可导入本地曲目的 BGM 播放器。

description.en: Pixel Dynamic Starfield theme: five palettes, four layered text schemes, five pixel fonts including a simplified-Chinese face, square or rounded corners, a rotating pixel starfield with meteors, and a header pixel clock — configured from its own settings tab.
description.zh: 像素动态星空主题：五套配色、四套分层文字方案、五款像素字体（含简体中文像素字体）、方角与圆角可选、旋转像素星空与流星、顶栏像素时钟，均在插件设置页配置。

description.en: Minecraft-styled skin for the DSH Web client: MC GUI palette and pixel bevels, a pixel logo, on/off switch art, two persistent toggles in Settings, and an optional 16 MB Minecraft AE pixel font served on demand by the host half.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 客户端用的 Minecraft 风格皮肤：MC 调色板与像素立体边框、像素标志图、开关图案、设置里两个可持久化的开关，以及由 Host 半边按需发货的 16 MB Minecraft AE 像素字体。

description.en: Anime skin pack for the DSH Web UI: five AI-generated HD themes (Ninja, Sakura, Bamboo, Ronin, Ryujin) with per-theme accent palettes, a top-right shirt-icon switcher, and an adjustable transparency slider.
description.zh: 动漫皮肤包：忍者、樱花、竹林、落日、苍龙五套 AI 生成高清主题，各配专属点缀色，右上角衣服图标一键切换，透明度可调。

description.en: A full-frame animated HUD background for the DSH Web GUI — a rotating light ring that mirrors the live session, with token capture and tool beams following the token stream and tool calls. Press C for the settings panel (117 parameters, six palettes, presets, import/export); press H to show or hide the right-hand HUD. A fork of Ke-wood/dsh-haloflux (itself the DSH port of Ryder191's HALOFLUX) whose display, HUD and control layers were rebuilt; same package name and bundle id as upstream, so it cannot be installed alongside it.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的全帧动态 HUD 背景：旋转光环随当前会话实时变化，词元抓取与工具光束跟随词元流与工具调用。按 C 打开设置面板（117 项参数、6 套配色、预设、导入导出），按 H 显示或隐藏右侧 HUD。基于 Ke-wood/dsh-haloflux（Ryder191 的 HALOFLUX 的 DSH 移植）的分支，显示、HUD 与控制层均已重写；沿用上游包名与 bundle id，不能与 Ke-wood/dsh-haloflux 同装。

description.en: Dark theme plugin for dsh web (port of Obsidian things-soft-colorful-headings): warm-gray dimmed text via --dsw-alias-label-* token overrides plus soft colorful h1-h6 headings, zero dependencies.
description.zh: dsh web 暗色主题插件（移植自 Obsidian things-soft-colorful-headings）：通过 --dsw-alias-label-* token 覆盖实现暖灰调暗文本，配合柔和的彩色 h1-h6 标题，零依赖。

description.en: A dark, glassy Scaramouche theme for DeepSeek Harness with static and video wallpapers, opening video, ambient music, particles, and a draggable dock.
description.zh: 墨黑玻璃质感的原神「散兵」主题：静态/视频壁纸、开屏视频、环境音乐、粒子与可拖动控制条。

description.en: United Nations theme for the DSH Web GUI: UN blue over paper white, the official emblem, a slow rotation of credited UN peacekeeping photographs behind the conversation, Charter and UN-facts ribbons, and a 7,030-language picker (127 languages with a complete skin translation) that leaves every existing control untouched. Browser-side only; installers for Linux, macOS and Windows.
description.zh: 联合国主题皮肤：白底联合国蓝、官方徽记、对话背景缓慢轮播带署名的联合国维和照片、宪章与联合国知识丝带，以及收录 7,030 种语言（127 种已完整翻译）的语言选择器，不改动任何原有按钮。纯浏览器侧实现，附 Linux/macOS/Windows 一键安装脚本。

description.en: Opt-in pixel-neon arcade skin with Fusion Pixel fonts, animated whale-girl icons, custom crosshair and draggable detail windows; preserves light/dark/system themes. v0.3.2 includes local display-name controls, mobile menu improvements and an optional source patch for the arcade home screen, transitions and telemetry HUD.
description.zh: 可选的像素霓虹街机皮肤：Fusion Pixel 字体、鲸鱼娘像素图标、十字准星与可拖动详情窗口，保留浅色/深色/跟随系统。v0.3.2 支持本地自定义称呼并完善手机菜单；完整街机首页、转场与数值 HUD 另附可选源码集成补丁。

description.en: Colour engine for the chat UI: ships the Mariana palette as the default preset, exposes 18 colour slots and 9 Markdown prose roles, lets you save up to 12 presets, and colours LaTeX blocks by running Sublime's own LaTeX syntax.
description.zh: 对话界面配色引擎：内置 Mariana 配色作为默认预设，提供 18 个颜色槽位与 9 个 Markdown 正文角色色，最多可保存 12 套预设；LaTeX 代码块通过移植 Sublime 自身的语法来上色。

description.en: A soft, simple pink theme for DeepSeek Harness with a hand-drawn kitty-print wallpaper, light and dark palettes, and two kitty mascots; no configuration or extra panels.
description.zh: 粉嫩、简洁的 DeepSeek Harness 主题：手绘小猫印花壁纸、浅色与深色配色，以及两只小猫装饰；没有复杂配置和额外面板。

description.en: EVA armor HUD theme skin for DSH, with startup animation and sequential UI entrance animation.
description.zh: EVA真希波装甲HUD风格DSH皮肤，自带开场动画、组件顺序入场动效，毛玻璃UI

description.en: A neon pixel theme for DeepSeek Harness desktop with playable air-battle, pig-sling and fruit-slicing backgrounds, mouse controls and a day/night switch for the sling game.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端霓虹像素主题，提供可参与的像素空战、愤怒的小猪和霓虹切水果背景，支持鼠标操作及小猪游戏昼夜切换。

description.en: Taojian (陶笺): Claude-inspired DSH theme with warm paper, clay accent, Noto Serif SC, and Cascadia Mono.
description.zh: 陶笺：奶油纸浅色主题，陶橙强调色，界面思源宋，代码 Cascadia Mono。非官方，与 Anthropic、DeepSeek 无关。

description.en: Wallpaper skin for DeepSeek Harness: static images, video and generative gradients with five fit modes, blur/dim/contrast/saturation sliders, rotation and six transition styles. A spread mode carries the same artwork into the sidebar, panels, menus and window chrome instead of only the conversation canvas. It also samples the artwork on a 12x8 grid to derive WCAG-checked text colours and surface opacity, and annotates replies with colour only, never boxes.
description.zh: DSH 壁纸皮肤：静态图/视频/生成式渐变，五种适配方式，模糊暗化对比度饱和度滑条，自动轮播与六种切换过场；「全窗铺开」把同一张壁纸推进侧栏、面板、菜单与窗口标题栏，而不只是对话画布。另对壁纸做 12×8 网格采样，据 WCAG 推导文字颜色与底板透明度，标注只写颜色不产生方框。

description.en: Transparent acrylic window material and layered frosted panels for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: the window reveals the desktop wallpaper (Windows Acrylic supplies the blur), the composer is a pane of frosted glass, and chat text is hard-clipped at the composer's top edge. Note: the page styling installs with the plugin, but making the window itself transparent needs a one-time app.asar patch (the patch bundle in this repo's Releases; double-click enable-transparency.cmd). The patch takes effect after a restart and must be re-applied after every DSH update. The plugin works without it — the window simply stays opaque.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版提供透明亚克力窗口材质与分层雾面面板：窗口透出桌面壁纸（模糊由 Windows Acrylic 负责），输入栏是一块毛玻璃，聊天文字在输入栏上沿硬裁切。注意：页面样式随插件安装，但「窗口透出壁纸」需要额外运行一次 app.asar 补丁脚本（仓库 Releases 里的补丁包，双击 enable-transparency.cmd），补丁重启后生效，DSH 更新后需重打。只装插件也能用，只是窗口保持不透明。

description.en: Derivative of dingminhua/dsh-subagent-default-model (do not install both): routes subagent delegations by role with candidate pools, cross-provider failover and fork window slicing; shows running subagents in a header panel with duration and token counts; supports mid-run and batch model switching and exposes routing tools the model can call. Subagent pages also carry a context / usage stats strip (context occupancy, output speed, cache hit rate, token buckets) and a model menu limited to that page’s whitelist — a pick outside the whitelist is substituted with an allowed model instead of running unlisted.
description.zh: 基于 dingminhua/dsh-subagent-default-model 的衍生作品（不要与上游同装）：按角色为子代理派发选路由，带候补池、跨供应商故障转移与 fork 活跃窗口切片；标题栏显示正在运行的子代理及其时长与 token；支持运行中与批量换模型，并给模型提供可调用的路由工具。子代理页另有上下文/用量统计条（上下文占用、输出速度、缓存命中、分桶 token），模型菜单只列该页白名单——选了名单外的模型会被替换成允许的模型，而不是照样跑起来。

description.en: Adds the Liquid Inference auction exchange as a model route, with liquid.auto and its ranking variants, and four tools that read offers, markets, routers and job receipts. Requires a Liquid Inference API key (LIQUID_API_KEY, spend scope).
description.zh: 将 Liquid Inference 拍卖式推理交易所接入为模型路由，提供 liquid.auto 及其排序变体，并附带四个工具，用于读取报价、市场、路由器与任务收据。需 Liquid Inference API Key（LIQUID_API_KEY，spend 权限）。

description.en: OpenAI OAuth login for ChatGPT Codex that adds ChatGPT as a selectable LLM provider (streaming, Off/Low/High/Max reasoning effort, image input) and a codex tool for per-session DeepSeek escalation, with optional light-task delegation to DeepSeek and subscription usage and reset-credit management.
description.zh: 通过 OpenAI OAuth 登录 ChatGPT Codex，把 ChatGPT 加为可选 LLM provider（流式、Off/Low/High/Max 思考强度、图片输入），并提供按会话授权的 codex 工具供 DeepSeek 升级调用，支持把轻任务委派回 DeepSeek，附带订阅用量与重置卡管理。

description.en: Rule-based multi-provider model routing for DeepSeek Harness with pre-first-token failover, cooldown circuit-breaking, usage accounting, and a status API.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多供应商模型路由插件：规则路由 + 首 token 前无感故障切换 + cooldown 熔断 + 用量记账 + 状态接口。

description.en: Time-based model routing: a settings panel defines weekday peak and off-peak windows and the provider/model each one uses, the choices are read from the harness registry (API keys and subscription logins alike), and a global switch decides whether that policy sets the model and reasoning effort of every request. The switch is independent per session, each session row carries a light showing its own state, and the settings panel names the model in force right now and why. A day no window matches — every weekend and holiday — uses the primary model of the first plan; the advanced thinking model is a separate axis, used only when a session itself asks for max reasoning.
description.zh: 按时间做模型路由：在设置页定义工作日峰谷时段与各时段使用的 Provider/模型（候选来自 harness 已注册的 API 与订阅账号），打开开关后由该策略决定每次请求的模型与思考档。开关按会话独立，会话列表每行带指示灯显示各自状态，设置页顶部写明此刻生效的模型与原因。无任何时段命中的日子（周末、假期）使用第一个方案的主力模型；高级思考模型是另一根轴，只在会话自身要求 max 思考时使用。

description.en: Reasoning-effort gear presets for third-party models: 16 vendor/model presets with per-mode custom wire values, written into dsh-llm-pi-ai with pre-write validation and per-rule rejection; per-model switching between OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages with automatic route regrouping; plus a composer Optimize button and a settings section that rewrite the input text with a model you pick.
description.zh: 第三方模型的思考档位预设：内置 16 组按「厂家 → 模型」组织的官方档位，支持自定义档位与逐模式传输值，校验后直写 llm-pi-ai 配置；支持按模型在 OpenAI Chat Completions、OpenAI Responses 与 Anthropic Messages 三种协议间切换并自动重新分组路由；输入框提供「优化提示词」按钮，用设置中指定的大模型改写当前内容。

description.en: Two-level model routing: pick the best model group first, then the best channel within that model; a failure switches channel before switching model. Preference mode pins one model across its channels, a status bar under the composer shows the live model, channel health and the day's token usage, and a speed/intelligence report can be imported as the routing prior. Exposes a model_orchestrator tool and a /route command.
description.zh: 两级模型调度：先在模型层选最优模型组，再在该模型的渠道层选最佳渠道；失败时先换同模型的其它渠道，整个模型不可用才换模型。偏好模式把单个模型锁在它的各条渠道上，输入框下方的状态条实时显示当前模型、渠道健康与今日 token 用量，并可从测速/智力报告导入路由先验；另提供 model_orchestrator 工具与 /route 命令。

description.en: Adds MiniMax open-platform models to the DSH model picker: paste the API key in Settings and MiniMax models become selectable, with the M Plan quota windows shown beside the composer.
description.zh: 把 MiniMax 开放平台的模型加进 DSH 的模型选择：在设置里填 API Key 即可选到 MiniMax 模型，并在输入框旁显示 M Plan 的额度窗口。

description.en: Connects Trae enterprise models to DeepSeek Harness from a personal access token alone, calling llm_raw_chat directly with no trae2api or traecli process; fetches the model catalog from upstream on startup and shows remaining quota for personal packs and enterprise seats.
description.zh: 仅凭一个个人访问令牌（PAT）把 Trae 企业版模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，直连 llm_raw_chat，不需要 trae2api 或 traecli 进程；启动时从上游拉取模型目录，并显示个人额度包与企业席位的剩余额度。

description.en: Pick the model your subagents run on — with a reasoning-effort ceiling and an output-token cap — enforced in code on every child DSH starts, whichever tool starts it.
description.zh: 自己选定子代理运行的模型——附带推理力度上限和输出 token 上限——在代码层面对 DSH 启动的每一个子代理强制执行，无论它由哪个工具启动。

description.en: Routes subagent delegations once at spawn time by keyword rules over the delegation label and prompt: the first matching rule sets the child's provider/model/reasoningEffort, explicit caller routes are kept unless a rule opts in, and unmatched delegations pass through unchanged.
description.zh: 在子代理启动时按关键词规则一次性选路：首个命中委托标签或提示词的规则设置子代理的 provider/model/reasoningEffort，调用方显式指定的路由默认保留，未命中的委托原样放行。

description.en: Global Alt+M model command palette for DeepSeek Harness Web: fuzzy search over models and providers, favorites and recents, per-model reasoning effort, provider and model configuration, request retries, capacity presets, and optional OpenRouter image/video generation tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的全局 Alt+M 模型命令面板：模型与提供商的模糊搜索、收藏与最近使用、每模型思考档位、提供商与模型配置、请求重试、容量预设，以及可选的 OpenRouter 图片/视频生成工具。

description.en: Declarative provider/model fallback chains for the model picker: an ordered root chain plus named pools, failure-code triggered switching, per-model cooldowns, time-slot presets, and subagent role routing. A fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-llm-fallbacks 0.6.5; do not install it alongside that plugin (both use the "llm-fallbacks" profile row id).
description.zh: 模型选择器用的可配置降级链：有序主链加命名池，按失败码自动切换，支持按模型冷却、分时段预设与子代理角色路由。omdsh-dev/dsh-llm-fallbacks 0.6.5 的 fork；不要与上游同时安装（两边的 profile 行 id 都是 "llm-fallbacks"）。

description.en: Planner/executor delegation with named roles: a strong planner steers, disposable executor sub-agents (per-role routes and prompts) implement. Default role plus per-delegation override, a global reasoning-effort knob in the composer chip, and a settings page for role management.
description.zh: 规划者/执行者委派调度：高阶模型（Planner）定方向，一次性低阶执行子代理（按角色的路由与提示词）干具体活；默认角色 + 单次委派覆盖，输入框芯片快速切换角色与全局思考等级，设置页管理执行角色。

description.en: Registers the workbuddy model provider by mounting dsh-llm-workbuddy and supervises the local wb2api gateway, then bundles two protocol bridges onto that same gateway: Responses for OpenAI Codex CLI, and Anthropic Messages for Claude Code and Claude Desktop, which see the gateway models under generated claude-wb-… ids. Skips work that is already running or already registered, and reports each part through a status tool. Requires a local wb2api gateway and a WorkBuddy account.
description.zh: 通过挂载 dsh-llm-workbuddy 注册 workbuddy 模型 provider，托管本地 wb2api 网关，并在同一网关前内置两条协议桥：给 OpenAI Codex CLI 的 Responses，以及给 Claude Code 与 Claude 桌面端的 Anthropic Messages——后两者以生成的 claude-wb-… id 看到网关模型。已在运行或已注册的部分会跳过，并通过状态工具汇报各环节状况。需本机有 wb2api 网关并有 WorkBuddy 账号。

description.en: One-step local model onboarding plus a light harness for DSH. On load it probes loopback and private-network inference endpoints (llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio), reads each model's context window and output budget from the backend, and registers the provider through settings, so a local model becomes selectable without hand-writing config. It then trims only that provider: masks the tool list through tools.restrict, drops named system-prompt sections and memory contexts, swaps the injected instruction block for a short one while preserving its first 80 and last 96 characters, and truncates tool-schema descriptions without touching structure or required fields. Cloud providers are returned as the same assembly object, untouched. The injected block is re-read from disk on every assembly, so editing the file takes effect on the next request with no reload. The panel in the plugin detail page is a live operations view: it shows whether the takeover is active and by which hook, how many characters the last assembly was trimmed from and to, and which providers are online (probed concurrently, with a real one-shot completion reporting latency and reply text per provider). If a local backend is not running, the panel offers a one-click launch: it probes the port first (never starting a duplicate), then starts the matching server (ollama serve, or a custom command you supply) detached and polls until the endpoint answers, clamping the wait to 3-600 seconds, reaping the child it just spawned if it never answers, and naming the paths it searched when it cannot find the binary. A stop button kills backends this plugin started (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL) and refuses to touch a server somebody else launched. When a model has just been downloaded and no backend exists yet, the panel can also scan the machine for .gguf files with hard caps (300 models, 20000 directory entries, Downloads only one level deep), start llama-server on the chosen one (skipping the .mmproj. vision projection and reusing a server that already answers), register the provider under the model id the backend reports, and run one real completion to prove it works. Before spawning anything it does a fit check that counts only the part of the file the GPU cannot hold: hostBytes = fileSize - VRAM, compared against max(total RAM - 2GB, free RAM). A file far larger than RAM is refused outright; a heavy host-side remainder is refused unless you confirm; the same remainder under mmap is only a warning, because the weights land in reclaimable page cache. A load-mode selector (auto / mmap / none / mlock / mmap+mlock) maps to llama.cpp --load-mode, and the default is whatever the engine picks. From 0.4.2 everything above is derived from the platform instead of assumed: home and data directories come from os.homedir() and the OS conventions (LOCALAPPDATA on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support on macOS, XDG_DATA_HOME elsewhere); backend binaries are looked up in the official install locations of each OS and can be pinned with OLLAMA_BIN, LLAMA_SERVER_BIN, VLLM_BIN or LMSTUDIO_BIN; model discovery walks DSH_LOCAL_MODELS_DIR, ~/models, ~/llama.cpp/models, ~/.cache/llama.cpp and the LM Studio data directory, with the WorkBuddy layout demoted to one candidate among them. VRAM is asked from nvidia-smi, then rocm-smi, then sysctl hw.memsize on Apple Silicon (flagged unified, so the same bytes are not charged twice), and any flip to a unified-memory budget is handled explicitly. Before building a command line the plugin runs llama-server --help once and keeps only the flags that build actually has, so older engines get --n-gpu-layers 99 and no KV quantization while newer ones get auto plus q8_0; anything it cannot probe is passed through rather than dropped. LM Studio is started with lms server start --port N rather than being lumped in with the engines that need a model argument, and vLLM gets its own --model example instead of llama.cpp syntax. Windows, macOS and Linux are all exercised in CI, including a windows-latest and a macos-latest job, because a cross-platform claim that has only ever run on one OS is not a claim. Two of those suites exist specifically to catch this machine's blind spots: one replays the whole suite with process.platform rewritten to each OS, and one deletes every advantage this development box has — no nvidia-smi, no rocm-smi, no sysctl, an empty PATH, a home directory with no models — and requires graceful degradation rather than a crash. That last one caught a real class of bug: several assertions hardcoded 'lms.exe', which cannot pass where the executable has no suffix. Measured on the reference machine: a 16.9GB 27.2B MoE with 14.5GB of VRAM holds a 285-691MB working set and sustains 76 tok/s after a 1000-2000 token warm-up, so file size alone is not a fit signal. From 0.4.3 the scanned models are shown as a table rather than a dropdown (one row per gguf, with its size and any fit warning), so you can see what is on disk before choosing. From 0.4.4 the delete button on the provider table removes the provider entry, not the weights file on disk. That distinction matters: what people actually want to clear out is the dead entry - one pointing at a port that never answered, one registered twice for the same port, one whose model file was deleted long ago - not a 15.8GB gguf. Deleting a config is undone by importing again; deleting a gguf is not. The removal goes through settings.mutate with an unset op on \['providers', id], because update merges layers: writing null there leaves a null provider key that the loader reads as a broken config rather than an absent entry, and only mutate/unset is implemented as Reflect.deleteProperty. The result is read back afterwards, because unset on a key that comes from a lower layer (the profile cordis.patch.yml or a home patch) does not delete it - it restores the inherited value, so the call succeeds while the entry stays.
