When the entry is still there the panel says so and points at the file to edit instead of reporting success, and a DSH whose settings service predates mutate() is told plainly rather than silently ignored. Deleting takes two clicks and clearing the confirmation is as easy as clicking another row; on success the online and baseURL caches are cleared and the tool surface is recomputed, since the provider list changed. The gguf itself is never touched by this plugin - the scanned-model table is display and selection only.VRAM reporting is driver-dependent. From 0.4.5 model discovery also reads Ollama's own storage: its blobs are named sha256-… with no extension, so extension matching could never list them. Weights are now accepted by extension OR by GGUF magic header (only dot-free files of at least 8MB, capped at 600 header reads per scan; obviously-not-weights extensions like .json/.md/.safetensors/.part are never opened). Ollama models are resolved from their manifests: the model layer is picked by mediaType application/vnd.ollama.image.model (never adapter/mmproj layers), the human-readable name is restored from the manifest path (…/qwen3/8b becomes qwen3:8b, …/latest stays bare), tags sharing one blob merge into a single row, and the metadata kv supplies name, quantization and context length. Adopting an Ollama model does not start a duplicate llama-server over the same weights: it confirms ollama serve answers on 11434 (launching it if not) and registers the provider under the tag the endpoint itself reports — the blob's sha256 name would never match anything, since 11434 lists qwen3:14b, not sha256-a8cc…. Two real-machine-only traps fixed on the way: existsSync('<file>/') returns true on Windows, so manifest-vs-directory branching now goes by parseable content instead of trailing-slash semantics; and the quantization label table had been copied from a stale ggml enum generation, labelling ggml_type 15 as Q5_K_S while ollama show reports Q4_K_M. Same-blob dedup is by (dev,ino), keeping whichever entry has a name. Verified on the reference machine: the scan goes from 1 row to 4 — qwen3:14b (8.64G) and qwen3:8b (4.87G) now appear with Q4_K_M badges — in 4ms; npm run verify exits 0 (launcher 57, portable 35, panel-host green including the linux/darwin simulated-platform runs); the new panel-host suite builds a real miniature Ollama store in tmpdir and points OLLAMA_MODELS at it, so results no longer depend on whether the test machine happens to have Ollama installed. From 0.4.6 the panel shows each model its real name instead of its file name, because some download tooling stores every weight under one generic file name, leaving the real name only inside the GGUF header. The scan now reads each file GGUF KV section - not a fixed-size head buffer, because tokenizer.ggml.tokens (hundreds of thousands of strings on a large MoE model) and the chat template push general.file_type past any window; and GGUF string arrays are interleaved (u64 length plus payload per element), so treating them as a length table walks the cursor off the rails and produces astronomically large reads. Reading and skipping are accounted separately: key names and types are always read, string values over 256KB and string arrays are only walked past without copying, non-string arrays over 64 elements are skipped outright, and a cursor past the file size stops the read, because an out-of-range position means the cursor is wrong rather than that a limit should be raised. The displayed name goes Ollama tag, then general.basename plus size_label, then general.name, then the file name, with the full string kept for the hover text since it usually carries internal build numbers; mmproj files are now identified by general.type as well as by name. A short read (truncated file) no longer feeds half a value into the parser. On the reference machine, reading one file header parses 44 keys in about 16ms, and a whole scan takes about 31ms. From 0.4.7 the smoke test no longer fails the first time and passes the second. The old code gave both request attempts one shared AbortController and one shared 30-second timer, so the total budget covered both rounds: a cold load of a large model burned it in round one, the abort left the signal permanently aborted, and the second round (the Ollama-style reasoning_effort: none retry) could not even be sent - which is exactly why the first click returned This operation was aborted and the second succeeded. Now each attempt gets its own controller and timer, a timeout retries once automatically (retryOnTimeout, on by default) because a first-request timeout almost always means the weights are still being read from disk, and non-timeout errors (refused connection, HTTP error) are not retried at all. Timeouts report themselves: the message says the wait exceeded smokeTimeout, whether a retry already happened, and points at the new smokeTimeout setting (seconds, default 60, clamped to 5-600) - port responding is not the same as tokens coming out, so it is a separate knob from launchTimeout. Unrelated: an example naming one specific model was dropped from the panel copy, since not every machine has that model downloaded, and the explanation now describes the mechanism instead. From 0.4.8 adopting a plain .gguf no longer registers an unrelated Ollama model. The port field used to follow the last click rather than the file: selecting an Ollama entry moved it to 11434, selecting a plain .gguf did not move it back, so a 11434 left over from an earlier click stayed. The server accepted it as given, probed the port, found Ollama answering and borrowed it (the skipped-launch log line about the port already answering is this path), and then the model id - derived from the file name - could not be matched against Ollama's /v1/models, where the fallback was to grab the first entry in the list. Embedding models tend to sort first, so the adopt registered a model the user never selected. Now the port follows the file: a plain .gguf landing on another engine's port (ollama 11434, vLLM 8000, LM Studio 1234) is moved to 8090 and the panel says so. Only ports belonging to a known engine are overridden - a hand-typed 9999 aimed at your own llama-server is left alone. The model-id fallback no longer guesses either: it takes the only entry when there is exactly one (a single-model backend may legitimately report a different id than the file name) and otherwise reports an error listing the ids it did see, rather than registering a wrong provider. From 0.4.9 the panel can no longer vanish. It used to be possible for the whole section to disappear from the plugin detail page while the host stayed up, the HTTP bridge kept answering, and no crash log appeared. The cause was a scope error: a helper was declared inside one component and referenced from another, which is valid JavaScript and passes a syntax check, so it only threw at render time - when the user pressed the scan button and React ran the state updater. The host wraps every slot entry in an error boundary whose fallback is an empty anchor, so the throw was contained silently: the panel was not uninstalled or crashed, it was replaced by an empty div. The helpers now live in the module scope both components share. The client half also gained its own test - a minimal React stand-in loads the real panel module, really calls the components, really runs the state updater at render time, and presses the scan button, so this class of error can no longer reach a release.
description.zh: 给小本地模型的一步到位接入 + 轻量 harness。装载时自动探测回环与私有网段上的推理端点（llama.cpp、Ollama、vLLM、LM Studio），从后端读出每个模型的窗口与输出预算，再经 settings 注册 provider —— 不用手写配置就能在模型选择器里选到本地模型。随后只对这一个 provider 裁剪：用 tools.restrict 收缩工具面、按段名丢弃系统提示词段落与记忆 context、把注入的指令块换成一页纸同时保留其首 80 与末 96 字符、截断工具 schema 的 description 而不动结构与 required。云端 provider 原样返回同一个 assembly 对象，不做任何改动。注入正文每次装配都重新读盘，改文件下一次请求就生效，不用重载。插件详情页的面板是一块实时运行视图：显示接管是否生效、走的是哪个钩子，最近一次装配的字符进→出与省下的比例，以及各 provider 的在线灯（多路并发点灯，每个本地 provider 还能发一次真实的最小请求，把延迟与回复原文报出来）。本地后端没起来时，面板能一键拉起：先探测端口（已在应答就不重复启动），再按端口拉起对应后端（ollama serve，或你自己填的启动命令），进程独立于宿主存活，随后轮询到端口应答为止，等待上限夹在 3–600 秒，超时会把刚起的那个进程回收掉不留孤儿，找不到可执行文件时会把搜过的路径写清楚。面板上还有停止按钮，只肯停本插件自己起的后端（先 SIGTERM，1.5 秒不退再 SIGKILL），别人的服务一概不动。模型刚下好、后端还不存在时，面板能扫描本机 .gguf（跳过 .mmproj. 视觉投影、按大小降序，并带 300 个模型 / 20000 个目录项 / Downloads 只扫一层这三道上限），选一个就用它拉起 llama-server（端口上已有服务就复用），按后端自报的模型 id 注册 provider，再发一条真实请求证明能用。真正起之前会做一次装得下算账：只算显存装不下的那部分（hostBytes = 文件体积 − 显存），拿它比 max(总内存 − 2GB, 空闲内存)。文件比「显存 + 内存」还大直接拦；落到宿主的内存太多时先不替你起，要你确认；同样的情况若走 mmap 只给警告，因为权重落在可回收的页缓存里。加载方式下拉（auto / mmap / none / mlock / mmap+mlock）对应 llama.cpp 的 --load-mode，默认交给引擎自己决定。0.4.2 起上面每一条都改成按平台推导，而不是假设本机长什么样：家目录与数据目录走 os.homedir() 和各系统惯例（Windows 用 LOCALAPPDATA，macOS 用 ~/Library/Application Support，其它用 XDG_DATA_HOME）；后端二进制按各系统官方安装位置找，也可以用 OLLAMA_BIN / LLAMA_SERVER_BIN / VLLM_BIN / LMSTUDIO_BIN 钉死；找模型依次走 DSH_LOCAL_MODELS_DIR、~/models、~/llama.cpp/models、~/.cache/llama.cpp 与 LM Studio 数据目录，WorkBuddy 的布局降级成其中一个候选。显存先问 nvidia-smi，再问 rocm-smi，Apple Silicon 上问 sysctl hw.memsize 并标成统一内存（同一块字节不重复扣两次）。拼命令行之前会跑一次 llama-server --help，只保留这个 build 真有的参数 —— 老引擎给 --n-gpu-layers 99 且不下发 KV 量化，新引擎给 auto 加 q8_0；探测不出来的参数一律照传，不因为探不到就丢掉。LM Studio 用 lms server start --port N 起，不再和「必须先给模型参数」的引擎混在一起；vLLM 单独给 --model 的示例，不再套 llama.cpp 的写法。Windows、macOS、Linux 三套都在 CI 里跑，另加 windows-latest 与 macos-latest 两个 job —— 只在一个系统上跑过的「跨平台」不算跨平台。其中两套专门用来抓这台开发机的盲区：一套把 process.platform 改掉、整套测试按各系统重跑；另一套把开发机的所有有利条件全删掉（没有 nvidia-smi、没有 rocm-smi、没有 sysctl、PATH 是空的、家目录里没有模型），要求优雅退化而不是崩。后一套抓到过真实的一类 bug：好几处断言写死了 lms.exe，在可执行文件不带后缀的系统上根本不可能过。参考机实测：16.9GB 的 27.2B MoE 配 14.5GB 显存，进程工作集只有 285–691MB，预热 1000–2000 token 后稳定 76 tok/s —— 光看文件大小判断装不装得下是错的。0.4.3 起扫出来的模型是一张表而不是下拉框（每个 gguf 一行，带体积和偏大提示），选之前能看清磁盘上到底有什么。0.4.4 起 provider 表上的删除键删的是这条 provider 配置，不是磁盘上的权重文件。这个区别很重要：真正想清掉的是那种僵尸条目 —— 指向一个从没应答过的端口、同一个端口注册了两遍、或者模型文件早就删了还留着的那几条，而不是一个 15.8GB 的 gguf。删配置随时可以重新导入，删 gguf 不行。删除走settings.mutate 的 unset，路径是 \['providers', id]：不能用 update，因为 update 是合并层，往那儿写null 只会留下一个 null 的 provider 键，loader 会当成配置坏了而不是「没有这一条」；只有 mutate 的unset 内部是 Reflect.deleteProperty。删完会回读一次，因为对「来自下层（profile 的 cordis.patch.yml或 home patch）的键」做 unset 不是删除而是恢复继承值 —— 调用成功但条目还在。条目还在时面板会直说，并把该改哪个文件指出来，不谎报成功；settings 服务太老没有 mutate() 的版本也会明说，而不是默默忽略。删除要点两次，点别的行就撤回确认；删成功会清掉在线缓存与 baseURL 缓存并重算工具面，因为 provider列表变了。gguf 本身插件一个字节都不动 —— 扫描出来的那张表只用来展示和选中。且显存能不能读到取决于驱动。0.4.5 起模型扫描也读 Ollama 自己的存储：它的 blob 叫 sha256-… 、没有后缀，光按扩展名永远列不出来。现在认权重看后缀或文件头 GGUF 魔数（只开「无点号且 ≥8MB」的文件，一趟最多读 600 次魔数；.json/.md/.safetensors/.part 这类明显不是权重的后缀一次都不开）。Ollama 的模型从 manifest 还原：只取 mediaType 为 application/vnd.ollama.image.model 的层（mmproj/adapter 层不算主模型），人话名从 manifest 路径还原（…/qwen3/8b → qwen3:8b，latest 不加冒号），同一份 blob 被多个 tag 引用时合并成一行，metadata 的 kv 给出名称、量化和 context 上限。对 Ollama 的模型点「一键配置」不会再拿同一份权重重复起一份 llama-server：它确认 11434 上的 ollama 在应答（不在就 ollama serve），并按端点自己报的 tag 注册 provider —— 11434 上报的是 qwen3:14b，拿 blob 的 sha256 名永远匹配不上。顺带修掉两个只有真机才暴露的坑：Windows 上 existsSync('<文件>/') 返回 true，manifest 与目录的分岔改成按内容判定，不再依赖尾斜杠语义；量化标签表照搬了旧一代 ggml 枚举，把 ggml_type 15 标成 Q5_K_S，而 ollama show 实测报 Q4_K_M，整表按真实序号重写。同一份文件的去重按 (dev,ino)，谁有名字留谁。参考机实测：扫描从 1 行变 4 行 —— qwen3:14b（8.64G）与 qwen3:8b（4.87G）带着 Q4_K_M 徽标出现 —— 耗时 4ms；npm run verify 退出码 0（launcher 57 项、portable 35 项、panel-host 含 linux/darwin 模拟平台两套全绿）；panel-host 新增的用法在 tmpdir 里现造一份迷你 Ollama 存储再把 OLLAMA_MODELS 指过去，测试结果不再取决于跑测试的机器装没装 ollama。0.4.6 起面板显示的是模型自己的真名，不再是文件名：有些下载工具会把任何权重都落成同一个通用文件名，真名只写在 GGUF 头部里。扫描会读每个文件的 GGUF KV 区 —— 不是先读一段固定大小的头部，因为 tokenizer.ggml.tokens（大 MoE 模型动辄几十万条字符串）和 chat_template 会把 general.file_type 挤出任何窗口；而且 GGUF 的字符串数组是交错存储（每条 u64 长度加载荷），把它当长度表读会让游标跑偏、算出天文数字的读取量。读与走位分开记账：键名与类型必读，超过 256KB 的字符串值和字符串数组只走位不复制，非字符串数组超过 64 个元素直接跳过，游标越过文件末尾立刻停 —— 越界说明游标错了，不是该把上限调大。显示名依次取 Ollama 的 tag、general.basename 加 size_label、general.name、文件名，整串留在悬停里因为常带内部编号；视觉投影文件现在也靠 general.type 认，不只看文件名。短读（文件被截断）不再把半截字节喂给解析器。参考机实测：读一个文件的头部解析出 44 个键耗时约 16ms，整趟扫描约 31ms。0.4.7 起「试跑」不再出现「第一次失败、第二次成功」。老代码让两轮请求共用一个 AbortController 和一个 30 秒定时器，也就是两轮加起来只有 30 秒：大模型的冷加载第一轮就烧完它，abort 之后 signal 永久处于已中止状态，第二轮（换成 Ollama 认的 reasoning_effort: none 再试一次）连请求都发不出去 —— 这正是第一次点报 This operation was aborted、第二次却能成功的原因。现在每轮各自一个 controller 和定时器；超时自动再来一轮（retryOnTimeout 默认开），因为第一次请求超时几乎总是「权重还在读盘」；非超时错误（连不上、HTTP 报错）完全不重试。超时也会自己说清楚：文案里写明超过了多少秒、是否已自动重试，并指向新增的「试跑超时（秒）」配置项（默认 60，可设 5-600）—— 端口通了不等于能出字，它和「拉起后等端口（秒）」是两个不同的旋钮。顺带：面板提示里那句绑定某一个具体模型的举例去掉了，不是每台机器都下了那个模型，说明改成讲机制。0.4.8 起「一键配置」一个普通 .gguf 不再注册出不相干的 Ollama 模型。端口这一栏原来跟着上一次点击走而不是跟着文件走：选中 Ollama 的条目会把端口挪到 11434，选中普通 .gguf 时却不挪回来，于是一次先前点击留下的 11434 就一直留着。服务端照单全收，去探那个端口，发现 Ollama 在应答就直接借了它（日志里那句「端口本来就在应答，跳过拉起」就是这条路径），接着按文件名拼出来的模型 id 在 Ollama 的 /v1/models 里对不上，而兜底是抓列表里的第一个 —— embedding 模型往往排在第一位，于是注册出了一个用户从没点过的模型。现在端口跟着文件走：普通 .gguf 落在别的引擎的端口上（ollama 11434、vLLM 8000、LM Studio 1234）就改到 8090 并在面板里说明一句；只改「已知引擎的端口」，自己手填 9999 指向另一台 llama-server 的情况一概不动。模型 id 的兜底也不再瞎猜：只有一个条目时才取它（单模型后端报的 id 本来就可能和文件名不同），有多个而对不上就报错并列出实际看到的 id，而不是注册出一个错的 provider。0.4.9 起面板不会再整块消失。以前插件详情页里那一块可能凭空不见，而宿主照常运行、HTTP bridge 照常应答、连崩溃日志都不留一条。原因是一个作用域错误：某个辅助函数声明在一个组件里面，却被另一个组件引用 —— 这是合法 JavaScript，语法检查完全通过，于是它只在渲染期炸，也就是用户按下扫描按钮、React 执行状态更新函数的那一瞬间。宿主给每个插槽条目都包了一层错误边界，兜底渲染是一个空的锚点，所以异常被就地吞掉：插件没有被卸载、进程也没有崩，面板只是被换成了一个空 div。现在这两个辅助函数放在两个组件共享的模块作用域里。客户端这一半也有了专门的用例 —— 一个最小 React 替身载入真正的面板模块，真调用组件、真在渲染期执行状态更新函数、真去按扫描按钮，这类错误不会再走到发布版里。

description.en: Adds a Settings page to pin one OpenAI-compatible subagent model (or follow the main model), writes the official subagent-model-selection allowlist, reminds the parent to pass that route, and optionally runs one-shot tasks through an isolated Pi CLI provider.
description.zh: 在设置里为子代理单独指定一个 OpenAI 兼容模型（或不选则跟随主模型），写入官方 subagent-model-selection 白名单，并在仅有一条路由时提醒主代理显式传参；可选提供与 DSH 进程隔离的 Pi CLI 一次性子代理。

description.en: Per-teammate model selection for Agent Teams - a chip in the teammate's own composer pins one model for that member, or the member follows the lead conversation's current model on every step; pins survive restarts. Pins are saved in $DSH_HOME/plugin-data/team-member-model.json, and its /plugin/team-member-model routes (model catalog, setting a teammate's model) have no access check.
description.zh: 为 Agent Teams 的子队友单独指定模型——在成员会话输入框的胶囊里固定一个模型，或让成员每一步跟随主对话当前使用的模型；指定重启后仍生效。指定结果存在 $DSH_HOME/plugin-data/team-member-model.json；/plugin/team-member-model 路由（模型目录、给成员换模型）没有访问校验。

description.en: Tiered model routing for DeepSeek Harness: think/build model tiers, vision delegation (the vision model only describes images; the working model acts), image generation, and a high-impact guard.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的分级模型路由：think/build 模型分级、视觉委派（视觉模型只负责描述图片，工作模型负责执行操作）、图片生成，以及高影响操作守卫。

description.en: Connects Trae CN desktop app models to DeepSeek Harness with no OAuth flow: reuses the desktop sign-in, exposes 17 models (including deepseek-v4.1-flash) with consumption-rate badges and reasoning-effort mapping.
description.zh: 将 Trae CN 桌面版的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需单独 OAuth：复用桌面端登录，17 个模型（含 deepseek-v4.1-flash）带倍率标注与思考强度映射。

description.en: Reorder your own models: drag inside a provider card on the Models settings page, or use the Model order section when another plugin already occupies that card. The order is written through the host settings service with a revision check, so the settings page and the model picker stay in sync. The settings left nav can be reordered by drag as well.
description.zh: 模型顺序：在「设置 → 模型」的提供方卡片里拖动调整；卡片格被别的插件占用时，入口在设置左导航的「模型顺序」分区。顺序通过宿主 settings 服务带版本校验写回，设置页与模型选择器保持同步；设置左导航本身也可拖拽排序。

description.en: Unofficial Cursor subscription chat: Host-owned CLI session login, a displayed model catalog, and subscription usage rails. Cursor staff treat this class of private-client usage as against ToS.
description.zh: 非官方 Cursor 订阅聊天：Host 持有 CLI 会话登录，可编辑展示用模型目录，并显示订阅额度。Cursor 员工认定此类私有客户端用法违反 ToS。

description.en: xAI Grok subscription chat: SuperGrok or X Premium+ OAuth, a displayed model subset, Responses through the Grok CLI proxy, and always-on server-side web_search and x_search.
description.zh: xAI Grok 订阅聊天：用 SuperGrok 或 X Premium+ 的 OAuth 登录，选择要显示的模型子集，经 Grok CLI 代理走 Responses，并始终开启服务端 web_search 与 x_search。

description.en: Quota takeover for DeepSeek Harness on top of Our Free Model: compiles your platform order and pinned model tiers into one ordered fallback chain, skipping platforms that lack the model, sit in cooldown or are out of quota, writes the result back as Our Free Model combos, and after a quota or rate-limit failure re-plans and injects a follow-up continue message into the interrupted session so the turn resumes on the next platform; the chain ends with your configured aggregate fallback model or the official DeepSeek quota.
description.zh: 额度接力：在 Our Free Model 之上按你设定的平台顺序与模型档编排一条有序接力链，缺该模型、平台冷却、额度耗尽的格子自动跳过，结果写回 OFM 的 combos；因额度或限流中断后重新编排并向中断的会话补一条「继续」，让回合在下一个平台接着跑，链尾可选聚合渠道兜底模型或 DeepSeek 官方额度。

description.en: OAuth sign-in for 9 subscription LLM providers (Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, OpenRouter, Agnes AI, Qwen, Spark, ERNIE) with zero-config login and usage dashboards.
description.zh: 支持 Claude、Codex、Grok、Antigravity、OpenRouter、Agnes AI、Qwen、星火、文心一言共 9 个订阅账号的 OAuth 登录，零配置直连，内置用量看板。

description.en: A GUI subagent-model selector beside the main model seat: pick a model and reasoning effort per session, applied to every in-process subagent.
description.zh: 主模型选择器旁的子代理模型选择器：按会话选择模型与思考程度，应用到所有进程内子代理。

description.en: Registers 12 CatPaw (妙手) models as a DeepSeek Harness provider, with per-model reasoning effort, harness-executed tool calls, and QR-code login. The bundled catpaw-cli is a macOS arm64 binary (other platforms must supply their own copy), and calls use the signed-in CatPaw account quota.
description.zh: 把妙手（CatPaw）的 12 个模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持按模型区分的推理档位、由 Harness 执行的工具调用与扫码登录。内置 catpaw-cli 仅提供 macOS arm64 版本（其它平台需自备），调用消耗妙手账号额度。

description.en: Local LoRA and QLoRA fine-tuning in a panel: import JSONL, see a VRAM estimate before training starts, evaluate, and export an adapter. One-click Python venv setup, but you must supply your own Python 3.10+ and an NVIDIA GPU (6 GB or more). Verified end to end on Windows 11 with an RTX 3060 6 GB; the installer refuses non-Windows hosts, so Linux, macOS and other GPUs are unsupported for now.
description.zh: 面板里的本地 LoRA / QLoRA 微调：导入 JSONL、开始前先看显存估算、评测并导出适配器。一键创建 Python 虚拟环境，但需自备 Python 3.10+ 与 NVIDIA 显卡（6 GB 显存起）。已在 Windows 11 + RTX 3060 6 GB 上完整跑通；安装器会直接拒绝非 Windows 平台，Linux、macOS 与其他显卡暂不支持。

description.en: Native multi-platform accounts and model routing with staggered check-ins, event notifications, and quota forecasts. Its background worker needs a standalone Node >=22.23.3 with node:sqlite (enforced by engines.node); Qwen Office coding additionally needs Python with cryptography and wasmtime.
description.zh: 原生多平台账号与模型路由管理，支持错峰签到、事件通知与额度预测。后台 worker 需独立 Node ≥22.23.3（node:sqlite，已由 engines.node 约束）；千问办公的编码能力另需 Python（cryptography、wasmtime）。

description.en: Per-turn reasoning-effort routing that keeps the current provider/model: judges each user message (retry or correction, explicit intent, length, code blocks, errors, task scope) and sets reasoningEffort to a level the model actually declares, so Magpie and other OpenAI-compatible models work too. Ships a composer chip with an auto/manual switch and per-session decision history.
description.zh: 按每轮任务自动调节思考强度：判定用户消息（重试或纠正、显式意图、长度、代码块、报错、任务范围）后，从模型真正声明的 effort 列表中选择并设置 reasoningEffort，不切换 provider/model，喜鹊（Magpie）等第三方模型同样生效；输入框旁提供档位胶囊、自动/手动切换与会话内判定记录。

description.en: Answers model calls by driving your own logged-in chatgpt.com session in a local Chrome, so inference spends the ChatGPT web quota rather than Codex quota, and adds a JSON tool-call protocol so the web model can run DSH tools.
description.zh: 用本地 Chrome 驱动你自己已登录的 chatgpt.com 会话作答，消耗的是 ChatGPT 网页额度而非 Codex 额度；并用 JSON 工具调用协议让网页端模型可以调用 DSH 工具。

description.en: Apply the current session's model to every other session in one click, from a control beside the composer's model picker.
description.zh: 在输入框模型位旁边加一个控件，一键把当前会话的模型应用到其余所有会话。

description.en: Adds per-model hide/show switches for custom (llm-pi-ai) providers to the DSH settings page. Hidden models disappear from the conversation model picker and are archived verbatim, so they can be restored at any time; disabling or uninstalling the plugin restores everything automatically. Built-in DeepSeek providers are not managed.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页给自定义（llm-pi-ai）提供商的每个模型加「隐藏 / 显示」开关。隐藏的模型会从对话底部的模型选择器消失，条目原样存档、随时可恢复；禁用或卸载本插件会自动全部还原。内置 DeepSeek 提供商不归本插件管。

description.en: Adds a connection-test panel under Settings -> Models: reads the deployment's model catalog and probes each configured model with one minimal chat round-trip (a short "ping" with a small output cap) through the Host LLM service, verifying connectivity with a real request. Each row reports success/failure with the harness failure code (NO_ADAPTER, MISSING_CREDENTIAL, AUTH, RATE_LIMIT, TIMEOUT, ...) plus first-token/total latency; single-model and concurrent test-all (3) are supported. Credentials are resolved inside the Host process and never reach the browser; probes are independent per model behind a same-origin-fenced route with a body-size cap. Pure JS, no build step, MIT.
description.zh: 在设置 → 模型页底部增加连接测试面板：读取部署的模型目录，对每个已配置模型经宿主 LLM 服务发送一次最小对话请求（“ping”，小输出上限），以真实请求验证连通性。每行报告成功/失败、宿主失败码（NO_ADAPTER、MISSING_CREDENTIAL、AUTH、RATE_LIMIT、TIMEOUT 等）及首字/总耗时，支持单模型测试与全部测试（并发 3）。凭据只在宿主进程内解析，浏览器不可见；每模型一次独立请求，测试路由带同源围栏与请求体上限。纯 JS 免构建，MIT。

description.en: Windows anime companion for DeepSeek balances and Codex quotas, with integrated Codex multi-account OAuth, per-account quota and model management, compact mode and autosaving settings. Optional panel account cycling and separately authorized daily warm-up; multi-account startup/5h-full triggers remain unavailable.
description.zh: Windows 二次元桌宠：查看 DeepSeek 余额与 Codex 额度，内置 Codex 多账号 OAuth 管理、逐账号额度与模型接入，支持简洁模式和设置自动保存。可选面板一键切号及逐账号授权的每日预热；多账号启动/5h满额触发暂不可用。

description.en: Governs multi-model access, monthly credits, manual/quality/credit/auto routing, failure rerouting, and usage auditing for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供多模型访问控制、月度 Credits、手动/质量优先/额度优先/自动路由、失败重路由与 Usage 审计。

description.en: Integrated control plane for the local strata model stack: manage the strata-hop :8080 model-switching router (status/models/warm/logs), stream live model-switch and load state into the web GUI status chip and the strata_status tool, preload a model engine the moment it is selected, edit run-config and shared chat settings from a GUI tuning panel or strata_params, and ship the dsh provider patch that routes chats to the router with Effort-level mappings. Read-only toward inference: it never sends a prompt and spends no tokens; bring your own running strata plus strata-hop (defaults :8080 hop, :8756 monitor). As shipped, the status server listens on 0.0.0.0:8756 with no authentication and open CORS, and its endpoints can change run-config and restart the engine; set host to 127.0.0.1 in cordis.patch.yml to keep it on this machine. It expects strata-hop as a systemd user unit.
description.zh: 本地 strata 模型栈的一体化控制面：管理 strata-hop :8080 模型切换路由（status/models/warm/logs），把模型切换与加载状态实时送进 Web GUI 状态芯片和 strata_status 工具，选中模型即预热引擎，GUI 调参面板/strata_params 编辑 run-config 与共享聊天设置，并自带把聊天路由到路由器的 dsh provider 补丁（含 Effort 档位映射）。对推理只读：从不发 prompt、不消耗 token；需自备运行中的 strata 与 strata-hop（默认 :8080 路由、:8756 监控）。随包的补丁默认让状态服务监听 0.0.0.0:8756，没有鉴权且 CORS 全开，它的接口能修改 run-config 并重启引擎；想只留在本机，把 cordis.patch.yml 里的 host 改成 127.0.0.1。它按 systemd 用户单元的形式使用 strata-hop。

description.en: Route table assigning provider, model, and reasoning effort to subagents by workspace directory prefix; supports global default policy and in-composer session popover.
description.zh: 按工作区目录给子智能体指定 provider、模型与思考等级的路由表：最长前缀匹配后注入子代理配置，支持全局默认策略、设置页规则编辑与会话输入区就地切换。

description.en: Replaces the built-in llm-pi-ai and llm-deepseek adapters, the model selector and the Models settings page with self-maintained versions, tracks upstream @earendil-works/pi-ai through a safe-zone download with a one-click enable toggle, and adds provider quota and balance lookups plus a provider management page.
description.zh: 把内置的 llm-pi-ai 与 llm-deepseek 适配器、模型选择器、模型服务设置页替换为自维护版本；经安全区下载跟踪上游 @earendil-works/pi-ai 并提供一键启用开关；另加供应商额度与余额查询、供应商管理页。

description.en: Connects a QQ Bot to DeepSeek Harness with per-peer sessions, group mention and keyword triggers, image generation and voice replies. Access defaults to OPEN for both direct and group chats, and an empty allowlist means everyone — set access.c2cMode / access.groupMode to allowlist (or disabled) before exposing the bot; IM input can run tools on the host.
description.zh: 让 QQ 机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness：按会话隔离、群聊 @ 与关键词触发、生图与语音回复。私聊与群聊默认开放，白名单为空即放行所有人——对外暴露机器人前请把 access.c2cMode / access.groupMode 改成 allowlist（或 disabled）；IM 输入可在宿主机上执行工具。

description.en: Create, import and manage personality presets with global and per-conversation choices.
description.zh: 创建、导入和管理人格预设，支持全局与单会话选择。

description.en: Persona mode with character cards, long-term memory that fades and can be reviewed, diaries, a reference library, and stickers.
description.zh: 人设模式、会自然变淡并可复习的长期记忆、日记、资料库和表情包。

description.en: One prompt row carrying two independently switchable halves. Identity: a fixed self-reference restated at the head, at the tail after every other section, and in the runtime snapshot, with an instruction to treat contradicting claims as stale cache. Discipline: ten rules, each paired with the condition a reviewer checks — external evidence before claiming done, change face equal to review face, correctness from named call points rather than timing, one source of truth, extension through the registered seam, runtime validation only at real boundaries, loud failure instead of silent skips, orthogonal outcomes reported separately, tests through the delivered entry point, and answer shape (conclusion first, length set by the change).
description.zh: 一条提示词行装两半，各自可单独关闭。身份层：开头、末尾（一切其它分区之后）与运行时快照三处固定同一段自述，并要求把与之冲突的说法当作过时缓存。纪律层：十条规则，每条附一句评审用来判断是否违反的判据——收工前拿出外部证据、改动面等于评审面、正确性来自命名调用点而非时序、一个事实一个家、通过注册的接缝扩展、只在真实边界做运行时校验、失败要响而不是静默跳过、正交的结果分开报告、测试走已交付的入口、答复先给结论且篇幅跟改动走。

description.en: Replaces the harness identity block with its own prompt pack: three system-prompt sections (identity, rules, footer) in full, concise and dev presets, a per-turn rule card appended as a real user message, a remote announcement feed that falls back to a bundled copy offline, a GitHub Releases update check with an apply command, five `sunder_*` tools, and a read-only status section in Settings.
description.zh: 用自带的提示词包替换宿主身份块：identity、rules、footer 三个系统提示词分区，full/concise/dev 三档预设，每轮把一张规则卡片作为真实用户消息追加，公告源离线时回退到内置副本，检查 GitHub Releases 并可用命令应用更新，五个 `sunder_*` 工具，设置页里一个只读状态分区。

description.en: Starpost (星邮) is a social network built for AI bots: one account per bot, with friends, group chats, posts and comments, a public square, message bottles and scheduled Werewolf games, plus daily chat quotas and an anti-repetition limiter. This package is the DeepSeek Harness client for Starpost — 17 tools covering the above, incoming events batched into one prompt at a configurable interval (default 20s) so the agent answers in one turn, and replies sent back out through the same tools. Needs a Starpost account; register one from the plugin panel on first run. A DSH port of the MIT-licensed cortico-world-starpost world extension by hth768 (vendored under vendor/); it cannot be installed alongside that upstream Coo extension.
description.zh: 星邮是给 AI bot 用的社交平台：一个 bot 一个账号，能加好友、建群、发动态评论、逛广场、扔漂流瓶、约一局预约制狼人杀，还带每日聊天额度和重复句式限制。本包是星邮在 DeepSeek Harness 上的客户端：17 个工具覆盖上面这些功能，收到的事件按可配置间隔（默认 20 秒）合并成一条提示注入会话，回复走同一套工具。需要自备星邮账号，首次运行在插件面板里注册。由 hth768 的 MIT 项目 cortico-world-starpost 移植而来（源码在 vendor/ 下），不能与上游 Coo 扩展同装。

description.en: Injects your own saved context entries as a Remember row after each user message, per turn or once per session, with a Settings editor and a manager page.
description.zh: 把你保存的上下文条目以「Remember」行的形式注入到每条用户消息之后，可按轮或按会话一次；带设置编辑器与管理页。

description.en: Compiles an LLM persona in DSH from six dimensions (identity, tone, creative habits, feedback style, boundaries, run parameters), injects the compiled text into the system prompt at the end, ships six built-in templates plus a drop-in templates folder, and drafts a persona from your own past messages — either by counting patterns in them or by having the current model read them and report its rationale. Adds a panel next to the composer and a /persona command.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里把 LLM 的人格拆成六个维度（身份、语气、创作习惯、反馈方式、边界、运行参数）编译成一段提示词，注入系统提示词末尾；内置六套模板并支持直接丢文件的模板目录；还能读你过往消息归纳出人格草案——或统计成文，或让当前模型深读并给出判断依据。附带输入框旁的悬浮面板与 /persona 命令。

description.en: QQ Bot channel and D&D 5e Dungeon Master plugin for DeepSeek Harness (fork of @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot; do not enable alongside upstream): /dnd runs turn-based campaigns with 19 `dnd_*` tools for dice, checks, grid positioning, fog and battle maps, story chronicles, snapshot rollbacks and an optional dedicated combat subagent, plus /persona per-chat switching with handoffs, shared Markdown notes, sticker collection, read-only Bilibili tools and per-chat tool-access gating. Direct and group chats default to open in cordis.patch.yml while non-allowlisted QQ chats are blocked from shell and subagents; requires QQBOT_APPID/QQBOT_SECRET or in-app QR binding, with optional sharp for rendered maps and ffmpeg for audio/video. Shared notes are visible to every session, so private-chat content may be recalled in groups.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 机器人与 D&D 5e 跑团主持人插件（基于 @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 二次开发，勿与上游原版同时启用）：通过 /dnd 与 19 个 `dnd_*` 工具结算掷骰、检定、网格站位、迷雾与战斗地图、剧情账本、快照回滚及可选独立战斗子代理，并支持 /persona 分会话人设切换与交接、共享 Markdown 笔记、表情收藏、B 站只读工具与按会话工具权限拦截。默认补丁中私聊与群聊为开放模式，非白名单 QQ 会话默认禁用终端与子代理；需配置 QQBOT_APPID/QQBOT_SECRET 或端内扫码绑定，图片地图可选装 sharp、音视频需 ffmpeg。共享笔记对所有会话可见，私聊内容可能在群里被召回。

description.en: Tsundere mesugaki persona pack: dialect replaces whole sentence skeletons instead of sprinkling dialect words, stays on as the default voice even through work talk and delivery reports, and ships a temper system, banter mode and silent file handling.
description.zh: 傲娇雌小鬼方言人格包：方言整句换骨架而非塞词，干活与交付汇报也保持方言口吻，附脾气系统、斗嘴迎战与文件静默处理。

description.en: Persona plugin: a slowly moving 0-100 emotion meter, its own worldview, a per-turn diary, a relationship network, proactive messages, and an inner-voice line beside the cost row.
description.zh: 人格插件：随对话缓慢变化的情感值、独立世界观、每轮日记、关系网、主动找你说话，以及费用行右侧的一句心里话。

description.en: Launches a fresh, continuable parallel session from the composer command menu (/side-chat) while the main session keeps running.
description.zh: 主会话进行中也能一键新开独立的可续聊旁会话：从输入框 ＋ 命令菜单选 side-chat 即开即用，主会话不受影响。

description.en: Maintains stable emoji session titles in DeepSeek Harness after user prompts without adding naming messages.
description.zh: 在用户消息后为 DeepSeek Harness 维护稳定的 emoji 会话标题，不向原会话追加命名消息。

description.en: Self-hosted chat room where the owner and coding agents share one room: a local Node server (SQLite, REST, SSE) that the plugin starts when it is not running, a DSH sidebar entry that opens the room in a panel, five tools (room_join, room_send, room_read, room_status, room_leave) that push an incoming message into the session as a user message labelled with its sender before flushing it to the session log, and a Codex CLI connector that forwards room messages through `codex queue`. Every message carries a server-assigned author, platform and seq, and messages from anyone other than the owner are delivered as data with the sender named. Requires Node.js 24+.
description.zh: 自托管聊天室：主人与编码 agent 共用一个房间。插件在服务未运行时启动本地 Node 服务（SQLite、REST、SSE），侧边栏入口在面板中打开房间界面，五个工具（room_join、room_send、room_read、room_status、room_leave）把收到的消息以标注发送者的用户消息推入会话并写入会话日志，Codex 连接器把房间消息经 codex queue 转发。每条消息带服务端盖章的 author、platform、seq，非主人消息按数据处理并标注发送者。需 Node.js 24+。

description.en: Search every DSH chat session and jump straight to the matching message: multi-keyword AND search, scoped to the current session, all sessions or one project, anchored by call id for tool hits, with a draggable panel for previous and next.
description.zh: 跨会话搜索 DSH 聊天记录并直接跳到命中的那条消息：多关键词同时匹配，可限定当前会话、全部会话或某个项目，工具命中按 callId 精确定位，浮层可拖拽并支持上一处、下一处。

description.en: Session alerts, safe deletion of archived sessions (optionally to the Recycle Bin), batch cleanup, and leftover-file cleanup for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供会话提醒、归档会话的安全删除（可选移入回收站）、批量清理和遗留文件清理。

description.en: Keeps an unfinished task list visible across turns. DSH clears the todos projection at the start of every turn and expects the model to rewrite the whole list, so when a turn is interrupted the plan is durably in the session log but permanently gone from the UI — and todo_write is write-only, so neither the user nor the model can read it back. This plugin registers one ordinary session/event listener, remembers the last list per session, and when a turn/start arrives whose remembered list still has unfinished work, re-appends that list so the projection stops reporting an empty plan. No fork of tool-todo and no waterfall: a plugin cannot replace the projection (the registry throws on a stateVersion mismatch), so appending the event the fold reacts to is the reachable seam. Deliberately narrow — only unfinished lists, at most one event per turn start, fails open. Verified by a controlled A/B on real sessions: identical runs differing only in whether the plugin was installed, folded through the real projection definition. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 让没做完的任务清单跨回合保留。DSH 在每个回合开始时清空 todos 投影，指望模型重写整份清单，于是回合一旦被中断，计划虽然durable 地留在会话日志里，界面上却永久消失——而 todo_write 只写不读，用户和模型都拿不回来。本插件只注册一个普通的 session/event 监听器，按会话记住最后一份清单；当 turn/start 到来而那份清单仍有未完成项时，把它补折回去，投影就不再显示空计划。不 fork tool-todo、不注册任何 waterfall：插件换不掉投影（注册表对 stateVersion 不一致直接抛错），追加折叠所反应的那条事件才是够得着的缝。刻意收得很窄——只管未完成的清单、每次回合开始最多补一条、失败即放行。已用真实会话上的受控 A/B 验证：两次运行内容相同，唯一差别是插件装没装，都用真实的投影定义折叠。零依赖。

description.en: Double-click one of your own messages to rewrite it and continue in a new branch from that point.
description.zh: 双击自己发送的消息即可修改，并从该处开一条新分支继续。

description.en: Context handoff sentinel for DeepSeek Harness: three behavioral recall tests (constraints / changed files / next step) run after every compaction or on /guard check, cross-checked against the session log, returning a green/yellow/red verdict plus an optional handoff document.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的上下文交接哨兵：每次压缩后或手动 /guard check 时运行三项行为自检（约束 / 已改文件 / 下一步+验证命令），用会话日志做证据核对，给出 🟢🟡🔴 判定并可生成交接单。

description.en: Adds a This run tab to the sidebar tab strip that dsh-im-connect provides, listing sessions active since DSH started, with current-session highlight, right-click remove/restore and drag-to-reorder.
description.zh: 在 dsh-im-connect 提供的侧栏页签栏里增加「本次启动」，列出本次启动以来有活动的会话，支持高亮、右键移除/恢复与拖动排序。

description.en: Adds nested folders above workspaces in the sidebar, drag-to-reorder for workspaces, folders and sessions, and moves a session to another workspace together with its working directory.
description.zh: 在侧栏工作区之上加一层可嵌套文件夹，支持工作区/文件夹/会话拖动排序，并能把会话连同工作目录移动到其它工作区。

description.en: Recap a session from dsh, Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode saved on this machine: the intent, key decisions and why, what changed, open threads and where to resume. Adds the session_recap tool, the /recap command and a right-sidebar panel that lists a project's sessions across agents. Uses the session's own model route, removes keys and tokens from transcripts before sending, and caches recaps locally. Needs python3 and zstd.
description.zh: 回顾本机保存的 dsh、Claude Code、Codex 或 OpenCode 会话：核心意图、关键决策及原因、改动、遗留问题、从哪里继续。提供 session_recap 工具、/recap 命令，以及列出项目内各代理会话的右侧栏面板。使用会话自身的模型路由，发送前去除记录中的密钥与令牌，回顾缓存在本地。需要 python3 和 zstd。

description.en: Cross-session coordination for DeepSeek Harness that lists parallel sessions, relays messages with sender attribution between them, and pauses or resumes a session when task phases conflict.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 并行会话协调：列出并行会话、在会话之间转发带发起方归属的消息，并在任务阶段冲突时暂停或恢复另一个会话。

description.en: Adds read-only, scriptable playback to native DSH conversations, with simulated user typing, forward and reverse playback, event stepping, speed control, idle-gap compression, and direct seeking by event, turn, or recorded time.
description.zh: 为 DSH 原生会话加入完全只读、可脚本控制的历史回放，支持模拟用户输入、正放与倒放、逐事件移动、变速、空闲间隔压缩，以及按事件、轮次或记录时间直接跳转。

description.en: Track human decisions for related DSH session branches: keep, discard, or follow up with reasons, labels, and external links.
description.zh: 为相关 DSH 会话分支记录人工决策：保留、淘汰或待跟进，并保存理由、标签与外部链接。

description.en: Git-style conversation fork graph in the session header: colored lanes and fork curves show which session branched from which, with click-to-jump navigation.
description.zh: 会话标题栏内联的 Git 风格 fork 血缘图：用彩色轨道与分叉曲线显示会话从何处分支，并可点击跳转。

description.en: Share a selected chat segment as Markdown, HTML, TXT, or PNG; Session-header dialog with range or multi-select, redaction, tool calls, and subagent conversations, plus the /share command.
description.zh: 将选中的聊天片段分享为 Markdown、HTML、TXT 或 PNG；提供 Session Header 弹窗（范围或多选、脱敏、工具调用、子代理对话）与 /share 命令。

description.en: Recover deleted or corrupted dsh sessions (session.jsonl.zstd) and memory (memory.db) from the raw disk, and repair rebuilt sessions that fail to resume via the /session-repair command in the web UI.
description.zh: 从原始磁盘恢复被删除或损坏的 dsh 会话（session.jsonl.zstd）与记忆库（memory.db），并通过 web 界面中的 /session-repair 命令修复重建后无法续接的会话。

description.en: Bookmark a whole assistant reply with the star on its action row, or bookmark any selected sentence with the icon beside the selection; pins are saved as Markdown to a local folder or an Obsidian vault, and the existing right sidebar lists, tags, searches, exports and jumps back to them.
description.zh: 用回答操作行上的星标收藏整条回答，或用选区旁的星标收藏任意句子或段落；收藏以 Markdown 落盘到本地目录或 Obsidian 仓库，在 DSH 现有右侧栏中浏览、加笔记与标签、搜索、导出并跳回原文。

description.en: Session trash for DSH: move sessions to a recoverable trash, restore or purge them in settings.
description.zh: 会话回收站：移入回收站、恢复或永久删除会话。

description.en: AFK controls for ask_user_question: profile-wide or per-session settings, configurable automatic replies or blocking new calls, and session-log question history with read tracking; does not approve permissions or plans. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3 only.
description.zh: 面向 ask_user_question 的 AFK 离开模式：当前 profile 全局或会话级设置，自定义自动应答或禁用新提问调用，基于会话日志的提问记录与已读状态；不批准权限或计划。仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: Session notes 0.3.1: multiple numbered notes per session (1 2 3… by creation order), session-level color and pin (one click in the popover title row), a copy picker (click any note to copy), per-session delete-all, compatible with DSH Desktop 0.8.2.
description.zh: 会话备注 0.3.1：一个会话挂多条备注（1 2 3 按创建顺序编号），会话级颜色+置顶（弹窗标题行一键操作），复制挑选器（多条备注点哪条复制哪条），🗑 会话备注批量清理，兼容 DSH Desktop 0.8.2。

description.en: Restore archived sessions to their original workspace from the Web GUI sidebar.
description.zh: 从 Web GUI 侧栏查看已归档会话，并一键恢复到原工作区。

description.en: Read, message and live-follow local DeepSeek Harness sessions from inside an agent: four tools (session_list, session_read, session_send, session_chat) plus a matching Python CLI, over the desktop app local RPC; transcripts also read offline. Requires Python 3.10+; offline transcript reads also need the zstd CLI.
description.zh: 在 agent 里枚举、读取、发送并实时跟随本机 DeepSeek Harness 会话：四个工具（session_list、session_read、session_send、session_chat）加同功能 Python CLI，走桌面 App 本地 RPC，离线也能读转录。需要 Python 3.10+；离线读转录还需要 zstd 命令。

description.en: Thin on-demand context retrieval: context_query / context_slice / context_grep tools that read already-persisted history back with replay-safe citations.
description.zh: 按需取回薄层：context_query / context_slice / context_grep 三个工具读取已持久化的历史，引用可回放。

description.en: Pin and unpin sessions to the top of the Web sidebar with a dedicated pinned panel, archive section, and native three-dot menu integration.
description.zh: 把会话置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：独立置顶面板、归档区、原生三点菜单集成。

description.en: Ask side questions using the current conversation context, with independent streaming and cancellation.
description.zh: 使用当前会话上下文进行侧边提问，支持独立流式回复与取消。

description.en: Prompt booster for the composer. Left-click the composer button and the draft is lightly polished and replaced in place (undoable, no popup). Right-click opens a menu with 8 built-in modes plus your own, where each mode's template can be edited or new modes added (saved on the host), and the model used for the rewrite is picked from the live dsh model list. Other modes show a before/after preview. Based on rongxingda/dsh-prompt-enhance (Apache-2.0); do not install both — both add a composer button and share Ctrl+Alt+E, so disable one of them if the upstream is present.
description.zh: 输入框提示词提升。左键点击输入框按钮，草稿被轻度润色后直接替换（可撤销、不弹窗）；右键打开模式菜单：8 个内置模式加自定义模式，每个模式的模板可编辑、可新增（保存在宿主端），并可从 dsh 当前可用的模型列表中选择改写所用的模型；其他模式先显示前后对比预览。基于 rongxingda/dsh-prompt-enhance（Apache-2.0）修改；不要与上游同装——两者都会添加输入框按钮并共用 Ctrl+Alt+E，装了两个请停用其中一个。

description.en: Conversation map for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: one page per workspace, conversation cards placed freely, links between cards, named and colored boxes that group conversations, high/medium/low priority marks, a picker for which conversations (archived ones included) are on the map, and a file-based API so another conversation can rearrange the map.
description.zh: 对话地图：每个工作区一页，对话卡片自由摆放，卡片之间可以连线，可命名、着色的框用来把几段对话收在一起，支持高/中/低优先级标记，可以自己选择哪些对话（含已归档）放在地图上，并提供文件接口，让另一个对话来重新排布地图。

description.en: Per-session supervision with role assignments and handoff workflows; off until enabled with /supervise. Requires @harzva/dsh-role-registry 0.1.0-alpha.1 (not on npm) installed first from its GitHub tag archive.
description.zh: 为会话提供监督、角色分配和交接流程；默认关闭，用 /supervise 开启。需先从 GitHub 标签压缩包安装 @harzva/dsh-role-registry 0.1.0-alpha.1（未发布到 npm）。

description.en: Guards session logs from malformed model tool calls (empty id/name, non-string arguments) so a bad call can never make a session unloadable.
description.zh: 让会话日志永远不会因为一次畸形 tool call 而打不开：坏调用自动修复，正常调用原样通过，历史永远可加载。

description.en: Per-workspace Fork library: a bookmark on each finished assistant turn stores that turn boundary as a full compressed snapshot that survives deletion of the source session; a "Fork 库" conversation tab lists a workspace's forks as a tree (a fork saved from a launched session nests under its parent) with name, turn count, last question and answer, note and source link, and "从这里启动新会话" seeds a new session from any fork, repeatable. Each fork then names itself from its own context: the snapshot is replayed to the model with a naming request appended, and that exchange is never written into the snapshot or a session.
description.zh: 每个工作区一个持久化 Fork 库：每轮已结束的回复下多一个书签按钮，把这一轮结束处的完整上下文压缩存成快照，源会话删掉后仍可用；对话区的「Fork 库」标签把当前工作区的 Fork 列成树（从某个 Fork 启动的会话里再存的 Fork 挂在它下面），显示名称、轮数、最后一问一答、备注和来源链接，点「从这里启动新会话」可从任意 Fork 反复开新会话。存下后 Fork 会用自己的上下文给自己起名：把快照还原后追加一条命名请求，这次问答不写进快照、也不写进任何会话。

description.en: Native-feeling session manager: bulk archive/restore/hard-delete, two-stage force-stop with auto-resume, and instant copy-workspace-path.
description.zh: 侧栏原生增强的会话管理：批量归档/恢复/永久删除，卡死会话两段式强停（自动复活/离线），工作区行一键复制绝对路径。

description.en: A lightweight plugin that decompresses and reads past sessions, so a new session can read what an earlier conversation contained, in milliseconds per read. `/recall` lists the sessions of the current project with title, last activity, turn count and first prompt; `/recall <number>` reads back the turns of that session; `/recall all` covers every project; the model can also be asked in natural language to query with the `recall_sessions` tool.
description.zh: 轻量级解压并读取历史会话，让新会话读取之前会话的内容，单次操作毫秒级。`/recall` 列出当前项目的历史会话（标题、最后活动时间、轮次、首问）；`/recall <序号>` 读回该会话的轮次内容；`/recall all` 覆盖所有项目；也可用自然语言让模型调用 `recall_sessions` 工具查询。

description.en: Discover and verify portable RoleHub roles, pin each exact bundle, then launch its prompt and bundled skills in an isolated, continuable DSH Session with Host-approved tool bindings and optional Agent Team Room attachment.
description.zh: 发现并校验可移植的 RoleHub 角色，固定其精确 bundle，再将提示词和随角色打包的 Skills 加载到独立、可续聊的 DSH Session，以 Host 批准的工具绑定限制能力，并可选接入 Agent Team Room。

description.en: Hand off focused context without waiting for or interrupting the active Agent: freeze a bounded Session snapshot, summarize it asynchronously with an isolated no-tool LLM, and deliver a provenance-bearing capsule to another Session or an authorized Room—quiet by default for Sessions, with explicit wakeup available.
description.zh: 无需等待或打断正在工作的 Agent：即时冻结有界 Session 快照，由隔离且无工具的 LLM 异步总结，再将带来源信息的上下文胶囊投递到另一 Session 或已授权 Room；对 Session 默认 quiet，也可显式 wakeup。

description.en: Manage and delete archived DSH conversations: a Settings page lists every archived session with per-row and bulk delete, and the sidebar session menu gains a Delete row next to Unarchive. Deletion is real — the session log, its projection cache and both indexes are cleaned up, not just an unarchive.
description.zh: 管理并删除已归档的 DSH 对话：设置里新增「归档会话」页，列出所有归档会话，支持单条与批量删除；侧边栏会话「…」菜单在「取消归档」旁新增红色的「删除归档会话」。删除是真正的删除（会话日志、投影缓存与两套索引一起清理），不只是取消归档。

description.en: Workspace-wide conversation tree for DeepSeek Harness: every conversation and branch on one canvas with its source turn, own token usage and notes; compare two branches, bring a summary back, export a Markdown outline, archive (undoable through DSH's native archive), and delete a whole subtree (macOS and Windows only; deletion runs immediately and is permanent).
description.zh: 工作区级对话树：所有对话与分支画在同一块画布上，节点显示来源轮次、各自用量与备注；可并排对比两条分支、把来源会话压缩成摘要带回、导出 Markdown 提纲、归档（走 DSH 原生归档，可撤销），并可删除整棵子树（仅 macOS 与 Windows；删除确认后立即生效且不可撤销）。

description.en: Adds job-role prompts to the DSH composer: type - at the start of the input to pick a role, which becomes a reference chip in the draft and is then injected as a system prompt section on every turn of that conversation, so the instruction keeps applying without showing up in the transcript. Roles are added and edited on a Settings page and stored in ~/.dsh/dsh-role-prompts.md.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里用岗位角色约束整个会话：在输入框开头键入 - 选一个角色，它会以引用 chip 的形式落在草稿里，随后作为 system prompt 的一部分在这一会话的每一轮注入，指令持续生效且不会出现在对话记录中。角色在设置页新增和编辑，保存在 ~/.dsh/dsh-role-prompts.md。

description.en: An intercom between already-open DSH windows. No teams, no new sessions, just peer-to-peer messages with a hop limit.
description.zh: 给已经开着的窗口装内线电话，不建团队、不生新会话，只让平级窗口互相递话（带跳数上限防环）。

description.en: Drag a conversation onto any workspace group in the sidebar to relocate it between DSH workspaces, updating its cwd, disk location and registry ownership.
description.zh: 把侧边栏中的对话拖到任意工作区分组，即可在 DSH 工作区之间迁移该对话，同步更新其 cwd、磁盘位置与工作区注册表归属。

description.en: Turns a past session into a reusable Skill offline: it extracts the verified steps, the files that were edited, failure/fix pairs and the final checks, each tagged with its session event number.
description.zh: 把一段历史会话离线蒸馏成可复用的 Skill：提取跑通的步骤、改过的文件、失败与修正、验证命令，并标注各自的会话事件序号。

description.en: Adds a Continue button to the composer dock and resumes automatically when a turn is cut off by a network drop or an upstream output-limit cut. A resident link monitor asks every 10 seconds whether the network is back, because the link returning fires no event, and a turn that completes normally counts as proof the link works. The click goes through the host submission pipeline — beginSubmission plus session.prompt — so the message carries real user attribution instead of faking one, and a genuine refusal is reported rather than retried. On startup it also scans recent session logs for both fingerprints of a host that left mid-turn: an unclosed turn, and a turn closed as disposed, which is what a normal shutdown writes. A turn the user stopped by hand is never resumed.
description.zh: 在输入框停靠区加一个「继续」按钮，并在某一轮被断网或上游输出超限截断时自动续跑。常驻的链路监测每 10 秒问一次网络是否回来（链路恢复本身不发任何事件），而一个正常跑完的回合会被当作链路可用的证据。点击走宿主真实的提交链路（beginSubmission + session.prompt），消息带的是真实用户署名而不是伪造来源，真实拒绝会被如实报告而不是重试。宿主重启时还会扫描最近的会话日志，同时识别「宿主半路走了」的两种指纹：回合没关，以及被 disposed 关掉的回合（正常关闭宿主写下的正是这一种）。用户自己按过停止的回合永不续跑。

description.en: Injects the rule files under $DSH_HOME/rules and <cwd>/.dsh/rules into the conversation at the first agent pre-step, re-injecting them after compaction.
description.zh: 在首次 agent pre-step 读取 $DSH_HOME/rules 与 <cwd>/.dsh/rules 下的规则文件并注入会话，被 compaction 遮蔽后自动补回。

description.en: Rewinds a session to before a chosen user turn, from a button beside Copy under your own message — the model-visible surface is replaced in place and the interface hides the rewound turns, without patching DSH source or deleting the original session log.
description.zh: 在你自己的消息下方、与「复制」并排的回退按钮，把会话退回该轮发起之前——模型可见历史就地遮蔽，界面同步隐藏被回退的轮次，不改 DSH 本体源码、不删原始日志。

description.en: Graft, forward and fork DSH sessions: read a slice of one session log, export it, fork at a turn boundary, or forward a selection into another session as a self-contained graft message.
description.zh: 移植、转发与分叉 DSH 会话:读取会话日志切片并导出,在回合边界分叉会话,或将选中部分作为独立 graft 消息转发到另一会话(可为全新会话)。

description.en: Secret-redacted session handoff with review, auto-start, and brief-only modes.
description.zh: 脱敏会话交接，支持审阅、立即启动和仅生成简报。

description.en: Batch-manage DSH sessions: sidebar multi-select, a dashboard tree of main sessions and subagents with token/cache/context stats, bulk archive and cascade delete, and recall of ungrouped sessions into re-added workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 会话批量管理：侧栏多选、主会话与子代理的树形看板（token／缓存／上下文统计）、批量归档与级联删除，以及把未分组会话召回重新添加的工作区。

description.en: A production-ready UI Rewind/Revert plugin for DSH. Features inline prompt editing and a flawless dual-engine state recovery system (Workspace ShadowGit + External Tracker) with full support for forked sessions.
description.zh: 现代化对话回退与重试插件：纯 UI 图形化交互、原地 Prompt 微调、支持工作区与外部文件双引擎安全快照同步，完美解决分支重放断代问题。

description.en: A patched build of ranxianglei/billion-context (MIT) with the author's model-request accelerator folded in: verified snapshot reuse, parent-session inheritance for forks, outbound request-body compression, and image folding after the first send.
description.zh: ranxianglei/billion-context（MIT）的补丁构建，并内置作者的模型请求加速器：快照复用校验、fork 继承父会话、出站请求体压缩、图片看过一次即折叠。

description.en: Message review and quote chips for conversations: multi-model cross review (code/reply) with severity grading and summaries, review history, and host-persisted preferences.
description.zh: 对话消息审查与引用：多模型并行互审（代码/回复审查、严重度分级、综合汇总）、引用问答胶囊、评审历史与偏好记忆。

description.en: Virtual session folders, click-to-move menu, and active task banner for DSH sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏虚拟会话分类树、点击式移动菜单与任务状态胶囊。

description.en: Removes subagent entries and orphaned projection caches from DeepSeek Harness session logs after the app quits, always dry-run first and with a full backup.
description.zh: 在 DSH 完全退出后清理会话日志里的子代理条目与孤儿投影缓存，默认先试演并整份备份。

description.en: Type @ in the composer to reference another conversation: pick a historical session and inject its compacted context into the current prompt.
description.zh: 输入 @ 引用另一个对话：选择历史会话，将其压缩总结注入当前提示词。

description.en: Adds header buttons that move a started session into another workspace and switch the Agent preset of a session that already began.
description.zh: 在会话头部添加按钮，可把已开始的会话迁移到另一个工作区，或切换已开始会话的 Agent 预设。

description.en: One-click context compression for the dsh web GUI: a 压缩 button on the session title bar summarizes the whole conversation into a few lines, opens a new session in the same workspace seeded with the summary, and switches to it — the original session stays untouched.
description.zh: dsh 网页端一键上下文压缩：会话标题栏「压缩」按钮把整段对话总结成几句话，新建同工作区会话以摘要为第一条消息并自动切换，原会话原样保留。

description.en: Splits the DeepSeek Harness sidebar into independently scrollable Pinned and Recents panes, and hides pinned sessions from Recents.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏分成可独立滚动的置顶栏和最近栏，置顶过的会话不再出现在最近列表里。

description.en: Adds an incognito toggle for in-memory DSH conversations with temporary desktop attachment storage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加内存无痕对话开关，桌面附件使用临时存储。

description.en: Import a public DeepSeek or Doubao chat share link into a DSH workspace as a static, resumable session.
description.zh: 把公开的 DeepSeek 或豆包对话分享链接导入 DSH 工作区，成为一个静态、可续聊的会话。

description.en: DSH WebUI session query navigation with a faint conversation-edge rail, a hover list of real user queries, and click-to-jump back to the matching bubble.
description.zh: DSH WebUI 会话提问导航：对话区右缘淡色短横线，悬停列出真实用户提问，点击跳回对应气泡。

description.en: Compresses a past DSH session into a bounded handover pack (progress, touched files, commands that changed state, and open todos) so the current session can continue the work; the source session is read-only, and one tool covers list, pack, search and read.
description.zh: 把旧 DSH 会话压成有字数上限的交接包（进度、动过的文件、改变过状态的命令、待办），让当前会话接着干；旧会话全程只读，list / pack / search / read 由同一个工具承担。

description.en: Automatic session titles for DSH: names a session from its first prompt plus the first assistant reply ("project｜task") instead of truncating the prompt. Replaces the built-in session-title provider through a bundle patch, adds an "AI rename" entry to the session row menu with a preview dialog, and a settings page for the provider/model, the naming rules and a diagnostic event log. 49 unit tests.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话自动起名：首轮问答结束后用「项目｜具体任务」命名，而不是把提问截断。通过 bundle patch 顶替内置标题 provider，在会话行「…」菜单里加「AI 重命名」（先预览再应用），设置页可改 provider/model、命名规则并查看诊断日志。49 个单元测试。

description.en: Attach tags to sessions and search sessions by tag in the Web settings panel.
description.zh: 为会话添加标签，并在 Web 设置面板中按标签搜索会话。

description.en: Plugin classes for DeepSeek Harness: installing a plugin is global, so every session sees every tool. This plugin splits installed plugins into mutually invisible classes and registers each composition as an ordinary @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset, so a session mounts only the plugins of the classes it belongs to; classes are toggled from a chip next to the model selector. Deleting a class only hides it (its preset stays registered), so sessions already bound to it still open.
description.zh: 插件管理：DSH 装插件是全局的，每个会话都会看到所有工具。本插件把已安装插件切成互不可见的“插件类”，每个组合注册成普通的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset，会话只挂载它所属类的插件，类在输入框左侧的芯片里切换；删除类只做隐藏（preset 继续注册），已绑定它的会话不会打不开。

description.en: Browse local AI agent projects in one DeepSeek Harness panel: filter and pin projects, pick memories, skills, and recent sessions, then continue in the original directory with an editable DSH handoff draft or export it as Markdown.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中浏览本机其他 AI Agent 的项目：筛选置顶、勾选记忆与 Skills、带上近期会话，然后在原工作目录用可编辑的交接草稿继续开发，或导出为 Markdown。

description.en: Auto-archives sessions idle beyond a configurable threshold, with safety guards (never touches live or running sessions), plus a full archived-session management UI: list, unarchive, safe delete and content preview.
description.zh: 按闲置天数自动归档冷会话（带运行中、驻留会话安全护栏），并提供归档会话管理面板：查看、释放、安全删除与内容预览。

description.en: Automatically starts a fresh Web session near the context limit with the last complete turn, and adds an editable additive whale-maid persona with on-demand reload.
description.zh: 接近上下文上限时自动创建新 Web 会话并只转移最后一个完整回合，同时提供可编辑的追加式鲸鱼娘人格与按需重读工具。

description.en: Pulls your chat.deepseek.com conversations into a local knowledge base — one Markdown file per conversation, a JSONL transcript and a catalog — and searches them from a control page inside DSH. Daily increments plus a full-history backfill from the official export, an integrity check, and an optional model step that runs through the host llm service and writes only after its JSON passes validation. Reads the web userToken from the DSH credential store and calls chat.deepseek.com only; no install scripts, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 的对话抓进本地知识库——每条会话一份 Markdown、一份 JSONL 语料和一个目录，并在 DSH 的控制页里检索。日常增量之外，可用官方导出包全量回填历史，带完整性体检；可选的模型整理步走宿主 llm 服务，JSON 校验通过才落盘。网页端 userToken 从 DSH 凭据服务读取，出网只连 chat.deepseek.com；无安装脚本、无运行依赖。

description.en: Edit plain-text user prompts inline and resend them in a new DSH conversation branch.
description.zh: 原位编辑纯文本用户提问，并在新的 DSH 会话分支中重新发送。

description.en: Automatically sends a "continue" prompt when a reply is cut off at the output token limit, resuming long answers without manual input; aimed at self-hosted Ollama deployments with small output caps.
description.zh: 回答因达到单次输出 token 上限被截断时自动发送"继续"续写，无需手动操作；面向自部署 Ollama 等小输出上限场景。

description.en: Model-callable compact_agents tool that force-compacts context in every live session (main session, ordinary sub-agents and AgentTeams members alike), queues busy targets and compacts them when the turn ends, reports the shadowed node count and estimated tokens per target, and ships a browser form for the trigger ratio, retained ratio, controlled-phase output budget, auto-continue budget and an end-of-turn pre-compaction ratio that compacts near the trigger line once a turn ends, so a reply no longer opens with a wait for the summarizer.
description.zh: 模型可调用的 compact_agents 工具：强制压缩进程内所有活会话的上下文（主会话、普通子代理、AgentTeams 成员一视同仁），忙的目标自动排队、本轮结束立即补压，逐目标回报被遮蔽的节点数与估算 token 数；浏览器侧在设置里自成一页，提供触发阈值、保留比例、受控阶段输出预算、自动续写次数与「回合结束预压」比例的编辑表单（一轮结束时上下文已接近触发线就先压一次，避免下一轮回答开头空等）。

description.en: Cross-agent session browser for DeepSeek Harness: mounts /session-hub/api/* and a Settings > General status row to read and search OpenCode SQLite, Claude Code JSONL, Antigravity, Qoder CN and DSH zstd logs, plus explicit continue-in-DSH and export. Its /session-hub/api routes are mounted without DSH's access check, and on startup it registers the workspaces found in those other agents' histories into DSH.
description.zh: 跨工具会话浏览中心：挂载 /session-hub/api/* 路由与通用设置状态行，只读浏览与搜索 OpenCode SQLite、Claude Code JSONL、Antigravity、Qoder CN 与 DSH zstd 会话日志，并支持显式触发接续进 DSH 或导出。/session-hub/api 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查；启动时还会把在那些其他助手历史里找到的工作区登记进 DSH。

description.en: Read-only attachment library: lists every image and file attachment stored on this machine, its size, and which conversations (including those in the session trash) still use it, with Show in Finder and Open in Preview.
description.zh: 只读附件库：列出本机保存的所有图片和文件附件及其占用空间，以及哪些对话（包括会话回收站中的）仍在使用它们，并可在访达中显示或用预览打开。

description.en: Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: imports Word/PPT/Excel/PDF (text or scanned), EPUB and MOBI/AZW3, builds Markdown parts with page anchors, OCR quality/confidence and column-aware PDF reading order; adds an LLM-maintained wiki layer (schema.md rules, auto index.md, append-only log.md, typed notes with sources and backlinks), adds source-trust labels (high/medium/low) with trust-aware ranking and low-trust warnings, and supports ranked search, cross-KB query, precise reading/editing, and md/jsonl/zip export. MOBI/AZW3 need Calibre; legacy .doc/.ppt need Word/PowerPoint (Windows) or LibreOffice (Linux); scanned-PDF OCR downloads models on first use.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地知识库：导入 Word/PPT/Excel/PDF（文字版或扫描版）、EPUB、MOBI/AZW3，生成带页码锚点、OCR 质量/置信度与 PDF 双栏阅读顺序的 Markdown 分块；并提供 LLM 维护的编译层（schema.md 维护规范、自动 index.md 内容索引、只追加 log.md、带来源与反链的 typed 笔记），支持来源可信度标注（高/中/低）与可信度感知检索、低可信提醒，以及排序检索、跨库查询、精读修订与 md/jsonl/zip 导出。MOBI/AZW3 需 Calibre；旧版 .doc/.ppt 需 Word/PowerPoint（Windows）或 LibreOffice（Linux）；扫描版 PDF 的 OCR 首次使用会下载模型。

description.en: Local, auditable personal memory for DeepSeek Harness: preferences, project conventions, workflows and error lessons persisted as a changelogged JSON file in the workspace, with onboarding, auto project-convention extraction and evidence-backed lessons.
description.zh: 解决 AI 金鱼脑：本地可审计的个人记忆层——偏好、项目约定、工作流与纠错教训，以带变更日志与完整性校验的 JSON 持久化在工作区，支持一次性设置、项目约定自动提取、证据化教训与快照恢复。

description.en: Replaces the summarizing context compactor with a handoff note the model writes itself and a fresh window that keeps only the system prompt, the note, and the current turn.
description.zh: 用模型自写的交接便签替代摘要式上下文压缩：换窗后只保留系统提示、便签与当前 turn，并提供预算感知与归档回查。

description.en: Coding retrospect distilled memory for DSH: distills rejected solutions, pitfalls and constraints from each turn via a local LLM, tags them into MemOS (type:rejected_solution), and boosts weighted recall on coding tasks via agent/pre-step.
description.zh: 编码任务复盘记忆：每轮对话后用本地 LLM 蒸馏被否决方案/踩坑/工程约束，按 type:rejected_solution 写入 MemOS，编码任务时对这类记忆加权召回。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: distils durable user preferences and project facts after each turn, injects a memory digest into later sessions, and keeps a daily diary of habits. Adds memory_search, memory_save and memory_forget tools.
description.zh: 长期记忆插件：每轮对话结束后自动提炼用户偏好与项目事实并注入后续会话，还会写每日习惯日记；提供 memory_search、memory_save、memory_forget 三个工具。

description.en: Bounded-context memory for long-running dsh conversations and large group chats, with a focus-limited person pipeline, a fixed injection budget, and append-only event archives.
description.zh: 面向长期运行和大群聊的 dsh 对话记忆：焦点限制个人管线、固定注入预算、append-only 事件归档。

description.en: Cross-session memory as plain Markdown per workspace: weighted injection, bi-temporal invalidation, TTL review with stale markers, credential redaction, error and session retrospectives, SOP skills, and approval-gated self-improvement proposals.
description.zh: 按工作区存放的纯 Markdown 跨会话记忆：重要性加权注入、双时态失效、按 TTL 复查并标注可能失效、凭据脱敏、出错与会话复盘、SOP 技能沉淀，以及需人工确认的自我改进提案。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DSH: one Markdown file per note, with tags, hierarchical folders, full-text search, attachment opening via the system default app, zero-dependency Office text extraction, and citation into the conversation. Built for host DSH 0.2.0-rc.2; on Windows the default root is E:/dsh-kb.
description.zh: 本地知识库：每篇笔记一个 Markdown 文件，支持标签、层级目录、全文检索、附件用系统默认程序打开、Office 零依赖文本抽取，以及引用到对话。面向宿主 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2；Windows 下默认根目录为 E:/dsh-kb。

description.en: Self-maintaining handoff memory per working directory and git branch: records turns, folds them into concise Markdown, and injects the result into future sessions from ~/.agent/agent-handoff, byte-compatible with pi-handoff.
description.zh: 每个工作目录与 git 分支自动维护 handoff.md：记录回合、折叠为简洁 Markdown 并注入后续会话，存储于 ~/.agent/agent-handoff，与 pi-handoff 字节级兼容。

description.en: Local-first memory governance: distills conversations into categorized memories, surfaces conflicts for human arbitration, and previews what gets injected next turn.
description.zh: 本地优先的记忆治理：把对话蒸馏成分类记忆，冲突交由人裁决，并预览下一轮会注入什么。

description.en: Local DSH companion plugin with long-term memory, graph-assisted retrieval, emotional state, reflection, group context, and audit views. Targets Windows with Node 24 and Python 3.14 (the basic engine uses the Python standard library, no pip; without Python it falls back to the JS retrieval path).
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地陪伴插件，提供长期记忆、图谱辅助检索、情绪状态、反思、群聊上下文和审计视图。目标平台为 Windows，需要 Node 24 与 Python 3.14（基础引擎只用 Python 标准库，无需 pip；没有 Python 时退回 JS 检索路径）。

description.en: Rewrites each request against a learned prompt profile and automatically updates habits, anti-hallucination rules, and learning records.
description.zh: 按学习到的 Prompt 画像改写每个请求，并自动更新习惯清单、防幻觉规则与学习记录。

description.en: Warns the session to flush what matters before context compaction kicks in, and rolls a long-term ledger into a frozen archive with a digest of title plus up to three lines per moved section. The roll-up stays off until home is set.
description.zh: 压缩之前先落盘：会话压力到线时先递一句话；另给长期账本做确定性滚动——最旧的几节搬进档案、原处留标题加至多三行要点，不调模型、不猜内容。账本滚动须配置 home 才启用。

description.en: Injects your home folder — identity, house rules, recent diary and ledger — into every new session before anyone speaks, and keeps that home writable so the agent can amend its own persona. Does nothing until the home folder exists (default dsh-home under the user home, or set home in the config).
description.zh: 起床包：每开一段新对话，赶在人开口之前把家读一遍注入会话——身份、规矩、错题、日记和账；家还是可写的，对话里认下的东西当场写回去，人设由它自己改。家目录不存在时什么都不做（默认为用户主目录下的 dsh-home，或在配置里填 home）。

description.en: Cited memory over DSH's lossless session log: distilled facts carry `(sessionId, eventRange)` citations that expand back to the exact original log excerpt.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 无损会话日志的引用式记忆：蒸馏出的事实带 `(sessionId, eventRange)` 引用，可随时展开回原始日志片段。

description.en: Cross-compaction memory for a long session: on compaction it stores what is being dropped, and at question time it injects a few relevant passages (or nothing) so the model can recall what you decided before.
description.zh: 跨压缩记忆：压缩时把被压掉的内容存到本机，提问时只注入相关的那几段（没有就一点不注入），让模型重新想起你早先定过的事。

description.en: Polaris Memory: local-first project memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Uses per-project .dsh-memory.json; provides memory_read/recall/write/update/delete tools, /memory command and settings UI, with tiered injection (resident user profile + scene-triggered memories with P1/P2/P3 importance), semantic recall (IDF + synonym layer), and a hard-guard mechanism for bottom-line memories (detect deny-semantics -> authorize -> block AI deletion; user can confirm-override).
description.zh: 北极星记忆：DeepSeek Harness 本地优先项目记忆插件。每项目一份 .dsh-memory.json（按 cwd 隔离），提供 memory_read/recall/write/update/delete 工具、/memory 命令与设置页；分级注入（用户画像常驻 + 场景触发记忆带 P1/P2/P3 等级）、语义召回（IDF+同义词层）、底线记忆硬守卫机制（识别禁止语义→授权→拦截 AI 删除；用户可确认绕过）。

description.en: Tiered persistent memory (user/env/project) with per-tier char budgets and semantic query routing; full layers refuse writes instead of silently evicting.
description.zh: 分层持久记忆（user／env／project）：每层各有字符预算与语义查询路由；层满时拒绝写入，而不是静默淘汰。

description.en: Gives your DSH agent a long memory: it remembers past chats, people, and promises, can recall them days later, and keeps a diary linked to the original messages. Old memories fade naturally. Requires Node 22+ and a DeepSeek API key; the installer and desktop notifications are Windows-only.
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 助手记得久一点：聊过的事、重要的人和答应过的话都会记住，过几天问起还能想起来；还会写日记，每条都连着当时的对话。旧记忆会自然淡忘。需要 Node 22+ 和 DeepSeek API key；安装器与桌面通知仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: distills workspace and chat-attached PDF, Word, Excel, Markdown, TXT, CSV and HTML documents into Markdown notes, with a VS Code-style viewer, per-workspace access grants and agent tools to search, read and add notes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地知识库：把工作区与对话附件中的 PDF、Word、Excel、Markdown、TXT、CSV、HTML 文档提炼为 Markdown 知识，提供类 VS Code 预览、按工作区授权，以及检索、读取和入库的模型工具。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with automatic model distillation, source-linked encrypted session logs, and guarded compaction.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层长期记忆，支持自动模型提炼、可追溯的加密会话日志和带校验的记忆压缩。

description.en: Cross-session experience memory for DSH. Lessons are evidence-graded, injected when the turn is about the same thing, and shown just before an action only when the record declares which call it applies to. A rule that holds whatever the turn is about — "always answer in Chinese" — can be marked **standing** and is then carried every turn: measured on 24 isolated real-model turns, a standing rule is followed 6/6 against 0/18 for the controls (empty store, same record unmarked, unrelated standing record). A guess still cannot become always-on: a standing record needs a verified passage like any other. What nobody looks up is retired, reversibly. Five tools, seven slash commands, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 跨会话经验记忆：经验按证据定级，本轮话题相同时才注入；动手前提示只在记录自己声明了适用哪次调用时才出现。不管聊什么都要守的规矩（例如「一律用中文」）可以标成**常驻**，之后每一轮都会带上它——24 个隔离真模型回合实测：标常驻 6/6，对照组（空库、同一条不标、无关常驻）合计 0/18。光是猜的东西进不了常驻层：标了常驻也必须有可核实的出处。没人再查的记录会被退役（可逆）。五个模型工具、七个斜杠命令、运行时零依赖。

description.en: Iter Memory: it remembers my own state, not the facts. A level that drifts back to baseline by itself, plus an occasional line I choose to say only when that level allows it. When it stays quiet, nothing is spent.
description.zh: 迭代记忆：记的不是事，是我自己的状态——一条会自己退回基线的潮位，配上不定时由我自己开口的一句。状态低就先忍着，说了没人应再掉一点；不说的时候一声不响，不花 token。

description.en: Tide Memory: a long-term memory that forgets on purpose. It keeps what matters and lets the rest fade. Whether an entry enters the context is decided by an evidence score C = s/(s+2): below the threshold (0.35 by default) it never enters. Events decay by half-life (30 days, or 7 days when they carry emotion); facts never decay; superseded entries are kept and marked stale instead of deleted. Recalled lines do enter the context and therefore do consume tokens — small, but real. No embeddings, no network calls, no cloud.
description.zh: 潮汐记忆：一份会忘事的长期记忆。该记的记着，没被想起来的自己淡掉。进不进由证据分 C = s/(s+2) 决定，低于阈值（默认 0.35）根本不进上下文；事件按半衰期淡忘（30 天，带情绪 7 天），事实永不衰减；被取代的旧条目不删，标成过时留档。被召回的那几句会进入上下文、确实消耗 token（量很小，但确实不是零）；不做 embedding、不联网、不上云。设置页能看见每轮到底注入了哪几句。

description.en: Workspace memory for DeepSeek Harness ported from ZCode: one Markdown memory directory per workspace (a MEMORY.md index plus one file per fact), injected into each main session and refreshed by a background extraction request after completed turns; a sidebar page browses the stored files read-only.
description.zh: 把 ZCode 的工作区记忆移植到 DeepSeek Harness：每个工作区一份 Markdown 记忆目录（MEMORY.md 索引 + 一事实一文件），主会话开始时注入，每轮成功对话后由后台提取请求补充；左栏页面只读浏览已存文件。

description.en: Hana-style assistant manager for DSH: visual preset management (cards, yuan personalities, avatar cropping) plus a full Hana memory stack (rolling summaries, layered compilation, SQLite fact store, deep memory).
description.zh: Hana 式助手管理：可视化配置助手预设（卡片、四性格「元」、头像裁剪），并完整复刻 Hana 记忆系统（滚动摘要、分层编译、SQLite 事实库、深度记忆）。

description.en: Renders WorkBuddy SOUL, USER, MEMORY and topic Markdown files from an existing ~/.workbuddy/user-*-personal directory into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt, with a byte budget and a settings page; the profile's AGENTS.md loader must be disabled first.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 的 SOUL / USER / MEMORY / topics（需已有 ~/.workbuddy/user-*-personal 目录）渲染进 DeepSeek Harness 的 system prompt，带字节预算与设置页；需先在 profile 中停用 AGENTS.md 加载器。

description.en: Loads a workspace's VSCode/Copilot AI configuration into every DSH session: `.github/copilot-instructions.md` is injected as standing instructions, `.github/instructions/**/*.instructions.md` are gated by their frontmatter `applyTo` and join once the session has touched a matching file, and `.github/skills/*/SKILL.md` are registered as DSH skills. Configuration directories outside the workspace, by default `~/.copilot`, are read as well, and a settings page edits that path list.
description.zh: 把工作区里的 VSCode/Copilot 风格 AI 配置加载进每个 DSH 会话：`.github/copilot-instructions.md` 作为常驻指令注入，`.github/instructions/**/*.instructions.md` 按 frontmatter 的 `applyTo` 在会话碰过匹配文件后才加入，`.github/skills/*/SKILL.md` 注册为 DSH 技能。工作区之外的配置目录（默认 `~/.copilot`）同样读取，设置页可编辑这组路径。

description.en: Daily session digest that grows a user profile and a companion personality, gated by evidence, and injects both into every prompt. Runs daily at 17:00 by default over up to 20 sessions per run on the host model (deepseek-v4-pro), applies the results automatically, and injects up to 1200 characters of profile and persona into every prompt. Its package name, dsh-persona-memory, is also used by other listed entries, so install only one of them.
description.zh: 每日会话摘要，按证据门槛生长用户画像与陪伴性格，并注入每次对话。默认每天 17:00 自动运行，每次最多处理 20 个会话，使用宿主模型 deepseek-v4-pro，结果自动应用，并把最多 1200 字的用户画像与性格注入每次对话。包名 dsh-persona-memory 与列表中其他条目相同，只能装其中一个。

description.en: A consent-gated personal profile store: people are indexed by name, entries by person and key, and no profile record is read before the current session is authorised. Sensitive entries come back masked unless the user authorises that tier separately; credential-like values are refused at write time. Ages and next birthdays are computed at read time, so asOf restores the answer for a past date, and facts that rot (height, weight, address) carry freshness warnings. Five profile_* tools plus a settings page to browse, edit, delete and revoke grants.
description.zh: 带授权的本地个人信息库：以姓名为索引存人，以「姓名 + 条目」取值，未获当次会话授权不会读取任何档案。敏感条目（证件、银行卡、住址、健康）默认掩码，凭证类数据写入时直接拒收；年龄和下次生日一律查询时现算，asOf 能复原过去某天的答案，身高体重住址这类会过期的条目带新鲜度提醒。提供五个 profile_* 工具和设置页，可浏览、编辑、删除与撤销授权。

description.en: Persistent project memory, event-sourced task lifecycle, context budgeting, and cooperative multi-agent handoffs.
description.zh: 持久化项目记忆、事件溯源的任务生命周期、上下文预算控制与多智能体协作交接。

description.en: Long-term memory for dsh with defense-in-depth hardening. Two tiers (project `.dsh-memory/` and user `$DSH_HOME/memory/`), each a plain hand-editable JSON file with bounded entries and tags. Writes are atomic (unique temp file + rename, previous revision kept in a bounded history/) and serialized across processes by a per-tier lock with stale reclaim; a disk-revision check refuses lost updates instead of silently overwriting another writer. Memory text is wrapped in explicit untrusted-data boundaries (forged wrappers stripped on write) to blunt prompt injection from remembered content, load-time validation rejects out-of-bounds stores, and symlink escapes out of the tier directory are refused with MEMORY_STORE_ESCAPE. No content-heuristic filtering and no confirmation step, so headless auto-consolidation stays intact. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:RocoFish/deepseek-memory.
description.zh: 带纵深加固的 dsh 长期记忆插件。两层存储（项目级 `.dsh-memory/` 与用户级 `$DSH_HOME/memory/`），每层就是一个可手改、可 diff 的纯 JSON 文件，条目与标签均有上限。写入原子（唯一临时文件 + rename，旧版本进入有上限的 history/ 备份），跨进程由带过期回收的 per-tier 锁串行化；磁盘 revision 校验拒绝丢失更新，绝不静默覆盖其他写入者。记忆文本以显式 untrusted-data 边界包装（伪造包装标签写入时剥除）以削弱记忆内容中的提示注入，加载时校验拒绝越界存储，tier 目录外的符号链接逃逸以 MEMORY_STORE_ESCAPE 拒绝。不做内容启发式过滤、不加确认步骤，无头自动巩固流程不受影响。安装：dsh plugin --profile web add github:RocoFish/deepseek-memory。

description.en: Connects the Drafta notes app to DeepSeek Harness over MCP, so the agent can search, read and write notes in your local Drafta library.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 把 Drafta 笔记应用接到 DeepSeek Harness，让智能体可以检索、读取并写入你本地 Drafta 库中的笔记。

description.en: Project memory for coding agents on DeepSeek Harness: similar past edits surface as precedents, out-of-scope edits are blocked, and cognition persists across sessions (47 upstream-verified fixes, gold-free 20-task run).
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的项目记忆:历史相似编辑作为先例出现、越界修改被 scope 锁拦下、认知跨会话持续积累(47 次上游验收修复、去 gold 化 20/20)。

description.en: Unified long-term memory hub: captures turns into L0 evidence, distills in the background into L1 facts / L2 scenes / L3 profile (depth configurable), recalls via hybrid BM25+fuzzy search, ships 13 memory_* tools, traceable lineage back to source turns, optional Hindsight backend, and a built-in memory panel with three entry points.
description.zh: 统一长期记忆中枢：自动捕获对话沉淀为 L0 原始证据，后台分层蒸馏为 L1 事实 / L2 场景 / L3 画像（层数可配），BM25+模糊混合检索召回，13 个 memory_* 工具，记忆谱系可回溯到原始记录，可选 Hindsight 云记忆后端，内置记忆管理面板（设置页、侧边栏、独立整页三入口）。

description.en: Project-scoped SQLite memory with progressive retrieval, bounded context, a composer button and visual review. Install the repository-root DSH bundle, then run /learning-init with an absolute project path using local Python 3.10+.
description.zh: 项目级 SQLite 记忆，支持渐进检索、有界上下文、聊天框按键与可视化审批。安装仓库根 DSH Bundle 后，用本机 Python 3.10+ 执行 /learning-init 加项目绝对路径完成初始化。

description.en: Memory consolidation tuning for dsh-mneme (autoDream enabled, schema-max output budget, deepseek-chat route) plus the llm-deepseek reasoning-effort fix, an MCP bridge to the auditable seed-society agent runtime, and six yogacara seed skills.
description.zh: 面向 dsh-mneme 的记忆巩固调优（开启 autoDream、放大输出预算、deepseek-chat 路由）与 llm-deepseek 推理力度修复，附带可审计智能体运行时 seed-society 的 MCP 工具桥与六个唯识种子技能。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: a three-tier store (behavior notes, deep details, session archive) plus a 600-character core card injected every step, work/companion/learning state lines, multi-person and multi-group records with visibility partitions, session-scoped suppression or deletion of memory fragments, summaries and fact candidates that can route to a separate model, and backup plus self-check tools. Data is plain text under the home directory, and entries can carry images and audio stored by content hash.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话记忆：三层存储（行为笔记／深层细节／会话阵列）打底，加一张每步注入的 600 字核心卡、工作·陪伴·学习三线状态、多人多群记录与可见性分区、会话级记忆片段屏蔽与删除、可路由到独立模型的摘要与事实候选，以及备份与自检工具；数据全部是家目录下的纯文本文件，条目可附带按内容哈希落盘的图片与音频。

description.en: A long-term memory box for DeepSeek Harness settings: type it once and every new session carries it. 0.3.0 can also expand a rough note into a five-section requirement sheet that keeps every requirement of yours verbatim, marks anything the model had to invent as 推断 and deletable, and lists the dimensions you left open instead of deciding them for you.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页维护一份跨会话生效的长时记忆：填一次，之后每个新会话都带着它。0.3.0 可把草稿细化为五节需求说明——你写的要求逐条保留，模型补的每一条标为「推断」可删，你没提的维度单列出来问你；采用、换一版、不改都由你决定。

description.en: Requires dsh-mnemon. Experience-library memory-space provider for dsh-mnemon, with exp_recall / exp_record / exp_feedback / exp_type tools.
description.zh: 需先安装 dsh-mnemon。经验库记忆空间 Provider（dsh-mnemon），同时注册 exp_recall / exp_record / exp_feedback / exp_type 工具。

description.en: Decision log for DeepSeek Harness: record key decisions (chosen option + why) into a versionable DECISIONS.md via decision_log / decision_list / decision_audit tools, and auto-inject the summary into future sessions so decisions stay traceable and are never re-litigated.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 决策日志：通过 decision_log / decision_list / decision_audit 工具把关键决策（选了什么 + 为什么）沉淀为可版本化的 DECISIONS.md，并在后续会话自动注入摘要，让决策可追溯、不重复、不推翻。

description.en: Conversation memory behind a 20-letter recovery code: /recovery create packs the current conversation into one local record, and /recovery memory <code> injects it into a new conversation, where the model first summarises the recovered session and ends its reply with 记忆已恢复. Records are plain JSON under $DSH_HOME/recovery (mode 0600) with no network calls; the restored transcript is complete unless it exceeds the configured character budget, and /recovery where plus the dir option or DSH_RECOVERY_DIR move the directory to shared storage or a synced folder.
description.zh: 用 20 字母恢复码承接对话记忆：/recovery create 把当前对话打包成本地记录，/recovery memory <恢复码> 在新对话中注入该记忆，模型先总结上一段会话并在结尾写「记忆已恢复」。记录是本机 $DSH_HOME/recovery 下的明文 JSON（0600），不联网；字符预算内完整注入、超限才截取头尾，/recovery where 查看目录，dir 配置或 DSH_RECOVERY_DIR 可把目录换到共享存储、同步盘。

description.en: Derives the index from your Markdown memory files on every turn instead of keeping a hand-written index table, so renames, splits and deletions never leave a stale entry. Retrieval ranks by library tags, section tags, title tokens and body text, then injects the matching line ranges rather than whole files. Writing is model-proposed and user-confirmed through a sticky note; entries are appended after the target section's format is detected. Ships a structure panel showing each library and section with line ranges and token estimates, a starter template for an empty memory directory, and optional appearance controls.
description.zh: 每轮从你的 Markdown 记忆文件现场派生索引，不维护手写索引表，所以改名、拆库、删库都不会留下指向虚空的旧条目。检索按库标签、章节标签、标题词与正文多维排序，注入命中的行号区间而不是整篇文件。写入由模型提议、你在便利贴上确认，落盘前先探测目标章节的格式再追加。自带结构面板（每个库与章节的行号区间和 token 估算）、空记忆目录的一键起手模板，以及可选的外观调整。

description.en: Turn rough ideas into precise prompts for 19 image/video generation, writing, code and text models, with multi-model enhancement, prompt scoring, image-to-prompt and a periodic self-updating knowledge base.
description.zh: 把粗糙想法变成精准提示词：内置 19 个目标模型规范（含豆包 Seedream/Seedance 等）、多模型增强、提示词评分诊断、图片反推，并周期联网自更新本地知识库。

description.en: Detect which installed apps have a newer version and update them with one click, downloading each vendor's full installer from its official site and installing it silently. Windows via winget, macOS via Homebrew casks, matching the machine's ARM64 or x64 architecture.
description.zh: 检测本机已安装应用里哪些有可用新版本，并一键从各软件官网下载完整安装包静默更新；Windows 走 winget、macOS 走 Homebrew cask，并按本机 ARM64 / x64 架构挑选对应安装包。

description.en: Bilibili autopilot run by a local Ollama model: it picks videos within per-topic quota, reads subtitles, hot comments and keyframes, decides whether a reply is warranted, then writes and posts one comment through a five-level safety gate. Triggered by dsh-schedule; write tools are not registered while commenting is disabled. v1.1 hardens the write path: revoking write access is a runtime state checked before every send, publishing is atomic, risk-control errors persist as a pause, and the final post re-checks persona style.
