Needs Python 3.10+ with the repo's requirements.txt installed.
description.zh: 本地模型刷 B 站：由 Ollama 小模型按题材配额挑片，读字幕、热评与关键帧，判断要不要评论，再经五档安全闸写出并发布。节奏由 dsh-schedule 触发；未开启写权限时不注册写工具。v1.1 收紧写路径：撤权改为运行时状态（每次发送前检查）、发布原子化、风控错误会持久化为暂停、发前复核人设风格。需 Python 3.10+ 并装好仓库里的 requirements.txt。

description.en: Compiles LaTeX with the TeX Live installed on the machine: one `latex` tool typesets a formula into an SVG, PNG or PDF and a whole document into a PDF (Chinese text switches to xelatex with ctexart), writes the file into the workspace and returns a Markdown reference to it. A system-prompt section asks the model to write `$...$` and `$$...$$` instead of code fences, and when no TeX Live is found a banner above the composer offers a one-click BasicTeX or TinyTeX install.
description.zh: 用本机已装的 TeX Live 真编译 LaTeX：`latex` 工具把一个公式排成 SVG、PNG 或 PDF，把整份文档排成 PDF（正文含中文时自动切 xelatex + ctexart），产物写进工作区并返回可直接引用的 Markdown 链接。同时注入系统提示词段落，让模型用 `$...$` / `$$...$$` 而不是代码块写公式；本机没有 TeX Live 时，输入框上方会给出 BasicTeX / TinyTeX 一键安装。

description.en: Local-first bookkeeping plus a separate wealth-holdings ledger: text entries and receipt OCR through an optional local provider, a running balance, a strictly degrading daily profit chain, and a two-section month-end report where cash and wealth totals are never merged.
description.zh: 本地优先的记账插件，附带独立的理财持仓账本：文字记账与小票 OCR（可选本地 OCR 提供方）、running balance、严格降级的每日收益链，以及现金与理财永不合并的月末双节报告。

description.en: Task timing for DSH agents: a task_clock tool that measures elapsed time on the host monotonic clock, resumes across DSH or system restarts with the gap estimated, and returns unknown rather than inventing a number; it does not touch presets.
description.zh: 给 DSH Agent 的任务计时工具：task_clock 用宿主单调时钟测实际耗时，DSH 或系统重启后可续算并标注空档为估算，桥接不了时返回 unknown 而不是编造数字；不覆盖任何 preset。

description.en: Clean Architecture reference library for DSH: 8 pinned reference repos (Go, Java, C#, Python) indexed into a local FTS5 database, with assertion rules, a review ledger, and a read-only observation panel.
description.zh: DSH 的 Clean Architecture 参考库:8 个钉版参考仓(Go / Java / C# / Python)索引进本地 FTS5,提供断言规则、审查台账与只读观察窗面板。

description.en: Injects the current date and time into the runtime context on every turn, so the agent can read the time instead of inferring it.
description.zh: 每一轮把当前日期时间注入运行上下文，让 agent 能读到准确时间而不是靠推算。

description.en: Adds a writing console above the composer with four style tiers (T1-T4) and five rigor tiers (L1-L5), selectable by hand or left to automatic choice; keeps project terminology and banned phrasing in .mem/config.md with a read-only human section; and provides a whale_polish tool that rewrites expression without changing facts.
description.zh: 在输入框上方增加写作控制台：四种风格档（T1–T4）与五种严谨档（L1–L5）可手动选择或自动判断；把术语、禁用写法等记入 .mem/config.md（人工区只读）；并提供只改表达、不改事实的 whale_polish 润色工具。

description.en: Auditable mathematical proving for DeepSeek Harness: a local stdio MCP server with 23 machine-checking tools, a bundled workflow skill, and the /prove and /audit-proof commands. proven, refuted and inconclusive are never conflated, and unproven steps are reported instead of hidden. Needs Python 3.10+ with pip install -r requirements.txt on first run; the 23 tools are unavailable until then.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的可审计数学证明:本地 stdio MCP 服务器(23 个机器校验工具)+ 工作流技能 + /prove、/audit-proof 命令。proven / refuted / inconclusive 绝不混淆,未证明的步骤如实报告而非隐藏。需 Python 3.10+，首次运行要 pip install -r requirements.txt（就绪前 23 个工具不可用）。

description.en: Adds seven `art_*` agent tools plus a right-sidebar drawing workbench (series, pages, revisions, regions, camera blockout) that submits ComfyUI graphs to a ComfyUI instance you host, for MOSS/K2 text-to-image, inpaint, character references, region editing and Qwen-Image edits, with up to four caller LoRAs stacked per request. Requires a local checkout and one adapter step: after a marketplace install, run `install/adapt.mjs` (or use `install/install.ps1` on Windows) to replace the `__MOSS_*__` placeholders with an absolute `workspaceRoot` and a ComfyUI origin; until then the Host refuses to load the preset with `MOSS_CONFIG_*`.
description.zh: 给 Agent 增加 7 个 art_* 工具和一个右侧栏绘图工作台（系列、页、修订、区域、相机体块），把工作流提交到你自建的 ComfyUI：MOSS/K2 文生图、局部重绘、角色参考、区域编辑与 Qwen 图像编辑，单次请求可叠加最多 4 个自备 LoRA。需要本机仓库执行一次适配：市场安装后运行 `install/adapt.mjs`（Windows 可用 `install/install.ps1`）把 `__MOSS_*__` 占位符替换为绝对的 `workspaceRoot` 与 ComfyUI 地址，否则 Host 会以 `MOSS_CONFIG_*` 拒绝加载预设。

description.en: Chinese writing-register plugin for the Gcores/机核 editor 白广大: registers a 40 KB style skill plus style_lint / style_audit / style_rules tools — 4 hard-error and 27 warning checks (banned connectives, slogan inflation, empty quantifiers, uniform paragraphs, unsourced statistics, AI clichés), with thresholds calibrated on 444 articles / 802k characters; a settings page adds an on/off switch, single and batch trial runs, and JSON threshold overrides.
description.zh: 把机核网编辑白广大的中文文风做成可执行的判据：注册一份 40 KB 风格技能，并提供 style_lint / style_audit / style_rules 三个工具——4 条硬错误 + 27 条警告（空转转折、金句通胀、冗余量词、段落过于均匀、孤证数字、AI 口头禅等），阈值按 444 篇 / 80.2 万字语料标定；设置页带总开关、单篇与批量试跑、阈值 JSON 覆盖。

description.en: Registers Brave as the web_search provider, resolving the API key from the DSH credential store, $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml, or the environment. No settings card and no fallback engine: one request to Brave's Web Search API per search.
description.zh: 把 Brave 注册为 web_search 的搜索提供方，API Key 依次从 DSH 凭证库、$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml 或环境变量读取。无设置卡片、无备用引擎：每次搜索向 Brave Web Search API 发起一次请求。

description.en: Read and write Apple iCloud Calendar over CalDAV through five tools: list calendars, read a window with recurring events expanded, create an event, and delete behind a dry run that must confirm the exact object count. Credentials come from DPAPI, Keychain or libsecret, or from an environment variable.
description.zh: 通过 CalDAV 读写苹果 iCloud 日历，提供五个工具：列出日历、按时间窗读取并展开重复日程、创建事件，以及先干跑、按对象数确认后再删除。凭据保存在 DPAPI／钥匙串／libsecret 或环境变量中。

description.en: A second, agent-owned cursor with a floating control panel for opacity, colour, size, badge and a permission ladder only a human can raise. It never moves the real pointer. Windows 10 (2004 or newer) only — the overlay is a Win32 program with no macOS or Linux fallback.
description.zh: 给 AI 的第二只光标加一个浮动控制面板，可调透明度、颜色、大小与提示显隐，并按只能由人提高的权限等级限制它；从不移动你的真实鼠标指针。仅支持 Windows 10 2004 及以上——浮层是 Win32 程序，macOS 与 Linux 没有实现。

description.en: Stage-gate governance tools: model-callable gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close for in-memory, per-session acceptance checks with PASS/BLOCK conclusions.
description.zh: 阶段门治理工具：模型可直接调用的 gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close，为多阶段工作提供内存态、按会话隔离的验收核对与通过/阻塞结论。

description.en: IMAP/SMTP mail tools for listing, reading, searching, replying, sending and moving messages, with built-in provider presets (QQ, 163, 126, Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or a custom server), attachment upload and download, and a sidebar page for account setup.
description.zh: 通过 IMAP/SMTP 列出、读取、搜索、回复、发送和移动邮件的工具集，内置 QQ／163／126／Gmail／Outlook／iCloud 与自定义服务器预设，支持附件上传下载，并提供侧栏账号配置页。

description.en: Auto check-in and claim credits for WorkBuddy via an isolated Chrome profile, no tokens required.
description.zh: 用独立 Chrome 登录态自动签到并领取 WorkBuddy 积分，无需令牌。

description.en: 123 Cloud Drive (123pan) client: signs in with a phone number or email plus password, or a pasted token, browses and drag-drop uploads and downloads through a sidebar panel, backs up a workspace incrementally while keeping its directory tree, and exposes 15 tools for an agent to list, upload, download, rename, move and delete files. Network, MD5, 16MB multipart upload and token encryption run in a bundled statically linked C++ core, so it needs no Python or other runtime. Windows 10/11 x64 only.
description.zh: 123 云盘客户端：支持手机号或邮箱密码登录，也支持粘贴 token；侧栏面板可浏览、拖拽上传与下载，并能对工作区做保留目录结构的增量备份；同时提供 15 个工具供 agent 列目录、上传、下载、重命名、移动和删除文件。网络请求、MD5、16MB 分片上传与 token 加密都由随包的静态链接 C++ 核心完成，不需要 Python 或其他运行时。仅 Windows 10/11 x64。

description.en: Enhanced MCP client: paginated tool discovery, non-blocking startup, mcp_tool_search, hand-rolled stdio/streamable-http transports.
description.zh: MCP 客户端增强：分页工具发现、非阻塞启动、mcp_tool_search 搜索，自研 stdio/streamable-http 传输。

description.en: Registers external databases and document corpora as callable model tools: a per-source access boundary, a credential reference ledger that never stores values, and a fetch ledger that keeps fingerprints and content hashes instead of payloads.
description.zh: 把外部数据库与文献语料登记成模型可调用的取数工具；每条库声明取数边界，钥匙台账只记引用名不存值，取数台账只留指纹与内容哈希而不留响应体。

description.en: CNC (NC/CNC/G-code) toolpath recognition, 3D display and a large editing view with quote-to-composer for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 数控程序（NC/CNC/G-code）刀路识别、三维显示与大界面编辑，支持代码引用到对话框，适用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: The composer predicts what you are about to type. Inline ghost text sits on the caret, measured against the editor's own font and line box, and Tab turns it into real text (Esc ignores it). The prediction is one short call through the session's own model router, seeded with your draft and the last few turns of the conversation, so an empty composer also gets a next-prompt guess written in the user's voice; suggestions that merely restate the assistant are dropped. Host side is one HTTP route with sub-path endpoints (loopback-only, 64 KB body cap, 2-minute result cache, 20-second miss cache, one in-flight call per session); client side is one 0-height overlay registered on conversation.input.overlay, with insertion guarded by the composer's draftRev CAS and a setDraft fallback. IME composition and slash commands are skipped. 16 node:test cases, zero runtime dependencies, real screenshots in docs/.
description.zh: 输入框会预测你接下来要打的字：幽灵文本贴在你的光标后面，字体、行高、字间距都照抄编辑器，按 Tab 变成真正的文字，按 Esc 忽略。预测是走当前会话自己的模型路由的一次短调用，喂进你的草稿和最近几轮对话，所以空输入框时还会预测你的「下一句」，用用户自己的口吻；只是复述助手原话的建议会被丢弃。宿主半边是一条带若干子路径的 HTTP 路由（只收 loopback、64KB 体积上限、结果缓存 2 分钟、空结果缓存 20 秒、每会话同时只有一个在飞请求）；客户端半边是挂在 conversation.input.overlay 上的 0 高度覆盖层，落字带 draftRev 的 CAS 校验，失败退回 setDraft。输入法组字期间与 / 命令不预测。16 个 node:test 用例，零运行时依赖，docs/ 里有真实运行截图。

description.en: Drives the Claude desktop app from DSH over its claude:// deep links: open a Claude Code session with a prompt and folders, a Cowork task with files, or push a CLI session id back into the app. Also presses Ctrl+Enter for you (SendKeys) and reads the reply back from the local Claude Code transcripts under ~/.claude/projects/<cwd-slug>/<session>.jsonl — seven tools: desktop_send, desktop_continue, desktop_open, desktop_sessions, desktop_read, desktop_wait, desktop_probe.
description.zh: 用桌面端自己的 claude:// 深链把活派过去：开新 Claude Code 会话（带 prompt、目录）、带文件开 Cowork 任务、把 CLI 会话 id 交回应用；再代按 Ctrl+Enter 发送，并从本机 Claude Code 的 transcript（~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<session>.jsonl）把回答读回来。七个工具：desktop_send / desktop_continue / desktop_open / desktop_sessions / desktop_read / desktop_wait / desktop_probe。

description.en: Runs the local Codex CLI from DSH as four tools (codex_run, codex_resume, codex_queue, codex_probe), and ships a standalone loopback bridge with an HTTP API and a file mailbox.
description.zh: 把本机 Codex CLI 接成 DSH 的四个工具（codex_run / codex_resume / codex_queue / codex_probe），另带独立的回环桥：HTTP 接口 + 文件信箱。

description.en: Five agent tools that administer a WordPress and WooCommerce site over the REST API - posts, pages and custom post types; media uploads with alt text; products, variations, orders, coupons, customers and reviews; plugins, themes and block-theme templates; classic menus need the companion dsh-bridge WordPress plugin. Tool descriptions and error messages are bilingual English/Chinese.
description.zh: 通过 REST API 管理 WordPress 与 WooCommerce 站点的五个 Agent 工具：文章、页面与自定义内容类型；带替代文本的媒体上传；商品、变体、订单、优惠券、客户与评价；插件、主题与区块模板；经典菜单需另装配套的 dsh-bridge WordPress 插件。工具描述与错误提示支持中英双语。

description.en: Lets the agent inject one turn into a chosen session on its own when the host has been idle. Daily cap, active hours, weighted action lottery, per-activity budget, and a policy file re-read on every check. Disabled by default; sends no network requests.
description.zh: 宿主空闲时由 Agent 自己决定要不要往指定会话注入一轮：每日上限、活跃时段、按权重抽动作、单次预算，策略文件每次判定现读。默认关闭，不发任何网络请求。

description.en: Lists every plugin installed in the current DSH profile, lets you tick the ones to keep, and exports them either as a migration sheet for a new machine or as a self-contained zip (local plugin sources plus a restore script) that a fresh DSH can install in one run. The restore script is PowerShell; a DSH restart (plus pnpm install if the plugin page reports pending installs) is needed afterwards.
description.zh: 列出当前 DSH 配置里装过的全部插件，勾选后导出成「迁移单」文本，或直接打包成自包含 zip（本地插件源码 + 恢复脚本），新电脑上跑一次脚本即可还原。恢复脚本是 PowerShell；还原后需重启 DSH，插件页报待安装时还需 pnpm install。

description.en: Mojibake guard bundle for DSH: feature-based garbled-text detection before writes with review-then-release (an identical retry passes), plus pre-execution pwsh encoding audit (ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/Default), Windows and Chinese first.
description.zh: DSH 乱码拦截器 bundle：写入前特征值/编码回环检测乱码并复查放行（原样重试即通过），pwsh 写入编码执行前审计（ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/默认编码），Windows 与中文场景优先。

description.en: Turn a script into a narrated explainer video: text-card slides by default (fast and exact for tutorials) or AI-generated footage per segment (needs AGNES_API_KEY); 14 online neural Chinese voices plus 3 offline Windows voices, with a one-command sample pack for picking a voice by ear. Requires ffmpeg, and the bundled video-remix skill copied to <workspace>/.dsh/skills/video-remix with npm install run there for the online voices.
description.zh: 把文案变成带配音的讲解视频：默认用文字卡片（快且准确，适合教程），也可逐段调用 AI 生成真实画面（需 AGNES_API_KEY）；内置 14 个在线中文神经音色和 3 个离线 Windows 音色，一条命令即可生成全部音色的试听包。前置需要 ffmpeg，并把仓库内的 video-remix skill 放到 <工作区>/.dsh/skills/video-remix 后在该目录执行 npm install（在线音色所需）。

description.en: Wayland desktop control for GNOME/Mutter sessions: screenshot, OCR with screen coordinates, click by text, and batch input actions. Needs a Python 3 backend with python3-gi and GStreamer; OCR needs Tesseract.
description.zh: GNOME/Mutter 下的 Wayland 桌面控制：截图、带坐标的 OCR、按文字点击，以及批量输入动作。后端为 Python 进程，需 python3-gi 与 GStreamer；OCR 需 Tesseract。

description.en: Convert PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, CSV, JSON and ZIP files to Markdown for the model, using a bundled JavaScript engine or Microsoft MarkItDown.
description.zh: 将 PDF、Word、PowerPoint、Excel、HTML、CSV、JSON、ZIP 等文档转换为 Markdown 供模型读取，内置 JavaScript 引擎，也可使用 Microsoft MarkItDown。

description.en: Scientific figures as code: agents create a versioned figure IR, patch it incrementally (one node at a time — untouched objects never move), and export publication-ready, true-vector SVG / PDF / PPTX. Seven papercanvas_* tools (create, get, patch, layout, lint, render, inspect) over a deterministic engine with FC001-FC008 quality lint and CJK-aware font resolution. Verified on DSH 0.1.5-rc.3 through 0.2.2-alpha.2. By the author of dsh-sessionflow. Requires the PaperCanvas engine installed separately: Python 3.11+ and the papercanvas CLI (not yet on PyPI — install it from this repository, put it on PATH or set papercanvasBin); the plugin is a thin adapter and ships no engine.
description.zh: 论文图即代码：Agent 创建版本化 Figure IR，经语义化 Patch 增量修改（单节点粒度——未指定的对象绝不动），确定性导出可编辑的 SVG / PDF / PPTX 真矢量图。七个 papercanvas_* 工具覆盖创建、读取、修改、布局、Lint（FC001–FC008 质量检查）、渲染与检视；中文标签自动使用系统 CJK 字体度量与嵌入。已验证 DSH 0.1.5-rc.3 至 0.2.2-alpha.2 各渠道。dsh-sessionflow 同作者作品。需另装 PaperCanvas 引擎：Python 3.11+ 与 papercanvas CLI（PyPI 尚未发布，当前需从本仓库安装，并放到 PATH 或配置 papercanvasBin）；插件只是薄适配层，不自带引擎。

description.en: Language-pack framework that rewrites model replies: A is an independent LLM rewrite, B injects FTS5 terminology retrieval into that rewrite, C applies local dictionary and regex rules, and composite runs a pipeline such as B then A then C. Ships a GitHub pack marketplace, a ZIP installer with path, size and file-type checks, and a mandatory risk disclaimer gate.
description.zh: 改写模型回复的语言包框架：A 为独立 LLM 改写，B 将 FTS5 术语检索注入改写请求，C 执行本地字典与正则规则，composite 按 B→A→C 等管线组合。附 GitHub 语言包市场、带路径/体积/文件类型校验的 ZIP 安装器，以及强制风险免责闸门。

description.en: DSH tools for operating a self-hosted Talebook library: search, download, upload and manage books and audiobooks, manage Legado book sources, and admin operations, with approval-gated writes.
description.zh: 在自托管 Talebook 书库上搜索、下载、上传和管理书籍与有声书，管理 Legado 书源及管理员操作；写入操作需经批准。

description.en: Searches a database of past motor-repair cases by fault description, motor rating and brand, and lets new diagnoses be saved back for future retrieval.
description.zh: 按故障描述、功率与品牌检索历史电机维修案例，支持将新诊断沉淀回写供后续检索。

description.en: Combines historical supplier quotes and service rates into onsite-repair, factory-overhaul, green-remanufacture and replacement options for a motor, then recommends one by total cost of ownership.
description.zh: 组合历史供应商报价与工时，生成现场抢修/返厂大修/绿色再制造/整机更换等维修方案，并按综合持有成本给出决策建议。

description.en: Summarises the case evidence, diagnosis, repair procedure, parts list and cost-option comparison for a motor into a Markdown repair recommendation report with data provenance.
description.zh: 将案例依据、诊断结论、维修工序、配件清单与方案对比汇总为带数据溯源的 Markdown 维修建议书。

description.en: Combines fault knowledge-base symptom-to-cause rules with similar past cases to rank candidate motor diagnoses with evidence terms and suggested extra tests.
description.zh: 结合故障知识库症状-原因规则与相似历史案例，输出电机候选诊断排序、证据词与建议补测项。

description.en: Builds a motor-repair replacement-parts BOM from the fault and motor rating, listing stock, lead time and domestic or imported alternatives.
description.zh: 按故障类型与电机功率生成替换配件 BOM，输出库存、交期与国产/进口替代选项。

description.en: Read-only Home Assistant panel for DeepSeek Harness: a full status overview, a compact right-sidebar card, a system-prompt environment block, one read-only ha_status tool, and optional browser notifications on Home Assistant down/recover. Configure the instance URL and token once; it does not control devices or change Home Assistant configuration.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Home Assistant 只读面板：完整状态总览、右侧栏速览卡、系统提示词环境块、一个只读 ha_status 工具，以及可选的 HA 不可用/恢复浏览器通知。配置一次实例地址与令牌；不控制设备，也不修改 Home Assistant 配置。

description.en: OAuth2-capable IMAP email reader for accounts where password authentication is disabled. Microsoft disabled Basic Auth for personal Outlook IMAP in 2024, so this plugin authenticates via refresh-token OAuth2 (XOAUTH2) with automatic token refresh, plus app-password login for Gmail through an optional local HTTP/SOCKS proxy. Registers list/read/search as ol_email_* so it can coexist with the market dsh-email plugin without tool-name clashes.
description.zh: 面向密码认证被禁用邮箱的 OAuth2 IMAP 读取插件：微软 2024 年起停用个人 Outlook 的 IMAP 基本认证，本插件改用 refresh-token OAuth2（XOAUTH2）自动续期，Gmail 走应用密码并可选本地 HTTP/SOCKS 代理；工具注册为 ol_email_*，可与市场版 dsh-email 共存不撞名。

description.en: SMS forwarding webhook for DeepSeek Harness. Phone apps (SMS Forwarder, Tasker, or any HTTP POST) push messages to a local HTTP endpoint; the plugin stores them as JSONL and exposes sms_recent / sms_search tools so the agent can read SMS verification codes during tasks. Auto-extracts the first 4-8 digit OTP from each message, supports keyword filtering, and works over LAN or Tailscale.
description.zh: DSH 短信转发 webhook：手机端转发 App（短信转发器/Tasker 等）把短信 POST 到本地 HTTP 端点，插件落盘 JSONL 并暴露 sms_recent / sms_search 工具，让 agent 在任务中直接读取短信验证码；自动提取 4–8 位 OTP，支持关键词过滤，可走局域网或 Tailscale。

description.en: Typed, guarded container control: ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop and compose up/down with JSON output, project-aware targeting, and approval-gated destructive ops.
description.zh: 类型安全、带护栏的容器控制：ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop 与 compose up/down，JSON 输出、项目感知定位、破坏性操作需审批。

description.en: Local semantic index over workspace documents (MD/PDF/DOCX/TXT): FTS5 BM25 + local embedding hybrid retrieval, hit citations with line numbers, and incremental updates.
description.zh: 工作区文档的本地语义索引（MD/PDF/DOCX/TXT）：FTS5 BM25 与本地嵌入混合检索、带行号命中引用、增量更新。

description.en: Financial market monitor bundle for dsh: real-time quotes, a local watchlist, threshold alerts with cooldowns, periodic polling, and in-chat ASCII/mermaid charts for A-share stocks/indices and crypto (Tencent + CoinGecko).
description.zh: dsh 的金融行情监控插件:实时报价、本地自选列表、带冷却的阈值提醒、定时轮询,以及在会话内用 ASCII/mermaid 渲染 A 股与加密货币图表(数据源腾讯 + CoinGecko)。

description.en: Auto-discovers model listings, pricing and capabilities from OpenAI-compatible API hosts, normalizes them, and emits ready-to-use model configs for dsh.
description.zh: 从 OpenAI 兼容 API 主机自动发现模型列表、定价与能力，归一化后生成 dsh 可直接使用的模型配置。

description.en: HTTP network debugging toolset for DeepSeek Harness: a general-purpose HTTP client with SSRF/private-network protection, per-session request history with replay, response inspection and HAR export - three dsh tools plus a zero-dependency CLI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的网络调试工具集：带 SSRF/私网防护的通用 HTTP 客户端、会话内请求历史与重放、响应检查与 HAR 导出——三个 dsh 工具外加零依赖 CLI。

description.en: Indexes public AI-company job boards (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workable, SmartRecruiters), scores postings for AI relevance, extracts the requirements from each job description, and produces a scheduled daily Markdown digest.
description.zh: 索引海外 AI 公司的公开招聘看板（Greenhouse、Ashby、Lever、Workable、SmartRecruiters），按 AI 相关性给岗位打分，从职位描述里提取招聘要求，并按计划每天生成 Markdown 摘要。

description.en: Custom script manager for DSH: turn verified operations into reusable scripts that run directly via /script or register as agent tools, with parameterized scripts, declared expected outcomes, and execution history.
description.zh: DSH 自定义操作脚本管理器，将验证过的操作流程固化为可复用的脚本，用 /script 直接运行或注册为 Agent 工具，支持参数化脚本、执行预期声明、执行历史记录。

description.en: Connects DSH to timestamped video reading, shared queues/history and Scroll personal Bilibili workflows through an existing Video Reader installation. Windows x64 only: install the core and set VIDEO_READER_ROOT before starting DSH; the bundle does not install Python, FFmpeg, models or Bilibili credentials.
description.zh: 复用现有的 Video Reader 本地安装，为 DSH 接入带时间戳的视频阅读、通用队列/历史与 Scroll 的个人 B 站工作流。仅支持 Windows x64：需先安装核心并设置 VIDEO_READER_ROOT 再启动 DSH；本包不安装 Python、FFmpeg、模型或 B 站凭据。

description.en: Figma design context for the agent: reads a frame's node tree, auto-layout, paints and typography, resolves the variables it is bound to, and renders a screenshot to compare code against — plus four bundled design-to-code skills. Connect with one button against Figma's own consent page; the plugin ships its own OAuth app, refreshes tokens automatically, and never asks for or displays a token.
description.zh: 给 agent 用的 Figma 设计上下文：读取画板的节点树、自动布局、填充与字体，解析节点绑定的设计变量，并渲染截图用于对照代码 —— 另附四个设计转代码技能。点一个按钮即跳转 Figma 官方授权页完成连接；插件自带 OAuth 应用、自动续期令牌，全程不索取也不展示任何 Token。

description.en: Mounts the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server through two gateway tools instead of registering its 200+ tool schemas on every request: rea_list searches the catalog or returns one tool's input schema, and rea_call invokes that tool, each call spawning a short-lived rea mcp process, so the tool definitions sent per step drop from about 780 KB (207 tools as measured in REA 6.5.0) to about 1-2 KB. When no rea entry point is found it installs rea-agents into a plugin-private directory with the pnpm bundled in DSH (dependency build scripts skipped) and links the reverse-engineer-anything and rea-gateway skills into the skills directory without overwriting existing ones.
description.zh: 把 REA（逆向一切）的 MCP 服务收成两个网关工具，而不是每次请求都注册它的 200 多个工具 schema：rea_list 按名字/描述搜索工具目录、或取单个工具的完整 input schema，rea_call 按原始工具名调用，每次调用启动一个短命 rea mcp 子进程，每步请求的工具定义由约 780 KB（REA 6.5.0 实测 207 个工具）降到约 1-2 KB。找不到 rea 入口时，用 DSH 自带的 pnpm 把 rea-agents 装进插件私有目录（跳过依赖构建脚本），并把 reverse-engineer-anything 与 rea-gateway 两个技能链接进技能目录，已存在的同名技能不会被覆盖。

description.en: Translate text-based PDFs via DeepSeek or OpenAI-compatible APIs while preserving layout, fonts, images and links, with editable output.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek 或兼容 API 翻译文本型 PDF，保留版式、字体、图片与链接，输出可编辑 PDF。

description.en: Add MiniMax image understanding, image generation, speech synthesis, and transcription tools to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 MiniMax 识图、文生图、语音合成和语音转写工具。

description.en: Reads your past DSH conversations and surfaces recurring prompt gaps — missing paths or versions, an unstated output format, missing preconditions that break tool calls — each with a paste-ready rewrite. Adds a one-click rewrite next to the composer that applies those constraints to the draft in a shorter form.
description.zh: 读你的历史会话，找出反复踩的提问坑（缺路径与版本、没定输出格式、漏说前置条件导致工具失败），每条给一段可直接粘贴的改写；输入框右侧一键把草稿改成更短的带约束版本。

description.en: Injects live time, weather, location, battery, and device context into the DSH system prompt, with a bilingual settings page.
description.zh: 将实时的时间、天气、地点、电量和设备信息注入 DSH 系统提示，并提供双语设置页面。

description.en: Adds catalog discovery, counterparty contact, deal signing, settlement coordination, human-task handoff, and signed receipt tools for agent-native trade.
description.zh: 为模型原生交易提供目录检索、交易方联络、合同签名、结算协调、人工任务交接和签名评价回执工具。

description.en: Adds parametric CAD modeling, geometry validation, previews, design history, and STEP/STL export to DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加参数化 CAD 建模、几何验证、预览、设计历史和 STEP/STL 导出能力。

description.en: A single-window video editing workbench opened from a DSH session: multi-video import, magnetic timeline with trimming and skimming, audio roles with ducking, local silence-detection rough cut, script-based captions, nine color looks, and MP4 export (WebM where the browser cannot record MP4).
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话进入的单窗口视频剪辑工作台：多视频导入、磁吸时间线修剪与掠视、音频角色和自动闪避、本地静音检测粗剪、脚本字幕、9 种调色与 MP4 导出（浏览器不支持 MP4 录制时回退 WebM）。

description.en: Semantic tool routing, skill discovery, and typed System One decisions for DeepSeek Harness powered by TypeSafe Jev.
description.zh: 基于 TypeSafe Jev 的 DeepSeek Harness 语义工具路由、技能发现与类型化 System One 决策插件。

description.en: Drive the NI Multisim 14.3 install on a Windows machine through nine msim_* tools: open and save .ms14 designs, read and edit component values and circuit parameters, run DC operating point, AC sweep, single-frequency AC and transient analyses, export schematics, BOM and netlists. A Win32 channel drives the visible window to run the Analyses dialog and capture Multisim's own schematic view and waveform plot; a SPICE command-file engine handles designs that expose no probes; an offline reader unpacks the .ms14 container without starting Multisim at all. Requires Windows, NI Multisim 14.3, and a 32-bit Python 3.11-3.13 with pywin32.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上把本机的 NI Multisim 14.3 变成可编程对象：九个 msim_* 工具可开关 .ms14 设计、读写元件值与电路参数、跑直流工作点/交流扫频/单频交流/瞬态分析、导出原理图与 BOM/网表；Win32 通道驱动可见窗口操作分析对话框并截取 Multisim 自己的电路视图与波形图；SPICE 命令文件引擎处理没有探针的设计；离线解析器完全不启动 Multisim 就能读出 .ms14 内容。需要 Windows、NI Multisim 14.3，以及装好 pywin32 的 32 位 Python 3.11-3.13。

description.en: 9router-backed web search + fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web). Wires the native web_search/web_fetch tools to 9router's /v1/search and /v1/web/fetch endpoints.
description.zh: 9router 网页搜索与网页抓取 provider，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索和抓取能力。

description.en: Reads .mcp.json from the .dsh home and from the agent workspace, mounts every mcpServers entry into DSH, and adds an MCP tab in the Web UI for listing, adding and unloading servers.
description.zh: 读取 .dsh 根目录与 agent 工作区里的 .mcp.json，把其中的 MCP server 挂载进 DSH；Web 界面增加「MCP」标签页，可查看、添加与卸载服务。

description.en: Mirrors a USB-connected Android phone in the DSH sidebar and drives it over scrcpy's control protocol: 12 agent tools for tap/swipe/type/keys, multi-frame scroll-and-stitch long screenshots, and agent-first control that hands over the moment a human touches the phone. Ships its own adb and scrcpy-server. Windows 10/11 only; the live sidebar mirror additionally requires dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏实时显示 USB 连接的安卓手机，并通过 scrcpy 控制协议直接操作手机：12 个 agent 工具（点按/滑动/输入/按键）、多帧滚动拼接的长截图，以及「默认交给 agent、人一碰手机就立刻交出控制权」的控制权模型。自带 adb 与 scrcpy-server。仅 Windows 10/11；侧栏实时镜像还需 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Read-only Windows device information tools: one agent tool per Win32 device category (time, system, cpu, memory, disk, gpu, network, battery, processes, usb, audio, printers) via WMI/CIM and Node os collectors.
description.zh: 只读的 Windows 设备信息工具：每个 Win32 设备类别一个 agent 工具（时间、系统、CPU、内存、磁盘、GPU、网络、电池、进程、USB、音频、打印机），基于 WMI/CIM 与 Node os 采集。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that interviews the user about a project, generates a project timeline / Gantt chart, and exports it as Word or Excel.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过与用户进行项目需求访谈，生成项目时间线 / 甘特图，并导出为 Word 或 Excel 格式。

description.en: Adds a balance-checking tool, injects a per-turn DeepSeek account balance snapshot with a low/critical power-saving and stop policy, and provides a settings page for thresholds and FX-linked currency conversion. Requires a signed-in DeepSeek account for balance reads; API-key-only profiles return an unreadable result.
description.zh: 新增余额查询工具，在每轮对话中注入 DeepSeek 账户余额快照与低余额省电/严重不足停机策略，并提供阈值和汇率联动换算设置页。需要已登录的 DeepSeek 账号才能读取余额，仅配置 API key 的 profile 会返回无法读取。

description.en: Strongly read-only, secret-aware Oracle second-opinion subagent.
description.zh: 强制只读、会脱敏的第二意见子代理。

description.en: Windows desktop automation for dsh: 14 tools that enumerate apps and windows, capture window screenshots that still work when the window is covered by other windows, read the accessibility tree, and perform real input — click, type text (CJK included), press key combinations, scroll and drag. Loads the official computer-use runtime (@oai/sky) already installed on the machine, discovering it by enumerating vendor directories, so vendor upgrades that change hash directories do not break it.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供 Windows 桌面自动化：14 个工具，可枚举应用与窗口、抓取被遮挡也能截的窗口截图、读取无障碍树，并执行真实输入——点击、输入文字（含中文）、按组合键、滚动与拖拽。加载机器上已安装的官方电脑控制运行时（@oai/sky），按厂商目录枚举发现，引擎升级换目录也不会失效。

description.en: Hosted PrimeSync AI Studio strategy-research MCP configuration bundle using the official MCP client and mcp-remote OAuth bridge; eligible Studio access required. Experimental: OAuth consent and tool calls are not yet verified end-to-end. Complete manual CLI sign-in on the same computer before starting Harness; otherwise tools may be absent after startup. Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only; mcp-remote 0.15.2 is downloaded through npx on first launch.
description.zh: PrimeSync AI Studio 托管策略研究 MCP 服务的实验性配置包，使用官方 MCP 客户端和 mcp-remote OAuth 桥接，需具备 Studio 使用权限。OAuth 授权与工具调用尚未完成端到端验证；启动 Harness 前须在同一电脑上通过命令行手动登录，否则工具可能无法显示。仅面向 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2；首次启动时通过 npx 下载 mcp-remote 0.15.2。

description.en: One MCP tool surface over two Windows desktop-automation backends (dsh-computer-use-win and windows-mcp). Both must be installed first: dsh-computer-use-win as a DSH plugin, windows-mcp via uv tool install windows-mcp --python 3.14, then run the bundled scripts/patch-backend.mjs once (it rewrites the local windows-mcp source; without it screenshot/read_webpage/launch_app fail) and disable the standalone wincu mount. It merges their 44 tools into 29 by dropping 10 duplicates, 4 dangerous ones (PowerShell, Registry, FileSystem, Process) and 1 tool-management entry, and blocks dangerous calls before forwarding through a reversibility-graded guard.
description.zh: 把两个需自行安装的 Windows 桌面自动化后端（dsh-computer-use-win 插件 + 用 uv 装的 windows-mcp，Python 3.14）合成一个 MCP 工具面：装完还要跑一次随包的 scripts/patch-backend.mjs 改写本机 windows-mcp 源码（不跑则 screenshot/read_webpage/launch_app 会失败），并在 profile 里禁用单独挂载的 wincu。44 个后端工具去重为 29 个（去掉 10 个重复、4 个危险工具 PowerShell/Registry/FileSystem/Process、1 个工具管理入口），并在转发前用按可逆性分级的守卫拦截危险调用。

description.en: Multi-round deep research in the DSH sidebar: each round fans sub-questions out to parallel sub-agents, then continues from where the last round stopped and writes a cited report.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏里的多轮深度搜索：每轮把子问题派给多个子代理并行查，再在上一轮基础上继续深挖，最后产出带引用的调研报告。

description.en: Chinese accounting and tax knowledge base for DSH agents, served by the hosted Quaesto service at api.accountingllm.site (needs network access; no account or API key, but your queries leave the machine): answers questions on CAS enterprise accounting standards, the small-enterprise accounting standards, CSA auditing standards and tax law with original articles, decision procedures, applicability checks and tax-accounting differences, exposed through 10 MCP tools and a china-accounting-standards skill.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供中国会计与税务知识库，由托管服务 Quaesto（api.accountingllm.site）提供，需联网、无需账号或 API key，但查询内容会发往该服务：查企业会计准则、小企业会计准则、审计准则与税法的原文条款、判断决策程序、适用性判定与税会差异，通过 10 个 MCP 工具与 china-accounting-standards 技能对外提供。

description.en: Text-to-image and image-to-image generation via OpenRouter's unified Image API: configurable model aliases with parameters gated against the live model capability listing, reference-image inputs, a settings card, and inline chat display of results.
description.zh: 通过 OpenRouter 统一 Image API 的文生图与图生图：以别名配置模型，参数按实时模型能力列表校验，支持参考图输入、设置卡片与对话内联展示结果。

description.en: Rewrites bash tool calls through `rtk rewrite` on the `tools/execute` hook, so it applies to any provider route. Zero dependencies and no build step: a single ESM module that adopts exit codes 0 and 3, runs the original command otherwise (no equivalent, deny rule, missing rtk, spawn failure), restores the original arguments after dispatch, and honors `RTK_PREFIX_ONLY` for direct `rtk <cmd>` prefixing and `DSH_RTK_BIN` to pin the binary.
description.zh: 在 `tools/execute` 钩子上把 bash 工具调用经 `rtk rewrite` 改写，因此对任意 provider 路由生效。零依赖、无需构建：单个 ESM 模块，退出码 0 与 3 时采纳改写结果，其余情况（无等价命令、命中拒绝规则、rtk 缺失、启动失败）原样执行，执行后还原原始参数；`RTK_PREFIX_ONLY` 直接改为 `rtk <cmd>`，`DSH_RTK_BIN` 用于指定二进制。

description.en: Local-first HTML review and annotation workspace for coding agents: opens an isolated copy of a file in a browser editor, collects text edits, format changes and element/area comments, and returns a durable handoff the agent can claim and resolve.
description.zh: 面向编码代理的本地优先 HTML 审阅与标注工作区：在浏览器编辑器中打开文件的隔离副本，收集文本修改、格式调整与元素/区域评注，并把持久的交接（handoff）交还给代理认领和落实。

description.en: Browser-local audio/video toolkit for DSH — extract frames, capture thumbnails, compress images, and convert clips to GIF with FFmpeg.wasm.
description.zh: 基于 FFmpeg.wasm 的浏览器端音视频工具集，支持抽帧、截图、图片压缩与视频转 GIF。

description.en: Model-facing weather tool that queries current conditions and 7-day forecasts from public Open-Meteo APIs, with no API key required.
description.zh: 面向模型的天气工具，基于公开 Open-Meteo API 查询当前天气与 7 天预报，无需 API Key。

description.en: Qichacha (企查查) enterprise data source as a dynamic Cordis plugin: 5 agent tools (auth with QR login, company search, knowledge search, tool search, tool execute) covering 100+ data dimensions (business registration, shareholders, judicial, IP), plus a settings-page account manager; network/file IO via DSH subprocess spawning node -e, credentials interop with the local BizOwl client.
description.zh: 企查查企业数据源动态 Cordis 插件：5 个 agent 工具（扫码登录认证、企业快搜、知识库检索、工具发现、取数执行），覆盖工商/股东/司法/知识产权等 100+ 数据维度，附设置页账号管理；网络与文件 IO 经 DSH subprocess 拉起 node -e 完成，凭证与本地 BizOwl 客户端互通。

description.en: Prompt-polish template injector for DSH: click ✨ in the composer to inject a "polish my prompt" template (current draft auto-embedded), no send, no network, no model — the main agent rewrites with full context. Replaces narrative-prompt-polish (2026-09-14 migration).
description.zh: 点会话输入框右座 ✨，把「打磨提示词」模板写进输入栏——当前草稿自动嵌进 `<内容>` 位置，不发送、不联网、不调模型，由当前会话的主 agent 带着全部上下文改写。替代 narrative-prompt-polish（2026-09-14 更名并整体重构）。

description.en: Read-only assessment of whether a Dameng DM8 database can be recovered and to which point (LSN or time), across 16 recovery scenarios, with an HTML report. Needs Java 8+ and a Dameng JDBC driver jar (DmJdbcDriver8.jar) that you provide yourself.
description.zh: 只读评估达梦 DM8 数据库的可恢复能力：16 类恢复场景下能恢复到哪一点（LSN/时间）、要丢什么，并生成 HTML 报告。需 Java 8+，并自备达梦 DmJdbcDriver8.jar。

description.en: A `search` tool that learns to pick between fast and thorough search strategies using a contextual bandit (Thompson sampling), improving from real usage instead of a fixed heuristic.
description.zh: 使用上下文赌博机算法（Thompson 采样）学习何时使用快速搜索、何时使用深度搜索的 `search` 工具。

description.en: SymPy-backed exact computation and independent verification for China's postgraduate entrance exam Mathematics I: 14 tools over 214 operators, exact symbolic results by default, and every result re-checked by a separate mechanism (requires Python 3.10+ with sympy and mpmath).
description.zh: SymPy 驱动的考研数学一精确计算与独立验证：14 个工具、214 个算子，默认返回精确符号解，并由独立机制复核每个结果（需本机 Python 3.10+ 及 sympy、mpmath）。

description.en: Connect SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL databases in DeepSeek Harness: browse table structure and data, run SQL, and let the assistant query and edit data directly in the conversation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中连接 SQLite / PostgreSQL / MySQL 数据源：浏览表结构与数据、执行 SQL，也可以在对话里让助手直接查数和改数。

description.en: Multi-workspace sandbox: grants file-write access to every registered workspace automatically — add a workspace, write to it immediately, no config or escalation needed.
description.zh: 多工作区沙箱：自动赋予所有已注册工作区的文件写入权限——添加工作区后即可直接写入，无需配置或提权。

description.en: Stores bookmarks as local Markdown files in a folder you choose, with a sidebar page for collections and links, library-wide search, automatic favicon downloads, and three agent tools.
description.zh: 把收藏的链接存成你指定文件夹里的 Markdown 文件，带侧栏页面管理收藏夹与链接、全库搜索、自动抓取图标，以及三个 agent 工具。

description.en: Branching surveys in the web GUI: the ask_survey tool with per-option routing, hover insights, Mermaid diagrams, quick one-click answer templates, and resumable banked progress.
description.zh: 网页端分支问卷：ask_survey 工具，按选项路由后续问题，悬停洞察、Mermaid 流程图、一键快速模板，答案可暂存续答。

description.en: Agent Settings: manage reusable sub-agent profiles in the sidebar, each with a when-to-use description and its own provider/model route, and let the agent start the matching one as a subagent.
description.zh: 智能体设置：在侧边栏管理可复用的子智能体档案，为每个档案写明适用场景与所用提供方/模型，任务中由智能体按场景自动拉起对应的子智能体。

description.en: Stock research tools for US, China A-share and Hong Kong stocks via the stockproof MCP server (Python 3.10+; install with pip install "stockproof\[mcp,cn]" — A-share/HK data needs Python 3.11+): news, earnings and announcement reads with cited sources, explanations of price moves, a whole-market A-share screen, a quant lab that backtests ideas on point-in-time history with a locked holdout, a portfolio check-up and a local web dashboard; 23 tools.
description.zh: 通过 stockproof MCP 服务（Python 3.10+，需先 pip install "stockproof\[mcp,cn]"；A 股/港股数据需 Python 3.11+）为 DSH 提供美股、A 股、港股研究工具：带出处的新闻、财报和公告解读，涨跌原因解释，全市场 A 股选股，用不偷看未来的历史数据回测想法的量化实验室（近两年数据锁定），持仓体检和本地网页看板；共 23 个工具。

description.en: Minimal snippet and command toolbox for DSH: five tools over a single human-editable JSONL file, zero UI, zero database, zero network, explicit save-only memory.
description.zh: DSH 极简片段/命令工具箱：5 个工具，一个可手工编辑的 JSONL 文件，零 UI、零数据库、零网络，只有明确说存才存。

description.en: Adds the MathWorks MATLAB Agentic Toolkit skills and the MATLAB MCP Server tools to DeepSeek Harness. Needs a local MATLAB R2021a or later. Installs from the plugin's own prebuilt release archive. A DSH restart is usually unnecessary: the market mounts the plugin live, and a page refresh shows the MATLAB settings page; restart only when the market reports that the live mount failed. By default (autoProvision) it downloads the MathWorks MCP Server binary and installs the newest Agentic Toolkit release on first use. With the China download region or a configured GitHub prefix, both are fetched through the fastest measured acceleration prefix first (the plugin's own, DSH's market setting, or the built-in gh-proxy.com and ghfast.top routes) and then directly. The downloaded server binary is verified against the SHA-256 digest GitHub publishes for its release asset when the release metadata can be read, and a mismatch refuses the install; if api.github.com cannot be reached the digest is read through the same mirror, so the check then only catches a corrupted or truncated download. MathWorks telemetry is disabled by default; set disableTelemetry to false to re-enable it.
description.zh: 把 MathWorks 的 MATLAB Agentic Toolkit 技能与 MATLAB MCP Server 工具接入 DeepSeek Harness。需要本机 MATLAB R2021a 及以上。从插件自己的预构建 Release 包安装。通常不需要重启 DSH：市场会热挂载插件，刷新页面即可看到 MATLAB 设置页；只有市场提示热挂载失败时才需要重启。默认（autoProvision）首次使用时会下载 MathWorks MCP Server 并安装工具包的最新 Release。下载区域为 china 或配置了 GitHub 前缀时，两者都会先经实测最快的加速前缀（插件自己的、DSH 市场的，或中国区内置的 gh-proxy.com、ghfast.top）下载，失败再直连。能读取 Release 元数据时，下载的 MCP Server 二进制会按 GitHub 公布的资产 SHA-256 摘要校验，不一致就拒绝安装；api.github.com 连不上时摘要也经同一个镜像读取，这时的校验只能发现下载损坏或被截断。MathWorks 遥测默认关闭，把 disableTelemetry 设为 false 才会重新开启。

description.en: Drive the Tuanjie editor from DeepSeek Harness by connecting to the running editor's Codely bridge, creating and modifying GameObjects, editing component properties, running editor commands, and executing C# inside the editor process. Adapted from opdsh/unity-plugin for the Tuanjie Codely bridge.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动团结引擎编辑器：连接已运行编辑器的 Codely 桥，创建与修改 GameObject、改组件属性、执行编辑器命令，并在编辑器进程里跑 C#。改自 opdsh/unity-plugin，适配团结引擎的 Codely 桥。

description.en: Drives Cadence Virtuoso from the host: VM lifecycle, SKILL execution through the bridge, window capture, Calibre DRC parsing and a write-confirmation gate, in 12 host-only tools.
description.zh: 从宿主机驱动 Cadence Virtuoso 画版图：虚拟机生命周期、经 bridge 执行 SKILL、窗口截图、Calibre DRC 解析，以及写入确认闸门，共 12 个宿主侧工具。

description.en: Undermind literature search inside DeepSeek Harness. The plugin owns the OAuth authorization-code + PKCE login the remote MCP server requires, refreshes the rotating refresh token before expiry, re-initializes the MCP session when the server drops it, and registers every tool Undermind tools/list returns as a mcp__undermind__* tool, alongside a permanent undermind_auth tool for status, login, logout and retry. Needs an Undermind account and a client id - Undermind accepts a Client ID Metadata Document URL (CIMD) or a pre-registered client id, and does not support dynamic client registration.
description.zh: 把 Undermind 的文献检索接进 DeepSeek Harness。插件自己维护远端 MCP 服务要求的 OAuth 授权码 + PKCE 登录，在到期前刷新并轮换 refresh token、在服务端丢弃会话时重新初始化，并把 Undermind tools/list 返回的每个工具注册成 mcp__undermind__* 工具，另加一个常驻的 undermind_auth 工具用于查状态、登录、登出与重试。需要一个 Undermind 账号和一个 client id：Undermind 接受 Client ID Metadata Document URL（CIMD）或预注册 client id，不支持动态客户端注册。

description.en: Windows settings switch that replaces PowerShell with Git Bash across the four built-in presets, including a persistent terminal in minimal mode.
description.zh: Windows 上的一键 Git Bash 开关，替换四种内置模式的 PowerShell，极简模式保留持久终端。

description.en: Per-agent on-demand tool discovery and progressive schema disclosure.
description.zh: 按 agent 的按需工具发现与渐进式 schema 披露。

description.en: Run AI commands in real NyaTerm terminal sessions, reusing saved groups, jump hosts and local terminals, with a per-workspace allowlist; commands stay visible and auditable in NyaTerm.
description.zh: 在 NyaTerm 的真实终端会话里执行 AI 命令，复用已配置的分组、跳板机和本地终端，按工作区限制可用范围；命令与输出留在 NyaTerm 中，便于查看和审计。

description.en: Inspect and tidy a real Android phone over adb: storage surveys, per-app data sizes read from dumpsys diskstats without root, cache clearing that preserves app data, directory measurements and screenshots — five tools; reads never modify anything, writes require explicit confirmation.
description.zh: 用 adb 查看并打理一台真实的 Android 手机：存储体检、未 root 也能读到的逐应用数据大小（来自 dumpsys diskstats）、只清缓存不动数据的清理、目录统计与截图——共五个工具；读取永不改动任何东西，写入必须显式确认。

description.en: One-click draft polish for the DSH composer: rewrites your spoken draft into professional wording, sends only the draft snapshot (never conversation context), and never blocks sending if the LLM is unavailable.
description.zh: DSH 输入框一键润色草稿：把口语化表达改写成专业措辞；只发送草稿快照、绝不夹带会话上下文；LLM 不可用时优雅降级，不阻塞发送。

description.en: Keyless web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness: Startpage, DuckDuckGo, Exa, and more behind a consensus fan-out.
description.zh: 无需 API Key 的网页搜索提供方：并发查询 Startpage、DuckDuckGo、Exa 等多个来源，再做共识合并。

description.en: Read Miniflux inside DeepSeek Harness in a three-column panel (feeds, article list, article) and ask the assistant for unread digests, per-category briefings, full-text reads and read/star actions on the same account. Needs your own Miniflux server (2.0 or later; 2.3.2 for batch starring) and an API token, kept in the Harness credential vault (the MINIFLUX_BASE_URL and MINIFLUX_API_TOKEN environment variables also work).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用三栏面板读 Miniflux（订阅源、文章列表、正文），并让助手在同一账号上生成未读速览、按分类写简报、读全文、标已读或收藏。需要你自己的 Miniflux 服务（2.0 及以上，批量收藏需 2.3.2）和 API 令牌，令牌保存在 Harness 的凭据管理器里，也可用环境变量 MINIFLUX_BASE_URL、MINIFLUX_API_TOKEN。

description.en: IP/domain intelligence for DeepSeek Harness: ip_lookup, dns_lookup and whois_lookup tools via free no-key APIs (ipwho.is, Google DNS-over-HTTPS, RDAP).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 IP/域名情报：ip_lookup、dns_lookup、whois_lookup 工具，走免费免 key API(ipwho.is、Google DoH、RDAP)。

description.en: Share the DSH workspace over the local network: phones, tablets and other computers browse, download and upload files via browser with no DSH login. Token gate, path boundary, read-only mode and rate limit. Zero-dependency (node:http).
description.zh: 通过浏览器把 DSH 工作区分享到局域网：手机、平板、其它电脑可浏览、下载、上传文件，无需 DSH 登录。带令牌门卫、路径边界、只读模式与速率限制，零依赖(node:http)。

description.en: Force the agent's chain-of-thought, planning, tool-invocation reasoning, and internal deliberation to stay in Chinese — the language constraint is injected at the top of the system prompt before every reasoning step, so it cannot be diluted by tool-returned content. A settings panel lets you edit the constraint text on the fly.
description.zh: 让 Agent 的思考过程也自动使用中文。在每步推理前向 System Prompt 最顶部注入语言约束，强制思维链、规划、工具调用推理全部使用中文，防止工具返回英文内容后发生语言漂移。支持在设置面板中实时编辑约束文本。

description.en: Requires the Codex CLI installed and `codex login` completed. Consult the OpenAI Codex CLI from DeepSeek Harness with three tools: codex_consult runs Codex in a read-only sandbox, inlines evidence files, verifies the served model and reasoning effort from the Codex rollout file, retries disconnected streams, and records quota before and after the call; codex_quota reports the current 5-hour and weekly quota; codex_calls lists recent calls.
description.zh: 需先安装 Codex CLI 并完成 `codex login`。为 DeepSeek Harness 增加三个按需咨询 OpenAI Codex CLI 的工具：codex_consult 在只读沙箱中运行 Codex、自动内联证据文件、从 Codex rollout 记录校验实际模型与推理档位、断流自动重试，并记录调用前后的额度；codex_quota 查询当前 5 小时与每周额度；codex_calls 列出最近调用。

description.en: Text-to-image and image-to-image generation inside DSH through OpenAI-compatible endpoints, with an agent tool, multi-provider fallback, and a side-panel workspace with history.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内直接文生图/图生图：对接 OpenAI 兼容图像接口，提供 Agent 生图工具、多供应商自动降级，以及带生成历史的侧栏工作台。

description.en: DSH plugin for Gaussian 16: SMILES-to-3D, input generation, serial job management, output parsing, and Multiwfn/VMD post-processing (orbital/ESP/RDG).
description.zh: Gaussian 16 计算辅助插件：SMILES→3D 建模、输入生成、串行任务管理、输出解析，以及 Multiwfn/VMD 后处理（轨道/ESP/RDG 出图）。

description.en: Trending-topics collector aggregating Baidu / Toutiao / Douyin / Weibo hot lists in one call (Weibo optional cookie), returning titles with heat values for content creators — tool: `sxs_news_hot`.
description.zh: 时事热点采集：一次调用聚合百度热搜 / 头条热榜 / 抖音热点 / 微博热搜（微博可选 cookie），返回标题+热度值，供内容创作借势——工具：`sxs_news_hot`。

description.en: Subagent delegation provider that runs any Claude-compatible CLI binary pointed at by a configurable executablePath field.
description.zh: 子代理委派提供方：通过可配置的 executablePath 字段，运行任意 Claude 兼容 CLI 二进制。

description.en: Create a one-click Windows desktop shortcut from the Settings page: a .cmd launcher + desktop icon for DeepSeek Harness or any local server, auto-opens the browser, with taskbar pin hints.
description.zh: 在设置页一键创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式：为 DeepSeek Harness 或任意本地服务生成 .cmd 启动器与桌面图标，自动打开浏览器、可固定任务栏。

description.en: Human-in-the-loop tools (`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`): pause the agent until the user performs a real-world action or returns an observation (GUI operation, game testing, visual verification, hardware checks), gated by session consent and an AFK presence check, returning a structured JSON result via a web task dialog.
description.zh: 人工协作工具（`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`）：让 Agent 暂停等待用户完成现实操作或返回观察结果（GUI 操作、游戏测试、视觉验证、硬件检查等），内置会话同意与 AFK 在场两级门控，通过 Web 任务窗返回结构化 JSON 结果。

description.en: Attach tables and documents (xlsx, csv, pdf, zip…) to the DSH composer via paste or drag-and-drop: files are saved into the session workspace and an @reference is inserted.
description.zh: 把表格与文档（xlsx、csv、pdf、zip…）粘贴或拖拽进 DSH 输入框即可附加：文件会保存到会话工作区并插入 @引用。

description.en: Adds an agnes_image tool that calls the Agnes Image Flash models (2.5, 2.1, 2.0) for text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition, and ships a settings-page console for the active model, default size and aspect ratio, output folder, API key and generation history.
description.zh: 提供 agnes_image 工具，调用 Agnes Image Flash 系列模型（2.5 / 2.1 / 2.0）完成文生图、图生图与多图合成，并带一个设置页控制台管理当前模型、默认档位与画幅、输出目录、API Key 与生成历史。

description.en: Audits Chinese copy for AI-sounding phrasing: a 0-100 score over six dimensions, sentence-level flags with rewrite hints, and per-genre weights adjustable in conversation.
description.zh: 中文文案去 AI 味审计：0–100 六维评分、逐句打标并给出改法，文体权重可在对话里查看和修改。

description.en: Generic Companion-protocol bridge from DeepSeek Harness to phones/IoT/legacy agents (includes Termux companion example).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通用 Companion 桥：手机 / IoT / 旧世界薄 Agent（含 Termux 样例）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness to macOS companion daemon (notify / Shortcuts / clipboard read-write).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对接 macOS Companion（通知 / Shortcuts / 剪贴板读写）。

description.en: Opens http(s) URLs from WSL in the Windows default browser.
description.zh: 在 Windows 默认浏览器中打开来自 WSL 的 http(s) 链接。

description.en: Read-only khal calendar list.
description.zh: 日历只读：khal list / today。

description.en: Reads and writes the Windows clipboard from WSL.
description.zh: 从 WSL 读写 Windows 剪贴板。

description.en: Detects WSL2 clock skew versus Windows that can break TLS and tokens.
description.zh: 检测相对 Windows 的 WSL2 时钟偏差，避免 TLS 与 token 异常。

description.en: Docker Compose ps/logs with richer status; up/down double-gated.
description.zh: Docker Compose：ps/logs 与更丰 status；up/down 需双重确认。

description.en: Safe Git Credential Manager hints for WSL without exposing secrets.
description.zh: 提供 WSL 下 Git Credential Manager 的安全指引，不回传密钥。

description.en: Read-only psql + redis-cli probes.
description.zh: psql / redis-cli 只读探针。

description.en: Windows security posture from WSL: Defender real-time state and signature age, recent detections, exclusions, and firewall profiles.
description.zh: Windows 安全态势：Defender 实时状态与特征库年龄、近期检出、排除项与防火墙配置。

description.en: Reports the current WSL distro and warns about multi-distro setups.
description.zh: 报告当前 WSL 发行版，并提醒多发行版混用风险。

description.en: Compares WSL versus Windows DNS resolution for common endpoints.
description.zh: 对比 WSL 与 Windows 对常用域名的 DNS 解析结果。

description.en: Reports Docker CLI, context, and daemon reachability in WSL, plus vLLM :8000 /v1/models health and GPU runtime hints.
description.zh: 报告 WSL 内 Docker CLI、context 与 daemon 是否可达，并探测 vLLM :8000 的 /v1/models 健康与 GPU runtime。

description.en: Lists or copies files from the Windows Downloads folder into the WSL workspace.
description.zh: 列出或复制 Windows「下载」文件夹中的文件到 WSL 工作区。

description.en: Opens a WSL Linux path in Windows Cursor, VS Code, or Notepad (optional line/column; win_editor_status).
description.zh: 用 Windows 的 Cursor、VS Code 或 Notepad 打开 WSL 路径（可选行列；含 win_editor_status）。

description.en: Reports PowerShell, cmd, and LANG encoding for UTF-8 versus code-page issues.
description.zh: 报告 PowerShell、cmd 与 LANG 编码，便于排查 UTF-8 与代码页问题。

description.en: Read recent Windows event log entries from WSL, filtered by log name, level, provider and time window.
description.zh: Windows 事件日志：按日志名、级别、来源与时间窗读取近期条目。

description.en: Advises or applies allowlisted Windows portproxy for a WSL listen port, preferring the kit :3081 relay and launch token for local dsh UI.
description.zh: 为 WSL 监听端口提供白名单 Windows portproxy 建议或应用；本机 dsh UI 优先用 kit 的 :3081 中继与 launch token。

description.en: Registers a wsl-proxy ctx.web fetch provider so official web_fetch uses undici ProxyAgent through HTTP(S)_PROXY instead of connecting from WSL to a DNS-pinned public IP (the official path that produces TypeError: fetch failed behind a Windows proxy).
description.zh: 在 ctx.web 注册 wsl-proxy 抓取后端，让官方 web_fetch 经 HTTP(S)_PROXY 用 undici ProxyAgent 出网，避免官方实现在 WSL 里 DNS 钉死后直连公网 IP，从而在 Windows 代理后出现 TypeError: fetch failed。

description.en: Capped Git status / diff --stat / log --oneline (no full patches).
description.zh: 截断版 Git status / diff --stat / log --oneline。

description.en: Uses a GitHub App to report open PRs and the latest Actions run for the current repo without returning secrets.
description.zh: 通过 GitHub App 查询当前仓库未关闭 PR 与最近一次 Actions，不回传密钥。

description.en: Read-only glab MR / issue / ci status.
description.zh: glab 只读：MR / issue / ci。

description.en: Probes nvidia-smi and GPU visibility inside WSL.
description.zh: 探测 WSL 内的 nvidia-smi 与 GPU 可见性。

description.en: Read-only Helm list / status / history.
description.zh: Helm 只读：list / status / history。

description.en: Probes Windows-host Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, and llama-server from WSL, compares ctx, and reports /v1/models apiReady versus TCP.
description.zh: 从 WSL 探测 Windows 上的 Ollama、LM Studio、vLLM 与 llama-server，比对 ctx，并报告 /v1/models 的 apiReady 与 TCP 是否打通。

description.en: Bridges Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, QQ, Slack, Discord, Telegram and Mattermost into dsh agents (outbound WS/Stream/Gateway/long-poll/webhook), with im_status, optional local Whisper ASR, plain-text outbound for QQ/DingTalk/Telegram/Mattermost, and env CSV allowlists (DSH_IM_*_ALLOWED_USER_IDS). Empty allowedUserIds means EVERYONE can drive your agent — set a whitelist before exposing a bot.
description.zh: 把飞书、企微、钉钉、QQ、Slack、Discord、Telegram、Mattermost 桥进 dsh agent（出站长连接/长轮询/Webhook），提供 im_status、可选本机 Whisper ASR、QQ/钉钉/TG/MM 纯文本出站，以及环境变量白名单（DSH_IM_*_ALLOWED_USER_IDS）。allowedUserIds 为空即任何人都能驱动 agent——对外暴露前请先设白名单。

description.en: Call TypeSafe Jev / OpenRouter System One for noul, choice, and score (jev_ask / jev_check / jev_rank).
description.zh: 对接 TypeSafe Jev / OpenRouter System One：jev_ask / jev_check / jev_rank。

description.en: Read-only kubectl get / describe / logs / contexts for dsh on WSL (configurable log tail).
description.zh: kubectl 只读：get / describe / logs / contexts（可配置 logs 行数帽）。

description.en: Launches allowlisted Windows apps such as VS Code, Explorer, and browsers from WSL.
description.zh: 从 WSL 白名单启动 Windows 应用（如 VS Code、资源管理器、浏览器）。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible client for llama.cpp / Unsloth Desktop (default :8080).
description.zh: 对接 llama.cpp / Unsloth 的 OpenAI 兼容接口（默认 :8080）。

description.en: Mail list/search via himalaya / notmuch (no send).
description.zh: 邮件只读：himalaya / notmuch（不发送）。

description.en: Local media/doc pipeline: ffprobe, extract, thumbnail, PDF, ASR, pandoc, OCR, exif (allowRoots include IM inbox).
description.zh: 本地媒体/文档管线：ffprobe、抽音轨、缩略图、PDF、ASR、pandoc、OCR、exif（allowRoots 含 IM inbox）。

description.en: Warns when the workspace path sits on slow /mnt/c.
description.zh: 当工作区路径落在缓慢的 /mnt/c 上时发出告警。

description.en: Shows a short Windows MessageBox or toast (BalloonTip) from WSL when a long task finishes.
description.zh: 长任务结束后从 WSL 弹出 Windows MessageBox 或 toast（气球提示）。

description.en: Optional Obscura headless-browser tools from WSL (obscura_status / obscura_fetch / obscura_mcp_hint). Not the same as dsh-wsl-browser win_open_url (Windows GUI browser), and not a replacement for dsh-wsl-fetch web_fetch.
description.zh: 可选：在 WSL 中驱动 Obscura 无头浏览器（obscura_status / obscura_fetch / obscura_mcp_hint）。不同于 dsh-wsl-browser 的 win_open_url（打开 Windows 图形浏览器），也不替代 dsh-wsl-fetch 的 web_fetch。

description.en: Bridges a WSL dsh agent to a Windows Obsidian vault on NTFS: status/list/search/read/write/append, wikilink resolve, write/append require confirm=true, plus obsidian:// open. Keep the vault under /mnt/<drive>/; Linux-disk vaults via \\wsl$ are unreliable.
description.zh: 把 WSL 里的 dsh agent 接到 Windows NTFS 上的 Obsidian vault：status/list/search/read/write/append、wikilink 解析、写操作需 confirm=true，并用 obsidian:// 打开。vault 请放在 /mnt/<盘符>/；Linux 盘经 \\wsl$ 不可靠。

description.en: Local Ollama status / list / chat / embed for dsh on WSL (unreachable status includes Windows/WSL gateway hints).
description.zh: 本机 Ollama：status / list / chat / embed（不可达时给出 Windows/WSL 网关提示）。

description.en: Converts Linux and Windows paths with /mnt/c caveats for WSL.
description.zh: 在 WSL 下转换 Linux 与 Windows 路径，并说明 /mnt/c 注意点。

description.en: Windows host performance from WSL: CPU, memory, disk and top processes.
description.zh: Windows 宿主性能：CPU、内存、磁盘与占用最高的进程。

description.en: Browse WSL directories under / and /mnt for workspace picking (start/filter; im-workspace shortcuts).
description.zh: 浏览 WSL 的 / 与 /mnt 目录以便挑选工作区（start/filter；含 im-workspace 快捷入口）。

description.en: Dependency tree summaries: npm / pip / cargo.
description.zh: 依赖树摘要：npm / pip / cargo。

description.en: Headless Playwright fetch (title + body text) in WSL.
description.zh: WSL 无头 Playwright 抓取标题与正文。

description.en: Diagnoses WSL port listening and Windows localhost forwarding, with a 3080/3081 uiPlaybook for the dsh web relay and launch token.
description.zh: 诊断 WSL 端口监听与 Windows localhost 转发，并对 dsh web 中继的 3080/3081 给出含 launch token 的 uiPlaybook。

description.en: Windows power state from WSL: active power plan, all schemes, battery, sleep timeout and hibernation availability.
description.zh: Windows 电源：当前方案、全部方案、电池、休眠超时与是否支持休眠。

description.en: Read-only rclone listremotes / lsf / about.
description.zh: rclone 只读：listremotes / lsf / about。

description.en: Read-only Windows registry access from WSL, restricted to an allowlist of key prefixes; list a key's values or its child keys.
description.zh: Windows 注册表只读：限定在允许的键前缀内，可列值或列子键。

description.en: Sandboxed ripgrep / fd / ast-grep under allowRoots (defaults include ~/.dsh/im-workspace).
description.zh: 沙箱 ripgrep / fd / ast-grep（默认 allowRoots 含 ~/.dsh/im-workspace）。

description.en: Read-only pass / age secrets with allowPrefixes; reveal defaults to false.
description.zh: 只读 pass / age 密钥（需 allowPrefixes）；默认不明文回显。

description.en: Read Windows service state from WSL: list services, or inspect one by name with its dependencies, logon account and binary path.
description.zh: Windows 服务：列服务，或按名查单个服务的依赖、登录账户与可执行路径。

description.en: Saves a Windows clipboard image into a WSL file (clear ok:false + hint when clipboard has no image).
description.zh: 将 Windows 剪贴板图片存为 WSL 文件（无图时返回明确 ok:false 与 hint）。

description.en: Hints how to forward the Windows OpenSSH agent into WSL without dumping keys.
description.zh: 提示如何把 Windows OpenSSH agent 转发进 WSL，且不输出密钥。

description.en: Sandboxed jq / yq / read-only sqlite3.
description.zh: 沙箱化 jq / yq / sqlite3（只读 SELECT）。

description.en: Read-only systemd --user list / show / journal.
description.zh: systemd --user 只读：list / show / journal。

description.en: Terraform/OpenTofu plan summary + state list (never apply).
description.zh: Terraform/OpenTofu：plan 摘要 + state list（永不 apply）。

description.en: Windows UI Automation from WSL: enumerate top-level windows, read a bounded element tree, and wait for or trace the path to a named element.
description.zh: Windows UI Automation：枚举顶层窗口、读取有界元素树，并按名等待元素或取祖先链。

description.en: Tiny local vector memory via Ollama embeddings and ~/.dsh/vecmem (workspace namespaces; optional IM crumb via vecmemOnReply).
description.zh: 本地向量小记：Ollama embedding + ~/.dsh/vecmem（workspace 命名空间；可选 IM 回合摘要写入）。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible vLLM client (default :8000).
description.zh: 对接 vLLM 的 OpenAI 兼容服务（默认 :8000）。

description.en: Enumerate and control Windows top-level windows from WSL: activate, minimize, maximize, restore, move, resize, set always-on-top, close.
description.zh: Windows 窗口控制：激活、最小化、最大化、还原、移动、改尺寸、置顶、关闭。

description.en: Targeted Windows input from WSL: invoke a UI Automation element by name, or send keys, clicks and mouse wheel to a chosen window.
description.zh: Windows 定向输入：按名调用 UI 元素，或向指定窗口发送按键、点击与滚轮。

description.en: Capture a Windows window to a WSL file, whole or cropped to a region or to a named UI element.
description.zh: 截取 Windows 窗口到 WSL 文件：整窗、按区域裁剪，或裁剪到指定 UI 元素。

description.en: Lists WSL distros and validates a Linux workspace path for DSH.
description.zh: 列出 WSL 发行版并校验可用于 DSH 的 Linux 工作区路径。

description.en: Gives read-only advice for Windows .wslconfig memory and mirrored networking.
description.zh: 只读查看 Windows .wslconfig，并给出内存与 mirrored 网络建议。

description.en: Fixes the Windows workspace-open action: the shipped opener spawns explorer.exe with windowsHide, so the File Explorer window is created invisible and the click reports success without appearing.
description.zh: 修正 Windows 上「打开工作目录」：上游启动 explorer.exe 时带了 windowsHide，导致文件资源管理器窗口被创建为不可见，点击看似成功却什么都没出现。

description.en: Injects native-Windows (non-WSL) PowerShell, encoding, filesystem, and cross-platform-build gotchas into the system prompt.
description.zh: 向系统提示注入原生 Windows（非 WSL）环境下 PowerShell、字符编码、文件系统与跨平台构建的常见坑点。

description.en: Generic browser automation with six tools (browser_open, browser_click, browser_type, browser_extract, browser_screenshot, browser_eval), @e element references, and dual Playwright-headless / CDP (connect to your own Chrome) backends.
description.zh: 通用浏览器自动化：browser_open、browser_click、browser_type、browser_extract、browser_screenshot、browser_eval 六个工具，@e 元素引用，Playwright 无头与 CDP（连接本机 Chrome）双后端。

description.en: Opens the dsh web GUI in a dedicated Edge/Chrome app-mode window on its own browser profile and gracefully stops the server when that window is closed.
description.zh: 在独立浏览器 profile 的 Edge/Chrome 应用模式窗口中打开 dsh web 界面，关闭窗口即优雅停止服务。

description.en: Exa web search and fetch provider for DSH: replaces built-in web search and exposes multi-source research capabilities.
description.zh: 基于 Exa 的 DSH 网页搜索与抓取插件：完全接管内置网络检索，并提供多源深度调研工具。

description.en: Mobile-viewport preview tab for the right sidebar, with nine preset sizes covering phones, tablets and a laptop plus a custom width/height, one-click URL copy, and the page URL inserted into the composer through an @ button or the /url command.
description.zh: 右侧边栏的移动端视口预览标签页：九种预设尺寸（手机、平板、笔记本）及自定义宽高，一键复制当前地址，并可通过 @ 按钮或 /url 指令把页面地址插入输入框。

description.en: Web search and fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness and Pi: anonymous-first routing across Exa, Tavily, Parallel, Firecrawl and TinyFish, with opt-in billing, quota preflight and bounded cancellation.
description.zh: 同时兼容 DSH 与 Pi 的搜索与抓取提供方：Exa、Tavily、Parallel、Firecrawl、TinyFish 匿名优先路由，计费需显式授权，带额度预检与有界取消。

description.en: Type /tabs to pick a browser tab (via chrome-devtools-mcp) and auto-fill its URL into the composer.
description.zh: 输入 /tabs 弹出浏览器标签页选择器，点选后链接自动填入输入框。

description.en: Tavily, Exa and Firecrawl behind one normalized web_search and web_fetch seam: a failing vendor falls through a cooled-down chain, and the row is a host Config form the desktop page and dsh-go both edit.
description.zh: 把 Tavily、Exa、Firecrawl 归一到同一层 web_search 与 web_fetch：厂商失败时按冷却链回退，配置是宿主的一段 Config 表单，桌面与 dsh-go 读写同一处。

description.en: Zero-key web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: scrapes Bing China, 360 and SearXNG through a backend fallback chain and returns real URLs with snippets and publish dates. No API key and no settings card are required. SearXNG is used only when you set your own instance URL, and installing this plugin switches web_search to it and turns off the official DeepSeek search row.
description.zh: 免 key 的 web_search 后端：按降级链抓取 Bing 中文站、360 与 SearXNG，返回真实 URL、摘要与发布日期；不需要任何 API key，也没有设置卡片。面向校园网等拿不到官方 key 的环境。SearXNG 仅在配置自有实例地址后才会启用；安装后 web_search 会切换到本插件，并停用官方 DeepSeek 搜索行。

description.en: A conversation-independent floating window for chat.deepseek.com, rendered in a webview, draggable and resizable, with page zoom, opacity control and an optional floating ball. It makes no API calls, stores no credentials and injects no scripts.
description.zh: 与会话无关的 chat.deepseek.com 浮窗，用 webview 渲染，可拖动、缩放、调不透明度，可选悬浮球。不调接口、不存凭据、不注入脚本。

description.en: Tavily-backed search provider for native web_search, with a Settings → Plugins card for API key management and toggling DeepSeek replacement.
description.zh: 为原生 web_search 提供 Tavily 搜索后端，并在设置 → 插件中提供 API Key 管理与是否替换 DeepSeek 的开关。

description.en: Connects Chrome, Edge and QQ Browser to DeepSeek Harness through a local MV3 extension and loopback bridge, exposing 12 browser tools for navigation, snapshots, clicks, typing, extraction and screenshots. The browser extension is loaded manually (MV3, developer mode) and paired with the bridge, and it requests the debugger permission.
description.zh: 通过本机 MV3 扩展与回环桥把 Chrome、Edge、QQ 浏览器接入 DSH，提供 12 个浏览器工具用于导航、快照、点击、输入、提取与截图。浏览器扩展需手动加载（MV3、开发者模式）并与桥配对，且会申请 debugger 权限。

description.en: WebMCP bridge: your agent discovers & calls site tools exposed over the W3C WebMCP protocol via a built-in headless Chromium.
description.zh: WebMCP 桥接器：让 agent 通过内置无头 Chromium，发现并调用网站按 W3C WebMCP 协议暴露的站点工具。

description.en: Zero-dependency browser hand & eye over CDP: drives your own Chrome/Edge with real clicks, Chinese IME typing, scrolling and text/selector element picking, and captures whole-page evidence into one replayable folder — DOM, accessibility tree, screenshots, cookies, storage, console, HAR, resource waterfall and perf metrics.
description.zh: 零依赖的浏览器「手和眼」（CDP 接入）：直接驱动本机 Chrome/Edge，真实点击、中文输入、滚动、按文字或选择器定位；并能把整页抓成可离线复盘的证据包——DOM、无障碍树、截图、Cookie、本地存储、控制台、HAR、资源瀑布与性能指标。

description.en: Chrome DevTools Protocol Plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Use chrome-remote-interface to connect to and control Chrome via CDP. The connection includes a graphical interface.
description.zh: Chrome DevTools Protocol 插件 for DeepSeek Harness。通过 chromremote-interface 以 CDP 连接并操控 Chrome。连接带有图形界面。

description.en: Opens chat.deepseek.com inside DSH Desktop from a conversation view tab (next to Chat / Trajectory / Context, scoped to the open conversation) and from a left-rail globe button — all entries share one embedded page, so switching between them never reloads it. Keeps you signed in across restarts by replaying a localStorage plus readable-cookie snapshot before the page's own scripts run, strips only the Electron/<version> token from the user agent, and keeps navigation inside deepseek.com while sending everything else to the system browser. Pure client code: no host-side script, no file access, no credential service, no server route.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端里打开 chat.deepseek.com：入口有两个——会话视图标签栏里的「网页端」（与「对话｜轨迹｜上下文」并列， 随当前会话走），以及左上角面板列的地球图标；两者共用同一个内嵌页面，切换入口不会重新加载。登录态可跨重启保留 （在页面自身脚本执行前回放 localStorage 与页面可读 cookie 的快照），UA 只剥离 Electron/<版本> 标记， 导航限制在 deepseek.com 内、其余链接交给系统浏览器。纯客户端实现：没有宿主侧脚本、不读文件、不走凭据服务、不开服务器路由。

description.en: Screen capture and external vision recognition: take_screenshot, list_windows, analyze_image and view_image tools with a configurable GPT vision channel (gpt-5.5 / gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-terra), API key via the credentials service, and a settings card; view_image shows the screenshot in the Web UI while the model context keeps text only.
description.zh: 屏幕截图与外部视觉识别：take_screenshot、list_windows、analyze_image、view_image 四个工具，可配置 GPT 视觉通道（gpt-5.5 / gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-terra），API Key 经凭据服务存储，带设置卡片；view_image 在 Web 对话中显示截图，模型上下文只保留文字。

description.en: Captures a dragged desktop region with a global hotkey and either recognises its text with Windows OCR or attaches the screenshot to the chat draft.
description.zh: 全局快捷键截取桌面选区，用 Windows OCR 识别文字填入输入框，或直接把截图插入对话。

description.en: Registers one `ocr` tool for text-only models: it runs the offline script bundled in the repo over a single image or PDF and returns the recognized text — Windows native OCR first, then RapidOCR, then Tesseract. Recognition runs locally with no network request and no API key. Needs Python 3.11 on PATH plus `pip install winocr pillow` (winocr is the preferred engine; RapidOCR and Tesseract are fallbacks). Per-line results for images, per-page results for PDFs.
description.zh: 为纯文本模型注册一个 `ocr` 工具：调用仓库自带的离线脚本识别单张图片或 PDF 并返回文字——Windows 原生 OCR 优先，其次 RapidOCR，最后 Tesseract；识别过程在本机完成，不发网络请求、不需要 API key。需自备 PATH 上的 Python 3.11 并 `pip install winocr pillow`（winocr 为首选引擎，RapidOCR 与 Tesseract 为兜底）。图片返回逐行结果，PDF 返回逐页结果。

description.en: Synesthesia Encoder for DSH: a vision model translates images into compact structured spatial text (canvas/elements/percentage coordinates), giving text-only LLMs pixel-level image understanding via the `mm_vision` tool.
description.zh: 通感编码器（Synesthesia Encoder）：调用视觉模型把图片翻译成紧凑的结构化空间文字（画布/元素/百分比坐标），让纯文本 LLM 获得像素级看图能力（`mm_vision` 工具）。

description.en: Vision relay for text-only models: a configurable GLM-compatible vision endpoint analyzes the images you attach in the background and the original model keeps answering in the same session, leaving your message, image, model and history untouched. Requires applying patches/0001-session-image-admission.patch to a stock DSH install (images are rejected before storage otherwise); the repo ships an apply/restore script.
description.zh: 为纯文本模型提供的图像识别转发：后台调用你配置的 GLM 兼容视觉接口分析图片，原模型在同一会话继续作答，你的消息、图片、模型与历史全程不变。需先运行仓库自带的 patches/apply-core-patch.cmd 给 DSH 打核心补丁，否则带图消息会在入库前被原版 DSH 拒绝（可用 restore 脚本还原）。

description.en: Local-first structured vision for text-only agents: images go to a local OpenAI-compatible VLM and come back as JSON evidence (summary, verbatim OCR, layout regions, entities/relations, colors, explicit uncertainty), with anti-hallucination fallback and an optional paste/upload bridge; zero cloud cost, images never leave the machine.
description.zh: 本地优先的结构化视觉插件：图片交给本地 OpenAI 兼容 VLM，返回 JSON 证据（摘要、逐字 OCR、版面区域、实体/关系、配色、显式不确定项），带反幻觉回退与可选粘贴/上传桥；零云端成本，图片不出本机。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness vision plugin: 8 analysis modes (describe, OCR, chart data, UI review, object detection, compare, code-gen, debug), any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible vision API, with a built-in free vision model and automatic rate-limit failover.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 图像理解插件：8 种分析模式（描述、OCR、图表取数、UI 评审、目标检测、对比、代码生成、诊断），支持任意 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容视觉 API，内置免费视觉模型与限流自动切换。

description.en: Transparent multimodal routing for text-only models: every image in every model call is fully transcribed (verbatim OCR, data, uncertainty zones, injection-hardened) by your own multimodal understander, with focused re-look via vision_relook and automatic retry on image-related failures. No bundled endpoints, no borrowed logins.
description.zh: 纯文本模型的透明多模态路由：每一次模型调用里的每张图片先由你自己配置的多模态理解模型全量转述（逐字 OCR、数据、不确定区、防注入），vision_relook 定点复看，图片类报错自动转述重试。不内置端点、不借登录态。

description.en: Turn every idea into an image or video with Kling AI. In DeepSeek Harness, use natural language for text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-image creation, task tracking, and result previews.
description.zh: 一句话，让灵感从想法变成大片。在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接用自然语言调用可灵 AI，支持文生图、图生图、文生视频、图生视频、参考图创作、任务跟踪和结果预览。

description.en: On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek models: upload images, and the model calls a view_image tool backed by any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (Qwen/DashScope by default).
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 模型提供按需视觉：上传图片后，模型通过 view_image 工具调用任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点（默认 Qwen/DashScope）。

description.en: Vision-augmented DeepSeek adapter: a vision-capable model describes image input, then a text-only DeepSeek model reasons over the description.
description.zh: 视觉增强的 DeepSeek 适配器：由视觉模型把图片描述成文字，纯文本 DeepSeek 模型再基于描述推理。

description.en: Full-screen screenshot panel for the DSH composer: marquee selection with rectangle, ellipse, arrow, pen, mosaic and text annotation, then insert into the conversation, copy or save. The selected region can also be recognized offline — PP-OCRv6 through onnxruntime-node, falling back to the built-in Windows OCR engine — and translated into nine languages with the model already configured in DSH. On Windows the marquee covers the whole screen including the taskbar and hides the DSH window first, so the capture is of the real desktop. The panel runs in an Edge or Chrome kiosk window, and falls back to an in-DSH capture flow when no browser can be launched. Note that DSH Desktop denies ordinary browser access by default, so the full-screen panel also needs "Allow opening this Profile in a browser" (compatibility mode) enabled in the profile settings; without it every capture goes through the in-DSH fallback. Windows only (DSH Desktop); the PP-OCRv6 models are downloaded from ModelScope on first recognition.
description.zh: DSH 输入框旁的整屏截图面板：框选后可标注矩形、椭圆、箭头、画笔、马赛克与文字，再插入对话、复制或另存为；框选区域可以用 PP-OCRv6（onnxruntime-node，模型未就绪时回落 Windows 自带 OCR 引擎）离线识别成文字，再用 DSH 里已配置好的模型翻译成九种语言。Windows 下框选覆盖含任务栏的整个屏幕，截图前会先隐藏 DSH 窗口，截到的是真实桌面；面板由 Edge 或 Chrome 的 kiosk 窗口承载，找不到可用浏览器时回退到 DSH 内截图。注意 DSH Desktop 默认不放行普通浏览器的访问，所以整屏面板还需要在 profile 设置里打开「允许在浏览器中打开」（兼容模式）；没打开时每次截图都走 DSH 内回退流程。仅支持 Windows（DSH Desktop）；PP-OCRv6 模型在首次识别时从 ModelScope 下载。

description.en: Reads a local video or page link with ffmpeg and Paraformer ASR, returning a timestamped transcript plus key-frame images the agent can open; finds candidate videos by keyword and installs its own runtime dependencies on first use. Requires Python 3.8+ on PATH; video_discover also needs a one-time douyin/xiaohongshu login.
description.zh: 用 ffmpeg 与 Paraformer 读取本地视频或网页链接，返回带时间轴的逐字稿与可逐帧打开的关键帧图片；可按关键词检索候选视频，首次使用时自动安装运行时依赖。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.8+；video_discover 还需一次性登录抖音/小红书。

description.en: Add PaddleOCR vision to text-only LLMs like Agnes, DeepSeek, MiniMax, GLM and Mimo. Supports local files and URLs. Free tier of 20,000 pages/day; needs a PaddleOCR API token you apply for (free, 1-3 business days).
description.zh: 为纯文本模型添加 PaddleOCR 视觉能力，支持 Agnes、DeepSeek、MiniMax、GLM、Mimo，支持本地文件与 URL。每日 2 万页免费额度；需先申请 PaddleOCR API Token（免费，审核约 1-3 个工作日）。

description.en: Multi-engine image generation inside the conversation: an agent tool plus a composer-dock panel with an on/off switch, engine presets (Volcengine Ark, SiliconFlow, OpenAI-compatible, custom) and local spend tracking. You supply the API key for the engine you pick.
description.zh: 会话内多引擎生图：agent 工具 + 输入框下方的停靠面板，带启用开关、引擎预设（火山方舟 / 硅基流动 / OpenAI 兼容 / 自定义）和本地消耗统计。需自备所选引擎的 API Key。

description.en: See the whole screen clearly: a 146-token overview map first, then 1:1 blocks up to 1400x900 so text is pixel-legible; a single sight_see tool with an on-screen eye toggle, measured against a 1600px host shrink limit. Windows only (it uses PowerShell); capture stays off until you click the eye.
description.zh: 一眼看清：先给一张 146 token 的整屏缩略地图，再按块 1:1 看清（单块上限 1400x900，字按原像素读），一个 sight_see 工具，界面上有一只眼睛随时开关；判据来自实测的 1600px 宿主缩图线。仅支持 Windows（依赖 PowerShell）；不点眼睛就不会截屏。

description.en: Client-side image downscaler for DeepSeek Harness: intercepts paste and drag-drop images over 1999px in memory via HTML Canvas and raises legacy attachment maxImageDimension up to 4096 when writable.
description.zh: DSH 图片上传前客户端等比压缩插件：拦截剪贴板粘贴与拖拽上传的图像，在内存中用 Canvas 将最长边超过 1999px 的图片等比缩放后再投递，并在未冻结的旧宿主上尝试放宽 maxImageDimension 至 4096。

description.en: Text-to-speech for the dsh-go native phone UI: long-press an assistant reply to read it aloud through Xiaomi MiMo TTS or ByteDance Doubao Seed TTS. The reply is segmented and pre-synthesized in the background after each turn, so one tap hands the app a single continuous MP3 instead of one short chunk per tap; playback has a stable lease so stop works, a status strip and progress bar give live feedback, and audio can be exported to phone storage. Keys stay on the device (0600) and are never rendered, committed, or sent to the model.
description.zh: dsh-go 手机原生界面的语音朗读插件：长按回复即可用小米 MiMo TTS 或字节豆包 Seed TTS 念出来。回合结束后台自动分段预合成，点一次交给 App 的是一整段连续 MP3，而不是一次只念一小段；播放持有稳定的租约，所以「停止」真的停得住；输入框上方状态条与面板进度条提供实时反馈；支持把音频导出到手机存储。Key 只存本机（0600），不回显、不入库、不发给模型。

description.en: Adds two Volcengine Doubao cloud speech recognizers to the DeepSeek Harness voice-input picker, optionally rewriting the transcript with an LLM.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入加入两个豆包云端识别器，可选再用大模型把口语顺成通顺的书面句子。

description.en: Music composition inside the conversation: the model writes a score against a bundled composing skill, and a play_score tool renders it as an inline card with a piano roll, Web Audio playback and WAV/JSON export.
description.zh: 在对话里作曲：模型按内置作曲规范写出乐谱 JSON，play_score 工具校验后渲染成对话内的卡片，含卷帘图、Web Audio 实时播放与 WAV/JSON 导出。

description.en: One-line song cover: fetch a track or take a local file, split stems, derive a key shift, run RVC conversion through Applio, align the vocal, mix three variants and gate the master — nine stages across three tools, zero npm dependencies. Requires a local Applio install (Python, ffmpeg, yt-dlp), a voice model and a CUDA GPU.
description.zh: 一句话翻唱：取源或直接用本地文件、分轨、自动定调、经 Applio 跑 RVC 换声、对齐人声、混出三档、过闸门再导出——九个阶段、三个工具、零 npm 依赖；需要本机装好 Applio（含 Python、ffmpeg、yt-dlp）、一个音色模型和一块 CUDA 显卡。

description.en: Connects a local Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro to the agent through its own Lua script API, with five tools for discovery, a persistent bridge, voice composition, note editing and DAW (VST3/ARA + MIDI) integration. Windows 10/11 only; requires Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 2.1.2+ with a project open.
description.zh: 通过 Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 自带的 Lua 脚本 API 把它接入 Agent，提供自动发现、常驻桥、演唱创作、音符编辑与 DAW（VST3/ARA + MIDI）集成五个工具。仅 Windows 10/11；需安装 Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 2.1.2+ 并打开工程。

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech for DSH: reads replies aloud, switches voices from the right sidebar, and trains a new voice from a dropped audio sample. First run downloads an 11.4 GB engine and needs an NVIDIA CUDA GPU.
description.zh: 基于 GPT-SoVITS 的本地语音合成：朗读 DSH 回复、在右侧边栏换音色，拖一段声音就能训练新音色。首次使用需下载约 11.4 GB 引擎，并要求 NVIDIA CUDA 显卡。

description.en: Document review workbench: select text in a Markdown file, leave comments saved as MRSF sidecar files next to it, and let the agent read them with doc_review_* tools and propose edits you accept or reject.
description.zh: 文档批注台：在 Markdown 文档上划词写批注，批注按 MRSF 侧车文件存在文档旁，Agent 用 doc_review_* 工具读取并登记改动提案，你在批注页逐条接受或拒绝。

description.en: Serve any local file in DSH web sessions - /ws/<absolute-path> maps disk files to same-origin http URLs that session markdown can render. Any drive, no staging directory.
description.zh: 让会话 markdown 直接渲染本地任意位置的图片与文件：/ws/<本地绝对路径> 同源路由，跨盘符、中文路径、深层嵌套与 UNC 均可，无需先复制到特定目录。

description.en: A local literature workbench for Windows x64 with PDF reading and annotations, automatic initial reading, separate per-paper Harness conversations, and a library assistant that searches metadata and shared summaries.
description.zh: Windows x64 本地文献工作台，支持 PDF 阅读与批注、导入后自动初读、每篇论文独立的 Harness 对话，以及按元数据和共享摘要检索的文献库助手。

description.en: Structure-level watermark removal for PDF and Word: finds full-page Form XObject overlays drawn on every page and text blocks matching a watermark vocabulary, lists them by confidence, then excises only the drawing operators or runs — the text layer, embedded images and their resolution are not re-rendered or altered.
description.zh: 面向 PDF 与 Word 的结构级去水印：识别每页都会绘制的整页 Form XObject 图层水印，以及命中水印词表的文字块，按置信度列出候选后仅摘除对应的绘制指令或 run——正文文字层、内嵌图片与其分辨率均不重绘、不改动。

description.en: Mermaid diagram renderer for the Web UI conversation: renders mermaid code blocks into interactive cards (zoom, fit-width, fullscreen viewer, preview/code toggle) with official UI primitives, and keeps the original code block with an inline error banner when rendering fails.
description.zh: Web UI 对话 mermaid 渲染插件：将消息中的 mermaid 代码块渲染为可交互图表卡片（缩放 / 适应宽度 / 全屏查看 / 预览代码切换），复用官方组件原语，渲染失败时保留原代码块并内联展示错误。

description.en: Search, read and write an Outline knowledge base from conversations, with whitelist-guarded approval for every document write.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中搜索、读取并安全读写用户自己的 Outline 知识库文档，写操作受白名单保护与审批约束。
