description.en: AI-native text editor for DeepSeek Harness: tabs, encoding-safe saves, selection/document AI with diff review, Markdown preview, and Windows file associations.
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 原生文本编辑器：多标签、编码保留、选区/全文 AI 与 Diff 审阅、Markdown 预览及 Windows 文件关联。

description.en: Bridge to the local doc2md (markdown_monitor) CLI — one doc2md tool with convert, read, scan and status actions over docx, doc, xls, xlsx, pdf and image files.
description.zh: 桥接本机 doc2md（markdown_monitor）命令行——一个 doc2md 工具，提供 convert / read / scan / status 四个动作，支持 docx、doc、xls、xlsx、pdf 与图片。

description.en: PDF electronic signing: generate a handwritten-style signature image, stamp images and typed blocks onto PDF pages, and apply a PKCS#7/CMS digital signature with a PKCS#12 certificate you supply. Stamping first keys an opaque background out to transparency - un-compositing each pixel so the ink keeps its original colour - and trims to the ink, so a seal stamped over a signature does not erase it.
description.zh: PDF 电子签名：生成手写风格签名图、在 PDF 页面盖章（图片与文字块）、并用自备的 PKCS#12 证书施加 PKCS#7/CMS 数字签名。盖章前会先把不透明签名图/印章图的底色转为透明（通过反合成保留墨色）并裁掉留白，因此印章盖在签名上不会把签名擦掉。

description.en: Paper reading in a DSH sidebar tab: the PDF keeps its original layout and fonts, a selection becomes a highlight, a note or a question in the current chat, and annotations plus paper-level notes are mirrored to Markdown in a per-paper folder that also holds the parsed text and the linked open-source code. Ships a `vibe_reading` tool and a reading skill so the agent can build that record itself.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏里读论文：PDF 保留原始排版与字体，选中文字即可高亮、写笔记或直接在当前会话提问；标注与论文级笔记以 Markdown 同步到每篇论文自己的目录，与解析正文、关联的开源代码放在一起。附带 `vibe_reading` 工具与阅读 skill，AI 能自己写这份记录。

description.en: Render Markdown to a standalone, self-contained HTML page: an `md_html_render` tool that works in a headless profile, plus a web drawer to browse, preview, edit and export local `.md` files; both share one renderer, with no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把 Markdown 渲染为自包含的独立 HTML 页面：提供在 headless 配置下同样可用的 `md_html_render` 工具，以及在网页端浏览、预览、编辑并导出本地 `.md` 文件的抽屉；两个入口共用同一个渲染器，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Typst live preview as a native right-Sidebar tab: clicking a .typ file opens a tab whose toolbar switches between the tinymist-rendered page and the highlighted source, with the preview page and its WebSocket served through the app's own origin.
description.zh: 原生右侧边栏里的 Typst 实时预览：点开 .typ 文件即得一个 tab，工具栏在 tinymist 渲染的页面与高亮源码之间切换；预览页面与其 WebSocket 都经应用自身 origin 提供。

description.en: Read Zotero PDFs inside the DSH right sidebar and let the model work on them directly. Requires Zotero 10 or newer with the local API enabled (Zotero 7/8 is read-only and cannot accept annotations). The model gets three tools: search_zotero_library to search your library, read_zotero_paper to read a paper by page or by query, and ask_zotero_paper for page-cited answers. Annotation handling mirrors Zotero's own reader: click an annotation to open a card with page number, quoted text, a comment box and tags; the three-dot menu recolors or deletes it; multi-line selections get a single surrounding box rather than one box per line. Comments, tags, colors and deletions are written back through the Zotero local API, so they show up in Zotero and annotations made in Zotero show up here. Selection actions cover translate, explain, ask and highlight; the reader remembers the exact reading position (page plus offset) and zoom level per paper, and keeps opened PDFs mounted so switching tabs does not reload them. MinerU re-parsing is available for scanned or broken-text PDFs and is off by default.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏里阅读 Zotero 的本地 PDF，并让模型直接基于原文工作。需要 Zotero 10 及以上版本并开启本地 API（Zotero 7/8 只能读、不能写入批注）。插件向模型提供三个工具：search_zotero_library 搜索文献库、read_zotero_paper 按页或按关键词读正文、ask_zotero_paper 做带页码依据的问答。批注操作与 Zotero 自带阅读器一致：点击批注弹出卡片，显示页码、原文引用、评论框与标签；右上角三点菜单可改色或删除；跨行选中只画一个外围长方形，不再每行一个框。评论、标签、颜色与删除都通过 Zotero 本地 API 写回，因此在 Zotero 里能看到，在 Zotero 里做的批注这里也能看到。划词动作包括翻译、解释、询问与高亮；阅读器按论文记住精确阅读位置（页加页内偏移）与缩放比例，已打开的 PDF 保持挂载，切换标签不会重新加载。扫描件或文本层损坏时可用 MinerU 重新解析，默认关闭。

description.en: Left-sidebar PPT workbench: imports an existing PPTX element by element (theme colours, gradients with alpha, rounded shapes, master/layout decorations, chart pages rasterized) and renders it as real 16:9 slides, lets you edit text and tables directly on the page, and hosts an AI chat column that rewrites the same deck.json.
description.zh: 左侧栏 PPT 工作台：把现成的 PPTX 逐元素原样导入（主题色、带透明度的渐变、圆角形状、母版/版式装饰都保留，图表页整页转图）并渲染成真实的 16:9 幻灯片；直接在页面上改文字和表格，内置可改写同一份 deck.json 的 AI 对话栏。

description.en: Drag documents into the dsh web chat; the agent reads them directly from the local filesystem and the right sidebar lists the outputs and file paths.
description.zh: 拖拽文档进 dsh Web 对话框，Agent 直读本地文件处理，右侧侧栏展示产出与文件路径。

description.en: Whole-PDF paper translation for DSH on top of a BabelDOC installation you provide (Python CLI, with an OpenAI-compatible API key in its config.toml): bilingual dual-page output, a token cost estimate before running, a per-domain glossary reused across papers, and the server-side thinking overhead disabled for translation.
description.zh: DSH 的整篇 PDF 文献翻译：BabelDOC（Python CLI 及其 config.toml 里的 OpenAI 兼容 API Key）需自行安装配置；输出双语对照 PDF，跑之前先给 token 成本预估，按领域跨论文复用术语表，并关掉翻译环节服务端默认开启的 thinking 推理开销。

description.en: A local-first sidebar knowledge base for a DSH workspace: indexes projects, documents and plugins, classifies entries automatically, and provides search, file previews and editable notes. Data stays in the workspace.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 工作区侧边栏知识库：索引项目、文档和插件，自动归类，支持搜索、文件预览和可编辑笔记；数据保存在工作区。

description.en: Pipeline for scanned textbooks: OCR at roughly 5x the ONNXRuntime speed (requires Python 3.10+ with pymupdf, rapidocr, openvino and numpy), then a structure report and a per-chapter reading plan before you open the PDF.
description.zh: 扫描版教材流水线：在本机 Python 3.10+ 环境（需 pymupdf、rapidocr、openvino、numpy）下，OCR 提速约 5 倍，先出骨架地图，再按章阅读。

description.en: Windows desktop LaTeX workspace with 24 template presets, dsh AI writing and selection editing, managed TeX compilation, PDF preview, and BibTeX validation.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 桌面版的 LaTeX 工作区，提供 24 个模板入口、dsh AI 写作与选区修改、受管 TeX 编译、PDF 预览和 BibTeX 校验。

description.en: DocChain knowledge base, document conversion and knowledge-graph toolkit — filename, content and metadata search, locate-by-doc_id/name with content reading, topic listing, bulk document upload, document-to-Markdown conversion, image-similarity search, per-document image descriptions saved to a sidecar markdown (flowcharts and architecture diagrams are turned into PlantUML sketches, other images into text descriptions; the original image is replaced by a clickable link), a deep-research workflow, and a knowledge-graph layer (ontology inspection, read-only Cypher, ontology/entity/relation writes). Every script-backed capability also ships as a native DSH tool executed in-process: doc search, content search, filename search, topic info, metadata search, upload, image search, image describe, doc2markdown, plus kg schema / kg cypher / kg upsert node / kg upsert relation / kg delete node / kg delete relation. All graph operations go through the DocChain API, so no Neo4j password is needed. The configuration page keeps several docchain environments (each with its own address and credential), switches between them in one click, and pre-selects topics per environment. Needs a docchain service URL and API key (except doc2markdown); image descriptions additionally need an OpenAI-compatible multimodal endpoint (defaults to an internal gateway model, configurable).
description.zh: 知识库、文档转换与知识图谱插件：文档文件名、内容与元数据检索，按 doc_id/文档名称定位并读取正文，主题查询，文档批量上传，文档转 Markdown，图搜图，文档图片转文字（流程图/架构图这类结构图自动转成 PlantUML 草图，其它图写成文字描述，并写入旁路描述 md，主 md 不动；原图改为可点链接），深度研究工作流，以及知识图谱能力（查本体结构、执行只读 Cypher、本体/实体/关系的增删改，全部走 DocChain API，无需 Neo4j 密码）。所有带脚本的能力同时提供原生 DSH 工具，由宿主进程内直接执行：文档定位、内容搜索、文件名搜索、主题查询、元数据查询、批量上传、图搜图、文档图片转文字、文档转 Markdown，以及知识图谱的本体查询 / Cypher / 节点与关系的增改删。配置页可保存多个 docchain 环境（各带独立地址与凭据）并一键切换，还可按环境预选主题。除 doc2markdown 外需配置 docchain 服务地址与 API key；图片转文字另需一个 OpenAI 兼容的多模态模型端点（默认走内网网关模型，可配置更换）。

description.en: Renders Jupyter notebooks in the document preview, with syntax-highlighted code, offline KaTeX for inline and display math, and a zoomable figure viewer.
description.zh: 在文档预览中渲染 Jupyter 笔记本，支持代码语法高亮、离线 KaTeX 行内与块级公式，以及可缩放的图像查看器。

description.en: Model-facing skill_manage tool that saves, replaces, or deletes Harness skills at user or project scope, with a standing system-prompt section that asks the model to evaluate skill retention before ending a reusable task.
description.zh: 模型侧的 skill_manage 工具，可在用户级或项目级保存、替换、删除 Harness 技能，并常驻一段系统提示督促模型在收尾时评估技能沉淀。

description.en: Diagrams a reader understands on first look: nine types from one JSON spec, with a checked title, reading path, legend, contrast and connectors. Requires Python 3.9+ for the render and check scripts.
description.zh: 让读者一眼看懂的图表：一份 JSON 规格出九种图，标题、阅读动线、图例、对比度与连线都经机器校验。渲染与校验脚本需要 Python 3.9+。

description.en: Registers the imagegen skill on the skill registry, so generating and editing raster images needs no hand-copied files under $DSH_HOME/skills. The agent drives a bundled image_gen.py CLI against any OpenAI-compatible GPT Image endpoint for text-to-image, reference-image editing, and transparent-background cutouts.
description.zh: 把 imagegen skill 注册进 skill 注册表，无需往 $DSH_HOME/skills 手工拷贝文件，每个会话都能生成或编辑图片：agent 调用随包附带的 image_gen.py CLI，对接任意 OpenAI 兼容的 GPT Image 端点，支持文生图、参考图编辑与透明背景抠图。

description.en: Windows only (desktop Word + full MathType 7 + Python 3.10+). Convert LaTeX placeholders in a Word .docx into real MathType OLE equations (Equation.DSMT4), preserving equation numbers, SEQ fields and cross-references.
description.zh: 仅 Windows（需桌面版 Word、完整版 MathType 7 与 Python 3.10+）。把 Word 文档中的 LaTeX 占位符转换为真正的 MathType OLE 公式（Equation.DSMT4），保留公式编号、SEQ 域与交叉引用。

description.en: Generates complete AI songs (vocals plus full arrangement) from a theme or from provided lyrics, and instrumental BGM, through a bundled xiapan-music skill and a xiapan_music DSH tool; also queries the Xiapan API balance. Uses a user-supplied Xiapan API key (BYOK), and saves the generated mp3 files on the DSH host.
description.zh: 通过内置的 xiapan-music 技能与 xiapan_music 工具，按主题或已有歌词生成完整 AI 歌曲（人声与完整编曲） 以及纯音乐 BGM，并可查询虾盘云 API 余额；使用用户自带的虾盘云 Key（BYOK），生成的 mp3 保存在 DSH 主机上。

description.en: Trusted office suite for government/enterprise work by Beijing Caizhi Technology (深知可信智能): three skills — trusted consulting (policy/regulation Q&A with citation markers + provenance HTML), trusted search (authoritative policy/standard retrieval with traceable HTML + clean Markdown), and official-document writing (draft/rewrite/Word/red-head delivery); all interfaces go through the dknowc trusted workbench MCP (Bearer auth), products land in the session workspace, one-time key setup persists for later sessions; ships on npm as dknowc-dsh.
description.zh: 彩智科技深知可信智能出品的可信办公全家桶 dsh 插件：包含深知可信咨询（政策/法规/办事问答，带真实来源角标 + 可点击溯源 HTML）、深知可信搜索（权威政策/标准检索与深度研究，溯源 HTML + 干净 Markdown）、深知公文写作（正式公文起草/改写/Word/红头交付）三个 Skill；接口统一经深知可信工作台 MCP 转接（Bearer 认证），产物写入会话工作区，API Key 一次配置长期免注册；已发布 npm 包 dknowc-dsh。

description.en: Skill panel: browse skills by source, group them into colored folders, preview files, export a skill as zip, copy one into the project, rename it on disk, and insert /skill calls from a composer menu.
description.zh: 技能面板：按来源浏览 skill，用彩色分类文件夹归类，预览文件，导出 zip、复制到项目、在磁盘上重命名，并在输入区菜单里插入 /skill 调用。

description.en: Douyin patent and trademark complaint workflow for DeepSeek Harness with a left-sidebar task panel: checks user-supplied links, materials and organization identity in a dedicated browser, records each submission state, queries platform history read-only, and shows local task counts in the sidebar; never discovers targets or submits without explicit authorization.
description.zh: 抖音专利/商标侵权举报插件：左侧栏任务面板 + 专用浏览器核对本次链接、证明材料与组织身份，记录提交状态，只读查询平台历史回执；不自动发现举报对象，未明确授权不提交。

description.en: Registers fifteen slash commands (/idea, /review, /poster, ...) that inject the matching research skill's SKILL.md as a user message, so installed skills run without a marketplace. The skills are not bundled and must already be under ~/.dsh/skills or ~/.agents/skills, otherwise commands report skill not found.
description.zh: 把装好的研究技能变成斜杠命令：/idea、/novelty、/review、/poster……一共十五条，敲一下就把对应的 SKILL.md 塞进对话，照着跑那个技能。技能不随包提供，须已装在 ~/.dsh/skills 或 ~/.agents/skills 下，否则命令只提示找不到技能。

description.en: Skill catalog with independent model and user manual invocation controls for file-backed Skills, live source reads, read-only non-file Providers, and safe cleanup of missing policies.
description.zh: Skill 清单与调用管理：独立控制文件型 Skill 的模型和用户手动调用，实时读取源文件；非文件型仅展示，支持安全清理未加载策略。

description.en: Fishing assistant skill: spot analysis, fish activity and bait/lure recommendations from water photos and weather data.
description.zh: AI钓鱼助手技能：水面照片分析鱼情，结合天气气压推荐鱼种、钓法与饵料。

description.en: Tracking assistant skill: monitor product prices, celebrity news and custom metrics with change alerts and scheduled pushes.
description.zh: 追踪管家技能：追踪商品价格、明星动态与自定义指标，变动自动汇报，支持定时推送。

description.en: Fridge manager skill: recognize ingredient photos and recommend recipes, with inventory and shopping reminders.
description.zh: AI冰箱管家技能：食材图片识别并推荐菜谱，支持库存管理与采购提醒。

description.en: Product research skill: analyze market, technology and supply chain, then output three-tier product spec proposals.
description.zh: AI产品调研技能：分析市场、技术与供应链，输出高中低三套产品规格方案。

description.en: Global news monitoring skill: track world events and analyze impact across industries, currencies and commodities.
description.zh: 全球热点监控技能：追踪全球事件，按行业、汇率与大宗商品链路分析影响。

description.en: Fruit price tracking skill: collect and query global wholesale fruit prices with RMB/kg conversion.
description.zh: 全球水果价格追踪技能：采集与查询国内外水果批发价，支持人民币/公斤换算。

description.en: Repackages the MedXpert skill collection (zhaoxinghua09-cell/medxpert-skills, Apache-2.0): twenty-one medical-device regulatory skills for NMPA, FDA, EU MDR, and PMDA workflows. Do not install the same skills twice (do not also copy them into ~/.dsh/skills).
description.zh: 把 MedXpert 技能集合（zhaoxinghua09-cell/medxpert-skills，Apache-2.0）打包为 21 个医疗器械法规技能，覆盖 NMPA、FDA、EU MDR 与 PMDA；请勿重复安装同一套技能。

description.en: Experience validation layer for DSH: zero-token collection of tool-failure/retry/search signals, AI refinement into verified skill books (three-layer verification), looked up at task start. Ships 10 trial skills and benchmark data (complex-task success 100% vs 60% bare).
description.zh: DSH 经验验证固化层：零 token 采集工具失败/重试/搜索信号，加工轮提炼成经三层检验的技能书，任务开局翻书复用。内置 10 本试验经验 + benchmark 数据（复杂任务成功率 100% vs 裸环境 60%）。

description.en: Product-thinking companion for DeepSeek Harness: clarifies negative boundaries first, separates facts from assumptions, routes through seven product lenses, and persists confirmed decisions to project memory.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的产品思考助手：先明确负向边界，拆开事实与假设，经七套产品视角讨论取舍，并将确认的决策沉淀到项目记忆中。

description.en: Skill that switches the displayed reasoning to Simplified Chinese: it enables the built-in experimental reasoning translation, pins provider bing and target language zh, then verifies and troubleshoots the result. The same repository also ships an optional one-install preset plugin for users who want the same setup without running the steps. Requires the DSH 0.2.1 line with the experimental reasoning-translation bundle and a Web or Desktop GUI; the default provider is bing, so expanded reasoning text is sent to Bing.
description.zh: 把思考过程切换成简体中文显示的技能：启用内置实验性思考翻译、固定 bing + zh，并给出验证与排障步骤；同一仓库另提供可选的一键预设插件，供不想逐步操作的用户直接安装。需要带实验性思考翻译包的 DSH 0.2.1 线以及 Web/桌面 GUI；默认 provider 为 bing，展开的思考正文会发送给 Bing。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle of the 25 promoted mattpocock/skills with a native agent preset, an invocation-aware skill provider, and a light grilling-to-implement bootstrap.
description.zh: 将 mattpocock/skills 的 25 个正式技能打包为 DeepSeek Harness bundle，附原生 Agent 预设、区分人触发与模型调用的技能 provider，以及轻量 grilling 到 implement 引导。

description.en: Bundles the official Scrapling agent skill into a DeepSeek Harness profile: anti-bot bypass, stealth browsing, the spiders framework, adaptive parsing and JavaScript rendering, discovered through the host skill catalog.
description.zh: 把官方 Scrapling 技能包进 DeepSeek Harness profile：反反爬绕过、隐身浏览、spiders 框架、自适应解析与 JS 渲染，通过宿主技能目录发现。

description.en: Geological 3D modeling and 3D seismic processing workflow skill: SEG-Y volume parsing, CGCS2000 coordinate unification, fault representative line and exploration boundary shapefile output, and multi-mine 3D geology platform building.
description.zh: 地质三维建模与三维地震资料处理全流程技能：SEG-Y 数据体解析、CGCS2000 坐标统一（带带号）、断层代表线与勘探范围 shp 输出、多矿区三维地质平台建设。

description.en: Ponytail port: a DeepSeek Harness agent preset that makes the model finish tasks with the least tokens, with lite / full / ultra levels.
description.zh: Ponytail 移植：让模型消耗最少的 token 完成任务，解决浪费，支持 lite / full / ultra 三档强度。deep seek harness 可用

description.en: Installs a skill-router skill that semantically searches a local skill corpus on demand, keeping the corpus out of the per-turn model catalog.
description.zh: 安装一个 skill 路由技能：按需对本地技能库做语义检索，让庞大的技能库不占每轮的模型目录。

description.en: ADHD-friendly output shaping where the mode belongs to one session, not a global setting: switch it with /i-have-adhd on|off in the conversations you want shaped, and the state stays with that session. Ported from ayghri/i-have-adhd.
description.zh: ADHD 友好输出塑形插件：模式属于单个会话，而不是一项全局设置——用 /i-have-adhd on|off 在你想要塑形的对话里开启/关闭功能，状态随该会话保留。移植自 ayghri/i-have-adhd。

description.en: Adds an Assist button beside the composer send key. It scans the skills and MCP tools available in the session, ranks them against the text currently in the input box, and lets you inject the selected ones into the running conversation as a steering message.
description.zh: 在对话框发送键旁添加一个「辅助」按钮：扫描本会话可用的技能与 MCP 工具，按输入框里的当前草稿排序，并可把选中的技能作为 steering 消息注入正在运行的对话。

description.en: Competitive-informatics coach plugin for DeepSeek Harness: coaching-rule prompts, learning roadmap, knowledge points, problem setting, real C++ judging with g++, and ima knowledge-base retrieval with four-notebook archiving, for GESP / CSP-J/S / NOIP / NOI teaching. Needs g++, and an ima account with ima-skill and the four notebooks configured; replies carry a WeChat-account promo and QR code by default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 信奥教练插件：教练规则提示词 + 学习路线图/知识点/命题/C++ 真评测（g++ 编译运行）+ ima 知识库检索与 4 笔记本归档，面向 GESP、CSP-J/S、NOIP、NOI 教学。需本机有 g++，并配置 ima 账号、ima-skill 与 4 个笔记本；回复默认附带公众号推广与二维码。

description.en: Competitive-informatics senior plugin for DeepSeek Harness: companion practice, three-version C++14 reference solutions, problem explanations, real g++ compile-and-judge (g++ required), and optional solution-record archiving to the ima notebook "信奥学长-题解复盘", for GESP / CSP-J/S / NOIP / NOI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 信奥学长插件：陪刷 + 三版 C++14 参考实现 + 解题说明，本地 g++ 真编译真评测（需 g++），做题记录可选归档到 ima 笔记本「信奥学长-题解复盘」，面向 GESP、CSP-J/S、NOIP、NOI。

description.en: Screenshot-review skill for DeepSeek Harness: the agent opens a frontend page, screenshots it, views the screenshot itself, revises the code, then re-screenshots — iterating until the page visually matches the user's requirements. Ships as a dsh.bundle, so it installs with `dsh plugin add`.
description.zh: 截图审阅 skill：模型自己打开页面、截图、看图、改代码，反复迭代直到前端效果符合要求。以 dsh.bundle 打包，可用 `dsh plugin add` 一键安装。

description.en: Hand a command-line-verified operation over to the GUI: drive it once, verify with ground truth, and hand back a self-contained illustrated tutorial.
description.zh: 把命令行验证过的操作交接给图形界面：自己驱动一遍、用地面真值验证，并产出人能照着做的自包含带图教程。

description.en: Provides three skills for the Let's Build Robots SO-101 course: yanshifu reads the learner's project files to assess progress and suggest next steps; ask answers questions using four bundled guides; update checks for and installs updates to those guides.
description.zh: 为《一起手搓机器人》SO-101 课程提供三个技能：yanshifu 读取学员的项目文件，判断进度并建议下一步；ask 根据四份配套资料回答问题；update 检查并更新本地配套资料。

description.en: Router and artifact gate for DeepSeek Harness: a per-turn skill router that ranks the live catalog, plus a write gate enforcing read-before-write, dedupe and a four-line audit on every file write.
description.zh: DSH 的技能路由与写入门禁：每回合对现有技能目录排序选择，另有一道写入门禁，强制先读后写、去重，并为每次写文件留下四行审计。

description.en: Skill for building a game design brief into a playable, publishable TapTap Maker project: it picks the browser workspace or local MCP route, extracts the five elements of the brief, writes a first-round prompt for a minimal core loop, iterates in the official order, checks preview and release materials, and keeps credit, credential and irreversible-action limits in view. Includes eight reference notes on the product, credits, themes and asset limits, the leaderboard, brief parsing, iteration, publishing and safety, four templates, and three read-only Python checks for brief completeness, project layout and release materials.
description.zh: 把一份游戏策划案在 TapTap 制造（UrhoX 引擎 + Lua）上落成可玩、可发布的项目：先用浏览器工作区还是本地 MCP、拆解策划案五要素、写最小可玩的首轮需求、按官方顺序迭代、核对预览与发布物料，并守住积分、凭证与不可逆动作的红线。含 8 篇参考（产品、积分、主题与素材、排行榜、需求拆解、迭代验收、发布、安全）、4 个模板、3 个只读 Python 校验脚本（五要素完整性、项目目录、发布物料）。

description.en: Adds two audit tools and four skills for Chinese medium-to-long texts (fiction among them) and document review — seven-dimension AI-flavor scoring with line-numbered blocking findings, plus file-backed continuity state for long manuscripts. Do not install with the older dsh-deai-audit from the same author, which registers the same tool names.
description.zh: 提供两个审查工具与四个技能，覆盖中长文本（例如小说）与文档审稿：七维 AI 味打分、带行号的阻断项，以及落盘的长篇连续性状态。不要与同作者的旧版 dsh-deai-audit 同装，二者注册同名工具。

description.en: 21 read-only lifecycle governance tools in one self-contained DSH plugin: task tiering, state/plan/evidence validation, gate precheck and aggregation, release/install audits, context and progress analysis, critical path, resume reconciliation, and a mutation preview that always denies execution. Installs from npm as @240xu/dsh-tech-lead.
description.zh: 单包 21 个只读生命周期治理工具：任务分级、状态/计划/证据校验、Gate 预检与聚合、发布与安装审计、上下文与推进分析、关键路径、续跑对账，以及始终拒绝执行的变更预览。npm 包名 @240xu/dsh-tech-lead。

description.en: Dispatches coding tasks to local Orca-managed agents and reports completion to DSH; documented for DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.
description.zh: 将编程任务派给本地 Orca 管理的 Agent 并将完成状态带回 DSH，现有文档面向 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。

description.en: Bilibili curation floating panel for DSH: learns your interests on a probability schedule and decays them by half-life, picks videos inside a token budget derived from a daily money cap, and mentions you only when a fit score passes a threshold. Comments are off by default; once enabled they run in draft-and-confirm or self-checked auto mode under a daily quota, with a hard no-comment rule for political, government and frontier-science topics, and comment text is scrubbed for account identifiers before it can be posted. It signs in through your own Bilibili account cookies; a separate posting account is recommended.
description.zh: B站策展浮窗：按概率学习你的兴趣并按半衰期淡忘，把每日金额上限换算成 token 额度后挑片，契合度达标才 @ 你。评论默认关闭；开启后按「草稿待确认」或「自检后自动发」模式运作，有日上限，政治 / 政府 / 前沿科学三类话题一律不评价，正文发出前会脱敏账号痕迹。通过你自己的 B 站账号 Cookie 登录，建议单独准备一个发言号。

description.en: Connects a locally installed, signed-in Codex CLI to individual Harness sessions for planning, code review, and optional image analysis; the CLI must be installed and authenticated separately. Verified on Windows; macOS and Linux use the manual CLI install and are not hardware-verified.
description.zh: 在指定 Harness 会话中接入本机已安装并登录的 Codex CLI，提供方案、代码审查和可选图片识别；CLI 需另行安装并授权。已在 Windows 实机验证，macOS 与 Linux 走手动安装 CLI 的方式、尚未实机验收。

description.en: Appends ambiguity-handling rules to the dsh system prompt so the agent asks clarifying options before guessing.
description.zh: 向 dsh system prompt 追加歧义处理规则，让 agent 在猜测前先列出 A/B/C/D 选项请求澄清。

description.en: Progressive disclosure agent preset and call directory tool that starts from a minimal baseline and unlocks tools, skills, and MCP servers on demand.
description.zh: 渐进式展开 Agent 预设与调用目录工具，从极简模式起步，按需解锁挂载工具、技能与 MCP 服务。

description.en: Dependency-ordered multi-agent team runner for DeepSeek Harness: define roles with their own model, persona and tools, run a node graph with an independent review gate and bounded rework, and watch progress in the web UI.
description.zh: DSH 的多角色团队编排插件：给每个角色各自的模型、人设与工具，按依赖跑节点图，带独立评审与有上限的返工，并在界面里看进度。

description.en: Independent read-only acceptance layer: spawns a read-only verifier before each top-level turn closes and steers non-pass gaps back into the agent.
description.zh: 独立只读验收层：顶层 turn 收尾前 spawn 只读 verifier，未通过时把缺口注回主 agent。

description.en: MCP bridge that lets Codex start and resume DSH headless sessions through three tools: dsh_env, dsh_run and dsh_resume.
description.zh: 让 Codex 通过 dsh_env、dsh_run、dsh_resume 三个 MCP 工具启动和续跑 DSH headless 会话的桥。

description.en: Project-based task manager: a sidebar panel, ten chat tools, and one-click splitting of an assistant reply into tasks.
description.zh: 把待办放进 DSH：左侧任务面板、项目分类、对话里增删任务，回答一键拆成任务。

description.en: Exposes the Paper-gogo evidence-first paper workflow as native tools: all 18 phases and the seven G0-G6 gates become callable, gate results are normalised and advancement is refused while any gate fails, and claims are audited against the four evidence states SUPPORTED, INFERRED, VERIFY and MISSING. Ships the workflow text and 57 skills in its own directory, so it installs without a separate Paper-gogo package.
description.zh: 把 Paper-gogo「审稿人倒推、证据优先」的论文工作流做成原生工具：18 个 Phase 与 7 道 G0-G6 门禁可直接调用，门禁结果会被归一化，任一门禁 FAIL 时拒绝推进；主张按 SUPPORTED、INFERRED、VERIFY、MISSING 四态证据审计。工作流正文与 57 个技能内置在自己的目录中，安装时无需另装 Paper-gogo 包。

description.en: Generates a standard motor-repair procedure from the diagnosis and motor rating, with labour time, staffing and a quality-check point for each step.
description.zh: 按诊断结论与电机功率编排标准化维修工序，每步含工时、人员与质检点。

description.en: Slack-style shared rooms with independent native DSH sessions, parallel member mentions, bounded agent handoffs, text attachments and conversation export.
description.zh: Slack 风格共享聊天室，支持独立 DSH 原生会话、并行提及、有次数限制的 Agent 接力、文本附件和会话导出。

description.en: Interview coach with resume-grounded mock practice, deep dive, answer review, searchable answer library, and an evidence-first interviewer workspace.
description.zh: 面试教练：简历驱动的 Mock 练习、层层深挖、回答复盘、可搜索回答库，以及证据优先的面试官工作台。

description.en: Group-chat multi-agent orchestration console for DSH: autonomous decision-making, task dispatch, verification and iterative optimization for long tasks; bundles its own backend, installs with `dsh plugin add`.
description.zh: DSH 群聊式多智能体协作控制台：自主决策、任务分发、验收复核与长任务自主优化；内置后端随包分发，一条命令即可安装。

description.en: Clusters arXiv, first-party lab, official artifact, hardware-vendor, and opt-in X signals into versioned release evidence bundles, then gates claim-level reproduction on commands, artifacts, metrics, and verifiers.
description.zh: 将 arXiv、实验室官网、官方产物、硬件厂商与可选 X 信号聚合为版本化发布证据包，再以命令、产物、指标和验证者约束 claim 级复现结论。

description.en: An agent preset (Hermit/小寄) that turns DSH into an always-on personal hub: a scoped butler persona, a dispatch tool that delegates multi-step tasks to background sub-agents with per-task model routing, async completion reports woven back into chat, plus a credit budget gate, a P/M confirmation chain and an M1 event log.
description.zh: 一个 agent 预设（Hermit/小寄），把 DSH 变成常驻个人中枢：作用域隔离的管家人格、把多步任务派给后台子代理的 dispatch 工具（按任务类型路由模型）、完成后异步把汇报自然插回对话，另含 credit 预算闸、P/M 确认链与 M1 事件日志。

description.en: A project-agnostic multi-agent collaboration protocol for the DeepSeek Harness: loop guards that stop runaway agent loops, a six-field handoff format, risk-tiered review routing, and a fixed verify→commit→push→review→close sequence. One skill instead of the same rules copy-pasted into every agent's instructions.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness、与具体项目无关的多智能体协作协议：阻止失控循环的循环守卫、六字段交接格式、按风险分级的评审路由，以及固定的验证→提交→推送→评审→关闭流程。用一个 skill 取代复制粘贴进每个 agent 指令里的相同规则。

description.en: Meeting rooms for DSH sessions: joining a room grants the right to convene and the duty to attend, and a session belongs to at most one room. Convening forks each participant in with its own completed-turn context and with its tools stripped, a moderator that carries no context chooses the speakers, and every turn is appended to disk as it is spoken. After adjournment each participant receives its own minutes as a user turn and resumes work.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话装上会议室：加入会议室即同时获得召集权与参会义务，且一个会话只能属于一个会议室。召集时把每位参会者 fork 进场——带着它自己已完成的轮上下文，同时剥掉全部工具；主持人自身不带任何上下文，只负责挑下一位发言者；每条发言在说出的当下就落盘。散会后每人拿到一份只属于自己的纪要，作为一条用户输入送回工作区继续干活。

description.en: Pre-production studio for AI short dramas: imports a TXT/Markdown/DOCX script or pasted text, splits it into episodes, structures the bible, characters, scenes, props, episodes, shots and prompts, compiles prompts for the selected video-model dialect (Seedance 2.0/2.5, MiniMax H3, Kling, Wan), and hard-validates IDs, beat durations, dialogue capacity and look/identity locks before generation, and warns when a shot looks like it has more than one action.
description.zh: AI 短剧 / 漫剧制片台：导入 TXT、Markdown、DOCX 或直接粘贴剧本并自动拆集，把总纲、角色、场景、道具、分集、分镜、提示词结构化；提示词按所选视频模型方言编译（Seedance 2.0/2.5、MiniMax H3、Kling、Wan），生成前硬校验 ID 与引用、节拍时长、台词容量、身份锁与 LOOK，并对一镜多动作给出提示。

description.en: Codex-style hook management ported to dsh: hooks.json discovered from config, plugins and projects, each hook pinned to a sha256 fingerprint that must be approved before it runs; a review dialog in the composer, a `/hooks` browser, per-hook run stats, and trust / enable / dry run in Settings -> Hooks. The config file is dsh's own, with dsh event names.
description.zh: 把 Codex 的钩子管理移植到 dsh：从配置、插件与项目三处发现 hooks.json，每条钩子钉在 sha256 指纹上、批准后才运行；输入框里的审查弹窗、`/hooks` 浏览器、逐条运行统计，以及在 设置 → 钩子 里管信任、启用与试跑。配置文件用 dsh 自己的格式与事件名。

description.en: External Agent control plane for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor Agent, and Antigravity adapters with settings and background job visibility.
description.zh: 外部 Agent 控制面，接入 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor Agent 与 Antigravity，并提供设置和后台任务可见性。

description.en: Installs two selectable Agent Presets: a shell-restricted general-purpose agent and a repository-focused coding agent.
description.zh: 安装两个可选 Agent Preset：默认不暴露 Shell 的通用 Agent，以及面向真实代码仓库的 Coding Pro。

description.en: DSH self-discipline companion with recurring tasks, a gaze-tracking desktop mascot, evidence logs, final AI review, reminders, and window intervention on Windows and GNOME Wayland.
description.zh: 大肥鱼监工是 DSH 自制力助手：支持单次与循环预约、会看鼠标的桌面角色、采集证据与诊断日志、到点后的 AI 末轮验收，以及原生提醒和窗口干预；支持 Windows 与 GNOME Wayland。

description.en: Project reporting in the DSH sidebar: draft a per-project report from its git commits and session records with one click, run it on a built-in schedule with a configurable daily cutover offset, and optionally submit Moka overtime automatically; all sessions of a project share one report.
description.zh: 侧栏「项目汇报」：一键整理本项目的代码提交与会话记录生成工作汇报，支持内置定时运行与自定义每日切分偏移，可选自动提交 Moka 加班；同一项目的所有会话共享同一份汇报。

description.en: Synchronizes DeepSeek Harness third-party plugin lists through S3-compatible storage with diff preview, local snapshots, rollback, and optional LLM provider configuration sync.
description.zh: 通过兼容 S3 的对象存储同步 DeepSeek Harness 第三方插件列表，提供差异预览、本地快照、回滚与可选的 LLM provider 配置同步。

description.en: Dual-brain agent presets for DSH: one model plans the framework and delegates execution to a subagent pinned to a second model. Ships brain-ds (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash plans, MiMo-V2.6-Flash executes) and brain-mimo (the reverse), switchable per session. Needs two providers configured (Xiaomi MiMo and a DeepSeek account), and the main brain must be selected manually.
description.zh: 双脑协作 agent 预设：主脑先出框架，再把执行步骤委派给锁定另一模型的子代理。内置 brain-ds（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 规划、MiMo-V2.6-Flash 执行）与 brain-mimo（反向），按会话切换。需配置 Xiaomi MiMo 与 DeepSeek 账号两个 provider，主脑须手动选择。

description.en: FIST commander task orchestration as an MCP server: seven-state task lifecycle, hierarchical decomposition, DAG scheduling, self-driving loops and Omega verification, all in one SQLite ledger. Ships a prebuilt CLI, so installing it needs no build step. Requires Node 24+.
description.zh: 把 FIST 指挥官任务编排做成 MCP 服务：七态任务生命周期、层级拆解、DAG 排程、自驱闭环与 Omega 强验证，账本落在一个 SQLite 里；自带预构建 CLI，安装无需构建；需 Node 24+。

description.en: Runs a second agent: hands independent subtasks to a local Codex CLI in parallel (up to three at a time), and asks it to review a design or a plan before the user sees it, returning conclusion, evidence, counterexamples and a verification step. A dispatch missing its timeout or its acceptance check is rejected by the plugin, not by the model remembering to check.
description.zh: 双 agent 协作：把互不依赖的子任务并行交给本机 Codex（同时最多三路），并在方案交给你看之前先让它盲审一轮，必须回「结论 / 证据 / 反例 / 验证方式」四段；缺超时或缺验收判据的派活会被插件当场拒绝，不靠模型自己记得。

description.en: Registers one tool, report_health, that answers whether a scheduled report job actually ran. It judges by side effects rather than exit codes: how old the newest report folder is, how many documents it holds, whether more than one report category is present, whether the audit ledger was synced recently, and how long ago the last log was written. Exits nothing, calls no model, and reads only local paths you can override by config or environment variable.
description.zh: 只注册一个工具 report_health，回答「定时报告任务到底跑了没有」。它看副作用而不是退出码：最新报告目录有多旧、里面有几份文档、是否不止一个类别、审计账本上次同步是多久前、最后一条日志写了多久。不调用模型、不产生退出码，只读本地路径，可用配置或环境变量覆盖。

description.en: Antigravity-style run_command for DSH: short commands return inline within a configurable wait window (default 10s) while longer ones auto-promote into ctx.jobs for later collection and completion notices — executed via ctx.shell under the session sandbox and approval pipeline.
description.zh: Antigravity 式 run_command：短命令在可配置窗口（默认 10 秒）内同步返回结果，长命令自动晋升为 ctx.jobs 后台任务并推送完成通知——命令经 ctx.shell 执行，受会话沙箱与审批管线约束。

description.en: Whole-book translation production line for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic chapter detection and segmentation, per-chapter subagent translation, glossary control, full-book review, targeted revision, and auditable meta.json evidence.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 整本书翻译生产线：确定性章节识别与分段、子代理逐章翻译、术语表控制、全书审查、定向修订，以及可审计的 meta.json 证据链。

description.en: Checks git commit messages against the 7DGroup convention (Chinese type tags, length and punctuation rules) before committing, as a client-side guard before GitLab pre-receive hooks.
description.zh: 提交前按 7DGroup 规范校验 git commit message（中文类型标签、长度与标点规则），作为 GitLab pre-receive 钩子的客户端前置校验。

description.en: DSH GitHub connector: review PRs, triage issues, debug CI, prepare changes (18 tools, gh-first + REST fallback, approval-gated writes).
description.zh: DSH GitHub 连接器:检查 PR、分诊 issue、调试 CI、准备代码变更(18 个工具,gh 优先 + REST 回退,写操作人工审批)。

description.en: Git panel in the right sidebar plus fifteen agent tools: editor-style diffs, a commit graph across every branch, staging and committing, branch, stash and remote operations, and model-assisted commit messages, pre-commit review and commit splitting.
description.zh: 右侧栏的 Git 面板与十五个 Agent 工具：编辑器式的差异、覆盖全部分支的提交图、暂存与提交、分支与贮藏与远程操作，以及由模型协助的提交说明、提交前审阅和拆分提交方案。

description.en: A Git graph plugin for DSH: repository tree and SVG lane history (curves, merge diamonds, ref badges, terminus notches, export) in a dsh-better-sidebar tab, plus conventions that reach the model - seven built-in frameworks (or your own templates, hidden built-ins), injected into every model step and checked against the last 20 commits. Shares the /git prefix with the upstream plugin, so pick one.
description.zh: DSH 的 Git 图谱插件：better-sidebar 里看多仓库提交图（泳道、合并菱形、短槽、导出），七套内置规范（可自建、可隐藏）注入每个模型步骤并体检最近 20 条提交。与上游同占 /git 前缀，二选一。

description.en: GitLab panel in the DSH right sidebar: commit graph, branches, changes, merge requests (inline diffs, review submission, pipelines), issues, and agent tools with an approval queue for triage and batch actions. GitLab data needs a personal access token or a logged-in `glab`; local git data works without either.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 GitLab 面板：提交图、分支、变更、合并请求（行内 diff、提交评审、流水线）、议题，以及带审批队列的 Agent 工具用于分诊与批量操作。GitLab 数据需要 Personal Access Token 或已登录的 `glab`；本地 git 数据无需凭据。

description.en: Codex-style Git workbench: workspace-scoped changes, diff, stage, commit, guarded branch operations, graph history, fetch, fast-forward pull, and upstream push through official plugin APIs.
description.zh: Codex 风格 Git 工作台：工作区级更改、diff、暂存、提交、受守卫的分支操作、提交图谱、fetch、pull --ff-only 与经官方插件 API 的上游推送。

description.en: Pick a Git branch, or name a new one, on the New Session screen and start the conversation inside an automatically created worktree, so the current checkout stays untouched.
description.zh: 在新会话页选一个 Git 分支或新建一个，并在自动创建的 worktree 里开始对话，当前检出保持原样。

description.en: Session-header environment and branch chips: Local git-switches the checkout; Worktree creates an isolated git worktree under .agents/worktrees, registers it as a workspace, and offers merge, squash, delete, and auto-cleanup.
description.zh: 在空白会话加入环境与分支 chip：本机切换当前检出，Worktree 在 .agents/worktrees 下创建隔离 git worktree 并注册为工作区，会话头部提供合并、压缩提交、删除与自动清理。

description.en: Qoder-style workspace mode and branch chips on the session row; picking a branch arms it, and the first message creates a dedicated git worktree and moves the session into it. Windows only: the write grant runs PowerShell Set-Acl; elsewhere Worktree mode reports an error and stays in the main checkout.
description.zh: Qoder 风格的工作区模式与分支 chip，选择分支即挂起意图，发送第一条消息时自动创建独立 git worktree 并把会话迁入其中。仅 Windows：放行写入依赖 PowerShell Set-Acl，其他平台进 Worktree 会报错并留在主检出。

description.en: Code smell radar: statically scans TODO/FIXME debt, stub implementations, long lines, oversized files and duplicated blocks, with severity-sorted read-only fix suggestions.
description.zh: 代码气味雷达：静态扫描 TODO/FIXME 债务、未实现桩、超长行、大文件与重复代码块，按严重度输出修复建议，全程只读。

description.en: Evidence-first GitHub research subagent with bounded tools and in-memory request caching.
description.zh: 带行号证据和内存缓存的 GitHub 只读调研子代理。

description.en: Shows the repository, branch, working-tree change count and short commit SHA on the composer row, with a searchable branch switcher and a per-file diff pane in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 在输入框那一行显示仓库、分支、改动数与短 SHA；点分支可搜索、切换或新建分支，点改动数在右侧边栏打开逐文件 diff 面板。

description.en: GitHub REST API tools + browser sidebar panel: repos, search, issues, PRs, comments, account binding (credential-store), and one-click clone-as-workspace.
description.zh: GitHub REST API 工具 + 浏览器侧边栏面板：仓库/搜索/Issue/PR/评论、账号绑定（凭据库）与一键克隆为工作区。

description.en: Compact Git status line for DSH Web: the current branch, staged and unstaged line changes, ahead/behind commit counts against upstream, and a clean-worktree marker — placeable in the sidebar footer, the session header, or above/below the composer, with the position switched on the settings page.
description.zh: DSH Web 的紧凑 Git 状态行：显示当前分支、已暂存与未暂存的行数改动、相对 upstream 的领先/落后提交数以及工作区干净标记；可放在侧边栏底部、会话标题栏或输入框上方/下方，位置在设置页切换。

description.en: Git tab in the DeepSeek Harness conversation view: reviews every repository in the session working directory and commits each on its own, with change groups, whole-file / changes-only / side-by-side diffs, in-panel editing, and a push button that lists every commit it would publish.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话页里的 Git 标签页：列出会话工作目录下的每个仓库并各自独立提交，变更分组，整个文件 / 只看变动 / 并排三种差异看法，面板内直接编辑保存，以及推送前逐一列出将要发布的提交。

description.en: Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: session-header chips keep branch, change count and sync state at hand for in-place switching, review and pull/push; the full window adds a lane commit graph, block-level staging, interactive rebase and history rewrite with restore points, batch cherry-pick, a three-way conflict editor, inline blame, worktree management and Git LFS import/export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作台：会话标题栏芯片常驻分支、改动数与同步状态，可就地切分支、看改动、拉取推送；完整窗口提供泳道提交图、逐块暂存、带恢复点的交互式变基与历史改写、批量 cherry-pick、三方冲突编辑器、行内 blame、worktree 管理与 Git LFS 迁入迁出。

description.en: Git repository connector for DeepSeek Harness: saved repo profiles addressed by name, work-copy operations (clone/fetch/pull/push/commit), Gitea/Forgejo/GitHub API tools, keys in the DSH credential center, and per-repo safety flags (TLS bypass, overwrite, force push).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 仓库连接：按档案名操作仓库（clone/fetch/pull/push/commit）、Gitea/Forgejo/GitHub API、密钥存 DSH 凭据中心，并按仓库单独授权忽略证书/允许覆盖/force push 等危险开关。

description.en: Reports bounded, repository-relative Git status as structured data without staging, committing, or changing branches.
description.zh: 以结构化数据返回有界、相对仓库根的 Git 状态，不暂存、不提交，也不切换分支。

description.en: Incremental diff reviewer for DSH: after approving a batch, only new changes since the checkpoint are shown, with a Web review panel and `/review` command that inject feedback back to the agent.
description.zh: 增量代码审查插件：批准一批改动后只审查检查点之后的新改动，提供 Web 审查面板与 `/review` 命令，并把审查意见注入回 agent。

description.en: Conventional-commit enforcement, changelog generation, PR summaries and branch pushes through the plain git CLI.
description.zh: 规范提交（Conventional Commits）、自动 changelog、PR 描述生成与分支推送，纯 git CLI 实现。

description.en: Push vague or rich, user-configurable DSH interaction states to the local Discord client as Rich Presence — real-time, content-free, with a user-editable status list and an optional rich-mode toggle in Settings.
description.zh: 将模糊或丰富的 DSH 交互状态实时推送到本地 Discord 客户端作为 Rich Presence——不携带任何工作区内容，状态消息列表可自由编辑，并可在设置中切换丰富模式。

description.en: Windows native toasts for DeepSeek Harness: pops a toast when a session needs you (approval, question, error, optional turn end), click to return to DSH, answer approvals with Allow/Deny buttons on the toast, plus a notify_user tool and an HTTP API.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加 Windows 原生通知：会话需要你操作（要权限、提问、出错、可选回合结束）时弹 Toast，点通知回到 DSH，通知上可直接「允许/拒绝」审批，另提供 notify_user 工具与 HTTP 接口。

description.en: Sends a macOS Notification Center alert when a session finishes or the agent is blocked on an answer, an approval, or an error. The banner carries the last reply and plays your system alert sound, and clicking it returns you to the DSH page.
description.zh: 会话结束、或 Agent 卡在等你回答／批准／排错时，发一条 macOS 系统通知；横幅带上最后一条回复并播放你的系统提示音，点击即可回到 DSH 页面。

description.en: Webhook notifications for dsh sessions: a POST when an approval is requested or a turn ends, to ntfy, Bark, a Slack/DingTalk/WeCom bot URL, or any HTTPS endpoint.
description.zh: dsh 会话的 Webhook 通知：审批被请求或回合结束时发送 POST，可发往 ntfy、Bark、Slack/钉钉/企微机器人地址或任意 HTTPS 端点。

description.en: Host-side macOS notifications for questions, approvals and finished replies — immune to hidden-renderer notification loss, with icon, sound and click-to-raise.
description.zh: 宿主侧 macOS 系统通知：提问/审批/回复完成即时送达，免疫渲染层隐藏丢通知，带图标、提示音与点击抬窗。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness via `dsh plugin add`; one DM user to one persistent dsh session, with full debugging docs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 私聊桥接插件，支持 `dsh plugin add` 一键安装，配套完整调试文档。

description.en: Telegram remote control for DeepSeek Harness: list conversations with titles and workspaces, resume paused persisted sessions on demand (preset remount), turn-tracked reply relay, first-line reasoning summaries, inline-button approve/reject with outcome edits, and a bot command menu.
description.zh: Telegram 远程控制插件：会话列表（标题+工作目录）、按需恢复暂停的持久化会话（重挂 preset）、按回合精准回传回复、💭 思考摘要、✅/❌ 内联按钮审批（结果回写原消息）、bot 命令菜单。

description.en: Bridge DSH sessions, prompts, tool calls and approvals to CodeIsland's macOS notch, including the latest reply on Stop.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的会话、提问、工具调用与审批桥接到 CodeIsland 的 macOS 刘海面板，并在停止时报上最近一次回复。

description.en: Background notification plugin: desktop notification, with a tab-title fallback, when an approval prompt or an ask-user-question card appears while the page is in a background tab. The host queues approval and question events behind a same-origin endpoint that the client polls every 3 seconds; clicking the notification focuses the page, and the tab title is restored once the page becomes visible.
description.zh: 后台通知插件：页面处于后台时出现审批提示或提问卡片，即发送桌面通知（通知权限不可用时回退为标签页标题 ⚠ 前缀），点击通知聚焦页面；宿主将事件存入同源队列供前端每 3 秒轮询，页面恢复可见后标题自动还原。

description.en: WeCom (Enterprise WeChat) Smart Robot bridge: two-way chat over the aibot WebSocket gateway, no public endpoint needed.
description.zh: 企业微信智能机器人桥接：aibot WebSocket 双向对话（bot_id + secret），无需公网回调。

description.en: Telegram, Discord, Slack, Mattermost, Zulip and Matrix channels in one plugin, with per-conversation sessions that survive restarts, a Settings page that adds, tests and saves channels without YAML, and a fail-closed allowlist that rejects every sender until one is configured.
description.zh: 一个插件接入 Telegram、Discord、Slack、Mattermost、Zulip 与 Matrix，按对话隔离会话、重启后仍能续上；带设置页可增删与测试通道、无需改 YAML，白名单 fail-closed——未配置前拒绝所有发送者。

description.en: Adds a Settings card that pops a system notification and optional chime when a conversation turn completes.
description.zh: 在设置中新增卡片，对话轮次完成时弹出系统通知与可选提示音。

description.en: OS-level system notifications for the dsh web GUI: popups when a turn finishes or the agent needs your approval, answer, or plan review while the page is in the background.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面系统通知：回合结束或 agent 等待授权/回答/计划审核时，页面在后台也弹出系统级提醒。

description.en: Audio cues for DeepSeek Harness: a short synthesized sound when an agent needs confirmation, finishes a turn or a background job, or fails, with five sound packs, per-event toggles and volume, and do-not-disturb rules stored in the host settings document.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 音效提示：智能体需要确认、回合完成、后台任务结束或失败时播放短提示音，内置 5 套音色、逐事件开关与音量、免打扰规则，配置存放在宿主设置文档。

description.en: Email notifications for DSH with an away-mode switch: mails you when a turn ends, a tool waits for approval, or the assistant asks a question. Title and body are editable templates.
description.zh: DSH 邮件通知插件，带一个「离开模式」开关：任务完成、工具等你授权、助手向你提问时发邮件给你；标题与正文都是可自定义的模板。

description.en: QQbot, QQ机器人 — watches chosen QQ groups over OneBot 11, batches messages by a count threshold, summarizes each batch with a model already configured in DSH, and sends the per-group report to chosen friends as a QQ private message. Messages can be filtered by keyword and by sender; ships a settings page, a local web console and a summary archive.
description.zh: QQ机器人、QQbot：通过 OneBot 11 监听指定 QQ 群，按消息数阈值分批，调用 DSH 已配置的模型总结每批消息，再按群私聊投递到指定好友；支持按关键词与成员过滤消息，带设置页、本地网页控制台与总结归档。

description.en: Linux desktop notifications and a chime for DeepSeek Harness, sent by the host process so they still arrive with the browser page closed: turn completion, pending questions, tool approvals and turn errors, delivered through notify-send and paplay with a canberra-gtk-play fallback. A browser half adds an in-page toast, a Web Notification and a synthesized Web Audio chime as fallback; every switch lives in a Settings page or a JSON file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Linux 桌面通知与提示音，由宿主进程发出，浏览器页面关闭后依然可达：回合结束、等待选择、工具批准与回合出错四类事件，走 notify-send 与 paplay（回退 canberra-gtk-play）。浏览器半身作为兜底提供页内浮层、Web Notification 与 Web Audio 合成提示音；所有开关都在设置页或 JSON 配置文件中。

description.en: Send QQ private-message notifications via a local NapCat bot: qq_send / qq_status / qq_napcat / qq_deploy native tools plus one-click deployment scripts.
description.zh: 通过本机 NapCat 机器人向主号 QQ 发送私聊通知：qq_send/qq_status/qq_napcat/qq_deploy 原生工具与一键部署脚本。

description.en: Connect a Weixin bot to DeepSeek Harness by scanning a QR code.
description.zh: 通过微信扫码把微信机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Diving-Fish score lookup for MaimaiDX inside QQ, plus qq-bridge chat extensions. #查分 renders a B50 with song artwork from an OAuth authorisation that any member can use, and works without the bridge running; the extensions cover balance and auto-shutdown, reasoning tier switching by billing peak hours, holiday-table coverage, start/shutdown greetings, and an in-QQ feature toggle.
description.zh: 把水鱼（舞萌DX）查分接进 QQ：#查分 查 B50 并渲染带曲绘的成绩图，走 OAuth 授权、不限管理员、且不依赖桥接运行；另附 qq-bridge 聊天拓展——余额与自动关机、推理档位按计费峰谷切换、节假日表覆盖、开机/关机提示词、QQ 内功能开关。

description.en: Wire up Feishu/Lark from a four-step wizard that discovers your chats instead of asking for a 32-character id, creates the app by scan, and runs a nine-item live self-test that names the exact scope to enable when a check fails. It drives a companion MCP server of 25 tools, including ones that move local files into a chat and pull a message's attachments back to disk. The MCP server is a separate install: take dsh-feishu-mcp-<version>.mjs from the dsh-feishu Releases (or npx github:yinsang0910-star/dsh-feishu-mcp); until it is in place the self-test reports MCP as not mounted and no mcp__feishu__* tool exists.
description.zh: 用四步向导把飞书接上：会话自动发现、不用手抄 32 位 id，扫码创建应用，再跑九项实时自检——哪项不通过就直接给出该开通的 scope。它驱动一个 25 工具的 MCP server，其中包括把本地文件发进会话、把消息附件取回本地。MCP server 需另行安装：从 dsh-feishu 的 Releases 取 dsh-feishu-mcp-<版本>.mjs（或 npx github:yinsang0910-star/dsh-feishu-mcp）；装好之前自检会显示 MCP 未挂载，也没有任何 mcp__feishu__* 工具。

description.en: Sounds a chime and raises a desktop notification when the agent needs you — stage completion, approval requests, awaiting input, task completion, and errors, each with its own tone.
description.zh: Agent 需要你时响铃并弹出桌面通知：阶段完成、请求批准、等待输入、任务完成、出错，五种场景各配不同提示音。

description.en: Host-layer Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: agent turn done, error or interruption, subagent done, and background job done, plus alerts when the model asks you a question or a tool approval is pending. The notification logic runs in the DSH host process, so toasts still arrive with the tab or the browser closed; a Win32 foreground probe suppresses them while you are looking at DSH. Windows only.
description.zh: DSH 宿主层 Windows 原生 Toast 通知：回合完成、出错或中断、子代理完成、后台任务完成，以及模型提问与工具审批待处理时的提醒。通知逻辑跑在 DSH 宿主进程里，标签页或浏览器关掉也照响；用 Win32 前台探测，正在看 DSH 时不打扰。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Mobile push when a DSH task goes idle, over 10 channels: ntfy, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu, ServerChan, PushPlus, Telegram, Qmsg and generic webhooks. The message carries the session, workspace, elapsed time, turn number and a reply excerpt, and it runs host-side rather than in the browser page.
description.zh: DSH 任务停下来时把通知推送到手机，支持 10 个渠道：ntfy、Bark、钉钉、企业微信、飞书、Server酱、PushPlus、Telegram、Qmsg 与通用 webhook；消息里带会话、目录、耗时、回合号与回复摘要，运行在 Host 侧而不是浏览器页面里。

description.en: Records the files and folders an AI agent creates, modifies, deletes, renames or moves, shows them in a draggable floating panel with unread counts, and persists the records as per-workspace JSONL logs.
description.zh: 记录 AI 对文件与文件夹的新建、修改、删除、重命名与移动，在可拖拽悬浮窗中实时展示未读数，并按工作区持久化为 JSONL 日志。

description.en: Automatic type-check diagnostics: after the model edits or creates TS files, runs `tsc --noEmit` in the background (debounced per project) and reports errors via the `code_check` tool — grouped by file with line/column, severity and TS error codes, closing the "edit → check → fix" loop.
description.zh: 自动类型检查诊断：模型编辑/创建 TS 文件后后台防抖运行 `tsc --noEmit`，经 `code_check` 工具按文件分组汇报错误（行列号 + 严重级别 + TS 错误码），形成「改 → 查 → 修」闭环。

description.en: Local visual React and Tailwind designer with project-scoped file tools; documented for DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.
description.zh: 提供本地 React 与 Tailwind 可视化设计及限制在项目内的文件工具，现有文档面向 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。

description.en: Preflight checks for a DeepSeek Harness plugin before submitting it to the community list: verifies the dsh.bundle manifest, cordis.patch.yml wiring, client bundle shape, and peer ranges that silently exclude prerelease harness builds. CLI plus one read-only agent tool.
description.zh: 投稿社区精选列表前的插件自检：校验 dsh.bundle 清单、cordis.patch.yml 接线、客户端 bundle 形态，以及会静默排除预发布版 harness 的 peer 版本范围。提供 CLI 与一个只读的 agent 工具。

description.en: Registers a `config_doctor` tool that checks the harness's own configuration for problems that boot silently: fields a patch dropped by whole-config replacement, patches targeting missing entry ids, and tool-name collisions. Read-only.
description.zh: 注册 `config_doctor` 工具，检查 harness 自身配置里那些会静默通过启动的问题：patch 整体替换 config 而丢失的字段、指向不存在 entry id 的 patch、工具重名冲突。只读。

description.en: Read-only health clinic for the installed DSH plugin set: loader health, dependency integrity, version compatibility, install-script risk, duplicates and patch integrity, delivered as a model tool, a Settings dashboard and JSON reports.
description.zh: 已安装 DSH 插件集合的只读体检诊所：加载健康、依赖完整、版本兼容、安装脚本风险、重复与 patch 引用，交付模型工具、设置面板与 JSON 报告。

description.en: Scans the DSH loader tree at startup for plugin conflicts (duplicate mounts, failed or pending plugins, duplicate config row ids), auto-stops or restores the affected plugins, and shows a conflict report popup in the web UI.
description.zh: DSH 启动时扫描加载器中的插件冲突（重复挂载、启动失败、依赖缺失、配置行 id 重复），自动停用或恢复冲突插件，并在 Web 界面弹出冲突报告。

description.en: Contract regression harness for plugin authors: a scripted LLM adapter drives the real pipeline in isolated child processes with session-event assertions (load/contract/behavior/fault layers); zero API key, CI-ready.
description.zh: 插件作者的契约回归风洞：剧本适配器在隔离子进程中驱动真实管线，会话事件断言覆盖加载/契约/行为/故障四层；零 API key，可进 CI。

description.en: Reusable Markdown prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness with per-turn model selection, argument substitution, and state restoration.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 可复用 Markdown Prompt Profile，支持单轮模型选择、参数替换和状态恢复。

description.en: Bidirectional RPC between DSH Host and Client through the native Connection and Typert Gateway, with targeted peer calls, cancellation, and connection lifecycle handling.
description.zh: 通过原生 Connection 与 Typert Gateway 在 DSH Host 和 Client 之间提供双向 RPC，支持目标 Peer 调用、取消与连接生命周期处理。

description.en: Stability audit for installed dsh plugins: static risk grading (hook surface, startup work, inject, entry, dep ranges) plus optional isolated install verification.
description.zh: 已安装 dsh 插件的稳定性审计：静态风险分级（钩子面/启动任务/inject/入口/依赖区间）加可选隔离安装验证。

description.en: Rebind running sessions onto a rebuilt agent-preset revision, so preset changes apply without restarting dsh.
description.zh: 把正在运行的会话重绑到重建后的预设 revision 上，让预设改动无需重启 dsh 即可生效。

description.en: DSH plugin for bounded agent evaluation: compare an original with candidate prompt or supported configuration changes against user-supplied checks, record evidence and costs, and leave adoption to the user.
description.zh: DSH 有界智能体评测插件：针对提示词或受支持的配置改动，用用户提供的检查比较原版与候选，记录证据和成本，由用户决定是否采用。

description.en: System proxy detection (scutil/env/PAC) with a status tool and a proxy_export bash snippet tool.
description.zh: 系统代理检测（scutil/env/PAC）：状态工具 + proxy_export 导出 bash 代理片段。

description.en: Right-sidebar console for the current workspace: detects Maven modules with a Spring Boot main class and Vite frontends, starts and stops them (batch; the "survive DSH exit" detached mode is on by default and Windows only), packages with Maven or pnpm, uploads artifacts over SSH/SFTP to named deploy environments with progress and per-environment remote dirs, restarts the docker container and checks its status; protected environments require a second click. Needs Maven, a JDK and pnpm on the machine; SSH passwords are stored in plain text in deploy.json.
description.zh: 右栏控制台：识别工作区里带 Spring Boot 启动类的 Maven 模块与 Vite 前端，一键启动 / 停止（支持批量；「关 DSH 不停止」脱离模式默认开启，仅 Windows 可用）、Maven 或 pnpm 打包、经 SSH/SFTP 上传到可命名的多个发布环境（带进度条、每台独立远端目录）、重启对应 docker 容器并校验状态；受保护环境需二次确认。需本机装有 Maven、JDK 与 pnpm；SSH 密码以明文保存在 deploy.json。

description.en: /repro exports a minimal, secret-scrubbed, replayable problem bundle: the session log, failed commands, and Git diff.
description.zh: /repro 导出最小可复现问题包：去 secret 的会话日志、失败命令与 git diff。

description.en: Config snapshot and rollback for DSH: auto-captures before risky changes, ships a standalone restore script that works even when DSH won't boot. Windows only; the restore script is a .bat and needs Node.js.
description.zh: DSH 配置快照与回滚：危险操作前自动留痕，附带独立还原脚本，DSH 起不来时也能救回。仅 Windows；还原脚本为 .bat，需 Node.js。

description.en: Exposes the DSH dynamic-Cordis toolset to Claude Code over MCP (streamable HTTP on the existing web port, no new listener): ten tools to list, inspect, define, run, stop and permanently remove dynamic plugins in a live DSH session, with the same approval flow the GUI uses for packages that ship a client half. Bearer auth is mandatory — the token is configured on a DSH settings page, the endpoint answers 503 rather than serve without one, accepts loopback only and never emits CORS headers.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的动态 Cordis 工具集以 MCP（streamable HTTP，挂在现有 web 端口上，不新开监听）暴露给 Claude Code：10 个工具，可列出、查看、定义、运行、停止与永久删除某个活 DSH 会话里的动态插件；含 client half 的包仍走 GUI 那套审批流。强制 Bearer 认证——token 在 DSH 设置页配置，未配置时端点直接 503 而不是降级放行，只接受回环访问，且永不返回 CORS 头。

description.en: Read-only static checks for DSH profiles, bundle resolution, version compatibility, patches and MCP name conflicts, with pre-install candidate checks.
description.zh: 只读检查 DSH profile、bundle 解析、版本兼容、patch 和 MCP 名称冲突，支持安装前候选检查。

description.en: Enforced pain-point gate: after two non-converged experiments it injects the three questions, denies non-investigative tool calls until answered, and blocks same-direction retries.
description.zh: 强制痛点检查：同一问题连续 2 个实验未收敛后注入三问、拦截非调查类工具调用直到答出、阻止同方向重试。

description.en: GitLab and Kubernetes monitoring for DSH: merge request and pipeline management, deployment and pod status with logs and events, webhook-triggered alerts, and a dashboard UI.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 GitLab 与 Kubernetes 监控：合并请求与流水线管理、部署与 Pod 状态（含日志与事件）、Webhook 告警，以及仪表盘界面。

description.en: MCP management panel for DeepSeek Harness — live connection status per server (green dot), one-click pip/npx upgrades for local stdio servers with Windows file-lock handling, pause/resume/delete, an add-server form writing cordis.patch.yml, real initialize-handshake probes, and beginner-friendly usage help.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 管理面板：每个服务器实时连接状态（绿点）、本地 stdio 服务器一键升级（pip/npx，自动处理 Windows 文件锁）、暂停/恢复/删除、添加表单直写 cordis.patch.yml、真实 initialize 握手探测与小白友好的使用说明。

description.en: Checks installed plugins against a DSH update before you install it, and reports the shared UI members and host services they use that the new version no longer exports — the case where an update installs cleanly but leaves plugins failing to load. Includes a read-only diagnose command. Windows only, DSH desktop, Node.js 18+.
description.zh: 在装 DSH 更新之前，把已装插件用到的共享 UI 成员和宿主服务，与新版本实际导出的逐项比对，列出新版本不再提供的那几个——也就是「更新装上了、插件却加载不起来」那种。附一个只读 diagnose 命令。仅支持 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端，需要 Node.js 18+。

description.en: Structured machine-readable CI output for DeepSeek Harness: JSON/NDJSON session reports, JUnit XML, semantic exit codes, artifact collection and privacy redaction - a dsh profile bundle plus a standalone CLI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化、机器可读的 CI 输出：JSON/NDJSON 会话报告、JUnit XML、语义化退出码、工件收集与隐私脱敏——一个 dsh profile bundle 外加独立 CLI。

description.en: Turns code review into a hard gate: deterministic severity rules, LLM-assisted findings, a team approval quorum and a durable compliance audit trail that must pass before a merge proceeds.
description.zh: 将代码评审变成一道硬性闸门：确定性严重级别规则、LLM 辅助发现、团队批准法定人数与合规审计追踪，未通过前禁止合并。

description.en: Self-healing runtime layer: a resource control loop with strategy switching and repair escalation, error-storm and fiber-failure insight, cross-session knowledge carry-over, a self-healing dashboard and 7 tools.
description.zh: 运行时自愈层：资源控制闭环（策略切换 + 修复升级链）、错误风暴与 fiber 失败洞察、跨会话知识传承，附自愈可视化面板与 7 个工具。

description.en: All-in-One MCP and skill manager with feature-based recognition and native OAuth 2.1 authentication.
description.zh: 一站式 MCP 与技能管理中心，支持特征识别与原生 OAuth 2.1 浏览器鉴权。

description.en: Let DSH act as a Locus client to deliver a one-stop Unity development experience. The plugin itself does not depend on Locus: you can install the Locus plugin for your Unity project in the settings interface. Features include operating the Unity Editor through Locus’s native broker; semantic analysis and debugging of C# code; and previewing prefabs and 3D models in the sidebar. Its Unity tools can evaluate C# on the editor main thread and edit assets and scene objects.
description.zh: 让 DSH 扮演 Locus 客户端，来实现一站式的 Unity 开发体验。插件本身不依赖 Locus：可在设置界面为你的 Unity 项目安装 Locus 插件。功能包括通过 Locus 原生 broker 操作 Unity 编辑器；对 C# 代码进行语义分析和调试；对 prefab 和 3D 模型在侧栏预览。它的 Unity 工具可以在编辑器主线程上执行 C#，并修改资源与场景对象。

description.en: Exposes dsh's internal capabilities (language, workspace registry, agent-status and approval events) over HTTP under /dsh-api on the local loopback socket dsh already listens on, with SSE fan-out at /dsh-api/events.
description.zh: 把 dsh 内部能力（语言、工作区注册表、agent-status 与 approval 事件）以 HTTP 路由的形式暴露在 dsh 已监听的本地回环 socket 上，前缀 /dsh-api，并通过 /dsh-api/events 提供 SSE 事件推送。

description.en: Crash protection plugin that auto-isolates plugins causing startup crash or hang, with independent watchdog process for total hang recovery.

Panel entry for the official client-plugin hot reload that tells you what actually changed first: it diffs each row rev against the last seen state and reloads only the plugin bundles that changed, keeps whole-graph reloads behind an explicit confirmation (a bare call is refused and reports the affected row count), and reports replay counters so a silent no-op cannot hide.
description.zh: 把官方客户端插件热重载做成面板入口，并且先告诉你「到底变了什么」：比对每行 rev 与上次所见后只重载 bundle 变化的那几个插件；整图重载必须显式二次确认（不带参数会被拒绝并回报受影响行数）；同时暴露重放计数，让「点了没反应」无法被静默掩盖。

description.en: Self-editing desktop workbench for DeepSeek Harness: a full dsh web replica with an edit mode in which the agent modifies the workbench (patch layers, plugins, UI) with hot reload.
description.zh: 可自修改的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面工作台：完整 dsh web 副本 + 编辑模式，agent 在对话中实时修改工作台（补丁层、插件、UI）并热更新生效。

description.en: Document-code consistency guard: audits version headers / changelog tables / directory trees / module & test counts / cross-doc references for drift, with severity-sorted, read-only fix suggestions.
description.zh: 文档与代码一致性守护：版本号/更新记录表/结构树/模块清单/测试计数/交叉引用漂移审计与修复建议，全程只读。

description.en: Windows boot autostart and one-click restart for the DSH service, from inside DSH: a resident supervisor that outlives the host, so a failed restart cannot leave DSH down; DSH spawned attached to a hidden console the supervisor owns, so no console window appears; plus a restart button, the current tokenised access URL and an optional post-start hook.
description.zh: Windows 平台的 DSH 服务开机自启与一键重启（都在 DSH 设置页内）：由常驻看护进程启动 DSH，它活得比 DSH 久，因此重启失败不会让 DSH 停摆；DSH 依附在看护进程的隐藏控制台上，不再每条命令弹一个控制台窗口；另有设置页重启按钮、当前带 token 的访问地址与可选的服务启动后钩子。

description.en: Cadence SKILL (Virtuoso Lisp) assistant for EDA engineers: official-doc-anchored API lookup (3557 entries across 5 IC6.1.8 manuals, signature confidence levels, never invents APIs) plus zero-execution static analysis driven by a lexical depth coordinate system — iterator-safe deletion with position-sensitive copy() protection, printf placeholder/argument reconciliation, in-loop nth O(N^2) detection, deprecated APIs with page refs, dangerous-intent interception and CIW error-log triage. Host half has zero third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 面向 Cadence Virtuoso 版图工程师的 SKILL 脚本助手：官方文档锚定的 API 检索（5 本 IC6.1.8 手册 3557 条，签名带置信度，查不到绝不臆造）＋不执行代码的深度静态检查——词法深度坐标系可精确判定跨行循环体与同行闭合，覆盖迭代中删除（copy 位置敏感）、printf 占位符与实参对账、循环内 nth O(N^2)、废弃 API（带页码引用），另有危险需求拦截与 CIW 错误日志定位修复。宿主半区零第三方依赖。

description.en: Mandatory cross-review for design proposals and lessons-learned: auto-detects design doc writes and enqueues them (tier=review) into the task queue, delivers the external reviewer verdict back to the initiating session, and appends approved preventive measures to OPS-GUARDRAILS.md (append-only, conflict-checked).
description.zh: 设计方案与事故教训强制交叉评审：自动识别设计文档写入并入队（tier=review），外部评审结论投递回发起会话，approved 的防复发措施以 append-only + 冲突检测方式追加到守则文件。

description.en: Mirrors assistant streaming frames (deltas, blocks, commits, turn fences) to a configurable NDJSON sink for external consumers.
description.zh: 把助手流式输出帧（增量、块、提交、轮次栅栏）以 NDJSON 形式写入可配置的接收端，供外部进程消费。

description.en: Scheduled update checks for DeepSeek Harness itself and installed plugins, applied only in idle windows — four schedule modes (daily, every N hours/days/minutes), bidirectional plugin whitelist, disk-verified installs, and a web settings panel with hot-reload config.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 定时自动更新插件：本体与已装插件一并检查，仅在空闲窗口执行。四种调度模式（每日/每N小时/每N天/每N分钟）、双向白名单、磁盘回读验证、内嵌设置面板热生效。

description.en: Registers /wrapped, which reads the session's own stats and renders a shareable dark SVG summary card — tool vs. thinking time, decode speed, and a tool/thinking-ratio verdict.
description.zh: 注册 /wrapped 命令，读取会话自身的统计数据，渲染成一张可分享的深色 SVG 总结卡：工具耗时与思考耗时对比、解码速度，以及工具/思考占比的评语。

description.en: Records the version of the edit target as an observation when the agent inspected the file with bash instead of the read tool, so the filesystem observation policy stops rejecting edits with FS_NOT_OBSERVED. Applies to edits only; blind whole-file overwrites stay guarded.
description.zh: 当 agent 用 bash（sed/awk/cat）看过文件而非 read 工具时，为编辑目标补登记一次真实版本的观察记录，使文件系统观察策略不再以 FS_NOT_OBSERVED 拒绝编辑；只作用于编辑，整文件盲覆盖仍受保护。

description.en: Category-based backup of DeepSeek Harness settings, skills, plugins, sessions and storages into verifiable, restorable and downloadable archives, with optional GitHub sync.
description.zh: 按分类备份 DSH 的设置、技能、插件、会话与存储，生成可校验、可恢复、可下载的归档，并支持 GitHub 同步。

description.en: Launch and manage local Maven-based Spring Boot applications on Windows, with service controls and searchable logs in the DSH web interface.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上启动和管理本地 Maven Spring Boot 应用，并在 DSH Web 界面提供服务控制与日志搜索。

description.en: Keeps what the agent builds at runtime: turns a `cordis_define` dynamic package into a real installed plugin that survives restart, writing the bundle and registering the profile layer with no pnpm, no network, and no build authorization.
description.zh: 把 agent 现场造出来的插件留下来：将 `cordis_define` 的动态包固化成能跨重启存活的正式插件，写包并注册 profile 层的全过程不用 pnpm、不联网、不需要构建授权。

description.en: Read-only DSH environment health check: disk, memory, latency, ~/.dsh bloat and outdated-plugin detection with graded reports and baseline trend comparison. Deletes nothing.
description.zh: DSH 环境只读体检：磁盘/内存/延迟/缓存膨胀/插件版本落后检测，分级报告并对比历史基线趋势。只读，不删任何东西。

description.en: Runtime plugin loading for the Web UI: a watched hot directory installs/updates client-plugin bundles live on every open page, no restart. Includes a right-column subagent dashboard example.
description.zh: Web UI 运行时插件加载：监视热目录，运行中安装/更新客户端插件 bundle，所有页面即时生效，免重启。附子智能体看板示例。

description.en: Telemetry backend exporting turns, model steps, and tool calls to yiTrace.
description.zh: 遥测后端：把 turns、model steps、tool calls 导出到 yiTrace。

description.en: Fullscreen business-app framework for DeepSeek Harness Web with a dark-sidebar workbench bundling a database connectivity tester and SQL query panel, a two-level knowledge base (bill and accounting) with local search and Word document ingestion, metadata environment comparison with alter-SQL generation, a data dictionary, agent log-search report demos, a system test-case runner, Evernote-style notes, developer utilities, and mini-games.
description.zh: 构建在 DeepSeek Harness Web 之上的全屏业务应用框架：深色侧边栏工作台，集成数据库连通测试与 SQL 查询、票据/会计二级知识库（本地检索与 Word 文档投喂）、元数据环境比对与变更 SQL 生成、数据字典、Agent 日志检索报告演示、系统测试用例执行、印象笔记风格记事本、常用开发工具与小游戏。

description.en: Lean and light? See DSH CPU, memory and UI stalls, broken down by plugin, terminal and MCP server, matched against stall times, and copy a diagnostic report. Windows x64 only.
description.zh: 小而美？看清 DSH 的 CPU、内存与卡顿：按插件、终端、MCP 拆分占用，对照卡顿时刻，复制诊断报告。仅限 Windows x64。

description.en: Manage Proxmox VE through conversation: 116 read + 116 write tools covering VMs, containers, storage, nodes, clusters, backups and firewalls, with API-token or username/password (ticket) auth.
description.zh: 通过对话管理 Proxmox VE：116 个只读 + 116 个写工具，覆盖虚拟机、容器、存储、节点、集群、备份与防火墙，支持 API Token 或用户名密码（ticket）鉴权。

description.en: Azure resource management: query and show resources, deploy Bicep/ARM templates, and check the activity log.
description.zh: Azure 资源管理：查询/展示资源、部署 Bicep/ARM 模板、查看活动日志。

description.en: Load testing with Grafana k6: smoke-test first, then run scripts and read percentiles from the JSON summary.
description.zh: Grafana k6 压测：先冒烟再跑脚本，从 JSON 汇总读百分位数。

description.en: Infrastructure as code: gated plan/apply, state and output inspection, and configuration validation via the terraform CLI.
description.zh: 基础设施即代码：plan/apply 门控、state/output 检查与配置校验。

description.en: Windows Package Manager: search, install, upgrade, uninstall, import/export and pin software through native tools.
description.zh: Windows 包管理器：搜索、安装、升级、卸载、导入导出与版本固定。

description.en: A hands-off safety net: directories the agent deletes go to a trash folder first and symlinks are never followed, with zero approvals.
description.zh: 脱手模式安全网：agent 删除的目录先进回收站、链接绝不跟随，零审批。

description.en: Audits the skills and plugins you already installed: routes a task description to the tool it needs, flags version drift against the npm registry and runtime faults from host logs, and reports which of a plugin's tools you never call. Registers 9 tools: can, find, status, recommend, check, scan, probe, run and suggest. Runs on Python 3.8+ with no third-party dependencies. Registered tool ids all carry the skill_audit_ prefix, for example skill_audit_can and skill_audit_find.
description.zh: 审计你已装的 skill 与插件：按任务描述路由到该调的工具，对比 npm registry 发现版本落后、读宿主日志发现运行时故障，并报告插件的哪些工具你从没调用过。注册 9 个工具：can、find、status、recommend、check、scan、probe、run、suggest。基于 Python 3.8+，无第三方依赖。注册工具名均带 skill_audit_ 前缀，例如 skill_audit_can。

description.en: Hard-stops further tool calls after a configurable per-session budget is reached.
description.zh: 在达到可配置的会话级工具调用次数上限后，硬拦截后续工具调用。

description.en: Auto-approval permission guard: a middle tier between workspace-write and danger-full-access — auto-allows safe operations inside trust directories, always asks a human for destructive ones, with 11 per-category switches and an audit trail.
description.zh: 自动审批权限守卫：介于 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access 之间的中间档——信任目录内安全操作自动放行，危险操作一律人工确认；11 个分类开关可调，自带审计记录。

description.en: Named user credentials the model uses by reference: values are entered on a Settings → Credentials page and injected into each shell execution as DSH_CM_* variables instead of being printed into the transcript, with credential_read as the documented last resort.
description.zh: 具名凭据按引用使用：秘密值在「设置 → 凭据」页录入，按次注入 shell 执行环境的 DSH_CM_* 变量而不打印进对话，credential_read 是文档化的最后手段。

description.en: Uses an isolated LLM review to approve or reject DSH sandbox permission requests.
description.zh: 使用隔离的 LLM 审查来批准或拒绝 DSH 沙箱权限请求。

description.en: Codex-style auto-review permission mode: adds an auto-review preset that auto-approves safe sandbox escalations, asks on risky or ambiguous ones, and rejects critical unconfirmed operations.
description.zh: Codex 风格自动审查权限模式：新增 auto-review 权限档，自动放行安全沙箱提权，危险或模糊操作转人工确认，未确认的致命操作直接拒绝。

description.en: Turn-scoped “Allow for this task” approvals: automatically allow matching `danger-full-access` escalations only for the current task, then expire.
description.zh: DSH「允许本次任务」临时授权：仅在当前任务内自动放行同类 `danger-full-access` 请求，任务结束自动失效。

description.en: Static pre-install security auditor for plugin bundles: lifecycle scripts, dynamic execution, credential-exfiltration combos, and patch-layer hazards, with zero dependencies and in-memory tar parsing.
description.zh: 插件安装前静态安全审计：生命周期脚本、动态执行、凭据外传组合特征与 patch 层风险；零依赖，tar 包全程内存解析不落盘。

description.en: Scans skills and MCP configs for prompt injection, homoglyphs, hidden Unicode, dangerous shell, and credential leaks.
description.zh: 扫描 skill 与 MCP 配置中的提示注入、同形字、Unicode 隐形字符、危险 shell 与凭据泄露。

description.en: Automated approval review: auto-approve read-only tools, auto-deny dangerous commands, fail-closed policy engine.
description.zh: 自动化审批审核：只读工具自动放行、危险命令自动拒绝，策略引擎 fail-closed。

description.en: Automatic secret redaction in tool results: masks API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys and configured secrets before the model sees them.
description.zh: 工具结果敏感信息自动脱敏：模型看到前掩码 API key / token / JWT / 私钥与配置密钥。

description.en: Right-sidebar panel that scans a DSH workspace on Windows for Low integrity labels on files and directories (quick or deep), restores them to Medium with verification, keeps a snapshot and restore script, and handles objects whose DACL does not grant the owner WRITE_OWNER.
description.zh: 右侧栏面板：在 Windows 上扫描当前 DSH 工作区文件与目录的 Low 完整性标签（quick / deep），恢复为 Medium 并复扫验证；保留快照与恢复脚本，可处理 DACL 未给 owner WRITE_OWNER 的对象。

description.en: Restores the permission preset a session was last set to when that session is reopened; a session opened for the first time is left untouched. Load it after dsh-experimental-auto-review to restore the auto preset.
description.zh: 重新打开会话时恢复该会话上次设置的权限预设；首次打开不干预。需排在 dsh-experimental-auto-review 之后加载才能恢复 auto 预设。

description.en: Destructive-command interception gate for dsh: parses shell semantics, judges risk against 41 built-in rules, and holds irreversible rm -rf, git reset --hard, and git push --force style commands at a confirmation gate.
description.zh: dsh 破坏性命令拦截闸门：解析 shell 语义、依据 41 条内置规则判定风险，将 rm -rf、git reset --hard、git push --force 等不可逆命令挡在确认关卡之前。

description.en: Blocks agents from reading or writing sensitive files (.env, credentials, key material), masks leaked secret-shaped values in tool results, keeps an audit journal, and exposes safe sg_* inspection tools that never print raw values.
description.zh: 拦截 agent 对敏感文件（.env、凭据、密钥材料）的读写，对工具结果中泄露的机密形状内容做掩码兜底，记录审计日志，并提供永不输出原始值的 sg_* 安全检查工具。

description.en: Read-only agent-fleet credential hygiene audit: credential-file permissions, embedded credentials in git remotes (masked in output), and provider token literal counts; zero-dependency and deterministic.
description.zh: 只读的 agent 机群凭据卫生审计：检查凭据文件权限、git remote 内嵌凭据（输出脱敏）与 provider token 字面量计数；零依赖、确定性。

description.en: Conversation lock for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: every conversation row gets a lock button, and a locked conversation blurs only the conversation area behind a password box while the sidebar stays usable. Re-locks on window blur, tab hide, page hide, or whenever the open conversation changes, and never pauses a running turn - the veil reports that background work continues. The password digest, lock flags, and preferences live in <DSH_HOME>/session-lock/state.json behind two same-origin routes guarded by a custom header, so clearing the page localStorage unlocks nothing; PBKDF2-SHA256 with a random salt, and a 30-second input lockout after five wrong attempts. Recovery is opt-in per machine: a Windows login password (enabled only after a real .NET PrincipalContext ValidateCredentials check against the local machine, so Microsoft accounts and passwordless machines keep it off) and a cooling period chosen while creating or changing the password (1/6/24/72/168 hours; expiry clears the password and releases every lock, and the correct password cancels the countdown). A settings section covers status, changing the password, lock new conversations, hiding locked titles, a three-position archive-restore policy (all / locked only / off, switching needs the password), lock everything, and unlock everything. Dialogs use the native dialog top layer, so a dialog opened from Settings is never covered by it. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer; no build step.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的会话锁：每个对话行尾多一个锁按钮，锁定后只把对话区挡住并弹出密码框，侧边栏照常可用。窗口失焦、切到后台、页面隐藏或换了对话都会立刻重新锁定；锁定只是界面层，正在跑的回合继续执行，遮罩上会提示后台任务仍在运行。密码摘要、锁清单和偏好存放在 <DSH_HOME>/session-lock/state.json，由两条带自定义请求头的同源路由读写，所以清掉页面的 localStorage 并不会解锁；PBKDF2-SHA256 加随机盐，连错五次锁定输入 30 秒。找回通道按机器可选：Windows 登录密码（必须用 .NET 的 PrincipalContext ValidateCredentials 在本机真实验证通过才启用，微软账户与无密码的机器会自动保持关闭），以及创建或修改密码时选定的强制冷静（1/6/24/72/168 小时，到期清空密码并解除全部锁，输对密码可中止倒计时）。设置页包含状态、修改密码、新对话默认上锁、锁定后隐藏侧边栏标题、归档恢复的三档策略（所有归档/仅已锁定/不需要密码，切换档位本身要密码）、一键上锁与一键解锁。对话框使用原生 dialog 顶层，从设置页打开的弹窗不会被设置页压住。要求 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上；无需构建步骤。

description.en: Read-only DSH plugin auditor with static scanning, current-session model review, and confirmation gates.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 插件审查器：静态扫描、当前会话模型审查和启用前确认。

description.en: Host-plane sovereignty clause and content guard: appends user-held adjudication to the system prompt tail, redacts credentials and hidden carriers in tool results, and vetoes irreversible actions before they run. Applies to every agent preset.
description.zh: 宿主面主权条款与内容守卫：在系统提示词末节注入「用户裁定」条款，清洗工具结果里的凭据与隐蔽载体，按可逆性前置拦截不可逆操作。对全部 agent preset 生效。

description.en: Three-tier deny/ask/auto gate for the computer-use (cua-driver) tool family: each tool category gets one segmented control in Settings, and an allow list or deny list overrides the tiers per tool name.
description.zh: 给 computer-use（cua-driver）工具族加三档「禁止 / 询问 / 自动授权」闸门：每个工具类别在设置里各占一个分段控件，另可用放行名单或拒绝名单按工具名覆盖档位。

description.en: Run a read-only security assessment of a Dameng DM8 database with 60 checks and produce an HTML report with GB/T 22239-2019 control mapping. Needs Java 8+ and a DmJdbcDriver jar you provide yourself.
description.zh: 只读安全评估达梦 DM8 数据库：60 项检查，附等保 2.0 控制点对照，生成 HTML 报告。需 Java 8+ 并自备达梦 DmJdbcDriver jar。

description.en: Bridges DSH to the local MimaVault password manager with seven tools for metadata search, entry lookup, clipboard copy, TOTP codes, password generation, domain-restricted API calls and user-confirmed vault clearing. By default it talks to the MimaVault desktop app, which must be installed separately; the optional built-in mode stores entries in plaintext.
description.zh: 把本机 MimaVault 密码库接入 DSH，提供 7 个工具用于元数据检索、条目读取、剪贴板复制、动态验证码、口令生成、域名受限的 API 调用与需人工确认的清空请求。默认对接 MimaVault 桌面应用（需另行安装）；可选的内置模式以明文保存条目。

description.en: Runtime security gate on the tool pipeline: denies calls naming hosts outside an egress allowlist, redacts credentials from results at the canonical value rather than only the rendered content, and appends every decision to a JSONL audit log; ships in monitor-only mode.
description.zh: 工具管线上的运行时安全网关：拦截出站白名单之外的主机调用，在 canonical value（而非仅渲染内容）层面脱敏结果中的凭据，每个决策写入 JSONL 审计日志；默认仅监控不拦截。

description.en: Blocks API keys pasted into the composer or written by tools, logs leak events, and scans the workspace for exposed secrets.
description.zh: 拦截粘贴进输入框或被工具写入的 API 密钥，记录泄露事件，并扫描工作区中暴露的密钥。

description.en: Security plugin that intercepts file deletion and write commands, requiring user token authorization.
description.zh: 文件守卫：拦截危险的文件删除/写入命令，需用户提供 token 才放行。

description.en: Security-focused Feishu (Lark) channel for DeepSeek Harness: allowlisted remote-agent access with workspace-scoped paths, symlink checks, risk-based approvals, session isolation, redacted logs, and bounded message queues.
description.zh: 面向安全的 DeepSeek Harness 飞书通道：提供白名单远程 Agent 访问、工作区路径与符号链接边界校验、风险分级审批、会话隔离、日志脱敏和有界消息队列。

description.en: Approval-free writes into whitelisted directories — wraps the filesystem fence for write/edit tools and auto-answers bash sandbox escalations that touch whitelisted paths, with a settings GUI.
description.zh: 白名单目录写入免审批——write/edit 文件工具直通白名单栅栏，命中白名单的 bash 沙箱升权自动放行，设置页可视化管理目录与开关。

description.en: Policy-layer guard that checks tool calls before they run: a read whitelist, a sensitive-path deny list (credentials, browser profiles, chat history, other users' home directories), dangerous-command blocking, subagent isolation, and a static scan that quarantines executables. Every denial is appended to an audit log. It is a text-and-path filter, not a sandbox or antivirus: dynamically built paths, encoded payloads and packed binaries can get past it, and it does not replace the OS antivirus.
description.zh: 在工具调用真正执行之前做判定的策略层护栏：读取白名单、敏感路径拒绝（凭据、浏览器配置、聊天记录、其他用户目录）、危险命令拦截、子代理隔离，以及对可执行文件的静态扫描与隔离区。每次拒绝都写进审计日志。它是文本与路径过滤，不是沙箱也不是杀软：动态拼接的路径、编码载荷、加壳程序都可能绕过，也不能替代系统自带防护。

description.en: Text hygiene as a dsh plugin: sanitize untrusted text, scan invisible characters, clean LLM formatting, and escape CSV formula injection.
description.zh: 文本卫生 dsh 插件：净化不可信文本、扫描隐形字符、清洗 LLM 格式、转义 CSV 公式注入。

description.en: An independent permission gate above the built-in sandbox.
