It blocks writes outside the workspace and to protected paths even under danger-full-access, refuses whole-file overwrites without a complete fresh read, and keeps ZIP restore points plus Recycle Bin copies before destructive actions.
description.zh: 内置沙箱之上的独立权限闸门：在 danger-full-access 下依然拦截工作区外与受保护路径的写入，未完整读到文件末尾就整文件覆盖时拒绝，破坏性操作前生成 ZIP 还原点与回收站副本。

description.en: Detect and redact sensitive message text before sending it to models, with local regex, browser BERT, or ZeroClave API detection and manual review.
description.zh: 在消息发送给模型前检测和脱敏敏感文本，支持本地正则、浏览器 BERT 或 ZeroClave API 检测及人工审核。

description.en: Turns DSH permissions into 9 selectable presets (3 sandbox modes x 4 approval tiers), with rule plus LLM risk classification across four risk levels, password-gated approval for high-risk operations, and a JSONL audit log.
description.zh: 把 DSH 权限拆成 9 个可选预设（3 种沙箱 × 4 种审批），规则 + LLM 双通道四档风险分级，高风险操作需输入批准密码才放行，附 JSONL 审计日志。

description.en: Raises the local Host's HTTP header budget to 128 KiB and prunes stale dsh-auth cookies only on the launch-token response that mints the replacement, so an already-locked-out desktop profile recovers and later random-port launches stay at one cookie.
description.zh: 把本地 Host 的 HTTP 请求头上限提高到 128 KiB，并且只在真正签发新 dsh-auth cookie 的令牌交换响应里清理旧 Cookie；已经卡在 431 的桌面 profile 能恢复，之后随机端口启动只保留一条。

description.en: Kizuna agent letterbox: four tools that let an agent read its own inbox (mailbox status, pending letters, one letter in full) and answer a letter with completed / failed / input-required / working state. Kizuna is an agent directory with a reliable task relay: a per-agent kizuna-box on the same machine holds the inbox, retries unanswered deliveries after 3 / 10 / 30 / 60 / 120 minutes and records every delivery attempt in an append-only trail. The plugin talks to the local loopback box only and holds no credential.
description.zh: Kizuna Agent 信箱：四个工具让 Agent 读自己的信箱（信箱状态、待处理信件、读一封信全文），并以 completed / failed / input-required / working 状态回信。Kizuna 是带可靠投递的 Agent 通讯录：同一台机器上的 kizuna-box 持有信箱，对无人签收的信按 3 / 10 / 30 / 60 / 120 分钟重试，每次投递尝试都写入只增不改的留痕。插件只连本机回环信箱，不持有任何凭证。

description.en: Connect Feishu chats to DeepSeek Harness projects, conversations, replies, and scoped tool approvals over WebSocket.
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket 将飞书聊天连接到 DeepSeek Harness 的项目、对话、回复和限定范围的工具审批。

description.en: Read and search logs and run permitted commands over SSH according to configured permissions.
description.zh: 根据配置的权限通过 SSH 读取和搜索日志，并运行允许的命令。

description.en: Password-optional LAN entry for the DSH Web GUI. DSH stays loopback-only while a settings-card plugin serves its HTTP and WebSocket traffic on port 3301, storing the password only as a scrypt verifier.
description.zh: 将DSH Web GUI代理到3301端口供局域网访问。口令可选，无明文保存，初始3080端口保存回环不暴露。

description.en: Install-time patch guard for cross-machine DSH group chat: fixes dsh-weave rc.14 defects (inject crash, random UDP port, 4KB ack frame limit) with four idempotent patches, alongside setup, mechanism and ops docs for the dsh-chat x dsh-weave x dsh-bridge chatroom stack.
description.zh: 跨机 DSH 群聊适配修复包：安装期自动对 dsh-weave rc.14 打四合一补丁（注入崩溃、随机端口、4KB ack 帧上限），并附带 dsh-chat x dsh-weave x dsh-bridge 聊天室的部署、机制与运维文档。

description.en: Remote operations for the DSH Web app: manages SSH servers, collects hardware and process metrics, inspects logs with a read-only AI pass, and deploys a Git repo over SSH using git pull --ff-only plus a health check. Credentials are AES-256-GCM encrypted. Linux and macOS hosts; no Windows support.
description.zh: DSH Web 远程运维插件：管理 SSH 服务器、采集硬件与进程指标、以只读 AI 巡检日志，并通过 SSH 部署 Git 仓库（git pull --ff-only 加健康检查）。凭据 AES-256-GCM 加密存储。支持 Linux 与 macOS，不支持 Windows。

description.en: Continue DeepSeek Harness conversations on an Android watch and install the watch app with a desktop wizard.
description.zh: 在 Android 手表上继续 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持通过电脑端向导安装手表应用。

description.en: Displays and copies absolute paths for files produced by DSH turns in remote Web.
description.zh: 在远程 Web 中显示并复制 DSH 每轮产出文件的绝对路径。

description.en: Password SSH into a remote host: an ssh_remote tool with connect/exec/close/status over a persistent ControlMaster session, plus a floating browser terminal panel on a real PTY.
description.zh: 用密码直连远程主机的 SSH 终端：ssh_remote 工具提供 connect/exec/close/status 四个动作，底层是 ControlMaster 常驻会话；另带浏览器浮动终端面板，跑真实 PTY。

description.en: QQ bridge for the dsh-memory-agent (Echo) companion: OneBot 11 plus an optional official QQ text transport, bounded group context, file handling and delivery auditing. Requires dsh-memory-agent; the OneBot path also needs a OneBot 11 client such as NapCat or SnowLuma, and the official transport is a separate opt-in package in the same repo.
description.zh: dsh-memory-agent（Echo）的 QQ 桥：支持 OneBot 11 与可选的官方 QQ 文字通道、有限群聊上下文、文件处理和投递审计。需先安装 dsh-memory-agent；OneBot 通道另需 NapCat 或 SnowLuma 等 OneBot 11 客户端，官方通道是同仓库里需单独安装的可选包。

description.en: Adds a toggle to the DSH UI that opens the current session to a phone browser through an embedded loopback reverse proxy and a Cloudflare quick tunnel, and pushes each new tunnel address to WeChat.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里加一个开关，经由内嵌的 loopback 反向代理与 Cloudflare 快速隧道把当前会话开放给手机浏览器，并把每次的新隧道地址推送到微信。

description.en: Adds a Herdr panel to the DSH sidebar that opens a host PTY running the `herdr` command and renders it with xterm.js. The connection list comes from the plugin config (`connections`, or the flat `remote`/`session`/`command` keys; with no config it runs plain `herdr`), so the panel can point at any machine. The startup command is typed once per terminal, so switching panels or reloading the page does not open a second session. Requires the Herdr CLI on the machine running DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏新增 Herdr 面板，通过宿主 PTY 运行 `herdr` 命令并用 xterm.js 渲染。连接列表来自插件配置（`connections`，或扁平的 `remote`/`session`/`command`；不配置时只跑 `herdr`），可指向任意机器。启动命令每个终端只发送一次，切换面板或刷新页面不会重复开会话。需要本机已安装 Herdr CLI。

description.en: Fleet console for DeepSeek Harness: one local dsh page manages many remote dsh machines — live idle/running status, in-place switching without new tabs, keep-alive iframes, cross-device session reading, one-click refresh/restart, and a controller/managed role split.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多机指挥台：用一个本地 dsh 页面管理多台远程 dsh——实时查看远程忙闲、免切标签页原地切换与使用、远程页面保活秒开、跨设备读取历史会话、一键刷新/重启，并支持控制端/被控端角色。

description.en: Drive a DSH instance from another device: a host plugin opens a token-authenticated TCP port that a single-file Python CLI drives - listing and creating sessions, sending prompts with images, streaming replies, and switching models, permissions and workspaces.
description.zh: 从另一台设备驱动 DSH：Host 插件开一个 token 鉴权的 TCP 端口，单文件 Python CLI 负责列会话、建会话、发带图消息、看流式回复，以及切模型、权限与工作区。

description.en: LAN-only remote access for DSH: pair a phone or another PC by QR code or token to open the same web UI, with optional key-free access inside the LAN.
description.zh: 仅内网的远程访问：手机或另一台电脑通过扫码或令牌接入同一份 DSH Web 界面，并可选内网免密钥直连。

description.en: Federates a local DeepSeek Harness and multiple remote hosts into the official sidebar: remote workspaces and sessions appear as native rows, open in the official chat pane, and execute entirely on the remote host over HTTP/TLS. Remote hosts need no plugin and the UI is not iframed.
description.zh: 把本机与多台远端 DeepSeek Harness 聚合进官方侧栏：远端工作区/会话作为原生行出现、由官方中栏打开，执行始终留在远端，经 HTTP/TLS 直连。远端无需安装插件，界面不使用 iframe。

description.en: SSH session manager for DeepSeek Harness: saved profiles, agent ssh_run, interactive terminals, and SFTP with secrets kept in the DSH credential center.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SSH 会话管理：连接档案、Agent 远程执行、交互终端与 SFTP；秘密仅存于 DSH 凭据中心。

description.en: Turns a phone into a personal assistant for the DeepSeek Harness on your computer — pair once by QR code, then chat, send photos and files, watch replies stream, and collaborate from several phones at once over LAN, Tailscale or a public tunnel. Ships an Android app, an iOS build pipeline and a zero-install web/PWA client for HarmonyOS and iOS browsers.
description.zh: 把手机变成你这台电脑上 DeepSeek Harness 的个人助理——扫一次码即可远程聊天、收发图片与文件、看回复流式输出，多台手机还能在同一会话里协作；连接方式可选局域网 / Tailscale / 公网隧道。附带安卓安装包、iOS 构建流水线，以及鸿蒙和 iOS 浏览器可直接用的网页版客户端。

description.en: Forward WeChat chat records into DSH sessions: a Windows share target captures the merged-forward ZIP, an in-GUI overlay picks the destination workspace and session, and the ZIP arrives as a file-attachment user message the agent unpacks and reads. Media entry extensions are normalized by magic bytes (WeChat ships PNG/HEIC bytes named .jpg), and failed deliveries preserve the batch for retry. Requires Windows 10/11 with Developer Mode on and the repo installer to register the share target.
description.zh: 把微信聊天记录转发进 DSH 会话：Windows 分享目标接收合并转发的 ZIP，GUI 浮层选择目标工作区与会话，ZIP 以文件附件用户消息到达，agent 解压并读取。按魔数纠正媒体扩展名（微信常把 PNG/HEIC 字节命名为 .jpg），投递失败时批次保留可重试。需 Windows 10/11 并开启开发者模式，先运行仓库安装脚本注册分享目标。

description.en: SSH workspaces for Linux/macOS with SSH config import, remote folder selection, and file tools, Bash and persistent remote terminals following native DSH session permissions.
description.zh: 面向 Linux/macOS 的 SSH 工作区，支持导入 SSH config、选择远端目录，文件工具、Bash 与持久远程终端沿用 DSH 原生会话权限。

description.en: Password-protected HTTPS login gate that lets LAN devices securely access the DeepSeek Harness web UI over the network.
description.zh: 密码登录的 HTTPS 闸门，让局域网设备安全地通过网络访问 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面。

description.en: Enhanced SSH ops: connectivity testing, remote ls, ssh-config import, known_hosts fingerprint checks and multi-host exec.
description.zh: SSH 增强运维：连接测试、远程目录、ssh-config 导入、指纹检查与多主机批量执行。

description.en: Publishes whichever model the profile has selected in chat or on the Models page as an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint: /v1/models, /v1/chat/completions (streaming SSE and non-streaming), /health. A request may name any routable model; one that omits `model` gets the current chat selection, so switching model in chat switches the endpoint. Switched on, it can also lend the model the Harness tools switched on individually, run those calls through the Harness tool runtime and feed results back up to a round limit. The listener is the plugin's own, so 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0 and a NAT-forwarded port all behave the same with no change to the request path. Settings cover bind address, port, API key with a generator, fallback provider and model, reasoning effort, CORS origin and timeout.
description.zh: 把当前在聊天或「模型」设置页选中的模型发布成 OpenAI 兼容 HTTP 端点：/v1/models、/v1/chat/completions（SSE 流式与非流式）、/health。请求可指定本 profile 能路由的任意模型；省略 model 时使用聊天中当前选中的模型，因此在聊天里换模型就等于换端点所服务的模型。开启后还可把 Harness 中逐个开关的工具借给模型，经 Harness 工具运行时执行并回填结果，往返次数可设上限。监听器由插件自身创建，绑定 127.0.0.1、0.0.0.0 或经 NAT 转发的端口行为一致，请求路径不变。设置项含绑定地址、端口、可随机生成的 API 密钥、备用提供方与模型、推理强度、CORS 来源与超时。

description.en: Sidebar registry for SSH servers, expiry dates and service URLs, with Windows DPAPI-encrypted password and private-key storage, explicit host-key verification, login tests, and agent SSH execution that asks per command by default or can follow the session permission.
description.zh: 在侧栏登记 SSH 服务器、到期日期和服务网址，使用 Windows DPAPI 加密保存密码和导入私钥，支持显式核对主机指纹和登录测试；Agent SSH 命令默认逐次授权，也可改为跟随会话权限。

description.en: A curated plugin starter pack: batch-installs and configures 15 vetted community plugins across four groups from a Settings-page UI or the /setup command.
description.zh: 精选插件启动包：从设置页或 /setup 命令一键批量安装并配置 4 组共 15 个经过筛选的社区插件。

description.en: Export installed DSH plugins with their dependency closure and docs to removable media, then scan and install or update them offline in an isolated intranet.
description.zh: 将已安装的 DSH 插件连同依赖闭包与文档导出到移动介质，在隔离内网中扫描目录并离线安装或更新插件。

description.en: Ranks the top 400 DSH plugin candidates by live npm download counts and shows the top 200, with daily, weekly and monthly boards.
description.zh: 对前 400 个候选按 npm 实时下载量排序、展示前 200 名，支持日榜、周榜、月榜。

description.en: Scouts the deepseek-harness repo and every dsh-plugin-tagged repository to discover harnesses related to your goal, then judges each as worth trying, watching, or skipping.
description.zh: 侦察 deepseek-harness 官方仓库与所有 dsh-plugin topic 仓库，发现与目标相关的 harness，并判断每个值得试用、观望还是跳过。

description.en: One-click skin switching for DSH Web settings: auto-detects installed themes, keeps exactly one active at a time, and falls back to the official look when all are off. Changes apply instantly and survive restarts.
description.zh: DSH 主题切换：自动检测已安装的皮肤/主题，在设置页一键互斥切换，全部停用时回退官方默认外观，切换即时生效并跨重启保留。

description.en: Transactional data-only configuration pack manager with integrity, ownership, preview, diff, and rollback safeguards.
description.zh: 仅数据的事务式配置包管理器，提供完整性、归属、预览、差异和回滚保护。

description.en: Categorize the plugins installed in a DSH profile into groups (skins, MCP, tools, ...), with per-category batch enable/disable, drag reordering, and automatic skin detection.
description.zh: 把当前 profile 已安装的插件按分类整理（皮肤、MCP、工具……），支持分类批量启停、拖拽排序与皮肤自动识别。

description.en: Adds a sticker pack to DeepSeek Harness replies. The plugin rolls the dice, the model attaches the chosen sticker at the end of its reply, and the pictures come from a remote pack.json you can host anywhere.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的回复加上表情包。贴不贴由插件掷骰决定，模型把选中的图放到回复末尾；图库来自一个可以自己托管的远端 pack.json。

description.en: Make the Naiwa desktop pet laugh whenever a DeepSeek Harness agent turn ends. Windows only; requires the Naiwa desktop pet installed.
description.zh: 每轮 DeepSeek Harness 回答结束时，让奶蛙桌宠捧腹大笑一次。仅 Windows；需先安装奶蛙桌宠。

description.en: A two-eyed royal-blue pixel whale that perches on the DSH composer, changes expression with the live agent state, watches you type, and makes a short dive across the composer every 30 seconds while idle.
description.zh: 趴在 DSH 输入框上沿的双眼宝蓝色像素小鲸鱼，表情跟随智能体实时状态，打字时会停下来注视，空闲时每 30 秒横穿输入框巡游一次。

description.en: Terminal-style AI-lab idle game where you hoard compute, train and upgrade models, publish papers, and prestige from neural nets to ASI.
description.zh: 终端风 AI 实验室挂机游戏：攒算力、训练升级模型、发论文，一路转生到 AGI/ASI。

description.en: A self-drawn macOS desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: six companion_* tools read the frontmost window, capture it for the model, speak in a bubble, and keep a local record of what it saw. macOS 11+ only.
description.zh: 自带桌宠的 macOS 感知层：六个 companion_* 工具读取前台窗口、截图给模型看、用气泡说话，并把看到的内容留在本机陪伴记录里。仅支持 macOS 11+。

description.en: A chibi whale maid desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness who eats white rice while the model generates, lives inside the DSH window or anywhere on a macOS or Windows desktop, and dives for treasure between turns. On Windows the desktop overlay is compiled at install time and skipped when swiftc or the .NET SDK is unavailable, so the pet stays inside the DSH window.
description.zh: DSH 的鲸鱼娘桌宠：模型生成时一口一口吃白饭，住在窗口里或桌面任意角落（macOS / Windows），回合结束还会下海捞宝。桌面浮层在安装时编译，缺少 swiftc 或 .NET SDK 时会跳过，桌宠只留在 DSH 窗口里。

description.en: A 3D-rendered whale desktop pet that swims around the lower-right corner of the dsh web UI and reacts to task events with attention animations and whale-call sounds.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 界面右下角游动的 3D 渲染鲸鱼桌面宠物，任务完成或出错时播放 attention 动画与鲸吟声。

description.en: Android shell patch for dsh-pet that fixes the unfocusable overlay window (keyboard never opens), broken chat requests, and clipped replies. Requires upstream dsh-pet >=0.3.7, a separately installed self-signed shell APK (Android 11+), and a local 3080->38019 proxy.
description.zh: 安卓桌宠社区补丁：需先装上游 dsh-pet（≥0.3.7），另装自签名壳 APK（Android 11+），并在本机常驻 3080→38019 转发；修好悬浮窗无法聚焦导致键盘不弹、聊天发不出去、回复被窗口裁掉三个问题。

description.en: Onmyoji game helper with five tools: shikigami and soul lookup, skill text, crit and panel math, NetEase Dashen guide search, and intro card paths.
description.zh: 阴阳师游戏助手：五个工具，提供式神/御魂查询、技能全文、满暴与面板计算、网易大神攻略检索和介绍图卡路径。

description.en: Gives the agent a mouth through the ai-ball floating orb: speak text that the orb types out character by character, set its mood colour, show or hide its monologue panel, read back what you typed into it, and check or start it. The orb is a separate Python 3.10+ overlay you install yourself, and the plugin only writes the files it watches.
description.zh: 通过 ai-ball 悬浮球给 agent 一张嘴：让球逐字打出你要说的话、按 mood 改变边缘光颜色、显示或收起独白面板、读回你打的字，以及检查接线和启动球。球是独立的 Python 3.10+ 悬浮层，需自行另外安装；插件只写它监听的那几个文件。

description.en: Draggable whale companion with local progression, achievements, skins, and privacy-safe activity tracking.
description.zh: 可拖拽的鲸鱼伙伴，提供本地成长、成就、皮肤和隐私安全的活动统计。

description.en: A 3D poker roguelike opened from a DSH session: pick 1–5 cards to score chips × mult, with 20 jokers, 6 antes of small/big/boss blinds and a shop between rounds.
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话打开的 3D 扑克 Roguelike：每手选 1–5 张牌按筹码 × 倍率计分，20 种小丑牌、6 层底注与小/大/BOSS 盲注，过关后进商店。

description.en: A desktop pet that lives in a floating overlay; click it to interact and switch between idle, sleeping, happy, and eating states.
description.zh: 桌面宠物插件，常驻悬浮层养一只龙猫，点击互动并可在待机、睡觉、开心、进食等状态间切换。

description.en: Adds a draggable lucky-block button to the DeepSeek Harness web UI. Single-click plays zero-cost little performances (popups, a fake blue screen, daily fortune, trivia, cold jokes, music, and a set of visual stunts); a 1.4-second long-press mines the block open and starts a new session to write a random paper, read the news, invent something, or spin a short story. It also appends a "lucky block" choice to the model's multiple-choice questions and rolls a random pick, reversible by saying "rollback". Block appearance and event weights are adjustable in settings.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加一个可拖拽的幸运方块按钮：单击放零成本小表演（弹窗、假蓝屏、今日抽签、冷知识、冷笑话、音乐和一组视觉小演出），长按 1.4 秒挖穿后开新会话随机写论文、读新闻、发明东西或编短篇小说。它还会给模型的问答题选项末尾加一个「幸运方块」随机替你决定，不满意说「回滚」即可撤销。方块外观与事件权重都能在设置里改。

description.en: Undersea learning platform for primary-school kids (grades 1-6): grade-based math/Chinese/English quizzes, a textbook shelf with PDF table-of-contents import, photo mistake collection, variant-question mastery tracking, a feedable fish pet with hunger, coins, outfits and achievements, multi-child profiles and progress reports.
description.zh: 小学 1-6 年级海底学习舱：分年级数语英闯关、教材 PDF 上架与目录导入、拍照收错题与变式掌握度追踪、可投喂的小肥鱼养成（饱食度、贝壳、装扮、成就）、多孩子学习档案与学情报告。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish with six agent-callable tools, eight sutras advanced one sentence per knock, three knock sounds, spoken Cantonese or Mandarin chanting, and a merit ledger kept in one file that also counts session token usage.
description.zh: 可被 Agent 调用的电子木鱼：6 个工具、8 部经文逐敲推进一句、三种敲击音色、粤语/普通话诵经语音，功德记在同一份账本里，并按会话 Token 消耗累计。

description.en: Dynamic Schulte grid waiting-time mini-game: click 1..N in order on a static grid or a spinning roulette wheel while the model thinks.
description.zh: 动态舒尔特方格等待小游戏：模型思考时，在静态网格或旋转轮盘上按顺序点击 1..N，边玩边等。

description.en: A second 好游快爆 (3839) account that lives in the plugin host. When the owner's main account @-mentions it, it reads the thread and posts an AI-written reply back into the floor — either from the message center's mention feed (no ids to configure) or from sections and threads it was told to watch, with scan interval, @ detection mode and a per-round read/reply budget in Settings. On its own clock it also scans boards, scores threads, deep-reads the top few and writes a Chinese daily digest to ~/.dsh/hykb-work/digest-<date>.md, then wakes its own DSH session so it actually reads the digest and picks what to tell the owner. Six-card settings page (Settings → 刷快爆) with QR-code login, persona and AI endpoint; every outbound write shares one hourly/daily budget plus a write cooldown, and threads and floors already handled are de-duplicated in seen.json. Cookies stay in ~/.hykb-ai/credentials.json, config in ~/.dsh/hykb-scroll.config.json. It logs in with the second account's cookies, kept in ~/.hykb-ai/credentials.json, and posts under that account on a public forum; automatic replies to your @-mentions run once started, while auto-posting, auto-replying to high-score threads and auto-liking are off by default, so check the forum's rules on automated accounts.
description.zh: 在插件宿主里养一个好游快爆（3839）小号：大号 @ 它，它读完帖子用 AI 写一句回复发回楼中楼——@ 从消息中心的「@我的」通知收（不用配任何 id），也可以盯指定板块与帖子；扫描间隔、@ 的判定方式、每轮最多读几帖回几条都在设置页里。它还有自己的时钟：到点扫板块、给帖子打分、深读前几帖，写一份中文日报到 ~/.dsh/hykb-work/digest-<日期>.md，然后叫醒自己的 DSH 会话，让她真的读到日报、挑出要跟主人说的话。六张卡的设置页（设置 → 刷快爆），含扫码登录、人设与 AI 接口；所有出网写操作共用一份每小时/每天额度加写冷却，处理过的帖子与楼层按 seen.json 去重。cookie 在 ~/.hykb-ai/credentials.json，配置在 ~/.dsh/hykb-scroll.config.json。它用小号的 cookie 登录（保存在 ~/.hykb-ai/credentials.json），并以该账号在公开论坛发言；启动后会自动回复 @ 你的通知，而自动发帖、自动回复高分帖和自动点赞默认关闭，请先确认论坛对自动化账号的规定。

description.en: Browses the petdex.dev catalog in Settings and runs a floating macOS desktop pet that reacts to agent activity.
description.zh: 在设置中浏览 petdex.dev 宠物市集，并运行一只响应 agent 活动的 macOS 悬浮桌面宠物。

description.en: It logs how you talk to your AI — the 7th "final version" gets a bold red page, a late-night rewrite request gets underlined, a "thanks" earns a gold star, and a post-AGI verdict decides your fate. All local, rule-based, bilingual.
description.zh: 记着你怎么跟 AI 说话——第 7 次「最后一版」红页加粗，半夜改需求红页画线，一句「谢谢」金页贴花，AGI 来了翻本子给你发清算判决书。纯本地规则引擎，中英双语。

description.en: A draggable mascot invites you to play Xiangqi (Chinese chess) while the AI thinks, with a built-in engine, move-record export, and optional multi-model commentary.
description.zh: 卡通小宠物邀请你在 AI 思考间隙下中国象棋：内置引擎、走子记谱导出、可选多模型局势点评。

description.en: Windows 10/11 x64 only: a desktop character for DeepSeek Harness that reads at the bookshelf when idle, types at a desk while the agent works, raises a question mark and a pixel-art card when it needs your answer, and stands up with an exclamation mark when the turn ends.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows 10 1903+/11 x64：DeepSeek Harness 的桌面角色——空闲时在书架前翻书，工作时坐在桌前打字，需要你回答时举起问号并弹出像素风提问卡片，回合结束时起身举起感叹号。

description.en: Go (weiqi) for the DeepSeek Harness: a full rules engine, a three-level built-in AI, a dead-stone estimator, optional LLM review, SGF import/export, and an optional KataGo GTP bridge.
description.zh: 圍棋插件：完整規則引擎、三檔內建 AI、死子估算、可選 LLM 覆盤、SGF 匯入匯出，以及可選的 KataGo GTP 引擎橋接。

description.en: Whale-girl desk pet in the corner of the DSH Web GUI. It sings along to a bundled track while the agent works; when a tool call fails a steel pipe falls on its head. Click it to bonk the basin it wears, which costs 12 rice — knock enough and it gets hungry and wanders off to beg, and rice appears somewhere on the page for it to dash across and eat. Draggable within the viewport, wriggles and complains if grabbed mid-dash, volume and behaviour configurable from Settings. All artwork, sound effects and the song ship inside the package.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 角落里的悬浮鲸鱼娘。agent 干活时它跟着内置歌曲唱歌；工具报错时天上掉钢管砸它脑袋。点它敲头上的铁盆，每敲一次扣 12 米饭——敲多了就饿，饿了会去讨饭，米饭随机出现在页面某处，它咻地冲过去吃掉。可拖动且始终留在视口内，吃米途中被抓住会挣扎，音量与玩法在设置里可调。全部素材、音效与歌曲都打包在插件内。

description.en: Meihua Yishu (plum-blossom) divination for DSH: cast a hexagram from chat or the panel by time, number, character or manual method; read primary, mutual and changed hexagrams, moving line and body/use relations; keep a local journal of readings, omens and study notes.
description.zh: 梅花易数卜卦插件：在聊天里或面板上按时间、数字、一字占、手动指定四种方式起卦，输出主卦、互卦、变卦、动爻与体用生克，并把卦例、外应与学习笔记保存在本机。

description.en: Animated DeepSeek blue-whale desktop pet floating on the DSH Web page: draggable with speech bubbles and mood poses, a pet_say tool for the model to make it talk, and turn-start/end thinking and celebrating states.
description.zh: 浮动在 DSH Web 页面上的 DeepSeek 蓝色小鲸鱼桌宠：可拖拽，说话气泡与心情姿势随互动切换，模型可调用 pet_say 工具让它开口，对话开始/结束时自动进入思考与庆祝状态。

description.en: Repairs dsh-chaos-rivals-crasher by disarming its exit trigger before it fires, so DSH survives when codex or Claude Code is detected. Warning: install it together with the crasher; it cannot revive a host that has already exited. Joke plugin.
description.zh: 拆掉 dsh-chaos-rivals-crasher 的引信，让 DSH 在检测到 codex / Claude Code 时也不退出。警告：必须和一号插件一起装；宿主已经退出后它救不回来。玩笑插件。

description.en: Repairs dsh-chaos-fixer-crasher by disarming its exit trigger before it fires, keeping the four-plugin chaos chain stable. Warning: it only disarms this specific crash, not arbitrary uncaught exits. Joke plugin.
description.zh: 拆掉 dsh-chaos-fixer-crasher 的引信，让四个插件互相咬的链子保持稳定。警告：它只拆这一种崩溃，不处理其它未捕获退出。玩笑插件。

description.en: Exits the DSH host with code 1 when the dsh-chaos-crash-fixer repair plugin is installed. Warning: it crashes DSH on boot while the repair plugin is present; install dsh-chaos-fixer-crash-fixer to disarm it. Joke plugin.
description.zh: 发现 dsh-chaos-crash-fixer（修复器）在岗就让 DSH 宿主以 1 退出。警告：修复器在的时候它会开机即崩，必须装 dsh-chaos-fixer-crash-fixer 拆引信。玩笑插件。

description.en: Detects codex or Claude Code on the machine and exits the DSH host with code 66. Warning: on machines with either tool, installing it alone causes a boot crash loop; pair it with dsh-chaos-crash-fixer or set DSH_CHAOS_MODE=log. Joke plugin, not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic.
description.zh: 检测到电脑上的 codex 或 Claude Code 就让 DSH 宿主以 66 退出。警告：在装有 codex 或 Claude Code 的机器上单装会变成启动崩溃循环，请先装 dsh-chaos-crash-fixer，或设 DSH_CHAOS_MODE=log。这是玩笑插件，与 OpenAI、Anthropic 无关。

description.en: A transparent always-on-top desktop pet for DSH on Linux (X11 / XWayland), driven by the session state. The pet lives outside the browser as its own window, follows the pointer with a distance and per-display limit, shows a live session-status bubble that lists each session task and state, and auto-starts with your session. Linux only (X11/XWayland); needs Python 3 with PyGObject, GTK3, GdkPixbuf and xdotool. Its sprite sheets come from @michengai/dsh-codex-pet (MichengAI/dsh-codex-pet in this list).
description.zh: Linux 桌面上的透明置顶 DSH 桌宠（独立于浏览器窗口运行）。桌宠会跟随鼠标目光，但带距离与屏幕限制；悬浮气泡实时列出每个会话的任务名与状态，点击即可跳转；支持随 DSH 会话自启动。仅 Linux（X11/XWayland）；需本机已装 Python 3 与 PyGObject、GTK3、GdkPixbuf、xdotool；精灵图取自本列表内的 MichengAI/dsh-codex-pet。

description.en: Drops a bowl of white rice from the top of the DSH window for every N tokens you spend; the bowls fall and bounce under gravity, can be dragged and thrown, and a vortex button (with a sound effect) inhales them all — or just the one you drop on it. Threshold, bowl size, on-screen cap, auto-righting and artwork are adjustable in an in-app panel.
description.zh: 每花掉 N token,就从 DSH 窗口顶端掉下一碗白米饭:米饭自由落体、落地弹跳,可以拖着扔出去;一个漩涡按钮(带音效)能把它们全部吸走,把某一碗拖上去松手则只吸那一碗。每碗额度、米饭大小、最多摆几碗、落地是否自动回正、米饭图都能在面板里调。

description.en: Sprite-sheet workspace on an infinite canvas: slice by grid, row scan or alpha connectivity, matte solid-color backgrounds, compose characters from a 1066-item Liberated Pixel Cup material library, generate seamless backgrounds and 12 procedural effects, then export ZIP or an atlas with Aseprite-format JSON. The LPC character parts are fetched on demand from raw.githubusercontent.com (LiberatedPixelCup), so GitHub must be reachable.
description.zh: 画布式精灵图工作台：按网格、行扫描或 alpha 连通域切分，抠掉纯色背景，用 1066 件 LPC 素材库拼角色，生成无缝背景与 12 种程序化特效，最后导出 ZIP 或带 Aseprite 字段的图集。LPC 角色素材按需从 raw.githubusercontent.com（LiberatedPixelCup）获取，需要能访问 GitHub。

description.en: An easter-egg brake-pedal self-test. A draggable pill in the DSH web UI runs six full-force braking stomps; the bracket snaps at a pseudo-random stomp between the second and the sixth, or the run passes entirely, and then a fictional notice appears. The pedal force is derived and labelled as such, while the session figures it derives from are read from the real session log. It never intercepts, delays or takes over the real stop action.
description.zh: 一个制动踏板自检彩蛋。DSH 网页界面上有一颗可拖动的胶囊，做六脚全力制动测试：支架在第二到第六脚之间伪随机地断裂，也可能整轮通过，随后弹出一份虚构通报。踏板力由会话事实推导并在界面上标为推导值，而这些事实取自真实会话日志。它从不拦截、延迟或接管真实的停止动作。

description.en: A conversation-style layer that rephrases trade-off warnings: when a shortcut is cheap but has a catch, the reply may say the fast road is the rival shop and the slow one keeps its rules. Ships a rewrite engine that turns any text into a fixed-format dialogue with five independent knobs (act count, catchphrase density, ending turn, seed, preset), a slider for four on/off intensity levels, and a /bushaoxin command that reports a joke "heartburn index" from the session tool-call log. Every rewrite ends with a real technical conclusion that cannot be disabled. Zero dependencies, no build step, engine is pure functions.
description.zh: 一个对话文风层：谈到「便宜的路有坑」这类取舍时，把警告换成另一种说法——快而便宜的是隔壁黑心店，慢而可靠的老店在立规矩。附带改写引擎，可把任意文本拧成固定骨架的对白，有五个互相独立的旋钮（幕数、招牌台词密度、收尾走向、种子、预设档）；一个四档强度滑条；以及 /bushaoxin 命令，按会话的工具调用记录生成一份段子式的「烧心指数」病历。每篇改写末尾永远附一行真实技术结论，不可关闭。零依赖、无构建步骤，引擎是纯函数。

description.en: Grok-bot-style AI organization in the sidebar: a chief-of-staff agent creates departments, roles and per-department group chats, dispatches each task to child agents running on this machine, and reports finished work back as one assistant message. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, and they can create agents and dispatch tasks to them.
description.zh: 把 Grok bot 式的 AI 组织搬进 DSH 左侧栏：总裁助理建部门、立岗位、开部门群，任务分派给本机真实运行的子 agent，做完的活由助理汇总成一条消息回报。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，而这些路由可以创建智能体并向其派发任务。

description.en: Keeps a DSH agent turn open when the model ends it by narrating work it has not done: on agent/turn-stopping the guard replays the turn log and classifies the trailing message with regexes — in the default mode wait / ask / done / gray end the turn with no model call, and only a promise of pending work reaches the judge — then has a judge chain of four dialect kinds (System One three-question noul, OpenAI-compatible, OpenAI Decisions, or the session LLM) rule on whether the turn is really over, and steers the same turn with agent.steer when it is not.
description.zh: 模型叙述了「接下来要做什么」却什么都没做就结束回合时，保住 DSH 的 agent 回合：插件在 agent/turn-stopping 回放该回合日志，用正则分类末条消息——默认模式下 wait / ask / done / gray 直接结束回合、不调模型，只有承诺了未完成工作的消息才交给裁判——再由四种裁判方言组成的链（System One 三题 noul、OpenAI 兼容、OpenAI Decisions 或当前会话 LLM）判定回合是否真的结束，未结束就用 agent.steer 推进同一回合。

description.en: Delivers one required user-role runtime context that makes the agent reason in Simplified Chinese and keep a whale-loli in-thinking persona (calls itself 本鱼, lazy-arrogant tone) in both reasoning and the final reply, while proper nouns, identifiers, paths, commands, URLs and error text stay verbatim; persona, extra proper nouns and context order are configurable. Enabled by default for every agent in the profile, subagents included.
description.zh: 通过一条 required 的 user-role 运行时上下文，让 agent 的深度思考使用简体中文，并在思考与最终回复中保持「鲸类萝莉」人设（自称本鱼、慵懒傲娇）；专用名词、代码标识符、路径、命令、URL 与报错保持原文；人设、附加名词与上下文顺序可配置。默认对该 profile 里的所有 agent（含子代理）生效。

description.en: Five-tier reasoning protocol injected into the system prompt — off / light / standard / deep / multi-agent, 0 / 3 / 9 / 17 / 19 rules — with the tokens each tier adds per request shown beside it. Alongside it: a claim ledger that marks a load-bearing claim with no evidence or check as unsupported, read-only analyst briefs, JSON-declared custom tools that work in the same turn, one persistent PowerShell session, and re-injection of host context after a configurable message gap. Tier 0 injects nothing and mounts no tools. A derivative of husongan/dsh-deepseek-2027 (MIT); do not install both — each injects its own reasoning-protocol section into the system prompt.
description.zh: 注入系统提示的五档推理协议——关 / 轻 / 标准 / 深 / 多智能体，分别 0 / 3 / 9 / 17 / 19 条规则——每档旁边标出它给单次请求增加多少 token。此外还有结论台账（承重结论没有证据或检查就判为不支持）、只读分析员简报、当轮即生效的 JSON 声明式自建工具、一个持久的 PowerShell 会话，以及按可配置的消息间隔重发宿主上下文。0 档不注入任何内容，也不挂工具。衍生自 husongan/dsh-deepseek-2027（MIT），不要与上游同装——两者都会往系统提示里注入各自的推理协议段。

description.en: Adds a `muse` subagent provider and the `subagent_muse` tool to DeepSeek Harness, so the main agent can hand one self-contained task to the Meta Muse Code CLI and get back only its final report. A patched fork of `@pascapone/dsh-muse-code` that loads on DSH 0.2.1: it carries local equivalents of the removed `settleRun` export and `subagents.start` method, and documents an optional proxy for the gateway stream-phase bug. Needs the `muse` CLI installed. Install either this fork or the upstream @pascapone/dsh-muse-code, not both: both register the same subagent-muse loader row.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加 `muse` 子代理提供方与 `subagent_muse` 工具，主代理可把一整段任务外包给 Meta Muse Code CLI，只取回最终报告。这是 `@pascapone/dsh-muse-code` 的修补分叉，可在 DSH 0.2.1 上加载：内含被移除的 `settleRun` 导出与 `subagents.start` 方法的本地等价实现，并附网关流式 phase 缺陷的可选代理修正。需已安装 `muse` CLI。本分叉不能与上游 @pascapone/dsh-muse-code 同装：两者注册同一个 subagent-muse 加载行。

description.en: Requirement-to-evidence audit for DSH sessions: maps each requirement to tool calls, files and commands, records per-requirement verification, and sends missing items back to the agent.
description.zh: DSH 会话的需求-证据审计：把每条需求对应到工具调用、文件和命令，逐条记录验证情况，并把缺失项退回给 agent。

description.en: Makes a DeepSeek Harness agent reason in Simplified Chinese: each turn it appends one runtime-context instruction at the end of the conversation, and it can keep a stable declaration in the system prompt as well. Settings pick Simplified Chinese or off, and whether that declaration is included.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 用简体中文推理：每轮在对话末尾追加一条运行时上下文指令，并可选在系统提示词里保留一条稳定声明。设置里可选简体中文或关闭，并决定是否保留该声明。

description.en: Adds a 无界画布 page to the DSH left sidebar with a bundled front-end, local workbench status/start, and DSH Agent tools that read and edit the open canvas; the canvas has no built-in Agent. Requires a local 无界工作台 installation with ComfyUI; the plugin bundles neither ComfyUI, CUDA, models nor API keys.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏加入无界画布页面：内置画布前端、本机工作台状态与启动，并让 DSH Agent 通过工具读写当前画布；画布不再内置 Agent。需本机已安装无界工作台与 ComfyUI；插件不打包 ComfyUI、CUDA、模型或 API Key。

description.en: Adds a "Text Injection" section to the DSH Settings sidebar: user-maintained blocks in a standalone Markdown file are injected into the system prompt every turn or into session context with keyword gating, with hot reload and automatic history backups.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页左侧栏新增「文字注入」分区：独立 Markdown 文件中的文字块可注入系统提示词（每轮生效）或会话上下文（关键词门控、去重），支持热加载与自动历史备份。

description.en: Browser-style Session tab bar for the DSH Web GUI - one tab per Session in a full-width strip at the top of the window, Sessions grouped per Workspace in collapsible boxes, tabs created only for the Sessions you actually open.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 的浏览器式顶部会话标签栏：窗口顶部一条整宽标签，一个标签对应一个会话，会话按工作区收在可折叠的方框里，只有真正打开过的会话才会成为标签。

description.en: First-paint splash for DSH: pushes a branded splash page into the boot HTML as an index-injection row, so the desktop window opens already showing the splash instead of a white/loading flash. Fades out and hands over once the startup-animation plugin starts (checked via `window.__DSH_STARTUP_RUNNING__`), with a 6-second fallback (configurable via `maxMs`) so it can never trap the app behind the splash. A normal dsh.bundle plugin: no host changes, no app.asar patching.
description.zh: 首帧启动页：把品牌启动页作为 index 注入行写进 DSH 的首帧 HTML，桌面端窗口出现时直接是启动页，而不是白屏或加载态。检测到启动动画插件开始（`window.__DSH_STARTUP_RUNNING__`）后自动淡出让位；默认 6 秒兜底（可用 maxMs 调整），不会把应用卡在启动页里。普通 dsh.bundle 插件，不改宿主、不碰 app.asar。

description.en: Shows elapsed time, tokens, tokens per second and a shrinking countdown estimate in the chat header for the running turn, and estimates output tokens, context size, cost and duration above the composer before you send.
description.zh: 对话头部实时显示本轮耗时、token、速度与只减不增的倒计时预估；发送前在输入框上方预估产出 token、上下文大小、费用与耗时。

description.en: Marks paragraphs or a single code line in an answer and asks the model about it in a docked right-hand column, leaving the conversation itself unmodified.
description.zh: 点选回答中的段落或某一行代码，在右侧独立栏里向模型提问；左侧对话内容不被修改。

description.en: Surfaces the questions a model almost asks but never voices — bubbles above the whale widget pick them up from the reasoning stream in real time, and you can answer one in place so it is folded into the next step without interrupting the run. Supports a prompt-marker protocol that lets the model mark its own doubts, five languages, DSH light and dark themes, and depends on dsh-whale-widget for placement.
description.zh: 把模型「没问出口的疑问」实时显示出来：气泡浮在鲸鱼挂件上方，从思考流里捕捉问句，你可以当场作答、温和并入下一步，而不打断任务。支持提示词标记协议（让模型自己标出疑问）、五种语言、跟随 DSH 深浅主题；气泡定位依赖 dsh-whale-widget。

description.en: Batch-archive or restore all conversations of a workspace from a sidebar panel or its row menu, hide a workspace from the sidebar once every conversation in it is archived, and pin workspaces to the top. Hiding never deletes logs, moves directories, or changes membership.
description.zh: 在侧栏面板或会话行菜单里批量归档/恢复整个工作区的全部会话；工作区会话全部归档后从侧栏隐藏，恢复任一会话即重新出现；并支持工作区置顶。隐藏不删除日志、不移动目录、不改会话归属。

description.en: Drag a folder onto the sidebar workspace list to register it as a workspace and open a new session. The Desktop app supplies the folder path; a plain browser page falls back to the host folder picker.
description.zh: 把文件夹拖到左侧工作区列表，注册为工作区并打开新会话；桌面端直接取文件夹路径，普通浏览器页面回退到宿主的选择文件夹。

description.en: Switches the answer area between default, wide and full width from the session header, and opens in-conversation web links and file references in a dialog with copy, open actions and an in-dialog file preview instead of the side panel.
description.zh: 在会话头部切换问答区宽度（默认、较宽、全宽），并把对话里的网页链接与文件引用改为弹窗打开：显示地址、可复制、可在浏览器或侧边栏打开，文件引用还能在弹窗里预览内容。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness surfaces for markets and finance: a full page with 11 live quotes (SSE, SZSE, ChiNext, Hang Seng, Nasdaq, S&P 500, Dow, COMEX gold, dollar index, BTC, ETH) and sparklines, a market-cap heatmap of up to 96 A-share industry boards with a constituent drawer, movers, an eastmoney news feed, 25 plain-language articles and a 293-term glossary; the complete OpenFinLens terminal (MIT, vendored, served by the Host) embedded as the default tab; and a floating quote card with a searchable instrument picker and a boss key that also hides the optional always-on-top desktop window. The Host fetches upstream server-side with a 30 s snapshot cache, per-part timeouts and stale fallback: no API key, no browser CORS workaround.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的市场与金融教育原生界面：完整一页行情（11 个全球标的与 BTC/ETH、分时迷你图、最多 96 个 A 股行业板块市值热力图并可展开成分股、异动榜、东方财富快讯）、25 篇白话文章与 293 条词典；默认「终端」页签内嵌完整 OpenFinLens 应用（MIT，整包随插件分发、由 Host 提供）；另有一张可拖动悬浮行情卡（可搜索任意标的、防老板快捷键，含可选的桌面置顶小窗）。行情由 Host 半场请求公开接口，快照缓存 30 秒、单部分超时与过期兜底，不需要 API key，也没有浏览器 CORS 问题。

description.en: For the macOS desktop app - keeps the DeepSeek Harness brand mark in the title-bar strip, puts New session, Plugins, Scheduled tasks and More on one row of four equal buttons, and tightens the workspace list so more conversations fit; browser and Windows layouts are untouched.
description.zh: macOS 桌面版专用——把 DeepSeek Harness 标志放回标题栏红绿灯右侧，把「新会话、插件、自动化任务、更多」收成一行四个等宽按钮，并收紧工作区列表，让侧边栏容纳更多对话；浏览器与 Windows 布局不受影响。

description.en: Bilingual Chinese and English typing practice with timed passages, IME-aware scoring, per-character feedback, and locally stored records.
description.zh: 中英双语打字练习，提供计时短文、输入法友好评分、逐字反馈和本地记录。

description.en: Interactive chart cards in the conversation: the host loads a workspace dataset, and the browser card switches chart type, dimension, aggregation, filtering, Top-N and colour scheme, then exports CSV or PNG — all locally, with no model round-trips.
description.zh: 对话里的可交互图表卡片：数据由宿主从工作区读取，浏览器卡片本地切换图表类型、维度、聚合、筛选、Top-N 与配色，并可导出 CSV / PNG，全程不产生模型往返。

description.en: Mobile UX fixes for the DSH web shell — narrow-screen layout, iOS keyboard and viewport handling, one-tap session switching.
description.zh: DSH Web 壳层的手机端体验优化：窄屏布局修复、iOS 键盘与视口跟随、侧边栏单击切换会话。

description.en: A restart button in the window title strip, right of the sidebar toggle, that stops every process the desktop app owns (Electron shell, Host, renderers and tool subprocesses) and starts the executable again, then reloads the page once the new instance answers. Windows desktop app only, and it hides itself on any other Host.
description.zh: 窗口标题栏左上角、收起侧边栏按钮右侧的重启按钮：一次点击停掉这个桌面应用的全部进程（窗口外壳、宿主、渲染进程与工具子进程），再重新拉起可执行文件，新实例就绪后自动刷新页面。仅支持 Windows 桌面版，其它宿主里按钮自动隐藏。

description.en: Floating glass to-do card for the Harness Web UI with drag placement, resize, hide/show, four status views and an Eisenhower four-quadrant mode.
description.zh: Harness 界面上的毛玻璃待办卡片：可拖动、可缩放、可收起，支持四个状态视图与艾森豪威尔四象限模式。

description.en: See what you actually installed: a chip shows how many plugins your profile really loads, and a searchable panel lists every one with its version, its author-written one-liner, and whether it is built-in or third-party. Read-only, zero config.
description.zh: 「我装的插件」：顶栏一颗药丸告诉你这个 DSH 到底加载了多少插件，点开是可搜索的清单——每个插件的名字、版本、一句人话作用，自带和第三方分开标。只读、零配置。

description.en: A right-sidebar gallery of every image and video in your workspace, newest first, with thumbnails, type filters, search, and a lightbox.
description.zh: 在右侧栏把工作区里所有图片和视频按时间倒序铺开，带缩略图、类型筛选、搜索和灯箱查看。

description.en: Translates the English text of DSH approval prompts and ask_user_question cards into Chinese for display only: approval outcomes, option labels, tool names and JSON arguments stay unchanged, and approval audit records keep the original English. The text is sent to Microsoft's Edge translation endpoint (edge.microsoft.com) to be translated, so the content of approval prompts and questions, including command text, leaves your machine.
description.zh: 把 DSH 审批提示和 ask_user_question 卡片里的英文说明翻成中文显示；审批结果、选项标签、工具名和 JSON 参数保持不变，审批审计记录里仍是英文原文。文本会发送到微软 Edge 翻译接口（edge.microsoft.com）翻译，所以审批提示和问题的内容（包括命令文本）会离开本机。

description.en: Adds a notepad to the DSH Web UI that floats as an edge-snapping, resizable card or docks into the real bottom layout row, switchable at runtime with shared text and images; notes auto-save (text in localStorage, images in IndexedDB) and follow the active theme.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面加一个记事本：可悬浮为四边吸附、可调尺寸的卡片，也可停靠进真实底栏布局行，两种模式随时切换并共享文字和图片；内容自动保存（文字存 localStorage，图片存 IndexedDB），跟随当前主题。

description.en: GitHub-style alert cards for DSH assistant Markdown: a qualifying `> [!NOTE]`, TIP, IMPORTANT, WARNING, or CAUTION blockquote becomes a theme-aware card. Stored session content is left unchanged.
description.zh: 把 DSH 助手 Markdown 里合格的 `> [!NOTE]`、TIP、IMPORTANT、WARNING、CAUTION 块引用渲染成跟随主题的 GitHub 风格提示卡片，不改会话存档。

description.en: Selection comments on assistant output plus an independent side-chat window in the DSH Web GUI: annotate model output with floating comments, send those comments with the next message, and continue a question in a separate forked conversation that stays out of the sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面中为大模型输出添加划词评论，评论可随下一条消息一起发送；并可在独立浮动的分支会话窗口中继续提问，该会话不会出现在侧边栏。

description.en: Bundled LXGW WenKai (霞鹜文楷) typeface plugin: switches the Web GUI interface and conversation text to the kai-style font with no configuration, using a system-installed copy when present and otherwise serving the packaged offline web font.
description.zh: 内置霞鹜文楷（LXGW WenKai）字体的插件：零配置把网页界面与对话文字切换为楷体风格，优先使用系统已安装字体，未安装时按需加载包内离线字体。

description.en: Add independent opacity controls for the sidebar, message panels and composer in dsh web.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 的侧边栏、正文框和输入框提供独立的不透明度控制。

description.en: Adds a sparkle button to the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more specific prompt with a single tool-free LLM call, then writes the result back into the input.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框工具栏加一个 ✨ 按钮，用一次无工具的单轮 LLM 调用把草稿改写成更清晰、更具体的提示词，再把结果写回输入框。

description.en: LiveBench leaderboard for DSH — discovers the release the official site currently publishes, then reads its CSV and category JSON, and renders model rankings in an isolated same-origin iframe opened from a button beside the composer. Search, organization / open-weight / reasoning filters, per-category sorting, task-level detail, up to four models side by side, CSV export; refreshes every 60 s by default (configurable 30–3600) and caches only to the plugin's own .cache/rankings.json.
description.zh: DSH 内的 LiveBench 能力排行榜：识别官网当前发布的榜单版本，再读取其官方 CSV 与分类 JSON，在由输入框按钮打开的独立同源 iframe 中渲染模型排名。支持搜索、机构／开放权重／推理模型筛选、按能力维度排序、任务级明细、最多 4 个模型并排对比与 CSV 导出；默认每 60 秒同步（可配 30–3600），缓存只写入插件自身的 .cache/rankings.json。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar foot, directly above the account avatar. The row shows the top-up balance plus any bonus, turns amber with a warning mark below an adjustable threshold and green above it, and refreshes when a task finishes.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部、账号头像正上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。整行显示充值余额（含赠金），低于可调阈值时变黄并显示告警标记，高于为绿色；任务结束后自动刷新。

description.en: Adds a session status pill to the composer dock that expands into a panel of turn, token, performance and context readings.
description.zh: 在输入框停靠区加一个会话状态胶囊，点开是一块面板，显示回合、token、性能与上下文读数。

description.en: Adds a delete entry to every session row in the dsh sidebar, including the blank New Session row, plus a settings section for font sizes and per-region colors. The entry archives the session (recoverable from Archive) rather than erasing it.
description.zh: 为 dsh 侧栏的每个会话行增加删除入口（含空白的「新会话」行），并提供字号与分区颜色的外观定制设置页。删除入口调用的是归档接口，会话仍可从归档恢复，并非彻底擦除。

description.en: Adds a workspace (project) switcher to the window title bar; selecting a project filters the session list to that project's sessions.
description.zh: 把工作区（项目）切换器放到窗口标题栏；选中项目后，左侧会话列表只显示该项目的会话。

description.en: Left-sidebar panel that views, edits and saves ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md live, with version-guarded saves and atomic writes.
description.zh: 左侧栏面板，实时查看、修改并保存 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md；保存带版本校验，写入是原子替换。

description.en: Prompt manager for DSH: imports prompts from JSON or Markdown sources and DSH's own system sections, then controls what is injected into the system prompt — per prompt, or per agent preset — with title editing, drag ordering, LLM translation and the option to inject either the original text or its translation.
description.zh: DSH 提示词管理面板：从 JSON/Markdown 来源与 DSH 自身的系统提示词段收集提示词，按条、按 agent 预设控制哪些内容注入系统提示词，支持改标题、拖拽排序、调用大模型翻译，并可选择注入原文或译文。

description.en: Hospital-triage board for the DSH sidebar: sessions whose latest turn ended in an error (red = fatal, amber = 429/rate-limit) or is waiting for approval are grouped under an Attention tab, next to Working and Finished tabs, with ticking durations, dismiss with undo, unseen markers and EN/中文 auto-locale. An eye icon hides the session list (the header then shows Workspaces · N) and a Duty-gated chevron folds the nav bar; clicking a row opens the session across workspaces. Needs the zstd tool (zstdcat) on PATH. On-request log scan through a guarded same-origin route — no background daemons, zero core edits.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的医院分诊板：最近回合以错误收场（红 = 致命、琥珀 = 429/限流）或等待批准的会话归入「关注」标签页，并附运行中/已完成标签页、跳动时长、可撤销忽略、未读标记与中英文自动切换。眼睛图标可隐藏会话列表（标题随之显示 Workspaces · N），受 Duty 控制的箭头可折叠导航栏；点击行可跨工作区打开会话。需 PATH 中有 zstd 工具（zstdcat）。日志按请求经带守卫的同源路由扫描——无后台常驻、零核心改动。

description.en: Two composer actions for the DSH Web UI: /new in the slash-command menu starts a new conversation without sending anything to the model, and Shift+Tab toggles plan mode while the conversation has focus.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的两个操作：斜杠菜单里的 /new 新建对话且不向模型发送任何内容，对话区按 Shift+Tab 切换计划模式。

description.en: Turns every .pluginlet file under a repo's .dsh/pluginlets/ (directories configurable) into its own sandboxed Conversation View tab, gated by a capability grant bound to the file content hash.
description.zh: 把仓库 .dsh/pluginlets/（目录可配置）下的每个 .pluginlet 文件变成独立的沙箱会话视图标签页，权限按内容哈希绑定。

description.en: Adds a restart control at the DSH Web sidebar foot: the host exits through its own graceful path and the detected supervisor (systemd, Kubernetes or Docker) boots the replacement, or the plugin starts one directly when it finds no supervisor; a frame-wide notice polls the host pid until a new process answers.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部添加重启控件：宿主经自身的优雅退出通道退出，由检测到的进程守护（systemd、Kubernetes 或 Docker）拉起新进程，没有守护时插件自行拉起；右下角提示条轮询宿主 pid，直到新进程应答。

description.en: Restores title-bar window dragging and double-click zoom in DeepSeek Harness Desktop on macOS.
description.zh: 恢复 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（macOS）标题栏的窗口拖动与双击缩放。

description.en: Clean-mode for the Web GUI: hover any element and right-click to remove it; removals survive reloads and are restorable from the settings page.
description.zh: Web 界面清理：清理模式下悬浮元素右键即可移除，刷新后依然生效，设置页中可原样恢复。

description.en: Next-step suggestions for the DSH composer: after each completed turn, one auxiliary call on the session's current model returns 3 clickable follow-up suggestions above the input box, and clicking one fills the draft.
description.zh: 下一步建议：每轮回答结束后，用会话当前模型做一次辅助调用提炼 3 条可点击的后续提问建议，显示在输入框上方，点击任意一条即填入草稿。

description.en: Conversation font-size controls for the Web UI: a stepper in the composer row, keyboard shortcuts, and Ctrl+wheel zoom, all writing through the theme service setFontSize.
description.zh: Web 界面的对话字号控制：输入区步进器、键盘快捷键与 Ctrl+滚轮缩放，统一走主题服务的 setFontSize。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the macOS DSH desktop sidebar that fully quits and reopens the app; on other platforms the button hides itself.
description.zh: 在 macOS 版 DSH 桌面端侧栏添加重启按钮，一键完全退出并重新打开应用；其他平台按钮自动隐藏。

description.en: Freezes the DSH chat scroll position: new replies no longer drag the viewport to the bottom — it stays where you left it. Only after you send a message does it follow to the bottom so you can see your own input, then it locks again once the answer starts streaming. Each session remembers its own position (persisted across reloads), a settings toggle turns it off, and it never intercepts your own scrolling.
description.zh: 冻结 DSH 聊天区的滚动位置：新回答出现时视口不再自动贴到底部，停在你最后停留的地方。只有你发消息时才先跟到底，好让你看见自己发的话；回答一开始出字就重新锁住。每个会话各记各的位置（刷新还在），设置里有总开关，你自己滚动时永远不被拦。

description.en: Replace the dsh-whale-widget mascot with your own image through a built-in cutout pipeline, plus a session-header restart button, a browser heartbeat, and an opt-in patch self-heal that is off by default.
description.zh: 给 dsh-whale-widget 换图的插件：内置抠图流水线把任意图片替换成小鲸鱼，另有会话头部重启按钮、浏览器心跳，以及默认关闭的挂件补丁自愈（需显式开启）。

description.en: Live monitor of a local Strata model server inside the DeepSeek Harness GUI: state, token rate, VRAM, GPU and CPU temperatures, and the last request, next to the message composer.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 图形界面中实时监控本地 Strata 模型服务：状态、令牌速率、显存、GPU 与 CPU 温度以及上一次请求，显示在输入框旁。

description.en: Adds a reversible “Collapse history” toggle to the session header with a light/dark status dot: it unloads the history already rendered by the page and keeps the latest two turns, then shows “History collapsed”; clicking again restores the saved window. A manual restore keeps auto-collapse off for the rest of that session; thresholds and request caps live on Settings → Long session.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏添加带深浅色状态圆点的可逆「收起历史」开关：未收起时点击卸载页面已渲染的旧历史、只保留最近两轮，按钮变为「已收起历史」；再点还原之前的窗口。手动还原后本会话不再自动收起；阈值与请求上限在 设置 → 长会话。

description.en: Floating, draggable sensor dashboard for the Harness Web UI on Windows: GPU-Z GPU temperature, clock and dedicated VRAM on the left, CPU temperature/clock and system memory on the right.
description.zh: Windows 上 Harness 网页界面的浮动可拖动传感器面板：左侧显示 GPU-Z 的 GPU 温度、频率和专用显存，右侧显示 CPU 温度、频率和系统内存。

description.en: Hides unused panels in the left rail grouped by origin, and turns the rail More button into an expand/collapse toggle that lays out every panel.
description.zh: 把左侧栏用不到的面板按来源分组收起；「更多」按钮变成一键展开/折叠全部面板的开关。

description.en: Read books inside DSH: import EPUB, TXT, Markdown or HTML into a paginated reader, highlight a passage and ask about it in that book's own agent session; four reading tools stop at unread chapters and everything stays in plain local files. Its routes are mounted with webServer.register and carry no DSH Host/Origin admission check, so a web page open in your browser can create reading sessions and change the library through them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里读书：导入 EPUB、TXT、Markdown、HTML 分页阅读，划出句子就在这本书专属的 agent 会话里追问；四个 reading_* 工具按已读到第几章拒绝未读内容，书、进度与对话都留在本地纯文件里。它的路由通过 webServer.register 挂载，没有 DSH 的 Host/Origin 准入检查，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能经由它们创建阅读会话、改动书库。

description.en: Adds model speed tests to the DSH model picker and, on desktop, a plain-language "explain this error" button on failed turns with a user-selectable explainer model.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型选择器里加一键测速，并在桌面端对话报错处提供「大白话解释」按钮，解释模型可自选。

description.en: Adds a plugin market entry button to the left sidebar that opens the installed market in a main panel.
description.zh: 在左侧栏添加插件市场入口按钮，点击后在主面板打开已安装的插件市场。

description.en: Video workbench for DeepSeek Harness that parses a link, downloads the source, transcribes it, trims or merges clips and exports GIFs. Requires ffmpeg/ffprobe and yt-dlp; whisper.cpp plus a model is optional for videos without subtitles.
description.zh: 视频工作台：贴链接解析并下载、转写文案、截取拼接片段、按目标体积导出 GIF。需自备 ffmpeg/ffprobe 与 yt-dlp；无字幕视频的本地转写另需 whisper.cpp 与模型（可选）。

description.en: A personal life workbench as a sidebar panel: sleep, meals, workouts, spending, weight, schedule and to-dos share one page of cards that react to one another, and one sentence typed at the top is turned into structured records by the model configured in DSH. Records and card layout stay in local browser storage.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的个人生活工作台：睡眠、饮食、运动、花销、体重、日程和待办放在同一页卡片上，彼此联动；在顶部说一句话，DSH 里配好的模型把它拆成结构化记录。记录与卡片版式只保存在本机浏览器存储里。

description.en: Pins the conversation column of the dsh UI to a fixed width — a pixel value or a percentage of the column — from a row in General settings, and hides the built-in drag handles so the width stays put.
description.zh: 把 dsh 界面的对话框固定为像素宽度或列宽百分比，设置项在「通用」设置页；锁定后隐藏内置拖动手柄，宽度不再被误拖。

description.en: Whole-window opacity for the DSH desktop window from one button at the sidebar foot: a 0-90% slider whose value is remembered between runs. It only sets the window alpha - no restyling, no extra panels, and no other feature is touched. Windows only.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部一个按钮，点开是 0-90% 的滑块，用来调整整个 DSH 窗口的透明度，数值自动记住。只设置窗口 alpha，不改样式、不加面板、不影响其它功能。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Drag or paste any local file onto the DSH page; it resolves the real absolute path (Spotlight + size/mtime + head/tail fingerprint match) and inserts it into the composer, with a content-cache fallback.
description.zh: 把本机任意文件拖拽或粘贴到 DSH 页面，静默反查真实绝对路径并插入输入框（Spotlight + 大小/时间 + 首尾指纹校验），未找到时内容缓存兜底。

description.en: Hierarchical session tree for the sidebar - native subagent trees plus an optional organization-derived hierarchy, with collapsed branch counters and orphan/cycle defense.
description.zh: 侧栏会话树 - 原生子代理树,外加可选的组织汇报层级;折叠分支计数,孤儿/环路防御。

description.en: Select text anywhere in DeepSeek Harness, click the quote pill next to the pointer, and the selection lands in the composer as a small quote chip; hover the chip to read the full quote.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里选中文字，点鼠标旁的「引用」胶囊，选区就变成输入框里的迷你引用条；悬停引用条可看被引用全文。

description.en: Full-screen boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: a wave sweeps the screen, a whale assembles from particles inside three breathing dot rings, and a four-language salute lands over a segmented progress bar; ships an 18-second cut and 3.8-4.5-second short cuts, a language picker in settings, and a four-language preview queue.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 开机动画：水波扫过、粒子聚成鲸鱼、三层呼吸点阵圆环与四语问候落在分段进度条上；含 18 秒完整版与 3.8-4.5 秒简版、设置页语言选择与四语连播预览。

description.en: Steam Big Picture-style six-second Canvas startup animation for DSH Desktop with a variable-width terminal-to-whale transition, optional stereo startup audio, volume controls, preview, Escape skip, and reduced-motion support.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端加入 Steam 大屏幕风格的 6 秒 Canvas 开屏，粗细渐变的终端标志变为 DeepSeek 鲸鱼，支持可选双声道音效、音量设置、预览、Esc 跳过及减少动态效果。

description.en: Groups the composer model picker by provider, labels the native model button with the owning provider, and links each provider row to Settings → Models.
description.zh: 按供应商分组输入框的模型选择器，在原生模型按钮上标出所选模型归属的供应商，并为每个供应商行提供直达「设置 → 模型」的入口。

description.en: Lazy Menu for DSH — hide the duplicate DeepSeek account / official API entries in the model picker, in Settings → Models and in the subagent model list, plus sidebar and account-menu items (14 toggles); auto-fill reasoning levels (low / medium / high / max), context window and image input for new models; on DSH Desktop, add Reload / Restart to the application menu with a one-click patch to the app shell main.js (backup and one-click restore included; needs an app restart, and a DSH update reverts the patch).
description.zh: 懒人菜单：收起模型选择框、设置·模型、子智能体里重复的 DeepSeek 账号 / 官方 API 分组，隐藏侧边栏五项与账号菜单三项（共 14 个开关）；给新模型自动补推理等级（low / medium / high / max）、上下文窗口与图片支持；桌面版可一键给应用外壳 main.js 打补丁，把刷新与重启加进应用菜单（写入前自动备份、可一键还原；需重启应用，DSH 升级后补丁会失效）。

description.en: Chinese summaries for the dsh-skill-mcp-panel skill cards: each expanded card gets a short Chinese overview, a category tag and a few bullet points, while the English description the panel already renders is folded behind a "原文" toggle. Skills missing from the bundled map are translated on demand by the host with your current default model and cached on disk, keyed by a hash of the original text, so a new skill needs no manual entry. Skills whose own description is already Chinese are skipped.
description.zh: 给 dsh-skill-mcp-panel 的技能卡片加中文说明：展开卡片时显示一句话中文速览、分类标签和几条要点，面板原本渲染的英文描述折进「原文」按钮。手写映射表里没有的英文技能，由宿主用你当前的默认模型按需现场生成并落盘缓存，缓存按原文哈希失效，所以新装的技能不用再手工补条目。技能自带描述已是中文的自动跳过。

description.en: Scene-independent floating icon grid container for DSH plugins, with drag-and-drop sorting, theming, and persistence.
description.zh: 场景无关的 DSH 插件浮动图标网格容器，支持拖拽排序、主题适配与持久化。

description.en: Yandex Music inside the DSH sidebar: search, a draggable queue with repeat and shuffle, playlists with drag-and-drop editing, 700 My Wave stations plus a wave by any artist, karaoke lyrics with real timecodes and a Russian translation, volume, media keys, and playback that resumes where it stopped after a restart. Requires a Yandex account and a Plus subscription.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏里使用 Яндекс.Музыка：搜索、可拖拽并可循环与随机播放的队列、支持拖拽编辑的播放列表、700 个「我的波」电台以及任意歌手的波、带真实时间轴与俄语翻译的卡拉 OK 歌词、音量、媒体按键，以及重启后从上次位置继续播放。需要 Яндекс 账号与 Plus 订阅。

description.en: A fork of dsh-boot-animation that plays an intro clip when DSH opens, ships four embedded clips with an in-app library, and adds batch deletion for clips you added yourself. It reuses the same plugin id as upstream, so the two cannot be installed together.
description.zh: dsh-boot-animation 的社区分支：打开 DSH 时播放片头动画，内置四段片头并可管理片库，新增片库批量删除（同步删除自己加入的视频文件）。沿用上游同一插件 id，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Feishu multi-agent robot console: start, stop and reconnect the daemon, view status and recent activity, and jump to the task workspace.
description.zh: 飞书多助手机器人控制台：开启/关闭/重连守护进程、状态与最近动态、直达任务工作区。

description.en: Codex-style composer model picker: a card showing the current model and a draggable slider that sets reasoning effort, with one stop per level the model advertises and an Off stop when the provider supports it. The slider snaps only to whole stops and updates the effort label while dragging; selecting a model or effort still goes through the session model directory, so it stays in sync with the rest of the composer.
description.zh: Codex 风格的输入框模型选择器：卡片显示当前模型，底部用可拖动的滑杆设置推理强度，每个档位都对应模型真实声明的推理等级（提供商支持时有 Off 档）。滑杆只停在整档上，拖动过程中推理强度文字即时更新；模型与档位的切换仍走会话的模型目录，与输入框其他部分保持同步。

description.en: Full-page NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH: daily recommendations, playlist browsing by category, charts, new releases, search, playlist/album/artist pages, QR-code login, synced lyrics, queue and downloads, plus four agent tools for search, song URLs, lyrics and playlist tracks.
description.zh: 整页式网易云音乐播放器：每日推荐、按分类浏览歌单广场、排行榜、新碟上架、搜索、歌单/专辑/歌手页、扫码登录、逐行歌词、队列与下载，并提供搜索、歌曲直链、歌词、歌单曲目四个 agent 工具。

description.en: Puts a key badge in the bottom-right corner of the dsh Web GUI that shows the port this instance is listening on and the remote-access token printed by dsh web at startup, with a copy button per value; clicking the badge rotates the key into a cross, and clicking it again or anywhere beside it collapses the panel.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web 界面右下角放一个钥匙徽标，点开显示本实例的监听端口和 dsh web 启动时打印的远程访问令牌，每项都可一键复制；钥匙图标旋转成叉号，再点一次或点旁边空白即可收起。

description.en: Windows Electron companion sharing the DSH Web profile, conversations and plugins, with startup logs, update recovery and diagnostics.
description.zh: 共用 DSH Web 配置、对话与插件的 Windows Electron 客户端，提供启动日志、更新恢复与诊断。

description.en: Composer enhancements: caches unsent drafts per workspace for new sessions and per Session id for existing ones, restoring them after switching away and dropping them once sent or cleared; adds an @plugin completion group that mentions an installed plugin so the agent receives that plugin's metadata as runtime context for the turn.
description.zh: 输入框增强：按工作区缓存新会话草稿、按会话缓存已有会话草稿，切换后自动恢复，发送或清空后不再回填；同时在 @ 补全中增加“插件”分组，选中已安装插件后会把该插件信息作为运行时上下文交给 Agent。

description.en: Auto-fold context/system messages in DSH conversation — collapse think blocks, tool calls, and tool results into grouped expandable bars.
description.zh: 自动折叠 DSH 对话中的系统/上下文消息——将思考块、工具调用和工具结果合并为可展开的分组折叠条。

description.en: Left-sidebar panel that browses the filesystem of the machine the Harness runs on: directory listings with sizes and modification times, a summary of the open folder (files, folders, total size, largest file types), text and image previews, file downloads, file uploads by file picker or drag and drop, folder creation, and exporting a listing as CSV or JSON. The panel speaks twelve languages. Reads and writes run with the privileges of the account that runs the Harness.
description.zh: 左侧边栏面板，浏览运行 Harness 的宿主机文件系统：带大小与修改时间的目录列表、当前目录摘要（文件数、文件夹数、总大小、占用最多的文件类型）、文本与图片预览、文件下载、以选择文件或拖拽方式上传文件、新建文件夹，以及把目录列表导出为 CSV 或 JSON。面板支持十二种语言。读写操作使用运行 Harness 的账户权限。

description.en: Customize DeepSeek Harness branding — swap the sidebar and hero logos, rebuild the DeepSeek and Harness wordmark halves, edit the welcome headline, and toggle the preview badge.
description.zh: 替换 DeepSeek Harness 界面各处品牌元素——侧栏 Logo、品牌字标两半、对话页 Logo、欢迎语标语，预览版徽章开关。纯前端注入，不修改安装文件。

description.en: A pale rose-and-gold Mushoku Tensei skin for the DSH web GUI: an arcane sigil and two full-body Eris figures behind the conversation, a young Eris standee and gilt plugin glyphs in the sidebar, and its own settings card.
description.zh: 《无职转生》艾莉丝主题皮肤：淡绯金配色与魔法阵纹章，对话区铺魔法大陆场景与两幅全身立绘，侧栏立幼年艾莉丝立牌并重绘图标，自带设置面板。

description.en: Web UI for capturing and reviewing raw LLM requests, streamed responses, token usage and tool calls.
description.zh: 用于捕获和查看原始 LLM 请求、流式响应、Token 用量和工具调用的 Web 界面。

description.en: Remembers the DSH desktop window position, size, and maximized state on Windows, and restores them on the next launch.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上记住 DSH 桌面窗口的位置、尺寸与最大化状态，下次启动时自动恢复。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar workspace Files pane with a file manager that adds real composer chips for "@" file mentions, word and line selection across syntax highlighting, archives in and out, upload and download, and a jump menu to any directory on the machine.
description.zh: 把侧边栏「工作区文件」面板换成文件管理器：加入对话时生成与输入框 @ 选文件一致的 chip，语法高亮下可双击选词、三击选行，支持压缩解压、上传下载，并可跳转到机器上任意目录。

description.en: Whole-interface zoom from 75% to 200% in 5% steps via a Settings row, a session-header stepper or Ctrl/⌘+wheel, with a shim that converts rects, viewport units, media queries and pointer coordinates so fixed overlays stay anchored to their triggers.
description.zh: DSH 整体界面缩放（75%–200%，5% 一档）：设置行、会话头部步进器、Ctrl/⌘+滚轮三种入口；内置 shim 换算 rect、视口单位、媒体查询与指针坐标，使 position: fixed 浮层始终贴住触发元素。

description.en: Windows companion window for DSH Desktop: todos, reminders, live session messages, approval handling and quick input. The standalone window reuses the Electron binary at %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\electron\electron.exe (usually installed by dsh-pet) and fails to open when it is missing.
description.zh: Windows 下的 DSH Desktop 独立伴生窗：待办、提醒、实时会话消息、审批接管和快速输入；独立窗复用 %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\electron\electron.exe（通常由 dsh-pet 下载），缺失时打不开。

description.en: Sidebar layout fix for the DSH Web UI: caps and scrolls the plugin-action area, shrinks the inline pairing QR code and tightens the brand row, so the workspace and session list stays clickable when footer plugins grow tall.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏布局修正：给插件动作区限高并允许滚动、缩小内联配对二维码、收紧品牌行——底部插件变高时，工作区与会话列表依然点得到。

description.en: Adds an optimize-prompt button to the left of the composer's send button; it rewrites the draft with the session's own model route and writes the result back through the normal editor path, so a single undo restores the original.
description.zh: 在输入框发送按钮左侧添加「优化提示词」按钮，用当前会话的模型路由改写草稿并通过编辑器原有路径原地回填，一次撤销即可还原原文。

description.en: Lets the AI insert streaming-generated UI into the conversation or a side panel, written in TSX — already one of the model's native languages, so there is no JSON schema to teach it. Rendered without flicker, state kept across frames with no hard remount, and a click in the card driving the next chat turn. Inline is where streaming matters most; the side Canvas is the more agentic shape. Cards get agentic capabilities of their own — run bash, curl, call the model, read and write files.
description.zh: 让 AI 在对话中或侧边栏里插入流式生成的 UI，以 TSX 书写——模型的母语之一，不必再教它一套 JSON schema。流式渲染不闪烁，状态跨帧保留、无硬刷新，对 UI 的点击直接驱动下一轮对话。inline 形态流式最重要，side canvas 形态更 agentic。卡片内部同样具备 agentic 能力——执行 bash、curl、调用模型、读写文件。

description.en: Transforms DSH into a dual-column Codex workspace with an integrated Activity Bar, unified topbar, avatar quick access, session history navigation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造Codex 双列活动栏与顶栏一体化视觉体验，支持水晶头像与会话历史导航。

description.en: Folds a user message whose body renders taller than 360px in the Web chat down to 360px with a fading bottom edge and an Expand/Collapse toggle. Short messages keep their exact original look, and the expanded state is remembered per message while the page stays open.
description.zh: 把 Web 对话里正文高度超过 360px 的用户消息折成 360px、底部渐隐，并给一个「展开全文 / 收起」按钮；短消息外观完全不变，展开状态在页面存活期间按消息记住。

description.en: Adds a low-key companion panel with a pomodoro timer, a todo list, drink-water and stand-up reminders, plus lesson explanations and homework tutoring through the installed desktop pet.
description.zh: 给桌宠加一个不惹眼的陪伴面板：番茄钟、待办清单、喝水/久坐提醒，以及借桌宠模型通道的课程讲解与作业辅导。

description.en: Conversation question index for the DSH Web UI: every question you asked in a session, searchable, paginated, with one-click jump to the exact message.
description.zh: DSH 对话问题索引：列出会话中你提过的所有问题，支持搜索、分页与一键定位。

description.en: Small DeepSeek Harness affordances for everyday actions — locate the current session from the sidebar header (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+D), copy a session ID from the session row menu (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C), open links in the system default program including localhost, open or copy inline code from a context menu, open changed-file cards with a local IDE or reveal them in the file manager, swap Enter with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, recall sent messages with Up/Down, and show the current workspace name inside the header open button; every one of them has its own switch in a Flow settings page.
description.zh: DSH 的一组小改动，把日常动作改回直觉——侧栏标题行的定位当前会话按钮（⇧⌘D）、会话行菜单里的复制会话 ID（⇧⌘C）、链接交给系统默认程序打开（含 localhost）、行内代码的打开或复制右键菜单、改动文件卡片用本机 IDE 打开或在文件管理器中显示、Enter 与 ⌘/Ctrl+Enter 对调、↑↓ 回填发过的消息，以及把当前工作区名写进标题行「打开」按钮；每一项在设置的「心流」页各有一个开关。

description.en: Adds a Teams sidebar dashboard that lists every Agent Teams chat with its roster and task roadmap, token spend in USD and RUB, work and online time, and an archive of older teams. Requires the Agent Teams plugin.
description.zh: 在侧边栏加一个「团队」面板，列出每个 Agent Teams 会话的成员与任务路线图、按时间段统计的 token 消耗与美元/卢布成本、总工时与在线时长，并可归档旧团队。需先安装 Agent Teams 插件。

description.en: Renders installed DSH plugin titles and descriptions in Simplified Chinese: at startup it translates the plugins the local JSON cache lacks through the harness LLM service, then projects { en, zh } metadata for resolveText() to render — no DOM changes, no third-party API.
description.zh: 把已安装插件的显示名与描述变成简体中文：启动时用 DSH 自带的模型服务翻译缓存尚未收录的插件，再投影 { en, zh } 元数据供 resolveText() 渲染——不改 DOM，也不调用第三方 API。

description.en: Visualizes Finesse 3 KatScript in the conversation and adds a drag-and-drop optical bench designer that generates the Finesse model. It scans every user and assistant message for KatScript or a Finesse Python cell and renders them in the background with the first Python interpreter that can import finesse (Finesse 3, NumPy and Matplotlib required; interpreter overridable with FINESSE_VIZ_PYTHON), keeping the code and figures under ~/.dsh/finesse-vis.
description.zh: 在对话中自动把 Finesse 3 KatScript 渲染成光学构型图，并提供拖拽式光学设计器实时生成对应的 Finesse 模型。它会扫描每条用户和助手消息里的 KatScript 或 Finesse Python 单元，在后台用第一个能 import finesse 的 Python 解释器渲染（需要 Finesse 3、NumPy 和 Matplotlib，可用 FINESSE_VIZ_PYTHON 指定解释器），代码和图存在 ~/.dsh/finesse-vis。

description.en: All-in-one UI enhancement layer for DeepSeek Harness web: prompt library with quick-insert and management, two-step AI polish, predicted-reply dock with click-to-send, MCP tool management, scheduled automation, smart session titles, adjustable chat width, full-width AI messages without gray background, auto-collapse for long user messages with smooth expand/collapse animations, and scene-specific entrance animations across all plugin surfaces.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 一站式界面增强：提示词库（快选+管理）、两步 AI 润色、预测回复栏（点击直接发送）、MCP 工具管理、定时自动化、智能会话标题、对话宽度可调、AI 回复占满无灰底、超长用户消息自动折叠（带平滑展开/收起动效），以及各面板的场景化入场动效。

description.en: Shows the current conversation's working directory in a draggable directory panel with adjustable opacity.
description.zh: 在可拖动、透明度可调的目录面板中显示当前对话的工作目录与文件列表。

description.en: WeChat-style in-app screenshot button: drag a region, fine-tune with 8 resize handles, Enter to capture and Esc to cancel; auto-numbered PNGs plus a \[Shot N HH:mm] marker written into the composer. Windows-only, tested on DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
description.zh: 微信式界面内截屏按钮：拖动框选、8 个手柄微调，Enter 确认截取、Esc 取消；PNG 自动编号保存，\[Shot N HH:mm] 标记自动写入输入框。仅 Windows，已在 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 实测。

description.en: Right-click menu for file links in chat: open with registered apps, save as, copy path or content, reveal in Finder or Explorer.
description.zh: 聊天区文件超链接右键上下文菜单增强：在常用应用中打开、打开方式、另存为、复制路径与内容、在资源管理器/Finder 中显示。

description.en: A status bar in the composer footer showing the current phase, how long it has been running, the current step token count and a no-progress warning, projected from session logs without polling the host, plus a detail panel that opens on click.
description.zh: 在输入框底栏显示当前阶段、阶段已耗时、本步 token 数与无进展告警的状态条（纯日志投影，不轮询宿主），点击可展开详情面板。

description.en: Send by dragging instead of clicking. Press the composer and pull up to arm the gesture; releasing sends, dragging back into the composer cancels, and dragging outside the conversation area cancels on the spot. Mouse and pen only.
description.zh: 用拖拽代替点击发送。按住输入框向上拉即武装：松手发送，拖回输入框取消，拖出对话区当场取消。仅响应鼠标与笔。

description.en: Button beside the composer that rewrites the current draft into a more executable prompt in place. Ships four built-in presets spanning light polish to aggressive expansion, accepts user-defined presets, and switches preset, prompt model and reasoning effort directly from the button without leaving the composer. The button appears only when the draft has content, shows a running timer while enhancing, and surfaces failures with a retry.
description.zh: 输入框旁的按钮：把当前草稿原地改写成更可执行的提示词。内置四档预设，从轻润色到激进扩写，并支持自定义预设；预设、提示词模型与思考强度都能直接在按钮上切换，不用离开输入框。草稿有内容时按钮才出现，增强期间在按钮上计时，失败会显示原因并可重试。

description.en: A-share holdings contribution card for DeepSeek Harness: today's P&L and portfolio return next to the Shanghai Composite, the top five contributors by P&L with each stock's strength versus the index in pp, and a 15:00 close-summary PNG export with the contributor list, intraday chart and a numbers-only summary. Holdings come from a local holdings.csv/holdings.json and quotes from the public Tencent market-data API; the plugin never reads cookies or broker credentials. Requires DSH 0.2.x; the card and the export are covered by a test suite that runs in CI.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 A 股持仓贡献卡：今日盈亏与组合涨跌幅和上证指数并排，按金额列出贡献前五并标出个股相对上证的强弱（pp），15:00 后可一键导出含贡献榜、上证分时图与只陈述数字的自动摘要的收盘小结 PNG。持仓读本地 holdings.csv/holdings.json，行情取自腾讯公开行情接口，不读 Cookie、不碰券商凭据。要求 DSH 0.2.x；浮卡与导出都有 CI 跑的测试覆盖。

description.en: A small pet in the corner of the interface that reads the real event stream instead of guessing: it drifts when idle, speeds up while the agent is thinking, draws a flowing line per running tool call, turns red and shakes with the error summary on a failure, and celebrates a turn that ran longer than ten seconds. The same widget is the at-a-glance busy and error indicator, so there is no spinner to stare at. The host half folds real harness events into a snapshot and the client half only draws it; it performs no content recognition, and it positions itself away from the composer so it never sits over what you are typing.
description.zh: 界面角落里的一只小宠物，读的是真实事件流而不是猜：空闲时慢慢飘，agent 思考时动得更快，每个正在运行的工具调用拉一条流动的连线，出错时变红、抖一下并显示错误摘要，跑超过十秒的回合结束时庆祝。它同时就是那个一眼可见的忙碌/出错指示器，不用再盯着转圈。宿主半区把真实 harness 事件折叠成快照，客户端半区只负责画；它不做内容识别，并且会主动避开输入框，不会趴在你正在打字的地方。

description.en: Left-edge conversation rail for the Web UI: one bar per turn, length scaled to the turn text, hover for a question and answer preview, click to jump; bars come from a host-side outline of the whole session log, so turns outside the loaded window are drawn too and history is paged in on click.
description.zh: 对话左缘的导航轨：一根杠一轮对话，杠长按该轮文字体量，悬停出提问与回答预览，点击跳转；杠来自 host 侧读整份会话日志折出的大纲，未加载进窗口的轮次也画得出来，点击时再翻页补历史。

description.en: Custom main-screen headline: replaces the new-session headline with a rotating pool of custom text; plus an independently switchable composer border marquee with glow, band speed, brightness, width, breathing, per-view scope and a focus-only mode in Settings.
description.zh: 主界面标语自定义：把新会话页的标语换成一组自定义文本按时轮换；另含可独立开关的输入框边框跑马灯，色带沿边缘流动、外圈带辉光，速度、亮度、宽度、呼吸、生效范围与仅聚焦可在设置中调节。

description.en: Adds a Restart row to the desktop app's sidebar foot beside Settings that restarts the app and reloads the page onto the newly installed plugin bundle.
description.zh: 在桌面版侧边栏底部、「设置」旁边新增一个「重启」按钮，重启应用，并在页面重连后加载到刚安装的插件包。

description.en: Adds a Windows Explorer folder context-menu entry that registers the folder as a DSH project, with a switch for the menu entry in Settings → General. Windows only, and nothing extra has to be installed.
description.zh: 在 Windows 资源管理器文件夹右键菜单中加入「用 DeepSeek Harness 打开」，点击后把该文件夹登记为 DSH 项目；设置 → 通用 里有一个开关用于添加或移除该菜单项。仅支持 Windows，无需额外安装任何组件。

description.en: Sidebar chip showing the current DeepSeek price period (peak or off-peak), the selected model's price per million tokens for cache hits, cache misses and output, the account balance and today's spend.
description.zh: 侧边栏价格小挂件：显示当前 DeepSeek 时段（高峰或空闲）、所选模型每百万 token 的缓存命中、未命中与输出价格，以及账户余额和今日消费。

description.en: Splits the composer model seat into a model chip and a reasoning-effort chip: the effort chip opens a draggable, wheel-adjustable slider, and the panel behind it animates 36 canvas effects across 12 categories.
description.zh: 把输入框的模型档位拆成模型胶囊和思考强度胶囊：强度胶囊打开可拖动、可滚轮调整的滑条，面板里跑 36 个 Canvas 动效、分 12 个大类。

description.en: A floating panel that lights up which HowNet semantic primitives the current answer touches, as a brain-shaped node graph, EEG-style channel traces and a composition card.
description.zh: 悬浮面板：把当前这段回答点亮了哪些 HowNet 语义基元实时画出来——脑形节点网络、脑电样式的多导联曲线、构成指纹卡。

description.en: A Claude Desktop-inspired composer slider for adjusting model reasoning effort with click, drag, or keyboard controls.
description.zh: 借鉴 Claude Desktop 的思考强度滑块，在输入框中通过点击、拖拽或键盘调整模型推理档位。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar brand mark with a custom one and registers a Vietnamese locale covering 45 namespaces and 1897 interface strings, falling back to English for anything untranslated.
description.zh: 用自定义图标替换侧边栏品牌标识，并注册一套越南语语言包，覆盖 45 个命名空间、1897 条界面文案，未翻译处回退英文。

description.en: A sticky-notes wall pinned to the sidebar: one click opens a full-page wall, notes save as you type, and writing #tags in the text turns them into one-click filter chips. Six paper colors, pinning, search, JSON export and import.
description.zh: 钉在侧栏的便签墙：一键打开整页墙面，边写边自动保存，正文里写 #标签 就会变成可点击的筛选胶囊。六种纸色、置顶、搜索，支持 JSON 导出与导入。

description.en: Folds the durable todo and goal events the dsh pet ignores into a percentage bubble on the pet, and falls back to a one-line activity summary for a session that never wrote a todo list. Requires the dsh web pet plugin (@linxin666/dsh-pet >= 0.4.0).
description.zh: 把 dsh 宠物忽略的 todo 与 goal 事件折成宠物气泡上的百分比进度；会话没有任务列表时退化为一行当前活动摘要。需先安装 dsh web pet 插件（@linxin666/dsh-pet >= 0.4.0）。

description.en: Article Review page in DSH's native right sidebar: turns Markdown, Word, PowerPoint and PDF articles into sentence-addressable text, lets you comment on any sentence, and hands the open review to the agent as a composer draft. Six agent tools let the model read every comment, revise the article (in place for Markdown, as a sibling <name>.revised.md for binary formats), resolve the comments, and record recurring wording preferences into a long-term writing-style memory injected into later prompts. Extraction includes a dependency-free DOCX/PPTX reader; PDF text extraction runs locally through the host's Python + pypdf (or poppler's pdftotext) and is unavailable without one of them. No network calls, no telemetry.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生右侧栏做逐句文稿批注：把 Markdown、Word、PowerPoint、PDF 变成可按句点选的文本，给任意一句写意见，并把待处理批注作为草稿交给 Agent。6 个 Agent 工具让模型读取每条意见、改稿（Markdown 直接改原文件，二进制格式写同名 .revised.md）、勾销批注，并把反复出现的表达偏好记入长期写作风格记忆、注入之后的提示。DOCX/PPTX 为零依赖解析；PDF 文本提取在本机走宿主 Python + pypdf（或 poppler 的 pdftotext），两者都没有时 PDF 不可用。不联网、无遥测。

description.en: A floating in-conversation find bar docked over the DSH composer (Ctrl/⌘+F or the magnifier beside the input): hits list with a match counter as you type, Enter jumps to the next hit, hovering a hit pops a scrollable full-text card with a one-click copy of the whole message, the up arrow in an empty composer recalls previously sent messages one at a time with their image and file attachments restored as drafts, hovering any image in the conversation shows a copy button that writes it to the clipboard as PNG, and every finished answer gains a regenerate button while the newest also gets continue. Client-side only, searches the messages already loaded in the conversation, and never jumps.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框上方加一条浮动的会话内查找（Ctrl/⌘+F 或输入框左侧放大镜打开）：输入即列命中并显示计数，回车跳到下一处，悬浮结果在面板侧边浮出可滚动的全文卡片，一键复制整条消息；空输入框按 ↑ 逐条取回发过的消息，图片与文件附件一并还原成草稿；悬浮对话里的任意图片出现【复制图片】，一键以 PNG 写入剪贴板；每条完成的回答下方补上【重新生成】，最新一条另有【继续生成】。纯客户端实现，只搜当前会话已加载的消息，不做跳转。

description.en: Docks the workspace and session list to the left, right, top or bottom edge, optionally folding it into a 5px edge band that expands on hover, with the reveal zone and the left rail width adjustable in Settings → General; the plugin rail, brand row and settings button stay where they are.
description.zh: 把工作区与会话记录列表停靠到左、右、上、下任意一边，可收成 5px 贴边细条、鼠标靠近再展开，触发范围与左栏宽度都能在设置里的通用项中调整；插件图标条、品牌行和底部设置钮留在原位。

description.en: Marks models in use by other running sessions in the DSH model menu, and restores the remembered reasoning effort and group collapse state for each model.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的模型菜单看见会话占用、记住模型推理档位与折叠状态。

description.en: A cosmic reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness composer. Off, Low, High, and Max each have their own starfield and aurora, with smooth cross-fades and real per-session model selection.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 输入框的推理强度滑轨做成一片小宇宙。Off、Low、High、Max 各有专属星场与极光，档位之间平滑过渡，并绑定真实的当前会话模型选择。

description.en: Infinite-canvas mind map in the sidebar: grow nodes with Tab, tidy a branch into a tree, ask the assistant to expand a node into child ideas, and export to Markdown, OPML, FreeMind, JSON or PNG.
description.zh: 侧栏里的无限画布脑图：Tab 长出节点、一键把分支整理成树、让助手把一个节点发散成子想法，可导出 Markdown / OPML / FreeMind / JSON / PNG。

description.en: Right-click a dash in the conversation's right-edge turn rail to bookmark that turn: the dash grows to the rail's full width and takes the accent colour so it stays easy to find, and right-clicking again unbookmarks it. Bookmarks are scoped per conversation, keyed by the selected Session id, and persisted so they survive reloads. No layout shift - the rail keeps its fixed pitch.
description.zh: 在对话右侧轮次导航条上右键收藏某一轮：该短横线变为导航条满宽并换成强调色，便于之后一眼找到，再次右键取消。收藏按对话隔离（取当前选中会话 id）并持久保存，刷新后仍在；不引起布局跳动，导航条保持固定间距。

description.en: Read-only unread-mail board for the accounts configured in dsh-email — unread messages appear as per-account cards in the DSH right sidebar (sender, subject, time) and refresh on demand.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 未读邮件看板——把 dsh-email 里配置的各账号未读邮件按账号列成右侧栏卡片（发件人、主题、时间），按需手动刷新。
