description.en: Adds a composer control that turns a plain-language draft into a structured, terminology-precise prompt, shows the professional term behind selected colloquial phrases with a one-line explanation, and offers a terms-only mode that returns professional terminology without rewriting the draft.
description.zh: 在输入框工具行增加「译」按钮：把口语草稿改写成结构清晰、术语准确的专业提示词，并把其中若干口语表达对照成专业术语、各附一句解释；「只查术语」模式只返回专业说法，不改写草稿。

description.en: A collapsible Recent tasks folder at the top of the sidebar above 工作区: the most recently updated sessions, pinning that ignores recency, running-state spinners, and a per-row menu with rename, fork and archive.
description.zh: 侧边栏「工作区」上方多一个可折叠的「最近任务」文件夹：最近更新的会话一目了然，可置顶常用会话（不参与时间排序），运行中的任务带转圈标记，行内菜单支持重命名、在新会话里接着聊与归档。

description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness desktop app icon (exe, tray and Start Menu) with any uploaded .ico, and restores the stock icon on demand.
description.zh: 更换 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端应用图标（exe、托盘、开始菜单），支持上传任意 .ico，并可随时还原官方默认图标。

description.en: Declares a UI layout contract, measures pages in headless Chrome or Godot scenes and declared layouts, and audits overlap, occlusion, overflow, clipped text, undersized targets, dead controls, spacing drift and z-order traps, with a breakpoint matrix and a sidebar panel. Page measurement needs Chrome, Edge or Chromium and the puppeteer-core package installed where the DSH profile can resolve it; Godot scenes and declared layouts need neither.
description.zh: 为 UI 开发声明布局契约，在无头 Chrome、Godot 场景或声明式布局中测量，并审计重叠、遮挡、溢出、文字截断、过小目标、死交互、间距漂移与层级倒置，附断点矩阵与侧边栏面板。页面测量需要 Chrome、Edge 或 Chromium，并要求 DSH profile 能解析到 puppeteer-core；Godot 场景与声明式布局都不需要。

description.en: Adds a Restart application section to the desktop app Settings; quits gracefully and relaunches the whole application.
description.zh: 在桌面应用设置中新增「应用重启」区块，优雅退出并自动重启整个应用。

description.en: Live network inspection dashboard in the sidebar: interfaces with IP/MAC, traffic rates, TCP/UDP session counts and latency curves, refreshed every 3 seconds. macOS only (the collectors run ifconfig, netstat, scutil and /sbin/ping).
description.zh: 侧边栏实时网络巡检看板：接口与 IP/MAC、流量速率、TCP/UDP 会话数、延迟曲线，每 3 秒刷新。仅限 macOS（采集依赖 ifconfig、netstat、scutil 与 /sbin/ping）。

description.en: Persistent agent-preset (mode) selector docked in the composer input bar: switch the mode for new tasks, and set the new-task default from any running session.
description.zh: 对话框常驻的 Agent 预设（模式）选择条：新任务直接切换模式，运行中的会话可一键设为新任务默认。

description.en: Context ring gauge in the DSH composer toolbar: view usage, open a breakdown panel, and run /compact from the panel, with a fireworks animation.
description.zh: DSH 输入框工具栏的上下文小环：查看用量，打开面板查看构成并执行 /compact，带烟花动画。

description.en: Adds a Home panel to the sidebar for choosing a workspace; focus mode then shows only that workspace's sessions and folds the other workspaces below, and exiting focus restores the shipped sidebar.
description.zh: 在侧栏新增「主页」面板用于选择工作区；进入专注后侧栏只显示该工作区的会话，其他工作区折叠在底部，退出专注即恢复原生侧栏。

description.en: Makes the DSH Settings dialog resizable from its edges and corners and movable by its top strip, remembering the chosen size across opens.
description.zh: 让 DSH 设置弹窗可拖动边和角改变大小、按住顶部横带移动位置，并记住尺寸。

description.en: Adds a Windows-only button at the foot of the sidebar that restarts the DSH desktop app and reloads the page when it comes back.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部加一个按钮（仅 Windows），一键重启 DSH 桌面应用，应用回来后页面自动恢复。

description.en: Control the Web UI left sidebar width: lower the 264px drag minimum and optionally tune the drag maximum and the expanded default width, applied by a startup patch of the ui-layout bundle.
description.zh: 调整 Web UI 左侧会话列表栏宽度：调低 264px 拖动下限，可选调整拖动上限与展开默认宽度，启动时自动修补 ui-layout bundle。

description.en: WeChat-style screenshot and annotation for the DSH composer, with a system-wide hotkey that captures without raising the DSH window. Windows only; on first use it compiles its helper executables from bundled C# source with the built-in csc.exe.
description.zh: 微信式截图标注，直接插进 DSH 输入框；系统级热键截图时不会把 DSH 弹到前台。仅支持 Windows；首次使用时用系统自带的 csc.exe 把随包的 C# 源码编译成辅助可执行文件。

description.en: Adds a Download PNG button next to the assistant message copy button in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 的助手消息复制按钮旁增加一个下载 PNG 按钮。

description.en: DailyBoard — a daily work task board for the DSH Web GUI with a one-month calendar of colored timeline bars and day tasks, a daily checklist, a seven-day week view with completion checkboxes and drag-to-reschedule, a draggable 24-hour day timeline, ordered per-day subtasks, weekly and every-N-days recurring tasks with per-occurrence result records, a long-term progress view opened from the calendar header, per-day completion for long-term tasks, tasks that can be marked “For others” by choosing one of the added recipients (shown as note + email), a collapsible daily email reminder that can be pushed to WeChat and can remind other people such as partners or relatives (each extra recipient has an email, a note and its own send time), and AI task extraction from natural language with smart date parsing: a single date such as “today” becomes a day task, “this week/month” starts from today unless the text says the work already happened, and pressing Enter in the input box extracts immediately.
description.zh: DailyBoard 是 DSH Web GUI 的日常工作任务板：单月日历（彩色时间条 + 当天任务）、日常清单、七天周视图（勾选完成、可拖动改期）与可拖拽的 24 小时时间轴，支持按天记录的有序子任务、按周几或每隔几天的周期任务及每次出现的结果记录、从日历标题栏打开的长期任务进展视图、长期任务按天完成标记、可从已添加的其他收件邮箱中选择（显示备注与邮箱）的「给他人」任务、可推到微信并提醒他人（如合作伙伴或亲属）的每日邮件提醒（每个其他收件邮箱可填备注和单独发送时间），以及能识别「今天/明天/周几/月日」并把单日任务正确归为当天任务、「本周/本月」默认从今天算起（提到已做/继续才整周整月）、输入框回车即可识别的 AI 自然语言提取。

description.en: Two split composer controls for output style: a tone switch with its own preset menu, and an output-form switch with its own preset menu; each session's system prompt follows the selections, with a preset settings page.
description.zh: 输出风格：输入框里两个分体控件（沟通基调、产出形态各带独立开关与预设菜单），按会话注入系统提示词，并带预设管理设置页。

description.en: Adds a sticky effort slider inside the composer model menu to select reasoning levels, with generic stops for custom models.
description.zh: 在输入框模型菜单底部固定推理强度滑块，无需进入子菜单即可切换思考档位，并为自定义模型自动补齐通用档位。

description.en: Rewrites the composer draft, or only the selected text, with one model call that uses the recent conversation as context, with cancel, revert, fidelity and length checks, and an optional preview.
description.zh: 用一次模型调用改写输入框草稿（或仅选中片段），参考最近对话，支持取消、回退、保真与长度校验，以及可选预览。

description.en: Reads EPUB, TXT, Markdown and HTML from the workspaces registered in dsh in a right-sidebar tab, restores the last reading position, and collapses the whole sidebar with Esc to return to the conversation. No runtime dependencies and no build step.
description.zh: 在右侧栏标签里读取 dsh 已注册工作区内的 EPUB、TXT、Markdown 与 HTML，记住上次阅读位置，并可用 Esc 一键收起整个右侧栏回到会话。零运行时依赖、无需构建。

description.en: One-click lock screen: a sidebar button covers the whole interface with the current Windows wallpaper, and two Esc presses unlock it.
description.zh: 一键锁屏：侧栏按钮用当前 Windows 桌面壁纸铺满并遮住整个界面，连按两次 Esc 解锁。

description.en: Select any passage in a DSH conversation to annotate it in place; the quoted text, the turn it came from and your comment are folded into the message on send, so the model can tell exactly what each remark refers to.
description.zh: 在对话里划选任意一段文字即可就地批注：原文高亮并带编号角标，发送时把原文、出处（谁说的、第几轮）和你的批注一起折进消息，模型能对上每一句指代。

description.en: Resize the Settings dialog and set its transparency from three sliders in General settings; the choice persists across restarts.
description.zh: 在「通用设置」里用三个滑动条调节设置弹窗的宽度、高度与透明度，重启后仍然保留。

description.en: Select a passage in a DSH conversation and read a plain-language explanation in a floating panel, which carries the surrounding message as the context. Three explanation depths (plain / general / pro) that re-explain on the spot when switched; optional web search and local file lookup (the model decides by default, and a button can force one lookup that reports only what is new); follow-up questions; and a button that hands the whole exchange to a new session in standby mode - the background is queued without waking the model or spending tokens. Settings live on the host in settings.json, and nothing is written until you press save. The repository also ships an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and a browser extension (source).
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里划词即得大白话解释，浮窗显示，并自动带上这段话所在的那条完整消息作为语境。三档讲解深度（小白 / 通识 / 专业），切换后当场重讲；可选联网搜索与本地文件查找（默认交给模型自己判断，也可一键强制查一次，查完只补充新内容而不复述）；可继续追问；还能把整段问答「待命式」交接给一个新会话——背景放好即止，不唤醒模型、不耗额度。设置保存在宿主侧 settings.json，不点保存不落盘。仓库内另含一个 OpenAI 兼容端点与一个浏览器扩展（源码）。

description.en: Composer suggestions for the DSH chat input: Up / Down step back and forth through every prompt sent in the current session — read from the session event log, so a message accepted from a prediction or sent by queueing counts too — Ctrl+Up opens a searchable history picker, and grey ghost text predicts the next message, accepted with the Right arrow. Every key only edits the draft; nothing is ever sent automatically.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的输入建议：↑ / ↓ 逐条回滚本会话发过的全部提问（读会话事件日志，采纳预测后发送、排队发送的也算），Ctrl+↑ 打开可搜索的历史面板，灰色幽灵文字预测下一句，→ 采纳。任何按键都只改草稿，不会自动发送。

description.en: Half Page (dsh-half-page) — a reading room kept for the agent: through reading_* tools it reads a book from ~/.dsh/reading one chapter at a time, writes notes beside chapters and keeps its own writing there, and a panel shows its reading progress. It adds lines to the system prompt telling the agent the room is its own and optional. Not a to-do list.
description.zh: 半页（dsh-half-page）：给智能体用的书房，它通过 reading_* 工具一章一章读 ~/.dsh/reading 里的书，在章节旁写读后感，也把自己写的东西放在这里，面板显示它的阅读进度。插件会往系统提示里加几行，告诉智能体这间书房归它自己、读不读随它。不是待办清单。

description.en: Splits the DSH chat window into two columns: your messages pinned in a clickable left rail and the model replies flowing on the right, with Enter-to-search across the conversation.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话窗口切成两列：我说的常驻左栏、可点击跳转，模型的话在右侧流动，并带回车触发的会话内搜索。

description.en: Fluid conversation width for the DSH web UI: the chat column follows the window minus a 64px margin, capped at 1560px and floored at 640px, while the built-in drag handles still override it.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的对话列自适应宽度：随窗口取「列宽 − 64px」，上限 1560px、下限 640px，内置拖拽把手仍然优先。

description.en: Weather plugin for the sidebar account row: a serif clock dial and a weather dial sit beside the account, a one-line weather strip sits below it, and both dials switch between circle and square, six dial themes, five fonts and local or network time; a weather tool and a full forecast panel (current conditions, 24-hour chart, 7-day outlook) share three forecast sources that fail over automatically.
description.zh: 侧栏账号旁常驻双表盘：衬线时钟盘加天气盘，账号下方一条天气横条；两枚表盘可在圆形/方形、六款表盘主题、五种字体、本机/网络时间之间切换，另有 weather 工具与完整预报面板（实况、24 小时图、7 天预报），预报源三级自动切换。

description.en: Read EPUB, PDF, DRM-free MOBI/AZW3 and TXT in the DSH sidebar. WeChat Read style typography with TOC, bookmarks, highlights and progress memory; select any passage to translate it into Chinese; the Ask-the-Book AI answers only from passages retrieved from the open book. Books and progress stay in local IndexedDB. Four themes including an eye-care green paper, and PDF paper follows the theme.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏阅读 EPUB、PDF、无 DRM 的 MOBI/AZW3 和 TXT。仿微信读书排版：目录、书签、划线、进度记忆，选中文本一键翻译成中文，AI 问书只依据书中检索到的段落作答。书籍与进度保存在本地 IndexedDB，不上传。支持四种主题（含豆沙绿护眼底色），PDF 纸色跟随主题。

description.en: Pressing Enter with an empty composer steers the first queued message into the running turn while the agent is busy.
description.zh: agent 正在处理任务时，输入框空着按回车，队列第一条消息就会插话送进当前回合。

description.en: A draggable task progress panel with local estimates, independent teammate progress, optional AI observations, and built-in probe cost estimates. Release candidate for the Web profile only; requires Node >=24.9.0 and Harness >=0.2.2-rc.1, tested on 0.2.2-rc.3. AI assistance is off by default; enabling observations uses billable tokens from the current session provider. Renamed to dsh-progress; eligible legacy progress data is copied without removing the original files.
description.zh: 可拖动的任务进度面板，展示本地估算、独立队友进度、可选 AI 评估与内置探针费用估算。候选版本，仅限 Web profile，需要 Node >=24.9.0 与 Harness >=0.2.2-rc.1，已验证 0.2.2-rc.3。AI 辅助默认关闭，开启评估后会消耗当前会话提供方的计费 token。已更名为 dsh-progress；可迁移的旧版进度数据会复制保留，原文件不删除。

description.en: Turns the composer send button into a tomato button while a task is running and the draft is empty. One or two taps hand the model a hidden note on its next step asking it to reflect on the approach and to finish by asking the user how to continue; three taps within a second stop the run first and send the same kind of note. Thrown-tomato animations and sound can be switched off in settings, which also counts every tomato thrown.
description.zh: 任务运行中且输入框为空时，把发送键换成番茄键。点一两下会让模型在下一步收到一条不对用户显示的提醒，要求它反思做法并以提问用户如何继续收尾；一秒内连点三下则先停止任务，再发同样的提醒。丢番茄特效与音效可在设置中关闭，设置页同时显示累计扔出的番茄总数。

description.en: Replaces the chat model picker with a collapsible provider-grouped list (640x720 max) that shows each model name, provider name, provider ID and exact model ID, plus a manually managed uncommon list and a separate favorites list. Classification is user-driven only: no usage tracking and no auto-sorting. Search covers model name, model ID, provider name, provider ID and account notes.
description.zh: 把聊天模型选择器换成按服务商分组的可折叠列表（最大 640x720），每款模型显示名称、服务商名称、服务商 ID 与精确模型 ID，另有手动整理的「不常用」列表和独立的收藏列表。分类只由用户决定：不统计使用频率、不自动分类。搜索覆盖模型名称、模型 ID、服务商名称、服务商 ID 与账号备注。

description.en: Skill card gallery for DSH: every installed skill becomes a game-style card you can browse in four carousel modes, filter by category, source or tag, and edit — rarity, stars, five stats, tags and card art — while the card data lives in a side-car file, so SKILL.md is left untouched. Also creates and deletes skill folders.
description.zh: 技能卡库：把已安装的 DSH 技能渲染成游戏卡牌，支持四种轮播模式浏览、按分类/来源/标签筛选，并可可视化修改稀有度、星数、五维数值、标签与卡面；卡牌数据存在旁路文件里，不改动 SKILL.md，同时支持新建与删除技能目录。

description.en: Subor-style CRT boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: the tube powers on, the pixel logo drops in with a "DeepSeek, endless fun" voice line, then 108 classic FC game windows fill the screen along a snake-like inward spiral, ending in a white flash that fades into the app. Auto-plays, skippable, zero configuration.
description.zh: 小霸王风格的 DSH 开机动画：显像管通电、蓝屏雪花、「小霸王」逐字落下，一句「啊哈，DeepSeek 其乐无穷啊」之后，108 个经典 FC 游戏窗口像贪吃蛇一样铺满全屏，最后闪白渐黑进入应用。自动播放、可跳过、零配置。

description.en: A-share and OTC fund dashboard forked from SuCriss/dsh-leekbox (MIT): indices, market boards, limit-up sentiment thermometer, dragon-tiger list, full-market search, a watchlist with in-place position editing and price alerts, a stock detail window with K-line, money flow and F10, a signal screener, 7x24 news, AI stock analysis, and an OTC fund tab with NAV, estimated NAV and a fund detail window showing stage returns, a NAV chart and the disclosed top-10 holdings with live quotes. It keeps upstream's /api/leekbox/* routes and $DSH_HOME/.leekbox-*.json data files, so install it instead of SuCriss/dsh-leekbox rather than alongside it.
description.zh: 持仓看板：A 股与场外基金看板，fork 自 SuCriss/dsh-leekbox（MIT）——大盘指数、板块、涨停情绪温度计、龙虎榜、全市场搜索、可原地编辑持仓成本与份额并带价格预警的自选、含 K 线 / 资金流向 / F10 的个股详情浮窗、技术信号选股、7×24 快讯、AI 个股分析，以及带净值与估值、阶段涨幅、净值曲线和最新披露前十大重仓实时涨跌的场外基金页。它沿用上游的 /api/leekbox/* 路由与 $DSH_HOME/.leekbox-*.json 数据文件，请替代而非并装 SuCriss/dsh-leekbox。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: Embeds upstream quota and usage progress rings from your local Magpie gateway (127.0.0.1:3425) right beside the composer context meter, with session-aware active model tracking and 5-hour limit reset tooltips.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：将 Magpie 本地网关（127.0.0.1:3425）的配额与用量进度圆环嵌入输入框底部状态栏（与上下文比例并列），支持各会话模型自动跟随嗅探、置顶卡片自动置顶与 5 小时重置倒计时微型面板。

description.en: Adds deliverable-file buttons to the end of each agent turn (opens files with the OS default app) and a floating dot rail for jumping between conversation turns.
description.zh: 在每轮对话末尾添加产出文件按钮（用系统默认程序打开），并提供可在轮次间快速跳转的悬浮圆点导航栏。

description.en: Prompt forge for DeepSeek Harness: one draft becomes three parallel rewrites, read for intent first and scored blind by the model, with the sentences each version added highlighted — then bind one back into the composer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的提示词炼成阵：先读意图，再让一份草稿并行炼出三个版本，模型盲评打分排序、新增句子高亮标出，最后择一写回输入框。

description.en: Select text in the DSH web client and a translate button appears at the end of the selection; clicking it translates that text in place. Translation goes through the host llm service, so it reuses the model the current session already has selected and needs no separate API key; an OpenAI-compatible endpoint can be configured instead. The result opens in a popover that stays inside the viewport, with one-click copy, a row of language buttons for instant retranslation, and smart Chinese-to-English / other-to-Chinese as the default. Configuration is stored host-side and its API key is never sent to the browser.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页客户端里选中文字，选区末尾会出现一个翻译按钮，点击即就地翻译这段文字。翻译走宿主 llm 服务，直接复用当前会话已选的模型，无需另外配置 API Key；也可改用任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。结果在保持于视口内的浮层中展示，支持一键复制、一排语言按钮即时重译，默认智能中英互译（中文译英、其他语言译中）。配置保存在宿主端，其中的 API Key 永不下发到浏览器。

description.en: Floating phone-pairing QR button for the DSH WebUI. One click opens the dsh-remote-link pairing QR (image + 6-digit code + TTL) in an in-app overlay — works in both browser and DSH Desktop (same-origin img, no iframe).
description.zh: DSH WebUI 右下角悬浮「手机连接」二维码按钮：点击在应用内弹层显示配对二维码、6 位短码与倒计时，浏览器与 DSH 桌面端通吃（同源 img 渲染，无 iframe）。

description.en: Shows the provider behind a session's current model as a compact badge in the DSH Web composer tool row, left of the model selector.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框工具行、模型选择器左侧显示当前会话所用模型的供应商。

description.en: Workspace groups for the DSH sidebar with group navigation and session status indicators.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏提供工作区分组、组间导航和会话状态提示。

description.en: Work todo reminders in a sidebar panel with four stage tabs (not started, in progress, overdue, done) plus separate recurring and paused filters, priority derived from the end time in real time, pinning that survives overdue, and enable/disable for recurring tasks. Recurrence covers workdays (following China's statutory holidays and make-up workdays), selected weekdays, monthly dates with month-end rollover, and 5-field cron; one-off tasks default to start and end reminders (start optional, end required); meetings can disable the end reminder. Alerts appear in a page overlay with optional browser notifications, snooze and quiet hours. Twelve agent tools; weekly/monthly reports, natural-language quick add, and cross-view search; data is a single local JSON file with completed tasks archived per quarter.
description.zh: 侧边栏「工作待办」面板：未开始 / 进行中 / 已超期 / 已完成四阶段页签 + 循环任务与已暂停独立筛选，优先级按结束时间实时派生，置顶任务超期也不下沉，循环任务可随时启停。循环规则覆盖工作日（跟随中国法定节假日与调休）、指定星期、每月指定日期（月末顺延）与 5 段式 cron；单次任务在开始与结束两个时间点各提醒一次。提醒以页面浮层呈现，可选浏览器系统通知，支持稍后提醒与免打扰。提供 12 个 Agent 工具，支持周报/月报、自然语言快速新建与跨视图搜索；数据为本地单个 JSON 文件，已完成任务按季度归档。

description.en: Adds a sparkle button beside the model picker that rewrites the current draft into a spec sized to the draft — two or three steps for a small ask, a longer checklist only when the request has several parts — and puts the original text back when pressed again. Greetings and small talk pass through untouched without calling the model.
description.zh: 在模型选择器旁加一个 ✨ 按钮，把草稿改写成规模随草稿而变的执行规格（小请求只给两三条步骤，多部分请求才展开成清单），再按一次按钮恢复原文；问候与闲聊直接放行，不调用模型。

description.en: Legal training workbench: three-pane academic UI that reads the "Minglü" (lawagent preset) learning profile (case dossiers, flashcards, wrong-answer book, notes) and sends instructions into a Minglü session with one click.
description.zh: 法学学习实训工作台：三栏学术风界面，直读「明律」（lawagent preset）的学习档案（案件卷宗/背诵卡/错题本/笔记），并可一键把指令送进明律会话。

description.en: Chat agent for a DeepSeek Harness session: create characters and write their personas, keep several archive threads per character, undo or rewind the locally stored transcript, and record story beats in an event book.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的一个会话变成聊天 agent：新建人物并写人设、为同一人物开多条档案线、本地保存的对话可撤销可回溯、剧情节点记进事件簿。

description.en: Composer attach button for DSH Web: multi-file picks become inline draft capsules, files are stored under the workspace uploads root with an auto-extracted UTF-8 .txt sidecar (txt/docx/xlsx/pptx/zip/odt, zero dependencies), and sent messages carry only the file name — never a raw path.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框附件按钮：多选文件以内联草稿胶囊形式插入；文件存储到工作区 uploads 目录并自动生成 UTF-8 .txt 提取件（txt/docx/xlsx/pptx/zip/odt，零依赖），任何纯文本 Agent 都能直接读取；发送消息只带文件名，不泄漏路径。

description.en: Adds a Restart button beside the permission control in the composer toolbar that relaunches DSH in one click, so freshly installed plugins apply without closing and reopening the app.
description.zh: 在对话框工具栏「完全权限」右侧加一个「重启」按钮，点击即重启 DSH，装完插件不用再手动关掉重开。

description.en: A merge of the dsh-effort-dial card structure and the reasoning-slider gradient/particle effects: a Codex-style reasoning-effort card in the composer with one control for model and effort, per-level accent colors, a quota line on the top level, and a blue-purple gradient with drifting particles. It takes over the composer model slot, so it cannot be enabled alongside dsh-effort-dial or reasoning-slider.
description.zh: 合并 dsh-effort-dial 的卡片结构与 reasoning-slider 的渐变/粒子效果：输入框里的 Codex 风格推理强度卡片，一个控件同时管理模型与档位，档位逐级变色，最高档显示额度提示并切换为蓝紫渐变与流动粒子。它接管输入框模型槽位，不能与 dsh-effort-dial、reasoning-slider 同时启用。

description.en: Observes detected background download commands and renders live cards with bytes, speed and ETA; silent downloads get a total from a HEAD probe.
description.zh: 观察识别到的后台下载命令并显示实时进度卡片（字节、速度、剩余时间）；静默下载用 HEAD 探测总量。

description.en: Moves the question panel's Skip and Submit buttons in from the right edge, and steps the composer column left so its controls stay clear of a bottom-right desktop pet.
description.zh: 把提问卡的「跳过」「提交」从贴右边收到中间偏右，并让输入区整列左移，避开右下角的桌面宠物。

description.en: Native DSH plugin that renders structured data as inline charts directly inside the conversation, with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 原生 DSH 插件：把结构化数据渲染成对话流内联图表，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Shares one right-sidebar across every conversation in the same workspace, so you don't have to reopen it when creating or switching conversations, with a switch in Settings → General.
description.zh: 让同一工作区内的所有对话共用同一份右侧边栏，不用新建或者切换对话时候重新打开，并在「设置 → 通用」提供开关。

description.en: Counts the prompts you send in the Web GUI and turns them into a push-up debt, shown as a chip under the composer with one-click pay-off, partial payments and a day streak.
description.zh: 统计你在 Web 界面中发送的消息并换算成俯卧撑欠账，在输入框下方以计数器显示，支持一键结清、部分还款和连续天数记录。

description.en: A DSH sidebar panel that talks to locally running Hermes TUI gateways over JSON-RPC: switch between bot profiles, resume their Bot Chat sessions, stream message and tool deltas, and embed the Hermes terminal view.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏面板通过 JSON-RPC 直连本机运行的 Hermes TUI Gateway：切换 Bot profile、恢复各自的 Bot Chat 会话、流式显示消息与工具增量，并可内嵌 Hermes 终端视图。

description.en: One-click screenshot button that floats over every DSH page, with a second one in the composer tool row: it captures the DeepSeek Harness window (or the whole desktop with a modifier) using the host capture tooling and puts the PNG where it is useful — straight into the composer draft as an attachment, or on the clipboard when no composer is mounted. Windows-verified, with macOS and Linux backends; no dependencies and no build step.
description.zh: 悬浮在任意 DSH 页面上的一键截图按钮（输入框工具行里另有一个）：用宿主侧工具截取 DeepSeek Harness 窗口（按住修饰键可截整个桌面），并把 PNG 放到用得上的地方——直接作为附件落进输入框草稿，没有输入框时放进剪贴板。Windows 实测，另带 macOS/Linux 后端；零依赖、无构建步骤。

description.en: Replaces the composer model button with one panel holding a provider-grouped model list with search, pinned favorite models, and a reasoning-effort slider with one stop per level the model advertises, whose aurora gradient and glow grow with the level; the last effort used with each model is restored when switching back, and the built-in selector stays registered underneath as a fallback.
description.zh: 用一个面板替换输入框的模型按钮：按服务商分组的模型列表与搜索、置顶的收藏模型，以及按模型声明档位分级的思考程度滑杆，其极光渐变与光晕随档位增强；切回某个模型时恢复上次用过的档位，内置选择器仍作为备用保持注册。

description.en: Composer tweaks for the DSH input box: a Markdown source/view toggle, Markdown rendering for user messages, one mixed file-and-folder picker backed by the macOS open panel, a GenUI prompt switch inside the plus menu, an open-in-new-window action on sidebar Session rows (needs the separate `dsh-popout-window` host plugin), and a collapsible subagent tree. Requires DSH 0.2.x.
description.zh: DSH 输入框增强：Markdown 源码/视图开关、用户消息按 Markdown 渲染、把「添加文件」与「添加文件夹」合并成一个 macOS 原生面板混选入口、把 GenUI 提示词开关收进加号菜单，并在侧栏会话行提供「在新窗口打开」（需另装 `dsh-popout-window` 宿主插件）与可展开的子会话树。需要 DSH 0.2.x。

description.en: Codex History Rail adds a Codex-style turn rail to the left gutter of a DSH conversation, with hover previews, click-to-jump, and saved favorites.
description.zh: CODEX 历史摘要条 —— 在 DSH 对话左侧留白处加入 Codex 风格回合时间轴，支持悬停预览、点击跳转与收藏。

description.en: Fairy III (Zenless Zone Zero) H.D.D skin for DeepSeek Harness: boot video, an eye-core dock that can be dragged vertically so it never covers text, and time-of-day greeting voices written by a model every day (5 lines, each <= 20 characters) and synthesized locally with GPT-SoVITS, with a fallback chain of today -> latest -> bundled audio so there is always something to hear. Replies can be spoken: a trailing marker line takes priority over length heuristics, and long replies can be compressed into one sentence first. The reader hashes the utterance it just played (MD5) so each reply is voiced exactly once, and switching sessions stays silent. Personal fork of dsh-fairy-zzz with its own package, route and storage namespace, plus a rate-limited summarize endpoint, POST-only engine control and bounded TTS and greeting caches. Two diagnostic logs (client revision, decision trace) are written next to the plugin and stay on the local machine. A personal fork of AssassinVIX/fairy-zzz-plugin (upstream package dsh-fairy-zzz): install this fork or the upstream, not both - both mount the full-screen skin on the same DSH surfaces. Dynamic greetings and spoken summaries need a DeepSeek-compatible API key in ~/.dsh/fairy-tts.json (or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY); without it only the bundled greeting audio plays.
description.zh: 《绝区零》Fairy Ⅲ 的 H.D.D 皮肤：开机动画、可沿纵轴拖动（X 轴固定）的常驻眼徽，用来避开正文；每天由模型生成 5 段时段问候台词（每句不超过 20 字），用本地 GPT-SoVITS 合成，取用顺序为「今日 → 最近一份 → 内置语音」，生成失败也有声音。回复可选朗读：末尾标记行优先于字数判断，长回复可先压成一句结论；朗读器对刚念过的句子做 MD5 去重，保证每条只念一次，切换会话保持安静。本仓库是 dsh-fairy-zzz 的个人定制分支，包名、路由与存储命名空间独立，并做了摘要接口限流、引擎启停改 POST、TTS 缓存与问候语定期清理。插件会在自身目录写两份本地诊断日志（客户端版本、决策追踪），只留本机、不外传。本仓库是 AssassinVIX/fairy-zzz-plugin（上游包名 dsh-fairy-zzz）的个人定制分支：与上游二选一安装，不要同时装——两者都会在相同的 DSH 界面挂载全屏皮肤。每日动态问候与朗读摘要需要 ~/.dsh/fairy-tts.json（或 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）提供 DeepSeek 兼容 API key；未配置时只播放内置问候音频。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the Windows desktop app title bar and replaces the cold-start "loading settings" overlay with an animated boot sequence.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面端标题栏加一个重启按钮，并把冷启动时的「正在加载设置…」换成一段科技感动画。

description.en: Pins an always-on-top progress bar while the agent runs a turn — the percentage is estimated from tool calls and filled to 100% when the turn ends — and badges the DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing window so large token operations ask for confirmation only during peak hours. The bar runs as a separate Electron process and is skipped when no Electron binary is found.
description.zh: 模型跑一次回合时，屏幕顶部常驻一条进度栏（百分比按工具调用次数递增估算，回合结束才补到 100%），并标出当前是 DeepSeek 峰时还是谷时——大额 token 的操作只在峰时先问你一句。进度栏是独立 Electron 进程，找不到 Electron 二进制时会跳过。

description.en: Windows only; needs PowerShell and the bundled install.ps1. Adds an interface menu to the left of the model selector with three actions that run immediately: reload the interface, restart DSH, and close DSH. The Windows build ships no built-in reload or restart entry, so this adds one.
description.zh: 仅 Windows，需 PowerShell 与附带的 install.ps1。在模型选择左侧加一个「界面」菜单：刷新界面、重启 DSH、关闭 DSH，三项都即点即执行；Windows 版 DSH 没有内置的重载或重启入口，这里补上。

description.en: Plays an intro full-frame when you open DSH, when you open a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. The built-in footage is themed on a Wandering Earth-style space station and the quantum AI MOSS (550W): a red single eye ignites while the Earth’s curve slides past the viewport. Four clips ship embedded in the code — no separate video files — and the library lets you tick any number to rotate at random (never the same clip twice in a row), preview the rotation, or swap in your own videos. Sound plays without a click; the pin button sits beside Settings.
description.zh: 打开 DSH 时、打开新对话时，或每次打开你钉住的那个会话时，播放一段全屏片头动画。内置素材是《流浪地球》风格的太空站与量子 AI MOSS（550W）：红色单眼点亮，地球弧线从视窗外掠过。四段片子直接内嵌在代码里，不需要单独的视频文件；片库可勾选任意几段随机轮换（不会连续两次同一段）、预览轮换，也能换成你自己的视频。声音无需点击即可播放；钉住按钮就在设置旁边。

description.en: Cross-project session grouping for the DSH sidebar: define named sections, assign sessions from any project into them, then collapse, rename, archive or move a whole project in one action; a toggle in the Sections panel swaps the host session browser for the section tree and restores it on demand, and each row flags live work — its own turn, a subagent it delegated to, or a background job still going — or a completion you have not looked at yet.
description.zh: 把不同项目的会话收进左侧边栏里可折叠的自定义分组：会话行与项目行各有菜单，可加入分组、移出分组、重命名、归档，或把整个项目一次性移入某个分组；分组面板里的开关可把宿主侧栏切换成分组树、随时恢复，行尾还会提示会话正在跑（自己这一轮、派出去的子代理、没结束的后台任务都算）或跑完还没看过。

description.en: A crypto ticker card in the DeepSeek-Harness sidebar footer, above the balance and Settings, showing BTC, ETH and SOL prices, 24-hour change and 24-point sparklines, sourced from OKX with automatic fallback to Binance then CoinGecko (CoinGecko has no sparkline history); clicking the header folds the whole card into a single small button, and the folded state is remembered. A fork of 18569663yz-web/dsh-plugin-crypto-ticker: do not install both.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏左下角的加密货币行情卡片，位于余额与设置上方，显示 BTC、ETH、SOL 的价格、24 小时涨跌幅与 24 点迷你走势图，数据源按 OKX → Binance → CoinGecko 自动降级（CoinGecko 无历史走势）；点一下表头就能把整张卡片收成一枚小按钮，收起状态会被记住。fork 自 18569663yz-web/dsh-plugin-crypto-ticker，不能与其同装。

description.en: Splits the conversation area into up to four panes inside a sidebar panel: drag a session from the sidebar onto the conversation and it opens as a new pane, drag one pane header onto another to swap them, fill a single pane across the whole area, and keep the host title bar, view tabs and sidebar untouched by portalling the grid into the conversation body; every pane carries its own index, workspace and title header, and the pane-count controls (+ / - / x) sit in the host tab row.
description.zh: 对话区分屏：左侧栏入口最多开四屏（1 屏铺满 / 2 屏左右并排 / 3–4 屏两列两行），从侧栏把会话拖进对话区即自动分屏，拖一屏的信息头到另一屏可换位，点一下把某屏铺满整个区域；网格是宿主正文区里的真子节点，宿主标题栏、页签行与左侧栏原样保留，每屏自带序号/工作区/标题信息头，屏数加减与关闭挂在宿主顶栏页签行右侧。

description.en: CPU, GPU and memory load in the DeepSeek Harness Session header: three compact cells with a percentage and a 2 px bar, coloured at 75 % and 90 %; CPU from os.cpus() deltas, GPU from nvidia-smi (Windows counter fallback).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话顶栏实时显示 CPU、GPU 与内存占用：三个小格各带百分比和 2 px 细条，75 %、90 % 变色；CPU 取 os.cpus() 差值，GPU 优先 nvidia-smi（Windows 下可退回性能计数器）。

description.en: A per-turn change bar above the composer showing which files the turn changed and the line deltas, for DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1 through 0.1.7.
description.zh: 输入框上方的本轮改动统计条，显示这一轮改了哪些文件、增删多少行，适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1 至 0.1.7。

description.en: Font switcher for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: 99 UI fonts + 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换字体的插件：99 个界面字体 + 31 个代码字。

description.en: Restart / exit power buttons in the conversation header.
description.zh: 会话右上角的「重启 / 注销」电源按钮。

description.en: Full-screen HAAVK-themed boot animation for DSH, rewritten from dsh-startup-secret 1.5.2 (which is listed separately): an intro video, a cold-blue console board and a five-step access sequence with recorded voice lines and a looping background track. Text and two accent colours are editable in DSH settings, and the intro video and BGM can be switched there; replacement media files go into lib/assets. Install it instead of dsh-startup-secret, not alongside it — the two share ~/.dsh/dsh-startup.json and the same settings section.
description.zh: 哈夫克风格的全屏启动动画：开屏视频、冷蓝控制台底板、五步访问流程，配预录人声与循环背景音乐；文字与两处主色、开屏视频和背景音乐的开关可在 DSH 设置页调整，替换素材需覆盖 lib/assets 下的同名文件。本包由 dsh-startup-secret 1.5.2 改写，两者共用启动配置和设置区，请与上游二选一安装。

description.en: Assign per-session duotone SVG icons and colors from the sidebar menu or a model tool, with browser-local persistence and cross-tab updates.
description.zh: 为每个会话设置双色 SVG 图标和颜色，可通过侧边栏菜单或模型工具操作，并支持浏览器本地持久化与跨标签页更新。

description.en: Localizes the DeepSeek Harness approval panel in the web client and translates authorization reasons from English to Chinese, with a built-in phrase dictionary first and a model-router fallback for reasons the dictionary does not cover.
description.zh: 在 Web 客户端把 DeepSeek Harness 的权限审批面板本地化为中文：授权原因优先走内置词表翻译，词表未收录的由宿主侧模型路由兜底。

description.en: Renders a TXT novel as a dim text layer behind the DSH chat, with a draggable controller for table of contents, chapter paging, auto-scroll and reading settings.
description.zh: 把 TXT 小说渲染成 DSH 聊天背后的淡色文字层，配一个可拖动的悬浮控件，用于目录、翻章、自动滚动与阅读设置。

description.en: Previews D2 diagrams in the DSH sidebar using the local D2 CLI, with live rendering, source editing, zoom, and chart, code, or split views.
description.zh: 使用本机 D2 CLI 在 DSH 右侧边栏预览图表，支持实时渲染、源码编辑、缩放及图表、代码、分屏视图。

description.en: Adds a native Restart DeepSeek Harness item to the Windows system tray menu and the account menu of the DSH desktop app: the plugin prepares a patched resources/app.asar at startup, a detached helper backs up the original and swaps it in after a normal exit, the patch is re-applied after each desktop update, and either item relaunches the app gracefully on the next launch. Windows desktop only; other hosts report 409 not_desktop.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端的 Windows 系统托盘菜单和账户菜单各加一项原生「重启 DeepSeek Harness」：插件启动时准备好补丁版 resources/app.asar，由一个分离的 helper 在正常退出后备份原文件并替换，桌面端每次更新覆盖后自动重打补丁，下次启动即可看到两个入口，点击走 app.relaunch() 优雅重启。仅支持 Windows 桌面端，其它宿主返回 409 not_desktop。

description.en: A pomodoro timer docked below the composer in DeepSeek Harness, with focus/short/long cycles, a resumable countdown, chime, optional system notifications and bilingual settings.
description.zh: 输入框下方的番茄钟：专注/短休息/长休息循环、可恢复倒计时、提示音、可选系统通知与中英双语设置。

description.en: Unofficial Claude UI-inspired model and reasoning-effort selector using the current model's available levels, with animated purple pixel effects.
description.zh: 模仿 Claude UI 的非官方模型与推理强度选择器，使用当前模型实际提供的档位，带紫色像素动画。

description.en: Adds a right-click context menu to delivered file cards, the changed-files card, inline file references and http(s) links in DSH chat. Actions are open with the default app, open with the system chooser, reveal in the file manager, copy the file itself, copy its path, save a copy to a chosen folder, download, and open a link in the browser. Delivery cards are addressed by Session coordinates the Host re-derives from the session log; inline references and the changed-files card are addressed by an absolute path the Host re-verifies.
description.zh: 给 DSH 聊天里的交付文件卡片、改动卡片、行内文件引用与 http(s) 链接加上右键菜单。动作包括用默认程序打开、用系统「打开方式」对话框打开、在文件管理器中定位、复制文件本体、复制文件路径、另存到指定文件夹、下载，以及用浏览器打开链接。交付卡片走宿主从会话日志反查的会话坐标；行内引用与改动卡片走宿主要求复核的绝对路径。

description.en: WeChat-style screenshot: freeze the desktop, drag a region or click a window, and the crop lands in the composer. A Windows-only fork of Durandalw/dsh-plugin-screenshot; do not install it alongside the upstream plugin.
description.zh: 微信式截图：点一下冻结桌面，框选区域或单击窗口，截图直接进输入框。Windows 专用的 Durandalw/dsh-plugin-screenshot 衍生版，请勿与原版同时安装。

description.en: Floating audio control panel in the Web GUI: play/pause/next/previous for Windows media sessions (SMTC) and the system master volume/mute, served by a Node route half that runs a PowerShell helper.
description.zh: Web 界面里的悬浮音频控制面板：控制 Windows 媒体会话（SMTC）的播放/暂停/上一首/下一首与系统主音量/静音，由注册路由的主机半调用 PowerShell 助手实现。

description.en: Sticky notes wall in the sidebar: rich text, images, ink, drag-to-reorder, per-note alarms, and scheduled delivery of a note into a session. Its read-only /state and /media routes have no authentication.
description.zh: 侧边栏便签墙：富文本、图片、手写、拖动排序、便签闹钟，以及把便签定时投递到会话。只读的 /state 和 /media 路由没有鉴权。

description.en: Runs a chosen power action (shutdown / restart / hibernate / sleep / lock / logoff) once every Agent session and background job has gone idle: the plugin samples in-process sessions once per second, counts running sessions as always busy, checks running background jobs through a configurable option (considerJobs, on by default, shown with its live count in Settings), waits a confirm window and then a cancellable countdown, and shows a draggable bottom-right card with the current phase and remaining seconds; the enable toggle never survives a host restart, any newly started session or Cancel aborts the countdown, and if the agents service is unavailable the machine is treated as busy so nothing ever fires. Windows only (the built-in shutdown / rundll32 actions); every action except none degrades to none elsewhere.
description.zh: 会话全部结束、后台任务也安静下来后自动执行电源动作（关机 / 重启 / 休眠 / 睡眠 / 锁定 / 注销）：插件每秒采样进程内会话，运行中的会话始终算「在忙」；后台任务检测是可配置项 considerJobs（默认开启，设置页直接显示当前计数）；确认窗口后进入可取消倒计时，右下角浮窗卡片显示当前阶段与剩余秒数并支持拖动；开关不会随宿主重启保留（重启后一律回到关闭），任何会话新启动或点取消都会中止倒计时；拿不到 agents 服务时一律按「在忙」处理，绝不触发。仅支持 Windows（使用系统自带 shutdown / rundll32），其他平台除 none 外均降级为 none。

description.en: Replaces the shipped sidebar workspace browser with Recents, a project editor that adds extra source folders, and pin, rename, fork, and archive row actions.
description.zh: 替换出厂侧边栏工作区浏览器，补上最近会话、可添加额外源文件夹的项目编辑器，以及置顶、重命名、派生和归档行操作。

description.en: Sidebar page that removes burned-in subtitles from a video with a local video-subtitle-remover checkout: frame preview with a start/end range, drag-drawn regions (up to six), automatic region detection reviewed by a DSH chat model, live before/after comparison, and open-file/open-folder on the result. Requires the video-subtitle-remover checkout with its models and a Python environment with torch, paddle and OpenCV.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏里调用本机 video-subtitle-remover 引擎擦除视频硬字幕：画面帧按开始/结束时段预览、拖拽框选最多六个区域、自动识别字幕带并由 DSH 模型复核、处理中实时前后对比，成片可一键打开或定位到文件夹。需预先准备 video-subtitle-remover 仓库（含模型）与装有 torch、paddle、OpenCV 的 Python 环境。

description.en: A conversation view beside Chat and Trajectory that turns a DSH session into a character stage, with Codex Pet sprites, comic bubbles and a completion report listing the files and attachments the turn produced.
description.zh: 与 Chat、Trajectory 并列的会话视图，把会话变成角色舞台：支持 Codex Pet 精灵动画与漫画气泡，并在完成时汇报本轮产生的文件和附件。

description.en: Personal reading log panel: track books as want to read, reading or finished with dates, page progress, ratings, tags, notes and excerpts; yearly reading stats; covers looked up from Apple Books, Google Books and Open Library; Goodreads and Douban CSV import and CSV export; and five agent tools: bookshelf_list, bookshelf_stats, bookshelf_add, bookshelf_update and bookshelf_add_excerpt.
description.zh: 个人阅读记录面板：按想读、在读、读完管理书籍，记录日期、页码进度、评分、标签、笔记和摘录；年度阅读统计；从 Apple Books、Google Books、Open Library 补全封面；支持导入 Goodreads、豆瓣 CSV 和导出 CSV；并提供 bookshelf_list、bookshelf_stats、bookshelf_add、bookshelf_update、bookshelf_add_excerpt 五个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Makes the provider groups in the composer model menu collapsible, keeping only the provider of the current model expanded.
description.zh: 让输入框模型菜单的厂商分组可折叠，默认只展开当前模型所属厂商。

description.en: Predicts up to three candidate replies you may send next and shows them above the input box after each turn, cycling between them; adopting one appends it to the draft on a new line and leaves the rest in place, and any of them can also be sent directly or dismissed for the turn.
description.zh: 每回合结束后在输入框上方显示最多 3 条预测的下一句话，可循环切换；点「采用」会另起一行追加到输入框并保留其余几条（可连续采纳），也可直接发送或本回合不再显示。

description.en: Inline next-message prediction in the DSH composer: a grey ghost line, Tab to accept, ArrowUp to recall sent prompts.
description.zh: DSH 输入框内联预测：灰字预测下一句，Tab 接受，↑ 召回本会话发过的 prompt。

description.en: Window-like controls for every Web UI modal: drag by title bar, eight-way resize, pin against outside clicks, maximize to the full viewport, removable backdrop blur, and per-dialog persistent state.
description.zh: 为所有 Web UI 弹窗添加窗口化操作：标题栏拖动、八向缩放、钉住防误触关闭、全屏最大化、移除背景模糊，以及按弹窗持久化的状态。

description.en: Shows the provider name in the current-model button and its menu, so same-named models from different providers stay distinguishable.
description.zh: 在「当前模型」按钮与菜单里显示供应商名，同名的不同供应商模型不再混淆。

description.en: Tiles several workspaces side by side or stacked in the Web UI, one conversation per pane, with draggable splitters and pane swapping.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 主面板里把多个工作区并排或上下平铺，每个窗格一个会话，支持拖拽分隔条与交换窗格。

description.en: A permanent status card in the top-right corner of the DSH content area: one line for where this turn's time went (model, tools, waiting), plus collapsible to-dos with a progress bar, the session goal (edit/pause/resume/clear), submitted plans that open in the preview pane, the files this session changed, subagents with their token and duration figures, and this session's background jobs: running rows carry a two-step stop button, finished ones fold into a count line that stays collapsed until opened; it yields space to the content as the area narrows and folds into a round button at the limit.
description.zh: 内容区右上角的常驻状态卡片：一行写清本轮时间去向（模型/工具/等你），另列可折叠的任务与进度条、会话目标（可编辑/暂停/继续/清除）、已提交计划（可点开在右栏预览）、本次变更文件、带 token 与耗时数字的子智能体行，以及本会话的后台任务（运行中的行带两段确认的终止按钮，已结束的收进一行计数、默认收起）；内容区收窄时正文向左让位，推到极限自动收成一颗圆钮。

description.en: Adds a paperclip image-picker button to the conversation composer - pick reference images through the system file dialog and feed them straight into the official attachment pipeline (thumbnails, limit checks, upload with message).
description.zh: 在会话输入框添加 📎 选图按钮，通过系统文件选择器选取参考图并注入官方附件管线（缩略图、数量与大小校验、随消息上传），绕开拖拽环境问题。

description.en: AI news panel for the sidebar: 24-hour picks, recent stories, a top-ten trending board, the daily digest and keyword search, all read from the public AIHOT JSON API. Picks and All filter by six categories; feed cards show category, source, time, heat score, summary and, when AIHOT supplies one, its recommendation note. The Picks, All and Search feeds group stories by Beijing-time day and page ten at a time with cursor endless scroll plus a Load more fallback. Read-only and client-side only, with no API key, no build step and colors taken from the host theme tokens.
description.zh: 侧边栏 AI 热点面板：24 小时精选、近期全部、热点 Top10 榜、每日日报与关键词搜索，数据全部取自 AIHOT 公开 JSON API。精选与全部支持六类筛选；信息流卡片显示分类、来源、时间、热度分、摘要，并在 AIHOT 提供时显示推荐理由。精选、全部与搜索三个信息流按北京时间按日分组，并以游标分页、每页 10 条滚动加载，同时提供「加载更多」兜底。面板只读、纯浏览器端取数，无需 API key、无构建步骤，配色跟随宿主主题 token。

description.en: A simulated search engine page in the DSH sidebar that queries the local web search API and lists the top 10 results.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的模拟搜索页：调用本地搜索接口，列出前 10 条结果。

description.en: Files the settings entries your installed plugins add below the ones dsh ships, behind a divider with a live count, and keeps up automatically as plugins come and go.
description.zh: 把已安装插件添加的设置入口统一收纳到 dsh 自带设置的下方，用带计数的分割线分区，插件增减时自动更新。

description.en: Renders an Agent Teams swimlane canvas above the composer: lead centred with members below, tasks laid out in lanes by longest dependency path, and four SVG connector families drawn as dashed paths (task dependency as a cubic bezier from the upstream card edge to the downstream card edge, lead bus, peer bus, member-to-task tether). Cards are absolutely positioned DOM, connectors are one SVG layer sharing the same geometry constants. Layout constants and path algorithms are ported from cc-haha. Reads the live per-session agentTeam projection (roster, shared tasks, dependency edges, running state) and falls back to the session todo list when the session has no team; team messages are not part of the projection yet, so the communication panel shows an empty state. Body colours come from host theme tokens; the eight member identity colours are the deliberate exception — fixed hues mixed with the theme accent via color-mix, declared as CSS variables because the same values feed an SVG stroke attribute that rejects colour functions. Ships zh/en dictionaries with identical keys.
description.zh: 在输入框上方渲染 Agent Teams 泳道看板：队长居中、成员在下，任务按最长依赖路径分泳道排列，四类连线用 SVG 虚线绘制（任务依赖是上游卡片右缘到下游卡片左缘的三次贝塞尔，另有队长总线、成员同级总线、成员到任务的 tether）。卡片是绝对定位 DOM，连线是一层 SVG，两者共用同一组几何常量。布局常量与路径算法移植自 cc-haha。数据读当前会话实时的 agentTeam 投影（名册、共享任务、依赖边、执行态）；会话没有团队时回退到本会话的工作清单。团队消息暂不在投影里，通讯面板显示空态。主体配色走宿主主题 token；八名成员的身份色是刻意的例外——色相固定，饱和度与明度用 color-mix 从主题强调色派生，且以 CSS 变量声明，因为这些值同时喂给 SVG 的 stroke 属性，而该位置不接受颜色函数。带中英文字典，两份键位一致。

description.en: Adds a Polish button to the composer tool row right of the permission control: it reads the draft you have already typed, has the current model infer your intent and rewrite the draft into a clearer prompt, then turns the button into Cancel so one click restores the exact pre-polish text.
description.zh: 在对话框工具行「权限」按钮右侧加一个「润色」按钮：读取输入框里已写好的草稿，先让当前模型推断你的意图再改写成更清晰的提示词，润色完成后按钮变为「取消」，一键回退到润色前的原文。

description.en: Model console panel: switch the model for every conversation at once or one at a time, filter sessions by idle time, fold subagents under their parent session, and bulk archive or release sessions.
description.zh: 模型控制台面板：一次性切换所有对话的模型或单独切换某一个，按闲置时间筛选会话，把子代理折叠在所属主对话下面，并批量归档或释放会话。

description.en: Four-column layout: split the DSH left sidebar into a 56px icon rail plus a full-height workspace column, and keep the icon rail visible when the sidebar is collapsed.
description.zh: 四栏布局：把 DSH 左侧栏拆成 56px 图标轨 + 占满整列高度的工作区列，侧栏折叠时仍保留图标轨。

description.en: Full-page NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH, reworked from stardream-1/dsh-netease-float (it reuses that package name, so the two cannot be installed side by side): now playing, full-screen lyrics, playlists, search and account sign-in.
description.zh: DSH 的网易云音乐整页播放器，改造自 stardream-1/dsh-netease-float（沿用同名包，不能与上游同时安装）：正在播放、全屏歌词、歌单、搜索与账号登录。

description.en: A shared right sidebar for the DSH web client — other plugins register tabs into the `rightbar.tab` slot instead of each pinning a `position:fixed` panel; ships a `rightbar-tab` skill for agents and an opt-in mode that moves legacy fixed panels aside.
description.zh: DSH 网页端的共享右栏——别的插件往 `rightbar.tab` 槽位注册标签页，不必各自 `position:fixed` 抢位置；随包附带给 agent 用的 `rightbar-tab` skill，另有一个默认关闭的让位模式把老面板挪开。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar's More menu with a single button that opens Settings.
description.zh: 把侧栏左下角的「更多」菜单换成一个直接打开设置的按钮。

description.en: Web panel for the DSH AI history importer — a floating button and a three-column wizard to preview conversations, pick which ones to import, and file them into workspace folders.
description.zh: AI 历史导入插件的可视化面板：悬浮按钮加三栏向导，可预览对话、逐条勾选，并把它们归档进工作区文件夹。

description.en: Ask the user a question about a local image; the DSH Web card offers zoom, pan, box, brush and lasso annotation, NG/OK/unsure verdicts and a note, and the agent receives annotations back in source-image pixel coordinates.
description.zh: 带本地图片向用户提问；DSH Web 卡片支持缩放平移、框选、画笔与套索标注、NG/OK/不确定判定和说明，Agent 收回原图像素坐标下的标注。

description.en: Side chat for the DSH Web GUI with a /side slash command, forked from @flyer103/dsh-side-chat 0.7.0 and adding a host /side command, an open-request bridge, and approval pinned to never. It cannot be installed alongside the upstream @flyer103/dsh-side-chat — both register the same routes and side-chat tab type.
description.zh: DSH 网页版的侧聊面板与 /side 命令，基于 @flyer103/dsh-side-chat 0.7.0 的分支，新增宿主侧 /side 命令、开放请求桥接，并将审批固定为 never。不能与上游 @flyer103/dsh-side-chat 同装——两者注册相同的路由与侧聊标签页类型。

description.en: Reorganize the home sidebar entries into groups above and below the workspace, toggle each installed plugin entry, and save every change immediately.
description.zh: 把主页侧栏入口按工作区上方和下方重新分组，可逐个开关已安装插件的入口，改动即时保存。

description.en: Context-based next-message suggestions and draft rewriting for DeepSeek Harness, with candidate paging, shortcut recording, and companion MCP tools.
description.zh: 根据会话生成下一条消息建议并优化草稿，支持候选翻页、快捷键录制和配套 MCP 工具。

description.en: Manchester United 2026/27 fixtures in the sidebar with kickoff times in your local timezone, finished matches with W/L/D results.
description.zh: 在侧边栏查看曼联 2026/27 赛季赛程，开球时间按你的本地时区显示，已结束比赛带 W/L/D 比分结果。

description.en: Rich-text notes with images, links, symbols, categories, backgrounds, heading folding, and export.
description.zh: 富文本笔记：支持图片、链接、符号、分类、背景、标题折叠与导出。

description.en: Find bar in the sidebar text preview, with whole-file match counts for plain text and code, highlighted hits, and jumps between them.
description.zh: 侧边栏文本预览的查找栏：纯文本与代码按整份文件计数，命中高亮并可逐处跳转。

description.en: Adds a single “Restart DeepSeek Harness” item to the Windows system tray menu of the DSH desktop app by patching the installed app.asar in place and re-applying that patch after each desktop update; it needs a writable DSH installation directory and adds no other tray actions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端的 Windows 系统托盘菜单中只增加一个“重启 DeepSeek Harness”项，做法是原位修改已安装的 app.asar 并在桌面端每次更新后重打补丁；需要 DSH 安装目录可写，不添加其他托盘操作。

description.en: Scores sessions and workspaces 0-100% by time since their last activity, then shows that heat as a sidebar icon, a small heat dot before every session title, a heat line in the session hover card, and a filterable sessions/workspaces panel that also totals the turns, steps, tokens and conversation time of each workspace.
description.zh: 按距最后一次活动的时间给会话与工作区打 0–100% 热度分，并在侧边栏图标、会话标题前的小热度圆点、会话悬浮卡片和可筛选的会话/工作区面板中呈现；工作区卡片还汇总该工作区的轮次、步数、Token 与会话时长。

description.en: Fixes the Windows workspace-open action. The shipped opener runs `explorer.exe "<file:// URI>"`, which on some hosts reports success without raising a window — the exit-code verdict cannot tell an opened window from nothing happening. This routes that one action to `explorer.exe /e,<dir>`, which raises a window reliably, and leaves every other application in the menu on the shipped path.
description.zh: 修正 Windows 上「打开工作目录」的行为。官方调用 `explorer.exe "<file:// URI>"`，在某些主机上会报告成功却不弹窗口——因为成功判据是退出码，分不出「窗口开了」和「什么都没发生」。本插件把该操作改走 `explorer.exe /e,<目录>`，稳定新开窗口；菜单里其它应用仍走官方路径。

description.en: RGB lighting effects for DeepSeek Harness: animated composer ring, sidebar rail, session indicator, and glowing brand logo.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 RGB 动效：消息输入框光环、侧边栏光条、活动会话指示器与品牌 Logo 矢量发光。

description.en: Codex-style paste collapse for the DeepSeek Harness composer: a paste of more than 1000 characters becomes a `[Pasted Content N chars]` placeholder, a second paste of the same size is numbered `#2`, and the host expands it back to the full text before the model reads it, so the model still receives every character. A pill on the top edge of the composer shows the preview, the sent message shows the same pill, and clicking either opens the whole paste in a side panel with a copy button. Pure in memory: nothing is written to disk and no token is saved.
description.zh: Codex 同款粘贴折叠：DSH 输入框里超过 1000 字符的粘贴变成 `[Pasted Content N chars]` 占位符，同样长度再粘一次编成 `#2`；模型读到之前宿主把占位符换回全文，一个字符不少。输入框上沿留一枚胶囊显示预览，发出的消息里也是同一枚胶囊，点开在右侧抽屉看全文并复制。全部在内存里：不写磁盘，也不省 token。

description.en: Live step pill in the DSH session header: folds the durable session event stream into the agent's current action (tool name plus its argument summary), the step index inside the running turn, the elapsed turn time and the todo progress, polls it every 1.2 seconds, and renders blue pulse while working, green for a finished turn and red for a failed tool call; hides itself 9 seconds after a turn ends. On Windows it also opens an always-on-top desktop HUD (set DSH_AGENT_STATUS_HUD=0 to disable).
description.zh: DSH 会话标题栏里的实时进度胶囊：把持久化的会话事件流折叠成 agent 当前动作（工具名 + 参数摘要）、本轮第几步、已耗时与待办进度，每 1.2 秒轮询一次；干活时蓝点脉冲、一轮结束转绿、工具调用失败转红，空闲 9 秒后自动收起。在 Windows 上还会打开常驻置顶桌面小窗（设 DSH_AGENT_STATUS_HUD=0 可关闭）。

description.en: Annotates elements or dragged regions in the Harness interface and Desktop Browser pages, then sends comments and cropped PNG screenshots to the current conversation.
description.zh: 在 Harness 界面与桌面版浏览器页面里标注元素或拖选区域，把评论和裁剪后的 PNG 截图一并发送到当前对话。

description.en: Folds the DSH sidebar's global panel launchers into the More button it already renders, so the workspace and session list below regains up to seven 36px rows. A row in the More menu toggles the fold back, and the choice is kept in localStorage.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧边栏的全局面板入口收进它本来就有的『更多』按钮，下面的工作区与会话列表最多多出七行 36px 的高度；『更多』菜单里一行开关即可还原，选择记在 localStorage 里。

description.en: A draggable sticky note that counts today's and this month's earnings in real time from your work hours, with an optional photo, GIF or video background.
description.zh: 可拖动的桌面提示贴，按上下班时间实时计算今日与本月收入，支持照片、动图或短视频背景。

description.en: Durable, reversible installer that patches DSH Desktop session-reference UX — workspace-prioritized @ candidates, title-first display, two-line menu layout, and sidebar drag-to-composer session references.
description.zh: 可回滚的 DSH Desktop 会话引用体验补丁安装器——@ 菜单当前工作区优先、标题优先展示、两行布局，以及侧边栏拖拽会话到输入区形成引用。

description.en: Turns the DSH sidebar into a message view, where a bell button groups sessions by priority and date and each row carries its preview and workspace name.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏切成消息视图：铃铛一键把会话按优先级与日期分组，每行带预览与所属工作区。

description.en: Adds a Chat entry to the DSH sidebar for project-free chats that use DSH's own sign-in and models, limited to web search, images and files dragged into the chat. Built for the DSH desktop app 0.2.2-rc.1 and tested on macOS only; do not enable it together with Starp1ume/dsh-chat-mode.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏加一个「聊天」入口，不用选项目，直接用 DSH 自己的登录和模型聊天，模型只能联网搜索、看图和读拖进来的附件。面向 DSH 桌面版 0.2.2-rc.1，仅在 macOS 上测过；不要与 Starp1ume/dsh-chat-mode 同时启用。

description.en: Weather dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with city switching, current conditions, an eight-hour trend, and a five-day forecast.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 天气看板，支持城市切换、当前天气、八小时趋势图和五日预报。

description.en: In-place text editing from the right-Sidebar document preview with ⌘S save and an external-change conflict check, plus a workspace Files tab (fuzzy search, create/rename/delete, per-file git status) and a Git changes tab whose baseline is the remote upstream — files that match the remote drop off the list.
description.zh: 右侧预览里直接编辑保存文本文件（⌘S、外部改动冲突提示），另带一个可模糊搜索、新建 / 重命名 / 删除、并显示每个文件 git 状态的「文件」页签，以及以远程上游为基准的「Git 改动」页签 —— 改回与远程一致的文件会自动从列表消失。

description.en: Sidebar balance row for DSH Desktop — account balance and a top-up button, right under the version row; refreshes every 10 minutes and whenever the window regains focus, with explicit signed-out and error states.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 侧栏余额行——在「版本 / 检查更新」下面显示账户余额与「充值」按钮，每 10 分钟或窗口重新聚焦时刷新，未登录与读取失败都有明确状态。

description.en: DSH Desktop control center: one-click app updating (progress dialog, unattended install, resume), plus Skills / MCP / Agents / Import settings pages — import agent presets and chat history from Codex, Claude Code, TRAE and WorkBuddy, search remote sources by address, and push notes straight into the composer.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 桌面控制中心：更新中心（侧栏版本号 + 进度条弹窗 + 一键装好 + 断点续传），外加「技能 / MCP / 智能体 / 导入」四个设置页——可从 Codex、Claude Code、TRAE、WorkBuddy 导入智能体预设与历史对话，按源地址联网搜索，侧栏笔记可多选插入聊天输入框。

description.en: Composer button that rewrites the current draft with four style presets, selection-only rewriting, a keyboard shortcut and instant undo; no settings page.
description.zh: 输入框一键改写草稿：四种风格档位、划词改写、快捷键与即时撤销，无设置页。

description.en: On touch devices, supplies the keys a phone's soft keyboard lacks (Escape, Tab, Enter, Ctrl-C and the arrow keys) as a translucent on-screen column beside the active terminal.
description.zh: 在触屏设备上补齐手机软键盘缺少的按键（Esc、Tab、回车、Ctrl-C、方向键），以半透明按键列浮在活动终端旁。

description.en: Configurable A-share, Hong Kong and US quote strip under the DSH composer: mini K-line per card, intraday, 5-minute, daily, weekly and monthly charts, five-level order book, A-share turnover and limit prices, session-aware polling and a Sina fallback source. Quotes come from public Tencent and Eastmoney endpoints; its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的 A 股 / 港股 / 美股自选股行情条：卡片带迷你 K 线，点开有分时、5 分钟、日/周/月 K 线、五档盘口、A 股换手率与涨跌停价，按交易时段自动调节刷新，腾讯不可用时切新浪。行情来自腾讯和东方财富的公开接口；它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: A to-do list that lives in the right sidebar instead of the conversation: add an item, tick it off, delete it, and drag rows to reorder them. Items are kept only in the browser's localStorage, and the plugin registers no model-facing tools; a button in the conversation header opens the panel.
description.zh: 放在右侧边栏、不进入对话的待办清单：添加、勾选完成、删除，拖动行即可排序。数据只保存在浏览器的 localStorage 里，插件不注册任何给模型用的工具；会话头部有个按钮可打开面板。

description.en: Reload the whole frontend from a button in the conversation session header. A press first reads the next document and waits until its bundle addresses resolve, so it does not boot into a failed graph after a client bundle is rebuilt.
description.zh: 在会话头部一键重载整个前端。点击后先读取下一个文档并等待其 bundle 地址可解析，避免客户端 bundle 重建后重载进入无法启动的图。

description.en: Four assistant output layouts with full reasoning, independent tool details, and frame-synchronized or fading text.
description.zh: 提供四种助手输出布局、完整思考展示，以及刷新率同步或新增文字淡入效果。

description.en: Reskins the DSH conversation hero — brand mark and workspace picker — with a Wordless-style landing view. The native composer stays untouched, and the picker still adds new workspaces (the entry declares its own directory-flow child hole, exactly like the shipped picker).
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话首屏的品牌标识与工作区选择器换上 Wordless 风格的着陆视图。原生输入框保持不变；选择器仍可在弹窗内添加新工作区（本条目像原生选择器一样自带 directory-flow 子槽位）。

description.en: A broom button beside the context-usage readout under the web composer. Its frame draws the current occupancy, shifting green to yellow to red as the session fills, with stronger wording and a faster pulse as pressure rises; clicking it compacts the session, preferring a native compact or compress command when one is registered and otherwise folding the oldest ranges that contain no user message through the plugin host route.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框下方的上下文占用读数旁增加一枚扫帚按钮：外框直接画出当前占用比例，随占用升高由绿转黄再转红，提醒语气加重、呼吸与摆动频率加快；点击即压缩会话，已注册原生 compact 或 compress 命令时优先使用，否则由插件 Host 路由折叠最老旧且不含用户消息的区间。

description.en: Node-based GLSL workbench: wire a shader graph on a canvas and preview it live, compile it to Shadertoy-compatible GLSL with multi-pass buffers (BufferA–D), hot-reload as you edit, cross-compile to HLSL / MSL / SPIR-V, and keep projects, materials, snapshots and resources (images, audio, lyrics) in a local workspace. Ships 57 built-in nodes, 8 bundled examples and 11 agent tools. No runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 节点式 GLSL 工作台：在画布上连节点图并实时预览，编译成 Shadertoy 兼容的 GLSL（支持 BufferA–D 多 Pass 反馈与热重载），可跨编译导出 HLSL / MSL / SPIR-V，并在本地工作区管理项目、材质、快照与资源（图片 / 音频 / 歌词）。内置 57 个节点、8 个自带示例与 11 个 agent 工具，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Adds a power button to the DSH sidebar - Shut down or Restart, each behind a confirmation - and ships a Windows tray launcher that starts DSH without a console window, supervises it so Restart can relaunch it, and offers the same start-at-logon switch.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏加一个电源按钮——关机 / 重启（各自二次确认）；并自带 Windows 托盘启动器：无窗口启动 DSH、托管它以让「重启」能自动拉起，并提供同一个开机自启开关。

description.en: Adds a one-click Continue button beside Send that resumes a stopped turn by sending the "continue" prompt; hidden while a turn is running or the session is empty.
description.zh: 在「发送」旁加一个一键「继续」按钮：用 continue 提示词续跑已停止的一轮；轮次进行中或会话为空时不显示。

description.en: Pixel art editor in a DSH conversation tab: pencil, eraser, bucket fill and eyedropper on a grid canvas that zooms in whole steps around the cursor; up to eight layers with merge, reorder, rename and full undo; a 36-slot palette whose edits move the old colour to a free slot so existing pixels never change; PNG export written straight into the session directory.
description.zh: DSH 会话页签里的像素画编辑器：在网格画布上用铅笔、橡皮、油漆桶与取色器作画，滚轮以光标为中心整档缩放；最多八层图层，支持合并、上下移、改名与完整撤销；36 色可编辑调色板，改色时把旧颜色搬到空闲槽，已有像素不会跟着变；PNG 直接导出到当前会话目录。

description.en: Folder-scoped sidebar for DSH Web: by default only folders you load are listed with their sessions; unload a folder without deleting its registration, mark folders to load at startup, and opening a session loads its registered workspace so it does not fall into Ungrouped.
description.zh: DSH Web 的按目录加载侧栏：默认只列出已加载目录及其会话；卸载目录不会删除注册，可设置启动时自动加载；打开会话时会加载其已注册的工作区，避免落入「未分组」。

description.en: Right-side file-tree sidebar that opens workspace files, plus a DeepSeek account balance meter in the composer stats line.
description.zh: 右侧文件树侧栏，可打开工作区文件；并在输入框状态行显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: Adds a space-key Quick Look preview to DSH deliverable cards. Hovering a card and pressing Space opens the native macOS QLPreviewPanel for the file, which covers docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf, images and media that the sidebar preview cannot render. The panel zooms out from the card's position, returns focus to the composer when closed, and exposes hover delay, focus-return and double-click behaviour in Settings > General.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的交付卡片加「按空格用 macOS 原生 Quick Look 预览」的入口。鼠标停在卡片上按空格即打开系统预览面板，覆盖侧栏预览渲染不了的 docx、xlsx、pptx、pdf、图片与音视频。面板从卡片位置放大出现，关闭后焦点回到输入框；悬停延迟、关闭后聚焦、双击预览三项可在设置 > 常规里调。

description.en: Right-click menu and drag support for the Files sidebar on Windows - copy absolute or workspace-relative paths, create files and folders, rename, move entries to the Recycle Bin, and drop a row into the composer to insert an @ reference.
description.zh: Windows 上给 Files 侧栏补右键菜单与拖拽：复制绝对或工作区相对路径、新建文件与文件夹、重命名、把条目移到回收站，以及把行拖进对话栏插入 @ 引用。

description.en: A named-agent-team chat workbench for DSH: per-member model routes with fallback and 3D mascot avatars; private and group chats with mention relay and bounded parallel lanes; a whole department as one agent whose lead dispatches sub-agents that run in parallel on their own models before the lead synthesizes; record search with hit highlighting and today/yesterday/earlier buckets; a four-layer memory system (raw chats → atomic facts → scene summary → user persona) recalled by hybrid BM25 + embedding RRF; plus an avatar library and local/cloud speech input. Hybrid recall needs an embedding endpoint (default: local Ollama qwen3-embedding:0.6b; otherwise BM25 only); speech input needs a local jianchang512/stt service or a cloud ASR key, otherwise it falls back to the browser speech API.
description.zh: 把一支具名智能体团队做成聊天工作台：成员各有可回退的模型路由与 3D 头像；私聊/群聊支持点名接力与受限并行；整个部门可以是一个智能体，主管分派子智能体并行执行后汇总；记录检索带命中高亮与今天/昨天/更早分组；四层记忆（原始会话 → 原子事实 → 场景摘要 → 用户画像）用 BM25 + 向量 RRF 混合召回；另有头像素材库与本地/云端语音输入。混合召回需要 embedding 端点（默认本机 Ollama 的 qwen3-embedding:0.6b，否则只用 BM25）；语音输入需本地 jianchang512/stt 服务或云端 ASR key，否则退回浏览器语音。

description.en: Adds Pin/Unpin to the sidebar session-row menu and a collapsible Pinned Sessions group above the session list, with host-side persistence, hover quick-unpin, collapse memory, and live running-state dots.
description.zh: 在会话行菜单加入 Pin/Unpin，并在侧边栏列表上方提供可折叠的 Pinned Sessions 分组：主机端持久化、悬停快速取消置顶、折叠状态记忆与实时运行状态点。

description.en: Native macOS desktop widgets for DSH: manage any number of widget instances — share quote tickers (5-provider fallback, trading-phase-aware throttling) and notes memos — each an independent NSPanel+WKWebView window spawned detached from the host, dragged anywhere, with a type-aware right-click menu. Instances are edited as cards in a three-view settings page (list / type picker / detail), and a market_quote model tool serves standardized quotes to any session. A Type Studio flow seeds a creation-mode session with an issue-template prompt for authoring new widget types.
description.zh: DSH 原生 macOS 桌面小组件中心：管理任意多个 widget 实例——行情小窗（5 源 fallback、交易时段感知节流）与便签，每实例一个独立 NSPanel+WKWebView 窗口（detached 独立进程、任意拖动、类型感知右键菜单）。实例以三层视图（列表 / 类型选择 / 详情）在 DSH 设置页卡片式配置；market_quote 模型工具供任意会话拉标准化行情；Type Studio 一键创建「创造模式」空会话并预填 issue-template 模板，起草新的 widget type。

description.en: Fork of z-col/dsh-workspace-groups (MIT): a grouped workspace sidebar for the DSH web client, with a science icon set and a docked default workspace; cannot be installed alongside the upstream plugin (same bundle row).
description.zh: z-col/dsh-workspace-groups（MIT）的分支：DSH Web 客户端的分组工作区侧栏，带材料与实验图标集，默认工作区停靠底栏；不能与上游插件同装（同一个 bundle row）。

description.en: Adds a conversation view that maps which skills, MCP tools and subagents a session actually used, with an attribution tree, a call table and an unused inventory.
description.zh: 在会话中新增一个视图，用归因树展示本会话实际调用了哪些技能、MCP 工具与子代理，并附调用明细与未使用清单。

description.en: Renders the final fenced card block of an answer as a typographic card, with card and article layouts, twelve block types and credited images.
description.zh: 把回答末尾的 card 围栏块渲染成排版卡片，支持 card 与 article 两种布局、十二种块类型和带来源的配图。

description.en: Adds a Settings row to the sidebar header before Plugins, which opens the shell's Settings panel.
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部 Plugins 之前新增「设置」一行，点击即打开原生设置面板。

description.en: Freezes the DSH Web GUI reading column at a fixed width and re-aligns the reading position after the window is resized or zoomed.
description.zh: 固定 DSH Web GUI 的正文列宽度，并在窗口缩放后把阅读位置对回原处。

description.en: Gives the web UI the same keyboard shortcuts on Linux that Windows and macOS already get: the host half injects one script into index.html, so a Linux browser reports a Windows platform before the shortcut service reads it, and the built-in table resolves instead of staying empty; a Settings row reports whether the mapping took effect.
description.zh: 让 Linux 上的网页端拥有 Windows / macOS 端那套快捷键：宿主半在 index.html 注入一行脚本，使 Linux 浏览器在快捷键服务读取平台之前报告 Windows 平台，内置键位表因此生效而不是空白；设置页额外显示一行，指示映射是否真的生效。

description.en: Changes the right sidebar panel-fullscreen mode to cover the conversation only: the panel starts at the left rail right edge instead of spanning the whole window, so the session list stays visible while the panel is maximized, and it keeps following the rail as you widen, collapse or drawer it.
description.zh: 把右侧边栏的「面板全屏」改成只覆盖会话区：全屏面板从左侧会话列表栏的右缘开始铺到窗口右缘，最大化时会话列表依然可见，并跟随左栏的拖宽、折叠与窄屏抽屉实时变化。

description.en: Mounted owner of the LLM Providers Settings page: provider cards, drag-reorder card order, and picker sort.
description.zh: LLM Providers 设置页的挂载 owner：provider 卡片、拖拽排序与 picker 排序。

description.en: Four whale-tail animations for the DeepSeek Harness thinking indicator, cycling on every thinking turn.
description.zh: 针对 DSH 思考模式鲸鱼尾巴的动画，丰富成 4 种动画。

description.en: Completes @path references in the Web composer: type @ (optionally ./src/ma) to list matching files and directories, pick one with the arrow keys, and the draft receives an @./relative/path reference (quoted when the path has spaces).
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框补全 @ 路径引用：输入 @（可继续输入 ./src/ma）即列出匹配的文件与目录，用上下键选择后草稿得到 @./相对路径引用（路径含空格时自动加引号）。

description.en: A read-only Cordis Inspect provider that lets an agent see the interface it is driving: outline() reports which UI regions the running shell actually rendered, with occupancy, geometry and current or past failure state; snapshot() returns one region's rendered node tree (tag, role, aria-label, own text, geometry, computed styles) addressed by slot key or CSS selector; failures() keeps a history of regions that failed to render and whether they recovered. Regions are addressed by the anchor the shell already writes for every slot, so it needs no region list and covers regions added later or contributed by other plugins. No UI, no tools, no dependencies, no network access.
description.zh: 只读的 Cordis Inspect provider，让 agent 能看见自己正在驱动的界面：outline() 报告运行中的壳实际渲染了哪些 UI 区域，含占用、几何与当前/历史失败状态；snapshot() 按 slot key 或 CSS 选择器返回某区域的渲染节点树（标签、角色、aria-label、自身文本、几何、计算样式）；failures() 保留「哪些区域渲染失败过、是否已恢复」的历史。寻址用壳为每个 slot 已写好的锚点，无需区域清单，也覆盖以后新增或其他插件贡献的区域。无界面、无工具、无依赖、不发网络请求。

description.en: Right-click menu inside the message composer: for the word under the cursor it checks a bundled English frequency dictionary of about 30,000 words plus a curated list of 182 common misspellings, and offers corrections ranked by edit distance and then word frequency. The same menu keeps add-to-dictionary, cut, copy, paste, select all, undo and redo. The dictionary and the menu are local, so nothing is sent over the network.
description.zh: 输入框右键菜单：对光标处的单词，用内置的约三万个英文高频词表加一份 182 条常见拼错清单做检查，按编辑距离、再按词频排序给出候选；同一个菜单保留加入词典、剪切、复制、粘贴、全选、撤销、重做。词表与菜单全部在本地，不联网。

description.en: Draws every question and answer in the DSH Web conversation blurred until the pointer rests on that row, and locks the mask to always-blurred while the window is unfocused; one control below the composer switches between off, hover to reveal, and always blurred, remembered per browser.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 对话里的提问与回答画成模糊，鼠标停在哪一条才显示哪一条；窗口失焦时自动全糊，谁都看不到指针留下的那条。输入框下方一个按钮在「关闭 / 悬停显示 / 始终模糊」三档间切换，选择按浏览器记住。

description.en: To-do list in the session header: the button cycles through unfinished items and is tinted red, amber or green by due time, and the floating panel adds, edits and ticks off tasks with an optional deadline, with a collapsible done section. Items persist in localStorage and follow the DSH theme.
description.zh: 会话标题栏里的待办清单：按钮轮播未完成事项，按截止时间以红、黄、绿整块着色；浮动面板可新增、编辑、勾选待办并设置截止时间，已完成收进可折叠区域；数据存 localStorage，跟随 DSH 主题。

description.en: Adds a sparkle button left of the model selector in the composer toolbar: one click rewrites the draft in place through the host and briefly offers an undo that restores the original text. A Prompt Enhancement settings section picks the lane — the conversation model (the provider/model the next message would use, falling back to the configured default) or a keyless Pollinations channel that needs no login and no token budget but allows one reply per 30 seconds. During that cooldown a click completes through the conversation model instead of being refused, and the first click after the window reopens returns to the keyless channel on its own. The rewrite keeps the draft's language, and a result in a different language is rejected rather than pasted over the draft.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏、模型选择器左侧加一枚 ✨ 按钮：点一下把草稿经宿主改写成可直接执行的提示词并原地回填，随后短暂显示「撤销」可一键还原原文。设置侧栏「提示词增强」分区可选择改写通道——对话模型（取下一次发消息实际会用的 provider/model，无则回退已配置的默认模型），或 Pollinations 免登录通道（无需登录、不消耗模型额度，但每 30 秒只允许 1 次）。冷却期内点击不会报错也不会被拒，而是自动改用对话模型完成改写；冷却结束后第一次点击自动切回免登录通道。改写结果始终保持与草稿相同的语言，若返回语言不一致则直接报错而不是覆盖草稿。

description.en: Adds a message queue to the sidebar foot: park a thought in a collapsible list, then send one entry to the current session when you choose instead of interrupting the running turn. Entries can be edited or deleted, the list holds two rows and scrolls beyond that, and an unsent composer draft is moved into the queue before a send rather than overwritten.
description.zh: 侧栏底部加一个待发送队列：把临时想到的话存进可折叠的列表，合适的时机再点某一条发送到当前会话，不必插队打断正在跑的回合。条目可编辑、可删除，列表一次露两条、更多滚动，发送前若输入框里还有草稿会先把草稿收进队列而不是覆盖掉。

description.en: Power button in the DSH Web UI session header that lets you close or restart the whole DSH process.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话头部的关机按钮，点击可关闭或重启整个 DSH 进程。

description.en: In-place prompt editing in the web chat: cleanly forks session history at the edited turn, preserves image and file attachments, and auto-archives the superseded branch.
description.zh: DSH Web 聊天就地编辑历史提示词：在目标轮次干净分叉会话历史，原样保留图片与附件，并自动归档旧会话。

description.en: A draggable dock in the top-left corner of the DSH window that stacks three groups in one fixed order: sessions blocked on a person (a tool waiting for approval or the model waiting on an answer), then sessions running right now, then results that finished while you were not looking. Each row opens its session, the collapsed chip shows one count per group, dragging the chip or the title bar moves it anywhere while rows stay clickable, and a single Settings row can switch the whole dock off. It observes only: the Host half records the two blocking paths and hands the request straight to the real answerer without changing the decision.
description.zh: 贴在 DSH 窗口左上角的可拖动任务坞，三组按固定顺序排列：先是要人处理的会话（工具等待批准，或模型等待回答），再是此刻正在执行的会话，最后是你没看时跑完的结果。点任意一行直接打开对应会话，收起态的小胶囊显示三组各自的计数；拖胶囊或标题栏可以把它挪到任意位置，行依然可点；设置里一行开关能整体关掉。它只观察不干预：Host 侧记下两条阻塞路径的请求后原样交给真正的应答方，不改变任何判定。

description.en: Sidebar panel that lists every plugin installed in the current profile and gives each one an enable/disable switch.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板：列出当前 profile 已安装的插件，每行带一个启用/停用开关。

description.en: Takes Enter away from sending in the DSH composer: Enter inserts a line break, every Ctrl/Cmd/Alt+Enter variant is swallowed, and messages leave only from the send button. A gray hint in the input box says so before the first keystroke and stays beside the button while typing.
description.zh: 让 Enter 不再发送：在 DSH 输入框里按 Enter 只换行，Ctrl/Cmd/Alt+Enter 一律吞掉，消息只能点发送按钮发出去。输入框灰字提示「已屏蔽Enter 发送」，空输入时接在占位符后面，开始打字后常驻发送按钮左侧。

description.en: Stacks the sidebar footer actions into one full-width row each, and lines their icons up on one left edge.
description.zh: 把侧边栏底部的动作按钮改成一行一个、铺满整行，并让各行的图标落在同一条竖线上。

description.en: Adds a per-answer Process drawer that streams, in Simplified Chinese, the agent thinking, tool calls and errors for that turn.
description.zh: 在每条回答旁加「进程」抽屉，用简体中文流式讲解该回合 agent 的思考、工具调用与报错。

description.en: Hide or show each button under an assistant reply, reorder them by dragging, and collect the hidden ones behind a single ⋯ button.
description.zh: 隐藏或显示助手回答底部的每个按钮，可拖动调整顺序，并把隐藏的收进一个「⋯」。

description.en: Rebind which key sends a message and which key starts a new line in the DeepSeek Harness composer; Enter sends and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter breaks the line by default, and either chord can be re-recorded from a settings page.
description.zh: 自定义 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里哪个键发送消息、哪个键换行；默认 Enter 发送、Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 换行，两个组合键都可以在设置页里重新录制。

description.en: Quote any message of the current conversation into the composer: pick one from the @ menu, click the quote button on a user or assistant message, or select text and use Quote in the right-click menu. Quotes show as numbered chips in the composer and as summary bubbles above it; after sending, each quote becomes a fenced block so the model can tell quoted text from new text.
description.zh: 把本对话里的任意一条消息引用进输入框：@ 菜单选择，或点用户消息、AI 回复上的引用按钮，也可以选中文字后右键「引用」。引用在输入框里是带序号的芯片，上方浮出摘要气泡；发送后每条引用展开成独立块，模型能分清引用内容与新写内容。

description.en: Shares sidebar navigation scrolling with Projects lists; supports native workspace scroll handoff and legacy outer scrolling (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1).
description.zh: DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 侧栏共享滚动：功能菜单与 Projects 列表共用滚动区，工作区支持原生滚动接力或旧版外层滚动。

description.en: A right-side panel that tells you in plain words what a long-running task has finished, what it is doing right now, and what it will most likely do next — read-only, never touches your session, and you can ask it a question or just chat with it while the task keeps running. Requires the dsh-better-sidebar plugin, whose right sidebar hosts the panel.
description.zh: 在右侧栏用大白话告诉你长任务做完了什么、现在手头是什么、接下来大概要做什么：不是复述思考链，而是攒一段时间或几件大事压成两三句；工具名和报错码都翻成人话。只读不写会话，跑着的时候也能随时问一句，或者随便聊两句。 需先安装 dsh-better-sidebar（面板借用它的右栏）。

description.en: Edge glow for DeepSeek Harness: blue while it drives your mouse and keyboard, amber while it asks a question, red while it waits for approval, plus a top banner naming the current action. Desktop only: the overlay is a separate Electron process (auto-detected from the DSH desktop app or dsh-pet; override with DSH_ELECTRON_PATH) and stays dark without one.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加光：模型接管键盘鼠标时屏幕四边亮蓝光、提问时琥珀、等你批准时红色，并在屏幕中上方显示正在做什么。仅桌面端：覆盖层是独立 Electron 进程（从 DSH 桌面版或 dsh-pet 自动查找，可用 DSH_ELECTRON_PATH 覆盖），没有 Electron 时不会亮。

description.en: Drag or paste files or pictures into the DSH Web composer as one scrolling row of chips, sent as @path references.
description.zh: 把文件或图片拖进 DSH Web 输入框，以一排小卡片展示，发送时以 @path 引用传给模型。

description.en: A draggable floating card for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that combines a Pomodoro timer, an off-work countdown, and focus statistics. Each launch opens on a fresh focus phase; phase completion triggers a chime, card shake, and particle burst. Includes today's pomodoros, focus minutes, streak and a 7-day chart, rhythm reminders for wrapping up and eye rest, optional system notifications, tab-title timer, auto-start, +5 minutes, and a custom long-break interval.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的悬浮卡片，集成番茄钟、下班倒计时与专注统计。每次启动默认进入专注时段；阶段结束有提示音、卡片抖动与粒子动画。含今日番茄数、专注时长、连续天数与近 7 天柱状图，下班收尾与护眼节律提醒，并可选系统通知、标签页倒计时、自动开始下一阶段、+5 分钟与自定义长休轮数。

description.en: Standalone mobile page for DeepSeek Harness served at /dsh-web-mobile-pmsfh/, with workspace-grouped sessions, streaming chat with markdown and collapsible reasoning, attachments via the official fileUploads API, read-only workspace file browsing, and login-gated static routes.
description.zh: DSH 的独立移动端页面，挂在 /dsh-web-mobile-pmsfh/ 下，不是给官方界面做移动适配：会话按工作区分组，聊天支持流式输出、markdown 与思考过程折叠，附件走官方 fileUploads 接口，工作区文件只读浏览，静态路由需登录后访问。

description.en: Count-up Pomodoro: focus counts up with no ceiling and never stops itself at 25 minutes, finishing drops straight into a short break, and a status board plus the four quadrants keep the task list in view.
description.zh: 正计时番茄钟：专注时段不设上限，不会在 25 分钟自动停止，结束即进入短休息；附带状态看板与四象限任务管理。

description.en: A diamond button in the composer that rewrites your draft into a structured prompt and puts the original draft back when clicked again.
description.zh: 输入框里的菱形按钮：把草稿改写成结构化提示词，再点一次还原原始输入。

description.en: Right-click a file or folder in the right sidebar file tree to add it to the composer as an @ reference (⌘/Ctrl and Shift multi-select insert a whole batch), open it with the default application, or reveal it in the system file manager. Open and reveal go through the built-in open-in-app host capability, so those entries appear unless the host explicitly reports the capability as unsupported.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文件树里右键，可把文件或文件夹作为 @ 引用加进输入框（⌘/Ctrl 与 Shift 多选可整批插入）、用默认应用打开，或在系统文件管理器中显示。打开与显示走宿主内置的 open-in-app 能力，只有宿主明确回答不支持时才隐藏这两项。

description.en: A polish button in the composer trailing controls that rewrites the draft in place with the model. Context is matched by topic, not by recency: anchors from the draft (paths, identifiers, quoted text, CJK bigrams) pick the earlier messages about the same task, so a session that interleaves several tasks does not leak another task goal or files into the rewrite — and the prompt explicitly lets the model ignore the extract when it does not fit. The result goes back through the same undo-able editor path a human edit uses. Drafts holding reference chips (@file, folder, session) or a claimed /command, and drafts mid-submission, disable the button instead of silently dropping references.
description.zh: 输入框右下工具区里的 ✨ 按钮，把草稿原地改写成更清楚的请求。上下文按话题挑而不按时间取：从草稿里抽锚点（文件路径、标识符、引号文字、中文二字词），在最近消息里挑同一话题的几条，所以一个会话里夹着多个任务时不会把别的任务的目标或文件带进改写结果；提示词也明确允许模型在上下文不像时完全忽略它。改写走与人工编辑同一条可撤销路径，⌘Z 即可还原。草稿里有引用 chip（@文件、文件夹、会话）或已认领的 /命令、以及正在提交时，按钮禁用 —— 宁可不动，也不悄悄丢掉引用。

description.en: Ask a sidebar assistant about selected assistant text: an ephemeral right-side panel answers from a snapshot of the main conversation's LLM history with streaming Markdown, collapsible thinking and multi-turn follow-ups, without touching the main conversation.
description.zh: 选中助手回答中的文本，在临时右侧面板向侧边栏助手提问：基于主对话 LLM 历史快照回答，支持流式 Markdown、可折叠思考与多轮追问，不打扰主对话。

description.en: Fast `@` file/session reference caching for the DSH Web GUI: preloaded indexes, browser-local keystroke filtering and native mention serialization.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框 `@` 文件/会话引用加速：预加载索引、浏览器本地按键过滤、保留原生 mention 序列化。

description.en: Named AGENTS.md presets for DSH: save instruction sets under $DSH_HOME/agents-md-presets, apply one to the current conversation workspace, edit bodies in your own editor, and keep one rolling backup of the file being overwritten.
description.zh: 为 DSH 维护多套具名 AGENTS.md 预设：正文存在 $DSH_HOME/agents-md-presets，在会话里选一套写入该会话工作区的 AGENTS.md，正文用本机编辑器修改，覆盖前把原文件留一份最近备份。
