description.en: Turn any DeepSeek Harness answer into a polished PNG share card: click a button under the reply, the answer is re-typeset on a canvas (8 gradient presets, light/dark, three fonts, width 720/880/1080, radius, padding, font size, line height, 1x-3x export, code wrap/highlight/line numbers, custom title and footer). Fully local rendering — no upload, no third-party dependency.
description.zh: 把任意一条 AI 回答一键变成精美的 PNG 分享卡片：点回复下面的按钮，回答会被重新排版画到画布上（8 套渐变预设、深浅主题、三种字体、宽度 720/880/1080、圆角、内边距、字号、行高、1×–3× 导出倍率、代码折行/高亮/行号、自定义标题与页脚）。纯本地渲染，不联网、不上传、无第三方依赖。

description.en: Splash and exit animations for DeepSeek Harness. Five hand-drawn styles (whale light-sweep, pulse, stardust, typewriter, radar rings) — or drop in your own video / GIF. A settings panel controls speed, particle count, accent colour, wording, mute and fit. The exit animation needs the bundled one-time desktop-shell patch (node tools/patch-asar.mjs --apply, reversible); without it closing only hides the window.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的开场 / 退场动画：5 套纯代码自绘样式（鲸鱼光扫 / 极简脉冲 / 星尘汇聚 / 打字机 / 雷达环），也可以换成你自己的视频或动图；设置页可调速度、粒子数、主色、文案、静音与画面适配。退场动画需先运行 node tools/patch-asar.mjs --apply 给桌面壳打补丁（可回滚）；不打补丁时关闭只隐藏窗口。

description.en: Windows-only process control for the harness: a sidebar button that shuts DSH down through the host's own graceful exit path, an app-window / normal-tab switch on the Plugins card that rewrites the desktop shortcut and restarts, and advanced settings for the wait before exit, the process exit code and a force-quit option.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 的进程控制插件：侧边栏按钮经宿主的优雅退出通道关闭 DSH；插件卡片可切换「应用窗口 / 普通标签页」——会改写桌面快捷方式并重启；另有退出前等待、进程退出码与强制结束三项高级设置。

description.en: Renders `latex` / `tex` code blocks in the chat as KaTeX formulae, and injects a system-prompt section that tells the model to write `$...$` and `$$...$$` instead of fenced code blocks.
description.zh: 把对话里的 `latex` / `tex` 代码块渲染成 KaTeX 公式，并向系统提示词注入「用 `$...$` / `$$...$$` 写公式」的规范。

description.en: All-in-one inline media previewer for mip-img/mip-video/mip-audio fences with streaming playback, ffmpeg transcoding fallback, lightbox, and trust-fenced LAN/mobile access.
description.zh: 全能内联媒体预览插件，支持 mip-img/mip-video/mip-audio 围栏的流式播放、ffmpeg 转码回退、灯箱浏览及信任围栏局域网/移动端访问。

description.en: Upload any file to DSH, isolated per workspace and session — a composer file library with server-side thumbnails and a context menu to open, copy, re-download or delete.
description.zh: 允许将任意文件上传给 DSH，按工作区与会话隔离。输入框内置文件库，服务端生成缩略图，右键菜单可打开、复制、重新下载或删除。

description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness home screen with a configurable palette and background image, a custom hero and sidebar logo, default 3×2 decks of recently used workspaces and quick links (local Chrome history or a custom list), and up to four API-usage widgets (DeepSeek balance, MiniMax, Cline Pass, OpenCode Go) refreshed on a configurable interval. The decks stay on the new-session screen and every option is edited from a built-in settings panel.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 首屏换成自定义主页：可配置配色与背景图、自定义首屏与侧栏 Logo、默认 3×2 的最近工作区与常用入口（取自本机 Chrome 历史或自定义列表）、最多 4 个 API 用量组件（DeepSeek 余额、MiniMax、Cline Pass、OpenCode Go）且刷新间隔可调；卡片只在新建会话首屏出现，全部选项在自带设置面板里调整。

description.en: Publishes the desktop shell's file-path bridge as the host-path seam the composer reads, so files and folders dropped into the composer become @path references instead of uploaded copies (images still upload through the native image channel).
description.zh: 把桌面壳的文件路径桥接发布为输入框读取的 host-path 接口，让拖入输入框的文件与文件夹变成 @path 引用而不是上传副本（图片仍走原生图片通道上传）。

description.en: Adds a cross-workspace activity sidebar for running, waiting and unread sessions, with search, optional pinned and scheduled-delivery groups, local read tracking and confirmed archiving.
description.zh: 跨工作区聚合运行中、待回复和未读会话，支持搜索、可选的置顶与定时交付分组、插件本地已读记录，以及经确认的归档操作。

description.en: Read books in the DSH sidebar - import EPUB/TXT/Markdown, get a five-part close reading for every chapter (paragraph summary, best sentences, what the author is doing, the AI's own opinion, what is missing), listen with TTS, ask questions while listening, and export the whole book to one HTML page. Export collects the chapters that already have a close reading rather than unread chapters.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏读书：导入 EPUB/TXT/Markdown，逐章给出五段式精读（本段落概括 / 文章美句 / 作者表达 / AI 观点 / AI 认为需要补充点），可朗读、边听边问，还能把整本讲解导出成一份网页。导出只装订已经生成精读的章节，未读章节不会包含在内。

description.en: Grouped skill picker for the composer. A button beside the input box opens a panel that browses every installed skill by scene (research, office, data, writing, media, dev), with auto-classification for new skills, Chinese annotations, search and drill-down; picking one inserts the /skill-name gesture.
description.zh: 输入框技能分组选择器：🧩按钮弹出按场景分组（科研、办公、数据、写作、媒体、开发）的技能面板，新装技能自动分类，中文说明、搜索与双层下钻，点选即插入 /技能名 手势。

description.en: Manage DSH MCP servers from the web settings panel: list, add, edit, remove, enable/disable with live status.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板管理 DSH 的 MCP 服务器：实时状态、新增、编辑、删除、启用/禁用。

description.en: Renders ```mermaid code blocks in DSH Web chat as SVG diagrams, with a diagram/source toggle, light/dark theme following and source-preserving error fallback.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话消息中的 mermaid 代码块渲染为 SVG 图形，支持图形与源码切换、跟随深浅色主题，渲染失败时保留源码并显示错误。

description.en: Windows floating status lamp outside the DSH window: a borderless always-on-top glowing orb on a fully transparent background — green with a breathing halo while tasks run, orange shaking for approval, blue floating for your input, dim grey idle, dark grey host offline; hovering lists each session's latest task, drag to move, and the lamp self-extinguishes within seconds when the plugin is switched off.
description.zh: 悬浮在 DSH 应用之外的 Windows 状态灯：无边框置顶发光圆灯，背景完全透明——绿灯光晕呼吸表示运行中、橙灯抖动待授权、蓝灯漂浮待你交互、灰灯空闲、暗灰宿主离线；悬停逐行列出各会话正在运行的任务，可拖动记忆位置，插件被关闭后数秒内自动熄灭。

description.en: A camera button in the DSH composer toolbar that opens the OS screenshot tool (Windows Snipping Tool; macOS screencapture and Linux GNOME Screenshot / Spectacle / scrot are untested, and scrot needs wl-copy or xclip) and leaves the shot on the clipboard for Ctrl+V; the host route only accepts requests whose Host header is loopback.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入面板工具行加一个相机按钮，点击调起系统自带截图工具（Windows 截图工具已实测；macOS screencapture、Linux GNOME Screenshot / Spectacle / scrot 未实机验证，scrot 需 wl-copy 或 xclip），截图进剪贴板后按 Ctrl+V 粘贴；宿主路由只接受 Host 为本机回环地址的 POST。

description.en: Local Markdown notebook: a three-column vault (rail, folder tree, editor), split live preview, tags, stars and pins, a todo centre that gathers every checkbox in the vault and writes ticks back to the file, full-text search, session-to-note deposit, insert a note into a conversation, save an answer as a note, links back to the originating answer, vault-directory and text-size settings, and four note_* tools.
description.zh: 本地 Markdown 笔记库：三栏布局（导航栏、目录树、编辑器）、双栏实时预览、标签、收藏与置顶、聚合全库复选框并回写文件的待办中心、全文搜索、会话沉淀成笔记、把笔记插入对话、把回答保存为笔记、跳回来源回答的链接、笔记库目录与字号设置，以及四个 note_* 工具。

description.en: Customize the DeepSeek Harness desktop shortcut icon: pick a preset or upload an image, auto-remove the white backdrop, build a multi-size ICO, and write the shortcut in one click.
description.zh: 自定义 DeepSeek Harness 桌面快捷方式图标：选预设或上传图片，自动去除白底、生成多尺寸 ICO，一键写入桌面快捷方式。

description.en: A draggable floating clock for the DSH Web GUI with analog and digital faces, a focus timer, four themes, and persistent placement.
description.zh: 可拖动的 DSH 网页悬浮时钟：支持数字与指针表盘、专注计时、四套主题，并会记住窗口位置。

description.en: Monthly household budget page in the sidebar: income, fixed and variable expenses, savings, emergency fund, debt and a month-by-month review, with totals, per-item budget differences and a savings, debt or home goal. Bookkeeping only, no investment advice.
description.zh: 侧边栏月度家庭预算表：收入、固定支出、可变支出、储蓄、应急金、债务与按月复盘，含合计、逐项预算差额与储蓄／还债／买房目标。只做收支整理，不提供投资建议。

description.en: Sticky-note wall in the sidebar with pasted images and text, due reminders, done state, shortcuts, a pin-on-top floating window, appearance skins, and a native always-on-top Windows desktop window.
description.zh: 左侧栏便签墙：粘贴图片与文本、到期提醒、完成状态、快捷键、可置顶浮窗、外观皮肤，以及 Windows 桌面置顶窗口。

description.en: Converts file paths in chat to clickable links with sidebar preview, external editor opening, and theme customization.
description.zh: 对话文件路径高亮与交互插件，支持侧边栏秒级预览、外部编辑器跳转与资源管理器定位，支持强调色自定义。

description.en: High-precision East-8 thinking timestamp and duration counter for DeepSeek Harness desktop without prompt modification.
description.zh: 纯前端交互的 DSH 思考输出东八区时间戳与耗时引擎，脱离提示词且思考完成后完整保留耗时。

description.en: Adds folders to a running DSH Web workspace from the Windows Explorer context menu and starts dsh web automatically when needed; the menu itself requires a one-time per-user PowerShell installer run from a repository clone (no admin rights).
description.zh: 从 Windows 资源管理器右键把文件夹加入正在运行的 DSH 网页版工作区，并在需要时自动启动 dsh web；右键菜单需先从仓库克隆运行一次按用户的 PowerShell 安装脚本（无需管理员权限）。

description.en: Reasoning translation for the DSH Web UI: template HTTP translation sites, or a model route through a Harness-registered provider or a custom OpenAI-compatible provider declared in the plugin.
description.zh: 把展开的思考内容翻成界面语言：翻译来源可以是任意 HTTP 站点模板，也可以是模型（DSH 已注册提供商，或插件自带的自定义 OpenAI 兼容提供商）。

description.en: Sorchron Study Board, a study workspace plugin with pomodoro timer, task management and activity heatmap for DSH harness. Records stay in the browser's localStorage (JSON export for backup) and the plugin makes no network requests.
description.zh: 溯时学习工作台，为DSH提供番茄计时、任务管理与学习热力图的学习工作台插件。记录只存在浏览器的 localStorage（可导出 JSON 备份），插件不发任何网络请求。

description.en: Sidebar file tree that covers the session workspace root together with every additional root registered through multi-root-workspace, so sibling checkouts are browsable from one tab. Directory levels load lazily, changed and untracked files carry Git markers, and clicking a file opens its content inline beside the tree. Read-only: it never writes, renames or deletes anything. Needs the dsh-better-sidebar plugin, which serves the directory listings; its own routes (roots, git status/diff, image preview) take absolute paths from the page and have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 侧栏文件树，把会话主目录与 multi-root-workspace 登记的每个附加根放在一起浏览：平级仓库在同一个页签里都能看，目录按需懒加载，改动和未跟踪文件带 Git 标记，点文件在树旁边直接内联预览。纯只读，不会写入、重命名或删除任何文件。需要 dsh-better-sidebar 插件（目录列表走它的路由）；插件自己的路由（根列表、git 状态/diff、图片预览）直接接收页面传来的绝对路径，没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Moves Settings out of the sidebar footer account menu into its own row at the top of the sidebar, hides the 新会话 new-session button, and hides the sidebar footer: the account launcher, the footer settings cell, and the plugin-runtime badge. Cmd/Ctrl+N still starts a session and Settings is still reachable.
description.zh: 把侧边栏「设置」从底部账号菜单移成顶部独立一行，隐藏「新会话」按钮，并隐藏侧边栏底部：账号菜单、底部设置单元与插件运行时条。Cmd/Ctrl+N 仍可新建会话，设置仍可打开。

description.en: Sets the chat transcript's markdown line height and paragraph gap, both adjustable under Settings > General.
description.zh: 调整对话正文的行高与段间距，两个数值在设置 → 通用里可改。

description.en: Interactive cards in replies, built from a fixed catalog of 31 components (sliders, inputs, sortable tables, charts, function plots, typeset formulas, tabs, checklists, flowcharts, quiz buttons, an animation player): controls recompute in the browser without another model call, and the model never writes HTML or JavaScript. Includes a calculus engine (integrals, derivatives, limits, sums, roots, Taylor polynomials) and a bundled skill that teaches the model when to use a card.
description.zh: 渐进式交互：回复里的可交互卡片，由 31 个固定组件搭成（滑块、输入框、可排序表格、图表、函数图像、公式排版、分页、勾选清单、流程图、答题按钮、动画播放器）。调节控件在浏览器内重算，不再调用模型；模型不写任何 HTML 或 JavaScript。内置微积分引擎（定积分、导数、极限、求和、求根、泰勒多项式）和一个教模型何时用卡片的技能。

description.en: Tab to toggle plan mode on/off.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框中按 Tab 键开/关 plan 模式。

description.en: Codex-style text annotation for conversations: select text, add a quote with your comment, inject it into the composer, and expand sent annotations as a pill.
description.zh: Codex 风格对话文字批注：选中原文加注释、引用进对话、发送后以「N 条注释」胶囊展开。

description.en: Codex-style right-edge workspace for the dsh web UI: file tree with preview tabs (Markdown/source), an embedded browser (direct/proxy iframe), and a side chat streaming from the host LLM — all as switchable tabs in the native details column.
description.zh: Codex 式右侧工作区：文件树 + 预览页签（Markdown/源码）、嵌入式浏览器（直连/代理 iframe）、侧边聊天（直连 host LLM 流式对话），全部收敛为原生 details 右栏的页签，可开关多开。

description.en: Renders the chat turn navigator as a clock-like half dial: one graduation per turn, a purple graduation every fifth turn, and a blue needle on the current turn.
description.zh: 把对话右侧的轮次导航画成带刻度的半轮盘：一轮一根刻度，每第五根是紫色，细蓝色指针指向当前轮次。

description.en: Adds a Markdown outline and full-reply search to conversations, with section references, reversible turn hiding, and new sessions from selected turns.
description.zh: 为会话提供 Markdown 目录与回复全文搜索，支持章节引用、可逆隐藏轮次及从所选轮次创建新会话。

description.en: A draggable whale-maid physics widget for the DSH Web UI: throw it around, catch token coins, and eat rice bowls.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的「鲸鱼女仆」物理挂件：拖拽投掷、吃 token 币计分、每满 500 个 token 冒一碗白饭。

description.en: Makes copying math from DSH chat put LaTeX source ($...$ or $$...$$) on the clipboard instead of rendered KaTeX markup; code blocks and the prompt box keep native copy behavior.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里复制含公式的内容时，剪贴板里得到 $...$ / $$...$$ 的 LaTeX 源码，而不是 KaTeX 渲染碎片；代码块与输入框保持原生复制。

description.en: Vietnamese (tiếng Việt) language pack for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: hand-translated dictionaries for 61 namespaces (3,477 strings) that take effect when Vietnamese is picked in Settings → Language, plus a /vi-sync command that translates strings added by newer plugin versions through the harness translator service.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 增加越南语：61 个命名空间、3,477 条人工翻译词条，在「设置 → 语言」里选中越南语即生效；另带 /vi-sync 命令，用 Harness 内置翻译服务补译新版本新增的字符串。

description.en: Configurable chat auto-scroll — paced section-by-section reading with size-proportional pauses, smooth follow, step and hold modes, hotkeys, and per-session open positions.
description.zh: 可配置的聊天自动滚动——按节定速阅读（停顿时长与篇幅成比例）、平滑跟随、单步与固定模式，支持快捷键与按会话记忆打开位置。

description.en: Adds an installed-plugin group to the @ menu, split into System and User, groups session mentions by folder, and gives section headers sticky positioning, row counts, and fold controls.
description.zh: 在 @ 菜单里增加已安装插件（系统 / 用户分组），会话按所在文件夹归类，分组标题吸顶、显示行数、可折叠。

description.en: Adds an installed-plugin picker beside the composer: drag a plugin name into the prompt at the drop point, open a draggable plugin rail in the right sidebar by double-clicking the entry, and choose which plugins (and remarks) appear in Settings.
description.zh: 在输入框旁增加已安装插件选择器：把插件名拖到提示词的落点插入，双击入口在右侧边栏打开可拖动插件栏，并可在设置中选择显示哪些插件、填写备注。

description.en: Right-Sidebar tab menu enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: adds a 'Close other tabs' item that closes every content tab of the session except the one whose menu is open and the docked guide.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏增强：右键 tab 菜单增加「关闭其他标签」，一键关闭当前会话中除当前 tab 与引导页外的所有内容标签。

description.en: Restart button for DSH Desktop placed directly above the sidebar account button.
description.zh: 用于重启 DSH 桌面的按钮，直接放在侧边栏账号按钮上方。

description.en: ADHD-friendly focus soundscape docked under the DSH composer: five procedurally synthesised noise colours (white, pink, brown, rain, fan), a live-waveform orb, a 15-90 minute fade-out timer and a liquid-glass popover. No audio assets and no network requests.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的 ADHD 友好专注声景：白/粉/棕噪与雨声、风扇五种程序化合成音色，实时波形声球、15–90 分钟定时淡出与液态玻璃浮层；无音频素材、无网络请求。

description.en: Compact top tools, untitled inbox and lower Working/Settled shelves; native menus, search highlighting, keyboard navigation, metadata backups and an original-layout switch. Chinese UI. On DSH 0.2.1-rc.5: macOS Desktop verified; Windows Desktop checked for cold starts, compact/original layouts at 1280x820 and 1471x1200, search, project filtering and native session menus. Linux and arbitrary third-party plugin combinations remain unverified.
description.zh: 顶部工具区与原布局切换，上方直接查看会话，下方收纳工作中与已整理；支持原生菜单、搜索高亮、键盘操作及整理备份。中文界面。DSH 0.2.1-rc.5：macOS 桌面版已验证；Windows 桌面版已检查冷启动、1280×820 与 1471×1200 下的紧凑/原布局、搜索、项目筛选和原生会话菜单。Linux 及任意第三方插件组合仍未验证。

description.en: Floating DeepSeek API time-of-day pricing window with Chinese legal-holiday awareness, account balance and estimated project spend; includes a green/orange 24-hour timeline and collapsible model, billing-rule and holiday sections.
description.zh: DeepSeek API 时段价格悬浮窗，联网读取中国法定节假日，显示账户余额与本项目花费估算；含绿/橙 24 小时时间轴和可折叠的模型、计费规则、节假日区块。

description.en: Adds a 最近 (Recent) section below the workspace list in the DSH web sidebar that flattens the newest sessions of every workspace into one timeline, reusing the session rows and hover cards the shell already renders, paging in earlier sessions as you scroll, and folding the workspace list itself to the five folders with the newest history. Requires DSH ^0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏的工作区列表下面加一个「最近」区块，把所有工作区的最新会话平铺成一条时间线，行与悬停卡片复用外壳自己渲染的会话行，滚到底继续加载更早的会话；同时把工作区列表本身折叠为最近有记录的 5 个文件夹。需要 DSH ^0.2.0-rc.1。

description.en: A right-sidebar session panel that lists every Skill, MCP tool call and file read or write by turn and step, with per-failure error detail.
description.zh: 右侧边栏的会话面板：按轮次与步骤列出全部 Skill、MCP 工具调用与文件读写，并展开每次失败的报错详情。

description.en: Adds a sidebar panel that browses the 设记 Design Memory component library by asset type, with live previews, design tokens, and copyable HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Component pages ship with the plugin; fonts and images load from the public library site.
description.zh: 在侧边栏增加设记 Design Memory 组件库面板：按资产类型浏览，支持实时预览、查看设计参数并复制 HTML/CSS/JS。组件页面随插件打包，字体与图片从公开资源库站点加载。

description.en: Select text or tables in conversations to bookmark, highlight, and annotate in the right sidebar, with a collapsible all-sessions bookmark page.
description.zh: 在对话中选中文本或表格右键收藏并高亮，在右侧边栏内联添加注释，并提供按会话分组折叠的全局书签页。

description.en: Three-party collaboration protocol for dsh: Step List state machine, five-tier review chain (Gemini/web/Claude Code/dialog/manual), alternatives adjudication, cross-restart resume with heartbeat, and capability persistence.
description.zh: dsh 三方协作协议插件：Step List 状态机、五级审核链（含本地 Claude Code 混合审）、alternatives 裁决、无介入续跑与能力持久化体系。

description.en: Adds Notion-style auto-hide to the left and right DSH sidebars: hover the matching window edge to expand, move away to collapse, and click the sidebar button to pin it open.
description.zh: 为 DSH 左右侧边栏加上 Notion 式自动收起：指针移到窗口对应边缘时展开，移开后收起，点击侧边栏按钮可固定展开。

description.en: Knowledge-base browser panel: tree browsing plus drag-to-cite (path-only or full content) into the composer.
description.zh: 知识库浏览器面板：目录浏览，支持把节点拖进输入框生成引用（仅路径或附全文）。

description.en: Plain click on an Obsidian vault file in the DSH conversation opens it in the right app: notes in the Obsidian app, configured types (for example .tex) in VS Code with their project folder as the workspace; Cmd/Ctrl-click keeps the in-app preview. The open_vault_file tool follows the same routing, and every open is confined to the configured vaultRoot.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里普通点击 Obsidian 库内文件会打开到对应 App：笔记进 Obsidian，配置的类型（例如 .tex）进 VS Code 并以项目目录作为工作区；Cmd/Ctrl+点击保留内置预览。open_vault_file 工具走同一套路由，所有打开都限定在配置的 vaultRoot 内。

description.en: Select text in a conversation and park it as a quote card above the composer; the input box keeps only your question, and the quoted text rides along with the message you send. Package name: dsh-quote-tray.
description.zh: 在对话里选中文字，选区变成输入框上方的一张引用卡片，输入框里只写问题；发送时引用原文自动跟在消息后面，模型能读到完整内容。包名 dsh-quote-tray。

description.en: Turns the DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel entries and footer entries into one row of icon-only squares with hover names, adds four icon-size presets, per-entry show/hide switches and up/down ordering, and puts a Settings shortcut in the footer row.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏的面板入口与底部入口改成只显示图标的并排方块，悬停显示名称；提供四档图标大小、逐项显隐开关与上下排序，并在底部加一个设置入口。

description.en: Microsoft To Do panel: browse lists, add, edit, complete and reopen tasks, and open notes, due date, reminder, recurrence, steps and attachments. Lists can be collected into local groups, and a batch of tasks can be picked into a My Day shortlist. Signs in with the Microsoft device-code flow; the token cache belongs to the upstream microsoft-todo-mcp server, pinned to 0.2.0 and started with npx (so Node.js and npm access are needed) with only an allow-listed environment, while groups and My Day live locally. Today, Overdue, My Day and new due dates and reminders follow the device time zone (override with DSH_TODO_TZONE). Chinese and English UI.
description.zh: 微软待办面板：浏览清单，新增、编辑、完成与重新打开任务，并查看备注、截止日期、提醒、重复、步骤与附件；清单可在本机分组，也能挑一批任务放进「我的一天」。用微软设备码登录，令牌缓存由上游 microsoft-todo-mcp 服务持有（版本固定为 0.2.0，经 npx 启动，需要 Node.js 与可访问 npm，子进程只拿到白名单环境变量）；分组与「我的一天」存在本机。「今日」「逾期」「我的一天」以及新设的截止日期和提醒按设备时区计算（可用 DSH_TODO_TZONE 覆盖）。中英双语界面。

description.en: Floating translucent DeepSeek whale elf on the DSH page that opens a draggable, minimizable temporary chat window using the session model or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with real-time streaming.
description.zh: DSH 页面悬浮的半透明 DeepSeek 鲸鱼小精灵：点击打开可拖动、可最小化的临时聊天浮窗，支持跟随会话模型或自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点实时流式输出。

description.en: Orders and folds the DSH left sidebar by what is actually running — a workspace floats to the top when one of its sessions starts and keeps that place when the session finishes, only the N most recently active workspaces stay expanded, and six switches plus one count control each rule.
description.zh: 按实际运行状态排序与折叠 DSH 左侧栏：有会话开跑的工作区浮到最前，会话跑完仍留在原位，只有最近活跃的 N 个工作区保持展开；六个开关加一个数量控制各条规则。

description.en: Rotating word and phrase flashcards under the composer, plus a right-sidebar page with an English topic brief, topic-matched vocabulary and a word book.
description.zh: 输入框下方轮播单词与短语闪卡，右侧栏提供当前会话主题英文简报、主题词汇与生词本。

description.en: Composer button that opens a panel listing every skill available to the current session with Chinese titles, purposes and usage examples, and lets you catalogue newly installed skills in one click (saved locally).
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏提供一个按钮，一键打开技能面板，列出当前会话的全部技能（中文标题、用途与例句），并可一键收录新安装但尚未录入词典的技能（保存在本机）。

description.en: Adds a system tray icon to DSH Desktop, with settings to hide the main window to the tray on minimize or close and self-healing after app updates.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 增加系统托盘图标，可在设置中选择最小化或关闭时隐藏到托盘，应用更新后自动恢复。

description.en: Opens a temporary side conversation in the right Sidebar that reuses the host conversation UI, so answers render with the same markdown, tool steps, timing and token usage as the main thread. Selecting part of an answer opens that conversation side chat with the passage quoted: the quote waits as a pill inside the composer, rides along with the next message, and joins the side chat context. The side chat runs on its own memory-only session: the parent snapshot is reference context only, and nothing is written to the session log.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏打开一个临时侧边对话，复用宿主原生会话界面，回答的 Markdown 渲染、工具步骤、用时与 Token 用量都与主对话一致；在主对话里选中一段回答，即可唤起该对话的侧聊并把选中内容作为引用胶囊停在输入框内，随下一条消息一起生效，并计入侧聊上下文。侧聊运行在独立的内存会话上：主对话快照只作为参考上下文，不写入会话日志。

description.en: Adds an action to the session menu and the session title bar that opens the artifacts folder of that conversation: it reads the session log, works out which directories the conversation wrote files to, and opens them in Explorer.
description.zh: 在会话列表菜单和会话标题栏加一个动作：直接打开这个对话的产物文件夹。它读会话日志算出该对话往哪些目录写过文件，再用资源管理器打开，不必自己翻工作区根目录。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu to DeepSeek Harness inside desktop shells that ship no context menu: cut, copy, paste and select all in the composer, copy and copy-as-plain-text on selected text elsewhere, and a search entry that opens the default browser with a configurable engine.
description.zh: 在没有自带右键菜单的桌面外壳中为 DeepSeek Harness 补上右键菜单：输入框内的剪切、复制、粘贴、全选，别处选中文字的复制与复制为纯文本，以及用可配置引擎在默认浏览器中搜索。

description.en: Ghost-text suggestions in the composer: the message you are most likely to send next after a reply, and a continuation of your draft when you press Tab, including images attached to the composer. Tab accepts, Alt+Down cycles candidates, and the Settings row shows which model route answered. Adapted from Stijnus/dsh-composer-predictions, so do not enable both at once (they share the composer overlay and the Tab key); each suggestion is an extra model call on the Session's model unless you pin another.
description.zh: 在输入框中显示灰色建议：回复结束后预测你下一条最可能发送的消息；草稿末尾或附上图片后按 Tab 续写，附上的图片会随续写一起发送。Tab 采纳，Alt+↓ 切换候选，设置页会显示最近一次用的是哪个模型。基于 Stijnus/dsh-composer-predictions 改写，不要与它同时启用（共用输入框浮层与 Tab 键）；每条建议都是一次额外的模型调用，默认走当前会话的模型。

description.en: WeChat Reading (WeRead) right-sidebar bookshelf and chapter reader: QR or Cookie login, store search, resume reading, and weread_shelf / weread_search / weread_book / weread_chapter agent tools.
description.zh: 微信读书右侧栏书架与章节阅读器：支持扫码或 Cookie 登录、书城搜索与续读，并提供 weread_shelf / weread_search / weread_book / weread_chapter 工具。

description.en: Replaces the new-session hero with a combined picker: role cards for the agent presets and a workspace card, collapsed into capsule buttons that expand into two scrollable rows.
description.zh: 把新建会话界面的选择器换成组合面板：角色预设卡与工作区卡各自成排，折叠时是胶囊按钮，展开后是两行可滚动的紧凑卡片。

description.en: Sidebar notebook with titled notes and inline images (videos rejected); click a title to copy its body to the clipboard, reference a note in the composer with @, and optionally open the notebook for every new session.
description.zh: 侧边栏记事本：带标题与正文的记事，可插入图片（拒收视频）；点标题把正文复制到剪贴板；输入框里可用 @ 引用某条记事；可选在新会话时自动打开记事本。

description.en: Minimal DSH Web transcript toggle: hide thinking, tool-call, and turn-process rows from the session header while preserving assistant answer text.
description.zh: DSH Web 极简会话切换：从会话头部隐藏思考、工具调用和轮次流程行，同时保留助手回答文本。

description.en: Adds a decode-speed reading to each reply action row, right of the usage control: open it for the turn time breakdown, first-token latency, decode output, prefill, speed ranges and total usage. A setting can keep every message action row visible.
description.zh: 在每轮回复的操作行里增加显示解码速度（用量右侧），可以显示这一轮回复的时间构成与速度：回答耗时、首字延迟、解码输出、预填充、速度区间与总用量等。设置 → 通用 另有「始终显示消息操作行」开关，可以始终显示所有对话消息的操作行。

description.en: Adds a chat-only action to the sidebar footer that opens a blank session in a dedicated ~/.dsh/chats workspace, so a conversation can start without choosing a project.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部加一个「仅聊天」按钮，在固定的 ~/.dsh/chats 工作区里打开一个空白会话，不必先选项目就能开始对话。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar workspace list with a Codex-style browser: sticky Pinned / Projects / Recent sections, status marks for working, awaiting approval, interrupted, and completed sessions, right-click sorting plus workspace rename and delete, and per-session pin and archive menus.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的工作区列表替换成 Codex 风格的浏览器：置顶 / 项目 / 最近三个分区标题滚动时固定在顶部，行首标记正在工作、等待审批、意外停止和已完成四种状态，支持右键切换排序、重命名和删除工作区，以及会话行的置顶和归档菜单。

description.en: Turn histogram navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness Web with mixed, DeepSeek, and Codex visual variants.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 对话轮次导航轨，支持 mixed / DeepSeek / Codex 三种视觉风格。

description.en: A right-Sidebar video player with a folder playlist (first-frame thumbnails, duration badges, sort by name/duration/modified/size, fullscreen, and a context menu for rename/copy/delete/refresh when the folder is opened with write access), live playback telemetry (buffered range, decoded FPS, dropped frames) and a read-only MP4/MOV reader for codec profile/level, exact frame count, per-track bitrate and rotation. Registers no agent tool; file writes use the browser File System Access API only after a write-permission folder choice.
description.zh: 右侧栏视频播放器：文件夹播放列表支持首帧缩略图、时长、按名称/时长/修改时间/大小排序、全屏，以及写权限文件夹下的重命名/复制/删除/刷新右键菜单；同时显示缓冲区间、解码帧率与丢帧，并只读解析 MP4/MOV 的编码档次/级别、精确帧数、每轨码率与旋转；不注册智能体工具，文件写入仅在用户以写权限选择文件夹后通过浏览器 File System Access API 执行。

description.en: Windows resource monitor for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) sidebar: samples CPU, memory and clock speed once a minute, keeps a 30-day history and draws separate 24h / 7d charts for CPU and memory (with 85% / 90% alert lines) plus a frequency chart that marks load-time throttling. Reports sustained CPU >= 85% (10 min), memory >= 90% (10 min) and frequency <= 70% of maximum clock under load (5 min).
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的 Windows 资源监控：每 60 秒采集 CPU、内存与主频，保留 30 天历史，CPU 与内存各一张 24 小时 / 7 天独立曲线（带 85% / 90% 告警线），另有一张频率曲线标注有负载时的降频，并判定 CPU 持续 ≥ 85%（10 分钟）、内存持续 ≥ 90%（10 分钟）、有负载时频率 ≤ 最高频率 70%（5 分钟）三类异常。

description.en: Select any sentence in a DSH chat session and mark it with a colored highlight (yellow, green or blue). Marks are drawn on an independent overlay so framework re-renders cannot wipe them, are anchored by quote context, stored per session and persist across restarts until deleted individually.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话界面划选任意语句即可标为高亮色块（黄/绿/蓝）。色块画在独立覆盖层上， 框架重渲染冲不掉；按引文上下文锚定，按会话分文件持久保存、跨重启保留，可单独删除。

description.en: Live multi-way tree of the current session's agents in the DeepSeek Harness conversation view and right sidebar, with status, plan progress, tokens, cost (requires dsh-cost-meter), and runtime on every card.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的对话页和右侧边栏中以多叉树展示当前会话的智能体工作流，每个卡片显示状态、计划进度、Token、费用（需挂载 dsh-cost-meter）和运行时间。

description.en: Nested session folders for the DSH sidebar: create folders per workspace, nest them and drag to reorder, move sessions by drag or context menu, click a folder activity count to open the matching sessions, and tag sessions with a header tag filter. Undo, rename, archive, search and keyboard navigation work on the tree.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏用嵌套文件夹整理会话：按工作区新建、嵌套并拖动排序文件夹，用拖动或右键菜单移动会话，点击文件夹上的活动计数直达对应会话，会话标签可在顶部筛选；树上同样支持撤销、重命名、归档、搜索和键盘导航。

description.en: A floating whale-girl pet for DeepSeek Harness that shows the live account balance and per-minute token spend.
description.zh: 一只显示 DeepSeek 余额和 token 每分钟花费的小鲸桌宠。

description.en: Adds Open workspace entries to the sidebar session-row menu and the session header actions slot, opening the session workspace folder in the system file manager.
description.zh: 在工作区侧边栏会话行菜单和会话顶部标题栏提供「打开工作区」入口，用系统文件管理器打开当前会话所属工作区文件夹。

description.en: Prompt history in the composer: Up and Down recall prompts sent earlier in this browser (newest first), Down walks back and restores the draft you had before the first Up, and the badge in the composer corner opens a numbered list to pick one directly. Only prompts you actually send are recorded — never fragments left by deleting text or cancelling a composition — history is shared across sessions and deduplicated, its badge size is adjustable in Settings → General, and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Backspace clears it.
description.zh: 输入框里的提示词历史：↑/↓ 取回此浏览器中此前发过的提示词（由新到旧），↓ 往回走并在越过最新一条时恢复最初的草稿；输入框右上角的徽标可点开带编号的历史列表直接选取。只记录真正发送过的提示词（删字、取消组词不会写入），历史跨会话共享并自动去重，徽标大小可在「设置 → 通用」调整，Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Backspace 清空。

description.en: Always-on-top lamp board for macOS: one lamp per agent, one row per session, collapsing to one lamp per running task; a lamp turns blue and blinks while an approval or a question is waiting on you, and the root agent finishing raises a system notification.
description.zh: macOS 系统级置顶灯板：每个 Agent 一盏灯、一个会话一行，收起时一个任务一盏灯；有审批或提问等你处理时该灯转蓝闪烁，根 Agent 结束时发系统通知。

description.en: Keeps the question you are currently on pinned above the composer, with a dropdown of every earlier question that scrolls the conversation back to that turn; questions folded into process groups are expanded first, and Escape, scrolling or clicking outside collapses the panel.
description.zh: 在输入框上方常驻当前提问，另有按时间排列的历次提问下拉，点任意一条把对话视图回退到那一轮；被折进「过程」分组的提问会先自动展开，Esc、滚动或点击面板外即收起。

description.en: Runs a complete HR workbench inside DSH — a 3D office, recruiting pipeline (resume, interview, written test, score), employee roster, files, attendance, performance, training and analytics — with the site’s AI assistant answering through the model DSH already runs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里跑一整套 HR 工作台——3D 办公室、招聘流水线（简历、面试、笔试、综合成绩）、员工花名册、文件柜、考勤、绩效、培训与人事分析——站内 AI 助手直接用 DSH 的模型回答。

description.en: Desktop dynamic island for DeepSeek Harness showing live agent status, approvals and questions, workspace switching, and usage stats.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的桌面灵动岛：实时显示任务状态、审批与提问、工作区切换和用量统计。

description.en: /cmd <command> in the composer runs that shell command in the session working directory, sends the command and its output to the model as a user message, and renders the input as a terminal card with exit status, expandable output and copy buttons; a bare /cmd opens an interactive terminal whose transcript is sent to the model with Ctrl+Enter. Runs with its own terminal permissions (danger-full-access) by default; set useSessionPolicy: true to use the session sandbox.
description.zh: 在输入框用 /cmd <命令> 执行当前会话工作目录里的 shell 命令，把命令与输出作为一条 user 消息交给模型，并把这次输入渲染成带退出状态、可展开输出与复制按钮的终端卡片；裸 /cmd 则打开交互终端，Ctrl+Enter 把整段终端内容发给模型。默认以终端自身权限（danger-full-access）执行，设 `useSessionPolicy: true` 改用会话沙箱。

description.en: Erii (Sakura) themed boot splash animation — falling sakura petals, a mint monster mascot with a blossom on its head, and a soft pink progress bar; fades out after ~3 seconds without blocking input.
description.zh: 绘梨衣（Sakura）主题启动加载动画——樱花瓣飘落、头戴樱花的小怪兽、粉色进度条，约 3 秒自动淡出且不阻挡操作。

description.en: Codex-style pause and continue for DeepSeek Harness: stop a running answer at any moment, then pick it up from the break point. Interaction modelled on Codex and Cursor.
description.zh: 把 Codex、Cursor 式暂停与继续带进 DeepSeek Harness：生成中随时暂停，再从断点接着写。

description.en: Make the right sidebar Start page scroll when its tool cards overflow.
description.zh: 右侧栏「开始」页的工具卡片超出可视区域时让页面可滚动，并按需显示滚动条。

description.en: Turn the seam between the sidebar panel list and the workspace list into a divider you can drag, snapping one row at a time, with the panel list scrolling when squeezed.
description.zh: 把左侧栏「面板列表」与「工作区」之间的交接做成按行磁吸的可拖动分隔条，面板列表被压小时自动出滚动条。

description.en: Manage native themes and installed theme plugins from a right-sidebar panel and a Settings page, with only one theme active at a time. Listing and toggling installed theme plugins requires dshmarket; the right-sidebar tab requires dsh-better-sidebar (otherwise the panel appears only in Settings).
description.zh: 主题管理器：在右侧栏面板与设置页里管理原生主题和已安装的主题插件，同一时间只生效一个主题。管理已安装主题插件需 dshmarket；右侧栏页签需搭配 dsh-better-sidebar（未装时只在设置页出现）。

description.en: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI on narrow screens: reveal drawer with the chat layer on top, drag gestures, bottom-sheet settings panel, composer and header fixes, zero desktop impact.
description.zh: DSH Web 移动端适配：窄屏下聊天页在上/侧栏在下的 reveal 抽屉、拖动手势、设置面板底部卡片上滑、composer 与头部修复，桌面端零影响。

description.en: Windows selection overlay for DSH that explains, summarizes or translates the selected text in any app; answers render in a native always-on-top panel with LaTeX formula support, multiple panels can stay open, and each can be folded or minimized to the taskbar.
description.zh: Windows 划词浮窗：在任意应用里选中文字后解释、总结或翻译，答案落在原生置顶浮窗里，支持 LaTeX 公式渲染、多窗口并存、折叠与最小化到任务栏。

description.en: Groups the composer model picker into customizable official, plugin and relay sources, with hierarchical navigation, an Our Free Model four-category view, and a dedicated settings page. The Our Free Model view needs dsh-our-free-model installed.
description.zh: 将输入框模型选择器按可自定义的官方、插件和中转来源分组，提供分层导航、Our Free Model 四类型目录及独立设置页。Our Free Model 目录需另装 dsh-our-free-model。

description.en: Sidebar button that opens a semi-transparent popup for browsing, previewing, downloading and deleting generated images and videos, with a settings page for the media, record and download directories.
description.zh: 侧边栏按钮打开半透明弹窗，浏览、预览、下载和删除生成的图片与视频；设置页可改图片目录、记录目录与下载目录。

description.en: System-audio visualizer for the turn navigator rail: the rail reacts in real time to whatever the default playback device is rendering, with four motion modes (spectrum, pulse, sway, travelling wave), a 16-band logarithmic spectrum from a 2048-point FFT on the host, and live sensitivity, strength, bass-punch and wave-speed controls. Audio is captured host-side through WASAPI loopback, so there is no permission prompt, no microphone and no screen capture. The browser half adds one attribute, one stylesheet, some CSS variables and a sidebar control row, and never patches the official component; switching it off removes the attribute, the stylesheet and the variables, returning the rail to its default styling. Windows only.
description.zh: 轮次导航导轨的系统声音可视化：导轨实时跟随默认播放设备正在渲染的声音律动，提供频谱 / 脉动 / 摆动 / 行波四种运动方式，宿主端用 2048 点 FFT 切出 16 段对数频谱，灵敏度、强度、低频冲击与波速均可实时调节。音频走宿主端 WASAPI 回环采集，因此没有授权弹窗、不用麦克风、不录屏。浏览器半只添加一个属性、一张样式表、若干 CSS 变量和侧栏一行控件，绝不 patch 官方组件；关闭时移除属性、样式表与变量，导轨完全恢复默认样式。仅 Windows。

description.en: Renders a ui-blocks file named by a ::dsh-ui <name> \[res=WxH]:: line in a sandboxed canvas, and turns an element token into a composer chip that serializes back to the token verbatim.
description.zh: 把 ::dsh-ui <name> \[res=WxH]:: 指向的 ui-blocks 文件渲染到沙箱画布，并把元素标记变成输入框 chip，回写时原样还原为标记。

description.en: Composer prompt polisher: a button in the input tool row rewrites the current draft through the session model (workflow engine, enabled automatically) or an OpenAI-compatible standalone API with host-side key storage, backfills the rewritten text with a replace/give-up dialog when the draft changed mid-run, and ships concise/structured style presets, custom templates with a {draft} placeholder, one-click restore from the status dock and reference-chip protection.
description.zh: 输入框提示词优化：一键把当前草稿交给会话模型（自动启用 workflow 引擎）或 OpenAI 兼容独立 API（密钥只存宿主侧）改写并回填，草稿中途变更时弹出替换/放弃确认；提供 concise/structured 风格预设、自定义模板（{draft} 占位符）、状态条一键还原与引用记号保护。

description.en: Create and edit your own Agent presets with a form in Settings, covering id, name, description, order, and the plugin composition.
description.zh: 在设置里用表单创建和修改自己的 Agent 预设，覆盖 id、名称、描述、顺序与插件组合。

description.en: Compacts the conversation header, moves the View tab row into the title row on wide windows, shows a local clock with session totals, and hides the duplicate composer statistics pills.
description.zh: 收紧会话头部，宽窗口时把 View 标签行并入标题行，在角落显示本地时钟与会话统计，并隐藏输入框下方重复的统计气泡。

description.en: Moves the context-occupancy ring out of the lonely dock row below the composer card into the composer tool row, beside the quick-prompt trigger. The same ring and percentage from the contextPressure projection, always visible while generating, with a click-open panel showing the system prompt / tools / conversation breakdown and ~used/window tokens.
description.zh: 把上下文用量圆环从输入卡片下方独占一行的位置搬进输入框工具行（闪电按钮旁）：同样的圆环与百分比（contextPressure 投影），生成回复期间也常驻不消失；点击展开「系统提示 / 工具 / 对话」占比明细与 ~已用/窗口 token 数。

description.en: Adds a lightning-button menu in the composer tool row that inserts saved prompts at the caret; the four defaults can be edited and stay in the browser.
description.zh: 在输入框工具行加一个闪电按钮菜单，点击即可把常用提示词插入光标处；四条默认提示可自行编辑，只保存在浏览器里。

description.en: Sidebar compaction: the global panel rows (plugins, market, tasks, context, memory, More) and the footer actions (e.g. paper reading and remote control) pack two per line in the wide sidebar, so the workspace session list regains the height. The collapsed icon rail keeps its shipped vertical layout. Pure CSS, no network or model calls.
description.zh: 侧栏紧凑化：宽栏模式下把全局面板行（插件 / 插件市场 / 自动化任务 / 上下文洞察 / Dream 记忆 / 更多）和底部功能入口（论文伴读、远程控制等）排成每行两个，把竖直空间还给工作区会话列表；收起成图标列时保持官方竖排布局。纯 CSS，不联网、不调模型。

description.en: A Codex-style right side panel for the DSH Web UI — session artifacts browser (live file tree, scan include, preview, reveal) plus a side chat that forks the current session with a model picker, human-pacing scheduled runs and smart send-to-bottom scrolling.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的 Codex 式右侧面板——会话产物浏览（文件树、扫描收录、预览、访达定位）+ 继承当前会话上下文的侧聊，支持模型选择器、拟人化定时调用、发送吸顶与智能滚动。

description.en: SoulFusion-style personalization: 9 response styles, custom instructions, persona cards, per-session switching, long-term memory with audit trails.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 个性化设置：9 种回复风格、自定义指令、人设卡、会话级切换、带审计的长期记忆。

description.en: Adds a Custom CSS section to Settings for adjusting dialog dimensions, font sizes, full-window wallpapers, and inspecting stable selectors.
description.zh: 在设置界面中调节弹窗尺寸、字号、全屏背景图与选择器速查，热注入自定义 CSS。

description.en: Plan / Build mode switcher for DeepSeek Harness: an always-visible dropdown in the composer beside the permission control that switches the current session both ways through the shipped /plan and /plan off commands, plus a Default mode row in Settings → General that decides the starting mode for newly created sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Plan / Build 模式切换：在输入框「完全权限」旁常驻一个下拉框，经内置的 /plan 与 /plan off 命令双向切换当前会话；设置 → 通用里另有一行「默认模式」，决定新建会话的起始模式。

description.en: A fold row is pinned at the top of the sidebar panel list and stays visible when folded, so the Plugins … More column collapses to that one row and the Workspaces section moves up; ⌥⌘P (Ctrl+Alt+P) toggles it too, and the state is kept in localStorage across reloads.
description.zh: 在侧栏面板列表顶部固定一行开关，收起时这一行仍然留着，所以「插件 … 更多」整列（含末尾的「更多」）塌成一行、工作区随之上移；⌥⌘P（Windows/Linux 为 Ctrl+Alt+P）同样能切换，状态存 localStorage，重开保持。

description.en: A local-first sidebar assistant for retirement and holiday countdowns, leave planning, a calendar, optional weather, wishes, time capsules and a small blob companion.
description.zh: 本地优先的侧边栏生活助手：退休与假期倒计时、年假与拼假、日历、可选天气、愿望清单、时间胶囊，以及一只时光团子。

description.en: Adds a sidebar entry that opens a full-screen 3D gallery of four procedural landmark models — the Eiffel Tower, the Great Wall, the Forbidden City and the Taj Mahal — plus a second entry with five quiet rooms.
description.zh: 左侧边栏加一个全屏 3D 展厅，看四座程序化建模的地标——埃菲尔铁塔、长城、紫禁城、泰姬陵——另带一个「五间安静的屋子」入口。

description.en: Cat beauty scoring plugin for the DSH Web GUI with CFA-style scorecards, a China-market price estimate, and an optional public leaderboard.
description.zh: 给猫颜值打分的 DSH 插件：CFA 风格评分卡、国内市场参考价，可发布到公开榜单。

description.en: Aipx toolkit: skills plus a Hub Console that fronts every MCP server with ~4 meta tools — server pool health, per-tool enable/disable, a tool catalog, and a search playground showing exactly what mcp_search hands the model.
description.zh: aipx 工具包：技能之外还有 Hub Console 控制台——用约 4 个元工具代理全部 MCP 服务器，含服务器池健康、工具级启停、工具目录，以及直观展示 mcp_search 返回结果的搜索试验场。

description.en: Windows only, needs the NetEase Cloud Music client installed. NetEase Cloud Music player for the DSH Web UI: a mini bar that expands into a liquid-glass card with search, synced lyrics and volume, a click-to-open spinning vinyl view, and it signs in with the local NetEase client account (cookie decrypted on this machine only) so VIP tracks play and the client current song can be pulled in.
description.zh: 仅 Windows，需本机装有网易云音乐客户端。DSH Web 的网易云音乐播放器：收起是迷你播放条，点开是液态玻璃卡片（搜索 / 歌词 / 音量），点封面区切换成旋转黑胶视图；自动使用本机网易云客户端账号登录（cookie 仅在本机解密），VIP 曲目可播，并可把客户端正在播放的歌一键拉进来。

description.en: Shows the agent's live state in an always-on-top strip on the desktop — one ball when idle, a pill with the running tool name and elapsed time while working, expandable to the last message.
description.zh: 在桌面置顶小条里显示 Agent 的实时状态——空闲时一颗球，干活时变成带工具名和用时的小条，点开可看最后一条消息。

description.en: Turns scattered thinking notes into a growing constellation of themes, claims, relations and open questions, plus a written synthesis of the argument.
description.zh: 把零散的思想片段编织成一张会生长的星图：主题、观点、关系与待补充的问题，并生成一份论证总结。

description.en: Upload files and folders straight into the conversation — images attach as real message blocks, text content is written into the composer draft, folders land by directory structure.
description.zh: 把文件与文件夹直接传进对话——图片以真实图片块加入消息，文本内容写入输入框草稿，文件夹按目录结构落盘。

description.en: WYSIWYG Markdown notes editor in the DSH right sidebar, with tabbed documents, table editing, chat integration, assistant read/write tools, and local file export.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的所见即所得 Markdown 笔记编辑器，支持多标签、表格编辑、对话联动、模型读写与保存到本地文件。

description.en: Browser and mini-program element annotations with collapsible composer notes and source locations.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供网页与小程序元素注释、折叠注释附件及源码定位。

description.en: Floating Pomodoro dial pinned to the bottom-right of the Harness UI: custom focus, short-break and long-break lengths, a long break that can be switched off entirely, a round counter, and five Web Audio-synthesized alarm sounds with preview, volume and ring duration. No audio assets and no network requests; timer state survives a reload.
description.zh: 常驻右下角的番茄钟圆盘：专注/短休/长休时长自定，长休可单独关闭，带轮次计数；闹铃为五种 Web Audio 实时合成的音效，支持试听、音量与响铃时长。无音频资源、无网络请求，计时状态刷新后继续。

description.en: Replaces the composer model picker with a compact panel for provider-to-model navigation and an adaptive reasoning-effort slider, with a Default stop and no slider for models without adjustable efforts.
description.zh: 将输入框的模型选择器替换为紧凑面板，支持来源到模型的逐级选择和自适应思考强度滑块，保留 Default 档位，不支持调节的模型隐藏滑块。

description.en: A reasoning-style row above the DSH composer with a stock watchlist and a host-backed TXT/EPUB reader; reading progress is shared across browsers.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框上方以思考行样式显示自选股票行情，或阅读 TXT/EPUB 电子书。

description.en: A numbered tag wall of recent projects in the sidebar: each project is a colored tag with a type logo that unfolds into date, summary, hours, cost and next steps on hover.
description.zh: 侧栏里的项目标签墙：每个项目是一枚带编号和类型图标的彩色标签，悬停展开日期、摘要、工时、费用与后续计划。

description.en: Select any text in a DSH chat reply to get a floating Follow-up/Copy pill: one click quotes the selection into the composer so you can type your own follow-up question, or copies it.
description.zh: 选中聊天回复中的任意文字，浮出「追问/复制」气泡：一键把选中内容作为引用填入输入框（问题由你输入），或一键复制。另附安装与实现文档。

description.en: Visualizes prompt-cache hit rates and model request activity in DSH Web, with request details, comparison, and conversation navigation.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中可视化提示词缓存命中率与模型请求活动，支持请求详情、请求对比和对话定位。

description.en: Cross-session token dashboard for DSH: daily spend as bars, trend or cumulative views plus a GitHub-style annual activity calendar, model and workspace splits, cross-filtering between day, model and workspace, and a per-turn timeline that also covers web-search and auxiliary model calls.
description.zh: 跨会话 token 消耗看板：每日消耗支持柱状、趋势、累积三种视图与 GitHub 风格年度活跃日历，模型与工作区分布，日／模型／工作区之间的交叉筛选联动，以及逐轮时间线——并计入联网搜索等辅助模型调用。

description.en: A price-aware task runner for DeepSeek: during an off-peak pricing window a batch of prompts goes straight to deepseek-flash; near peak it queues the batch behind a self-held timer and runs it at the start of the next off-peak window. Exposes `peak_run`, `peak_schedule` and `peak_cancel`, with configurable peak windows and a lead time.
description.zh: DeepSeek 峰谷价感知的任务执行器：平价时段把一批 prompt 直接交给 deepseek-flash；临近峰价时排队并用自持定时器在下一个平价时段开始执行。提供 peak_run / peak_schedule / peak_cancel 三个工具，峰谷时段与提前量可配置。

description.en: Records token usage per turn into two ledgers, imported history before installation and new events after, and shows exact per-bucket totals, per-model and per-session breakdowns, and day/week/month filters in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 按轮次记录 token 用量，分为安装前导入的历史账与安装后的新账两本，并在侧边栏展示精确的分桶合计、按模型和会话的明细，以及按日、周、月的筛选。

description.en: See what a conversation actually costs: how many model requests, how big the system prompt and tool table are, cumulative tokens, estimated spend, and how far you are from automatic context compaction. Reads the local session log only; never calls a model, never adds a word to the system prompt. Token and spend figures are estimates from character counts, not provider usage.
description.zh: 看清一场对话到底烧了多少：模型请求次数、system prompt 与工具表各占多少、累计 token、估算花费、离上下文自动压缩还有多远。只读本地会话日志，不调模型，不往 system prompt 加一个字。token 与花费均按字符数估算，不是 provider 用量。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (5-hour, weekly and monthly) in the DSH sidebar footer, with a countdown to the 5-hour reset. Requires an OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY credential (Settings → Models, or a refs entry in ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml); without it the card stays hidden.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏底部显示 OpenCode Go 订阅的 5 小时、本周、本月用量，并倒计时到 5 小时窗口重置。需先在「设置 → 模型」或 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 的 refs 中配置 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY，否则卡片不显示。

description.en: Cumulative token usage tracking for DeepSeek Harness, with per-model and per-day breakdowns, a settings-page dashboard and an online-changeable data directory.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 累计 token 用量并按模型/日期区分，附设置页用量看板，数据保存目录可在线更改。

description.en: Floating overlay in the Harness Web UI with OpenCode Go usage: 5-hour rolling, weekly and monthly percentages, reset countdowns and the renewal date, with device-code sign-in and silent token refresh.
description.zh: 在 Harness Web UI 上悬浮显示 OpenCode Go 用量：5 小时滚动、每周与每月百分比、重置倒计时与续订日期，支持设备码登录与静默刷新。

description.en: Adds a cost-and-balance chip to the composer stats row beside the shipped token-usage pill — the session's estimated DeepSeek cost, a peak/off-peak light and the signed-in account's remaining balance, with each billing item priced in the breakdown; it activates only when a DeepSeek official route is present.
description.zh: 在输入栏统计行、官方 token 用量条旁加一枚费用与余额胶囊：本次会话的 DeepSeek 估算费用、峰谷时段指示灯与已登录账号的剩余额度，明细里按计费项列出各自金额；仅在检测到 DeepSeek 官方渠道时激活。

description.en: Zhipu coding-plan sign-in, quota, usage and reset panel for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中登录智谱编程套餐，查看额度与用量并执行额度重置。

description.en: Session-header balance readout for DeepSeek Harness: shows the spendable account total (recharge and bonus wallets combined) in the conversation header, refreshed every two minutes, and renders nothing when the account is signed out or the query fails.
description.zh: DSH 会话标题栏右上角的账户余额读数：显示可用总额（充值余额与赠金余额合并），每两分钟刷新一次；未登录或查询失败时不显示任何内容。

description.en: Balance, remaining tokens and token/money usage waves for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar footer card plus a panel docked in the empty gutter left of the conversation, with 1h/6h/24h/7d stacked token-or-currency waveforms, a live tok/s strip and a per-command cost breakdown.
description.zh: 余额、剩余 tok 与用量面板：侧栏底部一张余额/剩余 token 卡片，点开是贴在对话栏左侧空白处的用量面板 —— 1h/6h/24h/7d 的 token/金额堆叠波形、实时 tok/s 曲线、逐指令消耗与花费；按最近 24h 实付均价折算「余额还能跑多少 tok」。

description.en: Floating card showing DeepSeek balance, peak/off-peak tier countdown, and remaining tasks estimated from historical per-task token usage and the current context.
description.zh: 右下角悬浮卡显示 DeepSeek 余额与峰谷档位倒计时，并基于历史平均单任务 Token 消耗与当前上下文估算剩余任务数。

description.en: Live prompt-cache telemetry for the current session in the DSH right sidebar, drawn as a register bank and a reactor-core history board.
description.zh: 以寄存器阵列与反应堆芯历史盘面的形式，在 DSH 右侧栏实时显示当前会话的提示词缓存遥测。

description.en: Sidebar receipt printer for DeepSeek balance — a dot-matrix screen shows the remaining balance amount, with a lit dot field tracking the balance level and a peak/off-peak price band, and a receipt slides out on hover with balance, spend and per-token prices.
description.zh: 侧栏小票机：点阵屏显示余额金额，点阵底纹按余额水位亮起并带峰谷价格带，鼠标悬停时从槽口送出一张明细小票（余额、已充值、今日/本月花费、单价）。

description.en: Multi-provider quota panel for DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek official balance, jojo code, SCNet and Ark Coding Plan usage windows in the sidebar footer, with 90 days of local history and trend charts.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏额度面板：聚合 DeepSeek 官方余额、jojo code 订阅窗口、SCNet 超算用量与方舟 Coding Plan 用量，本地保存 90 天历史并绘制趋势图。

description.en: Account balance chip beside the Harness mark, per-session spend beside each Session row, and a sidebar-foot list of what running sessions are spending — all priced from each session log's token usage, with a live ≈ estimate while a call is streaming.
description.zh: 在 Harness 品牌位旁显示账户余额，在每个会话行旁显示该会话消耗，并在侧栏底部列出运行中会话正在花多少——全部按会话日志里的 token 用量计价，调用流式进行中时给出 ≈ 实时估算。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance and unused bonus credit in the session header, refreshing every 20 seconds and whenever the window regains focus.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与未用完的赠送额度，每 20 秒自动刷新，窗口重新聚焦时立即刷新。

description.en: A cached daily scene, real weather, schedule and outfit for dsh conversation agents, with three ootd_* tools and the /ootd command.
description.zh: 为 dsh 对话角色提供按天缓存的日常场景、实况天气、日程与着装，并提供三个 ootd_* 工具和 /ootd 命令。

description.en: Shows the remaining DeepSeek account balance in the composer dock, right after the cache-hit reading, and links to the Platform usage page. Requires a signed-in DeepSeek account; API-key-only setups show nothing.
description.zh: 在输入框底部统计行、紧挨「缓存命中」右侧显示账号剩余额度，点击打开平台用量页。需要登录 DeepSeek 账号；仅用 API Key 不显示。

description.en: Minimal DeepSeek balance badge in the DSH Web sidebar footer, with a peak/off-peak pricing line, low-balance warning and manual refresh. The API key stays in the host process and the balance route is limited to private-network clients by default.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏底部的极简 DeepSeek 余额徽章：峰谷计价指示线、低余额提醒与手动刷新。API key 只留在 Host 进程，余额路由默认只允许私有网段客户端读取。

description.en: Peak and off-peak pricing-period indicator for the DeepSeek API in the DSH chat UI, with a countdown to the next period and an API balance readout on hover.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话界面显示 DeepSeek 当前高峰/空闲收费时段图标与下一时段倒计时，悬停图标可查询 API 余额。

description.en: Reports each machine's token usage to a team server you host, with one-time enrollment codes, an offline disk queue, and idempotent replay, so an administrator can see every member's usage and cost in one place.
description.zh: 把每台机器的 token 用量上报给你自己托管的团队服务器：一次性绑定码、离线落盘队列、幂等重放，管理员在一处看到全员用量与成本。

description.en: Displays DeepSeek and MoonShot API balances, Codex remaining quotas, and estimated local daily API spending in the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏显示 DeepSeek、MoonShot API 余额、Codex 剩余额度及本机今日估算消费。

description.en: DeepSeek balance and today's spend from the official usage export, in one line at the right end of the DSH sidebar account row; hovering opens a card with requests, tokens and the peak/off-peak countdown.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏账户行最右端一行显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日消费（官方用量口径），悬停展开请求数、token 与峰谷倒计时卡片。

description.en: Shows the remaining OpenCode Go quota (5-hour, weekly, monthly) in the DeepSeek Harness Web composer dock.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 输入框 dock 显示 OpenCode Go 套餐的 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月剩余额度。

description.en: Records how long DSH is open each time and the running total in a left-sidebar page; a restart within 3 minutes continues the same use.
description.zh: 记录 DSH 每次打开的使用时长与累计总时长（退出 3 分钟内重开并入同一次），在左侧栏页面展示。

description.en: Token usage meter in the DSH sidebar footer that runs both data sources at once rather than picking one: the DeepSeek platform account's usage and cost endpoints, which cover every device on the account but only the official channel, and local session logs, which cover this machine in real time across every provider but carry no cost. The two are merged per day — the official channel takes the larger figure, since one call is recorded by both, and providers the platform cannot see are added on top. History is backfilled month by month from the platform, providers are classified by channel rather than model name, days follow the platform's UTC boundary, and no token has to be pasted because the platform figures reuse the DSH account you are already signed in to. Totals appear as all-time, current-project, today, week, month, last-7 and last-30 in a compact bar, an expand panel and a detail modal with calendar, chart, model, provider, year, month and day tabs.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏页脚的 Token 用量组件，同时跑两路数据源而不是二选一：DeepSeek 平台账号的用量/金额接口（账号全部设备、仅官方通道），本机会话日志（仅本机、含所有供应商、实时、无金额）。两路逐日合并——官方通道取较大值（同一次调用两路都会记），平台看不到的供应商再叠加；历史月份从平台回补，供应商按通道而非模型名判定，日桶跟随平台口径（UTC）；平台数字默认复用 DSH 已登录账号，不用粘贴 token。数字出现在紧凑条、展开面板，以及含日历/图表/模型/供应商/年/月/当月按天页签的详细数据弹窗，口径为总消耗/当前项目/今日/当周/当月/近 7 天/近 30 天。

description.en: Give your agent a phone: a local incoming-call screen that really rings in the browser, speaks a preset opening line with the OS voice (no API key, fully offline), and can call again if nobody picks up. The first sentence is fixed text rather than model-improvised, because schedules, amounts and addresses are the kind of thing you cannot let a model paraphrase. Windows only.
description.zh: 让你的 agent 给你打电话：浏览器里真的会响铃的来电界面，用系统自带音色念出预置开场白（不需要任何 key、完全离线），没人接还会再打一次。第一句是固定文本而不是模型现编——日程、金额、地址这类内容不能被改写。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Quota monitor for GLM, MiniMax, Kimi and DeepSeek coding plans — per-window usage, reset countdowns and manual refresh in the Web GUI.
description.zh: GLM、MiniMax、Kimi、DeepSeek 编程套餐额度监控——Web GUI 内显示各窗口用量、重置倒计时并支持手动刷新。

description.en: Intercepts DSH tool results before the model reads them: dedupe cache for repeated calls, a declarative decision graph that replaces large outputs with structured digests, an injection gate, and an honest token ledger that includes a negative-return account for over-compression. Measured 1400-1600 tokens saved per hit; the cumulative ledger is currently negative and the README says why, including that it cannot skip model turns.
description.zh: 在模型读取之前拦截 DSH 工具结果：重复调用去重、用声明式决策图把大输出换成结构化摘要、注入闸门去重，并记一本含负收益科目的诚实账本（压过头导致重读会记亏损）。实测单次命中省 1400—1600 token；累计净收益目前为负，仓库里写明了原因，也写明了它无法跳过模型回合。

description.en: Cross-session per-model token usage replayed from the harness's own session logs, with a usage panel tab (requires dsh-better-sidebar) and a per-conversation model popover.
description.zh: 从 Harness 自身会话日志回放聚合的跨会话分模型 token 用量，含侧边栏用量面板（需安装 dsh-better-sidebar）与单对话按模型弹层。

description.en: A fork of dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage (the upstream repository has no license file; its manifest declares MIT) that adds IKunCode account balance queries alongside the upstream provider readers, subscription usage windows and model price snapshots. For IKunCode, your key is sent as a Bearer token to api.ikuncode.cc. It installs as @elsebit/dsh-deepseek-usage-extended from GitHub Releases with its own routes and settings, so disable the original usage plugin if you want a single card; the OAuth credential references it inherits are shared with the original.
description.zh: dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage 的 fork（上游仓库没有许可证文件，manifest 声明 MIT），在上游的各家余额读取、订阅用量窗口和模型价格快照之外，增加 IKunCode 账户余额查询。查 IKunCode 时，你的密钥会以 Bearer 令牌发往 api.ikuncode.cc。它以 @elsebit/dsh-deepseek-usage-extended 的名字从 GitHub Release 安装，路由和设置独立，只想留一张用量卡片的话请停用原插件；继承来的 OAuth 凭据引用与原插件共用。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance badge in the sidebar footer beside Settings — reads the key DSH already stores, shows granted/topped-up breakdown on hover, flags a balance under ¥2, and refreshes every 60 seconds or on click.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部「设置」旁常驻显示 DeepSeek API 余额——读取 DSH 已保存的密钥，悬停查看赠送/充值明细，余额低于 ¥2 变红告警，每 60 秒自动刷新或点击刷新。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance (recharge plus bonus) in the DSH composer dock and refreshes it automatically.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方状态行显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（充值 + 赠送），并自动刷新。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance, balance trend, and daily usage charts in DSH Web settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中展示 DeepSeek API 余额、余额趋势与每日用量图表。

description.en: Multi-select clear (archive) workspace conversations and bulk-delete empty workspaces in the DSH sidebar. Workspace-level selection (tri-state), select-all, progress and failure reporting; delete keeps folders and session logs (sessions move to Ungrouped).
description.zh: 侧边栏多选清空(归档)工作区对话，并批量删除已清空的空工作区。支持会话行/工作区头行勾选、半选态、全选、二次确认与失败保留；删除工作区保留文件夹与日志，会话移至未分组。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API account balance in the DSH Web sidebar with 30s auto-refresh, click-to-refresh, hover details, and low-balance threshold warnings.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额：30 秒自动刷新、点击刷新、悬停查看明细、余额不足阈值告警。

description.en: Per-project LLM token usage and RMB cost in the DSH Web sidebar, split by input (cache miss), cache hit, and output with model price auto-pricing.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏按项目展示 LLM Token 用量与人民币花费，分别统计输入（未命中）、命中与输出，并按模型标准价格自动计价。

description.en: Token usage panel in DeepSeek Harness Settings: folds session logs into day, week and month totals per model or per provider, persisted in the plugin storage domain and served over a same-origin /token-usage-rpc route; SVG line chart with crosshair hover, ranking with share and optional cost, cache hit-rate and cache read/write cards, a user-supplied price table priced per million tokens, daily and monthly budget alerts, CSV or JSON export of the current range, auto-refresh while visible, preset and custom start/end date ranges, and a rebuild that asks for confirmation before dropping history whose session logs no longer exist.
description.zh: DSH 设置面板词元用量统计：从会话日志折叠出日/周/月 × 模型（或按厂商合并）的词元统计，storage-domain 持久化、经同源 /token-usage-rpc 路由出数；SVG 折线图（十字线悬浮按日拆到每个模型）+ 占比排行（含可选金额）+ 缓存命中率与缓存读写卡片 + 用户自备的每百万 token 价目表 + 日/月预算告警 + 当前区间导出 CSV/JSON + 可见时自动刷新 + 预设与自定义起止日期 + 重建（存储里存在日志已不存在的历史时先要一次确认）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Usage tab for DeepSeek account balance, official peak/off-peak pricing, live countdown, platform usage link, and local balance warning light.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量页签：展示 DeepSeek 账户余额、官方峰谷时段价格、动态倒计时、平台用量页入口和本地余额告警灯。

description.en: Peak/off-peak pricing badge in the composer: shows the DeepSeek API peak and off-peak windows with a countdown in the tooltip, and only appears while the session model is a DeepSeek route.
description.zh: 输入框旁的峰谷计价徽标：显示 DeepSeek API 的高峰/低谷时段与倒计时，仅在会话模型是 DeepSeek 路由时显示。

description.en: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan usage widget for DeepSeek Harness — a draggable whale in the corner opens a bubble card with the 5-hour, weekly and monthly request quota, plus a local token-to-CNY summary for today, the last 7 days, this month and all time. Requires the Volcengine Ark CLI to be installed and logged in (npm i -g @volcengine/ark-cli; arkcli auth login).
description.zh: 火山方舟 Coding Plan 用量挂件：右下角一只可拖动的小鲸鱼，点开看 5 小时 / 周 / 月三档请求配额，再往下是本机 token 折算的今日、近 7 天、本月与累计花费。需要先安装并登录火山方舟 CLI：npm i -g @volcengine/ark-cli，然后 arkcli auth login。

description.en: Reads local DSH session logs to show real token totals, session count, estimated cost and budget, a 14-day usage timeline, per-session breakdown and CPU monitoring, plus a draggable token/cost status window and a whale-girl who eats rice as tokens are spent.
description.zh: 读取本机 DSH 会话日志，展示真实 Token 总量、会话数、估算成本与预算、14 天消耗时间线、逐会话明细和 CPU 监控，并提供可拖动的 Token/成本状态小窗，以及随 Token 消耗干饭的鲸鱼娘。

description.en: Replays the last request while a main session idles, so the provider prompt cache keeps its hit and the next real turn is billed at the cache-hit price instead of a cold re-prefill. Per-window toggle, per-task records, and an estimated net saving.
description.zh: 主会话空闲时自动重放最近一次请求，让上游提示词缓存保持命中，下一次真实请求按缓存命中价计费而不是冷启动重算；支持按窗口开关、按任务记录与估算净省。

description.en: Runs N serial speedtest rounds in one unchanged environment from the plugin detail page, then reports per-round tables with median, min, max and MAD, and keeps each batch as an archive that can be renamed or deleted.
description.zh: 在插件详情页按同一环境串行跑 N 轮测速，输出逐轮表与中位数/最小/最大/MAD，并把每个批次留档（可重命名、删除）。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance capsule in the conversation session header. A same-origin route registered by the package's own host half resolves the API key from the credential service and calls api.deepseek.com/user/balance, so the key never reaches the page; the capsule polls every 60 seconds and expands into a panel with per-currency totals, granted and topped-up amounts, last-updated time and a manual refresh. Read-only UI: it never touches prompts, tool results or model traffic.
description.zh: 会话标题栏里的 DeepSeek 账户余额胶囊。由本包自带的 host 半注册同源路由，从凭据服务解析 API Key 后查询 api.deepseek.com/user/balance，Key 始终不进页面；胶囊每 60 秒轮询，可展开明细面板，显示分币种总额、赠送与充值部分、更新时间与手动刷新。纯只读 UI：不接触提示词、工具结果与模型流量。

description.en: Registers /daily, which sends the model to read the newest bili-scroll report and say what it understood instead of repeating the text; a sidebar panel runs the same command. Needs the dsh-bili-scroll plugin to have written reports into ~/.dsh/bili-duty/out, otherwise /daily finds none.
description.zh: 日报一键读：敲 /daily 就把「去读最新那篇刷B站日报」塞进当前会话——只给路径不给正文，让它自己读原文；侧栏面板发的是同一条命令。需 dsh-bili-scroll 已把日报写进 ~/.dsh/bili-duty/out，否则 /daily 找不到日报。

description.en: Sets a CNY spending cap for each DeepSeek Harness turn (¥5 by default) and stops the run before the next model request once the cap is reached; the switch and amount sit at the right end of the composer dock.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 每一轮对话设人民币花费上限（默认 5 元），到上限就在下一个模型请求发出前停下；开关与金额在输入框下方最右侧。

description.en: Bottom-right whale widget showing DeepSeek balance, today's spend from the official usage API, per-turn cost narrated after each turn, and a peak/off-peak pricing countdown, with six expressions, click-to-refresh, weather and a bilingual (中文/English) UI.
description.zh: 右下角小鲸鱼挂件：显示 DeepSeek 余额与官网口径的今日用量，每轮结束播报本轮花费，并提供峰谷定价倒计时；另有六种状态立绘、点击刷新、天气查询与中英双语界面。

description.en: Sidebar card that prices this session's tokens in RMB at official peak/off-peak rates and splits context share by source, with per-turn pricing and a Markdown/CSV history report.
description.zh: 侧栏常驻卡片：按 DeepSeek 官方价目（含峰谷与缓存差价）把本会话 token 折算成人民币，并按来源拆开上下文占比；逐轮计价，另附 Markdown/CSV 历史报告。

description.en: Composer token pill for the current session: total tokens plus uncached input, cache read, cache write and output, with the cache-hit share. A pure client consumer of the session tokenUsage projection — no host service, no file access, no network requests.
description.zh: 输入框里的当前会话 Token 胶囊：总量与未缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入、输出四个分桶，并显示缓存命中率；纯客户端消费会话 tokenUsage 投影，不注册宿主服务、不读写文件、不联网。

description.en: Per-model API price table with Peak and Off-Peak rates in USD or CNY, the DeepSeek account balance and live session spend under the composer, an all-time total, a collapsible source URL and check date per model, and optional per-model Peak schedules.
description.zh: 按模型设置高峰/低谷价格（USD 或 CNY），在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本次会话花费，累计总花费，每条价格可记录来源链接与核对日期，并支持为单个模型覆盖高峰时段。

description.en: Shows how much of your Claude and Codex plan limits you have used: a line above the prompt in dst with 5-hour and weekly windows, percent used and time to reset, and a ring meter beside the context meter in dsh web that opens a panel listing every window.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中显示 OpenAI 与 Codex 的用量配额：Web 端用环形表与面板展示 5 小时 / 7 天窗口，dst 端在状态行显示同样的窗口。

description.en: Shows each conversation turn's cost and the running session cost in CNY or USD, with a session budget pill in the composer, balance reminders, an all-session billing dashboard and Excel export.
description.zh: 在每轮对话底部显示本轮与累计会话花费（人民币或美元），并在输入框工具行提供会话预算按钮、余额提醒、全部会话计费统计与 Excel 导出。

description.en: Live token spend for the current DSH session beside the composer, pricing the four server-reported token buckets with the profile's own table and showing both the peak and off-peak rate.
description.zh: 在输入框旁实时显示当前会话的 token 花费：用服务端上报的四个 token 分桶乘以本 profile 的价格表，并同时列出高峰与空闲价格。

description.en: DeepSeek balance and per-session token usage in the session header, with a three-level balance alert and editable thresholds, one-click top-up links, a segmented token bar with cache-hit statistics, and a visibility-aware poller.
description.zh: 会话头部显示 DeepSeek 余额与本会话 Token 用量：三级余额预警、自定义阈值、一键充值入口、分段 Token 条与缓存命中率，并采用可见时才轮询的省流策略。

description.en: Shows your Alibaba Cloud cash-coupon balance - the credit that pays for Qwen and DashScope calls - in the DSH sidebar, with an AccessKey form that keeps the key on your machine.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏显示阿里云代金券余额（抵扣千问 / 百炼调用的那笔钱），AccessKey 只保存在本机。

description.en: Estimates recorded DeepSeek model spend per conversation and turn, with a cost-ranked overview. Built-in tariff table covers 2026-09-11 to 2026-12-31.
description.zh: 按对话和每轮回复估算已记录的 DeepSeek 模型费用，并提供花费排序明细。内置价目表覆盖 2026-09-11 至 2026-12-31。

description.en: Cost display for AiSpot (sapi) relays: crawls the provider's group list from its public pricing endpoints instead of hardcoding it, lets you pick the active group from a dropdown in the conversation header, and shows a per-turn cost at the end of each turn plus a session total that recurses through every subagent subtree. Switching groups re-prices all history instantly, because the host publishes token buckets only and the browser applies the live rates.
description.zh: AiSpot（sapi）中转站的费用显示插件：从供应商的公开价格端点动态爬取分组列表而非硬编码，在会话标题栏的下拉框里选择当前分组，在每轮对话结束处显示本轮费用，并在标题栏显示递归合计所有子代理子树的会话总额。切换分组会即时重算全部历史金额，因为宿主只发布 token 桶、由浏览器按实时价目表计价。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance above the sidebar account area, the running cost of the open conversation, the cost of each turn beside its token count, and a one-click AI breakdown for any turn above a token threshold.
description.zh: 在侧边栏账户区上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、当前会话累计花费与逐轮费用，并对超出 token 阈值的单轮提供一键 AI 分析。

description.en: Sidebar DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing hint with a Beijing-time countdown, Chinese public holidays and make-up workdays, daily pricing-rule refresh, official top-up offer status, and your account balance converted to input tokens (read with the DeepSeek platform sign-in already stored in DSH).
description.zh: 侧边栏 DeepSeek 峰谷计费提示，显示北京时间倒计时、中国法定节假日与调休、每日定价规则刷新、官方充值优惠状态，以及按当前时段折算成输入 tokens 的账户余额（使用 DSH 里已保存的 DeepSeek 平台登录凭据读取）。

description.en: One-click update for the self-built Linux dsh-desktop: check fork releases, download the deb, swap the app and restart.
description.zh: 桌面端 Linux 自建版一键更新：检查 fork release、下载 deb、替换应用目录并自动重启。

description.en: Estimates what is filling the context window — per instruction file, per skill and per tool result — with a bloat verdict and actionable suggestions.
description.zh: 估算上下文里谁在吃 token —— 逐文件、逐 skill、逐条工具结果列出占比，并给出膨胀判定与可执行建议。

description.en: Shows today's, this month's and cumulative spend in the sidebar footer, under the message box and in the session header. Spend is metered by the plugin itself from session usage events using official DeepSeek unit prices (peak/off-peak, weekends and holidays treated as off-peak), with local-day aggregation and currency conversion. Also adds a cost_today tool and a /cost command.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部、输入框下方与会话头部显示今日、本月与累计花费；金额由插件自记 —— 从会话用量事件按 DeepSeek 官方单价逐次累计（含 UTC 峰谷，周末与节假日按平时价），并按本地日汇总、换算币种。另提供 cost_today 工具与 /cost 命令。

description.en: Removes AI phrasing so replies and documents sound human: an always-on de-slop style section injected into every session (on by default, switch it off with deslop_mode), four deslop_* tools (0-100 slop scan, deterministic rewrite, intensity switch, voice profile) and four skills (rewriting, conversation, technical docs, Chinese reports), copied into the DSH skills folder at startup. The effect is measurable: a typical AI-flavoured Chinese paragraph scores 49 before deslop_rewrite and 6 after.
description.zh: 删掉 AI 腔与套话，让回复和文档说人话：每个会话自动注入去 AI 味风格层（默认开启，可用 deslop_mode 关闭），配 deslop_* 四个工具（0 到 100 分扫描、确定性改写、档位切换、声音画像）与四个 skill（改稿、对话、技术文档、中文报告），启动时复制到 DSH 的 skills 目录。效果可量化：一段典型 AI 腔中文经 deslop_rewrite 清洗后，评分由 49 降到 6。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek account balance readout in the session header: host /api/balance route resolves the API key through the credentials seam (never sent to the browser), 60-second auto-poll plus manual refresh.
description.zh: 会话标题栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额：host 端 /api/balance 路由经凭据 seam 解析 API key（密钥绝不下发浏览器），60 秒自动轮询并支持手动刷新。

description.en: Rewrites a draft prompt against the current project: a composer button, slash command and agent tool ground the rewrite in the workspace stack, structure and conventions.
description.zh: 结合当前项目重写提示词：通过输入框按钮、斜杠命令或 Agent 工具，依据工作区的技术栈、结构与约定改写草稿。

description.en: Shows the cost of the current session's latest exchange, meaning everything since your last message, as a CNY amount to the right of the permission control in the composer, calculated from provider-reported token usage at DeepSeek's peak and off-peak prices.
description.zh: 在输入框「权限」按钮右侧显示当前会话最新一次交互（自你上次发消息起）花了多少钱，按 DeepSeek 官方峰谷价由提供方上报的 token 用量折算成人民币。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance and the current peak / off-peak phase in the sidebar, and estimates per-session and per-turn cost using the official peak and off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前峰谷时段，并按官方高峰/空闲价估算每个会话与每一轮的花费。

description.en: Balance strip in the composer dock — a green-to-red OKLCH ramp driven by your DeepSeek balance, with a dynamic toggle, texture options and a built-in settings panel.
description.zh: 输入框下方状态行里的余额状态条：色带随余额在绿与红之间变化，可关动态、换纹理，并带图形化设置面板。

description.en: Queries the balance and token prices of the model providers configured in DSH, whichever endpoint or relay they use, accepts cc-switch usage scripts, and shows the selected provider's balance under the composer.
description.zh: 查询 DSH 中已配置的各模型提供商的余额与 token 单价（不限厂商或中转站），兼容 cc-switch 的 usage_script，并在输入框下方显示当前会话所选提供商的余额。

description.en: Composer-dock capsule with this session's DeepSeek spend, account balance, daily/weekly/monthly ledger and the peak/off-peak price window.
description.zh: 输入框状态行里的本会话花费胶囊，点击查看账户余额、今日/近 7 天/本月账本与峰谷价格时段。

description.en: Shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently billing at the peak or off-peak (half-price) rate in the conversation title bar, with a live countdown once the next switch is under 30 minutes away and the Chinese statutory-holiday calendar built in.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏显示 DeepSeek API 此刻按高峰还是半价计费；离下次切换不足 30 分钟时把倒计时直接显示在标签上，内置中国法定节假日表。

description.en: Prices tokens with the official model price table, keeps the per-session and global running cost beside the composer context meter, mirrors your DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar, blocks a turn once this period passes your own global ceiling (clamped to that balance) or a per-session ceiling (each session sets its own, independently), and resets the billing baseline per session or globally — the two are independent, so resetting one never resets the other — so the period goes back to zero while history only rolls into the lifetime total.
description.zh: 按官方模型价目表把 token 折算成费用，在聊天框底部上下文环旁常驻显示本会话与全局的本次已用金额，在左侧边栏显示账户余额，并在本次费用超过你自设的全局上限（超过余额会被夹到余额）或某个会话自己的上限（每个会话各自设、互不共用）时阻断该轮（可一次性或按会话放行）；每个角标右侧可重置计费起点（本次归零、历史只进累计、token 一条不丢），全局与单会话两个起点各自独立、互不牵连。

description.en: DeepSeek balance chip in the sidebar name row, showing the balance, the current peak or off-peak window, and a countdown to the next switch; click to refresh.
description.zh: 侧栏名字行里的 DeepSeek 余额胶囊，显示余额、当前峰谷时段与下次切换倒计时，点一下刷新。

description.en: Token usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI — today/week/month totals, per-model breakdown and a stacked 30-day chart, with a 4-language UI.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Token 用量仪表盘 — 今日/本周/本月/累计汇总、按模型明细和堆叠柱状图，界面支持中/英/越/日。

description.en: Shows token and CNY cost per turn and per session in the harness's own statistics form, a whole-account bill over 1/7/30-day windows with cost-per-unit-of-work trends, and an advisor that re-measures its own suggestions after you adopt them.
description.zh: 以 harness 自己的统计形态显示每轮与会话的 token 与人民币花费，提供 1/7/30 天窗口的全账号账单与「单位工作量花费」趋势，并给出会在你采纳后重新测量效果的建议。

description.en: A possibly useful DSH token usage plugin: cross-session stats on where your tokens went - four headline figures, context length distribution, a 12-week heatmap and weekly trend, plus workspace and model rankings; it also ships a next-turn token forecast and a draft-optimization feature.
description.zh: 可能有用的 DSH token 用量插件，跨会话统计 token 都花在哪儿了：用量总览四项指标、上下文长度分布、近 12 周热力图与按周趋势，工作区与模型排行；另附有发送前 token 预告和输入草稿优化功能。

description.en: One-line notice at the top edge of the DSH window with your DeepSeek balance, the ChatGPT/Codex five-hour and weekly remaining quota and their reset times, and how many quota-reset cards are left plus the nearest expiry; the reset-card part links to the ChatGPT usage page in your browser.
description.zh: 在 DSH 窗口顶部边缘用一行提示显示 DeepSeek 余额、ChatGPT/Codex 五小时与每周剩余额度及其重置时间、剩余额度重置卡数量与最近到期时间；重置卡那一段是链接，会用浏览器打开 ChatGPT 使用情况页。

description.en: Adds the real CNY cost of each assistant turn, plus today's running total, after the timestamp in DeepSeek Harness's completed-turn footer. Amounts are folded from the session log's usage with a local price table - no billing API, no network call, no extra tokens.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 每条助手回复的页脚、时间之后显示本轮真实花费与今日累计：按会话日志里的用量和本地价目表折算，不调计费接口、不联网、也不额外消耗 token。

description.en: Per-call token meter for the DSH composer: a colour-coded pill under the input and a dashboard above it showing every model call (total versus billable input+output), sub-agent spend, tool overhead and cache-versus-fresh input, read only from local session logs.
description.zh: 输入框下方的彩色 token 胶囊与上方展开面板：逐次调用的双图（总消耗 / 可计费）、子代理开销、工具归因与缓存拆分，只读本机会话日志。

description.en: Predict a task's steps, tokens, duration and cost from this machine's local session history, with a local price table for cost estimates. Read-only, local-only.
description.zh: 基于本机历史会话预检任务的步数、token、时长与费用（P25/P50/P75 区间），本地价格表用于费用估算；只读本地数据，无网络。

description.en: Device-wide token usage on the Settings Usage page: Chat and Code cards with input, output and cache rows, a daily token chart that groups by scene or by model, and a per-model table that merges providers, all folded read-only from the local session logs.
description.zh: 设置页「用量」：本机 Token 用量统计，按 Chat / Code 场景分卡展示输入、输出与缓存明细，每日 Token 图可按场景或模型分组，并按模型汇总（跨 provider 合并）；全部只读本地会话日志推导。

description.en: Usage and balance dock for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: today's spend next to a Beijing-time peak/off-peak pricing band, today's tokens and cache hit rate, and a plain balance row that opens a detail panel. The panel lists the balance account, an eight-week activity heatmap where any day can be selected, and that day's tokens, cache hit rate, peak/off-peak cost and per-session breakdown with each session's own composition bar. Usage is read from the local session logs only; the only outbound request is the balance query against the provider base URL already configured in DSH. A heavily rewritten fork of Aisland-SJL/dsh-usage that uses the same plugin id (usage), so install only one of the two.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的用量与余额悬浮卡：今日花费配北京时间峰谷计价带、今日用量与缓存命中率，以及一行余额入口。面板里有余额账户明细、近八周活跃热力图（可点选任意一天），以及当天的用量、命中率、峰谷费用和按会话拆分的明细（每个会话带自己的成分条）。用量只读本机会话日志；唯一的对外请求是用 DSH 里已配置的供应商 base URL 查询余额。基于 Aisland-SJL/dsh-usage 大幅改写的分支，使用相同的插件 id（usage），两者只能安装其一。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness usage meter: a current-session cost status bar plus a Codex-style statistics page with token KPIs, a 53-week activity heatmap and weekly cell bars, priced with DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量统计：状态栏显示当前会话费用拆分，统计页提供 Codex 风格的 KPI 卡片、53 周活动热力图与每周柱状图，按 DeepSeek 峰谷价计费。

description.en: Cross-session usage rollup that resolves opaque route keys to real model names, with a per-request log, an editable four-bucket price table that leaves unknown models unpriced instead of guessing, and a calendar-day-filled bar trend whose values appear only on hover or keyboard focus.
description.zh: 本机跨会话用量汇总：把 qfmodel 这类不透明路由键解析为真实模型名，含逐请求明细表与可编辑的四桶价格表（无公开单价的模型标为未计价而非猜测），趋势柱状图按日历日补齐、数值仅在悬浮或键盘聚焦时显示。

description.en: Cross-agent token usage dashboard: aggregates local conversation logs from Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor IDE, DSH, OpenClaw, CodeWhale, Hermes and more into a persistent ledger that survives log deletion, with cache-hit rate, cost estimation, period comparison and day drill-down analytics in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 跨 Agent 的 token 用量看板:聚合 Claude Code、OpenCode、Cursor、DSH、OpenClaw、CodeWhale、Hermes 等本地对话日志,台账持久化(删除聊天记录后历史仍留存),提供缓存命中率、成本估算、环比对比与当日下钻分析的侧边栏面板。

description.en: Trims the GenUI card component prompt per global, workspace, or session scope; the built-in presets cut 24% to 61% of the prompt.
description.zh: 按全局、工作区、会话三级裁剪 GenUI 卡片组件提示词；内置预设削减 24% 到 61% 的提示词。

description.en: Shows per-answer and conversation cost estimates from recorded token usage, with automatic model pricing updates and detailed price-source breakdowns.
description.zh: 根据已记录的 Token 用量估算每轮回答和会话费用，支持自动更新模型价格及查看价格来源明细。

description.en: Current wall-side power in watts, today's energy use and electricity cost, shown above the sidebar account row.
description.zh: 在左侧边栏账号头像上方显示整机功耗、今日用电量与电费估算，支持电价与 CPU TDP 校准。

description.en: Monochrome MiniMax Token Plan radar: a sidebar readout with the 5-hour and weekly window remaining and both reset countdowns, plus a dashboard with tokens spent on this machine by day and by model and the pay-as-you-go cost estimate.
description.zh: MiniMax Token Plan 的黑白仪表盘：侧边栏常驻 5 小时与周窗口余量及两级重置倒计时，主面板另有本机按日、按模型的 token 消耗与按量价目估算费用。
