description.en: Composer status bar for GLM Coding Plan quota: 5-hour and weekly limits with reset times, MCP tool usage, and today's model usage, plus a glm_balance query tool.
description.zh: 在输入框下方常驻显示智谱 GLM Coding Plan 余量，含 5 小时/每周额度、重置时间、MCP 调用量与今日用量，并附 glm_balance 查询工具。

description.en: Shows the current conversation's cache hit rate and per-request token details in a fixed DSH sidebar entry.
description.zh: 在固定的 DSH 侧边栏入口显示当前对话的缓存命中率与逐请求 Token 明细。

description.en: Local-first usage analytics for DSH: subscribes to session events and aggregates tool calls, turns, errors, latency and capability usage into daily tables, shown in a sidebar panel (6 KPIs, 14-day trend, top tools, capability breakdown) and served over a fenced local HTTP API with 18 JSON-RPC methods. Zero runtime dependencies, local mode makes no outbound requests, and no message bodies are collected.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 用量分析：订阅会话事件，把工具调用、回合、错误、耗时与能力使用聚合为日表，在侧栏面板展示（6 个 KPI、14 日趋势、Top 工具、能力分布），并通过受围栏保护的本地 HTTP 接口暴露 18 个 JSON-RPC 方法。运行时零依赖，local 模式零出站，不采集任何消息正文。

description.en: Shows the remaining MiniMax coding-plan quota (5-hour window and weekly window) below the chat composer, and keeps the profile's MiniMax model list current by appending newly released models.
description.zh: 在对话输入框下方显示 MiniMax 编程套餐剩余额度（5 小时窗口与周窗口），点击可查看详情；并把新发布的模型追加到配置的模型列表里。

description.en: Retro pixel CRT overlay for DSH showing the DeepSeek account balance and live token usage.
description.zh: 复古像素 CRT 的 DSH 浮层，实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与 Token 用量。

description.en: Live DeepSeek API balance and this session's token usage in the conversation header, with a detail panel for the topped-up / granted balance split, request count, input, output and cache-hit tokens, and context pressure. The API key is read on every query and is never cached, written to disk or returned to the browser.
description.zh: 在对话标题栏实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额与本会话 token 用量，详情面板展开余额拆分（充值／赠送）、请求次数、输入／输出／缓存命中 tokens 与上下文占用；API Key 每次查询现取，不缓存、不落盘、不返回浏览器。

description.en: Routes dsh requests by conversation scenario and retries with fallback models when requests fail.
description.zh: 根据对话场景选择模型，并在请求失败时按候选链进行回退。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek API balance (official endpoint) and today-spend estimate (this DSH instance session-log usage x per-model price table) for the DSH web: composer dock strip, always-on floating badge, full settings dashboard (7-day trend, per-model cost, editable price table and polling, history rescan). The API key never leaves the host.
description.zh: DSH Web 实时显示 DeepSeek API 官方余额与今日花费(本机会话日志用量 x 分模型价格表的本地估算):输入框下方统计小条 + 右下角常驻悬浮徽标 + 设置页完整面板(近 7 日趋势、分模型花费、可编辑价格表/轮询、历史重扫)。API Key 不出宿主进程。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API account balance and live round-trip latency to the configured inference provider in one sidebar widget, with a configurable low-balance alert threshold. The balance needs DEEPSEEK_API_KEY configured in DSH credentials, otherwise the widget shows a missing-key notice.
description.zh: 一个侧边栏挂件同时显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额与当前推理服务商的实时往返延迟，并可自定义余额告警阈值。读取余额需要在 DSH 凭据中配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，未配置时挂件会提示缺少密钥。

description.en: A credit meter for XD Pool (WorkBuddy) accounts that shows each account's remaining credits and package breakdown, measures today/month/all-time consumption from balance snapshots, and warns about credits expiring within 3, 7 and 30 days. It reads its data from the XD Pool plugin (XDTrees/dsh-xdpool) and shows a data-source-unavailable state when that plugin is not installed.
description.zh: XD Pool（WorkBuddy）积分计费面板：显示每个账号的剩余积分与积分包明细，按余额快照差值实测今日/本月/累计已消耗积分，并按 3/7/30 天分档预警即将过期积分。 数据来自 XD Pool 插件（XDTrees/dsh-xdpool）的本地路由，未安装该插件时面板显示「数据源不可用」，本插件不自行实现上游协议。

description.en: Floating cost crystal for the Web UI: balance card, real-time tok/s, peak/off-peak billing countdown, last-24h spend, and a 🔮 next-message cost forecast, all timezone-aware.
description.zh: Web UI 成本水晶球:余额卡片、实时 tok/s 速率、波峰/低峰计费倒计时、近 24h 消耗,以及 🔮 下一条消息消耗预测,全部时区感知。

description.en: Session cost meter forked from dsh-cost-meter, retargeted at a self-hosted gateway: per-session and per-day cost, a 90+ model price catalog with automatic matching, gateway quota (one-api / new-api / sub2api, auto-detected) shown as used/total bars for the provider configured in DSH settings, Coding Plan quotas, provider balances, peak/off-peak pricing notices, bilingual UI. It provides service:cost-meter like Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter and the other dsh-subscribe-meter variants, so install only one cost meter: it replaces dsh-cost-meter rather than running alongside it.
description.zh: dsh-cost-meter 的 new-api 定制版：本会话与当日费用、内置 90+ 模型价格目录与自动匹配、网关额度（自动识别 one-api / new-api / sub2api，取 DSH「模型」设置里的 provider）以已用/全部进度条显示、Coding Plan 额度、自定义 Provider 余额、峰谷计价提醒，界面中英双语。 它与 Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter 及同仓库其它变体提供同一个 service:cost-meter，只能装一个费用统计插件：本条目替代 dsh-cost-meter 安装，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Session cost meter forked from dsh-cost-meter, retargeted at OpenCode Go: per-session and per-day cost, a 90+ model price catalog with automatic matching, OpenCode Go subscription usage as rolling 5-hour / weekly / monthly percentages with progress bars, Coding Plan quotas, provider balances, peak/off-peak pricing notices, bilingual UI. It provides service:cost-meter like Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter and the other dsh-subscribe-meter variants, so install only one cost meter: it replaces dsh-cost-meter rather than running alongside it.
description.zh: dsh-cost-meter 的 OpenCode Go 定制版：本会话与当日费用、内置 90+ 模型价格目录与自动匹配、OpenCode Go 订阅用量（滚动 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月百分比 + 进度条）、Coding Plan 额度、自定义 Provider 余额、峰谷计价提醒，界面中英双语。 它与 Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter 及同仓库其它变体提供同一个 service:cost-meter，只能装一个费用统计插件：本条目替代 dsh-cost-meter 安装，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Session cost meter forked from dsh-cost-meter, retargeted at OpenDesign Cloud: per-session and per-day cost, a 39-model OpenDesign price catalog, OpenDesign Cloud quotas as rolling 5-hour and 7-day used/total bars read from the official funding-check endpoint, Coding Plan quotas, provider balances, peak/off-peak notices, bilingual UI. The quota card needs an OpenDesign Cloud account (the plugin has a built-in login), and it provides service:cost-meter like Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter and the other dsh-subscribe-meter variants, so install only one cost meter: it replaces dsh-cost-meter rather than running alongside it.
description.zh: dsh-cost-meter 的 OpenDesign Cloud 定制版：本会话与当日费用、39 个 OpenDesign 模型价格目录、OpenDesign Cloud 额度（联动官方 funding-check 接口，5 小时 / 7 天两档已用/全部进度条）、Coding Plan 额度、自定义 Provider 余额、峰谷计价提醒，界面中英双语。 额度卡需要 OpenDesign Cloud 账号（插件内置登录），且它与 Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter 及同仓库其它变体提供同一个 service:cost-meter，只能装一个费用统计插件：本条目替代 dsh-cost-meter 安装，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Free Egg credits panel for the DSH sidebar: WorkBuddy / Qoder account balances, daily budget, check-in state and per-turn spend (WorkBuddy credits priced per input / cache / output token type where rates are known), with one-click switching of the platform whose credits are spent first when new-api is configured. Requires a local WorkBuddy2API or Qoder gateway.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏看 WorkBuddy / Qoder 账号积分、今日额度、签到状态与每轮消耗（WorkBuddy 已知单价时按输入 / 缓存 / 输出分类型折算）；配置 new-api 后可一键切换优先消耗平台。需本机运行 WorkBuddy2API 或 Qoder 网关。

description.en: Floating DeepSeek API balance capsule for the DSH Web GUI: a corner pill shows the remaining balance, clicking expands the total, granted and topped-up breakdown, double-clicking refreshes at once and the balance polls every 5 seconds; the host half proxies /user/balance so the key never reaches the browser.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 DeepSeek API 余额浮窗：角落胶囊显示余额，点击展开总额、赠金与充值明细，双击立即刷新且每 5 秒轮询一次；宿主侧代理 /user/balance，密钥不下发到浏览器。

description.en: Keeps DeepSeek usage and account balance in a bar at the bottom of the window.
description.zh: 在窗口底部常驻显示 DeepSeek 用量与账号余额。

description.en: The missing receipt for DeepSeek prefix caching: replays local DSH sessions, prices every call at official peak/off-peak rates, and produces an HTML receipt plus a shareable card.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 前缀缓存省下的钱逐笔算清：回放本地 DSH 会话、按官方峰谷价计费，生成 HTML 账单与可分享卡片。

description.en: Composer-dock badge that shows whether DeepSeek peak pricing is active: red during peak hours, yellow in the 30 minutes before they start, green off-peak, hidden for non-DeepSeek providers.
description.zh: 输入框下方的徽标：显示 DeepSeek 是否处于高峰计费时段——高峰时为红色，高峰开始前 30 分钟内为黄色，空闲为绿色；非 DeepSeek 来源时隐藏。

description.en: DeepSeek balance, today's spend, peak/off-peak countdown and per-turn cost rendered as one text line embedded in the DSH sidebar footer, plus a low-balance alert. A text-only derivative of dsh-whale-widget (MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget); do not install both - they register the same /dsh-whale/* routes and share the same ledger files.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 余额、今日已用、峰谷倒计时与每轮消耗做成 DSH 侧栏 footer 里的一行纯文本，并在余额低于阈值时提醒。这是 dsh-whale-widget（MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget）的纯文本衍生版，不能与上游同装：两者注册相同的 /dsh-whale/* 路由并共用同一份账本文件。

description.en: Token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: daily totals per model, with a trend chart, a calendar heatmap and a table view.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量面板：按模型统计每日消耗，含趋势图、日历热力图与表格视图。

description.en: Exact per-session spend for DeepSeek Harness, billed request by request at the peak or off-peak rate in force when that request was sent.
description.zh: 在会话状态栏精确显示本会话累计花费：按每次请求各自的时段价与所用模型分别计费。

description.en: Local token totals, per-model usage and a 12-week heatmap in a Chinese sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在中文侧栏面板中展示本地 Token 总量、模型用量与 12 周热力图。

description.en: Shows account balance, current peak/off-peak token price and today's spend in the dsh sidebar; today's spend is read from the local dsh-cost-meter ledger (~/.dsh/.dshw-usage.json), so it shows a dash until dsh-cost-meter is installed.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏显示账户余额、当前时段单价与今日已用金额；今日已用读自本机 dsh-cost-meter 账本（~/.dsh/.dshw-usage.json），未安装 dsh-cost-meter 时该项显示为「—」。

description.en: Local-first research toolkit for DSH: registers kb_grep, kb_list, and kb_save model tools. kb_grep searches the markdown knowledge base with ripgrep when present and falls back to grep, while kb_list and kb_save go through the scoped ctx.fs filesystem service; the KB defaults to ~/dsh-kb. The repo also ships two skills (local-first-research and session-memory) that must be copied into a DSH skills directory yourself; they are not installed by the plugin bundle. The plugin is pure Node ESM with no npm runtime dependencies and ships a framework-free node test harness. Installable via plugin_manager install_bundle; no client UI is bundled.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地优先研究工具包：注册 kb_grep / kb_list / kb_save 三个模型工具。kb_grep 用 ripgrep（没有时回退 grep）搜索 markdown 知识库，kb_list / kb_save 则经由作用域化的 ctx.fs 文件系统服务读写，知识库默认 ~/dsh-kb；仓库另附两个 skill（local-first-research 与 session-memory），需自行复制到 DSH 的 skills 目录，插件包不会安装它们。插件为纯 Node ESM、无 npm 运行时依赖，附无框架的 node 测试。通过 plugin_manager 的 install_bundle 安装；不含前端 UI。

description.en: ChatGPT-like conversation layout for the DeepSeek Harness Web client: a 768px centered column, right-aligned neutral bubbles for user turns, full-width assistant text at 16/28, and rounded code blocks with their own copy banner. Adds semantic inline markup (`==confirmed==`, `!!risk!!`, `++key word++`, with bare 4xx/5xx codes highlighted automatically) and line-start check/warn/tip callouts; a fast/thinking chip in the composer that switches the model reasoning effort through ctx.modelDirectories; and sidebar contrast, where the selected session gets a tinted row with an accent bar and workspace folder icons are colored.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 的对话排版改成 ChatGPT 风格：768px 居中版心、用户消息右侧中性灰气泡、助手消息全宽 16/28 正文、带独立复制条的圆角代码块；另有行内语义标记（==已确认==、!!风险!!、++重点词++，裸的 4xx/5xx 自动命中）、行首 ✅/⚠️/💡 整行卡片、发送框旁「快速 / 思考」胶囊（经 ctx.modelDirectories 切换推理强度），以及左侧工作区高亮：选中会话带底色与左侧色条、工作区文件夹图标上色。

description.en: Arknights-style procedural opening film and silent looping chat backdrop for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: Canvas-drawn visuals, synthesized WebAudio sound, click-anywhere skip, cross-dissolve into the interface, live-adjustable opacity; zero dependencies and no media files. By default the film (about 12 seconds, with sound) plays on every page load; a setting turns it off.
description.zh: 明日方舟风格的程序化开屏短片 + 静音循环聊天背景：Canvas 实时绘制、WebAudio 合成音效、点击画面跳过、片尾交叉溶解进界面、透明度实时可调；零依赖、无媒体文件。默认每次加载页面都会播放开屏短片（约 12 秒，带声音），可在设置里关闭。

description.en: Applies a Warm Beige light palette and a Dark Charcoal dark palette to the DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面应用暖米白浅色与深炭灰深色两套配色。

description.en: Ten Markdown-reader colour schemes for DeepSeek Harness that repaint the window background and the rendered Markdown typography, with a dedicated settings page to switch between them.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供十种来自 Markdown 阅读器的阅读配色：整个窗口背景与正文排版跟随方案变化，并提供独立设置页切换。

description.en: Per-wallpaper offset for dsh-dream-skin - nudge the current wallpaper along X and Y in pixels from Settings, remembered separately for each image, URL or gradient.
description.zh: dsh-dream-skin 的壁纸位移插件：在设置里按像素微调当前壁纸的 X 与 Y 偏移，图片、URL、渐变三类壁纸各自记忆。

description.en: Apple Liquid Glass skin that re-keys the harness design tokens, then adds its own settings page, a grouped model picker with peak and off-peak rate badges, and a merged usage panel.
description.zh: Apple Liquid Glass 皮肤：重写 Harness 的整套设计 token，并自带设置页面、带峰谷时段标记的分组模型选择器和合并后的用量面板。

description.en: Ye Xueqing (Justice Online) theme skin: two switchable artwork variants (wisteria courtyard / snowy river) rendered as a mask-edged band behind all UI text, bundled LXGW WenKai GB interface font with a toggle, and an exclusive mode that disables other skin plugins while it is on.
description.zh: 逆水寒·叶雪青主题皮肤：两个可切换的立绘变体（春庭藤影／雪霁寒江），画面经四边带遮罩置于全部界面文字之下，随包附带霞鹜文楷GB 字体开关，开启独占时自动停用其他皮肤插件。

description.en: One install for a whale-girl boot animation, a cyber code-eye video background and a holographic dark theme. The skin and background video (CC BY-NC-SA) are downloaded from the upstream repo on first launch; the boot animation is only installed when @ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation is already present.
description.zh: 一次装好鲸鱼娘开机动画、赛博代码眼动态视频背景与全息暗色主题。皮肤与背景视频（CC BY-NC-SA）在首次启动时从上游仓库下载；开机动画仅在本机已装 @ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation 时才生效。

description.en: A Madara pixel theme with dark crimson colors, Chinese pixel fonts, and a skippable Sharingan startup animation.
description.zh: 宇智波斑像素主题：暗红配色、中文像素字体和可跳过的写轮眼启动动画。

description.en: Reveals the real wallpaper and windows behind the main chat area in Anywhere Labs DSH Desktop on macOS, using native glass with adjustable background and panel opacity.
description.zh: 在 macOS 的 Anywhere Labs DSH Desktop 中让主聊天区透出真实壁纸和后方窗口，复用原生玻璃材质并支持调整背景与面板不透明度。

description.en: Restyles the DeepSeek Harness welcome area and composer, with workspace, mode, and skill shortcuts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 欢迎区和输入栏换肤，并提供工作区、模式与技能快捷入口。

description.en: Skins the DSH Web UI to match the opencode console — theme tokens, sidebar, chat markdown, tables, the composer and the question dialog restyled through CSS — and shows the current workspace's git branch under the composer. It also hides the sidebar brand row and the New session button.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 换成 opencode console 的视觉风格：通过 CSS 重绘主题 token、侧栏、对话区 Markdown、表格、输入框与提问弹窗，并在输入框下方显示当前工作区的 git 分支；同时会隐藏侧栏品牌行与「新会话」按钮。

description.en: Retro CRT phosphor theme: pure-black Matrix green, 40K amber-green or TFEL amber screens with bold glowing text, a code-rain boot animation and a BIOS-style control panel.
description.zh: 复古 CRT 磷光主题：纯黑底黑客帝国绿 / 40K 黄绿 / TFEL 琥珀三种屏种，粗胖发光字，附代码雨开机动画与 BIOS 风控制面板。

description.en: Rococo theme for the DSH Web GUI, shipped as a CSS overlay: misty-blue, silver and ivory surfaces with champagne hairlines, die-cut hang-tag sidebar rows, a scalloped-paper composer card with a bow, frosted assistant bubbles, gold-plaque code-block banners, and per-message avatar badges; a sidebar panel shows the stylesheet state and live avatar previews. Light and dark palettes follow the app theme.
description.zh: 洛可可风 DSH Web GUI 主题，以一份 CSS 覆盖层实现：雾蓝/银蓝/奶白配色与香槟金细线、模切吊牌侧栏、带蝴蝶结的扇贝纸输入卡、磨砂助手气泡、鎏金代码块横幅、每条消息的头像徽章；侧栏面板显示样式表状态与头像预览。深浅色跟随应用主题自动切换。

description.en: Colour-theme and wallpaper plugin: 62 colour themes (37 built-in, derived from OpenCode palettes, plus 25 IP presets), each shipping its own Markdown and syntax-highlight palette, a layer that pushes sub-4.5:1 semantic colours back to readable contrast, and local background images with fill or tile, blur, scrim and rotation. Replaces the earlier cnhenaihui/dsh-ios-theme.
description.zh: 配色主题与壁纸插件：62 套配色主题（37 套内置、源自 OpenCode 调色板，另有 25 套 IP 预设），每套自带 Markdown 与语法高亮配色，另有一层把低于 4.5:1 的语义色推回可读对比度，并支持本地背景图（铺满或平铺、模糊、遮罩、轮换）。取代此前的 cnhenaihui/dsh-ios-theme。

description.en: Theme plugin — supports dark/light appearance switching, ships 34 preset themes, and supports creating, sharing, and importing custom themes.
description.zh: 主题插件 —— 支持深色/浅色外观切换，提供 34 款预设主题，支持创建/分享/导入自定义主题。

description.en: WeChat-style skin for the Harness web UI: grey chat list, green outgoing bubbles, white incoming bubbles, a green send button, and a 已归档 tag on archived sessions.
description.zh: 把 Harness 界面换成微信风格：灰白配色、绿色气泡、绿色发送键、微信字体，已归档会话带「已归档」标签。

description.en: An eye-friendly green skin that reskins the whole DeepSeek Harness Web UI to a low-blue-light green palette, with complete light and dark mode coverage.
description.zh: 鎶ょ溂缁匡紙璞嗘矙缁匡級鐨偆涓婚锛氭暣浣撹鍐?DeepSeek Harness Web 鐣岄潰鐨勮璁?token锛屾祬鑹蹭笌娣辫壊涓ゅ閮芥崲鎴愪綆钃濆厜銆佹煍鍜岀殑鎶ょ溂缁块厤鑹层€?

description.en: Gemini-styled skin restyling the conversation ground, sidebar rows, hero greeting and composer through one stylesheet over the --dsw-* tokens, with light and dark both covered.
description.zh: Gemini 风格皮肤，用一张叠在 --dsw-* 令牌之上的样式表重塑对话区底色、侧栏胶囊行、首屏问候语与输入框，明暗主题都覆盖。

description.en: Bayern Munich skin for the dsh web GUI: home-red/away-white canvases, real match-photo backdrops for 19 first-team players plus drawn shirt, squad-wall, Allianz-Arena and plain backdrops, switchable player and accent colour.
description.zh: 拜仁慕尼黑主题的 dsh Web 皮肤：主场红/客场白双配色画布，19 名一线队球员的真实赛场照背景，外加球员球衣、阵容号码墙、安联球场、纯色四种程序绘制背景，可切换球员与强调色。

description.en: 22 light-only palettes (Pantone / Chinese traditional / Morandi) and 14 composable surface effects for DeepSeek Harness, with twelve-shichen clock rotation, manual picks that lead until the next boundary, workspace binding, per-session colour marks and a nickname/avatar row whose editor lives in the settings page.
description.zh: 22 套仅浅色配色（Pantone / 中国传统 / 莫兰迪）与 14 种可叠加的表面效果，含十二时辰轮换、手动选色优先到时段边界、工作区绑定、会话颜色标记，以及设置页内的昵称与内联头像编辑。

description.en: Vietnamese UI language for the DSH web client (all 2,615 core strings), three Vietnamese palettes in light and dark, and a rotating Vietnam-landscape backdrop from Wikimedia Commons with per-photo attribution.
description.zh: DSH 网页客户端的越南语界面（全部 2,615 条核心文案）、浅色与深色各三套越南风配色，以及来自 Wikimedia Commons 的越南风景轮播背景（逐张标注作者与许可）。

description.en: Three retrofuturist skins for the DSH Web GUI — a dusk train, neon rain and a sunset coast — with an in-page switcher and locally saved selection.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供黄昏列车、霓虹雨夜和落日海岸三套复古未来主义皮肤，支持页内切换并在本地保存选择。

description.en: Cyberpunk HUD theme for DeepSeek Harness. While a session is empty, a radar sweep reveals a dotted world map, network arcs and a telemetry panel; sending the first message removes all of it.
description.zh: 赛博朋克皮肤：空会话时扫描线自上而下扫过，扫过处浮现点阵世界地图与城市航线，左下角带信号监控；发出第一条消息即整体退场。

description.en: Moonrise dark theme for the DSH Web UI, with deep indigo surfaces and warm amber accents.
description.zh: 月升暗色主题——深蓝夜色打底、琥珀月光点缀。

description.en: One-shot entrance animation when the workspace opens: the logo is written onto the canvas, then an inverted color bar sweeps across on exit; mirrors light/dark themes automatically.
description.zh: 打开工作台时的一次性入场动画：标识逐字擦出，退场时反色色块扫过全屏，深浅主题自动镜像。

description.en: Adeptus Mechanicus amber CRT skin for DeepSeek Harness, themed on Warhammer 40,000: a gear-and-skull emblem replaces the brand mark, the new-session slogan is written as a machine-cult verse, 14 theme tokens and 23 static palette entries are overridden, a monospace font stack covers the UI outside KaTeX math, scanlines and a screen vignette are added, and the agent-preset selector is 10% wider.
description.zh: 以《战锤 40,000》机械神教为灵感的琥珀 CRT 风格皮肤：以齿轮骷髅圣徽替代默认品牌标记，新会话口号改写为机械神教偈语，覆写 14 枚主题令牌与 23 枚静态调色板色值，在 KaTeX 公式之外统一全站等宽字体，叠加扫描线与屏幕暗角，并把模式选择器加长 10%。

description.en: Eight Material-family colour themes for DeepSeek Harness (Palenight, Ocean, Darker, Lighter, Catppuccin Latte, Vitesse, Snazzy and GitHub Gray), each with light and dark palettes, switched from a row of colour cards in Settings → General → Theme.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 做的八套 Material 系配色（夜紫、幽蓝、墨灰、素白、奶咖、青苔、霓光、灰阶），每套含深浅两版，在「设置 → 通用 → 主题」里点色卡切换。

description.en: Adds animated ASCII sharks to new and existing chats with adjustable counts and named style presets.
description.zh: 在新会话和聊天正文中显示游动的 ASCII 鲨鱼，支持调整数量和保存命名样式。

description.en: Wandering Earth 550C control-room palette for the DSH Web UI, with dim 2px frames and amber selection states.
description.zh: 流浪地球 550C 控制台配色的 DSH 界面皮肤，含暗色 2px 边框与琥珀选中态。

description.en: Six material skins for the DSH Web GUI — Ink Jade, Terracotta, Aurora, Abyss, Sakura Mist and Paper — painted with CSS only: one engine derives the 119 --dsw-* alias tokens from six colour inputs per appearance, Alt+K cycles skins, and the choice is remembered in localStorage. No images, no host route.
description.zh: 六套材质皮肤：墨玉、赤陶、极光、深海、樱雾、素笺。纯 CSS 绘制，一套引擎由六个输入色推导全部 119 个 --dsw-* 别名 token，Alt+K 轮换，选择记在浏览器本地；不含图片，不注册宿主路由。

description.en: Three photograph skins for the DSH Web GUI — River Night (三江夜), Lingyun Dusk (凌云晚照) and Emei Mist (峨眉夜雾). Each paints its Leshan photograph across the window and the conversation column under an appearance-keyed scrim; one engine derives the other 119 --dsw-* alias tokens from six colour inputs per appearance, Alt+K switches skins, and the choice is remembered in localStorage.
description.zh: 三套乐山照片皮肤：三江夜、凌云晚照、峨眉夜雾。照片同时铺在窗口和对话画布上，按明暗外观压罩层；每套皮肤由 6 个输入色推导全部 119 个 --dsw-* 别名 token，Alt+K 轮换皮肤，选择记在浏览器本地。

description.en: Animated ocean waves with a whale swimming behind the page, plus translucent surfaces.
description.zh: 整个应用背景铺设动态海浪特效，一条鲸鱼在页面后面游泳，界面各层变为半透明。

description.en: Moonlight theme: cool-white light and navy dark palettes, rounded Latin type in light mode, assistant replies in bubbles or plain flow, minimal sidebar chrome, stepless body and sidebar ink weight, a 4-12 character sidebar title cap, and optional idle timestamps. Clicking the 工作区 label reveals archived sessions; Up/Down step through sessions.
description.zh: 月光主题：冷白浅色与海军蓝深色两套配色，浅色下用圆润拉丁字体，助手回复可选气泡或平铺，侧栏可精简，正文与侧栏字重各自无级可调，侧栏标题长度 4–12 字可调，空闲时间戳可隐藏；点侧栏「工作区」展开已归档会话，上下方向键切换会话。

description.en: Firefly "Spring Missive" theme skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Overrides 74 --dsw-alias-* design tokens in matched light and dark sets, draws a spring-window backdrop with drifting petals and fireflies, places one character illustration on each side of the layout, and keeps the centre column legible with a radial spotlight scrim. Registers a Settings section with switches for the skin and for the artwork; both choices persist in localStorage.
description.zh: 流萤「春日手信」主题皮肤。覆盖 74 个 --dsw-alias-* 官方设计令牌（明暗两套），绘制春日橱窗背景与飘落花瓣、萤火；布局两侧各放一张人物立绘，中央用径向聚光遮罩保证文字对比度；在设置里注册分区，提供皮肤与立绘两个开关，选择存在 localStorage。

description.en: Dark CRT pixel skin for the conversation pane: hard borders, block shadows and bitmap headings, scoped to chat and composer.
description.zh: 会话框的深色 CRT 像素皮肤：硬边框、方块阴影与点阵标题，只作用于聊天区和输入区。

description.en: Applies the Naihuangxin appearance preset with settings backup and restore. A preset for elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine 1.4.0; that plugin and the local Naihuangxin wallpaper (Workshop 3808236079) are required.
description.zh: 应用奶皇新外观预设，支持设置备份与恢复。它是 elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine 1.4.0 的预设，需先装该插件并备好奶皇新壁纸（工坊 3808236079）。

description.en: Firefly-themed wallpaper background for the DSH Web GUI: four hand-picked wallpapers behind the chat, a canvas firefly field on top, and sliders for veil, blur, particle count and panel transparency.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Web 界面挂一张流萤壁纸，再撒一层萤火虫：四张壁纸可选，遮罩浓度、模糊、萤火虫数量、面板通透度、缓慢漂移都能在设置里调，深色和浅色主题各有一套参数。

description.en: Unofficial Golden Spatula fan theme for the DSH Web GUI: an original hextech arena backdrop with a golden spatula crest (a parchment chart in light mode), four accent palettes (gold, cyan, violet, blue), a hex-board lattice, an optional aurora-and-gold-dust ambience, soft or sharp corners, a three-choice augment draft with a local 12-card codex, and a floating hex-core panel that can turn the theme off without uninstalling.
description.zh: 金铲铲同人风格的 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面主题：原创海克斯竞技场背景与金色铲影（浅色为羊皮纸棋盘地图），金/青/紫/蓝四套强化配色与令牌覆盖，界面底层铺六边形棋盘网格，另有可开关的极光与金色浮尘氛围、圆润/锐利棱角切换，以及三选一的海克斯强化草案和 12 张本地图鉴；右下角「海克斯核心」面板可一键关闭、即时还原原生界面；不含游戏素材。

description.en: Neon-green deep-space skin with dual character art, a 9-slice composer frame and a black-and-neon palette.
description.zh: 荧光绿的深空主题：双角色立绘、九宫格对话框外壳，黑底配荧光绿描边。

description.en: A CSS skin that restyles the reasoning-tier control drawn by hytime/dsh-thinking-effort into a blue-to-violet pill with a starfield and a sheen sweep, with matching light and dark palettes. Requires that plugin to be installed; it adds no UI of its own.
description.zh: 给 hytime/dsh-thinking-effort 已经画出来的推理等级控件换一层 CSS 皮肤：蓝紫渐变胶囊、 星点与流光，浅色与深色主题各一套配色。需先安装该插件，自身不新增任何界面。

description.en: Hello Kitty pink theme skin for the DSH Web UI: overrides the --dsw-alias-* semantic tokens in light and dark mode and paints a custom wallpaper on the app frame. Installs as a static profile plugin, so the theme restores automatically on every Harness start.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的 Hello Kitty 粉色主题皮肤：覆盖 --dsw-alias-* 语义 token（浅色/深色），并给主框架铺上自定义壁纸；作为静态 profile 插件安装，Harness 每次启动自动恢复。

description.en: EVA cel-shade skin for the Harness Web UI. Overrides the --dsw-* design tokens to give panels square corners, ink outlines, hard offset shadows and CRT scanlines, adds a three-state session rail (running, done, waiting on you), recolours the turn-navigator ticks, and can embed an optional dark backdrop image.
description.zh: EVA 赛璐璐风格皮肤。只覆盖 --dsw-* 设计令牌，把面板改成方角、墨线描边、无模糊硬投影和 CRT 扫描线，并加入会话三态状态轨（运行中、已完成、等你回复）、重绘右侧跳转条刻度，可选用一张压暗的底图。

description.en: Dark mecha wallpaper theme with graphite glass panels, drifting particles and a pointer-following spring mesh, with 16 adjustable settings and a one-switch return to the native look. The bundled Gundam wallpaper is not covered by the MIT license.
description.zh: 黑灰机甲壁纸主题：石墨玻璃面板、流动粒子与鼠标弹性网络，内置 16 项可调设置，一个开关即可恢复原生外观。内置的高达壁纸不在 MIT 授权范围内。

description.en: Adds Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, One Dark, Gruvbox, Solarized, GitHub, Everforest, Kanagawa and Rosé Pine presets to the DSH Web GUI theme picker, layered over the built-in light/dark/system appearance.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 的主题选择中加入 Nord、Dracula、Catppuccin、Tokyo Night、One Dark、Gruvbox、Solarized、GitHub、Everforest、Kanagawa、Rosé Pine 十一套配色预设，与内置的浅色/深色/跟随系统正交叠加。

description.en: Parchment-and-ink theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with a paper texture, Song serif type and a matching dark palette.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的旧纸墨褐主题：纸纹、宋体排印，另配一套深色「墨夜」。

description.en: Dark-only starry-sky theme for the Web UI: both Light and Dark resolve to one deep-space night palette with a twinkling click-through starfield and four constellation figures, and the appearance preference is pinned to Dark while the plugin is enabled.
description.zh: 深色星空主题：浅色与深色外观统一为同一套深空配色，带闪烁星点和四组星座连线；插件启用时外观固定在深色。

description.en: Saber (Fate) theme for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web with light/dark palettes, 30 on-demand chat wallpapers rotating every five minutes, and a task attention tray below the right-side turn index, compatible with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版和 Web 的 Saber（Fate）主题，提供冰蓝浅色、深色配色、每五分钟随机切换的 30 张按需加载聊天背景，以及右侧对话索引下方的任务关注浮层，兼容 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 和 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Global cyber-terminal theme: a click-through full-screen Matrix code-rain overlay, phosphor-green UI styling, a sidebar one-click toggle, and adjustable speed, density, opacity and glow with three palettes.
description.zh: 全局赛博终端主题：可点击穿透的全屏 Matrix 代码雨叠加层、荧光绿 UI 配色、侧边栏一键开关，以及可调的雨速、密度、透明度与发光和三套配色。

description.en: iOS 26 style liquid glass theme for DeepSeek Harness: a fully transparent workspace, layered glass panels, a built-in wallpaper gallery, and a control center for workspaces and plugins.
description.zh: DSH 的液态玻璃主题：工作区全透明、分层玻璃面板、内置壁纸库，外加一个管工作区与插件的控制中心。

description.en: Dark navy glass theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with a cyber-city background and holographic-cube cyan accents.
description.zh: 深海军蓝半透明面板承载赛博城市夜景背景、全息立方体青色辉光作为点缀的暗色主题。

description.en: Persona 3 Reload style skin: midnight-blue palette, cyan hairlines, skewed blue selection slabs, game-style-like dialogue boxes.
description.zh: Persona 3 Reload 风格皮肤：午夜蓝配色、青色细线、斜切蓝色选中板、类游戏式对话框。

description.en: Six switchable background palettes, a custom image, or any solid color for DeepSeek Harness, with adjustable opacity and a dedicated Background settings page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供六套可切换背景、自定义图片或任意纯色，可调节不透明度，并注册为独立的「背景」设置页。

description.en: An ink-wash theme for DeepSeek Harness inspired by Luzhou Moon, a guofeng song by the Chinese singer Vae. Built on dsh-theme-customizer, it repaints the app background, sidebar, composer, new-session button, settings panel, Cordis panel and floating panel with generated ink-landscape artwork, adds gold filigree frames and a full-screen rain effect, and rotates vertical lyrics drawn from 24 of his Chinese-style songs.
description.zh: 以许嵩国风作品《庐州月》为题的 DSH 水墨主题。基于 dsh-theme-customizer，为界面背景、侧边栏、输入区、新会话按钮、设置面板、Cordis 面板与浮窗面板换上程序生成的水墨画面，配金丝边框与全屏雨幕，并竖排轮播其 24 首国风作品的歌词。

description.en: Light neumorphic theme with pale glass cards and a fish watermark, plus a dark sci-fi boot animation.
description.zh: 浅色拟态主题：白色玻璃卡、大肥鱼水印、品牌渐变 logo，附带深色科技启动动画。

description.en: Orihime golden-hour skin for DeepSeek Harness: a two-layer illustrated backdrop with a sidebar workshop for composition and sharpness, amber message bubbles and a cream letter-paper composer.
description.zh: 井上织姬主题的暖金皮肤：两层插画背景、可调构图与清晰度的侧栏工作台、琥珀色消息气泡与奶油信纸输入框。

description.en: Shows the local desktop wallpaper behind a translucent DeepSeek Harness window: the image is pixel-aligned with the desktop (edge-snaps, partially off-screen and maximized windows included), follows wallpaper and slideshow changes, and adapts the readability veil to the image brightness; dialogs, menus, the embedded browser, the composer and search fields keep their original opaque palette.
description.zh: 把本地系统壁纸显示在 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口背后并逐像素对齐桌面（贴边、移出屏幕、最大化都适用），跟随壁纸与幻灯片切换，按壁纸明暗自动调节可读性蒙层；对话框、菜单、内嵌浏览器、输入框与搜索框保持原本不透明配色。

description.en: Matrix-style binary (0/1) digital rain for the Harness interface: columns spawn only while a task is running, fall off screen when it stops, and leave a blank canvas; frosted-glass token layer with adjustable digit and panel opacity.
description.zh: 黑客帝国式二进制数字雨（字形只有 0 与 1）：仅任务运行时生成数字，任务停止后停止生成并让已有数字落出屏幕、画面归空；配磨砂玻璃 token 层，数字与面板透明度均可调。

description.en: Sakura theme, companion notifications (approval/job/answer), message read-aloud, and voice settings for the DSH web GUI.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的樱花主题与陪伴功能：审批/任务/回答提醒、消息朗读、语音设置。

description.en: Capy-style ambient background for DSH with wallpaper, bottom black gradient, and composer aura.
description.zh: DSH 氛围背景插件，支持壁纸、底部深色渐变与输入框光晕。

description.en: Genshin Nicole PV wallpaper skin for the DSH web GUI — 14 subtitle-free frames rotate on a timed crossfade queue with pause and manual switching.
description.zh: 原神·尼可 PV 背景皮肤：14 张去字幕画面定时轮播淡入淡出，支持暂停与上一张/下一张切换。

description.en: Ambient firefly forest behind the DSH Web UI: a full-window canvas with a dark shrub layer, breathing fireflies on grass blades, and an owl or a moth that lights up when a drifting spark passes; on DSH Desktop a workbench panel adjusts brightness, firefly density, owl frequency, season and UI transparency.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的环境背景：全窗口 canvas 铺一层暗色灌木林，草叶上的萤火虫呼吸明灭，飞过的光点会照亮猫头鹰或蛾子；在 DSH Desktop 上另有工作台面板，可调亮度、萤火虫密度、猫头鹰频率、季节与界面透明化。

description.en: Animated wallpaper plugin with 8 canvas backgrounds (particles, meteors, starfield, waves, rain, bubbles, matrix, aurora) plus custom video import, and speed/density/opacity/blur sliders with localStorage persistence.
description.zh: 动态壁纸插件：8 种内置 Canvas 壁纸（粒子、流星雨、星际穿梭、波光、雨幕、气泡、字符雨、极光）加自定义视频背景，支持速度/密度/遮罩/模糊调节，配置持久化。

description.en: A switchable WebGPU black-hole theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that retains the built-in Dark palette and animates only the new-session background.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的可切换 WebGPU 黑洞主题：沿用内置深色配色，仅在新会话页面显示动态背景。

description.en: UI theme customizer, acrylic frosted glass, and panoramic live video/wallpapers for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 专为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 UI 个性化配色、毛玻璃拟态与全景壁纸/动态视频外观定制插件。

description.en: 2005-era instant-messenger skin for the DeepSeek Harness client: right-angle 1px window chrome, a blue-gradient title bar, SimSun for the Chinese UI, a buddy-group sidebar with an avatar card and editable signature, per-message name/time headers, and three switchable intensities. All artwork is original SVG; the reskinned toolbar also carries a cross-session notepad, a running-session panel, and an 8-ball game, minesweeper, a token garden and heads-up poker that a built-in focus mode silences.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 客户端的 2005 年代即时通讯皮肤：直角 1px 窗框、蓝色渐变标题条、中文界面统一宋体、好友分组式侧栏（含头像档案卡与可编辑签名）、每条消息带名字与时间抬头，皮肤档位三档可实时切换。美术全部为原创 SVG；重绘后的工具条另带跨会话备注框、后台任务面板，以及美式八球、扫雷、Token 农场和德州扑克——插件内置的专注模式会把它们静音。

description.en: Generative aurora wallpaper for the Harness web UI: 13 palettes, adjustable breathing and motion, and a local photo or video as the backdrop.
description.zh: 给 Harness 网页界面加一层生成式极光壁纸：13 套配色、呼吸与流动可调，也能用本地图片或视频当壁纸。

description.en: Local-folder wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: it defaults to your Pictures library (C:\Users\<you>\Pictures) and the host serves those images over same-origin HTTP, rotating one every N minutes (0-1440, default 5) in a shuffled pass with no repeats; the settings page under Plugins picks a different folder through the native system dialog, and tunes image opacity (100%), darkening scrim (25%) and panel opacity (15%) with changes applied live. Dialogs, modals and menus keep the default opaque background so text stays readable. Reads .jpg .jpeg .png .webp .gif .avif .bmp straight from disk, and keeps per-user settings under $DSH_HOME so upgrades never ship your folder path.
description.zh: 用本地文件夹当 DSH Web 壁纸：默认就用当前用户的「图片」库（C:\Users\<用户名>\Pictures），宿主通过同源 HTTP 提供其中的图片，每 N 分钟轮换一张（0-1440，默认 5），洗牌后一轮内不重复；「插件」页的设置界面可用系统原生文件夹对话框换目录，并可调节背景图不透明度（100%）、压暗遮罩（25%）与面板不透明度（15%），改动即时生效。弹窗、对话框与菜单保持默认不透明底色，字更清楚。直接读取 .jpg .jpeg .png .webp .gif .avif .bmp，用户配置写入 $DSH_HOME，升级不会带上你的目录路径。

description.en: Unofficial Asuka-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness with dual character illustrations, day and night city-dome backdrops, and five appearance settings covering mode, backdrop, character position, backdrop intensity, and character size.
description.zh: 非官方明日香主题皮肤：双人物精绘立绘、城市穹顶日夜背景，含表现方式、穹顶背景开关、立绘位置、背景强度和人物大小五项设置。

description.en: Sakura-afternoon pastel skin for the DSH Web UI: light and dark sakura token palettes, a click-through falling-petal overlay with a soft vignette, a header petal toggle and a General-settings master switch.
description.zh: 樱色午后主题皮肤：浅色/深色各配一套柔和的樱色令牌配色，全屏飘落樱瓣与柔光晕（点击穿透），会话头部的樱瓣开关与「通用设置」里的皮肤总开关。

description.en: Reskins the whole app from a sidebar panel with five skins — pixel arcade, midnight terminal, neon cyber, paper study and aurora glass — changing the palette, type and texture, with one click to restore the default look.
description.zh: 从侧边栏面板用五套皮肤换掉整个应用的配色、字体与质感——像素街机、午夜终端、霓虹赛博、纸感书房、极光玻璃——一键恢复默认外观。

description.en: Six Chinese-aesthetic appearance palettes for DeepSeek Harness — ink, paper, sea and porcelain, three dark and three light, switchable from the plugin market themes tab and generated from the same design source as the Codex port.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供六套中式外观配色：墨、纸、海、瓷，深浅各半，可在插件市场主题页切换；与 Codex 端共用同一份设计源。

description.en: Font system plugin: OFL webfont presets served offline from the plugin, user-imported custom woff2 fonts, and a ctx.fonts registry other plugins can extend.
description.zh: 字体系统插件：随插件离线分发的 OFL 开源字体预设、自定义 woff2 字体导入，以及供其他插件扩展的 ctx.fonts 注册表。

description.en: Coastal light and dark palette for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, built as a token-only ThemeRuntime overlay covering all 107 official alias tokens.
description.zh: 海岸线明暗双色主题，只通过 ThemeRuntime 的 token 层叠加，覆盖全部 107 个官方 alias token。

description.en: Registers two LLM account pools as model providers: TeleAgent (China Telecom TeleAI; paste a token once) with a daily 09:00 UTC+8 full-pool check-in — currently check-in, balances and model listing only, since its chat is blocked by the client signing key — and AutoClaw (Zhipu desktop, Windows), whose tokens are decrypted from the local DPAPI-protected credential store and whose chat streams through the desktop bridge. Both pools report credit balances and model catalogs; quota-triggered failover across local desktop instances is automatic, while switching the AutoClaw account is an opt-in setting (off by default). Panels ship in settings and the left sidebar.
description.zh: 把两个 LLM 账号池注册为模型提供方：TeleAgent（中国电信天翼 AI 星辰超级智能体，需手工粘贴一次 token）支持每天 09:00（UTC+8）全量自动签到，目前提供签到、余额与模型目录，对话仍被客户端签名密钥挡住；AutoClaw（智谱桌面端，Windows）的 token 由本机 DPAPI 保护的凭据解出，对话经桌面端桥接流式返回。两个号池都能查询积分余额与模型目录；额度耗尽时会自动在本地桌面端实例之间转移，切换 AutoClaw 账号则需在设置中开启（默认关闭）。设置页与左侧边栏均有面板。

description.en: Multi-model deliberation pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: independent proposals, blind peer review, program-executed evidence verification, immutable revision and independent acceptance on a fresh context.
description.zh: DSH 多模型协作研讨插件：独立提案、互审、证据核验、完整稿修订与新上下文验收。

description.en: Uses Z.ai / ZCode Start Plan quota inside DeepSeek Harness as a GLM model provider (GLM-5.3-Flash, GLM-5.3) with tool calling and reasoning levels; the settings page shows quota bars, gifted-plan claiming, refresh opportunities and a redacted request log. Requires the ZCode desktop app installed and signed in at least once (the plugin reads its local credential store) and an account with an active Z.ai / Start Plan entitlement.
description.zh: 把 Z.ai / ZCode Start Plan 额度接进 DeepSeek Harness，作为 GLM 模型提供方（GLM-5.3-Flash、GLM-5.3），支持工具调用与推理等级；设置页提供额度进度条、领取赠送计划、刷新机会与脱敏请求日志。需要安装并至少登录过一次 ZCode 桌面客户端（插件读取其本机凭据库），且账号持有生效中的 Z.ai / Start Plan 权益。

description.en: Control panel for local LLM inference servers in the DSH web view: service registry with health checks and stop controls, named parameter profiles for llama.cpp, SGLang and vLLM with pre-save KV/VRAM validation, GPU detection, and tok/s benchmarks.
description.zh: DSH Web 视图中的本地 LLM 推理服务控制面板:服务注册表与健康检查/停止控制、llama.cpp / SGLang / vLLM 命名参数 profile(保存前做 KV/显存校验)、GPU 探测与 tok/s 测速。

description.en: Use Claude models in DeepSeek Harness through Claude subscription accounts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中以 OAuth 登录的 Claude 订阅账号运行 Claude 模型，每个账号一条独立 provider 路由与一份可编辑的模型列表，提供 /claude-login、/claude-account、/claude-usage、/claude-logout 命令，并在输入框显示配额用量。

description.en: Edit reasoning effort levels and thinking formats for models that declare none.
description.zh: 为未声明思考档位的模型编辑推理强度档位与思考格式。

description.en: Official-style model + reasoning-effort control for the composer. Reuses the official picker and always offers Off/Low/High/Max — exactly like the official DeepSeek control — even when a gateway model declares no reasoning effort, with a small hint at the panel bottom when upstream does not natively support it.
description.zh: 输入框里的官方同款「模型 / 推理等级」控制。直接复用官方组件，即使网关模型（如 deepseek-v4.1-flash）未声明思考强度，也始终提供与官方一致的 Off/Low/High/Max 四档；上游未原生支持时，在面板底部显示一行小字提示。

description.en: Declares image input on relay routes whose endpoint omits modality metadata, so models that can see photos stop being rejected as text-only. This also overrides routes that are explicitly declared text-only.
description.zh: 为端点不返回模态元数据的中转路由补上图片输入声明，让本来就能看图的模型不再被当成纯文本拒收；声明为纯文本的路由同样会被覆盖。

description.en: Runs a local OpenAI-compatible relay that forwards DSH chat requests to grok.online, exposing its two chat models in the model picker without an API key.
description.zh: 在本机跑一个 OpenAI 兼容反代，把 DSH 的对话请求转给 grok.online，无需 API key 即可在模型选择器里用它的两个对话模型。

description.en: Talks to the two public Hugging Face Spaces (MiniMax-VL-01 and Llama-2-7B-Chat) that grok3ai.org only embeds in an iframe, presenting them as OpenAI-compatible models.
description.zh: 直连 grok3ai.org 仅用 iframe 嵌进去的两个公开 Hugging Face Space（MiniMax-VL-01 与 Llama-2-7B-Chat），当作 OpenAI 兼容模型使用。

description.en: Signs in to ima.qq.com (Tencent IMA) with a WeChat QR code and runs a localhost OpenAI-compatible relay in front of its SSE chat endpoint, so the four models behind it appear in the picker.
description.zh: 微信扫码登录 ima.qq.com（腾讯 IMA），在本机起一个 OpenAI 兼容反代，把请求翻译成它的 SSE 对话接口，让背后的四个模型出现在模型选择器中。

description.en: Signs in to LightVela by WeChat QR code, reads the model gateway key from your own instance and writes the gateway into llm-pi-ai so its models appear in the picker.
description.zh: 微信扫码登录 LightVela，从你自己的实例里读出模型网关凭据并写进 llm-pi-ai，让套餐里的模型出现在模型选择器中。

description.en: Adds configurable reasoning levels for third-party models and a model-strength picker in the composer.
description.zh: 为第三方模型配置推理强度档位，并在输入栏提供模型与强度选择器。

description.en: Runs a four-task, 150-point model intelligence benchmark inside DeepSeek Harness (Qin 60, Pompeii 45, Pelican 22.5, Candy 22.5): each selected model × reasoning-effort pair executes every task in its own isolated subagent session, Qin and Pelican are graded by the selected judge model against rubrics, Pompeii and Candy programmatically, and batches keep scores, artifacts and cost. Adds a 0–1000 real-world performance score per model × effort computed from local session logs across seven dimensions (output speed, first-token latency, reasoning speed, tool cadence, tool latency, tool success rate, cache hit), with baseline deltas and controlled speed runs, plus a sidebar page with ranking, performance, history and settings views. Each batch spends real tokens of the candidate and judge models, and candidate subagents get file and bash tools inside an isolated run directory.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内跑四题 150 分模型智商评测（秦始皇 60 / 庞贝 45 / 鹈鹕 22.5 / 糖果 22.5）：每个「模型 × 推理档位」组合在独立子会话中逐题执行，秦始皇与鹈鹕按 rubric 由所选裁判模型打分，庞贝与糖果程序判定，批次保留分数、产物与费用；另按模型 × 推理档位从本地会话日志计算 0–1000 真实性能分（输出速度、首字延迟、思考速度、工具节奏、工具耗时、工具成功率、缓存命中 七个维度），附基线偏差与受控测速，并在侧边栏提供排行、性能、历史与设置四个视图。每个批次都会真实消耗候选模型与裁判模型的 token，候选子会话在隔离的运行目录里可使用文件读写与 bash 工具。

description.en: A Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 adaptation of DSH WebTokens that registers a signed-in Chrome DeepSeek web session as the deepseek-web model in DeepSeek Harness, with tool-call transport, reply validation, a Chrome bridge extension, plus install and rollback scripts. It cannot be installed with the one-line plugin add shown on this page: it needs its own installer (node scripts/install-desktop.mjs, which backs up the whole profile first). Prompts, project content and tool results are sent to the DeepSeek website through your Chrome session; the author has tested it on macOS only.
description.zh: DSH WebTokens 的 Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 适配版：把已登录的 Chrome DeepSeek 网页会话注册为 Harness 的 deepseek-web 模型，提供工具调用传输、回复校验、Chrome 桥接扩展，以及安装与回滚脚本。不能用本页显示的单条 plugin add 命令安装：它需要自己的安装脚本（node scripts/install-desktop.mjs，会先备份整个 profile）。提示词、项目内容和工具结果会经你的 Chrome 会话发往 DeepSeek 网页；作者只在 macOS 上测试过。

description.en: Connect a locally installed agy CLI to DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1, with separate thinking levels, quota display, and Harness-owned tools. Community fork of dannndouglas/dsh-antigravity-acp, beta, verified on Windows x64 only. Needs the agy CLI signed in with your own Google account; installing makes new chats default to Agy models (messages go through agy to Google), switches web search to the agy provider and replaces the built-in compaction. Do not enable it alongside other forks that register the agy-local-acp provider.
description.zh: 将本机 agy CLI 接入 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1，提供独立思考档位、额度显示和由 Harness 执行的工具调用。dannndouglas/dsh-antigravity-acp 的社区分支，测试版，仅在 Windows x64 上验证。需要本机 agy CLI 并用你自己的 Google 账号登录；安装后新对话默认走 Agy 模型（消息经 agy 发往 Google），网页搜索切到 agy 提供方，并替换内置的上下文压缩。不要与其他注册 agy-local-acp 提供方的分支同时启用。

description.en: Declare whether a configured third-party model accepts image (multimodal) input; writes the modality into the owning provider settings and verifies it through runtime model resolution.
description.zh: 声明第三方模型是否支持图像（多模态）输入，写入所属提供方设置并通过运行时模型解析校验。

description.en: Per-model enable/disable and renaming for every provider in DeepSeek Harness: a panel at the bottom of Settings - Models with a search box, status chips with counts, a provider filter, collapsible provider groups with group-level switches, and batch actions scoped to the current view. Disabled models leave the model picker and custom names replace the built-in ones. Preferences persist in the profile and apply immediately, without reloading the page or restarting DSH.
description.zh: DSH 全体模型管理：在「设置 → 模型」页底部加一块面板，管理所有 provider 的每一个模型——逐条启用/停用与改名。带搜索框、状态筛选（含计数）、提供商下拉、可折叠的 provider 分组与组级开关，批量操作只作用于当前筛选视图。停用的模型从模型选择器里消失，自定义名直接替换显示名；偏好持久化在 profile，改完立即生效，不用刷新页面、不用重启 DSH。

description.en: Adds a one-click switch to every provider row in Settings - Models: turn a provider off and it leaves the model picker, turn it back on and it returns. It works by wrapping the model catalog call, so it affects the catalog and the picker only, never routing, keys or provider config; existing sessions that already use such a model keep working.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 模型」每个提供商行的「编辑」左边加一个一键开关：关掉哪个提供商，它就从主界面模型选择栏里消失，打开即恢复。做法是包一层模型目录调用，因此只影响目录与选择器，不动路由、密钥与 provider 配置；已经选着该模型的旧会话照常工作。

description.en: Runs one task through several configured models at once — in parallel or as a primary/secondary review — and returns each model's answer plus an aggregated digest.
description.zh: 把一个任务同时交给多个已配置模型（并行，或主模型起草 + 副模型复核），返回各模型答案与聚合摘要。

description.en: Declares two model routes in the llm-pi-ai settings section — a TLPro gateway and Z.ai's GLM-5.3 endpoint — with per-model context windows, output caps and reasoning-effort ladders, so the stock model picker can select and tune them. Requires your own TLPRO_API_KEY and a Z.ai coding-plan ZAI_API_KEY; the patch replaces the whole llm-pi-ai row config.
description.zh: 在 llm-pi-ai 设置节声明两条模型路由——TLPro 网关与 Z.ai 的 GLM-5.3 端点——逐模型给出上下文窗口、输出上限与推理档位，让自带的模型选择器可以选中并调节它们。需自备 TLPRO_API_KEY 与 Z.ai 编程套餐的 ZAI_API_KEY；该补丁会整体替换 llm-pi-ai 行的配置。

description.en: Writes one model and reasoning effort into every session at once from a control beside the composer model picker, since the shipped picker only changes the session you are in. Sessions that already match are skipped, subagent sessions follow their parent instead of being written, and the same selection can be pinned as the default for new sessions.
description.zh: 在输入框模型位旁加一个控件，一次把同一个模型与思考程度写进所有会话——官方模型选择器只改当前会话。已一致的会话会跳过，子代理会话跟随父会话而不被单独写入，也可把同一选择钉为新建会话的默认值。

description.en: Tiers free-channel models into three 1M fallback chains plus a custom chain; orders them by measured throughput, drops models below throughput or error-rate thresholds, and rotates accounts. Requires an OpenAI-compatible gateway (default :8326).
description.zh: 把白嫖渠道模型按倍率分成三条 1M 降级链，另加自定义链；按实测吞吐排序，低于吞吐线或错误率过高的模型不进链，账号到期优先并轮流。需 OpenAI 兼容网关（默认 :8326）。

description.en: Unofficial Volcengine Ark Agent Plan provider: registers an `ark-agent-plan` route with a model catalog fetched from the gateway, per-model thinking-effort control, server-side harness tools, and a quota badge with a panel showing remaining plan capacity.
description.zh: 非官方火山方舟 Agent Plan 模型接入插件：注册 `ark-agent-plan` 路由，从网关拉取模型目录，提供按模型的思考强度控制与服务端 harness 工具，并以徽标和面板展示套餐剩余额度。

description.en: Unofficial Qwen Token Plan provider: registers a `qwen-token-plan-full` route with a model catalog fetched from the gateway, Responses and Chat Completions protocols, server-side built-in tools, image and video generation tools, and per-entitlement budget tracking that disables a benefit once its quota is exhausted.
description.zh: 非官方千问 Token Plan 全能路由插件：注册 `qwen-token-plan-full` 路由，从网关拉取模型目录，支持 Responses 与 Chat Completions 双协议、服务端内置工具、图片与视频生成工具，并按权益做预算跟踪，额度耗尽即停用对应权益。

description.en: Qwen mode for DSH: manages local GenieX and Alibaba Cloud QwenCloud providers, normalizes thinking and sampling, detects model capabilities, and shows per-turn latency and decode speed. Its bundle patch replaces the permission plugin's preset table with reply-only, read-only, workspace-write and danger-full-access (the last two as in stock), so any custom presets are overridden.
description.zh: DSH 的 Qwen 模式：管理本机 GenieX 与阿里云百炼 QwenCloud 提供商，归一化思考与采样参数，识别模型能力，并显示每轮首字延迟与解码速度。随包补丁会整体替换权限插件的预设表：新增 reply-only 和 read-only，并照原样重列 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access，已有的自定义预设会被覆盖。

description.en: Connects CANNBOT gateway models to DSH by reusing the sign-in CANNWork already establishes for opencode: the JWT and virtual key are read from disk on every request, so no separate OAuth flow or extra key is needed, and the account's visible models are registered in the model picker.
description.zh: 把 CANNBOT 网关的模型接入 DSH：复用 CANNWork 已为 opencode 建立的登录态，每个请求从磁盘现读 JWT 与虚拟密钥，不需要另起 OAuth 流程或额外填 key，账号可见的模型会注册进模型选择器。

description.en: Switches to the next healthy model candidate before the next agent step when the current model has been marked unhealthy.
description.zh: 当前模型被判定不可用时，在下一步执行前切换到下一个健康的候选模型。

description.en: Harness-owned lifecycle for the dario proxy — starts it with your harness, readiness-gates it, and stops it when the harness stops, so subscription-backed (Claude/ChatGPT) model routes just work.
description.zh: 随 DSH 启动并管理 dario 代理（把 Claude/ChatGPT 订阅当 API 用），就绪门控、随停随止，订阅模型路由开箱即用。

description.en: Runs MoE4All models locally in DSH with automatic engine installation, model discovery and downloads, inference settings, and live speed monitoring, or connects to an existing service.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中运行 MoE4All 本地模型，支持引擎自动安装、模型发现与下载、推理参数配置和实时速度监控，也可连接已有服务。

description.en: Adds Standard Compute as an OpenAI-compatible model provider through the built-in pi-ai adapter, with its standardcompute router model and two direct model pins; configuration only, no code.
description.zh: 通过内置 pi-ai 适配器将 Standard Compute 添加为 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商，包含 standardcompute 路由模型和两个直连模型；仅配置，无代码。

description.en: Exposes the accounts in a local CC Switch database to DeepSeek Harness: every account (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok Build) becomes a model category in the picker, and the SQLite database is re-read on every model listing and request, so switching accounts in CC Switch needs no DSH restart. Requires CC Switch and the DSH desktop app.
description.zh: 把本地 CC Switch 数据库里的账号接进 DeepSeek Harness：Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Grok Build 的每个账号在模型选择器里各成一类，列模型与发请求时都会重读 SQLite 数据库，在 CC Switch 里换账号不必重启 DSH。需 CC Switch 与 DSH 桌面端。

description.en: Adds a Speed setting (Standard, Fast, Ultrafast) for OpenAI and Codex models on a patched dsh build: the pinned dsh 0.2.1-alpha.2 web client needs the Model / Effort child-slot patch, the host pi-ai must be 0.87.1 or 1.1.0 (other versions refuse to load), and the terminal controls need a patched dsh-TUI. Then it appears in the Model / Effort menu; in dst /speed opens a picker or sets the speed directly, and the current speed shows in the bottom bar. The choice is kept per session, provider and model and is sent as the request service tier.
description.zh: 为 OpenAI 与 Codex 模型增加 Speed 设置（Standard／Fast／Ultrafast），但需要打过补丁的 dsh 构建：钉住的 dsh 0.2.1-alpha.2 Web 客户端要加上 Model / Effort 子槽补丁，宿主 pi-ai 必须是 0.87.1 或 1.1.0（其他版本会拒绝加载），终端控制还需打过补丁的 dsh-TUI。满足条件后它会出现在 Model / Effort 菜单；在 dst 里 /speed 可打开选择器或直接设置，底栏显示当前档位。选择按会话、供应商和模型分别保存，并作为请求的 service tier 发送。

description.en: Turn a logged-in DeepSeek web account into an OpenAI and Anthropic compatible endpoint, with tool calling, image input, an account pool and a local admin console. First use needs a one-time `node scripts/fetch-assets.mjs` in the installed plugin directory to download DeepSeek's PoW runtime from the vendor CDN; without it the proxy starts but every upstream request fails.
description.zh: 把已登录的 DeepSeek 网页账号包装成 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容接口，支持工具调用、图片输入、账号池与本地管理台。首次使用需在插件目录手动运行一次 `node scripts/fetch-assets.mjs`，从 DeepSeek 官方 CDN 拉取 PoW 运行时；未拉取时反代能启动，但所有上游请求都会失败。

description.en: Model quality testing for DeepSeek Harness Desktop with a question bank, manual and scheduled checks, saved responses, human reviews, and model attribution. Install it into the desktop profile: the shared Go backend is started only by the desktop app, and a web profile can only view an already-running desktop backend.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端模型质量检测插件，提供测试题库、手动与定时检测、回答记录、人工评审和模型归因。需装进 desktop profile：共享 Go 后台只由桌面应用启动，装在 web profile 只能查看桌面端已在运行的后台。

description.en: Use your DSH models in [Libre WebUI](https://github.com/libre-webui/libre-webui) for chat, sandboxed Work and usage tracking, with provider credentials kept in DSH. Requires Libre WebUI 0.37.0 or later.
description.zh: 在 [Libre WebUI](https://github.com/libre-webui/libre-webui) 中使用 DSH 模型进行聊天、沙箱 Work 任务和用量统计，提供商凭据保留在 DSH 中。需要 Libre WebUI 0.37.0 或更高版本。

description.en: Configure model providers by probing their endpoint, check DeepSeek Harness health, and repair what can be fixed.
description.zh: 给一个调用网址就自动配好模型，体检框架健康度，并修复可自动修复的问题。

description.en: Configure thinking toggles and reasoning efforts per model for llm-pi-ai and official DeepSeek, and specify input modalities (input or inputModalities) in the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板为 llm-pi-ai 与官方 DeepSeek 提供方按模型配置思考开关与思考等级，并为各模型配置多模态输入类型。

description.en: Google Cloud Vertex AI (Gemini) provider: ADC or service-account credentials, project and region settings, thought-signature replay for tool calls, rate limiting, and a settings page with a live connectivity test.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 Google Cloud Vertex AI（Gemini）：支持 ADC 或服务账号凭证、项目与区域配置、工具调用的签名回传、限流，以及带连通性测试的设置页。

description.en: Adds an "Add model" entry to the model menu for third-party providers, plus a management dialog that switches the model of the current conversation, edits or removes entries, and highlights the one in use.
description.zh: 在模型菜单底部增加「添加模型」与「管理已添加模型」：接入第三方服务商并写入 DSH 模型配置，可编辑 / 删除条目，并一键切换当前对话的模型、高亮正在使用的那一行。

description.en: Reuses the local model proxy of a logged-in XiaoyiWork desktop app (Windows only) so its models appear in DeepSeek Harness without a separate API key.
description.zh: 复用已登录的小艺Work 桌面端本地模型代理（仅限 Windows），其模型直接出现在 DeepSeek Harness 中，无需单独 API Key。

description.en: Use local Ollama in DSH with Ollama native API and params support.
description.zh: 在DSH中使用带有原生API和参数设置的Ollama。

description.en: Exposes every model of every provider configured in DeepSeek Harness through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint on a fixed loopback port, with a sidebar page for the base URL, key, port and model ids.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 里已配置的全部 provider 与模型暴露成一个固定端口的 OpenAI 兼容接口，并在侧边栏提供地址、密钥、端口与模型 ID 的复制页面。

description.en: Use ChatGPT subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness Desktop via official Sign in with ChatGPT, with dynamic Agent registration and native model and reasoning selection.
description.zh: 通过官方 Sign in with ChatGPT 授权在 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 使用 ChatGPT 订阅，支持动态 Agent 注册及原生模型和推理强度选择。

description.en: Bridges the third-party providers saved in a local cc-switch app into DeepSeek Harness: Anthropic-format tool groups become adapter routes, Codex groups are handed to the built-in pi-ai adapter, and a settings page picks which groups to import and in which order.
description.zh: 把本机 cc-switch 里保存的第三方供应商接入 DeepSeek Harness：Anthropic 格式的工具分组注册为适配器路由，Codex 分组交给内置 pi-ai 适配器，并在设置页选择导入哪些分组以及它们的顺序。

description.en: Model switching, model capability configuration, fixed compaction models, subagent routing, and input history enhancement.
description.zh: 模型切换、模型能力配置、固定摘要模型、子 agent 角色路由与输入历史增强。

description.en: Gives pi-ai routed models a reasoning-effort ladder without manual settings: falls back declared to models.dev to a 7-tier default, and replaces the composer model chip with a Codex-style vertical picker.
description.zh: 让 pi-ai 路由的模型无需手写 settings 即可调节思考等级：按 已声明 → models.dev → 7 档兜底 的顺序回退，并把 composer 模型按钮换成 Codex 式竖向选择器。

description.en: Registers OpenCode Zen free models as a native provider: the catalog is discovered live from opencode.ai intersected with models.dev pricing, and a detail page can re-fetch it or test which models answer. Declares no dependencies, so the host's pi-ai stays the only one.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 免费模型注册为原生 provider：目录由 opencode.ai 与 models.dev 价格实时取交集得出，详情页可重新拉取目录或逐个探测哪些模型能调通。不声明任何依赖，宿主自带的那份 pi-ai 始终是唯一一份。

description.en: Adds a Settings section to adjust the advertised context window of each connected WorkBuddy and Trae model, writing the override into the connector's context budgets.
description.zh: 为 WorkBuddy 和 Trae 的每个已接入模型提供可视化上下文窗口调节设置页，并通过宿主设置服务写入覆盖值。

description.en: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan provider route for DeepSeek Harness with all 15 Coding Plan models and per-model reasoning-effort control, generated from a single source and drift-checked weekly.
description.zh: 火山方舟 Ark Coding Plan 的 provider 路由：为 DeepSeek Harness 收录全部 15 个 Coding Plan 模型，每个模型可调思考强度；清单由单一数据源生成，并每周自动探测是否过期。

description.en: Replaces the composer model seat with a search-first picker and adds a model management page: create and edit llm-pi-ai channels, choose which of an endpoint's models exist, and declare per-model thinking ladders and capabilities.
description.zh: 接管输入框的模型座位并新增模型管理页：增改删 llm-pi-ai 渠道、挑选端点里的哪些模型进入本软件、按模型声明思考档位与能力。

description.en: Provider pool for DeepSeek Harness. It runs a local OpenAI-compatible proxy that tries configured LLM providers in priority order and falls back on authentication, quota, rate-limit or server errors, with per-provider usage statistics.
description.zh: 模型 Provider 池：在本地跑一个 OpenAI 兼容代理，按优先级依次尝试配置好的模型服务，遇到鉴权、额度、限流或服务端错误时自动切换，并记录各 provider 的调用统计。

description.en: Runs the local llama.cpp Qwen3.5-4B from a Settings page — Windows only, NVIDIA GPU (8 GB VRAM handles the 4B Q4) — with start, stop and restart, launch parameters, deployment paths with a presence check, provider-route and compaction-policy sync in the profile patch, a loopback request-capture proxy, and a local_worker tool that hands translation, OCR and video-frame chores to the local model by file path. Needs llama-server.exe (verified on b12069) and Qwen3.5-4B GGUF + mmproj files on disk; video frames also need ffmpeg.
description.zh: 在设置页管理本机 llama.cpp 的 Qwen3.5-4B（仅 Windows + NVIDIA GPU，8 GB 显存可跑 4B Q4）：启停与重启、启动参数、部署路径与存在性检测、把模型路由与压缩策略同步进 profile patch、本机请求捕获代理，以及一个按文件路径把翻译/OCR/抽帧杂活交给本地模型的 local_worker 工具。需自备 llama-server.exe（在 b12069 验证）与 Qwen3.5-4B 的 GGUF 量化 + mmproj 文件，视频抽帧另需 ffmpeg。

description.en: Test configured DSH models with connectivity, behavioral fingerprint and a local 18-item weighted intelligence battery scoring 0-100 with a tier and per-question evidence, plus animated or custom SVG probes, quick SVG limits, concurrency controls, and latency and token metrics.
description.zh: 检测 DSH 已配置模型的连接、行为指纹，并用本地 18 题加权基准给出 0–100 智力值、档位与逐题证据；另支持动态或自定义 SVG 生成、SVG 快速模式限制、并发控制及耗时与 Token 统计。

description.en: OpenCode Go provider that verifies a model against the gateway rather than treating a recommendation as a measurement: the models.dev protocol suggestion is probed before it is used, reasoning levels follow a measured contract, and requests run through an ordered protocol fallback chain. Context window, max output and image-input numbers are declared by a runtime-refreshed models.dev layer rather than probed, with operator overrides above both. Several OpenCode Go credentials can be stored and switched from the settings page.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Go 接入 DSH 的提供方插件：不把"推荐"当结论——models.dev 给的协议建议会先真的探一次确认再用，思考档位按实测契约确定，请求走有序的协议回退链。上下文、最大输出与图片输入的数字由运行期刷新的 models.dev 声明层提供而非探测，操作者覆盖排在两者之上。可保存多把 OpenCode Go 密钥，在设置页里切换当前使用的那把。

description.en: Connects DSH to the local Qoder desktop client's sign-in to expose Qoder CN models (qmodel, qfmodel). Windows only: the credential is decrypted with DPAPI.
description.zh: 连接 DSH 与本地 Qoder 桌面客户端登录态，接入 Qoder CN 官方模型（qmodel、qfmodel）。仅 Windows：凭据读取依赖 DPAPI。

description.en: Local Ollama worker tools for DeepSeek Harness: model inventory, a single unverified ask, and a batch runner that chunks long text, checks every item deterministically, returns a small verbatim sample for review and can optionally write the labelled result inside the session workspace.
description.zh: 本机 Ollama 工具：模型清单、单次（未校验）问答，以及跑长文本的批处理——分块并发、逐条确定性校验、回传一小段抽样原文供复核，结果可选择写入会话工作区。

description.en: Connects the OpenCode Zen anonymous free lane to DeepSeek Harness: refresh the model list from upstream, tick which models the opencode provider exposes, test any of them with a real request that ends in one of seven verdicts, and order both the settings card and the model selector by a hand-written S/A/B/C capability rating.
description.zh: 接入 OpenCode Zen 匿名免费车道：可刷新上游模型清单、勾选由 provider opencode 暴露的模型、逐个发真实请求得出七档结论，并用人工 S/A/B/C 评级让设置卡片与模型选择器按能力同序。

description.en: Adds a relay_check tool that runs relaycheck against an LLM API relay to detect model swaps, misreported usage, truncated context and injected prompts; keys are read from environment variables.
description.zh: 提供 relay_check 工具，用 relaycheck 检测 LLM API 中转是否调包模型、虚报用量、截断上下文或注入提示词；key 只从环境变量读取。

description.en: Connects an existing local MiniMax Code sign-in to DeepSeek Harness through a loopback reverse proxy without storing an API key or signing out.
description.zh: 读取本机 MiniMax Code 登录态，经本地回环反向代理接入 DSH；不保存 API Key，也不会退出登录。

description.en: Asks which provider and model to use before each in-process subagent starts, listing the models from your configured LLM providers; if nothing is chosen within 60 seconds the subagent keeps the DSH default route.
description.zh: 在每个进程内子代理启动前询问要用的 provider / 模型，候选列表来自你已配置的 LLM Provider；60 秒内不做选择则子代理沿用 DSH 原本的路由。

description.en: Disables the built-in llm-deepseek-account route so the DeepSeek account model group no longer appears in the picker.
description.zh: 通过禁用内置的 llm-deepseek-account 路由，让模型选择器里不再出现「DeepSeek 账号」模型组。

description.en: Makes DSH's OpenAI Responses calls stateful: after the upstream confirms it stored a response, each turn sends only the newly added input items plus previous_response_id, and a stateless upstream is detected on the first response so every later request falls back to the full history.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 OpenAI Responses 调用走上有状态续接：上游确认保存响应后，每轮只发送新增的 input item 加 previous_response_id；首个响应即可判定上游是否存储，不存储时后续请求自动回退到全量历史。

description.en: Dual-endpoint Zhipu BigModel GLM provider catalog (Coding Plan and ordinary API) with live model discovery, live-tested thinking-tier mapping, and a settings card for keys, endpoints and the default reasoning tier.
description.zh: 智谱 BigModel GLM 双端点模型目录（Coding Plan 与普通 API），支持实时模型发现与实测校准的思考档位映射，提供凭据、端点与默认推理档的可视化设置卡片。

description.en: Adds per-route context window and compaction threshold fields to the Models settings page and a vendor-aware thinking-effort picker to the composer, writing llm-pi-ai capacities, reasoningEfforts, and a compaction-basic patch row.
description.zh: 在模型设置页为每个 pi-ai 路由新增上下文窗口与压缩阈值字段，并在输入框右下角按厂商提供思考强度选择器，写入 llm-pi-ai 容量、reasoningEfforts 与 compaction-basic 补丁行。

description.en: Enable or disable model providers, search models in the selector, and rename provider display names.
description.zh: 供应商启停开关、模型选择器关键字搜索、供应商显示名内联重命名。

description.en: Character persona summaries for DeepSeek Harness: collects moegirl-first public sources, distills them into a reusable persona document through the csp workflow, and keeps a per-character asset library with quality checks, manual source attachment, version snapshots and a settings page.
description.zh: 二次元角色人格总结：萌娘百科优先采集公开资料，按 csp 固定工作流蒸馏成可复用的人格文档，并用资产库管理每个角色的质检、手动资料、历史版本与删改。

description.en: Snapshot and switch the Codex login used by the Codex subagent from the DSH Plugins page, with a Codex usage quota card.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页管理 Codex 子智能体使用的登录账号：保存/切换 auth.json 快照，并显示该账号的 Codex 额度。

description.en: Force the model to write all replies in a chosen language (Simplified Chinese by default) via a system-prompt section, switchable anytime with a tool.
description.zh: 通过系统提示词强制模型全程使用指定语言回复（默认中文简体），可用工具随时切换。

description.en: Offline LAN chat inside DSH: direct chats, group chats and file transfer between machines running the harness on the same network, with UDP auto-discovery, CIDR scanning to add contacts, an optional access code (unset by default), local-only contact aliases, per-message and per-conversation deletion, and a configurable per-file limit. The host opens its own HTTP/WebSocket port for peers, and the plugin imports only node built-ins.
description.zh: DSH 内的离线局域网聊天：同一网络里运行本 harness 的机器之间单聊、群聊与文件传输，带 UDP 自动发现、按网段扫描加联系人、可选访问码（默认未设置）、只在本机生效的联系人备注、单条与整个会话删除，以及可配的单文件上限。宿主半侧为对端另开 HTTP/WebSocket 端口，运行时只用 Node 内置模块。

description.en: Create and configure Agent presets from a single settings section — persona prompt, a checked knowledge-base entry list injected into the system prompt, individual switches for four knowledge-base tools, per-Agent narrowing of MCP connections, and batch knowledge-base import.
description.zh: 在一个设置分区里新建与配置 Agent 预设——人格提示词、勾选后注入系统提示的知识库条目清单、四个知识库工具的独立开关、按 Agent 收窄 MCP 连接，以及知识库批量导入。

description.en: Reads what a message means beneath its literal wording in everyday chat, then steps aside the moment work starts.
description.zh: 日常对话里读字面底下那一层，一进工作就自动让位。

description.en: Mounts a persona kept in Markdown as a system-prompt section, so editing ~/.dsh/persona/*.md changes how the agent speaks; it reloads 150ms after a save instead of requiring a restart, and project-level .dsh/persona/ files override the global ones.
description.zh: 把写在 Markdown 里的人设挂载成系统提示词段落：改 `~/.dsh/persona/*.md` 即可改变回答风格，保存后 150 毫秒自动重载而无需重启，项目级 `.dsh/persona/` 下的同名文件覆盖全局配置。

description.en: A reflection layer for DSH sessions that slowly rewrites a 3-7 entry worldview across value, preference and habit layers, tracks spirit, health and account balance, ingests Bilibili/Douyin videos, and keeps an auditable growth archive. Video intake is optional and needs site cookies; Douyin parsing also needs Edge/Chrome and yt-dlp.
description.zh: 给 DSH 主会话的人格反思层：每日把对话与视频素材沉淀成 3–7 条分层原则，跟踪精神、健康与账户余额，并保留可审计的成长档案；视频摄入为可选项，需站点 Cookie，抖音解析另需 Edge/Chrome 与 yt-dlp。

description.en: Adds a four-part reply-formatting contract to the system prompt, so every answer is laid out like a Xiaohongshu post: a conclusion-first hook, a star-rated comparison table, emoji-headed bullets with four to six concrete steps or numbers each, numbered sections grouped by entry threshold, images that each carry a caption and one source link, and a banned-word list covering nickname terms, hype words and marketing catchphrases. Code, commands, paths and formal documents keep their original formatting. Host-only static prompt section: no config, no client UI, no dependencies.
description.zh: 把一份四段式回复规范注入系统提示词，让每条回答按小红书图文排：结论钩子开场、星级对比表、emoji 分点且每条写到 4-6 条可执行步骤或数值、按门槛分组的编号小节、配图逐张写图注并一图一来源链接，另附一份屏蔽称呼词、感叹烂词与营销话术的黑名单。代码、命令、路径与对外文档保持原格式。纯 host 侧静态提示词小节：无配置项、无前端 UI、无依赖。

description.en: Connects a local Codex ChatGPT login to DSH Desktop, with account controls, quota snapshots, automatic model synchronization, and model selection.
description.zh: 将本机 Codex 的 ChatGPT 登录接入 DSH 桌面版，提供账号管理、额度快照、模型自动同步和模型勾选。

description.en: Connects OpenCode Go subscriptions to DSH Desktop, with API-key management, usage snapshots, automatic model synchronization, and model selection.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Go 订阅接入 DSH 桌面版，提供 API key 管理、用量快照、模型自动同步和模型勾选。

description.en: Banter lexicon plugin: collects the words and angry quips the user said into banter ammo with add, list and random-pick tools, and injects the current ammo list into the prompt every turn.
description.zh: 斗嘴词库插件：把用户说过的粗口与气话收成斗嘴弹药，配收录、查看与随机抽取工具，弹药清单每轮自动注入提示词。

description.en: Daily rotating anime companion persona: deterministic date pick from JSON character cards, roster/reroll tools, and a voice-map route.
description.zh: 每日轮值二次元陪伴角色：按本地日期从 JSON 角色卡确定性选角，支持换角/重抽工具与 voice-map 路由。

description.en: Disk-backed persona card, handover note and long-term memory for DSH agents; each new session reloads them, and every memory carries a source tier, stamped revocation and soft archive.
description.zh: 磁盘上的人格卡、交接书和长期记忆，新会话自动读档；每条记忆带来源档位、盖章作废和软归档，换会话、清上下文之后还是同一个她。

description.en: Persona manager for DeepSeek Harness — a JSON-backed persona library, a per-session binding so each session can run a different persona, an optional default persona for sessions that have no binding, and switching that applies either at once or from the next session; the Web UI adds a Model personas settings page and a persona chip next to the composer, and three model tools let the model list, switch and create personas itself.
description.zh: DSH 人格管理器：人格库存于一份 JSON，可按会话绑定人设、可为未绑定的会话指定默认人格，切换可选立即生效或下个会话生效；Web 端提供「模型人格」设置页与输入框旁的人格切换条，模型侧另有 persona_list / persona_switch / persona_create 三个工具可自行列出、切换与创建人格。

description.en: Persona slot for DeepSeek Harness: each session holds exactly one persona that a later write replaces, a global persona covers every session without its own, a /persona command edits both in conversation, and the Installed page exposes a multi-line panel for the global persona. Persona length is unbounded. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 through rc.5.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的人设插槽（支持 0.2.1-rc.2 到 rc.5）：每个会话只保留一份人设，再次设置是覆盖而非叠加；一条全局总人设覆盖所有没有独立人设的会话；`/persona` 命令在对话里改，已安装页提供多行编辑器改总人设。人设字数不限。

description.en: A human-in-the-loop curation workbench inside a DSH session: mark whole turns or single messages to keep verbatim or to summarize, rewrite user, assistant, tool-result and injected-context messages in place without a model call, then compress the marked ranges with model-written summaries or the official /compact. A local JSON backup is written before every write to the session.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 会话的人工上下文整理工作台：可为整轮或单条消息标记「重要（原文保留）／一般／次要」，不调用模型即可改写用户、助手、工具结果与注入上下文消息，再按标记区间用模型生成的摘要压缩，或调用官方 /compact（范围由官方压缩器决定）；每次写入前都会生成一份本地 JSON 备份。

description.en: Grows a conversation into an editable card tree where each card is one self-contained question and answer, with child cards, same-level branches and in-card follow-ups, and an overview for dragging, re-hanging, cross-referencing or pruning the graph.
description.zh: 把对话长成一棵可编辑的卡片树：每张卡片是独立成篇的一问一答，可以派生深入卡片、同层分支或卡内追问；全览里能拖动节点、改父级、连引用虚线、删节点或分支。

description.en: Read-only session dashboard for DeepSeek Harness over the local ~/.dsh data: a sidebar overview of every session (tokens, estimated cost, turns, tool calls, model mix, daily activity, searchable and sortable session table) and an in-conversation Dashboard view that shows the current conversation turn by turn with per-turn tokens, cost, timing and tools. Zero dependencies, no network.
description.zh: 会话仪表盘，只读本机 ~/.dsh：侧栏总览全部会话（Token、估算成本、轮次、工具调用、模型构成、每日活动、可搜索可排序的会话表），并在会话内提供「仪表盘」视图，逐轮展示当前对话的 Token、成本、耗时与工具。零依赖、不联网。

description.en: Adds two entries to the DSH web sidebar above the settings row: a batch picker that groups sessions by workspace, filters them by a search box and moves the selected ones into a recycle bin, and a recycle bin that restores sessions one by one or all at once, or permanently deletes them. The recycle bin keeps its own list in browser storage and hides its sessions by wrapping the host session-visibility check, so it does not use the host archive; a moved session keeps its log on disk until it is permanently deleted. Sessions that are currently running are refused and reported instead of being moved.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏、设置按键上方加两个入口：「批量删除」按工作区分组并支持搜索，勾选后把会话移入回收站；「回收站」可逐个或全部恢复，也可逐个或清空彻底删除。回收站名录存在浏览器存储里，通过外包宿主的会话可见性判断来隐藏行，因此不复用侧边栏自带的归档；移入后会话日志仍在磁盘上，彻底删除才调用宿主的删除接口。正在运行的会话会被拒绝移入并在面板里说明。

description.en: Permanently delete DSH session records from the sidebar context menu, removing the session log directory, the projection cache entry and the workspace registration in one action. A confirmation dialog guards every delete. Its /dsh-session-purger routes, including permanent delete, are mounted with webServer.register and carry no DSH Host/Origin admission check, so a web page open in your browser can delete session records through them.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话右键菜单里彻底删除会话记录，一次清除会话日志目录、投影缓存与工作区登记；删除前有二次确认对话框。它的 /dsh-session-purger 路由（含永久删除）通过 webServer.register 挂载，没有 DSH 的 Host/Origin 准入检查，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能经由它们删除会话记录。

description.en: Route conversation-compaction calls to a chosen summarizer model in the Web settings page, and retry them on a configured fallback model when the primary ends in an error.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置页里为会话压缩指定摘要模型，并在主模型出错时改用配置的兜底模型重试。

description.en: Per-session color tags for DeepSeek Harness: hover a sidebar session row to pick one of 12 colors, with a colored bar on tagged rows and host-side persistence.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的每个会话标颜色：悬停侧栏会话行即可选色（12 色），被标色行显示同色竖条，宿主侧持久化。

description.en: Star-rating favorites for DSH sessions: hover a session row to rate it 1-5, the row keeps an importance badge, ratings persist in a Host JSON file, and a session_stars agent tool can list, set or clear them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话加 1-5 星收藏：鼠标移到会话行上即可评级，行内常驻重要度徽标，评级持久保存在宿主 JSON 文件里，并提供 session_stars 工具支持读取、设置和清除。

description.en: Turn on the built-in session full-text search backend (session-query-sqlite, SQLite FTS5) that dsh ships disabled by default, so the sidebar magnifier searches message bodies with snippets instead of titles only.
description.zh: 开启 dsh 内置但默认关闭的会话全文搜索后端（session-query-sqlite，SQLite FTS5），侧边栏放大镜即可搜索消息正文并附摘要，而不只是标题。

description.en: Share a DSH conversation without making the recipient install anything — copy a 24-hour LAN link, export a self-contained web page they can open offline, or import a .dshchat file as a real resumable session when both sides run the plugin.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话转发给别人：复制 24 小时有效的局域网链接、导出对方双击即读的自包含网页，或两边都装插件时用 .dshchat 文件导入成一条可继续对话的真实会话。

description.en: Splits a long QQ reply into separate messages sent a second apart, instead of one wall of text. Works only with the QQ channel streaming output turned off (im-qqbot streaming: false); with streaming on, replies bypass this plugin.
description.zh: 把 QQ 那边整段回复按标点拆成几句，隔一两秒一条条发出，而不是一次糊一大段。仅在 QQ 频道关闭流式输出（im-qqbot 设 streaming: false）时生效；流式开着时回复不经过本插件。

description.en: Agent-to-agent mail between DSH sessions on the same host. `send_session_message` delivers after the target's turn or injects into the running one, stamps the sender id itself and rejects forged From headers; every message carries an id, so replies quote it with replyTo, a thread stops the same task being queued twice, and supersedes recalls messages that are still pending. `read_session_info` reads a peer read-only: title, last reply, the files of its last present call, and busy/queue state.
description.zh: 同一宿主内 DSH 会话之间的代理传话。`send_session_message` 可等对方回合结束再送达、也可插进正在跑的回合；发信方 id 由插件自己写，伪造的 From 抬头会被拒；每条消息带 id —— 回信可用 replyTo 引用、thread 防止同一件事排队两次、supersedes 撤回尚未投递的旧消息。`read_session_info` 只读地看对方：标题、最后一轮回复、最后一次 present 的文件、以及忙闲与队列深度。

description.en: Compaction backend that replaces the default compaction-basic: it summarizes the conversation with a configurable pool of low-cost models, sizes each chunk to the chosen model's context window, and merges all digests in one call, with per-route cooldown and session-model fallback.
description.zh: 压缩后端，替代默认的 compaction-basic：用可配置的低成本模型池压缩对话内容，按所选模型的上下文窗口切块，并将所有摘要一次归并，支持逐路由冷却与会话模型兜底。

description.en: Quote an earlier turn of the current conversation into the composer from the @ menu — by turn, not by selected text — so a chat that drifted can be re-anchored on what was actually asked.
description.zh: 在输入框用 @ 按轮次引用本次对话前文（不是选中文字），把跑偏的对话重新锚回当初的需求原文。

description.en: A sidebar panel holding your personal global constitution: the text is kept in one Markdown file and injected into the system prompt of every session, the dsh counterpart of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. An empty file contributes nothing.
description.zh: 侧栏里的「全局宪法」：把跨会话生效的做事准则沉淀到一个 Markdown 文件，每次模型调用都会注入系统提示，相当于 dsh 里的 AGENTS.md／CLAUDE.md；文件为空时不注入任何内容。

description.en: Inject steering or correction into a running session while the model is thinking, or cancel the current turn, from a floating browser panel.
description.zh: 在模型思考过程中随时向当前会话注入纠偏/引导信息，或打断当前回合。

description.en: Resume a conversation whose turn stopped early: /continue and an action-row button carry the interrupted reply on, covering manual stops, failed model requests, output-token cutoffs and crash recovery, and the continuation prompt is retired from the transcript once it has been answered.
description.zh: 从断点继续对话：/continue 命令与消息操作行按钮让模型接着被打断的回答往下写，覆盖手动停止、模型请求失败、输出 token 上限截断与崩溃恢复四种情形，续写提示在被回答后从对话框中回收。

description.en: Gives the model in DeepSeek Harness a real new_conversation tool: creates a session in the current workspace, delivers a self-contained handoff as its first user message, optionally attaches a read-only dsh-session: reference to the calling conversation, pins the title, and switches the Web UI to the new session.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的模型一个真正能用的「新开对话」工具：在当前工作区建会话、投递交接消息、带上一段对话的只读引用，并把 Web UI 自动切过去。

description.en: Project-less chats for dsh: a session created without a workspace gets its own directory under ~/Documents/DSH/<date>/chat-NN, reused whenever the chat is reopened and left in Ungrouped rather than made a sidebar project; the new-session hero gains a hover clear badge and a "work without a project" row, and a client-only sentinel workspace keeps that hero and its composer usable.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供无项目聊天：不选工作区创建的会话会获得自己的目录（~/Documents/DSH/<日期>/chat-NN），重新打开会话时复用，并留在「未分组」而不会变成侧栏项目；新建会话的 Hero 上新增悬浮清除徽标与「不在工作区中工作」一行，另有一个仅存在于浏览器端的哨兵工作区，让该 Hero 及其输入框保持可用。

description.en: Soft-branches a self-contained sub-question into a child session and returns only a bounded digest, so the main context grows by a short summary instead of the whole investigation.
description.zh: 把自包含的子问题软分支到子会话，只把一页以内的结构化摘要带回主上下文。

description.en: Settings card that lists sessions whose history references attachment objects missing from the local attachment store, then backs the log up and replaces those dangling references with text placeholders so the session can send again. The repair script needs Node 22.15 or newer, and the card has been exercised on Windows only.
description.zh: 在设置页列出历史引用了本地附件库中已丢失对象的会话，先备份日志、再把悬空引用替换成文本占位，使这些会话能重新发送消息。修复脚本需要 Node 22.15 及以上；设置卡片目前仅在 Windows 上验证过。

description.en: Adds an Open in new window action to the DSH session menu when paired with the repository's native Desktop shell patch.
description.zh: 配合仓库的原生 Desktop 壳补丁，为 DSH 会话菜单添加“在新窗口中打开”。

description.en: Export a DSH session tree (lead plus subagent fleet) to two Markdown files from one frozen snapshot: a readable narrative summary and a complete raw archive. Target directories are checked against the session file policy, and a blocked location falls back to the workspace exports folder.
description.zh: 把一次会话及其智能体编队从同一份冻结快照导出为两份 Markdown：可读叙事摘要与完整原始存档。导出位置按会话文件策略校验，不可写时自动改存工作区 exports 目录。

description.en: Session rotation for long conversations: when a session reaches its step budget, at the end of the turn the plugin opens a new session in the same workspace, posts a handoff summary it assembles itself from local session events, and archives the old one immediately or after a retention window. Per-workspace step limits, a minimum-steps floor, a cooldown, a rotation cap and a dry-run switch are configurable in the settings page, and the summary is built with no model call.
description.zh: 长会话的换新与交接：会话步数到达上限时，在轮末于同一工作区开新会话，把本地拼装的交接摘要作为首条消息投递，并按开关立即归档或延迟归档旧会话。可按工作区设步数上限，另有最低步数、冷却、连续触发上限与试运行开关，都能在设置页里改；摘要全程不调用模型。
