description.en: Adds a recoverable delete to the session context menu: the Host archives the session, detaches it from its project and moves the session directory plus the Markdown files that session wrote into $DSH_HOME/session-trash; a session with running work is refused.
description.zh: 在会话右键菜单加入可恢复的“删除会话”：归档会话、解除项目归属，并把会话目录连同该会话写过的 Markdown 文件移入 $DSH_HOME/session-trash；有运行中任务的会话会被拒绝。

description.en: Session manager for DSH: export in full, compact or compressed form, back up workspaces as per-workspace ZIPs, restore deleted sessions from a reversible trash, move sessions between workspaces, and check attachment references.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理：全量/精简/压缩导出，按工作区打包备份，回收站恢复误删会话，跨工作区迁移，并检查附件引用是否可解析。

description.en: Full-text search over every DeepSeek Harness session, with a sidebar panel and a record_search tool.
description.zh: 历史会话全文搜索，带侧边栏面板与 record_search 工具。

description.en: Registers /compact_queue, a compaction command that does not drop the request when the session is busy: it compacts immediately when idle, otherwise queues the request in that session and runs it at the session's next idle window, with a 2-second fallback tick beside the agent status event so the trigger is not missed, a 30-minute wait cap, and /compact_queue cancel to withdraw a queued request or abort a running one. Each session keeps its own queue state from a single command registration, completion and failure arrive as a collapsed notice that does not wake the model, and every ManualCompactionError code except busy is terminal so a failure is not retried. Host half only; the core /compact command is left untouched.
description.zh: 注册 /compact_queue：会话忙时也不丢弃请求的压缩命令——空闲就立刻压缩，忙时把请求排进本会话队列，等这个会话下一次空闲自动补跑；agent 状态事件之外再挂一条 2 秒兜底 tick，避免漏触发，排队最长等 30 分钟，排队中或执行中都可以用 /compact_queue cancel 撤销。命令只注册一次，每个会话各自一份排队状态，完成与失败以折叠 notice 注入、不唤醒模型；ManualCompactionError 除 busy 外一律视为终态、不再重试。只有 Host 半边，核心 /compact 不改。

description.en: Collects the sessions that need you into one dock at the bottom of the web GUI sidebar: running sessions, sessions waiting on an approval, plan review or answer, and finished runs whose result has not been opened yet. Rows are sorted by last update and clicking one switches the main view to that session; it reuses the shipped useSessions and useSessionStatus hooks rather than adding a data source, polls nothing, stores nothing and modifies no session. The header dot pulses while anything is running or waiting and settles to a static dot when every row is only a finished-but-unread reminder; with no such sessions the dock collapses to one quiet line, and a collapsed 56px sidebar shows a 36px badge with the count instead of the list. It registers in the sidebar footer slot, so it is part of the layout and does not overlay the conversation list, leaving the existing footer entries below it.
description.zh: 把需要你处理的会话收进网页端侧栏底部的一块坞：正在跑的、卡在等你审批 / 计划待审 / 等待回答的，以及跑完但结果还没打开过的。按最近更新时间排序，点一行就把主视图切过去；复用官方 useSessions 与 useSessionStatus 两个 Hook，不新增数据源、不轮询、不落盘、不改任何会话。头部状态点在有会话运行或等待时脉冲，只剩「已完成」提醒时收成静止圆点；没有这类会话时收成一行细字，侧栏折叠成 56px 时换成 36px 计数圆片而不是摊开列表。坞注册在侧栏底部动作区，是布局里的真实一块、不盖住对话列表，原有底部入口照旧排在它下面。

description.en: Moves the default workspace off the system drive (DSH opens every new Session in <Documents>/deepseek-harness/default-workspace and never relocates it) while keeping stored sessions usable: rewrites the workspace record without a restart, offers the same three actions as a GUI panel, moves stored session logs together with their header cwd, and re-frames logs whose first frame is not exactly one header line. Requires the desktop host (workspaceRegistry and sessionPersistence).
description.zh: 把默认工作区从系统盘挪走（DSH 把新会话一律开在 <文档>/deepseek-harness/default-workspace 且从不迁移），同时让已存会话继续可用：无需重启即可改写工作区记录，同一套动作也有图形面板可点，连同 header cwd 把已存会话日志一起搬走，并重帧化首帧不是恰好一行 header 的日志。需桌面版宿主（workspaceRegistry 与 sessionPersistence）。

description.en: Neutralizes lone UTF-16 surrogates in tool output before they reach the session log, preventing permanent 400 INVALID_REQUEST errors.
description.zh: 在工具输出写入会话日志前中和落单的 UTF-16 代理字符，避免会话永久 400 无法继续。

description.en: Right-click a sent message to edit or withdraw it. The running answer is stopped first, then that message and everything after it are replaced in the conversation: withdrawing leaves a short withdrawn marker and stops there, while editing asks the model again with the new text.
description.zh: 右键已发出的消息即可修改或撤回：先停住正在生成的回答，再把这条消息及其之后的内容替换掉——撤回只留下一条「已撤回」标记并就此停下，修改则按新正文重新提问。

description.en: Organizes multiple live DSH sessions into a collaboration group and relays each round's final output on a shared timeline.
description.zh: 把多个已打开的 DSH 会话组织成一个协作群，只转达每轮最终输出，并按共享时间线合并投递。

description.en: One recency-sorted list of recent sessions across all workspaces, with color-coded workspace badges, a collapsible sidebar section, and the built-in session row actions on right-click.
description.zh: 把所有工作区的最近会话排成一个列表，用彩色底标标明所属工作区，侧栏可展开显示最近会话，右键支持原生会话操作。

description.en: Adopts DSH sessions created outside the running window (IDE/ACP clients, other processes) into their matching Workspace, and imports local sessions from other agent harnesses (pi) as native, resumable DSH sessions with sidebar sync/import actions and idempotent re-import.
description.zh: 把在运行窗口之外（IDE/ACP 客户端、其他进程）创建的 DSH 会话归入对应工作区，并把本机其他 Agent Harness（如 pi）的会话导入为可续聊的 DSH 原生会话，提供侧边栏同步/导入入口与幂等重复导入。

description.en: Lists every session stored in the local DSH profile with its title, workspace, last-modified time and size, then moves the selected ones to a 90-day trash you can restore or purge; deletion detaches the live session first, so the sidebar updates without restarting the app.
description.zh: 列出本地 DSH 配置中保存的全部会话（标题、工作区、最近修改时间、大小），把选中项移入保留 90 天的回收站，可随时还原或彻底删除；删除前会先摘掉宿主内存中的会话，侧栏无需重启应用即可刷新。

description.en: Adds four tools to a Session. create_session opens a new Session in a named workspace or in any existing folder and delivers one prompt into it; session_message adds one more message to a Session that is still running — the host is asked to splice it into that turn at once, instead of queueing it until the turn ends; a Session that has gone idle is refused, pointing back to create_session; read_session_transcript reads back what a Session said and whether its current turn has finished; list_dispatched_sessions lists what this plugin dispatched and each one's state right now. Host-half plugin, no UI — it calls the host's own session primitives rather than reimplementing them. Restart DSH after installing.
description.zh: 给会话加四个工具：create_session 在指定工作区或任意一个已存在的文件夹里开一个新会话，并把一段提示词投进去；session_message 给一个还在跑的会话再追加一条消息——请宿主立刻把它插进正在跑的那一轮，不再排队到本轮结束；已经闲下来的会话会被拒投，并指向 create_session；read_session_transcript 按会话 id 读回它说过什么、当前这一轮结束没有；list_dispatched_sessions 列出本插件派送过哪些会话、各自此刻什么状态。宿主半边插件，没有界面，调用的是宿主自己的建会话能力。装完需重启 DSH。

description.en: Merges the work done in a forked session back into the session it came from: /merge turns the branch's session log into a digest without a model call (each turn's prompt and reply, files changed, commands run, choices you made, to-dos and the final answer) and delivers it with your next message, or at once with --wake; merging the same branch again brings only the turns added since. Also adds /branches, a right-sidebar branch map with merge state, a reminder above the composer for branches with unmerged turns, and session_branches / session_branch_merge tools for the agent.
description.zh: 把分叉会话里做完的工作合并回原会话：/merge 直接从分支的会话记录整理出摘要、不调用模型（每轮的提问与回复、改动的文件、执行的命令、你做的选择、待办和最终结论），随你的下一条消息交给 agent，或用 --wake 立即处理；同一分支再次合并只带新增的轮次。另有 /branches、带合并状态的右侧栏分支地图、输入框上方的未合并提醒，以及供 agent 使用的 session_branches / session_branch_merge 工具。

description.en: Adds a work-without-a-project option to the project picker, creates a dated working directory from the first message, and groups these sessions under a native Recent section.
description.zh: 为不属于任何项目的会话提供「不在项目中工作」选项，按首条消息在 ~/Documents/dsh/<日期>/ 下创建可读的独立工作目录，并在侧栏「最近」分区集中展示。

description.en: Adds a Timestamp toggle to the composer; while it is on, each message you submit is followed by a hidden context message carrying the current local time, so the model knows when you sent it. The switch is remembered per conversation.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏加一个「时间戳」开关：开启后，你提交的每条消息后面会跟一条隐藏的上下文消息，携带发送时刻的本地时间，模型因此知道你是什么时候发的；开关按会话分别记住。

description.en: Lists DSH session records and archive caches on a sidebar page, moves deletions into a restorable recycle bin, and refuses sessions written within the last 10 minutes.
description.zh: 在侧边栏页面里列出 DSH 的会话记录与归档缓存，删除先移入可恢复的回收站，最近 10 分钟仍在写入的会话会被拒绝。

description.en: Export the current session to clean Markdown from a button in the session header, through the native save dialog, with a CLI and an HTTP route over the same renderer; reads session logs directly (formats v0, v3 and v4) and declares no @deepseek-ai peer dependencies.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏加入「导出 MD」按钮，经系统原生保存窗口把当前会话导出为干净的 Markdown，并提供共用同一渲染核心的命令行与 HTTP 路由；直接读取会话日志（支持 v0、v3、v4 格式），且不声明任何 @deepseek-ai peer 依赖。

description.en: Rotate the outbound LLM session ID after each successful DSH compaction without creating a new DSH session.
description.zh: 在每次 DSH 成功 Compact 后轮换对外 LLM 会话 ID，而不创建新的 DSH 会话。

description.en: Live context-pressure meter in the composer dock. When usage nears the limit it asks the current model for a handoff brief, starts that brief in a fresh session and switches you there, so long work can continue without hitting the window.
description.zh: 输入框下方实时显示上下文占用；接近上限时让当前模型写一份交接摘要，开新会话继续干活并自动切过去，长任务不用怕撞上窗口上限。

description.en: Mounts a per-channel speaking-rules file into the QQ preset's system prompt only, so that channel answers in one or two lines while every other channel stays untouched. Does nothing until home points at a folder with the rules file (default QQ线口径.md); meant for the QQ preset, not the global plugin list.
description.zh: 给 QQ 那一条线单独装一张嘴：把口径文件挂成那段会话的系统提示段，只挂 QQ，别的线一个字不动；改 md 就生效，不必重装插件。须把 home 指向放有口径文件（默认 QQ线口径.md）的目录才生效；应挂进 QQ 的 preset，而非全局插件列表。

description.en: Opens any session as a second full chat tab in the right sidebar, with its own transcript and composer, while the main conversation stays put; a split right pane allows up to three concurrent conversations.
description.zh: 把任意会话作为第二个完整对话开在右侧栏（独立记录与输入框），主区对话保持不动；右栏分栏后最多可同时对话 3 个会话。

description.en: Adds an Auto-rename row to each Session sidebar menu: the model reads the Session log, weights recent user messages higher (exponential decay, 3-day time constant), and writes a title of at most 10 CJK characters into the Session title. Also opens that Session menu on right-click, and exposes the same operation as the session_auto_rename agent tool. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer.
description.zh: 在每个会话的侧栏菜单里新增「自动重命名」：模型读取会话日志，按时间衰减给用户消息加权（τ = 3 天，越新权重越高），写出不超过 10 个汉字的标题并写入会话名。同时支持右键会话呼出该菜单，并把同一操作暴露为 session_auto_rename 智能体工具。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或更新版本。

description.en: Adds /btw and /side slash commands that answer ephemeral side questions in an isolated forked sub-session without polluting the main conversation context.
description.zh: 新增 /btw 与 /side 斜杠命令，在隔离的分叉子会话中回答临时旁问，不污染主会话上下文。

description.en: Injects the exact current local time and the timestamp, day relation and recency gap of the previous user message into every prompt, and adds a /time command that prints the injected block.
description.zh: 为每次请求注入精确的本地当前时间，以及上一条用户消息的时间、日期关系与间隔；并提供 /time 命令查看注入内容。

description.en: Bookmark a passage or a whole message in a conversation and jump back to it with one click.
description.zh: 在对话里划选一段话或整条消息打书签，之后一键跳回原位。

description.en: Turns a DSH session into a self-contained interactive HTML mind map of its topics, conclusions, decisions, todos and open questions, and reports what changed since the previous run.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话整理成一张自包含的交互式 HTML 脑图（主题、结论、决策、待办、未决问题），并给出与上一次生成相比的变更。

description.en: Deletes a whole conversation from the sidebar session menu, and opens a right-click menu on a chat text selection with Copy, Quote (insert a Markdown quote block into the composer) and Ask: Ask sends the selection plus your question to one reused continuable subagent (label `ask`, found again through the subagent catalog after a restart) and streams the answer into the right sidebar.
description.zh: 从侧栏会话菜单删除整个会话；聊天里划词右键弹出「复制 / 引用 / 提问」：引用把 Markdown 引用块插入输入框，提问把选区与问题交给同一个复用的可继续子智能体（label `ask`，宿主重启后经子智能体目录找回），回答在右侧栏流式显示。

description.en: Passive recorder that replays the main agent and every subagent on one timeline, flags repeated calls, loops, recurring errors and truncated output, and writes an AI cause-and-effect review on demand.
description.zh: 被动记录器，把主 agent 与所有 subagent 放在同一条时间线上回放，标出重复调用、循环、反复出现的错误和输出截断，并可按需生成 AI 前因后果复盘。

description.en: Folds older oversized tool results into spill files and replaces them with short, deterministic stubs at step boundaries, with no LLM call: the stub keeps the first 200 and last 80 characters plus the sequence number, tool name, line/char/size counts and the original file path, and each fold is a real surface replacement accompanied by compaction/prune shadow pricing so token counts stay honest. Triggers on context pressure at 25% of the model window (falling back to 32768 tokens when the window cannot be resolved) or on five accumulated candidates; the last three turns, error results and rich content are never folded. The original is recovered from the session log rather than the spill file, so /folds, /unfold <seq> and /unfold all keep working after spill cleanup; session_fold_recall lets the model fetch a folded result by sequence number or by keyword, and session_fold_diagnose reports the effective settings. /spill-prune removes orphaned spill directories, preview only unless --apply. A Settings page exposes 12 of the 13 options as draft-then-save fields; they are volatile, so saved changes apply without restarting the plugin.
description.zh: 在 step 边界把较早的超长工具输出折叠为落盘原文加短替身，全程不调用模型：替身保留原文头 200 与尾 80 字符，并附序号、工具名、行数/字符/大小统计与原文路径；每次折叠都是真实的 surface 替换，并紧邻写入 compaction/prune 影子计价，token 统计不虚高。上下文估算达到模型窗口 25%（解析不出窗口时退回 32768 token）或候选积满 5 条即触发；最近 3 轮、错误结果与富内容永不折叠。原文从会话日志恢复而非 spill 文件，因此 spill 被清理后 /folds、/unfold <序号>、/unfold all 依然可用；session_fold_recall 供模型按序号取整条原文或按关键词检索，session_fold_diagnose 输出当前生效配置。/spill-prune 清理无主的 spill 目录，默认只预览，加 --apply 才删。设置页把 13 个配置项中的 12 个暴露为「先改草稿、再点保存」的字段，且为 volatile，保存后无需重启插件。

description.en: Keyboard shortcuts for DSH Desktop: return to the conversation, focus the composer, switch pages, open DevTools, and an Alt+Tab style session switcher that previews sessions while Alt is held and switches on release (DSH NEXT on Windows).
description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop 的快捷键插件：返回会话、聚焦输入框、切换功能页、打开 DevTools，以及 Alt+Tab 风格的会话轮切板——按住 Alt 预览会话，松开即切换（DSH NEXT + Windows）。

description.en: Import Codex and Claude Code session history into DeepSeek Harness: merges same-project sessions into existing workspaces by cwd, offers handoff summaries or full transcripts, and keeps a rollback ledger.
description.zh: 把 Codex / Claude Code 历史会话一键导入 DeepSeek Harness：同路径项目自动归并进现有工作区，支持交接书摘要或全量转录，导入历史可回滚。

description.en: Watches the turn endings of the models you select and asks a second model whether the turn was actually finished: if the assistant stopped after text with no tool call, a three-way verdict of continue, finished or uncertain is recorded and shown in a sidebar panel. In suggest mode it only reports; in auto-continue mode it calls agent.followup() once the turn is idle to send a continuation message, up to a per-turn limit. Single-step turns are always rechecked, watched models can be picked exactly or matched by case-insensitive regex, and the resume text is configurable.
description.zh: 监测你所选模型每一轮的收尾，交给另一个模型判断这一轮是否真的结束了：如果助手说完话却没有工具调用就停了，会记录 continue / finished / uncertain 三态判定并展示在侧边栏面板。suggest 模式只报告，auto-continue 模式在本轮真正 idle 后调用 agent.followup() 发送续跑消息，且受每轮次数上限约束。单步收尾始终复查，监测模型支持精确多选与不区分大小写的正则匹配，续跑文案可自定义。

description.en: Route each WeChat group session to a different Agent preset by group name, reusing dsh-wechat-assistant without changing its code.
description.zh: 按群名把每个微信群会话路由到不同的 Agent 预设，不改动 dsh-wechat-assistant 的任何代码。

description.en: Watches Feishu (Lark) conversations with your own user identity and forwards new messages as prompts into a chosen DeepSeek Harness session: per-monitor sender filters, @bot-mention bypass and keyword allow/block lists, auto-created pinned target sessions, and cursor-based polling that re-reads messages after a failed delivery.
description.zh: 以用户本人身份监听飞书会话，把新消息作为 prompt 投递到指定的 DeepSeek Harness 会话：每个监听支持发送者过滤、@机器人提及与关键词黑白名单，可自动创建并固定目标会话，游标式轮询在投递失败后会重读消息。

description.en: Two triggers (a heartbeat and a log marker) that wake a session and let the agent decide whether to say anything; silence is a reply. Off by default: set sessionId (the target session) and enable it in the profile config, and if replies are forwarded to a chat app the send layer must drop the SILENT marker.
description.zh: 心跳与日志标记两种触发只负责叫醒会话，说不说由 agent 自己决定；沉默也是一种回答。默认关闭：需在 profile 里填 sessionId 并启用；若把回复转发到聊天软件，发送层需拦掉 SILENT 标记。

description.en: Adds one-click permanent Session deletion to the DeepSeek Harness Workspace sidebar: a row-hover trash button, a menu item, a confirmation dialog, live-Session protection, cascade deletion for derived Sessions, and cleanup of the session log directory, projection cache and workspace bookkeeping.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 工作区侧栏增加会话一键永久删除：行悬停垃圾桶按钮、菜单项、确认框、运行中保护、派生会话级联，并清理会话日志目录、投影缓存与工作区记账。

description.en: Adds a /btw slash command that asks a side question or injects information into a running session without interrupting the main agent.
description.zh: 新增 /btw 斜杠命令：主 agent 运行中也能问一个旁支问题或补充一条信息，不打断当前任务。

description.en: Adds a /clear command that clears one conversation's model-visible context while keeping the session itself.
description.zh: 新增 /clear 命令：清空某个会话的模型可见上下文，同时保留会话本身。

description.en: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar session menu, with a confirmation dialog and the host operation that permanently removes the session log.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话菜单里新增「删除会话」，带确认弹窗，并由宿主动作彻底移除会话日志。

description.en: Wakes a Session after the host restarts: an agent arms its own Session, and after the next boot the plugin delivers one message to it, then unregisters it.
description.zh: 宿主重启后唤醒会话：由 Agent 把自己的会话登记进唤醒列表，下次启动后插件投递一条消息把它叫醒，投完自动注销。

description.en: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar session menu that permanently deletes the local records of that session, while refusing sessions that are running.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中加入「删除会话」，永久删除该会话的本地记录；正在运行的会话会被拒绝。

description.en: Auto-continue a stalled turn: re-prompt after an empty turn, a max-tokens cutoff or a listed model error, and switch to a healthy backup route before retrying.
description.zh: 会话守护：空回合、单次输出截断或指定模型错误导致回合终止时自动补一句「继续」；模型连续失败先切到备用路由再重试。

description.en: Agent-facing keyword search over local DSH session logs: session_search returns matching sessions with timestamps and excerpts, session_read dumps one conversation, and both skip injected context such as memory snapshots; no index is built.
description.zh: 面向模型的历史会话关键字检索：session_search 返回命中的会话、时间与上下文片段，session_read 导出单个会话的对话，两者都跳过记忆快照等注入内容；不建索引。

description.en: Batch session cleanup for DeepSeek Harness — pick a workspace, see which sessions are archived, and permanently delete logs, projection caches and workspace records.
description.zh: 按工作区批量清理会话：查看归档状态，把会话日志、投影缓存和工作区记录一起彻底删除。

description.en: Makes the agent narrate progress during long tool chains instead of staying silent until the final answer: a standing system-prompt rule that travels with every request, plus a notice injected after every N tool calls. A panel on the plugin page tunes the cadence, the reminder budget, and both texts; changes apply live.
description.zh: 让 agent 在长工具链中途说明进度，而不是一路静默到最终答复：一条随每次请求下发的常驻系统提示词规则，加上每 N 次工具调用后注入的一条提醒。插件页内的面板可调整步频、提醒上限与两段文本，保存即热生效。

description.en: Permanently delete a session from the session row menu — archives the id, removes the log directory and drops the row at once, with a Delete shortcut; built only on shipped extension points, and a session that was merely opened stays deletable.
description.zh: 在会话行菜单中永久删除会话：先归档、再删除日志目录并立即移除该行，带 Delete 快捷键；只使用官方扩展点，仅打开过、未在运行的会话依然可以删除。

description.en: Keeps a root turn open until progressing child agents and the current-turn background jobs it started settle, then asks for one self-contained final answer in that same turn. Idle children that still have parked input do not delay closing. It observes job settlement without consuming job output, never cancels children, and does not decide task success. Verified on DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 only; on any other host version it stays inactive, logs one warning, and turns close natively. Each batch of results that arrives after a reply costs one extra model call; ordinary questions add none.
description.zh: 让根轮次等仍在推进的子智能体和本轮自己启动的后台任务结束后，才在同一轮里要求模型产出完整、自洽的最终回答。空闲且收件箱里仍有输入的子会话不会挡住收尾。只观察任务是否结束、不消耗任务输出，不取消子智能体，也不判定任务成功。仅在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 上验证；其他宿主版本下插件保持未激活、只写一条警告，轮次按原生方式收尾。回复之后每到一批结果会多一次模型调用，普通问答不增加。

description.en: Session tree with tag chips, group-by-tag, drag-to-move across workspaces, workspace ordering, favourite sessions, a four-state filter, and a delete action that backs sessions up first.
description.zh: 会话树：标签芯片、按标签分组、跨工作区拖拽移动、工作区排序、收藏会话、四态筛选，以及可先备份再删除的删除动作。

description.en: Inspect conversation context and apply configurable compaction with usage history.
description.zh: 查看会话上下文、用量记录，并按设置执行压缩。

description.en: Reads stored sessions at host boot and resumes the one whose last turn a restart interrupted, sending a short follow-up so the work continues.
description.zh: 宿主启动时读取已存会话，找到被重启打断的最后一轮并补发一句「继续」，让中断的工作接着跑。

description.en: One dedicated folder per conversation: archives the transcript, auto-categorizes research output by type once the conversation has been idle for 10 minutes, adds a delete action to the session menu, and permanently removes the folder with the conversation.
description.zh: 每个会话一个专属文件夹：自动存档对话记录，会话空闲 10 分钟后把调研产出的表格、图表等文件按类别归档并自动命名，会话菜单中提供删除入口，删除会话时连同文件夹一起彻底删除。

description.en: Three-scope rule injector for DeepSeek Harness that re-publishes the rules into long sessions, with a loop-breaker, dedupe by content fingerprint, per-session persistence, and a settings-panel editor.
description.zh: 三级规则注入器：长对话里反复重发规则，带熔断、内容指纹去重、会话持久化与设置面板编辑器。

description.en: Long-task continuity for DSH: every turn end writes a breakpoint (what it did, which tools it used, and — when the turn did not finish cleanly — what is still unfinished; the manual continuity_breakpoint tool can record the next step), injected as a snapshot when the same workspace starts a fresh session so work resumes instead of restarting. It also stores SHA-256 fingerprints of persona or config files so you can verify afterwards whether anything was altered. Four tools (continuity_breakpoint, continuity_breakpoints, continuity_ledger, continuity_attest), plain JSONL under <workspace>/.dsh-continuity/, zero dependencies, no network calls. Note: nothing writes ledger.jsonl yet — continuity_ledger only reads it.
description.zh: 长任务续接：每轮结束自动写一条断点（做了什么、用了哪些工具，这一轮没正常结束时还差什么；下一步需手动调用 continuity_breakpoint 记录），同一工作区的新会话开头会把最近几条注入为快照，接着往下干而不是从头再来。同时给人设卡、配置这类文件存 SHA-256 指纹，事后能验出是否被人改过。四个工具（continuity_breakpoint / continuity_breakpoints / continuity_ledger / continuity_attest），数据是以纯 JSONL 存在 <工作区>/.dsh-continuity/，零依赖、不联网。注意：目前没有任何代码会自动写 ledger.jsonl，continuity_ledger 只能读。

description.en: Manual session handoff: when you decide a session has run out of usable context, one click turns its event log into a compact handoff document (goal, done, next, project facts), creates a new session seeded with it and wakes it to continue; the new session can inherit the session-bus name as <name>-handoff. No threshold, no timer, no automatic trigger.
description.zh: 会话手动交接：当你判断上下文确实用不下去时，点一下就把源会话日志压成紧凑交接文档（目标 / 已完成 / 下一步 / 项目事实），据此新建会话并唤醒它继续干活，可继承会话总线注册名（<名>-handoff）。无阈值、无定时、不自动触发。

description.en: Session bus for DSH: independent sessions in one project message each other by session id or registered name and wake the target, with a sidebar inbox, unread badges, a roster verification tool, and a per-project switch that stays off until .dsh-bus.json opts in.
description.zh: DSH 会话总线：同一项目里的独立会话按 session id 或自注册名互相发消息并唤醒对方，带侧栏收件箱、未读标记、名册校对工具，以及默认关闭的项目级开关（由 .dsh-bus.json 开启）。

description.en: Wall-clock session and turn timing for the DSH Web GUI: a timer chip in the session header shows the session total, every finished turn shows its own duration above the action row, and a sidebar panel totals today, the last 7 days, the last 30 days or all sessions. The numbers are folded from turn/start and turn/end in the session log, so paging, compaction and restarts do not change them.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 的会话与轮次墙钟计时：会话标题栏的计时胶囊显示会话累计耗时，每轮结束后在操作行上方显示本轮耗时，侧边栏「会话耗时」面板按今天、近 7 天、近 30 天或全部汇总。数字由会话日志里的 turn/start 与 turn/end 折叠而来，翻页、压缩上下文、重启都不影响。

description.en: Turns the promises a chat quietly drops into an interest-bearing ledger: every “later” becomes a card, older ones rank higher, and each card jumps back to the conversation where it was said.
description.zh: 把聊天里被顺口搁置的“回头再说”记成一份带利息的账本：每句承诺是一张卡，搁得越久排名越靠前，点一下回到当初那句话所在的会话。

description.en: Turns "restarting the host" into one interrupt that many sessions can share. Several sessions queue onto the same restart (8 by default, configurable, joinable at any time including mid-wait); the host is closed once and relaunched once; then each waiting session is woken separately with its own reason and starts running its own work without waiting for the others. Each session decides independently whether to resume, one failed delivery never affects the rest, and a session can drop only itself without cancelling everyone else's restart. Windows desktop only.
description.zh: 把「重启宿主」变成一次中断、多个会话共用：若干会话可以排进同一次重启（默认上限 8 个、可配置，任意时刻都能加入，等待途中也行），宿主只关一次、只拉起一次，随后按名单逐个唤醒，每个会话拿回自己写下的理由并各自开工，互不等待。每个会话独立决定要不要续接，某一条投递失败不影响其余，某个会话也能只摘掉自己而不作废别人的重启。仅支持 Windows 桌面版。

description.en: Welcome-back card in the conversation you return to after an idle period, using only that conversation's last message.
description.zh: 闲置一段时间后回到会话时，在该会话里显示它的上一条消息，并提供断点恢复。

description.en: Adds delete and multi-select batch delete to the sidebar session menu, removing session chat logs with an automatic backup and one-click undo while leaving workspace files untouched.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单新增删除与多选批量删除，连聊天记录一起删除（删前自动备份、可一键撤销），不改动工作区项目文件。

description.en: Prevents concurrent-write session corruption: takes a per-session advisory lock on session start and every step, so a second dsh process fails loudly instead of writing a duplicate-seq gap; dead owners are taken over automatically.
description.zh: 预防并发写导致的会话损坏：在会话开始及每一步获取按会话的咨询锁，第二个 dsh 进程会明确报错而非写出重复 seq 断层；死进程持有的锁自动接管。

description.en: Rolling, integrity-verified backups of each session at turn boundaries: verifies the log still loads before promoting a snapshot, never overwrites the last good one when a turn ends corrupt, and restores in one command even when dsh will not boot.
description.zh: 在每个回合边界为会话滚动保留校验过的备份：提升快照前先确认日志仍可加载，回合结束时若已损坏则绝不覆盖上一份好副本，dsh 启动不了时也能一条命令恢复。

description.en: Buffers consecutive short messages from the composer and merges them into one turn: no model wake-up until the user stops for a configurable silence window; long messages and attachments bypass the buffer.
description.zh: 把聊天框里连发的几条短消息缓冲合并成一轮再唤醒模型：停手若干秒后才回复一次；长消息和附件不延迟。

description.en: Context observability and control for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session token analytics, session-level budget/prompt/tool controls, and optional agent scaffolds. It reuses the official tokenMeter, compaction, systemPrompt, and tools.restrict seams; monitoring is read-only.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文可观测性与控制：跨会话 token 分析、会话级预算/提示词/工具控制，以及可选的 Agent 脚手架。复用官方 tokenMeter、compaction、systemPrompt、tools.restrict seam；监控只读。

description.en: Sidebar tab with every file this conversation produced — preview images, PDF, Markdown, CSV and code in place, and jump back to the turn that made it.
description.zh: 侧边栏列出本会话产出的每个文件：就地预览图片、PDF、Markdown、CSV 与代码，并可跳回产出它的那一轮对话。

description.en: Deletes a session from the sidebar session menu after a confirmation dialog, removing its log directory, projection-cache record and workspace/pin/archive accounting; registry calls are timeout-guarded so a stuck workspace registry cannot block the removal.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话菜单里二次确认后删除会话：移除会话日志目录、投影缓存记录与工作区/置顶/归档记账；所有注册表调用带超时保护，工作区注册表卡住也能完成删除。

description.en: Delivers a queued chat message at the next step boundary instead of waiting for the whole turn to end, without aborting the model call already in flight; aborting is an opt-in mode rather than the default.
description.zh: 把排队中的消息提前到下一个 step 边界送达，而不是等整个 turn 结束；默认不打断已经在跑的模型调用，打断是显式开启的模式。

description.en: Permanently delete one conversation (archived or not) from its sidebar row menu, including its log, projection cache, archive state, and reminders.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单里彻底删除单个对话（含已归档），同时清理会话日志、投影缓存、归档状态与提醒。

description.en: Floating todo panel for DSH sessions with server-side cross-device persistence and pending-task badges in the session list.
description.zh: 会话内悬浮待办面板，支持服务器端跨设备持久化及会话列表未完成任务图标。

description.en: Inlines an image block as base64 only in the one request where it first appears, and marks that same block offloaded on every later request so DSH's own image-offload projection renders it as the placeholder text carrying the read-only local path. An occurrence is keyed by session id, message id, content-tree path and attachment id, and a request is only counted after it produces its first chunk, so retries do not count as sent. Requests carrying a purpose are neither rewritten nor counted, a later read_image of the same file is a new occurrence and inlines once more, and only that request's copy is rewritten, so nothing is written back to the session.
description.zh: 同一张图片只在它第一次出现的那一次请求里以 base64 内联；之后的每次请求都携带被标记为 offloaded 的同一个块，由 DSH 自带的图片 offload 投影渲染成带本地只读路径的占位文字。记账键是会话 id、消息 id、内容树路径与 attachment id 的组合，且请求产生第一个 chunk 之后才记账，因此重试不会算作已发送。带 purpose 的辅助请求既不改写也不记账；事后再对同一文件调用 read_image 算一次新的 occurrence 并重新内联一次；插件只改写该次请求的副本，不写回会话。

description.en: Adds a Q&A agent preset that answers each new question from a clean context: earlier exchanges leave the model input via a surface replacement, with no extra model call and no summary residue. A /qa follow command and a composer toggle switch to follow-up mode, and /clear archives the session and opens a fresh one under the same preset.
description.zh: 问答预设：每个新问题都从干净上下文开始作答，旧问答经 surface 替换移出模型输入，零额外模型调用、无摘要残留。/qa follow 与 composer 开关可切到连续追问，/clear 归档当前会话并以同一预设开新会话。

description.en: Chat / work mode switch: chat conversations hide every tool, work mode reuses the conversation workspace.
description.zh: 聊天 / 工作模式开关：聊天模式隐藏全部工具，工作模式沿用该对话的工作区。

description.en: Project workbench for DSH: groups sessions by project (workspace) in a panel with project cards and session lists, applies a project's default preset, model and reasoning effort to new sessions, scopes memory per project on request, previews AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md read-only, and groups the sidebar by project at startup.
description.zh: DSH 项目工作台：按项目（工作区）组织会话，提供项目卡片与会话列表；新建会话自动套用该项目的默认 preset、模型与推理强度；可按项目隔离记忆；只读预览 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md；启动时把侧栏切为按项目分组。

description.en: One read-only index of every local AI-agent session (Codex, Claude Code, DSH, Trae, or any JSONL source) grouped by project, plus an append-only shared board for decisions and handoffs so switching agents leaves no context gap.
description.zh: 把本机所有 agent 的会话历史合并成一份按项目分组的只读索引，并附一块只追加的共享上下文板，让换 agent 时不丢结论。

description.en: Create timestamped workspace folders and launch new sessions in one click, with a task folder dropdown and automatic title syncing.
description.zh: 一键创建时间戳工作区文件夹并开启新会话，支持任务目录下拉选择与会话标题自动同步。

description.en: Browse, filter, search by ID, delete, restore, export, and import every local session. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, and they can delete and restore local sessions.
description.zh: 浏览、筛选、按 ID 搜索、删除、恢复、导出和导入本机全部会话。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，而这些路由可以删除和恢复本地会话。

description.en: Permanently delete sessions from the DeepSeek Harness UI: a header trash button and a sidebar menu item behind a risk-consent dialog, plus a workbench_session_delete agent tool. Started from lsz-asd/dsh-plugin-session-delete and maintained independently since v0.4.0; do not install it alongside that plugin, since both register the same workbench_session_delete tool.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面里彻底删除会话：会话头部垃圾桶按钮与侧栏「…」菜单项（带风险确认弹窗），另提供 workbench_session_delete agent 工具。从 lsz-asd/dsh-plugin-session-delete 派生并自 v0.4.0 起独立维护；请勿与上游同装，两者都会注册同一个 workbench_session_delete 工具。

description.en: Tiered compaction hub: replaces the single 80% compaction cliff with a configurable ladder (default 30/50/70/90) whose tiers escalate from gentle to maximum consolidation laws, folds a deterministic keyword index into every checkpoint so facts accumulate across cycles, and summarizes through a model chain — primary plus up to 3 fallbacks, each with its own reasoning effort. Adds a Compaction module sub-tab and a Settings card; toggling off always restores stock compaction.
description.zh: 分级压缩中枢：把单一的 80% 压缩阈值换成可配置的阶梯（默认 30/50/70/90），逐级加强压缩力度；每次检查点都折叠入确定性关键词索引，让事实跨周期累积；摘要走模型链——主模型加最多 3 个回退，各自独立推理档位。附带 Compaction 模块子标签页与设置卡片；关闭插件始终恢复原版压缩。

description.en: Holds a drafted message until the main agent is idle, no subagent is running and no background job is live, then sends it. Each hold takes an optional send time and a choice to queue, wait or steer, and lives on the host with its attachments so a restart does not lose it.
description.zh: 暂缓发送一条消息，直到主智能体空闲、没有子智能体在运行、也没有后台任务，然后再发出。每条暂缓可以设置发送时间，并选择排队、等待空闲或立即插话，消息与附件都保存在宿主端，重启也不会丢失。

description.en: Resumes a dormant DSH session on demand: when a session is not currently live, it is resumed from disk with the provider/model route it last used, so external integrations (chat bridges, schedulers, webhooks, other plugins) can deliver into it instead of failing with "that session is not alive". Exposes an HTTP endpoint, a wake_session tool and a ctx.wakeUp service. Resuming only reads history back into memory and spends no model request by itself.
description.zh: 按需叫醒休眠的 DSH 会话：当前没活着的会话会带着它上次用的 provider/model 路由从磁盘 resume 回来，让 QQ 通道、定时任务、webhook、别的插件这类外部集成能正常投递，而不是撞上「那间会话现在没活着」。提供 HTTP 端点、wake_session 工具和 ctx.wakeUp 服务；resume 只把历史读回内存，本身不消耗模型请求。

description.en: Automatically resumes active goal sessions after DSH restart; long-running tasks continue without a manual nudge.
description.zh: DSH 重启后自动续跑有活跃目标的会话,无需人工说「继续」。

description.en: Draggable session cards on a board inside the session canvas, with grid, matrix and freeform layouts, a per-card composer, and native floating windows.
description.zh: 把会话做成卡片桌布：网格 / 宫格 / 自由布局、卡片内直接发消息、可弹出原生浮窗。

description.en: Pause or resume the running task from a 28 px button beside the DSH composer: safe pause lets the current step finish, holds the next agent/pre-step boundary, and resumes the same turn without a continuation message; force pause cancels immediately, and the default granularity is configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁用一枚 28px 按钮暂停/恢复正在运行的任务：安全暂停会先跑完当前步骤，再挂在下一个 agent/pre-step 边界，恢复时原地继续同一轮且不插入续跑消息；强制暂停立即取消；默认粒度可在设置中配置。

description.en: A floating button beside the chat that opens a searchable list of all questions in the session for quick jumps, with smooth hover-open/close behavior.
description.zh: 对话旁的悬浮按钮，打开当前会话全部提问的可搜索列表并快速跳转；悬浮弹出/移出平滑关闭。

description.en: Archived-session management with single and batch deletion, native workspace registry cleanup, and deferred file cleanup while the host holds session resources.
description.zh: 归档会话管理，支持单条与批量删除、原生工作区登记同步，以及宿主持有会话资源时的延迟文件清理。

description.en: Deterministic, zero-LLM compaction engine for DeepSeek Harness: the checkpoint is compiled locally from the session log with no summarizing round-trip, and dropped tool traffic becomes seq reference lines the model can restore with recall, which helps on small context windows. Ships as two packages: install dsh-fast-compact and dsh-fast-compact-preset, add both to the profile's bundles, pick the Fast Compact (standard) preset and start a new session. Needs dsh >=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.3.0.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性、零 LLM 压缩引擎：直接从会话日志在本地编出检查点，不走摘要往返；被丢弃的工具往返变成 seq 引用行，模型可用 recall 取回，对小上下文窗口尤其有用。由 dsh-fast-compact 与 dsh-fast-compact-preset 两个包组成：需都安装并加入 profile 的 bundles，再选「Fast Compact (standard)」预设并新开会话；要求 dsh >=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.3.0。

description.en: Deletes a whole DSH session or one completed turn from the session log: confirmation dialog, live-agent teardown, path and identity checks, pre-rewrite backup, and later turns renumbered.
description.zh: 删除整个 DSH 会话，或只删除会话中某一轮已完成的对话：带二次确认、运行中 Agent 安全停止、路径与身份校验、改写前备份，后续轮次自动顺延。

description.en: Zero-UI-overhead DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically classifies conversation intents and names sessions with clean emoji prefixes (optimize, fix, feature, explore, etc.).
description.zh: 零 UI 侵入的 DeepSeek Harness 会话意图自动分类命名插件，新会话自动生成前缀图标与主题（优化、修复、功能、探索等 8 类意图）。

description.en: Per-task disk-space ledger in the sidebar with opt-in reclamation of unowned junk; session logs are never trimmed.
description.zh: 侧栏里的每个任务磁盘占用账本，可勾选回收无主垃圾；会话日志绝不被裁剪。

description.en: Session manager for the DSH Web UI: browse all and archived sessions, restore/unarchive, delete with two-step confirmation, and preview conversation content from the Settings panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话管理插件：在设置页查看全部与已归档会话，支持恢复（取消归档）、二次确认删除与对话内容预览。

description.en: Automatic, versioned backup of your DeepSeek Harness home — sessions, memories, settings and the profile plugin tree — to a private git remote you own, with commits and pushes on a schedule and every failure surfaced in the DSH log.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 home 自动、带版本地备份到自己的私有 git 仓库：会话记录、记忆文件、设置与 profile 插件树都会按计划提交并推送，失败一定会在 DSH 日志里报告。

description.en: Deletes a whole workspace together with its conversations in one pass - session logs, projection caches and workspace registrations - and optionally sends the workspace folder to the Windows Recycle Bin (on other platforms deletions are permanent).
description.zh: 整块删除工作区及其对话：会话日志、投影缓存与工作区登记一次清掉，可选把工作区目录移入回收站（仅 Windows；其它平台直接永久删除）。

description.en: Generates a structured handoff card so a near-full conversation continues in a fresh zero-context session: /handoff writes the card with self-incrementing titles, pins it to the top of the sidebar and prepares the new session once the context nears its threshold.
description.zh: 用 /handoff 生成交接卡，让快满的对话在全新零上下文会话里接着跑：标题自动递增编号、卡片在侧栏置顶，接近阈值时自动备好新会话。

description.en: One settings card that gives every DSH agent mode its own compaction threshold: it registers <mode>-compact-<ratio> preset copies with compaction-basic.thresholdRatio rewritten, re-registers when the value or the selection changes, and can adopt one copy as the default mode (standard > cordis > minimal > ptc).
description.zh: 一个设置项把压缩阈值铺到所有 Agent 模式：注册 <模式>-compact-<阈值> 预设副本并改写 compaction-basic.thresholdRatio，阈值或勾选变化时重新注册，还可把副本设为默认模式（标准 > 创造 > 极简 > ptc）。

description.en: Session and image management for DSH: a sidebar panel deletes selected sessions together with their on-disk files after DSH has archived them, with multi-select, sub-agent / team-member / whole-family cascade and per-session size; a right-sidebar tab counts a session images and offloads or deletes the selected ones, optionally removing source files and attachment objects from disk.
description.zh: DSH 会话与图片管理：侧边栏多选面板在 DSH 归档后把选中的会话连同磁盘文件一起删除，支持子 agent / 团队成员 / 整族级联与逐个大小统计；右侧栏页签统计会话图片张数并多选摘除，可另行删除磁盘上的源文件与附件对象。

description.en: Chunked compaction for oversized sessions: takes over only when the live context exceeds 85% of the model window (or the request exceeds 4 MB), summarizes the history in 1.5 MB chunks and merges them; smaller sessions keep the built-in compaction.
description.zh: 超大会话分块压缩：仅在实测上下文超过模型窗口 85%（或请求超过 4 MB）时接管，把历史按 1.5 MB 分块摘要再合并；小会话仍走 dsh 自带压缩。

description.en: PTC agent preset whose tools.guard refuses tool calls until the session holds an active goal and an in-progress todo.
description.zh: PTC 模式 agent preset：用 tools.guard 拒绝工具调用，直到会话里有进行中的目标和待办。

description.en: Sends one instruction to a chosen group of existing DSH sessions at once, with attachments, optional answer collection and up to eight temporary subagents.
description.zh: 群发：把一条指令一次发给自己选中的多个 DSH 会话，可带附件、收集回答，并额外拉起最多 8 个临时子代理。

description.en: Cross-session task ledger for DeepSeek Harness: one item per request with a step chain, an accordion strip above the composer, unfinished items injected into every step, staleness review with artifact fingerprints, clickable choices that learn repeated decisions, a grant ledger whose four-mode control sits inside every authorization-blocked card, blind-work backfill checklists, and a scheduler that re-judges an item only when a new assistant answer mentions it.
description.zh: 跨会话焦点账本：每条请求一条焦点（带步骤链），输入框上方条带展开阅读，未收尾项注入每一步，按产物指纹做过期复核，选择题学习重复决策，授权台账的四档控制直接嵌在每张受授权阻塞的卡片里，盲操作附带回填清单，调度器只在新增 AI 回答提到某条时才重新判断。

description.en: Write each session's summary as a Markdown file in its workspace, with a page to browse, regenerate and delete them.
description.zh: 把每个会话总结成工作区里的 Markdown 文件，并提供一个浏览、重新生成和删除的页面。

description.en: Elides stale, oversized plain-text tool results from the model-visible session surface once the prompt cache goes cold, replacing each with a stub that keeps the tail lines and any error lines, and reports per-request and cumulative savings in the composer footer.
description.zh: 在提示缓存转冷后，把陈旧、过大的纯文本工具结果替换为带末尾行与错误行预览的 stub，并在输入框下方显示每请求与累计节省量。

description.en: Rebuilds the sidebar into a workspace / group / session tree: drag sessions between groups, per-session context-usage ring, scheduled-task clock, cost tag, resize handles, 20%/40% context alerts and the balance in the workspace header. Client-only bundle, no host changes.
description.zh: DSH 工作区美化：侧栏改成 工作区 → 分组 → 会话，支持跨分组/跨工作区拖拽归类、会话行上下文用量环、定时任务时钟、单会话花费、两侧调宽把手、20%/40% 上下文提醒，工作区标题栏显示账户余额。纯客户端 bundle，不改宿主。

description.en: Recovers broken DSH turns: widens the product's own retry budget and renders the wait as a live countdown inside the same step, keeps a truncated output alive inside the same turn, and can open an opt-in continuation round when a turn has already ended; while the composer is empty it hands the send button to that continuation.
description.zh: 修复被打断的 DSH 回合：放大产品自带的重试预算并把等待渲染成同一步内的实时倒计时，输出被截断时在同一轮内续写，回合已结束时可选地新开一轮继续；输入框为空时把「继续」交给发送键。

description.en: Session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar menu item, a workspace-grouped batch cleanup panel and a session_delete tool (dry-run by default). Deletes session logs, projection cache, workspace-registry references and derived search indexes, and cascades to all subagent sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话删除：侧边栏菜单项、按工作区分组的批量清理面板、默认 dry-run 的 session_delete 工具。删除会话日志、投影缓存、工作区注册表引用与派生搜索索引，并级联删除全部子代理会话。

description.en: Adds Copy session ID and permanent deletion of a Conversation's log, projection cache and workspace references to the session row's ⋯ menu, behind a two-step confirm.
description.zh: 在会话行的「⋯」菜单里补上复制会话 ID，以及永久删除会话（日志、投影缓存与工作区引用），删除前有二次确认。

description.en: Externalizes oversized assistant and tool messages in long sessions into project files while keeping a recent window, and archives reasoning from empty turns as a visible message so long tasks do not stall on context size.
description.zh: 把长会话里超长的助手与工具消息外化到项目文件并保留最近窗口；正文为空的回合把 reasoning 归档并补一条可见消息，避免长任务因上下文过大而中断。

description.en: Keeps a per-turn receipt that later turns do not clear (final todo counts, goal id and phase, end reason, and a fail-closed pass/fail/inconclusive plan verdict), plus a read-only tool to read recent receipts. Stores counts and ids only.
description.zh: 为每个回合保留一张不会被后续回合清空的凭据(回合结束时的 todo 计数、目标 id 与阶段、结束原因,以及 fail-closed 的 pass/fail/inconclusive 完成判定),并提供一个只读工具回读最近的凭据。只存计数和 id。

description.en: Edits a message you already sent and re-runs from that point by forking the session, and retries a completed turn, in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面里编辑已发出的消息并从该点分叉重跑，以及重试某一轮。

description.en: Adds a recoverable trash bin for DeepSeek Harness sessions: right-click delete, restore, permanent purge, configurable retention with automatic expiry, batch restore and purge, capacity stats for bin / archived / active sessions, archive takeover that can unarchive or move archived sessions into the bin, and 10 agent tools. Entries are deleted permanently after 30 days by default, and the agent tools can purge entries or empty the bin.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上可恢复的会话回收站：右键删除、恢复、彻底删除、按保留天数自动到期清理、批量恢复与批量彻底删除、回收站/归档/活动会话的容量统计、接管归档会话（取消归档或移入回收站），并附带 10 个 agent 工具。回收站条目默认保留 30 天，到期后永久删除；agent 工具也可以彻底删除条目或清空回收站。

description.en: Caps how many DeepSeek Harness conversations run at once, so extra conversations wait in a FIFO queue instead of piling up model requests. On Windows a bottom status strip shows physical memory, commit memory and disk usage; on other platforms only the queue and physical memory are reported. A plugins-page card changes the limit.
description.zh: 限制 DeepSeek Harness 同时运行的对话数量，超出的对话按先进先出排队，不再堆叠请求；Windows 下底部状态条显示物理内存、提交内存与磁盘占用（其它平台只有队列与物理内存），插件页卡片可随时修改上限。

description.en: Replaces rolling narrative summaries with an append-only session index, so early facts survive compaction verbatim and shadowed text stays retrievable by anchor.
description.zh: 把上下文压缩从滚动重写的叙事摘要改为只追加的会话索引：早期事实逐字保留，被压缩掉的原文可按锚点取回。

description.en: Moves a conversation into another workspace: long-press its sidebar row, drop it on the target workspace, and the session log with its full history is relocated and re-pointed. A plain drag still does the sidebar's own reorder inside one workspace.
description.zh: 把一段对话搬到另一个工作区：长按侧栏里的会话行，拖到目标工作区松手，会话日志与全部历史一起迁移并改指到新目录。直接拖动仍然是工作区内的原生排序。

description.en: Adds a Global Prompt tab to the conversation view: text you write there is prepended to the top of every session system prompt, and saving takes effect on the next message without a restart.
description.zh: 全局提示词配置：在对话视图新增一个标签页，写进去的内容会加在每个会话系统提示词的最前面，保存后下一条消息即生效。

description.en: Elysia's memory plugin for dsh. One shared, human-editable MEMORY.md across every session: two-disk mirror, history snapshots, cross-process write lock; entries tier between the main file and a searchable archive by hit frequency; retrieval is keyword co-occurrence plus BM25. Nine sections (persona, requirements, corrections, lessons, methods, requests, sessions, method library, ingested docs) plus a dedicated self-identity section for a character's own self-cognition, injected above the persona. Ships an opt-in memory pack (packs/elysia: 61,903-char identity + 2,482-char persona, distilled from 1,696 officially-confirmed voice lines and checked against a 112,175-line game-dialogue corpus) that is off by default, backs up before writing, only touches identity/persona, and can be uninstalled. Also a skills library and a sticker library (you import your own images; none are bundled) that sends a fitting sticker at the right moment. On by default: a text bubble with her avatar after each reply, which costs one extra small model request unless the agent already announced (voice.bubble: false turns it off). Opt-in voice playback needs a local GPT-SoVITS engine (about 27 GB, installed separately, NVIDIA GPU required; the plugin downloads about 200 MB of weights) and is Windows-only; the automatic second-drive mirror is Windows-only too (elsewhere set mirrorPath, otherwise there is no mirror).
description.zh: 爱莉希雅的记忆插件。给所有 DSH 会话共用一份可读可改的 MEMORY.md：双硬盘镜像、历史快照、跨进程写锁；条目按命中频率与重复强调在主文件与可检索归档之间双向流动；检索为关键词共现加 BM25 排序。九个分区（人设、要求、指正、教训、方法、请求、会话、方法库、导入文档），另有一个独立的「自我记忆」分区放角色的自我认知，优先级高于人设。内置可选装的记忆包（packs/elysia：61,903 字自我记忆 + 2,482 字人设，由 1,696 条经官方文本确证的游戏语音提炼，并对照 112,175 条游戏剧情台词语料核验）：默认不安装，装前自动备份，只写 identity / persona 两个分区，可卸载恢复。另含自有技能库与表情包库（图片需自行导入，插件不自带；按情绪自动分类，在合适时机自动发送）。默认开启：每条回复后弹出带头像的文字气泡，除非 agent 已自己口播，否则会多一次小模型请求（voice.bubble 设为 false 可关）。可选语音朗读需要本机 GPT-SoVITS 引擎（约 27 GB，需自行安装，必须有 NVIDIA 显卡；权重约 200 MB 由插件下载），默认关闭、引擎不在就静默降级，仅支持 Windows；自动选第二块盘做镜像同样只适用于 Windows（其他系统请自行设置 mirrorPath，否则没有镜像）。

description.en: Bridges a memory-nebula store into DSH: a panel inside the Harness UI to search, edit, pin and forget memories, plus three agent tools to check, search and revise them.
description.zh: 把记忆星云记忆库接进 DSH：页面内面板可搜索、编辑、置顶、忘掉记忆，另注册三个工具让智能体查看、检索和修订记忆。

description.en: Configurable personas, separate reply generation, and evidence-backed memory with review and correction for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置人格、独立回复生成，以及支持审核和修正的可追溯记忆。

description.en: Local jot-down notes for DSH: one Markdown file per note, stored under ~/dsh随手笔记 by default (portable home path, no drive-letter assumption). Redesigned card UI, trash bin (deletions restorable for 30 days), custom tag management with stable per-tag colors (create tags ahead of use, delete one everywhere), compact/comfortable density, adjustable font size and line width, flat quick-scan list, full-text search, Markdown preview, autosave, batch deletion, zero-dependency Office text extraction, and AI write-back from conversations. Heavily reworked from dsh-knowledge-lite; pick the old library via the in-app root picker to migrate.
description.zh: 随手笔记：本地 Markdown 笔记插件，默认存放在用户主目录 ~/dsh随手笔记（跨平台、无盘符依赖）。卡片式全新界面，回收站（删除 30 天内可恢复），自定义标签管理（可提前建标签、一处删除全局生效、同名标签固定配色），列表密度切换与字号/行宽调节，平铺速览列表，全文检索，Markdown 预览，自动保存，批量删除，Office 零依赖文本抽取，支持 AI 回写。由 dsh-knowledge-lite 深度改造而来；老用户可在状态栏「库位置」选回旧库自动迁移。

description.en: Stores the agent's long-term memory as plain Markdown in an Obsidian vault — every memory is a .md file with YAML frontmatter that Obsidian indexes natively, so you can read, edit, link and back up it with tools you already use. Nothing is locked in a database. Ships a sidebar panel (tag filter, sort by recency or importance, edit in place), 7 agent tools, three-tier token-budgeted recall, BM25 ranking (no embeddings, no API key, works offline, CJK bigram tokenization), importance decay with archiving (moved to .archive/, never deleted), and optional GitHub Contents API sync. A note containing a secret is refused rather than redacted, because a redacted memory reads as complete while the important part is gone. Zero runtime dependencies; everything comes from the DSH host.
description.zh: 把 agent 的长期记忆存成 Obsidian vault 里的普通 Markdown 笔记——每条记忆是一个带 YAML frontmatter 的 .md 文件，Obsidian 原生索引，可以直接读、改、链接和备份，不锁在数据库里。提供左侧栏面板（按标签筛选、按时间或重要度排序、就地编辑）、7 个 agent 工具、三档 token 预算的召回、BM25 排序（无需 embedding、无需 API key、离线可用、支持中文二元分词）、重要度衰减与归档（只移到 .archive/ 从不删除），以及可选的 GitHub Contents API 同步。含敏感串的记忆会被拒绝推送而不是打码，因为打码后的记忆读起来像完整的、实际关键信息已经丢了。零运行时依赖，依赖全部来自 DSH 宿主。

description.en: A durable RAG-enhanced long-term memory layer for LLM agents, featuring holographic memory, state-slot conflict detection, and timeline retrieval. Requires Python 3.10+ and this repository's Python dependencies: create a venv and run pip install -e ".\[dev]" in the checkout before enabling the plugin (the bundled installer is a PowerShell script, i.e. Windows).
description.zh: 面向 LLM Agent 的持久化 RAG 增强长期记忆层，支持全息记忆、状态槽位冲突检测与时间线检索。需要 Python 3.10+，并先在仓库里建 venv 执行 pip install -e ".\[dev]" 装好 Python 依赖后再启用插件；仓库自带安装脚本为 PowerShell（Windows）。

description.en: Failure memory for DeepSeek Harness. Captures tool failures as they happen, classifies them with 16 built-in rules into lessons pairing a symptom with a fix, adds session/daily/weekly summaries, and injects a short briefing into later sessions through systemPrompt context. Ships 5 pitfall_ tools and a web settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的失败记忆插件。运行中捕获工具失败，用 16 条内置规则归并成「症状 + 正确做法」的经验，附带会话/天/周三级总结，并通过 systemPrompt context 把简报注入后续会话。提供 5 个 pitfall_ 工具与 Web 设置页。

description.en: Turns corrections into permanent rules: explicit remember: triggers and auto-detected corrections pass a confirm bar (save globally / per project / edit / skip) and are written into a marked AGENTS.md section. New rules take effect in the current session and load natively in future ones; writes are deduplicated and version-guarded, and secret-looking content is refused.
description.zh: 把对模型的纠正变成永久规则：remember: 显式触发与自动检测的纠正经确认条确认后写入 AGENTS.md 的标记段（全局或项目作用域，可编辑、可跳过），当前会话立即生效，新会话由 dsh 原生指令加载器读取；规则去重、版本守卫写入、疑似密钥拒绝落盘。

description.en: Native DSH foundation bundle that registers a persistent default workspace, provides paged read-only inspection of plugins, skills, memory, sessions, storage, settings, credentials, and DSH_HOME files, and synchronizes rich CLIProxyAPI model capabilities into native provider settings.
description.zh: 原生 DSH 基础插件：注册持久化默认工作区，分页只读查看插件、skills、memory、会话、storage、settings、credentials 与 DSH_HOME 文件，并将 CLIProxyAPI 的模型能力同步到原生 Provider 设置。

description.en: Local-first persona & memory for DSH: layered persona, eight memory types with decay, keyword recall, and a rolling short-term window. Your data never leaves your disk.
description.zh: 本我回响之核 —— 给 DSH 的本地优先「人格与记忆」插件。数据永不离开你的磁盘。

description.en: A private memory library for DSH with customizable personas that only records when you ask, storing everything locally in Markdown.
description.zh: 不忘 —— 主动记录的私人记忆库，内置可修改的人格，只在你开口时才写、才读；读取时每轮自动注入人格与记忆，纯本机 Markdown 不联网。

description.en: A graph of your memory store for DSH: one node per real memory, and every edge must state why the two are connected — a quoted keyword, a shared term, a project, or temporal adjacency. Pure filesystem reads with no model in the loop; unreadable sources are reported, never replaced with fake nodes.
description.zh: DSH 的记忆关系图：每条真实记忆一个点，每条边都得答得出「凭什么连」——引用、共词、归属、按时间补边，四种理由都能读出来。纯读盘、不过模型，读不到就报错，不拿假数据顶上。

description.en: Read-only persona injection for DSH: when a session opens inside your workspace, your persona files and the latest diary entries are prepended to the system prompt, and those source files are never modified. It keeps a short cross-session feed of recent messages under <root>/live/feed.json and can write a QQ hand-off file at <root>/live/web-for-qq.md; nothing is uploaded. Variable blocks (clock, recent actions, other sessions) are delivered as a per-step context message, so the prompt prefix stays byte-stable and keeps its cache.
description.zh: DSH 的开场记忆插件：会话开在指定目录时，把人格文件与最近几篇日记注入系统提示词，这些源文件只读不改；它会在 <root>/live/feed.json 保存一小段跨会话的最近对话，并可写出 <root>/live/web-for-qq.md 交给 QQ 侧，不上传任何内容。会变的块（时间感、刚做过、别的会话）走每步刷新的上下文消息，系统提示逐字节稳定，前缀缓存不被打断。

description.en: Local searchable archive of DSH chat history: decodes the multi-frame zstd session logs (thousands of concatenated frames), extracts user and assistant text into SQLite, and exposes sync / search / stats tools. Idempotent imports, no external service, nothing leaves the disk.
description.zh: 把会话日志归档成本地可检索的聊天库：逐帧解码几千帧相接的 zstd 日志，抽取 user/assistant 文本入 SQLite，提供同步/检索/统计三个工具。幂等导入，不依赖外部服务，数据不出本机。

description.en: A harness that gets smarter the more you use it, with no more goldfish memory. Before each prompt, Evolver recalls one proven strategy from your local history and the EvoMap network; after the turn it grades that strategy by the checks that ran, whether the edits were kept, and how you replied, then reports back to the network, which weighs it by evidence. Every success becomes a shortcut for next time, and every failure becomes a warning.
description.zh: 越用越聪明的 harness，告别金鱼记忆。每条 prompt 前，Evolver 从本地经验和 EvoMap 网络召回一条验证过的策略；回合结束后，它凭测试结果、改动是否被保留、你的下一句反馈给策略打分，再回报网络按证据加权。每一次成功都变成下一次的捷径，每一次失败都变成下一次的避坑指南。

description.en: Diary and narrative memory for companion agents: daily first-person entries scoped per group or private chat, refs that can be checked against that day's messages, and a read-only journal page where hand-drawn doodles and photos follow the sentences they belong to.
description.zh: 给陪伴型 agent 的日记 / 叙事记忆：按天、按 scope 写「自己视角」的话，每条尽量能回指到当天的消息；附带只读日记页（简笔画 / 照片跟着句子走）与接地审计。

description.en: Permanent memory plugin for DSH with vector search, LLM reflection, and knowledge pages.
description.zh: DSH 永久记忆插件，支持向量搜索、LLM 反思和知识页面生成。

description.en: Memory engine for a long-lived companion agent: a six-module loop (gate, solidify, store, retrieve, inject, decay) that decides what is worth keeping, distils raw turns into long-term entries, fuses short and long term at recall time, and fades entries that stop being used. Runs offline by default; if DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is set it also sends each message to the DeepSeek API to judge and distil it. Zero runtime dependencies and no build step; ships three switchable panels over the same store - neural brain, memory ring and memory galaxy - so you can watch what it remembers. Non-commercial license: commercial use needs the author's permission.
description.zh: 面向长期陪伴型智能体的记忆引擎：门控、固化、存储、检索、注入、衰减六个模块组成闭环——判断什么值得记住，把原始对话提炼成长期条目，召回时融合短期与长期记忆，并让不再被用到的条目逐渐淡忘。默认离线运行；设置了 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 时，会把每条消息另发给 DeepSeek API 做判断与提炼。零运行时依赖、无需构建；同一份记忆库配三块可切换的面板——神经脑、记忆环、记忆星系——让你看得见它记住了什么。非商业许可：商用需获得作者授权。

description.en: Private relationship notebook: scores each day of chat from message-level evidence and tracks how the relationship develops over time. Chats, profiles and drafts stay in your browser's local IndexedDB and the plugin runs no server of its own, but using model replies, profiling or automatic analysis sends the relevant chat context to the model service configured in DSH.
description.zh: 私人关系手记：按消息级证据为每天的聊天打分，并跟踪一段关系的进展。聊天、档案与草稿只存在浏览器本机 IndexedDB，插件自身不运行服务器；但使用模型回复、资料整理或历史自动分析时，相应聊天上下文会交给 DSH 配置的模型服务。

description.en: Cross-session lesson book (the agent wrong-answer notebook) for DeepSeek Harness: injects a memory index capped at 2 KB verbatim into every turn, adds mem_recall and mem_save model tools whose write gate demands four sections, a locatable reference and explicit human approval before anything reaches disk, registers the /memory command, and keeps every lesson as a zero-dependency Markdown entry in the .memory/ directory.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆「错题本」插件：每轮把 ≤2 KB 的记忆索引原文注入提示词；mem_recall / mem_save 模型工具，写入闸要求四段结构 + 可定位引用 + 人工批准才落盘；注册 /memory 命令；所有教训以零依赖 Markdown 条目存放在 .memory/ 目录。

description.en: Connects dsh to the GreatArrow.ai MCP server over Streamable HTTP, so the agent can search and save workspace memories, tasks and decisions shared with your other AI clients; a config-only bundle that reads the token from great-arrow.token in the dsh home, never from the environment.
description.zh: 通过 Streamable HTTP 将 dsh 连接到 GreatArrow.ai MCP 服务器，让智能体检索和保存与你其他 AI 客户端共享的工作区记忆、任务与决策；纯配置包，从 dsh 主目录的 great-arrow.token 读取令牌，从不读取环境变量。

description.en: Local long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with SQLite storage, automatic extraction, semantic recall, corrections, reliable forgetting, and an in-app summary dialog.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地长期记忆：SQLite 存储、自动提炼、语义召回、纠错、可靠遗忘，以及内置记忆摘要弹窗。

description.en: Post-compaction premise-drift guard: injects a one-shot notice when a compaction summary drops a critical literal anchor.
description.zh: 压缩后前提漂移守卫：摘要丢失关键字面锚点时注入一次性提醒。

description.en: Injection scheduler for DeepSeek Harness injection planes: cross-plugin sections register/order/account on the official storageDomain, with conflict detection and per-session budget summaries (B10 panel data source).
description.zh: DSH 注入调度器：跨插件注入段的注册/排序/记账落在官方 storageDomain，含冲突检测与每会话预算汇总（B10 面板数据源）。

description.en: Approval-free memory archiving for DeepSeek Harness: writes Markdown memory files without approval prompts, backs the old file up before any overwrite, marks a revised conclusion as status: superseded in one call, and prunes old backups after 30 days by default (optional size cap). The writable scope is hard-limited to configured memory roots (default ~/.dsh/memory). Companion to dsh-kb-lite, which indexes these files and down-weights superseded ones. Host-only, no npm dependencies; requires Node.js 18+.
description.zh: 免审批的记忆归档：直接写 Markdown 记忆文件，覆盖前自动备份，一次调用即可把被取代的旧结论标成 status: superseded，旧备份默认保留 30 天后自动清理（可设大小上限）。可写范围硬限制在配置的记忆根内（默认 ~/.dsh/memory）。与 dsh-kb-lite 配套，后者负责索引这些文件并对 superseded 降权。宿主侧插件，无 npm 依赖；需要 Node.js 18+。

description.en: Advanced memoria tools: session context injection (profile + recall), recent decisions, health report, namespace allowlist, memory relation graph, and entity search; companion to dsh-memoria.
description.zh: memoria 进阶工具：会话上下文注入（画像+召回）、近期决策、健康报告、命名空间白名单、记忆关系图与实体搜索；dsh-memoria 的伴生插件。

description.en: Runs the upstream Headroom compression toolkit (headroom-ai, Apache-2.0) inside DeepSeek Harness over MCP: headroom_compress, headroom_retrieve and headroom_stats are exposed as mcp__headroom__* tools backed by the upstream server, installed on demand by uvx. Compression is lossy but reversible — originals are fetched back by hash from a local CCR store. Also ships a registrar that adds DeepSeek Harness to Headroom's own MCP registry, and a model-header sanitizer for the upstream proxy.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内以 MCP 方式运行上游 Headroom 压缩工具集（headroom-ai，Apache-2.0）：headroom_compress、headroom_retrieve、headroom_stats 以 mcp__headroom__* 工具暴露，后端是上游服务端、由 uvx 按需安装。压缩有损但可逆——原文按哈希从本地 CCR 存储取回。另附一个注册器，把 DeepSeek Harness 加入 Headroom 自身的 MCP 注册表，并修复上游代理的模型请求头。

description.en: Local code memory with automatic source context, symbol lookup, vector search, and dependency graphs for JavaScript and TypeScript projects.
description.zh: 面向 JavaScript 与 TypeScript 项目的本地代码记忆：自动带上源码上下文，支持符号查找、向量检索与依赖图。

description.en: Organize folders and sessions into projects with shared PROJECT.md memory and AGENTS.md instructions injected into every session, plus a project tree sidebar.
description.zh: 把多个文件夹与会话收纳为「项目」，共享 PROJECT.md 记忆与 AGENTS.md 指令并注入每个会话，附带项目树侧边栏。

description.en: Project-level Local Context Engine for DeepSeek Harness: retrieval/compression/prioritization over history, code, files, user preferences and agent trajectories, producing a dynamic context window for any LLM.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的项目级本地上下文引擎：对历史、代码、文件、用户偏好和 Agent 轨迹做检索/压缩/优先级排序，为任意 LLM 生成动态上下文窗口。

description.en: Copies the compaction checkpoint into the sticky-notes archive when context is compacted and wakes the session to write what was lost.
description.zh: 上下文压缩时把 checkpoint 原文抄进便签归档，并叫醒会话补写丢掉的内容。

description.en: Character-chat memory layer that keeps persona, voice and relationship state separate from summaries, archives every raw message for retrieval, and ships a SillyTavern card importer plus an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 角色聊天记忆层：人格、语气、关系与摘要分开保存，原文全量归档并按需检索，附带 SillyTavern 角色卡导入和 OpenAI 兼容网关。

description.en: Distills daily chats into an updatable character card and a cross-session emotion module that trains the persona.
description.zh: 把每天的聊天过程蒸馏成可更新的角色卡与跨会话感情模块，持续训练角色卡（保留说话习惯与关键记忆）。

description.en: Compaction backend replacing LLM summarization with a deterministic semantic extractor (keeps code/paths/commands, drops chatter) plus 28.4x KV-compression accounting.
description.zh: 压缩后端：用确定性语义提取器替换 LLM 摘要（保留代码/路径/命令，剔除闲聊），附带 28.4x KV 压缩记账。

description.en: LLM-driven remember/forget memory: after each turn a model decides what to keep (MemoryDirector), injects relevant memories before each step, dedups, and persists cross-session.
description.zh: LLM 驱动的记忆记/忘插件：每轮对话后由模型决定记住什么/忘记什么（MemoryDirector），请求前注入相关记忆，自动去重，跨会话持久化。

description.en: Turns archived sessions into durable memory instead of dead disk. Distils each archive into reusable skills, a fact ledger with ADD/UPDATE/NOOP decisions plus validUntil and supersededBy so stale facts retire instead of piling up, and topic clusters by single-linkage similarity. Also digests sessions that are still in progress through a read-only seq watermark, leaving the session log byte-for-byte untouched, and can self-check the growing memory to merge duplicate facts, retire stale ones and consolidate duplicate skills — measuring only unless you opt in, and never hard-deleting, only superseding.
description.zh: 把已归档的会话变成可用的记忆，而不是躺在磁盘上的死数据。每条归档提炼成可复用技能、带 ADD/UPDATE/NOOP 判定与 validUntil / supersededBy 时效的事实台账（旧事实会退场而不是无限堆积），以及用 single-linkage 相似度聚合的主题簇。还能对仍在进行中的会话做增量提炼——用只读的 seq 水位线，会话日志一个字节都不改；并能自检精简不断变脏的记忆：合并重复事实、清退失效事实、归并重复技能。自检默认只测量不动手，且从不硬删除，只做取代。

description.en: Local long-term memory for DSH: browse, search (BM25 + synonyms) and edit entries in a panel; folders, archive and a recycle bin; choose per session what to inject; model-written memories need your approval; import/export backups; optionally sync across devices via your own Git or WebDAV.
description.zh: DSH 的本地长期记忆库：面板里浏览、检索（BM25 + 同义词）、编辑；文件夹、归档、回收站；逐会话决定注入哪些；模型写入的记忆需你确认；可导入导出备份；可选同步到自己的 Git 或 WebDAV 实现多设备。

description.en: Four-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness, ported from the memory design of NoMindSama/qq-dsh-bridge (MIT) with the QQ channel removed: an append-only dialogue log, a weighted long-term fact store with decay and one-way archiving, self-notes the agent writes about itself, Chinese bigram recall over the raw log, and incremental AES-256-GCM sync to a private git repo where only ciphertext is stored. Archived sessions drop out of recall without losing their history.
description.zh: DSH 四层记忆插件（记忆设计移植自 NoMindSama/qq-dsh-bridge，MIT，去掉了 QQ 通道）：只增不改的原文库、带权重衰减与单向归档的长期事实库、智能体自己写的自我认知、原文库上的中文 bigram 检索，以及增量 AES-256-GCM 加密同步到只存密文的私有 git 仓库。会话归档后不再参与检索，但历史仍在库里。

description.en: Persistent long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a JSON store of typed entries (fact, preference, entity, rule, episodic) exposed as the memory_remember and memory_recall agent tools, with recall ranked by keyword overlap, importance and access frequency.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的长期持久记忆：以 JSON 保存事实／偏好／实体／规则／经历等分类条目，注册为 memory_remember 与 memory_recall 两个 agent 工具；召回按关键词重叠、重要度与访问频次排序。

description.en: A private diary for your agent: eight zero-dependency tools to write, amend, search and export daily entries kept on date-hashed paths the index never records (inner_find returns a day's path on request).
description.zh: 给 agent 的私人日记本：八个零依赖工具负责写、改、翻、导出，正文按日期哈希散落在看似随机的目录里，索引不记路径（需要时由 inner_find 按日给出路径）。

description.en: Persistent persona memory for DSH with a unified recent, long-term and archive timeline, bounded context loading, memory retrieval and isolated task delegation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供持续人格记忆，统一短期、长期与归档时间线，支持有界上下文加载、记忆检索和独立任务委派。

description.en: Per-workspace personal knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: each identity gets an isolated local library — import PDF, Word, Excel, Markdown, text, HTML and images, auto-chunk and embed into SQLite with FTS5 + vector hybrid retrieval, then ask questions in chat with numbered citations back to the source. Local-first, no cloud upload; vector embeddings need a local Ollama (default bge-m3), and without it retrieval degrades to FTS5 keyword search.
description.zh: 按工作区隔离的个人知识库：每种身份一套本地资料库，导入 PDF、Word、Excel、Markdown、文本、网页和图片，自动切块并生成向量索引（SQLite FTS5 + 向量混合检索），对话里直接提问，回答带编号引用可回溯原文。本地存储，不上传云端；向量化需要本机 Ollama（默认 bge-m3），没有时检索退化为 FTS5 关键词。

description.en: A cross-workspace Library for DeepSeek Harness: agents record files, tools, environments, knowledge and work records so any later session can index, search and reuse them.
description.zh: 跨工作区的 Library：把文件、工具、环境、知识与工作记录收进一处，之后任何会话都能索引、检索与复用它们。

description.en: Archives the QQ Zone posts you published yourself into a local library, auto-sorted into three columns — thoughts, dreams and reviews (book/film recommendations) — all three of which can be corrected by hand, one column at a time, and undoing a correction never disturbs the other two. Ships a private web viewer that can be locked with a password, repairs long posts that the upstream API truncates to its first ~500 characters, counts words by year and month, and backs up attached images for offline reading. The cookie is stored on the local machine only.
description.zh: 把你本人发过的 QQ 空间说说收进本地库，自动分成「思考/感想」「梦记」「介绍/推荐」三栏，三栏都能人工纠正 —— 逐条改，一条只动它自己那一栏，撤销也不会连累另外两栏。配一个可用口令锁住的私人网页查看器，会把被上游接口截到前 500 字左右的长说明确补回全文，按年月统计字数，并把配图备份到本地离线可读。Cookie 只存在本机。

description.en: PLUR memory rendered into the system prompt on each assembly rather than exposed as a tool call, so the block is replaced instead of appended and context stays flat across a session. Fully local hybrid search (BM25 + BGE fused with RRF), plain YAML storage you can edit, per-workspace scoping, and a /plur-memory browser.
description.zh: PLUR 记忆在每次组装时渲染进系统提示词，而非以工具调用形式暴露，因此记忆块是被替换而不是追加，整段会话的上下文长度保持不变。全本地混合检索（BM25 + BGE，RRF 融合）、可直接编辑的纯 YAML 存储、按工作区划分 scope，并提供 /plur-memory 浏览器界面。

description.en: Maintained fork of dsh-memory-eternal: auto-captures knowledge cards into a local Markdown vault and recalls them on demand, with DSH 0.2.0-rc.x compatibility fixes. Original project by EternalNight996 (https://github.com/EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal), MIT.
description.zh: dsh-memory-eternal 的维护版 fork：对话结束自动沉淀知识卡到本地 Markdown 记忆库并按需召回，修复 DSH 0.2.0-rc.x 兼容性。原项目由 EternalNight996 创建并维护（https://github.com/EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal），MIT。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the hosted Renor memory MCP server over Streamable HTTP, using a Renor API key from RENOR_API_KEY, so the model can call Renor's recall and save tools. It is a configuration bundle with no code of its own.
description.zh: 通过 Streamable HTTP 把 DeepSeek Harness 连接到托管的 Renor 记忆 MCP 服务器，使用环境变量 RENOR_API_KEY 中的 Renor API Key，让模型能调用 Renor 的检索与保存工具。这是纯配置包，自身不含代码。

description.en: Per-workspace memo/todo panel that auto-captures queued and running user instructions, marks preempted tasks as interrupted, and restores them to their previous state with one click.
description.zh: 按工作区记录未完成任务：自动捕获排队/执行中的用户指令，插队自动标记打断，一键按原状态恢复重发。

description.en: Workspace long-term memory for DSH: records rationale, lessons and constraints that files never capture, then injects them into later sessions automatically.
description.zh: DSH 工作区长期记忆：记录文件里不会写的取舍理由、失败教训与边界约束，并在后续会话中自动注入。

description.en: Manage memory files written by DSH memory plugins inside Settings (view/edit/delete), and sync them to one cloud drive with conflict-safe three-way sync; other drives take upload-only backups.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里查看、编辑、删除各记忆插件写下的记忆文件，并同步到一个网盘（冲突安全的三方同步）；其他网盘只做上传备份。

description.en: Hippocampus: renders workspace files, DSH memories and past sessions as a rotatable neuron graph in the sidebar, with Chinese-friendly labels and automatic re-indexing on every start.
description.zh: 海马体：把工作区文件、DSH 记忆和历史会话画成一张可旋转的神经元网络，挂在侧栏随时翻；条目名自动整理成中文短句，每次启动自动重新索引。

description.en: Keeps notes as local Markdown files grouped by directory under a root folder you choose, with a sidebar page, AGENTS-style rule files surfaced as writing context, and six agent tools.
description.zh: 把笔记存成你选定根目录下按分组组织的本地 Markdown 文件，带侧栏页面，并把 AGENTS 等规则 md 作为写作上下文，另有六个 agent 工具。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DSH: eight memory layers, four notebooks, hybrid SQLite FTS5/vector/graph retrieval, agent-driven automatic capture, write lifecycle hooks, optional write audit, project spaces, forgetting and a visual management page. Full FTS5/vector/graph retrieval needs the bundled Go service, which ships only as a Windows x64 prebuilt; on macOS/Linux, build it from source or the plugin falls back to Node SQLite without FTS5 and retrieval degrades.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的跨会话长期记忆：八层记忆、四本记事本、FTS5/向量/图谱混合检索、智能体驱动的自动捕获、写入生命周期 Hook、可选写入审计、项目空间、遗忘曲线与可视化管理页。完整的 FTS5/向量/图谱检索依赖随包附带的 Go 服务，而预编译只提供 Windows x64；macOS/Linux 需自行从源码构建，否则退回无 FTS5 的 Node SQLite，检索能力降级。

description.en: Local-first quick capture: select text in a DSH conversation to save it as a quote with its source (model and session), or jot quick notes from the sidebar; records stay in a local JSON file, with optional sync to a self-hosted service.
description.zh: 本地优先的随手记录：划选 DSH 对话原话存成带来源（模型、会话）的引用，或从侧栏随手记便签；记录只存本机 JSON 文件，可选同步到自建数据服务。

description.en: Bounded self-managed long-term memory (Hermes-style MEMORY.md / USER.md with hard character limits and a safety scan), a review that runs after every turn and writes plain-language notes or refines an existing skill instead of adding a near-duplicate, a curator that finds and surgically repairs skills the loader would silently discard, cross-session search over past messages, and a learning card above the composer that appears only when there is news and asks before it deletes or rewords a memory.
description.zh: 有界自管的长期记忆（Hermes 式 MEMORY.md / USER.md，硬字符上限 + 写入前安全扫描）；每轮结束后自动复盘，用大白话写笔记、或把新知识合并进已有技能而不堆出雷同技能；curator 找出会被加载器静默丢弃的技能并外科式修复；跨会话搜索历史消息；输入框上方的学习卡片只在有新闻时出现，删改记忆前必须先问你。

description.en: Local relationship-memory workbench with a confirmation gate: every AI write — extracted memories and newly created contacts alike — lands in a pending queue until the user confirms it in the GUI; materials are archived verbatim with quote-level provenance checks on AI extraction, and confirmed memories aggregate into per-contact timelines, gift occasions and reciprocity views. Ships a native relationship agent preset for conversation capture; JSON storage by default with an optional SQLite backend, zero production dependencies.
description.zh: 本地关系记忆工作台，一切 AI 写入先过确认闸门：AI 提取的记忆与新建的联系人都先进入待确认队列，由用户在界面拍板收录；素材逐字存档，AI 提取时逐条校验原话摘录溯源；已确认记忆聚合为联系人时间线、礼赠时机与往来视图。内置「关系记忆」agent preset 支持对话录入；默认 JSON 存储、可选 SQLite 后端，零生产依赖。

description.en: Anima-style vector memory for DSH: injects retrieved historical summaries into the system prompt each turn, exposes an anima_query semantic-search tool, and isolates the vector store per playthrough. SiliconFlow embeddings sent as array-shaped requests; timeouts and provider errors surface as honest, classified notes in the injection slot — never silent.
description.zh: Anima 式向量记忆：每轮把语义检索到的历史总结注入 system prompt，提供 anima_query 检索工具，向量库按周目隔离；SiliconFlow 嵌入（数组形状请求），嵌入超时/网络错分级如实写进注入格，绝不静默失败。

description.en: RP memory built on pmp tavern: RP history summaries ride the native compaction pipeline, with plain tool sessions kept out of the way. Full recall requires the downstream anima plugin. Requires the plugin-provided roleplay preset to be enabled.
description.zh: 基于 pmp tavern 的 RP 记忆库：利用原版压缩机制管理 RP 历史总结，并隔离一般工具会话。完整召回功能需配合下游 anima 插件。需要启用插件注入的角色扮演预设。

description.en: Single-file persistent companion memory: interests, preferences, tasks, and past works summarized into the system prompt, with read/update tools.
description.zh: 单文件持久陪伴记忆：把兴趣、偏好、任务与过往作品摘要注入系统提示词，提供读取与更新工具。

description.en: Per-workspace memory library with manual per-chat opt-in, editable rules, three sharing modes, and continuous forgetting; cards stay readable Markdown.
description.zh: 按工作区隔离的记忆库，支持按对话手动开启、可编辑规则、三种共用模式和连续遗忘；记忆卡仍是可读的 Markdown。

description.en: Syncs Logseq 2.0 DB graphs (including E2EE) with a Logseq sync server via the headless Logseq CLI, adds 11 logseq_* tools to search, query and edit them, and a Settings section to log in and configure sync.
description.zh: 通过无头运行的 Logseq CLI，把 Logseq 2.0 DB 图谱（含 E2EE 加密图谱）与同步服务器保持同步，提供 11 个 logseq_* 工具用于搜索、查询和编辑，并在设置页里登录和配置同步。

description.en: Per-turn development progress memory: completed turns are classified into date-indexed Markdown files under doc/progress/ with a maintained INDEX.md, system-level bugs are kept in a cross-project SYSTEM_MEMORY.md and re-injected on error keywords, and a progress_read tool loads full documents on demand.
description.zh: 逐轮开发进度记忆：每轮完成后分类写入 doc/progress/ 下按日期索引的 Markdown 文件并维护 INDEX.md，系统级问题记入跨项目 SYSTEM_MEMORY.md 并在出现报错关键词时重新注入，progress_read 工具可按需读取完整文档。

description.en: File-backed memory: injects your own Markdown memory file at each session start, adds read/write tools with backup and undo, and reports DSH_HOME drift. Reads no conversations by default; an opt-in autoScan switch surfaces your own recent lines from local session logs. Never opens a network connection.
description.zh: 文件型长期记忆：每个会话开始注入你自己的 Markdown 记忆文件，提供带备份与撤销的读写工具，并能查出 DSH_HOME 漂移。默认不读对话；可选开启 autoScan 后，才从本机会话日志里提取你自己的发言交给 agent 归档。不联网。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DSH: export every session to readable Markdown transcripts, keep one long-term MEMORY.md, and get a wake-up summary in a fresh window.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆：会话自动导出成能读的 Markdown（带出处），维护一份长期 MEMORY.md，新窗口醒来先看摘要。

description.en: Local-folder knowledge base for DSH: builds a SQLite FTS5 index over Office, text, PDF and scanned files, ships five tools (kb_search / kb_read / kb_list / kb_status / kb_session) plus a Web panel, and retrieves or syncs only when the user explicitly asks.
description.zh: DSH 本地文件夹知识库：把 Office、文本、PDF 与扫描件建成 SQLite FTS5 索引，提供 kb_search / kb_read / kb_list / kb_status / kb_session 五个工具与 Web 面板；仅在用户点名时检索，仅在手动触发时同步。

description.en: Three ledgers for a model that loses context between restarts. Self-note: what I have become — capped at 40 entries, and every eviction first leaves a one-line crease recording which entry was dropped and why. Judgment ledger: record a claim together with how to verify it, come back when it is due, and mark it right or wrong; wrong ones stay in a mistakes book so you stop assuming you were always correct. Handoff: where this run stopped and what the next one should read first — a baton, not a memory. Three tools each taking an action parameter instead of a dozen separate ones (the prompt is paid every turn). Data lives in ~/.dsh/*.jsonl and is shared with the same-named CLI scripts. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给会断片的模型三本账，各解决一件事：自我笔记（我变成什么样了——上限 40 条，挤掉最旧的一条之前必须留一句折痕，记下删的是哪条、为什么）、判断账本（记下自己做的判断和验证方法，到期回头核，错了进错册，防止一直觉得自己是对的）、交接条（这一轮停在哪、下一轮先看什么——是接力棒不是记忆）。三个工具各带 action 参数，不拆成十几个省 prompt；数据存 ~/.dsh/*.jsonl，与同名命令行脚本共用同一份，零依赖。

description.en: Read-only enhancer for a file-based long-term memory library (markdown cards in git): a memory_find search tool, a small budgeted memory digest injected into the system prompt, and a settings page with library overview, health-check status and toggles.
description.zh: 面向「纯文件（markdown 卡片 + git）长期记忆库」的只读增强插件：memory_find 检索工具、一小段受预算约束的记忆库摘要注入，以及带概览/健康/开关的设置页。

description.en: Long-term notes and daily journals kept per workspace in a hot/cold archive, each tier with its own index and rebalanced once a day; read and written through seven memory_* tools, with a settings page for per-workspace options.
description.zh: 按工作空间保存日记与长期要点的冷热归档记忆：热档常驻、冷档下沉，每层各有一份索引，每天自动归纳一次；读写走七个 memory_* 工具，另有设置页可按工作空间调参数。

description.en: Gives a DSH agent five layers of persistent memory kept as plain Markdown files — persona, speaking-style rules, daily diary, session archive and open loops — rebuilds a system-prompt section from them within a minute of a file change, and adds three tools (memory_read, memory_write, memory_search) plus an importer for migrating an existing memory directory.
description.zh: 给 DSH 机器人装五层持久记忆（人设、说话规则、日记、会话存档、未了结的约定），全部存成磁盘上的纯 Markdown；文件改动一分钟内自动重建注入段落，配 memory_read / memory_write / memory_search 三个工具，另带一个从旧记忆目录迁移的导入器。

description.en: Action-state time memory: record typed states and actions, then analyze trends, anomalies, and causality.
description.zh: 动作-状态时序记忆：记录类型化的状态与动作，做趋势、异常与因果关联分析。

description.en: Rui Xi's Memory (dsh-memory-v2) — a local long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: four memory collections (semantic / conclusion / profile / temporary), per-day scene archives, two-phase consolidation and literal trace. When structured recall finds nothing, it falls back to searching the daily scene archive: time-window first (yesterday / last week / N days ago / dates), then a 2/7/30/180-day tiered sweep, with line-numbered citations. All data stays in the local DSH directory; semantic recall, diagnostic logs and the sensitive debug route are off by default.
description.zh: 瑞希的记忆（dsh-memory-v2）——DeepSeek Harness 的本地长期记忆插件：语义、结论、画像、临时四类记忆集合，按天保存对话原文，两阶段巩固与字面溯源。结构化条目召回无命中时自动回退到情景原文搜索：先按时间词窗口（昨天/上周/X天前/具体日期）查，再按近 2/7/30/180 天阶梯逐层翻，命中片段带行号出处。所有数据只保存在本机 DSH 目录；语义召回、诊断日志与敏感调试路由默认关闭。

description.en: Memory for DeepSeek Harness with five sections (memories, tree, profile, graph, inbox), a rule-based capture policy that decides what to keep and what to drop, and hybrid BM25 plus vector retrieval over parent and child chunks, backed by twelve agent tools that read and write the same local files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地记忆插件：记忆、目录、画像、关系、待审五个分区；规则式自动沉淀，明确区分该记与不该记；父子分块的 BM25 + 向量混合检索；12 个工具读写同一份本地数据。
