description.en: Sweeps AI byproducts (scratch files, backups, logs, caches) into a reversible trash per project, and on project close classifies deliverables, archives reference results and writes a cleanup report. Requires Python 3 on PATH (the cleanup engine is a Python script; python3 / python / py are auto-detected, and without one cleanup cannot run and says so).
description.zh: 把 AI 会话留下的草稿、备份、日志、缓存收进可逆回收站；项目结项时归类成品、归档可引用结果并生成结项清理清单，未结项期间一切保留。清运引擎是 Python 脚本，需 PATH 上有 Python 3（自动探测 python3 / python / py；缺了它清运跑不起来，会明确提示）。

description.en: Generate images and videos directly in chat and deliver them to the conversation: generate_image / generate_video / send_media tools, a built-in Agnes free tier plus any OpenAI-compatible backend, background jobs that auto-push finished media, and inline gallery and video cards with download, lightbox, and native open.
description.zh: 在对话里直接生成图片和视频并发送到会话：generate_image / generate_video / send_media 三个工具，内置 Agnes 免费额度与任意 OpenAI 兼容后端，长耗时生成走后台任务完成后自动推送，内联画廊与视频卡片支持下载、灯箱查看和系统默认应用打开。

description.en: Deny-only tool blacklist per agent preset. Tick a tool off in Settings and it leaves that mode's tool schema and its calls are rejected; nothing is ever enabled or whitelisted, and tools nobody denied are left alone. Each row expands to that tool's own description, and rules live in one JSON file outside the profile.
description.zh: 按 Agent 预设（模式）管理的工具黑名单，只做禁用：在设置页勾掉一个工具，它就从该模式的工具 schema 里消失、调用也会被拒；不设白名单、不负责启用，没被点名的工具一概不碰。每行可展开看工具自己的描述，规则存在 profile 之外的单个 JSON 文件里。

description.en: Local fitness studio recording workouts, exercise duration and training volume within the DSH workspace, stored in the browser. Needs the dsh-studio-projects runtime and the dsh-worktable container from 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library installed first.
description.zh: DSH 工作区内的本机健身工作室，记录训练、运动时长与训练容量，数据存于浏览器本地存储。需先安装 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library 的 dsh-studio-projects 运行时与 dsh-worktable 容器。

description.en: Minecraft redstone music: rm_render renders instrument samples from a SoundFont and aligns every onset to within 3 ms, and rm_build compiles a song plus lane table into a datapack of scheduled mcfunction shards (optionally deployed over RCON).
description.zh: Minecraft 红石音乐：rm_render 从 SoundFont 渲染乐器采样并把起音对齐到 3ms 内，rm_build 把谱面与轨表编译成分片 mcfunction 数据包（可选经 RCON 部署开建）。

description.en: MCP management console for DeepSeek Harness — a left-sidebar page that lists every configured MCP server, trial-calls its tools in place, restarts a single row when its transport dies or never synced, and probes reachability. A fork of PerryLink/dsh-mcp-panel; do not install it alongside the upstream plugin — both register the /mcp command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 管理控制台：左侧栏独立页面列出全部 MCP 服务器，可就地试用工具；传输断开或工具未同步时可单独重启某一行，并探测连通性。基于 PerryLink/dsh-mcp-panel 的分支；不能与上游插件同装——两者都注册 /mcp 命令。

description.en: Agent tools that download a Bilibili video, transcribe it with a local whisper.cpp build, then write a structured Markdown note with DSH's own LLM (optionally printing it to PDF). Windows only: missing dependencies are auto-downloaded into the data directory — yt-dlp.exe and the ffmpeg.exe build from GitHub and gyan.dev, the whisper.cpp x64 binary from GitHub, and a ~547 MB model from the hf-mirror mirror; PDF export shells out to a locally installed Edge/Chrome. Two tools: video_to_notes and note_to_pdf. Pure JS, no extra API key.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频下载、本地 whisper.cpp 转写、再用 DSH 自身 LLM 生成结构化 Markdown 笔记（可打印为 PDF）的 agent 工具。仅支持 Windows：缺依赖时自动下载到数据目录——yt-dlp.exe 与 ffmpeg.exe（GitHub、gyan.dev）、whisper.cpp x64 二进制（GitHub）、约 547 MB 模型（hf-mirror 镜像）；PDF 由本机安装的 Edge/Chrome 无头打印。提供 video_to_notes 与 note_to_pdf 两个工具，纯 JS，无需额外 API key。

description.en: Serial-port toolkit for DSH - 9 tools plus a web UI where an AI agent and a human share one UART line, with auto port matching, hex/text frames, timestamps, scheduled sends, rule-based auto-recovery and appearance themes. The serial engine runs on Python 3.8+ — DSH's bundled interpreter is used when present, otherwise python / py -3 on PATH.
description.zh: DSH 的串口工具箱：9 个工具 + 网页版，人与 AI 共用一根串口线；自动匹配端口、文字/十六进制、逐帧时间戳、定时发送、规则自动处置、外观主题，已真机验证 CH340 与 HC-05。串口内核是 Python 3.8+，默认用 DSH 自带的解释器，找不到时用 PATH 上的 python / py -3。

description.en: Adds a download_file tool that fetches a URL over 16 aria2c connections and falls back to a single stream when aria2 is unavailable. Needs aria2c installed separately; the aria2 channel does not verify TLS certificates.
description.zh: 新增 download_file 工具，用 16 路 aria2c 并发下载，aria2 不可用时自动退回单线程流式下载。需自行安装 aria2c；aria2 通道不校验 TLS 证书。

description.en: Native WCAG accessibility scanner: runs axe-core over local HTML files / build output / URLs and reports violations (rule id, impact, WCAG 2.1 mapping, element targeting, fix suggestions) as Markdown/HTML/JSON. Read-only, CI-able.
description.zh: 原生 WCAG 无障碍扫描工具：对本地 HTML / 构建产物 / URL 运行 axe-core，输出规则 id、impact、WCAG 2.1 映射、元素定位与修复建议（Markdown/HTML/JSON），只读可进 CI。

description.en: Record terminal/tool output as asciinema v2 (.cast), replay with an offline embedded player, and export HTML.
description.zh: 把终端/工具输出录制为 asciinema v2（.cast）文件，离线内嵌播放器回放并导出 HTML。

description.en: Scan project lockfiles (npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/go/cargo/maven/gradle/...) against the free OSV API and report confirmed dependency vulnerabilities with fix versions and remediation commands.
description.zh: 扫描项目锁文件（npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/go/cargo/maven/gradle…）并对免费 OSV API 批量查询漏洞，输出「包 / 当前版本 / 漏洞 ID / 摘要 / CVSS / 修复版本」表格与修复命令。

description.en: Analyze the current branch diff and generate a Conventional Commits PR title, motivation/scheme/testing/risk description and a self-review checklist, write PR_DESCRIPTION.md, optionally open the PR via gh.
description.zh: 分析当前分支 diff，生成符合 Conventional Commits 的 PR 标题与动机/方案/影响/测试/风险描述和自审清单，输出 PR_DESCRIPTION.md，可选直接调用 gh 提 PR。

description.en: Mine local DSH session logs (JSONL) into personal usage & impact receipts: Markdown day/week/month reports plus a self-contained HTML receipt, cross-referenced with local git log — zero-network, privacy-first.
description.zh: 从本地 DSH 会话日志（JSONL）挖掘「使用与影响」报告：Markdown 日/周/月报 + 自包含 HTML receipt，交叉本机 git log；零联网、隐私优先。

description.en: Merges every folder's videos into one file per folder, matching the first clip's resolution, frame rate, and codec; clips with identical specs are concatenated losslessly, while mismatched clips can be normalized first.
description.zh: 把每个文件夹下的视频合并成一个文件，输出规格对齐该文件夹第一个视频的分辨率、帧率和编码；同规格片段无损拼接，规格不一致时可先转码对齐。

description.en: Connects AutoCAD, ZWCAD, GstarCAD and BricsCAD to DeepSeek Harness over MCP, bundling the CAD server and building a private Python environment on first run. Requires Windows, one of those CAD applications installed, Python 3.10+ on PATH, and CAD running as the same Windows user and at the same privilege level as DSH.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 把 AutoCAD、中望、浩辰、BricsCAD 接入 DeepSeek Harness，内置 CAD 服务端，首次运行自动搭建私有 Python 环境。需要 Windows、本机已安装上述任一款 CAD、PATH 上有 Python 3.10+，且 CAD 与 DSH 以同一 Windows 用户、同一权限级别运行。

description.en: Five production-grade DSH tools bundled into one plugin (8 tool slots total): git regression finder (find introducer, recent changes, bisect, blame age), stack-trace decoder with local code context, YAML/ENV/properties config validator with typo suggestions, cross-platform shell escape (POSIX/PowerShell/cmd), and MyBatis Plus SQL static auditor (N+1, missing @Transactional, LIKE leading %, SELECT *, missing WHERE). Zero npm dependencies, all offline; concurrency-safe except the bisect tool (dsh-when-broke). Each sub-plugin is also installable standalone (dsh-when-broke, dsh-stackdecoder, dsh-config-guard, dsh-cmd-shield, dsh-mp-auditor).
description.zh: 五个生产级 DSH 工具合一的 bundle（共 8 个 tool slot）：git 回归定位（引入者反查、最近改动、二分定位、blame 年龄）、带本地代码上下文的堆栈解码器、YAML/ENV/properties 配置校验器（带近似键名提示）、跨平台 shell 转义（POSIX/PowerShell/cmd）、MyBatis Plus SQL 静态审计器（N+1、缺 @Transactional、LIKE 前导 %、SELECT *、缺 WHERE）。零 npm 依赖，全离线；除 bisect 工具（dsh-when-broke）外并发安全。每个子插件也可单独安装（AAAlenwow/dsh-when-broke、dsh-stackdecoder、dsh-config-guard、dsh-cmd-shield、dsh-mp-auditor）。

description.en: Archive DeepSeek Harness sessions into a self-hosted WeKnora knowledge base with extraction, summarization and incremental dedup.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话归档进自建 WeKnora 知识库，含提取、总结与增量去重。

description.en: Moss text-to-image inside DSH — describe the picture in chat and get it back; needs a Moss API key from platform.moss.cn, and generation is billed to your own account.
description.zh: DSH 的 Moss 文生图插件——在对话里说一句要画什么，就出一张图；需自备 platform.moss.cn 的 Moss API Key，生成费用由自己的账号承担。

description.en: OneDev integration for dsh: an MCP server exposing the OneDev REST API as 61 tools — 57 administration tools (users, groups, roles, projects, authorizations, build agents and tokens, builds with streamed build logs, global settings, access tokens), 3 standalone documentation-query tools for docs.onedev.io, and environment discovery with per-call multi-environment routing — plus a dsh Web settings page that manages per-environment credentials locally and applies them on the next tool call without a restart.
description.zh: OneDev 集成插件：MCP 服务器将 OneDev REST API 暴露为 61 个工具——57 个管理工具（用户、组、角色、项目、授权、构建代理与令牌、构建及流式构建日志、全局设置、访问令牌）、3 个独立的官方文档查询工具（docs.onedev.io）以及带按调用多环境路由的环境发现；另提供 dsh Web 设置页，在本地管理各环境凭据，保存后下一次工具调用即生效，无需重启。

description.en: Mount the QianYuan MCP server inside DeepSeek Harness: one config-layer bundle brings 15 agent-record tools (pitfalls, cached results, identity, task board) to mcp__qianyuan__*. No runtime code; reads are anonymous, writes are ed25519-signed.
description.zh: 把乾元 MCP 服务器挂进 DeepSeek Harness：一个纯配置层 bundle 带来 15 个 agent 记录工具（坑库、成果缓存、身份、任务板），注册为 mcp__qianyuan__*。不含运行时代码；读匿名，写用 ed25519 签名。

description.en: One-click WorkBuddy daily check-in button pinned to the composer tool row. Clicking it calls the check-in route provided by dsh-connect-workbuddy for the currently selected account, and shows the result next to the button: already checked in, credits claimed, or streak days. The done state persists across sessions via a local date stamp and reconciles with the upstream status on load, flipping back automatically after midnight.
description.zh: 常驻输入框工具行的 WorkBuddy 每日签到按钮，一键调用 dsh-connect-workbuddy 的签到路由为当前选中账号签到，并在按钮旁显示结果：已签到、签到成功加分或连签天数。已签状态通过本地日期戳跨会话保留，加载时与上游状态对账，跨天后自动复位。

description.en: Reads the installed plugins, MCP servers and skills, groups them by capability, and reports which preset each belongs in; can register one preset per category on request.
description.zh: 读取已安装的插件、MCP 服务器与技能，按能力分组，报告每项能力应属于哪个预设；可按需为每个类别注册一个预设。

description.en: Read-only inventory of every agent preset for the Web GUI, with a matrix of which preset holds which tools, MCP servers and skills, plus CLIs that move a plugin between presets.
description.zh: 面向 Web GUI 的 agent 预设只读清单：以矩阵展示每个预设包含哪些工具、MCP 服务器与技能，并提供在预设间迁移插件的命令行工具。

description.en: Data cleanup and reconciliation for dsh, built around reviewable evidence: original sources stay read-only, a cell is accepted only after independent checks agree, and every accepted value keeps its provenance and audit trail.
description.zh: 用于数据核对与清洗的 dsh 插件：原始材料保持只读，一格数据只有在多个独立校验一致后才被接受，每个接受值都保留来源与审计痕迹。

description.en: Drives a local MaaEnd (MXU) client over its loopback HTTP API: 10 maend_* agent tools, a sidebar dashboard panel, and startup-mute / success-gated close-game steps in the task chain. Requires a local MaaEnd install with its MXU service running.
description.zh: 通过本机 MaaEnd（MXU）的 loopback HTTP API 驱动它：10 个 maend_* agent 工具、一个侧边栏看板面板，以及任务链里的启动静音与「全部成功后才关游戏」收尾。需先在本机安装 MaaEnd 并开启 MXU 服务。

description.en: Reads the local NTQQ (QQ 9.9.x) message database on Windows and Linux and exports group and private chat history to txt, csv, json, md, html or sqlite. Ships sixteen model tools: qqnt_status and qqnt_doctor for environment and blocker checks, qqnt_extract_key, qqnt_index to build or inspect the sidecar index, qqnt_list_groups, qqnt_list_chats, qqnt_search, qqnt_stats for totals and monthly counts, qqnt_export_group, qqnt_export_chat and qqnt_export_batch (a chat can be named the way the user says it, and ambiguity refuses instead of guessing), qqnt_jobs for OCR, speech-to-text, chunking and model downloads, qqnt_media for a chat's downloaded images, qqnt_storage for disk usage and allow-listed cleanup, and qqnt_ask plus qqnt_recall for retrieval with citations. The local web UI on 127.0.0.1:46728 adds an incremental SQLite index, six views (chats, export, statistics, ask, settings, models), a task panel, a single-pane layout on narrow screens, sender redaction, media bundling, per-day splitting, export presets and AES-256 password ZIPs; OCR, speech and embedding components install into the plugin's own virtualenv on demand. Needs python3 with sqlcipher3 (the settings page can create a private virtualenv), and the database key is read from the running, logged-in QQ client.
description.zh: 读取 Windows / Linux 本机 NTQQ（QQ 9.9.x）消息库，把群聊与私聊的聊天记录导出成 txt、csv、json、md、html 或 sqlite。包含十六个模型工具：qqnt_status 与 qqnt_doctor（环境体检与排障）、qqnt_extract_key、qqnt_index（建立或查看侧车索引）、qqnt_list_groups、qqnt_list_chats、qqnt_search、qqnt_stats（总量与月度统计）、qqnt_export_group、qqnt_export_chat、qqnt_export_batch（可以直接用用户说的名字指代会话，重名时不猜、返回候选）、qqnt_jobs（截图识别 / 语音转写 / 分块与嵌入 / 下载模型）、qqnt_media（取一个会话已下载的图片）、qqnt_storage（磁盘占用与白名单清理），以及做检索问答与时间线回顾的 qqnt_ask、qqnt_recall。127.0.0.1:46728 上的本地网页界面有六个视图：会话、导出、统计、问答、设置、模型与组件，另有任务面板、窄屏单栏布局、昵称 / QQ 脱敏、媒体打包、按天分文件、导出预设与 AES-256 密码压缩包；OCR、语音与嵌入组件按需装进插件自己的虚拟环境。需要带 sqlcipher3 的 python3（设置页可一键创建独立虚拟环境），数据库密钥从正在登录的 QQ 客户端内存中读取。

description.en: Windows-only desktop control for DSH with six tools that list windows, capture occluded windows, focus windows, click by coordinate, inject Unicode keyboard input, and diagnose the desktop bridge.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 桌面控制插件，六个工具：列出窗口、抓取被遮挡窗口、聚焦窗口、按坐标点击、注入 Unicode 键盘输入与诊断桌面桥接。

description.en: One switch that takes an MCP server's tool schemas and its instructions block out of the model context for every agent, live and without a restart, built for the 207 tool schemas REA registers whether or not a task is reverse engineering. A pill in the composer dock, /rea on|off|status|toggle, and GET/POST /rea-toggle/state; the position is remembered across restarts and subagents are covered before their first step.
description.zh: 一个开关，实时把某个 MCP 服务器的工具 schema 与说明块从每个 agent 的模型上下文中移除或放回，无需重启——针对 REA 在任何任务下都会注入的 207 个工具 schema 而做。输入框下方胶囊、/rea on|off|status|toggle 与 GET/POST /rea-toggle/state 三种驱动方式；位置跨重启保持，子智能体在第一步之前就被覆盖。

description.en: Persistent Codex advisor threads for DSH sessions, with six native tools, a Codex trail, a sidebar status card, and explicit model/effort provenance. Requires a locally installed Codex CLI with app-server support and a logged-in ChatGPT/Codex account (the CLI is not bundled); tested on Windows 11 with DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话提供可跨请求续聊的 Codex 顾问线程：六个原生工具、Codex 轨迹、侧栏状态卡，以及每轮 model/effort 来源。需本机安装支持 app-server 的 Codex CLI 并登录 ChatGPT/Codex 账号（插件不自带 CLI）；已在 Windows 11 + DSH 桌面 0.2.1-rc.5 上验证。

description.en: Registers a `dispatch_task` tool that hands scoped or routine work to an isolated subagent, waits for it to finish, then checks the expected files and runs an optional verification command before returning a short report to the main conversation.
description.zh: 注册 `dispatch_task` 工具，把局部或例行任务交给隔离子 Agent 执行，等待其完成后检查预期文件并运行可选的验证命令，只向主会话返回一份简短报告。

description.en: Windows desktop control connector: through 10 agent tools it captures the screen (including occluded and partially off-screen windows), lists and focuses windows, moves, clicks, drags and scrolls the mouse, and sends key chords or arbitrary Unicode text. Built on koffi FFI: no compiler, no per-call subprocess, and its own GDI screenshot plus PNG encoder.
description.zh: Windows 桌面控制连接器：通过 10 个工具截屏（含被遮挡与半出屏窗口）、枚举与置顶窗口、移动/点击/拖拽/滚轮鼠标、发送组合键与任意中文文字。基于 koffi FFI：无需编译器、不每次起子进程，自带 GDI 截图与 PNG 编码。

description.en: Pre-launch and runtime HTTP proxy control: writes the proxy into DSH's user-level .env so the launcher and the requests before any plugin loads use it, then keeps that file in sync from a switch in the Plugins page.
description.zh: 启动前与运行时的 HTTP 代理控制：把代理写入 DSH 用户级 .env，让启动器和任何插件加载前的请求也走代理，并在「插件」页用开关同步该文件。

description.en: MCP and skill manager as a full sidebar page: add, edit, enable, disable and delete MCP servers, expand a server to its tools and open one for its parameter list, translate skill and tool summaries with a model you pick, and count tool and skill invocations. Also registers an mcp_service tool so the agent can install MCP servers in conversation after an approval prompt.
description.zh: 侧边栏整页的 MCP 与技能管理器：增删改启停 MCP 服务器，展开查看工具、点开查看参数，用自选模型翻译技能与工具摘要，统计工具与技能调用次数；另注册 mcp_service 工具，让 Agent 在对话中经审批安装 MCP。

description.en: DOCX to PDF without Microsoft Office, LibreOffice or a network: converts a Word .docx with the dxpdf Rust/Skia engine, repairs the schema-invalid OOXML that WPS Office writes, and restores the blank pages Word inserts at odd/even section breaks. Needs Python 3.8+ on PATH with pip install dxpdf lxml.
description.zh: 不依赖 Microsoft Office、LibreOffice 或网络的 DOCX 转 PDF:用 dxpdf(Rust/Skia)引擎转换 Word 文档,自动修复 WPS Office 写出的非法 OOXML,并补齐 Word 在奇偶页节分界处插入的空白页。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.8+ 并 pip install dxpdf lxml。

description.en: Configurable, provider-agnostic image generation: mounts the bundled MCP server behind an NDJSON bridge as mcp__image_generation__image_generate and mcp__image_generation__image_config_status, and registers the bundled image-generation skill. Needs baseUrl and apiKey; without them the MCP server mounts nothing.
description.zh: 可配置、与供应商无关的图片生成:把随插件分发的 MCP 服务器挂在 NDJSON 桥后面,提供 mcp__image_generation__image_generate 与 mcp__image_generation__image_config_status,并注册 image-generation 技能。需要配置 baseUrl 与 apiKey，否则 MCP 服务器不会挂载。

description.en: Text-to-image through a StepFun-compatible endpoint: mounts a no-npm-dependency Python MCP server behind an NDJSON bridge as mcp__simple_image__simple_image and returns the generated image URLs. Needs Python 3.8+ on PATH and STEP_API_KEY.
description.zh: 通过 StepFun 兼容接口文生图:把无 npm 依赖的 Python MCP 服务器挂在 NDJSON 桥后面,用 mcp__simple_image__simple_image 生成并返回图片 URL。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.8+ 并设置 STEP_API_KEY。

description.en: Image generation through TokenRhythm: mounts a no-npm-dependency Python stdio MCP server as mcp__tokenrhythm_image__generate_image, producing images with qwen-image-2.0 or wan2.7-image and saving them to a directory you choose. Needs Python 3.8+ on PATH and TOKENRHYTHM_API_KEY.
description.zh: 用 TokenRhythm 生成图片:把无 npm 依赖的 Python stdio MCP 服务器挂成 mcp__tokenrhythm_image__generate_image,用 qwen-image-2.0 或 wan2.7-image 生成并存到你指定的目录。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.8+ 并设置 TOKENRHYTHM_API_KEY。

description.en: Six RF calculators as agent tools: level conversion, link budget and maximum range, cascade noise figure, Shannon capacity, and impedance match.
description.zh: 六个射频计算工具：电平换算、链路预算与最大距离、级联噪声系数、香农容量、阻抗匹配。

description.en: Connect DSH to a local BiliMemory backend for Bilibili search, collection, status and login tasks, A-Memorix shared memory health checks, plus QQ link status, QQ user allowlists and QQ watcher restart. The repository includes a Windows one-click installer that installs or repairs MaiBot A-Memorix when missing, then configures local-bge-small-zh, embedding and shared memory. It also provides install-memory.cmd for memory-only repair. Requires Windows, DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2+, Node.js 22.19+, Python 3.12, Playwright/Edge, FFmpeg, a running BiliMemory API at 127.0.0.1:8765, a local embedding service at 127.0.0.1:11435, a Bilibili login, and MaiBot/NapCat for QQ. Voice, RVC and cover features are excluded.
description.zh: 把本地 BiliMemory 接入 DSH，支持 B站搜索、视频采集、任务状态、登录管理、A-Memorix 共用记忆状态检查，以及 QQ 链接监听状态、QQ 白名单和监听重启。仓库提供 Windows 一键部署器，可在 A-Memorix 缺失时自动安装或修复，并配置 local-bge-small-zh、向量服务和共享记忆。另提供 install-memory.cmd 用于单独修复记忆库。需要 Windows、DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2+、Node.js 22.19+、Python 3.12、Playwright/Edge、FFmpeg、运行中的 BiliMemory API（127.0.0.1:8765）、本机 embedding 服务（127.0.0.1:11435）、B站账号登录，以及用于 QQ 的 MaiBot/NapCat。当前不包含语音、RVC 和翻唱功能。

description.en: MySQL and PostgreSQL connection manager with a schema tree, table search, SQL console with completion, and four agent tools for listing connections, searching tables, inspecting structure, and running queries.
description.zh: MySQL/PostgreSQL 数据库连接管理，带库表字段树、表名搜索、SQL 补全控制台，以及列出连接、搜索表、查看结构和执行 SQL 的四个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Connects the Bowmark hosted MCP server and registers the tools it publishes, so the agent can search a library of typed functions for live websites and call them. The API key is read from the BOWMARK_API_KEY credential and is not stored in plugin config.
description.zh: 接入 Bowmark 托管的 MCP 服务器并注册它公布的工具，让智能体搜索并调用面向实时网站的类型化函数库。API Key 从 BOWMARK_API_KEY 凭据读取，不写入插件配置。

description.en: Adds three tools that hand DeepSeek Harness downloads to the Rayburst aria2 engine — rayburst_download, rayburst_wait and rayburst_status. Requires the Rayburst desktop app (aria2-next) installed and running on the same machine; the plugin reads its aria2.conf for the RPC port and secret.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的下载交给 Rayburst（aria2 引擎），提供 rayburst_download、rayburst_wait、rayburst_status 三个工具。需先在本机安装并运行 Rayburst 桌面端（aria2-next），插件会读取它的 aria2.conf 获取 RPC 端口与密钥。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to AsimovBox for creating, updating, rendering, and finishing videos through API-key-authenticated tools.
description.zh: 通过 API 密钥认证的工具将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 AsimovBox，用于创建、更新、渲染和完成视频。

description.en: Blocks tool calls whose description argument is not written in both Chinese and English: adds a system-prompt section stating the 中文:“…” 英文:“…” format and a tool guard that rejects English-only calls before they run. By default it checks every tool that declares a description parameter; set DSH_BILINGUAL_DESCRIPTION_SCOPE=shell to limit it to shell tools.
description.zh: 拦截 description 参数没有同时写中文和英文的工具调用：加一段说明「中文:“…” 英文:“…”」格式的系统提示，并在执行前用工具守卫拒绝只写英文的调用。默认检查所有声明了 description 参数的工具，可用环境变量 DSH_BILINGUAL_DESCRIPTION_SCOPE=shell 限定为命令行类工具。

description.en: Record lecture audio in a phone browser and transcribe it locally with faster-whisper; generates summaries, mind maps and quizzes with a wrong-question gate plus a focus report, and serves the phone UI over a built-in HTTPS tunnel from any network. Transcription needs local Python, ffmpeg and faster-whisper (the setup script installs them plus a ~460 MB Whisper small model); the public HTTPS tunnel uses a Windows cloudflared build and has no access code by default, so anyone with the link can open it.
description.zh: 手机浏览器录课堂音频，本机 faster-whisper 转写；生成总结、思维导图、由易到难的题与错题门控、专注报告；内置 HTTPS 隧道，手机在任何网络都能连。转写需本机 Python、ffmpeg 与 faster-whisper（setup 脚本会安装它们并下载约 460 MB 的 Whisper small 模型）；公网 HTTPS 隧道使用 Windows 版 cloudflared，默认不开访问码，拿到链接的人都能打开。

description.en: Computer-use for DSH on Windows: a session-scoped toggle in the composer that registers nine tools for screenshots, mouse clicks and drags, keyboard typing and shortcuts, window switching, UI Automation element lookup, window-to-account mapping, a batch prompt queue and download collection. Desktop automation input is native Win32 SendInput and defaults to human-like pacing - bezier cursor paths with overshoot correction, real VK keystrokes, log-normal typing with occasional typo corrections and a pause before each click - with realistic, fast and custom (0.2-8x) speed presets. Windows only. Off by default and switched on per session by the user; screenshots are sent to the model, and clicks on send/pay/delete-like controls are refused unless confirmed.
description.zh: 鼠标键盘代理操作 · 真人模拟。为 DSH 加一个按会话生效的开关，开启后注册 9 个工具，让代理做 computer-use 式的桌面自动化：截屏、鼠标点击与拖拽、键盘打字与快捷键、窗口切换、UI Automation 控件定位、窗口与账号映射、批量 prompt 队列、下载收集。输入走原生 Win32 SendInput，默认拟真节奏——贝塞尔光标轨迹与末端过冲回拉、真实 VK 击键、对数正态字符间隔并偶发打错重打、点击前犹豫——并提供仿真 / 便捷 / 自定义（0.2–8 倍）三档。适合让 AI 像人一样操作浏览器、聊天框与任何桌面程序。仅 Windows。默认关闭，由用户按会话开启；截图会发给模型；点到发送/支付/删除等控件时需另行确认才会执行。

description.en: Literature search tools for DeepSeek Harness: four model-facing tools — paper_search, paper_get, paper_citations and book_search — over OpenAlex, arXiv, Crossref, Semantic Scholar and PubMed, with open-access PDF resolution through Unpaywall.
description.zh: DSH 学术检索工具：四个模型可用工具 paper_search / paper_get / paper_citations / book_search，覆盖 OpenAlex、arXiv、Crossref、Semantic Scholar、PubMed 五个库，并用 Unpaywall 解析开放获取 PDF。

description.en: Adds four tools that query a local SAG Wiki index through the installed SAG CLI: semantic search, exact or regex match, and index status or update. Needs the SAG CLI on PATH, and semantic search also needs a JEV model configured in SAG; the model chooses which directory to index or drop (default: the session working directory).
description.zh: 通过本机 SAG CLI 提供四个工具查询 SAG Wiki 本地索引：语义检索、精确或正则匹配，以及索引状态查询与增删。需要 SAG CLI 在 PATH 里，语义检索还要在 SAG 里配好 JEV 模型；索引或移除哪个目录由模型决定（默认是会话工作目录）。

description.en: Codebase knowledge graphs for DeepSeek Harness: seven graphify_* Agent tools, a /graphify command, and a Graphify page build and query a project graph locally with AST parsing (no API key), plus path/explain/god-node lookups and wiki/HTML/SVG/GraphML/Obsidian exports. Requires the graphify CLI (graphifyy); only full document/PDF/image extraction needs an LLM key.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码库知识图谱：7 个 graphify_* Agent 工具、/graphify 命令与 Graphify 页面，用本地 AST 解析构建并查询项目图谱（无需 API Key），支持路径 / 解释 / 枢纽节点查询与 wiki、HTML、SVG、GraphML、Obsidian 导出。需先安装 graphify CLI（graphifyy）；只有含文档 / PDF / 图片的完整抽取需要 LLM Key。

description.en: Optional DSH configuration bundle that connects the existing MCP client to hosted BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit using a user-provided BAIZHI_API_KEY Bearer header; tool calls may incur charges.
description.zh: 复用 DSH 现有 MCP 客户端连接百智云托管工具包的可选配置包，通过用户提供的 BAIZHI_API_KEY 生成 Bearer 请求头；工具调用可能计费。

description.en: C++ runtime info probe for Windows via CDB: cpp_trace prints variables at multiple breakpoints in one session (replaces hand-written print), cpp_probe dumps the call stack at a conditional breakpoint. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cpp-probe.
description.zh: Windows + CDB 下的 C++ 运行时信息探针：cpp_trace 一次会话多断点打印变量（替换手打 print），cpp_probe 条件断点输出调用栈。安装：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cpp-probe。

description.en: Pull frames and audio out of a local video with ffmpeg and hand back plain file paths, so the agent can look at the frames with its own vision. Five tools: probe, evenly spaced frames, one frame at a timestamp, scene-change frames (the practical version of frame-by-frame), and audio extraction. No models, no uploads, no routing guesswork.
description.zh: 用 ffmpeg 从本地视频里抽帧、抽音轨，只返回文件路径，让 agent 用自己的视觉去看。五个工具：探测、均匀抽帧、指定时刻取帧、场景变化抽帧（逐帧分析的实用版）、抽音轨。不碰模型、不上传、不需要配任何 provider，所以不存在路由选错的问题。

description.en: Reverse-engineer an image style into a reproducible prompt: measures palette, brightness, contrast, saturation, colour temperature, sharpness, grain and aspect with pure algorithms, fills only the semantic slots you confirm (subject, action, mood, camera, style), and reports which slots are still missing. Shipped with a negative prompt derived from the measured deviations.
description.zh: 把一张图的风格反推成可复现的提示词：用纯算法测出配色、亮度、对比、饱和、色温、锐度、颗粒与画幅，语义槽（主体、动作、情绪、镜头、风格）只填你确认过的，缺的槽位会明确报出来；同时给出由测得偏差反推的负向提示词。

description.en: Version-adaptive tooling for DeepSeek Harness: it reads the running DSH version from the plugin manager, mirrors app-boot plugin-compatibility rules (engines.dsh first, then @deepseek-ai/dsh* peers, prerelease-inclusive comparison, exact-version exemptions) to score every installed plugin, and statically flags source still using APIs renamed or deprecated between v0.1.6 and v0.2.1. Ships a conversation-view panel, an agent tool and HTTP state/scan/report routes. Read-only, offline.
description.zh: DSH 版本自适应：自检当前运行时版本，按 DSH 自己的规则（engines.dsh 优先，否则检查 @deepseek-ai/dsh* peer；预发布参与比较；精确版本例外）逐条判定已装插件，并用官方 release notes 摘出的规则标出源码里仍在使用 v0.1.6 起已改名/弃用接口的位置。带会话视图面板、agent 工具与 HTTP 状态/重扫/报告入口；只读、离线。

description.en: A local mirrored A/B benchmark for context compression, not another compressor. It runs one fixed read-only scenario twice with the same model and temperature — compression off, then on — and reports input tokens, turns, tool-call success, fact coverage, answer similarity and a per-line diff, with JSON, a self-contained SVG and raw warnings. 18 node --test tests, zero dependencies. The first measured run: 63,029 → 6,927 locally estimated input tokens (−89.0%), 3 → 3 turns, facts 3/3 → 3/3, answer similarity 1.00 on one sample.
description.zh: 给上下文压缩做本机镜像 A/B 的量具，不是又一个压缩插件。同一个只读场景、同一模型、temperature 0，压缩关跑一遍、开再跑一遍，记录输入 token、轮数、工具调用成功率、事实覆盖、答案相似度与逐行差异，产出 JSON、自包含 SVG 和原始警告。18 个 node --test 测试，零依赖。首次实测：本地估算输入 token 63,029 → 6,927（−89.0%），轮数 3 → 3，事实 3/3 → 3/3，答案相似度 1.00（单样本）。

description.en: Auditable token-cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness: wraps the llm/stream waterfall and records every call with provider, model, input/output/cache-hit/cache-write tokens, usage source and integer nano-CNY cost from an explicit price table. Aggregates by hour, day and session; exports JSON or CSV with a no-write dry-run preview; keeps a manually entered official platform bill in a parallel column with actual-minus-estimate diff. Unknown provider/model routes stay explicitly unpriced. Zero runtime dependencies; no balance query, notifications or animations.
description.zh: 可核对的 token 成本账：包住 llm/stream waterfall，逐次记录 provider、model、输入/输出/缓存命中/缓存写入 token、用量来源，以及按显式价目表算出的整数 nano-CNY 费用；按小时/日/会话聚合，支持 JSON/CSV 导出与不落盘的 dry-run 预览；手填官方平台账单与本地估算并列，给出 actual − estimated 差异。未知 provider/model 保持显式未定价。零运行时依赖；不查余额、不发通知、不做动画。

description.en: A delivery receipt panel for a project hand-off. One trigger collects the branch and commit, the test and build results, screenshot dimensions with sha256, and the secret-scan verdict, then assigns every line to one of three zones by evidence alone — verified, local-only, or unverified. A claim in the unverified zone keeps its label and prints an explicitly empty slot instead of the claim itself, because a confidently worded sentence with nothing behind it is the exact thing the receipt exists to catch. Test failures and secret-scan hits are still evidence, so they land in the verified zone with a red tone rather than being quietly dropped.
description.zh: 项目收尾用的交付回执面板。触发一次即汇总分支与 commit、测试与构建结果、截图的宽高与 sha256、密钥扫描结论，然后只按证据把每一条分进三区：已验证、仅本地、未验证。落在未验证区的声明只保留标签，正文位置显式留空而不是把声明印出来——措辞自信而背后什么都没有的句子，正是回执要防的东西。测试失败与密钥扫描命中同样是有证据的事实，因此进已验证区并带红色色调，而不是被悄悄丢掉。

description.en: Content-catalog guard for WeChat mini-programs: validates catalog.json so every activity price is an integer amountFen, every template renders prices through money(), required fields / duplicate copy / image paths are checked, and the result is an issue list plus a unified diff that can be applied with patch -p1. 29 rules over five groups (catalog shape, required fields and uniqueness, amounts, rendering, images). Three fixes are automatic (legacy yuan amount, string Fen, absolute image path) and preserve the file's own indent, EOL and trailing newline; everything else is reported with a hint instead of being guessed. Dry-run by default; apply re-checks the written file so the report describes what remains. One implementation serves a tool, a conversation panel and a CLI with exit codes 0/1/2. Zero runtime dependencies, no model call, no network.
description.zh: 微信小程序内容目录守卫：校验 catalog.json，保证每条活动金额都是整数 amountFen、页面价格统一走 money()，必填字段 / 重复文案 / 图片路径逐项检查，输出问题清单与可直接 patch -p1 的 unified diff。29 条规则分五组（目录结构、必填与唯一性、金额、渲染、图片）；三条可自动修复（旧「元」金额、字符串分、绝对图片路径），写回保留原文件的缩进/行尾/结尾换行，其余只给修法提示不猜。默认 dry-run，apply 后会重查写回的文件，报告描述剩余问题。一份实现同时服务工具、会话面板与 CLI（退出码 0/1/2）。零运行时依赖，不调用模型、不联网。

description.en: Measured /pua for DeepSeek Harness: every pressure message gets a receipt comparing the last N completed model steps with the next N — tool calls, verification-class steps, repeated-call peak, failed calls and text volume — with a three-way verdict (changed approach / merely restated / no change) and a daily ranking of which sentence moved the work. Ships a conversation-view panel, a /pua command with list/status/receipts/rank/off, append-only local JSONL receipts (no tool arguments, content or session ids), 38 node:test tests and a zero-dependency build. Reports observed differences, not causality. Inspired by MichengAI/dsh-pua (independent code); it registers the same /pua command, so it cannot be installed alongside dsh-pua.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 /pua 加效果回执：每次施压都对比前 N 个完整模型步与后 N 个完整模型步的工具调用、验证类步骤、重复调用峰值、失败调用与文本量，判定「改变了做法 / 只是重述 / 无变化」，并按话术排出「今天哪句话真的推动了工作」。带对话视图「回执」面板、/pua 的 list/status/receipts/rank/off 子命令、本地追加式 JSONL（不保存工具参数、内容或 session id）、38 个 node:test 测试与零依赖构建。只报告前后差异，不宣称因果。灵感来自 MichengAI/dsh-pua（代码独立）；注册同名 /pua 命令，不能与 dsh-pua 同装。

description.en: A shareable delivery receipt for a project hand-off. The `ship_receipt` tool measures what it can and records what it was told, then sorts every line into three zones: verified (evidence this run produced and that reproduces elsewhere — a command that actually ran with its exit code, a file hash for a file that is under version control, a scan that found files, a git ref present in the recorded remote), local-only (true on this machine alone — uncommitted changes, unpushed commits, an artifact no one else can see), and unverified (no evidence, including every sentence a human typed). A claim with no evidence keeps its label and leaves the body blank rather than printing the claim; declares the commit and branch, artifact byte sizes and sha256 with PNG dimensions, and the three pre-push checks.
description.zh: 项目收尾时生成一张可公开的交付回执。`ship_receipt` 工具自己测量能测的、记录被告知的，再把每一条硬性分进三区：已验证（本次采集到、且能在别处复现的证据——真跑过的命令与退出码、已入版本库文件的哈希、确实扫到文件的扫描、本地记录的远端里存在的 git 引用）、仅本地（只在这台机器上成立——未提交改动、未推送提交、别人看不到的产物）、未验证（没有证据，包括人写的任何一句话）。没有证据的声明只留标签、正文留空，而不是把声明照原样印出来；回执里含分支与 commit、产物的字节数与 sha256（PNG 附带宽高），以及推送前三步检查的结论。

description.en: Skill usage radar for DeepSeek Harness: records every skill hit from the skill tool and /name gestures into a local JSONL ledger, ranks skills by hits in the last 7 days, greys out zero-hit skills with an archive suggestion, and expands a row into time, session, trigger and prompt. Ships a conversation-view panel with frontmatter model-invocation toggle, skill creation, and a recoverable .trash archive/restore. 52 zero-dependency tests; loopback-only, no external network.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的技能面板加一列「命中记录」：从 skill 工具调用与 /name 手势记下每次命中的时间、会话、触发词与提示词到本地 JSONL，按最近 7 天命中数排序，零命中的技能灰显并标「建议归档」，展开行可查看命中明细。带会话视图「技能雷达」面板、frontmatter 模型调用开关、新建技能、以及走 .trash 的可恢复归档。52 个零依赖测试；只监听 loopback，无外部网络。

description.en: A conversation-view tab for turning one local reference video into a human-curated shot list. ffmpeg scdet finds shot boundaries, each shot gets one timecoded thumbnail, you untick what you do not need, and the export writes frames.csv (UTF-8 BOM), shots.json, numbered JPEG frames and a labelled contact sheet. Local-only, no upload, zero runtime dependencies, 39 node --test tests including a real-ffmpeg integration case. Requires ffmpeg 5.1+ (with ffprobe) installed separately.
description.zh: 把一段本地参考视频变成人工策展过的镜头清单：ffmpeg scdet 找镜头切点，每镜一帧带毫秒时间码的缩略图，勾掉不要的帧后导出 frames.csv（UTF-8 BOM）、shots.json、编号 JPEG 和一张带时间码标签的联系表。全程本机处理、不上传，零运行时依赖，39 个 node --test 测试（含真实 ffmpeg 集成用例）。需自行安装 ffmpeg 5.1+（含 ffprobe）。

description.en: Runs the local Claude Code CLI from DSH as three tools (claude_run, claude_resume, claude_probe) that parse --output-format json and return the session id for follow-ups, plus a standalone loopback bridge.
description.zh: 把本机 Claude Code CLI 接成 DSH 的三个工具（claude_run / claude_resume / claude_probe），解析 --output-format json 并返回可续接的 session id，另带独立回环桥。

description.en: Frontend aesthetics engine as 17 native tools — a 118-palette evidence library matched by register, cross-register whole-page design directions, four mechanical gates (WCAG contrast, color-blind simulation, AI-slop detection, scorecard) with digest-bound verdicts, plus semantic design tokens, existing-page audit, CVD-checked chart palettes, CJK type scale, render-vs-tokens reconciliation and measured-numbers rationale. Fully local, zero network. Requires Python 3.8+.
description.zh: 前端美学引擎的 17 个原生工具：118 块实证色板按语域选板、跨语域整页方向对比、四道机械检查（对比度、色盲、AI 味、评分）带指纹绑定，另有设计令牌表、页面审计、图表色板、中文字阶、渲染对账与量化叙事。全部本地运行，零联网。需 Python 3.8+。

description.en: Reorganizes a DeepSeek Harness session transcript into a structured Markdown document with an outline and a table of contents instead of exporting the chat in chronological order. Exposed three ways: a model tool session_to_doc, a composer button, and a loopback-only Web endpoint.
description.zh: 把 DSH 当前会话的对话记录重组成带大纲、章节层级和目录的结构化 Markdown 文档，而不是按时间顺序原样导出。三种入口：模型工具 session_to_doc、输入框按钮、仅回环的 Web 接口。

description.en: Manual context compaction for DSH Agent Teams, adding a scoped compact_context tool and the /compact-agent command.
description.zh: DSH 智能体团队的手动上下文压缩：按成员作用域注册的 compact_context 工具与 /compact-agent 命令。

description.en: Exposes Windows display geometry and the foreground window rect in physical pixels.
description.zh: 提供 Windows 显示器几何与前台窗口的物理像素坐标。

description.en: Downloads a video link, samples frames from it, and transcribes the speech with Groq Whisper so an agent can answer questions about what the video shows; long audio is split into 15-minute windows to stay under the upload limit, and frames still come back without a key, which only the transcript needs. Needs ffmpeg, ffprobe and yt-dlp on PATH.
description.zh: 下载视频链接、从中抽帧，并用 Groq Whisper 转写语音，让 agent 能回答视频内容相关的问题；过长音频会切成 15 分钟片段以符合上传上限，没有 key 时仍会返回抽帧，只有转写需要该 key。需 PATH 中有 ffmpeg、ffprobe 与 yt-dlp。

description.en: macOS Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: the agent reads accessibility trees, captures screenshots and drives real desktop apps, mounted on the 0.2.1-rc.5 line with a separately built native helper. macOS only.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接入 macOS 电脑操控：agent 读取辅助功能树、截图并驱动真实桌面应用，挂在 0.2.1-rc.5 这条线上，原生 helper 需单独构建。仅支持 macOS。

description.en: Weather care for DeepSeek Harness: turns a forecast into one sentence you can send — clothing and umbrella advice from feels-like temperature, humidity and air quality, adjusted for how cold-sensitive the user is and how they commute. Also a switchable daily care push, extreme-weather alerts and reminders, evaluated when the agent wakes (a host such as qq-bridge can wake it on schedule). Preferences stay on the local machine.
description.zh: 天气关心：把预报变成一句能直接发出去的话——按体感温度、湿度、空气质量给穿衣与带伞建议，并照顾对方怕冷怕热、骑车还是开车。另有每日主动关心（可开关）、极端天气预警与提醒，在 agent 醒来时评估，可由 qq-bridge 这类宿主定时唤醒；偏好只存本机。

description.en: LeisureTimeQueue is a local leisure-time task queue plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: LeisureTimeQueue 是一个基于 DeepSeek Harness 的本地闲时任务队列插件。

description.en: Chooses which skills and MCP servers each workspace may use, from a "Skills & MCP" item in the workspace row's "..." menu; unchecked skills leave the session catalog, the `skill` tool and `/name`, and unchecked servers have their `mcp__<server>__*` tools denied for that workspace's sessions, running ones included from the next turn.
description.zh: 在侧栏工作区行的「…」菜单中新增「技能与 MCP」，按工作区勾选可用的技能与 MCP 服务器；取消勾选的技能从会话技能目录、`skill` 工具和 `/技能名` 中消失，取消勾选的服务器其 `mcp__<服务器>__*` 工具对该工作区的会话禁用，已在运行的会话从下一轮起生效。

description.en: Adds extra working directories to a workspace, each read-write or read-only, from a folder button next to the composer or the `/add-dir`, `/remove-dir` and `/dirs` commands; the model sees them in its runtime context, and `write` and `edit` calls into read-write directories skip the sandbox escalation prompt by default while shell commands still ask.
description.zh: 为工作区添加额外的工作目录，可设为读写或只读，可通过输入框旁的文件夹按钮或 `/add-dir`、`/remove-dir`、`/dirs` 命令管理；模型可在运行时上下文中看到这些目录，对读写目录的 `write` 与 `edit` 调用默认免去沙箱提权确认，终端命令仍会询问。

description.en: Windows-only game crash diagnosis from Event Log, WER reports and crash dumps, with a diagnose_game_crash tool and an optional background notifier.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows：从事件日志、WER 报告和崩溃转储诊断游戏崩溃，提供 diagnose_game_crash 工具和可选的后台通知。

description.en: Foggy Java data-analysis integration for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Runtime, CLI, Launcher, onboarding Skills, and semantic-layer workflows.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理 Foggy Java 数据分析 Runtime、CLI、Launcher 与 onboarding/语义查询 Skill，支持数据库接入和语义层建模。

description.en: Restores the Windows desktop after a restart or power loss: snapshots open apps, documents, folders and window positions, and reopens them on demand. Windows 10+ only; automatic capture before shutdown needs two scheduled tasks registered once with collector/install-tasks.ps1.
description.zh: 重启或断电后恢复 Windows 桌面：快照已打开的程序、文档、文件夹与窗口位置，可一键重开。仅支持 Windows 10 及以上；关机前自动抓取需先用 collector/install-tasks.ps1 注册两个计划任务。

description.en: Windows desktop organizer for DeepSeek Harness: it registers 1 agent tool (desktop_organize).
description.zh: Windows 桌面整理：归类桌面快捷方式、发现未建快捷方式的程序、检测失效链接（1 个模型工具 desktop_organize）。

description.en: Local document library for DSH Desktop (Windows only, installed with the bundled PowerShell script): upload files once, then every conversation can search and read them through four tools (library_list / library_search / library_read / library_save); upload, download and batch download live in the Settings panel. Files stay on the machine unless you enable the optional vision model, which sends images to the endpoint you configure.
description.zh: 本地资料库（仅 Windows，需用随包的 PowerShell 脚本安装）：文件传一次，之后每个对话都能用四个工具（library_list / library_search / library_read / library_save）检索、读取；上传、下载与打包下载在设置页完成。文件只保存在本机——除非你启用可选的视觉模型，它会把图片发到你配置的接口。

description.en: Localizes the prompts DeepSeek Harness sends to the model — system prompt sections, runtime context, tool descriptions and parameter docs — into Simplified Chinese. Its Cordis API dictionary is derived from zjl1989-li/dsh-harness-zh-cn (MIT), which translates the same prompt layers at runtime; do not enable both at once.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 发给模型的提示词——系统提示词各段、运行时上下文、工具描述与参数说明——翻译成简体中文。Cordis API 词典派生自 zjl1989-li/dsh-harness-zh-cn（MIT），后者同样在运行时翻译同一批提示词层；不要同时启用两者。

description.en: Session-scoped system prompts: maintain a library of prompts in a settings page and tick them above the composer to inject into the current session only (subagent child sessions inherit via parentSession; empty tick list opts out), plus quick prompts that paste their text into the composer draft on click.
description.zh: 会话级系统提示词：在设置页维护一组提示词，在输入框上方按会话勾选注入（子会话沿 parentSession 继承，空勾选表明确退出），另有一类快速提示词，点击即把正文填入输入框草稿。

description.en: Douyin operator for DSH: drives your own Chrome to read the feed, comments and DMs, reply in-thread, and upload a local video through the creator center - every write passes a policy gate and publishing always needs your click.
description.zh: 抖音运营插件：用本机真实 Chrome 看推荐、读评论、回私信，把本地视频传进创作者中心；写动作过权限闸，发布永远要你点头。

description.en: Bundled registry of 119 computer-science sources (textbooks, official docs, standards, preprints) across the 17 CS2023 knowledge areas, each tagged with an authority tier, evidence type and refresh interval, plus cs_source_find and cs_source_audit tools that look up a source or audit the URLs in a draft.
description.zh: 内置 119 条计算机信源（教材、官方文档、标准、预印本），覆盖 17 个 CS2023 知识领域，逐条标注权威等级、证据类型与刷新周期；提供 cs_source_find 与 cs_source_audit 两个工具，用于查源和审计草稿中的引用。

description.en: Workout logging plugin: a fitness_log agent tool (log, history, stats, weekly plans) storing data in local SQLite; the repo also ships a separate optional left-rail panel bundle under ui/.
description.zh: 训练记录插件：fitness_log 工具（记录、历史、统计、每周计划），数据存本地 SQLite；同一仓库 ui/ 里另有需单独安装的左侧栏面板包。

description.en: Bridge local projects into Obsidian: bounded manifest scanning, deterministic dependency/tech/topic edges, and wiki-linked notes written into a managed graph/ vault namespace via the Local REST API or the vault filesystem.
description.zh: 把本机项目接入 Obsidian：有界的 manifest 扫描、确定性的依赖/技术栈/主题边，通过 Local REST API 或 vault 文件系统把带 wiki 链接的笔记写入托管的 graph/ 命名空间。

description.en: Give the agent a priority-ranked, coverage-honest map of any codebase before it edits.
description.zh: 让 agent 在动一个陌生仓库之前，先拿到一份按优先级排序、覆盖率老实的仓库地图。

description.en: Keeps discussion read-only and hands every repository code edit to the Codex CLI through a bundled MCP server; switches between the DSH model and the Claude Code CLI in the plugin form, with preflight checks and a write guard that blocks structured edits to repo files.
description.zh: 讨论阶段只读，改仓库代码一律交给 Codex CLI（插件自带 MCP server）；在插件表单里可在 DSH 主模型与 Claude Code CLI 之间切换，带前置检查，并用写文件 guard 拦截对仓库文件的结构化写入。

description.en: Local full-disk knowledge base: indexes documents from C:/ and E:/ into a SQLite FTS5 trigram index over filename, body, and path, with a searchable DSH sidebar panel, no-keyword browse, usefulness/topic tags, and a token-efficient kb agent tool. Windows only; building the index needs a system Python 3 with PyMuPDF and python-docx (plus python-pptx and openpyxl for PPTX/XLSX), and no prebuilt index ships with the plugin.
description.zh: 本地全盘知识库：把 C:/ 与 E:/ 的文档抽取进 SQLite FTS5 trigram 索引（文件名、正文、路径三列可搜），提供可搜索的 DSH 侧栏面板、无关键词浏览、有用度与主题双标签，以及省 token 的 kb 智能体工具。仅限 Windows；建索引需要系统 Python 3 及 PyMuPDF、python-docx（PPTX/XLSX 另需 python-pptx、openpyxl），插件不自带索引。

description.en: Persistent model tool-call trace recorder: every tool call is durably written to a JSONL file that survives restarts, queryable via a structured call_trace tool and a callTraceHistory service, with size rotation and an optional floating canvas UI add-on.
description.zh: 持久化模型工具调用轨迹记录器：每次工具调用落盘为 JSONL（重启不丢），提供结构化 call_trace 查询工具与 callTraceHistory 服务，支持文件大小轮转，附可选浮层画布 UI。

description.en: Send files or folders over the local network via the LocalSend v2 protocol, or generate a temporary browser download link that the receiver opens with no software installed.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中通过 LocalSend v2 协议把文件/文件夹发到局域网内其它机器，或生成一次性浏览器下载链接（接收方无需安装任何软件）。零配置开箱即用，兼容 dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 与 0.1.3-alpha.1。

description.en: Sends photos from a phone into a DeepSeek Harness conversation through a simple LAN service.
description.zh: 通过一个简单的局域网服务，把手机中的照片发送到 DeepSeek Harness 的对话中。

description.en: Hard stop for runaway turns: blocks repeated identical tool calls and ends the turn when per-turn step or time budgets are exceeded.
description.zh: 失控回合硬止损：拦截同一工具+同一参数的重复调用，单轮步数或时长超预算即结束本轮。

description.en: Appends actionable hints to failed tool results, such as the nearest existing directory when a path does not exist.
description.zh: 给失败的工具结果追加可执行提示（如路径不存在时给出最近的已存在目录）。

description.en: Adds a structured TextIn xParse tool and document parsing skill to DeepSeek Harness, supporting document parsing, cached-content navigation and durable multi-document tasks, with AppKey or Device OAuth authentication, paid-operation approval and bundled cross-platform CLI binaries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化的 TextIn xParse 工具与文档解析 Skill，支持文档解析、缓存内容导航和持久化多文档任务，并集成 AppKey 或 Device OAuth 认证、付费操作审批及跨平台内嵌 CLI。

description.en: Slash-command console for dsh: /web start|stop|restart|status, /tunnel SSH forward management, one-shot /ask, and a console TUI launcher.
description.zh: dsh 控制台命令：/web 启动/停止/重启/状态、/tunnel SSH 隧道管理、/ask 一次性问答、/console 启动控制台 TUI。

description.en: Learn from Bilibili videos, web pages, local files and live streams: local ASR, on-screen OCR and extractive digests add up to about 1.5KB of text per source, so the model reads a summary instead of a full transcript.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频、网页、本地文件和直播变成可检索的学习库：本地转写、画面 OCR、抽取式摘要，每个来源交回约 1.5KB 文本，让模型读摘要而不是全文。

description.en: Host-side HTTP bridge on 127.0.0.1:39217 with a Bearer token stored at 0600: external processes can create real DSH Desktop sessions that appear in the workspace sidebar, send prompts (queue or steer), read state and the last assistant reply, list workspaces and sessions, and long-poll until a turn finishes. Zero runtime dependencies; fixed loopback port; no outbound network; message bodies are never logged.
description.zh: 只在 127.0.0.1:39217 监听的本机 HTTP 桥（Host 半插件），用 0600 落盘的 Bearer token 鉴权：外部进程可创建出现在工作区侧栏的真会话、发消息（queue/steer）、读状态与最后一条助手回复、列工作区/会话，并长轮询到回合结束。零运行时依赖，端口固定，不联网，日志不记消息正文。

description.en: Bilibili companion for DSH (MIT fork of Alterssss/dsh-bili-whale; do not install alongside the upstream — both register the same `/dsh-bili/` settings routes and share `~/.dsh/bili-whale.config.json`): wakes on a schedule, reads videos through subtitles, danmaku, hot comments and covers, writes two diaries, and shares at most one pick per wake by commenting on the video and @-mentioning the owner (daily quota 3; DM when `share.via=dm`). Inbound DMs, commenter names, summary requests and live danmaku are normalized and scanned for injected instructions before they reach the model; only the owner DM channel can carry an authorization prefix.
description.zh: DSH 的 B 站养鱼插件（Alterssss/dsh-bili-whale 的 MIT 分叉；不要与上游 dsh-bili-whale 同装——两者注册同一套 `/dsh-bili/` 设置路由并共用 `~/.dsh/bili-whale.config.json`）：按作息自己醒来，靠字幕、弹幕、热评与封面读懂视频，写两本日记，每次醒来最多以评论区 @ 主人的方式分享一条（每日额度 3；`share.via=dm` 时走私信）。私信正文、来信人、总结请求与直播弹幕在进模型前会归一化并扫描可疑指令；只有主人私信通道能携带授权前缀。

description.en: Self-hosted SearXNG search provider: the bundled installer sets up and supervises a local instance on macOS/Linux/WSL (needs git and Python 3.11+), key-less and tracking-free; it probes the engines your network can reach and applies the recommended set in one click.
description.zh: 自建 SearXNG 搜索源：随包脚本在 macOS/Linux/WSL 上安装并守护本地实例（需 git 与 Python 3.11+），免 API Key、无追踪；实测本机各引擎的可达性与延迟后，一键应用推荐集。

description.en: Daily check-in for Nanjing Forestry University's ACM AI Hub plus seat booking for its library — both site addresses are hardcoded — with a settings page and a progress badge; built for DeepSeek Harness Mobile (DSHM) on Android.
description.zh: 南京林业大学 ACM AI Hub 每日签到与该校图书馆座位预约（两个站点地址写死），带设置页与完成度角标；面向 Android 上的 DeepSeek Harness Mobile。

description.en: Code knowledge graph bridge for codebase-memory-mcp: semantic symbol search (BM25), source snippets, architecture overview with Leiden communities, call/data-flow/cross-service traces, graph-augmented grep.
description.zh: codebase-memory-mcp 的代码知识图谱桥：语义符号搜索（BM25）、源码片段、Leiden 社区架构总览、调用/数据流/跨服务追踪、图增强 grep。

description.en: Desktop and browser automation bridge (36 tools): window/screen/mouse/keyboard control with PaddleOCR element perception, Chrome CDP browsing with accessibility snapshots.
description.zh: 桌面 + 浏览器自动化桥（36 个工具）：窗口/屏幕/鼠标/键盘控制配 PaddleOCR 元素感知，Chrome CDP 浏览配无障碍快照。

description.en: This plugin locates the root cause of a failed DeepSeek Harness agent session and produces a shareable diagnostic report.
description.zh: 此插件定位DeepSeek Harness代理会话失败的根本原因，并生成可共享的诊断报告。

description.en: Obsidian vault tools: 13 tools for listing, reading and searching notes, creating, appending and editing by line range, deleting to the vault's .trash folder, frontmatter CRUD, tag queries, image insertion, batch operations, and renaming notes while rewriting the wikilinks that point at them; writes are atomic and keep CRLF and BOM.
description.zh: Obsidian 笔记库工具集：13 个工具，覆盖列出/读取/检索笔记、新建/追加/按行号片段编辑、删除（移入笔记库的 .trash 文件夹）、frontmatter 读写、标签查询、插入图片、批量操作，以及重命名笔记时自动改写指向它的双链；写入为原子操作并保留 CRLF 与 BOM。

description.en: Scan installed Windows apps and launch them from a sidebar launcher above the settings icon.
description.zh: 扫描本机已安装的 Windows 应用，在侧边栏设置图标上方提供一键启动。

description.en: Windows multi-drive dashboard that labels cleanable, caution, and system space in green, yellow, and red, audits download folders, and suggests how to split data across drives.
description.zh: Windows 多盘磁盘分工面板：用绿/黄/红标出可清理、需确认、系统占用，核对下载目录，并给出多盘分工与迁移建议。

description.en: Cleans a Wallpaper Engine workshop folder against a screenshot of your subscriptions: it finds the blue check badges, OCRs the tile titles, matches them to each project.json title, and moves non-subscribed wallpapers to the Recycle Bin. Ships a settings page and a floating modal, and is Windows-only.
description.zh: 对照“我的订阅壁纸”截图清理 Wallpaper Engine 工坊文件夹：识别蓝色勾选、OCR 磁贴标题并与 project.json 匹配，把非订阅壁纸移入回收站；带设置页与悬浮模态框，仅支持 Windows。

description.en: GEO and bulk transcriptomics workbench backed by a local Python and R engine: search and download GEO series, import your own counts or TPM matrix, then run QC, filtering, normalisation, batch correction, PCA, differential expression, GO/KEGG/GSEA enrichment, immune infiltration, survival and prognosis, signature mapping onto single-cell data, and circRNA, miRNA, lncRNA, fusion and alternative-splicing modules.
description.zh: GEO 与 bulk 转录组分析工作台，后端为本地 Python 与 R 引擎：检索下载 GEO 系列、导入自有 counts/TPM 矩阵，再做质控、过滤、标准化、去批次、PCA、差异表达、GO/KEGG/GSEA 富集、免疫浸润、生存与预后分析、把分子签名映射到单细胞数据，以及 circRNA、miRNA、lncRNA、融合基因与可变剪接模块。

description.en: Single-cell RNA-seq workbench usable from the Harness UI or from agent tools: imports h5ad, 10x, loom, Seurat RDS and archive files, runs QC, filtering, normalisation, highly variable genes, PCA, neighbour graph, clustering, UMAP/t-SNE, marker genes and cell-type annotation, offers resolution scans and saved marker panels, and exports h5ad, result tables and reports.
description.zh: 单细胞 RNA-seq 分析工作台，界面按钮与 agent 工具共用同一套实现：导入 h5ad、10x、loom、Seurat RDS 与压缩包，跑质控、过滤、标准化、高变基因、PCA、邻居图、聚类、UMAP/t-SNE、标记基因与细胞类型注释，提供分辨率扫描与标记基因面板，并导出 h5ad、结果表与报告。

description.en: Attachment store manager: per-conversation inventory, impact-aware deletion, and relocation of ~/.dsh/attachments to another disk (relocation tested on Windows 11 only).
description.zh: 附件存储管理：按对话盘点、删除前说明影响，并可将 ~/.dsh/attachments 迁移到其他磁盘（迁移仅在 Windows 11 上测试）。

description.en: Search four free libraries from one window: Project Gutenberg through its OPDS catalog, Shuge through its WordPress search plus the s.shuge.org short links on each book page, and NCPSSD through its Solr-backed endpoint. The Chinese Text Project is deliberately link-only, because its terms forbid automated access. Two tools: readbook_search and readbook_open; the second returns real download URLs for Gutenberg and Shuge, and only a page link for NCPSSD.
description.zh: 一个窗口同时搜四家免费图书馆：Project Gutenberg 走 OPDS 目录，书格走 WordPress 检索再取每本书页面上的 s.shuge.org 下载短链，国家哲学社会科学文献中心走它的 Solr 检索接口。中国哲学书电子化计划刻意只给链接——它明令禁止程序化抓取。两个工具：readbook_search 与 readbook_open，后者给 Gutenberg 和书格的真实下载地址，NCPSSD 只给页面链接。

description.en: Daily remote job hunting across BOSS Zhipin, Liepin, LinkedIn and other Chinese job boards, scored against a saved profile and shown in a Harness panel. Requires a local Chrome/Chromium install (the plugin launches its own browser profile) and a BOSS Zhipin account for BOSS results.
description.zh: 每天从 BOSS直聘、猎聘、LinkedIn 等招聘站抓取远程岗位，按求职画像打分并显示在 Harness 面板里。需本机安装 Chrome/Chromium（插件使用独立浏览器配置），BOSS直聘结果需登录 BOSS 账号。

description.en: A WebSearchProvider that falls back across backends instead of relying on one: Exa, then Bing HTML, then DuckDuckGo HTML, and only then the quota-limited SerpAPI, so the free tiers carry routine searching.
description.zh: 多后端自动降级的 WebSearchProvider：依次尝试 Exa、Bing HTML、DuckDuckGo HTML，都失败后才动用有额度的 SerpAPI，日常搜索由免费档承担。

description.en: HarmonyOS device workbench for DSH NEXT Desktop on Windows x64 (tested with DSH NEXT 2.0.21-next and Better Sidebar 0.28.2); the floating mirror reuses DSH's Electron or downloads one (~140 MB) on first use.
description.zh: 面向 Windows x64 上的 DSH NEXT 桌面版（在 DSH NEXT 2.0.21-next + Better Sidebar 0.28.2 上验证）的鸿蒙设备工作台；悬浮投屏复用 DSH 的 Electron，没有时首次打开会下载约 140 MB 的 Electron。

description.en: Genspark tools for DeepSeek Harness - web search, crawl, image/video/audio generation, media analysis, X/Instagram/Reddit search and model listing through @genspark/cli, with 17 typed tools and 18 /genspark-* commands. Requires @genspark/cli installed and logged in (gsk login), or GSK_API_KEY set.
description.zh: 将 Genspark 能力接入 DeepSeek Harness：网页搜索、抓取、图片/视频/音频生成、媒体理解、X/Instagram/Reddit 搜索与模型列表，提供 17 个工具和 18 个 /genspark-* 命令。需安装并登录 @genspark/cli（gsk login），或设置 GSK_API_KEY。

description.en: Team shared knowledge base: one member runs a zero-dependency Hub, everyone else installs this plugin and joins with one invite code. Uploads are filed into ten categories with a summary, confidence and points; 15 agent tools let members upload, search, recall, comment and read them. Important items are pinned with a hand-written recommendation until the member has read them, and each account also gets a private local library, collections, a weekly digest and version diffs.
description.zh: 团队共享知识库：一个人在自己电脑跑零依赖 Hub，其他人装插件后粘一个邀请码即可加入。上传素材按十类归档，带摘要、置信度与要点；15 个 agent 工具支持上传、检索、聚合回顾、评论与阅读。标为重要的资料必须手写推荐语，并置顶到每位成员读过为止；每个账号还各有本地私有库、收藏夹、每周简报与版本对比。

description.en: Paste a Douyin video link (easy to copy from the Douyin PC app) and the plugin downloads the video, transcribes the speech offline into timed Chinese text, and imports it into Obsidian as a Markdown note. Built for DeepSeek Harness and for beginners building a personal knowledge base. Needs Python 3.10+ with playwright (it drives Edge), PyAV, sherpa-onnx and numpy installed, plus a SenseVoice model placed under %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\douyin-kb\models.
description.zh: 一个简单的人工提供抖音链接（可通过抖音PC客户端获得），由本插件自动将视频内容转化文字记录，并自动导入到Obsidian中，适用于harness、个人知识库搭建初学者上手。需要安装 Python 3.10+ 以及 playwright（驱动 Edge）、PyAV、sherpa-onnx 和 numpy，并把 SenseVoice 模型放到 %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\douyin-kb\models。

description.en: Turns declared health readings — source, criterion, verdict — into one read-only verdict; an unreadable source is reported as `unknown`, never as healthy.
description.zh: 把声明式的健康读数（来源、判据、结论）合成为一个只读的总判定；读不到的来源报 `unknown`，绝不报成健康。

description.en: Side panel for DeepSeek Harness that tracks a 15-ETF national-team basket intraday from Eastmoney and Tencent quotes (pure Node, zero dependencies): capital flow, minute-level support pulses and a composite read.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边面板：纯 Node 直取东财与腾讯行情，盘中跟踪 15 只国家队 ETF 篮子，含资金流、分时护盘脉冲与综合判读。

description.en: XMUM Moodle in the sidebar: courses grouped by term, a schedule merged from the calendar, assignment and quiz deadlines and dated announcements, and batch downloads filed by term, course and material type. It signs in to the school Moodle (l.xmu.edu.my by default) with your campus ID and password, keeps only the resulting Moodle token in the DSH credential store, and its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 把 XMUM 的 Moodle 搬进侧边栏：课程按学期分组，日程合并日历、作业与测验截止时间以及带日期的公告，批量下载按学期、课程和资料类型归档。它用你的校园账号密码登录学校 Moodle（默认 l.xmu.edu.my），只把换到的 Moodle 令牌存进 DSH 凭据库；它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: A-share assistant: 19 tools for quotes, K-line, screening, sentiment and backtests, plus a manual trade ledger, a sidebar panel, daily archive snapshots and risk-alert email. No broker connection or order placement.
description.zh: A 股助手：19 个行情/选股/舆情/回测工具，外加手工交易台账、右栏面板、每日存档与高风险邮件提醒；不接券商、不下单。

description.en: Real-time Codex/Claude/Antigravity quota-reset alerts plus AIHOT news digest and agent tools. News comes from the AIHOT public API, which is free for personal non-commercial use only.
description.zh: Codex/Claude/Antigravity 额度重置实时推送，外加 AIHOT 资讯日报与 Agent 工具。新闻来自 AIHOT 公开 API，仅限个人非商业使用免费。

description.en: Per-workspace activation control: a dialog opened from the workspace row menu switches individual plugins, MCP servers, and skills on or off, and the host applies the choice in that workspace's own agent scope — a disabled skill leaves the model catalog, an MCP server has its mcp__<server>__ tools denied, and a plugin has the tool names its entry declares denied.
description.zh: 按工作区开关插件、MCP 服务器与 Skills：工作区行菜单里的弹窗写入选择，宿主机在该工作区自己的 Agent 作用域内应用——关闭的 Skill 从模型目录中消失，MCP 服务器被拒绝其 mcp__<server>__ 工具，插件被拒绝其条目声明的工具名。

description.en: Claim WorkBuddy (CodeBuddy CN / WorkBuddy global) daily check-in credits and benefit bonuses from a composer-dock card and an agent tool, using the official web OAuth login — no desktop client or third-party plugin needed. If another WorkBuddy plugin has already saved a login in ~/.dsh/workbuddy-vault, it reuses that login instead of asking you to sign in again.
description.zh: 输入框工具行卡片与 agent 工具一键领取 WorkBuddy 每日签到积分与福利积分；走官方网页 OAuth 登录，无需桌面客户端或第三方插件。若本机其他 WorkBuddy 插件已在 ~/.dsh/workbuddy-vault 里保存了登录态，会直接复用，不再让你重新授权。

description.en: A floating box that turns one line or a screenshot into a Markdown file in your workspace.
description.zh: 界面里一颗灯泡：写一句话或拖一张截图，回车就存成工作区里的 Markdown 文件。

description.en: Embeds a private local Sub2API gateway (Sub2API + PostgreSQL + Redis via Docker) into the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with automatic local login. Windows only, with Docker Desktop and its WSL2 backend already installed; the first start pulls about 250 MB of images and needs local ports 18080 and 18081 free.
description.zh: 把一套本机私有的 Sub2API 网关（Sub2API + PostgreSQL + Redis，Docker 方式）内嵌到 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏，并自动本地登录。仅限 Windows，需已装好 Docker Desktop 与 WSL2 后端；首次启动要从 Docker Hub 拉取约 250 MB 镜像，并占用本机 18080、18081 端口。

description.en: Cross-session artifact center: agent tools that register deliverable files (PDF, Excel, PPT, code, JSON) into one shared directory, plus a sidebar panel that filters them by category, extension or keyword.
description.zh: 跨会话产物中心：agent 产出重要文件时用工具登记（默认复制一份到统一目录），侧边栏面板按分类、后缀或关键词即时筛选。

description.en: Audits JLCEDA (EasyEDA) .enet netlists for broken net labels, dangling nets, power-rail orphans, conflicting pin polarity, and full-differential-amplifier feedback wiring.
description.zh: 校对嘉立创 EDA 导出的 .enet 网表，检查断链式网络标签、单脚悬空网络、电源轨孤立、引脚名与所连网络极性矛盾、全差分运放反馈接法。

description.en: Gowin (高云) 1.9 FPGA toolchain control for dsh: 15 tools covering environment and license probe, .gprj/.cst project and constraint auditing against a real GW1N board pinout, gw_sh batch synthesis and place-and-route, pnr resource and timing report parsing, programmer_cli JTAG scan and flash, arbitrary gw_sh Tcl, and the GAO on-line logic analyzer capture chain — plus a bundled gowin-fpga skill and three field-note references. Pure JS, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把高云 Gowin 1.9 FPGA 工具链交给 dsh：15 个工具覆盖环境与 License 探针、.gprj/.cst 工程与约束审计（对着真实 GW1N 板引脚表）、gw_sh 批量综合与布局布线、pnr 资源与时序报告解析、programmer_cli 扫描与烧录、任意 gw_sh Tcl 执行，以及 GAO 在线逻辑分析采集链路；另附内置 gowin-fpga 技能与三份实测手册。纯 JS，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Deterministic Reasoning Engine (DRE) for dsh: dre__* tools for knowledge verification (three-stage discrimination), deterministic cognition loops, constraint solving, mental models and synapse memory - strengthens information certainty.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供确定性推理引擎（DRE）：dre__* 工具覆盖知识验证（三段甄别）、确定性认知闭环、约束求解、心智模型与突触记忆，强化信息确定能力。

description.en: Knowledge base (Vault memory + knowledge graph) for dsh: kb__* tools for deterministic memory search/write, knowledge-graph nodes/edges/subgraph/traversal, document-to-graph ingestion and unified cross-store query (KAL) - no web-search tools.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供知识库（Vault 记忆 + 知识图谱）：kb__* 工具覆盖确定性记忆检索/写入、知识图谱节点/边/子图/遍历、文档入图谱与跨存储统一查询（KAL），不含联网检索工具。

description.en: Local Kingdee Cloud (金蝶云星空) business portal for DeepSeek Harness: open the operations dashboard in the sidebar with your own Kingdee account; data stays on your machine. Needs Python 3.10+ with Flask and requests (pip install -r requirements.txt) and a local clone of this repo linked into the profile; verified on Windows with DSH Desktop only.
description.zh: 本地金蝶云星空经营门户 DSH 插件：用本人金蝶账号在侧栏打开经营看板，数据不出本机。需 Python 3.10+ 及 Flask、requests（pip install -r requirements.txt），并把本仓库克隆到本地后 link 进 profile；仅在 Windows + DSH 桌面版上验证过。

description.en: Chemical safety intelligence through the hosted MSDS Chain MCP endpoint: 23 tools for compatibility and mixing order, GHS hazards, PPE, storage, waste disposal, exposure limits, transport classification, multi-region regulatory compliance, SDS lookup and version diffs, and signed audit reports, each answer citing the supplier SDS and revision date it is grounded in.
description.zh: 通过托管的 MSDS Chain MCP 端点接入化学品安全数据：23 个工具覆盖相容性与投料顺序、GHS 危害、PPE、储存、废弃处置、职业接触限值、运输分类、多法域合规、SDS 查询与版本比对、签名审计报告；每条回答都标注其依据的供应商 SDS 与版本日期。

description.en: Wires the local cc-computer-use MCP server into DSH with one process per root session, giving each session its own Xephyr sandbox screen and private AT-SPI bus (requires the cc-computer-use MCP server).
description.zh: 把本地 cc-computer-use MCP server 接入 DSH：每个根会话各起一个进程，各自拥有独立的 Xephyr 沙箱屏与私有 AT-SPI 总线（需已安装 cc-computer-use MCP server）。

description.en: Decides which MCP server tools each workspace can see, keyed by the session working directory; workspaces without a policy see none.
description.zh: 按工作区（会话 cwd）决定哪些 MCP 服务器的工具可见；未配置的工作区默认一个都不显示。

description.en: Adds a Tavily search provider to the DSH web search seam, keyless by default so it works without an account or API key.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的网页搜索接缝接上 Tavily，默认免注册、免 API key。

description.en: Master Duel utility panel for DSH: card lookup with banlist filters and AI-assisted effect search, related cards, rarity badges, favorites, a deck builder with drag-and-drop and a collapsible favorites panel, engine-tested opening hands and hand_odds opening probabilities, deck-type rankings, and deck checking. Card images and text are fetched from third-party sources at runtime; the plugin bundles no card data and requires the separate master-duel-ai-advisor MCP server.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Master Duel 工具面板：带禁限筛选和 AI 智能查卡的查卡、相关卡片、稀有度徽章、收藏与构建拖放、可收放收藏栏、规则引擎先手实测与 hand_odds 起手概率、卡组类型排行、卡组检查。卡图与卡文在运行时从第三方来源获取，插件不打包卡牌数据；需要单独安装 master-duel-ai-advisor MCP。

description.en: Runs OpenCode as a DSH subagent over ACP and shows each task live in the right sidebar — its agent and model, tool calls, and the subagents OpenCode spawns itself; permission requests become DSH question cards with allow once, allow always or reject.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 把 OpenCode 作为 DSH 子智能体运行，并在右侧边栏实时展示它的 agent 与模型、工具调用和它自己派生的子 agent；权限请求会变成 DSH 问题卡片，可选允许一次、始终允许或拒绝。

description.en: Import Claude Code, Codex, WorkBuddy, Cursor and Trae conversation history into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, with readable titles and one workspace per source.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code、Codex、WorkBuddy、Cursor、Trae 的历史对话导入 DeepSeek Harness 成可续聊的会话，自动起可读标题，每个来源一个工作区。

description.en: Local file upload: paperclip button and drag-and-drop, per-session storage under .dsh-uploads, and a read_document tool that pages text and OCRs images.
description.zh: 本地文件上传：回形针按钮与拖拽上传、按会话隔离存储到 .dsh-uploads，并提供 read_document 工具分页读文本、对图片 OCR。

description.en: A manual screenshot button for the DeepSeek Harness composer that captures a screen region and sends it to the model as an image attachment. Windows only.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加一个手动截图按钮：框选屏幕区域后自动作为图片附件发给模型。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: arXiv paper survey assistant with a settings-page UI, a local knowledge base, a feedback loop, keyword search plus optional local-embedding semantic search, and per-paper deep-read notes. Requires a configured DSH LLM provider; semantic search and full-text deep read need an optional Python environment (pymupdf + fastembed), otherwise they fall back to keyword search or are skipped.
description.zh: arXiv 论文调研助手：设置页图形界面、本地知识库、反馈循环、关键词检索与可选的本地向量语义检索，以及逐篇深读笔记。需已配置 DSH 的 LLM 提供商；语义检索与全文深读另需可选的 Python 环境（pymupdf + fastembed），没有时语义检索退回关键词、深读跳过。

description.en: In-process ChatGPT Codex authorization, model discovery, and quota display for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内直连 ChatGPT Codex，管理授权、模型同步和额度显示，无需本地代理进程。

description.en: Optional Decision API tool discovery and search-source prefetch, with per-session controls and ordinary-discovery fallback.
description.zh: 可选 Decision API 工具预发现与搜索来源预读，支持会话开关和普通按需发现回退。

description.en: Local ComfyUI image generation for DeepSeek Harness — discovers or starts the ComfyUI installed on the machine, generates a text-to-image result from a chat request, and attaches it to the conversation.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 用本机 ComfyUI 真正生图——自动查找或启动本地服务，在对话里完成文生图并附图。

description.en: Windows-only (Windows 10/11 with PowerShell/WMI) process manager for DeepSeek Harness: monitor child process trees, detect lingering orphan services, diagnose plugin/command attribution, and kill process trees to release file and port locks; DSH core processes are protected.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows 10/11（依赖 PowerShell/WMI）的 DeepSeek Harness 进程管理：监控子进程树与残留孤儿服务，诊断插件/命令归属，终止进程树以释放文件与端口占用；DSH 核心进程受保护。

description.en: Local Qimen business-timing workbench for DeepSeek Harness, with nine palaces, deterministic scoring, future-window ranking, and direction advice.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中本地完成奇门排盘、商务评分、未来择时和方位建议。

description.en: Generate a persona appearance image from hair, outfit, accessory and expression text, then save it to a local gallery. Works with any OpenAI-compatible images API and also reports the composed prompt and backend status. Needs an images API key: it defaults to SiliconFlow (Qwen/Qwen-Image) and you set baseUrl, model and apiKey in the plugin config.
description.zh: 换装生图：按发色、服装、配件、表情生成人物形象图并存进本地画廊。对接任意 OpenAI 兼容的图片接口，同时能查到拼好的提示词与后端状态。需要图片接口的 API Key：默认走硅基流动（Qwen/Qwen-Image），在插件配置里填 baseUrl、model 与 apiKey。

description.en: Bilibili companion for DSH, derived from c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll (do not install both: they share the plugin entry id bili-scroll). Understand any video with AI summaries, chapters and subtitles; make your own with edge-tts voice-over, captions and ffmpeg; publish, post dynamics, reply to fans and read creator stats (publishing and dynamics stay off until Creator mode is enabled); plus an optional daily curated feed report. First run needs a one-time in-app install of Python dependencies (a uv venv plus PyPI packages such as bili-agent and edge-tts) and a Bilibili QR login.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 B 站搭档，衍生自 c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll（两者共用插件条目 id bili-scroll，不能同装）：看懂视频（AI 总结 / 章节 / 字幕），自己做视频（edge-tts 配音 + 字幕 + ffmpeg 合成），投稿、发动态、回粉丝、看创作数据（投稿与发动态须先打开「创作者模式」，默认关闭），另有可选的每日精选日报值班轮。首次使用需在设置页一键安装 Python 依赖（uv 虚拟环境 + PyPI 上的 bili-agent、edge-tts 等）并扫码登录 B 站。

description.en: Indexes the current workspace into a relation graph and exposes one agent tool, codegraph_explore, for reachability, callers, and impact, plus a Web sidebar graph pane.
description.zh: 将当前工作区索引为关系图，向 agent 暴露一个工具 codegraph_explore（可达性、调用者、影响面），并在 Web 右侧栏提供图形面板。

description.en: Wraps the separately installed agent-desktop CLI (`npm i -g agent-desktop`) as nine DSH tools (ad_status, ad_list_windows, ad_snapshot, ad_find, ad_click, ad_type, ad_press, ad_launch, ad_close_app) so an agent can list windows, read an accessibility tree, click a snapshot ref, type text, send keys, launch an app and close it gracefully. The plugin adds no automation logic of its own: it validates arguments, calls the CLI and returns the parsed JSON envelope, and asks the caller to take a fresh snapshot instead of retrying a stale ref, so a click never lands on a shifted target.
description.zh: 把需另行安装的 agent-desktop CLI（`npm i -g agent-desktop`）封装成 9 个 DSH 工具（ad_status、ad_list_windows、ad_snapshot、ad_find、ad_click、ad_type、ad_press、ad_launch、ad_close_app），让 Agent 直接列窗口、读无障碍树、按快照 ref 点击、输入文本、发送按键、启动与优雅关闭应用。插件本身不含自动化逻辑，只做参数校验、调用 CLI、解析 JSON 信封；ref 过期时要求调用方重新快照，不自动重试，避免误点。

description.en: Offline Chinese-English and English-Chinese dictionary with monolingual glosses, grouped related words, prosody analysis, and a public-domain Chinese/English literary corpus exposed to agents.
description.zh: 离线汉英/英汉词典：含汉语释义、英英释义、分组相关词与声律分析，并向 Agent 提供可检索的公有领域中英文文学语料库。

description.en: Dead-loop brake for DSH agent sessions: detects repeated identical tool calls, repeating call sequences, and duplicate text, then reminds the agent or refuses the call before it runs.
description.zh: DSH 会话死循环刹车器：检测重复的相同工具调用、循环的调用序列与重复文本，提醒 agent 或在执行前拒绝调用。

description.en: Drop-in web_search provider that follows the session's routed model: a runtime-editable priority chain with three wire dialects (Anthropic web search, OpenRouter online, Zhipu bigmodel), per-route endpoints and credentials, a Settings UI panel, local JSONL call audit, and built-in official fallback.
description.zh: 替换内置 web_search 的 provider：按会话当前路由的模型选择端点与凭据，运行时可编辑的优先级链支持 Anthropic web search、OpenRouter online、智谱 bigmodel 三种方言，设置 UI 面板可视化编辑，本地 JSONL 调用审计，链全失败回退内置官方方案。

description.en: Hao123-style AI navigation page: 95 verified entries across 8 categories, a search box matching names, aliases and pinyin initials, per-site in-site search, bookmark HTML import, a favicon proxy that keeps the page free of third-party requests, and an offline rules-based recommender that suggests a complementary tool stack for a stated need.
description.zh: 早期导航站风格的 AI 入口页：8 个分类共 95 个核验过的入口，搜索框支持名称、别名与拼音缩写，可跳到站点自带搜索，支持浏览器书签导入；图标走同源代理，页面不直连第三方；另有离线规则推荐，按一句话需求给出互补的工具组合。

description.en: One DSH tool that runs a command on any execution surface the machine has -- WSL, MSYS2, Git Bash, PowerShell, nushell, interpreters, throwaway containers, ssh, real terminal windows and a real console -- and reports the version each one gives and the capabilities it has.
description.zh: 把机器上的执行面收成一个 DSH 工具：WSL、MSYS2、Git Bash、PowerShell、nushell、各语言解释器、一次性容器、ssh、真实终端窗口与真实控制台；每个面报出自己能给的版本，并标出它具备的能力。

description.en: Manage Zuad digital signage programs, media, playback schedules, and devices through DeepSeek Harness. Requires an existing Zuad signage backend and an account on it; you sign in from the plugin settings and the password stays local.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek Harness 管理 Zuad 数字标牌节目、素材、播放排程和设备。需要已有 Zuad 信发系统后台及可用账号，在插件设置里登录，密码只保存在本地。

description.en: Daily check-in for MiYoushe (米游社) across six miHoYo games (mainland China servers only): Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, Zenless Zone Zero, Honkai Impact 3rd, Tears of Themis and Honkai Gakuen 2. QR-code login inside the plugin panel, per-game selection, a daily schedule with random jitter and startup catch-up, and four agent tools. Credentials stay on the local machine (mode 0600) and are never sent anywhere but the official miHoYo API.
description.zh: 米游社六个游戏每日签到（仅限国服：原神 / 崩坏：星穹铁道 / 绝区零 / 崩坏3 / 未定事件簿 / 崩坏学园2）：面板内扫码登录、按游戏勾选、每日定时（带随机延迟与启动补签），并提供四个 agent 工具。凭证仅存本机（0600），除官方接口外不会发往任何地方。

description.en: Model-classified tool compass for DeepSeek Harness: the agent sees functional categories and pulls specific tools on demand.
description.zh: 模型自动分类的工具罗盘：模型默认只看到功能类别，需要时检索并展开具体工具。

description.en: A fastfetch-style system and DSH panel: one slash command (/fastfetch or /ff) and one simple agent tool render OS, kernel, host, CPU, GPU, memory, every disk and local IP address, plus DSH version, model, session mode, plugin and skill counts into a colored terminal card, with a settings page that edits every field.
description.zh: fastfetch 风格的系统信息与 DSH 运行环境面板：/fastfetch 或 /ff 一条命令、一个简单的 Agent 工具，输出操作系统、内核、主机、CPU、显卡、内存、全部磁盘、本地 IP 地址，以及 DSH 版本、当前模型、会话模式、插件与技能数量，渲染成彩色终端卡片，所有字段都能在设置页里改。

description.en: Read Bilibili and Douyin from a session: WBI-signed Bilibili API calls behind one shared pacer (4 req/s, per-host cooldown after a 412) for video, feed, search, author, comments, danmaku and subtitles, plus Douyin hot list, video, feed and search rendered in a locally launched Edge over CDP.
description.zh: 会话内读 B站与抖音：B站走 WBI 签名接口，全部请求共用一个限速器（默认 4 请求/秒，吃 412 后按主机冷却），覆盖视频、热门、搜索、UP主、评论、弹幕、字幕；抖音则通过 CDP 驱动本机 Edge 渲染，读热榜、视频、推荐流与搜索。

description.en: Reads Claude Code and Codex plugin configurations to discover and preflight MCP servers and slash commands, with opt-in registration in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 读取 Claude Code 和 Codex 插件配置，发现并预检 MCP 服务器与斜杠命令，支持在 DeepSeek Harness 中按需启用注册。

description.en: An x_archive tool that turns an X (Twitter) post link into a permanent Markdown snapshot via the 2100laike archive service: images are re-hosted so they never break, snapshots survive post deletion, resubmits dedup-hit and return the latest version without spending quota, and refresh forces a refetch with a PAT. Needs the third-party 2100laike service; anonymous use is limited to 8 archives per day per plugin instance and a registered PAT raises that to 100 per day.
description.zh: x_archive 工具：把 X（Twitter）推文链接经 2100laike 存档服务转成永久 Markdown 快照——图片转存不裂链、删帖后仍可读、重复提交去重秒回不耗额度、带 PAT 可 refresh 强制重抓。依赖第三方 2100laike 存档服务；匿名使用每个插件实例每天限 8 次，注册后配置 PAT 可提升到每天 100 次。

description.en: Scans your Bilibili follow list, marks accounts that are closed or have posted neither a video nor a dynamic for a configurable number of days, and unfollows only the ones you confirm, skipping mutual follows and anyone who has streamed.
description.zh: 扫描 B站关注列表，标出已注销、以及视频和动态都超过设定天数没更新的账号；确认后才取关，并自动跳过互关和播过的主播。

description.en: Standing GitHub-first open-source check: a system-prompt section makes the agent extract 1-4 keywords on every new request and make one cached, rate-limit-aware github_search call, so the answer can list up to five reusable repositories with stars, language, license, last push and topics.
description.zh: 常驻的 GitHub 优先开源检索：系统提示词里常驻一节，让模型在每次新请求时先提取 1-4 个关键词，只发一次带缓存与限流保护的 github_search 请求，回答前列出最多五个可复用仓库及其星标、语言、许可证、最近推送与话题。

description.en: Gives the agent 14 tools to create and edit DingTalk Yida apps (apps, forms, pages, schema, data) through the OpenYida CLI, plus a right-sidebar workbench that opens them in the built-in browser.
description.zh: 通过 OpenYida CLI 给 Agent 14 个创建、修改钉钉宜搭应用（应用、表单、页面、Schema、数据）的工具，并在右侧栏工作台里用内置浏览器打开查看。

description.en: Adds an http_probe tool for endpoint health checks: status code, latency and key response headers, using HEAD with GET fallback; response bodies are never downloaded.
description.zh: 为 agent 增加 http_probe 工具：探测 HTTP(S) 端点的状态码、延迟与关键响应头，HEAD 被拒时自动降级 GET，不下载响应体。

description.en: Per-session switches for which tools a DSH conversation may call, plus a guest mode that keeps file tools inside the workspace and turns off shell and subagents.
description.zh: 按会话开关 DSH 工具，并提供让文件操作只落在工作区、同时关闭 shell 与子代理的访客模式。

description.en: Read-only QQ Mail over IMAP: list, search, and read messages; the settings page verifies the account before saving. Needs IMAP enabled on the mailbox and its 16-character authorization code (not the QQ password); the server is fixed to imap.qq.com.
description.zh: 通过 IMAP 只读访问 QQ 邮箱：列出、搜索、读取邮件；设置页在保存前会先验证账号。需要在邮箱里开启 IMAP，并使用 16 位授权码（不是 QQ 密码）；服务器固定为 imap.qq.com。

description.en: Sidebar developer toolbox with 65 pure browser-side tools in 13 groups — JSON, code formatting, URL, encoding, hashing, encryption, text, and number/date utilities — with zero network requests. Registers as a tab in dsh-better-sidebar, which must be installed for the panel to appear.
description.zh: 侧边栏开发者工具箱，内置 13 组共 65 个纯浏览器端工具，覆盖 JSON、代码格式化、URL、编码解码、哈希、加密、文本与数字日期处理，零网络请求；面板以页签形式挂在 dsh-better-sidebar 上，需先安装该插件。

description.en: Give it one URL and it traces the whole chain itself — DNS, reverse proxy, upstream, container, host and dependencies — then reports a root cause with evidence, so incident triage and routine operations run without anyone reciting where the machines or logs are. The chain comes from resource records it builds and keeps in your workspace; it is read-only by default and any change needs your explicit authorization.
description.zh: 给它一个 URL，它自己把整条链路查完——域名解析、反向代理、上游服务、容器、宿主机与依赖逐层核对，最后给出带证据的根因，让故障排查和日常运维不再依赖某个人记得机器和日志在哪。链路信息来自它在你的工作区里建立并维护的资源记录；默认只读，任何改动都需要你明确授权。

description.en: Qingshi diary and family-tree assistant: reads and writes career records, resolves relatives by kinship term, and drives the real H5 pages in a desktop window.
description.zh: 青史日记与族谱助手：读写生涯记录、按称谓倒推亲属关系，并在独立窗口里操作真实 H5 页面。

description.en: Folds the tool-definition prompt surface when many MCP servers are installed: a static KV-cache-stable catalog plus BM25/bge-m3 hybrid tools_search and batch tools_schema expansion, so hundreds of tools stay discoverable without spending their full schemas every turn.
description.zh: 装了大量 MCP 时折叠工具定义提示面：KV 缓存稳定的静态目录 + BM25/bge-m3 混合 tools_search + tools_schema 批量展开，几百个工具仍可检索，但不必每轮都付完整 schema 的 token。

description.en: Run the local Cursor CLI agent on a coding task in a workspace and continue the run by chat id.
description.zh: 把编码任务交给本机 Cursor CLI 代理在工作目录中执行，并可按 chat id 续跑。
