description.en: AList v3 file management: browse, search, upload (streamed and multipart), offline downloads, archive listing, task polling and control, plus admin tools for storages, users, roles, meta rules, settings, search index, shares and labels - 75 tools in total; every write goes through the approval flow and passwords are never read back.
description.zh: AList v3 文件管理插件：浏览、搜索、上传（本地文件流式与 multipart）、离线下载、压缩包查看、任务轮询与控制，以及存储、用户、角色、元数据、站点设置、搜索索引、分享、标签等管理端操作，共 75 个工具；全部写操作强制走审批，密码与 Token 只写不读。

description.en: Motion graphics from a dsh session through the Miran Fann engine over MCP, with a Miran settings page and motion-design skills. Requires the Miran Fann engine installed separately (npx miran-fann setup) and a signed-in install.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 调用 Miran Fann 引擎，在 dsh 会话里做动态图形，附带 Miran 设置页与动效设计技能。需单独安装 Miran Fann 引擎（npx miran-fann setup）并登录。

description.en: A `jev` tool that asks Jev (TypeSafe System One) typed yes/no, choice and score questions about one block of text and returns probabilities and confidence, with the provider and API key configured per user in Settings, a judgment ledger with its spend, and daily call and token caps.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加 `jev` 工具：就同一段文本向 Jev（TypeSafe System One）提出是/否、选择和评分问题，返回概率与置信度；provider 与 API key 在设置中按用户配置，并带判定账本、花费统计以及每日调用与 token 上限。

description.en: 9router-backed web search and fetch for DeepSeek Harness. Enabling the bundle automatically routes native web_search/web_fetch tools to 9router; disabling it restores the remaining provider configuration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 9router 网页搜索与抓取。启用插件包后自动接管原生 web_search/web_fetch，停用后恢复其余配置层的提供方选择。

description.en: Adds your own Recued server as an MCP server, so the agent can read your notes, tasks and the things you own and propose changes that wait for your approval in Recued.
description.zh: 把你自己搭建的 Recued 服务器接成 MCP 服务，让 agent 读取你的笔记、任务与物品，并提交需要你在 Recued 里确认的修改。

description.en: Mounts the hosted Reaudit MCP server (https://mcp.reaudit.io/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge with a REAUDIT_API_KEY bearer token: 238 mcp__reaudit__* tools for brand visibility in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews), competitor and citation analysis, site audits, content generation and social scheduling.
description.zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接挂载托管的 Reaudit MCP 服务（https://mcp.reaudit.io/mcp），用 REAUDIT_API_KEY 做 bearer 鉴权：238 个 mcp__reaudit__* 工具，覆盖品牌在 AI 回答里的可见度（ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Google AI Overviews）、竞品与引用分析、站点审计、内容生成与社媒排期。

description.en: Turn-level file undo for tool writes and edits: each file is snapshotted before the write lands, and the model (an undo tool), the human (a /undo command) or a button in the assistant message action row can roll back every file a turn changed. Snapshots are written in-process rather than by shelling out, so it needs no extra sandbox permission in sessions confined to workspace-write.
description.zh: 按轮次回退工具写入/编辑造成的文件改动：落盘前先快照，模型（undo 工具）、人（/undo 命令）或助手消息动作行里的按钮都能一次退回一整轮改动过的所有文件。快照在进程内写入、不 fork shell，因此在 workspace-write 这类受限会话里无需额外权限放宽。

description.en: A webfetch tool for full-text web/Toutiao articles: 3-tier strategy (direct fetch → resident Edge CDP headless browser → dump-dom fallback), with automatic Toutiao anti-bot challenge handling plus a bundled experience skill.
description.zh: 读网页/头条文章全文的 webfetch 工具：三级策略（直连 → Edge 常驻无头浏览器 CDP → dump-dom 兜底），自动识别头条反爬质询页，附 toutiao-reader 实战经验技能。

description.en: Nexterm fleet maintenance in a DSH session: 6 agent tools (auth with password/TOTP/device-code login, fleet listing, single-host exec, parallel batch exec, preset health checks, CPU/memory/disk monitoring) over the Nexterm REST API, plus a minimal settings page; no SSH private keys needed on the DSH machine.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中运维 Nexterm 托管的 SSH 机群：6 个 agent 工具（密码/TOTP/设备授权码登录认证、机群清单、单机执行、批量并行执行、预设健康检查、CPU/内存/磁盘监控），全走 Nexterm REST API，附极简设置页；DSH 机器上无需任何 SSH 私钥。

description.en: Computer Use for macOS desktop applications: reads any app's accessibility tree as text with element indices, then clicks, types, pastes, scrolls, drags, selects text and sets values through it, plus screenshots read back as images. Driven by a persistent JavaScript REPL — the agent gets two tools (`js`, `js_reset`) and calls an `sky` API inside them, so state survives between calls and the tool schema stays fixed as capabilities grow. Accessibility trees come back as diffs after the first read; actions address elements by index and indices from a stale read are refused rather than misapplied; typing waits for keyboard focus and reads the field back; paste restores the clipboard. Requires macOS 14.4+, Accessibility permission (Screen Recording only for screenshots) and Node 20+; ships a prebuilt native module, so nothing compiles at install time.
description.zh: macOS 桌面应用 Computer Use 插件：以文本读取任意应用的无障碍树与元素索引，并据此点击、输入、粘贴、滚动、拖拽、选择文本与赋值，截图可回传为图片。由常驻 JavaScript REPL 驱动——智能体只拿到两个工具（`js`、`js_reset`），在其中调用 `sky` API，因此状态跨调用保持、能力增长时工具 schema 保持稳定。无障碍树在首次读取后以 diff 返回；动作按索引寻址，过期索引会被拒绝而非错用；输入前等待键盘焦点并回读输入框；粘贴会恢复剪贴板。需 macOS 14.4+、辅助功能权限（截图另需屏幕录制）与 Node 20+；随包提供预编译原生模块，安装时不需编译。

description.en: Export diagram-design HTML diagrams to SVG/PNG, extract draw.io/Mermaid/Excalidraw structure, validate output, and browse 45 diagram types. Built on cathrynlavery/diagram-design (MIT); needs python3, and PNG export additionally needs Playwright.
description.zh: 将 diagram-design 图表导出为 SVG/PNG，提取 draw.io/Mermaid/Excalidraw 结构，校验输出，并浏览 45 种图表类型。基于 cathrynlavery/diagram-design（MIT），需 python3，导出 PNG 还需 Playwright。

description.en: Companion sidebar panel for the Kaipu site plugin: shows the built-in advisory team and seat status. Install together with kaipu-platform — seat data comes from the site plugin's gateway endpoints; a standalone install honestly reports "channel not ready". Removable: uninstall it and the site plugin stays fully usable.
description.zh: 山海·开铺 智囊团插件：配套侧边面板，展示内置谋士团队与席位状态。需与 kaipu-platform 一起安装——灯位数据由开铺插件经网关提供，单独安装会如实显示「通道未就绪」。可摘除：卸掉它，开铺仍完整可用。

description.en: Pulls the bookmarks of X, YouTube, Reddit, Bilibili, Zhihu and Xiaohongshu into one DeepSeek Harness panel: a daily three-item review page, filters by platform, folder and role, and one-click export to Obsidian, Reminders or Calendar. Collection runs through the opencli browser extension, so it needs Chrome with that extension installed and logged in.
description.zh: 把 X、YouTube、Reddit、B 站、知乎、小红书的收藏汇总到一个 DeepSeek Harness 面板：每天三条待读、按平台 / 收藏夹 / 角色筛选，一键导出到 Obsidian、提醒事项或日历。采集走 opencli 的浏览器扩展，需要 Chrome 装好扩展并登录这几个站。

description.en: MCP server manager for DSH: nine mcp_manager_* tools, a CLI and a web panel that list, validate, probe, add, edit, enable/disable and remove servers in ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml, search and install servers from the official MCP Registry, and locate or rotate stored credentials.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 服务器管理器：九个 mcp_manager_* 工具、命令行与网页面板，可列出、校验、探测、新增、编辑、启停、移除 ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml 中的服务器，从官方 MCP Registry 搜索并安装服务器，以及定位或轮换已存凭据。

description.en: Economic indicator lookup via World Bank open data (GDP, inflation, trade, population), no API key required.
description.zh: 世界银行开放数据经济指标查询：GDP、通胀、贸易、人口等，无需 API 密钥。

description.en: TransProof translation proofreader for DeepSeek Harness: full web UI (AI translation needs your own model API key or a local Ollama endpoint) plus a local, non-networked run-local-check agent tool.
description.zh: 译校助手 TransProof 的 DSH 插件：内置完整网页界面，支持 AI 翻译（需自备模型 API Key 或本地 Ollama 端点）、三段流水线校对、术语与专名核验、批量体检改错与一键交付报告；网页版与插件内置同一套界面，另提供一个不联网、不调模型的本地体检 Agent 工具。

description.en: Lets a DSH agent ask the user a structured question without blocking the turn: the ask_interactive_question tool returns a pending batch id at once, the answer arrives later as an ordinary user message, and pending batches sit in a browser inbox panel with optional system notifications.
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 提问而不阻塞回合：ask_interactive_question 工具立刻返回待答批次号，答案稍后以普通用户消息送回会话，待答批次显示在浏览器内的待答面板，可选系统通知。

description.en: Offline A-share checkups as four agent tools: valuation percentile (PE/PB/PS history, with negative-PE exclusion for loss-makers and a sample-length floor) and financial-statement review (three-statement reconciliation, DuPont decomposition, red flags, peer percentiles). Bring your own data; the plugin never fetches quotes and ships no data source. Needs Python 3.8 or later (standard library only).
description.zh: 把 A 股估值分位体检与个股财务体检做成 4 个可直接调用的工具：估值分位（PE/PB/PS 历史序列，亏损股负 PE 剔除、样本量门槛、周期股切 PB）与三表体检（勾稽校验、杜邦拆解、造假红旗、同业分位）。数据由调用方自带，本插件不取行情、不自带数据源。需要 Python 3.8 及以上（只用标准库）。

description.en: InfluxDB 2.x client for DeepSeek Harness: six agent tools and a side panel run Flux queries, inspect schemas and buckets, manage connections, and write line protocol.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 InfluxDB 2.x 插件：6 个智能体工具加一个侧边面板，可执行 Flux 查询、查看 schema 与 bucket、管理连接、写入 line protocol。

description.en: Percent-progress scoreboard docked below the todo pill: tracking_write rows with evidence-bound percents, host-captured git checkpoints with before/after deltas, and pursue/align/dismiss actions that reach the agent as instructions.
description.zh: todo 胶囊下方的进度记分板：百分比行必须带工件证据，检查点由宿主抓取 git 状态，pursue/align/dismiss 直接送达 agent 下一步。

description.en: Runs a shell command on your machine from the chat box with !cmd or /sh cmd, without sending a model request. The output comes back as your message plus a terminal card with the exit code, run time and a Copy button. While a ! line is typed, a menu offers zsh completions from your own fpath and matching commands from your shell history. Commands run as a login shell in the session folder, outside the agent sandbox, with a 120 s default timeout.
description.zh: 在聊天框用 !命令 或 /sh 命令 直接在本机运行 shell 命令，不发起模型请求。输出以你的消息加一张终端卡片显示，含退出码、耗时和复制按钮。输入 ! 行时弹出菜单，提供基于你自己 fpath 的 zsh 补全和 shell 历史中的匹配命令。命令以登录 shell 在会话目录中运行，不经过 agent 沙箱，默认超时 120 秒。

description.en: Windows-only sidebar panel that watches the CPU and IO of your AI desktop apps' process trees and shuts the machine down once all of them have been idle for a configurable time, with a cancellable countdown, a dry-run mode and an activity log; requires Python 3.10+.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 的右侧栏面板：按整棵进程树的 CPU / IO 判断 AI 桌面工具是否还在工作，全部安静指定分钟数后关机，带可取消倒计时、演练模式与活动记录；需要本机 Python 3.10+。

description.en: Generates 3Blue1Brown-style Manim animations to explain answers, with a right-column gallery and inline multi-modal file publishing.
description.zh: 调用 3Blue1Brown Manim 现做动画直观解释回答，配有右侧抽屉栏动画库及对话流多模态文件发布卡片。

description.en: Writing council: parallel multi-model drafting, judge consensus & critique synthesis, AI prompt refinement, visual concept illustration, and Markdown file preview.
description.zh: 写作工作台：引入多模型针对同一命题独立盲写，追加主审裁判交叉评审与去糟取精，支持 AI 命题扩写、视觉总览配图与 Markdown 文件预览导出。

description.en: CCReach capability-search provider for DeepSeek Harness, letting agents discover data sources, tools, APIs, MCP servers, skills and workflows.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 检索 CCReach 能力目录（数据源、工具、API、MCP、技能与工作流）。

description.en: Windows desktop control for DeepSeek Harness agents: window and UI Automation automation, local Windows OCR, direct browser reads over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (DOM text, JavaScript, selector clicks), humanised mouse and keyboard input, browser tab management, and a live control panel. It probes the machine on first run, writes its own config, and degrades gracefully when a capability is missing. Windows 10/11 only.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体用的 Windows 桌面控制：窗口与 UI Automation 自动化、本地 Windows OCR、通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直读浏览器 DOM 并执行 JS、拟人化鼠标键盘、浏览器标签页管理，以及一个实时控制面板。首次启动自动探测本机能力并写入配置，缺失的能力自动降级而非报错。仅支持 Windows 10/11。

description.en: Prevents macOS idle sleep while DSH Desktop is active, with configurable disabled periods.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 运行时阻止 macOS 空闲睡眠，支持自定义停用时段。

description.en: Code retrieval engine exposed as an MCP server: four tools (code_search, code_outline, code_index, index_status) over a SQLite FTS5 index with BM25 ranking, CJK bigram indexing, declaration-aware tree-sitter chunking, incremental reindexing, and a three-layer secret filter. The bigram index matches Chinese-language queries against English code, and the default path needs no vector store or embedding model. Requires a local Python 3.10-3.12 engine installed by scripts/install.sh, and CODERAG_ROOT set in the profile patch.
description.zh: 以 MCP 服务器形态提供的代码库检索引擎：四个工具（code_search、code_outline、code_index、index_status），底层是 SQLite FTS5 索引 + BM25 排序 + 中文 bigram 索引，tree-sitter 按声明边界分块、增量重建索引，并带三层密钥过滤。bigram 索引让中文提问也能命中英文代码，且默认路径不需要向量库或 embedding 模型。需要先用 scripts/install.sh 装好本机 Python 3.10–3.12 引擎，并在 profile patch 里设置 CODERAG_ROOT。

description.en: Windows desktop control with window-bound screenshots and accessibility state, text readback, DSH approvals, and activity overlays.
description.zh: Windows 桌面操作插件，提供绑定窗口的截图与无障碍状态、文本回读、DSH 审批和操作提示层。

description.en: Toggles the rea-mcp server on and off from the DSH Web UI session header or through the rea_mcp_toggle agent tool, so the 170 mcp__rea__* tool schemas stop being sent with every request while REA is off (the tools payload drops from about 722 KB to about 95 KB) and the REA child process exits; the choice is kept in a profile-scoped state file and restored at startup by a row-level disabled expression.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 会话标题栏或通过 rea_mcp_toggle 工具开关 rea-mcp 服务器：不用逆向时，170 个 mcp__rea__* 工具 schema 不再随每次请求发送（tools payload 由约 722 KB 降到约 95 KB），REA 子进程同时退出；选择存入 profile 级状态文件，重启后由行级 disabled 表达式恢复。

description.en: Turn Bilibili links into b23.tv short links with covers, with a tool, a /bili command, and a share-card panel.
description.zh: 把 B 站链接转成 b23.tv 短链并取封面，提供工具、/bili 命令和分享卡片面板。

description.en: Run Python on the local NVIDIA CUDA GPU from DeepSeek Harness: device status, foreground and detached jobs, durable logs, and a measured peak-VRAM figure per run.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接跑本地 NVIDIA CUDA GPU 的 Python 任务：设备状态、前台/后台作业、持久日志、每次运行实测的峰值显存。

description.en: Route every host-process undici fetch through a local HTTP(S) proxy while keeping localhost and China-reachable APIs direct.
description.zh: 把 Host 进程的 undici 请求统一路由到本地 HTTP(S) 代理，同时保持 localhost 与国内可达 API 直连。

description.en: Picks PTC or native tool presentation per task and switches it at runtime for the model or the user.
description.zh: 按任务自动选择 PTC 或标准工具呈现，并支持模型或用户在任务中随时切换。

description.en: Registers the MCP server built into DaVinci Resolve 21.1+ as an MCP server in DSH, so an agent can drive Resolve through its scripting API.
description.zh: 把 DaVinci Resolve 21.1+ 内置的 MCP 服务器注册进 DSH，让 agent 能通过 Resolve 的脚本 API 操作达芬奇。

description.en: Registers FilmLight's official FLAPI MCP assistant (flapi-dev-mcp) as an MCP server in DSH, so an agent can write and run Baselight / Daylight FLAPI scripts.
description.zh: 把 FilmLight 官方的 FLAPI MCP（flapi-dev-mcp）注册成 DSH 里的 MCP 服务器，让 agent 能编写并运行 Baselight / Daylight 的 FLAPI 脚本。

description.en: Requires Claude Code installed and signed in on this machine. Delegates coding tasks to the local Claude Code agent through the Claude Agent SDK, reports which files changed, supports one-command revert, and adds a Claude Mode toggle to the composer.
description.zh: 需本机已安装并登录 Claude Code。通过 Claude Agent SDK 把编码任务委派给本机 Claude Code，报告改动文件、支持一键回退，并在输入框旁提供「Claude 模式」开关。

description.en: Notes and todos as plain Markdown files in your workspace: type /ml plus a sentence to jot into today's journal; todos come in three flavors — deadline, sleep-until-a-date (auto-wakes when due), and anytime; /ml view fuzzy-opens any file with a few keystrokes. Zero tokens throughout — nothing goes through the model, and your notes stay ordinary local files that git and any editor can read.
description.zh: 把随手记和待办写进工作区的 Markdown 文件里：/ml 加一句话就记进当天日志；待办分三种——截止日、睡到某天自动唤醒、随时；/ml view 打几个字母就能模糊打开任意文件。全程零 token，不经过大模型；笔记就是普通的本地文件，git 和任何编辑器都能直接用。

description.en: Turn any SVG logo into a motion video inside DSH: an `animate_svg` tool renders a transparent 30fps assembly animation (parts fly in, or the whole mark settles) and synthesizes an MP4 with ffmpeg.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里把任意 SVG logo 变成动效视频：`animate_svg` 工具渲染透明背景 30fps 组装动画（零件飞入或整体落位），并用 ffmpeg 合成 MP4。

description.en: Search BOOTH for VRChat avatar assets — clothing, shaders, base models, accessories, textures, animations and props — from a dedicated BOOTH tab beside the conversation or via two read-only tools, with Chinese keywords translated to Japanese before the request.
description.zh: 在会话旁的 BOOTH 独立页或两个只读工具里搜 VRChat 素材（衣服、着色器、素体、配饰、贴图、动画、小物）；中文关键词在宿主侧转日文再检索，界面不出现日文词。

description.en: Attach files and folders in the composer via clipboard paste, a native file/folder picker, and @-mention path search; folders are converted to paged Markdown for the agent to read page by page. macOS only (clipboard and picker go through osascript).
description.zh: 在输入框附加文件和文件夹：剪贴板粘贴、原生文件/文件夹选择器、@-mention 路径搜索；文件夹转分页 Markdown 供智能体逐页读取。仅支持 macOS（剪贴板读取与选择器依赖 osascript）。

description.en: A-share research tools for DeepSeek Harness: stock search, real-time quotes, daily K-line, financials with TTM folding, valuation and Markdown research notes, using key-free public endpoints.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 A 股研究工具：个股检索、实时行情、日 K 线、含 TTM 折算的财报、估值测算与 Markdown 研报生成，数据源为免 API Key 的公开接口。

description.en: Gives the desktop agent one whole screen, or one half of a single screen. It lists windows whose center is inside, snapshots that rectangle, and left-clicks or replaces a control value. These tools do not move the system mouse, but the package also registers desktop_step, which drives the real mouse and keyboard across the whole virtual desktop (up to 20 actions per call, including key combinations such as Alt+F4 and typed text), plus get_screen_metrics; asking before acting is only in the tool description, not enforced. Windows only; compiles a C# helper with csc on first use; its tool names match dsh-desktop-tools-plugin, so do not enable both.
description.zh: 给桌面代理一整块屏幕，或单屏的半边。列出中心落在里面的窗口，截下这块矩形，并做左键或整段赋值。这几个工具不移动系统鼠标，但包里另外注册了 desktop_step：它会在整个虚拟桌面上操作真实的鼠标和键盘（每次最多 20 个动作，含 Alt+F4 之类组合键和键入文本），还有 get_screen_metrics；“先询问再执行”只写在工具描述里，并未强制。仅支持 Windows，首次使用会用 csc 编译一个 C# 辅助程序；工具名与 dsh-desktop-tools-plugin 相同，不要同时启用。

description.en: On-demand GitHub proxy for the Web UI: one-click git/SSH proxy toggle with connectivity tests.
description.zh: Web UI 按需 GitHub 代理：一键开关 git/SSH 代理并测试连通性。

description.en: IMAP mail triage and cleanup for DeepSeek Harness: incremental read-only scan, a hard-protection rule layer plus optional local-model classification, a Markdown report and a hashed manifest, an explicit approval card, and only then a move to the Trash mailbox — no expunge.
description.zh: IMAP 邮件分拣与清理：增量只读扫描，先过硬保护规则层、再走可选的本地模型分类，产出报告与带哈希的清单，人工批准后才移动到回收站——全程不 expunge。

description.en: Native macOS tools for DeepSeek Harness agents, with 21 local tools for notifications, clipboard, screenshots, speech, keep-awake, dark mode, Spotlight, Shortcuts, AppleScript and Safari tabs. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体的 21 个 macOS 原生工具，涵盖通知、剪贴板、截屏、朗读、防休眠、深色模式、Spotlight、快捷指令、AppleScript 与 Safari 标签页，零依赖。

description.en: Requires JDK 11+, the DM JDBC driver and SSH access to the target instance. Inspect Dameng database instances, assess security and recovery conditions, and generate filterable reports with shared evidence.
description.zh: 需 JDK 11+、达梦 JDBC 驱动与目标实例的 SSH 访问。巡检达梦数据库实例、评估安全与恢复条件，生成支持筛选和共享证据的报告。

description.en: Nine model-facing tools over the qBittorrent WebAPI v2, with confirm-gated mutations and an orphan-torrent diagnostic.
description.zh: 基于 qBittorrent WebAPI v2 的九个模型侧工具，写操作需显式 confirm，并提供孤儿种子诊断。

description.en: Windows-native computer use for DeepSeek Harness: two tools drive and read any desktop app. One batch call runs find, click, type, key, read, wait and screenshot steps in a single engine pass, so a task whose steps are known up front costs one model round trip; reading returns window text rather than an image, and input and capture prefer UI Automation patterns, Win32 messages and offscreen PrintWindow so the user's focus and pointer stay untouched.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 原生电脑操控：两个工具即可驱动并读取任意桌面应用。一次批量调用把找控件、点击、输入、按键、读取、等待、截图放进同一次引擎请求，步骤可事前确定的整件事只花一轮模型往返；读取返回窗口文本而非图像，输入与抓取优先走 UIA 模式、Win32 消息与 PrintWindow 离屏抓取，用户的焦点与鼠标全程不受打扰。

description.en: Forges a rough spoken request into a structured prompt, saves it as a /qp-<slug> slash command, and runs it again in one command — the slash command and the model-side quick_prompt tool share one local JSON library.
description.zh: 把一句口语需求炼化成结构化 Prompt，存成 /qp-<slug> 快捷命令，一键复跑；斜杠命令与模型侧 quick_prompt 工具共用一个本地 JSON 库。

description.en: Extract short-video scripts and captions from Douyin, Bilibili, Kuaishou and YouTube, including titles, authors, hashtags and engagement data, through a bundled Python extractor.
description.zh: 提取抖音、B站、快手与 YouTube 短视频的文案与字幕，并带标题、作者、话题与互动数据；抽取器以 Python 随包提供。

description.en: A DSH plugin that generates high-EQ reply suggestions based on chat context, with reasoning and strategy.
description.zh: 输入聊天上下文，生成 3 条高情商回复候选，附带判断依据和策略方向。

description.en: Pins a Chinese (zh-CN) thinking and answering constraint into the system prompt, and registers a per-step runtime reminder so the agent does not drift back to English after tool output. Zero runtime dependencies, single file; falls back to a second registration path and only logs a warning when the host API changes.
description.zh: 把「用中文思考和回答」钉进系统提示词，并每步注入一条运行时提醒，避免工具返回英文后语言漂移。零运行时依赖、单文件，带能力探测与降级注册，宿主 API 变更时仅记日志、不抛错。

description.en: Strips AI-flavor from LLM text with local density scanning and deterministic fact/strength/safety checks; a rewrite that fails verification falls back to the original.
description.zh: 把大模型生成的文本改成读起来像人写的：本地密度扫描 + 事实/强度/安全确定性校验，改写不达标自动回退原文。

description.en: Bridges the official COROS MCP server into DeepSeek Harness with a self-contained local stdio-to-HTTP bridge and on-device OAuth login, exposing 34 COROS tools on the current endpoint for sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, recovery, training load, activities and FIT files, plus workout and training-plan CRUD and scheduling.
description.zh: 把高驰（COROS）官方 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness：自包含的本机 stdio↔HTTP 桥 + 本机 OAuth 登录，在当前端点上提供 34 个工具，覆盖睡眠、HRV、静息心率、恢复、训练负荷、活动与 FIT 文件，以及训练课程与训练计划的增删改查和排期。

description.en: Author custom tools in Python from a web page, in chat, or from the dsh-go app's native panels, and register them as DSH tools without a restart; dangerous tools need built-in approval on every run, tools can be grouped into packs, and an optional unlock mode exposes them per conversation. Needs Python 3 on PATH.
description.zh: 用 Python 在网页、对话或 dsh-go 手机 App 的原生面板里编写自定义工具，保存后免重启注册成 DSH 工具；危险工具每次执行都走内置审批，工具可分组成包，还可选「解锁模式」按对话逐步放出。需 PATH 中有 Python 3。

description.en: Academic paper reading and citation manager for DeepSeek Harness: left-rail library, original-layout PDF reader, six citation styles, a Word bibliography append, and AI translation/summary/mind-map/term lookup. A derivative of jypjypjypjyp/dsh-paper-reader (now dsh-vibe-reading, MIT) that shares its default ~/.paper_reading work root — do not install both. Requires the dsh-better-sidebar plugin.
description.zh: 面向学生与研究者的论文阅读与引用管理器：左侧栏论文库、原样 PDF 阅读器、六种引用格式、Word 文末参考文献，以及 AI 翻译/概括/思维导图/术语。基于 jypjypjypjyp/dsh-paper-reader（现名 dsh-vibe-reading，MIT）扩展，默认共用 `~/.paper_reading` 工作目录——不要与上游同装。需先安装 dsh-better-sidebar 插件。

description.en: Per-project tool gating for the harness: before each step, the session looks for `.dsh/tool-gate.json` in its working directory and up to 32 parents, then filters the tool set handed to the model — allow or deny lists with `prefix*` wildcards, `off` when no rule file is found. A single `tool_gate_status` tool reports the active mode, rule file, and which tools were hidden.
description.zh: 按项目控制工具可见性：每一步装配前，会话从工作目录向上最多 32 层查找 `.dsh/tool-gate.json`，据此裁剪交给模型的工具集 —— 支持 allow / deny 名单与 `prefix*` 通配，找不到规则文件时为 off；另有 `tool_gate_status` 工具报告当前模式、规则文件来源与被隐藏的工具。

description.en: Quick notes: ⌘⇧N capture overlay, per-day timeline in local Markdown, multi-notebook.
description.zh: 随手记：⌘⇧N 速记浮层、按天时间线的本地 Markdown 日记，支持多笔记本。

description.en: Sidebar disk browser for DeepSeek Harness - browse any folder on the server (including hidden ones) with text preview, streaming download and upload (multi-select / drag-and-drop, overwrite confirm), responsive on desktop and mobile.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏磁盘文件浏览插件：浏览服务器任意目录（含隐藏文件夹），支持文本预览、流式下载与上传（多选/拖拽、同名确认覆盖），桌面与移动端响应式适配。

description.en: Annotates bash results whose exit code 1 is an answer rather than an error (grep with no match, diff with differences, false test) so the agent does not re-investigate them.
description.zh: 为 exit code 1 表示结果而非错误的 bash 输出（grep 无匹配、diff 有差异、test 为假）补充说明，避免 agent 反复排查。

description.en: Compile a video link into timestamped Markdown knowledge cards with back-links to the exact moment. Requires your own Python 3.10+ and yt-dlp (ffmpeg + faster-whisper only for videos without subtitles; Bilibili login cookies for members-only subtitles).
description.zh: 把视频链接编译成带时间戳、可回跳原片时刻的 Markdown 知识卡。需自备 Python 3.10+ 与 yt-dlp（无字幕视频另需 ffmpeg + faster-whisper，B 站会员字幕需登录 cookie）。

description.en: Domain-routed proxy for DSH fetch traffic: hosts on a force-proxy list always go through the proxy, every other host tries direct first and fails over to the proxy within a second, the first channel to answer is pinned for the session, connections are reused for 120 seconds, and each attempt is logged. Can also route pnpm/git subprocesses used by plugin installs.
description.zh: 按域名分流的 DSH 代理插件：列入「强制走代理」的域名（含子域名）永远走代理，其余域名先直连、1 秒内不通再换代理，先答上的通道在本会话定格，连接复用 120 秒，每次尝试都记录；可让插件安装用的 pnpm/git 子进程也走代理。

description.en: Bridge between DSH and the local WorkBuddy desktop app, in four parts: read, search and append WorkBuddy memory, skills, plans and daily logs; run tasks through the local CodeBuddy CLI with four permission profiles; drive the running WorkBuddy window over CDP (open a conversation, read its replies as sanitized rich HTML, type and send, switch the account-billed model, relaunch it with a debug port when it is missing); and a sidebar panel that puts that conversation surface inside DSH. 25 tools and 15 HTTP routes in one plugin.
description.zh: 把 DSH 与本机 WorkBuddy 桌面端接起来，分四块：读写与搜索 WorkBuddy 的记忆、技能、计划和日志；经本机 CodeBuddy CLI 跑任务，带四档权限；通过 CDP 驱动正在运行的 WorkBuddy 窗口（打开会话、以清洗后的富文本读取回复、代打字并发送、切换按账号计费的模型、端口缺失时带调试端口重启它）；再加一个侧栏面板，把同样的对话界面放进 DSH。一个插件里共 25 个工具、15 条 HTTP 路由。

description.en: Records an agent's short notes about what it browsed or thought, and lists them in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 把智能体浏览、干活时的碎碎念随手记下来，并在侧栏面板里按时间列出。

description.en: Keeps the /tmp cleanup daemon alive: an in-process watchdog revives it within about two minutes after Android kills it, runs the due cleanup inside dsh while it stays down, and adds a settings page for status, config, clean and dry-run. The cleaner ships inside the package (bin/tmp-clean, Python 3), so no extra install step is needed.
description.zh: 保证 /tmp 清理守护进程常驻：被 Android 杀掉后约 2 分钟内由 dsh 进程内看门狗复活，守护进程持续不在时由 dsh 自己兜底清理；设置页可看状态、改配置、立即清理或演练。清理工具随包自带（bin/tmp-clean，Python 3），装好即用。

description.en: Anime subscription manager for DeepSeek Harness: Bangumi metadata lookup, nyaa/dmhy torrent search, qBittorrent auto-download with RSS-based new-episode polling, local media-library dedup, and a calendar/progress sidebar GUI with 11 LLM tools (bangumi_lookup / bangumi_search / bangumi_subscribe / bangumi_unsubscribe / bangumi_list / bangumi_progress / bangumi_calendar / qb_status / qb_configure / qb_add_torrent / library_scan).
description.zh: DSH 追番订阅管理器：Bangumi 查番、nyaa/dmhy 搜种、qBittorrent 自动下载（RSS 判新轮询）、本地媒体库查重，附日历/进度侧边栏 GUI 与 11 个 LLM 工具（bangumi_lookup / bangumi_search / bangumi_subscribe / bangumi_unsubscribe / bangumi_list / bangumi_progress / bangumi_calendar / qb_status / qb_configure / qb_add_torrent / library_scan）。

description.en: Rolling-window batch scheduler for DeepSeek Harness subagents: one subagent_batch call carries a queue of independent subtasks plus a user-owned concurrency window, a settled child's slot is refilled immediately, and the call returns every child's final answer, stop reason and child id as one acceptance report. async mode keeps the pool running in the background for subagent_batch_status, and the window comes from config, DSH_SUBAGENT_BATCH_CONCURRENCY or a hardware recommendation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 子智能体的滚动窗口批量调度器：一次 subagent_batch 调用携带一队互相独立的子任务和由用户掌握的并发窗口，任一子智能体一结束就立刻补位，结束时把每个子智能体的最终回答、停止原因与子会话 id 作为一份验收报告一并返回。async 模式让整个池子在后台运行、用 subagent_batch_status 收取结果；并发窗口来自配置、DSH_SUBAGENT_BATCH_CONCURRENCY 或硬件推荐值。

description.en: Read, write, convert and retime a subtitle track across SRT, WebVTT and ASS, audit it for over-long or unreadable cues, and transcribe audio through a configured speech recogniser.
description.zh: 读写互转 SRT/WebVTT/ASS 三种字幕并校正时间轴，出片前体检过长或读不过来的 cue，还能用已配置的识别引擎把音视频转成字幕。

description.en: Renders GeoJSON payloads from session messages and file cards on an interactive Leaflet map with base-map switching and a feature property table.
description.zh: 将会话中的 GeoJSON 消息文本或文件卡片以 Leaflet 交互地图呈现，支持底图切换与要素属性表。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to AIyting's image generation MCP endpoint and registers four tools: aiyting_image_catalog (models, routes and specs), aiyting_image_settings (read, quote and save parameters), aiyting_image_generate (return a quote first, and submit only with an explicit credit ceiling) and aiyting_image_task (task lookup, waiting, and a local per-account ledger for unfinished jobs). A sidebar page signs in with an AIyting access key, shows points, today's usage and daily quota, logs out, and keeps per-conversation defaults for model, route, aspect ratio, resolution and count.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 AIyting 的生图 MCP 端点，注册四个工具：aiyting_image_catalog（模型、线路与规格）、aiyting_image_settings（读取、报价与保存参数）、aiyting_image_generate（先返回报价，只有显式给出点数上限才提交）、aiyting_image_task（任务查询、等待，以及按账号保存在本机的未完成任务台账）。侧栏页面用 AIyting 接入密钥登录，显示点数、今日用量与每日上限，可退出登录，并按对话保存模型、线路、比例、分辨率与张数的默认值。

description.en: Serial model orchestration: a delegate tool over a built-in catalog of current Chinese-market models (DeepSeek, GLM, Doubao, Hunyuan, MiniMax, MiMo, Kimi, Qwen, GPT). The main agent splits work, picks a model per subtask with a required reason, waits for each result, and falls back to a default model; every route is checked against the Session model-selection policy before a child starts. Needs Plugins → Subagent → Model selection enabled for the routes you want (new sessions only) and each model's provider configured. Uses the same plugin id as other model-router plugins, so install only one of them.
description.zh: 串行模型编排层：内置国内现役模型档案（DeepSeek、GLM、豆包、混元、MiniMax、MiMo、Kimi、千问、GPT）的 delegate 工具。主代理拆解任务、按子任务特征自选模型并必填选型理由、串行等待结果、宽松兜底到默认模型；每条路由都先经会话模型选择策略校验。需在「插件 → Subagent → Model selection」勾选要用的路由（仅对新会话生效）并配置好对应模型的 provider。与其他 model-router 插件的插件 id 相同，只装其中一个。

description.en: On Windows (PowerShell 5.1), snapshots whitelisted registry keys, hosts, user environment variables, services, firewall rules and scheduled tasks, diffs changes, and restores only registry, hosts and user environment variables.
description.zh: 仅 Windows（依赖 PowerShell 5.1）：改动系统前记录白名单注册表、hosts、用户环境变量、服务、防火墙和计划任务，可对比；只恢复注册表、hosts 和用户环境变量。

description.en: Lets the agent drive Windows by sight: Windows OCR turns on-screen text into clickable targets, then clicks, drags, scrolls, types and presses keys, verifying each action with a per-pixel diff and an OCR text delta; F6+F7 is a separate emergency stop.
description.zh: 让 Agent 看着屏幕操作 Windows：用 Windows OCR 把界面文字变成可点目标，再执行点击、拖动、滚轮、键入与按键，每步都用逐像素差分和文字增删复核；F6+F7 由独立进程急停。

description.en: Algorithm learning toolkit syncing Codeforces and AtCoder submissions, profiling weaknesses, generating AI training plans, and tracking spaced-repetition reviews across a 114-lesson algorithm curriculum.
description.zh: 算法学习工具：同步 Codeforces 与 AtCoder 提交记录，分析弱项画像， AI 生成训练计划，间隔复习排期，覆盖 114 课算法模板库。

description.en: Diet, workout and body-metric tracker for DeepSeek Harness: 12 agent tools log meals, sets, water and weigh-ins from plain chat, and a six-tab left-sidebar panel shows the day, the week, sodium/sugar intake, e1RM and the body-weight trend. Local SQLite only, no network, works without any persona plugin.
description.zh: 饮食 / 训练 / 身体记录：12 个工具在对话里记下吃了什么、练了什么、称了多少，左栏六页签面板看当天与本周、钠糖饮水、e1RM 和体重曲线。纯本地 SQLite，不联网，不依赖任何人设插件。

description.en: AnySearch-backed search tools for agents: general and vertical-domain search, parallel batch queries, vertical-domain capability discovery, and page-to-Markdown extraction, plus an API key panel in Settings. It registers its own tools instead of a web_search provider, so it cannot be installed alongside @anysearch/anysearch-dsh.
description.zh: 给 agent 用的 AnySearch 搜索工具：通用与垂直域搜索、并行批量查询、垂直域目录发现、网页转 Markdown，并在设置中提供 API Key 面板。它注册独立工具而非 web_search provider，不能与 @anysearch/anysearch-dsh 同时安装。

description.en: Windows NapCat deployment guide and read-only loopback port checks for DSH, with a user-initiated administrator launcher.
description.zh: Windows NapCat部署指南与本机端口只读检查，附用户手动运行的管理员启动入口。

description.en: Auto-switch DeepSeek models: routes every request to the vision model when images are present, to the pro model for complex tasks, and to the fast model otherwise; includes a switch_model tool for manual overrides.
description.zh: 自动切换 DeepSeek 模型：含图片时走视觉模型，复杂任务走 pro，常规任务走 fast；提供 switch_model 工具手动固定。

description.en: Recurring-habit scheduling from pure date math: next occurrence, range schedules, and overdue advice.
description.zh: 基于纯日期数学的周期习惯排程：下次发生日、区间排程与逾期提醒。

description.en: Panel for MCP servers registered by @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client: toggle each server on or off with live effect, see the registered tool count and estimated context-token cost of each server, and persist the choice to the home cordis.patch.yml with a timestamped backup before every write. The panel itself can sit either as a page inside Settings or as an icon row in the left sidebar, one seat at a time, with the switcher on the plugin page in Settings. Maintained fork of dsh-mcp-toggle.
description.zh: 面向 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 注册的 MCP 服务器的面板：逐个开关服务器（即时生效），显示各服务器的已注册工具数与预估上下文 token 开销，并将选择持久化到主目录 cordis.patch.yml，每次写入前保留带时间戳的备份。面板本身可以放在设置里作为一节，也可以放在左侧边栏作为一行图标，任一时刻只保留一个入口，切换器在「设置 → 插件」的插件页里。dsh-mcp-toggle 的维护分支。

description.en: DeepSeek Search API and Exa queried in parallel and merged into one URL-de-duplicated, cross-source-first web_search result list for DSH. Needs a DeepSeek and/or Exa API key (either alone works); it takes over the default web_search provider, and each query goes to every service you have a key for.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 搜索 API 与 Exa 并发查询，按 URL 去重合并成单份跨源优先的 web_search 结果列表。需要 DeepSeek 和/或 Exa 的 API 密钥（有一个即可）；会接管默认的 web_search 后端，每次查询发往你配了密钥的各家服务。

description.en: Adds /dev/dxg and /proc read-write grants to the DSH Landlock sandbox on WSL2, so CUDA is available inside a confined agent bash session.
description.zh: 为 WSL2 上的 DSH Landlock 沙箱追加 /dev/dxg 与 /proc 的读写授权，使受限的 agent bash 会话中也能使用 CUDA。

description.en: Windows only (binds user32.dll via koffi; inert on macOS/Linux). Remembers the DeepSeek Harness main window's size AND position: restores both on every launch (re-asserted during a grace period to beat the default layout), saves stable manual moves/resizes as the new lock, never records minimized/maximized/fullscreen states, never adopts the default rect DSH itself places the window at (so the app's own layout resets can never poison the lock), and stays on-screen when monitors change. Compatible with DSH 0.2.1-rc.3+.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows（用 koffi 绑定 user32.dll，macOS/Linux 上不生效）。记住 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口的尺寸与位置：启动时恢复上次的位置和大小，并在宽限期内反复断言以压过默认布局；手动移动或调整窗口后自动保存为新锁定；最小化/最大化/全屏状态不会被记录；DSH 自行放置的默认矩形永远不会被采纳，应用自身的布局重置无法污染锁定；更换显示器时自动防屏外。兼容 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3+。

description.en: Installs the codex-cua skill so DeepSeek Harness can use Codex computer use: drives Chrome and native macOS apps through the runtime bundled with the ChatGPT/Codex desktop app, ships a persistent session client and a doctor self-check. Requires the ChatGPT/Codex desktop app with its Chrome extension, Python 3.9+, and macOS.
description.zh: 安装 codex-cua 技能，让 DeepSeek Harness 使用 Codex computer use：通过 ChatGPT/Codex 桌面端自带的运行时操作 Chrome 与 macOS 原生应用，自带常驻会话客户端与 doctor 自检。需已装 ChatGPT/Codex 桌面端及 Chrome 扩展、Python 3.9+，仅 macOS。

description.en: In-app browser for DSH: a dedicated Chromium rooted at a persistent profile so a Feishu or SSO login survives restarts, driven over CDP, exposing seven agent tools (status, open, eval, read, feishu, screenshot, tabs) and mirroring the page live in a right-sidebar panel that tool calls open by themselves. Also converts Feishu documents to Markdown by sweeping their virtual scroll. Requires a locally installed Chrome, Edge, Chromium, or a Playwright Chromium build (it never downloads one); set DSH_IAB_CHROME to point at a specific binary.
description.zh: DSH 内置浏览器：独立 Chromium 配合持久化 profile，飞书或 SSO 登录一次跨重启有效，经 CDP 驱动，提供七个 Agent 工具（status、open、eval、read、feishu、screenshot、tabs），并把页面实时镜像到右侧栏面板——工具调用时面板会自动打开。另可按虚拟滚动回扫把飞书文档转成 Markdown。需本机已装 Chrome / Edge / Chromium 或 Playwright 的 Chromium 构建（不会自动下载）；可用 DSH_IAB_CHROME 指定可执行文件。

description.en: Browser automation connector: drives the local Edge or Chrome over the DevTools Protocol with zero runtime dependencies — launch a headless throwaway-profile browser or attach to one started with --remote-debugging-port, then navigate, read page text and interactive elements, click, type, and screenshot through 11 agent tools.
description.zh: 浏览器自动化连接器：用 DevTools 协议直接驱动本机 Edge/Chrome，零运行时依赖——可启动无头的一次性 profile 浏览器，也可接管用 --remote-debugging-port 启动的浏览器；通过 11 个工具完成打开页面、读取正文与可交互元素、点击、填表与截图。

description.en: Tavily-backed web search and page fetch for DeepSeek Harness: a Search provider, a Fetch provider with Tavily Extract, Firecrawl and direct HTTP modes, and a settings card. Needs a Tavily API key; Firecrawl is optional.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Tavily 网页搜索与页面抓取：包含 Search provider、支持 Tavily Extract/Firecrawl/本地 HTTP 的 Fetch provider，以及设置卡片。需要 Tavily API key，Firecrawl 可选。

description.en: Adds an element and region picker to the DSH Desktop built-in browser: hovering labels the element under the pointer, a click records that element, a drag records a rectangle, and each pick opens a small note box beside the pick. A batch is then inserted into the composer draft, never sent automatically, as one text block plus one attached crop per pick, so the user reviews and sends it themselves. Desktop only: the Web profile browser is an iframe, so the picker does not appear there.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版内置浏览器里加一个元素 / 区域选取层：悬停显示所指元素，点选记下元素、拖框记下矩形，每条当场在选取框旁弹小卡片写说明；整批会写成一段文字插进对话输入框，并把每条裁剪截图作为附件挂上，不会自动发送，检查、改完再自己按回车。仅桌面版可用：Web 版浏览器是 iframe，选取层不会出现。

description.en: DeepSeek account-backed web search and page fetching for DeepSeek Harness sessions whose chat model runs through a third-party subscription or gateway (for example OpenCode Go): registers deepseek-account-search and deepseek-account-fetch providers that call the official Search and Fetch APIs with the signed-in DeepSeek account token, so the built-in web_search and web_fetch keep working without a DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
description.zh: 为聊天模型走第三方订阅或网关（例如 OpenCode Go）的 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供基于已登录 DeepSeek 账号的网页搜索与抓取：注册 deepseek-account-search 和 deepseek-account-fetch 两个提供方，用账号 token 调用官方 Search / Fetch API，无需 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 也能让内置 web_search 与 web_fetch 继续可用。

description.en: Configuration bundle that connects Microsoft's official @playwright/mcp to your running Chrome through the Playwright extension, so the agent can drive your logged-in tabs. Install from a local copy: put your extension token in cordis.patch.yml first (with the token, connections skip the extension's approval prompt, so keep it private). Needs Node.js and the Playwright Chrome extension; the default command is the Windows form (cmd.exe /c npx), so change it to npx on macOS or Linux. It starts @playwright/mcp@latest through npx.
description.zh: 配置型插件：通过 Microsoft 官方 @playwright/mcp 与 Chrome 扩展，让智能体操作你已登录的浏览器标签页。请装本地副本：先把扩展的 token 填进 cordis.patch.yml（持有 token 时连接不再弹出扩展的批准提示，请勿外传）。需要 Node.js 和 Playwright Chrome 扩展；默认命令是 Windows 形式（cmd.exe /c npx），macOS / Linux 要改成 npx。启动时通过 npx 拉取并运行 @playwright/mcp@latest。

description.en: Self-managed persistent browser for DSH automation — launches its own Chrome/Edge profile, navigates, switches tabs, snapshots with semantic refs, acts by ref, evaluates JS, screenshots, and uploads files. Does not bypass CAPTCHAs by design.
description.zh: 自带浏览器的自动化插件：起自己的 Chrome/Edge 持久 profile，导航、切标签、语义快照、按 ref 操作、执行 JS、截图、塞文件。按设计不绕过验证码。

description.en: A configuration-only DSH bundle that connects the MCP server shipped with Scrapling to DeepSeek Harness over stdio, exposing its HTTP fetch and stealth-browser scraping tools for page extraction, browser actions, screenshots and network inspection. Requires Python 3.10+ with scrapling\[ai] (scrapling-mcp on PATH) and a Chromium-compatible browser (scrapling install).
description.zh: 纯配置型 DSH bundle，通过 stdio 把 Scrapling 自带的 MCP 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness，暴露其 HTTP 抓取与隐身浏览器抓取工具，用于页面提取、浏览器操作、截图与网络请求检查。需要 Python 3.10+ 装好 scrapling\[ai]（scrapling-mcp 在 PATH 上）以及 Chromium 兼容浏览器（scrapling install）。

description.en: Adds a sidebar button to the DSH Web UI that opens chat.deepseek.com in a standalone Chrome app window and focuses that window when it is already open (Windows).
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏加一个「网页版」按钮，用 Chrome 应用窗口打开 chat.deepseek.com；已经打开时改为聚焦置顶（仅 Windows）。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one baseURL/apiKey/model config powers Qwen Token Plan, OpenAI and any Responses API gateway.
description.zh: 基于 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 的通用联网搜索插件：配置 baseURL / API Key / 模型即可让内置 web_search 工具对接 Qwen Token Plan、OpenAI 等任意网关。

description.en: Exa search provider for the dsh-web seam: the web_search tool sends queries to Exa's /search API and returns the results as sources, in dsh web, dsh-TUI and headless runs. Needs an Exa API key (EXA_API_KEY, the credential store or a key file read on every search). web_fetch is unchanged and there is no UI.
description.zh: dsh-web 接缝的 Exa 搜索提供方：web_search 工具把查询发送到 Exa 的 /search API，并把结果作为来源返回，适用于 dsh web、dsh-TUI 和 headless 运行。需要 Exa API key（EXA_API_KEY、凭据存储，或每次搜索时读取的 key 文件）。web_fetch 不变，没有界面。

description.en: Real-browser automation for dsh via an MCP server (Playwright core): navigate, click, fill, type, screenshot, and act on accessibility snapshots with numbered references - all 22 web_* tools re-exposed to the harness over stdio.
description.zh: dsh 的真实浏览器自动化:基于 Playwright 的 MCP 服务,提供导航、点击、填写、输入、截图与带编号引用的无障碍快照操作,22 个 web_* 工具经 stdio 接入 Agent。

description.en: Controlled browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: the agent_browser tool and BrowserAutomationService drive a real Chromium or Chrome page (or an explicit CDP endpoint) through the agent-browser CLI, with allowedDomains containment and per-call output limits.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的受控浏览器自动化：agent_browser 工具与 BrowserAutomationService 通过 agent-browser CLI 驱动真实 Chromium / Chrome 页面（或指定 CDP 端点），支持 allowedDomains 域名收敛与单次调用输出上限。

description.en: An annotated browser tab: pages render in headless Chromium on the host and are served same-origin, so you can click an element or drag a region, write what should change, and send the notes into the conversation with selectors, visible text and rectangles. Requires a Chromium-based browser on the host (auto-detected, or set CHROME_PATH / browserExecutable). By default it provides the `browser` tab type itself; set `takeover: false` to keep the stock browser and use a hand-off button instead. Picking continues until you press Esc.
description.zh: 带标注的浏览器标签：页面在宿主用 headless Chromium 渲染并以同源方式提供，可以点选元素或框选区域，写下要改什么，把批注连同选择器、可见文本和位置一并发进对话。需主机装有 Chromium 系浏览器（自动探测，或用 CHROME_PATH / browserExecutable 指定）。默认由本插件提供 `browser` 标签类型；设 `takeover: false` 则保留内置浏览器、改用接力按钮。点选可连续进行，按 Esc 才退出。

description.en: Browser takeover for sign-in-gated sites: keeps a list of addresses that need a login (URL and date only, no credentials), answers before a visit whether an address is already on it, reports whether the debug browser is signed in there from the session-cookie names of that site (certain, likely, or not signed in — anonymous cookies such as _gh_sess never count), and opens saved addresses in that browser by navigating and clicking one element by its visible text, searching every iframe. One click per call, no crawling.
description.zh: 浏览器网址接管：维护一份「要登录的网址」清单（只存网址与添加时间，不存账号密码），访问前先回答这条地址在不在清单里；按该站点的会话 cookie 名字判断调试浏览器此刻是否已登录（确定／可能／未登录，_gh_sess 这类匿名 cookie 不计），在带调试端口的浏览器里打开清单中的地址，并按可见文字点击一个元素（会搜索所有 iframe）。一次调用最多点一个元素，不做批量爬取。

description.en: Fully background browser automation and browser use for DSH: an offscreen Electron window per conversation with real CDP input and screenshots, so headless-style browsing never steals focus or pops windows. Runs on Electron and keeps cookies in a persistent user-data directory, so a signed-in page stays signed in for later conversations.
description.zh: 完全后台静默运行的浏览器自动化：每个对话一个离屏浏览器窗口，提供真实 CDP 输入与截图，像 headless 一样工作却不抢焦点、不弹窗。基于 Electron 运行，cookie 保存在持久化的用户数据目录里，登录过的页面在之后的会话里仍保持登录。

description.en: Exposes Chrome DevTools Protocol to the agent through 17 tools for page summaries, element locators, activity timelines, console, network, storage and downloads, reading either a browser the plugin launches on its own or the tab the user is currently browsing through a small browser extension.
description.zh: 通过 17 个工具把 Chrome DevTools Protocol 接给 agent，提供页面概览、元素定位、操作时间线、控制台、网络、登录态与下载，读取对象可以是插件自带的专用浏览器，也可以经浏览器扩展读取你当前正在浏览的标签页。

description.en: Browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: agent-driven real-browser control (managed Chrome with an isolated persistent profile, or attach to your daily Chrome over CDP) with snapshot, click, fill and page-reading tools; records manual operation flows and replays them with variable slots to create test data on demand; ships 27 browser_* tools plus a Settings panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 真实浏览器自动化：agent 可直接驱动真实 Chrome（独立托管档案，或附加日常 Chrome/CDP），提供页面快照、点击、填表、读表与控制台/网络诊断工具；可将手动操作录制成流程并把输入标记为变量槽，按参数自动重放来批量造测试数据；附带 27 个 browser_* 工具与设置页控制面板。

description.en: Lets the agent drive the Chrome tab you @-mention — 13 tools for tabs, snapshots, clicking, typing, keys, scrolling, dragging and screenshots, with input sent as real CDP events so pages see isTrusted true and a pointer drawn inside the page. Needs the bundled Manifest V3 extension loaded by hand in Chrome (developer mode; it requests the debugger and all-URLs permissions), talks to it over a WebSocket on 127.0.0.1 ports 30795-30805, and saves screenshots under ~/.dsh/chrome-tab-shots; the macOS native input channel also needs Accessibility permission and the Xcode command-line tools.
description.zh: 用 @ 提及真实 Chrome 标签页直接读写——13 个工具覆盖标签页、快照、点击、输入、按键、滚动、拖拽与截图；输入以真实 CDP 事件投递，页面看到的 isTrusted 为真，并在页面内画出指针。需要在 Chrome 里手动加载随包的 Manifest V3 扩展（开发者模式，申请 debugger 与所有网址权限），通过 127.0.0.1 的 30795–30805 端口 WebSocket 与扩展通信，截图保存在 ~/.dsh/chrome-tab-shots；macOS 原生输入通道另需辅助功能权限和 Xcode 命令行工具。

description.en: Native headless and visible Chromium browser automation agent for DeepSeek Harness with DOM tree extraction, screenshot capture, and built-in SSRF protection.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生无头及可视化 Chromium 浏览器自动化插件：支持 DOM 树提取、网页截图捕获及内置 SSRF 安全防护。

description.en: Routes the built-in web_search tool to a self-hosted SearXNG instance and web_fetch to a self-hosted Firecrawl instance as DSH web providers, with a settings card for both backends.
description.zh: 把内置 web_search 的后端换成自托管的 SearXNG，把 web_fetch 换成自托管的 Firecrawl（作为 DSH 网页能力提供方注册），并提供两个后端的设置卡片。

description.en: Picks an element in the right-Sidebar browser and inserts its selector, computed style, and HTML into the chat draft as a chip you can remove one by one.
description.zh: 在右侧栏浏览器里拾取元素，把它的选择器、计算样式与 HTML 以可逐条删除的胶囊插入对话草稿。

description.en: Keyless web powers for any MCP client: web_search, JS-rendered web_extract over dual CDP Chrome with proxy failover, and 7 real-browser page_* tools in an isolated context.
description.zh: 免密钥上网 MCP server：web_search、基于双 CDP Chrome 的 JS 渲染抓取（代理自动互备），以及 7 个隔离上下文真实浏览器 page_* 工具。

description.en: Loopback relay as DSH's process-wide proxy route: web_fetch works under TUN fake-ip; a dead proxy gets same-request direct fallback, and a probe switches back.
description.zh: 把回环 HTTP 中继设为 DSH 的进程级代理路由，让 web_fetch 在 Mihomo/Clash TUN fake-ip 下正常出网；上游代理不可用时，同一请求内改走直连，1.5 秒探活发现代理恢复后自动切回。

description.en: Selection mode for HTML preview and browser tabs: click any element in a locally served demo page and its locator (selector, text, HTML snippet) is written into the chat input for precise AI editing.
description.zh: HTML 选区模式：点选本机 demo 页面中的任意元素，定位信息（选择器、文本、HTML 片段）自动写入对话输入框，供 AI 精准修改。

description.en: Adds a visible-browser Agent preset (persona and toolset for navigating, filling forms, clicking and screenshotting through the Playwright MCP toolset) plus a gate that refuses every browser tool call in other presets until the user approves that Session through the bundled browser_access tool. The bundle mounts the Playwright MCP provider itself, and both a settings page in the Plugins view and the browser_source tool switch the browser at runtime between Microsoft Edge (default), the Chromium shipped with Playwright, and a CDP endpoint. Requires keeping the shared browser-use registration row in the profile (one provider per process).
description.zh: 新增「浏览器操作」Agent 预设（基于 Playwright MCP 工具集的导航、填表、点击与截图规程），并加门禁：其他预设里的浏览器工具调用一律拒绝，直到用户通过内置的 browser_access 工具授权该会话。插件自带 Playwright MCP provider，插件页的设置页与 browser_source 工具都能在运行时把浏览器来源切换为 Microsoft Edge（默认）、Playwright 内置 Chromium 或 CDP 地址。需在 profile 里保留共享的 browser-use 注册表行（一个进程只能有一个 provider）。

description.en: Drives the Edge already open on your machine through a local WebSocket bridge and an unpacked MV3 extension: the agent reads the page as Markdown, dumps its interactive elements with stable refs, clicks and types with pre-action assertions and a three-valued effect state, and can capture pages from the extension popup as self-contained HTML snapshots, filed into a kb.py literature knowledge base when one is configured (kbRoot or DSH_KB_ROOT). Seven browser tools stay unregistered until edge_bridge is started, so an idle session pays no context cost.
description.zh: 通过本地 WebSocket 桥与一个免打包的 MV3 扩展，驱动你机器上已经开着的 Edge：agent 把页面读成 Markdown、转储带稳定 ref 的可交互元素、在动作前用 expect 断言目标再点击填表，回执带 committed/unknown/none 三值效果状态，还能在扩展弹窗里把页面抓成自包含的 HTML 快照，配置了带 kb.py 的文献知识库（kbRoot 或 DSH_KB_ROOT）时一并归档进去。七个浏览器工具要等 edge_bridge 启动后才注册，闲置会话不占上下文。

description.en: Drive a real Chrome and bundle the DOM, accessibility tree, HAR with response bodies, console logs, storage, screenshots, PDF and screencast into one self-contained evidence folder.
description.zh: 用真 Chrome 操控页面，并把 DOM/无障碍树/HAR+响应体/Console/存储/截图/PDF/录屏一键打包成证据目录。

description.en: Operate the Edge or Chrome window that is already open, without restarting it and without closing it: choose a window once, reuse a tab that already shows the URL, read page text or DOM state, click by accessible name or visible text, type, scroll, wait for content and batch steps. 22 tools over UI Automation, SendInput and an optional Tampermonkey bridge. Windows only.
description.zh: 操控已经打开的 Edge 或 Chrome 窗口，不重启也不关闭它：一次选定窗口、已打开的网址直接复用标签页、读页面文本或 DOM 状态、按可访问名或可见文字点击、输入、滚动、等待内容、多步合批。22 个工具，基于 UI Automation、SendInput 与可选的篡改猴桥。仅 Windows。

description.en: Drives the DSH right-sidebar built-in browser from the agent side with 38 tools (open, navigate, read page text and interactive elements, accessibility tree, click, fill, select, check, key press, scroll, resize the browser frame by dragging its corner, with the page inside reflowing responsively so a narrowed frame shows the mobile layout, screenshot, full-page screenshot, PDF, markdown export, scrape to JSON, download, cookies, per-step operation records with replay and action whitelisting), serves the built-in web_search from a self-hosted SearXNG over an SSH tunnel with Tavily and a real-browser fallback, and registers a fetch provider that retries blocked GitHub URLs through measured mirrors and sniffs charset from the response header so GBK and GB2312 pages decode correctly.
description.zh: 用 38 个工具从 agent 侧驱动 DSH 右推栏内置浏览器：打开、导航、读取页面正文与可交互元素、无障碍树、点击、填字、选下拉框、勾选、按键、滚动、拖动网页框边角改变大小，框内网页随之响应式重排，框宽收窄即呈现手机版布局、截图、整页截图、导出 PDF、导出 markdown、按选择器提取 JSON、下载文件、存取 Cookie，以及带序号的操作记录、重放与动作白名单。同时把内置 web_search 接到自建 SearXNG（经 SSH 隧道，Tavily 与真实浏览器作兜底），并注册抓取提供者：被墙的 GitHub 地址按实测可用的镜像顺序重试，并从响应头嗅探字符集，使 GBK 与 GB2312 页面正确解码。

description.en: Connect a webcam so the agent can see your face and the world outside.
description.zh: 接入摄像头，让大肥鱼看看你的样子和外面的世界。

description.en: Keeps a local sticker dictionary keyed by content hash so an image already described is recalled instead of re-read, and splits a GIF into evenly sampled frames laid out as one contact sheet so the whole animation is visible.
description.zh: 维护一本按内容哈希索引的本地表情包字典，看过的图直接复用描述而不再重复识图；同时把 GIF 均匀抽帧拼成一张联系表，让视觉模型看清整段动作。

description.en: Model-facing image-generation tool with a configurable channel and normalized image parameters.
description.zh: 面向模型的图像生成工具，提供可配置通道和标准化图像参数。

description.en: Eyes for text-only models: mounts the bundled stdio MCP server as mcp__opencode_eyes__describe_image, which sends an image file to StepFun step-3.7-flash and returns a detailed description.
description.zh: 给不具备多模态能力的模型一双眼睛:把随插件分发的 stdio MCP 服务器挂成 mcp__opencode_eyes__describe_image,把图片交给 StepFun step-3.7-flash 并返回详细描述。

description.en: Vision through NVIDIA NIM: mounts the bundled stdio MCP server as mcp__opencode_eyes_nvidia__describe_image, which describes an image with any of seven hosted vision models (MiniMax-M3 by default) and rotates several API keys.
description.zh: 走 NVIDIA NIM 的视觉能力:把随插件分发的 stdio MCP 服务器挂成 mcp__opencode_eyes_nvidia__describe_image,用 7 个托管视觉模型之一(默认 MiniMax-M3)描述图片,并支持多 Key 轮换。

description.en: Local OCR with nothing sent to a cloud: mounts the PP-OCRv6 Medium stdio MCP server (PaddleOCR on ONNX Runtime, CPU) as mcp__ppocr__ocr_image and mcp__ppocr__ocr_pdf for images and multi-page PDFs.
description.zh: 本地 OCR,不把文件发到云端:把 PP-OCRv6 Medium stdio MCP 服务器(PaddleOCR + ONNX Runtime CPU)挂成 mcp__ppocr__ocr_image 与 mcp__ppocr__ocr_pdf,识别图片和多页 PDF。

description.en: Give DSH text-only models vision: an image/OCR/document recognition skill (race pool → custom channels → local) plus an idempotent host patch so image messages reach the model.
description.zh: 为 DSH 纯文本模型补充视觉能力：识图技能（图片理解/OCR/文档解析，竞速池→自定义通道→本地）+ 幂等宿主补丁，让图片消息能送达模型侧。

description.en: Adds a right-column panel that compares a set of images the user picks from the workspace — 1/2/3/4/6 per page, per-image zoom and pan, the zoom and viewed position of one image synced onto the whole set, and a reorderable filmstrip. The browser loads every image, so none of it reaches the model.
description.zh: 在右栏新增一个面板，用来并排对比用户自己从工作区挑选的一组图片——每页 1/2/3/4/6 张、每张独立缩放与平移、可把某一张的缩放与显示位置同步到整组、缩略图可拖动排序。图片由浏览器直接加载，不进入模型。

description.en: Reads a video or audio file into metadata, sampled stills, subtitles and a multilingual speech transcript with speaker labels, captures the live desktop as frames or a recording, and installs its ffmpeg/whisper.cpp/sherpa-onnx toolchain on first use with per-file sha256 checks; all processing stays local. Automatic toolchain install and desktop capture currently support Windows x64 only, so elsewhere ffmpeg and model paths must be set manually.
description.zh: 读取视频与音频文件的元数据、关键帧、字幕和带说话人标签的多语种转写；把实时桌面抓成帧序列或视频；首次使用时自动安装 ffmpeg / whisper.cpp / sherpa-onnx 并按文件校验 sha256，全部处理都在本机完成。自动安装工具链与桌面捕获目前仅支持 Windows x64，其他平台需手动提供 ffmpeg 与模型路径。

description.en: Prove that a local image edit left every pixel outside its mask untouched. Original, generated and mask PNGs go in; a greppable `MASK_PIXEL_LOCK=PASS|FAIL|EMPTY` verdict, a difference heatmap, per-channel statistics, a bounding box and the largest changed pixels come out, plus a self-contained HTML report and `report.json` with a SHA-256 file hash, a canonical protected-pixel digest and a proof digest binding both to the policy. Supports edit and lock mask polarities, a mask threshold, tolerance and alpha-ignoring; PNG color types 0/2/3/4/6, bit depths 1-16, all five filters and Adam7. Zero dependencies, local only — no model call, no network, no upload.
description.zh: 证明一次局部改图没有动蒙版外的像素。输入原图、生成图和蒙版三张 PNG，输出可 grep 的 `MASK_PIXEL_LOCK=PASS|FAIL|EMPTY` 结论、差异热力图、逐通道统计、差异包围盒与最大差异像素，并生成自包含 HTML 报告和 `report.json`；后者包含文件 SHA-256、规范化受保护像素摘要，以及把两者与判定策略绑定在一起的证明摘要。支持 edit / lock 两种蒙版语义、蒙版阈值、容差与忽略 alpha；PNG 覆盖颜色类型 0/2/3/4/6、位深 1-16、五种过滤器和 Adam7。零依赖、纯本地：不调模型、不联网、不上传。

description.en: Pixel-level screenshot diff for visual regression. Two local PNGs in; a machine-readable first line (`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false`, greppable as an assertion), then the difference ratio, per-region bounding boxes, maximum channel delta and mean absolute error, plus a self-contained HTML comparison page. An ignore-region list with absolute or fractional coordinates excludes clocks, cursors and other per-render noise. It deliberately does no content recognition: it answers only "did this change", which is the part that can be made deterministic. Entirely local — no model call, no network, no upload.
description.zh: 面向视觉回归的像素级截图比对。输入两张本地 PNG，第一行是可机器判定的结论（`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false`，可以直接 grep 当断言），随后是差异比例、差异区域包围盒、最大通道差与平均绝对误差，并生成一份自包含的 HTML 对照页。可用绝对或比例坐标声明忽略区，排除时钟、光标这类每次渲染都会变的部分。它刻意不做内容识别——只回答「变没变」，因为这一步可以做成确定性的。全部本地完成：不调模型、不联网、不上传。

description.en: Video studio for DeepSeek Harness on Android: storyboard editing, multi-provider image/video generation with automatic failover, FFmpeg MP4 export, prompt optimization, and a mobile-first workbench.
description.zh: 安卓上的 DSH 视频工作台：分镜编辑、多供应商图像/视频生成与自动切换、FFmpeg 合成 MP4、提示词优化、手机窄屏工作台。

description.en: Adds three session tools — create_image and edit_image over GPT Image or Gemini through the TLPro gateway, and speak for text-to-speech through xAI — plus a viewer in the chat UI for the images and audio they produce. Needs your own TLPRO_API_KEY and XAI_API_KEY, and publicOrigin and mediaDir set in the profile config.
description.zh: 增加三个会话工具——经 TLPro 网关调用 GPT Image 或 Gemini 的 create_image、edit_image，以及经 xAI 的文本转语音 speak——并在聊天界面里提供这些图片和音频的查看器。需自备 TLPRO_API_KEY 与 XAI_API_KEY，并在 profile 配置中设置 publicOrigin 与 mediaDir。

description.en: Adds a screenshot tool that captures the Windows desktop to PNG and hands the path to the model, plus a composer camera button that previews, downloads or copies the capture.
description.zh: 在输入框加相机按钮（预览、下载、复制截图），并提供一个截图工具，把 Windows 桌面截成 PNG 交给模型读取。

description.en: MiniMax H3-Image text-to-image generation and image-to-image editing inside DSH, using your own MINIMAX_API_KEY.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用 MiniMax H3-Image 文生图与图生图，使用你自己的 MINIMAX_API_KEY。

description.en: Read a video with a text-only model: with ffmpeg installed, sample frames at a 0.1-10 second interval into contact sheets where every frame carries its real timecode, extract the audio track and send it to iTingnao (needs an ITINGNAO_API_KEY) for a timestamped transcript, and describe each sheet with an image-capable model in the host, so the plugin works on its own without any other vision plugin. A composer slider sets the sampling interval, and pure audio files are transcribed without frame sampling.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型看懂视频：需本机装好 ffmpeg；按 0.1–10 秒的可调间隔抽帧拼成总览图，每格烧录该帧的真实时间码；提取音轨后上传到听脑（需配置 ITINGNAO_API_KEY）转写成带时间戳的台词；并自行调用宿主里的视觉模型逐页描述画面，因此不依赖任何其他视觉插件。输入框上方有抽帧间隔滑块，纯音频文件则跳过抽帧只做转写。

description.en: Adds the agnes_image host tool for generating and editing images with Agnes Image 2.5 Flash. Text-to-image takes a detailed prompt; image editing and multi-image composition accept local workspace paths or public URLs through reference_images. Output size, aspect ratio, and model are configurable, and results are saved into the session working directory and shown inline as attachments. The plugin has no runtime dependencies and no build step. Requires your own Agnes API key (AGNES_API_KEY in the environment or ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml). Uses the same agnes_image tool name and loader id as zhp282515-wq/dsh-plugin-agnes-image, so do not install both.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 agnes_image 宿主工具，使用 Agnes Image 2.5 Flash 生成与编辑图片。文生图接受详细提示词；图生图与多图合成通过 reference_images 接受工作区本地路径或公开 URL。可配置输出尺寸、宽高比与模型，结果保存在会话工作目录并作为附件内联展示。无运行时依赖，无构建步骤。需自备 Agnes API Key（环境变量 AGNES_API_KEY 或 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml）。与 zhp282515-wq/dsh-plugin-agnes-image 的工具名 agnes_image 和 loader id 相同，不能同装。

description.en: Apple on-device Vision tools for text-only dsh models: local OCR (zh-Hans + 30 langs), image classification, face detection, document layout, and a combined describe — 100% offline, no API key, tall-screenshot slicing.
description.zh: 苹果设备端 Vision 工具：本地 OCR（含中文）、图像分类、人脸检测、文档版面分析与综合描述，100% 离线、无需 API key，支持长截图切片。

description.en: Local WeChat OCR tool for DSH: `wechat_ocr_recognize` returns recognized text and the engine structured result for a local image path.
description.zh: DSH 的本地微信 OCR 工具：`wechat_ocr_recognize` 针对本地图片路径返回识别文本和引擎的结构化结果。

description.en: Local Windows 11 OneOCR tool for DSH: `oneocr_recognize` returns OCR text and structured line/word polygons, confidence, rotation, and handwriting style.
description.zh: DSH 的本地 Windows 11 OneOCR 工具：`oneocr_recognize` 返回 OCR 文本，以及包含行/词多边形、置信度、旋转角度和手写体样式的结构化结果。

description.en: Carve one sentence into a clean text-free background image — 87 illustration, anime and infographic styles, four image APIs wired in, plus prompt expansion that fills in the details you cannot describe.
description.zh: 把一句话刻成一张干净底图——87 种插画、二次元与信息图风格，四家出图接口直接接好，附描述扩写帮你补出说不清的画面细节。

description.en: Give a text-only agent video understanding: extract timestamped frame files, sample only on scene changes, export GIF clips, probe metadata, and run a one-shot analyse over the frames. Five tools that shell out to a local ffmpeg through argv arrays rather than a shell string.
description.zh: 给纯文本 agent 补上视频理解：抽帧并返回带时间码的帧文件、只在场景切换时采样、导出 GIF 片段、探测元数据、并对关键帧做一次性分析。五个工具，通过 argv 数组调用本机 ffmpeg 而非拼接 shell 字符串。

description.en: Give your text-only model eyes - chat image attachments are auto-described via a vision model (default prompt), with iterative re-parsing through model-generated prompts when details are missing; system/custom model modes + GUI config panel, key-safe secret handling, and a small host patch for DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 (see repo README).
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能看图：发图自动用视觉模型描述（默认提示词），描述不足时对话模型自动生成更具体的提示词重新解析；系统模型/自定义双模式 + GUI 可视化配置、Key 脱敏安全、针对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 的宿主小补丁（见仓库 README）。

description.en: MiniCut tools for making multi-shot AI short films through the MiniCut CLI: status, next step, and run, with a price shown and the user's yes required before any paid job.
description.zh: MiniCut 工具：通过 MiniCut CLI 制作多镜头 AI 短片，提供状态、下一步与执行，任何付费任务前先显示价格并需用户确认。

description.en: Structured image recognition: local sharp measurements plus a cloud vision model return description, OCR with coordinates, object locations and fine-grained attributes in one call; a fingerprint cache makes repeated images return in milliseconds without spending model quota.
description.zh: 结构化图像识别：本地 sharp 感知 + 云端视觉模型，一次调用拿到描述、带坐标的 OCR、 目标定位与细粒度属性；图片指纹缓存让重复图片毫秒返回且不消耗模型额度。

description.en: Sidebar playground for SenseNova and Agnes image and video generation, per-provider API keys and default models, local result management, and sgen_* tools for conversations. Each request runs the bundled sgen command-line tool, any reference image or audio you give by local path is uploaded to the provider as base64, API keys live in ~/.sgen/config.json, and the sidebar saves results under ~/sgen unless you pick another folder.
description.zh: 侧栏试验场调用商汤与 Agnes 生成图片和视频，按供应商设置 Key 与默认模型，管理本机生成结果，并向对话提供 sgen_* 工具。每次请求都会运行安装包里自带的 sgen 命令行；按本地路径给出的参考图和参考音频会以 base64 上传到服务商；API Key 存在 ~/.sgen/config.json；侧栏生成的结果默认存到 ~/sgen（可改目录）。

description.en: Local eyes for text-only models: eyes_render draws text/shapes/Mermaid onto a canvas in the Web GUI, eyes_paste captures pasted images, eyes_ocr reads text via the built-in Windows OCR (offline), and eyes_analyze inspects pixels as structured data — no vision model required.
description.zh: 为纯文本模型装上本地眼睛：eyes_render 在 Web 界面画布上绘制文字/图形/Mermaid，eyes_paste 接收用户粘贴的图片，eyes_ocr 用 Windows 自带 OCR 离线读文字，eyes_analyze 把像素解析成结构化数据，全程无需视觉模型。

description.en: Give text-only models vision: a describe_image tool that delegates images to a vision model from your dsh model list over the harness's own LLM runtime.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型拥有视觉：describe_image 工具调用 dsh 模型列表中的视觉模型描述图片，走 harness 自身的 LLM 运行时。

description.en: Image generation and editing with configurable APIs, reference images, and an on-demand annotation canvas. Requires your own OpenAI-compatible image API endpoint and key.
description.zh: 可配置图片 API 的生图、参考图编辑与按需标注画布插件。需自备 OpenAI 兼容图片 API 地址与密钥。

description.en: Video study toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: fetch a public Bilibili single part or YouTube video, sample every 3 seconds plus change-triggered frames, transcribe locally with faster-whisper, page through section grids, and render a 16:9 study deck. Windows only, and needs the DSH pwsh tool plus Python 3.12 x64 with Pillow and FFmpeg/FFprobe; fetching adds yt-dlp, transcription needs faster-whisper with your own local model files, and deck output needs python-pptx.
description.zh: 视频精读：获取 B 站单分P或 YouTube 视频，每 3 秒基础采样并补取变化帧，本地 faster-whisper 转写，分页读取分段图版，并可排版成 16:9 学习 PPT。仅 Windows；需要 DSH 的 pwsh 工具，以及 Python 3.12 x64 + Pillow、FFmpeg/FFprobe；获取视频另需 yt-dlp，转写需 faster-whisper 并自备本地模型文件，PPT 输出需 python-pptx。

description.en: Local creation toolbox for DeepSeek Harness. It talks to a ComfyUI instance for image generation and a local GPT-SoVITS service for speech, checks which local services are reachable, and saves generated files into the workspace.
description.zh: 本地创作工具箱：连接本机 ComfyUI 出图、连接本地 GPT-SoVITS 配音，检查服务是否在线，并把生成的文件保存到工作区。

description.en: Removes the model-capability gate that blocks image prompts: patches llm.resolveModelInfo results and adapter model tables to declare image input, so routes with no declared input modality can send and read images. No app.asar or config-tree edits.
description.zh: 移除拦截图片请求的多模态能力门禁：改写 llm.resolveModelInfo 的返回值与适配器模型表，为未声明 input 的路由补上 image 输入能力，使其可以发送和读取图片。不改 app.asar，也不改配置树。

description.en: Adds an Omni-modal settings section to DeepSeek Harness that points the harness at any OpenAI-compatible image and video endpoint: switchable config profiles with separate endpoint, API key, model, path and size for each side, free-form extra request parameters, a connectivity test that does not spend generation quota, and three model-visible tools — generate_image, generate_video and check_video — with async video tasks that survive restarts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加「全模态设置」分区：可把生图 / 生视频指向任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，多套配置档案可随时切换，图片与视频各自独立的接口地址、API Key、模型、路径与尺寸，支持自由填写额外请求参数、不消耗额度的连通性测试，并注册 generate_image / generate_video / check_video 三个模型可见工具，异步视频任务可跨重启保留。

description.en: MiMo TTS speech synthesis for DeepSeek Harness: a speak button on finalized assistant messages with an inline player (draggable progress bar), a plugin-page configuration card with preview playback, and a voice-history settings page.
description.zh: MiMo TTS 语音合成——已定稿助手回复的朗读按钮与内联播放器（可拖动进度条）、插件页配置卡片（支持试听）和语音历史设置页。

description.en: Inline audio player for generated clips and songs: the play_audio tool renders a player in the conversation (promoted into the transcript when the host supports it, otherwise inside the tool-call fold). Serves only allow-listed directories, supports Range seeking and HEAD, 512 MB cap per file.
description.zh: 对话内音频播放器：play_audio 工具把生成的语音和歌曲直接渲染成播放器（宿主支持时提升到正文，否则留在工具折叠里）。只服务白名单目录，支持 Range 拖动与 HEAD，单文件上限 512 MB。

description.en: Floating TTS speaker in each conversation corner: when an AI reply finishes, edge-tts reads the summary aloud in the background with no popup windows; the toggle is remembered per conversation. Requires Windows, Python 3.9+ with the edge-tts package installed, and network access to Microsoft's Edge TTS service; summary is the default mode.
description.zh: 每个对话右下角悬浮小喇叭：AI 回复完成后由 edge-tts 在后台静默朗读摘要，全程无前台窗口；开关状态每个对话独立记忆。需要 Windows、Python 3.9+ 并安装 edge-tts，且需联网调用微软 Edge TTS 在线服务；默认朗读摘要。

description.en: Dual-MediaPlayer daemon ($think loop + $fx one-shots) with volume ducking, mood-aware sounds (smooth/struggle/deep_think triggered by consecutive success/failure streaks and prolonged agent runtime), 15 built-in PCM WAV synthesised from sine/square waveforms, per-tool sound mapping with 51 categorised tools, custom WAV/MP3 drop-in with auto-conversion, and a full settings UI with dark-mode fix.
description.zh: 双 MediaPlayer 守护进程（$think 思考循环 + $fx 一次性音效）支持音量闪避、情绪感知音效（连续成功/失败/长时间运行自动触发 smooth/struggle/deep_think）、15 种正弦/方波合成内置音、51 个工具分类映射、自定义 WAV/MP3 直替自动转换，以及完整设置页含深色模式修复。

description.en: Hold Alt (default; rebindable in the plugin page) to dictate and insert a cleaned-up transcript, plus a sparkle button that rewrites the composer draft into a clearer prompt. Dictation requires the Harness Voice Input plugin with its SenseVoice model enabled.
description.zh: 按住 Alt（默认，可在插件页改键）说话、松开插入修正后的转写文字，输入框左侧、模型选择器前的星标按钮可把草稿改写成更清晰的提示词；听写需启用 Harness 的语音输入插件并准备好 SenseVoice 模型。

description.en: Dictation that ends up in the repository instead of the chat log: hold the button (or import a WAV), and the plugin archives voice-memos/<id>/ with audio.wav, a rendered waveform.png, memo.md (frontmatter, per-segment timestamps, ready-to-paste quote blocks) and meta.json. Audio is resampled to 16 kHz mono in the browser before it is sent. Transcription stays local — the harness speechToText service with silence-split windows, or a command worker such as faster-whisper — and when no engine is available the memo is still filed with an explicit status and reason rather than a fabricated transcript. Ships a conversation-view 口述 tab with click-to-seek playback and per-segment quote copy, three agent tools (voice_memo_save / voice_memo_list / voice_memo_read) and HTTP routes. Zero runtime dependencies, 52 node:test cases, real screenshots in docs/.
description.zh: 把口述变成仓库里的归档，而不是聊天里一闪而过的转写：按住说话（或导入 WAV）后，插件把 audio.wav、渲染好的 waveform.png、memo.md（frontmatter、逐段时码、可直接粘贴的引用块）与 meta.json 落到 voice-memos/<id>/。音频先在浏览器里重采样成 16 kHz 单声道再上传。转写全部本地完成——DSH 的 speechToText 服务（静音切窗补时间戳）或 faster-whisper 这类命令 worker；没有可用引擎时仍然归档，并写明状态与原因，绝不编造文本。带会话视图的「口述」Tab：点波形定位播放、逐段复制引用；另有三个 agent 工具（voice_memo_save / voice_memo_list / voice_memo_read）与 HTTP 路由。零运行时依赖，52 个 node:test 用例，docs/ 里有真实运行截图。

description.en: Continuous dictation for the composer using a local SenseVoice ONNX model on CPU: recognised text appears while you speak, a pause ends the sentence and writes it into the input box, and audio never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 输入框连续听写：本机 CPU 跑 SenseVoice ONNX 模型，说话时实时显示识别文字，停顿后整句写入输入框，音频不出本机。

description.en: Windows-wide Bluetooth earbud shortcuts for AI work: a left-earbud volume-down gesture starts or stops Windows voice typing (Win+H), and a right-earbud volume-up gesture sends Backspace. The DSH settings page offers manual key mapping, test actions, Backspace count, volume-gesture detection, and a 1.6-second cooldown so one triple-tap performs one action. The helper is compiled locally from included C# source. The plugin itself does not record or upload audio; Windows voice typing processes speech under its own privacy settings.
description.zh: Windows 桌面级蓝牙耳机快捷键：左侧耳机音量减手势启动/停止 Windows 语音输入（Win+H），右侧耳机音量加手势发送 Backspace 回删；设置页支持手动映射、测试、回删次数、音量手势检测与 1.6 秒冷却，确保一次三击只执行一次。助手由随包 C# 源码在本机编译；插件本身不录音、不上传音频，语音由 Windows 语音输入按其隐私设置处理。

description.en: Text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness through Xiaomi MiMo TTS, needs a XIAOMI_API_KEY: a mimo_tts tool that writes audio to a local file, a read-aloud action on each finalized answer, auto-read, and a sidebar panel for built-in voices, voice design by description, or voice cloning from an mp3/wav sample. Same package name as lengmodkx/dsh-mimo-tts, so the two cannot be installed together.
description.zh: 通过小米 MiMo TTS 为 DSH 提供语音合成，需要 XIAOMI_API_KEY：mimo_tts 工具落盘音频、回答的「播报」按钮、自动播报，以及侧边栏语音设置（内置音色、文字描述生成音色、样本克隆）。与 lengmodkx/dsh-mimo-tts 包名相同，不能同装。

description.en: Composer mic button that transcribes speech locally with SenseVoice, then tidies the spoken transcript into clean text with your configured DeepSeek route before inserting it into the draft.
description.zh: 输入框麦克风按钮：本地 SenseVoice 转写，再用已配置的 DeepSeek 把口语整理成通顺文字，插入草稿前可对照原文。

description.en: Hold right-Cmd and talk — local SenseVoice STT, a fixed DSH session with voice-triggered rotation, and streaming CosyVoice2 TTS with emotion voices and an optional Live2D overlay.
description.zh: 按住右⌘说一句——本地 SenseVoice 识别、固定 DSH 会话（语音/按钮开新会话）、CosyVoice2 流式播报与情感音色，可选 Live2D 鲸鱼娘悬浮窗。

description.en: Plays the audio of a Bilibili video from a floating bar in the DSH Web UI, with a queue, seek and speed controls, and a host-side reverse proxy for the CDN Referer check.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面挂一个悬浮播放条，粘贴 BV 号或链接就能听 B 站视频的声音，带队列、进度与倍速，并由宿主反向代理绕开 CDN 的 Referer 校验。

description.en: Reads Harness replies aloud with the MOSS-TTS-Nano-100M C++ CPU engine: fully offline with no API key, one-click engine download verified against the release sha256sums.txt, auto-read of settled replies plus a read button on every reply, and playback that starts while synthesis continues. The weights are installed once and shared with the companion CLI and web playground. Windows x64 only, because the engine ships for that platform only.
description.zh: 用 MOSS-TTS-Nano-100M 的 C++ CPU 引擎朗读 Harness 回复：完全离线、不需要 API key，一键下载引擎并用发布页的 sha256sums.txt 校验，回复定稿自动朗读、每条回复也能单独朗读，边合成边播放。权重只装一份，与同项目的命令行和网页试听台共用。仅限 Windows x64，因为引擎只提供该平台的版本。

description.en: Offline voice input for the composer: records with the microphone, transcribes locally with SenseVoice, and sends the message automatically. A derivative of the official voice-input plugin that adds auto-submit; first use downloads the SenseVoice model (about 242 MB) to ~/.dsh/speech-to-text/sensevoice, and it registers the same speech provider rows as the built-in Voice Input, so disable that one first.
description.zh: 输入框离线语音输入：麦克风录音后用 SenseVoice 在本机转写，转写完成即自动发送消息。是官方语音输入插件的衍生版，加入了自动发送；首次使用会把 SenseVoice 模型（约 242 MB）下载到 ~/.dsh/speech-to-text/sensevoice，并注册与内置语音输入相同的语音服务条目，请先停用内置的语音输入。

description.en: Adds a composer microphone button that records audio as MP3 (default), WAV, or WebM and attaches it to the current prompt as a conversation file attachment. The format is chosen on the plugin's own detail page under Settings > Plugins; recordings are passed to the host through the conversation draft-attachment channel and are not written to disk by the plugin.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个麦克风按钮，录音按 MP3（默认）、WAV 或 WebM 编码，并作为会话附件挂进当前 Prompt；格式在「设置 → 插件」中该插件自己的详情页选择，录音经会话草稿附件通道交给宿主，插件不会把音频写入磁盘。

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS voice for DeepSeek Harness: boots the engine with DSH and kills it on exit, speaks only the line marked for voice, and ships a default voice, so you only need to point runtimeDir at a local GPT-SoVITS install.
description.zh: 把本机 GPT-SoVITS 接进 DeepSeek Harness：随 DSH 启停引擎、只念该说出口的那一句；自带默认音色，只需填好本机 GPT-SoVITS 的 runtimeDir。

description.en: Voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer that transcribes speech into the draft via the Web Speech API, with an optional auto-send toggle.
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：输入框一键麦克风按钮，基于 Web Speech API 语音转文字填入草稿，可选识别后自动发送。

description.en: End-of-turn voice summary: the model calls voice_say once before finishing a reply so the conclusion is spoken through Breeze TTS, with Chinese bracket audio tags (laughter, sighs, pauses) and optional performance instructions. Audio is synthesized host-side and played from browser memory without ever touching disk; the character limit is a writing target for the model, not a cut-off, so long lines still play in full. The API key stays in the credential store, and an optional daily Breeze check-in is included. Needs a Breeze API key and sends the spoken text to the Breeze service; its HTTP routes (including the settings route that stores the key) have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 每轮收尾语音：模型在最终回复前调用一次 voice_say，把结论经 Breeze TTS 念出来；支持中文方括号音频标签（轻笑、叹气、停顿）和可选表演指令。音频在 host 侧合成、浏览器内存里播放，全程不落盘；字数上限只是给模型的写作要求，不是截断线，超了照样整句播。API KEY 存凭据库，另带可选的 Breeze 每日签到。需要 Breeze API 密钥，朗读的文本会发给 Breeze 服务；它的 HTTP 路由（包括保存密钥的设置路由）没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Doubao streaming speech-to-text button in the DSH composer — one API key and your words land in the draft. Needs a Doubao (Volcengine) speech-recognition API key, kept in the DSH credential store; recorded audio is sent to Volcengine, and its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加一个麦克风按钮，用豆包流式语音识别把说的话直接变成草稿文字，只填一个 API Key 就能用。需要豆包（火山引擎）语音识别 API Key，保存在 DSH 凭据库；录下的音频会发给火山引擎识别，它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Talk to DeepSeek Harness through Siri and iPhone Shortcuts: a bearer-key POST /siri endpoint on your computer answers each spoken request for Siri to read aloud, with a settings page (key, port, workspace, model, Agent Preset, rate limit, allowed addresses), optional DS Bot routing, and a ready-made Shortcut.
description.zh: 用 Siri 和 iPhone 快捷指令对话 DeepSeek Harness：电脑上的 POST /siri 接口（Bearer 密钥鉴权）回答每一句语音请求并交给 Siri 朗读，附设置页（密钥、端口、工作区、模型、Agent Preset、限频、来源地址）、可选的 DS Bot 路由和现成的快捷指令。

description.en: Bilibili music player for the DSH composer dock: import your Bilibili login cookie and a listening-profile JSON for profile-based recommendation with like/skip/dislike feedback and 192k playback; without a profile it falls back to genre-based online search and progressive playback.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框上方点播 B 站音乐：导入 B 站登录态与听歌画像 JSON 后按画像推荐，支持喜欢/跳过/不喜欢软反馈；没有画像时退回按风格词在线搜索，播放为边下边播。

description.en: Transcribe local audio and video files offline with a composer panel, a CLI, and an agent skill, powered by SenseVoice int8.
description.zh: 在输入框面板、命令行与 agent 技能里离线转写本地音视频文件，引擎为 SenseVoice int8。

description.en: Reads DeepSeek Harness replies aloud with MiniMax voices, with a per-message speaker button, optional auto-read and barge-in when you send a new message.
description.zh: 用 MiniMax 音色朗读 DeepSeek Harness 的回复，每条回复一个喇叭按钮，支持每轮自动朗读与发消息立即打断。

description.en: Real-time duplex voice over Volcengine streaming ASR/TTS: agent reply narration, barge-in, wake word, live captions, 30 Chinese voices and a reply-first acknowledgment; builds in the DSH monorepo.
description.zh: 基于火山流式 ASR/TTS 的实时双工语音：回复朗读、打断、唤醒词、实时字幕、30 个中文音色与先响应后思考；在 DSH monorepo 内构建。

description.en: Local-first podcast player and transcriber for DeepSeek Harness: plays audio files from your disk, transcribes with local ASR, shows bilingual subtitles and exports SRT or Markdown.
description.zh: 本地优先的播客播放器与转写插件：播放磁盘音频，本地转写、双语字幕与 SRT/Markdown 导出。

description.en: Turn-end notification sound for DSH: built-in internet meme voices (ni gan ma ai yo, ji ni tai mei, shen ying ge, etc.), Settings panel with preview/switch/random, custom audio folder support.
description.zh: DSH 对话结束提示音：内置网络热梗原声（你干嘛哎呦、鸡你太美、神鹰哥等），设置面板可试听/切换/随机，支持自定义音频目录。

description.en: BreezeBlue text-to-speech for DSH: three agent tools, a header toggle that reads assistant replies aloud (markdown and code blocks stripped), and local HTTP endpoints for audio playback, synthesis and long-poll delivery. Requires a BreezeBlue API key (BREEZE_API_KEY); synthesis is billed per character.
description.zh: 把 BreezeBlue 语音接入 DSH：三个工具、会话头开关自动朗读助手回复（自动剥离 Markdown 与代码块），并提供音频播放、合成与长轮询的本地 HTTP 接口。需配置 BreezeBlue API Key（BREEZE_API_KEY），合成按字符计费。

description.en: GPT-SoVITS voice output for DSH: a speak tool and /voice command, a read-aloud speaker button under each reply, and a settings tab to switch voices, tune synthesis, manage the local service and one-click install a voice pack.
