Windows only; needs a local GPT-SoVITS checkout with trained weights and its Python environment.
description.zh: 把本机 GPT-SoVITS 音色接进 DSH：voice_speak 工具与 /voice 命令朗读，每条助手回复下方有喇叭按钮，设置页可切音色、调合成参数、管本地推理服务，并支持一键安装音色包。仅 Windows；需本机已有 GPT-SoVITS 仓库、训练好的权重与它的 Python 环境。

description.en: PDF translation for DeepSeek Harness through a yiyide.cc connector account: 12 tools covering authorization, upload with page-level pre-flight, a three-page preview, quote, a confirmation that freezes translation points, job polling, quality confirmation, and download of the translated or bilingual PDF to the local machine.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里通过一译得连接器账号翻译 PDF：12 个工具覆盖授权、上传与页级预检、三页预览、报价、确认（冻结译点）、任务轮询、质量确认，以及把纯译文或双语对照 PDF 下载到本机。

description.en: Token-efficient document reader for DeepSeek Harness: outline / ranged read / grep for PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT.
description.zh: 省 token 的文档读取器：对 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、TXT 提供大纲、按页读取、关键词检索。

description.en: Generates release material from what a local repository can actually support: a hero image, a feature grid and bilingual copy rendered as SVG and HTML from `README.md`, `package.json` and optional screenshots. Facts are quoted from those files — name, version, license, summary, features, install snippet — and a field that is missing is left unrendered rather than filled with placeholder text. Every feature carries a source citation such as `README.md#L42`, and a claim the repository cannot substantiate is linted out before anything is written, with the reasoning left in `lint-report.json`. `manifest.json` records a sha256 for each input and output, and `--now` or `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` makes a run byte-identical. Also ships a GUI panel that regenerates from inside a session.
description.zh: 从本地仓库真实支持的产物生成发布素材：hero 图、特性网格与中英双语文案，由 `README.md`、`package.json` 和可选截图渲染成 SVG 与 HTML。事实全部从这些文件引用——项目名、版本、license、一句话简介、特性列表、安装片段——缺失的字段直接不渲染，不补占位文案。每条特性带 `README.md#L42` 这样的来源标注；无法被本仓库证实的说法在写出之前就被 lint 掉，理由留在 `lint-report.json`。`manifest.json` 记录每个输入与输出文件的 sha256，`--now` 或 `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` 可让整次输出字节一致。另含一个可以在会话里重新生成的 GUI 面板。

description.en: Turns a repository's README.md and docs/*.png into a publishable market card: bilingual title and tagline, install command, a screenshot wall, capabilities, and an explicit limitations section — as self-contained HTML, a 2400px 2x PNG, a paste-ready card.md, and provenance-rich card.json. It refuses to invent copy: missing English goes into a missing-fields list, --strict exits 2, and a normal run stamps DRAFT. PNG rendering uses the local Chrome or Edge headlessly; without one the HTML is still written and the CLI exits 3. 48 node --test tests, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把仓库的 README.md 与 docs/*.png 变成一张可发布的市场卡片：中英双语标题与一句话、安装命令、截图墙、能力，以及一段必须显式写出的限制声明——输出自包含 HTML、2400px 的 2x PNG、可直接粘贴的 card.md，以及带 provenance 的 card.json。它不编造文案：缺英文就进缺失字段列表，--strict 退出码 2，普通运行会盖 DRAFT 章。PNG 用本机 Chrome / Edge 无头渲染；没有浏览器时仍写 HTML，CLI 退出码 3。48 个 node --test 测试，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Turns a plugin repository's existing screenshots into a 6-second silent looping hero reel: a VP9 webm that keeps real alpha, a matted gif, and a cover frame, plus a manifest with per-scene holds and sha256s. The timeline is exact by construction (integer holds plus transitions sum to durationMs, and the last scene transitions back into the first so t=0 equals t=duration). Zero runtime dependencies: PNG decode/encode on node:zlib, an SDF card compositor, and ffmpeg as the only external binary, discovered at runtime. Ships a conversation-view panel (pick, reorder, generate, copy the README markdown) and a CLI with a storyboard.json contract.
description.zh: 把插件仓库里已有的截图排成一条 6 秒无声循环首屏短片：VP9 webm（保留真 alpha）、压平垫底的 gif、封面帧，外加记录每幕停留与 sha256 的清单。时间轴按构造即精确（整数停留 + 转场之和等于 durationMs，最后一幕转场回第一幕，t=0 与 t=结束同一帧）。零运行时依赖：PNG 编解码基于 node:zlib，自写 SDF 卡片合成器，唯一外部程序是运行时发现的 ffmpeg。带对话视图面板（选图、排序、生成、复制 README Markdown）与一条接受 storyboard.json 的 CLI。

description.en: Paste an article link to get a structure mind map, bolded key points, a section-by-section reading and a written critique, keep any sentence as a draggable polaroid note, and copy the whole reading as Notion-ready Markdown; the interface and every digest can switch between Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English. The mind-map image needs a local Edge or Chrome, which is found automatically on Windows, macOS and Linux (set DSH_MINDMAP_BROWSER to use a binary elsewhere); everything else works without it.
description.zh: 贴一个链接，把文章读成结构导图、加粗要点、逐段精读与读后评论；任意一句可收成拍立得便签（可拖动、缩放、改字），全文可一键复制成 Notion 版，简/繁/英三种语言可随时切换。导图图片依赖本机 Edge/Chrome，Windows、macOS、Linux 都会自动识别（装在别处可设环境变量 DSH_MINDMAP_BROWSER），不影响其余功能。

description.en: Document workspace that turns equipment manuals and past reports into proposals, research reports and bid files, then exports Markdown, Word, HTML, PDF and PPTX. Word/PPTX export and document parsing need Python 3 with pypdf, python-docx and python-pptx (installed from Settings), and PDF export needs Chrome or Edge at the standard Windows paths.
description.zh: 文档工坊：把设备说明书与历史报告变成技术方案、调研报告和投标文件，支持导出 Markdown / Word / HTML / PDF / PPTX。Word / PPTX 导出与文档解析需要 Python 3 及 pypdf、python-docx、python-pptx（在设置页初始化），PDF 导出需要标准 Windows 路径下的 Chrome 或 Edge。

description.en: UML sequence diagrams as editable .drawio files from a JSON spec: Python places participants, fragments and labels, the draw.io desktop CLI renders a PNG at 1x-4x, and Pillow verifies the output size. Generation is deterministic and refuses to overwrite a file edited by hand. Needs Python with Pillow 12.x and the draw.io desktop app; the default paths are Windows ones (Python under C:\Program Files\Python314, draw.io under D:\drawio) and can be changed in the settings card.
description.zh: 用 JSON spec 生成可编辑的 UML 时序图 .drawio：Python 负责参与者、片段与标签布局，draw.io 桌面 CLI 按 1x-4x 渲染 PNG，Pillow 校验输出尺寸。生成结果确定可复现，遇到手工改过的文件会拒绝覆盖。需要 Python（含 Pillow 12.x）和 draw.io 桌面版；默认路径是 Windows 路径（Python 在 C:\Program Files\Python314、draw.io 在 D:\drawio），可在设置卡片里修改。

description.en: Turns up to 30 uploaded PDF papers into prompt-driven literature reviews, key findings, research ideas and study designs, exported as page-cited reports (DOCX/PDF) or slide decks (PPTX/PDF).
description.zh: 把最多 30 篇上传的 PDF 文献变成提示词驱动的文献综述、关键信息提取、研究思路与研究设计，并导出带页码引用的报告（DOCX/PDF）或演示文稿（PPTX/PDF）。

description.en: Publish an HTML document as a shareable link that opens in one tap and previews as a card in chat apps; publish, update, and export to PNG/PDF/Word.
description.zh: 把 HTML 文档变成一键打开、在聊天里显示预览卡的分享链接;支持发布、更新,以及导出 PNG/PDF/Word。

description.en: Builds a per-project code wiki: README summary, docs tree, tech stack, git activity and language composition, cached locally and exportable as Markdown.
description.zh: 项目 Wiki 生成器：聚合 README 摘要、docs 树、技术栈、git 活跃度与语言构成，本地缓存并可导出 Markdown。

description.en: Makes identifiers inside inline code in chat clickable; resolves a definition, then a wrapper, then the next occurrence, and opens the file at that line in the sidebar preview.
description.zh: 让聊天里行内代码中的标识符可点击：按定义、包装函数、顺序出现三级回退解析，在右侧预览打开文件并定位到对应行。

description.en: Converts Markdown into .docx with native Word equations (OMML), then exports a PDF to verify every formula renders. Needs Python 3.9+ with lxml, latex2mathml and python-docx; the PDF check also needs pymupdf and Word or LibreOffice.
description.zh: 把 Markdown 转成公式为 Word 原生对象（OMML）的 .docx，并导出 PDF 逐页校验公式渲染。需要 Python 3.9+ 及 lxml、latex2mathml、python-docx；PDF 校验另需 pymupdf 与 Word 或 LibreOffice。

description.en: Translates .hwp/.hwpx (Hangul) documents into Chinese while keeping tables, bullets and indentation. Registers two offline tools: hwp_extract returns the document segments as JSON, and hwp_apply writes {segment id: translation} back and returns the output path. Translation is done by the session model, so no API key is needed; the translator ships inside the package. Windows only; legacy .hwp needs Hangul installed, .hwpx does not.
description.zh: 把 .hwp/.hwpx（한글）文档翻成中文，保留表格、项目符号与缩进。注册两个离线工具：hwp_extract 返回文档段落 JSON，hwp_apply 按 {段落 id: 译文} 写回并返回输出路径。翻译由会话模型完成，不需要 API Key；翻译器随包分发。仅 Windows；旧版 .hwp 需要本机 한글，.hwpx 不需要。

description.en: End-of-chat visual storyboard: a storyboard tool renders a self-contained HTML card (inline SVG diagram, numbered flow, facts grid, timeline) from a JSON spec, writes it under ~/.dsh/storyboard/<session>/ and opens it in the sidebar; a system-prompt section and a /storyboard command trigger generation. Server-only, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 对话收尾可视化故事板：storyboard 工具把 JSON 规范渲染为自包含 HTML 卡片（内嵌 SVG 流程图、编号步骤、事实网格、时间线），写入 ~/.dsh/storyboard/<session>/ 并在侧边栏打开；系统提示词段落与 /storyboard 命令触发生成。纯服务端、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Local Markdown notes panel: import any local folder, browse its Markdown tree in the sidebar, edit files with auto-save, and search across every imported folder. Shows read-only Git context for each file — status, diff against HEAD with per-line change bars, and line blame — and exposes six notes_* tools so the agent works on the same folders. Files stay where they are on disk; the plugin never commits, stages or checks out.
description.zh: 本地 Markdown 笔记面板：导入任意本地文件夹，在侧边栏树形浏览其中的 Markdown，就地编辑并自动保存，支持跨文件夹全文检索。为每个文件显示只读的 Git 上下文——状态、与 HEAD 的差异（逐行变更标记）、逐行 blame——并提供 notes_* 六个工具，让 Agent 直接操作同一批文件夹。文件留在原处，插件从不提交、暂存或检出。

description.en: Review AI-generated Word, PowerPoint, PDF and HTML in the official preview: box problems, edit the text in place, and hand the notes to the agent. PDF and images are annotate-only; editing relies on the Harness bundled LibreOffice kit and Python.
description.zh: 在官方预览里审阅 Word、PowerPoint、PDF 与 HTML：框选问题、就地改字，再把批注交给 AI。PDF 与图片仅可批注；改字依赖 Harness 自带的 LibreOffice 与 Python。

description.en: Knowledge-point notebook for DeepSeek Harness: turns a Markdown notes folder into a card canvas — folder = chapter, file = section, body = knowledge points — with masked-answer questions for self-testing, KaTeX formulas, Mermaid flowcharts, a mind map view and in-panel editing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 知识点笔记插件：把 Markdown 笔记目录变成卡片式学习画布，目录 = 章节、文件 = 小节、正文 = 知识点；题目可遮挡答案自测，支持 KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 流程图、思维导图与面板内编辑。

description.en: Tree-shaped Markdown knowledge base for DSH agents: kb_list/kb_read/kb_write tools, tree/node HTTP routes, and a browser panel companion.
description.zh: 树状 Markdown 知识库：为 DSH Agent 提供 kb_list/kb_read/kb_write 工具、目录/正文 HTTP 接口，并配套浏览器面板。

description.en: Write and read Markdown notes: switch between reading, editing and side-by-side preview, with an outline, three preview themes, math and Mermaid, nested folders, and autosave to local .md files.
description.zh: 随手记、随时读：阅读、编辑、并排预览一键切换，附大纲与三套排版主题，支持公式与 Mermaid，多级文件夹管理，自动存为本地 .md 文件。

description.en: Saves opt-in conversations as structured Markdown study notes with topic folders and a maintained index.
description.zh: 按对话开启学习笔记，自动整理问答，按分类保存并维护 Markdown 索引。

description.en: Bilingual PDF reader for DeepSeek Harness that translates paragraph by paragraph: single-page, selected-text and full-document translation with a prompt that asks the model to keep formulas, citations and DOIs, a glossary that forces chosen terms, bilingual / translation-only / source-only views, per-paragraph notes with page highlights, document Q&A, and Markdown / printable HTML export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的段落级双语 PDF 阅读器：支持单页、选中文本与全文翻译，提示词要求保留公式、引用与 DOI；术语表强制指定译名，提供双语/仅译文/仅原文三种视图，段落笔记带页面高亮，可基于文档提问，并导出 Markdown 与可打印 HTML。

description.en: Forces ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English on every reply and every document. Commands: /asd100 on, /asd100 off, /asd100.
description.zh: 强制所有回复和文档按 ASD-STE100 简化技术英语输出。命令：/asd100 on、/asd100 off、/asd100。

description.en: Prepares files before read, read_image and the vision tools open them: downscales images over 2048 px or 8 MB (one retry at 1280 px within the same turn), converts BMP/TIFF to PNG, relabels mislabeled uploads by sniffing their bytes, and turns docx/xlsx/pptx, text-layer PDF, csv/tsv and html into Markdown with no external programs.
description.zh: 在 read、read_image 与 vision_* 打开文件之前先处理：长边超 2048 像素或体积超 8 MB 的图降采样（同一轮可降到 1280 再试一次），BMP/TIFF 转 PNG，按字节纠正标错的上传类型，并把 docx/xlsx/pptx、有文字层的 PDF、csv/tsv 与 html 转成 Markdown，不依赖任何外部程序。

description.en: Renders mermaid fenced code blocks in the conversation as real diagrams, with the source one click away.
description.zh: 把会话里的 mermaid 代码块直接渲染成图表，源码一键可查。

description.en: Registers a skill that turns a Bilibili video link into a structured Obsidian note. It fetches subtitles only with yt-dlp and never downloads the video, merges multi-part anthologies onto one continuous timeline, and writes front matter, timestamped jump-link bullets, a summary and tags into the vault.
description.zh: 注册一个技能，把 B站视频链接变成 Obsidian 结构化笔记。只用 yt-dlp 拉字幕、不下载视频；多分 P 合集合并成一条连续时间轴；写入 frontmatter、带时间戳的跳转要点、摘要与标签。

description.en: Ships the Alibaba Java coding guidelines, 44 selected rules, as an embedded harness skill, so writing, changing and reviewing Java code or DDL follows the handbook with a numbered self-check before delivery.
description.zh: 把《阿里巴巴 Java 开发手册》精选 44 条做成内嵌技能：写、改、评审 Java 代码与建表语句时按手册约束，交付前按编号自检。

description.en: Beginner starter pack for DeepSeek Harness: welcome flow, 0→1 learning path, scenario-based plugin recommendations and a self-check checklist, paired with the dsh-handbook-zh Chinese tutorial repo.
description.zh: DSH 新手入门包：欢迎语、从 0 到 1 学习路径、按场景推荐插件与新手自查清单，联动 dsh-handbook-zh 中文教程仓库。

description.en: Legacy code modernization workflow (preflight -> assess -> map -> transform) with a Cordis mount plugin, offline Python scripts and smoke tests.
description.zh: 遗留代码现代化工作流（preflight → assess → map → transform），含 Cordis 挂载插件、离线 Python 脚本与冒烟测试。

description.en: One-shot DSH skill (SKILL.md) generator: capture intent, draft, validate, package and distribute skills from inside a DeepSeek Harness session (skill_new / skill_validate / skill_package / skill_improve_description).
description.zh: 一键生成 DSH 技能（SKILL.md）的 Cordis 插件：在会话内捕获意图、起草、校验、打包分发并优化技能描述（skill_new / skill_validate / skill_package / skill_improve_description）。

description.en: Bundles the stack-diagram architecture-diagram skill as a runtime skill, and injects a system-prompt section so the model draws diagrams without being asked. Output is self-contained HTML plus light and dark PNGs from bundled Python scripts; brand logos are fetched at run time.
description.zh: 把 stack-diagram 架构图技能注册成运行时技能，并注入一段系统提示路由，模型遇到架构、技术栈、部署拓扑需求时会主动画图。输出为自包含 HTML 与明暗两版 PNG，由包内 Python 脚本生成；品牌图标在运行时抓取。

description.en: Spring Boot admin toolkit: EasyExcel batch import/export code generation and Thymeleaf + LayUI template safety guard.
description.zh: Spring Boot 后台开发套件：EasyExcel 批量导入导出代码生成与 Thymeleaf + LayUI 模板安全守卫。

description.en: Find photo candidates from the 2026 Qiandao Lake cycling race by bib number and visible gear, with local helper scripts and album snapshot comparison. Needs the event's photo album link; snapshot comparison uses Python 3.10+, bib OCR is macOS only (Swift and Apple Vision), and the optional gear ranking needs Pillow, PyTorch, Transformers and a local DINOv2 model directory.
description.zh: 按号码牌和可见装备查找 2026 届千岛湖自行车比赛照片候选，提供本地辅助脚本和相册快照比对。需要提供本届赛事的相册直播链接；相册快照比对需要 Python 3.10+，号码 OCR 仅限 macOS（Swift 与 Apple Vision），可选的装备排序需要 Pillow、PyTorch、Transformers 和本地 DINOv2 模型目录。

description.en: Guide an agent through exporting selected OneLap cycling FIT files, validating data and coordinates, and uploading via a logged-in Strava browser session. Needs Python 3.9+ (standard library only) and an agent with browser and file-upload tools.
description.zh: 指导具备浏览器操作能力的 Agent 导出指定顽鹿骑行 FIT，校验数据和坐标，并通过已登录的 Strava 网页上传。需要 Python 3.9+（仅标准库）和具备浏览器与文件上传能力的 Agent。

description.en: A mandatory 7-step plan on every request, each step with a binary acceptance criterion, executed through worker subagents and validated by independent memoryless verifier subagents that report PASS or FAIL with evidence.
description.zh: 每个请求都必须走完 7 步计划,每步都有可判定的验收标准,执行交给 worker 子代理,完成情况由无记忆的独立 verifier 子代理带证据判定 PASS / FAIL。

description.en: Strict verification for every task: plan 2-7 steps, execute them with worker subagents, verify each deliverable with an independent memoryless verifier subagent, and fix in at most three cycles before reporting honestly.
description.zh: 给每个任务加上严格验证:把任务拆成 2-7 步,用 worker 子代理执行,每个交付物都由无记忆的独立 verifier 子代理验证,最多修 3 轮后如实汇报。

description.en: Adds an `ocsr` skill and an `ocsr_dispatch` tool that run headless `opencode run` as fresh-context, cross-vendor worker backends, with a Python driver for watchdog timeouts and per-worker output files. Windows only (Windows PowerShell): requires the OpenCode CLI, Python 3 and a model allowlist at `~/.ocsr/allowed-models.json`.
description.zh: 提供 `ocsr` 技能与 `ocsr_dispatch` 工具，把 headless `opencode run` 当作 fresh-context、跨厂商的 worker 后端；超时看门狗与每 worker 产物文件由 Python driver 负责。仅支持 Windows（需 Windows PowerShell）；需本机安装 OpenCode CLI、Python 3，并在 `~/.ocsr/allowed-models.json` 配置模型白名单。

description.en: Extract Bilibili platform/AI subtitles or external/embedded/ASR/OCR fallback and render Markdown, Word, PDF, TXT, SRT or JSON with timestamps, bilingual alignment and a quality report. Requires Python 3.10+; platform/AI subtitles need a Bilibili SESSDATA cookie; OCR/ASR/PDF need ffmpeg, faster-whisper and LibreOffice or reportlab.
description.zh: 从 Bilibili 视频或本地视频提取字幕，输出 Markdown、Word、PDF、TXT、SRT 或 JSON，支持时间戳、双语对齐和质量报告。需 Python 3.10+；平台/AI 字幕需 Bilibili SESSDATA Cookie；OCR/ASR/PDF 需 ffmpeg、faster-whisper，以及 LibreOffice 或 reportlab。

description.en: Skill that transcribes local audio files into a timestamped transcript and an interactive two-column minutes page, with optional speaker separation. Transcription uses mlx-whisper in a Python 3.11 environment you set up yourself (the first run may download models); the renderer uses only the system python3. Given a public short-video share link, it can also drive a real browser through ego-browser and fetch the audio track with curl and ffmpeg, none of which ship with the package.
description.zh: 把本地录音转成带时间戳的文字稿和双栏交互式纪要的技能，可选说话人分离。转写使用你自备的 Python 3.11 环境里的 mlx-whisper（首次运行可能下载模型），渲染只用系统 python3。给一条公开短视频分享链接时，还能通过 ego-browser 驱动真实浏览器、用 curl 与 ffmpeg 取音轨；这三者都不随包提供。

description.en: Provides a PMNote skill for finding public resources on game project management, careers, and AI tools.
description.zh: 提供 PMNote 技能，查阅游戏项目管理、职业发展和 AI 工具的公开资料。

description.en: Turns the QQ groups you follow into a Chinese daily digest. Pulls chat history through a local NapCat/OneBot 11 service into SQLite, summarizes each group, and renders an HTML/Markdown report with an opportunity radar that surfaces repeated complaints, tool requests and unmet needs as product ideas; can push a card to Feishu on a schedule.
description.zh: 把关注的 QQ 群聊总结成中文日报。经本机 NapCat/OneBot 11 拉取历史消息存入 SQLite，逐群摘要，生成带「机会雷达」的 HTML/Markdown 报告（从抱怨、求工具、求助里找产品机会），并可按计划推送到飞书。

description.en: Skill manager with content-addressed version history: snapshots, per-file and line-level diff, rollback, zip export and import, and per-skill enable or disable.
description.zh: 带内容寻址版本历史的技能管理器：快照、逐文件与行级差异、回滚、zip 导入导出、按技能停用或启用。

description.en: Invoke DSH skills with a $name gesture instead of /name, with a composer picker and the same blue text-reference decoration as /name.
description.zh: 用 $name 手势调用 DSH skill（与 / 命令不冲突），带输入框候选菜单，并让 $name 获得与 /name 相同的蓝色文本引用高亮。

description.en: Adds SKILL.md bundles from nested subfolders of the standard DSH skill roots to the catalog, with settings for depth, watching, and extra roots.
description.zh: 把标准 DSH 技能根目录下嵌套子文件夹中的 SKILL.md 技能包加入目录，并可在设置中调整深度、监听和额外根目录。

description.en: Shows which skills each turn invoked and installs, updates or removes skills inside the app.
description.zh: 显示每轮对话实际调用了哪些技能，并可在应用内安装、更新与删除技能。

description.en: Decides whether Python code is original or a derivative work: reports the longest identical expression span against an upstream tree, an exemption rationale per finding, and a risk list. Pure stdlib `ast` analysis — offline, no model calls.
description.zh: 判定 Python 代码是原创还是演绎作品：给出与上游最长相同表达片段、逐条豁免依据和风险清单。纯标准库 `ast` 分析——离线运行，不调用模型。

description.en: Skill panel for the DSH Web GUI: lists every installed skill with Chinese annotations and eight category filters, runs pinyin and fuzzy search, ranks by pin and recency, and manages each skill in place (pin, disable, reveal, uninstall with undo). Ships its own maintenance skill.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的技能面板：列出全部已安装技能并附中文备注，提供八类分类筛选、拼音与模糊搜索、置顶与最近使用排序，可原地管理每个技能（置顶、关闭、定位、卸载并可撤回）。随包自带一个维护技能。

description.en: Skill quick-pick panel for the composer: lists the session's skills by source, inserts /name into the draft without sending it, and can disable, uninstall or track usage per skill. Disabling skills (rewrites SKILL.md), uninstalling them (moves the folder to a trash), usage statistics (reads local session logs) and model translation of skill names are all off by default and switched on one by one in the panel settings.
description.zh: 输入框技能快捷面板：按来源列出当前会话的技能，把 /技能名 插入草稿（绝不自动发送），并可逐技能禁用、卸载与统计使用次数。禁用技能（会改写 SKILL.md）、卸载技能（把目录移进回收站）、使用统计（读取本机会话日志）和用模型翻译技能名都默认关闭，要在面板设置里逐项开启。

description.en: Auto-detects whichever memory tool local Hermes uses, then reuses its skills and memory in DeepSeek Harness, with always-available recall. Needs python3 and a local Hermes installation; it only reads from Hermes.
description.zh: 自动识别本机 Hermes 当前使用的记忆工具，把技能与记忆实时接入 DSH，检索始终可用。需要 python3 与本机已装的 Hermes；对 Hermes 只读。

description.en: Windows host rules for DSH agents: one skill with nine individually switchable rules (UTF-8/BOM, CRLF-LF per file type, build output, SmartScreen, _scratch isolation, screenshot privacy gate, teardown, shared-doc lock, local trust marks) and six bundled dependency-free scripts.
description.zh: 为 DSH Agent 提供 Windows 宿主规则：一个九条规则、可逐条开关的技能（UTF-8/BOM、按文件类型的 CRLF/LF、构建产物、SmartScreen、_scratch 隔离、截图隐私门禁、临时产物清理、共享文档锁、本地信任标记），附带六个零依赖脚本。

description.en: Bundles the 14 obra/superpowers skills for dsh from a recorded upstream tag (v6.3.0), re-syncable with drift reporting; the skills trigger automatically.
description.zh: 把 obra/superpowers 的 14 个技能按已记录的上游 tag（v6.3.0）打包进 dsh，并可用带差异报告的命令重新同步；任务匹配时自动触发。

description.en: Turns a YouTube link into study notes: pulls the captions the video already publishes, optionally reads on-screen content with a vision model, then asks for your own notes and merges everything into one document. Requires python3, ffmpeg and yt-dlp on PATH (the skill stops with an install hint when they are missing).
description.zh: 把 YouTube 链接变成学习笔记：先取视频自带字幕，可选让视觉模型读画面，再问你自己的笔记，最后合并成一份文档。需 PATH 上有 python3、ffmpeg 与 yt-dlp（缺失时技能会停下来并给出安装提示）。

description.en: Skill dossier + work report for DSH: browse, search and archive each skill (direction, scope, boundaries, scenarios), review or delete it, and roll daily briefs into daily, weekly and monthly reports.
description.zh: DSH 技能档案与工作汇报：浏览、搜索并为每个技能建档（方向/使用范围/能力边界/应用场景），复审与删除技能，并把每日简报汇成日报/周报/月报。

description.en: E-commerce order analysis skill for DSH: refund-type classification, return-rate statistics, interception and refund-abuse loss accounting, after-sales analysis with product warnings, delivered as a single Excel workbook with a per-order detail sheet and a sampling verification sheet (the agent builds it with Python: pandas, openpyxl, matplotlib).
description.zh: 电商订单数据分析技能：退款类型分类、退货率统计、拦截件与白嫖损耗核算、售后深度与商品预警，交付为单个 Excel 工作簿（含订单明细表与抽样验证表）；由智能体用 Python（pandas、openpyxl、matplotlib）生成。

description.en: Registers a frontend-design skill that asks for a design plan and token system before writing code, and ships Chinese typography rules plus a measured no-screenshot self-check. It provides one skill and no tools, makes no network requests and writes no files.
description.zh: 注册一个前端设计技能：写码前先给设计计划与 token 系统，附中文排版规则和可实测的无截图自检。只提供一个技能，无工具、不联网、不写文件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness port of the Impeccable frontend-design skill: 24 design playbooks covering shaping, critique, audit, polish, layout, typography, motion, accessibility and design-system documentation, driven by the reference files shipped in the skill plus PRODUCT.md / DESIGN.md in the project instead of a downloaded engine binary. Registers the impeccable skill; reads project files and writes design artifacts under .impeccable/. The binary-only features (live browser bridge, pixel measurement, font matching) fall back to static variants, screenshots and explicitly declared manual estimates. Ported from pbakaus/impeccable (Apache-2.0).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Impeccable 前端设计技能：24 个设计剧本覆盖界面塑造、评审、审查、打磨、布局、排版、动效、无障碍与设计系统文档，靠技能自带的参考文件加项目里的 PRODUCT.md / DESIGN.md 驱动，不下载任何引擎二进制。注册 impeccable 技能；读取项目文件并在 .impeccable/ 下产出设计产物。依赖二进制的环节（实浏览器桥、像素测量、字体匹配）降级为静态变体、截图与显式声明的人工估算。改编自 pbakaus/impeccable（Apache-2.0）。

description.en: White-box testing workflow skill for embedded C: host-side stub harness, wb.py test driver with gcov coverage gating, and a control-logic study handbook template.
description.zh: 嵌入式 C 白盒测试工作流技能：宿主机打桩 harness、wb.py 测试驱动与 gcov 覆盖率门禁、控制逻辑学习手册模板。

description.en: Network Engineer Assistant preset plus a 12-vendor, 96-document switch/router/firewall command knowledge base skill (Huawei, H3C, Ruijie, DPtech, Cisco IOS/IOS-XE, Cisco NX-OS, Juniper Junos, Arista EOS, Fortinet FortiOS, ZTE ZXR10, VyOS, MikroTik RouterOS) with KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI screenshot reading, cited online manual lookup, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only. A community continuation of sososilencing/dsh-network-engineer (see NOTICE.md); it cannot be installed alongside that upstream plugin because both register the network-command-kb skill and a 网络工程师助手 preset.
description.zh: 网络工程师助手预设 + 12 厂商 96 篇交换机/路由器/防火墙命令知识库技能（华为/新华三/锐捷/迪普/思科 IOS·NX-OS/Junos/Arista EOS/FortiOS/中兴/VyOS/MikroTik），支持知识库优先检索、跨厂商命令对照、拓扑与 CLI 截图识图、带引用的联网查手册，并对高危命令强制 ⚠️ 风险标注；仅回答网络工程主题。是 sososilencing/dsh-network-engineer 的社区延续版（见 NOTICE.md）；两者注册同一个 network-command-kb 技能和同一个「网络工程师助手」预设，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Scheduled tasks and message push manager: cron scheduling with auto push to Feishu and multi-channel, dual-env (OpenClaw/DSH).
description.zh: 定时任务与消息推送管家：统一管理 cron 调度，自动推送飞书/多端，兼容 OpenClaw 与 DSH 双环境。

description.en: Browses and edits the skills directory in a VSCode-style file tree and editor panel in the DSH web client sidebar: creates, renames and deletes files and directories, reads and saves text files under size caps, and switches the served root directory from the panel (persisted through the profile config editor).
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 客户端侧边栏里用 VSCode 风格的文件树与编辑器面板浏览和编辑技能目录：新建、重命名、删除文件与目录，在大小上限内读写文本文件，并可在面板内切换所服务的根目录（通过 profile 配置编辑器持久化）。

description.en: DSH composer UI for searching current-session user-invocable skills and inserting the verified slash command into the draft without sending.
description.zh: DSH composer 界面：搜索当前会话可手动调用的 Skill，并将宿主可识别的斜杠命令写入草稿，不自动发送。

description.en: Gives agents the DSH (Cordis) plugin authoring contract and the dsh plugin market submission process, from the bundle manifest and entry module to the pull request.
description.zh: 给 agent 一套 DSH（Cordis）插件编写规范与 dsh 插件市场收录流程，从 bundle manifest、入口模块一直讲到提交 PR。

description.en: Measures one university department's research output: matches author affiliation strings against a college's known name variants (detecting same-named departments at other universities), backfills papers that only name the university by faculty author IDs, classifies each paper by journal tier (CAS partition with Top flag, JCR quartile, CCF, Chinese core via a CNKI export merger), splits staff from student first authors, and writes a workbook with a dashboard sheet, a filterable paper list, a teacher-by-direction matrix and per-teacher statistics. Student authorship is inferred from affiliation and staff lists, not verified against enrolment records. Requires Python 3.9+ with pandas and openpyxl (pip install -r requirements.txt); papers come from the OpenAlex API, whose free per-IP quota is limited, and Chinese-journal coverage needs a manual CNKI export.
description.zh: 统计某一所大学某个学院（二级单位）的科研产出：按作者单位串匹配学院的各种英文写法（并检测其他高校的同名院系），对只写到校名一级的论文用教师作者 ID 反查补全，再按期刊层级分类（中科院分区含 Top 标记、JCR 分区、CCF、经知网导出合并的中文核心），区分教师与学生一作，输出含看板页、可筛选论文清单、教师-方向矩阵和教师个人统计的工作簿。学生身份由单位与教师名单推定，未与学籍核对。需 Python 3.9+ 与 pandas、openpyxl（pip install -r requirements.txt）；题录走 OpenAlex 接口（按 IP 计的免费额度有限），中文期刊需人工从知网导出后合并。

description.en: Moves skills into a configurable directory and lets each workspace choose which skills it enables, avoiding context spent on unused skills.
description.zh: 把技能集中到可配置目录，并按工作区勾选启用的技能，避免每个会话都为用不上的技能付出上下文。

description.en: Career knowledge base vault with ten agent skills for setup, capture and import, audit, JD resumes, interview prep and review, plus Feishu interop.
description.zh: 职业生涯知识库：六大模块 + 十项技能，支持全库巡检、存入与导入、JD 简历、面试准备与复盘，并对接飞书。

description.en: Takes the user's own .pptx template plus a course outline (lesson plan / document / plain text) and produces a courseware .pptx that adopts the template's background, color scheme, fonts, and page skeleton. Pure plugin package, no built-in API keys; the image backend must be configured by the user.
description.zh: 拿用户自己的 .pptx 模板 + 一份课程大纲（教案/文档/纯文本），产出套用该模板背景、配色、字体、页面骨架的课件 .pptx。纯插件包，无内置密钥，图片后端需用户自行配置。

description.en: Turn a feature that actually runs into a trustworthy delivery demo video, or a defect into a traceable feedback video: real screen recordings, edge-tts narration with word-clock subtitles, a self-contained ffmpeg pipeline, and a deterministic quality gate (spec, audio, loudness, black/freeze/silence scans) that refuses to pass a fake or broken demo. Feedback episodes add severity/phase chips, a repro-steps overlay and a ticket-ready report bound to the artifact SHA256. Preflight and artifact verification included. Requires Python 3.9+, ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH, and `pip install edge-tts Pillow`; narration calls the public edge-tts endpoint.
description.zh: 把真实运行的功能做成可信交付演示视频，或把缺陷做成可追溯的问题反馈视频：真实录屏、edge-tts 旁白与逐字对齐字幕、自包含 ffmpeg 管线，配一道拒绝放过造假或残次演示的确定性质量闸（规格、音轨、响度、黑帧/冻结/静音扫描），含渲染前预检与成片证据核验。反馈模式带严重级别/阶段徽标、复现步骤浮层，以及按成片 SHA256 绑定的工单级问题报告。需 Python 3.9+、PATH 上的 ffmpeg/ffprobe，以及 `pip install edge-tts Pillow`；旁白会调用 edge-tts 公共接口。

description.en: Autonomous product-polish loop skill: every round opens a fresh brainstorm from 3 forced perspectives, picks one small angle capped at ≤3 files and ≈100 lines, implements it, verifies with the repo's own tests, build or lint, and commits it as a single round commit; the round is logged to a per-project ledger, and ideas too big for one round go to an icebox. A red check ships nothing — the round commit is reverted immediately so the failed diff stays in history. Non-git targets are rejected before any work starts. Pure skill bundle: no MCP server, no runtime dependencies. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3.0.
description.zh: 自主产品打磨循环技能：每轮强制开一轮全新三视角头脑风暴，选一个 ≤3 文件 / ≈100 行的小角度实现，用仓库自身的测试、构建或 lint 验证后以单个 commit 提交；轮次记入项目内 ledger，一轮装不下的好想法进 icebox。检查红灯不发版——先提交再立即 revert，失败 diff 留在历史。非 git 目标开工前即拒绝。纯技能包：无 MCP 服务、无运行时依赖。要求 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 或更新、低于 0.3.0。

description.en: Skill shell that installs, runs and troubleshoots React-Monitor-Agent, a human-agent operation board built on review replay and checkpoints: the agent writes its work as a structured replay timeline of screenshot, diff, text, link and file nodes, and the human decides at plan, progress, risk and delivery checkpoints, with verdicts branching the timeline and rejected branches kept greyed-out for audit. The skill guides cloning the source repo and starting a zero-dependency Node event service on 127.0.0.1:8790 plus a React board on localhost:5173 that ships an offline FIXTURE demo mode. The bundle embeds the skill only; product source stays in the repo.
description.zh: 安装壳技能：安装、跑起并排障 React-Monitor-Agent 人机协作操作板——agent 把工作过程写成由截图、diff、文本、链接、文件节点组成的结构化回放时间线，人在方案/阶段/风险/完工四类检查点上拍板，决策改变时间线走向，被否定/改向的旧分支灰掉保留以供审计。技能引导克隆主仓，启动零依赖 Node 事件服务（127.0.0.1:8790）与 React 操作板（localhost:5173），操作板内置离线 FIXTURE 演示模式。bundle 只内嵌技能，产品源码以主仓为准。

description.en: Fully local push-to-talk voice input for macOS: hold a global hotkey, speak, release — transcription is pasted at your cursor. Local-first STT (Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 4bit on MLX/Metal by default, SenseVoice and mlx-whisper fallbacks), zero external APIs, launchd self-healing service and an 8-point diagnose script. The bundled skill lets the agent install, configure (Karabiner hotkey wiring, launchd, engine switching) and troubleshoot the whole toolchain for you.
description.zh: macOS 本地按住说话语音输入：按住全局热键说话、松开即转写粘贴到光标处。纯本地 STT（默认 Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 4bit 走 MLX/Metal，SenseVoice / mlx-whisper 双 fallback），零外部 API，launchd 自愈常驻 + 8 项自检。内置技能让 agent 代你完成安装、Karabiner 热键接线、launchd 配置、引擎切换与全链排障。

description.en: Searches medical and life-science literature by topic, keyword or DOI through Europe PMC, PubMed, OpenAlex and Crossref; decides open-access status through Unpaywall/OpenAlex/Europe PMC; downloads the PDF when an OA route exists (verified by magic bytes and page count) and otherwise writes a decision card with the exact failure reason plus four manual fallback channels: AbleSci assistance, Sci-Hub, SciDown and X-MOL. The bundled Python tool uses only the standard library.
description.zh: 按领域、检索词或 DOI 检索医学与生命科学文献（Europe PMC / PubMed / OpenAlex / Crossref），用 Unpaywall 等源判定开放获取状态，能拿到 OA 全文时自动下载并通过文件头与页数校验；拿不到时生成决策卡，写清自动下载失败的具体原因，并给出科研通互助、Sci-Hub、SciDown、X-MOL 四条人工通道的直达链接，人工取回后用一条命令登记入库。随包 Python 工具仅依赖标准库。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle of 14 obra/superpowers engineering skills with a native agent preset, automatic session bootstrap, and Windows sandbox compatibility.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 的 14 个工程技能打包为 DeepSeek Harness bundle，附原生 Agent 预设、自动会话引导和 Windows 沙箱兼容。

description.en: Windows WeChat 4.x chat export toolchain shipped as a skill: discovers SQLCipher shards, decrypts, exports and merges them; conversion, stats, AI relationship analysis and HTML reporting delegate to the locally installed she-love-me skill. Requires Python 3.9+ for the analysis stages.
description.zh: Windows 微信 4.x 聊天导出工具链技能：自动发现、解密、导出并合并 SQLCipher 分片；转换、统计、AI 关系分析与 HTML 报告委托给本机已装的 she-love-me 技能。分析阶段需要 Python 3.9+。

description.en: Skill usage history rebuilt from local session logs, with per-day counts, session drill-down and custom groups.
description.zh: 从本机会话日志回填的技能使用历史：按天计数、下钻到会话、自定义分组。

description.en: Resolves unique kebab-case skill substrings in slash tokens, so /oneshot can load game-package-oneshot.
description.zh: 用唯一 kebab 片段解析斜杠 skill，例如 /oneshot 可加载 game-package-oneshot。

description.en: Merged, version-locked plugin upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness (0.1.3-alpha.1 to 0.1.5-rc.1 as two closed legs): an evidence-bound version card plus a zero-dependency 20-seam scanner, shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.
description.zh: 合并后的版本锁定插件升级技能（0.1.3-alpha.1 → 0.1.5-rc.1，两条闭环腿）：证据绑定版本卡 + 零依赖 20 接缝扫描器，以 bundle 技能 + npx CLI 两种形态发布。

description.en: AI video prompt style library with a Chinese aesthetic: 12 visual styles (6 original Chinese styles, 6 international rewrites) that turn a look into paste-ready Chinese prompts for Jimeng, Seedance, Kling and Tongyi Wanxiang.
description.zh: 中式美学 AI 视频提示词风格库：12 个视觉风格（6 个国风原创、6 个国际风格重写），把题材翻成可直接粘贴进即梦 / Seedance / 可灵 / 通义万相的中文提示词；本库只产出提示词，不生成图片或视频。

description.en: Folds the DSH skill catalog prompt surface with KV-cache-stable rendering, BM25/bge-m3 hybrid skill search, and optional auto route hints.
description.zh: 折叠 DSH 技能目录提示面：KV 缓存稳定渲染 + BM25/bge-m3 混合技能检索 + 可选自动路由提示。

description.en: Registers bundled full-stack, frontend-design and browser-automation skill documents as four read-only tools; a focus argument selects which reference file is returned alongside the skill body.
description.zh: 把内置的全栈开发、前端设计与浏览器自动化三份技能文档注册为四个只读工具，用 focus 参数指定随技能正文一并返回的参考文档。

description.en: Skill that reviews your coding-agent session transcripts (Claude Code and Codex only; DSH's own transcripts are not supported) over the last two weeks and reports which skills, hooks and rules work, need attention or go unused. Requires Python 3.
description.zh: 技能：回看最近两周的编程助手会话记录（仅 Claude Code 与 Codex，不支持 DSH 自身会话），报告哪些技能、钩子和规则有效、需要关注或从未使用。需要 Python 3。

description.en: Live skill provider that reads every Xiaomi MiMo (MiMo Desktop / MiMoCode) skill into the DSH session catalog: the engine-bundled skills under engine-config (unpacked from app.asar when that directory is absent), the MiMoCode global and project roots, extension-contributed skill directories declared in extensions.json, and the brand compatibility roots MiMo's own skillPathCompat setting enables.
description.zh: 实时技能提供器：把小米 MiMo（MiMo Desktop / MiMoCode）的全部 skill 读进 DSH 会话技能目录——engine-config 下的引擎内置技能（该目录缺失时从 app.asar 解包）、MiMoCode 全局与项目根、extensions.json 里扩展贡献的技能目录，以及 MiMo 自己的 skillPathCompat 开关启用的品牌兼容根。

description.en: Evidence-first reuse skill for DeepSeek Harness: before implementing, porting, choosing dependencies, or troubleshooting a tool, it searches the local project and machine for existing solutions in layers, judges reuse on checkable evidence, refuses reuse when essential requirements or risks are unmet, and reports what could not be verified. Ships as a DSH bundle that registers the skill on ctx.skills.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「先找本地现成方案、再用证据验证」技能：动手实现、移植、选依赖、排查工具之前，先在项目与本机分层检索已有方案，用可核对的证据判断能否复用，必要条件或风险不满足时明确拒绝复用，并写清哪些结论无法核实。以 DSH 组合包（dsh.bundle）注册到 ctx.skills。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness skill plugin that reviews law theses (international economic law and other legal topics): reads a student Word .docx, checks it against a bundled common-issue checklist, applies definite fixes as tracked changes, and adds Word comments for overall/section problems and missing-basis issues, then emits a short objective overall review plus a fix list.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能插件：批改法学论文（国际经济法等）。读取学生 Word 论文，对照打包的常见问题清单逐项检查；可直接确定的错漏以 Word 修订模式修改，对部分整体问题、缺依据/缺澄清之处写 Word 批注；并输出简短、客观、以宏观点评为主的总体评语与待修改清单。

description.en: Bundles 50 AMD ROSS agent skills for Vivado, Vitis HLS, Versal segmented configuration, Vitis AI, and hardware debug into DeepSeek Harness, with a left-sidebar catalog panel for filtering, searching, and copying skill invocations.
description.zh: 把 AMD ROSS 的 50 个 Vivado、Vitis HLS、Versal 分段配置、Vitis AI 与硬件调试技能装进 DeepSeek Harness，并在左侧栏提供可筛选、搜索、展开与复制的技能目录面板。

description.en: Publish size check skill: verifies a deliverable's geometric specs against a target platform before publishing - pixel dimensions, aspect ratio, dpi, file size, format, physical print width and colour mode. Geometry only: it does not review content compliance (QR codes, text-to-image ratio, copyright and prohibited content are out of scope). Pure Python standard library, no third-party packages, and inputs are never modified. Python 3.8+. Covers 10 platforms and 20 slots with per-platform confidence labels - WeChat MP, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Zhihu, Weibo, Douyin, WeChat Channels, journal submission, print and client delivery - and resolves a platform by id, Chinese name or alias with fuzzy matching. Two trigger modes: asked directly, or as a parasitic self-check that runs by itself once an image, poster, chart or export workflow has written a file and the user mentioned a publishing target, reporting in one line when everything passes and only expanding when something is wrong. For journal submission and print it judges by physical width (pixels / dpi), which catches files whose dpi metadata passes but whose actual printed size is too small; for multi-image posts it checks whether the whole set is consistent and names the odd one out rather than listing every file.
description.zh: 发布尺寸检查技能：发布前对照目标平台的几何规格核验交付物——像素尺寸、宽高比、dpi、体积、格式、物理印刷宽度、色彩模式。只查几何参数，不做内容合规审查（二维码、文字占比、版权、违规内容均不在范围内）。纯 Python 标准库实现，不装任何第三方包，原件全程只读。需 Python 3.8+。覆盖 10 个平台、20 个槽位，并按平台标注可信度——微信公众号、小红书、哔哩哔哩、知乎、微博、抖音、微信视频号、学术投稿、印刷交付、甲方交付；平台参数支持 id、中文名、别名，模糊匹配也能命中。两种触发：直接提问，或作为「寄生自检」在出图/海报/图表/导出流程落盘且用户提到发布目标后自行运行，全部通过时一句话带过，有问题才展开。投稿与印刷按「像素÷dpi=实际印刷宽度」判定，能抓出 dpi 字段达标但实际尺寸不足的图；多图连发时检查整组是否整齐，并指出少数派是哪一张，而不是罗列每个文件。

description.en: Discovers workspace Markdown commands, skills and path-scoped rules from .dsh and .agents directories.
description.zh: 从 .dsh 与 .agents 目录发现工作区 Markdown 命令、技能和按路径生效的规则。

description.en: Manage local skills across AI agents with version comparison, shared-directory consolidation, and recoverable migration and deletion.
description.zh: 管理多个 AI Agent 的本地技能，支持版本比较、合并到公用目录，以及可恢复的迁移和删除。

description.en: Captures verified project work as masked evidence and reviewable skill proposals; accepted skills become native project skills with version history, diff, rollback, and opt-in global publishing.
description.zh: 把已验证的项目工作保存为脱敏证据和可审核的技能提案；接受的技能会成为原生项目技能，并带有版本历史、差异、回滚和可选的全局发布。

description.en: Experiment-orchestration SOP skill for long-running experiments. A top-level model drafts a decomposition plan — subtasks, the model for each, an acceptance figure with tolerance, and dependency order — and dispatches only after the user confirms that plan; each subtask then goes to a lightweight executor subagent as a self-contained prompt, and its report is confined to measured facts and the delta from the agreed figure, with judgement and decisions staying at the top level. Ships one plan template and five task templates (gather, execute, consistency check, read-only review, mechanical transform), acceptance gates split into a task layer and an experiment layer, and three rules that stop internal-consistency evidence from being presented as independent or external validation.
description.zh: 实验编排 SOP 技能：顶层模型起草分解计划（子任务、每个的模型、带容差的验收基准、依赖顺序），经用户确认后才派工；每个子任务以自包含 prompt 交给轻量子智能体执行，回报限定为测量事实与基准差值，判读与裁决留在顶层。附一份分解计划模板、五类任务模板（采集/执行/一致性校验/只读审查/机械转换）、任务层与实验层两级验收门，以及三条防止把内部一致性证据说成独立或外部验证的规则。

description.en: Ships a skill for verifying a change with the cheapest check that still yields a definite answer: an L0-L3 cost ladder from static checks to a single suite, condition polling with a timeout instead of fixed sleeps, assertions that can actually fail, and durations that are measured rather than remembered. The package also carries the two zero-dependency Node tools the skill calls - wait-until.mjs (poll a command, a file, or a port until it is ready) and measure-runtime.mjs (wall-clock timing for any command, plus a segmented timer for library use).
description.zh: 携带一份技能：用仍然能给出确定结论的最便宜手段验证改动——L0–L3 成本阶梯（静态检查到单个测试套件）、用条件轮询加超时替代固定延时、断言必须能失败、耗时必须实测而不是凭印象。包里还带着这份技能调用的两个零依赖 Node 工具：wait-until.mjs（轮询命令 / 文件 / 端口直到就绪）与 measure-runtime.mjs（测任意命令的墙钟耗时，库模式下提供分段计时）。

description.en: Google's Agent Skills (google/skills) for DeepSeek Harness: 128 bundled SKILL.md skills for Google Cloud, BigQuery, GKE, Gemini, Firebase, ads and analytics.
description.zh: Google 的 Agent Skills(google/skills)for DeepSeek Harness：128 个打包的 SKILL.md 技能，覆盖 Google Cloud、BigQuery、GKE、Gemini、Firebase、广告与分析。

description.en: Shows what each installed skill costs in the model context and hides a skill from the catalog without deleting it. Lists every skill found on disk with the exact catalog line the model receives (description normalized and truncated at the catalog cap), its body size and token estimate; previews the catalog message byte-for-byte as the agent will receive it, compares that with the copy already published in the current session, and reports skills on disk that never reach the catalog (invalid frontmatter, or shadowed by a higher-priority root). Hiding writes disable-model-invocation into frontmatter and keeps the file, so the skill still works via /name. Also imports skills from ClawHub, Skills.sh and GitHub URLs and uninstalls user-owned ones.
description.zh: 显示每个已安装 skill 在模型上下文中占多少，并能在不删除文件的前提下把它从目录里摘掉。按 DSH 的渲染规则给出模型实际看到的那一行（介绍归一化并按目录上限截断）、正文体积与 token 估算；可逐字预览模型将收到的目录消息，与会话里已发布的那份比对，并列出来自磁盘却进不了目录的 skill（frontmatter 无效，或被更高优先级的同名 skill 覆盖）。隐藏会写入 disable-model-invocation 并保留文件，skill 仍可通过 /名字 调用。同时支持从 ClawHub、Skills.sh 与 GitHub 链接导入，以及卸载用户目录下的 skill。

description.en: Intervals.icu-only endurance-coaching skill bundle that turns Intervals.icu training data (activities, intervals, streams, training load CTL/ATL/TSB/rampRate, HRV, resting heart rate, sleep in-bed hours, eFTP, power curves) into concrete training decisions: readiness gating, VDOT pace and heart-rate zones, periodized weekly plans written back to the Intervals.icu calendar as events after confirmation, session reviews, race-day pacing and fueling, and weather-adjusted workouts. The bundle registers the endurance-coach skill in the profile, ships deterministic helper scripts, reads an athlete profile created by its init script, and requires the agent to state when data is unavailable instead of inventing it. It needs a separately installed Intervals.icu MCP server for training data and Python 3.10+ for its bundled scripts; with neither it works only from numbers you type in.
description.zh: 只依赖 Intervals.icu 的耐力训练决策技能包：把 ICU 训练数据（活动、分圈、秒流、综合负荷 CTL/ATL/TSB/rampRate、HRV、静息心率、睡眠在床时长、eFTP、功率曲线）变成可执行决策——恢复闸门、VDOT 配速与心率区间、周期化周计划（确认后写成 ICU 日历事件）、单次复盘、赛前配速与补给、按天气修正训练。插件在 profile 里注册 endurance-coach 技能，内置确定性计算脚本，读取初始化脚本生成的运动员档案，并强制「取不到数据就如实说明、不得编造」。需要另行安装 Intervals.icu MCP server；内置脚本需 Python 3.10+；两者都没有时只能用手工输入的数字。

description.en: Reusable experience for DeepSeek Harness: save a successful task as a structured playbook, recall it later as a native skill, and gate deliveries behind user-confirmed checks that require objective evidence before write actions are allowed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的经验复用与交付闸门：把成功任务沉淀为结构化 playbook，同质任务自动作为原生 Skill 召回；交付闸门经用户确认后，写文件前必须逐项拿到客观证据，否则动作被硬拦截。

description.en: Skill manager for DSH: drag rows into the order you want, pin any row straight to position 1, and rename a skill inline. Applying rewrites each directory name and the name field in SKILL.md. A skill that appears later is numbered and cleaned up automatically, and a description past 20 Chinese characters gets rewritten. Every change clears the host skill cache and notifies each session, so the slash menu follows at once without restarting DSH. Local-only and offline. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a page open in your browser could trigger a rename or reorder of your skill folders.
description.zh: DSH 的技能管家：拖拽排序、一键置顶、行内改名。应用后同步改写目录名与 SKILL.md 的 name；新技能进来自动补编号、洗净名字，简介超过 20 个汉字的自动改写。改完清掉宿主技能缓存并通知每个会话，斜杠菜单当场跟着变，不用重启 DSH。纯本地离线运行。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以触发对你技能目录的重命名或重排。

description.en: It shows the number of confirmed loaded skills in the conversation header. Click **技能** (Skills) to open the right sidebar and check whether each skill's full main body remains in the current main assistant context, along with its recorded versions and sources.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏显示已确认加载的技能数量，点击「技能」打开右侧面板，查看完整正文是否仍在当前主助手上下文中，以及各次加载的正文版本与来源。

description.en: An on-demand Chinese editing skill that reduces formulaic phrasing while preserving facts, uncertainty, genre, and author voice.
description.zh: 按需润色中文文本，减少模板化表达，同时保留事实、确定程度、文体和作者声音。

description.en: File-state cache skill for coding agents: one explore call replaces ls+grep+read, reads remember they already happened, and edits return a diff plus the exact changed line range instead of a full re-read. State is a JSON cache on disk, so it survives across tool calls and restarts. Requires Python 3.8+ (standard library only).
description.zh: 文件状态缓存技能：一次 explore 代替 ls+grep+read，读过的文件不再重复全量读，改完只回 diff 与精确变更行区间而不是重读全文。状态存在磁盘上的 JSON 缓存里，跨工具调用与重启都有效。需要 Python 3.8+（仅标准库，无需安装第三方依赖）。

description.en: Arms a watch on a directory and delivers a batched, deduplicated diff when the tree goes quiet, filtering out the writes the session made itself; delivery is per watch, either waking a new turn or queueing for the next step.
description.zh: 监视目录，在文件树安静后投递批量合并、去重的变更清单，并过滤掉本会话自己的写入；投递方式按监视器选择，可起新回合或排队到下一步。

description.en: Learning-plan tracker with local progress, notes and JSON progress backup. Ships one original six-node example roadmap; adding your own roadmaps means editing roadmaps.ts and rebuilding the plugin. Needs the dsh-studio-projects runtime and the dsh-worktable container from 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library installed first.
description.zh: 学习计划追踪：本机进度、笔记与 JSON 进度备份，附带一条原创六节点示例路线；添加自己的路线需编辑 roadmaps.ts 并重新构建插件。需先安装 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library 的 dsh-studio-projects 运行时与 dsh-worktable 容器。

description.en: Guided first-project harness: asks open questions about your day, shows what it heard versus what it only infers for you to correct, proposes 2-3 projects that reach a runnable prototype in one to two hours, and starts the one you pick — resuming from saved progress if you come back later.
description.zh: 引导式起步：先用开放问题了解你，把你说的和它推断的分两栏让你改，再给两三个一小时能做出雏形的小项目，选定后立刻陪你动手；中途退出后再回来会从上次停下的地方继续。

description.en: Mailbox for DeepSeek Harness: sessions pass letters through a shared folder, and an hourly randomized scheduler can wake a session on its own (mutual letters between two sessions, or a gentle nudge to the owner). Per-recipient hourly rate limit and a UTF-8 log.
description.zh: DSH 会话信箱：两间会话用文件夹互相传信，另加按小时随机调度——互递信，或主动找主人说话；每个收信人每小时限流，带 UTF-8 日志。

description.en: Deliver-and-align mode: the agent hands over one block at a time through an align_deliver tool, each block lands on disk immediately so you can edit it in place, and the agent re-reads your version before continuing.
description.zh: 交付对齐模式：AI 通过 align_deliver 工具一次只交付一块，每块直接落盘、你可以就地在文件里改，AI 重读你的版本后再继续；方向错了可带时间戳备份安全返工。

description.en: Scheduled model-news radar: collects official release announcements from LLM vendors through RSS, Hugging Face and GitHub organisation APIs and changelog pages (a 6-vendor sample list is bundled, a user-maintained list is read from ~/.dsh/model-news-radar/sources.json), deduplicates them into daily, weekly or monthly Markdown reports and opens a DSH session that writes the summary. Read-only, no logins, no third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 模型资讯雷达：按厂商官方来源清单（RSS、Hugging Face 与 GitHub 组织接口、变更页；自带 6 家示例清单，完整清单读 ~/.dsh/model-news-radar/sources.json）定时采集大模型发布资讯，去重后写成日报 / 周报 / 月报，并起一个 DSH 会话写摘要。只读，不登录任何平台，无第三方依赖。

description.en: Windows-only: adds a switch to Settings → General that powers the computer off when the finished conversation ends (default delay 60 s, configurable 5–86400 s), behind a native countdown dialog that cancels the pending shutdown in one click (shutdown /a).
description.zh: 仅 Windows：在「设置 → 通用」增加一个开关，本次对话完成后按设定延迟（默认 60 秒，可设 5–86400 秒）自动关机，并弹出原生倒计时窗口，点一下即执行 shutdown /a 取消本次关机。

description.en: Preset workflow template library: 12 reusable orchestration script templates with wf_template_list / wf_template_search / wf_template_run / wf_template_validate tools and static template validation.
description.zh: 预置 Workflow 模板库：12 个可复用编排脚本模板，提供 wf_template_list / wf_template_search / wf_template_run / wf_template_validate 工具与模板格式静态校验。

description.en: Annotatable checkpoint reviews: highlight any passage of a delivered document, comment on each decision point, and return one structured note; a single ask_user_question with three or more questions is answered on one sheet.
description.zh: 给阶段交付做可批注的验收单：在正文上划词、逐条写意见，一次回传结构化结果；单次 ask_user_question 三题以上合并成一屏提交。

description.en: Tracks successful DSH plugin installs per device, merges the ledger across devices through a user-authorized Baidu Netdisk account, and supports preflighted batch reinstalls.
description.zh: 按设备记录 DSH 插件成功安装历史，通过用户授权的百度网盘账号跨设备合并账本，并支持预检后的批量重装。

description.en: Keeps an unattended DeepSeek Harness session moving when nobody answers ask_user_question: it fronts the question waterfall, leaves a human answer untouched, and after a configurable window (120 s by default) submits the option marked (Recommended)/（推荐）, or the configured first/last fallback; plan reviews stay with the human unless explicitly enabled.
description.zh: 无人值守时没人回答 ask_user_question，也让会话继续走：站在问题 waterfall 前面，有人回答就原样放行；超过可配置窗口（默认 120 秒）后提交标了（推荐）/(Recommended) 的选项，或按 first/last 兜底；计划审批默认仍交给人，需显式开启。

description.en: Workflow tools for the local aflare binary: generate, validate and run local-first deterministic YAML workflow DAGs (WAL crash recovery, Saga compensation) through the local aflare binary, with 300+ templates built in.
description.zh: aflare 工作流工具：通过本地 aflare 二进制生成、校验并执行本地优先的确定性 YAML 工作流 DAG（WAL 崩溃恢复、Saga 补偿），内置 300+ 模板。

description.en: Multi-agent delivery workflow for dsh: a commander dispatches to fixed and temporary agents through a persisted task state machine, with a canvas and roster in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多 Agent 交付编排：总指挥派发 + 固定/临时员工 + 落盘任务状态机，右侧栏提供画布与名册面板。

description.en: Parse PRDs and PDFs, ask clarifying questions in batches, consolidate a BRIEF.md system brief, and package deliverables for upload.
description.zh: 解析 PRD/PDF、分批追问澄清目标系统并沉淀 BRIEF.md，最终打包可上传交付物。

description.en: Keeps a DeepSeek Harness run going on its own: continues a turn that ended abnormally, and continues a turn logged as completed while the model tool call was emitted as plain text instead, which leaves the agent silently idle. Revives a model request that stops streaming. A wait on an approval or on a question is logged and notified, never answered.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的回合自己接上：轮次异常结束时补一条继续；工具调用被中转站当成正文吐出、回合却仍记为正常结束时，补一条带指向性的继续，让它重新发起工具调用；模型请求不再出流时掐掉当前轮重来。卡在审批或提问只记录并提醒，不代为回答。

description.en: An isolated translation pipeline where each module is its own model call carrying only its own prompt and its own input — no session history, no tool schemas, no other module's content. Build chains from draggable cards, edit any module's prompt in place, override the model per module, or start from one of two precision presets. The same chain is exposed to the agent as a translate_flow tool.
description.zh: 隔离式翻译链路：每个模块都是一次独立的模型调用，只携带自己的提示词和自己的输入——不带会话历史、不带工具定义、不带其他模块的内容。用可拖拽卡片编排链路，就地编辑任意模块的提示词，按模块覆盖模型，也可直接套用两套精译预设。同一条链路还以 translate_flow 工具的形式提供给智能体。

description.en: Adds a system-prompt rule that makes DSH agents look for existing work before they build.
description.zh: 给 DSH 代理加一条系统提示规则，让它动手前先找现成方案，而不是闭门造车。

description.en: Auto Mode for DSH: a flash-model router that auto-picks the best agent preset (standard/code/minimal/cordis) for each new session and executes immediately, no confirmation.
description.zh: DSH 自动模式：用 Flash 模型为每个新会话自动判断最合适的 Agent 预设（标准/PTC/极简/创造）并直接执行，无需确认。

description.en: A fact layer for daily heartbeat turns: diffs the curated plugin market for newly published entries and the Chinese education SRC calendars (EDUSRC rounds, Beijing education SRC seasons, the standing vulnerability-hunting exercise) for new items. Reports deltas only — the first call seeds a baseline and stays quiet.
description.zh: 给每日巡检回合提供事实层：对比插件市场注册表报新增条目，对比教育行业 SRC 页面（EDUSRC 众测、北京教育 SRC 赛季、常态化演习）报新一期活动。只报变化，首次调用只建基线、不报新增。

description.en: Restart DSH and find out whether it actually came back. Windows has no external way to make Electron quit cleanly (WM_CLOSE just minimises the window), so this plugin does not pretend: it terminates the host, relaunches it with retries, then polls the host port until it really serves again, and reports the outcome to a local result file plus a QQ message when qq-notify credentials (appId/clientSecret/openid) are configured in the desktop profile. Verified end to end on 2026-11-08.
description.zh: 重启 DSH 并告诉你到底成没成。Windows 上没有「从外部让 Electron 干净退出」的通道（发 WM_CLOSE 只会最小化窗口），所以这个插件不装优雅：强制结束宿主、带重试地重新拉起、再轮询宿主端口确认它真的在服务，最后把结果写进本地文件，并在 desktop profile 配好 qq-notify 凭据（appId/clientSecret/openid）时发一条 QQ 消息。2026-11-08 端到端实测通过。

description.en: Human-in-the-loop self-improvement loop: one objective becomes an auditable work chain that iterates in child sessions while the main agent stays idle.
description.zh: 人在环的自我改进循环：给一个目标，工作链在子会话里一轮轮迭代，主 agent 始终保持空闲。

description.en: Task-pack builder for DeepSeek Harness: compress large files into one brief (default budget 8000 tokens, estimated) that a subagent can read alone.
description.zh: 任务包构建器：把大文件压成一个 brief（默认预算 8000 token，为估算值），子智能体只读这一个文件。

description.en: A board for DeepSeek Harness that composes stations, workflows and projects from separate Git repositories; GitHub is the access gate.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 把独立 Git 仓库中的站点、工作流和项目组合成一块看板；以 GitHub 作为访问关口。

description.en: Daily brief for DeepSeek Harness. Every day at a fixed hour it ranks the plugin market by real install counts and stars, cross-checks it against your own agent memory and working conventions, and proposes two kinds of item: concrete deltas on the plugins people actually use (original does A, the proposal does B) and directions nobody has built yet. The popularity numbers come from the catalog the market itself publishes and are quoted into the prompt rather than guessed; an entry the market has not measured is shown as unmeasured, never as zero. Approving an item opens a new session named after it and hands that session a fixed delivery contract — implement independently, never fork, test green before publishing. Rejected sources are remembered so they stop coming back.
description.zh: DSH 日报：每天定点按真实下载量与 star 把插件市场排一遍，再对照你自己的 agent 记忆与工作约定，产出两类条目——对已经有很多人在用的插件的具体改法（原版是 A，提案做成 B），以及生态里还没有的新方向。热度数字取自市场对外发布的目录并原样写进提示词，不由模型猜测；市场没测到的条目会标成「无热门度数据」，绝不当作 0。批准一条会按它的项目名新建一个会话，并把一份固定交付契约交给那个会话：独立实现、不许 fork、测试全绿才发布。标记「不感兴趣」的来源会被记住，不再重复出现。

description.en: A resident assistant for DeepSeek Harness that is deliberately not another chat box: one floating window plus one standing conversation, both independent of every other session. The heartbeat is held back by four gates — an authority grant, a daily turn budget, quiet hours and a pacing cooldown — and it keeps working across restarts through a lease it has to hold. Each wake is decided by a model that must answer SKIP or a short message, so silence is a decision rather than a failure. The window shows the standing conversation's real message flow, read from the host session store, or from the on-disk session log when the host does not publish that session, and it can send into that conversation directly. den carries the same reach as the person it stands in for, with one limit: read-only. It may read every session, this machine and work channels such as GitHub, but it does not write, send or publish, it never asks anyone for permission, and it never gates another session's tool calls. `npm run digest:github` turns GitHub notifications and your own open pull requests into three Chinese sections — waiting on you, waiting on your review, and yours — with reply drafts that are explicitly marked as unsent.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的常驻助理，刻意不做成又一个会话框：一个浮窗 + 一个常驻会话，两者都独立于其他所有会话。心跳受四道门约束——授权、每日回合预算、安静时段、冷却——并靠必须持续持有的租约跨重启续接。每次唤醒都交给模型裁决：回 SKIP 就一个字都不说，所以沉默是一次决定，而不是一次失败。浮窗显示常驻会话的真实消息流（优先读宿主会话存储；宿主不发布该会话时改读落盘日志），并且可以直接在里面发话。den 拥有人同等的触达范围，但有一条硬限制：只读。它可以读所有会话、本机以及 GitHub 等工作渠道，却不写、不发送、不发布，从不向任何人索要许可，也从不拦别人的工具调用。`npm run digest:github` 把 GitHub 通知和你自己开着的 PR 整理成三区中文摘要——等你回的、等你审的、你自己的——并给出明确标注「未发送」的回复草稿。

description.en: Standalone DeepSeek Harness port of Google’s Elephant-Goldfish Model with seven slash commands (/egm-*) for design, documentation, and fresh-context reviews using native DSH subagents. Requires no other plugins, but it registers the same /egm-* commands as other EGM ports, so install only one EGM plugin per profile.
description.zh: Google Elephant-Goldfish Model 的 DeepSeek Harness 独立移植版：七条斜杠命令（/egm-*），用于设计、文档与借助 DSH 原生子代理的全新上下文评审。不依赖其他插件，但与其他 EGM 移植版注册的 /egm-* 命令同名，同一 profile 请只安装一个 EGM 插件。

description.en: Multi-workspace agent federation with persistent ticket trees, parallel worker sessions, structured evidence reports, independent acceptance checks, retry/stop and restart recovery. Workers get shell and file tools in the ticket's directory, company_verify re-runs the ticket's acceptance commands in a shell on the host, and scope lists are task authorization rather than a sandbox. State is stored in ~/.dsh/ai-company; the optional company_repo_* tools run separately installed aoci/codegraph commands on any path they are given.
description.zh: 多工作区 Agent 联邦：持久化 Ticket 树、并行 Worker 会话、结构化证据报告、独立验收、重试停止与重启恢复。Worker 在工单目录里拥有 shell 与文件工具，company_verify 会在宿主上用 shell 重新执行工单的验收命令；scope 白名单是任务授权语义，不是沙箱。状态存放在 ~/.dsh/ai-company；可选的 company_repo_* 工具会在给定的任意路径上运行另行安装的 aoci / codegraph 命令。

description.en: Quest tree for DeepSeek Harness: track a long-running task as a main quest plus a branch tree, with a sidebar panel showing status, progress, markdown notes and a 'you are here' marker to prevent drift.
description.zh: 任务树：把长任务维护成一条主线加分支树，侧边栏展示状态、进度、markdown 备注与「你在这」标记，防止跑偏。

description.en: Right-sidebar flow editor for prompts, model switches, commands, condition branches and loops, executed only at turn boundaries so an in-flight request keeps its model.
description.zh: 右侧栏可视化流程编辑器：把提示词、切换模型、命令、条件分支与循环连成一张图，只在轮次边界执行，在途请求与断连重试保持原模型。

description.en: Injects the non-obvious operating rules of Agent Teams into the Lead session through one ordered system-prompt section: plan the roster before spawning, roster slots are never released, write scopes are advisory, and wait_agent short-circuits when no peer is running.
description.zh: 通过一条有序的 system-prompt 段落把 Agent Teams 的隐性操作规则注入 Lead 会话：先规划名额再派员、名额不可回收、写入范围只是约定、没有同伴在跑时 wait_agent 会立刻返回。

description.en: Control tower tools: dispatch a task to a role agent, read its report, verify and accept or send it back. Requires the separate agent-control-tower Python CLI (tower; it is not on PyPI — install it with pip install -e from the same repo) on the DSH process's PATH plus a tower init-ed workspace; without it every tool call fails with ENOENT.
description.zh: 控制塔工具：把任务分派给角色 agent、读取回执、校验通过后接受或打回。需要先把同一仓库里的 agent-control-tower Python CLI（tower，未发布到 PyPI，需在仓库内 pip install -e）装进 DSH 进程的 PATH，并在工作目录跑过 tower init；否则每次工具调用都会报 ENOENT。

description.en: A personal life planner derived from Meltllsy/dsh-todo-reminder (do not install both: they share the same data-dsh-todo-css style node): tasks with due-time reminders, countdowns to a target date, a month calendar, a forward-only focus timer and a 26-week activity heatmap.
description.zh: 个人生活时间管理（基于 Meltllsy/dsh-todo-reminder 二次开发，不能与其同装：两者共用同一个 data-dsh-todo-css 样式节点）：待办与到期提醒、目标日倒计时、月历、正向专注计时、26 周活动热力图。

description.en: Atomize a source into six reusable content atoms, adapt them into article, short-video, card-series, and podcast-script drafts, and check cross-draft fact consistency.
description.zh: 把源材料拆解为六类可复用内容原子，适配为文章、短视频、图文卡片与播客口播稿，并检查跨稿事实一致性。

description.en: Writes a novel from one idea to a validated manuscript with a code-driven workflow: a JavaScript state machine runs the stages (constitution, outline, design, writing, validation, batch, export) and a 15-step per-chapter loop, PowerShell scripts validate each gate, and versioned checkpoints let a restart resume at the exact chapter. Nine subagent roles do the drafting and review. Needs PowerShell 7 (pwsh) and Python 3.7+; without pwsh the gates record a DEGRADED verdict and the run pauses.
description.zh: 用代码驱动的工作流把一个想法写成校验通过的小说：JavaScript 状态机推进各阶段（宪法、大纲、设计、写作、校验、批量、导出）和每章 15 步的循环，每道门禁由 PowerShell 脚本校验，版本化断点可在重启后从原章节续写；起草与评审由 9 个子代理角色完成。需要 PowerShell 7（pwsh）与 Python 3.7+；没有 pwsh 时门禁记为 DEGRADED，运行暂停。

description.en: Evidence-gated teaching-material workbench with a Web UI: page model, per-page handout and slide editing, PAEG Chinese language checks, layered gates, checks center, version history, handout/deck/storyboard/Manim-script export and rights audit.
description.zh: 按证据链生产教学物料的可视化工作台：页模型、逐页改讲义与课件、PAEG 中文检查、三层门禁、检查中心、版本回退、讲义/课件/分镜/Manim 脚本导出与版权审计。

description.en: Injects a very short conventions reminder (absolute INDEX path + version) once per session per version; when the conventions version changes, the next turn re-injects it (chat turns included). Optional hard guard: on operation-like turns, write/edit tools are rejected until the session has read the index (chat turns and shell are not blocked by default). Ships example checklists or points at your own directory; zero dependencies, configurable paths. Solves: conventions are written down but never pulled up when the work starts.
description.zh: 每会话每版本注入一条极短的「操作约定」门铃（入口清单绝对路径 + 版本号）；约定版本一改，下一轮就重新注入（闲聊轮也算）。可选硬拦截：操作类轮次里未读索引前，拒绝 write/edit 等写类工具（闲聊轮与 shell 默认不拦）。清单可随包自带，也可指向自己的目录；零依赖、路径可配置。用于解决「约定记了但干活时不提就不用」。

description.en: Packages a working style into a versioned pack of rules, skills and presets injected into the system prompt at global, project or session scope, distills local agent sessions into aggregate reports and suggested rules you can adopt or undo, exports the pack as a tarball a teammate can install, and ships a reference FDE pack with 40 skills.
description.zh: 把工作方式打包成可版本化的规则、技能与预设包，按全局、项目或会话作用域注入系统提示；可蒸馏本机 Agent 会话生成聚合报告与建议规则，供采纳或撤销；导出 tar.gz 供同事安装；并附带含 40 个技能的 FDE 参考包。

description.en: Adds an ARIS agent preset that loads the 84 ARIS research-workflow skills and runs their reviewer as an in-harness subagent from a different model family than the session model. Other presets are unchanged. A fork of wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-sleep's dsh-aris branch: install it instead of the upstream dsh-aris plugin, not alongside it - both register the mcp__codex__codex reviewer tools and the same ARIS skills.
description.zh: 新增一个 ARIS agent preset，加载 84 个 ARIS 研究工作流技能，并让评审者作为会话内子代理、使用与会话模型不同的模型族运行；其他 preset 不变。本插件是 wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-sleep 的 dsh-aris 分支的 fork：应当替代上游 dsh-aris 安装，不能与上游同装——两者注册同一组 mcp__codex__codex 评审工具和同名 ARIS 技能。

description.en: Scheduled agents on a cron: run a prompt on a schedule and get the digest where you already are, with overlap/missed-run/timeout safety defaults.
description.zh: 定时 Agent：按 cron 计划运行 prompt，把摘要送到你已有的地方，内置重叠/漏跑/超时安全策略。

description.en: Ports jcode's auto-poke so an idle agent keeps working while its session still has incomplete todos.
description.zh: 把 jcode 的自动催办搬了过来：会话里还有未完成待办时，空闲的 agent 会被推着继续做。

description.en: Adds contextual guidance for explaining technical misconceptions in conversations.
description.zh: 为对话添加上下文指导，以简短方式解释技术误解。

description.en: Disk-persisted execution planning for DSH: milestone/step state machines, dependency gating, an audit event stream, and a deterministic completion gate via dsh tools, CLI, or skill.
description.zh: 磁盘持久化的执行规划插件：以 .trail 目录承载里程碑/步骤状态机、依赖标注、审计事件与复盘纪要，提供 dsh 工具、CLI 与技能三种接口。

description.en: Team presets for AgentTeams: ships audit6 / impl5 / lite2 rosters with seed task DAGs and a per-role report contract, plus a captain doctrine section, so a fresh session opens the right team in one approval instead of a pasted prompt. Needs the engine @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams added to the same profile first; the team patch targets that engine's entry by id and replaces its whole agent-teams config.
description.zh: AgentTeams 的团队预置：内置 audit6 / impl5 / lite2 三套编制与 seed 任务 DAG（每个角色带回报合同），并注入一段 captain 开团纪律——新会话一次批准就开出结构正确的团队，不用再贴提示词。需要先把引擎 @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams 装进同一个 profile；团队补丁按 id 指向该引擎，并会整段替换其 agent-teams 配置。

description.en: Project Development Mode preset plus an in-chat development board for DeepSeek Harness: the lead conversation clarifies requirements and delegates to an Agent Team, and the floating board tracks each user change request through dispatch, execution, testing and acceptance with 7 board tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「项目开发模式」预设与聊天内开发看板：主对话只澄清需求并向 Agent Team 派活，悬浮看板把每个用户修改点按派单、执行、测试、验收追踪（含 7 个看板工具）。

description.en: ZenTao workbench for DSH: load a ZenTao browse-page URL into a panel, multi-select bugs, tasks and stories, and hand them to the current or a new session with description, recent comments, screenshots as real image attachments and other files saved locally; when the agent is done it writes comments and status transitions (resolve, close, activate, start, finish and so on) back into ZenTao, one item or a batch, from the panel or through five registered agent tools (bug write-back verified end to end, task and story forms share the same code path).
description.zh: DSH 侧栏禅道工作台：粘贴禅道浏览页链接读取 Bug/任务/需求，多选后交给当前或新会话（带入描述、最近动态、截图转真实图片附件、其它附件落盘可读），AI 处理完把备注与状态（已解决、已关闭、重新激活、开始、完成等）单条或批量回写禅道，面板与 5 个 Agent 工具都能写；Bug 的备注与状态回写已实测通过，任务与需求表单走同一套代码路径。

description.en: Recurring task scheduler with an append-only delivery ledger: window-aligned dedup execution, failure/abandoned rows, and same-window retry redelivery.
description.zh: 周期性任务调度器 + 只追加的投递账本：按时间窗去重执行，记录失败／放弃行，同窗口重试可重投。

description.en: Skill bundle for tiered multi-agent science campaigns in math, physics, astronomy, engineering, and biomedical evidence: a shared blackboard, independent verifier and red team, wolf-pack and flanking tactics, token and time budgets, known-answer evals, a four-agent pendulum pilot, and a six-agent fourth-order pilot that caught and corrected a benchmark answer-key error. Does not claim open-problem solutions.
description.zh: 面向数学、物理、天文、工程与生物医药证据的分层多智能体科研战役技能包：共享黑板、独立验证与红队、群狼与迂回战术、token/时间预算、已知答案评测、四智能体单摆 pilot，以及一次抓到并修正评测答案键错误的六智能体四阶 pilot。不宣称解决开放难题。

description.en: Windows-only, workspace-scoped Codex to DeepSeek Harness handoffs with durable replies, independent review and restart-safe endpoint discovery; no computer-use. Built on code vendored from ESROAMER/codex-dsh-collab and Dax233/dsh-codex-bridge; it mounts the same default /codex-bridge route as codex-dsh-collab, so do not install both with default settings. Needs Python 3.11+ and a one-time pairing command.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows 的 Codex 到 DeepSeek Harness 专属工作区交接，支持持久回传、独立验收和重启后端点自动发现，不使用 computer-use。内置 ESROAMER/codex-dsh-collab 与 Dax233/dsh-codex-bridge 的代码，默认与 codex-dsh-collab 同挂 /codex-bridge 路由，不能以默认配置同装。需要 Python 3.11+ 并执行一次配对命令。

description.en: Six-step video-replica workbench: fetches a Douyin/Xiaohongshu/WeChat Channels/Kuaishou/Bilibili share link or a local file, breaks the source into shots with a vision model and optional ASR, writes three A/B/C storyboards, generates a first frame and a clip per shot, then stitches the final video with optional TTS narration, burned-in ASS subtitles and BGM. Needs Node 22.18+/24.11+, ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH, and configured vision/chat/image/video model endpoints; share links go through a third-party parser service (or yt-dlp), or upload a local file.
description.zh: 六步爆款视频复刻工作台：解析抖音/小红书/视频号/快手/B站分享链接或本地上传，用视觉模型逐镜拆解源片并可选 ASR 转写口播，仿写 A/B/C 三版分镜，逐镜生成首帧与视频片段，最后用 ffmpeg 拼接成片，可选 TTS 配音、ASS 字幕烧录与 BGM。需 Node 22.18+/24.11+、PATH 上的 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe，并配好视觉/文本/图片/视频模型接口；分享链接需第三方解析服务（或 yt-dlp），也可直接上传本地视频。

description.en: Multi-agent isolated debate for DeepSeek Harness: debaters of different temperaments research independently (no herding), then cross-examine, then judges converge to a conclusion. Runs as a background job with per-agent progress, token accounting, wave-parallel execution, and session-referenced resume.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多 agent 隔离辩论：不同底色的辩手各自独立联网取证（互不可见防人云亦云）、交叉辩论互相反驳、评审收敛出结论。后台 job 运行，逐 agent 进度可见、token 统计、波次并行、断点续传。

description.en: Research-style problem solving in four gated stages: record sources by retrieval tier with local before web, turn each shortfall of existing tools into a gap that needs evidence, score candidates against weighted metrics with a deterministic engine, fuse or improve the weak ones, then iterate on measured deltas. Also organizes a directory into human-facing and machine-facing trees.
description.zh: 把解题当论文做：资料按检索阶梯登记（先本地后联网），别人的不足必须挂证据成为 gap，方案按加权指标交给确定性评分引擎打分，针对短板融合改进后用量化增量迭代；另附目录治理，把文件分成给人用与给 AI 用的两棵树。

description.en: Collects the open questions of each AI turn into a right-side panel; you answer them, add notes, and send the decisions back to the conversation in one message.
description.zh: 把 AI 每轮回复里的待决问题收进右侧边栏，选完选项、写完备注后一次性提交回对话。

description.en: An agent preset that turns a one-line idea into requirements, tech plan and maintenance baseline — every step is restated and confirmed by you before proceeding. No scenario presets: 73 atomic skills (6 master skills + a verify dispatcher + 66 sub-skills) load by context.
description.zh: 「想法落地」agent preset：一句话想法 → 需求规格 → 技术方案 → 维护基准；每一步先复述、你确认、再继续。无场景预设：73 个原子 skill（6 主 + verify 调度 + 66 子）按上下文加载。

description.en: Live international news from seven RSS feeds, situation analysis, and a conflict-aware travel planner with flights, stays, transport, and booking-platform links.
description.zh: 聚合七路实时国际新闻，提供局势研判，并规划避开战乱地区的全球旅行路线，附机票、住宿、交通与全平台比价建议。

description.en: Runs an approved OpenSpec change to completion while the model stays a mechanical forwarder: a bundled Python CLI computes the ticket DAG frontier, claims tasks atomically, prepares one git worktree per assignment, and returns exact actions. The session delegates each action with the DSH subagent tool and reconciles the completion notice against a hash-bound receipt produced by re-running verification commands on a clean, advanced HEAD, so free-text "done" never counts. Runtime scope changes are plain tasks.md edits. Liveness is observable, not guessed: status returns a relay block (elapsed and lease budget, receipt presence, heartbeat and activity age, a suggested action); abandoning a plausibly-still-working attempt is refused with the judgment data unless --force; a late sealed receipt is revived by adopt after full re-verification instead of rebuilding the ticket; dispatched subagents refresh a progress heartbeat outside the worktree. Requires Python 3.10+ on PATH and a git project that uses OpenSpec.
description.zh: 把已批准的 OpenSpec change 跑到完成，同时让模型只做机械转发：内置 Python CLI 计算票据 DAG 前沿、原子认领任务、为每个 assignment 准备独立 git worktree，并返回确定的 actions。会话用 DSH subagent 派发每个 action，完成后按在干净且已前进的 HEAD 上重跑验证命令得到的哈希绑定回执来 reconcile，子代理口头说“做完了”不算成功。运行中改范围就是直接改 tasks.md。存活可观测而非靠猜：status 返回 relay 判定块（已用时与租约余量、回执是否存在、心跳与活跃时长、建议动作）；abandon 一个大概率还在干活的 attempt 会被拒绝并附判定数据，--force 可越过；迟到的已封回执经 adopt 全量重验后复活，不必重建票据；被派发的子代理在 worktree 之外刷新 progress 心跳。需要 PATH 上有 Python 3.10+，且目标项目使用 OpenSpec 的 git 仓库。

description.en: A five-stage engineering loop for agent-built projects — spec, build, verify, ship, learn — with one artifact and one gate per phase, so an agent always knows the single next action. Role policy, project templates and deployment sit behind explicit ports: swap the implementation without rewriting the loop. Its scaffold generator lays out the internal layers of a project — `init --layout {none,webapp,service,plugin} --stack {python,node,none}` — from nine layers sampled out of three unrelated production projects: entry docs, an OpenSpec plan face, a spec truth layer (INDEX, one file per domain, TESTING, CONSTITUTION), a wiki split into knowledge / progress / runbook, the six `.agents/` slots, server+web, scripts/deploy/config, tests+e2e and a gitignored out/. Non-none layouts also gate the directory contract and compile every source root. Ships a Python CLI (init/next/check/ship/new) plus a local command adapter and an SSH/systemd adapter with release directories, an atomic current/previous switch, a deploy lock, a commit-versioned JSON probe and automatic rollback on a failed probe; bootstrap and teardown provision and remove the unit and the reverse-proxy block idempotently and refuse to delete a root they did not create. Includes a runnable example workspace and a skill that keeps the agent on one phase at a time. Requires Python 3.10+ and PyYAML; remote deploys need SSH access, rsync, systemd and Caddy on the target.
description.zh: 面向 agent 工程的五阶段循环：规格、施工、验证、发布、收口，每个阶段一个产物、一道门，agent 每次只知道当前该做的一件事。角色策略、工程模板与部署方式都在显式端口后面，换实现不用改循环本身。版式生成器负责工程的内部结构：`init --layout {none,webapp,service,plugin} --stack {python,node,none}`，九层结构抽自三个互不相关的真实生产项目——入口文档、OpenSpec 计划面、spec 真值层（INDEX、一域一文件、TESTING、CONSTITUTION）、knowledge/progress/runbook 三分的 wiki、`.agents/` 六槽位、server+web、scripts/deploy/config、tests+e2e，以及 gitignored 的 out/。非 none 版式还会校验目录契约并编译每个源根。自带 Python CLI（init/next/check/ship/new），以及本地命令适配器和 SSH/systemd 适配器：多版本目录、原子 current/previous 切换、部署锁、按 commit 校验的 JSON 探针、探针失败自动回滚；bootstrap/teardown 幂等地创建与回收 systemd unit 和反代 block，且拒绝删除不是自己建的目录。附一个可直接运行的示例工程，以及一个让 agent 每次只做当前阶段的 skill。需 Python 3.10+ 与 PyYAML；远程部署需目标机的 SSH 权限、rsync、systemd 与 Caddy。

description.en: Graph-first permission preflight for DSH. The model declares a computation graph whose nodes state the semantic operation (download what to where, write what, delete what); the user approves nodes one at a time in a side panel, one approval covers one successful execution, and each node keeps an audit trail of what actually ran. Uncovered operations still ask through the native approval card, and a node blocked by an unanswered permission is suspended so work that does not depend on it can continue.
description.zh: 先交计算图、逐节点批准的权限预检：节点写清这件事的本质（下载什么到哪里、写什么、删什么），用户按节点批准，一次批准只对一次成功执行生效；未申报的操作仍走原生审批卡；节点被未答复的审批卡住时会自动挂起，先做不依赖它的工作；节点内实际跑过什么留有审计痕迹。

description.en: Beta: a project supervisor for DeepSeek Harness — standing rules plus a Web panel (three switches, dispatch modes) that splits a goal into parallel teammate dialogs, checks engineering baselines, interviews new-project requirements and protects beginners. The standing rules come from the repo kit installer, an optional separate step.
description.zh: 测试中：DSH 项目主管——常驻规则 + 「主管」面板（三开关、派发模式），把目标拆成并行对话框，做工程底线自检、新项目需求追问与零基础保护。常驻规则由仓库的 kit 安装器另行写入工作区，是独立的可选步骤。

description.en: Runs shell scripts on cron or interval schedules inside the host with no model call, logging every run and waking the model only when a script's output changes.
description.zh: 在宿主内按 cron 或固定间隔运行 shell 脚本，不调用模型，按次记录日志，只在脚本输出变化时唤醒模型。

description.en: Project control plane with durable tickets, replaceable DSH sessions, a project matrix, and bidirectional UI navigation.
description.zh: 项目控制台，支持持久化任务、可替换的执行会话、项目卡片矩阵和 DSH 双向切换。

description.en: Expose a running DeepSeek Harness instance over MCP, so an external agent can list, create and continue that instance's own sessions, delegate a turn and collect its result, answer the questions the DSH agent asks, and set how future approval requests resolve.
description.zh: 把正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 实例通过 MCP 暴露出来：外部 agent 可以列出、新建并继续该实例自己的会话，委派一轮并取回结果，回答 DSH agent 提出的问题，并决定后续审批请求如何裁决。

description.en: Turns your local WeChat group chats into a followable todo board: a three-column kanban (todo / doing / needs you) with LLM summaries, automatic flagging of messages that @-mention or reply to you, drag-to-change status, and local-only storage. Needs a local Python 3 with sqlcipher3 and zstandard, plus the existing rion-wechat-reader config.json and keys.json for the WeChat databases; the plugin does not extract the keys itself, and summaries send the quoted chat text to the model you choose.
description.zh: 把本地微信群聊变成可跟进的待办看板：三栏（待办 / 进行中 / 需要你）配模型总结、自动标出 @ 你或回复你的消息、拖拽改状态、仅本地存储。需本机 Python 3 并装好 sqlcipher3 与 zstandard，且已有 rion-wechat-reader 的 config.json 与 keys.json（插件不负责取密钥）；总结时会把群聊原文发给所选模型。

description.en: File-based task pool and dispatcher for DeepSeek Harness: keeps a P0-P3 backlog as Markdown, hands one task at a time to a background subagent, gates delivery by rerunning the project test command, and accepts the result against a git commit or a file snapshot; git and non-git directories both work.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的文件制任务池与调度器：用 Markdown 维护 P0–P3 待办，每次只把一个任务交给后台 subagent，重跑项目测试命令做机器验收，并按 git 提交或文件快照核对结果；git 与非 git 目录都能用。

description.en: DIY workflow builder for DSH - compose multi-step prompt workflows with self-check gating, engine-enforced jump rules, agent-driven execution and a live run panel.
description.zh: 流程锻造——在侧边面板编排多步骤提示词工作流，支持自检门禁、引擎执行的跳转规则、主对话 AI 逐步执行与实时运行面板。

description.en: Turns a product or UI request into an implementation-ready design spec with /ui-workflow and /ui-rerun. Analysts run through a read-only ui_analyst tool, and the lead agent writes docs/ui-workflow reports.
description.zh: 把产品或界面需求编排成可落地的设计规格，提供 /ui-workflow 与 /ui-rerun。分析师通过只读 ui_analyst 运行，主控把报告写入 docs/ui-workflow。

description.en: Long-form manuscript verification team for DSH: installs 10 skills that run a read-only content/structure check, three-tier revision proposals, a human-selection gate, exact replacements and a final re-check; it never edits the manuscript by itself and requires Agent Teams to spawn teammates.
description.zh: 长篇/设定集文稿校验团队：安装 10 个技能，跑「只读校验→三档建议→作者勾选→定点替换→逐字复核」六步流水线；不自动改稿，需要 Agent Teams 组队。
