description.en: An audit workspace for DeepSeek Harness: a multi-agent consultation venue where each review seat is filled by an agent, every judgment is routed to a named review face, and the whole run is kept as a traceable record. Works out of the box: the service endpoint is built in, a workspace is provisioned automatically on first launch, and review scenes come with their seats and agents listed. The built-in service endpoint is the author's hosted server (agent.ak2029.com/kai-pu): scenes, runs and review records are stored there unless you override baseUrl in the profile config.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多人会商审校的「场地」——每个审核席位由一个 Agent 承担，判定逐面路由，全程留痕可回看。装上即用：内置服务端接入，首次打开自动开铺，场景、席位与审核 Agent 开箱在位。内置的服务端接入是作者托管的服务器（agent.ak2029.com/kai-pu）：场景、运行与审校记录都存在那里，除非在 profile 配置里覆盖 baseUrl。

description.en: Kaipu Workstation — a cross-cloud, cross-platform console where agents collaborate on one workspace. Any agent runtime that speaks plain HTTP can take a seat, each with its own device credentials: project context is shared, files are kept per seat, and tasks rotate between seats with a trace of who did what. Workstation data lives on the server — this plugin is only the interface, so uninstalling loses no data and reinstalling restores it. The panel renders the persisted workstation state (no live stream yet). Workstation data is stored on the author's hosted server (agent.ak2029.com/kai-pu) unless you override baseUrl in the profile config.
description.zh: 山海·开铺 · 工位插件 —— 跨云、跨端的 Agent 协作操作台：不同机器、不同平台的 Agent 通过普通 HTTP 接入同一张工位，各自独立设备凭据；项目上下文共享、资料按位存放、任务在席位间轮转交接，谁做了什么一路留痕。工位数据存在服务端，插件只是界面：卸载不丢数据，重装即回到原样。面板渲染工位持久化态（非实时流）。工位数据存放在作者托管的服务器（agent.ak2029.com/kai-pu）上，除非在 profile 配置里覆盖 baseUrl。

description.en: ✨ One-click prompt polisher for the DSH composer — an agent refines your rough draft in a side chat over multiple turns, and you copy the result back when you're happy.
description.zh: DSH 主输入框旁的 ✨ 一键提示词打磨：点击后 Agent 在侧边对话多轮改写草稿，你满意后再手动回填。

description.en: Delegates a one-shot task from DeepSeek Harness to a locally installed Reasonix over the Agent Client Protocol, reusing Reasonix's own model, credentials and sandbox settings; exposed as the `subagent_reasonix` tool. Auto-approves every Reasonix permission request.
description.zh: 通过 Agent Client Protocol 把一次性任务从 DeepSeek Harness 委派给本机已安装的 Reasonix，沿用 Reasonix 自己的模型、凭据与沙箱设置，对外暴露为 `subagent_reasonix` 工具。自动批准 Reasonix 的全部权限请求。

description.en: Run your DSH agents like a company: departments, order dispatch, attempt credentials, an audit ledger and cost accounting on top of ctx.agents/subagents — plus a work board, an org chart and DAG task planning, no native team layer required.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 agent 当公司跑：部门、派工、attempt 凭证、审计账本与成本核算，叠加工作网看板、组织架构图与 DAG 任务图并行派发，无需原生 team 层。

description.en: Host-side scheduled jobs on cron, RRULE or one-time schedules: shell commands that start no model, gated jobs that wake an agent only when the command reports work, or agent prompts. Agent tools to create jobs, a Cron tasks page, and result delivery through any plugin that exposes a send method.
description.zh: 在宿主进程中运行的定时任务，支持 cron、RRULE 或一次性时间：只跑 shell 命令、不启动模型；先跑检查命令，有事才唤醒 Agent；或直接给 Agent 发提示词。附带让 Agent 创建任务的工具、Cron 任务页面，结果可交给任何提供 send 方法的插件发送。

description.en: Jimu (积木): domain-based orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness — domain_plan confirmation, per-domain sub-agents with hand-off, and automatic LLM audit.
description.zh: 积木：DSH 分域编排插件，domain_plan 分域确认 + 按域编排子代理（手递手）+ LLM 自动审计。

description.en: Self-media workbench plugin: 8-tab dashboard (daily brief, narrative lines, topics, drafts, knowledge-card distill review, sources, publish, advice) with hard guards (48h window, event dedup, card/line existence, read-only advice) and a read-only intel module following the four red lines.
description.zh: 自媒体工作台插件：8 tab 看板（今日简报/叙事主线/选题/草稿/知识卡蒸馏审核/信息源/发布表现/系统建议），五守卫硬执行，VAULT 数据与代码分离，intel 模块只读接入并遵守四条红线。

description.en: Generic monitor plugin for DSH Desktop: an HTTP polling rule engine. Poll any endpoint on schedule (multi-step, variable extraction, JS condition expressions); when conditions hit, wake a visible agent session to act — zero model calls otherwise. Configure everything in a sidebar GUI panel: create/edit/pause/test/fire-now/run history, same UX as the built-in scheduler plugin.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 通用监控插件：HTTP 轮询规则引擎。按规则定时轮询任意接口（多步骤、变量提取、JS 条件表达式），条件命中才唤醒一个可见的 agent 会话执行任务；未命中零模型调用、零 token 消耗。规则通过导航栏 GUI 面板配置：新建/编辑/启停/测试/立即触发/执行记录，与定时任务插件同款交互体验。

description.en: Sidebar node canvas for DSH where each node is an agent task and each link a dataflow dependency. One deterministic import (no model calls) produces both a task pipeline and a file-level module graph; file nodes carry a coupling score, and every run is snapshotted so it can be undone as a whole.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的节点画布：每个节点是一个 agent 任务，每条连线是一条数据流依赖。一次确定性导入（不调模型）同时生成任务流水线与文件级模块结构图，文件节点带耦合评分；每次运行前自动快照，可整次撤销。

description.en: Read-only workflow panel for DSH: overview, six gates, milestones, org template, task flow and roster - project data from a project.json file, roster from the live DSH state, ledger presence from the ledger directory. Ships as a Cordis bundle with two GET-only routes and writes nothing to the project or the DSH state file.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 工作流面板：概览、六道门、里程碑、组织模板、任务流与人员卡——项目数据来自 project.json，人员卡来自 DSH 实时状态，台账只读其目录。以 Cordis bundle 形式安装，只注册两条 GET 路由，不写入项目文件或 DSH 状态文件。

description.en: Let external MCP agents delegate tasks to the existing DSH desktop, with visible sessions, user takeover, and optional approval handoff.
description.zh: 让外部 MCP Agent 将任务交给现有 DSH 桌面端，并提供可见会话、用户接管与可选审批转交。

description.en: Work-review loop for an Obsidian-style vault: writes a day's Dream with a numbered T/G plan, executes only the items marked routine (read-only by default, local commits only with --live), folds seven days into an ISO-week routine, and shows every day and week in a read-only sidebar panel.
description.zh: 面向 Obsidian 风格 vault 的工作回顾闭环：每晚生成当天 Dream 与编号 T/G 计划，只执行标记为「常规」的条目（默认只读，--live 才本地 commit），把七天汇总成 ISO 周周报，并在只读侧栏面板里展示日报与周报。

description.en: Four agent presets for the default plan-native workflow in DeepSeek Harness: plan plans and delegates, work coordinates execution, code owns implementation changes, and review performs independent read-only audits. Each role has a defined tool-permission matrix. Works with the sibling l2-protocol bundle for opt-in controlled rounds. For new installs, Weihao654/dsh-workflow#role-chain provides these four presets and the controlled-round runtime in a single bundle. Do not enable role-chain alongside either legacy l1-presets or l2-protocol.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供四个 Plan 原生工作流角色预设：plan 规划与分派、work 协调执行、code 负责源码修改、review 独立只读审核。每个角色具有明确的工具权限矩阵，可配合 l2-protocol 执行显式启用的受控轮次。新安装可使用 Weihao654/dsh-workflow#role-chain：一个 bundle 同时提供这四个预设与受控轮次运行时。请勿将 role-chain 与旧 l1-presets 或 l2-protocol 同时启用。

description.en: Plan-native multi-agent workflow for DeepSeek Harness: plan directs, work coordinates, code writes, and review audits read-only. Ordinary tasks need no authorization card or budget form. Includes 14 chain_* tools for explicitly authorized controlled rounds, with a frozen T0 baseline, layered evidence, and blocking close gates. Provides per-role model settings. Requires the sibling l1-presets bundle. For new installs, Weihao654/dsh-workflow#role-chain provides this runtime and the four presets in a single bundle. Do not enable role-chain alongside either legacy l1-presets or l2-protocol.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Plan 原生多 Agent 工作流：plan 负责规划、work 负责协调、code 负责写入、review 负责只读审核。普通任务无需授权卡或预算表单。提供 14 个 chain_* 工具，支持显式授权的受控轮次，包括冻结 T0 基线、分层证据和阻塞式关轮门禁。支持按角色配置模型，需同时安装 l1-presets。新安装可使用 Weihao654/dsh-workflow#role-chain：一个 bundle 同时提供本运行时与四个预设。请勿将 role-chain 与旧 l1-presets 或 l2-protocol 同时启用。

description.en: Installs the whole role-chain toolchain in one step: four agent presets (plan, work, code and review) plus fourteen chain_* tools for evidence-bound rounds, with a settings card. It ships the protocol runtime itself, so no sibling package is needed. It replaces the separate l1-presets and l2-protocol entries, which must be removed before enabling this one.
description.zh: 一步装齐角色分工工具链：四个智能体预设（plan、work、code、review）与十四个 chain_* 工具，用于证据可追溯的受控轮次，并带设置卡片。协议运行时随包提供，无需另装同级插件；它取代原先分开的 l1-presets 与 l2-protocol 两条，启用前需先移除那两条。

description.en: Event-driven trigger plugin (the doorbell beside dsh-proactive's alarm clock): recursive fs watchers with per-rule debounce windows and glob filters, plus a loopback-only local webhook endpoint with per-rule tokens, fire rules that wake a target session through the host agents service - live sessions get a direct follow-up, cold ones are resumed first - and inject a rendered prompt with template variables (paths, count, payload). Rules hot-reload from the event-gate rules file without restarting DSH, every trigger appends to an auditable JSONL history queryable via the trigger_list and trigger_history tools, and a loopback health route reports install and runtime status. Typical uses: auto-organizing a downloads folder, diagnosing CI or monitoring alarms posted from local scripts, and watching logs for errors. Pure JS, no build step, MIT.
description.zh: 事件驱动触发器插件（dsh-proactive 闹钟旁的门铃）：递归目录监视按规则防抖合并并支持 glob 过滤，本机回环 webhook 端点按规则 token 鉴权；规则命中后经宿主 agents 服务唤醒目标会话（活会话直接投递，冷会话先恢复再投递），并注入渲染后的 prompt（支持 paths、count、payload 模板变量）。规则文件保存即热更新，无需重启 DSH；每次触发追加 JSONL 审计历史，可通过 trigger_list / trigger_history 工具查询；另提供回环 health 路由报告安装与运行状态。典型用途：下载目录自动整理、CI/监控报警自动诊断、日志错误自动定位。纯 JS 免构建，MIT。

description.en: Auto-send every DSH turn result to WeChat: listens for task completion, extracts the final assistant message and pushes it raw via the WeChat iLink bot (real delivery check, never fake success). Requires the wechat-acp daemon, a separately installed process you log into WeChat with.
description.zh: DSH 会话任务结束后自动把结果原文推送到微信（iLink 直发，真实校验送达，失败如实报错）。需配置 wechat-acp 守护进程——一个需要另外安装并扫码登录微信的独立进程。

description.en: Maintains reusable named subagent profiles for DeepSeek Harness and runs them with per-profile model, reasoning effort, and agent-preset settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 维护可复用的命名子代理配置，并按配置的模型、推理强度和 Agent 预设运行子代理。

description.en: Delegates coding tasks from DeepSeek Harness to Codex CLI in WSL, with required acceptance criteria, background progress and cancellation, thread resume, per-criterion reports, change tracking, and optional workspace guardrails. Requires Windows with WSL2, Python 3.11+ and a logged-in Codex CLI in WSL.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的编码任务委派给 WSL 内的 Codex CLI，提供必填验收标准、后台进度与取消、线程续跑、逐条结果汇报、改动记录及可选工作区护栏。需要 Windows 与 WSL2；WSL 内需有 Python 3.11+ 和已登录的 Codex CLI。

description.en: Card-based task orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: splits work into cards, dispatches and monitors tasks, handles stalls, verifies results, and adopts work conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供卡片任务编排：拆分任务、派单盯办、处理卡顿、核对结果，并接管工作对话。

description.en: Cursor-style mode switching for the dsh web UI: plan mode with a delegation gate, multitask mode with a tool-call quota, and the create_plan / request_more_edits / list_running_agent tools. Adds a plan card with Build buttons and compacts the subagent dropdown to running rows.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页端提供类 Cursor 的模式切换：带委派闸门的计划模式、带工具调用配额的多任务模式，以及 create_plan / request_more_edits / list_running_agent 三个工具。另有带 Build 按钮的计划卡片，并把子代理下拉收成只显示运行中的行。

description.en: Persistent waits for file creation, file changes or process exit; the turn ends and the original session is woken when the condition is met.
description.zh: 守候：登记文件出现、文件修改或进程退出等条件，当前回合正常结束，条件成立后自动叫醒原会话。

description.en: Pauses a DSH task at steps that need a human, such as 2FA codes, QR scans, signatures or payments, and shows a native card with done, skip and cancel actions.
description.zh: 人工步骤：在需要人做的步骤（验证码、扫码、签字、付款）弹出 DSH 原生卡片，用户点完成、跳过或取消后才继续。

description.en: Minimizes or closes only the windows the agent opened during a task, using a baseline snapshot; pre-existing user windows and shell processes are left alone. Windows only.
description.zh: 清场：任务收尾时只收 AI 本次新开的窗口，默认最小化，不碰用户原有窗口；仅 Windows。

description.en: 340-entry code-animation style library, 8 prompt templates and 5 renderable code templates in a sidebar panel, plus agent tools (awkit_search / awkit_get_style / awkit_render_template) so the model can pick a style and render a template during a turn; content ships inside the package, no extra download.
description.zh: 340 条代码动画风格库、8 个提示词模板与 5 个可渲染代码模板，集成在侧栏面板；同一套内容也作为 Agent 工具（awkit_search / awkit_get_style / awkit_render_template）供模型在对话中检索与渲染；内容随包分发，无需额外下载。

description.en: AlphaRSI — three-role self-improvement loop that evolves the training recipe of alpha sequence models. Operator runs walk-forward, Evaluator grades with OOS RankIC, Refiner proposes hyperparameters via TPE Bayesian search; only strictly-better recipes are kept. Offline one-command run, data bundle shipped with sha1 reconciliation, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.
description.zh: AlphaRSI——三角色自改进闭环，进化 alpha 序列模型的训练配方。Operator 跑 walk-forward、Evaluator 用 OOS RankIC 验收、Refiner 用 TPE 贝叶斯搜索提议超参，只保留严格更优。离线一条命令跑，数据包 sha1 对账分发，GPU 自动走 CUDA。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Training attestation — reproducible, attributable, auditable off-site standardized training for asset pricing. Hard-gates four failure modes (half-refresh, hash mismatch, unknown-read-as-pass, master pollution). Ships one skill.
description.zh: 训练鉴证——把资产定价的异地标准化训练钉成可复算、可归因、可审计的裁决链，四道闸硬拦（半拉子刷新、账物不符、判不了当通过、污染母本）。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Zagent — unified three-role self-improvement loop with three operators. Data-RSI (daily cross-sectional cleaning: winsorize → cross-sectional standardization → median fill, plus experience extraction), Harness-RSI (evolves system prompt / memory / skills), and Model-RSI (evolves alpha training recipes via framework-native walk-forward with 2-day gap and multi-seed). Offline one-command run, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.
description.zh: Zagent——统一 RSI 三角色自改进闭环框架，三个算子：Data-RSI（逐日截面清洗：去极值→截面驻日标准化→中位数填充，加经验提取）、Harness-RSI（进化系统提示词/记忆/技能）、Model-RSI（进化 alpha 训练配方，框架内置 walk-forward，含 2 天空白与多 seed）。离线一条命令跑，GPU 自动走 CUDA。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Task list panel docked to the left of the conversation column: five states, parent/child folding, abandoned and completed docks, shared with the agent through task_list / task_write.
description.zh: DSH 任务列表：对话左侧常驻任务面板，五态 + 父子折叠 + 完成区/废弃区 dock，agent 用 task_list / task_write 读写同一份列表。

description.en: Hand off local development tasks between Codex and DeepSeek Harness with original requirements, project agreements, workspace checks, and a relay board. Needs the Codex desktop app (or a codexBinary path in the settings); verified on macOS only.
description.zh: 在 Codex 与 DeepSeek Harness 间接力本地开发任务，保留原始要求、项目共识、代码状态检查及接力记录。需要 Codex 桌面应用（或在设置里指定 codexBinary 路径）；仅在 macOS 上验证过。

description.en: Persistent personal todos shared across DeepSeek Harness sessions and projects: SQLite storage, Agent tools, a native sidebar and turn-tail cards, with user-managed workflows or optional dispatch of individual todos to Agent sessions.
description.zh: 跨 DeepSeek Harness 会话与项目共享的持久个人待办：使用 SQLite 存储，提供 Agent 工具、原生侧栏与对话尾部卡片，既可由用户自行管理，也可按需将单条待办交给 Agent 会话执行。

description.en: In-conversation workflow run timeline for DSH Web: a horizontal rail with phase stations, agent pills, loop arcs and parallel bands replaces the stock workflow tool card and workflow-run chat node. Planned stations render before the run starts via client-side script scanning; status dots and icons follow DSH official primitives.
description.zh: 对话内工作流运行时间线：横向轨道 + 阶段站 + 子代理药丸 + 循环弧线 + 并行带，替换官方 workflow 工具卡与 workflow-run 聊天节点。客户端脚本扫描让计划站在开跑前全部渲染；状态点与图标对齐 DSH 官方 primitives。

description.en: By default, blocks marking a team task complete without a passed independent verification record whose commit matches the worktree HEAD, and adds a dependency DAG board and a settings page.
description.zh: 默认拦截缺少「验收通过」独立记录、或验收提交与 worktree HEAD 不一致的团队任务完成操作，并提供依赖 DAG 看板与设置页。

description.en: Floating commit panel for the DSH web UI: it appears when the current session workspace has unstaged or untracked changes, takes a hand-written or AI-drafted commit message (AI drafts follow Conventional Commit), and commits or commits and pushes. Works in the DSH web UI and CLI only; the desktop app cannot install it.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的悬浮提交面板：当前对话所在工作区出现未暂存或未跟踪改动时浮出，提交信息可手写或由 AI 起草（AI 起草按 Conventional Commit 生成），支持提交与提交并推送。仅支持 DSH Web / CLI，桌面版无法安装。

description.en: A code review workflow that reviews uncommitted changes, changes against a base branch, a single commit, a GitHub pull request, or a file.
description.zh: 一种代码审查工作流，用于审查未提交的更改、相对于基础分支的更改、单个提交、GitHub Pull Request 或某个文件。

description.en: Review code with Open Code Review: deterministic scope and rule resolution, judged by your own DSH model, no API key.
description.zh: 用 Open Code Review 评审代码：确定性的范围与规则解析，由你自己的 DSH 模型判断，无需 API Key。

description.en: Fork and delete buttons on each workspace row of the Harness sidebar, plus a /fork-worktree command: fork creates a git worktree and registers it as a new workspace, delete removes the workspace folder through git worktree remove (asking again before discarding uncommitted work) and drops the registration.
description.zh: 在 Harness 侧边栏的每个工作区行加 fork 与删除按钮，并提供 /fork-worktree 命令：fork 创建 git worktree 并注册为新工作区，删除通过 git worktree remove 移除工作区文件夹（丢弃未提交内容前会再确认一次）并移除工作区登记。

description.en: Gitee Enterprise work-item workbench in the Harness sidebar: browse projects and tasks, requirements, and bugs; inspect details, child tasks, comments, and Markdown; create or edit work items; and reference them with @.
description.zh: 在 Harness 侧栏提供 Gitee 企业版工作台：浏览项目及任务、需求、缺陷，查看详情、子任务、评论与 Markdown，支持新建或编辑工作项，并可通过 @ 引用。

description.en: Branch panel for the composer: creates rule-checked branches from production6, validates commit messages against a type(scope) convention, and commits, pushes, or merges into stage in one click.
description.zh: 输入框内的分支面板：按规范从 production6 切分支，按 type(scope) 约定校验提交信息，一键提交、推送并合并到 stage。

description.en: Turns real git history into two Chinese changelog drafts (short for users, long for developers); every entry carries its commit SHA and an evidence-backed verified/unverified mark, and commit subjects are never translated.
description.zh: 从真实 git 历史生成两份中文变更日志（面向用户短版、面向开发者长版）；每条都带 commit SHA 与「已验证／未验证」标记，只有能引用到验证证据时才标「已验证」，提交主题不翻译。

description.en: GitHub console inside DSH: token sign-in, repositories, issues, PRs, commits, notifications, stars and activity, one-click cloning that keeps itself up to date, and a categorized skill library that installs GitHub skill projects for the agent.
description.zh: DSH 内的 GitHub 控制台：令牌登录后查看仓库、议题、拉取请求、提交、通知、星标与动态；一键克隆仓库并自动保持最新；还能把 GitHub 技能项目装进按用途分类、带中文简介与检索关键词的技能库，供 AI 复用。

description.en: Score a GitHub repo's contribution-friendliness from live merge and maintainer evidence.
description.zh: 用活的合并与维护者证据，给一个 GitHub 仓库的对外贡献友好度打分。

description.en: A right-sidebar Git tab for DeepSeek Harness that lists working-tree changes with inline diffs and the commit graph, commits (locally or with a push), fast-forward pulls, and switches branches while the working tree is clean.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Git 页签：列出工作区改动并内联显示差异、浏览提交树，支持一键提交（仅本地或提交并推送）、快进拉取，并在工作区干净时切换分支。

description.en: VS Code-style multi-repository Git panel in the DSH right sidebar: repository and branch pickers, staged/unstaged changes with inline diffs and per-file actions, commit, stash/tag/worktree menus, a connected SVG commit graph with branch multi-select, and fetch/pull/push/sync.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏的 VS Code 式多仓库 Git 面板：存储库与分支选择、暂存/未暂存分组（行内 diff、逐文件暂存/放弃/还原）、提交、储藏/标记/工作树菜单、SVG 提交图形（分支多选与图例）、fetch/pull/push/sync。

description.en: Git and GitHub panel for the DSH web profile: stage/unstage/discard/diff, branches, commit, push/pull/sync, log, file browser, workflow board, and GitHub OAuth with PR creation.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 Git 与 GitHub 面板：暂存/撤销/丢弃/差异、分支、提交、推送/拉取/同步、日志、文件浏览、工作流看板，以及带 PR 创建的 GitHub OAuth。

description.en: Local AI code-review gate: review a workspace/branch/commit diff via the managed ocr.js, returning structured findings with token stats; gate mode fails on findings.
description.zh: 本地 AI 代码评审门禁：对工作区/分支/commit diff 跑评审（托管 ocr.js），返回结构化 findings 与 token 统计；门禁模式发现问题即失败。

description.en: Adversarial multi-lens code review: parallel correctness/security/maintainability lenses attack a diff, with deterministic severity grading, suppression rules and incremental review history.
description.zh: 对抗式多视角代码审查：正确性/安全性/可维护性透镜并行攻击 diff，确定性严重度定级、抑制规则与增量审查历史。

description.en: Codex-style Git panel for DeepSeek Harness: a header button opens a menu with commit, push, branch switching and creation, and repository initialization; shows the current branch and the total additions and deletions of uncommitted files.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格的 Git 面板：会话头部按钮打开菜单，提供提交、推送、切换分支、创建并切换与初始化仓库；显示当前分支与未提交文件的总增减。

description.en: Agent-facing GitHub repository tools: binds an account through a first-run prompt, then clones into the workspace and reads, exact-replaces, commits and pushes files, with writes off by default.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 GitHub 仓库工具：首次调用弹窗绑定账号，之后把仓库克隆到工作区并读写文件、精确替换、提交与推送，写远端默认关闭。

description.en: Injects allowlisted GitHub Actions and GitLab CI run metadata into agent context without reading logs, credentials, or provider APIs.
description.zh: 将白名单内的 GitHub Actions 与 GitLab CI 运行元数据注入 Agent 上下文，不读取日志、凭据或服务商 API。

description.en: Publish any local directory to GitHub from inside a DSH session with a /publish slash command — git init, gh repo create, commit and push. Never force-pushes, never deletes.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中用 /publish 把本地目录发布为 GitHub 仓库——自动完成 git init、gh repo create、提交与推送；绝不 force-push，绝不删除。

description.en: DSH Source Control tab in dsh-better-sidebar that mirrors VS Code Git workflows.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 中的 DSH 源代码管理面板，尽量对齐 VS Code 的 Git 工作流。

description.en: Codex-style location, worktree and branch switchers on the New Session screen of DSH; all git work runs in the host half.
description.zh: 在 DSH 新建会话页提供 Codex 风格的工作位置、worktree 与分支切换器，git 操作全部由 Host 半执行。

description.en: Tracks the DSH config repo against the copy on this machine (files changed, commits ahead or behind, sessions and skills not captured yet) and generates push, pull and restore scripts that run after the client exits. A blocked pull backs up both sides of every conflicting file so one side can be picked per file; every apply snapshots the profile first, and any snapshot can be restored later. Windows only: the generated sync scripts are PowerShell.
description.zh: 对比本机与云端 DSH 配置仓库的差异（改了哪些文件、领先或落后几个提交、有没有新会话和新技能还没抓取），并生成客户端退出后执行的推送、拉取与还原脚本。拉取被本地改动挡住时两侧文件都会备份，面板里逐项选择保留哪边；每次应用前自动备份配置，之后可还原到任一份快照。仅限 Windows：生成的同步脚本是 PowerShell。

description.en: DSH slash command /commit: stages all changes, summarizes the staged diff with the session model, and commits; no browser UI required, with a local fallback when the model call fails.
description.zh: DSH 斜杠命令 /commit：暂存全部更改，用会话当前模型总结暂存区 diff 后提交；不依赖浏览器界面，模型调用失败时回退到本地规则生成提交信息。

description.en: Line-level provenance and a decision ledger for agent edits: which session, model and tool wrote each change, with Markdown/JSON export.
description.zh: Agent 代码改动的行级溯源与决策账本：哪次会话、哪个模型、哪个工具写了什么；可按工作区/文件浏览并导出 Markdown/JSON。

description.en: Git tab that covers the session workspace root together with every additional root registered through multi-root-workspace, so sibling checkouts appear as separate sections with their own branch, ahead/behind, line counts, directory tree and commit history. Clicking a file opens its unified diff (or whole content, for untracked files), and Markdown files render as a formatted preview with a source toggle. Each section has a commit box that commits only the checked files (`git add -- <files>` + `git commit -- <files>`), drafts the message automatically when left empty, and offers commit, push and commit+push; the toolbar keeps a repository picker, scoped refresh, per-file checkboxes, and a font-size control that scales the whole panel.
description.zh: Git 页签，把会话主目录与 multi-root-workspace 登记的每个附加根放在一起展示：平级仓库各自一节，带自己的分支、ahead/behind、增删行数、目录树与提交历史。点文件看 unified diff（未跟踪文件显示全文），Markdown 文件默认排版渲染、可切回 diff/源码。每节带提交框，只提交已勾选的文件（`git add -- <files>` + `git commit -- <files>`），信息留空自动 AI 生成，支持提交、推送与提交+推送；工具栏保留仓库切换、按范围刷新、逐文件勾选，以及等比缩放整个面板的字体大小设置。

description.en: Left-sidebar code review panel for DeepSeek Harness. Reviews local diffs, commits, or GitHub pull requests with the configured model using the Codex review rubric and P0-P3 findings. GitHub PR review requires a logged-in `gh` CLI.
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏代码审查面板。用当前配置的模型审查本地 diff、提交或 GitHub PR，采用 Codex 的审查 rubric，输出 P0–P3 分级发现。GitHub PR 审查需本机已登录 `gh` CLI。

description.en: 33 github_* tools covering REST reads, issue writes, Git data writes, private repo creation, and clone; in-process permission gate and cost-discipline companion skill; no gh CLI required.
description.zh: 33 个 github_* 工具，覆盖 REST 读取、Issue 写入、Git 数据写入、私有仓库创建与克隆；附带进程内权限门与成本纪律伴生 skill，无需 gh CLI。

description.en: A /review command that hands the current change set to a reviewer subagent pinned to the model you choose, with one continuing reviewer session per chat.
description.zh: 一条 /review 命令，把当前改动集交给固定到你选定模型的评审子代理，并且每个对话只保留一个持续复用的评审会话。

description.en: Runs git init in each newly registered DSH workspace, with an empty initial commit by default, so git-aware plugins have a repository to attach to; directories already inside a work tree are skipped.
description.zh: 在 DSH 每次注册新工作区时自动 git init 并补一个空提交；已在工作树内的目录会被跳过。

description.en: Code management panel for the DSH web UI that handles everyday Git in five steps: ① env check auto-detects git/gh/ssh and one-click installs missing tools (gh mirror download sources speed up installs, Windows included) with check-update; ② SSH ed25519 key generation / connection tests plus one-click 443 config to bypass blocked port 22, with the Gitee personal token configured here; ③ repo status, side-by-side diffs, stage/commit, branch switching, history with revert/cherry-pick, one-click repo creation and push, auto-ignoring >100MB files; ④ lists all repos of your account for one-click clone; ⑤ five-step npm publish wizard. GitHub / Gitee dual-platform, with the UI switching between 中文 and English live.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的代码管理面板，五步搞定 Git 日常：① 环境检查自动检测 git/gh/ssh，缺工具一键安装（gh 支持镜像下载源加速，Windows 也可用）并带检查更新；② SSH ed25519 密钥生成/连接测试 + 一键写 443 配置绕过 22 端口封锁，Gitee 私人令牌在此配置；③ 查看仓库状态、并排 diff、暂存提交、切换分支、查看/回滚历史，一键新建仓库并推送，自动忽略超 100MB 文件；④ 列出账号名下所有远程仓库一键克隆；⑤ 五步发布 npm 包。支持 GitHub / Gitee 双平台，界面中英文跟随 DSH 设置实时切换。

description.en: Adds a Git chip beside the composer that opens a centered workbench (changes, history, files, tags, stash) plus a Git section in settings. Supports multi-account OAuth device flow and PAT with per-repository permissions (full, read, none), gates writes behind a global switch and reads behind an allowed-directory list, and refuses a push whose target remote belongs to no writable account. Diffs preview in place with line numbers, four layouts, word-level emphasis, syntax highlighting and Ctrl/⌘+F find; Markdown and images render inline, commit messages are searchable, and commit messages can be generated from the staged diff through the host LLM service. Ships 8 Agent tools, 51 local HTTP endpoints and 8 languages, with tokens encrypted at rest by AES-256-GCM.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一个 Git chip，点开是居中工作台（改动、历史、文件、标签、贮藏），设置页另有一个 Git 分节。支持多账号的 OAuth 设备码流程与 PAT，按仓库设三档权限（完整、只读、无权限），写操作受全局开关控制、读操作受允许目录白名单控制，推送目标远端不属于有写权限的账号时会被拒绝。差异就地预览，带行号、四档布局、词级强调、语法高亮与 Ctrl/⌘+F 查找；Markdown 与图片可内联渲染，提交信息可搜索，也能调用宿主 LLM 服务从暂存差异生成提交信息。提供 8 个 Agent 工具、51 个本地 HTTP 接口与 8 种语言，令牌以 AES-256-GCM 加密落盘。

description.en: Connects Octo direct messages, groups, and topics to DeepSeek Harness Web, with separate conversations, channel settings, and reply progress cards. Needs an Octo bot token and Node.js 24 or 26, and ships switched off until you enable it; private chats are admitted by a local allowlist or Octo friendship, and groups and topics need an explicit @mention.
description.zh: 将 Octo 私聊、群聊和子区接入 DeepSeek Harness Web，提供独立会话、渠道设置和回复进度卡。需要 Octo 机器人令牌与 Node.js 24 或 26，安装后默认关闭收发；私聊按本地白名单或 Octo 好友关系准入，群聊与子区需要明确 @。

description.en: Polls the DeepSeek status feed and shows configurable outage, degradation and recovery notices in the DSH Web UI, with an independently positioned persistent status pill, six notice positions, three sizes and Chinese/English copy.
description.zh: 定期读取 DeepSeek 状态源，在 DSH 页面上以可自定义的气泡、横幅或胶囊提示服务中断、性能下降与服务恢复；常驻状态胶囊位置独立，支持六种位置、三种大小与中英双语。

description.en: Poll Feishu (Lark) group and direct chats through lark-cli, extract candidate tasks with a review workflow, and two-way sync them with the task-board plugin, with a floating browser panel and one-click device-flow authorization.
description.zh: 通过 lark-cli 轮询飞书群聊与单聊，提取候选任务并逐条审核，与任务看板插件双向同步，含悬浮面板与一键授权。

description.en: Feishu bridge for DeepSeek Harness (derived from dsh-im-bridge): WebSocket long connection, approval cards, group @-mention-only replies, streaming card updates, /stop command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 飞书桥（衍生自 dsh-im-bridge）：长连接免公网、审批卡片、群聊仅 @ 回复、流式卡片打字机回显、/stop 中断任务。

description.en: Notifies the DSH session that started a task-board card when that card settles, queueing the title, outcome, duration and next step into it; successes merge inside a configurable window (30 seconds by default) and failures are sent at once. A card that stops to ask is relayed to the same session, which answers through a tool.
description.zh: 任务看板卡片结算后，把标题、成败、耗时与下一步排队送进发起该卡的那个 DSH 会话；成功卡按可配置窗口合并（默认 30 秒），失败卡立即发送。卡片执行中提问时，问题也送回同一个会话，再由它把回答交回卡片。

description.en: Strikes a single short chime, raises the DSH window, floats a reminder card above the page and sends a system notification whenever the agent needs your approval or an answer. Sound and popup are two independent switches in the session header, remembered across reloads and restarts.
description.zh: 需要授权或确认时敲一记短音、把 DSH 窗口提到最前、在页面最上层浮出提醒卡片，并弹一条系统通知。声音与弹窗是会话头部上的两个独立开关，刷新与重启后仍然保持。

description.en: Plays a chime when DeepSeek Harness asks for approval; tone, volume and on/off are set in Settings → Notifications.
description.zh: DSH 请求审批时响一声提示音；音色、音量与开关在「设置 → 通知提醒」里调。

description.en: Task-completion notifications: desktop alerts via macOS Notification Center and Windows Toast, plus mobile push through Bark, ntfy, ServerChan or any webhook when an agent run goes idle, errors or blocks.
description.zh: 任务完成通知推送：代理转入空闲、出错或阻塞时，经 macOS 通知中心、Windows Toast 及 Bark、ntfy、Server酱、通用 Webhook 发送系统通知。

description.en: QQ-style attention alerts for the DSH desktop client: one short cue when a session needs you, a notification-area icon that blinks like an unread message, and an unread dock. The blink stops only once every triggering session has been read.
description.zh: DSH 桌面客户端的 QQ 风格提醒：会话需要你处理时响一声短促提示音，系统托盘图标像未读消息一样闪动，右下角还有未读浮窗。只有把触发过提醒的会话全部读掉，闪动才会停止。

description.en: Two-way bridge to a Server酱³ Bot (not SendKey push): messages sent in the app drive a DSH session, question and approval cards can be answered from the phone or the web, and agent plus scheduled output is pushed back to the chat. Pairing is trust-on-first-use: while the allow list (allowChatIds) is empty, the first chat that messages the bot is trusted, so set allowChatIds to pin it to your own chat.
description.zh: 与 Server酱³ Bot 的双向通道（不是 SendKey 单向推送）：在 App 里发消息即可驱动 DSH 会话，问题与批准卡片可在手机或网页任一端作答，Agent 与定时任务的输出再推回聊天。配对采用首次信任：allowChatIds 为空时，第一个给机器人发消息的聊天会被信任，请设置 allowChatIds 把它限定在你自己的聊天上。

description.en: Windows toast when a turn finishes, with one setting in Settings → General: Never, Only when unfocused, or Always.
description.zh: 回合结束时弹出 Windows 通知；在 设置 → 通用设置 里可选 从不 / 仅窗口不在前台时 / 始终。

description.en: Persistent WeChat bridge for DSH: one WeChat user maps to one persistent agent session via the official iLink channel, with context and the user-to-session registry surviving restarts. There is no sender allowlist — anyone who can message the paired WeChat account can start a conversation with a session that has tool access, and the working directory defaults to the home directory; use a dedicated account and set WECHAT_PERSISTENT_CWD.
description.zh: DSH 的持久微信桥：一个微信用户对应一个持久智能体会话，走官方 iLink 通道，上下文与用户→会话映射在重启后保留。没有发送者白名单——任何能给所配对微信号发消息的人都能发起对话并获得拥有工具权限的会话，工作目录默认是用户主目录；请使用专用账号并设置 WECHAT_PERSISTENT_CWD。

description.en: Plays a short chime and shows a desktop notification when a tool asks for permission approval.
description.zh: 当有工具请求权限审批时播放提示音并弹出系统通知。

description.en: Flashes the Windows taskbar icon in the DSH desktop app when a turn finishes in the background or an approval or question is waiting for you.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版在后台跑完一轮、或等你审批 / 回答时，闪烁 Windows 任务栏图标。

description.en: Two small macOS features in one plugin. keepAwake stops the display and system from sleeping while dsh runs (caffeinate tied to the host process). taskNotify posts a system notification when a top-level conversation finishes its turn, with the outcome (completed, error, blocked, output cap) and the duration; clicking the notification brings DeepSeek Harness forward. Click-to-focus needs Xcode Command Line Tools to build the notifier; without the toolchain the notification still appears but clicking it opens Script Editor. Subagents and Agent Teams members never notify, and a stop you pressed is silent by default. Both features can be switched off separately.
description.zh: 一个插件里的两个 macOS 小功能。keepAwake：dsh 运行期间不让屏幕和系统休眠（caffeinate 跟随宿主进程，dsh 退出即解除）。taskNotify：主对话一轮结束时发系统通知，写明结果（完成、出错、被拦截、输出达到上限）和用时；点击通知会切回 DeepSeek Harness。点击切回需要 Xcode Command Line Tools 构建通知助手；没有工具链时仍会提醒，但点击打开的是「脚本编辑器」。子智能体和 Agent Teams 成员不提醒，你手动停止的任务默认不提醒。两个功能可以分别关闭。

description.en: Task-complete and question notification sounds for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a soft chime when the agent finishes a turn, a ding-dong when it asks you something (questions, plan reviews, approvals). Synthesized Web Audio, zero assets, mute toggle and volume slider in the session header and settings.
description.zh: 任务完成与提问提示音：Agent 完成回合时播放一声轻快提示音，向你提问（普通提问/计划评审/权限确认）时播放叮咚声。Web Audio 实时合成、零资源零网络，会话头部带静音开关，设置页可调音量。

description.en: Feishu/Lark integration for DeepSeek Harness through the official lark-cli: a sidebar panel for app setup and QR sign-in, a command console, and agent tools that run any lark-cli command across 18 business domains, 200+ high-level commands and the full OpenAPI; the official CLI is downloaded on first use on Windows, macOS or Linux.
description.zh: 通过飞书官方 lark-cli 接入 DeepSeek Harness：侧边栏面板完成应用初始化与扫码登录，内置命令控制台，并提供 Agent 工具执行任意 lark-cli 命令，覆盖 18 大业务域、200+ 高层命令与全量 OpenAPI；首次使用时自动下载对应平台的官方 CLI（Windows / macOS / Linux）。

description.en: Windows balloon notifications for session lifecycle events (new / running / finished / error) across all workspaces, with a session-store watch that catches headless and A2A dispatch sessions whose events never reach the host bus. Windows only.
description.zh: 会话生命周期事件（新建 / 运行中 / 完成 / 出错）的 Windows 气泡通知，覆盖所有工作区；还会监听会话存储，捕捉事件从不经过宿主总线的无头与 A2A 派发会话。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Two-way agent bridge for Feishu (Lark) and DingTalk groups: chat with a DeepSeek Harness agent from IM groups via long-connection / Stream Mode — no public port needed. Workspace selection/creation, session switching, archiving (synced with DSH GUI), configurable from the DSH settings page. Feishu uses interactive cards, DingTalk uses text commands.
description.zh: 飞书 / 钉钉群双向桥接：在 IM 群里直接与 DeepSeek Harness agent 对话（飞书长连接 / 钉钉 Stream 模式，无需公网端口）。支持工作区选择/创建、会话切换、归档（与 DSH GUI 同步）、设置页图形化配置。飞书交互卡片、钉钉文本命令。

description.en: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you are away, with stable SMTP (no 535 retry loop), connect and idle timeouts, and a --check self-test.
description.zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：稳定 SMTP（不重试 535）、连接与空闲超时，并带 --check 自检。

description.en: macOS notch panel for DeepSeek Harness: running sessions and pending approvals sit above every window, approvals are decided in place, and clicking a row opens that conversation in the desktop app. Requires macOS 14+ and Xcode Command Line Tools.
description.zh: macOS 灵动岛桥接：运行中的会话与待审批操作浮在所有窗口之上，审批直接在岛上裁决，点一行可在桌面端打开对应会话。需 macOS 14+ 与 Xcode Command Line Tools。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness when a task finishes, with the final assistant reply as the notification body, plus optional approval and question alerts and synthesized or imported sounds. Derived from ltao0829/dsh-task-notify; install this fork or the upstream plugin, not both — they claim the same task-notify bundle row.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务结束时弹出系统级通知，正文是本轮最后一条回复；另可开启审批与提问提醒，并支持合成提示音或导入自定义提示音。本插件派生自 ltao0829/dsh-task-notify；与上游插件不能同装——两者占用同一个 task-notify bundle 行。

description.en: DingTalk alerts when the agent needs your choice or approval, or finishes a turn; it stays quiet while you are watching the DSH page.
description.zh: 钉钉提醒：AI 需要你选择、审批或干完活时推送到钉钉群；有人正看着 DSH 页面就不发，没人看才提醒。

description.en: Shows a Windows 11 toast notification when a DeepSeek Harness session turn finishes, and stays quiet while a DSH window is focused.
description.zh: DSH 会话每轮结束时在 Windows 11 右下角弹出系统通知；DSH 窗口在前台时自动跳过，避免打扰。

description.en: Speaks a short status line when DSH changes state — turn done, turn error, job done, job failed, goal complete, goal blocked, an approval waiting, or the agent needs your answer — using eight pre-recorded clips in Chinese (default) and English. The audio is played by the host process through ffplay, or through the Windows PowerShell player that ships with the OS, so it does not depend on a Web Audio tab. Windows only.
description.zh: DSH 状态变化时读出一句简短提示——本轮完成、本轮出错、后台任务结束、后台任务失败、目标完成、目标受阻、等待批准、等待你回答——中文（默认）与英文各八条预录语音。音频由宿主进程播放（ffplay，或系统自带的 Windows PowerShell 播放器），不依赖浏览器 Web Audio。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: WeChat bridge and native Web settings panel with QR scan login, live token health probe, and credential management.
description.zh: 微信双向通道与原生设置管理面板，支持扫码登录、实时连通性与过期探测、单实例选举锁及凭证管理。

description.en: Sends desktop notifications when a DSH turn finishes or fails, and sends 继续 automatically after the model-retry budget is exhausted.
description.zh: 任务结束或失败时发送桌面通知；模型请求重试预算耗尽时自动发送「继续」让 Agent 接着执行。

description.en: Raises a Windows desktop notification card when DSH asks you a question, and returns to the asking Session when the card is clicked.
description.zh: DSH 向你提问时在屏幕右下角弹出毛玻璃通知卡片，点击卡片即恢复并置顶窗口、回到发起询问的会话。

description.en: Bark push notifications for DeepSeek Harness: turn completion, waiting prompts and approvals, plus opt-in background-job cards. Devices and card settings are edited live, and each push checks the per-device result returned by the Bark server and retries transient failures.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Bark 推送：回合结束、等待选择/批准，以及可选的后台任务卡片；设备和卡片参数在设置里实时生效，每次推送按 Bark 服务器返回的设备结果逐台核对，瞬时失败会自动重试。

description.en: Shows the open DSH chat, working or idle status, timer and daily token count in Discord Rich Presence, with Russian, English and Chinese settings.
description.zh: 在 Discord Rich Presence 中显示当前打开的 DSH 聊天、工作或空闲状态、计时器和今日 Token 总数，设置页支持俄语、英语和中文。

description.en: Windows-only plugin that shows permission requests, waiting questions, task errors and finished turns as native card windows, and can allow a permission request straight from the card.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows：把审批请求、待回答的提问、任务出错和轮次完成显示为原生卡片窗口，审批请求可直接在卡片上放行。

description.en: One-click publish of DSH conversations as Markdown articles on a Halo CMS blog: confirm in the GUI, type the console password (never stored), and the Q&A record is created through the Halo REST API.
description.zh: 一键将 DSH 对话发布为 Halo CMS 博客的 Markdown 文章：界面确认、输入控制台密码（永不存储），问答记录通过 Halo REST API 创建。

description.en: Registers im_say, a tool that sends each call as its own IM message through dsh-im's proactive delivery service, so a single reply can arrive as several bubbles instead of one block; im_targets and im_target_add list and create the delivery targets it sends to.
description.zh: 注册 im_say 工具，调用一次就通过 dsh-im 的主动投递服务发出一条独立 IM 消息，让一条回复拆成多个气泡而不是一整块；另有 im_targets 与 im_target_add 查看和新建投递目标。

description.en: Opens the Obsidian vault a DSH session is working in, on the first human message — so your sync plugin (Nutstore sync, Obsidian Sync, Obsidian Git, …) starts running and the files the agent edits actually get synced. Skips a vault that is already open, and opens a new window behind the current one instead of stealing focus. Also serializes writers per vault — a second conversation's write is refused before it runs and queued until the holder is done, so a sync client cannot splice two conversations' edits together. Windows only.
description.zh: 会话的第一条真人消息到达时，自动打开该会话工作目录所在的 Obsidian 库——这样你装的同步插件（坚果云同步、Obsidian Sync、Obsidian Git 等）就会开始工作，AI 在库里改的东西才能真正同步出去。已开着的库直接跳过；新开的窗口压到当前窗口后面而不抢焦点。同时保证同一个库同一时刻只有一个对话在写——第二个对话的写入会在执行前被拦下并排队，等前一个写完才放行，避免同步客户端把两个对话的改动拼在一起。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Badges the installed app icon with the number of finished, unread sessions, and pops an in-app badge or a Windows notification when a session fails or waits for your answer; each state has its own chime.
description.zh: 会话干完活时在应用图标上显示未读数字角标；会话报错或等待回答时弹出红色感叹号角标、黄色问号角标或 Windows 通知，三种状态各有提示音。

description.en: Reports DeepSeek Harness session state (working, done, error) to the agent-pet macOS desktop overlay and lets it open sessions or start a chat.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话状态（工作中、完成、出错）报告给 agent-pet 的 macOS 桌面悬浮宠物，并可从宠物打开会话或开始新对话。

description.en: Blinks the DeepSeek Harness tray whale when a task finishes in the background, and keeps blinking until you switch back (Windows).
description.zh: 任务在后台完成时让 DeepSeek Harness 托盘的鲸鱼图标闪动，并且一直闪到你切回窗口为止（Windows）。

description.en: Move45clock: a health clock for DeepSeek Harness. A 45-minute work timer (5–120 minutes), 12 guided 12–15 minute seated/standing break plans, a visual plan editor, reminder cards scalable to 200%, night reminders at 21:30/22:00/22:30, and optional action-name voice coaching. Window wake is Windows-only.
description.zh: Move45clock · 健康钟：每工作 45 分钟弹出引导式休息卡片，内置 12 套 12～15 分钟坐/站计划；支持可视化编辑计划、弹窗放大、21:30/22:00/22:30 夜间提醒，以及可选的动作名语音播报；Windows 下可把托盘窗口叫回前台。

description.en: Scheduled bilingual financial reports for DSH: market quotes, news and macro calendar, with per-target timezones and delivery through eight dsh-im channels.
description.zh: DSH 定时双语财经日报：包含行情、新闻与宏观日历，支持每个目标独立配置时区，并通过 dsh-im 的八种通道投递。

description.en: Periodic water, stand-up, eye-break and stretch reminders on your own work schedule, with daily and 7/30-day statistics and multiple switchable reminder plans.
description.zh: 按自定义作息定时提醒喝水、起身、护眼和拉伸，带每日与近 7/30 天统计，以及多套可随时切换的提醒方案。

description.en: Email assistant forked from dsh-email with host-side 163 IMAP monitoring that creates DSH conversations for summaries and reply suggestions, manual suggestions for selected messages, and persistent automatic/manual processing records with session links. Includes multi-provider mailbox browsing; automatic monitoring currently supports 163 IMAP only. Install it instead of dsh-email, not alongside (both mount the same tool-email row). It registers no send or draft tools; mail text goes to your configured model and is kept in the session logs; monitoring needs DSH running continuously and a 163 IMAP authorization code.
description.zh: 基于 dsh-email 的邮件助手：后台监听 163 IMAP 新邮件并创建 DSH 对话生成摘要和回复建议，也可选择已有邮件手动生成建议；持久记录自动及手动处理结果并关联会话。支持多品牌邮箱浏览，自动监听目前仅支持 163 IMAP。请用它替换 dsh-email，不要同时启用（两者挂载同一个 tool-email 行）；不注册发信和草稿工具；邮件正文会交给你配置的模型并保存在会话记录里；监听需要 DSH 持续运行和 163 IMAP 授权码。

description.en: Plays a chime when any session's response finishes (rising tone) or a question/approval is asked (falling tone), with a click-to-mute badge.
description.zh: 当任意会话的回复完成（上升音调）或提出问题/请求（下降音调）时播放提示音，带点击静音徽章。

description.en: Plays a short bell the moment DeepSeek Harness asks for tool approval or a question, so a stalled turn gets noticed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 请求审批、或向你提问时响一声“叮”，人不在窗口前也能立刻察觉。

description.en: Raise native desktop notifications from DSH itself for approvals, questions, finished turns, errors and sign-in prompts, attributed to the DeepSeek Harness app with click-to-open; the chime is synthesised in-page and can be picked from presets or authored as a note sequence in Settings.
description.zh: 由 DSH 自己弹出的原生桌面通知：待授权、等待作答、任务完成、出错与需要登录时提醒，归属 DeepSeek Harness 应用、点击回到会话；提示音在页面内实时合成，可在设置里选预设或自定义音序。

description.en: Approval reminder: an in-page card with Allow once / Reject when a session waits for permission, plus optional desktop notification, sound and phone push through PushPlus, ServerChan, ntfy, WeCom or a custom webhook.
description.zh: 审批提醒：会话等待权限时在页面右下角弹出提醒卡，可直接「允许一次」/「拒绝」，并可发桌面通知、提示音，或通过 PushPlus / Server酱 / ntfy / 企业微信机器人 / 自定义 webhook 推送到手机。

description.en: Fork of amlyczz/dsh-lark-link (MIT), maintained by Very12345. Per-conversation reasoning-effort controls, multi-app isolation, and streamed task-status cards.
description.zh: amlyczz/dsh-lark-link（MIT）的分叉，由 Very12345 维护；提供每会话推理强度控制、多应用隔离与任务状态流式卡片。

description.en: Sound alerts for the DSH web UI: a chime when an answer completes and a three-tone prompt when your approval or question is pending, with optional custom WAV stored only in the local browser (pure client-side, zero assets).
description.zh: DSH 网页端提示音：回答完成播放提示音，需要授权或向你提问时播放三连音；支持自定义 WAV（仅存本机浏览器），纯客户端零资源。

description.en: Emails you when a long turn finishes or errors, when a goal completes or blocks, and when an approval or a question has waited past a timeout; each new notification deletes the previous one from the inbox over IMAP, so the inbox holds at most one.
description.zh: 耗时较长或工具调用较多的任务结束时发邮件到手机，出错、目标完成或目标受阻也发；审批或提问挂起超过设定时间没人处理会另外提醒（正文带问题原文与候选项，提醒不依赖任务档位）。每封新通知会通过 IMAP 删掉收件箱里的上一封，收件箱里最多留一封；其它文件夹不扫描。

description.en: Daily AI digest by email: fetches ten sources (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Hugging Face, arXiv, Hacker News and others), clusters near-duplicate stories, scores them in code and with an LLM, then emails the top three on a daily schedule with a four-part reading (facts, why it matters, impact, open questions). Adds four conversation tools and a sidebar panel for previewing the digest, sending it now and changing the schedule.
description.zh: 每日 AI 三报：抓取 10 个信源（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、Hugging Face、arXiv、Hacker News 等），语义聚类去重，程序打分加 LLM 打分，每天定时把选出的三条发到邮箱，并附「事实／为什么重要／影响／存疑」四段解读；另提供 4 个对话工具与侧边栏面板，用于预览、立即发送和改配置。

description.en: Windows desktop notifications with selectable sounds: five bundled sound packs (45 clips) plus imported audio, one sound per event, and clicking a notification opens the matching session.
description.zh: Windows 桌面通知 + 可选音效：内置五组共 45 个音效并支持导入音频，可逐事件指定音效，点击通知直接跳到对应会话。

description.en: Adds a bell to the sidebar header: yellow when a conversation waits for approval, red when a turn was interrupted, blue when a conversation completed; clicking it opens a status summary panel and a session board, and a status with exactly one session opens that session directly.
description.zh: 在侧边栏右上角加一个铃铛：有会话等待审批时显示黄点，有回合意外停止时显示红点，有会话完成时显示蓝点；点开后是状态摘要面板和会话看板，某个状态只有一条会话时直接打开该会话。

description.en: Read and edit a Notion workspace from the agent: 10 tools over pages and databases, content handled as Notion-flavored Markdown, and writes guarded by a content-hash version check, a preview diff and one-step undo, so an edit made by hand in Notion is never silently overwritten. Installs with dsh plugin add; no build step. Requires a Notion integration token (or a personal access token) and sharing each target page or database with the integration.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里读写 Notion：10 个工具覆盖页面与数据库，正文按 Notion 风味 Markdown 读写；写入带内容哈希版本校验、diff 预览和一键撤销，你在 Notion 里手改的内容不会被静默覆盖。dsh plugin add 即可安装，无需构建。需自备 Notion 集成令牌（或个人访问令牌），并把要读写的页面/数据库共享给该集成。

description.en: Shares Bilibili videos of chosen categories to the QQ groups or friends you list, at random intervals (4-10 hours, at most 3 a day, quiet 23:00-08:00 by default), with per-recipient dedupe and an optional AI-written blurb. Sends through your own OneBot v11 HTTP backend (NapCat, Lagrange, go-cqhttp compatible) logged in to a QQ account, and sends nothing until you add recipients.
description.zh: 按分区或关键词从 B 站挑公开视频，在不固定的时间点（默认间隔 4-10 小时、每天最多 3 条、23:00-08:00 静音）发到你列出的 QQ 群或好友，带按收件人去重与可选 AI 推荐语。需要你自备已登录 QQ 账号的 OneBot v11 HTTP 后端（NapCat、Lagrange、go-cqhttp 兼容实现）；添加收件人之前不会发送。

description.en: Scheduled daily toast popups summarizing yesterday's conversations and managing two-tier pending TODOs.
description.zh: 每日定时弹窗推送昨日对话要点提炼与双轨待办事项管理。

description.en: In-app local notification center for DSH: a sidebar Notifications entry with unread badge, full-screen center with level color coding (info/success/warn/error), time/source filters, sorting, title/content search, read/unread, delete, detail popup with one-click copy, and pagination; written by the notify_add agent tool or the dsh-localnotify CLI (with auto-cleanup retention), page refreshes live, UI follows dsh web language (zh/en).
description.zh: DSH 本地通知栏：侧边栏【通知】入口 + 未读徽标、全屏通知中心（级别视觉分级 info/success/warn/error、时间/来源筛选、排序、标题内容搜索、未读已读、删除、详情弹层一键复制、分页），notify_add agent 工具与 CLI 写入本地 JSON 文件（支持自动清理），页面实时刷新，界面跟随 dsh web 语言切换。

description.en: Pushes a notification when a long agent turn finishes, a turn fails, or an approval waits too long, via ntfy, Bark, Gotify, ServerChan, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram or a webhook. Port of @magpie-community/gateway-notify (MIT); the upstream is a magpie API-gateway plugin that does not install into DSH, so the two never coexist in one host.
description.zh: 长任务结束、回合失败或审批等待过久时推送通知，支持 ntfy、Bark、Gotify、Server酱、飞书、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 与 webhook。移植自 @magpie-community/gateway-notify（MIT）；上游是 magpie API 网关插件，无法装进 DSH，两者不会同装。

description.en: Unread mail widget for DeepSeek Harness: 7-day and 30-day unread sections with senders, a local widget page and two agent tools, IMAP over TLS with no runtime dependencies. The IMAP app password is stored in plain text in ~/.dsh/mail-widget/config.json (mode 600), and the two agent tools return sender and subject lines from your mailbox to the model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的未读邮件挂件：按近 7 天 / 近一个月两段显示未读数量与发件人，带一个本地挂件页面和两个 agent 工具；纯内置模块实现 IMAP，无运行时依赖。IMAP 应用专用密码以明文存放在 ~/.dsh/mail-widget/config.json（权限 600），两个 agent 工具会把你邮箱里的发件人和主题返回给模型。

description.en: Counts down to 23:30 on workdays in a strip under the composer of the DSH web UI, turning yellow under one hour and red under ten minutes, plays a three-chime alert at the deadline with snooze and dismiss buttons, and a mute toggle persisted in localStorage.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页端输入框下方显示工作日 23:30 的睡觉倒计时:不足 1 小时变黄、不足 10 分钟变红,到点播放三组钟声提醒,可再等 10 分钟或关闭,喇叭按钮可静音,设置存于 localStorage。

description.en: Reminds you to stop working at several times a day (default 12:10 and 18:00, up to 12 editable points): at each time the host raises the DSH window to the front — restoring it if minimized and taking the foreground even from another application — and a full-screen animated alert appears with a five-minute snooze and a dismiss button. The alert can show your own image (SVG, PNG, GIF, JPEG or WebP, with GIF animation) instead of the default clock icon; times, image, mute and the auto-focus switch persist in localStorage.
description.zh: 按设定的多个时间点提醒休息（默认中午 12:10 与下午 18:00，可增删改，最多 12 个）：到点由宿主把 DSH 窗口真正拉到最前（最小化会先还原，即使正在别的应用里也会抢到前台），并全屏弹出动态提醒，可「延迟五分钟」或「知道了」。提醒可用自己的图片（支持 SVG、PNG、GIF、JPG、WebP，GIF 会动）替代默认时钟图标；时间、图片、静音与自动聚焦开关均存于 localStorage。

description.en: Plays a Windows system sound when the agent opens a question dialog, when a tool asks for permission, and when a conversation turn ends, plus a fish_beep tool to trigger a sound on demand. Custom audio folders are supported.
description.zh: 弹出选项卡提问时、请求工具权限时、一轮对话结束时，各播放一次提示音；支持自定义音频文件夹；另附 fish_beep 工具，可随时手动响一声。

description.en: Flashes the DeepSeek Harness taskbar button on Windows when an approval, a question or a plan review is waiting, or when a turn finishes.
description.zh: Windows 上审批、提问或方案确认在等你、或一轮回复完成时，让 DeepSeek Harness 的任务栏按钮闪动。

description.en: Sidebar badge and desktop notification when a background session finishes while you are working in another project.
description.zh: 你在别的项目里工作时，后台会话跑完会在侧边栏显示角标并发出系统通知，点角标可直接跳到该会话。

description.en: Native macOS completion notifications and user approval alerts with Settings UI for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生任务完成通知与审批提醒插件，集成设置面板。

description.en: Speaks a cue for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: a configurable phrase when an agent turn completes normally, a second phrase when the agent needs you to choose — a question, a plan approval, or a permission request — and a time-of-day greeting when a new conversation starts. A small bubble in the lower-left corner mutes and unmutes every cue with one click, with its own toggle chime. Phrases are synthesized with a Microsoft Edge neural voice (skipping aborted and errored turns, subagent turns, and rounds that a goal is still driving), cached under the DSH home directory and replayed locally, with the desktop SAPI voice as the offline fallback.
description.zh: Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 语音提示：一轮对话正常结束时朗读一句可自定义的话（默认「已完成当前任务」），智能体需要你做选择时——提问、批准计划或权限确认——朗读第二句（默认「老大老大，等你做选择呢」），开始一个新对话时再按系统时间问候一句（默认「早上好／中午好／下午好／晚上好！有什么工作需要做吗？」）。页面左下角还有一个小悬浮泡，点一下就把所有播报静音或恢复（自带开关音效）。朗读用微软 Edge 神经语音合成（被中断或出错的回合、子代理回合、以及 goal 仍在续跑的回合不朗读），结果缓存在 DSH 主目录并本地播放，网络不可用时回退到系统 SAPI 桌面语音。

description.en: Native macOS Notification Center alerts for DeepSeek Harness when the agent asks for your choice, a task completes, or a task fails, with per-scenario switches, background-job suppression, and click-to-open the session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 macOS 通知中心提醒：智能体需要你做出选择、任务完成或任务失败时弹出通知，可在配置中分别开关、在后台任务运行时抑制完成提醒，点击通知可直接跳回对应会话。

description.en: Capybara secretary for DSH: desktop pet notifications with ding sound, alert inbox API, session-aware alerts (turn done / approval needed / turn blocked), check scripts, and daily high-star plugin recommendations.
description.zh: 水豚秘书：桌面宠物气泡+叮咚通知、告警收件箱 API、会话智能提醒（任务完成/需要确认/阻塞）、磁盘/HTTP/进程巡检脚本，以及每日高口碑插件推荐，另附 API 冒烟测试。

description.en: Inventory every listening TCP endpoint and grade each holder as agent-spawned, workspace, dev-server, unattributed, system or protected; only the first two can be auto-selected, and a reap previews its descendant-closure plan unless confirmed.
description.zh: 枚举本机全部监听端口，按「会话派生的 / 工作区内的 / 开发服务器 / 无法归属 / 系统 / 受保护」六级定性持有者；只有前两级可被自动选中，回收前默认只预览后代闭包计划。

description.en: Command resolution forensics: which file a command actually runs, which PATH entry won, what it shadows, how many entries are duplicates or dead, and whether the copies behind one name report the same version.
description.zh: 命令解析取证：一条命令实际会跑哪个文件、PATH 哪一条胜出、遮蔽了谁、有多少重复与死条目，以及同名副本报的版本是否一致。

description.en: Runtime-switchable outbound HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy for DSH with a web settings card.
description.zh: DSH 运行时可切换的出站 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理，带网页设置卡片。

description.en: Design studio with MasterGo MCP node inspection, built-in implementation prompts and Reborn UI references. Needs the MasterGo desktop app with Vibe MCP enabled, and the dsh-studio-projects runtime and the dsh-worktable container from 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library installed first.
description.zh: 设计工作室，提供 MasterGo MCP 节点检查、内置实现提示词及 Reborn UI 参考。需本机 MasterGo 桌面端并开启 Vibe MCP，且先安装 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library 的 dsh-studio-projects 运行时与 dsh-worktable 容器。

description.en: Shared studio runtime serving plugin pages and connecting locally configured applications to DSH sessions.
description.zh: 工作室共享运行时，提供插件页面资源及本地应用与 DSH 会话的连接。

description.en: Real-time stage, ETA & cost dashboard for headless dsh tasks: turns the black-box session event stream into a live multi-task grid (cordis plugin + standalone local dashboard, no API calls).
description.zh: headless dsh 任务的实时阶段、ETA 与成本看板：把黑盒会话事件流变成实时多任务网格（cordis 插件 + 本地独立看板，零 API 调用）。

description.en: Deletes the dsh-auth-* login cookies DSH Desktop appends on every launch, which otherwise pile up past the 16 KB request-header limit and make the app fail with HTTP 431.
description.zh: 清理 DSH 桌面端每次启动新增的 dsh-auth-* 登录 Cookie，避免累积超过 16KB 请求头上限后出现 HTTP 431、打不开。

description.en: Opt-in HTTP proxy service for DSH plugins, with native address and port settings. Exposes scopedHttpProxy for explicit callers, applies address changes to subsequent requests, and leaves system proxies, environment variables and global network dispatchers unchanged.
description.zh: 供 DSH 插件显式调用的独立 HTTP 代理服务，提供原生地址和端口设置。通过 scopedHttpProxy 服务接入，地址修改对后续请求生效，不修改系统代理、环境变量或全局网络连接器。

description.en: Batches independent tool calls into one model round-trip: run_tools dispatches many steps concurrently (after-dependencies for ordering), run_parallel fans out sub-agents, so fewer round-trips and lower wall-clock time.
description.zh: 把互不依赖的工具调用合并进一次模型往返：run_tools 并发派发多步（after 表达先后依赖），run_parallel 并行派发子 agent，减少往返次数与墙钟时间。

description.en: Ecosystem trend dashboard (行情面板): snapshot the dsh-plugin topic and the awesome list into local history, then report weekly trends — new plugins, star gainers, category heat, awesome coverage — plus a keyword radar for new plugins and star surges.
description.zh: 生态行情面板：把 dsh-plugin topic 与 awesome 收录列表快照成本地历史，产出周报（新增插件、star 增速、类别热度、收录覆盖率），并支持关键词雷达监控新品与 star 突增。

description.en: Installs a self-evolving development-constraints rule library, exposes it to the agent through a constraints tool and a once-per-session reminder, and audits AI token cost and context usage.
description.zh: 把一套会自我进化的开发约束规则库装进项目，通过 constraints 工具和「每会话一次」的提醒交给智能体，并可审计 AI 的 token 成本与上下文占用。

description.en: Restarts the running DSH process from a model tool or a bottom-right GUI control, with launchd KeepAlive detection, a detached-supervisor fallback that aborts the exit when its handshake fails, a macOS desktop restart path, and JSONL restart records correlated by arm id, pid and profile so a restart stays distinguishable from unrelated log activity.
description.zh: 用模型工具或右下角 GUI 控件重启正在运行的 DSH 进程：探测 launchd KeepAlive，无托管时派 detached supervisor 兜底（握手失败即取消退出），桌面版走 macOS 应用重启路径，每次重启写入按 armId、pid 与 profile 关联的 JSONL 记录，使一次重启能与日志里的无关活动区分开。

description.en: Quality suite: background tsc --noEmit diagnostics fed back after the agent edits TypeScript, plus a /code-review command running five parallel review lenses with confidence scoring; absorbs dsh-code-check and dsh-command-code-review.
description.zh: 质控套件：agent 编辑 TypeScript 后自动回喂 tsc --noEmit 诊断，另含 /code-review 命令（五镜头并行审查 + 置信度评分）；吸收合并 dsh-code-check 与 dsh-command-code-review。

description.en: Shows which hosts each local app connects to, restores real domain names through the local Clash/mihomo controller, and records first/last-seen times to the second.
description.zh: 看清本机每个软件在连哪些 host：经本地 Clash/mihomo 还原真实域名，并给出精确到秒的首次/最近时间。

description.en: Rewrites pwsh and bash tool commands through `rtk rewrite` and executes the compact equivalent; falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent, and ships a checksum-verified `/rtk install` downloader.
description.zh: 把 pwsh / bash 工具命令经 `rtk rewrite` 改写后执行，让 rtk 的压缩输出进入上下文；rtk 缺失或无等价命令时原样执行，并提供带 SHA256 校验的 `/rtk install` 下载。

description.en: Manage development projects from the DSH web UI in a draggable floating window: add/remove, one-click start/stop/restart, hot-reload restart on file changes, and real-time persistent logs.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面以悬浮窗口管理开发项目：添加/删除、一键启动/停止/重启、文件变更热重载自动重启、实时日志查看与持久化。

description.en: Scaffold DSH local bundles in the dph format from any workspace and keep a pitfall experience library to steer later development.
description.zh: 在任意工作区按 dph 格式脚手架 DSH 本地插件，并维护踩坑经验库持续修正开发。

description.en: Governs the persistent information and project constraints an agent works with - project orientation and scope, information and document lifecycle, and persistent workspace mutation - through one additive system-prompt section plus deterministic runtime checks.
description.zh: 治理代理在项目中持续接触的持久信息与项目约束：项目定位与范围、信息与文档生命周期、持久工作区变更；通过一个附加的系统提示章节与确定性的运行时检查落地。

description.en: Verifies that Cordis-managed runtime resources return to baseline after isolated plugin teardown, with deterministic cleanup receipts.
description.zh: 隔离插件卸载后验证 Cordis 管理的运行时资源是否回到基线，并生成确定性清理回执。

description.en: Self-diagnosing, self-repairing watchdog for DSH plugins: 15s health patrol, version-switch repair with observe window and auto rollback, unknown symptoms escalated to human.
description.zh: DSH 插件自诊断自修复看门狗：15 秒巡检、带观察窗与自动回退的版本切换修复、未知病症上报人工。

description.en: Moves a DSH profile to another machine with its plugins, not only its files: packs the plugin bundle selection and the whole settings layer into one JSON file, then on restore writes the configuration back, restores local plugin sources and plugin-owned data, and installs the plugin bundles the backup recorded that the new machine is missing (plugin manager first, pnpm as a fallback).
description.zh: 换机迁移 DSH profile，连插件本身一起：把插件包选择与整个配置层打包成一个 JSON 文件，恢复时写回配置、还原本地插件源码与插件数据，并安装备份里记录、新机器缺失的插件包（优先插件管理器，失败回退 pnpm）。

description.en: Packs the third-party plugins installed in a DSH profile into tarballs and pushes them to a GitHub or Gitee repository; another machine pulls the manifest, compares versions and installs only what is missing or out of date. Needs a personal access token with write access to that repository (kept in the DSH credentials service); the tarballs contain each plugin's installed source, so use a private repository.
description.zh: 把 DSH 配置档里已安装的第三方插件连同源码打包成 tarball 推送到 GitHub 或 Gitee 仓库；另一台电脑拉取清单、比对版本，只安装缺失或过期的插件。需要对该仓库有写权限的个人访问令牌（存于 DSH 凭据服务）；压缩包含各插件已安装的源码，建议使用私有仓库。

description.en: Runs project check commands itself and records the real exit codes, pins the result to a git or file workspace fingerprint, expires the evidence when the tree changes, and reminds the agent to verify before claiming completion.
description.zh: 由插件自己执行项目检查命令并记录真实退出码，把结果绑定到 git 或文件级工作区指纹；代码一变旧证据自动过期，收尾时提醒 agent 先取证再宣称完成。

description.en: Capability drift detection: audit a plugin once, store a baseline of what it could do, then after every upgrade report only what is NEW (new install scripts, shell/eval access, outbound domains, credential paths). Deletions and version bumps are not reported, and no score is computed.
description.zh: 能力漂移检测：先审一次、存下这份插件当时能做什么的基线，之后每次升级只报新增的能力（新增安装脚本、shell/eval、外联域名、凭据路径）。删除项和版本号变化不报；不计算评分。

description.en: Dependency-topology guard: pre-install conflict prediction and post-install detection of duplicate @deepseek-ai/dsh-* copies, version drift, and vendored core services that cause Symbol-key crashes like "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')".
description.zh: 依赖拓扑安全：装前预测 + 装后检测 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 多副本、版本漂移与插件私包，防 Symbol 键冲突崩溃（Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')）。

description.en: Per-process tool-call statistics: a `tool_stats` tool reporting per-tool call counts, error counts, and average durations.
description.zh: 进程内工具调用统计：提供 `tool_stats` 工具，按工具汇报调用次数、失败次数与平均耗时。

description.en: Observation-only audit for DSH Agent Teams that records per-request cache usage and prompt-prefix rewrites to JSONL, with no tool or prompt changes.
description.zh: DSH 智能体团队的纯观测审计：把每请求缓存用量与提示前缀重写事件落成 JSONL，不加工具、不改提示词。

description.en: Screen frames, log lines and (on Windows) key/mouse input on one millisecond timeline: record, mark the failing seconds, box the problem on the frame, then hand the agent a keyframe strip, an animated GIF and the aligned log slice.
description.zh: 把屏幕画面、日志和（Windows 上）键鼠输入放在同一条毫秒时间轴上：录完标出问题区间、在画面上拖框标注，再把关键帧条带、动图和对齐后的日志切片连同描述一起交给 Agent。

description.en: Streams a running Godot game into a DSH sidebar panel as MJPEG by driving a native Godot process, so Forward+ projects and GDExtensions keep working. The panel can start, stop, capture and fullscreen the view and inject clicks, and the agent gets tools to read status, drive input and take screenshots.
description.zh: 通过驱动原生 Godot 进程把运行中的游戏画面以 MJPEG 推进 DSH 侧栏面板，Forward+ 项目与 GDExtension 都照常工作。面板可启动、停止、抓帧、全屏并注入点击，agent 另有工具读取状态、注入输入与截图。

description.en: Keeps a model request alive through a dropped connection: transport failures retry until the network returns while real errors still fail fast, and a turn killed by a process crash offers a one-click, state-checking continuation.
description.zh: 断网时不让模型请求死掉：连接类失败会重试到网络恢复，而真正的错误仍然立刻失败；被进程崩溃打断的一轮还会给出一键续跑，先核对状态再继续。

description.en: Backs up and restores the whole DSH profile through a private Git repository: profile configuration, per-plugin settings, skills, installed plugins and MCP servers, with one-click backup and restore and a restore point written before anything is overwritten.
description.zh: 通过一个私有 Git 仓库备份与恢复整个 DSH profile：profile 配置、各插件设置、技能、已装插件与 MCP 服务器，提供一键备份与恢复，并在覆盖任何内容之前先写一个还原点。

description.en: Inspects ONNX models (inputs/outputs, shapes, opset, operators, size) and benchmarks them with ONNX Runtime on the local machine or on a remote target over SSH, reporting average/P50/P95/P99 latency, FPS and the execution provider actually used, with PASS/FAIL gates for FPS, P95 latency and model size. Requires Python 3.10+ with numpy, onnx, onnxruntime, and psutil installed (pip install numpy onnx onnxruntime psutil); remote targets need python3, numpy, and onnxruntime.
description.zh: 检查 ONNX 模型（输入输出、形状、opset、算子、体积），并用 ONNX Runtime 在本机或通过 SSH 在远程设备上做基准测试，报告平均/P50/P95/P99 延迟、FPS 及实际使用的执行后端，可按 FPS、P95 延迟和模型体积设置 PASS/FAIL 部署门槛。本机运行需要 Python 3.10+ 并安装 numpy、onnx、onnxruntime 和 psutil（pip install numpy onnx onnxruntime psutil）；远程目标还需要 python3、numpy 和 onnxruntime。

description.en: Runs enabled PowerShell, CMD, Bash and Python presets in a user-defined order when DSH starts, shows live output for the selected preset in a left-sidebar page, and ends each managed process tree on stop, restart, disable, delete, or exit.
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动时按用户设定的顺序运行启用的 PowerShell、CMD、Bash 与 Python Preset，在左侧边栏页查看所选 Preset 的实时输出，并在停止、重启、停用、删除或退出时结束对应进程树。

description.en: One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness via a sidebar button, a model tool, and a detached watchdog.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键重启：侧边栏按钮、模型工具与独立守护进程。

description.en: Auto-update plugin for DeepSeek Harness — checks and updates a git-checkout or npm-global dsh plus integration repos, with ff-only pulls, automatic rollback, cancel, and an optional idle-aware auto-apply mode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动更新插件：检查并更新 git checkout 或 npm 全局形态的 dsh 本体与 integrations 仓，仅快进合并、失败自动回滚、可随时取消，可选空闲感知自动应用。

description.en: Evidence-first frontend release checks: real-browser content, accessibility, runtime, network, and baseline regression reports with screenshots.
description.zh: 证据优先的前端交付验收：用真实浏览器检查内容、无障碍、运行时错误、网络失败与结构基线，并保存截图报告。

description.en: Toolbox panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a right-side drawer (full screen on phones) with connection information (Wi-Fi details and gateway ping need a Windows host), one-click diagnostics, a speed test with server-side timing, a quality monitor, history and auto patrol; the host registers the /api/toolbox routes.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 工具箱：右侧抽屉（手机全屏），含连接情况（Wi-Fi 详情与网关 ping 需 Windows 宿主）、一键体检、测速（服务端计时）、质量监控、历史与自动巡检；宿主注册 /api/toolbox 路由。

description.en: Local-first control plane for managing multiple DSH runtimes, profiles, presets, sessions, plans, and knowledge references.
description.zh: 面向本地优先管理多个 DSH Runtime、Profile、Preset、Session、计划和知识引用的控制平面。

description.en: Adds a restart_self tool and /restart command that replace the DSH host process with the same command line and port, then deliver a message into the calling session so the agent picks the work back up by itself.
description.zh: 新增 restart_self 工具与 /restart 命令：以相同命令行与端口替换 DSH 宿主进程，重启完成后向发起会话投递一条消息，让智能体接着自己跑。

description.en: Keeps code edits in a review loop instead of letting the model edit files: each change is proposed as a two-column diff card with line numbers, applied by hand or with one click, and handed back for verification with another click.
description.zh: 把代码修改放进评审回路，而不是让模型直接改文件：每处改动以带行号的两列 diff 卡片提出，用户手动落地或一键应用，再点一下把接力棒交回给 AI 复核。

description.en: Take control of your tmux panes: list/send-keys/capture, run long jobs in a pane with watch mode, and approval-gated destructive commands.
description.zh: 掌控你的 tmux 面板：list/send-keys/capture、在面板中运行长任务并 watch，破坏性命令需审批。

description.en: In-process crash guard: takes over the fatal-error handlers that would exit DSH, names the responsible plugin from the stack, and disables only that row in the home patch layer, leaving the profile and the provider config inside it untouched. The crash page offers retry, keep-disabled or uninstall, and opens a temporary safe-mode session when no culprit can be named (CLI and web launches only).
description.zh: 进程内崩溃兜底：接管本该让 DSH 退出的致命错误处理器，从栈里认出是哪个插件，只在 home 层停用那一行——profile 与里面的供应商配置一个字节都不写。崩溃页给出恢复、保持禁用、卸载三个选择；认不出是谁时，开一个临时的安全模式会话（仅命令行与 web 启动）。

description.en: Lets build commands run inside the DSH sandbox instead of asking for elevation on every invocation: redirects pure caches (GOCACHE, NPM_CONFIG_CACHE, BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR, PIP_CACHE_DIR) to a temp root, or grants the real cache directories write access in place so they stay shared with the terminal. Dependency stores (GOMODCACHE, CARGO_HOME) are never redirected, only granted. Adds optional user-directory grants (~/.config and friends, all off by default) and a command allowlist that matches exact strings or per-segment after splitting on &&, ||, ; and |, while rejecting redirects that write files (fd duplication like 2>&1 and /dev/null are allowed), command substitution and backgrounding outright. Settings are per-profile or per-session; file edits apply without a restart.
description.zh: 让构建命令直接在 DSH 沙箱内跑通，不再每次申请提权：把纯缓存（GOCACHE、NPM_CONFIG_CACHE、BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR、PIP_CACHE_DIR）重定向到临时目录，或原地授权真实缓存目录以与终端共用。依赖仓库（GOMODCACHE、CARGO_HOME）永不重定向，只做授权。另提供可选的用户目录授权（~/.config 等，默认全关）与命令白名单：支持逐字符匹配，或按 &&、||、;、| 拆段后逐段匹配，写文件的重定向（fd 复制如 2>&1 与 /dev/null 除外）、命令替换与后台执行一律拒绝。配置支持按 profile 或按会话生效，改配置文件无需重启。

description.en: Read-only agent checkup with four probes (output repetition, error visibility, tool failure rate, context bloat) over recent local session logs, rendered as an HTML report.
description.zh: Agent 体检：对近期本地会话日志跑重复率/错误可见性/工具失败率/上下文膨胀四个只读探针，输出 HTML 报告。

description.en: Project progress panel that scans a configurable root for local projects, infers activity from anchors and git evidence, and exports a self-contained dark HTML report.
description.zh: 项目进度面板：扫描配置根目录下的本地项目，按锚点与 git 证据推断活跃度，支持筛选、锚点标记与自包含深色 HTML 报告导出。

description.en: WeChat Mini Program engineering tools: scan a project for pages missing from app.json, scaffold pages with automatic registration, fix orphan pages, manage subpackages, tabBar and components, and drive the WeChat DevTools CLI for preview QR codes and uploads.
description.zh: 微信小程序工程工具：体检扫出没写进 app.json 的页面，建页面时自动注册，一键修复孤儿页，管理分包、tabBar 与组件，并可调用微信开发者工具出预览二维码、上传体验版。

description.en: Blocks the end of a turn while temporary files from that turn are still lying around: it registers a listener on the serial agent/turn-stopping hook and, if anything is left, steers the model with the file list and two ways out — delete them, or justify each one and move it somewhere deliberate. Candidates come from two narrow temp-file sources, plus a backup-retention channel that is on by default and flags excess .bak copies of files touched this turn. The first is the .agent-tmp/ convention directory under the session cwd: whatever is left in it is reported outright, because that directory exists only for throwaway files. The second is the paths this turn actually wrote, captured through the fs/write-intent hook; those are reported only when they sit under that cwd, fall outside .git, node_modules, .tmp-sessions and out, match a temp-file pattern, and the file is still present — which is what keeps junk already sitting in the workspace from being resurrected as a complaint about this turn. One steer per turn, subagent sessions skipped, nothing deleted by the plugin in the default steer mode (only the opt-in mode: prune deletes backups), and the check is readdir plus stat only.
description.zh: 临时文件没清完，这一轮就结束不了：在串行的 agent/turn-stopping 钩子上挂一个监听器，发现残留就把文件清单 steer 回模型，并给两条出路——删掉，或者逐条说明理由再挪到明确位置。候选有两处很窄的临时件来源，另有一条默认开启的备份保留通道：本轮碰过的 .bak 副本超过 keep 份会被列出。第一处是会话 cwd 下的 .agent-tmp/ 约定目录：留在里面的文件一律直接报出，因为这个目录的存在意义就是装可丢的东西。第二处是本轮经 fs/write-intent 钩子真实写入的路径，这些还要同时满足：在那个 cwd 之下、不落在 .git / node_modules / .tmp-sessions / out 里、命中临时件模式、且文件此刻仍在，才会报——正因如此，工作区里早就躺着的垃圾不会被翻出来当成本轮的问题。每轮只拦一次，子会话跳过，默认的 steer 模式下插件自己不删任何文件（只有显式选 mode: prune 才会删备份），检查只做 readdir 与 stat。

description.en: Records a session as a run, replays it in an isolated workspace copy with another model or prompt, diffs the two trajectories side by side, aggregates runs into a task × variant matrix, and gates regressions with task assertions and a CI exit code.
description.zh: 把会话录成运行，在隔离副本里换模型或提示词重放，逐行对比两次轨迹，把多次运行聚合成任务 × 变体矩阵，并用任务断言与 CI 退出码做回归门禁。

description.en: Adds budgets to agent waiting: caps job_output waits, refuses runaway foreground commands inside run_code, breaks status-polling loops after four no-progress probes, and explains run_code deadlines and parse errors.
description.zh: 给 agent 的等待加预算：限制 job_output 等待、拦截 run_code 里超长的前台命令、连续四次只查状态就熔断轮询，并解释 run_code 的截止时间与解析错误。

description.en: Inspects a plugin's declarative patch entries and installed code files on its Plugins page.
description.zh: 在插件详情页查看插件的声明式 patch 与安装后的代码文件。

description.en: Blocks tool calls that create temporary files or directories in the workspace root, moves new root-level temp entries into tmp/_quarantine at turn end, and provides a graphical settings page.
description.zh: 拦截在仓库根目录创建临时文件或目录的工具调用，在回合结束时把新增的根目录临时项移入 tmp/_quarantine，并提供图形化设置页。

description.en: Repairs domains blocked by SNI filtering on Windows from inside DSH, without any self-hosted server.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上从 DSH 内部修复被 SNI 阻断的域名，不依赖任何自建服务器。

description.en: Audits and evolves agent context at four scopes: a single repository, a group of related repos, a knowledge hub, or the whole machine. Discovers projects, instruction files, skills, tools, knowledge, project state, evidence and credential references; reports drift, duplicate facts, broken pointers, paths left unverifiable in prose, budget overruns, unindexed knowledge, stale state and unregistered credentials; scores each scope on the dimensions that belong to it; and turns findings into reviewable migration plans that back up every file before moving it. The format contract behind the metrics is written down as a versioned spec (CTX rules, markdownlint-style IDs) that follows open conventions — AGENTS.md for instruction files, llms.txt-shaped link indexes. Also scaffolds a deliberately small hub for durable knowledge and project state. Ships a stdlib-only Python CLI plus two skills, with credentials referenced by path and never printed. Requires Python 3.9+ (stdlib only) and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3.0.
description.zh: 按四个层级审计与治理 agent 上下文：单个仓库、一组相关仓库、知识中枢、整台机器。发现项目、指令文件、技能、工具、知识、项目状态、证据与凭据引用；报告漂移、同一事实多个家、断链、正文里不可验证的裸路径、预算超限、未索引知识、过期状态与未登记凭据；每个层级只算属于它的维度；并把问题转成可复核的迁移计划，每个文件移动前先备份。指标背后的格式契约落成了版本化规范（CTX 规则、markdownlint 式稳定编号），并遵循开源惯例——指令文件用 AGENTS.md 标准、索引用 llms.txt 形态链接列表。还能生成一个刻意保持精简的 Hub，承载长期知识与项目状态。包含零依赖 Python CLI 和两个 skill，凭据只引用路径、从不打印。需要 Python 3.9+（仅标准库）与 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 或更新、低于 0.3.0 的版本。

description.en: Close and restart controls for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web on Windows, in Settings → General.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 与 Web 提供「关闭程序」和「重启程序」控制，位于「设置 → 通用设置」。

description.en: View and interact with the persistent terminal used by each DSH Agent.
description.zh: 查看并操作每个 DSH Agent 使用的持久终端。

description.en: Hot-reloads DSH plugin modules without restarting the app (module-cache purge, junction-path matching, bust fallback) and registers a refresh button in the session header so the browser page loads the new plugin bundles.
description.zh: DSH 插件免重启热重载：清模块缓存、按 junction 路径匹配、失败时带版本号重新导入， 并在会话标题栏注册一颗刷新按钮，让页面立刻加载新的插件 bundle。

description.en: Reports conflicting DeepSeek Harness plugin composition — duplicate loader names across bundles (install-shadow), one id given two names, enable/disable fights, and config keys silently overwritten by a later layer — then emits a patch with the final merged values. Ships a CLI that runs when DSH itself will not boot, plus a fusion_report tool that reads the live loader.
description.zh: 检查 DeepSeek Harness 插件装配层的冲突：跨 bundle 重复的 loader 名（install-shadow）、同一个 id 被写成两个 name、一层要开一层要关、以及被后一层静默覆盖的配置键，并把覆盖合成终值补丁。带一条 DSH 起不来时也能跑的 CLI，另有一个会读运行时 loader 的 fusion_report 工具。

description.en: Checkup for the whole plugin lifecycle: before install it verifies dsh.bundle, engine and peer compatibility, native build needs, platform limits and whether the new patch would mount a loader name that is already installed (install-shadow prediction); after install it groups every installed plugin by capability; before update it runs the same checks against the new version and reports only the problems the update introduces. Ships a CLI that runs even when DSH will not boot, plus three read-only tools.
description.zh: 管插件全生命周期的体检：装之前检查 dsh.bundle、引擎与 peer 兼容性、是否需要编译原生模块、平台限制，以及新插件的 patch 会不会挂出已存在的 loader 名（install-shadow 预判）；装之后把已装插件按能力分类；更新前对新版本跑同一套检查，只报这次更新引入的问题。带一条 DSH 起不来时也能跑的 CLI，和三个只读工具。

description.en: Re-encodes WebP attachment images to PNG so alpha-channel images load on LLM backends that cannot decode WebP (e.g. llama.cpp).
description.zh: 把 WebP 附件图片转码成 PNG，让带 alpha 通道的图能在无法解码 WebP 的 LLM 后端上加载（例如 llama.cpp）。

description.en: Auto-approval agent for DSH permission requests: rule layer (denyAlways/allowlist) plus Hermes Pro semantic adjudication with quick-fail retries, fail-closed to human when Hermes is unavailable, rejection feedback returned to the requesting session, and approve tasks enqueued into the task queue with a shared busy mutex.
description.zh: DSH 权限请求自动审批代理：规则层（黑名单/白名单）+ Hermes Pro 语义裁决（快速失败重试），Hermes 不可用时 fail-closed 转人工；拒绝原因回传发起会话；审批任务入队并与消费端共用忙锁串行化。

description.en: Hands DSH reset requests to an external ops agent via a versioned JSON protocol: preflight snapshot, pre-restart maturity gate (no pending approvals, free disk, cooldown), restart, health check, and interrupted-work recovery, with the result delivered back to the requesting session.
description.zh: 把 DSH 重置请求经带版本的 JSON 协议交给外部运维 agent：预检快照、重启前成熟度门禁（无待审批、磁盘充足、冷却期）、重启、健康检查与业务恢复，结果投递回发起会话。

description.en: Tiered task queue as the single source of truth for DSH↔Hermes work (reset > approve > review): enqueue tools for all submission paths, lease/claim model with concurrency 1, priority aging against starvation, atomic busy mutex, and a Hermes-side consumer (cron */1 + monitor gating) that drains tasks, writes review-handoff requests with single-slot checks, and invokes the reset agent.
description.zh: DSH↔Hermes 协作的缓存梯队任务队列（reset > approve > review，queue.json 唯一真相源）：全部提审路径入队、租约/认领模型并发 1、优先级 aging 防饿死、原子忙锁；Hermes 侧消费端（cron */1 + monitor 门控）出队执行、单槽检查写审核请求、调用重置 agent。

description.en: Windows recovery CLI and bundle for a DeepSeek Harness profile that no longer boots: test-boot a copy, disable selected plugins, restore a snapshot. Ships dsh_safe_status and dsh_safe_snapshot tools.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的进程外恢复工具兼插件包：为无法启动的 DeepSeek Harness profile 试启动副本、禁用选中的插件、回滚快照，并提供 dsh_safe_status 与 dsh_safe_snapshot 两个工具。

description.en: Audits a DSH profile for capabilities nothing consumes: inventories the declared composition rows, counts how often each registered tool and skill is actually called in the session logs, separates calls that were made from calls that returned a result, and reports the ones with no observed consumer. Ships a skill that fixes the evidence-chain format for completion claims.
description.zh: 审计 DSH profile 里没有消费者的能力：清点已声明的组成行，统计每个已注册工具与 skill 在会话日志里真正被调用的次数，把「发起过调用」与「返回了结果」分开，报告没有观察到消费者的那些；并附一份固定「完成声明」证据链格式的 skill。
