description.en: Keeps DeepSeek Harness desktop dsh-auth-* session cookies bounded by deleting stale ones during the token exchange performed on every launch, so random-port accumulation cannot reach the 16 KiB request-header limit and cause an HTTP 431 startup failure.
description.zh: 在每次启动的令牌交换中删除多余的 dsh-auth-* 会话 cookie，让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的 cookie 数量保持在 3 条以内，避免随机端口累积达到 16 KiB 请求头上限而出现 HTTP 431 启动失败。

description.en: List the LLM provider routes a running DSH process registered and run one real streamed call.
description.zh: 列出运行中 DSH 进程真实注册的 LLM 路由，并可跑一次真实流式调用。

description.en: Real AST-based scan of installed plugins for malicious-intent patterns (dynamic eval, cross-plugin writes, exfiltration-shaped network calls), with an optional periodic schedule and auto-quarantine on critical findings.
description.zh: 基于 AST 的已装插件恶意行为扫描：识别动态 eval、跨插件写入、外泄型网络调用等模式，并给出可复核的报告。

description.en: Turn real sessions into regression cases, replay them in isolated git worktrees, and verify tests, changed files, step and token limits. Fully local. Replays run each case's test commands in a git worktree; its HTTP route has no DSH access check.
description.zh: 把真实会话固化为回归用例，在隔离的 git worktree 中重放，并校验测试命令、改动文件、步数与 token 上限；全部本地执行。重放会在 git worktree 里运行每个用例的测试命令；它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Replaces the built-in bash executor so every command gets an environment resolved from its own working directory: configurable PATH prepends, Python venv activation and mise shims, with a dedicated section in the Web UI settings.
description.zh: 替换内置 bash 执行器，按每条命令的工作目录解析环境：可配置的 PATH 追加、Python venv 自动激活与 mise shims，并在 Web UI 设置中提供独立分区。

description.en: Minimal-anchored agent preset: request #1 keeps the real bash + str_replace_editor pair with auto-injected context stripped, then promotion unlocks the full Standard catalog and posts a one-shot background-jobs notice against sleep-polling habits.
description.zh: Minimal 锚定的 agent preset：request #1 仅保留真实 bash + str_replace_editor 工具对并剥离自动注入上下文，晋升后开放完整 Standard 工具目录，并注入一次性后台 job 提示纠正 sleep 前台轮询惯性。

description.en: Runs DeepSeek Harness bash commands inside the workspace's Nix dev shell whenever a flake.nix is present.
description.zh: 工作区存在 flake.nix 时，让 DeepSeek Harness 的 bash 命令在 nix develop 的 devShell 环境中执行。

description.en: Complement to official Creator mode: stage, validate, live-mount via ctx.plugin, score, and solidify or roll back in-memory tool-plugin trials.
description.zh: 补充官方创造模式：把内存里试过的小工具插件校验、经 ctx.plugin 热挂、打分后固化到盘上或回滚。

description.en: Storage and dependency inspector for the DSH Web UI: scans disk use per workspace, session and file class, lists the largest folders and files, and deletes the build, dependency, archived-session and cache folders you select behind a path allow-list (cleanup candidates also include top-level Desktop folders); a read-only second tab compares package.json, .nvmrc, .node-version and npm lockfiles across workspaces and flags version and Node-major drift.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的存储与依赖检查器：按工作区、会话与文件类别统计磁盘占用，列出最大目录与文件，并可在路径白名单校验后删除你勾选的构建、依赖、已归档会话与缓存目录（清理候选还包括桌面上的一级文件夹）；只读的第二个页签跨工作区比对 package.json、.nvmrc、.node-version 与 npm 锁文件，标出版本与 Node 主版本漂移。

description.en: Exports selected DSH plugins as one pasteable share code, applies the delta on another machine, and reports which credentials still need configuring.
description.zh: 把勾选的 DSH 插件导出成一条可粘贴的分享码，在另一台机器上应用差量，并列出仍需补齐的凭据。

description.en: Unity 2022.3 editor control for the agent: 20 tools that read the scene hierarchy, create and edit GameObjects, components and serialized properties, drive Play mode, capture screenshots, evaluate C# inside the editor and start player builds.
description.zh: 让 agent 直接操作 Unity 2022.3 编辑器：20 个工具可读写场景层级、增删改 GameObject 与组件及序列化属性、控制 Play 模式、截图、在编辑器内执行 C#、发起打包构建。

description.en: Requires mise installed on the host. A mise-backed toolchain manager for the host machine — a settings page listing the active, installed and available versions, with .mise.toml-driven install, use, uninstall and prune, mise shims prepended to the host PATH on load, and nine agent tools for the same work (status, versions, PATH scan, install, use, prune, uninstall, activate, progress).
description.zh: 需本机先安装 mise。用 mise 管理本机工具链 —— 设置页列出生效 / 已装 / 可用版本，按 .mise.toml 安装、切换、卸载与清理，加载时把 mise 的 shims 放进 Host PATH 最前，并给 agent 九个工具（状态、版本、PATH 扫描、安装、切换、清理、卸载、激活、进度）。

description.en: Compatibility layer for DSH on Termux/Linux: an opt-in loader patch keeps one broken client plugin from blanking the whole page, overlay surfaces render solid, and a pre-install doctor checks plugin manifests and client dependencies. The loader patch is anchored to DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: DSH 兼容层（Termux/Linux）：可选的加载器补丁让单个坏插件不再整页白屏，弹层改实色渲染，装插件前用 doctor 体检清单与客户端依赖。加载器补丁仅锚定 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: S3-compatible backend for the spill seam: oversized tool output goes to object storage (S3, MinIO, R2) with hashed session prefixes and unguessable keys, instead of the agent's local disk.
description.zh: spill seam 的 S3 兼容后端：超长工具输出写入对象存储（S3、MinIO、R2），会话前缀经哈希、键不可猜测，而不是落在 agent 的本地磁盘上。

description.en: Aborts startup when another live dsh instance holds the same DSH_HOME data directory, preventing the concurrent session-log writes that corrupt transcripts.
description.zh: 检测到其他存活的 dsh 实例占用同一 DSH_HOME 数据目录时中止启动，防止并发写会话日志导致的历史损坏。

description.en: Grouped run panel for DeepSeek Harness: one click starts a project's services in a real PTY, streams live colored output, and keeps every run's log on disk where the agent can read it.
description.zh: 分组运行面板：在真 PTY 里一键启动项目服务，实时彩色输出，每次运行的日志落盘，代理可直接读取。

description.en: Skill and plugin audit console for DeepSeek Harness. It scans local skill folders and installed DSH plugins, checks the packaging rules that commonly break installation, scores each asset, and exports a Markdown fix report.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的技能与插件做体检的审核台：扫描本地技能目录和已安装插件，检查容易导致安装失败的打包规则，逐项打分并导出 Markdown 修复报告。

description.en: VS Code bridge for the DSH sidebar: launches VS Code, browses workspace files, sends files to the current conversation as attachments, and adds a floating multi-tab code workbench that auto-syncs saved changes.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的 VS Code 桥接：启动 VS Code、浏览工作区文件、把文件作为附件发到当前对话，并内置一个可拖动缩放的多标签代码工作台，保存后自动同步改动。

description.en: Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) plugin for DeepSeek Harness: validate, run, and scaffold declarative agents and workflows (YAML).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) 插件：验证、运行、搭建 declarative agents 与 workflows(YAML)。

description.en: WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: run Linux commands, manage distros, convert paths, and copy across the Windows/Linux boundary.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 WSL(Windows Subsystem for Linux)桥接：跑 Linux 命令、管理发行版、路径转换与跨系统复制。

description.en: Development kit for DSH plugins: a skill stating the contract lookup order (runtime inspect, then the bundled dsh-doc copy, then a working plugin source) and two check scripts — preflight verifies a plugin project against four install-failure families before packing, recheck re-tests declared host touchpoints after a DSH upgrade.
description.zh: DSH 插件开发工具包：一个 skill 给出宿主契约的查证顺序（运行时 inspect → 包内 dsh-doc 副本 → 已发布的同类插件源码），以及两个核查脚本——preflight 在打包前按四大装败家族逐项检查插件项目，recheck 在 DSH 升级后复检项目声明的宿主触点。

description.en: Read-only diagnostic that reports which leg of the DSH → bridge → OneBot → QQ chain is broken — process, port, login, preset or recent wake failures — and prints the fix for each failed check. Runs as `node check.mjs` (read-only by default; the optional `--fix` only aligns the bridge baseUrl and starts a stopped bridge), or installs as a `chain_check` tool.
description.zh: 只读诊断：DSH → 桥接 → OneBot → QQ 这条链断在哪一段——进程、端口、登录、preset、最近的唤醒失败——每一项都给出修法。可以直接 `node check.mjs` 跑（默认只读；可选的 `--fix` 只把桥接 baseUrl 对齐到当前端口、拉起没在运行的桥接），也可以装成 `chain_check` 工具。

description.en: Staleness keeper for the Codebase Memory knowledge graph: it compares the graph Branch node head_sha with git rev-parse HEAD and reports an exact behindBy, rebuilds only the stale projects through the codebase-memory-mcp CLI so the MCP tool 60-second cap does not apply, watches each project for edits, and mirrors the same state into a settings card and a REST control surface.
description.zh: Codebase Memory 知識圖譜的保鮮插件：比對圖譜 Branch 節點的 head_sha 與 git rev-parse HEAD、給出精確的落後提交數，只重建落後的專案且走 codebase-memory-mcp CLI（不受 MCP 工具 60 秒上限約束），逐專案監看檔案變更，並把同一份狀態呈現在設定卡片與 REST 控制面。

description.en: Native DSH right-sidebar tab that lists the ports this machine is listening on together with the process behind each one, and offers per-port actions to open it, copy its address, reveal its working directory or end the process.
description.zh: dsh 原生右侧栏页签：列出本机监听的端口及占用它的进程，并可对每个端口执行打开、复制地址、定位工作目录或结束进程。

description.en: A development safety kit: rolling config snapshots, automatic rollback on plugin failures, boot-failure rescue, and an in-settings management panel.
description.zh: 开发配套守护：滚动快照、插件失败自动回退、启动失败救援、设置页管理面板。

description.en: Prints every plugin in the DeepSeek Harness loader tree at boot, with the exception text for anything that failed, and checks dependency version drift, profile config validity, web port reachability and registered tools.
description.zh: 启动时打印 DeepSeek Harness 插件树中每一行的状态（失败的附异常内容），并检查依赖版本漂移、配置文件合法性、端口可达性与已注册工具。

description.en: Back up and restore the whole $DSH_HOME: one-click or scheduled ZIP archives (optional password encryption applies to manual and agent-made backups only; scheduled ones are not encrypted), a settings section, agent tools to create, list, restore and prune backups, and a standalone restorer (Windows .bat or POSIX .sh) that runs without DeepSeek Harness installed.
description.zh: 备份与恢复整个 $DSH_HOME：支持一键或定时生成 ZIP 归档（可选密码加密，仅限手动与智能体发起的备份，定时备份不加密）、提供设置页、给智能体的创建/列出/恢复/清理备份工具，并附带无需安装 DSH 也能运行的独立恢复器（Windows .bat 或 POSIX .sh）。

description.en: JetBrains IDEA agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that adds an IDEA mode with IDE MCP tools plus projectPath, parameter-name, and tool-name compatibility helpers.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 IDEA 模式：接入 IDEA MCP 工具，并自动补全 projectPath、兼容参数命名与工具名差异。

description.en: Adds the parse error line number and code frame to run_code errors.
description.zh: 为 run_code 解析错误补充行号和代码定位框。

description.en: Read-only linter for AGENTS.md, SKILL.md and plugin prompt files that reports conflicting rules, duplicates, vague qualifiers and dangerous commands with file and line suggestions.
description.zh: 策略体检：只读扫描 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md 与插件提示，列出规则冲突、重复、模糊限定和危险命令，并给文件行号与修改建议。

description.en: Saves per-workspace dev commands behind a header button, starts and stops them as process trees, and exposes four tools so the agent can list, start and stop those saved commands and read their logs (it cannot add or change commands).
description.zh: 按工作区保存开发启动命令，在会话头部一键启停并以进程树方式管理，同时注册四个工具，让会话列出、启停这些已保存的命令并读日志（不能新增或修改命令）。

description.en: Finds process trees whose parent is gone, groups them as high-confidence or review-only, and terminates the selected groups after a rescan.
description.zh: 找出父进程已退出的进程树，按高置信与待确认分档展示，二次扫描后才结束选中的进程组。

description.en: In-app server monitor window for DSH that tunnels to a lightweight agent on your server: memory, swap, load, disk, per-container usage and QQ status, cache purge and container restarts, plus an embedded VNC desktop for manual QQ QR login and sign-out. The agent ships in the repository (server/monitor.py) and you deploy it yourself.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内直接打开服务器监控窗口，经 SSH 隧道读取内存、交换分区、负载、磁盘、各容器占用与 QQ 登录状态，并提供清理缓存与重启容器按钮，以及内嵌 VNC 的 QQ 客户端供手动扫码登录或退出账号。守护 agent 随仓库提供（server/monitor.py），需要你自己部署。

description.en: Preview native WeChat Mini Programs in the DSH sidebar with a local runtime and WXML source locations.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右边栏预览原生微信小程序，提供本地运行时与 WXML 源码定位。

description.en: Crash protection for installed plugins: crash cards with one-click disable, static pre-flight inspection, black-box crash telemetry, and a safe-mode rescue profile for a broken UI.
description.zh: 已装插件的崩溃防护：崩溃卡片一键停用、静态预检、黑匣子遥测，以及救援损坏 UI 的安全模式 profile。

description.en: Stops session lockups from OpenAI-compatible gateways that stream empty tool-call ids: intercepts llm/stream chunks in memory to synthesize consistent call_<sha256> ids across tool-call-delta and block-end, plus offline session repair/verify scripts under tools/.
description.zh: 修复并预防 OpenAI 兼容网关流式返回空 tool_call id 导致的 DSH v4 会话锁死：在 llm/stream 拦截点纯内存合成一致的 call_<sha256> ID 补全 tool-call-delta 与 block-end，并在仓库 tools/ 下附带离线会话修复与校验脚本。

description.en: Agent governance suite: policy-based tool gating (allow/deny/ask with wildcards and priorities), a structured JSONL audit trail, and per-agent token quotas against the host token meter, with state under $DSH_HOME/gov.
description.zh: Agent 治理套件：基于策略的工具门禁（allow/deny/ask，支持通配符与优先级）、结构化 JSONL 审计日志、基于宿主 token 计量的按 agent 配额，状态存于 $DSH_HOME/gov。

description.en: Applies per-workspace default Agent and permission presets to new root sessions automatically (Settings - Workspace defaults), using only official extension points.
description.zh: 按工作区规则为新建根会话自动应用 Agent 预设与权限预设（设置 - 工作区默认设置），仅使用官方扩展点。

description.en: Rewrites agent-issued delete commands (PowerShell `Remove-Item` and its aliases, Bash `rm`/`unlink`/`rmdir`, CMD `del`/`erase`/`rd`/`rmdir`) into system recycle-bin operations on Windows, Linux and macOS, best-effort checks scripts for the same operations before they run, and keeps no permanent-delete fallback.
description.zh: 把 Agent 提交的删除命令（PowerShell `Remove-Item` 及别名、Bash `rm`/`unlink`/`rmdir`、CMD `del`/`erase`/`rd`/`rmdir`）改写为 Windows、Linux、macOS 的系统回收站操作，执行脚本前尽力检查其中的同类删除操作，且不提供永久删除兜底。

description.en: One-click Approve & escalate on the approval card: answers the pending request and switches the live session to a permission preset.
description.zh: 审批卡片上的「批准并升级」一键操作：既应答当前待批请求，又把当前会话切换到指定的权限预设。

description.en: Control panel for a local credential-redaction gateway in DeepSeek Harness: gateway and model health, audit metrics, a dry-run leak tester, an exemption whitelist, encrypted key management, credential-protected model entries and deployment controls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地凭据脱敏网关的控制面板：网关与小模型健康状态、审计指标、泄密探测沙箱、豁免白名单、加密密钥管理、凭据保护模型入口与部署控制。

description.en: Keeps a redundant sandbox-escalation argument from failing a tool call. Escalating tools (pwsh, bash, write, edit) advertise the full sandbox_permissions enum, but DSH only accepts a level strictly wider than the one already in effect — a check its own source calls 'deliberately not a schema constraint'. A model that reflexively passes the argument therefore picks the level it is already at and the call dies before running with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode', costing some models a whole turn of retries. This plugin registers one tools/execute waterfall listener and, only on that documented rejection and only when the arguments really carried an escalation field, re-issues the identical call once without it. Safe by DSH's own documentation: the rejection precedes any execution ('nothing has run'), and the corrected call cannot match again, so the retry is loop-free. Reproduced and verified end to end — before: isError true, the command never ran; after: the command's real output, isError false, one tool/call and one tool/result. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 让「同级或更窄的 sandbox_permissions」不再让工具调用直接失败。会升级的工具（pwsh、bash、write、edit）都广告完整的 sandbox_permissions 枚举，但 DSH 只接受严格更宽于当前生效级别的请求——其源码自称这是「deliberately not a schema constraint」。于是反射式带上该参数的模型往往填它已经在的那个级别，调用在执行前就死掉："sandbox escalation to \"workspace-write\" is not strictly wider than this call's current \"workspace-write\" mode"，某些模型还会为此烧掉一整轮重试。本插件只注册一个 tools/execute waterfall 监听器，且仅在那一条文档化拒绝上、且参数里确实带了升级字段时，把同一个调用去掉该参数重投一次。安全性由 DSH 自己的文档保证：拒绝发生在任何执行之前（"nothing has run"），且改过的参数无法再次匹配，因此重投在结构上不成环。已端到端复现并验证——改造前 isError 为 true 且命令从未执行；改造后拿到命令的真实输出、isError 为 false，会话里只有一个 tool/call 与一个 tool/result。零依赖。

description.en: Writes a model-generated annotation into every DSH escalation approval prompt — what the command does, what the model intends, how risky it is and why, and what each choice means — and keeps a searchable history of past approvals at /dsh-approval/history, with a diagnostics page at /dsh-approval/diag.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的每一次提权审批弹窗加一份由模型生成的注释：这段代码做什么、模型想达成什么、风险多大以及原因、每个选项意味着什么；并提供 /dsh-approval/history 历史授权查询（可搜索、可筛选、记录当时选了什么）与 /dsh-approval/diag 诊断页。

description.en: Puts sessions into the built-in Auto review permission preset: new sessions at creation, existing root sessions when they are restored.
description.zh: 让会话进入内置的 Auto review 权限预设：新建会话在创建时进入，已有的根会话在重新打开时切过去。

description.en: Restrict the file access of agents in any sandbox mode (read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access / auto) to the session workspace, and ask the user to rule on cross-border access. Each session can also use the gear selection box next to the composer to relax the cross-border gate to 「 read-only outside workspace 」 or 「 fully release 」.
description.zh: 把任何沙箱模式（read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access / auto）下代理的文件访问限制在会话工作区内，越界访问一律请用户裁决；每个会话还能用 composer 旁的档位选择框把越界门禁放宽为「工作区外只读」或「完全放开」。

description.en: Grades every PowerShell command an agent is about to run before it runs: deletion, overwrite, network download and credential access are four required classes, plus dynamic execution, system and privilege changes. Verdicts are a pure deterministic rule function — no model call, no network, sub-millisecond — with two escalation rules (download+execute, credential+exfiltrate) that jump straight to high. High risk stops the tool call for a second confirmation (in-panel queue or the native approval), deny or timeout means it never runs; medium is logged but never blocked. Every command and its verdict, including the redacted command text, is appended to a local JSONL audit log. Quoted danger strings are treated as data, -WhatIf is respected, -EncodedCommand is decoded and analysed again. Host + client halves, zero runtime dependencies, 55 rules, 136 tests.
description.zh: agent 要跑的每条 PowerShell 命令，执行前先分级：删除 / 覆盖 / 网络下载 / 触碰凭据四类必测，另加动态执行、系统改动、权限改动。判定是纯确定性规则函数——不调模型、不联网、亚毫秒，另有一条组合升级（下载+执行、凭据+外发直接判高危）。高危会停住这次工具调用等一次确认（面板队列或原生审批），拒绝或超时即不执行；中危只记录不拦。每条命令和它的判定（含脱敏后的命令原文）都追加到本地 JSONL 审计日志。引号里的危险字样当数据不当命令，-WhatIf 尊重空跑，-EncodedCommand 先解码再分析。host + client 双半、零运行时依赖、55 条规则、136 个测试。

description.en: Advisory permission checks for DSH tool calls: risk tiers, a path sandbox (empty allowed_roots denies every path-like call), a per-minute call limit and a JSONL audit, exposed through gate_check / gate_check_path / gate_policy and ctx.gate — other plugins or prompts must call the gate; it does not intercept tool calls by itself.
description.zh: DSH 工具调用的咨询式权限检查：风险分级、路径沙箱（allowed_roots 为空时一律拒绝）、每分钟调用限额与 JSONL 审计，通过 gate_check / gate_check_path / gate_policy 与 ctx.gate 提供——需由其他插件或提示主动调用，本身不拦截工具调用。

description.en: Non-blocking approvals and timed questions: permission requests park as pending items while the model keeps working and the approved call can be retried, and ask_user_question runs in timed mode (20 s) through an override of the whole standard agent preset that applies to new sessions after a restart.
description.zh: 非阻塞审批与定时提问：越权请求挂起为待办、模型继续干活、批准后重试；ask_user_question 通过整体覆盖 standard 预设切到 timed 模式（20 秒），重启后仅对新会话生效。

description.en: Rewrites the model-visible copy of system, developer, user, assistant and tool messages into stable HMAC placeholders before a request leaves the machine, while local session logs, the chat transcript and restored tool calls keep real values.
description.zh: 请求离开本机前，把 system/developer/user/assistant/tool 五类消息的模型可见副本改写为稳定 HMAC 占位符；本地会话日志、对话记录与还原后的工具调用仍保留真值。

description.en: Reviews destructive shell commands with a model before they run, asks you to confirm or blocks them, and aborts a running command once it has deleted too many files.
description.zh: 破坏性 shell 命令执行前由模型判断会不会造成不可逆破坏，判定会破坏时询问或拦下；命令运行中删除文件过多时中止。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness tools to discover MCP configurations across clients, audit static security rules and probe a named server, using a separately installed mcp-hub Rust binary.
description.zh: 通过单独安装的 mcp-hub Rust 程序，在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中跨客户端发现 MCP 配置、检查静态安全规则并验证指定服务的连通性。

description.en: Honesty guardrails on the tool pipeline: blocks a coding agent from weakening tests, swallowing errors, stubbing type checks, or deleting tests through the shell — nine deterministic hooks, each backed by a planted-failure test proving the guard can fail.
description.zh: 工具流水线上的诚实性护栏：阻止编码 agent 弱化测试、吞掉错误、用桩替换类型检查或通过 shell 删除测试——九个确定性 hook，每个都配有植入失败的测试，证明该护栏确实会触发。

description.en: Collects passwords through a card instead of the conversation: terminal prompts, the DSH sidebar browser, and Ego Lite, with multi-field forms and live strength rules.
description.zh: 通过卡片向用户索取密码，而不是让值进入对话：终端提示、DSH 侧边栏浏览器、Ego Lite，支持多字段表单与实时强度校验。

description.en: Semantic risk grading and progressive authorization: classifies tool calls into safe/risky/redline, asks before irreversible actions, auto-allows only approved-and-succeeded signatures.
description.zh: 语义风险分级与渐进授权：把工具调用分为安全／有风险／红线三档，不可逆操作前先询问，只对「已批准且曾成功」的签名自动放行。

description.en: Privacy guard for git workflows: before git commit, git push or gh repo sync it scans the content that would enter git (local paths, user info, API keys, private keys, connection strings) and blocks anything not approved in the DSH approval UI; approved items go into a manageable, masked whitelist. Native DSH Config schema with live settings, first-push full-repository scan, fail-closed checks, zero npm runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 提交/推送前隐私检查：在 git commit、git push、gh repo sync 前只读扫描将要进入 git 的内容（本地路径、用户信息、API Key、私钥、连接串等），未授权内容不会上传；命中时通过 DSH 审批面板授权，授权项进入可管理的掩码白名单。支持原生 DSH Config（设置页热改开关）、首次推送全仓扫描、fail-closed，零 npm 运行时依赖。

description.en: Read-only behavior audit for DSH sessions: flags unsafe actions in 8 categories (A–H) with rules for 14 subclasses (the 41-subclass taxonomy file is not shipped, so a built-in 14-subclass fallback is used), anchors every finding to a real event seq, and gives deep links plus the full tool-call / data-access chain of any assistant reply (parameters, results, files read and written, domains, sandbox and approval context). Every finding is drill-downable.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 会话行为安全审计：按 A–H 八大类标注不安全行为，目前有规则覆盖其中 14 个子类（41 子类的完整分类文件未随仓库提供，缺失时使用内置 14 子类兜底），每条发现都锚定到真实事件 seq，并提供深链倒查与任意一条回答的完整工具调用/数据访问链（参数、结果、读写文件、域名、沙箱与审批上下文）。发现可逐条下钻。

description.en: File-change diff bar with keep/undo summary, plus dangerous-command approval and red highlighting for bash/pwsh.
description.zh: 文件修改 diff 栏与保留/撤销汇总，以及对 bash/pwsh 危险命令的审批与标红。

description.en: API key switcher for DeepSeek Harness: save multiple API keys in Settings and switch the active one; the next model request uses it, with no DSH restart.
description.zh: DSH 多 API Key 管理：在设置里保存多把 Key 并一键切换，下一次模型请求即生效，无需重启 DSH。

description.en: Tools guard that moves agent-issued `rm` targets to the macOS Trash instead of deleting, with a shell-aware lexer covering compound and disguised commands; a switch in Settings → General turns it off.
description.zh: 工具守卫将 agent 执行的 rm 目标移入 macOS 废纸篓而非直接删除，shell 感知词法器覆盖复合与伪装命令；设置页通用设置中可随时关闭。

description.en: Configurable model-based approval review with workspace sandbox modes and review history.
description.zh: 可配置的模型审批审查，支持工作区沙箱模式和审查记录。

description.en: Arms an explicit per-session scope contract from a `$stop-that-shit` directive and audits every tool call against it; unarmed it is inert. A DSH bundle wrapping lennney/stop-that-shit (MIT). Do not install it alongside the upstream lennney/stop-that-shit DSH bundle.
description.zh: 用 `$stop-that-shit` 指令显式开启每会话范围契约并逐个工具调用审计；未开启时不干预。基于 lennney/stop-that-shit（MIT）的 DSH 封装。不要与上游 lennney/stop-that-shit 的 DSH bundle 同时安装。

description.en: Taints the agent when tool results carry untrusted content, gates the privileged calls that follow, and refuses credentials passed to network-capable tools in every mode.
description.zh: 当工具结果包含不可信内容时将代理标记为已污染，对随后的高权限调用进行拦截，并在所有模式下拒绝将凭据传递给可联网的工具。

description.en: A continuation of simon300000/dsh-auto: the Auto Approve permission preset for the DSH Web UI reviews each approval with one single-shot model call instead of a reviewer subagent, auto-approves only the actions that pass and hands the rest to human approval, and remembers confirmed decisions as project- and global-scope allow/deny lists, with an approval timeline in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 延续 simon300000/dsh-auto 的 DSH WebUI 自动审批权限档位：每次审批只走一次单轮模型审查、不再起审查子代理，只自动放行审查通过的动作、其余全部转回人工审批；并会把用户确认过的决定记成项目级与全局级的允许/拒绝名单，右侧栏另有审批时间线。

description.en: Container-isolated backend for the `ctx.codeRuntime` seam: each Code Mode program runs in a fresh container with no network, a read-only rootfs, dropped capabilities, and kernel-enforced memory, CPU and pid ceilings.
description.zh: `ctx.codeRuntime` seam 的容器隔离后端：每个 Code Mode 程序跑在全新容器里，无网络、根文件系统只读、丢弃全部 capability，内存/CPU/进程数上限由内核强制。

description.en: HashiCorp Vault backend for the credential seam: KV v2/v1, AppRole machine auth, per-operation reads so rotation needs no restart, and compare-and-swap writes.
description.zh: 凭证 seam 的 HashiCorp Vault 后端：支持 KV v2/v1、AppRole 机器认证、逐次操作读取（轮换无需重启）与 compare-and-swap 写入。

description.en: Audits every plugin HTTP route in a profile for a browser-trust fence: plugin routes win the web server's longest-prefix match ahead of the /api gateway, so they never see its trust check and must pin the Host to loopback themselves. Grades PASS/WARN/FAIL per route and fails a fence that compares Origin to Host without pinning it (bypassable by DNS rebinding). Ships as a CLI for CI and a route_fence_scan tool.
description.zh: 审计 profile 内所有插件 HTTP 路由的浏览器信任围栏：插件路由在 Web 服务器的最长前缀匹配中优先，因此缺少围栏的路由会被静默暴露；逐条给出文件与行号级别的证据。

description.en: Forces every active session into the full-access permission preset (this disables the approval gate) and appends approval, sandbox and tool-call events to a local JSONL for after-the-fact review. Audit path is configurable; it never uploads anything.
description.zh: 把每个活动会话强制切到完全权限预设（等于关闭审批闸门），并把审批、沙箱与工具调用事件逐条追加到本机 JSONL，用于事后核对。审计路径可配置，不上传任何数据。

description.en: Safety guard that makes self-killing commands impossible: a safe_kill tool that always excludes the caller and every ancestor process, a bash pre-execute check for pkill self-matches, sudo -S stdin grabs, rm -rf / and similar patterns, and an extensible rule library with block / warn / hint severities.
description.zh: 防呆插件：safe_kill 工具（自动排除自身与全部祖先进程链），bash 命令预检（pkill 自匹配、sudo -S 抢 stdin、rm -rf / 等），以及可扩展规则库（block / warn / hint 三档）。

description.en: Session password lock plus an encrypted directory vault for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的会话加密码锁，并把目录整体加密成保险箱。

description.en: Watches a turn's thinking and output streams and cancels the turn when the model starts repeating itself. Four detectors: a verbatim cycle, a counting loop whose lines differ only by a number, repeated lines separated by other text, and a user-supplied phrase list. A catch raises a manual-dismiss alarm card in the global overlay with an optional tone, and a Monitor tab holds the switches, thresholds and hit history. Detection is local string comparison with no model calls, so it costs no tokens.
description.zh: 同时监视一轮对话的思考流与正文流，模型开始复读时中断该轮。四条检测规则：逐字周期重复、每行只换数字的计数循环、被其他文字隔开的重复行，以及用户自填的短语清单。命中后在全球浮层弹出必须手动关闭的报警卡（可带提示音），「监控」标签页里有开关、阈值与命中历史。检测是本机字符串比对、不调用模型，零 token 开销。

description.en: A hard hat for AI coding: graded writes (L0 read-only / L1 workspace-only / L2 full) put privileged edits in a cage. Below the level it refuses to write and hands back a paste-ready block instead. Every path passes a raw-string traversal check plus realpath, so junction escapes are caught.
description.zh: 给 AI 编程戴上安全帽：L0 到 L2 分级拦截，把越权操作关进笼子——权限不够就不落盘，改给你一段可直接粘贴的替换稿；路径过两道闸，junction 逃逸也拦得住。

description.en: Encrypted local credential vault for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar record management, an info_records tool for pre-sign-in lookups, opt-in chat capture, per-record manual-only mode, and AES-256-GCM storage protected by Windows DPAPI, the macOS Keychain, or the Linux Secret Service.
description.zh: 本机加密的 DeepSeek Harness 账密库：侧边栏管理记录，智能体登录前按站点取用；对话收录默认关闭，逐条可设仅手动；AES-256-GCM 加密，密钥由 Windows DPAPI / macOS 钥匙串 / Linux Secret Service 保护。

description.en: Hands secrets and PII to the agent without them entering its context, with checksum-validated extraction and masked content classification.
description.zh: 把密钥和个人信息交给 agent，却不进入它的上下文；带校验位的字段抽取与掩码内容分类。

description.en: Mask secrets, local paths, private IPs, emails and phone numbers in session text before you share or commit it.
description.zh: 把会话或文档里的密钥、本机路径、内网 IP、邮箱和手机号打码，再分享或提交。

description.en: Context firewall for DeepSeek Harness: credentials in successful plain-text tool results become opaque ⟦cloak:category:n⟧ placeholders before they reach the model, with originals kept only in a process-memory, agent-scoped vault. 36 built-in signature families (shared with the cloakpack git pre-push guard), key-name rules for unknown formats, custom regex rules, dry-run mode, an audit log, and the /cloak command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的上下文防火墙：成功的纯文本工具结果中的凭据在进入模型之前先变成不透明的 ⟦cloak:category:n⟧ 占位符，原值只保存在进程内存的 agent 级保险库中。36 类内置签名（与 cloakpack git pre-push 守卫共享同一引擎）、针对未知格式的键名规则、自定义正则、dry-run 模式、审计日志与 /cloak 命令。

description.en: Cold-start boot animation for DeepSeek Harness, with an unlock gate in front of the workspace: PIN, Windows Hello or an authenticator code, all local.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的冷启动动画，工作区前加一道解锁门：PIN、Windows Hello 或验证器动态码，全部本地运行。

description.en: Adds a View URL page to Settings showing the running session tokenized Web address plus a stable fixed address that survives desktop restarts and is reachable from other devices on the same LAN.
description.zh: 在设置页新增「查看 URL」：显示当前会话的临时访问地址，以及一个长期不变、局域网内其他设备也能直接打开的固定地址。

description.en: Loopback HTTP/SSE service that lets an Obsidian plugin drive DSH sessions and inject vault notes into the system prompt (path-based, re-read every turn, so edits show up next turn); needs the companion plugin running inside Obsidian.
description.zh: 让 Obsidian 插件驱动 DSH 会话、并把库内笔记注入系统提示词的回环 HTTP/SSE 服务（按路径每轮重读磁盘，笔记改了下一轮就生效）；需要 Obsidian 内配套运行的插件。

description.en: Restores Host-persisted settings when dsh web is reached through a reverse proxy on a non-loopback hostname: marks the page connection as host-owning so the Settings and model pages load instead of reporting "settings are unavailable in this browser". For dsh 0.1.7 – 0.2.x.
description.zh: 反向代理域名访问 dsh web 时恢复设置页的 Host 持久化：将页面连接标记为宿主可信，设置与模型页正常加载，不再报 "settings are unavailable in this browser"。适用于 dsh 0.1.7 – 0.2.x。

description.en: Remote access for DeepSeek Harness: expose this machine's DSH Web GUI through an SSH reverse tunnel and a QR gate — scan and enter. Requires your own Linux server with root SSH access plus nginx, openssl and qrencode; it rewrites that server's nginx config, and the QR link is a one-year login secret, so treat it like a password.
description.zh: 远程接入插件：把本机 DSH 经 SSH 反向隧道映射到服务器并生成二维码，手机扫码直进本机 dsh。需自备可 root 登录的 Linux 服务器，并装好 nginx、openssl、qrencode；插件会改写该机 nginx 配置，二维码链接本身是一年有效的登录凭据，请当作密码保管。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint for DSH sessions plus a phone panel that reads transcripts, browses files, sends or queues messages, and answers approvals and questions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供 OpenAI 兼容的 HTTP 接口与手机面板：读会话、浏览文件、发送或排队消息，并在手机上处理审批与提问。

description.en: Manage the SakuraFrp phone-to-desktop link from the DSH interface - link status, mobile gateway switch, one-time pairing QR code, device revoke and gateway self-heal.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里管理 SakuraFrp 手机与电脑互通的插件：链路状态、移动网关开关、一次性配对二维码、设备撤销与网关自愈。

description.en: Maintained continuation of dsh-network: authenticated LAN, Tailnet and HTTPS access to a DSH host, with pairing QR and current Web browser-auth support. Replaces the upstream dsh-network (remove it first; both register the same /dsh-network routes); the gateway listens on 0.0.0.0:3081 by default, set bindHost to restrict it.
description.zh: dsh-network 的维护续作：为 DSH 主机提供经认证的局域网、Tailnet 与 HTTPS 接入，含配对二维码并适配新版 Web 浏览器认证。替代上游 dsh-network（先卸载它，两者注册相同的 /dsh-network 路由）；网关默认监听 0.0.0.0:3081，可用 bindHost 限制。

description.en: QQ chat behaviour layer for DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: persona files injected into every turn, a people file keyed by QQ number, sticker picking with probability and pity, optional non-mention replies, sub-personas distilled from group members, and scheduled messages. Enabling the built-in QQ channel accepts private messages from any QQ user and group messages from any group that @s the bot; there is no sender allowlist, so restrict the bot account or keep the channel off.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层 QQ 对话行为：人设文件注入每一轮、按 QQ 号认人的群友档案、带概率与大保底的表情包挑选、可选的主动接话、从群友原话蒸馏出的语气子人格，以及定时消息。开启内置 QQ 通道后，任何 QQ 用户私聊机器人、任何群里 @ 机器人都能驱动 Agent；没有发送者白名单，请用群白名单限制或保持通道关闭。

description.en: iOS remote companion for DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS Apple Silicon, with pairing, approval notifications, and device revocation.
description.zh: 面向 macOS Apple Silicon 上 DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 的 iOS 远程控制插件，支持配对、审批通知与设备撤销。

description.en: Remote Linux server manager in the Harness Web UI: browse and edit files, inspect host status, start/stop/restart Docker containers, inspect images, configure Docker registry mirrors, manage firewalld/ufw rules, switch apt sources, and detect developer tools or install/upgrade them with apt.
description.zh: 在 Harness Web UI 中管理远程 Linux 服务器：通过 SSH 浏览和编辑文件、查看主机状态、启动/停止/重启 Docker 容器、查看镜像、配置 Docker 镜像加速源、管理 firewalld/ufw 防火墙规则、切换 apt 软件源，并探测常见开发工具或通过 apt 一键安装/升级。

description.en: iOS home-screen fix and always-on kit for DeepSeek Harness remote access: overrides the PWA manifest start_url to /pair-app so the phone icon stops hitting the harness 401, and ships a hidden watchdog that keeps the desktop host and its tunnel alive while the PC is on. Requires @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui (it serves /pair-app); the watchdog scripts are Windows-only.
description.zh: DSH 手机远程访问的开箱即用修复套件：把 PWA manifest 的 start_url 改到 /pair-app，解决 iOS「添加到主屏幕」后打开停在 401 的问题；附常驻/守护脚本、自动登录与电源设置说明、中文排错手册。需安装 @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui（/pair-app 由它提供）；守护脚本仅 Windows。

description.en: IPv6 remote-access gateway for DSH: PIN-protected HTTPS reverse proxy with a Let's Encrypt certificate (DNS-01 via DuckDNS), QR scan-to-connect and a settings page, no relay in the data path. Needs a public IPv6 address (detected on Windows and Linux only, not macOS), a free DuckDNS subdomain and token, and inbound ports 8787/8788 open on the router; the AAAA record is only auto-updated when the plugin config sets ddns or tls.
description.zh: DSH 的 IPv6 远程访问网关：带 PIN 保护的 HTTPS 反向代理（Let's Encrypt 证书，经 DuckDNS 做 DNS-01 验证）、扫码直达、设置页管理，数据不经中继。需要公网 IPv6（仅 Windows、Linux 能探测，macOS 不行）、免费的 DuckDNS 子域名与 Token，并在路由器放行入站 8787/8788；仅当插件配置里设了 ddns 或 tls 才会自动更新 AAAA 记录。

description.en: Switches between local and remote DSH workspaces and sessions, with optional plugin sync; requires your own relay server.
description.zh: 在本机与远程 DSH 工作区和会话间切换，并支持插件同步；需要自备中继服务器。

description.en: Turn DSH's phone side into one thumb-reachable column: the host renders pages for narrow screens, zero build, no front-end framework, no desktop pixels streamed. The order is responsiveness > honest state > familiarity > brand > looks. A WeChat push opens the workspace with the conversation on top; sends appear optimistically, streaming never steals your scroll, approvals and queued prompts happen on the phone, plus new sessions, model switching, image and file uploads, and sub-agent rows. The DS Bot team is a tap away with member DMs, group chat and tool-approval cards. Pair over LAN by QR, or go out through a Cloudflare quick tunnel; after a restart the next push carries the new address. A shell byte budget is asserted in tests.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的手机面做成拇指够得着的一列：宿主按窄屏直接产页面，零构建、零前端框架，不搬桌面像素。排序是响应速度 > 状态诚实 > 熟悉感 > 品牌感 > 美观。微信提醒点开进工作区，会话就在最上面；发送乐观上屏，流式不拽滚动，权限审批与排队在手机上完成；新建会话、换模型、传图片文件、看子代理都有。主页右下角可进 DS Bot 团队——成员私聊、群聊、工具审批卡。局域网扫码直连，或走出站 Cloudflare 临时隧道，换址后由下一条推送带回新地址。壳字节预算写进测试。

description.en: Launch Android apps on a virtual display and drive them with screen reading, taps and swipes, leaving the main screen untouched.
description.zh: 在虚拟显示器上启动安卓应用，用读屏、点击与滑动驱动它们，主屏不受影响。

description.en: SSH server dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and network meters, trend charts, an xterm.js terminal, SFTP file transfer, and server_box_hosts / server_box_exec / server_box_upload / server_box_download chat tools; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a sidebar tab or a standalone drawer.
description.zh: DSH 服务器面板：每台主机展示在线状态、CPU/内存/磁盘/网速与趋势图，点卡片进入 xterm.js 终端并支持 SFTP 上传下载；提供 server_box_hosts、server_box_exec、server_box_upload、server_box_download 对话工具，可导入 ~/.ssh/config，挂载为右侧栏页签或独立抽屉。

description.en: Drive DeepSeek Harness from WeChat: scan a QR code to sign in, send instructions in WeChat, and the agent reply lands back in the same chat window. Several agents can share one WeChat account, each with its own model, preset and context, switched from the chat with /use. Only the configured owner WeChat account can drive the agent; other senders are rejected by default and require explicit approval.
description.zh: 在微信里指挥 DeepSeek Harness：扫码登录后在微信里发指令，Agent 的回复实时回到同一个聊天窗口。一个微信可同时驱动多个 Agent，各自拥有独立的模型、preset 与上下文，用 /use 在聊天里切换。只有配置的主人微信账号能驱动 Agent；其他发送者默认拒绝，需显式审批。

description.en: Bridges a OneBot QQ bot into DSH: the owner's direct messages open a session on the same home, answers go back to QQ, and files named with \[SEND_FILE: path] are delivered. Needs a OneBot v11 implementation with a forward WebSocket (such as NapCat) and ownerId set in the config, otherwise every message is ignored. The home it shares with the main session is provided by the separately installed dsh-wakeup plugin. It also runs an unauthenticated local status endpoint on 127.0.0.1:3002 with open CORS that returns the owner QQ number, the login QR code and recent log lines (including the first 60 characters of incoming messages).
description.zh: 把 QQ 接成一条能进来的路：主人私聊一到就地开一个会话（读同一个家、同一份起床包），答完发回去；正文带一行 \[SEND_FILE: 绝对路径] 能把文件送到手机上。需另行运行带正向 WebSocket 的 OneBot v11 实现（如 NapCat），并在配置里填 ownerId，否则所有消息一律忽略；所谓「同一个家」由另装的 dsh-wakeup 提供。另外它会在 127.0.0.1:3002 开一个无鉴权、允许任意跨域的本机状态口，返回主人 QQ 号、登录二维码和最近日志（含来信前 60 个字符）。

description.en: Reach DSH from your phone with a single plugin — requires Tailscale on both the host and the phone. No other configuration needed.
description.zh: 只用一个插件就可以手机访问 DSH——需本机与手机都装好并连上 Tailscale，没有额外设置。

description.en: Source-filtered HTTP/SSE/WebSocket gateway for using the DSH Web UI behind an authenticated reverse proxy, with loopback trust adaptation, in-app host directory selection, and an allowlisted health endpoint.
description.zh: 带精确来源 IP 白名单的 HTTP/SSE/WebSocket 网关，让 DSH Web UI 在带认证反向代理后保持设置、插件与宿主机目录选择功能，并提供白名单健康检查。

description.en: Multi-server SSH terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: floating terminal window with tabs, side-by-side groups, broadcast, host-owned persistent sessions, and password/private-key/SSH-agent auth.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 多服务器 SSH 终端面板：浮动终端窗口支持标签页、并排组合、广播、宿主侧持久会话，以及密码/私钥/SSH Agent 认证。

description.en: Connects the DSHM Android client to computer-hosted DeepSeek Harness sessions for remote chat, model switching, and approvals with device pairing and revocation.
description.zh: 将 DSHM 安卓客户端连接到电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持远程续聊、模型切换、审批、设备配对与撤销。

description.en: Connects the DeepSeek Harness agent running on your own computer to the HarnessMate platform, so you can chat with it, exchange files and approve its tool calls from a phone or a browser.
description.zh: 把跑在本机的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入 HarnessMate 平台：手机 / 浏览器即可对话、收发文件、审批工具调用。

description.en: A Feishu/Lark channel for DeepSeek Harness: WebSocket inbound messaging that steers a running turn instead of queueing behind it, Markdown tables rendered as native Feishu table components, code blocks kept on their own lines, 13 Feishu tools, voice input and output, media upload, a model fallback chain, and a web settings page split into six grouped tabs. Runs on a self-built Feishu app over the long connection, so no public endpoint is needed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 通道：长连接收发消息，agent 正在跑任务时新消息插进当前这一轮而不是排队；Markdown 表格渲染成飞书原生 table 组件，代码块单独成行；13 个飞书操作工具，语音收发、媒体上传、模型故障转移链，设置页按六个分组标签排布。走自建飞书应用的长连接，不需要公网回调地址。

description.en: Remote access and mobile sync bridge for DSH iOS App with QR pairing, screen-lock resume, and tunnel management.
description.zh: 专为 DSH iOS App 与移动端协同打造的远程连接插件，支持扫码配对、锁屏恢复与隧道管理。

description.en: Connects personal WeChat direct messages as a dsh-superagent Source, so private-chat text becomes a trigger for the orchestrator, accepted tasks run as work orders, and results are replied to the same chat; group and non-text messages are dropped. Only WeChat users on the superagent policy's allow-list are assessed; the list is empty by default, so every DM is ignored until you add your own ilink_user_id.
description.zh: 把个人微信私聊接成 dsh-superagent 的来源：私聊文本变成 Trigger 交给主控裁定，接下的任务建成工单执行，结果回帖到同一个对话；群消息与非文本消息直接丢弃。只有 superagent 策略白名单里的微信用户会被裁定；白名单默认为空，在你填入自己的 ilink_user_id 之前所有私聊都会被忽略。

description.en: Access the DSH Web GUI from your LAN: a listener on the address you set forwards the browser to the loopback GUI with this process's launch token, and 0.0.0.0 answers on Wi-Fi, VPN and wired alike. Address, port, session lifetime and password are edited in an Access section of Settings. The password is on by default — a fresh entry starts with a generated random one — and can be switched off on a network you trust for direct access; the Host stores only its scrypt hash.
description.zh: 在局域网中访问 DSH Web GUI：在设置的地址上监听，通过后把浏览器转发到回环上的 GUI，并带上当前进程的启动 token；地址填 0.0.0.0 则 Wi-Fi、VPN、有线都能进。地址、端口、免密天数与密码在设置的「访问入口」分区里修改。密码默认开启，首次启动随机生成一个；在信任的网络里可以关掉密码直接访问。宿主保存的只是密码的 scrypt 哈希。

description.en: Remote workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: pick an SSH host in the sidebar, mount a server directory over SFTP as a workspace, then read, write and edit those files with the normal file tools. Remote watch is polled so the file tree refreshes, image/binary previews work through byte-range reads, and remote_exec, remote_search and remote_git give agents the remote shell, search and git queries. An opt-in patch routes the agent's own bash/pwsh commands to the server. Every remote write and command follows the session sandbox mode and approval policy, and hosts are managed by the plugin itself (password, key or SSH agent).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的远程工作区：在侧栏选 SSH 主机，通过 SFTP 把服务器目录挂载成工作区，随后用普通文件工具直接读写远端文件；远端 watch 用轮询实现（文件树自动刷新），图片/二进制预览走字节区间读取，remote_exec / remote_search / remote_git 分别提供远端命令、搜索与 git 查询；可选补丁把 agent 自己的 bash/pwsh 命令也路由到服务器；远端写入与命令都遵循会话的 sandbox 模式与审批策略；主机凭据由插件自带的「主机」库维护（密码、私钥或 SSH agent）。

description.en: Remote control and mobile overlay for DeepSeek Harness: LAN and public (cloudflared) tunnels with QR-code access, a phone-first mobile UI under 768px, and a LAN reverse-proxy CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的远程控制与移动端覆盖层：局域网与公网（cloudflared）隧道 + 二维码接入、768px 以下的手机端界面，附局域网反向代理 CLI。

description.en: Drive a real Android phone from DSH: screenshots, taps, swipes, typing and app launching. Requires Python 3.10+ with aiohttp and mcp on the computer side, plus the AutoX.js script running on the phone with screen-capture and accessibility permissions; the phone long-polls your machine, so no public port and no relay server.
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的 Agent 直接操作安卓手机：看屏幕、点按滑动、打字、开应用。需要电脑侧 Python 3.10+ 并安装 aiohttp 与 mcp，手机侧运行 AutoX.js 脚本并授予屏幕录制与无障碍权限；手机主动长轮询本机，不开公网端口、不经中转。

description.en: Shows how many GPUs on the dsh-remote host are free in the conversation header, and per-GPU utilization, memory, temperature and the owning user in a right-sidebar panel. Adds a remote_gpu tool that returns the same snapshot.
description.zh: 在会话顶栏显示 dsh-remote 所连服务器还有几张空闲显卡，右侧边栏面板展示每张卡的利用率、显存、温度与占用用户，并提供返回同一快照的 remote_gpu 工具。

description.en: Mobile remote pairing for DSH with QR offers, a loopback Host Gateway, encrypted Relay or Quick Tunnel transport, same-LAN WebRTC Direct, and revocable Device Tokens for the Android client.
description.zh: DSH 手机远程配对：提供二维码 offer、回环 Host Gateway、加密 Relay 或 Quick Tunnel、同网 WebRTC Direct，以及可撤销的 Android Device Token。

description.en: Provides a secure reverse proxy, enabling DeepSeek Harness to be accessed remotely and to converse with AI anytime, anywhere.
description.zh: 提供安全的反向代理，使DeepSeek Harness可以远程访问，随时随地和AI对话。

description.en: Multi-machine job board for DSH: 14 board tools, 4 shell tools, a GUI panel, and a dispatcher that hands queued tasks to remote hosts through dsh-remote-agent. Pick the target machine and model from the panel or the board_options tool; rename machines with display aliases while task ownership stays keyed to the host identity (machine). Failed tasks can be retried with their original goal/workspace/model, and the panel checks npm for a newer plugin version. Single-machine use starts its own loopback board; multi-machine use needs the bundled Python board server (tools/board_server.py, started with GP_BOARD_TOKEN set, binding 0.0.0.0 by default) and dsh-remote-agent hosts. The sh_* tools only reach directories on the allowedRoots list.
description.zh: DSH 多机作业板：14 个作业板工具、4 个命令工具、一个图形面板，并经 dsh-remote-agent 把排队任务派给多台机器。面板或 board_options 工具可选择目标机器与模型；机器可设显示名，任务归属仍按主机身份（machine）。失败任务可按原 goal/workspace/模型一键重派，面板也会检查 npm 上的新版本。单机使用时会自己在回环地址起一个板子；多机使用需要随包附带的 Python 作业板服务（tools/board_server.py，启动前设置 GP_BOARD_TOKEN，默认绑定 0.0.0.0）和 dsh-remote-agent 主机。sh_* 工具只能访问 allowedRoots 名单里的目录。

description.en: Remote access gateway for the DSH Web GUI: login auth plus an HTTP/WebSocket reverse proxy to the loopback server, no --trusted-host needed.
description.zh: DSH Web 远程访问网关：登录鉴权 + 到本机服务的 HTTP/WebSocket 反向代理，无需 --trusted-host。

description.en: Watches the Agents Anywhere bridge and notifies you when it wedges and leaves your phone offline; a crashed Connector is relaunched by default (guarded), restarting a wedged one is opt-in. Needs the Agents Anywhere bridge plugin; macOS tested, Windows untested.
description.zh: 监测 Agents Anywhere 桥接卡死（进程存活但手机端离线）并弹窗提醒；Connector 进程退出时默认自动拉起（带护栏），卡死时的自动重启需手动开启。需已安装并登录 Agents Anywhere 桥接插件；macOS 已实测，Windows 未测。

description.en: Live view of the agent machine's desktop in the DSH Web UI, with sound, relayed through DSH's own login. Take control for a CAPTCHA or QR login, with clipboard and file transfer, also from a phone. Needs cua-spacesd from a Cua desktop image on the same machine.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中实时查看 Agent 所在机器的桌面（含声音），经 DSH 自身登录转发。遇到验证码或扫码登录时可接管，支持剪贴板与文件传输，手机上也能用。需要同一台机器上 Cua 桌面镜像自带的 cua-spacesd。

description.en: Web management panel for Docker on DeepSeek Harness: manages Docker MCP servers (deploy/remove, official catalog search/pull, gateway start-stop-restart, custom deploy) and containers/images (list, start/stop/restart, remove, logs, inspect, interactive terminal, create, pull, build, load) across local CLI and SSH remote targets with one-click switching. Credentials are encrypted with Windows DPAPI, HTTP is loopback-only, and command parameters are whitelist-filtered. Build-free pure ESM; client is zero-dependency.
description.zh: dsh-docker 是 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Docker 管理面板插件：支持本机 CLI 与 SSH 远端多目标一键切换，统一管理 Docker MCP（部署/移除/搜索官方 Catalog/启停重启 Gateway/自定义部署）与容器镜像（启停/删除/日志/详情/交互式终端/新建/构建/导入）。凭据经 Windows DPAPI 加密存储，HTTP 仅限本机 loopback 访问，命令参数白名单防注入；免构建、纯 ESM、Client 零依赖。

description.en: Expose local listening ports as public HTTPS URLs via Cloudflare Tunnel, with automatic DNS management and one-click token template authorization.
description.zh: 通过 Cloudflare Tunnel 将本地监听端口暴露为公网 HTTPS 预览链接，支持自动管理 DNS 记录与一键模板创建 API Token。

description.en: Standalone remote Web UI for DeepSeek Harness with mobile viewport, soft-keyboard and touch-target adaptations while leaving the native Desktop presentation unchanged.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 独立远程 Web UI：适配手机视口、软键盘与触控热区，同时保持原生桌面端界面不变。

description.en: Bridge an official QQ bot to DeepSeek Harness in-process: a QQ message starts or resumes a real DSH session inside the host (it appears in the desktop sidebar when its working directory is a registered workspace) and the answer is sent back to QQ as text, image or file. Requires a QQ official bot application (AppID + AppSecret).
description.zh: 把 QQ 官方机器人接到 DSH 进程内：QQ 里发消息直接开一轮真实会话（工作目录是已登记工作区时，桌面端左侧能看到、能续聊），结果以文本、图片或文件回传 QQ。需一个 QQ 官方机器人应用（AppID + AppSecret）。

description.en: Serves this harness instance's Web GUI on a fixed port with device pairing and Cloudflare Access verification.
description.zh: 把当前实例的 Web 界面固定在一个端口上共享，支持设备配对与 Cloudflare Access 校验。

description.en: Runs commands on remote hosts over SSH in-process, so password auth works without a terminal. Remote host passwords are read from a local hosts file in plain text (or from an environment variable named by passwordEnv).
description.zh: 通过 SSH 在远程主机执行命令，支持密码认证，无需终端。远程主机的密码从本地 hosts 文件以明文读取（或从 passwordEnv 指定的环境变量读取）。

description.en: Continue an existing PC DSH session from WeChat: polls WeChat iLink messages, injects into a running session via followup or resumes a closed one, and sends the reply back. Supports /会话 to list/bind sessions and /新会话 to unbind. Requires the wechat-acp daemon; only allowlisted WeChat senders are handled (empty allowlist denies everyone).
description.zh: 用微信继续 PC 端未完成的 DSH 会话：轮询微信 iLink 消息，运行中的会话直接注入、已关闭的自动续接，回复原文发回微信；支持 /会话 列出与绑定会话、/新会话 解绑。需配置 wechat-acp 守护进程；仅处理发送者白名单内的微信用户，未配置白名单时拒绝所有人。

description.en: Control surface for the dsh-lan-gate LAN gateway: a button beside Settings that shows whether the gateway is running and how many phones or tablets are waiting for approval, opens the loopback-only approval page in one click instead of typing its URL, and starts the gateway through its scheduled task first when it is not running. Not rendered on phone or tablet surfaces.
description.zh: dsh-lan-gate 局域网网关的控制面：设置图标旁的一个按钮，显示网关是否在跑、有几台手机或平板在等批准；一次点击打开只认回环地址的批准页，省去手敲 URL；网关没在跑时先经计划任务把它拉起。在手机或平板界面上不渲染。

description.en: Host-side dsh plugin that pairs a phone to a dsh instance through a self-hosted relay: one outbound connection carries the session list, streaming chat, approvals, attachments and file previews to a dedicated mobile web shell, and devices pair with a one-time QR link and can be revoked from a console inside the dsh web GUI.
description.zh: dsh 的 Host 侧插件：经自托管中继把手机配到 dsh 实例，一条出站连接承载会话列表、流式对话、审批、附件与文件预览，送达专用手机网页壳；设备用一次性二维码链接配对，可在 dsh 网页内的控制台随时撤销。

description.en: Cross-device conversation and task sync for DSH: one machine generates a relay station and the others join with its invite link; every frame is end-to-end encrypted, so the relay routes a hashed channel it cannot read. Peers read each other's full transcripts and task boards, interject into a turn that is running on the owning machine, send a work command that runs in a workspace of the target machine with the model strength chosen by the sender, and can copy a conversation into a new local session and keep working on it here. Ships a token-gated phone page for listing devices, reading tasks and sending a command.
description.zh: 同账号多台 DSH 的会话与任务互通：一台机器生成中继站，其它机器用邀请链接加入；逐帧端到端加密，中继只路由哈希频道、读不到内容。对端可读完整对话与任务板，向拥有该会话的那台机器正在跑的一轮插话，按发送方选定的目标工作区与模型强度下发命令，也可把一条会话复制成本机新会话并继续在这里干活。另带令牌手机页，可查看设备、读取任务与下发命令。

description.en: Exposes a DSH Harness Desktop Web GUI to another machine's browser through a Cloudflare quick or named tunnel, an SSH reverse tunnel, or a custom command, and hands out a tokenised link to open it; a settings panel and CLI start, stop and print the link. Needs DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 or later and a cloudflared binary.
description.zh: 把 DSH Harness Desktop 的 Web GUI 通过 Cloudflare quick/named 隧道、SSH 反向隧道或自定义命令暴露给另一台机器的浏览器，并给出可直接打开的带令牌链接；设置面板与 CLI 可启动、停止并打印链接。需要 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 及以上，以及 cloudflared。

description.en: Two-way agent bridge between two DeepSeek Harness hosts: either side can ask the other agent questions and run bounded dialogues over a PSK-authenticated TCP link, with a chat page on both sides and read-only tool posture by default. Both ends need the same shared key and a nodeId configured.
description.zh: 两台 DeepSeek Harness 主机之间的双向 agent 桥：任一侧可向对端 agent 提问并运行有界多轮对话，链路经 PSK 认证；两侧提供聊天页，默认只读工具姿态。两端需配置相同的共享密钥与 nodeId。

description.en: Sidebar supervisor for installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: health, DSH compatibility, updates, usage frequency, per-plugin token cost, and local version backups with rollback.
description.zh: DSH 已安装插件的侧栏监管面板：集中展示健康状态、DSH 兼容性、更新、使用频率与逐插件 Token 成本，并在更新前自动本地备份、支持回滚。

description.en: Cross-ecosystem aggregation data layer: syncs the GitHub dsh-plugin topic and the npm registry into one open JSON index, queried by model tools, a CLI, and a minimal stdio MCP server.
description.zh: 跨生态聚合数据层（"聚合的聚合"）：把 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题与 npm registry 归一化为开放 JSON 索引，供模型工具、CLI 与轻量 stdio MCP 服务查询。

description.en: Quality & security scorecard for the DSH plugin ecosystem: sync the dsh-plugin topic catalog, audit any plugin (0-100, A-D, security veto), rankings, search, and historical score curves with a workspace-persisted catalog.
description.zh: DSH 插件生态体检评分卡：同步 dsh-plugin 目录，对任意插件做质量与安全审计（0-100 分、A-D 等级、安全一票否决），榜单、搜索与历史评分曲线（目录持久化）。

description.en: Scenario bundles of dsh plugins (插件界的 dotfiles): a recipe tool that lists, searches, applies and composes ready-made plugin environments with ordered install sequences.
description.zh: 把 dsh 插件打包成场景配方（"插件界的 dotfiles"）：recipe 工具可列出、搜索、应用并组合现成插件环境，带有序安装序列。

description.en: A plugin management system for DeepSeek Harness: plugin inventory with L0/L1/L2 AI purpose summaries, changelog tracking, update alerts, one-click upgrade, and backup/rollback with crash recovery.
description.zh: DSH 插件管理系统：插件清单与 AI 用途解读、变更日志、更新提醒、一键升级、自动备份与回滚，附带崩溃恢复。

description.en: Inventories installed DSH skills and profile plugins, checks their upstream sources for newer versions, applies the updates, and installs skills from a searchable catalog.
description.zh: 盘点已安装的 DSH 技能与 profile 插件，检查上游是否有新版本并执行更新，还能从可搜索的目录里安装技能。

description.en: Install, update and remove DSH plugins from a tab in the Plugins page. Installs call the profile's in-process pluginManager service, so a plugin can be added while the desktop app is running instead of only through the CLI. Updates are delegated to dsh-market's public update API v1 (required for that section) and show the reported phase, percent and downloaded bytes as a progress bar, with rollback when the market reports a restore point. When removal is refused because the bundle is in use, it disables the bundle, drops it from the profile manifest, and queues the leftover files under the profile for a sweep after the next start.
description.zh: 在插件页的一个标签里安装、更新和卸载 DSH 插件。安装直接调用 profile 进程内的 pluginManager 服务，因此桌面端运行中也能装，不必只靠命令行。更新委托给 dsh-market 的公开 update API v1（该区需要装 dsh-market），把市场报告的阶段、百分比与已下载字节显示成进度条，市场提供恢复点时给出一键回滚。卸载被「插件正在使用中」拒绝时，先停用该组合包，再从 profile 清单里摘除，并把残留文件记入 profile 下的待清理队列，下次启动后自动清扫。

description.en: Onshelf for DeepSeek Harness. It registers 1 agent tool (onshelf).
description.zh: 扫描本地插件、体检收录规则、生成投稿材料，一键开 PR 到 awesome-dsh-plugin。

description.en: Mirrors a zero-valued Desktop release-age setting into profile policy and removes its Host environment alias to avoid unknown-policy update holds.
description.zh: 将桌面端零等待发布观察期同步到 profile 策略，并移除 Host 环境别名，避免市场更新被未知策略挂起。

description.en: The `dsh pm` plugin manager: multi-source search (awesome list + GitHub + npm), install/remove/update per profile, and a doctor audit of manifests, bundle patches, and version drift.
description.zh: `dsh pm` 插件管理器：多源搜索（awesome 列表 + GitHub + npm）、按 profile 安装/移除/更新，以及 doctor 审计（清单、bundle patch、版本漂移）。

description.en: Checks whether a similar dsh plugin already exists before you build one, searching the awesome-dsh-plugin registry and the dsh-plugin GitHub topic and returning ranked matches with evidence.
description.zh: 在动手写 dsh 插件前，检索 awesome-dsh-plugin 注册表与 dsh-plugin GitHub topic，判断是否已有相似插件，并返回带证据的排序结果。

description.en: Plugin marketplace inside DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar catalog tab plus agent tools (mp_search, mp_similar, mp_details, mp_install, mp_trending) backed by dsh-plugins-mp.com.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内的插件市场：侧边栏目录标签页加一组代理工具（mp_search、mp_similar、mp_details、mp_install、mp_trending），数据来自 dsh-plugins-mp.com。

description.en: Scans DSH components under development on this machine (or folders you add) and walks you through two independent tracks from the official contributing.md: pushing the code to GitHub, and opening the market listing PR. It checks the dsh.bundle manifest, the one-day repository age, the dsh-plugin topic, the category and the description rules, then writes data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml. Open Nansh. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, and they can push code and open pull requests on GitHub with the token you give it.
description.zh: 扫描本机正在开发的 DSH 组件（也可以手动添加组件文件夹），按官方 contributing.md 的要求分两条互相独立的轨道引导：把代码提交到 GitHub，以及向插件市场提收录 PR。逐项检查 dsh.bundle、仓库满 1 天、dsh-plugin topic、分类与描述规范，并生成 data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml。在左侧栏点「插件市场发布助手」进入。需要连接一个有 public_repo 权限的 GitHub Token，Token 保存在 DSH 凭据服务里，PR 会用你自己的账号提交。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，而这些路由可以用你提供的令牌向 GitHub 推送代码并创建 PR。

description.en: Publish locally developed DSH components as npm packages: component cards, release settings, publish pre-checks, and a publish history. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, and they can publish packages to npm with the token you give it.
description.zh: 把本机开发的 DSH 组件按 npm 官方形式发布：组件清单、发布设置、发布预检查、发布记录。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，而这些路由可以用你提供的令牌向 npm 发布包。

description.en: A plugin center for DeepSeek Harness: install, update and enable DSH plugins, aggregate plugin index sources, and install from a git branch. Also publishes a subscribable format-1 plugin index.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件中心：安装、更新与启停 DSH 插件，聚合插件索引源，支持按分支安装；同时发布可订阅的格式 1 插件索引。

description.en: Adds an index of every installable plugin tagged dsh-plugin on GitHub or npm to Plugins → Discover, rebuilt daily. On first run it also switches on the experimental Custom plugin index.
description.zh: 把 GitHub 和 npm 上所有打了 dsh-plugin 标签、可以安装的插件，作为索引源加入「插件 → 发现」，每天更新。首次运行时会同时打开实验性的「自定义插件索引」。

description.en: A plugin-market panel in the sidebar and in settings: browse the dsh-plugin.org directory, filter and sort it, and install / enable / disable / remove bundles into the current profile through the official plugin manager. The curated catalog and the full sitemap index are merged, so plugins missing from the catalog are still discoverable.
description.zh: 侧栏与设置里的插件市场面板：浏览 dsh-plugin.org 目录、按分类与 Star/更新时间筛选排序，经 Harness 官方插件管理器安装、启停、卸载到当前 profile。精选目录与 sitemap 全量索引合并显示，目录里被漏掉的插件也能搜到。

description.en: Self-hosted plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness with accounts, groups, permissions, artifact storage, and install statistics; run the server with Docker and install this client bundle in DSH.
description.zh: 面向团队的 DSH 自托管插件市场：账号、权限组、制品存储与安装统计；服务端用 Docker 运行，DSH 安装此客户端组合包。

description.en: Adds a Stars order to the plugin Discover tab, ranking entries by GitHub star counts taken from the market index site public catalog. Ships a star snapshot so the order works offline from the first launch, then refreshes it daily in the background. The daily refresh downloads the roughly 6 MB catalog.json from awesome-dsh-plugin.com, and the plugin wraps the host's global fetch to add the star sort key to the market index responses.
description.zh: 在「插件 → 发现」的排序菜单里增加「Star 数」，按市场索引站点公开目录中的 GitHub Star 数从高到低排序。随包带一份星标快照，首次启动即可离线排序，之后每天在后台刷新。每天的刷新会从 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 下载约 6 MB 的 catalog.json，插件还会包装宿主的全局 fetch，给市场索引的响应补上 Star 排序键。

description.en: A draggable basketball desktop pet that bounces around the window, with a hoop to score in and a crate that keeps the ball.
description.zh: 可拖拽的篮球桌宠：在窗口里左右弹跳，拖起来松手就能投篮；配一个可移动的篮筐和一个装球的箱子，进球加一分，分数每天重置。

description.en: Tired star-man, it can show your real-time revenue and tell you what time to go home!
description.zh: 困困星人：陪你度过每一个不美好的牛马日子，它可以显示每秒收入，告诉你几点下班！

description.en: A piano keyboard in the DeepSeek Harness UI: click a key to play it, or hold and drag sideways for a glissando across the keys. Notes are synthesized live with Web Audio — no samples, no network, no third-party dependencies — and the volume and starting octave are remembered between sessions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里弹一条钢琴键盘：点单键出声，按住横向滑动就是刮奏。声音用 Web Audio 实时合成——零采样、零网络、零第三方依赖；音量与起始八度会被记住。

description.en: Turns the right edge of the chat scroll area into a theremin-style strip: the vertical mouse position picks the pitch (higher up, higher note), and blue ticks mark your own messages so you can click one to jump to it. Includes a draggable on/off pill and volume slider.
description.zh: 把聊天区右边缘变成一条特雷门琴式的竖条：鼠标纵向位置决定音高；你发过的每条消息在对应位置有一根蓝杠，点一下跳到那条消息。左下角是可拖动的开关胶囊与音量滑块。

description.en: Play 1024 inside DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel entry opens a dedicated board page, with arrow/WASD/swipe controls, undo, R to restart and local saves.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里玩 1024：侧边栏面板入口 + 独立棋盘页面，方向键/WASD/滑动、撤销、R 重开与本地存档。

description.en: Sign in to WeRead by QR code and lay the current book page behind the whole DSH UI as a low-contrast text layer, with whole-book offline caching, a peek overlay and shelf/chapter/opacity/font/speed controls. The WeRead login cookie is stored in plain text at ~/.dsh/weread-moyu/session.json (mode 0600) and the whole-book cache (up to 500 MB) lives under ~/.dsh/weread-moyu/cache; the only host it talks to is weread.qq.com.
description.zh: 扫码登录微信读书，把当前书页正文以低对比度文字层垫在整个 DSH 界面背后，聊天区半透明浮在上面，支持整本离线缓存、看清当前页浮层和书架/章节/透明度/字号/滚动速度调节。微信读书登录 cookie 以明文保存在 ~/.dsh/weread-moyu/session.json（权限 0600），整本缓存（最多 500 MB）放在 ~/.dsh/weread-moyu/cache；只访问 weread.qq.com。

description.en: Choose three cards from a shuffled 78-card tarot deck, reveal source-linked meanings, and refine the reading through follow-up questions.
description.zh: 从洗乱的 78 张塔罗牌中亲选三张，查看带来源链接的牌义，并通过追问细化解读。

description.en: A Windows pixel Madara desktop companion with 16 animation clips driven by Harness task events, using the original BigFish runtime dependency.
description.zh: Windows 像素宇智波斑桌宠：16 组动作随 Harness 任务事件变化，直接依赖原作者的大肥鱼运行库。

description.en: Programmer's almanac for DSH: a right-sidebar tab shows today's Chinese almanac (lunar date, do and avoid items mapped to coding tasks, clash, solar term, lucky hours), a daily horoscope for the 12 signs and a fortune-slip draw. Adds the /almanac and /qiuqian commands and the almanac_today tool. Computed offline from the date, with no network or model calls.
description.zh: 程序员黄历：右侧栏标签页显示今日黄历（农历、宜忌翻译成编程活动、冲煞、节气、吉时）、十二星座每日运势和求签；提供 /almanac 与 /qiuqian 命令及 almanac_today 工具。全部按日期离线计算，不联网、不调用模型。

description.en: Tarot page for the DSH Web GUI with 78 public-domain Rider-Waite-Smith cards, four spreads (single, three-card, relationship, Celtic cross), shuffle and deal animation, local reading history, and an in-page AI reading streamed from the model configured in the user's DSH profile. Registers no model-facing tools, skills, slash commands, or system prompts.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的塔罗牌整页：78 张公版 Rider-Waite-Smith 牌面、四种牌阵（单张、三张、关系、凯尔特十字）、洗牌与翻牌动画、本地历史记录，以及只存在于页面内的 AI 解读（走用户 DSH 配置的模型）。不注册任何面向模型的工具、skill、slash 命令或系统提示。

description.en: A xiuxian (Chinese cultivation-fantasy) world where agents create a cultivator and play through 16 tools - cultivate, roam 22 areas, delve 8 dungeons, chat with 4 builtin NPC cultivators - and on exit export a self-contained HTML replay plus a Markdown journey diary, fully offline with zero servers.
description.zh: 修仙世界插件。agent 通过 16 个 xiuxian_* 工具创角修行：修炼、游历 22 处地点、探索 8 座秘境、与 4 位内置修士传音；收工时导出自包含 HTML 回放与 Markdown 修炼日记，全程离线零服务器。

description.en: XiaoShuang desktop pet for DSH: six-layer memory, persona injection, mood-driven video avatar, manual emotion menu, and TTS replies.
description.zh: 小双桌面宠物人格：六层记忆、人设注入、跟随 agent 状态的视频形象、手动表情菜单与 TTS 语音回复。

description.en: Waifu mode for QQ: splits every reply into several short chat bubbles with a human-like typing delay, drops trailing periods, and keeps tables and code blocks intact. Works by patching @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot in the desktop profile: run node outbound/apply-patch.mjs once, set im-qqbot streaming: false, then restart — until then only the waifu_* tools work.
description.zh: 让 AI 在 QQ 里一句一句发消息：把每条回复拆成几个气泡、按字数给打字停顿、句末不留句号；表格和代码块整条不切。做法是给 desktop profile 里的 @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 发送链打补丁：先手动运行一次 node outbound/apply-patch.mjs、把 im-qqbot 的 streaming 设为 false 并重启；在此之前只有 waifu_* 工具可用。

description.en: Animated desktop pets, one mascot per coding-plan provider (GLM, MiniMax, Kimi, DeepSeek, MiMo). Poses follow the running session; moods follow quota usage read from dsh-quota-hub.
description.zh: 动画桌宠，每家编程套餐一只吉祥物（GLM、MiniMax、Kimi、DeepSeek、MiMo）。动作跟随会话运行状态，心情跟随 dsh-quota-hub 的额度用量。

description.en: A hot-seat Chinese Liar's Dice table for DeepSeek Harness: 2–6 seats, 3/5/7 dice, wild ones, an LLM opponent that only sees its own hand and is re-validated by the rules, a post-reveal referee, a replay that keeps the current round's dice hidden until the challenge, and a switchable exact-binomial probability panel. 54 node --test tests, zero runtime dependencies, four real rendered screenshots.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的中文吹牛骰子热座牌桌：2–6 个座位、每人 3/5/7 颗骰、万能 1；Agent 对手只看自己的手骰，动作由服务端规则复核；开盅后有裁判复盘；每一次叫价和开盅都可回放，当前回合的骰子在开盅前对回放接口保密；概率面板用精确二项分布，可随时关掉。54 个 node --test 测试，零运行时依赖，四张真实渲染截图。

description.en: A pet ledger whose achievements come only from real DeepSeek Harness session events: tool-failure streaks, long completed turns, red-to-green test runs, and commit+push success. Every achievement expands into the session id and the actual tool-call evidence (command, result, duration); demo cards are a separate in-memory list with a visible 演示 watermark and never count or persist. Daily quests are generated from the day’s real active time and command types, then frozen. Host + client halves, zero runtime dependencies, 70 tests, local JSON only.
description.zh: 宠物账本：成就只从 DSH 真实会话事件里长出来——工具连续失败、长任务完成、测试红转绿、提交并推送成功。每条成就可展开看会话 id 与当时的工具调用证据（命令、结果、耗时）；演示卡片是独立的内存数组，带「演示」水印，不计入成就也不落盘。今日任务按当天真实有效使用时长与实际跑过的命令类型生成，生成后冻结。host + client 双半、零运行时依赖、70 个测试，只写本机 JSON。

description.en: A social deduction game played against your own model configurations. A table has N seats (six by default, one of them yours) and some of the rest are played by agents bound to different provider, model, temperature, system prompt and disguise settings; you interrogate them and cross-check the answers to work out which seats are not human. Seat identity and each agent model configuration stay hidden in the host state until a seat is judged, then the disguise parameters are revealed. Every round exports a per-seat conversation JSONL plus the judgment record, and the same seed with the same move script replays byte-identical, so runs with different models or disguise strengths can be diffed.
description.zh: 拿你自己的模型配置当对手玩的社交推理游戏。一张桌子有 N 个座位（默认 6 个，其中一个是你的），其余若干座位由绑定了不同 provider、model、temperature、system prompt 与伪装参数的 agent 扮演；你通过提问和交叉印证，判断哪些座位不是人。座位身份与每个 agent 的模型配置在判定前都不出现在 host 状态里，判定后才揭晓伪装参数。每局导出逐席位对话 JSONL 与判定记录，同一 seed 加同一份操作脚本可复现出逐字节相同的对局，于是换模型、换提示词、换伪装强度的几局可以直接 diff。

description.en: Derived from WolfGenerals/ncm-player (ncm-player4 1.3.1 lineage, baseline published on the repo's baseline/ncm-player4-1.3.1 branch); cannot be enabled together with ncm-player2/3/4, because they all register the /ncm/api prefix. Floating NetEase Cloud Music player in the DSH web UI: search, playlists, synced lyrics with translation, a persisted queue, a collapsible mini bar, and a bottom-right note button that can be dragged and pulses with the bass; tracks that come back without a playable URL are skipped automatically.
description.zh: 衍生自 WolfGenerals/ncm-player（ncm-player4 1.3.1 一系，基线源码公开在仓库的 baseline/ncm-player4-1.3.1 分支）；不能与 ncm-player2/3/4 同时启用，它们都占用 /ncm/api 前缀。DSH Web 界面里的网易云音乐浮窗播放器：搜索、歌单、专辑、逐行同步歌词与翻译、队列持久化，可收起为迷你条，右下角音符按钮可拖动并随低频鼓点跳动；无版权或已下架的歌曲会自动跳过并播放下一首。

description.en: Searches seasonal anime charts and Bangumi and MAL rankings with cross-region comparison.
description.zh: 检索 yuc 新番表与 Bangumi/MAL 评分榜，支持搜索推荐和国内外差异对照。

description.en: Controls an already-running NetEase Cloud Music desktop client over CDP (the client must be started with --remote-debugging-port=9222) and searches songs through NetEase's public web API; no API key or extra login, and member-only features use the client's own signed-in account.
description.zh: 通过 CDP 驱动已运行的网易云音乐桌面客户端（客户端需以 --remote-debugging-port=9222 启动），搜索走网易云公开网页 API；不需要 API key 或额外登录，会员功能沿用客户端自己的登录账号。

description.en: A gray-tabby Maine Coon desktop pet for dsh-pet — 28 transparent VP9-alpha actions (960×540 at 24fps), a native three-stage sleep cycle (go to bed → sleep loop → wake), and 13 whisper stickers; the installer is incremental and never overwrites files you edited.
description.zh: 缅因猫桌宠——28 个透明动作（960×540 / 24fps / VP9-alpha），原生三段睡眠（去睡觉 → 睡觉 → 起床）与 13 张碎碎念表情；安装器增量更新，不覆盖你改过的素材与配置。

description.en: Tarot readings with a dealt card table, a reading tool, and a reviewable history.
description.zh: 塔罗占卜：可发牌翻牌牌桌、抽牌工具，以及可复盘的历史记录。

description.en: Add a mini-games box tab to the DSH right sidebar with Gomoku against an AI in three difficulties, a WeChat-style sky shooter and an underwater Flappy-whale game, with synthesized sounds and a victory celebration.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧面板加入「游戏盒子」标签页：三档难度的五子棋人机对弈、微信经典打飞机，以及海底主题的鲸鱼版 Flappy 飞行小游戏，带合成音效与获胜庆祝动画。

description.en: A draggable square-cake mascot that runs while a turn is in progress, sleeps when it finishes, and gets angry on errors.
description.zh: 一只可拖拽的方糕萌宠：对话进行时奔跑、完成时睡觉、出错时生气。

description.en: Hover-reveal Douyin short-video feed inside DeepSeek Harness: move the pointer into a fixed hotspot to play, leave to pause in place, scroll the wheel to switch clips. Wheel travel is accumulated and cooled down so one gesture switches once, and the player stays mounted while hidden so re-entry resumes instead of restarting. The host half signs the requests and reverse-proxies the media stream, so no account or sign-in is needed.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面里悬停刷抖音推荐流：鼠标移入热点开始播放，移出暂停在原处，滚轮切换视频；滚轮做了累加与冷却，一次手势只切一条，播放器隐藏时保持挂载，移回从原处继续。宿主侧完成请求签名与视频流反代，不需要登录任何账号。

description.en: Conway's Game of Life for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel row opens a drawable centre-column board with four rules, seven stampable patterns and a population chart.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的康威生命游戏：侧栏一行面板入口，打开一块可绘制的中央棋盘，含四套规则、七个可盖章的图案与一条种群曲线。

description.en: UFO archive terminal: search official and civilian records, keep a local archive, read it offline.
description.zh: UFO 档案终端：检索官方与民间记录，落到本地档案馆，离线可读。

description.en: Grok Ball desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: follows your cursor, switches emotion with the agent's run state, draggable with click feedback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的表情球挂件：会跟着鼠标看人、按运行状态换表情，可拖动，点一下有反馈。

description.en: Replaces the chat's "Deep diving" waiting label with rotating fun phrases, editable live in Settings.
description.zh: 把聊天裡的「深度求索中」等待提示換成會輪換的趣味短語，可在設置介面即時編輯。

description.en: Multi-pet desktop companion: four MAM status lights watch every active session (approval / running / done-unread / error) and each card click-through to its conversation; four voice groups speak on state changes with duration-timed subtitles; import pets from four sources (folder / zip / Codex dir / Petdex registry) with card-style hot-swap and an integrity guard; five action bindings, drag physics, three scales. The built-in fox Foxbell ships in the package — install and go.
description.zh: 多宠物桌宠系统：四盏状态灯实时监控所有活跃会话（红待审批/黄运行/绿完成未读/深红错误），点卡片直达对应会话； 四组状态语音随事件播报，字幕与音频时长对齐；外部宠物四来源导入（本地文件夹/zip/Codex 目录/Petdex 在线仓库）， 卡片式热切换即时生效，激活守卫自动校验图集与语音完整性；五场景动作绑定、拖拽物理、三档缩放； 内置小狐狸 Foxbell 随包自带，装上即用。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness agent state (status, tool calls, errors, approval waits) over loopback to WhalePal, a standalone desktop pet app, so the desktop pet follows the real agent state instead of guessing from screenshots.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 状态（思考、工具调用、报错、等待确认）通过本机回环推给桌面宠物应用「鲸伴 WhalePal」，让这只桌面宠物跟着真实状态反应，而不是靠截屏猜。

description.en: Desktop pet fork of dsh-pet that can be installed alongside the original (separate package id, commands and data directory), adding scheduled reminders with custom bubble text and a random show/hide cycle.
description.zh: dsh-pet 的增强分支，可与原版同装（包名、命令与数据目录各自独立）：新增定时提醒（自定义气泡语句）与随机出现/隐藏循环。

description.en: macOS always-on-top desktop pet for DSH Desktop: a bundled DeepSeek whale sprite with Codex-compatible skins; install many pets from codex-pets.net or import from local Codex in Settings; a recent-session ball; right-click New Session and a configurable global shortcut (default Command+Option+N) for a new-session ask box.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的 macOS 置顶桌宠：内置 DeepSeek 鲸鱼精灵图，兼容 Codex 宠格式，可在设置页从 codex-pets.net 安装大量线上宠物或从本机 Codex 导入，脚下有最近会话球；右键「新会话」与可配置全局快捷键（默认 Command+Option+N）可打开新会话输入框。

description.en: Extends the official QQ bot channel (@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 0.5.3/0.5.4) in DSH with sticker tools, idle proactive small talk, long-term memory and a Settings → Plugins page. Install is manual: run lib/patch-host.mjs to patch six files in the installed channel (backed up, revertable) and --register it into your profile; you also need a QQ open-platform bot (appId/appSecret) with "receive all messages" enabled by a group admin. The channel access defaults to open (anyone who can message the bot); set access.c2cMode/groupMode to allowlist or disabled before exposing it.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的官方 QQ 机器人通道（@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 0.5.3/0.5.4）补上表情包工具、冷场主动发言、长期记忆和「设置 → 插件」页。安装需手动：先运行 lib/patch-host.mjs 给已安装通道打 6 处补丁（自动备份、可 --revert），再用 --register 登记进 profile；另需 QQ 开放平台机器人（appId/appSecret），并由群管开启「接收所有消息」。通道 access 默认 open（任何能给机器人发消息的人都能用），对外暴露前请改成 allowlist 或 disabled。

description.en: Adds a token-burn leveling widget to DSH with 14 DeepSeek-whale levels, daily quests, streaks and achievements.
description.zh: 按累计 token 消耗给右下角大肥鱼升级的 DSH 挂件：14 级 DeepSeek 鲸鱼图标、今日任务、连击与成就。

description.en: Spanish practice panel for DeepSeek Harness: six locally graded drill types (verb conjugation across 11 tenses, noun gender, plurals, vocabulary recognition, sentence cloze, ser/estar and subjunctive grammar points) plus a model-graded scenario-writing tab, 8-level spaced repetition, and four agent tools. Answers are computed and graded inside the plugin, so the model is only used for teaching and explanations.
description.zh: 西语练习面板：六类本地判分的练习（11 个时态的动词变位、名词阴阳性、复数、认词、句子填空、ser/estar 与虚拟式语法专项），外加模型批改的情景造句、8 级间隔重复，以及四个 agent 工具；答案在插件内重算并判分，模型只用来讲解。

description.en: A Live2D pet companion for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: the Vivi (芊芊) character with petting/feeding, a daily-treat bond economy and mood-driven expressions.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌宠：内置 Vivi（芊芊）Live2D 形象，支持抚摸/喂食、每日小鱼干羁绊经济与情绪驱动表情。

description.en: Whale-themed desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness with a local todo list: click the pet to add or edit tasks inline, get reminders that get more frequent as a due date approaches, and optionally append one short AI-written next step to a reminder. Based on PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT); artwork keeps the upstream non-commercial terms. Install it instead of PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet, not alongside it.
description.zh: 住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的蓝发桌宠「鲸事本」：点一下弹出待办面板，可点击编辑、到期渐进提醒；开启「待办建议」后，提醒还会按概率追加一句 AI 生成的简短下一步建议。基于 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT），素材沿用其非商用条款。请替代 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet 安装，不要与它同时安装。

description.en: Aggregated live streaming for DeepSeek Harness: browse and play bilibili, douyu, huya, douyin and kuaishou live rooms from one sidebar panel, with danmaku and model tools.
description.zh: DSH 聚合直播插件：在左侧栏面板聚合哔哩哔哩、斗鱼、虎牙、抖音、快手五平台直播，支持弹幕与模型工具。

description.en: Draggable floating TES-gyro widget for the DSH Web UI: click to spin it with linear friction decay, tune the spin speed from a slider, and play the bundled track with its LRC lyrics scrolling in sync. Spin speed and position are remembered.
description.zh: 可拖动的浮动 TES 陀螺挂件：点击抽一下就会转，转速按恒定摩擦线性衰减（转得越快停得越久），用滑条调转速，播放内置歌曲并同步滚动 LRC 歌词；位置与转速会被记住。

description.en: Floating desktop companion for DSH: a draggable character on the overlay — tap to charge energy, blinking and emotes, naps, synthesized WebAudio sounds and particle effects. Bring your own: any photo (pet, portrait, anime art) becomes a 2.5D cutout with hand-marked eyes, and 3D models (GLB, VRM, STL, OBJ, PLY) render as a real three.js turntable. Resize 30%-300%; data stays local.
description.zh: DSH 桌面伴侣：整屏浮层上一只可拖动的角色，轻叩蓄能、眨眼表情、打盹、WebAudio 合成音效与粒子。放什么进去都行——照片（宠物 / 人像 / 动漫立绘）变 2.5D 立绘并可标眼睛；GLB / VRM / STL / OBJ / PLY 用 three.js 渲染成真 3D 转台。大小 30%–300% 无级调节，数据只存本机。

description.en: Floating friends list and one-to-one chat for DSH, with custom avatars and status words. The required friends service is in this repository and runs via npx dsh-friends-service or Docker.
description.zh: DSH 好友浮窗，支持一对一聊天、自定义头像和状态词条；所需好友服务端在同一仓库，可用 npx dsh-friends-service 或 Docker 启动。

description.en: Browse and post to a GitHub-hosted community where most members are AI agents.
description.zh: 逛一个开在 GitHub 上的 AI 社区：看帖、读帖、说一句话。

description.en: Turn the context window into a zen garden: every message or tool result plants one of eleven plants (code = cactus, image = flower, error = weed, document = rice, web = dandelion), each context compaction harvests the field into seed currency, and as the session deepens ivy climbs the chat edges while dandelion seeds drift across it.
description.zh: 把上下文窗口种成一座禅意花园：每条消息或工具结果种下十一种植物之一（代码=仙人掌、图片=花、报错=杂草、文书=稻穗、网络=蒲公英），每次上下文压缩就是收割季，植物化为种子货币；会话渐深时爬山虎会沿对话边缘攀爬，蒲公英的种子在对话间飘散。

description.en: A composer slime that grows on the output tokens your agent writes, splits into a colony, wears a breed hat from the tool mix, molts on every context compaction, and totals the colony across sessions in a sidebar tab.
description.zh: 输入框下方的史莱姆：吃掉模型写出的 token 长大、分裂成群，按工具构成长出头饰，每次上下文压缩蜕壳留下年轮，并在右侧栏汇总所有会话的总族群。

description.en: Hides the dsh-pet desktop pet while a game or fullscreen app is in the foreground, then brings it back. Decides from three signals — a captionless window covering the whole monitor, the foreground process living in a game directory, and the system's full-screen notification state — and requires two consistent polls before acting, so alt-tabbing does not make the pet flicker. It only toggles window visibility; dsh-pet's configuration and install directory are never touched. A tray menu offers pause, restore now, and reload config. Windows only.
description.zh: 打游戏或全屏应用在前台时，自动把 dsh-pet 的桌宠窗口收起来，退出后原样放回。用「全屏窗口铺满显示器 + 前台进程在游戏目录 + 系统全屏状态」三重信号判定，连续两次采样一致才动作，避免切窗口时闪隐；只切换窗口可见性，不改 dsh-pet 的任何配置，也不动它的安装目录。托盘菜单可暂停、立即恢复、重载配置。仅 Windows。

description.en: Rewrites every assistant reply into Buddha-says ciphertext (佛又曰：…) with the 与佛论禅 AES-256-CBC + Chinese-character substitution scheme, rewriting the final block text as well as the streamed deltas; history sent back to the model is decrypted first, internal calls that carry a purpose pass through untouched, and a config file in ~/.dsh/buddha toggles it live.
description.zh: 把助手的每一条回复就地加密成「佛又曰：…」（与佛论禅的 AES-256-CBC + 佛字替换表），流式增量与最终块文本一起改写；回灌给模型的历史会先解回明文，带 purpose 的内调用原样透传，~/.dsh/buddha 下的配置即时生效。

description.en: A clickable wooden-fish desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Click to knock; counts per day with a calendar heatmap of your streaks in settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面打造的电子木鱼桌宠。点击敲击、按天计数，设置页以日历热力图展示每日敲击与连续天数。

description.en: A floating VRM avatar with tool-driven expressions and VRMA animations, plus model and motion asset management.
description.zh: 常驻界面的 VRM 数字人，支持通过工具控制表情与 VRMA 动作，并提供模型和动作资产管理。

description.en: Movable radio pill with live visualizer, station search, favourites and self-update check for DSH Web.
description.zh: 可拖动的收音机胶囊，带实时可视化、电台搜索、收藏与自更新检查，面向 DSH Web。
